Pink lemonade is one of my ultimate favorites! They also have a truck that drives around with several flavors that you can get - they're also at farmers' markets!

I am sorry for the natives of Pennsylvania are deluded enough to rate any PA liquor store so highly.  Being larger and prettier than the dumpy stores like 10th and Wharton and the one that used to be on Chestnut doesn't mean it still doesn't suck.  The employees also seems less surly, which is nice.  Therefore, it's worth one more star than the non "Fine" stores.

However, it's still the same crappy selection, overpriced wine, and clueless staff.  "Sparkling Shiraz?  Never heard of that!"

Please, go to NJ, then come back and still rate this 4 or 5 stars, and then come see me and I'll slap some sense into you.

So far, I am not impressed.
Recently opened up a couple accounts since they offer no foreign ATM fees with certain accounts that qualify. Was tired of the double dipping ATM fees from Citizens.
Our debit cards were ordered over a month ago and nothing in the mail and not a single call from the bank to advise they are there for collection.
I tried to call them to confirm they are at our local branch and after going through the automated system to try and reach a human, it rings and they hang up the phone. Let's see how this plays out.

In my opinion, nothing beats Dunkin Donuts. This location has been in business for a few years and I have been going to this Dunkin almost everyday since it opened....yea...i know. No matter who they have had working inside, the drive through moves very quickly, and i cant really point out a time where they messed up any of my orders with the exception of hot coffee instead of iced which really is not a big deal. For the most part, Dunkin can be known as being reliable and always available to provide a great cup of coffee, bagel, or donut. Overall, you cant go wrong with this specific location.

This Dunkin is normally pretty reliable, however, the other night I ordered a large vanilla iced coffee, with cream and sugar through the drive through. I paid for it and drove off. The coffee immediately had an odd taste to it. Upon further tasting I realized that the person who made my coffee failed to know the difference between vanilla syrup and peach syrup. 

Incase you're wondering....Peach coffee is not good. At all. 

Get it straight Dunkin Harleysville...oh and seriously...cold beverages get liquid sugar and not granulated sugar...granulated doesn't dissolve and settles at the bottom of the cup. Sheesh.

Miller Tire fully deserves 5 stars.  While not serving up soft shell crabs and great wine, they excel at what they do - provide excellent repair service at fair prices.  They also give you great prices on new tires.  We are in there several times a year for oil changes, tire rotations, and inspections.  Always a smooth courteous experience.  I don't even bother checking Costco for prices, I just deal with Steve ( Yeah, Steve Miller, would you believe it?)  and Roger.  Honeestly, I have never heard of anyone complaining about them, either.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I was looking for a new place to grab pizza since Dominick's went so far down hill. Really just stopped by this place because it was next door to where I was stopping for ice cream. I'm glad I did. They have excellent pizza! Actually, it was the best slice of pizza I had in quite some time (actually had 4). We also had the broccoli rabe appetizer and it was cooked perfectly and not bitter at all. The service was friendly. They did make a few mistakes with the orders but they fixed them without any problem. I've found my new pizzeria in the area!

I have used this Hertz location a few times. Usually things are smooth and quick except one occasion where I went to pick up my assigned rental car from the parking stall that was numbered but it wasn't there. I couldn't find anyone nearby to help me so I went to the Hertz office and had to wait in line for 20 minutes in order to get helped. I felt like the person at the counter didn't really care about my situation and was probably frustrated with all the other people in front of me that weren't happy with the wait time in line.

We sat for 10 minutes before our waiter even showed up, he took our order and disappeared for 20 minutes. Finally once everyones glass was empty he came back and took another 10 to refill a beer, a glass of wine and a diet coke.   Forty minutes in and we still haven't gotten our dinner. The 2 tables behind us who came 20 minutes after us have received their meals though. Oh, and the manager came to talk to a table behind us and propped herself oh my chair. I leaned back to give her a hint, aaaaand nothing. She stayed there until she was good and done, then removing her hand.

Perhaps we just had some bad luck but I cannot say I enjoyed this restaurant at all. I've been here many times and had great food and drinks. On Friday, July 22, we decided to make our way to Tampa and were so very much looking forward to a lovely meal. Sadly, it was not even close to our expectations.  The grouper tasted as if it were cooked in maple syrup. It was so sugary. The Caesar salad was overpriced for the quality and not once were we offered bread. Not one to complain we finished our meal and vowed to never return.

I don't know why I keep going here other than its about 2 min from my house. About 95% of the time I go through the drive thru, they forget half my order. Tonight my family and I sat in the drive thru for at least 10 minutes waiting to pay and get our food. And true to form, they forgot my hamburger. I got a smug "Sorry" when I was like where the hell is my burger??!! About 50% of the time, the fries are cold. If you go inside, the restaurant is moderately clean. I have better experiences elsewhere. If you go here, MAKE SURE you check your order before you leave the drive thru, cause it probably will not all be there.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I'm never over the top with my ratings, but I must say that this was a great hotel.  I loved the modern, sexy feel that was just a few steps from Bourbon St.  

With all that was great about this hotel, it was the knowledge and skill of the staff.  This would have been a normal stay without the work of Special K and Rico.  These guys were the dynamic duo that helped these first timers big time.  Special K is the concierge that knows everthing! Listen to this guy.  If you decide to stay somewhere else, still stop by to see this guy.  Tell him that R&R sent you.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Every once in awhile I get a hankering for a Gyro.  Well, after going to Bosna I am going to have to add Doner kabob sandwiches to my list of desires.  The bread was good and the gyro meat that fills it had a wonderful flavor.  We also tried a sandwich which I cannot pronounce that had chicken, peppers, and mushrooms on it.  It was good but not as good as the Doner was.  They had an interesting chip item as well.  I guess you would call it a chip.  It was puffed like cheese puffs but shaped and flavored like peanuts.  I am going to have to go back just to try those out along with my sandwich.

I was in Nashville for a girl's weekend with 6 other friends.  After calling a few places around town that had no openings for 7 pedicures, we called Apex.  The man who answered the phone said they could do pedicures for 7 right away!  We showed up and got started.  When I told them I read about Apex on Yelp, the man was super nice and brought us complimentary glasses of wine.  They were all very friendly and the price was definitely reasonable.  My friend who lives in Nashville said she would be coming there again.  There are some cute shops around the strip mall, too.

Great for the money. You can't beat it at $35 a month.  Most people who go there are nice and normal, and the employees are helpful.  It's a friendly environment to work out in.  Equipment, however, is indeed dated, but it gets the job done for sure.  The building itself, needs some major maintenance, which is really my only complaint.  The ceiling looks like it might fall in from water damage and the gym itself is WAY too hot in the summer.  I'm sweating before I even start working out.  Other than this, it's a GREAT place, especially for the price you pay.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Clean Subway with a well-maintained dining room, friendly staff, fully stocked and to spec toppings list, and some ever-important attention to detail.

I discovered this Subway by accident when I overshot starbucks on a telephone call.

They have $3 subs each day and the special of the day varies.

Unlike other US locations, this south philly location has sweet peppers. Also cucumbers and some other nice fresh surprises.

In LA, they have avocados and cilantro.  South philly has different cheeses and peppers. Yaay subway.

Loved this hotel!

I travel alot for work and have stayed at quite a few Westins. This one is now my favorite. We had a view of Busch Stadium from our huge, gorgeous room and just happened to be staying on the eve of a Cardinals game. Made for a fun energy in the hotel and surrounding area. 

The hotel felt clean and newly renovated and the staff were very friendly. I loved our gigantic bathroom (the Heavenly shower is amazing!). The only suggestion I have for the Westin... lose the scary modern art hanging above the bath tub. I don't need or want to read and think about words like "scar" and "dying" while getting ready for bed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Wanted to try this place after I had good experience at Blackfish. Food was decent and ambiance was cozy as well. I had chicken liver pate and short rib. Chicken liver pate is one of my favorite dishes so I usually get it whenever I see them on the menu. Sadly it was just average. Not bad but not good either. Liked their creamy texture but was lack on flavor, they gave you a lot of brioche though. Beef short rib dish was pretty good but was little too sweet in my opinion. For me, 4 or 5 star on yelp means I would like to go back. This place more like 3.5 star or above but just not a 4 star...

So so so good. I love their salad and Italian seafood grill. I have been there multiple times but once I had just ok meal. My seafood grill was overly cooked that day. I hated the texture of my rubbery calamari and dry swordfish that day. 

Last night I asked the server that I prefer not over cooked seafood. She was so kind and said she will make sure. And my dish was phenomenon. Was sooooo good and the best grilled seafood I had. I was super satisfied. 

We also got shaved  sprout salad, garlic bread, meatball and vongole pasta. They were all delicious.  We really enjoyed them all. 
I can eat there everyday.

Fresh sushi/ sashimi is my favorite meal. I can literally eat 3 times per day! I was so eager to find my favorite Japanese restaurant once I came to Philly. Zama was my first try. Location is good and ambiance is typical Japanese restaurant. Tried uni, tuna, fatty tuna, salmon, salmon roe sashimi. Those are my favorite so I get them wherever I go. They were good but not outstanding. I thought price was little high for what it is.. But I still go there for quick lunch since location is so awesome for me and I do like that intimate ambiance to chat with my friends. If price was little lower I would give 4 star.

Although difficult to spot at first, this restaurant is unforgettable once you give it a try! We made really good decisions from the menu and were treated with outstanding food and service! The highlight of my meal was the roasted chicken dish with asparagus and creamy grits. It tasted like mama's home cooking and it was oh-so-right. This is a great place for a date or a nice dinner - very dimly lit with an exciting menu and sweet waitstaff who went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable. Five stars! (I love giving 5 stars to places so close to home.)

Lived next to this place for years and just recently decided to walk in. When there are so many options in Chinatown, it is difficult to try everything! I really regret not trying this sooner - it is really just a high quality Chinese restaurant. The service is unbeatable - they are kind, attentive and helpful and let you take your time while finishing your meal.

The pan-fried dumplings were great, and so were our other dishes. Ho Sai Gai is also open late and they have carry-out beer. Definitely make your way here if you are looking for a casual, Chinese meal.

I have eaten here several times and have generally enjoyed it until last night.  My son and I came in and ordered boneless wings, which were delicious.  Then I ordered a cup of the chicken velvet soup and told the waitress it was my favorite, and I also got the appetizer trio.  My son got a buffalo chicken wrap.  My appetizer trio came out and was burnt.  How you burn potstickers and breadsticks I will never know.  His wrap was dry and didn't taste good.  We paid and left and I realized I never got my soup.  Disappointed in this experience.

Been going here for my car wash and oil change for years.

Never had any problems with workers or owners (koreans). Friendly service for the most part. I really like the free car wash with an oil change service. It's a fairly priced oil change. Not cheapest deal, however not over the top price. One time I had an air filter change there also and afterwards my service light went on after I drove. I immediately drove back to asked what happened. They apologized and fixed the issue asap. 

My only complaint here is sometimes the car wash isn't perfect.

Will I keep going back here? Yes.

This is in the strip mall near Marsh and Arby's. 

Atmosphere is very bright and colorful. We visited on opening weekend and it was packed with a few folks waiting. We enjoyed great food and service. We had fajitas for two, which was a huge amount of food. Our chips and salsa were always filled and there was a children's menu as well. Total bill was about $25 before tip (there was a 10% discount for opening weekend). The manager came around to ask how our food was, which I always appreciate. If it is cold outside, ask to be seated away from the entrance as the breeze blows in through the entry ways.

Bo's is a Tampa institution.  It incites feelings of nostalgia to wait in line at the old fashioned ice cream stand.  Bo's offers cones, dip cones, shakes, sundaes, splits, thick n' chunkies, slushies, and even hot dogs.  The prices are a bit steeper than a fast food ice cream, but the quality is worth it.  For ice cream lovers, there is something for everyone at Bo's.  I highly recommend the Thick n' Chunky (like blizzards).  They are HUGE (even the small) and so very good.  You also can't go wrong with a good old fashioned ice cream cone!

I've been going back and forth between a 2 and 3 star review.  Here are my arguments for each:

2 star:  Brown lettuce in the Caesar salad.  Chicken spiedini boasts a healthy and delicious meal.  It was healthy, but extremely bland.  Fiance' ordered the butternut squash pasta and it just wasn't that great.

3 star:  Great, friendly service.  Affordable prices.  Comically large bottle of wine for $30, which they vacuum sealed for us upon leaving.

In the end, not the greatest experience and I was definitely glad I had a gift card.  Next time I have a gift card, I may use it at Chilis instead of Macaroni Grille.

Worst experience in all my years dealing with a rental car and having a reservation where I didn't drive a car off the rental lot. Steve (yes you with the beard and ponytail) you had an opportunity to at least try and assist and make this business transaction right on top of the foul thing you did with not moving my reservation earlier this week). I got it...messaged received, customer doesnt come 1st. I'll go high since you went low. Review will tell you where I am with them and my p@#t off level (Very high)

Worst experience in all my years dealing with a rental car and having a reservation where I didn't drive a car off the rental lot. Steve (yes you with the beard and ponytail) you had an opportunity to at least try and assist and make this business transaction right on top of the foul thing you did with not moving my reservation earlier this week). I got it...messaged received, customer doesnt come 1st. I'll go high since you went low. Review will tell you where I am with them and my p@#t off level (Very high)...

Failed it, horrible, poor, out the window. This was the worst fast food customer service Ive experienced in a long time. Not a good trip through this drive thru tonight placing an order. Ordered  some garlic parm wings, fresh fries, and an Orange cream smoothie. They tell me it's a 6 min wait on wings and fries. I was fine with that. I prefer my order fresh and hot. I xidnt appreciate how it was over a 30 min wait and they ran out of Apple pies. The complimentary  ones were forgotten to be given out. This was a bad night for he customer at this checkers. They really dropped the ball on this.

I live close by and I hate this place so much that even though it would be the quickest place for me to go here, I avoid this place and just do without.

Aside from the fact that's it's dirty, my biggest complaint is that it always takes at least 10 minutes to get through through the check out aisles, and that's if you're lucky and there's only 1 person in front of you. 

I've never hated a grocery store as much as I hate this grocery store. I hope this place goes out of business and new management comes in.

This is the place I usually get my prescription glasses (regular and sunglasses). As noted, the staff is fantastic and they really know their product. This place can get busy, and so best to try to come at odd times (no lunch or after work) if you don't want to wait to get help selecting frames. 

I used to get my eyes checked at a UPenn Hospital eye clinic, but the wait list at UPenn was often long, and it seems like if you get your eye exam at Modern Eye they also give you an extra discount on frames/lenses, and so it more or less evens out $wise, and so now I also have my eye exam here.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
First time visitor. Tried to make my own pizza. Pretty standard ingredients to gauge how good the pizza is:

Traditional dough
Tomato sauce
Shredded mozzarella 
Chicken
Red onion
Green peppers

Verdict: chicken is super dry and lacks any flavor. Tomato sauce is nonexistent on the pizza, rendering it dry. It just felt like eating pizza dough.

Disclaimer: I did not use any finishing touches for this pizza.

Customer service: excellent!! Super friendly staff. No wait. Took about 5 minutes from entering to exit. And this was at 12:30pm. Impressive during a lunch rush.

Make sure to order as soon as possible if you decide to get pick up or delivery because it takes a good 45- 90 minutes. I've ordered delivery twice and I live about 5 mins from the restaurant.  It took over an hour both times for the food to come.  But when it did come, it was amazing.  Totally worth the wait. The Tacos Supreme with shredded beef is delicious, all the varieties of tacos are bomb, the shredded beef Tortas is amazing! I've also eaten in the restaurant and it's a very casual and relaxed atmosphere. Place is very clean and the service is prompt.

Aggressively mediocre. My husband and I had vegetable burritos. While large, the rice was bland, most of the veggies frozen. If it weren't for the chipotle sauce, mine would have been nearly inedible. My husband did not benefit from the chipotle sauce, and as hungry as he was, only ate half of his. The chips were thick, cold and served with Taco Bell like guacamole. Fresh avocados aren't so expensive that you should fail to make your own; especially when you have lots of (marginally better) area competitors nearby that do.

Hopefully my fellow reviewers won't rip me for my 4 star review.  I truly love Saku and very happy that the lunch specials are also available on saturday and as late as 3 p.m.  I went for the spicy salmon, spicy tuna and eel rolls.  I thought that the spicy tuna need a bit more bite (personal opinion since a desired level of bite varies for all of us) and the eel was actually hot and I believe should be served warm.  The spicy salmon was perfect.  And the staff and manager are extremely attentive.  I definitely plan on returning in the future.

I told my dining partner that we haven't had mexican in a while and she said that she had a great time on her last (and 1st) visit to Feliz.  It was relatively sparse at 5:30 p.m. on a Friday but was nearly full when we left at 7 p.m.  We had the quacamole and chips as an appetizer and the quac was among the best I have had.  Truly fresh tasting. I also had the crab on the side but didn't go well with the quac.  I had the fish tacos and my partner had the mushroom tacos.  I have had better fish tacos but the mushroom tacos were fantastic.  Service was very good.  We shall return in the future.

Room was great, bed was very comfortable. Shower was pure genius 
Handles for shower was on one side of the shower so you don't get full of water.

Ok my only complaint is about the valet.
No one was there to greet us or offer to help us with our bags.
We have a brand new suv and it was very clean. Prior to checking out, I called for our suv. 
They brought it back full of bird shit, yes bird shit. All over the hood and grill. 
So was very disappointed in the condition and service of valet department. 
I ask the valet if he parked "in bird shit town"
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Love this one of a kind yogurt spot. The location is perfect right inside if the south street square. My favorite is the blood orange yogurt with a scoop of sweet coconut on the top. Other notable yogurts are the plain Greek yogurt, salted caramel and pistachio. The place is super clean too. The only thing I noticed was that the topping were accessible by children, and we all know that they sometimes like to stick their hands in things, while mom & dad aren't looking. Which can make some people a little leary, including myself. But overall it's in a great location and a great addition to the graduate hospital neighborhood.

Worst Subway ever! This used to be a good branch under the old nice guy management last year, but since the new idiot manager came in, this place took a huge dive. I tried to stop in for a late dinner at 8:45pm, the posted hours in the window saying it was open until 9:00pm, but the doors were locked. The manager was inside and he looked right at me and then just ignored me. Guess he didn't want the business. No problem buddy, Jimmy John's is just down the street and is now cheaper with the recent Subway jumps from $5 to $6 on Footlongs. Jimmy John's is now my new place for subs. Adioso Subway in Wayne.

As I was waddling my pregnant butt (37weeks) towards the door to get myself a sandwich, someone working inside locked the door....

It was 2:20pm on a Saturday afternoon(7/24). Hours posted on the door didn't say anything about closing in the afternoon but oh, well. 

Was going to be my first time to this Subway, but it also looks like it will be my last.

No, reason. 

Waddled my butt back to the car and off to another sandwich shop. 

Just another store making their own hours due to short-staffed I hope.....??

We booked  a spur of the moment post kids football party there this afternoon. 30 people... They were very nice and our servers tried hard And kept a smile on their faces... Our food was good bar food served with a smile. You can't top that. I highly recommend landmark in stafford for a large group... I'd even consider this spot for an office party or reunion. Way to go landmark and thank you! (No I do not work there or own the place lol). I loved my sunny burger (a jucy burger with fried egg) lots of our group loved the wings too.

Wayne is needed a sushi place for a little while now. Sushi Nami was for sure a welcome addition. I found the atmosphere and menu  to be fairly basic. No real wow factor here but that said it is nice to have predictable basic Japanese food available at a great location. I only went for lunch and they are relatively new so I'm hoping that they will expand the specialty roll choices and add a few more interesting items when they get a little more settled. I will likely visit this location a lot because of convenience and happy to expand my review and update as they get more settled.

This is a Slightly above average pizza joint in Coatesville. I went here because another yelper called the pizza greasy... To me greasy equals gooey. 
The pizza was adequate... I have had much worse and I've had much better. It was thin enough but crust was pretty bland.The cheesesteak that I split with my husband was pretty big and pretty good. My husband ordered it with light mayo which counter acted the over cooked meat. I ate my entire half.  I will come back because the staff is friendly and there are not many choices in the area. (My son goes to a special needs school near by. )

Against my better judgement, I ordered off the "4 Courses for $20" Menu, which says it all.  At that price, I shouldnt expect much.  The bread, which I expect decent bread at an Italian place, was blah. Course 1 was a bruschetta which was really good and easily the best course. The app choice was salad or soup, I had the salad which was just limp greens with a terrible vinagrette- supposedly the house dressing. The entree, dessert, & sangria weren't any better.  The waiter was nice but timing was a little off.  I see a lot of people here refering to this being a step up from Olive Garden but I dont see it.

Will not go back. I have been there twice with my 3 year old. Once for her first haircut and recently for a trim. For her first haircut, I explained that I wanted a clipping and the gal gave me an envelope with what was basically shavings - nothing I could save. The recent haircut was supposed to trim the back and clean it up and it was uneven on the left and right sides and the ends different in length as much as a half an inch in some places. It is more atmosphere than actual skill. I will find another salon for my daughter.

An Asian Buffet that does not scare or disappoint.

No frills, just good hot and fresh food!  

The Sushi is not 5 Star but it is certainly tasty as is pretty much all the other food served on the steam tables. Even the fish filet was not over cooked!  

From the outside the place looks kinda, well less than appealing. But when you walk inside the restaurant is bright and clean and the food is displayed very appealingly. 

Don't go here for ambiance or High end service, go here for VERY a reasonably priced buffet for lunch or dinner and you will leave a happy and full camper!

This place has a more limited selection than some of the other state run liquor stores. On top of that, they were out of a few things when I was there.

The store is also a bit grungy and in need of a makeover.

That being said, I found the staff extremely helpful. When I couldn't find what I was looking for, one of the employees checked the back for me, then called another store for me to locate the item.

On a return visit, I found what I was looking for and also noted that checkout was extremely efficient.

Don't waste your time and money. I scammed out of $270 and nothing was fixed. 
With a "loud exhaust" I asked them to find it and fix it. They needlessly ripped out a piece of the exhaust. Then spent another 90 minutes "securing" the heat shields. Total BULL. 

When I got home.... the sound was still there, and we found that the heat shields were GONE! CUT OFF - not secured. Called manager, and got a load of bull. He claimed they weren't necessary. Very different story than "You're all fixed up, should be a quiet ride and all is secure with the exhaust" 

I got robbed - at an exhaust specialist... they could not fix the exhaust.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
When Pie in the Sky Pizza is very good, it's great - some of the best pizza in Nashville, but they aren't very consistent with requests.

For example, I like my pizza extra crispy with light sauce.  They either get it right or screw it up.  With tonight's pizza the screw up to get it right ratio is skewed in favor of screwed.

I splurge on the calories of pizza every once in a while and I want it right - and it really, really bugs me that they get it wrong so often.

I just won't go back again, they've had 5 tries and it's been right 2 times.

I have lunch here a couple of times a month. It's a strip mall location with seating for about 25. You order at the counter and they bring the food to your table. 

Food has always been well cooked (tender crisp veggies and well done meat).  No complaints about freshness of food and staff is friendly. Never had to wait too long for food to be served and never had more than a couple of people in line to order before me. 

Good menu selection and they are willing to make changes when requested. Overall a well run establishment for a low budget Chinese food restaurant.

Cute little house converted into a restaurant. The inside is lovely and clean. We went for brunch which was probably more affordable than their dinner menu. I had the omelette which came with sun dried tomato- it was kind of bland and the tomato was hard to chew. My husband had the eggs Benedict which was really good. The truffle fries with Parmesan were great. The service was also very good. Coffee was eh. While they were very flexible about leaving meat out of dishes they could definitely use some more vegetarian options. I guess I had high expectations. I'm sure their dinner is outstanding.

We stayed here for 5 nights in early May 2009.  The hotel is being renovated, so not everything is ready for use.  For you Starbucks fans, that store is open.  Our 10th floor room had beautiful views of the Arch and the Old Courthouse!  The staff was very nice.  We had to ask for a small fridge and you have to pay about $10 a day for WiFi (which I think should be free).

Please note that there is valet parking for $25 a night, but if you go two blocks north to Mansion House you can self park for quite a bit less.  They told us it was $19 a night to self-park, but we never spent more than $11.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Saw it on Yelp so had to give it a try.

Plenty of parking, walked in, ordered food, watched the guy grab a handful of meat and put it on the tortila then hand me the plate, walked to the salsa bar and sat down to eat.  I can see how the salsa bar could be a bottleneck at lunch.

I had beef and pork and the beef was better than the pork.  both were ok.  maybe a little dry but it was 4 in the afternoon so the meat was probably cooked for lunch.

The price is good, the service is fast and the food is ok.  I think I like Los Tarascos better but Lilly's isn't bad.

This us a smallish Dunkin Donuts. It gets the job done but has limited seating and feels a little claustrophobic. Stick with the munchkins and mix n match. I don't know who can eat while donuts? You gluttons. I prefer a nice indie bakery. They don't do the deals here other Dubkins do cuz they on da beach.. There's a new DQ up the road next to Palm Pavilion FYI. And like 70 indie ice cream parlors within two blocks. Clear Sky is good eats. But gets busy. That is all. Oh and people like the new Coney Island hotdog place out toward Palm Pavilion and away from the round about..

A terrific addition to downtown New Port Richey. Right across the street from Simms Park, this lovely market is a great spot for coffee and tea or to pick up ice cream. They also have tasty sandwich, wrap, quiche, soup, and salad offerings. There are also some good baked goods from in-house and other local bakers. This is a very enjoyable, friendly and relaxed local market with a convenient local seafood store next door. There isc omfortable seating indoors in a sun porch setting and outdoors (along the Cotee River). A great spot that is helping revive New Port RIchey's downtown.

This is a very contemporary (modern) Mickey Ds. They have digital touchscreen ordering, but you need to have an account so you can log in.

Service is pretty good. The Manager was bringing meals out. But they did forget to give me my sundae so I had to ask for it.   :*( Thank goodness I remembered!!!

Not sure when McDonalds got so fancy. And sepndy. Happy Meal is the best deal. And you can get a fruit with it! Skip the chocolate milk. Weird ingredients and too much sugar.

Burgers are thin. Decent. Fries too salty. But decent. Sundaes are tasty. Nake sure to ask for the nuts with them (free upon request).
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
A year ago, when I visited Midas, the mechanic told me that my battery was unable to hold a charge adequately, and that this would probably result in starting problems and a dead battery.  Then he tried to sell me a new battery and installation for over $100. I refused. 

Turns out my car has had zero problem starting over the past year. This was clearly an attempt to get me to spend more money. Makes me suspect that the supposed "blown tire" was the same. I wish I had refused all service, disputed the charge for the supposedly failed inspection, and brought the car to a more reputable place.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I'm not too harsh and I rarely write reviews ... But wanted to warn you guys. A few months ago I purchased a burrito via the drive thru. I began to eat the burrito and the potatoes were so raw that I had to turn around and return it (overall it was bad quality). Less than 2 minutes had passed and I still had my receipt. I went to tell them about this & they were not very nice about it and said that they don't do refunds. I was grossed out by the place and wasn't interested in anything else after the bad food & service. Long story short ... You get what you get. No guarantees. :-/

Not a good place to wash your car. Unless, you don't actually care about how clean your car will be. 

This car wash is very expensive. Should cost me around $8-11 to clean and vacuum my little Mazda. Today I spent $14 and had to leave before being even remotely close to satisfied with my vehicle. I wasn't about to waste any more on cash on this place. 

There is another spot close to this location on stony plain road (across the street from Tim Hortons). They offer a complimentary undercarriage wash and I can do a good job vacuuming the inside of my vehicle for $2.

This is our favorite Mexican joint in the area (if not favorite restaurant period). The food is fantastic, especially the queso dip. We don't even need menus at this point because we both have our favorites. 

The Fajita Nachos are a lot of food. A half order is usually good for one person. The quesadillas are great for kids even though they have other kids menu items. 

They should be moving soon to the old KFC across the street which should alleviate some of the degradation of the building itself. The facilities are not fantastic but it seems like a short-term rented building at this point so it's hard to mark them down for that.

I met  my girlfriend  for dinner tonight and the dining experience was disappointing  due to the service. We rarely saw our waiter and waited long times for him to visit our table. I am also wondering why a restaurant  charges $3.50  to refill an ice tea. The waiter came to the table,  refilled my tea without asking me and I am charged another $3.50. We were  very unimpressed  with this restaurant,  high prices, small portions and terrible service. You could not pay me to visit this restaurant  again! Awful!!

I know one of the cardinal rules of Chinese take-out is not to eat at a "yellow-sign" Chinese restaurant, but China House proved to be pretty good.
The prices are really good, and the delivery service is very fast. While you're not going to get gourmet chinese food, the food is still really good. The portions are pretty large (for instance 10 steamed dumplings instead of the usual 6), so the price is right if you're buying for a few people.
This is my go-to chinese delivery place. The staff is also always friendly.

Short and sweet:

 Neg- Took over an hour and a half for a pizza with no one in the restaurant or anyone picking up deliveries. This was also their New York crust. 

Pos-Staff was very friendly. 

Neg-Gave us the wrong order. Ordered half-cheese and half-Italian sausage (which was ground). 

Pos- Provided a complimentary pizza. 

Neg- Comp pizza's cheese was not melted 

Neg- pizza was sliced in half...no more.  

I'll alway give a restaurant a second chance, also because I'd love to try their Chicago-style pizza. Stay tuned.

I went here for a co-worker's birthday and really enjoyed their food. 

Overall, the rolls are great. I can't remember what I had, but I know that it was served quickly and was delicious. The rolls were average size, so nothing to complain about. 

The service was not the best because our waitress sometimes did not seem to understand what we were saying but really I don't think that's always a horrible thing. They seemed to try their best to meet our needs. 

I will always give the best sushi in town vote to Sushime, but Samurai is quite good and their location is very convenient as well for a quick sushi stop.

My friend took me there last night. Can we give negative stars?? It's an "Italian" restaurant decorated with cute jazzy pics and posters from New Orleans and plays music from the 50's. Hardly a person in the place, yet the service was the worst I've had in a very long time. The waitress couldn't tell me anything about the wine, the label, where it was from and she thought it was funny... I'm glad she did. The food was edible at best.  I've heard they have good food but don't think I'll goo back to see if I get it next time.  The only redeeming quality of the experience was the company I was keeping!!

My toddler's favorite donut shop, and this is a pretty good location with consistently tasty & fresh donuts and other food. Try the hash brown bites, they are actually great.

They do frequently run out of certain donuts, however, not sure if that's unavoidable or just poor planning. Staff friendliness is a bit hit or miss ... I've had great experiences as well as times where they've made me feel slightly unwelcome.

Toddler factor: No high chair inside and very few tables in general. Wish they at least had a booster seat or two, but no dice.

Solid new spot in Cherry Hill. Great beer selection, local NJ produce and meats as well as a cool market section with many local products for sale. I don't understand all the 1 star reviews - seems overly harsh for a non-chain restaurant which this area desperately needs. Perhaps they would be happier at the Cheesecake Factory?

On our way out we bought some store-made mortadella which was fantastic. I would definitely eat and shop here again. Oh and for lunch I had the grilled wings and minestrone soup. Both were very good. My wife had the triple stacked BLT which was awesome. Our waitress service was good as well, no complaints.

I love this place! 

The few times Ive come here, there wasn't a line and no wait, so we were helped right away. 

Customer service was good and the staff were really friendly. 

I love the variety when it comes to the ice cream. They have both soft serve and hard ice cream, and many types of cones to choose from. They also have water ice. 

When it comes to the prices, they are inexpensive compared to other ice cream/water ice places. 

I would recommend coming here to get ice cream or water ice for your family.

I like dunkin for their iced coffee and stopped getting their hazelnut flavorings cause every time I get it it tastes funny. But once I switched to just a regular iced coffee/ it tastes better. 

Most of the time the service is good and employees are friendly for the most part. 

I also like their bagels with cream cheese and their egg and cheese sandwiches. For a quick and easy breakfast for my 7 year old I prefer this place because she enjoys their sandwiches also and usually eats it all up so it's not a waste of money.

Been coming to this location for about 10 years now, and I really like it. 

Ive had mostly everyone of the cars Ive ever had serviced here and can say that every time I have gone to get something done, I was always pleased. 

Every time I come, they work with me and help me use whatever coupons they have and give me the military discount which is really helpful. 

The owner is a nice guy and he takes the time to work with you when it comes to pricing and service. I always leave happy when my car is brought in and I feel like they do a great job.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Came in for lunch with a party of 3 for the first time. Ended up ordering a bento box which came with vegetable tempura and chicken and shrimp tempura. It was a nice size box with many different items. 

The bento box also came with with 2 sushi rolls and I ended up getting some extra rolls for the table. Everything tasted so good and was fresh. The customer service was great and the service was fast. 

The menu is huge and there's so many items to choose. My aunt had the hibachi because shes not a fan of sushi, and she was raving about how delicious it tasted.

One of my favorite sushi spots. 

Food is always so fresh and the rolls are packed and thick. They have some pretty decent specials which I like including the 50% off sushi rolls on certain ones each day. 

Came in for a late lunch with some friends and were seated right away. The waiter was really good and we didnt have to ask for anything. I ordered a few rolls including a shrimp tempura roll, chicken tempura and a sweet potato roll which Ive never tried before. 

All the rolls were rolled tight and filled with ingredients. I also ordered a miso soup and a salad and they both were tasty.

Came in for a quick stop to use the restroom of all things and figured I'd buy a donut for my daughter. Glad I didn't buy a whole dozen- the glazed and strawberry iced feel hard as rocks- I don't live in the area but come through to pick my daughter up from her father who lives close by. Not a huge fan of dunkin but figured I'd give them a shot and get her a donut when I pick her up- sadly the donuts
 are hard and most likely the $2 I spent just got thrown out the window. Glad it wasn't more. On the plus side the customer service was very good and the interior of the building was very clean!

Love this place and their ice cream. 

Love the fact that they have a drive thru also so its easier access to the ice cream on my lazy days of not wanting to sit out in the son and sweat my a** off. 

I like the variety of flavors that they serve and the fact that they have sundaes for both kids and adults. 

When I visit, I usually get a mint chocolate chip on a waffle cone, and my daughter likes the blue slushie or a vanilla cone, or a sundae that has gummy worms in it. 

The staff is really friendly here and always happy to serve their customers. 

I would be coming here once the weather is warmer.

Everytine I order from Uber Eats the food is fresher then when I acrually go to the location. Very strange that it would be better organized and all my food is actuakly hot abd fresh. 

Ordered a bundle box and all the items were hot and fresh. So delish. I also ordered a box of cookies and they came in a cute box. The cookies smelled so good and were still warm. 

Everything u ordered was tasty and freshly made. I am so satisfied with my meal and my purchase. I think for now on ill just order in rather than go out to the location where I have to deal with bad service, miserable staff and terrible food.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Food was really good here when i ordered from here for dinner. We ended up eating the chicken and broccoli, crab ran goon (which were so hot and fresh) and my daughter got the chicken lo mein. 

We ordered delivery and it came quickly with not much wait. The driver was very friendly and had delivered everything and even gave us a bunch of extras like sauces, tea bags and crunchy noodles. 

The food was hot and fresh and was very flavorful. This was one of the first times I have eaten food from here and me and my daughter were very satisfied with our orders. We will definitely order from here again in the near future.

I don't come here too often because I have a favorite Dunkin, and this isn't the top one I would go to when I need a coffee, but the last couple times Ive come here with my sister in law the iced coffee has been pretty good. 

The service here is like any other Dunkin and is okay, and surprisingly they are pretty quick getting through the customers in line. 

I came in on this day and got an iced coffee with milk and sugar, and an iced tea for my daughter. I don't buy anything else from Dunkin, because i think the donuts taste like crap and not a huge fan of their bagels here, but the coffee and iced tea was really good.

Food is amazing here. Pizza is the best and they use the freshest ingredients. It's a bit more pricey then most pizza places but so worth the extra money. Customer service is always great and the waitstaff is very fast and accommodating. If you go, must try the manicotti or the pollo roso pizza which is white pizza wth chicken onions and ricotta cheese. Best time to go to avoid the crowds is during the week before 7pm. Weekends are always crowded and you need a reservation to get a table. They also have very good desserts. My favorite is the cheesecake with chocolate shell over it. My dad likes the flan and my mom likes tiramisu

Really nice hotel. 
Really large tv that swivels so you can watch it in either room. Bed was soft, comfortable and big so when I was here, I slept really well. 

The room had a small kitchenette with dishes and a stove, if we wanted to cook. The bathroom was really big as well and had a nice double sink. 
The breakfast here wasn't too great, but its probably because of coming during the pandemic. The breakfast consisted of a bagged meal, with muffin, piece of fruit, yogurt and a juice. 

The hotel was overall a good one and a nice stay and was in a great location close enough to walk to the bars and restaurants of honky tonk row.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Food is amazing here. Pizza is the best and they use the freshest ingredients. It's a bit more pricey then most pizza places but so worth the extra money. 
Customer service is always great and the waitstaff is very fast and accommodating. If you go, must try the manicotti or the pollo roso pizza which is white pizza wth chicken onions and ricotta cheese. Best time to go to avoid the crowds is during the week
before 7pm. 
Weekends are always crowded and you need a reservation to get a table. They also have very good desserts. My favorite is the cheesecake with chocolate shell over it. My dad likes the flan and my mom likes tiramisu.

Warning, this is NOT like NYC pizza.

I found and read a review on one of my iPhone apps that said "just like NYC pizza".  Based on that, and since am from NYC,  I thought I would give it a try.

Its looks like your typical strip mall pizza place.  It is what it is, so I was not expecting a fine night of dinning, just a decent pizza. 

I guess the reviewer that claims its like NYC pizza went to NYC and ordered pizza from Domino's,   Porto's pizza is edible, but not very good.  Look elsewhere.  If I find a decent spot in the area, will review

The place looks very inviting.   The service was good.   The menu large and very interesting, maybe a bit light on chicken dishes.   Lots of pork.
Everything looked good.   We had The Ocra with Garlic sauce.  Sadly the ocra was under cooked.   Another 5 minutes and it probably would have brought out the flavor.  We had the chicken with green beans.   The chicken was tasteless, cooked a little too long.   The beans were not cooked long enough, maybe another 5 minutes would have improved the taste.  Alas, the rice was also disappointing.   Dry and tasteless.  Very disappointing experience.

I wasn't sure what to expect from this place. They have barely any social media/internet presence. I had to physically go to the restaurant to find their menu for future takeout options. My boyfriend and I just moved to the area and only because it's the closest Chinese takeout place, we gave it a try. 

And it was awesome. I loved the food! Their vegetable fried rice was the freshest I've ever had. Definitely unique flavors. Everything else was great and fresh and delicious too. Their prices are pretty typical, maybe $0.50-$1.00 more than the norm, but it's obviously worth it, in my opinion.

Always go to B&B for laundry. Their machines are clean and competitively priced for the area-- 2.75 for single loaders, 3.50 for doubles, 4.25 for triples, 25 cents per 10 minutes in the dryer. The place across the street is cheaper, but it's pretty nasty looking. The staff is nice and I've had fun conversations with other people waiting for their laundry to finish. They offer fluff n fold, but I've never done that. If you sit in the front, you can get the free wi-fi from the Daily Grind. It's also across from Cafe Derf, McConnell's and the Daily Grind if you want to get your snack on while the machines are running!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
The worst Starbucks ever! 

I see from other reviews that the drive through is a problem. One would think that after 6 months they would have their act together.

After a 20 minute wait in line for a Grande Cappuccino (couldn't get a pound of Expresso too, as they were out) I drove away with ...TEA. There I was navigating the rush hour traffic, pulled the cup to my mouth and discovered that coffee was tea. How could they mess up a single order ? It wasn't worth my time to battle traffic to go back so, I made note, never to go to this Starbucks again.

This place is very hit or miss.. and lately there has been more of an emphasis on MISS.  The quality and tastiness of the sushi is very inconsistent.  We almost always get the Sex on the Beach and Las Vegas rolls... however, it seems like they never come out the same, one time it's good, the next time it's yuck. 

This place does have some redeeming qualities, such as 1/2 off certain rolls every night & $5 sake bombs all day.  They also give you a small bowl of miso soup to start and FREE (imagine that!) edamame if you sit at the bar.

This place is worth a shot.  Just cross your fingers it's a hit!

Consistently known as the worst McDonald's in the city, likely the world. I've been going here occasionally for over 25 years, since my dad worked down the street for years and I later lived in the neighborhood. I've been to McDonald's restaurants in third-world countries. They were all much nicer. I give 2 stars instead of 1 because one time they gave me a bunch of extra food they'd made by mistake, and the food tastes like it is supposed to. Once you finally get it. Once they correct whatever mistakes they made. Once you get past at least one panhandler and/or rowdy patron - this includes the drive-thru. DAMN, I am being generous here.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Three coins diner. Some of the reviews refer to it as an institution- it definitely looks like its been here for a while, but I hadn't heard of it living in other parts of town. Now as a proud member of the Seminole heights community, I ventured in. Pleasant staff, prompt service on a busy labor day morning. Waitstaff referred to customers by name. 
Menu covers a wide swath of breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Bummed that they didn't serve white gravy with the country fried steak after 11am. Food was good enough for a diner- greasy, and probably would taste better after 2 am. Several of the patrons were colorful. 
Will require a re-visit after dark.

We live in Phila but came here bc it was one of the only ones who offered financing aside from Care credit which of course we didn't qualify for... plus we had puppies delivered here about 12 years ago. Despite some of the reviews here I guess we lucked out and got an ok diagnosis on our dog, I was almost sure she was a goner after the symptoms she was having. Plus I guess if you act like you know what you're talking about they probably don't try to sell you things you don't need, like mechanics; Plus they have barns nearby with all kinds of cool farm animals to watch while you're waiting;

Very clean hotel. My first experience at Aloft. Clean and thick towels, however bed isn't the traditional Heavenly beds and big huge pillows, but comfortable nonetheless. Walls are thin and heard sirens outside during the night.  Receptionist named Nora is very friendly and welcoming and smiley!  

I ate at the bar downstairs--great service, but food was average, almost seemed microwaveable type.  The highlight of the stay was Bliss soap and face wash!   Would definitely stay here again if passing through Philly to stock up on the Bliss products baby!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Serafina Philadelphia was well able to handle Sunday lunch for a group of six for a group of diners that included one celiac, who was thrilled to be able to order a gluten-free pasta dish. The rest of the lunch was solid. Again, wish the table-service bread had been the brioche I had my first visit to Serafina, but I do like the olive oil slurry its served with. The sausage in my build-your-own omelet was singed-to-burnt, but I was able to eat around it--thankfully not a hangry day! The Bresaola pizza was delicious, though a little salty: love the combination of arugula with cured meat!

I randomly came across this nail salon and was pleasantly surprised when I went inside.  The salon is extremely clean and spacious which from the outside did not look like it.  The pedicure chairs are clean and are lined with single use plastic so no worries about germs.  Their spa pedicure is a bargain for all the service you receive!  I also got a gel manicure which surprisingly lasted awhile on my nails since nothing sticks to them! Also you get a paraffin wax deep with any manicure! I definitely would return and have already recommended it to my friends!

A wreck it is!

The place looks like a rusted Chilis, with all the crap hanging on the walls.

I ask the bartender for a Tetanus Shot, she did not get the joke.

Had a crappy homemade shot that cost me $8 and was undrinkable. After that I stopped drinking all together.

I really wasnt impresed with the architecture, the acoustics, the asthetics or the layout or the sanitation levels.

Want a crappy smelly old rotted bar? go to the Buffet at least the drinks are cheap and the bartenders are nicer. Want Country? go to the Maverick.

I had no official intentions on staying, but my flight cancelled and they were the only local hotel that was available; blessing in disguise. Check in process was quick and painless. I made the reservation over the phone, shuttled over, and checked in and was in bed no more than 15 minutes after arriving! While it was pricey and out of budget, for the stay, it seemed fair. WiFi is paid, which could do without having to pay for. Bed and pillows were nice and comfy and the room was so dark it was easy to fall asleep. Four for five because it seemed a little "nickel and dime" like to not throw in breakfast or charge for WiFi.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I just love this intimate family owned restaurant. The brushetta and calamari and shrimp diablo, seafood salad, any salad, pizza ..everything I have ever tried here was amazing. My favourite place in the northeast philadelphia. Also, the desserts are phenomenal. Especially the canolli, or sherbet in a peach or a lemon shell. They serve a beautiful assortment of gelato. The outdoor seating is beautiful as you are surrounded by a growing blooming grapevine. There is a lovely bocci area for children. In the cooler evenings and months there are outdoor heaters. Wish they would pave the back parking lot.

My wife and I love Peking House Chinese Food!  The quality and portions are great! My wife never suggested Chinese for dinner when we would get from other Chinese restaurants, it was always me.  Since we have discovered Peking House, my wife wants it once a week.  We both love their dumplings which are filled with a generous amount of meat.  My favorite is their Pineapple Chicken, it is so delicious and the portion size will give you enough for 3 or more people or meals.  Everything is so fresh and that means at the busy times you may have to wait, but we feel it is well worth the wait to have the quality of food.

Unfortunately this is going to sound like repeat of all the others that complained about service...The restaurant was not very busy at all and yet the waiter seemed overwhelmed and easy confused.. I will say the chicken Alfredo was very good, martinis were also fabulous.  The $5 martini is a little deceiving because yes they are 1/2 the price of competition but 1/2 the size also. If this place could get the service together it would make for a decent restaurant. Unfortunately service was so bad I won't return.

This is an update to my original review. My dog ended up having osteosarcoma in his shoulder. This was not picked up or potentially looked into at this visit or suggested for aftercare. If it was detected early- it could have been treated earlier which is why I brought my dog here to see what was wrong. My pup ended up passing away because since It was not detected early, the options were limited. This is my experience and hopefully the bet I trusted my dog with at that time will listen to The owner of the dog better than to discount the concerns. Hi

Terrible customer service. Asked about the weird breadsticks we were given and were told they were done and done correctly (see picture). We said we were only asking because they look different at the E. Washington Street location. The "manager" said he doesn't know what they do at that location. because he doesn't go in there because it's a dirty store. Seriously, dude?!? And for the record, E. Washington Street location is considerably cleaner than the Post Road location. Don't go there. Just don't. We definitely won't be back.

The coffee is amazing here but the service is iffy. If you come on a weekday morning expect a line snaking all the way around the corner and a 5-10 minute wait just to order. They get slammed, I think they need another cashier. They have also messed up my orders on several occasions, for example, giving me a small coffee when I ordered and paid for a large, giving me an iced latte when I ask for an iced coffee, etc. I get it though because they are really busy, and they always correct the mistake. I just really think they could use more employees. I'll still keep going there though!

Stopped in to have quick drink before my dinner reservation at Buddakan.  The sign on the sidewalk advertised a happy hour and a short list of beer/cocktails.  Once you are inside you find out that happy hour only includes 2 types of beers and not one of the other items listed on the board outside.  I ordered a mojito - which was one of the items listed on the board.  What?!?!?  you don't have any fresh mint.  Well, if that's the case you should really temporarily take that off of your advertising board so you stop wasting mojito wanting patron's time !  Arrrghh !!    Oh yeah...... CASH ONLY !!

Downgrading because even with plenty of competition nearby in the beer-to-go market segment, prices remain too high. 

With a little bit of planning it's not hard to get a growler of premium craft beer for $6-$8 at a number of places in Nashville. Growlers start at roughly $10 here. 

I don't see why I should pay a 25-33% markup for the same 64 oz. of Yazoo/Lagunitas/Stoudts etc. I can get just down the road. It's a great business model and I salute their commitment to good beer, but as a consumer I'm taking my glassware elsewhere.

Feel guilty giving this place a mediocre rating, but heck! they should try harder to earn its place on the hip, revitalized Passyunk strip.

Ok, guilt-ridden cause my family likes to go there for special-occasion dinners and they live in the 'hood and are supportive of places like this restaurant. 

But honestly, most times we've come here, the wait for the entree is interminably loooong (I'm talking like an hour!) and the dishes are often way too salty. I think a restaurant that boasts a chef-driven sensibility like Tre Scalini should opt for less generic seasoning than all-purpose salt.

I've been going to Zen for 5 years now, usually 2-10 times a year. The staff are super friendly, and the all you can eat is pretty great, simply because you can get all you want and can eat in 2 hours.  The decor is awesome, it feels very authentic and everything is very clean. I always enjoy myself here, and ALWAYS eat to much (if that's possible). 

The last time that I went, they set up a nice little booth for me and a friend, the food came at a good pace and was good as always. The waitresses were very kind and friendly. 

I'm not sure what else you could ask for from a restaurant.

I had dinner here last night with my boyfriend. The food was a little more "Americanized" than I was expecting, but it was very good. The staff is very nice; clean, quiet atmosphere. It was not busy really, but there was a steady flow of customers coming in. It seemed like some of them frequent the place, one guy sat at the sushi bar and chatted the chefs. We ate a lot, and the bill was considerably low for a sushi place. I don't get over that way much, but I would definitely go there again if given the chance.

Just an update. I got to the 30 day limit, and called to cancel. They gave me an 888- number, which went to an advertising company. I waited and called the gym again the next day. I was officially past 30 days, and my credit card was charged. I explained the situation to woman who was helping me. She said she'd speak to her manager and they'll take care of it. Today, I have the money credited back to my card.

The staff at the gym is very nice and helpful, even when cancelling an account. I gave them another star for this, because at least it seems like a good company to work for, with such consistently nice staff.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Pretty lousy.  Nothing exceeded expectations.  Everything was worse than expected actually.  Just crappy tasting food.  You can do better with stuff from the frozen section of supermarket.

"Crab" Rangoons - lousy, I think full of cake frosting? no crab.
Terriyaki steak was terrible-burnt and bad flavored, worst terriyaki I've had.
Spring roll was dark brown and dripping in oil, contents barely chopped.
soups were bland & terrible tasting and came with an immediate msg headache.

They give packets of both mustard & sweet&sour instead of cups of real too.

On the positive side, it was very cheap...but I've had waaaayy better cheap chinese food.

Good sushi but I've never waited so long for food. It took an hour and fifteen minutes after being seated to receive any food, and we had a reservation. They also forgot some of our order and we had to wait again while one person at our table had no food for so long. We were close to walking out and many people came and went with take out orders. Seems like the priority went to take out and not the people who were sitting and waiting and made reservations. No apologies from the staff either. Going here was an annual family tradition so we'll probably pick somewhere new next time or do the take out. Too bad, it was pretty yummy.

DO NOT GIVE THESE PEOPLE ANY OF YOUR HARD EARNED MONEY!!!  Night time front desk employees have God complex.  Called police on group of five 40+ adults, who had no alcohol, because they were sitting in the lobby chatting after their 10PM curfew!  This was a Saturday night!  They actually kicked out two people for questioning them.  Kicked them out of the hotel - at 11:00 at night!  Police didn't understand either, but said that they needed to respond to the call and inforce what property owners wanted. There are plenty of places to stay...don't stay here!  Drury Inn corporate will be hearing from me on Monday.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've only ever been inside this location once. And I found it a bit of an odd experience if only because it was more lined up than the average Starbucks location usually is. Perhaps this is because they seemed to be training new staff, or rather because the staff they had were busy asking questions about things that are normally rather commonplace at the other Starbucks locations I normally visit. Regardless, my food was delicious, and I didn't need to spend much time inside, so I'll call this visit a success! :)

A standard Subway location with perhaps a bit more seating than some other Subway locations. This location was clean and two employees seemed to be working there at the time. They were very enthusiastic and capable at their jobs. That said we had to repeat our orders multiple times -- this didn't seem to be a language barrier (though this could have been a possibility) but rather that they were distracted as we had a perfectly entertaining conversation with the staff members at the time as well. Service was slow if only because we had to repeat what we wanted multiple times.

So we came here for frozen yogurt recently and we had the regular froyo with various toppings that we served ourselves. It was pretty good and reasonably priced when compared to other similar froyo places. Admittedly it was my first time visiting this brand and definitely my first time visiting this particular kiosk. I was amazed that they also served cotton candy. Pretty neat in general and I was happy for their tiny seating area (there's 4 chairs and two tables). We enjoyed our froyo treats and the toppings (I'm so glad that they had mochi, fruit and a few sweets to go on my green tea frozen yogurt).

What can I say, it's a pretty standard Second Cup location. I visit it on occasion while on Whyte Avenue (though I'm honestly more likely to frequent other businesses in the area when given the option -- it does not stick out as being particularly awesome or bad). 

That said, when I do visit, the service I get is efficient. So there's that. And like other Second Cup locations they have a fairly varied menu of non-coffee beverages which I rather do appreciate. The last time I was here I had frozen lemonade which, while overly sweet, was pretty good. 

This location is pretty lively, and is usually busy.

I was here for a work social function recently and I rather liked how they have a spreadsheet that one can use to record one's orders for group meals here. The food was delicious and in ample portions for our group and the service was wonderful for a group of our size. It's not often that groups this large can eat out together at a restaurant, so it is nice that this was a good option!

I like that you can get most of the pasta options baked with extra cheese. I also liked the fact that one can pay for one's bill via credit card or other card payment even when such a large group is here. Very useful overall.

This McDonald's is the most consistent restaurant I have ever eaten at.  

If you order fries they are always cold
Order something without cheese.  Won't happen.
And list goes on.  

Why does the McDonald's closest to where I live have to be this awful?  They updated the building but the consistent poor food quality still persists.  As anyone can see I am not the only one crying the blues.  

Maybe they just need to bulldoze this place and put in a Wendy's or a Culvers....but only if they promise to never hire an employee from here.  That's the problem.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: With so many GREAT sushi restaurants around I am surprised that this spot is making it! The Sushi is ok, apps are decent, nothing special but the service and the atmosphere were bad enough to keep me from going back. I have been a total of three times so far and each time was worse than the time before. I doubt I would have went back if it wasn't so close to my house. The quality and freshness of the fish  was good, however the disco lights, server attire and attitude will have me driving to some of my other preferred sushi spots (Wasabi on Frenchman, Sushi Brothers , Mikimotos, or Rockin Sake)

I am sure some of the bad reviews are people people don't understand cultural differences. This place was totally fine! I ordered shrimp fried rice, watched it made right in front of me. It was very good and a huge portion for a heck of a price. Super good deal. If you want a lot of hot fresh food, this is a place to go to. I could have made 3 dinners out of the amount I was given. The lady behind the counter was short with her answers but not rude or condescending or anything. I didn't expect any differently. It isn't a fine dining establishment but for the money you pay and the selection available it is hard to go wrong here.

After an unsuccessful tasting at Va La winery up the road, I was hoping to dissipate my disappointment with a fine Mexican lunch.  Unfortunately, Taquería Moroleón never matched the food of my favorite Philly taquerias.  The huge menu written in the style of popular tex-mex chains (with many of the same dishes) did not inspire confidence and the dishes that came - tacos al pastor, mushroom quesadilla, huevos rancheros, all remained firmly in the "Meh" category, as did the soupy salsas.  Much better:  the chile relleno and the crunchy tortilla chips.  Service was nice but absent after a while.

Stayed here for 6 nights while attending a conference right next door at the America's Convention Center.

Great location in downtown, walk to the convention center, Busch Stadium and the arch . 

Lobby was a very clean and well kept vintage lobby.  But they forgot to update the insides of the elevators, still with an old dirty stained carpet and metal walls.

Room was large and clean . Probably the nicest room I stayed in in awhile. Housekeeper did a great job all week.  

Great small lobby bar with a great selection of local beers on tap.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Pizza is great, service is terrible. The pizza and crust is incredible. Full of flavor and options. 

Bad part is, you'll be craving it. Something always happens to our pizza -- and we're not even getting it delivered but picking it up. We've had the wrong toppings, waiting for an hour after a guaranteed pickup time of 15 minutes because our pizza was accidently delivered to the wrong address?!? Don't try to call the store becaues their "answering service" is turned off. Is that even possible? 

I'll have average pizza for timely food.

Charlie's is definitely a great spot to sit down and grab a slice or two, maybe three or four! The pizza is awesome! Sauce on top and cheese on bottom there's so much flavor and you can tell they put time and effort into making this pizza. Make sure to bring cash cause that's all their about.. Been here twice and I still managed to eat 4 slices and still bring home a slice or two that doesn't even sit for a day, it's just that good! My girlfriend brought me here and I was instantly hooked, it puts Vince's pizza to shame. I will be back time and time again to enjoy this fabulous pizza!

I came here for the 3rd time in awhile, and bought a 6 pack and a few single bottles of beer, I was pretty upset when I went to go pour a can on Conshohocken Tandem that was dated from 12/18/15, I poured it 12/2/18....why would you keep a can this long and charge full price for it? Hops fell off, complete malt bomb and not a single coffee note. Pretty upsetting, I don't think I'll be going back for awhile. I really liked this place when it first opened, but I'll be sticking to my regular stores when it comes to shelfies. Other then that I can't say I had a bad experience, a tad over priced for mediocre selection.

My husband and I had friends in from out of town that we wanted to take to a special dinner, and Louie did not disappoint!  The food was fantastic, but the service was even better.  I am so mad at myself for not remembering her name, but our server ("the pregnant lady") COULD NOT have been better.  She was the perfect amount of attentive, friendly, funny, and knew the menu front and back.  Each member of the party was happy with their meals.  The hummus was a delicious surprise, and the ice cream sandwich dessert didn't sound like much on the menu but was incredible.  Thank you for a wonderful experience!

Nancy E I have to agree this is the worst place I've ever been to.  the fettuccine alfredo  sauce was straight from a jar no maybe that would be better.  it was flavorless and gunky.  hard to get the frozen bread. took forever.   The waitress was sweet.  the other waitress looked horrified when asked how my meal was and I said horrible.  yes Nancy frozen tv dinners are better.  and then I got the wrong check.  Yes is was 18 cents less than my check but I would not sign.  I wanted my correct check.  

I will not go back.  and I had a restaurant.com for $10 off $20.

The  food was excellent as was the service. We really enjoyed everything.  my one drawback was portion side.  We were told everything was shareable and that was how we should order because even if the order was placed together the kitchen could not guarantee that the food would come out together. The food was delicious but the portions were too small for the price.  We were three people and it came to $43 per person and we were not full (that might not be a bad thing, it kept me to my diet) but I felt that I should not have walked away feeling like maybe i wanted a little more.  Again the food was good.  Just give me a little more per serving.

Tried Sage for the first time for lunch today. Very nice soup and salad for appetizers. Dr. Fiance had a squash soup of some sort and I had a simple tossed salad with house peppercorn dressing, which was very good. My crabcake sandwich that I had for my main course was fairly ordinary though. It was tasty, but it didn't get my heart racing. In general I prefer a crisp crab cake with a soft interior, this was just soft all around.

I really liked the space though, so I'll be trying Sage again for dinner to see if the dinner menu is more exciting.

I feel bad writing this, but this is the third time I've been here and I'm still not impressed. I keep trying it with different stylest, because it's so close and is very trendy. I just got my hair done, a semi-weave and layers. It cost $121 and my hair looks almost the same as when I came in. The highlights weren't the colors I asked for at all...if there were even any put in my hair. BUT...the stylist are sooo nice and friendly. My stylist showed me different ways to style my hair, which was really cool. But, unless you have the money to spend a lot and aren't looking for anything "wow" or too different, I'd search around a little more.

My wife and I celebrated our one year wedding anniversary here this past Saturday. It's a really special place. Every course was great! My personal favorites were the Beef course and the Lamb course. My wife doesn't eat red meat, and they handled that easily. We really enjoyed the atmosphere and the staff's eagerness to make it a nice night. This place is top-notch. Really glad to have a restaurant of this caliber in Nashville.

I would recommend checking out the FAQ section on their website and making a reservation while you're there!

How many ways can food be called bland? When it comes to this place, not nearly enough. You could serve this food to any patient in a hospital with no fear of the tastes being too strong. The mussells tasted literally like water. The bread was hard and had less flavor than a loaf of Wonderbread. You'll find more flavor in a jar of Ragu.

The interior of the place is cute, but cute doesn't fill your stomach or excite your taste buds.

One person reviewing the blandness of the food, ok.. everyone saying the sme thing? Why waste your time and money? Its overpriced and underwhelming to say the least.

We ordered take out. Everything was really fresh/hot. The wonton soup was extremely salty. The dumplings were awesome, but the sauce was really salty. The fried rice tasted bland, but I'm pretty sure it's because the soup and sauce were so salty that my taste buds were off. I think otherwise it would have tasted great. The beef with vegetables was pretty good. We didn't care for the egg rolls, though. 

I think we'd try it again; nothing was terrible. The staff was super nice and lots of care was taken in packaging the food to go.

We checked in here tonight. Front desk was courteous. We got our keys and headed to our room. The whole floor smelled like fish and of course it was the person next door to us who was also screaming and fighting with a woman inside the room with the door wide open. (To fan out the smell from cooking fish). Couldn't use the pool either as there were a ton of unsupervised kids in there raising hell. 

 I should have paid more for a hotel with better reviews. Lesson learned. The people next door also keep opening and slamming the door while arguing
With kids running in and out. Good times...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Really not a big fan of this place.  Every time I eat here something seems to be slightly off, and always dry.  I understand there are vegetarian and vegan dishes here but they also have meat products.  So where's the grease?  How about a bit of butter, oil, spice?  My girlfriend likes this place so I get dragged here sometimes, hungover, and the food always takes forever to get out of the kitchen.  The Iced Tea sucks too.  Head to Green Eggs Cafe- it's not too far down the road.  And just because a place is vegan friendly, and veggie conscious doesn't give them a free pass to serve up mediocre renditions of this type of cuisine.

I still drive over the bridge to this car wash because I have no idea where to get a car wash in the city. For $10 you can get a decent car wash, they don't vacuum the inside too well and I'm left with streaks on my windows but its $10 so I'm not expecting my car to come back impeccably clean. If you go, see if the line is long. If it is, don't expect the workers to pay much attention to detail while cleaning the inside of your car. If you go when there's no one else waiting, the workers will spend a little extra time washing the dashboard etc. Don't forget to tip for good service!

Can I go back? Like, now?

This is an adorable little restaurant with amazing food. I could easily see myself coming here weekly if I lived in town.
