The Sunday gravy is amazing. I don't typically gravitate towards meatballs because I've had some not-so-good dry and flavorless ones. But you won't find those here. So much delicious, homey flavor. 

We also had the arancini, which were perfection (they come with a truffle aioli sauce). And the garlic bread. It comes with a whole head of roasted garlic to smother on your slice, should you desire.

Your visit to Philly isn't complete if you don't come here. I'm obsessed.

You know, Chinese take-out restaurants should unite, just think of buying power, the advertising, the quality improvements....
There are probably more take-outs than McDonalds in this country and typically all taste the same.   Low budget offering, with little to no flavor, in a sticky seat and table, store front location.
This one isn't any better than the next really. 
I've had much better.   But if you like this and think its healthy, by all means take my place at the counter.  I will move up the strip center a few doors and get something that at least tastes like beef.

Visiting my daughter at nearby college and she wanted some Japanese food. Yelp review brought us here.  My wife and I ordered Chirashi and it looked okay at first but sashimi slices were a bit thin and rice had very little sushi rice flavor.  Problem was the freshness. Fish didn't have any firmness to it and they smell fishy. My son's salmon wasn't fresh either. My daughter's Unagi Don was okay.  Misoshiru was watery and tasteless. If you like cooked items, lots of mayo, teriyaki sauce and lots of avocados, this is your place.   I would give service 3, overall food 2 and sushi or sashimi 1 star for freshness.

It's fine, close the the Dow and Pfizer campuses but it is showing its age.  My room has broken tile, holes in the carpet and peeling paint. The mattress is overly soft and floppy. I don't know if that is from age or just the nature of the mattress.  The "Bistro" ran out of most food choices at breakfast. That was annoying. The staff was very nice though.  Same for the hotel staff. They run a shuttle over to the Dow and Pfizer campus which is handy. I next time I am in town I would probably look for something in a little better condition.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I had seen the reviews here and thought since it's literally at our doorstep, that we should go and try it out. My son who is 11.5 absolutely loves Sushi, and so as a treat we went after school. We were the first ones there for dinner, and were treated very nicely by our waitress. My son chose the the Soho rolls, and I asked the waitress to recommend something, since it was the first time there. I ended up choosing the Boston Roll. I have to say that it was amazing. Not too expensive and very friendly staff. We'll definitely go back with my husband.

I've visited this Subway on numerous occasions, most recently this past weekend for lunch.  It's close to home for me.  It's located in the same plaza as Frankie G's and Scottie's Pub House.  This is always a good place to go when you're looking for something quick and fairly healthy.  The people here have always been very friendly.  I ordered the footlong turkey sub, and made it a meal with chips and a drink.  It was more than plenty for lunch, and was quite good.  I was in and out of here in just a few minutes.  I know I'll be back.

These guys deserve 5 stars just for how knowledgeable and friendly they are. They'll always immediately ask if you need help and are happy to chat about beer. If they don't have something you're looking for they'd be more than willing to order it for you. For a smaller place, they have a great selection!

Seriously, Total Wine might have pretty much every beer you could ask for and that's all fine and dandy, but you won't get service there like you would here. They're just straight up beer lovers and it shows. Support these fellas!

From my experience today I don't know where Sakana Sushi Northtowne is getting its great reviews. Service was exceptionally slow (it took 15 minutes to get an appetizer) the rolls all seemed to have the some combination of same 4 flavors - sweet mayonnaise, sriracha, sesame oil, and the ever present teriyaki sauce. The nigiri I had was poorly cut, paper thin and uneven. The only good part of my meal today was the green tea ice cream, but that isn't nearly enough to get me to return and spend my money there again. Just another less than mediocre Reno sushi bar, totally forgettable.

This is a pretty good place for Mexican food, I would say better than the place we went to prior to this one during work lunch break.  I had the cheese enchilada topped with pork and ranchero sauce and it was quite nice.  The guacamole tasted really fresh which I liked because I have been to some Mexican restaurants with brown-ish guacamole which does not look appetizing at all.  The service was fast and decent and the food was overall, appealing to the palate so I give it a 4 and would definitely come back here!

So so.  Some ice cream flavors are hits some are misses.  Dumb rule is that you can't have more than one flavor in a small.  Really?   It doesn't cost anymore and all of the local competition does it and they are much more customer service friendly than this place.   There is delicious ice cream in the area and customers are treated better elsewhere.  Please improve your policy to be more customer service oriented especially with a simple request that is very doable.  Friendly staff obeying a stupid non customer friendly rule.  Why do I need to pay $1.20 more for food I don't want?

very fun hangout and great neighborhood. 
Excellent bar, prices are reasonable and will vary depending on how the bartender likes you (lol).  Great pitchers of beer in kitchen quart containers, but the most interesting thing about this place is the ornate craftsmanship put into the bar (kind of like Mimi's downstairs bar). Skip all that Jon Taffer corporate bean-counting nonsense, a bar that creates a following and makes everyone feel comfortable is a success.

you can tell you're at a great place when the jukebox is run off a bartender's iphone.  

**enjoy the magazine articles posted in the restroom

Why is it when you leave a review on a business do they try to make you look Dumb ....look the review I left was crystal ....clear,   your company was advised of other carwash experiences to help you take care of the customers needs instead of listening to the customer the employee and the manager was only thinking of making $$$ when I came to your company nothing was working except the computer carwash the customer service way would have been wow ok let's get your car in and see if it's a good fit for our carwash I've owned businesses I get it ..but customer service is job 1  and your company could improve but that day it didnt

+.5 for service

Our first "real" food place during my trip to Edmonton was Boston Pizza, on a Tuesday night, aka pasta night.

One thing I'll never get used to (I don't go to many Boston Pizzas) is how huge their portions are...my friend split a pizza for two, and they didn't even finish half of it! I ordered a Boston lasagna, which tasted okay, however there were some pieces of lasagna that weren't fully cooked. My other friend (we had a table of 4) had a linguini with meatballs, and also enjoyed it.

Service was excellent. Our lady took care of us the whole way and came back 2-3 times asking us how the food was. Albertans are so nice!

Yum yum YUM! We wanted traditional Italian food and this was it. I ordered the Sunday Gravy dish so that I could get a sampling of a few things. It is a lot of food...at some point my husband and I contemplated splitting the dish and getting an appetizer. But I wanted my own meatball so I ordered the dish for myself. The pasta was delicious, the gravy was divine, and the meatball...oh my gosh! I've never tasted a meatball like that before. It was perfect. We also tried the Italian lemonade, which was unique with a thyme spring garnish and also tasty. Highly recommended.

First of all, everyone is very friendly and helpful. However, they opened almost 30 minutes late and then were still in the process of basic prep. A friend and I wanted to try their ravioli after reading the reviews. I tried one with their spicy sauce and it was almost inedible. There were large red pepper flakes that overwhelmed anything else. My friend got the mushroom truffle ravioli and she said it was fine, much more bland than she was expecting. Other than variety, not much stood out here about their food. I was really hoping for more!

Had been wanting to try this place, my brother didn't want to go so I waited until my other brother came to visit. Very impressed. They were busy and seemed to be somewhat understaffed but did their best. We were aware of what was going on and they kept our drinks full. Great menu options, some unique rolls, not the usual knock offs that you see at other places. There are other options for people who don't like sushi. Really neat atmosphere, I love the fountain!!! A little pricier than other places but you get what you pay for, fresh, flavorful food. I'll be back!!!

My daughter and I usually frequent Yogurt Beach but we have been here twice and I thought this place deserved a review.  The yogurt is average and the consistency is not always creamy and smooth.  I expect this in yogurt so it competes with ice cream.  The signs with the nutritional information are not clear as they advertise sandwiches for Texas Meltz in another Yogurt Beach location.  This is important to me as I have allergies and dietary concerns.  Lastly I thought the place needed better decor.  Also I hate dirty yogurt machines.  I mean it is the one thing you have so it is imperative to maintain the integrity.

Tucson must really be hurting for pizza places if this warrants such high reviews. Evidently this used to be Canal Street Pizza, which is what we were looking for. Our service was very good, but the food was unremarkable. The salads were not fresh, and the pizza and pasta were only OK. It's not a bad place, but there was nothing about it that stood out as noteworthy. And frankly they have no business calling it a "New York" pizzeria, because it's definitely not New York style. Personally I would not go back. I'm sure there are better pizza places in town.

If you are looking for an "Economical" car wash, this is an interesting place to go.

Its entirely self-service (think like a car wash vending machine. I'm pretty sure there is literally no one working here.

To get a car wash you pay a machine and then just pull your car in. There are almost no instructions. You literally just park in the car wash and the machine moves around the car (rather the traditional pull through method).

If cheap and self-service is your game, than give it a try (its very fast). I much prefer a more full service shop like cardinal.

I paid $12 for the top of the line wash and wax and I have no clue if I actually received this. They shuttle the cars through so quickly and packed together, I don't know how I could have received the "extras" when all the cars go through the same wash literally at the same time. I was SUPER uncomfortable with how close the vehicles were on the track, like fender bender City in there.

It's nice the vacuums are free but that's about it. My car doesn't really look like it got a good wash, or the extras including the wax polish I paid for.

There are other reviews that give you a sense of the atmosphere so I'll just stick to the coffee itself.  It's awesome.  Not, seriously, it's a beacon of hope for coffee in new orleans.  My soy latte was perfect.  Not a crazy amount of foam, not a crazy amount of soy, just right.  The espresso was smooth and creamy.  The barista was kind of soft spoken but knew how to work that machine and to me, that's what counts.  Heads up, you CANNOT leave a tip when you pay with a credit card so bring in some change or a few bucks to tip if you plan to pay with your card.

I stopped by this place because I was bored and hungry. I've been looking around for the next best breakfast burrito. The one that can top Pepes. Alas, it could not be found here. The burrito turned out slightly better than my expectations but I think I would have to be hungover, stoned, and starving to eat it again. I also tried the horchata (some background about me: I have never had horchata up to this point) and it was freaking delicious and a decent price. I WOULD stop back in here to grab a horchata, and that's what bumps this review from 3 to 4 stars.

$3.00 for the first four minutes and additional quarters can be added before time expires. I added a dollar more in quarters and it really felt like I got jipped with no extra time added. The signs did not say that you are suppose to add in three dollar intervals so I take it that you can add any amount... wash/soap, rinse, wax and foam brush are available for the car wash bays. There are four bays and four vacuum cleaners. We were in desperate need of a self-service car wash and this spot was the closest one we could find. Located next to Ooka restaurant!

I've been to Ooka several times over the past couple of years. I have always had an excellent meal there. They are what most restaurants are not - very consistent! Their Sushi is fantastic, service is excellent, love the seafood teriyaki! I took my parents there right before Christmas and they had an amazing meal too. My parents raved about it for two days. My only complaint and reason for not giving Ooka 5 stars is because their dessert menu is a little weak. Lucky for me its not often I have enough room left over for dessert when I eat there. I would totally recommend for anyone in the area to give it a shot.

A fun neighbourhood bar in uptown near J's place. Came in here one night, before we headed out to Frenchman St. The bartender was super nice. J ordered her usual cupcake-tini and I was unsure because it seemed like it would be super sweet. However, the bartender made a little extra and gave me the extra in a separate cup. Which was awesome. And, even though it was sweet, it was actually pretty good. And pretty!  And I ended up ordering Lillet Smash and it was perfect. It was refreshing and delicious. Definitely come back when I come back to visit J.

DELICIOUS Cadillac margs with no sour mix and the free chips and salsa my Californian heart desires.  The default salsa is medium, but you can ask for mild or hot.  The hot is jalapeno-based and has a great kick.  Loved it.

House margs were on special for $5 while we were there, but I opted for the Cadillac instead because the house marg is made with sour mix.  My friend ordered one, though.  I tried it, and it was way too sweet for me, but if sweet margs are your thing, go for it.

Service was slow, but my drink was good, so I didn't mind.

I just moved to Tucson and have been on the hunt for a place that does nails and waxing and it looks like I've found it. I walked in last week for pedicure and the woman did such a fantastic job I ended up getting a manicure as well.  I went back a few days later for a eyebrow/lip/chin wax and the woman took her time and was extremely  thorough with both the waxing and the tweezers.  She then used some kind of great cream afterwards that took all the redness away.  It was fantastic.  Lucky for me this place is within waking distance of where I'm staying but no matter where I end up permanently I will keep coming to Rich Nails.

Clearly Claudia E., has no clue about Italian food. You can't buy your way out of ignorance though. I personally know the owner, and have watched the chefs produce the meals. Everything is made to order and from scratch. And it tastes like it. If what you're looking for is a big bowl of pasta overcooked and swimming in a bath of canned sauce, then this is not your spot. Al dente pasta with the sauce clinging to it is what you get here. Beautifully prepared veal dishes, and creatively presented local fish specialties. 
I can't let 2 weeks go by without a visit.

I scream for ice cream! Especially for cake flavored. When they have the cake flavors I have to come. This location seems to sell out of them quickly. 

Kids love the clown cones & the bubblegum flavor (when they have it). Wish they made a all blue flavor for boys. 

The products is the same as most Baskin Robins. Customer service sometime is great other times lacking due to only having one person. Understandable, they never know who in come in for ice cream. Overall clean with great item. So, cool off with something cold.

I don't eat a lot of fast food, but Wendy's is my favorite fast food place. However, this will be my last time going to this location. Having ordered at the drive through, my order is wrong 90% of the time. I'm not interested in having to root through my order in the car to double check the incompetence of the restaurant staff. What baffles me is the receipt lists the correct items, but still the contents of the bag are wrong/missing. Skip here and go to Whole Foods for a healthy, inexpensive pre-cooked value meal.

It's cheap. It's greasy. It's heavy. It's, at best, average. But it's Philly, where sub-par Chinese food is just about as good as it gets. Golden Chopstick, with its cheesy purple fluorescent lights isn't bad, but it'll never impress. 

If you don't mind greasy, Americanized Chinese food, you shouldn't have any problems with GC. Most of the items I've had are okay, heaviness aside. One warning though: until they learn how to properly use a deep fryer (either by getting the oil up to the proper temperature or taking food out sooner), avoid the egg rolls, or expect a mouth full of grease with every bite.

Never again!!! We got the rental for 4 days 165.00, for an extra day they charged me 73.00! I called customer service and the idiot started to read the same receipt I have!! I was trying to explain her how the hell my rate went up so much for one day?! She said: oh there's a fee of 12.00 for the extra day... so if 165.00 for 4 days is 41.25 per day, Isn't it supposed to be 165.00+41.25+12.00= 218.25?! She said they kept the same rate, which is not true! I was charged 238.63! 

I said never again will do business with this people!!! They probably don't care cause they would rip other people off! And I'm taking this to the BBB!!!!

My coworkers eat here often and love it. They have great lunch specials. I finally came here for dinner, after craving new york style pizza for weeks, and this really hit the spot. I love veggies on my pizza and was very impressed to see REAL mushrooms (pizzerias that use canned mushrooms drive me INSANE), and green peppers so fresh that they were still bright green on the pizza and not the overcooked dull green that you typically see. This place is mostly for take out but there's a couple of tables inside and out. We were able to hear some live music from Ricky T's at the end of the strip. There's also a cool candy shop next door.

Delicious and excellent service!! After calling 3 places for sushi take out at 830, we got denied since everyone was closing at 9 (you'd think 30 min for sushi takeout would be sufficient time). After coming in from a long flight we stopped here and I'm glad we did!! Service was excellent, very friendly staff and food came out quick. If I ever stop in the area again I will surely be back. After being sad that our vacation was over, this place surely cheered us up with their positive attitude and friendly service. Thank you!!

After an afternoon spent in the sculpture garden at City Park this ice cream hit the spot.  They have 5 or 6 cute little bistro tables inside so, there is plenty of room to indulge inside in the air conditioning.

I ordered the six scoop sampler for $6.00.  Anyone who knows me knows that I am not a huge ice cream fan but, these flavors were creative and delicious.  You like chocolate, banana split, coffee, marshmallow, etc????? well you will find it here.  If you can't decide grab the sampler that also comes in a 4 scoop size.

The Golden Star has legions of fans. Sadly, they're probably the same people who first experienced American-Chinese food when this venerable Orchard Street eatery opened in 1965.

My Hong Kong-born ex-wife would call this gweilo Chinese, American-style dishes for non-Asians. I call it bland.

I ordered Kung Pao chicken and fried rice on the lunch menu. It wasn't objectionable, but there was little flavor and no spice. 

The staff was friendly, but that wasn't enough to overcome the blandness of the meal. I liked this kind of meal when I was a kid, but 50 years later, I expect a lot more from a Chinese restaurant.

This bar just isn't my favorite. I've only been there at night, when its crowded and you have to wait for 10 minutes at the bar to get a drink. I would imagine it'd be more enjoyable in the daytime with their great patio and garage door walls.

Their bathrooms are always disgusting and 90% of the time, only one of the toilets work in the Ladies room (and that's if you're lucky). The crowd is mostly college students with a few tourists here or there. I've heard the East Nashville Red Door is a much better, more authentic experience.

There could not be a more gracious veterinarian's office to go to.  I HIGHLY recommend The Vet Clinic of Palm Harbor.  My cat Pink has been a patient for over 8 years and they have done nothing but accommodate our every need.  Pink has congestive heart failure and Dr. Frazee (though she recently left the practice) has been the sweetest kindest vet I have ever met.  The staff at Vet Clinic of Palm Harbor is wonderful, warm and caring, you'd be making a big mistake to take your pet anywhere else!!  Thank you Vet Clinic of Palm Harbor for all you have done for Pink and Tig, my family loves you all!

Amy is the best and does my nails still since my 2012 review. I wanted to update my review because of the negative review below.  The salon smells nothing like acetone and no one rubs oil all over your arms and leaves it on.  I am not sure about her experience but I've been going here since it opened 8 or so years ago and it is clean, the ladies (and men) working are lovely if anything  the place is 10 times better than before. My only grievance is they play football on the big tv LOL and politics which Amy gladly changes for me every time  best nail salon spa ever!!! Oh and the deluxe pedicures are tooootally worth it!!!

This a great local branch right up the road from my home, so its very convenient. I came in on a Friday, in the early afternoon and the place was surprisingly slow. There was no line to speak of so I was helped almost immediately.
The teller, Mayra was very friendly and pleasant to deal with. I was surprised when she didn't try to sell me anything during my transaction which gets irritating with other branches. I've been to this branch numerous other times for the ATM but there's really no point in reviewing that. They have 2 drive up ATMs so the line has never been long on any of my visits.

The staff here is hands-down one of the friendliest you'll find in Boise.  Unlike the places you get forced smiles and fakey greetings Starbucks sometimes generates, the staff here seems to honestly be happy to see you.
At least in the evenings, they're never overly busy and I've never had to wait more than a minute or two for my drink. I've never had a quality issue, and they seems to always properly follow recipes. The restroom is always super clean, which probably takes a fair amount of work on their part.
If you're on Eagle road, this is the best of the four Starbucks to drop by.

superb, priced right  BYOB. Went here on a friday night for dinner, arrived at 7:30 and only waited 5 minutes to be seated.  I went with the waiters suggestion for the entree and he was right! It was the most delicious salmon dish ever.  The special lobster crab over capellini  and equally the chicken with portabello and artichoke dishes that my guests had were as delicious. There gave nice portions but still had plenty of room for the fried cheesecake with ice cream which was over the top.  Great wait service too. Fabulous dining experience , highly recommend.

Stopped in for lunch on a Friday. Tried the buffalo chicken flatbread and the wycombe country club sandwich. Both were excellent. The flatbread was very flavorful and not too spicy. The sandwich was made with hand carved roasted turkey and was delicious. Large portion and the turkey was very moist. 

They have an impressive and reasonably priced beer selection. The bartender was very knowledgeable and friendly.

Overall I enjoyed my meal and visit here. An added plus is that they donate 10% of the food sales on Thursday nights to the local fire company.

Sushi and sake were great!  We were sat upstairs in a nice back room with floor to ceiling windows which was just, but it got extremely loud once all the tables had filled up.  Our server was unfortunately one of the worst I've experienced.  He was not attentive, at one point had to flag down a random person to order another drink as I hadn't seen ours in at least 15 minutes.  When he was in the room we would make eye contact multiple times to get our check or a refill and he simply did not approach our table.

Supposedly this is the spot to go near Vanderbilt.  Yes and no.

Salad was really good.
WARM SPINACH SALAD
spinach, shaved radicchio, toasted hazelnuts & candied cranberries
tossed in a warm Benton's bacon vinaigrette top

Main dish was slightly overcooked, but ok (but for $30 I would think it would be a better dish)
SEARED SEA SCALLOPS 
 with a sweet potato, parsnip & golden beet hash served with 
butternut squash coulis & crispy leeks 

Server did not come by very often.  Took awhile before he came to take my order, and then took a very long time to get the check.  He was however a nice guy, just busy or forgot about me.

DON'T TRY THE NEW SATIS-FRIES!!!!!  There's a reason they have less fat and calories.  They are tasteless!  They remind me of those microwavable fries.  Just yuck!  I'd give BK one star, but I actually prefer their grilled patties to say McDonalds.  They also at least try hard to diversify their menu and try new things like remember those rib pieces?  But fundamentally, this is a big a s corporate t rd factory with unhealthy ground beef from sick cows full of antibiotics and growth hormones that will utlimately make you sick.  Burger King is just not my cup of tea, because I usually don't like a big fat t rd in my cup of tea.

This is definitely the place to find what you're looking for close to home.  I'm the adventurous type, so more than once, unsuspecting party guests have been treated to the contents of the "Bargain Buggy" at the store entrance. It's always odd items that you wouldn't actually go looking for, and bargain doesn't always mean "cheap". 

They also have a great selection of foreign, domestic, and local wines, which I love, and an uncommon collection of tequilas!

There always seems to be enough staff to help you find something, and they tend to be friendlier than most Hood liquor store employees. 

Three thumbs up!

They just remodeled the multiple laundry rooms and replaced the parking lot. I just love the new laundry facilities with all new washers and dryers, plenty of counter space, and a large sink. The washers even lock once you start them so you can feel safe leaving your laundry to attend to other things or simply go sit in the jacuzzi! ( not that I have ever had a problem before but it is always nice having that added security) 

Been here a year now and it just gets better and better :) The staff is always friendly and so helpful!

The hotel is located in Center City... It has a huge lobby... For it was a little worn... This hotel has shown this age... 1980s... What I hate the most about this place is that they charge for all Internet unless you have your own hook up and even in the business center which you would think would be a courtesy they actually have credit card sliders for one minute 87 cents but minimum payment of 8$.   So if you lost your boarding pass or you wanted to print it up for records... They'll charge you eight dollars... Three stars is the only rating I can really get it... The room is clean (what you expect a clean room open)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The hibachi chef was very entertaining and attentive to my kids. The filet was cooked very well and the fried rice was good too. The California role was delicious and they give you soup and salad with your meal. I like the half sushi role add on for half price option. The servers were very attentive and also aware of what small children need which I appreciated very much. The price was good (better than Hirosaki). I do wish they'd reconsider their lobby decorations...Christmas lights and clutter made it seem like a dive and makes you question how clean and organized they are in the kitchen. Overall a great meal.

Okay Las Maracas, since my favorite Mexican restaurant endured fire damage, I decided to give you another chance. I have to hand it to you, your beef and chicken tacos are delicious, and cheaper than the competition. But the service is. so. bad. The waiters either ignore you, or all but slam your food down in front of you. Forget about asking for extra salsa or chips because it will either never come, or you'll get eyes rolled in your direction. 

I want to like you Las Maracas..heck, I even want to LOVE you. But I feel downright dirty when I leave there, and I work too hard for my dollars to be treated that way.

My favorite spot to stay at, when we come down here. Majority of things are in walking distance,  so that helps to cut down on driving.  Can't say enough about the professionalism the comes from the staff here. Rooms are kept very clean, you have the convenience of the bistro, which comes in handy at times. The only drawback is trying to find a place to park on the street, if you don't want to pay to park on site. Almost forgot, there is a club,  so you might not want to be on that side. Can get a lil noisy,  but nothing that bad... And they have a good fitness center, which is always a plus....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Been here a couple of times over the years and while the location is great the rooms are not awesome. For $300 plus I would just spend a little more and open up a lot of other options. One of the rooms I stayed in I could touch all the bathroom walls with my arms outstretched. I know I have a long wingspan at 6'1" but that's pretty small. The room was also one of the smallest I've been in on one of my visits. Had a very large room another time that was on the ground floor but it was for a vampire as it was dark all day.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is a fairly good Subway sandwhich shop.  The ingredients are fresh and tasty.  I'd pass on the personal pizzas, though.  One of two of the 'sandwich artists' girls seem kind of snooty and aloof, like they are doing you some huge favor making you a sandwich with the ingredients that you choose.  They don't seem to have any sandwhich recommendations the last few times I've asked and the response was "it depends on what you want to eat" and "I don't eat meat".  I go here about once every two weeks and like I said it is okay for the most part.  You get what you pay for.  It's quick food when you are on the go.  Happy eating!

I was not that impressed, the street tacos were pretty salty and that's a go margaritas were Really weak! There's a ton of Mexican restaurants here in Nashville that is excellent, I just don't think this is one of my favorites!! But for the record I only ate there one time and maybe it was one of those things where the cook was off His is or her game that day! But for now I am rating this place three stars, and I will go back once again just to make sure and if it's better than my first visit I will update my review!

If there is a better donut in Reno/Sparks I haven't found it.  Shockingly the chocolate raised donut frosting tasted like actual.....um....chocolate.  Huh????? These donuts look like any other in Reno -- except they actually taste wonderful.  Sweet, airy, light, and no pathetic aftertaste.  I've tried this place early on two different Sunday's past 2 months...

The chocolate cake donut though was too intense and 1/3 of it could trigger diabetes if the moon if full.   Pleasant, authentic staff, clean, consistent... worth a drive to get too.

New spot In Havertown. Doing only takeout only for now. If you are a fan of Detroit Style Pizza, you will love this place. 
         My "Detroit 1946" was perfect. It was a pizza cooked in a traditional steel tray. 
It was crisp around the edges with just the right amount of char. It was topped with Wisconsin Brick cheese which tasted excellent. The tomato sauce was on the sweet side but went well with the cheese. It is placed on the top of the cheese. 
     They have a number of toppings and styles of pizza. They have been selling out each day so put your order in early.

Visiting the area and made a quick stop for breakfast. Ordered McGriddle and an iced coffee with apple pies. 

They operated super quickly, I love the friendly staff. Taste was exactly now expected it to be. The place was super clean and tended to very carefully. Enjoyed my experience thoroughly. 

Bathrooms were well kept and fresh smelling. 

The management does a good job at tending to this location! Keep it up!!!!

text:
The staff here is very friendly, but they need a lot more training.  My normal order is black iced coffee, and they do a good job with it.  But anything more than a black coffee is regularly incorrect.  Piles of sugar on the bottom of iced coffee, even when asked for melted sugar.   Also the fact the donuts arent made fresh and are delivered, usually already stale, is a big turn off.  Again, the staff is wicked nice, but this Dunks wouldnt last 2 days back in New England.  

Also, for other customers, dont use the drive thru when ordering the whole damn menu.

The front desk people were efficient and very friendly. The room was very nice. The thing that made me score it so low, I came back to my room after being gone all day to find the door to my room propped open for who knows how long. Anyone could have walked in and taken anything they wanted. Luckily nothing was taken but could have easily been. I was staying here with 4 coworkers. One of them who were staying on another floor said he saw a room door propped open on his floor. It was 9 at night so he closed it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I've been on a sushi kick lately because in my mind, eating small pieces of fish is somehow going to make me lose weight.
I've tried a few places close to the office but today, I decided to venture a little farther to see if there is place that is a bit easier on the wallet. Kabukiza was a well rated place and the lunch special was an attractive price so I was all in.
From looks alone, the place is a step above most 'round the way sushi places, what with their thoughtful decor and...well, yeah, that. 
The rolls I got were tasty and that's about it. I'd go back.

This is, personally, the best place for me to get a St Louis treat.  Our family loves it.  Our dogs love it! Even when there is a line it moves very fast.  I have no idea how the folks working in the back keep all the orders straight but they do.

About the only down side is on a nice evening there aren't enough seats to go around.  On the plus side, we have offered open seats at our tables to folks and met some neat people and others have offered open seats to us.  There doesn't seem to be a bad vibe around the place at all.

Had great lunch; crab and avocado salad was stunning and overflowing with prime clump crab.  Friend had Panini so large he took home half (it came with salad). Groupon made the deal excellent.
The service was friendly and kept us informed admitting she made an input error causing delay.  Unsweetened ice tea was real tasty and always refreshed,
But for lunch, get a smaller menu to serve quicker  I don't have over an hour every day to leisurely lunch.  Fast casual.  Fratelli's has the food quality; they need to focus.  Too many choices.

I loved this cozy little Italian place next to Sugos. I know they are connected and have the same owner but the feel here is totally different. They have a nice wine selection and great service. Our waiter,Moshe was stupendous. Calamari was good, cooked perfectly. Chicken Spedini was great but slightly over cooked but it was tasty. They serve the Del Pietro salad from the old restaurant and it is still good. It has a nice bar where you can drink, eat and watch the game. Overall, a really nice place to have dinner.

Just want to add that we got takeout last night from BrickTop's.  They have the best takeout I have had in St. Louis.  Everything was delicious and packaged nicely.  Sometimes I feel that takeout isn't the best because you are not eating in the restaurant but I will say that this restaurant takeout looks just like it would have you had ordered in the restaurant.  We had grilled artichokes (excellent), goat cheese and beet salad (excellent), Chicken Milanese (excellent) and a burger with fries that was very good according to the person who ate it.  If you are looking for good takeout, this is a great place.

This place deserves more than the one star. 

First, it's got a mostly Mexican clientele. A good sign of authentic food being served.

Second, the guy at the register. He said if the food isn't good he'll give me twice as much next time, that's quite a guarantee.
Unfortunately he didn't inform me that three of the four things I ordered were not available.

Third, the cook. She gave me the news so I told her to give me what she wanted. It was going to be a surprise.
I love mystery meat.

Fourth, the surprise. She gave me some wonderful, rich and flavorful pork rib tacos. 

Fifth, the price. $1.59 per taco!

Sixth, NO LINES!

No. Just no. 

I wandered in this place hoping for a bite of Mediterranean during my flight delay. It was 5:00pm on Feb 9th and several people were behind the counter.

I browsed the coolers looking for something to catch my eye, but sorry, nothing could look appetizing enough to balance our the terrible service. I looked for approximately five minutes and none of the workers could be wrenched away from their personal conversation about one man's girlfriend who was currently pregnant with some other ******'s baby. Lovely.

A new low in airport food experiences.

This will be my third visit to Ralphs but my first review. Made a reservation for lunch and our table was ready. It is cozy but adds to the ambiance. We weren't in a hurry so I was fine waiting a while for service and food. I ordered clams w/white sauce and was disappointed when the order arrived without the shells, instead the clams were already diced and on top of the very watery pasta, could it have come from a can? I don't know but was a little disappointed. Others ordered the ravioli which came out overcooked and peas and prosciutto, eh, just ok. But three entrees and a carafe of wine for $60, not too bad of a value, but not exceptional.

Don't let the location or the appearance of this place fool you- the food is freakin DELICIOUS & the staff is wonderful. The to go specialist is AMAZING. She's super friendly, knowledgeable & my order is always just the way I order it. The portions are ridiculously huge- my entre made for 3 meals & was so good. I've heard people mention that prices are high- but for the amount of food you get it's not pricy at all. I'm about to make the 10 mile drive shortly to go pick up some takeout for my sat evening in. Def recommend this place & will continue to be a loyal customer:)

This place used to be great, I went there all the time but they have changed management I think.  New staff and the one lady, I believe to be a manager, is not very friendly.  She has snapped at me for asking questions and just has a I DONT CARE attitude.  The quality of the sandwiches have done down as well.  I ordered a steak and cheese extra meat and it was pitifull and she said it was double meat.  she was lying.   I have since started going to another location and they rock every single time.  Shows what having a good staff can do to a place.  EAT FRESH!!

Been several times, even took dad here for fathers day.  Nice little place,  Service is excellent.  Server was at my table less than ten minutes after I ordered apologizing for the delay and I didn't even think there was one.  Food came out shortly after that.  They have a big menu and big portions.  They have a lot of offerings I havnt seen at other places.  Food was is very flavorful and the price is right too.  Soo much better than the place close to the house I have been going too.  No loud music and even the night it was crowded and we were sat next to a large party, it wasnt annoyingly loud.

First customer of the day so service was pretty quick.  They bring wantons out to the table with a sweet sour type dip, kinda like Mexican restaurants do with chips and salsa. Place is very clean and comfortable atmosphere.  I had the lunch special pepper steak.  came with fried rice, eggroll and soup.  Price was very reasonable.  Food came out very quicklly but I was the only table when I ordered.  about 5 more tables were sat while I was there.  Egg drop soup was very good as well as the pepper steak.  Lunch portion is on the small side.  I would consider it a lite lunch.  If your really hungry order a regular portion.

Stopped in for lunch.  Nice place, very friendly staff.  Not very big.  Had to wait for a table only because they dont have many.  Sits right on the river, real nice view and you can see the local park on the other side. Food was ok.  I had the hamburger steak topped with cheese, baked potatoe and salad bar.  The steak was real small, just a hamburger patty covered in cheese and onions.  Well done and bland.  Baked Potatoe was very good.  Cooked just right.  Salad bar was very small and few options.  I look forward to going back for dinner and trying something else.  all in all just nothing to get excited about except for the view.

It was our wedding anniversary and I was counting the days til we dined at this famous restaurant.  It began with a small room and an elevator with no one to greet us.  We were met at the next floor by a hostess who apologized and said she was on her way down.  The staff was friendly but the place has a terrible FRUIT FLY problem.  I kept shooing them away from my glass of $100 bottle of wine (minimum priced bottle). When sure enough I noticed a fly swimming in my wine I was drinking!  When I told the server she offered to go in the back "and fish it out with a spoon".  Not the stellar experience I expected given the almost $500 price tag.

Good little coffee located inside of a gymnasium facility, The Gathering Place in Greenwood.  That makes it a little difficult to find.  They brew high quality fair trade coffees and make other coffee drinks as well.    You do not have to be a member of the gym to get to the coffee house.  They make good smoothies and carry Umpqua oatmeal which is a nice breakfast after a workout. The coffee house has a nice atmosphere to read and enjoy a cup of joe.  The coffee house uses its funds to help a variety of Christian ministries to help people in the community.

If you are visiting a gin spot you want a vibe that invites you to relax and enjoy every sip. This visit was a quick pop-in for a break from heat and was so happy we ended up here. Bartender was excellent! Welcoming, attentive, knowledgeable and viewing her prep the drinks was like watching an artist. For a busy day w festival this spot was like stepping into another world. Calm, cool, fragrant all combined to form the perfect space where a few hours can slip by enjoyably. Will 100% return for food which looked amazing at other tables, and the flight. Allow yourself time to enjoy the variety of gins and explore the menu!

Location: On Congress
The Skinny: Not a hard location to find. Located near the Hub and across from the bus hub. 
The Restaurant: The Screamery has a great indoor location. I love how they used decor from around town like the bowling alley floor as their counter (don't worry its clean). The Ice Cream was flavorful, unique and locally sourced. Seating is limited to some tables so be wary if you have a large group!
What I did not like: Was nothing I did not like. 
Should you go: Yes! The ice cream is not bad priced for the quality. 
My Kids Review: Go! Its Ice Cream!

Welcome to the neighborhood OTHER Dunkin, lol. Not sure why we needed another Dunkin Donuts in the area, BUT I'm here for it! Stopped in yesterday and I believe they just opened their doors. Grabbed an iced coffee for myself, donuts and munchkins for the kiddos. It was also National Donut Day, so one of my donuts were free!

Because they're a new location, and they just opened, they handed out coupons and FREEquent cards so I can't wait to come back and get more stamps. If I remember correctly I believe the menu was digital which I was quite impressed with.

It is always nice to go into a retail store that has few customers and many worker bees; and having a difficult time finding someone to assist. Fortunately, one man stepped up and walked away from his buddies, who were busy entertaining themselves with one of their smart phones. Lots of laughter with that group, but very little customer facing energies necessary for competency in a good retail operation. The one fellow that tried to help me save my review from becoming a one star review. Lots of competition out there and I am now heading to a competing operation. Too bad for this company. Another unhappy customer.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I was extremely surprised when I walked in to find my usual brand name products for such low prices! I was beyond excited, as this starving college kid loves any chance she gets to save a penny here and there. The staff was extremely helpful and gave me tips on their epic "case nights" with $5 case purchases. 
Things are a little overwhelming to sort through, but if you have the time to browse the isles, you might just find a gold mine. Case in point, an IPad docking station for $50! 
In any case, give these folks a shot for your thrifty shopping needs!

review is for the bar on the south side of the bldg, not the dining room to the north.  sahms is a great casual place to grab a drink.  eating tables to the right, separated by a divider from a row of 2-person high tables and the bar itself.  bar is classic wood with a nice rail and footrest.  bar back looks great and is well-lit, as is the entire bar area.  enough hdtvs to catch the game.  great food and service. like so many other places, have moved to a craft beer focus, large beer menu that changes daily.

Everything at the Wild Beaver is average at best. The entire place/atmosphere feels to contrived or fake. Though there is nothing horribly wrong with the place, there are too many other places with Broad Ripple with much more character.   Overall, a themed/cliche/corporate bar do not belong in the Ripple.  What's next, another Applebees or a Rusty Bucket?  I now classify these types of bars as a "shot girl bar"....you know that scantily clad girl that constantly pesters you about "buying a shot".  Your father's bar would never have one these.

Wow! We had a fantastic dinner at Billie Jean! The space is intimate, warm and very chic with black walls, minimalist art and subdued lighting. The menu is so enticing that we had a hard time deciding what to order. The starters menu was fabulous so we ordered 4 or them. They were delicious and beautifully presented. The carpaccio and lobster tail were especially noteworthy! They have a lovely cocktail menu and their Manhattan Rebellion was fantastic! We finished the meal with a coffee creme brûlée which was sublime! We will definitely be back!

Not Bad.  Not Great, but not bad.  
You can get good Italian fare here.  
Everything smells good, looks good, tastes good.  It is certainly not a Maggianos, Thank God.  It is not over rated.  It's a good place to fall back on, if you want to go out, you aren't sure what you want, and you want good food.  One of these days, I need to try something with tomato sauce.  Linguini with white sauce of various kinds are my stand by but I need to venture.  Oh, and their house red wine isn't bad.  Pretty good standby place.  can't go wrong.

Maybe I've been spoiled, because Reno actually has some decent fast food Ameri-Chinese places.  Food is warm, generally in good shape and I am happy, full and greasy.  Not so with Egg Roll King.  If it is nearby, there is a guarantee that I will try it at least once.  And once is all I will try Egg Roll King.  Easily the worst chow mein and sesame chicken I have ever had.  Most of it went in the trash and I felt frustrated over money wasted.  Maybe I had an off night or ordered the wrong thing.  But this experience was enough for me to make the drive to other places where I know the quality is consistent.

Would of been 4 stars if the service was better. Our server took over 30 minutes to take our order! I hadn't been to GrillSmith in years and decided to have lunch with a girlfriend who was visiting. After debating over Bahama Breeze and GrillSmith we opted for GrillSmith. The food was not terrible, but nothing special either. I had the Buffalo chicken sandwich and my friend ordered the fried fish, which looked pretty generic. Coleslaw was very bland and I got about 6 frenchfries with my sandwich. Not as good as I remembered, probably won't be going back again.

I really liked this place.  I had to bug them several time, because I am visiting from out of town and had trouble finding it.  They were extremely attentive, really talked thru the items on the menu and then even went next door to get gluten free pasta from their sister restaurant - I mean, who does that sort of thing?  Food was excellent and the reduced menu on Sun and Mon was pretty hard to tell that it was reduced.  I wonder what the regular menu is like.  Food was fantastic.  I will be back here again if I come visit.

This is my go to place when I am craving sushi. We have been going here for years and we have never been disappointed. I haven't had one thing I haven't liked. We moved farther away so we don't frequent as much as we used to, but when we have a chance to visit we delightfully do so. Even our kids love it now. Raquel's tataki is my fave and the spicy softshell crab roll is one I get every single time. The tropical mango roll is one of my new faves too. I love the gyoza and the shuman. My kids love the salmon sashimi. You name it and we love it.

Ixca is a pretty good place. I really loved everything. The guacamole and chips were really good, but it did need some salt.  I had the fish taco and shrimp taco. Both were great, but the shrimp taco was my favorite. It had mango and avocado and a nice aioli.  My husband had the pastor and asada tacos. He enjoyed both. My kids had the nachoitos. Itbwas cheese sauce and grilled chicken on chips. They devoured it. For dessert we all shared the churros. It was so good! Overall, it was a great experience and this place has some serious potential. They just need to add a bit more seasoning to the guacamole.

I usually go to the fresh market on the southside, but I was up here for an appointment. I wanted something quick to eat before my appointment, so I ran in here really quick. This fresh market is so much nicer than the one on the Southside. It is clean and has a nice set up. Their prices are just like the other ones, but the sushi options varied more. I got the flying tiger roll. It was pretty spicy and it tasted pretty fresh for grocery store sushi. It was a lot better than Kroger.  I am up here weekly and if I am ever in a pinch and hungry I will probably run in here real quick. The employees were really nice too.

Yummy! My daughters and I visited here for the first time tonight. I wasn't sure what they would eat because they have never been big fans of chinese food.  We got potstickers and crab rangoon to start off and my 7 year old had 3 rangoons gone in less than 2 minutes. Both girls loved the crab rangoon and the potstickers.  The potstickers were my fave. The girls also got wonton soup and loved it. It was pretty tasty. I got the princess shrimp and I had to force myself to stop eating it. It was crunchy with just enough spice. The couple that ran the restaurant were so sweet and they worked really hard. We will definitely be back!

Our group was a statistic...ended up eating here because everything else nearby was packed on a weekend evening. But, it turned out to be a serendipitous turn of events in the end.

The bresaola appetizer was amazing (meaty and lemony and argula-y), as was the risotto. The gnocchi were tasty but not mind blowing. Overall, we were happy with everything we ordered. This place is a great choice for some solid Italian food.

But what totally made the experience was our server, Shereen. She was friendly and talkative but in no way annoying, and totally fun.

I generally don't opt for Italian food, but I would definitely come back here.

Ritter's Frozen Custard - currently only open for drive-thru and only accepting credit or debit card.  They do use a delivery service as well.  We had a butterscotch and hot fudge sundaes.  Their custard is excellent as always they service was fast, friendly and just pleasant.  I could go on and on about the sundaes but let's just say they were awesome.  If you need a sweet sundae give them a try.  Locally owned and run business and I am sure they will appreciate your support.  The custard and the team will put a smile on your face and you will be helping them.

I stopped by St. Louis for a visit and decided to have a frozen yogurt and came across this gem.  It has really good yogurt.  You can tell the ingredients are good compared to other stores that use cheap ingredients and yogurt powder.  

Ambience was clean and modern. 

Service was friendly. 

I had the angel food cake, cake batter, and Dutch chocolate.  

Location: 2 blocks from scotttrade stadium.  8 blocks from Busch stadium.  Very central to downtown and close to library. 

Next time I am in town, I will definitely visit again.

It's hard to knock a gym that's only steps from my job when I'm getting a good rate too (about $20 a month). The thing that make this fitness center is the staff. They do double duty as parsonal trainers and fitness class instructors and they do a good job at both.

On the downside, some of the equipment is older (especially the treadmills and the headphone jacks are hit or miss). It's a small gym, so there can only be one class at a time. There's not a lot of room for big drills. Not a lot of bells and whistles, but i can't complain for the pirce.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I was so happy to see that there is a Frozen Yogurt place in my neighborhood and couldn't wait to give it a try! I always see people outside so I figured that it would be great but I was honestly a little bit disappointed by all of it. Although the flavors are good they are very limited. There are few topping choices in comparison to other places but the overall quality is fine. The employee was great and she just couldn't stop talking but I enjoyed the conversation. Overall it's a great spot for the area but I wish that they had more to offer!

All I can really say is "Eh" about Serafina. Tria was packed around happy hour and we were hungry so we decided to stop in since there were plenty of openings. Unless you're sitting at the bar you can't enjoy the Serafina happy hour and we were hungry so we just sat at a table and ordered some food. The pizza is a bit over priced but we split the Margherita Pizza, which is $12.50 and it was good but nothing special. We also split the gnocchi ($15.75) and I highly suggest that you don't get it. It barely tastes the like anything and the texture is just too mushy. Overall everything was just ok and I don't plan on returning.

I live a block away from Villa Di Roma.  I've been there probably a dozen times.  I don't understand the hype. The food is solid. The food is good.  
    Maybe I think it's on the expensive side for Italian food.  $15 for Veal Parm?  $11 for spaghetti with olive oil?  
    I'm totally unimpressed by the garlic bread and I thought the breaded asparagus was far too soaked in butter. 
     The thing is - I'm totally not a food snob at all.   Maybe I need to be a food snob to appreciate this place? 
     Someone local help me out and explain what I'm missing compared to the 15 other Italian places within two blocks?

Needs to renew equipment or get some fixed. 

You can definitely tell the staff doesn't care about cleanliness. 

Nasty restrooms, swimming pool, Steam rooms, Sauna...
Not sure the last time they cleaned their pool.

Saw nasty debris in the womens locker room for at least 6 weeks proves they lack cleaning... I'm no longer going to this gym, but who knows... that same debris might still be there. 

We are all paying to join this gym. The least they can do is to keep it clean.

Not dissing all 24 hr. fitness facilities, just this location!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I took a friend here for her birthday. Atmosphere is good, but that's really where it stops. The drinks were over priced (which would be ok if they were good - but they were weak.) We had 3 rolls and 2 drinks and the bill after tip was over $90. The waiter we started with left half shift without saying a word. We should have known we were in for a treat when we walked in and their blackboard proudly displayed that they were no longer accepting coupons of ANY kind. Nothing says financial ruin like blackboard art, eh? Riiiight. Anyway - won't be back. Save yourself some money. Go to Sakura or Ocean World.

Ok so when I first reviewed Huddles, they decided to close 30 minutes early without warning - and since this was my first impression, it certainly was and is a lasting impression. While I don't find it professional, I decided to give it another go today. The yogurt was very tasty. On point as far as cost goes. Staff was friendly enough. One thing in particular that I liked is that 80% of the toppings are in individual containers which leaves less room for cross contamination... and germs. Loved the modern decor. If you're looking fire selection as far as yogurt flavors go though - it's no orange leaf or fro-yo.

Vincents is a good last minute grocery store when it comes to common items.  i feel like they really try to offer a wide variety... maybe even too much, but the harder to find items are not always in stock or are maybe past their due date.  I am usually weary about anything from the meat cooler (check the dates), but their deli usually has a good selection with fresh meat.  They are a bit overpriced, but so is everything in Soulard.  I frequent Vincents a lot, and will continue to do so, but i do feel like they do not live up to their potential.

Bravo is the best pizza place around in my opinion... Everything just looks so wonderful when you walk in it makes it hard to decide what to get!  I usually settle on one of their gorgeous stuffed peppers... Ths last one I had was a veggie version... A beautiful yellow bell pepper stuffed with all kinds of veggies topped with their great tomato sauce and lots of mozzarella cheese.  Oh my was it good!  Anyway, the other stuff we have tried is equally wonderful... Staff is always courteous and attentive.  Definitely a must try!

It's been years since we've been here, but since I accidentally checked in here instead of Sears the other day, I figured I would write a quick review.  I don't recall ever having any problems with Sears Auto Center, and it's been open for as long as a I can remember, which is sadly a pretty long time (wait, maybe it's not sad, since I can actually remember the last 30+ years - hmm!?!?) so they must be doing something right.  Anyway, nowadays we get our tires and other stuff for the vehicles elsewhere.  I pretty much forget it exists until I happen to be driving by.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I haven't actually been to this place, but I was lucky enough the other night to be the recipient of some fabulous leftovers that my daughter brought home.  Even the next day, the sausage flatbread (a special that day) was delicious.  Also got to try the Bruschetta Chicken (another special) which was very good, and the pasta was really yummy (I think it was the Cajun Chicken with Rigatoni a la Vodka).  My daughter also raved about the salad that comes with your meal and the bread with tomato sauce that they give you.  She can't wait to take me there someday - hopefully soon LOL.

In was in the area on business and asked everyone where is the best pizza place around. It was unanimous, everyone said go to Meglio's and I am glad I did. Friendly staff, nice dining area, fast service, reasonable and clean. They have a real wood burning brick oven. I ordered the Margarita pie and it was outstanding. Perfecto. They have a nice menu and looking at what the lunch crowd was ordering everything looked good. It is no wonder why this place has been voted as Buck County's best (says so on the menu). I will definitely come back to this place again.

This place has a great deal for Restaurant Week lunch. The meatballs, which are stuffed with cheese, are the best you will find in this city. The roast pork sandwich is outstanding, much better than the more famous roast pork sandwiches you can find elsewhere in the city. You can't go wrong with the Tiramisu or cannolli for dessert!

I've also been here for dinner in the outdoor patio. It's a wonderful place for an outdoor meal if it's not too hot. The sunday Gravy is the high point of dinner. It includes a slowly braised beef shortrib, the  meatball, and house-made hot fennel sausage in a sauce over some pasta.

This is a 5 star restaurant!

Got a great rate on the rental car. The problem is you can't trust the people working there to process your paperwork upon return of the car. Always make sure you get a receipt from them. I was charged over double because the person working failed to process my return in a timely manner and stated I returned the car two days after I actually did.   Lucky for me I used my iPhone to timestamp pictures of when I returned the car and I am in the process of getting a refund. Not acceptable,do your job correctly.  Avis corporate handled the situation well but that's probably because I had overwhelming proof.

Authentic Japanese cuisine. If you are craving it and  are in the area, check this place out! Dont be fooled by the location inside a strip mall. This place is a hidden gem!

There are two sides to this restaurant, the traditional sit down seating area and the Hibachi grill area. They are divided by a wall. Its a nice set up, you dont have to get the hibachi grill aroma if you are dining and arent doing hibachi style. 

This restaurant is a nice place to dine for a casual lunch or dinner. No reservations needed. 

The staff is friendly and knowledgeable. They can answer any questions you have about their menu.

This restaurant was fantastic.  The restaurant was nice and quiet.  A friend and I went for an early dinner and we shared the chicken and steak fajitas which were fantastic.  Their cheese queso was not up to par though, it was a little runny and was just missing something.  Their margaritas were super strong and extremely tasty!  What was great was you can buy a gallon of their pre mixed margarita mix to take home.  I brought it home for my husband and myself of course, and it was extremely enjoyable!  We will definitely be back again!

I get really irritated with stupid little fees.. Extra delivery charges when it's not that far away or the coupon is only for dine in..or print out the coupon? Really... That's annoying. There are 2 other Chinese restaurants in the vicinity that WANT my business. I'm a working professional and sometimes carry out and delivery is a priority. Stop nickel and diming and telling people to print out a coupon..you're supposed to be easy and convenient. They almost always forget the fried rice upgrade. But don't worry they won't forget to charge you for it.   But the Food is good. Not anything crazy.. id prefer panda express if they'd deliver

I have had my car repaired here on 2 occasions & was quite pleased with their professionalism and workmanship.  I recently went for an estimate & felt for the first time I was being spoken down to as a woman.
What I was saying I wanted done, was not being heard. The response I was getting is what they wanted to do, a really different story.
I am really quite suprised with the recent encounter & hope they get some training in customer service. What's a girl to do? Ask for what she wants ts & receive  she asks for.

This is definitely a dive bar. I have no opposition to dives & generally like them. This was no exception.
There were a few people there when I entered & they were still there about an hour latter when I left. No.problems, everything was fine.
When I left it was dark & being unfamiliar with the area, it felt a bit creepy. It definately is in a sketchy area
 I guess the lesson is, if you are a lone female, I would recommend leaving before dark.
What's a girl to do?  Dive bar, live bar, any bar....they all have a time & place.

This DD is in a busy location on US 19 near Main Street. True parking lot is small. I believe the staff does not listen, as so many customers are yelling at them.
Inside is fairly clean, but I have yet to get an order correct after 2 visits. Not sure of the reason behind this, but trying to get it corrected is harder than ordering. Between staff with selective hearing, excessive wait time, wrong orders & frustration, this will be my last visit to this location.
What's a girl to do? Coffee is good, but who wants a serving of drama?

When you are searching for a quick dessert or mid day snake this land of yogurt will certainly please. With your ability to add your own flavors of yogurt or combinations and the toppings of your own choice (they have a topping bar) it's a great place for hanging out or taking a bowl to go. I had two flavors the New York cheesecake and the chocolate cookie. I added some gummy bears, Oreo Cookie Crisp and cheesecake bites from the topping bar with fresh whip cream. The price was just over $5 and was well worth it

went here for the first time about 8 months agoand didnt care for it.figure to give it a second try.WHY?! i went here a few days ago and ordered chicken alfredo.blah!no taste to the chicken and the alfredo seemed watered down.my mom ordered the chix parm with a side of angel hair.she got fett instead.my dad like what he got.the garlic bread was awesome! the salad was fresh and a good size. for an app we order mozz stix.was alright but seem like it came from a bx.big portions but it struck out with me on 2 occassions.

This Starbucks location is really cool.  Since they've been open,  the tall gentleman barista (don't know his name but he reminds me of David from QVC)  has been so nice and helpful in my indecisive choices lol.... Though this spot has little and tight parking spots, it's best you park across in the median area, and it gets really crowded at different times of the busy day. 
 Also the location is easy without having to drive deep into Metairie or downtown if you are near the Lakefront, N.O.East, or Mid City areas.

This place is awesome plain and simple. I was trying to get a fresh cut before July 4th weekend and like a bonehead I waited until the last minute. Even tho they were completely booked they said they could still fit me in since I had been there before which means they value loyalty. The atmosphere is fantastic from the help to the way they have decorated the shop with philly sports memorabilia to old school barber shop artifacts. They offer you a beer while your waiting too. My man Nick hooked me up with a real fresh cut I highly recommend him.

This used to be a great location. The outdoor seating was my fave, but I think it's stopped? But I'm wondering if they hired a hospital designer (is that a thing?) to redecorate. It's blindingly bright. Are they making it less inviting on purpose? (No... really.) I'm also a little uncomfortable with a guy sitting in the corner, randomly yelling & cursing... the staff just ignores it, which I'm sure is not their fault. The staff is actually really great. 
The new sharps collection cans in the bathrooms are a nice touch.

This used to be a great location. The outdoor seating was my fave, but I think it's stopped? But I'm wondering if they hired a hospital designer (is that a thing?) to redecorate. It's blindingly bright. Are they making it less inviting on purpose? I'm also a little uncomfortable with a guy sitting in the corner, randomly yelling & cursing... the staff just ignores it, which I'm sure is not their fault. The staff is actually really great. 
Now one of the worst in town. The new sharps collection cans in the bathrooms are a nice touch.

First things first- they have amazing pastries. Really, really delicious, unlike many other coffee shops. Their coffee is just ok to me. It's hard to do better than la Colombe, I don't know why philly cafés resist when it's roasted here. I love the atmosphere of the shop, but as many have noted, the staff can be stand offish. The biggest problem is their prices. One day I ordered some egg dish and tea- and it was $15 and change. That's insane, and what they use for 'veggie bacon' was inedible. In short- great for pastry and coffee, not for over priced not awesome eggs.

Worst customer service. We've been here multiple times and have never been treated nicely. We went to grab ice cream tonight and stood in the lobby for five minutes while multiple people were sitting there eating ice cream. No one helped us. I went around to the front and could see the employees just standing in the back. This place has cameras so I'm sure they could see us standing there; still no one helped us. This place could care less about their customers; if they did, they would do a better job at training their employees and teaching them about customer service. This place will not be getting any of our business anymore.

I really like cheap, fast chinese food and this place was up to my liking! I ordered the chicken and mushroom combination plate with chow mein noodles for $4.95, there was so much food!!! My husband got the seafood tofu soup for $5.95, it was huge and piping hot! We also got free dessert for spending over $10, which was some coffee tasting cake. I will definately come back for take-out. The restaurant was not really a place to sit down and eat with only having a few tables and using plastic ware and styrofoam. Also, the drinks are bottled which to me means, overpriced.

Really excited this place opened up. There's so much hype about soft serve after a bunch of soft swerve chains opened up in NY. 

I love the flavors they have! I like how they paired the taro flavor up with the green tea and how they paired the pumpkin with the charcoal vanilla. They have such interesting flavors and it's absolutely delicious!

Prices are a little high but reasonable if that wanna stay competitive.

Only thing is location is a bit hidden and out of the way. I only accidentally stumbled on this spot as I was exiting Chinatown.

Congrats on the opening!

Vial American-mexican sludge so flavorless and processed it could have come from the worst public school cafeteria in the city.  Restaurants been up for sale for a while (You gotta search the net a little, but the sale notice is there, i think they checked out cuz some say it use to be good), if it weren't for their patio (overlooking Down-town broad ripple), drinks, and Naptown's inexplicable tolerance for mediocre food at low prices, this place would be a parking lot. Do your self a favor and just buy an Old El Paso taco kit and some ground chuck.   Service was average.

I've visited this location three times ( refer to my check-ins and each time the leasing office is closed during business hours...during those times the "will return" sign is up...I understand taking people on tours but my vehicle has been the only one parked in the "future resident parking" space. There has been one or two golf carts (maintenance ) sitting in the "future resident parking". Three strikes and your out...hence the negative review -- I cannot become a future resident if NO LEASING REP is available.

Not sure what happened to Eatalia since the first time I went but this time, they brought "pesto" to the table to go with the bread.  It was a vegetable "pesto" which was quite bad and happened to look like hummus. There were six of us and nobody liked it. I then asked for olive oil and balsamic for the bread, much better.

I then ordered their special, which involved shrimp, crab and capellini.  They forgot to add the flavor :(

Service was very good though.

For the record, I LOVE hummus, but not when I am told that it is pesto.  This "pesto" was just really bad, no matter *what* they call it.

I'm so sorry that I have to give this place 2 stars. I din't have a good experience at this location. Me and some co workers came after work because we were starved! We came in we were seated a friend and I ordered a pitcher of margaritas. It was very good but strong just like any other Mexican place. The one thing that threw me off was that our waiter was sitting a few booths down eating while we were eating. I'm a server too and I know that is a big NO NO. It really just didn't sit well with me. I ordered the Chuy's special with shrimp it was good but a very small portion.

I just found this place not to long ago.  It is a great place to go grab some good lunch because I work just down the road.   Their sushi is good, but their service not so much.  I never seem to feel that the people are glad that we came, but are more annoyed that they actually have to interact with people.  

They would have received more stars if their service was worked on.  Their food is 4 star worthy.  I have had better, but it is hard to beat this place because of its location.  If you are in the area I would check it out if you want some solid sushi

We first tried this place in the South Tampa location and then moved to Riverview. We were happy to discover the Riverview location was not too far from us. 
We have only tried the pepperoni pizza, breadsticks and cheese sticks. We have tried many different places and we continue to come back to Cappy's. We really like the New York style pizza. The price is very food for the size pizza. 
We have only ordered carry-out but the restaurant looks nice inside. We will have to eat in sometime and try the deep dish.

The Filling Station in the 12 South neighborhood is one of those unique Nashville spots that is fun to stop by. You can either grab a pint on tap and stick around for a while or you can grab a six-pack or growler with beer to-go. They have a pretty good selection of different craft beer. The interior is pretty small but they do have a few tables and also some games to play. They also have a bit of seating outside as well. 

Definitely a cool place if you're in the area or if you grab dinner at Edley's next door then I like coming here for a drink after.

It really beats me why this Dunkin' has such a low rating. The employees are SUPER nice, the service is quick and the location in Midtown is convenient. I popped in the other morning to get half a dozen donuts for my coworkers (I know, coworker of the year award goes to me) and an iced latte and I was in and out in 15 minutes in spite of a long line. The coffee was just what I ordered and they were great. Parking can be a little bit of a hassle because there is only street/metered parking but that usually isn't a big deal if you come early in the morning. I will be back!

I found this place with my husband and my teenage nieces.  It took 40 minutes to be seated even though during that time there were tables available.  So we are seated and no one comes not offering water or checking on us. Several people around were waiting for service and those with food were unhappy.  Overall horrible service,  place needed a little cleaning and food was unappealing to those eating. We did not est but instead left simply due to the horrible service.  Will never go back nor do I recommend.  STAY AWAY!

I had a very pleasant experience last night at this restaurant.  Our party of six was seated in a semi-private area, far enough from the bar and music to be relaxed, yet not oblivious to the scene.  Our server was knowledgeable, his assistants prompt, and the food and drinks were enjoyable.

The menu takes some time to understand, as the distinction between appetizers and "real" food is minimal, but the choices are intriguing and varied.  I'm not sure how long the  Pennsylvania Dutch concept will last, but you should get here while it does to try some interesting meditations on comfort food. 

I'll be back.

CCC is a family run business serving very good Italian dishes. The menu is not limited to just Italian, there's enough variety to fill just about any taste preferences. The menu claims that fried chicken is a speciality. You will have to be the judge of that.The two dishes and salads that I sampled were very good. The service was good and friendly.The dining room seats about 25. Take away is a viable option, and appears to be a popular choice. If you are in the Edwardsville area I'd suggest that you give CCC a try.

The place is clean, the service is acceptable and the food is at least average. The menu is not extensive, but serves to satiate a college appetite. We sampled one of the french fry apps and liked it a lot. The burgers were fine. The beer selection is good. The menu did not indicated that the burger came with any sort of side, but the server asked what side I wanted, so I ordered one (5 lame-ass onion rings). She failed to indicate that they would come as additional $4 charge. I can handle an upsell, but I'd like full disclose.

Went and could not believe the fantastic atmosphere. A very romantic, cute little dining experience, in and outside.

So far I've had the bruscetta, salsiccia and mozarella panini, capricossia pizza, and the PENNE A LA VODKA (wow. incredible.). All were absolutely amazing, and highly highly recommended. For the quality, too, I think the price is absolutely fantastic. A pizza can easily be split between two people, and that's $13... just don't go expecting your pizza hut deep dish kind of situation.

And, great music on the weekend.

Visited Shear Sherrie by chance at Studio 16 when I was in a wedding on 11/24/2012. The bride had made all of our appts, so I went into the situation blindly. Ladies, we all know we get a little nervous letting a stranger give us an updo!! I felt more and more confident watching Sherrie do other girls hair. Then it was my turn.
