Excellent, attentive service and very clean. Adorable kids playing ball out front. Rich, dizzying aromatics wafting from the kitchen.

Excellent tamales, both the pork and chicken. The 4 stars rather than 5 is because most of the meat was a little dry, but the tamales themselves were tender and flavorful. 

Highly recommend the salsa verde. If store bought rather than homemade, I'd love to know from where.

Oh! THE COMPLIMENTARY CHIIIIPS! DELICIOUS.

When ordering rice (which has a strong black pepper spice flavor), and if you have less than four people at your table, just get the small. Ferreals.

This place is really fun, because you get to design your own pizza everything from the crust, sauce, toppings and seasonings! They have a huge variety of ingredients available as well. I chose the rosemary herb crust which was good, however, I made the mistake of picking chicken as my protein when I should have obviously went for the pepperoni :) Anyhow, the interior of this restaurant is great. The staff is both friendly and helpful. Not to mention it is conveniently located by the U of A campus!

I would recommend for everyone to try this place out at least once :)

Igloo is my favorite place in Philly to grab froyo. Menchie's is my all-time favorite, but there aren't any here. I always grab two flavors--usually the greek + one other. Flavors I've had are the coffee, peanut butter (both so good!), but last night I had the cookie dough (which was okay). There are a standard amount of toppings to choose from: candies, fresh fruit, granola, nuts, and some sauces. Nothing too special. 

But man oh man. I would cry if I could never have the greek frozen yogurt again--it's that good! So creamy and rich and all around just fantastic. That's definitely what keeps me coming back!

Love this place. I really can't say enough positive things about Durango. It is my go to spot for tacos!

Durango is a family run place; they also own a grocery in the same plaza. Check it out for the same ingredients they use in many of their dishes. What will always be missing if you try to recreate their specialties at home is the masterful touch of spice and sauces they make in house.

I have introduced many friends to Durango and they all enjoy it (almost) as much as I do.

Pro tip: they'll never bring you the check. Go up to the counter to pay, and don't take it personally, that's just how they operate.

Enjoy!

I care a lot about the atmosphere of a place and I'm not necessarily talking about how it looks.  I mainly care about the people atmosphere.  I've now been to the Taco and Burrito place three times and the workers behind the counter have recognized me each time (not the first time of course).  The second time they even gave me a free Quesadilla!  The food is extremely inexpensive and it tastes good.  Not much more that you can ask for.  I've had the steak and chicken tacos, of which I preferred the steak.  We'll definitely go back.

VERY! GOOD! AUTHENTIC! TACOS! Came here for a quick lunch one day since the taco deal looked decent and it was! Got two al pastor and one chicken taco - both well seasoned and tender proteins topped with cilantro and onions. While waiting for the tacos to come out we were given nachos with refried beans and Cheese sprinkled on top. I normally don't like beans but it was really good to snack on! And there was a slightly spicy sauce to dip it in. Overall, great lunch experience and a good deal! A little under 9$ I think for three tacos which is very good pricing for a store front. Would def come back

I deposited through the drive through, because of that they say that an automatic hold gets put on my bank account. Brian is the bank manager, he says that because it was placed in the atm that there is nothing he can do about it. He deflects all responsibility to corporate, I asked him to release a small portion so that I could pay for my server. He refuses to do so. As a small business sometimes money is tight but even by now with a normal bank the check would have gone through. Brian has not been nice in any case.

okay so who doesn't love Subway! So this review will be based on this location- ehhhhh- not to happy. First what place doesn't accept digital coupons now-a-days? Why have me kill a tree to use a coupon at your location:( Not only that when i asked there was some serious hesitation and uncertainty if you did or didn't. But my sandwich was good i always like getting a healthy sandwich at Subway for lunch (and i get it the way i like it). It was a clean location and the staff was so-so not too friendly but had no problems - just not very welcoming. We shall see how long ill go before returning.

I would say this place is 3.5 stars.... The only reason I can't give this place a solid 4 or 5 is because it is a hit or miss.. Sometimes the rice is perfect.. and sometimes the rice is hard and I can taste the grainyness of it which I hate.  Other than that the prices are more than reasonable, I would say they have the cheapest sushi in town! They often have 50% off rolls everyday.... Mondays are my favorite because their cali rolls are priced at $2.00 and their spicy tuna rolls are a mere $2.50. I can't complain about Wednesdays either.. as their rainbow rolls are $5.00.

I go here all the time because it is right by my house but recently the orders have been screwed up. The other day my husband ordered 2 coffees and when he got to the window they tried to give him a dozen donuts. He said he didn't order that, he only ordered two coffees. They asked him if he wanted to buy the donuts and they would give him the coffees for free. Um no. We don't need a dozen donuts. Just the coffees please. And now today he specified that we wanted two dark roast pumpkin coffees with cream and 2 Splenda and we now have 2 regular coffees that are not dark roast, not pumpkin, and do not have Splenda. Ugh.

DO NOT COME HERE! This is the absolute worst hotel stay of my life. This is a nightmare. The staff here is allowing echoing screaming and yelling to continue hours past designated "Quiet hours" that start at 9pm. They are allowing a level of noise that can be heard throughout the hotel. This stay was booked because I thought I could get a good night's sleep at a Marriott before running in a marathon but this is a ludicrous. Multiple calls to the front desk we're useless. At nearly midnight it sounds like an absolute party is going on right outside my room door and the hotel is making no effort to stop it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went there today because I read something about them having a Hello Kitty roll and my boyfriend and I enjoying trying new places. Our waitress was awesome, she really took care of us. The California roll didn't have any roe on it and hardly ANY rice but a crapton of sesame seeds. My hello kitty roll was very disappointing :( it was a very small hand roll for 15.00. My boyfriend got the king cake roll and liked it. I'm glad we tried this place but I would definitely recommend Sushi Brothers over Geisha any day!

I've been a Hilton Honors member for a few years, but I probably wouldn't stay at this hotel unless it was necessary. 

PROS:
I thought the staff was very friendly and helpful. Due to the construction, you're greeted with a warm cookie (amazing). 
You're very close to everything (casino, aquarium, bars, restaurants, etc.)

CONS:
Construction was a bit of a pain at times. 
The room wasn't as updated as I thought it would be, because I was told our room was renovated. 
Our room never seemed to be 100% cleaned and towels refreshed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Just popping by 7 years later to say Via Vai remains my favorite Italian restaurant in Santa Barbara. I dream about their butterhead lettuce salad (Insalata Cappuccina), calamari, pizzas (Margherita), and pasta dishes (particularly their Cappellini Con Pomodoro, Pappardelle Alla Contadina, and Linguini Con Vongole). However, you truly can't go wrong with anything on the menu. Even the olive oil that comes with the bread is to die for.

All of their servers are the best and their hostess DD is an angel. I highly recommend making a reservation so you can get a spot on their lovely patio.

And Tiramisú for dessert is always a good idea ;)

I dream about their tuna dumplings on a daily basis. I'm almost officially a Vic Sushi Bar tuna dumpling addict just looking for my next fix of tuna. I really do love the ambiance of Vic's sushi bar, even tho there is none. There are only about 10 seats in the entire place, one table for four and a sushi bar. You order directly from your sushi chef which gives it a little something extra. Great menu of special rolls and an awesome special of three rolls for $10.95. That's not just a lunch special that is ALL the time! 

I just hope to one day get my picture on the wall like all the other regular tuna dumpling eaters!

I dig totally dig this place!  This place has TONS of custom hand rolls and everyone I've tried was delicious! 

If you like it raw is their motto, and yes I do like it raw!  Their fresh fish (sashimi) is delicious!  They have great cuts of fish, they have additional items on their menu if you're willing to try something different.  This place is a combo of Japanese and Korean dishes so they provide great options.

I normally get take-out here which is always ready when they promise.  My casual go to sushi place.

This place is authentic to South Philly and has delicious Italian-American fare.  The portions are large so be prepared to take items home.  Pricing is around $15 for general pasta dishes and seafood dishes are around $25.  The place has a long history which makes dining here interesting. 

The only downside I see here is the service. For such a small place, service is not that attentive and Ive waited about 20 minutes to have my drink refilled and waited another 20 trying to get a server for the check.  Worth trying out for yourself but dont think it's worth the $$$.

Sushi was great but unfortunately the service was awkward.  I say awkward because they were attentive but in the wrong way.

I went here with a friend for dinner, used a Groupon deal which was worth it but the hostess/server was all over the place. They were really nice girls but they constantly wanted to remove plates that I was still working on.  I felt kind of rushed eating it since I felt like they were going to come take my plates away when there was obviously food on it.

I think I'll stick to take out from this place to avoid the awkward dining experience I had the other day.

Holy mole! Yum. The consome, quesadilla, and house salad with avocado or the chicken mole are where it's at! The cheese sauce is not the usual, it's got carrot pieces and cilantro which was so good. I forgot it was the cheese and may or may not have eaten a spoonful or two of the cheese. Dont hate, you thought about it, I did it. Cadillac Margaritas are pretty good but I'd much rather them with real lime juice. Everything else is made with love. Definitely a fan of the trios on the menu so you can taste a few things.

This place is cool, I love that they came to Cherokee Street, we need more fun stuff other than a ton of Mexican restaurants (which are awesome too). Hipsters paradise for sure, and love they now serve booze. Went last night and got a Lavender Martini. It was delicious but way small (more like a large shot), and overpriced. I'll forgive you as it's new, but you have cool pictures on facebook of your drinks, make them as pretty and booziful as the pictures please. I'll bring friends if you do, otherwise I am just coming here for breakfast and orange cream shakes (delicious)!
Your staff and cooks rock, you will go places.

Whats the word for the next level down from al dente ? Not cooked ? 

The waiter was nice to sent it back to the kitchen , what he brought back seemed like they just put it on the microwave and heated up. 

I had the fettuccine al salmone , it was so fishy. I couldn't take another bite, it looked good but the taste was just so so. 

Penne alla carsuso - tasteless, this plate we also sent back and when it got back it was half empty. What happened ?  

Soup of the day - i think it was pumpkin soup? I couldn't remember much it was mediocre.

This is my favorite sushi restaurant in the city ! 

I have been here quiet a few times and I am pleased each time. I always order miso soup and sashimi for two. The miso soup is good but I am still searching for THE ONE. Sashimi for two is way more than enough, you actually dont have to order any rolls, but their rolls are so good ! I have been trying 2-3 different rolls each time I come here and they were all pretty tasty. Sushi are well presented , I think they have really talented chefs. 

The decor here is cool, it's great for a date night . Waiters are nice and professional.

Very interesting and more innovative Japanese food.  The lunch menu has some interesting options and overall, it is very tasty.  I really liked the spicy tuna bowl which is basically a deconstructed spicy tuna roll.  The spicy tuna (in spicy tuna rolls), avocado, and daikon with ginger.  Great chirashi option and definitely different.  The salmon teriyaki bento was good...whatever that roasted sweet potato fry was soooooo delicious.  And they also had an interested Korean sushi spin with kimchi and tuna and very tasty sauce.  Overall, good meal.  Just a bit pricier than I expected.

The food is not bad.  I was hoping for more home made pasta.  The calamari appetizer was interesting...we were expecting the "traditional" fried calamari appetizer but it was calamari in marinara sauce.  Although the marinara sauce was delicious.  The pastas we ordered were all solid and tasty, just not very special.  The worst part was service was not attentive at all.  There were maybe 3 other tables occupied in the entire restaurant and we had to wait for a very long time to get anything.  At the same time, the waitress kept rushing us through our meal and took our plates before we even finished eating.

Definitely one of the best Italian dinners I've had in the city so far. I came here for a restaurant week lunch and was absolutely flabbergasted by the quality of all the dishes on the menu (we basically tried everything because the options were limited *no complaints there* and my friend and I love splitting).

From the pulled mozzarella to the arancini to the orecchiette, and finally the chocolate pistachio cannoli... everything was droolworthy and impeccably prepared. The ambiance in the restaurant is unbelievably cute as well.

Would go back in a heartbeat.

I only get one thing at any Dunkin' Donuts - a vanilla chai. As long as it's hot, creamy, frothy, & not underfilled I'm a happy camper. This location always gets it right so I have no complaints in that regard. I hate that they sometimes use that lid that doesn't have that little seal to keep the drink from spilling. They should always give that lid for a hot beverage ordered through the drive-thru. Also, the customer service is almost non-existent but I know that coming in so it's never a big deal. My husband got a donut once and it was terribly stale & inedible. Went straight to the garbage.

3 stars because my drink always tastes great.

This place seems in need of a Mexican cook. I have been there several times and everything I have ordered was bland and didn't really have any flavor. Usually Mexican food has some spice and great flavor but I don't think they even salt and pepper their meat. The salsa tastes like straight tomato juice and even after dumping more than a normal amount of hot sauce that's on the table its still below average. I would say that the staff is friendly but that's about it. I was really hoping this place would be a better place to eat at since the town is pretty small.

So I read many reviews about CTO and decided to try it out. First off the guy on the phone that took my order was so nice, kind and spoke very good english. I ordered beef n broccoli combo, general tso chicken combo and egg drop dumpling soup with a free order of plain lo mein bc I had a coupon. General Tso chicken was excellent, I didn`t like the beef n broccoli as much, it actually tasted better the next day. Same goes for the egg drop soup, it tasted better the next day. Will try this place out again and hopefully have a better review next time. Would definitely recommend overall.

I honestly thought this place was an asian restaurant everytime I drove by but apparently not, haha. It`s your normal typical cafe. I went to eat with my co-worker and it wasn't to bad. I had a greek salad, but BIG RECOMMENDATION if you get the greek salad try it with the italian dressing. I like balsamic vinaigrette  but this way to sweet and it just tasted so much better with the italian dressing. Loaded fries were very yummy and staff was helpful and polite. Looking at the name I was kind of expecting something alittle nicer like a panera bread but oh well. Its a good lunch place or a quick bite to each.

Where should I even begin? Should I start with the lack of any aroma of anything cooking coming from the kitchen? Or how speedy the food came out because nothing is cooked to order? How about the Wal-Mart pre-shredded cheese and bagged lettuce and chips? Oooh, how about the sounds of things stirring or being chopped, with no aroma of anything sizzling, grilling, etc. Hopefully, the word "authentic" is nowhere in the description of this place. Also, no happy hour unless there is Saints or LSU football, so no drink or food specials during the week. To say we were let down would be an understatement.

I cant believe I've never reviewed Spuntinos. They are really good personal size pizza in the neighborhood. 

We tried almost all of their pizzas . Each pizza is 10inch and perfect as an individual platter. They have pizzas without sauce. Never tried but I bet those are good too. They do have a good selection of wines which was very appealing to set outside and drink wine along with pizza. Its wood fired pizza and its good and dough is like sour dough. Very interesting. 

NOTE: NEW RULE 2% FEES ON CREDIT CARDS.

I don't think this is bad but something to be aware of. I will continue to use Spuntinos irrespective :)

Recommend this place.

My husband and I have been ordering pizza from here since we moved out to Tarpon in the past month and we love their pizza, the portions are huge too, which we love. Only one time we ordered a pizza and asked for extra mushrooms, came home and there was not one mushroom on it at all and we paid extra, we called the place and they gave us a credit/free pizza the next time we ordered from there which was great because we still continue to order from there, just making sure we check the pizza before getting home!

My mother and sister-in-law threw me a surprise "welcome to philly" lunch here and we had a wonderful experience! Toscana was very accommodating for a private lunch and had a nice room with fairy light decor and big open windows (that you can close if you wish) that set the perfect ambience. We all really enjoyed our food and the service was good too! I had the eggplant rollatine, which is rolled eggplant filled with ricotta, a blend of tuscan cheeses, and baby spinach topped with a tomato sauce and serviced with a cast iron with pasta. It was very flavorful and a great vegetarian dish!

I stayed here for a bachelorette party.  Both groups had huge rooms, the location was great (only a few blocks to Bourbon Street, Frenchman Street, and Cafe du Monde).  Older rooms, but comfortable beds, and they all had style.  Good water pressure in the shower (always a plus).  Our rooms were well-cleaned every day and all staff that I dealt with were excellent. The pool, while also a plus, was a little bit dirty, a little bit small, and a little bit too warm on labor day weekend.  I imagine all of these things are hard to control in NOLA so close to all the tourist traps, but they are true.  I would definitely stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
A great experience!
The counter was super easy to find, just at the end of the front desk.  The guy working the desk had top notch customer service skills and the whole thing took about 20 minutes start to finish.
The downtown location is far better for me than trekking to the airport to get a car.  The only annoying thing is driving down from the 10th floor in the parking garage.  A small price to pay to not go to the airport!
There is a night key drop but you have to park (on the 10th floor of the self-park garage) and then hit the Enterprise desk.
Totally stoked on this location - will definitely be renting from here again.

I'm glad I went before reading all the negative Yelp Reviews.  We went at a friends suggestion and it's just good, old fashioned burger joint food.  Perhaps it's because of all the new equipment and reopening, but everything we ate was fresh (including the great fried Zucchini), a basic (but really good) grilled cheese, and my husband loved his BBQ burger and Chili cheese fries.  It's not "gourmet" its just good food.  We will be back, and while it does take a while- that's sort of the norm when something is being made to order.  If I wanted fast food- I'd go to Sonic.

Customer service: great. The two girls were very sweet

My coffee: I ordered the white Mocha. My coffee taste burnt and really bitter. 

I got a tahoe trail bar it was delicious

They have sandwiches,  wraps, bagels, muffins and bread

Now for why they get a 2 star review. My coffee was terrible. It was extremely bitter. It tasted burnt. I ordered a white mocha and it tasted nothing like it. 

They have other things on the menu that look really good, so if I'm hungry or thirsty and in the dmv, I'll give them another chance.

The sushi itself was delicious, but the execution was sloppy. They have a self serve salad bar with canned peaches, house salad, edamame and miso soup. 

The restaurant itself is very spacious. Can definitely accommodate large parties/large crowd. 

The service was alright. Nothing out of the ordinary or spectacular worth reporting. 

I like raw sushi so the sushi that was on my rolls tasted fresh and like it was supposed to. 

Overall, I wasn't overly satisfied nor dissatisfied with my dining experience. I would recommend it if your in the area, but Reef in downtown Reno holds the record for me.

When El Vez has too long of a wait or you just can't handle going there again, this should definitely be the next place on your list to try! It's right across the street, with a more intimate and date like feel, and smaller portions with tons of unique flavor. Check it out for lunch. I loved my chicken taquitos and the mango guac (although I wish the guac portion was a bit larger). The best thing is absolutely the tres leches cake, definitely one of the best I've ever had. The perfect place for your upscale, fancy Mexican needs!

Pass on the stale cupcakes...

Only reason we ended up here is because it's the only cafe/dessert place in the area and my bad dessert cravings, unfortunately. The first time we walked in were ignored as the counter person was with someone else...so we left and walked around and came back. This time she came around and gave us our sad little vanilla cupcake ($.95). It tasted just like a Shop Rite fake chemical cupcake...that was old. So not only is there little choice of dessert...it is also not that good. Perhaps the gelatos would have been better. Definitely dissappointed.

One of the best gyms in the city, with definitely the best classes. There are tons of easier as well as more challenging classes ranging from yoga to spinning to bootcamp. All the staff is great and knowledgeable, and seem to actually enjoy being there. The gym also has a nice pool and steam room, which are always empty at the end of the day. Spinning and Kristin's classes get filed up really fast, so must get there early. Overall, I would still love to be a member but unfortunately the gym is out of my way and I have to go to LA Fitness, but I love visiting with day passes! Plus there are tons of renovations so it just keeps getting better!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This branch doesn't overall feel like a bank should feel, granted I've never been inside but I've been through the drive-thru plenty and the ATM. Which never go to the ATM in the morning hours! My goodness you cannot read the screen!! But ultimately going through the drive-thru, the tellers aren't very friendly, they don't ask how you want your cash back, and it ends up taking a bit of time to get accomplished what you go there to do. Unfortunately for me this is the most convenient option, especially when I have my pup with me in the car.

I've been here twice and extremely happy with the food each time. It's a small spot and they keep you distanced. No complaints there at all. 

The service has always been good as well. They keep the drinks full and help you out with the menu if needed. 

My Favs: Atlantic Roll, Hot MaMa Roll and the Funky Roll. I'll admit I only liked cooked protein sushi, but I'm definitely going to venture the next time I come back!

Kids Fav: Teriyaki Sushi. You'd think they sprinkled crack on it the way the kid was eating it and asking for more!

Since I've moved to Boise numerous people have told me about this place. My family is Italian so for me it's hard going to an Italian  restaurant everything is compared to my folks cooking. So a friend invited me the other night and I said what the heck. As soon as I walked in i knew this wasn't going to be a great experience. First off the service was meh the bread seriously hard pass on that and the wine was a no as well. I ordered the cioppino an Italian Fish soup/stew. Large serving but I wasn't impressed but it wasn't horrible. I would say this place is a step above olive garden not horrible but not great.

How could this be anything less than 5 stars?!  Now one of my favorite ice cream shops in the country....too bad (or maybe good....) that its so far away!

We tried the avocado (yep!), the butterscotch English toffee, and the honey nut feta...ohhh so good.  The serving size was very generous and for those that can't make up their mind they serve tasting boats where you get 4 or 6 golf ball size samplings.  They also offer samples (of course) but don't be a "sample hog."

Definitely go out of your way to sample these goodies...you won't regret it.

I had been going here for about 4 appointments. The last one I was left unattended during a hair process that came out incorrect. They did "toning" to correct it. Then my stylist was told her next appointment was in. My cut was not finished and the tone burned my scalp. The problem was not corrected and I have not heard back from any manager. I'm devastated by my hair being ruined and can't believe the rude behavior and lack of follow up. I'm still waiting to hear from a gm as to how to fix this and what apology I will get. I am devastated.

Udderly Delicious as the lettering in the front window proudly proclaims! 

Browns is busy serving up Bassets ice cream, a local favorite, featuring your favorite standby flavors and a couple of original and locally inspired flavors like Gadzooks and WHYY! (Cheers if you get the references!)

Bring your cash for a heaping scoop in a homemade hand dipped waffle cone! There is plenty of seating but it wouldn't be a summer evening without a stroll along bridge street! 

Friendly and fast service makes this the perfect place to stop for a summer treat!

This hotel is really the best option from what is available in the area. I came on a lengthy business trip, and the staff made me feel welcome day after day. They have a great breakfast selection in the morning. Everything from pastries, eggs, oatmeal, cereal and coffees. 
I do, however, recommend they keep the common areas more clean. Instead of letting crumbs and lint and dust and dirt clearly sit all over the lengths of the hallways, have one of the housekeepers run the vacuum once a day. It really will make a HUGE difference. And it only takes a few minutes.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Even though it's just off state street this place manages to stay pretty well hidden. Roy is definitely eclectic, which I think adds to the charm! Red leather booths are lit with unique rawhide and metal lamps. Deep navy blue wall adorned with some excellent (though some unusual) artwork, extend to a high ceiling. Menus are all handwritten and an enormous retro neon sign fills the wall above the bar. The staff is friendly and attentive. I had seared scallops on a bed of greens. Light and delicious! Prices are very reasonable.

I'm LIT. I love this place and the bartender was a disrespectful asshole. She would come up to my group, ask us what drinks we wanted, make one drink and go to someone else finish making their drinks, and then come back to us and make the other drinks we had already asked for. Half the time she just straight up ignored us. As a bartender myself, I understand a busy bar, but she was just being petty and was discriminating. I've never felt so belittled in a bar. I love the drinks and band but the blonde lady in her LATE 30s SUCKS!

There's nothing worse than when something happens to your car... especially when your AC goes out in the middle of a hot St. Louis summer. The worst part is that I just had the AC compressor replaced by another place last year. Of course it was just out of the warranty, and they wouldn't help me out at all. When I went to see Dave at Knight Auto, he actually told me if I bought the compressor online myself, he would install it and it would save me a ton of money! I was blown away that a mechanic would do that. 

He did it in less than a day and I saved about 30% over what I paid last time. Super happy!

Cool small bar on prytania (obviously).  Cool vibe for sure and not too crowded.  They have Founders (MI) on tap which you aint going to find anywhere else in NOLA.  Nice bar tender.  I'd go back in a heart beat with friends for beer.  

When I went they were letting a popup kitchen serve; NOLATCHOS.  (full disclosure, I am friends with the cook).  I love bars with popups so that was awesome. Plus nachos were awesome.  Huge fan.  Supedup velveta cheese, pork, pickled onions, jalapenos, sourcream/cilantro and homemade bbq.  Very very good.  (she'll have a bike cart soon and not just a popup)

Wow! We have pizza that good in Nola? Went there for late lunch on a Sunday, and man was I impressed.  Staffed completely by bohemian-hippie types (I mean nothing negative by this) as is typical of Bywater (the neighborhood it's located in) and doing a brisk business they were whipping out hot pizzas at a high rate.  As is the case with most great pizzerias, the Margherita was awesome - zesty sauce, fresh mozzarella, crisp crust - definately the best of that type I've had in the City.  Somewhat out of the way unless you live near Bywater but well worth the ride.

It was after lunch and my friend and I needed a "pick me up".  We decided on a coffee from the experts at Starbucks.  The store was actually fairly busy for 1:30pm but we were helped right away.  I had the Pikes Place regular coffee with room for cream.  My friend had the peppermint white mocha in decaf.  The store is very clean and so was the bathroom.  The customer service here is very good and the employees are very professional.  My favorite drink at Starbucks is their Egg Nog latte but I only felt like a cup of plain coffee this visit.  Too much caffeine will keep me awake later.

I've been here twice and will probably not be going back. The first time I came, a friend and I sat outside and had to wait a pretty long time before even getting water. We didn't mind because it was such a nice night.

I gave them a second chance, and came back on a Saturday around 7pm to sit inside. This experience was worst... The service was ok but felt rushed. The food was also just ok, but expensive. The worst, however was the noise. It was so crowded and so LOUD that we ended up cutting drinks short to just get out of there so we could have a real conversation.

Great gym! New gym in this area. Staff is super nice and helpful if you have questions.  I love the virtual workout room. It allows you to do many different kinds of workouts led by an instructor.  Yes, it's basically like doing workout dvds but you can do a very wide variety of things because the gym has a wide variety of equipment.  I love to spin and the spin workout is great. The one thing that I don't like is that the spin bikes do not have anything on them to tell you your rpms or distance.  I love to spin sometimes to my own music and knowing things like that would be really helpful.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Arby's has been a favorite of ours for years.  Just can't beat the flavor of their roast beef.  We do miss the onion petals . The onion rings are okay but, onion petals they are not!  The apple crisp for fall fell short of our expectations.  Thoughts of Apple crisp bring to mind a warm crunchy topping just waiting to mingle with hot cinnamon apples.  This is more of an apple cake.  Tasty.  Warm cherry or Apple turnovers melt in your mouth.  Yum!   The sandwiches are all good though we are partial to the French dip a d the roast beef.  We'll keep coming back!

I had dinner with three friends here on Friday night, from the moment I got there I knew it would be a great experience.  Everyone from the host to bartender to waiter was excellent, paid attention to detail and was very knowledgeable about the food and wine.

We started with the foie gras soup and pop over which are amazing and worth the trip alone.  I had the beef tartar which was very good following that we each ordered a different pasta dish and one was better than the other.  Main course I had tilefish which was cooked perfectly.  My friend had the fried chicken which was outrageously good. We can't wait to come back!

Off Freret Street is this a small ice cream shop with a good selection of snow cones and homemade ice cream.  Sign says 2 scoops of ice cream for $5.95 and you actually get 4 scoops with the option of have the ice cream in a small cup, a waffle cone or may favorite a waffle bowl. The guy working there is extra courteous and the three outdoor tables are great for enjoying your ice cream and the great NOLA weather.

I highly recommend if you are seeking a small intimate place to get ice cream with your family and loved ones.

Fresh and great tasting fish in Center City! The Sushi Roll Lunch Special cannot be beat and it's what brings me back again and  again. For $10.95, you get a choice of 3 standard rolls with a side of either miso soup or salad with ginger dressing (my fave)! 

The staff is friendly and speedy. Definitely worth a lunch time trip for either dine-in or take-out!

One suggestion: frequent customer punch card for people like me who would like to feel less guilty about frequent trips because I'm working towards that something free!

I'm on the fence here

I left my previous office over 10 years because they rushed me thru choosing my glasses, they fit horribly and it seemed they did very little to fix the situation. 

This office was very nice. But in the end I just didn't feel my exam was as through as I thought it should be. But maybe there wasn't enough change to warrant flipping thru more choices in lenses. They were very good about putting lenses in a pair of old frames that I liked. And insurance paid everything they said it would. 

Nice doctor and staff.  Just can't decide whether to go back next year or not.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
A unique casino lounge on the first floor towards the front north end. 

Updated, yet reminiscent of the 70's with purple and pink neon lights and velour seating. It has a really cool signature water and fire pit at one end.  In the  afternoon the bar is full of retirees playing the slots. Around 8 pm the younger crowd fills the entire place up. At this bar they still serve a few old school cocktails like pink squirrels, grasshoppers and Brandy Alexander, all made with ice cream. As well as any martini you want. 

Closing time ? Not really sure, it there's partiers there they keep on going.

This was an amazing place for a big group. Their chicken cutlets did not disappoint! They are thin, large, and delicious! We started with several bottles of red wine and the antipasti. Nearly everyone at the table got the chicken parm which was the way to go. I do wish a little more pasta came with it, but the portion of chicken parm was huge! We came for a birthday, so of course we finished off with the chocolate torte and ice cream which the birthday girl enjoyed. Service was quick and while small, accommodated a group of 11 with ease. I'll be back!

Delicious ice cream and sorbet!  Quick and friendly service with a smile. If you can't decide what to get, try thr 4 mini scoop sampler. The scoops aren't actually that mini, and it's totally worth it for $5 flat- tax is included. Just make sure you bring cash! I would recommend the mexican hot chocolate, lavender honey, pear-ginger sorbet, and the mango. So creamy and delicious!  Eat it quickly, because it does melt rather quickly. Lots of seating indoors as well as a bench outside. Easy access via the St. Charles streetcar. Definitely check this place out if you are visiting New Orleans!

Really enjoyed my stay at the Marriott. The rooms are pretty big and the hotel staff was able to arrange joining rooms for our bachelorette party. The big perk for us was location: we were close enough to walk to Broadway but we were off Broadway enough that we could go to restaurants kind of away from that tourist hot zone. We spent a day at the pool and it was pretty full, but not overwhelmingly crowded. Their cabana rates aren't crazy high so I would recommend getting a cabana if you have 6 or more people in your party. They also have a very nice gym and spa if you're into that kind of stuff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is the nicest Starbucks I have been to in a while. It is spacious, clean, and a little modern. I was meeting a friend up here for coffee after work, and while the traffic was hectic and busy, upon walking in I immediately felt at ease. Something about a smiling barista and the thought that coffee is on its way just puts me into a good mood. It also helps that there was so many tables so we could find a quiet area to catch up. I would definitely recommend this location if you plan on sitting and enjoying your coffee there.

Came in for a drink after Eclipse Pizza. I was surprised at how close this location is to the one on 4th street. This location does not offer food, but it has a large selection of wine and liquor. You can purchase a bottle of wine to drink there or any drink of choice. Nick got a margarita on the rocks and I got the Zinfandel. Both drinks were amazing but the ambiance is what really made it better. The bar area is spacious and sits 15-20 persons comfortably. Across the bar there is lounge area with sofas, tables and chairs and a cozy fireplace. Will be coming back again :)

My SO and I stopped in for lunch during a long walk around the neighborhood.  We were total newbies to TdM and had no idea what to expect.  But lo and behold, it's like a Mexican food Subway.  Fair enough.

I had a taco salad with carnitas.  My SO had loaded nachos.  It was quick, decently good, and the guy behind the counter told me guacamole would be extra for me, but included on hers, so I should just get it on the side for her and take it for myself.  Why thank you, kind sir!
Our food itself was pretty good.  Obviously not fresh or top notch, but good for what it is.

Met a couple friends for dinner last night.  We got gyoza and spring rolls to start, which were both pretty good.  My SO and I got 1/2 Hana Special Roll and a Lobster Roll to split.  We pretty much always get the special roll, but it was our first time trying the lobster roll.  It was very good and I think we'll add it to our rotation!
Our service was surprisingly lacking this time around, though.  Usually, they are spot on with the warm hand towels, water, and general attention.  But they were a little slow and choppy with everything.  But our food was delicious, so 4 starts it is!

Better than the Kroger in Donelson on Lebanon Pike.
A little cleaner.  The employees don't bitch and complain about their jobs.
The produce seems a bit fresher.

Been to this store, twice.  Go here after I have been to Aldi's in Madison.  
Convenient to Aldi's, and it seems to be a tad cleaner, which I appreciate.

I'm not a fan of Kroger.  Publix is wayyyyyyyy too expensive for my wallet.
Aldi's is my go to, but when I need half n half, and something that Aldi's isn't stocked up on, I will go to this Kroger.  But in all honesty, they're all about the same.. Bottom of the barrel.

Second time, new staff.....   not as good experience as the first time.
The food wasn't as palatable as the first visit.
It's as pretty, and gorgeous and visually stimulating, but.......
it didn't "wow" me like the first time.

Wear lightweight clothes - it gets plenty warm around a kitchen.
You could feel the A/C crank on and off.. when it went off, you wiped your face and brow.. when it was on, it was pleasurable.
Room was filled to capacity, including booths.... Noise level was as loud as first time.. You have to raise your voice to be heard.
Music wasn't as loud, this time.

It was fun...
I did it twice.
That's plenty for me.

Not only was the fried chicken to die for, but the service was amazing! We had the friendliest, sweetest waitress, and the owner even came by our table to check on our chicken. At first we weren't sure who he was, but then he introduced himself with a toast of Frangelica! LOL. Lisa Casalino was singing, and while I wish she had more room to showcase her talent, we really enjoyed her show. We did not explore the back patio, but there was some kind of jazzy band playing back there, as well. It seemed like a lot of locals in there, which added to the cozy, friendly and warm atmosphere. Will DEFINITELY return!

Ordered Eggplant Parm. This place was really really bad. The pasted was old, soggy, and overlooked. It's pretty clear it was prepped way in advance and sits around. It had the classic "leftover pasta" taste. The eggplant was overbreadded and the creasing was soaked and falling off. People in my group got a burger. Burnt to a crisp, looked like a frozen party.  We also ordered a chicken sandwich... two tiny pierces of chicken and a stale kaiser roll. This place is a joke right... serve staff was awkward and not attentive.

I had such a wonderful time at Anthony's Bar. This little place is tucked away downtown that I never would have noticed it without a colleague suggesting we go there. As a previous reviewer said, the atmosphere is like straight off the set of Mad Men. A very cool, intimate vibe. Anthony's has their own small menu and also serves the same food as Tony's. Looking over the menu, I wasn't sure if there was anything that I could eat since I was vegan. However, the waiter and chef took great care to make me something off menu that was absolutely delicious. I will definitely be back!

A no frills type of Marriott but they do have all day dining until 2am and the location cant be beat!

I will say that getting a lyft or a uber is quite difficult since it will always want to default your pickup location to one of the airlines and it does take a bit of a walk to get to the ground transportation area in comparison to other hotels but it's nothing that cant be overcome with just a little bit of planning ahead of time.

Will be looking forward to staying in st. Pete's or Clearwater on my next visit to Tampa instead.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Have stayed at other Hampton Inns in the past including another one right on Rt73 just a few miles away from this one. This is is by far the best. It is completely renovated, easy parking, good breakfast buffet, has quick elevators and friendly staff! The only reason I cannot rate 5 stars is because the indoor pool had a greenish color during our stay and the water is not heated. The color of the water is what really got to me even though they said they clean the pool each night, the chemicals just seemed way, way off.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've been to this place once before and really didn't have any issues. I went in on this Friday and got a nice manicure. But when I'm driving home from work...my pinky nail literally pops off! I have never had that happen before...so I rush right over. I tell the woman up front and she said she'd fix it, and to give her a second. I sat there for fifteen minutes, ignored completely. And they weren't even busy. One woman was sitting on her phone, playing games. 
I ended up politely leaving and walking next door to Marshall's to buy a similar color nail polish. I won't be going back. Whenever they're using doesn't seem to work.

I know it's a new place, that could be a great business for the Sparks area, but they need to train their crew a little better. Everyone was moving slow, the managers were just standing and talking with each other not really helping their employees. I got the small chips ahoy coollatta unfortunately it was really watered down, my Boston creme donut was still doughy, my girlfriend got the jelly filled donut which was also doughy. I've been to the one in Vegas and I know they can do better. I'll give it a month before I go back and hopefully their crew is better trained.

The pi bites are kind of like, mozzarella sticks on steroids. Prosciutto baked inside a small cheese-stuffed bite, with an addicting marinara sauce on the side. I highly recommend! 

Recently tried their Pi2 cocktail which was like a mojito but better with a nice basil flavor.

The wife and I usually get a margherita pizza think crust style. The sauce makes the pizza for sure. As for thick crust, the cornmeal style crust is definitely different than the ones I've had in Chicago. But still my favorite deep dish in STL.

I have used this place for 10 years and was finally glad when they got card machines. I generally just rinse my car and go for around $5. This weekend the price on the pay machines was covered and I really thought nothing of it. Two swipes and they simply charged me $10 each time. I paid $20 come to find out and feel like a fool. I can go through the machine up the street at Jimmys for $12. Even though I feel I got ripped off it is a cheap price to pay for the lesson. Won't be back ever and sorry I recommended this place to a lot of friends for years. I will put the word out on you Futura.

I fancy myself an ice cream aficionado and have been on a personal journey exploring various ice cream locales which is found Tubby Robot.  The ice cream is definitely tasty.  I love they have a social distance system (which is not true of all ice cream places during this time).  Their servings are large and product is quality.  They also have all the toppings.  The only downside is it's on Main St. Manayunk so if you're not local parking can be tricky during high volume times.  Definitely worth checking out.

This is my typical "I want sushi for lunch but don't feel like putting thought into where to go" restaurant. There is absolutely nothing wrong with this place in my opinion. The decor is nice, the food is fine, and prices are typical. There is just nothing that is special about the place or the food. If my boyfriend and I are going to dinner we will probably pick a different place to satisfy our sushi craving. If I'm going to lunch with my sister or a friend then I will absolutely come here! I like the 2 rolls with a soup or salad lunch deal.

I love the unique flavors that this place comes up with! You can order baby scoops of 4 or 6 different flavors if you can't choose just one. Some of the flavors that I really love are the chocolate amaretto cheesecake, the cookie monster, and the dessert at Tiffany's (which I think is a vday special). This place has a really cool authentic ice cream parlor feel, and once you've been here once it's nearly impossible to not stop here after dining at one of the restaurants on Prytania. Make sure you have cash though! They don't accept debit/credit.

Phenomenal food, phenomenal service. My boyfriend and I actually had a debate about whether or not our waitress was on cocaine or not because of how energetic , excited and helpful she was. This chick really likes her job and it shows. The food is impeccable and worth every cent. My only regret was not ordering the lobster. We will be back ASAP!  Best place I have been in a bit. Excellent ambiance and lighting, perfect temperature, clean and tidy place, fully stocked and clean bathrooms,full bar with an Experienced bartender, not a complaint in Sight!

This restaurant is still so good! We haven't been here for some time but went a few weeks ago & it's delicious! Place is clean and all the employees nice. Ordered sushi, beef negimaki, pork Katsu & ramen bowl which all tasted amazing! House soup & salad came with some of the meals & of course, still so good! We'll be back for sure. The prices are fair compared to other Japanese restaurants we frequent. This place is good for dates or families. So happy we're all out & about again helping locals keep their businesses going!

Lovely place! Came for a small group dinner for a school club, so dinner was subsidized. Otherwise, the place can get pricey, running over $30 for pasta. It's BYOB though!

I tried their daily special handmade pasta, which was delicious! I would give this place 4 stars, except its pricey and the weird service. 

They wouldn't let us order until our entire party arrived! (Though we were already seated). Also, they wouldn't let us order appetizers first! We had to order it together with the main course... Inflexible. Ugh.

A nice Japanese restaurant with sushi bar that seemed a bit empty even for a weekday night. I came with a large group upon a friend's recommendation.

The service was relatively quick for our size and different orders. I ordered a Rainbow Roll. Although they serve "American style" rolls, the focus still remains on the fish. I asked to replace the imitation crab in my roll with snow crab, and they were happy to do so at an extra cost.

While I have no particular complaints except that the rolls seem smaller than average (or maybe I was just really hungry), there was no wow factor. 3 stars.

Like other reviewers, I also ended up at Serafina because the wait at neighboring restaurants were too long. Serafina is a relatively decent sized restaurant for Center City, and has tables that can accommodate larger groups.

The place serves decent Italian pizzas and pastas. I ordered the Margherita for $12.50, but beware, it turned out to be more of a regular cheese pizza. For the "real" margherita (mozzarella separated, basil distinct etc.), you will have to order the Margherita VIP for $17.50, which I think is slightly over priced. The waitress did mention this when I ordered, but I was cheap, so... I really can't complain.

Stopped by here for some quick/cheap food and drinks for the kids before a wrestling Camp.

There were no people in line and 3 workers and a manager/supervisor? (Not sure which as the had a different uniform were standing around talking. No one greeted me and I stood at the register for about 2 minutes and cleared my throat to get attention. The supervisor came to the register and took my order:

Five $1.00 drinks
One lrg Fry
Eight x McDoubles

The food was fast and cheap. Kids were happy and all was as expected. 

We will return as, the one thing about Mickey D's is that it's always the same.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Good was pretty good. Apparently this place is owned by the same people who own La Hacienda on the Westbank.  It is in a good location downtown. Some of the same people that work there work here. 

The server we had was poor. She was inattentive and never checked up on us. It was a Sat night though not very busy.

We got the Cookout for 2. It was good, but not exceptional.  I would give it another chance, but I was not impressed. 

The menus were both dirty and got food on our hands to start. Not a great first impression.

I hadn't been here since I was right out of college, but we stopped in for a drink as we were making our way down bourbon after the crescent city classic. They always seem to have live music, which is a very nice touch.

It was quick and easy to get our drinks, and the bartenders seemed nice. When I used the restroom, it was nicer than most bourbon street bar restrooms; however it had a hilarious sign inside that I just had to take a picture of (attached).  Apparently, people like to smoke pot in restrooms? Honestly, I didn't know places had that issue. Very amusing.

This has been my drycleaner and source for alterations since I moved to Old City in 2007. The owner is very cheerful and friendly, the clothes come out looking "like new" and they take time to cover special buttons so that these are not damaged by the chemicals. 

I've also had clothing altered, and they do a careful job. Once I needed small hole in a seam repaired and they did it right there and for free. 

I've also taken heavier items like duvets (one was a super heavy velvet), and these come out beautifully as well. I have nothing bad to say and I'm glad that I've found a trustworthy drycleaner 2 1/2 blocks from my house.

Tip: Bring cash.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
My prior cleaner for nearly a decade exited the pick up and delivery service. 

So I was in the market for a new cleaner. 

Lots of online information and a great website so it was easy to learn about Pleats. 

Great, personal, and fast response to emails to set up an account. 

They followed up with a phone to confirm everything and completed explain the pick up and delivery process. 

A couple of weeks in and everything is "seemless" pun intended. 

That is the dirt on Pleats. It is easy to keep your clothes clean.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Called in make reservations for Tony's. 

Spoke to Elizabeth said Tony's was all booked but we could reserve a table in the bar. 

They called to confirm the reservation I said the date and time and confirmed a table. 

However, our party was seated at the bar not a table in the bar area for dinner.

While the food was as good as before I do it like the bait and switch at the new location. 

If I wanted to sit at the bar I would have requested that. 

What is the sense of taking and confirming reservations if you do NOT Honor your reservations?!

I got scammed.  Took my car in for a tire alignment.  20 min later I get a call that the car is ready.  
Me- Did you do a tire alignment?
Them- oh uh.. No you didn't need one.  It will be 18.99 ma'am for the oil change.
Me- I didn't need an oil change, I just had one done.
Them- oh? Okay it's 18.99 anyway for checking your car out.

I was dumbfounded.  I paid and left.  My car was still shaking bc it needs an alignment, and my tires are low on pressure which they didn't check.  Back to sq one.  And down twenty bucks.  As a a financially struggling student, even twenty bucks that went to waste is significant to me.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Mehhh. Came here for lunch with a friend because I bought a groupon and was craving italian food. The place is pretty nice overall. Friendly waiters. The food is meh. The bread and butter they brought out was cold and tasted old. The salads i didnt care for. The appetizer we got -the calemari and the raw salmon was yuck. The calimari was so chewy and it tasted quite old and overcooked. The salmon was just not fresh... the pasta that we ordered wasnt too bad though. Not anything out of the ordinary. But good. The portion sizes are huge. So take some home and have leftovers (:

We had a blast at this place.  I don't know why, but we just did.  Goofy music with a goofy hype guy (which I still don't really get but whatever, it works when you're hammered) who featured the "All That" theme at one point.  Really strange crowd.  We chilled here through an epic thunderstorm (one of the "Louisiana classics", according to a pretty authentic-seeming  local I was chillin' with) and chucked beads at the idiots in the street.  It was great.

So yeah, idk why, but this place is a lot of fun.  Highly recommended if you're partying your way down Bourbon.  Totally bizarre, but worth a stop.

"Meh" is really all I have to say about this place.  It reminded me of eating out in NYC (and a lot of places in Center City taking cues from there): great decor, decent food, decent drinks, outrageous prices.  I had short rib and veggies and it was very good, but for these prices you better blow me away.  And it just didn't blow me away.

And while the decor was very nice, it was pretty crammed in here.  We were a large party, granted, but we had a reservation (so they knew we were coming) and we managed to get stuck in the middle of the restaurant.  Nearly impossible to get out and hit the restroom.

Five Stars hands down!!!  My friend and I ate at Bowl for my birthday dinner last Sunday night.  Everything was wonderful.  She had the gourmet meatballs and I had a nice salad.  They have a very simple menu, still relatively small, but with lots of options.  They have wonderful outdoor seating, facing the main street with lots of room to people watch.  The service was nice and friendly, quick to help us, but not hovering... just how I like it.  One more bonus is the location.  Plenty of other cool bars near by if you feel like changing atmospheres after dinner.  I can't wait to take my husband for a casual date night to Bowl.

My wife and I stopped there on Sunday 10/2/16 and sat at the bar to get drinks and dinner. No one else was seated  there but there was at one time three employees behind the bar and NONE of them acknowledge us at all as we sat there for 5 minutes. They were too concerned about a bill or something other than to greet us and offer to take a drink order. We opted to leave since they were too occupied to give us any attention. Now I know why this place is not doing the business. I can always patronage another business with my money. Will not be back.

This is the quintessential 'old school' dive bar.  Though I miss Russ, having been a 'regular' in the 70's, the ambiance is exactly the same, the tater salad made fresh daily, the cheeseburger perfect, service pretty good - never was fast - and Russ's Rules still in effect.  Russ called me Rolly, nicknaming me after Rolly Fingers, ace pitcher of the Oakland A's, because I sported a handlebar mustache in those days.  I never questioned Russ when he was alive and I'll not question him in memorium. His presence lingers and his spirit still runs the most well mannered bar in town. Salut Russ, mi amigo.

Came to Bud Rip's to kick-off a Halloween weekend bar crawl. This bar is the perfect spot kick-off a bar crawl and there's plenty of space inside and out. The staff was super friendly and the drinks were super reasonable. This is a true neighborhood gem and the regulars who make up the bar were all super cool. You can tell this bar has so many great stories and I can't imagine who all has crossed those doors.

Y'all have to check out this bar and get ready for a good time!

*They were adhering to all COVID-19 related protocols during October 2021.

Red Chile Beef Burro Double Wrapped with Onions and Cheese.  There is nothing else you need.  Except time, because it takes a damn long time to get your double wrapped burro which still sometimes ends up leaking because the heavenly tortillas are so thin.  Hence one star is deducted because of the unnecessary long wait.  Sometimes waiting is necessary in order to consume a superior product (see my review for Little Miss BBQ), but the long wait here could easily be eliminated without affecting the quality of the product.

Very good. Everything we had was great down to the complimentary butter. The butter was an herbed butter that was out of this world. We also ordered the crab cheesecake. It was perfectly cheesy, but didn't lose the integrity of a true crab cake. It had just enough filler to crab. I had the chicken Toscana. It was great! The chicken was in a lemon wine sauce. It comes highly recommended. My husband has the tuna in wasabi sauce. It was great! It came with a risotto style potato cake that was just fair. We can't wait to come back.

I wanted to love this a lot more than I did and I hesitate to give this review but I relied on reviews when I made my plan so I have a duty to share. Food was inventive and at times remarkable. It was well crafted and seasoned except for a few dishes. The amuse-bouche were fun and just kept coming.   Decor and service was just a tiny bit too austere. Wine pairing just a "meh". I would not compare it to similar meals I've had in other cities (Blanca, Eleven Madison, Ikarus). Was expecting more for the price and the hustle to get the res and the mysterious wait outside the door to be seated.

Walt's is a gem. The steaks are as good as, if not better than, the best South Philly faire. The square hamburgers are fresh and perfectly grilled to order. And their fries are perfect. The grill and wait staff make you feel at home as soon as you walk through the door, and the new management has only improved upon a long-time Clifton Heights institution. The decor is vintage luncheonette --right down to the Coca-Cola radio on the shelf behind the well-preserved original counter. You'll love Walt's. We certainly do.

I didn't break my promise.  I talked my co-worker into driving me out to this restaurant again on the follow-up work I performed at this airport.  This time I had the single enchilada combo with shredded beef.  The taste and quality of the food is still top notch, but I'll stick with the chicken or ground beef.  The shredded beef is very hard to pull apart and it turns into a single ball of beef that gains solidity as you try and pick it apart from the tortilla.  I'm sure it was good entertainment for my K and his wife, though.

Seems like this place underwent renovation, and in a great way. We ordered food to-go and the owner himself came out and chatted with us. He even gave us free soft drinks while waiting for our orders! Incredible! Outside of the food, I really felt like I got the chance to know the owner, which was an incredible - heartwarming feeling. I definitely want to come back, if not for the service alone. They were really eager to help out and were excited to be a staple in this community. I can't wait to see what happens here.

The pizza here is incredible. It's very much a neighborhood pizza spot, but it actually has a pretty big fan following in Philadelphia. We got a square cheese pizza with pepperoni, and it was just what I needed.  The crust was flakey, the cheesy was gooey and very delicious, and the pepperoni added a nice contrast. It takes about twenty minutes to make the pizza and is take out only. I would recommend calling ahead if possible or ordering at the counter and grabbing a drink at a nearby bar. You won't regret coming here.

Little Nonna's is a fantastic place for date night. I went on one of the first sunny days in Philadelphia and sat in their ultra-cute outdoor patio. While the restaurant itself was great, I found the food to be a little simplistic. My girlfriend got the Spaghetti and Meatballs, and while she loved the meatballs, the spaghetti was pretty much as billed. I personally got the gnocchi - which was incredibly soft and fell apart in my mouth, but I felt that the sauce was a bit watery. It's a great place to go for the ambiance!

I'm from Philadelphia and now that I live in Jersey I'm always searching for restaurants that are reminiscent of one's from back home. This place definitely fits the bill. Great atmosphere and the food is amazing. We had the deviled eggs, chickpea fries, pretzel, meatball, shrimp n grits, Tavern crunch, and the ceasar salad. I will absolutely be going back for the eggs, pretzel, meatball, and dessert. Honestly I could've done without an entre. The shrimp n grits is great if you love grits but personally it was too heavy and dense for me. I'm very excited to go back here.

stumbled on this gem by a friend tell me about it. he told me that the sushi is really good and the place is cheap and affordable and he was right about everything.  This is a small place that packs a powerful punch. The sushi is incredible, my friend and i got the sansom roll and  it was out this world. they have a three roll special for $11 is pretty good considering your getting 24 rolls. 

All in all this place is not meant for big crowds as the place is really small it only seats about 10-12 people. So if your in the city make the trip to 20th and sansom and enjoy a meal you won't regret.

This is a very good restaurant with great food and a very kind server. However, today/tonight there is only 1 server working the entire restaurant and working a double! I can't even fathom that the restaurant management would expect a server and customers to deal with that. I was looking around at the full restaurant almost every table was full and it was more than just our table that was getting irritated. No server can handle 10-12 tables at about 4 people per table. I think it was inappropriate and won't be back for a while. Hire more people and I'll come back.

I really want to give this place another shot! The first impression was just okay, unfortunately. The service wasn't super fast and, even though it wasn't very busy, we were sat in a weird part of the resultant where I was facing the 'break corner' and it just cheapened the experience. The place could have a lot going it, the atmosphere just feels forced. The open kitchen concept is a fun idea but, again, not executed as well. 

I ordered the arroz con pollo and the vegetables were huge and not cooked enough. 

Hoping to give them another try soon.

Love Chow Express for lunch during the work week.

Yes, it smells like cigars when you first get in the door but you'll get over it. Walk up to order, very fair lunch special prices. Fairly quick to serve your meal. Meal comes ready for a lid so you can take the rest home if need be. The best part about this place: the freshest of Chinese places I've ever been! 

You know that feeling you get after consuming something really greasy and it's usually Chinese food? Not here. The fried rice is still white! And its delicious. And the portions are great to have some for tomorrow's lunch.

I live nearby and was very amped to try Crust once it opened. My husband and I went on a Saturday night and the place was pretty much dead. We were seated promptly and had a very bubbly waitress. 

We ordered the mac & cheese for an appetizer and the dish was so soupy is was almost mac & cheese soup. I showed the waitress and she had it taken back right away, very helpful. 

The meatball pizza was very good, hardly any complaints. But it just wasn't anything spectacular for the price we were paying. I would go back for sure but it's not my new favorite pizza place unfortunately. Which is a disappointment because they are so close by!

I used to really like this place and went here often. But I feel like it's going downhill. I've had way too many experiences with the nail girls doing shoddy work and when I try to point out so they can fix it they give me an attitude. I'm going to start looking for another place to go. It's a shame because I used to like this place. I hope they correct these problems or they're not going to be in business much longer. It floors me that the nail business charges as much as they do for gels. That being said, if I'm going to pay for gels they better be damn good

They're cheap for a reason: they don't care. They just don't care. They're rude and they don't want to deal with you and they aren't afraid to let you know. 
They just completely brushed me off when I took my cat in. My cat has something wrong, her skin is all bumpy, her fur has gotten matty, and she's started peeing all over the place. 
Value bet just said she had bad behavior, charged me, and sent me on my way. 
Luckily another vet I found was full of caring people who helped her out and got her some medication. I'd say save your money and give it to people who actually like animals.

I've been looking forward to visiting since there aren't many sushi places in the area.  The decor was very modern and trendy and the location is in a strip mall with a few other bars and restaurants.  The staff was attentive.  I order a few of my usual rolls, Spicy Tuna, Arizona, Futomaki and a miso soup.  Although the rolls were nicely presented and I liked the spicy mayo, the rolls were rather average in taste.  The miso soup was very watered down and barely had any taste.  Overall, I would come back and try some of their specialty rolls for dinner.

Check my reviews. Usually don't do bad ones but this place sucks. Don't spend $25 for a sandwich, small wine and terrible service. 

Atrium Lounge and their grumpy employees make for an awful way to finish your time in New Orleans. Whatever mood you were in when you get here, they'll do their best to ruin it. 

Wish I could put less than 1 star cuz they don't even deserve that much. 

Sadly the entire airport isn't much better. Someone just walked by and told his friend this is by far the worst airport. Gotta say, it's hard to argue against that assessment. 

Awful. Hate that my flight is delayed 2 hrs. Get me out of here!!!

We only stopped in because this place was on Bar Rescue.  What a waste.  $12.00 for 2 beers.  They were playing crappy music and the staff was very uninterested in the very few patrons who were there.

The scenery was decent, I liked the barber chair in the middle of the floor, but the rest of the place just didn't make sense.  It seemed like a mish-mosh of decor.

The bathroom was filthy with holes in the tile.  The sink was tiny and had a lot of pink mold around it (see picture).

With all the other choices on Bourbon, skip this place.  They need Bar Rescue to come back!

I have to change my previous review. I went for an oil change and they told me I needed new brake pads the next time I had an oil change. So I dutifully showed up again the next oil change and had them check the brakes. They said, oh, now you need calipers and this and that for the brakes and it will be $1500. My car isn't even worth that. I was skeptical, so I took it to my usual guy in South Philly and he said no, it just needed pads and would be $200. I don't know if pep boys was actually trying to commit fraud or they just don't know what they're doing. Either way, I'll NEVER go back there.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
After reading all the great reviews, I was excited to try Niche. Really excited. 

Allow me to comment in list form:
1. Uber trendy
2. Music was WAY too loud (even if it was great). Everyone was shouting to be heard across the table
3. As many staff members as there were patrons (and the place was full). Very weird - they kept staring. Our waitress was amazing, to be fair.
4. The food was interesting, different, but didn't quite hit the 'amazing' mark I was expecting
5. Pricey - Given how much you got and how good it was, I would have expected dinner for 2 to be under the 150 it ended up costing. 


Would I recommend? No.

I love Sang Kee but this was my first time at the one at the Reading Terminal.  I wasn't too hungry (just strolling and was a little greedy) so I ordered the bourbon Shish kabobs.  I must say that I was so disappointed! So dry and crispy....is it suppose to be like that? I know it was only 2 bucks but damn!!!! Any amount of money I spend....I want the food to be delish!  It must have been left out all day or Something.  WELL, I do want to give this place another try because of all the great reviews.  Next time I will try the roasted duck with green veggies and rice (a real meal)...then I will see how they measure up!

Lets face it, no one likes to go to get tires or have their car worked on. If you do, then you probably already work at at Dobbs. That being said the wait at this location has been consistently less than at others, which is always nice. I don't feel like I get the run around from the staff on getting unnecessary services. Though, I'm never sure why every auto service place EVER hands you the dirty/broken part they found, like a cat bringing you a dead bird. What am I supposed to do with a rusty nail/old air filter? Honestly. But I digress... if there is a Dobbs to choose, I'll go to this one.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I went to Crazy Sushi with a Groupon deal of $20 for $40 worth of food. I love the food here. My favorite thing is the caetus roll. It is a sushi roll with a fried pancake on the outside and some fish filling. It is seriously not for you if you are on a carb free diet. But you gotta live a little! The service here is okay. Its pretty much like a normal Asian restaurant where they just want your order and that's it. At least its quick. The presentation of the food is always amazing. They put these crazy LED lights and ornaments on the plates for some serious bedazzling. Its also BYOB!

Friendly tip for road tripping parents:
    You must be a paying customer to use the restrooms here (and it's connected to a gas station).   If your little one has to REALLY GO you must get a special token first. 

Friendly tip for short people / children/ parents:
    To put the token in the lock to enter the restroom and to twist the handle to unlock the exit, be prepared to reach said lock at about 5'5". 

Clean bathrooms 
Clean gas station 
Healthy snack options 

I think the honor system would work just fine here. Making a child who has waited awhile to use the restroom pay is a little much.

This gym has just about everything that you can imagine to work out with. I haven't even tried any of the classes yet but the variety of machines and equipment keeps me busy enough. 2 different floors with multiple rooms so it never seems overly crowded. This City Fitness has a bunch of kettle bells, try ropes, machines and free weights along with a good amount of cardio machines. It's a little pricey and kind of far from me, but the gym itself is in great condition and has everything you want for almost any type of workout.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This gym has everything from cardio, weights, ropes and a turf for agility exercises. The trainers are really nice and do a good job of motivating you. I have a few classes with Rich and Dan that are really good. Parking is relatively easy since it is located in the city. I've never had that much problem for parking, never had to park more than 2 blocks away. I really like this gym a lot.

Regarding the billing complaints on other reviews, I bought a year membership and prepaid for a cheaper deal. I haven't had any additional charges, but am not sure if the billing process might be different if I was month to month.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Tasty authentic Italian food! Simple, warm & cozy venue. Friendly & attentive staff. 

I was craving for some pasta & one of my co- workers suggested Trattoria Vittoria ( it's actually her favorite Italian restaurant as well) & I'm super glad she did. I had their lasagna with meat, which I'm not a lasagna fan, however I was not let down at all it was delicious! & for those who have a sweet tooth & like to make some room for dessert I recommend their tiramisu cake you will not be disappointed! 

I definitely would recommend trying out this place.

Went through the drive thru and it was super quick but with one good thing it has to be two bad. The fries were cold and not seasoned. I ordered the 10p chicken nuggets and buttermilk crispy sandwich. The nuggets are basically a can't miss but the chicken sandwich was a nogo. I had to ask for sauce which comes with nuggets and the buttermilk crispy chicken sandwich didn't have anything on it not even the tomato or lettuce. Overall it was fast food but I definitely hoped for better but it was a drinking night.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
4 stars for the weekly Friday night (6-8pm) and Saturday afternoon (4-6pm) free wine tastings

The clerks that run the show for the free wine tastings are knowledgeable and friendly

The selection is pretty wide and the store is large. The clerks can be hit-or-miss, but ultimately, I'm trying to just get in/get out/move on. 

Tips/Takeaways:
-Lines are super long Friday night.
-Friday night 6-8pm and Saturday afternoon 4-6pm Free Wine Tastings!
-I usually use the Vivino app to try to narrow down what wines to get

Absolutely fantastic coffee.  Sump is a go to coffee shop for a jolt of caffeine.  I especially appreciate the Cold Brew at this location.  You can buy coffee beans and drinks at Sump.  Sump is currently only taking online orders for coffee and delivering them to you curbside.  In this very scary time, this curbside pick-up option is appreciated.  You can text on arrival, for someone to bring your coffee or coffee beans out to you in your car.  Thank You Sump for going the extra mile during this Covid pandemic.

I have never been to a Chimi's and now I know why.  Just subpar Mexican Food.  Their rice and beans had no flavor at all.  Frankly I can make it better than they did.  If it is not Chava's or Mi Ranchito then it is not worth a visit to me.

The decor is just horrid.  I have no idea why they had an opportunity to make a new and fresh look and went with the antiquated Mexican feel.  I think they missed the mark here.  They even have a monkey standing on bar with a cigarette in his mouth???  This is just so bizzare in a time when Non-Smoking is King. 

The positive...  they do have seating for a lot of people.

This is the first time I have dined at this restaurant in five years. It was also the first time for my wife dining at this restaurant. We did the Sunday dinner, which is a prix fixe three course menu. We started with the parsnip soup which was certainly the highlight of the evening. This was followed by a duck ragu parpadella and followed a flourless cake. The pasta was great but the dessert just ok. I also got the wine pairings which were lovely. Any time there is a Chateauneaufdupape in a wine pairing I am one happy camper.

Came here for a quick lunch with my parents today. Our server was really great, friendly and informative.  She knew her wines, and helped me pick a nice red wine that I have never tried before.   I ordered the veal with wild mushrooms... it was juicy, flavorful and delicious. My mom ordered crab cakes and they were fried, and not the best .
