Their pricing is fair (and much less than the dealer), they have loaners available so you're not stuck there all day, and the most important - they know enough about the cars to give an honest assessment of what's in the 'needs now', 'will need within a year', 'not a big deal' categories and are happy to discuss each service in those terms.  

I've had terrible experiences with the local dealership, if it weren't for Euro Motorworks, I might have stopped buying Mercedes altogether.

@ Whoy

"If your only reason to go to a bar is beer, then this is the place to go.  If its food you're looking for, go down the st to Watkins eatery, or over to Passyunk for the many bars with food there...evidently this place is a throwback to the beer and shot bars of the 50s, albeit a better collection of beers..."

SO BASICALLY YOU UNDERSTAND THE CONCEPT OF THE PLACE BUT THAN DECIDED TO REVIEW IT BASED ON FOOD AND WHAT IT IS NOT ATTEMPTING TO BE?  THAT MAKES PERFECT SENSE... (SARCASM)

Good selection of crafts... Will go there again.

I've been to Educated several times, originally because I had an Axxess card. The service is okay, not great but not terrible. I've gone back several times because it is located close to my work. Pros: quick service, friendly staff, cheap gas, cute gift store. Cons: they don't vacuum very thoroughly, don't clean out/wipe cup holders and compartments. I don't get into my car after the wash and think to myself, "wow, my car looks amazing!", which i should think after paying for a car wash. But all in all, it gets the job done.

LOVE this spot! Randomly drove past after leaving Red Rock one afternoon and decided to stop in and check it out.The place has tons of outside seating and live music on the weekends. All of the employees are very friendly and the food is DELICIOUS! They have a pretty good selection on the menu, but I usually go for the tri tip, fries and hot wings-can't go wrong there! The food is a bit pricey, usually spend about $10-$12 per person. Dogs are allowed which is nice too. Great automosphere, all around! Even just talking about this place makes me crave a tri trip sandwich:)

I've been to Balduccis a few times over the past month for various parties. It's in kind of a hole-in-the-wall strip mall but don't let that fool you, the restaurant is actually pretty big as you walk downstairs.

Every time we went there the party ordered pizza which was very good but nothing spectacular. The deep dish cheese pizza was better than the thin crust and usually I feel the opposite as I really enjoy St. Louis-style pizza (just goes to show how much I liked the deep dish). 

Service was good as the waitresses and hostesses were friendly and attentive. Overall I'd recommend giving it a try.

Is Kevin Sbraga trying to make up for under seasoned food from his top chef season? The meal was mediocre at best. I upgraded the second course to the gnocchi and lobster. There were only a handful of gnocchi that were starchy and dense. The lobster was overcooked. For an $18 upgrade I expected the food to be cooked correctly. The surf and turf platter was basically 1 oz of lamb and fish with greens on top. It was salty I could not finish it despite its minute portion size. Save your money, there are tons of better restaurants in Philly.

Choices was limited since it was late - so we got a Beef Donair with Cheese and some fries from Sam's just before midnight. I wasn't impressed as the Donair failed to have that pleasant flavour in a beef donair. Not sure what but something about the donair seemed off or maybe it's just different. Let's just say - I had better from a different takeaway with the same beef donair with cheese but better. Definitely better. 

Though, I must say free delivery for an order worth $15 or over is a bonus nonetheless but food wise - unfortunately I won't be back for more. It seemed like it's either a hit or miss with Donairs.

I find a trip to my beloved Santa Cruz Market to be necessary every single week whether I need food or not.  With fresh fruits and vegetables at good prices, all the things pu need and nothing you dont. The little deli area has the most delicious green salsa in the world  and in my opinion the chili relleno burrito is almost like a hug frim your Mother, its so good. The meat area is the heart of the store and frankly Ive found myself here just for the vibe from time to time, the music is the best and just feels good. I find exotic items here for special dishes too like frozen octopus and goat head, all the spices and chiles, its the best.

Well, there's nothing really special about this Dunkin Donuts. It's pretty much just like every other DD I've been to. 

That being said, I do like DD's coffee and the service here is really friendly -- probably friendlier than the other locations I've frequented. There's another location just down the road on Gandy but their employees aren't as warm so I generally just go here instead. 

There is sadly no free wifi here which is a total bummer, but if you're looking for a quick cup of joe served with a smile, this Dunkin Donuts isn't a bad bet.

Came with a large group ~12 for brunch. Our waiter was super friendly and talked us through the drinks and dishes on the menu. He was great, but unfortunately also the only really good part about the brunch. 

When our orders were put in, they took a loooong time to come. Even just the drinks at the beginning. At least, the main dishes generally came around the same time, so they timed it well. However, the actual quality was quite average. Potatoes were dry-ish, eggs were just ok. But still had a good time so ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Was a great spot in Collingswood. Waiter was friendly and inviting. Got a table by the window. Brought a bottle of wine since it's BYOB and they opened it for us.

Bread and some dip served to the table - surprisingly good but no idea what it was. Tastes like something between eggplant and corn purée. 

Ordered the goat cheese and mushroom appetizer with balsamic glaze - delicious but small, though our waiter warned us of that in advance which was much appreciated. 

Others the chicken Sappori without pancetta which was delicious and unique. 

No dessert this time though I think there was a cannoli cheesecake that sounded good.

I love the fact that if it's rainy outside I can go in the parking garage and stay dry! The produce here is exceptional and always fresh and crisp! The staff has always been helpful and never sent my solo on a journey to an isle number they are guessing my item is located at. So that's always a plus for me in my book. Oh and there is this super cute guy that works there. Kinda short with suuuuuper curley short hair, he looks Latin. Im always too nervous to look at his name tag but always excited to have him ring me up. Super polite and always asks how your day is.

Amazing service and food. I had only been to the branch in metarier prior and it was a mediocre store so I wasnt expecting much here. But i was so wrong!

The waitress was amazing (funny and was able to predict what we needed before we even asked for it) I wish i got her name to give her a shout out.

I ordered 3 tacos - fish, carne asada and lengua. I like the carne asada and lengua the best. The meat serving in the taco is very generous. The meat was cooked to perfection- soft, tender, flavorful. This fish taco was okay but i thought there was too much batter on the fish. 

Would come here again!

Good lunch spot. Great pizza slice selections. The crust has a nice crunch to it, which I really like. The sauce is pretty good. They also do a great buffalo chicken pizza. They always have Sicilian slices and a few Stromboli options too. They also have a ton of sandwiches and salads made to order.  I love the buffalo chicken salad here. This place gets busy for lunch but the employees are good and move the line quickly. There is also plenty of seating. I have never had to wait for a seat. A very reliable lunch spot.

A small but stylish Mexican restaurant from the Barbuzzo family.  They used to be byo but now serve alcohol. Their guacamole and plantain chips are superb. They have delicious (and necessarily messy) Mexican street corn on the cob, which is a great appetizer for the table. The tacos here are awesome. I prefer the pork here because it's loaded with flavor. While their tacos are popular, they have a nice selection of other Mexican favorites, and they seem to be consistent in their quality.  This place is good for a small group or a dinner date. Great cocktails too!

This spot is the coziest and most hipster Italian restaurant ever, with really tasty food. The place is tiny with seating for about 35 in the restaurant, and a small makeshift rear patio with seating for about 20.  On the inside, the red booths along the wall, the mismatch but comfortable chairs and random array of wall mirrors give this place a unique and refreshing charm. And the meatballs appetizer is worth the trip on its own. Incredibly flavored and giant, these bad boys are served over a heavenly cheesy polenta. Trust me, it works. This place is a gem in an already crazy good food district. It's a good overwhelming.

I came here for lunch today and ordered the fried chicken bento box with a spicy tuna roll.  The box itself was really cool. The fried chicken was tasty but it came with a weird cabbage slaw and would have been a lot more enjoyable with white rice. The sushi roll was OK but not great. The roll itself was really loose and kept coming apart. There was very little spicy sauce, so it lacked flavor and spice. There is much better sushi in Center City. 

The ambience, decor and service were topnotch. I really enjoyed the atmosphere. While the food was just OK, and a bit overpriced, I would go back for the cool upscale experience.

Nice, clean nail salon. I go here often in the summer and recently returned for my spring tune-up pedicure. Let's be honest, this is always the worst pedicure of the year and they handled it like pros!

I always make appointments when I go, but I've seen walk-ins arrive and they are usually able to get in promptly. They always have a nice selections of polish to choose from (classic to new and trendy). Also, if you're looking for a mani/pedi combo they offer it for $35 which is fair considering the quality of services received!

Check it out if you're in the Avon/Plainfield area! Always a relaxing experience!

Gina is the bomb! Seriously, she carries a great conversation while expertly cutting hair. I would go more often to see her, but my hair doesn't grow that fast. This could be due to my older age, but it still doesn't change the fact that Gina is a professional that deserves repeat customers. Sure you could go to some corner shop and get an ok cut, or you can come here and get an awesome cut, with a shampoo and a neck massage. Decision seems easy because it is. Professional. Courteous. Stylish. Entertaining. All you need for a haircut. Go see Gina, and your welcome.

Pasta was so overcooked...you really don't even have to chew it. Basically the pressure of your mouth makes it disintegrate. 

I got the angel hair pasta with pesto. And that was a mistake. Angel hair pasta was so overcooked..I was amazed that it was still maintaining its shape. The pesto was the worst pesto ever. Period. It was like they took a jar of cheap pesto and mixed it with like a gallon of cheap olive oil. SO oily. I ate about half and the rest I had to leave because it was basically soup. That's how much oil was in my bowl. 

They took an easy meal and made all the mistakes you could possibly make.

Re-editing this so it's not as mean, but keeping it short.
It's cute on the inside, but that's about it.
It's not an endearing kind of hot mess in my opinion.
The waitress was horrible and it was pretty obvious what she went out to do when she was gone for a while by her behavior.
The cook could care less about being there, but I honestly can't blame her. But I sure in the hell can blame that attitude she had.
The burgers were just ok though.

Definitely not like the one in Fountain Square, which is way more welcoming and loving.

I finally tried this new place out last night.. it was really good.  I know the place has been a million different restaurant, but believe it or not, I have never been in there before. I really liked the atmosphere and the bar was great.  I ordered the Fajita Burrito and it was great.. I loved that everyone at the table got their own little bottle of salsa and the margaritas were great.  Four of us went to eat and 2 of us were drinking and the bill only came to around 17.00 for each of us... so the price is just right.. I will definitely be going back again!

I used to really like this place, I would order takeout if not dine there with my mom. But today was probably the worst order ever. When I got home with my food I could see they clearly didn't read my instructions for extra soy sauce. Instead of the normal 6 packets they decided to only give me 3. The Salmon roll had a insane amount of fat tissue and connective tissue making it unbearable to eat. Also the Dynamite roll has so much grease on it. 
Not to mention if you dine in the restaurant it takes for freakin ever to get anything on your table. Save your money. I'm done with this place.

Had lunch here with a colleague due to the proximity of our work.  I went with the sushi lunch special and it it was awesome.  The only thinks your able to choose is soup or salad, it comes with a California roll and the chef picks the sushi, so if your not adventurous this may not be your best bet.  However the sushi that came out were pretty popular options so don't be afraid!  The taste was amazing and everything was awesome. My colleague had the Tod roll not exactly sure what it was but there were no complaints.  Will definitely be back.

So I have been going to Heritage consistently for about a year now.  It is the best barber shop around.  Christian always gives me exactly the cut in looking for.  He is very detailed and goes above and beyond to ensure your hair looks great.  The vibe is awesome.  Joe the owner is always upbeat and friendly and plays some type of cool music and typically has some type of sports show on.  What more could you ask for when going to the barber.  I definitely made the right choice coming here and will continue to go.  Definitely worth the trip to check them out, you won't regret it.

Came here with my staff during a staff retreat.  Great prices and service (though we only got dinner salads and pizzas).  They were really flexible with our reservation (we ended up arriving 30 minutes prior), accommodating with our orders, and very friendly.  Since we were sharing salads, our server was willing to bring out many samples of salad dressings and extra bowls, etc.

Their Meatless Special pizza is DELICIOUS- especially if you like garlic.  We also got their chicken pesto, which was also pretty tasty!  All-in-all, great service, great for larger groups, and tasty pizza!

I came in with my sister on a hot Saturday afternoon...

When we arrived there was a line up all the way out the door so it must be good :) 

I decided on keylime because I love citrus flavors. My sister ordered the colorful one ( I can't remember the name).

It's a cozy ice cream shop which is cute but can be quite tight when there's so many ppl crammed in all at once. 

The ice cream was great! I love how cold and flavorful it was, you just can't go wrong with ice cream lol .

I will definitely come back whenever i'm in St. Albert.

Marcos pizza is a refreshing alternative to pizza hut, domino's, and the like. Prices may be a tad higher, but it's totally worth it to have delivery pizza that doesn't taste like garbage. They have a pretty wide selection of specialty pizzas, my favorite being the white cheesy. They also have two or three different kinds of crust toppers- the Roma is delicious! Among the different types of pizzas, you'll also find hot subs, salads, wings, and breadsticks/cheezy bread on the menu. Great selection and good food, I'm sold.

This is my first time ever getting food here and it's not so great. I ordered take out for a hand roll and some seaweed salad. It took an hour to get to me and came WARM. Like, it's been sitting out on a counter for half an hour warm. I don't believe raw sushi should come that way. Also the rice is super gummy and the roles are reminiscent of cheap buffet sushi. I also should mention that when the delivery guy came he just kept pointing to the delivery slip saying "cash tip! Cash tip!" Over and over. I'm fairly positive I won't ever be eating from here again.

This Starbucks is decent; clean and comfortable inside.  There's not lots of seating or table space available, so studying here is a hit or miss.

The drive-thru is often jammed, and service moves way too slowly.  Be sure to give yourself plenty of time if you plan to swing through before work or class.  Consider yourself lucky if you arrive and the drive-thru is clear!

Service is always friendly and cheerful, no complaints about the baristas.  

Also, on the major plus side, they're mostly dog-friendly.  They usually have a water bowl on the outside patio.

Never, ever go to this place. We went on a friday night and were in pj's so we went through the drive thru. When we pulled up the the window, the guy asked us to hold on. We ended up sitting there for almost 30 minutes (my sister really wanted ice cream). We then pulled up to the window and they refused to serve us, saying that we had to go back to the drive thru window. They were rude and showed no respect to my mother. We asked for the manager number and called and left a message (Her name was Ashley), and never heard back. 

Disgusting place with disgusting service. I wish I could give it 0 stars

So obviously this isn't high end, life changing, memory making Chinese food. But, this is hands down the best mall chinese food I have ever had. When I am in a rush in cool springs, sometimes I swing by the food court and get their lo mein noodles and bourbon chicken. And it's always been fresh and tasty. 

I know they make everything fresh, because I see them chopping up raw chicken in the back. It's also such a great price, because it's enough food to last me two meals and is only like 7 bucks after tax. 

The people that serve there are so kind and always smiling. This is def my go to mall food place!

Will never go back. Not only is the food sub-par and overpriced, but the bouncers, bartenders and management staff are completely outrageous.

After ordering, receiving our appetizers, I cancelled the dinner order and walked out. 

Paid over $16 for 2 mediocre weak drinks, and had to bring my date over to be ID'ed for the 3RD TIME, I mean come on. They wouldnt even bring it over to us. I understand you have to be strict in certain instances, but you dont have to be rude about it and you should be accommodating to people.

No wonder there was only 3 tables filled on mothers day!

I got it - Nashville is not the mecca of sushi...  and Fujiyama proves it. I mean, it isn't bad... it just isn't great. Don't get me wrong, the service was amazing and the speed that the sushi came out was lightening. The selection is also rather extensive, and you can get some pretty unique rolls going here... 

However, the sushi is pretty much the same quality that I would get at one of those fast sushi places in (fill in major metropolitan city). 

Oh, and this is not a date place what so ever. The lighting makes it seem creepy almost, and the interior is generic sterotypical sushi place. If your mother in law is in town - maybe...

i eat here between classes a lot and their food is mostly alright, but their dinner combo (pick a protein + rice + soup) sounds awesome and cheap until you realize it's mostly onion with maybe an ounce of protein. i'm not a chicken when it comes to spicy foods but the spicy sauce is literally too hot to eat. i've been playing it safe with spring rolls and veggie lo mein recently which have both been really good, and i always wind up getting the same young woman making my green tea bubble tea and she makes it FANTASTIC. $10 card minimum

Stayed 2 nights and we had a pleasant experience. The room is very spacious and having a kitchen was nice. There were some leftover empty water bottles in one of the drawers that I think housekeeping forgot to clear but overall no other issues. 

Free breakfast in the morning - it was a fairly standard selection of breakfast sandwiches, cereal, yogurts, etc. 

They have a garage you can pay for but we ended up just parking on the street and leaving to go about our day early (I think the meters start at 8:30am).
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Many Japanese hole in the walls are fantastic. This one is far from it. Disinterested service (dirty plates left on table, server forgot to take additional sushi roll order), salad is drenched in dressing in a sloppy manner, had to ask for a glass for my huge Sapporo beer, mediocre sushi (nigiri bland where some fish is served too warm or too cold, dragon roll was yucky (eel was slightly bitter and even the tempura  seemed chewy and dried out). No one said thank you or goodbye when I left. I'll remove a star if I get ill from the meal which seems like a possibility given the environment and my experience at Samurai sushi.

My family loves to rant and rave about Dairy Joy.

I guess it's been a staple ice cream stand in South Tampa / Inter Bay for decades. 
Anyways, this is really an old school ice cream stand. They have soft serve, hand scooped, shakes, floats, sundaes, cones, etc.. All hand made. It's a classic ice cream experience but nothing fluffed up about it.

This place is cash-only however everything is really cheap. A normal ice cream cup is about 2$, you can get a mini cone for a dollar and other things for between 1-3$. It's way worth the cash only price.

Overall if you don't mind eating outside in the heat it's a good ice cream.

We really love this Goodyear location! We have gone to this location since we have been married for 5 years! We love the staff and the quick service! I called a Midas to get an oil change (because it was close to my job) and they were full from 1:30pm (when I called) until close at 6pm. I called my normal Goodyear guys and low and behold, they had me in and out in 2 hours! 

The prices are not too bad: $30 for an oil change and whenever we have tire issues, we get the insurance and they replace the tires no questions asked!!! 

I would absolutely recommend this Goodyear to every friend I have!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I have been going there for a long time. My complaint is not about the custard, it is the serving size and quality. I always go in for a two scoop chocolate waffle cone. Every time I have gone the scoops and the amount of custard keeps getting smaller and smaller. Today I ordered the standard and it was two rounded scoops, an inch short of the highest point of the waffle cone. The past waffle cone always higher than the highest point of the waffle cone. The reason I am mad enough to complain is because of the cost. This place for Ice Cream or Custard is the highest priced place. I will not be back!

Wetried this on a friend's recommendation when wanting a more upscale Chinese food option. While the menu selection is diverse and the staff seemed friendly enough, the food was really nothing spectacular. I am sure the food was made to order and not the same pre-made items you get from a carry out shop. But the bottom line is if it doesn't taste great it doesn't matter. 
The sesame chicken was probably the best thing we tried. It wasn't overly battered and the sauce was good. It actually could have used more sauce.

The new location is great and a good size that just works for the vibe of this place. The staff could not be friendlier and you feel welcome in the casual atmosphere. The menu is woefully short of what would be considered typical lunch/dinner food. But why limit your waffles or breakfast food to the morning?!
Everything is fresh and well prepared. Is a single waffle and a cup of coffee worth $8 or so? Probably not..... and the prices seem high for such a "bohemian atmosphere". But, it is something different. Plus, they are open late enough that options for "after bar" food are limited. So, give it a try and see what you think!

The convenient location and variety of flavors that can be added to the drinks are the two factors that drew me into State Street Coffee. I was not at all disappointed. They have syrups of every flavor imaginable and they work as a great addition to the average cup of joe. My boyfriend and I ordered two small coffees and each got different flavors added (almond and peppermint). The flavors were subtle and delicious. Additionally, the service was quick and friendly and the cost was very reasonable. 

If you have a few minutes, I recommend stopping in for a drink and sipping it in their outdoor seating area.

Ronnie is a dick head extraordinaire, I had to use Siri to spell that cuz I'm too stupid to do it myself, according to him, I'm also too stupid to fix the AC or call the front desk. I'm saying this fuck head of a weekend manager was unwilling to work with diamond and gold members to switch rooms to ones with mother fucking functioning AC. I also asked for pillows and and extra blanket for my guest but this incomprehensible piece of shit would NOT deliver anything. He abused his maintenance staff, humiliating them on front of guests AND MAKING THEM WIRK IN GUEST ROOMS WHILE THERE WAS AN EMPTY PARKING LOT.  This c*nt shouldn't have his job.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Friendly staff and quick service. I have to hand it to the employees here because they are constantly slammed. Y'all, the closest Starbucks is like Devon, Wayne or West Chester. Yes it's annoying when the drive through line goes all the way to the street, but the staff keeps their cool with a smile. 

Love the open space to do work! People are always having meetings or doing work in this space so it's really productive. I haven't had a long wait time for a drink before. So kudos to my local Starbucks for doing the damn thing day after day.

This was our first time here, and we were able to make a reservation online. The front of house staff were very pleasant and helpful. The restaurant offers beer, wine, and sake as far as alcohol goes, and a wide variety of sushi, and hibachi. The sashimi was to die for, and we really enjoyed most of the rolls. The E roll was a little lack luster, and the music was sort of off putting. They had old school 80's and early 90's country playing, which I didn't necessarily mind, but it didn't add to the experience whatsoever. Will definitely return.

Holy rice man! I'm usually not the type to complain about too much rice, but the rice on everything here was excessive. I couldn't even taste the fish or the rolls because of the quantity of rice that was used. For the most part I only tasted the vinegar used for the rice. Rolls had platforms on the bottom that consisted of pure excess rice. The fish tasted fresh, when I could taste it over the rice and the service was good. Yet I wouldn't go out of my way to drive out to JJ for sushi. Think I'll stick to Sakana and Hiroba for now.

This is my favorite second best sushi place in Brandon Florida. Only second because the first place i like in Brandon has an amazing dragon roll. Still I love coming to this place every time, it has been here for years and it has lots of km mom and pop charm to it that reminds you of Japan. The sushi chef has been doing this for years and years you can tell he appreciates his craft and has totally mastered it. The fish is fresh as they're right next to an Asian fresh market and the staff is extremely friendly. I definitely recommend this place.

Excellent meal the other night. Had the seafood pasta, garlicky, a bit of heat, lots of goodies (seafood that is), only small issue was there was little to no sauce to allow my table bread to have a good purpose (I am sure the el-dente linguini soaked it all up making the flavor of the noodles perfect -just like it supposed to be). The sea bass was perfectly cooked, great flavor, succulent, and sweet, again the only peccadillo was that the fish had little sauce and with sea bass for sure you need a bit of flavoring to help the fish really hit its potential. Oh well, minor indeed. Next meal I will ask for more sauce, haha.

This seemingly "mom and pop" Chinese restaurant was a perfect place to satisfy my Chines food hunger, the biggest problem with this place, is that they give you too much food. The dinner specials are just outrageous in the amount they give you, best to just order one and split it amongst two people. Soup, fried or steamed rice, entree and egg roll or crab rangoon left no room for me to have even a fortune cookie for dessert. The food overall was good, the egg roll a bit "mushy" for my taste, I like egg rolls crunchy and filled with at least some meat for variety. The crab rangoon was good as was my entree, lots of shrimp. Can't go wrong here.

I'm not a patron, but I'm writing this review based on first impressions. It turns out the fitness competition I'm doing today used Hotel Tucson as the host hotel. To me, it looks more like a motel from the outside. The inside lobby, courtyard, and patio are much nicer (renovated?) than the facade. You have to take back roads to get here, which was not conveniently accessible considering you can see it from the highway. Their ATM was malfunctioning and their meeting spaces looked very worn. I would personally rather book a Holiday Inn over this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I really liked the sushi. I had the cocomo roll (or something like that) and the sweet potato tempurah roll. Both were awesome. Service was great. I don't know what some of these yuppity people are talking about. It's a small place, better to eat outside. The sushi wasn't cut evenly on the roll, but it still had amazing flavor and looked pretty. I thought the prices were decent. No veg options to speak of though! The cocomo till was in special for $7.50 and the sweet potato roll was $4.5 or 5 I forget. But not bad. Great for meat eaters.

This is a worthwhile place for lunch or dinner, when taking a trip to the Riverfront.  The menu is not that large, but it does have a fairly good selection of hamburgers and sandwiches, along with an ok selection of entrees.  Service was ok; we got our dinners fairly quickly. Everyone in our party seemed to enjoy their food selection.  The place is a little on the dark side, it would be nice if the inside could take better advantage of the riverfront location.  They do have outdoor seating, though.  Before or after the meal, be sure to take a walk along the Riverfront.

Not bad for Hermitage! Small inconspicuous location, in a shopping center, which worried me. But it was packed when we walked in and we got the last available table. Only about 6 or 8 tables, and a small bar. Service was subpar, but I'm pretty sure it's family owned considering a boy about 8 years old took our drink order. We each ordered three rolls, and we loved them all except the Volcano... Beware, it comes on a bed of tin foil and is covered in melted cheese. A little odd for sushi. But overall, very tasty!

The atmosphere at Oobatz is awesome, lots of TV's, big fish tank, lighting and decor are really nice.  I was taken back by the menu, it was very corny with poor photography and a terrible layout.  We ordered sandwiches, the bread was very bland and food was salty.  Also, everything is served on brightly colored plastic plates.  I think if they put as much money into the menu and real plateware as they did the building itself, this could be a successful restaurant.  Also, the management and staff were very nice but dressed in whatever they felt like wearing. Manager was in plaid shorts with a Puma t-shirt and soccer shoes.  Very unprofessional.

While I hate admitting that I "dine" here,
I'm certain I'm not the only one! Let the food shaming begin... 

On occasion I stop in here for a quick breakfast when I'm running short on time. It's on my way to work and the price is right. 

The food is nothing to write home about but the service at this location is fantastic! In the mornings that is... The staff is always smiling and seemingly pleased to process my order. They really set a great example of what good customer service should be. Especially at 7am when nobody wants to be awake!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
A pleasant surprise. I was in the area and was in desperate need to cut my boys hair. Little man was very particular about his cut, he wanted a blowout. 

I was calling around to find the right shop and came around gifted hands. The Barber knew exactly what he wanted and was able take care of us in timely fashion. 

The shop is a bit of a hole in a wall, nothing special. Typical of other shops in the area. The service was great, our Barber did an awesome job and took good care of my boy. 

We loved our first experience at gifted hands and hope to return at some point down the road.

Not the biggest DD fan. Going to DD is more for nostalgia reasons, having spent a good portion of my life leaving in New England. That was all we had around. 

What you see is usually what you get. Mediocre donuts and watered down coffee. I don't mind that as much as I do getting good service. This particular DD is nothing but a ghetto operation. 

My issue with this location is the inconsistency, sometimes you have one person running the show, other times you have a teeny bopper or two hanging around treating this place like an after school hangout. 

Check them out if you must, just keep expectations at bay.

What a strange place. Went for lunch. It's on route 413. Not much parking. Majorly shabby. The bar is nice but I didn't like the dining room at all, small rooms , crappy chairs. Looked really cheap and had a loud party going on. The bar had dead animals on the wall . So... you know it's classy. The food was fine but it was a crazy menu. Pizza cheese steaks, burgers, oyster Rockefeller. Really!! Had a cheese steak. It was fine. It's was a real experience. Didn't seem like a $12.95 burger place but it is. Enjoy!!

Very underwhelming. Parking during the day is very difficult even though the restaurant may be quiet. This is still a train stop. It's pretty enough and the service was very good but today was really sub par food wise. My buddy asked for a chicken cheese steak, but received a beef one. I order a chicken parm but it was subparm. The roll was over toasted or stale and heated, either way yuck. Lots of cheese a sauce but the chicken was not hot. I'll assume it was made ahead and sat around. The onion rings where pretty good. I've eaten here a few times and happy hour is a pretty good deal. So....

Went for a late lunch. Got the fried calamari and zucchini. Very hot crispy and good. To be honest I'd wish it was more and thicker zucchini.  Thai chili sauce was good but why the marinara?? Both were served. Also got the Raviloio ? One big undercooked ravioli for $20. Not even good. The Prosecco was flat. The service was ok but we were there at 4:00 and the staff ordered take out Chinese and ate it at the bar. This was disconcerting. I love the danger tape paint job to warn you about the step up and down from the bar. I got a pizza to go and it was really good. Happy hour might be worth a trip.

I really wanted to like this place (the girl who took my order over the phone and the deliveryman were both so friendly!), but it is a miss for me. I haven't been able to find a good Chinese restaurant in Indy, and this is another meh one for me. The eggrolls are alright and the rice is too. I had Szechuan chicken and Orange chicken. the Szechuan was pretty good, but the orange chicken wasn't. The flavor isn't the problem, but the meat is. The chicken was just odd and kind of grossed me out, but I'm really weird with meat. Overall, if you are used to other Chinese food in Indy it is better or on par with that, but I'll pass.

After a long first day back at work after vacation, the 27oz strawberry daiquiri was just what I needed. The daiquiri was delicious and certainly didn't got to waste. 

As far as a Mexican restaurant, this is about the same as most of them, but as most of them are, authentic and delicious. It did take us quite a while to receive our food and cheese dip, but the taste made up for it. 

All three of us had a chicken fajita quesadilla, which was huge and great. After eating chips and cheese we all had half left, so if you tend to eat a lot of chips before dinner, split it with someone. 

Overall, good place!

The buffet seemed very standard, at a non-standard price of $15.95. We ordered off of the menu instead, and I was delighted by my Egg White & Spinach Omelette-it was delicious. (It was also cheaper than the buffet). My husband had the Avocado & Egg Quesadilla, and it was tasty as well. 

It's worth the price if you skip the buffet. That said, had we not stayed at the hotel, we would have eaten somewhere else...so basically, if you're staying at City Center Hotel, it's a decent, convenient breakfast. Otherwise I'm sure there are decent breakfast places around.

We decided to try Charlie's yesterday evening (Saturday) and I am so glad I did!  The restaurant is nice, was not crowded when we arrived, so our table of 4 adults was immediately sat.  Our waiter was prompt in taking our orders and was friendly.  We tried a few appetizers and a total of 4 rolls: veggie, California roll with spicy crab, spicy salmon, and the sweet potato roll.  All the rolls were delicious I would not change a thing.  Our group also had a few Sapporo's which were on draft!  We will definitely go again!

Very satisfied with my rental car. 3 stars because of a very rude young blonde man that worked here. He clearly didn't care about his job and had an attitude. A polite young lady was helping me try to get a hold of my insurance company he walks over and takes the phone out of her hand and hung it up as she was calling and said "no, she needs to do that herself" speaking of me. And was speaking about me in front of me. There were better ways to handle that. Other than the customer service, no complaints with the vehicle.

This isn't in it's a hay day. Wow, this food needed help and the service needed just as much. I ordered the Alphonso which included "steak", pork, and a chili. The steak wasn't steak it was a cheap thin stew meat with no flavor, pork so thin with no flavor and the chili was like a wet diaper. The server sucked he didn't refill drinks until after bill was drop off. This food is so dated you can get much better in Tucson. The restaurant itself is nice and the positives was the tortilla and the salsa. Everything else was massively under seasoned and over cooked.

Lately now, everything I love we don't quite have ?  a few of my favorites were white cheddar, or turkey bacon, or go bars!  Guess it's a corporate decision . Service has also become spotty, most of time I use drive in but I've come in a few times too and depends who's on.  A few occasions we ordered a hot latte and the cup is 1/2 full, and while it is a pain, they had it remade for me. . We'll see if this update has a lasting effect but think they know they don't have competition in this area so folks suck it up.

Stopped in on my way to work counter service here was very friendly.  Came at very slow time I think, because only 2 others in here m.  I'm sure people traveling this route were more concerned with getting to the interstate. Lots of indoor seating and well lit with plenty of windows a good energy overall.   I definitely will come back as needed.  Also, a much larger location than the two that are nearest me reminds me of one on Kennedy.  My custom ordered latte was actually full and unlike the Dunkin app I was able to upgrade to almond milk inside for a little extra $ , hopefully that gets fixed and I can order online in the future.

Mechanics are like doctors.  They tell you what you need to fix.  It's up to you to make the decision.  I normally come to this location for an oil change.  But...
- the Dodge needed brakes
-the Subaru needed brakes
This we both knew.  We were offered a competitive price.  The work was finished in good time.  
Wait times can be long at any oil change / garage.  Thus the 3 stars.  I'm not sure if any auto place will ever get more than 3 stars from me. Just my nature.  
This location does good work and communicates well.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
This place is a hidden gem, from the outside it looks like a dump....and frankly it sorta is, but Wow!!!!! The ice cream here is great, try the "Thick and Chunky".....it's exactly what you wish a Dairy Queen blizzard was like.  10x the candy, twice the size, and about 25% less in price!.....my choice is chocolate ice cream loaded with Reese's Peanut butter cups, these guys aren't shy and will load it down with candy and even dump extra on top!!!

WARNING: be careful, this place is addictive, and I'm not sure if any human can handle the large size here.....OMG! It's HUGE!!!!

How have I not been here sooner?! SO IMPRESSED with the quality of sushi! Honestly, the best I've ever had in NJ.  Having recently moved from LA makes me a bit of a sushi snob.. not bragging, just saying!
Sushi texture is like butter and not chewy. Also, servers are attentive and always nearby.  I will have to stop myself from coming here daily!

Banana rolls, mango sauce, everything is stellar!  Please check this place out, the reviews don't lie!

Lunch Specials:
$9 for two rolls soup &salad
$11 for three rolls soup and salad

* $1 up-charge for spicy mayo
* Mango (salad) dressing is the best!

Had a nail in my tire; went completely flat overnight BUT luckily I had a spare. Once I got the spare on, I looked I yelp and found this place and figured; why not?!? Lol. Sure enough I pulled in, immediately got greeted and they started work right away to patch up my tire. I also got a rotation done for $10 extra (my idea; it's importsnt to get this done so the tires wear evenly) and I'm so glad I did cuz they found a second nail but luckily it didn't puncture the tire. 

All in all, these guys are pros and got me hooked up quick and easy! That's 5 stars in my book!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We were woke up at 8:53 on a Saturday. Check out is not until 11. I went down and said something. I put a note in the door...do not disturb until 11 a.m...9:13...bang bang bang...I went down again. I was called a liar. 9:45...at this point, I'm down in my truck...I watch the maid go back and knock on the room again (my husband is still in the room)...I see them ..I grab my camera... she ran back into the room next door when she saw it.. Do not stay here unless you don't mind getting the bum's rush,or like being treated like cow dung and called names.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The harrassment campaign to try and get us to vacate our rooms early, culminated with them calling the police on us, because I took her picture, so I could document the abuse they were putting us through. And she had also told my husband that he could stay an extra hour for ten dollars. She called the police while he was in the shower DO NOT STAY HERE. We are an older couple, not young kids. We created no disturbance. We were abused, intimidated and humiliated.l, because we dated to complain about the way we were being treated. DO NOT STAY HERE, THEY WILL DO THE SAME TO YOU.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Used to work at McDonald's back in the seventies I do go to this McDonald's once in a while probably once or twice a month.The way the restaurant is run today in comparison to the way it was run back in the seventies amazes me.If McDonald's food is prepared properly and the employees are properly trained you can most definitely have a good experience.But the people that are running McDonald's these days are not like the people who ran McDonald's years ago the care level just is not there.Preparation is the key and caring about what you give to the customer if you won't eat it neither will they.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
While biking the cultural trail, ice cream was on the mind of my biking crew. We found this yogurt place while we were in Fountain Square. I'll be honest, I loooooove FroYo. After living in SoCal for three years, it becomes a necessity for your life. I consider myself a connoisseur, and this was just okay for me... especially for the price per ounce. 

For FroYo, it was pretty heavy and reallyyyy sweet. They had a good toppings selection. As we all snacked on our yogurt though, it felt like we were settling. The flavors were gourmet and good... but I really thought they were juuuust okay.

Check it out if you want to, but you don't gotta.

Not a fan of these apartments. I've stayed multiple times with a family member who lives here and they could definitely use some updates. For starters, just the front doors on the townhomes are all beat up and scratched! Not very inviting. Inside, the interiors could use some major updates. Tight hallways, old bathroom fixtures, patched ceilings, cheap doors, lack of central lighting in bedrooms, etc. And then there's the noisy neighbors! Having a shouting match in the middle of the night and waking me up. I would definitely avoid!

My friend and I used Yelp to find a place for cocktails in Carmel the other night and decided on this place. I struggled to find the entrance since the GPS brought me straight to the Renaissance hotel. I wasn't expecting a hotel restaurant (should have read the reviews better!), but I was tired and decided to go in anyway. It was very bland. I tried a pear vodka drink that was watered down and uninspired. My truffle "fries" were large chunks of baked potatoes. Mac & cheese tasted pretty formulaic. Overall, not impressed and will not be returning.

We love it here. All the different kinds of pizza they have are delicious!! It's pretty small so if you're trying to eat in sometime she may have to wait but usually not. We love going there to get single slices just because there are so many different kinds to try. 

Parking is sometimes a pain because Wawa right next-door. Are usually don't try many their appetizers because we got wings and fries and they weren't really that good. But their pizza on the other hand is delicious. 

If you're somebody who loves custom pizza like macaroni and cheese pizza and etc. definitely give this place a try

Not bad mole, but could have used more spice to it.  I prefer the mole over at Oasis personally.  The salsa was very good, as were the rice and black beans.  

Some of my family rave about the wet burrito, and it did look good.  Perhaps I'll try that next time.  

Staff was able to take care of our humongous group without any issue, and I appreciate that they have a separate room that they can use for large groups.

This BYOB was super accommodating for what we were looking for.  I'd be interesting in trying more of their menu.

Villa Barone gets lost in a sea of Italian restaurants in South Jersey.  I ordered the gorgenzola salad and split a margherita pizza.  The salad was pretty good, and overshadowed the pizza.  I would have liked it if the salad was a bit bigger.  There wasn't anything particularly bad about the pizza, but it was not really memorable.  Knowing that I can walk to a number of other Italian restaurants in the area, I can't imagine I will be back to go deeper into the menu.

The warm rolls were pretty good with the oil and spices that they leave on the table.

I've been back a few times because I keep thinking that it is going to be better than it actually is.  They have a lot of sushi, but most of it is covered with too much mayo and therefore tastes the same.  Some small dim sum options, that are good for buffet standards.  My biggest problem is that most of the entrees are cheap versions of high priced foods that I don't really trust at a buffet,  A LOT of seafood which I would like anywhere but a buffet.  I wish they had more non-seafood options.  Also the rice was hard and undercooked, which is unacceptable.

Terrible!

I went for my lunch break.  Ordered a salad because I thought ordering something that didn't need cooking would be fast.  It took 45 minutes for them to make my salad, I had to tell them to make it to go because I didn't have time.  The place was not even busy, there were three other people in the restaurant while I was there (and the phone only rang twice for delivery).    

Also, the salad was terrible (I know a pizza place is not the place to get good salad).  It was soupy with dressing and dripping out of the sides of the container.  

I won't be going back.

I was not there for the buffet, just for a quick sushi lunch.  Service was fast and friendly.

The spicy tuna roll was nowhere near spicy enough and they put that crunchy stuff in the spicy tuna roll, which I am not a fan of.  Used all of my wasabi and asked for more because the tuna wasn't hot enough (wasabi diddn't have enough of a kick either).  The eel roll was ok, but I have had better.  Ginger salad was good, with a lot of ginger dressing on it, but was watery. 

There wasn't anything wrong with Tomo's sushi, just seemed pretty bland.  I have definately had better.  Try Bamboo Fusion in Clementon if it isn't too far away.

Huge selection of wine and liquor as well as domestic and imported beer.  This is where they are much better than many other liquor stores.  When I am coming in for these items I can find exactly what I want, quickly and at a reasonable price.

The one thing that I dislike about H&P is how they deal with craft beer.  While there is a good amount, there is limited quanity of each, and how it is arranged is a pain to sort though.  I have gine in a few times looking for a specific beer and after looking around myself I asked someone who worked there, and it took them a while of searching before they could even they me that they did not carry it.

I really like this sushi place! It had such a nice, upscale ambiance without actually being too expensive. I ordered the sashimi lunch and it came with rice, miso soup, and salad. Sashimi was very unexpectedly fresh and the portion was pretty big for $12. I have no complaints. 

Service was good as well. In fact, they were so attentive that they accidentally came around twice and gave us 4 soy sauce plates instead of 2.  

I would definitely come here again to try the Other things on the menu. The presentation of their food is really great and makes the food seems really fancy!

Since quarantine started, my girlfriend and I have tried getting takeout/delivery from quite a few ice cream places, and this place has to be my favorite. Their flavor selection is vast. I ended up selecting oreo cheesecake, and I swear they smashed a whole slice of cheesecake into the ice cream. The matcha was also amazingly smooth and delicate. 

Their service was also amazing; we got the ice cream to go and they included a ziplock bag of ice to keep the ice cream cold on our journey back home. We highly recommend this place and cannot wait to be back to try more flavors!

This place is pretty good. The dishes are large and definitely have a lot of flavor, sometimes a little too salty. The star is the Xiangxi beef, which is stir fried beef seasoned with some cumin and dry chili spice and mixed in with a bunch of different types of hot peppers. If you like Hunan beef, you'll like this one a lot. The noodles here are also pretty good, if you're brave, you can try the Saozi noodles, they come in both soup and dry. The soup version is spicy and vinegar-y and has small chopped bits of potatoes and minced pork. 

There is never any place to sit unless you don't mind sharing a table with strangers, just as a warning.

*They were supposed to refund me for the roll on my card but they never did*

I ordered eel/avocado but they gave me eel/cucumber. I didn't notice until I got home. 

The dynamite roll is lacking flavor today. Normally this roll makes my mouth water just talking about it. Tonight, I'm extremely disappointed. It's usually has a lot more sauce/scallops on top. 

$28 for two rolls, one of which was wrong and the other was mediocre + side of eel sauce. 

They still haven't updated their prices online to reflect the actual prices when you go to pay. Everything is about $1 to $2 more than their menu online. 

I regret tipping on my takeout order.

Had a fantastic dinner date at Ryan Christopher's last night.  The muscles in pomodoro sauce were delicious some of the best I've ever eaten.  The orange roughy special entree was also very good.  Portions are decent and we were too stuffed to order their award winning desserts (next time).  The service was the best part of the experience.  Our waiter, definitely a high school student, had so much charm and was very professional.  A great move is they spaced out the food so we had time to actually enjoy ourselves and didn't feel rushed one bit.  We will definitely be back!

I absolutely love Gulf Coast Bank, and for so many reasons. The main reason is that the customer service is so strong that I can't even imagine there's another a bank that comes close. 

As much as I love Gulf Coast - and it's a whole lot - this branch's drive thru isn't my favorite. All other aspects of this branch are top notch with the exception of the drive thru.  As long as I use the lobby, things work so well.  There seems to be a little bit of a lag when you drive up.  It may just be that the tellers work with lobby customers first. 

No matter the issue, I'll continue to use Gulf Coast.

Maybe I went into things the wrong way. With a craving for chipotle, and wanting delivery. I thought I had found the solution to my Sunday afternoon craving. 

I sat waiting at my window, watching for the delivery guy to pull up, for my steak burrito, with queso, and quac added. What it was- fatty pieces of meat ( I'm talking every bite spitting the meat out), queso sauce (that was actually shredded Monterey Jack, served cold and shredded), and the after taste of cumin. I ate half, which was purely out of hunger.

This is my new favourite sushi restaurant in Edmonton because the food is good, fast and the location is fresh. Perfect for a lunch date. The smoked salmon roll was the best. The place has nice decor--it was a shawarma place before and its unrecognizable now. Only had the sushi and tempura so far, but I'm going to go back and try the ramen.

I do wish that they had more of a range of sushi options and fewer westernized choices. They are delicious and fun but sometimes I just want some typical sushi rolls that you'd find elsewhere.

This is our normal Chinese take out spot. When we have a need for Chinese food we will turn to New China. Now the food is good and we have never had an issue with consistency however I wouldn't say it is the best I have ever had. The food is always fresh and never seems to greasy. The prices are really good as well for the amount of food you get. One extra plus is you can now order online which we did last night. It seems easy enough but we did a very basic order nothing special. Will have to try it when we want specific things and see how it goes.

You know what? It was about what I expected.  

Not a mind blowing five star experience, but solid for an airport meal. 

I ordered a Cobb salad, fries and a cider. 
Everything came out quickly.

The greens in my salad were fresh, as were all of the other ingredients. 
French fries were crisp and hot. 
The cider, gave me a perfect refreshing buzz and I was on my way.

Additionally the server was attentive (not obnoxiously so...), and on point.

There are other options on this terminal and obviously if you want to hike across the airport there are even more- but if you're into being in the here and now, you can't go wrong here. 

Cheers!

The atmosphere here is incredible . You feel so relaxed and it's got this fancy vibe to it. Also the lighting is adjusted to make you more comfortable and the scenery of the whole thing is perfect for a date! Although, the food isn't all that great, it's actually kind of bland. Also some things taste like they need more sauce (if you order pasta) and not enough sauce is a big turn off for me with foods. But overall, I would really only go for the atmosphere, so I guess I might eat here again. The people here are nice though.

I have only been to the newest location that just opened. I went with a friend for a Sunday sushi lunch. It was a little bit more pricey for lunch compared to other sushi restaurants, but it was very good quality. The fish was very fresh. Everything came out fast at the bar. They have very unique rolls. They don't have typical green tea ice-cream, but they do have delicious homemade ice-cream choices to choose from. I had the strawberry vanilla. I thoroughly enjoyed their donald duck nigiris and the lion king roll.

There are far better sushi places to go to than this place. 

I had the chirashi sushi and miso the appetizer we had was fried tempura shrimp and veggie. 

the fish seemed fresh though the rice under it was so packed it was hard to dig into. 

the tempura was not great. over battered and over fried twice as much the batter than the item fried in it.. also the batter was extremely heavy. 

my partner had some rolls seemed fine. 

we asked for spicy mayo.. they charged us for it without telling us. 

over all.... not going to go back.

Upon entering I was given a small tester cup and pointed in the direction of the urns. I  was excited to try something fabulous and unusual. So I was crushed to find the sample tea was a black tea orange spice (cinnamon). Oh boy! The flavor you find in every cheap holiday gift basket. I tried a jasmine blend off the menu. It was weak but ok. There is free Wi Fi so there was that guy in the corner table not adding to the ambience. The soul music is nice but is seems more like a gimmick than a reflection of the business as it exists in the world.

This is a really good Mexican restaurant in the neighborhood! I would take my friends and family.

I placed an UberEats order for 3 Pastor Tacos and a Tamal. I did put a note to not add onion to my tacos but when I received them they had onion (main reason for the ding). The tamal was also warm when it arrived, but it was cold by the time I finished my tacos. I felt like the tamal was too dry (but again, it was cold when I started eating it).

I was very impressed with the flavor of the marinated pork, and 3 tacos for less than  10, you can't beat it.

I can't believe that we've lived in Boise for so many years and not run into Luciano's before. We loved this place. We had veil parmigiana and shrimp scampi linguini, and both were very good. The calamari appetizer was excellent as well. For desert we shared the chocolate cake. The service was great, and the setting was casual, but nice. Prices were reasonable too. Be warned...  As others have noted, the parking lot is crowded, and the lobby area is small. It is best make reservations, or at least call ahead, since it seems they are busy most nights.

We were out running errands today, and got super hungry for lunch.  A Pizza Buffet sound like it would be the ticket.  My wife and I were with my daughter and granddaughter, and taking a 20 month old anywhere requires careful consideration.  IPC is a great place for families whenever you want pizza and/or a great salad bar.  Like normal, the Pizza buffet is just OK, and not as good as when you get your pizza fresh, but still good.  Staff is nice, and the service was fine.  And....  They have Diet Dr. Pepper, which is always a plus!

[  I thought the decor at this Idaho Pizza Company was totally un-bear-able...  (Joke...  see photos.)

This is my go to spot for sushi. Great quality and great price! They men behind the sushi bar are quick with the orders and never fail making a great roll. The older woman who works here is such a sweetheart, as well as the other staff. The woman who helped me me today right before they closed for lunch had excellent service.  I highly recommend the deluxe shrimp tempera roll !! I have been coming here since March and I have yet to find a better local sushi place. As much as I love them, they take forever to charge for the food. Other than that small little detail, everything else is great!

Again I am not a fan of Mexican food, but apparently all of my friends love it. We stopped here for lunch before heading to the Bike Expo at the Gateway Center. I had the buffet, which was very nice and clean. Tacos, burritos, tostitos, and some other thing that was rolled up and fried. You can also build a nacho platter which is what I did. They only have Pepsi products, huge downer if you are a Diet Coke fan (which I am). Our waitress was so friendly and funny, I tipped her nicely just because of her personality....

Tried this place after getting a coupon in the mailer.  The hibachi dinner was great, and the chef was very friendly and talented (I think his name is Eddie).  Sashimi was excellent quality but a bit overpriced ($9 for 5 thin slices).  The sushi was so-so, in my opinion.  Tried a rainbow roll and the Mexican roll.  The rainbow roll was pretty good, but the Mexican roll didn't have much flavor (and it was supposed to be spicy!).  We would go back for the hibachi grill but probably not for the sushi.  Service was friendly but slow, honestly, despite the seemingly slow night (maybe 4 other tables).

Price was reasonable. Staff was nice. We will printed a whirlpool room, but the whirlpool was on a timer. After 20 minutes, it would not turn back on the rest of the night. I would not of spent the extra $25 for 20 minutes of whirlpool. Also, the shades in our room would not close enough to keep out the sun in the morning. It's an unpleasant thing to wake up to a single ray of sun in your eyes at 6:30 in the morning. That could be avoided by staying across the hall of course. The pool is nice, but oddly cramped with a lot of people during our stay. If given the opportunity, I would look elsewhere for a place to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Located in the East of New Orleans in Bullard lies McDonald's in between Cajun seafood & taco bell/KFC. Carby carbs! Works in all ways for a midnight snack (open 24/7, meaning oatmeal all the time!) .. Coffee run..a fat lazy dinner for the family&& not for me since I'm pescetarian and don't really care for fried fast food.
Service is always a hit or miss. However, Sunday night's service is pretty nice. I always go through the drive thru.
Yeah...I'm not sure how to review McDonald's exactly..I mean.. It's McDonald's! I'm lovin' it!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
looks like it's been remodeled/good service. not easy to find from i-75.
pass pdq restaurant

keep your eye on publix shipping plaza.
bathrooms are clean. 
wow! paper towels available!
even though they still have the dreadful hand blower. that scatters all the dirt of the floor into your lungs.

the food coming out seemed fresh.

text:
Visited this old school italian restaurant with my girlfriend for a late Saturday lunch and were seated immediately. We started with mussel's (white) which were delicious. For main we had the veal parm and the eggplant parm. Both servings were huge and easily the best italian we have had in Philly. Big fans of the food and will definitely return. 

Only downside was the slow service. Our waiter 'disappeared' outside and whilst other tables were being served, we had to wait 20mins for him to return before we could ask for the bill...But that was only a minor point in otherwise a delicious and enjoyable lunch.

Things are looking up for KOP Mall with the arrival of Pizzeria Vetri. Perfect place to take a break from hiking the mall, or to reward yourself for dragging yourself there, either upon arrival or before departure. Lunch or a quick snack. The wait staff - yes, table service, this is not just a take out/serve yourself place - was excellent. Shout out to Theresa, who was both efficient and welcoming. We shared the Funghi Rotolo, a perfect snack for weary shoppers. Draft beer! Tired Hands Hophands, what could be more appropriate? Delicious. Will be back!

Overall I would give them another try because the negatives could of just been an off day . I had vegetable hibachi , veggies were perfect they followed directions of exactly what I did and didn't want which is HUGE for me so I applaud that ! The rice was hard and not edible and the hibachi noodles could use more flavor ! Edamame cooked perfectly but would of been better salted , soup was great and the salad was only a few pieces of lettuce I feel the portion was terrible but the dressing was great ! I'll try again to see if there is a difference on days . Over all not bad .

We went here for Valentine's. Cute little place in the strip mall. But once you walk through the door I remind you of a little piece of Italy. Decor was low-lighting very romantic white tablecloths even though you could dress casual. I would give it 5 stars if it wasn't that the service/cook was  slow but very polite and accommodating. We assume wait was due to cooking our meal, however dinner took 2 hours. Not sure if that was due to Valentine's Day we will have to go back on a regular night. Besides that the food was great! Lots of choices of wine!

This was the first time I've been to this location and it was so nice! I would recommend the crispy chicken Thai chilli appy and the Big Mac inspired pizza!! If you can't decide between a burger or a pizza then this is the perfect combination. This location has a great atmosphere for after work drinks or meeting up with friends before an oilers game. There is underground parking nearby so you don't even have to walk outside to get there if it's cold. The staff was very friendly and always kept our drinks full. I would definitely be happy to come back here!

Great place to go if you're in the mood for a hearty pasta meal! One of my favorite foods happens to be spaghetti and I ordered the baked spaghetti last time I was here. It was delicious! I was so full by the time I left here because they start you off with warm bread and garlic butter and a salad before you get your main dish. It's easily a place you could go for a date night or bring your whole family because it has a casual yet classy atmosphere. The service was great and we didn't have to wait too long for our food which is always a perk when eating out!

What a fun gym! I love the purple and yellow colors, they're inviting and lend to the idea working out is fun! The gym is large with plenty of cardio equipment. There are a select few weight machines and a few sets of free weights. There are no body weight machines nor squat racks, but they do have Smith machines. This is definitely a beginner friendly gym and the prices reflect such. There are only two total in town. Overall, I definitely would recommend this gym for beginners, or for the experienced if you need a quick fix!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
What a fun little donut shop! I love me some Best Donuts in Town, which has closed and makes me sad, so when this place opened up, I was really excited to try a new donut shop, with some flair! I didn't go in opening day or opening weekend as I knew the place would be packed. I went the Monday evening after opening and while there were only 6 types of specialty donuts and some glazed, I was able to get a half dozen of my choosing.
Holy crapola batman were these donuts amazing! I loved the varieties they had on hand, and I'm looking forward to all the future fun varieties they'll come up with!

In the past, my fiancé and I were big fans of Amani's. Good food, good atmosphere and a BYO-the best!

But then we went for Amani's NYE prefix meal. We've been to Amani's a few times and since were impressed, we invited friends to join us. 

Needless to say we were disappointed. For $85 pp, the food was sub par. Scallops were sandy, soup was bland, and I couldn't even tell you our server's name. I was very disappointed for such a steep price (plus tip). However, the complementary glass of champagne was quite tasty.

Jeni's is AMAZING!!! Definitely some of the best ice cream I've ever had. All of the flavors are so creative, and it is always so difficult to choose what to get because everything is so great. The people who work at Jeni's are so nice and helpful, and don't get at all annoyed when you have to try 5 or 10 flavors before you decide, because they all sound so tempting! There is always a line if you go after dinner time, but they are very efficient and you never feel rushed to make a decision. I try to go to Jeni's every time I'm in East Nashville! It's hard to walk/drive by without stopping!

Speedy service, nice but not spacious on the inside - great outside seating area. 

Very nice location near the Countryside Mall and it also sits in a very nice shopping plaza with TJ Maxx, Ross, etc. 

For the size of this location the cleanliness is always great.  

Yes yes it's PSL season (you butta ask somebody) LOL (stop judging me) you know you like it also :)

Let's face it we mostly don't really visit Starbucks for the coffee but for the experience, the baristas are always with a smiling friendly face and super knowledgeable, they look me in the eyes and the customer service is OUTSTANDING. Keep it up Baristas! :)

This is my favorite Sbux in town.  They are always friendly, and the drinks are well-made.  The parking lot can be a little treacherous when they're busy...today I parked in front of Snarf's (they weren't open yet) and walked across the drive through line.  Saved myself 20 minutes by getting out of the car and walking my happy a$$ into the building instead - just sit in your cars, people, it makes it that much faster for me.

Also, I love that the building reminds me of a spaceship and has easy access to the highway.

I Never use Avis, but they are my companies "preferred" rental service. This was a mistake. Charged me $50 extra to pick up the car 30 minutes early.. or just stand there and wait for a vehicle that was sitting waiting for me. Upgraded the vehicle to a luxury SUV and got a 2 year old, 25,000 mile, dirty and heavily scratched Infiniti. Wasted almost an hour of my time exchanging it for another vehicle. Next got a GMC Yukon. The vehicle was nice, but had to wait for it. They sure do like to up charge you and not offer customer service in return. I will stick with Hertz. Lesson learned.

Nigiri pretty good . 
But I don't see why I would give anymore stars to be honest. Our drinks were low , lack of service . 
Had a al a cart , $14.95 for teriyaki chicken , tempura , some rice and seaweed salad . 
Bento $13.95 teriyaki chicken , tempura, some rice , seaweed salad, miso , and a roll of your choice . 

The price different is a bit confusing ? 
There was hardly any food with the teriyaki chicken and when we asked about the chicken and the prices , they just said portions ? Still doesn't seem right , when you're getting 3 extra things . 

Definitely had better .

The manager at this location, Ramona, is one of the rudest people I have ever encountered. I have been here numerous times where not only has she been rude to me personally but has caused quite a scene with her workers and other customers. She is highly unprofessional and rude. I witnessed her telling a customer that she had the authority to decide who was allowed to bank with the company and that she was going to close his business accounts and severe ties with him and his family. The man was not loud or combative or argumentative. She was clearly on a power trip. If this is how 5/3 bank is run then I need to bank elsewhere.

Me and the fella ate here yesterday and it was ok.  The building is huge but isn't the most appealing, especially with a loading dock out front. We had the buffet, of course. Some of the food was good and fresh, others not so much.  The rolls, chicken, and fried shrimp was kinda old. The sushi bar was a little suspicious looking.  I am BIG on sushi and I just could not bring myself to eat any sushi off the bar.  Looked like it had been sitting there a while.  I thinks it's best to go to this place early for fresher food instead of later in the evening as we did yesterday.

This is a McDonald's whose employees too often think it's a place of socializing instead of a place conducting business. 

On 3/13/15 at 6:40pm, with very few customers in store due to inclement weather, they got the order totally wrong. When I called to complain, the manager said, "Do you want to come back?"

I ordered fish. I'm a Catholic and cannot eat meat on Friday. What did they give me? Cheeseburgers. 

They don't get it. My time and transportation are valuable and driving in bad weather for their mistake is an insult. Go to the Steak 'n Shake next door, they never have this issue.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: What I love about Yogurtland is that there are SO many combinations YOU can choose. Talk about have it your way! Toppings, yogurt, sauces and more. You've got your traditional flavors then a whole slew of other ones to try. Make sure to ask for sample cups at the front before you get a heaping amount in your own bowl. If you don't know where to go for dessert or to satisfy a sweet tooth then Yogurtland is your place. The only caveat is what goes into the yogurt. Tons of ingredients but all can be looked up on their website. Make sure to make it a periodic rather than regular stop ;)

I'm not sure what happened here. I am a pretty regular customer and about two months ago the place seem to have a huge overhaul. All the regular girls were gone - I mean it seemed like every single one doesn't' work there anymore. The new staff is great but the coffee is just terrible now. I've gone there a bunch of times and every single time it's been pretty bad. I think they need to teach the new staff how to make a latte! I can't even step in there anymore. It's too bad because I love to support local places and it's so convenient for me, but I'll have to start driving to a new coffee spot.

Not bad.
The good: Service.. 4.5 initial order taking was slow but everything thereafter was good.  
Food was 3.70...Quesadilla with steak was tasty but steak was undercooked.  Crab fundido was muy delicioso with some sort of sharp cheese and lump crabmeat (yum yum!)...
That was from May.  5/23/12 to be exact.

Today 6/28/12 we are having drinks and Crab Fundido with extra crabmeat plus shrimp....It was most excellent!  Lump crabmeat, plenty of cheese, fresh chips, and some kick-butt drinks.  In my best Arny voice "I'll be back."

Back at the Bayou Club and acts are still good.  However,  they changed up the bar.   It now more like a corporate neon TGIF drink 'till you barf bar.   Too commercial and sterile,  but hey,  I guess that what sales.  No more do they get the crowd involved with musical acts,  it's now about emptying the drunk walking  wallets of $$.  The servers now blow whistles and throw around little stupid empty green plastic hand grenades....whatever,  I'm out. 
The real scene is on Frenchmens Street anyway; Bourbon is for the noobs who don't know any better.

Great wine shop just outside the warehouse district.  This type of wine shop has been needed in this area for some time.  They have a very large selection of esoteric wines from around the world.  The staff is very accommodating, well trained and knows their products well.  They even offered to deliver my order...  My only reason for not giving it a five star review is that I found some of their pricing a bit higher than other stores...  If you don't mind paying a little more, than you will be fine (not a lot, maybe a few dollars per bottle)...  To me the service and convenience is worth it, but that would be my only negative...

I don't know what place the others on Yelp are reviewing, but they don't reflect the experience I had at 4:59. I walked out with a haircut that looks choppy and felt rushed all for double the price of Hair Cuttery for example (which does a nicer job). My stylist could not even shave my neck correctly--missed spots. Billed as an upscale salon for men, this place is nothing special at all--big deal they give you a hot towel for your face and offer you a pop while you wait. Perhaps I just got the wrong person on my visit, but I would not recommend 4:59--save your money folks.

Ordered dinner from here recently. I wasn't really a fan of my meal, but I was definitely very happy with the service. They labeled everything and made it all nice and neat and individually packaged so it was easy to distinguish what was what, which was GREATLY APPRECIATED.

As far as the food, I would say I probably wouldn't order it again. I got the spinaci insalata ..... spinach salad with chicken and bacon and a bacon dressing, candied walnuts, and more...

The combination of savory and sweet wasn't really appealing to me, but it normally isnt so I guess I wasn't surprised. I just really didn't like that dressing!

2 hours for a regular mani/pedi and almost the same for a single gel manicure??!!  That should never occur but it did here.  It didn't help that the gel manicurist was working on three people at once (she left my hands soaking in acetone for about 40 minutes) or the woman doing the regular mani/pedi was obviously so inexperienced that other people had to check in on her often. They also don't do manis and pedis at the same time which delays things.  End result was ok so the extra star for that.  But if you have other options, I would try those first.

Too Soul is an adorable, quaint addition to Reno. I love the ambiance and staff that greet you and are always so helpful with their suggestions. My husband (Mr. steak N Potatoes) was so embarrassed to go to a tea shop with me, but after the staff made him feel "Cool" we were walking out with tea pots and various flavors of their loose leaf teas. I am obsessed with the coconut flavor. It's such a treat and unbelievably soothing. I love to just go hang out there and read, or simply sit there and people watch. Too Soul is awesome! Keep up the good work :)

In the spirit of getting the full Bourbon St experience, I stopped in this place to grab the famous Hand Grenade.  It was fruity and delicious, and it went down easier than a drink with that much booze should.  They gave us little plastic grenades along with our drinks that you are supposed to throw at people once you finish the drink.  The bar itself is like walking into Spring Break circa 1997.  It tacky as hell, smelly and has sticky floors...but all in a charming way.  Places like this have been added to my Murtaugh List, but it was nice to take a stroll down memory lane.

Why has Josephine survived Covid?  Three reasons.  Quality. Quality. Quality.  Josephine has an amazing menu and delivers unparalleled service equal to the top 3-5 food/drink spots in the city.
