I'm a foodie and Josephine never disappoints.  The brunch menu and brunch experience is equal to the best in Nashville and quite likely sets the bar for all the other best brunches in town.  Josephine isn't bi-polar.  It's identity and purpose remains true to itself and I'm sure it will be singularly focused for many years to come.

pretty cool foodie experience for the top chef aficionado on a budget..  

make sure you sit on the side of the restaurant that doesn't obstruct your view of the open kitchen.  half of the experience is watching kevin sbraga go to work.  fine dining with trendy ingredients, perfect execution and beautiful presentation. and the price really isn't that bad either.  everything was great but the foie gras soup is a must.  the only downside is that the portions are small and you may leave a little hungry.  fortunately, the top chef experience and creativity of each course more than satisfied my foodie cravings for the night.

The inside is great, very fancy. lots of more exotic groceries like aloe leaves and stuff.
DO NOT BUY MEAT HERE though. I was given green, very obviously spoiled pork. 
I then returned it. I was then given more spoiled pork.
Everything else is nice though, and they returned my money for the spoiled pork so I can't really complain except for being inconvenienced. 

Maybe it was a bad shipment? Still though- definitely sticking to a butcher from now on. My fridge still smells like rotting dumpster from it. Agh.

"Meh" is the best expression for this dining experience that I can come up with. I ordered the hibachi vegetables, fried rice and miso soup. Everything was really bland, not enough juices in with the hibachi. It was all quite dried out actually, and the miso soup was so extremely lacking in flavor. It all needed a good bit more salt...I kept thinking... should I add soy sauce? salt? No...I just wanted flavor and pizazz...I don't even like salting my food and rarely ever use salt, but everything I purchased from Ninja just screamed for it. I won't be visiting again, I don't think.

The food here is bland grease laden slop!!! I find it hard to believe this place got a review over one star!!! I guess some people like this place which boggles my mind. The last thing I ordered was vegetable soup, and a order of shrimp fried rice. How do you screw up shrimp fried rice I don't know? But it was dry as a bone bland and had literally a few bean sprouts and about 6 shrimp in the large order. The veggie was came in handy to wash down that dry hard funky rice I ordered. I would give this place less than one star if I could . ***STEER CLEAR***

This bar is a bit dingy, dimly lit and dirty looking. Stopped for a few beers since our gate was close by. Drafts were expensive, typical of an airport bar, but were flat and not too cold. They also didn't have Stella Artois or my second choice, Anchor Steam. Had to settle for Coors Lite. My boyfriend had a gin and tonic, very weak for the price. Not a good selection of anything.
They did have WiFi available, but I believe that is offered via the airport. Food Menu looked basic, but overpriced, Place was a but scummy, so we didn't eat here. 
Service was good however, very attentive.

If a person ever wanted to know what it feels like to have a beer and sit inside of a toilet then this is their place.  We should have known it was a dump when out of 100,000 people on Bourbon Street Saturday night, there were maybe 5 inside here "enjoying" terrible service from Ronnie and 100 boring beers.  

The only thing that was a positive was that the NOLA Ale was good that I ordered.  Having no soap or towels in either bathroom was a nice touch as well.  Maybe it was done on purpose so that irritated customers can leave with the stench of this place still on them.

Needless to say, we won't be back.

This is a small spot with a mostly take-out business. There are several tables to sit at, but I wouldn't call it a real dine-in spot. I've been here twice, and both times ordered the Teriyaki Chicken. The dish comes with a side of vegetables which consist of mostly cabbage. If you like cabbage, that's great... but if not.. there's not many other vegetables in the medley. The chicken had adequate flavor... nothing special. The food was made in under 10 mins, but the price differed from what was on my menu. It seems that I had an outdated menu at my office, so check prices before you order. Oh and FYI: THEY ARE CASH ONLY!!! $$$

Was driving by and saw the $2 dollar special for any car wash and was immediately drawn in like a moth to a flame. This deal runs every Tuesday! That's the only good news. The attendants are also nice and helpful. 
I would recommend coming here if you only need a wash. The vacuums have very little suction power. So little in fact that I just gave up trying because you would need to run over the same area for 10 minutes before it would look semi clean. Also just found damage from the wash to the front of my car. It caused small chips in my paint. I will never come here again

Checked into the hotel after a cancelled fight. Updated hotel, very nice and Asa at the front desk took great care of me. Was nice after getting hosed on 4 united flights - another story. Room was awesome, bar and restaurant not bad but the concierge lounge was a little disappointing, like they wanted to close and just left out enough to say they were "open", grabbed a water and left, not great there. Otherwise close to airport, clean updated and has a place to grab food and drinks. Nothing in walking distance but you can survive here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I have eaten here 4 times and only come back for the delicious homemade spaghetti. Service is terrible from the walk in the door- wait for hostess takes forever, it takes 15-20 minutes for the wait staff to introduce themselves and take your drink order, tracking down your check after an hour and a half meal takes forever. 
Only positives to the staff are the young table bussers. Each time they have gotten my forgotten bread, refilled my drinks and gotten me the check after asking the wait staff 3 and 4 times! 
Sat near the kitchen and someone was clearly smoking a cigarette in the kitchen! 
Consider just ordering takeout!

I was craving some sushi and happened to stumble across tamaki. I'm not to sure if it was the time of day that had something to do with it but it was completely empty. Which wasn't a problem at all lol ^_^. The interior was nice. You're typical sushi bar type of feel. Staff was welcoming. I ordered the combo B. Which Consisted of 18 pc of spicy sushi, it came with salad and miso soup.   The sushi didn't have enough sauce on it...I had to keep flavoring it with soy sauce...:( for overall experience it wasn't bad  but I don't think I'll order combo B again. Lol

Let me first say that I dig this place, a lot, did I mention that I really dig this place? 

While others may think the prices are a little bit steep I couldn't agree less, you're paying for not only your drinks but the experience that St. James has to offer. 

I really love the black and white theme with the red lights on the inside and the rooftop patio is always a plus if the inside is too dark for you. 

If it's on a crawl, do yourself a favor and stop by for a drink, you might just find yourself coming back in the near future.

Let's see, this place used to be a favorite. Must be new owner/management. Chips are often stale and IF you have more than a basket or two they charge you for the extra (salsa included). {First Mexican place I've been to that does that}. The prices have gone up and the quantity and quality of food keeps decreasing. There are a couple servers that don't seem to fit in because they are actually nice and friendly. There are a few that seem pissed off that they must wait on you, never smile or say thank you. I'm done after several years of going there at least once a week. Do yourself a favor and keep driving.

It's okay. 

I don't mind Chu Shang but I think it's kind of overpriced, even though the soup is pretty large. They have add some kind of cream in their soup that gives the broth a comforting feel and it is quite delicious, but nothing crazy special. I also don't love that they don't put the itemized prices next to each ingredient, since you have to pick enough items so that you hit at least a certain price point or something. The concept of choosing each ingredient can be fun and cool, but I prefer transparency in the process. 

Maybe next time I'll try their dry pot and have more opinions!

This is for their food truck ; 3.5 stars

El Gorrion stops by everyday where I work to sell lunch to hungry employees with no time to make food. I will say, for what they have to offer, I do think they do a pretty good job. Is it the best Mexican you've ever had in your life? No, but it does the trick. I really enjoy their carne asada hard tacos (the soft ones sadly get super soggy by the time you start eating them) and their salad bowls are pretty good too! I've only had the carne asada and chicken and was pleasantly surprised. Not too bad for a food truck, but I've had better

Don't hate it but don't love it. I've yet to find a Starbucks where they are actually moderate to quick service wise--- and I just mean to take my order- obviously it takes time to make coffee.

I went to this location on a Saturday to try the new Smores frap. There was one guy ahead of me. He was ordering a bag of coffee.... it took the lady a really long time to get him this coffee. meanwhile 3 other employees walked around behind the counter... looking at me but not asking me if I needed help... I continue to wonder why this part of the Starbucks chain fails at EVERY location..

Went here yesterday for lunch and I was extremely satisfied! This is definitely the best half-off sushi place in the lower Bucks area.

My family and I ordered 15 different rolls and I am happy to say that each was delectable, especially the specialty rolls--they were truly fresh and delicious. The price, of course, is beyond worth it; drinks all around, 15 rolls, and 2 salads for 75 bucks! Can't beat that anywhere else. Definitely try the spicy girl roll, shrimp tempura, and salmon avocado.

Beware! They charge for refills!

Besides that, excellent place.

Food was fulfilling... there's the upside. 

Try to keep your Viva experiences to the drive through. Interior might appear clean, but the bathroom isn't very hygienic as well as the cheap tile floors.

It makes me laugh that all of the aluminum chairs all have that one super short leg to assure that your seating experience is never relaxed or comfortable. 

I also don't speak much Spanish, but I know when the kitchen staff is being offending through gestures, looks and body language. Comes off a little rude. 

Great salsa though!

Let me just say that I have not had a bad experience here! 

I do not recommend a larger group (above 7 people) due to the lack of space to push tables together. 

However if you don't care about that then you most deff should go here. They are the home of trashed wings. And for good reason. Get them! also the onion rings are amazingly fried. 

The servers are helpful and sweet. They made sure my beer came out cold and stayed filled. 

The patio is also able to be a year round patio. They put walls up and have a heater in the winter and take it all down for the summer. 

One of my favorite places.

Came with a friend for a quick Chinese food lunch. Not bad for fast. They were better than the Egg Roll King on Prater. Much more flavor in the rice and the chow mein was much more tender. I didn't get the feeling of the food being dried out like it can be in the quick serve establishments at times. The orange chicken was not as tender and juicy as I had hoped. But still good and would definitely return when craving another quick lunch break. 

They do have a small parking area on the side of the building so that's helpful if you get here before 12.  

The staff was friendly and quick to get out order started and the prices are reasonable.

Wonton soup surprisingly delicious! The pork they use is so flavorful, and the wonton wrapper/dough skin is to die for. I personally don't like meats (chicken, pork, beef, shrimp) mixing, but I get that it makes the broth taste so much better and stronger!

Unfortunately the fried dumplings plate was very mediocre. Can't tell if I got lucky with the wonton soup or unlucky with the fried dumplings, but either way a point gets deducted.

Service was attentive and friendly! We mentioned that we were in a rush, and they took great care to get our food and checks to us on time.

Disclaimer: I'm pretty picky with seafood and don't eat sushi at all.

I came here because my roommates love sushi, which they seemed to really enjoy their sushi. But be warned: Fat Salmon doesn't have much else besides sushi. I have gotten the udon noodles (pretty good, but tiny portion), gyoza (average quality, so not great for the price), and katsu (pretty bad, to be honest). I even left some katsu on the plate because I couldn't force myself to finish.

The atmosphere and lighting is very cool, but the service is lacking. Since the place is pretty small, there can be a long wait if you don't reserve before hand.

Decent Italian American suburban food.

Ordered the chicken parm. This was all as expected for a American Italian joint. 

The food was predictably good. The chicken was breaded and deep fried. The pasta was ok, but not excellent. 

We ordered the fried calimari. The flavors were blunt. The calimari was at points tender and other points tough.

Overall, this restaurant caters to 45-75 locals who want reliable and tasty food. And they do that well. Don't come here looking for subtle flavors or impressive execution.

Came here on a Saturday night. Had the Veal Marsala. It was OK. The meal was not amazing and the sauce was just to strong on the wine flavor. Could have used something to balance out the bitterness of the marsala. The pasta side was good, but not spectacular. I've made similar quality at home. All in all, I think you can find a better Italian restaurant. Not quite sure why this is still sitting at 4.5. The bread, however, was hot and the butter was nice a sweet and delicious. No complaints there. I'd find someplace else if I were you. There are better options in Malvern.

Tuna Poke: The tuna was tender, but not exceptionally so. The taste was fresh and no "fishy" element. The crisps given to dip this were inappropriately thin for weight of the poke. And this rendered them nearly useless. 

Fried Bologna Sandwich: This was a good version of the sandwich. It's a bit heavy on mayo for an already fatty dish. The fries were soggy but I will pass that off as being a symptom of COVID takeout. 

Overall there were good aspects going on here, but this spot is not executing at an exception level of cuisine. It's a bistro, and I believe it does that well.

I hadn't been here in years, but I was in the neighborhood so I decided to give it a try. The building itself is a little shabby, and the decor typical strip mall sushi restaurant style. However, the service was very attentive, even not sitting at the sushi bar. And the sushi itself was incredible. It was lunchtime, so I didn't order a ton of things, but they were all perfect. The spicy tuna roll was in exactly the right proportions and had great flavor. The salmon nigiri was tender and flavorful. But it was the white tuna that was truly magical. 

The food was so good I would definitely make an effort to drive across town to eat here again.

Grabbing our Sunday breakfast we decided on The Great American diner in Langhorne. Nothing special, nothing horrible.  Simple basic diner fare and atmosphere.  Upholstery on booths could use a good cleaning or replacement as the edges were beginning to fray.  Our server Theresa was attentive to our needs and our food was prepared to order in a reasonable amount of time.  The bacon was on the floppy side and lacked the crispness that I prefer. Yet all in all an edible meal at a fair price.  A simple review for a simple experience.

talk about a little nugget of down home goodness this is the place. i have heard the breakfast is great. i had the mushroom swiss melt and good golly miss molly it was good :) the house salad was better than most resturants at $2.50. it had boiled egg sliced in fours and lots of bacon etc. the onion rings and steak fries were also good. i am the type to share when i am with someone. u know the one that says let me try that lol. anyway people check this out and i barely mentioned just are darned cheap the prices are for the quality of food.

They have a Asia Grocery store connected to the restaurant...it has only been open 3 months. They also remodeled the inside sense I last went. The reason I have ate elsewhere is the price is higher than others close by and it wasnt that much better for the price. Although it is slightly better. But the owner said in April he will have a new menu and more specials like dollar sushi and a lot others. Like 10 dollar chirashi... which normally costs 15 dollars or more. So I am definitely coming back and if the quality doesnt slip to much then u can bet I will be a regular.

Dive bar in central Tucson. Prices are reasonable, the appetizers on the menu are $1 off during Happy Hour. Played pool with friends and enjoyed some crispy french fries, the hand dipped chicken strips were really dry, would not order them again. 

We ended up in the smoking room for a bit to play pool out of the way of a poker tournament, the room could use a lot of TLC, seems to have been abandoned. 

Friendly dive bar, seems to have a lot of regulars, staff was friendly. Would return again if looking for pool and dive bar scene.

This small mom and pop shop is my favorite kind of sushi place! 

Ordered the Kazaku Special that came with 20 pieces chefs choice sashimi plus two rolls- all for $50. Our sashimi pieces were thick and tastes pretty fresh for Tucson. We ordered the crunchy roll and dragon roll. Enjoyed the dragon, but not sure if we'd get the crunchy again- a little tooooooo breaded for us. Overall we felt the special was a great deal for non happy hour pricing. 

Service was very friendly and our drinks were always filled. Sushi also comes with miso soup.

I've only used the drive through car wash. It gets the job done! A-Ok! It's right around the corner from my house so very convenient. 

No human is manning the car wash. I've never had any issues come up in my half dozen or so washes. You can purchase car wash package at a discount. You pay and then you're given a code for the next time you come. Coin vacuums and hand washing is also available at this location. There is also a water refilling spot in the parking lot- not sure if they have the same owners. 

I'll continue to return here for the occasional wash.

5 stars for friendly service.  I want to try other items on the menu to give this place a fair rating
Food is served quick , fresh and good size portions. 
Authentic Mexican food is hard to find in Spring Hill.  
Good tortillas, great salsa and great cheese ( Mexican) not yellow Monterey or mix cheeses ). Chihuahua or Cojita or queso fresco.  With some amazing Spanish rice   This would be a 5 star all the way.
I will revisit and re rate.  Looking forward to loving this place.  Because I do love true Mexican food

Their claim: "Better ingredients, better pizza"... What?! I ordered a pizza from here and this was certainly not the case. The pizza was loaded with a high quantity of low quality ingredients, especially the sauce which was like ragu, the nadir of all marinara . Pappa John's is typical National chain pizza. Only resort to it if you are in the South where they mess up pizza almost as badly as we do with Mexican food up here in the North. If you get a coupon for an "offer you can't refuse" just settle for the thin crust with grilled chicken.

I'm a transplant from Northern New Jersey, and locating decent Italian has been challenging. 

I like this place. Hopefully the neighborhood leaves the establishment alone. 

The cold sandwich is something that does not require repeating. The mission of finding a good sub, hoagie, whatever u call it - that mission is still in progress. Despite a fail on the Italian sub, their meatball salad is fantastic! Been back twice for it... Who would ever imagine that the two could compliment so nicely. I give all the credit to that meatball though.

Wanted a quick sushi fix and decided to try this place because it was close to my hotel and from some of the reviews I read.  For $7.50 I got a sushi combo (egg, shrimp, tuna and salmon nigiri with tuna or salmon roll) and a spicy tuna roll.  The taste isn't bad and the quality is ok.  I noticed that tea isn't free, even if you ate in (2 tables and bar seating).

The man (owner?) seemed pretty nice but it looked like he was by himself (6:30pm Thursday night).  He allowed me to substitute the egg nigiri for the shrimp one which was great.

I would probably try another place that had more variety.  Sushi Ya doesn't have bentos or hot food.

Don't make the same mistake we did.  Plenty of better options.  Good:  clean sheets and room in general.   Decent size room.  Clean lobby and general area.  Big flat screen.  Bad:  not the best part of town but cameras in the parking area made it okay to leave my motorcycle out.  Overpriced, but hotel taxes in this liberal town are very high in general.   Went down for lobby coffee and they want to charge $3 for a cup out of a machine.   Unless you are traveling with kids I would stay in an exterior room to avoid kids screaming in the pool.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Seen the place many times, but only recently went in. Was craving sweets, but also tried to limit my sugar intake, so the "50 calorie" poster caught my eye. The place isn't fancy at all, but "low calories" (I choose to believe, it's the truth) and delicious ice cream (prob frozen yogurt is a better description) made this place one of my new favorites. I love just the classic vanilla soft serve, but they have many other flavors. When I come with my dogs, they also get a fee ice cream treat. The staff is always friendly and efficient. The place is always clean. Beside ice cream they have jams and other sweets to take home.

I ended up at this Giant supermarket because I needed to go to the pet store next-door.  I like this chain of supermarkets because I can take good advantage of the gas discount. However the store starting to show its age a bit.   The one in Springfield is much brighter and user-friendly. I didn't see an Olive bar  or other amenities that I have seen and other grocery stores. They help here however is very polite and it appeared much less crowded than the other store does on a Sunday morning around 10 o'clock.

Ordered takeout from here a few weeks ago on a Saturday night.   Lots of takeout fleeing out the door while there was one set of outdoor diners. 

Food here was very good and I would order from here again but somehow I remember the food from the Malvern location a few years ago being somewhat better.   I usually end up with enchiladas- Other dining partners with soft tacos and quesadillas.  

Nothing unexpected on the menu.  

I would warn anyone ordering from here that the storefront is not visible from Lancaster Ave.   it shares the location with Rita's water ice.   Go down the side street and El Limon faces the side street.

I haven't been to a nicos in a very long time, ( 15+ years) went there last week pretty late at night, not too many places open late night here in town, ordered a Machaca burrito, it had a good portion of Machaca and vegies mixed with eggs, it was very tasty.  Had the cravings again today and drove across town to get another Machaca burrito even tho there was one closer to where I live. This time I was very disappointed with the ratio of machaca to vegies to eggs. It was like 96% eggs to machaca compare to last time 75% eggs to machaca.  It's like biting into an egg burrito. ( YUCK!!!) Don't think I'll go to any more nicos..

I would go back, however I felt the pricing was as bit steep and my BIGGEST pet peeve were the windows. They did a shitty, shitty job. I am terrible at windows and they did worse than me. They used the same dirty rag on both front and back windows, now they are streaky and cloudy...I am pissed I spent $12.99 (without tax) on this wash and now I have to do my windows over. UGH...I hate that!! But don't get me wrong the rest of the car was done very well and I was very impressed by that, but I will mention the windows next time and make sure they use CLEAN rags. If they do that, I will up my next rating...

This Holiday Inn Express exceeded my expectations. I stayed for a week while on a business trip. The employees are very kind, the breakfast was satisfactory, it is clean and the building is aesthetically appealing (interior and exterior). The main thing that could be better are the beds. At first it didn't bother me but after a couple of nights it did. The sheets are not soft and the bed has really hurt my back. Also, the wifi is terrible. I have never witnessed such terrible wifi in a hotel. Getting on was a whole process in itself. Once on, loading things constantly took forever. This was on my phone and computer. This was frustrating.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I've recently decided that kampai is my favorite sushi restaurant in St. Louis. I eat sushi pretty frequently (we're talking at least once a week) and kampai perfectly balances quality fish, good menu selection, continence, and price point. I order take out from here very often and have always had great experiences and they also have a great restaurant atmosphere for dine in! I'm a big fan of their rolls and nigiri. Fried rice is also a very frequent side of mine. 

I just recently learned they have an omakase option which I can't wait to try soon!

Well, let me say, I am one of the bartenders here. So, the bartenders are amazing! Seriously though, this place is great. The ambience is very Cubanesque, the drinks and the options, especially on bourbons and scotches, are awesome, and the cigar selection, though small, is good for smokers of all styles. With a full menu from The Northside Social this is definitely a place I would enjoy coming to, even if I didn't work here. 
With an array of jazz, blues, and big band music playing every night, it's a place to sit back and relax and enjoy a drink and cigar. Even if you don't smoke, it's still a comfortable and relaxing place.

This is by far one of the worst pizzas I have ever had. I ordered a margherita pizza and received flavorless, cardboard consistency dough with very meager cheese and extremely uneven SHAKER basil. The sauce tasted like it was from a jar. Others I was with also ordered pizza with different toppings and had similar complaints. Also, their website doesn't list the different sizes and the prices that go along with them, nor did the girl let me know my total over the phone when I was finished ordering. I won't be returning.

My first visit to Penn Pizza Palace was sub-par at best. The crust was flavorless, there wasn't much cheese or sauce and shaker basil was used for the Margherita pizza.

BUT...

I gave them another chance, and had a completely different experience. The second time around it seemed that they paid close attention to detail. I also ordered the buffalo chicken pizza, which I highly recommend. The service and product here are great. However, they need to make sure they are more consistent (see attached pictures).

I would definitely recommend this place if you're local and want great service and good pizza.

I made the mistake of going on Good Friday around 2pm.  I wanted a hot meal from the deli.  After getting my food, I stood at the cashier for 5 minutes waiting for the 2 cashiers to finish their conversation.  When a young man came up, they stopped and one came over and insisted on checking him out before me.  He was courteous enough to let me go first, since I was already there, but  I didn't trust the cashier at that point.  I decided it was best to go to another cashier, and then decided not to get the food, anyway.  I decided to leave it like so many other people who get disgusted by the poor service or lack of service these days.

This is my favorite place that I love to hate. I only go here cause I am a starbucks phene, and I get a consistent flow of gift cards and the Barnes and Noble does not accept Starbucks gift cards. The staff for the most part is RUDE RUDE RUDE. I have to ask a zillion times for my cup to be filled more, they always roll their eyes at me when I hand them my refillable cup, sorry my dad bought me a refillable coup and a giftcard, I'm a broke college student who needs caffiene. It is in a pretty convenient location on campus so thats why I keep returning.

I've taken my 4 year old dog there since she was 4 months old and have never had a concern with her care. I found the vets to be caring and gentle each visit.  In fact I board her there when I'm out of town as I trust them with her. That being said she has not had major health issues that I've been faced with so I cannot comment on that aspect. The front end staff also is friendly and helpful.. In person. The only complaint I have, and why I give it this rating is their phone presence is less than desirable. I have felt rushed when asking questions, have been hung up on and been made to wait long periods.

Just your average Chinese food place. I ordered delivery through a third party on grub hub. Food estimate was 50 minutes and it came in 25 minutes instead. Prices were reasonable and food was hot and fresh. Pork fried rice was excellent but Chicken with Broccoli had a different taste. Not awful, I ate it, but I did not save the rest for left overs. Wonton soup wasn't bad, but Crab Rangoon was lacking filling and the dough seemed under cooked / under fried. I would not rule this place out, but I would probably order something different from here next time- if I didn't just someplace different all together.

This particular Subway always has young people working, and that's because many students nearby go to CFHS and are looking for a high-school job to make a little extra. Or more likely, because their parents want them to learn how to work. 

It is located in the shopping center that houses Bashas, and is the only chain among several little locally owned restaurants. It is a little smaller than other Subways. Parking is not as easy, but this Subway will in the end by your standard QSR experience. Nothing stood as anything past average, but nothing below either.

This is one of the busiest Publix in the area. It is always well-stocked. The staff is very helpful and always willing to go the extra mile for your convenience. The bakery and deli always have additional staff to ensure the line moves swiftly. Publix baggers continue ro offer assistance to your car.

The store always has buy one get one free options. There is an abundance of wine and beer options. The produce is always fresh and there is a large variety. For vegans there are refrigerated and frozen products. There are also fresh seafood selections and a sushi bar. This is a nice place to shop but be prepared for the crowd.

This was a beautiful, spacious event venue. There was plenty of parking and an option for front door drop off. The banquet room was clean and the tables were well set. The sound system was amazing. And the overall ambience was very nice.

Our host chose a Caribbean themed lunch buffet. The buffet was bright and colorful and included the following options: fish with a Caribbean sauce, grilled chicken with pineapple salsa, Caribbean rice with vegetables, spring mix salad, fruit salad, plantains, and key lime pie for dessert. All items had a nice fresh taste, however, salt was the missing ingredient and the reason for my 4 stars instead of 5.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Friendly staff & decent equipment but this gym is way too small for the area. Peak hours and you will have to wait in lines to use anything. Non-peak hours it's still pretty busy and since there is not enough equipment, a lot of time is wasted waiting to work out. I don't know about y'all, but waiting kills my workout. Very cramped free-weights area too. Loved the small monthly fee and when I lived in Clearwater, that you fit  gym was awesome for my needs (and bigger, even in a smaller city) but this location is a waste of time!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I also feel goofy reviewing a pizza place.  But just had to share my experience last night.  Had a 50% off coupon on a large pizza.  So we decided to order a large pizza with spicy italian sausage, pepperoni and half with bacon.  I picked up the pizza and everything looked okay.  By the time I got home, sat down and actually ate a slice...I quickly realized that there was literally only 2 slices with bacon on it.  Felt kinda gypped.   My girlfriend prefer PJ to Dominoes...and I'm the opposite.  Another strike P Johns....

My Fiance knows I love my coffee. So while we were out and about he took me to a spot he "thought" I may like. Well, he was.......RIGHT! The coffee was SO good, I only add a little half and half in my decaf iced coffee. After my first sip I asked the guy behind the counter, why it tasted so good lol. He was knowledgable and explained it to me very well. My fiance and I could have sat inside but I love being outside, it's not much of a view ( an abondoned building across the street) but I still kinda liked the ambiance of it all. I'm definitely a fan!

So so. It used to be one of the best sports bars in town, but it's been surpassed by other sports bars in the past decade. It's not a good place to watch a game. The TV's are oddly positioned. The food is OK. The prices are high (especially for beer). The service is not good. The bartender that served me seemed like she would rather be doing anything than working that day. She was not friendly or attentive. It is fun to sit outside in their expansive patio when the weather is warm. Wednesday nights are fun in the summer.

This place used to be great. I would go at least once a week for lunch since my office is right down the street. Today will be my last time. I have watched the prices go up and up and the food go down. It takes way longer then it used to as well. It seems that it is under new management, my guess would be sold and now there cutting corners. Sad was a great place. Today i went and i think they served me beef stew dog food in my chimichanga and it was soggy again. Gross. My wife got a burrito it was dry and nasty but they covered it in watery cheese so u might not tell.

Zama is a sushi restaurant in Center City, right in the heart of the Rittenhouse Square district.

We stopped in here last night on the recommendation from a friend. Very happy with the freshness of the Sushi ingredients. The Sushi chefs made everything right in front of us, and you just can't get better than that.

They have a Sushi bar too, or you can order off the menu, which we did. I thought the prices were reasonable, considering I love sushi and I'll pay more for better food anytime.

Very glad we went here: The food was good, service was good - I would recommend you try it yourself.

A little pricy for the location, but definitely worth it. The bar selection would give any hipster an orgasm. Seriously. Locally distilled vodkas and craft beer. Although the bartenders were not that friendly-- scowls and all-- the drinks were good so I can't complain about bitchy bartenders too much. The steaks are great. The service tonight was PHENOMENAL. Kaitlyn Jarvis was knowledgable, yet not annoying. Perfect. The only reason this place didn't get five stars.... Corner booth with zero lighting. I had to use my cell phone flashlight to see the menu.. I'm 23--not blind, just really dark. Will definitely return and suggest to friends.

I keep trying to give this place another chance, Why? I have no idea.  Over the past 15 years I have had so many disagreements.  They don't get out stains, they charge me more than  they agreed to, temporarily misplace my clothes,  etc.  It is such a shame because it is so convenient and they is always a parking space right in front or around the corner.  After not going in there for 3+ years I brought in a shirt I just needed ironed for a trip and wondered if I could get it back in a few hours.  They rudely said NO WAY, it would be three days.  Insanity.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
This was a bit of a let down. Next time I am in Ybor I am going to look for a Cuban place.

I got the Fusilli Sicilia, which is fusilli pasta with Italian sausage and veal meatballs. The pasta was al dente, just how I like it, the sausage didn't add anything to the dish, and the meatballs were amazingly good, but I only had 2 small meatballs. With a meatball dish I am usually expecting 3-4.

We were there for lunch, and more than half the menu, were pizzas and sandwiches. So as Italian places go, it was inexpecisive.

It's great if you like living in a military prison, where the employees patrol all day long, looking for things that their inmates are doing wrong. Over priced also, I WILL NOT BE RENEWING MY LEASE!

They always put new, cheap carpet in apartments of people who move out after 1 year (majority of tenants) so you cannot get your security deposit back. After 6 months my carpet is totally shot.

Also they don't allow you to pay your rent online, and is due on the 1st. One day late? $50 late fee. The only good thing is when something breaks they come the day you call and fix it.

I'm not a Starbucks fan, but sometimes it just can't be avoided. Had to be on this side of town and was meeting an ex-coworker for coffee to catch up, so Starbucks was convenient. Its not a very comfortable Starbucks as the seating is kind of on top of one another, but the shop was clean.

The service was polite and quick.

The coffee was just meh. I've become addicted to the Cafe con leches in Miami. Ask one of the "baristas" (said in my most sarcastic tone) at Starbucks for a cafe con leche and you'll get a blank stare. I ordered a Caffe Latte as that is the closest they have, but still just meh.

I'm happy to see a moderately priced Italian restaurant as an option in Bala Cynwyd.  

Atmosphere-wise, Franco's seems to be tyring for upscale with white tablecloths, but the decor is a little lacking.  The space has housed several restaurants before and the redo looks cheap. Chairs were a bit old and uncomfortable.  

Service was prompt and friendly.  Wine by the glass was reasonble at under $7 per glass.

As far as the food, it was good to very good.  Especially enjoyed the caesar salad and clam pasta. Will be back to try other tiems on the menu.

This place has been here forever under different names. It has morphed from a bare bones type luncheonette to a cozy American cafe atmosphere, the menu has a wide selection and the food is reliably good. Came here recently for lunch with a friend, the ambiance was quiet and good for talking, the turkey club sandwich was a standout, fresh cooked turkey, crispy bacon, and fresh lettuce tomato on toast. To me, its one of the best all american sandwiches ever, and they did a good job with it. My lunch companion had the greek wrap which she liked as well. Our plates were clean at the end of lunch.

BEST HAIRCUT/STYLE in such a long time!  I chose this salon based on Yelp reviews, & I wanted to check it out for myself.  I've received so many bad expensive hair cuts, so I figured, worst case, I would just add 1 more to my list.  I am so pleased to say I am SUPER happy with my do!  Billy was amazing!  Best $90 I've spent on my hair!  I have really long, thick hair, & stylists typically go overboard trying to "thin it out to lessen the weight," and I'm never happy.  He totally "got" what I wanted my style to be!  So happy!  I found MY salon finally!

Ordered seafood udon thinking maybe it would be shrimp, squid, and/ fish with it. Well it was fish only n the fish tasted fishy I couldn't take it in and the udon didn't have enough seasoning. Our waitress kept disappearing for a long time. Bake salmon was good as usual. Shrimp and veggie tempura comes with only a shrimp taste like anywhere else. Squid steak a bit chewy. Beef with asparagus was good. Had sashimi and asked for fresh wasabi, waitress had no idea what it is. I personally believe every sushi restaurant should have fresh wasabi it's makes a world of difference from the powder wasabi.

When your new car gets dirty from the winter sludge, it's time for a wash! I haven't been to a car wash in awhile because I have always hand washed my car. I heard great things about Crew so decided to try it. Overall the quality of the wash was good, but the staff was average. They didn't explain anything and was yelling and tapping on my window because I didn't hear what he said when he said neutral and made me feel bad about it when I couldn't even hear what he said. Overall though the wash was quick and did a good job, just know what to do when or you might get yelled at.

So after months of hearing about this place I finally was able to try it out and it is fantastic! I am not a huge fan of buffets because I never know how old the food it however this place has solved that issue but just allowing you to order what ever you would like for 1 price and the quality was great! I had NY strip and shrimp as well as 3 delicious sushi rolls for under $20. You really can not beat that. I can not wait to go back. I would have given 5 stars if the service was a little better but again for the price and the quality this place is a must. I'll never go to Kobe again now that I know this place exist.

If it was only the ice cream, it would probably only be three stars. I am very picky with my ice cream and I only want the best. This was good, but not the best. So why 4 stars? Jeni's was an immaculate spectacle of an ice cream shop. It was a pleasant experience. 

What I ordered: we got the ice cream flight. It come with a scoop of 3 different flavors. I cannot remember the other flavors, but I loved the almond butter crunch (I believe that was the name of it).

Overall it was good, but not my favorite ice cream ever.

It is a hit or a miss and it has a lot to do with who you get.  Yes they do offer a wide variety of service but they position themselves int he market as above the rest and it is not really. If you are lucky to get a good technician you may get lucky, but other wise overpriced and making appointments and trying to walk in forget about it. I use to go there more often but my experience last few times has been really poor. Out of three times 2 times would be a miss and 1 a hit. Who has time for that? I just don't mind to pay more, I want consistent good service.

Pictures and lobby are very deceiving!! 
Stayed here for one night & one night only. As soon as we opened our room door we regretted our decision to stay here. If it hadn't been so late I would've looked elsewhere. The lobby seems to be the only nice up-to-date part of this hotel. Our room was small, dingy, and smelled like stale cigarette smoke (promised & labeled a non-smoking room). There were a couple of mysterious wet spots on the floor surrounding the bed. We tried entertaining ourselves with the tv to find that only two or three channels came through. 

Could not have been more excited to check out of this hotel- would not recommend!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Ordered from here online tonight for carryout with a Lightning 50% off code. Order was ready within 15 minutes as promised and completely accurate. The gentleman at the counter was super friendly and the staff members were as well. The parking lot is a little crunchy to get into off of Hillsborough and right off of I-275 but there are two entrance ramps. Leaving is a little harder because if you want to head east or back to the highway, you'll need to make a U-turn at the nearest light. They seem to do good business and I could see why.

This place has an amazing selection of local and national draft beers!! A lively scene and live music on the weekend. I've been here a couple of times and have never had bad service. Beers are around $6 per pint and food is also available. Sliders, random appetizers. The staff is attentive and knows their beers.

Atmosphere is chill. Plenty of bar seating and tables for groups. Outdoor seating is also plentiful so you can bring your puppies if you'd like. There isn't a parking lot so you'll need to find street parking nearby. I would definitely recommend this bar to craft beer lovers...it will not be a disappointment!

Ok My wife and I love Pizza Delicious, but I was very disrespected when the Blonde Cashier with tons of makeup didn't hand my credit to  me. I placed my credit card in her hand to pay my bill, but she placed it on the table and wouldn't even attempt to put place it back in my hand. I had to mention to her and she just brushed it off.  I've visited this Pizza Delicious on many occasions and the pizza is exceptional. This is not a knock on the product, but the customer service was horrible. I really hope this problem is solved so other customers don't experience it. Thanks.. Larry Jr.

Was super excited to go to this restaurant only to be completely surprised that the menu had almost completely changed since the last time we were there. The waiter was generally awkward and unfriendly. They no longer bring out bread before the meal.  We ordered the burrata and it also did not come with bread.  The person who came around to fill the water was not courteous of us at all, she spilled some and poured ferociously  which led to us being splashed slightly.  

The main courses Agnolotti & Strozzapreti were great.

My family and I love Sushi 7. It's the closest to our house and the rolls are consistently delicious. I also like that they have a punch card and a cheaper all you can eat price for kids. We don't go to sushi a lot but when we do its a pretty big expense with our family of 5. The only complaint I have is the light in the restaurant is so dark when you wAlk outside you feel like your blinded. Also the bathrooms are very dark, if you don't have great vision you could easily not see spilled water near the sink and slip.

When you forget to call ahead for a take out order this is the place to go. Fast service and food is still hot by the time I get home.  I like the fact that they do it in the three-step process. Pick your rice either brown or white or Noodles, pick what meatyou want to add and then pick your veggies. It's almost like a build your own.  So while at most places you can't order shrimp with broccoli, or tofu with cashews, you can do that here.

 They do have a dine in option was several tables available if you preferred to stay there. I have done that in the past but tend to use them more as a takeout option

Interesting concept for a drive thru... Look at the board and then drive up yo the window and order in person. Slowest service ever since there was ONE car in front of us. We ordered an Oreo blizzard type of item and a banana split. 

Was expecting the Oreos to be present in a chunky format. Instead it looked like they were a cookie powder dispersed evenly throughout the mix. The banana split only had 2 banana pieces in it and we had to hunt for them. It was called a banana split right?  Unfortunately for them, there are a few better options very close by that have better service and banana splits that contain a split banana.

Fabulous service. I applied for a construction loan with this firm. From day one they were courteous and very honest with me regarding expectations and how the process would evolve. They updated me at least weekly as to the progress of the application. They covered the costs of 2 appraisals and included that in the closing costs. They didn't even waste time with the appraisals until I was approved for the loan.  They said the loan would close 45-90 days after the application and they met that expectation closing right at 90 days. I'm looking forward to growing my relationship with this institution.

I ordered thru Ubereats which was a bad idea. Order came an hour and a half after i ordered it so yes ot was cold. I live 10 min away.and most pizza spots keep their pizzas on top of the oven to keep them warm. I ordered the Pomadoro, regular cheese and goat cheese and bacon. The Pomadoro was delicious.  Will definitely order again. The cheese was good but it was for a 4yr old and the crust was completely burnt. The goat cheese and bacon was just ok. What totally pissed me off was the sloppiness of the way they cut my pizzas.  There were big cuts and tiny baby cuts. please take pride in your work...

I have been coming here for years. Close to 6 years, to be exact. I just returned for my regular cut and realized that Sandy, Mei and the other hairdressers were all gone. The owner is still there but all new hairdressers. I was disappointed with my haircut and went with a friend, that was also unhappy with her cut because it was uneven!

My cut was unoriginal and not what I asked for, a traditional boring cut, to be quite honest. It has been a few weeks and I have decided that I will not be going back and will need to find another place as my go-to. It's unfortunate.

Online order, 3 enchiladas with green sauce, rice and beans. The chicken in the enchiladas was flavorful and filling, and the beans and rice were both tasty. While I ordered green sauce, there was barely any sauce on the dish, instead just a GIANT plop of sour cream, which kinda took away from the flavor. Couldn't even find the green sauce for the first half of my bites. Fitting in the platter, the rice and beans portion was pretty small too, also covered in sour cream. No frills, but had late delivery so I was bound to try it at some point.

It has been reported to me at several other locations, the DD Chocolate Chip Muffin was taken off of the menu. I was heartbroken, not sure where I would find a quick breakfast in the earliest of mornings when a donut is too sweet but a bagel is too bland. Alas, I have found a consistent chocolate chip muffin at this location! There are always multiple on the shelf and I've never had the disappointing experience of leaving empty handed. This location is always a bit unorganized and the common area a little iffy, but where I find a muffin, I find a way to overlook small issues like that!

Hellooooo.... renovation!! I walked into this location last week after taking a break from my expensive Starbucks habit. When did the interior change? I love it! It feels more open and airy. Very woodsy feeling too.

I try to avoid this Starbucks before 8am and during the lunch hour, because it is always waaaaaayyy busy. If you use the order ahead function on your Starbucks app - that helps immensely. 

So why the three stars? They always, always run out of food items like the protein boxes. Just keep more in stock, m'kay?

I stayed here for free as part of a BlueGreen Vacations package that I won. Their breakfast changes daily and the breakfast pizza was the best! They also have a complimentary dinner 5:30-7:30 on certain days with a menu on the fridge (or from front desk if yours is missing like ours was). I got to try the mini sandwiches they had for one evening and they were the bomb. 

The staff was very friendly and I felt like it was a place I'd want to return to but wouldn't be sure I could afford. It stood out and is one of my favorite chains to stay at now so I will definitely have to look for them where I travel to next!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Ordered some take-out from here since I didn't like what I got for dinner. They said it would be no more than 45 minutes and it felt like they got here pretty quickly. I was quite pleased. A bit of a charge for delivery- but then again it's always expensive to get something delivered. 

I got some hummus and a gyro. The gyro meat is cut thicker than I'm used to and it seemed greasier than usual but otherwise it was tasty. The hummus was just meh but it was plain hummus and that just doesn't do it for me usually. I liked the olives they put in the top but nah I'll just skip that next time. 

Liked: 
- Gyro

Disliked
- Hummus

Very cozy atmosphere with a warm welcome.

Service was terrific.  Everything came out well timed.

BYOB.... but they partner with a winery so you can purchase wine there.

They have specials each evening.  For example
On Fridays if out take a selfie and post on their Facebook wall you receive $5 off. 

- Stuffed long hots were not my favorite.  Not terribly flavorful.
-Mussels in red were pretty standard.  
-Seafood risotto was very good.
-Shrimp Tortellini was good
-Brownie Sundae was delicious topped with gelato


Definitely a must try

I found Derf's because I live close by. I love their set up on the corner or Mission and De La Vina. They have indoor and outdoor seating and it is my go to place when I am looking to have a drink with a friend casually. My boyfriend loves their chicken strips that they'll put in Buffalo sauce if you request. I think their wraps are great and they also have very tasty fish and chips. They are not exactly the "healthiest" place to eat, but it's mostly comfort food. Their potato skins are super yummy too! All of the service is wonderful. Every time I go in I have a wonderful experience with the staff. Great place overall!

Very strange interaction at this Chase branch. This particular branch does not accept deposits at the counter. Both the teller and the branch manager told me I would have to put my deposits in the night drop box and refused to take them at the window. 

This is an inconvenient policy that requires me to make an extra trip to the bank to retrieve the deposit receipt and is not in the best interest of the business I represent. Also when I asked why they have this policy at this branch all the people there act like it's a company wide policy which is absurd.

This is a great laundry. There is somebody on site from 8a-7p 7 days a week if you have questions or need help. All laundry soap etc are sold onsite and there are 2 big change machines that will change up to a 20 dollar bill. I had 2 king size comforters and other bedding to wash so I opted for both 'big Bertha' machines. There is an assortment of machine sizes and everything is well marked.  You can also have your laundry done for you if needed including comforters.  Not great seating but doesn't really matter unless it's packed.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I had a gift certificate from last Christmas I had to use so we dropped off my car. When I got it back home the headlights and hood still had dirt on it. No big deal I can clean that when I set up a heater in my garage to finish the job. The console was still dirty with dust and make up from lipstick but I can clean that myself. Then I will turn the car around and back it in and vacuum out the back of the Jeep that still has sand in from the summer. I will lug my heavy vacuum cleaner out as far as I can reach and finish that job. Otherwise it was okay. I guess you get what you pay for. 89.00 grand slam thank you ma'am.

This is a wonderful local ice-cream shop with sooo many flavors, some of which are rotating! A couple seasonal favorites of mine are the Green Tea and the King Cake, but I also love the Cookie Monster and the Lavender which are always there! I only wish their ice-creams had some more chunks in them, and that they'd offer some nuts as a topping option (I thought it was odd they had none!) Overall it's good ice-cream and worth checking out, their root bear float was mentioned on Diners Drive-Ins and Dives! Also make sure you bring cash, it's cash only!!

You go to the Landing for the location and the views.you know that going in. Got wings and ordered them well done. "Well done" means nothing, you get the same wings as everybody else. The so-called "buffalo" wings had just about zero buffalo flavor or sauce. And you get a dollop of blue cheese which is enough for about 5 of your wings. Also got fish tacos. It's talapia. Fish harvested from the Ganges or some other small pond in Asia where they feed dog food and pig shit to an overpopulated gaggle of diseased fish. The only thing that saved us at the Landing was a handsome blond busser who tended all our culinary needs

From the front area workers to the mechanics, I really enjoy the service they provide for my Kia Sportage. I had a broken bolt around the wheel area. They sent a driver out to pick one up and replace it for me with no charge. I get my oil, engine maintenance, tires, and brakes done there. They will work with you if you give them the same respect they give you. It's hard to find a trusted mechanic. I trust these guys. When I trust a place I drop off a treat for them to enjoy. One day I dropped off donuts and the guy up from was so happy. That made me feel good. I will return for more work. Soon headlights and a battery.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
This is probably one of the best diners! 
I went there with my dad and he chose it! We both really enjoyed it! The turkey balls were great it came with a cranberry sauce and they were delicious together!
The bathrooms were pretty gross! You went in there was one doorway, and one stall with no lock! There was a game room too with candy, you play until you win! There were a lot of video games too it is perfect for kids! The bar was nice too! There was even someone singing while we were eating! Overall this place was great!

Love this shop! It is reasonably priced, in the neighborhood, and they do a great job! My husband and son are both regulars. My son was not an easy customer when he first started going at 3 or 4 years old but Paul and Sal were patient with him and willing to handle the tantrums as we got his haircut. They told us not to worry and to keep bringing him and that he would be OK. Now he loves stopping in to say Hi to Mr. Sal and Mr. Paul. My husband has walked in and had a trim with almost all the barbers and has never had a complaint.

Fantastic food, great atmosphere and happy servers are what you will find at at Sidelines Grill in Ashland City! The burgers are great and cooked to perfection. My favorites meal is the smothered chicken breast with a side of squash casserole! The chicken is tender and juicy with the mushrooms and swiss cheese. The squash casserole is tasty and is a classic southern side. The atmosphere is nice and I like the tables and decor on the walls. The decor is like a sports bar but it is also classy. The serves are all happy and they all seem to have that southern hospitality.

Las Maracas, is a phenomenal Mexican restaurant!! The food is awesome and super cheap, and the portions are quite large. They make fantastic margaritas and they often have amazing drink specials. Las Maracas, isn't your typical Mexican restaurant. They really set themselves apart from everyone else! The salsa is just right as it isn't too spicy and they load you up with their salsa. The chimichangas is my favorite meal Las Maracas, because the chicken is juicy and not dry. The rice is authentic tasting. The servers are excellent and they are attentive all while having a sense of humor with their customers!

I can 't say anything bad about this place.... They have remodeled it and it no longer has the feel of a truck stop... When you walk in it now appears like a diner... They do have a full buffet for breakfast, lunch, diner and late night... The hot section of the buffet does shutdown around midnight...  As well as a huge menu that has diner food coming out hot from the kitchen... They are open 24 hours 7 days a week... The staff is always friendly and very helpful... 

My last visit my wife and I had the soup and salad buffet...

Great new place for the Wesley Chapel diners. It's a concept from the Texas roadhouse group, Bubba's 33 is known for its pizza, burgers and beer. They have weekly specials, Monday madness with $7.99 burgers, Tuesday pizza night, 12 inch pizza for $9.99. We had one pizza, the Margherita which was very fresh and tasty and a burger which was juicy and delicious. There are lots of televisions around so it's a good place to kick back and watch a game. They have a large dining room and a separate bar. Definitely a relaxed vibe. They have plenty of parking available in the parking lot as well.

generic Starbucks.

In Tampa across from hotel & office location.

Coffee was excellent.

Very good selection of non-coffee goods and foods.  Wifi - noted a large number of persons having coffee & plugged in to their notebooks/laptops.

Comfortable seating although i, as is my want, ordered take out. 

The coffee here was very good.  I'm not usually a huge fan of Starbucks coffee but the coffee i got here was excellent.  

Service was professional, prompt, kind, good humored and most courteous.

Recommended.

The food is delicious but unfortunately the service was horrible.  Our first time here was a great experience however our most recent visit today ensures that we will never return. When we sat down the menus were tossed to us followed by " what do you want to drink" no hi hello how are you today my name is... We were not offered water. We were brought the bill without asking for it first as if we weren't welcome. The other patrons asked for their bills before they were given to them. We will never spend our money here again.

new spot for lunch near work and i just realized that they're across the street from my pup's vet! woo hoo! anyways, their salads are pretty big and prices are decent for rittenhouse. they have salads, sandwiches and a deli you can order food to-go. they also sell chips, cookies, sugar, beverages and a bunch of other stuff. i've been here three times since discovering it and everybody's been friendly. it's also really clean. i always order their chicken thai salad but will def be trying out some of the other items on their menu.

I had given this place 2 trys. First time I went it took literally 20 mins to get a drink order in then another 10 for the drink to arrive. After arriving the waitress left and said she'll be back but didn't return until I flagged her down about 15 mins later. I ordered a bento and 2 specialty rolls but waited another 20 mins still nothing so I got up and left. Second I went I tried the chicken katsu, spicy tuna, and Delicious roll. The Katsu was really good but it took way too long. Tuna was average and the specialty roll was good. Sushi is mediocre but SERVICE was horrible. Will be back once they hire more experience staff!!!

This location is in the Levittown Towne Center ( real name, no joke ) within the Wal-Mart Supercenter. I am confused about this because the seating area can only seat 40 people, heck the store is over 100,000 square feet so more than that is on one asle at any given time. While they do try to deliver a quality product some how my sandwich was just mushy and some parts tasted odd which had the remaining 2-3rds end up in thr rubbish. Did they have an off day ?  Was a supply truck overdue ?  I don't know but i expected better. It is the cleanest location i ever saw though...

Went in for a pedicure and paid $25 +$5 for the callus remover. Seemed cleaned and the tech was super friendly. I wasn't that satisfied for the experience because the color selection was poor and the massage chair was the weakest chair I've ever used.  I was distracted with my magazine (they did have a good selection of mags) and after walking out, noticed how the nail polish on a few toes either didn't cover the whole bed or the nail polish was on my skin. Also, she didn't file the corners of my nails well and they were sharp (ouch!) if they had more nail polish colors I'd go again and just go to a different tech but I probably won't go back.

It's in the area and typically has the basics you'd need - nothing unique or special.  I can get by all of that but yesterday the young woman working the register was down right rude.

Could she have said "Can I see your ID?"  but she barked "ID".
Could she have said "Are you paying with card or cash?" but she barked "Card or Cash?"
Could she have handed me a pen for my signature instead of just dropping it in front of my outstretched hand?  I think so...

Rude enough that I won't be back unless it's absolutely necessary.

This place has the worst customer service of any restaurant I've been. We ordered through Eat24. The order was late and then it was wrong. They told us to come back to their store and get our correct order (the purpose of eat24 is to avoid coming to restaurant). When we get there, they straight up say "this is your fault". At this point, you would think they'd have some decency left to them. Then they tell us they are charging us more money since the rolls were incorrect! 
By the time it was settled and we got home- our sushi was cold, fishy and hard. I will never eat here again and I will never recommend this terrible place. Good riddens

My Mom and I were in the area and were thirsty. Since Dunkin' is our go-to, we searched in our GPS for the nearest Dunkin' and came across this location. There was no one in line (which I thought was kind of weird) but it was also 5:30 PM at night, so that is understandable. The workers seemed a little confused (we had to repeat our order to them and they asked us if we wanted whipped cream on our iced coffees which usually whipped cream only goes on iced lattes). They were still nice though. The drink was okay, we asked for caramel mocha and I tasted 95% mocha, but it still tasted fine.

There are so many great things about the custard stand- but one of my absolute favorite things is that it is open all year round. Whenever you are in the mood for ice cream, even if there is snow on the ground, this place is open. 

I love everything here and my go-to is always a flurry with oreos. It's a little bit big, but it is worth every bite. The prices are reasonable and the employees are always really friendly. 

The only annoying thing about this place is that it is cash only. However, there is an ATM right next to it.

Cute little restaurant. .. sending for about 60 ppl
Very friendly staff ... good food !  Hubby ordered a sausage and pepper hot sandwich  
I ordered the steak and cheese with the works
Hubby loved his ... gave it a 5 out of 5 ... right amount of sauce and meat. Large bun which was toasted to perfection. He kept saying that it was yummy!
Mine was also very good ... lots of meat and veggies, toasted but not too hard... The only little prob that I had was that I asked for mustard but they didn't have any. 
Sandwiches were so big that we could only eat half so we brought the other half home ... we are going the switch 
A must try !!

I was truly looking forward to a five guys juicy burger made the way i like it.

What i got was an overcooked dry pair of burger patties with overcooked dry bacon.

i asked for it to not be so well done amd i like them juicy ahead of time, but the cook just couldn't stop mashing down on the burger, squeezing out every bit of flavor with each torturous press.  Maybe he was mad or having a bad day and was taking his anger out on the burgers,  maybe he likes overcooked flavorless dry burgers, i dont know.  I do know this was a first for five guys and me...

My friends and I went here as the other place we wanted to go to was closed on Monday nights.  I really questioned this place as we walked in.  It looks like it belongs on Bourbon Street.  Someone said the door was open, and yes it was.  It's right off of Canal which also makes it questionable in my mind.  The sushi was OK--I wonder how fresh the fish was though?  As far as I know, no one got sick, but I really did wonder about the fish.  I won't put this on my list of places to return to when I return to New Orleans.

Our group of 6 wanted to try this new place considering we have tried every sushi joint in Reno. 

The fish was alright, mixture between fresh and not. Of course a group of us, we are definitely going to order everything so nigiri was alright, the rolls are definitely different. When we got our unagi, it was pretty cold and weird taste to it. 

We can also hear them microwave a few stuff in the back but nothing majorly against that. 

Overall, a good place to go in the Vista and Sparks area. This place is better than sushi time for sure.

The food is excellent, but I am having a hard time with a couple of things that prevent me from giving a five star rating. First, the chips and salsa come at a cost. That wouldn't be a big deal, but the salsa is mediocre at best. Second, the adult beverage prices are way too high. The pozole was very good and came with two bean tostadas that were also good. The server was attentive and the atmosphere is nice. It's a good change of pace from the other local chain type Mexican restaurants, but it will cost you a bit more than most.

I ordered the burger sliders, which come 3 to an order. You can get them dressed however you like. The lettuce is fresh iceberg. The buns were fresh, but aren't toasted. They would be so much better toasted. The burgers were good, although there was a bit too much black grill char on one. The burger wasn't burnt, I just think the grill needed cleaning. I also got a side of potato salad, which is homemade. It is good, and has a kick to it. However, $4 for an ice cream scoop of potato salad is a bit much. The service was fine. The a/c works great! Definitely a neighborhood place where everyone knows everyone. Parking might be an issue.

The Dalian isn't really a pet friendly community. Their list of breed restrictions for dogs is 3 pages long. Also, although they have ample green space in the community, dogs are not permitted in any outdoor common areas. My 45 lb Border Collie/Shepherd mix and was turned down as I was about to submit an application. It turned out well for me as I found 2 other more welcoming buildings downtown that have Dog Parks in the building and no breed restrictions. The Dalian is a great community, but they should just post their book of pet restrictions on their sight to avoid wasting dog owners' time.

Slowest! Drive Thru! Ever!  Last evening around 8:45 after hitting the beach we wanted to grab 3 milkshakes (2 vanilla and 1 strawberry) and it took 14 minutes from the time we ordered to the time we received our shakes!  They didn't tell us why until they handed us our shakes - they had to refill the strawberry syrup. If they would have informed us earlier we would have just ordered all vanilla. The worst part is they made the 2 vanilla when we ordered so they were melted when we got them. I've used this drive thru before and they are always slow but an acceptable level of "slow". I'm sure during the lunch rush they are fine.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I don't know why we haven't come here before. We came here yesterday for dinner and I LOVED it. I wanted to order everything off the menu because everything looked so good. We ordered this boat that had an array of nigiri, sushi and sashimi on it. It was so beautiful and I nearly cried. I really love the Brad Rolls and I was able to get my fill of salmon sashimi that I was craving all weekend. My first experience here has been good. I will continue to come as long as the service and food remains consistently good. So far, this is my third favorite place for Japanese food.

Dined here for lunch today and overall it was good but nothing to boast about. When I grade a restaurant I go by 5 things. Environment, Food quality, Presentation, Service and how the tea is. The environment was very nice pretty classy with mirrors all down one side of the restaurant. The food was ok, nothing wrong with it but I have had better. Presentation was nice. Service was good and the tea could have been better. We had the Penne Vodka and the Salmon Risotto both were pretty good but I have still had better. Tea was very bland and didn't taste like much. Again nothing was bad but it was just ok.

I was introduced to their pizza at a food truck event at Chaddsford winery. At the winery, my friend and I ordered the tomato pie; it was yummy! The sauce had minced garlic and basil, i believe. No cheese, but it was a tomato pie. The sauce itself, we agreed, was delicious. It was brick oven so the crust was thin and a small pie may not satisfy 1 person who is hungry. 

When i visit the location at Concord mall, i will request Motzerella cheese and update my review based on the location. The food truck rocked though.

Something about a very wide selection of local beers on tap housed in an old temple...

The Creation Café introduced me to the largest wedge salad (Manly Style) I have met to date.  Quote from my 11-year old: "If you put all the sections in a pie chart, they would add 400%!"  (Great, you are learning something in school, Honey!)  The crispness of the "pie chart" sections was well obscured by blue cheese and smaller ridges of pulled pork making the dish look a mini mountain range on a plate.

Pumpkin flavored brew definitely puts you into a fall spirit.  An Italian Kiss Gelato adds a different mood flavor...

Ever since the new management team came in, things have been running poorly. They eliminated Concierge's shifts, and added a keyless system that breaks down frequently. The hot tub in the pool area has never worked since our four years of staying there, always the same excuses. When we tried to exit our lease a month early, we provided options requesting they would work with us however they did not. The only plus side to living here is they do have events every so often such as happy hour and arts and crafts events. Utilities are not even included, I recommend you search for other options in the Cherry Hill area.

Went in with a group of about 12, and we were given a small private room, which was great. The food was delicious - I has the most delicious,perfectly cooked piece of roasted chicken I've ever eaten. Service was flawless. Atmosphere lovely. 

Based on that evening, our group has chosen to have a yearly event at their ballroom and it too has been terrific. The staff is wonderful and accommodating and the venue continues to be spotless and beautiful, the food is delicious and the event very reasonable in cost. Bravo, all around!

Based on the reviews I thought this was going to be a crummy place to eat but turns out it's actually just fine. My friend and I came here to split an entree (we were looking from a light meal) and it was pretty decent!
It was fairly empty and large it seemed like we were one of two or three tables that night so the service was good! The pasta was also freshly made which was pretty nice.
Despite everything, I don't know if I will be back however, the prices are a little on the steep side for the quantity of food you get. But for the location/ convenience it's pretty average.

I was forced to stop by as I was coming back from Antioch after a long day of working on the rental house I wanted to stop to get a bottle of wine to unwind at home. The selection is very limited, but I decided on something other then wine. The ladies in the store were as nice as anyone your ever meet. I have lived here for 20 years and this was probably my third time in this store. I appreciated the smiles and friendly service. I respect that they have been at the location for long time and seem to be catering to their clientele to stay open where other things around them have tanked.

The new location located of Charlotte Pike near downtown at the base of a new condo development Capitol View. I would never be able to do all my shopping at this location as it is very small and I will only use in a pinch. The location is geared to the on the go type downtown person, but a welcomed addition to those who live across the bridge in East Nashville. Parking is available under the garage at the back entrance which is well marked. The prices are high for the fresh fruits and veggies as well as just about everything else, but that is no real surprise. The selection will be limited, however something is way better then nothing.

I eat at Subway often, and the people who work there are amazing.      Jalapeno bread with roast beef, and spicy guac.........Or the Turkey bacon guac.........filled with veggies........I sit and read my Kindle Fire 7.   Some times I get a foot long...........to have for dinner,   What separates this Subway is the customer service.        Excellent customer service.       They take pride in the place, and it shows.           amazing place, and and amazing manager, and his name is Isaac.    Great sandwich maker, and very personable.

I visit various subways around town when I am looking for something a little lighter and healthier.    This sub way (in the Rita Ranch area) is pretty nice.  Yesterday I got a roast been sub, on the new tasty sunflower crunch bread!   I kept in simple with Swiss cheese and cucumbers....and of course jalapeños.    A bit of spicy mustard and salt/pepper to finish.
The staff was friendly, and patient....and quality of the food was good.  Oh, one more thing....the veggie area was well stocked and CLEAN.    Very important to me.    Nice Subway.

3.5 stars. Cute place with throwback, gravy-house vibes. Large portion pasta dishes or pizza are the mainstays. 

What's good

Well-paced meal, not rushed
Really good garlic bread
Pasta e fagioli soup tasted homemade 
Large portions
BYOB


What's not so good

All pasta was overcooked
Pasta drenched in sauces
Sauces were fine but too oily - taste slightly greasy and doesn't stick to noodles 
Service was fine but not especially friendly. Not rude though!

Feels like if they made small improvements to the way things are cooked, could be an amazing eatery.

Same as other reviewers. Had lunch here. Food is good, overpriced - but eating outside is nice there  

The problem: poor communication and slooooow service. Given table by hostess - drinks brought out and menu explained by someone else who said "your server will be right with you." 

What's the purpose of a hostess and two waiters? Anyway. They forgot about us. Had to remind them despite the fact we were only table outside. 

Overall wait times probably added up to 30-35 minutes. For lunch, that seems too slow. 

They need better leadership and a new communication system. Then the St James might be a nice little spot.

First of all the place was empty when I walked in. Well, I ordered  the crawgator and request it to be on Hawaiian sweet bread. Well, instantly I noticed it wasn't Hawaiian sweet bread... was like oh well, I'm hungry. I ate half of it thinking the onions had no flavor and only can really taste the green pepper. After I took a bite of my friends. .. I realized the onions do have flavor, I just didn't have any on my sandwich. I asked the girl for the onions I didn't recieve.. she gave me cold onions to put on my hot grilled cheese... I was just done with it. Thank god I had the mac and cheese to eat.
