Only thing good out of this place.

We were craving a change from our usual pizza night and had driven past Anthony's numerous times. We decided to try them out but were discouraged by the difficulty in finding a menu. I would have been much quicker to select them if they had their menu posted online. Needless to say, my husband drove to the shop and picked up a menu so we could look it over before ordering. Once we got our pizza we were not disappointed.  It is your typical pizzeria pizza which is harder to come by than you may think. I look forward to trying their sandwiches and/or calzones in the  future. Anthony's is a welcome addition to the neighborhood. :)

Feeling like I got completely RIPPED off by this place tonight. Ordered 5 count of tiny wings, 2 slices of pizza, 2 VERY SMALL side salads, 1 cannoli & 2 small fountain drinks for a total of $37!!!!!! What????? How. The pizza was cold .. wings so small.. salad soooo small. I am so completely annoyed. For almost $40 a dine in restaurant sounds more like it. I will never come here again which is very disappointing because we love next to it. We will support a different restaurant that doesn't like to rip their customers off for practically kids meal.

Second time here.. yogurt is pretty good here. Was a little dissapointed that the chocolate froyo was out.. and peanut butter. Also the cheesecake did not taste like cheese cake which was my 3 choice so ... So I got strawberry and vanilla instead which was good. 2 boys were working.. one working hard at the register the other one standing with his arms crossed not with a friendly face. We noticed a man went up to them to ask for change to give them a tip.. he gave them a few bucks and noticed they didn't even thank him. Seriously young kids these days.. anyways yogurt was good and it was very clean inside.

If your a foodie and within 25 miles I think you should make a point to visit. 

Food
Great food, interesting. The "hmfic" as it says on the website obviously knows his spices and cook times and temps. 

Service 
service is attentive but doesn't really have the knack. They really try and overall it's "B" service. 

Layout
Upstairs the Tables are goofy size 
Patio chairs questionably comfortable
Main dining room is where it's at but you'll have to make reservations to be safe. 

Extras 
Toys and games, great look, changing menu.
Hit the apps in the box on the upper left side of the menu.

Out of town for a conference we stopped in with two young boys (8 & 10yrs old) to meet my colleague for dinner.  There was some difficulty getting a table to seat 5.  I ordered a margarita,  the heaping mound of whip cream drowned out the flavor of tequila.  The mole enchiladas were minuscule. The cheese quesadilla was good.  A kids menu was unavailable,  so we ordered mini chimis, the kids were unimpressed.  The restaurant sits atop a hill with a beautiful view of the foothills and is in a better neighborhood.  It would be my guess that we paid more for ambience that good Mexican food.

We've been waiting for them to reopen. Had a Hawaiian pizza and husband ruined it by adding bacon. It made the pizza too salty. Crust was good.  Sauce was tasty. Had antipasti salad. The dressing was just a cup of red wine vinegar. Spiced it up with all the condiments on the table. But then then we discovered these little Italian cookies. Oh my.....I am speechless. Pro tip: off hours are best. We arrived at 3pm on Saturday and parking lot was packed.   We will be back to try again. The pasta entrees at other tables look delish!

Rooms are very clean, good linens and comfy beds. So the hotel part is very beautiful and nice. Love the ghosts! Very helpful front staff, always a smile. 

The restaurant is not so good. Had breakfast twice here. My husband ordered bagels with salmon and cream cheese. The order arrived with one half of one bagel cut into 6 pieces with lots of not so fresh salmon slices. We told our waitress that it was not acceptable. The supervisor gave us $3 off our bill. I felt they should not have charged for an inedible entre.

Egads, now we have to worry about bed bugs!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Dr. Thomas, in my opinion, is outstanding in both her knowledge and her interaction with patients!  Having seen more doctors than I can count, to include another optometrist trained in vision therapy, Dr. Thomas is hands down the best.  I had a very early traumatic brain injury which Dr. Thomas acknowledged and has treated me for with kindness and compassion.  Her guidance with light and vision therapy have caused positive major shifts in my functioning.  My husband's words are:  "If they offer 5 stars, Dr. Thomas deserves 6!"  For me, Dr. Thomas and her staff have offered me hope in the midst of great darkness.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: So came in there are 2 guys working and 2 guys in the place. 2 pizzas were al.ost gone and a ham and pineapple barely touched.  Got a slice o pepperoni and some meat pizza for the other person I am with. Then the construction crew that came in after me wiped out the rest of the pizza.  Thought I'd have a nice salad while I waited for more pizza, more than 10 minutes, but only had iceberg lettuce. Yuck. Last time they had real lettuce. So for 8 bucks I got 2 slices of pepperoni and a soda.  What happened to the classic combo pizza?  Anyways really rainy out and roads are flooded so this was close by.

This place is a damp mess. Hilton needs to get in here and do a major renovation not just throw paint at the issue...BOO HILTON!
The staff is marvelous and tend to noisy neighbours after 10pm well well. But the walls are paper thin and before 10 you are on your own. Stay away from adjoining rooms during the weekend...the noise is unbelievable.
The beds are comfortable and the cookies are always great
The hotel is damp and you can see the rust in the window and door jams.
Location is bloody amazing and PinKberry rocks. I never ate at the restaurant but I believe it is open until 1am.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I admit I'm not a big fan of sushi but my husband loves sushi and he loves to come here given how close it is to our house and how good the food is. We've visited a few times and I had sushi on my
most recent visit. I thoroughly enjoyed the sushi. One thing to note for any vegetarians is that there is a vegetarian roll that is not included on the weekend menus BUT they will make it for you if you ask. This keeps us coming back because my husband is vegetarian and it can be rather difficult to find places that have more than one vegetarian option.

Loved it.  It is a small, intimate restaurant that can hold maybe 35 people.  We almost passed by since yelp said it was "closed" we assumed because it was Monday but we saw people inside. It is a friendly family owned business with a nice warm ambiance.  They played classic Sinatra and his pictures are on the walls.  Now for the food: The salad had a delicious Italian dressing and the shrimp fra diavlo was probably the best I've ever had.  No room for dessert but I saw delicious looking cheesecake in the front display.

I only get to stop by this Dunkin Donuts once in a while but when I do I get a little upset. I understand that this is a new location and everyone is learning but now that they've been open it still hasn't changed. Each time I order a breakfast sandwich it comes out burnt . I am never able to check it until I get to work because it grab the sandwich and go. Next time I will make sure I check. The staff is very friendly so that is good but I think they may need to review the settings on the breakfast sandwich times.

AMAZING food. Wish I could eat here again. (Just traveling through on a road trip.) 

We weren't sure what the ordering protocol was when we walked in, so I imagine we looked pretty stupid. We also asked for vegetarian options when I'm pretty sure there are ZERO on the menu. They were SO nice to us though. It's not always easy being vegan. We ordered cactus tacos without the meat. They come with guacamole, some type of salsa, onions and cilantro on a warmed corn tortilla. Seriously amazing. We also asked for the roasted peppers and onions. Everything was so fresh and simple. This was my first time trying cactus and I'm totally addicted now.

Media may be one of my new favorite places in the world!?!? John's Grill interesting place to get a beer and cheesesteak. I liked the cheesesteak. I have to find my receipt to verify but I am 95% sure it was under $8. I wish it had more meat but at under $8 I am not going to complain. I think my pint of Yards was $4.50. The cheesesteak was all around solid. In the picture you shd be able to see a nice big slice of mushroom. Very good amount and melt of cheese. Triple crown; good cheesesteak, good beer and good prices.

This turned out to be the weekend of Northeast Philly.  After a long day Montesini Pizza was the cheesesteak to me.  When did Montesini get the Montesini special cheesesteak.  It comes with mushrooms, pepper, fried onions and sauce.  The sauce is ladled on top.  There were a lot of peppers in a cheesesteak. They gave it a lot of flavor but also gave it a lot of juice.  We would have had a roll blowout but I ate the cheese steak from the bottom. This Cheesesteak had a lot of flavor, a nice nicely toasted roll but was a touch small.

I liked my cheese steak. They were nice enough to make me a garlic bread roll. $0.50 for the Garlic bread roll which is more than fair. The girl at the counter was very helpful and made sure that my Cheesesteak got made on a garlic bread roll. They have beer. They may or may not have a deal with the local microbrewery. They may or may not have draft beer. The answers to those questions were a little vague. Luckily I got there after what appeared to be a little boy's birthday party. I like this place but it was just missing something.

I got the cheesesteak. Lots of glorious meat surrounded by Kaka. The bartender spent most of her time tending to her needy boyfriend and his four friends. There was a lot of very very good meat. The roll did an admirable job. The extras were not mixed in. The cheese was non existent until I saw some (unmelted) at the end of the roll. The tomatoes were weak. Overall big place, their own parking lot, several dining rooms, big bar area with TV's and several best of Montco's.  The meat and roll were contenders, the rest needs to be revisited.

Mixed in with all the churches on Allegheny Avenue is Johnny B's. We got Johnny B's special steak.  It came with everything, fried onions, mushrooms, green peppers, pepperoni and sauce.  We took our cheesesteak to the Philadelphia Brewing Company.  This was a good cheesesteak but there was a lot going on and some of the flavors got lost.  The green peppers came through the most and the meat came through the least.  A thicker cut and bigger chunks of could be a simple solution.  Big Cheesesteak, under $10 and we took it over to Philadelphia Brewing, good to very good overall experience.

Seated immediately in the bar area.

Ordered as soon as I was ready.

Server forgot to bring sweetener with unsweet tea. Eventually had to ask someone else for it once food arrived.

I had the triple appetizer - boneless buffalo wings, soft pretzel sticks with beer cheese and pot stickers. All were really good.

After I finished, I kept waiting to be offered something else, specifically the dessert menu.

Eventually I gave up settled my ticket and went to Starbucks instead.

Too many other choices nearby to consider going back.

Love that they have a nice beer selection, but sometimes it seems like a lot of ipa's. Which if you like ipa is great...... As a rule staff is friendly and knowledgeable. There are definitely times it takes forever to get acknowledged because the bartender is too busy with friends/regulars to notice others waiting. Good liquor selection, though it was frustrating when I ordered a porter one night and asked for a chambord float and the bartender didn't know  what chambord was. Friday and Saturday it can get a bit loud and hard to find a seat or get help.

This is the closet Starbucks to my house so I am usually here every morning. The layout for the parking/drive thru creates congestion when it is busy and that is so frustrating at times. 

With that being said some of the workers have taken time to remember my order which is appreciated. However for the ones who haven't, they seem to be pretty inconsistent with getting my order right. 

I mostly come here for the rewards through the Starbucks app for free drinks/food items. However this particular Starbucks is pretty average at best.

Zita is now my pizza delivery of choice here in Metairie (sorry Reginelli's and Stella) - but thats not high praise.  The pizza is good, not great, and they'd go out of business in a week if they were in the New York or Boston area (but thats true of every pizza place I've tried in the south).  Still, a nice thin crust, a bit tough, but with correct amounts of sauce, cheese and toppings.  Good salad and cheese breadsticks (basically a small cheese pizza).  Chocolate cake is rich and decadent.  Delivery was fairly quick (under an hour) and I like the online ordering system.

Had lunch here with my mother on 1.6.16 I'm a local and had read the great Yelp reviews. We took a seat at the bar. No server.  Tracked down a server, waited forever for waters forever to take our order. I finally asked our server why three other tables came in, got waited on and served. She was speechless, then said that they are regulars. So the lesson is, if you're not a regular, don't expect service or explanations. I was so turned off at the snobbiness that I couldn't enjoy the food. The server never made an attempt to make us happy. She gladly accepted our $55. Never again.

I work nearby and I always get their drive through due to Covid. I have had good experience so far, everyone is friendly and fast when I order. They only forgot about one of my drinks one time but I quickly realized and went back and they already had it there for me to pick up and apologized. I haven't been into the store yet, but I assume since it is located in one of the gas station arcade it is small and functional. I would recommend doing drive through here if it is convenient for you to have a pick me up!

This place is quick and convenient for lunch with the prices being a little cheaper for special rolls in general. The sushi's good, but nothing great. I had the joe's roll which had fried banana tempura on top which was very interesting and then a basic crunchy roll. I like that you can choose whatever sauces you want to go and the staff was nice. Just very quick if you want sushi. Food was ready within minutes. Restaurant is kinda dark inside even if it's a beautiful day, you would have no idea sitting inside.

This place is my favorite. It's got an old feel soda shop when you walk inside. Cash only! We used to live uptown and would walk here weekly to get ice cream from here! Ice cream is homemade by the owner and the flavors extend from normal ice creams, sherbets, etc to out of this world delicious flavors!! My favorite go to is the Cookie Monster which is oreo and cookie dough ice cream combined. Love! On a waffle cone! They also do Birthday parties and ice cream challenges!! One day.....I will do a challenge! Life goal.

I come here about 2x a week and usually get the same thing: 2 golden California rolls, one with no cucumber.

There has never been an issue, but today I ordered my usual and received 2 golden California rolls with cucumber, 1 without eggs on top. The reason I specifically order the GOLDEN roll is for the smelt eggs.

When I asked about it, the lady just dismissed it saying she couldn't do anything about it since they already made the roll. She interrupted me rudely and would not let me speak. She also seemed pissed when I asked for eggs on top even though THAT's WHAT I ORDERED. 

They have good rolls at low prices but terrible service!!

I stopped by for dinner with my wife and father.   This is our second time visiting the Mexico City Grill.   Our first visit was very pleasant, and we were quite impressed.  Tonight's visit was a disappointment.    The food was good, but the restaurant was dirty, especially the dust that's collected on the wall shelfs around our booth.  Our table was sticky and booth seat had not been washed.   Our server,  Nimoni, was very friendly and we appreciated the conversation that we shared with her.   The dirty  booth and the dust were more than we can take.   We won't be back.

It's interesting to see some rough reviews on here but I just went for the first time and enjoyed it! The woman working the register was very friendly in an auntie or mom kind of way, saying "you're welcome, baby" and stuff. That made me feel a bit more at home. I ordered the Sumatra but they ran out halfway through the the cup. She asked if I wanted to get topped off with something else and I said the Veranda, a bit sad since I couldn't get a full cup of what I wanted. Then she asked if I just wanted all Veranda, I said yes and she dumped out that Sumatra and told me that the next time I come she'll give me a free cup. So, yay!

Tried Ginza for the first time today.  We were a party of 5.  The hibachi was meh.  The Sushi was excellent and they had a great variety.  Everything is made to order so it is not a typical buffet type place at all.  The service was terrible that is the down side.  My server has the personality of a doormat.  I ordered some appetizers and we all put in an order for hibachi.  I had to wait for my hibachi for 40 minutes because they didn't put my order in.  I would go back for sushi.  I will hope that the service issues were because they recently opened BUT we were only one of 3 parties in there.  I was disappointed.

LOVE! 
The shop is located in between California Pizza Kitchen and Books-A-Million in the outside courtyard. It's all freshly made ice cream, yogurt and sorbet with flavor combinations similar to Cold Stone. I prefer here better than Cold Stone though because it takes way fresher and the prices are a bit lower. 
If you don't feel like indulging in ice cream, they also make smoothies/milkshakes where you can choose between the ice cream, yogurt, sorbet and fruits. The employee's there were very nice and patient with me as I took forever to decide what I wanted and offered plenty of samples.

It's your standard Starbucks so the drinks are well-made, the baristas are nice and everything is very clean. I give 3 stars because the location is horrible. It's right across the boulevard from the mall, so technically it's a prime location but it get's way too busy and the lines don't move fast enough. The drive-thru gets especially bad both in the mornings and afternoon. The layout of the parking lot doesn't help the situation at all. It's very easy to block someone's car in while waiting in line. I would advise going inside instead of the drive-thru, and don't park anywhere near the drive-thru or you might get stuck when you try to leave.

Zapata's is a moderate nice Mexican joint. They cater to the bar crowd with a selection of Mexican brews and a karaoke machine on the bar side with several flat screens for sports events when no karaoke. The food here is decent, the chips are a bit bland for my personal taste needing the salsa to balance them out. The food is moderate to very spicy; but good and generous portions for a meal. The prices are moderate as well; the benches are a little too small for the average 200 lb adult and feel like I'm being squeezed in unless I sit in a chair.

The challenge for many sushi restaurants now is that you can purchase average sushi rolls, sashimi, and wraps in most grocery stores at a reasonable price point.  Yoko's is unable to overcome this competition - it has a modest menu, the value proposition is low given the poor quality, and the atmosphere is typical "strip mall sushi bar".  If you are like me, you enjoy sushi when it is a full experience of high quality/unique flavors, sashimi that melts in your mouth, and presentation with flare.  Sadly, unless you are just looking for an excuse to get out of the house, I must recommend that you "pass" on Yoko's.

Consistently very good.  Great neighborhood Italian food.  The waitstaff are friendly and attentive.  The pasta dishes are large and filling.  They also have a wide variety of chicken and veal dishes which include a side of pasta.  If you have children, the restaurant has a minimal charge for a kid's pasta.  The tables are close together, but the restaurant has a homey nice warm feeling.  They also have nightly specials in additon to their regular menu.  Family owned and operated.  Top Italian food in Horsham area.

Ordered mushroom/ garlic pie for the hungry crowd at the house after the first swim in the start of pool season!
It's Friday night and this place is as busy as any pizza shop in NY.
The staff at the counter were right on fast for this busy place. Checked out my pie- slipped it into my pizza bag- yeah I got an insulated bag- respect the pie please.
As for the pizza- delicious 
Crust is thin and well done, mushrooms are fresh and not too much cheese just the right amount of sauce and plenty of garlic
Must have a new pizza chef because this pie was best I have had  here.

Our revisit has make me to reevaluate this restaurant. I like to change my opinion review to 3.5 stars. It is not a true 4 stars. The revisit show the restaurant step backwards in compare to the first few months they just open. I am some what disappointed. The nigiri has show increasing of rice and thinner fish cut. The sushi roll is still in good shape but not the best as before. I wonder I am going to revisit this place. Although they have good price for all you can eat but the quality drop. Service is still good.

We enjoyed the Element Hotel. It was clean and comfortable. Our room was a nice size with a refrigerator (which I appreciated) and a microwave. 
The weekend we stayed was very busy, but the staff was attentive, proficient, and very friendly. Many places have pre-packed breakfast, as did this hotel. I have to say that Element has some decent choices. 
The pool looked amazing with the chairs in the water, but unfortunately I did not get to indulge. The workout room was clean and had all you'd need. 
We would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
** This is a review of sushi ordered through Grubhub **

We did not eat at the restaurant. We ordered once through Grubhub which has limited sushi options. The sushi was 2-3 star, with exception to the tuna pepper roll, which was just horrendous. The fish looked dry and tasted even worse. We liked the salmon rolls however, and decided to order again about three weeks later. My wife and I both got sick that night. I am concerned about the freshness, though we realize this might have been the result of having it delivered, but we won't be ordering from here again.

Great food in an unassuming location.  I've tried Oak Oven couple of times and while service right after they opened was a little spotty they seem to have worked out the kinks.  The food is great and I suffer menu paralysis every time I go in since the pizzas, handmade pasta, and sandwiches all command attention.  However the pizza, with its super thin crust, generally gets the nod.  It is a pretty restaurant - amazingly a new incarnation of an old Popeye's.  However the dining room is small and it is popular so eating at non-standard times can be a real advantage.

Planet fitness. It's exactly what it should be. The facility is always clean and the staff is always helpful and friendly. 

For the life of me I can't understand the pizza night and bagel mornings, but that's not really for me to understand. If they want to be planet carbs for a day or 2 each month, it's like Bobby Brown said, it's their prerogative...or was that Britney Spears??  I'm getting off track. 

If you want a nice clean gym without the lug heads and weights slamming around, PF is the gym for you. The intensity isn't high but then again, I don't need anyone screaming at me to get that last 1/4 mile on the treadmill.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I had eaten here years before when I went to IUPUI, but since then the menu has changed for the better.  We had a certificate from restaurants.com.  we had the flat bread app w local goose sausage.  I had the buffalo chicken salad w a generous portion of blue cheese.  It was excellent!  My boyfriend had a pasta dish and we finished with the cobbler.  The service was excellent, and we will definately be back.  Plus there was plenty of parking in the hotel garage that was free.  This was a great deal for downtown eating.

5 starts for the food, probably about 3 for their mixed drinks. My friends and I definitely come here for the food, not the bar. Their beer selection is decent and they have a very large wine list, but I have never had a good mixed drink here. Not sure if its the alcohol they use or just bad bartenders, but every cocktail has tasted like straight alcohol- and not in a good way.

The food, on the other hand, is great IMO. We love the "its always restuarant week" option, and everything I have eaten here has been great. My top two recommendations would be the root beer vodka wings and the manayunk chipwich- SO good.

What a delicious little place! Some friends took me for dinner last night and it was succulent! The bowl of miso soup they greet you with is light but very flavorful, the you can choose between edamame or salad, I had the edamame which were fine. 
We ordered the sashimi that had tuna, salmon and white fish, the salmon was like butter, gorgeous, the tuna was really fresh !!! We also tucked into the kiss me roll which has pink seaweed , I had never seen that and it was really cute, something you would expect anime girls to eat! 
Overall very good quality fish and good price point, will return.
Also wonderful staff!

A little too filling for lunch but great for dinner. Multiple options for those who are gluten free. For fans of crunchy fish tacos, this place has the best. Great texture and the plantain adds a sweet undertone. The nachos are also great. I'm a big fan of even topping distribution and they definitely deliver on that. 

The Mexicans Street corn is a generous portion. I recommend ordering to share. On a workday lunch, the agua Fresca is a nice stand in for a cocktail. Refreshing and mildly sweet. Perfect compliment to any dish on the menu.

The all you can eat special for $21 can't be beat! All sushi rolls we ordered were unique, and tasted fresh. And Hooray for being BYOB! 
I also like that you had the option of ordering other things from the kitchen that weren't just sushi, like vegetable tempura, calamari, and salads. I loved the kani salad, which was imitation crab and cucumber. 
The waitress was very kind, but service was a little slow. I didn't really mind all that much since I wasn't in a hurry.
The presentation of all the sushi rolls was beautiful! Definitely Instagram worthy haha. 
I'm glad I found a new awesome sushi place in the philly 'burbs!

We came here on recommendations and were glad we did.  Florida roll and Arizona roll were great. Next time the rolls with salmon on top...electric eye and citrus?

Cooked special roll ok.   Happy hour ok.  I'm thrilled that there is a good, reasonably priced wine list. Overall this is a good place for sushi and we will be back.  Diverse apps as well.

Negatives...sushi bar seating designed by Inquisition torturers. Also, the fish is cleverly hidden from view.  Service was so-so.  Ask for ginger.  No warm towels, etc.  


They have a parking lot.

We come here with the children because it's a fun and lively atmosphere and the food is overall a good value.  Sushi is supermarket quality, but some of the hot foods like Mongolian beef and noodle dishes are very good.  Service is always friendly and prompt but more training is needed on the restaurant concept.  Although it's an open, all inclusive menu, the waitstaff really pressure you to just order one appetizer, entrees and leave.  We are by no means over eaters or wasters of food but we do like to try different foods without feeling pressured to leave quickly.

Ordered take out.  We went in to order because I couldn't find the menu on here. We (my daughters and I) ordered some crab Rangoon, Lomein, Fried rice, and chicken and broccoli.  Placed our order paid with credit card and were told it would take about 20 min.  It was packed just right, everything arrived hot.  Taste is one of the best around here.  Service was regular, and promptness was reasonable.  Food is a bit on the greasy side, but it's what's expected and by my girls what they love lol.  We will be coming back.  I had been here before a few times but never took the time to yelp them, next time I'll make sure to post some food pics

Nostalgic, voluminous, but somewhat basic Japanese food.

This is a small sushi place in center city Philadelphia.  The interior is surprisingly nice, but I got take-out.  I'd definitely eat in here if I had the opportunity.

I tried the Makiman's Pancake and the Chicken Katsu Don.  The former was basically a seafood pancake in the Vietnamese style, and - like the many seafood pancakes I've had at other places - was really darn good.  The Chicken Katsu Don was accurate to what I ate in Japan, but a bit basic - the breading and egg were a bit weirdly moist, but nonetheless were pretty good.

For chinese delivery this was overall a good experience. 

Pros:
Quick Delivery - had my food in just under an hour
Sesame Chicken - great flavor with PLENTY of food
Rice - delivery was fast enough that it didnt need to be reheated

Cons:
Crab Rangoon/Fried Cheese Wontons - Well below par for what I would consider a fried wonton. Usually this is what I look forward to most in my chinese meal but I wont waste the money again.

Overall:
Ill order from here again, but next time Im gonna try another place in the area to compare.

I've worked in New hope for about a year and I eat Giuseppe's a few times a month. The food is pretty good it's above average for your local pizza place. Some of their entrees seem to lack quality but that tends to happen with pizza places like this one.

They do always have a large assortment of slices my favorite being the BBQ chicken or the cheesesteak pizza. Their sandwiches are also usually pretty good. 

Also a nice perk for a pizza place they have a full bar and sell 6 packs of beer which is nice if you're picking up pizza and want to grab a drink too

Oak oven is an amazing little gem tucked away in Harahan. They offer a decent assortment of wood fire pizzas, pastas, and salads. I recommend making a reservation we had to wait about 40 minutes for a two top but it was worth it. Depending on what the fresh fish special is, you may want to give it a shot. Tonight was fresh redfish offered up with multiple options of pasta, sauce, and other seafood pairings. It was fantastic and our waiter was very knowledgable and friendly. Overall a great place for some up scale Italian without a drive into the city or a heavy bill.

Honestly, really depends on the crew working for the day. While the last review is from a year ago, a lot of it still applies -- you'll probably hear a good bit about the employee's lives, but when it's not super negative it is endearing. 

Location is great, parking can be a little difficult depending on how busy it is at the time, there aren't a lot of parking spots for the amount of stores in the strip. Line is often out the door, especially at lunch.

Food is good though and honestly that's all that really matters at the end of the day - I'm usually picking up and carrying out.

I typically come to this restaurant during happy hour (which is almost the same as the regular business hours, except on Sunday) for good sushi at a great price. The wait staff is friendly and on top of things. Every meal comes with a complimentary bowl of miso soup and either soy beans or a salad. I've never received a bad roll there, even though I've tried several of the ones available on the menu. It's good enough that I regularly recommend it to my friends and try to go anytime I'm with someone who enjoys some good sushi.

The rating is for food. The place is not fresh. My salad was bottom of the barrel. I had blackened chicken pasta with Caesar salad.  There is nothing "blackened" about the chicken. Actually it looks like the frozen chicken strips available at retail stores.  

Our server Scott worked hard and was very attentive with lots of personality. The big down side of the service was that the meals were delivered too soon  after the  salads.  Personality or not, managing the food delivery is huge!  Service would get 3 stars.

Central Downtown Location with Daily Fresh Buffet Specials!

Very popular location in the Hilton downtown facing Franklin Street pedestrian mall.  The large, floor to ceiling windows provide plenty of light.  Each day they feature a very popular and different themed lunch buffet. You can try the buffet or order from a full menu.  The food is good and plentiful. Its a great place to meet for business or catch up with friends. It is a hotel restaurant so they are a little higher on price but you will not go away hungry!

Had to stay here for a conference this past week. I've stayed at numerous Sheraton/Westin hotels. This place was a total pit. I checked in and was given room 331. Went to room and was totally disgusted. Stained/buckling carpet. Went back down to lobby and requested room change. Management didn't seem too concerned or surprised when I told them how foul my room was. Went to new room, not much better. Rooms have a weird musty odor, carpets are dirty/stained. My room wasn't cleaned during the day. If I was Sheraton, I'd be embarrassed to say this hotel was apart of the chain. Gross.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: For me this is my new place for sushi in St Louis they have a great variety of sushi,nigiri and rolls. They also have non sushi items also so you can take someone who is not a sushi eater but why would you lol. The fish is very fresh and melts in your mouth. I've only actually been twice (2 days in a row probably 3 tonight) and already feel like a regular by the friendly staff. Happy hour is great yet it's worth it even if it's not happy hour. It gets busy but the staff is obviously seasoned and very efficient at what they do.

I would describe this place as American style sushi place.

We wanna try some new place and found this on yelp.
Seaweed salad came first and it's impressive how big the portion was, compare to price this is very good deal.
While we were waiting, which was not too long at all. The sushi bar shows pretty good quality ingredients.
Our rolls came out with nice display.
Surprisingly, the taste of the food was hard to explain. I travelled to japan more than 5 times and never had this taste. 
It's not bad but not that good.
Soy sauce/ shoyu was diluted, wasabi has no taste.
Again, this is just my opinion.

First time here, came for happy hour, great fun. The place was buzzing, very busy but all staff was efficient and made sure to tell you how long the wait might be.  Sat in bar area for the happy hour special. Bartender was excellent, friendly, was sure to acknowledge everyone right away. This is a great little neighborhood find. If you like Italian give it a try. Happy hour until seven. The clams were a little salty, but still delicious. Enjoyed everything we ordered. TV by bar plays old black and white movies  really enjoyed the atmosphere.

The manager yells at employees and the one man who works there does not give coin change back to you, he instead puts it right in the tip jar. Few people who work there are nice and clean but most of the workers I've dealt with mess up a simple coffee order over and over again. From no ice to no syrup to no cream or sugar, they have even messed up food orders. I gave this place enough tries but they just disappointed me. I make the trip a few minutes down the road to the Clayton Dunkin now instead as I am much more satisfied with their service.

Ya this place is pretty rad and if you have driven by Terry's too many times and not stopped, like myself. It is time to stop making excuses and just go. 

The drinks are strong and affordable. The drink keepers are spunky, fun, and on-top of their games. Pull up a pool cue or pull up a big table and plop down. You can expect to do some serious people watching, some serious dancing, some serious singing (karaoke), some serious socializing, and maybe some serious drinking. Ok, probably some serious drinking since you will be having fun. 

Parking isn't the best but honestly, don't drive if you are drinking.

Total dive heaven!

Really disappointed recently. Seems the owner got too busy with a new restaurant and "out with the old and in with the new"...the rolls have become sub par without any charm. Service rushed and careless. We didn't even see our favorite guys working the sushi bar there the last 3x, maybe they left to the new location. We used to be so excited to come out here and came at least weekly even tho it was out of town...now we are lost in Reno for good sushi again. Used to tell all the docs at work about this place...What happened Sakana!

My friend and radio show co-host, Pat Shillito, runs a weekly open mic comedy contest at 3rd Street Bar every Wednesday at 9pm.  I had been threatening to go for months, and FINALLY made it yesterday.

WOW, was I impressed, not only by the great comedy show but the bar itself was SO nice!!!  Not sure what I expected, but it definitely wasn't the beautiful, inviting interior, the friendly service, or the comfortable seating and layout of the place.  I highly recommend 3rd Street Bar any night, and if Wednesday night comedy isn't your thing, they offer karaoke on Thursday nights and live blues music throughout the week.

First time at this location, after comparing the two, the Chesterfield one is better possibly due to being busier. The staff was very nice and welcoming but the food wasn't fresh. It seems as if the chicken may have been refried after sitting a while. The mashed potatoes were a little off as well. I also ordered cheese sticks which were good and fresh however they were out of marinara so I settled for cocktail sauce which I guess wasn't so bad.
I tried the fried cauliflower and it was very good.
I would definitely give them another try if I was in the area but I would just request my chicken to be made up fresh.

It was great about a year ago when it first came out. Ever since then we've been two times and it's gone downhill from there. The pizza is delicious though! However the pasta  has lacked. I had a friend who ordered the Alfredo and the pasta was completely stuck together and the flavor was bland, tasted like just cream, the cheese flavor didn't come through. He actually got it replaced and this time the pasta was how it should be, nice and loose, but the flavor still lacked. Their tomato sauce is amazing but their pastas am have been bland and tasteless.

Excellent business lunch.  
Three of us went here on a weekday afternoon and enjoyed a delicious lunch.  The place was a bit noisy when we arrived, around one PM, but got quieter as we had delicious "Bento Bite" lunches of shrimp and vegetable tempura on rice, preceded by edamame and soup.  The soup is where this becomes a fusion of Japanese and European cuisine, with a broth-based tofu snd seaweed soup in a ceramic cup with a Chinese  style ceramic spoon. It was all very nicely flavored, and the service was efficient and polite, so we were very happy with out lunch.

You know the frozen Totino's pizzas that are super cheap at the grocery store? Sir Pizza makes them taste like a pizza from The Original Ray's in New York City. The service is bad. The food is bad. The floors are just nasty. The silverware? Look it over carefully before you put it in your mouth. Every table dirty. Had to ask them to bus them, they came out and cleaned up one. Save yourself the hassle, time, and money and don't clean your house for months, half wash your dishes,  buy some Totino's and soda, heat it up and eat it on your dirty kitchen table. I just pissed away $22.

Came here on my dad's birthday for happy hour. Their happy hour ends at 6:30 which in my opinion is early. Well, their food and margaritas definitely make the happy hour a good one. We ordered blood orange margaritas all around. For food, we ordered the chicken nachos, chicken taquitos and something with salmon in it. Food and drinks were great. Service was pretty good. Our server was very attentive and made sure to check if we wanted anything before happy hours ended. Price wise, I prefer their neighbors double knot and sampan but i understand it's a different cuisine. 

Will return for a main meal next time.

I've been here multiple times and what I've noticed is that there's always limited seating. I was there for over an hour and there was a large table with four seats next to us that had one open laptop and a large stack of files- unattended! I never saw anyone sit there the whole time I was there. This is a very small Starbucks and if you wanted to sit inside to relax or get things done it can get quite loud and chaotic. As a warning there are always lots of middle schoolers after school hours because they can walk to this one. I've never had a problem with my drinks here but the seating arrangement and policy could be improved.

My boyfriend and I brought 2 out of town guests here on a weeknight. Everything we sampled was outstanding, but the cheese board, squid ink pasta, and pork shank entree were some big standouts. Restaurant is cash only and BYOB and doesn't have the best view, but is totally worth a visit. Service is fine, it wasn't a packed night and we had to wait for water refills several times. But other than that, our waitress was adequate. This is a very small restaurant, so it can get loud, it is probably not a great place for a big party or a romantic private dinner. We will definitely be back!

Read all the positive reviews and couldn't wait to try out this new place but unfortunately came back disappointed. Our group of four came here on a Tuesday night for dinner and were promptly seated. Our server was pleasant and friendly but the food left a lot to be desired. Like a couple of reviewers have already mentioned, I felt the food tasted more Italian-American than Italian. On the positive side, they use fresh ingredients, right from the salads to the entrees. My pesto roast chicken was just about average and my wife said the same about her rigatoni. Overall, not bad but way below my expectations.

I was passing by looking for something to eat and came across Jalapeños Grill. It is a very authentic Mexican restaurant and service is absolutely excellent!Our server was Amparo she was so friendly and attentive ! I had a Salmon Salad and it was delicious.. The balsamic vinaigrette was something I had never had tasted before... OMG!!!.. My husband had Pork Chop Vaquero which was just as delicious! 
We will definitely come.back and will recommend this cute eatery to everyone we know.. Also its a BYOB even better!!!

My wife and I stay at the Conrad a few nights a year when we are in town.  I would give 5 stars as this is a five star hotel but for the beds.  We have stayed in numerous rooms and suites and every bed has seemed a little worn and slightly uncomfortable.  That being said, I still sleep good enough to come back every time.  I cant say enough about the rooms, service and Capitol Grille that is attached.  Excellent location downtown is a giant plus as well.  Do yourself a favor and book a night or two for your next stay in Indy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I really loved our bartender. She was ridiculous and a lot of fun. I think her name was Brooke. Everyone that came in acted like they knew her and maybe they did. Which could be why she was so entertaining. It was busy but relatively quiet and calm which I really liked. The crowd was pretty young but not crazy like the Bourbon street crowd. We got Jameson and ginger. Nothing special, but tasted great. I had already eaten, but all the food I saw coming out looked so good, I wish I would have saved some of my appetite. They also have an old arcade game.

If your ever in Chalmette and craving chargrilled oysters and HH martinis...you're in luck. This place has what you need! 

They're all several kinds of toppings but I love the original, Rockefeller and the bacon and blue cheese options. Normally I don't spring for food off the menu but I had the creole tomato soup of the day once and OMG!!!!! Best thing ever. 

Service is always awesomeness and it's family owned so they remember your face and order most times.

Trust me this place may be a bit off the normal path but worth the venture. You won't be disappointed.

Endless hibachi, appetizers, and sushi for $9.95. You can't beat that deal! It's not the greatest tasting hibachi, but it's all pretty good for the price. I would recommend not going on Saturday because the wait time is usually up to 1 hour and your tummy will be crying for food. 

I recommend trying the gyoza and Singapore noodles if you are looking for some good appetizers. The Singapore noodles are very light and have a sprinkle of curry on it, which to my taste is wonderful! As for sushi, I don't particularly like the dancing crab roll, but all of my friends go crazy for it! 

Please go on an empty stomach and leave full/happy :).

I really like the concept of the small. local market and go to Happy Harrys often. A problem I have noticed is that some of the produce just isn't fresh. Got rotten potatoes one time, a 5 pound bag of which about half was useable.  Peppers today, had to inspect each carefully - one green pepper rotten at the stem, I bought it anyway, as I needed it for a recipe, and cut away the bad part. 
 I understand Harry's is up for sale. Hope the new owner can fix it. Honestly, I am skeptical about anyone making a go of it.

I wouldn't come here for the food.  The drinks, on the other hand, are strong but not that great in the taste department.  The best times I have had at Las Palmas have been with a few of my friends on a night where we intended to have fun, drink a little, and do something afterwards.  I would generally not recommend this place to anyone that is looking for a good Mexican meal that represents what Mexican eateries have to offer in Nashville.  Come in with the right expectations, and you will have a great time!

Pros:
-The hotel is in an excellent location. It is within walking distance to many bars, restaurants, and activities.

-The hotel is well maintained and is on the newer side. It is only ~3 years old. 

- The concierge lounge is open every day serving breakfast, h'orderves , and sweets

Cons: 
-The pool is on the small side. The photo makes it look much larger than it actually is.

-JW classification- as a person who travels and stays on average 160+ nights a year in a hotel, 120+ in Marriott's in a variation of their different brands, I feel that it would fit better into the Marriott Hotel flagship brand.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I've never had a bad experience here.  The sushi is fresh. Always good.  They have a soup...Nabyaki (spelled wrong I'm sure) Udon that is out of this world.

The reason for the 4 stars instead of 5:  it is always very warm in there.  I don't  think their AC functions properly.  Or they just keep it warm.  For that reason I  won't physically eat in the restaurant unless it's cool outside.  I will do takeout though.  They also used to put a small dish of edemame on the table when the drinks were brought.  Not anymore.

Kazu, the owner, is always welcoming.  And very accommodating to special requests.

Typical dunkin donuts, new enough so that it hasn't accumulated that dingy feel most dunkin donuts have. The fireplace is nice enough, and the store is quiet so that you can get some work done if you want! The seats aren't the most comfortable, but it works for a late night (24 hour) study place that isn't overrun by students. Bring a friend and eat donuts and mediocre coffee all night, while glancing up once in a while to check out the news on the TVs or play some chess with local Philadelphians who frequent the store.

I think Walmart is in trouble - selection and prices at WinCo are outstanding. I like the concept of different color labels indicating how much you will save.

Only Costco is better for bulk items and variety of goods to keep you interested and spending hundreds of dollars. Also, Whole Foods is great where quality is more important than price.

WinCo is great if you want variety of basics and value. Only two minor negatives - 1) cash/debit cards for payment only and 2) you bag your own groceries.

This store is only out West. So enjoy it.

Two visits to I Fratellini and I'm still in love.  Service is warm, yet professional and the food is just fabulous.  It's cozy with just a handful of tables, but it's still very inviting and comfortable.  The off-menu lasagna is the best I have EVER had - seriously.  It's a monstrous serving and has just a little kick to it.  The linguini with clams, white wine and garlic was outstanding as well.  The caprini appetizer was generous and something I'll definitely have again.  It's a creative, romantic, special place - highly recommend!

The guy who did my hair cut earlier was extremely rude. (Don't even know the name, but probably in his 40s and with tattoo on his right arm, short). He kept using his mouth to blow away the hairs dropped on my neck and face. What's even worse, I am sure he smokes a lot from the awful breath and I don't know if he got a flu cos he kept coughing... 

Before I left, I still tipped out of courtesy but for God's sake, he yelled at me and humiliated me in Mandarin saying it's not enough... Totally shameless... Please avoid this salon

The coffee is great!
The service ranges from meh to very good.  Sometimes I get very friendly, attentive, fast service.  Sometimes I go in and the person behind the counter is chatting away with a friend/customer/colleague and ignores me for a little while longer than they should.  Once, after the girl took my order, she starting talking to someone and forgot to make my drink.
The shop itself is cozy and nice, with lots of windows for people-watching and getting natural light.  Definitely worth a stop in if you're in the neighborhood!!  Their seasonal specialty drinks are particularly yummy :-)

I went here for lunch.  There was a good amount of people here for a late lunch.  Service was good, no complaints.  Food...meh.  The presentation was nice, but overall I've had much better.  I thought it was very fresh and the spicy tuna roll was good.  It's actually a crunchy spicy tuna roll.  The only disappointment was the yellow tail.  It was really small.  For $7, I'd expect to have two nice sized pieces and not two tiny pieces that together would equal one.  I'll go again, maybe for dinner it's a little better.

Nice, clean newer Wendy's close to home.

As I've said on other fast food reviews you should know what you're getting when you come to these places.  Usually come there cuz we're in a hurry and want something fast (pooh, fast food?). 

Service is fine, food is hot, love their new tangled soda machine and I like their baked potatoes.  I remember when Wendy's first opened in New England I would drive miles for a Wendy's burger.  Burgers are no longer as good, so seldom buy one, stick with chicken sandwiches.

Miss the good old Wendy's.  Would no longer drive miles for one.  sad.

Not my favorite Starbucks 

I ordered a iced venti decaf sugar free caramel latte.  When I got my drink it was definitely not decaf (believe me I can tell). But the barista insisted it was decaf.  We went back and forth with this until he offered to remake it.  I then got my new drink and I noticed this one had 2% milk while the original was fat free.  I tasted it, no flavor.  He finally added more caramel and it was then ok, not great.

I don't like what this store looks like either.  Felt crowded and cluttered. Staff was nice but I doubt I would be returning to this particular store.

*Update. We did bring the coffee back and they gladly made us a new one. They were super friendly about it. They apologized but I do think they need to work on consistency. 

They have messed up our coffee every single time we give them a group order. The girls are too nice and wouldn't bring it back in the past. I asked for a large iced black turbo coffee and I got a pure white iced coffee with so much cream I could use it for cream itself. I'm so disappointed but ask myself why do we keep subjecting ourselves to such awful coffee abuse.

Consistently the worst service I have experienced at any Dunkin Donuts facility. They are always under-staffed and highly unorganized. Be prepared to stand in line and wait for several minutes while listening to the manager complain and bark out orders to employees who are not capable of making the simplest of breakfast orders. Unfortunately, they are the only option for several miles, but if you can avoid this location, I would do so at all costs!  The only good news is that once you finally get your order (assuming they have not managed to mess that up as well), the food and drink is decent. What a disaster...

Stayed here this weekend. Thus us a perfect place to stay if you need to be downtown and won't be spraying long. I stayed in an inner apartment so there was absolutely no view. I dud hear the train but faintly. I thought it added to the charm. The location us awesome if you want to head out to eat, catch a game, or go to work. I think they could gave upgraded a bit on the fixtures, carpets, etc. it felt like a hotel room with a kitchen. Overall, I would stay here again. The location us the biggest asset and they just put a qdoba in out front. Not sure I would live here permanently.

The burger was amazing, I get why it was rated nationally in a top 100 burgers. The bar is super clean and verging on trendy. If the staff wasn't awful it would be a 5 star. Literally 7 interactions with both bartenders, icy white was man and 20 something white guy, and they managed to NEVER say one single word to me the entire time I was there. They gave off the pretentiousness of being spoiled bougie kids from California or Connecticut, who decided to piss off Mommy & Daddy off by being South Philly hipsters.

Great pizza! We have placed numerous orders for delivery since moving to plant city in October 2017. They are always very fast and have never made a mistake on our order. Pizza is always hot and very tasty. 

What I love the most is the ease of ordering online. I love that I can easily log on and place an order within minutes. Everything is easy to customize and create exactly how you like it. I always like light sauce and my husband loves extra sauce so we split the pizza to accommodate our likes. They have always gotten it right. We love Marcos Pizza!

Pure awesomeness all around. Great service. Actually excellent service. Great selection of beer probably 50 beers to choose from. I ordered the Astoria burger which was ground lamb fresh veggies ect.This could possibly be the BEST burger I have ever eaten. The French fries were so good I didn't want to ruin them with ketchup. It's a little expensive here how ever worth every dime. Considering the quality of the food it's actually a value. The place was sparkling clean including the men's room.  All though not close to where my girlfriend and I live I could see us becoming regulars.

Do not go here after 6 p.m.   They are understaffed in the evenings.  I came in around 6:30 to pick up a tire I'd left earlier in the day, and had to wait at least 20 minutes before anyone would even talk to me to see what I needed (I just needed to pay and leave). The two employees there were involved with a long and complicated issue with a customer and wouldn't even let me tell them I just needed to pick up a loose tire.  I might still go there because they are close to me.  But don't expect anything close to prompt service.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
The service is great. Ashley, our server was very attentive and friendly. 

The food, however, is a different story. The pomodorina soup is a bland, boring cream based tomato basil. The caprese salad wasn't too good either. The mozzarella was flavorful, but the tomatoes were tasteless and mealy. 

My husbands steak was salty and too tough. 

The wines prices are very high. I am used to a 200-300% mark up, and their wine prices are closer to a 400% mark up compared to what I have purchased the same bottle for in a store.

My wife and I have been coming to eat at Villa Gallace for about two years. It's always delicious and the service is excellent every time. It's nice to see a local restaurant with present owners that really take the time to train wait staff and make consistently great food. The pasta is superb and our favorite dishes are the bolognese and the puttanesca. The tiramisu is also amazing. Villa Gallace is an authentic Italian gem tucked away in Indian Rocks. Looking forward to many more years of memories and delicious food at Villa Gallace in IRB :)

Went here this past Wednesday for an afternoon appointment with Metta. It's a cute little salon known for its organic products and Deva styling. Metta was super friendly and gave my hair some much needed TLC. I got my first Deva cut. I chopped off a good amount of hair (see pics below). I left with my hair feeling/looking so hydrated and it felt significantly less frizzy. I tried replicating it today, and unfortunately wasn't able to get the smooth finish Metta was able to achieve on Wednesday. Price was reasonable considering other nearby Deva salons and their prices.

Sandwiches aren't terrible -- that's not a great way to start a review LOL! 
I enjoy the sweet onion chicken teriyaki sub, lightly toasted on honey oat bun.
However, they don't put much care into making your sandwich, they skimp on the meat/toppings, and it seems like they are just trying to get you out the door as fast as possible, instead of making sure you have a great sandwich and pleasant experience. 
I appreciated that they used gloves when making my sub. 
And they usually only give you one napkin. Just one! Lol.

First time here. 
Long lines each time I came by, finally decided to wait. Had a free wash to check it out from a local oil change. 
Got the Gold wash.
There were 6 cars in from of me when I arrived. We waited 30 minutes before our turn. 
The wash itself took about 4 minutes, 1 minute to dry. 
I folded in my mirrors, as instructed but when the pads started cleaning they pushed them out. Thankfully, no damage. 
The very top of my minivan didn't get clean, and some parts on the bottom didn't get clean. Not sure if this is typical for this type of wash, as I usually hand wash my cars. But the kids enjoyed a fun experience!

I've been going here for almost 10 years, these folks have always been super good to me.  As a single Mom, I will say that I really appreciate the way I'm treated.  It's hard to give 5 stars as the staff and company have changed a lot over the years, but I can definitely say that they respect my time and my needs and don't hesitate to give me a ride if I need it.  I have been treated very well here.

I like that they show me what services my car needs, discuss it with me, and give me candid feedback on the priority of each maintenance service.  This allows me to budget accordingly.

I'll keep going back!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Bleh. Stopped in here cause it looked cute and I had some time to kill before a hair appointment. I guess their claim to fame is some frozen coffee drink. I was in the mood for an iced chai. The guy at the counter looked like he would rather burn himself with lit cigarette butts than make my drink. Not friendly at all, not a word spoken. I always tip my baristas, like dude, it's not that hard to say your welcome or have a nice day. The chai was the kind from a box... A bit too sweet. Whatever, not the end of the world. Hire friendlier baristas and I'll give it another go...

Worth a stop, if you're in the area. Food is good and somewhat affordable. I got the catfish po' boy with fries and left with a full, decently pleased belly. Fries were pretty standard.

Couple noteworthies include the single-stall bathroom resembling that of a gas station washroom, and the server seeming to be stretched pretty thin. She did a really good job serving for the circumstances, but was running around the whole time we were there and didn't have the capacity to check up on us much or refill waters. Definitely a champion server for the number of tables she took care of though!

What happened to the quality of their bartenders??? You can't make your own signature drinks or a dirty martini? We sat down at the bar on a Friday night and sat for 10 minutes and then asked what to drink when we weren't given drink menus. My dirty martini was mostly olive juice and my husband got the nutty Russian that was served in a pint glass on ice. It was 90% some milk substance.  Sad because this place used to have great drinks and staff. They lost good customers and we will definitely let our friends now

I have tried viva 4 times now. Today I was there and waited in the drive thru for a very long time. The burritos have no flavor. Everything is dried out and cooked way too long. I wouldn't be surprised if the eggs are precooked. The employees in the front are very nice and do a great job. Today I had to return and go inside the store because they forgot one of my burritos. I will not return. Consistently bad. Drive a little farther and go to a Nicos or Filibertos, they are consistently much better than Viva.

They have three locations I believe on bourbon, and they are knwon for their hand grenades. I personally don't like them, after my first trip to New Orleans. Ihad several and don't remember anything after that. They are very strong and will have you drunk in a matter of hours, maybe not even that lol. My bf loves the grenades so we came here often during our stay. Everyone mostly just goes in and orders their drinks and goes back out to bourbon, they did have a live band but I'm more fond of DJ's then cover bands.

This place. Is. So. Good. We get food here about once a week at work, and we never complain! Great service! They are a bit more expensive than other places but so worth it, but the lunch specials are not only affordable, but filling! Accommodating for requests. Try the curry. I swear the curry sauce has crack in it. I want to try other stuff but the curry has a hold on me! Spring for some doughnuts too... you may eat a whole bag. This is a must visit or takeout if you live nearby. They are likely better than where you currently go.

This is a good place for a romantic dinner, or a sassy time in the back or front corner of the restaurant having a good time. I not only had a good time here, but the staff made it an even better time.
My date and I enjoyed some spicy sausage pasta and I can't remember what he had as it was a fun complicated name. But the food was amazing, and the atmosphere was friendly modern and classic. I would highly recommend this place if you want a date. But be careful as you may both be super bloated from the pleasentries of amazing food and good wine. I know I had a fantastic time!

I went here for an eye exam and had a great experience. It was easy to book and the renovations are very nice modern and bright.
The decor was nice and the staff was very friendly and efficient. 
They don't take GroupSource as direct billing which sucks but I don't mind since I have benefits still. 
I gave them a lower rating cause all the display glasses are locked up and I can't just browse and try on glasses. I don't have money right now to buy glasses right now and felt pressured to buy glasses instantly. 
But overall great service and a great place to get your exam. Could not be happier.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
My new neighborhood Publix, since I just moved to the area.  Just like all the other Publixes ever, it's a higher-quality grocery store with decent buy-one-get-one offers every week.  This particular location has the online deli ordering feature, so you can pre-order your subs or chickens and just pick them up - something highly recommended.  

Decent beer selection, along with a "build your own six-pack" display.  Shame about the selection on that, though.  All pretty rote stuff.  They have a liquor store here too if you need to get your booze on.

I almost got murked here TWICE before I even walked in the door.  The parking lot is one-way, so don't be a fool like me and go in the exit (almost a head-on collision, my fault but still).  The parking lot also has a sharp dogleg so make sure you check several times before walking through it (almost hit by a pickup truck, this one not on me).  

Donuts are fine.  I got a cruller which wasn't as good as Hole In 1 but it's way closer to my house.  DD's coffee is terrible and if you like it you are a martian. 

*murked - verb; to get killed violently with no hope of defense

BURGER KING, WHERE ALL DRAGON MASTERS EAT!

Burger King changed their advertising direction years ago to get away from "The King" and all the weirdness that surrounded him, and go a more traditional "we sell burgers and also smoothies" route; and for that I will never forgive them.

However, flame-broiled Whoppers do have a more legit flavor than your average McDonald's fare, plus this location has a Coke Freestyle machine, which is always fun to experiment with.  Of course, it is still pedantic fast food and they won't make you an Angry Whopper no matter how much you plead, so here we are at a big fat two stars.

Went for an oil change and the accompanying wash, and left quite disappointed.  The oil change ran $30, and I needed a couple new air filters as well, so the price went up a bit.  After the wash though, the detailing people missed a few areas on the car.  Whatever, it happens, right?

So I get in the car, and in the passenger seat are my old filters and my car antenna.  Thanks for removing it (I guess?), but why wouldn't you put it back on?  And I really don't need the old air filters.  

Free popcorn in the lobby, and a few checkerboards for with which to pass the time.  I'll stick with my old favorite place, though.

A 24-hour drive-through McDonalds off exit 240 on I-75.  Go west to get to Ruskin, east to get to Sun City Center.  

I swung in here because it's open later than the Ruskin McD's and I needed a few burgers.  They're much less crowded than the other location, and the people I interacted with were all as pleasant as a person working at a McDonald's at 11:55 pm could be.  So good job, I guess.

Everything came out correct, and because it's so much less crowded (seriously, the Ruskin one with the double drive-thru takes forever and is always packed) I may come to this one from now on, when and if I ever need to feel ashamed of myself.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I enjoyed that the atmosphere was different from a standard bar since it had a theme.  Other than having a theme, not much differentiated Wild Beaver from any other bar.  There was a stage where not much dancing was going on, even though the music was pretty good: classic 80s hits that the bar goers were too young to remember the first time around, old school Nelly, and songs that are popular today.

It was a girl's 21st birthday so they called her up on the bar to take a shot, and then allowed her and her friends to dance on the bar, which was pretty fun.

Overall, average experience, decent drink prices.

Exceptional drinks and unfortunately stops there..We were there with our MC of about 14 people and whoever ordered food was still waiting for it an hour later..dont no why, but the lottle waitress in her corset was not good at her job! Then they wanted to fight us for the bill and. harge us for the food becauae "its coming out now!" Sorry, we can go get served somewhere else without trying to get robbed..one of our guys actually got take out from across the street & we still had not received the food..so good for drinking, the resurrection was a great drink, but if u wanna eat do it somewhere else

Best liquor & wine store & selection in town! Been stocking up here for 25 years! There are some great wine & liquor pros. So if you're looking for something special or specific, chances are, these guys will be able to get you what you want. Of course, you get a case price on wine. And there are weekly wine tastings that are always fun. Their packages are no pricier than other liquor stores in Nashville. Matter of fact, there are stores in west Nashville that are higher on wine. I would put them as $$ not $$$.
It is in an odd place so entrance/exits are tricky depending upon which direction you're trying to go. So be careful turning left!

I really don't understand all the great reviews for this place. The guy who answered the phone was rude. I should of just hung up but I didn't. The food came quick and was hot but that's about all that I can say was good. The cheese on the cheese fries was nasty. It tasted old and like it was reheated many many times. As for the pizza... The crust was nasty. We ordered a white pizza with what was suppose to be fresh tomatoes. Let me tell you they were not fresh. The food is mediocre at best. Maybe they were having an off day but I wasn't impressed.

Third time here.  Different vehicle each time. This time a current Cadillac.  Car wash did a good job...BUT...found the next day part of the blue drying cloth wedged in to a seam in the body work of my car.  It is clear that it came very close to bending the metal on my car.  Have never had this occur in years of going to automated car washes.  This makes me wonder whether there is something fundamentally wrong with this part of the process.  I would have been angry had it managed to damage my car.  Not sure I will be back, especially with the Caddy!

Had dinner here tonight, Saturday, April 2nd.  After movie headed here.  Found a fairly large menu with wide variety of choices.  

Sweet tea was primarily sugar - too sweet for my tastes.  Two sweet potatoes - one good, other had unusual flavor and we did not eat it.  

Turkey bacon sandwich good. Nice flavor to turkey.  Had asked for it without tomato, but it came with tomato.  Chicken Marsala was salty.  Pulled pork was a bit inconsistent. 

Included dessert was one of those pre-packaged single serving ice creams.  Came up  short on what was expected.  

Satisfactory service.

Beautiful grounds. Nice rooms, pretty much a suite. Well insulated. HOT water in the shower and rooms. Friendly staff who takes time to remember you. Never quite made it to the bar and restaurant but there's an indoor pool. Working elevators, nonsmoking rooms but there's an easily accessible place on each floor to smoke if you need to. They give rewards for everyday you don't use housekeeping (points to your Starwood account or money towards the pantry). Free airport shuttle every 30 minutes. TVs in the lobby as well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm not a huge Chinese food fan, BUT, this place has found it's way into my heart. The food was so fresh and so reasonably priced. The service is friendly. They take really good care of your to-go orders. They even bag up the silverware separately. I had the Sesame Shrimp lunch plate and it was so filling, I couldn't eat it all. My coworker had the General Tsao's chicken and crab Rangoons and she's been raving about it ever since. She said it's so rare to find a place that uses white chicken for the plates. She loved the rangoons as well. She said it was very fresh and quite possibly the best she's ever had. We will be back!

I've been to Sushi Brothers several times for lunch to meet a friend. It's not very crowded during the day, so easy to get a table. They have their own parking lot across the street which is nice because street parking around that area can be hard to find. Today I had the seaweed salad and the Sushi Brothers special roll. The roll has salmon and avocado on top and tempura salmon and cream cheese inside. My friend had a house salad with extra ginger dressing, miso soup and tempura shrimp. All were good and fresh.

I like to go to this Surf Thru Car Wash. it is in an excellent location near the on and off ramp for Hwy 395/Interstate 580. The staff is super nice and helpful. They have self vacuums after you get your car wash. Having a pass, it includes unlimited washes and you get some additional items, such as, bag for any trash, air freshener and a "towel" to wipe down the inside of your vehicle. Sometimes the was doesn't get all the dirt spots on the car and I did notice with the black paint job I have on my vehicle it leaves rings or circles on it.

I have visited Hot Tuna 3 times in the last 2 weeks! I work nearby and they have a great lunch special menu and I get their 2 rolls with miso soup. I love their Mexican rolls, they are the best ones I've had in months.  The food is always fresh and ready when I get there to pick it up.

The restaurant itself is quaint but nice, its decor is simple but inviting and the staff is always super nice and helpful. I'm always able to get in and out in a reasonable amount of time. If you enjoy good fresh sushi at a good price, Hot Tuna is the way to go!

4.5 stars.  Moto is another successful M Street restaurant where you can't go wrong with any of them. I visited with a few coworkers for an early dinner.  It was 6pm and it was pretty vacant, but it was very busy by the end of the meal.  We ordered meatballs, calamari, and burrata.  The meatballs were not massive,  but they were good.  You get two with cheese and a spicy sauce.  The calamari had a marinara and a spicy aioli which was good.  The burrata was decent.  The calamari was my favorite of the three.  For my main course I ordered the black spaghetti.  I was as pleased as I could be.  It was excellent and will probably make me return.

I've been wanting to try this place for a few months, but I was nervous bc of the varying reviews.. Well, my review is good and bad:
Good:
Cute decor
House dressing 
Veal parm
Mashed potatoes 

Bad:
Calamari was okay, but tasted like it had been frozen
Crab cakes- tasted very fishy and gritty, several bones
Service- all of the people were very nice, but things got very very slow after the salads came out, and it took about 20 minutes for the waitress to the check to us after we asked for it 

My take away is: try Maria's down the street..

This was a great experience. I felt like the staff really cared about my business. They were friendly and quick to answer any questions we had. I loved that they brought out olives in olive oil with crusty bread to dip in for the table. I ordered the Merryman which had the most delicious brandy cream sauce with scallops & shrimp. I could have dipped the bread in that all day.
We finished the meal with a cannoli and espresso. It was a perfect end.
Keep in mind that this restaurant is a BYOB.
Overall, this was a great location to relax with friends, sip some wine and load up on some fresh Italian food.

I'm really glad I gave this place a shot for lunch. The entire menu is available for take out. They have really good lunch specials. I had the grilled salmon teriyaki and it was delicious. It comes with soup, salad, and rice. I wasn't a bug fan of the soup, but the salad was good and the rice was okay. My salmon came out on a really hot and sizzling on one of those fajita kinda plates. Really cool. The sushi is to die for. I sat at the sushi bar and watched the guy make them. He made one called a Hawaiian roll that looked so yummy I ordered it to go. I really enjoyed this experience.

Literally the worst! Tried this place based on a recommendation from a friend, and I will never take her recommendations seriously again. Service was terrible. I had to ask for a menu. It was very loud, and the layout was extremely awkward. I had just opted to get 2 rolls and my boyfriend got the all you can eat. I could barely eat my rolls because they just fell apart when I touched them (extremely frustrating). My boyfriend didn't seem to impressed with his food either. I really suggest going elsewhere because for me, this was not a pleasant experience. For nearly $50 you can get a lot better within a mile of this place.

We had to stop by the famous Pi pizzeria on our trip to st. Louis. Service was great, the topping options were expansive. Locally bottled Fizz's sodas were great and the facility was phenomenal! We ordered the deep dish and I have to admit that I was slightly disappointed. My expectations were in line with the deep dish pizzas of Chicago that I am deeply in love with and in my opinion these did not meet the mark. Our pie wasn't particularly warm when it arrived at the table and the tomato sauce was some what over powering. If/when we return. The thin crust will be the pizza of choice.

Thank goodness for a place like Joe's inside of the DMV!  We have all had to deal with long wait times, and it is refreshing to have a place where we can get drinks and/or snacks.
We both ordered different iced mochas and when asked if we could get lite ice, we were told that she puts a hot espresso shot in the cup, which will melt the ice anyway.  We know this, but we still wanted lite ice :/  Other than that, the drinks had decent flavor, I have had better and worse, which means that we will come back next time we need a pick-me-up while at DMV.

This DD location can't seem to get it together. Last time I visited I had problems with customer service and a wrong order. This time they managed to get my order right after asking me twice at the speaker and again at the window but the quality of the product was questionable. 

I ordered an iced coffee with milk and sweetener and 1 cruller. Simple enough! My iced coffee was more like room temp as it had about 3 ice cubes in it. My poor cruller was half flattened and pathetic to say the least.

This location has a lot of room for improvement to make for an enjoyable customer experience.

Had a good dining experience here.  The sushi was pretty decent, but not the best I have had. My first sushi experience in Tucson, so not sure how it stacks up locally yet. My friend got the tonkatsu (fried pork cutlet) which was cooked very well and super crispy. A lot of the sushi and entrees come with edamame and miso soup which were good (kinda hard to screw theses up).  The pistachio ice cream at the end of the meal was surprisingly good! Like, I would pay for a scoop of that. Solid 4 star restaurant, probs because of the bonus edamame, miso, and ice cream.
