I love the variety of chips they have that comes with their guac though but the last time I went, they seem to give less of those and more of the plain tortilla chips. I really like the margaritas they offer though. This place is definitely a date spot considering how small, dimly lit and cozy seating is. Altogether I still love this restaurant especially when outdoor seating is available.

I went here today for the first time. I was looking for a new mani/pedi place as I've been underwhelmed with other places in Green Hills.  I wasn't sure about going in, but thought it couldn't be much worse than some of the other spots I'd already tried.  When I entered I felt I'd made a good decision. They were so friendly and happy to have me there. Great selection of polishes, nice calm music, clean, really good massage chairs (all new and working), good foot and hand massage given by my lady.  Both mani and pedi were $40.
I will definitely go back.  This place didn't feel like a factory.

I can always count on Vetri to serve me a killer Neapolitan-style pizza! Favorite is definitely the pepperoni pizza - you can probably tell from my photos - but it's just too good! 

They have smooth, flavorful sauce. The cheese they use is always fresh and has the perfect chewy texture to contrast against a crisp, homemade crust. Speaking of crust, this is the reason I keep coming back. Pizza is always about having a delicious crust and Vetri knows how to make it spectacularly, with just the right amount of burnt bits and tender, soft spots.

I was skeptical at first of using a "chain" vet, but I took my new puppy in for a free exam from the Puppy Pack coupon book. Immediately, I was impressed both with the techs and the vet we saw. I opted to do the wellness puppy plan because I have a large breed dog who will grow rapidly her first year. I've already made my money back between free exams, vaccinations, and the discount on her Trifexis. This team is compassionate, caring, competent, and organized. Everything you'd want from a vet. I am very pleased! (PS i have two other pets and am not new to the vet scene)

I've been going to this nice little restaurant periodically for several years now and have always found the food to be of good quality and I always receive good, prompt service there as well. They have a nice variety of lunch meal and / or seafood cocktail daily specials, along with some good breakfast, lunch and dinner dishes. The waitress' have always been pleasant, prompt and attentive - but not pushy. The food portions are generous and very filling. Overall, it's just a nice, quiet little place to have a meal and relax for a bit.

Came here to grab lunch. The place was empty which I did not take as a good sign. The sushi was just blah which really sucked because I was in the mood for it. First of all the selection isn't that great as in they don't have any really cool rolls. The rolls were smallish but the real thing that bothered me was that the fish inside the roll was a little dull looking. It felt like I was eating the leftovers which is what I really don't want at a sushi place. This place seems to have good reviews on yelp so maybe this is a one off but I will not be returning.

Today was not a good day. I waited at the drive thru at least 30 minutes. Ordered  a venti peppermint mocha Frappuccino..didn't taste peppermint at all..a little too watery and didn't get the "venti" amount. And my tuxedo mocha Frappuccino tasted just likes a regular coffee but a little bittered...very disappointed. One of the drink came out all dripping on the side of the cup and the guy handed to me didn't bother to either clam it up or tell me about it till it got all on my hand then offer me some napkins....

It supposed to be a BIG FAT 0 RATING!!!!
Went in. waited at least 5 min cuz the guy was on the phone looking pissed. Saw a promotion, buy a $50 gift card and get a 1 foot sandwich  free. So I ask...the guy said only today's  sandwich.. NOT any sandwich... so NVM. so my sandwich listed $8. He charge us $9.25. I looked at the cash register it says $8.50. So I told him, it's  $8. He kept arguing said it's the tax. But $8 × 8.265 that equals $8.66. He kept saying 9.25 including tax and threw a fit. DUDE IF U CAN'T READ...U CAN DO THE MATH.. BUT IF U CAN'T DO EITHER,  QUIT OR CLOSE UR STORE! 
WATCH how they charge  you.. Always charge MORE

I went here to try the pizza because I've heard so many great reviews but I ended up getting pasta because it looked so good! The Meatballs and Spaghetti were pretty good! The Carbonara was just ok but I make it at home so I might be a tad bit biased. Well, I'm getting Pizza for sure next time because I've heard so many great things about it! I did get the infamous Cauliflower roll but again , I was so impressed by it! It was just ok. 
I'm told that i should get the pepperoni roll next time!!! 
I will be back for sure to get Pizza!!!!

Great night at the opening of this new restaurant and bar on Banks St! The food was all delicious and the drinks were excellent! Really enjoyed the ambience upstairs on the rooftop! The live music was a added treat too! They have a great menu and spectacular cocktail menu ! They charbroiled oysters were my favorite but I also enjoyed the spinach dip , the crawfish dip and the spinach dip. The crawfish and shrimp pasta was very tasty and included some slices of french bread covered in a delicious butter sauce! 
The buffalo wings were the bomb!!! 
I am looking forward to going back here and trying more dishes on the menu as well as cocktails!

I hate that terry parkway is the most convenient  one for me because they are sooooo slow. Why can't they just get it together like the rest of the awesome Starbucks drive thru! 

When I am leaving the West Bank at 4 heading to work from 6-2am I need my caffeine fix and this one just happens to be the closest drive through on my route before the GNO. Sometimes you just have to suffer a slow line for the greater good of caffeine in my veins. And by slow I mean a 15-20 minute wait in line and no whip on my venti after all that

We needed a place close to the airport and wanted to use some points so booked this older hotel.  It is a 5 min drive to the airport - that is a plus.  I am guessing this used to be something other than a Four Points since it appears most rooms are suites and it is built around an atrium. 

We were warmly greeted at check in and were supposedly given an upgraded room as a Gold member - not sure how this room was different.  Overall the place was looking pretty worn out especially in the bathroom.

If I am back through this area and need to stay by the airport I will look for other accommodations.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Friend of mine from Palm Harbor wants to meet this morning "do you know where Country Boy in on Main in Dunedin"?

Hell yes I do! This is really a great place- I mean the typical Greek run finer-but they do it just a little bit better here. Place is decorated just a bit better, always clean as a pin and the help is friendly/funny/fast. Coffee cups never get empty, food is good and plentiful and comes out quick. 

Yes I've been coming here for years and I plan on many returns. Good people, good food, nothing fancy but they do it well.

I arrived and the young guy took my keys quickly, he was a bit curt but I saw the huge group of people waiting for their cars. It looked quite busy and several workers were counting all the tips. I had 2 gift certificates I had been gifted and wanted to use them. It took about half an hour to get my vehicle. I think they left it better than it was when I took it in - hard water spots, dusty and bird droppings. It wasn't perfect but I was satisfied. I know some people have high expectations for a hand car wash. There's always a drive thru car wash that's cheaper!

I have consistently gone to Mr. Lube for my oil changes since my car has been out of warranty the past 4 years. This location is the one closest to my house and I find them to be good. I like being offered a coffee and paper when I get here. Waits are not bad if you are going during a less busy time (Shoot for weekdays, weekends can get crazy busy). Join the mr. lube club also to get access to coupons/discounts. I recently got a $15 off coupon via email from them and plan to use it this week. I haven't had any problems with my oil changes from them.

I know a lot of people have very strong feelings about Publix (especially as compared to Kroger). I don't. I think it's a fine store. More expensive that Kroger and with some healthier products, but with perhaps less variety in some areas of the store? This store is big, bright, clean. The only real difference I noticed between this Publix and others in the Nashville area is that this one seemed to have a more options in the international foods section (especially in the Kosher and European areas). Nice store. Fine store.

I go to this Publix all the time, so it's a little strange I hadn't reviewed it already! I know people in Nashville are OBSESSED with Publix, but I just think it's okay. It's bright, it's clean, it has good customer service, but it definitely doesn't have the broadest selection of products? There are certain things I buy at this store (and then other things I buy at a combination of Kroger, Fresh Market, and various international markets on Nolensville Road), but it's not full-service for me. Definitely a good, pretty standard store with your basics.

I had brunch at Josephine with two friends this past weekend. It had been on our list to try for quite a while, but it was the first visit for all of us. Three stars is a teensy bit harsh (wish I could give 3.5), but I think we all just thought the meal was okay. I had the lobster salad. It was fine. My two friends both had the Benedict (scrapple in place of the usual English muffin), which they liked fine as well. The service was okay. The restaurant is nice. They only have valet, but we all street parked and walked (that's 12 South). It was an okay meal. But it's not a meal or a restaurant I'd be excited to repeat?

Melt has quirky charm, and maybe a fun place to go see creative, juxtaposing of vintage and creative imagination along pinball and skew-ball games while you wait for your waffle to be made.

Basically waffles and stuff. Sweet, savory or plain. 

Again, creative combos though portion wise may be on the smaller side, soooo you might have to order an extra "half" portion if you have a bigger appetite.

Family ordered the buffalo chicken on waffle, waffle club and just plain waffle for the kiddie. Good, but wish it was a bit bigger.

Very mediocre Italian food. I ordered the eggplant rottilini - the eggplant itself with the ricotta and spinach was very good, but the sauce was flavorless and everything was little smothered in mozzarella cheese. I mean, I like my cheese as much as the next person, but this was ridiculous! My pasta-loving boyfriend ordered the bolognese rigatoni, and he had the same complaints about the sauce and cheese. He came into the restaurant starving, and couldn't even finish his plate because he disliked it so much. I doubt we'll ever be back. Even Italian food at a diner would've been better than this.

I agreed to come here with my best friend after she had been raving about this place for several weeks. After I took a class I was totally in love.  The staff here is like a family and they care about their clients. They use a model that helps each person reach their own fitness goals while simultaneously recognizing that everyone is different with different limitations and have different levels of fitness. I got my butt kicked (in the best way possible).  If you love endorphin highs then this place is for you! Special shout-out to the owner, Kevin, who is a wonderful human being and fantastic motivator!!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I've been wanting to try this restaurant for a couple years now. I've heard good things and it must be good if you apparently need to make reservations for any time. I tried it and was very disappointed. I walked in and stood there for a few minutes waiting to be helped; noone came. I had to go to the bar to ask someone about my reservation- not a good start. The owner was nice though. He eventually came over to greet us and was very helpful. The food wasn't what I had expected, not at all... It was very plain and lacked flavor. I wouldn't go back.

Debated between this and a snow cone place, and I'm so happy we picked this one bc they have a lavieen rosé flavor that was so heavenly. I loved the soft texture and the light crunch inside. It was melting a bit faster than I would have liked, but still enjoyed it thoroughly. 

The other flavors we tried were all really good. Service was fine and the interior is very bright and colorful, creating a happy feel right as you enter. There were some fun artwork on the walls that were hilariously cute. I'd def recommend if you are in the area!

First of all, I used to think yogurt was pretty disgusting. Then I realized not all yogurt tastes like the monstrosity that is Greek yogurt. Anyway, this place has a lot of flavors and they all are very pronounced. I now love yogurt. In particular, I like pretzel flavored yogurt with cheesecake chunks, sprinkles and strawberry chunks. It's pretty awesome. 

The price isn't bad for what you get and they are friendly people. It's great for groups and it's popular with the younger crowd. Overall, great yogurt, great price and the location isn't bad at all.

What a pompous ##### ...  The wife and kids were away, so I decided to try it bc I heard the pizza was good.. I ordered an $18 grilled chicken and asked for an app, which I requested to be a slice of pizza ( which they sell at the front counter). But I was told they will not serve slices in the back.. I said I'm not JUST ordering a slice, I am ordering a full meal.. Still they refused, but they "generously" offered to sell me a whole pizza.. If you are going to sell slices of pizza, how can you  discriminate where you sell them..

Lots of competition, if you are trying to set yourself apart, being a ##### isn't the way to go

Despicable service. Came with my family for breakfast and tried to use the computer to order. Nothing on it worked so we went to the cash registers to order. They said they were broke and we had to use the computers. So we had a employee that really was trying her best and had a smile on her face. God bless her heart for going through this. She put in our orders but we wanted a few substitutions that were not on the computer. She then walked up to the cash register and entered it there! The lazy manager had lied to us so she wouldn't have to take our order! Unbelievable! The cooks also messed up 2 of our orders. Crazy. -5 stars if possible.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I ordered this for a company luncheon. This was the cheapest thing I could find in town that would be enough for the amount of people I had, and when I actually picked it up I was surprised at how much food we got for the price. This was much, much better than most of the Chinese fast food I've had and I'm getting it again for lunch today.

With the Party Trays, I got steamed rice, Beef Broccoli, Sweet and Sour Chicken, General Chicken and the egg rolls and everything was great. We would have had plenty left over, but every single person went back for seconds. I was pleasantly surprised by the quality and the service for the price.

My mom and I came to check out this place on an early Saturday afternoon. Let me say, the outside is totally unassuming but you walk in and feel like you could be downtown or in some city. It's so cute and the decor is amazing. 

We ordered bloody Mary's which weren't great but whatever. We had French onion soup, duck meatballs and chicken Caesar salad. The food was awesome, really well cooked and decently large portions. 

They had a happy hour from 3-6 (or close to that) which I really want to check out. Overall definitely try this place!

Been awile since Ive been hear. I always liked the decor of this cafe. And the staff, I was hear on a Thursday morning and barley anyone in hear. Orderd full stack of French Toast and waited awile for it. About 35 min. For a place that was not packed that seem kinda along, and especially with the high price of the food. It be out alittle faster. I can't denie the fact that it is well kept up place. So made the reason for the high priced food and the specials they have its only 2 and they are even on the pricy side. 

I might come back in the future if around the area but definitely won't be my go 2 spot for breakfast!!

my wife and i just moved from the city to west conshy. let me tell you, this place has everything. after seeing the picture of hamm's on yelp, i knew this place was for me.  sadly, they dont have hamms anymore and that was a couple years ago. either way, this southern gothic style abandoned mansion turned bar is tits. cheap beer, amazing, friendly staff. it also has a bathroom. uber drivers are confused where youre driving them to, and might think youll take advantage of them, but then when you explain where youll going, they still confused but drop you off. 5 stars. less dangerous than old philly bar.

Still one of the best pork chops around!  The 3 sauces are all different and good in their own way.  My fav is the mole.

The piri piri chicken was awesome.  Polenta was mild and tasty and the spicy sauce is definately spicy.  

Toasted sour dough bread was just right.  A bit crunchy shell but I liked it.

The carrot mole wasnt my favorite.  Kind of a weird tomato carrot puree flavor and the cilantro on top wasnt for me.

Brussels sprouts were flavorful but I like them grilled and charred better than cooked, steamed or boiled.

First night in New Orleans and of course I would end up in a bar that reminds me home, South Florida! With a live band going strong and happy guests throwing grenadines, my cousin and I sat and jammed. We ordered the signature drink, The Hand Grenadine and it was so sweet, delicious, and refreshing. EXTREMELY DANGEROUS BECAUSE ITS SOMETHING YOU CAN DRINK AND DRINK AND IT WONT HIT YOU TILL ITS TOO LATE. So worth it, and so worth the time. Awesome atmosphere and good people! Our bartender Kyle was so splendid to talk to, was easygoing, and extremely knowledgeable about NO.

Great prices, friendly staff, clean.  Those are the positive aspects.  Now... the meat is SUB PAR.  Don't get your meat here if you care about your health.  I'm not saying it's spoiled... I'm just saying it's just a bit questionable at times.  Produce is decent, layout is good, bulk items are fun... it's just the meat that is kinda sketchy.  Pretty sure  it's lower grade than Savemart or Walmart.  Also - sometimes when I've had a long day and my back is almost like OUT... bagging my own groceries is not awesome.  Worth the savings, though.

$8 for 2 different types of rolls and a salad? YES PLEASE!

I got take out so I can't really comment on the service but when I was waiting for my food the hostess was very kind. The restaurant was very clean which is always a good sign since you are about to eat raw fishies. Inside is modern looking, plenty of spots to sit but I can see how it could get crowded on a Friday night.

The rolls were good. Not as much rice nicely rolled on the outside as I would have liked BUT, nonetheless it was yummy. The spicy tuna rolls were really tasty and of course California rolls were good as well.

Great price for good food!

Horrible!!!!!! I've rented from other Thrifty's and NEVER had issues. I got in at 12am & was already tired & irritated and encountered the worst clerk ever. She tried to charge me $350 deposit on top of the car fee of $189 mysteriously after I declined their insurance. BITCH PLEASE!!!! I was using a major credit card and have never been charged a deposit. Most of the other car rental agencies were closed, but thank God Budget wasn't and they helped me out & at a cheaper rate!!!!!!!!! I will never rent from them again & you shouldn't either!!!!!!

Mixed review here...my company prefers I use Hertz, so that's usually what I book. The car I got this week smelled like someone had left week old spaghetti under a seat. I don't know how else to explain it...so I wasn't so pleased about that, and when I told the person a the return area, she didn't seem very interested.

The bright side of this review, David was the shuttle driver getting me back to the airport and he was very friendly and pleasant. It was very clear he loved his job and took it seriously.

Five stars for David.
One star for the car and other staff.

We stopped into this Dunkin on a Sunday morning and the line was crazy long. The way the store is set up there really isn't room for more than 4-5 people to stand in line so we were wrapped around like a cinnamon roll blocking the door.

When we finally got up to order the gentleman that helped us was nice and seemed attentive. Got us our donuts, and gave us a number for the rest of our things. After waiting about 10 min and still not getting two of our things, we went up to the counter only to realize that he never rang up two of our sausage biscuits. By this point, we didn't want to stand in line again and wait, so we left.

Been here once before and I think it was better last time. Donna was really friendly and informative but the food was just kind of meh. Breads and spreads before knocked me out of the park, this time it was just ok (they change it seasonally). This time it has forgettable hummus, a red pepper spread, and an odd tasting quinoa fritter. Overall weird flavors and nothing special. The mushroom toast was my favorite. salmon tartare was really quite awesome and fresh but I think it should have been served with something other than chips, maybe wonton crackers or something

short and sweet .. ho sai gai is a philly chinatown staple for americanized chinese food. been going here sporadically since they were at their previous location at 10th & cherry with the ginormous buddha in the vestibule. lol. stopped in last night for take out. the gentleman who took my order on the phone was super friendly. when i arrived the same gentleman waited on me at the counter and was friendly and talkative. really nice guy. food was as expected .. hot and tasty. maybe i need to stop by more often. no complaints.

I love Station Tap House! I love trains, so being able to look out the giant windows at the trains, either coming and going or just parked on the tracks is a major bonus for me. This restaurant also has very versatile seating options - from a nice long bar, bar tables, or more family friend tables in the back. The food is always tasty and they offer a great variety of options. I've had great appetizers, sandwiches, or nice entree style meals. Station Tap House is a great choice for lunch, dinner, drinks, snacks any time of day!

This 4 story hotel that is of the interior atrium design is a nice hotel. I stayed here for 3 nights last week and enjoyed my stay. Check in was easy and courteous. The atrium is very nice with an inside restaurant and bar. My 2 room suite was very good and up to the standards I expect when staying at a Hilton Suites. Parking availability was adequate. I only ate breakfast one morning and the buffet was good and plentiful with several choices. They also have an indoor pool. There are also several restaurant options nearby.

When I return to Nashville I will stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is different than your typical restaurant because you order when you walk in and then they bring your food to your table. Margaritas aren't displayed on their menu board but they do have a full bar and have various margarita flavors. Brian, the host, was so kind and personable. I ordered three tacos which were delicious. My dad ordered Adrians Burrito . Now for my dad, Mexican food typically isn't his go to but he devoured his dish and said he needed to come back again soon with my mom.. that speaks volumes. I would definitely recommend trying this place out.

Very spacious gym. One of the largest hotel gyms I've seen.
*No Pool
*Mirrors in stretch/an area and free weights

Gym: 
1. Cardio Machines: 5 treadmills, 3 ellipticals, 3 bikes
2. Weights: Free weights. Several machines for legs, arms, chest, and back
3. Extra Equipment: Bosu balls (half and full), medicine balls, kettle bells, and 2 adjustable chairs

Room: Smelled smokey upon entrance and my room was a non smoking room. They brought a deodorizer to neutralize it

Overall I wouldn't recommend. The gym is great however you need to feel comfortable as can be while away from home as traveling can be stressful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I give this place 5 stars for food, and 2 stars for service, so that is what makes up this 3 star rating. They have a great sushi happy hour special which is what brings me in. I pretty much loved all of the food. We had a seaweed salad, several rolls of sushi, and ramen noodles. Everything was tasty.

I've had issues with timely service, and also one of the waitresses made a mistake charging credit cards, and had to reverse everything out and re-do it. I shouldn't judge on this one experience, but my friend that was with me told me that this has happened before at this restaurant.

I will be back, and hopefully the service improves.

I love Publix!!! This is by far the best supermarket we have in the Tampa Bay Area. The service is great! They do a really nice job training their employees to provide good service to their customers.  Every time I ask for help, even if they don't know what I'm looking for, they ask their peers and use their resources. 

Publix is always clean and everyone is friendly. In the bakery they have free cookies for children.  Their subs are good too!  And let's not forget about the bakery, where they have ready to pick up cakes as well as made to order.  This is my favorite grocery store.  Publix truly is where shopping is a pleasure.

Walked in here and was pretty surprised by the ambience. It's clean and very stylish. 
My family and I were craving sushi and wanted a quick bite to eat. The waiter seemed to be attentive, but he seemed to have mumbled quiet a few times when we were talking with him. Maybe he was just having a bad day?
The sushi is surprisingly cheap (or cheap for the city) for the quality and quantity. When the sushi was brought out, it was garnished with so many different sauces, it looked amazing. So clean and colorful! 
Have to say, if I'm around here and craving sushi again, I'll be back!

Gotta drop this gym to a 3 star. This is the closest planet fitness near me, but I try to not come here considering a lot of the equipment seems to be broken. (At least 4-5 machines were done the last time I was there) I've noticed several times when I'm there that there's people standing at the counter not really doing anything other than talking. All this happening while one or two trash cans were all to the brim with paper towels. Also, I'm not sure if this is just me or what, but the lighting is a bit off. It feels a bit dim compared to the other planet fitnesses I've been to.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Came in for the weekend and was celebrating a birthday.  Easy access to come in and self park is less expensive than valet by $4.  The bar is great and our bartender Ryan was awesome and attentive making sure we were ok with our drinks.  The hotel room has a European feel which is different and pretty neat to see how the light switches do different lighting.  We were on the 6th floor where the pool and gym is located. The only downfall is we went to the pool and the bar was closed during the day on Saturday.   Will be coming back to stay to be able to go around downtown and hang out and go to the restaurants and bars
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Actually really clean, affordable last minute rates if any rooms are available. Great location, confusing valet.
Rooms very modern, very clean even the bathrooms were stylish. The bar is trendy and convenient but they only ever have one person working and a lot of large group's coming through so check in can be annoying but staff is friendly.
 Very sensitive smoke alarms, I only did one dab and the darn thing was going off for like an hour. Such a hassle lol the girl at the front seat was kinda annoyed with me. They offer bliss spa brand beauty bathroom essentials which I think is super awesome
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ordered online for delivery to a hotel in the CBD.  Got the lasagna, comes with Caesar salad and cheese bread.  A good size portion, very generous with the cheese, the sauce was ok.  Had green peppers, which I wasn't expecting.  Could have used a little garlic and salt, but those are my personal preferences.  Salad was fine, cheese bread looked like a slice of pizza and very cheesy.  Also, ordered mozzarella sticks.  They were fine, marinara was basic, nothing spectacular.  Showed up on time, no complaints with delivery.  The meal hit the spot.  It was nice to order in, and give my achy feet a break.

They didn't clean very well. We saw two rooms. The first had structural issues, was dusty and dark and the outside security door didn't work. Someone from our group walked into the hotel without a key card. The second room had hair in the bathroom, dry pee on the toilet, dirt on the toilet seat, dirty hand prints all over the doors, stains on the chairs, and dust over the lampshades. I think all the cleaning staff did was change the sheets. It was a little brighter though. Water pressure in the shower was great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Loveeeee this place! My sweetheart & I decided to spend our Sunday date night here. I had seen on a Yelp review the $17.99 unlimited so I asked our waiter (who was so kind and informative, wish I could remember his name :( but our chef was super fun too! The staff all around rocks!) but yes he told me that actually where it was a Sunday it was even cheaper, $15.99. What?! what?! Definitely can't beat that for unlimited hibachi AND sushi. Definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for amazing hibachi, delectable sushi, or a phenomenal mix of both. We'll definitely be back.

A couple red flags : you cannot reach corp for any inquiries or issues. Everything goes through the local location which means if you have any issues with equipment, faculty or billing you're screwed. I emailed corp and never heard back and all calls go to the local gym. 
Which leads me to the everyday issue and more important to most gym goers. Broken and old run down equipment. Make sure to really go over the contract and terms so you understand the true cost of business as well. Every 2-3 months you'll see all new staff including management if that says anything.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: New spot in Burlington and to my knowledge the only sushi spot. Decided to get some takeout the other night. Going into it I had low expectations, but I gotta say I was impressed. I ordered online and to my surprise the estimated time was only 15 minutes. I drove there and still expected to have to wait for it to be ready, but as soon as I walked in it was ready to go. We got a few different sushi rolls, the shrimp shumai, and the chicken teriyaki bento box (which also comes with sushi). Everything was great. Staff was friendly. The inside of the restaurant looked pretty nice too and I am sure will be great when they open indoor dining again.

Oh. My. Friggen. Goodness!!!! You. Will. Die!!! This place is delish!!!! 

The quality of their ingredients is tasted with every morsel. Sooooooooooo good. Just plain delish and savory Italian with modern twists and updated presentation. Totally worth your time! You will be craving this place after one meal here. 

If you can't make up your mind about the wines, they are happy to provide you with a taste before you commit. 

The service is kind, helpful, and sweet!  A jewel in the neighborhood. I'm happy it's not in another part of town, otherwise we may never get a seat. A must visit if you are in the Tampa Bay Area!  YUMMMMMMMMMY!!

I saw that they won best crab cake as voted on by Delco Times readers so I had to try a sandwich. My buddy got one to go and gave me half. I'm amazed this was recognized as best. I found mostly filler and very little crab. A HUGE disappointment. Occasionally Yours's crab cake on first Friday blows this out of the water - big chunks of fresh lump crab with very little Panko breadcrumbs to bind it together. The problem is it's only available once a month. I'll be trying Frankies On Fairview next since they came in as the best of the rest.

It was Wednesday. Not a seat to be found at the bar when I walk in to wait for my takeout order. Then I found the reason why - it was Meatballs and Martinis- deals on drinks and free food. 

Soon my order was ready and I was on my way. 

The pizza was tasty - good thin crispy crust and nice blend of sauce and cheese. The salad had a delicious Nana blended dressing. The wings were ok but exactly as advertised. 

Anthony's might be a franchise but it is a good option for folks looking for delicious Pizza and like items. Since the Mecca of Pizza - NYC - is hours away, this is a great local option for a pizza fix.

We were there yesterday for Happy Hour. 

Loved our waitress Courtney. Did a great job.

My lady had the house Chardonnay and it was fine for the value. I had a vodka tonic and it was ok. 

The complimentary bruschetta was tasty as was the bread. We ordered only appetizers - crab cakes, roast pork sliders and meat ball parm sliders. Crab cakes were ok. Roast pork slider was ok. Meatball parm was ok. Shot of limoncello was nice touch (complementary) but they need to make their own in house.

This place does great on a Friday happy hour. Overall it's just ok. Not great, not terrible.  There are better choices for both happy hour and Italian.

Maritsa's is a hidden gem. My family loves this spot and I had never been before. My mom and I went yesterday for lunch and it was an amazing experience. We went around 1:00 PM; there was no wait. 

I ordered the bacon, egg, and cheese sandwich and it was AMAZING. It was 100% a 10/10 breakfast sandwich. The bacon was cooked to perfection and it came on a Kaiser roll. They also had excellent coffee; it was very fresh. 

Our waitress was so sweet and very attentive. She checked on us several times to ensure that we had everything we needed. 

Truly this was the best experience! Absolutely stop by the next time you're in the area.

The food was fine, we had a coupon for sandwichs and drinks.  We had came here once before on a Sunday afternoon, but the restaurant was closed.  We were told the restaurant was only open at night, so we came back.  The restaurant was closed and we had called before driving over.  I asked why it was closed and 'Presto', they opened up and sit us down, but left the closed sign up.  I didn't understand why and the whole experience was wierd and confusing because we were the only ones present in a huge dining room at prime dining time.

Finally stopped in with some trepidation based on all reviews.  Had breakfast with 3 friends.  Arrived at 8:30 am.  Our orders (various egg dishes) arrived at 9:10.  Very slow service and eggs and home fries were cold.  Waitress explained some issue with plate heating system and offered to reduce our tab.  I understand the cafe is adult owned and kid run.  Unfortunately the kids haven't figured out how to provide fast warm food yet.  We locals love its location and want it to succeed but I wonder how long we'll tolerate the slow service and cold food?

This is the best traditional pizza in the area. Have been visiting here since they opened and it had several items I love. I am a huge fan of their Italian Stromboli & the cheesesteak Stromboli. The pizza is great and their Sicilian is a staple when I have a casual get together or party.
I do like their hoagies and cheesesteaks but there are definitely much better options for those items nearby. 
Sometimes it is a challenge picking up on s Friday or Saturday night due to volume, but order early and plan to wait.
Definitely a great choice for pizza in Chalfont.

Their peanut butter burger is amazing, but their house-made ketchup is watery ragu sauce. They need real ketchup. Even if it's hipster to make your own ketchup, if it's not good- I'd still rather have Heinz. Some of their items on the menu are kinda bad pairings of foods that shouldn't go together, and they really don't go together. I think if they were to make more staples with a twist rather than trying to shoot for some high cuisine experience, they'd be more of a staple in our week. Their upstairs patio is great though. And the peanut butter burger is OUT OF THIS WORLD.

This hotel was pretty great. The room and bathroom were clean, the bed was comfy, and the price was reasonable. Also, we requested a later check out of 1pm and they approved it which was nice. 

My only beef is that upon check out they said our bill was paid ahead of time so we were set to go. We asked if we could leave our luggage with them for about an hour so we could go have brunch. They said yes. We pick everything up no problem. Everything was fine until we see that they tacked on a separate extra $70 charge after we checked out, we assume to be for the luggage. Would've been fine if they warned us but they didn't mention it at all.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It's a McDonalds, so one should not expect much. A fast coffee in the morning, a quick bite to eat on the way somewhere. But this particular McDonalds is the worst on both accounts. They tore it down and rebuilt it and now it's worse than ever. The customer service totally sucks and it takes forever to get served. They will get your order wrong and they will overcharge you, no doubt about it. Or you will be waiting by the cash register and they will just ignore you until you say something. I work nearby and used to come here because it was convenient but not anymore. Blech stay away until they get new management! You have been warned
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very clean place and well maintained.  Looks like a complete renovation lately.  Skimpy continental breakfast.  Iron and board, fridge, microwave hair dryer, coffee maker.  Shampoo, lotion, thick towels and wash cloths.  It in the shadow of I-10 and I was worried about noise, so I set the fan for white noise .  I probably didn't need it because late night was pretty quiet.  I was worried about rowdy guests because for NOLA, this is a cheap motel.  Free parking.  Guests were quiet too!  Will stay here again, great mattress and pillow!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The room next room has what looks like repaired bullet holes in the door.  There is mold in in the corner of the bath tub.  They didn't vacuum the rugs when there was stuff on it and there was a long hair and an empty soap package on the bathroom floor.  Loud music and talk late and early.  The clerk is less than interested in unlocking the door in the morning for breakfast.  There was a huge rain last stay and the street in front was flooded and I couldn't even get in the place.  This room has feather flat pillows, don't like that.  Time to find somewhere else.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Being born and bred in South Philly, I was concerned when moving to the burbs (in 2003) that I wouldn't be able to find a good place for pizza or cheesesteaks anymore.  Well, within a month I knew that not only had I been dead wrong about that, but Nino's has the BEST pizza I've ever had.  Their Italiano pizza, margarita pizza, cheesesteak pizza, taco pizza and ziti pizza are ALL incredible. My wife and I have been loyal customers of Nino's at least once a week since we moved here...and if I ever moved away from the area would need to make special trips here.

Recently had a really enjoyable and tasty girls night out at Sushi on the Rocks. It was Thursday and the martinis were half price! The rolls here are very unique, so you really have to branch out to enjoy the place. The udon soup was very good and the noodles were some of the best I've ever had. I liked the look of the place, but there are a bank of televisions in the middle of the dinning room and while we were eating we were treated to having Wheel of Fortune and Jeopardy playing next to our faces. Totally killed the vibe.

Not a fan. The food was ok and the owner, George, was very friendly. The lady taking our order, however, was incredibly rude. Our group had varying price points on our final receipts, even though we ordered the same tacos. I had one steak and one chicken taco, with 2 extra toppings (only 2 are included with the order), which made my price per taco jump from $2.99 to $4.24 (not a typo with the .24 there). Oddly, I some how ended up with one corn and one flour tortilla, even though I asked for corn. 
My total order, 2 tacos, chips, guac and a diet coke was $17.12. Holy cow. While the tacos were good, I've never in my life paid that much for one.

Fat Mo's use to have the best wings around. A couple months ago, I got an order that tasted horrible. They were smaller, excessively coated in breading and missing the typical spicy kick. In fact, they tasted just like that gross crap you order over the counter at a WalMart deli. So much so that I figured they must've run out and bought some pre-cooked crap from WalMart and re-sold it. Well, I gave it another try and at a different location. Gone are the good wings of days passed. I guess the WalMart wing is the new standard. Won't be back, unfortunately.

Dr. Ford is amazing. He takes his time going over pre-op and follow-up treatment plans each time I go in. My first experience was taking my Dacschund in (which we adopted) to have nearly a dozen teeth extracted due to severe decay and halitosis - it was brutal. Our dog also has a heart murmur. Dr. Ford took all of this into consideration and went over it thoroughly with me in the blood panel, and choice of anesthesia since some can cause adverse affects to their hearts and our dog is now living much happier and healthier, albeit with a bit of a hillbilly smile now. It's part of his charm. :)

I have been going to various Planet Fitnesses in the New Orleans area recently, and the Metairie location does not live up to the cleanliness standards of the franchise. While the equipment is clean, the water fountain looks like it hasn't been wiped down in months. Lots of dust and debris has pilled up on the back of the water bottle refilling station as well. 

This location also is poorly lite and typically overcrowded. 

On the plus side it's by far the coldest gym I have set foot in as of late! If you are looking to pump some iron while staying cool, you are in luck.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Came here for lunch one day and surprise surprise I ordered a burger. This place got best of the best in south jersey I think for breakfast so I think next time that's what I will try. The staff are friendly, and the place was clean. Had a good amount of choices on the menu and I believe serve breakfast all day.

The burger was fine and so were the fries, but burgers are my thing so if it's not amazing I don't have much to say unless it's bad, which it wasn't. Good place to go when you want to keep things casual.

I went on a Friday with a friend. We beat the Friday night reservation crowd and were seated right away which was nice, but our service was awful. We believe the waitress forgot to put in an order because my sashimi sat on the counter waiting to be delivered for about 15-20 mins. We saw several other tables get served before us even though they sat down after. I usually get sashimi so I expect to pay more for my food but Fat Salmon is definitely higher priced than other Sushi Bars in the city. However, the sashimi pieces were generous and everything tasted very fresh. I also liked the presentation in the boat.

Absolutely a quintessential beach bar -- if you don't have expectations too high and can relax and enjoy the view, you'll have a great time. On my recent visit to the Dolphin Resort, I stopped in here after our conference each evening with other conference guests. A nice vibe and the weather was gorgeous. My only hang up is that the wine selection isn't that great -- but that's me being picky as a drinker, and nothing to do with the location itself. My star rating is based on that since I didn't order food here. They had live music a couple times when I was in town -- also a bonus!

For personal bank account use, Bank of the West is probably one of my favorite banks to use. For my business accounts however, they have room for improvement. The bank fees for business accounts are kind of ridiculous. 
But the Sparks location is my favorite location in the Reno area. Their customer service is Always friendly and they know my face. I recently had a problem with the Reno location and Sparks tried their best to resolve it. I go out of my way to visit the Sparks location for all my business needs!!

Upon entering store, no one approached us while we waited to order. No person at the register. Person on drive thru was getting fries for his orders, and no gloves touching them, after handling money. Yucko. Finally a young woman came to take our orders. 

FYI, a reuben sandwich has sauerkraut. Mine was MIA. Basically, I got a corned beef and swiss. Bread was flimsy, not toasted or grilled, and mushed.  Skimpy on cheese too. Curly fries were OK.  
Chocolate shakes were not consistent amount of chocolate and not mixed well, AKA vanilla on the bottom. 
Spent about $26 on 3 meals including the coupons. Not worth it. Meats have a weird texture.

Nice staff but the overall visit was a fail. Ordered 2 regular mozz sticks and half of them were old and chewy not fresh and one order only had 3 in it and a random jalapeño popper. Also got their 2 for $5 fish, that was a mistake. The sandwiches made me and my friend feel sick afterwards bc they too were old and kinda chewy like they have been setting out for a while. 

Won't be going to this location again probably. Horribly food quality and taste.

Have been to a lot better locations, this one might need a little revamp on how to prepare food.

Great for fresh fish sandwiches when they have them, unfortunately it's only offered randomly during part of the year. 

The lady that helped me today was polite and professional, very nice :) that was a definite plus especially making sure she knew what sauces we'd need bc we were asked to pull forward .

The only big let down was old mozzarella sticks, especially after waiting on Greg fish I was shocked our mozzarella sticks would then be old and chewy unsteady of fresh n crispy. Other than that it was a great experience, hoping next time for fresh mozzarella Stix!

Overall what you'd expect for an authentic Mexican restaurant. 

The chips and salsa were good and we got sat quickly. 

The booths are a bit dated and the tables was a little small but overall a nice dim dining experience. 

The server we had wasn't very efficient, we were left waiting on drink and salsa refills. And he seemed confused that I wanted queso on top of my entree. 

The food came out nicely and correct. Very filling and all tasted pretty good!

Overall this place was good, not amazing but a decent place to get authentic tasting food. Might try a different one next time I'm in town.

Definitely not the happiest place in the world.

I came here with my boyfriend, not having heard or read anything about it. Although the rain may have had something to do with it, we were one of only two occupied tables in the whole restaurant during prime dining hours.

Despite the emptiness, service was still really slow. We had to flag our waitress down several times. 

The food was just alright. I ordered the French Dip Sandwich; he ordered the Meatball Sub. Nothing special. 

I think the problem with this place is just that it's ridiculously average. At least their bar selection is pretty impressive--maybe we'll come back for Happy Hour.

Photo on left was what I asked for, photo on right is my own hand. SPOT ON! Nang understood exactly what I was looking for. She communicated with me the whole time to make sure we were getting my desired result. This is a French hombre dip manicure. I also had a pedicure which was fine. The place is clean and new, with a nice sound system playing pleasant music. No TV. A little pricier than others but totally worth it in my opinion. Nice location in the heart of Media if you have other errands to run in the area.

I came with a large group during peak lunch hour and we all ordered from the lunch menu which meant our food came out within 15 minutes or so. It actually might have taken longer for the complimentary bread and the ordered drinks to come out once we sat. 

I ordered the rigatoni broccoli and chicken and while I enjoyed my meal well enough (too little salt & flavor), others at my table complained that their dishes were too watery and you could actually see what they were talking about. 

The pizzas came out perfect so I'd recommend sticking to the pizzas here

Let's call it a 2.5 rounded up to a three star. 
Why? Because it's average at best. 
It's a decent waterfront bar with a great view of the sunset located on Clearwater Beach -as part of the Holiday Inn property.
Wednesday night they offer half-price burgers which makes it a pretty good deal. Other than that consider the food average. 
Breakfast was served by a great friendly, competent staff. 
But again, sadly, the food was only average --lacking in real flavor profile.  they make up for the flavor in quantity, if that's any consolidation.

Average at best. My neighbor wanted to go here for the early bird special. $15 three-course meal sounded pretty good. 

The house wine -- barely drinkable. 

I ordered the mahi-mahi and it came out still swimming. Don't give me wrong, it was really overcooked, but swimming in some sort of an odd godly soupy sauce all over the plate. 
The crème brûlée was institutional. It  resembled crème brûlée that have been left in the fridge for four days. 

There are a lot of wonderful restaurants in downtown St. Petersburg, unfortunately for me this is not one of them.

First time here- I'm not a fan of smoking/smoke, so we got drinks & went outside on the patio where they had a projector playing the Rays game on the wall approx 14feet x 20ft - as well as other tvs with other games.  Bartender staff came out to take our order for the next couple of rounds, which was great so that we didn't have to go back inside & carry drinks out. "Elwood" was friendly, funny & a great bartender- we will be back for sure because of him!!! Prices were pretty good too (I didn't see the bill... But my husband said it was great!)

First time here- I'm not a fan of smoking/smoke, so we got drinks & went outside on the patio where they had a projector playing the Rays game on the wall approx 14feet x 20ft - as well as other tvs with other games.  Bartender staff came out to take our order for the next couple of rounds, which was great so that we didn't have to go back inside & carry drinks out. "Elwood" was friendly, funny & a great bartender- we will be back for sure because of him!!! Prices were pretty good too (I didn't see the bill... But my husband said it was great!)

This was my first visit- I typically don't go to all you can eat or buffet restaurants. I was pleasantly surprised with the fresh sushi rolls. Appetizers are for 1 person so order more if you're sharing. The hibachi had a salty brown sauce on it- next time I will ask for sauce on side, or no sauce. I really enjoyed the scoop of mango sorbet after eating sushi & hibachi- it was refreshing & settled our tummies. The server we had, Billy C, was very attentive & treated us well! I believe the lunch menu is the same, only cheaper. I will likely return!

I wouldn't think of reviewing a rental car business, but I have to say I was severely impressed by Enterprise twice now.  I used Enterprise when my car was in the shop due to an auto accident.  They quickly came and picked me up from the body shop and hooked me up with a rental. The even upgraded the rental to a premium vehicle to match mine when the insurance company would only pay for an economy!  When the insurance company was dragging their feet in paying the rental bill, they stayed on them to remit payment and I didn't have to do any work.

We called to get reservations for New Year Eve and was told we had to go to the restaurant n speak to a manager. They did have 12-14 opening for the package special.
We went down there told them we would like to speak to a manager which was Paul. In the mean time we would like to order drinks n some food.
Was seated on the patio, waited 10 minutes before we were acknowledged, order water n drinks, and nachos. Waters came out another 10 minutes drinks n then the nachos. 
Guess what NO MANAGER!!!! Place was disorganized and NOTHING SPECIAL or great about this place.... 
Won't back there again !!!!

Horrible customer service. I was returning a car Sunday evening after 7:00. There was no one around. No instructions. Waited and waited. Walked to the exit booth where I was told no one works after 7:00. After hemming and hawing he directed me to the "Gold" booth. Which is on the opposite corner of the garage and painted black. I'm short and could not see it.  Mary was at the counter and had an attitude. I recommended some signage. She got snippy with me. Offered to call a manager. He was unavailable. Mary said employees have complained a lot but nothing gets done. This location needs some serious customer service training and better signage.

Stopped into an empty restaurant on Saturday at 5:30, dined the entire meal like this! And to give an update, it's still a BYOB

Order unagi roll, spicy tuna hand roll, fire cracker, and special of the day roll called battle.

Unagi and the hand rolls were up to par, but nothing extraordinary. The fire cracker and battle rolls were what you would expect for specially rolls at that price - not that it was TOO expensive, but I like it to justify the $$. Fish tasted fresh, interesting combinations, and nice presentation. Only complaint was both dishes were plated the same. Seems lazy since we were the only people in the restaurant.

Everyone at Ian's was fabulous! Eric provided a very thorough quote with several options to replace two of my tires. He was also very patient as I asked several questions and helped me find the best option for my car and my wallet. The desk staff were no different, also very kind, personable and helpful. It took 1 1/2 hours to get my two tires replaced - tip: there's a donut shop right next door which is a great place to grab a cup of coffee and a donut while waiting. I'm definitely coming back the next time I need new tires!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Hot coffee. Quick service. And 2 desserts for $3 AFTER 4PM!!! Why am I just finding this out?

It's Starbucks? What do you expect?

This is going to be my preferred location in DE because the other 3 always having some kind of problem. In order from worst to least worst are:
-Concord - unnecessary long waits; poor order accuracy, pastries aren't pulled from the display when they run out (this isn't a problem if you like playing the guessing game)
-Marsh - unnecessary long waits
-Kirkwood - unnecessary long waits; poor order accuracy

^Disgruntled patron

I have to be honest, I have been here many, many times to get my son's hair cut. I don't typically do the online check in but today, I did. I am not sure why though because the wait was 20 mins longer than the online site said that it was going to be. It makes no sense why a place like this does not staff appropriately. If I wanted to wait 40 mins, I would go somewhere with much more experience than this. 
The hairdressers have zero personality and don't interact with children very well. I guess its time to move on....

For the most fastidiously groomed.  Overwhelming selection of shaving, hair care products, hair cuts, beard trims you could find anywhere.  Complimentary drink as you sit down.  I highly recommend this place if you are removing a beard, you may want to grow another one just for the lavish shave.  I felt comfortable with a straight-razor shave, even after seeing Godfather movies.  Service is professional and friendly.  Overall cost is double most barbershops, so luxury becomes the expectation.  Eccentric collection of books for sale on Gentle-Manliness.

So I have gotten rotten chicken there 3 times before the sell by date. So I decided I'll continue shopping there and just not but meats. The other day I bought avocados and came home to make guacamole  and the were moldy! So my boyfriend went back to the store and wanted a refund on exchange and the "night manager" said he couldn't be trusted with the keys to the register to do that. We should come back the next morning for a refund and spend more money on gas! What  manager can't do refunds?! That place needs a inspection because it's disgusting and the policy's are horrible!

Had the onion relish burger and it was good. Just a burger and relish. But the reason for my low score is the lobster bisque - on a scale of 1 to 10 I rate it a 3. So full of corn starch or flour that it's a gelatinous solid. Combined with little seasoning or flavor and microscopic molecules of lobster, it should be overhauled or taken off the menu. For actually great lobster bisque, try Spikes, Point Lobster or Atlantic Fisheries, all in Point Pleasant Beach, New Jersey. Because Chambers 19 isn't even in their league of cream and butter bathed lobster bisque heaven of those three eateries.

Ok well I'd heard so much about this place i had to try it. Well NEVER AGAIN! Dirty Dirty Dirty! Rude service. Chicken parm outrageous over priced. N never in life had chicken parm covered in black pepper. Would of sent back if waiter ever came back to table. Bread was so old n when asked for new i was questioned if i new what i was talking about. Well since i grew up in the food industry. I think i know. N from dirty table clothes. Too dirty glasses not once but 2x give up on clean one. If it wasn't for husband stopping me complaining right then u would of heard it all in person. I know restaurant have off nights. But this was beyond OFF.

Sake Café used to be very good, but it seems like the quality has disappeared.  I can remember when the local chain used to get very fresh fish, but lately the fish has been old. 

I ordered the Sashimi lunch. I recieved 8 pieces of sashimi. Salmon, hearing, yellow tail, octopus. The fish sashimi was a little slimy with a less appealing flavor. 

While the price is competitive there are much better establishments around the city. It's upsetting,  because Sake Café used to be good. It's hard to recommend solely on price.

This location, in Philadelphia International Airport, is busy, busy, busy.  But, they keep the line moving and make a GREAT cup of coffee... my order, which is Extra Large, Half Decaf, Half Dark Roast, with 2 pumps Blueberry Syrup, Six Creams and Three Splendas, didn't even raise an eyebrow; and, it was perfect.

The space was quite dirty from prior patrons, with napkins and other debris scattered around the space, so someone should have been looking after the seating area, which was my only complaint.

Fresh, fresh, fresh donuts, my wife and I had Old Fashioned donuts and our daughter just the Glazed.  Nice stop before our flight.

Best sushi in Tampa Bay. It rivals many sushi houses in California and Hawaii. Chef Derek is great and he only works with the best ingredients. The seafood is always high quality and served at the perfect temperature, rice is always perfect, the varieties of fish on the weekends are second to none and he knows how to balance the flavor profiles of fish using small garnishments, oils, torching technique, fresh wasabi, or when it is best just to let the fish do the talking. And they carry Junmai Daigingo sake (the best quality sake). I love Sushi Ushi and I hope it stays in the area for many years to come.

Lunch with coworkers here was good, unfortunately we didn't try any alcoholic beverages but the blood orange soda was good We started off with the chips and guacamole- and like the reviews I read we were left wanting more plantain chips instead of tortilla chips but we would order it again. The queso  truffle was my favorite - but we all enjoyed our food. A few of us ordered the fish tacos, the salads were huge, and so were the burritos. Overall, everything was good, will certainly stop by again maybe for happy hour.

First off, them cookies.... terribly DELICIOUS!! My stay here was pleasing. It's in a great neighborhood and easy to get to from 76. It's a few minutes from the wonderful King of Prussia mall and I also managed to find some hidden gems venturing unto the neighboring city of Norristown. 
With regards to the hotel, the employees are all pleasant, my room was serviced well, shower clean, water nice and hot and I slept like a baby. I visit Philly quite often and I am definitely making this my go to hotel when I wanna spend the night outside of the busy city.
Thank you!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Came here way late in the night and big props to all the staff who dedicate their nocturnal time to serving and feeding those like me who decide to eat out around 3am. Great service for being surprisingly busy at the hour and the food was pretty good going by diner standards. 

I ordered the corn beef hash which came with breakfast potatoes and an egg. It was yummy except I didn't particularly like the crispy, fried outside of the corn beef hash. I grew up eating it more on the runny/ taco meat texture style so that's just what I'm used to. Anyways, great place and I'd stop by again anytime!

Even though I only pay $19.99 a month to work out I would still prefer my experience to be good.  I have been at this gym for 2 yrs now and it has only gotten worse.  If it's not staff flirting with other guest, or favoring their "regulars" you get a mumble of a hi or just a stare.  I don't know how much they get paid but it's obviously not enough for them to check the tanning beds when someone is done; in my last few times of tanning I have had to clean up after the person before me and it's gross.  The manager has talked to me about it and said how sorry she was and put up a sign but that hasn't helped at all.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I love working out at this gym! 

Pros:
Really affordable compared to other gyms in the city 
Free fitness classes (wide variety of cardio,conditioning and spinning)
Indoor pool and outdoor deck to tan during the summer

I usually try to attend as many classes as possible. If you plan on going to Kristen's classes plan to go there 10-15minutes early because they fill up fast but are worth going to considering they are included in the price. The layout of the gym is a little different than most, but they have alot of machines equipped with tv-s.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Excellent place to go and have an awesome Italian meal. Best part? Its BYOB (and you won't have to worry about cork fees like certain other places have started doing in philly). We were here with a big group and they were really accommodating. For my entrée I got the salmon with the potatoes and it was fresh and yummy. Everyone else at the table seemed to be enjoying their food as well. I also had a taste of the truffle pasta that my friend got and I highly recommend it if you want a vegetarian dish. The truffle tasted delicious and it wasn't too overpowering. Good place for large groups or a date night.

Stay away from the Ginza Roll! You have been warned. I wanted to try a new sushi variation so I went with the Ginza Roll and the crab meat and apple roll. The Ginza roll is basically grilled salmon with onion, masago, and mayo. I love all the ingredients but once you put them together you are setting yourself up for failure. I almost threw up after tasting it. To my surprise, the crab meant and apple roll were actually pretty tasty and I recommend it. The service in this place was just border line ok. They get incredibly busy at lunch so obviously they service wont be as quick. Decent place if you go super early and avoif the ginza roll.

The staff is friendly but it is very evident that this is a student run cafe. I mobile order everyday on the way to class and this morning they completely lost my business. (I was someone who ordered here twice a day before.) I watched the girl swirl blueberries in my cup for a solid five minutes after the order was due and then she finally informed me they were out of bananas. Over fifteen minutes since I originally placed the order and they couldn't figure out how to get ahold of me to let me know they were missing ingredients. Thank god there is a Starbucks on campus because I won't be back, which is a shame because the coffee is good.

I appreciate honest people. I have a small gash in my rear tire that hasn't even penetrated the tire. I stopped going to the last one because they told me I needed new tires immediately. Well, screw you. 
    Made an appointment at Autotire for an oil change. They got the job done promptly. He mentioned the gash but that's about it. Thank you for not bringing in my dirty air filters HAHA. They gave me a list of repairs I may need in the future. This was the perfect oil change experience. 
     I will be only going to this location because I trust them not to rip me off. I'm a happy and satisfied customer.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Great spot in grand central district 

Service was good

Metered street parking free after 6pm

Food:

Ordered the cheese charcuterie and my friend ordered the meat and cheese charcuterie. I also ordered the limoncello cheesecake. 

I charcuterie cheese are changed periodically. Today's was 2 cheeses piave and gorgonzola. The piave is hard white cheese excellent and great paired with honey. Gorgonzola was creamy and nice spreadable cheese for the crackers. 8/10

The limoncello cheesecake was amazing it was served with almond cookies and white chocolate straws. 10/10

I went for an oil change because my wife had a coupon. Despite having an appt they started 15 minutes late and took nearly an hour to complete it. The shop is a mess: it is dirty and disorganized. There were old parts laying around outside the shop along with tons of cigarette butts. I thought I was back in the Middle East. With just a bit of effort, they could clean it up, make it look professional and get a lot more business. On the upside, the mechanic was friendly and seemed like he knew what he was doing. I doubt I will go back.

So my BF and I stopped in here for lunch one Saturday.  We were first put off by the horrendous decor.  For an upscale place in Rittenhouse, it seems so...cheap.  Our server also handled our bread with her bare hands (which I don't think she realized we saw) so can't comment on the bread, unfortunately.  My salad was pretty good, nicely cooked grilled chicken on a bed of spinach with goat cheese and pine nuts.  I might go back to try the pasta, but questionable service and cleanliness has me a little hesitant.

Your typical local dirty dive bar. Only one reason to come here, and that's for the wings. Just make sure to bring cash, as they don't accept credit, although they do have an ATM inside. 

Not a place I want to hang out, but the locals sure seem to like it.  There is one pool table inside. The outside looks sketchy, and it doesn't get any better once you go inside. Bathrooms are barely that, with an accordion style door to the 'stalls'.

Wings were good, not the best I've had, but I would come back, just maybe do takeout next time.

If you've ever been to The Spotted Pig in New York, this place looks like it a lot! Small two story house that has a 2nd floor patio which is good when the weather is nice.

Service is good and the food came out pretty quickly. I had the meat sweat and the pork belly was just way too fat, it's like 2/3 of fat in the sandwich. The biscuit debris was pretty good but not as crunchy as I thought. My friend really liked the bacon.

I heard that they change up the menu all the time so I might to back and try something else.

This is the second time I've taken my car here. I immediately told the ticket guy that last time I was in (about 2 weeks ago) they forgot to clean the wheel wells- no big deal, they did an "OK" job on the rest of the car. He apologized and said they would make sure it gets done right today. NOPE, they forgot. I will say that out of the 4 or 5 car washes I've been to in Tucson, this one has been the best, but be prepared to finish the minor details yourself. $21.99 for a decent inside-and-out clean isn't BAD, but don't come here with high expectations. 3 Stars for an OK car wash ***.

First time at tutti frutti, frequent fro-yo goer. We were hoping for more tart options as the sign suggested but they only had one when we visited - strawberry. Also missing from my list was pecans. They did have some seasonal flavor like pumpkin and a chocolate Nutella if you are into that kind of thing - not for me.  The workers were extremely nice - they spoke to my kids and we even lit a candle to celebrate my son's third birthday. Not bad but not overly great as far as selection. I would oh here again but I am not sure I would go over other fro-yo options.

The staff here are so friendly, you'll want to come back again and again!

I had to stop by here because I didn't want to drive back to Metairie or spend a ton of money at Roberts. I'm happy I did! I was greeted by every single employee here. From the buggy boy who went out of his way to greet and welcome me, to the sushi guy (from who I didn't even attempt to buy food from), and finally the cashier. They were all very friendly.

 I grabbed only some red beans and a bag of rice. The total was very comparable to the grocery chains in Metairie, which was the cherry on the top. I will be returning to this store!

Fun dive bar in the Navarre/Lakeview neighborhood!

Homedale Inn was established in 1937, making it the oldest bar in all of Lakeview. Frequented by locals from the surrounding neighborhood, you will pass your time here taking advantage of the great drink prices and free food during all Saints and LSU games. The bartenders here are very nice and are quick to make suggestions if you're not sure what you want. 

Check the chalk board inside to see the changing events calendar, as they constantly have themed parties and hold weekly trivia too. They also have video poker and darts as well as an outdoor deck for smokers.

I was skeptical that this may be an over priced restaurant based on location, but I was pleasantly surprised by the taste and quality of the food. I had the pork shoulder with grits and it was delicious. My date and I also shared the small plate beet and mozzarella special and it was great as well. 

Our waitress was perfectly attentive and helpful, but there was another waiter in our area who was a bit overbearing on his tables and annoying to us being nearby. 

I will visit again when looking for a nice meal in a classy joint.

Ordered for pick-up via their website and picked up, great protocols in place. The fish quality is pretty middle of the ground, but a little pricy for what you get. Not bad quality, but not very flavorful either. The rice on my rolls was cooked pretty well and the ginger dressing on my salad was fresh and yummy. 

Portions were not bad. My partner got the tuna lover that comes with sashimi, a tuna flower, rolls, and nigiri. I got 3 basic rolls, tuna salmon and yellowtail and they were fine. Each came with miso soup, salad, and seaweed salad. Total was about $50 with tip which felt pricy for what we got.

I liked the food at this restaurant.  The tacos were great and the app that was cheese and black truffles made my night.  I wasn't thrilled with the drinks.  I got a white sangria, but it tasted very acidic and I thought maybe it was a margarita by accident, but even for a margarita, it wasn't good.  It was also very noisy, but if that doesn't bother you, then it's great!  I would not go there looking to have a romantic dinner for two because you will just keep yelling across the table at each other, like my party wound up doing.  Food was good though.

Ohhh boy.  Jim and Mike's was a childhood favorite.  Whenever I was lucky enough to go to the Broadway Theater for a movie, I'd be allowed to get a slice here...  Nowadays, the pizza just doesn't seem as good as it used to.

I'm pretty sure that the interior hasn't been updated in over 20 years, and judging by the napkins strewn across some of the floor and salt or sugar all over my table it seems like it hasn't been cleaned in a while either.

The pizza itself was greasy and thin and didn't have enough sauce.  There's so many better spots in the area, J&M's needs to step up their game.

Have been here twice and I am happy that I waited to review until after I tried this place again. Service was great both times we went. Table side guacamole is amazing but unfortunately that is about it. Food is tasteless and the "carne Asada" is laughable (see photos) and this is the dish that was recommended to me by the staff so I'm afraid to taste anything else. The salsa doesn't taste like they use fresh tomatoes but have a canned tomatoes taste. Was hoping that I had finally found a good Mexican spot but alas, my search shall continue.

Sbraga was absolutlely wonderful! We were looking for a special spot to celebrate my in-laws 30th anniversary. I was a little nervous based on the comments re amount of food but to all those people I say you are not able to appreciate good food and you should visit golden corral. The food was incredible and the service divine.  I was thrilled with our waiter Jesse and everyone treated us like we were special and deserved top service. The octopus, escargot, calamari, pork and lamb rigatoni were delicious and I highly recommend this place for date night or a fun dinner out.   $49 for 4 courses was so so worth it. Skip the wine pairing!

I'd call this barely adequate. I had not been here since it got rebranded to Tiger Express. Based on their reviews I'm guessing it's the same owners as CQ Car Wash which is its former title. My car was extremely dirty and while the dirt did get removed I also got a lovely whipped soap look that dried on my car haphazardly. NONE of the employees, including the ones indoors, were masked on 3/2/21 when there is still a mask mandate in St. Louis County. I was handed a towel when paying for my wash and it was wet?

I love Blue Iguana Car Wash. I've been here about 3-4 times now when I'm in the area which really isn't that much.  Where else can you get a car wash for $3 and as much time as you need with free vacuums? The $3 car wash is by no means perfect but it gets the basic winter weather dirt off the car and is so worth it.  I don't see any reason to fall for the upcharges and better service options because when you drive through there how do you know you are the one even receiving the services? For $3 this is a bargain and I will be back again and again.

Hmmmm so I needed a hair cut that day and the Salon I always go to is not answering my calls. After reading the reviews here I opted to try. Since it's last minute I wasn't able to pick a stylist. They gave me Anson. So the first thing is the regular Shampoo, but this one has massage! Very nice! I told Anson just to cut me any style as long as I'll look good.. He did an awesome job! AWESOME JOB! He's the stylist that doesn't talk much (which I prefer) but asks you questions regarding your hair.. Place is okay. Smells good and clean. Cash only don't forget

My first time visiting this nail salon and all the rumors are definitely true. This place had everything from professional staff; calm atmosphere and a very tranquil design of decor. 

I did not feel rushed to select a color or to get serviced. I absolutely loved my nail technician Amy. 

Normally I go to Ladue Nails, but wanted a change of pace and try out a new salon. 

If you come here whether for a polish change, pedicure/manicure or waxing you will be satisfied. They also have a rather large Essie collection! 

Oh and request that you're seated in front of the fish tank.. Gives you a chance to feel like you're not in St. Louis :)

Had a very nice stay here with good service the entire time. At check in, we were greeted with warmth and many recommendations. We were quickly given a map and were given a variety or recommendations for places to visit. Our room was a lovely corner room (2316) and we could see the river. The room was spacious and the bathroom was also. Is it somewhat noisy here, yes but be realistic, it's a city. A few nights sirens or train horns woke me up. Admittedly I am a light sleeper and didn't take advantage of the free ear plugs. The guests near us were not loud and housekeeping gratefully came early afternoon while we explored the city.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Avis here is hit or miss. Sometimes I get awesome service, upgraded to an SUV at no cost etc. Other times poor service...this time, the driver just blew passed the preferred drop point and said that no body replied where in fact he never asked, they bumped me up which was great but...the car had no been cleaned or it was cleaned poorly on the inside, dirty car, I pulled out a mile up the road and the fuel said 7/8 full, it took me 3 attempts and 30mins just to get on to customer service just so they don't stick me for $5 in fuel. The agents checking cars back are nice sometimes and others very rude and not customer friendly at all.

Hot, fast delivery every time.  Quality of the food is very consistent.  The drivers friendly and the people on the phone who take orders are very nice and efficient.  I've called this place 15 minutes before they closed and they've taken my order and delivered my food within 30 minutes.  My go to lately has been a cheesesteak Stromboli with extra cheese and a cheesesteak fried onions extra cheese salt-and-pepper. My daughters have gotten the chicken fingers. I've gotten the hot wings and the pizza.  They've never disappointed me.  I like thin crust pizza crispy on the bottom I asked them for that one time and it actually was very good.

For sleepy little Carmel, this a pretty hip bar. The outdoor rooftop area is heated with outdoor heaters and fire pits are arranged around the patio.
