Probably not warm enough to be out there in the winter but those who braved it while we were there seemed comfy enough. Inside features a long bar with TVs, tables, and more intimate seating areas throughout. Interesting cocktail menu. I ordered the Mrs. Collins and the hubs ordered the Kandykrush KK. Both were pretty tasty but definitely pricey. We didn't eat here but they have a small menu from which to order. Not bad for Carmel if you don't mind paying a bit more for the atmosphere!

The food here is excellent and the ingredients are always fresh! Service can be hit or kiss depending on whether the boss is here or not, but I come here mainly for the food. 

The salmon has a refreshingly buttery taste and the rice are neither mushy or too undercooked. The sushi lunch here is unbeatable, I usually get the sushi lunch box for $11 which comes with soup, salad, shui mai, and sushi rolls as well as California rolls. It's very filling! 

If you check in, don't forget to redeem your free regular roll on Yelp! 

Overall, I highly recommend this place! It's clean, delicious, and well worth the price!

I thought this McDonald's looked very clean and up to date. The service was also very quick, which is what I would expect from McDonald's. I ordered a McDouble with tomato, bacon, and mac sauce and a large fry. I don't what people say but not all McDonald's are created equal. I didn't think this was the best McDonald's, I think the one that serves the best food is the McDonald's right before you go to Honeymoon Island. But, like I said before, I think this Mcdonald's is very clean and I would certainly eat inside it again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
BEST PIZZA IN STL!! This establishment exceeds any expectation ! I love the veggie + banana peppers, the wings are good, hell even the fries are delicious (yes the FRIES). There is music that plays outside and it is very clean ..... and I hear from the owners that they are expanding so hooray you will soon be able to sit down. (I usually sit at the 3 seater bar because I'm always hungry and can't wait)

Enjoy !!! The owners are super good people who actually care about your satisfaction and they say "thank you for your business" and "thank you for coming back".

We were in town for the Philadelphia Marathon weekend, so pre-race pasta was a must.  We made reservations at Little Nonna's and were very pleased with the overall atmosphere and food with one major flaw.  The dishes were freezing by the time they arrived - which was hard to believe considering they were pretty quick to arrive after ordering.  Our waiter, Cal, was curt almost to the point of rudeness, but thankfully the ambiance and flavor made up for that.  Would be willing to try again the next time I'm in Philly in hopes the temperature of both the food and the wait staff improved.

This is the worst sushi, service, and experience I've had at any restaurant in the Indianapolis area. We were seated at a table right next to the hostess booth. The entire time we could hear some old American lady yelling at all the Asian workers. The sushi was nearly flavorless except for the Bob's Roll. All of the sushi was room temperature or warmer. We weren't even given a sushi menu until we had been there for about 20 minutes. After finishing our meal we waited about 30 minutes for the check. I will never return to Sansui. There are much much better places try Tomo or Sakura.

We arrived on a Saturday night for drinks and apps. To our surprise, we were the ONLY people in there around 7:30PM....on a SATURDAY. Normally, I would not have continued on , but I'm glad we did. Service was great, the place was clean and the food tasted great. 

We enjoyed their BOGO Margaritas and had a few apps as well. We were later joined in the restaurant by some Mexican patrons so they obviously dig the food as well which is a nice sign.

We will go back as it is very local to us and we enjoyed ourselves. 

Check this place out. BOGO Margaritas!

This place is a weird balance between chill and wild. The barber shop chair where a woman pours shots in your mouth  may lure the street spectator. Then, there are the mixed drinks in the flashy skull cups. The Ressurection (blue drink) was a little too tart and sweet. The jalapeño was a weird kick in this concoction. The hurricane is a more balanced, drinkable drink if you want to enjoy a large drink in a fun cup. 

The dueling pianists were fun for sure. Save any Queen songs for Pat O'Brians. Bohemian Rhapsody was an ambitious request for this bar.

I have to say I'm hooked. I loved the Pork Ramen Soup, Vegas Roll and Lunch Buffet. Which tasted fresh it was surprising. My almost two year old is very picky and ate her rice, fish and soup so where ever my daughter eats a plate says a lot for me. I'm caving the soup the most. 
The service was ok, not bad but could have been better. 
One weird thing that was uncomfortable for me was the restroom. I felt like I could watch or be watched while using the restroom, and kind of embarrassing and can't help but blush when there are others waiting on you.

So ... i had a problem rating this Italian restaurant: Give them 3 stars and talk it up, or 4 stars and talk it down. I'm going with 3 stars and pointing out the positives. 

Good food, good service, portion sizes were congruent with prices. 

I was shocked at first to get good, crisp service ... it's kinda funny ... I've forgotten what plain ole' standard good service is like since moving to Boise. Good to see. 

I feel that if this place was in a more food savvy city it would be just another restaurant ... but given Boise's dearth of quality dining establishments Luciano's is a place to visit.

I have mixed reviews about this place. The food can be very good. They have some of the best fried rice and general tso chicken I've had from a takeout restaurant. My biggest issue is the consistency and the delivery. They seem to always make a mistake with the orders, they always forget something. The other issue is the delivery. Over an hour on a Tuesday evening is just absurd! The girl on the phone is also very short and rushing you through the order. Not sure if I'll order from here again, sad because the food is pretty good.

Probably the worst car wash I've ever been to! I paid $19.00 plus tax for a full service wash. It's not what I received. The dashboard was never touched and the floor mats were barely vacuumed. To top it off my car is a month old and was very dirty on the interior to begin with. 

As they were vacuuming they must have hit the window buttons. Both of the rear windows were cracked and the inside was soaked. There was water in the cup holders and the interior was wet. No apology or anything. I will never go back. 0 stars if I could.

Sakura is very clean and has always been consistent. The service is always great as well. We stopped in tonight after a busy fun filled day.

I ordered three rolls, I love the fact it doesn't take forever. There are other places that take forever to get the sushi to you. Tonight I ordered the Miami roll, dancing prawn roll and the vegetable roll. Wow! They were all delicious and fresh! My wife ordered the homerun and Bensalem roll. Both very good as well. I can't say enough good things about this place. Always fresh food and at great prices. We will be back!

Stopped here yesterday for a quick lunch. I arrived around 11:30 and it was dead. They had a large variety of slice pies. I opted for a medium plain. They didn't carry a small or personal, that was a bit of a bummer.

I waited roughly 20 minutes for the pizza. It was just okay.  They say brick oven but there was barley any color on it. Not sure if it really is. The sauce was good, not too sweet and had a strong garlic flavor. The cheese was meh, greasy. The pizza was kind of sloppy (see picture). I'm not sure if I would go out of my way to go back. 2-3 stars

I kind of have a love hate thing for Bensalem beer. Since Bounds moved this is the closest distributor to me with decent prices. I will say though that their prices seem to be getting higher. They do offer a wide variety and a nice selection of crafts. My biggest issues is their customer service. I'm almost certain this is owned by Bounds but it's nothing like it. The girls at the registers are never pleasant and it seems like your almost inconveniencing them. Don't ask them any question either, they never have an answer. Some advice would be to be like the store in Warrington... clean, organized and friendly staff

Welcome to the worst Wendy's in the world. Tonight's visit including me dining with hundreds of Fruit Flies. Since I was the only one eating here I had plenty of room, but half the dining room was unstable because they put the chairs up on the tables (could have sworn that is a health code violation). I wishes there was a way to leave zero stars. Also not sure where to throw my trash away since they have covered all the trash cans with trays. I keep on calling Wendy's corporate to report this place but there is no effort to improve this location.

Service sure has gone down hill in the last year. When the restaurant is half full you can expect to wait 45 for your food. Nothing on their menu justifies this type of wait times.

Because of the volume they do here the Sushi is fresh, but I think there are other places nearby that are doing it better. This use to be my favorite because it was closest to being authentic, but other places in town have opened up that exceed my expectations for authenticity here in Indy. My biggest sadness is that their tempura has gotten heavy. 

It is back to the Broad Ripple Sushi Bar for me.

Thought I would give this new addition to the neighborhood a try and was glad I did. My friend started off with the cream of mushroom soup which she said was the best she ever had. Her steak dish was cooked perfectly. I had the striped bass with rice and grilled bok choy--delicious. They have many seafood entrees--something I have been looking for in the area. Despite an unusually busy Wednesday night, our server, James, did a great job. My only suggestion--a small side salad should be available. Will certainly return to Dishez! BTW it's a byob!

The bar in this place is amazing! Very cool location with an outstanding wait staff.. the food is amazing. We have been here several times and have always left full. We are constantly impressed with their wine selection as well, it stays current with many great vineyards on their list.

However good, our feedback is that they are limits on space and are not set up well for parties larger than 8. We were able to squeeze 10 into their largest table, but were challenged for space throughout the dinner.

Overall a great experience, will return, just with a smaller group.

The absolute worst experience I've had with a gym!  This place only cares about up selling packages and not about their clients needs, plus this place is overpriced.  A normal gym package is $69.99/ month. 

They have sales people who are very pushy and try to get you to sign up the first
day you visit, which is absurd.  They con you into signing at least something with all of their confusing, stupid promotions. MAKE SURE TO READ THE FINE PRINT, as they completely screwed me over.  

In addition, you have to pay and annual fee for equipment for the gym, and the gym is mediocre.  This place absolutely sucks.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I went here for lunch, to try out the tacos at this place. The place was not very crowded - was quite empty to day the least. I tried he taco plate here, comes with a taco, some rice beans and salad which was worth $5 including taxes. The taco was good l, but the beans were too bland. I had to add quite a bit of lemon and salsa to get some taste from it. The rice was not hot too(probably a bit cold).

The food wasn't too bad, but I was let down on the taste a bit. There are definitely better taco joints in Reno than this.

I've gotten take out from jays a few times. It's mediocre sushi at mediocre prices. They have a large menu and are accommodating with making substitutions but the quality of sushi is not the great. Let me explain...

I ordered a spicy tuna with brown rice, a speciality roll, dumplings, and a seaweed salad. Dumplings were alright. Both Sushi rolls were mushy... And not good melt-in-your-mouth mushy. I think soggy is a nice way to describe it. I was pretty grossed out, but hungry, so i finished my meal. Seaweed salad was watery.

I don't think ill order from there again. Vic is way better, sorry Jay

I was walking by & suddenly I needed the mens room. I asked to use it, but "it's only for customers". 
Out of many places, it was the least crowded & after buying a bloody mary, I knew why. For a city known for bloody Mary's, they've got work to do. Small cup, lots of ice & lacked flavor & kick. I would'nt dare buy anything else. That was one expensive bathroom break.
After I bought the drink, the bar tender was my friend...we left because I wasnt going to let them ruin my experience of NOLA. Maybe their team was losing, haa.
I really hope this was just my experience because the bar itself felt intimate & well preserved.

Had a wonderful experience here with my girlfriends. Such a nice atmosphere once you walk in. We decided to sit outdoors since the weather was nice and they have a cute mural for photos. The food was pretty good. Although we missed the happy hour deal on their oysters, it was still so fresh & tasty. Our waiter Mort was so helpful with the selection and definitely gave us some awesome recommendation since it was our first time here. Their lamb, pork belly, mashed potatoes, and oysters were our favorites. Overall, good food, good drinks, and an awesome experience.

-January 30, 2016- 
We got up to the speaker and dealt with a girl with apparent hearing issues. Every single thing we ordered she would say, "HUHHHH?" and my husband would have to repeat it "louder and clearer" than what he already was. I can't really complain about the slowness, I guess, since it's lunch hour and a lot of customers in and out. We were finally off...... We get home, my husband opens his Chicken sandwich wrapper and there is nothing there besides a bun, mayo and lettuce. That was sweet.  Now, on to the rest of this amazingly beautiful day!! Almost 60 on January 30?! Yes please!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is by far one of the best Mexican Restaurants close to me! First it is an extremely clean place and the decor is awesome! The people who work there are very nice! The food was really good!!! Everything we ordered was amazing Finally a decent (better than decent) restaurant which I will go back when I want Mexican Food and wonderful Margaritas!! I got the Presidential one but will try the Blood Orange one next. Prices are also good especially for good stuff! Make sure you have your masks with you? They are great about the social distancing.

WARNING! Bugs in bed! 

As depicted in this picture this hotel is filthy dirty with bugs in their beds. 

Mr. Reyes(general manager) offered one free night at the same hotel thinking I would really want to keep staying there... 

He needs a lesson in customer service and also he kept using the word "fair." 

When a hotel has bugs in their beds, I can't get over how he would want to come up with a "fair" resolution. 

If I were him, I might want to bend over backwards to please the guest for a HORRIFIC experience. 

He downgraded me into a smaller room by the way.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great, unique flavors! I get overwhelmed, but luckily you can try all the flavors. I recommend the Wildberry Lavender, but everything I've tried is delicious. A waffle cone wedge is the perfect way to top off a bowl. The decor is quaint but modern. Free stickers are always a plus. Complimentary cucumber water to clean your pallet. I am dying to try one of their ice cream sandwiches, but I'd need to have someone to share it with. Parking can be tricky, but walking a few extra blocks will only help burn some of those delicious calories. Beautiful neighborhood!

I've dined in twice now, but have ordered carry-out countless times. This is my favorite sushi place in the city.
I recommend the spring rolls which are available in pork or veggie (but not for carry-out as they aren't as good after the car ride home). My other favorites are the Butterfly specialty roll, Philly and California. Other options like Chicken Teriyaki are available if sushi isn't your thing.
I recommend sitting upstairs for better ambiance. Outdoor seating is also available. Parking can be tricky especially if you go at peak business hours for South Grand.

I had a great brunch here this morning! The staff was very friendly and kind. The food taste was excellent! I still can't get past the amount of food served while maintaining very reasonable prices. I had full plate of breakfast scramble - potatoes, breakfast gravy, 2 scrambled eggs and it included 2 pancakes!!! The pancakes were each the size of a small plate as well . All for like $6.00. I'm not sure I could order this much food at fast food joints for that kind of price. That means I didn't feel like I spent an arm and a leg just to eat out. Quality, service, and cost all add up here. I'm sure I will be back soon!

Possibly the worst place in town to do laundry. There's often no attendant, all the change machines are routinely empty/not working, twice I have come in to find the floor flooded with a few inches of water from a broken machine and everyone just ignoring it and there are very few carts to go around. They also remove the handles from the sink so you can't use it. The place seems to be used to do commercial laundry service during the day and then opened to the public nights & weekends so they can make some extra cash. The owner clearly doesn't care about taking care of the place. 
Ghetto.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Revisited this place a few nights ago for dinner with friends. Used to order sushi for delivery when I went to school years back. Definitely did not disappoint! Sushi was very good, rolls weren't obnoxiously large that you have to cram into your mouth, nigiri was some of the freshest I've had in St Louis. Wait staff was kind and checked on our table at appropriate intervals. Parking is sparse, but there is a parking garage next door that usually has open spots on the second level-first level is for tenants living in the apartment buildings.

Decent Hotel, it is a bit out of the way, but a decent hotel. The rooms are nice, fairly standard, bed, chair, desk..... The showers are walk in which can be nice for some. I found that the front desk is hit or miss, the employees seem to be disengaged and not care. When we stayed here there was a breakfast for our group, and we'd say good morning to the employees and never found any that responded....

The stairwell is actually a service stairs, so take the elevator, but the stairs often were cluttered with weird things on the door knobs
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Philly is a great restaurant town; no doubt about it and Sbraga is a terrific addition. Went in a little skeptical because of the Top Chef buzz but Kevin is the real deal not some TV wannabe. Went with the tasting menu and  each course was better than the next.  Dessert was a complete home run.  Despite some comments to the contrary, service for us was excellent and I really like the space. Wine list is a little funky but some excellent Malbecs.  Don't forget to start with a custom cocktail because those are killer too.

I received a recommendation for this Optometry and eye doctor.... Firstly the assistant name is Jessi is pleasant and welcoming.... She performs the preliminary part of the eye exam and she is efficient and caring... She's also the one who help you pick out your awesome glasses and can help you stay within your budget if you tell her what it is. Dr. Schilling is awesome And is efficient and very thorough. I will definitely go here again and keep this place as my eye doctor of choice even though it is way out of my way... This place is also four-legged friend friendly.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
We loved it here!

We spent two nights at another hotel that was a dump and HAD to leave. Ended up getting a room here on last minutes notice (luckily!) and what a difference!

We checked right in, went up to the room and it was beautiful and clean! Spacious bathroom, bed was large and comfy, an actual Keurig coffee maker for the next morning (instead of those cheap little coffee makers).. VERY classy, beautiful place.

Front desk staff was friendly and efficient. Also love that there is an Applebees literally right next to the hotel so you can go eat dinner without a car (which we didn't have).

Great experience....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is a nice hotel--would be perfect for anybody either from St. Louis, and especially someone who is not from St. Louis and is looking for a nice upscale but not pretentious place to stay, with all the Delmar Loop attractions within walking distance. The staff was very friendly, and they have private-lot valet parking for $17. The rooftop lounge is a really neat bonus--a place to hang out with a date or with friends. The rooms were also clean, modern, and comfortable. Not what I would call a bargain price-wise (plan on about $200 for a single room) but everything was well worth it. Would recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Delicious, fresh sushi in Sparks! 
Quality here all the way through. The service was fast and friendly. The fish was very fresh. All the rolls were created on the spot. Nothing was pre-made like with the other bigger sushi places around town. You can tell they care. 
The Miso soup was the best I have had at ayce sushi. The hamachi was my favorite nigiri, off-the-boat fresh! And the deep fried ice cream was better than anyone else too! Also $16 for AYCE lunch is very fair. Go here instead of the more popular places!
Thank you! 
We will be back again! 
Josh

My husband and I tried this restaurant because it is right by our house. I wish I could recommend it since it is a local establishment, but the sushi was absolutely terrible. I have been to dozens of other sushi restaurants in St. Louis that were better than this - even Dierbergs take home sushi is better! The rolls were small and were loosely held together. The salad had a very watery dressing with pineapple chunks in it. My husband had steak teriyaki which may as well have been boiled because it had no flavor, with some teriyaki sauce poured over it. Not a great dinner experience, especially for the price.

Nothing fancy but nice little gem of a Mexican restaurant hidden on Page. Decent basics with tortilla chips and salsa and any of the tacos. Go for anything with carnitas as I think it's their best protein. The torta ahogada is as good as everyone says it is. Nothing fancy just carnitas and onion between a solid slice of bread coated in a delicious spicy chile sauce. The sauce is so good you'll want every inch of that bread coated in it. Only real criticism is that the Margaritas are just a premix. A fresh made margarita with this food would put this over the top.

Honestly I love this place! I see a lot of bad reviews so I might have just gotten lucky with my first time going with a lady named Truc. She does amazing nails, I always bring in Pinterest nail pictures and she always does them perfectly. I also love that she is always so gentle, I usually have my gel nails for about 3 and a half weeks before I have to get them off but they never come off without a struggle, which is nice cause I never worry about them falling off while I'm on vacation. I highly recommend going to Truc if you come here, she is a delight!

That's Amore Pizzeria is in a strip mall in the center of Metairie, Louisiana. The exterior is simple, but the interior is clean, neat, and nicely decorated. Service was very good, and the owner introduced himself and spoke to all of us. I ordered the Spaghetti & Meat Balls (and lots of meat sauce), which came with a Caesar salad & bread stick. My lunch mates ordered an Italian salad, a thin-crust Cheese & partly Pepperoni Pizza, Chicken & Sausage Gumbo, and a small Caesar Salad. We all agreed that the food was good, and we all loved the hot, fresh chocolate chip cookies. I would recommended it, & we would return. RJT

When we first walked in, it took a few minutes to be seated. 2 staff said they would be with us in a few. When seated it took another 5 minutes or so to be waited on. We were ready to order when the waiter was ready to take our drink order. We waited another 5 minutes for the chips to arrive at the table. When they arrived, it wasn't a typical basket but 10 chips total  When the food arrived at the table, it was completely wrong. We ordered 2 burritos and an enchilada. What arrived was 2 hard tacos and a chimichanga. The food didn't have any flavor. The decorations and atmosphere do seem nice though. I wouldn't come here ever again.

The gel manicure is very expensive for the area ($40 vs. $30 at other places in the area).  I recently got a gel manicure before New Years and the salon was very busy, so the girl was rushing mine, and it didn't even last two weeks.  Started chipping within days, which is very odd for gel.  I also got a pedicure and requested reflexology, which the girl had to ask someone what that meant, and she was told, "a longer massage," which was nice, but I thought it would be more about  involving different pressures to the foot.

This is a newish place in Frontenac next to Brio's.  It is very upscale so plan on spending $20+ for lunch.  When you arrive if you are meeting someone they will write down the name of the person you are meeting which i thought was a nice touch.

Service was very good as was our meal.  I got the chicken tenders and it was a lot of food.  The bar area looks like it would be fun for a happy hour.  Lots of windows and light during the day and in fact, they had to lower the blinds it was so bright.

This place is a bit pricey for me to go on a regular basis.

6 at our table. Had never been here in all my years in Phiily. Was not too impressed.

Actually, it wasn't a bad meal, but when you serve us two side orders of cold meatballs and broccoli rabe that was way over cooked - 2 basic things a good italian restaurant should serve properly, well it's hard to give a 3 star "A-OK".

Our entrees were decent, not wow, but good. The bread was good, but not great. Service was pleasant, and efficient. We were seated upstairs and liked the ambience of the place. I liked the everything salad - basic, old school, but big, fresh and good.

I've never been to a laundromat before, so I was a little unsure of the process. An employee there (or possibly the owner) got me change for my large bill and showed me the process. There are different sizes of washes and dryers, and all of the machines are in great condition. You can go next door to the BBQ place while your clothes are being washed, which was nice.All in all, I was in the laundromat for an hour which isn't bad considering I did three loads of laundry. Pricing did not seem to high to me, I paid $12-13 to wash and dry three full size loads. I will be back.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
We reserved a room with a king size bed.  When we arrived we were told they were all gone and had to get a room with 2 doubles (not even a room with a single queen). This was upsetting since in my book the whole purpose of a reservation is to get what you paid for. 

Once we settled for the 2 doubles the guest services told us a lot about activities and local food. 

The room was in great shape and clean. I am giving 3 stars for the reservation issue.  I was going to give lower but guest services had great services and even though there is an issue with the beds it is a nice room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
WOW, best chips and salsa I might have ever had in my life. I could have downed an entire basket for myself (and maybe I did...)

Overall a great dinner spot for downtown Tampa. For a Saturday night around 7 it wasn't slammed, as my party of 4 got sat right away. Service was great as well, very attentive staff! 

They have a whole VEGETARIAN section on the menu (cue singing angels) I got the veggie chimi which was good but a lil too spicy for me. The other people in my party who ate dishes with meat liked their plates as well!

I love Italian food and have been dying to try Uva, finally got around to it and it was not a let down. Made a reservation for 8:30 and was seated promptly. I read on here that the restaurant was loud and cramped but it wasn't nearly as bad as a lot of other Italian places I've been to, I had no problem holding conversation with my date. Service wasn't speedy but at a place this nice, I don't see that as a problem- definitely the kind of atmosphere you settle into for a few hours with friends or family for a special occasion. The decor was surprisingly modern, loved it!

As far as national car repair chains go, these guys aren't the worst I've dealt with. However I am irritated that the new brake rotors and pads they put on 16 months ago (10,000 miles) are already bad, and of course there is no warranty. Most brake pad companies and mechanics agree that pads typically last between 30,000 and 70,000 miles. Brake rotors can last quite a bit longer (as much as 3 times as long as pads), but again this depends on many factors like your driving conditions and brake system maintenance. 
I won't be returning. Don't go here for brakes they don't know how to install them.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This has to be the worst experience I've ever had at a Burger King. Went through the drive-thru to get breakfast for my son. These people didn't put any utensils in the bag. Then to add insult to injury the woman working the drive-thru took orders and handed them out while sitting down. I literally had to stand while in my car to reach over and get my bag. Not once did she even attempt to stand up or assist. Just utterly ridiculous. I will not be returning. I wish I had my receipt. I definitely would have taken the survey.

We were so excited to finally try Mica, but unfortunately we didn't feel it lived up to its amazing Yelp rating. The bread was really good, as was the onion croquettes they gave for free. The spicy beets appetizer was good, but we weren't crazy about the eggplant appetizer - something about the flavor just wasn't great. My husband got the scallops for his entree and I got the steak - both were too salty and just weren't very good. The churros for dessert were delicious. The ambiance and decor was a little lacking as well. All in all, not a great dinner - we won't return.

Slooooooww! I've been coming here for years  and always receive my food at a glacial pace. I literally waited 20 minutes inside for my food. The  drive thru wait time is not much better . This is a busy location with only 4 workers. 1 on the cash register inside, 1 cook, and 2 on the drive thru. The line is literally down the street every morning for the Drive-thru between the hours and 8 and 9 am. The line inside is all the way to the door. One thing is for sure that you will have an usual WAIT time for your order unless you come in earlier than 8am.

New Orleans, Louisiana ---

"The Prytania Bar" is a basic bar in an older building ...

the "only" plus to this bar is they had the "Big Lebowski" playing on the TV ...

the bartender was an "80%-er" ... that is a group of bartenders who "think they are good" 

some bar flair, but just a convenient location to the hospital ...

Bars like the "Prytania Bar" make me appreciate other bars.

day 041 "DUSA 2017" (Discover USA) 
day 094 "666 Bars of 2017" / bar 192

"Run-A-Way Bill" was here! 

#RunAwayBill #DUSA2017 #666BarsUSA 

04.04.17

Loathsome. Allows smoking inside and the staff are incredibly rude. I have been twice now, dragged by friends who have terrible taste and it has been a uniformly terrible experience. The music is awful and the building doesn't look like it's seen so much as a mop since we were at war with Vietnam. 

Most recently I went and handed my money to the doorperson; standing in the threshold I saw how many people were smoking and immediately asked for my 5 cover back. They refused. I really hope the health department pays them a visit soon.

Well... I'm impressed!

I didn't even have a car issue and this place was awesome! I had a homebrew keg with a stuck part, and I didn't have the tools to fix it. I took the keg to Doc Hallowy's on a whim, thinking they might have the tools, and they were happy to help out. It took only a few minutes, and a specialized socket wrench, but they did it! They didn't even give it a second thought.

This place has always had a full parking lot, and I can see why! Great service! I'll be heading back down there next time any car issues come up (knocking on wood).

My boyfriend and I come here sometimes. The portions are big and the price is low. My favorite combination :-) We only really come here for breakfast so my review is based on that. It is a small hole it the wall type of place with friendly servers. I got the banana pancakes. It was good I liked how the bananas were embedded into the pancake instead of just on top and the food came out fast. It is a little greasy for the eggs and bacon. I wish that they had more pancake flavors but it hits the spot when I am looking for a big breakfast. The parking lot is small.

This is a nice mom and pop place to get Mexican food. Unless you know Spanish it's hard to figure out what the difference between asada, pollo, chorizo etc.... I am familiar with what they are but for others who may not it may be confusing to them. The tacos are cheap at $2.00 each but they are small so get ready to order a lot of your hungry. I liked the Orange sauce that it came with. This is one of those places to come to when your in the area but I wouldn't go out of my way to go to it. It would be nice if they had a menu besides what is written on there board. Food is good overall and that's what is important :-)

Absolutely love this nail salon! I have been going to this nail salon for probably two years now and they are amazing! There are so many options with choosing a gel/shellac colors. They have a good variety of colors. I always go to Mary. She is in the front to the left when you walk in. My nails have never chip, never lifted, nothing at all! It's hard to find a good nail tech but I'm glad I found Mary and only sticking with her. Prices are decent. Not cheap but not expensive if that makes sense' Cindy and Gwen are really good with pedicures along with a couple other girls. But overall I would recommend visiting this shop!!

Woo-hoo!! We saw this place a few weeks ago in the early AM, and finally got a chance to go when it was open.

Great flavors and want to go back to try more!
Ordered: 
Grandma's Oreo - standard oreo ice cream, super good!
Curried Coconut- vegan, coconut ice cream with a curry flavor, yum!

We had lawn chairs in the truck of the car so we ate outside.

One downside, there was a family in there with us who were barely wearing masks and took up most of the shop (there were 6 of them, but they were not sitting together). I understand that everyone has their own comfort level, but it would have been nice to see the masks more enforced at this place.

We showed up at 6:40 with 20 min left to the happy hour. We ordered 3 drinks, 2 sodas, and 4 apps all within 15 min of sitting down. Keep in mind we were the only people sitting down at this time. We waited for 1 hr and friends came and went with drinks and the lady promised it would come out next. Then the couples next to us got there hot food who got there 30 min after us and when we complained the waitress said "it's only me, I'm sorry" as if she's the one who's cooking the food. Did I mention it took her 40 'min to bring a water when there were 10 people in the place and again when we complained she said "it's only me" and she wo

Been to Hot Tuna a couple times now and it is hands down one of the best sushi places around. Very fresh and flavorful food. The restaurant is clean and trendy. They have awesome happy hour specials. The staff has been extremely friendly and helpful with making choices. I have been here 3 times already and everything I have ordered was delicious including their crab cakes, short ribs and the specialty rolls. The owner is very involved and you can really tell he takes great pride in his restaurant both pertaining to the environment and quality of food. My favorite sushi restaurant!!!

Anytime I've visited Biaggi's, I've never been disappointed.  Of course I have a soft spot for this place because I'm familiar with the one in Bloomington, IL where I lived for about 3 years before moving to Indy.  When I found out they were planning on having one in Carmel, I freaked!  Great Italian fare with a relaxing atmosphere.  Each time I go, I try to branch out and get something different, but my standby's are always the Fettucine Lobster or the Ziti Al Forno.  Try either, you won't be disappointed. And, for fun order the Italian Soda, refreshing!

Great for a date night or a night out with the girls.  Check it out!

Came here during lunch and ordered the lunch special fajitas which was a lot of food.  The steak fajitas had good flavor.  Only got 2 tortillas which was kind of a drag.  The chips and salsa were fresh.  The chips came out hot and crispy.  The only thing is that the service took a little too long for lunch.  The rest of my party complained a little about the wait time since the restaurant was not packed by any means.  The food was good so I plan on giving it another shot just as long as I don't have to be anywhere right after lunch.

Been here a few times but won't go back. Yes, the sushi is good (for Edmonton, which is a sad but necessary qualifier) but the service is so poor. 
 
Yes, its a tiny restaurant, but there's no need to seat you next to the toilets or right next to another table, when the restaurant is empty and you've called ahead for a reservation.

You could try ordering take-out ... but be prepared to be quoted more than an hour for your order to be ready.

As a city, we need to stop accepting poor, pretentious and untimely service!!

I love getting a car wash for #CRVyLuna regularly & I kinda enjoy detailing her. My current car wash spot is great, but this place is amazing! The wash cycle itself seemed a little rough but definitely effective. Afterward, each parking spot had TWO different sized vacuum nozzles for self-service cleaning of my vehicle's interior. One nozzle is small for those tiny crevices, and the other is larger for carpeting, upholstery, etc. AND, all the parking spots for detailing are covered! This is literally a game-changer for me. Plus, they have TWO floor mat machines, also under shade. Express Wash on Hills has a monthly membership option, aIso!

Small and convenient grocery store with good variety that caters to various diets. Has a lot of vegetarian, gluten free, organic, health conscious, etc options. 

The salad bar is convenient if you are looking for a quick and cheap lunch. There's also other prepared food available.

Fruit and meat are always fresh, which honestly is an issue at other nearby stores.

The alcohol selection is great. Lots of different wines and a huge beer variety.

My one qualm is that the lines often are slow, but that isn't very different from other grocery stores in the area.

This place is great depending on what day you go and what sushi is half price. Everyday they have about 5 rolls half off. Our dinner started off great with the food and the service. The sushi was fresh and came out promptly. When we wanted to go we waited about 15 minutes before anyone even acknowledged us again. They had a very large group come in and all 4 servers were helping the group and seemed to forget about the other tables.

All in all it wasn't bad except for the service towards the end. I will be returning.

My friend and I stopped in for lunch earlier this week and it was packed. Its a small restaurant with only about 8 tables and the sushi bar. There was 1 table left and we grabbed it.

I love this place. You get free miso soup and edamame right away. You never have to ask for it. For lunch I always get the terayaki chicken with California roll and its only $7.50. Its a great deal! The service is great with the two servers that are always there. My friend has an eel roll and she loved it. We can't wait to go back next week for lunch.

Surprisingly when I walked in there was a couple in front of me ordering. There is normally a long line when I come in or go through the drive-thru. 

Today when I went to order the barista was not friendly at all. I usually have a great experience when I go to starbucks. This woman didn't say anything until I ordered a croissant and she asked warmed? Then she asked for my name.

This was the worse experience I have ever had. They are usually very friendly. Even the drive through talks to me more. 

I will continue coming to this starbucks due to the fact that there is a drive through and makes it convenient.

The Star rate would have been 5 because the food ( sushi is delicious) but the rather iffy' treatment made me want to eat and go about my day quickly. We bought a deal through a third party promotion and unfortunately that was not fully honored, but when we asked for our free Edamane when you check in with Yelp they refused. We asked again if they can work the Yelp deal out and they did with an uncomfortable attitude. I'm not a destructive Yelper but It's my first and last time I'll eat at Ichiban. I do however wish them luck.

This is probably the best mexican restaurant I've been to. It could be because with them following the covid standards the servers have more time to focus. No matter the food is excellent. 
Salsa made at the table.  A huge bowl of deliciousness. Chips are good. 
I had some kind of corn tamale open faced with carnitas. It was their specialty. It was good. 
But I was totally eyeing the cheeses chicken dish my buddy got.  The tacos looked tasty too. 
We will be back for sure. 
Highly recommend this place.  It totally trumps our other go to Mexican Tucson spot. 
I'm getting hungry.

I read all the low reviews and am really surprised, my date and I were celebrating his birthday and had great service and really great food. I had the Chicken Botticelli, at the suggestion of the server, 
(chicken breast in a creamy sauce with prosciutto and provalone cheese) and the chef prepared a "not on the menu" Chicken  Cacciatore at my dates request. He is Italian and thought it was delicious. 

Both meals came with a large side of spaghetti, it was not outstanding but was very good. Nothing was dripping with oil. 

We will definitely go again.

This location is awful; I don't maybe it's the time of the year. I've been there 3 times in the past 3 weeks and I have yet to get a haircut. First time I went they said 30 min; I waited an hour then left. Next week; I go they told me a 2 hour wait said if I check in online it'd be quicker. This week checked in online said 30 minutes; I arrived at my designated time waited 15 minutes as other people around me were called but not me. An hour-two hour wait for a hair cut? That's insane and ridiculous I will find another place..

My husband loves this place! It's a hidden gem in Edgehill behind taco mamacita. 

I've been to Italy and it gives off the same vibe and I really feel like I'm not in Nashville. It's neat because they have live music on some nights as well!

My favorite from here is their rigatoni and carbonara. They have different specials, too. My husband loves their pizzas!

The wait is not too long depending on what night you come. I'm not sure if they take reservations but I just suggest coming a little early and beating the dinner crowd.

Expensive, the employees and the doctor a bit cold. Beware, 1. If your glasses break, loose a screw or something the like, the repair is not included on warranty. You would think for such a "high class" place and the price you paid they be nice enough to install the screw for you for free. 2. You will not get a prescription, you will have to pay additional for that. You get the exam and will have to buy there contacts and/or glasses or pay additional for that. 3. There are better and cheaper places around here.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

This is the WORST Jerry Bobs In Tucson! I will NEVER go back! The last two times we have been there the cook has screwed up my order!! This time I asked to talk to the manager who comes over admitting she knew about the screw up and didn't come over to apologize or take the meal
Off my tab! I usually do not complain to have the meal remove if they fix it to what I ordered, however today by the time I was able to have my complete meal it was cold!!! Soo mad! No one ever said they were sorry for messing up my breakfast!!! Will NEVER GO BACK!!! Stay away! You will always be disappointed and they don't care!

I can always count on this Starbucks being pretty empty and having somewhere to sit, therefore I come here often. I don't feel like the product of Starbucks varies so it's a typical Starbucks! This location is great and right next to some food places to eat or Walmart if you need to do some shopping. The staff at this Starbucks is very friendly,  always cleaning and trying their best to stay on tasks, especially with their drive thru window! Definitely one of my first places to go to if I just need to camp out for awhile.

Get out of here!!! This place is out of this world. The flavors are so creative and varied and they deliver. All unique and well balanced. I had the Mini Scoop tasting which was perfect. I had the Green Fairy, Magnolia, Creole Cream Cheese, La Vie En Rose, White Peach and Elderflower Sorbet, and Lome and Thai Basil. Wow. All of them rocked on their own way. I don't even think I have a favorite. I wish I could have tried all of their amazing flavors. This is a must stop next time I am in town. Oh but it is cash only!!

This is going to be our new go-to restaurant in the area for Mexican in Franklin!  We used to go to a spot on Columbia, but it changed hands and wasn't as good.  A coworker recommended El Sombrero as a kid-friendly spot, which we are always looking for these days.  I've eaten at the one in Lenox Village before.

Overall, we loved it!  They were so kind to our little guy in his high chair too; every server who came by was waving and smiling at him and asking about him.  The food was hot and delicious.  The menu had tons of options.  The prices were good.  I have no complaints!  We'll definitely be back.

I'm a Marriott member and when traveling, always check their hotels first. Usually the hotels are clean and reliable. Unfortunately, this experience didn't hit the target. The main issue was the water in bathroom sink didn't drain. Maintenance came up to fix it while we were out. When we came back to room, not only was it still not draining, but now water was leaking from bottom on to the floor. Rather than wait up for them to come back, I left a garbage can under the drip for the night. 

This hotel won't be one of my choices for future stays in the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Been going here since they opened In Green Hills and had decent service however, today was a different story. Went in at open time on a Tuesday- not busy. Sign in for full set and pedicure. After my one hour pedicure (which was great), I'm told I can come back in an hour or wait an hour for my nails. What????? I was here before everyone else and now I need to wait an hour because only one person is available for hands???? This was my favorite nail place....but the service is consistently inconsistent. Expect to stay a while I guess. I went down the street to Venetian and finished up the work Nail Bar couldn't.

So here's the thing--it's a beautiful bar, it looks like a happy hour from every cliche rom com movie that is cool and trendy. I had a fun time and the staff was very nice, but the prices are meh. For two drinks and a split appetizer + tip I spent nearly $45....for a happy hour. The drinks were okay, they tasted good, they were pretty but they weren't like life changing. The outdoor patio is cool and a fun spot to spend on a summer evening. But would I go here weekly --probably not. It's a fun experience but you'll be paying for it.

Best delivery service!!! The are always fast and always so nice! Food is always hot when delivered and they have the best eggs rolls in town! I get anything from chicken lo mien to chicken curry or beef and broccoli. The egg rolls tho are my favorite! Always crispy and remind me of my favorite Chinese restaurant from back home. If you're in the Carmel area, definitely order from here! Their website has an app that you can order online with, which was super handy and convenient since I always get like anxiety calling to order from places. So check them out and I'll be ordering here soon!

I love their coffee but holy crap. Some days it's a few minute wait other days like today I waited 5 minutes in line inside and the cashier hadn't even taken the ladies order who was waiting at the counter and there were 3 people in front of me. So if I had stayed it would have been about a 30 min wait for a simple iced coffee. I feel bad for the employees because it's always a quick turnover with no leader. And th cashier is very very slow. So a good product if you're willing to wait. Some days it's fine, other days like today I just left not willing to wait in a 10 car drive thru backed up line or slowest inside line.

Was kind of disappointed with this place. We rushed inside on a rainy day and was hoping it was going to be a hidden gem seeing the size of the place (very small with one table and more seats at the counter) but the sushi was a little lacking for me. We went for lunch and got the salmon platter and some other rolls. The raw salmon itself was amazing but the rolls were very small and squished and didn't taste that great. Some of the avocado was also browning already. 

The kani salad (really recommend) and miso soup were great though! Another plus was the free bags of tea and hot water they had! I really loved that

Am I the only one who thinks this place is just OK? Saturday night, dinner for me and my hubby. Our dinner starts off with octopus and arancini - both good and tasty. For our entrees, we order spaghetti meatballs and the pork chop parmigiana. Both were good but nothing special, we thought. We also had a carafe of pinot noir. 

Servers were a bit oblivious, in our experience. Not very engaged, eager to be friendly or answer questions about the menu. Decor is cute, a little too cramped for us. Affordable place, but wouldn't return.

I can't think of anything bad about this restaurant. It's close to my house, it has a parking lot, great sushi and friendly service. 

We walked in without a reservation and were seated in the separate area on the left. 

We ordered quite some stuff and everything was delicious. It tasted fresh and they serve interesting combinations. 

Our waitress was really friendly and helpful. She kept filling up our cups of hot tea, which is always nice cause you don't really want to keep asking. 

I will definitely come back here and try out more of their sushi.

They did not recommend what was needed. I am a veteran and had brought my service dog here. I had a very traumatizing experience with my dog when I left, having him die in my arms attempting to rush him to an emergency clinic. Really was not satisfied with the fact they gave me false hope of my dog surviving instead of suggesting to put him down. Now I am stuck with a bill of service they did to try to revive him instead of euthanizing. Giving them two stars instead of one star due to the fact they accepted caring for my dog when I didn't have money.

Went in for lunch.  No prices listed anywhere for single slices, so I probably overpaid for a slice of cheese and what they considered to be Chicken Bacon Ranch pizza.  Have no idea how much all of it cost, until I was rung up.

Chicken was a little chewy, and they didn't even bother to heat that slice up before throwing it in the box, since "they just made it".  Cheese pizza was good, but nothing overly spectacular.

One bright side is that they accepted credit cards, without much of a fuss.  Used to require a $10 purchase, according to a co-worker who used to frequent, which is ILLEGAL.  Must've gotten their hand slapped by Visa.

Ben was not only professional but kind and caring. He didn't try to find or push costly or time-consuming repairs on me. Rather, he repaired the quick, inexpensive problem I had that was extraordinarily inconvenient for me on my mom-mobile. Knowing I had a quick time constraint I was under (to make sure I got home to Hendersonville to get me older child off the bus,) he addressed the other problem I had by giving me a quote and telling how long it would take. I appreciate his honesty, his swiftness, and will undoubtedly take my vehicle back for all future repairs, major or minor!

When I lived in Saint Louis, I used to live right behind the Imoz, not sure what has happened with this restaurant. went in the other day while I was in town. I stood at the front counter for 3 minutes before someone even acknowledged that I was there, the pizza took 45 minutes to come out and the breadsticks took 30 minutes. Which is waaaaay too long. The inside of the restaurant could also use some new tables as almost all of the tables we sat at were old and wobbly or they were dirty and not wiped. Customer service isn't all that good either. The only reason they're getting 2 stars is because the pizza is the best

Date night! I was a little pessimistic about Mexican food in Spring Hill.  We've tried other Mexican food before since moving down here from Chicago. Nothing compared. 
Chulas was a delicious surprise! The food was tasty and filling. A bit pricey, but still quality. The atmosphere is very cute and I could see coming back and drinking a margarita(or 2), on their patio. Our waitress was awesome! Very sweet and knowledgeable and she kept the free chips and salsa coming! 
Overall, I gave Chulas 4 stars. Chicago will always be the best in this Chicago girls eyes!

I hate to say it but breakfast was not good. Lobster étouffée was mediocre and my toast was hard, chewy and cold, the eggs were still clear and runny. Then our child's breakfast the scrambled eggs were cold and chewy. The bacon (I personally like well done) so not their fault but it was more chewy. I really wanted to like this place for breakfast because we're looking for a place after church Sunday brunch. I guess we will keep looking. Bloody Mary's were very good!! And our other child's mac and cheese was decent.

Beautiful atmosphere, attentive servers and drink fillers, and OMG the food!! We had the fried calamari as our app to share and that enough could have been a meal. They aren't some skinny strips these are huge thick calamari with a tantalizing dipping sauce. My father loves the scallops and orders them every time because they melt in your mouth. I ordered the seafood risotto. There were clams hiding in the risotto and it was just the right amount of seafood and I had half the bowl left over. Our other party ordered the lasagna that was enough of a portion for 3 people! She said it was amazing. 5 STAR across the board and did not disappoint!!

Just coming back from 5 star dining experiences out of country, this review maybe a little biased.  But when I was waiting for my wife to arrive, at least offer me some water or ask me if I would like a drink.  I thought my server was just being rude but I came to the conclusion that she doesn't really know what good service is.  Tough start.
Food was good.  Their Bolognese sauce had decent flavour but the tortellini that came with the dish was just ok.  Lasagna was also ok because of the Bolognese.  The Caesar salad was good but had some wilted greens that were served.
Not my first choice for Italian out but not my last either.

OK, so I know you aren't expecting haute cuisine at place that looks so bland and has no atmosphere at all. This is a place for a quick lunch, nothing more. So none should be surprised to hear the food is just so-so. The wonton soup is the worst I've ever had, with wontons clearly made several days earlier, and too-salty broth. The noodles were just rubbery and filled with something reddish and nasty looking. And even though soup was the only thing I was ordering on 2 occasions, I still had to wait 10 minutes for them to ladle it out. So don't expect much from this place.

Stopped here after a long train ride to feed the family. Prices are too high for what you get, and our service was very slow...had to approach the waitress and say we were leaving if the food didn't come soon. A plain burger was 12.95 (2.50 extra for fries!) and it wasn't very good. The fries were cheap and bland, and there were hardly any for that hefty price. The kids meal was $7, and it did not earn its keep. Way too much $$. Won't be back unless I just need a beer. Good window views of the cutesy town though.

Came here for lunch and was not impress. I don't think it was worth the price. Everything was very easy small portions. I order the salmon bento box and usually it comes with rice but it does not. In my opinion if it doesn't come with rice I believe the salmon shouldn't be that saucey and salty. In addition a friend of mine order the sashimi lunch special. I would think that it comes with a bowl of rice as well but nope. He order a bowl of sushi rice that was 2.50 and it had like three spoonfuls only. I guess that's what happen when it's in a secluded neighborhood with not much options

Food was amazing. Order the Hawaiian Pizza and Seafood Alfedro and it came with a Caesar salad. Food came out pretty fast but service was not that great due to it being Friday Night and it was super busy. Kinda dislike how the seatings were like a cafeteria and if you see someone leaves and sit down first you get the table even though others may have been waiting longer. The empty plate I got was dirty and the table were sticky. Its a place with good food but the enviornment just feels kind of weird since it is right in the middle of a mall where people are just walking around and shopping !

Another of my group's favorite places on Bourbon Street. We enjoyed both a live band and a DJ during our one week in New Orleans, and both scored high on the talent and entertainment scales. The live band, Rock Box, was a '90s Alt/Grunge cover group. Probably about the last sound I expected to hear. But it drew me and my group in, and we really enjoyed ourselves.  

No cover, beer prices as expected, and excellent music. Bathrooms were actually pretty clean, especially compared to some of the other places we visited. What more do you want from Bourbon Street?

This place has some delicious sushi but the service can be uhhhh sketchy. My favorite roll from here is the cattle roll (filet mignon I think, cream cheese). I like the fact that it has nothing raw in it. Receiving a hot roll is a very unique experience that more people should try. As far as the service, the younger waitresses are amazing but the older waiters are a bit....rough around the edges. Prices are fair for the quality and ambiance that you receive. My friends love getting udon noodles, it's delicious and it's big enough to share!

This is one of our family favorites! For everyone's birthday we come here without a doubt! We have a big family which means we need seating for at least 14 people. We got here at our reservation time and it was already set up and ready for us to be seated. We were greeted with a warm smile and they were happy to have us. 

The restaurant has a very welcoming feeling and is very clean. Their tables are so cute! It definitely captures the whole mosaic theme which is included in their theme. 

I always get the red menudo with the pan birote. I wish I could get a whole basket of pan birote. It's that good.

Is this restaurant even open? Drive through does not work tonight. I sat at one speaker for 2 minutes, nothing, no one asked for an order. I backed up and sat at the other speaker. Again, 2 minutes and no one took an order. I pulled up to the open drive through window, you can hear emoyees joking around and laughing, bit not one person came to the open window. I walked up to the lobby door, locked....but you can see people not in uniform behind the counter. All joking and laughing. 
What the hell does this owner know about his emoyees?? What about the manager? No where!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
A group of girls stayed for a special weekend for our friend. We told the front desk the reason for the stay (they asked/small talk) and before we knew it two bottles of champaign, chocolate covered berries and a very sweet signed card were sent up for her. It was absolutely above and beyond the already phenomenal service (in a gorgeous hotel). 
The pool is great, very nice bartenders whipping up FL style fruity drinks. There were also several local beers and some of the regular standbys as well. 
The hotel is close to the trolly line which zips you right into Ybor for a fun night on the town!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Honestly, not terrible, not fabulous either. Came with a group and we made reservations beforehand. When we were all there it took them a while to come over and take our orders (we had to ask them to come take the order). Once the order was placed it then took forever for it to come out. No real explanation as to why things took long, no kind of apology. 

Our food was ok, nothing really outstanding, but not terrible either. Overall, wouldn't really want to come back because the service was subpar and food was just "eh."

Just ok... the line was long and only one barista was working so it didn't move super quickly. I got a flat white, it was ok. Not a super strong taste of espresso, which was kinda bummer because all I really tasted was the foamy milk. They had different bags of coffee for sale, but I couldn't tell if they actually had those coffees brewing or not or if they had pour overs (didn't notice it on the menu). 

The space is nice with seating downstairs and upstairs. Seems like a nice place to work during the week, but was a little more crowded on a weekend.

This is not my favorite Starbucks.  We go here because it's convenient and close by; however, my coffee always tastes bad.  Burn or just plain bitter.  It's super annoying that they don't have stir sticks, sweetener packets, or creamer around for over a year and half now.  I always feel like I'm annoying them when I have to ask for one of those items to complete my coffee.  This Starbucks feels cold and somewhat uninviting.  I've never been in the restroom but I can imagine how it looks considering I've seen the other Starbucks' bathrooms (terrible).

We had a very nice stay here while traveling for my sisters wedding. First price was very reasonable for a two bedroom that had a nice size kitchenette and living room. It was very clean and they had nice beds. One complaint was a floppy pillow but you can't win them all. Our room as on the highway which did seem pretty noisy all night. 

They accommodated my sisters party and had the fire pit going for us which was a nice touch for after the wedding. In the morning their breakfast was very good. There was a nice variety of breakfast choices and a comfortable spot to eat and catch up with family
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Just loove awesome customer service. Too bad I didn't get today. I do like this place however I just feel like some of the employees don't care. As I put my order in I thought the young lady was asking me a question and she simply says "I'm not talking to you" in a rude way. Now I understand you're doing many things at one time but still have tact with how you talk to your customers. 

I feel like if it wasn't for their one manager, I don't know her name, I probably want to go to this location. Nobody cares about the job anymore they want the pay without the work it's so annoying and discouraging.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
This location is so convenient to stop here before you get onto 95. You get literally get off Woodhaven Road, and right back on. I know I hate having to go out of my way just for coffee or hot tea. This is the ideal location. I do not know why I waited this long to start using this location. 

The service is usually fast & the workers are always pleasant to deal with. The coffee is usually very hot and fresh. I hate getting cold or burned coffee. 

This location also has a gas station & small connivence store.

I absolutely love this place. I have been ordering from them since I was in college. Sandy is awesome! She is always so pleasant and always gets my order right. 

Some of my favs are the sesame chicken, sweet & sour chicken & the garlic chicken. I love that they give you a free egg roll with any purchase of $12.00 or more. And a free 2 litter after $35.00. 

If you are picking up its usually about 10-15 minutes & 30-45 for delivery unless they are very busy. 

I love their food and highly recommend this mom & pop place.

I do believe that there was a Sbarro in the very first mall that opened 50billion11 years ago. Or something like that. I know they have been in malls since the early 1980's. This Sbarro is no different than any of the others. The portions are large, filling and hot. They do offer salads, but its pretty much romaine lettuce, croutons and parmesan cheese. No other vegetables. It is mall food, and therefore convenience is king here, Quantity over quality. Price is generally under $10 for one person. Service is fast.

I don't have much experience with dry cleaners here in the Greater New Orleans metro area. This dry cleaners seem to be comparable to the ones I used in other cities I have lived. 

In the neutral ground of West Esplanade at Severn, the parking lot is small, but I am guessing it is enough for them. I had a queen size comforter of my sisters to get cleaned, so I brought it by. Just over $30, they cleaned it well, folded it nicely, and put it in a zipped up bag. Very nice. 

I am sure if I ever have anything else needing dry cleaning, I will be back.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Get the cream cheese with your bagel. Trust me on this one. They have the best flavoured cream cheese I've ever tried! The garlic and herb is too die for (although you might not want to eat it before having to talk to people... it packs a real punch). The spinach and feta is also amazing. Yum, yum.

Their coffee is also alright if you are in need of a java fix and I've been meaning to try out more of their drinks - they've got quite a selection. One small complaint is that they do take a while to make your food/drink, so just schedule in a little wait time if you're planning to pick up some goodies before class.

I needed a place to stay overnight before a flight and Baymont delivered. Smooth check-in and check-out was even seamless. I checked out around 5:30am and the gentleman at the front desk assured me that the $50 deposit will be credited back to my account within 2-3 days which it was. He also offered a breakfast plate with apple, bagel, and yogurt. The experience was  decent, however, the building exterior and interior could use an update. Nonetheless, for $59 + tax it was a no brainer for a quick transient stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My flight arrived in late and Comfort Suites was the most suited place to spend the night. Parking lot was well lit, smooth check-in experience, and covid precautions were enforced. The room was decent with the usual amenities i.e. mini fridge, living room area, microwave, coffee maker, and free airport shuttle service. The location is ideal as it's a minute drive from the airport. The water pressure was decent; overall the stay was pleasant and I had a goodnight sleep. It's a 2.5 star hotel so for what it's worth I give it a solid 3 star.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I went here for lunch with my husband. He ordered the shrimp and grits which was okay. I had the grilled salmon with mashed potatoes and cole slaw as my sides. The mashed potatoes came out with gravy (I ordered it without). They took it back and changed it quickly but the new potatoes came out cold (didn't want to send it back twice). The coleslaw was a little weird. Too much mustard. The service was good. My biggest complaint though, are the many dead bugs stuck to lamps or the squished mosquito on the Elvis picture. I would not go back again.

Staff was incredibly rude and short with me. The young lady kept whispering to me when asking my order and then when I would say excuse me or ask her to repeat she gave me a cockeyed look like I was out of line. The sandwich did get the job done but the whole subway experience was left to be desired. Clean as a whistle though. Oh and the big kicker.. They didn't have any cups! What kind of place doesn't have cups. I get maybe if it was a big weekend or something but its Tuesday and they won't have any until Thursday. Thanks Obama

I belong to Retro Fitness in Saint Clair Shores Michigan, but I visit this area frequently and come here when I'm in town.  Never had a problem. Friendly, clean, all machines work.  I do love that when you belong to Retro Fitness, you belong to all of them and don't have to do a song and dance to workout when you're a visitor.  Swipe and go. I was greeted and offered a tour when I told them I was from out of town, but just chose to wander around on my own since I've been there before. Thanks for the friendly offer, though.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I have been to this place twice now. Once dinning in and another time ordering in. The first time there was fantastic! Good service and the food was great! I just now ordered in the chorizo burrito wet with green sauce.... I can't move..... So good... So full.... Going back as soon as I wake from the food coma...... OH! The delivery was super fast! Way before the estimated time and on a Friday night no less.... Also, it didn't look like it had been regurgitated into box. A problem I have had ordering from a lot of places around here.

Visiting the west coast for work and I have heard about in and out for years and years.  Anyways, in and out happened to be like 5 minutes from me so I just HAD to try it.  I like how the menu is very simple.  Burgers, fries and shakes.  I didn't have a shake, but I had a burger and fries.  The burger to me taste like a fresher version of Wendy's except with special sauce on it.   I thought it was very good.  But not all oversized like how five guys is. Also the fries are really good. I'm Simone who likes plain French fries.  And everything is made hot and fresh.  So unlike McDonald's , you're not rolling the dice on getting hot fries.

Awesome service and a decent hot fudge sundae, but not a standout in my opinion. The shop is really cute and there's a bunch of different types of frozen treats. 

I think I've been spoiled by made-in-house ice cream at other places, and one of my ice creams tasted a little freezer burned, but the cherry vanilla was the best of the 3 I got. I'm a value seeker, and this was a little on the pricey side, especially for non House made. 

This isn't on my "no-go" list, but given the choice, I'd probably head elsewhere.

I came here with my partner-type-person for a battle of the bands type show. So, there is at least good music here. The bartender seemed attentive. The bathroom was kind of gross. The show was pretty good. 

I'm giving it two stars because the mixed drink I had tasted like a bunch of fruit juices with ice; I couldn't taste the alcohol. I'm a light drinker and a lightweight. If I couldn't taste the alcohol or feel its effect, then it really was a weak drink. I told my partner to get me a bottled apple cider when he asked me if I wanted another; I told him that whatever he paid for the mixed drink was more than it was worth.

Went on a random weekday night and was seated without a reservation which was great. I ordered the meat ravioli and my friend ordered the chicken parmigiana. She enjoyed her chicken but when I had a bite I thought it was pretty dry. I enjoyed the ravioli but it is a little heavy on the sauce, sort of overwhelmed the entire dish and I could barely taste anything else. We had ordered an appetizer that never came out so the waiter was kind enough to take it off the bill and give us a free dessert. The servers were nice but really slow, especially for a random weekday night where there was maybe 4 other tables of people.

Food is awesome but service was lacking and made for an unpleasant experience. We had reservations and were seated immediately but they took forever to return to take our order, instead serving people that arrived after us their food before even taking our order. the waitress answers the phone while taking our order so we couldn't even give our full order. After letting them know how disappointed we were they brought the food out but too quickly. Couldn't finish one dish before the next arrived. It would have been ok if only they would have just said "we're sorry" but they didn't. Won't be returning or recommending this restaurant.

To the people who said that the service was unfriendly.... maybe you're the problem! I LOVE Tre Scalini.  My waiter was so friendly and so nice to my boyfriend and me.  And we are well under 40! The other waiters walking around were so nice to me as well.  I love the chef too- she is as authentic as you'll find in Philly.  Thick Italian accent.  

The food is EXCELLENT. I've never had a bad meal here.  I'm taking my entire family tonight actually.  Scallops- excellent.  Lobster ravs- excellent.  Eggplant parm- the closest I've had to my grandmother's (it's GOOD).

Hidden gem, byob, excellent food, and real Italians.... I'm sold!

We came here on a Saturday night and were seated right away. Our server was very friendly and our food came out fresh and hot. The service was exactly what I would hope for but I feel like the food was decent at best. Nothing tasted bad but just didn't have much flavor. Salsa was fine.. queso fine... nothing I would crave. I felt like we got a good portion with the chicken fajitas and definitely would be able to share but again, not very flavorful. I probably wouldn't choose to come here again but would return if other friends wanted to meet her. I did not try any margaritas but they did have a lot of flavor options and come in 27 ounce size!

If you want to avoid the crowds here on Mondays through Saturdays, go early as in the first two hours of business. Sundays are typically busy all day. Otherwise, expect to have anywhere from a 5-15 minute wait. Service has been hit or miss for me over the last seven years. I have had some employees help me tremendously with employment and notary documents. And I, like another reviewer on here, have had employees act in what I would term an unprofessional manner (not greeting you, staring at you, mumbling, looking miserable, etc.) In my experience, the drive-through is faster than inside.

This is my go-to place when I need to get the car washed. The prices are decent and they do a good job. Plus, you save more with the wash books.  They used to do themed discount days but I guess they scrapped that so everyone gets the lowest price.  I usually go for the $6 Classic Wash (tax is included in the price), but I think you can get the Economy Wash for as low as $4.

Just note that sometimes it gets really busy, particularly during lunch hour, and the drying job isn't as good as normal at that time because they have to push the cars through quickly.

With ample parking and wonderfully friendly staff this spot is perfect for lunch if you're in the area. Service is great here, menu items all very fresh with salads, sandwiches, soups and weekly specials as well. If you're a hot tea drinker they've got a ton of great options to choose from.

All in all, very quick, accessible parking lot, wonderful staff and tasty food. They even have a nice covered outdoor seating area!

I'll be coming back here very soon!

The celery blue cheese soup is great (a tad salty), Greek salad was tasty and portion size more than plenty.

Had a great first experience here, but my most recent visits were disappointing. The menu (and possibly the chef?) has changed, and not for the better.

My all-time favorite dish is from a restaurant in San Francisco: gnocchi served in a red sauce with roasted eggplant and a ricotta mixture. I was ecstatic to see that Caruso's new menu had a very similar menu item, so I excitingly ordered it. Unfortunately, the amount of eggplant was extremely skimpy, and the gnocchi was mushy. This was just one of several let downs here.

Though the pasta is homemade and the service is usually good, I do not think I will be back.

Good variety of appetizers. Poor service. Dining area needs improvement on cleanliness and spacing between tables. 

The hubby and I went with all you can eat for lunch and our 7 yr old did the kids chicken Katsu bento box. We only got half of our order and our waitress asked if we were ready for the check. No dessert was offered and we had to remind her that we ordered more items on the list. 

Food: if you love sushi doused with sweet sauce and spicy mayo as if a fireman took a hose full of hoisin to the fish.. then you'll like this place.

I called the same day and made an appointment to get my hair cut. My hair was down to my belt level and very damaged at the end. 
When I got here, the owner asked (but more like just told me) if she could take her lunch break after the assistant had washed my hair.. which is sort of weird but it's all good. 
Then she did an amazing job of cutting my damaged hair and I love my cut! I didn't really know what I wanted, but I took all her suggestions, which was helpful esp since I didn't know what would fix my hair.
$30 for the cut + tip

street meter parking only

I have to just let everyone at Westin know I was working an event last night and the staff was the kindest most helpful group of employees I have come across in years of being in a service industry. When I asked for directions not only did I get a awesome smile and a answer, I was escorted to where I needed to go, introduced to anyone relevant with what I needed, and always asked if there was anything else that they could help with.
