This was with 3 different employees at different times! Incredible. Your hotel really made my night! Great job :)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I wish I could do a better review... Im a world health fan and love the other locations but this place is gross (even after the remodel) Front desk staff would much rather eat a full meal at the front desk or play on their phone then check people in. The showers are pretty much see through, You can very easily from the shiny metal right into the next stall it makes me a little exposed feeling. Not a fan in sight anywhere in the whole gym. Ive done half marathons and frequent 10ks and I can barely fit in a 5k on the treadmill because my body temp gets so hot. Waaaaaaa World health I just want to like you so much.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I came here with my family of four on a busy Sunday afternoon. The ice cream flavors are plentiful and unique and didn't disappoint! They were reasonably priced considering the quality and we were moved through the line pretty quickly. The employees seemed a little bit annoyed with how busy they were and weren't exactly rude, but definitely weren't smiling and chatting with customers. The seating is also pretty minimal, so be prepared to stand around and eat your ice cream if they're busy. I'd definitely come back here, but only to grab ice cream and go.

Okay so the first time I came here it was amazing! Not the mushroom ravioli and my little sister got the lobster ravioli.  We absolutely loved it.  But I'm giving it three stars because the second time we came here it wasn't that great the food just didn't taste the same and maybe it was because it had been a while and they might've changed the recipes but definitely not the experience I expected the second time around.  I'm definitely going to give them the benefit of the doubt and try it out one more time.

I have ordered from here and have ate at the restaurant and both were amazing!! I don't eat a lot of Italian food or pizza in general but this is definitely one of the places that I can keep going to every day their food is just that good!! 

We had my sister's 19th birthday party here and they were so good and gracious with us we had a huge party of about 12 people and we were ordering drinks and food and desserts but they made sure everything came out in a timely manner and that everything was right there was no mistakes in our orders there was no mistakes in our foods and everyone had a blast!!!

Visited my first Hubbard's & Cravens in Indy! I went mid-day, so it was pretty packed! I got the iced Carmilla latte which was an unsweetened iced coffee and I was expecting the caramel+vanilla latte. I'm not sure if they forgot the flavors or it if it was just naturally this way, but got my order to go so didn't notice until I sipped while driving away.

I'd like to go back and give them another chance and cross my fingers for being able to get seating next time. I noticed several people come in and leave because there was no open seating available. Popular spot! Plus they have Ethiopian coffee available that I was tempted to purchase!

Now that Planet Fitness has been open for over a year it needs a little TLC. A couple of the arc trainers could use a check-up since they make some irregular cranking noises. Some of the hooks in the bathrooms are broken and need to be tightened or replaced, and the women's bathroom floor could use a good sweeping as well. Usually it's pretty clean, but not so much during this visit.

This location is still a great place for a workout. Even during its busiest hours there are always plenty of machines available.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Very nice accommodations once you are put into a clean room, we were not satisfied until the 3rd room- the others smelled of urine and cigarettes. The room and stay would had been perfect being that it's like a small condo except our 3rd room was right by the pool and a cookout area where other guests were far from obeying their quiet rule and this kept up until midnight each night; I had to complain just so they would send security to take care of the noise. They were nice enough to comp us for a night.
The pool is small but they have a cool basketball court and the beds are comfortable.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
On our way home from visiting family, so excited when I found this restaurant just a couple miles off the freeway- completely and 100% authentic! I had steak tacos and my hubbie had a burrito, both were very delicious and made with quality beef. The guacamole and salsa were perfect (plus there are other salsas to choose from) and the chips, exactly how I like them, thick and dark- great corn flavor. 
The family who owns the restaurant is very friendly and the service was FAST, I think we had our food in under 5 minutes, unbelievable- We saw a family of 8 receive their meals just as quick. I would go back anytime.

The 3 roll special was the major reason my friends and I used to go to Kai over other nearby places, but now that it's changed, I no longer have a strong desire to go. Their sushi is good, but not worth the price without some kind of deal (Groupon, happy hour prices, etc.) in my opinion. I've also been happy with the non-sushi items I've ordered.

The interior is beautiful and minimalistic. The service is fast and we are always greeted politely. It's always been strange to me that it's never very full inside, even on weekends, but it is quite nice to be seated immediately on a Saturday at 7pm.

So we came here on a whim around 7pm on a Thursday evening and because we didn't have a reservation we wound up sitting at the bar.  This place is hopping - make reservations!

The bar was totally fine and service was super fast and friendly.  The food is great value for what you pay for and their sashimi was fantastic!  Their rolls are your basic sushi rolls, no attempts at recreating new/modernized rolls. The veggies were all super fresh too.  Our teapot was always full so that was really nice too - despite how busy they were they were def taking care of their customers.

Totally worth checking out!

I went back for an appointment last week after a year hiatus.  I was so taken aback by just how friendly the entire staff was from the front desk to the Eye Dr.  I got compliments on my earrings, and they were all just so happy and friendly!  Everything was explained every single step of the way.  I absolutely love the glasses that I got here 2 years ago, I drive to the other side of town to continue coming here!  It just truly struck me how incredibly sweet everyone was.  I had a last minute situation come up, and they even offered to waive the cancellation fee.  The best of customer service ever!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: My first time here, and I really liked it - it's a build your own pizza place.  They are several pre-made combos to choose from, which I like because I feel like the restaurant usually knows what goes well together, or you can totally choose all your own sauces, and toppings... then they throw it into a brick oven, and it's yummy!  You can choose your own dough too.  One thing I didn't like was how the toppings were kinds sliding off of the pizza.  I like the mirror on the wall that says :meet the executive chef" :).  They a nice selection of deserts too, along with wine and beer selections. It's $7.75 a pizza - nice!

I pulled my car up to the curb of the hotel and was greeted by the friendly valet. I then walked into the beautiful lobby and checked into my room. The wonderful bell hop took the luggage up to the room. Once I was settled in,  I received a phone call from the front desk, making sure my room was ok. I was very impressed with the service of this hotel. The bar was very nice.  It is in a good location on Canal Street. 2 blocks away from the craziness of Bourbon street, but quiet at night for a restful night's sleep! I enjoyed my stay here, and will be back!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been going to this Barber shop now for about 4 times having had all the barbers that work there. But this time I had one of the men I had once before and left with cuts in my scalp that were just short of bleeding. I have a thin scab all the way down my hard part as well as the back of my neck. When I mentioned how sharp the electric razor felt he said yeah some people say that and done don't! I'm terribly disappointed at the fact that I have to heal after a haircut! Guess I'll be looking for a new shop for future cuts without the cuts!

After reading reviews online I was a little skeptical of this place. However upon arrival staff was very friendly and the lobby resembled a Marriott property. I had high hopes! Those were crushed as our room smelled of air neutralizer over spray which after leaving and coming back was obviously covering the musty smell. Our room faced the main road and it was like we were sleeping on the Las Vegas strip all night. Very loud, beds were full size and uncomfortable. Great location but definitely felt more like a 'motel'. We were scheduled to stay 2 nights and checked out well before check out time after one night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I ate here for lunch and sorry what did you do to your mani Dawson's.  Oh you raise your praises sky high.  It was hard for me to find anything under $9 in there so you will not get out of there for lunch anywhere below $9-$12.  Sorry it is not worth it.  I had the veggie wrap w a side of ranch it was good but I had to pay 40 cents for the ranch Bc there was no dressing w the wrap.  

With many lunch choices in Brownsburg this is going at the bottom of my list due to price.  

The server was nice but I did spend a full hour in here.

Cinco de Mayo was your time to shine The Toros. Yes we expected you to be busy but customer service is still key. They did have a special menu w a few items on it for the Cinco De Mayo specials. We were in no rush but we did order guacamole for our chips. That never came. We asked for utensils, which I had to get on my own. My burrito that was brought out was the wrong one and I asked for more salsa. Never received the salsa or guacamole. I ended up eating the burrito that was brought bc the server never came back. 

We usually go to Los Toros or Iguanas but thought we would give this restaurant a try.

Stopped in here for some ice cream cones after spending the day at the Children's Museum.  We ordered 4 ice cream cones, 1 apple pie and 1 drink.  There was no line when we went in.  You would think that this would be an easy order that was quickly filled.  We waited 10 minutes for that small order.  I don't know if they had to milk the cow and hand churn the ice cream or what.  Maybe they had to pick the apples and bake it themselves but it was border lining on ridiculous.  We finally got our cones and such and sat down.  We could not sit without people trying to bum money.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Visited Tucson yesterday and fell in love with the sweet cream honey comb! Listen to the reviews and get a sample of it! It's deliciously creamy and I love it waaay more than Creamistry. 

Creamisty kid's size is $4.95, meanwhile Screamery  is only $2.95. It's cheaper and still quality ice cream. Creamistry is pretty overrated at that price. 

I hope they open one in PHX soon! The cashiers said they were going to in the near future. Crossing my fingers that it's in my area. If you're in the Tucson area, go to Screamery!

I was a regular here with my family. Sad to say this was my last time here. Table with 4 drunk guys using extremely vulgar language on the table next to us. I had to bring my daughter to the car after repeatedly asking the staff to handle it. After a few requests from the staff the guys got mad and started attacking us directly and using threatening language talking about guns, etc. 
they proceeded to get louder and use all kinds of foul language. While one can argue it's not the restaurant's fault, they should have asked the guys to leave. I don't feel safe bringing my family here anymore.

So i had a day off from work and wanted a good home cooked breakfast for my son and I. 3 coins hit the spot.
My son order grits, eggs, and bacon with a side of toast. As for me i order the grits, eggs, and ham steak with a side of toast.  Everything was cooked to order and to my liking. The ham steak was a lil salty but sometimes that can be normal. My son really enjoyed his breakfast eating every last bite.

The diner sits on the corner of Nebraska and E. Broad St in the Seminole Heights area. Dont let the outside fool you, once you come in, you'll be surprised.

Never mind my last review! We've been going to this Great Clips for several years now, and it's great and deserves a new review with five stars. 

This is now our go-to place to take our kids to get haircuts. My kids always get a nice haircut, the people are always friendly and get along well with kids, they're quick (which is also important when you're dealing with kids), the price is right and it's never super crowded. 

I also come here to get quick trims, and they are super no-fuss and I'm in and out very quickly. Sometimes you just need a quick trim and not the full salon experience, so in those cases, I go to this Great Clips.

I didn't think I could expect much from a restaurant attached to a mall but I was mistaken. They had good sushi that was worth the price which by the way was very affordable. And the service here was also good. However that was just about it that was worthy of good mention here. Everything else in this place from the water to the food apart from the sushi leaves much to be deserved. I would lower the stars to maybe a 0.5 or more less if I were to think again but I must admit the sushi was actually good. This place has potential if they clean up their act.

The sushi wasn't bad but it wasn't great. I have had worse and I have had better. 

The dragon roll was pretty good. It was the best of the three rolls I had. The ginger
Roll was okay. The Margarita roll was average. I was kind of disappointed with the selection of rolls they did have. The thing that bothered me the most was the fact that one roll had roe on it, which is fine I mean I did order it lol, but the roe ended up on each roll I had ordered and all three vegetarian rolls that my gf ordered.  Our waitress was polite. I'm just not sure if I would or wouldn't go back.

I was working in the neighborhood and decided to take a walk on down to the Fresh Market. I'd only come to this location once before to buy some turmeric. (Random I know.)

I grabbed some gelato this time around. Didn't get her name, but the woman serving the gelato behind the counter was awesome. She was funny and let me try a few (if not all) samples. I knew I couldn't go wrong with salted caramel.  I realized then that I actually was missing out by avoiding pistachio flavored things for so long. For the price of 2.99 for two HEALTHY scoops, I couldn't beat it!

The best Italian food I've had in Tampa!  The restaurant is tiny and they don't take reservations so there usually is a wait for dinner but it is definitely worth it!

I tried a little of everything,  the lasagna,  linguini,  pear sachets,  tortellini, seafood, prime rib - ALL were excellent!  I went with a party of 6 and we all cleaned our plates out by the end of the night,  the food was too good! 

Service started slow especially since it was so busy but was good overall,  very accommodating.   I highly recommend this restaurant and will definitely be back for more!

I have been here a countless number of times and every time I have had a great meal. The food is utterly delicious. I would recommend the Carbonara, it is creamy and the sauce is fantastic. They have the best I have ever had in my life. The only down side of this restaraunt is that the atmosphere lacks greatly. It is a great place to sit down for a quick, quality meal. The food is great, yet the atmosphere lacks. If you do not care as much about atmosphere and service,  and you are mainly worried about food, then I would suggest to go to this Italian restaraunt. Enjoy!

La Metzicana opened just recently and the building currently still reflects this, as there is no offical sign in the front.  I wonder if they are still just trying to get in the pattern of service because there were a few werid things about my lunch here.  

I had tacos and the meat was not the best of quality.  The salsa did not seem to be really fresh.  We had no problems and enjoied the sauce options they bring to the table.  It seemed like it was 1/2 table service and 1/2 not.  It did not seem like a good flow of service, which is why I gave 3 stars.  

I would come back more often if the quailty of steak is improved.

The only reason I'm giving this place a 2 star instead of a 1 star is because the 1 drink I had there was actually pretty good ( although it was in a small plastic cup with lots of ice which was about 4 sips.) Terrible service and a trashy bar. The bartenders wear bikinis that are practically thongs and posters of the same on the walls. I get it, it's by the beach and some bartenders will do anything to make tips but this place is too much. I much prefer Bongos where the bartenders are a little more classy and I don't feel like I'm at a strip club. Won't be coming back.

I have gone past Old Point Tavern so many times and haven't given them a second thought. I had been missing out on this place. Its a nice small bar that I immediately felt at home in. Grant and Jess the bartenders were so cool. They took great care of us, laughed joked and made sure everything was good throughout our menu. I orders queso and chips and a bbq park quesadilla. The queso was pretty good, not a Qdoba queso but still good. They were not stingy at all with the bbq pork on the quesadilla. It was filled to the edge with pork. 

I will be back and hopefully on a Sat night with Jess and Grant.

So this Starbucks is super convenient because it's in the mall. But the drinks are a hit or miss. I watch the baristas and make sure they do it the way I order it. Usually I know which ones make it right. There was a barista one time adding water to the coffee that was already made up. I'm not sure if they was running low or something but the coffee was horrible and tasted very watered down. That's one of the main things I watch for. If they don't have enough coffee to complete orders then they need to close it down. I will not pay for something that is watered down ever again. Just watch when they make your things.

During my visit I was invited here by some locals one night. I enjoy a good down home bar , which is what this is. There is chicken and fish frying in the back, dancing to loud music upfront, and drinks flowing until they close. I enjoyed myself. I laughed, talked, and danced. I forgot to get me a chicken samich, but they must be good because every other person had one..lol. 

This is place where the locals go nothing touristy about it. If that is not your thing in a new surrounding then I would suggest not going it could be a little intimidating.

Vero is still fairly new to the area, but the pizza is terrific!  We're kind of picky when it comes to sauce on pizza; it can make or break a place.   Vero has great sauce and their pizza is delicious.   Also a fan of the french fries!   Few places actually serve the regular, old fashioned, crinkle cut fries --  Vero does!   I don't like the fries that most places serve now, with the coating or breading on them.   We actually ordered the cheese fries and they were awsesome.  Looking forward to trying other menu items.   We had the wings before, as well, and they were pretty good too.   You can also order online, which is a nice convenience.

Does anyone not love the Old Spaghetti Factory? It's one of the few places in Edmonton that I've been to as a child, a teen, a young adult, an adult, a parent, a boss and a host for out-of-towners. That should give an idea of the range that the Old Spaghetti Factory can serve. I can take staff there for a Christmas Lunch...I can go there on a date...the kids love it no matter how old they get... I like the all-inclusive meal...bread, soup or salad, entree and spumoni for dessert. Tried and true. Most of the time there's no wait and there's street parking all around.

After a recent visit to this BP location, I'm adjusting my previous review. This visit included waiting for a table, the restaurant was busy but not full so the wait seemed unnecessary. The server was very good. The food quality was questionable. Certain things were fine; the desserts for example. The salad though...it shouldn't have been served. I ended up picking out most of the lettuce due to discoloration, and the level to which it was wilted. At the risk of sounding pompous, the wine selection was limited. I love the central location and the service provided by the servers but the food did not live up to the famous BP reputation.

Came here for our Valentines dinner. We were' aware that it was a prefix valentines dinner, nobody told us when we made reservation.
Anyhow, the ambience is very quiet and intimate which I like. The prefix was $75 per person for 3 course meal (pricey). 
I had the veal milanese and bf had the New York strip. 
We ended up spending about $230 with drinks and cocktails. 
They're drinks are really good. I liked the Blissful Martini. 
I wouldn't recommend this for an every day thing. 
I liked the ambience, but I wouldn't go there again. 
The food was okay, it wasn't "WOW"

Nice little sushi spot around the corner from the convention center and reading terminal market.  They had a handful of tables so it's definitely not 'to go only' though they were doing a brisk to go business.  

I had a rainbow roll and two tuna avocado rolls.  I added roe to both.  Quite tasty. My only slight criticism is that i feel very certain the tuna avocado rolls were pre-made.  This was doubly confirmed when I got an additional one to go and it was clearly fresher and the ingredients looked different.

How does my favorite sushi place near my apartment not have more love on here? First off best sushi in Bucks County! If you're unsure of coming here do yourself a favor and stop what you're doing and head over to Osaka for delicious sushi!!! The Tuna Pizza is my favorite thing on the menu. It's sheer perfection really: spicy tuna, caviar, avocado and other delicious things. I also love their Salmon teriyaki and spicy tuna and salmon rolls. If you haven't come to Osaka Sushi yet do yourself a favor and change that!

Wow! Everytime I come here, I am blown away. Tonight we had the swordfish which was cooked to perfection. The quinoa salad was fantastic. Also came with some asparagus which was crunchy and amazing. We also had the zucchini meatballs which came with spagetti squash. I would eat this for every meal of the day. My only issue with this place is we ate in the market common area because the actual restaurant is so small. I had to listen to someone talking about puking in the sink. He was all wasted from the beer crawl. So you have five star food in a one star setting.

Wings and potato skins for apps were decent.  Crab cakes were good, but the kids mac-n-cheese was marginal.  Noodles were overcooked and cheese sauce was watery.  Crab cakes were good, veggies on side were raw.  Shrimp and grits were a complete disappointment.  Grits were not cheesy, shrimp was tiny and the weird spinach and vinaigrette on top didn't make sense.  Service was excellent.  The price tag for two apps, two dinners, a kid meal, one beer and a glass of wine was $110...much higher than the quality of food spoke to.

Their pizza is in our rotation and it's a decent pie- best non-Picas pie we've discovered in Havertown. The Kelly O' Fries are solid- melted cheddar and mozzarella with bits of bacon. Also, the steak bread is well worth it. The wings fell a little short, but we'll give them another shot. They can get busy on weekends so plan accordingly.

The cheese steaks are mediocre. The onions were over-cooked and seemed to be sitting for quite some time. The fries also seemed to be sitting for awhile and dropped down in the fryer- muy disappointed.

Located behind an abandoned building, the only sign that indicates that this was the right place was the sign on the road, the hotel itself is unlabeled.

Pros: 
Hot water
Cable
Gentleman and housekeeping are friendly

Cons:
Only 2 of the 4 lamps work
Furniture had stains
Curtain had holes
Wet spot on carpet 
Ants in the bathroom
Smelled like old cigarette
Lady who works the front desk isn't very customer oriented 
Wi-Fi is patchy
Walls are thin, woken up at 3 am by a group of people fighting in front of the hotel (I'm on the 2nd floor)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Dr. Olcott and the ER vet were fantastic, they called everyday that my dog was hospitalized with an update. I give the doctors 5 stars. 
The rest of the staff I give a 2 star. They are not customer oriented, particularly, Debra (Doctor Olcott's administrator). She is almost never able to come to the phone and when you leave a voicemail, she never returns your call, instead I constantly had to be the one to call her back. When I do  reach her, she is incredibly rude, she interrupts me every time and never hears what I have to say. Her responses are really rude as well, such as "well, did you not get my email?" They need to replace her!

Really disappointing. I was looking forward to having a cheaper gym closer to my apartment and while the equipment is new it is seriously lacking in variety. I know that Planet Fitness doesn't "cater" to bodybuilders, but the only free weights they have at all are dumbells, not even a bench press. Upon touring the gym I noticed this and asked if they would at least be getting a bench and the employee taking me around (who was a manager) told me "No, that's the kind of thing we're against here." The equipment they do have is new and the facility itself is nice, but if you're looking to lift any weights at all don't bother.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Food is great.  Had wings which are half grilled and fried.  The beer selection was adequate but they were out of the beer the server told us about.  The hot pepper wings were excellent. We love this place but Saturday night they were not busy and the service was horrible.  We just kept waiting it was so bad we waited in 20 minute intervals. She just didn't get it.  The appitzer was brought out with the dinner and then we chased her down all night.  I will still come back but they need to hire better servers. L__r_ needs to be more attentive. Too bad

One of my favorite places to eat, ever! The lunch is great, there are wine specials during the week, the staff is passionate about good Italian food and it is authentic, I mean the good stuff!! And anywhere that lights cheese and liquor on fire is just great in my opinion! The house made lemoncello is also a great aperitif! If you plan on coming here and expect a 30min meal with some Marie calendars imitation fettuccini just spare yourself the experience, it is usually a long wait, a long dinner, and the best meals are the ones they recommend.

First place I've gotten all you can eat. I wish I could give this a 3.5 stars.

I guess it's great that they do have it. Not as many options as I would have hoped for speciality rolls but still not too bad! 

I would recommend coming here for for the fresh fish!! Especially the salmon. Seriously. It's awesome. Their system is you look on a piece of paper and order accordingly. I wish there were at least pictures...only downside.


Also get the appetizers! They're not exactly Japanese appetizers, more like Asian fusion. Still pretty good!

The restaurant is beautiful and they have those igloos outside for outdoor eating which look neat. My only gripe is the menu when labeling a dish doesn't really give the full ingredients in the dish. I ordered the a pasta dish and when it came out it had chili peppers. They were never listed. The dish also had other ingredients that I didn't see listed. Unfortunately I don't like chili peppers and had I know I would've asked for them to be not included. The manager came and was very nice and offered me a new dish or a refund. So that was my only issue is just wishing the menu was more clear on what you were getting.

I didn't know what to expect when we decided to go here. I had heard people say it is only for hipsters and all that but we decided to go anyways, I'm glad we did. The place isn't very big but I really like the design inside. There definitely isn't another bar in Reno that has a design even close to this ones. The beer selection was great, the bartender knew what he was doing and offered suggestions and samples if needed to find the beer we wanted. We will be back and encourage other people to try the place out as well.

Eh, food wasn't that great. Came in craving sushi, wasn't great at all. A friend ordered coconut shrimp, and ended up with lumps of fried bread, had to decline paying for it. Hard place to find, couldn't tell if it was open at first. Very dark inside. I get that it helps save food and probably cost, but kinda disappointed that we were committing to paying for any food that was not eaten... does it get donated or just thrown out..? Overall not worth the money or stress. Was looking for a nice, chill night out.

STAY AWAY!! I went here last weekend and there was a big piece of fried paper mixed in with my side of fries! What's worse is the waitress didn't seem the least bit surprised when I told her about it and did nothing to offer to make up for it! 

No wonder this place was closed by the city for food care code violations and roaches in their kitchen! It's a shame they're allowed to reopen, clearly things aren't any better there. I'll NEVER be back here again.

Go to Miguel's on the corner of Kennedy and Macdill if you want good Mexican food.

My girlfriend and I arrived for a wedding. This is the worst experience I ever had in a hotel. First off, we were not able to check it until 4pm. This slowed down our progress for the rehearsal dinner. Second, they accidentally put us in an old room with a shower with half a door. Third, the bathroom had a funky odor. We had to call to get the bathroom clean. It smells fine now so I can conclude they didn't clean the bathroom in the first place.
  The only pros are the friendly staff and the shower pressure which feels like waterfall. Then again the water leaks since we only have half a door.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Gorgeous apartments, really nice appliances, With great amenities but the lack of care is starting to show from management. 

Half of the cardio machines don't work, and are always down.
Our so call spin room where we supposedly can get free classes on the TV -- doesn't work 

The coffee machine hasn't worked in months. I just gave up on it. 

Also they charge for "trash removal" on top of the valet trash fee. Too many hidden fees. 

Parking is tight, and majority  of them are reserved and also there is no visitor parking (they have to pay)

I purposely waited awhile before going to make sure the kinks were worked out and I'm very happy I did. Around 1pm the line was still long, I'm assuming from the lunch rush. I was pleasantly surprised it moved quickly. I ordered the Market Turkey Bacon Ranch sandwich and delicious! Ample amount of bacon, just the right amount of ranch and plenty of turkey on soft bread. It's a monster of a sandwich so two people could easily share if you aren't famished. I haven't been to an Arby's in many years so I was impressed and those yummy curly fries brought back good memories quickly. I'm definitely coming back!

This is my favorite sushi restaurant in the city for lunchtime sushi. I find that the 'mix 3 special' is a steal of a deal given the excellent quality of the fish. I have converted countless coworkers into Shiroi Hana regulars, and highly recommend it. I have had most of the appetizers as well as the sushi and sashimi. Colleagues have had some of the cooked dishes if they didn't like raw fish, and always said they liked the food.

The service is also attentive and very quick, and the fish is presented nicely on the plate. Even at noon I can get in and out under an hour, which is not my experience at some other restaurants at that time.

I was looking for a place to hang out for a little, while I was waiting to board my flight back to the burgh. Since there is no place in the Nashville Airport for priority pass members, I decided to hang somewhere close to my gate... which was this place. The service is realllly slow, like many other yelpers said. It took me a while to receive the 1 beer I had ordered (which was like $12 or $14 with tip mind you), so by the time I got it I had to drink it rather quickly so I could finish it before my flight boarded. It was a decent place to hang out and watch TV, but I wouldn't order food from here.

Stayed here for one-night- we were able to check-in a little early (noon instead of 4) which I was SUPER thankful for. Parking was expensive ($38) but it was awesome to be able to come & go Downtown as I pleased. The room was honestly a little outdated, but it was clean and had everything we needed. No free breakfast here, but they did offer breakfast at the hotel. The bar area was really nice and we were able to enjoy some live music on Saturday evening at the bar. Overall, we had a good time here but I don't think I would stay here again. Downtown Nashville is too crazy for me and it was not very cheap to stay here on a Saturday evening.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Got take out from here based on the reviews. Not really that blown away. I ordered spicy yellowtail and spicy shrimp sushi, boom boom shrimp (which I assumed was like bang bang shrimp at bonefish grill-wrong) and yellowtail and jalapeño appetizer. The yellow tail app was ok. But the sushi was not yellowtail. It was just spicy tuna and had a fishy smell. The spicy shrimp was not spicy at all and had more "crunch" flakes than anything. The boom boom shrimp was sweet and sour shrimp w a barely spicy mayo on the side. Eh.. I was kinda disappointed. The girl at the counter was nice so they bumped up the stars to 3.

Ordered from here earlier as I was at work and went to pick it up on my break. Ordered their panzarotti and to my surprise it was very small and I was charged more than it was listed for on the online menu. The panzaroti itself was alright. Dough was a little chewy and pepperoni was all stuck together inside like they were too lazy to spread it out. Workers behind counter acted as if I was disturbing their peace when they had to ring me up. Probably won't be returning. Pizza places around here are a dime a dozen and this place is just alright

I loved the great service, BYOB, cozy atmosphere, and yummy food. I got salad as entree with cranberries and walnuts and fish with spinach. The dishes weren't fancy, innovative or earth-shattering, but it was delicious and I cleaned my plate. My friend got steak and potatoes, which was simple and tasty. 

Overall, a good place for a cozy date night, simple and to the point. Not for a fancy night out where you want to be impressed. It's the kind of place where everyone lingered around the table talking and leaving unfinished corks to the surrounding tables. Plus a place with great bread is good in my book.

Love this place! They have a great selection of...everything. The beer can be purchased from the shelf or from the cooler. They sell singer beers to build your own 6-pack or you can buy a pack of your favorite.

The wine selection is almost overwhelming...luckily, they're willing to give suggestions...and they're actually good! Last time I was in, they helped my find a red blend for $9.75 that was made by a family in honor of their grandfather. Cool story. Great wine. 

Doesn't look like much from the outside - but it's worth it!

I've been to Vetture's twice so far.  It is informal, affordable Italian food -- the kind I grew up with in NE Ohio before moving to Tampa Bay a/k/a the land of chains.  There is nothing fancy about it, but the food is good, the service is friendly, and the price is right.  I had pizza the first time, and chicken parm with a side of pasta marinara the second time.  Both were good.  They also have $2.00 draft beer specials, and we got 20% off of our bill for checking in on Yelp.  They also give 20% off to police and firemen in uniform.

Wonderful ice cream!
Unusual flavors - goat cheese and cherries?  Yes.  Reisling and pear?  Yep!  A whole lot more?  You have no idea, ask for tastes!!!  I decided on the Brambleberry Crisp.  It was delicious!
Price - it's up there, but it's quality ice cream.

This is not your run-of-the-mill ice cream and is not a place I will always think of when I'm in the mood for ice cream but I will return, for sure.  If I'm in the area, I'll consider it or Pied Piper.  If I'm in the Brentwood area, I'll be visiting Glazee.  Great and unique choices in the Nashville area, lucky us!!!

I'm not too sure how I haven't went to this place before, it was amazing! Great variety, great sushi and kind staff. We went here for a evening out of good sushi & were more than satisfied. 

The 4 rolls we chose were:
The Dynamite Roll (my personal favorite)
The Shrimp Tempura Roll
The Spicy Salmon Roll (boyfriend's favorite)
The Crunch Crab Roll

Of course we had our favorite rolls but every single roll we had was phenomenal and I am excited to go back and try out more from their menu! I definitely recommend trying the Dynamite Roll if you dint know what you want to get!

I've driven by this place many times and never stopped in until last week. The style of the interior is amazing! Whoever designed the restaurant really knew what they were doing! They have a crazy amount of options to pick from for breakfast, lunch and dinner. We went there to try out their breakfast on Labor Day. My boyfriend loved his bread bowl egg scramble and would definitely recommend it. I had the eggs Benedict with potatoes, wasn't a fan of the potatoes but the Benedict was great! We will definitely be stopping in for lunch or dinner this month to try out the rest of their meals - the menu definitely makes me excited to come back!

Honestly,  this place sucked. My parents were in town and we wanted to go somewhere nearby. We sat down at 4 on a Saturday afternoon and were literally the only ones there. By the time the waiter got to us, we'd been sitting there for over 15 minutes (the hostess got us our drinks). We ordered the pizza. The crust was waaaay too thin (honestly, it was more like flatbread) and the bottom was burnt. Once our food came, the waitrr didn't come back again. We had to wave down another waiter to get our bill. Will not be returning.

Have eaten here many times before! Had the Chicken Parm and pasta! Comes with a delicious house salad and tasty dressing. You also have a choice of garlic bread or regular Italian, they send out huge loaves. The pasta as a side was delicious! Very tasty, food served nice and hot! My friend had the spaghetti with the white clam sauce! She said is was awesome, it smelled wonderful. My only complaint was that the chicken parm needed some flavor. It had none. The bread crumbs need some seasoning, thats an important factor if your breading things! The sauce was delicious, fresh and flavorful.

Came in on 10-15-16 AROUND  10 pm. We had placed an online order and ended up needing to make another.  There was only 1 person in the dining room and then whoever in the drive through.  We stood at the counter for maybe a 5 minutes all the while no one acknowledged us . Finally a manager came by and took care of our order. That was fine and all but when we got home they totally missed the cheese I asked for on my chicken rings. I should have checked my order before I left but I was already so dissatisfied I didn't think of it. Maybe the next time will be better

Great find!  Just walking down the side street and noticed the nice Zagat's review in the window. Nothing to look at as far as decor but the food has always been excellent and as a BYOB it is ideal for small groups.  

Our group ordered all the appetizers they offered that evening and no one was disappointed.  I loved the perfectly prepared short ribs and my wife enjoyed Atlantic Cod. The service was friendly and the waitress was knowledgeable as she seem to enjoy describing the food. 

The place is small and I would recommend calling for a reservation on weekends. It can also get a little loud but I don't mind the energy.

Had the lunch buffet, and it was pretty good overall. I really liked the breadsticks and marinara. Salad was good too. The pizza was good although not the best pizza ever. Don't get me wrong, it was good just not something I would really call home about. The buffet is super tiny and since they were busy, it was tough for them to keep it full and with a wide variety of pizzas. The service was good. The people were kind and you could tell they were working hard. The bathroom was a little dirty which is never fun. But overall it was a fine experience and a pretty good deal.

The sushi is good - very fresh and I love how they flavor their rice. Downside - the speciality rolls are crazy expensive and are average at best. Better sushi restaurants in the city have cheaper specialty rolls.
The regular rolls are tastier in my opinion and worth the money.
Service was below average - we felt rushed at the end even though it was 15 minutes before closing.

Biggest upside of this place was that they served Chabaa Thai. However, they shrunk that menu over the last couple of weeks to barely serve a few Chabaa dishes. I mean how do you remove red curry from Chabaa's menu?!

All in all its a solid 3 stars. No more and no less.

I first saw this bar on bar rescue and I love this place! It's my go-to spot when we're visiting Bourbon street, especially with people who've never been. If you haven't done the Spinning Fireball Shot Chair... have you even been to Bourbon Street?! The bartenders are nice, the drinks are strong and the live piano is always playing. This bar also serves some food which is necessary after a long night of walking the street! Get the resurrection drink in the blinking souvenir cup and ditch those green hand grenades lol

This has been the week of really disappointing restaurant/fast food experiences. I stopped by this location at 9:50 am on June 29, 2017 to pick up breakfast for a co-worker and I. Waited in line for 15 minutes while watching a senior woman have to come back to the counter three times for something to get her order right. Not a good sign. There were several people waiting for their orders and several in the lineup and cars in the drive-thru but no one was getting served so I had to leave empty handed and hungry.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I ordered from Franco's on a regular basis. Most of the time I get there veal Parmesan which is amazing and the regular pizzas are also very good. Although the last time I ordered from them I got their tomato pie. I was not impressed at all the sauce was watery and the crust was soggy. When I picked up the actual slice all the tomato slid right off. You would think considering the restaurant is called Franco's tomato pies the tomato pie would be their signature pie but when I got it I felt like a regular cheese pizza beat that any day the week other then that Franco's is a good place to get some food for a decent price

Residence inn by Marriott Tampa Westshore Airport off Lois and Spruce really stepped up their complimentary breakfast ! They now offer amazing savory juicy sliced polish sausage, shredded beef, scrambled eggs, boiled eggs, cheese, salsa, sour cream, Cinnabon's, bagels, yogurt, fresh fruit, fresh fruit juice and coffee! There's a make your own waffle station with strawberry,  blueberry, sugar free syrup, sugar free whipped cream, chocolate kisses, caramel, and many more toppings! This location has a pool, basketball courts, gym, business center, but sadly no hot tub.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Great location. Haven't really Ben inside so I can't comment on the inside amenities. However, this place really lacks a double drive thru window. At lunch time, the drive thru can get very long. But, the order is right and the food comes out hot and fresh. 

The drive thru for me is not a big problem but is when your a fast food restaurant. Key word "fast." People frequent fast food restaurants for speedy and correct service. The single drive thru window in the middle of West End. Yeaaa that's kind of a problem.

I was excited that they delivered to my house from the app that I was using and I didn't have an issue paying additional for the delivery. as always the food is good and I am a fan of the pizza. What I didn't understand is that I ordered from here twice and paid the additional delivery fee. the second time they delivered, I was told that, we don't deliver here and we won't be delivering here anymore. this will be the last time. Ok, so then why is your location registered with an app where for an additional fee, you will deliver here. That is very contradicting and is why they got the rating they did.

This is my go to lunch spot. Quesadilla, wraps and chips/salsa. The food is just average, but the portions are large. I do suggest the chips and queso. I knocked off a few stars because the quality of food could be better.My quesadillas always seem very thin. The flavor also starts to blend in. 

They also have a pretty long wait time when you dine in. Forget ordering delivery if you order past 10:30am. I have mistakenly ordered lunch at noon and waited almost 90 minutes for the delivery. The food arrived cold. They do have online ordering which is a plus...The food is average, but I'll be back. It is reliable average food.

My wife and I snuck away to SB for the weekend, spent the afternoon pub crawling, hands down every barkeep recommended this fine Italian place.

Was not disappointed, started at the bar where Evo, he put on quite the show, not to mention he knew his spirits!

Dinner was fabulous, my wife licked her plate clean, best mushroom pasta she has ever had. My caesar was amazing, with nice tasty anchovies on the side. Finished off with seafood pasta that was an array of fresh fish... fantastic!!!

Place is small and cozy, excellent service, eats, and drinks!!! We will be back!

Loved this place.   Sweet young waitress was very knowledgeable and attentive.   Had a basket of thick warm bread brought out w olive oil for dipping.   Salads were delicious w a light balsamic dressing and entrees were perfect.    Fettuccine w chicken sausage and a fantastic tortellini dish in a creamy white sauce were so good.  We ate plenty and took home leftovers.    Had to try their tiramisu and it was delicious.   Celebrating our anniversary and this is definitely a memorable meal.  Enjoyed a great bottle of trialing too.  We ll definitely go back sometime for delicious high quality Italian food.

This is one of my all-time favorite Bourbon Street bars. Seriously! I spent many nights over 2 Mardi Gras experiences at Tropical Isle and the band is fun and engaging. They play music I know and everyone can actually sing to - and trust me...people SING!

Why do they sing so much, you ask?? Well...this is the bar with the famous Hand Grenades. I have no idea what is in them. Doesn't matter. They are good, good, good and not all alcohol-y - but, they hit you like...well...I'm assuming a hand grenade!? 

Go enjoy the fun!

Went to have my Faux leather coat cleaned after an incident with a feline, dropped coat off, they said they couldn't dry clean because of material but would get the coat clean, $25 prepaid. So a week goes by, I called them and asked for an update, the guy said " we can't dry-clean it, I said I know, and brought up the conversation we had at the counter. He asked the woman I originally spoke with in person and said " ok, it will be done on thursday, which is another week away! Well finally the coat was cleaned, and in good shape, but the wait and poor communication was a problem.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Fantastic sushi. I have been to this restaurant DOZENS of times. The sushi is delicious and always fresh. California rolls are enormous and best in the city. Small and family run, if you want to get a table on a Friday or Saturday you better make a reservation! The odd time we have gone during peak hours and waited a long time for food but it happens from time to time. Some waitresses are not overly pleasant, but the food quality makes up for it. Chefs always great you when you come in the door. Will keep returning!

Old Pointe Tavern (OPT) is one of those bars along Mass Ave that are great, but nothing really stands out so much that you'd recommend this place. It would be weird to not have it on Mass Ave, but I can't say I couldn't live without it. 

My recollection of this place is simple drinks (beers) and vegetarian nachos. They're delicious! The place is a bit small but the outside patio area helps break it up in the warmer months. The patio is also perfect for people watching. 

Is it good? Yes. Best place along Mass Ave? No.

The service at Sakana was excellent, and the servers were very friendly and attentive. They had a variety of signature rolls to choose from and our orders came out fast. Every roll and nigiri we ordered was delicious! Presentation was on point and the fish was very fresh. On top of it all of was the homemade ice cream which my friends and I loved! They had a lot of flavors to choose from such as Birthday cake, Cotton Candy, Blueberry Cheesecake and Mint Chocolate Chip! Definitely coming back for AYCE here again!

I love the sushi here and their everyday special 50% off. There's just so much variety so hard to choose from. This place is always busy even for takeouts! But whenever I don't have time to dine in I order out. I have their menu on my fridge and order takeouts almost every week. I love the salmon sashimi and their special rolls. I'm glad I don't have to drive downtown for expensive sushi that is made the same without paying double the price. I love sushi in general. I'm glad Sakura is right around the corner from my house.

Probably one of the best automatic car washes around.

I used to work in Wilmington, so I would have to drive past this place all the time. I have never had my car shine so good. They use Armor All Products and they have 3 different tiers of car washes. I use the $20 service and I think it is money well spent for a quick wash.

The only gripe I have that I gave it 3 stars is that they don't allow trucks to pass through their car wash. I bought a new truck and was disappointed that I was turned away. It's a shame. Hopefully they fix this issue soon.

We are always looking for great Mexican food! This placed nailed it. We came on cinco de mayo and it was extremely busy, but they managed to squeeze us in a corner - which I didn't mind. It is kind of small inside. They also had giveaways for cinco de mayo & I won some cool sombrero sunglasses. The margaritas were good and $2 for 5 - not sure if they always run this special. The food was delicious and authentic! Most of the staff speaks Spanish & English. 

The location is off the road and around back, but maps will get you there.

First time here:
So far on this first trip to Bistro 7 I have only sampled the green bean fries. They are OK but I think if they used a lighter batter on the vegetable so they didn't have to cook it so long to get it crispy the green beans would stay a little more firm and be tastier. I have ordered the steak frites but they will have to go some to please me with that. I have eaten this dish all over France so I know what is this supposed to be like. More later on that. I won't be sampling the wine tonight as I am the driver.

*First online order : it was easy peasy @740pm
-Due to it being my first order online with Sorrentos Pizza I contacted them to make sure it went through. Called them twice, no answer.. But I guess third times a charm. If I didn't call, who knows when my order would've gone in. Order placed @747pm 
-Order was incorrect: receipt clearly has what I ordered but, but my green peppers were missing
*Chicken cheesesteak was good, fresh bread, creamy and meaty 
*buffulo chicken platter: fries was nasty cold, chicken was ok.. Had better 
- meal delivery @842pm 
$$$21.00$$$ food,tax and tip

Stopped in here for a couple drinks before our swamp tour down the street at Ultimate Swamp Adventures. The drinks were strong, the patrons were nice, they had a wonderful sitting area outside to enjoy the weather. The owner was very personable and came out and sat with us for some time giving us restaurant suggestions that were off the beaten path a little bit; we tried an oyster house he recommended and it was delicious! This was the perfect place to enjoy a couple of hurricanes (much better than what you find in downtown NOLA) and the sun before going out on the water!

I guess coming from Ohio where we have Jeni's ice cream I've been spoiled. You can get it at whole foods here and you'll never ever step foot in to this place again. Creole creamery is so over rated, over priced(Jeni's is expensive but damn worth every penny) and just blah. I've tried it a couple times and its just mediocre. There were also screaming kids all over and the parents were clearly just not giving a damn. It was sooo utterly obnoxious. I know that's not the shops fault but it didnt make my experience any better. The staff however is very friendly hence the 3 star.

I've been her a couple times now. Had their buffet and ordered off the menu. Poor Mexican food. Nothing is fresh here. I had the chimichanga and it was extremely dry and just smothered  with cheese. You can't even taste the chicken. I wouldn't recommend doing the buffet. It's all dry and greasy. On the other hand, the chips and salsa is delicious! Oh and cheap margaritas too! Oh and not sure what the deal is, a lot of the men like to flirt there too. Not comfortable for payin customers that is trying to enjoy their lunch and dinner.

For breakfast I love the egg sandwich. Depending on the time of day you go the service can sometimes be slow, but I am rarely in a hurry and have never felt like it was a burden. For dinner the wings and sweet potato fries are my favorite. I always get a side of blue cheese dressing because it is the best.  The food is always consistent and the folks are friendly. Sometimes you can catch live music or karaoke if you play your cards right!

Check out the artwork when you are in there too. Local screen prints from Arcade Death. Gives an old 50s diner a bit of edge.

I don't normally do fast food chains but this place is my sanctuary, my office away from my office. I love this place. I go here atleast once a week. They staff is always friendly and the drink machine is always stoked. It is new and located right near Bankers Life Field House.

Five Guys has the best burgers and this franchise is no different. And you get a bag of fries (Yes, please). You cant beat that. I am in heaven. 

The only issue that I have is being bombarded by people coming in the back door and asking me for money while I am eating.  That is the difference between a 4 and 5 star.

We recently had a small office party catered by Cancun. They were awesome to work with. We placed our order with Jose, who was extremely friendly. He confirmed our order and seemed eager to help. Once the event day came, Jose arrived on time. He was very friendly and outgoing. He helped deliver our food, and everything we needed to serve and eat it. Plates, napkins, forks, serving utensils etc. The food was all fresh, and tasted great. Everyone on our team loved it! The rest of the office was jealous. The cost was around $9 per person, and we had plenty of food to go around. I would recommend them to anyone, and would use them in the future.

Came here for a friends birthday, my husband and I ordered the sushi dinner for two. We were served the sushi and sashimi platter instead. I didn't want to hold everyone else up from eatting or make them aware so I politely told the waitress on the side, she did discount my meal by 5 dollars but to me that did not remediate that I do not like or eat plain sashimi.  I had to give away 15 sashimi pieces to the table. Also it did not taste very fresh. 
The specialty rolls that my friends ordered looked good, if I were to come back I would order that instead.

We stopped at Tako due to the positive reviews on yelp. We brought a bottle of white wine with us, the staff did not bring a ice or a chill bucket for us. It took 45 minutes for our appetizers to come out. The edamame was over cooked and mushy while the spring roll did not look appetizing almost like it was frozen. I could buy better spring rolls from trader joes.
Next we moved on to our sushi which was sat on the sushi bar for 15 minutes before it was brought to us. The sushi it self was good, but not the best I have ever had,
If I came here again I would not buy any appetizers. The service was slow

Just ordered dinner from here about 20 minutes ago. I put on each food I ordered that I had an allergy to shellfish and to make sure there wasn't any cross contamination. I also called the restaurant to make sure it was enforced.... here I an 20 minutes later swollen. The food was tasty but it was evident there had been some cross contact. When I called to verify none of my food would come in contact with any shellfish I was told it wouldn't..... very upset. I would have changed my order accordingly if certain items were at risk of cross contamination.  So I spent $25 and now can't eat any of it.

I was literally blown away by the food here. I live in the city, but the fam still lives in Doylestown-area, so I always like to hit up a new place to eat when I come home to visit. 

My boyfriend and here came for happy hour / dinner and absolutely love it. We just got back from Maine, so I of course got the lobster roll, and he got the fish and chips. Lobster roll was so good I couldn't believe it. And for $8 on HH, I couldn't believe the portion. Boyfriend was happy with his fish and chips and got a huge portion as well.

We stuck with wine, which was just okay. But I'm excited to come back for dinner again soon!

Place needs a serious updating and a thorough cleaning.  Holy 1980-90s!

I think someone sat on my sandwich.  

If they put a few of those nationwide advertisement dollars into hiring people that would give a damn (franchise owners mainly) then Arby's would be a more frequent stop.  

The food is fair so I bumped it up a star to make it two. Please Arby's - I have consumed your food since I was a tiny little boy. Do something quick!  McDonalds made the same mistake - letting the franchises go to hell to cleaning the place. The tables and bathrooms need cleaned. I hope that is not true of the kitchen. 

The bathrooms are scary too. 

Please!

Reserved a truck the other day because I needed to move. I don't have a licence so I had a friend who could drive. We get there and they said oh since he's the one driving he has to pay. Between my friend and I we had over 500 cash on us...he has no available card on him...the guy refused the cash and we walked out. To save yourself the disappointment use uhaul at 12th and washington...they make things easy and aren't petty af about who pays and aren't discriminatory. BTW even if I had a license you have to pay a bull crap 12 dollar second driver fee. This is why uhaul will always be number one and budget at the bottom of the  barrel.

Even though we didn't stay long because we had a very early flight, we were pleased with our stay.  Coming from out of town and being able to receive great customer service provided by Mr. Terrell at the front counter was great!  He was very pleasant and hospitable, he explained the amenities all the way down to breakfast for the next morning.  His assistance made me add this location to my list of hotels to visit!  The room was very clean (the tub could use a touch-up though), the beds were very comfortable and the heat was perfect.  This is a must return!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The Shrimp  were so huge, is was easy to understand why they were .50 each with the head on.  Things were like prawns.  The new addition to the grab n go plates are the BBQ for $5....

But today in the middle of July the bakery is killing it.  Fresh baked cookies.  Orange crush, dr. Pepper, and 7up cakes.  Blackout cake.  Pineapple upside down cake.  Chantilly cake, diverge, chocolate cream cheese, chocolate decadent and chocolate thunder.  Red velvet, praline cake, black magic cake, creole strawberry, pecan  carrot. 

If these taste as good as they look  this place is on fire .

The reason I gave this place a one star is because who doesn't do reverse happy hour on Friday night?  Why do u have to drive to broadway to get some late night sushi?  Guess this place doesn't want to make money with a late night crowd because as the hostess turned us away, they turned away people after us.   Hey!!  Owner of Sushi garden north....you need to change your name to "Sushi Garden who doesn't stay open for late sushi"!  I like your sushi but really??  Update your hours on Yelp for happy hour!!!  Guess u don't like money!!  Oh yeah...we got turned away at 1045 pm and the hours say till midnight!!  Thanks sushi garden

Since we've moved here, this place has been my standard, go-to Chinese takeout. It's fairly average, yet consistent as a takeout place, and I've definitely encountered worse around here. Staff is always very polite and accommodating, service is quick. Minor frustration... I live literally 1.3 miles away and while they do deliver (I've called multiple times and had delivery) for some reason when I try to get delivery through the app, it says they don't deliver to my apartment. Not a major problem, but something weird is happening.

Who doesn't love ice cream! I like Baskin Robbins because they have so many choices! 31! It's in the name! It can be tough deciding, but you can try samples and usually I find the one I want pretty quickly. My last trip I got the German chocolate and it was amazing! Mu husband had the cherry cordial and it was really good too. 
The people are always friendly and they seem to stay open pretty late for last minute ice cream cravings. 
They have been doing a $1.31 special on the 31st of the month. So check your calander and be there the 31st!

Their mochas are as good as it gets. Definitely as good as it gets in Fishtown. I order far too many of them, and that's totally fine. The service experience can vary, but by and large everyone is really nice. Its a good place to get some work done when you don't want to be in the office or on the couch. Last time I was working at ReAnimator the barista brought over a glass of water when I finished my coffee. That was pretty nice of him, and unexpected. I would probably go to any coffee shop that was this close to my house, but I'm really glad its this one.

My friends and I shared the free chips with refried beans on them and totally destroyed them. There is no reason for something so simple to be that good!

Beyond that, my chimichanga was delicious (crispy) and filling. It isn't often that establishments give you a decent-sized portion for the right price. I left here without even spending $10 and was full!

I had never heard of this place and couldn't really pin-point what part of the city it was. I want to say it's Kensington, and there were a mix of people who looked like long-time locals and, for lack of better words, hipster/yuppies. I will definitely be be back!

It goes without saying that for the most part a Subway is a Subway is a Subway or in other words, if you've been to one then you've been to them all and pretty much it takes a lot for a location to F-up the menu.  Thankfully for me, this location for the most part did the chain proud.

The sandwiches were made fast enough and they even had their crack-like addictive Broccoli Cheese soup de-thawed and ready so I got some of that to go as well.  Not to bad with a door to door time of under ten minutes for two soups and three sandwiches.

This is my go-to delivery sushi place.  The ordering is very easy and they usually arrive within 45 min (at the most).  I always get the 3-roll special.  The price can't be beat, the rice has pretty good taste/texture and I really like any of their rolls with salmon - good, fresh flavor and texture.  I also like their spider roll, tuna roll and spicy tuna roll.  The yellowtail here is not bad (not the greatest either and the pieces tend to be thin) and I've tried the tamago and dumplings here - they are not recommended.  If you stick to rolls you'll be very happy!  However, I wouldn't stray past that.

I made a reservation for a birthday party. When we arrived, our reservation wasn't ready which was admittedly very frustrating. When I expressed my annoyance, the staff was extremely apologetic and got our table together as soon as possible.

When we sat down, our server brought out six or seven complimentary appetizers to apologize for their mistake. It was an amazing gesture and we were all very impressed. The rest of the service was fantastic and the food was quite good as well. They also allowed us to bring in cake and were very accommodating all around. I would suggest Cucina Pazzo for a large group! Great food and friendly staff.

There is nothing like a first-rate Italian BYOB in New Jersey or Philadelphia. It's even better when you go to a residential neighborhood that's not obvious and get to sit outside. And it's better still when the menu has 20 items you want to order and then the server, whose father owns the place, tells you about the specials. which included a marvelous thick pork chop in marsala wine sauce with risotto. Deb had a seafood pasta Cardinale that was so good she scooped up all the remaining sauce with bread. You may need a GPS to find this spot but do find it. And call to get one of the sidewalk seats.

My sorority sisters and I had dinner here tonight. The place was packed. We had a table of 15 or so. I don't know how they did it but they managed to keep drinks and food coming at a reasonable time. The staff was all so fun. The funny part of the night: I ordered mushrooms. The server announced, "mushrooms!" I eagerly took a bite and it was chicken. A great bite but not what I ordered. I did eventually get the mushrooms. I'd go back just for those. The highlight was the new Mayor of George's, Stevo!  He was great. Funny and accommodating. I don't know how he did it.  Thanks for a great night.

What I like:
My pozole and all the fixings was tasty and fairly healthy
My bartender was part of the family of owners. He was genuinely interested in my experience 
I like the local vibe 

What I didn't like so much
No beers on tap. All bottles
$10 glasses of wine?? For some reason I think that's excessive for a casual Mexican restaurant

It's still a new restaurant, so I know they are trying things per my great Bartender. 
Suggestion: develop a "skinny cocktail" menu- drinks with lower sugar; calories. This is Carmel and I think it would be a hit with health conscious and a balance to the chips and salsa. 

I will definitely be back.

Everything you would expect in a smaller locally-owned nightclub, without anything left to the imagination.

When I walked in, I saw the layout of the club like this - big rectangle bar leading back about half way from the front of the building, designated dance area beyond that taking up 1/4 of the area, and couches lining the walls going back thr length of the room. That's literally all of it.

Music is no different from any other - no better nor worse.

Great stop for those who like to hop around from club to club at night, but not really worth visiting otherwise.

Definitely worth a short taxi from Trentons main Train Terminal.   I was looking for a quaint place to have a 30 yr college reunion.  I wanted something central but Trenton does not have many dining options so cross the river where the scenery is so beautiful.  It was perfect with smaller rooms and casual home feeling.  Our server was always available and allowed us the leisurely pace to reminisce.  They offered Gluten Free and vegetarian Brunch options so everyone was pleased.  Fresh bread with olive oil and a tapenade was a nice way to start the meal.  Do make a reservation to be safe as they can book larger parties.

Expensive! $4.50 for double load! I went to Kin's and it was $2.50. Have to get a laundry card too, machines don't take quarters. Just isn't convenient for me. More machines and longer hours (not 24 hours, I believe it's mostly 6a-1a) but not for me. There's a parking lot, which is nice, but for the whole plaza it's about 8 spaces. The plus is that there's wifi and plasma TVs  but that's not enough for me to pay those prices. It's a decent laundromat for the area; clean and a lot of machines, but I won't be using again.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Eaten here many times . Mostly carry out . If you eat in . You will smell like onions . Had to change as soon as I left . Found a knarly huge hair in my giant burrito . Gross. They don't speak great English . We asked for chips and extra guacomole and she said "no" and walked away . Must have thought we wanted them free , but we were trying to order . Aside from the hair , the food is good , authentic and much better that tejana down the road .  Big portions . Some of the steak had some weird grissly pieces . Would prolly go back .

Came here with my boyfriend for All You Can Eat sushi and was not disappointed! We tend to be picky when it comes to sushi and only stick to places we know are good, but we found this place and tried it. The service was amazing, the food came out as it was ready, and the rolls were amazing. Our favorite roll was the Colts roll, and our least favorite was the spicy girl, only because of the texture that we didn't care for. Otherwise everything was amazing, miso soup, crab rangoons that had good crab flavor, and all the sauces were great. Love this place!

Part of the reason I went there myself was that someone from the area told me how great this place was. I have to believe this place has a nostalgia thing going for it as most of the really positive reviews are from people who seem to have grown up with this place.    There is nothing wrong with that but, as someone who is not as familiar with Cenzo's, I did not find their pizza all that impressive.  It was ok but there was virtually no sauce on the pizza I had; pretty much just cheese and dough.  I'm not looking for a pie to be bathed in it but it made the pizza a little dry. Nothing special. Must have cash as they do not take credit.

So far Xsquisite Hair has given me the best hair experiences I've found in the Philadelphia area. I've only gotten sew in weaves here. The shampoo and deep conditioning are always great. Even if I get to may appointment early I've never had to wait more than 10 minutes to get started. Charice always does a good job and never takes too long. Now that I've seen other shops in Philly, I'm happy to travel all the way to Cedarbrook to not have to deal with the bs. My only complaint is that I wish the weaves lasted a bit longer. Their technique is different from the one I had on the west coast, and the hair lasted much longer there.

Deterra is a cute little restaurant in the heart of Ambler. I used to come here often prior to covid to get a drink at the bar before dinner. Most recently I came with a friend for some drinks and apps. They have a cute little outdoor patio in the back - I made a reservation for outdoors but the hostess was less than *friendly* and told us it was fully booked w/ reservations (we also had a reservation?) - ultimately they accommodated us back there though. Everything else was great though - lots of good food, wine, & drinks. Our server was nice and attentive. Overall a good experience!

Love this place! SOOO many wine choices, they will probably have whatever you're looking for in wines. They have a decent selection of liquors, but no beer. The staff are really friendly and helpful if you ask for some help. *And there is a LOT of staff. 

The facility is REALLY big, spacious and clean! I was really impressed. The prices are pretty reasonable, so you should be able to get a nice wine without breaking the bank.

So glad I finally located this place, decent walk from my apartment, but I will only come here for wine/spirits!

My family and I have been coming here for years! Even my dad drives 20 minutes out of his way to visit the deli side for some fresh bread, Cuban black ckddee, and/or a tostado (machine pressed bread with butter with cheese. There is also a butcher in the back (price per pound varies but have good deals for families). The supermarket side is good for special foods like cheeses, and certain spanish products we use for cooking only sold here. The family that owned this just sold it a few months back, but nothing has changed for the customer coming to get their quick breakfast and lunch. I recommend this place fully.

The sushi seemed fresh so I ordered 3 dishes of sushi at one night for myself, but I had diarrhea and vomit after I got home. I was so confused what happened to me coz I m not allergic to seafood like some people normally I will fine when I have seafood. I think I may eat too much raw fish at once and probably the sea urchin upset my stomach a lot. The seafood could not be very clean or healthy even it is near the ocean. Although the food is tasty,it does not make me wanna go back again since I suffered at that night!

Well it's June 2 get a doughnut with your purchase of a beverage. Sounds good. Not. So I went through the drive through and the new clueless cashier evidently zeroed out my DD card that had  a brand new reload of $10...Not free at all. The most unfortunate thing about my stop was she didn't give me a receipt either. Guess I'll never see that money again. Management please train your employees before putting them in front of customers. She was awfully clueless. Haley knows who I'm talking about. BTW, thanks for never returning my phone calls.

This is the most inefficient and just plain awful Starbucks I have ever been to. They've never gotten my order correct and all it is only an iced vanilla coffee with heavy cream. I went there once and I had to go back in the store THREE different times and I still left with a drink that didn't taste how it normally does from all other locations. I only go here when it is convenient as far as location. Don't even consider the drive thru...unless you're prepared to wait thirty minutes for your incorrect order.

I mean, it's Subway. It has always been clean when I have visited despite being located in the French Quarter. 

The employees are actually kind of strange. Not rude. Not mean. Just strange. Most have a hard time understanding English but don't seem annoyed whenever you point to what you want on your sandwich. There was an employee working there that was very forward to myself and coworkers, making comments on how we looked or dressed but I haven't seen him the past few times I've eaten here. 

Convenient since I work right down the block.

One of the worst nail salons I have ever been too. I got a gel manicure, and left with polish all over my cuticles and fingers. Then, the next day it started to peel off.  I have had gel from other nail salons and not a chip for over two weeks. I went back and demanded them to re-do it, and they were very apologetic. It took longer for them to re-do it then it did in the first place.  Then, one day later I got a chip on my nail. I just want my money back at this point, and am so disappointed with the entire experience. 

The people were very nice, but the quality of the products is terrible. I would not go here ever again.

I use to hate going to Jeni's as I struggled paying that much for a scoop of ice cream...Especially when I can do like 5 scoops by myself.  Needless to say it's won me over, the variety, the richness, the small spoons for tasting.. How can you not like it. I'm glad Nashville now has a few locations to keep one from over crowding, though they all still draw a line. 20 mins wait sure does me 2 hours.  

Beyond the ice cream their waffle cones are so delicious and freshly made.  Definitely recommend all of our Nashville locations!

We first sampled Nicey popsicles from a food truck at a local event last summer, so imagine how delighted we were to discover they had opened a brick and mortar location in Broad Ripple.  The interior is cool and open, and all the flavors are listed on a chalkboard on the wall.  I am probably the most indecisive person of all time, and the employee at the counter was very patient, describing her favorite flavors and guiding me to my perfect choice - Lemon Cream, oh how I love you.  We will be going back.  Often.

I placed my order on their cite. You can only pay online which was a little inconvenient because I wanted to pay in cash but whatever. Then the food came on time but my jalapeno poppers were just alright and came with a marinara sauce which made no sense to me.  The caesar dressing was sweet I'm not used to that. The pizza was good. The veal parmigiana was pretty good. BUT what rubbed me the wrong way was the $6 I paid for the TINIEST  slice of their raspberry cake which wasn't really worth it. Guess I should've gotten the tiramisu. I probably won't order from them anymore. It got the job done but I expected better.

I called sat before driving over to ask about a walk in mani. She said come on by we'll get you right in. I came in she never gave me a time estimate until I asked. When she didn't give me a time - 25 mins later I asked how long it would be she said 5 mins. The next client went back & she said they told her it'd be another 10-15 mins at least. I waited almost 45 mins. I would have been ok with waiting if I'd known this upfront - hence why I called. It was my first time trying here, I left, & I won't go back probably because the nail place up the road got me in & did an amazing job.

We have not been here in a while due to covid, but still as classy and awesome as before!
Literally everthing I have ever had here is wonderful!
Erin our bartender was great and experienced! 
They had taco Tuesday so we had one each as our appetizer, they were perfect! 
Split the patty melt and it was spot on as real Patty Melts should be on Marble rye, the burger had wonderful flavor!
We took the pepperoni breadsticks home and warmed up in the air fryer and they were as good as Kilroys or better!!
We will be going back often. So many things we want to try!!
