Thank u for a great day! Good beer selection also!
Kellie

I'm fairly conscientious about not going into restaurants  within 30 minutes of closing. When we went into this  place at 8pm (with an 11pm) close time on door, I was a little surprised to have to walk around a week floors sign, see the garbages all emptied and the crew in process of cleaning out the back.

We ordered nonetheless and the food was delivered quickly and it tasted fresh. The service was nice and quick but couldn't get over the constant feeling that me being there was getting in their way. 3 hours before closing.

A+ Service!!

We had a connecting flight in STL heading to Texas for Super Bowl 51.  It was a group of guys and we were obviously having some fun.

This place was still about 15 mins from opening and we had only about 30 mins until boarding our next flight.  The waitress was so nice she went out of her way to serve us some drinks early so we could cheers and grab our next flight.

You don't find many places like that anymore that put service over rules.  Love it here, love STL, and thank you for making our trip even more fun!!!

REAL REAL GOOD STUFF HERE THANKS FOR A LOVELY REST WEEK

pros: cool decor, well-informed waitstaff, minimal waiting time in between courses. coconut rice pudding was unreal. i ate all of it i couldnt stop. worth the stomach ache/nearly debilitating guilt, my bf looked real cute that night. the watermelon and beets and corn were weird in the best way. 

cons: super noisy, my bf's entree was meh (carne asada) 

i live a sad frugal existence working in the npo field. if i made more dollarz i would eat here like every night.

alright see ya.

I usually get the same thing(General Tso's Chicken or shrimp fried rice)every time I go to a Chinese takeout. This visit was no different. I decided to give this place a try after reading the reviews. The cashier was friendly while taking my order. It wasn't crowded so the wait for my order to come up was short. The place is small, but brightly decorated with a few tables for dining. I opted for the GTC combination(fried rice and egg roll). The portion size was good, and the meal was flavorful. I'd visit again.

This may be the first time I've actually walked the store to shop. I usually just run in the front to the customer service desk to play the lottery(they accept debit cards for such!), or the bank when Huntington had a branch there. On a Thursday morning, the place was empty, but I was surprised how clean, organized, and well stocked it appeared. I usually don't shop for groceries here, but after this positive experience I may frequent here in the future. Their app offers some good deals as well. All of the staff I encountered were friendly.

Love it here and shop here often, they always have a coupon that you can use but that's probably because all of the regular pharmacy store makeup is overpriced here to make up for it. Love the selection of everything else and all the ladies on the sales floor are always very helpful but please I beg You pleaseeeee put more people on the registers. There's ALWAYS such a long line with 2 people checking out and a million people on the floor. I've walked out before because I do not have time to wait in such a long line

So I get to my room and no wash cloths and the room was not cleaned well. Then I look and there's no lotion or shampoo. So I call down and and am told well they are busy so it was missed. Umm. Ok. Can I have a wash cloth?  So they called maid service said she will bring. An hour later nine. The managers reception is going down hill. My spare blanket looked like someone had sex on it and put it back. I left a note but no extra blanket. Been staying here for years. Probably not going to again. It's really going down hill. Staff are great and friendly but man the rooms. Place needs some tender loving help.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I had a similar experience as others on here: food is consistently excellent with generous serving size, but service is iffy. I like the host guy who always greets people in Italian...but our waitress this time was really grumpy and condescending and treated us as if we were being too demanding by asking for cheese...she really upset me, made me want to leave, but the great food made up for it.  I would def give this place at least four stars if it weren't for the iffy service we've generally had there (been like 5 times).

I come here often and generally have a good experience. However, my last trip I was not so lucky.

Everyone was incredibly friendly as usual and the online check in is great. Unfortunately the hair cut itself was not good. 

The day after I got my haircut I realized that the back of my neck had not been trimmed well at all and there were large splotches of hair left along my neck line.

I do frequent great clips and understand you get what you pay for but would like a little more attention to detail.  I will likely use another location but will definitely pay more attention before I check off on my next haircut.

A large variety of various alcohol's offered at a discount. The personnel that works here are friendly and know their stuff. 

I recently went here looking for a specific Champagne for New Years. They did not have it. I was informed that they could special order it. They have a large variety of all kinds of liquor from the very expensive to the cheaper brands. 

One cool thing I did notice is that they love to promote local businesses and breweries. Like Verdi Distillery and Two Bitches Bourbon from Eurkea. I thought that was cool. What a great resource.

This is fast becoming my favorite Starbucks. Not only is this location close to me. But they are so friendly and earnest. I am so glad they opened this location. 

I also believe they love animals. If I have one of our dogs with us they often ask if they would like a puppacino. It is nice to know that our animals are loved.

Store is clean, large and has ample parking. However, the drive-thru speaker was hard to find for me. The first time I ended up at the window and asked if I missed it. Sure enough, I had but it didn't upset them at all that I was at the window.

I finally decided what I wanted to order, it was 9.95 and there was a $10 minimum *rolls eyes* This is entrapment and should be illegal! lol, To top it off there was a $5 delivery fee! I begrudgingly added another spring roll and it end up being $20 just to get dinner for 1! 

But it ended up being kind of perfect. 
The lo mein came with, fried rice, an egg roll and soup.
So, I got the lo mein and spring roll... meanwhile with the soup, extra roll and the fried rice, my "not hungry" boyfriend had enough to make a meal for him too haha  

Overall this isn't the best chinese food, it's your average corner store place. but nice portions.

A no frills hotel. I stayed here mostly for my dog.. No pet fees at La Quinta. The location is on a side street off the main road. It appeared a little dodgy, random people walking around at late hours, cars with blown out windows in parking lot. I didn't feel comfortable taking my dog out at night for a walk alone. Also it's a non smoking hotel-- funny enough.. My first floor room smelled like smoke. I didn't bother telling management since I literally was only staying there 12 hours. Check in was quick, easy, and friendly. Complimentary breakfast.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Came in here to grab some quick items since it was on the way home from my location. I did like the amount of organic items, and their selection of nuts and healthy snack, as it kind of reminded me of Whole Foods, and not all Giants have the wide selection of healthy food items that they did. I would rate the experience higher if it wasn't for the cashier. She was very rude, didn't say hello, and was talking to the bag boy about how much she hates another coworker. He told her that she probably shouldn't say the things she was in front of customers and she responded "I don't care and I doubt she does either."

This hotel is not for light sleepers.  I could hear every toilet flush and faucet running in the rooms around us.  

The decor of the rooms is a bit dated.  We stayed 4 days and the cleaning seemed inconsistent.

I unfortunately happened to walk down the hall as the hotel manager ripped into one of his employees, telling him he was not allowed to go home until all the laundry was done.  His tone was condescending and it was unprofessional to have that type of conversation in the hallways.  I walked away feeling really bad for the employee.

Overall, I think I would spend a little more next time to stay somewhere nicer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My friends and I stopped in one night on an edm night we didn't stay long though because she didn't like that there wasnt very many people but they did have a nice set up for pictures! It sucked we had to pay $5 to get in since we didn't stay awhile but oh well. The staff is super strict on the mask policy so please wear your mask so they don't have to keep saying something! I definitely want to go back when it's busier! And I also want to know the weekend themes so if y'all could give me that info I would love to come back!

I've been to this location probably around 10 times and although it's always been a good experience I'm never blown away or have that "tell all your friends about it" feeling. It just a great comfy place to eat pasta and I do remember the mens bathroom being really nice looking and clean last time. Not sure why I remember that but I guess it's a good thing. I have other places that I'd rather go for "date night" pasta but if I'm in the area, or someone's never been to the Old Spaghetti Factory, this is where I go.

The gym is clean and you don't need to wait for equipment to use but that's pretty much the only good. Two different staff members I dealt with didn't seem to know what they were doing and it just made me have to wait 10 minutes longer each time. They are not open 24 hours a day, even though the website for this location still says they are. Also, half the treadmills and bikes have TV's that don't even work and it looks like it's been that way for while.

I'm sure there's better locations but this one is not the one to go to to make you feel like you're spending your $525/ year membership for.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I've been going to this BP's since 2008 and I have one word for the five star rating - Manager! The manager that runs this place has always been one of the best out of any resturant I've been too. He always smiles and if you let him he'll tell you a joke or two. When I first started going here it was always a hour before they closed and he would make sure I was taken care of, and my friend, until the very end. Even it meant past closing time. Now I go during normal supper hours but I still get awesome service from him and the staff. Love the food too so that helps. I never go in the bar much but it is a fair size with lots of room.

I like dumplings with thicker skin that are pseudo home made... a little irregular and flavorful. King's garden does not use the frozen manufactured ones. They were a perfect bite with the Mei fun noodles. I took out a plate full, and the box still looked full. I'm glad I have others to share some delicious leftovers.

They constructed a whole new plexiglass barrier with speakers, and seem to have the carry out game down. Just remember the number they give you when you order, otherwise it takes longer to hunt down the order. 

Would love it if they offered carside, but def hit the spot for Chinese takeout.

This family owned Mexican Grill has the drive up/car side down pact! You  call in order, (ours was done within 20 min) drive to right side of restaurant. You can call if you don't see anyone when you come to tell them you are there, but someone came right out. They take your card inside and come back out with your food and slip to sign.

We've gotten the arroz con pollo and NY strip which were really good, and comes with free chips and salsa. The menu has a variety if someone wants Mexican and someone wants a burger or steak, you can do it. We've already been there twice in the past month and will sure be back!

Dropped $130 here for lunch before tip between three people. We brought big appetites, but this place is WAY overpriced it's value in the St. Louis market. We were also served a few things we didn't order (hand rolls and a few pieces of single sushi) but we ate them anyways.. 
The sushi is fresh, but I didn't have a single roll I thought was exceptional.
I disliked the fact that every spicy roll (tuna, yellow tail, and salmon) was coated in Panko.. The rice to fish ratio on these rolls could be much better.
The Nigiri is cut thick, so I do appreciate that.

Ordered ahead, just like everyone else says, it took forever. When we ordered it said it would be ready in 10-12 minutes. No lie 30 minutes from the time we ordered we finally got our drinks. They seem to love at half speed here. It is a convenient location but not worth going to. We regularly use the Concord Pike location, which is just as busy as this one most days, and we never wait half the time this one takes!! It doesn't make sense to me that at two different locations you could have such a huge discrepancy in wait times.

The sushi here is still INCREDIBLY DELICIOUS and an excellent value. But the ambiance has degenerated to that of eating at a Chuck E Cheese on a Saturday morning with a huge Birthday party going on. And I was there in the evening! College football up on the big screen TV. Hip hop top 40 playing on the speakers. I chuckled when I heard some kids say that they wanted McDonalds instead! Maybe next time I will phone in my order to go. At home I can pop a Godzilla movie into the DVR and experience more Japanese culture than here.

The "Good" car wash for $5 is actually an excellent car wash. Thick soapy suds combined with vigorously twirling and scrubbing cloth brushes got the desert dust and grime off my car completely. Rinse cycle drenched my car like a monsoon and got the soap off fast. The dryers worked pretty well, but you might want to bring some towels with you to go over some leftover wet spots. The included vacuum stations really sucked, in a good way. I liked that they have hoses on both sides. It makes vacuuming much easier. I shall return next time my car is dirty.

I have been to the sister restaurant in Marana and thought it was very good. So being on this side of town I thought I would give this place a try. First was a Cucumber salad with imitation Crab on top. It was fresh and crisp. Off to a good start! Next was the Miso Soup. Rich, cloudy, savoury broth. Delicious! So far so good. But when my Nigiri Sushi order arrived, I was a little disappointed in the dinky size of the pieces. They were fresh and tasty, but just small. The sister restaurant in Marana has better, more generous and good size Nigiri. I will go there instead.

After a long road trip my car was completely covered with cross country grime. I was in the area so I thought I would try out a $5 wash. I wasn't expecting too much and that is exactly what I got. You would think that the automatic car wash machines would be engineered to do a better cleaning job. My car still had some dirt on the lower sides between the wheels, but it looked better than before. Meh, what do you want for $5 today? Don't fall for the upsell. This place is only good for getting the worst of the dirt off your vehicle. For example, if you have been 4 wheeling in the desert, or in a mud race.

Made a pit stop here for a business trip, staying with several co-workers. While slightly outdated, the hotel room and its common areas were clean and spacious. My room included a kitchenette, desk, couch, coffee table and flat screen TV. Unless someone was talking near my door, I didn't experience any noise issues. The bed was also comfortable and I slept very well. 

Because the hotel caters to visitors staying long-term, our group was able to mingle in the sitting areas downstairs and drink a few beers together. A hot breakfast was included in the morning - I recommend the biscuits & gravy. Parking is also included with the room fee.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Went here for the first time last night.  Overall, not bad.  I can usually tell by the color of the sauce if I'll like a place.  If its the orange color I usually don't like it. If it's a darker red then I do.  This place has more of the orange.  I had the veal parmesan and liked it but wasn't crazy with the side pasta.  The pasta tasted good just didn't like the sauce.  

The kids had pasta and my wife had the lasagna.  Both said they liked their dishes.  Overall, not bad.  I will go back but I know I'll have to stick to the veal or chicken parm as I don't think I could handle a pasta dish due to the sauce.  Sorry, just a personal preference.

It's hard to judge this as an independent restaraunt as it's basically your one choice if you are staying at the airport and don't want to venture far. The staff is friendly and helpful with choices. Our waiter recommended the Cajun chicken pasta dish, which had very tender chicken and a decent sauce. I would add more spinach, but I like veggies. I had the salad topped with salmon. Nice flavors.  Great pours on the draft beer and they do have a few locals on tap. I found the temperature chilly, so bring a jacket.

can you say food poisoning and fat shaming!!! my group and i all got food poisoning from here. when i brought it to the owners attention he called me a liar and said i was just trying to get a refund because i had buyers remorse. he then proceed to call me a slew of derogatory names and told me i new nothing about the culinary world and that my group and i would be better suited to a troff (i assume a shot at mime and a.few others in my groups weight). im a professional chef. i learned later that other people in  my group had had called and were treated the same way. dont eat here. dont get food poisoning. most of dont get fat shamed here

my husband and I didn't feel like leaving our hotel to eat so we found china house, which was close by, open until 11, and would deliver. they're decently priced and give you large quantities of food. Thats about it. I know there are chinese take out places that actually taste great, this one was lacking. The wonton soup was tasteless! The wontons were really thick too plus lacking flavor. chicken lo mein was alright. Had lots of meat and veggies. egg rolls were bland. fried rice was fried rice. I'm sure there's plenty of other take out places in this city that are better. If you do eat here, they're cash only.

So I've come here on several occasions and they always seem to be "out" of something. So this time I'm here and I go to order a cloud macchiato and the girl ringing me up says they're out of the cloud powder that they make the drink with. So I said to her, "it seems like you guys are always out of something." So then she proceeds to tell me that all the Starbucks in Brandon are out. I knew that was absolute BS the minute she said it bc how would she know that? Did you call all the stores to find that out? No. I didn't appreciate being lied to, especially since I went to the Starbucks in the mall minutes later and they made it for me. Sad.

I had a schedule change and needed a quick gel manicure and gel polish change on my toes.  I looked up salons close by (my normal salon is about 20 minutes from my house and I wasn't able tho make it over).  

Nothing impressed me about this salon.  It wasn't overtly clean.  The chair/table I was at wasn't wiped down between clients (seems pretty typical since covid) and the work was sub par.  I have some polish on my skin and my toes look pretty bad.  

It also cost $60 ($35 for the gel manicure and $25 for just a gel polish change).  Definitely not worth the money and no above and beyond customer service wise. 

I definitely won't be back.

Stopped by Big Daddy on our way to a show for a quick slice. We specifically asked if they had slices as we were in a rush and they said only plain. Fine, we settled. After waiting for 10 minutes we got up to see what was taking a while and the girl went in the back only to come back and tell us they had just now put in a new pie and we would have to wait 15 more minutes. Not sure who would wait 25 minutes for a slice of plain za but we sure didn't. She refunded us for the slices (but not for the waters we purchased... lol thanks BD). Won't be back!

Really REALLY good coffee. I mean really good. It's not really defined how you order, and when you pay, and it takes a really long time to get your coffee. Whether it's intentional or not, they do not seem organized behind the counter. The only reason why it's odd is because when you watch the baristas making coffee, they are very precise: water temperature, timers, the whole nine yards. Not the place to go if you are in a rush. There is some space to relax, and it's fun to walk around and see the large equipment. 

But the point is coffee, and like I said before, this place makes REALLY good coffee.

Out of all the ayce sushi joints in Reno, JJ's is our new favorite. Affordable, delicious, quality, and the service is phenomenal. The place was pretty busy, there were only two chefs, and one and half servers, but they killed it! They were seating, waiting, and feeding tables like it wasn't busy.  

There's something about their imitation crab. It's creamy, packed with favor, and it complimented every roll that had it really well. I had one of each sashimi, the tundra, jj roll #2, godzilla, and every other roll with salmon. I recommend it all. 

For you mussel lovers, there's a 2 order limit per customer on the mussels.

Right down the street from our house, we didn't go here for months after moving in. Not sure why, but I just didn't think it would be good. 
Location is strange, it's in our residential area of olde Richmond... But great!!! 
Awesome service and mostly importantly great food. 
Went 3 other people and we all ate each other's food because everyone wanted to try it all. Chicken parm - awesome. Lobster ravioli - awesome. Steak - awesome. Fish dish - awesome. 

And it's BYOB which makes its extra great. 

I'd suggest this to anyone in the area!!! 

Call ahead though, because it gets packed and you need a reservation to get a table on a busy night!

I may be a bit generous with the stars but it is a pretty nice hotel. Certainly better than the LaQuintas I typically stay in. There are plenty of staff hanging around and they are very pleasant and easy to look at but few are able to actually help. The room is cozy at best and teeny at worst, there is not a chest of drawers, there is no room for it with the queen bed. I had to call down for an iron and board and the iPad device is inoperable. Gotta pay for interwebs and there is a little sign on the counter indicating that I can help myself to a bottle of water in the fridge... for a fee.....no water in fridge. Am I gonna get charged? Crap
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I see people complaining about the price here, but I don't get it. Some of the rolls (the dynamite comes to mind) are absurdly cheap, on the order of $4.50. The dynamite is also very tasty (though I might like it even a bit hotter, but that's what wasabi is for). The specialty rolls are also good, and I'm sad to think that when I leave NOLA I won't be able to immediately track down a Frenchman roll.

The Yakisoba is also a good deal, though for $11 I'd like a little more food.

Regardless, this place is a good deal, with fair prices, good service, and good food.

QUALITY SERVICE. QUALITY RECIPES. 

R Bistro was a pioneering eatery at the Northeast end of Mass Ave. in downtown Indy when others feared to risk the area. Quality service and quality recipes made the trendy restaurant a popular spot for locals and visitors. Those standards continue. 

The chef-owner travels the world and returns with new dishes she shares with diners not concerned about price as much as value. 

R Bistro is a nice, small place for a special occasion or late-night dinner. Expect to pay top dollar for smaller, high-caliber portions.

This place kicks ass, and always has.  Yes, it's expensive compared to all other dim sum joints but honestly the variety and quality and speed at which those dishes are flogged around the room is impressive.  No kidding, it's twice as much as other dim sum joints but it's soooo good.

Considering I had blah experiences over the last month at Beijing Beijing and Gooden Rice Bowl, the bill at Noodle Noodle never really matters.  When you want a kickass dim sum meal and want to walk out full and completely happy everytime - this is the place to go.  I'm craving it even now as I think about it.

Will probably head back this weekend.  Yummmm.

I was pretty underwhelmed by this hotel. The check-in process seemed to vary in length for people, but mine went pretty smoothly. 

The hotel room does not have a lot of light and the light that is there is not in the middle of the room, but rather right by the entrance and then by the beds. The room and bathroom are pretty spacious though. 

I'm not sure what the housekeeping does, but the sheets and towels were never fully clean. I kept leaving the towels on the floor for new ones, but I'm pretty sure the old ones were just re-folded and placed back on the shelf.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stopped in this past weekend to check this place out. It was very cozy and made me want to sit in there just to have coffee. Line was sort of long but the wife and I moved though pretty fast. I got the nitro brew which I didn't like but that's my fault for trying something new. Wife got an ice coffee that she said was good. Only reason I am given this place 4 stars is because it said they offered tea but I did not see a tea menu anywhere. Would I go back and give this place another try? Of course I would! I love supporting local business and this may be my new spot.

The best sushi I've had in my life! (And I've been to Japan!)

I'm vegetarian, and usually sushi options are limited to avocado rolls/cucumber rolls, etc, which I still love, but this place was so innovative with the options, I was blown away. There were definitely at least 10 cool, interesting, vegetarian sushi options. 

The salad/soup is good too and the wine is a decent price! 

It is a really nice restaurant too with a cool, trendy feel. It gets loud though, so wouldn't recommend if you are trying to get to know someone. Fun for a girls night out! 

Get reservations though!

There must six Starbucks within a two mile radius of where I work but you would be hard pressed to find more than one Dunkin so this location is all I've got because I am a Dunkin Donuts kind of girl.

The drive through is tricky if you don't pay attention to where the enter sign is. The service has been lackluster but my orders have been good until today. Barely any sugar in my extra large coffee and my hash browns were terrible. How is it possible to mess up a pre packaged potato product? I can't even explain my disbelief. Instead of a crisp disc I received smashed barely warm wedges of potatoes. Not happy.

Went here and was hoping for great Things. Ordered some miso soup and sat and listen to the waitresses talk smack on all the other customers and each other. Hey. Guess what? Other people speak languages other than English. Be more discreet. Duh. The miso soup had a clod of glop the size of of my soup spoon in it. Asked the waitress to come over and look and she just took away the soup. Acted like she didn't understand what I asked or just didn't give a shit. Got my sushi and it was ok. Left and didn't leave a tip and a lady that wasn't even my server came out and asked me if I forgot something. Told her I didn't and left. Fuck this place.

Nicey is AMAZING. The word "popsicle" doesn't always sound that appetizing because I tend to just think of what's available in the frozen treat section of my local grocery store..bleh. At Nicey this is not the case at all. My favorite combo is toasted coconut dipped in dark chocolate. Think: frozen mounds candy bar. YUM. So many awesome flavors to try and not really enough days of summer here in Indiana :( Anyway, it's the perfect dessert after dinner at one of BR's local restaurants or a mid-day summertime snack while strolling down the Monon.

Great food, but service lacking. We came for brunch.  I ordered the chicken and waffles. It was honestly one of the best I've ever had. I loved how the waffle was thin. The spice and sweetness were perfectly balanced. The kitchen did take forever to make our food. It wasn't super busy by the time we ordered food. Our server didn't come by often. Forgot coffee.
I loved the Pennsylvania twist on the menu. It was really interesting to see scrapple in the South. If I were here longer I would have liked to try dinner.

I really wanted to love Lolita. I had a few drinks before I went in for dinner, and I can honestly say I could tell the food was not up to par even with a good buzz and an empty stomach. I ordered the short rib nachos and the fish tacos. My disappoint was with the nachos. The food was beautifully presented, but the chips were extremely salty, and the meat cold when served. The fish tacos were excellent and I would totally order those again. The restaurant had a good vibe, but it was too dark in there. I want to see my bright food and it was just a dreary meal for a nice sunny summer day.

I've been on the hunt for good sushi without having to schlep in the city. Let me tell you, this is not good sushi. It is great sushi.
It is fresh, and the takeout menu is pretty vast and eclectic with something for everybody. 
I ordered a salmon skin roll, spicy tuna, James Bond roll, and a garden salad with ginger dressing. Everything was fresh and spectacular. Flavorful, and did not disappoint. My favorite roll was hands down the James Bond Roll with the spicy crab and salmon. It was a burst of flavor with every bite. The salmon skin roll had a nice crunch.. This is my new sushi joint!!

Visited this quaint Mexican restaurant on a rainy Saturday night at about 6pm.  It was a little bit early and hadn't filled up yet, so we were a little unsure.  

Turns out it was really great!  We ordered tamales - a huge dish that was delish, the pizza quesadilla, which is actually like a standard quesa and very good.  The sides of guacamole were very nice - not too many onions or other fillers, just a lot of good avocado.  We also got chimichanga, and it was excellent.  Also, the Sangria was better than we expected and even the chips were just-right.

Thanks for a great meal!

Love this little taqueria on Lancaster Avenue. The food is affordable, tasty, and portions are large. I've tried the quesadillas, enchiladas, and the tinga tacos which are my favorite. It's only $2 per taco! Also, if you're 21 you get a complimentary margarita with your meal and it is BYOB. 

I am hesitant to give more than three stars because the service is quite slow and they do mess up orders frequently. The tables are close together and it's very loud in the restaurant. The good food and low prices are definitely worth stopping in at least once though!

Ordered takeout on a Saturday night. Ordered a large pepperoni, garlic knots and wings. Everything was eh, ok. Wasn't impressed with any of the food. Garlic knots were hard and not flavorful. The marinara sauce it came with was awful. Wings were not crispy (classic naked) and BBQ sauce was alright. Pizza was sub par and did not have a good crust.

Customer service was lacking. The girl at the front seemed less than thrilled to be there. And I think our food had been sitting on the counter behind her for a while before she handed it over to us. This place is closest to us but I think we'll keep driving that extra mile for better pizza.

I was happy with the little details at this hotel. Free wine and soft drinks in the lobby, the water bottle filling stations, nice fluffy duvets and pillows. My room was pretty large. I thought it was a bit odd that there was no chest of drawers or suitcase stand but that wasn't a big deal. Bathroom was clean but not sparkling. There was some dust on the shelves for example. One thing that was gross was that my pillows all smelled really bad. I didn't ask for new ones which is my own fault but you have to wonder why they smelled like that. 

Overall a very convenient and comfortable place to stay in Philadelphia.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I hate that I ever lived in here. I'm currently on day 4 with no AC! It's 90 degrees out! I do not have a patio to open nor can I open windows because they failed to put screens in. I have been calling the past 3 days to get this issue fixed. Today I was told it would be fixed today if not immediately. Just keep driving if you are looking for a place to live. Read these reviews and definitely trust them! Update: this has been here for months with no urgency from them to clean it up. I will get it cleaned up today bc I simply cannot look at it any longer. Damn shame.

I love Papa John's, but this location slacks. I ordered 2 pizza's and after an hour waiting I called and they said it was on the way and should be to me in 15 minutes. Every 30 minutes went by I called and kept being told 15 more minutes. Needless to say, 3 hours later and cold pizza...........no refund, no apology. My pizza didn't arrive to my home until 2:15 a.m. They credited me a pizza on my next order, but due to the inconvenience I should have just been refunded. I don't even want the pizza they credited to me because I will die of starvation before it ever gets to me. So, no Papa John's, I will NOT be back.

This review is based SOLELY on their tamales!  Don't know if it makes for a "proper" review, but it's all I've got.  I ordered tamales, minus the cheese sauce, which I think is wrong, wrong, WRONG.  I'm originally from San Antonio, and tamales were NEVER served with cheese sauce.  Anyways, El Potro's tamales have a very good ratio of masa to meat filling.  VERY tasty.  My one complaint is why don't any places offer anything besides pork tamales???  I need some beef tamales!  I want some chicken tamales!  WHY can't I find 'em?

It wasn't terrible, but not wonderful either.  Hubby and I split a chef's salad and he had to pick through his lettuce to pull ugly stuff out.  He mentioned it to the waitress, and she just blew it off.  The Bloody Mary was okay, but definitely nothin' to write home about.  The best part of the meal was the Hickory Grilled Salmon with Chili Lime Glaze which was really good.  The service was fine, other than the total disregard of my husband's complaint.  And the HUGE televisions in every corner of the dining area?  By the bar, I understand, but in the dining room, I find it ridiculous.  Not impressed.

I started coming to this car wash when they first opened. I lived in the area and decided to come here. I moved away and still drove all the way from Spanish springs. It was the best car wash in town! Sadly the quality has gone down hill, I've  always paid for the works. But now they don't spend any time spraying and scrubbing like they used to at the start of the wash.  It seems as if they sped up the tracks as well, now I spend most of my time wiping off the bugs and dirt that was missed instead of vacuuming. I will not be going back.

When I seen this place being built I was super excited because I pass through here almost everyday, so location was a great plus. However I was a bit disappointed the first couple times I came here. The blowers were very weak. I spent a bit of time wiping my car off at the vacuum station. I get that it's a new business and the kinks have to be worked out. So I will come back. I do have a favorite place I go to and have been for years, it's cheaper but their vacuums aren't free. Hopefully they'll do better, would love to make this my car wash of choice.

Nothing out of the ordinary here. They have plenty of selections and it's the closest one to me in walking distance.  I go here because its convenient not because of the prices.  It's center city prices for sure. 

The cashier however did NOT ask for my ID. I must say this broke my heart since I'm 28, but i look like i'm 18. (this is a fact ok! I don't make this up!) This broke my heart a little not gonna lie.... but on a serious note it got me thinking are they not checking anyone's??? Should someone be looking into that?? hmmmmm

Not gonna lie, I meant to order Chinese from the spot located across the street, but I couldn't think of the name and Google images led me to this place. I ordered food enough to feed five people. It's a shame I did not enjoy the food as this is located in the heart of Chinatown. Everything I ordered was bland and not flavorful. Even the fried rice wasn't good as it was dry. I had ordered a chicken and broccoli which is pretty standard and asked it to be spicy, but it was not spicy at all. The only thing I did enjoy were the egg rolls.

This location is consistently slow when it comes to their drive thru, and it's not very convenient to get in and out of while on your way to someplace. The staff always seem a bit frazzled, whether I've been inside or utilizing the drive thru, but they also have always been personable and provide service with a smile, so the effort is being made. However, compared to the Starbucks on Main St in Dunedin (the next closest one I know of), the lengthy wait times and the lack of convenient entrance and exit from the road make this one of my last choices when I need my Starbucks fix.

Pretty tasty and usually really quick for both walk in or take out. Haven't personally tried delivery from here so I can't speak to that. They're super close to my college though, so when the Chinese food cravings kick in this is my go to place. 

Decent portion sizes and always pretty filling. The flavors here are a bit different than what my hometown Chinese places feature, but in a good way. I've never had mushrooms in my lo mein before trying this place and now it's one of my favorite things. The General Tso's have a bit of an after kick to them; not horribly spicy but there's definitely a little something that lingers.

They seem to regularly be out of stock of things, have semi-often forgotten to include a doughnut or hash browns or something when we've placed larger orders, & they aren't the best listeners at the drive-thru portion but maybe that's a technology issue? Who knows, but they do seem to have a nice, fun group of staff who are often joking with each other inside & are always smiling & pleasant at the window. I haven't had a downright poor experience with them, just the occasional disappointing moment when we get out of the drive-thru only to realize things were forgotten - they usually make things right for us semi-quickly inside though at least.

I came here during the Devour Downtown Winter Festival. I glance through the menu while waiting at the bar for 30minutes even with a reservation. I understand cause it was a busy night.

All the items are the menu seem reasonably price, I lucked out and got a three course meal for thirty bucks cause of the event going on. The salad was dressed nicely and light. The soup was a bit over seasoned and the dessert was okay.

Afterwards, I was still hungry and ended up driving to the grocery store and made hamburgers.

Bottom line: it is good food, but it isn't good a place to go when you're starving.

My husband and I ate at The Wild Hare last night. We had a short wait of about 15 minutes because we did not want to sit at a communal table.  Our food was good. The prices were good. The staff was very friendly. I love the idea of dipping fried mushrooms in cheese! I mean come on, what's better than that? I had the lobster pizza...I have no idea how they do it, but wow their crust is amazing! 

It is a small restaurant, and there really isn't anywhere to wait because the bar was full. If I didn't feel like I was in the way during my 15 minute wait, I probably would have given it 4 stars.

A let down for a Marriott property. Being a road warrior for work, I stay at many different Marriotts across the country and this property is a definite disappointment. Rooms are small and operations are not efficient. My 6 year old locked the bathroom door by accident so we couldn't get in, after repeated calls and promises of someone on their way, no one showed. We finally unlocked it ourselves after an hour wait. Also very noisy rooms if you are unfortunate enough to get one facing the road. No sound proofing at all. We came back to catch some zzzs and take a shower before dinner and was unable to do neither. Will not stay again in future.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Ok, so the food is very good, but the service was just horrendous. It took an amazingly long time for our appetizer to come out, then the main course came out immediately out- a big no-no in my book for this kind or restaurant. The waiter was nowhere to be seen; didn't get a water refill until we were almost done. I didn't dare order another drink for fear that I wouldn't get it until after we were done.

Yeah, it was a Friday night and they were very busy, but so what. It's not a cheap place to go and I expect better. Stay away on weekend nights.

This is the place my sister and I go to whenever she has nail appointments because it is so close. The food is fresh and it always tastes good. My favorite roll here is the Tuna roll while my sister loves the Avocado roll. If you decide to go, go during their lunch hours for cheaper prices. The bento lunch boxes are definitely a must order if you go. Make sure to get there before 4, at 4 the lunch orders on their computer shut down and you can't order from the lunch menu. I got lucky and got mine in at 3:58
Make sure to check this place out!!!

Great food here and pretty cool place to boot, especially the upper "sky room" with the views of main street manayunk.Parking is easy, and they validate for the lot across the street, so even on a busy saturday night it shouldn't be too bad getting here. Food is consistently good and the wine list is substantial and very reasonably priced. Wait staff, is OK...though could use a bit of refinement in regards to customer service. Bartenders are great and variety of liquor/drinks available is good too. I would certainly go again.

I've come here multiple times because let's face it the pork belly tacos are life. Unfortunately the past few times I've come and even today the food has been inconsistent. To make matters worse tonight the pork belly tacos sucked! No sweet glaze, pork belly over cooked just a blah taco. Maybe it was just a different cook tonight or different staff but I'm going to really think twice about coming back here as the inconsistencies in the food have become so frequent. Hope the management staff can get the kitchen crew back on track so people can enjoy what use to be a great place!

2 Stars-Because when it's good it's good. But when it's bad, like just leave the drive thru after 20 min and go to Steak 'n Shake bad.
But what really bothers me is that everytime I go into McDonalds and wait on my food. CNN is ALWAYS on their television. I hate CNN and I feel most people in Arnold hate CNN. 
This is a republican town turn this Clinton News Network off!!! 
Fox News #1 !!!!!! 
Or none, turn on literally anything else besides Liberal news in a MAGA town.
#MAMGA
Make Arnold McDonalds Great Again
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The trifecta - bad food, service, and prices. Places wasnt' busy, but server acted like it was a bother to wait on me. Ordered a so-so wine listed at fine wine prices. Got a very small pour. Saw several glasses of wine pass by me, all at differing levels. Seems like there is no set standard - for wine or for food. Guy sitting next to me ordered chicken wings, said he'd had them several times before. This order contained only 7 wings while the others he'd had contained 8. When he asked about it, the server shrugged him off and said something like "he got lucky" before. So, walk a little. There are many far-better places at the PHL.

This was a tiny coffee place, which is all fine and dandy but there was barely room to walk around and wait for my drink! That being said, my drink was good (cinnamon brown sugar latte) but the barista barely said two words to us and I just didn't get a good, friendly, relaxing vibe from this place like I would want in a coffee shop. I am still looking for the ideal coffee shop in Nashville where I can get some homework done or just hang out and feel comfortable. If this is on my way somewhere I will stop by, but I'm not interested in any special trips.

My friend and I wanted to meet for dinner and we both love sushi. This restaurant is conveniently located between us and my friend said they have a happy hour! Hurrah! We dined here before the corvid-19 shut downs.

There are several rolls available for $4 each. Granted, they are a little smaller than regular rolls but not by much and they are still very good. We had a spicy tuna, tempura Japanese bagel roll and one other one. The three rolls were enough for the two of us for dinner.

Staff was polite and the rolls came out in a timely fashion.

I would definitely eat here again and would even get takeout while the dining room is not open.

I can't believe how slow this place is. I took my car in for an oil change and tire rotation and they also replaced two brake lights. Pretty standard stuff. I waited for almost an hour and finally asked when they would be done. He said he hoped that they would be done in the next 15 minutes, meaning over an hour for an oil change! He told me "were not built for speed" and said that they didn't have the staff needed to be quick, like I had been ridiculous for wanting a quick service. Cant yet comment on quality of work, but i can probably get a much quicker change elsewhere. Will not be back.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Landmark is my go-to happy hour spot. They have great food and drink specials weekdays from 4-7 (till 10PM on Mondays), including the now famous Landmark combo. Hungry? Try the combo. For only $7 during happy hour, you get 3 pieces of a chicken quesadilla, 3 chicken tenders, and crab fries, served with honey mustard, cheese sauce, and sour cream. They're $5 balsamic Brussel sprouts with bacon are delicious as well. They have cheap wings on Sunday AND weekdays during happy hour! The bar tenders are always pleasant, attentive, and easy to look at. Want great food, drinks, and service? Look no further than Landmark Americana.

My volleyball team and I will often go to this BP's lounge after one of north end games.  There are usually some drink specials and a hockey game being played.
The servers always greet us with a smile and are willing to banter with us which adds to the experience.
Usually, the food we have ordered has been pub style food and it has been consistently good. The Pizzaburger sliders are a treat! Burger wrapped in a pepperoni pizza = Homer Simpson drool.
Always a reliable place to go to for after game bevies and treats.

Great hotel with nearby restraunts and about a 15-20 minute drive into town to view attractions. They have great staff, a pool and free breakfast. They always help you with whatever you need and the only problem is that ice machines aren't on every floor so you have to go a ways to get them, but they are renovating so they might add them in later. Other than that great hotel for the price with clean rooms, high-speed wifi, great staff and much more. I love holiday inn express (especially their cinnamon buns )
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We started out a little nervous, there were 2 parties of 10 waiting for their table at the same time we were (jazz fest people). It took about 15 minutes to get our table with a reservation, which I wasn't crazy about, but once we sat down, the service was incredible. The food was even better. 

I usually only get a filet when I am not crazy about the menu, and in this case I wasn't, so I got the filet, and it was honestly one of the best steaks I've had in my life. Perfect in every way. 

Very happy with our visit.

Attended a meeting here with a small group.  We did not stay here so I am not rating the rooms or related aspects.  The room we were in has a listed capacity of 45; that would feel crowded.  Our group was 10 and the room was very comfortable for us.  Restrooms were very close and kept clean.  Room temperature was about right and was stable.  The hotel location is convenient and less than a mile off I-465.  Coffee and tea selections were good as was the taste.  They are set up for breakfast daily and guest reception select evenings for guests staying there.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
So the concept is incredible. All you can eat sushi, especially when I eat sushi it takes a lot for me to get full. What I believe makes it even better is you appetizers included too. I love the crab rangoons, and whatever sauce comes with it is wonderful.

I usually get the same sushi rolls speedy way and w10th street rolls. I try different ones once in a while but love my usual. However I do think for the price you sacrifice some quality of the sushi. I would say it's a good place to go if you are really hungry and want to eat s lot of sushi 

Agree with most others on service and appearance, it has been poor since the beginning.

I went to their brunch January 11th. The service was good.  I chose the crab benedict and it didn't have any flavor and the english muffin was burnt on the edges. Very disappointing. I didn't even finish it. The potatoes were ok. The fruit was the best thing. The calamari was good.  Their website says Mimosas are $2.50 however they were $3. When we made the manager aware, he honored the website price. 

 If you want the unlimited mimosas or Bloody Mary you have to book brunch 24 hours in advance.

I will go back and give them another try.

Very nice however slightly biased having just left the ramada screaming and crying. This is a nice hotel. Clean, classy, updated. Room is a little small but not unusually for the great price ($129) for a standard king bed room. Nice view from just about everywhere. Food at the bar was disappointing but there's so many places within (safe) walking distance that it's hardly an inconvenience. If you're reading this and don't get to my other review just FYI to never stay at the ramada here to save twenty bucks unless you like 1970s carpet and crackhead ambiance. Again the Westin is great, definitely recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I really used to like value vet. However, now I will never use them again. I have 5 dogs & a cat and they will not allow me to schedule 6 consecutive appointments to bring my animals all in at the same time, no matter how far out in advance I schedule them. They want to schedule 2 in the morning, take a three hour break and schedule 2 in the afternoon, take another hour and a half and then schedule the other 2. I would have to take off a whole entire day of work just to take them for their yearly exam. I guarantee that they will start losing customers due to this ridiculous policy!

The perfect place in the CWE for fast cheap eats on the go. Food is always fresh and hot; never takes more than 10 min and your out the  door.  Dinning in is always an option, wait staff are always friendly and on their toes. It's what you would expect for $6 Chinese lunch special; nothing fancy but consistently good. My favorites are the Kung Pao Chicken and Spicy Beef. I've never had a bad meal here. If your in a hurry to grab a hot lunch and don't want to spend typical CWE coin for a sandwich, give West End Wok a try, you won't be disappointed.

Finally try this place out after reading a lot of good reviews. Nice atmosphere. Our waiter is very fast and attentive, despite a restaurant being jam pack. 
We got shrimp dumpling as an appetizer. I think dumpling wrap are too thick. The sauce and flavor are really good. The bread and oil dipping are fabulous. I got paella after reading a raved review about it. However, what I have in front of me doesn't resemble paella at all. It is a bowl of tomato broth with seafood and rice. It look more like cioppino with rice in it. It tastes good, but it's not a paella.
I might go back when I'm in the area, but won't make a special trip there.

We stopped at this restaurant on our way east and now that we're on our way west, we stopped again.  It's a hard place to rate.  We've been pleased with the food but the service is definitely lacking.   Thus, we decided to rate this as a "3".  This restaurant sits in a large RV park for snowbirds and patrons are definitely captive.   We would return only because of convenience and that's a shame because we've not had a complaint on the food.  A friendlier more efficient wait staff would definitely improve the restaurant.

When I first got to the hotel I couldn't find a parking sport at all and had to circle around the block a couple times until finally I had a little room to park. The staff was friendly and helpful. Stayed here for 2 nights and the price wasn't bad compared to other places but 37.00 bucks a day for parking is ridiculous. Other then that I found the bed very comfortable. Plenty of towels. The thing that didn't like was there wasn't a vending machine on my floor. The convent thing was there was a city centre across the street. Overall it was a nice hotel and the only thing I hated was parking. I will debate whether or not I stay there again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Good and seemingly well-managed gym. Only 1 combination barbell Squat and Bench rack/apparatus - was told when touring the place that there are plans to add a separate squat rack, but no idea on timetable. There is a smith machine on which people can do these lifts, but I think many lifters tend to avoid those for those lifts. 

Wish they'd offer recycling, given all of the water bottles/etc people probably bring in. Otherwise, gym is clean, cardio equipment is very modern, location is convenient. Dedicated room for screen-directed fitness classes open 24/7. Good gym overall!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I came here pretty early so I didnt deal w any line at all. Service was pretty fast and the staff was friendly as well. I ordered chicken noodle soup and to my surprise the broth and noodles was really good! I was expecting egg noodles but the noodles were rice noodles, which are used in pho. My only complaint is the chicken because it was pretty obvious that its not fresh. Very dry. 

Also, I was watching the kitchen and couldnt help but notice one of their workers chopping onions and putting it in a plastic bag. Kind of unsanitary!

Terrible all across the boards!  How terrible can a car wash be try $34 terrible. And.... They broke equipment in my car but claim they don't do inside detailing. The owner could care less. You can basically see what type of business they are running when you pull in based on the folks working outside and doing the actual cleaning. Of course not the people the handle the $$$$ nor make any decisions. Will never return even though they are like the only hand car wash in downtown Nashville they will rip you off big time. Stay away!!!!!!

I have read other reviews and perhaps those people had a bad experience. I have been getting my dress shirts dry cleaned there for years and have never had a problem. $.99 a shirt within less than one week .... at least I can't complain about that. I have also had a few suits dry cleaned there and it was done well and price was great compared to other places. I also had some dress pants let out at the waste ..and the alterations were done well and $10 each is a good price. I never had regular laundry done there so I cannot respond to that. But for what I bring in they have never tried to "Up Sell" me anything!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Located in a busy Publix plaza, one would think they get a lot of business. That's just the case. This Asian Wok is extremely busy during lunch time. If you try calling more than once with no answer..try again. The food is worth the wait. Their lunch special comes with a side of pork fried rice, your item and a soda for $5.25. Price is average for lunch special. So far I've tried their beef and broccoli, Kung pao chicken, shrimp lo mein, wonton soup, hot soup soup, and shrimp fried rice. They're all equally delicious. Definitely one of the few delicious Chinese fast food around.

Parking is limited here and they are always short staffed. I have been here numerous times were I have been waiting in line forever and ended up leaving with out ordering anything.
Today I went to this location to give it another try and I have to say it was quick getting in and out.
I ordered a trenta passion tea lemonade and it was perfect.
Apparently they are building a bigger Starbucks next to the Bank of America in the parking lot so we shall see if the service changes but overall today was a good day to make a purchase at Starbucks.

First time here as I read in the TBT that they were one of the top 5 Spanish resturants in the area.
Both my husband I got chicken dishes. The chicken had no flavor, very bland. I had a very hard time finishing my dinner.
The waitress was very sweet and kept coming to our table to refill our drinks and to make sure everything was good.
The good thing about this place is that I ordered a Coke and it was a bottled Coke. I haven't had a Coke like this in forever and it was perfect.
Would I recommend this place, no as again the food had no flavor.

I'll be avoiding this place forever. Had the Steak Tapatío, supposed to be a rib eye steak, that couldn't be further from the truth. No wonder they offer all their so called rib eye steaks varieties covered in some colorful sauce. I asked mine with the green sauce on the side. The steak was just a pathetic if that, low cost  breakfast steak. Overcook, chewy and tasteless. Rice and beans were the regular you will find in most "mexican" restaurants. Service was ok. She new I wasn't happy with the dish. Not the girl fault. She could have ask and try to fix it. I wasn't sending the plate back. Ate what I could save from it and left.

This review is unfortunately not about the food as much as it should be. The biscuits and gravy were good, nothing special. Solid bacon. Amazing peanut butter pancakes. Great server.

After we finished eating, it took us 20 MINUTES to pay. They had 1 person working the register, getting pick-up orders, and taking call in orders. Absolutely ridiculous. We were set to come back again soon, but not if it's going to take that long to pay, I doubt we come unless we have extra time. 

Great food, great table service, but be prepared to stand in line to pay just as long as it takes to eat.

Went here on a Friday night with friends and it was packed, but we called about ten minutes ahead of time, and they managed to save us a table for 6. It's BYOB, and they even brought us some ice to cool our wine. The service was incredibly fast and our waiter was really understanding when some of us needed more time to look at the menu. I wasn't that hungry and just got a yellowtail scallion roll, but it was so good and I shared some pork gyoza with my table and that was a solid choice as well. Overall: great prices for what you're getting and BYOB is a huge plus.

Been there twice recently and waited for our second visit before writing my review.
The restaurant is a very modern boutique styling,  reminiscent of a West Coast feel, Seattle maybe.
Great service very friendly staff and a very welcoming nature. 

The sushi menu is quite expansive and we explored it well on our two trips. 
The quality was good and there were certainly no complaints.
But it just seemed to be lacking that WOW factor.
Of all the rolls we tried the Hamachi Lovers and Gator roll were our favorites.

Don't get me wrong this is good solid sushi, but it's not the best I've ever had.

Very nice. They didn't rush my yearly scale removal and toe shine, instead had a very relaxed, pleasant experience. The ladies were very nice, and efficient, and did a great job on my poor ugly feet. 
I've been to their other location, and like this one a touch better. It's prettier. Never ever thought I would like orange walls, but they manage to work it.
The polish selection is confusingly awesome... Not just red, but every shade of it. Lots of dark purples, sparklies, blues and greens. I don't see yellow or orange, but there are some golds. Plenty of flesh like tones also, but what's the point in those?!

The decor was my favorite part of this experience. Classic Mexican colors and designs filled the small docs. 

Queso Funtido starter was unique, made with shrimp and crabmeat. My chicken dish was filled with Mexican flavors and accompanied by rice, beans, and guacamole. I had the x-rated margarita, which tasted like a spiked pink lemonade. 

Service was standard and friendly. 

The prices were a bit high for the experience and location, but definitely a nice find in a city without a lot of Mexican restaurants. No problem getting a table at 930p on a Friday.

I've definitely had better. These guys have been in the game a long time and are a local staple so I'll cut them some slack. It's not the best Mexican food you'll eat in your life but they are dependable and who can say they don't like Chapala's chips and salsa?

If you're going to get anything, get the fajitas with the cholesterol-free beans. That's the only way to make this place somewhat healthy. The pork carnitas are good, too. Go out on a limb and try the horchata. Good rice drink that everyone should try at least once!!

I came to Trattoria Totaro with my wife for the first time for their Wild Game Night 2017. It was a prix fixe menu of game meat centered dished with beer pairings. The chef at this restaurant somehow knows exactly what my favorite flavors are. We had smoked trout over arugula with apples and walnuts, wild boar bolognese with homemade pappardelle (which was just perfect), duck, venison... and everything paired with a well thought out beer that balanced, accentuated, or counter pointed the flavors in the food. It was a spectacular meal and I am now a big fan of this Trattoria.

This is drunk pizza and it's exactly what you want. It is rather expensive ($48 for two pizzas) but what do you expect in the French Quarter? The decor is a little strange, with a TV in the counter, but with no sound or captions. There are two fish tanks as well, but when we were there they were both empty. It was a little weird.

The pizzas were cooked very quickly, and had a crisp crust and lots of melty, gooey cheese. They were topped with a few spices, which was a nice touch. Overall, we rather enjoyed the pizza and it met all of our needs.

I was attempting to order food from this location, when the person taking the order kept stating, I'm sorry hold on... then she would giggle and say can i help you.. I would ask her a question again, she then blurred out after again telling me hold on.. you are to Mexican. NO NIMROD, I am an American!!! Just because your craphole headset doesn't work, doesn't make me hard to understand!!! 

O by the way it was the MANAGER... there was a long line of other vehicles waiting to get food.. on the side another customer told me don't come here I have been waiting for them to bring my order out.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Raffi's is an ok taco establishment. No frills to it, which is sometimes what you want for your taco experience. You can also order nachos and burritos. My usual order consists of steak tacos, supreme style, on flour tortillas. The cut of beef could be better, as I'm often trying to chew through really tough pieces. They could also ease up on the salt. They've got a selection of Jarritos sodas - a must for me. And on the weekends they're open late to cater to the drunken (or night owl) contingent around Broad Ripple.

My girlfriends and I went to Jalapeños late on a Saturday night. I liked the vibe of this place and you can immediately tell it's going to be great authentic Mexican food.  The portions were huge! The guacamole was very flavorful although not much quantity for the price. I ordered tacos al pastor and although flavorful, the tortilla was so greasy. It was almost as if they dipped the tortilla in oil then put on the toppings (very strange). I would up eating my taco "insides" on top of the complimentary chips. 

We had a great time at Jalapeños and practically had the place to ourselves! BYOB

China Kitchen is now down to one star.  Pretty sad.  Luncheon specials are now w down to half the size they used to be. It appears it is under new management.  Very sad.  End of an era!

I'm downgrading my review from 5 stars to 2 stars.  Every time I come in here I get scowled at by the lady behind the counter.  Look I know you hate your life:  but I am the customer!  This means smiling!  This means greeting me!  The food is OK but to be honest it's not that great and they are getting more expensive!  Want a better review!  Smile at me.  Be nice to me.  Or I'm going someplace else there are now other choices!

comfy, not pretentious, casual, friendly. was greeted warmly by server, who soon after gave me her personal picks, both of which my partner and i ordered and were simply delighted by!!! prices very reasonable and portions are hearty. i would definitely return to eat here if i ever get back to carpinteria. overall, it was a wonderful dining experience. i wish i could recall our server's name because she was delightful and extremely helpful in selecting entrees either she'd had or gotten feedback from diners about. 
Check out Tony's!!!

I had won a night stay and dinner package in an auction. The staff was very friendly at the front desk and the bar/ dining area. The place was empty and i soon found out why.the bar area pool area and worst of all the kitchen and dining area are infested with fruit flies. The coffee machine had bugs the menus had bugs even my drink had 3 or 4 floating in it. We had free food vouchers but could not bring ourselves to eat there. I feel bad for the very friendly staff that waited on is. This management team needs to get the kitchen area deep cleaned and bug bombed immediately.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
There's a good selection here.  A sales associate directed me to what I was looking for.  The wait in the line was short - another cashier opened up a register so that I wouldn't wait for the person in front of me.

The bad - just like other reviewers I got harassed while at the store.  I was in the checkout lane (AKA inside the store) and some lady had some prepaid visa card. She did the classic Philly and told me that there was $18 on the card & if I bought her something I could get $10.  I had to tell her no a couple of times.  The store employees just ignored her as if this was just a part of operating business that they had to deal with.

Unfortunately zero stars was not an option. Possibly the worst delivery food I've ever had. 

We ordered $120 worth of food, all of which was inedible. Out of the 80 wings, about 4 of them were just chicken bones, with no meat. They looked like they had already been chewed on. The pizza was soggy. The cheesesteaks were dry and flavorless. 

We called to inform the restaurant. The owner came on the phone and asked: "you want 40 more wings?" to which I declined. He said "ok thanks" and hung up. 

Never, ever again.

Local residents - you need to frequent this place so that they remain. This is on par with the taqueria's  in the Cherokee St area of St Louis, but without the travel. They have 6 different meats to choose from, corn or flour tortillas, and a great selection of salsa. They also have Mexican beer on draft or in the bottle, and Mexican sodas with real sugar. There has not been a crowd the times I have been, so not sure how they would handle a rush. Our service has been exceptional, and they are willing to let you sample just about anything you are not sure of. Really great, authentic tacos!

I couldn't believe the amount of unprofessionalism this DD has. We get to the drive through and wait at the speaker for about 7-8 mins. We don't get any answer or "Hey be right with you" so we assume the box is broken. We say hello a couple times just to make sure. So we drive to the window and we hear her come on the speaker!! We are parked behind the guy that was in front of us and she is laughing hysterically at us. So we drove off and didn't even order. Never been to a Dunkin Donuts before and probably will never go to one again. Super disappointed

Terrible service! I just stood downstairs at the front desk waiting for a Starbucks coffee for over 15 minutes while the front desk clerk attended to another couple.. that's not the problem. Not once did he turn around and acknowledge me (he knew I was waiting) it was so long that THE COUPLE said "We're taking to much of your time and you can go ahead and attend to that lady".. but nope, still didn't turn around and say anything or attend to me. I ended up walking away. Glad we're checking out. The air conditioner kept us up all night long clicking on and off, it's extremely loud and their pool is closed for the season. Bye!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I'll start with the positives - generally clean rooms, easy check in/out, and extra toilettes (ie toothbrush, soaps/ towels when we asked). Neural comments - they are not a full service hotel, so when we wanted anything after 10pm we needed to go to the front desk ourselves. Complimentary breakfast was bread, bagels, cereal, yogurt, bananas, coffee & juice. Negatives - mattresses were real soft, paper thin walls, hallways not the cleanest, further from USF and Busch gardens then expected, disinterested/dismissive staff. Not worth the price, should be more like $60 a night no
more.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: They recently added some new machines and opened up an area for weights. There's one of everything you might need along with a studio room, which I use to do workouts from apps. It's almost always open (there's a class every now and then). They have one HIIT class M/W at 5. It's usually pretty busy so it's hit or miss on the equipment you get to use. Jordan and Nick are both trainers and are really nice. They always greet me when they're there. It's not perfect but for the size of the gym i think it's pretty good. I only wish it was closer to my home!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Not sure what I missed here, but of the 3 pastas I had, 2 were either under seasoned or overtly salty, and undercooked. I get al dente. This was borderline crunchy. Antipasta was 50% soft, characterless white cheese, boquerones from the can, too many olives  and rubbery duck prosciutto. The caponata was good but minuscule.  Nothing resembling a salad on the menu and the octopus was like a puzzle with missing pieces, let alone hammered on the reheat. That coupled with the sheer disappointment our server displayed when we declined the tasting menu was enough for me to cross it off the list. Too bad. Just moved to the neighborhood.

The lady was nice and still took my order to go since they were closed. Hours are wrong on Yelp. I sent in correction. The food was ok, not bad. Presentation good. For my to go order I did not see any soy sauce.  I asked for some.  I didn't pay attention as surely she wouldn't just give me one packet for two rolls. Sure enough I only got one packet.  Since I'm traveling I didn't have any soy sauce back at the hotel. I was looking for a nice dim restaurant to relax before my overnight work. This place was a fast food strip mall type place that is well lit. Not a place if ambiance or romance. I'll go somewhere else next time.

Good food, friendly people, homemade tortillas, great prices, and some unique menu items. I regret not stopping sooner. 

For a recent dinner we had a lengua taco (not bad), a shrimp taco (delicious sauce and homemade slaw), a pork belly taco (not bad, but it was tender cubes of pork. I  was expecting a slab.) and I simply had to try the pork rind taco (yum!).

My companion had the asada burrito and loved it. The sauce, cheese, rice, and perfectly marinated steak combined with the homemade tortilla was a winner.

We will be going back without a doubt.

Their pizza is obviously better than the national chains.  In fact, it's rather good, though I would not call it "gourmet" as they do, by any stretch of the imagination.  They have a larger selection of vegetarian and vegan options than are available most other places. However,  $1.50 to $3.00 per veggie topping (depending on pizza size) for items that aren't even organic, is rather silly.  So if you order here, get the toppings, like pine nuts and sun dried tomatoes instead of mushrooms and onions so that you can approach getting your money's worth.

Your typical airport restaurant. I believe there are a few better stops in this terminal, but it's not bad. I was a little disappointed in the beer options considering the name of the place. Food was okay, nothing memorable. It was pretty quick with good service, so can't complain about that when you're trying to catch a quick meal before a flight. I'm not sure I would pay the price for it if I was traveling for pleasure, it is overpriced for the quality of the food. I usually try to eat before I enter the airport because nothing in the terminal is great, so you get what you ask for when you come to a place like this.

TBH, I wasn't impressed. I've heard some great things about this place, and thought it was a St. Louis Classic, but they need to get with the times. Their food is sub par for the price (so many better places in the city). The food wasn't bad, it just wasn't anything special that I would pay that much for. Food was mostly bland, not a lot of flavor. Pretty big portions, but they make it seem like a fancy restaurant when it doesn't really feel like one. Service was okay. Food was pretty quick. Just an okay experience. Again, it's not bad, but for the price, I would rather eat somewhere that has better flavor profiles and options.

I have eaten here at least ten times and I like it a lot.  

I have tried almost all of the rolls on this menu and I must say I have left happy every single time but the last time. 

The last time there was something in my roll that was not fresh and that really upset me. 

I typically go for either an early or late lunch since this place is super super small and otherwise I wouldn't get a seat. There are like 6 or 8 seats at the sushi bar and then one table for 4. So, you see it's a small place. 

They prepare your order in RECORD SPEED. I think this is the fastest prep in the city.

I am a fan of Lolita. I liked it prior to thier renno / liquor liscense and I like it even a little more now. I really love the changes they made to the inside. The decor, the layout, everything is beautiful. 

The drinks are so festive looking. 

The food was really nice, I had the carnitas pork tacos, the shrimp tacos (the shrimp tacos were very very spicey but I enjoy spice) and I had chips and guac which was wonderful. Memilitas was also enjoyable. I liked my meal so much and I'll definately go back. 

The presentations nicely done. 

Sevice was great too. 

A pleasant dining experience.

This Crew location is so convenient to downtown. With that being said, it's not the easiest to navigate. The turn going into the actual wash is very sharp and there isn't much room to maneuver onto the track. The wash then ends going directly into Meridian street, which can cause a backup for vehicles exiting the wash. 

The employees are always so nice and helpful. Today, I wanted to purchase the unlimited plan (but I held strong and passed) just because the employee was so pleasant. Crew really hires top-notch people. 

All in all, I won't let the logistical fails keep me from returning.

I wish I could give this place 3.5 stars. Neat atmosphere. Never crowded. Usually quiet. Lots of stuff on the menu. Yummy salads and big! Bruschetta is bangin! Tomato stack app is delicious! Ribs are good and all you can eat on mondays I think. Sundays, kids eat free. Scallops are damn good but only if you get them solo (sometimes overcooked if you get them with the dish that includes shrimp). It's really hit or miss depending on what you get. Most of the servers will be completely honest with you about what is good and worth getting. Just ask!

We came in for a drink and some food, didn't stay overnight. I had asked for about four different drinks that every bar should have to offer but they didn't have anything I'd asked for. I finally asked them to make me a sangria, easy enough (but pricey). We had the Buffalo wings, and chili-- which I was told was made inhouse. The wings were good, but the chili tasted like the can it came out of-- swirled with some sour cream and cheddar on a small plate to make it look fancy. I could've saved $16 if we'd gotten the same chili at the Dollar General. Musical entertainment was good and appreciated.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: They got me with the sign outside that says 2 rolls for $7.95 or 3 for $10.95 But then I found a really appealing lump crab roll on the menu for $12.95. It was really yummy so I don't mind the extra money. But I also got the green salad and it sucked. I didn't really eat it and I wished I asked for my money back for it. But I felt bad because they were really sweet and friendly. In the end I spent twice as much money then I had intended. So if you go in just go in for the special. But food's good and staff is friendly.

Crab meat rangoon??? Are U kidding me.  These are the most disgusting thing I've put in my mouth in a very long time.  The 1st time I got them I thought the filling had gone  bad so I just threw them out. They have this really gross sour taste.  Ordered today and forgot I didn't like them (2nd time eating here) and immediately spit  them out.  They're just horrible.  The veggie egg rolls were also a waste of money IMO.  The fried rice is cool nothing special it just seems like white rice with veggies.  My son didn't care for his chicken lo-mein and threw it out.  It had to be bad cause he looovvvves Chinese.  He said it was just blah & bland.
