We ordered carry-out on a Sunday evening and our order was ready in 10 minutes. I had 2 beef tacos with all the fixings and my husband had a steak quesadilla. We also ordered queso and chips. The order came with complimentary salsa as well. My tacos were good but my husband said his quesadilla was soggy. It probably would've been better if he ordered that for dine-in. The chips were pretty bland but the queso and salsa were both good. Overall, it was an okay experience. We'll be back to check out the food quality with a dine-in experience in the future.

This place has the best chorizo, homemade flour tortillas and coffee in town!  The chorizo has to be homemade because the spices are right on.  The flour tortillas are to die for because an employee makes them fresh to order and so the yummy and chewy.  And the coffee has a natural sweetness to it that you can't find anywhere else.  We have only eaten breakfast here so can't confirm the other reviews regarding bad food.  Yes, the portions are small and the price is a little high but not enough to keep us away.

It's like it's hit or miss...one day the service is good and the next day it's downright awful! Sometimes you get a call back, but after a while you don't count on it. Although my car is fixed now and everything seems to be in good condition, the overall process of going to the service department was not how I liked spending my days off. I always had a feeling of dread every time I called or went in. I can deal with bad customer service but common courtesy and better communication skills are seriously lacking. 2 stars because my they fixed my car properly.

This restaurant definitely needs a facelift. We wanted to try the $25 prefix meal, but they were out of the ravioli which was one of the two dishes offered. So we tried the $50. Lots of food that didn't taste good. Antipasto was okay, pasta trio had an odd after taste, and the bread was hard as a rock. We both order filet mignon medium cooked, and was surprised that it was served in medallion pieces, cook well, with marina sauce. It was chewy and flavorless. The soup and the chocolate cake were the only two dishes that tasted really good. If you just want to get wasted on unlimited wine and fill your belly, this is the place.

Clean and comfortable hotel. Quick walk to Peppermill. Receptionist was totally unfriendly when we arrived. Acted like we interrupted her on an important phone call. Scribbled our room number on a post it which we couldn't read and had to ask her what it was. Never mentioned wifi password, breakfast hours, pool, checkout time or anything. We missed breakfast. Wifi password didn't work. 

Funny, we stayed 6/13/15 in room 260 and we also heard the dog barking its head off in the morning. Another reviewer posted this in May 2015 about the room right below us in 160. When we first arrived the dog was lunging at the window barking at us.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm only giving this review due to the rental I got versus the weather. I got a Nissan Versa and it was windy as all get out and I had to keep both hands on the steering wheel anytime I was on the road with the rental because I got whipped all over the road. I also had an issue with the "trunk" of the car because I put my luggage in there and shut the "trunk" pretty dang hard and the "door is open light" kept coming on while I was traveling. I finally arrive at my destination, and I'll be damned, the "trunk" was open the whole time. WTF!!!!!

Well what can I say about this place that the other reviews did not say.   We lived there 3 years and had maybe 15 years of maintenance issues. First moved in dish washer was broke. They "fixed it" a few times till they brought me a new one.  Oh how about every time it rained hard in the summer the back bed room flooded...  had maint out there sucking up water and replacing pad and carpet all the time. They did finally fix it after I called them out 5 times to fix it.   AC was sucked at best and would freeze up all the time.  The dumpster looked like a garbage dumb on a hot day. And the rent staff just kinda rude. Some nice not many lol

The fish and other seafood is fresh and of a very high quality. I have never had anything here that was not absolutely delicious. However, when you're dining out you do expect a level of attentive service, you will NOT find that here at Cafe Mochi. Even when they are not extremely busy, the staff is very slow, and worse, often rude. The only reason I keep coming back is because it is located so close to my home and the food is amazing. Otherwise, I would never frequent this establishment. So if you're looking for good sushi  and don't mind putting up with slow and inattentive service, then by all means enjoy.

Hipster popsicles. That's my best definition of this joint. My coworkers and I ended our ladies night here. Initially I was impressed by the selection of flavors, but the actual quality is mehhh. I had peanut butter with milk chocolate coating, it didn't have much flavor. The actual popsicle was very icy, I was hoping for a more creamy texture I suppose. One of the ladies got the sour cherry cola, ate two bites and threw it away. For $4/pop (with chocolate), I'll save my $$ and just buy a box of treats at the grocery store.

We have a few Subways close to us, but this is  the one we like the best. We know that our sandwiches will be made the  way we want them to be made. The restaurant is is clean and the people who work here also appear to be clean. It's nice to have a place that you feel that you can depend on. The indoor eating area is small, but still big enough for me to get around in my power-chair. Subway really puts very little meat on their subs. Like any other advertisement, don't think your sandwich will look like the picture.

This was a very strange experience and I don't recommend coming here. The sign clearly states that the buffet is $10.45. The girl however said, no, we had to get a plate and bring it up for her to weigh at $5.99 a lb. She said it was cheaper that way. Well, it isn't cheaper and we tried to tell her that we wanted to pay the $10.45, but it wasn't going to happen. We watched a group of 9 walk out after hearing the ridiculous rule about weighing every plate as you go. WOW! $100.00 out the door. Some of the food was good, although the choice was limited and some was not that great in my opinion. I doubt that I will be returning.

The drive thru asshole tried to ignore us at 2am till I threatened to leave a bad yelp review then I order a biscuit and he said they only had lunch despite the "breakfast all day" sign then we argued and ordered more breakfast then he said they only took cash at this location and I called bullshit I just wanna eat on my long morning up to the mountains for my ski retreat but anyways yeah I called him out and now he's being sassy so ya YiKeS! Fingers crossed he gets fired I'm putting that on my praye chain YA HEAR THAT SUSAN ITS ON MY PRAYER CHAIN (heart emoji)(send tweet)
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place had good potential, when they 1st opened a couple years ago, seemed as the whole family was involved. We were regulars. Than as time went by quality of there food seem to fall off, the last straw for me was when my wife and I went in for a late diner Around 8pm, I ordered a couple slices of pizza and a soup. No flavor in either, soup was Luke warm at best, waitress warmed it up and thought she was doing me a favor. My wife's spaghetti was the same way, not quite sure how they are still in business, have not been back in over a year.

This Marsh is fancy schmancy.  There is everything from your typical groceries to an awesome cafe area which includes a large salad bar, large soup selection, pizza, sandwiches, sushi, and so much more!

We often walk from IUPUI to have lunch here.  It is conveniently located and seems to do a brisk business.  The U-Scan registers make checking out a breeze.

After you check out, there is an upstairs cafe seating area where you can enjoy your meal.  If you're lucky, you can snag a window seat.

The restrooms upstairs are clean and well-kept as is the rest of the store.  We enjoy going here.

Ritter's locations seem to have almost vanished.  That is a shame because they really do have an excellent product.  All of the locations on the west side of Indy have long since closed, so we have to travel if we want to eat here.

It was a rainy day, so we were the only people here.  I ordered the strawberry shortcake.  It was pretty pricey at around $5 in my opinion. It was a decent-sized portion of vanilla frozen custard.  I wish there would have been more actual cake in it.  It was just some soft sponge cake instead of real shortcake, so that was a bit disappointing.

The service was friendly.  Not that they had anything better to do.

This place has gone down here. The high school kids they hire to work here don't seem to care too busy chatting with friends less and less topping options. How can you have a butterfinger sundae when you don't even carry butterfinger anymore? You're out of Reese cups topping? Seemed like they have changed their focus from froyo to ice cream. My white chocolate froyo tasted like ice milk? How can you possibly charge money for Ice milk?  It's a shame cause there the on my game  in town close by. Loyo you can do better for your customers than this

Ordered at 5:15 pm, called at 6:15 pm and the guy said our order would be delivered in 10-15 minutes. I could hardly understand the man that answered the phone, and he seemed frustrated when I asked if he could repeat himself. 

Our order didn't arrive until 7 pm, and I was about to call back and cancel since I was paying cash and it was almost 2 hours later! Crab rangoon wasn't the best whatsoever.. my sweet and sour chicken was cold and had a weird thick sauce that was just gross. Only thing I ate was the fried rice.... My friends Hunan Beef and Chicken Lo Mein was apparently good, but whatever. I won't be ordering from here again!!!

I have gluten, dairy, and sugar allergies which make it very difficult to eat anywhere. Daniel was kind enough to take the time to talk to me about the menu options that fit my issues. They were extremely accommodating and super understanding about my needs. I ended up with a very delicious fillet mignon, roasted brussel sprouts, asparagus, and a house salad with balsamic vinegar dressing. It was AMAZING!! I would definitely recommend this family restaurant to anyone and will be going back to eat their amazing food!

So I'm going to bump up my rating for this restaurant now. It feels like they've improved upon the menu and their service.

The service has improved greatly. The servers are more attentive now than in previous visits, even during their busiest of times. I have to mention again that their server, Terrence, is the absolutely the best and I try to sit in his area whenever I dine here to ensure I get his exceptional service.

I would personally like to see this place update their menu a little bit while continuing to serve their popular items.

I have given this restaurant two opportunities for dinner and have been let down both times. The first time I went, the waiter uncomfortably hovered over us and would ask us if we were ready to order every 30 seconds. The food came out almost suspiciously fast. I ordered a miso soup and a specialty roll. The miso soup was fine (I find it hard to mess that up) and the sushi was very low quality. I found the fish to be chewy and definitely not fresh. The second time I went to this location, I ordered the Chicken Pad Thai. I found the chicken to be almost raw and very fatty. The only plus side this restaurant has is that it is a BYOB restaurant.

If you have anything valuable...dont stay here...we forgot our jackets when we checked out and i had money in my pockets and when i returned for them the money was gone..Rosemary the head of housekeeping was very nice but the indian looking girl at the front desk was sizing me up like i was wrong for inquiring about my own belongings. Its a shame that this hotel doesnt have better customer service, because its a nice hotel with great amenities. This isnt the first review about theft from forgotten belongings. I wont be staying here again...and if you choose to...watch your items
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went here last night after having some beers. I went with #13 machaca combination plate and it's really pretty good but not what I expected. All combos come with rice and beans, and the machaca was mixed with green peppers, tomatoes, onions, eggs and cheese. I like how fresh it is but I was expecting straight up meat like the delicious and tender machaca I've had elsewhere. My partner got the #2, the taco tostado combination and and found both disappointing but enjoyed the rice and beans. Combo plates were expensive and overall it was just okay.

I give this a five star for setting, four star for service and three star for food but we were all happy that we had eaten lunch there. Ham and Brie  sandwich on grilled bread was rather plain but good enough. I think everybody else felt the same way about   dishes including fish and chips hamburger. The fig salad did not have fresh figs which seemed a bit odd as dried figs add no moisture or interest. That friend helped us eat our lunches because she was still hungry. I would still recommend it for view cheerfulness cleanliness and the interesting and nouveau menu.

Since we moved to south tampa this has been our go to Chinese dive. We have never gone here & not been satisfied.  We have tried the chicken & broccoli, General tso, chicken lo mein, krab Rangoon, steam dumplings, and donuts. We are creatures of habit so we usually always get the same thing. 
This place always serves fresh, hot, & best of all...LARGE portions! you definitely get your money worth!
The only reason why it gets 4 stars is because the appearance of the place isen't that great. It does no justice to the quality of the food.  Motto: don't judge a book by it's cover!

Have been hitting this location for several years, my first time in about 2years.  The food was good, not great.   I had the crab ravioli and wife had the tortellini.    Both were good.     Service was good, we had a new server, her great attitude made up for her experience.   Hand to ask for bread, no salad with a pricey entree, and had to ask for Parmesan cheese.........at an upscale Italian restaurant?    Ambience was ok, prices high, ánd their website was not totally up to date.    Probably go back some day.

Was pretty disappointed with this place. They have a a very limited dinner menu and the few entree options- half of them come with arugula as a side. So if you're not a salad person you have even less options. Decided to just order the chicken noodle soup. I figured you couldn't go wrong with that. I was wrong. It was extremely bland. I tried putting as much salt and pepper as possible and nothing helped. Had less than 10 bites and decided I couldn't do it anymore. The waitress asked what was wrong and I told her. She didn't seem too concerned. I paid for the check and left.

well, Mickey D's is advertising the fresh heck out of their new Chik-Fil-A ripoff. Being a HUGE chicken sammich fan, I tried McD's offering today. 
Two words. SCORCHED HEN. 
They overcooked that bird so hard, it must have tried to fly outa the fryer. Funniest part? McD's chose to have their drive thru bags pay homage to this new breaded bird on a bun, and wouldn'tcha know it, it says, and I quote:
Crispy.
Juicy.
Tender.
Someone must have been in quite the hurry, jotting to memory ONLY the first word, cause it was crispier than that new money our government is printing 24/7/365. I may give it another try, but it's doubtful.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Awesome location. It's just a few minutes walk to Broadway, Printer's Alley, the convention centers, etc. The hotel is nice and clean and the staff is super friendly. 

But.... They didn't give us what we'd booked. The beds were tiny (way smaller than queen sized). The WiFi was not dependable. The noise level is a bit nuts; you can hear everything going on outside. And the parking sucks; $22 a day or $26 for valet. Maybe it's just me but it'd be nice, if you're paying for a room to have parking provided. 

It served its purpose for a few days.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Delicious sushi! Perfect for both lunch & dinner! The lunch options are so affordable and there is something for everyone. Bonus for being very fast, so you are in and out quickly. I have always been so impressed with the freshness and variety of sushi offered. Both nigiri and rolls. Additionally they have some hot food and non seafood if there is anyone in your party that requires other options. In my opinion its the best sushi around and the lunch boxes are a great place to start if its your first time. The edamame is out of this world if you are looking for a quick appetizer as well!

The staff at this Starbucks is always friendly and helpful. I had to give up caffeine and was not badgered in any form or fashion for ordering my decaf-non-fat-sugar-free latte. In fact, my barista gave me lots of ideas on other tasty decaf drinks I should try. 
I also want to take this opportunity to tell you to Pay It Forward- the last time I visited Starbucks the silver van in front of me paid for my order. I do this too every now and then, just never understood how good the receiving end could feel until this day. Give it a try and make somebody's day.

Stick to the basics when ordering from this location: donuts, coffee and Baskin-Robbins ice cream

I ordered a veggie egg white flatbread sandwich.  Half of the cheese was crusty and the other half was melted (see pic) So I returned to have a new one made and received one that had a different type of cheese on it a white cheese and was stone cold, almost frozen. Absolutely unacceptable, I just asked for my money back at this point. 

I received no apologies just a few eye rolls. Which I don't take personally I'm sure they were just irritated at the situation but a little customer service does go a long way for future reference.

The to-go window is a great concept!  Can't taste the liquor in the $15 resurrection drink though, which I've sampled many Bar Rescue recipes at home using what they show you on TV (and they usually taste weaker and after 3 you feel like you drank a soda).  For a mixed drink, I definitely recommend a hand grenade or one of the 10000 places down there who do Hurricanes.  I would definitely consider Spirits a good one for a quick beer to go as that window saves a lot of time waiting inside the bars and you get a fast, friendly attentive bartender with immediate response.

The location is great and the salon and staff are friendly but my mani/pedi was rushed. I did bring my 3 sons in and they all got pedis very rushed as well and full adult price. First I was surprised my toes were done last, the polish didn't dry and my toes look a mess. I was handed a pedicure menu when he was done and callus removal isn't included. I paid $100.00 for 4 foot rubs and 1 polish.
My manicure was rushed as well and to make it worse he used was the wrong gel color.
Needless to say I will be going back to Kelly Nails in Noblesville where a pedicure is a pedicure and they offer lower rates for children.

Authentic hole-in-the-wall taqueria in Norristown's Little Mexico. The inside is very basic and the waitress doesn't speak English well. But that's ok because the food is delicious and flavorful.

If you are hesitant about these types of places, don't worry - just order any of the following and you will be happy:
- tacos al pastor
- huaraches
- carnitas sope
- enchiladas mole

They give you a bowl of light green salsa - its a bit creamy but has some good heat (pour it religiously on each bite haha).

No complimetary chips/salsa, but hey we're all watching our carbs nowadays.

Wash it all down with a mango Boing!

PS - cash only

Yudy is gone and she was honestly the only reason why I went to the salon. I have no problems with the other employees, however as soon as she left prices went way up. I go to Temple University which is expanding so maybe they want to be more competitive? If you have natural hair they push blow outs and not roller sets. Which are more expensive and damaging for the hair. Trims are cuts and you feel nickel and dimmed for everything deep conditioners are $5 or $10 with no explanation on the difference. I just hope Yudy comes back and things change back to normal.

I came here with a group from the office and I'm not sure any of us will return. The food wasn't super bad, however, nothing was seasoned and it took a really long time. I ordered fettucine alfredo, which turned out to be a bit dryish and pasty tasting. The staff were a bit slow and seemed disorganized/poorly trained. 
The only dish we enjoyed was garlic cheesy bread, which was cheesy but not very garlicky. Nonetheless, it was toasty and good.
Overall, they've got a lot of opportunity for improvement. Hopefully they'll figure it out!

We had brunch here for Ben F's birthday and absolutely loved it!  The restaurant is very homey and casual with super friendly staff.  The "manmosas" are a perfect size, making me never want a mimosa in a champagne flute again!  And they're made with fresh squeezed OJ...yummy!
Everyone in our party thoroughly enjoyed their food.  From the bacon that is cured in-house to the cornbread french toast to the perfectly prepared eggs and baked smashed potatoes, everything was fabulous!
We are planning to go back sometime to try the dinner menu...I can't wait!

While I love Italian food, this is not working. The menu sounds great. The dishes were visually enticing, but alas when you taste it... disappointment... heart break... regret... that pasta??? what is wrong with that main ingredient? IDK... couldn't honestly tell you... seems more like ramen than angelhair.  No sauce in the world could save that. 
tried the breadsticks and the garlic dough... hmm... limp and greasy would describe that most accurately. 
I so wanted to like this place... It looks great, I love the concept, but the execution is just not there.

Their sushi is delicious and looks great every time I've eaten here, but my only criticism is how tightly the sushi is rolled. Returned here last week after a few years of being in Baton Rouge and I've always had the same issue - the pieces fall apart too easily. 

I'm no newbie to sushi so it's frustrating when the pieces fall apart between plate to mouth so often. Whether this means it's not rolled tight enough or they're offering you so much inside the roll that it can't take it, I'm not sure. Good looks, great taste, just roll them tighter, please!

My A/C wasn't running as cool as I though it should be, so I made a pit stop at Ben's without an appointment. Luck was on my side, it was a cool day, so nobody else was competing for his time at the moment I arrived.

He asked me what the issue was, what I drove , and had had me pull around the side. He filled my A/C (which was a bit low), and had me out of there in ten minutes flat. No muss, no fuss. Really nice guy and on the ball.

Really one of the best car guys around - he knows what he is doing and doesn't make you wait. I know my A/C will go out eventually, and he will for sure get my business. He earned it today.

went here for restaurant week and it was a super super good deal. they're more on the high end   for price but quality is really good. the lighting is a little dark inside but lit enough to eat i guess. the appetizer/small courses were not that unique or particularly memorable but the black cod saikyoyaki was life changing. the cod was so soft and tender and the sweet glaze they had on it complimented the slight saltiness of the actual fish. the skin is was super fatty and delicious. my other friend who ordered sushi said it was good too so if sushi is more up your alley go for it!!

TLDR: go here if you like customizing your food and want something relatively light and cheap 

Tips: On Wednesdays you can receive a complimentary glass of wine with your order. 

The best part of this place is the ability to customize your pizza with lots of fancy ingredients (think balsamic vinegar, pineapple, arugula). They also have pre-selected options for pizzas and salads, if you don't want to think too hard about your order. 

A custom pizza will set you back around $9-11, and portions are okay. You'll leave feeling full but not stuffed, and most likely with no leftovers.

Please, I beg you, do not eat here. While the low prices may seem enticing, the food itself is terrible. Not to mention we found bones in both of our dishes. I had a taco salad and my husband had chicken enchiladas. That is inexcusable. When we told the waitress, her exact response was "oh really". Nope, I brought them from home. No money was taken off, no sorry was said. Again inexcusable. 
Next, the place smells strange and service is subpar. The salsa tastes like marinara you find on a pizza. $1.00 is charged for a small thing of sour cream. All in all, we weren't impressed, whatsoever. Save your money.

So this going back a few months now. This BK is always dirty for one. My son's decision was to come here I did inform him our food would be F@ucked up and slow. We'll still want to go so he wanted a double bacon king with only cheese and bacon. We got a burger with to patties no bacon or cheese my burger is jacked up as well but okay back to my sons it comes back with sauce bacon and cheese!! So I'm done the fries were cold and I want my money back. So the manger says it's the guys second day sorry. Okay I still want my money back guess what she couldn't figure how to give me my money back so I said f it I'm out. This place is the worst ever

If I was just rating the food I would give 5 stars but the service is less than great. As others have said, they bring you a snack size portion of chips and salsa, get your drinks take your order and then never return except to serve your meal. I've never ate at a Mexican restaurant where they aren't shoving chips and salsa down your throat. On the positive side, the food is delicious and very fresh. I recommend the chimichanga. The sweet red sauce that comes on it is great and I normally don't care for red sauce. This was our 2nd time here for lunch and I'm sure we will be back again despite the poor service.

We love this pizza and have recommended it to others from the tristate area.
The place hasn't changed a bit in the 4 years we have been here.  Definitely not about ambiance
Service hit or miss.  Sometimes they appear glad to see you other times they go through the motions 
Pizza.  Best in the area.   Crust is just about crispy but still foldable.  Just the right amount of sweet to the sauce. cheese in the right proportion 
Recommend getting the whole pie as slices border on overdone when reheated  even with the negatives it's a great pie if you are from nyc

I recently moved to East Norriton and decided to take my care to be washed at Pete's this past October. The next day I realized my radio  antenna cover (shark fin style) was missing from the top of my car. (Note- this is not the kind that lowers or raises and it is permanently attached). I called and luckily a co-worker there told me they did have it and it was still in one piece. I was not offered any type of compensation for the damage their car wash did. I would not recommend this car wash because of this experience and am afraid to bring my car back to this place for fear this will happen again.

This is one of my favorite sushi restaurants, and there are many in this area. They each have their own unique qualities. I've dined in a couple of times, but most recently I've been getting it delivered though Mobile Meals. I've never had any issues with any of my delivery orders. The staff are always very nice when dining in. 

My two absolute favorite rolls from Sushi Ushi are the Sashima Roll (tuna, yellowtail, and salmon), and the Fresh Roll (spicy crabmeat and tempura shrimp). They are always fresh and tasty. I have tried other sushi rolls, but these are the rolls that keep me coming back.

This is a cute little place that had an open reservation on one of businesses days in f the year Mothers Day!!  Thankfully they allowed the s to waiting for my kids who were over an hour late. Ordered mussels and a very traditional Caesar salad with perfect anchovies!!!
Dinners arrived and the best out of 5 meals was the Lamb Chops, which was the special for the night. Pappardella & vodka sauce was ok. Chicken Piccata was sub-par. Not enough sauce. Lobster ravioli was average at best. Wish we could have had a above average dinner but not at this place.

Recently dined here for a night out with my husband.   Will start by saying the service was good but went downhill from there.  The place seemed dirty from the menus to the table, light fixtures etc.  then, we got our food which was served super fast!  The rolls were pretty good but then went to bite into a piece of salmon and found a hair in it!!  When I finally flagged down our waitress, she did not appear concerned and offered me another piece of salmon but, at this point, I was completely turned off.  Can't believe they were not more apologetic and accommodating about this.  Will not be back.

Not a fan of big open gyms full of dooshamabaggins. Place is subpar. Both my buddies who worked there left and it really dropped off. 

Charged me three times after I cancelled and then sent it to collections. My girlfriend had billing issues while we were both there and cf never addressed the billing issue as they said they would. 

Gym is overhyped and they promote partying more than fitness. Not really sure how binge drinking and pumping iron go together. We make fun of Planet Fitness for pizza and tootsie rolls while this gym promotes over hyped parties on their little tvs and crappy fliers.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The Continental breakfast was a good spread that actually had meat. They had Otis spunkenmeyer muffins and danishes. The room I had was 313, I thought it 2as beautiful and up to date. The bathroom was nice but the toilet sat kinda low; glad I'm not a dude if you catch my drift lol got the room through hotels.com got a 20% discount (hotels.com happened to be running some special) the room was $83.99 with tax for 2 adults. Not bad considering I hit a Caribbean party, got some good sleep, got some good continental eats, then was on my way to Fort Lauderdale to then head to st thomas. I would stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
La Viola is an awesome place, but I think you need to know what you're expecting if you come in on a Friday or Saturday night- it's crowded, loud, and most people are really getting after it. The food is good, especially for the price, and the wait staff is generally nice and on top of it, but this is definitely not a date spot, and if you bring a big group, plan on shouting across the table. 

One piece of advice: if the line is too long, go across to La Viola Ovest- same kitchen, same menu, but it's quieter and less busy.

I ordered through Uber eats the gnocchi and the chicken piccata. Not only in the menu description as well as the pictures the gnocchi was to come with vodka sauce it came with white greasy oil sauce and was mushy as can be like uncooked dough balls with peas and not edible. The chicken piccata came with not one caper not one and it had been cooked to death dry as can be. The spinach it cake with was so salty it couldn't be eaten.  This is literally the worst food I've ever gotten and I paid $47 for it. Never again.

Ordered a dozen through Grubhub.  Specifically selected the donuts I wanted.  The order is a mess of not what I wanted at all.  What a waste of my money and my time.  Giving half of this crap away to the neighbors.  If you didn't have the donuts O wanted then you should let the customer know through the Grubhub app instead of just going ahead and throwing in a whole other order of donuts I didn't want or ask for because you ran out of what I selected at least that's what I'm assuming happened.  Thanks for nothing! PS: Now that I have bitten into one of the donuts I find out they're old stale and nasty as well. Unreal!

It is a new kid on the block and I thought we would give it a try.
Their milk shakes were to die for- I will definitely be back for this as I am very fussy. All other shakes that I have tasted, before I checked this place have tasted artificial to me. The Boardwalk version tasted super creamy, and made with "real" ingredients. 
I had the chicken burger. I would have loved it but all I could taste was beef as it was grilled on the same spot where my husband's burger was grilled. Needless to say I do not like beef and this was unpleasant. Other than that the ingredients were fresh, the bun was the right size, not massive.

By far one of the worst McDonalds in Boise. Every time we go here the fries are cold and stale. The cashiers are very friendly. I went today and got a cheeseburger and I asked for extra pickles  normally you only get one extra pickle. So I asked for more than one, four would be great. I opened the burger and there had to be 20 pickles in there. That just looks like spite. Come on now. All I asked for was four pickles, I was polite and courteous. This didn't need to happen. Just avoid this McDonald's at all costs.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Ok.  I get the idea but how far can they make that last?  Maybe I'm short sighted but it would be great to have a donut shop sell....donuts?  Not just one expensive donut with toppings meant for a 10 year old. It's the Menchies of donuts.  An idea: maybe focus on having really exceptional donuts (lots of different kinds) and have the kitschy idea be just one option? We are a big donut eating family and have been waiting for this shop to open. Went last night for the first time and probably won't go again.  If you sold a variety of donuts we'd be there weekly.

Starbucks at this location is great. The staff is awesome, the drinks are great (cider and vanilla chi tea are my favorite) and the place is relaxing with a great hangout area with free wifi. The downside is that the parking lot is very small and a pain to get into. With GameStop next door, the lot seems always full but I ride a bike there so this isn't an issue for myself. Also the interselection is quite brutal between memorial highway and hillsborough ave. Also remember that Starbucks isn't the cheapest but in the end, it's better than anything Dunkin can produce.

Check your doughnuts! I'm waiting in line for ice cream Saturday night and in the back kitchen this braless elderly lady (gravity had not been kind) is flipping her hair and after about the 8th or 9th time I see her flip her hair near the rack of freshly made doughnuts I have to wonder what type of extra toppings are applied to thier doughnuts. Then it's no surprise next when she pulls out a pack of cigarettes from the inside of her shirt (yuck) and heads to the exit for more doughnut flavorings. Just gross and unsanitary conditions.

I have been here several times, and I think the quality of the food has declined over the years, especially in relation to the prices.  That said, the regular pane e vino salad is quite good.  The grilled polenta appetizer is also good, because the sauce is awesome (the scallops are not fresh -- but I would order the dish again just to dip bread in the sauce).  The pastas are ok.  The tiramisu is also good.  On our last visit, the panna cotta had a thick skin on top and bottom and a refrigerator taste that was not very appetizing.

This place is great to just walk in and there is never a wait. Lily did my pedicure with a big smile. I took her picture. She didn't try to sell me other services, she was very quiet and kind.  I felt so bad when she put the shellac on my toenails while she sat on the floor with only a towel to sit on.  I felt her humiliation, there she was sitting under the manicure table applying polish with such precision. Omg I won't get my pedi here any longer. No respect for the hard workers.  I gave her a tip, thank you Lily for the great service. But geez they have to have a better way to apply shellac.

I had heard about Pita Pit from my boyfriend in Texas and was thrilled to find that they had opened a location in my hometown.  I finally had the chance to give it a whirl, and I am absolutely hooked!  The food was fresh, the service was friendly and helpful, and I couldn't believe my pita (Chicken Soulvake [sp?] -- Mediterranean) was only 375 calories!! This is a fantastic place for a healthy, filling meal without sacrificing on quality and taste.  The best part is, it's only a buck or so more than a $5 footlong from Subway, but I'd pick Pita Pit any day!

I came here with friends on a Fri or Sat night b/ Stella and Irene's Cuisine were full.  I couldn't be happier w/our luck.  

I made a meal of starters b/c none of the entrees were really firing me up.  I had the pork cheeks, the gnocchi, and the duck leg confit for a little less than $30.  The food was amazing and I was happy with everything.  The portions were very large (especially the duck).

This is a great choice if you want a change from seafood (though they have seafood as well) without spending a ton of money or waiting behind crowds of people.  Would definitely go back

We ate at the bar on a Friday night, where the extremely charming bartender made us the best Manhattans I've ever had, using Carpano Antica Formula vermouth.  We ordered the lamb meatballs, which were okay, and the spring rolls, which were excellent. 

This is a perfect place to stop for a drink in the Quarter, if you need a nice civilized break.  The drinks were extremely expensive, but well worth it for the occasional night out.

The manager, Eric, could not have been more professional and friendly.  We will definitely go back.

Absolutely, one of the most consistent sushi restaurants in town! Not only are their prices right in line, but the product that they offer is fantastic! We highly recommend any of the sashimi, their eel rolls and rainbow rolls are fantastic! Both my son and I love their house cabbage salad. Small place with easy "to go" system. There is parking in the back and on the street. They definitely know how to do a takeout system during covid highly recommended for all sushi needs! And their sake selection is very good!

I ate here years ago and never made a review. But recently a friend picked up some take-out for us. I had their eggplant parmigiana and my friend had some stuffed shells.

First, their garlic rolls that came with the meal were hard as a rock. The only thing that had flavor with my meal was the sauce. My friend's stuffed shells were small, not that much sauce and didn't taste that great.

If you want real Italian go to Tony's around Newark. They season the water that they boil their noodles in, which gives them flavor.

This place is pretty mediocre. The pricing is generous, along with the serving portions as mentioned by others. I am your basic Chinese takeout eater in the fact that I am satisfied with an egg roll and chicken fried rice. The vegetable egg roll was great! The chicken friend rice was a different story. It really lacked flavor and I'm not a fan of Saffron rice used in making chicken fried rice. I'm a fan of brown basmati/jasmine rice. They use a mixture of both dark and white chicken meat, just fyi. Donuts were yummy, as all breading covered in sugar is. Pretty bummed there's no longer bubble tea here.

After being disappointed at a number of other tire stores, I use McGee now exclusively for new tires.  Unlike some other stores, I have never had to argue with them over warranty's or road hazard.  Reduce 1 star in that I have never had a damaged tire that could be repaired rather than requiring replacement, and explanations sometimes weak.   Staff is friendly and professional, and location is convenient to downtown.   Store recently switched from Goodyear to independent, but still sell Goodyear as well as other brands.  If simple nail in tire might want to check cost to repair elsewhere before McGee tells you it cant be repaired.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We stopped by between a doctor appointment and class and were served quickly.  My son had a quesadilla.  He's been surprised to get cheddar cheese instead of queso fresco is chihuahua cheese like he's used to with authentic Mexican food.  It was large but wasn't cut into slices.  He was able to save some for leftovers.  I had the carne asada.  It was okay.  I gave the leftovers to my son; there was plenty of steak, rice and beans left for another meal.  We were excited to have horchata and Mexican coke.  There were a lot of options and pricing was average; we spent about $20.

My wife and I go to this gym when we want to work out and are on that side of town. It is always clean and fresh unlike some of the other local gyms. Love the up to date equipment. Owner and trainer will help you with any questions that you might have with the equipment.

Another great feature of the gym is the Fitness On Request.  You can do just about any type of class that you would like, any time you would like without having all the other people around if you are not comfortable with your skill level.

If we lived on that side of town we would go every day.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Snazzy bar/eatery just outside of the hotel lobby. 

It was fairly busy when we got here and I think they only had two servers in the seating area. They were hustling. Despite being busy, service was friendly and timely. Good selection of beer and apps....along with food too. I went with a bottle of Yards Pale Ale, my wife a wine.  We ordered the pretzel bites and they were tasty. They brought us out a huge cup of nuts/cocktail mix as well. Nice touch. Prices weren't too bad, but it is a bit pricey since you are in the hotel. 

All in all, a good choice if you're looking for something right inside the hotel.

Decent food. Portion size is small. A little over priced, but decent service. Every time my husband and I sit at the sushi bar we usually connect really well with the sushi chefs. They are normally very informative and personable, which is why we sit at the sushi bar every time we go. Wish the portion size was a little bigger for the price we pay - meaning the $12 and up rolls. Other than that, it's probably the best sushi place to go to on the east side of Tucson seeing that there isn't much of a selection on the east side of town.

Your average neighborhood car wash.

Full contact brushwork here, so the car gets a good cleaning.  Various price levels from $5 to around $15.  No hand drying by staff in the day I went - don't think it's offered here.  

Big plus to me was the free vacuum.  You can use it as long as you want, and there's trash cans to boot.  You could detail the interior with armor all there and throw out all your trash and re-vacuum areas that need special care. (Florida beach sand anyone??)

Wasn't a long line and the purchasing is automated.

It's Starbucks - if you haven't heard of this place, congratulations. You're a Bona Fide hermit!

That said, this location had confusing signage and ordering.  I know they had more options to choose from, but they had a small board with small cross-section of selections.

Also, the Carmel Macchiato I ordered didn't taste very strong at all.  The get a better coffee at Dunkin' Donuts, and it's cheaper.

For the amount of people working there it seemed like only 1 was truly making the coffees, so it took forever.

Gonna pass on this location in the future...

I'd been driven my past these folks for 1/2 a year and decided to use them to clean a suit and shirt for an upcoming wedding.

Decent hours - can pick up your dry cleaning until about 7pm most days.  Turn-around time is about a day and a half.  I dropped clothing off on a Thursday morning and was told it'd be done Friday by 6pm.  It was ready on time.

The cleaning facility seems to be off-site, so hence the time delay.  No matter if you plan ahead or aren't in a rush.  Price was good, too.  For a suit and dress shirt it was under $20.

They do alterations and repairs as well, and open early so you can drop off your items on your way to work.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Ooof. You know, it really hard to rate a fast food resteraunt because they're all the same and I have low expectations at them all. However this Wendy's is horrible, like I would rather eat a can of spaghettios than go here. 

The woman behind the counter is clearly under the influence every time I come in. And she struggles using the cash register. The drink machine is consistently broken and sprays you as you get your drink. The food comes pretty quick but you are lucky to get your actual meal. I would avoid this place st all cost if possible.

Generally not too clean. Customer service is great though! Heather especially stands out. Things seem to run pretty good. I wish they had a soda machine, the bottle of water they sell don't taste all that well. We did put in a request and they did as we asked, which was completely awesome! We go here a few times a week with friends and the kids. At times its really busy so theres not anywhere to sit in the small place. We do appreciate that they kept the graham cracker and they always cut us a fresh banana. Ill be back, as I come every week for family time.

Not your friendliest Starbucks employees. The wait for the drive thru was Long so I decided to go inside for faster service. Unfortunately they're so focused on fulfilling the drive thru orders they ignore the patrons who come inside. I was literally the only person in line and it took me 20+ minutes to get a coffee. While waiting for my coffee I decided to get a bottled beverage but no one even bothered to turn around to ring me out so after standing there like an idiot for 10 minutes I decided to eff it and just leave. 

3 our of 4 times I've been there my orders were incorrect so it's probably best you triple check it before you leave.

Cesar dressing tastes fresh, thicker in consistency. Very flavorful, tastes like they made it from scratch. There was definitely a lot of garlic in it so if you're not a garlic lover, watch out.  Polite staff, but our server jolynn definitely made a great and welcoming experience for us. 

Half priced wine on mondays $100 and under counts. Lots of great selections.

They do not skimp on the scallops! Amazing. Cooked to perfection. 

Pasta sauce very fresh. And allow substitutions and add ons.  Would highly recommend this place to eat. 

Says 2 dollar signs but I would say this is more on the 3 dollar sign list. Thank you!!

Meh, it was ok.  The place was clean.  The servers on the cafeteria line were friendly and helpful.  The mashed potatoes were a mix, which was disappointing. The meat dishes were good, but not great.  I thought it was going to be super cheap, but not really. It worked out to $26 for 2 meat dishes, 4 sides, 2 desserts, and 2 sodas. Which is an average price, but not cheap, as I was lead to believe they would be.  I would not complain about the price, had the food been better.  There was nothing I felt I needed to return for.  We will not be going back.

My friend suggested we go here for dinner.  This place has been around forever, yet I haven't been there  in years.    Walked in around 7 on Saturday, they were busy, but still had availability at the bar and tables.   We sat at a high top in the bar area.  Started out with some cocktails, & the Tuscan Plate app, which was very good.   The had the prosciutto chicken, with mashed potatoes & asparagus.  It was a large portion & very good.  I took half home.  My friend had the filet, mashed potatoes & spinach.  She said it was very good.   I'm glad we went, because now I have another good place to eat, that's close to home.

I have often visited their location in NW Reno, but working in the other side of town meant only getting their food on the weekends. I was really excited to see they opened this one so close to my work.
The food is really tasty and if you are dining in, you can ask for chips and salsa free of charge.
if you are unsure what to get, go with the carne asada tacos, or if you want to share with someone, go for the carne asada fries!! so yummy!
the breakfast is really good, I had the chorizo and eggs plate, very filling with rice and beans and tortillas on the side.

This is only the second time here, but since it is close to our house we went tonight. Well, we like the decor better than most; however, the service is not as good here. Regarding the food today, we found the rice to be greasy and then the guacamole was totally flat with no taste and it seemed old like it was not fresh. We are not sure how soon we will return. Our server did ask twice how things were and we mentioned both, but no courtesy correction was offered. We know other establishments who would have done so.

The resturant looks nice. Good size menu with choices  for everyone. We started with a brie quesadilla and salsa that came with it -- not a fiesta for me. Then the fried zucchini would have been nice if not so much breading. Now on to my chicken parm - threw me off when asked if i want, rice, potaoes, or pasta with it. Pasta won - duh. The sauce on chicken parm was spicy in an unfamiliar way for me.

The staff was extremely nice and accommodating.  I do not see us returning for dinner, but the appetizer menu in bar may get us back for cocktails.

I used to love this place, but I think they've changed ownership or something. Food is ok. but staff is inconsistent and many times disinterested. The last couple of times I've been there, they've been training new people and they put the absolute worst guy in as cashier.

Also -- it's worth noting that I recently found a Blue Coast charge on my bill that didn't match the receipt I received. Perhaps somebody accidentally calculated/inputted my tip wrong? Never had it happen before, but I suppose it's possible.

My husband and I used to love going to Amis in the city, so when one opened up on the Mainline, we were so excited!
The outdoor area is absolutely gorgeous, and the lights make it a wonderful place to walk around at night. 
The food was pretty much the same that's at the Amis in the city, which was great! 
There were little things that kept this from being the  perfect night out though. The bread with our ricotta was impossible to tear and the pizza was light on toppings that weren't really spread out on the pie. The waitress was nice but service was so so slow. 
Not a bad addition though to the Mainline!

Check in was a little goofy, but we figured it out finally. My husband has Roman numerals after his name which thru off the computer & the desk clerks. LOL
The room was wonderful. Nice sized suite. It did take a while to cool our room down, but we finally got it cooled off. 
The hall & elevators are a completely different bird. Our hall by the elevator smelled like something died there. The hall temperature ran at least 75-80 degrees. The elevator temperature was even warmer than that. 
I would recommend this hotel. They really take care of their patrons. Marriott does a good job. And the price isn't too bad.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This is my family's go-to spot when we want takeout/quick sushi at home, rather than going out to dine anywhere. For that purpose, it does it's job.  The specialty rolls are versatile and tasty.  The price, however, is a little steep for the value.  There are many other places that have the same quality and quantity at a more affordable price.

I've never dined in, but from my on the phone orders and pick-ups, the staff is very friendly and accommodating.  If you flip through the local papers, you will be sure to find a 15% off coupon!

Dropped in for a late late lunch today. Was greeted as I walked in. Ordered the usual cold-cut combo, which happens to be on sale for $2, wow, fantastic deal. The sign for their $3 breakfast combo says all day, then a tiny sign beside it says until 1130 only, confusing. 

Panoramic corner view here, and hanging planters along the walls for that garden look. Small TV screen in an upper corner a bit difficult to watch. Rock music on the radio.
A few people came in on this lazy Sunday afternoon. They are still the Sub kings after all these years, a winning formula.

First time here last Sunday around 2. Few people were there, may be different on weekdays. They checked out my number, then made me sign a roster since my home gym is the St Pete location. Never had to sign when visiting other locations across Florida.  

Huge parking lot on north side of quiet strip mall, on a side street that's a delight to get in and out of. US 19 overpass across the street so hop on the highway immediately.

 This gym is just as big as the main one in St Pete, long rows of treadmills and stationary bicycles flanked by other equipment. Large weightlifting area. Bathroom was spotless. What, no soap? I can live with that.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Dropped in yesterday, not my first time. Glad they provide a bike rack in back. Wise use of small space, well organized. Sometimes there's line to the door plus the drive-through is busy, yet they keep things moving well. Get their coupons often, just one more reason to keep me coming back. 

Four tables with two chairs each, tightly packed. Bar row seating along south side of panoramic window, where it can get too sunny depending on what time you go. Five wrought-iron tables with chairs outside along drive-through entrance, which usually stay shady and pleasant. Drinks are a buck during the afternoon, enjoy with their delicious jelly donuts.

This has always been my favorite go to sushi
Restaurant. We went Saturday night when they first opened. Maybe they were trying to get rid of yesterday's fish.

I had the sashimi deluxe. The fish was NOT fresh.
The tuna had an odd color to it and the other pieces weren't sushi quality 

We also ordered the charred Octopus which was
So chewy there was nothing to do but spit it out.

We left abruptly having been so turned off.
Jimmy was there and we told the waitress it wasn't fresh. No one came over to talk to us.

When we arrived around 1:30pm, there was no one here. No customers in this place at all so we got a little skeptical. We were pleasantly surprised however. Staff was friendly and food was delicious. They told us about the all you can eat sushi that is prepared fresh each time you need another plate. My friend thoroughly enjoyed her food as well did I. It looked so good that we forgot to take pictures and dove right in. I would recommend trying this place out if you are in the area and looking for good sushi.

So they have a good selection of frames. 
They act like they are doing you a favor when they mention a promo or a discount you can get. Oh you brought your own frames, you can get 25% off the lenses. Why jack the prices up just so you can seem like you are giving a discount. 

Make sure you get a time line before you pay for anything. Just dropped off frames to get new lenses in. Went through everything paid etc then was told ok see you in 10 days. How does it take 10 days to do lenses in house

Should have got me elsewhere where it literally takes an hour
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Bought a large sausage & bacon pizza. This place,so far,has the 2nd best tasting pizza in St Louis.Faraci's on South Florissant is the best.Angelo's do put more toppings on their pizza than Faraci's but Angelo's sauce has a slight cheddar cheese taste.Faraci's sauce has wine in theirs and you can taste it! I paid $18 and change.The large pizza fed me & my girl for 2 days.They share a front parking lot with 2 barbershops but there is an additional lot on the side but towards the back of the buildings.I called my order in on a Friday night and they told me it will take 30 minutes.I will return,I want to try a few more of their culinary delights!

We needed to grab something quick to eat and this McDonald's was close by. I wish we hadn't stopped. We each got the Quarter Pounder and fries combo. The buns on the burgers were horribly stale. The meat tasted like it had been cooked the day before. The burgers were missing the condiments on them. The fries were cold and not seasoned. It really seems like the franchise owner of this McDonald's doesn't care at all about quality, or is trying to cut corners to pinch pennies. The only reason it gets one star is the staff were friendly.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I started shopping at this Basha's after I moved to this side of town. Frankly, it's a really good store. Some of the prices (meat, deli) can get a little high, so it's important to watch for sales and coupons. Their wine selection is okay, not great, but it'll do in a pinch. What makes me a fan is the customer service. They have some great people working there. Always willing to help, they remember you from past visits and engage is great chit chats. I'm really a fan of the people there. Give them a try, like I said, they do remember their regulars.

Tampa has a large selection of quality sushi restaurants; Yoko's is at the top of the list. Very large selection to fulfill the crave. Service is consistently pleasant and efficient. Prices are reasonable and atmosphere is inviting. Great social spot. Always a great experience.  Take-out is just as good as dine-in as far as quantity and presentation.
Later review: attempted to order via phone. Was placed on hold (phone receiver was on counter) for fifteen minutes while hostess and other employees socialized. Missed my window for takeout since we had later plans. Very disappointed. Tried to call back but just tone.

I have been taking cars to dobbs for years. In the past year or so the service has declined severely. I took my car here for an issue with it starting and they misdiagnosed the problem and charged me 124 dollars for a diagnosis that was wrong. It's sad that this chain is going down hill they used to be the place to go but now they are just basically the McDonalds of car service- they get the job done but always fall short. Won't be taking my or my families cars here again (we have been taking our 6 cars here for years).
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Ok so first off I ordered two Sonoran hot dogs, thankfully guy took my order wrong and only one came. Took one bite...don't know what the hoopla is all about. I had two carne Asada tacos which brought this review up to 3 stars. Also had an order of chips and well they are those store bought la mission type chips. My two daughters had the burrito Jr. Adding beans for an additional .50. They ate them right up. And before anyone says maybe this style hot dogs is not my cup of tea, I've been having these "Sonoran" style hot dogs in Mexico all my life.

In short: This is a hole in the wall, all you can eat sushi joint with an okay selection. The staff are efficient and friendly. The place is clean and tidy. 

Gyoza here is not served steamed, but flash fried, which wasn't very good. Shrimp tempura were strangely over battered. (Presumably the frozen variety, heated up.) That aside, notable special rolls to try out are the Tiger and Rainbow. Both were the two best dishes of the night. 

Sashimi offerings were mostly limited to mediocre white fish. Slightly disappointing considering the dinner price point, but not surprising. 

Mediocre experience overall.

Stopped in here to try one of the famous hand grenades. The grenades are $10 and if you save your souvenir grenade cup you get $9 refills. $1 off why not! 

This place was pretty packed and believe it or not the bartender was on her s*%t! Very tight and not much space to move. 

The hand grenades are pre-made frozen or on the rocks like all the other Nawlins famous drinks are. 

It's a nice chill spot but if your looking for more of a club or lounge type seen with live music, this is not the place. The drinks are always good though.

The hand grenade you must give it a try, it creeps up on you.

Good ol' Starbucks! I have been visiting this location a lot lately because i have been studying a lot and needed some quiet time and the aroma of coffee circulating through my nostrils. 

I never seem to run into an issue with anything here. They have WiFi and tons of seating. All the outlets work properly and are equally spaced amongst the tables. 

I'm giving Starbucks 3 stars because every Starbucks I have visited does not recycle or display any type of blue can or triangle saying we recycle. A multi billion dollar company such as Starbucks should consider recycling and it is crucial for the environment.

I can't imagine how anyone could be happy leaving this place. The old adage, you get what you paid for does not apply here. I paid $62 for a full set manicure and a pedicure and where do I begin with what went wrong... One my big toe, the salon worker left excess polish on the side of my toe. On my fingers, there was excess glue and gel.  When I asked the guy if there was anything he had to get it off, he said to just use a brush when I get home. Two of my fingers were left bleeding and one finger had skin hanging by the nail bed. I will never come here to get my nails done. If I could give this place negative stars I would.

Ambiance is okay, but bathroom is pretty nasty. Service is fine. 

Price value is ridiculous. Maybe because it's Nashville and there aren't a plethora of Japanese restaurants but this place would hands down lose in Chicago. 

Udon is $11! For a normal very bland portion. Also only had fishcakes and seaweed- very minimal additions. Tempura shrimp average. 

Saving grace is def the sushi rice- very very nice.

We also got the 11 course meal- more like just a bunch of appetizers. Beef rolls in scallion- good but pretty salty. Salad rolls-good. Beef tenders- not flavorful. Sauté mushrooms good. Sushi and sashimi good.

Sometime in early 2016 the Merchantville Diner changed owners. Since then the overall quality of the food, portion sizes, timely service and general atmosphere of the place has sadly gone downhill. Also the prices have gone up. What was once a hidden gem and nice old school diner with a unique charm and above-average food has become just another commonplace cookie-cutter type eatery. Go to the Cherry Hill Diner on Rte 38 at Cooper Landing instead they're open 24/7 and remain a genuine NJ style Diner with the food quality and service we've come to expect.

This bar was ok. Nothing like I was expecting lol. It was kind of calm when we were in there. The bartenders were very friendly and let me get on the bar and get my picture taken, Happy hour was nice since beers were half price. I just didn't like the fact that we had to buy shots. My friend doesn't do shots so I had to do both of them and for 2 beers and 2 shots, it cost us $30. Kind of expensive for my taste. I prefer just to drink a few beers and chill out. We will go back the next time we are in town though, just be prepared for shots whether you want them or not. lol

Personally I loved everything I ordered! My husband enjoyed the meal but didn't love it. 

We got the lunch special which was 11 bucks and got 3 tacos and a chopped salad. 

Tacos

Miso cod: amazing! Perfect Asian taco! Cod was cooked perfectly too.

Baja: again cod, but fried with slaw. Delish.

Chicken chorizo: very spicy in a good way, but not my favorite. 

I got all mine on lettuce to be healthy and I was still full! The salad was the perfect amount and packed with flavor. Cheeses, sliced beets, tortillas and vinaigrette. Awesome! 
Wish my whole party

I have nothing but good things to say about Banfield. Not only could I get my Husky pupp Ra'Ra seen same day, but they took great care of her and explaining everything--process, cost, and next steps. Even when I hit a financial snag we were able to work through a treatment that we could afford and set up plans for her next visits. The location is so clean, open, and spacious and everyone we encountered were so nice and informative. The wellness plans they have fit our needs exactly and I'm so glad we found Ra'Ra her forever doctors from Pupp on up!

A fantastic meal tonight - everything was delicious, from the gorgeous cheese and meat board (truffle honey, burrata, grilled bread, prosciutto and then some) to the amped up Caesar salad to gemelli with sausage and chills to the fish and the brussel sprouts.  Honestly hard to pick a favorite dish, everything delivered and then some. 

The service was super courteous, attentive, friendly and helpful.  Vibe is very cool (gorgeous space) but warm and welcoming.  Great wine list.  

Can't wait to come back, a lot of things we still want to try (starting with that black spaghetti and the blueberry lasagne!).

Jefferson's is best summed up as a hometown Buffalo Wild Wings. Lots of tvs, excellent wings and family friendly. We took the family here a few days ago. The food was excellent and the service was good. 

We started with an order of their boneless wings. We opted for a sweet Asian flavor with ranch. It was terrific. Sweet, with a mild heat. Even my wife, who is very adverse to hot foods, enjoyed them. 

I had a burger and fries. It was really good. My wife had the chicken bacon ranch wrap -- also very good. The ranch is homemade, which I love!

All in all, I highly recommend the place. We will definitely be back.

This is the best burger in St Louis... Hands down! Shake that! Smash this... Nothing close. Start with better beef, get a better burger! 

I took away one star cause the dining room leaves a little to be desired. The large table in the center has fixed seats that reduce seating versus a bench or chairs. You also have to get up and put in your own order, then pick it up at the window. They can expand their menu by exploring a good hotdog or chicken patty. 

We didn't wait to sit at 6 on a Wednesday... Good was ready promptly, and we were paid a visit by the chef/owner.

The food here is excellent! I was a little put off that our table was sticky and had some crumbs on it. The Bread Service is a little confusing. They didn't serve butter and the olive oil is just left on the table (ours was empty). I asked for butter and Parmesan and that seemed to help. 

I ordered the lasagna and my wife ordered the Alfredo Chicken. Both were delicious. I have enough lasagna to last 2-3 meals! 

I would recommend this place to family and friends looking for Italian food in Edwardsville.  I think a little attention to smaller details like cleanliness and service can help dramatically!

I went in recently for a business lunch with a colleague. 

Our food was excellent. I had the Javelina Chicken Sandwich and he had the New England Seafood Roll. My sandwich was delicious, and his looked better than mine!  I opted for the house salad as a side and the waitresses explained there was an up charge. I agreed and it was well worth it. 

I w/held one star on principle because I was charged for carbonated water from the tap. In my opinion that's totally Busch League. 

UPDATE: I'm calling BS on the owners response. There's not a box of club soda syrup in the back, and you're not getting charged for it.

Ehhhh, I mean, it's Arby's. My expectations aren't high to begin with, but they need to get it together, service-wise. I will say the food is actually good (still fast food, but it's tasty), but it took FOREVER to get our 2 meals & we were the only couple in line. Also, we had to wipe down the table and booth where we sat (most of the tables looked like they needed to be wiped down, as did the condiments counter). Their staff isn't exactly friendly or enthusiastic either. I'd eat there again, but would go through the drive-thru.

I like that Lorenzo's pizza is open late and it is cheap. I think their sauce is very bland tasting and very sweet. I don't like my pizza like that at all. I had a very negative encounter with the security guard who wouldn't let me in because I wanted to use the bathroom as my boyfriend stood in line. He followed me throughout the restaurant and made me leave without letting me use the restroom. He then refused to tell me his name. I find that to be extremely poor customer service. I left without giving my services to Lorenzo's and do not intend to be back. I wish to see a change in employees.

I'm a big fan of sushi. So one thing I don't like, is paying a lot of $ for some basic sushi. Which is what this place offers. 

Now, I'm not saying the sushi is bad. It was good. It's just not worth the price they were charging. This is the type of sushi you would expect at an AYCE sushi place. 

The service was good. It did take quite awhile to get our rolls, and the place wasn't busy. So, I'm not sure what that was about. 

I wouldn't really recommend this place, unless you feel like wasting money on some basic sushi.

Been a while since I'd been to the point but after Alice in Chains Tuesday I needed some grub in the gut to quell the booze/no food routine of the last 4 hrs. 

So yeah I'm buzzed, I order the brat with kraut, buddy gets some sandwich since we don't share I can only speak for my order. Maybe this is the booze talking but the brat was spot on, kraut was not what I was really looking for even though I ordered it. What was I thinking? 

Beer selection good, got something on tap (cant recall, booze) vibe is cool, late nighter crowd paid and burned out. Thanks point, that hit the spot.

So I show up of all days national donut day. I had no clue, what I had was two yutes who wanted donuts so I figured some for them and a few for me. Selection is ok, I agree with the others, why don't you have signs on the donuts? Figured most of them out but had to ask for a few, apple cake is the best of the bunch. Got a half doz, enough to try everything, at a buck/donut not better than Longs. 

I don't eat donuts often, I know what I like, these were just ok imo, place was packed not sure if that was due to donut day or if that's the normal spread. If I was in the area and wanted donuts maybe, but truthfully I doubt it.

We stayed here for a convention. Luckily, we were on the floor that had a fridge; floors 14 and 15 I believe are the only locations that have them. Comfortable beds, clean, quiet, pool was smaller than I thought it would be but no big deal. Overall average hotel. We wanted to stay an extra night but they wouldn't work with us on the price. It seems like they'd rather have a room stay empty than have us pay a lower rate since we'd only be there until around 8am. So, we found a different hotel at a much better rate, and it was a pretty cool place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I keep falling for the Chicken Parmesan and it keeps just being ok.  Somewhat dry with a faint burnt taste.  But the people here are very nice and the atmosphere is cozy and warm.  I really like in the summer when you can sit by the waterfall.  We have also rented their private room for a function and that went very well, if only the menu could be enhanced a little, and one of the most popular items as aforementioned redone... but for now there are a handful of other Italian joints nearby that do Chicken Parmesan better.  Will be back down the road someway, somehow, hope I remember to try something else...

Great service all around. I was referred to Jack Furrier's by another local auto shop that did my oil change. He noticed I had a flat and told me about Jack's right down the road. 

Such a great crew! The men at the desk were very friendly and made jokes and lucky me, the guy working on my car is a Cadillac fan so he definitely new what he was getting himself into when I pulled up. He even noticed whoever put my tires on last year didn't rotate them right and offered to do it for me real quick. He defiantly had my safety in mind. Thanks guys! I shall be back.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I came on a very busy day with an appointment and waited for over 30 minutes so I left-I think it was honestly a simple overlook because they were so busy. I let the owner know and he contacted me personally to apologize and offer to make it up to me. I came back a few days later and was treated so well-you could tell they really felt bad about my previous experience. They offered to let me choose a free service on top of what I needed done. I left feeling extremely happy with my nails and excited to go back for a fill and make this my new regular nail salon. Worth checking out!

I've been going to Great Wall for years.  I think the husband and wife there are the nicest people, always pleasant and friendly.  I don't eat  in the dining room because I don't like the smell of the fryers, but that's not a knock on them (I'm just weird that way).  So always take out and you won't be disappointed.  Ingredients seem fresh and food is cooked well.  General Tso's is my pick.  Also get the boneless spare ribs, which are actual ribs that they cut the meat from the bone into long strips.  Very good without the mess.  You get a cold can of soda with each take out combo too.

I probably come to Snap once a week. I get the Kraisin Salad and add chicken to it. I love this place, the ingredients are so fresh! The pizza is delicious too. Honestly, there is something about personal pizza's made to order, fresh in front of your eyes, that I love. 

I always take my food to go, It gets packed in there. I'm not one for small crowded places.
I think they have some kinks to work out. I always see new people working who don't know the menu well and my salad has been messed up a couple of times.  Way too many cooks in the kitchen. 

Otherwise, I'll be back!

This place was crazy in a bad way. I came here for lunch during the week and experienced several problems even though the restaurant was relatively empty. To start the wait time was excessive for both the salads and the sushi. When the sushi arrived nearly 25-30 minutes after ordering the order was incorrect and parts of the fish used were frozen. Additionally the service was terrible I wasn't even given the opportunity to talk to the waiter about the incorrect order because they 1 never came back to check and 2 didn't even look back over to our table which seemed intentional. Will not come back here again.

I feel blessed to have randomly discovered this restaurant! Good Mexican food is hard to come by in the Philly area and La Guera really hits the spot. The tacos here are made the way they should be: onions, cilantro, meat and nothing else. The steak tacos are good, the al pastor tacos are good, the chicken tacos are good...everything is good! When dining in, the chips and two salsas they give you are good enough to be a meal in themselves. I'm constantly trying to think of excuses to go to Upper Darby so I can eat here.

I'm surprised that this Wine & Spirits location has such a low rating. It has a much better selection than most Wine & Spirits stores, particularly the one in Manyunk. The Chairman's Selection wines are always exceptional wines and are usually discounted by about $10 (I always thought the stated discounts were exaggerated but when I look up them up, the retail prices are as high as stated). 

The only downside is that, like everything on City Ave, it's annoying to get to due to traffic. Despite that, this will forever be my go-to wine store as long as I live in this area.

Just don't get it. I tried several flavors, but went back to a basic as I do not like cucumber and cricket ice cream. OK...I'm just kidding, but some of the flavors are meant to appeal to the Instagram/Snapchat crowd. "OMG...you won't believe the flavor combo ice cream I am having! It is SO ON FLEEK!" Some day they, too, will grow up. Overpriced and over-hyped. I would have been just as satisfied with a half-gallon of Edy's butter pecan - at a third of the price. But that would not have the cool factor of a selfie with your BFF and your tri-flavored sundae with extra bitter chocolate ranch sauce...

The view was amazing. The drinks were on point. However the food and service was disappointing. Ordered the seafood linguine and my boyfriend the ravioli bolognese. The linguine was so bland and the ravioli's were chef Boyardee like. The server never came to ask how everything was until the end. Only then was I asked if i wanted something else when everyone was finished. We both should have just ordered the mushroom ravioli's like everyone else as that was the only good item served. I do thank the server for removing the linguine off our tab. Will likely not go back.

I was a loyal customer to this location from 2007-2010ish, I since then relocated so haven't been around. Today I was in the neighborhood so decided to stop by to what I thought was the best nail salon. Boy do times change. I went in for a refill and designs. I remembered designs used to be free, not anymore which is understandable... but the salon wanted to charge me $7 EACH for regular designs, which meant $70 total for all fingers. That would make my simple refill total at $110 at a cash only nail salon. No thank you! Besides extreme pricing the staff was very rushed and unfriendly, will not try again.

Don Juan is the man. Wether you want just a trim or a full on cut, Juan takes his time to make sure your cut is expertly done and fits your needs. That is not to say he is slow. He performs all his work in a timely manner. I just got my bi-weekly trim up and my face shaved with the straight razor and I couldn't be happier with the results, as usual. The price ($25.00 for a cut and full face shave) is amazingly affordable. The staff is friendly and knowledge and the environment is fun. I recommend Don Juan's Barbershop to all of my friends and coworkers.

The beds are comfy. If you have kids there is an indoor pool. The overall appearance when you enter is good, but beware this is not a clean hotel. It did not live up to Marriott name. Toothpaste on the wallpaper in multiple locations, a "brown spot" behind the toilet paper roll, a bug on the floor near the kitchen, stained pillows on the in room sofa, frayed rug in the room in multiple places, moldy grout, and a dirty toilet seat on arrival is not the typical Marriott way. The beds were clean and the AC worked, but don't pay a lot for this small room!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The dirty appearance of the floor and food line was a turn off for me. The floors mats have a ton of food debris on them. I am stepping on chips under my table as I type. The subs were OK. The servuce was not friendly. They dont have napkins available in restaurant and when I asked cashier for napkin she insisted three times that they were rolled up in my bag.
