I said no napkins again and anoyher customer commented that I just need napkins. That is crazy...no napkins out by other cup and condiment items?? Cleanliness gets a 1, service gets a 2, food gets a 3.

At this location their debit machine has been broken for a week and does not accept tap. 

The worker was pretty flippant in telling me that their machine was unable to take tap. I asked politely if there was any way to use another machine and he said yes "but I don't want to go back there to it."

Given everything going on with cleanliness, and this workers rude approach, I left the location. 

Hopefully they can remedy the machine and help their teams approach. I can be empathetic that some people were likely less kind than I was but it was still sadly a poor experience.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have had 3 meals at Moscato's and will continue to visit.  My last visit was a bit disappointing only because of the server.  Dinner with my girlfriend and daughter.  The server brought out my dinner and my girlfriends, but not my daughters mini pizza.  She said she would be back with it.  We waited and waited.  Saw the server at other tables, but still no mini pizza.  We had to ask another server to check for us.  By this time our meals were cold.  This is one thing that really bothers me.  I'm not going to start eating while my daughter looks on.   Work on your servers for excellent ratings.  Otherwise we've always enjoyed our visit.

So I have been a LONG time customer-that ended today. I called to inquire if the pizza dough contained egg or soy as my son was recently diagnosed to serious food allergies and we must avoid these allergies. The female identifies herself on the manager and says she can't be sure it doesn't but maybe it does or doesn't and says well if his allergies are serious to soy then goes silent.....I finally say are you trying to just tell me you don't want our business? She doesn't respond. No problem! Heard loud and clear-JERKS!!!!!!!!!!

This is a solid pizza all around. Pizza is life for me so I can be more critical with it than other foods.  I ordered both the large Sicilian plan cheese and large pepperoni pizza when we had some friends over.  I liked that the offer the Sicilian bc you don't see that often.  It was a good change of pace.  Overall the pizza was good.  Had a nice crisp crust and soft dough.  Would've liked more sauce on it, but that's just a personal preference.  I know for next time to ask for it.  They also always seemingly have coupons for a buck or two off which is never a bad thing.  

Overall, solid pizza that I will get again

One of the best places. You better make a reservation though. It's small and cozy. 

I've been here a few times and the different types of squash soup are always my favorites. 

Most recently we went for restaurant week. I got trout and my wife got chicken. Normally I choose the better meal but her chicken was so F***'n good!

And that is not to say that my meal wasn't also excellent. In fact better than most places. 

Some places like to short you and give you less for restaurant week but not Pumpkin. We left full and happy. 

So if you haven't tried it yet but it's on your list I suggest moving it to the top.

My husband and I had just got done hiking Table Rock and we were STARVING! We were on our way to Tasso and stumbled across Alias. We were so happy that we did!

I ordered the turkey, bacon, cheese and tomato cream cheese, everything bagel and it was DELICIOUS!!! 

The prices were pretty affordable and competitive compared to the surrounding sandwich and coffee shops in downtown Boise.

$7.90 for a stacked bagel sandwich! $9 for the bagel sandwich, chips and a medium drink. Not too shabby!

The two girls upfront were super friendly and helpful! :-)

Totally recommend!

Cutest sushi place ever. The interior is very nice and clean with beautiful open windows for optimal lighting, feels very open and bright. 

The food is very fresh and light. My friends and I ordered spicy ramen, katsu and sushi. The nigiri was fresh and the California rolls didn't feel cheaply made. My friends really enjoyed their food! 

You get free miso (unlimited too!), edamame and a cute yogurt probiotic drink as a dessert. Nice little touches. 

The cook and waitress (assuming they're a couple) were very quiet but sweet. Always smiling. I'll definitely come again!

We stopped by The Refinery yesterday for a burger. It was our first time there and won't be our last as we really enjoyed our food. Both of us got the house burger and I got a side salad with mine. The house burger had bacon, tomato jam, white cheddar, and garlic aioli on a fresh baked bun. The burger did not disappoint.  It was cooked perfectly and was very juicy. The flavors were all nicely balanced. We both really enjoyed our meal. The place itself is unique and feels like it was an old house of some sort. Cool location and great food. Worth checking out.

We needed a better Mexican option in this neighborhood.  Menu is extremely limited but affordable.  I have ordered twice from here.  Guacamole and chips is great, can be made not spicy for kids.  Carne asada and al pastor tacos are so delicious that you could eat all three if you didn't pay attention.  They serve the tacos with a grilled onion garnish, which is very different but excellent.  I think their nachos are meant for sharing because you get a mountain of crispy tortilla chips smothered with meat, cheese, jalapeños, etc.  It is absolutely amazing how even the last chip is crispy.

Why does this Kroger make me feel like the aisles are closing in on me? It's like they are taller and more narrow than standard grocery store aisles. The plus side, it seems to have a wide selection in a smaller space, but the anxiety is a bit much. Still, I'll put up with it for those fuel points! 

Also, strong recommend on Rebel Fish maple salmon. Everyone should have Rebel Fish for dinner at some point in their lives. No exaggeration. It's available just off to the side of the fish area of the deli in an open refrigerator case.

I appreciate people who may be inclined to get "original tart" or "Tahitian vanilla" however, they should be aware that unless they lack taste-buds they will end up over paying by adding weight in the form of toppings, which Huddles has no shortage of. That being said, there are plenty of amazing flavors available that only need one or two additional choice toppings to be taken to the next level! My choice was pecan praline - saving precious weight by skipping the pecan toppings. Huddled was a nice treat to enjoy while walking the Monon.

A great gym worth it's price. If I checked in as often as I'm here I'd certainly be a regular- perhaps that's why I quickly noticed when the morning employee schedule changed. While the new morning guy is decent, he's just not as friendly as the girl before him. Wherever she is- bring her back. Also, for a Planet Fitness they really don't use their lunk alarm as often as they could. Ultimately though, thanks to this Planet Fitness I've been able to run over 350 miles this year so far, with more planned. It's a strong recommend- as long as you don't crowd the gym while I'm there.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Unfortunately our dining experience was very disappointing.  Starting with a less than clean table, uninterested server and a ridiculous up-charge for side dishes.  The veal was very good, $26, but my only choice of side was spaghetti with marinara,  so I paid the $4 extra for broccoli.  My date ordered the Ciopino, $39 entree.  Never a disappointment until last night :  poor sauce, oversized chunks of whole tomatoes, limited selection of seafood and pasta was over cooked and mushy.  After over 25 years of great dining at Bazil's I hope they can go back to what was once excellent food and service.

We booked that afternoon to check in after 9 pm that night for a UCSB tour at 9 the following morning.

Since we were just looking for hot showers and clean beds we thought we would try the infamous Motel 6.

Very cramped and Spartan for about $100 on a Thursday night.  No shampoo, hair dryer or Kleenex.
 
The shower had a decent spray and enough hot water so that was probably the best feature of Motel 6. 

Towels were tiny and thin, smelling strongly of bleach, so I assume they were clean.  The mattress was not very comfortable.  A little lumpy.  Hard to sleep because of motorcycle noise from the road.

Definitely not my first choice
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I love to support local businesses and love Mexican.   The first time was takeout and my food was excellent and food fresh.  Second time, we choose to dine in and Quesa birilia taco preparation was not the same and we were all disappointed with our tacos and nachos.  I made the waitress aware, she seemed clueless as to what to say.  We paid and left.  

I am posting pictures from my first takeout, again, the better experience.  

I may try to go back again but definitely disappointed with the lack of consistency with food and honestly service was lacking.

We entered Cancun around 3pm on a weekday. There was only one other table sitting. Our service was prompt and the waitress was friendly. The food was mediocre. I found my burrito to be rather bland and really lacking flavor. My son enjoyed his chimichanga even though he found it spicy.  I ask my boys to skip the usual kid fair on the menus and go for the more authentic dishes when dining out, so they are able to try new and different foods.. My younger son ordered a mexican pizza. We were disappointed when what looked like a microwaveable pepperoni pizza came out for him.

One of the worst experiences I've had at a Bertuccis.   Last time I was here.  Food was amazing and service was great.   This time.  Food was bland   Service was awful.  No one even was available to seat us when we walked in!   Then our server/hostess. Took our drink order.  Then our rolls came and we finished them and still no drinks.  Then she came and took order with salads.  Finally drinks come about 15-20 min later then salads came.  1 min later entrees came out after salads just came out with our garlic knots.  A manager apologized but yet server really didn't care.  Thanks Bertuccis for a bad experience.

Aka St. Marys Mexican Food. 

This place has Mexico written all over it right when you pull into the driveway. 

The food is excellent, must try the mini chimis, the tacos, toastada. There appears to be a mother and son running the place with the mother doing a majority of the cooking and the son taking the orders, but he helps when not taking orders. When I was here there were 5 groups including us, that gets a little line building up and one person/group may be waiting for a few moments. Other than that, definitely worth a try!

Cheers!

Excellent food and large portions. The oldest Italian restaurant in the United Staes founded in 1900 and operated by the same family. We went for lunch and the restaurant was not too crowded, but the server was not the best. Very casual, did not even give us his and and never check on us during the meal. I can understand this if it was dinner and the place was packed, but it was not. Luckily another server was there and glad to assist us. This poor service will not scare me away, and we will be back because the food is Sooooo good and the portions are huge!!

I have eaten in once here and have gotten delivery. Delivery has been prompt and yummy. But, I definitely perfer eating there. Their presentations are amazing! Mini umbrellas are always awsome. Service was great, I don't think my water was more than three sips in before it was refreshed.

I am kinda lame when it comes to sushi -so I can't comment on anything too "crazy". My favorite is Cali roll and sweet.potato roll. Both of them are excellent. I also like how they don't put too much rice on the roll. I want to taste the insides more!

I stayed here as part of wedding block fo rooms and it was a pretty standard hotel stay. It was a relatively central location between airport and venue that the wedding was at. 
The rooms were fine, the beds were fine. It was fine.
The parking situation was not well marked or defined, but there was a parking structure so at least you won't have to pay for parking. 
There were some hiccups when it came to checking out and I had to call afterword to speak to them and they were less then assuring in trying to make sure my card did not get charged twice. 
All in all...it was an OK stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
For Booth's Corner I consider Massimo's fine dining..LOL!! We love this place, the pizza isn't the best you will have in your lifetime but it is seriously good!!! CHEAP and GOOD!!! Always consistent slices and finally had their fries and the combo reminded me of back in the day when you were at your public pool! 

On our visits our service has always been friendly, not over engaging but friendly and fast! This is perfect because you're at Booth's Corner to get a quick fill, shop and watch all the strange Delconian's that you never imagined existed in Delco!!! Whenever we go...we eat at Massimo's!!!!

I had the fried chicken tacos here... to go.

They were good, full hearty pieces of meat good ingredients. Tasted good. 

My girlfriend wanted to get Nachos with Guac, I wanted Nachos and cheese. They would not sell just the cheese I had to get another serving of chips at 4-5$ a piece.  
Get out of here, you can sell me a side of cheese.  
Interior felt cold and uninviting. It was kinda of a bizarre environment to be in. I would give them one shot to redeem themselves. Seemed like a family owned place. They were friendly.

We stayed here for UCSB commencement.  Never again.  Thread bare towels, tepid shower water, no soap and the shampoo was in the same packaging as ketchup condiments at Jack in the Box.  No lamps, just ceiling mounted Spotlights.  Tile floors with no rug.  Honestly, I've stayed in better motels in Tijuana than this.  And to top it off, $200 a night!  Folks, I stayed at the Rome Hilton for less than that!  Truthfully though, I wouldn't have stayed here any other time, but Santa Barbara was full because of commencement.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
AVOID!!!

I thought about giving this place 2 stars since the food was edible, but why??  When there are many, many other places to get better Mexican food.

5pm on a Saturday night, not a single other booth occupied.  Only ones there (I wonder why).  Still, it's a free dinner, why not?

Place felt dingy and dirty.  No atmosphere at all.  

Chicken fajita was covered in this weird red sauce.  Again, edible, but not memorable at all.  Small portions, odd flavors, and just overall strange vibes.

Go to Jalapeno's on Franklin or even Café Ole.  You'll thank me.

When I went out to get my car, it was completely dead and had been left unlocked. I went back in to tell the guy that checked me out and all he said was "well, not sure what could have done that." I have a battery that is less than 2 years old and I'm confident the battery didn't die from something that I did. I can understand these things happen sometimes, however, I wasn't even offered an apology. A simple apology could have gone a long way. I have always had great experiences at every other Dobbs, but I will not be back to this one.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Actually closer to a 4.5 star. 

It's kind of like a DIY hotpot style where you customize what you want to go in and they cook it in a broth and it comes out like a soup, if you add noodles it's like a customizable noodle soup with hotpot ingredients. The spice levels here are all one level spicier than what the menu would imply, so be careful. I would recommend getting 1-2 proteins if you're into that, noodles, and maybe 3-4 veggies and the total comes out to be about 13-15 dollars. The portions are enormous so you don't need too many items. Overall authentic and yummy mala tang.

went to this location for the first time and sad to say they dont stand up to the standards of other subways i went to before.

 i ordered tuna hoagie witj extra lettuce and cheese and it was disappointing. they put a little tuna on the roll and the extra lettuce i asked for was like 10 little shreds of lettuce. there was nothing to this sandwich besides bread.

 i would not come back here ever waste of money. 

the staff were angry and looked like they didnt want to serve customers and the vibe of the place was terrible. i wont be returning.

People are too harsh and critical sometimes. This store is not as bad as people complain. Today, Donna (the district manager) was here to run the place and it all went SMOOTHLY. They worked as a team to get everyone's order done in less than 5 minutes - for dine in specifically. I personally don't enjoy drive thru because it always makes the wait feel longer. The food was good and fresh! Everyone's was pretty friendly (and highly stressed...I would be too). People need to cut them some slack. Try being in their position. If you're in the area, grab a coffee, be patient, smile!

definitely not close to the best sushi in the area, unless you live in West Virginia. then I guess by default it'd be the only sushi restaurant.

ordered a salmon teriyaki box for $20, and, well, it kept me not hungry. way too pricey for the quality of food. the rice tasted like the stuff you get for free from Chinese takeout places. the only positive is that this was the only sushi place available in the area with decent reviews on a sunday afternoon. All the other better restaurants open around 4PM or later, like 1225 Raw.

Recommend if you're stranded in the desert of CC restaurants craving decent sushi.

So I'm gonna give this place five stars. One its in the middle of like no offense, first world problems pa. And I say that with love. But this place is awesome. Really good food for the prices, I live in center city and I can't get this kind of quality food and service for these prices. But haha in Yardley pa you expect that. So Edgewood cafe I will give you those five stars because I think you guys do amazing compared to a lot of other places! Your tuna melts are great! French fries are out of this world! And since my friend and I were nice to our servers it seems like we got really fast awesome service! So keep it up!!!

This is a wonderful neighborhood Italian restaurant.  It's been one of my favorites so you may see earlier reviews from me. However, I was there yesterday for the first time since Sam bought the restaurant and also my first dining out experience since COVID-19.  Caffe Valentino did not disappoint! Al fresco dining with 2 of my girlfriends, Sunday afternoon 3 o'clock dinner. Relaxing and delicious!! BYOB! Our waiter was letting us take our time and also making sure we had everything we needed! It was a delightful experience and I'm so glad it was where we picked for our first time out! I'm sure I'll be back again!!

The best things about this place are the atmosphere and the waitstaff.  I came here with an Italian who was visiting and I was trying to show off...it didn't work. :(  My pasta was hard and slightly overcooked and really overpriced!  Our waitress was the best part of the night.  She was friendly and knew alot about the menu.  Most importantly, they were closing and I never try to make people stay past closing because I know they still have to clean and everything but I really commend her for not ever making us feel rushed.  We left about 20 minutes before they closed.

Imo's was good my first time when I didn't know what to expect, and I splurged and ordered the deluxe toppings. However, the cheese flavors were sickening the second time I tried their pizza when my roommate ordered just cheese...   
I still constantly crave that deluxe style though, hence the high rating. That's what I would recommend for any St. Louis style newbies. When you order a lot of toppings, each slice tends to fall apart because the toppings are too heavy for the breading, but the toppings are what make it delicious since the cheese isn't as overpowering.

I've now stayed in NOLA a few times and this was the worst hotel by miles. The people at the front desk were good enough, but everything else was a disaster. The room layout was horrible, right when you open your door, it's a wall. Doesn't make sense, not sure who designed this. Multiple days we ordered towels, it either came an hour later, or they never brought them. The pool/gym is the highlight, but other then that, don't stay here. Stay down the street at the Intercontinental or if you got the $$$ stay at the Ritz
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I really enjoyed the Refinery's new space...it's open and has a nice patio space. The service was friendly, and the staff was knowledgeable. I love the restaurants farm to table concept, and use of local vendors. The cauliflower creme brûlée was savory and unexpected. This appetizer is definitely worthy of any food network challenge! The meatloaf was good, but a little salty. I think everyone always has an opinion when it comes to meatloaf. I will definitely return - I can't wait to see what comes up on their changing menu!!

Service was great, but TGC is unfortunately your basic local ice cream shop. Ice creams are not made in house, but they do have a wide selection. 

The frozen yogurt selection was quite small, as was the toppings available. The price of the froyo per ounce was also quite expensive. The toppings available were fresh though, which was nice. 

If you're in the area and are craving some ice cream, TGC is perfect. The hours are great for the late night ice cream adventure and they are located in a fun area. However, if you are looking for some speciality ice cream/froyo there are other options available.

I had heard a lot about this place and finally tried it- but honestly I was a little disappointed. Upon seating the bartender was on his phone, and took a second to get to us. We had gotten a cocktail and a "orange blossom lemongrass apricot" with knickerbocker gin and it tasted nothing like it. I tasted only the orange beer he had used- I am familiar with knickerbocker gin and I couldn't even taste a hint of it. The bartender was knowledgeable.. but the drinks were not great. For a casual drink with friends it's not bad- but if you're a fan of different types of gin concoctions, I would not recommend it.

Not impressed at all. We got The Original with the tomato basil soup. The soup was blah (not fresh, microwaved) and my grilled cheese came out burnt. My husband got The Mac & Cheesy, he said it was alright, his was also on the black side. I was expecting more and definitely not a burnt $5 and $7 grilled cheese sandwich. Might try this place one more time but I haven't decided yet.

Update: My 18 month old and I both got food poisoning from this experience!! We were both up all night throwing up and having diarrhea. I will never eat here again and recommend to everyone that you don't try it. It's just not worth it!

I think this has been re-named as a Marble Slab Creamery, but both signs were hanging up inside. No matter what the name is called, the ice cream was amazing! Anytime you can custom make your dessert, you cant go wrong. This was the case here. Over the last couple weeks, I have ate both inside, and had an order to go. The ice cream travelled very well, which pleasantly surprised me. It didn't melt during a 15 minute drive this weekend, with the temperature in the high 80's. Anything I have ever ordered here has been top notch.

This is my favorite coffee place in Philadelphia.  I love supporting independent local cafes especially when the surpass all of the chain cafes.  The coffee is excellent, the staff is friendly and knowledgeable, and the energy and set up of the cafe is perfect for anything from catching up with a friend to studying.  I've done some reading and work on my computer here before and there's no place that rivals the amount of space they have at Menagerie to lay out your laptop/notebook/etc.  

If you want to visit a great cafe while in Philly either as a local or visitor make sure to check this place out.

Unfortunately very disappointing. Obviously the location is prime, but that's all they've got going for them. Service was good room was clean, but the room was super tiny, and empty and not like anything I had seen on the website. Our window looked out into the hall way which was super annoying especially with house keeping coming up and down the hall and slamming a fire door each time. Funny enough, while checking in, we had requested a quieter room. Biggest turn-off was the lack of hot water. I had luke-warm showers which sucked and had to wash my hands in cold water. Would not return, would not recommend at about $600 CA for 2 nights.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Oh, Jeni's. I love to love you. Fresh, flavorful ice cream with a menu full of fun flavors. Every time I come in I leave smiling.

I could go on and on about how great the ice cream is, but you really just need to go in and try it for yourself. The real gem of Jeni's are the staff behind the counter. They are always so helpful, so kind, and so well-educated on what exactly makes up each flavor. I'm amazed by their service, and so grateful to be eating great ice cream served by great people as well.

It makes the entire experience that much better. Thank you Jeni's and thank you Jeni's staff!!

On my way to Vanderbilt I stopped by this Starbucks location directly up the street from the school. It's the perfect spot to study, meet with friends or colleagues, or just relax and enjoy the scenery.

I beat the early morning work crowd and was able to be in and out in minutes with an iced coffee in hand. The staff was very friendly and quick in taking and making orders.

My favorite aspect of this Starbucks location is the outdoor seating, it's very upscale with a covered top and lots of table options. This would be a great place to work on projects on a nice day. I will definitely be back!

Went to Lolita for Restaurant Week and it was super average. I was disappointed after having such great experiences at Barbuzzo and Bud & Marilyns. Maybe I picked the wrong menu items (for some reason I happened to pick all vegetarian stuff, even though I'm not vegetarian). I got the veggie burrito and it was kind of bland and boring. The description made it sound like it was packed with lots of flavor, but it really just tasted like rice and beans wrapped up in a tortilla with some curried cauliflower thrown in. Maybe it was just the items I ordered, but nothing really stuck out to me here.

I moved to the area a few years ago and this was by far the best DD in my opinion..... In the last few months my opinion has changed. My favorite drive thru employee left and it just seems very bitter and unorganized. There is no standard to my iced coffee that I order just about daily and it makes for a bad day when it's not what you're used to. Maybe they could standardize the sizes as far as cream sugar and flavor go. On the bright side, They finally masted the speaker which is a perk. I used to order into the speaker and then again at the window. Hoping to help this business with this review.

This is a dive all the way...but I'm ok with that. It's within walking distance from my office so I have stopped by a time or two for a greasy bar food lunch (because sometimes it's just one of those days). Great 50 cent wings on Wednesdays and they actually do a bang up job on their pizzas. Very thin crust and great flavor for 5 bucks can't beat that. Half of the establishment is a dark smokey bar and the other half is a liquor store. Medium size selection in the store but very helpful staff. Overall you get what you pay for and this is a great option when you're in a hurry.

My first visit to here since Miyako's turned into Tenno's-- very sad day! Lunch specials were very limited & overpriced, gone are the multiple choices for sushi rolls- very, very sad! One choice of either soup or salad, not both! And apparently no refills on tea, again I said no refills on tea!! My first and last time there-- finally squeezing wasbi out of a mustard container in a sushi place is so wrong! Seriously!! Sushi was sub-par compared to Miyako's, rolls seemed really dry & tasteless - guess if I want sushi in Brentwood I'll be going to Peter's- review coming soon

Update. Pretty annoyed when I went for lunch the other day that the lunch menu is so limited! No crab Rangoon! Seriously - it goes in a fryer, what's so difficult about making that at lunchtime? Our server was misinformed and tried to tell me that I'd I ordered a crab Rangoon appetizer, is then have to pay ala carte for everything else?! Luckily. The manager cleared that up and allowed us to order an appetizer. If not, would have left. We really like crab Rangoon. 

Also missing a lot of sushi rolls from the lunch menu :(

Neighborhood McD's and we stop in here occasionally for my daughter. Flat out - I'm not a fan of McD's, so don't really do the food here unless in an absolute pinch. But I do get a lot of Diet Cokes here and they typically give them to me with sides dripping down the side or one time the lid not on completely. That was nice.

Today we actually went inside for breakfast. There was a line, and the register situation was weird with only one person taking orders and another taking money. They kept asking people to use the computers to order ... but flat out those were taking longer and people were getting upset. Not a great experience.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Went there for the first time since Plums- cute place! I enjoyed the menu and unique ideas. 

If you have little children, a stroller, etc. be warned, the stairs are horrendous. The railing is only on one side, too. 

The food took a little longer than expected and then we had to wait another ten minutes for our roasted potatoes. I ordered the steak and cheese. While the bread is massive, there was not a lot of steak. Pretty disappointing when you really only taste bread with each bite.

Mac n cheese was probably the best part. Very cheesy and loved the cavatappi noodles.

Overall, it's just okay.

This McDonald's customer service SUCKS!!!!!! The girl at the first window was obviously new. No big deal. She asked the manager for help and the manager completely went off. She was so rude. You could tell she was not contributing to a positive work environment but a negative one. FIRE HER!!! The second window lady was so rude. I wasn't surprised with a manager like that. I asked for sweet and sour and said thank you. Never once a you are welcome or Thank you have a good day. 

The fries and cheese burger was great. 
This happened about five mins ago. 
Awful.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It was everything I expected. Make sure you bring an appetite! The food comes out fast and they have pretty good sushi considering how fast it comes out. I recommend going for lunch and bring friends. I have not gone for habachi but ordered it as an entree and was satisfied. Remember when you get al you can eat that you can order pretty much everything as long as you finish your plate (which they didn't seem too strict on. ) Some plates were made very small so you may have to order several of them, but I think you will get your money's worth.

I've been to a few salons out here and I have not been too happy with the service nor the lack of energy from the actual clients. The service was impeccable I will definitely be coming back to see Jenny and Elsa :) 
I am beyond happy with the service and in looooove with the color ! I also took my friend for one of her first pedicures and she loved every minute of it we also had gel nails done as well. Their color choices are extensive and their chrome dips are even better :D 
Thank you so much can't wait until my next visit.

I enjoy the 69 cent cheeseburgers on Wednesdays, and usually have good customer service and always quick, which is deserving of 2 stars, however I think the lobby should be open much later than the current hours. A group of us wanted to stop on our way home from the bars NYE, and couldn't believe that at 1230 the lobby was closed. I know this is normal for most fast food joints, but with the foot traffic in BR late at night, it may be smart to keep this lobby open late night or 24 hours. That's just my opinion, I think it would be a great idea, or have a walk thru window.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It's a new boutique hotel located out in the middle of nowhere so both the wireless and wired internet don't work for business travelers located especially on the fourth floor.  Management is helpless to do anything to restore the internet connection so they will just give you the 1-877 number of their helpless internet service provider who will just reset the wifi router on your floor to no avail.  Lucky for you, the hotel serves better continental breakfast than your Best Western hotel, and unlike other hotel chains, it offers free hot appetizers and alcoholic beverages such as beer and wine every weeknight.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Pretty cute little Japanese food and sushi restaurant hidden away in the plaza at 1st and Grant.
The food's pretty decent as are the prices.
The service is okay-- not super friendly but not terrible either.
The inside isn't extravagant, but is nice and comfortable.
We've been here several times and it's always been a decent experience-- nothing extraordinary, but enjoyable with good food and good prices.  
It's one of our "go-to" places for sushi.
The only warning-- be careful in that parking lot! It can be kind of dangerous.

Love this little family owned store which had everything I needed (Including a little help with ingredients I didn't know how to use)

First time in but not the last. I was making hot & sour soup and needed to buy a couple of ingredients. I had seen that some recipes call for dried daylilies. After the owner described what I would need to do, I decided that ingredient wasn't for me. She laughed and agreed. Right then I knew this was a store I would be returning to often.

Besides groceries and produce, there was a nice assortment of gifts, jewelry, chopsticks, etc. The store is very clean.

Free on-site parking and it is easy in and out.

This is an awesome restaurant. I thoroughly enjoyed the Duck Confit salad, but I think it was removed from the menu (BRING IT BACK!). My fiancee and I absolutely LOVE brunch. The homemade donuts are to die for. I highly recommend ordering them-$2 for 2 donuts...cannot be beat! They're made fresh to order which is refreshing and appreciated.

I love the whole Farm to Table concept paired with craft beers and an upscale menu. It can be pricey (reason why I deducted a star); however, this place should definitely be visited once.

Used to eat here a lot years ago and gave it a shot again tonight. It was easily the worst sushi I have ever had.  I have eaten sushi all over the world, including Tijuana. The sushi we had tonight was worse than Tijuana. 

The sushi was stale and nearly tasteless.  The  rolls were loaded with so much rice that I could not taste the fish.  

The only thing tolerable were the uni shooters.  

The terrible sushi included marina roll, Godzilla roll, and the hip hop roll. 

And, the meal cost $75! Way too much for such a bad meal.

Best liquor store hands down. Selection is awesome! Wine selection is bigger and broader than anyone else in the area and their beer options are great too! We have been turned onto several newer breweries just by stopping in and having a few tastings. Every time I go in they greet you and are eager to help you find exactly what you are looking for. Most of the times that also comes with a taste or two . 

If you are in the area definitely visit, I highly recommend! It has been a great addition to the neighborhood.

We stopped here for a quick lunch.  My party of four was seated immediately and the waitress took are drink order as soon as we sat down.

I ordered a couple of sushi rolls: spicy shrimp roll and the Miami roll.  The Miami roll consisted of spicy crab and avocado and topped with shrimp.  They were both good. Other people in my party ordered hibachi combos that they enjoyed. The combos came with salad and miso soup.

The price was right.  I payed around $8.00 for both rolls and the hibachi meals were only $8.95.

I will be visiting again...

I love it here!  It's the only PF that is never crowded.  Even at peak gym times, you have access to machines and equipment with little to no wait.

It's open 24 hours so you can get your workout in at any time.  I haven't had to interact with the staff other than a hi and bye but they seem friendly enough.

The slogan is true-PF offers a no judgement zone.  You can work out without worrying about if people are watching you or sizing you up.  This place is full of people wanting to workout...not loaded with hard bodies or muscle heads like some gyms.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Ok I know it's Dunkin Donuts and I shouldn't expect gourmet coffee or amazing service...BUT this is probably my least favorite dunkin I have been too. It's right by my house so when I'm craving caffeine quick but I do get frustrated every time! They are always out of something(last time I went it was blueberry flavor and Carmel). The employees that work there are never happy. The donuts here are ok but sometimes don't taste very fresh. They have a drive thru that seems quicker than going inside.

All in all it's a chain coffee company, if you don't expect too much and you will be happy when you visit here.

A hidden gem inside Edmonton South Common. They serve standard Japanese fare, but the ingredients are better and worth the price upgrade. For example, for California rolls, you have the option of ordering the imitation crab or real crab meat. Also, for the rolls, you can order them either with caviar or sesame seeds. This nuanced approach to ordering means that the chef understands the difference of ingredients and price, and is giving options to his customer. The owner is Japanese, and you can tell from the high quality and great taste. My favorite Japanese restaurant in the city.

The Refinery was delicious. I really like how their menu changes every week and all of their food is fresh. I got a chicken dish with mushrooms and it was the perfect size for me. The prices are higher than other restaurants, but, to me, it is definitely worth it. They also have a really good craft beer selection, and their servers are all very nice and helpful with menu recommendations. I would definitely recommend this place to friends. While I wouldn't be able to afford to come here every night, it's definitely a nice place for a quiet birthday dinner or date night.

Had the occasion to stay here on a forced delay on American Airlines. This place was close and we are Hilton members and used points. First off, place is close to the airport. Friendly check in. The rooms are small, but whatever. The main problem we had is our room had an odor to it, mildewed or something, but it was nasty. The A/C is one of those old school under the window units. My Harley makes less noise then this A/C. But hey, it's Kenner Louisiana. On the plus side, nice pool area, good shuttle service and they have something like 6 channels of free HBO.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Ordered standard pepperoni pizza - In town for a convention and didn't want to venture out for my food. Saw this place had a high rating so I ordered delivery to the hotel. It was a busy Saturday night and expected an hour or more for delivery but they guy showed up in about 40 minutes. Very pleased with the speed of delivery. It was smaller than I had hoped for the price but perfect size for one person. Delivery always makes it a tad bit soggy but that is unavoidable and can't be held against them. Super great  flavor. Big slices of pepperoni. Nice fresh tasting sauce. An all around good pie.

We came here after having a wonderful meal at Anthony's Chophouse! 

The entire vibe is very NYC feel. Access to roof to overlook below, great drinks, dark with blue lighting. We sat at the bar and had some REALLY GOOD drinks. The bartender was very nice and answered all our questions! They gave me some tastes of draft beer they had as well. I really think the drinks were some of the best craft cocktails around Indy. The vibe was fun as well. Good music and TVs to watch the games but not to be a Sports Bar whatsoever. Little places to go hide and sit or be out in the open at community tables. I enjoyed this place a lot! We will return!!

The 2 stars are for a nice atmosphere and friendly staff. Otherwise I can't figure out the high ratings for this place, so maybe we ordered the wrong things. Bruschetta was nice to start with great tomato taste and fantastic bread. Went downhill from there - watery and tasteless Caesar salad; over cooked, tough pasta paired with under-seasoned rabe and sausage that hadn't been browned; and chicken francese that was oily and lacked any zip. Could be a great spot with more attention to their preparation since ingredients all seemed to be high quality and the people are really friendly.

You do not want to come to this gym

A while ago they had a policy where a member could sign in non-members to use the basketball court. Thie policy brought in a ghetto crowd every night to the basketball court. This then led to a shooting at the gym (you can look this up yourself). The owner then stopped the signing in non-members to the basketball court. Recently however, the owner of world gym brought that policy back but now a non-member has to pay a 10 dollar fee to get in. Give it time another shooting is going to happen. I really wish these people would learn but that's Bob Boyle for you.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: After seeing everyone walking around Bourbon Street with the "Grenade" drink in their hands I decided to stop in and get one. The place is part of a chain on Bourbon street, and it was small but comfortable. A young man was playing live music, and did a good job. The staff was friendly. The Grenade cost $9, and comes as a low calorie version, the regular version, and a slushy version. I'm not much of a drinker, but what little I had tasted ok. It's advertised as the strongest drink on Bourbon Street, but I don't know if that's true.

The first time we went the food was spectacular and the presentation was beautiful.... Second time we went the food was good but not as good and the presentation was ok... The third time we went the food was thrown on a plate with no regard to presentation and the sushi was stale and the rolls were falling apart and it was all just terrible, and that sucks because we spent 100$ on it.... I will not go back there... I guess they only try to show off the first time you go... I dunno maybe the chef had a bad night but they lost a customer... To many other good options to waste money.

It's Little Caesers, it's $5 pizza, I get it! Customer service was awful! Had to listen to the manager complain to the staff about a customer complaint about employees not washing their hands! I'm sorry but I'm with that guy, gross! Put the phone down and help the 2 kids who are struggling and not trained properly! Get it together!

Follow up just watched the manager count money then roll dough without washing hands!

10 minutes after I ordered one of the kids told me that he forgot to make my order! Cool, thanks! More time to yelp!

Amazing! Authentic! Fresh! Flavorful! Plentiful! I knew this place would be awesome from the moment I walked in, they did not disappoint. Huge portions, worth every cent. Staff was very friendly, clean environment. I got the platillo poblano. Pepper was lightly fried, not greasy. Beans and rice were awesome, and the mole sauce was GREAT. Friend got chorizo hurrache and it was really good, great texture and zing. I would totally come back here and try EVERYTHING ON THE MENU. I'm sure it's all great. BEST MEXICAN FOOD IN SALEM COUNTY!

This place is about a C+. Got delivery from grubhub, actually came pretty quickly. Food was bland and neutral, somewhat unfulfilling. I def ate it though, it was OK. I got nachos, they were mushy, the guac was so flavorless it could have been from wawa. Friend got pork and pineapple tacos, they were actually pretty good. Gave an old dry lime though, tsk tsk. Other friend got portobello fajitas, they were ok, but lacked any flavor. Last friend the guacamole burrito.. it was mushy and boring. For a place with multiple jalepeño referenced in the name, this was place was not so hot. The cantelope juice drink was DOPE though, would recommend.

I frequent many Japanese restaurants and have had the extreme pleasure of vacationing in Japan so I think I have a good idea of how certain foods should be. To-yo was literally the 5th Japanese restaurant 2 of us went to on a Friday night recently and where all of the other 4 had wait lines or you needed a reservation this  place was empty, save a party in a private room and two other couples.
The menu had inaccurate pricing service was slow even for it not being busy and both of our food was mediocre at best. 
Oh, and one more thing, for all of this it was overpriced.

Okay so I was in the mood for Chinese.  I did not read the reviews on Yelp!  I wish I would have.  It cost $9.91 for dinner.  The food was not good.  The Mongolian need tastes like I was eating hamburger.  The salmon was extremely fishy.  They had mashed potatoes and gravy, but they gray had the consistency of water.  It was that runny.  The chicken in the quesadilla was brown.  Gross!  Then I went to the bathroom before I left.  The bathroom was disgusting.  If the bathroom looks like that makes you wonder what the kitchen looks like.  I pray to God I don't get sick later.  Will not be back.

These rooms are nicer than other Courtyards I've stayed in. The lobby is new. Stayed in a standard room with 2 Queen beds. Asked for an upgraded room upon checkin and was denied before the front desk attendant even checked his computer. Then I was offered a Courtyard view due to my status. Ummm... it was a view of the pool.. if it was summertime and kiss were in there it would have been loud AF. So I feel like the guy was totally dissing me. 
Bathrooms (with shower and toilet) are spacious but the vanity area is small. 
PROS:
These rooms are well lit, & clean. It was nice being able to see in a hotel room for once.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Two stars. 
The food has always been good, and I have NO issue with the portion size and quality... my issue is with Willie's attitude and indifference towards customer service. I have come across this a few times when I have been there, basically as far as he is concerned "I am the best, this place is the best, and I could care less about you, or what you think". There ARE other family owned pizza restaurants in the area, he is not the only one. Pizza mania has comparable food and pizza, without the attitude!

Great cut for a great price. 

I've been going to perfect cut for about two years now and I'm never disappointed. I've only ever had my hair cut by Frances so I can't speak to anyone else there, but Frances is great at recreating cuts from pictures or even giving advice on types of cut, and she's always really sweet and lovely to talk to. I normally don't like talking to hair stylists, just because it generally feels forced, but chatting with Frances is always comfortable, whether it be about the changes in Chinatown or her kids in school. 

Plus you get a free wash and (sometimes) massage all for about 20 bucks !

If you're taking the swamp tour, you'll probably stop at this bar. It wasn't hard for the bartender to convince us that getting a bucket of beer was better/cost-efficient than buying a couple of bottles to-go for our tour. She let us mix and match which was nice. 

The IPA in the can had floaty brown things in it though so beware. It reminded be of the gunk you see in your Kombucha when you let it sit out for awhile.  

Besides the IPA hiccup (we still 4 more bottled beer), the service was friendly. They also have tables outside so you can enjoy the weather.

I'm very disappointed with this car wash. I bought the the 3 pack of high end car washes because the attendant up sold me by promising me my wheels would come out clean.  I was hesitant but I figured  it was worth it if I didn't have to clean my own wheels. At the end I got out and looked and they looked terrible! I went over and showed him and he agreed so he put me through again, same result. The car was clean wheels look terrible. I showed him again and he shrugged his shoulders and told me he had a towel I could use if I wanted to wipe them down myself. Not doing it myself was the whole purpose of the upgrade!!!

If anyone ever asks my opinion on where to get Sushi in St. Louis I always say Cafe Mochi.  
I usually only go during happy hour, because you absolutely cannot beat that deal.  My friend and I will go and order 7+ rolls with beer and our bill will be ridiculously low.  On top of all that, it actually tastes delicious.  When you go to Drunken Fish, Subzero, or any other CWE sushi bar, you're paying for their ambiance and atmosphere and the food is not even great.   The only thing Mochi can work on is service.

This place is the perfect addition to the broad ripple strip. It's perfect for a night of partying and in need of some sustenance to absorb the alcohol. 

I ordered the asada tacos, and they were tasty! My biggest pet peeve when it comes to tacos? When they pile on too much toppings that the tortilla can't simply hold it together. George's does it right by doubling up on the corn tortilla! 

Only negative was the girl taking our order. She could be having a bad night, tired since it was late? Never the less, a smile would have gotten this place 5 stars!

There is no consistency to the service here. I was going here for the last 2 weeks b/c I didn't know there was a Second Cup across the street from my new office in the basement of ATB/TELUS towers. Anyway I would get my morning mocha and at lunch grab a hot tea. I like my tea a lil sweet and ask for 2 pumps of classic syrup sometimes I'm charged sometimes I'm not. I get the charge for syrup in an iced tea as they use like 6 pumps but come on 2 pumps should not be $0.50. like I said sometime I'm charged sometimes I'm not. Ugh.

The staff at subway were very friendly and helpful in creating my delicious sandwich.  They helped me eat fresh with all of their vegetable options that were available.  They were however out of banana peppers at the time of my visit, but it was OK.  I ordered a italian BMT, and my wife got the meatball sub.  We were both very happy.  The restaurant was also very clean and the washroom was in impeccable cleanliness.
Thank you to all 3 subway employees it took to create and ring out my order.
Overall 5 stars for helping me to combat my hunger after kayaking the Harpeth River.

My husband and I stayed for one night due to a graduation, I was greatly disappointed.  The valet was $35.00 so that was definitely not going to happen.  Then we get to the room to relax and our TV remote was not working properly.  At 1 am people were running down the hall, then at 3 am loud voices from the next room, then apparently proceeded to have intimate relations giving that the headboard was hitting our wall which was quite annoying.  But I will say that the staff are very friendly and professional.  But for the price that you pay I would have expecting better.  But I will if ever in St Louis again, I will pick some where else to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have been looking for a new nail salon. Every since my pedicure in Orlando, the bar had been set high. I decided to give this place a try after looking at their website and reading the reviews on yelp. I went as soon as they opened and was promptly greeted by a friendly nail technician. I was instructed to choose a color from a huge colorful selection. They carry Opi zoya and And. Wi-FRI is also available. I was offered a complimentary beverage. It was a peaceful atmosphere (which is what I want when trying to relax). Shellac is available too.  I will definitely returned for my next pedi and strongly recommended mcn.

When my fave spot closed down and a lengthy search high and low. I think I have found a new spot.. Don't be fooled by the outside .. The decor is very intimate.. Presentation was AMAZING !!  They don't have a specials in the evening but the rolls were AMAZING.. I had Philly, Cali, Crazy Sushi Roll (house roll), Spicy Crab, and Spicy Tuna ... Only complaint is I hate everything and was left with the empty plate .. Currently waiting for the ENDLESS SUSHI PROMO. That doesn't exist yet but ohhhhh the possibility

Tikaiya not sure if I spelled her name right or wrong but she was very helpful for the midnight shift, great enthusiasm and joyful. Hopeful for another good small conversation because that's what wins my stay.  The stay was good. There was long piece of hair in the shower walls though. And not sure if there is suppose to be mattress covers but I sure did sleep on it. Not loud on Tuesday check in so unsure about neighborhood. It was very affordable. Hard to locate don't turn into the highway look at map first because he entrance is where the hooters is next to gas station.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This was such an interesting experience. I think it's a must for anyone who's into modern cuisine. Dinner is served "omakase" style, kind of like in Japanese places where the menu is preset and portions are rather small but there's a lot of courses. Their food was really good! I've attached the menu for anyone who wants to see what they serve. We couldn't finish the last dessert .. there was so much food. You could also choose wine pairing for around $55/person and they brought a different glass of wine for each course. Highly recommend!

Food was fantastic ! We had fried calamari for an appetizer, different pieces of sashimi and baked Philadelphia roll as a main course. Baked roll comes hot.. It's overall very good but I'm used to cold sushi so I'm going to try something different next time. The dessert ( green tea and red beans creme brûlée ) was out of this world!!! Food was a 5 star experience but the waitress was kind of sloppy ... Spilled the green tea on our table while we were eating and didn't bother to wipe it out.. Also not very attentive. Other than that amazing food

First time here.  Crab rangoons were really chewy.  Had a hard time biting through them. And really there stand alone flavor wasn't great. Same with the egg rolls.  Crispy shrimp was decent. Orange and General's chicken  was ok.  My wife wouldn't eat her Cashew chicken, the sauce had a medicinal taste.  Gentlemen working the counter was nice and helpful and they were pretty quick. The amount of food for the cost was good, combos come with an app and a soup.  I'd like to give them a better star rating, but the four of us just had an overall disappointed with the the food.

The sushi at Origami is always great! On the other hand, the service isn't as awesome. They are always friendly, but need to be a bit more attentive to basic things. Not having any chop sticks prior to receiving food is a no-no, particularly on a slow day. I appreciate the effort made when my drink is refilled or the server remembers to bring the extra wasabi that I requested, but there have been a few occasions that it just didn't happen.

I usually grab lunch here with coworkers at least once a month, it's our usual spot and we do enjoy the atmosphere. If they bring back the TNT mussels I'll bump it up to 4 stars!

Loved it!  Went for Saturday evening dinner around 5:00.  Glad we went early because they were packed out within 30 minutes of us arriving.  Friendly service. Love the idea of them making fresh salsa at the table; however, it took a while for someone to get to our table to make it, so we were eating plain chips for a while.  The salsa was excellent!

I had the taco and tamale plate and it was great!  We went back a couple of days later for lunch.  Salsa was already prepared and served.  

Highly recommend!!!

Quick Read: The service is amazing, the food is great, but you may need dessert or a snack after.

I love the environment in Bartaco -- the service is always attentive, and it's a beautifully relaxed restaurant. The food is really tasty, but at the price-point, the servings can be relatively small. There are a few exceptions, but I'd lean towards ordering a tiny bit more food than you think you need. They are tacos, after all! The posole is FANTASTIC, and the perfect dish for a nasty cold or just a chilly day.

I like Papa johns pizza. It's the best around. I am convinced that Seminole has the worst food around. It's hard to get a good meal in this area. But papa johns is pretty consistent and way better than howies or dominoes and even the local Pizza Hut. 

It's def not a good honest Chicago pizza, which I grew up and I've had real New York style which is what papas is closer too but it's a franchise pizza place with processed ingredients so it is what it is but the best of the rest.
I do wish pizza places would stop using nasty Tap water, it hurts to flavor of the sauce and dough.

This is in regards to the location on Seminole blvd and park blvd.

Worst food I have ever received!
After listening to the staff in the back making rude comments about customers returning because their order was incorrect for 15 min I finally received my order.

My whopper was a complete mess and prepared wrong and joined the nuggets we ordered under a warmer while they made one order of fries at a time. 

The manager Joseph did nothing more than work at the drive thru. Not checking to make sure orders are prepared correctly and cooked fully. 

This place is horrible and the prices do not match the quality. 

Adding a photo of my burger!

This is our GO-TO place for sushi and we are picky. If you know sushi you know right away when their sushi rice is made correctly and their rice is near perfect.  

CONSISTENTLY on point sushi; been there over ten times now. 

Their sushi is always fresh no matter the day of week we order.  We've tried many of their Maki rolls and have liked them all. 

They have a half off happy hour for sushi that makes it affordable.

The dumplings are crispy and the pork is flavorful.  

The service is unremarkable and decor somewhat dated but an enjoyable experience for take out or dining in.

This review is for the mobile ordering app for this restaurant.
I ordered via the app...hoping this would alleviate waiting in the long line at the drive-thru or inside the store.
However... when we arrived at the restaurant, a sign said please use the drive-thru as their mobile ordering used that. What a disaster... the line was ridiculous, and it took us 20 minutes to get to the window to get our food. Additionally, when we got to the ordering screen, the operator had trouble finding my order. What a mess. If you want people to order food using the app you may want to improve upon your system.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Had a lunch meeting here and it was pretty busy for a Monday. Service was great and extremely polite, but a bit slow since they were so busy. I think the towels you get when you're seated are a nice touch!

The sashimi bento at $18 had a lot of food: soup (which unfortunately they forgot, but I didn't realize until the end), salad (love the dressing!), tempura (large portion including 2 shrimp), chicken teriyaki (fatty with the skin, but I didn't mind it), sashimi (2 salmon, 3 tuna) and a huge portion of rice.

Great option for lunch though a bit pricier than some alternatives. Quality was definitely worth it.

A new-ish building, it looks quite nice inside though smaller than other locations (can seat maybe 35?) and focused primarily on drive thru traffic. Took some time to be noticed at the counter even though there are lots of staff working. 

Variety and freshness of baked goods is decent and coffee was fresh. I tried the grilled bagel breakfast sandwich and was very disappointed. The bagel was barely warmed and the sausage and egg was cold. Definitely thrown together to push the orders through fast. 

Parking lot was a bit of a maze with the drive thru exiting into the lot which caused a lot of people confusion as I was watching from inside.

If I could give no stars I would. First after calling for the shuttle 3 times and then waited an hour in the heat the shuttle finally came to pick us up at the airport. Next arrived to get rooms that should have been adjoined and were told they were but when made it to rooms, not adjoining. 
Then there's the fart smell. It's downstairs, it's upstairs, it's everywhere. 
It was 100 degrees outside as well as in the hallways. It was like the heaters where on. 
No hot water in the shower.
Breakfast was barely edible. 
Overall this place was terrible and would recommend avoiding!!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
It has been almost year since our first trip to Catbird Seat. This is what was served by Chef Trevor Moran and his staff (see picture of menu posted). A truly gastronomic culinary experience. 

Would have loved to experience Chef Trevor Moroan's tasting menu again, however, since he is back at his original abode, Noma  in Copenhagen, that will have to wait. Can't say I am surprised Noma wanted him back. 

Excited to experience the tasting menu under the new chef Ryan Poli. I am sure food will be different. Wonder if the logistics aspect of preparation and service delivery has changed.

Will know soon enough...

The best sushi place I've found in Edmonton so far. I have been three times and never had anything I wouldn't call delicious. The maki, nigiri, and sashimi are all excellent. And the place has the exact vibe you want from a sushi joint. Small, friendly, and a sushi chef that looks like he's been doing it right for decades.

The prices are a little high, although not out of line for what sushi goes for in Edmonton. And while I like the small restaurant vibe, it can make getting in for dinner a challenge. But in terms of quality and taste, this place can't be matched in Edmonton.

I wanted a quick mani on my way out of town a few weekends back. I drove by this place slowly, trying to read the open hours sign. A lady ran out and waved me in. They were scheduled to close in less than 10 minutes, but she took me anyway, which was very nice. She actually insisted. It could have been that she was rushing, but she did a pretty bad job on my gel mani. Several nails had a corner not painted, and it didn't last long. I feel bad for the lady running it, because she seems to have a hard time getting people in, but I won't be back.

I had gone through 6 vets in 2 states before bringing my dog Toby to Jane about 4 years ago. Jane and her staff are Fantastic! The service you receive is not like any where else I had been, they know your dog and are very personable and the diagnosis is very accurate and the price is far more than fair. Unfortunately I had to put my dog down today and did it with jane and am so incredibly thankful it was with her. The whole process was compassionate, quick, and professional. If ever I decide to get another dog I will only use jane and her staff in the future. I would recommend her service to everyone and anyone.
Thank You!

I'm not sure how the food tastes and never will. The people who operate this establishment are very rude, nasty, mean spirited and have no clue about customer service.  

I used them today to pay a utility bill (Entergy) and I will never step foot in this place again.  I just loathe poor customer service and it behooves them to be kind as competition is directly across the street.   

I hate leaving bad reviews on customer service because their food could actually be decent but oh well! It's too many places around here making po boys and the likes to subject myself to that crappy service.

I finally went in and checked this place out. I definitely no NOT regret it. This is a VERY good Italian Restaurant. The Pizza was really good...they use San Marzano sauce and excellent Mozzarella. I have also tried some of the non-Pizza dishes like the Chicken and Veal Parm. The red sauce is excellent. And the service is also top notch. And the Cannoli was great too.

The only reason I don't give it 4-Stars instead of 5-Stars is that I wasn't such a big fan of the Appetizers. The Clams were small and old. But overall this is an excellent restaurant which you guys should check out.

This place is above average by Tampa Bay standards, but would not be considered adequate in a Northeast location. Their Sicilian is probably a little bit better than their traditional pizza, but the overall weakness of both is that they seem to use mediocre Cheese and their oven is not hot enough so everything is just slightly "off" even though it's definitely edible.

I used to eat here a lot when I first moved to Tampa because most of the Pizza places were outright revolting, but eventually I discovered some places that were a bit better than Best NY Pizza. Overall though, this is worthy of a solid 3-Star rating.

Budget/ Dollar in the Tampa Airport STOLE my money today. I rented a car online on their website and when we went to pick it up, they refused to give it to us because the original Reservation was made online with a Debit Card! So they won't give us the car, but they won't refund the money either! I'm not sure if I should call the police or not...this is basically Robbery but there doesn't appear to be anything I can do about it. Dollar is now owned by Thrifty/Budget so do not use ANY of these 3 car rentals companies. I have been on the phone with their Corporate Office all morning and apparently they are very comfortable with stealing from us.

I have been on the phone with their Corporate Office all morning and apparently they are very comfortable with stealing from us.

I hate giving this place 3 stars because I heard such great things about it. I had brunch on the upstairs patio. Service was friendly but little slow which I attribute to the downstairs kitchen and understand. I had the Grit and corn casserole which had a mountain of corn in it that I couldn't really taste anything else. I can't say it was canned corn but the taste from fresh corn and this were noticeably different. The side of potatoes were ok. The bacon was amazing. Drinks were good. Pricing is reasonable. The upstairs patio deck is adorable. I would go back for dinner to see if I enjoyed something different.

Like a previous reviewer had mentioned, since Todd and Miram have left, the gym has taken on a completely new feeling. Gone are the friendly and endearing elements of what was once a community. I had to leave a few months back due to this and run into quite a few of the previous members at the new gym that I've joined. ALL have said the same thing....things aren't as t hey once where and it's simply easier to move on that to try and change things back to what they once were. Apparently Todd and his wife are what ultimately held this place together.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We went here after a long time since our last visit.  We waited with empty tables since we were early for our reservation.  Not sure why.  The waiter was fine but said we didn't get bread since the kitchen had burnt it.  He did eventually bring some but it was hard and over cooked. The table next to us received much more buttered bread that looked great but we never received any of that.  The food was fine but with the other issues It was Avery disappointing experience. And the fact we pay 50% more here made it that much more disappointing.  We will not be back anytime soon.

I tried Nephew's for the first time today.  I wasn't impressed.  I ordered a catfish sandwich and got a catfish dinner.  The catfish was overcooked.  It was dry and tough.  They didn't have everything I ordered either and didn't bother saying anything until my delivery driver got there.  The food was only ok with the predominant flavor being salt.  That being said, the fries were pretty darn good.  All and all I'm not sure I'll be ordering from here again.  I wish them the best though, the concept of their restaurant is awesome.

Quite disappointing and overall not my favorite coffee shop. The coffee itself was very enjoyable and quite tasty but didn't enjoy the coffee experience. Ambiance wise, sitting towards the back of the place, I was having flashbacks of old college days in someone's dorm room. Secondly, the coffee shop was freezing and didn't seem to have their heat on during a cold winter day in the city. Major area for improvement would be the bathroom. Highly recommend they find ways to clean that more regularly since it was very gross as soon as you walked in.

Was on the mood for Italian and my wife spotted this place. 

Ate here with her and in-laws. Never eaten here before. It's a nice place. Eating area is cozy; comfortable chairs that roll out easily. The dining area is not very big so I don't recommend bringing young kids as it would likely bother others. 

Food was a little on the pricey side but full of good flavor. Must mention our waiter, Mike. He was honestly one of the most naturally friendly waiters I've had and very attentive. 

I had the veal parmesan which was very good. Wife had the lobster ravioli and she raved about it.

Really nice place to eat, the food is solid and it is reasonably priced.  The desserts would be my only complaint, not great.  The bread is really good that they serve beforehand, and I don't live close enough to frequent this place, but if I did live closer, I would definitely go in often.  i also like the atmosphere, it is fancy, but also quiet and elegant at the same time.  I was impressed with the variety of the menu, service, and quality of the food.  Good food, good prices, not sure what else you could want from a restaurant.

Lolitas provided a decent meal that was good but nothing I would have to return to. I waited months to go here as they were renovating the restaurant when initially wanted to attend.

The home made pork skins were great, crisp yet not salty. The pork skins were a treat that actually ended up being the highlight of my evening. While small plates & tapas is in these days, the portions were too small and not really shareable.

The fish tacos were good. The pork tacos were bland. This restaurant was warm & inviting and I may be open to giving it another chance.

First time here. Read some reviews saying best pedi ever. Not sure if these people have never had a good pedi but this  certainly was not the best or even closest to the best ever. Maybe it was the girl who did it but she was very fast did not say a word to me just spoke to the other girl and only in her language which is sooo rude. I will say the massage was good but the bottom of my feet are still rough and I told her that I have callous but she totally blew my comment off. The place seems to be very clean which is a plus but not a friendly place.  Sorry but there is a lot more to a pedicure than just the massage.

I eat sushi constantly and I wanted to try a new place! This place was reasonably priced and very fresh! The best part was now quick the service was. Everyone was super friendly and the rolls were large and in charge! Started out with the app of gyoza was delicious very juicy! The Asahi special roll was amazing, it's deep fried and huge! The rainbow roll was topped with fresh salmon and tuna and white fish! The spicy crunchy salmon was good the only thing was the rock n roll with the shrimp tempura I feel was missing more of the actual shrimp filling! Other than that I will be going back for sure!

With the jump in prices from any other Marsh or Grocery store to this location their rent must be outrageous! For staples you should look elsewhere if you have the means to do so (food deserts, transportation issues, all that jazz...). 

Buuuut if you need something kinda special - like a huge array of organic produce, random sauce you can't find anywhere else, or fancy cheese - you've found the right place. 

The best part of this Marsh is the free garage parking and the array of ready-to-go options. They have a (mostly and usually) fresh salad bar, an olive bar, a fruit and dessert bar, as well as sushi and hot foods to go.

Had my memory there and today  is the last day the are being in business.

Is the busiest day I have seen since I go there quite often over in 3 years probably because of the article.

The Chicken wings were sold out since everyone wanted to order them.

So far my experience has been positive, maybe I didn't have much expectation, maybe it reminds me of my childhood.

I went there not for the food but for the history and memory that came with it.

Sadly there's one less place remain that's witnessed the golden era of the Philadelphia Chinatown.

Best wish to all of them and we'll see what the future holds.

Farewell, Tasty place.

To me, I'm a bit indifferent, just another Japanese restaurant with the same list of items, sushi, teriyaki, etc. just a bit more polished for the demographic of the town, compared to Little Tokyo a few blocks away.  And the waitress at the time, a little lukewarm.  This is Haddonfield's third sushi restaurant, and it sits between Fuji (upper scale) and Little Tokyo.  If I'm looking to grab a lunch I'll split between Megu or Little Tokyo.  A special night out, definitely Fuji, I just wish they were more flexible with their Omakase. So take that for what it is.

The only way to describe Passariello's is a Sbarro's on steroids. Just opened in Haddonfield and it's rather refreshing to have an updated and modern restaurant like this in Haddonfield.  You can get really tired of the other run of the mill Italian restaurants sprawled all over South Jersey.  You walk in and get a Dave and Buster's like charge card, peruse the different stations and make a request whether it's pizza, salad, or entree.  The portions are large and found the place really clean.  My wife and I was able to share an entree. At first it's a little confusing, but eventually you'll get the hang of it.

Haven't had Shake Shack in a while but ordered it to go recently online.  My wife put in an order for two Shack burgers, chicken nuggets, three orders of fries including the cheese bacon fries, and a milk shake. When I got there they had the Covid precautions down, showed them my order on my phone and picked up my meal.  There were people there eating outside as it was good weather. In terms of the food, it was as expected, nothing spectacular as to warrant the price, but it was a solid burger.  There seems to be a lot options around for burgers, it's nice to have this as one of them in Cherry Hill unfortunate that Zinburger closed down.

DO NOT GO HERE!  They are very expensive and dishonest.  I went in for a contact lens fitting and they neglected to tell me that it was not covered by insurance until the very and after the procedure.  They charged me $90 for this crap...you could go to America's Best and pay $99 for 3 years of unlimited eye exams and lens fittings.  Also, they keep their frames locked on the shelf.  They carry a HUGE markup on their frames and lenses.  You could save yourself at least $100 by going to another overpriced place like Lens Crafters.  Go to America's Best or Costco...do not come here unless you like to be ripped off.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Pros: the food & drink could not go wrong.  One of the best brunchs' I've ever had.  Apple mimosa, grits, salmon beni were all incredibly well crafted and scrump.  The location & decor are also decent.

Cons: some of the slowest, least capable service I've ever had and Im a pretty patient person.   I'm not sure if this was just our server but, it seemed it might be as even when the crowd had cleared he still was s-l-o-w.  Nice enough but slow and not at all attentive.  I would give the place another try as  the food was great though.

Although it looks small from the outside, India Bazaar is a very good-sized Indian grocery store conveniently located off Carothers in Cool Springs. They have a nice produce section that offers foods not available in chain grocery stores, such as fresh curry leaves. They also have every variety of rice, spices, teas and pretty much whatever you need to make an Indian feast. I found both the staff and customers to be very helpful. I was looking for a number of ingredients, and some customers offered advice on brands they prefer over others, making my selection easy. This is a store I will frequent often!

This is my second visit to this little place.  I now know why I suggested we go here to my son-in-law.  It's great, the Sushi is fabulously fresh and tasty and the service was impeccable.  The only complaint I have is the pricing, much too high for what is offered, but I will go back again as it was a very excellent meal and even my 16 month old grandson gobbled up his Teriyaki Chicken Bowl which was specially made with the Teriyaki Sauce on the side.  The ambiance is divey, but we were there to eat so I don't really think it was all that important.  Food was fantastic, will go back again.

I've only been here a handful of times.

This is a low cost clinic. So i guess the saying "you get what you pay for" is true. 
They do not take appointments so plan to be here for about an hour and a half to two hours. I guess you have to think about how much your time is worth.
Each time Ive been here the vet has been in with me for about 3 minutes.  So I don't feel like I'm really heard. 
The office staff and vet techs are all very friendly and helpful!

I will def return, but will make sure I have phone charger and/or a book to read!

The sushi here is average at best and the atmosphere could be better. In fact, most of the non-sushi items are better than the actual sushi items. Their soups and fried rice are really good but in my opinion, you don't go to sushi restaurants for the soup and fried rice. Also, the place is kind of small with limited parking. You are better off going on week nights when it isn't as busy. The service is kind of slow but thats pretty common at sushi restaurants. Its probably 3rd best in town after Ra and Sushi Garden.

I recommend trying it if you are in the area.

I love the Pumpkin Spice Latte and it always comes out a week before my birthday! It is the Epidemy of fall! As soon as Pumpkin spice latte comes out you know fall is coming and the flavor is rich sweet and pumpkin!
