The thing about Starbucks' Pumpkin Spice latte that makes it so special is that they use real pumpkin in their latte. I have to say it's as good as it gets and at this location they are quick and accurate in getting you your order the way you want with a smile and friendly face to greet you! What more could you want!?

Just went in to get a fill and it is always so nice and clean in there! Just wanted a fill with regular polish but the lady talked me into getting it with gel which isn't that bad but sometimes I just want regular polish! But had Tom do my fill and having r be his first day at the salon but 18 years in the industry he was super nice and polite and definitely knew what he was doing!! Fixed my nails as they were in bad shape and did an AMAZING job! This is definitely the place to go and get all your nail services! They are amazing!

I came here and was pleasantly surprised. At first I thought the $6.35 charge was high but they serve you a good amount of ice cream so I was content after receiving it. The staff, all young high schoolers, were very engaging and funny. The ice cream itself was delicious. Absolutely amazing in fact. I will definitely be coming back. Added bonus is the toppings are for free. I know many an ice cream place that will charge extra per topping to squeeze every cent out you they can, so it was very nice to see this business offer free toppings.

I received  excellent customer service ( i wanna say the guys name was brian?)  very helpful and professional. Location is good and within walking distance of pretty much anything.  Room was one of the smaller rooms I've ever been in but served its purpose. thing that threw me off was there were no windows (in my room) this bothered me to be honest. Only other negative was how is there no computer in the lobby for guests to use?  Either way, the hotel served its purpose for me. if you are in town for 1-2 days, this is worth it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Our stay started with one of the girls in our group (age 20) being approached by a man in the parking lot who said "Beautiful night we're having. You're pretty." Then we went in to the front office to check in, and the man checking us into our room is everything creepy about the 80s wrapped into one. 

We had no major issues with the room itself, but there was nothing nice about it. A hard bed, rips in the comforter, a weird blue splatter on the wall. Again, not anything unbearable, but overall just quite unpleasant.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Everyone in Fishers circles talks about how this is a staple but I don't see it. It's your run of the mill mom and pops Mexican food joint. The highlight of the meal were the chips... I'm an absolute mark for super crunchy tortilla chips. 

My enchiladas were heavy, bland and pretty forgettable. For $30+ for a couple, you shouldn't feel like you would have had better value at Taco Bell but that is exactly how we felt. They do get the third star for the service. In fact, that probably accounts for one and a half.

Very extensive shot list. Me and a group of friends went for happy hour. Drinks are 2 for 1 during this time and they give you chip to turn in for your 2nd drink. Nice method of operation however, I noticed that when we bought rounds everyone did not get their 2nd chip.  There was only one bar tender at the time so service was understandably a little slower but not to the point of annoyance. The bar tender was nice enough. He did not extend himself to my group but he did his job. They do not sell food but we were told you can bring in food if you like. We grabbed some Oyster Rockefeller's for next door and ate them at our table with no issues.

Passed by this ice cream shop from Philly on the way home to NJ.

'Been a long time, the last time we're here was more than seven years ago.

This ice cream shop is well known with the locals in this area. Maybe only few out of towners like us know this great ice cream joint. 

They use fresh ingredients from the local farmers and dairies. They used to have they're own farm and dairy facilities in the back of the dairy store. 

We ordered for take out in half gallons:
Peanut Butter crunch, Strawberry, Coffee, and Chocolate Almond.

Delicious ice cream!

Will be back here soon.

Terrible customer service. I was shopping refinancing rates for my new Tacoma, TFCU had the best rate by a fraction, decided to give them a try. First off, I had to reach out to even find out the terms / rate after a vague approval email, then spent over a week and multiple times trying to get ahold of someone / my loan officer via email and phone to no answer. Was promised by their customer service department here on Facebook someone would call me (twice), never a single phone call or follow up. Sorry but no customer should have to chase a bank down for their business, what a joke. Look at other reviews, save your time and go somewhere else.

Based on a Yelp friends recommend, I tried it on my lunch break.   Super clean place, very large portions, and a pretty robust selection.  Although I wouldn't compare it to Cherokee St as my "friend" did, it's legit.  Another Yelp'r once said the guacamole was too salty...happy to report that they've corrected that issue.  They are still working on the soggy tortilla from juice.

I'd like to give 3.5 stars because although it tasted great, the spicy salsa and jalapenos made me dominate my workplace restroom...even if it's my fault for eating spicy, I still blame the tacos.  I don't like poopin' at work!

A little pricey, but really good food. We started with the dragon ball appetizer and it was delicious! I just wish there was more or that I didn't have to share it! I had the small sashimi platter and the portions of fish were very generous. My husband had the fire cracker roll with sliced jalapeño and extra saracha on top, he likes it really spicy, and he said it was great! He also had salmon roll, yellowtail roll, and phili roll, he said the rice was a little sweet, but the fish was very fresh. Overall I think we'll be back. :-)

I visited this bar this past weekend.  What drew me in was the live jazz.  There is no cover; however, it is only right that you tip the band at least a little.  
The name refers to the 21st amendment to the US constitution, which repealed prohibition (1933).  The decor and the clothes the bartenders wear all reflect this period.  In addition, the bands tend to dress and play accordingly.
The place is very small but finding a place to sit is usually not difficult.  I never had a problem getting a drink at the bar.  The location is just off Bourbon Street so it is close to the craziness there and provides a haven to take a break.

My boss and I took a couple clients here for lunch based on their recommendation. We were not disappointed.  Yeah, it's kind of a dive bar atmosphere with an outside patio/deck as well as inside seating.  Unfortunately, we had to have non-alcoholic drinks for lunch. I had the trashed wings based on one of our clients recommendation and they were excellent. The sandwiches that the others had looked very good as well.  Not sure you could find this place if you didn't have a connection with knowledge it, but I'd like to come back in the evening and enjoy the full ambiance with beer!

On a Saturday evening, this rooftop restaurant & bar felt more like a nightclub.  The decor is modern, people were mostly dressed up, there was a dj, and the music was very loud. 

I ordered a margarita and we shared the pizza special along with the brussel sprouts. I would eat those brussel sprouts every single day if I could. Holy cow, those were good!!  The pizza was just okay. I expected better with the margarita, but it was just okay. 

I wouldn't avoid this place, but I'm definitely not recommending it or trying to hurry back there. Well, for anything other than brussel sprouts. Maybe takeout.

They sent me off with a keyfob with a dead battery in it.  So I couldn't lock my car at my first destination (stress) and then had to find, buy, and replace the battery (time) on a very brief trip to Nashville.  They had to know it was dead because they way the fob was used to start the car was a workaround (hold fob up to steering column).  I called for help and the best they were willing to "offer" was for me go back to the airport.  On a 24 hour trip with a packed schedule, simply not possible or even reasonable.

Dollar prices change if you keep your weekend rental beyond 4 days. An $86 weekend rental ended up being $370.00 because I chose to return it at a later time while my vehicle was in the shop. Never-mind the calls to customer service asking for the extension or the fact that no one disclosed this information to me. I was hit with late fees as well as a rate change. I prolly won't rent from dollar again anytime soon unless they are offering the absolute best rates. I won't even mention how filthy the cars at the Philadelphia airport is. Customer service means nothing to this business.

I have just signed up recently and so far the gym seems very clean and the equipment is perfect for the type of works out I am doing. The only reason I am giving this a 4 is because I was less than impressed with the Assistant Manager at this facility. Upon signing my enrollment form he said "This is for when you come to complain I can slap this in front of you with your signature" I am not sure that is a good way to start a business agreement. I also found him to be very condescending which goes against the no intimidation motto of the company
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I normally LOVE this place & their food. But, I'm super frustrated tonight because we checked their hours online & it clearly states that they close at 8:00. We were finally off work and excited to dine in since COVID, but we couldn't get there before 7:30.   We walk in, asked if we can be helped, then to be told we could only order carry out because dining in ends at 7:30.   PLEASE explain the sense of this. Clearly the kitchen is still working, you can sanitize after we leave, AND you say you are open until 8. Nothing says you close 30 minute early.

From a recommendation, we tried the Lake House which is close to Bobby's Frozen Custard.

On the night we tried the special which was BBQ'd Pork Steak. The sauce was quite good and the meat was cooked to perfection, plus you had a choice of two sides. I had fries and mac n' cheese which went along well with the BBQ for an All American meal.

The big thing here is you really can't beat their prices and you get more than enough to eat that you won't even want to stop for Bobby's frozen custard or maybe not. Bobby's is so good. You might as well try both if you're in the area.

Went last night for my birthday & the food, as always, was delicious. Nate, our waiter, was excellent as well. The only thing was the hostess. She was extremely rude to my partner & I when we walked in & repeated to us multiple times we were late (by 3 minutes) & that they were having their company party. We felt very rushed & unwelcomed by her specifically, especially as she continue to stare us down our entire meal. We're sorry it was your party that you were very obviously eagerly awaiting but her attitude was no excuse. I wish that it would've been communicated to us that they were closing early too- we would've eaten somewhere else.

Ive gone here a few times over the years.  For me once, for my daughter twice and for my son twice.  More times than not, the cuts were lacking expertise.  My son said he NEVER wants to go here again because the cut he received was so far from the picture he provided. Now today we are giving it one more try and it's only because Modern Male is closed and he has a recital that I want his hair to look nice for.  Hoping that they have increased their skills and he is satisfied with his cut. If so, I'll increase to 3 stars.

When we found out that two of our favorite restaurants also owned this place we had to go check it out! It was very nice inside and it is BYOB which we do like but they do have bottles you can order. We ordered their flat bread that was on their special list that night which was really good. It was a tomato flatbread with no pizza sauce. We also ordered the muscles which were really good. We were stuffed from the appetizers that we both ordered salads and they were extremely flavorful. We will definitely be stopping in again soon. They do have specials every night of the week which is really nice.

Made a wrong turn Monday night and didn't want Mexican so I came here. Staff was friendly though the sushi chef wasn't your typical greet n bow type. But if you talk to him he will respond. Started off with Miso soup which was saltier than any I've ever tried. Then had the Tenno #2 special along with Super California. What arrived were two rolls that looked alike with eel and some white cream on top. I asked about the eel and they said that's how they come. Not sure about that but they tasted exactly the same and the tuna inside their special was really dark. So in essence, 'No Fresh For YOU!'

Origami is a classic New Orleans sushi joint: slow-paced service, affordable and delicious sushi.  Lots of creative rolls here, and the portions are perfect for making two meals out of a dish.  Three rolls split between two people will be MORE than enough to share.  I have dined in and picked up from here three or four times, and the staff are always extremely friendly and accommodating.  Minus one star because the feel of the restaurant isn't very authentic, but that could just be my lingering haunting memories of Friar Tuck's (the business that once inhabited the building).  :P

This gym could be so much better if it were run by people who care, they expect people to come to them without lifting a finger to get business in their doors.  The owners or management are barely ever present, they give different rates and deals to different people depending on their mood.  There's no "ambiance" for a gym, no music playing in the facility, a very sterile and uninviting environment for a gym.  They don't utilize their group fitness room nor seem to care to offer classes that people want either.  Children are not welcome in this facility either as there is no child care.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Cute ambience and excellent service. The food, however, is a bit overpriced considering the quality. Groupon brought us here and groupon will have to bring us back because I don't consider this Italian food worth full price. 

Boyfriend and I both got the fixed price menu and to be honest it wasn't worth the $25. For appetizers, I had the stuffed mushrooms and he had calamari. Both decent. House salad was just bagged salad (although the vinaigrette was excellent). We both got penne a la vodka with proscuitto and it was mediocre.

I have stayed here several times when it was the Holiday Inn.  We recently stayed there 12/25/13, in a renovated room. Nice firm bed and extra points for the full sized pillows! (I hate those mini pillows that so many hotels are using!). The new room was very comfortable, when I stay there again in April, I am looking forward to the renovated lobby. The location is brilliant, walking distance to both the restaurants in Old City and Chinatown.  I always recommend this hotel to people who are traveling to Philly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I read the reviews for this Dunkin after I made a purchase. I hadn't been here in years but it is the closest Dunkin to us and since I wanted to grab a muffin and maybe an iced coffee I decided to make the stop. The muffin was good but the donuts I picked up were stale. We did go around 7 so I can understand that they didn't have a large selection but please don't give us minimal options and than what you do serve us is ... stale. 
My iced coffee was disappointing and I am not sure I was even served decaf. If you are looking for a good Dunkin - steer clear. Stick to the one on 611 next to Bound's. My preferred stop of choice.

Man I can't get over the street tacos. I've been coming to this place for 2 years now and I can't help but always get the chorizo and queso and the street tacos. Anytime my buddy and I say Mexican or tacos this is the place we crave and we both get the same thing every time. Maybe one day I will venture off to other items. But they always say if it ain't broke don't fix it. 

Oh and how can I forget the endless chips and salsa! Also the quac but now I can't remember if it's the Vallarta or the other that's not amazing sorry just ask for the fresh one and not paste lol

This place is fantastic! I wish I had photos but I forgot to take some! Firstly, the service is one of the best I've experiences in the Tampa area. This makes a huge difference after a busy week and when you're just looking for a nice place to eat. I ordered some vegetarian tacos with a lettuce wrap - the perfect bite! NOTE: They have a secret taco (you can check their Instagram or ask your server). They're usually a meat item so I've never had them. My friends loved their ahi tuna taco and their baja fish. You can't go wrong here!

Went by for dinner with my wife. Been here several times and thought the food was so so. I had the chopped salad and she had the soup and salad. Chopped salad and chicken velvet soup.

Can not understand all the hoopla about the chicken velvet soup. These people must have decaying taste buds. It is mediocre at best according to an awesome cook.....my wife. The chopped salad was satisfactory.

The real reason was the service. We waited a long time to place our order and longer to get a check then we got the wrong one. I can forgive mediocre chicken velvet soup since it might be a bad batch but crappy service is inexcusable. O-3 and they are OUT

Came here for the first time and got a gel mani and pedi. The salon is clean and spacious. They have several pedicures packages to choose from, but I just got the basic one. Angela did my pedicure and she was so sweet and took her time to make sure she did a great job. Sandy did my manicure and she was great too. I got a quick but wonderful shoulder and back massage while my nails were drying, then afterward she did a paraffin dip which left my hands silky smooth. I'll definitely keep coming back to this salon :)

First tiem we came to this location. My hubby and I ordered an in iced almond milk (0.50 extra) mocha latte, a regular hot coffee with a bit of ice so he could drink it sooner than later and 2 6 pc hashbrown sides. If you havent had the hasnbrown nugget/coins you are missing out. They taste so dang good I could eat way more than 6. Our guy was named Jawad (i think!) and he was THE BEST. Smiling, sweet and had a great suggestion on joining the baskin robbins club along with the DD club Im already part of. My drink was spot on and hubby's coffee was exactly how he wanted it. We will definitely come here again.

Honestly, it varies day by day and also by the time. I come here once in a while before my train commute to work to grab a caramel iced coffee. Sometimes it's lighting fast, I pay and walk out within a minute or even less! Other times, it'll take several minutes. Also the coffee can be inconsistently made. I always ask for cream and less sugar. Sometimes I'll get full sugar, other times less. Sometimes it's liquid sugar, other times it's granular. You never really know! In any case, it's a great location since I can always pick one up, you just never know what you're gonna get!

this past Friday after work since I had time still decided to get my hairs cut walked in and the owner and a few other barbers were there sitting and talking having a nice conversation between customers the owner introduced himself as I did too he started my cut then the other barber Jennifer finished and both did an awesome job the last time I was in that barber shop was 27 years ago when I first worked in that area price was very reasonable plus a few extras for a little extra fee but over all am happy got a buzz cut so I'll be cooler this summer

What a fun place! Great atmosphere, colorful. I just love it. The food is amazing, I loveee mexican so i tend to be pretty picky with my mexican choices and i was delighted. The service was just as amazing. 
The ceviche will make your tastebuds go wild, among many things i have gotten to try there i believe this continues to be my favorite...for now. 
I really do appreciate the location of Distrito seeing as though I usually have to cross the bridge into Philadelphia for some good food. 
If you are in the Moorestown, NJ area i encourage you to give this little flavor fiesta a try :)

I was so excited to have my birthday dinner from this place. We got it to-go. Unfortunately, the rice on all the sushi, rolls and press boxes were al dente. That's fine if it was pasta or risotto but sushi rice shouldn't be. The fish is raw but the rice shouldn't be. The only item on my nigiri sushi and rolls that were cooked by them is rice and they got that wrong. Was it an off day, maybe, but a sushi place should be able to get that right. I don't even know if the Toro, ikura, uni, yellow tail or albacore was good because it was taken over by raw rice.  I cannot give this place a second chance.

Although this place is set up for the mans delight I still dare to go there for my cut. It's the best shaved undercut I've had, Shannon perfects it for me every visit. We get a quick girl talk in, once in a while I'm even treated to a kool design on the side by Scott. This place is kinda like a salon for men so if your into great services, a good cut with a smile then go here. Only $12 for all of their concierge type treatment is an amazing value. They take walk ins but I found an booked appointment helps, I was told about another location further south opening soon when I stopped in last week.

Not a great night at Sake Café.  My companions both had sushi rolls for their dinner.  They both thought the sushi was very dry, almost as if it had been pre-made for quick service.  The shrimp tempura roll was also filled with a large amount of lettuce, which I have never seen before and wasn't very welcome.  I had the chicken katsu entrée.  The chicken was also on the dry side, as was the rice that accompanied it.  The dipping sauce reminded me of Bullseye BBQ sauce.  Overall, a very uninspired meal, definitely not a priority to return.

Clean store, usually ample parking. They often have some kind of two for one deal on some meats or sausage and they have a fuel perks program in conjunction with Shell. They don't have a whole lot of organic produce and I'm not sure about any of the meats. They do have a small section of organic and gluten free products just past the produce section, though I'm not sure it's any cheaper than Whole Foods. The salad bar looks like there isn't a lot of turnover. Overall, they should have most of what you're looking for, unless they are some specialty items.

Little Tokyo had a really large menu. Their combo dinners are a pretty good bet. You get a ton of food for under $20. On this occasion, my fiancé and I got an order of the hibachi rice with chicken, the sizzling beef wrapped around asparagus, a crunchy roll, a spicy crunchy roll, and a shrimp tempura roll. The rice was pretty good and it is a large portion big enough to share. The beef has a nice teriyaki glaze. The sushi was just okay. The spicy crunchy roll did not have much in the way of crunchy and the shrimp tempura roll had nothing else in it but a whole lot of cucumber sticks.

Stayed here for a wedding this past weekend. Room was impossible to get a comfortable temperature. There were no drapes/curtains behind the sheers so the sun blasted into our room at 6am. Stopper inside toilet was corroded and toilet would not flush causing it to run all night. Went down for the complimentary breakfast at 10:40 and they were starting to clean it up and literally took food away as we were making plates and turned off juice/water dispenser. Ice makers on 2 of the 4 floors were broken. Bed was super comfy and there is a nice, large fridge in the room...but that's about it. Location is pretty convenient too.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've relocated outside of Los Angeles, and I still wait until I go back to Florida ever so often to get my haircut. Becky is so sweet and amazing! I'm not usually a fan of the Asian style haircut with all the layers, as I have thick, Filipino hair, but she understands that and cuts it just as I want it. 
My favorite part is when they wash your hair...their shampoo lady has magic hands. I always want to fall asleep afterwards.

Their prices are decent, but the service and their generosity go above and beyond.

Hands down my favorite sushi restaurant in New Tampa and Wesley Chapel area. I've dined here a handful of times and every time left happily full and satisfied with all of the rolls. Their variety and quality is fantastic. Most recently, I ordered take out and again everything was delicious. As pictured I ordered the following (not in order as pictured): avocado roll, crazy roll, spicy salmon roll, butterfly roll, godzilla roll, and rainbow roll. If I had to pick my favorite it would be butterfly! It's a perfect combination.

The food and drinks are phenomenal (highly recommend trying their cheese board appetizer and the R&T fish entree) and the service is wonderful. Our waitress took her time reviewing the menu, answering questions, and sharing recommendations. It's a quaint and intimate restaurant with an open kitchen, which is perfect for date nights or small parties. However, a true "wow" factor is missing; perhaps it's due to the fact I have only been once? So I plan to return soon and try a few other appetizers and entrees in hopes it changes my mind. Also, several of their appetizers and entrees are a bit overpriced.

I came here for my birthday with a friend last month and I love it here. This restaurant reminds me a lot of iHop and Waffle House mixed into one, but with a little local flavor twist to it. My absolute favorite thing here is their waffles. Oh man do their waffles taste good! The staff is nice and friendly, and the restaurant itself is super clean. 

My only issue is the noise level when it comes to the kitchen. You can hear the dishes drop into the sink and hear everything cooking. Aside from that I love it.

Called on Saturday for a curbside order. This was my first time ordering and I was really craving lasagna. 
Pickup went great. I loved the look of the lasagna. It was pretty. I love having both a cream and red sauce on the lasagna. It was good. Solid. But I'm not sure it's an $18 piece of lasagna. Maybe if it came with a salad I would feel more comfortable with spending that amount of money. Or if I were dining in and enjoying the ambiance as well. It was good. But I'm not sure I'll be rushing back anytime soon.

Don's always done good work on my car at a fair price.  You can get in pretty quick for an oil change, usually without an appointment.  My car is getting older and is having more issues...I'm trying to get every last mile out of it. I know he thinks I'm beating a dead horse at this point (he's pretty much told me to get a new car the last two times I came in). So, he's been a little impatient with me lately especially because he can get really busy.  However, I know he still slips in a little extra work for me just to keep me up and running.  :)

There is no way on earth that this quaint ice cream shop should have so many five star reviews. It almost makes me question whether all the other reviewers are real! It isn't that the ice cream is bad, it is just that there is no way this place deserves five stars. I went in expecting smooth and creamy, dense and luscious ice cream. Instead, I received average ice cream (politely served!) at best. There is better ice cream in New Orleans, by far.  I almost didn't write this review, as I hate being negative about small homegrown businesses. I suggest that the owner go have a few scoops at the local creameries and step up his game a notch or two.

Really love Mexican food. We realize it isn't authentic to the truest sense of the word, but it's florida not Mexico City.  So for the restaurants in this area for our taste Urban Cantina is one of the best.  Like the down town location and the looks of the restaurant is bit funk and casual.  The service is always great and you can count on their advice for a great meal.  The drinks are great and strong.  I always have the fish tacos. I'm in love with the, crispy and soft, pickle onion and slaw and the sauce is fantastic.  Step to the south of tampa and get your tastebuds spiced up...ps try the verde sauce.

We've been going to here for years, mainly because its the only place that is pretty much consistent. The food is ok, kind of like a Taco bell on steroids, quick and clean with no frills, The problem with the Boise area is ALL the Mexican restaurants have pretty much the same menu and taste to there food. Its like the all came from the same area in Mexico and they alll learned to coos the same way. Would really like to see a TEX-MEX restaurant come into the valley that didn't smother there food with cilantro.

I've came here a few times, most of the time when I come here with friends we just order a few rolls & split them! The rolls are delicious, I've never really been disappointed in the food, but the last visit our waiter took awhile to come back and take our order, it was a little busier so that's probably why, but I feel like we waited too long! The parking isn't the greatest either because they do share the parking lot with the other businesses. Dragon eyes, mango tango & the spicy tuna rolls are my top favourite!

We came here last night around midnight, it wasn't our first choice but the kitchen was still open. We had the platter to share between 3 people that was very good, I would recommend getting it if your  just wanting an appetizer. I also had the frozen rocket drink which is my favourite one at BPS, but when the waitress came out she said that its runny today for some reason? I said ok? I would expect something to be frozen, not melted. The waitress wasn't the best, and around 1:00am they were putting up the chairs, gave us our bill was made seem like we had to leave right away. They close at 2am, so the service should be until then.

Truly scary .... that's the first thing that comes to mind followed by dark, dingy, dirty, looking ...!

Upon entering you immediately sense you're going back in time to a 20's seedy underground bar.  Dark, musty just an almost ominous environment where you have one hand guarding your wallet while wondering if you are going to get mugged, or worse end up dead in a dumpster this is the feeling and impression you get.

After waiting 15 minutes for a menu I followed my instincts which were fight or flight so I flew the coop only to look back to make sure I wasn't followed !!

This post is as of 3/31/19.   My son and I have not been here in over  a year .... Seems we have not missed anything .    Sadly while some of the staff may have changed the same low standards for low quality food has not changed .   

Eggs Benedict is still over cooked poached hard eggs on uncooked English muffins with an eyedroppers worth of hollandaise sauce.

The carving station is still serving over cooked roast beef and turkey.   Very sad because this place could be a home run if the kitchen staff showed the same dedication to excellence as some of the wait staff.   For $50.00 we have officially given up and will not be back.

This place was just okay. The ambience was nice. I like their little back patio area. Truthfully I have only been once and I had some appetizer or small plate with Brie and it was not good. Maybe the brie was off? It was really inedible and the bartender/server never bothered to ask if i would like something else or is she should cancel it out, considering the whole thing stayed on my plate and was left behind. Ps. I love Brie just not what ever it was they served me. Anyhow that was enough to keep me from returning there.

I do not get all the hype? Four of us visited here for dinner for a birthday. The space was cramped (we are not big people). There were a lot of people that evening which tells me they probably have a following. I also thought this because the owner (or at least i though he was) was greeting a few parties as if he knew them. the food was not bad but it was not good. It was bland, which I am not used to with Italian. Also it was way over priced for what they were selling, $20 for a piece of chicken and then you have to buy the pasts on the side? No thank you! We were very underwhelmed and will never go back.

Ambience was nice. The place is very clearly a hipster spot. The service was pretty good. I went to this place because so many people recommended it and it happened to be recommended by my AIRBNB host. The food was just okay and I felt it was over priced. Put it this way... I cant remember what I had to eat :-( . Maybe they have improved since I have been there? When I went I sat upstairs in the inside section across from the upstairs bar. I remember there being a second floor patio and thinking how beautiful it would be to have dinner out there. They were pretty busy that night and I guess I was pretty lucky to get a table so last minute.

I've been going here for years. The service has always been top notch. Everyone is very friendly and helpful. They have an Optomap retinal exam that takes a picture of your eye, which is way better than using the old dilating drops. They have a wonderful selection of frames, sunglasses, children's. Prescription sunglasses were a game changer for me. The brands they carry are higher end, big names. So they can be pricey, though they have a good mix. The only problem lately had been a turnover of doctors. Not sure why, but it's not a big deal, maybe just a little frustrating.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I was very excited to try this place after our foodie friends had recommended it...I can't say I was too impressed. Though the food does taste close to authentic, I feel that there are much better Italian options in the city. The flavor is not there with their dishes. The restaurant has a family style home-y vibe which is something you can't find often in the city at Italian restaurants! We felt so welThe wine options weren't too great, and the place is very cramped. Dessert was DELICIOUS and if I do come back, I will definitely be coming for that! Service was really good too, the wait staff was extremely friendly.

I was very excited to try this place after our food friends had recommended it...I can't say I was too impressed. Though the food does taste close to authentic, I feel that there are much better Italian options in the city. The flavor is not there with their dishes. The restaurant has a family style home-y vibe which is something you can't find often in the city at Italian restaurants! We felt so welcomed. The wine options weren't too great, and the place is very cramped. Dessert was DELICIOUS and if I do come back, I will definitely be coming for that! Service was really good too, the wait staff was extremely friendly.

This was my families TO GO order tonight...

Qt. House special fried rice:
Not at all special, very little meat. The rice wasn't golden, more like the color of soy sauce on white rice. 

LG.  Krabmeat ragoon:
ok.

2 pork egg rolls:
Tasty.

Qt. Beef lo mein:
Not over the top bad, just pretty bland. The noodles were good.  Very little beef.

Qt. sweet & sour chicken:
tasty.

BOTTOM LINE:
Not worth the drive from my home, I'll never go out of my way to eat here.

They didn't even give us fortune cookies. My order was $32.00

Dissapointing considering I'm trying to find some local Chinese food.

I am new to the area and used Yelp to decide on this salon after reading all the good reviews. 

The staff was friendly and my stylist was very nice.  I arrived on time for my appointment and was asked if wanted coffee and only waited about a minute before being seen.  My stylist worked quickly and made small talk while asking minimal questions about my personal life, which I appreciated. 

The cost was on the mid to high end ($45 for a layered trim) but scheduling was easy and the cut was quick and well done.  I will most likely be returning for my next haircut.

Every time I go to this location, they have a bunch of retarded people working. Why bother asking what kind of sauce someone wants? They aren't gonna get it. Why bother asking what gender for the toy? They'll forget to give you one or give the wrong one. And almost every single time I order a sausage biscuit, some dumbass puts cheese on it? Like what the fuck? There isn't ever supposed to be cheese on it. It's  a sausage biscuit. Plus don't even ask me how disgusting the inside is. They might as well not even have workers hired to clean.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
As someone who spends a lot of time working near and around the Royal Alex Hospital, Sapporo Sushi has often been my go-to for takeout during long, never ending nights of work.

For a period of time, the girls actually recognized my voice when I used to put in my orders.

Always ready in 10 to 15 minutes. Always reasonably fresh and tasty. Always fairly priced.

They had kimchi for a while, but it seems to be off the menu now. The restaurant itself is sort-of second tier when it comes to Japanese in our city, but they don't seem to take themselves too seriously... and it works for them.

I was so happy to be done with NBAZ when I walked into one of their branches on 4/22 to permanently close my account.

I happened to log in to my old NBAZ account tonight while looking for past deposit. I was shocked to see that the auto pay that I forgot to transfer to my new bank actually went through on a CLOSED account nearly a month later!

The payment was returned the next day, but a $35 insufficient funds fee still remains. 

How do you get rid of this bank?! I filed a BBB complaint, so hopefully I can end this nightmare soon.

The main advantage of this sushi place is the location : right next to the movie theater.

Prices are fair, but the food is quite mediocre. I'd consider this sushi place more like a "fast food" sushi restaurant. You place your order at the counter, get a tag and wait for them to bring you the plate.

The chicken teriyaki is average, California rolls can often be a little soggy and not very pleasant to eat. It depends when you go.

Overall not a first-choice restaurant but definitely to consider if you want a quick bite for not too much.

Well let me say this is an expensive Marriott for being in Reno! The hotel is very nice. However they struggle in sending the receipts after you stay there and for me as a Marriott member. I called and asked for them to send me a receipt and the person that answered the phone said he could not find it and hung up on me!

Just recently they went to full valet parking and a steep increase in pricing on an already super expensive hotel for Reno. What is the GM thinking? When I ask the employees they just shake their heads and say they completely understand where I am coming from.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Sake house is a great place to eat when you are having that late night sushi craving. After 10 PM, they have $5 rolls on items 1-30 on their menu.  I really like the dynamite roll. I also like the rainbow and Kiran roll which does not qualify for the $5 roll special. But they have other specials that come with a miso soup and salad on their regular dinner menu. The miso soup and salad are both really delicious. Although the sushi isn't the absolute best I've ever had, it is satisfying enough to hit the spot. Great for students living near USF.

My grandparents lived up the river from this place as far back as I can remember.  They partied it up with friends here many times from what I heard.  It's located right on the Alafia River and can be accessed via boat or car.  I finally got to go with my grandparents one time when I was a teenager.  It reminded me of a tree house with lots of wooden deck interior. There was an outside deck with a nice view of the river. Everyone was friendly and no riff raff of a small pub.  I will have to visit again one day.  My grandparents are no longer around, but I miss hearing the stories of the ole Beer Shed.

They pretty much do anything and at a fair reasonable price. I stopped by because they were close to work and I was able to leave it there and pick it up by lunch time they even gave me a lift. The staff is super friendly and I was really impressed with my first experience the reason I would give them 3 star is because one time they replaced a tire and it was the wrong size so it set off a lot of my sensors and it took several trips and over 10 hrs of sitting around waiting to find out what was wrong with my car and two pulls on my warranty and deductible to figure out it was just the tire replacement.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Unquestionably THE most extraordinary array of 5 star service, cuisine and presentation anywhere...for miles and miles.  Just look at the menu, and find yourself INSTANTLY saying "...Yum, yum.  I like that, and that, and that...AND that"!!  So artfully orchestrated, the type, quality an AMOUNT of service alone is so gratifying.  This is your relative's family wanting so deeply to make sure that you like EVERYTHING.  It's all from the heart and deeeelicious!   Not inexpensive...but, the best things never are.

BK is promoting their Café, so I gave it a shot. I went through the drive through, as my large Café was handed to me. 

It was not hot. When I arrived at my destination, I opened the lid. It smelled awful. It has to be THE CHEAPEST coffee grounds known to mankind (and womenkind). I tried doctoring it up, which I shouldn't have to do. Waste of blood, sweat and tears.

Long story short: This BK location should pay customers to try their Café. Hear me now, thank me later: Go to the next block and get a decent cup of Café from McDee's.

We have no idea why this place is so high rated. The sushi was way overpriced ($6 for a CALIFORNIA ROLL!), the atmosphere wasn't great, the server was pushy, and the more expensive rolls (which we tried despite the cost) were all very plain tasting and not all too good. In addition, our waitress was pushy and annoying until it was time to get the check. That took her almost 10 minutes, even though there were only people at 3 tables, and us and one other couple at the bar. 

Overall cost, including a 15% tip was around $45 for two.

If you want good sushi and a good experience, go somewhere else.

I had a craving for some sushi and searched for close pick up places. I saw the positive reviews on Yelp! and decided to give Crazy Sushi a try. I tried three different options over two days and I am sad to say the sushi was no better than an option from a super market. 

There was nothing "crazy" about the sushi. Great decor, staff seems nice and the lunch special is a great deal but its not knock your socks off. Also, the miso soup is a huge "no no". I have had miso before and it definitely was a miss. I could not even finish it.

I ordered delivery from here this past weekend becuase my boyfriend was BEGGGGGING me that he wanted a fat roscoe sandwich. I personally am not one to enjoy a sandwich filled with every appetizer in the world possible but I did order the munchie madness which is basically every appetizer in the world joint as one. Even though it took about an hour, it went by pretty fast. I enjoyed the munchie madness, everything was pretty good quality and the mozz sticks were surprisingly amazing. i would definitely drunkenly order from here again

came here for hibachi for lunch and had a great time!

great deal on hibachi... except they charge you extra for fried rice which is LAME bc everyone knows fried rice at hibachi is the best fried rice so how are you not gonna order it?

i started out with the shrimp shumai which was OK, nothing spectacular. the lunch sized hibachi isn't huge, so i had a couple pieces of steak and like 5 pieces of calamari. i hate that they chop up the noodles so they're small pieces but they're still tasty

overall, i'll definitely be back to try their other dishes!

I am pretty impressed with this place; not always good sushi in Langhorne but this might be the best one!

I ordered some rolls here for delivery to my office and they were delicious! All the fish were so fresh and cut well, I am really impressed. The yellowtail jalapeno was fresh and perfectly rolled. The salmon and avocado roll was everything I always want it to be; huge chunks of salmon not that shredded stuff, I hate that.

My only criticism would be the salad. Salad was cut very messy and no other vegetable but lettuce. But other than that sushi was amazing.

This pizza place isn't one for everyone, it depends how you like your pizza dough consistency. I would say the pizza here is definitely soft, doughy; you'll have to fold the slices in half to eat. If you're one that likes thin and crunchy crust, you won't be a fan. I got the diavolo pizza and it was very good! I loved the salami and cheese but I also tried a slice of the brocolli rabe and sausage and the broccoli rabe was SO BITTER, i couldn't even eat it and I'm a huge fan of broccoli rabe. I think it needed to be cooked differently to be not so bitter on the pizza. The place is a bit pricey so be prepared!

I just went in for dessert because people told me that this place would offer me churros that were good since I couldn't find a restaurant that would serve these and my goodness were they delicious! It was definitely a plus when it came with vanilla ice cream all for $5! The only downfall is if you order online, they won't get it so when you go in there for your online to go order, they don't have it. It's kind of dumb to have the ability to order online but get there and your order was never placed. The only downfall for me besides not having lunch there and only dessert.

Hate this dunkin donuts. Please do yourself a favor and DO NOT visit this location. I work locally and live in king of prussia and sometimes get stuck ordering from here when I'm in a rush and don't wanna pay for Starbucks because it gets a little pricy. Anywho, they never understand a word I'm saying. I have to repeat myself four or five times when I can hear them not paying attention and having side conversations in the background about nothing. Half the time, I go to the window and my orders wrong and then they're constantly forgetting stuff in my order but charging me. Always an issue, these people are complete idiots.

Wonderful concierge. Wonderful room. Wonderful amenities. 

We booked a King suite with a city view and our room did not disappoint. We had a great view overlooking Logan Square and City Hall on the 23rd floor. Our room was impeccable upon check-in. We were even given free happy hour drink tickets for the two nights we stayed in addition to the free breakfast buffet at the in house TGI Fridays. 

My only gripe is that there is no free in-room WiFi, but not many hotels have that nowadays. 

Great location right in Logan Square. Will definitely consider booking again if the need arises!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Booked my room on name your price and got it at a great rate. Unfortunately when I check-in they say they only have double beds left and since I booked on a third party site they don't reserve your bed preference, Oh but there is a queen available for a $20 fee. I thought there were not any left? Love the location and the free pretzels, fruit, water and soda in the lobby.  I would stay there again even though they tried to get me for an extra $20 and the people that were smoking wacky tobacky in their room that had me waking up starving.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ordered unagi  and an  order of  shrimp  katsu  curry ,the unagi was a  half  order anywhere else  for  the  price  of $16.50 ,the Shrimp dish at $12.50  was  primarily  rice ,curry sauce , potatoes and  carrots  with  maybee three bites of  chicken in it  and  2  small tempura  shrimp  ........i had   leftover  chinese food  after  eating here ....won't  be on our  list  to return  to...................also in  addition  they  have  several  dishes  with  spicy  tuna but no  dishes  with  regular  tuna  , a  sure  sign  that theyre  buying  low  value  tuna  and  using the  chili powder to mask the quality ...ick

I keep trying the drive-through but so far I have only ever received an incorrect drink order (it has been 5+ times now). I am not sure why this is I have never had a consistent problem at any starbucks and they don't' even offer to correct it either.  That being said, this is just one of those starbucks that don't know how to handle the rush and if its not too busy and you go inside they are friendly and nice and get your drink right...just stay away from the drive-through! I keep thinking it might get better and try every once in awhile but it has literally been a bad experience every time.

Went again tonight with another friend. Had a whole room to ourselves and had a great experience! Salmon stuffed w/crabmeat was excellent, and the spun sugar pumpkin filled w/chocolate mousse was so beautiful, we hated to crack it open (but very glad we did because the mousse was sooo good! It is seriously amazing the chef is able to stuff these delicate shells with the mousse just before serving, as they are so very delicate and thin. Definitely a talent developed with lots of time and practice! Excellent service from our wait staff. Will definitely be back soon to see their spun sugar Christmas tree deserts!

So sad. This McD's used to be a decent place, but ever since ownership changed, it is the absolute WORST! Employees suck... they are always on their phones, are rude to deal with, and always screw up orders. New owner... I hope you are reading this! You really need to clean house! We own a business right up the road and used to get lunch here almost daily.... but we will find other places and will no longer be recommending this McD's in our list of possible dining locations for our clients. If anyone reading is craving MdD's, the Downingtown one is SO much better! Great customer service and they mostly get your order correct.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Worst Mexican food I've had in a long time, and some of the most expensive. Service was fine, the restaurant clean, but the food was awful so what's the point? This place used to be okay, (I've lived in Carp since 1994) but even then they never put a lot of care into their food. For example, all of the cheese and/or rice would be at one end of a burrito, and the cheese would be cold and not melted. This time, the beef in their tacos was tough and largely fat and gristle. It's been several years since I tried their food, and it's worse, not better. Last time I'll go here. There are other much better options.

I was looking for somewhere to get my nails done and this was in a convenient location so I gave them a shot. The shop is nice and clean and they have a nice selection of polishes as well as dips. I wanted a full set, in a short coffin shape which was easily taken care of. My nails look great, my only complaint is when she was filing down the sides the got into my skin and cut me, it burned when it first happened but I let it go. Later she went back over it and I couldn't take it and I was actually bleeding a little. Now it's a little swollen and painful so we'll see how long it takes to heal. That's the only reason for taking stars away.

I've been to this location three times now and never once have they had warm donuts. Today we ordered 3 donuts and some donut holes for my three year old. The donuts were so sweet and the glaze was so thick that it was falling off in huge hunks. The donut holes were hard and appeared to be from yesterday. The seating area had icing all over the floor, the table was dirty and the seats had definitely not been wiped down. Disappointing when they had three staff members visible and only three other customers. There are so many better donut places in Tucson. I think this will be our last visit.

NommingNomad Approved!

I walked in here on a Sunday for brunch and was seated promptly. It is a cute space. Unfortunately it was too chilly to sit outside. They have a lot of interesting options on the menu but I saw the lemon ricotta pancakes calling out to me. So I ordered that and didn't wait for long before the pancakes were in front of me, looking so tempting.

There were three really fluffy lemon ricotta pancakes topped with a blueberry compote which was perfection. The pancakes were one of the best I've ever had. I have to go back to try their dinner and will definitely recommend this place to anyone who asks.

Such a win!

This was not so pleasant experience at the Avis check in center.  They were overwhelmed even though it was almost midnight.  They didn't know what cars they had or where they were located.  I was sent to the wrong car in the rain then ran into a guy who worked there and he couldn't find the car, so we are walking around in the rain trying to find it.  I did find it and the car was clean, but not totally fueled up.  I didn't noticed that until I was long gone, but it was late and raining, so I just filled it up myself and ate the cost.  Needless to say, Avis will not be my first choice in St. Louis anymore.

Two strikes and out for me. I had a very mediocre haircut for $34 including 15% tip. Was expecting that my curly men's cut would be more manageable- but honestly I got a better haircut at Great Clips in Brentwood. 
Then, a completely disastrous, this-is-not-what-he-asked-for, for my 16-year old. It's not good. No, honestly it's bad. With him playing football there's no real chance to fix it. 
Nice people, and thanks for the bottle of water. I just don't think they are attracting quality hair stylists. And the pre-pay is somewhat annoying, but raises the bar. 
Save $20 and get a mediocre-to-really-bad haircut elsewhere.

For two years before I ever had to buy tires, these guys would patch up my flats for free and often checked out my oil just to be safe. 

I've been taking it in for tires, oil changes and brakes ever since.  They always give the best prices and the most honest service.

I've been ripped off @ other car places before, but I've never felt more safe in trusting my business with Big Brand in SB!

I've lived here for 34 years, and it's the best service in Santa Barbara.

Just ask for Delip or Victor, tell them Adrienne sent you :)
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I love Pizza Delicious! Garlic knots are (appropriately) very garlic-y! So if you're not into that, don't order them. The pizza is great. I love the atmosphere in and around the restaurant. Great location. I took off one star because one time when I ordered the pizza was INCREDIBLY greasy. It was a whole pepperoni pie, I ordered it to go, it was so greasy the bottom was black. I actually thought it was burnt but realized it was black from grease. That must have just been an off day, because it also took over 45 minutes to cook my pizza. But every other time it has been great and I try to go as often as I can.

Friendly. Fast. Convenient. Cheap. Love coming here for my dry cleaning needs. Everything is $2.25 which is a great deal. Use Yelp to check in and get 1 garment free. Staff is very friendly and super fast. As long as you drop off before 9am you'll have it next day. Never had any issues and I've been coming here for years. Highly recommend for any of your dry cleaning needs. Open early so you can drop off in the morning in the way into work. Always gets me in and out as well.  You do pay up front and not when you pick up. They accept credit card.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Don't let the fact that this place is in a convenient store scare you off. Their Cubans are dirt cheap and large! And soo good. They don't have pork on them but I sort of prefer my Cubans without the pork anyway. These babies have the right amount of mayo too -- it's when you have the drippy mayo that runs out of the sandwich when you know you have the perfect Cuban. The bread is so soft and fresh. We called ahead and our order was ready for us when we arrived. Friendly staff. Recommend giving this family owned establishment a try. You'll be hooked.

I'm a tad disappointed. The kids and I went for a Friday night meal.  We had been talking about Chinese for the entire week and finally decided to stop in this place. The restaurant was easy to get to and the parking was ample. Between the three of us we probably tried everything. Quite a bit of the food was cold. The fried fish was made in old grease which was obvious by the way it tasted.  There was not a lot of variety.  

The pros: the staff was very attentive and cleared our place frequently. The place was clean.

I love it here!  It's the only PF that is never crowded.  Even at peak gym times, you have access to machines and equipment with little to no wait.

It's open 24 hours so you can get your workout in at any time.  I haven't had to interact with the staff other than a hi and bye but they seem friendly enough.

The slogan is true-PF offers a no judgement zone.  You can work out without worrying about if people are watching you or sizing you up.  This place is full of people wanting to workout...not loaded with hard bodies or muscle heads like some gyms.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I joined a group of 6 for dinner over the past weekend.  A friend reserved an outdoor igloo which is perfect for people with Covid concerns.

Service was excellent.  Our waitress was prompt and checked in frequently.

I ordered the Parker House Rolls for my app and the wedge salad for my entree and both were very good. We were also given a chefs tasting which was also tasty.

We took advantage of the Yelp Check In Offer and scored a round of champagne for the table.

Unfortunately I was full of bread so I didn't have a chance to induldge in dessert.  I guess that gives me a reason to visit again

I had high hopes for this place based on the Yelp reviews but was underwhelmed with my visit.  

We were helped right away-placed our order at he counter and took a seat at an empty table waiting for our food.  We ordered a cheesesteak, cheese fries and a large pepperoni pizza .  The steak was very good and the fries were good too.  True pizza was another story.  To me, the crust was very thick and bland and tasted more like a cracker than pizza crust.  The pepperoni had a strange after taste as well.

I would visit again but I definitely would avoid the pepperoni pizza-which is unfortunate considering this is my go to item at pizza places.

This hotel is now operated by Red Roof Inn.  Re-painted the walls, room carpet was in pretty good condition, hallway n elevator carpet were filthy.  Sink and tub had no stoppers.  Swimming pool was closed, bottom of pool was black, real bad shape. 
Wi-Fi, due to the change of management no one seemed to know in-room Wi-Fi password, lobby Wi-Fi was knowned but that did not help me in the room.
Made reservation thru priceline, got a call the day of arrival that my reservations was a #/=#&$ mess.  The hotel staff made it work, that is the two stars, customer service, room was good, again two stars, but being anywhere else in hotel -zero stars.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The love affair is strong and deep. Which is surprising as I just started down the caffeine trail in the last 4 months. 

This location is along the way to work every morning, making it hard to not stop by and put in a little quality time with you. 

The drive thru is hardly ever packed and the customer service is awesome just like the whip I add on you every morning. 

The place is clean on the inside but I hardly venture in as life and responsibilities force me to keep moving expeditiously on to the next thing like the natural born millennial I am. 

You're awesome I won't leave you my hot grande caramel macchiato! 

Until tomorrow morning!

Local take out pizza pie. Good crust many items available . Free local delivery! 
Located s end of Ace hardware strip mall across delivery access alley form Bisbee breakfast club .
Usually get the special loaded w items about 18$ when family from the north vists. Very large , loaded piled high , & cut in small squares. 
Remembering his high school days some friends worked there and az pizza co. on Kolb eating a lot of pizza . 
Try it good pizza choice in foothills if hungry . 
Tried to Order  Christmas Eve but told closed thru wed after, call first !

This Publix isn't in the best location but it's still a Publix, so it's better than any other grocery store in the area. This Publix is nearby USF so you will see a lot of college students shopping here. The staff is friendly just like at any other Publix and the shelves are kept well stocked.

The parking lot is looped around with a lot of one way rows. It makes it annoying if someone decides to stop and wait for someone's parking spot while they unload a full cart since you'll be stuck waiting with nowhere to go.

By far the best iced Vanilla latte I've ever had. However I disagree about the Baristas most of the time they are busy chit chatting and have on several occasions have totally screwed up my order. I am only allowed decaf because of reflux issues and I nearly hurled after taking a big swig , when I told the girl behind the counter she mumbled something then whispered to the other girl behind the counter and then they both laughed. Not very courteous or.professional. I come by a couple times a week.but if I see her working I go elsewhere.

The adobada and asada burritos left a bit to be desired from the flavor aspect. Meats didn't really stand out as particularly good, when they should be the highlight of the meal. The plus side is the price was somewhat reasonable for Santa Barbara and they offer cactus salad (nopales: +1 star) at the salsa bar. Green sauce wasn't quite right, red (not roasted) sauce was decent but reminded me of something you serve at a Mexican birthday party with a side of chips. Cleanliness was average. Overall probably won't be returning.

This isn't my regular place..I went here with a friend bc that's his usual place. Worst gel manicure I've ever had. I got it fri and by Sunday it was chipping and Monday, today, it's peeling off. Gel has always lasted at least 3 weeks before chipping or peeling on my nails. It was also a sloppy job, there's bumps all over the polish. It also wasn't a full manicure yet I paid full price. My nails were buffed and cuticles cut that's it. I would drive back but I live so far away. If you're looking for a new salon this isn't it.

Worst fries ever! Soggy as hell very oily and no one here when we arrived feels like just passing off old fries to customers. Burgers tasteless and greasy as hell we both won't return to this Restuarant  as it was horrible food for burgers! Lucky to get a 2 star rating for the food they serve! Fries should be cooked more and same with the burgers ! A complete disappointment but am sure it won't last long if the food is like this all the time I won't bring my worst enemy here to eat this  food. The owner should be ashamed of the quality of the food he serves I would be!

Great place! Probably the best toasted ravioli in St Louis where it was supposed to be invented.  Good price for a group or family. Parking is a bitch.  Parking only enough for two restaurants.  Spaghetti and meatballs were good with huge meatballs as it should be. Fish was prepared well and tasty.  Appetizer was the raviolis and as mentioned superb.  Wine and beer selection could be a little better for my tastes...like add another Sangiovese or two and couple more Cabs at mid-price to match the family atmosphere here. Cheers!

I don't go to the Starbucks very often but stopped by a couple times this week when i was in the area. I was able to order and move through the line pretty quickly during the morning rush around 7:30am. I ordered my favorite drink an iced caramel brulee latte and was devastated that they were out of that flavor! They offered me a toasted white chocolate mocha which i don't like white chocolate but i appreciated the suggestion. They had pumpkin which i settled on which was made well. I would definitely come back to this location when I'm in the area and it's a plus that they share a building with Chipotle if you're around during lunch.

So ...we had been waiting to go here for a while and today we decided to try it out ( we were excited ) . Went in and it wasn't really crowded found seats at the bar . We weren't greeted for a while and felt odd that a couple who came in after us was served before us . The longer we sat there ignored the more we felt not welcomed . We are a same sex couple and really felt like maybe the bartender was saying stay away . Weird . Oh well ...went back to downtown Dunedin and had fun drinks and dinner . We won't be going back. And side note ...none of the servers wore masks . Hmmmm.

Use to go here but now in Surat he of a new salon I was a client here for 2 years and they added a color correction $300 extra without telling me. It was also odd since I've only had coloring for them for the last two years. 
The stylist told me there was no extra charge for curl (while she wanted my hair curled).  The owner tried to nickel and dime the to add up the cost of $400 total spent for my hair. 
The owner's response to a client of being unhappy was horrible. I literally drive from saint Pete to there. 
Mind you my sister had her hair dyed as well and that was $400 the same day. 800$ total

Came in because my car was having trouble. It turned out to just be the battery. Mike and his team were very friendly and honest. They helped me get back on the road same day. I was blown away with the service and affordability. Since I was in a hurry I only had time for the battery change so they made a follow up appointment so that I could come in and have my oil changed and run a diagnostic on my car to make sure everything else was okay. It was and the second visit was just a nice as the first. I can see why they have been in business so long, this is definitely a stand up auto shop and one that I trust.

wow wish we'd read the reviews before going .. being a chain restaurant you'd expect some standards to the product and service ... not saaaa much. the corporate office needs to do some spot inspections and because this was shameful in service, product. looking at the reviews I see this wasn't just an off day. The trash was overflowing and the bathrooms were disgusting. No soap in the bathroom. I don't usually review chain fast food places because they are usually standard .. this was farrrrr below standard.

          this location is near the zoo, art museum and forest park.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Anytime Fitness is run by some really nice people! I just started a membership and have only been a few times. The equipment is all in working order, clean, and ready for use. They have a really cool room that has a virtual personal trainer. You just plug in whatever exercise you want to do from yoga to spinning and a big projector screen comes down and the virtual trainer takes you through the exercise. Pretty cool! 

This is a great place if you're on the NE side of town and need a gym that's always available.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I don't see much point in leaving a review. Obviously they don't care with all the bad reviews on here they do nothing to remedy the complaints. Anyways my advice is to check and make sure all the items you order are in the bag before you leave the drive thru. Half the time it is missing items. I order the big breakfast, half the time it is missing the hash browns. Another time I get the coffee and then he looks at me like I should drive away, I say I'm still waiting for my meal, he gets it and then there is no hash brown, I have to ask for that as well. Don't expect too much from absent minded high school drop outs working for minimum wage.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If the cafeteria wasn't so bad at the hospital I don't think we would ever eat here. That being said, they're just as bad. Pizza is bad, most all the appetizers are frozen fried crap, the hoagies are dry, the older ladies taking your orders hates being there and hates people. The teenagers who worked there prior during lunch time are nicer and more accommodating. The only good thing they have on the menu is the seasoned fries! Don't change that!! . If this place was good the entire hospital would be mobbing this place, instead it's just another option for the people who didn't pack their lunch today.

A great new addition to the neighborhood! Nori Sushi is a modern and well decorated space on South Street. It is reasonable priced, with a 3 roll + salad or soup special at lunch ($11) and dinner ($14). I ordered the spicy salmon and Alaska rolls, and the fish was fresh and tasty. My dining companion and I were treated to a complimentary chicken dish that was also delicious. The service was fast and friendly too! I'll definitely be stopping by in the future for takeout and to try some of their special rolls as well! They're currently having an opening promotion with 10% off all orders, so hurry in!

If you're searching for a great happy hour, look no further than Lolita. I visited the establishment around 5:30 on a Thursday with a friend, and we were quickly seated. I highly recommend the blood orange margs (only $6) which taste great and aren't too sweet! I ordered the chicken taquitos, and my friend ordered the tacos (both of which were on the $5 snack menu), and we were pretty satisfied. The portions are relatively small, so I would recommend ordering at least 3 for a party of two to split! Overall, I had a great experience and I can't wait to come back to try out their late night happy hour!

My husband have lived in Downingtown for 5 years and never tried this place. We didn't have a reservation & were able to get seated right away at about 5:30pm on a Saturday. Definitely a louder place as it seems to be good for families & large groups. Our entrees came with a salad which is nice because you don't get that much anymore. We were also served bread with oil and herbs. I had the linguini with clams & my husband had chicken parm. We both loved our meals! We had recently been to lemoncello & the linguini with clams was better here. It's byob which is awesome!

Scary walk through this strip mall parking lot.  Located next to the H2O punch palace.   At night, you will either be buzzed in, or served through a barred window.  It's up to the discretion of the attendant.  They are always really nice to me and watch me walk back to my car.  They will bring in products for you.  Just ask.   I guess the surprising find was some good bottles of wine hiding on the shelves. Since it's not an oenophile destination, perhaps these bottles stay safe and cellared as a nice treat for a neighbourhood patron, too lazy to drive to a large liquor market.

Went here last week for a graduation celebration. Service was good, however the food was meh at best, especially for the price. I've had better from olive garden, and I truly mean that. Also, I didn't really enjoy seeing ( I assume) the owners wife and kids in full view doing homework, etc, and also eating. You're a business, and you should be professional. There's no reason I should have to see and hear your kids doing whatever they're doing. We were there to celebrate, and you ruined it. So, thanks for that, I guess? 

Much MUCH better Italian restaurants in Collingswood to choose from, and more more professional.

We stopped in here before we headed to Mardi Gras parades. The restaurant was surprisingly empty which was lucky for us. The service was fast and friendly, especially considering the parades were right outside their doors. The food was very good. The corn bisque was soooo good! You could tell that the food was fresh and not a pre-made pour it into the fryer type meal. Everything was very clean, which is again impressive during Mardi Gras. We were all very pleasantly surprised and will definitely go back next time we are in the area.

Fun friendly local ice cream shop.  Coming here you have the option of going through the drive through or ordering outside.  There is no indoor seating area, but there are table around the shop to sit and relax.  

This place is constantly busy.  I've seen it where the drive through would extend into the street.  All the staff is friendly, you don't feel rushed when ordering.  

Portions are enormous here. I recommend sticking with the small sizes unless you are sharing.  Everything I've tasted is good, haven't had a bad experience yet.

I haven't been to Koizi in a while, probably over a year.  I went recently for a friend birthday, the quality has definitely dropped a lot.  For lunch, it is still worth it, but you probably can't expect to have good quality food.

The sushi is OK.  I feel like to save on money, they go a little lighter on the fish and heavy on the rice.  Also many of their rolls are covered in sauce.  Staff is friendly, if it is busy they do seem a little distracted but not a big deal.

Overall I believe this place is nice for lunch, but wouldn't go out of my way for it.

Typical dunkin donuts. I drove by the first time on free iced coffee day but the line inside and out was obviously crazy. I returned the next day because my usual office coffee supplier was going to be out. As a beginner coffee drinker I wasn't sure what to get and the guy behind the counter was knowledgeable on all their options. I got a coconut flavored coffee and two donuts for a little over $3... Good deal to me! I got a chocolate glazed which I usually love but for some reason was super sweet as was the sour cream one. It's a very convenient spot though so I shall return if I need a sweet fix or done morning caffeine.

My wife and I have eaten there two times. Once was back in 2004. The waitress stuck us in the back corner and completely forgot about us. The meal was ok, but that night they had a loud musician playing and we couldn't even talk to each other. The second time was about a week ago. The service is VERY slow there. The food was still just ok. Before our main entries came out, we asked for a second glass of wine since it took so long for our meal to arrive. We did not get the wine until we had almost completed eating our meal. SLOW SERVICE.

I wouldn't recommend. It's below average at best. The staff smiles but still has an air about them like you're wasting their time.  The $25 wash as a whole was a waste. My windows still have streaks and the inside was hardly done. You can see where they vacuumed the floors in a square foot radius and missed everything outside of that zone i.e. the reachable and visible under the seat section. My inside doors weren't cleaned at all and my hood still looks like there's bird poo on it. Definitely trying somewhere else next time.

Worst McDonald's ever!! Never once have I been to this location and they got my order right! I mean how hard is your job?? I'm not going to say much here cause their not worth my time but if I can save one person from going here I'll feel better. Place is always dirty inside employees would rather be on their phones then cleaning. 

I go in today for a quick breakfast I order two egg mcmuffins. Simple order right? Yeah I open them up to find out it's just bread and cheese!! No egg!! Umm.... Really?? And what's sad is this isn't the first time. Do yourself a favor and find a different McDonald's trust me.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
This car wash is pretty good, especially for the price. I wish they had someone to dry the water off of my car and windows after the wash because I tend to leave with my windows still with water on them and then get water marks. But I guess I can't really complain for a $5 wash. I also think this wash takes a lot of the top layer dirt off but doesnt do a heavy duty job for the caked on dirt from the winter. 

The free vacuums that they offer are fantastic. Super strong and clean my  mats great! Overall, this place is pretty good and I would recommend it since I find this to be the best car wash locally in this area.

I love to give good reviews but feel the need to be honest here on this one.  The pizza came and the slices were not cut even at all. Some were huge some were small. The taste was good.
The italian grinder was soaked in vinegar and there was more vinegar sitting in the bottom of the container. The bread was totally wet and soggy. 
A small packet of dressing was included but never would have been enough for the large salad that came. Some of the cucumber slices were fresh and tasty but a few were turning translucent. This was our second time trying Westshore. Not very impressed either time.

Went here today after a friend of mine recommended it sometime ago. It was great! I was pleasantly surprised by how thoroughly  cleaned our car, it looked great inside and outside! The waiting facilities were cool as well, they were outside breezy and shady. They have a small location but they make it work and the wait was not that long especially when I could see that they were doing a really good job cleaning the car. If you need gas they have a couple of pumps in the back with very good prices! My only concern was that the attendant whom first took our car was rude  but other than that everything was good!

I hate to say this because the people were so nice there, but crust was flavorless, sauce was old, the pizza cheese (not real cheese trust me when I came home it was 1 slab of rubber but I did not want to re heat or even try to eat cold) and all toppings were old and stale (sausage was like dog food nuggets) or canned or both. Definitely canned mushrooms. It's strange because we went based on more recent reviews being positive but the ones that are a little older seem to be more accurate. Extra star for the very friendly folks who run the place and the fact they had Amberbock on draft

This place was just delicious. We started with the sour dough bread that was delicious and the breech mushrooms which were tasty but I probably wouldn't order again. My husband got the octopus and loved it. I got the pork shoulder and it really was to die for. Best pork shoulder I have ever had. Everything on the plate complimented each other and was satisfying. I ordered one of the specialty cocktails, the petruska, and personally it was not tasty - tasted like a citronella candle.
