All in all I left there stuffed and by the time I was home I was craving the food again. You won't be disappointed.

I felt compelled to write a review as I witnessed the most disgusting thing. There was a worker there smoking outside. She saw me and my kids come in ready to order a sandwich. She proceeded to go in the back (as I was closely watching her to see if she was going to wash her hands.) She didn't then proceeded to ask us what we wanted while putting gloves on never washing her hands. I quickly walked out with my kids and made a promise to myself never to set foot again in this store. If only the owner knew how disgusting her hygiene was. They've lost a customer for good. So gross

I have not been to Macaroni Grill in about 5 years and now I remember why.  The new menu is less than memorable and if my favorites from the past Penna Rustica had very little flavor.  At this particular location, the servers appeared less than interested in taking care of the customers.  They were busy talking.  For a party of 4 the dinner was 2.25 hours long.  We had to ask for bread and made our own dipping oil.  When we got desert we did not even eat it (very crusty and old for chocolate cake).  Pass on this place and move on down the road.

In many ways this is just a typical Marriott Courtyard. Nothing too flashy, boring bar, average food, standard rooms, etc.. But I gave it four stars because of the employees who work there. Everyone we encountered went out of their way to make sure that all of our needs were met and that we were comfortable and happy in their hotel. And I mean everyone, from the valet guy, to the maintenance guy, to the front-end clerk, to housekeeping, everybody was really fantastic. 

So, on your next visit to The French Quarter , if you don't want to spring for the higher-priced JW Marriott or Marriott, I would highly recommend staying at this Courtyard!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This was my husband & my first time experience at Ooka. We have heard about it for years but never had the opportunity to go. My husband started eating sushi more recently so he suggested we go. 

Our server was fantastic. He was very attentive & had a great sense of humor. That's a plus when you are serving my husband!!

We had edamame & shrimp dumplings for appetizers. The shrimp dumplings were AMAZING!

As for sushi, we had a California roll, spicy tuna roll, Philadelphia roll & shrimp tempura. All were fresh & delicious. 

I had the Tokyo Princess as a speciality drink. It was similar to a mimosa. 

Can't wait to go back again.

Great little Italian restaurant tucked away from the madness of state street. Nice and relaxing ambience. 
They start you out with a basket of toasted bread. It's a little tougher and crunchier to eat than preferred, but still nice. 
I got the gnocchi, which was absolutely amazing. It seriously just melts in your mouth! The pomodoro sauce with it was good. Generic, nothing special. 
Only downside is that the portion for the gnocchi is a bit on the smaller side. 

Will probably come back here when we're in the area again.

SO GOOD. Would highly recommend this restaurant to any sushi lovers in the Philly area! Menu is extensive. House rolls are unique and tasty. I personally LOVE the Peacock roll, which features shrimp tempura, mango and coconut sauce. It's unreal. Presentation is A+ as well.. usually involves hibiscus and/or different nautical themed items on the tray. Restaurant provides a semi-formal atmosphere, though dress is casual.. overall it's pretty relaxed with fast service (you can prob be in and out in 25 mins). I would go as far as saying this is the best sushi I've ever had in my life.

this place is really good, everytiime i come back into town I eat here. Always get the salt and pepper calamari. there's a 3 for 22 menu that you have to ask for. get the shrimp and chinese vegetable if you want some light food/veggies, other than that everything is gonna be heavy. Also good: mongolian beef(they give you too much onions and not enough beef tho IMO), eight treasures(soup-ish).

Bad atmosphere though. It isn't very fancy(that's what you get 3 for 22!). If your group is too big, the refill of rice/water will be very slow. (endless rice is only $1 per person at the table)

I come here sometimes for the pure convenience of going to a machine and have an auto car wash. However, if your car is covered in pollen, bird poo or something else don't waste your money here as it will not get most of it off even with the most expensive wash. 
The attendant is pretty cool if there is a long line but at the same time if there are six cars in the line expect to wait nearly 45 to an hour depending on the washes they ordered. 
If I need a light wash and there is no line I'd stop back but anything more I'm going somewhere else.

About two miles from the New Orleans airport. Actually has a BBQ restaurant attached which is very uncommon but appreciated for a holiday inn express as they never have restaurants on the grounds. Just the free breakfast bar. 
Parking is no charge and plentiful. Hotel interior and exterior is well decorated and modern. Found it very clean. 
The employees were all very nice and helpful. I messed up my reservation but they quickly resolved it which was greatly appreciated. 
My only slight gripe is there is no desk in the room. Instead a round table with non desk type chairs. Not very accommodating for work.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Snaps for Pumpkin!

I've been wanting to try Pumpkin since pretty much birth, and all my expectations were met. This is definitely a choice spot for a much needed date night or special celebration. The food is exquisite, delicate, and an adventure for your taste buds. 

Reservations are a must as this restaurant is tiny! The menu is constantly changing based on the ingredients that are available at that point in the season. That being said, the food is extremely fresh and the menu is small. 

Overall, I recommend trying Pumpkin if you want to have a more "exclusive" experience and if you have a venturesome palate.

I love the atmosphere here....! The vibe is real cool with great scenery. I'm not reviewing the hotel... this is just a review of my bar experience. I think for a center city bar the drinks are mediocre. Measuring drinks is quite wack to me. They do have good happy hour pricing but I'd stick with the wine or basic cocktails because the mixed drink I had was wayyyyyy too sweet I had to send it back. I'd come here to hang out in the lounge area but I wouldn't try anything fancy on the bar menu.. keep it simple.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
A convenient 24-hour stopover between Highway 295 and the Turnpike.  The buffet ($12.95) was okay - though do yourself a service, skip the eggs (which looked dried out) at the serving counters but order them at the station which come perfectly cooked.   Also get the fruits as they do have a decent selection - pineapple, cantaloupe, orange, grape, etc.  (Somehow, they don't have banana which was there in my last visit though.)  

As other have noted, the staff is friendly and attentive.

(For Sunday, kids eat free with an adult entree.)

CLOSED as of September 26.  Too bad!

We have been here for sushi several times in the past few months.  At first I was somewhat concerned because of the mixed reviews.  But each time we have been there, the sushi has been fresh and delicious.  We've tried a variety of rolls and all have been good.

There are always tables available on a Friday and Saturday evening upstairs (and if you want to be sure, make a reservation).  Plus, this place is quiet (unlike Ooka on the weekends) so you can actually have a conversation with the people at your table.  We will be back.

My wife and I had dinner there last night.  She ordered the pasta with marinara sauce.  The portion was small and the price was $17.50.  No soup or salad came with the meal.  The sauce was good, but just feel like we got ripped off with the price of this dish.  They don't have the price of this meal on the menu, just the kids meal for about half the price.
I ordered the veal with side of pasta.  The veal was very very thin, but I liked the breading and enjoyed my dish.  The portion was average.  
I really wanted to try the soup, but won't pay $9.00 for a cup of soup.  Ok, I'm cheap.

Favorite ice cream place in Conshohocken. Wish it was open all year but it makes me look forward to the summers! After dinner we often take a walk to here for our dessert. We like to think we are getting some exercise and the ice cream calories won't count ha! The owner and his employees are always friendly and work with a smile on their face. Even though it was under a mask this year LOL! They did a great job serving their customers this summer despite everything going on. Even when busy everyone respected other's space and most everyone wore masks in line. Can't wait for next spring :)

They have the glass partitions to separate the checkout clerk from customers for social distancing, but they don't enforce mask wearing. Even employees walk around without masks, eating and talking on the phone on the floor. The hot food and deli are good but you have to suffer through the employee's attitudes and don't let it be within 2 hours of a shift change. They'll take FOREVER to make your sandwich. The panhandling outside is terrible. 30 teenagers asking to help you with bags. I wish Fresh Grocer would just employ some of the kids and make the other ones move on. At this point, i get a bit of anxiety anytime I have to shop there.

Simple, no-frills authentic Mexican food at incredibly reasonable prices. They cover all your basics here and they do it well. All the meats are great, just not the most robust in flavor. Where they really shine is their flour tortillas; they're homemade daily and very tasty. Not to thick, not too thin, and not too chewy. They also serve a delicious homemade red salsa sauce that they keep it out on the counter for you to grab yourself. There's about 10 tables inside to eat at. All in all, a great place to grab a big portion of good food for a low price, quickly.

Came in here the other day. A true hidden mom and pop authentic Mexican place.  Everyone was speaking Spanish and it was clear that this place is a pillar in the Latin Community.  They were so welcoming to us Gringos!  Everything here down to the tortilla chips is made from scratch.  We ordered the steak fajitas and steak enchiladas verdes.  Truly these are family recipes!  The plates were so large and generous and the food so flavorful.  As long as your comfortable with truly experiencing someone else's culture, this place is for you.

I really wanted to give this place 5 stars because of its great customer service and location, but not having a small refrigerator or microwave in the room was a slight inconvenience for me when there for 5 days. However this boutique style hotel is lust blocks away from Central Ave which is booming with restaurants, bars and nightlife. And with just a short walk further, you're met with the bay and waterfront parks and dining. Always friendly staff available. Their bar/restaurant has a small but palatable menu. Overall this place is great to stay if you're in St. Pete or doing business in Tampa as it's a short 25 min drive into the city.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I usually would rate this gym really well. However, if you're an early person like myself and want to bang out the gym in the am the only down side is you have to deal with the cleaning person. I don't go at night because it's way too packed and I don't want to have to wait for a spot. But at night at least you don't have to deal with the cleaning person basically cleaning your feet. I'm paying to come here. While the cleaning person is getting paid to work. Uses strong products and cleans right by you or mops over your belongings. I find it extremely disrespectful and rude. I'll be switching to another gym after coming here for over 4 years
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Was excited to go hear after walking by it so many times. The restaurant itself is very cool, gives off a nice old school vibe. Unfortunately the food was so mediocre. The bread was cold and bland. The calamari was so-so. My girlfriend got the linguini with the alfredo sauce which tasted awful and bland once again. I had the chicken livers which were ok but the pasta and sauce were bland. I think this place needs to get its act together as I can't imagine they built their reputation on the food they're currently serving.

First time dining at this restaurant and I didn't know what to expect. A friend of mine wanted to go there so being the sushi lover that I am I was excited to try a new spot. The restaurant is a bit small, but our waiter was very nice and attentive. We ordered 4 different types of rolls and they brought it out on a big plate for my friend and I to share and I thought that was a good touch. We ordered the dynamite, California roll and 2 orders of crunchy shrimp. The dynamite was extremely hot so unless you love hot food stay away from that one. But all of the rolls were very good.

Wow this place is great if you have any kind of problem stains master cleaner sure can help out not only will they do press only they do bulk laundry service I never have to touch a washing machine again and the cost is cheaper than you think if you have no time or just don't like doing laundry come to master cleaner you'll be happy you did the customer service is also outstanding thank you master cleaner and with free pick up and delivery service it can't get easyer than that for clean wrinkle free garments
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: It may have been the place in it's day but those days are as faded as the best of clippings on the wall from 1991. Service was fine and the food was ok, but certainly not worth the price. We had the Filet and I think it was prepared properly but the quality of the piece of meat was poor. Onion soup was good but Grille 131 in Seminole is much better. When the manager came over to ask how everything was I told him the steak was not very good, his answer "OK" as he walked away. I think he hears that a lot. Not the worst meal I've had but we will not be back.

I've been back a bunch of times since the last review. I love their lattes. They use ganache from prep and pastry(p&p) instead of fake syrups. They've also had Horchata on stock all but that once but I'm hooked on the Vanilla Bean latte. I'm still working through the sampler box of beans and my favorite is the Guatemalan. It really does taste like chocolate ganache.

Great service, great coffee, plenty of options like nitro, cold brew, etc. They even have pastries from P&P. 

Also, it's worth it for the $50 gift card because you currently get an extra $10 loaded. Buy the card first and use it right away.

Had lunch with the family on Easter Sunday and had a great time. We were seated in the patio which I highly recommend, if available, especially on a sunny day. Also makes for great people watching. The staff was great and were attentive but not intrusive. The food was good and brought out timely. Had the chicken picatta and the sauce was spot on. Portions were well sized fitting for one person. We all enjoyed our food with no complaints. The ambience was very laid back  and friendly. Their price was very reasonable. Definitely will be back.

Awful!!! We went Saturday for a graduation dinner. Waited for drinks. They didn't put in our order for appetizers. Food was served to 2 people when we were 4. You bring out entrees together.  Restaurant 101 people. It's a shame, food is good. Service is horrendous. I'm not talking a short wait. I'm saying we sat down at 7:30 and didn't leave till 9:30. This was not by choice.  We sat there twiddling our thumbs waiting for drinks and food. It was by far the worst service I have received in a restaurant in my entire dining life. Never ever again.

Who doesn't love all-you-can-eat Mexican food? There's not very many of those places in the STL area that I know of. Of course, when it comes to buffets, the quality of the food is questionable. But, in this case, sometimes you just can't expect it to be perfect. There were a reasonable amount of items on the buffet, including salad, nachos, make your own tacos (hard and soft), burritos, taco salads, and a few other items. The corn cake rocked! I walked out a happy man, getting my money's worth in food (haha). They do have a regular menu here, too. Somehow I'm getting the idea people come here more for the buffet. Service was great.

Upscale Italian???
Bread  was horrific with low quality olive oil and no Parm. 
Special Salad $16,, lol. Two halved artichokes soaked in cheap balsamic. With unripe tomatoes and wilted greens. 
Shrimp scampi was inedible as the shrimp smelled bad and the sauce was just melted margarine with zero garlic or white wine flavor at all. 
Veal Marsala for $28 was an insult. Just chewy and smothered with thanksgiving gravy. 
Dessert. Yeah right. 
Shame on the kitchen. That's bad, bad food. 
Server was nice. 
Heading to Dairy Queen for a burger and shake.

This is a decent hotel. My family and I stayed here for one night. It was the cheapest and closest option since we were traveling to Philadelphia the next day. The rooms were nice and spacious. Beds were comfy. The pool and bar area was nice also we didn't have much of an issue. Some of the people are a little shady however the overall atmosphere was pleasant enough. If you stay on the 4th floor please be aware that there is a ball room  near the elevators.....there was wedding here and the guests were extremely loud and rude yelling in the hallway around 12:30am.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Seated upstairs next to the AC unit our table and chairs vibrated through dinner.. we order Margarita's that were 12.00 and straight sweet and sour mix, not even a buzz off a 12.00 drink.  I don't know when it became acceptable for Mexican restaurants to serve nachos without adding real cheese. Our nachos were served with watered-down queso watered-down sour cream no guacamole even though the waitress told us it came with guacamole, the only positive was that they did add a generous serving if meat with the nachos and the waitress was very nice. Other than that I'd go somewhere else.

Boring, wildly overpriced sushi.  We had the black belt sushi / sashimi selection and each piece was as boring as the next.  Not horribly bad, just not the least bit memorable.  Yeah:  I'm very spoiled from my trips to San Francisco where sushi is a competitive art form but still, especially given the prices, I expected a lot better (tastier, fresher, more interesting) in the raw fish dept.  Ironically, the desserts were terrific for the most part.  Forget the sushi and just come for the sweets and you'll be a lot happier.

First Chinese restaurant I've visited in this neighborhood. They have a standard menu with American-style Chinese dishes. I didn't take it as a good sign when my egg roll appetizer came out 30 seconds after I ordered accompanied by mustard and ketchup bottles. My visit was around 8:30 PM so the egg rolls were OK, but had likely been sitting out for hours.

The entree was OK. About the same as I would expect from a fast food chain or buffet. It left a lot to be desired from a sit down restaurant. 

The lights were also unusually dim so I can't comment on the cleanliness of the dining room. Server was nice!

Good service and good food! We didn't even need to ask the staff for a refill of bread... It just came out to us.  A complimentary bowl of mushrooms was a great welcome. I ordered the baked manicotti, and it was very well done. The salad was a little disappointing, just some house greens of questionable freshness thrown into plate. 

Portions are quite large, so be ready to carry a box back home. It's quite a small restaurant, so it could get a little noisy, but nothing at the level that bothers you.

I recommend this place to anyone looking for an Italian place in South Philly that is away from the typically noisy college crowds.

I've had some awesome Mexican food in my life and I'm so tired of coming to these restaurants and the best best thing on the menu being the Chips and Queso. I've never been a "Eat because I'm Hungry" kinda girl but eat for an experience. Two things in life that should never be slacked on are food and sex. Sorry for the ones who have a limited pallet and think that this is the best thing since sliced bread because you're missing out. If you understand how to truly cook you can taste when a dish is made fast and this isn't supposed to be fast food. No foodgasm for me. I won't be coming here again. B L A HHHHHHH.....

What do you get with this Starbucks on Vista? You may have guessed it: a typical Starbucks experience. Which is not to say it's a bad thing. It's just not as fresh, local or unique as other options for coffee houses in Boise. 

What I like is this: prompt, friendly staff, plenty of windows with great light, cleanliness and decent wi-fi connection for those squat and work folks out there. 

It's one of the newer Starbucks in the area, so you get fresher amenities. If your a PSL fanatic, this may be your best bet for Starbucks on the bench.

This place is everything I want in a vet (too bad they're specialists!). From my panicked phone call to the greeting at the door to the nurse consult to the doctor consult, I felt very welcome and comfortable in feeling that they could help me with my pups dewclaw. My dog is not the friendliest of pooches (loves dogs, hate's people), so after propper sedation, they were able to get her back and fix her up quickly. Not only were they incredibly caring they were not incredibly expensive (unlike my normal vet). I would give them 10 stars if I could. Thank you Sierra Vet. Specialists, I'm sure we'll meet again! :)

This was a really cool find! We were walking along looking for margarita deals on Sunday and we saw these steps so we decided to follow them upstairs to a really nice, open air bar! It was not crowded at all. There were plenty of tables under the shade and plenty of space at the bar to sit. I was in luck because they had five dollar margaritas! The bartender even added a splash of watermelon in mine. I liked the atmosphere a lot and the fact that if you look out eye level you are in the tree branches-that was really cool!

I just cant figure this place out. Where does the money go? The ancient & worn out bathroom is wretched. Ancient linoleum is tacked down with a few dozen tacks. The trip to the bathroom is deplorable across blackened carpet in the bar area. If you get seated in the over flow upstairs the same blackened carpet awaits you. The old wooden lathe ceiling is kinda cool upstairs but once had white ceiling tiles nailed up there then ripped down.  The carpet was a golden/yellow which you can see on the sides.
The food is amazing, and this place is hopping busy, go figure. Laughing all the way to the bank I guess....

This is a nice, small place with a simple "walk in, get your ice cream, walk out" atmosphere. It got quite busy while we were enjoying our sundaes. I am sure they are very busy in the summer.
It was nice to see how they made the soft serve and had it dispense directly into the containers they scoop it from. Only real reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because since their soft serve was SO soft, once we had a warm topping, such as hot fudge, on our sundaes, they just started turning into ice cream soup so quickly. It was difficult to enjoy when we had to eat it stop fast in order to get some actual ice cream.

Went for a later dinner.  Small, deep restaurant as Philly restaurants tend to be.  No cocktails, beer, wine and the expected Sake.  Sushi rolls listed actually had pictures of the actual rolls which is a great idea.  Had two rolls which was more than enough.  Very good and off the beaten path a bit, which was a positive.  Selection of wine by the glass is a bit sparse.  Service was ok, a bit slow for the size of the restaurant.  Overall, food and atmosphere are a positive, bar and service was a neutral.  I would definitely go back for the food.

When they first opened, I used to come through the drive thru to grab a quick bite and a coffee on busy mornings. While the food wasn't anything to write home about, it was pretty good for a fast food restaurant. 

I recently came through to get a breakfast sandwich and a coffee and I was thoroughly disappointed with the food. The breakfast sandwich was squished and dry and the coffee was extremely sweet. I also sat in the drive thru for a solid 3-5 minutes just waiting for my food. 

It really unfortunate that this place has gone downhill so fast.

Been here several times since they opened about 5-6 years ago. This last time was a disaster. The waitress was so unfriendly. Ordered miso soup, 2 rolls and 3 nigiri sushi. 

The miso soup was horrible. It had a nasty funky taste. 2 tastes and pushed it away. The 2 sushi rolls were so small and tight, like they could not spare the rice. 

The nigiri was ok, nothing special. Also the ginger they gave was 3 tiny pieces. 

There are 6 sushi restaurant off Dale Mabry in Carrollwood so never a reason to come back here.

The best way I can describe this ice cream place is obscure. The names of the ice creams are unique which is cool, except they don't tell you (signage) what they are.  For example, what is Brooklyn Blackout? I can tell you that it contains eggs because the signage says so.  

The workers will tell you what each flavor which is why the line is out the door as they will let you taste each flavor. 

I did have one of the few self explanatory flavors, Cookies & Cream. I did taste the Coffee Crunch and the Sweet Cream with sprinkles.  

In the end the ice cream was ok. Not bad at all, but nothing special either.

This store has a huge wine selection! They have so many different types of wines at all price ranges. I went in looking for a Moscato since I prefer the sweet wines. At first, I was so lost and had no idea what to choose. A very friendly associate came over and helped me pick out a bottle. Over the past few weeks, I have had some terrible wine and was skeptical of every bottle. He convinced me the bottle he picked was just want I would want. He was spot on! It was amazing and I finished every last drop in one sitting.

Been here a few times. Problem is its hidden away. West of LaCanada go past Missle park. Believe it's the next right into a commercial area right again to the end 

They make pizza, soups,sandwiches. And dinners. Wine & beer are available.

Not necessarily gourmet, but the food was good and reasonably priced. Claim to have New York style pizza, and it's pretty close 

Would absolutely go again.  And if you get Pizza by the slice they give you a card. Buy enough slices and you get one free.  It's a good thing. Enjoy!

So it's midnight and we are hungry. The local stadium just let out 50,000 people. Ordered at 11:53 pm and received food at 12:20 am. One burger was wrong, one burger was  torched, 2 other burgers were correct and fries were good. I guess my beef is when you know there will be 50,000 of your closest friends stopping by at midnight why not prepare for it? This place did not. 

Food less than mediocre but filled our bellies. Not good for event traffic. Probably your standard arches when not as busy as it was tonight.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Stopped in to wash the car. Used the last bay furthest away from the oil change part of the joint. This one was horrible. It is from ancient times. The wand leaked so that it trickled water all over you as you wash your car. The settings available are minimal at best. It is $2.50 (cash only) to begin with and once you want to rinse the soap it takes what seems like an hour to stop the soap from dispensing. It did a lame job of actually cleaning the vehicle which was disappointing. We won't be returning. Update this place and you will bring the business... as they say 'build it and they will come.'

This is an old Publix with a small layout and occasionally long lines. That being said, they have a lot going for them. 

They have a wonderful and consistent staff. I love seeing the same faces when I come, especially Vicki and Alexis, the super nice cashiers. 

They have a lot of great sales and deals, as Publix usually does. 

The lines move quickly and happen only at peak hours (5-7pm weekdays). 

What matters to me, is an organic selection, and the produce is lacking in that department, but they do have enough to sustain me until I'm ready to venture further from the neighborhood for my health foods.

This Starbucks location is great. It's a lot less crowded than the St Charles x Canal Street location and most patrons are office employees looking to get in and out. The baristas are pretty friendly and know their stuff. I recommend ordering on your app if you're in a rush- I placed my order at the Poydras crosswalk and my iced coffee was ready on the counter by the time I walked into the store. The only reason I'm not giving them 5 out of 5 stars is because there seems to always be one or two fruit flies flying around the pickup counter every time I'm there.

Solidly good fried chicken. I wish I could give it 5 stars but occasionally it is dry and not very fresh in spite of the place being busy. The chicken would benefit from a brine. Still the chicken is good, the coating crunchy and you receive a good value for the cost. The white box is an excellent value. The simple stand and the low prices make it a solid choice. There is enough chicken to share, and if you order an additional side it is easily a meal for 2 people. The mushrooms are delicious. Bring cash, like most of the good local places in Alton, they annoyingly only accept cash payment.

DO NOT GET YOUR EYE EXAM DONE HERE. Whenever I call them to get my prescription info, they say they cannot release it or I have to come back in (3 months after my eye exam) to get remeasured etc. They seem to scam their patients for money, and use every opportunity they can to get money from you. They basically forced me to buy contact lenses from them after I told them I would get them online. Very bad customer service (especially the guy who works out front) and very rude to customers. The O.D. herself was ok, but you are better off getting your eye care done somewhere where they don't treat you like a dollar sign.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: One waitress, one cook. One wall is painted, one isn't. Food comes out one at a time. It's very well proportionate to a person with a healthy appetite. There's a talkative mother or wife in the kitchen, sounds just like mia nonna...unfortunately the waitress is always missing in action. But over all the washrooms are beautiful and the food is fantastic. Italian cook came to say hello. Very friendly. Only in business for 13 months. Things will get better. I would score it 4/5,  if the waitress ever shows up again.

At first the price was a bit shocking for an oil change. Was quoted $99.99 at dealership. But this place is a lot closer to my location. There are a lot of nice women working here if that appeals to single men. They do the job quick and efficient. The only problem is there is no place to sit and wait. I guess you can wait in your vehicle, a bit different from sitting in a lounge chair watching TV eating donuts and looking at over priced cars. I got my key and turned the power on to roll down the window, (did not start it) but freaked out everyone underneath the truck lol. I give this place 4/5

It was decent there the lady at the front was really nice. Problem is if you order a drink you have to go sit outside and drink it...which is kinda funny. When it comes to payment, basically just tell them what you want to pay. They start you off at the $220 wash then have to work your way down. I told him I have a gift certificate for $125 so he said...ok it's $130. Problem is there is an interior car wash for around $110. I asked him what's the difference between the 130 and the 110 price, he said " We'll scrub a little bit more." Anyway just set a price drive-in and tell them that's the price you want. Hopefully you can do better than I did

Solid, but I can seem to get it totally right! After my second visit, I'm still searching for something DELICIOUS. My first visit I had the salmon benny and yesterday it was the blackened catfish; both were just fine. My little guests enjoyed their meals which consisted of little sliders and sloppy joes with an option to pick two sides and a sundae for $11; that alone is worth the visit. The wait is always minimal and the staff was attentive. I will say the sweet potato fries are some of the best I've ever had. I would go back again, still searching for that WOW entree.

Just ok. Over priced definitely. Too much hype about this place and since I have a group coming nearby decided to check it out. Not really worth the high prices. The margarita was good but too small a glass for the price. Had the sweet plantains who ch came out covered in cheese, yes, it said cheese on the menu. They were ok but not how I eat my plantains. Also got the brisket enchiladas which were not to my liking. Also, the tacos (9.50+) come with no sides. Like I said, pricy.   Staff was friendly. Won't be back because I didn't care for the food.

My parents and I have been going to this restaurant for years and we agree that the interior is better since the renovation.  As for the food, it can be delicious or eh just okay.  Tonight, my meal was delicious.  Rexys' homemade ricotta gnocchi was Yum in my mouth.  The dough balls were huge, stuffed with ricotta filling, and topped with homemade red sauce.  My dad got the pepperoni pizza which was good.  He normally gets the sausage pizza which is the best sausage pizza in the area.  My mom got the ahi seared tuna with vegetables and the tuna was okay.  So if you love gnocchi and/or sausage pizza, I recommend those two food items.

Service may be fast but not so friendly. And can someone please answer me why they charge $.60 for chocolate drizzle on top of my frappé? I WILL NOT be coming back to this location. 

The drive thru was packed but they get cars in and out. There are a lot of workers inside the restaurant but they aren't smiling. I went at 8am and no one seemed to be happy to be there. 

I give this location 1 star because I frequent Starbucks quite often, and I am a Gold reward member, but this charge is ridiculous and just made me question my loyalty to this franchise.

Thomas, the general manager, told us part way through our stay we had to leave several days early because they booked our room out to someone else at a higher rate (even though we were already promised those dates). Thomas, the general manager, refused to honor marriott's ultimate reservation guarantee. I don't recommend booking here unless you have a second hotel as a backup plan in case Thomas decides to cancel part of your reservation when he finds someone willing to pay more than the price you agreed to pay for your room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Well for this to be a newly opened Wendy's, I left without getting food. The service alone was horrible. A turtle moves faster than the long lines inside. I purposely went inside because the drive thru line had 10 cars waiting. 

There were napkins in several areas on the floor, tables not cleaned up, spilled soda at the beverage station & the ladies room was disgusting. Maybe they need more staff to help out or more managers to oversee the entire business. 

I should have followed my instincts & went elsewhere....as I have to because I waisted 15 minutes here.

Late night early morning SPOT for coffee & FOOD!! Drive thru action can get very busy after clubs close. The staff really try to do their best to keep it moving even with delivery services coming thru. 

Tonight Sheba assisted me thru the drive thru. She has done so before & has always been pleasant over the mic & at the window. She also knows how to hook up a good cup of coffee that was well needed at 4am. Lol. 

My food was hot & DELISH. HOT cakes, hash browns & sausage were on point. My breakfast started off right today!!! Never had a problem with this location & this is why I frequent here & suggest it to others!!! I'll be back as usual!!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Stayed here during Gencon 2015. At first they changed my 2 Queen room to a King with a cot, then after I got that fixed their housecleaning staff threw away a bag of purchases I had from Gencon worth about $200 and they offered no compensation. In addition I feel like if they would have just searched their recycling, they could have probably found it, but while the staff were very polite the stock answer they kept giving me was that they were "following protocol" instead of telling me what they were actually doing.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I bookmarked this restaurant on Yelp and was excited to celebrate my friend's birthday, here. I think I was expecting fresh pastas, red sauces or creamy sauces and sausage dishes. This isn't that. I just found out that cotoletta means cutlet which makes sense, because it's that. I ordered the chicken piccata and I missed the capers. The pasta was just ok. I tried the chicken parmigiana ordered by one of my dining partners and the breading was good but the sauce was too sweet for my taste. We ordered some wine and had a good time in a sweet location.

I'm giving this 3 stars because they almost never mess up my coffee order (they sometimes add sugar when I always say just cream). However, I am taking two stars off because the young lady who works at the drive thru makes me very uncomfortable. She literally never talks to me, despite me saying hello, how are you, or thank you. I am always friendly and smile. She talks to my husband when he is the one driving. It drives me insane and makes me feel super uncomfortable. I sometimes go to the Dunkin on White Horse Road just to not see this girl.

Magnificent in every way.  It's difficult to describe how perfect and impressive the food and service were.  I've had my fair share of fine dining experiences and this was no contest the best food and service experience I've ever had.  The artistry that goes into the food (and cocktails) is a serious level of craft.  But there is no pretense, what a relatable friendly staff!  We did the chef tasting and it wasn't cheap ( 
we definitely splurged) but if ever a restaurant was worth it...well Avance is indeed.  Most highly recommend!!!!

Conveniently located next to STL airport, the hotel offers free shuttle every 30 minutes. Although breakfast is not included, there's a restaurant at the lobby that serves breakfast (off the menu and continental). Thy also have a bar that offers variety of drinks (cocktaild, beer, wine). Until most of the Marriot brands in the Midwest, this hotel seems updated and modern. They also has a sizable gym and a pool. The service was fabulous as well - they brougt free tooth brush and tooth paste to my room per my request. 

Only downside is no extra beddings to be found in the room and it was chilly at the bar. Also, parking was $15 overnight.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I stopped here for a drink without co-workers on my way to the airport. I was surprised how crowded it was at 10:30 on a Wednesday. 

It was a pretty standard Starbucks. I got an iced chai tea latte and a chorizo breakfast sandwich. This one actually had the low sugar chai mix here which is hard to find now. The breakfast sandwich was pretty good. 

It was so crowded that I think we got the last table there. Even though it was crowded, there wasn't a line to order and we got our drinks fast. 

I would come back again.

We stayed here for a week when traveling for work. I usually stay elsewhere, but my husband wanted to stay a little closer and this was the only Hilton option close by. 

The hotel was dingy overall. It definitely needed to be upgraded. It smelled kind of funny, was dimly lit, and the hallways were dirty. 

The rooms weren't dirty, but they were falling apart a bit. The fan was missing a blade, the carpet was torn up, the couch was ripped, the pillows were so flat they might as well not have been there, the blanket was scratchy. 

I'll stay a little further away next time for a nicer hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
That was 15 minutes well spent! I arrived at 12:30 and didn't have to wait one moment to pay, wash or vacuum. The service attendant was very friendly and helped me decide on the buy-two-get-one-free package for $11.99.
A few days ago someone emptied their soda cup in front of me while on the freeway and my car was covered in sticky syrup dots. The carwash did a great job of removing everything off the front and sides of my car, and the powerful vacuums at the outside stations were easy to use and helped me get the interior looking great.

2 Stars because free Philly pretzels and water while waiting. Unfortunately the line was to the door on a Wednesday at  4:15 pm.
Instead of 2X welcome hostesses, One one girl on the computer not helping the line. How about putting these workers behind the counter, or getting cars ready ?? !!
Bad use of available resources.

Why bother with a fake email telling me that my rental car is waiting ?????
Don't waste my time with false promises and lies.

I started at 5 stars and drop a star for every 10 minutes waiting in line, for that car "that is waiting for me"

I booked my dog to get neutered here. They told me to arrive at 8 am. Little did I know they also told 30 other people to come at 8 am. So after an hour wait, my dog was finally checked in. Same story with pick-up. I arrived at 4 pm to pick up my dog along with everybody else. Had to sit and wait for quite a while just to pay and pick up my dog. If you have a busy life like I do and don't have 2 hours to sit around "waiting" to be seen or pick up your dog, find another vet. Otherwise, staff was friendly. It just would have been nice to know that the wait period would be as long as it was.

Remember seeing Ho Sai Gai(Good World in Cantonese) restaurant as a kid in the 1980's. This place has been around a long time! Though I've never tried it. I decided to try it and give it a shot. 

Was greeted by the nice(very nice) waiter upon coming in. Seated immediately. Hot tea and water instantly. 

Their menu was quite large. So I asked the waiter what's good. Any recommendations? Forget the name of the dish but it was beef and cabbage in oyster sauce with rice. And a Sesame Chicken. It was great. 

Customer service was excellent.

One of the standout restaurants in Tampa, and it's starting to get even more recognition now after the Beard nomination for the head chef. Even for a tapas style restaurant the plates are on the smaller side. But they're more than worth it, every time I've gone here I've used the waiter as a resource to help me navigate the menu and they are always well informed and have never led me wrong. The scallop crudo was my personal favorite so far, but I will say It's definitely a more enjoyable experience if you're sharing and trying as many different plates as possible. They also have a well curated beer and wine list (no liqour) as well.

It was good bass to relax and have a beer or two. The have a nice beer selection.  A convenient place to have in the mall when you just need to rest your feet, hang with friends and have a beer.  The bartenders were very cool and helped us figure out what we wanted. Only thing that I didn't care for is the small food selection.  Wished they had more variety  in there bar food. But we did order the beer cheese with the pretzels bits that the bartender told us it was good. I would go back when I just want a chill atmosphere  and a beer.

I stopped in here for lunch with an OLD FRIEND...we were seated right away!

Our server was KELLY...dark hair and glasses...very friendly and attentive!
 
We ordered the rib platter and the garlic parm wings....very good wings and nachos

The ribs were from the day before covered with lots of BBQ Sauce....  I had the ribs b4 @ TIMOTHYS , they weren't what I remembered, I was disappointed...

but the rest of the meal was very good

Overall I enjoyed my visit...

If you should visit , ask for Kelly 
she knows the menu, 
(took our orders by memory)...very friendly and on point 
I like that!

I went here for a dinner Thursday evening around 8pm, and it was pretty quiet. I ordered a bento box which was about $23 and you get to pick 3 choices from the list and it comes with rice, salad and a miso soup. 

I picked chicken teriyaki, sashimi, and tempura (vegetable and shrimp). My favourite part of the dish was the tempura, well done. The sashimi was good too. However, the chicken teriyaki was alright. It was pretty pain I would say, I won't order it again. 

Would go again but for my first time, it wasn't as good as I had imagined. I was also hungry at the time and mentally for me, it should have been delicious.

So I want a shake. Go to McDonalds o  Swan and Fort Lowell.
The casher comes up to the counter. It is apparent that she was on a break. Her  mouth is full of food and a bunch of sauce on her face. 
I motion to her. Then she wipes I'm the sauce off  her face with her hand  and then proceeded to use her shirt as well. 
Takes my order. Continues to touch everything. The screen, the cups, the shake machine!! 
 This is one more the most disgusting health code violations I have ever witnessed.I know that the girl is young. And would loose her job it I reported it to the management. She certainly was not trained on HACCP.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Food was as expected.  It's Arby's, not fine dining.

But... the floor was filthy.  Water leaks showed through several ceiling tiles.  A couple ceiling tiles were missing.  Also, there were several tables that hasn't been bussed (partly the fault of previous customers).

We were there about 7:15pm and were the only people in the place.  Stayed about 45 minutes and were still the only people there.

Counter staff was very neutral to us. Took our order in a very perfunctory way - no smiles, no emotion, just what do you want, and here's your change.

Like I said earlier - it's Arbys.

Maybe it was my experience. But I found this place to be overhyped. It was my first time eating there and I get my usual. Carne asada tacos with onions and cilantro. We also got steak nachos. 

Issues with the order.. issue one my steak was mostly fat and less STEAK! Literally majority of my meal was made up of cooked fat. I couldn't decide on weather or not I like the steak because I had pieces of cooked fat every other bite.

My husband had great chicken tacos which is what's saving this review.

All in all, I don't believe the food was as hyped as I've heard it's indys best tacos

Love love love coming here for a quick eat! & delicious margarita! We live off of 146th street so it's a closer option if we want a quick bite of Mexican. First... i will say i love there queso. It's soooo good can't get enough.

I usually get Carne asada tacos. They come served with rice and beans. It's a very large serving so i usually take the rice and beans and tacos to go. (I'm always full of chips and queso)

Lastly, you have to get a margarita. I personally love the Texas one it's very strong and right to the point with all of the syrups. 

I will be back for more food and trying different things!

This should be advertised straight up as a tapas-style restaurant, as it's not clear at first that our entrees would come out at separate times as if they were appetizers. They had limited choices for vegetarian tacos other than the usual cauliflower or mushroom in a lettuce leaf. The food is OK, but not worth the high prices. $2.50-$4 per small taco. Also, $3 for an 8 oz glass of juice that was filled to the brim with ice. The servers are great and explain everything clearly, even when they were busy.

Just overall, nothing special. 3/5

I had heard about this place through Yelp and UberEATS and I was in the area so I decided it couldn't hurt to walk in. I don't have dairy in my diet at all, so I didn't expect too much from the place. I was so wrong! I thought it was just pints of ice cream but it's actually popsicles!

They have tonnnnsssss of non dairy options! Everything is packaged perfectly inside of a freezer in front of the checkout counter. They have dozens of dreamy flavours. I was deciding between the banana coconut and the watermelon hibiscus and I cause the former. It was delicious!

If you love coffee and want a good donut to go with it you can't beat this Dunkin.  The staff is friendly and quick.  I have never had to wait long in either the drive thru or inside.  I usually get a medium or large Cold Brew.  I personally prefer the cold brew because of the smooth mellow taste. Currently you can get the Sweet and Salty Cold Brew which I have had and if you are a fan of savory and sweet you will love it.  The donuts here are hard to beat. I am not a big fan of yeasty donuts and the cake here are great.

Love this Restaurant-Market. My husband and I have been enjoying the Happy Hour food offerings at excellent prices. The barmaid Sherry knows how to make a mean drink to accompany the retro priced Happy Hour dishes. I believe this to be one of the finest Italian restaurants in the southern NJ area. Attached to the restaurant is a market, I am head over heels in love with the specialty items offered here. The owner Catherine makes a point of always greeting me, love her!!! This place is well worth the trip if you are in search of a good Italian meal. Thumbs up for both the Restaurant and Market.

I found this provider on my eye insurance website (VSP) AND IT WAS A BIG DISAPPOINTMENT. The selection is limited and the service was awful and on top of that they tried to charge over $244.00 for a pair of plastic frame eyeglasses. I am in the insurance business so I was aware of what they were doing.  So I went down the road to Eye to Eye Contact 1404 West Chest Pike PA 19083.  Michelle R. was excellent  warm and helpful and actually applied the discounts I was entitled to since I have insurance. It's nice to know that there are some honest people who do there job and save me money!!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is your local friendly street corner convenience store. I remember it used to be really small whenever I came here with my mom as a kid. With its latest renovation, it's slightly more roomy (but still small.) My mom would come here for her groceries but I would come here with my little brother for the snacks. The snacks are still cheap (and probably the ONLY place that I can find ketchup chips nearby, I hope they never stop selling them). There's always a strange but awesome variety of stock.The lady behind the counter is friendly. Very convenient place for whenever I feel like getting something to munch on for less than a dollar.

Plantation is not my go to liquor store for bar restock trips. For one, their whiskey (scotch, bourbon, TN, etc.) selection is less than stellar and their wine prices don't really rock my world either. Other spirit selection is decent with the major options but organization here doesn't appeal to me. The customer service has always been friendly, never had any complaints in that regard. My main reason for opting for this option is location--if I happen to be in the area and need a pint or a bottle of wine for the evening it's good for quick in and out trips.

There are definitely trendier Mexican restaurants in Nashville, ones where you can get more "authentic" dishes, organic dishes, fusion dishes, etc. Nothing on this menu will be unknown to anyone who's ever eaten at any Mexican restaurant before. That said, it's all really tasty. It's fairly priced, and it has a good amount of parking for a place in its location so that sets it miles ahead of much of what surrounds it. Decent happy hour, excellent service, clean interior. HOT HOT sauce, good street taco menu, warm chips w/ flavorful salsa. It really works for what I'd say is Mexican comfort food in the heart of Nashville.

This was recommended to us as a great place but a bit of a dive, and it lived up to both reputations. Don't worry if you can't find it on the street - it's not there. Walk in at the address, walk through the trinket shop, go down the stairs(I believe there's an elevator if you cannot manage the stairs), and the restaurant is immediately to your right. We stuck to traditional Cantonese style dishes: beef chow fun and salt and pepper squid. Both were delicious. Don't be fooled by the ambience (or lack thereof), these folks know what they are doing. Prices are extremely reasonable. We'll be back on a future visit to Philadelphia.

Cenzo's is the best,,most consistent pizza in Havertown. The pies are thinner crust, and when given time to fully cook,are crunchy and at their peak. The sauce is NOT sweet, thankfully, and is bright and flavorful. The cheese does not pool oil like those that use cheap cheese. On weekends and durin Friday Lent order really early!

This is an old school, store front pizzeria that is more row home than strip mall. Right out of a movie set, front window with advertisements for team car washes, pre made pizza boxes stacked, kids working the counter, molded booths with 8 middle school kids packed in......

My order to go. I am very disappointed with my order.  I asked for Chicken Pesto with Spinach,  and was served Chicken Pesto with Carrots. When I called, the guy on the phone he tried to explain to me that even if I order Spinach they can give me carrots and still put Spinach on the receipt. I don't like carrots! You need to teach your employees how to identify your menu! He asked can me for my phone number and told me he would have the manager call me to explain to me how they can put any vegetable they want and don't have to tell you. Manager never called me. BAD Customer service. Bad experience. Bad service.

I've been here twice and both times the pizza was really good. I mean, i got to perfect it myself, so how could i go wrong. I was able to choose the healthiest options which removed any guilt. Once i ordered ahead and did takeout and it was super easy and convenient. The next time i went after a night out on the town and it hit the spot. Not only was the pizza great, but we ended up sitting and talking with a few others and kind of had a lil after party. Who knew a pizza spot could create such memories. I will def be returning (probably much sooner than later)!

Literally the MODEL of customer service, and efficiency. You'd never expect this in Philadelphia, but amidst my travels, the team and the operation of the Manayunk Enterprise is by far one of the best places I get to work with and visit every week (or month). When you live on the road, and in their cars 24/7, I couldn't ask for better. The best mix of cars, always fast, always flexible, accommodating for my any and every request and change in travel, and able to change vehicles for me any and every time. Even in the future, if I don't need them as much, I'll still stop by and rent from here, and visit. Great spot.

Wonderful service overall. I ordered delivery and it was nice and quick. Big portions - and pasta entrees come with a soup or salad too. The salad just smelled fresh and looked good, the penne vodka I'd definitely recommend, and then they include rolls with butter and oil with spices as well which is nice since not all places do that for delivery. You get your money's worth that's for sure! The person answering the phone and delivery woman were both very pleasant and kind as well. I'll be back to get delivery again or come in, as it seems like a nice quality Italian restaurant.

In the area and stopped in for lunch. Ordered the pretzel burger, medium. It was cooked perfectly and had fantastic flavor....cheddar, caramelized onions, and honey mustard (no lettuce & tomato), with sweet potato fries on the side. It was one of the better burgers I've had in a while, and the fries were awesome. Menu was a tad pricey, but not considering the quality.  I would definitely eat here again if back in the area. There were several items on the menu that I would like to try. Server was friendly and attentive.

Don't get me wrong...the food was decent but way overpriced for the portion size. Veal chop was good but definitely not $37 good.  Soup was bland especially for $10. My wife's pasta looked like a child's porton.  
The place looks nice but the acoustics are terrible. It is so loud inside you can't even have a conversation.  Far too many tables squeezed in so the guests and servers can't even squeeze through.  Service was not great. 
Maybe I will try it again or maybe I won't.  There are better restaurants in the area.

This used to be a pretty good store. Looks like the were bought out and have decided to make it a liquor store and U-Haul rental place all in one.  Not sure who thought that was a good idea but now you stand in a long line while the cashier goes back and forth with U-Haul customers on speaker phone.  
The wait was ridiculous  and the guy working (if you can understand him) wants you to show him a picture of what you are looking for on your phone. All the while he is arguing pricing (loudly) with a U-Haul customer....no thanks! I'll go somewhere else.

I love their coffee but have been so disappointed. I have been trying to get a gingerbread latte for a few weeks at the location on Williams but they never have it. Decided to come here and they had it but when it was time to find somewhere to sit, EVERY table was completely dirty with food and plates. This seems to be common between all locations as they all seem to have a hard time keeping their locations clean. Really hope they can get this together and get it fixed. The thought of how dirty the dinning area is makes me wonder how clean the prep areas are.

I have actually never stepped foot inside this place but have had take out several times. As a vegetarian I get typical vegetarian rolls so admittedly its not hard to get those right.  Still the veggies and ingredients always seem fresh.  I have also had the vegetable bowls with rice.  They offer both Teriyaki and Hibachi style for you to choose and they have a very good flavor. I've never heard any complaints about the food from meat eaters either, who get varied dishes from various sushi rolls, chicken, and shrimp meals. Overall decent food for the price, and a decent take out option.

This is Mexican with a little more of a modern/rustic vibe. Dined here for the first time on New Year's Eve.  The specialty menu was offered and not their regular menu. I'm not sure if the offerings were pulled from the regular menu or created for the night but they didn't disappoint. I chose the vegetarian options from each course selection. The meal started with a mushroom and goat cheese mini empanada that was delicious.  The Chile relleno was so good and the sauce had great flavor.  The main course was seared cauliflower with a tamale and the flavors were excellent. Nice ambience and friendly staff.

We stayed in the 2 bedroom suite which was perfect for our family of 4 teenagers, my wife,  and me.  My only complaint was that the bedroom doors didn't lock. Otherwise, the pool was perfect, the kids had fun, and the two moms were impressed and relaxed. Management was courteous and hospitable. The best part was that we could see the pool from all of the windows in our suite. Another plus was the bartender. He offered perfect suggestions for dining nearby and local attractions while being accommodating and providing quick wine and martinis to us tired parents. Great stay!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
A small gym. It's gets the job done for those trying to stay in shape. My standards for gyms are high. 

Pros:
They have a punching bag
They usually aren't crowded 
They offer tanning
They have enough cardio to meet the demand
They are open 24/7

Cons: 
not a lot of space.
Only one free weight barbell rack and one barbell so only one person can either bench or squat in the whole gym.
No bumper plates for Olympic lifts.
The machines are Precor, which is a great cardio manufacturer, but not so good with resistance machines.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This is a newer place near to the save on and all of the other shops just off of 109 St and Jasper Ave. 

I'll be honest, what brought me in initially was how inexpensive the cost was for men's cuts. Some places you go will charge an arm and a leg for 15 minutes of work. At first the cost for a men's cut was $20 I think. Now the cost has gone up to $25 which is still great. They actually take their time and are really thorough. 

The environment is clean and they almost always take me as a walk in. You do have to wait a little but it's usually worth it  

Check it out!

I have been a H&C customer since the place opened but lately have been disappointed.  The staff is friendly and the space clean but the lattes and cappuccinos are no better than a Starbucks.  Feel like they are hastily made without clean shot glasses and spooned on foam from milk that was over-steamed.  The baristas used to take their time making the drinks but now it is like a production line to see how fast they can turn them out.  And they don't even taste good.  With so many great coffee shops in town, it is worth the drive to find a place that has great drinks.  Unfortunately H and C isn't that place anymore.

Great deal and great sushi! We wish you were open for lunch on Sunday's. You can get in and out in less than an hour on a week day, which is nice bc I work right now the street. I will most certainly be coming back. The tuna roll was just a huge chunk of tuna, which I love. The spicy tune roll and some crunch in it, it was also delicious! The shrimp roll would have been better it the shrip was fried right then, but I've been here before and it was- so hopefully it was just an off day. Regardless, I'll be back!

The decor is different for a Mexican restaurant.  I had high hopes, but really overall the food was bland.  We got chicken taco, eh.  The chorizo taco was not good at all, very unimpressed.  I have had way better Chorizo at other places, the salsa and chips were nothing to talk about, and the guacamole was very bland.  Worst of all I am a huge fan of Sangria, I ordered a glass and let's just say i won't ever do that again.  It was small, and not like Sangria at all!  The seats were dirty, as was our menu on the table.  Our server was wonderful, but the food and drinks they can keep them.  Unfortunately for me, epic fail.

Very nice hotel with nice accomodations and a fair price. 

Pros: Beautifully designed rooms, Gorgeous pool, and friendly staff.

Cons: Staff doesn't seem to know much about Marriott Elite Gold (they didn't know that Gold members are eligible for free upgrades and didnt know about late checkout), the breakfast hours are pretty restrictive (6a-9a weekdays), and there is no hot tub. 

Overall, good experience and would return. The rooms feel new and clean and the breakfast spread was pretty nice (waffles, eggs, chorizo, turkey sausage, fruit, cereal, brie, bagels, and lots of waffle toppings). 4 stars.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Low rent, out dated, dirty.... scary location.  I missed my booking window for the full service Marriott, so closest Marriott property (lifetime platinu Marriott member) near my meetings.  The first night, I was concerned that I'd get mugged, seriously. There were several young men drinking outside and noisy.  The room was dated and dirty. My door didn't fully lock. I couldn't get another hotel and stay near so i stayed here all week.  I took my stuff with me every day.  That's how bad the vibe was.  Even the employees were "off". I'd hope that my next visit wouldn't be here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I used to really like this place but as of late everything tastes old and/overcooked. I ordered garlic chicken tonight and there was absolutely no garlic anywhere in there. In fact it tasted like they cooked it in the sweet and sour sauce. Disgusting. I could even eat it. There was barely any chicken to even pick over. The rices tasted old and hard and the egg roll had a funny smell and taste. I'm livid because I just wasted my money on dinner and I'm hungry. Like I said I used to like it here, in fact some of my old pics are up but this is just not what it used to be.

Very good service. Very mediocre food. Don't bother with the food. We live in MT.  The Mexican food there is much better than this place so we were very disappointed.  I'm sorry to be so harsh but seriously these were the worst fish tacos I have ever had.  No interesting ingredients, ..we were all so completely  unimpressed with the food , although I feel bad because  I really  thought the staff was exceptional. The restaurant has a corporate feel... to what I was looking for or expecting. Do yourself a favor...try a different Mexican restaurant..I wish we did.

Great casual, trendy spot. Love the tapas style food. Gives you a great tasting but not obligated to a full entrée. I love the cocktails and sampling. Also love how it is all served, the guacamole and its oversize chips is great. Service is quick and wait staff is attentive. Great for a brunch party, a small celebration or a first date. 
So glad that you are in Hyde Park. It's a destination worth checking out and afterwards it's nice strolling through the village. 
I hope that you will do a BarTaco truck and have it outside Amelie during hockey season. 
I know I really don't want to eat the food offered in most sports arenas

The food was AMAZING!! Everything we had was perfectly cooked and fresh and our apps of ceviche and loaded chips were delicious. We also had one of the specials that was superb. All of the seafood was on point. They also have specials every day which is good to look into! What wasn't on point was our waitress. Granted she was the only server and told us she was in arm pain, but she overcharged is $16 for our drinks and then claimed we were the liars! No bueno! I only bought two drinks because it was a buy one get the second half off deal so why would I get another? Plus the blood orange margarita was too sweet to get a 3rd. Just sayin...

I've only seen Pinkberry in the States, so when I saw the one here in Edmonton I knew I had to try them.  They're full serve like Yogen Fruz.  I got a medium and although was not told how many toppings I could get, with their small size cups and after filling it with frozen yogurt, you can only fit four spoonfuls of toppings.  I really like their nutella flavor as I don't think I've seen it anywhere else.  Topping wise, it was a pretty normal selection.  I thought $6 was a bit steep for the portion (cheaper without toppings) but I did enjoy it overall.

It's been a minute since I've been to La Reyna. Stopped in a couple times on the way back from the beach and La Cabana del Tio.  Pistachio is my paleta of choice here. They have plenty of flavors to choose from, as well as ice cream.  I believe they also outfit various Mexican grocery stores with their paletas.  I want to say I've seen them at Acapulco Mexican Grocery. So if you don't frequent Clearwater very often, check to see if your local Mexican store has them.  Minus a point for the atmosphere but I'll give them 4 stars just because I like ice cream on a stick.

I'll echo Karen F's sentiments. The ice cream was fine; however, the options are fairly limited. I think there were about 7-8 basic flavors. I went with the butter pecan and cookies and cream and Kit Kats as a topping. Sort of a long wait to just put two scoops in a cup. I'm sure things will be more efficient once they get the hang of it. I actually got my order before the two girls before me who seemed to wait an extra 10 minutes longer than I did. They ordered the ice creams with the sauce-filled syringes. That's off putting to me. Who started that bad trend? Anyway, it's nice to have a dessert shop in AW since Chocolate Pi bailed.

Not as bad as the reviews indicate. I've been a few times and while the food is average, I feel inclined to give 4 stars to improve their 2.5 rating because on my most recent visit, my server Xiaoli (and the other fellow) provided top notch service. Filling up my water often and asking how everything was. He even would say Enjoy! after topping it off while motioning to the water. That amused me. haha I ordered the beef chow fun. Not bad. 3 stars for this dish. The beef wasn't of the highest quality but it was still OK.  I like the water feature in the center of the dining area. Would be cooler though if fish were swimming around in it. :)

It is very small and the dryers are very old and don't have a timer on them so I'm not sure how much time I had. They only have two large washers and since they provide a laundry service, they were using both of them. It's a small outdated place and the machines don't take cash or card and the attendant even had to put the coins in because the machine was so old and nearly broken. I will not go back here.  I will try the place down the road next time. The prices seemed reasonable though so that's why I gave it two stars.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I just tried this place for the first time today after having my eye on it for quite some time. The atmosphere isn't great with some bench seating and fast food style setting. However don't let this deter you from trying their food!! The service was extremely friendly and they were helpful in helping us decide what to order. They have a good variety of options so there should be something for everyone including vegetarians. I got the miso ramen and a hand roll both of which were delicious. I loved that the ramen had corn and bean sprouts in it to give it some crunch. I will definitely be back to try more!

I just tried this place for the first time today after having my eye on it for quite some time. The atmosphere isn't great with some bench seating and fast food style setting. However don't let this deter you from trying their food!! The service was extremely friendly and they were helpful in helping us decide what to order. They have a good variety of options so there should be something for everyone including vegetarians. I got the miso ramen and a hand roll both of which were delicious. I loved that the ramen had corn and bean sprouts in it to give it some crunch. I will definitely be back to try more!

This is an okay car wash. Some of the stalls work better than others, so I make sure to only use certain ones. Also, I don't use the brush to avoid scratching my paint. Unlike other reviewers, I've never had a problem with the credit card machine. It authorizes $10, but the correct price updates in your account within a few days. I think I've only paid around $5 for the last couple of washes, so the value is good for what you get. The location is convenient for me, so I'll continue coming here whenever I need a quick wash.

My niece and I ate here while hanging out in City Park one morning. The actual building/set up is nice and there's a lot of socially distant outdoor seating. There's something about the original Cafe du Monde that the other locations can't duplicate. The beignets just don't taste the same here. As I was eating my big, doughy beignets, all I could think about was how much I miss Morning Call! The 3 big beignets were crammed in a tiny bag and I couldn't get the powdered sugar to distribute properly. I love City Park but will pass on this Cafe du Monde location.

I visited Krispy Kreme and placed an order on the drive through. The lady in the drive through made my order. She had on gloves and used the paper to pick them up. I could also see another employee, a guy, making orders. I'm assuming it was for inside customers. He had on gloves, but I saw him grab his pants on both sides to pull them up. He then touched the donuts with those gloves and placed them in the box. That was disgusting in my opinion. 

As far as the donuts, the glazed were delicious as usual. I decided to try the chocolate glazed and lemon filled also. They were okay but I'll stick to the glazed moving forward.

WILL NEVER TAKE MY VEHICLE HERE! My boyfriend took his truck in for a brake issue, was told after diagnosis it was the Master Cylinder, which involves replacing and including a flush of the system....still having an issue. Took the truck back in to see what the issue is, comes to find out the master never needed replaced it just needed a flush, WHICH THEY NEVER DID IN THE FIRST PLACE. Not only is he out hundreds of $$$ he now has to take his truck to have the original work completed somewhere else. POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE -  RUDE - STEALS FROM CUSTOMERS!!!! Think twice about taking your car/truck here!

Literally had time to write this review while waiting as the only car in the drivethru SLOW! I have to edit this.  So, the more I think about it the more pissed I am.  All three ladies were just chatting away.  One lady handed me my donuts then walked sway. 3 min later a different lady walked up and finally hands me my iced coffee that was literally behind the window already made.  My youngest is sobbing in her car seat, obvious!  My window down it's loud.  All just sat there talking.  Very unprofessional.  This was noon on a Thursday!

This used to be a favorite of mine, however my last experience left me with no desire to return, the service was poor, the food so so and the restrooms and tables were filthy. My experience with dirty restrooms make me feel like the rest of the place is filthy too. Surprisingly empty during a dinner rush on the weekend. You could over hear the servers/sushi makers talking poorly. It was disappointing, my fiance and I loved our first date there 6 years ago, I brought him because it had been my local favorite for about 10 years. Sad to see the change.

Rude staff. 

Hard sell for insurance. I really enjoyed the high-pressure scare tactics and the annoyance from the agent. 

They have no system set up for organizing customers as they arrive. No system for moving unneeded or returned vehicles off the lot (meaning my wife had to leave me as every foot of the lot was occupied by a vehicle). 

After 30 minutes of waiting, I'm finally greeted by an annoyed and condescending agent who snatches the keys and blurts out "You don't have to wait" with an eye roll.

Not worth it.

Not too shabby...
Decided to give their "All you can eat sushi" deal a try.
$30.
Make all the selections you can handle from their expensive menu of "little plates" of sushi and many othet dishes.
2 hour limit.
A little disapointed (but not entirely surprised) that the crab was imitation.
All items were pretty satisfying.
Not amazing...but nothing inherently wrong. I like the premise. One can certainly "cover the gamut".
I selected ~16 items for my initial order. Turns out...I was hard pressed to get through all this. Plenty of food.
Can't say that be rushing back...but It's on my lust to revist...someday.

First off the sake I ordered hot was Luke warm at best. 

My companion had to keep repeating her order because apparently we weren't worth exercising the limits of the waitresses attention span. 

Each time our orders were brought out it was a different server who could have cared less if the order was right. 

I had the sashimi combo, medium. I couldn't finish it. In fact half of my order just didn't taste fresh. I wound up going to my hotel for a free ab workout because the quality of food was just atrocious. 

Skip this place unless you want crappy service and some quality time in your restroom.

What a wonderful place! This has become part of my daily morning routine. I'm new to the area and was so excited that there was a close by coffee shop. I was not disappointed! So far I've only had the iced coffee and iced americano - but I have to say that both might just be the best I've ever had. The coffee is so rich and flavorful - I love that they add a shot of espresso to their iced coffee. 

The service is also truly great! It's a great start to the morning to be greeted often by the owner and other awesome staffers with a great coffee. Everyone should make this a regular stop!

I really wanted to like this place, but the few times we have ordered from here; the pizza was just okay. This last time takes the cake for us never ordering here again. As my boyfriend was eating his pizza, I noticed a hair hanging off his slice. I stopped him from eating the slice so that he could remove the hair. Which at the time I thought it was maybe one of my hairs that flew on to his pizza slice. NOPE! This long hair was BAKED in the pizza. He pulled it out from under the baked cheese! We ended up throwing out the rest of the pizza. Maybe the rest of the slices were fine, but we were not going to eat those to find out.

Located in a really sweet part of downtown St.Albert; This corner cafe is a great stop to make before wondering around and absorbing all of the  surrounding summer scenery. The coffee is pretty standard self-filling with milk and cream off to the side, but the price is right for the large Dixie cup. My husband got one of their 360 cold drinks, which was pretty flavorful. They offer a wide variety of gluten free food, but it appears that all of their food is pre made and frozen, so it gets microwaved when you order it. All and all, I'd return here for a quick cup of coffee.

I went on a father's day family "brunch." I had biscuits and gravy; portion was big but there were more biscuits (6) than gravy.  Breakfast menu had 10 items (all meals) but nothing that can be ordered as sides; I would have liked some bacon or sausage with the biscuits and gravy, so I didn't think meal was fulfulling.  I had tenderloin at the other Grill and that was very good, but as we arrived at 11 am today, that was too early for me.  No smoking (a big plus) and service was good and prompt.  There are also pictures of some Indy 500 cars on the walls, including the first winner at our table.

Found hair in two of the orders. We placed a group order, and order here often , since i work at the hospital. It was a group order of about 9 people, and two people had food in theirs, a stromboli and cheesteak. I was highly dissapointed at how this was handled. First it the hair was discovered on the stromboli, and we got a replacement.
