Later that day my coworker found hair in her cheesesteack half way through it, whe she called the lady who picked up was very rude and said "call back tomorrow and talk to the manger" and abruptly hung up.

Disgusting that two of our orders had hair and how it was handl

Okay. That's really all I can say about this place. The food isn't great. I had a full plate of sweet and sour chicken and I can say I've had much better. The chicken wasn't crispy, just somewhat soft. If you like your chicken like that you'd love this place. The atmosphere is even worse. Imagine your average strip mall Chinese place, then take away all the Chinese aspects save for a koi pond and two or three Chinese characters on the walls. However, my entire family loves this place. Maybe, I just have too high tastes (Joke)

This McDonald's has been part of my life for more than I want to lol, but now I can finally write a review. I only get breakfast here, they have been fast and accurate for the most part, the only problem I have is that in the morning it gets super busy and I have seen the same couple talking by the back door "pretending to work". It took them 6 mins (I timed them lol) to actually stop talking and did what they had to (open one of the register at the drive-thru). The manager should watch out for those two love birds lol . Keep it for after work, people is hungry and need coffee asap in the am.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Nice bar in the growing downtown St Pete area... great selection of beer, full liquor, and nice interior design with outdoor seating as well. They also host local bands in the back room. 

Though the layout is a bit awkward with its narrowness. There is essentially the front room with the bar & the staff, and then the back room that is separated by the bathrooms that are in the middle. This design doesn't always work out so great if you have (drunk) people who apparently require supervision.  (I can't unsee what I saw.)

First time at this place to grab some quick pizza.  I liked the concept of being able to get a slice of pizza or a whole pie!  Even though it was super busy we were still able to find a table right away.  Our food came out very quickly and it smelled amazing. 

The pizza was a great portion but also so perfectly made.  I'm from Chicago so I'm all about the deep dish but this thin crust pizza was too good!  I was craving it even after I finished my entire meal.  

I would definitely recommend this place for a quick bit or a night out for some pies!

We are sitting in a Budget rental Jeep Compass that won't start.  We are stuck on the causeway on the way to the beach.  We stopped to pay the parking and turned off the car the car - big mistake!

We called roadside assistance and they said this is KNOWN PROBLEM, so why would Budget rent us a car they know has problems.  That is so disappointing.

The roadside assistance guy wants us to go all the back to the way airport, which is an hour drive.  This ruins our afternoon.

Thanks for nothing, Budget.  My last rental with you.

This was my first visit in years and I was pleasantly surprised at the new interior.  I ordered the a few nigiri and some rolls.  I am usually not a fan of fried rolls, but the Kirin Bomb was really good!  Unfortunately the rest was mediocre.  The Crazy Crab roll tasted like a 70's style crab salad.  The nigiri was 90% rice and 10% fish which was very disappointing.  Finally I noticed that the spicy mayo was very runny, almost as if it were watered down.  What a shame.  While other locations may not be as nice on the inside, they make better sushi.

I wanted to have a great experience with Fountain Street Auto Service, but they just didn't allow it to happen. I made an appointment, but apparently that just gets you in line when you arrive behind whatever other appointments are made. Then my car sat all day waiting for new tires. At the end of the day, they did not have the tires, and I would have to bring it back. Delivery issue. I understand, but I can get tires elsewhere where they're actually in stock. The worst part is that I told them what tires I wanted when I called to set up the appointment. I have not been back.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Came here for dinner with couple of my friends. I have to say that service, ambience and food is absolutely delicious. I love cute hipster outdoor places and their outdoor patio is exactly what I wanted. 
Food: I got their gnocchi, and my friend got meatballs. Their food portions are small than average. I'm a very picky eater and meat wise, I only eat chicken so the menu was very limited for me and plus they have a very small menu. I would still come back here again...maybe for lunch, when I'm not so hungry and don't have to get a huge plate full of food.

Average but quick is the way I would describe this restaurant. If you are looking for Mexican flair, this is not the place for you. BUT if you want decently priced food that will sort of satisfy your Mexican food craving, then you may enjoy this place. 

I got 3 soft shell tacos with beef in them. It doesnt really feel made to order because the beef felt like it was all cooked in a big pot and seasoned with packets of "taco seasoning". 

I gave them 3 stars because I am lenient and price was literally the phrase "get what you pay for" when it came to the food.

My, have the mighty have fallen...

Been coming here for about two decades; but the last time was several years ago; and although the service was good as was the garlic bread, the "Large Antipasto" was anything but. Although the size was barely adequate to feed one person, there were only about 3 slices of cheap salami & American ham, and only a few small chunks of cheddar cheese, the rest of the dish was a tablespoon of jardiniere -- In other words, it looked like they were trying to see how cheep a plate they coud throw out in front of me for the $11.99 menu price.

Sorry, I'll not be back.

We went to New Orleans for Jazzfest and had a great time, but our stay at the Holiday Inn was sub-standard.  The maid service was horrible.  They did not clean or replace the glasses, they did not clean the bathrooms, they did not refill the coffee.  I think all that they really did was make the beds and change the towels.  I could understand if we were a bunch of partiers and trashed the room, but we were on a family vacation.  The front desk was nice enough, but I'm not sure if our experience was part of the laid back "Big Easy" attitude of New Orleans or if it was due to Jazzfest weekend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love bartaco...but not for the tacos. The portobello and falafel filling are decent, but I find the shell a bit chewy. However, their bowls are amazing. I had the portobello bowl, filled with a seasoned rice, and fresh peppers and onions, topped with their green salsa. It's slightly on the spicier side, but not so much as to take away from the flavor. They also serve gelato...and I couldn't resist sampling both the mint and chocolate and both deserve two thumbs up. They also have tons of sides, so between that, the bowls, and the ice cream, there are plenty of reasons to give this place a try.

This place has the best craft beer selections in the city. All beer is offered as singles so you can build unique and tasty six packs. They offer a decent rewards program. 

They also have a tasting bar in the back were they off unique beers on tap. Every Friday they offer a flight of the week that includes unique beers that are usually only offered in big bottles. On top of the Flight of the week they do other special beer events that are all worthy attending.

The staff is very friendly and willing to help you find beers to fit your individual taste.

Paid $39 for car wash and mats/interior vacuum got it done yesterday. I unclipped my car seat for them as they asked so that they could vacuum underneath it and all through the backseat. When I got home I saw that they had not vacuumed the back seat at all or the trunk of my Prius. I called they said that they would redo it so I happily took them on their offer. These pictures were taken AFTER they re-vacuumed the back. They offered to do it a third time but I didn't have time for a third time. Next time I'll just go to Mike's.

Paid $39 for car wash and mats/interior vacuum got it done yesterday. I unclipped my car seat for them as they asked so that they could vacuum underneath it and all through the backseat. When I got home I saw that they had not vacuumed the back seat at all or the trunk of my Prius. I called they said that they would redo it so I happily took them on their offer. These pictures were taken AFTER they re-vacuumed the back. They offered to do it a third time but I didn't have time for a third time. Next time I'll just go to Mike's.

Amazing pizza, however we had no idea that they were TINY!

I ordered a single pizza for myself and someone else. I figured with the $15 price tag that it would most likley be a medium pizza since it was a nicer place. Well it was not, it was tiny, smaller then a small. 6 Baby Slices. So cost wise not worth it, however the pizza was most certainly the top 10 in St Louis.

Very clean inside, the staff was very nice as well. Hard to find parking sometimes but that is not their fault by any means. Overall I would recommend checking them out, I would not drive all the way down there to eat again but I do not regret trying it by any means.

Convenient: yes. 
Was the car clean: sorta. 
Attention to detail: nope. 
The employees aren't very invested in what they're doing. I requested an exterior clean with premium rim care and paid $14. That did not include any vacuuming of the interior because I requested them not to. The tires look OK but the rims were not efficiently cleaned. The car in itself was left with water spots And they don't even do any kind of wax finish. I expect more from a car wash where the employees have an active role in the cleaning. I can get the same quality running my car through the gas station wash

Moved to the area and wanted to support local restaurant.   Got the menu and ordered a bunch of take-out.  Felt that they were a little rude on the phone, but wrote that off thinking that they were really busy.  They said thirty minutes. I went to pickup.  Place was deserted.   Counter people again very rude and they got my order wrong.  Waited another fifteen minutes for them to get it right.   Got the food home, average to below average.   "Best Food in Town" clearly a misnomer, both in service and in quality.  Now, I get my chinese takeout in another "town".

Soooo i called to place a to go order and they told me NO call back later, and i said no im at work and can not call later. So they literally put me on hold took 4 orders at the counter then someone else answered the phone and took mu order.
Order was incorrect after repeating the order 3 times 
Paid $8 for costco chips and salad
And $7.50 for a plate of lettuce that they called a salad.. Then cashier was mad because she couldn't get the order correct.
Rude customer service!!!
Coworkers and I will never order from them again!!!

I really want to give this place more than three stars because I really really enjoy the food. However my experiences are always mixed. 
I come eat here regularly, and will continue to, but it's sad that it takes a half hour to even get a glass of water. The service is the least attentive I've ever seen, and I'm not even one to have high standards. This has been going on for years. Sometimes I've chalked it up to busy servers, but the last time I visited, it was completely dead and I could never find my server. 
Please, if someone in management sees this, I love your restaurant. Please find a way to fix this issue.

I came with my boyfriend to do some work for a bit before exploring the rest of the street. The guy at the counter was pretty friendly. I got an applesauce bran muffin at his recommendation (after he realized they were out of my first choice); my boyfriend got a scone and a coffee. The pastries were good, and he enjoyed his coffee. I liked the design they made in it with the milk. I just wish they had some sort of menu for non-drink items.

This shop also has a great atmosphere. I loved sitting by the window upstairs and looking out onto the street--it was a great view.

I have been to this location many times and I always have a good experience. The sushi is always fantastic, and the service is consistently friendly and attentive. The restaurant itself is very clean and aesthetically pleasing. Having said that, I do have to agree with some of the other reviewers that I find the prices a bit high. It makes Mikado a nice place to go for a special evening but not exactly a go to sushi place. I do highly recommend this place for a fun girls night out or special dinner, especially if you get one of their private rooms. Those are really great.

So I noticed this place gets some bad reviews, however I always pay attention to them and check it out myself. I checked it out today as I needed to rent a vehicle. From the moment I arrived it was a friendly atmosphere. Michael W. was "Awesome" from the get go. I had a slight issue before renting and Nicole the manager was also "Awesome" and worked the issue out to a resolve! I am sorry about the bad experiences that happened to my fellow renters, but I couldn't have been happier. Anyway happy travels to all and if you haven't been to this location give them a try I think you will be pleasantly surprised.

Lovely atmosphere. Sitting outdoors in the evening reminded me of dining in Europe. Nice servers and slow, but enjoyable pace to dining. Appreciated the size of the menu, selection of homemade pastas, and proper portions. Wine menu was approachable and reasonable. The main courses were somewhat underwhelming as far as flavor, but overall not poor quality. I ordered a slice of tiramisu to-go, but was incredibly disappointed when I went to eat it at home and it was still frozen. They didn't claim to have homemade desserts, but the quality was not on par with the meal.

Solid, authentic, cheap Mexican food for a cheap price.

I ordered a carnitas burrito with rice and beans for $6.  It tasted good, but the burrito was 75%+ rice with a little beans and a little meat.  My wife ordered 3 tacos, a la carte, and they were much tastier, but small/traditional (3-4 inch diameter) corn tortillas.

Can sodas and Mexican Jarritos bottles, as well as home-made horchata.  2 of us ate for $13 with a lunch plate and drink, each.

Great price, sufficient/nothing special food.  Friendly staff, only a small wait while food was prepared, but at least (I'm guessing) it was made after we ordered it.

We wanted to have a couple appetizers and drinks for lunch so we popped into Hart's Tavern, mainly because Peddler's Pub was closed. We sat at the bar and ordered a few beers, the caramel apple sangria, potato skins and fried pickles. First the "special" sangria was watered down apple juice. That had to be the worst sangria I've ever tasted simply because it hardly had any taste. The potato skins were soggy and lacked an real flavor which was a huge disappointment and the fried pickles were mediocre to say the best. The only positive was the beer was cold...enough.

I've been on a quest to sample all of the good coffee that Nashville has to offer and this was one on my list. It's in the Gulch so that means no parking lot of their own and you'll probably have to pay to park in a nearby garage. It's connected to a hotel which means this place is very upscale (along with the clientele). I would recommend this place for a casual business meeting or something. I got an iced latte, which was good, not too bitter or anything. Another thing I should mention is that they seem to have an array of alternative milks for the coffee (almond, oat, etc.) so this place should work if you're a vegan coffee drinker as well.

Delicious food!! Accommodated dietary challenges with ease. Triple tacos with carne asada, pork & chorizo-- so tasty. The beans were cooked perfectly and I dipped my tacos in them. Yes, totally dipped. Hubby had fajitas, a huge portion, with fresh sides. Lots of great salsas to select, ask for the arbol sauce, it compliments the already super flavorful meat and beans. Service was excellent, clean restaurant... Pinellas county needs good authentic Mexican places and this place meets that need and then some. I'll probably never be able to come to natures food patch again without coming to this restaurant! Yummy!

The fro-yo is good, lots of selection and it's a great low fat treat. The topping bar has everything you could want. The place is clean and the staff is friendly. 

Their doggy frozen yogurt is a big hit with my puppy. She has a sensitive stomach and this treat doesn't upset her.

I don't know if it's seasonal, because they were out this week, but the cookie dough ice cream sandwich is Ahhhh-mazing. -1 star because because sometimes they are weird and stingy with the sample cups. 

Lots of seating at this location so bring your friends.

Nice hotel downtown next to the Superdome.  Has restaurants and bars on site.  The room I stayed in this time is on the corner so there are views of the city in two directions.  Everything is clean and nice including walk in closet with natural outdoor lighting.  Service here is top shelf.  I did find the elevators a little confusing at first but figured it out quick enough.  Worth a stay if you're wanting downtown.

Cons:  it's not especially close to the French Quarter so you'll need a cab or other transport.  The high crime here makes walking prohibitive unless you are in a large group.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very vibrant, close, intimate atmosphere for a saturday night. Service was on point and was very patient with our group. Had fun lovely couple next to us engage on conversation so be ready to interact with other parties around you. The bruschetta was ok and i thought it would be a little be more flavorful with balsamic or herbs. All the dishes we ordered excellent, however. The lamb chops and octopus were both extremely flavorful and had original sauce complexity to them. I would come back to this laid back BYO.

Crispy Eggplant - 4 stars
Seafood Risotto - 4.5 stars
Carbonara Ravioli - 4.5 stars
Tiramisu - 4 stars
Service - 5 stars
Tampa has several excellent Italian restaurants and Cena is definitely one of them. 
They are known for their risottos. Seafood risotto was really good. I'd come back to try their other risottos. 
The tiramisu had the most unusual shape. It looked like a big Easter egg. Tasted good but didn't taste like a tiramisu. It didn't have that fluffy texture that is signature tiramisu. I would have called it something else.

I have been going to Magic Nails on Keystone for over 10yrs for all my waxing needs and Mai who does the waxing, is AWESOME, she takes her time, talks with you and uses baby powder, lotion and anything possible to make it quick and painless as she possibly can. I learned the hard way to never trust anyone besides her. I always get exactly what I need done in a timely manner and am always greeted by my first name when I walk through the front door. I don't know what I would do without her!!! If anyone is looking for a new waxer I definitely/highly recommend Mai. They also do nails and pedicures :)

I recently started taking my dog to Watson Road Veterinary Clinic after getting some recommendations from friends. It's a smaller clinic and they don't offer overnight hours on site, but my experience with Dr. Zeis has just been phenomenal. Dr. Zeis performed surgery on my dog, and even though they are a busy clinic they've been great about getting us in for his follow up appointments. He and the rest of the vet staff really seem like they care a lot about the health and well being of your pet, while offering services at much more reasonable costs than other clinics I've been.

This review is based on the DELI. I like going to this Publix for groceries. However, ordering from the deli is always a hassle. Long lines. Now on numerous occasions I have ordered ahead with "online easy ordering" the estimated time is given, usually 30 mins when my subs will be ready. Now when arriving to pick up the subs they are never ready. This has happened to me 5 times!!! One time they just didn't make it because they ran out of 5 grain bread. Very unprofessional! It takes over an hour for an online order to be fulfilled. Sometimes my order isn't even accurate. I won't be ordering from the deli any longer.

Not sure how I've managed to not eat at Pi before tonight but I've definitely been missing out. Stopped in around 8pm and it was very crowded but my friend and I snagged a few seats at the bar. We ordered the Greek salad, wings, and the hill pizza on whole wheat crust. The salad was just ok but the wings and pizza were absolutely delicious. The wings are baked with a dry rub. The pizza was cooked perfectly to my liking where the whole wheat crust is soft but you don't need to eat it with a fork. I will definitely be stopping by Pi again.

So I attended the New Years event and was not loving it. It was advertised as being the biggest and best however if you do not get the $400 VIP package totally not worth it. There was hardly any food (only jambalaya) small amount for a massive crowd and with the $135 you only get access to two rooms the main room had a band that sang 'the weekend dance' and that was all the song said over and over and over again. You get the very cheap liquor some tequila and rum I've never heard of. Bags were also not checked.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Marion's isn't straight-up awful.  Their hours are better than a another shop closer to my house (who closes at 4:30?), their turnaround time is usually two days, and the staff are pretty friendly.  They even called once about being concerned there may have been leather on a jacket I dropped off (leather and dry cleaning don't mix).  AND there's a PJ's like two doors down.  I haven't logged their rates against other dry cleaners in the area, but their prices are not so outrageous that I've ever complained about it.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
This is a little roadside stand on the Westbank Expressway. Not a sit down restaurant.  There are a couple of seats and a counter to eat at if you're in a hurry.
Maybe 10 things on the handwritten menu taped to the glass. 
THE FOOD: I just tried a couple of carne asada tacos. Came with a lime wedge and salsa verde.
I gotta say, lots of flavor in the meat. Delicious char flavor. The salsa was also awesome. Heat, savory, great. 
$5.00 for the tacos. 
THIS is a great little quick eats place.
Gonna try some other menu items next time!

This is my local McDonald's.  
I only go to the drive thru. 
It's usually slow, but today I sat for 10 minutes behind about 7 cars. Didn't move.
I was getting ready to call the manager from my car when a car moved. 
I got up to the first window and the cashier was making boxes for happy meals. I sat a minute before asking if I paid at the other window. She said "oh sorry", but kept making boxes. In the meantime, all the cars were taken care of and I was sitting waiting for her to take my money. 
Total waste of time !! 
It's McDonald's!!! 
How hard is that??
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
On Fat Tuesday you have a staff of 5. Are you serious?  You are on one of the most popular corner Poydras and St. Charles day of Mardi Gras and you don't properly staff your location. Come on Starbucks. They have one person on the register and on guy who looks like he is trying to look busy so he doesn't have to do work. This is ridiculous. 

The staff is moving slow as turtles no smiles no hi how are you. Heads down they have one door open and the line is out if the door. The only good thing was I got bathroom tickets. DO BETTER

This place had promise, it really did. Strip mall? Check. Sweet ladies working there? Check. Sufficient vegetarian options? Check. Unfortunately, I left feeling a little underwhelmed. My vegetarian roles were mediocre, the green tea was not great (had a slightly funky flavor), and the sesame desert things were just meh. The part that really was difficult for me was the music. I'm not against christian pop music (at all), I just don't enjoy having KLove or whatever christian radio station they had on playing while I'm eating. This is a sure-fire way to deter customers that are not of the same religious leanings.

I wish I could give this place a 0 or even -10
Cause the staff was so mad and pissed all the time at everyone 
The manager who name is Deion wanted everyone to know he  was a women named Ms. Good Thang which was weird and I don't think anyone cared to speak to him they just wanted to check in there rooms 
He would get mad and tell the staff to" treat them the way they wanted to be treated "
Rooms was dirty 
Shower and toilet was dirty like they were used before us without being clean. 

Please there are so many other places to stay DONT STAY HERE !
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Fast coffee, but don't waste $ on the baked goods (try Willow location instead). 

I never bring food back, but I hurt my jaw trying to eat a scone from here. No lie! It must have been a week old. When I took it back for another one, the barista seemed to take it personally (not believing me until she failed to break it in half with her own hands). Then she tried handing me another brick. Come on! Got a muffin instead and it tastes 5 days old. 

Step your pastry game up, PJ's! I'd rather you say you're out of food than you trying to play customers with "fresh" week-old food. :(

Ps- barista at 9 am on weekends is the sweetest.

Very convenient and close to my work, it's easy to get an appointment within an hour or two, or just walk in. All the barbers/stylists are competent, efficient and give great cuts. Prices are reasonable - about $20 for a cut. Fairview Barbers is super old-school and no-nonsense, with a straight-edge clean-up on the neck and vibro back massage at the end. The talk and banter used to border on politically incorrect, but it's mellowed out a ton over the years. It's a real friendly, family-type establishment now. Highly recommend it for males of any age looking for a good haircut.

This is such a fun little place in Atco! The inside is decorated to the tune of a 50's ice cream parlor. Tables are very clean inside and there is some outdoor seating too.

We tried two small ice creams; the butterscotch and cannoli. Tge price seemed a little high, nearly $8 for the two of us. They were both really good. The ice cream is heavy and and tastes like nothing else around. I was barely able to finish my small ice cream, so the price was well worth it.

A great spot to visit when you're in Atco  (or their Medford location).

More like 3.5 stars. Not bad but not the best I've had either.  I was in the mood for noodles so we came to this location. The place was EMPTY at dinner time. I don't know if that was a good thing or a bad thing because our food came out super quick. But it's probably bad for business (or the fast food is a sign that they don't make the food fresh). 

I ordered pad Thai which was decent but at Golden China they use a different spice that's a little sweeter than what I am used  to and they also use different noodles. 

Husband got the teriyaki  chicken and was satiated.

Great dive bar.  They have added food and honestly it's very good!  We got the sloppy Joe's on Monday only  $4.95 with chips.  Wow!  The onion bun is soooo soft I want to know where they get them from so I can get some for home.   Haha.  The meat and seasoning very tasty and they even put melted cheese on it to complete the perfect sandwich.   I don't even think you can make it from home for $5.  Service has always been good and they seem to have a good team who treat regulars right.  Check it out.  We'll worth it!

They don't deliver, so be prepared to pick up your order. 

Even though we were told our pizza and onion rings would be ready in 20 minutes, it was luke warm upon our 20 min pick up.  The crust is too thick to be considered "New York style", it is a typical regular pizza crust (not thick, not thin).

Onion rings, which I ate on the drive home, were barely warm and very soggy. I've had better and crisper appetizers delivered to the house by other restaurants. 

Nothing about the ingredients or experience stood out.

Was really excited to try this out with the outdoor deck and love music for summer! My boyfriend just moved within walking distance. Great venue for a restaurant! Lots of people at the bar for a Wednesday. Sadly, the food was less than optimal. Everything we ordered (appetizer, buffalo chicken sandwich and burger), after getting the wrong order, was honestly not very good. Guessing it is due to their prep outdoors at this deck area or champps has changed a lot since I was there years ago. Inside dining may be much better when it can be prepared in their regular kitchen. Would think about going back for live music but not for dinner.

Horrible!!! Worst Krispy Kreme experience EVER!!! The employees seem have no idea what what to do.  The manager was angry and nasty and should not be allowed to work until she has had her coffee, apparently.  Their idea of the famous "HOT NOW" Krispy Kreme doughnut is taking already make cold doughnuts off of a tray from the back and placing them on the conveyor belt to reheat and glaze.  I watched them do this.  I am guessing that this is not up to standard KK practices. If I wanted this I could have gone to Dunkin.

I just took some $$ out of the ATM at TD Bank on Radnor Chester Rd. and all they had was $20 bills.  I needed a $5 so I went inside to get change but was promptly told bc I am not a customer they won't give me any change for a $20.  I said "I'll be sure not to be a customer in the future," and walked out.  So they lost a future customer bc the teller would not make change for a $20 bill.  Way to go! I guess customer service only applies to current customers.  Just a reminder that I paid to use their ATM, so technically that makes me a customer.  
#TDBankSucks
#TDBank

This is my second review for Jalapenos, but I figured after 4 years... it's time for a new one! I still love Jalapenos, and through the pandemic we ordered delivery at least every 3 weeks. We love how quickly the food comes, how it is the same size portion you'd get if you were in the restaurant and how it is always hot and delicious! I was recently able to stop into their new location on WHP and the atmosphere is eclectic and feels authentic. The service and staff are amazing and always accommodate my younger kids. We are life long diners of Jalapenos!

Great place and location. Here on work related trip. Hotel seated off of main street and tucked between restaurants and a residential neighborhood behind. The room was great with multi HBO stations and central air. I had a working desk with seating area. Room service was good. Thier breakfast (6-10am)was good as well with an omelet service, pancakes and waffles. To go along with that service you had additional choices of scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage and potatoes. The also had fresh fruit,cereal, oatmeal  yogurt with fresh coffee. The server was outstanding handling all stayers needs. Parking was ample on either side of hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I hadn't been to Mazatlan in years but ended up back here the other day. I was pleasantly surprised and will be returning again. The fajitas Jalisco's were INCREDIBLE. They were hot, flavorful and a serving for one could feed two easily. I have been craving them since we left. The salsa is also yummy but the chips are just ok. The price for a pitcher of margs was great but they tasted veryyyy weak which is no fun at all. 

The place is huge so it's easy for everyone to social distance. The servers wear masks and are attentive and speedy. Overall a solid choice!

I was hoping to really like this place and I will say the service was great. Our waitress was very friendly and attentive even on Cinco De Mayo. However the food was not great.  We ordered the guacamole and it was missing something... it just didn't have any flavor. We got the Molcajete and it was just ok. I've had one before at another local Mexican place that was much better. For me, it was a little too spicy - I didn't love the sauce in it.  I will say the Don Julio Margarita was delicious.  I may go back to try something else but there are so many Mexican places I better at this point.

By far the best pizza we've had on the Main Line.  We are definitely pizza snobs, preferring true Italian style pizza and Felicias is as close as it gets in the area - starting with the wood fired oven.  Tony is all business and cares about his pizza. His menu is vast which options for everyone and it extends beyond the zza. Sandwiches, calzones and salads. Pricing is comparable to other gourmet style pizzas. 

They have a few tables on the roof top with limited service. From our perspective its's really take-out only.  

Note it is tucked away, so you'll have to look but will love this discovery!

I love this place! I've been eating sushi in the area for about five years and have not found a place close to home that I love as much as temaki. They have great, cheap lunch specials & when the weather is nice it's great to sit outside. The location and ambiance of the restaurant is awesome, and the sushi is spot on! They could use some more experienced servers, but as a waitress I am very picky about my service. Still tipped 20% despite minor problems, and the food definitely made up for the slow service. I bring all my friends from out of town here and haven't had a bad experience once!

Went here tonight for some amazing food. The portions were huge and prices were more than fair. The sauces we're great, pasta cooked perfectly and Meatballs and chicken parmesan we're delicious.  Meat lasagna with a side of sausage was cooked perfectly with great taste and we got two meals out of it. Will now be on our rotation for sure. I strongly suggest reservations, even weekdays. The place is very small...too small...it's the only thing I didn't like...sitting on top of each other with no room to stretch.

Enjoyed a nice meal here. They were quite busy, it was a Friday night. I found the hostess to be less than inviting, hence the 4 star rating. We ended up eating at the bar which was just fine with us. The bartender was Quite helpful. Asked for menu advice and boy was she right. I thoroughly enjoyed my Di Mare and he had the short rib ravioli. Kitchen was a little slow but again I say they were busy. 

Definitely will be back.  Clay Terrace has plentiful parking and in warmer weather it's nice to take a walk while you wait for a table or after dinner.

Just ate here for a lunch break from the Myseum. Food is not that great. It's not terrible, but it's not very good either. Tge quesadillas are not any better than a chain restaurants appetizer. The salads are all the same with just different meat and sauce depending on which one you order. The chips are whatever was cheap at Sams.

The service was mixed. The one guy who helped us was super friendly. The girl who took our order had an attitude, and I don't mean a good one.

Overall, I'd recommend looking elsewhere for sustenance.

Came here for lunch on a weekday with a group of four. We each ordered a slice of pizza and a salad. The pizzas sit out and they just warm up a slice in the oven. There was artichoke, plain cheese, veggie, and plain tomato pizza. I am one of those weirdos who enjoy tomato pizza, so I was happy to see that option! The salads are quite large and tasty. The pizza, however, falls flat (literally- the crust has no rise to it), and it lacks in flavor. It felt like eating for function rather than for fun.

TL;DR: pass up on Slice and go for any of the other good food places near Rittenhouse!

Worst McDonald's I've ever been to. Always super slow no matter what time of day or night you go. They have super immature kids that work the drive thru. Went there a couple nights ago just to order a 10 piece chicken McNuggets. They kid asked if I wanted any sauce and I said BBQ, so he replied with "oh we're out of BBQ is there something else you would like?" So I asked for honey mustard. His reply was "actually those are the only two we're out of." I guess I should have asked. "WELL WHAT DO YOU HAVE?" This place is so pathetic!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Pretty decent apartments for the price and the area. They've got a decent size pool and fitness room. Plus the apartments are located close to many grocery stores and shopping centers. I only have a couple of complaints. One is the parking. There is assigned parking which is fine, but the parking spots are very close together. The passenger side door of my old car was hit with the car door of another resident. Also, the lighting in the parking areas are horrible. Not well lit at all, some of the lights don't even work properly. Overall I've had a great experience here.

Went to Ooka for my sisters birthday. We opted for Hibachi and I was unimpressed with the presentation. Our chef seemed un-enthusiastic and rushed through cooking with only minor flair. Overall the drinks and food were good but the hibachi area is a bit cramped and doesn't make for a comfortable experience. 

I'd still like to go back and try the sushi.

The staff was very nice and friendly. 

Parking was a bit cramped and we had to loop around a couple times to find a spot during peak hours. 

They do take reservations!

Full bar and LOTS of swanky sake.

Didn't really enjoy the food here. 

The fajitas had no flavor, it was chicken mixed with black pepper spice and that was all. They only serve you a handful of chips with beans on it so if you're looking for a Mexican place that gives you a bowl full of chips this is not the place for you. The enchiladas were literally swimming in some sort of sweet black sauce that we did not enjoy. Although the people were nice the food not so much. We will not return. Also nothing came with sour cream. All the food was bland.

As many other reviewers stated,  my family has been going here for many years.   The food used to be excellent,  but has really fallen off in recent years.   I don't know why,  but I speculate that the owner is spending all his time at the new Maurizio restaurant in Moorestown.   

I'm really saddened that it has fallen to just a subpar restaurant.  I can think of 10 local Italian places as good or better within 10 miles of Cinnaminson.  Hopefully I'll hear things have gotten better, but if not I'll take my business somewhere else.

I used to order from Los Jalepenos at least once a month when they were located in South Philly, but since they've moved up to Bella Vista the authenticity of the food has changed in my opinion.  The last 4 times I've ordered, the food has been below par.  I always get the same thing, and gave them 4 chances to improve, so I'm a bit disappointed that I no longer have a favorite Mexican spot.
On the positive side though, there is a lot of seating, and the service is always very good when you eat in.  It's good BYOB as well.

We went to Sam's Grill quite a few times until they were too obnoxious and we decided we'd rather not spend our money there.  
We were there with our family and one of the orders came to us extremely dry and overcooked, and when we asked the waitstaff to exchange it for something else, they sent the hostess (owner?) over, who proceeded to tell us she wouldn't take it back, without charging us for the returned item, as well as the replacement.
We'd seen the same woman treat other customers rudely, so that was it for us...we'd rather patronize a place that cares if you're happy with what they serve.

I generally go to Starbucks to by COFFEE beans. Normally I purchase other interesting items they have on display. Yesterday I went to Starbucks to get coffee as usual. They had none on the shelf. The person with whom I was speaking asked manager if they could make me a couple of bags. I don't know what was said but it amounted to. "We're to busy" well that's the last time I'll go there. Come to find out I can get it for the same price at Amazon. And, save time and gas. Plus I'm not tempted to buy something for which I did not go shopping.

Excellent service and friendly staff.  Very clean establishment with free WiFi for customers.  The owner Kim Price has been in business for eight years and is located in Mid City on the corner of Cleveland and South Genois St.  Carol, Betty and Carla are happy to assist with your laundry needs.  They can wash and dry your clothes for $1.25 per pound.  If it is a corporate account, please speak to Kim regarding the cost per pound.  Price varies from $1.50 - $2.50 per pound.  Also, there is an additional charge for pick-up depending on one's location. They prefer advance notice for corporate accounts to ensure turnaround time is within 48 hours.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Most of the time it's a pleasant experience, but once I got the rudest guy ever.  He clearly did not want to be at work.

Many times I only get a car that has a 1/4 tank or less which isn't that big a deal unless I'm planning to leave on a long trip right away, I have to stop right away for gas.  Most of the times the cars are not very clean, the last one was actually washed just for me, but they left so much soap on it I had to wipe it down when I got home cause I was embarrassed to drive it with soap residue all over the paint and windows.

Overall it's a good place to rent a car.

I was here recently for the annual Dot Food Show at the convention center and this was my go to Pizza Place for lunch and late night food. As a pizza manufacturer I can be critical of crust, sauce and cheese. However this place does a very good deep dish pizza. I ordered the same pepperoni and mushroom and it was consistently good all 4 times. Now if they could just focus on better service this place would be very enjoyable. Unfortunately I sat at the bar 3 times and had the unhappy redhead serving me. She clearly didn't want to be there and seemed annoyed with everyone at the bar. Food was a 5 stars, service was 2 stars.

Was hoping to find a really yummy Mexican food restaurant and this was subpar. When my husband and I first entered the restaurant, the hostess just looked at us like we were crazy. No smile or greeting. When we finally got seated, we were seated in a section where the employees were standing around arguing with each other. On the plus side- The chips and salsa were good and I did enjoy the cheese dip. I got shredded beef chimichangas with rice and beans. The chimichangas were sitting in some kind of juice and was like soup on my plate. Instead of being crispy, they were soggy and not good at all.  Will not be returning...

A little expensive for me. $12.85 for a katsudon. Well probably also because it is located Downtown. We were seated at the bar. It was not really full at that time but I got my food - katsudon - 20 mins after we ordered. My friend got hers only 10 mins after - she ordered tonkatsu udon. My food was okay, not bad but nothing amazing too. My friend said her udon was bland. If you bring your own drinks even it is your personal water bottle, they won't allow you to drink it there. You have to buy drinks from there.

We ate here last night, the atmosphere was sleek and modern, the food was exceptional, and our server Elena was awesome. We sat at the bar as there was nothing available when I called for reservations; I wouldn't recommended that for dinner but it was fine, we really wanted to try the restaurant. I ordered the swordfish with olives and roasted lemon and it was melt in your mouth delicious. We also ordered the creme brulee, it was some kind of coffee flavor. So good. It's a little tight in there, which doesn't bother me, I like cozy, but if you wanted a little "quieter" area I might request a table towards the back. We'll definitely be back.

BEST ANYTIME in NOLA! 

I've been to over 7 of the anytime fitness gyms in New Orleans and this is the one to beat!

There's free weights, treadmills, bikes, squat machines, and the list goes on - everything you could possibly need to get a good workout! There's a total of THREE bathrooms, two which have showers and one that is unisex, very clean. They have classes you can take on certain days. Tanning is also available.

The staff here are super friendly and the people are willing to share equipment. There's also Smoothie King & Subway next door, which is convenient!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Very friendly and fast service. Doesn't do more than what needs to get done. (For instance, I just got front brakes and rotors done. Rear brakes almost need to get done but have a little more time. They didn't try to sell me on replacing those sooner than necessarily.) Comparable prices to other places I've been. I also love the location: I have the convenience of dropping off my car and can go to Charcoal for a good meal, wander downtown Yardley or the tow path or hang out at Starbucks for coffee and free WiFi.)

I visited Las Margaritas for dinner and was completely underwhelmed. I ordered the shredded beef taquitos which come with beans and rice. The taquitos were very average and similar to the frozen ones you can buy at the grocery store. The avocado tomatillo sauce they were doused in was unique but not quite enough to save the dish. The refried beans and rice tasted like the same canned refried beans and mushy rice that every Mexican restaurant has. The salsa wasn't really salsa, more like a bottle of hot sauce and a bottle of tomato sauce you could mix together.

Overall, the food was very average. Expensive for the quality and quantity.

I was so exited to try this place after reading about them online. But, after Trying them, I was totally disappointed. The miso/tofu ramen was so bland, I needed 3-4 ingredients to make it better. Then, the menu states the Vegetarian Ramen is purely veg. Well, until you bite into a fish cake, you wouldn't know better. I confirmed twice that there wasn't seafood in my dish, but again disappointed that there was no taste and rubber fish cakes in my dish :(
My friend wasn't to keen on her pork ramen either. Very bland. Sorry, but we won't return.

Awful. Repeatedly. Yes, I know there's a pandemic. No, that has nothing to do with this. This was the last straw in many attempts. I order on mobile app often. I know my order was taken correctly, as you can see on the grill slip. This happens every single time. And don't come for me saying I need to check. The responsibility is on the restaurant to get the orders right. Something is wrong with my order every time I get home. I looked in the bag and the grill slip was right so I figured they got it right this time. I will never return, even though this location is so conveniently located near my job.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Inside has tables set w distance, which is great. Sanitizers up also. Food was lovely. Waitress was surely.  Overall staff were friendly. Take out at night is great. Salmon is a huge fillet w veggies and such. Tasted great.  Chicken souvlaki dinner was huge and delicious. Greek salad is huge and so yummy. No onions in potato salad, so thats a plus. Really great food at very fair prices. We are happy to have found it. We seem to prefer takeout though.  Would be five stars if it weren't for the one experience with this waitress.

We visited this spot seeking good not so heavy lunch. When we arrived we were greeted immediately by a friendly host and sat us down right away. They wasn't busy at all, just a few other diners. 
We were greeted by our server within a minute and he was very interactive. Ordered plum sake which was soooo good and tuna  takaki! 
Also ordered from there very reasonably priced lunch menu. You have an option to order two or three of the lunch only rolls. We chose to order 3 rolls and share it, it's perfect for two people.

We are locals and had the best time sitting out on patio once again this evening...great live music.. as always...along with delicious appetizers and drinks. And not to forget to mention the absolutely gorgeous view. These are the places that make living in Florida really amazing. The Margaritaville shrimp were awesome!!!!! Service was on point..thank you kayla for being fabulous! These are the places that we appreciate coming to when we want to  pretend we are tourists. We are never disappointed...thank you so much for a fun evening

What a quaint little restaurant in Plant City. From the lite background music to the sweet staff and yummy food...it just seems you can't go wrong here. I had the chicken enchilada verde. It comes with a side of rice and refried beans. Delicious...a little bit of heat, but just right. My son had the devil shrimp. He cleaned his plate...rice, beans and all. May I just say that it was a hearty portion? My daughter-in-law had the burrito. It was huge! She shared it with my granddaughter and they both enjoyed it. We all washed it down with hibiscus lemonade. It was quite a meal that started with homemade chips and salsa. I'll be back...

My last review was five stars. The food and service were outstanding. UPDATE:
Was there a week ago. Everything was perfect as usual. It really is a wonderful place to chill. The food is tremendous. It's a wonderful price point and I give it 10 stars not five. 
I had the best steak of my ENTIRE life - 22 ounce porterhouse cooked to perfection. I'm heading back this evening for a repeat!
Such nice folks there...especially the owner. Dominic treats us like gold. Sometimes I wonder why I go anywhere else! I'm salivating at the thought of that steak!

I stop by here probably a couple times a month in the morning on my way to work.  I like to get an ice tea in the morning and it is convenient going through the drive-thru.

Unlike that burger place that starts with an 'M', you can get burgers anytime of day.  Why should I have to wait to order a burger till 10:30 (oh and 'M' is religious about the time don't try to sneak through 2 minutes early) when burgers are what you are known for?   They'll make it my way instead of getting bent out of shape that I don't want onions.  Not everyone loves breakfast food nor works a normal 9-6 schedule.d

This is the best bottle shop I know. What a great goddamn beer selection. Not only that... COCKTAILS WITH EGG WHITES AND STOUTS, AND ABSINTHE/SCOTCH WASHES? stahp. It's not even the ingredients (that no one normally mixes with) that is so impressive, it's the perfection in which they're mixed. I just had some of the most phenomenal cocktails I've ever had, served by extremely welcoming and friendly staff, while watching pet semetary on the big screen. I am so supportive of this place. Cheers guys, you're all awesome. All the love.

The laundry services were fine. The wash was $5! That goodness I only had one load as the washers were huge. But wow, not cheap. The cycles are fast, everything done in under 1:15. But the Laundromat was so loud, between the soccer game and the blaring music I couldn't get any work done. I had to go across the way to Starbucks. :(  

The machines were fine and my clothes came out as they should, always a concern with Laundromats. Also, even though it was a Tuesday morning, it was very crowded. 

Best advice, put your clothes in and then park yourself at Starbucks!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Let me start off by saying I'm a dunkin girl through and through... that being said I will never go back to this Dunkin' ever again, not only was the staff beyond rude but I got a large iced coffee like I usually get (so I know exactly what it should taste like... but I get it some people make it different ...) anyways when I took one sip of it I almost threw up (i wish i was being over dramatic by saying this) it tasted like they used dirty sewage water mixed with cleaning supplies to make it... my stomach is still upset after that one sip. So if you value your health drive the extra mile or 2 to the next Dunkin. I know I will!

Went here for my husbands graduation dinner and man we're we satisfied. Of course we ordered everything that we wanted to try and received it on 2 boats despite the stares we got because it was so much for 2 people but please believe me we arrived here with empty stomachs and left satisfied and full.
The waitress was very polite and checked in periodically to make sure we were okay. The atmosphere is amazing despite the covid precautions that are in place. Definitely would recommend this place if your looking for a appetizing sushi experience the only thing is make sure you make a reservation.

I only chose this location because it was nearby my work but was surprised with the wonders they worked with my car! I thought my car was on its last leg and only wanted to do the bare minimum but they found out the problem with my car, fixed it, and it runs almost brand new now! Before it was shaking so bad and it felt like my tires were about to fall off but now it runs smoother than even when I purchased it in 2007. The only reason I didnt put it at 5stars is because I know I probably paid more than I would at some other places but once I got in my car and felt the difference it was well worth it!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I was looking for a new coffee shop option besides tStarbucks, so I stopped here one morning looking for my espresso fix.
I ordered the Varamel Iced Latte in that middle size, I think they call it moyen. It was wayyyy too sweet and I don't think it had any espresso in it at all. It doesn't even look like it has any espresso, just caramel and milk. I didn't even drink it; It was beginning to make my stomach hurt. 
Definitely won't come back. A waste of $5. The guy that served me was nice tho, so I guess you can say they have good service

LARGE rooms, comfortable beds, nice work area, nice view, PHENOMENAL breakfast, nice location in between Poydras and Canal.  Away enough from the Bourbon Street experience but close enough to walk.  About a mile from the Riverfront Mall and area as well as 3/4 mile from the SuperDome.  A CVS and 2 Walgreens within 4 blocks.  Not sure if some of the rooms have been (or should be) renovated lately but noticed some wear in corners and such.  Also, no fan in bathroom which is odd for this level of hotel.  Solid choice otherwise.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm not one that would ever order a quesadilla on a menu, but when I wandered by here, I was curious.  How much can you do with a quesadilla?  Even after I ordered the thai chicken quesadilla and my friend ordered a Cancun quesadilla, I wasn't expecting much.  But the portions are huge, the food was much more flavorful than I had expected and my friend and I swapped portions of our meals.  Their quesadilla was so different than mine, but just as delicious.  This place deserves a try, even if you aren't a quesadilla fan.  I bet you'll be back.  I will.

Since I joined the Marriott, I am glad I did. Our stay at the Courtyard was great , affiliation to Marriott. Rooms were clean and Comfortable bed. We even got to swim in the pool that is heated and the hot tub. They do serve Starbuck's drink but not all the drinks are available. They had very nice set up for gathering area. Kids and I was able to hang there and play some board games. Sorry about the cookie crumbs that kids left. Parking building is across the building. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and hope to see you soon.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We have eaten here a few times before and always enjoyed it. But we just had dinner tonight with family. Service was very good. Thats a 4 star. The food well thats a different story 
Three of the four main course dinners were warm to cold. Not hot, like a plated dinner should be. Also two dinners that were totally different had the same tasting sauce?? And add that they were barely warm. Yuk. But my son liked the meatball and spaghetti (yes 1 meatball) for $15!
To top it off my wife and mother in law ordered coffee. The decaf my wife got was also cold
Wow.
Dessert was good. But overall. Gotta give tonight 2 stars.

We had been going to Amici's for years, and the pizzas have always been good. One of the original owners unfortunately passed away, They somewhat recently Installed a new pizza oven and for while the pizzas were excellent. However last night we ordered a couple of pizzas and the crusts almost were like premade crusts. Perfectly even coloration, fairly flavorless, not crisp, I would say pretty below average. With the new pizza oven they been small, but the last pieces we received were small and not very good. It is an unfortunate change.

Well - I was really hungry, and there it was, and it was new and looked exciting. I went in. Apparently, there is something wrong with me - it couldn't have been the waitress who walked by me 6 times without a nod, while helping the dark-skinned people in the booth behind me...OK- ordered carnitas combo with flour tortillas. 22 minutes later got my meal, but with corn tortillas. Honest mistake. Only gringas eat flour tortillas, I guess. 
So, the food was ok, a bit over-priced, service was horrible, so you decide for yourself. Maybe they're still working out the kinks. But not at my expense....

With all due respect at no point have we received any missed calls, voicemails, emails, or condolence card. Your statement that the Dr. or anyone at your office has attempted to contact us in any way is false. Also at no point were we advised of any payment options. At the end of each visit we were advised of our bill and that is it. 
If anything please use our review to step up your bedside manner, customer relations techniques, and provide some sort of information in writing to your future clients about "payment options."

They are friendly but I was really disappointed. 
Picked me up 30 min late at collision center because they'had to get gas'. However, tank half empty when I got ut.
Only had gas-guzzling mini-van. Honestly, put $50 in it in 1 week, going less than 100 miles.
Check engine light on same day I got it. They assured me it was okay,they would never send out lemon vehicle.  However,  day I turned it i , I forgot my garage door opener and called them. They had immediately taken this van in to get serviced because of the light. 
Yet they begged me for 5 star review.  Yeah right!

Solid, red "gravy" place in Philly. Beware - it's very cramped inside and a table for two gets smaller as the bread is brought out along with 2 water glasses, 2 wine glasses and a bottle of wine!  Service was okay, nothing too special but they were very busy on the Sat. night we went. Food is delicious and the wine list is great . I'm always on the hunt for a great meatball and this place is in the top five!  Prices are reasonable for a city restaurant.  Definitely take advantage of the valet parking. Other wise you'll spend a lot of time circling the block and there are no nearby parking lots. Look forward to returning.

Honestly I wouldn't have written this if dessert was something cooked. The food was mediocre for Bucks County. Everyone saying there's only food this good in the "city"- which city? My main issue is that dessert was a cut up peach. For a three course 70$ meal, I expected something cooked or baked or elevated. Not a raw peach with blueberries, blueberry sauce, and the same vanilla sauce that was on the main course (shrimp). It took 30-45 min to come out and the wait staff couldn't even give anyone a fork. The entire dining room was clinking around a spoon to try and pick up a slice. It allegedly soaked in champagne, but I couldn't find it.

For the second and LAST time, we have ordered and PAID for a large takeout order for kids waiting back at home. Any idea how one is made to feel when some of the kids are missing their meal upon delivery. If this is the type of embarrassment and guilt that you would like to avoid, please pass by this particular establishment. A call to speak to management just rings with no answer, the employee's dress and professionalism lacks and their seems to be a lack of managerial supervision on site. I know this is fast food and one should not expect a great deal, but the bare minimum is giving the customer what they paid for.

This was so disappointing this evening ... my girlfriend's order of eggplant parmigiana was returned 3 times and she settled for cheese lasagna... it was so bland then my meat lasagna was burnt ... the owner charged for only for our wine which was kind... then we saw the neighboring table get an appetizing looking lasagna and even better bread that was served to us.... I could never recommend

Today 10/7 I tried again ordering pizza delivered ... it was very good! Loved the crust, not huge fan of artichokes but other than that would definitely recommend this restaurant

Plain, bland, not good sushi restaurant.  3-4 younger Chinese boys were the sushi chefs.  None of the staff was friendly or concerned about my experience.  

I had a dragon roll which was mushy, a spider roll which wasn't soft shell crab, and a spicy tuna roll that had a bunch of sesame seeds rolled into the rice.  

Normally at a sushi restaurant I would order nigiri only but the fish in the hoshizaki refrigerator at the sushi bar looked unappetizing and not properly stored.

Will not come here again. Stay away.

Terrible service. I was going to get a milkshake for a relative in the hospital who could only have liquids, I was told the machine was out of order and when I asked for a manager I was told they could not give me the managers name nor give me his name as he laughed while telling me this. This is unacceptable and pure laziness! If the machine is truly broken AGAIN- as it is every single time I've tried to get a shake or sundae then it's laziness on the management team for not having it properly fixed. The team members getting away with saying it's out of order is ridiculous as well.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Ordered pizza from our Embassy Suites near the St. Louis Airport. Got a family size half pepperoni and black olives and other half sausage. It was absolutely delicious! Absolutely! We frequent STL a few times a year, will def be back. I would also like to mention that we ordered some boneless chicken wings and asked for barbecue sauce and ketchup on the side. The driver forgot them but was nice enough to go downstairs to our hotel kitchen and ask for some. He then brohht them all the way back to our room. Awesome touch!

One of the best parts about living in SoBro is being within walking distance to this liquor store.  The best cider on earth, "Blackberry Wild" by CiderBoys did a limited release this fall and I could not find it anywhere--until I walked into SoBro Spirits.  I nearly cried tears of happiness, because this place really came through for me.

What I like about this liquor store is that the prices are reasonable, there is a good variety of beers and wine, and the staff is knowledgable.  Also, if you go in on a weekend there always seems to be free tastings going on!

P.S. Bring cash if you want a slight discount.

The salsa is AMAZING!  But i'm going to take this time (i have a LOT of it here at my table) to talk about.....driving from hendersonville to nashville in rush-hour, seeing my PCP for a physical, mowing a 1 acre lawn, running 5 miles, retrieving everything on the grocery list, taking the dog for a walk, 10 rounds of a fantasy football draft, vacuuming the whole house, making my own mexican dinner at home.  These are all things that can be done in the time it takes for your food to come to your table at Garcia's.  Enjoy with patience.

Ok, let me start off with my friend DJ mad maxx spins here. That being said this place is another hit or miss. I have been here in the summer when the outdoors part of the club is ideal and it was amazing it was packed the music was blazing and beautiful woman everywhere( I am married but I do have eyes).lol. On the flip side I have been in the winter when it was the opposite....drinks are strong and the smoke bar is cool and I will be back. Not because my friend is the DJ but because I enjoyed each time I went here. I recommend for any age but if your older and not looking to be surrounded by a bunch of kids this is your place.

Stopped in for a quick dinner a week or so ago despite the bad reviews on here. 

We actually enjoyed our meal though.The prices were decent as well. I got the sushi dinner special which I thought was a great deal: salad, soup and 3 rolls for like $14. I got the crunchy roll, spicy tuna, and salmon and avocado roll. They all were delicious and I even had leftovers. The boyfriend liked his noodle and chicken dish as well. 

Didn't really see anything bad about the restaurant on this trip. It seems like a decent place for a quick low-key dinner.

Went on a Tuesday with a friend, which is apparently the day they have sushi specials. So that made me happy since its been hard to find good sushi deals around town. 
The sushi I got was yummy. The side salad was ok..the ginger dressing (which j usually LOVE at Japanese restaurants) was weirdly overly chunky)
The reason for the 3 stars was the service. I know it was busy, but it took a long to time to get menus, our order, our food came out at weird times, the check. 
I'd go back for sushi when it's on special, but fully knowing the staff will be overwhelmed.

Generally i am not a big fan of writing bad reviews. But this place stands out

First the room i paid $249 a night is super small. I cant easily close the restroom door with me in it. Also the shower wasn't working

There are no basic amenities in the room like hair dryer and after asking twice in 3 days. We didn't get one

Sewage wasn't workingAnd when we called to fix it and the guy came to fix it acted like its my fault and it was hard explaining him that we checked in 1hr back

Super expensive and Not worth the price. Only reason i stayed there 3 days is because i needed a kitchen in the room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Normally somewhere I really love to go. The food is fantastic, and quick walk from my house. Unfortunately, after seeing I didn't pick up my phone for the delivery driver, he drove away without picking his phone back up and as I made it to my front door he refused to pick up the phone. After multiple calls, The restaurant promised to call me back, and didn't, twice. The manager told me there was nothing she could do. Not resend me food, not refund me, pretty much sorry our driver didn't pick up. Hopefully his foot gets stuck in a door & gets to read this. Congratulations on being a delivery driver.

I live in Montgomery County and really don't like coming into Philly because of the traffic and parking issues. My son and wife coaxed me in to coming.  I heard a lot about Ralph's and I was expecting a great meal..  Well all three of us had a great meal.  The best meatballs I have ever had.  The only reason I gave a 4 star and not a 5 star is that I felt that the waiter seemed to be doing us a favor in seating us when he was not that busy.  My son and wife did not agree with me.  They did not pick up on the attitude.  It is possible I was wrong.  Overall,  you need to try this restaurant because the food is very good.

Probably the best thing about this store is that the customers don't plug in the electric carts to charge for the next person WHO NEEDS one and the employees make ZERO EFFORT to correct this and plug the carts in. A store that is not accessible is total garbage until it fixes this gross negligence. 

Update: continues to be one of the few stores in the city with carts and aisles wide enough to use the carts, and can't be bothered to plug the carts in. Very confusing. It's almost as if able bodied people just really don't like disabled people and think we shouldn't leave our homes. Yep, almost something like that.

A couple of years back a guy pulled shears on me and tried to mug me just outside this place, and I ran in, explained what happened and asked to use their phone to call the police. A middle-aged Asian man (probably the manager) shooed me out, locked the front door, folded his arms and stared me down until I left (to wander around back outside where the guy who threatened me could easily have been waiting). I went to the ski shop just south of this place and they were much more accommodating.

Needless to say I will never give this place any business. It looks absolutely disgusting, run down and decrepit as well.

The service here was great, and the chefs were super quick and friendly. However, I was not impressed with the sushi. Some rolls were excellent but I had gotten two rolls that was so overwhelmingly fishy that I couldn't taste anything else in the roll. One roll I ordered twice and it didn't taste nearly as good the second time. Their menu was pretty diverse, but definitely more limited than ijji. There are also no fruity rolls if you like anything like that. But overall, great price and great service compared to most sushi restaurants in the area.

So thankful and grateful to the entire staff. Quality care is what this facility strives to achieve. Even though it's a walk in clinic, they are extremely efficient and effective with the care they provide. I walked in on a Saturday because my baby wasn't feeling well. After Dr. Catrina examined our dog she was diagnosed with pyometra . This isn't something to take lightly. It was a Saturday afternoon which they are scheduled to close at 3. Dr. Catrina is so committed she stayed later and did an immediate surgery on my dog. My sasha has recovered and back to normal. The ladies at the animal house are amazing. Thank you !!

I was able to eat here last night with some friends. The place was very clean and the server was friendly. We ordered mostly quesadillas and while they tasted really good, the shells were quite mushy and you couldn't actually pick up the pieces to eat them.  Our other friend got the fajitas in the pineapple. That looked fantastic and was a huge portion of food. Overall, it was an ok experience. I wasn't overly wowed by it, but it was tasty and made good leftovers today. Not sure if go back on my own but glad I tried it.

Okay, I confess I haven't eaten at a Burger King in like forever. But, I was hungry and they were there so I stopped in. 

Where have you guys been all my life? I tried there new burger the Philly steakburger and fries with a shake. (maybe I shouldn't be writing this review, if my kids see it I could be in trouble he works for the other guys)

Anyways, I loved the burger!!! Hands down it was good. The shake was as well good and the fries tasted freshly made with real potatoes not frozen. (at least thats how it tasted.)

I will definately come back again and give them a try on other items.

I understand that every fast food place has a bad day. However, this place has them all the time. I normally go through the drive thru,this time I went in. Bad mistake! No one welcomed me, or said we will be right with you they just kept going and focusing on the drive thru. I stood there 10 minutes. I would expect at least sorry for your wait, but nope. Then in the middle of my order she walks away to help you guessed it drive thru. No Hey, I am sorry for that just looked at me like let's get this over with. Not impressed with the staff, the rudeness, and where was the manager who should have been navigating the flow?
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Not worth it. Cashier inside was rude and didn't even pay any attention to me. She was talking to another employee the whole time. She just took my receipt and never looked at me once. No hello nothing. My car was still dirty inside. They didn't even touch my center console. I asked them if they could wipe it down because it was still filthy and they said sure no problem when i got inside they didn't even get the spot, as for my outside it was still dirty as well. It needed another time through the wash because there was a film left on it. I saw this place was busy so I figured I would try it out. Nope don't waste ur money.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PET HERE! I took my cat to this hospital because he had not been eating or drinking and they did not do anything to help!! They charged $150 just to take his vitals and to suggest for me to euthanize him. They did not even want to give my cat sub-cutaneous fluids, even though he really needed them. They also complained about my cat's behavior, and took him over an hour just to take his vitals. My poor cat died a few days after, and this people did not attempt to help. Shame on this hospital and the vets that work here.

You must have thick wallets to get your pet emergency surgery and if not, they will put you in front of a computer to apply for any credit you can get your hands on during an emotional  straining event and them telling you that your pet / Best Friend will be euthanized unless you retrieve the $4000-$6000 needed for the surgery every hour on the hour. 
The one very grateful occurrence was that the veterinarian at VSCD  helped me to find a surgeon who would do the same surgery for five (5) times less and my 2 yr German Shephard survived and is doing extremely well. 
So, I must thank her for Saving Ryder !

There are two paying systems to take more money in less time.  But, I am not sure how the car wash determines what was paid by whom.  I sure that would be more accurate if there was only one lane all-together. 
I guess people are just in a hurry and are not really paying attention.
There is an attendant there for guiding each vehicle into the conveyor.  So more cars can be lined up for washing--MORE MONEY!!!
I paid $10.00 for my carwash.  The attendant also sprayed slightly under my car.  That must be the detailed explanation of cleaning of the undercarriage.  
I guess you get what you pay for or accept what is given to you.

An unexpected find in a strip shopping center in Ewing. Ewing itself is always a turn-off, a town waiting for an economic revival. This place, though, is worth the trip. Old-style Italian cooking well-prepared and reasonably priced. Service was friendly in an old-fashioned way. Nobody seemed scripted and trendy would never describe this place. The decor is just fine and everyone in our party of 8 was pleased with both the food and the ambience. We will be back. BYOB's are less common on the New Jersey side of the Delaware river, making this spot even better.

I left this place many years ago when it became a regular hang-out for large groups of boisterous Russians who stood in clusters in the doorway, smoking profusely. The smell of smoke was unbearable. Now I'm back, the Russians are gone, and the place is great. I'm sure business here suffers in the shadow of the immensely-popular Oishi (less than a mile away). That's sad-because the food here is even better! We called ahead for our party of 10. Service was quick, efficient and very friendly.The sushi, tempura, teryiaki: all delicious. Miso soup was to die for! Not much "Asian Fusion" here-this is seriously Japanese and seriously good.

My goodness attitude I got from the cashiers so bad again from the moment I walked into the place. The worker who was supposed to work on my sandwich is stalled and went to the back for a little while eventually Cain and check the order but we purposely extremely slow for some reason didn't ask me if I wanted another sandwich and started with the next customer. I will stop her and she snapped how many sandwiches are you getting? When you got time to put Toppings on I asked for Parmesan and oregano, she put it on purposely heavy. 5:00 Monday

Jules has the best pizza. It's light thing crust and comes in so many healthy varieties. I don't feel guilty eating there once a week. My favorite slices are the Brooklyn (tasty garlic), buffalo chicken, ricotta spinach, butternut squash, mushroom, or eggplant. Every slice is truly divine. Service is quick. Seating indoor or outdoors is great. Parking can be tough in the lot. I recommend parking on the street and crossing over. Their cookie desserts are different and tasty. I like that they support local vendors and farmers. I don't have a single complaint about this joint and have been going weekly since 2009.

I was sadly disappointed with my visit. 

After reviewing other people's comments I can see why I was disappointed. I thought this was going to be restaurant quality food but this was fast food quality......I would compare it to Nico's. 
The food took forever to get to us, when we finally got it the food was cold. Taste wise it was okay, like if said I was expecting so much more.

On the positive side the waitress was super nice and they were all trey helpful! Customer service was A++. Also, the margaritas were yummy. 

Will not returning anytime soon, which is a shame because they great customer service which is hard to find.

The usuals are pretty good (sesame chicken, fried rice, dumplings etc). But the egg rolls are funky, the crab rangoons are never quite cooked all the way, and STAY AWAY from the Pad Thai, it was disgusting. I've only ever ordered for delivery, so I can't speak for dining in. Pricing is average, delivery guy gets here in about 20 minutes usually. One time it did take over an hour. 

To sum it up, eat here if you don't feel like cooking and want run of the mill American Chinese takeout.

One major perk is that you can order and pay online.

What a surprise this restaurant is in our neighborhood. The Mongolian beef wAs one of the very best that I've had. It had just the right amount of heat with tender meat. The scallions onions and sauce were the star of that dish. 
General Tsao chicken was very good and tasty.
During the lunch hours one can order endlessly many items in the menu including sushi and even hibachi. This is an unusual buffet concept as the food is ordered at the table and served to you by your server. And the server was very helpful and friendly.
We are certainly looking forward too returning soon.

We came in for an early birthday dinner. Half price wine on all bottles on Thursday were a definite attraction. The Louis Martini Cabernet at half price is a real bargain and treat.
My chicken Marsala was excellent with roasted garlic and potatoes. The sauce was exceptional. And as always their tiramisu is my favorite.

Unfortunately this review is not as good as it should be. The chicken piccata was so tough. We notified the server who took the dish back. He returned with the very SAME piece all sliced up and just as tough! What the hell was this chef was thinking????
