Absolutely insulting! And unprofessional. Shameful!

The Bottle Shoppe is a seriously terrible liquor store. Their selection is horrible. Anything more obscure than Fat Tire isn't available cold. It's overpriced. There's a 10$ minimum for card purchases. 

The Bottle Shoppe gets an extra star because it's probably in the most convenient location ever and the staff isn't offensively bad. Maybe I should have given them 1 star. Well, too late now.

P.S. To Luyi H. down below. The Bottle Shoppe is not in a bad area .If you think 49th and College is scary you're probably one of the top 20 most sheltered human beings to ever walk the face of the earth.

Holy toppings, Batman!  No seriously, the toppings are worth the trip to Yogurt Mountain.  It's not my absolute favorite yogurt, but it has the best toppings.  Nutella topping?  Yum!

I try to avoid eating dairy, so I was excited to see that they have one dairy-free option.  It was pink lemonade the first time I was there, which was pretty good.  However, I went back and the dairy-free option was Green Apple Slime.  I ate it because it was their only option, but it sucked.  I mean, does that name even sound good?

You can label this restaurant's cuisine as, Contemporary American. But you can also label it as, Not So Top Chef.

We ordered the Four-Course Prix Fixe Dinner plus the Beverage Pairing. For a party of four, the total bill was over $500. If the food was amazing and the beverage pairing truly enhanced the meal. Then we would have been okay with the bill. But it just didn't meet our expectations. Honestly, it wasn't worth the money. If you want fine dining, perhaps you'll consider another restaurant that will be equivalent to their cost.

The Ophthalmologist side of this business was fine and efficient. The retail side seems to have a lot to work on. There is a lot of up-selling and I felt like I was on a used car lot. After ordering my glasses I waited over a week and heard nothing from them as to wether my glasses were ready. I called and they had me on hold for almost 10 mins. to find out my glasses were ready. It looks like from some other reviews that there are some problems with this location. I will have to find another source for my glasses.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Second time down to nola for our group and we went straight from the airport to spirits. The resurrection drink is what we remebered from our last trip and they do have a cool light up mug. Now for the bad one of the wife's purchased us fireball shots on the barber chair. This started out by sitting in the barber chair and the lady takes this towel that felt like a brillo pad and wipes off your face. She spins the barber chair and pours a shot into your mouth. The rest of the experience you can look up from bar rescue but she would be better suited working in an S&M shop from the twisting that she did to us.

This place was pretty much a rip off. I had a coupon for a discounted inspection fee so I figure you would present it at checkout, which I did, but then I learned I had to have show it to them before I gave them my keys? Why, so you can up charge the other services? The emissions and state inspection was way more expensive than if you went to any other place. I only came here because of the coupon even though I saw the bad reviews and then end up not being able to use the coupon over some piece of paper taped to their counter that is not obvious to the customer.

We've been wanting to try this place for ages and until now, have had no luck because they are always sold out by the time we call. So when we were actually able to place an order, we were HYPE, and happily ordered the Burrata pizza and the Nonna's Argula Salad. The pizza crust, on top of having a great crunchy outside-to-soft inside ratio, had a beautiful sourdough taste and the red sauce tasted great. Despite being simple, the salad packed a lot of flavor, and paired very well with the pizza. Would definitely order from there again!!

Impeccable dinner and service! I had their riesling then switched to a pinot grigio for dinner. I had their Italian wedding soup and white truffle sacchettini that was in their 2018 holiday menu. SPECTACULAR!!! Enormous scallops, mushrooms, and lobster. Fully satisfied. Unfortunately I had no room for dessert.

I thoroughly enjoyed my meal. If you do come here I advise to go for pasta and/or seafood. Several people at my table had something more meat related and weren't that impressed.

Waiter was knowledgable about the menu and liquor selections. Would come by again and try something new.

The place is great and cheap. We go all the time.. well this one time we went and sat in the middle bc we wanted sushi and pizza for the kids.. well there was an issue with which side would serve us.. and then my boyfriend sits in the booth and a nail broke His 100 dollar jeans.. I get a manager and since I had already paid the bill and we are regulars.. THE MANAGER GIVES MY A 10.00 DOLLAR CARD TO COME BACK.. REALLY 10.00 DOLLAR FOR 100 DOLLAR PAIR OF JEANS..ALSO NOT TO THINK IF THAT RUSTY NAIL WOULD HAVE CUT HIM THE ISSUE WOULD BE MUCH BIGGER.. SMH..

I did not enjoy my upside down banana split. They were generous with the toppings, but skimpy on the ice cream so I had a ton of topping left that I threw away. I enjoyed the flavor-quality of the soft serve ice cream. However the hot fudge tasted bad to me, so I didn't really enjoy that at all. I think the items are too pricey for what you get. For $4-5 an item, I'd rather take my $$ to coldstone. 
If you are into the mom & pop type places, dairy joy on Manhattan is a lot like Bo's but with a lot cheaper of a price tag.

I drive a company owned van a 2013 ford transit connect. I have been noticing that the brakes in the rear have been making noise. I have told my management several times and they did not want to do anything about it. I came a little early before work i took the van here. They usually take it to ntb but they could not do it because the mechanic left early. Tires plus checked the brakes it turned out the fronts were good and the rears had cracks they even let me see the car to take pictures and let my management know hopefully they will start to bring the company cars here.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Stayed here on a Saturday night after a soccer game at LFF. Decent for a one stay & not too pricey for a Saturday night compared to other hotels I've frequented. 

Pros: Friendly staff. Separate living room/bedroom. The suite was a decent size. Comfortable bed and pillows. Free small bottle of water. (The larger bottle has a $4 sign on it)

Cons: Yellow stains on actual pillows. Water pressure in shower was high then low. Burnt out light bulb in bedroom. Have to pay $13 for wifi. Vending machines were practically empty and there's no gift/souvenir shop.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I took my BMW 3 Series in for service here last week. I'd been going to Dreyer & Reinbold but I have to say after my experience here this will be the only place I'll take my car. I took my car in for a suspected spark plug or ignition coil issue. I got estimates from multiple places on fixing the issue. Euro Motorworks compared favorably to all the other places. When I called they said if I didn't need a loaner they could get me in that day. I took my car in and they called me shortly after with a confirmation on the issue. They got everything fixed and I was able to pick up my car later that day. This is the place I'll be using from now on.

Highly recommend for its divey, authentic vibe and excellent pizza and full Italian menu (including $7.99 lunch menus, with dinner price being around $12 to $13.) Their pizzas are excellent and highly unique (served Chicago style by default but also avail in NY style). The clientele is very much the local university and overall Temple Terrace community. I recommend any of the pizzas (meat lovers is excellent) and any of the grinders or full dinner entrees are great ( try the CDB combo sampler for stuffed shells, chicken Parmesan, Ravioli, and Baked Ziti).

Service is great! Decor is nice! Beer and wine selection excellent. The problem is the pizza. I'm from Canada, I was in St. Louis for a few weeks for work. I mm really not sure if Pi Pizza is typical pizza for this part of the US or if it was specific to this restaurant. I tried both the deep dish, and the thin crust. I kept the ingredients simple so I could ge a flavour for the crust and the sauce. The crust was overly crunchy, and the sauce was full of powered garlic. I could taste the pizza in my mouth for hours afterwards!

My boyfriend and I got our food to go and when I got there to pick it up it took like 10-15 minutes for me to even pay for my food and there was only 4 people ahead of me. This place is super cute inside and their food is decent. My nachos didn't even have many chips it was basically all toppings which is okay I guess but I think there should be a good balance for chip to toppings. Also, they we're pretty greasy. My boyfriends Asada fries were pretty good but we're drowning in cheese. We also got their horchata which is a bit too sweet but very tasty.

Decent, I had the regular steak burrito, chips and salsa and guacamole. Burrito was decent, nothing to brag about.. Was hoping for better since I heard so much good about them. Salsa was great! Guacamole was bland and sad not to mention super freaking expensive. :( I will never pay almost $6 for their crappy guacamole again. I will try them again (just because their salsa is great) and hope I find what all the talk is about. It took forever for my food to get done. I was the only one in line and it took a good 30 mins .

Atmosphere was good and service at the bar was excellent; however the pizza was only so/so. We ordered a cheese pizza w/ extra cheese - the crust was still doughy and thick - not thin crust like the menu says!!! The cheese and the sauce had a decent flavor but the undercooked crust just made it a globby mess!! And the crust really had no flavor. We also tried a margarita pizza. Conversely, the crust on this pizza was well cooked and crispy where it needed be, but still had very little flavor. The tomatoes were ok but not ripe and it needed more basil. So... We're still in search of NY style pizza in the Tampa area!

My friend and I were walking around Rittenhouse and really wanted to grab a drink and be able to sit outside. We tried several places in the neighborhood, and finally stumbled upon Zama who had no problem wiping off the seats and having us sit outside. The hostess and waiter were super friendly and sweet, and didn't seem bothered that we were the only ones sitting outside. I ordered a bubbly wine, while my friend ordered a beer, and we were both very happy with the selection. It is a little pricey, but I would like to come back and try the food.

I came here for lunch, because I was craving some Japanese food.  I was planning to get one of their lunch specials, but noticed they serve ramen.  I decided to try the spicy ramen with California rolls.  The waitress was friendly and attentive, so I feel the service is good.  However,  when the ramen came out, the broth was kind of watery.  It lacked depth and kind of tastes like water with some spices added to it.  The noodles were decent.  The California rolls were adequate, but nothing to write home about.  My rating is not based on the service, which deserves 4 stars, but on the food, which I give 2 stars.

I really enjoy the food and atmosphere at Lücha. The service is excellent; friendly but unobtrusive. I especially love the pastor and the lamb tacos. Their margaritas have a lovely zing to them and I especially like the sangria. Taco Tuesday is a great way to nibble your way through the variety of tasty tacos or to try something besides your favorites. I do miss the hearty soup that they offered when they first opened. Hopefully they will bring it back at some point. Great spot to dine before going to the Fox or to the Symphony.

I don't usually DO McDonald's, but this one is close to my apartment, and I wanted to try a concoction. Caramel sundae with a hot apple pie crunched up in there. This my friends, is dangerous. I also had a spicy mcchicken. My personal trainer is probably like "how does this b*tch keep gaining weight?!?" Well girl, let me tell ya. It's random concoctions like this. 

Anyways. 4 stars for being quick, friendly, efficient, and for the ice cream machine working when I needed it the most. 

Four fast food stars is like two restaurant stars, but whatever. ‍ The apple pie mcflurry was incredible btw!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Love having dinner here after golfing or while my kids are golfing. The bar staff is great. The food is prepared fresh and they are flexible with sides. It's better quality than some of the other golf clubs in the area. They have a great happy hour and offer discounts for residents. They usually have 4-5 beers on draft and several others in bottles and cans, including Angry Orchard. 
The wings are award winning! The salads are really good but my favorite is the buffalo chicken wrap, grilled. It's tender chicken, with a light buffalo sauce, with cheese, lettuce and tomato- all packed into the wrap!

They offer free breakfast, but they run out of everything within a minute or two of setting it out. And what you stand around waiting for is really terrible. Microwaved pancakes, bacon, sausage, etc... Not that there's anything wrong with microwaved food, but they must microwave it for way too long. Not sure what happened with the eggs--super watery. The next day my daughters blueberry waffle was hard as a rock and the coffee tasted like water. I know, I know, it's "free" trust me, it tastes like it. Other than that, the room was nice and clean. And the staff was very friendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I brought my family here on Sunday night and there was a nice band. BUT! THE CHEFS TOOK FOREVEEEEERRR!!! The waitresses and the bus boys were running around tending to everyone like CHICKENS WITH THERE HEADS CUT OFF!!! My dad and went outside between chips and salsa for a vape break and came back then I started my timer... It took over 30 minutes to receive one plate of food out of a four top! In addition, we didn't receive our appetizer until after our food came out!!! This is not a problem with the staff, this is a problem with the upper management... Everyone was being served, IT JUST TOOK FOREVER...

I am beyond disappointed in JFK nails. They recently raised their prices from $30 for a mani/pedi ($20/$10) to $37 ($25/$12). Not only is that a rip off (you can go somewhere much nicer with free champagne for $35), but they have not one sign in the entire establishment with prices on it. I was there last month and paid $30, and then I come back this month and it's $37 - without the courtesy of being told beforehand that the prices went up. I will never be coming back here; it simply is not high-quality enough to be charging these prices. But even more, it is terrible business to not inform loyal customers of price changes - it's dishonest.

Not a fan of this place at all.  That weird, 'supreme' smell makes me think that something inside it is rotting.... and  I really, really don't want to eat it.
Their produce section is, surprisingly, good on selection.  I still prefer to buy out of farmers markets (Clark Park!) or one of the Amish trucks that circle the neighborhood, but supreme works in a pinch.  
I do NOT buy meat here.  The cases are dirty, and often not cooling properly, and possibly the source of the smell.  They do have a lot of ethnic foods, though, rarer things if you're feeling adventurous.

Walked in here at 10PM on a Saturday night in April after being turned away at another hotel which was full. They found us a "King Size River View" room and didn't question our poor planning.
Though the physical room dimensions were a bit small the bed was very large and very comfortable. Bathroom wasn't too pretty, the building is getting a little bit older, but the main floor and reception area is attractive.
The river view is actually quite beautiful at night!
Check in and check out was very easy and quick, the receptionist very friendly and attentive for 10PM. Really appreciated them accommodating me last minute.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: As long as you don't order the Honey Chicken, this is a pretty good takeout/delivery Chinese restaurant. They have all the usual staples on the menu, and vegetables come out fresh and crispy, not cooked to death and mushy. Pretty much my litmus test for a solid Chinese restaurant. As with most Chinese takeout places, the combo meals are where the best value is to be had. Containers come packed full, and for a 5.95 lunch that includes an egg roll, it's pretty hard to beat. The Honey Chicken though was a travesty... Avoid it at all costs!

Old school italian food that's delicious and affordable. Have only had it delivered so I can't speak for the restaurant experience, but the food has been fantastic! Standouts include the chicken parmesan and eggplant parmesan. As well as their Stromboli. It's a bit smaller than some places, but it's packed with ingredients and very filling! The marinara they serve is very tasty and those yeast rolls that come with the meals are excellent. There aren't many affordable old school italian joints around, and I'm  glad to have found this place and they are in my regular rotation!

This little market is in my top 5 favorite places to shop in St Petersburg, even though they offer a very niche inventory. I am a Lebanese boy, and everything I need to make all the food I grew up on, I can find here. They have an awesome selection of spices, bottles of oils, beans and legumes, rice, sauces, etc... They also have ready made hummus, stuffed grape leaves, tabouli salad, olives, and various baklava. Not to mention fresh pita bread and some frozen specialty items. If you need to entertain, and Mediterranean/Middle eastern food is your jam, you'll find what you need here!

I just recently moved the Wesley Chapel. I was in search of the best chicken wing spot, not really caring for the usual beef o Brady's and some other smaller places. I decided to try New York's best pizza for their chicken wings .I was glad I did. by far the biggest ,meatest and best cookd chicken wing in the area .sauces are pretty good .i chose to get them naked and put whatever sauce I want on them at the house. that being said ,I ordered a stuffed shells dinner for 14.99 one evening for my lady ,wasn't really well done and for 14.99 .I won't be ordering it again. but the chicken wings are what I'll come back for again and again

After seeing Dr. Vaughn's review, I didn't want to go to this location at all, but they were the only available open Banfield vet that wasn't booked. I heard there's four Drs there. I got her . It's true how previous reviews mentions how she talks about her own dog lol. Then call herself a "nerd, obviously because I'm a vet". Umm okay. I feel certain exams are overly price. I'm only there to help relatives who's out of town and their insurance is there. My own dog doesn't have Banfield anymore. There's better dog insurance out there.

Great atmosphere, staff was super friendly. Our waitress was really nice and accommodating to our then five year old daughter. I had been feeling a bit home sick (from NY) and when I discovered this gem at our local mall I couldn't believe it. I had yet to find real NY style pizza since moving to TB. I was not disappointed. The pizza was the best I've had here. Not exactly the same as the original in Brooklyn but it was delicious. Some parts were a bit burned so took off a star for that.  Great patio area for a nice evening meal in this great Fall weather.

Changing my review due to a pretty bad experience here on 1/27/18. Very disappointed as I was a frequent customer, unfortunately, I will not be visiting this location again. I really don't like to pull the race card at all, but tonight we felt the hostesses, two young Caucasian women treated us differently because of our race. My husband and 9 year old daughter were with me. We complained which normally I wouldn't, I'm pretty easy going but these young ladies' behavior was blatant.  Vivian,
Our waitress was wonderful and saved the night which is why I'm even giving  this place 2 stars but the experience left a bad taste in my mouth.

Yahoooo !! Finally a good Pizza  !!! Being from the East Coast, New Jersey, I really miss my pizza. Came across this tucked away hidden gem after seeing a show at the Eldorado.  Good thing I did cause this so far has been the closest thing to a real Pizza Pie !! Unfortunately, they are inside the Casino, don't open at till 5 and they aren't open on Sundays, total downers !!! I wish they had a stand along place because I would be there every weekend!! 

Oh, you can order by the slice, which is super huge!! And they are have beer. 

Thank you for a fantastic slice of heaven and I will be back !!

I had heard mixed reviews of Crazy Sushi for years and finally gave it a go. I was underwhelmed by their rolls (we got spicy tuna and spicy salmon) and they labeled which was which but they tasted so close I couldn't have distinguished what was what. I also found a scale in one of the rolls which I'd think happens here and there but was kinda gross, plucking this scale outta the sushi roll. 

I will say they had excellent Gyoza dumplings and their seaweed salad was one of the best I've ever had. We also tried the chicken pad thai and it was just okay, it was kind of bland.

I was really looking forward to taking my friend here for her birthday, but we were all disappointed. The service was not great, although she was a very nice woman she was not a good server. She messed up our order and was slow despite only being one of three tables. When we asked questions she said she didn't know. She had no recommendations when we asked which was odd. Everything we ate was not great and I know I could have made better at home (and I'm on the level of cook for survival, not really for pleasure) I'm glad I tried it because I had heard good things but was disappointed overall. Not a repeat place for me.

Wife and i visited for dinner. They served nice little garlic rolls. We had pleasant sausage soup, very good lasagna and chicken marsala with penne pasta. The pasta, marsala sauce with mushrooms was delicious. The chicken was awful. It appeared to have started out as a thick breast that had been butterflied into 3 pieces two of which were served. They were thin and tasted over boiled. I left a slice and a half on the plate. Ate some of my wife's lasagna. Service was efficient and very pleasant. DO NOT order a sliced chicken dish.

Lived here for almost 6 months now, and still love it. The office team is helpful and friendly, and keeps the clubhouse and pool looking great! The laundry facility is nice and easy to use. The maintenance crew was also super friendly and welcoming to us! 

Our apartment came with new carpets, bathrooms were clean (except for a few nail polish stains from the previous renters) and was in pretty great condition. Our garage came with a built in light, and plenty of space to work in! They are even super friendly towards our new puppy! Happy with our home, and plan to stay for another round.

The best thing about this place is that it's byob.   Here was our order:

- Salad: comes with your iceberg lettuce and some house dressing.  Not that great
- Meatballs - I thought this was good.  The ball was very tender and the sauce/gravy complemented the dish well. 
- cacio e pepe - this was just an oily dish.  The noodles were almost fried, not al dente.  Definitely not worth the price tag. 
- pizza: I think this is what you should come here for.  The pizza was good and probably the star of the night.

Would try other places on the Ave

The food was just magnificent. Highlight: Gnudi dumplings in a sage brown butter sauce. Just like the sweetbreads at Bayona, I could have just order multiple of these. 

Our waiter was very nice and intelligent when it came to the food; however, I did hear another waitress describe the meal to be served "family style" to her table. This was incorrect. Family style would be one large dish that everyone shares. A mano serves individual size portions. 

I will highly recommend this joint to anyone seeking Italian cuisine.

Atmosphere is really nice inside.  Our server was pleasant and did her job just fine no complaints. But you go to a restaurant for the food and I have to say I was very disappointed - the duck was dry and sauce too thick, crispy chicken was not crispy or anything special at all, the sea bass was dry and had multiple  bones - .  I had a cocktail the smallest Martini glass I've ever seen tasty but way over priced for the size.  The cocktail did come in a chilled glass. My sons spaghetti was ok.  Very disappointed -

I always like a good Hampton Inn. The room was spacious. The bed was super soft and comfy. The bathroom was clean and newer looking. Breakfast in the morning was plentiful. The only thing was that we did not have room service on a daily basis which is ok for me because I don't particularly need it everyday as long as I have clean towels I'm good. But if you're into that sort of thing then I would say keep an eye out. Also this hotel is attached to a super cute food court and small shopping center. The location is a block from Bourbon St. and there is a 24hr chicken and convince store right on the corner. I would definately stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We went here for dinner after shopping, it wasn't too busy on a Monday night.
The hostess lead us to our table, and put down menus then walked away.
Jeff our server was attentive, informative and friendly.
My Capellini Carbonara was great, my husbands spaghetti n meatballs looked horrible w processed looking meatballs.  Breads served in the beginning and the Garlic bread ordered was good.
Portions were large.
But when our salads were given, a trio of dressings were given with no explanation of what they were and the actual vessel it came in was a little gross.
It was nice, but I wouldn't come again.
It just didn't seem clean to me...

I called ahead this time to confirm they still had my appointment and it was there. I showed up 10 mins early and they were waiting for me. This was an oil change and a 30 point inspections, I should have asked ahead, so keep in mind this takes about 1:20 to be done.
The waiting room is great, cold A/C, free water, coffee, cappuccino, soda, popcorn and cookies.
Once they finished, the inspection did not comeback with any crazy finds and the whole check-in / check-out process was smooth. I think they recovered from the first fumble.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Got a Grupon for oil change. went there two weeks ago and made an appointment for today at 11am. I showed up and they said they had never heard from me. my name was not in their computer and I was treated ok, but they never apologized for loosing my appointment (I forgot to show them the TXT message I was sent by their system to prove that I was there before). This alone would have made me never come back to this place, but I have the Grupon already. So, I got another appointment for next week, this time I asked for a written confirmation of the appointment. we will see if this rating changes. This is not a good start with a new customer.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Stayed here 4 nights on our first visit into NO.

This hotel is about 2 blocks away from the french quarter and has good access to nearby convenience and drug stores.

Being 2 blocks from Canal, you are able to walk into FQ really easily, but not get all of the noise that comes with late night partying.

The morning breakfast is excellent.

The housekeeping staff failed to clean our room 1 night, and overall I felt the front desk could have been a bit nicer. They show off a 4 star Trip Advisor rating, but I feel that with a few changes, they could be a 5 star. 

I guess 4 star is just where they want to be.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We had an awesome stay for my girlfriends birthday here. I was hoping to stay somewhere different and attractive all while having the luxury of staying in and enjoying Tampa itself. Thankfully, Aloft delivers. The only thing I would say in this, would be the 20$ valet fee that you're forced to pay along with a random 50$ I was charged on my card at check in. We spent almost 200$ just at the bar because the servers kept making us close out but honestly, if it weren't for all of the strange payment situations, I would most definitely make this my go to hotel!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
These people are the absolute worst! I have come here twice with both of my vehicles to get an inspection and on both occasions they have told me I can't pass my inspections because I need brakes. Both of my cars are 2018 and 2019 vehicles respectively. I take them for routine maintenance at the dealerships. They want me to por chase brakes from them both times however, when I took my car to the dealership for an oil change l, they said my brakes are not in need of new pads and suggested I go elsewhere. Also, the staff is not knowledgeable about prices on anything. 
Just be careful before you bring your car here for inspection is all I can say.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
The family that owns this convenience store, deli, and meat market, are top notch friendly people. The Deli just opened and they are still getting organized, but is on its way to being a dependable business in the neighborhood. 

Improvements that are needed- 

Though in a rough neighborhood, employees could be friendlier and prices could be reduced on grocery and deli items by 10 to 20 percent and still be profitable. 

Hats off to the owner-  Red Zone is Clean and well lit. It feels safe. That is a definite plus.

All you can eat sushi for $20! This place doesn't have the best ambiance and is out of the way from my downtown abode (this place is near Ben Davis in an older building), but it's made its way on to our list of sushi restaurants. This place is good for slightly above average sushi (for the area) and when you want a lot of it! They don't skimp on the amounts, and will bring as much as you mark down. They will charge extra if you leave a certain amount uneaten. The dinner price includes soup and some appetizers too. Pictures say a thousand words, so check out our platters and give this place a try!

I decided to go here after I arrived in Tampa. Since it was in the late night/early morning hours this place seemed ideal.

I ended up going with the Bacon Cheeseburger. The burger itself was just okay, nothing special about it. Just an average diner burger. The fries however were pretty bad. You can tell they must be using old oil in the fryers because the fries were a brownish color. They also weren't seasoned at all, so they were very bland.

The one positive I would say is that the waitress was really nice.

I'm so glad that I have a Anytime Fitness nearby. What's really nice about the Anytime Fitness franchise is the remote key access that they give to all their members. You literally can go whenever you feel like it, even when their employees are not there. It's also a universal key that works at all locations. 

This particular location is spacious with ample cardio equipment, free weights and weight machines. I've gone three times so far (between the hours of 10am-12pm) and I've never had to wait to use a treadmill or weight machine.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: No wifi and cell signal horrible. Had pizza with pepperoni, anchovies and feta. It was light on feta but tasty. Got it with x sauce and crispy. It was repeatable but crust was a bit too institutional for my taste even tho I like thin crust. Thai wings were huge but get blue cheese with them. They may have been ostrich wings! I felt return on investment was low here. Been trying lots of New Orleans pizza places. I prefer mos for value and tasty sweet sauce. I like reginellis but make sure to get hummus there. It's the star on the menu. Brooklyn pizza was ok but didn't wow me. Favs still are gendusas and mos. Prob gets another star with wifi

I really enjoyed getting takeout here with my entire family.

We ended up here after shopping one day, and placed a giant takeout order. It only took about 15 minutes for everything to be ready! The lady was really nice, and after placing an order of about ~$60, my boyfriend wanted to buy a coconut drink and she told him just to take it.

The food is really good, but the pork fried rice and sweet and sour pork are definitely two of my favorites.

Will definitely return! Hoping to try their lunch specials sometime.

I think the word Global is a stretch... Now if Pico di Gallo on everything means Global than I apologize. I was looking forward to experiencing unique updates to the traditional quesadilla but was disappointed that it was variations of the same thing. The St. Louis quesadilla looked to be the most interesting variation of ingredients but definitely not global. If you have a hankering for a lot of cheddar and Monterey jack cheese, this is your place, if you are looking for a fresh take on an old standard you will be disappointed.

Staff were very helpful and the workout was just the right intensity and targeted the whole body. I also liked that there was a variety of equipment to work out with and ways to track your progress within the studio. For example, there is a body scanner there that tells you your measurements of your hip, waist, biceps, thighs, etc., which I thought was super cool!! It was my first time here and doing a TRX workout, and J was extremely helpful and supportive when it came to correcting form or doing the right exercise.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I went here for dinner on a Friday night. It was busy but I was seated right away. The atmosphere is pretty casual. The beef bulgogi was good. The tuna (maguro) nigiri was excellent. I thought the Mt.Fuji roll tasted off but they said it's a traditional Japanese roll with Oba leaf which has a very distinctive taste and most people are not a fan of it. They were nice enough to give me more nigiri instead since I did not like the roll. I really like the Ozeki Karatamba Honjozo Sake. It was dry and not too sweet. (+7 scale)

I just moved back to Tucson and used to LOVE the original Vivace. This was my first time at the new location and I love the inside of the restaurant. I was here in the middle of summer, during a monsoon on a Thursday night and it was full. Very unlike Tucson restaurants. The service was perfect.

I liked the burrata. The escargot was ok but not my fav. I didn't realize Veal marsala had mushrooms so its my fault for ordering and not liking it. I did like the side vegetable pasta. Next time I go, I'll try the fish of the day.

The food was a moderately expensive price for what you get. It lacked seasoning and portion sizes were small. The salsa was just heat, needed more acidity. They had a unique feature because they only use a QR code menu. I got the pollo bandido which was 10 for a very small portion equivalent to a lunch size. I had to request hot sauce to give it flavor, they had Valentino's which is one of my favorite hot sauces. The staff was very friendly and they cleaned well from what I could see. A lot of customers came in maskless though, which I didn't like. I probably wouldn't give them another try again.

Can't expect much from a chain fast food place that isn't chick-fil-a. Decided to come here for the new tacos since I actually like them. The place was not very busy when we first came in and the place wasn't as clean as it should be. Staff was not friendly and service was fairly slow. The food was alright, the tacos weren't as good as the other two locations I have had them at. The staff ignored a group of lawn guys waiting to order. It really isn't that hard to say, "just one second let me finish this up." None of the staff smiled once or even said have a good day. I would not revist this location.

I like going here for just plain custard but they don't have much of a variety of flavors. I like to change things up and the only real flavor you can get here is vanilla. It does advertise that the custard is fat free though. I would have liked if there were other choices. The custard is not too flavorfulI. I would recommend getting some kind of gelato, topping or getting a flurry with peanut butter cups or something in it. It's a good place to go to if you're passing by but I wouldn't go out of my way to go here.

Umai had a cozy environment with well decorated lighting. The bathroom was clean, though unisex so I could see it getting busy. 

The sushi tasted enjoyable and fresh, and I appreciated how they chose to prepare it with more fish than rice. It's a BYOB and it's a good experience, especially considering it's availability and convenience.

I rated the restaurant more poorly because some of the staff were sheerly incompetent. We asked for a variety of things, such as a fork, warm water, and to even take our order, but the younger gentleman waitress seemed to just be staring off into the abyss rather than answering our help.

Grabbed some take out on a Thursday night. We had gotten their menu in our mailbox and it's within walking distance to our house. I orders the 'Rodeo Burger' which has bacon, cheese, onion rings, and BBQ sauce. Burger was big and tasty. The fries were still hot and Fresh when I got home. Solid burger option and nice service. The place was clean and the gentleman behind the counter was nice. I did not try any pizza or anything else yet. This review is for the service and burger. I did not see any pizza ovens up front behind the counter but may be in the back kitchen area. Cheers!

We ordered takeout from this spot last night and overall the pizza was just OK. We ordered the cauliflower white pizza which was interesting and somewhat tasty and their shrimp pizza with red sauce. The shrimp pizza had tiny pieces of shrimp on it that looked like 2-3 shrimps had been shredded up and spread across the dough. This left us feeling disappointed (not to mention hungry!) after spending $30 on two pizzas for dinner. The service was friendly and it's one of a handful of BYO spots in Nolibs but given all the other amazing pizza spots that deliver or are 15-20 mins walk we will skip giving this spot a second chance.

This is a convenient bar and grill that often has live music on the weekends. They serve decent food especially the great breakfast over the weekend. They have a full bar and kind bartenders. The owner is great when he is there and everyone else that works there is either close friends or family...or so it seems. They treat everyone lovely. You can even go alone and have a nice time with the bartender and listening to the juke box when there isn't a live band. The only things that sucks is the bathroom as it is very small.

Okay, so this FOOD CITY is the BOMB! They have a cocina that makes a variety of foods including but not limited to sopas/caldos, chile rellenos, burritos, breakfasts, lunch, sonoran hotgods, agua frescas, and even SUSHI!!! So, I go for the Gallina Pinta or Cocido. Both are great choices and served with a pan birote- grilled and buttered or a tortilla (flour/corn) of your preference. A large is only $7 and you can get it to go or eat there. 2nd best thing is the sushi. The sushi chef is amazing and he freshly prepares the sushi right then and there.

Unlike my coworkers I'm not too keen on the burgers or fries here; however, their customer service would be the thing that I would come back to. 

It does get busy during lunch time (11am-1pm) with line that leads out the door and an equally long one at the drive-thru. 

The menu is simple: burgers, fries and shakes. It is straight and to the point. This isn't a place that has a bombarding and overwhelming menu. The chocolate shake is my goto when my coworkers won't stop somewhere else to appease me. :-)

Now, back to the customer service it is impeccable...inside or via drive-thru. They are always cheerful & look genuinely happy.

My poor car was long overdue for a wash. Since saturday was a nice day i figured why not  get this thang cleaned. Well..i opted for the $10 package..after driving out to dry off i noticed that a few spots were missed..not exactly terrible but upon trying to use the FREE vacuums i had no luck. The suction was pretty non existent. Went to tge vending machine and it was out of many things. Definitely not worth what i spent. Will not be returning to this location. Gave them a 2 bc my car actually did look better afterwards.

Got the chance to stay here on a random Wednesday. The lobby area is really nice and modern. Staff was friendly. The room was small but nicely decorated and equipped with what we needed. I dont like the fact that were no windows...felt a bit stiffling. 

Loved the sliding door to the bathroom. Bed was comfortable and room was pretty clean. Lots of channel variety on the tv..important for a tv junkie like myself. Quiet on the floor which was nice. Street parking was easy to find..probably bc it was the middle of the week. Would def stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Passable food, attractive room and generally excellent service, but I hesitate to return mainly because of the house margaritas: sickeningly sweet, made from mix (no fresh lime juice). You can do better San Carlos. Also, many dishes taste as if they share the same generic red Mex sauce; they're often bland and lack heat and complexity. The small outside patio mainly overlooks the parking lot and Walmart complex. That said, they do put out a great anytime breakfast, which you can scarf down before an early bargain matinee at Century theaters a few doors down.

If you are walking around GFS and are a bit peckish, this is not a bad choice. Food is very casual but fresh and prepared when you order. Soups are homemade and are usually very good, pizzas not too bad for kid's tastes. But you don't really go here for the food alone, more for the convenience of not having to leave the park, and also for the great atmosphere in the courtyard. I've eaten here many times and was never disappointed since I knew what to expect. If your tastes are for more upscale cuisine, walk over to Rat's, but be prepared to spend twice as much at least.

Shout-out to Rob, our regular server, who hooked us up with an amazing Quatro Formaggio Thursday night.  Rob - I'm also going to try that Pesto & pepperoni modified Quatro Formaggio of yours.  I think I'm man enough to handle it.

For those of you in the Carmel area who haven't tried Crust yet, you don't know what you're missing.  Everything about the new location has been phenomenal, and when it comes to personal service, it doesn't get any better than this.  The owners and staff care, and it shows in their work.

This was our first time here. We received excellent service from our server, Eric. He took time to speak with us about the restaurant, and about the various pizza choices. The Meridian is an excellent choice. Very flavorful and satisfying. The overall ambiance is upscale and tastefully decorated. Located on Old Meridian in Carmel, it's easily accessible with nearby parking. The pizzas here are all 12", so if you're looking for a place to feed a bus load of kids after the game, you should probably go to Pizza Hut instead. We'll definitely be coming back here.

Had my first Philly cheesesteak experience here. The staff were nice and the seating area was clean and well maintained. I didn't have anything to compare the food to but, it wasn't bad. I thought the cheesesteak was a little dry but, that might be how they always are. 

One thing that irritated me was that a sales person for some makeup brand was allowed to walk around and interrupt our meal to ask me if I wanted to buy makeup or if my coworker wanted some grooming kit. It was more of a nuisance then anything but, I'm not sure why the manager thought it would benefit the customers to allow this person to come around and try and sell things.

When our office moved to a new location on Old York Rd we were at a real loss for where to get good take out.  Bravo Pizza II has been one of the few places that my coworkers and I order from.  The pizza is pretty tasty and is good for when we need a quick meal to serve a bunch of people.  I also tried their Buffalo chicken pizza.  On the plus side it was cheap but not the best I've ever had due to it being incredibly greasy.

In general Bravo Pizza II is good place to order some pizza for a big group but not the best if you're looking for high quality or healthy food.

I love Chinese and I have to admit that I'm not very picky about it.  I don't know if I've ever met a General Tso's chicken that I didn't love.  We ordered Generals, Orange chicken, sweet and sour chicken and some lo-mein (I didn't try the lo-mein so I can't speak to that...)  All of the chickens had really great flavor and large portions.  Prices were very reasonable and it was extremely quick delivery.  If the chicken had been slightly crispier I would have gone with 5 stars but other than that everything was fantastic.  Oh except that they forgot our fortune cookies.  Apparently I have no future.  Bummer.

Usually I make the long trek out to the Giant in Landsdale but lately when I'm in a rush I've been stopping over at the Fresh Grocer.  The nice thing is that it's very clean and nice inside.  They have a wide selection, including many more ethnic food items then your typical chain grocery store.  The downside is that everything is outrageously priced.  To make matters worse they don't have any generic brands so there are literally no cheap options.  I will go here if I just need a few things and I'm in a pinch but 99% of the time I'd rather drive 15 minutes extra to go to Giant where I can actually afford to buy food.

We had a very good pizza. Plenty of toppings and the crust was perfect. Both the inside of the rstaurant and the parking lot are very small. They had less than 10 parking spots total. And inside, about 5 tables. They are geared more for take out and the tables were covered in a thin plastic table cloth with holes in it. It needed to be wiped down, but was the plastic with the little ridges, so very hard to clean well in a public setting. Not a very large selection of beverages and no beer. I give the pizza 4.5 stars, 3 stars for the place being so small, and 2.5 for keeping the place clean.

Please do not move here. There is little to no ventilation in the apartments as a whole.Several tenants have informed me of the mold and dust issues that they have experienced living here. Recently, I had mold growing in my apartment, while they spray cleaned it, the Home Depot tests that I did show that there are spores throughout the apartment that also need to be addressed.  I have been coughing for almost a year because of the mold situation and have had several doctors bills and prescription bills as a consequence. The management has not fixed the systemic issue of poor ventilation in their units. DO NOT GET SICK! STAY AWAY!

This nail salon is a chop shop. This was the first time Ive had my nails done in over 5 years. I knew I wanted the gel set nails but I didnt know how they applied them. Which wasnt good because after 5 times repeating I wanted a gel full set I was given a acrylic full set but charged for the gel set. The guy that works there was rushing which caused my nails to bubble and chip with in the next 2 days. The price is reasonable but you get what you pay for. Cheap service you get cheap results. I did like how i was given water bottles after waiting for 20 minutes! :-/

I know this is Reno, but employees here are just gruff and lacking in personality. The rooms are clean and basic in amenities. Hotel is in a quiet corporate area so no airport or freeway noise. Kinda gross hot foods for breakfast. I'd go out if you want a true hot breakfast. 

Worst coffee ever!! Both in breakfast and in rooms. Nasty stuff. Go to Starbucks.

Edited to add that I had 3 separate conversations with the front desk about which credit card to charge. THREE! The last being the moment we checked out, being assured it wouldn't hit the card I'd used months ago to reserve the room. It STILL hit the wrong card. Details people, they matter.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I used to get oil changes here. Oil changes come with a free tire rotation. Well, with my first car I got around three oil changes and tire rotations, and the wheels became misaligned and the car needed a $160 repair (which they, conveniently, offered to provide). Come on, if they should be good at something it should be tire rotations. Their name is "Just Tires".

Anyway, now I get my oil changed at Walmart nearby, which is same price.

Customer service is ok and they do have a nice waiting area, but that is no excuse for poor technicians who will cause your vehicle needing repairs. If you do get an oil change here skip the tire rotation.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I called to get a 6:45 appt for a gel manicure. She sweetly asked if I could come in 20 minutes because they close at 7. So I hightailed to get here and I've been sitting here for 15 minutes. 
I have gel on, so they could have had me soak while they finished their other stuff. 
It's only my second time here. It was last minute and I realized I could use a manicure before I left town in the am. So I thought this would work. 
Anyhoo, be warned that setting a time or accommodating theirs doesn't mean you'll get in and out when you expect.
The girl did a nice job on my nails and they are reasonably priced.

I really wanted to love Moto but it just didn't live up to the hype!

My husband and I split:
- Olive oil flight:  Loved it -- the infused olive oil was my favorite, and their focaccia bread is amazing.
- Pork meatball:  Unfortunately not a lot of flavor
- Oreccihette carbonara: Was way too salty, didn't finish
- Offerte del Giorno pizza (had tomato, sausage... I've forgotten what else): Not bad.

That being said, our server was very pleasant and the atmosphere was nice.  If you're thinking this is a romantic date spot, though -- look elsewhere.

Came back for Valentine's Day lunch and after immediately sitting down our server comes along and rudely tells us to rush our order because they were closing in half an hour so we were only allowed to get 1 order in. 

Keep in mind, their service is either decent or really poor. It was definitely the latter today. Not even 10 minutes into receiving our order, they had us pay before we even got to get through be 1/4 of our food because they wanted to close. Working in a restaurant myself, rule is that even if we're closing we are never supposed to tell guests to hurry out. We felt very unwelcome and as if they couldn't care that we were rushed.

Food was good but Maki Maki is better. The prices seemed more than fair and the decor was nice, but the booth we got was horribly uncomfortable! Wood with no cushioning, and it was barely attached and the odd shape meant we couldn't relax backwards without wood pressing uncomfortably into our backs, and if the table at our back pressed against it, it would lean precariously. 

I got the chicken and sashimi bento and my boyfriend got the deluxe sashimi and a roll. The sushi roll was much bigger than expected and he wasn't complaining HAHA! 
I'd give it four stars if on our next visit we sit at a table rather than the booths.

This place has the nicest most hospitable staff I have ever met. I stay at hotels all the time, I travel for work for a living and I have never had so many people in one hotel be so kind hearted and generous to me. I would recommend anyone stay here. The staff at the restaurant us such a joy and the front desk is so helpful and sweet I truly cannot get over the good hearted souls that work here. I would vote this the best double tree I've ever stayed at and I'm a Hilton Honors member and stay at them all the time. Thank you staff you were excellent.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've stayed at this place almost 10 times now and I love it. I feel so at home here. The staff is wonderful and the room is cozy and provides an awesome view. Outside by the bay you can go to the beach, have a cocktail, hang out w friend. It has an amazing ambience!! It's a nice vacation away from home and it's not too pricey. I would absolutely recommend this place! I do wish there was an outdoor pool but they make up for it w/jet Ali's and kayaks and lots of activities. It's also right Next to Bahamas breeze which is an awesome good time w great food and drinks. The best part is they don't charge for your pet!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went in on Veterans Day to get my free small coffee and free donut! This was my first visit in! The shop is quite small and on the end of a strip mall. It was the end of the day and they still had a good variety of donuts left. The staff were friendly and quickly provided me with my order. My coffee was okay. The donut chosen was just the signature glazed donut. It was airy and light and delicious!!!! Still fresh at the end of the day! One small issue, there were very small ants crawling around by the coffee creamers, sugars and stir rods (trash can located there too). Hope this gets fixed!

We made reservations to have dinner here in a Saturday evening. Our reservation was for 530pm and we arrived on time. We weren't seated until almost 6pm. The restaurant was not packed but it looked as though the restaurant was understaffed. Our service once seated was good. Our waitress was knowledgeable and friendly. The lobster bisque was yummy but didn't have any chunks of lobster in it. My mother had a lasagna but it was a bit dry/not enough sauce. My spaghetti and meatballs were pretty good but they skimped on my noodles. The bar drink menu was limited.
Overall, an okay experience but there is a lot of room for improvement!

I have loved this place for years - only issue seems to be staff turnover and the staff ranges from exceptional to barely competent.  Blonde woman who was there for the first few years was great - then she left and they had another tall lady with dark brown hair who was pretty awful.  Then a couple of others and a young enthusiastic guy who spoke Spanish and had potential came and went..   Girl who's there now during the week seems distracted and makes a lot of mistakes.  I still love the food - owners need to focus on retaining quality staff.

I'm increasingly disappointed in Cafe America.  The consistency of the dish which I've been ordering for a long time has been suffering  - I honestly don't know what I'm getting when I order the food to pick up and I've had to open the bag, open the container and make sure the order is complete.  On top of decreasing consistency (which they blamed on their chef when I called to tell them about it this past Friday as though they have no responsibility for what comes out of their kitchen) their staff has adopted the practice of showing you your credit card slip and asking "did you want to add the gratuity to this??"

Love this location! Super clean and the staff is always wonderful. You're always greeted with a smile and the service is very prompt! Conveniently located next to Target so I can shop and stop in for breakfast, lunch or a quick drink & treat! They keep everything well stocked. Though the Target has a kiosk for Starbucks inside, I always prefer to come here! It's also next to an urgent care and when you have an unexpected visit with one of the kids late in the day it's a nice place to stop and get a pick me up to get through the wait times.

We love coming for the lunch buffet on Sunday's. The food is always very fresh and you get the most bang for your buck if you get the buffet. We have never experienced bad service. The waitresses and waiters are always friendly and they bring plenty of drink refills. 

The sushi rolls are made fresh right in front of you. Also great choices are the spicy noodle salad and the spicy tofu salad. They also have fresh miso soup, cream cheese wontons, and a whole variety of cooked dishes like spare ribs and cooked salmon and a large variety of tempura style items. 

This place is always a favorite!

I used to come here years ago and it was a great place with great signature dishes. Last night was the 1st time in 5 years.
TIP-----the menu has changed. The majority of the good dishes are not there so look at the dates of photos or the date of the menu photos.
TIP-----they are building condos across the street. More than likely it won't be a very quiet outside meal during construction  hours.
TIP---- this location will be closing; the land will be a parking lot for the new condos.
Enjoy it while it's still here.

This place is very nice and clean. Staff seems friendly enough & the free breakfast isn't bad at all. My room has everything you can need when you're on the road a lot. Office / Kitchenette area, living room, bedroom, dressing room and a nice bathroom. I'd give this place 5 stars if the rooms had a little square footage. They are not small by any means, but feel a little more room would make it more comfy. They have a nice pool that's very clean with plenty of nice seating. Also has a very small "store" by the front desk that is nice for getting food and the essentials when you don't have time to run to a store.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: When there on a whim one day. Tried to order online first, but their website only lets you order form their Manayunk location. Got a veggie burrito and chips & queso. The queso was REALLY BAD. I mean, it was worse than movie theater nachos, as those at least have a strange, chemically flavor to them. This queso was just a tasteless, warm, viscose substance. Chips were like crappy storebough ones, not like the warm, crispy thin ones you get at other mexican fast food locations. Burrito was Eh. Nothing special. Got the Saffron rice, but didn't care for it too much. All in all, I'd rather just stick with California Tortilla or Moe's.

I have mixed emotions about this place, it was very staffed at 6am but some staff did not seem to care where the other staff went out of their way to be helpful. I waited 3mins in line before the girl who took my order seemed to be only into herself & claiming about everything (the schedule, her getting a new job)....while using profanity at the front register. I asked for the order for here but she was not paying attention & someone put it in a bag, anyway. Got a ice coffee, it was ok I guess, an older lady asked me if I wanted a refill as I was leaving, that was nice of her.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is a very slow BK, only 2-3 employees operating it. I think one person called in from what one of them said. Long time to order in the morning & they seemed to have a steady business coming through, Chris was very good behind the counter. Got sausage biscuit, was ok, little smaller then normal but tasted good. Caramel frappe was good, smooth coffee taste to it. Only problem I have with BK is they don't sell frappe in small, only in medium or large so I end up throwing half of it away, that's one reason I like getting small frappe from McDonald's, they're only $2 plus I can finish it.

Amazing sushi that is truly crazy! The display of the platters is the fanciest and most exquisite for most sushi resturants! Truly blown away, the sushi chefs are super nice and easy to talk to and they honestly recommend rolls that are good not just because their pricy! 

The eel here on every roll is super tender and the mango sauce is to die for! Dont let the outer appearence fool you the inside is beautiful and even has a mini lift for handicap customers! I wouldnt recommend going anyway else! This place is the bomb.com!

Voted best pizza in south Jersey? Not to be mean but  I demand a recount! Perhaps a hanging chad fouled the vote count or the voter cards were used to make the competitors' pies. Either way, we were not overly impressed..

We ate dinner here a week ago using an Amazon Local deal. Nobody got sick, everyone ate their fill, but with 200 restaurants in Cherry Hill, this place has a long wait in the rotation before we are compelled to try them again. I keep looking up at my rating, Meh actually describes our experience pretty well. 

The photos? They could not capture the saggy booths or the tired decor.

Overall I was disappointed with this sushi restaurant. There are many other great sushi places in Reno. No need to ever come back to this one.

Service was passing. Though, there was a shard of broken glass on my ginger plate.
All of the other sushi places I've been to allowed my 3 year old to eat free if I ordered all you can eat. They said it would cost $18.
The menus were delaminated and clearly need to be replaced. 
Sushi quality was below expectations in Reno and the lemons on my salmon roll were pretty pathetic.

First let me say that the service staff is great! They were really busy when we were there, but we never felt neglected. They make an awesome Margarita. We shared apps instead of ordering meals. The ahi tuna was very good and the deep fried Ruben bites were amazing! They give you plenty of sauces with your apps. The only reason I marked off one star was because they had the outside closed and even though it was a little chilly out, we really wanted to sit outside. The room inside, albeit having a very cool looking ceiling, was bland and box-like. 

I look forward to warmer weather so that I can sit on your patio in the evening.

Carol (owner)is awesome! She's always present and a true "hands on" owner.  Epps is a family run beer distributor and has been for many years. I'm very impressed at how many varieties of craft beer Epps has been carrying. We get our lottery tickets here once a week. A very worthy establishment worthy of your patronage. Years back they moved to a building across the street. It's more spacious with much better parking. They offer some nice gift sets at Christmas time, sodas, and all kinds of delicious snacks. They even offer complimentary fruit for Blue Moon (oranges) and they have fresh limes usually for the Mexican beer like Corona.

Four for four! Great deal. Sydney was a pleasant host/order taker.  The food didn't take long. Enjoyed the meal, the fries were smoking hot. The restaurant has been upgraded since they had a fire, much like other Wendy's .

There was a sign on the soda machine that all soft drinks were flat. The sign said that if you wanted diet coke or sprite you can get it at the counter. I understand that machinery breaks etc. I'm giving the lower review because I felt it was a disservice to not tell customers while ordering that this is the case. Instead you had to get your meal THEN find out and THEN go back to the counter to get a not flat drink.

Stopped by for lunch. Got lucky that got a seat immediately. Its a really tiny place, can accommodate 10 people probably. Good for single or party of two. They have good list of specialty sushi rolls. We were part of two and ordered sunomono, sansom roll ( shrimp , crab) and spicy combo roll (salmon, tuna) . Really fresh fish and the sushi rolls were really good. $36 for 2 entree and 1 appetizer. Its a quick stop , eat and go kinda place. I would like to come back and try few of their other speciality rolls.

I recently ate at Sushi Minato because of all of the amazing reviews it had received on Yelp! I had been to this location a couple of years ago but realized that it must have changed owners because the sushi here is amazing. The proportions are perfect, meaning they DON'T give you a huge ball of rice with a little piece of fish on top. Instead their is a small mound of rice, with amazing fish and flavor combinations on top. I have been raving about this place to anyone who will listen. I cant wait to go back!!

Went in for gel manicure and regular pedicure. I had a Groupon deal - first of all, they said I couldn't avail that without an appointment, which is just rude!
Secondly, there were only 2 women who work here and when we went in with 2 mani pedis and 1 mani, they made it sound like we would get done in no time, but made us wait forever!
One of them was constantly on her phone or going outside repeatedly.
I would give it one more star if at least the quality was good - but the gel mani came off in a week. 
Would NOT recommend.

First thing first, the crew in the morning Is completely different from the team members working in the afternoons. The afternoon crew are rude and unprofessional. They take their time trying to take your order ( this is why the lines are big).  I ONLY come here because they have a Baskin Robbin, but they always Say, " were deep cleaning our Baskin area". Like? I've been told this multiple times. When will it get done? Or you guys don't want to serve us. Mohammed K, snatched my money from my hand. I am so disappointed. Please, don't go here unless you REALY NEED COFFEE.

+ Nice ambiance, friendly staff 

- Food is not that great. 
 1.Plantain Chorizo Soup- color/presentation not appetizing. it had good flavor but the texture of the soup is odd.
2.Gouda Mac & Cheese- it was creamy and cheesy. It was serve hot and fresh but nothing really wow about it.
3. Mortadella Prosciutto Polpette- sauce was good. pasta a little bit overcooked, meatballs were dry. 
4. Pastitio- pasta was overcooked. good flavor on the sauce
5. Fried Baklava Ala Mode- very good, not greasy. Good portion and presentation.

I have been waiting for opening day. Got a reservation for 2 with no problem booked it online. The new renovated space is beautiful the decor and lighting is beautiful the outside patio has also been revamped. Beautiful restaurant and view of the city. Service was great our waiter was pleasant and attentive. We ordered apps and small plates to share. Dias cheese bread and the lamb ribs was my favorite and the flan for dessert melted in your mouth. Gerard Craft restaurants you can't go wrong. I will come back for sure

Two stars because your ice cream was advertised as gelato. Damnit... if I wanted ice cream, I would get ice cream. I don't like being played Fruit Sensations! People like me know the difference. 

Rating it as ice cream, it was ordinary and tasted like something from the grocery store with a bit of freezer burn. 

The only thing that I can really give a thumbs up to is the massive scoop portions. If you choose to come here, just order one scoop...because you'll get like four. I ordered two and it was way too much.

Okay let's start off with the service. There's two guys working at the front. I did not get their names but it was a Hispanic and White male. They did not smile or say hi or whatsoever. They were so rude and unprofessional. They even charge me extra for two piece of chicken when all I order was one and a soup. When they fixed the order they were not happy and also did not apologize. This was the worst customer service ever. And also the place is also outdated and very humid. The tables seem like they been wiped with a dirt rag because there's brown swirls when it dried.

After Sushi King closed down and Sushi Hama was sold and become mediocre, it was not easy to see who would emerge as the top dog in sushi restaurants. A lot of people I used to see frequent the above places started going to Sushi Garden- they are fine but are basically the McDonald's of sushi (priced fine and convenient locations).

Sushi Ten has begun to stand out. The sushi is great, but I must say service will be hit or miss. Grab a seat and hope for the best-at the very least your meal will taste fantastic.

Friendly staff, but this particular location always seems to be dirty. I rarely come to this one, because it isn't the easiest access/parking even though it is closest to my home.  No drive thru and it's a very small store, so you'd think they could swipe a broom through it before it gets to the level of filth.  The case where the pastry/cake pops are kept has been dirty and crummy, as well.  I posted a pic of how well they keep their outside.  It takes all of ten minutes to pick it up, c'mon guys, have some pride in your workplace.

Fast, smart, reasonable, and down to earth. Perfect.

I first took my car for service because of the good reviews and they're literally two blocks from me. They made the repair fast and reasonable and explained what they did. I needed a new transmission, so they referred me to a great shop for that. I've been back to Sooter's several times since. 

The other day, I asked if they could fix my brakes before I had to go up to Phoenix. They checked my brakes to make sure they were safe -- free! -- then scheduled me to come back to fix the problem at a later date. They will prioritize appointments based on the urgency of the situation.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Barista taking my order decided to dissect my coffee verbally and  drag out the ordering process. I've ordered the same coffee forever. It's not that complicated. It was as if she needed to prove she knew something about coffee in general, for no good reason, confuse me about my own order, and hold up the line in the process. Now I have a headache on top of needing coffee! Also, after all of that knowledge she attempted to drop (Yep! You guessed it!!) she fixed my coffee wrong!  I'm hoping to not need coffee in this area ever again. If so, I'll keep driving to the next Starbucks.

I usually get hot dogs, but today, they had new carne Asada nachos!  Super stoked!  

Nico's supreme nachos are way better!  These actually almost sucked.  I could have gone to a little league game and had the same nachos.

Cheap corn chips.
Cheap canned jalapeños.
Poor presentation.
Crappy canned nacho cheese.
Gristle based meat...nicos has you beat by a mile.  That's sad.

Totally disappointed but I gave 2 stars because my wife's hot dog was decent.

Guero...don't get us excited for nachos supreme and deliver us nachos disgusting.

Best non dairy ice cream I ever had, they also have regular ice cream. It's really hard to find non dairy options that actually taste, look, and smell good as well. I am a regular here for the coconut flavored sorbet, its creamy and you won't feel like your missing out on some good creamy whole milk ice-cream. Which is hard to duplicate in the non dairy section, for some reason it's always an epic fail. No photos because I'm not interested in my phone when I'm really enjoying something amazing. Plus I don't want to share my drippings with my phone .

if I could give this location 0 Stars I would. This location has the worst customer service skills,  and the worst sense of urgency in the Drive-Thru. I ordered a lemon pound cake slice and the lady just sat in the drive-thru window talking and running her mouth for 4 minutes. She never took my payment and it was ridiculous the time I sat at the window waiting on a slice of Pound Cake. I'm not waiting on a mixed coffee or prepared drink I'm waiting on a slice of Pound Cake! This location has the worst service compared to all of the Starbucks chains that I have ever been to. They need to just cut it and start with a whole new crew.

Okay so first off, fuck this McDonald's and it's incredibly lazy morning staff. They've made us so close to being late because they don't want to actually do our jobs, it pisses me off. Every time we'd order doughnut sticks, we would have to come INSIDE to get our food when we did drive through because they took so long to actually give us our food that we were going to be late to work. That's happened to us 3 times. Everyone who works at 6am is a lazy asshole teenager that doesn't care about anyone else's jobs. Smh. Hire people who actually give a shit
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Made reservations and mentioned my GF has gluten allergies. We showed up and was immediately greeted by a gentleman who immediately welcomed us and made note they were aware of gluten allergy. Hostess too us upstairs where our waitress immediately noted she knew about the gluten allergy. Over several years together and many restaurants dined in and I had never experienced such a well planned staff. The house is very clean and great feel. Overall we had a great meal and would return especially since they get the whole gluten allergy issue. Very impressed!!!

This place is awesome. We should have come here for dinner + drinks, but made the mistake of coming after dinner and being a bit full. 

We were lucky enough to find seats at the bar, the place was packed so there was going to be a long wait. We had a few spicy margaritas which are actually pretty hot. That was a nice change. The people watching was top notch, and the scene is young professionals which was great.

After more margaritas we ordered the Baja and Pork Belly Taco. Both were great.

Great spot, worth checking out if you can get a seat!

Decor is nice and all but the food is not that great. I'm not a sushi person so we only ordered their entries. 

I had the pineapple shrimp fried rice and my boyfriend had the steak and scallop hibachi. My fried rice was not delectable at all. The only saving factor were the pineapples, otherwise I couldn't eat the rice by itself. The scallops from the hibachi had a strong after-taste and were not savory. The steak was dry, despite the hibachi sauce and the fact he asked for medium rare. 

I'll stick to Ahi Sushi from now on.

I may be influenced by the long drought in decent restaurants in the area, but it's good to see this place come to town. The food is consistent and good,the service is fast and friendly. Prices maybe a touch high, but I've thought that about Mexican restaurants since Taco Bell tacos went up from a quarter. If you're familiar with El Adobe in Reno, I believe some of the same people are involved here, and some of the dishes are  familiar. That's a good thing-- I like El Adobe, and this is 10 miles closer to home.

This staple of main street has lost it's mojo.  When you walk in, the smell of old grease is overwhelming.  I've been walking past and can smell it outside.  I'm talking heavy in the air greeeeez from the hibachi.  

Last time I was there, the anglo/AA waitstaff was busy yacking it up and seemed to have forgotten I was there waiting for my food.  In an empty, smelly restaurant, they could at least remember to take out their earphones.

They used to have a green river roll, which was excellent.  They changed the name for some reason.

I love the convenience of the drive thru but this location can never get it together even after new management. Their chocolate frosted never have much frosting on them compared to the other locations. This is why I got the frosted vs. plain. I wanted frosting. 
The employees here also seem to not give much thought to common sense when they throw frosted donuts into a paper bag, frosting side down leaving the consumer now with a mess of a bag, donut and even less frosted donut. 
Can I recommend a chocolate frosted paper bag on the menu?  Maybe then I'll get frosting?

Didn't get plates. Slow service but it's understandable since it was packed for Valentine's Day but still, we waited for about an hour or more for our food. Our waitress was a little rude and had a bit of an attitude problem but again, it was a busy night. Still not an excuse to not smile and treat your customers with respect. Didn't ask if we wanted an appetizer with our all you can eat meal or for refills. Small tables. The sushi wasn't bad nor great but the whole experience was a little off because of the service we received.

Yes, they have a huge variety of tamales.  Alton Brown loves them (not a good endorsement IMO).  Their salsas are delicious.  The fillings are creative, fresh and well prepared.

But, for God's sake, they don't use lard in their masa.  I mean, really?  First, it makes them so light and airy when you whip it into the masa, since it melts out while the tamales steam.  It's not a fat-bomb either, since the bulk of the fat winds up in the steaming water, not the masa.

Their masa is too dense and pasty for my tastes.  Maybe that's just me.

Went here with a bunch of friends and it was pretty late on a saturday.  Nice looking place and the place is clean.  The customer service is good as well.  I ordered the sashimi platter for $22. I was expecting to get some great variety of fresh fish, but only white tuna, tuna, salmon, and tilapia. I was not very impressed by all the decor and i think it took awhile for them to do because most of my fish became warm and not pleasant to eat.  My friends got a few kitchen items and 4 rolls.  Most of us later that night got upset stomachs.  We will not be back!

So goooood...just moved to the area and saw their restaurant on Route 70...and I'm happy to have stopped to see their menu and take out options. Portions are large and filling, and everything was well seasoned. I got the chicken sandwich and it was top notch, just like the Mac and cheese (which is more than enough for even 3 people). And I'll definitely order the potato skins again because the bacon, melty cheese and everything else hit the spot. Last, it's nice to support a local business that also sources their ingredients from nearby protein and produce vendors!

I think this place has gone way downhill over the years. I found the menu limited and uninspiring. Limited choices on the kids' menu as well. Half of our party of 6 found floaters in our water glasses. 3 of us had potato soup which came out lukewarm and not the texture we remembered. Almost like lumpy mashed potatoes. Our service was excellent but the food was just so-so or less.  They need to spend some money on a major overhaul. I think the only thing keeping this place alive is its proximity to the movie theater.

It was really disappointing. My Mexican husband thought it was terrible. I had the fish tacos and enjoyed their version. My daughter had the tamales which were heavy on the masa and light on the meat. My husband ordered chicken flautas and said the salsa was obviously put on hot because it made them soggy and wilted the lettuce. He said the oil in the fryer needed to be changed as well. I found the salsa refreshing even though it was mild by anyone's standards. The chips were light and crispy. Service was very good. We were pretty sure what we had gotten ourselves into when the menu had no lengua which is a favorite of my mine and my daughter.
