Not bad of a place but the service could be stepped up.  We had beers that were on tap and we had to ask our bartender for another round.  Some younger guys showed up and kind of took over the patio space by moving there chairs in the walkway, if I was a manager I would have asked them to make room for people to walk by.  We finished our beers once they took out the cell phones and decided to do some online tinder dating and make comments about the women on the site. I'd come back to watch a game but other than that I'd rather go some place smaller and more locals.

Was looking very forward to eating here.  I have been here several times for drinks but never for dinner.  The atmosphere and service is excellent however the food was not as amazing as I was expecting it to be.  It wasn't bad however not worth the prices they were charging.  We ordered everything from appetizers to desert and the appetizers and drinks were the best part of the meal.  The main courses were decent but two of the four dishes we had did not tast fresh at all and the lobster was very fishy tasting.  Deserts tasted like they were frozen and just thawed out.  I will not be returning here to eat.

Big fan of the vibe in this bar. It's a favorite among my boyfriend's group of friends- they like to get "the special" ($4 for a Coors Banquet and a shot of corn whiskey) whenever one of their friends returns from deployment. (Nothing says thank you for your service like a crappy drink special). The drink menu is definitely hipster and a bit too extra for my taste. I prefer simpler drinks and the go-to at Tough Luck usually has 6 ingredients, 3 of which I don't know. I drink the "Bee's Knees" each time we go, it's a gin cocktail with honey and lemon.

Small place. They have indoor and outdoor seating, but outside seating isn't in good shape. They take cash and card. I went for lunch and had the sampler appetizer (green chili, red chili and Indian taco, all on fry bread). The bread itself was delicious! I wish I had purchased the dessert sampler because I know that fry bread with sweet tooong s would have been delicious! The cinnamon tea is delicious too! The chili was okay. It Needed to be seasoned more in my opinion. It's right across from the mission and right outside the restaurant are little shops and a restroom. Good for tourists

We have been scouring around for a good japanese buffet in the area and has been disheartened.  We happened to have just stopped by Winco and saw the sign.  My husband and I ventured in and was so happy with the place that we highly recommend the place and this has become our go to place whenever we have a craving for sushi.  We love the appetizers, rave about the sushi and happy to end our meal with the homemade ice cream.  I also love the karoeke music.  We will highly recommend both location.  Service is great and food is delicious!

Let's just say, the canned beer was good. Can't go wrong with canned beer, right? As far as the food goes, it could have been loads better. We've come here more than a few times and the service, cleanliness and food just keeps getting worse.

This time, we ordered a campechana. No flavor. We also ordered the shrimp pozole. No flavor. The oysters were far from fresh and the side of al pastor tacos tasted like boiled meat tossed in sauce too late for it to hold on to any flavor. We might be too demanding but this is definitely not what good, authentic Mexican food should taste like. Needless to say, that was our last visit.

There were pros and cons with the visit to zinc cafe but overall,it was pretty good..

pros..the atmosphere was really nice and staff where friendly..i had a delicious French onion soup and my gf had the ahi tuna. Both where yummy. My gf had the seared scallops which where cooked perfect.. the spinach dip was pretty good, just needed a little more salt.

Cons..i ordered the bacon cheeseburger medium rare and it was super well done and they forgot the bacon..the  mushroom risotto that came with the scallops had great flavor but the risotto was way too mushy..

Overall, I would give this place another try and maybe more starts next time

During COVID, they've been slammed. Weekends are crazy. Phone line is constantly busy or they put me on hold for indefinite time, they have no phone queue, parking lot is completely full, and the online checkin has gone unanswered. I simply need to pickup medicine, but I had to spend about 30 mins calling from the parking lot before getting in contact with someone. 

The service I have received, once answered, is good, but wait times are crazy. 

I recommend arriving first thing in the morning on weekdays for routine things, which are still slammed but not as badly as weekends.

I have recently relocated to the Boise area and finding a new hair stylist can be scary, but the second I went to Native Salon and worked with Maleah on my hair, I knew I had found a great stylist in a cute space. Maleah is very professional, personable, and does a great job listening to what I am looking for to meet my hair goals. The salon is clean and has a beautiful wood wall that is great for selfies after getting your new hairdo. I would suggest Maleah and Native Salon to any person looking for a great hair experience.

I went here for the first time today to get a bad haircut fixed and Kara was fantastic. She was knowledgeable, listened, but also talked through ideas she had as a pro that I wouldn't know about. Super helpful. She did a great job and I left with the cut I wanted the first time around at another salon (who butchered the cut). I have been hoping to find a stylist I really like and have been striking out for years, but I will definitely go back to see Kara. The atmosphere was really nice and everyone was friendly there, too.

A pretty average sushi place with The name that I find to be kind of a turn off. I was expecting to have more than a "sushi meal" experience but that's what I got... very little originality and what I found to be very average quality.

The staff seemed to be pretty pleasant, perhaps above average, so a pretty good thing. I just can't find anything to rave about with this place. Perhaps it was that my expectations were high that it would be kind of fancy or something but again I wasn't impressed. But I will say is that there was nothing bad about it...just very average.

My partner went into this DD and was looking for certain donuts. As she asked the guy at the counter for the certain type of donuts, she spotted them. The guy quickly said "nope we're out". She said oh ok and pointed to them as he quickly again said "nope we're out." She left feeling very much like she was just refused service. We never play the "gay card" but in this instance I strongly believe she was refused service because of her appearance and her gender identity. This is so disturbing. We will never go back as we would rather spend our money where equality for all exists.

We brought the kids here after bowling last night and this little ice cream parlor was bustling.  The kids had Lucky Charms and Cotton Candy in waffle cones and I shared the brownie sundae (vanilla ice cream) with my other kid.  

Everything was great--rich, delicious, creamy goodness.  My husband said that Hagen Das is real ice cream--Creole Creamery makes Hagen Das taste like the grocery store commodity brand for 99 cents.

A great selection of traditional flavors and then some for unique palettes as well.  All goodness.

Got take out. Was able to order online which was great. I got spaghetti with meatballs minus the meat and green calzone minus the cheese. The service was excellent. My food was prepared correctly even with my special requests and it was very good. My husband got two personal pizzas to try out different crust. He liked the NY style but did not like the thin crust. He said it was a little burnt, that's why I took off one star. We will definitely go there again and explore the menu further, they have lots of options. It is definitely worth a second visit!

The JW is such a nice hotel. From the parking garage to the lobbies, every inch is really clean, sophisticated, and welcoming. It's perfectly located by Lucas oil for football and victory field for baseball among other event facilities. 

The JW is also a great venue for events as I've attended a couple work events here as well. 

Service is great! There is a Fedex shop for your mailing needs and a Starbucks on the 2nd floor. On the first floor they have a very nice sports bar called high velocity where you can enjoy watching a sport on their multiple TVs or drink/snack before an event. This hotel really caters to all guests.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Came for (free) money in motion exhibit- it's this small area with lots of informational tidbits plus games (some are meant for kids, others for those with some background in economics or who just read everything super thoroughly!) exhibit talks about the Fed's structure, history of economics in this country, basic economic principles, and how cash is printed. No photography and you'd have to go through security. There's a machine to get a new 2016 Georgia state quarter. They even give you a bag of shredded money!

An Indianapolis-local answer to the Starbucks sort of coffee shop. Very clean, with an upscale design (again similar in feel to a Starbucks or Argo Tea). They make a very good, strong cup of coffee! In addition to standard milks, they also offer soy and coconut milk for lattes. 

I visited this location for a work meeting and it is convenient - off the busy street, with parking lot parking (which can be a rare gift in certain spots in the area). Seems to be a popular place for others to study or meet up... it was busy, but in a good way.

Came here with some friends for dinner. Service was excellent. The sushi was good but not great. We shared the following rolls: Lava, Fishtown, Sprunchy and Hikari. With the exception of the Lava roll, it was honestly difficult to tell the other rolls apart because the flavors in each of the speciality rolls were so similar (avocado, tempura flakes, eel sauce or spicy mayo). I also ordered yellowtail nigiri and a spicy scallop roll. Both were just meh. My friends were not blown away either. Maybe we came on an off night?

Ever since Yogorino closed in Philly this place has been my go to spot! They bought the recipe from Yogorino but, in my opinion, it doesn't tastes exactly the same. Igloo's version is still really good and it beats driving all the way to Paoli. I also really like the Greek yogurt froyo here despite the powdery aftertaste. Customer service is always great. There are plenty of chairs and tables outside the store and they play movies right outside in the summertime. Great place to walk to and have a chill night if you live in the area. And they open late!

I had a really nice anniversary dinner here a few days ago. It's BYOB. Service was excellent and the food was very good. The roasted beets and mussels were AMAZING. The grilled octopus was good but I definitely had better. My husband enjoyed his squid ink spaghetti. I had the crispy gnocchi but was a bit disappointed. The gnocchi was dense and oily and everything in the dish was very heavy (pancetta, butter, goat cheese) so it wasn't the best way to end the meal since I didn't have room for dessert after this. I would definitely still go back to try the other items on the menu.

My husband took me here for my birthday a few months ago. While it was a great dining experience (service, ambience, food quality) I think this place is more of a one and done place for me. Let me explain why. I really loved the nigiri and sashimi courses but some of the other courses were not that great (especially the very first course with the four small dishes were just meh). For the price they're charging, I'd expect everything to be amazing. Additionally, my husband was still hungry after our dinner here so we headed to a cafe afterwards and he ordered and finished an entire entree as a second dinner.

Glad to see Redner's open in Audubon!  Nice prices on most items.  This store is a different take on thier other warehouse style stores. Nice fresh food offerings, tons of ice cream choices and the meats are really nicely done.  Red meat is actually red as opposed to giants not so red meats.  I love addition of a gas station as well!!!!

Beer and wine selection is limited.  Beer section is great if you at a Coors light Budweiser beer type.  Wine selection seems decent as well.

Welcome to the neighborhood!!!

I live right down the road from this place but for some reason I never checked it out until now. 
I walked my dog over since it's dog friendly! (You can get the most adorable little cone with a small scoop of vanilla and a dog bone on top... it disappeared before I was able to take a picture)
The girls working were super friendly, so don't believe the reviews that say the service is bad. 
The ice cream is your typical foothills creamery stuff you grew up with. Granted prices have increased greatly from your childhood. It's not exactly cheap but it's a fun special treat. 
I would definitely return here.

With the recent change of the menu I am very disappointed. Previously they had the sort of menu and food where no matter what you ordered you couldn't really go wrong. 
Now they have changed their menu from classic pub fare to a fancier gastropub type deal. They used to offer a good steak sandwich special. Well the special remains but the quality of the food has gone down. There was a half hour discrepancy between some of our party members meals coming out. 
Considering how good their food used to be and how often we frequented Overtime as a group. It's really disappointing to say we likely won't be back.

Have been going here forever! Really good wonton soup ,make sure you get a long doughnut to dip ! Crispy house chow main is an all time favourite here . Black bean beef chow fun also a fav ! The ginger beef is pretty good if you eat it hot and fresh and has thin slices of real ginger ! Chinese chicken wings my mothers favourite are flavourful hot and crispy ! The curry chicken is also very tasty . The prices are great portions are large and food starts coming out as so as you've ordered it ! Have fun trying to chooses from their big menu lol

A much more pleasing exterior than the former building, and also kept much cleaner from what I can see. The updated drive thru is easy to maneuver and traffic continues to flow with the double drive thru windows. Most of the staff are nice enough, but Christinia could not have been any more bothered by me using a coupon in the drive thru. It truly seemed as though I ruined her entire existence by telling her that I had a coupon. She actually even rolled her eyes. If you're going to work the window, then at least have the personality to do so, otherwise stick to working behind the scenes.

I don't care for Planet fitness because each one that I've gone to offered a basic workout experience. While this one offers massage beds, it doesn't make up for the lackluster experience. First, the equipment isn't clean. Things are usually left in holders and it has a dirty look. They need to keep them wiped down. Second, on peak times it is a wait to utilize equipment. Third, the bathrooms don't seem clean. Fourth, the workers are not friendly. That's the one thing I appreciate about the Kroc Center---workers are always helpful and friendly. Yes, it may be affordable but it's overrated and I'm glad I only go if a friend ask me.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I ordered delivery from this place the other weekend after craving sushi all day but being too lazy to leave my house to get some. The reviews looked good so I gave them a shot and I'm so glad I did. Their specials rolls were amazing and the fish tasted so fresh. Delivery was also very quick which surprised me. I feel like I would've waited longer if I had gone in and dined in. My only complaint was about the delivery boy. He was a little rude and seemed to hate that he had to delivery my food. I read online that it's byob so I definitely want to dine in next time.

I've been getting my hair cut here for two years and I love it! Switch from my old place due to wait times and staff. I tried VN hair salon by recommendation by my boyfriend (who also gets his haircut here) and I don't regret it. She listens to what you want and takes her time. Still, I like to call ahead and either make an appt or see if she's busy. She's very honest and will tell you when to swing by and not just tell you to come to get your business. Very friendly and is family managed. 

The place is small but clean and looks nice. No complaints as of yet. Definitely recommendation to try it out if you're looking for a new hair stylist!

Came through drive through...
Repeated my order 3 times. 
They did not have the sweet black pepper bacon sandwich so we had to make a quick decision. The bacon croissant was fine. 
Ordered 2 large coffees, both with xxtra cream. Instead got one black with no sugar. Also ordered a maple bar, not only was it just thrown in a bag frosting side down but it was hard. I will go out of my way to visit other donut shops here...you guys aren't selling gourmet one of a kind shit here, hell its barely edible and I can make YOUR coffee at my house..NEVER AGAIN WILL I COME HERE!

While they specialize in standard Chinese-American food, I appreciate that many of their dishes (e.g., Hunan beef, kung pao chicken) are loaded with fresh, crispy veggies and not deep fried. I really like that the flavors on these dishes are a bit spicer and less sweet compared to many other similar places. The combination plates are awesome and come with the main dish, white or fried rice, an egg roll, a crab Rangoon, and soup (egg drop or hot and sour). If you are being lazy and live in CWE, this place gives you enough food for at least 2 meals for $5-$8.

Saw a Burger King and craved. Burger and fries.  I went on a Friday at 3pm.  I went hoping to eat inside. Sadly the lobby was closed. The drive thru was open.  Pleasant voice  with order taking. I requested salt.  Sadly it was not in the big. I did not like my jr. Cheese with bacon and light Mayo and no lettuce.  My order was all wrong. 
The burger was dry. I had 1/4 a slice bacon. The bacon was extremely salty, no bacon taste. The burger had so much Mayo, when I asked for light Mayo. The tomato on the burger did not taste right.

Arrived and had to wait about 25 minutes which was dine. Had eel roll for appetizer, could of used a little more eel but it was good. Ordered Monday special filet mignon and chicken teriyaki.  The problem I have with most these style restaurants is the limited menu items. Filet was ordered medium, was more medium well. Pretty standard teriyaki sauce. Vegetables and fried rice were part the course.  Nothing unique for the style restaurant. 
     Good for kids because of the knife/cooking show that comes with. Onion volcano. Throwing shrimp.

Really enjoyed the environment and ambiance here - a great place to meet with friends in a comfortable environment with great food! 
Walking distance from where we were staying (The Matrix) and will definitely recommend to others as the good was great! Service was good, food came out quickly, and we didn't have to wait! 
Only suggestion would be to firm up the sushi menu and perhaps create a separate sushi menu with a few more options that is easy to read. Had a green dragon roll and it was delicious!!! We will return!!!

After hearing about this place, we finally decided to give it a try. We love sushi especially omakase! However.. my fiancé and I was disappointed after leaving here.

We made reservations at 6:30pm but got there at 6pm. We were the first ones there and was able to get seated right away which was great.. and basically had the whole restaurant to ourselves for an hour before more customers came. That's strange..

The fish was okay. There were couple of fish we never tried before. Most of the fish was torched.. guess it was worth the experience but not really worth the money and time.

The bistro is set up in the middle of the mall, literally. With a rectangular bar enclosing the kitchen and tables on either side of the bar. It is always busy and during peak times like the weekend there can be a long wait.

I've been to the bistro a few times already and have always had a good meal with great service. They have very reasonable lunch specials. I got the Caesar salad and personal pizza for $12. 

They are notorious for their huge loaded baked potatoes. When in Cherry Hill this is where I eat.

Ordered take out with my girlfriends family last night. They hung up on us on the first call. Seems to be a theme of their photos having poor connection because it happened to me before. They don't have the nicest employees answering their phones to say the least.

Never the less, we ordered about $65 worth of food. Cheesesteaks and cheese fries were on point as usual. 

The two salads were 4/10. No salad dressing was provided. But, like I say you don't go to saladworks and order a pizza.

Delivery was prompt. Great spot to get cheesesteaks and fries from.

Been to corner bistro a couple of times, in the beginning it was a nice place with good food, but their menu is not that diverse and it doesn't change that often either so we began to branch out. Came back here last week in hopes that it had changed, but was severely disappointed in their entree dishes. It's just a lot of meat and one vegetarian option which is pasta. For a restaurant that claims to be this diverse, I wanted more than just steak and potatoes, or steak frites. I doubt I'll head here again this season.

My PM on the project absolutely loves Eclipse. It's his favorite spot to have a good dinner, and it is warranted. The food is good (love the mushroom and chorizo tart). The only thing is the menu does not change that much and they do not have good vegetarian options. They have the goat cheese gnocchi but that's been on the menu for the past couple of months and as a person who doesn't eat red meat or want a whole chicken, I'm left with very few choices on what to eat. But the smores bread pudding is fantastic, and so I usually stock up on the apps and dessert.

Dr. Wood was nothing but fantastic in helping us when our dog was diagnosed with cancer. I can't say enough good things. 


Now for the one star. A couple of weeks ago we had to put our dog to sleep. In the final moments of saying our goodbyes -sobbing and all- a front desk worker came in to get a final payment and made us pick out final arrangements. This could have been handled so differently and I wish it would have been. So through sobs, I had to make final decisions and a credit card payment while trying to say goodbye to my dog. You should be ashamed you have people like this working for you.

Love, love this restaurant! It's the closest I can get to mom's home cooking, and not too far from home. They have a variety of things to eat, some more Americanized things like nachos, and quite a few authentic dishes likes tacos tripetas. Definitely a good find in Indy!

The only thing I can critique is the service. Really friendly people, but not super attentive. I had to wait forever for some water, to get more chips we had to go to the counter, and our tacos were kinda grouped randomly instead of by person's order. 

Overall pretty legit place. That's something come from a Mexican

I am only here for night but my experience has been positive. The front desk customer service was fast and friendly. Reading reviews of the concierge lounge I didn't expect much but I was pleasantly surprised. The attendant went above and beyond to make my short time there enjoyable. They served pulled pork sliders, a variety of cheeses, crackers, fruit and vegetables. Of course the had the free pour honor bar. The rooms are average size, they meet Marriott standards. I didn't go to the restaurant or venture around the property.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The worst service and the worst food. Had to go to the bar to order drinks because no one greeted us for 15 minutes. TGIF gives a bad name to restaurants in Opry Mills mall. Not one piece of silverware delivered to the table 30 minutes after we got our food. We finished our food and didn't see our server for 20 minutes after we finished our food. Then instead of him being apologetic, he was rude and said he was too busy to worry about our table. Do not waste your money here. Not one manager came to see if we were ok. At least I have enough class to not mention our servers name.

We live near this place and order from them often! Their meatball deep dish pizza is delicious and our "go to." Their other pizzas are good too, and I'm a fan of their award winning strawberry walnut salad. We've eaten at the restaurant a couple times, but mostly just order to go - as other reviewers have said, it seems to be outdated in terms of paint and decor but it never bothered us. It's not JUST like Chicago Pizza but pretty close considering location. Not really anywhere else like it in this area so can't complain.

I patronage this restaurant for three years along with bringing more black customers to this establishment, tonight we was told to get up from our table so the owner put her hands in a upwards motions so we can leave in order to seat more customers. Granted it's busy however we're being rushed!!? We paid our billed prior to her rushing us to leave. I never thought to be rushed out of my conversation and to leave this establishment after I paid for my average meal. Never again will I or any of my friends co-workers will EAT HERE AGAIN!!!

I've been to Ian's twice. In May 2016, just before a road trip we had to change our tires and pretty much every tire store in the Santa Barbara area did not have our tires. Not only did Ian's have our tires in stock, they helped to get them installed quickly at the last minute. The service was excellent. Recently I went back for an oil change and free tire rotation; I called the day of, and they were able to get me in that morning. There's a coffee shop, Java Station, several blocks away where you can wait if you want some coffee. Otherwise, Ian's has wifi and there's also some nearby stores as well. Definitely recommend.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
The ambience seemed too simple, too plain as we walked into the restaurant, which is why I was a little reluctant to try sushi here. I gave in and ordered a portion each of Bansai and the Oishi special, both from their specialty menu. The specialty rolls were amazing but two portions are probably a bit too much for one person. 

My colleague ordered some red curry. I consider this a safe dish at an asian restaurant, but this was a big disappointment. Loaded with coconut milk, more than the usual, the entree was too bland, devoid of any flavor. This took away some of the sheen from my sushi experience.

First I was very skeptical about coming here, because the prices were extremely cheap. I've had bad experiences with eating cheap sushi; A few times I ended up getting sick because the fish wasn't fresh. But this place is pretty legit for the price you pay. Because it was so cheap, my husband and I ended up going a little crazy and ordered a whole bunch of rolls. Needless to say, they hit the spot and we will definitely be back for more! Definitely not a fancy type of sushi place, if you are into those sort of stuff. But it's cheap and the quality isn't so bad!

So for the first time ordering our Thanksgiving dinner this was a flop!!! Thanks Giant 

I called the 1-800 number as directed on the flyer, spoke to a human being and placed my order. Received the confirmation email with all the correct details. 
I arrived at the store for my scheduled pick up & not only did they not have my order they also had no knowledge of my order. WTH?????

A extremely nice employee took the time to put an order together for me.. mind you I ordered ham... No hams  were to be found....
Lesson learned NEVER COUNT ON ST. DAVIDS GIANT FOR SPECIAL OCCASIONS

Crust is great. Pepperoni and cheese breadsticks are awesome. *Garlic knots... Brozzinnis are the best go there for them, if ita your 1st time they will give you free.* they have great soda, not sure why it taste better than most but it is. I do NOT like their ricotta cheese! Its water and gross, it separates and I've never had any that has separated on me before on pizza. I also do not prefer their pizza sauce. I prefer a sweeter tomato sauce. Theirs taste bland more like a watered down tomato paste. 

I'd go any day for pepperoni and cheese breadsticks and nacho cheese dip with a soda!

This is our first trip to NOLA, and I was looking forward to staying at this hotel. I was rather disappointed when we got to our room. I read reviews before booking and expected a true 4-star hotel. When we got in our room, it smelled dirty. The room was filthy and clearly not properly cleaned before we checked in. There was hair on the shower floor and on the shower wall. The towels were not fresh and had hair ( long blonde hair) on them. There was tissue under one night stand, the floor wasn't vacuumed, and there was a contact lens holder on the floor. Also, my niece killed a bug in the bathroom.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Terrible location. Every time I give them another try I regret it. This morning I went for a breakfast sandwich and an iced coffee. I got to the drive thru window and was giving the wrong order. I was pretty shocked considering I was literally the only customer there until I started driving to the pick up window another car pulled behind me. How the heck do you mess up one order? Anyways coffee is always watery-doesn't taste much like anything and my sandwich (that I almost didn't get becuSe the employee charged me only for the coffee at first) is Luke warm.

Thieves in disguise, that would be my description of this inhumane place
After waiting for an hour to be seen (no other patients, only us in the vet) a vet comes in to do an exam (I only asked for a re bandage of my let's wound, she did not need any exam nor did I ask for it
They wanted to charge almost $400 to do a re bandaging. (That service usually ranges from $35-$65)
I declined. They still charged $85 for an exam that I never requested
My feel is that these people are anxious for money and somewhat desperate, stay away from them, they will rip you off!
They had no sensitivity towards my dog's condition

Believe it or not  this was the first time I had a Dunkin Donut.
I have heard so much over the years, maybe my expectations were a bit high.
I enjoyed the Donuts, but there was no wow factor.
I ordered three, chocolate old fashioned, old fashioned, and maple bar.
The old fashioned were not shaped like regular old fashioned , and really had no taste.
The maple bar was the best with a generous amount of maple, and the bar was light and fluffy.
I am not much of a donut eater, so I do not anticipate coming back.

Peets coffee is located inside of Raleys. There coffee is not bad, but not great. You get the feeling they are on a quota and how fast can you crank it out.
The art of coffee brewing and pulling shots is lost here, because all it is is pushing buttons. 
The gals behind the counter were more concerned what they were going to do with there boyfriends than serving the customers.
There is a small seating area,coffee bar where you can pull up a stool and enjoy your coffee.
Peets also serves croissants,donuts and danishes.
Unless i needing coffee bad, i probably will avoid this place

I have not had pizza for about 2 1/2 months to make the doctor god's happy, so when my blood work came back excellent, I high tailed it to get some pizza.
That is where the good part ends. I entered the restaurant and literally waited for ten minutes
Until someone came to help. I was one of two people in the restaurant.
I bought the lunch buffet which said it starts at 11am, at 11:15 there still was no pizza out.
Finally they brought out a pepperoni pizza.
That was the extent of the buffet, a pepperoni pizza.
The pizza was so-so, nothing to write home about.
I would not go out of my way to try this place out.

This is a full-sized Starbucks, not a cart or hut. I love this location! The employees are all super friendly and have been from the get-go. The various batistas quickly learned my order and always make me feel welcome. They have typical Starbucks fare...cups, mugs, snacks. And a pretty good selection of breakfast and lunch foods. When new drinks come out, they are quick to offer samples. There's lots of coffee competition on this block, but if you're a diehard Starbuckser on Poydras...your coffee dreams have finally come true!

We walked over to this cafe from the Le Pavillion Hotel on a Tuesday morning. The place was almost empty which scared us a bit, but fear was unwarranted. Service was prompt and friendly. Our breakfast was delicious, but I have to mention the biscuits and gravy. The gravy was out of this world!!!! What a fantastic cheat meal! We asked how it was made and apparently they use andouille sausage in it. I couldn't stop eating it. The rest of our breakfast was good, too, but the gravy just rocked my world. After breakfast, we took a stroll through nearby Lafayette Park. Nice morning!

Left my dog with them to receive treatment.  My experience was horrible.  Not truthful, high priced, and to top off a 1000.00 bill they lost the dogs ashes.  I got them a few days later but totally unacceptable.  After a meeting with the owner he took ownership of the mistake but no ownership for the lack of treatment given to my dog.  He offered a 75.00 refund on the 1000.00 bill but this was just lip service.  The 75.00 never has shown up. The front office of younger adults was playing grab butt and unprofessional.  Save yourself the money and grief.  I won't be back.

Excellent place. They really paid attention to the detail and decor of the place which is cool. Barbers dressed up all sharp looking too.

I was very happy they accept reservations (and online too!) - generally if I have to get a haircut I'm trying to squeeze it in on a lunch break or something so having a finite time slot is important.

The haircut I got was great, I have been a habitual hat-wearer so I don't know how to do anything with my hair. Got some advice in that regard too which was helpful. I'd go back and probably try the whole haircut shave experience just to see how it goes.

Busy Sunday morning but the lines were moving smoothly, however a patron decided that my breakfast sounded better than there's.  My son had to use the restroom so I stepped away for a minute and after waiting a bit we discovered that it was missing from the counter.  The staff was so apologetic even though I knew it was not their fault.  They offered my son a free donut & drink!  They even comped my breakfast!!  This definitely wasn't expected but very much appreciated!!!  Kudos to the staff! My food was yummy too!

Since I've been coming here in November 2016 Black Membership the staff has changed noticeably (in a good way) 9 out of 10 times they great you and/or acknowledge you leaving. I seem them taking shifts to clean, check on their clients, and generally show interest. As far as I seen there has been one machine needing maintenance and was fixed within the week of it breaking. The members here are courteous  and mostly keep to their workouts. Overall I've grown fond of this place and find myself enjoying going to this gym to workout. Thanks PF team!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
For starters... made a reservation online. Called ahead of arrival to confirm. Arrived and they weren't aware of the reservation. Party of 13!  
Not off to a good start to say the least. Order drinks first, server got them mixed up (sodas). Ordered food, and let's just say it was a struggle. Many orders came incomplete, mixed up or not at all!  
Let's talk karaoke... dated songs that many lyrics didn't match. Oh, and the machine crashed twice. No Bueno!!!  

And it was HOT in the room

If there was any saving grace... The food was tasty tho!

So sick of listening to Tucson yelp reviews. This place is not 4-5 stars. Ordered takeout. Lousy at best. Salty, over fried "chicken piccata" with super salty capers. 25$ total as well. We went to vivace for to go recently and if I had a picture of the two plates lined up everyone would pick vivace over this sewage dump of a restaurant. In fact the food is almost inedible due to the saltiness. The only reason we ordered here was listening to yelp reviews. Obviously those who wrote the other reviews for dolce vita are staff, friends who were probably paid, bots, and outright liars. This place is garbage. Don't go here

I had pretty much given up on finding good Chinese food when I decided to pop into this little hidden location.  Love the fried rice--especially pork. They prepare it right when you order and it is hot, well-seasoned and not filled with a lot of unnecessary fillers such as carrots or peas. I love it and I think the prices as compared to many of the over rated Chinese restaurants in St. Louis are very reasonable. 
It's not fancy or decorated but the fanciest and most decorated places in St. Louis have all proven to me to have overpriced, bland food. 
I will continue to go to Sho Wok--give it a try.

This place is great for lunch or dinner, and I really enjoy coming here for their rotating sushi lunch special during the week - half off the roll of the day. Wednesday is Jalapeno Roll day and the rolls are AMAZING! The Nigiri is great also, and the servings are huge compared to some places in Tucson. 
I come here with people from my work for lunch sometimes and we are usually in an out within an hour or less, even with 5 or 6 people, which is pretty great.  
The staff is always friendly and accommodating and always seem to work to get us taken care of quickly, in a good way.

4th time here, first time getting pizza and boy we were blown away. Got a plain pie and a cheese steak pie. And a pitcher of beer! Plain pizza was fantastic, some of the best I've had in this area. Their cheese is really good. The cheese steak pizza was mind blowing. Loaded to the top with fresh peppers, onions and steak meat. It was absolutely wonderful. The beer was super cold and the wonderful server brought us out ice cold frosted glasses. A pitcher of beer was only 8 bucks!
Great service, great prices. Ignore the shitty reviews I have yet to have a bad meal here.

So planning on staying here in a couple weeks. Checking out google reviews and WOW!  Poor reviews for a property, that's been around longer the 8 years. No hot water was the major complaint, besides the poorly trained (if at all) employees.  So I called to ask about the water and AC complaints, and when the "person" answered the phone as;  "Front Desk", I knew to avoid this GHETTO "hotel".   Front desk of "WHAT"?

It might be good, but consistency is everything, not worth "taking a chance" staying here,  not unless I'm using YOUR Covid $$.!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This Chinese is just okay for me. I've also tried so many Chinese restaurants over the years that I've had really good and I'm picky. I've only done take out. I feel like the food is very plain tasting and lacking in flavor. It's not gross at ALL, It just doesn't do anything fit neatly The sesame chicken is okay, definitely not the worst I've had but not the best, the fried rice is yellow which I don't like for some reason. There crab rangoons are pretty good. Won ton soup is okay. The chips that come with the soup are one of my favorite things but they're not good here at all. Good Chinese food in Collegeville is hard to find.

Pushy, impatient, impolite server/cashier lady needs to take a few more classes in Customer Service. I'd asked her what the daily special was and when I asked for more info about the Turkey Ham (I wanted to know if the turkey ham was turkey or ham--though I guess I should have known lol), she kept emphatically shaking her head "no" thinking I was asking her if I could exchange Turkey for the Turkey Ham. Very annoying since it took a few minutes for her to calm down and realize what I was asking. I was almost hesitant to eat the sandwich after all that bad, confusing energy. Prob won't go to this one again..

So i just picked up my suv from Meineke. I made a last minute appointment this morning, dropped it off early (before my appointment) and before i knew it they were calling to say its ready. They did an oil change, changed the air filter and repaired a tire that had a screw in it. I used a 45% off coupon i got from their website and got a pretty good deal. The place was very clean and organized and the guys were super friendly. Also, to my surprise, i got a free 4 months of roadside assistance, a free keychain and there was an ice cold bottle of water waiting for me in my suv. I'd definately recommend them to anyone and will also go back again.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Straight forward. The food here is straight forward, I can't complain about the food. I had the carne asada caramelo, which is simple, humble, honest food. The cheese was gooey and good and the tortillas were warm and had those spots of golden brown crisp. 

I would definitely comeback here for lunch. This is blue collar food, the type you come in for after you've been working all day. I'm a fan of this food.

Again like I always say when I review Mexican food, it is hard for me to give a 5 star review since Tucson is a Mecca of Mexican food. There are so many places that vie for those coveted 5 stars.

This is the second time I have been here.  First time the cheesesteak I ordered was subpar.  This time there was 6 customers and two bartenders.  Four of the patrons sat with no drinks for over 10 min.  The bartender finally decided to serve some customers he decided not to serve me. I sat for another 15 min until he finally decided to get me another drink. Was also kind of in the mood for mozz sticks but the bartender rudely told me the kitchen was closed ( when two other people just ordered ).  I will not be coming back.

I've been searching for regular, delicious, Chinese take out.  Nothing special, or exotic.  I'm just asking for some good pork fried rice, sesame chicken, and crab rangoon combo.  Hong Kong failed.  The crab rangoons were edible, but very sweet and not as delicious as I know they can be.  The fried rice was gross.  It was flavorless.  The peas in it were hard.  Were they freeze dried?  I don't understand how they messed up fried rice.  And the sesame chicken was meh.  It had too much sweet sauce, and just missed that wow factor.  The breading was mushy and too bready. There was no crunch. We will not be ordering from here anymore.

The worst Italian food I've ever had. The chicken parm I ordered tasted like something you would get at an employee cafeteria with breading like that on frozen fried shrimp, the sauce was flavorless, and even the pasta was so salty it was barely edible. The bread was burnt on the outside and undercooked on the inside, and we never received bread plates but luckily paper was covering the tablecloth. Gonna give the restaurant two stars and the benefit of the doubt and say maybe they were rushed because of Mother's Day, and the lobster bisque and pizza bread was OK.

I love visiting Prime. It's one of the few car washes where your car is wiped dry after the wash. I enjoy this feature because the other washes around the city always leave me with streaky water spots after I'm finished. 

The offer wash packages (interior and exterior), and the biggest plus is that there's always a Groupon available for around $27 for an interior wash package of 3.

I've never had a bad experience, always received kindly, and never left with a streaky car once finished. I haven't tried the interior wash on my car, but I have had it done on our truck and it has always looked very nice.

I'll continue bringing my business here.

Stumbled across Laredo and decided to try for dinner.  It is a small place but yet managed to fit a two piece band in the corner. I sat at the small bar in the back.  Chips and salsa are served while you wait for your meal. I ordered the Chicken Mole. Portion was very small. Only one chicken breast that is butterflies to look bigger.  The Mole sauce was good but a little on the spicier side. Meal comes with Mexican rice and refried beans that are puréed.

While the music was nice and the staff great, I would not return.

I am not a donut lover, but these were pretty good. Everyone in my family liked them! 

The place was really clean inside and the staff member was really nice! I had a lot of options for as late in the day as I got them which is always nice! It's always a bummer when everything is sold out and the place doesn't make them all day. Parking was great because it's in a shopping plaza!

Overall, I really like the filling in mine. I'm not a glaze person, but the donut itself was really fluffy, fresh, and not dense at all!

My husband booked this place with the anticipation of being a four star hotel, maybe even better than Hampton inn. A must for us is to always have free breakfast.  I called the hotel to confirm we would receive free breakfast and the man said yes, you get to choose off the menu.  Next morning we go to order and they tell us no your room does not get a free breakfast.  Needless to say I was pissed but the very nice lady at the desk ended up giving us the meal card.  I didn't appriciate being lied to over the phone.  We will be staying loyal to Hampton Inn.  This place wasn't even that fancy
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went here yesterday with my boyfriend and the food and drinks were amazing . They have so many varieties of tequila and margaritas. I forgot the waiters name, but he was awesome in recommending some of the drinks that we ended up having. The ambience of this restaurant is incredible. I would like to go and visit the one in Philly because it has from what I heard swings and cars. I defentily will be back. If you haven't tried this Mexican restaurant which is in Moorsetown mall you will not be disappointed. I'm looking forward to trying their happy hour which is also recommended by our waiter.

I came back for another wash. This time a greeter up-selled a product that was secondary to the full $45 wash with waxing and thorough cleaning. The vacuuming and deep clean for $25, which was a seasonal deal that they're having. When I came back into my car, I found my old laundry that I had left was hanging on the joystick. My cup holders were still sticky and there was still trash left in the back of my car. I watched them clean the interior and exterior part of my windows. The top of my radio still laid in dust. The way the cleaning staff from post-wash were extremely unprofessional in their work. This will be the last time I'll be here.

go for the dinners and the house salad dressing ... you cannot go wrong ........ the dinner platters here are all home made and excellent .   The big secret is their House Italian salad dressing is old world recipe and its excellent ... you will want some to take home !   If you want excellent service - ask for Elaine ... she has been there for many years and loves making people happy .    She will even set up your BYPB wine .  The Penne ala Caprese dinner special is the best ... youwill have leftovers to take home . Just an all around great place to have near home .

Great service, creative design, but the food was poor. I ordered the spicy roll combo. The food arrived quickly, but I could not differentiate between the salmon, the yellow tail and the tuna. The portion size was the smallest I have experienced at any Japanese restaurant in the area. My wife ordered the chicken teriyaki. Although the portion size was more reasonable, there was nothing special about the dish.
Despite the disappointing food, the warmth and professionalism of the staff left me hoping my experience could be blamed on visiting on an off night. I hope Temaki Sushi improves the quality and quantity of the food in the future.

Snickerdoodle ice cream in a fresh, homemade waffle cone. 

The ice cream here is really nice.  Creamy, fresh, smooth.  Classic and more unique flavors are available.  The snickerdoodle ice cream was I think a smooth vanilla with a crunchy cinnamon-sugar swirl, and they did not skimp. 
Service was patient and friendly, though I can confirm they are a little slow - but we were in no rush on a cool October Sunday.

No where to sit. 
I found that a little odd and slightly inconvenient as our ice cream was melting fast as we drove away to find a place to enjoy it.

Very good local BYOB. Food was good, guacamole for the chips was ok (needed more seasoning). Serving size of food was plentiful. There's a liquor store next door, so we picked up Coronas to have with dinner. 
Lots of food options on the menu. There's even margarita mix for drinks so you can add your tequila. 
Service was good & fast, even on this busy Friday before Cinco de Mayo. It was pretty loud in there & made it a little hard to hear conversation, but it also made for a fun atmosphere. 
Would definitely recommend & would definitely go back.

Service was superb. Snails delicious! Wine beyond great. Food was lousy. Was the chef off last night? Hamburger was way too salty..couldnt eat it. Cheese plate had sour grapes, pathetic slices of cheese and 2 tiny chocolate things with 5 crackers. Mushroom pizza was  not like you use to make it.  So, we ordered the chocolate plate. Again, it looked someone had opened 2 hershey bars..broken the squares off..unevenly ... then placed the 8 tiny pieces on a saucer.  This is the second time in two weeks: great service  and wine. Lousy food. Need quality control.

Love this gym.
I have been a member at almost every gym in town and have never felt as comfortable as I do at this one.
The staff is very friendly and the equipment is new and updated!
The gym is kept clean and organized very well!
I bought the black card membership and haven't used tanning beds yet but the HydroMassage beds are awesome and the total body enhancement machine leaves me feeling energized and in a good mood!
I love the fact that they have a separate area for stretching and abs and plenty of cardio equipment
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
A Gem

I first visited Little Nonna's in May. I had wanted to try the restaurant for months, and I was so happy with the experience. Reservations are absolutely necessary, as the space is small and fills quickly. Service was friendly, and the decor was welcoming. My boyfriend and I started with the Pickled Strawberry Bruschetta, very good. I had the Pork Chop Pizzaiola--this was amazing! He had the Sunday Gravy. As all reviews say, it's fantastic; try it. For dessert we tried the water ice, which was refreshing, and the sweet Apples Crostata. This is a great restaurant, and I look forward to returning.

I do not recommend this Starbucks, unless you are visiting in the late morning or early afternoon. The drive thru only comfortably holds a queue of 2-3 cars, and then you are blocking the road around the shop. Service is slow, and the baristas are not as friendly. The attrition here seems high for baristas; maybe it is a rotational Starbucks for training baristas in the area? If you sit inside, it is quite small, but clean. I say here in the winter once, and because of the two entrances, and the small size, I froze my rear off with the cold wind blowing in every time the doors were opened.

This store is very small and not convenient. Once you get in you are 'stepping' on people who are in line to place an order. Service is slow and it takes forever to get your food. There is always a bunch of people standing in front of the counter which makes it impossible to move around. The napkins dispenser is empty all the time and drinking straws are on the floor. Food is alright- usual Macdonald's food. Prices are low. This is the only location and it's right at the beach so it makes it busy no matter what.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I ordered through Door Dash but I made sure to type in all edits And specialty fixes to my order. 

Do you know when I got my Order everything I didn't want was on the sandwich and nothing I actually wanted was on the sandwich; not even the stuff i didn't ask to take off! My order was simple! I only wanted 3 items on my sandwich! 

I was only refunded a portion of my money back for something that I couldn't even eat due to allergies. I'd already waited long enough for the food so I didn't bother reordering it.

Tried them today and I really only have two things to say: 

1. I tried the Strawberry Lemonade popsicle and omggg it was so delicious. I loved everything about it. I would love a 10-pack of them. HOWEVER that brings me to my #2

2. I paid almost $5 for one small popsicle -_- imagine paying $50 + tax for a 10-pack of popsicles. I can't. 

I respect businesses and the price them deem their products worth, but $5 is a little pricey in my opinion so once I get over paying $5 a popsicle, I'd go back. 

The quality is there. The flavor was good. The pricing is the only reason I couldn't comfortably give 5 stars.

Like a moth to the flame i keep coming back week after week.  If only CFA was open on sunday...  i really like Wendy's.  The food is great.  This Wendy's has some pretty bad service on sunday's though.  always they act like it's a inconvenience for me to be there.  And, hold on for a minute.  If i'm getting two meals and i ask for ketchup.  (begin the forbidden all caps) Please give me more than 3 ketchup packets.  For the love of god.  it is super embarrassing to have ask you twenty-three more times to get more ketchup like some kind of ketchup junkie.  God, I know I have a problem. I need you Wendy.  Hold me.

I like that they have a touch less car wash option.  It's much less abrasive to the paint on your car than a regular car wash with brushes. It will work for cars that don't have a lot of dirt caked on. If you're just trying to wash off some light/medium dirt/spots, try touch less. Although the last cycle is a spot free rinse and there are fans to dry your car bringing towels is a good idea to get a really spot free look. There are spaces to park to dry your car, vacuums as well, and vending machines to buy towels and some other car maintenance items like tire shine.

This is a first time for me to try country cooking with a twist. The two dishes we tried was the sausage with rice and beans and roasted chicken with white bean soup.  Yep that was exactly what we got.  Aside from the fresh made sausage which had a good flavor. All the other parts of our meal was very basic.  For country cooking standards the roasted chicken meal was missing a key part of the meal. Where was the potato's? You can't have a country meal without some hardcore carb overload (just my opinion). I guess some people really like country cooking and want to have a drink with the meal and Cracker Barrel does not offer drinks.

I love this hotel I don't know about you guys but this BEST WESTERN Burlington Inn is kinda okay? Me & my family we've stay overnight for only just one night because we've just came back form the theme park/water park. When we first came into the hotel room the tv remote just didn't turn nothing, but then the sec when came into another hotel room the tv just did it ok when I turn into differnet channels. The food for the breakfast the bagles taste good & even thier coffee as well. But me & my brother along with my mom we just came down the last sec! Because I should came down when it first open up!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Inept registration staff. 
Room smelled like mold (cleaning products).  
Rooms are old and need to be updated.  
The stovetop is damaged.

Maryanne Warwick does not return calls.  
Bradley Latham is nice but timid.  Rather than apologize for the lack of follow through he said I was aggressive and threatening. When I mentioned (in the lobby with other customers) how they triple charged me... crickets.  

Clean lobby.  
Clean hallway.  
Roomy rooms.  
Centrally located.
Laundry room is convenient.  No charge.
Breakfast staff is awesome.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The young lady who answers the phone last night Sunday Sept 8th sounds asleep and answers the phone n puts you on hold... she is rude  and hung up on me because I asked why she needed  my entire billing address n security code and expiration date for credit order...... She is very rude........all I did was ask a question n she gave me this speech bout doing her job n hung up..... Birds!!!!!!! Then the food was not worth that hassle!!! The spaghetti was just ok.... The cheese steak was cold n void of flavor n the Greek salad has way took much feta.... A

This place is great for family gatherings! My husband and I have gone here with both our families, and they were very accommodating.
While I prefer mild and sweet food, my husband loves spicy food; we both can be accommodated at Biaggis. We both particularly enjoy one of the pasta dishes, it has squid noodles! So very good!
My family can also be slightly pickier, and even they enjoy this place! They have classic dishes that can satisfy old time cravings, or you can try something new! 
All in all, we will continue to return here!

I have been going to this Italian eatery for many years and last evening had a terrible experience that seems based on new staff, both servers and chefs (though in this case "kitchen staff" is more appropriate than "chef").

First off, the outdoor heater near us didn't work so we had to change tables.

Second, the server took fifteen minutes to greet us.

Third, I was served the piddliest glass of wine I've ever seen in Santa Barbara.

Most important, the food:  Almost inedible.

The pizza was a disaster area, even after two tries from the kitchen.

As John Junor of Fleet Street used to write, "Pass the sick bag, Alice."

As a regular customer of the Canyon Grill I was disappointed when the waitress messed up the order causing someone in my party's food to come way after everyone else was done eating then she refused to discount the food or provide any reimbursement for the meal saying "(she) didn't hear him right". Exceptionally poor service on her part. The service isn't always the greatest, but the prices are half decent for very basic food. Meal portions are mediocre. The only thing that keeps me coming back is convenience.

So, I don't love Dunkin' Donuts but it's convenient for me. 

I haven't really had a complaint about the bakery items. Every once in a while, a bagel will be too tough or a croissant will be rock hard, but that's gonna happen. 

As for coffee, this location is extremely un-consistent. Sometimes I get a great coffee, sometimes it's crazy sweet or it tastes like there's no espresso even in it. 

I wish this location would step it up. Sometimes I feel like there is no pride being taken in what they are serving customers, then the next trip I get a good drink.... 

Be consistent. Please.

Never been here before today. Decided to take the kiddo out for a treat. 

First impressions.... there goes my diet. 
Second impressions, the place is super clean and the staff was very friendly. 

There is a pretty big selection of fro-yo and ice cream.  Choose a bowl, a bowl with a waffle cone, a cone.... oh man, so many options.  Oh, and the toppings...too many to list!

I'm not sure if this place is cheap or expensive really, but, I was able to get out of there for under $10 for the two of us.  That's not bad to me. 

I will definitely return, after I recover from the candy coma I'm sure I'll be going into soon!

First impression, this is a nice very modern hotel. The bloom comes off the rose rather quickly. The rooms are small. I guess that is alright if you only use the bed; but the is no room for a comfortable chair. If you want to read of play on your tablet you have three choices: a desk and chair; an ottoman without a back; or the bed. None of which are comfortable. I really really like the shower. I want one like that at home. The sliding door to the bathroom is a nice touch; but, as you get settled to do your business, the door rolls open.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: 2 stars for poor service on a Friday early evening and for food that was subpar in my opinion. We ordered miso soup (which tasted watered down); an order of a new roll with salmon and seaweed salad in it (it was spicy! and underwhelming); an order of salmon sashimi which was decent; shrimp tempura (the shrimp were pretty small compared to other places we've had this at); and also ordered beef shogayaki (which they forgot about - but our server claimed it was on its way). Don't think I'll be back anytime soon.

**Note: After 20 years in the same location, Vinomania is moving. This location will officially close mid-January 2016 with details to come as to where they will be moving to.**

I came here as they are having an inventory reduction sale and all their craft beers were 20% off. I was able to find the one I was looking for for my fiance. The staff member who assisted me and answered my questions was helpful, albeit not super friendly.

I've been to this location several times over the years and find they have a nice variety of wines and spirits.

I'm interested to see where their new location will be and what it will look like!

We stayed here thanks to being super close to the American Board of Radiology. There are several average chain restaurants nearby.  The rooms are basic and there is a small bistro downstairs where you can grab breakfast or a drink.  The hotel was packed with people taking the board exams...and if all the rooms were like ours, many were simultaneously panicking about managing to sleep with an extraordinarily loud and rattling air conditioner.

Addendum: we checked with some others that stayed here and their air conditioners were super annoying also. Something to consider for ABR exam takers!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The black pepper tuna appetizer was quite good but everything went downhill after that.  It took a long time to place our order (even though they only had two tables) and the sushi was underwhelming.  It did come out quickly though.

The rice was loose (fell apart when you picked it up) and the rolls looked nothing like the photos in the menu (normally I run from places that have food photos.)  The rolls were fairly plain as well and the sauces lacked much flavor.

The fish itself was fresh which gets points.

The miso soup looked good but lacked the umami flavor you expect.

Clean restaurant but no plans to go back.

Food is good, yet pricy, but everything in Franklin's table is pricy. I deducted a point for their slow service. It took them 15 minutes to scoop some soup into a cup and add bread. There was only two people ahead of me. They got their food right away. The lady behind me got her food before me. This is a food court. There is no reason it should take 15 minutes for food that is already prepared. Their roasted squash soup is good. I would increase stars if service improves or people improve their customer service etiquette.

I've been to Wasabi in downtown St. Louis, Edwardsville, and Fairview Heights multiple times each. This place never fails to please. My favorite part is their individual specialized menu's particular to each location. Their sushi is always delicious and I've never had something here I didn't like or that wasn't presented well. Their service is always good and I love taking out of town guests here for great local sushi. Additionally, one of the best qualities of wasabi is their pricing. Sushi can be wildly expensive and I feel that the quality of their sushi Far exceeds their pricing.

It's Starbucks, chain coffee house. Similar to fast food places, if you're going here you should know what to expect. 

This location specifically the drive through always seems to be slow. The parking lot can be very crowded and awkward. It has a Japanese steakhouse next to it. (Which on a side note is fantastic) 
The review is 3 stars cause this place is just average. Some of the employees are  great and others not so much. The drinks are sometimes great and others not so much. Overall I've been to worse locations and been to better. But this is my go to/closest location so it's bound for me to experience the ups and downs.

I have gone to Skyn a few times for manicures and pedicures. There are often appointment mix ups and sometimes it is hard to get an appointment even though every time I go to skyn I'm the only person in the place... 

The service is pretty good for the price. However I do find that for mani pedis they take too long. Set aside a good 2 hours for a manicure. My friend got gel nails here and they did not have the nails she wanted to they basically used shilac and these white tips and it looked horrendous. She had to pay around $70 for that. 

Overall I wouldn't recommend Skyn for nail services.

This is a solid place to bring genuinely Japanese friends. They don't over-try on the ambiance and the food is true to the book and quality. No surprises here, unless you count the fact that some of the stuff NOT on the sushi menu actually kicks a$$ - cellophane noodle stew comes to mind! 

That said, it's not a first-date place, more like a fifth-date, someone you're actually comfortable with and you know isn't too superficial or high-maintenance. Servers and chefs are great folk, but investing in the decor and playing with food presentation and pricing might help bring my next rating up.

I was really craving for sushi and was just around Cherry Hill Mall when I decided to do what a good yelper does and yelp for sushi. I did takeout and not the all you can eat buffet. The food was done promptly and the staff was friendly. I ordered a spicy tuna roll, a salmon and avocado roll and a shrimp tempura roll. To my disappointment, I didn't like them very much. However, it was a great deal, 3 rolls with soup and salad for about $13. They also packaged everything so nicely and made sure that anything that you would need for sushi was within the bag.

I come here couple times a week. Gym is located less then 5 min away from my house so it is really convenient. 
Today, I bought a powerade on my way in half way done, I realized the drink tasted little funny. It was 6 months expired. 
I let the staff know and they didn't think this was a big deal and that really bothers me more than the expired drink.
I wonder if it were their kids or nephews drinking expired drinks, they would still think it wouldn't be a big deal.
Make sure to check the expiration date if you are willing to buy a drink from them. Better yet, stop by wawa near by.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I reached out to the Yelp community to get some help with an electrical issue on my car. Tampa Auto Doctor was quick to respond and gave me a positive feeling that this issue wasn't going to be a guessing game. I made an appointment and dropped my car off. Xavier was at the desk, he kept me abreast of how the diagnostic went and how quickly everything was going to be handled. The cost was reasonable and the fix was that day! I'm more than happy to drive across town to get work done by people you can trust. (Because of Covid, there was NO waiting room, so have plans to be picked up or Uber/Lyft somewhere to wait.)

I wish this location would get their service together. They're sooo slow. The drive thru is slow and going inside seems even slower. The baristas act like it's a chore to speak with you and if they can avoid making eye contact they do. It's not a friendly environment. The pastry I purchased today was stale. Even though there was only 1 person in front of me in line and only 1 person at the counter waiting for their drink it took almost 15 minutes to receive my drink after I paid for it today. The layout inside is awkward. I keep returning in hopes for some improvement but it's consistently poor.

You walk in what looks like a beautiful restaurant and no body is there to welcome you and it's seat yourself dining. Fine however we waited about 10 minutes to be acknowledged and then she took our drink orders, to come back with only one persons drink and no waters. The horrible service continued as she brought out one roll at a time forgetting to bring a roll making our lunch experience awkward and annoying. The sushi was good but when the service doesn't add up to the prices it's just a bummer. Needless to say we won't be back or recommending to anyone!!

I'm really surprised this hotel only has 3 stars! I've always been treated amazingly here from check in to check out. The lobby area is beautiful and the rooms are well appointed. The last 2 times I've stayed j got a corner room with views of Lake Ponchatrain and in fb am it's stunning! All the rooms also have a coffee maker and fridge which I think is a must. The concierge lounge is pretty good for some basic small bites and breakfast. Room service is always on time and fresh! Parking is a bit expensive to valet but pretty much on par with other hotels in the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: When walked in, was immediately hit with smell of bad frying oil. Almost just turned around and left. But, might as well try. French toast donut cooked to death. Grease bottom. Very dry. That one needs improvement. Samoa donut actually good. Good donut flavor and consistency. Captain Crunch was ok. Cereal was stale, but donut had ok flavor . Icing good on all 3 donuts. Maybe they are still working out the kinks. They are still a new business. Will try again in a few months to give them a chance to consistently put out good tasty product.

I wanted to try a new salon and I had a terrible experience because when the polish I picked was too light the manicurist blobbed on a third coat of a dark polish on top. There were cotton strands on my fingers which is a huge pet peeve that she painted over and when i asked her to remove it she scrubbed it off with no acetone. All the side of my fingers were missing nail polish and it was just so rushed and streaky that I rushed home to take it off. Never again! There are too many nail salons on Bustleton for such service.

Beautiful day to enjoy Lucky 13. We ate outside and I ordered the Mexican pizza to share. All of the ingredients for fresh except they were out of salsa which seems a little crazy. My friends Pizza only had a few sparse Pepperoni's on it and he was very disappointed. The music from the 80s was awesome as well as the atmosphere. This visit was not as awesome as normal because the food was not prepared as well and they were out of several things. They stated they have been really busy the night before but personally salsa should have been something maybe they went and bought.

3.5 stars. This location is pretty clean and the staff is friendly but there is always a wait. I have been here many times and even if there is no one else in line I wait 10 to 15 mins for my food. That is great timing in a diner but not a fast food place. If you go through drive through...forget it. If you're getting more than 3 or 4 items be prepared to be asked to pull up and wait for someone to come out and bring your order to the car. There is plenty of parking. The food has always been good, fries have always been hot.

Lately it's been a hit or miss when it comes to the food..

Tonight makes me not want to come back.. I walked in and it smelled like urine.. My kid was so hungry I decided to stay anyway..my chicken sandwitch was so dry and tasted like it had been sitting all day.. I know there is a time limit on how long they hold the chicken in the drawers and this was def over the time limit.. To top it off we were fighting fruit flies the whole time.. 

It seemed dirty the rug stinks and looks like it is in desperate need of a vacuum and rug doctor

My husband and I ordered takeout from this place and it was better than any other Chinese takeout we've had here in Tampa. I got the chicken with vegetable and I could tell that the vegetables were fresh, unlike most places. I always order chicken with veggies and usually the veggies are overcooked or just plain nasty. We also ordered crab rangoons which were delicious. I don't like the way they make them at some restaurants. My husband ordered general tso's chicken and didn't complain about it so I'm assuming that was good, as well. My only complaint is the price but I am willing to pay a couple of extra dollars for better quality food.

For a big bank like Chase to have such a friendly little neighborhood branch is a huge win.  Every time I walk through the door, I'm greeted by name, and the service has always been top notch.  My banker Wanda has been incredible!  She consistently goes above and beyond to help us with whatever we need, and checks up by phone every once in a while to see how we're doing.  Brad, my financial guy, is equally on point, offering great advice, asking me in to review my investments periodically, and getting things done like a boss when I need something to happen fast.  Thanks Chase Allisonville for being so awesome!

I had a few drinks here the other night with friends and I really enjoyed it! Prices were great for an awesome beer list, including $5 burgers and $3 fries! For a casual environment, with good burgers and fries, and a good beer list, there are few better spots in South Philly. I will say that the seating was not very comfortable, and I could see it getting super stuffy if it were a little bit busier. Staff is super awkwardly not happy. No smiles, boring tones. I just don't get it considering the rest of the environment, but okay. If that is your thing, they are really sticking to it.

My new nail salon! I was going to a nail salon close to my house for 8 years, but they shut down in order to focus on family. I then switched to Beautiful Nails. After several times of going there and my nails breaking and chipping because the acrylic and gel were too thin, I was told about Vicky's nails. Ive been going here for about 8 months and will not go anywhere else. My acrylic and gel nails always look stunning when leaving the shop and they have never chipped or broke! I now drive about 45 minutes to get my nails done, and will continue to do so.

Finally North Valleys has an excellent restaurant to offer!  So far excellent better than Miquels and Bertha Mirandas! The Fajitas, Burritos all the food are excellent and done to perfection. The have an outdoor patio with a mariachi contemporary band that made it pleasant and inviting. The staff and our waitress was warm and inviting and glad you where there. We will go back! !
They also have a fruit punch with tequila and different fruits in it. It is so delicious they serve it in a bowl kind of the reason I like to go there!   I have been there numerous times me and my husband like to go once or twice a month!

Absolute worst experience ever. We waited over an hour for the food to come out. The owner Mary is very stuck up and rude. Our food had been sitting in the window for over 5 minutes. When our food was brought to the table it was warm and soggy. When my friend ordered food to go there were no fries in the box and the owner said "well that's the waitresses fault because she's new" I'm sorry but that's not how you run a business. Then when we were cashing out we told the owner Mary about our terrible experience she copes an attitude and told us that it was all our fault. Video was taken of everything please go look on their FB page.

My favorite sushi place in the mall closed so I visited this restaurant because of all of the positive reviews on this site. I agree with some of the other reviews that it doesn't look like much from the outside. I was a bit skeptical when I pulled into the drive-way. Once inside, I realized it was just like any other sushi place. I had the sushi/sashimi lunch special and it was good. The Gyoza (fried dumplings) were awesome! The steamed dumplings were just ok. My friends were all happy with their meals as well. This place is my new KOP sushi spot.

I paid 10.04 for 1 pizza (7.99) with 2 ranches (1.50). First off it's pretty awesome that they have quite a few customizations and you can build whatever you want for $7.99, bad side is that the pizza is kind of small, roughly a medium size. It has 6-8 slices but they're fairly small as well, the crust is extremely thin and was a tad bit burnt. Barely enough for 2 people. The ingredients are pretty fresh though and taste amazing! I would go back for the customizations and fresh ingredients alone, maybe next time I'll check if they have a different crust. All in all, it was worth it, the ranch is incredible by the way!

I'm writing my review based solely on my bar experience. 

First off, I love the concept of a bar/deli. You can get a little saucy while you wait for your sandwich, how great is that? It's very clean and modern and the bartender was young, energetic and courteous. 

Me and a friend ordered two margaritas. They didn't have the glassware to accommodate however they tried their best and we ended up with a basic margarita in a highball. I was still pleased after I had my lacking margarita and kept them coming. I would go to primos solely for the bar. It's a great chill atmosphere.

This place has been a neighborhood favorite for as long as I remember. The food is consistent. The best part about Larry's is... yes you guessed it, the cheesesteaks. Steak and cheese or buffalo chicken, doesn't matter, they're both excellent, hot, gooey and will eliminate that craving for a decent cheesesteak. Their pizza is average, however their mild wings are just right. They're tangy and spicy and generously coated in sauce. Overall I would recommend ordering from Larry's if you don't feel like cooking dinner and want some good fatty food or if you're drunk and hungry for an above average steak.

The food was alright, the service was pretty bad to say the least. They were slow in taking our order, the server was very rude and got my moms order wrong. When asked about it she passed it off as an error that we read the menu wrong when my mom has been has been here several times beforehand. She also left no explanation and no solution to the problem, all my mom wanted was shrimp tempera she didn't even ask if we wanted to add that to the order. She never came by to fill our water even though we clearly need a refill. 

The food was alright, I liked the special box raw fish the tuna was probably my favorite. Everything else wasn't great.
