I have definitely drove passed this place a handful of times and never known it was there! It is conveniently located just south of Bay to Bay Blvd  , a block from Bayshore. I called around 10am and spoke with Jamal, a very nice and extremely helpful man. I unfortunately ran over a long metal rod that pierced one of my tires. He recommended a patch rather than a new tire. I appreciated his honesty. Some other places I've been to overcharge. I'm not sure if this is a family run business, but everyone seemed nice in there. I'd recommend bringing your car in to Southern Tire to have it repaired!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
What is it with DD employees not knowing their own menu? I ordered a No. 1 Combo and the cashier asked me what size I wanted. I said "whatever size the menu  price of $1.98 gets me."
She said, "small"
I double checked the menu and saw it said medium...so I corrected her. 
I know I sound bitchy but this exact same thing happened to me at the other DD on 4th St recently.  
Why don't they know the size of coffee their most popular combo comes with?   Its printed on the wall behind them.  ...also I asked for a cruller and a boston cream, but received a cruller and sour cream doughnut.

Sbarro's is a chain-first tried it in New York City and was glad to fine it at the Foothills Mall food court.  The pizza is pretty good and there are a lot of choices for toppings.  I like the spinach calzone which has a lot of spinach and cheese wrapped in the really good pizza dough.  They have luncheon specials, salads, pasta, desserts and sodas.  When you choose what you want (pizza or calzone) they will warm it up for you and it is pretty good.  It doesn't take too much time and the counter guys are friendly and pleasant.  It'a good option at the food court.

The restaurant I went to (there are 3 of them) is in a shopping mall at Swan and Sunrise near the Safeway but a bit south of it.  They do a lot of takeout but we dined in.  I've eaten here a few times and it is decent food.  I like their egg rolls that have a nice crispy outside.  I've had a few different dishes including cashew chicken and the chef's recommendation of pork with satay sauce.  They will prepare it mild, medium or very spicy.  I think medium is best as the mild doesn't have a lot of flavor.  The interior is dated and the seats in the booth are lumpy but service is always quite good.

This is a branch of the regional bank right on Tchoupitoulas. I've only ever used their drive through banking and ATM.

Product: N/A

Service: Quick, efficient, and friendly. No complaints here. 4 stars

Facilities: It makes me wonder why banks today have such large footprints, but the property is aesthetically pleasing. The lawn is alway well-tempt, and the concrete clean. 5 stars

Overall: If you need to use Whitney/Hancock bank, and you're uptown, this is the spot for you. There's rarely a line, and it moves fast. 4 stars

Their sushi was fabulous! Quick to get in, and they are very fast at making the sushi since they have the rice already rolled out and ready for the sushi chef.  I was surprised at how fast it was to order a roll and have it on your table! The wait staff can be hard to track down because they get busy running everywhere, so you may have to wave them down (otherwise 5 Star!) This is our new go-to for sushi! 

I also loved how all the rolls are named after movies.  Classic! But do try the "Anger Management" roll... it's listed as a customer favorite on the menu and does not disappoint.

Love the food here! I haven't tried anything that I don't like, and the margaritas are great.

Some of the tacos were on the spicy side for me, but the servers are great about steering you in the right direction. The Mexican street corn and guacamole are great starters! My group has always ended up ordering too much food, so I would recommend just ordering a little bit at a time and adding on if you're still hungry!

My only complaint is that it can get pretty loud if there is a big group, but overall, I love it!

Should be 0 stars.  The absolute worst McDonalds I have ever frequented.  Employees are not hospitable.  There is always something wrong with the orders.  I come here mostly for a "quick" happy meal for my kids.  The quick is in quotations because the last meal I got was through there drive thru AND it took over 20 minutes!! Is that fast food?  The line just doesn't move!  SAVE YOURSELF THE AGGRAVATION AND PROBLEMS BY DRIVING AN EXTRA 8 MINUTES TO THE MCDONALDS UP RIDGE.  I promise it will be faster and better service and better order accuracy and quality.  I try to avoid this location with every fiber in my being.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I'm a Tampa native who travels a ton for work. 
I rarely ever ever have anything good to say about conference food. 
I'm usually one of those that refuses to eat the conference food and opts to leave the hotel to eat out during lunch or breakfast, etc. 
I even brought plenty of snacks to hold me over in case the food would suck. 
This was fresh, great quality, healthy food! 
We're all super pleased and impressed. It's also a very clean and beautiful location. 
I can't believe it's my first time here. 
Definitely not the last =)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I am not a fan!  I have been here 2 times both of witch where not all that great. I feel like the staff is the majority of the problem. 

My chef today sadly falls into the not so good category. He was to pre occupied wth the what I assume where restaurants politics he service suffered. Not a single roll I ordered was made correctly, it took forever for him to get them made because he was everywhere but his station.  

One thing I would not want to be in Reno is a sushi joint!! There are so many great ones the standards are very high. This one to me don't meet the standard!

This place has great tacos. I had the sesame ribeye with kimchi, the shrimp, and the portobello mushroom taco.  They were all delicious.  I particularly loved the portobello taco. It was amazing.  I was with friends and they all had different tacos. Everybody loved theirs. Also, the deserts were great. 

The atmosphere was fun, the wait staff was excellent and there was quite a feast for the eyes. Our waiter, James, was excellent.  He was very helpful with the menu and he was very attentive.  Also, I loved the decor. Very beachy chic. 
All in all, it was a great experience.  I will definitely be back.

KOI is showing its age. It wasn't as nice or as clean as the last time I visited. The table was a bit sticky. There was food scraps on the floor around the seating areas. Despite that, the staff was nice and we were seated quickly. We ordered shrimp and chicken. The cook was skilled, entertaining and the food was good. I'm mainly dinging them for not maintaining the restaurant over time and for a lack of cleanliness. If you are looking for affordable hibachi then this is a decent option. I hope they were just having an off night.

Try this place...you will LOVE IT!!!!  Such friendly owners and extremely attentive and concerned that the food is to your liking...which is was.  Excellent dining experience.  The Pan Fried Gyoza was delicious.  We also ordered the Yaki Udon Stir Fry with chicken with the side of Miso.  And the Chirashi Zushi Bowl with Salad.  DELICIOUS!!!  All of it...we had never had Yaki Udon...the noodles and stir fried ingredients were flavorful and the chicken was tender.  The extra side of Super White Tuna Sushi was fresh and a generous portion.  A must visit.

Been here 5 times and all were amazing gel manis, except the most recent visit. The place is very clean and the decor is amazing. Staff are professional and knowledgeable. Totally would get 5 stars except for on the most recent visit "Mimi" massacred my cuticles (see photo). I will go back, but will specifically request to NOT have Mimi. She lamely apologized for the cuticles by telling me that I have sensitive skin. No! crazy lady! This has never been an issue before in years of manis. If I had known how bad my cutes would look a few hours after leaving, I would have taken this up while I was there...

I used to be a recurring customer at Modern Nails and would go every week. I would typically get gel polish with a refill. The issue is that I noticed my nails would break very easily. Every time I would go back for them to fix it, they would blame it on my professional work assuming I type (which I don't very much). Not only would they charge to fix the nails, they use cheap acrylic. Almost every time, my nails would break after a few days. I've wasted so much money here. Luckily, I've found a new establishment that uses good quality acrylic and I've yet to break a nail since!

I had some pretty bad experiences at the sushi kingdom by franklin mills but when I heard there was one in jersey, I figured if give it a try. 

Based on my previous experiences, I wasn't expecting much. I was surprised this visit was a lot more pleasant. Never once was my water glass empty. Waitresses and waiters constantly came by and refilled my cup. They were very patient with my large group when ordering. Food was delicious and service was prompt. I don't know why all these reviews say the food took forever to come out, it was probably out in about 20-30 minutes. I will definitely come again.

I come to this Dunkin' all the time as it's right by my house and have always had great service. This is a relatively new Dunkin' and it shows, it's very clean and well-cared for. My coffee order is always tasty (and correct which is important).

I have yet to go inside, but the drive thru is super efficient and the workers are friendly. There's almost never a line and they have no problem hearing me. It's super easy getting in and out if you're headed east on Hillsborough. They also offer $2 Iced Coffees/Lattes from 2-6 everyday!

I enjoy coming here for a quick car wash. Is it amazing? No. Is it better than getting your car professionally detailed? No. But if your car is covered in pollen and you're tired of looking at it, this will do the job. Don't bother paying for the $15 works package, just get the $5 basic car wash. It's the same thing.

Once you've gone through the car wash, they  have vacuums and floor mat cleaners that you're welcome to use free of charge. The suction on the vacuums are not great, I can get about the same with my Shark vacuum at home, but the floor mat cleaners are great!

We came here for our anual meeting, and I am still at the hotel, but decided to write the review. I got a really nice room in the 28th floor. Great view too! The front desk was very nice, and always ready to help. Now, on the bad side... make sure to ask a room away from the elevators! I have not been able to sleep before 12am and after 4:30am... this is the only reason why I am not giving a 5 starts. I have stayed before by the elevator and never had this problem. I definitely think this is something the hotel may be able to fix.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I ordered delivery from Que Chula Es Puebla. It was OK but I probably wouldn't order from them again. The El Pastor tacos were pretty good and of the Mexican style with radishes and cilantro. The nachos however were not good. They tasted like something you'd buy at the concession stand at a sporting event instead of from an authentic Mexican restaurant. They used cheese whiz instead of melting Mexican cheese. There are plenty of other Mexican restaurants in northern liberties and fish town that are much better (e.g. Loco Pez and Jose Pistolas).

We enjoyed our stay.   Me, my mom and son enjoyed 2 weeks staying here during Christmas and New Year.   We stayed in the remodeled part, as did my family that came to stay a night here also..It was very quiet, clean and my mom is handicapped, so she enjoyed the roll in shower.   I bought a few kitchen supplies at Goodwill, and it was on!  Decent, and inexpensive!  New Years was the noisiest is all, but that was on with me.  I am from Indianapolis, so I know the area is good.  Lots of shops, restaurants and stores close by.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Do not recommend going here...I ordered on the phone a few egg rolls, crab Rangoon, and gyoza. 
The total should have come to the amount of 8 dollars. My friend went to pick it up and used my card and got the receipt. The total on the receipt said the total was 16.97 and didn't have the individual items priced ,just the total. So you can't see how they got to 16. 
    I looked at the prices online and that is how I got my total so that's how I know they overcharged me . 
     It's just annoying since I was just looking for a cheap place that had mediocre food and they definitely have mediocre food from what I can tell by their appetizers.

Oh my god don't eat here. Go to Burger King. 

Stopped by last week on the way to our gate because we needed food, and I thought "how bad could a burger be?" SO BAD. I mean SO, SO, SO bad. It was microwaved, grey, pasty meat. We're talking worse than middle school cafeteria lunch. I'm not joking. It's really that bad. I will remember this hamburger for the rest of my life. 

The best part was that after two burgers, one order of fries split, and two bud lights, our bill was over $60. Just go to burger king, or anywhere else. Chew on your own luggage. Worst meal I've ever had.

I was checking out a new neighborhood in Philly (new to me) and came across BYOB Italian restaurant. We were asked if we had reservations (and we didn't) but they were able to provide seating outside. Waitress mentioned that they do take walk-ins but they were busy that night. The pizza was great and the food was ok. The owner provided a free glass of his home-made wine which was decent and really nice. They are opening a Beer establishment across the street in September that will offer beer and sandwiches. It has a front patio that has great potential as an outside seating area so I'll return to give that a try.

Hey all just a little info for ya. I've been here several times while there food isn't the best in town it is good and quick I usually get the combo the price is great and I get Kung pao chicken and Szechuan beef, now the sauce is salty some times but like I said good. Now the thing I found surprising is their fried rice almost too a tee it is tasty fluffy and light unlike most places whose fried rice is greasy. You can get the combo with either the fried rice or the chow mien  now I haven't tried the chow mien yet so I'll keep ya posted so if your down wells and need a quick bite and Chinese is on your mind give em a try

Took a long time for me to finally come here due to formerly lack luster reviews. I had a great experience at lunch.  Service was kind and attentive; there were only 1-2 other customers. All 3  rolls were delicious. 

I will say they were notably smaller than other sushi spots. We noticed right away after sharing 3 rolls that we were not bursting with fullness as usual.

Prices were typical. Specialty roll options not as abundant as competitors. Groupon deal was irresistible. Would have no problem returning but a couple other spots would probably be my first choice.

Love this place. The drinks are craft cocktails: tasty and still strong; decent selection of beers. Interior decor is nice, there's a pool table in an adjoining room.  Seating is somewhat limited but theres a patio as well which is super nice & has fire heaters. 

There are events going on here daily every week (you don't need to be a hotel guest) so check their website. Staff is always very kind. 

 The restaurant has good food which you can eat in the restaurant or order and eat in the bar; delicious but a bit pricey. I love the brussel sprouts and their flat iron (although it is small for the price).

So here's the deal. Nothing ever sounds better than waffles on a Sunday morning. I ordered the violet beauregarde with sweet potato waffles x2 and they said the wait would be 30 minutes so I arrived an hour later (see past post for reason). Food was ready, I was acknowledged fast. My issue is this. Our waffles weren't sweet potato, idk what they were. They were also burnt. Sure, I should've checked before I drove all the way home but I didn't. I'm not going to put any blame on the wait staff because they seem to be doing their job.

My favorite dish here is the fish tacos.  The fish is crispy, and the sauce - some variation on mayonnaise, lemon complements the fish and cabbage well.

The cheese enchilada is huge and a creamy gooey delicious mess.

I've had the taco salad, and they are willing to accommodate your preferences, the black beans ( tasty), they used to have a good gazpacho, but haven't in a while"

I'm not crazy about their guacamole ( I like Serranos and Chipotle guacamole better), but their chips are usually very fresh and crisp.

Service department is the worst! It takes 2 hours just to get your oil changed and tires rotated. Whether you make an appointment or you don't, you won't leave this place without being here for almost 2 hrs. I used to go to Toyota dealership in Charlotte, NC it would take 30 min WITH a FREE car wash. Here everyone takes their time. Plus when you ask for a time estimate, you get an attitude in return. On top of that, they always loose my tire air pressure caps. If it wasn't for my prepaid car care plan from Toyota, I would not step a foot in this place.

We initially tried this place on one of our adventures to eat at all of the places in the area. I was skeptical since the place was almost empty when we walked in but the staff was friendly and service was good. We ordered a little of everything, soup (I would skip the soup) general taos, crab wontons, spring rolls, sushi, sashimi, and rolls. 

For the price this place is amazing! It has become our go to for a night out. We went to another place this past weekend and as we walked out said we should have gone to oki sushi! Surprising becoming our favorite sushi place.

Great space for a night out with friends!  It's quite spacious with the ability to sit inside or on their large terrace. The food is decent, but it came out cold which makes it difficult to give higher ratings. We ordered chicken wings with several of their side options. The tacos were okay as well. The drinks are way overpriced. They have a drink called a boom box that is served in a boom box made of porcelain and while the composition sounds good, there is no way it's worth $30. Let me add, you are not able to keep the boom box.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: What an unexpected gem! Went out to the "swamp " for an airboat ride and a face to face with some gators. Got there early and we went across the street to a little spot for some adult refreshment before setting off. What we found was local very friendly spot I wish we could have spent hours instead of minutes. Bartender was a lovely woman, owner was a great guy, a local named Ray was a charmer and everyone the bar was just warm, welcoming and friendly. Living in a big city I sure love finding these places that remind me that not everyone is a stranger. This place is worth seeking out if you're coming to NOLA and get tired of the same ol'

Would not recommend. There are $5 car wash option with an upgrade for $2 extra for wax, tire shine for $3. I went here due to the solid recommendations from Yelpers but following the car wash I noticed that the pollen still was on the car and only half cleaned at best. 

Further, my 2013 car (still new) had its wax taken off/some paint as well (area about a penny's size) when I inspected it.

Bonus was free self vacuum service which I used after the car wash. Weak vacuuming power so it won't remove the little dust and dirt particles, but it does the job.

The menu is very limited, like a taco truck. Their street tacos didn't interest me because every taco truck has them. So I ordered the huarache with carne asada as the meat. I've never had a huarache but the ingredients should have made it really good. But it was very bland, like Central American bland. I kind of overdosed on green sauce trying to bring it to life, but to no avail. FYI their street tacos are $1.50/ea, which is a fair price. The huarache, at $9, was not worth it. They should have thrown in some beans and rice for that. Oh well. I won't be back, but if you find most Mexican food too spicy, check it out.

This by far is one of my favorite pizza places in St. Louis. Whenever I am craving a nice greasy and oh so cheesy slice, I come here. I used to stay at the Embassy Suites across the street when in town for work. During the week it is a perfect time to go because the wait is none, and the food comes quickly. I get the thin crust, one topping half sausage, half pepperoni. And do not forget the side of ranch. Ooooooo so yummy.  The staff was great, very friendly. Small pizza is great for 2-3 people. A must try when you are in the city!!

Tony's was the perfect choice for our late Valentine's Day celebration. I had never experienced such attentive service. I could barely begin to move my chair when I needed to use the restroom that our waiter was behind me pulling it out from the table for me! The food was wonderful; I ordered the shrimp linguine while the Mr. enjoyed a perfectly seared peppercorn steak. Overall, this was a wonderful fine dining experience and easily the best restaurant we have been to in the St. Louis restaurant. Do expect a pricey bill! It is all worth it, though.

I had a poor experience. I walked up to the counter and told them that I had a gluten allergy. They questioned making my food "off the line". I order a pizza with herb butter, grilled chicken and peppers. I watch the gentleman putting my pizza together grab butter right of the line full and a flour covered area. I had to asked three times for a manager before getting one to help me. The manager informed me that herb butter wasn't available off the line, so he remade my pizza with olive oil. He was apologetic and didn't charge me for the $2 fee for GF. However, I'm not sure I'll go back.

I enjoy publix because of its friendly and clean environment I tried to contribute to that yesterday as I was looking for cheese since I was going to make a flatbread. I came across expired cheese (cacique), so I brought to the register and advised the lady that it was expired also I had noticed it had mold. The normal this to do is mark it in the system and take it out of the system she handed it to the bagger and he walked back towards the shelf where I had removed it... Really!!! Not cool, always check your expiration dates people before making a purchase.

I know I eat here often because the price is so right...but the food is good...not great.  It's great for the amount of money you pay.  Sushi is mediocre...for obvious reasons...but this place is seriously packed almost every time I've gone...especially on holidays! (Btw, they're open on holidays...another reason why I come here).  

Service is good and hibachi is yummy.  The hibachi chefs that are hired now are better than the previous. My kids are certainly entertained.  They serve a variety of alcoholic beverages and have Quality Green Tea ice cream for dessert.  A must at the end for me :)

This place is amazing. It's a small BYOB and cash only. Plan on about 200.00 for two...it is worth it! The owner is the chef only kitchen staff. I think it maybe his wife that serves. It has a family feel and they treat you as such. The food takes a little while but it is fresh, delicious and worth the wait. This is the only place I get an appetizer (sometimes two to share), an entree and dessert. It is a relaxing dinner that gives you a chance to really talk and enjoy the company you're with over a fantastic meal. The owner has also come out and talked with the customers. This place is definitely worth a visit! What a gem!

Great Chinese food - reminds me of the take out I used to order in NY. Nice mid range priced tasty food that is in a convenient location for me. I called to place a pick up order and within 15 mins it was ready just as they said it would be. Easy location to park in and run in and pick up the order. The hot and sour soup was tasty and hearty - not as spicy as I usually like but I easily fixed that with some hot sauce, the sesame chicken was great and the chicken fried rice was solid. Good portion sizes and the menu has a lot of options!

Easy to make an appointment, parking right beside and behind the building and no wait time when I walked in. Friendly greeting when I walked in, was promptly taken to an exam room and was in and out in about 30 minutes including dilation. Dr. Cooper was pleasant and knowledgeable and answered all my questions patiently. They also have plenty of stylish frames if you are looking or you can purchase contacts lenses. Location was convenient and easy to find. I appreciate them fitting both myself and my husband in before the end of the year on fairly short notice so We can use our benefits ! Will be back again next year for the annual check up!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This place is nice inside and the service is fast and friendly. However, I was not impressed with the food quality and high prices. I ordered rolls combo which had cali, dynamite and spicy tuna rolls. The california roll was just decent, dynamite pieces were huge but pretty empty with too much rice and not much of a taste, and tuna roll was disappointing. Its was spicy to the point where it didnt even taste like tuna and tuna was mushy. Salmon sashimi was about $14-15 just for a few pieces. It is expensive place with good service but not the best food.

First time going here for dinner, food was good but for the prices they charge their portions were small. Only 1 meatball and 1 sausage with linguine. Only 2 very thin flat pieces of chicken for chicken piccata and small portion of risotto which costs extra. Chicken piccata dinner with upgraded risotto was $31.00, this should not costs more then $22.00. We had filet mignon cheesesteak egg rolls $16.00, could not tell if the meat was filet or not. We went on a Friday night hardly any of the seats were filled, I think they need to cut their prices or give you more food for the money they charge. Perhaps they will have more business.

I don't know about everyone else but, when I ask for a dark roast coffee I want a strong cup of coffee to start my day. This Sips is located next to the hotel registration across from the valet at Circus Circus Reno. They also have a location at the Silver Legacy Hotel next door. 

Tons of pastries and bagels to choose from and an expansive coffee menu as well. The lines can move super slow at peak hours so be prepared to wait. The last time I stayed at CC I waited roughly 35 mins to place my order. And it's not due to slow workers, they are really understaffed. 

Solid 2 stars and gave them an extra 1 star for having maple doughnuts!

So disappointed!! This place use to have AMAZING food, but I haven't been in a few years and it has really gone down hill. I ordered the lunch Bento Box B, which is suppose to come with Miso soup. I had to ask for it at the end of my meal, and they no longer serve bean sprouts with their Miso soup. Their California rolls & kappa maki are good, and so is their tempura. But their Teriyaki chicken was bad. It use to be breaded and delicious, now it's plain and over cooked. Service wasn't great either, until near the end of the meal, when a new girl came on and she was good. We'll be visiting a different location after this experience.

Great service, and I come here every two days. Whenever I end up coming in and ordering there are several super friendly, cheerful baristas ready to craft me that perfect beverage. I have never had an issue here. I've order specialty creations I found on the internet, regular items, and have sometimes just said "Surprise ME!" to see what happens. Yum! 

Tip: The parking lot fills up at certain times, so you might want to do a mobile order to quickly run in and run out. I've used this service several times, have never been disappointed! It is also very convenient if you are on the way to work!

Would love to give this place a four but can't.  We heard so much and had high expectations.  First, it appeared they screwed up our reservation.  We ended up at the bar while the scrambled to get us a table.  The beers were great, no a huge selection, but of good quality.  I had the trout w/bacon and shrimp risotto.  Fish was bland, the the risotto was over powered with bacon.  My wife had gnochi, she said it was flavorful but was very soft.  Server was great, a short asian guy.

We will definitely give it another chance.

Another location to add to my favorites. They have a massive selection of teas and provide testers every day in case you can't decide! I really enjoy their orange black tea, but I'm currently drinking a raspberry peach green tea.. because I just can't decide! You can order various sizes, up to a 24ounce personal pot of tea! They also have smoothies, shakes, and hot chocolate. 
Wifi is available and so is electricity, so if you need to do homework and don't want your computer to die, have no fear! 
Parking is decent and the orange building should be easy to find! 
GF note- THEY HAVE GLUTEN-FREE CUPCAKES AND BROWNIES. YAY!

Called at 11am (when they open), was told they "can get me in at 3pm." I gave my name/number. If that isn't an appointment, IDK what is. 

I got there and there was no record of me on the books. The receptionist asked the male I spoke to on the phone and told him I called and made an appointment. He said I'm a walk-in and that he said on the phone that "he'd try to get me in." It would be a 35-40 minute wait. 

Thanks for inferring that I'm a liar and for wasting my time. In lieu of arguing for my scheduled appointment and having an awkward experience, I rather give my business to a considerate salon.

Ventured out to Somersett to try Sakana due to their yelp reviews. Unfortunately I'm not sure why they have such a high rating. 

Pros: decent sushi, slightly larger beer and wine selection than other sushi restaurants. 

Cons: slow service from sushi chefs and servers and it was not busy at all, fairly dirty glassware for beer, bathrooms outside business, located in Somersett. 

Would I return? Nope, way too far out of the way and not close to much anything else. If one were living in Somersett then Sakana would be okay but not worth the trip through tract housing for miles to reach otherwise.

Very nice and fairly newly built liquor store.  
I believe it used to be across the street from it's current location, in a much smaller and older run down building. 
It's now a much better looking and bigger store with some newer/updated and neat features - like a huge walk in cooler to retrieve cold beer and spirits.  
Considering the sheer size of the store, they seem to have everything you might possibly want or need - all things spirits and beyond.   It appears they have most brands that exist, and I can only assume at this point that if they didn't, they could get it for you.  
This store easily services the southside adequately.

Sorry..Just is not what it used to be.

Smelly fishy raviolis. Was explained to us the reason why they smelled was because sometimes they makes their Raviolis with Crab instead of Lobster or Shrimp. Ok..so then if you know this why would you make them with Crab in the first place and serve it? Dumb

Over cooked Chicken

Smaller portions.

Higher Prices

Cheaper ingredients.

Management doesn't seem to care as much as in the past.

 We have had too many disappointments here.

Collingswood with 3 terrific Italian places in 15 minutes away so...fatty says ADIOS Tarantella!

well amazingly, this still considered brand new place has steadily gone down hill every time we have tried it.

Now its just painful. 

The food is not near to what it was at Grand opening.
If someone does not want All you can Eat, the Ala cart menu will not satisfy. 
The owner does not seem to recognize they have problems here.

The service is terrible, again because no one speaks enough English to communicate. Food was served incorrectly, at the wrong time. It was so difficult to be a customer here. 

Personally, I have never experienced a place which had so much promise go from a must have to a never again.

Strange. We give it a year max.

Went here for lunch one day. My boyfriend and I both got the regular charburger with fries. He got a soft drink and I got a strawberry shake. First off, I thought the burger was juicy and I loved the grilled onions versus raw onions. The fries were decent. They didn't come with any seasoning/salt already on them but I liked that I could add salt to my personal preference. The strawberry shake was the perfect size and tasted great. Overall the service was quick, food was ready in just a few minutes. I can see why this place is so popular. To be able to sit outside and enjoy the nice weather while eating a tasty burger is the best!

I was really disappointed in my eating experience at Villa Barone. I always get mussels either red or white and they have always been my favorite. Last Friday we were greeted by a surly waiter who told us it was 'our loss' if we didn't want to hear or order the appetizers. When my mussels arrived the were tough, the sauce was so-so and many of the mussels were not opened. I told the waiter who was not very interested and I doubt he told the chef. What a disappointment. 

The has always been one of my favorite places I'm hoping it was an off night.

This wonderfully cozy spot used to be something else but for the life of me I cannot figure out what it used to be. Great spot for brunch. The menu is small but the food is delicious. They didn't have french toast to my liking so I got the cinnamon buns and ate them as I would french toast or waffles - with warm syrup. I also ordered their grits. Menu said they came with shrimp but mines was just topped with collard greens. Huge disappointment but I had a few bites and it wasn't worth finishing. Overall the drinks were great and everyone else enjoyed their food.

White pizza okay. Cheese pizza ordered w pepperoni, had no pepperoni . When I called and explained pepperoni was missing, she said to bring it back so they could see there's no pepperoni . 
Why would I lie about pepperoni ?! 
I told her no, I would not drive all the way back in 6 o clock traffic, she pretty much said oh well too bad. No other help or suggestion, other than show us the pizza. 

Acting as if I were making up a story made me angrier than no pepperoni . 
There are way too many pizza places out for way less money!!, to have crappy customer service skills!!

There are way too many pizza places out for way less money!!, to have crappy customer service skills!!

We were traveling to FL the day after Christmas, so we knew to expect long lines for security and car rental. When we arrived at the Thrifty/Budget car rental counter at the airport, my heart fell. The line seemed a mile long.  However, we moved through the line faster than I expected. They had four or five agents working.  When it was our turn, we had a nice, friendly agent who apologized for the wait and even gave us a free upgrade. These public-facing customer service positions are such a challenge right now. I really appreciated her positive attitude. Way to go, Thrifty.

Price for lunch $12
Pasta 
Drink
1 Garlic Bread Pizza 
Side Salad

Very low key place if you dont want a large crowd around. You, must try the Shrimp Italiano nice size shrimp,fried beef,light (crawfish boil) spicy creamy sauce, over spaghetti; one of my favorite pasta. I just wish they could add more shrimp. Cafe Roma Garlic Bread Pizza, OMG is to die for just the right amount of everything. 

Just a fyi, this is the only Cafe Roma that sells these items.
Picture was take after I had eaten most of my food. The lunch plate was a decent amount for $12

This is the location that I use when my grandparents ask me to pick them up Whoppers for dinner. While it's a typical Burger King, I would have to say I've always received polite service and correct orders. 

The huge issue is how absolutely dangerous it is, trying to turn back on to Seminole Blvd. There is a bush planted right there by the road and it completely obstructs your view of oncoming traffic. So you're playing chicken, nudging out, trying to see if the coast is clear. That bush really needs to be removed.

I was in a rare mood and couldn't resist the idea of a roast beef sandwhich and curly fries, when I saw the Arby's sign. 

It was lunch rush when I pulled in, to place an order for lunch for myself and my daughter. I was in line for a bit, but I got the impression the car in front of me was being a pain. Nonetheless, the gal that took my order was super friendly and polite. When I got to the window, our food and drinks were handed out promptly after processing our payment. 

Food was hot, fresh, and service was polite. No complaints here!

The queen of drive thru highly approves! 

Line moved quickly, order is spot on, and staff very polite. But something really stuck out to me and made my day...

When I approached the window, I was greeted by a young man with special needs. He was clearly in training, as I listened to the team leader talking him thru things. He did fantastic, but what really made my heart happy was listening to how patient she was with him during a very hectic, busy Monday morning. 

As a mom of a special needs boys, this makes my day. Coffee and kindness...what a way to start this Monday!

You pay what you get for. I visit this site during work hours usually for my break, which is any of the peak times between 11 am and 2 pm. Everyone and their mom and their mom's cat are at this place. I don't find the equipment hogs like I do at other locations. The area is pretty tight, not much room, but there's a plethora of cardio equipment - not so much for lifting. 

Everyone's got an ego  here, dunno why. Don't let it deter you, though. The locker rooms are "ok", clean but this place is a bit depressing.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
So, I won't give this a one. I'm giving it a two because they did well on alterations and fixing work pants for myself and my fiancé.

went in for my last time to pick up a comforter I dropped off. Received the comforter back with black spots and a stench -- a cross between mildew and wet dog. At first I thought one of the cats had urinated in the closet (I hung the comforter, covered in plastic, and left it there for two weeks). It wasn't the closet or a cat... it was the stench from the comforter. And it cost me like $50!

Needless to say, I won't be going back again for major dry cleaning only alterations.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: We used to get take out here regularly, but stopped after we saw the quality of the food decline.  I recently gave them a try again and had food delivered.  The delivery was on time (you pay a delivery fee if $3 in addition to the tip).  The potions are good and the vegetables looked fresh, but the rice was stale and discolored.  My family style tofu lacked flavor which was disappointing.  The veggie spring rolls were good but the chicken sticks looked unappetizing (think they were over cooked, as they were very dark) and were a bit dry.  Good food is hard to find in Pottstown, but the quality here just isn't what it used to be.

This Giant is convenient because it is so close to Target, but I personally prefer the one on the other side of town.  I don't like it that they started selling beer and wine and find the isles to be lacking labels on a regular basis.  It can get overwhelming.  I have also found one of my go-to items miss labeled/expired on multiple occasions.  I used to let them know when I was checking out, but have stopped since it did not seem to make a difference.  They do some nice find raising activities and always have something for kids to do, like a coloring station or the make-your-own card station for special holidays, so that is something.

I was only here overnight but had a great experience overall. This is a gorgeous hotel from the time you walk in, to the rooms, to the views. It is extremely clean and well kept. Whether you have a water side view or view of downtown Tampa, you will not be disappointed. The only drawback is valet is $28 per day overnight. They use the same garage that is self parking for $12 a day which is a much better deal in my opinion. It is not a far walk at all either. Highly recommend this hotel based on location and modern decor/cleanliness.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I was not impressed at all. First of all there is one table in the whole restaurant with 30 seats so you have to sit with other people either way. Second, I asked to substitute fried rice for steamed white rice and was told no. Meanwhile the people next to us brought their OWN crabs in and were allowed to eat them at the table !!!! Why ??? Last, my meal was not served as advertised and when the dessert came I was STILL left with my meal sitting in front of me. It was never taken away and I wasn't offered a box. Not that I wanted a box, but take meal away at least! My family really enjoyed their sushi but I wouldn't return.

A great little Starbucks located in Scotia Place. It's a smaller store than most Starbucks location but if you are a Starbucks addict this will hit the spot. 

The baristas are friendly and quick with drink order and the drinks are always hot. The seating is limited and so is the merchandise however they have the basics. Coffee, K-cups, Travel Mugs, etc. This Starbucks also has the standard baked goods for sale. This location also provides "drink" samples for customers to try something new. 

If I'm downtown again and need a Starbucks fix I would definitely stop by again.

I love this bar. It's far enough removed from the beach so you don't get the typical 'frat boy' beach crowd, drinks are cheaper than all the popular beach bars, and I adore the bartenders Johnny and Mark. They're sarcastic and funny and treat you like a friend. The crowd is younger and it's always lively on the weekends. Smoking permitted, there's 1 pool table, 1 dart board, and a couple arcade golf consoles. It's laid back and comfortable, and it has a pizza place next door open til 4 for those late night munchies. Thanks guys!

This location has good seating and I'm usually able to find a chair quite quickly. However, I don't go here anymore because the Internet has consistently been slow. I don't get it, but 3/3 times the connection was ridiculously snail-like and I ended up leaving to go to the other Starbucks across town, where I had no problems. I don't go here anymore because I don't want to risk waiting in their long lines, getting a chair, setting up, and then discovering I can't even make any progress because their internet is frozen solid. Now I'll either stay home to work or go to another location.

Amazing! Literally my new favorite Italian place. The atmosphere is wonderful, cozy and warm. The food was out of this world and the portions definitely don't disappoint. The red sauce that's provided with bread for dipping tastes fresh and homemade. Penne a la Vodka with added chicken was rich and flavorful. The Pasta Carbonara is a must, I think I want to get this every time I go! Even the side salad included with entree was delicious. Looking forward to another visit. Server was a tad short and looked like she was in the weeds, but won't stop me from loving this place. Mangia!

As far as coffee goes it stands by its name and brand image. May be expensive but worth every penny. My favorite part is the extreme consistency they provide you. I can order a drink a 100 times from them and it will taste exactly the same 100 times straight. Whereas I can order same drink 100 times from Dunkin donuts and it will taste different 95 times with 15 of those times I need to force it down just so my 2.50$ doesn't go to waste. 

If you are looking for quality and consistency then pull out your wallet and head to Starbucks

My shopping partner and I stopped stopped in here for a burger this week.  I have driven by The Happy Cow thousands of times so it was time to stop.  The restaurant had 8 tables of diners.  I would guess that we were the only "unknowns".  The waitress spoke to each person by name.  I was waiting for "Norm" to come through the door. I would guess the average age of the customers was in the late 70s.  The waitress was very attentive and very pleasant.  Our deluxe burgers were good and the price of $5.00 was very fair.  I would much rather give this place the business than a chain restaurant.  We will go again.

I only come here for the salmon sashimi and green tea ice cream because they are so good here! Everything else is okay to good. I do like some of their special rolls and Kani salads though. However, service is always just okay. Sometimes you wait around a lot even if it's not super busy.

I would recommend if you like sashimi and always do buffet in my opinion it's more worth the money. If none of the above apply then other sushi restaurants will be better for you. 

Price is currently $24 per person, it used to be $20 and it seems like the buffet menu got a little smaller.

Such a chill bar! Fountain Porter is a no frills place, with a decent beer menu and affordable drinks and food! I mean where else can you get a $5 burger out that isn't fast food? The patty was small in size, but flavorful. Menu is limited, less than 10 items but that's what makes this place what it is. It's simple, hipster, and to the point with a focus really on their beer. Just FYI the pickle chips are slices of pickle, I originally thought it was going to be fried pickle slices. If you're looking for a chill day or night and you're in the neighborhood, this is definitely a place to take a look at especially if you're into beer.

My wife and I have used this place a hand full of times and if you really want your car washed use the bug station and prewash your whole car then pay $10 to wash off the prewash lol its that  bad!!  You get out and only half the car is washed on one side!! Every time the drivers side isn't washed!! Don't even think about asking to run it threw again on the house BC it didn't work the first time!! With so many other options just on vets alone. I live 3 blocks behind here and I still drive somewhere else now!!

I am a long time Starbucks customer and I usually go 5-7 times a week. I use the mobile app almost every time and they still manage to get it wrong. I rarely get an acknowledged when I come in and I always always say "thank you and have a good day." I would say 1 in 20 times someone looks up with a half interest and then goes back to what they are doing. I go anywhere from 6am to 3pm and it's always the same. There was one guy working the register Sunday who was very personable.... hire more of him! I would almost rather pay the 20% upcharge at the airport just because they are friendly and always get my drink right!

Really it's McDonald's. Not much that can go wrong with the order because it's the same menu you have as every other location. But I walked in here and there was only one other person ahead of me who had already ordered and we waited a bit for her order and then I waited for my coffee and muffin to be handed to me. It's McDonald's. They are not making the muffins fresh in the back. The woman t the counter looked flustered and that doesn't help. It's not a busy place so really just calm down and let those of us who are in the place wanting a quiet coffee in a Sunday morning enjoy it. Next time - I'll just do the drive thru.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We had a family dinner for 6. The warm bread was crusty and great with either olive oil or butter. We tried a few of the appetizers although I can't remember the names which are in Italian. The buffalo mozzarella, antipasto, and smoked meat were very tasty. The dinner entrees were outstanding. The pasta is freshly made and well seasoned. The portion sizes are perfect. The wood fire pizzas had thin crust and ideal proportions of sauces and cheese. We'll definitely be back. The service was attentive without interrupting the flow of our conversations.

We tried this for dinner on Sunday night.  It was not very crowded or noisy.  It was clean and had a nice interior.  We split the pork ravioli as an appetizer and the white margherita pizza for dinner.  The food was very good.  The pizza was definitely the right size for sharing.  Although it's on the menu as a personal pizza size, it would've been too much for one person.  Rick was our server.  He was very attentive and helpful.  Rick did bring us some delicious and hot crusty bread when he felt that our appetizer had been delayed too long.  I would definitely go back because there are other items on the menu that I'd like to try.

This place is a train wreck.     We ordered 3  bowls of ceviche but when we got home we discovered they gave us shrimp cocktail instead.  We called,  no problem mistakes happen.  We were told save our receipt for next time we were in.    I have now been sitting in their restaurant for 30 minutes, counting flies and code violations,  waiting for them to find someone who has the authority to fix the order .   For Christ sake,  just take care of your customer it was only a $35 order.    Sad thing is,  if they ever get a manager on the phone,  there is no way I'm eating it.

The Aloft Downtown Tampa is a great hotel in a perfect location right on the Riverwalk in the downtown area. I would recommend this spot for travelers of all types. Tampa is really growing into a neat city, and this hotel is right near a lot of the cultural action in the area. The staff is attentive and very helpful. The pool deck area is great for relaxing or swimming for the kids, and the bar area is a trendy spot for a happy hour drink and appetizer. The hotel is minimal, clean, and has a great vibe. Overall, I had a wonderful stay, and I recommend this hotel for any Tampa visit.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Never!!!i normally rent from national it's easy!   Hertz...not at Stl.  Only reason was because nat'l wAs sold out (duh).  No signage on where to meet the shuttle.  I ended up canceling my car because everything I find said I had to pick up off site (not a shuttle).snwde up with budget..yeah...getting on their bus and I see a hertz shuttle????? Too late. I already canceled.  If I was hertz for the business travelers who do not use the airport stations...I would damn well make sure they knew where to get the shuttle...seriously.  Youlost a rental credit because of bad signage?

Poor service and blah baristas today. Line was 7 people long with 3 uninterested baristas working the front counter. I ordered my usual grande iced tea poured over a Trenta cup full of ice and was advised they were out of all Trenta sized cups. No "I'm sorry we're all out."  Just a matter-of-fact statement, "We're all out."
 
Disappointing to say the least that there exists such a vast inconsistency in the local, individual Starbucks stores when it comes to staffing guidelines, product availability, and barista friendliness/customer focus.

Stayed here on business this week. The hotel is located only 2 miles from the airport and is right in the middle of a whole bunch of other hotels.  

The Hotel is just about ready to undergo a full renovation, it is needed.  The hotel is a very late 70s / 80's scheme.   The hotel is clean and the rooms have all new linens and amenities.  

There is a pool that is both indoor and outdoor.  It goes through the glass wall. Very cool.  

The staff is friendly and quick.  This place will be really nice after the renovation.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
First timer at Sushi House and was impressed!
It had a nice, open atmosphere but the seating arrangements provided an intimate setting as well. The service was friendly, professional, and timely. They even give you complimentary candy with your check. That's always a plus ;) We ordered a few rolls (see photos) and each were delicious! My personal favorite that I've tried so far is probably the Geist Roll with the Sushi House Roll coming in at a close second. Their menu is fairly large with many different options to choose from. I can't wait to come back and try more! Sushi House, you've successfully won a returning customer.

One of the most important things for me when traveling is whether the room is quite or not. Despite being right next to a small airport and a busy road, the room was incredibly quite. The bed was comfortable and the blanket and sheets, clean and soft, not bare thread thin like so many hotels. 
The price was reasonable and its location was easy to get to from the Tampa airport. Staff was pleasant and helpful. Location near a number of fast food and sit down restaurants is a major plus. Would have no problem recommending this hotel to friends.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I just bought my glasses from here. The lenses get smudges on them which require a lot of cleaning. I only use the cloth I was given to wipe them. I think they messed up the coating that they put on the lenses. When I go to the store to complain about this issue, they argue with me instead of fixing it. They flat out don't do returns. They say they'll fix any problem you have, but instead of fixing it, they argue. The new management of MyEyeDr has really changed the tone of what used to be St Charles Vision.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Main reason they are getting 3 stars is because the pizza is just so good. Lost 2 stars because I am not a germaphobe by any means but bathrooms that make me cringe is bad I can tell ya. Management should address this for sure and not just chuck it up to "well the building is old!" The ceiling fans have not been cleaned in well over a year...thank goodness they were off or the amount of dust balls that would fly off of them into your food would be unreal. Place needs a deep deep cleaning way more than it gets for sure.

Been married to an Italian woman is never easy especially when she tells you to go find some pizza. You know you have to find the best. So I remembered that Fortunato's had opened a new location next to our home so I decided to give him a shot. I went there order the pizza and it was done fairly quickly the staff was helpful and friendly. I took the pizza back home and let my wife Try it. Now I am in hero because the pizza was so amazing. I will definitely be going back in ordering much more pizza from them LOL

Would never go back. There are drive through car washes other than gas stations that are much better than this place. The Drive through part is as big as a gas station car wash, but is more costly! Took my car to this place came out with at least 3 scratches. Had to spend the entire time afterwards waxing the surface scratches out. Lady next to me asked me if 'I come here often'. I said no, she said because her car is still dirty. Translation, 'do they always do such a crapy job'. Spend 10 more minutes drive up the street and go to another wash.

I love Racanellis pizza! Real mozzarella. Perfect Italian high temp crust: charred, crisp on outside, with that New York style chewiness on the inside. Very good sauce, garlicky, not too sweet like many local sauces. My favorite toppings here are the Italian sausage crumbled fine and oozing with herbs and fennel, Margarita (tomato/fresh basil), or just a slice of plain cheese which they LOAD on top. A "slice" here is humongous! And somehow tastes better than out of a whole pizza The customer service here is basic and sometimes very slow, but it is worth it to me to get my NY style fix.

Somehow this place has remained in business and has the nerve to call themselves a hotel. Where should I start? Let's start with the fact they didn't have hot water the entire three days I was there. I actually left early and found a different hotel. Each time I asked about the water I was told it will be on in two hours. Two hours never came. Then the "city view" is a parking lot. The staff seemed to not care about anything. The silver lining I would say is I lost weight while staying there because I got food poisoning from the restaurant. Don't go I would recommend they house prisoners here instead.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This place should get at least 4 stars!
The place is nice and clean with a classic style. It's BYOB so you better bring your wine, because the food came out a bit long. However the food is good! It's not perfect but the taste is there. I try a bit of this and that. And loves almost everything. Definitely you have to try their veals and steak! Desserts were good also. We had fabulous dinner with our team. Service was great! Will be back.
The only reason i took 1 star is because the food came too long and the have only 1 restroom (1 room only)

I bought 1 month unlimited member for $ 24.99. Its a very good deal. U can attend classes, unless sweat x. However, you can go to another sweat fitness with your membership.

 I just came 2 times so far, and try their barre class. The class it self was good, but the room is bit dirty. And the wood flour is worst, better not take your shoes off if you dont wanna get the wooden string in your feet

I was about to bring my sob and bring it to the kids room. Lucky i tried to see it first today. It was smells bad. Like poop??? And looks like the air circulation is not good too. Well just try to inspect it first before you put your child there
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I just left Debbie's Salon and I am impressed. I am a very picky woman who pays attention to detail, and she hit the nail on the head! 

She took her time, didn't make me feel rushed, she gave me a beautiful color, cut and style, and it seemed effortless! She is a natural at what she does and I highly recommend her! 

The prices are very competitive and fair! I felt like my money was well worth what I got! 

Not only is she good at doing hair, shes also very sweet, professional and kind. 

The salon is immaculately clean and inviting! Definitely go see Debbie, you wont regret it! Im definitely going back!

I really wanted to give this restaurant a good review......I really did.  Especially since the service was great.  But I just can't.  If you like good italian food...........do NOT go here!  The food is okay......at best.

My husband ordered the Le Pappardelle Di Portofino and it was just okay.  The penne was good, but the chicken was gamey, tough and overcooked.  I ordered the rigatoni alla bolognese and it was HORRIBLE!  I make better meat sauce at home and it tasted and smelled like Chef Boyardee.  

Pros
Good service
Late night kitchen - open til 11pm on a Sunday

Cons
Cold bread
Food is just not very tasty
Overpriced for what you get

If you acknowledge it's not going to be walmart prices, this is a great grocery chain! Have an very large selection of organic products (which they segregate all in one area to your left as you walk in). Makes it easy to know where to look for those hard-to-find items. 

Rest of the store has a good selection and the store branded products are both cheap and high quality. The fresh meats and seafood in the back are drool-worthy and my wife and I have thoroughly enjoyed all of the steaks we've gotten from here. 

Probably the best perk, though, is that you get 5% off for every $300 you spend (which is actually pretty quick). That adds up!

Shocked its still open..Could be the worst restaurant that we have ever been to. Being an Italian citizen and know food I long to see good Italian restaurants here in Franklin. I went again to check it out because I thought they might have changed recipes or owners. The food is just awful..(look at other reviews to understand). The breads are hard, the food is overcooked, the seafood is unedible because its so fishy,etc.. My wife never returns or refuses to eat and she can't stomach getting the food down here.. Never again until they change recipes, owners or BOTH.. Great location and just a waste..UGH

I got take out from here and was not disappointed! It's 5 mins from my house, delicious, and quick. Being pregnant I can't eat raw sushi, so I had the spider roll, shrimp tempura roll, and the banana peanut butter tempura roll (not the actual name but I can't remember what it's called) for dessert. Both shrimp and crab rolls were delicious and the banana roll was amazingly delicious. It was soggy from my drive home, but even soggy it was amazing so I can only imagine eating it in the restaurant. I will definitely be ordering from them again! I can't wait until I can eat raw sushi again - yummm!

This is my husband's favorite Mexican Restaurant in Indy. Honestly. La Mexigringa was my favorite, but they have closed. I decided to give this place a try, based on my husband's raving. He had talked it up so much I was expecting tacos like La Mexi Gringa, but I was so disappointed. I felt the steak wasn't fresh, and it had that old meat taste. I don't know if I had it in an odd day, but I was so disappointed. I'm willing to give them another chance. My hubby said their dinner menu is completely different too.

The food here is amazing. The salad, bread, and my lasagna. My husband got the chicken piccata, my son got the fettuccine Alfredo. Everything was fresh and amazing. Even though we were completely stuffed, we got dessert. My husband got the white chocolate raspberry cake, and I got the cheesecake. This was hands down the best cheesecake I've ever had. I plan on coming back to try something else, but sampled each of the other entrees and everything was wonderful. I'm only sorry now that it took this long for me to try it out. I would much rather have fresh wonderful food here, than from the chain down the street. We will definitely be back!

This is definitely my favorite diner in the area. I've came here many times for brunch, dinner, or late night cravings at 2 am. The diner opens 24/7, it's nothing fancy. 

The food is delicious, cheap, and it comes with a big portion. I'm a big fan of omelettes, their omelettes prices range between $5-$10, and they're huge omelettes. 

We got an omelette and pancakes this time. The omelette came with a side of potatoes or grits, and a side of toast or biscuit. I didn't even finish my food, I brought half of my omelette, potatoes and toast home in a box. 

I will be visiting this diner again just in a few days.

A excellent restaurant! My Wife and I are picky about sushi. It has to be fresh, presented well, and delicious. Our favorite use to be at Del Sol Casino, that is until we found this gem. Not only is the sushi better, the service is exceptional. We try something different each time and have not been disappointed. Susie, our waitress, remembered our names from the very first visit and always makes us feel welcomed. The sushi is not only tasty and beautiful, the portions are cut to an excellent size. Well worth finding in this complex, it is hard to see from the road.

i've been craving some really, really good mexican food. but does the greater st. louis area have any good mexican? no, not really. 

this restaurant has a great atmosphere! there was live karaoke and a nice waiter. however, one of the hostesses sat in the bathroom on her phone for about 30 minutes. just looked bad.

the food was alright. nothing was very special. the salsa didn't have much of a kick and the tortilla chips tasted store bought. the food was pretty average- was definitely nothing near authentic and it lacked a lot of that mexican flavor i was after. but nonetheless, this is still a fine restaurant.

Our server, Maria was wonderful. Very friendly and gave great service. Bread came complimentary but it was very plain. My boyfriend loved his chicken Parmesan, and I enjoyed my shrimp scampi (which I asked to be made because they don't have it on their menu which is shocking, but I'm glad they were able to accommodate). Our entrees also came with your choice of salad or soup; I chose a salad and my boyfriend got the clam chowder. He raved about the clam chowder and the server mentioned they make it on premises. We were tempted to try the tiramisu but we didn't have any room! I would go back.

I was so happy an El Limon opened right by my parents home! We have been to the locations in Ambler and Malvern and love it. The menu and the inside is no frills but the food is delicious and authentic. Also who can say no to free margaritas? I highly recommend the enchiladas with the mole sauce....I personally like getting the chorizo enchiladas... there's something about that hot Mexican sausage and chocolatey mole sauce. Yum! I'm only giving 4 stars for this visit because the server didn't check up on us until we were practically finished our meals and he didn't offer dessert. Other than that, he was very friendly and the food is delicious!

Nice hotel friendly staff but they should get their own room service kitchen. They use the ritz and because both phones in our room were out had to use a cell. Called the number in our room and ordered. Well 2 hours later the manager blames me for not specifying what hotel I was at. Oh and this was our meal before we got married so messed up our whole day. Room service manager keeps saying its on its way. Going on 2.5 hours.long story short. Don't order room service unless you like being talked to by rude people who you are paying their paycheck.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Was my first day in my new job as the assistant to COO of an important lawfirm in Wilmington DE. My first responsibility was to pickup coffee and biscottis for an important meeting this morning. 3 Caramel Mocciottos with light cream no sugar and 2 black dark roast extra sugar. And instead I got to work with 5 hot tea's. And got fired too so to say I'm never going to return to any Starbucks is an under statement. They we're all very nice when I got there but there incompetence to correctly get my order right makes me wanna give up on drinking coffee all together.  I'm soooooooo depressed.....

I went to the nail salon to get my eyebrows waxed. The service cost $8. I have visited in the past. The place is now called Britney Nail Salon. The person that normally does my eyebrows was on vacation. Typically I have great service, this time was different. They are doing renovations in the salon. 

They only had two staff which were busy and only one could do eyebrows. Since they were. Since they were busy I left and did some nearby shopping. I can back and they were ready. The person who did my eyebrows did an okay job.

Worst experience. Employee wouldn't listen. Asked for 'hot tea with milk' and she kept saying we don't have 'black tea.'  She couldn't even tell me what kind of tea they had. Then she said they have no bagels .... so what else do you have? Seriously, order was for three things and she couldn't comprehend two of them. Drove up to the window and she's banging around and throwing things. Too early to start my day off bad, I went somewhere else. Time to get better team members that listen and treat customers better. Wouldn't fly where I work.

Decent pizza for the price. Tried the Sicilian pie and asked for it to be cooked extra well done as I saw another person order pizza this way. By the looks of some of the pictures the pizza looked really good so I ordered the same thing. I picked up and live 5 minutes away. Pizza was very hot, cooked as asked. Tomato sauce was decent, not anything to brag about. Decent out of cheese, but could have used just a little bit more flavor. However, compared to completion in the area, it's better than most. Customer service was friendly as well. Worth a try if any area.

The food is great but service is horrible. Immediately upon entering we were ignored. Staff continued to ignore us until the exact moment we were given a table 20 minutes later. Food took forever and server wasn't friendly. The food itself was delicious. Highly recommend their salt and pepper tofu and eggplant. We also tried their vegetable fried rice and one of the veggie pots. Both were incredibly good and portions were huge. We still eat here but because of the terrible service we only get take-out. For dine in we prefer Chopstix on Fletcher.

I cannot speak for the entire Publix, but this location is not near my house and I pass probably 3-4 others just to use the Pharmacy.  The 3 people that I have had the pleasure of dealing with have been amazing.  My wife has some medical issues, along with being pregnant (high risk) so I am making medication runs 1-2 a month.  They are always honest with us, they're incredibly friendly to my 3 young sons when they're with me and I appreciate they aren't just pushing pills - they care about what they're doing.  I'm a fan for life.

My husband and I came in today around 4:15 pm, attempting to purchase a donut as we both have never had Dunkin Donuts before. The inside of the store was empty, no customers and no employees. We waited, and waited some more. We called out hello to the back of the store, and waited. Well, I don't know if anyone actually works here besides the one girl who told us to wait after we had already waited almost ten minutes for her to make her appearance to the front of the store, but she prioritized the drive thru which had just pulled up and that's when I decided to take our business elsewhere. Why does Reno have such horrible service?!

I would rate Bar Taco a solid 4 based on their food and decor, however, we did the call ahead and it still took them over an hour to seat us. It was very annoying because we had a party of 6 and they continually broke down the larger tables to seat 2 at a time seating people that came way after we did.  The decor is cool and trendy, the falafal taco was surprisingly my favorite, the jalapeno margarita is a great match. If this place will start taking reservations via opentable I would recommended it and go back. Although i think the tacos are better than Green Lemon, until they get their act together, that's where i will be!

I will give 5 stars for the environment, the fun toys, and Carol who is the owner... She is amazing. She handles the kids nicely, she is engaging and fun to talk to as well and you can tell she is experienced. She makes sense of my daughters crazy hair. My daughter has very fine hair, which is sometimes straight, sometimes curly and sometimes wavy, and Carol is able to advice me on how to get it cut and style it. They lost a star for the other haircutters who work for her who unfortunately aren't so experienced. But Carol will always understand if you are not satisfied and will call you in for a fix.

This place is fabulous! From the moment we got here, we were greeted with very friendly helpful attentive employees. The gal who checked us in was very nice. Our room, was awesome! Really nice view & bed was super comfy! Lobby is small but done up really nice. Perfect location, within walking distance of a lot of activities. Will definitely stay here again if we ever come back to New Orleans. :) Oh, and also, Chelsay at the concierge desk was very friendly & super helpful. Had a bunch of knowledge & suggested a few places for us to try.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Food was pretty tasty, as usual. Unfortunately they got my boyfriend's sandwhich wrong. He asked for no pickle no onions & got extra pickle extra onions on his Big Mac. 

He brought it back, they were really nice about it & fixed it right away. I just think that the cashier needs to pay closer attention the first time to avoid these mistakes because if we were going through drive thru & didn't notice til we hot home I think we would have been very upset. 

Also, the lobby was very dirty! It appeared as tho they haven't swept or mopped the floors all day & the tables were dirty as well.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Came in because it was pretty late & we just wanted a quick bite. My Fiance originally wanted a Shamrock shake, but the girl said they were out of it & weren't selling it anymore. But when we happened to notice the tubes for the shakes, one of them had green liquid in it. So we asked what that was & we were told oh that's mint but we haven't had it since before St Patricks Day! Can u say GROSS!! What the hell!! Do u not clean the shake machine at all??!?! Needless to say, we will probably find another McD's to go to! Not to mention the lobby was pretty dirty as well! Very disappointing!! :(
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Having just moved into the neighborhood, this is very conveniently located for all my grocery needs. They have a seperate section each for beverages and fresh fruits and vegetables. The layout is very aesthetically pleasing and items are easy to locate.

As a bonus, you can also get fresh coffee and a selection of meats. The store is a bit pricey compared to other grocery stores, but if you're in the need for supplies and can't drive further out to a cheaper store, then this place is perfect. The staff is very helpful.

I'm always hanging around Ybor enjoying cigars, beer, paired with the atmosphere and each time I always end it with getting a popsicle from The Hyppo! What makes this spot unique and interesting is that you are paying for something natural and authentic that is truly made from fruits and of course not filled with artificial sugars! If you thought popsicles were not healthy, give this place a try. Their menu is pretty diverse and will leave you thinking for minutes on what popsicle to get, this is not your regular cherry or chocolate type of deal!

Popped in here with no appt on a holiday weekend and they were able to seat 3 of us next to each other right away. $35 cash mani/pedi, $40 if you pay by card. The pedi was really not good, the scrubs they used where rougher than usual and rubbed my skin raw. I was squirming in my seat during this. I asked the girl to not cut my cuticles, just push them back. When I got to the mani she skipped my cuticles all together, and the filing was so poor that jagged edges of my nails kept clipping my clothes and other fabrics. The polish on my nails chipped within the first two day, I can do them better myself.

Can't beat this place.  We are big fans of Berryism (I love their regular vanilla) but Chill does the place better and is kid friendly.  They have a good rotating selection and are always friendly ready to serve you.  We get coupons all the time and we have their card to get discounts.  Great place to bring the kiddos for a treat.  Although there are other places in town that are good, this place does it right with service, cleanliness and a kids corner with toys and videos.  My daughter loves it there.  Great job guys!  Keep those coupons out there!!  We go there more than we would without the coupons!

This facility is so convenient to where I live and is very cheap.

HOWEVER, they do a POOR job of maintenance, especially the elliptical machines. For months I have been complaining about the electronics not working. Last week I called for the manager, I was polite and asked that she call me back to discuss the problems, never called. I then sent her an email, no response. Again this weekend I complained that of 15 elliptical machines, 12 of the screens, TV's or sound did not work. They keep saying they have a "work order", but never get this stuff fixed.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Food and service was great! My fiancé and I each ordered an entree from their daily special menu and we couldn't be happier. The food was very flavorful and servings was just enough. We were full when we left we did also have their calamari appetizer and pistachio almond and bourbon gelato for dessert. We both enjoyed everything we had and will be dining here again. I didn't mention that the waiter was very knowledgeable about the food and helped us make our decision on what to order, being that it was our first time dining here.

I've bought tires for both my car and my wife's car from Tire Pros. They're very accommodating and quick with their work. They include free tire rotations throughout the life of the tires, and if you buy the road side hazard insurance, they will replace a flat tire no questions asked. My wife has gotten nails in the sidewalls of two tires, and TirePros replaced both tires, no problem. Well worth the $$ for the road side hazard.

The only thing that they messed up once was they put a tire on my wife's car with the tread backwards, but they fixed that for free.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I don't get why they don't get good reviews.Years ago, I wasn't crazy about them, but recently, we've ordered 2 pan pizzas in a week.We loved them! The sauce was like what Pizza Hut USED to make (years ago)&THIS pizza was REALLY GOOD! Good crust, GREAT sauce & NO BURN! Though a bit small (but it WAS only $7.00), we really liked it and will go back again-in fact - was hard to get a parking spot cuz so many ppl were there.LOVE their pizza! P.S.I Yelp every so often - so I'd never lie.Some good-some-not so much-I look to Yelp to find good things too.I truly liked this pizza.

Drove from uptown to try this place out because I love Italian food, and I was not disappointed. Fantastic. Everything was fresh and cooked to perfection, and the service was great. 

We started with a pizza margherita. It was amazing- perfect thin crust, perfect amount of sauce/cheese. 

For my entree I had eggplant parmesan. Eggplant was lightly breaded and perfectly fried-The perfect thin slices. Pasta was fresh and cooked al dente. My boyfriend had the shrimp and artichoke pappardelle pasta. The shrimp were large and in a delicious lemon butter sauce. Again, pasta was perfectly cooked. 

Kudos to the chef. We will be back.

Not up to what we've come to expect from Marriott.
* Staff is friendly and helpful 
* Clean, except for breakfast. 
* Room is poorly laid out. Air conditioner (images) blows is the face of the guest in the right side of the bed - making a restful sleep difficult.
Couch in the room is very uncomfortable - It looks and feels like the primary function of it is for appearance. Room feels confining. 
* Decor ans Art is an ok choice; however, of poor quality and lacks variety. The art and decor do not present a unifying theme.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
If your a light to medium sleeper don't come here..

A nice place to stay, rooms were comfortable. Several things are right, however, one major drawback is the noise. The hotel is set up with exterior rooms and interior (atrium) rooms.
