We stayed in an interior room, every noise that was made in the atrium echoed and came in our room. Little noise dampening was on the wall, door and window that separates the room from the atrium.  I was woke up at 6 am by people walking by our room having a conversation,  additionally this was added to by children screaming in the atrium, I don't know if they were in the pool, it's in the atrium...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Heaven Sent is the most honest repair shop that I have EVER been to in my life. They are honest and take incredible care of my car. I go to them for everything including tires. They always get me a better price than anyone else. I just had my 90,000 mile maintenance on my Volvo with a new timing belt put in. I would only trust HS Auto to do this. They finished in great time and the costs was MUCH lower than expected. Jody, Chuck and Sydney are complete professionals who I feel really care about myself and my car. I am so grateful to have found Heaven Sent
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Ordered lunch to go from here the other day. I used to come all the time when it was Jeannie's. I ordered a Greek salad with chicken, and my husband got a cheeseburger. Both aren't anything too fancy, but we both agreed we have had better. 

For a "family style restaurant" I was disappointed there didn't have a soup and salad lunch combo. The Greek salad was loaded with lots of "stuff." There was no green peppers, but Greek dolmades, lots of chickpeas, and beets that needed to be rinses and strained. My salad quickly turned pink from all the beets. To order take out lunch it around $20 (said by my husband who picked it up and paid).

I had actually never been to Walt's until this past year and finally decided to give them a try. I ordered a Bacon Cheeseburger and Fries and it was less than satisfactory. The taste, texture, everything. It was like eating a rubber toy with playdough. I decided to give them another shot and ordered take-out.  I didn't even want to finish my meal. As of today Walt's has left a bad taste in my mouth..literally and figuratively. The only upside is the large parking area and the renovations done to the building. Maybe next year.

So we wanted to branch out and try some new restaurants and we ran across Wasabi. We'd never heard of it before and just happened to drive by it. It's a bit out of the way but the parking was easy. The price for all you can eat sushi was lower than any other place we've found. The sushi menu was rather limited. The service was good though. The food was anticlimactic. Not bad, just a little bland. The interesting thing was a sushi roll called the Krispy Kreme. Deep fried and drizzled with some sort of mayo sauce and chocolate sauce. It shouldn't have worked, but it did. The view of the mountains is incredible from the big windows at the front.

Went to this location for the first time; it wasn't bad but I'm unsure if I'd be back. I didn't get an alcoholic ice cream so maybe that's why it wasn't the greatest. I believe I had a mint chip cone and it was not worth the amount it cost. I really didn't enjoy it at all. The prices are pretty expensive, especially for alcoholic ice cream. I got a small PBR Coffee to go, I think a pint maybe, and it was like $15+. I have yet to open it but I'm hoping it's better than what I had when I visited. The place itself looked really nice though

Some of the worst service at a fast food restaurant I've ever encountered. Everything from being just plain ignored to somehow making it my fault that they didn't realize I wanted all of the usual trimmings on my burger combo. They don't ask and if you don't tell them, they hand you a piece of meat on a bun. Don't go out of your way to go this one. They really just don't seem to care.  My review is based on 11 years experience with this particular Wendy's just down the road from my house and I must say, it's always been bad.

I came here with a colleague for lunch. The atmosphere is quite cozy... the decorations make it feel like Christmas all year round, which I absolutely adored. 

They have a lunch menu with select salads, personal pizzas, entrees and sandwiches which are decently priced. 

I ordered a cup of the lobster bisque and the crab and shrimp pizza. The lobster bisque was great, good thickness and flavor. The pizza was a good size and I had leftovers. I felt that the pizza lacked serious flavor. Additionally, service was on the slow side even with hardly anybody in the restaurant. 

I would give it a second chance.

Note: This review cannot be compared to Japanese on the east or west coast or Hawaii or even Albuquerque. This is specific to Tucson only. If compared to coast cities this place would not place. 

For Tucson this is one of the better Japanese restaurants especially around central Tucson. The staff is very friendly and food is good. I tend to stay away from fried food here as the non-fried food is better. Their donburi is ok (for ramen/noodles or donburi I'd suggest Ikkyu). Their sushi is decent as the rice is seasoned correctly. As they get a good customer base the food seems fresh.

We went in on a Saturday night around 5 and it was about 1/3 full. Ordered a famous sausage pizza ,wings and a Cuban panini.  Wings came first 12 big wings for $10 and they were quite good. I'm kind of a wings purist preferring wings that are not breaded....these were but they were cooked perfect and tasty. The pizza was also really good but after eating most of the wings I could only manage a slice. The panini was a real winner loaded with pork and ham grilled to perfection. I've been here before but this was my favorite time

Have to say, I was a little apprehensive when I pulled up to the place- being at the bottom of the complex, but I was pleasantly surprised.  My order was To-go, and the staff was very friendly and answered all my questions on the phone.  My order included a Meat Skillet, which was fabulous.  The cheese and potatoes was perfectly blended on top.  My only issue was I said no onions and there were a few; not enough to ruin the meal. Also, I got an order of turkey bacon and it could have been cooked a little bit more. Overall, a good place and I plan on adding Chef V. in the rotation when I want breakfast and I would definitely recommend them.

Meh... nothing special... stayed three nights...this is a lower end Hilton property.  The hotel is awkwardly constructed with a parking lot quite a long hike away from the hotel front entrance and then another long hike to our room.  Hotel keys kept deactivating so we had to make several trips back and forth from our room to front desk and back to our rooms again.  Maid service did not come on the 2nd day.  Only positives were a friendly breakfast staff and decent location close to KOP Mall.  The property is underwhelming.  There are better options in the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I saw some great reviews on this place, but agreed with a few others. Very slow/no service. We waited at least 15 minutes until we flagged the hostess down that no one had come by or even walked to the corner where we were. After that, the drinks food came out quickly. My husband ordered the Hacienda platter and loved it. I ordered brisket street tacos which were a little underwhelming. The brisket tasted very vinegary (braising process?). The house margarita was super tasty. Overall, I'd like to give them another chance, but no brisket tacos next time.

I saw some great reviews on this place, but agreed with a few others. Very slow/no service. We waited at least 15 minutes until we flagged the hostess down that no one had come by or even walked to the corner where we were. After that, the drinks food came out quickly. My husband ordered the Hacienda platter and loved it. I ordered brisket street tacos which were a little underwhelming. The brisket tasted very vinegary (braising process?). The house margarita was super tasty. Overall, I'd like to give them another chance, but no brisket tacos next time.

Sometimes coming into these places you're greeted by "coffee snobs" and you feel uncomfortable immediately. Not the experience here!

The staff was really great- knowledgable & personable. 
I had the Bourbon Caramel Latte & thought it was delicious! It was lukewarm, I could have used it a bit warmer, but the flavor was there. I appreciated that the flavors were noticeable but not overpowering. 
My husband got an Oolong tea- pretty sure he's never even had tea before! He actually really enjoyed it and that's a big deal!

Decor was rustic/trendy, pretty cool. 

If we're ever back in the STL, we'd come back!

It was my first time ordering here . The service is great . Rosaire is very nice however when I got home I noticed the fish had an after taste as if it was spoiled. I had to throw it out  . I thought it was just me being sensitive to smell but when my boyfriend had it he said the fish was spoiled after one bite  . It seems as if the fish was left out or maybe the fridge is broken and then the fish was fried . I was looking forward to giving a great review just for the service alone but I have to be honest about the food . The picklies is also different ....I can't quite put my finger on it but it's not authenticate .

Had been hearing so many good things about this restaurant. People have recommended the chicken and waffles but I ordered shrimp and grits/eggs. The shrimp were HUGE and had a creole spicy sauce to it. The grits where a little too thick for my liking maybe because of the cheese. This dish probably wouldn't be on my list to get again because I basically paid 20 dollars for 6 shrimp and wasted the rest of my dish. I do believe this place has great potential and I love the setting and not to mention the mimosa and Bloody Mary bar they have available

Pretty good for a McDonald's. This location has the updated look to make it like a McCafe. I like that that they only have one drive thru lane. So many people don't know how to use the two lanes to make the orders efficient. For the most part this location has gotten my order correct.

Breakfast is my favorite from McDonald's.i enjoy their McMuffins and biscuits and gravy with a large Diet Coke. 

What I can't understand with the whole franchise is why do the McDonald's outside of the STL area not offer Frozen Cokes?
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Ah, Sushi Land. Love of my heart. My stingy, tempura loving heart.

Cheapass sushi, awesome greasy chicken tempura, and all the "special rolls" I've tried were delicious. I wouldn't recommend the nigiri, because frankly the actual quality of the fish isn't superb, but all the special rolls have enough bells and whistles (the Pink Lady's sauce is wonderful) to cover it up. More importantly, it's CHEAP. (and accepts Wildcard...)

I've been with a group of college kids, but we weren't drinking so hopefully we were tolerable to the patrons around us. Pick-up's probably a better option for anyone looking to enjoy a quiet meal.

I don't know if it was because my truck was big but the box to pay for the car wash was too far away i had to step out and the car already in the car wash got me wet. Ewwww. I was rushing to pick one just for i can retreat in my car again. I got the $10 one.
THAN i finally went in. My car in the end looked ok but not clean.  I tried this place out and its a no for me. I did have dead bugs on my windshield coming from cali to reno. So maybe it was because the bugs were already dry... idk but it didnt do the job for me. Good for just removing dust/dirt. No to dry dead bugs or dry bird poo.

Overall good experience. This was my second time renting from this location. Both times had no issues, staff was informative and friendly. Got the vehicle I was asking for and everything was smooth. My 1 negative is that it turned out to be a bit more expensive than I thought. Made my reservation online and got an estimated cost. I knew it would be more than that because I got full coverage but still a bit more than I anticipated. Major plus is that I was in and out on both pickup and drop off in under 5 minutes.

I hate to write a bad review but it is seriously disappointing seeing a vet clinic care more about making money than healing animals. My friend took her 95 pound dog here since it had an ear infection. Any vet or technician should know that the antibiotics prescribed was not going to take care of the issue since the dog was too big. After multiple trips here and the issue not being fixed, my friend took her dog to an aspca vet for low income households who finally solved the problem and could not believe they attempted giving this dog antibiotics to solve her ear infection. Greed or ignorance (or both) are not acceptable!!

Made reservations here at 7:30 to celebrate passing my exam. We were seated quickly. The place was busy. However it took a awhile for our server to show up.  We ordered drinks and escargot, by the time our dinner showed up it was almost 9pm... 1.5 hrs after we were seated. There was a couple next to us who also experienced over a 1 hour wait for their dinner. This place only gets 3 stars due to the slow service and long delay of our food, however the food definitely deserves 5 stars. I would definitely come back for the food but hopefully the service will be better next time.

Great atmosphere and staff was super nice. Place was very clean.. As far as the food goes it was just ok Italian food. We went there for my daughters birthday. My daughter was made to feel special and she got the bada bing pasta which the presentation was super fun with the fire show lol. They sang to her and we had a nice time. However they really need to bring a new chef in or change things up .. Italian food is in our wheel house and this was a little better then pizza parlor Italian.. no one really liked their food.  3 stars for the positive stuff.

This place is right down the street from my house. The pizza is just okay. The crust is super thin and kind of chewy in my opinion. It may be better if you make sure it is crispy. 

The wings are decent though. They don't fry them, so make sure you ask for the wings to be well done. 

I will say I really like their Philly cheesesteak sandwich. It has great flavor and isn't overly cheesy. Not to mention, it's a big sandwich! Enough for two servings. I wish this place served fries with the sandwich instead of chips. I feel like chips are for cold cuts. 

Not my favorite pizza in Wesley Chapel, but it will do in a pinch.

I tried this place for the first time today and was pleasantly surprised. Everything about it was good. Service was great. Environment was very nice. Prices were good enough for me. The menu had a ton of great sounding options. The pizza we tried was the mexican street corn pie. It was really good. I would say that I can't not return to this place atleast a handful of times, because there are so many great sounding dishes and pies to try on the menu,  that I've got to get back here and try some more. It's nice when you unexpectedly find little gems like this place. They're the kind of place that makes me want to go out to eat more often.

This place is awesome! They have all the beer you ever ask for. 

It is like a game to look for the beer you want. My other half started getting into apple cider so we went in to this place looking for this one kind that he likes. Guess what it took like half an hour to find this one kind that was close to the one he like on the first time. (We forgot the name so that's kind of why too) 

But second time we came, it took less time like ten mins. Some of the stuff could be cheaper else where but hey it's nice to have his place opened to us! 

Come here to buy big bulk of beers for your party night or just for stock for yourself! ;)

I don't understand all the hype about this place. I came here based off of a recommendation but it's far from even meeting my expectations. It wasn't bad but it wasn't good. More mediocre to me than anything. Honestly I would choose Mike's sushi or Kobe's sushi over this place. They do have a slightly wider variety but not really. A lot of their rolls are similar, for example most of their special rolls contain jalapeño, which isn't a normal sushi ingredient. Variety is good but don't sacrifice quality for quantity.

Coffee was ice cold! Tomato soup was very tart! Lion Burger has a weird spicy spread on it that was not on the menu. Server was not attentive at all smoked wings were blah! Lemonade was great and the best part was the ranch dressing. Little below our expectations for such a nice location and they need to turn the heat up when it's 10 degrees outside. Oh they also were completely out of all desserts and two of the house made sodas. They need me to do a prep sheet for them. Let's get it together and the server with the beard seems to be the only one who knows how to serve. Good job my man!!

Came on a Sunday Night, not many people eating out here. It was a quaint house. Had the calamari, arancini, and polpette. Everything was great. We especially loved the calamari and meatballs. For our main dish we all got half pastas. The food was a lot even with just a half portion. Gnocchi Neri had a very strong flavor from the ink. The other gnocchi on their menu with blueberries and gorganzola dolce was the perfect amount of savory and with a hint of sweet. Lasagna hit the spot. Definitely would come here again if I am in the area.

Came here on the day it opened and am so glad that Zionsville has another breakfast and lunch option. Had the breakfast sandwich with bacon, egg and cheese on a jalapeno bagel. The bagels are freshly prepared and are much better than any other bagel I've had. The bagel wasn't too doughy or heavy for the sandwich. The coffee was absolutely outstanding. I'll definitely be back to try out the lunch as the salad bar and burgers look fantastic. It's a place where you feel like you can hang out for a while even if you don't want a full meal and just want a cup of coffee. Can't wait to come back.

I used to love this location years ago however it's totally run down and dingy now. The last two times I've come in on a Friday evening the staff has been uninterested and dismissive. I ordered some kids hot chocolates and they were so scalding hot they were a hazard for my little ones. This was after I asked at the counter when ordering that she add cold milk so it wasn't dangerously hot. 

 In addition to the pfft service the decor is tired and worn out. Seats held together with duck tape leave a lot to be desired and arm chairs worn threadbare.

This is my single least favorite ULTA. I wish corporate would send secret shoppers to this location just to see how unhelpful and catty the employees are. There was ONE helpful woman out of 10 available staff and I think she wasn't even a store employee, she was a Clinique or Lancôme Rep. Really sad they just stand around and gossip instead of helping customers. It gets 2 stars because it's close to my house and and work which is convenient, plus they have a large fragrance selection but after this last visit, I'd be happier waiting in 45 mins of traffic to go to the location in Wilmington.

Yum! This place is so good! My two friends and I ate here last night for the first time and we were all so glad we did.
We all had burritos. Two carne Asada burritos and a veggie burrito. They were absolutely delicious.
I had the spicy green sauce on the side and it wasn't very spicy but very flavorful.
The burritos were a good size especially the veggie burrito.
I also had a michelada that was the perfect amount of spicy and delicious.
I will be back here soon. I'm looking forward to trying other menu items.

Growing up in the area during the late 70s and until I moved away in 1990 I remember this was supposed to be THE place on the then non-existent north side. Unfortunately, the  owners haven't allowed the hotel to keep up with the times. The dated exterior and poor condition of the parking lot certainly doesn't help set the tone. The lobby is quite nice and up to date and the staff, from the front desk to the cleaning staff, is wonderful and helpful. Rooms were both comfortable, seemed clean, yet dated. All seems odd because the hospital next door certainly generates business as does the Lilly Center. Perhaps some plans are in the works?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The food was not good. Ordered chicken teriyaki with steamed rice and veggies. Chicken was unseasoned and over cooked (and dry.) meal consisted of a thin breast cut into strips with really dark teriyaki sauce drizzled over the top, not marinated like it should be. Steamed rice was good but you can't go wrong with that and the mixed veggies were onions and carrots...
We paid over $30 for two take out meals that we didn't even want to eat, I literally said "this was such a waste of money." 
If you are looking for Japanese style food please try OKETO, it's right down the parking lot from this place and the food is amazing.

This place actually made me not be lazy and write my first review.  I love Chinese places and I never expect anything crazy good or bad.  However, the general tsos chicken was horrible.  Does not taste like any General tsos I've had.  I would instantly describe the sauce as cooking oil, grease, and soy sauce.  The fried rice was 50 percent onions, 50 percent rice.  The egg rolls, meh. 


Also, it is the most expensive I've seen.  $30 for two. 

Out of the 8-10 Chinese delivery places around here, my favorite by far is 88 China.

New building on old location.  Haven't been here in awhile and thought I would check out new building.  Same fast food but in a nice new place. Flat screen TV soft seats benches.  Nice location.  

Hope they don't fall victim to letting a new place fall apart as this area can get shady at times. But no issues with the locals today.  

Got spoken to about taking pics and showed my Yelp app.  Some questions but they chilled out. When I entered an employee was getting spoken to about poor work , but stopped when I ordered.

Came in for the $18.99 semisynthetic oil change and inspection/rotation with no appointment. The final price was great only added tax and $5.50 shop fee. There was no hard sale. Just informed me of minor issues.  

I listened to others and there was, also, no pressure or attempts to up sale.  Only issue was having to listen to employee issues, people not working out and being moved.

No anti covid action going on. No wiping things, no social distancing lines or moved chairs.   

Was told it would take 1.25 hr, but was done in 45 min. Cool.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
A little rough start,  table needed wiped, crowded at 6pm, but seated right away,  my Arnold Palmer had weird stuff floating in it. The staff fixed everything when it was pointed out to them. 

We ordered the teriyaki special one and two so we could share the California roll and nigiri sushi.  Came in a boat with tempura.  Kind of awkward but nice. Small hot sake was tasty.

No major issues good quality and quality.  Kind of crowded.  You may have the next table really close to you. A little slow to get check and pay but staff was always pleasant.

Me and my wife have been coming here for many years.  It is a very good sushi place and it is never too long of a wait, either for a table or for service.  There is bar and table seating.  Not elegant, pretty informal and quite a variety of patrons.  

Look on the walls and board at the entrance for specials.

There are meals with sushi and boats, and noodles and deserts.  Meals come with Miso soup.  Saki Bombs available.  TV's set to different sports or events.  About $25 per person with drinks.  It really is a nice local place to check out especially if you are near the airport.

Didn't have our phone in reservation. Table available. Waitress seemed distracted. Had to request water several times. Linguini so so. Creamy but not much parmesan flavor. Cheese on table was Kraft like you buy at the store. Never could quite get that there were only two of us. Kept assuming another two would show up soon. Not a very busy Sunday so don't understand the lackadaisical service. Partners smoked trout linguini was flavorful but again not much parmesan flavor. No cannelloni or manicotti on menu. Just average. Reasonable prices and modest wine list. Out of desserts. Probably won't return. A-shame since it is a nice local restaurant.

Frank's has done a great job on my truck and friends' vehicles in the last year.  Consistently good pricing as compared to other shops, quick quotes over the phone that they hold to with no surprises, and the vehicle is ready when they say it will be. Even better, ladies, they will explain everything to you and give you options just like they do for our men friends.  Frank's has handled both engine and suspension work for me equally well.  They're only 10-15 min from downtown Reno, so don't let their location dissuade you.

Great service and quality in the days of COVID! I recently moved to Somerset and we love this place not because it's convenient, but because it's actually very good.  I've been ordering the 20 piece chef's selection sashimi, heavy on the salmon, plus the goyza and tempura vegetables. Plenty for two. The fish has been consistently high quality.  The sides/appetizers are well prepared, tasty, and the sauces good. Unless you ask, the fish selection will be pretty standard - but they've been very accommodating to a more diverse palette.  I think one of the best options in Reno.

We went recently and everything about this place was enjoyable. Friendly staff great calamari app the brussel sprout salad was unique and spot on with just enough dressing I had the spaghetti with seafood outstanding my wife had the chicken soto which was great also all the pasta was recently cooked And the red sauce is some of the best I've ever had a few other people had pizza which I heard was also good. I can't reccomend enough go there you will not regret it.We had a glass and a half of wine 1 app 1 salad and 2 entrees total bill b4 tip was 72 bucks I felt good about that price point with such high quality food

This place is better skipped.  Carne Asada burro was made incorrectly with beans inside. Oh well I can live with that mistake and didn't send it back for remake, but the Asada meat was not recognizable as carne asada.  It was like strips of some mystery cuts of meat. The flavor was marginally passing as Asada flavor and the beans and rice were bland and ordinary.  One highlight was the salsa and chips which were pretty good.  Go with the posole soup as it was decent, though the chunks of meat were way too large for a single bite.

I rarely come out of the woodwork to review a restaurant, but I feel obligated to share my experience. I rather enjoy (Americanized) Chinese food, however this place is not to be enjoyed lest you only order egg rolls or crab rangoon. I had a guest come in from Kansas City last night and we decided to get take out. We both wanted Chinese, so we chose the closest place to my apartment, which was Ho Ho's. What we got were terribly assembled, under seasoned boxes of crap with boiled spaghetti noodles passed off as "steamed lo mein". I will never visit them again now knowing that there is a China King nearby.

Went here for supper with a friend who lives in the neighborhood.   Very good food.  Appetizers were meatballs and calamari in tomato sauce.   Both were good.  I had ravioli filled with ricotta cheese.   Very good, what you would expect from a good Italian place.   Barry had the special rainbow trout which he said was cooked perfectly.  And he would not shut up about how good and large the tirimsu was.   He also would not shut up about the dates Vynil table cloths and how old the chairs ectopic were.   So they could use some updating to some things.  It is an old place and a place does not last decades if it is no good.

We have ordered from here before and have been very happy. Last night was not the case. First off they didn't give us chop sticks or any sauces with our sushi, which we didn't have any at home. The sushi was not great. $60 for 4 rolls and we were still starving. I got a simple shrimp tempura roll and they put Mayo on it so I couldn't eat it. I have never gotten Mayo on this type of roll and it was not in the description. Overall you could tell this meal was thrown together. Not worth the price tag, I'll be ordering elsewhere from now on.

It started off with being asked by 3 different people if they may take our drink order. That's great that they are asking instead of just letting guest sit there, but I also think they should either have sections so they know whose table it is or relay the message that they've already taken our drink order. We ordered and the sushi arrived pretty fast, only thing is we had also ordered rice and it never arrived. We just had them take it off the bill. It's casual and usually a little loud. Good for late night munchies with your friends.

Went for the first time, enjoyed the atmosphere and lighting. Service was prompt and attentive. Liked the drink menu. You will see a variety of patrons, from mid aged ladies and gents to young couples and younger ladies there as well. I think the only thing I wasn't a fan of was their music videos. They were scattered in genres and era and need to update the playlist for sure. One last thing, everyone was correct, if you've never been you will have a hell of a time trying to find it. It really is "within the Cafe". Other than that, I will be back.

I wanted to give it five stars because I love their pizza, but today I spent $22 on a Greek pizza and it had about two inches of crust around the edge. So this meant not slot of toppings. On top of that, there were so many slices cut into the pizza that eacb slice was about two inches wide at the top. It really bummed me out cause last time I ordered here I got burned pizza and about three pepperoni on a lunch pizza. This was my "let me give it a try again" and was let down again. For the price, I just expect more.

Staff were nice but it looked like they had their hands full between the two of them. My burrito was gross. The salmon was off-putting and mushy/chewy and I'm kind of worried I'm going to get food poisoning. I only ate two bites before I got grossed out. Then I took out the salmon and finished most of the veggies from that half. Now my fingers smell fishy and fresh salmon should not smell fishy. Ive had this before at a different location and it was much better than this. Fingers crossed I don't get sick ! Will update.

This is a solid little Subway.  I stopped in today to grab lunch and was not disappointed.  The service was friendly and fast, the food was tasty and I left a satisfied customer.  There is nothing particularly special about this Subway.  It's simply a good representation of the brand and a pleasant customer experience.  There is plenty of parking.  But seating is limited at the time of this writing as they are doing social distancing.  I totally plan on returning the next time I'm in the mood for a sandwich.

I'd say this is a really solid representation of the Subway brand.  I've been several times and always had a pleasant experience.  It is clean, the service is friendly and there is plenty of seating and parking.  My food has always tasted great and I've never had any issues.  It also never seems horribly busy which is great (but this is being written during COVID so that could be why).  If you're in the mood for a sandwich I'd highly recommend stopping by and grabbing one here.  I will continue to stop in to get my Subway fix.

Sitting here at Guadalajara Grill we are longing for just the basics of good Mexican food. Sadly we have finished our homemade salsa and decent chips with the Dragoon IPA's-the best of the meal we ordered today. 
The combination of poor quality tortillas and sweet red sauce ruined the experience of a decent Mexican comida.
It is sad this is a busy establishment but quality is so poor. Last week we enjoyed a modest but superior Mexican food at the Conoco Filling Station in Raton, New Mexico( Thank you, 
Two stars for the service, cold local beer and salsa.

In a town that takes their sandwiches quite seriously, Little Nonna's might have the best sandwich on its block, its neighborhood, and maybe, just maybe... the whole city. The braised short rib sandwich is absolutely perfect. Meat so tender you could cut it with a butter knife, balsamic, gorgonzola cheese, aioli on sesame bread. Just glorious. Little Noni's spaghetti and meatballs plate is HUGE, and totally sharable. The salads are anything but typical, with unexpected but delightful ingredients, and inventive house made dressing. Ambiance is something recreated out of 1970s-era Italian Harlem.

So glad they opened this second location so I don't have to hunt for and then pay for parking to visit the restaurant.  Also don't have to contend with the traffic on Mandalay Avenue.

Friendly staff.

I ordered takeout of tuna and salmon nigiri and it was very FRESH, well packed, with high quality ginger and strong wasabi.

Look forward to visiting again.  

I ordered my takeout by walking into the store, but I noticed today that there's a separate door or window around the corner, on the side street, that said "PICKUP" or "TAKEOUT." Will try that next time.

Full bar.

Came here for the 2016 Easter dinner buffet. Very disappointed. Host seemed to be confused as she could not find our reserved table for the first 10 minutes so we stood in the middle of the dining area until an alternative table was made. The food was poor wedding food at best and bad Golden Corral at worst. Food selection was limited. Chicken dish looked like slop. Best entree was the salmon which was mediocre and portioned extremely small (1"x 3"). Will never come back to this restaurant again for any occasion.

Definitely not the best New York style pizza. It was mediocre. I went in to get take out. The place is a little lacking in decor, but looked clean. I ordered a small Capri pizza and a chicken Cesar salad. While the pizza was good, it is no where near traditional NY pizza. Traditional New York pizza should be able to fold in half. This crust was far too crispy to fold. Good but definitely not New York style. The Caesar salad was overpriced for what was received. However the dressing stated it was homemade and it was fabulous. I probably won't go there again.

These donuts made me sad. Donuts should make you happy so that you can forgive the calories. If these donuts tasted even half as good as they looked I would throw on a 3rd star, but alas that is not the case. We picked up a dozen for a weekend treat with my family and each person had the same complaint, the donuts were oddly crunchy and had a really distinct oil/grease taste. I'm no pastry chef but I think that this is usually caused by the fryer oil temp being too low?

In any case, super friendly staff on my visit, and a cool little building. But I probably won't return for a while until they have a chance to (hopefully) work the bugs out.

This place has Italian food that could compete with anything in the city. Not just philly but NY. The gnocchi is my favorite. With tomato sauce is great! The Basile is so fresh!

The four cheese gnocchi is also amazing. Thing of the BEST mac and cheese U ever had and it is with the best fresh hand made gnocchi! 

Then I also had the grilled squid. Great flavor   Pan seared to perfection and very big serving. 

AND THEN desert: you NEED to try the roman cheese cake! 

Amazing. The service is fantastic and it is a BYOB. 

Considering this place is on the main line and as good as it is the prices great.

I chose this motel for the close proximity to the convention center  I don't like casinos, so this fit the bill. I stayed here last year and it was okay. 
If I had written this review after my first night, it would have been one star. The room wasn't very clean, the a/c was poor, the bathroom lightbulb was burnt out as was the bed lamp, and worst of all, the shower knob was broken and there wasn't any hot water. 
After a complaint to the front desk, everything was fixed and the room was even re-cleaned (maybe for first time). It was quiet and a decent place to stay.
By the way, the pool and exterior photo are not from this location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
If I could give a million stars, I would. Everyone was so warm and welcoming. They brought me a coffee while I waited (perfectly how I wanted it, by the way), and even gave me a candle as a Christmas present on my way out. It smells amazingggg, y'all.

April was my stylist, and she did an outstanding job. My hair has never looked this good before. I mean, it looks GOOD. Really good. So good. She took her time, listened to what I liked and didn't like, educated me on how to style it at home, etc. I'm pretty sure no one else will be cutting my hair from now on.

Thanks for being awesome, April!

Originally came here to see Josh and Jenny Higgins play on a Saturday.  They are a must see great bluesy sound.  The place is kind of different and looks like a dive.  The food so far has been 4-5 stars with a definite 5 for the fried chicken!!! Service has been up and down that is why I gave this place a 4. Most recently we had a young girl that appeared to be new.  Several times we had to remind her of drinks we had already ordered.  She also was not sure if they even had sangria. Overall for the food and entertainment we will definitly return.  Lets hope for a little more consitance on the staff.

I don't understand the fuss. Average pizza - being generous, unlike this shop, which skimps on just about everything, not like anyone's grandma. And way overpriced. Sauce lacks complexity. Fresh mozzarella can be great but let us have some, please; a dollop just won't do it. Ridiculously small size. I might pay this for Vetri or Santucci's cause of the quality of the pizza, but frankly this addition to Philly's already tepid pizza scene doesn't merit the investment. I liked the thin crust; my wife didn't. Liked the sausage. Just not much going on here.

First time at the Zinc Cafe and when I walked in I was not impressed but with an almost full resturant, looks may be deceiving. I got the pork with blue cheese and it was great. It was very muck like a steak in that it was seasoned perfectly and was very tender. My wife got the seared scallops and she loved them. she always finds something wrong with her dinner but not tonight. I have already recommended this cafe to my friends and would return. I only gave it 4 stars because I save my 5 star rating  for over priced resturants so I feel lie I got my money worth!

I agree the server is friendly and respectful. Not many places do the server or service refer customers as sir or ma'am. The gentleman at the counter kept calling me sir. I appreciate the respect and he has earned my business. I ordered 3 scoops in a waffle cone. He packed it high. Price is steep. My order cost almost $7.  By far more expensive than other ice cream parlors. However, the ice cream and service is better. Inside the store is very plain ... nothing fancy. They have another store in East St Louis which has been around for 54 years according to the staff/owner.

A friend and I stopped by and had lunch Tuesday and were disappointed. My friend had Salsbury steak and mashed potatoes, she was sick with in an hour and a half. I had the pork chop, green beans and pinto beans, the veges were great the pork chop had been fried for hours, no sickness for me thank goodness. Charlie Bob's is dirty, the area around the booth have food on the walls and the women that work there look like they have been in the kitchen for days without a shower or change of clothes. We wont be back

Had dinner here with husband and another couple. SLOW service. Beer selection is nice when they don't run out of it (every beer I wanted the keg was empty, and it was early on a Saturday night, so I'm assuming by end of night they run out of alcohol entirely???). Food was OK but nothing that I would go back for (my husbands $25 filet was burnt to a crisp). My waiter was like 12 years old and didn't really understand some of the questions we asked him. For the prices they charge, don't think I'll be going back. Plenty of other places in D-town that will get my money.

I was looking forward to this place based on reviews, but my experience was very average. First, the restaurant was pretty empty (Thursday at 7:45p). The decor was confusing because it was all baseball - jerseys, posters, photos everywhere. The waitress was nonchalant, so I didn't really feel warmly welcomed. The sashimi were quite large. I got 9 pieces for $13.50. The knife work could have been better overall on both the sashimi and rolls. The rolls are creative, not the most traditional though. I'd be willing to give this place another shot, but I felt it wasn't as authentic as other places like my favorite, Sushi on Oracle.

DELICIOUS, CLEAN-TASTING AND BEAUTIFULLY PREPARED SUSHI!  
I eat a lot of sushi in the ST Pete area and this is a hidden (and new) gem that just opened. The chef is Japanese and the menu is mot littered with excessive, Non-Japanese items.  It is purely fresh sushi and Japanese food. 
Lets talk about the ambiance.  Clean, modern and overall has a nice feel. Nice bright window with beautiful stylized Art on the walls.  No sticky table tops here , and the service is very friendly.  
The price is fair and is appropriate for the quality of the food, which is excellent.  You must try this place first then go to the others.

I rent from National a lot and generally have good experiences at most locations. However, this was not the case at STL. When I got in the car, the fuel gauge was slightly below full - not a big deal. On the way back, depsite being in a hurry, I stopped to refuel the car. When the rental receipt was emailed to me, I noticed an extra refueling charge had been tacked on, which is really irritating considering I returned the car with more gas than when I got it. Luckily corporate customer service was able to resolve the issue and refund the charge, but this location seems to have some questionable business practices.

Dr Blonder is terrific. I would definitely recommend him but he isn't there too often. So I made an appointment with Dr. Iverson. He was condescending and arrogant. Never introduced himself and was so negative. He told me I didn't have cataracts but I would someday!! I'm 72, how does he know? I could die before I have cataracts!! I have been into preventative healthcare for 52 years, longer than he's been alive, and he told me I wasn't into prevention because I didn't want my eyes dilated. The whole experience was dreadful and I thought he was extremely rude.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: My pearl white Mazda needed a regular cleaning after a final straw of one large, brown bird crap on my driver side window and door. I figured I'd spring for the "Ultimate" wash which covered bright wheels, hand prep wash, and hot wax amongst other features (their most expensive offering). Came out of the wash and hand dry, pulled right next door at Chipotle only to find the crap stain still there! Between the hand wash prep and the hand dryers why wouldn't anyone notice a brown crap stain on a bright white car? Waste of money.

I have been going to Too Soul Tea for awhile. Located near California off of Plumas, there are breakfast goodies, great teas and coffee as well. They have a loyalty card now and a student discount, so be certain to ask. There is usually sample tea to try out if you'd like. Inside and outside seating available, no matter the the weather. It's a neighborhood place - to get out of the Starbucks thing. Teas are excellent hot or iced! Try their loose leaf teas for great flavor, and for a new taste in Fall warm drinks.

Ever since I was a kid, we used this as our main go-to car wash/vacuum spot. I still continue this tradition, however I only get my car washed (by a machine) usually once a year. 

After I vacuumed my entire car, my lazy self decided to skip the self-wash and try Touch-free. I did the $8 Deluxe wash, and pulled in. The wash was pretty extensive, and looked like it did a good job from the inside. 

I got out to inspect it for damage, when I noticed there was residue left! What a bummer. I'll continue to come for the vacuums, but I'll be doing the self-wash from now on.

As much as I want to like this place, it's pretty tough. Our last experience was horrible, making me not wanting to go back (especially with the drive). 

It was a Wednesday night, and as expected it was dead. Yet we don't get our food until 50mins after sitting. People who walked in after us were eating before our meals. 

It was obvious our teenage waitress forgot to put our order in. She came back at around the 30min mark to tell us the kitchen was running slow. She gave us 10% off. As we waited, she was eating fries with friends at another table 

When our food eventually arrived; it was only ok. I really only liked the fries

Friends and I went here for pizza.  3 of us shared a 16" veggie pizza.  You have a choice of 3 crusts. hand tossed Neopolitan, Crispino, and Deep dish.  The pizza was perfect. We each had a side salad. They were fresh and tasty.  We shared a piece of Chocolate Cake for dessert. The server was wonderful. The menu is extensive, sandwiches, salads, calzone, stromboli in two sizes and classic Italian entrees. The take out area is separate from the dining room- It is a family friendly place and there is ample parking in front. Next time I'll try an entree or stromboli.

We tried out this place without checking yelp reviews, so we were relieved that the food was great and offered real Taiwanese platters.  We ordered  a fish with black bean platter, bok choy with mushrooms, and shrimp steamed dumplings.  I can honestly say that it was all amazingly good! Y husband is Taiwanese and gave his approval of the food as well, which is a plus for me!  I also enjoyed the free wonton crisps and dipping sauce, they give when they seat you.  Staff were all very friendly and helpful!  Overall it was a positive experience and we would definitely recommend this place.

St. Louis style, but the pizza is very sweet. I'm not sure if it's the sauce or the crust? The cornmeal on the bottom is a little strange for St. Louis style. I guess they really like cornmeal because the ravioli's are done in a corneal breading as well.
It was difficult to place our order on the phone, they had trouble understanding our simple order. When we went to pick up our order, we had to wait. Then we got home and they had forgotten to put our sodas in the bag.
 
I don't like sweet pizza so I won't return

This is all you can eat sushi, sashimi and more restaurant. It is not cheap as you pay almost $22 per head. If you are hungry and have a big appetite, it is worth the money back. For the food, it is not bad, surely not premium. For buffet, I give it high remarks. The service is remarkably great. You order from order sheet similar to Chinese dim sum format. I kind of like this as it makes when you order so the food is guaranteed fresh. It is highly recommended that you order enough so you don't waste foods. If money is not concerned, Just grieve it a try and you will like it

I walked in and was immediately greeted. The guy I'm guessing who's Van did my nails. He did a great job with the round shape of my nails but why not use a base coat before adding polish? I'm still looking for a new salon since my previous salon is no longer around. I'm not crazy about the prices either. 25 for a fullset, 15 for a refill and 7 for eyebrows! I'm use to paying $15-16 for nails and brows not $22 oh plus the extra $1 for the so called "high credit card fee". My nail already messed up I guess what I thought was dry wasn't smh and the bubbles in my nails are annoying!

You know what they say, sometimes the "hole in the wall" restaurants are the best and that is certainly the case for Tacos El Rey 2.

Their tacos are absolutely fantastic. They have some of the best meat and salsa in town, I can't say I have ever gotten a disgusting grizzly piece of meat in my mouth. The food is cheap, the service is quick and the food is delicious. I've tried the other Tacos El Rey location and it just can't compare in taste, so I will stick to this delicious hole in the wall!

If you are looking for some delicious authentic tacos for cheap, look no further!

This was my first time at Banfield, and I was very impressed!  The prices were reasonable (I did use a coupon for a free exam, while I paid for vaccinations) and the staff was extremely friendly!

They were very patient with my scared cat, and she was absolutely as comfortable as an animal can be while being poked and prodded :)  The vet took the time to sit down with us and answer our questions, and I truly god the impression that they care about what's best for my cat, rather than what would make them the most money.  Will be going back!

Came here for a late lunch with the girlfriend  and fell in love with the atmosphere. We expected a great turn out from previous reviews but at last we were not happy with most of the meal. 

The only saving grace was the miso soup and ginger salad. We both ordered a bento box, which the presentation was great but the food itself lacked flavor and just wasn't what we expected. To top it off my girlfriend a hair in her bento box which turned both of us off from continuing our meal all together.

We agreed that we are in no hurry to come back here.

I appreciate the efforts and service at this location. That being said- the food has room for improvement. Our appetizers were all served fresh including seaweed salad, shrimp shumai, avocado salad, and miso. We ordered a sashimi platter and 5 sushi rolls including tuna avocado, yellowtail scallion, rainbow, dynamite, and spicy scallop. The menu offers a wide selection of interesting choices but after a few bites I noticed the quality fell short. The sushi rolls were "fishy" and salty, mostly lacking the freshness that is fundamental to a quality sushi experience. 3 stars for attentive service, fresh appetizers, and byob that Ota-Ya offers.

Had lunch with several friends at Peking today, and was surprised how good the food was and how serene the place was.  We all ordered either from the lunch specials or the basic Chinese menu and the seafood and veggies were of high quality, well prepared and flavorful.  One of us had the Green Goddess vegetarian special, one had the Rainbow shrimp and I had the Mu Shu pork.  Decent service, prompt and attentive.  I commented that the food was better than many chain restaurants like PF Chang and the place was much quieter. This was my first experience here, but I'll be back.

This place is fantastic! Tucked away in a strip mall in the west end is this little unassuming sushi place - but it totally blew me away. The service was incredible, the wait wasn't bad at all and our waitress knew what vegan meant and made sure everything we ordered was good-to-go!

If you're looking for vegan tempura look no further because this place does not use any dairy in theirs!!! I recommend the inari, yam tempura, avocado-yam maki and don't even think of skipping out on the complimentary miso soup - it's the best I have ever had. I will definitely be back any time a sushi craving hits.

Came here for the first time over a month ago. Got a very pretty violet color. I believe it was a single process color. No cut, just blow-dry. I opted for a color brand that was much more vibrant. Spend $270 just for it to wash out within a month and left me with a coppery color. The stylist threw the color over my blonde highlights, which was fine but when I washed my hair, most of the color washed out in a single wash. I ended up visiting another salon for my touch-up for a quarter of the price and a pretty purple color that hasn't washed out.

My orders are consistently wrong, and the drive thru time is annoying.The staff is always friendly and kind, but everything is done in a shaky disorganized way that makes me wonder what's going on behind the scenes. Maybe they're often shorthanded? I don't know. 

Last week I woke up early enough before work to visit this Starbucks. I ordered a grande iced coffee with cream. They gave me a venti, which I suppose was nice, but it had no cream. I decided not to mess with correcting them, then got a few blocks away and realized they hadn't given me a straw. This is a typical visit for me.

Looking for something different for lunch, I stopped in for a Mexican meal since it had been awhile.  Most places specialize in quality of food or size of portions.  Unfortunately, I didn't see this as the case.  Food quality/taste were unremarkable.  Portion size was smaller than expected for price.  My order was a simple cheese enchilada and bean taco with rice and beans.

On the plus side I have to give credit where it's due.  Service was prompt and friendly and I didn't have to ask for a refill on salsa or my drink.

I just got an older used up 2003 jeep that's been in the family for a bit. So not the best condition. I needed new brakes ASAP. I take it here i wanted to get brakes, sparkplugs, and coolant for my a/c. They told me it was in the $900 ballpark. Tmi said screw that since o only really needed my breaks. Which was still $569 but I had just enough. Tell me my rotors where shot and cracked and I needed everything new so I said screw it and get it all done. Took about 3 or 4 hours and my brakes where great for about a small period of time. Now they're squeaking and I got them done 4/18/17. I say use someone else they're overpriced.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: My experience today, unfortunately, doesn't reflect the exuberance of previous customers. The oil change I scheduled four days in advance took an hour and 20 minutes. And they used the wrong oil for the engine.  In their defense, they did call within 15 minutes after I left and offer to change it, and the filter, to the correct oil at no charge.  That was very kind and good customer service but I declined since I was already at the dealership to have it changed back. One star for car care, 5 stars for customer care. That's a 3.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Prime geographic location, premier name; but, pitiful situation.  You'll see numerous other comments about 30-minute wait times with a half-empty restaurant.  'Tis true, I'm afraid.   We visited on Easter Sunday and accepted an offer for a 15-minute wait.  30 minutes later, we were offered an undesirable table in the bar because 'they were swamped.'  No, they weren't.  They were understaffed.  There's a difference.  And that difference is management.  We went elsewhere as I'm sure you will.  This one is off the list for good for us which is sad--we love the lobster ravioli.

This place is the worst . I wish I could give it a negative . My whole purpose was just to relax and get some  coursework completed, I booked through Travelocity !!! Upon checking in I aske d the WiFi password !!!!!!!!!!!! In which I was told that the WiFi doesn't work in the room!!!!!!wtf!!!!  What place doesn't have WiFi in the room ? Due to the fact that I booked through Travelocity I couldn't cancel the room without losing my money, fortunately  my phone can be used as a hotspot so I was able to salvage my night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: this is the worst giant, EVER. i have brought produce from here and two days later rotten. i've brought items off of the shelf, months EXPIRED. i also went here and a worker was fixing a shelf, sat it on floor and walked away..... (mind you shelf blended in with floor color) and i tripped over it and almost fell. i will not spend another PENNY in this hole of a store. i will be taking my money to acme, shop rite...anywhere but here. and i will also inform all of my friends, family and coworkers of how horrible this giant is.

We arrived 40 minutes early to look at frames. Amanda was very friendly and helpful. We had an appt at 4:20 and did not get prescreening done until 4:45 and waited to see dr until  5:20. The staff was very knowledgeable about the available frames and which size looked best on my daughters face. She informed me that she was eligible for the kids package which saved us money out of pocket. They were very apologetic for our wait and my daughters glasses were ready in 30 minutes after her appointment. She really likes her glasses.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: We came by for lunch on Friday. There was one other group of people there also. We had hibachi chicken lunch special with just vegetables and the volcano roll and another on with fried fish, bacon and cream cheese, can't remember the name. The hibachi was very good and the volcano roll was very good, the other one was just strange with the bacon. The hibachi lunch special was 7$ not bad for good lunch. The other rolls were 8 and 9$, fair price for speciality rolls. The service was pretty quick and the restaurant was clean. Good for a quick lunch.

I don't usually go inside when I go to any Dunkin Donuts but the other day I wanted to use the bathroom and the the free Wi-Fi that they're always advertising. When I asked the girl how to connect to the Wi-Fi she was really rude to me. She treated me as if I was a terrible bother to her and I had a lot of nerve to even bother her with this. And as if that wasn't bad enough when I went in to use the bathroom the bathroom the toilet was full of toilet paper and turds. It was so bad I couldn't even use it. I had to drive about 2 miles to a McDonald's to use their bathroom. Never again!!!!

Come here for good, cheap, filling food, and nothing more. If you want fast service and nice staff, go elsewhere. 

There were at least three or four tables, and there was one waitress. She seemed to be in a hurry. Our food took over 35 minutes!! Crazy! The staff didn't acknowledge us for at least 10 minutes. 

The plus side is that the food is very good tasting, and filling. I ordered one waffle after reading a couple reviews about this being a filling restaurant, and it surely filled me up. 

If I had to come back, it'd be for the food.

Highly unpleasant experience tonight.  The gentleman running the vacuum cleaner was very rude when I asked about the difference between the super clean and platinum car washes.  It was 10 minutes before closing, and he told me "Ain't no way super clean is happening" instead of a nice "I am so sorry but if you come back tomorrow we could take care of that".   They advertise complete interior detailing but my husband has never had any luck scheduling that.   Not sure if I will continue as their customer.  Sparkling Image is cheaper and friendlier.

Would not recommend. Service was horrible rude and condescending. Attitudes like that won't be tolerated especially when there are much better pizza options available. The deep dish was like soup and apparently they don't cut it for you?! Seriously? I asked and the actual response was "it's to hot to cut". Also part of the crust broke off and instead of them remaking it they attached a note, saying call for adjustment on your next order. Lmao that's customer service on an 80 dollar order?  Avoid this place there are much BETTER options available. If I could give zero stars I would.

Though some may not consider it the gym for "serious" power lifters, this is a really nice facility for the every day exerciser. There are at least 50 treadmills/eliptical machines so you'll never have to wait even at rush hour times. The gym is always super clean and you will notice the workers going around refilling paper machines and cleaning every 30 minutes like clock work. The "spa" area features tanning and massage beds which is a nice plus. For $10 a month (basic gym membership only) you just can't beat it. Staff is kind & it's a very un intimidating atmosphere. The only thing I wish it had was a childcare area!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This place rocks. For $16, I got an awesome cut (and a complimentary massage!) Two of my coworkers told me about this place, and they delivered. The owner, Frances, cut my hair, and I plan to go back soon! I got a basic cut, nothing over the top, but I got exactly what I wanted. Sad to say, that's hard to come by in this industry. And Frances is a pleasure to speak with :)  It's a little out of the way for me to get to, but afterwards I can walk to Reading Terminal and treat myself with some fancy doughnuts, ha, so it's all good!

Drinks and food are delicious but customer service in terms of prioritizing is horrible. I showed up asking for a table for two (which takes up the same room as a table for one, obviously) and was told I have to wait for the other person to arrive even though there was only one outdoor table left (actually, one 2 seater, one 4 seater). 

When said person arrived, I was told there is no room outside even though there was a table for 4 free.  They could have separated the tables to make two tables for 2!  But no. Not happy.

It's a donut place. I don't go often but the last few times I've been it hasn't been great. I ordered a oatmeal and it was full of water, hot water actually and the top wasn't on it all the way so I ended up getting burnt but that wasn't what made me mad it was the fact that I ordered oatmeal and they seriously thought it was ok to serve it to me with so much water in it that I would of needed a straw to DRINK it.  I know that the donuts aren't fresh all the time but they also sold my son a rock hard donut. Umm no when is it ever ok to do this.

Omg don't waste your time, accidentally called the wrong place! Didn't want to eat here, spring rolls tiny and suck, egg rolls sooo dry, bourbon chic actually was ok small portion- crab ran goons will be throw in the garbage where they belong! Inedible! Egg drop soup cold and tasteless. Literally driving to chopsticks to get real food. Almost inedible, and I don't like to waste money. Do not go here!!! Almost forgot to mention absolutely no condiments, napkins, or plasticware- no effort put into assembly of this order. Wish j could ask for the 2$ I tipped him back, and the drink that came with my meal I never got.

What a gem. First, the ambience. A waterfall and intimate setting immediately sets the tone. The booths are comfortable and private. The server was perfect, and so polite. Sushi chef was very accommodating, he fulfilled a specific request, no qualms. Now. The sushi. The flavors were emphasized yet balanced. Hawaiian Roll with tuna and pineapple.... Wow. My guy loves the eel and remarked that the fish melted in the mouth. The soy sauce was a higher quality than most. The presentation was elegant and modern. Decor, modern and traditional. This place is truly a gem. Happy we found it!

i am a Santa Barbara resident.I have been going to Danny's barber shop on and off for over
45 years. On my next birthday I will be 98 years old, so I know that at Danny's they know who I am. They advertise mens hair cuts for $19.00.I went in the last part of august 2016.Since I don't have much hair left, I asked for a trim back only. When the Barber got through he said
that will be $21.00 I knew it should have been $19.00. But I bit my tongue and decided never to go back.I hope the barber enjoyed the extra $2.00
                                                                                     Art

Spur of the moment decision to eat there last night - we dined in. Am happy we tried it. The steamed dumplings were delicious. The pork egg foo young was absolutely delicious. I could definitely taste it was fresh and made on the spot, not pre-made and frozen. For once, I could actually taste the egg. My husband had the pork lo mein, and he gave it a thumb's up. No, it's not NYC.... Come on people....accept that you live in Tampa Bay and judge accordingly. China City is not the prettiest of places, but hey, I find that holes-in-the-wall stay in business because the food speaks for itself.

Came here today to treat myself and my 4 yr old daughter who wished to have her nails painted.  The guy who worked on my full set must not be cut out to do nails. Crooked, gaps from acrylic, and I wanted a specific design to be painted, I was told NO CAN DO. NO DESIGNS ALLOWED THERE. .......huh?? So I waited 5 years to treat myself pfinally having my nails done to get shoddy work and my bubble bursted. Not to mention my poor daughter, she picked 3 colors to alternate. Guess I didnt speak the right language because that is FAR from what she got. Never again. EVER.

Ran through Tiger Express for a quick car wash on the way home!  I was nervous it was going to take forever when I saw the line, but they are very efficent!  There is a line for members and a line for non members, which keeps things moving quickly!  All guests join the same line as the approach the car wash.  Employees rinse down the exterior before pulling into the car wash.  They offer several different washes starting at $6 (I think).  After leaving the wash, you can pull into the vacuum area.  I did not use this service, so can't comment on it.

Wash looked great.  Great price.  Quick and easy.  Will go again!

We enjoyed a dinner here two weeks ago.  We didn't have reservations, so we arrived shortly after they opened.  We got a table easily, but by the time we left, they were filling up quite a bit.  The food was very good.  I only gave four stars here because I wasn't blown away, but I would choose to eat here again for sure. We had a salad appetizer--very good and fresh, and I got the veal scaloppine (which I really liked) and my husband had the pork rib special.  He said it was good, but he didn't love it.  We got dessert and they gave us each a shot glass of chocolatecello afterwards. Staff was friendly and the restaurant was clean.

By far the WORST Wendy's I've ever been to. The food is always old, and nasty. The fries are cold, dry, and greasy. The burgers, and chicken nobody can make because its always hard. Dont make me even get started on the nuggets . Lets just say rocky mountain nuggets (). If i use the bathroom I gotta push for my life they're so dry, and hard. I dont know how this place stays in business. I always seem to give them another shot, and nothing has changed. How hard is it to put the microwave on 60 seconds? Probably leaving it in there too long or something. Wendy would be ashamed.

With all the "twinning" pizza places in town I would have to say that the only reason we go to this one is because they also do pasta.  Their pizza is ok, but I like MOD better and MOD is cheaper.  BUT as I said, they do pasta and since our family is half pasta and half pizza lovers, this is a good fit for us.   They offer a lot of toppings, but are not very generous with them when they put them on your pizza... Maybe 7 pieces of pepperoni total, then you have to ask for more.  We'll be back, but only because of that pasta.

If you have any car problems at all, take your car here and ask for Tyler.  While I'm sure other employees at this location are just as great as Tyler, he's the person I dealt with personally when I took my car in.  The level of service and prices charged from this location is going to be extremely hard to beat from any other service center. Also I'd like to personally give props to Tyler for going above and beyond to acquire parts that are pretty hard to get for my car, and charging a very fair price for labor.  As long as I live local to the Clearwater area I will be bringing my car back here for service!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Atmosphere / Location - Excellent location and with-in walking distance to the French Quarter.  5-10 minute walk to the FQ.  Very typical Omni hotel atmosphere.

Rooms - The rooms are very nice, very well kept and a nice touch of NOLA flair.  No issues that we saw 

Amenities / Service - Excellent all around friendly service.  Front desk did a great job for a late check-in.  We did ask for a 'roll-a-way' as we had a 3rd in our room.  Very quick and prompt service.

Summary - A suggestion would be to clean the drain in the tub.  Didn't drain well and I'm kind of picky when it comes to the drain in the tub.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This was one of the first Mexican restaurants we came to in Meridian (Boise). After going to a few others, we decided, kids included, that this is one of our favorites in the area. It's not perfect but it's close enough without being too picky. All of the staff are very friendly. The main suggestion I would make is to clean the carpets and tile floor and and fix some of the ceiling tiles so it's a little more presentable. I've found this to be a common issue with many Mexican restaurants. All week long my kids keep asking if we can go to Fiesta Guadalajara. The pico is really good and warm fresh tortilla chips are a plenty.

This place is a solid three star,and I don't really forsee it going any lower unless a staff member has a severe lapse in judgement.  The gyoza was average..  Not the best, but definitely  NOT the worst. The shrimp tempura was really good.  They were  decent in size and quantity too for only $14.  They were nice and flaky.  Sometimes places serve them as dinky shrimps, but they loook big because people just keep piling on breading..  but not Kabuki,  It was a good balance.  The tempura vegetables were good too.  Tempura onion rings with tempura sauce? YUM!  Never thought I'd eat tempura broccoli, but I did and it was delicious!

The service was quick and friendly. The parking is easy to access. I think it is a good place for groups and children. Great for date night! I really enjoyed my meal. I will come back here again!

REVIEW UPDATE
So we came back again for date night, the server spilled water on my date and his phone. The manager came over and said she would get us a bottle of wine, that never came. The server then was trying to up-sell us on every add-on possible and talking about dishes we weren't interested in. Am I at a car lot or restaurant?

New sister-restaurant to their Paoli location. 

Good Rock Shrimp, but small portion and small shrimp, especially for $9. Great sushi pizza. It's very messy to eat though. Fire Dragon roll was great. Dinosaur roll was very good. KOP roll had no flavor. 

It was very hot in the restaurant. 

Great WiFi. 

Very slow to get food... An hour or more for the sushi. I have little patience, so this was a turnoff. 

Several items on the original bill were never received. 

I'll be back, but it's not at the top of my list.

A 'safe choice' for foodies and dates. Went here for a smaller celebratory dinner date to do the tasting on a Thursday night. 

Pretty nice atmosphere, and we had a great time for dinner. I don't remember being too crazy-impressed with the food, but like I said, a 'safe' choice. Surprisingly, the food that sticks out to me the most was the foie gras soup. Despite not being the hugest foie-gras fan, I must say that it was delicious! 

Price-wise, very decent for the tasting menu. I guess I was expecting a bit more (food-wise), but it was overall a nice experience.

Gotta say that if there were a time machine I'd go back to the time when I enjoyed eating here.  The days when the menu had more than today's 8 - yes I said 8 - entrees.  In the past I especially enjoyed the Wednesday seafood buffet (long gone).  But alas, the good ole days are gone.  I took a business associate here for dinner and was disappointed to find the streamlined menu.  No more "Seafood Plank" seafood combo, and of the eight entrees, 2 or 3 appealed to me.  Service was good, quality of our meals was OK.  Glad my company picked up the tab for this meal.  Sadly, unless something changes for the positive, I won't be returning.

Bo's over others

I'm an ice cream junkie and Bo's hits the spot. They don't have as many interesting flavors as other places but sometimes it just takes good ice cream to be above the rest. The menu options can fit any preference and the prices are great for the serving size. I got a Think n Chunky, which is similar to a McFlurry, with Reese Cups and Brownies. It was delicious. The ice cream was sweet and creamy. They also added a great amount of mix ins. Their service is also great with a friendly and accommodating staff. I vote for Bo's as the best ice cream in the area.

We got a large takeout order for a family birthday celebration of gyoza, seaweed salad, and many rolls. The $35 tray had a good variety of vegetarian options and California roll but also had a few too many rolls that included cream cheese. I really enjoyed their specialty rolls but they are not memorable on the level of Masamoto or Mikis. We got a lot of sushi for the price though. The gyoza and the seaweed salad are some of the best I've ever had. I will go again to try some of the noodles and hot entrees. Plus they usually have a Groupon for dine in

When this restaurant was built a couple years ago my family and I heard such awesome things about it. So we decided to come and we fell in love with it! We come here probably 3-4 times a month lol.. I'm a really simple person when it comes to Mexican food, I usually just order a shredded chicken quesadilla and it's only about $5.00. My favorite part about coming here is the unliminted free chips and salsa! Service is awesome and they have it decorated really cute on the inside and outside. This is my absolute favorite Mexican restaurant it's basically kind of like La Caretta's. They have really awesome and cheap lunch specials.

The service is great at the front desk, but then I have a few critiques. Beautifully renovated lobby/main areas (see pics), but ruined by dirty windows and entry doors (pic). The bar is also lovely, but when I took a seat in a corner there were dirty napkins stuffed in the seat and under the cocktail table. The bedrooms need renovating and the bathrooms are very very small (and we have a suite). The water pressure is low in the shower and the tub is dangerously slippery. And the towels are dingy & scratchy. Again, the front desk staff goes above and beyond. Maintenance needs to be prodded to step up.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Moved to the area last week and I'm scouting places to eat. First night in the new house with everything packed we decided on Chinese. I noticed the prices were above average, but maybe that's due to the area.
I've got to say, this food was not good. I got the House Lo Mein...the whole container had 2 shrimp in it. And I'm almost positive that they used regular spaghetti so it made it weird tasting.
My husband got his fav; General Tso's Chicken combo. He didn't think too much of it as he fed the left overs to our dog.
We'll be looking at other Chinese spots around here.

Best dry cleaners in town. I love supporting small businesses in the area. My clothes are always beautiful when I pick them up and for a great price. The staff is always friendly and nice, you can tell that they work hard to please their customers. No fancy tags and receipts here, just good old fashioned services. Totally recommend them
*** I have to alter my review. I wish I could give them 10 stars.
My husband left $50 cash in one of his suits by accident. In all honesty he didn't even remember leaving it there. These people are so honest, they had the cash in a separate envelope when we picked up our dry cleaning! 
Simply amazing people!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Spent last night here.  The setup is ideal for a balmy night. We were a large group 30 + people.  The jazz group playing were very good.  However, the speaker volumes were  too loud and spoiled attempts at conversation - many shared this opinion..  We enjoyed our wine selection - a California Cab.  We chose the fish and chip special.  Although it was well done the fish portions were not comparable to what we get at other restaurants in the area.  All and all a good evening and we will probably return - not sure about some others.  Hopefully management will correct thesound system before they lose their customer base.

This used to be a fun local tavern.  I hadn't been there in years and was not surprised when I went in and it was exactly as I remembered ( which is not necessarily a bad thing ).  Most of the bartenders are nice although it is easy to be ignored or overlooked if you don't speak up.  Not sure how often the kitchen concession changes but it seems it is different every time I go in.  It has a VERY different clientele from weeknight to weekend night when the crowd is much younger.  And you have to walk through a crowd of outside smokers to get into either entrance which is nasty.

Eh, this place alright. Don't go in expecting good customer service because it doesn't exist there. I have been to this store often and they never greet you or make you feel welcome. In fact, the thugs they have working there always uncomfortably stare at my wife when we go in. Weirdos. They have a small selection of wines & liquors compared to other stores in the area and their prices are a few dollars more on the majority of items. If it wasn't such a damn convenient location I wouldn't even bother going there anymore.

I've been before but that was years ago and I didn't like it then.

Went back for lunch today and thoroughly enjoyed bartaco.

They have a great lunch special and being that i'm gestational diabetes I had to try to cut out my bread and fun stuff. I opted for lettuce leaves on my tacos and had the side chopped salad. I did the fish, chicken and mushroom taco they all turned out well. The deal is pretty good at $11 and I was surprisingly FULL. I had a ginger grapefruit agua fresca and it was so refreshing that I felt like I was drinking an alcohol beverage even though clearly I was not. Will be back again for sure!

Delicious courtyard dining on Magazine Street.

A Wonderful selection of cocktails, and happy hour 5 days a week.
Service was friendly and attentive. After enjoying about half of my Kim chi Bloody Mary with bacon infused vodka, the entrees arrived.

Mouthwatering medium rare Hanger steak with two poached eggs over cheddar grits and a sauce Bearnaise. Phenomenal. 

The "La Fin Bo Ssam" was a home run. A twist on the popular Korean pork lettuce wraps, this was two pieces of Butter lettuce with sweet soy glazed pork belly, house pickled Mirliton and Watermelon radish, served with Napa cabbage Kim chi.

Nothing like it anywhere on Magazine.

Not all subways are created equal. What's the difference you ask ? Customer service, I'm sorry I can't remember her name, but she was a sweet girl. I've been to many and especially the one closest to where I live, I skip right over that one and take a drive just for a better experience. The only thing I would ask al subways, is why do you have only 1 employee working at a store at 6pm dinner rush in a Friday night.
