I know at the end of the days it's a business but support your team members by giving them the support they need.

Cocktails is the newest addition to St Pete gay community. If your ready for one of 2 spots in the city that have a dance floors then lets GO! the dance floor although small is properly located to create a good dancing feel. If you happen to look up while dancing you will see an array of didlos hanging brightly over the dance floor. Addding to the ambiance is a HUGE! disco ball and the amazing laser and light effects. The DJ here on weekends get the crown pumping. There is some outside seating as well as plenty of interior seating. Nice, clean respectful atmosphere.

The host Ciro is the most personable and hospitality owner you will ever meet. Beautiful interior, also great "al fresco" area outside ... a variety of entertainment from opera singers to a woman solo. Fish is flown in, pasta from italy as well his olive oils...everything is FRESH. It is our favorite restaurant. Previously Ciro had a restaurant called Bellini's in Dunedin....we probably ate their over 100 times...and NEVER had a bad meal or a problem. In Clearwater...some of the wait staff are new..so service can be spotty...It is our favorite italian restaurant and I take my clients and family their all the time. Love...it is a must!

It took me to almost the age of 50 to realize it is time to get a real haircut at a real barber shop. Les at Derby cut both my son and my hair. He did an awesome job on us both. As soon as I walked in I knew I was in a classy and "cool" joint. Love the style. The gentlemen that work there are friendly and professional. This is my new go to place. They are also expanding so that is cool. Go see these guys if you want any style of haircut done right. They also offer razor shaves and beard trims. If you desire, they alo have adult beverages to wet your whistle. Awesome place!!!

I can't believe how poor the service can be . We ordered a satay beef and ice cream for our second round,and after the beef came out , ice cream never show up . My BF called the waitress , they saw us , and ignored us. We waited again , no one ever come over to our table at all . So i went to the register , told them we're going to pay. I saw them were checking their own review on Yelp. Please do your own job well before you spend time on your phone and wondering why there's so much bad reviews on your business. 
叫了两次服务员，换来的只有一眼对视。 结账的时候还要被教育说 牛肉上了，才会上甜品。 对不起， 是我吃的太快了。 我的错。 
     .    .

I have never seen a car wash sooooo clean! I guess that's a good thing, knowing that it's kept up and maintained.
I didn't really notice the price. It's going to cost you something everywhere you go. I liked that I was able to just go in, get my tokens, wash my car and go. It was a mess, but I was able to do what I needed to at my leisure. The gentleman who gave me my tokens was nice and friendly as well. I'd come back here, seeing that I have leftover tokens, and it's not that far away. I do prefer to wash my own vehicle, and with the large 10 bays, I found it was a great place to go.

I'm glad to say this place finally got better. The yogurts used to be very icy and unpleasant, probably because they tried to make everything low-fat (???!!!?!???). Now they're good, some weird flavors but they also have crowdpleasers like cake batter and vanilla. Good variety of sauces, toppings are okay. 

What I don't get is why each froyo restaurant feels the need to copy each other. What about some really unique flavors or toppings? 3 stars for being like everybody else on the block, and not going above and beyond.

As a fellow small business owner in this area, I really appreciate all that the owners have made available to everyone in corona and vail.  

Gas is an obvious need, but its everything else that makes this so much more. They have an amazing kitchen full of better than fresh homemade sandwhiches and burgers. Awesome pizza (they deliver), and my favorite is their fresh seasoned fries. 

They have always had nothing but great customer service with me. A great business begins and end with outstanding customer service, and they have it.

Please support your local family owned business and stop in and try it out!  See ya soon!

David

Good pizza, probably the best in the area including downtown Trenton, NJ.  Most
times I'm in a hurry and grab a slice
from the pizza side of the restaurant.  The slices are more like NY style, with a thinner crust.  Slices with topping can get a bit pricey but again, given the lack of viable
alternatives,...

The pastas are ok as well.  I've enjoyed the penne vodka and linguine with white clam
entrees both in house and catered.  The salads are also fresh.  

I definitely will revisit when the stomach grumbles.

This restaurant is definitely chic and great for date night.  It's got a great vibe and the service seems to be attentive.

The sushi on the other hand is ok.  There isn't anything precise about the sushi here, it just seems like the fish is masked by sauces here which constitute the majority of the great review.  The fact that the sushi chefs are accommodating is great, especially for the vegetarian population.  

I may or may not return.  If someone in my party wishes to visit I wouldn't object but given the option personally I probably wouldn't.

It's a McDonald's so I figured that the Filet O Fish sandwich would be standard here but alas this fish filet sandwich didn't satisfy.  

For starters this drive thru line was really sloooow.  I mean I understand the customers are a part of the equation here but I did consider jumping off due to the wait.  

The fish filet patty itself was under cooked leading to a soggy exterior.  It definitely needed more time in the fryer before assembling.  Given that the fish patty is a majority part of the sandwich itself, it's hard to say this sandwich was ok.

I'll pass on future visits.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Have eaten in the bar several times and am always pleased. The décor is rustic, the sound level is acceptable and the service is always attentive. There are several mounted TVs and an unobtrusive audio system. The bar menu has something for everyone's taste but some of the selections are a little odd. $10 pretzels - really? Sandwiches are large, tasty and are accompanied by either fries or sweet potato fries. Presentation is clever with the meals arriving on slate boards and the fries fitted into a tin cup. The cheese board is excellent. Overall, a lot of pride and care is taken with the food here.

Rolls were packed with a poor ratio of fish to rice (way more rice). Quality of rice was poor.


 I've been to similar order by paper sushi buffets, and agree with other negative yelp reviews that service here was inexcusably slow. The restaurant was not packed, and it seemed that the waiters were intentionally taking their time in picking up our order and bringing our order. Furthermore, you may check off several items on the paper sheet but they consistently left off half our order each time we submitted the buffet sheet. No free refills on fountain drinks.

We went after dinner for the celebrate 31 $1.50 scoop.  Service was friendly. Location was clean.  All flavors in stock.   We got chocolate and mint chocolate chip cones in a sugar and cake cone.  Ice cream was delicious.  However they refuse to accept baskin robins coupons, stating they were a "scam".  I received one from the baskin robins corporate distribution, and they refused to believe even the ones from the app were legit.   They said they will only take coupons with a dunkin donuts logo. So the practices here do seem sketchy.

I think the entrance needs to be better located. For an out of Towner it was difficult to locate. Valet attendants were extremely helpful and friendly. They wanted to help, not just because it's their job. We were upgrades once we checked in. Unfortunately our view was of an exit ramp. But the bathroom made up for the view. Very large tub and shower. Bed was very comfortable. It's location to attractions was excellent. Right across from Busch stadium. About a ten minute walk to the arch. And 5 minute walk to city gardens. A few restaurants within walking distance as well. Overall great hotel experience! Would stay again if in area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Good overall clean.   4*  because as I have tried several auto car washes in St Pete and Tampa I find except for the real crap places that your car comes out dirty; most  places get your car as clean as an auto wash can...the differences are vacuums: suction, type of cleaning head  and pay vs Free  and...  Do they supply any cleaning cloths and glass cleaner.    Bay Breeze DOES supply  all the thoughtful details except  the small crevasse cleaning head...so gunk in the skinny places of your car will remain unreachable.... c' est la vie.   Get that bit at home.

The food here is pretty typical of any other Arby's that I've been to but I will say that the staff makes it worth coming back to this location. 

They've always been super friendly and they're very good about letting you know if your food is going to take a little extra long or something. (Like fresh fries.) Even while we were waiting for the order they had offered us a cookie as a "sorry for your wait". While we didn't take the offer, I appreciated that it was given. 

This store has always been clean when I've been in here and it's one of the few fast food places that gets my order correct every single time I order.

Went here the other night for the first time. Not sure if it's just the aesthetic or the night but they had boxes of supplies around the dining room. We had to wait about 10 minutes for food even though we were the only ones waiting for food. While waiting for the food an employee came out to the condiments counter and took ketchup cups that had fallen out of the dispenser and pushed them back in. Not the best to see because all the cups then touched the counter and were put back in like they were clean. Fries were also flavorless and burnt, I didn't end up eating them.

Just skip it (before you waste time and still skip it)

Ordered, pulled up to the window: the employee was half out the window cussing out the woman in the car in front of us, loud enough for my kids in the car to hear. That woman clearly left, then I pulled up and the employee was gone from the window. After waiting a few minutes I pulled up to the second window, 4 employees just stared for a couple minutes talking amongst themselves. Opened the window and asked if we paid already, responded no, then employee said "okay making sure you're not gonna lie to me" and closed the window. At that point we left, no food.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The folks that work there are usually very pleasant.  I just wish they were as competent.  4 out of 6 of my last orders have had something wrong with them. I've gotten the wrong drinks, poorly made drinks, sloppy sandwiches with no napkins to help with clean up and I've gotten the wrong donut twice.  This all happened in one month.  I figured it was just a bad stretch and wanted to talk with the manager. Unfortunately my attempts and requests to communicate with them were never reciprocated. Really disappointed. Horrible management.

If you enjoy staff that won't speak loud enough to understand what they're saying, a staff that has zero expression, a staff that obviously does not want to be there, a staff that doesn't say thank you (or you're welcome), and a staff that you constantly have to ask to add more ingredients, then you will truly love this place. 

As for me, I 1000% prefer Firehouse Subs. But sometimes, it's get an inkling for the sweet onion chicken teriyaki, and then debate if it was worth it. 

Most often, the answer is no.

This gym is a high pressure for personal trainers to the point where you don't get a good feel of the place. No sooner that my wife and I signed up to use the facilities and didn't make one workout because there were three personal trainers trying to get their business. Very crude and rude as both my wife and I were told by our current doctors to do certain things including a diet. The You Fit people said the doctors were given the wrong information!
All this gym is concerning the hard sell and a big turn off! Had to get the third degree to cancel our membership after joining for one month! Stay away from this trap!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: There were stains on the bedding, chair, and curtains, and it looked like someone had tried to kick in the room door, but I still think it's a good value for the location. It's right by the streetcar and within walking distance of restaurants, bars, a brewery, and Magazine Street shopping. The employees were friendly, and the courtyard and murals are lovely. You can avoid paying to park by parking on the street. We never had trouble finding a close spot. I feel like they could easily make this a very nice hotel by just cleaning it better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Once again: delicious! Went to Luciano's tonight for Valentine's Day with my husband and some friends. Great atmosphere! Great food! Great friends! 

The beef tenderloin was tender and full of flavor. The risotto was divine! My husband and our friends all had pasta that they raved about. For dessert we had the milk chocolate bailey's Irish cream cheesecake and the cannoli. The only minor complaint is that only the ends of the cannoli were filled instead of the whole cookie. But the price is right, the food is tasty, and this place can't be beat!

I went for dinner on a Thursday night with my two roommates. We ordered a glass of wine each and the sweet potato fries, brussel sprouts, fried tomatoes, and chicken thigh sliders to split. Every single thing was delicious. Very different menu, but I like that. The ambiance is chill and trendy. I spotted a lot of business happy hours taking place. I have heard good things about their lunch fried chicken sandy but I've never had it. I plan to return soon with my boyfriend to order some dinner off of the entree menu!

Came here with girlfriends for dinner. We were seated outside which was nice because the inside was a little loud.. but since there is a roof on the outside it was like a hotbox in the middle of July. We really were super hot the entire meal and it was hard to not be uncomfortable.

Service was okay, food was great! I had the gnocchi and was very happy with my choice. It's not your typical red sauce type of pasta but it was a welcomed change.

I will probably be back and maybe opt to sit inside or outside if its not summer.

I love Anthony's! My husband and I first came here when they opened years ago and only had a picnic table outside. They have since expanded and I came back with my parents and husband for dinner which was delicious. Because of that, we decided for our rehearsal dinner to have it at Anthony's in the upstairs section. Danny was a joy to work with and the waitresses were very accommodating for the party. My husband and I came back just the other night for my birthday dinner and it was amazing. The French onion soup, burrata, and penne vodka were soooooo good. Love it here

Depending on what you come here for, you might have a better experience than I do (I just about never purchase hard liquors). Their wine selection is decent (I assume since they have quite a few) but they never have any bottles that I'm looking for... and I don't think my tastes are all that refined or anything.

Their beer selection is awful - they just have the standard Coors, Canadian, Bud, etc. The only 'speciality' beer really was Grasshopper... not really any good other local beers or anything from smaller breweries.

Lemon drop roll. That's all you need at Cafe Mochi. A lemon drop roll and the patio on a nice day.

Sushi elitist here. Sashimi is my go-to and although it's not bad here, the lemon drop roll is just that naughty, not real sushi item that's just too delicious to pass up.

Service is fine, decor is fine, menus are stained and old. Mochi a little haphazard and dated (looks like it was great 5 years ago then not attended to since), but they still have that roll and a patio. If you live within 2 miles, you have no excuse not to end up here.

I enjoyed breakfast and evening drinks here. Both were great. The morning buffet gives you great options and the food is great as well. Staff is very friendly and service is fast. Melissa is host sets the tone from the time you walk in. 

Drinks in the evenings were spent with Newton and Mark at the bar. Both extremely nice bartenders. The bar is a small area with about 6 seats but the area around it is lounge-ish and you can enjoy cocktails there as well. 

The managers reception that is apparently every other Wednesday is a nice touch that included drinks and heavy hor d'oeuvres. 

I would visit again when I return to town.

Always love the food and service in this restaurant. Choose it for special occasions and whenever I can. Last night was a disappointment . The hostess was less than welcoming. She never greeted us or acted like it was a good thing we were there. No mention of the birthday we were celebrating. She did a follow me and took off. After questioning her regarding some seating changes her only response was no. This has never been my experience in the past. Even our granddaughter remarked how rude she came across. I stopped at the reception desk on the way out and the "manager" was eating there! Ugh. 
Great place but less than stellar experience.

I dined at The Little Lion for the first time on a Monday night around 7 pm. We made reservations, but the restaurant was pretty empty when we arrived. 

As a table, we shared the cheese plate, fried green tomatoes, fried chicken, and shrimp/grits. The fried chicken was my personal favorite- all white meat and extra crispy. The cheese plate was good and we could have eaten another serving of the friend green tomatoes that had a red pepper sauce on top. The sauce on the shrimp and grits was smoky therefore making the whole dish undesirable for me.  

I have heard great things about their brunch and am looking forward to returning to try it!

Good night - outside entrance for rooms - since it was raining heavily it was frustrating bringing in luggage- but hey...
Room priced less then $70 for a night and free breakfast
The breakfast was ok
Lots of carbs - some protein in sausage gravy and biscuits 
And I thought I saw hard boiled eggs 
Cereal and milk 
Yogurt 
Waffle machine
It was an ok breakfast 
And it seemed clean I didn't go looking for surprises - mostly because I didn't want any 
One thing ABC gum on the lamp next to the bed - very obvious !
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
What can I really say about this place?  It is like most of the Mongolian bbqs.  The place has the usual items to choose from and the night we went was a good night where most of  of the containers had something in them.  I must admit that I wonder where they get carrots that appear black in the middle.  It's the only place in the world I have seen this phenomenon.   I do like the control these places offer however, this place didn't bring our rice or drinks until we had been eating for 15 minutes.   

I still enjoy this place and will return again.

Who would've expected a restaurant underground? I sure didn't. Tasty Place is a nice place if you're looking for cheap lunch/ dinner if you're in the Chinatown area. I had ordered the Shanghai noodles, Beef ho fun, Roast pork fried rice and the chicken wings. Everything tasted okay, wasn't amazing but wasn't too bad.  
           Only downside would be the service and friendliness itself. Our waitress wasn't friendly and rushed my group when it came to taking our order. Later on when she came to pick up the check, she complained we didn't tip enough.

It was our first trip to St. Louis and as we left and sight seen all the places we wanted to go, my sister suggested this place her, my brother, and boyfriend ate the night before and loved it. I never ate sushi before so I was skeptical but we had a really courteous server they had from the night before. I ordered the salmon box I forgot the same but omg everything was delicious! Even the sushi, sauce, salmon, misu, dumplings, everything was wonderful! So glad we stopped here before we left it was amazing. My sister and brother kept ordering sushi till we hardly get up lol. Loved it! It's a must to stop in and the boxes are beautiful.

So my daughter someetimes stops st this location on her way to pick me up from work and this is the thirdd of fourth  time when going through drive through that the people taking your order have an attitude. She wanted frozen chocolate which we have had before in thin mint and they acted like she was crazy or stupid. I mean it's def an  item that was offered before. Then they said yeah I guess we can do it can we get decaf too. It was oh no we can't do that. I mean why not it's not like you don't just add the flavoring. Anyway I think I am done with this location. Get a little better customer service.

Friendly staff, easy handling, nothing to complain. 
I arrived at the counter, my booking was found immediately. Within two minutes I received my confirmation printout. The person offered my the standards like additional services (E-ZPass, additional insurance etc.) but was not pushy.
I could select my preferred car within the selected booking class.
The car was clean and in good condition.

Also the pickup handled very simple. I just handed over the key to the staff and received within 5 minutes my return receipt via email

A nice BYOB Sushi place in Center City. I work close to this place and it is very convenient to visit this place with some colleagues. 
During lunch time the place is usually really crowded, however the service staff is always very friendly and the service is very fast.
You get really good quality sushi for a reasonable price. My recommendation for lunch time is the "Sushi and Sashimi Lunch Special". You will get six really delicious pieces of Sushi, Sashimi and California rolls. Additionally you can decide between a salad or soup. All together for a price of USD 18.
The food is presented really nice on the plates.
Always again.

So-so menu, which is very limited before 5 o'clock. It's mostly a "new take" on Mexican food (the new take is adding more cilantro). A little over-priced for an atmosphere that's a bit tacky and garish. The most redeeming characteristic is the service, which is outstanding. Dana the bartender is so friendly that Distrito is worth visiting just for a drink. Chefs will come out of the kitchen to discuss menu options and listen to feedback. Visit more than once or twice and the manager Camillo treats you like family.

A hidden gem, so much better than you would think a strip mall sushi place would be. Food is outstanding. They offer sushi and hibachi. Sushi chefs are at a bar so you can ask them any questions and watch them make your food if you like. Service is outstanding, especially the bartenders who remember names and what you ordered last time you were in. The manager is one of the best I've seen, a real professional. Atmosphere makes you feel like you've arrived. If you like Asian food or want a fun place to try it, Yokohama is a great choice.

Ordered the Aviator Burger without the bun and fries but instead asked to have it served in a bed of lettuce. They said no problem. The burger itself simply did not taste that good.  The toppings I requested were not correct and the "bed of lettuce" was meager at best. Just an unfortunate experience for such a high price. It's late and I have a very early flight in the morning or I'd send it back. The server was very friendly which kept this particular meal above a "1".   I'm sure I'll be in the situation where I'll have to eat here again and I hope next time it will be better!!

Love their instructors and facilities, but I am writing this because of their horrible customer service. Not only was I charged for 5 (5!!!) months when I signed up for a 3 month membership, but I was _not_ told about the fact that my membership would automatically continue, that I would be charged for another month if I did not cancel by a certain date, that I had to come in personally to cancel, and that even though I canceled in person, I was still billed for a 5th month because of the timing. I have now called twice and emailed asking to speak with a manager about my account with no response.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Horrible!
Terrible sushi, old ingredients, absolutely a rip off!
Went their at 2:45 and ordered 
Got the bill and was changed the dinner price
Hostess never said a word that it was now dinner menu
Music in the background was Michael Jackson!
Sushi chef did not use food gloves
Waitress did not wear gloves
None of the staff were Asian!
A waste of time and money!
Better off getting some sushi from Whole Foods
This place won't last as they are clueless 
Ordered hot tea and it was cold
When we asked if it could be heated she said the microwave was used for the unagi and they could not warm up the cold tea!
It was a nightmare!
Stay away!!

I've heard of this place but never gone. Someone told me they are closing so probably pointless for the review. Haha. Hot braised chicken wings were spicy and fried well. Crab Rangoon was standard. Beef n broccoli had flavor and beef was tender. Stay clear of hot and sour soup tho! Worst I've ever had and may be the most disappointing food item I have had. If you like pepper then this for you. Awful! No flavor except pepper. Tons and tons of black pepper. Both my co worker and I pitched ours in trash! No sour, no chili spice. Like eating peppered broth. White rice had veggies in it. Fried rice was boring

Wonderful local byob! Server was great, a lot of knowledge about the menu and specials. First time there and we both got a complimentary glass of wine with dinner and homemade lemonciello with dessert--really nice touch.  We got the calamari to start--very good! And I got the pesto shrimp with tagliatelle pasta. Delicious! The pasta is made fresh and it literally melted in your mouth! The portion was big! I took a lot home. Had the canolii for dessert--Delish!!  The space is small -it was a Monday night, so we were the only ones there for a bit, it was quiet, but I could see it being bumping on a Saturday night!  Will be going back!

Have been going to this Subway for fifteen-plus years,,,always for a lunch sandwich...six inches; choice depends upon my mood for the day!  Sometimes I watch the person in front of me, ask him/her what they are getting, and I tell Deb...ditto for me.  Maybe a salad.  Toppings pretty consistent..lettuce, tomatoes, black olives, oil and vinegar.  Never gone wrong...David, Deb and staff always treat me well...get my seniors discount...chips and coke...home for lunch with my wife...then a nap..Doesn't get better than that

My boyfriend and I ordered take out from here on a Friday night. The service was quick but the food did not meet expectations. I ordered the Tekka Don (sliced raw tuna over rice) which came with a miso soup and side salad. The tuna was mediocre and the rice was pretty dry and hard. That being said, they did include a lot of tuna with my dish, and the soup and side salad were both good. My boyfriend ordered the teriyaki chicken bento box; he said the chicken was overcooked, but enjoyed everything else. All-in-all, we probably won't be coming back, but it was worth a shot.

Delicious sushi that doesn't break the bank. I've ordered sushi for pickup a few times now and have nothing but good things to say about the food and service. The wait time between ordering and picking up is at most 15 minutes (even on weekend nights) and the owners are super friendly! The rolls are on the smaller side, but when you're getting three of them for $11, it's hard to complain. The sashimi appetizer is excellent; the slices are always thick and fresh. Their fancy rolls are disproportionately priced when compared to the regular rolls, but tasty nonetheless. Try the tuna dumpling, you won't regret it!

Due to no fault of my own. I ended up with a small dent in my car door yesterday. The management at Metro Car Wash offered to split the cost of repairs with me even though I had not complained or made a big deal out of it. I only had notified management of the potential for further guest to receive damage to their vehicles based on the new equipment they had installed. Metro Car Wash is the best car wash in Reno and their customer service is 5 star. They are currently working toward improving their vacuum stations and this issue is being resolved.

This restaurant received three stars because the food is good.  The service is terrible.  Our waitress took forever to get us drinks, forgot our 2nd round entirely, served us the wrong dinners, and had major attitude when I asked for more water.  She was clearly not handling her stress of multiple tables well, and was literally deep sighing her frustration while taking our order.  It was pretty ridiculous.  Go for the food if you do not care about service.  Rudeness was way more disturbing that the mistakes.

Crispy wings sounds very good on paper but the truth is.... when you use a low quality, most likely frozen wings and fry them to a crisp... it usually leaves with over cooked, dry , flavorless wings. The sauces are pretty good, especially the Chesapeake flavor. I would give them 5 stars if they take the wings out of the fryer a few mins earlier or they can use a higher quality wing so you don't fry all the chicken flavor out of them. I had 36 wings during the all you can eat on Wednesday. And 36 were consistently over cooked.

I was excited when I first heard Tortas Frontera was opening in Philadelphia. Prior to that, I was only able to get these tortas when passing through Chicago. I've been to the Philadelphia location a few times now and the only reason I go back is because the tortas are so delicious! They are very flavorful and the bread has a nice bite to it. However, other than the food, everything else is very sub-par. Service is horribly slow, the staff is rude, and the dine-in experience is lacking.

Food Rating: 4/5
Service Rating: 2/5
Ambiance Rating: 2/5

I love Big Brand Tires. I never take my car anywhere else. They always do their best at finding me the best deals. Victor has always been very helpful and friendly. (Even if he is a Cowboys fan lol) I called ahead to get a quote and make sure they had my size tires in stock, since they aren't a popular size. Victor was able to order them and have them in the shop the same day. I was able to make an appointment later that afternoon.  They started working on my car at my appointment time, and they were fast and efficient.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
To be more precise, this rating should actually be 2 1/3 stars, which is only because I had a salmon salad which was decently priced and yummy. 
Our waiter, as another review mentioned was tactless. He repeatedly questioned my friend's choice of wine and offered us dessert about eight times before he finally got the hint. 
Our bread, also as mentioned in other reviews, was cold and the butter was so hard it ripped the bread. 
Since I only had a salad I cannot expound upon the quality of the main menu, but I wasn't impressed enough to return.

Quality has definitely declined at La Vitas. From burnt pizza, low quality food, to rude and slow service. I'll never forget when my family ordered delivery, and my parents ordered two california turkery burgers for themselves. When the food came the burgers had no lettuce, tomato, onion. Nothing! They called La Vitas and the delivery driver didnt return with the condiments for an hour and a half. The burgers were stone cold by then. But we gave them many chances after that, but it just hasn't been the same for the past 2 years. I think they sent their A team to Little Shop of Pizza in Lumberton. They make decent food there.

This location is pretty deserving of its average rating.  Service was friendly but on the slow side. Had to remind bartender to bring me my beer.  Salad bar was also thinly stocked, for instance no mushrooms, no cottage cheese, no croutons, and no sunflower seeds.  Those are standard at every other Ruby Tuesday's salad bar I have  ever been to.  Buffalo chicken sliders and fries were hot and tasty, though they took quite a while to come out from the kitchen.  On a Monday night at 8 o'clock, they should be out lickety-split.  Menu prices are also really high for a fast casual restaurant.

Had the Friday special of fish tacos. They weren't too bad but they weren't really great. In my opinion there were too many onions. The cod wasn't too bad either. I just like mine a little more crispier in tacos.
My son got wings and wasn't too impressed, and he's a real chicken wing fan. Although, we both liked the jalapeño hush puppies.
Maybe there are better options we haven't tried. There is a playground outside so it is really a great spot for parents who want to grab a beer and let the kids run around.

The bar is set pretty low for this place as soon as the waitress starts telling you what they don't have on the specials separate piece of paper each diner gets. I echo what another yelper noted, why not print a daily sheet? Also the specials don't list prices!  Caesar salad had shaved Parmesan which was nice, but a bland taste otherwise. My veal scallopini included thick cuts of meat that were better suited for a stew. Veggie lasagna just alright and an ambitious sounding short ribs dish fell short. Maybe we should have stuck to pasta dishes?

They are under new ownership now and frankly they need a lesson in making customers feel welcome .. if you want to sub anything or change anything forget it.. I don't like the surichi suave and have always told them to hold it.. now that's a big deal and it's a dollar to have less.. they raised their prices .. not a huge deal but they used to be packed and we have been in several times and it's not very busy.. too bad as there isn't a sushi place nearby. They have a great location and the parking is easy too.. It used to be our favorite but not now.. they need a good marketing PR campaign and then need to welcome customers.

If I could give this McDonalds no stars I would. I waited 20 minutes in the drive thru line to pay, then when I asked if my food had also been waiting that long, the cashier said, "I don't know, I just got here". When I received my food, the Large Fries were half full, and cold. I asked for new fries, and was forced to wait another 5 minutes. Absolute waste of time, no napkins or condiments, in the bag, when asking if my drink was pink lemonade, which I ordered in the beginning, I was told "we don't have that."
These people shouldn't even be paid the measly minimum wage I'm sure they are earning. Worst.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
As always - THE BEST!!!  My husband and I cannot get enough of this place. We love splitting a hibachi meal (steak and shrimp) and getting my son a chicken hibachi of his own. 

The meals come w salad and soup, we also sometimes order spring rolls or crab Rangoon. We always get a specialty sushi roll - the pink dragon. Delicious!!

Thanks for being a staple in our lives - always consistently delicious and service is always on point! We have also ordered takeout many times and never had an issue. Looking forward to the next time!

it looked a bit getto from the outside though.  

Greet staff, seems like it's a family business.  They had VERY good AUTHENTIC sushi!  

there are 3 ways to tell whether a sushi restaurant was authentic (Japanese) or it's own by Chinese.
1) the rice they used.  Japanese would use sticky rice.
2) the Japanese's bathroom are MUCH cleaner!  
3) the Japanese ones would usually give a bit more food and present the food much nicer.

we ordered a lunch box and eel on rice, they both taste really really really Good!  Their fish is FRESH, and their eel is THICK!  (you know, some places have cheap eel that is kinda thin and small)!

I've been to a couple hyatt place, and most of them were pretty good, yet i felt quite disappointed @ this one @ indianapolis.  

the staff were okay, 1 of them were quite nice, the other one didn't look at us at all and she was the one serving us.  the room was neat as the other ones.  we stayed for 3 nites, they didn't come clean up our room at all on one of the day, didn't change the towel at all; and one of the day, they didn't have water for a few hours without notifying the guests ahead of time.  Their TV channels are fewer than other hyatt place hotels.  

1 plus is they had pretty good cookies at night by the front desk for guests.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Anytime Fitness is obviously convenient for the 24 hour operation and their multiple accessible locations. This specific location takes that a step further. No Valley's Silver Lake location still has that "brand new" gym smell, and the staff keep it clean and organized. Tanner helped make the sign up process a clear and easy experience. No hidden fees or up-sell pressure. With Tanner and the training staff there, a novice looking to get healthy again or an expert keeping that summer body ready can get equal but customized support. If you are looking to get back in to shape or keep the one you have, come hang with us in the Valley!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I could write a better review for a car accident or my wife attempting to cook. Orders always inaccurate and staff seem to not care. The French fries are always soggy and over-salted is under statement. I can easily spend $30.00 on five of us here. So when I pay that much I at least expect to get what I ordered and how I ordered. I ordered a double quarter pounder meal with no pickles, I'm allergic to pickles and stated this at the drive in. When I got home it was cheeseburger loaded with pickles. Me being to irritated due to this consistently happening decided to toss it in garbage and told my kids were no longer going back.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I love DD's hash browns. Of course, its donuts are good when fresh. I also love the fruity Coolattas and iced tea. However, I have one major complaint about this location. I stopped in and wanted to do some work on my laptop. My battery was low. This location had no outlets in the cafe area to plug up and charge my laptop. Really? In this day and age where people need to charge phones, tablets and laptops, not one outlet in the entire cafe area? Had I known, I would have gone to the location on the White Horse Pike at Gibbsboro Road. I guess the owners are dropping a hint that they don't want customers hanging around.

This hotel is awful. It is dirty and does not adhere to
CDC guidelines for preventing the spread of COVID. Hardly anyone wears a mask. I did not see anyone clean the lobby, hallways, or pool. The same dirt and hair balls sat on the floor in the lobby and my hallway for 5 days! Hotel is dirty and I found a roach in the bathroom my last night there. The housekeeping staff needs to do a better job of cleaning. The carpet in my room was disgusting. The entire hotel is gross and outdated. I will never stay here again. GROSS!!! 

Pay a little more and stay at the Hyatt or Westin. This place was a dump!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I moved to the area three years ago. I always get the brownie sundae. The first summer we were here the sundae came with a whole brownie. Last summer there were brownie chunks. I went a few weeks ago when it first opened back up for the season and I was given one small brownie bite the size of a large crouton. Now that Rita's is stepping up their game and selling a brownie sundae of their own, I don't see myself going to Sundae World again this season. My kids try multiple items on their menu and agree that the portions are stingy and quality has gone downhill.

The salon is clean, quiet, and staff is very friendly. As a walk in I didn't have to wait and my acrylic set with gel was complete in about an hour. The customer service part is great and prices are average. The nails themselves are a different story. I showed the nail tech a picture of what shape and length I wanted but ended up with super short, wide square nails.  I kept explaining to her how I wanted them to look.  She was very sweet and kept trying but I just gave up.  If you want basic nails I would recommend this place.  If you want artistry and a wow factor go elsewhere. This is not the place for you.

I have really enjoyed eating here.  The staff is very friendly and give suggestions which I appreciate.  Their food is very good.  Many selections and difficult to choose which meal you want.  If you order the pizza be warned to expect a huge pizza.  The large almost covers the table.  I have never had a bad pizza here and the price is great.  This place has always had alot of customers here so you may wait a few minutes but it's worth it.  The place is clean and atmosphere is friendly.  I would refer everyone here.  Good Food.

I've been here several times and for me, it's just okay.  The most recent visit was last week with my girls.  They ordered pasta and seafood dishes which were quite good, however, huge - a lunch portion offering would be great!  I ordered a turkey sandwich - it was dry and okay, nothing great.  Last time I was here, I ordered the pesto chicken salad (sounds much better than it was) - very underwhelming.  I had to add a ton of salt and pepper just to get some flavor.  Like I said, it's just OK and, in my opinion, not at all worth the price.  The service, however, has been quite good every time I visited.

Horrible for the most part. 

I ordered $50 worth of food and 27 was eatable

The fried rice was soapy 
The duck bun that was $8 alone was gross and I love duck 
The sushi was $5 for two pieces I ordered $15 worth 6 pieces it had next to no rice but the fish was awesome very fresh that alone gave them the two stars I would give half a star for the miso 

He ordered a sushi roll he said it was pretty good again the fish was great 1star for this review 

I won't go back because I would rather drive to Tampa and go to I ai sushi for cheaper higher quality food.

We usually have a wonderful time eating here, however my family and I just had a late lunch here and were quite disappointed. 

My food was personally quite good, but one of my party's veal was quite bad, and their noodles were very undercooked. In addition to this, despite us being one of three small parties, it still took over 45 minutes to have our food served. 

The waitress was also pretty short with us once we sent our food back.

Perhaps we were unlucky, but this was certainly an unpleasant experience.

In response to Rodney. I spoke with the leasing staff 15 minutes after it happened and the next day to the property manager as I previously wrote. I was told that it needed to be investigated by the property manager and reported to the police. I provided the police report that day and followed up with an email to ask what the outcome was of the investigation. The property manager asked me to give him a few days to provide an answer and he would follow up. Tomorrow is 1 week from the theft. I haven't heard anything back from the property manager, yet. I will keep you updated, Yelp!

This place is consistently a disappointment. First time I came through here, I ordered a breakfast sandwich and the thing was burnt to the point that I could only eat half of it.

Today, I had to wait 5 minutes to place an order. When I pulled up to the window (which was wide open), I sat there for another 5 minutes. The woman prepared three drinks during this whole time and didn't even acknowledge my presence. I grew tired of waiting that long for so simple an order. I drove away.

I'm never stopping at this Dunkin again. And you shouldn't either. Don't waste your time.

Stayed here during a conference in NOLA.  Normally I skip Marriotts because I utilize a different chain.  Overall the experience was ok.  

Location -  Location was convenient to all of our business needs and the French quarter.  It was on a side street from canal which was nice.   

Appearance - The hotel itself was nicely decorated and the room was in good condition.  The only complaint is that I had an interior room. It was weird as my window faced into the adjoining hall. Again it was weird and I didn't really like that.  

Overall, it was an ok stay.  The next time I would ask for a different room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Went back again with a gift certificate from Christmas.  Tasteless lobster bisque and tasteless brandy cream sauce on one of their signature dishes. The dessert was still partly frozen. 
The owner is very nice but the food is lacking. We went with a gift card and will probably not be returning. We've eaten there before, many times. It's just not worthy of the prices they charge.
It's a BYOB which is enticing but food it overpriced for what you get and everything is a la carte.  Very disappointed in this recent meal.

One of the bigger mysteries in Ardmore for me is the appeal of this shoddily run, mediocre pizza business.  They've got a gorgeous bit of property and an awesome oven, but I've rarely had good pizza here (that's cooked correctly/evenly) and the rest of the menu doesn't leave much to be admired.  The owner is regularly unpleasant/rude when you go to pick up your order, too.  I get that the rooftop is a neat thing, but there's much better (and friendlier, and better priced) pizza in Ardmore, let alone the rest of the Main Line.

Walking by one day on Main St. Manayunk and I saw this place. I've heard good things about this restaurant so I decided to try it out. 

This place is gorgeous. 

I had the Sushi and Sashimi for 2. My lady never really had it, but she was all for it when the plate appeared right in front of us. It was a chef's choice and it was a great decision.

Though a little pricey, the quality and care is there. 

If you enjoy japanese fare, go to this place because its very hard to find good a good sushi place around philly!

Friday night at Joeys, such a great place,  people are waiting outside. I ordered a pick up pizza and was given a 30 minute pick up time. I arrived in 40 minutes just to be sure it would be grab and go. Well another 15 minutes and I asked to check again and there it was. It was a very busy night so I was ok with the wait. The people seated seemed very happy. Got home and a little disappointed that my toppings were not what I ordered, it was still a beautiful and tasty pizza and our Greek salad was also very good. I'll make sure I check before I leave next time but there will definitely be a next time.

It's a clean hotel.  It's dated but functional.  Nothing seriously terrible but the desk and charging port was a new thing.  Tv is he but smaller.  Bathroom looks old skool.. air unit was a bit noisy looks nice from walking into lobby but it's old inside. Stand hotel stuff nothing fancy. Should not be considered a 3 star hotel.  That's what Priceline called it... very big hotel. Initially gave it 3 stars and I was till here now I got tapping at the door just at 9am saying housekeeping!!! There are no do not disturb signs so I'm being bothered early in the AM!!!  Then you hear this noisy housekeepers making all kinda racket!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If you're looking for a great snack that's low-calorie and healthy hyppo gourmet ice pops is the place. My daughter makes the trip to Ybor city to her three times a week from North Tampa just to get one. The flavors rotate often so you never know exactly what's going to be offered which makes it kinda fun and adventuresome. My favorite so far is the bourbon peach. I can't really recommend getting it dipped in chocolate as I don't really like the chocolate shell seems like a cheap chocolate and I am a chocolate fanatic. Pops run about $3.50 each and about 100 calories

loved it so much the first time, went back two days later for a second time.  Just as good.  Striped sea bass in a bed of bamboo rice, kumquats, you name it.  This is just well balanced, fresh, fun food.  Had the Berry Boom cocktail which included blueberries they infuse in a jar on the bar for two weeks.  This is the kind of special attention that makes Jax worth a few dollars extra for a great meal.  Can't say enough about this place...grew up in NYC, 15 years in SF, and Jax could hold its own in both cities.  You won't be disappointed.

I've been getting my hair cut and colored by Carol for over 7yrs. now & she flat out rocks!! I have very thin hair so when I grow it out it looks very unhealthy. I tell her most of the time 'do whatever you want w/ it' and she cuts it perfectly (and short, as we agreed) EVERY TIME! (she's a perfectionist) I get compliments on my hair ALL the time  

My only complaint (about the salon) is that not all of the stylists dress professionally. It makes the salon look bad when ANY stylist shows up to work w/out doing their own hair & wearing clothes like they're going to Walmart for the day.

Probably the only thing that wasn't soggy was a soft pretzel. Seems clean, I guess we will see mid flight. Pretzel was soft and good and the mustard seemed good. I mean, you can't really mess that up, right!?!? 

Employees do not talk to you. They sit on their phone with ear pieces and talk to someone on the phone the whole time. So when you don't see the ear piece and you think they are talking to you, you get a weird look and it's really weird when the employee asks what you are wearing tonight. Should have known. Lol.

Being a new New Orleanian with Italian roots, this was my first Italian restaurant - and will be my only Italian restaurant, the food is THAT good! The eggplant is amazing and the angel hair pasta was cooked perfectly. The meal also comes with choice of soup and a salad. Unlimited breadsticks right in front of you. The cannoli is true cannoli and it goes perfect with coffee. Going to treat myself at least once a month. Darlene the bartender is super nice. The only reason I can't give a five-star review is because they jam you in at the bar...too many seats.

I really wanted to like this restaurant.  The food smelled fantastic.the service was slow, but we had a group of ten, so not unusual.  I ordered the fish of the day, Red Grouper.  The seasoning flavours were good, but the fish was WAY overcooked.  Most everyone else was happy with their meals except me.  I might go back, but given how good King Fisher is and it is just down the road, probably not.  I don't have any association with King Fisher, just enjoyed a meal at the bar last night.  Perhaps I just drew the short straw and got the line cook in training to cook my meal.

We had a great experience with Hotel Indigo. The hotel was remodeled from an old building and has charm mixed with a fresh, clean interior and decor. It is bright and cheerful. Our room was very clean and they even had Aveda soaps (bonus points)! The location was great, just blocks from Central and Beach. Parking was tight (as all parking is in St. Pete). We parked in the overflow lot. At first we parked next to the side of the lot with the apartments... it was a little 'shady'... we moved the car. There were no problems and our car was fine there overnight. The staff seemed to be eager to help and were very friendly. We'll be back :)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I can't really give a review because I haven't eat there but I can tell u that I walked pass this business regularly because I am a mall walker early in AM and  i see the same people there working, they prep the foods and every time walking by,  it triggers my hunger. They also do  a lot of cleaning.  I guess one of these days, I will try and write a better review when i eat there.    ******* On 12/07/15. Finally we ate there.  The foods were good but a little pricy.  Otherwise, I am happy and would definitely eat there again.********

It's a shame, my family said their pizza was great. If you're ordering only pizza, go for it. Grubhub delivery was awesome. The reason this is getting 3 stars instead of 4 is because the salad I ordered was messed up. I ordered a chef salad which was supposed to have ham, cheese, onion, green peppers, tomatoes and lettuce. Nowhere on either menu did it say anything about it having black olives in it. When it arrived via the salad was loaded with a handful of black olives. Lastly the ham in this salad tastes like cheap super salty, prepackaged, supermarket "ham". Needless to say I was less than thrilled.

I started coming here again a few months ago when my regular salon closed. They still do a good job and overall I'm happy with the results BUT if you're waiting to get your hair done by Elizabeth she's never there when they open at 9 so plan on waiting at least an hour if you have an appointment with her. I'm seriously thinking about looking for another salon in the area where I can get my hair done early without ALWAYS having to wait around. Also they talk WAAAAY too much and too loud the entire time I'm there.

Let me start off by saying i love both vets in this office. But the receptionist is an absolute b****! I have been taking all of my dogs here for six years and spent thousands of dollars only for her to be a total b. Today id had enough and am switching vets. I wonder if the vets know what a cranky old skank they have working up front. And yes im talking about you Wendy. Maybe you should smile once in awhile, i promise it wont hurt. Sad that one lady can make things so crappy that im leaving vets ive used for six years... i hope the vets read this.

The ladies are friendly and thats the only reason for two stars. All i wanted was acrylic over my already short nails and to paint them. She rounded them so extreme that she cut into my natural nail beds on each side of the nail. They look ridiculous. Then to top that off her acrylic is super wavy. She barely buffed the top to get a nice even nail. Never again.  Now i have to go get them redone on my vacation which im leaving for today. And the whole reason i had them done. I even told her she cut into my natural nail bed and her response was " they will grow out"

I'd love to love this place. It's a good price for a multi course meal. But for being a student run restaurant, it is what it is. They set up a makeshift dining room in the school's antrum. It's pretty cool that there's a window to the kitchen to see the work in progress. 
All the students were very nice and interesting to talk to. But unfortunately, the dishes just didn't really taste good. Not much to say but all pretty bland. 
Chocolate truffles and the end were the best part of the meal. 
Good to try once to support the school.

Well I'm still trying to find some good to decent sushi places here in AZ. I ask a lot of people their favs. So far I'm still batting a thousand. Rolls were loose, hard to eat. Why are they double rolling rice? To make it look bigger? I've never seen that. Guess I've been lucky all these years to miss the displeasure of that. What salmon there was wasn't cold and tasted it. I wish all places when serving imitation crab that it be moist and shredded. As in the salad type, not taking a tube like piece and spreading it apart with your fingers and setting it on top. Its just dry & falls off. I can scratch this place off my list.

Im so saaaaddd. I was hyped about the fries bc they re always fresh her NOT TODAY. They were old and unloved. Disappointed bc my triple cheeseburger was hotter than a flame! 

Keystone McDonald's is my favorite. Its near our house.  Very rarely do we have bad service. Today not only were my fries cold and salty but I ordered ice cream, that they forgot. Bean had to go inside to get it. Today's service just felt like a Monday. Slow & not quite into the groove. 

The manager apologized and thanked us for coming in. . . to get our ice .
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The ambiance here is romantic and chill, I really liked the atmosphere and music a lot. More importantly their wine and cocktail list is awesome. It's clear that an expert sommelier put some thought in to picking great wines. The oysters are the best I've had in St. Louis. The jerky skewers are mouth watering good too. The gnochetti is really flavorful and filling. I personally wasn't a huge fan of the lamb cruda, but have heard others like it, so could just be my personal taste. Great spot in the heart of Maplewood!

I've never been so displeased with a Chinese restaurant before.

Not only did we receive our delivery 15+ minutes after the latest estimated delivery time, but the food wasn't very hot or tasty.

I ordered general tso's, and they were disgustingly sweet, not spicy as they should have been.  I typically order general tso's to gauge the quality of a Chinese restaurant, and I can't imagine what the rest of the food tastes like knowing that they messed up such a common dish.

I wish that I could get a refund on the bill and the calories wasted on this meal.

If I didn't work so close to this Starbucks, I would not subject myself to being cramped in such a tiny franchise location. This located off the front of the massive Comcast center, but heaven forbid that any of that big lobby be used for more space to stand while waiting for your drink. This location makes you realize that in the city rather than in the suburbs, Starbucks only cares about quantity, not quality of locations. I wouldn't be surprised if they had similar locations in broom closets- at least there I wouldn't have to repeat my order 3 times because of the morning rush.

Living near this grocery store is pretty cool.

The prices are generally pretty cheap, and the aisles are well stocked lots of variety of items. I love smoking then just going to the deli and staring at all of the cheeses until I get 3 different kinds to bring home and basically inhale once getting back home.

Produce seems fresh, meat is cheap (although I've seen some meats that have looked bad), and there's at least 20 different kinds of peanut butter and probably even more varieties of queso on the shelves.

Just make sure that your items are being rang up correctly once you get through the suuuper slowwww linessss!

On National Coffee Day, I enjoyed a BOGO deal for two hot coffees for the price of one. I still believe this made my coffee taste better. When I ordered in the drive thru, the woman was very bright and cheery for 9am on a Sunday. She made me smile and I remember thinking, wow if only other drive they'd had her level of enthusiasm and positivity. The coffee tasted pretty standard but right on for the price. I tend to choose Dunkin Donuts for its value. Thank you Dunkin for this deal and for continually wowing me as to how fast you have my coffee ready. It's magic I swear!

I blindly booked this hotel through Hotwire.com's special rate deal. I was glad that I did.

The staff was extremely friendly. The hotel was nice and clean. The location was great as well as it was almost walking distance to all the important sites to see while in New Orleans.

I especially enjoyed their complimentary breakfast. It wasn't your normal continental breakfast which you get in other hotels; they had eggs, biscuits and gravy, sausage, pancakes, waffles, and etc. 

I also enjoyed the complimentary cookies when you walk in/out of the hotel as well.

If I do come back to New Orleans, I'll make sure to stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We came in for the last night of a stay for loosing a family member and wanted to unwind from a stressful week of organizing and cleaning out their home n Tampa area. We went onto Priceline and found a 4 star hotel at a chance bargain. So we ended up at the Sheraton San Key and right away loved how it was away from claustrophobic area by pier 60! From getting a ocean view to Tom the concierge everything was so together at this hotel. 

Looking for the perfect place in Clearwater, this is a great place for couples or families. 

Thanks for the great stay!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Hotel was nice but room was small and nothing like the pictures on webpage. Staff was nice and we enjoyed our visit. But very disappointed on room size. And bed was not very firm. Also paid 35 for parking plus 5.00 for tax. That was a sock never paid 40. For parking including tax 

Very upset that you pay at least 25.00 for outside parking. Everywhere you go. New Orleans is a rip off when it come to parking. Can't enjoy the rip off for paying for parking. 

Hotel is nice but small and not like pictures at all
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: have always been a big fan of the Feliz chain. When living in Manayunk, my boyfriend and I would frequent Taqueria Feliz and never had a bad experience. This was my first time at Cantina though. I was anxiously optimistic that it would be just as good and they did not disappoint. We got chips and salsa to start an the salsa was great.  I got the pork tacos as my meal and the pork had this great crisp to it. My boyfriend got the special which was chipotle chicken tacos and they were equally as good. We will definitely be back.

Ordered delivery from Nori via GrubHub tonight and wasn't super impressed. I ordered two chef's special rolls and a miso soup (rainy night vibe). The soup was what I expected, but the rolls weren't great. The spicy roll wasn't spicy at all and the second roll contained some really mushy eel that was a really unpleasant experience to eat. I order eel all the time from other sushi restaurants and have never had that happen to me before. Nothing made me ill, so that's good! Even so, I will probably explore other sushi options for this neighborhood in the future.

The first trip to Sake Cafe was on my birthday. It wasn't bad, had better, the atmosphere was really nice. 

Second trip there I was getting takeout, the hostess was pretty snooty in general. It took 40 minutes to get 3 orders of rolls to go. 

Third and final trip, I went to a different Sake Cafe, on Veterans, and the hostess couldn't even be bothered to seat us. She looked right at us, yet just sat in the back area talking to another employee. After waiting for 5 minutes, we were walking out the door and she started to come to the front.

I don't recommend this place at all.

This place is very nice and a great value! The room is very spacious and nice.  The staff, while they seem to be stretched thin (front desk/cafe-chef/bartender/fitness center staff all in one), are very nice and accommodating.  The location is great- easy access to the highways to get anywhere, near a shopping center for anything you need (Target, GNC, drugstores, Grocery etc).  They have a happy hour at the bar and will make you a sandwich off the menu, or you can shop at the small commissary which is very convenient.  It's the next best thing to room service, which you can get at a hotel costing 3x what this cost.  Home away from home!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I love the location of this place, the restaurant.... Not so much. I want to but the past few times we've been here have not been the best. 

Our most recent time was for dinner in a Saturday night. I ordered the fish and chips sandwich and there was more breeding then fish which was very disappointing and the bun was huge. Way overpriced got hardly any fish. 

My friend got the salmon and said it was nothing special. 

I like that there is a brick oven for pizza and that's pretty good. 

I don't mind spending money for good food but this was just average. I'll stick with its sister restaurant, The Drafting Room, instead.

As far as places in the Northeast for delivery this is the best place I've gone to since I moved to Rhawnhurst. 

GOOD- Wings are good if you like "wings to go" style, chStk was good and we also had gizmo's which I haven't had in years

Bad- took a long time to get my order in over the phone, delivery guy put a $30 tip for himself on my credit card. I noticed it and he had to go back to the shop to issue me a refund. Good thing I noticed

Food was real good and I'm def ordering from here again.
WAY BETTER THAN AL's or Shef's Pizza

Service was poor; our waiter seemed like he wanted to rush us thru everything, from ordering til the check.

Salads are a decent size, but the tossed salad was bland. I ordered the oil and garlic with anchovies and it looked like fish soup with pasta, nothing like how most restaurants serve this dish. I ate here many years ago, perhaps built up by the 100-year establishment hype. I am not coming back again. I didn't think you could go wrong at any Italian restaurant in the Italian Market. Guess I was wrong. This place is over-rated, if it's even a contender. Next time, Victor's maybe ?

This convenient location is right in the City Museum. After waiting in a short line, I ordered the pulled pork sandwich. I was told that my order would be out in 8 minutes. I held them to that and they called my number (that's how it works) right around that time. 

The food:
Now I know what you are thinking, "Museum food: overpriced and not very good."

I am here to say that this was one of the best pulled pork sandwiches I have ever tasted. There was plenty of seating and my party and I spent the rest of the day walking around at the City Museum. We will be back

just now
Horrible! Came in for the main purpose of getting interior cleaned (started to rain on my way in). And they barely touched it! Paid $21 and inside was barely wiped down! The mats they sprayed off and left standing water in them.. the inside cup holders and by the shifter not even wiped! Seats not even vacuumed! Normally I go to Ridge Pike that's cheaper and does an amazing job but they were closed so I decided to try them out. NEVER AGAIN! Now I need to go home and wipe everything out myself including the mats to get the water off of them!

Went for dinner around 5pm tonight

Quiet. Clean. Adequate atmosphere. Yawn. 

My meal, egg plant parm was kinda warm.  My wife got chicken Marsala which was hot
I had to track down waitress to get my meal reheated. 
It took about 10 mins for my meal to return 
We kinda ate separately because of it. Turn off!
The restaurant had only 8 other patrons. Why the warm meal and slow reheating?

They had an unannounced holiday menu. 
They also didn't accept a coupon because of the unannounced holiday menu. 

First impression ?   Not worth returning as it was adequate and $25 holiday priced entree was boring!!

Nice friendly staff, clean areas and restrooms, along with free Wi-Fi. Donuts and drinks are always fresh and yummy. Parking lot is super small, so be careful backing in and out with the rushing soccer mom's and dad's late to work in the morning. Stay away from the drive through in the AM, it will add at least 5 minutes onto your stop, if not more. My first attempt at drive through was around 20 mins (a lot of coffee specialty orders I guess). Love the little Munchkins aka "donut holes". Keep up the good work inside guys and gals

Stopped for 1 night stay after a show at the Casino. Rated 4 stars on hotels.com and we had a free night stay. Grabbed a budget King suite room just to avoid driving home. Lobby very clean with fresh lemon water. Staff last night was a little chatty with each other during or check in with the person we were talking too. Room was big and bedding very clean, large TV that worked. Bathrooms clean with supplies in wall dispensary. Room had an odd scent to it, not foul or moldy...kind of a dusty Arizona outside smell but all windows shut. Smoke alarm was hanging from ceiling. Overall clean and safe stay though.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The hairdresser did a great updo for my daughter.  She also got her hair trimmed. The haircut was not so good. When we got home there was a chunk of hair longer then the rest that we had too cut off. Then the next day we found another part where we had to cut it again! Very beautiful decor and clean. Was not impressed with the hairdresser's personality though. Nobody wants to be pressured into getting a cut they don't want!! Getting your hair done at this salon is not cheap so I felt like I got ripped off BC if I am going to pay a lot of money for a haircut I expect too get that top notch quality in return. That just wasn't the case here.

I was surprised with How quickly your team handled my whole experience (including the shuttle staff too) when I arrived to Philadelphia from Fort Wayne, IN and the smooth process when I returned the car too! You guys (the staff) were like a well oiled machine but made my interaction funny, quick and affordable too!
I've rented from Enterprise in Fort Wayne, IN but years ago when I lived in Philadelphia I rented a car and that was not a so great experience. So I was just a little leery to use you guys again in Philly. But I did and was amazed. I will definitely use you guys again when I come to Philly and tell my friends too

I just feel like in this desperate situation we're facing and having the "unknown" fall around us, I want to say thank you to our local Publix for hustling the best they can to provide us with waters, paper towels and toilet paper as most people are in a mad dash to stock pile these items. We went in for our daily dinner ideas and just thought in this stressful time this Publix was KICKING BOOTY. Workers putting their own health on the line to stock and help the alarmist of the neighborhood. People be kind, be sweet to others we are ALL IN this together. 
Thank you Publix!    Xo

This place was recommended to me as the "best bang for your buck" sushi in Philly.   It's still not the cheapest place ever for speciality rolls, but it certainly is good - and the $10.95 3-roll special is definitely on point if you don't feel like specialty rolls.  The "Dancing Kani" and "Ocean Brother" are two of my favorites rolls, and I've had trouble finding specialty rolls that are better anywhere in this city.  Service is friendly and fast.  And, it's a BYO that takes credit cards.  

Cons: the place is really small and doesn't take reservations, so if you want to sit in and eat it's going to be a long wait plus some squished elbows.

Adequate if you don't use their drive-thru. I don't know what takes them so long compared to the other First Tennessee banks in the area which are all fantastic in comparison. When it takes 15 minutes to respond to the call button, get a receipt, deposit slip etc., and send something back through the tube during their slow time of the day, there's something wrong. If it were just an isolated incident, then I would completely understand but it's been multiple times now that this has happened. Needless to say, this is not my favorite branch of first Tennessee.

Yogurtology is very clean and has a really nice open space. The modern interior/look of this place attracted me to come check out, but I didn't like that they offered a lot of unique and seasonal flavors than the regular flavors that other places would normally have. The toppings were all fine except the mochi didn't taste like mochi...they tasted weird. On top of that, I also felt like the consistency and taste of their froyo were lacking and simply can't be compared to the Green Island Frozen Yogurt & Tea Bar. Would not recommend.

Clean facility, great customer service, wonderful large washer and dryers, what more could you ask for? 

While searching for a clean and well kept up laundromat in Tucson, we drove by many places that didn't make us fans. Well, we are so glad we used Yelp and found Campbell Laundry and Cleaners!  A variety of washer and dryers sizes with plenty to choose from, staff on site to assist with any questions or concerns, and a clean place with WIFI!  You couldn't get a better place to do your laundry and if that isn't good enough, they will do it for you for an extra fee. So, don't hesitate and use Campbell for any of your laundry needs!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I just had my first experience with Chase Bank. My daughter lives out of town and is in need of a little money. I stopped by with her account number ready to deposit some cash into her account so she could get through the weekend. How on God's green earth does a bank not accept cash. This must be the most moronic policy I've ever heard of in my entire life. They'd be more than willing to sell me a money order and then deposit the money order into her account but they do not accept cash. Are you kidding me a bank that doesn't accept cash?

I spend a lot of time here for someone who doesn't drink much, but when I do the bartender (usually Andre, Otar, or Jim) has my drink ready before I can sit down. I love that Strongbow is on tap. It's easy to become a regular here because everyone is always so inviting and pleasant. Hours are easy to lose between games of pool and shuffleboard. It's a great hole-in-the-wall even though sometimes that aspect attracts random mobs of hipsters that will descend upon the place out of nowhere. I think that really only bothers me, though, ha.

Typical Italian fare, but very well done.  I'd especially recommend Ernesto's for a date - unlike other Italian spots in the area, it's fairly quiet and romantic.

It looks like the offerings have changed somewhat since I was last here based on the menu on their website, but all of the dishes that my guest and I have had during our two trips here have been very tasty.  I especially recommend the pepper fillet if it makes a reappearance on the menu.

And as other reviewers have noted, Ernesto's is a BYO (for a $5 corking fee) but has a full bar.  Can't go wrong with that system!

Embassy suites is okay. The cylinder structure situation leaves you confused as hell once you get off of the elevator so beware. If you want a taxi, not happening. Me and my old lady asked two bell boys for a taxi and they barely made any attempts. No one had a number for the nearest taxi service it was a mess. Needless to say I missed my dinner reservation. Last complaint, out of 28 floors there is only one ice machine on the second floor and the heat in our room was non existent. It's convenient and the rooms are nice, if you're dying of hunger try the complimentary breakfast at Friday's.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My car was making a noise that I knew as not good so I pulled in to Tire Choice and asked them if it was safe to drive. The Manager Karl came out and started the car and thankfully it made the noise right away. He took it right in and had an estimate for me within half an hour.  I did not have an appointment, I just pulled in on my way to work. He then ordered the parts and had to go to Clearwater to get them to have my car repaired on Saturday, so I didn't miss another day of work. I can't say enough about how much I appreciate their level of service. We will definitely be taking our cars there again.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I enjoy sushi. Now, a few years ago I tried their sushi and it reeked. Bad. Then, they found PAUL the sushi master! Each time I go, I buy the Chef Sampler, the Crunchy Roll (I save this one for dessert!) & the Spicy Salmon Roll. 
Thank you Publix for finding and hiring Paul! He comes in three times a day to make fresh sushi. 
5 stars!!!
Also, Paul will do special orders. Just call ahead and you can order whatever you want! :)
Edit 5/1...looks like the sushi prices are going up! If you're a regular like me, pay attention to the prices!

This restaurant has a wonderful view if you're lucky enough to get a window seat.   We had a reservation and were seated in minutes, a plus on a busy Saturday night.  Our two entrees were the veal and the salmon, both of which deserve 5 stars, they were absolutely wonderful.  Our sausage appetizer was severely overcooked, taking back an overall star.  The Ceasar salad was tasteless, (insufficient dressing?) and the ingredients didn't seem fresh, taking back a second star.  Overall, this restaurant has the basics to be one of the best in Reno, but someone should take a look at how the non entre staff is performing.

4 girlfriends and I had lunch at Ooka today and it was wonderful and budget friendly (which is really important to me).  I don't often eat out because I'm trying to save money but Ooka's bento boxes were a good deal.  I choose the tempura chicken option for $11 (see picture) and this included a small salad with ginger dressing and miso soup.  There was plenty of food for lunch and I even brought about 1/3 home and will have to dinner.  My other favorite Ooka items are the sakura roll and crunchy roll but at $9 and $11 each they're a bit out of my budget.

Had a nice lunch there today. My coworker and I decided to splurge and we spent about $50 on 2x soups, 3 appetizers, and 2 rolls. there are 4 sushi places that deliver to us at work, and Wasabi is by far the most expensive choice of the four - but it's also the best quality. 

I used to live 2 blocks from Wasabi and in 3 years, ate their twice. It's just too pricy for an everyday sushi fix, and too quiet & boring inside to enjoy an evening in the restaurant or bar. That said, Wasabi IS one of the best quality sushi options. You trade a boring experience for super fresh food, so it's worth it. The answer to that? Get it delivered like we do.

Ordered food for delivery with a couple of coworkers. It took about 40 minutes for the food to arrive from the time we placed our order, and I understand that this place will deliver anywhere in the St. Louis area, but they are located only about 10 minutes from my workplace so the wait was a little long.

I ordered the Thai peanut quesadilla, which was flavorful and filling. I've seen a lot of complaints about their prices, but their portion sizes are pretty hefty so I'd say the prices are fair.

I wouldn't say this is my new favorite place or anything, but I did enjoy the food and will probably order from them again in the future.

So... over the past 5+ months I have seen some improvements; so they seem to be listening.  

There is noticably one stand out member who has a great attitude and approach.  Inventory has improved but it not 100% yet.  

The improvements have not encourage an increase in the number of stars, but if improvments continue, I can definately see an increase in their future.

Unfortunately, the focus continues to be on money (even over heard loud comments about tips).  That needs to change.

Quality over quantity.  One will be ok with waiting if the experience is worth the wait.
