We were patrons of the Kenner location, but we live in Luling so of course we are thrilled to see another location added right by us. Gendusa's is my absolute favorite Italian to eat. We tried pizza for the first time, and something on it was a bit spicy, so I'm not sure I'll get it again. I may try a plain pepperoni to rule out if it was the sauce or a topping. Otherwise, our usual favorites were still delicious as ever. I swear by the chicken parmesan here and it will feed you 2-3 times, so it's a steal! If you are local to this location, absolutely add this restaurant into your "eating out" rotation. I would hate to see it not thrive here.

If only the last review was true.  Opened acct on April 9, 2015.  As of April 30th, 
STILL no ATM card.  Unfortunately,  have a direct deposit scheduled but thankfully no payroll.  Was yelled at by the Customer Service Mgr who even gave me erroneous info about the whereabouts of my card.  He told me they were " only human"...umm,  think I would prefer an efficient machine.  So much time spent to simply have a working bank system but must mention the atmosphere in the bank is very unprofessional in other ways.  Uncomfortable there, reminds me of Mad Men...too bad there is no Chase in NV.  Now, to find another bank..

I came here because of the great reviews.  HUGE mistake.  We were the only table but it took at least 30 mins before we got our food.  By that time I asked the waitress to just serve everything as it becomes ready instead of waiting.  The chicken teriyaki was just dry deep fried chicken breast with sauce on top.  The nabeyaki udon was so over done, the noodle was soggy, the veggies cooked to mush and chicken dry.  We also had calamari which was tasteless only saved by the hot sauce.  Overall, extremely disappointing since I was expecting a decent meal given the high rating.  This is not Japanese food.  Won't be back.

I particularly like this Little Caesars, the customer service is always good and they own up to their mistakes. I got a free soda (probably put it against his check) because he gave me a Hawaiian pizza instead of 3 meat and had to drive back.

I have been going here for years and I can honestly say its better quality than the others, maybe because they have a different water tap?

Its not unknown that little ceasars can mess with your tummy, which it used to do to mine but maybe I have developed an immunity or they are they have more sanitary staff? Either way, I like the people here and I like the pizzas, keep it up guys.

First time we dined in and ordered the philly steak pizza it was fresh and delicious, few months ago I ordered exact pizza for take out and it was slightly disappointing. It came home very dried and the meat was more of beef jerky style. Tonight we decided to give it another shot and ordered a traditional cheese pizza with a side of fresh basil. I was impressed how they kept the basil on the side so it wouldn't be wilted sitting on the pizza. The pizza was the same as last time we ordered take out. It was luke warm and very dry. The sauce was uneven making it a hit or miss slice. Maybe from now on we should just dine in.

After hearing lots of positive vibes about this Marsh, I finally got a chance to check it out after work.  Free parking in the garage is a great perk, although I get the sense that it fills up pretty quickly.  The salad bar is extensive and everything was fresh. I liked that the fruit & dessert bar was separate from the salad bar.  It made it less tempting :)  Nothing was labeled which is a slight pet peeve of mine.  Check out was quick and efficient.  Will be back during the lunch hour to check out the fresh made sandwiches!

So, I really wanted to rate Old Point Tavern higher.  I mean it has a great location on Mass Ave with plenty of seating (both indoor and patio).  The bar is extensive and the menu has lots of options including vegetarian. 

However, when I ordered one sandwich to go that didn't come out correctly and there was no one else in the restaurant, its hard for me to give anything higher.  In fairness, I would have returned it if I was eating there.  Normally, I'm very understanding especially if its busy, but it was not busy at all.  Staff were just standing around.  It didn't help that the sandwich was just meh as well.

Just got take out... I placed my order by phone, got a call back because one of the items I ordered was no longer on the menu. Picked up the food, which was ready on time and everyone was friendly - good marks there. Came home, sat down to eat and apparently the "Alaskan pallock" described on the menu for the fish tacos is now "Maki", which to those of you who don't eat fish, might sound like no big deal. Imagine if you ordered chicken breast and instead got pulled pork. To me, it makes the dish inedible... I'll survive, but STH, could you please just update your menu on here???

Limoncello... The word evokes the taste of the sweet and sour Italian liqueur if the same name... Go figure... But in our area it also conjures up savory thoughts of the wonderful Italian restaurant in West Chester, the older sibling of this establishment.

Age before beauty. This second location doesn't live up to the family reputation. After two visits, my advice is, skip it. The food doesn't shine, the service is average, and well. My experiences were so poor I'll keep them to myself. 

If you want great Italian food, go to the original in West Chester or have an Italian friend invite you to mom's house.

Great selection of wine but on my 2 recent pick-ups the manager was quite rude. The young man certainly has an attitude that is not becoming of someone working in a retail environment. In fact the last trip I entered 20 minutes before close - yes my fault and after I picked up the wine ordered at their side door I put in cart and went to purchase other items. The young man followed me and asked "are you going to purchase anything as we are closing soon". I said, fine, goodnight. Went to Lukens up the street and spent another $125.

What a quante little place. This was our first visit to this place and we really enjoyed it. Had to check out the candy 1st andc take a trip dowm memory lane of all the old fashioned candies we had as a kid. Also the vintage games and toys were an added bonus. End up getting a old electronic football game. 
The ice cream itelf was delicious. I had a scoop of the vanilla peanut butter( 1st time seeing this flavor) and the birthday cake. My husband had a cookies and cream malt. Thought the ice cream was rich, creamy, and flavorful. Good service as well. We would suggest checking it out.

This place is amazing!! The price is reasonable, the food gives you enough for your meal and lunch tomorrow and to top it off it taste wonderful! I love my dinner her at Joeys and I will certainly be back. I had the eggplant rolittinni and it came with some delicious homemade wedding soup, and a side of pasta with garlic rolls. It was way to much food for me which I dont mond because now I dont have to worry about lunch tomorrow. The food had an amazing flavor and brought me back to my grandmas dinning room table on a Sunday thats how good it was. I will be back and I will start recommending it when people come to town.

I am wondering if the people who work here somehow get screwed over by customers on a regular basis? Not only did no-one smile but they all kept eyeing me suspiciously as I picked up my car. When I went to leave, one of the cleaners asked for my receipt, eyeballing how much I had left him for a tip. I thought they would add a fragrance - nope. My car smelled like all the chemicals they used to clean it and just plain bad. My car smelled better before I brought it in. The detail was okay - I wasn't thrilled but there was nothing big I had to have them go back and do. The one positive is that you can use your Axxess card here and save.

Its a decent place to get "ethinic" ingredients at a decent and fair price. The halal deli meat section is sooooo much better than last year although some of the guys behind the counter move just a tad over the speed of molasses.  The produce is more than fair especially for the quality. I love this store for a quick run as opposed to running somewhere like save alot where healthy choices are limited , my only real complaint lies with the fact that basic items cost a bit more but than again there must always be a trade off.

We were lucky enough to score a 2 top outside. The guacamole was great and had a nice selection of chips and the short rib nachos were delicious. We loved the blood orange margarita and for those who want a virgin drink the blood orange mint fresca was perfect! My friend got the carnitas and really liked it but I got the fish tacos and was disappointed in them. I love the ones from Buena Onda and these sucked in comparison. But besides the fish taco everything else was awesome. I can't believe it took me so long to finally go to Lolita's. Looking forward to going back soon!

I found a go to place for street tacos in Reno.  Tacos El Rey has three locations, i tried the Sutro location.  Ordered three tacos  Al pastor , lengua and cabeza  I will try the chile verde, babacoa and birria the next time. I would definitely order the lengua and cabeza again, the al pastor didn't float my boat  it was a little dry and they used a lot of pepper flakes which doesn't work for me, they're like little time bombs in your stomach , i had to pick them out with a toothpick.  Other than that, i would definitely come here. Maybe I'll try one of their other locations they have three in Reno.

Excellent sushi, creative rolls and some fusion dishes well executed.  Servive on two visits was in the extremes -- need to find balance.  First visit, understaffed and very lax service.  Second visit, aggressively attentive to the point that we could not finish a sentence of conversation as they kept interrupting to ask if they could remove each empty plate -- practically as you put the last bite in your mouth.  The point of our meal together was to talk.  It was nearly impossible.  Very un-Japanese. Neither visit saw them even 25% full.  Both mid-week.
Four stars for excellent food.  Three (or two) stars for all-wrong service.

Finally, finally AWESOME sushi! The best I've ever had and I've been to upscale sushi restaurants that were high priced and just OK. The spicy tuna nachos were marvelous. The Tampa, Mexican, Spicy Tuna, Spicy Salmon rolls, Off the charts! It's  a hidden jewel because you will drive past because most of the plaza is closed, it's tinted windows make it dark and easy to pass. It's not fancy inside or big, but that doesn't matter you'll be so into the awesome food to care. The staff is friendly and make you feel at home. I'll be a lifetime costumer! I'll be telling everyone about this place!

I hardly ever leave reviews on yelp...More of a Google guy...But I felt that I had to share my experience after my recent order today for lunch. First off you would expect $7 for calmari to be somewhat worth it...I ended up with 5-6 overfried pieces of calamari aka just fried coating pretty much. So word of advice don't order the calamari.


Second the actual meal....I got the beef teryaki bento box. Was decently sized.


I had gotten the food Delivered. Showed up the soysauce spilled all over everything. So that was a nice surpise to open the bag too.

Maybe dine in is better. I would hope so because the delivery was horrible.

There is one great server, Jules.  Everyone else seems... listless, clueless, just less.  And why are some foods, such as bagged potato chips, being sold more than one month out of date?  A supposed manager, a tall fellow who seemed swallowed by the responsibility of running a small coffee shop, said, "They're still okay to eat."  Really?  Ok, YOU EAT THEM, and give me some fresh ones, for my HARD EARNED MONEY.  Thank you, kindly.  This is not LV, but people should still give a darn and have some pride in their work, their person, etc.

This place is a hit or miss; more so a miss. I have been here multiple times and I was only satisfied twice. Recently however, I had a horrible experience where my gel polish was lumpy and had changed colors. I went in two days later to have them fixed and the man assumed that I had caused the color to change and that I needed to pay for a gel color change. NOPE. 

Needless to say, this place stays busy. They do speak english, which is nice. I think the service that you receive depends on the quality of the person that you get when you sit down.

Great place to watch football- lots of tvs. Good deals on beer. Watched the super bowl here. I ordered the French dip -pretty plain but ok. My husband ordered the burger and liked it I had broccoli on the side and it was surprisingly good for s bar. $4 bloody Mary's on Sunday were delicious. Fun place!!! Megan was our waitress- she was attentive, friendly, helpful and fun.

Now we are watching march madness here. Cheap beer.  Well drinks r cheap and strong. Lots of tvs. Good nachos. Our waitress lisa is very nice and very attentive.  Will be back!! Great place to watch the games. Even tho msu lost the Iowa fans were fun and Iowa won!!

Brown's Cow is a small ice cream shop with seating for 12 inside and about 6 curbside outside. They carry a variety of Bassett ice cream flavors. The smell of fresh made waffle cones delight you as you enter. The store was clean with nostalgic mementos all over. The young lady at the counter was very nice. I did not try and ice cream or sundaes but opted for a milkshake instead. The milkshake was very good and a decent size at $6.50. The store is cash only so make sure you have cash before ordering. If not, there is a bank located just a stone's throw away.

Convenience cannot be beat. However, I will opt for a 5 minute cab ride next time. 

Curly dark hair under my soap dish. Shower floor is oily/slimey. Towels are thin and worn. Club level food a joke. In-room food unappetizing.  Went to bed hungry and will leave hungry. Menu is stomach turning gross. 

One must pay for wifi.  And I mean high prices. 

Ironing board with iron in room. Absolutely no convenient plug to use iron. 

Furnishings in room are old and dated. Remote needs batteries. 

Very unhappy and disgusted.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
A pleasant surprise just down the street from my house!  I've passed this several times and decided to give it a try.  Larger than it looks on the inside and has a nice decor.  The bar area is kind of small but it was very crowded that night too.  The food was excellent.  I had the walley special and my wife had the steak special.  You get soup, salad, entree with two side for a reasonable price.  

Another surprise was the people!  The crowd was a diverse older crowd that engaged each other and made us feel like home!  Good drinks, food, conversation and live music!  I'll be back.

The place is very old and the equipment is not up to date.  The weights are all over the place and doesn't appears to be managed very well.  If you want to just get a workout with no frills and don't mind searching for weights, then this is the place.  Before moving to this side of town, my anytime fitness in Avon had updated equipment and a staff that was there to help customers and keep the place clean.  

This place is comparable to an old Rocky movie gym with old equipment.  Get in, get to work and get out!  Nothing fancy or welcoming about this gym but it's down the street and cheap.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I used to love this place (spacious, clean, friendly), but after getting a very sloppy gel polish job from the owner herself, I started going elsewhere. It was not only sloppy but I had to go home and file my nails myself because every single one of them had rough edges and were getting caught on my clothes (I told her this before leaving and she told me they were fine in her opinion--they were definitely not). I think they started great when they opened, but quality seemed to go downhill the busier/more popular they became. Way too many nail salons to choose from to leave unhappy. Sadly, I won't be returning.

I went in to start an account for my elderly father. Well the person who was supposedly helping us continually talked down to us and made us feel like his business wasn't wanted. We both quickly got up and left.  
IMO my father was judged by his appearance.  He had a stroke a few years ago and it really messed him up.  But we gladly took his business down the street to Regions who were more than happy to take his money.  BTW my Dad was very successful in his lifetime and was frugal with his money and Regions stepped up and cashed in lol

I've tried this place over the years.  Pizza is ok.  I just got the wings today and they were awful.  So dry they broke when you took a bite.  The hot wings were maybe mixed with mild, but there was a little sauce in the bottom of hot he container.  I couldn't even taste hot though.  I pushed my way through eating them since it out me $20 for 20 wings delivered but I won't be getting them again.  I'll be thinking heavily against ordering here again.  Oh, there was no option to pay by card online, only cash.  Bummer.

I've tried this place over the years.  Pizza is ok.  I just got the wings today and they were awful.  So dry they broke when you took a bite.  The hot wings were maybe mixed with mild, but there was a little sauce in the bottom of hot he container.  I couldn't even taste hot though.  I pushed my way through eating them since it cost me $20 for 20 wings delivered but I won't be getting them again.  I'll be thinking heavily against ordering here again.  Oh, there was no option to pay by card online, only cash.  Bummer.

I used to love this place. I used to order here all the time but the one on airline is more convenient for me now and I have been patronizing this company since their first location in kenner opened I have no issues with the other 2 locations BUT this location has THE RUDEST employees. And the last 12 times i come here I ask myself why I even bothered stopping here and should have just gone to Starbucks. You really need to have a customer service chat with the young lady with long brown Hair and glasses. She always has the worse attitude in the way she greets or lack of greets customers.

I wanted to love Grand Hacienda. It's conveniently located on 4th St. There's a good amount of seating, indoors and out. Very family friendly environment and the prices are reasonable. Service was friendly and the food came fairly fast. 

The margaritas were big and good - the tamarind margarita was very good. The guacamole was honestly the best I have had in Tampa Bay.

So why three stars? The ceviche. It was dry, fishy, and tasted like it had been sitting out all day. Ceviche is ultimately uncooked seafood, which means that when it's bad, it's really bad.

Really on the fence about going back there. If you do, don't get the ceviche

The sushi here is amazing! Tonight was the second time I've eaten here. Although the food is great, the staff is horrible! The first time I went we got the same waiter who did not introduce himself so I couldn't get a name. He was not attentive or friendly. He didn't bring out our waters for 20 mins. We ordered sushi rolls that are suppose to be $5 each after 10pm and he rang up two meals instead. Our bill came out double the amount! We told him and he didn't make the changes. I will never return to this place and it's sad cause the sushi is so good :(

2nd time I've taken my car here, first to replace faulty steering column, was locking a little bit at the time and they fixed the issue with no hassle, 

Today was my second time visiting, they fixed alignment and wheel bearing, car sounds 100% better.

I like the follow up Emails and texts as well explaining the rundown and cost, and the videos they send to your email showing you what's wrong, I drive from Apollo beach to come here specifically due to the fact the service and follow up was great, will recommend and me and wife will make this our goto for car issues, thanks team.

First time going to a mechanic for a problem with my car.  The guys at Rick's were really nice and charged fair prices for parts and labor.  At first visit, they replaced my battery.  My car broke down 2 and a half days later.  They replaced the alternator, and said the battery was fine.  I've wondered if my battery didn't need replacement at the first visit, but I won't know since I didn't check my battery before taking the car there.  Currently the car is working.  I hope I don't have more issues with the charging system.
May go there again.

I haven't needed glasses for most of my life and then it happened! My husband wears glasses. We went on two different days and both really enjoyed the doctor and felt the exam was thorough and well done. I thought the customer service was great and I had a ton of questions. My husband said he felt rushed and when he picked up his glasses that the woman who helped him was rude and difficult. I suppose with anything these days it can depend on who you work with, but we are both pleased with the glasses and will return. They were knowledgable.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: We've wanted to try Yokozuna for some time and finally following a maki craving we ended up there on a Saturday night. It was busy with families and groups but they were able to seat us right away. We ordered the Dragon Eye, Spicy Tuna and Dynamite rolls. They were all fresh, tasty and we left feeling satisfied. The dishes were on the more expensive side but the restaurant has a great atmosphere (despite it's outward appearance in a strip mall) and the servers were very attentive. I would definitely return to try some of the other items on the menu and let's be honest for more deep fried maki.

We've stayed here a few times over the years by virtue of having family in close proximity. The staff is invariably courteous but I have to confess that the place has seen better times. The carpets are beginning to get a bit ragged as is the furniture. On our most recent sojourn, the water would not drain from the bathtub - the lady in the reception was kind enough to find us another room but the room smelled strongly of frying oil (!)........ given that it was way past our bedtime, we chose to keep the room. Think the innkeepers need to up their game a bit here...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I moved here in October 2016 and am very pleased to be here.  The grounds are kept in very good condition and when I've had a maintenance issue the fellas have been here to fix it immediately!  WOW!  Also I've found the ladies in the office to be very nice.  I travel a great deal so the fact that my packages are delivered to the office is a real bonus to me.  The complex (my building anyway) is quiet and the neighbors are respectful of one another.  My view is spectacular.  I've only good to say about this place I now call home.

Came here for their 80th birthday special. Buy one dozen get another dozen for .80. The first time I came they were out of glazed donuts. Said the truck will be here in an hour! I thought they made it fresh in the store!! They had the conveyor belts and equipment for it. So ok, I'll run some errands around here. Came back and the line was out the door! Service was extremely slow. They had so many workers but not efficiently working.  

The donuts are good for a quick fix. The prices are kind of high and they got rid of their combo deals. The only time it's worth coming is if you have any coupons or if there's a special going on like today.

It's burger king, and it's in the hood. How can that go wrong? Look, the location is filthy, the weirdos hanging around are sketchy and I was the only person in the drive-thru and I still had to wait to get my food. They had me park in the front and had to bring my food out to car after about 5 mins. It is what it is, right? Oh, and ask for light or no mayo. That was half of my sandwich,mayo. Gross amounts of mayo, if you know what I mean. And lastly, the buns smelled moldy. It wasn't a great experience. It's just another reason to not eat fast food I guess. Don't go here if you can avoid it.

No offense to the sweet people who own this place but I will never be back. I got meat and 2 sides. I got baked chicken because nothing behind the glass looked all that edible. It was decent but nothing to it. Two small pieces of baked chicken. The sides are very limited. I got Mac and cheese it was alright. And mashed potatoes. They were terrible. The roll was cool as well. It was close to $10 for this meal and I was highly dissatisfied. The people working we're kind but I will not return as that is too much for bad food. There were many people in there however so maybe it was an off day for them.

I come here once in a while because it's close to home. Service is usually friendly. I've been in a couple times since the Holiday Drinks have been out and they have been out if the skinny mocha syrup each time. This is not something that is random.  I have found that they do not always have their products in stock. This can be frustrating when you are expecting a certain specialty coffee. 
Parking is usually limited because of the other businesses around. Drive through is usually pretty easy to get through.  It is always warm and friendly when we go in.

We went to Tre Scalini a few evenings ago and had a wonderful dinner. The service was timely but we never felt hurried. The overall atmosphere was relaxed and casual. Most importantly the food was excellent.  We shared a few appetizers between a table of four (some we chose, some recommended spontaneously by our waiter) and then enjoyed delicious entrees - lobster ravioli, black papardelle pasta with prawns, and lamb popsicles. All of our meals were prepared perfectly and were portioned well. We don't live in Philly, but plan to go back for another meal the next time we're in town.

I am actually considering paying for an entire road trip from San Francisco to Santa Barbara JUST to eat dinner at Sakana. This place is on another level - and I cannot imagine another restaurant getting close to the quality, creativity, and ambience that Sakana offers its diners. My boyfriend and I would plan date nights at Sakana regularly and stop for ice cream afterwards in the adorable downtown Montecito. Each time we would order different rolls and each time, my expectations were surpassed. HANDS DOWN THE BEST SUSHI I HAVE EVER HAD. thanks Sakana - we miss you!

I'll begin with the positive...the staff was very friendly and accommodating upon check-in. 
But Reality check to previous reviewers...this holiday inn express IS DATED and not the best HIE out there!  We stayed one night in the king rm that another viewer posted. 

The bed linens were wrinkled and the overlay on the bed had soiled spots visible to the eye. 

The tub as well as the sink kept getting backed up. 

The furniture had the appearance of being second hand goods. 

We stayed at previous HIE's and the decor was extremely up to date and modern....this one was a HUGE disappointment. Sorry...  :-/
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Literally the slowest Starbucks I have ever been to in my entire life AND THEY WEREN'T EVEN BUSY!!! There were four freaking baristas working, two people ahead of me in line (one didn't order a drink, just a slice of lemon pound cake) and it still took 20 full minutes to get my tall iced coffee which literally requires no fancy mixing. You just pour the coffee from the pitcher and some cream and viola! I almost asked if I could make it may damn self at one point. So frustrating, every time I come here it's slow. I have to remind myself to not come to this one.

Okay, so I have to update my review for Target. As much as I don't want to, I am just not satisfied with my past experience. My vision insurance had changed over the past year and I called to see if they took it - and they did. When they ran it, they ran it incorrectly so it charged me more than they should have. I have been going back and forth with my insurance to get the money back for the past week and it's very frustrating. I don't think I will be back. Just make sure you double check your insurance and don't always take their word for the costs - you never know if you are getting overcharged!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is a newer location, but it's been over a year now.  It appears to be staffed by teenagers - who are consistently very nice.  However, the drive thru is chronically backed up, often onto the street.  I understand it only takes one idiot ordering the whole menu in the drive thru to cause a problem (one of my biggest pet peeves).  My issue is after I wait in that line for one or 2 drinks, they are regularly wrong at this location.  If you order Splenda, you get sugar, if you say 1 pump or light cream, you get a cup of milk.  These kinks should have been worked out by now, but only seem to be getting worse.

In reference to the hot/cold bar and (what used to be) sub shop, Giant is nearly 20 years behind Wegmans (even Acme back in the day), and about 20 behind Publix. Why would you build a brand new store complete with 'eatery' and label an area sun shop/panini grill when all you get is Turkey Hill quality premade food? You would think with this new update to carry alcohol, they would realize how sad their food bar area is. Walk into Wegmans and you are met with amazing food. Walk into here for lunch, and you will probably buy Ramen.

I have been telling my wife stories over the past two years of this little restaurant I went to in Philly that reminded of my grandmother's (Nona) kitchen.  The moment she walked in she smelled the sauce cooking in the back and gave me that acknowledging smile.  She too knows my rants and raves were true.

Every Italian dish on the menu is an absolute delight and a throwback to what my kin used to cook for me when I was a child.  I sit here now in upstate NY imaging be back right now enjoying the tastes of my past.

Do not hesitate to visit and stay for dinner.

Aldi closed this location, moving to the Indian Lake area.  I have to say that I'm disappointed.  The previous location was close to my home, and where they moved to is a heavy traffic area, which I try to avoid.  Also, what Aldi a great place to shop was partially because they weren't a big store like Kroger and Walmart.  Yet, they're trying to become more like that with larger stores, more selections, and more non-food items.  I don't like the layout and the larger format.  Aldi used to be great because you get all of your grocery shopping done in a short amount of time.

Only reason I'm giving this place 2 stars is because the food is good.... when it comes that is.... we ordered today at like 7:40 through Grubhub. At 8:50 I was calling to see where the food was and they didn't even bother to pick up the phone. When I got tired of calling the pizzeria at 9pm, I called Grubhub who was able to get in contact with Wyoming. They had the nerve to tell the customer service representative that they never received the order and that they are closed. Super unprofessional and just plain rude!

We came for dinner for the first time in several years for a special occasion. Our server was amazing and so attentive, but the food was incredibly disappointing! Our salads came out warm and almost wilted. My entree was great but my husband's steak was stone cold in the middle, even after sending it back once. They re-plated the vegetables and upgraded side of pasta onto a cold plate and the steak was still cold! We talked with another couple there and they said they had been coming for years and their food was cold as well. Such a disappointment; we won't be returning!

Eh, this Starbucks is hit or miss.  Unlike some of the other reviewers here, I've typically had pleasant interactions with the staff as it pertains to personality, but the wait times here are tremendous.  They're so slow that the traffic gets backed up well into the street, which, during a morning commute in Brentwood, is very frustrating.  In short, this is a fine place to go on a slow Saturday morning when you can go inside and have time to wait, but stay as far away as possible if you'r eon any sort of schedule.

I don't normally give 5 stars for anything, but in this case I will. I've been looking for a old school barber for a long time. Every other place is only into the close to the scalp hair style or quickie in & out. They won't listen to the customer or take the time to understand how you want your hair done. Today I had the pleasure of having my hair done by George at FishHawk Barbershop. After showing him a picture of how I wanted the back to look and overall style he completely understood and gave me the best cut I had in a long time. After all these years, I have found a great barber. I look forward to my next visit at FishHawk Barbershop.

Man oh man, I usually don't do a review talking about food poisoning cause you never quite know if it really was them, but this is different. I got a basic carne asada burrito around 11am. I didn't eat anything else all day as I was busy, and come 6pm I was hurting. I will spare the details but let's just say I spent a significant portion of my night in my bathroom. It is now the next morning and I will be taking a sick day from work. I looked up the health department record on this place and it is not pretty. STAY AWAY!!!

Came in today for a quick lunch since its right down the road from my house. I got the two shredded beef tacos combo, which was good nothing really amazing, but good. I had two friends with me and they were both disappointed in their meals. The tamale was very very dry, and said the enchilada was not very flavorful. The service was very friendly so no complaints there, and for three of us the bill was $28 and some change, so pretty affordable. Bottom line is it is a ok Mexican restaurant, but being in Tucson, there is A LOT better places to go and spend your money.

Coming from a paying club member of mister, this ine does seem pretty good! Just wish there was more locations around. The tunnel that washes really does a good job, and they kinda "pre-wash" before you go in. They have bigg we parking for bigger vehicles, or just so you don't feel so cramped in there. The very basic wash was only $6, which is cheaper then the others around town. The one downside is that the employees could use a little more in the customer service area, but it wasnt horrible. I took the work vehicle today, I just may have to come back with my personal sometime.

Hit or miss on both the food and service, I work nearby so I am forced to visit this location. In the last two years I can sadly say I have visited this location over 100 times for breakfast or lunch, they typically can get your order ready fast but it might come out wrong, not fresh or with a side of attitude. The do have several employees that are great but it takes more than one or two shinning stars to offer what most other Casper owned locations typically offer. I hope they change but I wont hold my breath.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Miserable employees = horrible service. Couple in front of me offered the cashier the extra .40 cents to make the .60 cents change coming back to them a dollar. The cashiers response was "Oh, no... I've already tendered it" and closed the drawer. During my transaction, the cook out of nowhere started yelling at the cashier about some  bread from across the work floor. This distracted him damn near into a coma. While waiting for my order they managed to somehow mess up 2 orders prior to handing me my own messed up order. I love Dunkin' Donuts.. the ppl they hire ill trained not so much.

This place is pretty good but I only gave it 3 stars because its pretty pricey. The thin crust is good.. we got 2 of the 14" pizzas. A buffalo chicken and a deluxe. They were tasty and they were more than willing to bring out the condiments. The first bite of the buffalo was really salty.. I don't know if I just got a bad first bits or what. The pizzas were around 18 bucks each which was pretty steep for the sizes. The waitress was very nice and friendly.. and the place was clean. Prices could be better. We used a bogo coupon so it wasn't a bad price.. but I honestly wont go again if I don't have a coupon.

This is the WORST McDonalds I've ever eaten at, and it's only a mile away from my house. They routinely put pepper on their hamburgers but don't warn you - YUCK! And they CHARGE now for adding mayo, but don't give you a break for keeping the lettuce or pickles.

They told me their Peppermint Mochas can be made in sugarfree, then the person making it told me no, only vanilla and caramel are in sugarfree.  THE WORST THING?  When I told her I am diabetic, she actually told me it "will be ok, my aunt is diabetic and she drinks them all the time."  CAN YOU BELIEVE THAT?  She could kill somebody!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I love trying new places based on Yelp reviews. My family loves sushi and we had never heard of Kazoku before so we decided to give it a try.

First impression was this place was packed and there was not enough staff. We weren't even acknowledged when we first walked in which made us uncomfortable.  We waited about 5 minutes and then the server  said hello and already had a table ready for us. 

All the sushi we tried was great. Their Korean beef was also really good. What better way to end a great meal than with some complimentary plum ice cream. Can't wait to go here again.

This is a decent grocery store. They have pretty much everything your typical grocery store would offer. One extra offering they have though that I liked, were the freshly boiled crawfish out in front of the store, yum!

Prices seemed in line, and the staff I interacted with were friendly and helpful. I wasn't a fan of the layout though inside the store. It's very cramped at times, and maneuvering with or without a cart can prove challenging. 

If you're there during a busy time, don't expect to get in and out very fast, but if you go at a non peak time, this is a good store to do your shopping at.

Most of the review here seem really good but when I went in, there was no variety of froyo at all...only two flavors (orange and coconut vanilla), which is really uncommon for a froyo shop. I went in expecting more flavors to be honest. 

Since I was stuck with those two, I took one of each. Orange flavor really tastes more like orange sherbet than orange froyo (so not my favorite). But the coconut vanilla flavor was HEAVENLY!! So delish! So good! 

Ambient overall was nice, service was nice but I wish they had more flavors when I went in.

Went in around 11:30 am on a Sunday with one of my girlfriends. The hostesses informed us that there were no available tables (with an almost empty dining room) and if we wanted we could sit at the bar. We said okay, to their dismay it seemed. I ordered the quiche and it was great. My friend order their waffle. Bar staff was inattentive for how empty it was. My Bloody Mary had way too much hot sauce but the food was good. Dining room was still half empty when we left, would be a great place if the hostesses could relax and let people have tables

OK...this restaurant just went through the whole makeover thing and you know, it's dump already!  Tables and chairs are sticky the last two times we went in and the bathroom is as bad as the Walmart behind it.

Let's talk about the food...(if you call it that).  The fries have way too much salt that we almost had a heart-attack on the spot.  We tried a couple of their sandwiches and they are just OK.

I used to love Wendy's and this restaurant totally destroy my love for it.

I blame the management!

If you want a better meal at the same price range, try the Chick-Fil-A next door or Panera accross the street.

I stayed at this hotel over the Memorial Weekend. I was just in town to visit Nashville. I love Nashville its one of the favorite cities on earth. This hotel was great. The rooms were comfortable and the service service was great, my own complaint is the sales tax is way too high. It's a great place to stay because its in Brentwood a leafy suburb of Nashville but also very close to get to Broadway and 2nd Ave, I believe it only took me about 10-15 mins I may drive a bit fast. I have a fast car. Anyhow I would recommend this place for anybody that nears to stay near Nashville but also wants a safe quiet place to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: First impression great service and the food is wonderful, the waiters are very attentive. I decided to order the sushi and some appetizers with hibachi just to try it out. My overall rating for my dinner is 4 stars, the sushi was right amount and very tasty, the rice was perfect and the fish is not dry, the hibachi part i was really too excited we ordered the fillet minion with shrimp, the meat was perfectly cook but the portion of the meat wasnt too extravagant but still cooked right. I will come back in the near future but not for the hibachi.

Worst I have ever been too. I purchased at least one Starbucks a day at various locations. This is by far the weakest. Employees tend to lean on the rude side, service is very slow and forget doing a mobile order. They apparently loose them half the time. If the manager is reading this, which I doubt, maybe it's time to close the store again but this time loose the diversity training and focus on doing what you are in business to do. Provide service that matches a $4 cup of coffee. Last I checked McDonalds was across the street for $1.

we went 3 three times. we found a deal from groupon, we went on a sunday the first time, the manager had a better deal going on; like half price on sushi rolls, so we did that, and we didn't use the groupon, we went for a second time after a week, we got a free appetizer and free dessert we didn't use our groupon again, the third time they just didn´t want to take our groupon and they told us to return it!! the food is okay, we got the love boat the third time,  careful using coupons here! you better take the deal they offer in house! i honestly don´t want to go back never again! 

food & drinks = okay
service = sucks!!

First and last time!  Make reservations for 6 people on Saturday night and the lady on the phone said "6 really"?!?   Not sure what that meant but figured it out when we got there.  Two square tables pushed together and a 3rd round table, push into them which was awkward and squished.   Shrimp over cooked, lasagna looked like dog food and the appetizers were small.  The service was bad.....they delivered the food and never came back to even check on us until they wanted to clear the table.  Best park of the meal was the lemon "pie". Not coming back......

Good martini. Pleasant service. 

They list conch on the sushi menu which delighted me, only to be told after I ordered it that they stopped carrying it some time ago. 

Rice paper roll outstanding. Fresh and stuffed with vegetables. Yellow tail roll very tasty as well. 

Noisy bar blessedly separated from main dining room. Found the dining room too brightly lit, however. I don't know why this concerned me, but for a dinner after the sun has set one rather expects a less Shoney's-like ambience. 

But, it's a casual neighborhood joint so take it as it comes. I enjoyed my meal and look forward to wandering in again.

This is a starbucks; it's very similar to other Starbuckes and in fact I love Starbucks. They deliver top quality products and services, treat their employees well, give back to the community, and work toward a sustainable environment. This particular starbucks, however, recently underwent a renovation and I have to say, I'm not a fan. The stark white and dark browns are harsh on the eyes and that combined with the new angular furniture no longer feels warm and cozy. Worse still is the parking situation and by that I mean there are often no spots left because there aren't many in the first place. Major oversight in design here.

This is a place you're not going to drive by and just happened into. I've heard good things about it and that's the reason why we came. Maggie's is  tucked off the main road in a little strip center in the middle of nowhere, down in Fenton Missouri. Service was great, quick, fast & attentive. Pretty basic for a diner type atmosphere that they're running . would go back if I was in the area ,but definitely have no reason to be back in that area. unless I worked at one of the company's adjacent to the establishment you have no reason to be there

The great thing about the Park Tavern is that, the whole time you're in there, it seems like somebody's mother is going to come downstairs, ask what the ruckus is, and chase you out.  It's just a relaxed place in Palmyra (which is just on the other side of the Taconey Palmyra Bridge, my Philly phriends) which clearly used to be a house.  The bartender is friendly and is enthusiastic about his hiccup remedy.  They do have some food, but it's really a place to come and watch a game and have a beer.  Maybe shoot on the pool table or throw some darts.

We only stayed for one night. I really wanted to love this hotel, but it definitely had its pros and cons. All in all, we were pretty happy with the room and its cleanliness, and the pool amenity until it was time for bed. The soundproofing was pretty bad, and it kept our one year old who is a light but good sleeper up all night. Also, the bed was like sleeping on a bed of rocks. When checking out I did give the feedback and the man at the desk gave an insincere apology. Breakfast bar was high quality. The experience was good, but I'm mostly disappointed in the quality of the mattress.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not being a east nashvillian, I didn't really know where to go for wine. I work in the area and needed to grab a couple bottles on my way home. After passing wiess and here multiple times going to and from work, I decided on Main Street. So glad I did! They carry my favorite wine (gazela-vino verde) which I have a hard time finding ANYWHERE consistently. Not only that, it's 3/$21.99! I purchased all the wine for my wedding and for thanksgiving this year here.  The staff is always welcoming and ready to help.

*AVOID* Not only did they cut my nail down so far it sliced it underneath the nail and was bleeding into the towel, the nail tech then shoved the tip into the cut as she attempted to glue it on.  After the 45 minutes of pain I then was told I had to pay full price.  Thought I'd give it one more shot since all I had to do was get 1 nail fixed and it's close.  I was treated horribly for not getting my nails done there, was told the colors on their swatches weren't available then told they only accept cash or check so I had to go to an ATM.  After all of that, my nail is still broken 2 days later.

We had lunch here before so we decided to come back for a special occasion. Portions were much smaller this time, but food was good. I can remember when plates of lemon or sweet sour chicken came piled on a plate. It now seems to be routine to have a few pieces scattered around to make it look like something when people are paying $1 a bite. It was not ok when the Mu Shu was served with tortillas instead of thin pancake wraps.  I am also wondering how much MSG was used. After dinner I started to ache like crazy and had to go to bed. The next day I ate the leftovers and same exact thing happened again. I doubt we will go back.

Quiet neighborhood yet close to the interstate so easy access to everything.  If you are worried it is too far away from downtown, etc.-don't.  The drive is not that far and you don't have to pay the parking fees those fancy places charge! Clean, quiet rooms and comfy beds.  We stayed three days and the quality was consistent.  The staff was very respectful and eager to assist.  The rate was great compared with others in the area.   Don't stay here for the breakfast though.  It fills the need, but is nothing to write home or Yelp about. Therefore, this is the end of this review.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The best way to describe our meals at this Brown Boxer restaurant...surprisingly strong. We read other various reviews prior to going and had some reservations. However, our experience was great.

Started with the Stone Crab soup...had a good cream sauce and was filling. My grouper sandwich was cooked well and was tasty. The fries were hot and seasoned perfectly. My wife's southwest salad was loaded with more than just lettuce. 

Service was pleasant and attentive; parking was not an issue, which is shocking for Saturday night on Clearwater Beach.

Possibly the most creative sushi ever!  Favorites include the habanero yellowtail melt and the sea bass appetizer is the best.  The uni was so fresh that it was actually moving (great texture and taste).  I would agree that the service although not bad was not friendly or personable.  The hostess and waitresses were more engaged with each other and seemed to congregate at the end of the sushi bar hence the 4 star rating, however I observed that the busboy was excellent attending to all of the tables and made sure that the turnovers were seamless.  Definitely a fan of Sakana!

We LOVED Ixca! My coworkers and I ordered carry out for our monthly lunch meeting. The call ahead ordering was super easy. The service was very quick. The food was so good and so fresh!

Shrimp, Chicken, Carne Asada, and Pastor Tacos: Delicious! Great flavor. Get the hot salsa on the side and enjoy a little heat. Definitely would come back!

Chicken Nachos: Plenty of chicken. Very flavorful. Big Portion!

Mole Platillos: This was very good! I liked how the "heat" is sneaky! The chicken itself was very tender. I look forward to trying more from Ixca!

I stopped going here years ago but bought a new enclosed trailer and decided to try this place again. It's still terrible. The soap actually stains your vehicle looks worse then when you started. The timer doesn't work don't swipe your card there's no way to extend your time it's just another $5 the people there don't offer to help with the selection timer even when they know you're having an issue. The foam bush wand leaks all over you. The high pressure wash is not high pressure and the trigger on the wand doesn't work. Go somewhere else.

Man. . . .this place is awesome! For a while, I was going to Total Wine to buy all my stuff, but then I was introduced to Plaza. I really like their selection of beer and whiskey. They do have other spirits and wine among other local things, but I haven't spent much time going through that part of their stock. One of my favorite beers is kept here regularly: Anderson Valley Bourbon Barrel Stout. If they don't have something on their shelves they will do what they can to try and bring it in and even take down your name and phone number  to give you a ring when they get it in(if they can get it, that is).

This place has to be the worst sushi place I have ever been. I went for the Sunday brunch with my sister. I love the Sherwood park one so since they opened one that is closer we decided to give it a try. Never again. There was not a lot of variety and the food did not look fresh. The sashimi was not the best. Tuna was very fishy, no matter if they were in the maki rolls or by itself. They also add in 15% gratuity so it comes out to be $42 a person. To be honest, I would rather go to tnt supermarket and get $42 worth of sushi and it would taste 100X better than here.

I'm not a fan of all you can eat places but I was pleasantly surprised. The sushi was good and the hibachi was also good. The fried rice was the worst I've ever had but everything else was really good. The crab Rangoon was awesome! Highly recommend! The beer was not very cold but maybe it was because they were so busy! We ordered the dancing crab roll, tempurA, and Christmas tree (spicy tuna). All were great. Adults are about 20$ with tax for all you want! Can't beat that just for the options. Jose was our waiter and he was great!!!

Great, affordable place for the family. The ingredients are top notch, the flavors are always changing, and there are more toppings than you'll ever need. The decoration is modern and very nice. Love that they have a frequent customer card. Typical cost for our family of four is $12 which works out to $3 a person. Of course it is pay by weight, so if you go nuts you will pay more. I've been to other local ice cream places with the family and we never get off that cheap for four servings. Love it and highly recommend.

Horrendous sushi here. A lot of the "crunchy" salmon or "crunchy" tuna were not actually crunchy. There were some rolls that were sooo mushy it was hard to finish. The apps were decent but pricey for small portions. It was completely dead when we came in on a Sunday at around 4-5pm. 

Service was okay, only 1 receptionist and 1 waitress. Then again, no one there they needed to serve but us. They did seem to get lots of take out.

The actual venue was outdated and decor was poor. Bright orange walls opposing red walls. Plenty of empty tables for large and small groups. 

Would not come back for anything here. Happy eating.

I prefer the old management better. The staff here is friendly, don't get me wrong however the quality of the work (I would only get pedicures here) has declined. This used to be THE spot for me as my daughter attended the dance school on the next block which allowed me time to get a pedi while I waited. I live about 25 min away and would come here even when my daughter was not at dance school. It is no longer worth the trip. I have never taken advantage of the nail services, I can only speak of my experience as far as pedis go.

So far so good. I just checked in so if they make me mad before I leave, I'll be sure to update my review lol. The room is beautiful and the hotel as a whole is beautiful. It's also very clean but I always do my own pre-cleaning no matter what hotel I stay in. The staff that I've encountered so far has been friendly. Like I said... So far so good.
Okay so I just found out that they do not offer a continental breakfast. You would think a hotel of this caliber would at least offer a free breakfast. Since they don't, I took away a star. Lol
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I can't comment too much on the customer service inside the bank since I mainly use my phone/atm for all of my transactions, but when I went in to set up my account the woman helping me was great at explaining the differences in banking plans. If you go with the chase liquid account they actually don't charge you all that much for maintaining your account. I think it's like $5.00 a month or so. Chase still has it's flaws *cough* phone support service, but I'll continue banking with them as I've ran into very few problems.

Doctor gives extremely informative care- the downfall is his front desk staff and the dusty offices. I scheduled with this office in person. There was no mention that the desk was unable to accept credit cards or able to bill when I scheduled. Office technology is definitely not up to date or pace with competition. Staff had to "ask manager" if I could have approval to return with my $10 co-pay, meaning that for some people this is an option. I'm still unsure why this was not an option for me, but I am sure that I won't be back. There are plenty of accommodating optometrists in the local area for those commercially insured. See yah!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This place makes any dive bar a Michelin 5-star Resort. As Bette Davis put it, "What a dump!" It's fabulous. Hahaha. Just off-duty servers, Wawa crew, and the greatest collection of Media's fine crazy people round out this diverse crowd of the fun-loving and the depressed. Hahaha. Drinks are cheap and strong. Internet-linked juke box, REALLY FANTASTIC food, and some new drama story every few minutes. Perfect way to end a rainy-night. Everybody knows each other, it really is the epitome of a good ol' neighborhood dive bar.

Summary:  Watch your back.

I went to this location on a weeknight at 8pm and was told that they don't accept people walking into the lobby after 7pm for protection issues.  You had to use the drive-thru and then sit in the parking lot and wait for your food. 

So if it's not safe for the workers...why is it safe for people to sit in their cars in the parking lot?

It's Little Caesar's Pizza.  It's not THAT good that you want to be at risk to wait for it.

Bottom line:  There's PLENTY of other pizza places and even other Little Caesar's locations.

First off let me begin by saying I'm from Tucson so I should have known better. I would have given this place less than one star if it was possible. Husband order cheese enchilada dinner and I had the los amigos dinner. I don't know what type of cheese is used here but it isn't right. Tastes almost like white American cheese. The salsa that came with chips was ok but the chips were very bland and they obviously not homemade. The tortilla soup had fresh avocado but the broth tasted like it was made with a bullion cube as it was extra salty. The best part of the meal was the sweet tea which was excellent.

This place is pretty legit!  I question to write it because I don't need the place to get anymore popular. This is a tiny tiny sushi spot, so do not come here with a large party. 

They have a variety of sushi options from your standard roll to specialty rolls. A popular option is the tuna dumplings and their $11.99 special (includes 3 rolls). 

The place is a byob but offers bottled water and canned drinks. Green tea is also offered for free!

I have yet to come without waiting at least 30 minutes so make time to wait and even though the workers will tell you the wait will be 20 minutes... they are lying lol.

This is the best McDonald's and all of Reno's to get chocolate dipped cones from. They must teach their employees how to make them and how to make them right because my kids and I never go away I'm happy. They are always good size and always delicious. I will drive from across town on my way home to stop by this McDonald's knowing that they make them right over here instead of getting a small one at a different McDonald's. It is definitely worth the drive. The workers are always polite and friendly. Highly recommended.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I've both eaten at their restaurant and taken out. Everything that I've ordered has been good both ways. I don't think they are the best pizza "hands down" like the other review that I read but it is good. (-1 star). The menu that they have online lists a large variety of gourmet panini sandwiches. They haven't made these in some time and haven't updated their online menu to reflect this for at least a year. (-1 star). I spent time trying to choose 2 different ones for my wife and I and was very dissapointed when they had no kinds of paninis.

Room 106 has a broken tile leading into the shower.  Because of the broken tile the shower door would not close completely.  Also you'll notice that the tile appears to need a good scrubbing! Barring the shower issues the room was as expected.  I would also recommend having more than one person manning the front desk.  The ladies handling check-in, check out, and answering my questions couldn't have been more professional but each time I saw them they were being brow beaten by other guests.  Thank Goodness they were able to contact security, but perhaps safety in numbers would have defused the situations.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The yogurt is normal and they have the regular expected toppings. Nothing particularly special, a pretty average yogurt place. 
Points off because I guess sometimes they close earlier than their times posted on the door. One time I tried to go and they had closed a half hour early and machines were already shut off. We had even called earlier that day to make sure of their closing time because we were driving back from out of town and wanted to stop by before they closed. I thought that was pretty inconsiderate of customers, not sure if it is the fault of the store though or just lazy workers that day.

I've been a Sweat member for over 4 years, started with the Fitler Sq location as my primary, then Passyunk Sq, sometimes used to hit up the Queen Village spot. Passyunk is the best out of the 4 I've hit up. 

The Manayunk location is pretty janky, they always have buckets out catching water when it rains and there's a physical therapy office there so sometimes sharing the space/machines seems ridiculous. Mainly, it's nice that there are women in the weight areas a lot and it's not really a meat market. The staff are nice and it's always as clean as they could get it to be, considering there's some grime you just can't scrub.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This place was simply outstanding! We went as a group of four for dinner. We had reservations and went right up on the elevator. We were sat within five minutes. The ambiance was trendy, romantic and impressive. Astounding large flower arrangements everywhere. The view was gorgeous. The only issue was the music was a little too loud for us all to hear each other just at our table at times. The food came out quickly and every dish was outstanding. I highly recommend this restaurant! We will certainly be back.

I believe that this is the only frozen yogurt place in Land O Lakes besides a couple of gas stations that have a frozen yogurt set up.  The place is small and the variety of flavors is slim. Especially since they were out of 3 of the flavors. There are quit a bit of toppings. There was no crowd when I entered and the young lady behind the counter did greet us, although she was doing something on her phone the entire time that we were there and we dined in.  The place looks clean and bright. Wortha try but nothing to get excited about.

Last time I ordered the delivery from this restaurant. I ordered a chicken pot with two rice bowl. I would say the rice bowl is good. The main dish chicken pot taste is okay. But it is not worth the price, +gst it is around 38 dollars. And I've attached the picture so you can see whether it is worth it or not. And for delivery I need to add 3 dollar delivery fee and 4 dollar tip, the total I spent is 45 dollar. And then I got this (see the picture) , so I am kinda disappointed. If you want to try this restaurant, you just go there but don't order delivery. It might be better if you eat there cuz I've never been to this restaurant.

Good South Philly Jawn, a place were family and friends can go and feel like home.Came here by mistake due to the fact that I though I was going to the fine restaurant next door. (Can not use gift card from this place for the restaurant next door, which really ticked me off)
The waiter aka Charlie Hustle who works the back room deserves a statue out front for the amount of quality effort and work he puts in. Great work/service! The ZA was OK but not the best in the area. BEST part of this this place is that it is a BYOB.

World class joint, with some of the most blue collar bartenders around. The Coach also known as the Sheriff runs a tight ship and has a heavy elbow. Drinks are always ice cold and the DJ on the weekend makes the ladies panties fall to the floor. The locals love to chop it up about the Philly sports teams BUT beware of the Crypt Keeper who slithers around the happy hour crowd talking nonsense, he will chew you ear off. Perfect places if you looking to play some competitive shuffleboard or darts. All in all, this place feels like home.. if you cant buy happiness you can sure as hell buy a beer HERE!

It was our first visit here and I can say , this is one of our favorite places now to eat Mexican food in the area. We have tried several places around, but this place provided more flavorful food at decent prices. The portions were filling and we even had to get a box to take some home. 
I had Nacho Fajitas and my husband had Chimichangas. Cheese sauce had a nice spice to it. Nothing was bland, everything we had was delicious, hot and fresh. It is now one of our go to spots for Mexican. We will be returning.

Great restaurant.  Great food. Super service.  We visit as often as possible.  When possible the kitchen will go out of there way to accommodate  special requests.  There foods are home made, not out of cans and frozen boxes of food.  Crab cakes are the best I've ever had, lump crab meat not lump BREAD like most restaurants.  I like the fact that you are given time between courses to relax and talk, not like most restaurants that you no soon finish one course then the next is plopped down in front of you - so refreshing not to be rushed through a meal so they can make room for the next group.  Keep up your great work Botto's.

Florence Solomon

This place is close to where I live so I often go in here when I need something.  What I like is that it is pretty new (maybe a few of years old).  It's clean and quite spacious.  I love the fact that they have a liquor store and offer a good variety of different alcohol beverages. I love drinking foreign beer brands and I was quite surprise with the variety of brands they have in the back.  The price is a little more expensive than some of other grocery stores I have been in, but it's nice to have a place close to home.

Enjoyed my stay. Hotel is kinda old so there were a couple of hiccups with the water drainage, nothing too alarming. Friendly staff, hotel has 3 restaurants- all have bars. And a Starbucks is attached. It's located right beside the arch so great location. About 10-15 minute walk to the convention center. Rooms were a nice size and pretty clean. All in all pretty good hotel. It's the Hyatt so it's s little pricey. Check for deals before you book here. Some hotels had better amenities for cheaper rates but if you like the Hyatt experience then go for it. With Hyatt there is a certain quality that you expect and they rarely disappoint.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We visited this place on Sunday and it was crowded but we were seated right away. The food was very fresh and tasty. Our waiter was very attentive and did a great job taking care of all of his tables. The only thing I didn't care for is the seating. There is a long bench seat with small bistro tables and one chair on the other side of the table. Our table was less than a foot away from the tables on either side. It felt very cramped and was uncomfortable when someone had to get up from a table for any reason. I will definitely request a booth or somewhere other than the window seat for future visits.

I hate this Dunkin Donuts. The only reason I use this Dunkin Donuts is because it's close to my house but everytime without a doubt they mess up my order whether they give me the wrong drink don't put bacon in my wakey wrap, don't put any sugar in my extra sugar coffee or without a doubt every time give me cold lukewarm coffee. I just don't understand is their machine old and it doesn't keep coffee hot and there's always different people working there and they all suck every time I don't understand it so now I Drive a little bit further out of the way to go to another one which is amazing.

The best location for any downtown resident who likes affordable monthly rates and great group classes! The equipment is a tad older in terms of the models but STILL very efficient and well kept. The staff is friendly and helpful and the location is AWESOME, you have a view of the casino and Canal St. should you choose to gaze out the windows while pumping your iron. Cancellation policy is great, no long contracts to bind you with and the locker rooms are well kept with a sauna and showers. Definitely money well spent!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Never again. 
I took my car for oil change and they quoted me a price of $99.00. I informed them I pay  $69.99 at the  dealership.  They applied coupon and promos to my account and quoted me  $68.99. Hmmmm. I was told that I need to replace the battery,  I  questioned that and took it elsewhere to have checked. The second place informed me that my battery was fine and Mr Tire didn't understand that there's a cover on my battery and didn't get a proper reading.  Wow  Don't go there unless you wanna spend money on the repairs again somewhere else.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: My wife and I ordered a large pepperoni pizza and breadsticks from here last week...we were not impressed. The breadsticks looked like they cut the crust off of a pizza, stuck it back in the oven until it was basically burnt, and then stuck it in a box and called them breadsticks. So if you like really small, hard, burnt breadsticks...these are for you! The pizza was not that great either. There really wasn't much sauce, it was realllllly greasy, and tasted really cheap. Overall, we were not satisfied at all with our experience with Big Daddy Pizza. You should try somewhere else and save yourself from a bad experience

Explosion of flavors! The food is absolutely delicious here, but I'm not a huge fan of the "Spanish taps"  feel the meals have. 

A group of friends and I shared four meals, which we loved, but felt a little underwhelmed with the portions. Keep in mind, we were four people, with a small appetite. 

If you are looking to be adventurous and have your mind blown with distinct delicious flavors this is the place to go, but keep in mind you will probably need to order more than one plate if you have a big appetite.

Great Cali-Mex style taco spot! 

Bartaco has a great taco selection, oyster and Baja fish are my favorite! Their guacamole is also very delicious! Make sure to try the fried sweet plantains, served with a tasty green sauce. I would also recommend the coconut gelato. 

The service at Bartaco is good, every one is usually very friendly. If you are planning on heading over during peak dinner hours make sure to make a reservation, keep in mind, you may still need to wait a little while even with a reservation. 

The wait isn't usually too bad, and if it is, you can always make your way over to the bar and grab a drink while you wait.

The spin class is pretty good but there is a lot of focus on arm movements which unless you are very coordinated take away from the cycling aspect since you'll find yourself slowing down to figure out the "routine" you are supposed to be doing on the bike.  My favorite instructor is Brooke, she nice, motivating, and you can understand what she is saying (unlike some who sound like Charlie Browns teacher).  There is a slight cliquey atmosphere which I hope they try to combat bc it is a nice facility with a nice mission statement. I am just not looking to be part of a sorority, I'm there to feel encouraged to be healthy.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This was an excellent hotel. I stayed for a week, but I was originally going to stay a month. When I had to check out early, this hotel and its staff were more than helpful. I had booked with Princeline, and they were absolutely terrible in canceling my reservation. They were difficult and refused to let me cancel at first, but with help from the hotel, I was able to receive the rest of my money and check out when needed.
Overall, the rooms were kept nice and clean, the staff were helpful and friendly, and overall I had a nice stay. I plan to stay here again next time I come to town, and I would recommend it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We knew to expect the deep dish pizza to take awhile but we ordered the small 7" and it took over an hour to make it out to our table. And we were expecting it to be piping hot since it took so long to cook but NO, it was colder than room temperature. Not sure how that happened. 
I don't think I would have even enjoyed it if it were hot. It just reminded me of eating cold lasagna. The crust was doughy and chewy and the pizza sauce reminded me more of pasta sauce. 
I had high expectations based on the reviews but we just did not have a good experience.

Some of the best authentic Italian food in the area! Most of the time the staff is attentive and super friendly. I only had one cold experience with a waiter...I came in once to ask for a menu to order take out and he just stood there with a blank stare. I was then left there alone for a good 10 minutes searching for him to take my order again. However, I'll look past that since I've always had positive experiences in the past. Some of my favorites are he clams casino and lobster ravioli! Absolutely nothing here is lacking any flavor. I enjoy them so much that I even often get catering done from them. Love love love.

Such poor customer service.   I arrived 15 minutes before closing as was told to wait outside, on a cold rainy night for my ride to show up.  They refused to do a walk around inspection with my, and told me to drop my keys in the overnight bin.  I realized I had left my sunglasses in the car, and when I called the next morning, moments after they opened, they tell me they were not in the car.  A month after returning the car, a charge shows up on my credit card, and when I called to ask, they could not explain why.   My experiences with other rental companies was much better in the past, and I will be sure to not rent with them again.

So this is the hardest review I've written. I LOVED the old Lolita since it opened, and we had gone regularly. This way my go to place, I even had my bachelorette party there. We tried the new Lolita, and we were so disappointed. The food is just not the same and pricey for what you get. We paid 70 for 2 drinks, guac, and 2 small plates and still felt hungry. While $70 before the renovation would have provided us with an amazing meal and leftovers. Unfortunately, unless something changes, we will not be coming back. It used to be such a great place.

Hi. I was there today, service was brilliant but food not too much.. I ordered chicken noodle soup (which was not a noddle soup) it was more soya inside , but noodle was good inside. Second dish I tried orange chicken.. so -so. The chicken was pretty old , I could taste the flour on the fried part, rice was sticky and very low quality. I would get better quality one and serve smaller portion. i got also fried little rice , it was so crispy and too dark in color. I am sorry but, sure I stick with other place. Even customer service was 5*. The table were little unorganized , and front door could use little clean to make the place more inviting.

Dont waste your time! This bar was featured on Bar Rescue, which is what drew our attention. Of course you have to have the signature drink in the over priced Resurrection Mug. Dustin the bartender couldn't even be bothered to make me a fresh one, just one that was poured already and said it was extra and it was fine. Gross. I found it strange that on the TV Show Tafer changed the name and everything however the receipt still shows the old business name. Long story short skip it! You stomach will thank you later!

This Marsh is a little sketchy but my biggest problem with them is that we have bought a few items that were moldy as soon as we opened them. Bread, pitas, and English muffins, have all been bad once we got them home. I started to look at use by dates on items when I go there now and very often have to dig around to find something that isn't a day away or 3 days past the use by date. 

So why do I keep going? I'm lazy, it's convenient when I'm driving by, so while it's not my main grocery I do occasionally stop here. And then always regret it. I'll learn, eventually.

The good...no I mean GREAT....their Butter Pecan is AMAZING.  Especially if you get it as a milkshake and ask for thick and eat with a spoon.  Trust me, it's delishhhh.  The bad.....this place doesn't seem to know how to stock it to never run out of it.  Consider yourself lucky and blessed if they have it when you stop in.  I turn around and walk out if I see they don't have any.  Maybe their other flavors are just as amazing but that butter pecan OH MY!  Would have rated 5 stars but they drop a star for not adequately stocking my favorite.

Set back in an area with several retail shops, this hotel was set up for the business traveler. They offer Starbucks coffee in the lobby, have a restaurant-style breakfast, large conference rooms, and potentially the largest in-room desks in the hotel industry.  The rooms were spacious, had comfortable beds, and a desk that converted into a large L-shaped desk by means of a hideaway table section. Being more business focused, it was very quiet despite being nearly full. There are shops nearby and restaurants to dine at but the hotel offers plenty on-site. Overall, it was a great place to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Two things - first, the service at this hotel is top rate.  From the valets to the conference planning staff, we were treated like royalty through and through.  The bad?  There was a fire alarm on my second night there.  I walked down the stairs from the 10th floor, as instructed, and got to the bottom only to be stopped along with 30 other guests and a single staffer.  We were locked in the stairwell.  We couldn't exit on any floor, or to the lobby.  No exit to the street.  We were trapped for a good 15-20m before someone responded to the staffer's frantic radio calls.  That could have been DEADLY.  Totally, wholly, completely unacceptable.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
severely overpriced groceries.    Nice apple fritters though. have to admit.   what a JOKE though about these prices.   who shops here?  GOOD LORD!  i cannot think of anything that would be more wasteful than shopping for food here, No bang for your buck.    If You went to WIN CO and bought everything you needed, then looked at your shopping receipt and dived it in half money wise, and then took that 1/2 amount out of your wallet and set it on fire in the parking lot you might be very close to being as wasteful as shopping at rosuars. 

    WTF!    OMG.   are You kidding me?  this is so bad it makes shopping at albertsons seem smart!

My boyfriend and I have toured the apartments twice and we really like them and have been deciding between them and another community in South Reno. I called today towards the end of the day, which I know can be annoying, but it was the first opportunity I had to call today. I asked about their pricing, availability and specials and the person who took my call was rude and snarky and very short with me.
