Based on that phone call I will likely go to the other community who has been very nice to me with every interaction.

My original rating of Nail Bar a year ago would have been 4 stars but I found a better salon closer to my home--better prices, flexibility with scheduling and mani actually lasts. I went to Nail Bar a week ago and my gel mani is peeling around just about every nail, there was an air bubble on ring finger and two spots where the gel peeled off the same night. I asked manicurist to trim my nails a tiny bit and she wouldn't, only filed. I have two cracked nails now. Two stars for atmosphere and usually nice peeps. Over priced and lacking in quality manicure. This visit reinforced why I stopped going.

I just came in from out of state and had an issue with my alternator, or at least that is what I  believed to be the issue.  I told Jerry about the problem and he assured me he would verify that. I had to have this fixed asap, Jerry got his very capable mechanics on the job.  FIXED!  Reasonable and fast, right the first time.  Its reassuring to know that if anything were to come up I would have the Goodyear national company standing right there with me. I have been using this shop for many years and will continue to do so.  They may not always be the least expensive,  but in my opinion they  are fair.  I  trust Jerry.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Food is mediocre and service was distracted and not that attentive (even though they weren't very busy).  The restaurant was small and tight.  If there was good food and great service you could say it was quaint but with mediocre food and meh service it just made for a subpar meal.  Our table brought in very nice aged bottles of wine and the staff didn't realize or know how to even open them.  For our last bottle it took them close to 20 minutes to try to open which is ridiculous.  Would not be rushing to come back here anytime soon.

The venue is stunning and very impressive.  The service attempts to be engaging and white glove but comes across a little desperate and aloof at the same time.  The food was good but not great.  We ordered at least half the appetizers and quite a few of the entrees.  The foies gras and corn dumpling apps were the best.  None of the entrees were amazing but the desserts were very pretty and tasted great.  The wine list is nice but very overpriced (assume 4X what you would normally pay for retail).  I would go back if someone wanted to check out the venue but not go back solely for the food.

Have never had an issue with this store and having dropped my kids off at Henderson many times over 7 years, morning/noon/evening we've had plenty of quick meals here, drive through and sit-down. I always say "hello" to the window crew and nearly every employee who's ever waited on me has been friendly and polite.

With the huge volume this location must do, I've rarely had a mistake in my order.

Inside the place is pretty clean and this location now has the electronic ordering boards.

No issues for me, here. :)
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I absolutely love this cleaner. 

There is always someone to greet me as soon as I walk in with a smile and a big hello. They have a rhythm, and take care of your needs really quickly. They seem to do a lot of business but are always welcoming and the work is well done. My laundry comes back just right. 

Their hours are amazing. The prices are cheap. And I can't say enough about the women who run the front desk. 

Tips 
10 dollar min on credit cards. 
There are drop off days that provide 10% off (sorry I don't remember which). 
There is plenty of parking. 
Quick return!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I had lunch with a friend here today.  My first visit.  The menu is quite extensive and there was a large lunchtime crowd who all seemed to be enjoying themselves and the food.  My friend and I shared an order of edamame which was a bit tough and over salted.  My previous experience with edamame did not include sale.  I had Shumai, steamed shrimp which was very good and vegetable tempura which was plentiful, delicious and cooked perfectly.  My friend had Misu soup which was also too salty (waiter said it is a new version) and Haku Sushi which she enjoyed.  I need to do more exploring of Japanese food and especially sushi.

Picked up for dinner tonight and it was delicious!!!!! There was not an empty table in the restaurant when I got there. The pizza took just a few minutes longer than what I was told, but that was okay, I enjoyed a beer with the good company at the bar. The owner was present and making sure everything was running smoothly. All of the staff that I came in contact with were great. We got the medium deep dish with pepperoni and sausage. My husband usually eats 5 slices of pizza from a usual delivery place and he just ate one tonight because it's so filling. We will definitely be back, great service and amazing food.

A man cut my hair today, and I asked him to layer and thin my hair. It took him about 10-15 minutes to cut my hair, and my hair ended up very blunt. I feel like that was a very short time to get my haircut. He forgot to thin it out until I asked him again, and he didn't blow my hair off after he was done. I had a lot of hair falling off the rest of the day. Throughout the time, he kept on telling me that I had thick hair. After I left, I realized that there was a few strands of hair weren't cut off. My hair ended up a mess on one side. He charged me $5 more  than the given price for my first haircut when using an Axxess card.

8/21 update: AMAZING! 
Run don't walk and come here to eat the best sushi in Pinellas County. Believe me we have tried every joint in this town to try to find good sushi and it all stinks. It 

This sushi is fantastic.I had resource seaweed salad and a rainbow roll and a salmon skin roll. My husband had spicy tuna and spicy salmon rolls. The fish was exceptionally fresh and beautiful firm consistency yet melted in the mouth. The wait staff is friendly this place is clean the bathrooms are clean I couldn't ask for more. I will be back here at many times a week!! I hope they stay open!

This is a recently opened sushi bar. It's located in a rundown plaza on Missouri in Clearwater but don't -by any means -let that put you off. 

Place is large and looks like it might have been another type of restaurants in a prior life. Nice sushi bar with many seats.

We ordered the seaweed salmon skin salad and three rolls (with soup and salad), and it was excellent. 

Kudos for the salmon skin salad. Amazing, not large, but so tasty.

The sushi rolls were fresh, as was the salmon and tuna. 

The waitstaff was courteous and very open to my request for no mayonnaise on anything. 

I'll be back.

If your child or grandchild is bitten by a dog in their care, don't count on any cooperation to verify the dog has had required shots. Veterinary information  is not covered by the law that protects human information. The dog is a two time offender and could attack another child. Yet these people are protecting the dog's privacy. When we said we'd have the police call to get the info the response was "Whatever"  
Really???


Please provide a copy of the law that prohibits you from saying yes or no to the question: Is this dog current with rabies injections?

This is a great place for a quick personal pizza. The prices are amazing, but you get what you pay for. You can get better tasting pizza in Philadelphia than here if you are willing to travel to South Philly or Fishtown, but it's great if you work/live in the area and want a quick personal pizza. It's build-your-own (like Chipotle with pizza), but that doesn't mean it's good.

The pizza is mediocre, and the ingredients only taste slightly better than Dominos, Pizza Hut, etc. It's the love child of Chipotle and Little Caesar's.
 
Whatever all-natural soda they have is really gross compared to Maine Root soda that a lot of area restaurants use.

This place is okay. Been here twice with a friend. The first time was just to check it out, the second because we were in the area and it was the only thing open. The rolls are nothing special (I can't even remember what we had). The staff behind the counter were talking really loudly about their plans for the weekend and it wasn't really work appropriate topics. Not professional. The BEST thing about this place is the unlimited Miso Soup bar where you can put your own toppings on (aka all the tofu!) I'd come back just for the miso bar. Other than that, nothing else is memorable.

Food is okay. Typical Americanized sushi. Service is slow and it's a very small place. Ordered the teriyaki chicken lunch special. Chicken was dry and overcooked, they had plates of raw fish sitting on the counter instead of inside the refrigeration unit. Not very good knife techniques--they were serving bloodlines and gristle along with the prime fillets on several plates I saw around me. The redeeming thing is this is fairly healthy food and at $10.95 for 3 rolls its a decent option for lunch compared to Chilis or the fried stuff at Reading Market.

Dolphin Resort restaurant offers delicious specials during the winter season but discontinues the early bird specials immediately following Spring Break. This is very disappointing to the locals who have been loyal to this restaurant. The Spring and Summer dining prices are too high for this resort. Although we normally come in for dinner 1-2 nights per week, we won't be back until next winter when the owner properly adjusts the menu pricing. I guess the owner doesn't value the repeat business of local Floridians.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I did receive a call from management about the issue of replacing parts on car that don't need to be. He did tell me that they have to guarantee the work they do but what I don't understand is why replace what is not broken..... Anyway he did offer me a free service and wanted me to come back in exchange for changing the review. I did agree but I am still waiting for the coupon to come before I changed my review this was like a month ago was told it would be a week. Still waiting was just a ploy for me to take down review.....
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
A truly amazing and foodie place-  we ordered 5 dishes and all five were perfect.    
My favourite was the king mushroom appetizer which was made with flowers and had a spectacular combination of flavors.  I ordered a flounder for a main dish and that was amazing as well.   Ie the food is definitely five star.  The service was also great so five star for that.
The rest I would say is more 4 star - the alcohol menu is nice but not great and the I interior is pretty but I would say the noise level is kind of high.
In general though - I definitely recommend coming here.

Good idea,poor execution.I thought it would be busier on a saturday night at 7,but it was not and I understand why.The environment was bland and industrial when a homey theme would be more appropriate for a place that serves a home cooked type meal such as mac n cheese.The prices were a bit high,$7 for a small portion is to much.I had tje philly dish and it was overloaded with black pepper so much that it was about all I could taste.My girlfriend got the chicken cordon bleu and all we could taste was rosemary it was barely edible.Overall I was disappointed because I figured,mac n cheese you can't go wrong,but we did by going here.

We had two items on the menu.  Lettuce wraps and Almond Chicken.  We came with a coupon and found it could only be used on some items.  The Almond Chicken was eh ok but the rice served with it was cold.  The lettuce wraps filling was also cold.  The lettuce were pieces torn and thrown on a plate resembling no shells served with care.  The filling was bland even with salt and pepper and soy sauce.  In short they were awful.  For 9 dollars I was expecting more.  The food, service and price were not worth the one star given, I would not bother, its not worth it!

I really liked this place! Service was phenomenal and I got complimentary miso soup, edamame and pickled cucumber salad. I ordered rock and roll maki, which was a shrimp tempura roll with tuna inside, Ikura (salmon eggs), and an orange roll which was a California roll topped wth massago. I really enjoyed the orange roll because the mayo wasn't overwhelming like it can be in some California rolls. Also, while I was waiting for my food, the sushi chef came over and gave me three complimentary slices of a roll to try. I will definitely be coming back.

They do not know how to use the app this is my third time coming to this location pulling up the scanner or barcode handing my phone over and not receiving either my free item or any rewards points I'm still at zero I just don't understand what's the point of this if the members don't receive any points or the workers don't know how to use the points there needs to be some sort of training that goes on she literally just put my phone down by the register and never scanned it so when I check my points I'm still at zero what should I do

It's been so long since I have come to Busch gardens. This mc Donald's must hire order takers who dont want to work here why is everyone so angry the lady who took my order at 1:10 literally asked the workers do they wanna make my round egg??? What? Lol is all day breakfast on the menu MAM? OK IT WILL BE 10MINUTE WAIT ? ok ! Then you still give me a regular egg and on a biscuit and I ordered sausage egg an cheese mc griddle with round egg  amongst other things when u spend alot of money and are willing to wait AGAIN WHY ARE YAL SO MAD HERE
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Saturday night take out, wife ordered Lemon Chicken & pork fried rice, had to throw it in the garbage, rubbery overcooked tough chicken, pork fried rice was crunchy not suppose to be crunchy. I ordered Mongolian Beef its still sitting on my kitchen counter while I'm having beers looking at it, ask my wife to smell it, she said no, I smelled it seems OK jez this place use to be pretty good place I mean a legend in old town Boise but the old lady passed away, the neighborhood past away, so did their food, sad.

As an accomplished chef, it's hard to please me.  Well, I'm impressed at this restauranr. Consistency, freshness, quality, and cooked just right. No short cuts here. No Sysco delivering here. Everything is made from scratch. I don't know of one good, and I mean really good restaurant in Buck's county; that cooks from scratch, and don't cheat.  Money well spent. at this place.  My scallops were absolutely true perfection. Seared  and in a truffle butter crean sauce.  Outstanding!!!!!!  The "fresh made to order"  Napoleon. Outstanding as well!!!!! Bravo Bravo Bravo

I have actually been here 4 times. While the food is okay, I continue to find the service terrible. The food is continually delivered by someone other than the server and without fail a mistake is made. The last visit I made (and it will be my last) I waited one hour for a table after being told that it would not take long. My check was lost and I was told that I would not be charged. Three days later a charge shows up. While everyone is nice they obviously do not have a system to deliver good service. Go there if you have plenty of time and service is not important.

This review is almost a waste of my time,".
I had a concern and the manager on duty started taking orders while I was talking to her.  ( why answer the phone ?!) The employee at the window gave me a drink that had be sitting for a while because the cup had become soft. I asked for another fresh drink and he said OMG! What the heck is going on here. What ever happened to ORIENTATION before putting servers on the floor and  wanting satisfied customers !  Come on. 86th street get it together!!

P.s. The food is always cold too
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Practically the definition of OK.  Sushi was not as good as other local ayce restaurants, however the appetizers were much better.  For some reason out of saki and some of the beers.  Of course covid was to blame, maybe the warehouse was out but there is a saki distillery in Berkeley that is open and has product ( I get an email from them once a week and they do have good saki).  The servers were nice enough but didn't know much about the menu or particular rolls.  Convenient to the movie theater.  Good job on spacing diners away from each other.

Authentic and delicious. 
Is no way to describe the flavor of the food in this place because u have to try to understand how good this place is. 

If u travel and had the opportunity to visit places around the world but u don't have a lot money to go back to that place they have ur fav food please do not panic, don't worry, do not stress anymore because Lulu's cafe can give u all ur heart desires. 

From different regions of Mexico this place has from Tijuana all the way to Cancun and more just remember when I say that this is a hole in the wall but is an incredible little place that I really, really love and wish much success.

Where do I begin? The 1910 rusty bathroom fixtures that made me cringe each time I showered. The awfully bare and putrid smell of the room I stayed in for 5 nights. The disheveled and dirty look of the wait staff in the restaurants who just couldn't seem to get an order correct. No free wifi in the lobbies?!?! I was HIGHLY a disappointed by the quality of this hotel that had the name HILTON associated with it. If this is what Platinum Hilton Honors status gets you then I will take my business elsewhere...maybe the Marriott or Westin across the street. A little extra for quality never hurt!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: A good in and out place to grab some tacos. I'm not huge on corn tortillas but I get that most people like the authentic "taco" experience. The chips and salsa are served very odd here. A few tostada shells served with some verde salsa... no thanks. The oyster taco was my favorite along with a pork belly taco. They did screw up our order which was disappointing but we came when it first opened, so they are probably still working out the kinks. The street corn was outstanding as was the beans and also cucumber salad. Worth checking out and relatively cheap.

Just good neighborhood food.  My husband and I live near and get their take out at least once a month (they are always easy to get on the phone and get your food ready quickly - in my opinion it is better and actually as fast as say Panera and about the same money as well).  I love the spinach melt, chili, buffalo chicken sandwich, and chicken fingers.  My husband really likes the tenderloin sandwich and meatloaf sandwich.  All of their sides are yummy as well and their coffee cake which comes with any salad will melt in your mouth.  If you just want some good solid bar food, you can't go wrong with this place.

Staff is friendly but is not familiar with the menu, was told by one they have a special soup called "Italian wedding" and when I asked what that was they had no idea. Ordered fettuccini which was with chicken and broccoli, asked for no brocoli and add shrimp. The chicken was similar to leather and still delivered filled with broccoli. No bread or anything as you would normally expect from Italian restaurants in this price range. The only reason I would come back is if I need something without leaving the hotel. Sadly there is not much else around here for dinner restaurants.

Hidden From view:

This place is out of site, but once you find it you will enjoy a large outdoor seating area with bike riders, runners and outdoor dart games.
The food and service is fantastic ...

I had the spinach wrap with slaw, my grandson had a burger wrapped in lettuce with a fruit cup, we both agreed we love this place.

The way we found this hidden place is my grandson playing soccer... yes we go to all the soccer fields in the area.

Check this place out, it's cool and breezy and very enjoyable to sit and people watch...

I had high hopes for this place bc they are all over  St. Petes and look really nice. It's very new and up to date but it's EXTREMELY small. This is a newer location from what I heard this gym was at a smaller location and moved into this "bigger" location. This place is smaller than planet fitness!!!  They only have one of each machine (excluding cardio equip). They don't even offer a locker room and want to charge $35/ a month!  You can get a golds gym or LA fitness membership for that price. The only plus is that they're open 24/7 so you can come late at night and have the place to yourself.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I am a native New Orleanean but stayed downtown because of a ball that I was attending. The staff was great, the hotel was well maintained and I had an awesome stay my one night there. The only complaint I had was that my room never seemed to get cool enough but we're in New Orleans...I know the ac can be overwhelmed sometimes.

I also wanted to give a special shout to the young man in The Bistro, Jameson. He was extremely friendly and helpful. I went to get a drink and he hooked me up! If you need to get your buzz started or a bit to eat while you're staying make sure you head down to the Bistro and ask for Jameson...he will get you together.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Had take out from there tonight, had the Pad Thai and it was very disappointing. The  chicken was dry,  a lot of celery (I hate cooked celery) the noodles were  over cooked and the potion was small and tasteless...menu says bean sprouts, egg, scallions and special sauce, they were all missing from my dinner.....nothing about celery....for $14 definitely not worth price.....hubby had General's chicken and that tasted better but again not worth $14....this is our second take out order, won't be in a big hurry to order from here again

It's right in the middle of the action on Bourbon street. Right out the front door is street music and entertainment of all types. My shower had no water pressure and after a night on bourbon street ...trust me, you need a shower the next day.  The staff was very nice and the price is right since the location is perfect for a parting bunch....but be advised, it's loud  all night long...it's the price you pay for the location...have a few extra drinks and you will sleep right though it.

By they way...it has a beautiful pool...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The food is good but extremely  expensive for what you get. $25.00 for chicken parm with mushy angel  hair pasta and then charge $2.oo extra for another kind of pasta. Way way too many rules and regulations.
$5 TO SHARE, $2 TO SPLIT A DISH, nothing comes with the main coarse. Everything is Alacarte  so it gets pricy
The bread sucks. In an Italian  restaurant, come on.
Vitos pizza has amazing Italian food dinners !!! Half the price.
Oh yea, the waiter was dripping sweat from his head profusely on our food???
Not worth it for all you people that are in love with this place. I don't get why. 3rd time there and still think the same thing.

They were so good! Stopped there once a week or more for years then it seems they got new Managment. That's when things changed. First, they seemed to reduce the sweetness. It's a desert! It's supposed to be sweet. They have plain if you don't want sugar, and some of them were plenty sweet without extra sweetener. Now it seems they have decreased the flavoring additives. The most standout aspect of Yogurtland was its vibrant, robust flavors. No more. There was good reason for strong flavors. Frozen yogurt can freeze your taste buds making stronger flavors almost necessary. Sad. Don't fix what isn't broken.

While recently visiting Philadelphia, I was walking around the neighborhood near Reading Terminal Market to try and find a place to grab dinner. I had walked by a few bars that were offering happy hour deals, but for some reason I was in the mood to dine at a place that wasn't too crowded.

I passed by Fratelli's and glanced at the menu. After a quick glance, I figured this place was worth a shot. The food was great - I had the veal marsala with a glass of their house cabernet. 

Not much else to say about this place - it's an Italian restaurant. It's not too fancy, but neither is it a complete dump. I'd definitely consider coming back here.

Asian Wok is a yummy place to grab some food to take home. The soup is flavorful and seasoned well. I usually have egg drop soup and this is piping hot and soothing. It is just what you need when you are hungry, have a cold, or it is cold outside. Sweet and sour chicken is consistent and solid. Nothing fabulous but good and satisfying. Sauce is not too thin and coats chicken well. Orange chicken has good flavor. General tso chicken is not too spicy. 

All combos are filling and a great value for the price. Crab rangoons are satisfying but nothing special. 

On the way home, this is a consistent and good place to grab dinner or lunch.

I've been to this location several times and have been continuously impressed by the customer service of every employee working and by the quality of the product. You find many more toppings here than any other yogurt chain. I keep coming back to this location because of these two important qualities. Last but certainly not least, they have puppy yogurt! I'm one of those crazy pet people who believe their dog is truly their child and treat them as such. Due to this slight mental imbalance, I will always come here instead of other chains to give my dog this very special treat he goes crazy for. Keep up the great work!

Good Morning:
I have been going to Inner Vision for quite a  few years.
The degree of professionalism, quality of their products, their patience, and overall excellence of commitment to their customers is unparalleled.
I also received one of the most thorough and complete eye exams, with one of their optometrists.
The staff is always, without fail, available: for any  issues or problems, that may arise.
Their selections of quality eyewear, is beyond belief.
I am very glad Inner Vision is here in town.
Randy Alan Inkles, M.D.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: They just opened and my co-workers and I were curious to try it out.  We ordered the bento box and could not believe what a deal it was!  You get so much food for such a low price.  We went into the restaurant to pick up our food and the place looked very nice inside.  We were impressed because most of the restaurants nearby did not look as nice as this one.  Service to pick up was normal.  Once we got back to the office, we all tried the food and everyone was very pleased.  It was a winner for us.  The food was delicious, filling, and a good price.  We will be back try more bento boxes. Welcome to the neighborhood!

This place had the best, and I mean THE BEST, sushi in the city. They had very unique, creative and flavourful dishes. But unfortunately they drastically changed the menu and now I can't hardly believe this is the same place. We ordered 6 dishes and all of them were disappointing... flavorless. They kept a few items from the old menu but they just don't taste the same anymore. The very famous TnT and Tuna Tataki were both tasteless and all the dreamy, mouth watering, rolls simply disappeared. 

I will not go back there again. Too bad.

Ok so this place has the cheapest drinks ever. And they're pretty good too! The food is also delicious. The sweet and sour chicken actually looks like chicken instead of mysterious weird "meat" that you usually find. The servings are really big I've always brought home another meal and a half! Usually service is pretty good but tonight when we came we have waited 30 minutes for our check. Our food was boxed up and she said she'll bring out check and still hasn't. Getting antsy, but everything else has been great!

My favorite place for happy hour or to go watch sports (TVs are everywhere!). Family friendly no matter where you sit in the bar or restaurant. Patio seating is comfortable and fills fast, so get their early if that's what you want. The service is always efficient and friendly. Food portions are fresh, delicious and generous (especially the appetizers and when they are half off - SCORE!). Burgers are juicy and always cooked to order. The kebabs are very flavorful. Sandwiches are stacked high. Love the sweet potato fries and twice baked potatoes. Make sure you let them know if it is your birthday, because you will receive a free dessert. Yum!

Good food, authentic cuisine and very friendly owners. My only complaint is that they haven't added tamales to their menu yet. They consider it winter food, but I want it year round. We'll be back for more. 

Well I took my family of 10 in this past Sunday for dinner. The service was excellent and the food     was very good. The mini street corn appetizer was phenomenal. I looked for the tamales and couldn't find them. My daughter and I both love tamales and are looking for them to arrive. Every other Mexican restaurant we frequent and it's quite a few, offer tamales on their menu and it's still summer?  C'mon now!

Hotel was beautiful. I had a issue with the bar manager. We had about 50 guest staying there for my sons wedding. After the reception we all headed to the hotel bar. It was 11:15. The bar manger immediately instructed the bartender to issue last call.
I approached said manager to inquire why on a Saturday night with a bar full of happy guest all staying at the hotel he would shut down the hotels arguably largest profits center?  He stonily replied we close at 12. I ask why? Does your License only allow service until 12?  He promptly turned and rudely walked away. Nothing like good Ole customer service. Well done sir!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
If you are looking for a place that is going to clean off a very very dirty car thats doused in mud, this is not the place. This is not a substitute for a hand-wash. What this place is a quick wash that does a decent job getting your car clean.

The machines seem new, and you have an all you can vacuum depot where you can clean the insides of the car yourself. You should also use this opportunity and time to wipe down your car and clean off some of the spots they missed.

For prices ranging from 5 - 15 dollars this is not a bad place to bring your car to for basic washes.

You know the Starbucks down the block? Walk straight past and come to Chestnut Hill Coffee Co! I walked into this place and was greeted by the cozy atmosphere and smell of freshly brewed coffee. The girl at the counter had a friendly smile and service was quick as could be.
Excellent cup of black iced coffee, rich in flavor but not at all bitter.
I love that there is a variety of seating, from small outdoor spots, to high top tables by the window, to the plethora of seating upstairs. Tons of windows--beautiful natural light for studying or just enjoying the atmosphere. Great coffee shop!

Been to Caruso's several times and have always had a great meal and good service.  Was a bit disappointed in our calamari, a little too much breading for my liking but it was not greasy and was fresh so overall fine.  Perhaps an off night.  Atmosphere is warm, pleasant cozy and casual.  Staff is friendly and attentive, great service. Only complaint, is that it's quite loud upstairs which makes it difficult for conversation. (We've never been downstairs so cannot comment if that is the same).  Will definitely return!

Very bad when you order a pizza and when delivered, you realize it was an old cheese pizza (probably on display for hours) with just the toppings we just added and placed back in the oven.

Called them back and the manager said "that never happens, that he watches every order". Yeah right, judge for yourself (see pic), look at the toppings not even stuck to the cheese on the pizza. Doing this is disgusting, who knows what the pizza goes through before delivery. Deserves 1-star, only reason I give 2-star is because when we picked up before it was better.

I returned to the Little Lion, to give it another chance, and it was much better this time around. We sat upstairs which I think helped with the noise, it also wasn't quite as crowded. The waitress was much more knowledgeable and attentive this time which was great. The only reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is that the menu was almost the exact same from the last time I was there. If they switched things up a little more often and/or were a little more adventurous with their offerings, I could definitely see myself returning again.

Bad service. Maneuvered around the tight curve into the car wash. The one guy started soaping my car with a brush. Handed the other guy my credit card and he told me they don't take credit. First of all, I was there two months ago and used credit. I asked him where it said no credit and he pointed to the service choice sign. After having to back up and ad oh d the curve with no help and a halfway soapy car I stopped and looked at the sign. No where did it say credit only. I told the guy they should advertise that out front so people are aware! Left with a soapy car. Will never return.

Get it right guys check with your customers about their orders nice area excellent customer service when listening to complaints Thank you. We will try you all another time.
Ok so we went back the next night because the food is so delicious and this time it was prepared just right!!.... this is a previous review I had wrote and so you know I still deal with this today. I think it's time to try another Pats Select because this location just cannot get my order right. I more than likely won't be back here. Very delicious food though.

Two stars at best for this experience. Just very blah is a good way to describe it. Liked the atmosphere and the look inside. Service was ok. They bring u nachos and salsas on the house. Practically broke my teeth on the chips they were so hard. My husband and I had tacos. The pork ones were horrendous. Bland and tasteless and I had to ask for sour cream so it could go down. Husband had beef and chicken tacos and he liked them. Tacos are $3.50 each and they're tiny. Side of beans and rice was 3. Wasn't wowed at all.

I have to say, this location seems to have many issues with prompt service. The staff always great, very courteous and professional. I just have to wonder about what's going on with management. I've noticed this for last couple of years, this one tends to be very slow.  In other words if you're in a hurry...

Update: after several months since my original review, nothing has changed ifyou're short on time do not come to this McDonald's for a quick lunch.

Update: 3-25-19 this location needs real help now...  what a mess and dysfunctional for a McDonalds.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
We stayed at this hotel on Saturday night. The staff was very friendly the room was  clean and the breakfast had a fairly good variety of food. Even though I wish they had more vegetarian vegan healthy options. But the noise was unbelievable for me. I could not sleep till about two in the morning. Even though they supplied earplugs the music from the next-door bar was so loud.  the bass kept me up all night. If you're not a light sleeper like me you might be OK     
I went to the hotel for a nice rest and I Definitely did not get that. Other than the noise the hotel is in a great location and it's a good option for Whyte Ave
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I went grocery shopping at this location. This is the same location my parents shopped at for three to four decades. I bought 4 packs of thin sliced chicken breast and when I  got home and they were all rotten. That's understandable but when I return them, I got the pleasure of paying $7 more because the sizes I had originally bought weren't stocked.  Didn't complain...not built that way.  I will go to Publix or Aldi from now on.  Now I have to change my pharmacy....oh well.  It's not the $7....it's the zero apology...it's the having to drive back the next day....stand in a long...long line to be charged more.

I wish I had never order from this place , I was around this area last week I order online 2 hrs after I'm still waiting for my pizza I call and was put in hold aprox.20mins just to tell me they understand mi pizza was late but the driver was already on his way guess what ???45mins still nothing call again to cancel and get my money back,   person in the PHONE (female) was very rude and said well if you don't have the patience to Wait are you serious lady 3 hrs and nothing please don't order from papa John's there is many other options..

Great location .. That is the only positive thing I can say about this hotel.  This location is not up to the standards of other Doubletree locals.  The room might as well have been located in New York it was so tiny.  The walls were paper thin.  Housekeeping was extremely unreliable.  Two out of 4 days they failed to clean our rooms and on the third day they knocked twice and came in even though the "do not disturb" was hanging on the door.  The sound of the door to adjacent room consistently sounds like it is your door.  Really, a less than stellar property.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Everytime I hear about other chinese places i want to throw them a menu from Kangs. The prices are perfectly rounded to the economic clash of budgeting. For the dinner combos you get Soup, Eggroll and an entire meal for  under $9.00. Thats really awesome. Not to mention the food is good everytime me and my gf get something. 

I always order the Bourbon Chicken w/Wonton Soup and Extra Egg Roll, and it is perfect everytime. The sauce is exactly what bourbon chicken should taste like. 

Finding that one chinese place is difficult because their are so many. 
I found mine, I would highly recommend giving them a shot.

Now to find a Thai place...

Decided to try this place out because my usual place was super busy. This place is very clean and the pricing for the washers are competitive. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Since it was my first time there the gentleman working was nice enough to give me cash for my roll of quarters and he even took the time to show me how to load money on to the card. However, the dryers do not dry your clothes and as a result you have to put spend more money for your clothes to be fully dry. With the dryers requiring you to spend more money makes me think that this is how this laundromat gets you to spend more and more money.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Ehh, it was ok, but not as good as Lee's or KFC. Chicken was REALLY GREASY and didn't have that thick crunchy batter. We used a coupon for 12pc with 2 sides for $16. We were glad we didn't pay the full price for it! The white meat was dry and tasted like it had been sitting out. The mashed potatoes were strange. They were obviously instant but also had a very strange garlic taste. The milk gravy was instant and bland. The green beans were flavored well. The rolls tasted like the store bought Kings Hawaiian rolls we buy at Schnucks. We would rather drive a little farther and get Lee's as this place was not very good.

I been wanting to try this place out since it opened but never got the chance to until tonight. I called to see if it would still be open by the time I get back to Philadelphia and the shop was closing in three minutes. However, the owner insisted on leaving the machine on until I get there. What?! I know. Talk about great service. 

I got two cones, one honeydew and one honeydew and taro swirl. Both were large servings and delicious. The taro and honeydew one was definitely a must try. If you're ever in Chinatown make a quick stop here!

I have definitely stayed in both better and much worse hotels, and I'm not a whiny critic who expects much more than what they're paying for. It's a good hotel, few frills, but otherwise more than adequate. Room was clean and housekeeping saw to it everyday. Water was hot and good pressure. Their complimentary breakfast was a full breakfast. I was in the area for business and not pleasure, so didn't use their pool or other amenities. Staff was friendly. I love the location: walking distance from getting groceries, dinner, etc..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: For some reason I haven't tried GSH even though I live here for almost two decades. Service is attentive and fast. The sushi was OK but the pieces were way too big for my taste. The spiderroll was mushy, fell apart easily, and tasted a bit "off". The sunimono salad didn't deserve that name; no idea how one can mess something as simple as a sunimono salad up but they managed. Maybe they excel with cooked food like donbury katsu. I might try that at one point but for now stay with Itsuki and edomasa for sushi.

They've created a warm and comfortable environment on the inside; it reminds me of a cabin at one of my favorite ski resorts and I totally dig that. The food far exceeded my expectations! I used to go to Cleveland heath for the best food around and now it's, hands down, Edgewild. The wings and duck tacos are killer for apps and the salmon Oscar for an entree. Oh, don't forget the Brussels and bison meatloaf. 

Update:
I have now left the restaurant twice before even ordering food, due to horrible service. The blonde girl who usually takes high tables by the bar has been the reason, both times.

The WORST!  Long lines, no cars, terrible shuttle service, everyone was complaining.  Had a reservation that I was going to be six hours late to pick-up so called in the morning and was told not to worry, as long as I was there to pick up by midnight my reservation was good.  I waited about 20 minutes in line to be told that they gave my car away because I wasn't there on time and they had no car to give me.

Pay the few extra bucks, get better service and more importantly, get a car.  I went on priceline and ended up with a better deal and no hassles with Avis.

I have been using this car wash for about eight months now and I really love it! I used to use another place but it was just too expensive. I got the deal the first time and I just bought another one today where I got three washes and got three free so it makes my washes about six dollars each. You have to vacuum your car yourself which I need to do because I have two terriers that are in my car everyday and the other car wash just doesn't do as good of a job as I do getting the hair out. The people are always pleasant and the car is always sparkly!

Very nicely designed with small bistro feel. Clean and comfortable. Good service. 
Excellent egg rolls and steamed dumplings. 
Really good white rice.  
Liked General Tso's Chicken and Szechuan Beef. 
We will be back.

Returned a second time and shared steamed dumplings, orange chicken and a pot of tea. Plenty for two to share. 

Place serves consistently good old school Chinese menu in a pleasantly redesigned environment. Like the place. 

Really good neighborhood choice for a night that is too hot to cook.

Giving the 3 stars for the food. Went here with a group of 15. I will have to say that the staff was excellent. Very attentive and took care of us well.  But then there's the food... almost everyone ordered something different and EVERYTHING was so salty we couldn't even finish the dishes. I would understand if it was one  meals... Then it was probably just an accident but it was literally every single thing that we ordered. For the price we were pretty disappointed. Can't say I'd try to stop back if in town unless it was just for drinks 

Again I do want to say that the staff deserves 5 stars for their work!

The location is great and the room clean. Really nothing to complain about. I am only giving it 3 stars because I am comparing it to other Embassy Suites that have been better. The reason this one did not have a pool, and the breakfast omelets were tiny. When I asked for a larger one he said I must order two, but there was no reason why he could not have place more egg into the skillet. When I wanted to bring a meal to my wife I was handed very small to go boxes, instead of one normal size box. The happy hour was good. Overall I would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I don't usually take time out of my day to write reviews for things, but I feel this needs to be addressed. I took my daughter to this McDonalds Playplace today and was shocked at how dirty the play area was. All of the tables needed wiped off, there were hairballs on the floor, and every inch of the playground looked like it needed THOROUGHLY cleaned. I hope the managers of this McDonalds take this review seriously and do something about the poor conditions of the play area. I am always looking for places my daughter can play and hope one day to be able to take her back here; however, we will not be returning until it is cleaned.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Terrible experiences here. Once sat at drive-thru for ten minutes, no one came on the speaker. Went inside, the manager told me he was too busy to pay attention to the drive-thru.
Another time, got stuck in the drive-thru for 45 minutes, was told by the guy that gave me food that he was new and "trying to make sure he did everything right".
They have rude employees who seem to enjoy making you not understand a word they're saying. 
The sausage is always burnt to hockey pucks.
The biscuits are under-cooked.
They'll park you in drive-thru, then act like they're angry that they have to bring your food to you.

Ordered a couple of pizzas for dinner for delivery. The pepperoni and Tuscany were mediocre and didn't have a lot of toppings on either pizza. The size of the pizzas were what other places would call small or medium. Overpriced for what you pay for. The pepperoni had zero sauce and minimal cheese. The Tuscany had little pork and very little cheese and barely any sauce which tasted like honey mustard. Crust was burnt on parts of both pizzas. Was 5 minutes from the restaurant, took around an hour to deliver. Would not eat here again.

Pretty decent sushi place and one of the cheaper prices for AYCE ($16.95 lunch). I was a bit disappointed in the calamari rings and the miso soup. The calamari rings I ordered were shriveled up calamari dunked in excessive batter, which was the only thing I could taste. And then their miso soup was so-so, mine barely had any tofu. Also, I was surprised that they put an order limit on muscles. That was a first time for me having been to a lot of sushi places. Overall though the service was great and the sushi was pretty good.

While in Horsham PA, I didn't get too excited about this place. Generally a hole in wall place is usually a good sign of quality food but not in this case. Greeting and servers were great but I had the veal Marsala and it was bland and not very flavorful. The pasta was ok and the coconut cake was ok. Yelpers I think you got this one wrong with 4 stars. I am being very generous at best with 3 stars. I have had the best in Boston and NYC and maybe that's the problem. I wouldn't go out of my way to go here. Sorry

I have no complaint with the quality of the car wash. However, we hit the button for the $3 wash and were charged $7 (credit card inserted). There was no-one to ask because the attendant went into his booth and, due to the amount of cars, it wouldn't have been prudent to get out of my car. Cars were backed up into the busy street. I immediately called from my cell phone and was told that I had already gone through the wash and that there would be no credit . I don't mind paying $7, but this seems similar to a bait and switch.

Lovely little place with gelato, sorbet, and ice cream. The staff was super friendly and willingly offered samples. I picked up a medium (4 oz) lemon sorbet for $4.95 + tax. The sorbet was good though the texture could be improved. Overall, quite enjoyable for someone who is trying to avoid dairy. I do find the pricing a bit too high for my tastes - so this will stay in the realm of a rare treat. 
I will be back to try their soft-serve, which is also dairy-free and only costs $2.95. I am looking forward to that. :-)

Slow service. We were wondering what was taking so long when the waitress finally showed up with ALL OF OUR FOOD at the same time  wings soup and entrees. The best I can say is that the food was edible...but not enjoyable. Taco salad had an overcooked chopped up burger not seasoned ground beef. There was zero taste.  I picked through to eat the lettuce. French onion soup was onions cheese and watery broth. Blue cheese with the wings was watered down. I should have gone to yelp first but we were just driving by and it looked busy. Two stars because at least the bar looked full. Don't go for dinner.

This is really a note to the owners who seem dedicated and have some great choices on the menu. 

When it comes to your menu keep it simple and do it well.  REALLY WELL. 

Train your staff. We have asked about different dishes and been told "I've never tasted it" or "I don't know"....they should be familiar with the food....meaning they have eaten it. But more importantly, speed up, introduce yourself, smile and if diners are open to it make suggestions. 

You have a great concept, location and opportunity - don't be mediocre when you can be regarded highly.

Have been here many times over its life and always got good food.
I generally have the mondo burrito .I guess they can't call it by that name anymore because 'mondo' is copyrighted or something but it is excellent.
You go to the back and they prepare it in front of you in an assembly line type deal,asking you what ingredients you want as you go along.
I usually have the pulled pork with black bean sauce and fixings.
Big burrito at a very good price.
Staff is friendly and the place is well lit and open.
They have cholula hot sauces to add yourself for extra spice . I use this at home and it is recommended.

After several years living in close proximity to the establishment, we finally decided to give Untouchables a try. We got a deep dish, pepperoni. Not bad but the pizza sauce is extremely sweet, sweeter then I'd like but the dough was good. Next time we plan to try a regular pizza and hope there isn't excessive amounts of sweet sauce. The down side to our visit, besides the annoying patriots fan there, was that they don't take credit cards, cash or debit only; so your bank will charge you a fee. Friendly staff and clean kitchen. We will give Untouchables one more try.

The pizza deserves 5 stars but the overall experience (at least for pick up) only 3 stars. We ordered Pizzas and they weren't ready yet when we arrived. Most of their tables outside were unoccupied so we asked if we can eat the pizzas outside with a drink instead. They said all tables had a reservation within the hour. We said we needed less than 30min. They still didn't seat us even though it was 4:30pm and most tables were open. It's OK but the message could have been delivered in a more accommodating way. Maybe offer a water / drink while waiting in the heat and/or a "sorry for the wait".

Pasta was excellent . Fresh made bread was also great. The only beverage we were offered was water. Seems if you don't bring wine that iS the only option. The menu was different than the one you see through yelp. The decor was very nice and cozy. They should really get rid of the TV, paper table cloths, add a few candles and get a wine license then I would to five stars on my review. As it is we paid ninety dollars for three pasta entrees and washed them down with water. Thanks god the pasta was exceptional !

This is a place for NOLA locals, by NOLA locals.  My boyfriend and his mother chose this restaurant for dinner, and I was blown away by the quality of the service and the food.

The menu is setup differently, based upon pre-defined multi-course offerings; however there are al a carte  options as well if you want to choose your own pairings.

I had the minestrone as a starter and the braised rabbit and tomato for my entree.  Both were perfectly prepared and highly recommended.

If you want a break from the typical Cajun/Creole/Seafood options I definitely recommend this place!

My review echos a lot of what the other reviewers who gave this place 3-stars or less said.

Pros:
-Excellent portions
-Fresh fish
-Real wasabi (the kind that you can feel in your sinuses and not just on your tongue)
-Decent Service

Cons:
-Catered to Americans--i.e. too much dressing on the salad, too much sauce on top of a roll, too many flavors within a roll (Tip: ask for dressing or sauce on the side)
-Booths need to be secured--I got shoved into my table because the person sitting on the other side of the booth moved.

I'd come back.

I'm very, very torn with this review. As a grad student, I really like this place because it's a great place to study. There are a decent amount of outlets, lots of seating, reliable wifi and good hours. As a coffee snob, I find myself somewhat disappointed. The drip coffee is really inconsistent, and the espresso tends to be much more bitter than I prefer. Overall, if this place stepped up its coffee game, I would be all in, but for now it pales in comparison to some of the other more proficient coffee shops in Indy.

Great facility with lots of equipment in great condition. Really nice decor, beautiful changerooms with lots of amenities, and ample parking. Drawback is how salesy it is!! I tried the free week and while it's a great offer, be prepared for a half hour meeting in one of the sales guy's cubicles, asking all kinds of questions - what you look for in a gym, where you go now, how much you pay, do you have any friends you might like to bring here (ie can we get them to buy a membership too). A bit pushy and kind of a turn off.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I can count the number of positive experiences I've had here on one hand. First thing I learned is not to go in the morning, you're almost guaranteed to get the wrong order. I thought going after work, when it's less busy would be better but it hasn't been. I've been charged for the size I ordered and given a smaller size. I'm a member of the rewards program and I've tried to use rewards here several times - as instructed I tell the barista I have a reward and would like to use it and they haven't. If this wasn't the closest one to me I would not return but unfortunately it is and I have a slight Starbucks addiction. Avoid this one if you can.

Went here for the first time and gotta say wasn't great. 

The doorman was Pissed we showed up which I found real weird considering the lack of patrons. He thoroughly questioned my ID (I'm 26) and asked me why I was there... Told him to drink beers and take a hike basically. He loved that. 

The regulars mean mugged my friends and I for awhile but that just added to my intrigue. I enjoy being a part of the cool kids club even if it means I get angry stares. 

Beer was cheap and the bartender was nice. Couple people were smoking squares which also added to the coolest kid in town vibe. 

I won't be back.

I have been ordering Chinese from this restaurant for many years. Recently the food has been going down hill. I  had ordered Shrimp fried rice using brown rice. When it was delivered it was plain brown rice with shrimp. Not fried at all. I called and explained the situation and received the explanation "what fried rice"  i explained it again and again until i got tired of explaining it . We all make mistakes but own up to it and correct it! Instead i was given a dose of i no understand, what fried rice. bs, 9.00 
Down the drain  besides , the egg rolls are all roll and no egg. Horrible

I'm giving this hotel 2 stars because it was clean and the beds were comfortable. 
Most of the rooms weren't available until after 2:30. Check in time is 2. When I did get a room, the key didn't work. I wasn't the only one. People were continually coming up to the front desk stating they're keys weren't working. I went back THREE times stating my key didn't work. Finally got another room after the "maintenance man tried to open the door for a fourth time and failed. It was a time consuming cluster. Bathroom needs to be updated. I had an overall poor experience here. There's lots of other hotels, try one of them.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Ambiance and wine were both great. We started with the burrata which was delicious however it was not accompanied by any bread or crackers to eat with it, outside of the complimentary focaccia bread (which was great on its own but did not pair well with burrata). I ordered the tagliatelle for my entree which was just ok. It could have used more meat in the sauce. Service was great at first but then slowed down significantly as the restaurant became more packed. Ordered another glass of wine before the entrees arrived and received it after I finished my pasta. Overall a good dining experience that was able to accommodate our large group.

So very disappointed in my lunch. I went in this shop bc it was next to where I got my haircut. When I walked inside there didn't appear to be anyone there. The guy finally comes from the back and doesn't really greet me just grabs gloves and asks what I want. He was very unfriendly. I saw that they had a wrap but don't believe they had any prices posted. Bottom line is that I paid over $15 for a very small wrap and bag of chips. The lettuce was browning and he totally forgot to put avocado on my sandwich. Then when toasted it he overcooked it so the wrap got all hard. I think I'll be sticking with Jimmy John's when I need a quick sandwich.

Went for a recent business lunch. Initial hiccup - with the fellow who met us at the door and seated us being rather rude - was made up for with some inventive and delicious food, and very good table service. Chips and salsa are *both* very odd (chips were just 3 large crispy tortillas that had to be broken into pieces at the table, and the salsa was more like a salty dark red mole sauce). Everyone in the party agreed that everything else we tried was very good: charred steak taco, crispy tempura shrimp taco, cheeseburger, and I forget what. 
Need to go back and try the drinks.

The food is not bad, but the restaurant is dark and slightly dingy. If you are sitting outside, you will be occasionally hit with sewage stench because the toilet plumbing runs right under your feet in the outside seating area. One time sewage broke through and seeped right as we were eating. It was absolutely disgusting.
The restaurant owner opposes separate checks for people in groups, so keep that in mind if you are coming with friends. You will receive a group check that will include items you ordered but never received. 
The beer selection is a cheery cheap beer variety. Nothing artisanal.

When we we moved back to Philadelphia we were in a pickle: where to go for decent sushi? It is uncertain how we first came to sushi house - theories abound but I'm guessing daughter yelped it and we came to check it out. Since then we have come back many times, even weekly. The staff is courteous and respectful, the food is good and the price is very good. I love the sushi and tuna rolls and son loves Philly roll. I am addicted to the ginger dressing on salad. Tempura is delicious too. We are almost part of their family because they know exactly what we are going to order. GREAT neighborhood sushi, even if you don't live in that neighborhood.

I had an awesome experience here. I went solely based on the Yelp reviews and was not disapointed! I have curly hair, but luckily Ashley, who cut my hair, has worked in a curly-hair salon before and so knew just what to do. Even though I was terribly vague about what I wanted, she made it turn out beautifully! She cut my hair when it was both wet and dry, which was a first for me, but I think it helped a lot in the shaping of my hair. Compared to what I've been charged elsewhere for a haircut, I thought the $35 she charged was very fair. I will definitely be going back to her next time I need it cut!

Got food delivered last night, and the best thing I can say is delivery was prompt and polite.
The food, however, not so great. We got crab Rangoon, beef with broccoli, general Tso's chicken and white rice. The crab Rangoon was all wonton, with very little filling, and was so overcooked it was like biting into concrete. The beef with broccoli was fine, except for a giant chunk of bone or gristle mixed in. The General Tso's was adequate, but not remarkable. The rice had a soapy aftertaste that led me to throw out an entire carton. It smelled like air freshener, and tasted like soap. Will definitely NOT order from here again.

We stopped in to check this place out. They are open 24 hours and have free coffee. My husband ordered a California burrito ( steak, potatoes, salsa, and cheese ). He loved it. The burrito was huge. I ordered 5 taquitos supreme. I thought it was going to come out with sour cream and guacamole. My order has 5 taquitos on bottom then had layers of sour cream, guacamole, lettuce, cheese, and steak on top.  They also have a salsa bar with over 6 salsa, spicy carrots and some other items. I have it a 3 star because it was not bad but we were also not saying "this is soooo good". Really picky with Mexican food.

The comforter had cigarette burns on it, I asked for someone to switch out the linen and they gave us two sheets. The room would have been better if the floor did not creek when we walked in a certain spot, the counter had cigarette burns on it as well. The tub was not suitable for us to take a shower, we did not request for a room that is acceptable for smoking. I asked can we move to another room and we were told no. The front desk clerk called to ask if we were okay afterwards which was not expected but this hotel could use a renovation of new management, carpets, sink counter tops, and new bedding for the beds.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My husband and I went in on a Friday night before a Symphony show. The atmosphere was really nice. Our server (Sanjay) was very good! Nice, friendly and very knowledgeable. He recommended his favorite tacos. We took his suggestions. I ordered the pork belly, spicy chicken and fish tacos. The fish was by far my favorite. The pork belly was good but almost too salty. Chicken was ok. I also had the house margarita which was very good. We shared the ceviche app. That was great as well! Overall, very good experience. We will be back!

So I ordered a four for four simple meal I did it dine and no one was there but a person from the staff eating in the lobby above the french fries there's like a timer a digital timer it took them 10 minutes to give me my simple order I said wow 10 minutes they said we're short staffed I said I understand that but 10 minutes!! Then I sat down I forgot to get ketchup so I went to the machine or the dispenser I seen flies flying around it so I was like let me go get my cell phone to take a picture of it and I seen this inside the ketchup!!! Omg and after this I seen all the negative reviews on this Wendy's!!! 579 location

Been renting from National in St. Louis (2-3 times a month), next to airport.  Shuttle running from airport seem to be plenty, I haven't had to wait more than 3-5 minutes for a shuttle. Car selection is not great, most of the times I had a choice of either van or big pickup truck, great if I needed to shuttle people around but that wasn't the case for me.  I had to go inside and talk to someone at the counter once, not very helpful. Overall staff at the St. Louis location are not friendly, perhaps if management ready this they can provide a little more training to staff?

If you are looking for an airport hotel, look no farther than the Comfort Inn. It has a free shuttle service back-and-forth to the airport and is just minutes away. While this is an older hotel, it is clean, well -cared for and has everything you need for an overnight stay. The free WiFi worked well and the cable TV came with all the channels that you would need. The bathroom was good sized, and had all of the amenities. The shower was way above average. There's a restaurant located just across the street from the hotel. While it's not conveniently located to downtown, it is just a quick Uber ride away. This is a fine airport hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Local hole in the wall sushi spot. Ambiance is nothing special but the food is good. Sushi is fresh and tasty. Service is good. Nice place to go to grab a meal if you're craving sushi and a causal atmosphere. I am not a big fan of rolls so big you can't fit them in your mouth in one bite, so if you're like me order off the regular roll menu and not the specialty roll menu because they are HUGE. None of the dishes really stood out but the prices are good and so is the food. Wouldn't go out of my way to go back but if I'm in the area and want sushi would return!

So so so average at best. Ordered take out

2 pork tacos, 1 chix.  Meat in all three was dry and basic....other words cheap

Chicken burrito, chix , rice, beans, cheese...That it.  And the cheese, mozzarella?? That was the consistency and taste of it, not what you want or expect on a burrito.  All ingredients are cheap.  I expect to be asked and/or offered fixings, toppings, etc., well no help there...then again the girl at the counter, she doesn't have a proactive bone in her body.  Now the food wasn't expensive as a positive, my pallet just seems to be more advanced then this place

We use to love Luigi's .We always over looked the décor. It is certainly over priced for the amount of food they serve. Very small portions. Lately the chicken parmigano seems like rubber. .The Fried Calamari was ok , the salmon carpaccio  was definitely a peace of frozen salmon. Caesar salad every part of it screams  BAG. But my biggest complaint is that I noticed that they always over charge me every time I am there . ONE DOLLOR HERE, ONE THERE AND IN THE COURSE OF A YEAR THEY ARE CHEATING THERE CUSTOMERS NIG TIME.. Lastly , the younger guy is so  nice but the older one is plain NASTY. 
.

Every time I need some weird ingredient for a new cocktail I'm trying, I come to Plaza. They always have what I need, no matter how rare the ingredient. The one time that they did not have what I needed, it was because they had just sold out. I described the drink I was making and they pointed me to an adequate substitute. These guys have the heart of teachers, always focusing on the customers needs and always willing to give advice. Plaza also hosts tastings of breweries and distilleries from across the country.

Passedby BK asked the Window clerk for a hot fresh hamburger. No cheese bread  toasted hard.    My way ... Then I told the window clerk at 9:43 pm , didn't his name.  He said we have lots of hamburgers which one,  I said a double whopper and thank you since he was being ass hole.  He said he wasn't going to serve,   I was so happy he said that.., So I went to Micky  D's and they served me a GREAT burger.  I won't ever go to BK again.  Especially since you have ass holes working the window.  .  
THANKS AGAIN for directing me to the best burger !   

And hot hot fries ....

We were not familiar with Magnolia, but found it on a groupon & decided to check it out.  We really, really enjoyed it & are glad we got to stay here before everyone else discovers it too!  The decor is beautiful, the rooms are clean, the drinks are good, and the staff is extremely friendly, not to mention is right near a lot of activity downtown.  I have no doubt Magnolia's popularity is going to catch on fast & soon enough it will be hard to get a room, but as of now we were very pleased with our experience & very happy with the price we got.  Thanks Magnolia!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If you want to open an Italian restaurant in the St Louis metro area you have to do 1 of 2 things, serve good food at reasonable prices or serve great food with great service at steep prices.  Cibare has turned this on its head, they serve good food at steep prices and mediocre service at night, no service at lunch.  Think of it as Pasta House Company food at Tony's prices without the Pasta House service.  I don't know why anyone would open a restaurant without a clear vision for it but these folks did it.  Go to the 1904 Beer House and get value for your money.

Get the sampler!  They are not shy with the scoops, we haven't been able to finish one yet, try as we might!  It's an adventure each time we come here. Service had been good, quick. And the selection of flavors!!  So tasty.  Oreo was my favorite this go around with nice chunks of cookie, but I also really liked the mint with chocolate chip cookie pieces- not the typical combo but really good. Maybe I just like some chew in my ice cream, but even so they are really good. Hubby's favorite was the chocolate shock. Can't come too often, but looking forward to the next sampler!

Has continued to be one of my go to spots for Mexican foods for burritos . Always excellent and consistent and waaaay better than some of the trendy Mexican spots on Santa Barbara. Def better than Super Cucas across the street. If you go, def get some of the pink habernero  salsa. OMG is it HOT but all tasty at the same time. Great local hole in the wall. Every thing is good. Burritos, tortas or even the dishes on the side that change daily. Try it all and you will not be disappointed. Wish I still lived in SB so i could go there right now.

Now I wanted the Oxtail gnocchi, but it was sold out. I therefor went with the pheasant. Now the place looks rustic and industrial and that's the sort of atmosphere I like. The place was packed and we had to wait a few minutes for the food to arrive, but that's only to be expected. Now I really have got no complains about the food but I would have liked to try the oxtail rather than the pheasant, although the pheasant had a crispy skin and the pasta was al dente I can't help but feel that the oxtail would have been better. 

Would I revisit? Yes

Such great sushi! Hands down probably the best in town. This small quaint spot offers a full menu of hand made sushi! I would strongly recommend calling ahead to make a reservation on a Friday or Saturday night. The staff are friendly and helpful with selecting from the menu. Lunch is offered during the day and other food items for lunch or dinner, not just sushi. The sake is umm umm good and good to share.  On a Friday night when it's busy and you're extremely hungry, order a salad or soup to hold you over.

Mixed bag.  I ordered Veal Parm sandwich with french fries.  The wife ordered chicken fingers.  And we topped it off with 2 mini-canolies.  The veal Parm was dry and really tough - so I wouldn't recommend that.  The fries were really good for a pizzaria.  My wife really like her chicken fingers.  The canolies on the other hand were gritty.  Not as if it had dirt in it, but as if the filling was drying out.

Before I could make a final determination on the place I would need to order again but try something else.  Maybe the Pizza or a cheesesteak.  But till then a 3star rating.

Came here for the first time with my husband and daughter, and was in heaven with the Mike burger.  My husband and I split the burger and fringe, and my daughter had the 4 cheese rigatoni.  She ate the entire bowl and wanted more!  The server was a young man who was so incredibly nice and helpful, especially when my daughter spilled an entire cup of water.  Needless to say, we will be going back again before we leave town this weekend.  Knocked it one star for some of the prices.  $7 for ONE trip to the salad bar that only has lettuce and toppings???

Wonderful hotel. So beautiful and beautiful area. A lot to do around there. 45$ for valet or park in the parking garage extremely close for $12 overnight. 

Staff was extremely friendly and helpful. 

No complimentary water in hotel room which i found off for the price / luxury of hotel. 

The room was extremely elegant and clean. 

We were supposed to have two queen beds and they were definitely full beds - not anywhere near as large. Disappointed as it was a moms night out and would have been nice to have the extra space. 

Overall was satisfied and happy
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Come on ya'll have been up a few months now let's get things right . Stop in and ordered  a pumpkin coffee .  Pay at the window to be told they are out of pumpkin coffee :( .  Isn't this a donut and coffee store ?   Went the two weeks ago and had no chocolate donuts .  Now today , we are talking 1 o'clock so why no coffee and since nobody was ahead or behind me ... Or in the store ??  Anyway , someone on the high stepping ladder ask these people to get themselves together :( .  Oh , and clean up the messy floor you can see on from the drive inn window :(

The missus and I are avid fans of Sam's. The prices are very reasonable and we have not been disappointed yet.  The donairs are decent for late-night eats (however, more veggies on them would be a good thing), and the onion rings are always a classic.  When you order a pizza from these folks, I hope you don't mind cheese... Because you get an absolute pile of it!  I remember getting a flyer in the mail a couple of years ago from them and it said "we guarantee extra cheese!"  

They weren't lying.

Free delivery over 18 bucks is also a bonus and gives them a 1-up against other late night options like Domino's or Pizza 73.

This is a run of the mill Chinese food restaurant. I will say the restaurant itself is very well kept and clean and the staff are extremely friendly but the food itself is average. I ordered the Orange Chicken with fried rice and my girlfriend ordered the General Tso's Chicken with Lo Mein. The Lo Mein was very good I must say but the fried rice was on the bland side. Both main meals were good but the funny thing was both the Orange Chicken as well as the General Tso's tasted and looked identical. Overall the food was ok but I wouldn't recommend going here if you're looking for GREAT Chinese food.

My friend ordered the Bento. Then menu says it comes with Tempura. When her food came there wasn't any tempura. They said they have discontinued tempura. I ordered the Korean BBQ. I did NOT get Korean Kalbi Ribs as usual. It was some weird kind of beef with teriyaki sauce. If I would have know I would have ordered something different. They need to change menu and be more upfront with customers. I did not eat one bite of my meat. When they asked if everything was OK, I told them no. Yet no kind of compensation or anything. We got charged for items we did not get.

Large portions, cheap prices, good food. Eggs were made perfectly to order, unlike most places. I ordered bacon and expected a couple slices, received a pile of bacon and it was all delicious! Ordered toast and it was perfectly buttered and just the right texture. Only critique would be on the home fries, they need more flavor and maybe some crisping up. I received my home fries with no seasoning and they were mainly soggy. Would definitely return though because of the price and quality of the rest of my food!

The pizza is pretty good but their sandwiches have consistently been bad.  I had the Italian hoagie, which was actually my 2nd time ordering it for some reason.  First of all, the Italian hoagie doesn't call for just ham and cheese! No ITALIAN meats.  Not to mention just one slice of each.  The tomato and onion were diced on top and with every bite it all fell out of the sandwich.  I've never seen a philly/suburbs pizza shop mess up a hoagie so badly.   Their cheesesteak is dry and the minestrone soup is just alright.  For the restaurant being Italian owned, I would expect more flavor.  I would only order their pizza here.

I was not impressed at all with our two night stay. Our first night involved getting the bedding removed due someone else's blood. Disgusting! No complimentary breakfast. The view was of construction. The shower kept losing its heat. And if we wanted to go to the pool we had to take two different elevators to get there. Not only that but the pool and fitness was open to the public. It was not worth the price we paid for. Wouldn't stay there again. The only convenient thing about the hotel was the location that's it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
My boyfriend keeps saying it's just popsicles, but there must be coke in them and I'm an addict!! And proud!!!

I've had their strawberry mint, strawberry cream, and banana cream. All of them were absolutely delicious. Make sure you dip the dairy based ones in their milk or dark chocolate. Adds an extra layer of crunch and they use good quality chocolate. 

Place is awesome for a quick stop after dinner or a walk down the trail. A bit pricey since it's just a popsicle, but I can warrant the extra cost considering they seem to be using good quality ingredients.

I would not recommend this place. Unfortunately for them there is a new car wash with a semi self service (vacumm) near by. It's half the price of this place. The carpets came back dirty (still with obvious stones and dirt on them), the rims were left dirty, I drove next door to the Dairy Queen to complete the job that was seriously half done....Stay away, and if the owners read this, fix your pricing to be more competative with the one on baltimore pike, and make sure people are not sending out the car dirty....

What a change since they got the TV Cable Coverage. Quite empty a 9 AM on Saturday. Food very slow out of kitchen, wait staff not attentive, portions have been reduced and prices have escalated.

Ordered my favorite Machaca. Normally it is a shredded beef dish that is very flavorful and has egg mixed into it. Today's version almost all egg and virtually no meat and overcooked.

More anxious to clear used plates to turn table for guests that weren't there then to care of your dining needs.

Quite a shock from the wonderful Mosaic that we enjoyed on previous visits

Pizza is really good.  Watch the pricing on the menu listed online on their website.  The last few times I have ordered from them, the prices seemed to get higher for the same order.  They are pulling the ole switcheroo.  When you question them, one person will tell you that you are wrong about the pricing and another person will tell you that the menu is old and the prices are wrong.  Seems a bit dishonest to me.
