The food is great but I have a hard time doing business with dishonest people.  You should honor your advertised prices or update your menus.

I have always loved shopping at this store, wherever we have been stationed.  This particular Fresh Market has been just OK.  Not all of their basic pastries are available all the time and the wait at the deli can be annoying.  Also, the fruit I bought was either moldy when I bought it or became moldy the day after when I started to wash and prepare it.  I was quite shocked.  
I only visit this store early in the morning because traffic around that area in the afternoon is complete madness and of course the constant road work doesn't help!

Ok, first... this place is just so pretty! So welcoming and makes you want to be on vacation!! Second, the tacos, oh my, so many delicious tacos!! Third, the guac! And finally, the margs.... so, so yummy!!! I love Bartaco so much for a date night, for a girls night and a perfect lunch date with or with out the kiddos!! They have perfected the ability to make it a great place, no matter the reason! It's one of my absolute favorites in town! Final piece of advice... don't forget to order churros! Maybe 2 orders! They are delicious!!

My cat Dobby had an acute urinary obstruction. Art City Vets appropriately and rapidly triaged him to an acute inpatient hospital ...they  saved his life sending us to the other facility. He was so quickly critacally ill. Once discharged we have continued our care at Art City Vet.  Art City Vet were  actually the veterinarians who found the cause for the obstruction. I cannot say enough about the professionalism, the skill and the warm fuzzy loving care we have received. Dobby is doing great.  I am so so thankful.

SO DISAPPOINTED!!
I've been a fan for years ... Chocolate chip ice cream with the hot fudge was the absolute best -- but yesterday I stopped in for my first of the season only to find they've ruined it.  Ala Ted Drew's, it's just vanilla concrete with a disgusting, strong mint syrup and if that didn't ruin it enough - the "hot fudge" is just the chocolate wax mixture that is used to dip cones to create a hard shell.  I guess that's the chocolate chip.  Crash and burn from a history of 5  to less than 1.  Very sad day.

Please don't waste you money here they will screw you order even if you just want ketchup they will f it up 
I don't understand how a nice place from my childhood became so trashy and dirty everyone in this place has a bad attitude 
Don't know how a manager of a fast food restaurant (if we can call it  fast food ) is going to be such a bad Pearson I can understand the employes being so careless they are high school kids  but if you don't like to work here just quit. 
        I WILL NEVER COME BACK HERE 
        AND WILL NEVER TELL PEOPLE
        TO BUY HERE.   ;((
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Supporting local places tried the Shake Shack in Cherry Hill.  Ordered a smoke shack burger and a mushroom burger both were tasty a little more than we expected so it will be worth a return trip in the near future to try other items.  Down side was that cashier or payment method would not accept credit cards or debit at the time of ordering waited ten minutes to find that out?  Good easy ordering on the kisok to place orders pretty easy but wanted to customize my order and did not see a way to do that.  My problem I am sure not Shack shacks I am sure.  Still worth another trip when we are in the mood for a burger.

Place is lovely but service is very slow. No one to seat us and restaurant had only a few tables of customers. Not one server anywhere - Stood there for 10 mins before someone finally came to seat us.

Also - spicy tuna cones have hardly any tuna in them. Order this item a lot at various places and amount of tuna various per place but this is a joke for what you get here. Comes are very small, hardly any tuna in them. Waste of money.

Won't go here again just cause it looks like they are cheating out on ingredients.

Not the most upscale digs you have ever seen but GREAT sushi!  It's a great family place and the owners couldn't be more friendly.  Service is always great.  If you want a menu you have to ask for it because almost everyone gets sushi, but the japanese fare on the menu is also very good.  We have a friend who has travelled extensively in Japan and he knows good sushi.  He thinks this is the best sushi in the whole Tampa area.  If you want an upscale date place to impress, this may not be it.  But, if you want great sushi, come to Kaiko.  (We call it Charlie's cuz, he is the owner)

The veterinarians and vet techs really care about the animals. Everyone is very easy to work with and I have had no problems refilling prescriptions or scheduling appointments. I feel comfortable bringing and leaving my animals here. My 2 cats have both had surgeries here and we bring in our dog as well. The treatment plans are well-explained and they make sure you agree and understand before anything is done; nothing has ever been sprung on me. I see Dr. Martini and she is great! I have also seen Dr. Rasmusson and she was wonderful as well. I would highly recommend this clinic for all of your pet needs!

Hard to rate. Good drinks at the bar and friendly wait staff. Seated for dinner the mistakes began:
1) brought iced coffee instead of tea
2) not a mistake, but Cabernet ordered was Undrinkable
3) very long wait for 3 burgers, all over cooked 
4) pimento cheese asked to be left off one burger was on it

On the plus side, the manager took back the Cabernets and gave us a requested taste of the Malbec before we accepted it. 
Burgers were good meat.
Pickled onions on burgers really good ( I have a thing for pickled onions ). 
Fries reportedly very good. 
All very respectful of our food allergy issues. 
Manager made good on our complaints.

No. No no no. I used to live right down the street from this place, and there were multiple times they just straight up wouldn't answer their drive thru speaker... ? I can't even count how many times I went there for a mcflurry and their "machine was down." As if that isn't enough, the lines here are always especially long. So, not only do you have to wait 30 minutes to place your order, you get then get the wonderful surprise of finding out that you waited 30 minutes to be told what you want to order isn't available! Awesome! :-)
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Pasta dishes are huge and plentiful. They literally are served with steam coming off of them. They are pretty good.  There is no way the average person can even finish one. I'd say the pasta dishes are the best thing here. The pizza is not the best, needs more sauce and flavor. Years ago, it was much better.  Their cheese steaks are very good, I highly recommend.  I'm not thrilled with the quality of the chicken and veal dishes.  They have the best tasting buffalo chicken wing sauce. They are the best. So, if you dine here, be selective in your choice.

Enjoyed the sushi, but the service didn't knock me out. I'm an African American. And one thing I noticed with my waitress is that she was 90% more bubbly and cheerful with the other customers than she was with me. It got to the point where it made uncomfortable for me to see her go from another customers table, being happy to wait on the customers, to my table, where she didn't seem to want to serve me. Again, I enjoyed my meal, left, and even left a nice tip. Would just like to receive the same bubbly service next time.

Me likey!

We've been going to Villa for years and it's been consistently wonderful.  The best red gravies in town, not to mention a fantastic preparation of veal and chicken.  My all time favorite, though, are the chicken livers romano.  TDF!

Note: This is a cash-only (ATM on the premises) restaurant.  Also, they don't take reservations so if you hit it at the wrong time you'll have quite a wait.  The bar gets crazy crowded at times on weekend nights.

This is a no frills joint, but it's excellent.  Perfect for out-of-towners would want a South Philly experience.

I have never stayed at a hotel so ghetto. Sure the atmosphere is great and very classy looking. However the staff is the opposite. First of all, my friend booked us a suite for the bachelorette party she was planning. They gave us two separate rooms and my friend had to beg for them to be at least next door to each other since they ran out of suites. Then to make up for it, they threw in free valet. The next day her car had been keyed on her door when the valet brought it from the parking garage. Seriously? Worst experience and I certainly won't ever be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Could be a new favorite.  Excellent food, excellent staff, and great setting.  We had the octopus appetizer, lasagna, and lobster ravioli.   All good was 5 stars and our waitress was a 10!  So accommodating, clued in, and perfect style.  Loved this place and glad this is in our backyard.  BYOB and they have beer/wine.  Can't best that.  Met someone there while waiting for our table that shared some excellent craft beers with me.   We talked about beer and the fruity nabs was a perfect pair for the octopus.  *** no longer BYOB.   Still the same great food and now they are expanding the place since they are so awesome.

Nothing more to say except this is the best restaurant in Bensalem. Period. End of discussion. 
The people who own this are beyond nice. They will make anything you want and change it up if you ask. Genuine Italian.  Like being in Italy. 
just a place that everyone in Bensalem needs to visit.  

Again this is the best restaurant in all of Bensalem.  Don't hesitate to take a business associate or your date or partner for a special dinner.   Don't bring the kids!  Seriously.  It's not for kids or kid friendly.  It's special.  Very special.   Enjoy!!!

The drive through at this location looked really long today so I decided to just go inside. That later proved to be a mistake when the woman taking my order took probably 5 whole minutes to take my order. 5 minutes in the grand scheme of things is not much but when the man next to her is serving 3-4 people before she was even done with my order, it starts to feel long. She was very nice and obviously just new but maybe start your newer employees at a less busy hour than 10am. 

With that being said, the barista making my iced vanilla coffee did a great job. The best one I have had in a while.

First impressions are important when you try a new restaurant. So what do you think when you sit down and are given a used paper menu where where the previous order has been whited out?

Meanwhile, at $13.99 pp  we anticipated a better lunch special, even if it's all you can eat. Although of acceptable quality, the sushi selection was extremely limited. Basically it was various iterations of krab stick, tuna, salmon, white fish and cream cheese. The results were truly "meh".

As for the tempura, it verged on inedible: huge chunks of veg with soggy underdone coating.

Not a winner...

We stayed at this hotel by mistake. I thought I was booking the large nicer hotel across the street. I'm sure this is how they get most of their business by the names being so close so beware of that. There is nothing wrong with this hotel, the inside is fine, the front desk is nice and the restaurant has pretty good food. I did book the exterior room thinking it would be a nice view but it was just the freeway and a cheap restaurant. If you are going to only sleep here because you are out exploring Nashville (which is about 20 minutes away FYI) then stay here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've gotten my nails done here a few times, each time in hope that maybe my nail tech will be better.  The employees are pretty rude and don't listen very well.  The quality of their work is okay, but not great.  I got my nails done here today and when j told the nail tech what color nail I wanted, they did not give me the color I wanted and instead of giving me regular polish like I requested, they gave me gel polish so I had to pay more.  They also cut my finger with a file, which made the experience even less enjoyable than it already was.

When I first moved to the east side of town, I was thrilled to find this place so close to my new home, & I pass by everyday, on my way to work. I gave this location not only 1 try, but a total of 3 tries. The last of which, I came to the conclusion that they just don't want my business. The drinks were horrible each time. i always order a hot coffee, but yet had to ask for a sleeve after they handed me a hot cup. They were rude when I asked for it, and looked at me like I had 2 heads. Save your money, or go to Starbucks.

We walked in today to buy 2 tires. No one was at the podium so we waited around for a few minutes in comes this heavy set guy Jim* and I asked if he worked here since I wasnt sure because he was wearing a burgundy shirt it threw me off his answer was "no i just walk around wearing a sears logo on my shirt"
His response was very rude and out of line. I didnt get an apology and he proceeded on asking what we needed. SMH...if it was his way if being funny he ISN'T. 
Based on that interaction alone i would advice people to go else where for better customer service.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Fry's Pharmacy is awful. I recently had Bronchitis and was given 4 prescriptions, 2 of which they did not have and promised I would get them the next day. Went the next day still no prescriptions. the 3rd day I went back they had only 1 of the 2 missing prescriptions. Meanwhile I called in a refill of a regular pill I take. 4th day back they finally had the 4th prescription but no regular meds were filled yet. Why does it take 2 days to fill a prescription? If only there was a closer place to go I would change....

I wanted to start by saying the hours here on yelp are not correct. I'm not certain what the hours are but I came through/passed by multiple times between 5-630 am on my way into work and it wasn't open. 
I was able to get breakfast here one morning but that was after 7 am. The line moved very quickly but their menu is severely limited. I had to settle on my 3rd breakfast option because they were out of the other 2. I got the feta wrap but it was still frozen cold in the middle which sucked. The good thing is my iced chai latte was very good but took awhile to get made.
Would be open to return next time I'm in town.

My wife and I went to this restaurant on a Friday or Saturday evening even though we didn't have a reservation. We expected a wait but we're surprised that we could get a table pretty fast.  

The Good:
- Complimentary Victory beer and/or Sangria!
- Good Italian food, better than Stella Rossa up the street
- Very friendly wait staff

The Bad:
- Even though we got a table pretty fast, it did seem to take awhile for our food. The waiter was attentive the whole time with drink refills, etc., but it was a longer wait.

I have the christmas reveillion dinner last night and the ffood was very good, just a bit small on the portions.  I started with the scallops, or should I say scallop for an appetizer and it had a nice chili glaze on it.  The minestrone with lump crabmeat followed and it was good but nor great.

My entree was the fire roasted cobia.  Loved the fire roast flavor on the fish and the vegatables but again, the portions were small. My wife had the arugula salad and the veal marsala and her portions were much more generous.

We still love Maximo's and will return.

We were in the mood for pizza, looking for something different so decided to try Bacco. We had escarole soup to start. Definitely fresh stock but not a lot of escarole and was the first time I had pepperoni in escarole soup, flavor was good. Then had Caesar salad, crisp romaine, shredded cheese and a nice dressing, definitely not bottled. For the pizza we topped it with sausage and green peppers on one half and pepperoni, Italian long hots and fresh garlic on the other. The pizza was perfect. Atmosphere and service was good as well.

I use to love this place. The quality of food is awesome and always fresh. After you become loyal customer for couple years that's when the mishaps start happening. Simple no onions turns into onions and than it get to the point where half or whole order is not what you ordered. This is not nice especially when as a customer it is paid for one product and you get something that you don't even like to eat at all. Too many order screw ups in a row. That is the reason for us not ordering as much as we use to from Pat's.

We are longtime SB residents and wanted a great tasting pizza & pasta and we were so disappointed tonight with our dinner. Ordered " Penne w/sausage " and it tasted very old and salty and sent it back and I orderd a salad. It arrived drowning in salad dressing it was so disgusting. I feel the " Chef" was angry cause I sent the pasta back and drowned my salad on purpose. Our Server even commented how much dressing was on there and I sent that back. Thank goodness the pizza was okay or I would of went home starving. Maybe it was a off night at 8 pm when we arrived ??  We wont be going back there for awhile, so sad !!

My husband and I were regular customers here. During our last visit, the lady at the register was excessively rude and refused to  let my husband purchase the two bottles of wine he had picked out because I did not have my wallet with ID on me. The employees at this store have never been able to answer the simplest questions about their selection when we've asked which we've put up with as it is the only store close to us. As a result of this last horrible encounter, we will no longer be giving our busy to this establishment.

I'm not going to say much about this. Food was just barely ok but WAY expensive and just overall bad experience. Too many sub par places in St Pete getting good ratings. Lots of mistakes from service and back of the house on busy Saturday night, Saturday nights are what good restaurants should be made of! $42 fish plate that wasn't anything special. $20 eggplant parmigiana that I could get at any corner Italian spot for $10 or less. Stale crusty bread and the inferior olive oil to dip it in. Come on.. Please people, get some culture in your life and find out what a decent 3 star restaurant entails or don't bother yelping..

Used to get pizza from Pizza Shack all the time when I lived in S. Philly, but that was years ago. Just had some again and if anything, it's improved. I'm a fan of crispy thin crust pizza and they nailed that part to perfection. The bottom of the pie was a nice brown but was not burnt -- great flavor. And a far cry from the soggy mess I had from another S. Philly place I won't mention. Perhaps a bit much oil / grease would be the only complaint. Delivery was promised for "within the hour" but was much faster than that. Under-promise and over-deliver -- great business practice.

Located about 10 miles west of Santa Barbara in a smaller town of Goleta, which is quieter and has less tourists. However, the price of the hotel was still elevated, likely due to its proximity to SB. 

Check-in was friendly and the room was perfectly sufficient. However, the walls are thin: you can hear footsteps upstairs and the garbage man early in the morning outside, if your room is faces out from the left side of the hotel. 

There's a decent breakfast spread and dining area; it does get mobbed though and seating fills up, so go early!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: After hearing so much about this place,I decided to give it try. Overall experience was meh. I came here for the nigiri and was very disappointed. More rice less fish type of nigiri. Quality of sushi was just ok. For some reason my rolls came before my nigiri order which btw took a long time to arrive at our table. Rolls were okay.  The best part of it all was shockingly the calamari appetizer. Those did blow me away!Not chewy at all.. Do I see myself coming back here? Probably not. Server was friendly tho'.

The food is better, but the prices reflect that (it's a bit expensive- $20 for a pasta dish). The main reason for losing 2 stars is the loud music in the middle of the dinner rush. Who starts live music at 6:30pm? We couldn't hear the waiter, had to shout the whole time, it was just entirely too loud. Live music is for bars, not restaurants, or at least AFTER the dinner rush, maybe 8 or 9pm. We just couldn't shake the mood of being at dinner with 5 people and not being able to talk to anyone. Unless you dislike the people you're going to dinner with, don't come on a Friday at 6:30.

Visited Bottos for first time last evening with friends. Very nice facility, although odd the attached market seemed larger than the restaurant, but none the less...
The atmosphere was good, the food was good but the service was severely lacking. At one point, we asked for more bread when our entrees were delivered and it did not come until we were done. Getting coffee and desert took an extreme amount of time also. Entree prices were reasonable given the good quality of food but my Osso Buco had an inordinate amount of pasta compared to meat. My wife chicken saltimbocca was EXTREMELY salty.

Attended a rehearsal dinner there recently. The location is tough to find but not debilitating. It is located in a " planned residential community", group of stores surrounded by residential units. They have planned events in the common area, located right outside the restaurant. That day was a farmers market with some food stands. Was tough to find a parking spot. The food was OK, nothing to rave about. The venue for the dinner was nice, looked out onto the common area. Service was OK although one of the servers could have ben a bit more friendly and have a sense of humor. I didn't pay so can not comment on the value.

Not like New York..Not impressed at all!I ordered The Brooklyn Bridge Pizza,suppose to have ricotta and sausage!!Only 1 other table and it took 30 minuets for a small pizza and I did not order any appetizer's!That would have been ok if the pizza was good..The Pizza had no flavor,very little sausage,a few sprinkles and not on every slice of a small,skimpy and no ricotta..I took 2 bites and the waitress ask what I thought and I told her not good at all..Gave her a tip and went to Anthony's coal fired and got a great pizza!I will not return..The waitress was good and like I told her,not her fault,not what I expected!!

Great little family run Italian restaurant..Lunch was great,all homemade dishes.We had classic dishes as I always do my first time in a restaurant,eggplant parmigiana,spaghetti and meatballs and chicken piccata!!Each dish came out piping hot,enough to split,we all had leftovers and they were very very good!!Bread and soup or salad comes with your entree,$9.99 is a great deal considering the quality/portions..I will be back this weekend for dinner!!Chris the owner Chef was very gracious and knows his stuff!The Veal dishes are as good as Donatello's...One last thing,save room for the incredible New Orleans style bread pudding!!!To Live for....

We went here for dinner during the week and it was a small crowd with some nice music playing low enough for us to talk. The wait staff were very nice and answered questions for us. They have a neat beer and wine menu and an agua fresca of the day which sounds neat. The menu is full of great prices for the size and quality of food that we got. The torta carne was really good, flavorful, and came with fries and chipotle mayo. The tacos were also great and came in a cute taco holder. Would definitely recommend, love having great restaurants in Irvington

Today was our second time to visit.  The street tacos are pretty good. We spend most of the winters in AZ and there are a lot of taco places there so I know what I like.  Like all street tacos they are served on a relatively
small tortilla.  The choices of meats is pretty extensive and prices are decent $2.  for most and $2.25 for lungua.  If you ask for Jalapenos they will give you a decent platter of roasted jalapeno, onion and yellow pepper.  This 2nd visit was as good as the first so no reason not to go back.

The food is really good if you don't mind it having been cold and reheated. I have a bad habit of looking at my food to the point it's unappetizing, and to keep it brief, I don't have to stare long at this stuff before I'm turned off. There is something suspicous about the caesar dressing, but that may be my personal taste. The wait staff is very nice though and I can dig the music. The place is typically very quiet, lots of space if you want to bring a large group. Overall I'd say the place is maybe a step and a half up from Olive Garden.

Sushi cafe has nice atmosphere and good service. The Mexican sushi roll was very good but the small plate beef was average. The beef was ordered medium and was chewy and tuff, the fried rice did not have any taste to it. I had to add some soy sauce just to give it some flavor. Ordered the tempura ice team for desert which was just ok. The ice cream was full of ice crystals and was not smooth and creamy as I had expected. While not the worst restaurant, if I do return I will stick with just the sushi rolls. I guess that is why it is called Sushi Cafe.

This was my first visit to Ranadall's and they have a great selection of Wine and Spirits and other items as well. However, you must wear a mask in the store as it is strictly enforced.  They have a great selection of Red and White wines and one that I feel in love with called Primal Roots for only $7.98 and me and my friend as well his wife thought it was one of the Best Red Blends that they ever tasted. The store is hard to locate, but if you use your Yelp app to get directions you should have no problem finding this store.

Finally got here after we hear all good things. Over priced terrible service. Walk in and no one greets us. Finally a hostess comes out and says " you been talked to yet?" Well no. The. She asks us to move so a larger party waiting can sit down in the very small waiting area. We waited only about 15-20 minutes. But after we sat it took awhile for the server to show. And right away she said the kitchen is in a bad way, might be awhile. Food finally arrives about 45-50 minutes for pasta. Then she never returns. Never we had to ask another worker for our check. 50$ for bad service and over priced pasta

It is a nice hotel near the airport, perfect for the night before your flight.  Very clean and new, the staff is friendly.  Yes, Industrial highway is closed, so taking 95 makes it 7 minutes to the Airport from here.  

The negative reviews are not warranted, I have flown over 1 million miles the past 10 years and have stayed extensively in hotels world wide.  This is a good location and great value.

The real tip **there are not any good places to eat and you do not want to venture off of the beaten path near this area, so eat before you arrive or be prepared to drive 15 minutes**
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Red Clam Chowder soup was thick and delicious. If I ate bread, I would have dipped it in the soup and skipped dinner. Enjoyed the slightly large chunks of potatoes. 

We shared the tender and tasty steamed mussels appetizer. One order with garlic sauce, one with red sauce. Broke down and dipped some bread in the sauces. So did everyone else. 

The five of us ordered our dinners differently and were completely impressed. 

Loved the piano player who plays only on Sunday.  Claude sings opera the other nights. Been there for years. 

Credit cards not taken. Have an ATM unit near the rest rooms.

I haven't been to a Dunkin' Donuts in ages but I was driving home from spin class the other morning and decided to stop in for breakfast. I ordered the egg white sandwich, hash browns and an iced coffee with almond milk. The iced coffee was good, but the food was not edible. The sandwich was microwaved, the egg and English muffin were both wet and soggy. The hash browns were ice cold and also soggy, but yet hard in some parts. Like they were microwaved over and over again. My $8.00 meal (50 cent up charge for almond milk? Really?) went right in the trash. Definitely will not be back to this location.

The food at Leo's was decent, and the service was good. The salsa served with fresh tortilla chips had a nice kick. We also tried the guacamole, which was a little on the bland side. My partner had the chicken enchiladas for his entree. The portion was large and somewhat heavy on the cheese sauce, though the enchiladas themselves were very flavorful. I had the green corn tamales, which had a nice texture, although I was not a fan of the accompanying sauce. The staff was attentive without being overbearing. We would go again if friends chose it, but it would not be our first choice for Mexican food.

First time here. Got, to go: won ton soup (pretty tasty. I loved the large size won ton s), one shrimp egg roll, a roast pork roll, beef with broccoli. Unlike a lot of reviewers I liked, for the most part, what I ordered.

Though the shrimp egg roll wrapper was VERY greasy I was pleasantly surprised the roll itself wasn't (oil soaked wrapper aided that, probably). Having said that, that one wasn't as tasty as the pork. I'm enjoying the beef with broccoli still. (Only complaint about latter it could be a bit tastier too.)

4-5 stars, had everything been seasoned better.

Monical's was recommended by a friend of a friend, so we figured we would give it a shot. The young lady at the counter was kind, our food was hot and ready on time-- service was good. However, our family didn't care for the pizza. It was bland and the pan pizza seemed extra "doughy" and heavy. It was akin to a pizza that would come from a basic box of pizza dough from the grocery store with basic ingredients or toppings. Obviously some families don't mind the style as it was recommended to us, but we won't be ordering from there again. We, personally, would prefer Greek's, Donato's, or Noble Romans in the area.

Wowza, this is the real deal folks. 1.99 each for the tacos and 5.99, or so, steak burrito ( a monster ). Slow roasted flavor to all three of the different meats in this order. The space is very roomy inside, and while there's really zero to be said for décor, there isn't any, there are 2 large tvs and great A/C. Not the place for a first date, but for any other event or just a cool spot to eat alone, thumbs up. 4.5 stars, though it's not really fair to zing them for no beer or wine. Matter of fact they make up for that in the dope assortment of authentic SOTB mineral waters and soft drinks. Ill be back-

I am here right now waiting on take-away and a couple at the table next to me are moaning how they googled 'sit down' restaurant and picked this place. They seem to have never seen a counter order Chinese restaurant. Yes, it seats 18 people if it has to, but St Pete doesn't have a single old school, tablecloth, pot o tea waitress style Chinese restaurant remaining on the 4th St corridor. I remember at least 6 on 4th in the 90's. That said, this is my current favorite between downtown and Gandy. They even do a little thai and a couple of curry dishes. The wings are amazing and every chicken dish I've tried I recommend.

Just wasted $30.00. Please don't make my mistake. I ordered shrimp with lobster sauce, shrimp with broccoli , shrimp rolls and mixed veggies with rice. The rice was mushy. The broccoli was burnt yes burnt. The shrimp with lobster sauce was not cooked and smelled rancid. My little one is vomiting and I'm feeling queasy myself. I just pushed the whole order down the disposal. This is my fourth time ordering from this place and it has become progressively worse in the last 7 months. I think there was a change in management and overall quality is poor.  Order if you dare. You have been warned.

Limited cars available for Executive members.  Many vans were 80% available.  I chose a car that was washed, but not vacuumed and gas was not full.  I was told to bring it back to the level were I picked it up.

My question was who can arbitrarily do that.  This was a customer service issue that was not handled very well.  I am the one inconvenienced, but the rental car company will win in the end.

There was only one person working to get several cars out of the lot.

There are several issues with this location, but I will choose another rental car company at this airport.  There are several pattern issues here.

So incredibly expensive it astounds me every time I go inside. I live close, so I'll stop in to pick up something I forgot during my usual shopping, but I usually leave deciding I'll figure out a substitute at home because the prices are so exorbitant. Anything you can think of the price is going to be double if not triple what a normal supermarket would charge. It's ridiculous and frankly predaHighly recommend you save your money and walk the extra few minutes to Target, Trader Joe's, or Sprouts. Whole Foods might honestly be cheaper.

I stayed here 1 night on an Expedia deal. Price was very affordable. Very convenient, centrally located. Bed was comfortable. I did not appreciate being forced to use the automatic checkin kiosk at 3 in the afternoon to check in. I do t like my card swiped on an open to the public device that could have security issues ( such as a scanner). There were 2 desk attendants . And the one avail told me to do it thru the machine. Why? When there is a person there? I like personal service! Not a robot , or machine. A person.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I appreciate the extended convenient hours of the bank. All staff have always been courteous and knowledgeable and a pleasure to do business with. My complaint is this location has a lot of wasted space. Only 2 ATMs , wish there was at least 1 or 2 more. Also move the ATMs to a larger vestibule area. Make the vestibule larger and have a guard or agent to help with transactions. I saw an elderly woman get frazzled by the machine confused and the machine ate her card. She then went into bank and a teller helped her to get card and calm her nerves. Also, wish there were more bike racks outside to park bicycles.

Just amazing.  Went with the wife for lunch yesterday.  Service was 5 Star, food was fantastic, beautiful space as well.  I had the zucchini carpaccio appetizer, very generous portion, light and citrus-y.  We split and shared 2 pasta entrees.  The tagliatelle, and the mushroom ravioli.  Tagliatelle was one of the best pasta dishes I have ever eaten.  The ravioli was good as well, but anything pales in comparison to the tagliatelle.  Tried the tiramisu and blueberry desserts.  Both outstanding.  Must try.  Just do it.

I've just had so many problems with this bank and ONLY because the employees here are terrible. For example, one visit an employee sat there ignoring me talking on the phone and even when they got off they sat there on their personal phone texting and then when they asked to help me, they took their time laughing and flirting with other employees ! Another visit, an employee gave me false information regarding my account and I ended up with an extra hold on my account even when they were the ones who lied. Too many times I've gone in and some of the employees just do not care about helping others.

I have to say when I call this place the people are always friendly and take my order very fast and ask all the right questions. It a average time for pick up and delivery, nothing worse or better then any other local place. The variety of pizza is great. I have always had a great pizza from here and stromboli are always great. One of my fav's is the cheese steak Hoagie pizza! It is so so good! I find that the Shack gets my orders right mostly all the time, were I have been having problems with other local places as of late. 

I recommend trying this place and deciding for yourself, it wont disappoint .

Terrible service and obviously told to gouge customers from management. Looked at my car and came back with a laundry list of things that were wrong. I told them forget it and took it to another place and what do you know most of them were false just to gouge money out of me. The guy with long hair did not get his name was such a pompous ass and thought he was so cool,he was not. Sat there and completly lied to my face and i wanted to punch him in his. Told me my caliper was bad??? That sent of red flags bigtime!! Will never step foot in there again and i suggest you do not either!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I love cafe mochi's happy hour (Tues-Thurs 4:30-6:30pm dine in only). The only thing is that service is a scant so sometimes it takes a little while before a server even stops by to get your drinks and greet you. And it took a long wait for food to come out too, but it's understandable since its happy hour and probably busier times. 

I really really love the crunchy bagel roll, spicy white tuna and yellowtail. I like the spicy tuna as well but to me the spicy tuna has a fishier taste compared to the spicy white tuna which is a lot more subtle in taste.

I was really disappointed when I had their white tea with rose because they use boiling water, which ruins the flavor - the water _should_ be hot, but it should never get to the boiling point. I suspect that is the reason there are people here complaining about the tea being too weak.

Also my tea was served in a wax-coated paper cup so the boiling water made the wax leach into the tea and lose its flavor.

The only reason they get three stars instead of two is the people who run this joint are nice. Other people seem to like this place, so they're doing something right; I just wish the hot tea was one of those things.

My husband and I decided to try out the new Leon Mexican Restaurant, and we are so glad we did!  Finally...a great Mexican Restaurant in Greenwood!  I ordered the carne asada street tacos and they were delicious!  The steak had a distinctive char grilled flavor and they came with pico de gallo and a special spicy sauce too on the side, which gave it an extra kick.  The refried beans were fabulous.  My husband ordered the pork carnitas, and he also said they were great.  We will definitely be back again.  Leon's food was fresh and the waitress was very attentive.

Found this place looking for something new to try. I was happy to find that they had low sugar chai sweetened with monk fruit. I have to say that it tasted fantastic.

There are plenty of other drinks on the menu as well, and the person I was with said they are very good. The drive thru wasn't busy, and I was able to get in and out pretty quick. 

While everything was perfect, I have to knock off a star due to my cheapness. If you want an alternative milk in your drink, it is going to cost you $2. That's quite a mark up, when the typical charge is less than a dollar, and on a rarity some places don't even upcharge for that.

We opted to come here when I realized my favorite spot -Fuji- is closed on Mondays. Not a bad place for sushi. However, they forget things that most sushi places do not. In our experience, they forgot the wasabi and ginger. They also forgot to leave the sauce off the sushi like I had asked for. The chicken tempura is supposed to come with chicken and vegetables and all we got was a mountain of chicken. I'll give them four stars even if it's really a 3/3.5 because I want them to stick around, especially for Mondays.

I'm very surprised at how popular and well rated this spot is. Not saying it doesn't deserve it, but I have never found their sushi to be better than average. I assume it's mostly locals that know nothing better of quality sushi. The quality here is mediocre to be completely accurate. Salmon should be a bright coral, not a pale pink. Orange tobiko added to spicy tuna, but what purpose does it serve if the fish is not fresh? The ginger dressing they use for their salad is also not that good. I will not be getting my sushi from here anymore.

The sushi lunch special is a must. It's probably the best I've had yet and believe me I've tried a ton of spots. They took their sign down, so it took me five minutes of driving around the parking lot to find it because I haven't been here in awhile; wish they told me over the phone. Also, check your bags before you go! My bag felt light and they forgot to add the soup and salad. I'm glad I caught it before I left. 
They are getting four stars instead of three because the food including the soup and salad was delicious. It's a drive for me, but worth it.

OK so I went to 24 again and the weight room was a mess again.  I will include pictures.  But, this time, for the first time, one of the staff was down there trying to put the weights back. Big task for sure. 
I give props to that guy for trying to clean up. A guy at the front desk told me he personally goes now every hour and puts the weights away. I had to call BS on him and got into an argument with him because he was flat out lying.  Then he said they were under staffed so he wasn't able to get down there very often.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I go to this 24 hour when ever I'm in SB. This week I went 3 times at different times of the day.  What I noticed was that every time I went the free weights were all over the place and almost every piece of equipment was loaded with weights. As if someone forgot that they were not working out with their mother who could clean up after them. Not only that but the one time I saw someone from 24 down there he just walked through and left. 
I did go to their website to let them know all this so I wasn't just hiding behind Yelp. 
The place really is turning into a dump making workouts frustrating.  We will see if it gets better.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Coffee is typically pretty good but I have had a few misses. I would give 4 stars for coffee and two stars for service.  I think most of the locals are used to the fact that no matter what you order it is a 20+ minute wait, if you want to linger and enjoy your coffee that works but occasionally I want to run in a get my coffee in under 10 minutes and be on my way to my daughters swim practice or work and you just can't plan that.  The place is always busy but not more busy that most coffee places with fast service.  Nice atmosphere.

At first glance appears to be a very nice, well maintained hire. We had a large room on the fourth floor. Our room was always clean and the staff were pleasant. For a continental breakfast we were satisfied; however upon closer notice the vote appears to be minimally run down. Minor complaints that are not issues, except for the super picky maybe. Our bathroom door lock was broken and our curtains had tears in them. My biggest complaint though, again more just an inconvenience, was the speed of the elevators.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I am overall pleased with the service and quality of work at this Goodyear location. I had various repairs done here, including tire replacement. Steve the manager is helpful and honest about the work that needs to be done. Prices are competitive and they are willing to price match. I also encountered a situation where I was not completely happy with the end result of the work. Steve was willing to engage in an open discussion about my concerns. He promptly and efficiently resolved the issue, which speaks to his dedication to provide good service.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Tried this place based on reviews alone. So glad we did!! We love Mexican food and will for sure be coming back! We went on fajitas and margaritas Monday. Fajitas were great! Margaritas yummy! The salsa had a great flavor and kick. Of course, I still added the habanero sauce to it. I love spice! The place was very nice, clean, roomy. To service was wonderful. Very nice and polite servers. They even have a patio out back. I didn't go back, but from what I saw it looked nice. 
I'll give 4 stars for now, since I haven't tried the tacos yet! For me, tacos are a make it or break it!! Go! You'll love it!

Burgers were cool, cheese cold, bread is kind of rough, ordered number 1 with cheese and chili cheese pup, got all of it, but gave me chili cheese fries, the lady got mad and walked off when I said I didn't order the chili cheese fries, still didn't get my fries with my meal.... but that's fine cuz they're probably hard and cold as well with no salt, more than likely won't be stopping at this one, they need to train from the people at the goodlettsville Krystal. They're perfectly cooked at that location everytime I go there. Never was one thing wrong at that store. Never.

We recently adopted a sweet black lab mix from Saved Me, which is right next door and which uses the Pet Mechanic for treatments/exams, so we figured we'd take her to a place she'd been before. I loved the vet on our first visit, who answered all of our questions, gave suggestions, and got down on the floor and very lovingly checked out our girl. It was a great first impression. Whenever we have a question or need something quickly they make sure to fit us in and help us out. It's so nice to have the Pet Mechanic right in our neighborhood!

This was ok but nothing special. If you're in the mood for NYC pizza it's a solid option. On the plus side the pies are HUGE and the customer service was very nice. 

However, the crust wasn't the doughy kind I like. Instead there were tons of air bubbles, so no real chew. My daughter ordered the sweet heat pizza and the "heat" part was just some jalepenos. She commented that it would have been better if the sauce had some bite or there was a spicy pepperoni. I had the pepperoni which was fine. 

Overall, not something I'd go back for but it's not bad.

The best thing about Chinatown is the old Chinese grandma waitress who bosses you around. "No don't eat that with that sauce, use this!" "Everyone share, don't eat one dish by yourself!"  

Nashville is a Chinese food desert. Of the restaurants there are Chinatown is pretty much as good as it gets. We had the beef chow fun, mu shu pork, Mongolian beef and chicken fried rice. All classics that are hard to screw up and all were totally acceptable. Decent flavors, normal sized portions. 

Nothing special here but nothing egregious either. My overall sentiment is "meh" but if you're desperate for Chinese it'll do.

Because of its location to my home, this has always been me and my husband's go-to Starbucks location. We go weekly. Sometimes daily. But lately, since their renovation, the service is terrible slow!!!! Even when I've gone and there are only a few folks in the drive thru, it's still a minimum of 15-20 wait. They used to be able to get through a crowd of folks in no time, but lately, we find ourselves either not going or leaving before we can even order. LOCAL MGMT: PLEASE fix this!!! We love you. We wanna come. But this must change!!!

This place is adorable and the food is surprisingly delicious!  I didn't expect that the food here would blow me away and it totally did.  Went for a lunch over the weekend and ordered the veggie riblet sandwich and it was phenomonal.  You would never know you're not eating meat.  The home fries that come on the side are little cubes of white and sweet potatoes and the combo is really good!  My dining companions got an omelette and the special tortellini omelette - both were equally as impressed as I was.  We'll definitely be back again.

I always land here at some point during my monthly visit to NOLA. It's the charm and intimacy that always draws me in, as well as, terrific local jazz talent. 

The downside, and there's always a downside, is the lack of seating but expected for such a small venue. My other beef is the complete lack of table service from the bar staff. They seem relegated to manning the bar from behind the bar.  Maybe that's their deal, I don't know but it can be annoying when you have to fight your way to the counter for every drink. I did that at college bars years ago and I'm past that. 

Otherwise, great locale.

Def one of my favorite Mexican Food places. Good home made authentic Nana food. Red Chili or the shredded beef Chimichanga Re amongst my fav here. What's even better is their prices! Where can you get a $6 giant chimi?! Here at St. Mary's Mexican! The ONLY thing Is this place is packed! Always call in your order in advance and pick u it up. Even their phone lines are always busy, but that's the first sign of how good this place is. Super good home made tortillas, and soups to go in pints or quarts. Little bit of everything. Also a good spot to pick up food to bring to parties and potlucks.

We like this place and have been a few times.   The food is decent, probably priced well and since it's BYOB you can't go wrong there.   The reason for 3 stars, the service is a but surly.   The waitress we've had the past few times could really be a bit nicer and act like she likes her job.   Also, this is one of the ONLY places that there's a Groupon in Lambertville and it seems as though they look for any reason NOT to take it.   Once a Groupon expires, it should be good for the amount you paid on ANY day, not just the days that this waitress deems valid.

I like the habit but today they made many mistakes. Two of the the burgers were incorrect and also the Santa Barbara Cobb salad. I wanted to inform the manager, Rosie, that the Cobb salad had onions. I've been ordering Cobb's for many years and I know it does NOT have onions. It also states on the menu it does not have onions. Rosie quickly stated all Habits are different and her store, the Cobb's do come with onions. I wasn't trying to get my money back just informing her of a 3rd mistake on the order. My visits are usually a 5 but today it's a 2 due to the 3 mistakes.

We have tried giving this Macdonald chance after chance we went there last nite and the we're busy laughing joking around then to worry about having customers finally when they did come a take our order it took forever I believe u should do better training and get people in there that wants to work instead of people who think it's a place to have fun and still get a paycheck so I've tried more then I should to give this Macdonald chance after chance I'm done no more good luck cause Macdonald will end up losing a lot of customers cause u don't care to train the people that work for u to care about there job 
Again good luck

text: So, I'd gone away for a while and now I'm back.  Joe is still phenomenal,fixing a series of unfortunate color events in a single visit and helping me to strategize about my future hair plan.  I love that Joe is a complete perfectionist- he knows that his clients' hair is his calling card.  He definitely wouldn't let me walk out with sub-par or even average hair.  Salon Bass is my salon home.  Seriously, it's the ideal mix of upscale and on trend, while still being comfortable and never feeling stuffy.  Everyone who works here is delightful.  Joe and Salon Bass, I love you.  I'm glad we're in a committed relationship.

I have gone to Millcreek for my eye exams quite a few times over the years and have found them to be very professional. The last time I went, though, I wanted to get a new prescription but keep my frames because I like these frames very much. They refused to do that, so I went elsewhere and have not been back. Today, I received a brochure from them in the mail and have been thinking of paying them a visit as I definitely need an examination. I still have the same frames and would still like to keep them  I'm planning to give Millcreek another try. If they are willing to make lenses for my existing frames now, I'll revise my rating.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: First and foremost, the 3 for $22 menu had GINORMOUS portions. They did NOT tell us that and my husband and I looked like idiots sitting there with these HUGE plates. Each plate is enough to feed about 3-4 people, no exaggeration. The salt pepper shrimp was way too salty. The other reviews raved about them but it was very salty and also VERY LARGE. The outside looks a little sketchy but the inside looks legit. They get a lot of business. I was not a fan of the taste of the food. I ordered the chicken lo mein, the shrimp fried rice, and the sweet and sour chicken with the salt and pepper shrimp as an appetizer.

This is one of my go to spots but never reviewed it.  

It was nice today.  Not crowded so got a table outside.  Had a plain pizza for the first time.  So glad we did!!!  The last few times we ordered specialty pies and they were just ok.

The plain medium was super thin and delicious.  

Also had the house salad with cilantro lime dressing.  Not sure how they charge do little for a big portion salad.  My dining partner had the Julius Caesar salad and mine was much nicer for the price difference.  

Overall great experience and good food.  Server was friendly and helpful!

I have shopped here for years Excellent prices and selection. BUT over the last few months I've had various problems with some of the cashiers-I asked one for paper only and she tried to give me paper and plastic because "everyone wants" that. After today's horrible experience with Adam I have decided to keep shopping here but do the one thing I hate-I will use the self-checkout lanes. I hate those on principle-they cost people their jobs-but in this case I'm fine with that. The staff who work the floors are super nice and helpful but not the cashiers. Pity.

The old man that work at the cigarettes department is rude and incompetent. Their new policy on buying money order requires ID and your name have to match the debit card you're using or else you won't get to purchase the money order. I tried buying the money order with my wife card because she is at work, but was denied but I was able to buy cigarettes, how F**king stupid is that?. The new policy doesn't make any sense even though I know the pin number to my wife debit card. That old man needs to collect shopping carts since all he does is stand there and talk to his co-workers.  STUPID POLICY!!!!

One word...Horrible. 

In attending the Mothers Day Brunch the experience was not worth the price of admission.  The lack of service, poor quality of the fare, and overall bad execution of the event left our party with a bad experience.  Over priced and under delivered.  Definitely was not worth the $70 a person or the $10.00 Bloody Mary's in plastic cups.  The only reason for the one star is because that is the lowest review I can give and they do not deserve that.  I have had a better experience in a high school cafeteria.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I ordered two specialty rolls and an appetizer, which was the Rock Shrimp. The appetizer was good, especially with the spicy mayo drizzled over it. However, their rolls were not as good, which is odd considering that Sakura is a sushi restaurant. Compared to other sushi restaurants, Sakura would be at the lower end of the list. The rolls were just not enticing in terms of taste and aesthetics. Though filling and relatively inexpensive, it did compensate for a bit. If there were any takeaways from this place, it would definitely be the cheap prices and their spicy mayo.

I don't recommend this place although I wish I could. The receptionist is a sweetie and the vet is a ham (a fun one) but I don't feel we recieved a full exam for my cats and I have to take them in again somewhere else, which isn't cheap especially since there's 2! Also not the cleanest/most sanitary feeling clinic, although it isn't disgusting by any means. I would rather spend a little more and go to Capilano Vet Clinic where I KNOW my cats will get the quality care they deserve, which gives me the stress relief I deserve! Although, my cats LOVED the honeysuckle pouches we picked up from there so 2 stars for that and for the staff's kindness.

I get my hair done by Robert. I have baby fine, thin, absolutely straight hair with a number of cowlicks. Difficult to say the least. I have never been disappointed. No matter what style I want, he makes it look good. The work I have seen by the other stylists also looks good. Most of the clientele have been going there for years, so I think that is a statement about the quality of the work. I always make an appointment and find their prices very reasonable. I don't expect good work on the cheap nor would I inconvenience others by asking them to "work me in".

My experience here was all around good, except for one minor thing. I chose my vehicle from the executive lot, and then proceeded to the exit.  The man in the booth asked me if I needed a toll pass at $3.95 per day. I said I wasn't sure, since I had no idea about the route I would be driving daily. He asked me where I was going, and I told him. He said "Yes, the toll pass would be good." So I did it. And guess what? Never encountered a toll road at all.  I'm not dinging them big for this mistake, since I know now that I need to be more aware of my route for future rentals. Lesson learned.

Decent Mexican food, nothing to rave over but some options you won't find everywhere, so I come here every month or so. Quick service, good range of salsas. I like the pork and plaintains burrito, it's something a little different but a nice flavor twist. The Green Enchiladas platter is a more than sufficient amount of food for one meal, and the green sauce is the best in the house, the spice kick stays with you. Cheap and filling! I'm not a flan fan (a fan of flan?), but the sopapillas and the fried ice cream are tasty choices.

GOOD: hot breakfast daily and happy hour Mon-Thurs with local craft beer options. Staff is very friendly. Efficiency suites with cooktop and full refrigerator. 

MEH: room had a bit of an odor, we believe from the refrigerator. Not horrible but noticeable. Some bathroom tiles were loose. Shower head had very low pressure.  

Most hotels downtown are pricey. That said, it was a decent value relative to the other options. 

TOP TIP: valet parking is expensive. Park yourself one block away at the library lot. Also there's some steep hills in this area when walking around.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: i've been here a few times and it was good but this is the first and last time I will see this face.  For me to give this bartender Nicole one star is a lot. In fact the one star goes to the establishment and as for Nicole...zero!  I am a bartender and server myself and this is by far one of the worst experiences I've ever had in the food industry.  Negligence at its finest... How she has a job is mind-boggling. I would not recommend coming in here if she's working. The food was good though...so I'll give it to the chef but as for the bartender thumbs down!

The tacos I had were very good. I haven't had anything else there. I give the food so far a 4/5 stars. I gave the review a 3 star review because the service was horrible. I got my food before I got my water and I had to ask for my water. She took my drink order in the beginning. I also came in and was ignored by the same waitress who didn't want to wait on me. Then a party of two came in and they were seated right away. I guess because I was alone I wasn't seated right away. I didn't get any napkins either and they were messy tacos. I will be back. Hopefully with better service so I can update my review.

Have eaten here about three times. The food is great but the service is terrible. Visited again a few weeks ago because we love Italian food. The staff was different this time. We had better service ourselves but the table behind us had an elderly couple that was very angry because they had been waiting 45 minutes for their food. The restaurant was not that busy for that kind of wait. I don't understand why they cannot handle the service there. If you want to pleasant atmosphere and good food this is the place however be prepared with lots of patience.

Cute decor- the lounge is nice and Drinks have potential but Horrible service, the bartender didn't know how to make any of the drinks and he had to read step by step what to do. Also complained that we ordered two drinks off the menu instead of ordering something straight. On top of that he had his friends come in and just chatted with them loudly and told them not to order food off the menu as it was nothing special...and I was going to order something but just wanted to get the heck out of there - also when I was leaving I made the front desk aware of glass near the elevator shafts on my guest floor and she seemed not to care.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Bad services I need to get quarters I was going to withdraw money from the clerk then one of the representatives that work and that desk came up to me and said that I could withdraw money from outside from the ATM and then she would give me the change instead of me waiting in line for a window so I did that when I came in she wasn't there to help me and nobody else would help me so I would have to get in line and lose my spot in line so that was just bad service or tell me to do one thing then I wasnt able to get what she said.

Nothing special- just an average nail salon that happens to be over priced. I came here today for my first time. Customer service was average and the gel mani was average. I probably wont be back. I asked for dark red and for some reason they didn't let me pick my own color and ended up with bright red nails for the fall. Great.

Also, I wasn't a fan of how they use a nail file to buff your nails. Seems like a good way to make your nails thin and weak. She also never asked what shape I wanted my nails filed and proceeded to make them round although they were already square shaped. 

Overall I do not recommend!

We have a newer Dunkin' Donuts (or Dunkin') in Vail - we decided to swing by there and get some donuts one morning for breakfast. Our plan was buying them in the AM would be our best bet on freshness - didn't work out that way. The donuts were dry even the first day - after the 2nd day, some had to be tossed. Their coffee drinks are very good. We also bought a small box munchkins - they were fine and stayed good for several days. So the rating is average as some items were good, others were not - so I landed on middle of the road.

There is a new Filiberto's in the Vail area - located at Old Vail / Houghton. Food is fresh and tasty ! Menu is huge - be sure to study it closely - the first time we ordered, we did get something different than what we thought we ordered. Very busy drive thru and some seating inside. Order completion is very quick. No salsa bar due to Covid - you have to get what you need from the counter. The enchiladas and tacos are very good - we're still trying other menu items. Prices are good - platters come with rice and beans also. More to come as we try other items on the menu !

Time for a revisit to In-N-Out Burger on Broadway - not as good as I remember it. Had a double meat - bun was kind of dry, should have ordered extra sauce because it needed more flavor and moisture. Fries were excellent, as usual, love the fresh fries at In-N-Out ! Tried a chocolate shake today - yum ! Place was packed at 1:30 in the afternoon - wow didn't remember it being that busy in the afternoon. Good for them ! Staff was very friendly and they did get our order out quickly. Giving it a 4 today - would have been a 5, but the burger just wasn't as good as I remember in the past. Maybe next time . . . Back to 5.

Taco del Mar recently had a menu update. The food changed slightly  (you can now have shrimp tacos!) and the prices went up. I came here with 3 kids and we were able to eat for around $25 (I didn't order a drink). I am slightly disappointed with my experience. Kids meals only had the option for chips as a side  (Despite the displayed menu saying otherwise.. .maybe the employee was misinformed?) And the chips did not come with salsa. I'll probably return because the burritos are still some of the best fast food burritos in town....but my standards have dropped.

My family and I have been faithful customers of Glasses Galore for several years.  They have earned our loyalty the right way, by giving us excellent service consistently with every  individual who has gone to their shop for exams, selection, services and advise.  This is for contact lens, glasses, snorkel and other sporting gear.  Their selection is tremendous from economical to top end designer brands. I recommend them to anyone who talks about shopping for eye wear.  Staff is the best and having a beautiful showcase makes the experience a pleasure.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This branch of this bank is beyond horrible.  Avoid it.  The customer service representatives at this location are rude and incompetent.   We wanted them to re-title a family member's account from being titled as an individual account into an account titled as a Trust.  The jokers at this branch didn't do it for 6 months, though we repeatedly queried and asked them for status.  They had my family member sign and re-sign papers, get them notarized, but still they didn't do this simple task.   A terrible bank.  The tellers themselves seem to be in a perpetual bad mood and are rude beyond imagination, too.

We heard good things about Sun Sushi, but unfortunately we had a bad experience. The most disappointing was the sushi. Both such rolls (Box and Rainbow) has no flavor. The fish was too cold and very low grade sushi. 

We've been all over the world eating sushi and even lived in Asia (Japan for 2 years) for more than 6 years. This was some of the worst restaurant sushi we've experienced. When we got home we both had to eat something to get the taste out of our mouth. 

We're heading back to Arigato Sushi -- they are consistently great with sushi.

The location is great and I did give this place two opportunities. Both times were a fail. The service is poor & the portions are way too small. The second time I went we were a party of seven ordered chips and guacamole and they gave us four large chips to split. Can you say awkward. Seven adults need unlimited chips I'm willing to pay. Also our server took our drink order and did not write down the drinks he got two out of the seven wrong. The music was so loud we could barely talk. Let's just say I will neverbe back.

Since I used to work for a gym, that was recently bought out by another company.. I feel like I would always have to compare. But not here. I went in and signed up immediately! Signed for a year and have been loving it. And my weight loss has been significant. My trainer as well, she been such a blessing. I've never had any problems. The girls up front are very personable and make it a joy to actually walk into a gym and...well workout. The gym is clean and has a great atmosphere. After joining Shapes Total Fitness I don't think ill go anywhere else unless I have to.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Absolutely excellent choice for good Mexican food in Tucson. Very warm & inviting atmosphere, excellent service. The food is wonderful...salsa is made to order, right in front of you at your table. It was impressive & came out so perfectly. The lobster enchiladas were amazing, generous chunks of lobster with a wonderful sauce, huge burros & probably the best rice we've ever had, cooked perfectly with with just the right texture & flavor. It seemed like a very popular spot & we could certainly understand why.

This place was recommended to us by a few people, as we only live 10 minutes away and have never tried it. My husband and I were pleasantly surprised by how amazing the food was! We started with a Caesar salad (big portion, really good and fresh with a ton of shaved parm cheese), and fried mozzarella which was also really good and fresh, not frozen. I got penne vodka with lump crab as my entree.. really really good. The sauce was amazing and portion was perfect (not too big or small). My husband got chicken parm which he said was one of the best he's ever had. A little pricy but worth it for good food. We will definitely be back!

Winco is a great place to go shopping until today.     Went shopping today finished and went to express to check out!    After we finished, we used our credit card to check out and it wouldn't work, we tried different cards but it didn't work, I got the attendant attention, but she ignored us.   After trying again and again , my husband asked for her help and she finally said they don't take credit cards only debit.    She saw us needing help and didn't bother.   Was this a racial thing due to the fact I was Asian and my husband was white?   It wasn't even busy at Winco.    What kind of people do you hire at Winco?     It wasn't even busy!

The food is good but not great rates 3 stars.   We've been there a dozen times and had bad service and long waits more often than not.  We went there after the cycling races and waited almost an hour for our food.  The hostess admitted that our waiter forgot to place our order on the kitchen!  They then presented us with the wrong  food!  This was the last straw.  1 star for service.
  We will probably only do take out in the future.
Went back recently and had a much better experience so I upgraded to a 3 star.

While it touts that their sushi is half price it really is just $2 cheaper than sushi restaurants in the area.  The selection though is pretty good.  We ordered the beef negamaki, the ACE roll, salmon, white tuna, red clam & scallop sashimi.  They were all very fresh though I'd recommend putting slivers of lemon in between the scallop.  My less than five star rating was due to the fact that we had to wait fairly long for our meal.  The table the got seated after we finally got our sushi they barely had 10 minutes go by before they received theirs.

Creole Creamery has delicious ice cream. They have a wide selection of flavors with many unique ones. They change flavors out frequently. Serves ice cream, sorbets, and sherberts. Sampling is allowed. Single scoop is a generous portion. Cash only.

I always bring visitors there to try New Orleans flavors in ice cream form. One must-try is Black and Gold Crunch, which is only available during football season (or all year round if the Saints win the Super Bowl). Recent flavors I have tried include Roasted Pistachio, Golden Summer Fig, Mango Unchained! All excellent. There will be a flavor for everyone.

While many of the menu items are what we've seen before there are some unique dishes. The food tasted fresh, not so overly salted and boring as others. The Verde sauce and refried beans were particularly good. Good flavor in The chicken Monterrey, not just redone veggies from a steamtable. Chips were good salsa could have more chunky fresh veggies and cilantro. 

Noise level will be a problem when it's busy. There's a lot of kitchen noise, the noise of a loud child on the other side of the restaurant sounded very close. Nice  and unique decor but lots of hard surfaces. Clean, will definitely be back.

Rude, horrible customer service. The cooks look like they hate their life with a passion. The quality of the ingredients is very poor. They have their cheap stuff laid out first so you can fill up on that and then few fresh veggies at the end. They are always rude about your portions and examine the punch cards for at least a minute to make sure you didn't somehow make your own little MG to stamp on there for a free lunch! I honestly don't know how this place is still open. Location? Hence my two stars instead of one. It's close to my house

Ebisu is a cute sushi shack. It had a comfortable ambiance and would be convenient for anyone in Seminole heights. The food was good, I enjoyed the fried squid legs. Some of the sushi rolls were better than others. Everyone said to try the orange roll and it was good but it almost tasted watery, not sure what that's about. The roll with Cheetos on top was delicious, and the volcano roll was a 7/10. The service was great. Overall I probably wouldn't come back just because of the numerous other options for sushi in the surrounding area but it is still a good restaurant

I joined City Fitness January of this year and I am so happy that I did! The staff is very friendly and helpful and honestly have your best interest and fitness goals in mind with everything they do! I started working out with one of the trainers (Alissa H) through the Thrive program that They offer.  Alissa has been awesome and has helped me loose weight and inches and get noticeably stronger.  She is always on time and makes the most out of my session with her and makes them fun and enjoyable, it's like working out with a friend!  I would recommend City Fitness and the Thrive program to anyone!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This is a great find for authentic Mexican border food. We previously lived in California and Arizona so we have eaten lots of good and bad Mexican food, and are excited to this place. Today for  lunch at El Paso we sampled a chorizo quesadilla and sopes with lengua. Both were excellent, as was the salsa, with just enough heat, and crisp house-made chips. After we finished our food we discovered that two other salsas are available, so we will try those next time.

A note to those who may be timid about venturing into this tiny, bare bones café -- the proprietors are bilingual and very cordial so there is no communication difficulty.

to start it off i asked for sweet and sour sauce and barbecue and only received barbecue. but not only was i so disrespected by not receiving the proper sauce but it also took over 10 minutes to get my order at the so called "best fast food" restaurant chain. when i asked the manager with a firm respectful voice where my order was she rudely responded that she called the order 6 times but i know for a true fact that she did not. i also discovered soon after that my 6 piece nuggets i ordered was in fact a 4 piece to my surprise. so i believe this mcdonald's should immediately be shut down and or getting a new management and staff. thank you
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I've been going to Spruce for about a year now and finally decided that its time to go somewhere else.

This is due to the fact that in the last year, four of my shirts have come back with holes in them.  Always the same size.  Always in the same place.

The old guy who runs the place tries to say that they are normal wear and tear but these shirts have all been less than a couple months old when the holes happened.

He will sew them up and try to charge but I've been able to argue with him and get them sewed for free.

However, the holes shouldn't be happening in the first place.

Time to look for somewhere new.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Got alterations completed for a replacement for a zipper . This is the sloppiest alteration I have ever had in my life ,Geesh . My dress is has also been sewn back together so unevenly . I would highly suggest not getting alterations done here . Then they made me get my item dry clean a second time before getting alterations so the price was ridiculous , all for this sloppy work ! Baffled ! Won't be returning ! And the staff are very unfriendly ! Never will you here a good morning , they just snatch your items from the counter and get to sitting up how much ur items will be . Just wow !
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: heck!! the BEST hibachi no-meat noodles i've ever ever had!!! usually when I order noodles at Japanese restaurants they don't have a lot of flavor but these were perfect!! honestly it seems a like a weird part of town at night but it is so totally worth it and the service is so friendly!! sadly I didn't get a picture of the noodles before I ate them because I was so ready to dive in but look!! the entire plate was full of noodles and I ate them all!! my father got the Kenner roll and said it was divine!! also the vegetable tempura was superb!! not greasy or oily !! i'm using so many exclamations but they are well needed, honestly.

Can't wait for them to open visited their location in Florida they did an amazing job great quality equipment. 


OK it must've been opening day so I thought I would give it a try over all the car came out pretty clean though I would not recommend the more expensive option. Because the rims were full of Armor all that does nothing but attract road dust they look horrible within minutes they don't do any manual drying so my recommendation would be get the basic wash you have to vacuum your own car anyway and touch it up once you pull out to the vacuums.

Can't wait for them to open visited their location in Florida they did an amazing job great quality equipment.

Because the rims were full of Armor all that does nothing but attract road dust they look horrible within minutes they don't do any manual drying so my recommendation would be get the basic wash you have to vacuum your own car anyway and touch it up once you pull out to the vacuums.

2/2016: Sad to say the sushi I ordered was not at all fresh and, because of this, will not be coming back anytime soon. There are plenty of local Tampa fresh sushi spots that will quell my taste for yummy sushi. I'll try Yoko's again in a year or so...but not in any hurry. 

11/2015:
Freshest sushi I've experienced in Tampa in the four years I've lived here. They also take pride in their work so the customer service is top notch! And if my tastebuds weren't enough to tempt you, the restaurant is always packed with locals who know what's up :)

Prices are higher than other close by stores.  We decided to stop in and purchase an advertised (street sign advertisement) beer on a whim.  This would have been a good purchase but they didn't have it in stock.  Call it false advertising, bait and switch, or poor inventory planning as I stopped in a couple of days later and still no sale item.  This is not my first choice, rarely stop in due to the repeated nature of my concerns.  I assume they are less competitive due to their small footprint, so while I can accept higher prices as a result, the store should yank it's advertising if it can't fill orders.

This was my first visit to Pearle Vision. It was such a great experience from the minute I walked in. The staff was so helpful. I felt Dr. Bingham really addressed my concerns and listened to me. He explained everything. I did get a new pair of eyeglasses and the gentleman who assisted me went above and beyond. I was so indecisive and he was so patient and offered many suggestions and even looked to see if frames I liked came in different colors. Overall, great experience, excellent selection of frames, and a great Dr. and staff.
