categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Today was $5 individual pizza. What a great deal. I got the meateor and my son got the Hawaiian. The food came out hot and fast. Guess it helps if you are the first ones in the restaurant. Lol. The waitress was nice and talked with us.  When she was busy the other waiter stepped in. I must say a much better service then the last time I was there. Last time we walked in a group of 4 the place wasn't busy and we let ourselves known we were there. They said hold I'll be right with you. Ten minutes later with hungry kids still nothing. We walked out. I'm glad it was better this time.

Just ok. My expectations were low to begin with. Sunday gravy is a long tradition in my husbands family and I wasn't expecting much from a restaurant. I was still disappointed. The gravy was bland, no bread, and too much food. The place is tiny. The tables were spaced nicely with ample room between them but the dining room still felt congested. There was only a limited bar - wine, cans of beer, and premixed signature drinks. If red gravy is a tradition in your home, pass on Little Nonna's and make it at home.

We came in because our hotel gave us a complimentary drink and stayed for several more. Got there about 4pm and it was pretty empty but it filled up by 5pm. Our bartender was Deanna and she was wonderful. She worked her butt off the entire  time.  Stocking the bar,  making drinks, cleaning tables plus she was friendly and knowledgeable about drinks and about the city. It was fun to watch her. She's an asset to the bar. The jazz band playing prohibition era music was entertaining as well. My wife and I enjoyed it and we'd go back again!

Arguably the best Italian food I've ever had. Im not Italian aand wasn't brought up on this type of food but this stuff is to die for. Shrimp scampi was heaven with a weinderful butter, wine sauce that was great soaking up with their fresh Italian baked bread. We had the Billa salad which we shared that was great.  For our entrees I had the Chicken Bella Bucca that was topped with spinach, I would recommend this. My partner had a veal pizzaolini that was exceptional. This place is best on a tuesday nite cus it gets packed on weekends which isnt surprising.

This place is great! After reading the reviews I decided to try it out and loved it. I got a gel manicure and pedicure done by Vu and it's perfect. The staff is very friendly and they take their time (even when there are people waiting), which I LOVED because I hate feeling rushed. They were also great at suggesting colors (which was perfect because I'm very indecisive). Vu was very gentle and gave a great massage. I spent two hours there and am not sad about it. It's not perfectly clean (the floor was dusty from acrylic powder) but most inexpensive salons are like that, and the awesome service was worth it. I will definitely be going back.

Beautiful old mansion and lovely patio for the summer months. But the food fell short. 
I've been to this restaurant several times only for lunch. I was excited to try the pizza as it looked fabulous. It looked much better than is was.  Very bland. Which is what I find to be the case with all of their pastas as well. 
Service is hit and miss. Last summer I went with a friend to enjoy the patio. The service was a disaster. Totally inattentive. At one point even spilled red wine on my friends white jeans. Barely an apology and did nothing to compensate. 
Unlikely we will go back.

It is really hard to overstate how consistently excellent Pumpkin's Sunday prix fixe offerings have been over the past several years. We are rarely anything short of delighted and amazed with the inventive flavors and variety of dishes. There is definitely a theme and sensibility at work, but it's so reliably satisfying that we can't imagine going anywhere else in Philly on a Sunday night. I travel all over the US (and work in NYC) and get to enjoy terrific meals most places I go. But I rarely have a meal that comes close to Pumpkin even at 2x or 3x the price.

We stopped here for dinner during a pub crawl last week. Against my normal behavior, I ordered the special of the day. Grilled chicken and a fettuccini type sauce with cherry tomatoes. The chicken tasted gamey.  I ate a couple pieces and couldn't eat any more of it. It didn't taste right. So I then just focused on the tomatoes and left the rest. The service was excellent and the restaurant was clean and inviting. That night, I was sick to my stomach and get sick the morning at the airport.  Luckily, one of the airport stores had Pepto. So I made the flight without an embarrassing incident. I cannot recommend.

We've been to another Taqueria Corona and this was a bit different. In general, it was just OK. The food was good, the drinks too. The service was fast and the staff is friendly. Quality-wise I feel it wasn't as good as the other taqueria corona. The rib-eye tacos were kinda dry and the shrimp tacos were too soggy. The cheese in the enchilada was REALLY delicious! The rice and beans were also not-so-fresh but overall the food was ok. We also had drinks. They don't have much variety of margaritas so I was kind of disappointed. Servers are friendly.

I will say on the pros: what I ordered was good. I will say on the cons: the egg roll was half the size of what people would expect to be a normal eggroll. Ordering in downtown Saint Pete is give-and-take, this is a nice little Chinese to go place, however with a guaranteed business of being in downtown Saint Pete, smaller portions and higher prices than what you normally see at locals takeouts..  I live in uptown, however when I order here again? Probably not. It's worth more to me to drive an extra half mile for the same food at a cheaper price.

This is our favorite spot. We eat sushi 2-3 times per month. Excellent service and the rolls and nigiri are superb! The staff know us as regulars and engage us in friendly conversation, no matter how busy they get. They even remember our usual drink orders. Clean and quiet restaurant and the sushi, dessert and check come out quickly, whether you're at the bar or a table. I only wish the restaurant was larger so I could bring my entire immediate family and show them how great JJ's is! I think the largest table they have fits around 8. See you soon!

There is great equipment here, but beware of the contract you sign. I needed to cancel after coronavirus and was told I would have to pay at least half of the year before I was able to cancel. I was also charged when I was supposed to be on a freeze. Again, gym is in great condition, but there are other gyms in the area that won't be such a nightmare with charges!

The childcare also has weird hours that change constantly! The workers in the childcare center are very nice, but there is a lack of consistency.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Great addition to the neighborhood! I haven't had a full dinner experience yet, but have visited several times for cocktails and small plates at the bar. As a vegan they are able to offer several options and I will say that I will return repeatedly for the Umami Brussel Sprouts (minus the cheese) and their Sweet Potato Fries! I was thoroughly impressed by their bartender and their creative cocktail menu. I work around the corner and love having a place to visit with co-workers after work. A real gem with kind employees and a welcoming vibe!

I know this is McDonald's, but it is always frustrating when there's a long wait or they mess up the order. Many times we've been asked to wait in the spot up front even for a simple order when there's no one behind us or it seems they cannot get the order right (e.g. onions when we said no onions; putting eggs on the side for an egg Mcmuffin for no logical reason). Besides that, in my experience the drive-thru folks are not friendly which I feel you should be if we are giving you business. PS - they sometimes cannot hear your order if the train is going by.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The positive is that the pizza is good-I can't really comment on the varieties since I stimbled into one of the signatures first time in and have stayed with it since it was so good.  For the negatives: the music is always way too loud to enjoy being inside for longer than a few moments, unfortunately due to the customization the service does take a while, so you're forced to hang listen to the ruckus. It'd be a more regular place for me to visit (and five stars) if not for the decible level and everyone yelling over it.

well here it is -20 plus degrees and our office needed doughnuts!! it was our polar vortex insurance so we needed those carbs to burn!! LOL we ordered through Grub Hub and I was a bit reticent after reading the reviews of the orders not being correct. However, my order was correct no issues and delivered on time to a very happy hungry office :) Thank you and GrubHub for delivery on such a chilly morn! oh the Doughnuts were Awesome! the Cronuts were great, and i loved the white fluff ones. !! will definitely be ordering again!

The first time I went to ATL wings I ordered the Teriyaki wings which were tooo salty. I had to wipe them off with a napkin in order to enjoy them.  My Mother ordered the garlic pepper and they were really good. The fries were soggy like they cooked them earlier and placed them in a pan and reheated them to order. I always try a place twice before I give a final review. The second time I ate here I ordered the garlic pepper wings and fries. This time the fries tasted fresh and the wings were actually better than before! Give them a try if your on South Street!

I can't go more than two weeks without coming here for sushi. By day twelve, I am a little twitchy and nervous- jonesing for some Kazoku. I love that they still give you edamame and miso when you sit down (the way a sushi joint should). The sushi has always been reasonably priced, good, and fresh. The service is always friendly and relaxed. And the ice cream finish is an over the top nice touch. I would give this place five stars but the bathrooms need a serious re-fresh. They are clean but they are poorly lit and just look tired. At least judging by the men's room. But I go there for the excellent food and service, not the restroom.

So I ordered a medium Frappe with 2 shots of espresso in a large cup. I get it ALL the time in many McDonald's, especially this 1.
But this time the girl handed me a Frappe, with 40% whipped cream. I said "no, I'm not $6 for whipped cream. So I said I would park and come in. This time the cup looked right, but it was all ICE! NO FLAVOR! So I got the wonderfully kind manager. It took like 6 more minutes (total 14 minutes), but he fixed it Perfect AND gave me a large! Props to you manager, but to the poorly kempt girl who can't even take the time to be nice, she should probably move along!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Arrived around 3:30pm for a late lunch/early dinner with my daughter and my wife.
The three of us placed our order without problem. Food was prepared accurately and in a timely manner.
However, when we went into the dining area, the manager was conducting a large employee meeting (approx 15 to 20 employees). The attitude of the employees attending was aggressive, loud, and disruptive.
It made for a VERY awkward dining experience as most of the complaints from the employees were about customers in general.
We ate quickly, kept our heads low, and got out before we were lynched.

I came in on a Friday with a few friends for the first time. I really liked their specials, Mon - Fri 8 pm to close $2 domestic, $3 imports and half price apps. 

But I didn't love their sushi menu. I had the Sumo Slam roll and a salmon ngiri. The fish was nice and fresh, but none of the flavors in the speciality roll really popped. 

The service was also pretty slow. We had to ask multiple times for things, and it took maybe 45 minutes to get our rolls. 

Hot Tuna is ok, but I'd much rather go to Soho Sushi.

They  water down the drinks to a point they do not taste anything like they should, it was like drinking sewer flavored water. I've been here about 3 times (not by my choice) and had the same experience each time, so this was not a one time thing, and the other people I was with had the same complaint of nasty tasting watered down drinks. I also had different drinks each of those times, I've had their Dunkachino, Vanilla Chai (which I usually love) and hot chocolate. They should be ashamed to sell drinks like this.

Stay away from this Dunkin Donuts, the other locations are much, much better.

Friendly hostess!!! BUT...had problems from the git-go. A washer got locked up and its door wouldn't open. She didn't know how to get it going nor unlocked, called her boss, inserted more coins, got it started BUT in the incorrect temp, i.e., cold and not warm. (I decided at this point to accept the cold temp.) One of the entrance/exit double-doors was locked making it a little more awkward. Too, the washers seem smaller than what I've experienced elsewhere. It's wi-fi works! One more thing, a good thing, definitely: They saved my laptop when I accidentally made the mistake of leaving it behind. (I thanked them profusely.)
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: This is regarding the McKay's Mill location. Lunch today was not a good experience. Waiter was obviously new and needed help with his English. I understand the shortage of workers in today's economy so let this slide. Peach marguerites came with salt on rim. Who salts peaches? Ordered food. Order came out looking nothing like the menu illustration and side not as ordered. Manager seemed unconcerned and said they could not prepare the entree as it was illustrated. Left most of the meal untouched. Paid and left. Another first time last time experience.

We love Joey's Pizza in Thorndale. They are a staple on our regular take out schedule.  The white pizza is by far the best I've ever had.  Cheesesteaks and Stromboli are also a household favorite.  The salads are also excellent. Joeys is almost always packed around dinner time so I always call my order in and then go pick it up.  The beer selection is surprisingly good for a pizza place but the beer is a bit on the pricy side. The staff are friendly and everyone is always working hard in there. We will continue to feb regulars at Joey's.

DELICIOUS FOOD!!! It's a Tucson Gem. Truly one of the last few great spots to get authentic food. I like the sushi however I sat at the bar once (I've been going here for years) and I really lost my appetite after seeing the way the sushi chefs were not sanitary at all. I also noticed one of the sushi chefs go to the bathroom with his gloves on and walked out with them on and still went straight back to work. I was in shock and ended up ordering Ramen instead.  The SERVICE though is truly wonderful. The ladies who are waitresses are fantastic.

As native Texans, we spent months searching for a place in Philly that would be able to satisfy our hardcore cravings for Mexican food. After a string of disappoints that seemed like it would never end, we finally came across Que Chula es Puebla. Now,  I'm pretty sure we're some of the most regular customers here and the staff know our order by heart. 

I'm not saying it's Mexican perfection, but it is fantastically comforting, chill, affordable, and super consistent. Basically it plays lead role in keeping us sane here in PA.

Go to order is chicken fajitas with flour tortillas and a side of pico. Literally tastes like home.

I have to be honest. I can't figure out if I like Farm and Fisherman. I have been there four times. While the servers are good, they seem to have an edge or an attitude. As for the food, it is definitely fresh, but with exception of a the omelette of the day I have never been wowed. I go out to eat approximately six times a week and I rarely think of heading to FAF. I wish I did because I live in the area. Maybe they need to change up the menu...and not just for the season. I don't know. Few offerings, not very exciting.

The DoubleTree is THE place to hold a convention.  We just had 330 Red Hat Society members there and we were all treated like Queens.  The staff absolutely out did themselves to keep us all happy.  The food was amazing and we could not have had a better experience.  The rooms are beautiful and very comfortable as well.  I cannot say enough good things about this hotel and will definitely be going back.  Of course, all the free cookies make you stay even better!
Special thanks to Karen, Mittal, Paris, Aseem, Sammie and all the rest of you who welcomed us into your home!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We usually get carry out from Vincent ' - the food is good enough to still be yummy when we get home at the end of the block - but this time the wait was twice as long as we were told, salads were ready and sitting on the counter for 20 minutes - right beside dirty glassware and trash!!! Yuck. The main courses will still tasty but the experience brings down the rating. The dining room wasn't even full. I am hoping it was just an 'off' night because if this happens a second time there are just too many other options in Riverbend and I will just put Vincent ' at the bottom of my list.

Cleanliness was lacking but the food was a definite bargain. The seafood and tofu soup was wonderful, the veggie chow mein was good and the sweet and sour chicken was nice and crisp (yes, I know... but that's what my youngsters like to eat at a Chinese restaurant--I can only assume the other more authentic dishes would be even better).  It's close to my wife's work and our daycare so I'll definitely be coming back.  

FYI: it's on the SW corner of Prater and McCarran near the west end of the strip mall; you definitely don't want to turn into the wrong corner or you're in for a bunch of turns against traffic.

This was my 2nd time here. First, Christina is amazing my dip manicure not only looked great but it lasted, however that's where the good ends. My 2nd visit I didn't have Christina and the service was awful, I was cut (to the point of Bleeding) 3 times and my dip is not clean at the edges. My nails aren't even and they are bumpy. I'm really disappointed that they don't take appointments and they aren't honest about how long the wait is. 
Lastly, I'm  concerned that I saw reuse of manicure tools between customers  (especially since cutting to the point of bleeding seems a common trend on the reviews) and they don't use tub liners

The coffee was good and the staff was very nice, but the overall atmosphere and cleanliness wasn't impressive. It seemed like supplies were just set down every where. Lots of piles and clutter and it definitely made me question the overall cleanliness. There was one small table there in the tiny room, making it not very enticing for a group wanting to chat over coffee or students to come work for hours. The place is in desperate need of more space, renovation, organization and some cleaning. I'm sure this is a new business just getting started, but they have a lot of work to do before I return.

Why do people at this wendy's always seem so miserable? I visit this location at least once or twice a month and I honestly have never had anyone here say hi or smile. It's close to impossible to even get eye contact. 

The food is good, but everyone here seems so depressed. On today's visit, the woman opened the window, handed me my food, and closed the window. Not even a word! They aren't busy, so I didn't understand the rudeness or rush. So through the class, i thanked her and told her to have a great day as well. Come on, Wendy's. You're a cool company. Let's get these employees smiling again!

If you are looking for decent Italian food, run don't walk away from this place. Yes, it's very crowded and the restaurant seems to be very popular but that says more about the low standards of people that live in Chester County rather than the quality of this establishment. 
The food is at best Olive Garden standards with a higher price tag. The pastas we ordered are over cooked and tasted like jar sauce. The risotto was a joke. The veal had no taste with texture of card board. The service was friendly and efficient however.

Ok so we wanted a quick dinner before a concert and they came through with the speedy service so they get big points for accommodating us.   However the food was nothing special.  I got raviolis.  They tasted land looked like what comes out of the frozen section from cosco.  Bit disappointed about how factory made they looked and tasted.   The sauce on it was very tasty tho and tasted authentic Italian.  The antipasto salad was also delicious and had a delicious Italian dressing.   So will I be back....maybe...

Ok I'm conflicted about this place.   I usually don't eat at fast food in general. But we needed food fast tonight so we are here...   The fries were fresh and delicious.. The burgers were typical.  This place would get a four star compared to other fast food.  However the place is filthy!    Tables not cleaned floors were dirty.  To in front of the bathrooms in the dining area... All while attendants are chatting and laughing behind the counters.   And our cashier couldn't smile to save her life!    Yikes....    This was very disappointing even for a fast food joint....   Please improve this location....   Very disappointed...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Used them for a wash and mini wax this week.   Tuesday's are senior's days with 15% off the wash.   Attention to detail is what sets Richboro car wash apart.  The detail waxing crew went over every inch of the car in a professional manor and I was very pleased.  They brought the car around and I inspected it ... they responded to minor areas that still needed a cloth wiping.   I now feel prepared for winter since I have to keep my SUV outside. 
They offer a full in and out detail which I'll probably get in the spring.  Fair price for outstanding work.  ps:  I can't remember the last time the inside of the windows looked so clean. :)

Ordered delivery twice from here. First time wasn't bad but it was also not a busy time of day. The last time I ordered here was before an Eagles game & my food showed up almost 2 hours after I ordered it & my pizza was lukewarm. I had to reheat my pizza in the oven as soon as it showed up. Wings were terrible, lukewarm and barely any meat on them. if they would have called & let me know my order was gonna be a little behind schedule, I would have waited patiently, instead of receiving the delivered food that wasn't up to par. At least the 2 liter of coke was cold.... Also the pizza needs more sauce!

Not a fan. Everything was hot (delivery) but the chicken was soggy, the beef had a weird texture, the broccoli was rubbery. Ordered a fried rice also that was good enough but all the shrimp was sitting on top, so it looked like a decent amount of shrimp in it but there were none throughout and rather than asking if we wanted white rice (since we'd ordered fried rice) they also gave us two white rice containers with our orders. Just seems like a waste to me. 
Tried the sushi also. Anyone who says they have the best in the area must be used to supermarket sushi. No thanks. 
No need to go back.

Had my first visit last night, and while the service was good at first, it kind of dwindled towards the end of the evening and we were just sitting there waiting for our waiter. The two other biggest disappointments were the Mojito, which was straight out of a bottle pre-made mix, thrown over some ice with a couple mint leaves. I definitely expected much better there. Kind of tasted like toilet cleaner. The other was the chile relleno which I see in other reviews has always been terrible, so definitely skip that.

Babes pizza is delicious! But we ate there with friends a week or so ago and the waitresses were not only rude, they never cracked a smile. Fortunately we had a new young male waiter who was very nice. Otherwise the 'girls' may have ruined our get together with friends. Their were 10 in our party, you would think they would appreciate our business. The owner is very nice, I wonder if he knows how his waitresses treat his customers. Again, the pizza is fabulous as long as mediocre to bad service is okey with you!

I want to point out that I am a coffee lover first and a loyal Starbucks customer.This Starbucks is one of the best around. They have employees that have been working there for years and treat you like family. Sandy, whom you can almost always find at the cash register always greets you with a smile, she is one of the most pleasant persons you could ever meet. Don't forget about the manager Isa, he always goes the extra mile for his customers. If Howard Schultz, the Starbucks founder stopped by this Starbucks location, even he would be impressed with the quality and service.

The atmosphere was nice and the staff was friendly but not very attentive.  They seemed far more concerned with talking to each other and regulars than they did bringing orders or simple drink requests.  

Food was flavorful but both of my sides, vegetables and smashed potatoes, were cold when they arrived.  Also split an appetizer of their "famous wings" that were small and not anything to be excited about.  The prices were also a bit higher than I'd have liked or expected.  

I really wanted to like Rhode's Fireside.  It just didn't do it for me.

First time visiting for skateboard competition at FDR park with son.  
Nice sized room on 3rd floor.   Nice beds and TV.  Weird free WiFi for only 24 hours with a timer attached.  We stayed 18 hours so did not care.

Hotel has no restaurant so ate at Hotel across the driveway.  

Some food in lobby .. but $3.50 DIY bagels and $8.00 DIY Espresso is a bit obscene.  

The staff was very nice.  

A small indoor heated pool was a good diversion.  Alas no jacuzzi.  

Airport view was interesting but sounds from there were no problem.

Would come back again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Given the lack of suburban dining options that are better than just "decent" (particularly in Lower Merion), I was so excited to try the Saint James... especially given the hype preceding its opening - so try it we did.

Count me among the underwhelmed.  The quality of the food and the cooking technique in no way matched the cost.  The prices of menu items and portions were on par with what you'd typically expect of a good restaurant in the upper end of the casual dining spectrum.  The food, not so much -- small portion sizes, greasy, lack of real flavor.

May give it another chance at some point.  What a wasted opportunity for them!  Sigh.

I came here looking for a specific item which was no longer stocked. I managed to grab other essential items such as coffee and cubed sugar. The store itself seems well stocked and clean. 

My only compliant is that I wish the cashiers and other store personnel were profesional and engaging. They are are sweet as a bite of a lemon. They come off as if they are being held against their will, and this is displayed in their lack of professionalism.

I will engage other Rouses Market in hopes of better customer service.

We recently moved to Clayton, from New York, and have been trying out all the local restaurants.  Mad Tomato was recommended by a friend from Ladue and so we tried it out this evening.  We came with our two young children.  Normally we would dine outside, however due to a potential storm we headed inside.

The place was very nice and we we quickly given a nice sized table for four. 

The service was very good - they looked after us very well.  Food was great (Seasonal Salad, Lamb and Pork Chop Milanese).

We will be back and would definitely recommend Mad Tomato to friends.   On our next visit we will try out the Patio also.

Everything was just very bland and tasted a bit old(like when something sits in the refrigerator for a while),the wontons for the soup were stale. We got a dish that had a pepper on the side, which is supposed to indicate that it's spicy, it didn't even have flavor, much less spice. The Rangoons have no crab and are sweet. The shrimp toast definitely tasted old and overcooked. The egg drop soup was pretty bland. It is cheap! So illl give it that. We have plenty of leftovers that aren't even going to be eaten because it's so lackluster..

They mess up my order at least half the time. But they're fast. If only the were fast and accurate. ‍

Can someone tell the employees when someone pays with apple pay in the drive thru, not to take the persons phone? Bring the card reader to the car window, you don't take the persons phone. I think only two employees know this. It's annoying.

Edited to add:
I was writing this while waiting on my food, I just pulled up to the second window and two employees were talking rudely about about customer with me right there. Not very professional here either I guess.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We celebrated my husband birthday dinner here & it was delicious! From the hostess, greeter, waitress & owner everyone was very warm & welcoming from beginning to end. We ordered the fried cauliflower with a special sauce concoction which is mouth watering! The margherita pizza was made in a huge pizza oven which is visibly displayed in the restaurant. My husband said the dough was made perfectly. My favorite part was the mozzarella! I consider myself a foodie & cannot wait to come back and try many other things on the menu and bring my friends. Louie will be added to my list of new restaurant hot spots to dine in 2018! - Jarah & Devin Warren

Still running slow at drive thru...people are friendly and seem to be trying to give good service, but it just takes forever to get thru the drive up.
I also wish there were some big improvement in the breakfast sandwich offerings...it sounds great to offer a bacon, cheese, egg sandwich, but, when the roll is funky, semi stale tasting, the egg is a pre cooked, maybe frozen disc...yuk!  Bacon was ok on taste, terribly undercooked and not crisp at all.  Combination just totally bad and at the price, really, really bad.

NEVER GO HERE. WORST SERVICE EVER! No one has any idea what they're supposed to be doing. No one has any clue what time appointments are scheduled, all employees are negligent, rude, and incapable of doing their job. Don't bother showing up to any appointment on time here. You'll get there, check in and they'll tell you your appointment is actually an hour later. They lose prescriptions, never make calls back, and so much more. It's a complete and total waste of time and money to go here. Do yourself a favor and avoid this disaster of a "vision center."
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Ordinary Mexican food with unfriendly wait staff. It took a long time to get our drinks ordered . I asked for mild salsa and it didn't come until our food came. The waitress never looked at us in the eye and never refilled our drinks . It was during lunch and was not busy. I would prefer El Molonitos. 

I guess if I were to eat there again, I would order take out , but even then I would worry they wouldn't get my order correct. Prices are too high when I can go to another place with better service and prices .

Every time I come here, and go in the drive thru, that girl always tries to tell me to wait after I've placed my order, why am I going to sit there and wait after I place my order.  The line up is backing up behind me, people on the drive thru are getting irritable.  Please can someone train these people how drive thru works???  Every time I come here I regret it.  Btw when she says "wait till I tell you to move ahead". I don't listen and just drive ahead.  Please train that girl at the window.  

Thanks,

Every single person at the drive thru.

I've been here 5-6 times. I feel like the restaurant used to be very good (4-5 stars) but the last 2 times I've been really underwhelmed. Other than the Oysters Amani and the Honey Lavender Creme Brûlée, everything has tasted boring and uninspired. I feel like something changed the last 12 months. I love that it's a BYOB but the food just hasn't been good enough for us to keep coming. That plus last time we were with friends and talking and drinking wine after the meal and the servers stopped refilling water and were snapping fingers to leave. My wife and I will not return.

I think those that can't appreciate the food at MidAtlantic can't appreciate fine food. The atmosphere in my opinion is very cool witih its open kitchen and mix of recycled materials while at the same time having a modern but minimalist appeal. The servers all seem knowledgable and if they don't know the answers they are quick to find them. The food is fresh, creative and presented well. The farmhouse salad tastes like the ingredients came in straight from the Farmer's Market. The veggie scrapple is spicy and delicious and the desserts are devine. Check it out!

It used to be pleasant; it used to be professional; and it used to be worth the money.

Now the haircuts run at $140/hour and they think nothing of having a 10+ minute conversation over your head with each other - getting terribly defensive when it's brought to their attention.

Needless to say: "No more." Unless you enjoy getting harassed on your phone and chided by a shopgirl.

The level of customer service, concern for customer needs and considerations have pretty much all evaporated. T

After almost two years of patronage, time to look for another venue. Shouldn't be hard - anything else is better.

First and last visit. Went in for ombré powder dip on my natural nails. My nails were extremely thick and not natural looking when Vi finished my manicure. As she was doing my manicure she kept dipping her brush in a liquid then in the powder then on my nails. I've been getting powder dips for over 2 years and have never seen this method. When I left my fingers were sore and itchy. They remained this way for days. After 5 days I went to another salon to have Vi's job removed from my nails. The other salon took over an hour to get the thick glue like bond off my natural nails. My nails are now thin & brittle.

Five star service! Ordered on a Friday night and 30 minutes later picked up without a hitch. As far as pizza, Lou's separates itself from most by using quality ingredients and balanced flavors. The deep dish spinach has a perfect cheese, sauce, spinach, crust ratio. The dough has a fantastic yeasty quality that goes perfectly with a Pilsner. The cheese is not overwhelming like some deep dish and is countered by the acidic garlicky sweet and herby sauce and spinach mix. My young daughter liked her thin crust cheese. My son enjoyed a personal pepperoni deep dish but only ate 1/2. Good news for my lunch tomorrow. Highly recommended.

Received a new restaurant flyer in the area plus they delivery and delivery is free. What a bonus. Unfortunately the food was mediocre. I ordered the sesame chicken with shrimp fried rice, fried chicken wings with pork fried rice and an order of crab Rangoon. The rice was pretty good. The chicken was very salty and sesame chicken is suppose to be more on the sweeter side. The crab Rangoon was ehh. Okay. Lastly, they like to round up the the total. My order came to 21.00 flat when it was suppose to be like 20.19. Nice rounding out for sure. But since they are new maybe it would get better.

Was able to find this place because of fellow yelpers reviews.  Like the review below it is hidden in the franktown corners mall but was easy to find.  

I got the bordertown wrap with was a lot bigger than i thought for the price!  It was diced garden burger with lettuce tomatos and i chose a chipotle sauce on a tomato basil tortilla.  If i had to do it again i would put the sauce on the side as it was too flavorful for my taste (as most dressings are for salads in restaurants though)  It had a small town cafe feel.  I also got their apple fritter which tasted freshly made and not that sweet.

I don't know how to rate mimi nails.. I wish yelp could give 1/2 stars because maybe they deserve 3.5/5. For reference, I get gel nails every time. 
Pros: They have a good amount of colors to choose from. The price is definitely right. 
Cons: you wait for a while if you don't make an appointment and then the staff rush you. The colors on the gel nail samples never seem accurate once they paint them on your nail. And lastly, after having 1 or 2 nails done and telling them you want to change the color, they always give a hard no.
Overall, I don't mind this place, but it's never my first choice.

Whatever. They pretend they like you and make you feel,like they will be supportive and help you learn more about fitness.

Reality, once you sign up, you will be lucky if they even remember you.
Of course that is if you kiss their you know what every time YOU see the (the owners) unless you are another business owner who they can get something for free.

This is meant for only a certain type of customer like their website mentions "upper middle class" or the north east yuppies that hang out at no other places but the ones on beach drive. 

No thanks.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: A trip to New Orleans is not complete without taking a trip to Bourbon Street and paying a visit to Tropical Isle!! Yep, after a long day at work; a hand grenade is in order!! I can't really tell you what's in it but one will make u silly; two will possibly have you stumbling and three you just might end up on the floor. Yep that's right!! They are super strong but for whatever reason it taste like punch! I paid about $16 bucks for mine but I did get it without ice. Ice is recommended. I think it's neat that you get a little souvenir cup! They are doing construction on Bourbon Street but you have to make it happen when you're in the area!

eatalia is a decent Italian restaurant.  byob is always a plus.  it's in a strange location for this type of food/place.  friendly service but a bit on the slow side at times during our meal.  food was good but not amazing.  some items were better than others.  we've tried a lot of Italian places all over philly and are a bit spoiled.  eatalia is very good for the area it's in but we've had better in philly (some places in south philly and center city are tough to beat).  overall a cozy place and it's easy to find parking right outfront.  good if you live in the area but wouldn't go out of my way for it..

I've rented here twice; it's the only National location in STL, and my work has a contract with them so we get better rates.

I love National, in general, but this location is not a good example of what I normally expect from them.  Service is severely lacking!  I could not get help as I was picking up the car or dropping it off...and they don't allow cars on the lot, so local renters are forced to walk on Natural Bridge to get picked up.

The savings AND the Emerald Aisle do not outweigh the hassle for local renters and the poor customer service.  I will not rent from this location again.

What has happened to this Jerry Bob's? The food is not as good as it used to be. They have changed some key ingredients. The portions are smaller. There is an atmosphere that is hard to explain, the wait staff used to be happy. There must be a new manager or something. We are done coming here. This used to be one of our favorite places. Now it is not a good value or a happy place. We will certainly miss going there. What has happened to change this place so much? (We haven't gone to any other Jerry Bob's so I can't speak about them, just this one at River and La Cholla.)

Ooka is the place to go if you want to get amazing sushi! My date got the Lobster Dynamite Roll and I got the Popcorn Shrimp Roll. We also shared the sashimi sampler. Everything was bursting with flavor and tasted super fresh.

First of all, make a reservation. The wait could be an hour so we called ahead of time and got our table right away. The place was packed, and that usually means the food is good. 

We got our sushi pretty quickly and we ate every last bit. I highly recommend both of the rolls. We will definitely be coming back soon!

We arrived at Easton Nails and the workers were not very welcoming towards me.  My daughters were waited on right away while I was overlooked for over 45 minutes . It was very unsanitary as they used a dirty towel on my legs. The workers were not careful about their 
work . I did not get my moneys worth because the full pedicure wasn't completed.  They hardly clipped my nails and didn't give me a paraffin wax. They did not even give me an ample amount of time to dry my nails and they rushed me out. It was my first time and I'm not planning to return.

Go to this place. Order like seven cannolis. You can go to the gym later it's fine. Now let me explain, I'm Italian. I'm a sucker for Italian food. And sweets. And really just food in general. That being said, I've had cannoli and then I've had "cannoli" - you know - the store bought icing filled cookie that resembles a cannoli so they call it a cannoli but it's just an imposter. Forget about those. This place does them right, and that's something to be treasured. So like I said, go. Grab 7. Minimum. And maybe hit the gym on your way home.

We tried this last night. Got there early as I had heard it gets pretty busy later on. Loved everything. Homemade strawberry soda very refreshing and natural. Had the beets  and an item not on the menu snails and tails.  Escargot and crawfish tails. Wonderful hot crusty bread. Then mussels with black beans in a spicy chile infused broth. Bowls a creammmy grits. Wait staff must love their jobs. Smiled all the time and really seemed pleased that we were very enthusiastic about our choices. Also very reasonable.  I liked the buzz of the place.  Can't wait to go back

I ordered 3 "New" Sandwiches and 3 1-topping medium pizzas under the $2.99 customer appreciation special. 

For the sandwiches, the roll was excellent but I needed a MICROSCOPE to find the filling. On both the steak and the chicken sandwiches, there was so little steak and chicken and vegetables, PaPa John's should have called them flavored rolls.

For the pizzas, PaPa John's continued the dusting of cheese and few toppings method of making pizza.

Maybe it was because of the $2.99 Customer Appreciation special price that they skimped on the filling and cheese and toppings, but this customer does NOT feel appreciated. Will they never learn?

Can't say enough good things about their gluten free pizza--it's delicious, fresh, and one of the most reasonably-priced GF pies I've ever had. My go-to is a 10 inch gluten free pizza with mushrooms, which comes out to about $10.75--absurdly cheap in the world of gluten free pizza. I also love their buffalo wings and french fries, though they don't have a dedicated GF fryer, so celiacs who are extremely sensitive should pass.

We always get take-out, and the food is generally ready in 15-20 minutes, even on the busier weekend nights.

Wonderful! Bistro Daisy is the place we chose for our wedding dinner. Everyone was so impressed with the attention to detail, presentation and finely nuanced offerings!  Our wedding was a year ago. We visited Bistro Daisy again tonight and it is better than ever. Everything they do is excellent, but, tonight we started with the salmon mouse. OMG! Get it! Delightful! And we had perfectly cooked filets for dinner (never had better) topped off with the Pb and banana crepes....just absolute gastro-bliss! Definitely worth every cent and more! The staff at Bistro Daisy is unparalleled! Sweet, fun, professional and attentive! Go.

Wish I could put a negative star for review. We literally just had the worst fries ever from McDonalds. I'm originally from California, and these fries bleed through the fry carton and the bag! I am so disappointed. All of the fries were soggy. Yo make it worst,  I've  tried to call back to let them know and they turned off all communication. It goes straight to voicemail. Worst service I have ever received from McDonald's. I am even going to stop my uber eats from them despite I've given decent food via the app. If you have the option, DO NOT COME TO THIS ESTABLISHMENT.  YOU HAVE BEEN WARNED!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This McDonalds is a joke. We order a 20 piece chicken nugget meal and the screen doesn't show it as a meal nor did the man ask for the size or drink we wanted so we tried to confirm that it was a meal and he said it was. We weren't sure so someone started talking to us at the next speaker after we drove away and we asked her as well. She then started talking out of the other speaker so we couldn't hear her. Both of these employees were extremely rude and had terrible attitudes about simply checking for us. This was all too much of a pain so we decided to leave and go to another Mcdonald's that I know will give us better service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very disappointed in them lately. Portions are getting smaller and quality is slipping. We had the tempura shrimp roll and the slices were the size of a loonie, and about a half inch thick, you could barely see the shrimp. Half the size from the previous time we had ordered. We tried the lobster king roll, the lobster was like leather, it was the worst thing I have ever eaten. Very disappointing for $30. I still like their bento boxes, but the rolls are starting to resemble the quality of Tokyo express or worse.

The bar and staff are AMAZING. we got a room upgrade for have been being on our honeymoon and the view was gorgeous. But, the room was not any better than a hilton. It had rust in the tub floor, and some weird stains on the tile. But this was only in the bathroom, so i give it 4 stars! Great staff, but too much for valet so we parked a couple streets down. That was the only other con I would say. 

Would recommend if you want to be literally in the working downtown area of st. louis. Lots of cool bars and restaurants on a friday night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great food! Mexican authentic indeed. My boyfriend and I ordered for pickup. It was an average 15 minutes wait. I ordered Tacos de carne enchilada and my boyfriend ordered a chicken burrito. The tacos were good! Nothing exceptional. I do recommend. My boyfriend's burrito was huge! And his order came with a lot of fries. Which were good. He loved his burrito as well. What surprised me was that the burrito costs more than they're three really filled up tacos. I guess it was more for the fries but I don't know. They're prices are pretty standard. Stop by or order for delivery if you want truly authentic Mexican cuisine.

What a dump. The first thing to get you nice and relaxed for your service is a parking lot guaranteed to give you hives. Then when you find a space in the back, you get to see the nail girls hangin' out back smokin'. Like, they're going to be in close contact with you and they smoke?? When you walk in be prepared for major chemical stink. I swear I felt tumors sprouting from it! It's really cramped. It's noisy. The nail polish you choose from is pretty ratty, and they had, like, no new OPI summer colors. It's a tacky joint.

My family and I have been enjoying Papa Murphy's for around 10 years or more in Fresno, California! After moving to Reno, we tried the one on Mae Anne Ave & McCarran, but we never knew which day was a good day! On Valentine's Sunday, I stopped to buy pizza for my husband,  my whole got sick and we threw the leftovers away! This last Tuesday,  I thought I stop by this store! Sebastian (I believe) was all  alone at 11:00 am, very busy! His customer service was great! My family really enjoyed the pizza and ate leftovers! I guess will be back!!

Great service, they came to pick us up on a cold icy day and it was tough as they were slipping and sliding with their four wheel drive truck!! Of course they were very busy and it took awhile to put us in a car! They gave us a Dodge Caravan and it was great to drive on the cold, snowy days!! They checked us in right away when we turned the van back in! The only thing I recommend is to pay for the extra $15.00 a day for the extra insurance!! As they found a small knick in the windshield and was going to make us pay, but the extra insurance coverage my husband bought took care of it!! I would go back to them!!

My daughter has lived here for about four years when she invited us to move up to Reno into the apartment complex! That was four years ago and we still love living here! Yes it is an small 400 square feet junior studio apartment! Yes the kitchen is small with small appliances, but you can learn to live small! We live in a corner apartment with two big windows! At night you can hear either the train or Truckee River,  lots of nature! The staff is friendly and very helpful! But now more homeless are stealing & some neighbors too! But love living here, lots of nature! Also pet friendly and hopefully the pet owners will clean up after their pets!

I stopped in here when they first opened a few months ago. They had very little inventory so I decided to wait a bit before I passed judgement. 

Went back today. There is more inventory but the prices are very high particularly for items that are carried by other stores. With all the choices available in Reno im afraid this is not going to be a choice I make for my groceries. I may go back and try some of the local coffee and produce...if the prices go down a bit.

Actually I won't be going back at all. I bought a tomato and a cantaloupe and both were so bad I threw them in the trash.

I was a little disappointed in dinner last night.  The food just wasn't as good as last time. 4 people at the table got the pear salad and it was so average. It's pretty rare for people to leave a lot of their salad, especially since it was the first course. Basically a big heap of not very tasty lettuce, light on everything else with barely no dressing. One person ordered it vegan style for dinner and they messed it up twice, finally brought it out after everyone was finished, with no dressing. All the other food was fine, overall it was an average experience, not one that makes you want to come back or recommend a friend.

I have visited in person from time to time and have always thought of Las Bugambilias as a "nicer" Mexican place in the city, based on presentation and price. I decided to treat myself the other day and order delivery since we are currently under lock down. From the person I ordered from on the phone to the delivery person it was A+ service. I live a bit far from their usual delivery zone and they didn't give me any problems or up charges. Other than using styrofoam containers, which is disappointing, it was a great experience. A nice little treat during these weird times.

I think we can all agree that Fairmount is in dire need of a good Chinese restaurant.  That being said, what we're left with is Long River, the scary place on 29th (?) street whose name escapes me because I'm too scared to go in there, and Golden Chopstick.  Out of the three I take Golden Chopstick.  I've eaten both in the restaurant (only to check out where I was ordering from), and then mostly takeout.  The restaurant is clean, service is quick and the food is hot and tasty.  Plus, they never adhere to the "$10 min" delivery rule which is great for a single meal.  Groundbreaking, no.  The best choice in the area?  I'd say yes for now.

Pregnant and craving a cheesesteak . A friend raved about their cheesesteak so we decided to try them out.

If you're into soggy , mushy , tasteless , and skim on cheese type of steaks , this is your place. I was ready to devour a whole cheesesteak and couldn't even get passed another bite of the second half. Looking at my plate that was filled with steak soup next to my fries was not the most appetizing.

This is in no reference to the staff who were very nice !Next time I have a craving , will not look to go here .

We stayed at this hotel for a night while passing through town and were pleasantly surprised. The rooms are clean and the shower has excellent water pressure. The staff on duty is very helpful and accommodating as well.

Breakfast in the morning has a great range of items to choose from like oatmeal, pancakes, omelettes, and the always delicious cinnamon buns that Holiday Inn Express is known for.

The pool is nice with a small waterfall and a hut tub in the corner. There's a gym with a few pieces of equipment and a meeting room for businesses.

Overall, this was a very nice stay and I would be likely to return again if I'm back in town.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Imagine you come to Reno and decide to go on a Casino club crawl. Around 10:30pm you suddenly get those drunken munchies. Now you are stuck downtown and can't afford $50 for one meal. Where do ya go? Well in between two casinos is a hidden little gem called Hidden Pizza. Its s blink and you miss it sign. But the pizza is huge. For less then $4 you can get a great tasting slice. Piping hot from the oven. The staff is really friendly and its quick service. The only reason this place didn't get five stars from this blogger  rated three starsis because the only offer 3 types of pizza. But its great for a late night nosh.

Went in to the Mainline Seafood store where this is located.  Decided not to purchase given the higher pricing involved for single-rolls or appetizers.  Everything looked very fresh though.   Not sure if they are really just a seafood-market place trying to make a few extra dollars with sushi.  

Maybe its worth going with someone and trying the "tasting" platters with multiple pieces to get some real value, but I always hate leaving it up to the chef to figure out what s/he wants to dish out where you have no idea what you might get including the older stuff they want to "move".

Not a whole lot to say. It's just a good bar, with a good burger, and a friendly staff. A little on the dark and dreary side at times, but hey, sometimes that's how a good bar should be. 

They typically play good music, have adequate seating (except for maybe Thursday-Saturday nights) and can we mention the burger one more time? It's totally delicious, and only five bucks. I suggest you get two, because you WILL want another one when you get to your second round. 

I would five-star this place if they had (just a few) outdoor tables.

Was in town for a wedding and we stayed at Wesley chapel Hampton Inn (fantastic place). Then spent Sunday nite at the Hyatt grand. I got food poisoning Sunday nite/Monday am and the Hyatt was full and didn't work anything out for me to stay. Went to the airport and got sick again and after looking on Yelp was more than happy to know I just had to walk a short ways to get to the Marriott in the airport!!!! This place was clean, Theo, with guest services, was more than accommodating to have someone send me crackers and said anything he could do to help. The hotel was perfect and couldn't have been at a more perfect location!!!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Big sushi fan, and was disappointed by Zama's. Ordered a few maki rolls, including the wasabi tuna. First, each roll is a lot smaller than I expected based on experience in other sushi restaurants, and about 30-50% more expensive. Wasabi tuna roll had 8 pieces, 3 of the pieces were extremely spicy, and the other 5 were more or less bland. Left much to be desired. Not worth the price in my opinion. A shame because I really liked the ambiance. Their service was polite and professional, however, so that was a plus. Will not be returning.

Excellent, I had too try the place  at first because of the name. However, all in all it was a very nice experience. The miso soup was light and refreshing (not salty at all) the gyoza was flavorful and tender both the filling and the dough, and the ell cucumber roll was extremely fresh and the presentation, though simple was very nice. The only thing i can grievance about is that when i was done, i was still a little peckish and i was not asked if i would like anything else too complete my meal. The check was just handed to me. This place is well worth going back too again.

Honestly, I have not had the pleasure of dining here in a year, but since I've been reviewing more lately I couldn't leave this one out. Since it was one of the BEST meals I've had in St. Louis!  The bread and sorghum butter were a wonderful start to the meal. The wine list was pleasing, the service impeccable. I eagerly awaited each course since I opted for the 4 course Chefs tasting. The food was scrumptious and very innovative. The whole experience was So very memorable, I think I need to go back very SOON!

We travel... a lot. We always hit starbucks. Some are beautiful, some are busy, some are perfunctory. This is near our home, so we tend to drop in often. This is the most polite Starbucks I've ever been to, more than Pike Place, Disney, South Carolina, New York, Cali, etc.  it's not the most updated highest tech or most beautiful, but the significant respect, professional courtesy and cheer by the morning staff cannot be overlooked as a step above. The manager seems very professional which seems to trickle down to the staff.   Staff turns out consistent coffee.

Trying to get lunch on Saturday. Most of the time I came to eat in this place, but what happened to me today really surprised me. We ordered  fried rice , shrimps, beef, sushi. All was good, but sushi today doesn't look good for me. Fish had some unusual smell, so I didn't want to take "risk". So i said that I afraid to eat them. In 2 minuets I saw the owner. She was not trying to talk to me nice... She was screaming. That wasn't nice at all. I have never been in situation like this . But being a customer for 3 years will never come back because of owner acting.

I gave this Arby's three times and I am done. I love Arby's but it's hard to find a location that is on point with their service and with their food. I ordered the 5 piece chicken tenders and received four chicken nuggets. Shame on me for being in a hurry and purchasing fast food, but I hate that feeling of disappointment when you realize they messed up your order and you're already blocks away. Stuff happens but it shouldn't happen more then three times at the same location. The Arby's on East Hillsborough Ave. is always on Point!

EXCELLENT SUSHI in Bensalem area. I have been eating sushi for many years, Tako could be the best one. BIRD'S NEST, EVERYTHING TUNA ROLL, CRUNCH ROLL and YELLOW TAIL JALAPENO are my favors. The fish tasted so fresh and are definitely high quality. I strongly recommend to my friends. If you are sushi fans, you definitely need to try out. I know there has many Sushi restaurants that offer 50% sushi, however, I do not trust the quality of the fish they sell. If you only eat cooked fish, that's fine. Better to try Tako's high quality fish if you like raw fish, because high quality fish is healthier.

The reviews on this place were great, so when I got to the place, I was surprised. It is def a hole in the wall. But it's clean. (I felt safe eating there) 
The food was AMAZING. The staff was super friendly, and helpful. It took me so long to order because they have sooo many rolls. Try the Vandy roll if you like tempura and meat, sooo good. And I saw several people that suggested Dr. Larry roll, but when I read that it had mango, I was turned off. My sister ordered it and I tried it..hate I didn't order it. The mango is so subtle, it added a great contrast to the roll. Will be here again. The prices were very reasonable.

I came here for dinner on Sunday night.
It wasn't crazy busy that night.
I saw omakase style with 5 courses meal on the menu.

Starter was mozuku-su with shoga and vinegar.
I loved it. 

2nd around was abalone, salmon saikyo, kaki fried.
It was very good presentation, pretty good portion.

Main was 10pices chef choice sushi and toro hand roll.
It was fantastic ! All the fish came from Japan and so fresh!

You can choose ice cream flavor for dessert.
The chefs and sever were super friendly.
If you order sushi, take a seat by sushi bar, they will tell you what you get for fresh sushi. 

I will definitely going back to sun sushi.

I came here with friends pretty much right after it opened.

The food is solid. Really good. The chef in the back knows what he's doing. Everything was flavorful, fresh, and delicious. The waitstaff were still a little shaky and unsure of themselves, but that should fix itself up shortly.

Our table had a fun time creating a fictional background (yet unconfirmed) of the plucky, experienced Szechuan chef, packing up his family as help to head to America to open a restaurant. It seemed to fit what we saw.

Overall, an inexpensive, un-chic and untrendy restaurant on Main that's actually delicious? Amazing!

My co worker and I decided to try this coffeeshop this morning as we had a walking meeting and it was the perfect spot! It is not too far from our office so we figured we'd walk. Upon arrival we were warmly greeted by who I assume was the owner. He took the time to explain the menu to us as well as letting us know that every drink was fully customizable and they were completely local. Great prices and smooth espresso. Even better, they threw in a 10% discount due to us being employees of a local business. We will definitely be back!

We dined there on a Tuesday night --the place was packed.  Our waitress was short-tempered.  Service was so so slow - we waited for the longest time for our entrees.   Salads are pricey, but easily serves 2 people. I had rigatoni with seafood and vodka sauce.  The vodka sauce was yummy, but my pasta was very overcooked and dried out.  The shrimp was overcooked & hard to chew.   My husband's "eggplant ravioli" was stuffed with mushrooms, but was so tough, he could barely cut it with his knife.    For the money, I was disappointed.  I've been hearing about this restaurant for so long.. I really wanted to love it.  
We won't be back.

Space is beautiful, drinks decent. Had the Lavender 75... Strange flavor, I love lavender too. Never again. Steak Tar Tar was ok, no where near Good Dog or Parc. Smoked Trout was fantastic. Spaghetti & Meatballs were so bland, i hate to say it but Maggiano's meatballs are better, just awful. Mushroom lasagna was good, not amazing... More like a mushroom pasta in a skillet. Not really cheesy, more of a cream sauce. We had such high hopes, we'll try it again soon with the hopes they've read the comments on here and made some changes.

Went on a Friday night and was able to be seated right away. That's always a plus.
The calamari was excellent, entrees not so much. The sauce on the baked Alfredo dish I ordered was so bland it could have just been milk poured over pasta. The shrimp and chicken had absolutely zero seasoning which would've helped. The whole dish was just bad.
Husband ordered the bolognese rigatoni dish and the sauce was also very bland and thin. 
Won't be back. There are much better Italian options nearby than to spend money here again. 
Also had to send back my wine because it had a terrible taste to it. Was told that it was probably an old bottle....

My gym closed due to COVID, so I had to find a new spot. Retro made the most sense based on location and price. A gym is a gym and Retro has everything you could want. Where I find myself frustrated is when Temple is in session the students huddle in packs around 1 or 2 machines. It's annoying with or without COVID, but even more so with the health risk. You get the occasional meat head that thinks he's too good for a mask, but nothing you can do about it. I try to get in and get out so I don't think too much of it - just wish there was a little more monitoring in regards to masks and groups of kids on top of each other.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I have visited here several times now and have always had a great experience. I never felt pressured for additional services but I do appreciate the list of items scheduled for replacement. If I do not want the additional services, I simply say no and there is no other discussion. I did visit another location nearby and received the hard sell even after the "no". I also appreciate the free topping off services between oil changes. I stopped into today for a flickering oil level light and they quickly topped it off and checked the other fluids.

I now take all my cars there now.  Clean, quick, and easy. No complaints at all.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: There are very few Mexican restaurants in Spring Hill! This may be why there prices are so high and the portions so small . It's Mexican food !!! Every Mexican restaurant we have ever gone to give you large portions of everything, beans and rice is very inexpensive but not here!!! Margaritas should have alcohol in them we ordered some and we're not impressed. The enchiladas smaller than Chinese eggrolls and very expensive. When you go here expect to spend some time because the service is very slow, thank God there are two new Mexican restaurant opening in the area soon.

Just got barked at in the salad section by a stocker who was putting up potato and coleslaw on a nearby shelf. (12/5/19 11am) A simple friendly "excuse me" would have worked but she yelled ever so hateful "EXCUUUSE ME!" Totally embarrassing, as I always try to be aware of my surroundings and very courteous to everyone. Yes, I'm the one always moving over for the inconsiderate pushy shoppers, without complaining, so this was completely unacceptable. I live a few short blocks from this store but will gladly drive the distance for a friendlier service environment. Her direct barking at me came underserved.

I decided to try this place on a whim.  I am huge on customer service, and if you are too, this is NOT the place for you.  I was the only customer and was not greeted.  I asked the waitress what she recommended and she rolled her eyes and seemed annoyed by my question.  To then list almost every item on the menu.  I ordered 3 tacos, guacamole and sour cream TO GO.  The tacos did not have onions or cilantro which I requested; the taste was good but nothing spectacular.  However; the guacamole was amazing!  Not a place I would visit again.

Dr. Singer rocks. The best Optometrist I've had in years. And Matt, has the patience of a saint. I have already referred some friends.  Great service. Great prices. Great care. 

One of my friends visited a local Optometrist in Chester Springs and waited an hour to be seen!!! No way. I was in and out, received great care/advice in under an hour. No interrogation at the front desk regarding my insurance. Assisted me with purchasing that was within my budget. 

Singer Specs Rocks!

P.S. Dr. Singer is available on Wednesday's.  Highly recommended.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I've been trying to find a palatable Chinese place in West Philly.  I used to live in New York and was spoiled at the quality of Chinese food.  When I moved here, everywhere I tried was not up to par.

This is by far the best Chinese restaurant in W. Philly.  I've tried most of them now and this stands as my favorite.  The reason?  The food is freshly made and their ingredients are fresh.  You can taste the crispiness of freshly fried sesame chicken and the crunch of fresh veggies.

Given what it is (a cheap Chinese delivery place), it's tops in my book.

Once again, a Marriott loses points for housekeeping.  Room looked ok on first glance.  But, there was a thin plastic bag on the floor behind one of the desk legs.  Easy to see.

OK...let it pass.   First use of the bath, I close the door and find a damp towel hanging on the hook.  Hand towels aren't evenly hung...as if one had been used.

Table light missing a bulb.

Bed nicely made...tight...

Dinner and service in the lounge quite acceptable.

Captive audience for the airport travelers....  adequate.

did I mention no hot water in the shower? Handle loose in the wall?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Appreciated mechanic took their initiative on fill up my tire pressure, but me and my wife felt some noise and stiffness when driving down highway with outside temperature above 90 in these tires and found out that they overinflated my tire to 40 psi in the rear and 35 in the front while spec called for 30 front and 34 rears!!! More critical concern for me was synthetic oil they changed wasn't meant for my mercedes benz c300 as it should be 0w-40 (euro formula) not 0w-30. Hope my engine will not deteriorate before next service due. Good bye, dom!  Thank you for your good customer service but still not technical enough.

I'm here at the moment!!

Listen- I'm an avid sushi eater... this place is decent at best. I don't understand the rave reviews.  

They couldn't bring me water because NO CUPS! WHAT???!!

I'm watching the sushi chef make my food and guess why they're fast... they don't even include all the ingredients in their rolls. I ordered a WINWIN hand roll and he missed the scallops and shrimps that go in it. Hello!! Rule #1: never sacrifice quality for time.  Period.

The sushi isn't bad.. it just wasn't as amazing as everyone else is claiming. No. 

The sushi chefs are nice though. And it's cheap.

They out here making bacon McDoubles without love. Just pilling on toppings without care.  But that's not why I'm here today.. Their buns were stale and falling apart. I know the manager is probably trying to pinch pennies for a bonus but that is not the standard of care i expect when coming to Micky D's.  I know you have the fresh buns in the back that you're hoarding while you're desperately trying to pass off these stale buns. Just throw the buns away, chalk up the loss and live to serve another day. Highly dissatisfied with cheap managerial practices, serving buns that i wouldn't even feed my dog.   You guys are better than this... sad
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
WARNING DON'T go to the counter for pick up! Start a gold Account and prepay and go straight to your car! Warning   
I would really like to give this business 5 stars BUT if you run into Agent Don't give a Darn, you are screwed &  stranded!  
She should retire, at least she's not the babysitter! 
I would NEVER ever take that chance again! The manager is amazing he  did his job and hers ...
checked all my credentials and we were on our way....
After 4 hours stranded in Hertz because my name wasn't on a business credit card, but we had a business account. should have picked up without going into the counter...

my daugter and i come in here and one night i tried to vary to something different to the fahitas cause my daughter has gotten them and they was always good, when i got my order they were awlful no flavor, so i sent them back and so did the table over too, nex time we both ordered fahitas and they both was bad so we sent them back and she got chicken guesodillas like she usually orders, do you know they put the chicken from her fahitas in her quesodillas.  we could tell cause she orders hers plain and there was onions and green peppers in there and they ususally fry up everytime and we didn't here it that time

I had an omelette. Cheese and spinach. Not much of either in the omelette. Had these stupid iPads one has to order from. Food came half warm. I asked for ketchup for the uninteresting potatoes. I had to ask again since waitress never brought it. When she did she set the ketchup down one spot from where I was sitting instead of in front of me. Not a great arrangement at these airport restaurants. Seems like you must order from a computer and not a human and good luck getting anything else. The the food is made at some remote kitchen so that it comes to you warm and not hot.

I don't recommend this tacos el Rey , the place is always so messy, waitresses take a while to get to your table even if there's no costumers. The people that work here look mad and depressed all the time . Orders are never complete. I'll almost be done eating my plate before tortillas get there. The other 2 tacos el Rey in town are a little better in regards to a clean area. However, the cooks in  south Reno area are extremely slow ! Took 25minutes to get our 7 tacos with no customers in line ! Why? Because they chatter chat too much

One star
 for a nice chef.
The glass display have precooked shrimps, imitation crabmeat premixed, different type of fishes stack on the same plate & many many plastic container, yeap all these in the glass display.
Scallop is slimy, fish not fresh...sorry but honestly I feel like throwing up.  Went home got some m&m to clear the nasty after taste.
I was Arigato Sushi for 1 1/2 hours last night, every plate was so fresh and unique delicious.

My 3 plates are slimy & nasty, not once I see the 2 chefs take the cold fish in the glass case as he prepared over 20 plates in front of me.

I was very disappointed with Edgewild. This was our first time and this will be our last time. The portion size of the food is a joke for the amount of money they charge. We had 2 appetizers: soft pretzels(we only got 2 for $8) buffalo chicken dip was runny and it looked like soup! My husband got burnt end sandwich and it looked like something off the kids menu. Our daughters chicken strips off the kids menu was the beat looking dish on our table.
Our server was horrible. We had to ask for refills on our drinks, that drives me crazy.

This is still one of the worst Duncan donuts in my area. While I realize that wearing masks are extremely uncomfortable and inconvenient we all must take precautions. Two of the ladies in DD were wearing their masks under their mouth and nose. I watched as one of the women bent over the ice cream to scoop it out with her mask on her chin. Yup, safety first, what can you expect from the worst DD in Florida. When I said something I was met with a dirty look. How can they get away with the Blatant disregard for the publics safety.

One of the worst Duncan Donuts ever. Not only very slow but 9 times out of 10 the order is wrong. Big disappointment. I used to go everyday, now maybe once a week. Tried it again, this time along with my coffee ordered munchkins and a chocolate chip muffin. Stupidly I did not check until I got to my friends house. Took out the muffin which appeared to be "used". paper was rolled opened like it had been returned . I called and they refused to acknowledge my complaint. Asked for the owners phone number . Left a message on owners phone and never received a call back. They really are a horrible Dunkin' Donuts

Was there in Saturday after a great time at Christmas village. Just found it on Yelp and by walking by. Reminded me of a Resturant in little Italy section of NYC. Great atmosphere and nice selection of food. Wine list is small but good. My wife had the truffle ravioli and I had the pizza with mozzarella and prosciutto di parma on a thin crust! Everything was fantastic. What really sets this place apart from other Rittenhouse rest is how well they treated my 5 year old daughter! The waitress was fantastic and played with her. Made her the priority when serving us. I recommend this place to everyone.

This location fails me 2 out of 3 visits. I have really got to stop coming here. The order is never accurate! Then when I called in to complain, the mgr assured me that my name would be in their book for replacement food. When I arrived, not only did they make me get out in the cold & COME INSIDE to have my order that THEY SCREWED UP in the 1st place remade, but my name was not even in their book! Talk about inconvenience to the customer. I'm waiting on a return call from corporate!

***5 months later, never a return call*** HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The food here is pretty good! My fav is the Charmaine Corn only sold on Fri & Sat! It's a meal in itself! The crab Legs were yummy! The mashed potatoes are a must & next time I'm asking for Xtra gravy! It's magical! There's no signage so be sure to look close for the address or you will ride right past it. It was also hott as hell in there so we got our food to go. No masks worn just fyi... It would be great if orders could be called in. Curbside pick up would be great for those of us with little ones...especially during Covid. It's very small inside. I've taken 3 other friends here & we have all enjoyed the food!

Hadn't been here in years so I decided to give to the "Ultimate Wash" a shot. The vacuum guys did a poor job, they don't even vacuum the seats. There were still dead bugs on the front grille and spots all over the dashboard window. The interior was not cleaned it was all dusty and windows were barely swiped. Every door I opened had water drops. I shouldn't have to point out these items. For $23 all of this should have been done and checked that it was done. It's not like the place was busy. It was an "ultimate waste" of money. I prefer the $11 care wash at Shell off Turnpike.

I wouldn't think of reviewing a McDonalds because I had the mindset you seen one you seen them all, but today an employee at this McDonalds showed good customer service can be found at a fast food place. The employee I am sitting here observing is Sam.  She is walking talking customers at tables asking if they need anything, and when customers get up and leave she quickly wipes the tables down and cleans the mess left behind.  So stop in and get your McDonalds and say hello to Sam as she is showing how one person can show pride in their work.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Ordered take out through Uber eats the other night. 
I ordered the special that was chicken alferdo with a crazed salad, garlic toast and mozzarella sticks for around 25$ I think. 

The pasta was a bit dry but overall not a bad Alfredo. 
Ceased salad was a good size portion and the dressing very creamy. 
Garlic toast actually had cheese on it, which it didn't state on the menu as I prefer it without it. 
The mozzarella fingers definitely left something to be desired, they tasted just like any generic frozen sticks. 

All in all not a bad meal for the price and taste was still there after being delivered.

Overall I didn't love this nail salon. My gel manicure was decent but rushed and for $35 before tip I wasn't happy. 

My pedicure was awful. They first put a timer on for your massage and once it obnoxiously went off my pedicurist just stopped mid foot rub and then rinsed off the extra lotion that wasn't rubbed in. I then requested my French polish to be a little thinner and ended up with wavy lines. Maybe it's just me but for $60 before tip I expected a nicer experience. 

Total spent $105 and not thrilled especially when a friend recommended the place.
