I don't know who is writing these reviews but my guess would be uncultured locals. The girl at the front desk should have gotten her money back from charm school. We seemed to have totally ruined her day by asking for a table for two. She proceeded to keep us waiting and basically ignored us even though the place half full. The floor of this restaurant was filthy, and as for the toilets, let's not go there. Leaves a lot to be desired in terms of rude staff and sushi chefs who all seem miserable. If your looking for a relaxed and enjoyable dining experience go anywhere but here!

I've been going to this location for about 6 years. I agree with the other reviewer about the rating: it's good but it could better. I'm a male and I don't expect much from my hair cuts other than even and straight, which they do most of the time.
I wish they'd keep the staff on regular shifts because I never get the same person twice, except Dawn, the manager. Long story short: good place to get a hair cut. The only bad thing about the service is the constant interruptions the staff make to check people in. Let people check themselves in, as in take a number. Also, download the app to check yourself in. It's worth it.

This is one of the many local diners - I can't say they're on the top of my diner list either. The menu is just what you would expect for a diner - meat gravy, potatoes and veggies. It just seams that the quality is not there. With a little more effort, it could be a much better affair. It felt sloppy to me. For example, the ketchup is an off-brand, as are the other condiments. The mashed potatoes are instant. The food is just rather bland, but again, it is a diner. 

Don't look for home made specials here. But on the positive side, it is cheap.

We had a disappointing meal here last night. Three stars because we were seated promptly and one member of our group loved his fish soup which provided generous portions of mussels and clams, two large scallops and chunks of tasty fish. The rest of us order pasta dishes. Billed as "pappardelle with shredded short ribs" we received barely a taste of what appeared to be the same ground beef you would expect in a bolognese sauce.  So little meat, it was sad, especially for $22. Basically, it was a bowl of noodles. Absolutely ordinary. We had heard good things about this restaurant but will not go there again.

Great addition to south Tampa!

Love the conveyor belt approach  to take the car thru the wash...no more rim rub trying the get car wheels in the the guides!!!!!!!!!!  

My wife will now feel comfortable taking the car thru.

Great wash and service!

Don't like let the tight vacuum parking area for a pickup. I find myself not wanting to vacuum

Don't like the mask-less guys hanging over my window while I pay at machine ...how about stand back and just ask if I need any assistance. Or if  I would like the know about options.. Post COVID sure, but dude..back off for now!

If vacuum area was bigger and no mask-less help.....would give 5 stars.

Hir or miss.  They gave me 11 instead of 12 donuts.  It was so obviously missing, I had to point it out and they had closed to box and said it was placed oddly and that there were 12.  Then the lady behind me said, nope there was 11.  The employee opened the back and sure enough, there were only 11 donuts.

Another time I ordered 4 apple bear claws, and they only gave us 3.  We only noticed when we got home.   Let's say kids were not happy.

I'm glad they are close by, I wish it had better service and didn't run out of donuts we like so often.

The noodles and duck sauce were excellent as was the hit and sour soup and egg roll but the sweet and sour chicken was just chicken fingers with sauce on the side - not what we were hoping for. No green peppers or pineapple in the sauce. Just sauce to dip on the side. My husband was very disappointed. I had the spare ribs and white rice but no vegetable dame with this and nothing to alleviate the dryness of the rice. We were disappointed. Fortune cookie was very fresh and the orange and pineapple at the end were a nice touch. Wish we had sauce!

I was pleasantly surprised when I stopped in for a weekday lunch.  This small, unexciting-looking place next to Rouse's has good food, very fast service and reasonable prices.  The dressing on the lagniappe portion of noodle salad actually tasted like something (sesame).  The miso soup that came with the 2-roll lunch special for $7.99 also had more taste than at some places.  The small salad was just lettuce and the usual orange dressing, but was fresh.  Not wanting to risk anything fancy, I had a tuna roll and an avocado/salmon roll.  Both were good and fresh and had 8 (skinny) pieces.  It was more than I actually needed for lunch.

horrible experience. i went through the drive thru and ate in the parking lot, in which they tried to give me someone elses order. afterwards, i went inside for a trip to the loo and i brought in both my mcdonalds bag and a captain ds bag to throw out. immediately, a hispanic woman with bad english started rudely berating me about why i was throwing out trash in the mcdonalds. i refused to speak to her. she followed me into the bathroom and also announced to everyone of my "crime".  i waited til she walked out and snuck out. im going to complain to corporate.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Eating at Sakana is an unforgettable treat!  I lived all over Japan for 20+ years in places boasting some of the best sushi like Hokkaido, Kyushu and Osaka so I do know my sushi.
Trust me when I say it's among the best in the world.  Sakana takes sushi to new dimensions with its creative approach and amazing sauces and presentation.  Purists can order sans sauce for a more traditional taste.  I was impressed as well with the sake menu which has a well-considered selection of sakes.  I like that the ambiance is not pretentious despite the excellence of the food.  This place is one of my all-time favorites.

Not the best sushi, but it's late night shtick must be it's saving grace. I wonder if more high grade sushi places like Shintori or arigato stayed open this late, if this place would work out...

The waiters are  generally bland and don't smile much. There is also this one Japanese male waiter with blond hair that literally acts like he hates the place and everyone in it. Always makes me and my friends laugh on how he thinks tips follow a bitter face. No sour sushi! 

Godzilla roll is good. Cajun tuna is good. Tempura is ok. 

This may be SBs only late night sushi, but definitely not the best.

Bought a groupon to Timothie Hill Hair Dressing.
I walked up the sketchy building and hallway, which should have been my first clue...

He hacked off my hair to my chin, was supposed to be shoulder length... i said I did NOT want short hair at all... specifically said no shorter than shoulder.
My hair is uneven and way too short. I should have left at that point but figured I alreadypaid for a colour ...

He didn't even highlight my hair properly... put two foils in of blonde and two in of dark
then he charged me almost double to cost of the groupon. ...

Seriously worst sylist ever.

Super Save your money by doing it yourself! I asked if they offered any deeper vacuuming and I was told they had a "Super Express Detail" Half hour and they do a more thorough vacuum job and wipe all the surfaces... I think there is a miscommunication with what thorough means... admittedly they did "pass" the vacuum over in the crevices but I still came home trying vacuum out what they missed and rubbing in the armorall that they swiped over the surfaces leaving it looking sticky and uneven. $42 dollars of disappointment! Yes $42!

Stopped in on a Friday without a reservation and were able to get squeezed in. Really good food. Like REALLY good. We had the chips and dip appetizer (obviously homemade and plenty for the 2 of us to share), the chicken supper (delicious!), the pork tenderloin (delicious), the chocolate tart and pumpkin creek brûlée (very impressed with both desserts). My husband also had 2 beers that he liked. This 5 star meal totaled $92... not bad, especially considering we recently paid around $40 more for a less than ideal experience at another local establishment. We will definitely return!

Haven't been for dinner yet but have stopped in for lunch over half a dozen times in the last 6 months. This has become my favourite sushi restaurant in Edmonton.  The food is always fresh, prices are reasonable for high grade sushi & service usually good.

Bento box for lunch is easy and offers lots of options.  I always get the Saba Sashimi with it.  Can't find a sushi spot that does Saba better and the pieces of fish are a good size.  Beef tataki was fantastic.  But the Pressed Salmon sushi makes for great presentation and tastes even better! 

Look forward to hitting Japonais for dinner with my kids in the very near future.

17 Nov 2018 **

My wife had the crab cake sandwich, she says it was average.

I had the Louisiana Gumbo. It started with room temperature rice. The gumbo was a bit warmer. The bowl or presentation though looking nice allowed what was called soup to cool off very quickly. The bowl was wide and flat. The seasoning was insufficient and I had to add salt to give it some flavor. 

My wife says her sandwich was a bit high for price to value. My soup was way over priced for what I received. Maybe six to seven dollars not the eighteen I was charged.

Employees are nice, but the food leaves much to be desired. Friday the 1st of Dec 2017. I had a gyro, the meat was overcooked and under seasoned, little hard balls of charcoal. The onions were two large pieces. I had to cut them up to make them edible. The sauce was sparce and not intense enough. The caesar salad was good.

My wife had a turkey burger. The juice from the burger soaked the bun until it looked like white bread snot. It was under seasoned. The bun was not toasted enough, however the sweet potato fries were good. 

The beer and wine were good but over all not a good meal for the money.

We have eaten at Tokyo Sushi well over 100 times over the years and really think they do a great job.  We have ordered almost everything sushi on the menu, but really enjoy the salmon sushi, salmon sashimi, spicy salmon rolls, rainbow roll, and spider roll. They always have three specials on the board and we always try one on each visit.  Another great locally owned business delivering great service and quality product.  Can't say enough good things about the staff & owners.  Friendly, efficient, and knowledgeable.  A+

Took my sick cat to be examined after he was displaying some behaviors that caused me to be alert.   The front desk receptionist was very impersonal.  Doctor was very friendly,  as was her assistant.  I feel like the prices are just way to much for a family on a budget.  Frustrating we could not afford everything for our cat,  but was sent home with a couple of needs to assist.  Praying for our cat and wishing vets didn't charge such outrageous prices! Front desk people really need some customer service trainings.

They don't serve dine-in customers at 7 o'clock on a Wednesday night. At least they wouldn't serve me. As I waited at the counter, five employees were scurrying to give zippy service to drive-thru customers. Two employees walked right in front of me, avoiding eye contact. Zero employees wanted to take my order. After growing a bit older, I left.

Funny thing is, I came here because the exact same thing happened at Bojangles. Must be some new starvation diet.

Gave two stars because they usually have good service ... when I drive thru.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We've taken doggo here a few times since the place changed hands. I was leery regarding the new ownership because the 'old' place was inexpensive and sincere. Well, the new place is fine. It's a little less expensive than any other place we found (other than FACE of course). Out dog is a stray we found who had multiple problems. Indy Paws has been very complete and open about how to treat his conditions (mange, teeth) and has explained the treatment well, including like what he needs, the side effects, the cost, everything.  So this is cool.

Visited for dinner two weeks ago on a weekday.  The two stars are for the scenery of the Delaware River.  The shrimp tacos were average, but at least were loaded with small shrimp.  My wife's iced tea had a old sour taste.  When the waiter finally decided to check in and replace it, he said that they were throwing the iced tea out because there were other complaints, wow how tough is it to have fresh iced tea at these inflated prices at a tourist trap.  By the way, even though there is outside seating, do we have to sit on dirty white plastic lawn chairs and seated at a table that looked like they haven't been cleaned in years?

Very poor service. We had not come here for over a year because of the bad service we got the last time. Things have not changed. We were here at a very slow time with lots of empty tables. However, we waited 5-10 minutes between getting seated, getting simple drinks (water and cokes), then eventually getting to order and finally getting food in 2 stages. We had to ask for bread about 5 min after we got salads. 

The food was okay, but not worth the waits.  We never once got a refill on water and cokes. 

We'll see how they do in another year. Until then, this place is a NO-GO.

The Bryn Mawr El Lemon's  website states that they are open till 10 PM on week nights so, facing an empty fridge after a long day of work, I called at approximately 9:20 PM on a Thursday night to order a couple of tacos for takeout.  There was no answer after several calls.  I can only assume they were closed.  I really like El Lemon.  They generally have very good food, but the fact that they close early without stating the change on their website places them a little lower on my list of go to places to get a quick bite.

Yes, very nice people. But whoever is making/tasting this food just doesn't have a palate worth sharing much less charging for. Preparation and flavors are off on everything. There were six of us and we sampled firsts, mains, and desserts. Not one was good enough to have again and some weren't good enough to eat at all. Sorry, I know they mean well--but it has to start with quality on the plate not trendiness on the menu. Overseasoned, unsuccessful mismash of flavors, overdone meat, poorly executed and heavy-handed pastries, etc., etc.

I am fascinated by how this online reviewing works. We live in Northwest Tucson, a former wasteland for restaurants--good, bad, or otherwise. Now we are rich with quality choices. We had every hope that Jax would be another, but our first excited dinner was a disaster. Nice people, bad food, generic but pleasant atmosphere. We wrote about the food and the problems and were immediately attacked with e-mails from people accusing us of being competing restauranteurs. We are simply well-traveled Tucsonans who love good food and talented chefs and eat out a lot. Our initial review is gone. Only the raves are left. Hmmmmmm.....

Paid the daily fee ($7) today.  Fairly big place.  Looks like they converted a raquetball club, so it's a bit of a maze.  Fair amount of cardio equipment, but it's a little old.  Did not see a stepmill, which was a bummer.  However, really liked the free weights, machines and hammer strength stuff.  Had a very good leg workout.  Lots of equipment (some a bit old), good variety, and none of the cookie cutter/same stuff at every gym bs you get at corporate places like 24 Hour Fitness or Spectrum in So Cal.  If I lived in Philly, I would definitely join 12th Street.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
My wife & I had a very enjoyable first visit to Bici this evening (Saturday). Very friendly and knowledgeable staff, casual but stylish decor, no kids present but there were kids items on the menu (so I guess we were in the right place at the right time!). Food was very good overall and we especially liked the Tuna Nicoise and Mushroom Ragu over Polenta. Chicken Picata was ok but too oily or buttery. The 3-huumus selection was also very good. 

I'm sure we'll be back and would recommend it highly. On this night the friendly staff made the experience extra nice.

Great place to enjoy a nice treat with your family. Can be pricey if you don't watch it but very tasty and great toppings available. We have visited several of these stores and this one is my favorite because of the customer service. My surprise to see a young man working in a pink store (lol) but he was very nice. Reminded me of the old days when customer service was #1 just about anywhere you went. Now a days it seems a lot of the young people aren't being taught that you have no job with out customers! Not so with this place. We will certainly be back!

Ordered take out for myself and some co-workers.  Called my order in and it was ready at the time requested for pickup.
The interior is really nice - modern and clean.  The staff was EXTREMELY friendly and helpful.
I do find it pricey for what you get.  We all ordered the Pollo Alla Griglia Panino.  For $13 all you get is the sandwich.  It was tasty, but a little dry.  Could have more filling - a lot of bread.

I'd love to give this place a 4 star just based on the interior and how awesome the staff was, but the sandwich was underwhelming.  

I would like to come back and try their pasta/pizza to see if I can up the rating to a 4.

Not impressed. Went here with my car looking for a decent wash.  Paid for the most expensive wash ($13-ish?) to get water spots and some pollen off my car (nothing crazy, my car is only 4 weeks old).  Went through the wash, parked to look at my car afterwards and the blowers did a terrible job drying it so I needed to dry it myself... good thing I did bc I needed to wipe off the film layer and water spots. Car looked like crap and a total waste of money. I'm so disappointed. I just want a car wash to make my car look clean!

Very noisy! Every time the person in the room next to me went outside to smoke I heard their door bang shut and it shook my door as well. There is also lots of noise from the parking lot since there is always marina/park/restaurant traffic. I also, didn't like the windows in my room, they didn't want to stay closed so people walking by can see in through the slight cracks in the shutters.The room was clean and the view of the water is beautiful; and this has a great restaurant next door. This is also within walking distance to downtown Dunedin. This is a great place to stay if you don't need to get a good night's sleep.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: For the pizza I would give this place maybe a 3, as it was tasty.  It was Mike's Pizza, a medium for something like $17-18.00.  We also had a appetizer or fried calamari,  which was OK.  Drinks were $3.00.  What I am trying to say is that the place is expensive, way more expensive than the taste of the food.  Service was OK if slow.  One table walked out as service was too slow for their appetite.   Ultimately would I eat there again?  No.  perhaps I would get a pizza to go and eat it down by the beach, but this place is just too expensive.

I recently visited this restaurant while in the Clearwater area for business. A friend of mine highly recommended Villa Gallace. I am so happy that we went. After a week long of striking out at many restaurants in Tampa/ Clearwater we finally had an amazing dinner here. The night was very low key with great food, great wine and to top it all off the staff was the best part. They were all so inviting and I was so impressed that the owner Luigi was there and taking time to stop and talk to the customers.  I highly recommend. The food is outstanding.... You will not be disappointed.

This place is quick and extra fun being able to vacuum yourself....but don't count on it to do more than scratch the surface of any stuck on dirt or bugs.  I just went there and noticed the front of my car still had about 20 love bugs that weren't even ground in, just kinda flapping around in the wind....and I asked the scrubber guy if I could go through again since it didn't get them off and he said it's not guaranteed so too bad.  So I tried to call but their phone number isn't in service. So now I'm off to go clean the front of my car with a bucket and sponge....

I am disgusted. I shop here about once a month out of convenience. Though it's expensive I always had decent experiences here. Well not this week. I bought prepackaged Oscar Meyer turkey breast on Thursday, July 24th. Friday night I decide to make myself a sandwich. Saturday morning at 3 am- wake up with horrible stomach pains and proceed to vomit three times. Had no idea why until now while cleaning out my fridge- use by date on the turkey breast is JUNE 4th! Seriously?! Never again will I shop here. One would think with their high prices that Rittenhouse Market would supply their patrons with quality and safe products. Stay away!

Great location right on the streetcar line and one block from Canal Street. Lots of walkable restaurants and shops.

Room was surprisingly large. Everything was very clean every day.

I used the free fitness center four times. Clean and fully working equipment, lots of clean towels. 

Easy to connect WIFI. Worked 100% of the time.

Included breakfast was fine and in line with most hotel free breakfasts. Good variety and some healthy choices. Breakfast staff very visible and keeping things well stocked. 

Can easily recommend this property.

Jim
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Lobby closes at 7 pm...locking gate around parking lot..I think you know where I'm going with this. Besides the rough neighborhood the motel is located in, everything else was pretty good. Compared to other motel 6s, the rooms were very large and the bathroom was lined in what looked like granite. The owner of the motel who also works at the desk is Indian so don't be surprised if there's a faint smell of Indian food throughout the halls since his family also lives in one of the rooms. Otherwise, one of the best motel 6s I've stayed at.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I ordered the taco salad, which came in an almost stale tortilla with far too many large slices of raw onion.  But the chicken and salsa were both good and the cheese melted.  My husband ordered the liver and onions, which was a little over cooked.  We ordered the chocolate cake for dessert, which had obviously been sitting in the refrigerator all afternoon.

The setting and decor were okay, and our waitress was friendly and attentive.  However, the time between dessert and getting our check was a little excessive, and we thought maybe we'd been forgotten.

Not to diminish Grace Tammera's skills, their office proficiency needs polishing.  Let me preface this by saying I understand, things happen; waiting in a doctor's office is inevitable. And I do consider myself a very patient person.  But time after time, patients (non-emergency) who arrive after me were taken back to see the doctor on several occasions.  If you have an 11:00 am appointment do yourself a favor and show up at 12:00 pm. Oh...and don't expect an apology from the doctor and staff for running late....because they simply don't care.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I'm SHOCKED by the reviews. 
  I don't give out many 4 star reviews but i have to give this place a thumbs up. The service was phenomenal, our bread basket and water was immediately filled before it even got empty. Our food came out it a timely fashion. Maybe the other reviewers came at a bad time?

  I had the Vodka Penne and it was divine. I also tried some of my friend's lasgna and that was extremely good as well. We also had their home made tiramisu cake which I must say was the icing to the cake . 
 
  Definitely give it a try when it's not so busy. Maybe around 6?

I visit this Fortel's often and the pizza is really good.  It is interesting that this is a local chain because the food varies a lot from location to location.  The Kirkwood pizza is great with lots of tasty and flavorful toppings and a good beer selection.  The Creve Coeur location pizza is entirely different.  It is not a fancy place but great for a spontaneous outing and never lets you down with the food/quality and service.  It is slightly more expensive than some other places, but we always leave with a half pizza because it is so large.

In my opinion, this is just a regular grocery store. My low rating us because when I took my service dog into the store, several employees gave me dirty stares and some even had the audacity to ask if my dog was actually a service dog. Legally, this is all they are allowed to ask me, however, with the dirty stares, I was already upset. If the employees don't know the laws of service animals and don't respect them, then I won't be shopping at Kroger ever again. Publix is just across the street and is much more welcoming of service animals and also has higher quality food for basically the same price as Kroger.

This is an okay gym and would otherwise receive 4 stars.  I have subtracted two extra stars because:

-When I signed up a few months ago, I was told that they would have a room for spin classes.  Great!  Today, I asked when the spin classes would start.  They have changed their minds, and spin will not be offered.  That really sucks.
-They still don't have wifi, and the employee said he has "no idea" when (or if?) they will get it.

If I had known this a few months ago, I'm not sure I would have chosen YouFit.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The meal was very good. Had black pasta with seafood, gnocchi, and pizza. Creative, served at perfect temperature, service ruined an otherwise perfect meal. No matter the question about a dish or more water to waiter it was AWESOME. And 33rd time you hear that word to describe something, you realize it is a catch word rather than the truth. I was amazed an M Street restaurant doesn't train their staff on what to say about the food and how to answer a guest's question more descriptively. In other words anytime now my guests and I hear the word we laugh! It is a word we use to mean exaggeration.

This place is amazing. I have always loved DD, but this particular location is great because the staff is friendly and they are always so quick! If I'm in a rush on my way to work, I know I will get what I ordered and be through the drive-through in 2 minutes. I've been coming here all the time for about 3 years and they've only messed up my order one time ever. I have the Dunkin mobile app and occasionally their scanner won't properly register my app; more than once when this has happened they've given me my order for free.

Giving this place only two stars because of their bartender. Very cozy place and the food is delicious. Have been there twice and both times we decided to sit at the bar, so we wouldn't have to wait. The bartender (the same one) was acting like he did not want to be there. BOTH TIMES. He seemed annoyed and unhappy, which kind of ruined our entire experience. Maybe he is going through something, however, you need to leave your personal stuff at home. 
Not sure we will be back.... 
Again- amazing place with great food. But If you decide to go, avoid the bar area.

I have been wanting to stop at this place for months as I work with a client nearby and dry past often. Today I finally had time to do it and I was very disappointed. The girl working did not greet me or make eye contact throughout my time in the shop (there were only 2 other patrons in the front). The dirty iced soy chai latte I ordered was approximately 1% chai, 99% overly sweetened soy milk, and not dirty (no espresso shot). I got a veggie bagel with cream cheese that was delicious though. I will try it again in hopes of encountering a friendlier staff and better service.

The place was pretty busy.  I had a long wait despite my appointment because there were some "emergencies".   I am only putting this up here so other people who might run into this problem can share to indicate if it is problem, or just a one time or occasional incident.

Aside from the wait time, the vet was excellent.

I didn't need specialty care so I cannot attest to that, but the vet was very gentle with my baby and I appreciate it.

The place was spotless and odor free.  

I have no reservation recommending this place to someone looking for a new place in the area.

I really thought this location would be better, but sadly it is worse. Enterprize just cannot employ people with good customer service skills! Very sad! I hate it when they call you just to see if you have a credit card as if you have Monopoly money! I'm finally done with this rental company and their lack of treating a long term customer with some dignity! Just a quick observation for this company, don't over talk or quick the customer. When I comment I have rented several times don't look at me, OH REALLY!

On numerous occasions we have received the incorrect order. Last time we had delivery we received the wrong order, we called and they said that we could have our next pizza free. They have NOT honored this since. Our last pick up order they had our order wrong. I checked prior to leaving the store since they have had it wrong on other occasions. They said they would cook us another pizza. I had to wait another 25 minutes and they did not compensate us for providing us with the wrong order nor for my time I had to wait.

i hate giving bad reviews!! bad these is my second time in the past two weeks that i came to do my carwash here and its always a dissapointment!! i use to come here all the time because i use to like their service but its defenetly changed!! i did stop coming here because the quality of service kept on decreasing!! so i recently came back and the first time back wasnt pleasent so i thought i give it a second chance and it just was very dissapointing!! my car is 2019 white  honda and when they were done they left red marks outside my car also the vacuuming job not that great!!! i also had to finish wipeing my car!!!

Good to great food.  Good to great drinks.  I just wish they had more drink specials.  George's is well managed and well served.  At times, I wonder if it is over staffed but I guess that is not a bad thing from a consumer standpoint.  

My only complaint would be that they do not open promptly on weekends which is disappointing.  I remember coming there to watch the Indy 500 but the doors were locked up to 10 minutes after the posted opening time.  Needless to say I had to go to another bar so I wouldn't miss it.

Curbside takeout is great, although the parking lot can be over crowded at times.

Food - Very good.

Drinks - Very good, but very over priced.

Service - Hit or miss.  Bartenders are usually  very good, wait staff is usually not good.  

Restaurant - Great layout, very clean.

They usually have live music.  Sometimes they have live music during sporting events which is confusing to me - as the music is located in the bar area so you essentially have to watch a sporting event on mute.  And they definitely get a crowd for the music.  If you're going to watch a game make sure they don't have live music going, assuming you want to hear the game.  I think I realized this going for Thursday Night Football.  Come on people!

i don't  like being processed like a military lineup and wait between services amongst other customers. I like going to a hair salon to get my hair done with good service and be relaxed but not here. It's all about how fast they can get you out and work on other customers while they're working on you.!!  This place is not about quality and good customer care and I found that very disappointing. Their prices are never the same either.  In addition they always gossip about their customers because I can hear them.

This looked good at first but wound up being a terrible year at broadstone. 
you have no privacy at all, after three months they started threatening and fining me.
the toilet up stairs flushed every five minutes all night long and if I made a sound
the same people would complain right away. Notes on the doors all the time on
how to live and what to do. doors slam constantly. The sides of my car are all 
banged up and scratched. I hated living there for 10 out of 12 months.
Whats good about it ? you have a year to find a nice place at reasonable 
price that's what I did.

The server was a very sweet guy and had all good intentions but he obviously wasn't trained at all -- prb not his fault but so much wrong with service it affected the whole experience. 

If you go for bites with drinks you won't be disappointed. For dinner, they aren't reddy yet. 

Baked oysters were very good. Veg tacos were ok, add balsamic sauce on them. Shrimp, scallop, grits was messy and lacked flavor other than butter and cheese. Pork shanks is ok. Clam chowder also lacked flavor. Their flatbreads looked promising. Nice bar.

Do not rent a car from Avis Reno!  We returned a car in perfect condition, were told it looked good, then received a $250 cleaning charge that was completely false.  They said the car smelled like "Indian food."   I can assure you that the car had no smell and was returned in the same condition we got it in.  We also never ate indian food or any other meal in the car. We filed a complaint with the company and were told over the phone that our complaint sounded valid.  Weeks later, our credit card was charged anyway.  If you need to rent a car in Reno, look elsewhere.

We're going to appear to be food snobs, but we've been around the block. This place could be stellar, but needs some basic upgrading. Dimmer lighting, Spaghetti noodles that don't look like pad Thai noodles. Minestrone soup with more Italian and less pinto beans, warm bread with butter, and the ravioli appetizers don't need breading (they're more like mozzarella sticks than ravioli). You can taste the dye in the raspberry gelato. We're travelers, implement a few small changes and the restaurant will be busy and do well. Coffees and danishes were good.

Stay Away... From the poor quality of the fish used, to the ignorant staff, this is a NO GO!.  The best is that they increase the cost on the weekends for absolutely nothing!!  This is nothing more than an overpriced Chinese restaurant that tries to serve sushi.  Nothing authentic here, and actually more to the contrary.  Save your money, no value here, except for poor quality food and even poorer service. Event their regular prices for the inferior quality are way too high.  Bottom line, this place is probably the worst overall restaurant I have eaten in during the past 10 years!  Save yourself some grief and money...DONT GO HERE

Affordable and it's Italian to the max! Besides the food, the music playing was Frank Sinatra and instrumental Italian music xD I was amused in a good way. 

I ordered the fettucini alfredo chicken combo (comes with drink, salad, and garlic bread) and it all came up to like $10 something o_O When I tried the pasta, I must say I was surprised. It tasted like it came from any fancy restaurant. I really liked it. Casual and the atmosphere is quite nice. Plus the owner was really helpful, since it was my first time there and I was clueless about where things were on the menu lol.  I'll come back~ ^^

We use to be a fan of Marathon Grill because of the smoothie choices, but our last five experiences have been HORRIBLE.  The food is okay, but the service is absolutely terrible, and I consider myself a very patient person.  The waitstaff can be very rude, they mix up your orders and take forever even to get you a glass of water.  Also, they have this strange habit of seating you in the worst section of the restaurant even though the place is empty.  I do not understand how they think.  Considering the price and quality of food, it's not worth it especially with so many better restaurants right down the street.

Opportunity cost...
the amount of money I just lost from NOT working on my business for the past 2.5 hours is not worth the amount of money I saved on an eye exam. 

Although I had an appointment at 12:30pm, it's now nearly 3pm and I'm still here. I made the mistake of waiting until after this exam to eat, and now the hanger has driven me to Yelp. 

the only good thing is the staff. Everyone is extremely nice, and the doctor is thorough and clearly cares about what he's doing. 

From now on I will gladly pay 3x the price for somewhere that actually adheres to a schedule that respects their customer's time.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is way over due.  I have been going to Mama Sanchez for well over 13 years, both on 22nd and on Cortero Road.  The food is consistently good and service is quick.  This a Christian owned business so they don't serve alcohol but they do serve RC products instead of Coke or Pepsi.  The serve yourself salsa bar is great.  I have been in Arizona for 17 years and this is where I send my friends for lunch and/or dinner.  If you need a Margarita then you will need to try one of the other couple hundred Mexican places here in the Old Pueblo!  But if just want good food at a good price, this is the place.

The specialty apps are worth coming for.  We had the Hoisin duck burrito and the stuffed jalapenos - both were unique and delicious.  The sushi here is solid but not great.  We had the calamari sushi roll which was not one of the better ones I've had here but still good.  My husband had the avocado and the sweet potato roll and he also stated these were both good but not great.  

The evening we went - they had one server who appeared to be taking care of most of the restaurant - she forgot our soup but who could blame her - this place needs more staff.

This place is just terrible!!!  We read the reviews before we went & still thought we would give it a try.  All the reviews were dead on!  The food was awful!  How can you majorly screw up pizza???  The sauce was gross as well as the margarita pizza.  The crust was actually ok but that sauce!  The kids pizza was the same size as all the other pizza's.  The pork chop was dried up, deep fried and nasty!  The restaurant itself had a "cafeteria" feel to it!  Very sparse, no booths and strange wallpaper/cloth.  The service was also bad.  The comment card on the table asks what you would do if you owned Avero???  Shut down and cut your losses!

To be a fairly new property, the room was in need of several general repairs.  The toilet cut on and off throughout the night, a couple of light bulbs were burned out, bathroom faucet was loose, the wall heater was extremely noisy.  Also when we first entered our room after checking in, the a/c was on and it was 61 degrees in the room (very cold outside and snow on the ground).  The front desk clerk stated "the maid must have done that".  The initial set of door keys/cards did not work and we had to make a trip back to the front desk.  Overall, the stay and property is not consistent with other Marriott properties.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I LOVE KONG'S!!!!!!   After being ripped off by just about every mechanic garage in South Philly (ya know, they see a new expensive car pulling in and they see gold), I was fortunate enough to stumble upon this hidden gem.  Mr. Kong is the most HONEST and FANTASTIC mechanic I've ever had the pleasure of dealing with.  CHEAPEST prices around too for quality work!   I take my BMW's to him all the time and he is a pleasure to deal with.  A very up-front, no-nonsense kinda guy.  You take your car in, they fix it (often times by the end of the same day), and you're on your way.   Not many places like this still around!

I recently joined this gym for two reasons:
1. After attending as a guest with a great friend
2. An amazing deal on Rue Lala

I think the gym is phenomenal - great equipment, awesome classes, etc. The staff are always enthusiastic and friendly as well.. except for the employee who signed me up for my membership. Not only was he completely unpleasant, but he never even took the time to ask me if I had questions, explain the benefits of a membership or offer a tour of the facilities. To top it off, he told me how annoyed he was with all of the Rue Lala vouchers. Talk about a real disappointment in customer service.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This is one of the best sushi places I've eaten at in philly. I love it because it is the only place I've seen that actually gives you a large size piece of raw fish in or on your sushi roll. It is never mushy and all the rolls are creatively designed and have a unique combination of ingredients. Not to mention there are 20-30 rolls to choose from so you can always find something you like. The only downside is every time I try and make a reservation they are full unless you go really late so we usually do take out.

fyi - if you're ordering a "pint" of beans or rice from El Limon ... their "pint" container is 12oz.     When I called to point this out and spoke to three different people at the new Paoli location they assured me that it's ok because that's the "pint" container they use at all their restaurants ... 

The enchiladas were good if you have a high heat tolerance, but too spicy for the "wimps" in our family, which made the 25% reduction in the pint of rice and beans we paid for that we COULD eat more problematic ..

I took my car in a couple weeks ago for an oil change, rotation, & new wipers!  I got a really good deal, staff was very friendly, and as a woman I didn't feel like I was being taken advantage of.  The service I received was great! My only pet peeve, was that I guess they had to get my wipers delivered from another location so it took a good 2 hours or more, where I anticipated about 1 hour (and I had to go up and ask what the hold up was). They were very friendly though and said in the future to call in advance because I guess my car has special wipers.  Would recommend them for a good price and friendly service.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: EASILY the best sushi in Santa Barbara. Sakana has a very creative and robust menu filled with flavorful items. The staff is almost comically (in a positive way) helpful. You absolutely must try the Basil Fluke! Waze did not know the way to restaurant, but it got us close and we were able to wing it from there. The space is pretty small and it was a little loud but it added to the vibe and energy of the place. Prices are on the high-side but the quality drives the value. Only "want" is for them to have some Ramune for the kiddo (and maybe,me).

I ordered take out from here the other day. We ordered their sweet and sour chicken, chicken and rice soup, pork egg roll, and fried chicken dumplings. 

The chicken and rice soup was pretty good (standard), but the fried chicken dumplings were so amazingly delicious! Loaded with chicken and fried just right. 

The sweet and sour chicken wasn't bad either. I always request sauce on the side, as I hate having my food completely smothered! The chicken was big, decent quality, and had your typical greasy batter attached to it. What really made this dish was the sauce-it was the best sweet and sour sauce I have ever tasted.

Good food, but not a pleasant experience.  It's cramped and noisy, especially the closer you get to the back, and OMG do they rush you through the meal!  We got there at 6:10 on a Saturday night and three tables around us already had their checks. That seemed odd, until we got thrown into the food race ourselves -- they whipped us through 4 courses in less than an hour, and the check was on the table before we were halfway through dessert. It's really hard for two people to enjoy a bottle of wine that fast! This can never really be a great or destination restaurant if they act like it's a diner.

These guys were great.  I purchased a discounted oil change, rotation, etc from LivingSocial, moved, and the coupon expired. They still honored my expired coupon! Listening to the service manager was refreshing too, Cory I think his name was; professional and courteous to everyone on the phone and walk ins. I'm not affiliated with the company or the staff, I'm a Realtor (markshanerussell.com) and happen to understand the importance of referrals, which is why I'm even taking the time to write this.  These guys deserve your business.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I used to eat here a lot, but after the other night, I will shy away.

There food is good, depending on the menu choice.  The prices are iffy, again depending on the meal choice.  The service is either great, or horrible depending on the server.

The other night, I witnessed an altercation between a customer, and a server with whom I had problems in the past.  I do not know the entire story, but can only assume her poor customer service lead to whichever problem took place.

Like I said, it is hit or miss depending on which server your dumb luck gives you.  I am out at the Kopper Kitchen just due to this horrible server.

I rented a car this past weekend as a Gold #1 member.  Everything was fine except for two things.  The car was ready when I arrived and I was quickly helped when I returned the car and even offered a personal trip to the airport instead of the shuttle.  BUT the fuel option is outrageous.  EITHER one buys a full tank of gas, OR one is charged $9.99 per gallon.  I opted to refill the tank myself, but this is not customer service.  Second, my bill included a small "energy surcharge" of $1.49.  What is that all about in these days of gas glut?

Use to be my favorite pizza joint...pizza from Roma's was a weekly event. However, over the past several months its has gone downhill and we found a  new local pizza shop. Always willing to give a second chance, stopped there with family for a quick slice and was severely disappointed. The slice of pepperoni was tasteless and just downright awful. I ate half and was done...same with the family. Not sure what happened at Roma's, but the za is either way too oily or has no taste...inconsistent product. While it pains me, family pizza night has permanently moved to a different local pizza joint.

We've come to this Starbucks early on every Saturday for years.  We've tolerated the inconsistent service, the cranky manager, the Bible group that takes over the entire patio every Saturday because we love the location. This morning was possibly our last visit - there are tons of other SBs to choose from.  No attempt whatsoever to maintain the patio area - see the picture. We always have to clean off our own table, but this is ridiculous - I'm not going to sweep for them!  When someone slips and falls on the piles of leaves they might pay attention. Sloppy.

There is nothing wrong with the coffee, but the attitude that was displayed today was not very friendly.  I stop here now and again and everyone tends to be pleasant.  I made a mistake on my order...it was my fault and I was apologetic for my mistake, and the order was caught before the drinks were made.  The girl who was making them gave me an eye roll and a snide remark.  When she paced over the drinks I said sorry again and I got an unpleasant "whatever" in return.  Everyone makes a mistake sometimes, like messing up while ordering and I am going to take it that she messed up with the attitude.

The apartment complex is very good. I've lived here for more than 2 years and loved it. It is a very quite and safe area, which is very close to the university. The 3rd street is just a block from the complex, which makes it a perfect place if you're a bike fan.

I've never had any issues with the managers or my neighbors. A couple of times (over the two years) students living there organized parties but nothing too noisy. Overall it's rather quiet. The apartment is a little pricey for Tucson, therefore only 4 stars.

Today was my first time ordering takeout from here. The place is very nice on the inside, not big so you will be close to your next table mates. I ordered the 3 roll lunch special, tuna avocado, spicy tuna, salmon avocado and smoked salmon sashimi. The sushi smelled fresh, rice was perfectly cooked. Decent sized cut portions 6 pieces of each. My only dissatisfaction was the smoked salmon was very thin, any other place they are cut thick, sushi snobs call them steak cuts. These were not even close (see images ). I will order from again, but I'll pass on the sashimi if they continue to cut them thin.

Without a doubt THE WORST customer service I've ever experienced in my life. Rude from the second he picked up the phone. Screwed up my order. Then hung up on me 10 times when I called back to figure it out. He even threatened to call the cops for harassment! it would be funny if my blood wasn't boiling. Three different people lied to me about a manager being on duty until finally someone fessed up and said there was no manager. They refused to refund any money. I wanted a refund because I wasn't about to eat the food they brought back.

I love Cantina Feliz. It's by far the best Mexican restaurant in the area. The food is consistently well prepared and very tasty. My favorites include the guacamole, short rib enchiladas, fish tacos and the (sadly undersized) mushroom huarache. Everything is tasty here and prices are appropriate for the quality served. Diners with a big appetite might be left still hungry after three courses. A glass of perfectly chilled Dos Equis (which I happen to enjoy) is only $4.50 with a wide range of other drinks available. I love the inviting colors used to decorate this restaurant.

We wanted so badly to like this place.  Waited to review until after I went three times.  The location is great, and the decor and staff are laid-back and quirky--very cool.  I could even deal with the limited menu if they did everything well consistently, but unfortunately this is not the case.  The pizzas are ok--props for uniqueness.  

For brunch I got the veggie omelet.  The veggies were raw.  The next time I wanted the breakfast burrito, they were out.  The third time they were out of tea.  They didn't ask how we wanted the burger cooked.  A lot of little oversights and mediocre food.

If you want great ice cream this is the place but don't expect to get the joy. The lady is always crabby and today she literally was even more rude than normal. My kids were trying to ask me if they could get a waffle cone and she was not happy they paused for 10 seconds. Her attitude literally takes the joy out of taking kids for ice cream. Which is a bummer bc the ice cream is great and prices are pretty awesome BUT DO Not expect a friendly face or joyful experience, not sure where they get Dairy "Joy". Good teaching lesson today for me to teach my kids on how to act and not to act towards people.

My mom and I stayed one night here at Homewood Suites. Every time we stay at a hotel we always check for signs of bed bugs. While checking we didn't see any noticeable signs so we thought it was all clear. The next morning we woke up to 2 bed bugs in our bed. You know if there's one there has got to be more. The hotel staff was very understanding and helpful. They are currently investigating the matter further prior to my receiving any reimbursement. But this is still a serious matter and I'm sorry to say I won't be staying here any other time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Is this place for real?? Went in because I work in the area and don't really care for Starbucks. The interior is nice but that is the only thing nice about the place. Ordered an iced coffee. Asked for some cream to top it off with after I got it. Barista informs be they "are a purist coffee shop and don't have cream." They want you to really be able to taste the coffee. Fine. The coffee is sour almost. Really disappointing addition to an area in desperate need of a good coffee shop. No sweetener either, by the way.

My husband and I haven't been here since the new ownership.  I must say, the entire experience was great.  My husband doesn't like Mexican food, but went for me.  He liked it so much that we plan on going back this week.  The food was absolutely wonderful, very tasty and the presentation was great.  This restaurant is a must to try and frequent.  The entire staff was so helpful and friendly as well.

I can honestly say that I love Mexican food and have eaten at A LOT of Mexican restaurants.  This is by far the best tasting food. 

Thank you for coming to our area.  We'll see you soon

Great dinner tonight. 
My wife and I both had chicken dishes, I had Marsala, she had Suprema or something. Salad was ok, bread was seasoned, very good. Bruschetta was very good also. But the Chicken Marsala was great in my opinion. Service was ok, it's obvious they are still working the bugs out in this new restaurant. 
But, I would have to say, that for dinner, it's the kind of place you could make your regular spot for good Italian food.
$14.95 for the chicken dishes and with all of the fresh ingredients, it was a deal.
(BYOB)

I'm leaving the Claridge after calling it my home for 2 years. My favorite part about the building is the location and the staff. Everyone is so nice and I was very sad to say my goodbyes. They are constantly having events for the residents- a wine a cheese happy hour was yesterday.

My only real complaint is that the walls are pretty thin. But Michele worked with me to try and soundproof it a bit and that helped. 

I'll miss the convenience the Claridge has to offer. It's the perfect "first city" apartment as it has the safety of a doorman, the great location and the utilities are included.

From the second you walk in you know this is not your ordinary mexican restaurant.  What was once known as pugs corner has been completely transformed into an open and airy eatery.  You are greeted by some familiar faces from the west nash food business and delightfully so.  The menu is large. Take your time.  Hub and I both chose the build your own combo 3 items for $10.99 including beans and rice.  The poblanos are the closest to ones I ate in mexico. The burrito and enchiladas  we not lacking in filling or taste. Make your way out charlotte pike and enjoy some wonderful food.

WOW!!! Great place reasonable prices and the Sushi chef was extremely friendly and helpful. The fish was superb quality! Had Tuna and Salmon nigiri and salmon rolls inside-out.. I lived in Singapore for a few years so I think I know how to recognize a good sushi place when I eat in one and this one is definitely a place I will drive half hour to eat/bring food from. Crazy Asian location.. food court with Korean/Japanese/Chinese food and the biggest Korean supermarket I've seen in Philadelphia so far.. Don't think just go!

might be time to start looking for a new car wash place    this wash will leave your windows with thousands of little spots    i always go to the sunoco close bye and get towels to wash off the spots   they say they are working on it    well   for all these years???    now     the last three times i have been there    they never have all of their vacuum hoses operating   only a few and the ones that do not reach all around your car     i asked why   ' i am the only one here '   wow    they need to get their act together   sad

Let me start by saying, I am very familiar with this place pre "Bar Rescue" (ie Raven and Quill's days), and it literally could only get better.

That said, it didn't really get better.  It's still a happening spot for high school kids, and/or all of Kenner in it's Ed Hardy, spiked hair glory.  They're still practically giving the alcohol away (hello, Beat the clock, and $2 anything specials), and still giving off creepy, uncomfortable vibes.

If you're on Maple, try Bruno's across the street or Philips further down.  Unless you're trying to holler at 16 year old Cabrini girls.

Can you give 0 stars??  We had a simple request - 2 chicken burritos.  We went through DoorStep Delivery (never had an issue, extremely helpful and kind) and received one beef burrito.  Not only did we not order this, they were extremely rude to the Doorstep Delivery person. who tried to fix the issue.  So, I call Estela's and the manager tells me there is nothing they can do. Really?  We paid extra for chicken.  Ordered 2 burritos - received one.  Screw this place.  60 later, I have inedible food (their ground meat is true dog food...).  How many nights do wish you were going to Taco Bell? It's THAT bad! Stay the hell away from here.

The food and waiters were ok, but there was a significant drawback.  Do not take a table upstairs as the noise level makes it impossible to carry on conversation.  Our party of 10 was promised that space was suitable for a dinner meeting.  Two other large parties were seated near us.  The acoustics in the room with the high ceiling amplified the sound. When we requested the opportunity to move to another table, it was denied.  We finished quickly.  Downstairs was much quietier.  I left with a headache, but if you can get a seat on the first floor you would be ok.

We come because we love the low prices and excellent service given by the staff fitting glasses. However, this doctor, according to the staff is always late. We arrived at 10 for the first appointment thinking we would be in and out pretty quickly since it's the first appointment. However we found that the doctor is always at least a half an hour late. So what should have taken 30 minutes ended up taking over at hour since the doc didn't get in until 40 minutes after the scheduled appointment, and apparently this is "normal". Please be aware when making morning appointments with this doctor. "Elisabeth Knibb".
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I don't understand why this location received such favorable reviews. I merely wanted some tasty frozen yogurt and I was disappointed. For starters, you can only sample their self serve yogurt if you ask an employee for a sample. They trust their customers to use the machines to serve themselves cups of yogurt but not samples. Ultimately, it probably doesn't matter too much because all of the flavors (except chocolate) taste like vanilla with a slight hint of another undetectable flavor. The shop is clean but not a great place to hang out because it is terribly loud. If you're used to Yogurtland or Pink Berry, you will be disappointed.

This is an excellent place to visit if you are in the mood for a burger and a craft beer or two.  The beer list is long and changes a lot, and they have a beer room too if you want to take something with you.  The menu is not limited to burgers; they also offer a bunch of other popular upscale American pub entrees like salads, sandwiches, quesadillas, etc.  The atmosphere is first-rate.  It is an attractive, comfortable place to visit, and was that Howie Long, the football player and broadcaster, sitting a couple of tables away?  I could be wrong about that, but Becker's is good enough for the likes of Howie.  And me.

Went for lunch and the place was pretty busy.  The decor was pretty nice and the service was okay.  Unfortunately, my ratings are almost always based on the food.  I ordered the standard fair for visiting a new Japanese place.  Agedashi tofu, 2 pieces of Saba (mackerel) and a bento box which consisted of sashimi, teriyaki chicken and tempura.  The tempura batter was very thick and the teriyaki chicken was like warm and hard (probably pre-maid).  The sashimi was cut really nice and had some good flavours.

I'll probably try it again but it's. It on my bucket list.

There's nothing bad I can say about this place as I've been going here for 30 years.  Over that time it has turned itself from a super dive to a moderate dive.  It used to be very dirty and run down and now it's just a bit acceptable.  Regardless the food hasn't changed, still just as good as it was back then.  Loads of msg and everything good.

Don't go if you're super health conscious.  Go if you really like authentic yummy food.  Btw this place is CASH only.

I recommend the beef brisket with wontons in noodles soup.  Also the hoinan chicken rice.  Best of all is the salt and pepper wings.  If you have time order the ribs in rice hot pot.

I've been coming here for years, and no, it's not incredibly authentic Chinese food and it won't change your life. But it's pleasant, it's cheap, the food isn't bad at all and it's a Nashville institution.

The staff are always friendly and really do their best to make sure you have a good experience. But for the easiest time in and out, call ahead for pickup - it usually only takes about 10 minutes for them to prepare it. 

The only bad thing I have to say is that I wish they hadn't changed their recipe for country style bean curd. I liked it better with more mushroom variety.

Excellent place to have a thorough eye exam with Dr. Brosof.  He is excellent!  I was long overdue for an eye exam and he took the time to explain everything that ultimately occurs with your vision as you get older.  The selection of frames is not extensive but I found the frames I wanted immediately.  I ordered one pair of glasses for driving and a second pair for reading.  The business used to be in Ivy Ridge Shopping Center but they relocated to the storefront at the Vesta Building (Ridge and Parker Avenue).  Highly recommended.  Don't forget to use the $20 on Yelp if your purchase is over $100!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
This was my first time visiting this car wash, and I'm really disappointed with the quality of the work. I paid $28 for a full-service wash, including vacuuming, etc. They did an okay job on the inside of the car, and the people were friendly, hence the two stars. 

But the exterior wash was incredibly poor. Big blobs of bird poop left on the car in several places, and my vehicle is white, so it was super-obvious. Leaves were still embedded in the door cracks. I've had better washes for $5 at automated outfits at gas stations. I won't be back.

Beautiful spacious hotel. BUT Located about 8 blocks from French quarter... If you are not into walking everywhere, and your destination is the French quarter, you may want to choose a closer hotel. Also, there are NO drawers in the rooms to put your little things in, like underwear, socks, things that don't particular go well on hangers... No towel racks to hang your wet towels on, only one hook on the back door... Very strange... Seems like a luxury hotel but missed some basic amenities... Also the hotel bars all closed at midnight... In new Orleans?? That was a surprise...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Pretty dirty and low scale once you walk in the door. I was really hoping to find a nice nail salon in the area. My gel nails are less than a week in, and already chipping. Disappointed. I will not be returning, and would't tell anyone to go there. Looks like I'll have to make the hike to Green Hills if I want gel nails to last and a clean nice environment. The pictures on the website are not anything of what it looks like inside. Maybe that's at another location? 

Also to add, they did no sanitize their tools or use a new kit for each client.

Hubs and I have been here twice. The first time I tried their drunken gnocchi and have not been able to stop thinking about it. Delicious!!!  Five stars

Second time we ordered out and of course I got the DG again. Loved it! 

Hubs had something different than last time, artichoke chicken lemons pasta with capers. He loved it!! He said 5 stars and would def get it again!

We also had garlic bread which is pretty tasty and loaded with oil and garlic!! 

We would totally be back weekly, but are carb conscious people.

Mu husband and I stayed two weeks ago and the location is great. The moment you walk in you just feel how NICE the place is. It's gorgeous but we got to our room and found it to just be okay. Clean, comfy but really nothing exceptional and for what they charge they could do a little more. Big downside is they charge for internet $15. We passed on that. There saving grace was the delicious breakfast buffett excellent coffee. When I am in St. Louis I prefer the Moonrise but would consider staying here again for the excellent location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place is TINY. When we first walked in we were a little overwhelmed by how snug it was. The smell of food, although not bad, was pretty overwhelming when we came in. We were sat on the porch ( covered) which was nice and a little better ventilated.

The oil/balsamic dip we got with the bread was sooo good. We had the burrata salad - mozzarella and ricotta were so fresh and very light. We had the bolognese which had a nice flavor/ spice and another in our party had the lobster ravioli which was amazing - wish I got that. We ended with the chocolate mousse - light and nice way to end dinner. Def recommend this place!

Initially I was excited for this new ice cream shop but the staff managed to ruin the experience.  My order rarely changed over the summer yet the price I was charged constantly fluctuated by several dollars.  The staff was so curt and dismissive that I was not willing to make an issue of it.  Unfortunately on the last visit, the girl that was ringing us up threw our loyalty card on the counter and slammed down the iPhone she used to process the credit card and didn't speak to us.  I regret that I've ever put money in their tip jar almost as much I as I regret giving them business this past summer.

Ok so I get that you are restructuring with the closing of the Grant Rd location but your new first avenue employees need to check themselves. Thank you for keeping Tammy we love her. But guy with curly grayish hair who chooses when he wears a mask is being to aggressive. We live in the hood and try to wear our masks but forgot them once and he jumped on us when he hasn't worn a mask since he arrived at "our" store. I thought he was a customer because he has disregarded the signs you post. Where's Mike? Where's Fred? Who's this guy? Maybe he can learn his new regulars.

I used to LOVE this place until recently. I think they do a great job when it comes to manicures and full sets. However, I had my first pedicure here a week or two ago and it was the worst pedicure I have ever had. The water was not even hot.. barely warm! I was not given any special treatment whatsoever. It was the quickest pedicure I have ever had. The girl barely massaged my feet and legs.. maybe for 5 seconds tops. Definitely not relaxing. Also, they people there aren't as friendly anymore. Lastly, they make you pay $1 for a nail kit and $1 for flip flops.. annoying.

The concept is great but execution fails. The premise is hands free car wash which is fine but stop the rip off when it comes to 
1. Cleaning the floor mats - Extra charges $$$
2. Wiping down the interior - Extra charges $$$

Beware this place is only good for an exterior wash ONLY - do not expect more. Just pay for the most basic service and move on. I'm hopeful another place opens near where I live so they understand how to price car washes. No one wants to pay $40 for a car wash and leave with a dirty interior and dirty floor mats.

Just a few issues with the rental, even though it had 2 no smoking stickers on the dashboard the car totally smelled like smoke but due to time I just put an air freshener in to combat that smell. Car was not cleaned out all the way, crumbs and the like still in the seats and on the floor, needed to be vacuumed out alot better than it was. And the last thing was the sticker on the plate was 6-16 and my rental was in July.  Other than that all the employees were very polite and helpful. No mechanical problems with the car, appreciated the ride home. 
Would probably rent from again

I've been going to this salon for about 2 years and Adela has done a fabulous job on my hair.  She does some of the best highlights I've ever had.  The problem is her prices seem to keep going up.  I just can't afford it anymore.  The last time I went in, I tried to reduce the services down to just a partial highlight and got a haircut at Great Clips to save money.  The partial highlight was like, $130 dollars!!!!!!  That's crazy.  Yeah, so I'm done going to this salon and am searching out a new one with more reasonable prices.  However, if money is no object for you, Adela does a great job.

The food is good. We came in and the woman said there was a 35 minute wait time despite the dining room being half empty. We waited 35 minutes, then asked how much longer and she said another 20. More groups of people came in and she also told them 20 minutes and it took much longer. She seated several groups the same size as ours who came in after us. She offered no explanation or accommodations. I understand a busy dinner time, but the staff should offer explanations, be polite, and let us know instead of us having to come up constantly and ask.

I couldn't wait to get home and rate this business!!  I just left after the best cut I have ever had!!  Julie did a great job.  She nailed the cut I requested and was so sweet ...I think She was excited as me!!  (Chopped off 8 inches!)  The color turned out great, as well!  I met Michelle, the owner who also very nice. The shop itself is clean and very cute. I highly recommend this salon and have already scheduled my next appointment!!  See you, May 1st, Julie. Thank you again!  I haven't stopped smiling!  I absolutely LOVE IT!!

P.S. This review is from Darci Lombardo
My son must have logged into my yelp account.

The service at this location was awful and so was the drink they tried to pass off as coffee.  I ordered a short decaf Americano, I basically received a warm cup of water.  I gave it back and told them about it.  So they offered to put in another shot.  But they didn't.  They just gave me back the same cup of disgusting coffee.  Perhaps if you want a fancy coffee drink they'll get it right.  But it seems they cannot get a simple cup of coffee correct.  On top of that I had to wait a long time because she was training a young man how to actually make the coffee but did she say "thank you for waiting" or apologize for the wait, NOPE!!

My husband and I went to No 9 with friends to celebrate our birthdays. What a great little restaurant! The pear/brie/bacon salad was AMAZING and my husband hasn't stopped raving about the braised short ribs for 48 hours! Definitely a wonderful place to celebrate a special occasion. Oh, and one of the appetizers, the clams with a tomato broth, was beyond delicious. Basically, everything was out of this world. It's a BYOB so that's an added bonus. Be prepared to pay about $25-$35 per entree. The apps are anywhere between $10-$15.
Also, our waitress was the best!

Sometimes you get the best pan pizza ever but alot of times you don't. You have to make sure you ask them to let " the old man" aka the owner, to make your pizza. He must be oblivious that only the food he makes is good and that his staff sucks. They are always messing up your order, bringing out food in wrong order or take like 20 minutes to bring you a drink. I will still get the pan pizza there because it is the best around but I go there to order it have a few beers while I wait. If I dont see the owner in the back making pizza then I go somewhere else.

I've been going to Ginza for over 10 years now and I don't think I have ever had a bad experience.  Generally I love the food and think it's very flavorful, much more so than any of the chain hibachi grills I have tried. I don't even need the extra sauce they give me because just the right amount of flavor is cooked into the food. I also like that it's not a chain because it gives it a more pleasant feel.  Some of the others are part of giant corporations and it shows. 

If you want good hibachi and you are visiting Indianapolis, considering giving Ginza a shot.

Delicious for most of the courses. Foie gras , salmon mouse one of the more intriguing amazing combination of flavor and texture , rigatoni with pork shoulder is amazing , surf and turf was pork belly and squid was basic, I was disappointed after so many wonderful dishes then this being brought out , pork belly seemed to charred on the outside, not much flavor, for the third course maybe a larger portion , and the Bavarian was mediocre TOO MUCH SALT for me, my other half got the macaron which was fantastic. Mainly the third course needs to be amped up in many ways. Overall great experience would return in 1-3 years.

This place is hit or miss - and it's ALWAYS a miss with the hostess.  Never in my life have I walked into a restaurant and stared at a hostess booth for over a minute before I was acknowledged.  Do these owners realize it all starts at the front door?  I've been to many of restaurants in my days and never have I been to a restaurant where a hostess is nasty like at Toscana 52.  I'd like to tell you about the time I had over cooked gnocchi but I'm exhausted typing about the hostesses - this place is a joke. I cringe when a friend wants to go here - I beg to sit at the bar.  Work on that!

I was disappointed that we just missed the breakfast cutoff, but not for long.  Their lunch was very good.  They offer a nice selection of hot tea, but it's not on the menu.  I had to ask.  

Their grits with wilted mustard greens were amazing!  I'm not normally a fan of grits, but these were next level.  They were fluffy and lightly cheesy, and the mustard greens had a little acidity to cut through the richness of the grits.

The turkey sloppy joe was on point.  I enjoyed the crunch and acidity of the homestyle pickles.

I will definitely recommend this to anyone traveling to Philly.

Three stars only for their yummy coffee. My husband and I come here most weekends. It's closer to us than Starbucks so DDs is where we go until today. I won't be coming back as I'm sick of them getting our order wrong more often than not. I'm always given the wrong sandwich, well 90% of the time- (unfortunately not even an exaggeration) and my coffee order is wrong this morning which is highly irritating since I am already paying too much for a coffee. Sorry DDs, I really like the convenience of your location and your coffee and food is good, but I'm moving on.

My main concern was no vegetarian options, come on. When I asked the girl who was taking an order about those she was had no idea whether they have veg options or not so she got another girl who was clueless as well, so they got me the manager lady (I assume) who gave me the look and said oh I can put lettuce and tomatoes on the sandwich will this do ? Who does this? I felt very awkward cuz all staff members were staring at this freak(me) who's out of her mind and asking for vegetarian sandwich. Never again I'm gonna go there.

This Mc Donald's is the worst. I don't eat the food because I choose not to . I only go in for ice cream or a specialty drink. Well forget it !!! 9X outta 10 the ice cream machine is down and go in today for a macchiato oh, that's down today. Maybe if the ignorant individuals that take up space ( not work) in this establishment did thier jobs properly like cleaning the machines and stay on top of the upkeep of these machines they wouldn't be constantly down !!! Maybe the owner of this franchise should be a little more hands on and make frequent visits to see exactly what's going on in there . Start with retraining !
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
There's not a better espresso in Tucson, and you won't find a better cold brew either. Dave and Caroline are not only master ( maestra ) baristas, but indeed are delightful people as well. For the adventurous, an epicurean surprise of a vegetarian burrito is usually available for lunch that never tastes the same way twice. This omnivore is fully satisfied every time.  Oh and DO get an Earl Grey scone to share with your friend or loved one on the way out. 

Now if I could just apply my negotiation skills to convince my CFO to buy Anna's cold brew by the keg for the office....

The sushi is not horrible, but it is not great.  The specials are good and draw you in.  I come here occasionally because it's near my place and the value makes it worth it.  I recently went there, there was a long line and the host staff made me feel they were doing me a favor by allowing me to wait and eat there.  Ultimately, I left because I don't need that favor.

That being said, the sushi is usually ok and the prices are generally good. Nothing bad will happen to you if you eat here, but is that the goal?

 I suggest going to Raw, Sachiko, or Yoshimatsu.  The sushi is better and your presence is better valued.

I know it's an airport where you expect to be overcharged for lame food but this place takes that to a new level. Caprese salad was passable but did not include fresh basil even though that ingredient was touted in the menu. The chicken tenders, for 10 bucks, were more like something you would get on McDonald's dollar menu. But the greatest affront was this: if you want fried onions on your $13 cheesesteak, that will be an extra 75 cents.  If you are cruising the B concourse for a place to eat, it is best you just cruise right past this place.

Tried this location with a maintenance coupon. The gentleman was fair with answers & advice, but the woman was a bit unknowledgeable and depends upon sales training to push for selling you extra BS.

So it ends up being like a auto dealership that you have to be on your guard or you will pay too much.

I still debate whether I'll return. 
I believe in being polite to folks so I'll probably look for another shop without the sales pressure.
It only takes one bad apple!
The "mechanics" aren't the most professional either.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Worst Mexican food I've ever had in my life. The waiter was nice but the food was absolutely not edible. I ordered the steak enchiladas with tomatillo sauce and it was way way to salty and I love salt. It seems them just poured the salt into the food for fun. The steak tasted like it was past it's best by date because it smelled rotten. I took two bites and just threw the rest of the plate away. The rice it came with was even worse, it was so salty. I would avoid recommending anyone to this establishment. The only thing okay was the tortilla chips.

Don't go here unless your squad deep. Even then I wouldn't recommend it. I have several friends that have been robbed here. I even have a friend who was jumped in the bathroom. One of my friends was robbed leaving, they took her entire purse including her car keys that were inside. I come here frequently bc it is a late night early morning bar. But take it from me it's never a good idea.
