If you feel like it's a must hopefully it's your lucky night and you make it in and out safe. 2 stars because pops always seems too be were I end up after all the other bars close and the night must go on.

We eat at Rizzo's often and we usually like it.  Tonight we had curbside pick up and ordered the Chicken Spedini special. The presentation was terrible.  We had there specials.  They lumped all of the Spedini together in one small rectangular box.  The sides were individually prepared. When we asked the restaurant why it was like this they said because it was their special.  It would have been $1 more for the boxes.  Seriously, the order was going to two place and we could not even send the orders.  It was boxed family style and unacceptable. The food was good.  The presentation ruined the experience.

The food here is good and not particularly expensive. They serve one of the better California rolls compared to other local sushi places I've tried, and the spicy tuna is worth noting as well. The miso soup was flavorful, though perhaps a bit too salty, but the edamame was not salty enough - although I tend to like mine with a lot of salt. For dessert the green tea moshi with ice cream was quite tasty. In all, not much to complain about.

The decor is refined, yet not intimidatingly so. The bathroom was also very clean.

"buono come si arriva"
Anyone who rates this restaurant as less than 4 stars clearly does not know what real Northern Italian food tastes like.  If you are looking for a big pile of spaghetti with a fat meatball and thick dark red sauce, this is NOT your place nor is that typically Northern Italian style.  If you really know Northern Italian food, you know that this is about as authentic as I have had in a long time.  After spending much time in Northern Italy, I have to say that this is really super.  I have been here many, many times and it never fails.  It's the real deal. 
Buon appetito, è la cosa reale

Highly unimpressed. If you're not a regular your wont feel very welcome. I wasn't ignored but I was definitely an afterthought here. Very much a dive bar which I normally love. Tables, pool tables, juke box, pretty scaled down but nice place. The biggest issue was the staff. Like I said not very friendly and very short. They were also annoyed at my usage of the juke box. If you only want to hear specific songs that YOUR employees like.. Kill the jukebox and use a mix tape. Otherwise be open to everyone's taste in music..

I am not impressed with this place at all and I will never go back.  I wanted to put prescription lens into a  pair of Maui Jim sunglasses that I owned.  Both  representatives already made up their mind that insurance would not cover it.  Instead of helping me go over my benefits, the female representative acted like I was inconveniencing her.  She looked at my benefits and quickly decided that it was not covered.  She quoted me a price of $549 before adding in all of the costs.  Keep in mind I i already owned the frames.  Truly low rent and not worthy of the brands they carry.  I had a far better experience at Target.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: THEY ARE UNDER NEW MANAGEMENT AS OF JUNE - They need some time to get their act together.  We had been going here for ages and it was an awesome local BYOB.  Went there last sunday and nothing was the same.  It was the waitress' first day and she said they  are keeping the food the same and everything the same.  NOT YET!  French fries were dripping in grease, bread on hoagie was different, the eggplant parmigiana was pretty good which was the saving grace for two stars, but otherwise no reason to go there.  We are bummed by this turn of events, but such is life.  We won't be back soon, maybe in a few months. Miss the old owners already.

Very nice hotel. The bathroom was gorgeous & so was the room. Also very convenient that they provide dishes in the kitchenette. However during my stay there were a lot of ants in the room. There was also a light out on the ceiling which was the main source of light for the room. I only stayed one night and noticed the ants in the morning. I reported it to the front desk and all the woman responded with was "thank you for telling us" . I was expecting her to at least apologize, but she did not. I would've loved to stay here again, but I wouldn't because of the ants.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Don't be put off by the lackluster waiting area in this funky converted house.  When we entered on a Saturday night, the little area was empty and no one was there.  We waited for a few minutes and a gruff woman finally appeared to greet us.  She seated us immediately and whisked our wine bottle off the table to uncork it, before waiting for a response to her question about opening it.  Despite these transgressions, I'm still giving it four stars because the food was totally worth it.  We had ginger beef, miso soup, salads, dumplings, and sushi rolls.  Everything was homemade, incredibly fresh, and so yummy.  Sushi fans won't be disappointed!

The largest mainline grocery store in the immediate area.  Design and aisle width are a throwback to the 1950s.  The prices are high enough that you won't spend that much more getting your top-end / fresh items at somewhere like DiBruno Bros or Max's Produce.  So that leaves this place for non-perishable items such as canned goods, etc.  And with a little planning ahead, why not buy these outside of the Rittenhouse area where you will pay a lot less?  OK in a pinch but generally go higher end for your fresh stuff / lower end for your non-perishables if you can.

It's a very touristy stop, it's extremely busy and the bartenders are good at keeping up. Know what you want before you get to the bartender. Known for their hand grenade- I really enjoyed the Shark Attack. Live music was great plays a lot of songs in the Key West/Floridian playlist which suits the feel of the spot. Please tip your bartender, they deal with a lot of bull and work hard to help give you a safe fun environment. Saw the one bartender get stiffed 7/10 customers. Don't go out if you can't afford to tip.

Last time I came to Passariellos, the chef salad was amazing. The server made it with an extra scoop of everything! I watched as she added two scoops of tomatoes, onion, carrots, well everything! When she went to put it in the box it filled both the base, and the lid of the container. She had to press the box together to get it all to fit.

Today, not so much. The salad was made with a single scoop of each ingredient. The salad was large enough for one side of the to-go container. 

Still good just not what I expected.

Great service from the time I was picked up at home until I drove away in the rental. It was nice how someone came to open the door for me when I went to enter the building, I don't think that has ever happened to me before! They explained the procedure well and told me that if I needed the car longer than the insurance company would pay for, they would allow me to continue paying at the insurance company's rate. They offered a choice of vehicles and the car I chose was very nice and well kept. I will be back to Enterprise if I ever need to rent another vehicle.

Live bug in my food!  And all the waiter did was laugh.  Finally got the bartender to come to our table 15 minutes after discovering the bug and asking to speak to a manager.  There was no manager on that night (Tuesday, so it was slow) and she took off my salad and gave us a free glass of wine.  In my opinion the entire meal should have been complimentary, or she could have given us a gift certificate to come back.  We still spent $60 so it's not like I only ordered the salad. I will never go back, which is a shame because the food was quite good.

We've tried a lot of sushi and in St. Louis this is some of the best. The food is pretty consistently good (only once did the fish seem not as fresh, and we eat here often), the service is always friendly and prompt, even when they are busy, and we're always happy when we leave. The rolls are creative and certainly more Americanized than someplace like Nobu, but they also have a nice selection of nigiri.  It's our go-to place and though we leave nearby now, we used to travel a decent distance on a regular basis to get Oishi.  "Oishi" means "delicious' in Japanese, and we agree!

I'm a fan of Wasabi's at both locations - the food is always so good, and the sushi rolls to perfection! I like to give it 5 starts but it's always a little unsettling when we stop into the this location and every table is available (anyway of the week at the lunch hour), and yet, the table service often stinks. But if you're lucky to be ackowdged within 10 minutes of sitting down..you're in for a good lunch. Recently did a take out order on a Saturday night, and was happy to see about 10 guess in the house. Not sure how they even stay in business, but I'll keep going..the food is great and it never disappoints!

Cute place--well lit, some seating, easy parking, and ok prices. My biggest hang up is that it's not consistent. I've been about a dozen times over 10 years, because it close to me. The shaved ice is nice--but the flavors often taste off, or there's no cone shape snowball top (like it's half made), and the service is slow--whether you're the only one in line or 5 ahead. There's usually about 5 tiny boppers inside...goofing off. There was one time when I think the ice or something was contaminated--worse food poisoning if ever experience in my life after eating a bubble gum snow ball. That's all I have to say about this snowball stand.

I give them 5 stars on there lunch special 3 rolls and soup or salad for under 12  with no bad experience. salad isn't anything special but a little something extra with the sushi will fill you up for lunch.They have a decent selection of sushi rolls so you can switch up everytime  you come or you can be boring and eat the same 3 rolls everytime whatever floats your boat .Anyways great place to grab some quick good tasting fresh sushi. 5 stars is for the lunch special i can't speak on anything else right now . I'm still sorting through what rolls i like most!!

First of all, it's just not a pleasant atmosphere inside.  Probably best for takeout.  On Saturday, there were two servers running the show and both were teenagers who just had no clue.  We were brought water glasses but never any water.  At one point both of them were leaning up against the wall looking at their cell phones.  

The food was hit and miss.  We tried the Thai chicken wings and they weren't cooked.  However, another special (Tuna Bomb) was excellent.  The tuna and salmon sushi were tasteless and seemed old.  The yellow tail was a bit better.  Their shrimp tempura roll is weak.  Peking is much better.

Extra friendly staff.  I found them all to be chipper, helpful and polite.  However I have rented cars using Enterprise in different cities and I have found that in other offices they make sure cars are clean in between rentals.  I recognize this location has high turnover, but I've used another location in a very tourist-y area that has probably just as much volume, and each time they have asked me if I'm willing to wait an extra 10 mins for them to clean the car.  I am not a germ-a-phobe, but riding in a weird smelling car isn't my thing.

Yup. Just ordered from here, hoping that the hot and sour soup lived up to the 5 star review... I got Szechuan Chicken, Boneless Pork BBQ App, and Hot and Sour soup. Sadly it was all disappointing. Typical Americanized Chinese food, overly sauced, not spicy at all, and slightly bland. I was really disappointed by the Hot and Sour soup as it lived up to the other reviewer's comment 'Neither hot or sour'.

I"ll probably order from here again as it wasn't TERRIBLE, but it wasn't wonderful either. Maybe I'll ask whomever takes my order for their favorite dish.

The food here is very good, but admittedly not the best Italian I've ever had. The veal piccata comes with an almost gravy-like sauce, which was thicker than I've had before and thicker than I prefer, but overall I liked the flavor. Soups and salads were good, and my husband really liked his pasta dish. We had panna cotta for dessert that was really flavorful. I will tell you though, we had great service. That really uplifted the whole experience. We'd gotten takeout from here before but I think I want to keep eating in just because our waiter and the host were both so personable and attentive.

The moment you walk in you feel the good energy of this place - it's very natural and relaxing decor and the lack of any harsh chemical smells. They use organic, natural, and animal cruelty free products and try to follow earth friendly practices so you can feel great about getting your hair done! If you have curly hair you must check this place out - they are trained in working with curly hair and know how to get you the most beautiful curls out, even when you thought you didn't have any natural wave or curl at all! I'm so excited to have found this place!

Highest recommendation!! Lenny and the team at United Tire have always stepped up to help with some tricky problems and have always done a great job!!  My Suburban has custom brakes, which makes it a challenge to get parts and find someone willing to service them. Recently had a frozen caliper slide pin, which caused premature brake pad wear.  Placed a call to Lenny and had the situation fixed in an hour and then ordered and installed pads.  No one on the Main Line is willing to get their hands dirty anymore and actually do mechanical work, so a 5-star "shout out" to Lenny and his team for outstanding old fashioned mechanical work!!!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Great shop, I came in without an appointment (which I would suggest getting as its a smaller operation) but a barber there who I assume is the owner said we'll get you in no problem. My barber was Daniel (I think that was his name) and he was very talented and personable, but not overly talkative which can be annoying sometimes, so just the right amount of conversation. It's hard to find a barber that I like as I am pretty particular about my hair, and I've been to most local shops, but I will definitely be coming back to Chago's.

For full disclosure - I have only ever ordered a side of crab rangoon for pick up.  The rangoons were OK, not to my liking.  However, much like a previous reviewers delivery experience, my takeout experience was poor.  I arrived approx 30 mins after I placed the order online, and I had to wait in the restaurant about 15 mins for it to be ready.  All this for one order of crab rangoon.  There were a few other people waiting for orders as well.  Also, I noticed the small buffet area (while not in service during my visit) had dust on the overhang.  I won't be going back.

The only place you should even consider for your wedding cake is Publix!! This is true for almost any baked goods, as there really is nothing better than Publix when it comes to this category. But the cake turned out absolutely perfect, and for a fraction of what it would have cost to go to an actual specialty cake store. They only required 48 hour notice, were able to create a cake to feed 120 people within that time - and it was DELICIOUS. The delivery went smooth and I can honestly say Publix made the cake the easiest part of my wedding!!

They used to be terrific, but two things that keep my rating at only three stars are the size of their sushi rolls (which are abhorrently tiny for what you're paying), and the price that is tethered to them. The money is not well spent, at least for sushi. Which is supposed to be a specialty of the restaurant. The entrees and the specials are this place's saving grace.

One time I ordered miso soup and the tofu was frozen. The clumsiness and mistakes that are made can be appetite-killing, but for the most part, this place is alright. Not the worst place you can eat in town.

I've had Giovannis in Santa Barbara many times and love it. I assumed they were owned by the same owner but I believe that is not the case based on the difference in quality and price. We were charged $75 for 1 XL pepperoni pizza, 1 medium pepperoni and mushroom and a pitcher of beer. $75 for the amount of food we got seems very high. The pizza was good but inconsistent, 1 pizza was thin crust and the other wasn't, and no we didn't order thin crust. Overall, good food but way overpriced and inconsistent quality. I personally would prefer the SB location if I have the choice.

Two words....Miracle Whip. Unfortunately, every item we ordered here was slathered or swimming in overly sweet mayo. The noodle salad with squid everyone raves about...swimming in sweet mayonnaise. We ordered 3 very different sushi rolls and ALL of them were coated in sweet, Miracle Whip style mayonnaise. C'mon people...it's sushi. Rice, seafood, and maybe a tad of creativity and you have yourself a great roll....but not here. Disappointing, because the interior is cute and the service was good. It's the kind of sushi your grandma would make, if you're into that kind of thing.

It's not like I really like writing bad reviews, but here goes.  We are tried and true Sake Cafe goers, but decided to try something new.  Bad idea.  The interior is bland and the seats are cold, uninviting, and uncomfortable.  Aside from one other table, we were the only people in the place (another bad sign).  The service was acceptable, but the sushi was seriously sub par.  I mean this when I say.... you can go to any Rouses grocery store and get much better (with much better presentation) sushi than Origami.  That pretty much says it all right there.  Won't be back...Sake Cafe here we come again!

I am very excited to found this place, Serenity Nail Salon always the best nail place to go, they always have the cool color I wanted. and they always update the newest products & colors for you to choose from. they also carry all the most  Gel polish brand Shallac..Etc...
    All the staff are very  professional and friendly, they will do whatever it takes to make sure you are happy and satisfied. 
  The only reason i rating 4 star. because they super busy during the weekend every single time i go there,  i have to wait for at least 15 mins to get to the Spa chair. :(  but over all good Job!

Last day in New Orleans. We planned on having breakfast at this cafe. 
I had an egg white omelette with mushrooms and feta cheese. She brought it with regular eggs first, then had it replaced with the correct order. 
I also substituted my sides with fruits. You can guess how the grapes came in at the very bottom of the cup. Ugh!
My husband had scrambled eggs with potatoes and sliced tomatoes.  the potatoes were covering a layer of over cooked burned potatoes that looked to be leftovers from the morning. Yuck!
Not worth he $25 at all!!!!

Made plans to come to St Mary's Mexican after seeing the reviews.  First attempt they were closed for vacation so we decided to try the next Friday.

We ordered:
Mini Chimis - Half Chicken, other half Bean
Pint of Rice
Pint of Beans
Half Dozen Green Corn Tamales


The Mini Chimis were good.  The rice was not.  The beans were decent.  The Green Corn Tamales had the right smell that we have grown accustomed to when we used to get them from Lerua's prior to their closing.  However, the taste was just not there.

All in all, this was a wasted trip.

Haven't been here for a couple of years. A friend and I had lunch yesterday. As requested, we were seated outside in an umbrella shaded courtyard, very pleasant and quiet. We shared a chicken pesto sandwich with fries and a margherita pizza. Food was excellent and very nicely served. Service was excellent. The old inn is beautiful and since it's walkable from our homes (even though we drove), we'll be back. Overall an excellent lunch, nice portion sizes, and very fairly priced. Will return for lunch or dinner.

This is my 2nd visit to this particular restaurant and it was worse than the first. A few weeks ago I used the drive thru and they forgot my curly fries, so even though it was disappointing, mistakes happen. Today I ordered again from the drive thru - a turkey bacon ranch sandwich, 2 chicken sliders and curly fries. I get home and open the bag to find 2 roast beef sandwiches and onion rings. Needless to say I was furious. Not just because they keep screwing up my orders, but I'm on a lunch break and had to waste time returning to the restaurant to straighten out this mess. Avoid this Arby's location at all costs!

This is a great place. Not sure what everyone's complaining about.  To get a comfortable clean hotel room in the middle of a metropolis in any city much less Philadelphia for a rate of around $100 is amazing.  George the receptionist was super helpful and kind. He called us soon as we got to our room to see if everything was ok.  How nice!  And it was ok, lovely shower with good pressure, fridge, bottle water, microwave, this is a great place to stay.  Parking across the road for only $17 with validation from the hotel for 24 hours.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The only good things about this place are the cleanliness and the fact that the staff is pretty nice.  I got steak tacos and the steak was tasteless except the flavor of grease and it was obviously poor quality meat.  The only salsa they have is a chipotle salsa and not a regular tomato based salsa and it was not very good and the tortilla chips were stale.  I really wanted to like this place because there are basically no good Mexican restaurants on the south side.  Hopefully someone will take advantage of the awful Mexican restaurants on the south side and actually open a good one..

I was so excited about this place but both times I ate there it was just ok. One time I had their happy hour. The food was decent but the happy hour drinks were horrible. I seriously couldn't choke them down. We hadn't seen our waitress in quite a while so when I saw a manager I just asked if she could clear the drinks. I told her they were not great. I wasn't expecting her to comp them but that would have been the best customer service oriented action to take. Instead she snapped at me and said its happy hour so no drinks are comped. So needless to say, I haven't been back.

The all-you-can-eat deal was a wonderful treat.  Everything in relation to the meal was perfect, including our sashimi (not part of ayce) and edamame.  Items were quickly prepared and were absolutely beautiful.  

The only reason 4 instead of 5 stars was that we had to wait 14 minutes (yes, I timed it) to recieve our check.  Not normally a big deal for me except we did have a bit of a time crunch after lunch.  I finally had to rush the waitress to get our bill.  It wasn't her fault either as they seemed a bit under staffed on the main floor.  Overall it was a wondeful experience.

I find it ironic that YELP uses my uploaded photo of a sub-par pizza crust from Franco's as advertising for internet searches of this business (see...picture of my hand holding up two slices of pizza made with stale dough.)  Yet, my negative review associated with said picture is "not recommended" and thus is not displayed, nor factored in to any of the reviews presented.  Where is the so-called impartiality which YELP contends to maintain?  At the very least, stop using my photo if you will not recommend my review.

Only come here if you have plenty of time! The staff must be new and do not have a clue. A bagel and cream cheese order with no cream cheese and then asked for a bit more cream cheese turned into two new bagels and still no cream cheese. As I sit and eat my bagel with no cream cheese I watch the line build up to the door to the outside. Orders mixed up, orders repeated over and over again, people walking out and just overall people frustrated! 

Great location..... just hope they get someone in there who knows what to do or some training for those in there now. Won't be back any time soon. What a shame!

Don't come to this place, they put cash tax in their own packet not to the government and they gave people some else's food to others because the food is trash. I had ordered few times in this place the worst Chinese food I ever eat, general tso chicken not even spicy too sweet, the fried rice is disgusting, the broccoli with beef taste not authentic. We pay, we eat, we should get the food we deserve. There are so many take out restaurants nearby. Not just this one with bad food bad service and bad attitude.

I had read the other reviews and was glad to see they were accurate. I hadn't been to a laundromat in a long time, and I needed a large commercial washer and dryer.  This place has lots of different kinds of machines, as well food and drink, slots, tv.  In addition they have a very helpful attendant. 

My only complaint is that people who smoke go outside onto the front steps  to do so, and when the front doors open, all the smoke blows in on peoples' clean laundry! Maybe they can designate another outside area for smokers.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: So  So ....It is a shame how inconsistent Teresa's food has become lately.   As a long time regular I've seen a decline in the last two years ...    Several of our friends and family came along over the labor day weekend for lunch ...Server was great ... The food was cold.   beans and rice cold.   The chicken in the Chimi was cold.  I guess the focus on the expansion and the growth has taken them away from what the use to focus on ...Food quality and service.  Sadly they've becoming just another restaurant.   I will give a couple more tries,  but for what they served it is not worth the drive.

If I could give this place a negative 10 I would. They don't deserve any stars. Went on Sat night, made a reservation for 7pm. Waited an hour to be seated. I watched people that came in after us get seated. I ended up stopping the hosts and demanded a table. Then we got seated and NEVER GOT OUR FOOD. We ordered as soon as we sat down. Got one app. Then nothing. NOTHING!! A huge table of 8 were seated way after us and they got their food. We still had nothing. We got up and walked out. 2+ hours. No one ever apologized. No one tried to make it better. This place is a F&@$-ing joke!!!

First time here! For our 21st anniversary. Enjoyed the food and customer service. We will be returning. Try the Crab, asparagus, & cream cheese egg roll! But! I requested medium for my filet mignon and I got well done and they didn't care. They usually will not fix your order. They act like they don't have too but your supposed to pay for food that's not correct. And the steak tasted like liver. Myself and a customer sitting next to me I did not know said the same thing. We complained to our server who did nothing and did not care. $67 bill to not fix our problem!

WOW! I stopped here on a whim and I have to say I am glad I did. There were a ton of flavors that were so so good. I got peanut butter and strawberry/cheesecake and my friend got salted caramel and dark chocolate. 

I did think it was weird at first that you have to ask for samples but considering the amount Im sure people waste, it makes sense. The taste was great and they have a ton of toppings. I don't think I have ever been to a froyo place that had as many.
Chocolate rocks, every color sprinkles, many different sauces, and more.

Cant wait to go back!

I'm only giving this place 4 stars and not 5 because I got my slices to go. There was a great selection of a packed veggie slice, tomato, meat-lover, etc., and I enjoyed my pizza slices, but ultimately I'm dying to go back and order myself a pie made to order. Once I got the slices home they weren't as crispy and magnificent as they would have been if I got them made to order or even just ate them immediately at the restaurant. So I'll be changing this review next time I go back in and bring my own wine and enjoy the garlic bread, my own pie, and some cannoli.  

I can't wait to return. Good job, Giorgio!

I would give this place five stars straight up, because they have some AMAZING gyro. yum yum yum. I'd had an average burger and my boyfriend had a heavenly gyro (that I ate 3/4 of) and the gyro alone was enough to rocket this place into perfect status. It was FULL of lamb, tomatos, lettuce, and that tasty gyro sauce. we've pretty much promised ourselves that we'll go there more often to eat them.

the only reason I am giving it 4 stars is because the staff was not exactly friendly. But I wasn't looking for friendly service. We were just looking for a good, inexpensive meal. We got that at Olympia. hurrah!!

Folks I'm giving this 5 stars for what it is...not what it's not.
Good diner fresh diner food, clean restaurant, good service. Breakfast is fantastic and their breakfast specials are even better. They have a broad menu for lunch and dinner, with drink special and a bar. Burgers and sandwiches, soups are all good. When you are leaving for dinner and don't know what you want, you can find it here. Chicken Marsala is great and a fraction of the big fancy places.
  What it's not...It's not a fancy restaurant or expensive. Good food, good value.

Alfredo pizza with bacon and artichoke hearts was the pizza of choice here, paired with the porter on tap. Both of our choices were tasty enough, but quality was mediocre. Selection of beer variety was great. Overall, the meal was not fantastic, but we would try a different pizza and beer, if there is a next time (we were just driving through). It was nice to be in a relaxed and inviting atmosphere, as we had been in the car for two days, very hungry, and wanted quick service. These expectations were met, and our pup, whom we sat out on the spacious patio with, was treated sweetly by the staff and other patrons.

We will never return to this store.  We ordered a cake for my daughter's birthday party and they called 15 minutes before I was supposed to pick it up to tell me i would be 45 minutes late.  When we arrived the cake was poorly made.  The writing was very sloppy and the picture was blurry and peeling up from the cake.  I tried to contact the owner about this issue and she just responded with a very rude and unhelpful email blaming me for what happened.  I showed others the picture of the cake that they made for $70 and people were shocked at the quality.  I will never recommend anyone to this store!!

Just a bad experience overall.  The service was very slow and unattentive; it took 1.5 hours to get our food. The mixed drinks were small and expensive.  We couldn't get salt and pepper shakers for the table because they didn't have enough.  I had the Frutti de Mare and it had 3 musses and 1 shrimp in it, of which one of the mussles was not open...very sad representation of that dish. We found the restaurant owner and told her about our experience. She didn't say one word in response and just walked away. This is obviously an establishment that doesn't case about their  customers.

They advertise as the biscuit queen, but never have any of the ingredients they display for them. It's ridiculous to run out of peanut butter or bananas when the location is right next to TWO grocery stores. They also have a HUGE sign right when you walk in advertising for the "farmers daughter" breakfast bowl. I ordered and they said "we don't carry that at this location." I responded "but what about the sign". They responded "you should ask the owner about that." So I found that all very weird. 
Their drinks are good and always in stock. But they need to get their act together on the breakfast and customer service.

Favorite sushi place in Philly. Whenever I come to Philly to visit my girlfriend we get take-out. The summer roll is amazing, it's a veggie roll with mango on top. Only downside is how tiny it is inside. One time we decided to eat in and my girlfriend sat down and ordered while I parked the car...the 7 rolls of sushi were ready by the time I got there (literally 5 minutes). Aside from super fast service and fresh fish, reasonable prices is also a plus. Only reason 4 stars instead of 5 is for the salad and soup- nothing special.

I gave Wasabi a 3, but only because I couldn't give it a 3 and 1/2. It's not quite a 4, but not less than a 3. Unlike Thuy N. who gave Wasabi a horrible review, I am a former NOLA resident and not a California sushi snob. 

The fish is always fresh and prepared mostly in a traditional Japanese fashion. There are some really interesting special rolls, like the Money roll and the  French Quarter roll which are very good, but they are bit pricey.  The sashimi is usually pretty good as well. I try to avoid the place on Friday and Saturday nights because it can get quite busy before the shows on Frenchman St, but overall worth the trip.

I'm not a smoker so it was a disappoint right away. Once we sat down, we finally decided on margaritas. They were majority sours and minimal alcohol. I tried to drink it but after an hour I just pushed it toward the bar and intended to ask for a ginger ale. When I saw the bartender talk to the bar manager a meter away obviously about me- since I asked for a mojito before the margarita. Shortly after, the very kind bar manager asked about my drink and I told him my honest opinion. He offered a new drink or a refund and I declined both. I won't be back. Great dive bar for beer drinkers.

Excellent, uniquely prepared food with top-notch service. Everything was wonderful.  The menu is diverse and the chef prepares dishes in a delightful and unique way...so our dinner was far from ordinary. Not only was the food superb, but the service was also. Our waitress was knowledgeable, attentive, friendly, and efficient. However, the new shopping center really did Solstice (and the other businesses there) a major disservice with the parking lot. There are nowhere near enough parking spaces to serve the number of new stores they allowed. Cars are constantly cruising the lot looking for a spot.

Really disappointing dinner experience.  Air conditioning very weak, so we sweated through dinner.  Several of us ordered the Salmon entree salad which was said to include kalamata olive, oven-dried tomato, goat cheese, red potato.  It had a decent portion of salmon and lots of olives, but maybe two pieces of tomato, 4 small chunks of potato and ZERO goat cheese (on all 4 salads ordered).  They brought us a bowl of goat cheese to share and it was extremely gloppy.  It was way too hot inside to consider staying for desert, so we cut our losses and evacuated.

They recently renovated the gym. Big improvement. The only problem is they still keep the gym way too warm. Also, to make the problem worse during the renovation they removed all the fans over the open space . They have a few fans in the arobic area but don't keep them all on. Have mentioned the temperature issue many times to staff, they said they are told to keep the AC at 72 degrees. Sometimes it's warmer than 72. Very unhealthy  and uncomfortable to work out in the warm temp's. I hope someone will respond to this review.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The Brentwood Hilton is a great hotel. My husband and I thought this was the perfect place to have our wedding reception. They gave us a great deal on the price! We also got to stay in the executive suite free that night, it was so beautiful! Tara helped make everything absolutely beautiful when she didn't have to do all that she did! She truly cared and wanted our day to be stress free and perfect. Were so grateful for everything that was done to make our day special. This was almost 6 years ago lol but I did want to write a review on this awesome hotel. The hotel is also VERY clean and the food is great!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This restaurant's version of new American is good, not incredible.  There's somewhat of a lack of seasonality that hurts the food.  The asparagus quiche served with lamb shanks was a highlight.  The scallops with a heavy brown sauce were not.  The menu keeps it simple with a limited selection, and that's fine.  The wine list is reasonably priced with nice variety.  One issue with the red wine is that it is stored and served at too high a temperature.  Service was above average, and dining al fresco on the patio was a nice touch.  Would I go back?  Maybe...

Disappointing. They have a great menu, but perhaps too many things for them to cook well? Seafood lasagna sounds really good, but it was really bland and we only saw 2 little shrimp in it. Ordered a Chicken Alfredo pizza. Decent crust, but again, very bland and only one little piece of chicken on each slice. We also ordered garlic bread. What we got resembled a tiny pepperoni pizza. Very strange. Peanut butter pie was awesome!

Not sure if we will try it again. Maybe order a custom pizza? 

One more thing- the person who answered the phone sounded mad. Not a great first impression!

there were 8 discriminating palates on the table & every single one of us gave this restaurant a 4 or 4.5 star.  we came during the last night of restaurant week & had the last seating. considering it was the last day & last seating, i was prepared to get mediocre service, food & limited selection. but, no. i was pleasantly surprised & impressed of the food & service. i had the sweet corn soup to start with - simply delightful! then the bay scallops that melted in my mouth.  then the grand finale, goat cheese dessert encrusted with pistachio and fruit glaze. oh my gosh, the food was divine! and yes, they did not rush us out of our table.

Just moved into area and "found" this ice cream shop while driving around. They have 2 sides of the store, ice cream and yogurt and they have some indoor seating. The yogurt side had several machine for you to serve yourself, and add toppings before being weighed and you pay. We didn't have the yogurt this trip. The ice cream we had was fantastic. I had the Bart! (Vanilla with butterfingers in it) and my wife had Reeces pieces (vanilla with Reeces pieces and peanut butter chips.) Even though our ice cream was pretty basic, it was very good. We will be returning to sample more of their ice cream or yogurt.

Walked by the place many times and it didn't look inviting from the outside.   My wife and I decided to try it.   First time we ate in and learned the procedure.  Second time we ordered to go and talked to the owner for a while.  He's opinionated but it's definitely an interesting experience that I would recommend.  Place isn't super clean but he is from Japan and seems to know what he's doing.  He's no Jiro Ono.  But since Jiro charges $370 and this fellow charges $5.75 again, I'd recommend it.  BTW he told me he's been there since 1999.

It really wasn't as bad as I thought I would be.  I order the 3 roll lunch special with yellowtail scallion, tuna avo and salmon avo, along with an order of edamame and a spicy, crunchy salmon roll.  The lunch special was large, the edamame was perfectly salted and the special roll had a good amount of crunch.  I'm not a huge fan of spicy and the heat of the spicy roll was perfect for me, probably not as hot as other people would prefer.  This is not the best sushi I've ever had, but for a quick sushi lunch that delivers, I'd definitely recommend and certainly plan to order from them again.

The restaurant is beautiful, and the presentation is lovely, but for me, the actual food was just okay. Some dishes were bette than other, but for the price range, I have a high expectations, and I just didn't find t that special. I also found the servers a little pretentious, putting on airs. They had a very limited wine list, we ordered the least expensive wine, and it was just terrible. I would think a place like this would be very selective with their wine list, but I guess it. Overall, it was a fine evening, but there  are much better options in this price range.

Went with a group (8 people) and very glad we had reservations.  The place fills up fast but it's worth it.  They have a variety of wines!  The specialty La Nonna pizza was new to us and it was great  I had the Eggplant Parmigiana and there was enough food for three meals. I had the wedding soup and ate half of the parmigiana there.  I took home the other half and the side of pasta, so I got three meals out of my dining experience.  We have also had pizza delivered and that was good too.  Staff was helpful and courteous, restaurant clean and bright, overall experience worth it!

Not impressed, especially for the cost!!  Stayed in a king room. Didn't realize I needed to pay more for a "superior king" just to get a normal sized room. The king room was small to say the least. Looked nothing like pics on their website. Bathroom was clean but only had a TINY shower. Did have a nice tv & a little fridge. On checkin, woman made me dig through my luggage for my license since room was in my name even though my husband gave her his w his credit card. She was less then friendly. Vacuuming hallways right at checkin time. Bar was nice looking but small, didn't try food/drinks there.  Nicely decorated hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Went to a happy hour here last night. Drinks and food were good and we had a great time but as a warning, know how much your drinks cost before ordering from the bar. I ordered two martinis off the menu, each were $12 ( which i found out later) and when they came the bartender stated $26. I paid and the drinks were good but later when looking at the menu to order food, I noticed how much they should have cost. Of course I paid in cash, and the $2 wasn't worth the trouble to get back. Could have been an honest mistake, and I hope it was, but just some advice. Know how much your drinks are supposed to cost before getting them here.

The food was amazing.  We had a few appetizers and shared some mains and dessert.  Every course was delicious. We had beef skewers and chicken wings and the Wagyu Beef Skewers were the favored of those. We also had the sea bass which was delicious and the right amount for two.  The sauce with the fried potatoes was awesome. 

For dessert we something like a trifle and the semifreddo.  Both were good and a bit different from the usual. The only thing I wish was that it was a little less expensive so I could go all the time, but it's a fun special occasion spot and I'll definitely put it on my list of places to take people from out of town.

You simply must try this quant lovely restaurant!  My family and I enjoyed a wonderful meal that included appetizers of pork belly, corn chowder, oysters and gazpacho. Dinner at our table included crab cakes, braised short ribs, filet mignon, veal special of the day, and mussels. For desert we had, key lime pie and cheesecake. Everything was so delicious and well prepared!  The flavors was so good and complementary to each dish. The service was on point!  It is no doubt a local gold mine for excellent food and service!!

The owner is a thief, he insisted i need a new radiator since i only had 3 months max left on mine, ironically his sons car was missing a radiator, yes same model. Guess what 3 years later my radiator is still fine, he tries to take advantage of people who aren't experienced with automobiles, to bad for him i caught his lies.
Also he has a posse of young boys (son included) always hanging out in the shop you know the stereotypical night racing, loud exhaust having, backwards hat wearing, sagging their pants crew.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: A good mix of excellent food and fantastic margaritas!  Nice to be able to taste the tequila in the margarita.  Most other margaritas in the area taste like they only wave the tequila bottle over the glass instead of actually poor tequila in it.  The fajitas have very good flavor as we as the beans.  My wife had the enchiladas verde. She loved them to the last bite.  We used to live in Texas and finally we found good Mexican food with great margs.  Taco Flacco has good margs but the food is not the best.  Here you get both!steak fajitas

I love this place! There are few things better than finding a local restaurant with good service and better food. Their weekend bartender "Zombie" pours one helluva drink too! So here's the way to go:

Pizza: you can't go wrong with any of the brick oven pizzas, but I'm partial to the Belle Isle with it's spicy mustard sauce!

Burgers: They won best burger for a reason! 

Steaks: Their steaks are great, but by no means the best in the area. I would recommend coming in on Monday for the steak special to save a few bucks.

Come for the food, and stick around for the nice upscale bar environment.

Meh, average. About what you'd expect from a strip mall Mexican place in suburbs. The staff was friendly and provided good service and the prices are VERY low! They had great combination plate offerings all for less than $10. However, their menu warned that they charge extra for refills of chips. Keep that in mind!! I know places usually add that cost into the costs of products, but still when you're used to pretty much everywhere offering free refills with similar priced food it's surprising. Margaritas were ok. I wish I had ordered something different, to be honest, but that's on me.

This place has really gone downhill. Came with party of 6, was told the wait will be 20 minutes. Waited 50 min and finally got a table. When we sat at the table didn't get a waiter for 15 min and we all left not even a greeting from hostess. I called the manager after leaving and he apologized stating "it was very busy". Well I'm sorry, many restaurants are "busy" but they have to learn how to deal/cope with it instead of ignoring paying customers. I'll take my 20$ a person somewhere else more deserving

Side note. Brandon Koizi is more legit if it is closer to you.

This was a stop in my never-ending quest to find the perfect Oyako donburi at a local eatery.  This place definitely didn't fit the bill.  I ordered Oyako Ju; the sauce was pretty good, on the sweeter side, but the chicken was extremely tough and dry.  I might have rated this place lower, but a friend ordered a teriyaki/roll combo and liked it.

This place seems to have a community of regulars.  When we were there, the majority of patrons who came in (altho not together) knew each other as well as the waitress.

I really like their new chocolate cake donuts.  The texture is more like a tender chocolate cake than a donut, and they have a deep dark chocolate flavor.

One thing that can be improved is to keep their shelves more stocked with donuts, especially on days where they're open for most of the day.  If you visit on a Saturday around 11am-12pm, you'll find that they've run out of most donuts, and their next batch won't be ready until many hours later.  Also, it seems that sprinkles (IMO not the best topping) are not too popular and are always the last donuts left on the shelf.

Terrible, Service and Concern for Customer's Health. 
Couldn't give zero, but that being said, this review is not for product, which is always good. 
Ordered 5 raspberry filled donuts in store, 11.30am, Tuesday 4/21/20, and got 5 regular. Was in the box..
And more importantly
The woman behind the counter, wasn't wearing a mask, and when I mentioned it to her, she said "no, no mask" I said I would report you, and there was silence. Are you kidding me, my business is shut down because of Convid 19, and she is lucky to have a job to go to. Horrible, Absurd.

The reason I'm giving five stars is not because of the stellar food. It's dunkin. It's decent but the real story is this place just cannot get help. And they have just two guys behind the counter hustling to fill the orders in a drive through wrapped around the building. So all the weight of making this store work is on their shoulders. Strange days for sure but I'm glad these employees show up every day and do their best to make this work. Tip them please. They are hustling to take care of you as fast as they can.

I have read ahead and truly think someone is on here to put a wonderful restaurant down.  I have gone here since they were opened in Berwyn.  the service is fantastic and if it isn't the server is gone.!  the food is excellent - nothing is dry and everything is prepared fresh - if you are looking for spagetti and white clams done the right way - come here - the clams are in the shells, it is a healthy sauce. The atmosphere is wonderful and it is always, always packed.  I have never gone in there later in week and not have to wait - it is best to make reservations!   Trust me you would never be dissapointed.

In my continuing quest to expand my culinary horizons, I decided to give Las Margaritas a shot with a to go order. After parting with my ten dollars I was greeted by a large ground beef chimi covered in melted cheese. The crust was a bit chewier than I would have liked, but the beef itself was decent. It's worth noting that I got all that and a bag of chips. Since it's so close to my work I'll likely sample more from the menu*, but I've had better on my recent Mexican food tour.

*I've never since been tempted to go back.

I have been going to Dr. Warren for many years, and my opinion of him is very high.
My 20 year old cat had a seizure on a Sunday, and I was very scared.  I left a message for
Dr. Warren, and he called back right away.  He was in the office (on Sunday) and said to
bring her right over!  He said she had a stroke......after a few emotional days, I had her put
to sleep, with Dr.Warren there.
My new shelter cat has been cared for by him for two years, and again he is wonderful
with her.  I'm sure she'll live to 20 also, with his good care.
The office techs are friendly and kind.
I am purring!

Went here for the first time with a friend. This is one of her favorite places. The food was delicious. Bacon wrapped scallops were shared as an appetizer. Arugula salad was beautiful and my friends favorite. For entree's I had eggplant parmigiana and she had a penne pasta with fresh mozzarella, eggplant, etc. Very yummy. Too full for dessert. But they looked really good at another table. Parking may be a problem since it's on the street only ( both sides). So if you love Italian food then this is worth the trip.

7 months since we moved out and still waiting for the money related to the security deposit....! They took money out of my deposit by "mistake". We complained about it. They agreed to send it to my new address in California but the check never arrives....We have been following up every month and they seem not to get that check out of the door! Unbelievable!

We had to live in an apartment with a leak on the kitchen ceiling for more than 6 months plus the termites and now is the time investment and follow up with a different building manager to make sure they assume the responsibility of sending a check!

Came here Saturday 9Sep17 when I was craving some soft serve before dinner. When I got inside, I was really impressed by the overall feel of the shop with its sleek, modern look and a lot of white in the decor. When you first walk in, you're greeted by really enthusiastic staff asking what flavor you want (I got the taro and my friend got charcoal vanilla), what type of cone you'd like (chocolate, vanilla, or cinnamon), and what toppings (unlimited, can you believe it?). They have a wide variety of flavors that I hope they will be able to expand. I will definitely be back to try more.

Their smoothies and hot chocolate were quite delicious. If you're going to run in and out to grab a quick snack, I would recommend it. 

However. The bathroom was shocking. It smelled like a biker bar urinal, the walls and dispensers were covered in graffiti/tagging and the floor/tile grout was layered in either black mold or some kind of sludge. Unfortunately, it was a potty emergency and I had to go. When I went to wash up there was no soap. *gasp*. 

Uggghhhh. Never again. Their hot chocolate isn't worth possible contamination of some kind of infectious disease.

I live in the neighborhood and genuinely want new businesses to succeed ........so I feel sad to give this new business only one star. These are the reasons for one star:
--way overpriced for what you get
-staff was NOT friendly, welcoming or engaging in the least
-ice cream flavors weren't anything special and didn't taste extra special especially for one scoop at $4!
-it's cramped 
-the controller box for cute video games aren't mounted on the counter so you can't play without leaning or holding down the whole thing.

I really wanted to like this place. The servers were so kind and attentive, but the food was just "okay"...although the sushi is a death wish. I'm giving two stars for service and the steamed dumpling things. I'm giving zero stars for sushi. 
I don't know if it's just me, but I need my sushi cold. This sushi was almost warmer than room temp. My body could be playing tricks on me because I ate warmish sushi and my mind is going a little crazy about it, but I am currently sitting on my toilet while I write this. 
It could be ebola that has me crapping my brains out but I'm going to venture that it was bad sushi. Send help.

This was our second stay at this Drury .... First time it was over run with kids sports teams and this time was no different. Unfortunately if the parents and coaches don't keep it under control there is no security to help out either.
Breakfasts the next morning is also an event.... Get ready to compete with the kids and housekeeping ! 
Thankfully there is a cracker barrel across the parking lot.  
If your a sports enthusiast and feel like competing for sleep and breakfast .... This place is for you ! 
Otherwise do yourself a favor and go down a few exits and get a room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Alright been to this place 3 or 4 times, time for a review.  I wasn't blown away first time out, but the food was good. Each time since it's been better every time. Osso Bucco, delicious.  Chicken Marsala was unique and fantastic.  Not just run of the mill, rich flavors and the addition of sun dried tomatoes adds depth.  If you like cream of mushroom, try the mushroom soup with brie.  Trust me, it's amazing.  Dip the bread/crostini and enjoy with a good byob red. I've also had the rigatoni with meat sauce and eggplant parm, all very good.   Love byob's, love the little center of town vibe, love this joint.  Definitely recommend.

I just read more customer's reviews on the Pytania Park Hotel TripAdvisor.com account. 
 
http://www.tripadvisor.com/Hotel_Review-g60864-d89119-Reviews-Prytania_Park-New_Orleans_Louisiana.html#REVIEWS.

It is pretty sad and hilarious. The owner/manager keeps arguing with all of the clients' after they review. She insinuates that they are liars or that they didn't actually have a terrible experience. Why would someone take the time to write a bad review if they weren't disgusted by their stay?
This place is a joke. A very very dirty, moldy, expensive joke!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If you want a good mani/pedi without paying for a salon's decor, come here.  It's nothing special inside, but Jessica did a great job on me.  She's very thorough and takes her time.  I've only been here once(today), but if all of the workers work like her, then you won't be disappointed.  They don't really talk to their clients, but I prefer it that way as I view nail time as a relaxing experience.  I paid $28 for a mani/pedi combo and the callus remover is included.  Not too shabby!  I'll def be a repeat customer here.

First time there, on a Sunday afternoon. The calamari was nicely prepared, tasty, but the chewiest platter I have ever had. I asked for the fettucini alfredo with chicken instead of shrimp. It was very delicious. Parner got the Cardinale chicken with blush sauce. No blush sauce was provided, it was basically tasteless. We sat outside on the patio which was pleasant, as our table had an umbrella. Inside seemed like it might be noisy. Server was excellent, and checked on us often. Odd that the wine glasses that they gave us were chipped in several places at the base of the stem. The salad dressing tasted straight from a jar.

First time there and last! The place is disgusting. Pedicure tubs are nasty! gunked up with God knows what under the pad where you place your feet to be done and the chair was extremely worn looking and tray that holds a cup or your things was filthy. I know they are moving so I hope they are upgrading for their own sake but I will never go there again, this experience showed they don't clean their pedi chairs. The gal that did my pedicure did her best to clean it up and she did a great job on my pedicure unfortunately sanitation and cleanliness is NOT a priority here. Actually surprised they are allowed to operate this way. Unbelievable!

Read some reviews before coming here and I'm a little confused. "On par with Wild Ginger?" You have to be kidding me. Not in any way close to Wild Ginger. Maybe a little cheaper, but fish had an off taste. Not something I want from a place that serves raw fish. Tiny pieces with an off flavor? Not for me.  I won't be back. I've had Peter's and it is pretty good, and I've been to Sushi o Sushi across the street from this place and it's pretty good, but seriously Wild Ginger is the best place I've found. The bartenders are great and the food has never been anything but perfectly fresh.

We tried it because it was new. It is not the restaurant that it used to be. The Mexican food was bland and very little taste. I had the fajitas and there was no taste to the meat. My has been had one of the combinations and he couldn't even finish his plate. He said the food just tasted really bad. There's been some changes to the inside of the restaurant but they should've concentrated on the taste of the food. It was hard to get refills for the drinks and it just was really unpleasant dining experience. Very disappointed. Was looking forward to having some new choices in Mexican food in Smyrna.

Food was decent. Environment was nice. 

3 stars because:

had to wait 40 min for 4 rolls (3 specialty 1 regular)

Hostess was rude

Server was very nice 

Treasure roll (specialty roll) claimed to have mangos and mango sauce. Unfortunately when I ate it. The mangos  tasted like the mango jello I used to eat when I was a kid not a real mango. Paying close to $15 I would expect real mango.

Philadelphia roll was good 

Godzilla roll was good too

Overall I would go again, hopefully they won't make us wait and def won't get the treasure roll.

Pizza itself is good.
    The problem here is the service at this specific location.  If you order delivery you are lucky to get it in 2 hours.  Once had the delivery driver actually show up after THREE hours.   The place is 5 blocks away.  My fat butt should have walked there,  but really 3 hours to make and drive a pizza 5 blocks?
  
Once mentioned the length of the wait after calling in to find out if they even got my order and got nothing but lip from the person on the phone.  Asked for a manager and was blown off, and hung up on.  Immediately called back and the wuss didn't answer the phone.  Cancelled my order.

Been going for the Chambersburg pizza, which is a fair replica, for a few years, but tonight I was very disappointed in the Caesar salad. Asked for salad for the table (4) of us. We each got a very small salad plate portion... To the tune of $25. Not  to mention it lacked flavor, had to add more cheese. The salad was more money than our pizza! Then when I questioned the owner, she was going to check with her husband and never came back! I work too hard for money to be ripped off. Won't be back anytime soon :(

This was our third visit.  The first two visits the food and service was generally very good.  The one consistent item for all three visits was a very slow kitchen.  On each occasion our food took 30 or more minutes.  The first two times was during decent volume but today (Saturday) we arrived shortly after they opened and the kitchen still struggled to execute.  Even more disappointing was that my Buffalo Chicken sandwich was borderline cold.  If the kitchen doesn't get its act together Edgewild will become just another ho-hum restaurant in Edwardsville.

This was my first time here on a Tuesday night.  We had a reservation for three. Upon walking in, I was impressed with the decor and atmosphere. It seems like reservations are necessary, unless you don't mind eating at the bar, which many people were doing. 

The olives and white bean hummus were both very good. There was one only one salad on the menu which we split 3 ways. It was good size, and delicious.  We had the Pork Chop and Chicken breast entrees. Both were excellent and cooked perfectly. Next time I'd like to try some dessert. 

This is a great addition to DeMun, Ave.

Be very careful with this shop, they are lairs. You will end up cost a lot more than you think it should be, so you still want to go? They don't tell you how much it will cost initially, if you ask, they will always say they want to take a look or they will give your a quote then regret. But once you bring your car there, they will charge your big money until they finish and until they think you pay enough. Yes, please go there if you want to pay a lot more than others. You need to be careful, you want to find a store with good reputation and no cheat, right?
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I wanted to reach out their for those who need a review and let you know the Service and the Food were great. The only reason I did not give it a 5 star was because I asked for my steak medium well and it came rare. I was hungry so started eating a bit of it and then became full on all the other food we ordered. What impressed me is the server (Megan) came back about 15 minutes later and she "Oh know you ordered a medium well" and took it back as well as did not charge me. I just loved that although it was busy she knew my steak was not right without me having to say something. Megan you are terrific.

My brother and I were excited to try this place for the first time for lunch today.  Got there at 10:50 (open at 11:00) and no sign of anyone around.  Finally at 11:00, someone came rushing in the side door and opened the front door.  Was not impressed when entering.  Musty smelling and not very clean.  My brother and I both ordered the luncheon cannelloni and side salad.  Side salad was great.  Cannelloni was ok, but I've tasted better.  When they brought it out, it appeared to be steaming, but upon cutting it, it was just lukewarm and the noodles were a little undercooked.  They need to clean the place up before I go back.

Outstanding value! Ordered the combination teriyaki dinner: edamame, miso soup, salad, rice, sautéed veg, teriyaki, 4 pieces nigiri (maguro, sake, hamachi, ebi), and 5 pieces sashimi (2 hamachi, 3 sake @ approx 4 oz. total), finished with strawberry ice cream = $18. Fast, fresh/firm fish, and decent quality (dined last week at high-end restaurant in LA's Little Tokyo @ 3x price). Based on single visit, very impressed. That said, don't expect much ambiance beyond an inexpensive family-run (it would seem) restaurant on Speedway. I'll be back.

Don't go to this location if you're in a hurry. We ordered a pizza and a turkey and salami footlong. It took over thirty minutes to find a pizza, know the difference between pepperoni and salami, figure out how to cook the pizza, and work the register while calling another person on her phone to help with each thing. Another employee came in as we were still waiting for her to ring up the order. Thank goodness for the other employee!  She rang it all up in less than a minute and out the door we went to never come back!  Never will we stop at this location again.

Went there for dinner last night as I had heard from friends this restaurant had opened.  I understand it has only opened for a couple of months.  I was very pleasantly surprised. I had the feature salad which had very fresh greens, dried cranberries, squash and green beans. Was not too sure of the combination but it really went well.  Also had the shrimp and scallop pasta dish which also tasted very fresh and well seasoned.  I have heard the pizzas are good and they did based on looking at and asking other diners.  The service was very attentive. They also have an outside seating area.

Went for dinner on a Saturday night. Hostess stood behind the desk and stared at me as I said dinner for 2. Instead of walking around the desk to greet and seat us she hollers 'what?' I had to approach the desk and say 'dinner for two'. Ordered margarita and they tasted horrible! They were an odd color and so strong they were terrible!!
Orders chiles relleno's,  rice and beans. The chiles relleno's were floating in grease...tasted like grease, the worst I've ever had. The rice and beans were cold. Service was terrible. Had to go and get our waitress so we could get our ticket. Bad food, drink and service. Will not be going back.

We were given a rental through the insurance co. due to  our truck being in the shop.  The truck we were given was fine on the outside, the inside however was stained and dirty.  We were given the vehicle with 1/4 tank of fuel, no windshield wiper fluid (in the winter), and a notice that the oil change was due.  Had we gotten this vehicle for a trip, I would have been extremely disgruntled.  I was told there was nothing they could do about the stained upholstery (clean it maybe?).  It made me really not want to sit in the vehicle at all.  They were nice enough, but service and maintenance of there vehicles is definitely lacking.

My husband and I love this restaurant. Great for sushi lovers.

The huge Kenny roll, Godzilla roll and lobster roll are some of our favorites. 

The staff is very nice and will heat the sake you bring free of charge in a Sake bottle with Sake cup. We have been going there frequently. The prices are reasonable and the quality of the ingredients are excellent and very fresh. 

Hibachi grill is available as well.

Our friends have been going in there for years as well. 

There are two adjacent parking lots in the back.

Seems to take a long time for order to be ready. And if I'm drinking coffee in the establishment and ask for it in a glass, it never happens.    The communication isn't there.   I prefer Starbucks, but came in to meet a friend.   It's just weird I never get a glass when I ask for one.  (?). Slow service, and untrained staff.   Kind of a bummer.


8/21/18..ordered a chai tea latte
What I got  was a hot tea with whipped cream.   It wasn't good.  Wanted a latte with milk, chai etc.  employees seemed slow and clueless.  Not my usual stop, but meeting a friend.   Nope, not ever again.  Untrained and slow.  I'll stick with Starbucks.

My rating is for the lack of forewarning about the parking bill. $32 dollars for parking makes their rate less competitive with the other options would could have gone with, and to me the fee doesn't make sense for the locations. In my opinion, the rooms were pretty nice. The toilet and the shower were in the separate sections and the mattress was very soft and comfortable. Housekeeping woke us up at 10am. We had the king suite and the tv wasn't visible from the bed or the couches...super awkward and weird spot.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Um.  Where to start.  When you arrive, there's no where to stand while you wait for your table.  House wine grim- both red and white.  Home made chips are greasy but good. Trout was tasteless. Risotto incredibly heavy witn cheese. Didn't see any of the advertised shrimp in it.   haricot beans oily. Duck appetizer ok, nothing great.  Coffee average.  The apple  cobbler wash like thick whipped cream in a jar with sone chunks of apple on top.  It Kraft a bad aftertaste.  As did the whole meal. The staff was very nice, which is why a two.

Went here for lunch because we were in the mood for Mexican food. Host seated us promptly. The place is cozy with the tables fairly close to each other. We started out with the chips and salsa which were a great start. I had the carnitas tacos and thought they were great. My friend had the enchilada verde with shrimp and rated it 3.5 stars. The coffee was better than most restaurants. Service was a bit on the slow side. I would have tried the tres Leches cake but we were not offered to see dessert menus. They were good enough to warrant another try in the future.

I've come back to Antonio's after 3 years or so.. I ordered a gordita and a torta, and waited close to half an hour for my food.. All tasted good and it filled me up.. But the place was a little dirtier as I walked around on my way to the restroom . I know the owners work hard and probably everyday.. The outside dining was basically empty and on a rare 80 degree day on the Thursday before Easter in the late afternoon,  I didn't expect to wait so long.. There are several Latino restaurants in town now, many my favorites,  but this restaurant doesn't happen to be one of them anymore.. So sorry.....

Would love to give this place 5+ stars if I could, BUT there's one ongoing problem with this place. THEY'RE NEVER OPEN!!! I've only gotten a chance to eat here once, and it was amazing, and I'd love to go again because it was great food and great service. The last straw though, was being closed AGAIN, and this time at 5:45 PM on a Saturday?!? Mind you, this was only a week after they were closed for a entire week. We have since taken our business to another restaurant that's farther, but is open regularly. Not the same, but it'll do I guess. 

Would love to give them our loyalty, but tired of guessing at when they'll be open next. #frustrated

First impression - the place reminded me of a cozy dining room at someone's house.  When we walked in, we were greeted by a very friendly hostess. The place wasn't busy due to the weather, we got to pick a table.  We ordered the restaurant week meal and they were good. The first course was fish but it was very salty for my taste. The main course was a pork dish and it was delicious.  I wasn't a big fanboy the mashed chick peas. The desert was some sort of blue berry pie but the crush was a bit over baked and tasted burned a little. The service was top notch and place felt warm and cozy.

We came here for dinner the day after Christmas. The experience is just average. The food was average. The service was below average. It did not seem to be a busy night for them, since there were only 3 tables with guests. The waiting time was definitely longer than it should be. There seemed to be a lot of take out orders. They probably focused more on the take-out orders and let people dining in wait.... it just does not seem right to me.

We will probably be looking for other sushi restaurants in he future.

It was time for a Saturday afternoon date with my beloved and we chose Speranza. It is a really nice restaurant, nicely decorated, clean, with a classy feel. Jake, our waiter, did a great job. He welcomed us, told us about the mouth-watering specials and he was attentive. The food was delicious. Crab meatballs with cappellini was a tasty appetizer. The dipping sauce had a nice little kick. The bianco pizza was a white pizza lover's dream. Super thin crust and bursting with flavor. The crab pannino with truffled parmesan fries was outstanding. Unfortunately, we were too full for dessert. Maybe next time...

Guess I am not eating at same restaurant as other reviewers. Have eaten here three times and had three different things. Spaghetti and meatballs are just ok. Needs more sauce. Very dry. Salads are average. Pizza was not what I expected. Ordered the Margarita pizza. It should have beautiful sliced tomatoes and pieces of Mozzarella with twigs of basil. My pizza had no sliced tomatoes. It had cheese sprinkled on it and leaves of basil shriveled up.  So sad. You would think they could fix a basic Margarita pizza. Don't have to go back again

I am new to rolls so I might not be the best reviewer. They are not claiming to be 'worlds best sushi' but the lunch time special is hard to beat. It has never been sub-par but it could be better. The rolls are on the small side and the wasabi can sometimes be bland or burning hot.

I wish yelp had a 3.5 star because I would like to give more points but it isnt the best. but hey! in south philly, good sushi isnt all over unlike pizza/steak joints. I have also never tried the real 'sushi' they offer. Next time ill try them and maybe update my review.

Upon coming back to this place being newly built tells me the company needs new direction already, the sandwich Ioredered was the new Chicken crisp bacon,cheese, lettuce and tomatoes, it looks thick in juicy on TV Only nothing like what was given to me and the time waiting was far beyond usual peak hours, lot of talking among the management and not enough work ethic is here the bacon was a crumbled little pieces as well this, place NEEDS help now before there's nothing left..Buying popyes chain isn't going to help this chain it's going down like MC Donald's... Lousy low paid workers with no emphasis on customer satisfaction

WORST McDonalds location ever!  They consistently mix up the order, went in there one time and they were out of smoothies, another time the play place was closed for NO reason, and now they give me a salad with no croutons, no tomatoes, fatty chicken.  Once again I have wasted my money.  I eat there sparingly (wouldn't at all if it wasn't next to my job).

Sure, the fries are good.  But aren't they supposed to be?  I would never give a 5 star rating somewhere because they serve what they are supposed to and other locations do just as good if not better.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
The price was decent.  Two of us ate for under $25.  But the buffet was small and a lot of the items didn't taste fresh or recently made.  We went around dinner time on a week day and there were several other tables that were occupied.  Some items labeled, others were not.  Sushi tasted old, ice cream had a funny taste, and other items just didn't seem like they were cooked right whether it was crusty from sitting out to long or under cooked. 

Glad we checked if off the list of places to try in the area, but we won't be back.  Decor outdated, tables outdated, and the music almost put us to sleep.

One of the very few places on Bourbon that I'm comfortable recommending, and that's only because it's also one of the few places that consistently features cajun and zydeco music. That being the case, this (or Funky Pirate) is usually where I get my Hand Grenade fix. I like the Tropical Isle chain, but I the music at the other spots is a gamble. Sometimes it's great, sometimes it's just a band playing Lynyrd Skynyrd and the like (which isn't what I come to New Orleans to hear). That's where the Bayou Club (and the Funky Pirate, for that matter) rise above the chain's namesake.

Great place to go for lunch. Lots of options up front and their lunch specials are great and change frequently. Much nicer restaurant to eat inside than your typical pizza place. My only complaint in the frequent bait and switch. There will be a fresh pizza up front, but when you order, you see that you're actually getting a slice from a much older previously cooked pizza behind the counter. Sometimes you must toss stale food in this business. Cicontes however does not do this. Other than that, highly recommend!

Since it was 8pm on the weekend, our regular vet in Bloomington was closed.  We rushed to IndyVet when our cat suddenly lost control of his hind legs.  Dr. Smith and his team were very quick to respond.  

The vet hospital functioned like a well-oiled machine during the current coronavirus quarantine/social distancing.  Sadly there was no treatment possible, and we had to euthanize our beloved family member.  But during the entire process Dr. Smith was very understanding, and he patiently answered all of our questions.  It was very comforting to know they cared for our animal as much as we did.

This is my usual nail salon but after this time I will not be back. I got a full set and they came out terrible. Two nails are really short and the rest are long and completely uneven. She was very ruff and cut my fingers up. The lady was so rude, she keep saying "you need your eyebrows waxed bad" like that is so rude and an insult. Wasn't to happy about that. On top of all this she keep pressuring me to pay. Usually you pay after your completely done and your nails are dry but she made me pay before she even painted my nails. Never going back again. Waste of $30 take your money and go to a better salon.

Cute place, nicely varied menu. But I can't believe they won best chicken as that was what we ordered. I got white meant and she got dark. The thigh she got was really greasy with grease running out when she pulled the skin off. Neither of us cared for the seasoning used in the batter -- some kind of spice. The lunch special was $7.95 and only comes with fries & apparently not even a slice of bread. We're from St. Louis and wouldn't drive back over there for chicken again  when we can get better closer to home.

This being one of the first pubs to open up after power was restored post-Katrina, i have to give Touche props. Hence one more star than is probably necessary. Donna was a source of a particular brand of local humour back when we all needed it. As well as her co-worker Mike.  
    Fast forward nearly 10 years - i only come to this bar but twice a year at best - and she's the same 'ol gal!  Donna doesn't seem to age, either.  Hmmmm....
    Smokier than god up in here, but that will change in a few months.  Prices are okay...and the people- watching out on Royal is even better.

It pains me to have to write this.  We ordered a 14" four cheese pizza, well done and some Zeppole bites.  It is not our first visit here, in fact we USED to eat here very often. Tonight was a deal changer!!  Absolutely the worst pizza and zeppole bites to date, from any place.  The pizza was so greasy I would not even feed it to my dogs.  We have had this pizza many times, never again!!  For almost $30 dollars I wanted to drive back and put it on display for everyone to see but you were closed.  You lost good customers tonight.  Oh, and thanks for ruining my birthday dinner!!

Krispy Kreme? More like Lazy Kreme. I would love to tell you how the donuts were, but the workers blocked the entrance to the store with their truck so they could close early. I drove from the Garden District and arrived at 7:45 pm on a Wednesday night to get donuts for the next morning. However, I was unsuccessful due to closing the store before the office closing hours. Don't know what I was thinking checking online to see the hours and assuming they would actually be open 20 minutes to closing. Good thing I didn't order with the app because I don't know how I would have gotten my donuts. Poor management.

I absolutely love this place.

But after tonight I just have to give a bad review.

Walked in, said hello to the owner and talked about how slow/empty it was tonight.
