Sat at the bar, placed our orders and then just sat, and sat, and sat.

Took about 40 minutes to get one salad.  They brought out one of the appetizers (ordered as an entree) with the salad.  When we went over the hour mark for the entree I asked about it and was told that it was just "dropped" a few minutes before.

Will I go back.  Yes.  I really do like it.  Sometimes the restaurant needs to be reminded that good service and returning customers is their life blood!

Looks to be under new management.  Small place.  When our family walked in there was table at front with what looked to be teenage friends of the person working behind the counter. It was rather loud. So guessing this is becoming a hangout of sorts?  But your experience may differ.  Either way, service was just ok, and seating was awkward as they have a long counter so you can't really enjoy chatting that easily.  Pricing was on the high side relative to portion size for me.  Wish I could have given more stars.

This place is amazing! The staff is super friendly and nice. We came for lunch with our three month old and had a wonderful meal. We had the emerald stone appetizer with spicy tuna which was incredible. We also loved the dumpling soup, we will definitely order dumplings next time as it was so flavorful. We had a mix of sushi rolls, all great, but our favorite was the three musketeers. The bento boxes come with plenty of food and I love that you can substitute the roll. Although we don't live in the area anymore, we will definitely come out here again just for the sushi.

First time at Felicia's, I had the margherita pizza. I like to start with a basic pie, as it tells you allot about the dough and the ingredients. Upon entering, owner greeted me, and well, he's awesome! You can tell immediately a few things, he's hardworking, and super passionate about what he's doing.
Dough was great, nice crisp, and lots of flavor. The buffalo mozzarella was perfect, and just enough herbs. 
I'll be back, as it's not your ordinary pizza joint, it's real brick oven, that's wood fired. 
Yum! A real hidden gem!!

I have no clue how this place has 4 stars. We went here because of the high reviews on Yelp and had a really awful experience. First I had a chicken quesadilla with rice and beans. The chicken was a greasy disaster and I'm pretty sure the rice and beans were cooked weeks ago. Very overcooked to the point of burnt. We also had a medium Margarita (12$ mind you) and it tasted like sour mix. I am pretty sure there is no tequila in their margaritas because it's neon green in color. I ADVISE YOU TO GO ELSEWHERE...$53.00 WASTED MEAL....

The experience at Rent Max was phenomenal,great customer service, wonderful establishment, very very friendly.I had my three boys with me  and they were all over the place, instead of Steve the owner saying anything about it they were enter acting with them and it made me fill so calm like he understood there language it was such a relief.And the lady next to him was like a in house baby sitter she was very helpful with the boys not aggressive at all they even gave me a ride after I dropped the car off and the driver was phenomenal as well I give them all 100% stars thank you for the experience with Rent Max.

Came to Zama on a Friday afternoon for lunch. The decor was nice...light bamboo looking wood and very clean. Got two different rolls and both were very fresh. The cucumber was crunchy;that doesn't happen often. The flavor of the sushi was good. Not the best but decent. It should be better for what they charge at the dinner prices. A glass of sparkling wine was $10. Overall, it was good but the prices at lunch were about the same as Fuji Mountain regular prices and Fuji Mountain is better. If you're looking for an upscale environment then this is for you. Otherwise, save your cash.

Although the location is great, this hotel is lacking in amenities and comfort. While staying there for three nights, the fire alarm went off two out of the three nights due to fires starting in the suites. We were evacuated both times in the middle of the night. There is no restaurant and the breakfast is mediocre. The 24 hour pantry where you could buy snacks was completely out of alcohol the entire weekend, which was disappointing since there were torrential down pours. My bathroom sink area had tiny ants crawling around. When heading to New Orleans, stay away from the Staybridge Suites!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This is strip mall country.  Pretty much captive unless you want to start walking 1/2 mile or more.  Rooms OK.  But the breakfast buffet was minimal.  Sure, Starbucks in the hotel opens at 5:30 but their baked goods aren't ready till 6:00 or maybe later.

Had to come here for a conference.  But for lunch, they didn't even offer their full menu, only a set buffet.  Having experienced their lackluster overcharged breakfast, I had enough time to order GrubHub, which I did.

I wouldn't come here again unless the conference organizer was crazy enough to book this hotel
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Loyalty program?? What a joke. My husband has spent hundreds of dollars at Cheers. Recently told him they didn't have several bourbons, then proceeded to ask "do you shop with us"? She then pulled his "file" and claimed we hadn't shopped there in 8 months: they hadn't logged any of the recent purchases we've made. The lady was beyond rude. We walked away and she goes over to another coworker and started laughing while looking at us. What kind of customer service is that?  Locally owned business that doesn't treat locals with respect.

Friendly staff and drive-thru service is great. The issue I have is the interior is never very clean. We won't dine in anymore. Everything is grimy and sticky. It looks and feels like a dirty rag was used to clean the tables -that is if you can even find a table that was recently "cleaned." You can see streaking all over the "cleaned" ones. This place needs a serious deep cleaning/steam cleaning and not the typical half-ass job of a kid who doesn't care. We see the same sticky stains from last week. I'm amazed that the manager or owner doesn't really examine how bad it's getting. Ick!!!

Stayed one night. 

Pros - great location, decent size room with great views, decent price. 

Cons - comforter had human fluid and some scattered hairs on it when we checked in and it took 2 hours and 2 calls for someone to come change it. 

PARKING IS A DISASTER. They don't offer valet or parking on-site. You have to park on 16th or 17th street in the most confusing garages ever. You then have to walk with your luggage to the hotel. They offer 35% off the parking garage rate (if you find the right garage to park in). 

Overall, the location is great but based on the parking I would never stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The 3 stars is for the freshness of yellowtail and spot on flavoring of the rice!  However, the huge problem is the nigiri fish to rice ratio. It really isn't sushi, as sushi is meant to be enjoyed. I get it though, probably shouldn't be AYCE sushi to begin with. Essentially if you enjoy nigiri, you will not enjoy the ratio of huge mounds of rice with thinner than usual slices. I can't speak to the rolls because I normally don't order those when paying for AYCE.  That said, I won't be returning, but at least I gave it a try.

I'm not quite sure why this is listed online as the #3 best place to eat in Tucson. The view is gorgeous, but I couldn't see it from where I was sitting. I scanned the restaurant and was easily the youngest one there at 19 years old, even most of the waiters are older. I got the filet mignon, but the best food I ate tonight was the bread you get at the beginning with garlic pesto sauce. Maybe if I was older and could appreciate a quiet, sophisticated dining experience with classical music playing then I would rate it more stars. I don't plan on returning here though

The manager knows his thing, I have never written a 2nd review before. Meineke on germantown pike is way better than pep boys on germantown pike. He has a smaller operation so he can't always squeeze you last minute in but he tries, schedule an appointment if u can. He's honest and doesn't try to over sell you. He has earned my business for years to come. I even sat there today with a young couple who was quoted like 1 thousand dollars at pep boys and I think i overheard 355 at meineke and they were ecstatic
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We wen't here 11/13 for my birthday dinner and it was one of the best places I have ever eaten! The decor and ambiance of this place is outstanding. The service was exceptional along with our drinks and food. We ordered tapas to begin with and then our table of 8 also ordered individual entrees. The entire table was raving about how great the food was and to top it off the desert was phenomenal. The Chile con Carne dough God is amazing along with the Prickly Pear Ribs. I can't say a single bad thing and will absolutely be back!

Tonight my friend and I tried QQ Revolving for the first time. We were sat quickly but after that our server was not very attentive. We consistently had to call Chen over for an order, wasabi, and drinks. The sushi however was delicious and I loved how the sushi came in smaller portions so we were able to try several different roles. Another server named Brielle (spelling??) stopped by several times to refill drinks, ask if we needed anything else and quickly delivered our check which made up for being ignored earlier on in the meal. 
We will be back :)

The only 5 Star Dive Bar in Indy, The Fat Cat, formally at 38th Street & Lafayette Road, on Indy's west side has relocated to 30th Street & Lafayette Road (formally Bud's Tavern). It has greatly improved that location.

I've stopped in several times for lunch and a few beers. The food is good, the beer is cold, and the prices are very good. The patrons are friendly and interesting too. Lesley, the day bartender, is an incredible host and runs a good bar. 

If you like a laid-back, neighborhood, dive bar, then this is the place for you.

Let me be clear here.. The first time we came it was AWESOME. Our server was amazing and the food was great..

So, we returned and it was an awful experience. The waitress we had was anything but good. All she cared about was eating up at the bar . We never got our plates cleared, they ran out of bud light and never offered anything else. The food was very old and bland. And the worst part, they close at 9 and they started telling people they were closed due to running out of food at 7:30. The entire staff was at the bar eating by 8. 

This sucks because it was our favorite place for Mexican food. And now we will never return.

It's a great local place where who you are and what you do for a living doesn't matter. You're there and that's all that matters. Est. 1732... so friendly debates on politics, including revolution and tyranny, practically echo in the bar. Nice selection of drafts (not hundreds - just a good selection), food is very good - take advantage of the specials board. Takeout beer open 364 days. If you're looking for local character without arrogance - this is your place. Looking for arrogance - go to New Hope - you won't be missed.

Returned two burnt crust Farmhouse Pizzas. The difference between the two burned and the two it took twenty minutes to replace is night and day. I didn't have my phone to take a picture which really would have blown you away, The dining area and the ladies room was clean. The servers were average. They sang happy birthday in Italian to our birthday guest. The Classic Italian bake had gigantic meat balls and everyone enjoyed their entrees. They brought the birthday guest their dessert free of charge and with a candle.

The pizzas are very delicious though, interestingly, not like ones I had in Naples despite the fact that the pizzaiolo is clearly Neapolitan, as is the family. Sauce, spectacular. Meatballs, outstanding. And I have high standards for both!  I only realized later that they're related to Vecchia Osteria, which makes sense because that food is also amazing. The waitress/manager/owner's daughter was as delightful as could be and brought us little treats to try throughout the meal. Great atmosphere, very sweet place.

We were VERY disappointed with West Side Gravy.  My fried chicken was two small legs and a thigh, all undercooked,  served in a paper cone, with very small sides of tasteless potato salad and so-so coleslaw.  My iced tea tasted sour.  My wife had the lobster roll which was quite small and tasted mediocre at best.  My son had a hamburger and fries which was fine.  The service was adequate, but nothing special.  Not worth the $50+ (plus tip).  We will not return . The big reason for our disappointment is the fact that The Blackbird Restaurant (attached) is run by the same chef, share the same kitchen and the Blackbird is terrific.

Outstanding. Went to celebrate my wife's b-day. We had the five course tasting menu, our two guests picked from the three course fixed price menu. Something for everyone. Really top of the top food preparation and presentation. Our waitress in particular and the service in general was impeccable. Had salmon tartare with lemon, then foie gras, striped bass, pork tenderloin and freddo. Fantastic pace of flavors and textures. Nice wine's by the glass gave us the perfect backdrop. Peaceful setting, great atmosphere. Highly recommended and will return.

Love the food here. I owned a Italian restaurant when I lived in New York and this is a real gem tucked away in Apollo Beach. Luckily we only live 2 miles away. Have yet to have a bad dish. Portions are large and reasonable. Wine list right but with nice quality. Seafood dishes are exceptional. My wife swears by the seafood cannoli. My only reason for not giving 5 stars is the service. It's very hot or miss. On 2 occasions our server didn't even know how to open a bottle of wine or pour it for that matter. Several times had to wait forever for cheese and drinks. Bar service very slow.

When we lived a block away we constantly ate here after church. It was good back then and now it's even better. The chicken and waffle is superb topped with sausage gravy and scrambled eggs. Don't get no better. The wife had the eggs Benedict this morning and the eggs were cooked perfectly.  Great atmosphere hardly ever a line which is weird because it sits inside the Blake hotel on st Charles.   Great staff very friendly and quick. A little on the high side for breakfast but I like it better than the world famous mothers restaurant down the street.

I am so excited about this hotel. It is really a hidden gem. We arrived at 8:30 am, planning to store our luggage until check-in time. The very friendly lady at the front desk, gave us a room immediately. She was very kind. They had a guy take up all of our luggage. He was very friendly. Once in the room, I discovered a nice room, nice tv, and best of all, AVEDA bath products. They even leave guest a travel kit with cotton balls, q-tips, and a finger file which we really needed after a seven day cruise. Hands down, best hotel I have stayed at, and I have stayed at many. If and when I return, I will be staying here for sure!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Workers are EXTREMELY RUDE and don't smile, especially one of the creepy managers who walks around in the PM hours and asks to help you mockingly. Food selection isn't bad- it is a small store, but they have everything you will need. However- VERY VERY VERY expensive- about 3X or 4X more than an average supermarket. I know city supermarkets are going to be more expensive than suburban ones, but this is much more expensive than the other city supermarkets. You are better off going to "Food and Friends" at 20th and Spruce, Superfresh at 10th and South, or if you have a car- Wegmans in Cherry Hill. Overall- Rittenhouse Market is basically awful.

This hotel was a nightmare. Trash all over the lobbies, no employees in sight. Our room had filthy clothes left over left all over the floor, they obviously are not sanitizing correctly as state mandates call for. This place is a total health hazard. The valet we paid $100 for told us each time they were unavailable to get our car, which cost us a few reservations and meetings. Management has taken 12 days to respond to our complaints and then offers no response in to why. Other hotels in the area are offering much much more.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I took my elderly sister who had already eaten here and really liked it. We went for a late lunch on a Saturday. We were lucky that there weren't many people there. According to reviews, this place is VERY popular. Our waitress was welcoming, answered our questions and helped us order. My sister ordered the penne bake & really liked it. It looked scrumptious! I ordered a slice with spicy sausage, green peppers, fresh mushrooms & onions. The crust was very thin, exactly the way I like it. Yummy! I will be coming here for pizza whenever I'm in Green Valley!

Stay away on vacation in myrtle beach right now with the clunker lights are popping on it was soooooo dirty when we got it oh I'm sorry we did get a big $60 off cause of the fifth inside we found Cheetos n blow pops on day 2!!!!! Then we get here from phila n hv a bunch of issues and are told they'll tow it 3.5 hrs away bring us a smaller car n if they don't find it to hv issues wel b charged cause ALL they can do.. Well maybe I hv trust issues because ur not doing anything without me visually watching you.. Especially when u hv our credit card NOT HAPPening.......worst start of a vacation thanks dollar rental:(

I was here with two friends from college, who I hadn't seen for many years, and we wanted a leisurely meal so we could catch-up. We started with salads and then had entrees. I ordered shrimp scampi which was delicious! My friends each ordered pasta entrees and got "to go" bags because the portion sizes were huge. We had wine by the glass and I had the tiramisu for dessert. All was well-prepared. Our waiter didn't gripe about us needing individual checks, which was very nice and isn't always the case. Even though we were there on a Tuesday night the restaurant and outdoor patio were very busy. I would recommend this restaurant.

The name fits because it is certainly not gold.  The food was better than the unattentive service however. I should have gone into downtown Boise, but was tired from a flight in for business.   Don't bother getting a drink unless your cutting back, because they are watered down in my opinion. However, the liquor stores close early in this bible thumping state so I had no choice but to quench my thirst here. Maybe the bartenders pours light to save the juice for her regulars. I've seen this before and think it's very tacky. I won't be back.

Went here with group of 4. The interior is really nice, clean, non-smoking. Bar area seems nice with nice flat screens. We were seated in rear dining area. 
Waiter seemed harsh and dry at first, but got better with time.
We had buffalo wings and Chicken Satay to start: both were just okay.
The dinner salads were very fresh and tasty.
The crabcakes were decent, but not the best. (I may be spoiled by Louisiana crab cakes though)
I tasted the Coconut Chicken.... eh, it was not good.
Peas and mashed potatoes were nothing special.
Prices were a bit high for the quality of food IMO.
Overall our group decided we would probably not retun here.

I loved the location in the city so I decided to give this place a shot despite the mixed reviews. Unfortunately the reviews are right. I didn't have high expectations for a pizza place in the mall but boy does this do a disservice to the brand's name. To be fair, I tried a new pizza and I want a fan so the 2 stars is strictly for the stale rotolo that tasted like it had been sitting out for at least a day. It's a shame that this is the suburbanites intro to the chain because it's nowhere near the quality of the other locations.

I am truly shocked at some of these reviews - every time I've eaten there, it's been great.  The service is attentive and dignified, and I don't find the prices unreasonable.  Some of the best fresh pizza, soups, and salads in this town and the surrounding areas at good prices - well located next to the Arden Theatre for a perfect pre or post-theatre lunch.  I think some people take something of a negative attitude with them when they go out to eat, and, therefore, always find something to complain about.  I think Pizzicato is awesome and reliable.  Go there - you will not be sorry!

I've eaten here a few times and always had a good meal. This is not the "new kid on the block" or hipster heaven - which, frankly,  for me would not be such- lol- this is an old school place with tasty and authentic Italian-American food.  Just had their panini with long hots and porchetta- boy, was it good - their bread is excellent.  I don't care how much "stuff" you stuff into one- pannini sink or swim based on the bread.  They get it right.  The caramel cheesecake for dessert is really perfect and their coffee rocks.  Service was excellent too.  Prices very reasonable. You know I'm going back.

I could not give it "0".. it does not even deserve zero. Some of you called it the ghetto. It's a lot worse than ghetto. They need to tear this place down and start all over again.

NOTHING WORKED

We had to stay there as we were part of a large group of artists. Boy was it a tragedy. If you've ever seen the movie 
            My Cousin Vinny 
where the train goes all night honking... this was exactly it. Even though we were booked for 3 nights we stayed one night and got out of there. Sleep in your car but don't take a room in this hotel oops sorry dump.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Well, after waiting 29 minutes to make a reservation at the Grove Hotel to join a wedding party (time kept on cell phone) we ended up booking online while they were trying to quote a rate.  We got the same price as the block and took about 3 minutes.  That's 29 minutes I won't get back.  And got nowhere.  At about 25 minutes I said "I take it you don't work at the Grove Hotel."  The polite gentleman responded, "no, we are a booking call center."  Luckily around 26 minutes that had found the wedding party and said "now we have to hear back to see what rate we can get you."  It was nearly silent the whole time.  Lost business.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Had dinner with my husband and while at first we were uncomfortable with having to select from the pre-fixed menu of just 2 options per course... the food was delicious and did not disappoint! We got 1 of each plate offered and shared. The mini chef plates that they also provided were scrumptious and complimented the overall meal. The restaurant is very small (16 seats), has a rustic ambience and the service is good. I gave 4 stars only because it was a tad bit too dark and 1 of the servers put his hands a little to close to the food when explaining what the course was.

This is one of the friendliest and most honest places in Nashville. Not only are they professional, they make you feel completely comfortable about the work being done to your vehicle. I have had to bring my car in 3 times since Feb 2021 and they are always efficient, honest and reliable. This business was recommended to me by a friend and I am so glad I decided to leave my old mechanic and hand my vehicle over to Import. Boone and his family have an incredible way of making you feel right at home. Highly recommend!

If you value getting any sleep, do not live here. We have lived here for months and nothing has changed. Franklin manor continues to blare music until 0230 in the morning. With our balcony doors closed I can literally hear every word of the song being played. Right now it is "oops I did it again, I played with your heart...." If you are a professional, or student, or any adult who needs to sleep at a reasonable hour for work, this is not the place for you.

 And the fancy gym downstairs? More than half of the equipment does not work and is crap. 

 Management in leasing office changes every week.

Absolutely the best pedicure I've ever had! Regular pedicure, not even the spa pedicure, lasted nearly an hour! Hot stone treatment and great exfoliation. So thorough and relaxing, with gorgeous results. Manicure was great, too. Even got a glass of water (could've had tea if I wanted). Brief shoulder rub while my nails were drying. All for only $40! 
Only complaint would be that my manicurist spoke very little English, especially as compared to the others in the salon. 

This is not the place to go if you are in a rush.

Fuzio is now "Capo", themed to fit a 1970s casino show, with the Brat Pack painted on the walls. Somehow, this is not right. Also, Capo would not accept my less-than-two-years-old Fuzio discount that the hotel handed out by the dozens upon check-in.

The prices have gone up a little, and the early-bird discount was not obvious, if it even still exists. I noticed that Capo wasn't as crowded as Fuzio used to be. 

Oh, and you'll hear a lot of Sinatra music while you dine. I think they're trying to capture the over-80 crowd now. I wish they would have left it as it was. But....the food was still pretty good.

Have eaten here several times now. Positives: 1. Convenient to Creve Coeur Lake Memorial Park. 2. Decent outside seating area. 3. Decent live music.  4. Decent burgers. Negatives: 1. Poor service - especially time for orders to be delivered.  2. Nachos and other dishes served cold, inedible. When items sent back, brought back unaltered. 3. $5.00 pitcher of Long Island Iced Tea is almost all ice. So at $5 this could be a good deal. Instead you get the equivalent of a small glass. I only visit this venue when friends want to go.

Order food today thru Uber Eats, we ordered crab cakes, turkey burger and Jamaican Jerk dry rub wings. The food was a waste of money $49.50 down the drain. Initially we rated the burger a thumbs up but then when my husband and bit into the burger it wasn't fully cooked. The crab cake was basically breading the asparagus was cold and the wings dry!! Dry rub is suppose to be juicy wings with seasoning, these wings were dry on the inside and the out! Never again! We were super hungry and totally dissatisfied. Timothys has definitely changed. I'll pass, wish I could get my money back!

Had the worst experience at Dunkin Doughnuts [Apollo Beach]. One car besides myself in line. One customer inside.
Had to wait a long time before they would take my order. [Same with the only other car in front of me.] "You will have to wait." came from the speaker. Several minutes later I said hello. Again,  "You will have to wait, we are busy." But, we were the only customers.. Wow.. Then came on the speaker, "What do you want?" Very rudely.. Wow.. When I reached the window, no customers inside. The staff acted like they were put out, having to serve a customer. 
I'm hoping the person that was going to start-up a Bagel Shop will do so soon..

I had purchased a pair of prescription Oakley glasses from Glasses Galore about 2 years ago. The  frame was all out of wack and the string that holds the lens in place was sticking out of the glasses. I probably sat on them one too many times... I stopped in their place today and was greeted by one of the employees and I showed her the glasses,  she said she would be happy to have them fixed for me within 15 minutes.. I said great and when I came back the glasses were completely fixed and cleaned. I said how much do I owe and was told, NO CHARGE! When does that ever happen? Not many times for me.... GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Rip off artists. They must have to make a sale quota. I was charged over $65 for an oil change. I pay way less than that at the car dealership. I don't need some fancy one. I expected it to be under $30!  Also I bought tires here with an alignment so I was under the impression I would get free tire rotations and balancing. But no I was charged!!!  I asked if any coupons apply he said he gave me them which clearly isn't true since I paid for services advertised as Included FREE. Nonsene. The waiting room is too small. The tv is from 1986. It's uncomfortable and elbow to elbow.  Go to pep boys. They actually deduct coupons.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
The service at this place was excellent! The waitress was very attentive and accommodating. The decor is certainly not something you see a lot of in Philly (old NYC subway signs), which I found interesting.

The pizza we had was good, not amazing. for a place that offers only a few choices, we'd expect those few choices to be the best. The amount of ingredients in the pizza was too small. The taste was good but not something amazing. I feel we got less for what we paid.

I could give it another try; the experience was good the place was immaculate, the service was great. The food could offer a little more for what we pay.

I have had good experiences here before,  but Shelly brought the average star rating down. She outright did not listed to me when I said I wanted a trim. I told her my wedding was in a few weeks and that I wanted long hair for it and would cut more off after the wedding. She just did not accept this and told me that I would thank her later for the haircut. The haircut isn't bad but is much much shorter than I want it to be for my wedding. I wish she would just have listed to me. Just because certain hair cuts are more in style doesn't mean that my request shouldn't be taken seriously...

Not happy with my cut. I asked the guy to thin out the top and the back, and not cut any length off the sides at all. 

He cut length off and didn't take any weight off the sides. Exactly the opposite of what I wanted. Plus, the sides are now uneven and awkwardly cut. He took off my apron and said "you're all good man" without even letting me look things over. 

Also, reception was not very nice. Took me forever on the phone to schedule an appointment.

Would not recommend. Looks like they made do a decent job on fades and shorter haircuts, but as far as mid to long hair goes, find somewhere else.

I gave this dunkin donuts a 2 out of 5 stars because it's still my favorite coffee chain, however this is the worst one in the area. I keep coming back because it's on my way to work. The service does not compare to the other locations. My most recent experience will be my last. Going to go out of my way to another store. My coffee was wrong...To the point where I couldn't drink it. Also, after biting into my burnt cinnamon raisin bagel, I discovered that the cream cheese was spoiled. When I called the store to let them know, I was put on hold and not addressed. Needs some improvement!

I went to my regular tire guy on 2nd and Keystone to get my tires filled (after having sat in the driveway for more than 1 yr!) and found out that he has apparently closed his shop.  Then I tried the chevron on the corner only to discover that the air hose was "out of order".  Right next door was Meineke.  I went into the lobby (with a lovely fragrance) and asked the guy there (Kevin) if I could get some air.  He readily agreed and quickly had me on my way.  Think I know where I'll be going next time I need some tire related issues!! Thanks Kevin!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
My goodness. This McDonald's is simply awful. It is Thursday, December 27 at 2:42 PM. I just ordered a big Mac combo and at this point it has been nine minutes and I have no food. Tried to go get other condiments but  nothing in the lobby is filled. There is no sweet tea the lobby.  The Lobby looks like a war zone and none of the people here seem to care.

I don't have any idea who owns it. But given how bad it is I wouldn't be surprised if it's part of the Tucson McDias family.  All of their restaurants suck as well.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
My 2nd visit to the restaurant.  
Shrimp nachos (Nachos con Camarones) were very good.. good flavor of shrimp and nachos.
For main course I got the Vegetarian Fajitas. Frozen vegetables swimming in oil.
Beside the peppers there were frozen  broccoli and carrots. Why can you not use fresh vegetables? These are plentiful fresh even in the winter.
Server was almost impatient with us for taking our time (a group of women), didn't not come to check on us or refill our water. Too many other Mexican restaurants in the area to come back here again soon.

Went for a GNO holiday get together & we had a great time!  We ordered 2 of the appetizer specials - the scallops & the langostino.  The scallops were in a light cream sauce & accompanied with wilted spinach & the entire dish was amazing!!  All 4 of us agreed that the langostino was no good.  It was overcooked & the only flavor was the grill flavor. I ordered the salmon special which was covered in lump crab meat & in a vodka cream sauce -  phenomenal!!  That should be a regular menu item.
We each enjoyed our entree's & the dessert good as well!

New Owners took over a couple of months ago and things have changed - not for the better either: Higher prices and they let their very best seamstress, Pauline, go - very sad.  We used  this drycleaners ever since we moved to West Chester 8 years ago and the only reason we still go there now is because of PAULA (who is the Manager and is terrific - she'll do anything to help you). They just started offering "Next Day" service and all I can say is they need to get it together - it took several days to get my so-called "Next Day" service. Disappointing.  Will rate them again in a few months.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Met some friends for New Year's Eve earlyish dinner. They are regulars, so I took their recommendation and ordered the fried chicken and was not disappointed. The batter was delicious and no greasy residue. But the best part by far was the complimentary dessert buffet. OMG! Every offering was delicious and diverse and so homemade tasting. The staff was very friendly and our server was a real sweet gal. We didn't stay for the music but the outside bar/stage area was definitely happening. Will return for music and maybe the ribs.

The previous reviews must have been written by the owner or something... because the Indian food here is really, really, breathtakingly bad.  

I wasn't expecting much from a hybrid Pizza/Indian restaurant in Harleysville... but this was just a shame.  The paneer was not paneer.  The Naan was made of pizza dough.  The rice tasted like it was hanging around for a while and then nuked 17 times.

The extra star is for the pizza, which is not bad.  The owners would be wise to just leave the Indian off the menu if they're not going to do it the right way.

The time is 7:50pm. We had gone to the Dunkin Donuts on 7004 N Dale Mabry first. When we walked in all they had left was 4 different flavors of munchkins and all the empty racks on the counter as if they were going to close (they don't close til 10pm), service was mediocre. So we decided to try the one on hillsborough and my goodness what a difference! As soon as we walked in such a Warm welcome, Big smiles and Exceptional service. Jeriaya took care of us and was phenomenal! This is my Dunkin hotspot thanks to such a great experience that the staff provided.

This place must be doing something right they get a ton of business through the drive in and also a lot of in-n-out they have a good amount of parking... They are conveniently located it is a very clean and spacious location.

Yesterday I had a cinnamon raisin bagel with light cream cheese and it was very good the service was excellent and the staff is friendly and chatty.

This location has been kind to the Rockit riders bike club for many years and to Wheelies bike shop and we would like to thank them for their hospitality.

Still our go to all the time for its convenience. Obvious in the last couple of weeks they raised prices suddenly and swiftly for the holidays. With all the competition nearby i.e. Joe canals and wineworks surprised that this happened.

It would be nice for a store in the last 2 weeks prior to Christmas to have more than one cashier available. The cashiers seem not to care about scanning your canals Clubcard.

It's obvious that the ownership lacks....  this has been going on through quite a few ownerships. While they still have an excellent selection this place can be so much more. .. I can say that about Traino's and Wineworks too.

Tried the Sunday lunch buffet for $42 (including 15% tip) without drinks. This includes ordering sushi snd sashimi from the menu aside from the displayed sushi and maki rolls. They also have other food to choose from like chicken and beef teriyaki, fried rice etc. The desserts and salad bar were not that good - less appetizing noodle salad, dried small cakes, etc. The shrimp tempura is not what you see in places like Mikado. 
This place is good if you want  to eat a lot and feast on sushis - but for $42 i can get authentic Japanese cuisine somewhere else.

Two stars is generous.

My room (rack rate $550 plus another $15 if you want internet service) was so nasty that I spent an hour cleaning it myself -- yuck -- and delivered the filthy washrag to the manager, who could not be bothered to call me back.

Three of us wanted to sit outside for dinner at Il Terrazzo (um, "the terrace").  Too much to ask.  One party was outside, but "that was a reservation."

Worst of all, upon check in, one of my colleagues got a key to someone else's room.

Also, be apprised that there is no good food or shopping within walking distance.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I order from this imos at least once a week.  Today will be the last time.  We have had issues in the past with our order getting messed up but usually nothing to big.  Today we were given the wrong pizza.  The manager refused to fix the situation.  We ordered pizza online for our entire staff. We called to verify the correct pizza would be made.  They did not make them right one and would not fix it because we started eating the pizza already.   We have been working since 7am.  None of us could wait another 45 minutes before eating.

I don't really get why some 'locals' love this place so much. The 'pizza' is not really that great. The last time I was here, I ordered a buffalo pizza and was very disappointed. The slices are very thin and even the presentation of the toppings and sauce made it look like a frozen pizza. In fact, it tasted exactly like the pizza I bought from a stand in The Gallery food court a few weeks prior. Even the adjacent  Wegmans grocery store makes a much better pizza. May be okay for sandwiches, but if you are looking for a good pie, go somewhere else.

We haven't been here in about five year (mistake on our part).  It was delicious then and was just as delicious tonight! I passed on some amazing sounding specials because I had a hankering for shrimp scampi (so good).  I almost ordered the sausage ragu special to go! My wife had the baked manicotti -awesome.  The chocolate mouse was super fresh and light.  Needless to say, we won't be waiting five years to return.  To top it off, the service was excellent; a friendly and attentive waiter and mindful busboys who were also very attentive.

The residents of D'Town have a gem; I can't imagine being within three blocks of this place (we would be broke)! Although a new spot, this place is great. Manicotti, tortellini Alfredo, taco pizza and cannoli -all were amazing for a local Italian restaurant. This place will have a waiting list every weekend. We are anxious to go back. The menu ranges from simple to complex (Risotto with scallops was the special).  The food was very fresh and clearly homemade. Well worth the trip from DubC. The icing -our server (Wyatt) was excellent, very attentive and it's a BYOB.

I came here today because the food court was Jane packed. I should've taken the absence of a wait as a sign about this place. The staff is incredibly friendly and nice, but the food. Oh the food. The beef quesadilla tasted like something was either bad in it, they haven't cleaned the grill too in a really long time, or there was som sort of chemical nearby that spilled atop the cheese before folding the tortilla over. Beans and rice were sub par. Not sure how it stays in business at the very competitive student union.

I repeatedly have problems with this office.  If you decide to rent from them: 1) check the fuel level vs what is on your receipt; 2) check the mileage level vs what is on your receipt 3) check the vehicle for damage or missing equipment; ask for an inspection if you don't get one, else you are responsible for damage 4) check the check-out time on your receipt since that drives the check-in time requirement 5) be prepared for ill-prepared car - dirty inside or out 6) check fluid levels especially in winter to make sure you have enough washer fluid. I have had issues with all of these things. 
Current staff is polite.

We ordered the fried pecorino with figs and honey....amazing start. Then it went downhill from there. We tried the rustic bolognese and shrimp carbonara. Both dishes were very bland. We had to request grated cheese as none was provided when the dishes were brought. It feels Cena is trying to be more creative than tasty. At the prices that this place is charging for these average plates, suffice to say we will not be making a return trip. Very disappointed as we've been wanting to try this place for a long time.

Hello V Cibo- goodbye Villa Gallaci! I watched as this place was being built in the neighborhood and was anxious to try it- glad I did.  This place has very good food, excellent wine on tap and great service. Not as pretentious as Villa Gallaci! 

The meatballs might be the best we have had and the pizzas are equally as good. And I am not kidding about tap wine! You would think crap Chianti but the Super Tuscan and Chianti are as good as any bottle wine. And only $6 a glass. 

Give it a try and give Villa Gallaci the finger!

Two adults, breakfast, 8:30 am. Only 3 cars in the parking lot, so expected great service and food. 
Seated us quickly, service was friendly, yet no water refills.

Wife ordered french toast, scrambled eggs, all ok, potatoes, potatoes had no seasoning whatsoever, obviously frozen out of bag. She also had mexican coffee as a treat- her birthday, best part of the meal.

I had scrambled eggs with meat and chilis, ok, yet nothing exceptional, corn tortillas were good.

Overall, an average experience, given the many negative yelp reviews for service, no compelling reason to return.

We have been to Botto's many times but this past weekend was absolutely horrible. I'm embarrassed because it was a special dinner and the table wasn't set. It took over 30 minutes to get napkins and utensils. The food was mediocre at best. Our server was nowhere to be found.
We had no one attending to us upstairs. The espresso was only hot milk. It was a joke! Let's just say it will be a long time before we go back. If you don't have enough staff, don't book large parties. They had more than enough hostess's however.
And yes my name is KAREN

Its fast food without the "TUDE"!  The employees are nice here every time I have been, extremely rare for any fast food anywhere even close to New Orleans. The food is really good too. I love the hot sauce bar, I really love the hot sauce bar. 
  The only reason I wont give it more stars is the fact that you CAN NOT eat here without being surrounded by children. For some reason it attracts the creeps that just refuse to take their brat out even after it has screamed for over 10 minutes. Seriously has a child infestation.

If you can avoid this McDonald's please do so. I would've given a zero star rating but that's not possible. I've been here countless times despite my better judgment and am continuously disappointed. In my most recent visit a drive thru breakfast order of two sandwiches and two hashbrowns took a total of 20 minutes. The visit before that I was told they don't serve breakfast in the afternoon despite the "all day breakfast" sign. When I mentioned the sign they proceeded to take my breakfast order. I can see why it's the country's worst rated McDonalds.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Sages has a nice atmosphere. The food is just ok. Prices are reasonable so it's a fair deal. 

I had the chicken parmesan with angel hair pasta. The sauce was missing in flavor. Just a little bland. A light red sauce. The chicken parmesan itself was just ok. It could have been frozen and microwaved. 

My wife had eggplant parmesan and she said it was ok.

Didn't try pizza or grinders. May try something else next time. 

To me a great italian place has a great sauce. That's missing here. A lot of potential with the atmosphere, but the food could use some work.

Not sure why this place got such good reviews. Maybe I'm too picky because I'm chinese but even I love a good take out and this was not it. Had the beef mei fun, chicken with broccoli, dumplings, and hot sour soup. Everything was too salty, dumplings were literally too gummy and I was overloaded by the sheer greasiness of it all. 

The nice thing about the place is that you can order either a small or large size version of mostly whatever on the menu so you don't feel like you have to commit to any one dish. The bad side though is that you sample a bunch then decide to never come again.

I've only ever ordered delivery and it has never taken less than an hour to have our food delivered. If you order delivery expect to wait an hour to an hour and a half. No joke. 

The food is okay. Not mind blowing but it's the best in the area that delivers. The reason we choose to order Joy Garden even though they're crazy slow is because their Boba smoothies are AMAZING. They use to have raspberry which was sooo good but they do not have that flavor anymore. Pretty lame... I'll keep ordering here but if there is EVER a better Chinese food place that has delivery in the area I'll change up who we order from.

Started with Italian wedding soup.  Mine had no escarole, but was tasty with plenty of meatballs, my husbands had a little escarole and was other wise the same.  I had veal saltimbocca which was delicious and my husband cx Sinatra which he loved.  He finished the sauce with a piece of bread, not a drop left.  We ordered the tiramisu for dessert which came out frozen.  The owner Leslie came over and explained they make it each day and freeze it so it will cut nicely.  It was not taken out of the freezer early enough.  She gave us a piece to take home and it was delicious.  We will definitely go back.

We went to Bowl on a recommendation and were blown away by both the customer service and the great food!  We ordered the pork and the duck and both were cooked perfectly (the pork was falling off of the bone and the duck skin was crispy and delicious).  It's true there are no waiters here - you order up at the counter but we were greeted with a smile and the chefs cheerfully explained the menu and made recommendations.  It's a bit drafty so bring a sweater, but it's well worth the trip (even despite the paid parking).  Thanks to the owners for opening yet another wonderful restaurant downtown!

I used to like this place until the delivery driver (older male with an accent) came to deliver my cheesesteak and demanded a tip from me. He wouldn't leave until I gave him a tip because he "has children to feed". That was a terrible/scary experience for me because I am underage and I was home alone. I was about to call the cops on him, but I decided to give him the tip and he finally left. In addition to that, my food smelled strongly of cigarette smoke. That was my last time ever ordering from this place. Please get rid of that crazy delivery guy!

It's New Year's Eve.  We've gone to Cielo at the Four Seasons for many years. So...no more Cielo's.  Now it's Cinder House with South American influences. It was SO noisy.  Cielo was elegant.  We always felt like we got what we paid for.  Each course was beautiful and delicious.  There was always a glass of  sparkling wine to end our meal.  There wasn't much on the menu at Cinder House that sounded appealing.  At least our waiter warned me that the piri piri chicken was very spicy, so I could avoid that.  The food was adequate, but nothing befitting a four star hotel.  Next year we'll try 360. Did I mention that it was NOISY?

The food was good. Our server was Jose. He was very good. For some reason they did not give us any chips and salsa. The food came out fast one plate at a time. Jose came by to refill our drinks saying he had to go on break and Sofia would take over our table during that time. Sofia never came by the table ever. We finally flagged her down to get our check after sitting there 15 minutes after eating. I asked to talk to the manager after we paid. We finally left because no one would every come to talk to us. With the food just average and bad service, we won't return.

I would not recommend this practice. My dog went in for an ultrasound. The doctor who read the ultrasound came in--I am sure he is well qualified--but he gave me some of the worst possible news I could have received--terminal inoperable cancer--as if he were passing the time of day.  There was nothing such as "I am sorry that I don't have better news".  Metropolitan in King of Prussia is much more caring and compassionate and when your animal is sick, you need this compassion about your pet as much as you need an experienced doctor

Pool/Gym and Spa CLOSED during Thanksgiving!! 
The last time we stayed here over Thanksgiving weekend, we were thrilled to know they had a beautiful pool and spa that they boast about in their website. Dream come true! Not quite. 
Of course they neglect to mention that it was CLOSED as the employees that operate it wanted the holiday off. Bait and switch. That was our vacation and you should let your customers know that what you advertise isn't actually offered. 
We will be making other arrangements this year and you get one star.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Not only are their roasts the best but their customer service is spot on! We just opened our second bakery and cafe location and called Reanimator based on references and their reputation. Mark and Mark came to our location in NJ and walked us through their products and trained my staff on how to get the most of the coffee. They cleaned our equipment, help us trouble shoot some issues and then CAME OUT FOR OUR GRAND OPENING! They are the best and truly passionate about what they do. We will use them in all our future locations (yes there will be more). Cannot say enough. Thanks again guys! 

www.victoriansavories.com

I ordered for delivery and everything was excellent, although I think their food, especially their pizza, suffers a bit when delivered. This is most likely unavoidable to some extent. Probably better to eat it there. 

I wish there was a bit more choice in the pizzas ( if you don't like or can't eat certain toppings it can dramatically reduce your options), but I don't object to a restaurant keeping their offerings authentic. Not every place needs to offer pineapple pizza...although I happen to like that, too.

Addendum: service a bit slow but a good job, and the pizza is definitely better to eat there

Well, this is a Market on the bubble for sure! I am asking all locals to give the market a try, look for the items you like to buy, check the price, give the market price feedback. I also would ask for people to look for items you like to buy which they don't have and also let the market know and see if they can stock the missing items for you.

The market needs support to stick around, so give it a whirl!  Ice cream is always on sale! 

Soon, Chelten IGA would like to carry beer and wine, what brands would you like to buy from them?
Is alcohol something you want to buy at IGA?

Yo! Let's buy local! Support our local food market!

Dropped in Saturday afternoon, after a nice bike ride.  The place was busy but only had 2 people working, taking orders.  I cannot call them wait staff because they clearly had no idea what they were doing.  

After seating myself (always a bad sign), I watched these amateurs take orders, one at a time...they would go to a table, then disappear, then come back, then disappear.

After watching this for 10 minutes, and not getting service, we left.  

A note to the management...hire more people, preferably ones who know how to work in a restaurant.

I'm always looking for good bowl of good pasta (especially if it's made in house).  The place is beautiful - seriously gorgeous.  I found the food, service, and creativity comparable (or a little less so) to other good pasta places - Sugo's, Katie's, Pastaria.   However, the price was a bit too high (Yelp is generous with their "moderate" category - the pasta dishes truly run about $25.).  Give it a try, if you must.   Then go to some of the other great pasta places I mentioned above for more reasonable pricing, and slightly better food.

This used to be a great place for breakfast.  It was always fast, the food was piping hot and tasty.   In the past two or three months the quality of service in mornings has gone down a lot.  The staff is rude, the production is slow, and food is not quite a good.  I've watched and heard some of the regular customers grumble about the decline in service.  I even overheard the staff discuss how they've served items to customers with "a lot of love."  Since no one that is reading this was born yesterday, I'll leave it to your imagine what that probably means.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Husband and I stopped in today and it exceeded my expectations. They have something for everyone! 
I tried the avocado coconut and my husband had the maple pecan and they were both delicious to say the very least. I wanted to try all the flavors haha
Additionally to the exceptional quality of the pops was the excellent customer service from the two young ladies working there. They greeted every single person that walked in there and offered them advice and background information on the pops... if you are in the area, stop in!

Poor communication from office staff no maintenance staff very unorganized and  dealing with this property has been the worst experience Ive ever encountered  Rhonda the property manager is the impossible to deal with. She also is racist.  If you have a disagreement about a price instead of talking it out she will tell you shes uncomfortable being alone with you because you're black and call another black person to be in the room with her. Ive never dealt with a business like this vet unprofessional.  There is a new leasing agent every 3 months because Rhonda makes it impossible for them to do their jobs.

This place is a joke.  Arrived after booking 3 months in advance and they put me in a suite with a roll-out bed because the hotel was "overbooked." Staff sent me in the wrong direction to my room.  Rooms are generally clean and OK though and some staff members are competent.  On the final day of checkout there was not a single person at the reception and had to leave a handwritten note to tell them I had checked out and to send me the receipt to my email address.   There are many better hotels in New Orleans.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is the second time I've been there.  The first time the did and service was pretty good,  but things have certainly gone downhill since then.  The service is lousy and so is the food.  If you want,  save a lot of money and just go to any chinese buffet and you will get about the same quality of food.  If it's sushi you want, I recommend going to Kazus sushi, otherwise just head to any chinese buffet and save about $10/person. The sushi was horrible, about what you'd expect from a chinese buffet as well as the hibachi dinner.

I absolutely love the personal service from the owner Enrique and his staff!   Tremendous!  Anxiously awaiting to hear when you they'll start music.   Just ask and they're willing to assist.  We went on Sunday evening.

I had the Yuaca Tamale with Red Sauce--absolutely heavenly!  And, I had the Taco Pastor...they seemed to have been marinating too long.

My husband liked his tacos as did our young friend!

I'll return and will probably next time be able to give a 5 star...the el Pastor was the only reason for the 4 star versus 5 as I anticipate great food.

The size of this place was never meant to be a restaurant - the moment you walk in you feel a little claustrophobic. On top of that they insist on playing jazz music that's way too bass heavy for me to be relaxed and focused on my food that's trying to fight for space on my minuscule table. I think the food was okay - I couldn't tell, nor did I care. I left as soon as I could and never looking back.

Do yourself a favor and buy a breaded chicken wawa hoagie and sit on the park bench at fitler square instead.

Two weeks ago we ordered two baconators and both did not contain any bacon. Tonight we tried again and the order was even worse. Although there was some bits of bacon on them, the burgers were dried out, not served hot, and were just horrible. Did not look at all like the photo on the menu board. The fries were cold and rubbery. They were out of baked potatoes on both visits, and out of Dr. Pepper on the most recent visit. This is not the Wendy's I have known years ago... Something is amiss at this location.

Had several issues with this location. I received and email after my stay asking me to fill out a satisfaction survey which I did. I received a snarky "thank you" email back (which I didn't ask for) questioning some of the issues that I brought to their attention. 
Stay here at your own risk and you may or may not have a good stay but my best advice is not to give them any feedback when they ask for it else suffer the passive-aggressive wrath of Mr. Robert Duato. Fear not, "sir." I won't step foot near that property again. You may have it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Consistently, Ooka's in Doylestown is our go-to place for quality sushi in a relaxed extremely well-serviced venue. The servers are phenomenal and our favorite is eating at the sushi bar and asking for recommendations. Firm believer that the culture of a restaurant starts with the owners/management of the establishment and no question, the warm welcome you get from the managers with regular check-in's to ensure everything is meeting expectations reinforces that Ooka is a place to feel welcome with superlative food and service! Worth every bit of a five star rating!

To be quite honest, I've never taken my car to anywhere, but the dealer or a close friend who owns a shop, so I was quite curious as to how taking my car to this shop was going to go. I walked in, stated the problem, they took a look, fixed my car, and I was in and out in less than an hour. While this may not be the typical experience for everyone based upon what is wrong with the car and their current workload, this experience was nothing short of perfect. They are reasonable, understanding, and efficient. Thank you, RYAN and to the whole team behind Meineke of Andorra! Highly recommended!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We're going out for Chinese food but turned into wrong plaza and decided to eat Italian. What a mistake. Staff was ok. We got takeout. Two spaghetti with meatballs and meat sauce. A house salad and garlic rolls. You'd think an Italian place would make a staple of all Italian restaurants spaghetti and meatballs! Got home and the dinner was terrible. I don't know what the meatballs were made of. Wow. There was hardly any sauce. The spaghetti was done right. The rolls were pillsbury rolls with no garlic! The salad was good. Don't waste your money. Two thumbs down.

I am a sucker for a neighborhood "find" a this is definitely one of those.  A great find.  It's tucked away and best found by "looking for Starbucks and then turning around" but once found, it's worth it.  Intimate setting with great old brick walls and only about 15 or so tables.  We had a quiet dinner and enjoyed the food.  Even though it's Italian for the most part, I went for the duck --- it was tender and had lots of flavor.  We were a last minute reservation for a late dinner and were about the last ones there but the service held up until we walked out the door.  An enjoyable evening.

Alamo Rent A Car corporation is ridiculous.  The employees at the rental buildings are okay,  but if something out of the ordinary happens then you are dealing with unprofessional management.  I was hit from behind while parked at a stoplight.  Alamo has lost the claim number twice now and their managers continue to lie to me.  The responsible party and I are both receiving the same bills so I think they are trying to double up on payments for the repairs.  There are so many better options with responsible employees.  I don't recommend using Alamo ever.

Ate here with the wife tonight. Server Ryan was nice and in cheerful spirits for the duration of our stay. We ordered a large pepperoni pizza and two side salads as a $2.99 add on that we're a little on the small side. The bread that comes complimentary with the purchase of any meal was perfectly fresh and delicious and came with a side of Olive oil. 

The pizza was a 9 out of 10 and delicious. They have a lack of ample paper products such as napkins at the table and paper towels in the bathroom. The wife also said the bathroom was an arctic 58degrees. 

Atmosphere was nice and friendly even for a Friday

Hard to explain how I felt walking into this house/restaurant.  Apparently we were the first customers of the night.  As you walk in you hear a doorbell ringing.  Not sure why it's needed but ok.  Overall a quirky experience.  The service was prompt, no complaints there.  I ordered the chicken corn soup which I normally love but not so much here.  More potatoes than corn or chicken.  I also had the shrimp and crab pot pie.  Crust was puff pastry.  It had maybe 2 shrimp and they were cut in half.  Not sure where the chunks of crab were.  Sorry won't be back.

I haven't actually stayed at the Hyatt Place Reno Tahoe but I did just make a reservation for one of our staff who will be going there on a business trip and I am not at all impressed with the reservations people. I spoke with 'Josh' and it seemed like I was wasting his time. He was very monotone and didn't even bother to let me know that he had finished making the reservation; I was waiting for him to offer me the confirmation number and the next thing I know I am listening to the automated voice asking me if there is anything else I need. While I don't necessarily NEED it, I would have liked a polite, professional reservations specialist.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I go here often.  Never really had a problem... 
Until tonight... 
I came in around 8ish and was in line waiting to be served and a bunch of cops came in and skipped everyone and they just went ahead and took their order.... no excuse me or no reason. 
So they took their order and they just went to have a seat.  There was no rush on their part...
 I under stand protect and serve but not skip and rude like seriously.... 
Took about 15 mins just to get my drinks.... they need to not do that especially when your busy and everyone waited their turn.

Covid-19 mask warning. We have loved this place for years. And still do. And during the pandemic they have done a good job offering curbside pickup. I give three stars for one reason. The people who bring your order curbside (we've experienced two different people) either don't wear masks or they sort of prop their mask up with one hand (about 3 inches from their face) and if you have your mask on they think they can take theirs off, forgetting that we wear masks to project others, not ourselves. So, at least during the pandemic you might think twice about Mr. Whiskers.

My sisters and I take turns bringing my mom to this particular Jerry Bob's every week, and we've always had a great experience there. Fausto cooks up consistently good food, the place is always spotless, and the three waitstaff that we see there most--Dallas (most fab hair ever), Melissa (superlative tattoos), and Hanna (possible halo spotted)--are genuine, fun, professional, sharp, and really proficient. They make everyone feel so welcome, and they're always up on who needs what when.

Thank you, Fausto, Dallas, Melissa, and Hannah, for always making our experience a wonderful one.

This is for the Enterprise Car Rental on 3005 Mill St, Reno, NV 89502. There is no Yelp listing except for the car sales which the Rental Department must be new. Anyways ... Took my car in to Arrow Automotive for the day for maintenance, I was stranded and needed a rental for the day. Arrow Automotive called Enterprise and they came and picked me up within 10 minutes. When arrived at rental shop the place was busy, but they had plenty of staff and there was hardly any wait. The staff were professional and fast. When dropped off the car at end of day, they drove me back to Arrow Automotive. Good rental experience. Will be back.

Excellent customer service + experience. We made an appointment to come in for a site tour and fell in love with the space instantly. Trinidy was incredibly knowledgable and kindly helped us secure our new place. The facilities are new and modern with a pool, hot tub, dog washing room and roof top deck. There is enclosed/covered parking and its actually located on the water, not near the water. There are shops next door that are being remodeled and should be quite lovely when its complete. I highly recommend this location if you're looking for a new apartment.

Just like every other review on here, I share the same experience. Terrible staff and they're always "out" of everything. No matter what time of day or night you go here, they always seem to be out of everything. This place is a total disaster and in need of all new employees or some serious management overhaul. It's no wonder why Starbucks is taking all your business. **update 5/18/19: went to get ice coffee and they ran out of ice supposedly. LOL how does that happen. Owner still hasn't responded. Loser. *Second Update: went again today, and this time they're "out" of Splenda. Worst staff**

I've been here a few times over the years, this time was with six friends. Service was pretty good but she never came over to ask if everything was ok!  While the female waitress said how good the broccoli rabe and cheesecake was, I didn't agree & found it  to be just ok. Esp the broccoli rabe, was bland and not enough oil & garlic, (I could have made it better myself!) my friends agreed! My Pasta Nera was very good though thank goodness! Lastly, I thought it was pricey, since we took our own wine and shared only two appys for seven of us and had a few desserts, $53 each.

Pleasantly surprised. Its hard to carve space around here with italian cuisine.  the reviews left me cautious.  The negatives first: They were out of a few things so our server (Raye--sweetheart) had to come back for a rrecorder. waitstaff was thin, but thats part for the course.

Positives: Great server attitude.  Very clean, rustic feel. The food was much better than I expected. one of us has pasta (very nice).  The cheesesteak was really, really good. As in I will come here for that vice other SJ spots..  Give it a try....

We were a group of 20 for dinner at 6:30.  It was a busy weekend night.  Instead of being at one table, we were split up into two tables; one behind the orher.  At 6:30 we were asked it we wouldn't mind changing our reservation to 7:30.  We were opposed to thst since most of our party was in attendance.  We aked if we could have out checks broken out in; 4 to a check.  This could not be done.  One check for each table was issued.  Food was good, service was good. Price was too high. The dinner service took about 3 hours.  The theatre goers were given an understandable priority, but unfortunately, to our expense.

Great service, lovely people. Sat at the sushi bar and ordered gorgeous edible art all night. The halibut tasted like butter and the tuna was divine. The fish here is by far fresher and of better quality than other places in town. The seaweed salad was perfectly seasoned with just enough rice vinegar and the cucumbers were a treat!  Don't let the run-down strip mall deter you from a wonderful meal. They have put their time, money, and energy into the food, service, and interior,  not the exterior appearance.

This was our third time there and we drove over an hour to go. I would easily have given this restaurant 4 stars except for one major factor. The hostess was extremely rude to us several times during the evening and embarrased us in front of our friends by hurying us out the door "so that she could seat the next party" after we dropped about $240 for dinner. Hard to explain here but it was not a good scene. The food was great. The server was great. I don't know Franco (the owner), but friends of ours do and I hear he's a good guy -- he can certainly cook. Unfortunately, because of how we were treated by his hostess, we will not be going back.

Even though this place has been open for a while, I've never been in for lunch or breakfast. I pass by everyday, but I still think the place needs that extra something to cheer this place up. I ordered tacos al pastor, and my friend ordered the steak nachos, and the lack of flavor it's a con. The pro, it's the big portions, which I think balanced the fact of flavorless meat. The service was great and fast, (probably cause they weren't so busy at that time) and plus, not pricey at all.
We'll definitely come back, to try out something else. Who knows, probably by then they might have improved their sazón.

We decided to go here because of the high ratings on yelp, my wife prefers vegetarian and it didn't seem like they had a lot of options for vegetarian and they were not able to confirm if the beans were vegetarian even though we asked and they were unable to confirm.  My chicken quesadilla very good and my son enjoyed his chicken nuggets, but the next day my wife got food poisoning so after 24 hours, the doctor said we should go to the hospital and we talk to the nurse practitioner and she said it could've simply been hygiene of the wait staff, or it could've been the food directly, but we're not sure.

This place is still terrible, however just wanted to let people know that all the other car washes in the area, like waterworks car wash express in 202, now only charge $3, also have clean vacuums, and don't have facetious mentally lacking employees. The guys leave you alone when you are paying, when you are vacuuming, and give you a nice smile when guiding your car onto the track, rather than trying to guide you in hopes they can compensate for being terrible at life like they do at petes. The vacuums actually work at waterworks too!

Immediately upon walking in, I noticed that the place is a dump.  They should tear it down or and rebuild it from the ground up.  That's a big negative.

I also noticed that there's no soda machine in the lobby.  I like to get free refills.  That's another big negative.

But the biggest negative of all was that there were no employees visible much less anyone taking orders.  Eventaully, the supervisor showed up, but not to take orders.  He was putting together the order for the customer already waiting.  I left and went to Burger King!

Had been here a couple of times when I lived in Reno, and tonight on our way out to Silver Springs we stopped in to satisfy an urge.  It was pretty dead in there, which was a bad sign, but the food was good and the service was outstanding.  The owner stopped by several times to check on us, brought my boyfriend water when he was obviously suffering through a very spicy roll, and then took a minute to talk a little.  He has obviously been affected by the recession, but rather than cry about it and get bitter, he has stepped up the customer service.  Smart man, because now I will go back just to be treated so well.

Love, love, love Dr. Frank! She is always extremely thorough and caring. Dr. Frank and the vet tech staff have been excellent in handling my super sassy and stubborn Husky.  I have always been able to get a same-day appointment when I call in emergency situations. 

Prices are very reasonable, I have since moved out of Philly and have found that it is actually cheaper for me to drive from NJ to the Pet Mechanic over seeking out a new vet in the South Jersey suburbs. 

Also, If you're coming by car, parking can be a bit harder to come by after 4:30pm-  I would recommend making an appointment in the morning or afternoon.

I just want to say, this Macdonald's has made a come back with their customer service!! More specifically, josefina (the manager) is so caring about the customers and always wants to be sure we are taken care of. Every time we come in, she goes above and beyond to make sure we are happy and have our orders right. If they are not right, she does more than necessary to make us happy. Thank you for making a quick trip to a fast food restaurant something we look forward to every week before church!! We appreciate you josefina!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This location is so hit or miss. More miss than hit. Their are a few baristas in there that need attitude adjustments. Being nice is not hard. I understand we all have our days but their drive thru skills are pathetic. Need to take a lesson from Chick fil A. I do enjoy Sandy (I think that's her name). She always is pleasant and there is a younger guy that works there that takes his job really serious and aims for excellent customer service. Great job to those two employees. The others just need to be a bit more friendlier.

I went today to begin a week trial... and left shortly after arriving. 
The vibe of this place was just off.  I can't really put my finger on it.

The thing that really irked me was I was asking about personal training, and the Manager (?) said they discouraged training between peak hours of 5-7.  What?  He said they'd train at that time, but it isn't preferred.  Again, what?  How about people that work all day and like to hit the gym after work?  I was pretty confused on this practice.  He acted really odd about it too.  

I hopped on a cardio machine and just continued to be irritated, so peaced out.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Had my second meal here last night-- and my last!  The waitstaff was very attentive and knowledgeable yet the timing was VERY slow -- it was an hour before our appetizers arrived. Everyone in our party enjoyed their choices.  Dinner entrees arrived 45 minutes later.  My roasted chicken was too dry.  A salmon ordered by our party was on a bed of kale that was too salty to eat.  The turkey burger by another member of out party was dry and chewy.  Overall not worth making another trip unless maybe to sit outside for a simple salad or burger but honestly not worth the $$$.

Just went here for a holiday lunch. We were a small group and most of us ordered pizza and wine. The Barbera wine I had was great, the pizza was ok. I felt the crust tasted like chlorine (is that crazy?). I tasted a co-workers pizza just to see if it was just my pizza, but her's also tasted a bit like chlorine...not sure what that was about. Service was slow (I drank all my wine and no one asked me if I wanted another glass, which I did!). 
Overall, A-ok. Will I be back? Probably not. There are so many better places to eat in Philly that accommodate groups.

Went there 2 nights in a row.  First night was wor wonton soup and fried wontons.  Have to say I was very disappointed.  Second night I ordered Sizzling Seafood rice soup and found only 4 pieces of shrimp throughout the whole container!  Just think it is very overpriced for qaulity and quantity.  The fried won tons have no pork, just a fried won ton, and costs $7.  Soup quanities of meat is very low.   HOWEVER, love the people who own and run the restaurant.  I've heard it's a much better meal if you dine in.  Think I will try that next time.

This is not a bad place to spend a night but next time I might try elsewhere.  Check in and staff service was fine.  The room is clean enough and everything works.  The bed is comfortable and the pillows are good. It might be the best in town.

The breakfast is OK but there were problems.  They had sausage, cheese omelette and sausage; no potatoes.  There is a cool pancake machine but they were inedible because the batter was old.  There is some traffic noise but not too bad.  We were next to the freeway, at the end of the hall. The pool is very small.  So is the lobby.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Garlic knots are excellent. It was a quiet night and nobody else was in there and I got a wrong topping on my pizza I didn't order, the server said he'd make sure he didn't charge for it so that was good-didn't want send it back and have to wait again so I just dealt with it. Pizza was not very hot for some odd reason being the oven was only 15 feet away from us-I didn't get that. Like others said, it lacked cheese. We got the extra thin crust and it was kinda "soppy". I'm from MN so I am not used to these meager sausage pieces down here in FL. I will stick to making my home made pizza on the grill or Jetts pan pizza from now on.

What the... heck... is up with this bank? 

Today I stopped at this branch to make a deposit, and they said they had to scan my DRIVERS license, using some device they mounted at the teller windows. 

And then she asked me for my SOCIAL SECURITY number (which I presumed they had on file). As IF the wait wasn't long ENOUGH. And I there to DEPOSIT a thousand dollars. 

Between this, and their phone apps that seem to update on a monthly basis, until it were no longer COMPATIBLE with my device, this bank has REALLY become a pain in the ---------------.

This was extremely average authentic Mexican food.  I was under-impressed to say the least.  Service was sub-par as well for it being so dead for a Friday at lunchtime.  I was supposed to get beans and didn't and had to ask for them.
