One member of our party ordered a dish with eggs and didn't get told there weren't any eggs in stock until everyone had been served and then she had to order something else while we were all eating.     Chips and salsa was good but that's where it ends for me.  I will not choose to eat here again.  Maybe I just didn't order the right thing.  Price was very cheap.

I have dined at Nanarosa twice.  I have found it to be almost okay on both occasions.   On my last visit, I ordered a very basic dish with marinara sauce.  The sauce might as well have been straight tomatoes out of a can.  The sauce had no spice.  I rarely salt my food and I had to salt each and every bite.  You can add a small amount of sugar and that will cut the acidity of the tomatoes.  Oregano, basil, and other basic spices would be a nice add as well.

I would love to support this restaurant with my business, but only if they decide to step up the quality of the food.

Here's hoping...

Small selection of food. The food did not taste good. Their desserts were dried out and nasty. The jello looked like it had been there for a week. The price was 5.99 per person and that's because they don't offer a lot of food. Most of the trays were empty and they weren't keeping a stead flow of food coming out of the kitchen my husband and son had to ask them to refill certain foods and when they did refill it was only a small amount they put out. The won ton soup was so nasty looking I almost threw up just looking at it. The sushi was so bad it was I had to spit it out. I would never go there again.

Check-in is at 3pm arrived at 3:26pm and room wasn't ready. My wife played pool in the very nice lounge area. Equipped with tables and chairs, televisions and a coffee and tea bar also has a bar a few feet down the hall. Was given room key at 4:05pm. Not really how I expected my checkin to be as it was raining pretty bad and my pants were pretty wet and I wanted to change. Got to the room, amazing. Have a grand suite. Equip with two rooms separated by a door. Kitchen area with microwave fridge and a Keurig coffee maker. Large soaking tub in the bedroom. So far my experience has been ok. Will update after.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Budget (and Avis which owns it) has really done well by me. I like their car selection. They swapped a car out for me in the middle of a trip when the tire popped, which went smoothly. They charged WAY WAY WAY too much for the tire, but now I know to always get the damage protection. Alamo wouldn't rent to me because they don't take bank cards for the credit hold,  but Budget does, they were right next store, and went out of their way to beat Alamo's price AND gave me a free upgrade. I think we both had that 'screw Alamo' mentality.

Went for a Friday dinner.  The host was friendly and we got seated promptly.  The food was good - from the reviews and the prices (NY prices for a Philly BYOB?  I better be blown away!), I expected more.  The black bass was tasty but the star was the Pot de Creme for dessert.  

Service though was another story.  We waited at least 30 minutes in between courses from when our plates were cleared.  No apologies.  When I asked my waitress if our entrees would be coming soon, she couldn't have cared less.  There are so many other delicious restaurants with better service and prices that I will not be coming back to this one.

First off, drinks are not cheap. My friend and I came here to have a couple of beers at the notion of $2 PBRs. Well after ordering a round they served them in 8 oz. cups. Any other beer is $3.50 and up. Another rather upsetting part is that the bar has a $10 minimum on card policy in which they only have one tiny sign for at one side of the bar. Bartender was inattentive and we waited around 5 minutes for a beer after each round. I have not seen a show here but couldn't imagine the acoustics with a sunken cast-away stage. I would suggest drinking at home over this place.

I ordered a pizza from this place awhile ago and it was great, the second time I ordered however, they sent me the wrong pizza so I called and they gave me a replacement credit for my next order.  Unfortunately my replacement pizza was disgusting!!   I couldn't even eat half of it before I started feeling sick and throwing up!  I threw up for awhile and had to shower afterwards, even the smell of the pizza was disguising!!  I had to throw out the trash, change clothe, take shower and it's still giving me nausea just to think of it.  I don't recommend this place.  Better off going to Blaze Pizza or Piology!

This review is exclusively for the bakery. (The rest of the grocery, produce/meat, etc are great!!) the bakery has terrible service. The people were nice enough. I ordered a cake 4 days ago. Was called the day of to be told they didn't have the flavor we ordered. Then went to pick it up & the name was spelled wrong (it was an online order so it was typed out correctly). The poor girl tried her best to fix it but it still looked terrible. Redeeming factor - I got 1/2 off for my terrible cake. Very disappointed. Will not order or recommend.

This is a few steps above basic Americanized Mexican food.  We have eaten here several times, at least five times, and the service is terrific.  Very personable and helpful waiters!  Some of the items on their menu are great, while everything is at least very good.  I tried the molcajete bowl and will order it again after I try a few other different dishes first.  The interior is bright and festive, the margaritas are tasty, the salsa is spicy, the food is consistent.  Four stars says "Yay! I'm a fan." and I definitely agree.  If you see a five star review from me, that really means something, and Santa Fe is almost there.

I love, love, love Burger King.  Yes, I know it is not fine dining but I love that charbroil taste and I get the condiments I like not the ones the restaurant is pushing.  Hey, to each his own.  

However, this is one of my least favorite locations.  Yesterday at lunch was no exception.  Inattentive staff at the front counter.  I had to repeat the order three times.  It was not all that complicated.  Add that to cold fries and this was the middle of lunch in a busy restaurant you can see why this is not my favorite location.  

I will still be a Burger King fan but will always try to go to a different location.

Our party of eight dined here the Wed. before Thanksgiving.  We wanted to eat here because we saw their recipe for Brussel sprouts in the New York Times. The food was exceptional.  I am from out of town, and this is the best meal I've had in a long time.  The duck breast with risotto was exceptional, as was the flank steak.  All of our appetizers were well seasoned and interesting.  The Brussel sprouts was the winner, living up to the reviews it received in the Times.  Add to this the great service we received, and we were pleased to have visited Josephine for our Thanksgiving meal out.

Very disappointed in my experience at Benini's. Waiter was attentive but rude. Expressed his displeasure when some people in my party didn't order drinks. Knew nothing about the menu and couldn't answer questions. We watched a pizza we ordered sit out for 15 minutes before it was brought over... Cold. I expressed that I had a food allergy and he brought my dinner with an item that contained that allergy, and fixed it by scrapping it off the plate & giving it back. The food was pretty good but I was so distracted by the crappy service to really enjoy it.

We have been to this place several times. Usually, it is very quiet. The staff are always nice and the food is very good.  

The spicy crab salad was well received by my brother in law. We always get the beef negamaki which is very good. There are several rolls, like the casino roll, which have been great each time. 

The presentation is very good. In fact, it's excellent. There are lights and flowers and artistic drawings on the plate. The dishes come in varying sizes and shapes which helps with the presentation. 

I like this place because it is quaint and always has a seat available.

Looked up great sushi places in Philly  and though this place ranked 1 below Morimoto,  omg!! NOT to compare.  The sushi was OK. Very little atmosphere to say the least.  We were a party of 4 squeezed together.  The waitress was meh! Worst is that the food was so meh! And the prices ridiculous for what you got.
If you want great sushi and atmosphere this is not the place!  Splurge on MORIMOTO.
If you like ok sushi and mediocre atmosphere with some neon lighting to give you the feeling that you may be someplace special than Fat Salmon it is!

Some changes to the new menu that I have to give thumbs down to...but that's just personal opinion. Ordered a cheeseburger for lunch on Friday...cooked medium rare, with shredded lettuce (stressed the shredded lettuce)...what I got was more of a cold hockey puck with a big piece of lettuce. Was over cooked even if I had requested well done, I was charged .50 cents for the lettuce that wasn't even shredded. Cheese was not melted, which leads me to believe that I received a left over burger sitting on the grill after lunch rush. Disappointed, I used to love spatolas burgers.

I arrived to a line of about 20 people waiting on cars. No cars were in sight. I am Emerald Club member and there were no cars in the Emerald Club section or any other. I was told they overbooked. After about a 40 minute wait I had a car, unfortunately I had to cancel a meeting and reschedule it for a future date.

In my travels the St. Louis National and the San Antonio National locations seem to be constantly overbooked and the cars are regularly dirty.

For perspective I travel 3 weeks out of the month and almost exclusively use National so I visit a substantial amount of their locations.

I had never heard of Frank Papas and because of its low key signage out front I never noticed it, even though I had driven past hundreds of times. This place is fantastic! I was with 5 girlfriends and we each ordered a half portion of something different and sampled each others (we also had apps, salads and dessert - all delicious!) but the pastas were amazing!!! And now I know I want the cannelloni all to myself the next time I go back. So fresh. Also, I wish I remembered our waitresses name, but she has been there forever and was the sweetest, most helpful person who absolutely went above and beyond. Go there!!!!

Wonderful! Met Dr. Thomas at a routine exam at Costco and she found some visual problems I had been living with for years undiagnosed. She wrote me a special prescription for glasses and in 1 month my life has changed. I came to her office at Cimarron for my re-check and I was fixed! Less headaches, anxiety, dizziness and my vision is great again. She is incredibly talented, passionate, knowledgeable and friendly. I can't possibly repay her for the increase in my quality of life shes given me. If you have visual problems this is who you should see!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Honestly I hate to do this because I have been here previously and it was great.
But tonight when I got my entree I had hair wrapped up in my pasta so I discretely told my server and his response was 
" we don't have women in the kitchen"
That pissed  me off and it's honesty why I'm now writing this review  because although it did seem to be female hair and I am female it def was not mine 
It was wrapped up deep in the dish
He also kept forgetting everything I asked for prior to the incident so clearly he sucked. 
the owner said nothing.
I won't go back
I would also like to add men can have long hair too

Declining standards at Uncle Classic...

I have had some excellent, some good, some mediocre and some lousy haircuts at Uncle Classic Barbershop in Brentwood.  Today was a new low.  The barber (a young, cheerful and well-meaning woman) failed to cut my hair to the length I desired. She did not shave my neck (something I have always received from Uncle's barbers).  She got so much of the hair down my neck and back that I had to shower a second time when I got home.  And she failed to shampoo my hair, even though that was part of the scheduled service.  I may return to Uncle, but I will never let this person near me again.

My wife and I have had several dining and takeout experiences here before. They've mostly been good and the food is decent.

Today however, when I placed a take-out order, I requested no capers to be put on my fettuccine Alfredo. This has been done several times before and I can't stand capers. The person on the phone basically argued with me that they were never put on there before.

OK, so I complete my order and as I pay with my credit card I get asked about giving a tip.

Really!? This is a takeout order. It was more than awkward and uncomfortable

Great place to stay and dog friendly!!!

This is our second time staying here with our Jack Russell Terrier. We stay in one of the 2 bedroom suites. What a pleasure to feel like you're "home". 2 really nice bedrooms and 2 baths (master with a claw foot tub and separate large shower!  Full kitchen with stove, microwave and dish washer. Dining room table and living room. 

Marriott Rewards member price can't be beat at $199/night!  (November 2011) 

Can't imagine staying any place else when we visit the area....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Excellent unique ice cream...bottom line.

Be ready for a wait during peak hours but even when we got there and the line was literally out the door, we only waited 20-25 minutes.  The wait was worth it.  The staff is friendly and encourage you to try flavors (don't be a hog though, try a couple and order there will likely be ALOT of people behind you).  While pricey for the amount of ice cream you get it is well worth it.  I've never seen such unique flavors and toppings.  

Another nice touch is they have a pitcher of water to wash your palette with.  If you're in town, definitely stop in for an unforgettable taste of ice cream

We've been anxiously awaiting the opening of Angelo's, and it certainly didn't disappoint! My husband and I stopped by the other day for a slice. I had a backwards, and my husband had buffalo. They were both excellent - and large! I loved the sauce, and the crust had wonderful texture and flavor. My husband also ordered a bowl of chicken soup and said it was obvious the soup was homemade - really tasty. The restaurant was adorable with comfortable seating, and the menu looked fantastic. I also have to mention Angelo's iced tea - fresh and delicious. I'm so glad they opened in our neighborhood! We certainly will be back. A lot!

The ambiance is pretty cool - really nice inside.

I was underwhelmed by the food.  Maybe it's just because I was at Vic Sushi around the corner last week, but while the fish was good, it's was expensive.  The nigiri pieces were also on the smaller side and the roll selection seemed limited.  Also, our green tea was tepid in temperature and the miso soup was barely warmer than the tea.  

Especially for the money, I'd rather go to Fat Salmon/Vic Sushi/Raw/Kisso.  There's just no compelling reason to spend Rittenhouse prices to eat good, but not outstanding sushi.

Let me begin by saying there are far too many good hotel choices for you to waste your money at this hotel!  I will keep it short by saying, they ran out of food, they were understaffed, and for two days and several stops by the front desk,  my room was NEVER serviced!
When Corinna, guest relations, emailed me( while I was still in the hotel), she asked how she could give me a discount on a future stay.
HOW ABOUT MAKE THIS STAY BETTER.

So to make it "right", I need to come spend more money at your hotel????  There are much better guest relations and solid performing hotels nearby to consider the Staybridge as an option!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
They put almost no sauce on their pizza. I always ask for extra sauce and they used to put lots of extra right on top (almost too much, a little soupy, but whatever). Recently they started charging $1 more for extra sauce which was completely fine with me except that they didn't put any extra sauce!! I posted some pics to show how large parts of the pizza have literally no sauce on them. The pizza is also very doughy and you have to ask for it well done to get it even a little crispy. 


On a positive note, the wings are crispy, saucy, and delicious! Delivery is usually fast too.

Food was alright. I had the Shrimp and Ravioli special. It was not flavorful, but the raviolis were perfect and homeade. Additionally the shrimp were high quality gulf coast shrimp, but only three!

My fiance had the Chicken Cacciatore. It was very good, if a little dry.

The reason I am not giving Ralph's a higher rating is that it promotes itself as fully authentic and yet makes its Tiramisu with CREAM CHEESE!!! not MARSCAPONE. They have also replaced rum and marsala soaked ladyfingers with Kahluah soaked lady fingers. It was the grossest Tiramisu ever. Very disappointing..

I'm regularly disappointed with this location.. They over charged me for my crawfish and we had a couple of their prepared items just out of curiosity.. we didn't feed it to the cat for obvious reasons..  There is no excuse for the fish sandwich when you can get a popeyes flounder sandwich for $1 more, they tell you not to expect cheese rather than just forgetting to put it on.. I mean really?  A fish and cheese sandwich has Three ingredients if you're not planning to dress it, how could they forget 1 of the three ingredients?  This is what we used to call "nobody's best effort".

The Fireside Lounge is my favorite place to go in the Peppermill in Reno, Nevada.  Playing Poker on the machines at the bar and being served creative drinks by their great and friendly bartender, Mark,  is such a fun experience!    The round fireplace with its video musical concerts to watch is a cozy way to relax after all the excitement at the bar.  I hope it never changes, as this is a real winner!!! This is such a great experience that my boyfriend and I can't wait to go back every chance we get!  We highly recommend the Fireside Lounge and the  Peppermill in Reno, Nevada .

This location gets no stars! I only chose 1 so that this will post. The manager is completely disrespectful! DO NOT GO TO THIS LOCATION! CHOOSE ANOTHER RENTAL CAR COMPANY! I almost lost my salvation on the manager, she couldn't even look me in the eye when I came to the counter to check out. I spoke with her the day before about removing my insurance that I did not need because my company covers it and she still said that because they are a private company they operate differently. National Rental needs to be notified that there are locations that use their name and do not even have high expectations when it comes to customer service.

If your into Nigiri sushi like me I would not recommend this place for you. Don't get me wrong it's a nice scenery, sushi specialty rolls are great taste. And their hibachi steak and chicken is really good. But if you are looking for all you can eat I wouldn't recommend it here. They put so much rice on their nigiri, or any sushi. And they put too much rice vinegar sauce on their rice.  It just seems like they were packing their sushi to get you full faster.  As I think as it is like food court since it right at an shopping outlet area. Easy to go to after a long day from shopping. Service was ok. Kid friendly.

Pass by and was surprised it was a Chinese Restaurant.  It's very clean, very modern.
The prices were reasonable. I didn't have to wait long. It was around 3:30PM. What amazed me with my meal was that it was so fresh. I had a lovely egg drop soup piping hot, smooth a satin. I order shrimp lo mein.  The sauce was light and tasty. Not like many others that I had that were stuck together like glue and too sweet.
A side of dipping sauce and crispy wide noodles. And mainly, it was quite, away from the street noise. So calm. It was a very enjoying meal.

Providence Wine & Spirits has totally abandoned customer service. I was in there Saturday, not only did no one speak when I came in, nobody offered to assist my wine purchase, but worst of all NOT even a thank you after the purchase. The young man who "helped" us (by help I mean took my money) snapped at me to bring my purchase to the back counter, instead of the front counter. I tried to see the rude young mans nametag but I could not find it. I have no interest in shopping at a place that is rude and can not force out a thank you for a purchase.

The staff overall was very friendly and super nice but there was a housekeeping lady (seemed like a manager or supervisor) who had a bad attitude.I asked a question about my room not being cleaned as it was already after 5pm. There is nothing more annoying than being out all day and still the room is not cleaned. She gave me some excuse around the towels were hanging so they left them but what about the beds and trash etc. Poor customer service for someone who seems to be in charge. Otherwise the rest of the staff was super nice, the room was clean when it was cleaned, breakfast was good and the pool was clean and enjoyable.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: First of all, they need to teach their VERY young staff that a landline phone must be placed back on the receiver before a takeout order can be placed. I called repeatedly for over 20 minutes and the phone was off the hook the whole time. I went down to the restaurant to place my order in person and to advise them of the phone problem. The boy behind the counter looked at me as if I were crazy. I placed my order of a chimichanga with no rice and extra beans. Well, I got lots of rice and NO beans. I've tried this place a couple of times. The food is pretty good, I will say that. The staff on the other hand, well that's a different story..

This was our go-to place, but after today we may reconsider. Do not let Jade cut your hair. She butchered my boyfriend's hair and mine.
I asked for a bang trim and she cut it in the opposite direction from where I part. She also mumbles terribly, so I couldn't understand what she was saying. The sides of bangs have straight, blunt cuts.
My boyfriend asked for a shampoo after his cut (to rid of any loose hair) and she cut it AGAIN after shampooing. Now it's super short on the sides.
. . . I told him he looks like Zorg from Fifth Element . . .

Place is always hit or miss everyone looks either lost or annoyed that they have to do work. God forbid you hand them an e-mail coupon they're too lazy to cash by hand it since they don't supply a barcode. They've messed up my drink several times one I had someone pour carmel over a latte i had ordered   Because they accidentally gave me mocha. Instead of making a new one she squirted caramel over top as if i wouldn't notice. The only good thing about this place is that its clean, and the only thing un can order with no issue is a donut anything else is asking too much of them. Horrible service avoid this place

Their all-you-can-eat sushi is decent but doesn't hold a candle to Takamatsu as far as quality, service, or value (and Takamatsu is cheaper).  The sushi itself is okay, but not as good as Takamatsu.  Service is usually pretty poor, which is an added problem when you are paying for all you can eat--the last 2 or 3 times I went I was still hungry when the rest of the table was finished because they kept losing my orders.  Also, the last time I went I discovered that now you can only get one order of tuna (not toro or anything fancy, just normal yellowfin tuna, which is usually the staple fish of AYCE menus).

Received a delivery of tacos, nachos, and beans & rice. 

The steak taco had little meat cubes that were almost beef jerky. The carnitas (ground beef) and chicken tacos were good. No cheese on them. I put spicy red sauce on them. I'd order those two again.

The house nachos with steak and ground beef were not good. The tortillas were thick and cut small, and sat on the bottom of the dish like cement fish. I FOUND A BONE IN THE NACHOS. Well that ended that. 

The beans and rice were unbelievably bland. Perhaps this is authentic peasant food, but spices don't cost much here in the States. 

Move on.

If you like your car and want a nice clean car, then this is not the place.

Automatic car wash and hand cleaning. They focus on quantity not quality.
They dont give much attention to the bumpers, wheels and spoiler.
I've experienced much better hand car wahes with same price.

For inside outside cleaning they charge $20. And i had to ask them many times that bumpers are not clean, there still were mud patches on the car.

And if you have aftermarket wheels, just forget it that they will be cleaned.

I will not recommend this place.

I had dinner recently.  I ordered the Pomegranate Chicken with a salad and Asparagus.  Val the bartender was very attentive and fun.  I think her service was great.  When my chicken arrived tho, it was obvious it had been frozen, then thawed before they cooked it.  The meat was not moist and juicy but tough and a little dry.  The pomegranate sauce was outstanding tho.  I finished with a blueberry type crumb cake and ice cream that was really good. 

I'd love to see them work on what is available on the menu and offer more choices.

You've gotta be s****ing me with these reviews. This place was terrible. We were brought the wrong appetizer from what we ordered. The salads were meh and basic.. The lasagna that was so called out of this world was the thinnest I've ever had. My wife's meal could have passed for chef-boy-r-dee. Ambiance was loud as we were seated next to a large party when every other table was open,, and could hardly hear each other. Really wanted the place to succeed since it is a byob italian right down the road, but I live in Philly, way too many good restaurants around to return to this one.

Nice lobby, friendly staff, decent continental breakfast, even though the furniture was worn the room was clean. As we were going to bed I noticed the smoke detector was missing. I went to call down stairs to notify them and the phone didn't work. I had to use my cell phone to call. I let them know and there didn't seem to be a sense of urgency. I was told if there was a fire I would definitely hear the alarm because they are loud. What if the fire started in my room?!? The next day the smoke detector was installed and phone was fixed. I'm just wondering how many other rooms are missing the smoke detector?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We came here for the 1st time 2 years ago because the reviews were so great. Our food was average and price high. Cheese plate was the best part of the meal. We came here  again 2 years later again based on reviews and because i wanted to give them a 2nd chance. I am sorry to say it was a let down. Cheese plate was great and our beet salad was good. My duck was chevy and my hubby's lamb chops fatty and came with soggy veggies. For $100 meal with no alcohol i would expect a lot better. Really wanted to like this place too.

Why am I reviewing this? It's a fast food joint that is typically operated by kids that either consistently mess up orders or what condiments you want with your order. It's amazing when they actually get it right and that they actually put out some decent food. I like the Classic Chicken sandwich but  I'll be damned if they can ever put enough mayo on the thing and spread it out evenly instead of just one dab of it on one end of the sandwich. I know, it's a fast food joint but why is it I can do it quickly when I make a sandwich at home? Non caring teenagers with attitude is why. I guess they don't want to be Jr. managers, ha!

Skip them. I got stuck with them through Expedia when booking. I paid with the company credit card, but then when I arrived to pick up the car, they said they needed my personal credit card for $200 hold. Maybe I'm inexperienced, but they have a cc number on file, use it! What everyone else said about the shuttles is true...you'll get sick from the fumes of the other companies breezing by you before Hertz picks you up. Almost missed my flight on return because the shuttles were just sitting in the lot not moving. I will never, never use Hertz again, but eff-em...I got a Chevy Aveo over 80.

11/10/2010 -$55 for 2 people, one full size bed, Exhausted and late at night so I figure I could stand sharing a bed for one night, The manager gives me room card and tells me the room number out loud in front of other people that were in the lobby. I find the room, (outside corridor),  insert card key and when I open the door, I find a man in his underwear, sitting at the desk. We all screamed and I apologized profusely.  We went back to manager and asked for a cancellation, he didn't seem to understand why I would want one, kept saying _"It was a simple mistake." But I finally convinced him we were not staying and he issued me a refund.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Had dinner with the family the other night and every one of us was delighted with our selection.  The food was delicious and the portions were extremely generous.  We could not eat it all and brought home the leftovers.  They were equally delicious the next day. Our grandson ordered a pizza and the crust......oh, my!  I'm only giving 4 stars because the establishment was on the warm side and we were uncomfortable. Maybe if the paddle fans had been turned on it would have been cooler.  Will this keep us from coming back?  Heck, no!  We'll be back this weekend to try other things on the menu.

Came anticipating a delicious brunch. 
I will start off by staying I was extremely excited about the lox Benedict... 
cold, non toasted English muffin, WAYYYY too much of the fish, like an over powering amount. The eggs were okay.  
The hash browns were cold and undercooked. 
No seasoning whatsoever- on anything. 
My boyfriend got the French toast and bacon. The French toast was okay, bacon was over cooked and definitely kept under a heat lamp. 
Mimosas were overpriced and just meh- no real comment. 
Overpriced and overrated- definitely will not be returning.
More so aimed for the baby boomer church goers.

This place needs to be removed from Grubhub if it is not going to hold true to deliveries and food. 
I will be receiving a refund, cancelled my order after an hour and a half of waiting I was extremely irritated and no longer hungry. I was told a 35-45min wait not over an hour and a half. Despite cancelling, 15 minutes later (1 hr 45mins) the order was delivered. 
None the less, food was cold, and not even the correct nor full order. The delivery guy was apologetic, but unfortunately that doesn't make up for the lack of communication on his or the restaurants poor service. 
I will no longer be using this business.

Ordered 16 inch pizza, fries and onion rings. Let me start by saying the food is really reasonable priced. The pizza was good but a little greasy for my liking. The fries were really good, crispy on the outside  and fluffy on the inside. However the onion rings were awful, they were over fried almost burnt, they were hard almost like they were left over and refried for my order. If I was in a restaurant I would have sent them back. I lived 15 minutes from the take out place and my other food would have been cold if I drove them back.
I would give this place another try with something on the menu.

The food was wonderful.  The food parings were well thought out, and the seasoning was spot on.  The Amuse Bouche was a Foie Gras soup that was the highlight of the evening for me, except maybe the beetroot ice icream and chocolate macaroon.  Our server was attentive and thoughtful.  My only complaints: the Spring Lamb dish could have used more acid to cut the richness of the bernaise sauce, and there are far too many tables in the small restaurant.  I could barely get out from behind my table, and walkways are blocked by badly placed tables.

This place is just okay.  I read the reviews and decided to take a co-worker here for their last day with the company and I wish I hadn't.  Just generic, okay food.  Service was fine, though they certainly aren't giving anything away.  Expensive food, small portions and it's not worth what you pay for it.  The ambiance is non existent and the menu is not impressive.  Perhaps hearing how good it was before going was the kiss of death, as I was not impressed and neither of the young ladies that I dines with were either.  You could spend much less for food that is just as good or better.  I'm not going there to simply keep them in business.

Sushi was outstanding but we had an hour wait for 3 rolls...

Apparently a chef quit while we there so the waitress, Yasmine, gave us free sake. Not bad. 

I could tell that the restaurant was trying to keep up with the overflowing amount of customers and with the new issue of a chef quitting. Even though we had a long wait the food was excellent.

 If my girlfriend and I go again it will be on a weekday...not Friday night.

Things to note: loud music, college scene, not a ton of space, friendly/courteous staff, great sushi

The store has a great atmosphere, with an upstairs seating area, vaulted ceilings, exposed wood beams, and sky lights. The store was updated and very clean. 

The slices are enormous - basically the size of two pieces of what you would normally expect. The pizza itself was delicious. The crust is a great thickness in both the crust and the center, with a delicious flavor. The sauce on the pepperoni pizza was a little sweeter IMO than most places, which I really like. The white pizza with spinach, tomato, and Ricotta was also delicious. I will be frequenting this place.

09/05/2020, 2:10pm. Do you want possible COVID19 exposure?
Lady allowed to remove mask while waiting to pick up food at counter (near the drive-thru window and where they package orders) and right next to customers wearing masks waiting to order.
When asked about a mask, she pointed towards a table.
Staff said/did nothing - So they must be okay with NOT WEARING A MASK (fake news or not, its currently against policy during a WORLDWIDE pandemic).
We left and won't be back (have been coming here since they opened).
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Very good service, nice ambiance, its semi-fancy, not pretentious.
Appetizer: Very good fried green tomatoes topped with crab meat; but a little expensive for the size of the dish
Entree: lasagna was very tasty; veal parmigiana, tasty as well. The only problem is that both of these dishes tasted EXACTLY the same (minus the veal). They need to add variety and creativity if all the marinara-containing  dishes are equally seasoned.
Dessert: bread pudding: a little on the sweet side but very good
Other: Delicious warm bread.The owner walks around making sure everyone is satisfied with their food.

Lunch early (11am) on a recent Friday, so it wasn't overly crowded.  Waiter seemed to be doing us a favor to stop by, service lately seems to be heading in that direction.  No refills on drinks, no checking back.  The food was barely OK, but nothing to match the prices.  When you're paying top price for entrees and then on top they want $1.50 for tortillas, that seems a little overboard.  Used to enjoy this place a lot more, probably won't be back (and they need to learn to make beans--when a basic like that has no flavor, it's kinda downhill from there.)

I have been a regular customer at this location and have always been impressed by the service and friendliness of the team.
Unfortunately, the recent management staff changes have not been a positive move for this location. The staff starting with Manager, Melvin is cold and indifferent. I am used to being picked up around 7:30 -- 7:45 in the morning, to which now they areb refusing to do so. They tell you cars are unavailable despite making reservations in advance. Arranged pick up at 2:00 PM, called to remind at 1:30 and was told that I need to come in.
This locations is going downhill...fast!

Hotel itself is ok, room was humid but the staff has the absolute worst attitude I've ever seen in 20 years of traveling.  From the entrance where the taxi dropped me off the attendant was smoking and eating a sandwich.  He didn't even acknowledge I was there until I asked him what floor to go to for check-in.  Then the check-in person seemed bothered that I walked up to the desk.  After getting into my room I went back down to get water and toiletries and the check-in person pointed to the wall.  Nothing but attitude the entire time.  Then I asked where I can get water and she went off.  Never coming back to this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The Good
Excellent pizza, and calzones.
Good lunch specials. 
Cheesesteaks are OK. 
Salads are OK. I like a good salad however can't put my finger on why they don't thrill me. 


The Bad
I've been getting pizza here for years. Close to work and home. The large pie is the smallest around. It does not even fill the box. It's been this way for a while now. Large pizza price in a medium size. 

Delivery has always been suspect. Only had delivery a few times however they took 2 hours when I ordered several pies for a poker game. Pizza came cold. They couldn't find my house. Other's don't have that issue.

Servers need to be trained properly, or at least told that it is rude to push the check on to paying customers before they are done eating or able to order something else from the menu. It is in the best interest of sushi garden to remind employees they the dinning experience is the only thing that separates a sit down restaurant from a fast food chain where a no "tip" is involved.  The server came twice to my table to push the check letting us know her shift was done and she needed us to hurry up. Not going back to this location!

There are so many fake japanese restaurants in Indiana,most of them are owned by Chinese or Koreans. The sushi club is one of the top fake restaurants. Their fish is not fresh,by no means sushi or sashimi level; I was served by a really young kid, who I guess is a server's daughter, how can they allow such a young kind to work for them? The all you can eat sushi is definitely overpriced,there is very limited choice, the options are significantly less than the regular menu. With the same or lower price,you can actually go to Asaka!

First let me say the return was nice and quick and the guy there was pleasant. The car was OK.The woman at the rental car counter was a b**ch.She gave me the hard up sell on the upgrade to a premium car .. A Chevy Impala,news flash Budget, an Impala is not a premium car.Then the hard up sell for the liability insurance which my personal auto policy covers and my charge card covers secondary, She insisted I was wrong.PLEASE BUDGET TRAIN YOUR PEOPLE NOT TO LIE.We know they are on commission to up sell. Would have used again if not for the counter woman.

Food was good and the waiter was nice but we had a similar experience as some of the other customers ` posts  in regards to being rushed through the entire meal. As soon as we were finished with our desserts, one of the hostesses was getting impatient with us - wanting to clear our glasses, etc. Owner was pretty much the same way as we overheard some comments he made as well.  There are plenty of other BYOB restaurants in the surrounding areas that we have gone to and never had an experience like this. We will not be returning to this one.

Another gourmet donut shop, like many gourmet cupcake shops, starts with a crappy donut that you (have to) "get to" over compensate that fact by piling as much crap on top of it as you can! Publix donuts are way better and that's not saying much, but Publix are better than Dunkin' Donuts and DD is better than these.

They should advertise as a coffee shop, the coffee is way way better than the donuts. Or they could try to master a traditional donut and then add the Razzle Dazzle once they get the base product right.

I'd go back for the coffee but I'll pass on the Razzle, Dazzle and the donut.

Don't try and use your Axxess card here... after ordering we were told that we'd have to order 2 drinks at $3/each to get the deal.. and when I mentioned that this was not on the axxess website or in the book, they told us that we were lucky they were taking it at all, since it was summer. The food was not much better than the service, the  shrimp fajitas had barely any shrimp, and the chili relleno was mushy and tasteless. I live in Carp and have eaten here many times over the years, and both the food and service have really gone downhill... we will not be going back again.

Although the wings are excellent, when I went gluten free I was a little dismayed. My boyfriend called once to get the female on the phone and she was rude at giving him an answer on whether the wings were gluten free. I just recently called hoping to talk to someone different who would know more information and the guy did not even ATTEMPT to check for me. Unfortunately, they have lost my business. If you are not gluten free (which is the majority of people) then this place is just fine. If you have any food allergies at all, most likely they will not have answers for you. I use to love this place.

We were very excited to try this new spot after reviewing the yelp ratings and sadly were left disappointed.  We started with the special antipasta, a nice selection.  The lasagna was lacking in flavor other than salt, the lobster ravioli dish was generous on seafood but overall lacking in flavor and too fishy.  Finished with the Creme brûlée cheesecake, a nice surprise after mediocre entrees.

Perhaps we are used to Modo Mio's level of ingredients and flavor.  Either way, great to see a local restaurant addition to the neighborhood.  We wish them the best of luck.

This place is the worst. Yes, it's an airport restaurant, but the mentality that "our customers don't have a choice so let's have terrible food and over charge" is an awful way to run a business. Chicken was frozen. Wings were not cooked to order (sauce had congealed). Guacamole was heavily diluted with lime juice so much so that it was akin to sour patch kids. They didn't even microwave the nachos long enough to melt the cheese. I sound real bitchy but this place was horrible. Slow as hell too which doesn't help at the airport. 2 glasses of wine, 1 beer, nachos, and wings = $75. Neat.

I was really excited when I moved to the area and has a taco shop close to my house. 

Then I went inside... It's a dirty mess, but I thought maybe it's just "character". I've had some of the best tacos of my life in some not so nice looking places. This place is not one of those.

The tacos my wife and I got were really bland. There was a salsa included which was basically watered down tomatoes. We had one of every flavor so I'm sure it wasn't a one-off. 

If you're in the area, skip this place. Or on second thought, go to the restaurant which replaces it when they are out of business

Pretty good sushi, I'd categorize it as standard high quality with the normal selection. For me, it was the wasabi and ginger that set Samurai apart, it was very strong and flavorful. The wait was pretty long and the service was standard. Prices were standard as well. If you are looking for a reliable, quality sushi place in midtown and don't mind the wait, this is your place. Ninki and Taki are of similar quality if they are closer to you. Doesn't displace my top choice for sushi in Nashville though: Dear Sushi.

Saturday afternoon and our 16 year old cat was in pain and dying. The Human Society would not schedule an appointment for me on Sunday because they were full. The HS supervisor balked at scheduling my cat for Monday, although they had an 8:30 opening. She told me to just call Banfield. So I called Banfield. The man I spoke with was not helpful or caring. He said they were booked for the next week to week and a half and could not euthanize our pained cat. He said he could not refer me to any other professional. Period. 
As a result, I would not recommend this location if they won't listen and help when an animal and its owner are desperate.

On Saturday 8/18/2018 just before 6pm I was at coyote wash when Marge an employee who was off duty came up to me an said "I don't know why your mad at me stop trying to get me fired. Just shut your mouth. JUST SHUT YOUR MOUTH." The reason why we left in the first place was she was very rude to me. We went back to Coyote Wash when she was not there so we would not have to deal with her. I have emailed the owner but have not heard anything back, yet. I will not be going back to Coyote Wash because of Marge. And I will let people know what she has done to us.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Do you want bad pizza, overpriced pizza? Then this is for you. Chain pizza isn't as good as your local pizza shop but the understanding is that it's supposed to be cheaper. This is as expensive as the much better pizzerias, of which there are several better just a few blocks away. Looking for a cheaper pizza? 7-Eleven down the street makes an okay pepperoni pizza for $5.50. Dominos and Pizza Hut are also nearby. 

The only reason this place still exists is that it's within walking distance of the West Chester University dorms.

Zero stars.  We had a rental reserved, arrived at TPA at about 10:30 pm, got to the rental counter at 10 :45.  Didn't talk with an agent until 11:45.  Now we're waiting for a car and there are 30+ people with reservations ahead of us.  It's 12:30 am and we're all paying for cars we don't have  Thrifty/Hertz has no cars here at the terminal.  This is a mess.  We can't go elsewhere because it's midnight and no other car rental desks are open.  All of us are stuck.  The CEO of Thrifty should be fired for this mismanagement.  Never again will we rent from Thrifty or Hertz.

I drive past this location pretty much every day and when I saw a nail bar was coming, I got excited. So weeks pass and I'm waiting for the coming soon sign to change to grand opening. The time has finally come and I am very happy with my choice to have my nails and feet done here. They are still working on a few minor installments on the stations but it's well designed and decorated. They even offer wine with their services. I kinda hate I'm relocating soon, I would have become a regular customer. Planning to get by again before I leave town.

I've been coming to Mike's (now Crew) for years. I've always been satisfied with the results and customer service. Last Monday, I entered the wash, followed the usual instructions, put it in neutral, etc. half way through, the conveyor stops and I get rear-ended by a huge SUV. After several minutes, they got us out and took our information. The manager didn't explain anything, nor say "sorry" to any of the five customers involved. At a minimum, the associates, and definitely the manager, should have said, "here's what happened, we're so sorry, here's a coupon for a wash, etc". Nothing. The manager did say, "this happens all the time". What?

I like the place, the food is always excellent, the wine list plentiful and service top notch. The only reason I don't give it 5* is because it sits in the middle of the casino and tobacco smoke smell permeates everything which spoils the experience. I had lobster bisque which was stellar and their sea bass special with shrimp that was outstanding. It is easy to overcook seabass and this one was moist and flakey as it should - a real performance since we had 18 people for dinner and all our foods arrived cooked perfectly. Top prices too go with the quality but well worth it.

We still love this place and my other review shows it. But we tried two new dishes that we wont' be ordering again. Stuffed shells and lasana. Both were a mess of melted cheese. There was no balance of flavors. Just a plop of melted cheese, not very tasty or sophisticated.

Also, as usual, the bread was slightly stale and the butter doesn't taste like full butter, some kind of butter/margarine mixture that I don't like.

But ah well. Their lamb chop starter is amazing and their pasta with garlic and olive oil is delicious.

I live on the mainline and go to a LOT of restaurants in the area and in Philly.  Third try at Plate again last night - 3 strikes and they are OUT.  Our Waitress (who never even had a HINT of a smile on her face) could not have cared LESS about simple courtesy, service, or promptness.  We almost walked out because from the time our dinner plates were cleared (VERY Ho Hum food, WAY overpriced...) it was OVER 40 MINUTES until dessert arrived!!!  Fine - we are DONE.  We will NOT be back and I intend to spread the word to all of my clients and colleagues about how totally disappointing plate is...

Visited there for lunch with my wife. Ordered the mussels that were of a repugnant variety but ok in how executed. The service was poor, server very inattentive even after few people left from lunch hour. My cheeseburger was overpriced and of medium quality. My wife has a roasted beet salad, she said she liked it. Why the two stars, prices too high, service fair at best and a menu written to justify high prices. Lastly limited selections. More like a child trying to prove he is the smartest in the room just a little too hard. Skip this stop.

We have been coming here for about a year but the service is so bad I doubt we come again. They are nice till you try and use a coupon! Pizza in the past has been good but the place is dirty. If the tall girl with shoulder length black hair is not related  would get rid of her just for her attitude. I don't mind paying for good pizza but hold the tude!

Dumb bit went again...pizza was a joke. The outside 3 inches, had no cheese, no sauce a a very small amount of toppings. Not your typical Mountain Mikes. Don't waste your time or money.

Only tried the pizza but it wasn't that great.  Well, it may have been good if it wasn't severely under-cooked.  The pizza slid right off the slice it was so under-cooked.  Might give it another try to see if it was an anomaly but wasn't thrilled with what I got.  Prices were fair, slices were standard size and the atmosphere is what you would expect of a small pizza joint.  Some locals were hanging out taking up a few tables,  you can tell they frequent the place a lot. Not a lot of traffic for the lunchtime which can be telling for some places.

The 4-star rating is based on what I was expecting and what I actually was getting. 

This place is a great alternative to the Motel 6 next door.  The rates are better and the bathroom, besides having a nicer decor than expected, has a hair dryer.  A big deal if you have long hair. The rooms are a pretty good size and the exterior is rather cute. The staff is a friendly, helpful bunch. 

This a better than expected 2-star place.  If you are looking for a clean, well-priced place to hang your hat while you're out enjoying yourself at the beach or shopping in SB and don't mind a 10-15 min drive, then this is a good place to go.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The Bobby Pin Hair Gallery is AS GREAT as it gets. Daniel has transformed my hair from just ok to AMAZING!!! They have such a warm, friendly atmosphere, I really enjoy my time there. Daniel has a passion for hair & it comes across in many ways, he LISTENS to what your concerns are, educates you and really focuses his attention on what he is there to do... AWESOME HAIR!!!  For the first time in my life, people stop me and compliment me on my hair & I send them to The Bobby Pin, because everyone deserves GREAT hair!!!

*Went here on a Sunday for dinner* we ordered a bunch of starters and shared them. The restaurant itself was airy and it had a cool historic theme. A little hard to hear because the ceilings were high and sound bounced off them. The appetizers were good I would recommend the mac and cheese because they put sweet tomatoes in top. The full plate which was a meat and cheese platter was pretty scarce but still tasted good. The sweet potato fries were dipped in a sweet sauce and were pretty good. Chicken thigh sliders were excellent. Nice dinner spot

*Went here on a Sunday for dinner* we ordered a bunch of starters and shared them. The restaurant itself was airy and it had a cool historic theme. A little hard to hear because the ceilings were high and sound bounced off them. The appetizers were good I would recommend the mac and cheese because they put sweet tomatoes in top. The full plate which was a meat and cheese platter was pretty scarce but still tasted good. The sweet potato fries were dipped in a sweet sauce and were pretty good. Chicken thigh sliders were excellent. Nice dinner spot

When you walk in you may think this restaurant is a dive but don't let the decor fool you. The Grill 2 is consistently good. From the service to the yummy food, it is always good. Unlike The Grill on Fall Creek which is an over 21 bar, this place is for families with the same menu and the same delicious food. The chicken tenders, salads, fish, and steaks are especially tasty. Almost every time we've been to the restaurant (30 to 40 times) the manager will stop by our table to check on us. The prices are reasonable and the portions are generous. A nice place to take multi generational families. Grandparents & grandkids will be happy.

This is one of the best Italian Restaurants that I have ever eaten in.  The food was flavorful and hot.  The atmosphere was superb and even though they were crowded the waiter made us feel like we were the most important people in the room.

The seafood rissotto is absolutely delicious and the seafood was fresh and not over cooked.  This place is great for dates as well as groups.  There was a family of about 30 relatives there and the restaurant took care of them without letting the other customers suffer.

This has to be one of the best places that I have ever been to in Manayunk.

I was sooooo excited about trying this place because I love Tela's Market and the food there is always good. The staff and service is superb here at Clementines and the atmosphere is great, however the chicken and waffles brunch I had was the worst I've ever tasted. The chicken was very bland and dry, and the waffle was more crunchy than I'd expected, I prefer it fluffy. The syrup wasn't any better than what I have at home and it wasn't even warm. I will probably  try Clementine's again, based on the strength of Tela's alone. However if it isn't up to snuff the second time around, won't go back and won't recommend.

I don't understand these reviews. Don't get me wrong, the food is good but the service is horrible. Unfriendly as if I'm bothering them. We went 20 minutes with empty drinks and no server. Even when we sat down, it was several minutes before our drink order was taken. Then after several more minutes, drinks were served, but again, the server left without taking our order.  We were there nearly a half an hour before our orders were taken.  

Was this place horrible? No, but it was very pretentious.  It was also loud and dark.  Again, this wasn't awful, but there are so many better choices in St. Louis. Even better choices on that very street.

These people do what pizza places should do: they offer inexpensive, fresh, good Italian food that arrives hot and garlicky. What's not to love? Their antipasti is great and a welcome change for when you don't want so many carbs. Their ridiculously buttery, garlicky bow-ties are wonderful for the other 98% of the time. One star is deducted because a couple of times (in the 10+ years I've been going there), the pizza crust was a tiny bit overdone. All in all, this unpretentious, reliable little place is a jewel to have in our town.

Very dissapointed!!!! I made a appointment over 2 weeks ago only to be called 30 mins before and having the appontment cancelled. No sorry offered and just a when would you like to rebook. I find it funny that I get told on 2 sepperate occasions that they will need 24 hours notice before i cancell yet they only give me 30 mins!!! Seems like they dont feel like my time is worth the same ammount as theirs. I will never go here and i will ensure that everyone i speak to knows about the experience i have had with this place. Horrible!!!!

Truly horrible service. I actually signed up for Yelp just to write this review.  The order taker was texting while we were ordering and my carne asada burrito came out cold. While we were waiting, another couple got a refund for their dinner and left.  The order taker didn't call out our orders when they came up so each table had to go up to see if the food was theirs. I've been here once before and the service and food wasn't as poor. Hopefully the guy that doesn't care about service and quality isn't the owner of the place and they can get rid of him.

My husband and I love our La Viola dates when we are in the city for a show, concert, or just to wander around.  We bring a bottle of wine and enjoy the atmosphere of this cozy restaurant.  This food is always very tasty and fresh.  Try their special--it's usually homemade pasta and delicious!  We always finish with their homemade tiramisu (yummmmmm!) and cappuccinos.  This restaurant can get tight when it's busy, but we often forget about the people around us.  The hostess can sometimes leave something to be desired, but the wait staff is very good!  They refill drinks quickly and are attentive.

Absolutely amazing! Came with my family on a Saturday night, reservations are strongly recommended and encouraged, and it was perfect! Since it is connected with anthropology and terrain, you really get that authentic and rustic vibe by the decor which is beautiful. The service was impeccable. We started with the Bufala Ricotta, which is an absolute must while there, and the yummy Margherita Pizza! I had the roasted chicken for dinner which was superb! Every member of my party thoroughly enjoyed their dinner. To finish off the night we enjoyed the milk and cookies as well as pistachio cheesecake! Definitely a new go to dinner spot for us!

Maybe it's hard to make a decent cappuccino (I don't know, I never tried), but Lucky Goat gets it right each time. Some of the other places in the neighborhood, not so much. The pastries are good too, always fresh. Friendly staff. Nice help-yourself jawn of water which always has some kind of fruit in it, which is good on a hot morning while waiting for the coffee. If you sit in the front you can see when the trolly's coming so you can go to work if you're not into the whole "work all day from a coffeeshop while milking a single cup of coffee" thing. (SRSLY, people, move it along after a few hours. It's not your office.)

Hotel was nice and clean.  Desk clerk Jose was very helpful.

However the cleaning staff was making a racket starting around 9am.  Laughing and shouting at each other in the hallway and talking about people and the conditions of the rooms.  They were banging on something loudly.  Impossible to get any extra sleep in the morning.  

Forget about staying an extra day. Heading to the Holiday Inn.  

11:15am and they seem to be having a party in the hallway.  Vacuuming and banging against the wall and doors.  I've never experience anything like this.   

The most inconsiderate cleaning staff ever.

I stayed July 4 2019 on the 3rd Floor.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We walked in and my husband had a bad feeling, not I am sure why or how. I was optimistic, but turns out he was right. I was pretty unimpressed. I wouldn't say anything I had was horrible, but I have had lots of tastier sushi. It's worth noting my son has eaten everything we have ever given him and he didn't like anything he tried! We joke that he eats anything, and he turned down everything. The tuna and cucumber salad I was expecting something super yummy. It was literally like tuna, cucumber and soy sauce. Again not horrible but not really great either. Overly sweet drink. Just generally underwhelmed.

People you nees to realize that any shop is going  to try and upsale you on things you don't absolutely need that is how they make their money. I may look like a stupid women who will pay whatever but I am smart and know when I am being fooled with. Bottom line just tell them no! I go in with an old car knowing it will always need work but I only want the $99 brake job and that is what I walk out paying for. Take someone with you if you have to. I never gobbled up their sale so neither should you. I rate them well because they are open when I need them and I can always just bring in same day.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Today, I brought my dog in for a second opinion and overall exam. My dog is 10y.o and was told from another vet hospital that her excessive peeing is due to old age. I am BEYOND happy I scheduled my appointment here at Garden State. She was examined by Joanne and Dr. Granite who talked me through the examination and handled my dog  professionally and kindly. I'm glad to say, my dog has received a proper diagnosis and medication as well as a plan to get her healthy and happy. The staff is very nice. Even the ladies at the front who helped checked me in and out. Again, extremely satisfied with my dog's care here.

The service is above excellent at Ralph's! From the moment you walk in everyone wants to make sure you are comfortable and satisfied. This is "team service" at its best. It's almost hard to discern who you actual sever is.  Everyone works together and the results are customers that are happy and never without anything.  Add to this service that the food is prepared fresh and to order! I love the small family style feel! I will patronize this establishment anytime over the large chain restaurants with frozen food and horrible service.

The good: Located in the heart of downtown, a short walk or cab ride to all the music, shopping, and food you can handle. Super cute, helpful and efficient valet/bellmen. Beautiful lobby and bar area with a Starbucks cafe. Well-equipped fitness room with updated ellipticals, treadmills, a recumbent bike and weights. The bad: Dark, sparse rooms typical of a lower end hotel. Makeup application impossible. Clearly you are paying for the location, and not the room. Summary: If you are looking for fancy, don't stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Your average local grocery store. Decent stock, nothing to write home about.

Biggest downside is the deli. It is an absolute disaster. Example, last time I was there 3 people were working the deli and there was about five people waiting. It took over ten mins to get three people done! If it was just a slow day for some reason I'd Let it go but for some reason this is normal. I've never seen such a thing. No matter the amount of people behind the counter or in line you will always wait at least 15-20 mins. Most of the time I don't get cold cuts now because I can't wait twenty minutes for American cheese.

I went with 5 others just last week. The service was only mediocre. 
I ordered the veal piccata, a $30 entree. not only was it just passively warm it was tough and required steak knife and a strong arm to cut it. Veal like this should be so tender you can cut it with a fork. when the waiter came to remove my place he only inquired if I wanted to bring what I have left over home not whether or not it was good.
Vivace has gone down hill quite a bit in the past year. it used to be one of my favorites. 
I sincerely hope they will stop this slide in quality before it causes serious problems.

After reading the reviews on Yelp, I wasn't sure what to expect. Come to find out the hand grenade was a very good drink. For $8 you get a good sized drink in a cool glass. The best part the refills are only $7. I am not sure of the exact location, but I would recommend visiting the smallest Tropical Isle on bourbon street, as they poured the strongest drink. I would opt for on the rocks, instead of the slushy. You also have a choice of an ice less hand grenade for $12 (maybe $15)? Try it, you won't regret it!

The salon is nice, but after two years, I found a new salon. One that appreciates their customers. My hairstylist at Aslan consistently called to rebook my appointments because of personal issues (her son had soccer, her husband was working out of town, etc. etc. etc.).  I was patient until the 6th or 7th rebook. To the owner at Aslan (Tammy) - consider employing stylists who take their jobs seriously and stop bitching about you behind your back, and train your front desk staff to treat your customers they way they deserve to be treated

There are certain places you really want to like and this, for me, was one of them. However, after a year (nearly 6-7 visits) I had to find a new salon. I felt that Crush was over-priced for the level of experience and service offered. Moreover, they didn't do a great job. But what finally forced my hand was the level of gossip at this salon. I told my stylist something in confidence which she promptly told others. Shame on me I guess, but I expected a higher level of maturity. If it is class and professionalism you are looking for I would advise looking elsewhere.

If I could give zero stars I would. It's hilarious to think the hood rats working here at demanding $15 an hour. You can't even make change or speak the English language. I got a spicy chicken sammich and asked for no tomato. What do I get a regular chicken with only tomatoes. Asked for a new one and was told with disgust " dats how you ordered it man. " the customer behind me I line came up moments later with incorrect order and he advised to genius behind the counter that I In fact did ordered my spicy no tomato. The worker said to this guy " y'all can jus get out my mothafuckin store. Dis a business not no debate." What?!?!?

How do I put this? Hmmm
A pizza joint without cheese is like a wedding without the bride. The excuse was that the demand was higher than expected, my response to that was; or just plain bad planning! I had to wait for someone to deliver cheese, I was overcharged for olives, and when I unwrapped the pizza it looked like a two year old threw the think together. Rest assured, not only will I not return to Papa Murphy's, but I will NEVER recommend this place again.

Just a BAD EXPERIENCE all around, and the smart mouth kid did not help!

I'm not sure what to do now, I had brakes done all the way around in September to the tune of $480, two days later they were grinding. I took my car back and was assured all was good by Danny. The grinding while intermittent, is more frequent, and much worse. I have been trying to reach the garage for the last 3 weeks and only get voice mail which states "this mail box is full". I guess I need to contact the BBB, and the Atty General to get this resolved. Update, he did take care of the problem, he replaced the pads and re-turned the rotors.

Definitely a meh type of place.  The portions are too small for the prices charged.  I get the idea of the a la carte menu, but I think they take it a little too far.  I was here for a weekend lunch with another adult and a little kid, and I'm pretty sure we spent close to $35-40, with tip.  We tried some of the favorites other people listed, and were not impressed.  Overall, we left unsatisfied by the taste, the price, and the portions.  There are so many other options in Cwood, so I have no plan to return here.

Pizza sucks. Never fresh .. EVER. They have cold pies sitting in a window waiting for suckers like us to pay $4 for a slice of old reheated pizza. I've been here numerous times for a quick lunch. Each time I hate myself for it. Today, I thought I'd be bold and order the $4.32 a slice truffle mushroom and artichoke pizza. I could not taste a hint of truffle oil. I can't come back here again. 

2/5 UPDATE - I hate myself all over again. I tried to be simple this time and ordered a plain and pepperoni slice. All the oregano, hot pepper seeds and garlic powder can't help this pizza.

I've had marvelous sushi at Sushi B several times, but my recent visit (this time for lunch) offered up COLD tasteless shrimp tempura --both the shrimp & veggies were tasteless and the tempura batter was cold, bland, and tasted like it was left over from the day before. My guest had 2 different totally second rate rolls, Boston and another one I can't recall. Even the rice was cold, just a bowl of cold gum. Yuk.  I was embarrassed to have invited two guests from out of town.  I can't afford mistakes like this...SBistro really needs to shape up! While the service was fine, the food was surprisingly poor.

My friends and I attended a Saturday Zumba class and it was awesome! The ladies at the front desk are so kind and helpful. Once our lesson  was over we came back to pay in advance for more classes. It is reasonably priced and fun! The only bad thing was that the class was so full the second time (on Saturday ) it was hard to "go hard" in the studio because there wasn't much space for that many people. I would say there was about 15-18 of us in the room, a Great Crowd! But other than this, it's a great place to Zumba!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We came here for the first time today.  Despite several open tables in the restaurant area, we were seated in a booth in the bar without being asked for our preference.  Then others who came in after us were seated in the restaurant area.  We were dressed appropriately, so I don't get it.  Also surprised by the limited nature of the menu, but it was lunch.  I will say that the food was very tasty, but the way we were treated soured the taste of the food and our experience.  I will have to think twice before coming back.

I been going to Planet for many years.  I like the hours and machines are always available.  I am noticing it is not as clean as it use to be.  I filled my water bottle up at the fountain and there is brown scum on the stainless steel, it looks like it has not been cleaned in awhile.  The black wire fence around the machine area is coated in thick dust.  I think the staff could be doing more to keep it clean, they seem to have a lot of time to visit with whoever hangs out at the desk area.  Membership is reasonable, guess you get what you pay for.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I do love their tea, but it's such a hassle to shop here.  The people working there are constantly breathing down your neck and trying to get you to buy more things.  I really hate pushy sales people.  Once one of the guys working there kept pestering me, asked me what I usually get, and then started bagging up the tea I mentioned after I specifically told him I was just looking at the time and would let him know if I needed anything.  For the prices, which I consider expensive, shopping here shouldn't be so irritating.

Excellent dinner, amazing ambiance.  You choose a four course dinner from about five options, all of which looked fascinating.  The chefs do an amazing job of blending and melding flavors and textures such that the bite evolved in your mouth as you eat it.  I've never had liver before (other than foie) but the chicken liver mousse was rich and flavorful and combined with enough sweet from the grapefruit and pickled papaya to create an amazing dish.  The other dishes were likewise creative and challenging without sacrificing flavor for flair.  Highly recommended.

Great food but their ability to adapt to accommodate their customers is lacking and it is actually costing them money.  I went in to use coupon for free 12" 1 topping pizza with purchase.  I ordered deluxe and said I understood thrre would be an associated up charge.   Server came back and advised manager said they  couldn't do a Deluxe as they had no way to enter it into their system unless they charged me for every additional item and it would cost more than the menu price.  I find it hard to believe there is no override capability.  
Disappointing.

Food here is excellent, good to have quality sushi near by.  The service on the other hand.... HORRIBLE!  Ive never waited so long for my food at any other place.  It seems like every time i come here. No matter weather they are busy or empty, I'm always waiting 40min At least for my food. Usually order an appetizer and 2-3 rolls.  If i get my app before my main course ill be lucky. They usually just push it out all together.  On a few occasions i noticed my food just sitting at the counter. With multiple waiters passing by as if there's nothing there.   Like i said, food is good. But only come here if you have time.

Called in to see what their hours are as they never update google. Woman informed us 930 was last call. Arrived at 9 and was informed last call was 830. No one took credit was only 2 females there. And we drove 30 mins to get here. Very upsetting. Wouldn't even give out managers number. Asked if we could just get sushi to go as some tables were still getting food. Won't allow us. Kitchen was closed even though I saw them making rolls. 

Would normally rate this place a 4-5 star. But today really pissed us off. Wife doesn't want to come back. Have been a loyal customer for 9 years and will see how they handle this issue.

Disgusting bathroom and annoying up-selling technique. I fell for the annoying up-selling technique of only asking whether you want "medium or large" and took the medium, which lopped $2.50 onto my costs. I really only wanted a small soda and fries, so frankly I felt duped. (I know, I know...I wasn't paying close attention)
 Then there's the men's room. Absolutely disgusting with poop all over both toilets and a piss filled and STINKY urinal. I just washed my hands, which I considered skipping since the whole bathroom was so filthy, and left. I waited to get home to pee. I'll never walk in that place again.

I don't know what the last reviewer is talking about.....perhaps, a different place?  The food is excellent!!  Freshly cooked, high quality, beautiful presentation and very flavorful. The food is as good as you would find in any center city restaurant.  The atmosphere is hip and pleasant as is the wait staff.
The prices are reasonable and the portions are more than sufficient.  We have eaten there lately about twice a week.   Do not go by the first reviewer, try this place.  I think you will be pleased.
Susan S.

I love their pizza and I like the decor and vibe of this place, however the staff is inexperienced and one young lady was downright rude! Her eyes were tearing apparently because they were cutting onions in the back. I asked why her eyes were tearing and her reply was "your face"!  Really? I am a 60 year old woman and I was so insulted that I did not enjoy my pizza!  She should not be working in a public place.  I am thinking about calling and reporting her to her manager.  Sadly, because of the rude and inexperienced staff I probably won't return despite the fact that the pizza is quite good.

I live right near this place, and I love it. It has a nice variety of spices (though totally random), the groceries are a little pricey, but the selection is frankly AMAZING for a store of its size. As someone who cooks often (and not just sticking chicken or fish in a pan), the variety of interesting ingredients and drinks is great. I seriously was not expecting it when I first walked in. I love the aloe drink selection, I always get mango! The staff is very kind and helpful. I'm so happy I live nearby. I can't say I think it's worth a trip if you don't live nearby though.

The worst Mexican food I've eaten.  I have been going to El Limone in Ambler since years and love their authentic Mexican food.  I was hoping to try something different and tried this place which was a big mistake.

1.  Their prices are 10-15% more than their menu on their website, which is wrong.
2.  I got a Burrito bowl, which was essentially large quantity of rice with tiny bit of pinto beans and chicken.  That's it.  No veggies, onions, salsa, hot sauces.  It was a abomination for a burrito
3.  We got shrimp tacos which were lame with just 3-4 shrimp in each taco

I would give it a 1/2 star as its not worthy of 1 star

Update: the past several times I've ordered from here something has been wrong with the order in some way or another. Tonight I ordered chips and guacamole and when I opened the bag, no guac. I called the restaurant and they said to give them 10 minutes. 30 minutes later it still wasn't here. I called again and 5 minutes later the guac showed up. However, at that point I no longer wanted it. I know mistakes happen but I'm really disappointed because I enjoy the food for a quick and easy Mexican delivery. I'm even more annoyed that nothing was done to compensate for the mistake as much as I order from them.

I have been here twice. First time shortly after they opened ....., and we left during the appetizer. ....Not a good experience.  2nd attempt:  So we went as part of a group last night and had hopes of a better experience......sadly it was only marginally better than our first experience.  Salmon was frozen and tasted it. Flounder overcooked, chicken dry, on and on and on.  From reading the other reviews it appears the safest bet is the pizza.  I guess I'll never know because I have no plans to go again.   Sorry.

If you are into bait and switch, this is the place for you!  Second time now, I've called and got an estimate only to have the actual price paid 3x more!  They treated me like a child, but I have a couple of engineering degrees. I think I know how the sway bar linkage interacts with the strut. Anyway, they screwed me for the last time. They should learn to be honest with customers. But it seems the estimating staff lowers the price to get you in and then once you're there they zap you. And come to find out, the sales staff in commission based. Horrible business
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: My dog needed emergency surgery and our original vet wasn't able to perform that kind of task. I found Turkey Creek on the web and called. The woman who answered was nice, patient, and helpful. Brought him in same day and surgery was done that afternoon. Drs were very down to earth in explaining recovery process and patient with me as I was a nervous wreck... brought him back for follow ups and wasn't charged! Will definitely be bringing our other 2 dogs to them for regular vet visits; hopefully no more surgeries!

My iPad was stolen from my bag in room 908 last weekend. I notified the hotel staff immediately. They were highly responsive, but after several rounds of emails and phone calls I was informed that it was not the hotel's concern, and that the theft would not be covered under the hotel's insurance. I am 100% positive it was in my bag when I left it there. Barring a confession from one of the staff members, there does not seem any possibility the hotel will admit any responsibility. I do not recommend this hotel to anyone.
