Oh and fyi we were able to get the donuts we wanted across town at doughboys!

This McDonald's is the worst McDonald's that ever been to I think in my entire life. The managers could give two Hoots whether you sit there in line for 5 minutes or 20 minutes. The people who wait on you God if they give you a smile it would take a miracle that says a lot about what they work in. I try to be very nice give my order quickly have my money ready say thank you and go on about my business. Unless it's just to get a drink or there is an absolutely no line I might stop if I need something but other than that no thank you
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
All I can say is FILTHY!!!! 

Went with my family to hibachi and the grill was dirty, had old food on it. Built up grease that needed to be cleaned off . Disgusting .... when we asked the waitress if they were going to clean the grill she looked at us like we requested something crazy.  To top it off the men's bathroom did not have a sink to wash hands.... it was out of order.... with no option to wash hands anywhere else.... GROSS!!! How are other costumers and or staff washing their hands!!? 
Stay far away from this place unless of course you want to spend the night sick 
in the bathroom....

The food and service was good but... We got the 7 course tasting menu at this fine seafood establishment expecting some seafood. Wrong!
1. Gazpacho, was delicious
2. Sea bass ceviche - winner!
3. Foie gras
4. Beef short rib taco
5. Duck breast, was pretty chewy
6. Cheese
7. Dessert 

Only one small appetizer course contained seafood. I would not have ordered the tasting menu had I known this but our server would not tell us what was on the tasting menu. She said it's whatever the chef is feeling, which is usually a slam dunk but not here.

We went there about 9 o'clock last night and had a better experience than at most coffee shops. (I don't know if this is the category the Grand Sierra would put it in, but it's how I think of it.)

The service seemed fairly efficient and everyone was pleasant. No complaints about the food--they got my husband's eggs-over-easy just right, and my BBQ tri-tip sandwich was delicious. The fries were big, plentiful, crispy on the outside, and soft on the inside.

The only complaint I had about it was the noise from entertainment going on in the casino right outside, but I know it should be expected when you eat at a casino.

I had high hopes for this place but will not go back. The people there seem nice...but the food is muy mal. I ordered a chicken burrito with rice, beans, and cheese. I ended up with steak instead...whatever, I'm pretty laid back. However, the taste overall was just gnarly. I also saw someone with the chile relleno combo plate with beans, rice, and guac. Totally gross. It had a pool of yellow oil slicking across the whole top of it. the salsa for the chips was good but not good enough. With 4 stars, obviously some people like this place, but I'm not going back.

I'm giving 2 stars because the two times I have visited they have been out of beer also the first time we ordered the bread pudding , but it wasn't served with any ice cream that it said it comes with. The second time service was ehhh. Anytime we asked how something was our server would be like yeah it's ok .
Everything was served hot but it was just ok . I ordered the creamy pesto chicken angel hair it was really just cream sauce on angel hair , hardly any pesto , and it had 3 bites of chicken, smaller than a chicken strip . I'd like to say I would go back , but doubtful.

I'd like to give this place a better rating based on the food only but unfortunately this place is a bit to pricey for me considering the cafeteria style setup and ambiance.  I love places like this with the choose your own adventure made fresh approach but there are a couple places around town with the same setup for less.  

I enjoyed the pasta and they get high rating from me in this regard. I consider myself a big eater and I felt their portion size was significant which left me in a food coma(I'm mostly okay with this)

We have enjoyed Salvatore's for a while, including takeout during Covid19.    Tonight was an exception.  We did takeout.  Fried mozzarella sticks were okay.  Just okay.  Clams casino were SO Salty.  My cat wouldn't even eat them. Ravioli was good.  Eggplant parmigiana with penne was bland and boring.  They forgot to give the side salad.  Cheesecake was the best thing.  Two out of the four employees we saw were either not wearing a mask at all, or wearing a mask hanging from one ear.I don't think we'll be back.

Just average. I gave it three because the staff were friendly and the place itself was interesting with the old decor and historic site marking. The pasta tasted like it was from a box and not made fresh as I was expecting (being the stores down the street were all selling fresh pasta and it being in the Italian market). The veal was too salty and chewy, but the sauce had a nice light flavor to balance the dish. In the end just disappointed in the overall quality as it does not fit the location in the Italian market... tasted more like Italian food that I would get in the Poconos or a small town in West Virginia.

You can always count on panhandlers loitering around the parking lot and at times absolutely no parking. Unfortunately some very rude obnoxious customers frequent this Publix and add to the negativity. I seldom leave this place in a good mood. The staff seem ok but no where near as friendly as other Publix locations. The selection of items is limited by the size of the store and the parking lot is unkempt at times. Overall a disappointment but a lot has to do with the deteriorating nature of this part of Seminole Heights.

Last night we tried to get into the oldest Italian Restaurant in South Philly. Thankfully, they couldn't fit us in, so our son said lets try Angelina's  so we walked around the corner and into a small Italian Restaurant.  Immediatly we felt at home.  Angelina is cooking in the front of the resaurant and her husband is servicing. There were 3 of us and we started off with Eggplant and roasted pepper appetizer.  One bite and we were hooked.  We ordered the Veal Osso Bocca, Carbonara and lasagna.  Everything was absolutly DELISH!!  Can't wait to go back!!!

This place is so runned down and out dated. I think i counted 3 roaches in the bathroom. But its no doubt there would be bugs given all the food on the carpet. 


The cooks play a game where they throw the food and try to make it in the customers mouth. Well that doesn't always happen and it ends up in the floor and stays and gets step on. Just gross.   

If it was clean and had hard floors theu wouldn't have bugs. And they would probably do better. Food was not fresh if i didnt see bugs until after i ate. Thank goodness i did t get sick

Gives me chills thinking of it.

Location is near the Sheraton Hotel in University City. I had pants cleaned here, and when I got them back the zipper was not working properly anymore. There is a sign in the store saying they are not responsible for any buttons or zippers, etc. when something is cleaned. When I asked if they could do something about the zipper, they said it would be $20 to have fixed, so I might as well buy new pants. Perhaps it's not their fault that the zipper broke, but it was working when I brought the pants there to be cleaned...
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Generally good, but I've been noticing that there are always bug guts left on my windshield and sometimes hood when I leave. The guy who guides you into the tire rails and then spritzes your windshield with what I assume is some kind of bug/tar remover (or something at least stronger than the regular wash stuff) barely, and I mean barely even got a few drops on my windshield & looked pretty unmotivated. I will still keep coming though because it's conveniently located and most of the staff are friendly... and my car is mostly clean when I leave which is better than nothing.

Most of the sushi was ok, but the tamago was a bit dry and seemed old. The big disappointment came when I ordered chicken teriyaki to go. First they totally forgot about my to go order. After quite some time I asked about it, at which point they rushed to make it. I wish I'd just said to forget it. Got home to find a super thin, HARD portion of chicken breast, although I'm not sure it was ever full breast, or even half. It was about as thick as two stacked ritz crackers and tough as a piece of leather.  The only redeeming factors about this place was the friendly (albeit forgetful) staff.

Came here before some boating with my wife and kids and father in law. I ordered the beef grinder. My first positive sign was that she asked what temperature I wanted the beef in my grinder. The sandwich was tasty and the beef in it was tender. It could have used a bit of a zappier taste for me personally. All in all great place and great service. I ordered a beer and the waitress said if I didn't like it she'd be happy to bring me a new one. That doesn't happen often. I told her I'd feel bad since I ordered the beer. She said she'd bring me samples of others to try. 
Great little place.

Went to dinner tonight for the first time since Hurricane Katrina. It was a personal favorite before the storm, and much about the place feels the same. BUT, the portion sizes were miniscule (almost comical). the salad dressing was too oily, but the brisket in the brisket and tomato salad was good.

the sausage and peppers were quality, but there was barely enough sausage to equal one link. the red gravy - always great.

the service was inconsistent, including a couple of spills during water refills and pouring coffee.

we'll go back, but not too many times more if we have a similar experience.

Loved our night out here. You need a reservation to snag a table but we like eating at the bar so we snuck in right after opening and grabbed seats at the bar no problem. The wine list is great and the bartenders know about the wine and will offer a taste if you're curious about wines by the glass. The food. Is. Delicious. We had the hummus, gnocco w/pork ragu, and Margherita pizza. All excellent. Plus we just liked the vibe: a place that is into good food, feels comfortable and also nice, has a din but isn't loud, and is really really attractive inside.

Staying here for a week on business. Overall, the hotel is satisfactory and staff is very friendly and helpful. I rated it a 3 because of the following; carpet in the room needs to be replaced, the rooms are so small I could not pull the desk out and work- I had to go down and work in the restaurant, no drawers - this is a personal preference but when I am staying somewhere for awhile I like to be organized and have my clothes in drawers. If I wasn't traveling on business, I would stay here again but the desk issue is a deal breaker.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I was always a fan of La Calaca Feliz in the Fairmount area of the city, so I thought this restaurant from the same family would be good too. And I was right! The menu and feel is much the same. It was bustling with good energy even on a week night. The customer service was upbeat and attentive. The food flavors were delicious. I was taken aback by how scrumptious the carnitas tacos were. The meat was moist underneath and crispy on top. The quality of ingredients felt appropriate for the price. I would happily come back for an energized vibe and yummy dishes to share with loved ones and friends.

My husband and I have dined here twice in the last ten days, and it is fabulous!  We invited friends the second time!  The restaurant is inviting, clean, and the staff is attentive.  The chips and salsa are both very, very good.  We have enjoyed the Tacos de Pollo, Tacos de Chorizo and the Corralejo Chicken Bowl (not sure if that is the specific name) and everything has great flavor and is done well.  We live twenty minutes away but will return often,  as it's one of the best Mexican kitchens in the area!  You will love it too!

Went there last night.  I started with a bloody Mary and it came with a menu!  I could pick vodka including a homemade one infused with hot peppers, garnishes from salami or cheese to special pickled tomatoes. I tried the works and the drink was a meal in itself. Appetizer was mussels with medium spiced sauce that you use bread to get the last drop of sauce.  The salad was was crisp and fresh with a light tasting house dressing.  By this time I'm full but then out comes Veal Par magian with a wonderful marinara sauce. I would definitely come back for more.

I have been going to Olive for years and used to love it. It was purchased little while ago and the quality has slipped. Sometimes the service is good and sometimes it's not. When in a rush I've been told to go prepare for a pedicure, but then I'm left waiting there for 20 minutes. Would have appreciated if they told me that they were running 20 minutes late. Could've used the time better.  Many of the newer technicians do not speak or understand English, so explaining color or even how you would like to nail shaped becomes a challenge.

My lunch break is only 30 minutes. I was able to walk here during the lunch rush, wait inside in line, get served fresh food, and still walk back to work in time from my break. The staff were professional and friendly. They had a smooth system to verifying orders and their accuracy. My food was prepared fresh. Hot items were hot. Cold items were cold. They have a multifunction self service beverage machine for both soda & teas & lemonade. Only big drawback for me us that they do not accept Samsung Pay, Google Pay or Apple Pay. I'd recommend this Wendy's location to anyone hungry and expecting a good experience.

While their coffee creations are some of the best around, I've stopped making the special effort to visit and usually opt to get my caffeine fix elsewhere.  The reason?  Their baristas are ungodly slow and apathetic.  

I have frequently stood in a line of 10 or more people while there are 3 staff members behind the counter with only one of them working on orders.  My last visit, I was 4th in line and it took 25 minutes to even place my order.  The staff seemed more interested in chatting with a friend who had dropped in than doing their jobs.

Sorry, no matter how wonderful the drinks and atmosphere, I just can't abide lousy service.

Nope. Why would anyone pay over $4.00 for a slice of cold pizza warmed up in an oven? Well, I was dumb enough to try it once but will certainly not go back. The pizza tasted like day-old pizza, warmed up. I'm sure that's exactly what it was, too. 

I asked for a cup of water and was told they don't have cups for water but would sell me a bottle of water. I saw a stack of cups on their counter and asked if I could use one. Nope, they are for purchased drinks only. 

Any food establishment that cannot make the effort to offer complimentary cups/water does not make my list for a repeat visit.

This place is 'okay'. The fish was fresh, prices reasonable, and staff friendly.  The mango was not ripe and was pale yellow in color, the eel was very fatty to the point that it really should not have been used, but everything else was good.  They also seem to be obsessed with "crunchy" everything.  Personally I'm not a fan of crunchy or deep fried sushi and I do believe that they would omit it upon request.  There is definitely another nearby that I prefer so will return there over here. Only upside is this place is larger than the closet-sized one around the corner. As previously mentioned, it's worth a try! BYO

It's a very pricey restaurant! If you looking for a good Japanese restaurant, obviously this is a good choice. However, if you run out of your budget. I don't think is a good choice. $60 per person you will have lots of choices and very good food. If you looking for $20-30 per person with your girlfriend or boyfriend or friends. It's Not a good place. You should go all you can eat! I'm not giving this place for more than 3 stars because there was a huge table beside us. 5 people, they were super loud!!!!!! No waitress or waiters helping us. That's so bad. Not a bad place, and also not a good place.

My husband and I enjoyed a quick trip to New Orleans and chose The Saint hotel. We loved the hotel decor; very chic and clean. The service was great from the valet to the front desk.  We only had trouble when  ordering room service. It was difficult getting through to place the order, only to be hung up on.  Then when it arrived, we had no utensils. Other than that, we thoroughly enjoyed our visit! On a side note...you must eat breakfast at the Ruby Slipper just next door. The Bam Bam Breakfast and shrimp grits were delish!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This little hair salon is a real gem! It is ran by a cute family. I first found this place cause my husband would go get his haircut there, and he is always happy about it. Out of curiosity, I decided to give it a try when I needed a trim. It seriously went beyond my expectation! The owner and hairdresser Jason is extremely talented. He made me happier about my hair than going to those much fancier hair salons in old city! I got a wash, cut and styling for less than half of the price of a women hair cut! Can not recommend them enough!

So an update.  I lied and went back again...a couple times.  Sorry it's so close to where I live and work that it's hard to avoid.

I have to say the service has improved dramatically and the food is still good (maybe a little worse than before, but still very good).  Only downside to the lunch food is that the sandwiches are still difficult to eat and keep your hands clean at the same time.  The kitchen still is slow when you would like a fast lunch, but it is up to par with peers.  Overall I will say that they have tentatively won me back as a part time customer.

My wife and I had a great time at Henry's last night. It was Fish and Chips night and Frank does it right. Probably the best I've ever had. The bruschetta and big hunk of Feta cheese was magic with the great Italian bread. The salad with Gargonzola, Romaine, walnuts and cranberries was also tasty. And then there was the spicy Mussels.... Really, really good!
It's BYOB so take a bottle of your favorite wine and you'll have a great dinner, meet an interesting host and leave with a feeling that you just had dinner at a friends house instead of a restaurant. 
* Note - Check their hours. they're limited.

Frosty Jakes has delicious custard and a surprising and creative selection of sundaes to choose from. I ordered a peanut butter, chocolate, and banana sundae and my hubby ordered the banana, chocolate and pecan option (called Jake's favorite).  The custard was creamy and cool, and although the portions are not huge, they satisfy.  There are some issues with customer service; for instance, they forgot the bananas in my hubby's sundae and rather than make a new one they splatted a handful of bananas on top of his melted ice cream.  Still, I recommend this dessert oasis in the desert.

my little mining engineer scratched his eye on a small excavation to the center of the earth or something (beagle). it wasnt getting better, so we got to go to the vet, saturday morning at 7 am.

i am kinda squirrely about the whole vet thing, but from the beginning, everything was GOOD. the receptionist (sara), the vet tech (tamara) and dr miller were all great. very professional, and they all obviously really liked critters.

billing was fair, and they were very careful to keep me informed of the estimate, and to stay on it.

big bonus, they did not try to upsell ANYTHING.

thank you all

The only reason I am giving them 2 stars is because of the staff. We weren't greeted by anyone, none of the staff ever smiled and never said goodbye. When we wanted to order, we had to just blurt out what we wanted because they never asked if we were ready to order. The food was good and the person who brought us the food explained what it was, which I liked. She was nice. I had two charred steak tacos and a Jardin, which was really tasty. I live close and wished that the staff was more inviting so I can go more often with friends. Not sure if I am willing to try it again, customer service is everything to me.

We are Hilton Honors members - doesn't mean much - ended up in a room on the train track side with BigFoot upstairs playing soccer. After many hours during the day at 8:00pm I went to the desk to complain about BigFoot.  4 hours later got out of bed and complained again. The customer service was lousy - for the price of the room for 2 nights it's ridiculous when you can't sleep. There are many choices when you go to Santa Barbara and this hotel won't be our choice.  We received an e-mail after we got home to rate our visit and even then the response is we hope you will give us another chance....no thanks...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Fresh bread with mushroom and sun-dried tomato to start. The soup was excellent. A light chicken stock base with the mushroom and SDT playing off one another. I moved on to the eggplant parm for dinner - which is served on a bed of pasta. I have a very high standard on this dish. It was good. Under seasoned and bit lacking in flavor. I also found the eggplant to be cut a little too think for the "doneness". It was a little harder than it should have been. Still good though. Nice space. Wait staff is on top of it and very nice.

We usually stay at the Cherry Hill Residents INN but I decided on this one because it was closer to where I needed to be. This was a huge mistake. This is the worse Residents stay I have ever had and I stay with they quite a few times a year. I usually don't complain but this was bad. I stayed in room 150...all night I heard people running up and down the stairs, I didn't get any sleep (and I am use to noise I have to teenagers) Then I had to deal with the toilet that ran water all night. I had to keep jingling the handle...IN A RESIDENTS INN!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Terrible service! Where do I start???? Well it is nasty not clean everything is sticking and dirty. They have about 10 people working and not one is working at a fast pace unless you consider shuffling your feet fast! Not a thank you not even here's your order. Order from the kiosk and take a number and you still have to walk up for your order. Worthless! How is this place still open?? Fries came out ice cold. Who owns this place? Come on clown! Take a look at the pictures. The one picture is a pair of rubber gloves that a worker had on while clean the bathroom....yep took them off and placed them on the table. Nasty
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Stopped in for a late lunch on a Friday, menu looked appetizing and the place was not busy with two other tables. Ordered oysters on the half shell and a shrimp po boy. The po boy had 5 small shrimp which could have used twice that amount, it was basically a jam sandwich (two pieces of bread jammed together) barely any shrimp for $12. The quality of the bread and toppings were good, just missing the shrimp. The oysters were the smallest I have ever seen in a restaurant passing them for $17 a dozen, cmon man. Service was non attentive.

I don't mind spending a good dollar on my hair. I usually pay about $60. This time it came to $74. plus tip. I have hair that is just above my shoulders. I do, however, want a good experience when I pay more than $50. I was surprised at how quiet the salon was and it's marked "for walk ins", they had a nice set of products to select from, and they were clean and tidy. I wasn't offered a coffee or water and customer service was mediocre. The stylist was skilled and had recently earned a commendation. I am pleased with the cut and the stylists good customer service but for that price I'd want a better overall experience.

UPDATE 9/4/15
Weeds were cleaned up on the sidewalk so no more chair jockeying.... Previous Review below ....

This is a new business in town. It used to be Barcelona Bistro. The Decor and fixtures seem to be the same as before. The food is good although a bit pricey. I kind of laughed when it was suggested that I eat "al fresco" on the sidewalk. Why would a restaurant offer that option when there are weeds galore under the tables and trash under foot. I DONT want to pay to see that. MY advise to Manninio's Cucina..... CLEAN first... Then offer these tables to your patrons...  THUMBS DOWN.....WAY DOWN. : (

After a fun day at the Philadelphia Car show we decided to grab a bite to eat. We headed into Chinatown and found this restaurant. Service was ok but the food was great! I got the Mai Fun chicken it was really spicy. Just the way I like it! Shrimp in lobster sauce was also really good. We got the Shrimp dumplings for an appetizer. They were alittle fishy but good. Everything was fresh. I also liked the fact you can watch them prepare your food. Prices are reasonable. We will be returning to try the Generals Tso chicken!!

Love this place! Complimentary clear soup. The dumplings are so light, hard to pass up. I don't do fish sushi so I love the crunchy roll and the rock n roll. One day I felt adventurous and tried the swamp roll and Louisiana roll. They both sound odd but they are both soo amazing. I love the contrast and vinegar of the okra! The boyfriends family loves the fish sushi and says it's the freshest in the city. They did a big platter for a family get together and it was demolished. Everyone was very impressed with the quality of the sushi.

While I think there are many good things about City Fitness their willingness to maintain the spinning room is not their strong point.  The spinning bikes are often in need of maintenance, and it isn't as though the management is unaware, they know!  In spite of their awareness there are never out of order signs on bikes and far from fun and safety is the surprise when your handle bars won't secure in position and fly out in front of you when you rise from the saddle.  The monitors on the bikes are just for show.  They don't work, and if by some chance they do forget about having light to look at what the monitor is showing.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This place is terrible!

The kid that waited on us was very nice. That's the only nice thing I have to say.

The chicken is very salty, and cubed like it came out of a bag. The food has no seasoning/spice. It was so bad that I pulled it off. Rather than asking how it was or offering to remove the up charge from the bill, it server just ignored the situation.

The cheese in the quesadilla was fresh mozzarella (the big chunks of cheese, not the shredded stuff), so not at all authentic.

How this place gets such great reviews is beyond me.

Sometimes it's nice to be able to run in and out of a small store like this, for convenience. Unfortunately Laurel Liquors is extremely overpriced.  The first time I stopped in here was during a snow storm last winter, and if it wasn't for the weather I would have left without buying anything.  An average bottle of wine that is normally 10.99 other places was $15.  Not only more expensive, but that particular bottle didn't have a price tag on it, and I was made out to be dumb when I asked how much.  If it weren't for the convenient location, they would probably get no business.

Good east side sushi restaurant. I usually go for lunch and get there early because it gets crowded fast.  I have noticed the last two times with my bento box that my sashimi is cold but so is my chicken teriyaki.  There are signs with daily specials all over the walls, which hinders the atmosphere but hey, it's the quality of the food that counts right?  Sushi is presented beautifully and is always fresh.  Prices are on point for this type of restaurant and service is average at lunchtime, fast and not too friendly.  Would definitely recommend for sushi.

Two stars because for whatever reason this Dunkin has the best coffee of any Dunkin I've been to. I don't know what they do different but it's phenomenal. It's the only reason I keep coming back. That said, they will screw up your order every single time. If you're lucky they'll get it right the second time. I have literally never been here and been given my correct order.  Today I ordered hash browns and they gave me a bacon egg and cheese croissant instead o_0.  Check what they actually give you before you drive away!

Second time and still not. impressed. Won't be back. First time I tried the pizza-Blah. Nothing special at all.
Last night ordered a cheesesteak. I waited 20 mins for it to be ready while I watched the girl working the register touch food after touching money without washing hands or using gloves.
Brought home a VERY dry cheesesteak with no cheese and if the onions and mushrooms I ordered (and paid for!)were on there I couldn't see them. Overpriced and overcooked,  And my order was wrong. I guess that is why it took so long on an empty Monday night.. There are much better places around!  See ya....or should I say you wont see me!

Frankie Fellinis is another hidden jem in Berwyn. The atmosphere is very casual but don't be fooled. The food is real Italian and cooked to perfection. I ordered the swordfish special thinking it would be ok but hoping for the best. Wow. It was absolutely delicious. It was not over cooked (as often is the case with swordfish) and it just melted in my mouth. Our party of 6 passed around tastes of their entrees and all were really good. Ended with a freshly made cannoli and espresso. Delicious. We'll definitely visit this BYOB again.

I shop at this Winn Dixie almost daily. I really don't understand working at a place that you don't enjoy, if you don't want to work, stay your ass at home. I don't need your attitude. The cashier (Jeolisa) spoke twice to me, to ask for my plenty card & to tell me how much my total was, that's it! This is the first time I have had a cashier or any employee for that matter, to be impolite & NO I'm not bagging my own groceries this time, you can do that, that's NOT MY JOB!!! Maybe she had a bad day, we all have them, but you will never know I'm having a bad day at MY job. So do your job properly or QUIT!!!

We keep wishing this place were better because it's so close. We'd be regulars if the food and service ever improved.  The food is just mediocre and service is typically the same - adequate but disinterested. The best thing they do is burgers. We frequently get them for take out. I do LOVE the homemade potato chips. The cajun chicken salad is also quite good. Those are about the only two dishes I would ever eat here, having had others.  They keep expanding and expanding the seating area, so someone must like it... The bar crowd perhaps?

Prego! This place enticed me from the title when I was walking out of the "sorry we are closed" (but excellent when open) chinese restaurant next door... "Italian Street Food".
Glad to see no pizza or gelato... Happy to see chefs in white standing behind a hot table of various Italian dish ingredients. Very simple and easy to use menu with choices. 

Price for a filling lunch of quality pasta, grilled meat choice, grilled vegetables, and sauce along with added no charge topping of cheese, mushrooms, and other delights: $8.95 b-4 tax and drink. I forgot to mention lobster bisque or tomato basil soups choices too. Included.  Welcome to Rome.

I actually LOVE Papa Murphy's pizza and usually buy it on their sale day, Tuesday. However, I was hungry for my favorite, CHICKEN-BACON-ARTICHOKE on Wednesday, 8/25/21 so I ordered a large, original crust C-B-A.
It was $15 on Wednesday but hey, it's a great pizza...
I was shocked to discover at home that I received a THIN-CRUST  C-B-A pizza. I hate thin crust pizza. But I did not take the receipt so there was nothing I could do... Next time I will go again on a Tuesday when the owner is there and I always receive what I ordered... and will accept the receipt - just in case...
Erika

Went for a weekday lunch. Our order started to come out after an hour and I got mine in one hour and half when my friends had finished theirs. There was nothing special about my order, just lunch box with grilled salmon. Could not understand why it took 90 minutes to grill a piece of salmon. It was not a full house at all. The waiter seemed to forgot our table he did not refill our water nor brought any silvers or plates to the table. We basically self-serviced. The only thing he did is to drop our dished to the wrong person. DOES NOT RECOMMENDED AT ALL!!!!!!

After trying about 5 hair salons in Philly, I think I've found one to stick with -- and happily. I have fairly short hair and despite explanations, I almost always tend to tend the haircut that a stylist likes to give, rather than one suited to what I want. Kayla listened, looked at the photos that I brought, and gave me a cut that is easy to deal with, resolves my hair issues (can't stand it in my face, but trying to grow it out and don't want headbands, combs, barrettes, etc. to keep it back), is very current, and completely suited to me and what I am trying to do with my hair. Price was very reasonable and I am delighted.

I order from fox pizza in Antioch on a regular basis! On my LAST order they delivered the wrong pizza, when I called back to tell them they advised that there is nothing they can do!!! Really when u have already charged my card and I have to pay for their mistake!! I hope it was worth losing a loyal customer! That really sucked!! The managers name is Alex!!!! Alex sucks for cheating a loyal customer! Take a class in customer service better yet train your entire staff because everyone is rude when they made the mistake but not when taking my money!

This place offers great Italian comfort food.  They serve big portions and their sauce is excellent.    I really liked the rigatoni w/ crab meat.  Also, their Spaghetti and Lasagna are very good.    I didn't care for their eggplant parm as it had way too much breading.   Last time I went, the pasta had a bit of a stench to it .  Makes me a bit worried that their kitchen may not be the cleanest.

The place is small and gets very crowded during peak hours.   Don't go here if you mind being seated next to complete strangers.

Horrible 
Horrible customer service and the whopper was cold. The restaurant is extremely dirty and no one seems to be in charge. I love Burger King but it seems like all of them in Pinellas county are disgusting 
I will never go here again. Nothing was also stocked . Some people they handed 7 or so ketchups me two
They need to hire and manager and corporate needs to have a clue what is going on. The staff moved at a glacial pace. I have no idea how this place is open.  Go to Daly's burger off Seminole on 70 th

First time here got a calzone it was huge and i mean huge and delicious both good things in my book. Came in a second time for steak and cheese subs and as i expected there were very good sized and again delicious and then tonight we hit the trifecta got subs sides and burgers and again everything was excellent food is five starts in quality and quantity how ever the insides not so great, seating is uncomfortable and the two tvs seem to always b playing p.b.s. (eww) a few booths less red and dimmer lighting would make dining in much better but its safe to say eat in or take out I'll b a repeat customer for the foreseeable future

I really am disturbed how they helped with cost. the X-ray was an exploratory for your surgeon to see why she cant walk anymore because she was baffled as to why this is happening and I did pay out of pocket over $300 dollars for that visit so don't act like you did me a favor. it is called after care and bedside manner. So disappointed in your little smug remark. Don't act concerned then take a shot it is very unprofessional.
 Please leave us in peace as we have to lay Loxie to rest the day before a holiday and after my birthday. thanks for the memories!!!!

A nice addition to the budding omakase scene in Philly. The presentation of the fish feels a little rushed and I think the fish on display could be arranged a little neater. For high quality fish, the display case gives off the feel as if it is any run of the mill sushi restaurant, rather than a quality omakase. The chef is very friendly and the wait staff was attentive. The prices extremely reasonable too, especially for the fish they offer. I'm hoping they iron out their process in the next couple of months, one star off just for new restaurant kinks that can definitely be worked out.

They have totally changed my opinion. I tried it once more since this review and they were so nice that I tried again and again and again for the past couple of years and they have been amazing. Annie does my nails and she is always so sweet. She also does an awesome pedicure. Always asks about my kids and family as well. She's super sweet. The atmosphere is welcoming as well. There are definitely the stereotypical side conversations but I never feel like I am the subject of any of them. They make me feel so amazing when I leave. Their services I feel, are right in line with the normal nail salon.

Ken sushi it was alway good since he come back and work now but thing that bother me are
- Packing really had to see and look for at night. 
- Not enough light in the packing lot it a little bit scary when you come to had dinner at night time or late night. 
- Sever using her phone to much some time.
- Togo order sometime you might have to wait longer than people who siting in the restaurant.
- Some time you might need to ask the sever for pen more than 2-3 time before you going to get it.

other than that I love they sushi , teriyaki , ramen , and Ken.

Horrible customer service on a regular. The sauce tastes strange compared to other Imo's Pizza locations. They could definitely benefit from some customer service classes. They need to stick with the sauce as Imo's provides it because it doesn't meet my standards and I'm sure many others. The last time I visited this location I ordered deluxe it tasted like all the meat was dirty. This store needs a revamp ASAP. Not all the workers are bad but the management I experienced definitely shouldn't be in the customer service field.

I'm writing this review from visiting there with Nashvilletacoweek.  We had a delightful experience, but overall, tacos were slightly above average.  Pleasant and clean interior, outstanding and attentive service.  Chips and salsa kept coming with HOT (temp) chips.  That's a rarity.  We enjoyed the featured $2 chicken taco.  Very tasty, moist, tender, and flavorful.   We'd go back to try more menu items.  FREE Parking - where do you find that?  Margarita was nothing special, didn't taste like it had any tequila in it, just mix.

Stopped there is October 2015 and ordered a cheeseburger kid's meal. For the drink I ordered an apple juice. They said there would be an up-charge for the juice. I've been to many McDonald's before and after this time and have never been charged extra for a child's apple juice. I also ordered an ice water with the meal. I was told that the water would be $1. So, I promptly said to give me the free cup of water. No free water, they all cost $1. Again, only  at this McDonald's.

That's one way to run away business! Now, when the baby wants McDonald's I will drive out of my way to avoid this one.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Disclaimer that we got the pizza delivered so I left an extra star on because of that. But I guess after reading all the stellar reviews, we were just left a little disappointed! The pizza isnt bad, its just not that great. The sauce on the Regina was slightly bland. I was really excited for the carbonara pizza and it was just ok. Not bad! But I really cannot say it was worth the money / calories, which is a bummer! Wanted to love it. Maybe we would have felt differently if we ate there, but its pizza! If any food should be delivery friendly,  pizza would be it.

My wife and I walked by here a few times and liked the music so we thought we would give it a try.  The bartender was snooty, first chastising us for having a hurricane cup in our possession  (this is a block off of Burbon street, and she's going about judging people).  Then she proceeds with two failed attempts at a PIMMS cup for my wife, does not offer me a glass for my beer....just plain failed at bar tending 101.  

Hope you have better luck.  Keep your pinky in the air (or in my case maybe a different finger, haha)

While the restaurant looked nice and located within walking distance of my employer, the food left a lot to be desired.  I had the grilled cheese sandwich, which at best was mediocre.  The bread was good, but the cheese and apple(!) left a lot to be desired.  The atmosphere was pretentious and the waiter was very forgetful.  I also didn't enjoy the techno music playing while I was eating.  My guess is that this is not the place for lunch and dinner is better.    The tables are also very small, we have five in our group and it was a little tight in a corner booth.

The concept is great, but the food is just okay.

I went for the first time today.  I was hoping it might become my go-to place for fish tacos.

Here's how they could improve things (in case they read these reviews):

1) Put some moisture into the rice; Al dente is good, but way-al-dente is not
2) The fish taco needs more taste/spice to it..and a little more sauce.  You need more of the slaw on it.
3) Chips - they are nice & light & crispy, but they need salt or lime salt added
4) Hire employees who speak well to people/customers.

I didn't anything that I will crave later and have to re-visit for unfortunately.

Delicious food here in a warm and comfortable atmosphere. I enjoyed it a lot more than some of the "trendier" Italian restaurants in the area, which I've found lacking. It's nice to see traditional fare like rabbit ragout and pasta with homemade veal sausage on the menu. My party was also impressed with the large selection of homemade desserts, including my personal favorite -- panna cotta (not something you'll find at just any restaurant). The waiters and food runners/bussers were very attentive without being overbearing. I'd definitely recommend!

My husband and I had a very nice meal here last night. Nice atmosphere- definitely glad we made a reservation for a Saturday night. We had miso soup was tasty on a cold day but nothing special. I had a spider roll and sweet potato tempura roll, both very tasty and beautifully presented. My husband had a spicy salmon roll and a AAA roll.  The fish was super fresh and practically melted in your mouth.  The AAA had a great combination of textures.  All total, our dinner was less than $40.  We would definitely go back, and if you are looking for a good sushi place in the area, this is the one!

Absolutely terrible. Disorganized, rude, and not friendly. Waited 20 minutes for a pedicure, had to run outside to take a three minute call, told them where I was at, I would be one minute since they were not even set up for me, and when I came back in they gave my turn to someone else with no words or acknowledgement to me. I mean I was outside their glass windows... Hey, I get being busy but come on - just plan rude, and not worth it when they have so many other nail salons around. Terrible customer service, nothing pampering about this place. If I could give a zero I would.

The room/suite is very nice, except for the hide-a-bed/sofa which sinks when you sit on it, making it harder for this senior citizen to get up. There are 2 tv's, one in the sleeping room, one in the living area. Many channels on the bedroom TV didn't work - low/weak signal - when the tv in the living area was on. Called front desk, staff member came to the room promptly. He thought the splicing of the satellite line was done improperly, which he's seen before. He was going to check with owner, who was out of town. If they make this right, I'll update this review.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is our 1st time staying at this location. I called the night before our arrival and spoke with Gabriel. He was very friendly and professional as he spoke to me. I made the reservation and when we checked in the next day, we were lucky to meet him in person. He made us feel welcomed and offered an extended check out due to my dancing daughter's schedule. We decided to stay a second day. The breakfast was very good. They even offered white egg and vegetables omelets that were delicious. Every staff person we met was very friendly and were happy to help. We will definitely stay at this location again soon.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The service was fantastic, she told us about all the specials and suggested her favorites! (Love that) I appreciate the passion. We ordered 3 apps between the 4 of us, so delicious, the only suggestion is that the soup was too salty.  Everything else was fantastic! Lassaugna rolls, a pizza and the crab bites.  We shared all entrees, ny strip ( delicious) and the crab shrimp risotto, we diched the rice and had it over pasta.. Fantastic! Desert was delicious, chouclate cake with homemade espresso gilato. Yummy, we were so,stuffed!!  Great place love that its BYOB, and so close to schiliens for a night cap!

Do not stay at this house of horror    Elevators are absolutely terrible.  You have to leave a half hour ahead because you can wait for 30 minutes for the elevator to come.  
Room security lock latched behind us and security had to use the terrible elevators to get to us, which means 1 hour wait.   The hotel is also not cheap.  I stay in hotels 200 nights a year and this is the worst hotel I have ever stayed at.  

Again do not even consider staying here!!!!

Can't believe I have to endure another night here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Food is really good, but a little too pricy for what you get. They serve imported drinks and the guacamole is delicious. I usually only visit during Happy Hour because that's when the restaurant is at it's cheapest. The staff is friendly and the atmosphere is very authentic. The only problem is the price. There is also some weird continuity as to what comes complimentary. My first visit, there was complimentary nuts and water ice. However, I have yet to be treated to the same thing again. Overall pretty good place. B

Slow service. Guest #4 but still waited 7 minutes for my incorrect order. Forgot my fries. Cashier said I didn't order fries. All I said was number 1 with no tomato with a shake. Which comes with fries. He wanted me to get back in the ever increasing line to order fries. Yeah right.

He should have admitted his mistake and just got me some fries. Instead I leave unhappy and won't return.

I also hate how ordering a shake delays your order so much. Why is it such a big deal? Why would you hand out later orders instead of making my shake first?

I ordered a tray of lasagna here.  It was not edible.  It was gross. It was wads and wads of mozzarella cheese .  A layer of pasta on bottom. Then it looks as though he just dropped big balls of mozzarella  (not shredded) into it layered one more pasta layer on top and baked it, very , very little sauce.  My guests could not believe it, it was nothing we've ever seen before.  The owner claims this is the way it's made, it is not. There is no way other customers would eat this lasagna as he claims.  If he was on the restaurant critic show it would have been thrown in the garbage.

This place SUCKS!! They have zero SEVICE and expensive. Never again we will take a car to Dobbs. 
Two tires. Dropped off car at 11am. They said come back at 4 and it will be ready. 4:30 and they are just now putting the tires on. No apology no excuses. They are terrible. Try to hard sell unnecessary items and repairs. I am shocked they have not been shut down by the attorney general of Missouri. Bait and switch. They said 4 tires would be $259.00. When I confirmed they said no sorry that is for only two tires...we calculated wrong.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I have to say I'm not sure about these reviews, but they are also 2 years old but from my food experience the food is on point. I'm a very picky eater and particular about my salads. Which means things have to be fresh - meaing no soggy tomatoes, crisp lettuce, crunchy croutons and etc. I ordered a grilled chicken salad and i got all the above fresh crisp items in it and a hard boiled egg (hard to get elsewhere). The service was pleasant and my salad was on point. Will definitely order again from Vito's.
   Salad junkie

Order 7:32p and they tell me 40 mins and total is $20 and change .  8:26p no food... mind you we live less than a mile away . Lady says ok it's coming just a couple minutes away . Now it's  8:42 and still nothing ! Call back again and same lady says  "um don't see your order". Put her manager on the line he continues to tell us there is no order with our address , are we sure we ordered on the phone etc etc. ummmm yes we are sure. Just a horrible encounter and extremely frustrating . No apology or anything .  . Lost a regular *deletes contact *

I adore McDonald's, but this is the worst McDonald's I've ever been to.  I always use the drive thru because I usually have kids in tow.  They ALWAYS get my order wrong, forget to give me part of the order or just don't make it right.  I ordered a latte here the other day that must have had 50 shots of espresso.  It was like mud, I almost threw up.  And they NEVER apologize when they mess up.  Don't have this problem with any other McDonald's in the immediate area.  I am tired of dealing with it so avoid this McDonald's at all costs.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place use to be a amazing, affordable deal. We use to love to eat here.Not so much now. We came in got sat down. I ordered water and my boyfriend ordered a soda. The soda was flat and my water glass had indistinguishable grime on the inside rim. Our tempura appetizer had literally skinny shrimp and one each 6 veggies.  We saw our rolls sitting in the bar. By the time we got them,  our rolls were sticky and soggy. It has really gone down. We did end up getting new soda, but it took a bit. Our waitress was nice, but we will spend our money elsewhere. Go somewhere else.  We will be.

Terrible experience. I stopped here on the weekend after shopping because it wasn't busy (only 1 car in the drive thru and no one in the dining area). The person taking orders wasn't paying attention and kept messing up my order. (It wasn't difficult either: I wanted a sandwich and drink for myself and a kids meal for my child) I still ended up getting the wrong stuff. 

The food was badly prepared. The fries were barely lukewarm and hard, tasted like it's been cooked in rancid oil. The Reuben I ordered was soggy and poorly made (and cold). The sandwich with the kids meal was even worse. 

Never coming back here.

Very disappointed. Son was told he could not carry a gallon of water while working out. He is a 6'4" athlete who drinks a lot of water. They have 1 water fountain. My husband who has a great deal of injuries from his job was told that he could not use the machines in 30 minute work out room when it was completely empty because he was not doing a circuit.  Understandable if it's busy but it was empty!  The staff puts on blinders when it's obvious that people are doing exercises wrong when they can seriously hurt themselves. Not safe at all. I cancelled 5 memberships and will not return
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Be honest, this is not New York style pizza. I never had pizza like this in NY.  They must place sugar in the sauce..it has no bite at all, only sweet.  Overall a boring pizza.  Since they have tables on the sidewalk, why allow pickup customers to park at the curb ..engines running, and all the exhaust fumes getting to the tables.  Why does the waiter offer to box my slices, when he clearly sees I am still eating?  I tried this place from the reviews, but not again.   If you want the best pizza in NPR, go to Rossi's on SR 54 or Alpha on Ridge Rd.

Nice unassuming sandwich/salad/bakery/breakfast & lunch spot in Fenton Industrial Park. If not for Yelp I would not have known it existed! The small storefront disguises the large interior space with spacious dining rooms. Order at the counter and in a few short minutes your food arrives at your table hot and fresh. BLT and Fried chicken club were both good sandwiches with generous portions. Sides are pretty standard - a bag of chips, potato salad or very small side salads. Too full to try dessert but several choices looked delicious. Only open daytime hours M-F, but a nice affordable lunch stop.

Found ants in my munchkins, that should pretty much sum up my experience at this Dunkin'. Don't know how they can serve food with rodents in them makes me wonder what it's like behind the scenes. Anyway they obviously lost my business and I hope after reading this you decide to do the same. Step on the gas and go to closests Starbucks. I rather pay more money knowing everything is sanitary and I don't have to question myself every time I'm about to take a sip of my iced coffee or eat a breakfast sandwich. Honestly disgusting DONT GO HERE

They move pretty swiftly. I was a walk in; I was getting washed, set and under the dryer 2x app within 20. Business picked up and they became more busy. The shampoo lady is phenomenal, she gently scrubbed my scalp so good.. ahh (she's a keeper) my hair was squeaky  clean... normally I whenever I go to the Dominican shops, I receive a wash, blow out ; either straight or bumped. This time I was washed, deep condition and my hair was sectioned off with clips and curlers... I've never sat under the dryer twice before - normally they'd flat iron after blowing it out

I understand this is a tough time for businesses. However, when a service is incomplete, I don't think that is acceptable. I opted for the Platinum wash which includes an interior cleaning. My backseat still has visible dog paw prints and there is mud on the mats in the back (of which I don't think is of my doing because that wasn't present before). I'm annoyed because I expected my interior to be sufficiently cleaned. I don't think I will be back. I will drive 45 minutes to the car wash in Lawrenceville NJ.

The salon is very clean and promotes a calm environment, which I like. The prices are a bit expensive: $15 for regular manicure and $20 for the OPI gel-like nail polish manicure (sans the heating lamps).  I recently tried the new gel manicure (sans heating lamps) and a few days later I had some nail chipping. I like that I can walk-in and not wait a long time to have my nails done. They also have great hours. This isn't my go-to place but when I have a tight window to get a manicure done I will go here. I have also experienced their pedicures, but not recently. I remember that they were ok but not the best pedicure I have ever received.

Buyer Beware!   We cancelled our son's membership in July (during the Covid-19 epidemic) but Gold's began charging us again in November.    The customer service team at the Carrillo location don't care about their customers--they're shills for ABC Financial, the company that holds their memberships.     It was difficult to cancel our membership (no thanks to the people currently working there) and we're contemplating joining one of several California class-action lawsuits against the company for bilking former members during the Pandemic.    It's gross.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Just trying to get a quick bite.... was not quick.. the training is not done well. So the service is well below par. Order was not even correct. Fries were burnt.  The oil at this location at one time was changed often.  But did not taste that way today.  If you see brown fries... throw them away and put some new ones down!  Don't give them out to customers.   When you have a line of 12 people inside.. you shouldn't have the trainee doing it solo.     Just disappointed. Makes me realize not to eat out and so called fast.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We went for Sunday brunch and enjoyed our meal.  I'd give it 3.5 stars if I could.  The biscuits with honey butter were very good, as were the brussels sprouts.  The Rally House salad with buttermilk ranch was good but needed more lettuce.  And the fried rice was also good, but not amazing.  We had a solid brunch there, and it has a nice vibe.  If I hadn't been so full of cards and cheese from the night before, I may have enjoyed Josephine's even more.  I'd definitely go back again the next time I'm in town.  It's on a really cute street of stores and there's an awesome park down the street.

I expected this Joey's to be the same as there other location but I was very disappointed.
First thing we were told to sit where ever we would like from a server from the far end of the restaurant. The table we sat down at was dirty as well as the tables around us. My wife's chicken parm was left in the oven too long the cheese was burned. The sandwich I ordered came out 10 minutes after my wife's chicken parm. We also ordered a meatball sandwich to go to have later that evening it had egge shells in one of the meat balls. The server was  good and the decor was very nice but I'll never go back.

The sushi is good, but the place is super tiny crowded. Don't expect to have a romantic or private conversation here. It's really dark so bring your glasses and a flashlight to read the menu. The sushi is always good and fresh and the presentation is beautiful but you pay for the location. There are better sushi places in Santa Barbara, but if you want to stay in Montecito for sushi you will get good sushi at a premium. If there is a wait you'll have to wait outside or stand next to someone's table, and I don't think it worth the wait, unless like I said your in Montecito and don't want to go into SB. I sort of recommend this place.

The worst experiences one customer can experience. It took a month to replace my misplaced debit card. Several hacked cards and one customer said they believe some of their problems are inside fraud. After dealing with several incompetent staff ppl and being told several different explanations, I ended up writing letter to the President. I'm still waiting for a response to date. I'm not sure whose managing this credit unit but they need not be in banking at all.  Supervisor B. Williams is rude and told me one thing and then backed tracked. My next move  is to report them to the BBB.

I've been going here since they opened. I've had all the washes, waxes, even my headlights buffed to remove the haze. The short of it is, if you want a good cleaning, you'll need to do it yourself. If you are willing to settle for a job that is just OK, then this is the place for you. They are usually pretty quick and they are the only full service joint in Sahuarita/Green Valley. I wish it was better, perhaps if they actually had a supervisor review the quality of work before letting a customer drive away like nicer establishments I've been to, it would improve.

The food wasn't terrible. I had the spinach and artichoke dip (delicious, they poured a hefty amount of olive oil on the bread which is always good.) My chicken was cooked perfectly, the pasta was sub par though, quite bland.  I would tell you how my dessert was, but my server thrusted the bill in my face before asking us if we wanted dessert. We did mention it before we ordered our food though. She seemed preoccupied talking to another table about her honeymoon at Yellowstone. Go for the food, expect bad service and a terrible old fashion.

Well, when Vetture's is good it's good but when it's bad, their food is inedible and it's actually theft as they charge their customers for pizza that is reheated, oily and charred to a crisp.  Their meatballs are also at times burnt and can't even be eaten because they are stale and reheated.  I've had both pizza and meatballs from this place so I know when they make it fresh and when their food has not been sold or old.  Instead of donating it before it goes stale , they reheat it and pawn it off on their regular customers.  This practice is really disgusting and unethical.

This spot used to be amazing, but ever since Jason sold it, the quality has gone down and the prices have gone up. I wouldn't even mind paying more if the sushi was as good as it used to be. Very hit or miss, and lately, mostly miss. I've given this spot 3 more tries after the first time I noticed a change. Shrimp tempura rolls are never crunchy and the shrimp is so small. Luckily, the fish is typically fresh, but otherwise they're cutting corners. My last order of miso soup had 5 tiny pieces of tofu and 1 seaweed leaf. I have yet to find better sushi in the area, but it's time to start looking again.

We rented a car for several days in early August 2013, and the staff who works here were courteous and efficient. We arrived at the Trenton train station a couple hours earlier than planned, and they came quickly to pick us up. We got the car we had reserved and the gas price at the rental office was cheaper than the one on the streets. Drop off was just as easy, and they took us to the train station again. I would rent here again. I'm not giving more stars because the office and bathroom were shabby and not clean.

We had the Omakasè premier last night. It was quite good the fish was fresh and creative and yummy. A few things they may want to fine tune are the pace, portion and service. At times we felt a bit rushed. The sizes of each portion were definitely on the small side. The waitress didn't do anything except clear our plates, no wine or sake pouring. Seemed strange. We all agreed we were still hungry after a 450$ bill which seems crazy. I would return but I'd order ala cart. Like I said the fish was delicious but too small.

There are a few select staff that are friendly and provide quality work. However, that is now overshadowed by the inexperienced staff that they are hiring that I've ended up getting the last several times I've visited. I have left very unsatisfied and I've seen other clients have the same negative experience. Appointments are not recorded properly, I've been cut multiple times during manicures and the polish is old and dried out. Admittedly they have great prices, but it's all about the experience. This place has gone downhill in my opinion.

Not sure why there are any negative reviews at all, this place is a gem!!!  We came on a night with live music and sat outside on the patio.  The mood was perfect, and honestly, it felt like a warm and friendly party!  We had BYOB wine and enjoyed impeccable service.  Two separate staff took care of us, our water was constantly refilled, and the food came quickly!  My kids had the margherita pizza, which was delicious.  We also had the grilled vegetable salad, eggplant parm, gnocchi and mussels. Very happy with the quality and freshness of the food.  Delicious!!

I loved this place, in person got to sit at the chef's table a few times, and during COVID ordered delivery and food was excellent too, even considering the delivery time and loss of freshness. Today, 5/27 everything except cocktails and Crispy Brussel Sprouts wasn't good, for example, a crispy eggplant was way too sweet and to cheese, Seared Scallops, super spicy, salty and not washed, crushed bits of shell and sand in every bite, then my (former) favorite, their Cacio e Pepe changed, instead of Parmesan and/or Pecorino and pasta water, it was some bland corn starchy mixture with a little of pepper. What happened?

Cute hotel! Close to everything, good for first timers since it's right there in the mix of it all. My room faced a brick-wall/other windows, I wasn't too happy about that but I didn't try to change rooms, it just wasn't that important. Had there been a beach, I would have been right back at the desk :) The staff was nice, all that I encountered anyway....They need more choices on the menu. Love the décor! In the lobby and the rooms! Had a small room service issue but was quickly fixed! Thanks Donna! 

Thicken those walls! We basically had sex WITH the couple next door! hahahahahahah

I would definitely go back!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Our waitress was inattentive. The pizza was overdone. It was black on the edges. However, even though it was over cooked the sauce was good and the toppings were tasty. If they cooked it a few minutes less and checked on our table occasionally it would have been a four star review. The employees all seemed to be college aged. If they put a manager in to control quality they would be a top notch place. We waited for the waitress to take the bill, finally went to counter to pay. Three people walked by us before someone finally took our money. Still a decent pie.

I ordered a salmon caesar salad from here last night and found a hair in my food! It was late and I didn't feel like dealing with it on a Saturday night, so I called back today to see if there was something they could do. 

The manager apologized after admitting that they do not wear hair nets, but said there was nothing she could do since it was the next day and I threw the salad out. I would have appreciated a refund. Until they start wearing hair nets, I suggest going elsewhere. I will not be going back here.

Great location and the coffee is good. One suggestion I have is that the owner(s) finds a new baker to get pastries from. I like almond croissants, but a majority of the time I get them here they are completely overbaked. Sometimes even being charred and crumbly. Not sure if the reason why they still serve these is that no one has complained, but please find a new baker. It's disappointing to waste money on a dry and crispy burnt croissant that mostly crumbles. Other coffee shops get this right, I hope you do soon.

Sushi Ushi is awesome!!! The sushi is the "BEST" in this area hands down! Sushi is always fresh and consistent. The rolls are the perfect size with fresh, flavorful fillings and just enough rice on the outside to hold it all in. The owners are fantastic and very friendly. Very nice people who work very hard to make your experience great! Sushi Chef is "VERY" talented at his craft! We're so happy this place is in Valrico! We've been loyal customers since opening weekend and eat there nearly every weekend since! Thank you Sushi Ushi!!! Also, the Tempura Fried Fresh Jalapeño Roll is Incredible!

We love marble slab and have had this on the south side location, but I was less than happy with this location. We walk in to celebrate our daughters test results (big reward for her) and immediately we had to wait for 6.5 minutes while the worker stocked the beverage fridge with water bottles (no lie).  She finally attends to us and was not organized at all. She tried taking all 3 orders at once but she kept getting confused. Pulled out the wrong iced cream, we had to state waffle cone 3x and she hardly even mixed the toppings at all!  She could have done a better job with a spoon. Needless to say - we won't go back to this location.

Made reservations for a large party for dinner on a Saturday night. The manager called to confirm the night before and made all accommodations for food/drinks. On the way over we were notified they didn't have our reservation anymore and that 'open table' must have canceled it. No apologies no remorse or attempt to accommodate us when they clearly were at fault- was left scrambling looking to find a last minute restaurant that would take such a large party of 15 as everyone was driving in. Needless to say would never step foot here again.

Going to pickup my food at this McDonald's is the worst experience that I have ever had.  I ordered a double quarter pounder with cheese, plain, a medium order of french fries, and 2 ten piece chicken nuggets, then I waited for my order, they were taking forever to bring out my food. I walked in to get my order, they saw my receipt, and I thought they fixed it, but on the way home I only got 1 ten piece chicken nuggets, not 2. I will never eat at this  McDonald's again, I'm going somewhere else. They need to learn to not take too long to fill an order. I'm never going back there. Nothing but a bunch of uneducated snowflakes.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I live around the corner from this place so I pop in from time to time... Or maybe I should say I try to pop in from time to time as it requires planning and calling ahead to actually get a table... I want to like the concept but the reality falls a little short. I hate the ordering system... If I wanted to order food using an app I would just call Uber eats. I just want a waiter and a menu. The food is pretty good. The tacos definitely have great ingredients but I wish there was more ability to be able toCustomize them on the app. This place is super popular so my opinion probably wouldn't matter at all but this place could be a lot better.

Good coffee. VERY WELL LIT in the day time. Great place to bring some work and sit for a bit. Its quiet, but the music is always a great selection. 

Baristas are really hit and miss. You know when someone hates their job and you for coming to their place of work? Then they hate you more for ordering a drink and tipping. So when they mess up your drink because they weren't listening to your order, you don't say anything because it seems like a conflict... thats this place sometimes. 

Other times its just a normal coffee house experience and no one looks like they want to kill you.

I got a flat tire from a screw today and went in to have it fixed and walked out paying absolutely nothing!  They patched my tire, put air in all my tires, and checked my brakes because I mentioned they were making some noise.  Also, it was the middle of my work day and instead of having to sit there while they did the work they gave me a ride back to work and then picked me up when it was all done.  I seriously couldn't believe it!

The place was organized and the staff was friendly.  The guy who helped me, Eddie, was very friendly.  This is one of the first places I've taken my car that I feel is trustworthy.  Great job guys!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Finally an excellent craft beer establishment in New Orleans! The selection of singles offered here is far superior to any other place I have come across. Patrick, one of the co-owners, is incredibly knowledgeable and an excellent resource in pointing you toward a new beer that you will enjoy. In addition to singles, they also have gear from many local breweries. The space is also gorgeous. Really hard to find something to criticize about this place except that it took this long to come along. If you are a beer lover, this place is a must!

Manager did help me

Loud loud loud. Do not expect to get rest. It says quiet time starts at 9 pm but that's when the party starts. Rooms are old. Way overpriced.  Operator won't answer despite my 13 calls between. 9&10 tonight to attempt to get the parties quiet. If I could get my $ back I'd leave now and go elsewhere.  If you don't care about sleep stay here. If you don't care about a lumpy worn out bed then you will love this place. Ate lunch at the grill and chicken was red on the inside.  When I showed the waiter he said it was the lighting.  In all my years this is the worst stay of my life at any hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We made an appointment to get pedicures but they didn't get to us until 45 minutes after our appointment time. Made us sit with our feet soaking in cold water for 45 min (I timed it) while they were with other customers. Then my friend got her pedicure and I didn't even have anyone start mine until hers was done and her toes were drying. Just a little annoying. Pedicure was just ok...barely scrubbed the bottom of my feet and barely pushed back cuticles. nothing great. Seemed rushed like they just wanted to get it done and onto the next.

This location is super close to my house but the management is seriously lacking (no one there in the early morning) and the facility is run down just like the center it is in. Recently the young girl that works the front desk in the morning had strep throat (with no antibiotics) and was required to come to work .....really, no one could fill in for her (not even management)? PLUS, all members were now exposed! Real responsible. This place needs a complete makeover - facility & staff.....poor representation of LA Fitness.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Tonight we arrived with barely anyone in the restaurant at 5:10pm.  We were seated at 5:15 because they needed to clear a table - most tables were dirty.  
At 5:29 our waitress finally motioned that she would be back in a moment to take our order.  She arrived at 5:37 to take our order (just about 20 minutes after we were seated).  My husbands bento box came pretty quick, but my order (sashimi) arrived another 15 minutes later.  The rolls split as you picked them up, no sauce for the tempura and the miso soup for my husband was cold.


Needless to say we won't be back to this location.

I've been going to Yamato for years with friends, always for lunch. The sushi is as fresh and tasty as any I've ever had. I usually get the spicy tuna roll, yellowtail and salmon rolls and I've never been disappointed. We also get their salad, which has this awesome house dressing made with ginger or something and I can't help but tip the bowl to my mouth to get every last drop. Their miso soup and cucumber salads are also memorably good. I'm glad they've made it through the recession and for the life of me can't understand why Sushi Garden always gets recognized as best sushi in Tucson when this place is indisputably superior.

Although service was fast, the delivery guy was rude. He called me twice making sure I was to be on my way, and I supposedly gave the wrong address. Ok, he comes, its pouring down raining, I stand outside in the rain and he finally gets out of the car to give me the food. Now he is pointing to cash, I paid with credit card. I guess he was asking for a tip, I don't know. He finally said, "Never mind", with an attitude and ran away. Now, the food; ordered extra spicy Scallop and garlic, scallops pretty much non-existent and it was not extra spice. Rude service and food not up to par. Taking my business elsewhere.

I am an active person but wanted to supplement what I was doing with strength training. The only catch is that I've had 2 back surgeries in the past. After talking with the owner Adam, he reassured me that I could start a strength training program and do it in a safe way. I have been lifting with him for several months now and have not once felt any issues with my back. It is a supportive environment that, when paired with Adam's deep knowledge, makes it both easy to continue training and incredibly rewarding.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
We looked at reviews an said 4.5 well we went during the covid 19, which meant outside dining it was a beautiful nite we order a app of hummus it comes out with No hummus an in to-go containers now u no how hard it is to get ur server again ok then we get our dinner an out it comes in to-go containers wow  I didn't know this was how every place was serving dinner !???! We were very disappointed  our bill was with drinks $93.00! I'm sorry but for 100.00 you should serve on plates!! We will never go there again! 
PS the food was a four out of ten !

We were a party of two at 6 on a Wednesday evening. They sat us in the enclosed patio area. The wait staff was slow and inattentive. The area was so loud that a conversation was not possible. The chips were cold and the salsa was bland. We ordered beef and chicken nachos that appeared to be dumped onto a few chips and then drizzled with cheese sauce. The chicken was in one huge hunk and had no flavor. The ground beef had a good flavor but had been cooked down to mush. 
We used to go here on a regular basis, but the past two visits have been very disappointing. 
Apparently they have decided to focus on alcohol sales instead of food quality.

I was really happy to see a new place in the neighborhood. So we ordered takeout one night. It took quite a long time for them to get it ready but when I was sitting there waiting for it they ofered me something to drink and everyone was very nice and chatty. When we got home and ate, the portions were good. The meat was nice and tender. It was a little higher priced, but I guess you get what you pay for sometimes. They were doing a great buisiness in the restaurant. It was packed. The next time I would like to eat there. It looked like a nice, fun place. I will be back.

Salt, salt, salt!  In a city that puts out some really amazing food (NOLA, Coquette, Cochon, Atchafalaya, etc), we ran across a few duds who substituted salt for flavor.  i had a pasta with meatballs.  The meatballs were very good - seasoned well with a bit of spice that you'd expect in New Orleans, but the pasta was a gummy, salty mess.  The food came out pretty cold, which didn't help too much.  There are a ton of great places close by - maybe Italian should be avoided in New Orleans in lieu of more traditional food?  But it just seems a shame with a lot of beautiful flavors available to put out mediocre food.

I order a cheesesteak and cheese fries. I want average time for them 10-15 minutes when I went back inside to grab my food the cashier said she over charged me and gave me extra change back.which I'm like okay didn't mind I was curious why I was charged 14.00 for platter but did not question. When I drove home open my platter the fries was good,they just messed up on my cheesesteak it was tasteless and also I asked for only salt pepper ketchup. They must have have given me someone else's steak because it had lettuce,tomatoes,fried onions everything I can't eat. 2 star on this location I drove a distance and couldn't return my order back.

Subpar hotel for the Westin brand. Service was shoddy on our stay and even though we arrived at 4pm for a guaranteed 3pm check-in they were not ready for me and we waited until 5pm to get our room key (said they would call me when it was ready but never did - an hour later I went back to ask and only then did I get my key). Lobby is uninviting and basic for a Westin brand hotel charging $500/night for a regular room w/king bed. Two stars because they have self parking garage attached to the hotel which is convenient in the middle of winter. There are plenty of
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Just meh.
