Holy Cow Pony!!  I go here, rarely, because my friend is a huge fan and sometimes I need to slum it!!  Yes, it is an eclectic bar scene with so many different types of people, that it makes for good entertainment.  There's bikers, college kids, hipsters, bridal parties, your average Joe, and pretty much any other type of person in attendance.  There's several pool tables and other games if you're so inclined.  The floor is a cross between sticky and slippery.  The women's bathroom is scary.  There's one toilet...one freaking toilet...come on, really!!  

I will give kudos to the cheap drinks and quick service.

Outstanding service + Exceptional food makes it worth paying the high price!

I was a vegetarian stuck in the land where people like me are few. Our server ensured That there were enough options for me. He was extremely good in finding those options and recommending those.

I had appetizer, Pasta, Pizza and a desert. He ensured that none of those had meat, fish or eggs. He ensured multiple times during the dinner that everything was as per our expectations. He ensured that we were aware of all details or anything special about the food we were eating. 

Definitely worth the price!

They are scam artists! We've used them many times in the past and today they tried to tell me the lenses my wife needed would be an additional $290++ additional to the $197 my insurance would cover! So basically telling us just her lenses alone were $500 just for standard type  lenses! I'm in shock since her vision is typical nothing unique required so unless theses are X-ray lenses there's no logical reason they would be $500 for lenses alone!!! Needless to say we'll be taking our prescription and buying glasses elsewhere! So sad they tried to get us to overpay so significantly for average lenses
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
We came here because it was walking distance to our place and it looked good from the outside, but I was severely disappointed.  

First, it look a super long time for us to get seated given the emptiness of the restaurant.

My boyfriend got the chicken teriyaki and it looked good and while the chicken was okay the sauce was very salty.  I got the sushi sampler plate and the food that came was not worth $24 that it cost; the sashimi was below par on its quality and freshness.  

If you're in the mood for Japanese drive 2 minutes and go to Wasabi.

I want to love this hotel. The amenities and friendly staff make it a great place to stay. It is close to the airport and has quite a few things around to eat. They have renovated, but they didn't update the windows or AC system. There is mold on the curtains and the AC vent was covered in mold. The room is humid. The thermostat is new, but clearly the rest of the system isn't updated. The humidity in the room won't go away, no matter how much you use the AC. If they maintained the rooms and systems better; this would be a great place. But breathing in mold throughout your stay is a major reason to avoid staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Relly enjoyed the Churro donut along with the Mocha. Staff is always nice, clean facilty.

Presentation to get home and boxes has a bit to be desired.

I only order a few at a time now, so they fit in the box flat. With the thick and tall icing, they should never be put on the sides, otherwise you end up with donut soup. The boxes can be a PITA to open at times, super tight fit.

Most other places in town can stack them sideways, but with the frosting here, six to eight is pushing it. Keep that in mind. 

Walk four miles after each donut. They are rich. :)

Why wait until Tuesday when Monday brings you the opportunity for a rarely seen lunch hour.

1. Guacamole and chips were on point. Intern wasn't a fan of the salsa, but he is wrong.

2. Had to get the intern some real tacos. Al Pastor, Lengua, Cabeza, Chorizo. Add, baptize him with horchata. Mission complete. 

Tacos El Rey again delivers the plate of perfection.

No lines, great staff as always.

On the way back to the office, the line at Dutch Bros was only three deep. Flipped a U eee and got the good stuff. In the words of the great Ice Cube, today was a good day!

I went here for an exam and contact lens fitting and agree with the Mary Anne review from several months ago. Lots of employees standing around not doing much but looking at their computers. They also seem quite disorganized as a young woman called me the day of my appointment saying that my eye follow-up appointment was not covered by insurance and I would have to pay out of pocket. When I went to the office it turned out they misunderstood that this was a second appointment and that I wasn't to be charged. Nice enough but they need to get their act together, this is a doctors office not a Tommy Bahama store.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Now I'll start off by saying that this hotel is beautiful and located in an amazing area of Tucson. There are so many great places to eat and drink near the hotel (brewery, steak house, Mexican street tacos, bars, night life). The rooms are modern and have amazing views the beds are really comfortable too.  

Now here's the the reason I only gave the hotel three stars.  This place is LOUD!!!!! Since there are a lot of bars around this place, the music is blasting until 1:00 AM.  It's one of those catch 22 scenarios, the bed is extra comfortable but with the loud music, it's a pain in the ass to fall asleep. 

If you stay here, bring earplugs.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Spent $2,134 in new brakes twice since 11/2018 and I'm left with squealing brakes that I have to get another shop to repair. Horrible service, unprofessional, charged for unnecessary repairs, treated poorly, don't expect a call back about your car in service. I had to take my car back 5 times and it was in the shop for 7 full days. They should pay me for having my car so long. I continue to have problems, zero response from corporate office. 

Watch youtube video, its a must see. 
https://youtu.be/fnv7OKlUccs
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I bet if you did all of your grocery shopping at ALPS for a month your hair and teeth would all fall out from malnourishment.  They specialize in random food items that look like they fell off the back of a truck, halal meat, beer, liquor, lotto, cellphones and cellphone accessories.  Beer, liquor, and lotto are in their own separate section of the store so you don't even have to look at food if it's just not your thing.  One time someone in line ahead of me bought a $60-something bottle of Courvoisier entirely with ones.  Good times!  Stumble in today!

Free bag of money! It's shredded but it's a nice little memento to take with you.  

The federal reserve isn't somewhere you need to rush to see.  You can't really tour the building.  They do have an exhibit of various trivia and facts.   I will admit to playing some of the trivia games.  Unfortunately I did not do so well. 

They also have a machine set up that you can exchange your old quarters for the most recent new release of collectible quarters.  

If I had to choose, go to the US mint instead.  They have much more to see.

Joey's Pizza is your standard American pizza joint that you grew up with.  I've been there about 6 or 7 times so far with my fiance's family and it's very consistent.  Yeah, it's good on a Sunday night when you don't want to cook.  Yeah, it's going to be a people pleaser, but it isn't going to wow anyone. I don't want to say I dislike Joey's - that's not the case.  It's perfectly fine.  On a bell curve, it would be right towards the middle.  It's just that Joey's isn't exceptional.  Get an XL pizza of the works, it's pretty good.  I just want to help you manage your expectaions.

Went here for brother's 29th birthday fiesta - my Mother In Law was worried when we approached and the sign said "RESTAURANT"... brother was worried too ... as were husband and I (annoying foodies from Los Angeles) but her, his, and our fears were fully put to rest.  

Absolutely fantastic meal.  For all 10 of us.  Including our 8 month-old.  Great wine by the glass, amazing pork meals (both #1 and #2), amazing appetizers (especially the brie), amazing service.  

I grew up in Delaware, and wish I lived closer, because I would be back again and again.  Loved it.

The hotel is centrally located for downtown walking distance to most places in the city.  It was very convenient to walk to almost anywhere from there.

I felt the staff was very nice, cleaning was very good.  There was a bit of confusion about paying state taxes when on business for a nonprofit. Their business office said one thing, front desk staff did another. We figured it out, but after a lengthy period at the desk.

The hotel was satisfactory, but the walls were slightly thin. I could hear the neighbors unfortunately.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Hilton Santa Barbara Beachfront Resort Food & Beverage Service provided exceptional service for our dear friends' wedding -- Karma, Jonathan, Keira, Myra Madrigal & a sea of others. From cocktail hour through reception, we wanted for nothing & any request was handled with utmost import & ease. Brava, Hilton, to you & your team. Please ensure you continue taking good care of uncommonly great people such as these. They truly make your business come to life & our guest experience so very memorable in a really positive way! (Rating reflects event only, not other aspects such a accommodations, price to stay, etc))
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Just stayed there during Mardi Gras(one week)- Was built 1833 !!!  Yes its old and a maze to get to your room. So what! Great place to stay and get location to everything that's around. Would i stay here again. YES. Room with single bed/w window facing Decatur St. (on 4th floor), this is during Mardi Gras week-quiet. Shower was great and plenty of hot water. my very minor negatives is uneven floor in room(squeeks) and maybe a better (thicker-warmer) blanket. Front Desk and Staff Help are friendly and great! Thanks for a great stay :)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The fresh market is a lovely store where a group of high-end, organic, green groceries would go to get got. I love the fact that they have weekly specials, that are often a steal for the quality of food you get! Inside the store, it's like a dream - if you dream of organic chicken breasts, fresh fruits and veggies, savory sauces, and tasty prepared foods. What's more is that on their website, they feature a wide array of recipes for you to try out! I think this place encourages you to make healthy choices about the food you eat, and that's a plus! I'll definitely be frequenting The Fresh Market often, so say hello if you happen to see me!

It's NOT a night out on Bourbon street without both a Hurricane and a Hand Grenade.  Although the recipe is a secret, you can rest assured that the drink is both delightfully refreshing and tasty.  For $8 you get a drink in a tall Fat Tuesday's-esque plastic cup with a little toy hand grenade floating at the top.  The drink is Midori green in color (hmm...) and the taste is strong.  You get your money's worth for sure!  Be sure to throw the hand grenade into the basket.  If you nail the shot in your drunken stupor, don't forget to claim your high-five from one of the bartenders.  I sure did.

Came in with a friend who had just returned from a trip to Texas. We wanted a nice lunch. We shared the Panzanella and he had the Angelhair Pomodoro, I had a mixed seafood Mediterranean style salad. We shared a piece of cheesecake. I had a glass of pinot gris and he had an Iced tea lemonade. Food itself was excellent. Very fresh and hardcore Italian ... My only things keeping this from being a 5? The bread should have been warmed and the lemonade should have been made with fresh lemons. Server was nice and owner was present and hands on which is great.

The search for a local place that serves good pizza has been exhausting. Yes there are 2 good places on the way home from work and Center City has a few good places, but sometimes you just wanna sit in your pjs and get some pizza delivered.

Venice hits that spot for me now. The delivery was a little slow, but it could have just been bad luck. The Sicilian pizza crust crunchy like it should be, but not dense like a rock. The sauce on top was fantastic and they actually sold a half size Sicilian which was the perfect size for my craving and some leftover for lunch.

FYi: still waiting on the second fraud investigation being conducted by Fulton Bank, as Marriott front desk also stole off my debit card, too. One down, one to go. Lesson learned, never stay at Marriott!

By the way, check this out, i STILL HAVE SCARS from their bed bugs!! But Bob MacDonald said he had the room checked about a week after i checked out, and he said they had no evidence of bed bugs. My docs and pics of blood streaked sheets and insane allergic reaction on my body, yeah, those aren't evidence. Ok, I believe you, Old MacDonald!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Not the best and not the worst that I've said at.  Located right off I-10, it is easy to get to and from.  (Took no more than 15 minutes to downtown). Front desk staff was super friendly and sped through the check-in process.  They were also helpful in pointing out places to eat.

The lobby, sitting area, bar and restaurant have been nicely redone.  The rooms now need to follow suit.  The bathrooms specifically.  Just a little facelift please!
While its free, it's hard to bitch about, but the wifi was pretty slow.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A delicious thin crust pie! It has the perfect ratio of cheese to sauce. This is definitely one of my favorite pizza places in the Delco area. It is just a little too far from my house to get a a hot pie home.  I would rather enjoy this one in the establishment because I know it's going to hit the spot. It's also a little pricier compared to local pizza shops, but for the taste I would gladly trade.  It's been a while since we ordered from here and boy were my taste buds missing this pizza. I will have to make sure I keep them in the rotation and order them on my way home from work.

Went on A Saturday for lunch and there was hardly anyone in the joint! Took the waitress a 1/2 hour to bring our food which was all from the fryer! I had the sampler and everything was cold! I should have sent it back but I was hungry. Lauren had the boneless wings and they 2 were tasty but cold.  The food was good but I am sure it would have been much better if it was HOT! I did not finish my meal because of the temperature but decided to bring it home which I  reheated and it was better.  I am guessing the waitress let our meal sit in the window too long! I will give them another shot but it will not be anytime soon!

Hit & miss... I had the all you can eat sashimi which all in all was pretty decent. Really weird is that all the fish was pre-cut and the "chef" just slapped in on a plate and gave it to me with no presentation whatsoever. The fish was of OK quality and the only one that really stood out for freshness was the yellowtail, the salmon was pretty fishy.
I will commend the chef that he was on top of things and really wanted you to get the most for your money. The waiter was on top of things too and overall I enjoyed the experience but I wouldn't rush back.
Your AYCE comes with free saki so don't forget to order it ;)

This hotel is not worth more then 300-400 per night. Ocean view sux. Hotel and rooms are out dated dirty and old. They do not do a very good job of cleaning ie. spider webs everywhere and ants in the room.
Our room did not have curtins on half the windows. When I asked to change rooms we were told sorry too busy. They said they would try to put up a curtain but they might bot be able to. I said that was kind of unacceptable and they replied I am happy to refund your money and u can leave. Rude. Check in staff was very rude. I don't know how many other places there are in Santa Barbara but please try to avoid this one.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
What is with hotels not putting drawers in the room. I like to unpack my things not just leave them on my suitcase. I have this complaint about many hotels but never has it been this bad. Only one drawer in the entire room. The front desk said that when they remodeled the rooms the took the drawers out. WHY?

Otherwise the hotel is fine not great not bad. If it wasn't for my Marriott reward points this would not be worth it. I am a Marriott fan and this location is good just need management to step it up a little to make this a decent place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The lobby staff says "Aloha" but doesn't speak proper Hawaiian (they should be forced to do that as well).

The room screams "hej, hejsan" (the language of Ikea).

The room service and shuttle service says "buongiorno" because 1) my room had no towels 2) my wake up call didn't work and the staff waited 20 minutes to come to my room and 3) the shuttle service was 10 minutes late (which can be a pretty big deal when you are trying to go home after a week of traveling).

I had to dress at 4:30AM while peeing and brushing my teeth at the same time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I was really excited about the McRib coming back today! I ent around 10:40 in the morning thinking that being only 10 minutes into lunch service the food would be hot and fresh, right? WRONG. I waited for 15 minutes to get my order amidst the chaos I witnessed as their 'kitchen' only to receive cold food. I ate it because I had to get to work but it was wildly disappointing. I guess stockpiling food to sling it out as quickly as possible is a better alternative to trying to create customer loyalty and satisfaction. Avoid this location at all cost.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I really dont see what everyone sees in this place. cover charge,? ok....drinks a lil much, not to mention that they are way too understaffed and takes a really long time to get a drink. the place gets way to crowded for me. its a good place if u like crowds and like to dance, but if you are more of a chill, laid back pub kinda person as myself, and dont like to sweat your a** off from the moment you walk up to the place.......try somewhere else. i think the only way i could enjoy this place is if i am totally wasted before we go.

I have had a couple of predicaments with my cars.  Hien was able to resolve both of them.  He seems to me to be very honest and caring.  He fixed an air conditioning problem yesterday and explained that he could not guarantee long term results, which I appreciated knowing.  Air conditioning works great now.  Fixed it in about 15 minutes and charged way less than competitors.  

The other issue got resolved because he's open on Saturdays.  Doesn't get any better than that.  

My only complaint is that it is hard to understand his English and he only takes cash.  Otherwise, yes, I'm a fan.

I was here with my mom and 12 year old daughter. We waited 45 minutes for our food and the restaurant was half empty! When the food came, two of the entrees were cold. One order was just a plain waffle, and in addition to being delivered cold, it was dark brown, nearly burnt on one side, and significantly undercooked on the other side. I had the Traiter Tot waffle which was good, and the use of waffles is a novel idea, but the food quality and service took away from what we intended to be be lunch at a fun new restaurant. We'd like to leave but it's taking 10 min just to get the check!

Food is ok here. I recently moved to the Allegheny area of North Philly, which is rundown and in need of gentrification. The outside of this Chinese Take Away is very noticeable with its bright colors. The order area is encased in bulletproof glass because of the sketchy area. I ordered Happy Family and Wonton Soup; both of which were flavorful and not greasy. The only downside that I see to this place is the lack of acceptance of credit cards. There are atms inside, but with all the sketchy people around, I wouldn't risky using the atm inside. Arrive with cash ready!

This location is the only DD that I have ever been in that serves stale donuts at 8:30AM.  This happend to me for the third time this morning and I am over it.  They should be making the donuts fresh every morning and donating whatever is left at the end of the day, not charging for stale merch at the beginning of the day.  

From day #1, the owner/operators of this location have not cared about quality service or quality products.  Luckily the service has gotten better since they re-opened, but the quality still sucks.

2 stars for the location. It's right along the river in Eagle with patio seating which is lovely in the spring and summer. I took my mother here and the food was an overpriced disappointment. In fact, this place would be the perfect candidate for Kitchen Nightmares and should consider it so we can have a nice restaurant that actually cooks good food here. Their only saving grace was their bread pudding, I used to order it to go once in a while, but it seems in a desperate moneygrab they are now charging $7 for cold leftover bread without ice cream! Looked inside and place was empty. Hmmm wonder why.

Here I am, standing outside the rental office, contract in hand and an hour drive ahead at 10pm. No one can seem to find the car I've been rented. There's 4 women in a minivan with the engine on, and periodically one sticks her head out to tell me they're "probably still cleaning it."  
Extra bonus for the guys coming around and just offering to find me a new car, and at least being apologetic.  Also, the empty lot is well lit, and there's an overabundance of staff to help. Upgraded from a Yaris to a Chrysler 200.  Woot.

My husband, son, brand new daughter and myself met up with some friends at Gentelins for dinner one night, they had their infant son and toddler daughter as well.  Thankfully, they gave us a small room in the back, which was nice as we didn't have to worry about the noise of the toddlers and babies.  

My friend and I each ordered the wedge salad and soup and it was good enough that we both crave that salad now.  And for ~$7, you can't beat it.  Ironically, our husbands ordered the same meals and they were both very happy with theirs.  I would have given it five stars if the service was a little better than it was....

These guys are amazing!  

Called them in the morning ~9am, got a quote on 4 tires, said they'd get cheaper tires by 3pm delivered that day.  I brought my car in ~5:15pm, coming straight from work.  I was out the door, done by 6pm.  

Not to mention, I said there was a light on and that there might be an oil change needed - there's a coupon on their website - they let me know it was overdue and added that into the 45 min time frame.  

So nice over the phone, quick and efficient, priced extremely well with coupons available, and even nicer in person.  If you're lucky, you'll see a cute dog walking around the shop too. :)  Will return
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: we stop by here during breakfast while we were on our way up to northern Indiana and went through the drive-thru. The girl on the monitor let us know that there would be a wait, so we waited about two to three minutes before she was able to take our order. When we finally got to the window, you could tell that she was flustered and understaffed. But she worked professionally and she was polite. The food tasted like pretty much every other McDonald's experience, so I don't think we need to visit that. But I will say that the customer service we received was definitely top-notch when it comes to an everyday fast food restaurant.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Kim Cameron, Valencia, CA
LOVE Presto Pasta!!! I recommend the:
-Sampler Combo (Lasagna, Chicken Piccata, Fettuccine Alfredo)
-Chicken Parmesan (with Fettuccine Alfredo instead of the penne marinara & a side of extra marinara sauce for the chicken)
I love their Cesar Salads too! They use a rich, creamy, dressing (not too vinegary, like some other Cesar dressings).
This place has great food, and it's reasonably priced. The only reason for my score of 4/5: sometimes the food seems a little processed and not-so-authentic. I don't know how else to describe it...

Not bad but nothing spectacular.  Had some sake (house/hot) that was ok..  Kinda hot, probably heated in the microwave (ick!). But $5.50 for the large serving isn't bad even if it's Gekkian.. 

Edamame and the salmon/caviar roll for the food.   edamame was a bit overcooked and def frozen rather than fresh.   Salmon roll was good, but ginger was a bit stale..  Very comparable to anything I've had in the southeast before. 

For a college area and sushi it's def worth. 3 star..  Set your expectations and you will enjoy..  Staff was friendly..  A bit slow tonight so almost too overbearing for me, but definitely never waited long for anything.

The bomb!

This is quite possibly my favorite grocery store ever - across various places in Tampa, Chicago and San Francisco.

I've heard it's different in this Winn Dixie than others - I wouldn't know as I haven't been to any others.

Great products including prepared foods, aged meats, deli, etc.  Great people including a legit butcher who likes giving away free samples.  Always clean, spacious, and not very crowded.  Full liquor "store within a store."  

I recently moved here and tried Publix - doesn't compare in terms of quality and price to this Winn Dixie.

It's the only place I'll shop.

Located inside the Goodland hotel, is this very cool bar with a great cocktail menu! I was very impressed by the cocktail offerings and really enjoyed the vodka based drinks.They offer something for everyone. I didn't try the food but heard that the chicken thighs are supposed to be amazing.

The space: great design and lots of instagram worthy "photo shoots" are to be had in this place. If you venture off the bar and into the back room or patio, you'll see what I'm speaking of. There is nothing like this in the area and needed. 

Check it out and you won't be disjointed. 

Enjoy!

Stayed here for 9 days on a work trip and absolutely enjoyed my experience here. The hotel was super clean, there are tons of free Dasani water bottles everywhere (grab some from the gym to put in your room fridge), and the room service food from Hatters Crossing restaurant downstairs is an excellent value.
I found every staff member to be super friendly.

The only thing that I recommend be improved would be the quality of the sheets. It felt very rough on my skin. Definitely not the same sheets you get at a flagship Sheraton hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Yes I would eat here again and again and again! We came in with a large group attending a convention at a nearby hotel. Several members of the group had to leave for programs at various time putting extra pressure on our server. She handled the situation very professional and accommodated everyone's schedule. The food was amazing not one person at the table had a complaint. Everything tasted fresh and was presented as one would expect at a fine dinning establishment. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed!

This place is beautiful. I had heard they had outdated TVs and hot water issues but my room 251 had none of these issues. 
The resturant, internet (12.95 for 24 hours), and parking ($31 a night), are pricy but parking seems inline with all the other hotels in the area. 
Millie the "navigator" is AMAZING! She knows everything and is superhelpful. The guys working valet are all so nice too. Everyone I came in contact with at the front desk seemed indifferent and that really is my only complaint.
The hotel is walking distance to just about all of the touristy stuff and all of the street car lines (quarter of a mile).
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place used to be a lot better. Most recent visit they really messed up our milk shake/ McFlurry order.... I mean there's only so many options...like 3.. we did a Mobile order for 4 shakes and McFlurrys and they were messed up. I didn't see Jeff the night manager there. Typically when he's there everything runs smoother and everything is correct in our order. This is our go to place for late night milk shakes. Maybe Jeff was off that night idk but now I know to check first if he's working then I know my order will be on point and on time. Maybe next time McDEES!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I've always enjoyed the Marathon restaurants that are sprinkled throughout Philadelphia. I'm pretty sure that I've been to every one of them and I always have decent service and decent food for a reasonable price. My favorite item on their menu is definitely the Southwest salad with BBQ chicken. The lime vinaigrette is so good and the BBQ sauce on the chicken adds the perfect touch. 
I also love that they all seat so many people that there is rarely a wait. If you're looking for a fairly quick, casual meal and not really looking to impress then you can't go wrong with Marathon!

If you like walking forever to get to your room, up countless escalators, deciphering random elevators then you might like this place. 

It's lovely in way that is modern and sleek but the size was off putting to me. I was there for 3 nights for a conference and it suited my work needs. Nice rooms and updated technology. Banquets served large potions for lunch, dinner and break outs. 

Honestly I just found it to be too big - finding conference events was hard and confusing.  It reminded me of the Hunger Games!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Checked this place out last night. They have great flavors and awsome toppings. I had the tart, which tends to be hit or miss at most frozen yogurt places, but it was great here. My boyfriend had the strawberry, and he loved it. (He is very picky about his frozen yogurt. DIVA!)   
  
The chocolate didn't really do it for me, and I wish they had more fresh fruit toppings. None the less the place gets the job done.  

Reasonably priced at .35 an ounce. The toppings weren't a complete mess, and the store itself is very clean. You can sample all you want. Staff is super friendly.

Went here to get my breakfast grub on. I ordered the sausage mcmuffin with an extra hash brown. The egg inside of the sandwich was almost all egg white. I thought they took out the yolk but near the end it was there. I think they should start scrambling the eggs. The hash browns were a little oily which the bag soaked up most of it. They have started using the paper straws (yeah!). As mentioned in a previous review, this location does not have a drive thru. First time I've seen a McDonald's without a drive thru.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have been here several times and order 5-6 dishes for my family of three because it's not close to home and the food is excellent. I appreciate that my order is NEVER wrong when I pick up. Not a single thing is missing. They're fast and super clean. They take Covid-19 very seriously which is much appreciated. Their packaging is great and when picking up they're super efficient and friendly. The young girl who is in the back is super sweet. I'm pregnant and have a huge craving for ginger and she always gives me extra on the side at no extra charge. I will only come here for sushi going forward because it's definitely worth the drive.

Went through the drive-thru after heading home from bar hopping downtown. The prices are so cheap, suspiciously cheap for anything with meat, that I ordered onion rings and a fish filet sandwich. They accidentally gave us an order of crinkle cut fries. 

The fries were barely warm and hardly crispy. My onion rings were great - hot, real onions, right amount of batter, medium greasy. 

The fish sandwich was dry, and tasted like it had been sitting around all day. 

Service was professional and timely considering the time of night. I would only return for more onion rings and try to come when Church's Chicken next door is open.

Took my mom on a Sunday afternoon as a little get away luncheon. We were seated immediately, enjoyed one of the performances of "Somewhere over the Rainbow" by the hostess, and had one glass each of the house Chianti, which is very good, and served generously in a good size tumbler, Italian style. 
The food came promptly, Mediterranean Sea Bass for mom, and Pasta di Mare for me. Both came piping hot and with enough to take home for a second meal. We were served politely, promptly and efficiently even if the server spoke really LOUDLY.
I'll bring her back soon.

Usually I can count on McDonald's to be consistent. No matter where in the world I am...maybe with a few additional items on the menu...but consistent. What I have found lately though is that Nashville area McDs have become very inconsisten with what is available, which machines are "up" or "down" and whether they value their customers receiving fresh french fries.

I started boycotting my local McDs b/c they were so incredibly inconsistent, after the 3rd epic fail in service the employee said "don't blame me, I just clocked in".

You get what you pay for and sometimes a little less. Thats McD's for ya.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I had a good first experience here - the bison burger was excellent. I'm a huge fan of restaurants that use fresh ingredients and get them from local farms and businesses. They had just switched to using ketchup from a local business that makes it, and it is the best ketchup I've ever had! I know that sounds weird, but it is wayy better . I had a chocolate mint dessert that was really good as well. I did the Devour Downtown deal, and from appetizer to dessert - every part of it was delicious. The atmosphere is very nice and tastefully done.

A great space carved out of the old county courthouse, that retained much of the original design's charms - soaring ceilings, wide hallways, spacious rooms, huge wood doors, marble walls, and more. 

There is an outdoor pool, cafe in the lobby and a restaurant on the second floor. 

Our bed was super comfortable, the closet spacious, a fridge in the room and huge windows. Neat and clean. Valet parking was a snap. 

Unfortunately, partly due to Covid and partly due to the MLK holiday, both the cafe and restaurant were closed. 

Great spot if there's no holiday.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Clean, Covid protocol conscious and terrific location. Our room was bright and airy, and the two restaurants on site with ample outdoor seating make the stay easy for guests and particularly families. Water bottles provided too! 

Included in the portfolio For Bonvoy (formerly Marriott and Starwood) members as well. 

The biggest surprise was in room Starbucks coffee instead of the usual flavorless garbage. 

Definitely stay here again for any of the popular attractions and restaurants in the area so we can skip the drive home after a dinner (at Berns for example!)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
let me just say this...

We were packed like sardines in this tiny spot. 
In the middle of January, it is freezing outside, right?  So packing that many people in a small place makes the room temp rise... therefore we were all sitting and sweating uncomfortably all over the place.  It was embarassing especially since i picked the place to take my out-of-town family to celebrate a birthday!  

Advice, wear layers!!!  If i were smart I would of gone in spegetti straps! 

Food good, on par with most other more comfortable establishments... There are atleast 3-4 BETTER byos in a short walking distance i would rather go...

Super solid pizza spot and our first meal out post-Biden winning the election (!). 

Had our friends pick up the pizzas and meet us at the park. We were a half hour late meeting up with them but the pizzas were still fresh and bottom crust still nice and crispy. 

We got the Salsiccia and a plain pie. Both were great, but I personally liked the plain better because you could really taste the flavor of the sauce and tanginess of that sourdough crust. Definitely can see this place being added as a regular on our Philly pizza joint rotation.

Cute coffee shop with a minimalist vibe but still plenty of seating for you to sit and get some work done. I came in on a Friday afternoon and there were a good amount of people working but it wasn't too loud. (Side note: I did see a sign at the front counter saying no laptops on weekends & holidays...so potentially less seating to get some work done if you come on a weekend.) Wifi speed is nice!

Ordered an oat milk latte ($5.50) and it was delicious. It seems like the employees here actually know a lot about coffee, which I appreciate. Wish I had been more hungry to try one of their pastries!!

I felt like I was in that Seinfeld episode..."they know how to TAKE the reservation, they just don't know how to KEEP the reservation. The location is staffed by two poor guys who were struggling. They were waiting on people out of order, while the phone was ringing and ringing and no one was answering. The person ahead of me also had an issue with their "reservation". When it was all said and done, I waited 55 minutes to get in a car that I had "reserved". Do yourself a favor and rent somewhere else. Personally, I prefer the folks at Enterprise on Michigan Road.

I found them on a Yelp search and since my truck had bugs on it from the highway, I stopped in. This is a touchless wash which is the only type that I use. 
It is a drive through where you sit in your vehicle. It di a great job of removing them and mostly drying the truck off. It need a little touch up with a microfiber towel and you also get a free vacuum with your wash. 

There were several options up to @$15 for the best wash. I got the  $12 one and it worked fine for me . They accept cash or credit/debit cards and even have a ATM on site. I recommend them if you are int he area of Lapalco and Barataria Blvd.

Had the gyoza and sushi. Mom had the gyoza and the agedashi.
Food was ok. 
Gyoza-not bad, not homemade but not bad
Sushi-
   Egg (tamago), mackeral (sabe), cucmber roll (kuri) and a philadelpia roll (smoked salmon,avocado,cream cheese)
It was pretty good except the smoked salmon was hard to bite through. Ive had smoked salmon in lots of different places and have never,  repeat  NEVER,  had such a hard time biting into something they claim to be smoked salmon. 
Mom was happy with her food. 

Service was on point. Very professional and attentive.
However, the meal was way over priced. $46.33 for average tasting food.

The hot wings are to die for! (Better order two orders!) It was easy to order for delivery, and we got one of their many bundled "deals."  So, we got a 2 liter sodas, 10 hot wings, and a large 2 topping pizza, for under 30 bucks! They have a wide and unique selection of " culture driven"selections! Where else can you get an Indian pizza?  We are staying at the Sands, and so the owner met me in the lobby, after phoning me in advance, that he was seven minutes away, and we met him. During the Pandemic, it is especially important, more than ever, to tip your service providers!

I dig this place! The food and view are great and the service is top notch, in my mind!

I wasn't feeling anything on the menu tonight and decided to order a chicken parm with penne a la vodka and they made it for me! Their desserts are amazing... ummm hello bread pudding and creme brulee!  The also serve bread, butter and pesto before the meal which is nice.

They have a valet parking option which is also a nice to have.  It's pricier for Tucson but worth it.  The menu is a bit limited and the wine list is pages and pages long as an FYI.

Definitely a place to go for a nice night out!

It would have been two stars but our waitress and the food were great.  I had reservations at 7:30 & we hit there early to have drinks.  We checked in and went to the bar where we stood for 10 minutes with barely a glance. One bartender just started putting away the glasses rather than asking us if we would like anything to drink.  We ended up just walking away and waited for our table.  
We were seated promptly and our waitress Micaela made the night better with her service and friendly banter. The food was excellent.

Rented through HotWire, decent rate for a holiday weekend. Car was fine, no issues there. Picking up was frustrating, the employee was polite but clueless. Claimed my credit card didn't go through then Insisted on getting my "full itinerary" to pay for rental with a debit card, but wouldn't accept a screenshot of my flight info and couldn't explain why that wasn't sufficient. Made full payment in advance, unclear why this was an issue at all. Management stepped in and it was resolved immediately. Picked up car at the lot from Herman, who was super friendly. Drop off was quick and easy.

Great location. This is the biggest Anytime Fitness I've been too in The Greater New Orleans area.

It's always clean and the staff are friendly. The machines and weights are always ready for use. I've never seen an "out of service" sign.

Unlike other locations there is One men/women restroom AND another set of separate men's' and women's shower room.

Even during the evening rush hour I've never had to wait on equipment. I actually take the long drive to this location instead of another closer one.

The location is on a strip mall that has a Smoothie King and Subway restaurant.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: There is nothing inviting about this place at all. It's dirty, employees smoking outside the front for a half hour, and there are not enough dryers. I understand that they're trying to make doing laundry not so much a chore but a fun place to hang out and socialize. However, their approached is not organized as far as you can't bring in out side food (but they only offer hotdogs), the machines are too expensive, and the staff is unprofessional. Just a tip...The pool table is taking up space, get rid of it and put in dryers. Combine the bar area with the front desk and put in newer machines with dryers.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Self-serve frozen yogurt on State Street... Yum!

Standard chain yogurt shop.... bright colors, cute cups and spoons, fun atmosphere.  

16 delicious flavors to choose from and a toppings bar filled with fresh fruits, candies, and other treats.

Best part about it was the cleanliness.  While we were there, the young lady working was constantly cleaning the topping bar and the yogurt machines while the young man there cleaned the two gender neutral restrooms. 

Service was friendly. 

We loved how it was open late.

One of the most authentic Mexican burritos I've ever had - tortilla and meat was grilled to perfection, and it was a long overdue explosion of flavor that I had missed being away from souther California, so thank you!

My only gripe that prevented this from getting 5 stars was their guacamole.  A) we paid extra for guac in the burritos; and couldn't find it until the last few bites.  B) when we did find it, it was more like an avocado salsa than a true guacamole so it was a bit cheap.  If you're gonna charge extra for guac, give me guac.  

Other than that - it was fantastic.

There is no way this place has only 3 stars. First of all, their pizza was phenomenal. This coming from a native New Yorker. And then there is their cheesecake. Oh my lord, it was maybe the best white chocolate cheese cake I will ever have. Oreo (?) crust with sweet plums and chocolate shaving. Like sex in your mouth. I also tried the "For the Ladies" drink from the bar and it was extremely good. The rooms were very nice, no complaints. The bad part is the location (5 - 10 minute walk to Bourbon), but I needed a cheap(er) hotel in the area, and the Lyft prices were half off all week. 10/10 would stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
OMG! where have you been all my life!? Two days in a row now we've been here and never disappoints!  Yesterday had the buckeye state which was a deep and rich peanut butter taste and scoop two was sweet cream biscuits with peach jam- mouthwatering than cover that with salty graham gravel- which I've never even heard of before here! Today, Sheridan who was SOOOO friendly and personable dished me pineapple upside down cake with bramble berry crisp followed by honey butterscotch sauce and donut gravel!! 
Yummy!! Lines move fast, plenty of samples and seriously nice staff!!

Just okay sushi. 

I'd prefer a slightly higher price point to get higher quality fish myself. I understand why they price the way they do. The clientele generally bought the Americanized dishes and was cost conscious. So they adapt to the Philly Sushi market. It's a shame. 

Nevertheless, for Philly, this is a decent sushi place. You can do a lot worse.

I also find it a bit off-putting to drink water out of a styrofoam cup I poured for myself out of a sink, and that the seaweed salad comes in plastic. They aren't Japanese in the way they take care.

I've been here several times and the good outweigh the bad. However, I had a carry out on Saturday January 25th and I was disappointed. I had seafood bisque which was excellent but I ordered a cup and it was half of a small styrofoam container. Half of a cup. I also ordered a slice of carrot cake, once again good but a tiny piece.  I've found this to be the case on more than  one occasion.  The sizes are great if you dine in but for carry out not so much. BTW I did have teriyaki salmon and green beans and I was happy with the size of those two dishes.

I've been coming to Sushi Ten for at least 10 years now and I have to say, this restaurant has slowly been going downhill. I used to love this place, the service, decor, the freshness of the rolls. 

Nowadays, they have cut back on a lot. Rolls are mediocrely decent - lots of rice, cream cheese, and carrots?! Service is hit or miss. I like the complimentary edamame or salad and looove the happy hour times and prices. But that's pretty much it. If your looking for just an okay cheap sushi place, then this is your place.

Went here for a bite at 9pm on a Wednesday. We walked in and the was no direction so after standing around we just picked a booth and sat down. The servers cold have been more attentive but this was great diner food. Had the blt and the turkey club. Bread was fresh, fries were good. Nice portions and delicious bacon. Would recommend! 

They have Plexi partitions between booths. Their cleaning was standard. I saw them cleaning the floor more than the tables but they were wiped down. 

Spent $23 on two sandwiches (with fries) and a soda. 

I wish we lived closer as I honestly think we would frequent more often.

I have never eaten in the restaurant, so I cannot speak to that. I have ordered delivery a few times. It has never been good. The only reason I have ordered more than once is because they make it easy with a good website that will accept CC's. The last time I ordered will be the last. An hour after I placed my order (I know the time because the website keeps you updated) I received a phone call from an Amore employee who sounded like a Kardashian, "Hiiiii, this is so and so from Amoreeeee, do you still want your orderrrrr cause weeee, like forgot?" Lame. No apologies. 

Attention West Chester restaurants, improve your websites.

I enjoyed my meal here, but was disappointed by the service. Granted it was Saturday night at 7:30. We were seated promptly by the hostesses, but it was somewhat downhill from there. Our waitress was not very attentive or personable. Maybe she was overwhelmed by tables and was just trying to keep up. I had the spaghetti and meatballs ($18). I believe the pasta was fresh... it was delicious. The meatballs were small but tasty. I was surprised the dish filled me up! The cream puffs were a great ending. My review would have been 4 stars if not for the service hiccups.

Loved this spot. The chef is a genius. No other word for it. 
The smoked Scottish salmon on the app menu is a must! The homemade bread will make you want to just eat that, but don't fill up because what he has in store for you is amazing!! 
I had the Mushroom Ragout and it was a festival in my mouth. His homemade pasta is one of the best! 
I love that they offer you a smaller portion. It was the right size. I finished off with the gelato and a glass of scotch. Fantastic! 
Also a shout out to our lovely and knowledgeable server Kelly. Thank you for letting us hang out and treating us so wonderfully. 

I'll definitely be back!!!

went last night, seated very quickly, service was great, waitress had good recommendations. i had the $25 pre-fixe menu, which was a good value, crab cake was good & vodka penne was good. My husband had the Special jumbo diver scallops with mango sauce, which was amazing and cooked perfectly. Had the house wine Pinot Grigio at $7 a glass, great deal. Also, we purchased the $30 yelp gift certificate which made the prices more reasonable, as they are slightly on the higher end. However, i'd prefer this over the Olive Garden across the street from it. All in all, i recommend it!

I came in on a Tuesday night which wasnt really busy which was great because that meant no long wait for a drink. Bluegreen neon lights casted an alien glow over every thing. I knew what I wanted before I had even walked in. The legendary Hand Grenade. I had to try this drink out after a tip from a friend. I got it frozen cause it was hot has hell outside. The drink was hands down awesome. It's way stronger then other frozen drinks that I've had. If I had one  more I'd end up in the gutter face down. (Thankfully I know my limit) The live band on the scene was pretty good. Wouldnt mind stopping by for another drink and to people watch.

For this genre of restaurant- a fast food type of Asian takeout- this place rocks! Yeah, it's not authentic but it IS pretty good quality old fashioned Americanized Chinese food. Service is great every time and they will happily replace any meat item with tofu. Prices are cheap and you get a lot of food!! I'm talking 2-3 days if you eat normal sized portions every day.

Their lo mein (soft noodles) are so good. And if you get the larger size it is seriously a shit ton of noodles. Blows Panda out of the water.

I know it looks a little sketch on the inside but give it a try!!

This is a great little place! So much so that I've been very reluctant to do a review about it. It's quite small and has been increasingly more crowded with longer and longer wait times all during the week. The sushi is very fresh and the chef is accommodating to your whims. They also have a very nice selection of sake. If you are a hot sake drinker may I encourage you to try some of the cold ones? I'm particularly fond of the Nigori, or "cloudy" sake - it's very refreshing, smooth and sweet. Just be sure to shake the bottle each time before you pour it into your glass.

I was sad to see these stores close up around Arizona, since they really do have the best donuts. So I'm super excited that this one opened up again!

I adore their simple glaze, but their assortments have great options like chocolate, custard, cream, apple, blueberry, as well as specialties like cookie dough and Oreo cookie!

Donuts are pretty cheap, being $1 for glaze, $1.20 for other kinds, and $1.50 for specialty ones. And it's $10/dozen assorted or $9 for dozen all glazed.

I don't come to this part of town often except to get my braces straightened nearby. But I know that I'll be getting a donut every time!

Slightly updated older building in a great location.  Walk out the front door turn right walk 2 blocks and your at the entrance to Bourbon which was convenient and somewhat safe if your walking around at night.

My room was right by the breakfast eating area and was not loud at all.  It was 1 1/2 the size of regular hotel rooms.  I had a king bed, desk/chair, sofa, large TV(not flat screen), and separate washroom.  Very nice for an 11 night business stay.

Staff from front desk, housekeeping, and valet were all very attentive and welcoming.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Really disappointed in these guys. I've been coming here ever since I moved downtown a year and a half ago and have never had any issues with the friendly staff. Today, however, when I walked in, I asked Chris, the guy behind the counter (two feet away) why he wasn't wearing a mask. (It's currently legally required in St. Louis.) He said it was really hot in the back, and I said I agreed it must be, but could he put one on when he came to help a customer at the desk? He said no, and that if I don't like that, I don't need to come back. Okay! Done. I'll find a new dry cleaner.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Wow, just had one of the best crawford boils I've ever had (see my pic)! Nice and spicy. They usually make a boil once a week. Great atmosphere here always a warm welcome. Things are getting back into swing again which I so good to see. 

Drinks are nice and strong but makes for a great conversations to linger to out in the courtyard. Local bands and musicians are always performing in the courtyard to really set things off. 

Definately come on down and check out B Mac's for a great night out. Cash only bar but they have an ATM on premises.

This wasn't a pleasant experience. The only good thing I can say is the price was great. $220 for five days in Florida. The wait was over an hour. They were taking 15-20 minutes with each customer. I've never seen anything like that before. It's almost intentionally slow. The car was a Nissan Rogue which was exciting because we love those. But it's over 30k miles, tires very worn, brakes sucked. Cars shouldn't be sent out like that, period. It's a safety issue and not to mention tacky. We will not return here. We'll do enterprise or try someone else new.

I've been to multiple of the IPC's and this one is my favorite lunch buffet location. They are usually busy, they crank out pizza, and I've never left disappointed. Staff are friendly, food is fresh, and I feel better about myself because I eat a salad. My only negative is that I always am painfully full the rest of the day because I lack control but can't knock them for that. The pizzas are usually the same each time but they do a very good job of bringing fresh ones. It would be nice to see some variety on visits but at the same time I like it, and see why they do it that way too.

We had a wonderful, huge ocean front room. It was clean and comfortable. The staff, from the reception desk to the waiters at the bar, were very pleasant. Would highly recommend this place. The only downside was that our toilet wouldn't flush effectively. We had to have the plumber in three times. We're not talking about anything heavy duty, just pee. Just before we checked out I had to head to the lobby restroom which was pretty far away. I was hoping they might offer a discount given the situation, but nothing was offered.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Party of seven, we check in ok, but as we are seated the staff realize they have to fix our table (literally fix it and take it apart) which was a bit awkward and uncomfortable, but from that point on it only got better.
I had the Osso Bucco which was delightful and tender. Served on a creamy dollop of polenta. I had to try the pasta since they make their own and the server suggested some linguini with browned butter...fabulous! 
Service was friendly and efficient. I would love to come back to try more pasta.

As someone who is almost anti-gym, I really do love being a member at Anytime Fitness, DTSP. I signed up almost a year ago, and since then, have never once had an issue with overcrowding, lack of machine availability (even during busy hours) and the staff is always friendly and supportive. I've tried the classes, and even those are small enough that they are personal, but not so small you're uncomfortable. I never thought that I would say this, but I love this gym and will definitely be renewing my membership for another year!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This place was recommended to me by a friend as AAA Auto Electrical.  Now know as Premium Auto Care.  Took my daughter's car in for an electrical short for rear brakes.  They were able to find it and called me to give me the details and different options for repair depending on what I wanted to spend on an older model car.  Happy with the repair and service.  Not the cleanest place, but then again it is a garage.  They also requested payment in cash too, but I got a receipt and they seemed legit.  Will probably use them again for future repairs.

It's frustrating when you are depending on someone for your coffee and the person at the drive-through wants to pick an argument when I asked for a couple extra napkins. I'm a little bit messy of an Eater and I always like to make sure that I have enough napkins, which is a silly argument to have, when I'm paying this person. This is our local Dunkin' Donuts and it just seems like they get more and more skimpy with the way they do business. It's not like I asked for 20 napkins I just asked for two extra napkins I sure hope the coffee is good LOL

Serafina was a nice restaurant with outdoor seating.  I went with a friend and ordered gnocchi with cream sauce.  It was so tasty I ate the whole thing.  The portion was a decent size but not too much, it was just right.  

The waiter was nice and even brought my friend's dog some water so he could sit comfortably with us.  I'd like to go back and try other things on the menu.  The only down side was that the drink I wanted to try was not available.  The waiter asked what flavor I liked and had the bar tender create a martini... it tasted like some flavor of cough syrup, so I would recommend sticking to the drinks on the menu : ]

The service was excellent and the food was great.

I had originally ordered nachos, but the cheese sauce/queso they put on it was like water, which just makes the chips limp, and kind of gross before they even set it in front of me, so I sent it back.  I then ordered two enchiladas, but our waiter said the same sauce comes on those.  He was happy to substitute shredded cheese on the enchiladas for me and they were great.  The soft tacos were also excellent.

You get a large quantity of food here for a low price and the food was very good.  A great find in Largo!

This Starbucks is easy to get to for me on the way to work. The parking lot is a little tight tho. I order in the morning through my app and pick it up on the way to work. It's so convenient! 

Certain times of day they are a little busier and what should be a quick in and out for my mobile pick up takes a little longer. Sometimes people who ordered in store are all standing around the end of the counter and that's the same place you pick up mobile orders so it's hard to tell who is mobile and who was in store

(COVID review) Bettina has been on my list for a very long time after my coworkers raved about their pizzas! On a Saturday at noon, I called in my order for 3 pizzas and they were ready in about 20 minutes. Since they are open for take out only, they have some bench tables outside so you can enjoy your food there while it's hot.

Each pizza is about $20, and is about 2 servings (3 slices each). The pepperoni is a must try! The sausage pizza was similar to the Margherita, and just had sausages and bell peppers added.

I've been to this Wendy's twice. The first time they were completely out of fries. How does that even happen?  I ended up waiting forever for whatever it was I ordered. 

I went here again last Wednesday. They weren't out of anything this time but the wait was ridiculously long yet again. I got a Baconator and I swear it tasted as if it was just dipped in salt. I couldn't even finish it. I was honestly turned off of Baconators for a while, something I never thought I'd say.  Never again will I go to the White House Wendy's.

My review somehow got deleted so this will be shorter. This Aloft was not as nice as the one we stayed at in San Jose Cupertino. The hallways of two different floors had a bad smell like a combination of being hot, musty, and weed. My room didn't have all the towels that was suppose to be in there along with the complimentary water bottle missing. When we called the front desk for more towels, it never came. The frame of our room door was damaged and looked exactly how someone would try to break in. It was weird and interesting they didn't bother to fix it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Just as an update: I was so perturbed by this apalling visit that I also wrote to the store manager. Andrea, who is the store manager, actually phoned me to let me know she had looked into the "situation" and dealt with those involved accordingly. 
She apologized profusely for my wretched experience and thanked me for bringing it to her attention. She clearly values having good customer service at her store, and I very much appreciated her phone call. 
Based on her phone call and sincere manner, I will be shopping here again in the future.

Grab and go was easy peasy. We popped in after finding a location that was nearby to the hotel we had stayed in and this one popped up. We were greeted right away and our orders were up very quickly. Drinks were made as ordered and staff was nice.   

This one does not have a drive thru and the inside seating was closed, but they did have a limited amount of outside (uncovered) seating if you really wanted to hang out.  

Overall: A  Easy in and out for a grab and go coffee, but no drive thru and lack of covered seating.

Excellent all around! I haven't met a drink or food item that wasn't delightful. I love the bar area and the dinning area in the church the most, but the patio and parlor rooms are also lovely. The decor of this place is top notch; the style feels vintage, elegant and European. 

The craft cocktail menu is pretty decent and includes seasonal cocktails too. I particularly enjoy the variety of spritz offerings. There's always a few vegetarian food items on the menu, and the dishes are fresh and perfectly balanced.

Location and price is why I'm giving three stars. Smells like mold, i think every room does and the lobby wreaks of cigarette smoke. 

The staff is semi friendly and they get the job done but overall our stay was so so. Slept ok on the beds but we also traveled with our own blankets and pillows which i highly recommend, since their pillows are tiny hard squares. 

You do have to exchange the soiled linens to get new ones, and that's tracking the soiled ones all the way to the lobby to get new. 

Also the room photos that you book are not very similar to what you get.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I went here a year ago based on co-worker's recommendations. I don't recal how long I waited to be seen; however, it doens't stand out so I am sure I didn't wait that long, if at all. Since my appointment I received glasses from another vendor and they were really quick at faxing my perscription to the vendor. I did buy 6 months of contacts there at my appointment and after that I went through another vendor.They were very nice and timely for both of my outside purchases. I will be calling back today to make an appointment.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I love Starbucks but this is the single worst location I have ever encountered by far. Between 300 and 330 on Monday Mar 2 I was trapped in their drive thru line unable to get out during the half hour it took to get to the window and be able to escape. People were actually leaving their cars and clustering to talk while we waited, unable to escape. When we went in to plead just to be able to leave the line, forget the coffee, we were told "they got busy" - but hey looked fully staffed, not abnormally busy, and not edit silly hurried. Awful awful awful.

Sahm's Place is quickly becoming my favorite neighborhood spot! We love sitting in the bar - it's cozy and almost always full of friendly people. 

They have a large menu - truly something for everyone. They also have a great beer list - mostly Big Lug and Half Liter drafts, but always a good selection of rotating drafts. From 3-6 and 9-close they serve $3.33 sliders. They have about 10 different options and they're all fantastic! My favorite one is the meatloaf slider. They're bigger than you'd expect - 2 are definitely the same amount (or more) than a regular burger. Also love the buffalo chicken sandwich and the steal salad.

We ate at Hart's Tavern while visiting Peddler's Village during their annual strawberry festival.  This was our first time at Hart's and we had the entire family (2 adults, 2 kids).  For the very affordable price, the food well exceeded my expectations.

I had the Roasted Vegetable Grinder with fries which was excellent.  The fiance had the Cheese Steak grinder which he also liked.  The kids had the standard kids meal fare and there were no complaints there.

The atmosphere in the restaurant was very cozy.  Servers were nice, even fellow diners were nice (we struck up conversation with several diners around us).  We will definitely be back.

We have stopped here over the years on the way either to or from New Hope and have learned an important rule.

Do not order any of the pasta dishes.

The pizza is normally very good and some of the sandwiches can also be decent but the pasta dishes are served in these little dishes where the sauce kind of pools in the bottom and then the pasta sits in a sauce soup that looks horrible and tastes less than appetizing.

Service has always been good as any time we've gone as the place has never been that busy, usually Sunday afternoons, and the prices are a bit steep but it is lower Bucks County so that is to be expected.

As we walked up and down the strip each night, we noticed this place always had some of the best bands.  Mostly classic rock....the band that was playing when we finally stopped in here was excellent with a lead guitarist who was just absolutely ripping it up on the guitar.  It's also really cool the way they have the band propped up on a stage behind the bar.

I guess you are required to try their famous "grenade", but I thought it was way too sweet and I'm not sure about their claim of being the "strongest drink".  Still we had a fun experience here and I'd go back to this place next time I'm in NOLA.

Whenever I wake up with enough time to enjoy a relaxing coffee and bagel before work I head over to higher grounds. I don't drink their coffee too much but their lattes are the best in the neighborhood and I have tried em all. Service can be a little slow if you are in a rush but they seem to be one of the few coffee shops that still actually press their espresso grounds for each drink. (I am not sure if thats what you call it but its basically what they do. No automatic machine here.) They also have really good smoothies and food. My personal favorite would be a bagel with cream cheese and tomato. So simple. So brilliant

This place is a drinker's worst nightmare. Staff completely took advantage of their power over the customers. Not only do you see them breaking the law by doing drugs in the bathrooms, but when challenged for a charge on my tab, they laughed in my face. I stopped by to meet up with a friend when I got off work and had one beer before leaving to go home. They charged me for 6 of a completely different kind than what I actually had in my hand. The staff was completely rude and treated me like I was a drunk idiot when I was talking to them. I have been here before, but now I will never go back.

First of all, this place is a blast from the quaint little neighborhood grocery store past!

There's a few things that are utterly amazing here:
1. sushi
2. chicken salad
3. chili
4. pretzel croissants

Try all of them, a lot of times, just to be sure they're good. I know I have. 

Take a stroll down their wine aisle.  If you don't know what to get, ask the wine guy there; he's super nice and knows a TON!

I splurge on their Trapp candles and Caldrea hand soap.  WORTH paying a little extra for quality smells!

Overall, youll pay a little more for the average item, but it's the atmosphere that makes this store a city gem.

Went for brunch on Sunday.  4.5 stars.  Buffet was 15.00.  Nice variety of sweet bread, coffee, traditional dishes, and a few unique options.  The buffet comes in phases so try to get there at 12.  Entrees were wonderful.  Huevos con carne.  Steak was awesome.  The pechuga poblana was dynamite as well.  Poblano sauce remarkable.  Service was perfect.  4 stars because it wasn't off the charts - but it is authentic and prices are reasonable.  Bloody Mary was meh....  We will be back.  It's better than good - close to great.

Went in on a Tuesday night, sweet bartender made a good ole fashioned, enjoyed music selection from the juke box (plenty of Tom waits), and free pool. Looking forward to going back. clean inside.

back in on a Thursday night, Adam was a very chill, attentive bartender.  Really enjoyed the house cheese taquitos - awesome sauce (tomato base with a carrot hot sauce)...pepperoni pizza was solid, also with a house sauce with a good amount of spices.  I might end up as a regular - other customers were just down for a good time, very friendly.

Local ? (kind of, they talk up the tiny garden "behind the wall" ), Different? (Almost), Trying to hard to be what they are not? (Definitely)

The tile floor and almost there decor is trying to be a hip yet upscale place and it just doesn't quite make the mark. 

The menu changes weekly which is nice, however last Friday night, everything, I mean everything was overcooked.  Pork Belly, Lamb Brat, Cornish Hen were all dry (yes, dry pork belly) 

Decent wine list, weird servers and the Yellow shirts need to go. 

I really wanted to like this place but I didn't

We stopped here with some friends and enjoyed the happy hour specials. $3 drafts, $5 margaritas $5 tacos and other things. We also had the steak fajitas which where fantastic. Only issues, our waiter was a bit slow and overwhelmed with the crowd so our drinks where not refilled quickly and the host was clueless. He did not communicate well at all with staff or customers. We initially walked in and after a few minutes of staring at him we walked to the bar and where finally helped by a waitress to get seated. Overall fun, so I'll try it again.

I heard heard good things about this Italian restaurant. The owners are related somehow to a few other Italian restaurants I have been to and enjoyed. The place is big, taking up a few store fronts. We were greeted and seated quickly. The place was crowded for a Thursday. The tables are tightly packed together, my only complaint. I don't like rubbing elbows and chair backs. Our server was very personable and efficient. The food as I suspected, fantastic. Each dish had its own flavor, and full of flavor. Fresh rolls and bruschetta were excellent and they have numerous desserts to choose from.

Pizza is ok. The couple times we got it was like night and day though, so you have to take your chances. Guess it depends on how the cook feels.

If you go to pick it up you'll probably have fun. Entering the dining/storage area is interesting. Some tables to eat at, while others are blocked by boxes and other items.

 You can watch the flat screen  tv, or enjoy the cashier argue with the pizza maker..awesomeness!!

They finally seem to be open on Sundays, now just clean up the building inside and out they might have something!

With all the other pizza shops in the area they need to do something.

Went there for lunch today, and let me tell you, do not let a little hole in the wall fool you! The food was delicious!!!! I had 3 tacos, 1 assada, 1 pastor, and 1 pollo and they were all authentic tijuana tacos and delicious! But even better was the assada fries that I ordered! Sooo good! Must try! 

I have one critique to the business though: 

DO NOT HEAT UP STYROFOAM IN THE MICROWAVE!!!! 

The box was all deformed and not to mention, the food was full of cancer causing chemicals! 

PLEASE, PLEASE get paper box for anything that goes in the microwave!!!

super disappointing!! I came here on a Sunday evening looking to get some pre-cooked food for dinner only to find that their food choices were very few, and not that fresh, not too mention expensive. I thought they'd be better than Whole Foods but that was not at all the case. Even the "fresh" multigrain bread I bought was not very good and a bit dry.  The pastries did look delicious but looks can be deceiving and if that's really what you want, you'll probably be better off just going to a good local bakery.

Typical overpriced airport food, but it could be worse. My breakfast bowl was $11.30 w/ tax, and easily was the size of a frozen breakfast bowl from the supermarket, if not smaller. Granted, it was pretty tasty, and the onions were surprisingly crunchy and fresh.
The cashier though.. yikes. So rude, constantly yawning, and when I asked if there were any utensils, she snapped "YES".. I looked around blankly before checking the bag and saw a fork, then thanked her (she ignored me), but sheesh, she could've just said that it was in the bag.

Wouldn't recommend this place as the food was bland and the service was lacking. I ordered the mushroom risotto with a cream sauce and it was more like a broth with zero flavor. I had also ordered  a side of meatballs to go with my main dish. When the waitress didn't bring them out and I asked where are they, it was deer in the headlights look. She promptly said let me go check, then came back and blamed the kitchen.... well needless to say they never made it out as she got sidetracked! I could go on but I think you got the picture!

I bought a Groupon that introduced me to this fabulous place of frozen treats. So happy I did! I tried the cheesecake flavored frozen yogurt. Oh so yummy. Topped with nuts and fresh fruit and strawberry syrup. 

Also the young man behind the counter was so very wonderful. He noticed that I wasn't very pleased with the state of the blueberries and, without my asking, he swapped out the container with a new one full of fresh healthy berries! Just dropped what he was doing and took care of it right away. How wonderful!  

I will be going back to try as many flavors as I can, with or without the groupon. Keep up the good work, John!

First and foremost, Max and his staff are great people. Very professional and very passionate about getting you the haircut that you are looking for. 

The service is also top notch. I have gotten the look I was going for just about every time. The one time that I didn't, Max was cool enough to ask me how the cut could be improved and he did just that. 

The barbershop is very clean and the music that they play is very smooth. Whether you are looking for an upscale professional look or a family friendly place to bring the kids, Max's Barber Shop is sure to impress.

No real complaints on my end. Service was a bit slow and impersonal, but both people at the registers were chill. Prices are a bit on the high end for everything, but it is NYC...So, again no need to dock the business for that.

It was convenient and hours were helpful to grab some items for dinner and staying in the hotel at different times of the day.

TIP: Most restaurants (that I experienced) in NYC are BYOB and this is a great place to get beverages for restaurants or some hotel fun while you're in town.

This is my first time coming here as I read good reviews, and i got a latte per my usual. I absolutely enjoy checking out coffee spots and just unwinding... it's sually my favorite part of my work day. However, the small latte that i got looked more like it was contained in an espresso cup than a regular coffee cup in small. For $3.35. I couldn't help but think that I should've just gone at Starbucks when I passed by. At least their "tall" cup contains more bang for my buck which is probably the same price for a latte too

Started with the beef carpaccio. It was very good, served with a mixed green salad on top. The dressing had a smokey flavor, similar to Chipotle. The beef was very delicious. For my entree I had the Veal Saltimboca (spelling) which was out of this world. The cheese was melted perfectly on top covering the layer of prosciutto. The only thing lacking was the side served with it which was fingerling potatos and green beans.  Though the potatos were good, I think it could have been spiced up with a better side. For wine I had a glass of St. Josephs from the Northern Rhone region. It was fantastic. Service was great, ask for Melvin.

Was hoping to find a forever salon in my new neighborhood but alas, I will not ever be going here. Woke up today feeling a little sick and called to tell them I needed to reschedule. After a few hours was feeling much better and had no fever (doctor has said I'm not contagious) so I called to get my appt back and they told me they would not be able to take me because I had claimed I was sick. Seriously. The most rude situation ever! I would have been a regular but now I'll have to take my business to another salon.

Not what we expected, we went by the reviews and was very disappointed and will not return. We had the steak fajita's, the steak was tough and not a typical sizzling fajita with a regular taco seasoning. We also has the burrito, enchilada and taco. It was nothing to brag about but the proportions were small and did not fill me, lucky for me, my wife did not like the fajitas so i finished them off. Nothing else seems to work, the refried beans tasted scorched, the rice was dry, but to top it all off, was the full tomato stem in the salsa. (see the pics I posted)

If you are gluten sensitive, don't eat here.

Professional, competent, and very personable.  I could not have asked for a better experience.    They worked hard to find all the possible discounts that could be leveraged based on my plan.
