I was so happy with my pair of normal prescription glasses that I went back and got a pair of prescription sunglasses.  Beware that Costa's must be sent to Costa for the prescription lenses and not the normal lab.  The turnaround time for the prescription sunglasses was excessive, but that is of no fault of this establishment.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Meh.

The good stuff: Our order was correct, and the prices are very good. The pizza was edible. We also got a free two-liter with our two larges.

The bad stuff: The crust felt like a sponge or a cheap loaf of bread - very weird. The pizza itself was pretty bland, the sausage was cheap pizza sausage (as you'd probably expect), and it was super greasy.

Overall, it's on the low end of what you'd expect, but it's not the worst thing ever. I'd rather not order from here again, but I'm okay with it if I have to be.

I came here in a group of three and a half (one toddler :P) This place is pretty good, but there are a few problems. First of all, they were out of my first two choices of meat, the lengua (tongue) and bistec (steak). I ended up getting a huarache al pastor (pork and pineapple). One of us got a chorizo burrito, one of us got a trio of chicken tacos, and the toddler got a single beef taco. I enjoyed my huarache and the tacos were fine (a little salty) but the chorizo burrito was way too salty. I'd probably come again if I was in the area, but I'll make sure to ask what's available and make sure to not get the chorizo.

In and out in a skinny minute!  We flew in to Nashville and went straight to the car rental area and Enterprise staff were there and ready.  Offered us the choice of 5 cars and gave me the Avalon when I wanted the easiest one to park.  It had such a smooth ride.  I spent 2 full days putting that car through its paces in stop and go situation and could not have been more comfortable.  Upon arrival at the airport, again greeted by staff and was out in less than 5 minutes.  What a great experience.  Thanks to Danny in the Charleston area for hooking us up!

One of three restaurants in South Jersey owned by Jim Cook and family.  The Telford Inn in Mantua and Carolina Blue in Pitman are the other two. Riverview Inn is the most upscale of the three and it does not disappoint. Great deck which provides up close view of the Delaware which is perfect on a summer night. Live music on the weekends and Quizzo during the week provide great atmosphere. They host wedding receptions and large party celebrations for any type of event. Servers are knowledgeable about food and drink. Love the seafood and the blue cheese dressing- made fresh daily is fantastic. Definitely recommend it.

Two words...Chicken Parmesan.  It isn't on the menu, but ask for it.

La Baia is interesting...definitely a mom and pop joint (which I love) with good italian food.  Who doesn't like an inexpensive italian meal?  And its a BYO.  I would recommend this as a date or for a group of friends...or a double date.  Just a relaxed place to grab some good food.

I think one of the complaints is the service...but with all mom and pop type places, you need to engage the waiter before they will take the best care of you.  So be nice and you have nothing to worry about.

Solid little BYO.

Last week my daughter and I were in Sparks and she asked if we could go there. I ordered a 25 count glazed Munchkins in the drive thru. They had a decent amount of glaze and were placed in a cute box with a handle. 

This morning my husband and I stopped by for glazed Munchkins. We ordered a 50 count this time, also in the drive thru. Our order was placed in the same size box as the 25 count. The employee said, "the box won't close," as she handed us the overflowing container and walked away. We remained at the window to ask for a bag. We were given a brown paper bag. On top of the lame packaging, the Munchkins have hardly any glaze today.

Hair saloon is a nice place for the boys to get their hair cut.  It's got a better vibe to it than Sportsclips and the other chain barbers that are around.  Free soda and water when you come in, and what I really like about it is that you can make an appointment.  If you get hooked up with a nice stylist, you'll be good to go.  It's tough for guys to find a new barber, but they do a nice job.  Prices range from $15-25, which is pretty standard these days.  Best of all, they actually use scissors and not the clippers.

Stumbled upon this when I was waiting for an Rx at Walgreens. It is hidden in a strip center that runs perpendicular to Clearview Pkwy., so you kinda have to look for it. I have to say the pizza here is REAL! It beats anything else in Metairie hands-down. I lived in New York for 7 years, and something about the taste of the cheese and the crust made me wax nostalgic for the Big Apple. They have a large one-topping special of $9.99 on any night, I believe, and it is a VERY GOOD deal for pizza that is NOT your run-of-the-mill chain-store pizza.

First of all, I am a Marriott Titanium Elite, and over the years,  I only stay at Marriott properties.  I stayed at this hotel for a business trip (10/26-10/29) and loved every bit of my stay.  The staff was friendly, my room was great, and the food was top notch.  The M Club was perfect for breakfast, and I had access to the club 24/7 for a water or soft drink.  I valeted, like I normally do, and the valet service was top notch.

I will stay here again for business, and will also stay here for personal trips as well.

Well done!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Came here with a group of friends and received terrible service. This local beach bar is not what it used to be.

Bar tender ID'd me and walked away to help everyone else first. When I finally got the chance to order a drink she was pretty rude. Everyone in my party had a similar experience with the staff.

The location and scenery is wonderful (except the spring break type crowd and the service), but for a beach bar it is not very laid back. I have been coming here for years and have slowly seen it turn from a local beach bar to a spring break party. That was probably my last visit.

Really confused bunch of school girls..i had purchased a plan before my visit for my puppy,  and they didn't know what I was talking about,   just about told me I didn't!? I don't think anyone knew what they were doing! 40 minutes they had me in a room, one arguing with me, and No one looking for my paperwork..i was in there 2 days ago putting one other dog down,  completely different scene,  except for the reception having to take my cc twice..forget it. They try to sell you a "wellness program" and I did, now Ive pd, and cant seem to get my money back.!! GO Figure...
 No thanks..dont waste your time!!

For a holiday inn express this place is awesome. Brand new and clean. They have bikes you can rent for free to ride around on and they are on the free Boise shuttle route from the airport. They're about a 3 mile walk to downtown area which is doable if you have the time to meander.  The hotel is clean, the bed is comfortable, the pillows are awesome. The bathroom was very well lite- which is hard to get in a hotel room, and the shower had automatic closing sliding glass doors. Gym and pool are  nice for this level hotel. I'd stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Best nail salon in reno by far! I will fully admit I'm a brat when it comes to standards at nail salons. I normally hate going because 1. They are expensive 2. I normally leave unhappy 3. It's just awkward most of the time or forced convo. Not here!!!!! They are a fun lively bunch that are great at what they do. The sailing is cute and cozy and especially clean! They have a great color selection and brands. I believe the owner did my nails and he was awesome! It doesn't even matter who you get because they all did beautiful jobs on the ladies around me as well.

This is in reference to the one in Bellevue. They never se to be open at 7am (today was my 5th attempt to try to get my car washed. I arrived at 7:15 am, but the entrances were all blocked off. There were cars in the lot, I'm assuming for the employees). 

I waited for 5 minutes for them to open up - nothing. 

The equipment isn't efficient, nor does it seem to work consistently (both inside and outside of the car wash) - my car always has a ton of soap on it even after the rinse cycles.

The young kids that work there are nice, courteous, and professional. If I could give a star rating just based on them it would be at least 4 stars.

I must say their tea is great - food is decent. However, I'm more of a coffee type of a person and since they use the same presses on their coffee as they do their tea. . . their coffee comes out tasting fruity and odd. Not a huge fan of their coffee. If you crave tea, come here. If you like coffee, go some place else. 

Otherwise, I hope they read this and realize they need to use different presses. Even after I saw it I confirmed with the employee (young girl) if they are supposed to use the same press, she said it didn't matter. (well, it did. . . a ton, it was nasty).

....eeeh.  What's the fuss?  This is food from Jean-Marie Lacroix from 15 years ago, add BYOB, minus service. 
We got the moderately inspired tasting menu... foie gras au torchon was v.good then
2 courses later we find foie gras inside our main of guinea hen? ...& I love F.G., but seriously?!  Was is a F.G. tasting menu?!  Whatever, 2 dishes were spot on, while 3 missed the mark & left us wonde  
Then there was the 40 minutes between 1 ofapology or explanation? ...eeeh? 
All this for $70 pp for the tasting menu?!  Not so enthused.

I literally can not say enough good things about this place, or the amazing people. The owner is incredible and not only thinks of you as a customer, but really cares about you as his customer. I always come over during my lunch break, for which I have an hour, and he always manages to get my nails and toes done to perfection. Ex. I got my nails done 2 days ago and had a few chip and right when I walked in, with no questions asked, a sweet lady fixed them and the owner would not let me pay for anything.. How sweet is that? This is the best place ever.

It's nice to have a good restaurant in the neighborhood.  Food is good and prices are fair.  I had the fish tacos which are tasty and my wife had the tamale trio and that was fantastic.  Their margaritas are real good and their large draft beer is well....Huge!  Great value all around.

I am not even concerned about service since it has been open for about a week but it was good.  All the staff members were very welcoming and appreciative of us being there.

It is a 100% improvement over the first Mexican restaurant housed there.

I'm not sure how this place has such high reviews. It wasn't great.  Donatello's is way better. Their Cesar salad had obviously a bottled dressing, not the real deal salad dressing, unimpressive. Their spaghetti bolognese the spaghetti was over cooked and not al dente and the sauce had no flavor was under seasoned. Nothing authentic at all tasted like jarred sauce on regular spaghetti. Their tiramisu was alright it was good but nothing out of this world. I got takeout and didn't dine in so maybe that affected the food i may try it again not sure. Nothing special.

I give this two stars only because the customer service was great. The food honestly tasted pre-packaged. I ordered the ham and cheese pizza, it was dry... No real flavor. It was pretty much a big blob of cheese on top of some cut up ham and tortilla. My sausage taco was decent. It wasn't worth the money we paid. They also make you pay for the chips & dip. Way too expensive and totally not worth it. A friend recommended this place. He said it was the best.. I disagree. Also, the fried ice cream was NOT fried at all, was freezer burnt and the strawberry sauce tasted fermented.

A very Denny's style place. Need I say more, oh but I will. 

I ordered the Generals chicken which was okay. The problem with living in the Bay Area is that you really get to taste the best and thus get spoiled. If you'd like to try good Generals chicken visit Ark's in Alameda.  

The pad thai was also okay, a little more edible than the over sweetened Generals chicken. 

The spinach and mushroom dip was ok as well. A bit too creamy. 

The server serving the next table seemed very nice. Our server was a bit odd or shall I say different.

Great Donuts! Poor everything else.
This store runs out of 40% of their menu by 10am every day and will not make more donuts or other product. They get upset if you order by phone and start pestering you to use the app because phone orders are an inconvenience but the app requires $10 deposits everytime...oh brother. 
Newest employees have the best attitude. The rest do not, I've had better service at all dunkins and even private mom and pop shops across the states vs this location. 2 stars because the products are good and the new employees are approachable... It sucks I have to drive a ways to go to another Dunkin for better service

Thought I've never heard of Sakura, I was excited to tryout a new sushi spot. I liked the intimate setting of Sakura, but that may be about it. The waitress was nice, but very slow. We notified her we'd be ordering items throughout the evening, and we were sitting waiting to for her to be found. It was multiple times we'd have to raise our hands to get someone's attention to find her. Our food came out cold each time, and our refills were non existent. The food was very bland which also hindered the experience. The cook preparing the sushi was nice. He chatted with us as we sat at the bar, but I doubt I'd ever go back.

We have been coming here for years and the last few visits service has been terrible and the food just ok. Tonight I ordered the combo plate with quesadilla & enchilada my husband ordered the fajita burrito. My combo plate arrived and the quesadilla was cold, the cheese was not melted and the quesadilla looked like it had been thrown together. My enchilada was topped with a stingy sprinkle of red sauce. I ate my entire meal and my husbands food never came. Our server didn't apologize or offer an explanation on why his food was delayed. She never once came back to our table after delivering my food. Guess we will visit Casa Fiesta from now on.

Brought some stuff from Orlando to cook a nice Thai meal for my parents in town.  Oops, forgot a couple things.  Quickly pulled up Yelp and found this place not too far away & boy am I glad I did.  I ended up dropping about $40 worth on cans and jars of this and that, and months later we're still indulging in them at home (watch out for green curry - it's a firestorm in your mouth!!).  Had a nice conversation about different brands of coconut milk with the young lady running the store on a weekend afternoon.  Headed back to town in a few weeks and I'm already making my shopping list to restock!!!

First time visit. Greeted by a helpful person. Left with nothing to buy. 

I was hopeful when I arrived looking for Dolin Rouge sweet vermouth, Noilly Prat dry vermouth for martinis, and George Dickel Rye for Manhattans.   Found none of the above. These are not unusual liquor store items.

Disappointed. Moreover, website missing any information what's available, so wasted my time. Is this the year 2021?

Guess I'll have to travel to Nashville or Murfreesboro for a more fully stocked store.

On the plus side, selection of bourdons is good, and worth a return for that item.

Everyone from around here goes on and on and on about this place.  I don't get it.  We ate there with friends who told us it was the best Italian food they've ever had.  We love them, but we now think they don't get around. :)

Chicken parm was ok.  Kids meal was enough food for 2 adults, an utterly absurd amount of food for a toddler.  Very good bread.  Skipped dessert.

If you're locked into eating in Medford, it's not a bad choice.  But really, take a drive somewhere and get some better Italian food for your $$.

Today I went to lunch at Osaka and sat at the sushi bar.  The place looks great and the service was top notch.  Now on to the important part the Sushi.  Very high quality for a very good price.  One of the key ingredients to having good sushi is the rice and I must say that the rice they is very good to excellent.  I had the Suhimi and rice and everything was extremely fresh.  The Angry Scallop was also delicious.  The other good news for me is that this place has delivery and that is a big bonus.  This is really a great addition to our neighborhood and I am looking forward to returning.

This hotel covers the basics. 
The place had parking included, which is not always true in Nashville.
The rooms were clean.
The beds were fairly comfortable.
There were mini fridges and microwaves for guests to use.
There was a free breakfast included, but we skipped it to sleep later.
The desk staff seemed fine.
The major drawback was that the walls are paper thin. They don't block ANY noise. It sounded like the family staying in the next room was in bed with us and the people talking in the hall were in the bathroom with us.
So there's that.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Pleasant little historic hotel in historic downtown west Chester. I recommend paying to park in the adjacent garage -- not cheap, but convenient. Everything about the place is fine enough, and the staff are very friendly. The breakfast offering is just some simple carbs, and not really worth grabbing unless you're really in a hurry, since there are so many places you can go for breakfast within a couple of blocks radius. Ultimately, the Hotel Warner wins on that location, being smack in the middle of tons of cute shops and restaurants and bars..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Spent one night in this lovely & clean room. It's in the middle of downtown Boise and close to everything, restaurants, bars, state offices, etc. they have a pool & hot tub which we did not use, but we have a view of it from out window.

There's free breakfast that's pretty much the standard in many hotel/motels. There just is not a waffle maker for the waffle fans. They do have breakfast muffins though. Although I don't eat those things. I just had a toasted bagel with butter, yogurt, & coffee.

The room is very clean & quiet. The lady at the front desk was friendly and helpful. We would stay here again if we come back again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Okay, I still really like this Publix but they need to get their crapola together when it comes to online ordering at the deli. As I said in the previous review, their subs are an awesome gift from the hangover gods (whom I pray to a little too much of course), but the past three or four times I've placed an online order I've had to wait in the sub line and ask them to make my order because it was over half an hour past the time the interwebs said it'd be ready. 

Maybe more deli employees? Doesn't seem like there is a protocol in place to figure out how to deal with online orders while face-to-face orders keep walking up.

Oh Sushi Teri, you make it so difficult for me to write this review in spite of your delicious sushi and chicken/beef teriyaki. 

Service is everything. To better explain my experience, here's a couple quick tips for improvement:

-do not bring one person's food out 15 minutes prior to the other person's food

-do not hover around like a swarm of bees 

-"bill, please. bill, please. bill, please."

The sushi plate is so fresh. The chicken and beef teriyaki dinner is generous and delicious. 

With a bit more experienced..err..attentive staff, this place is golden.

Scammers. Ordered two pizzas and one had a promo code I ordered with online. They show up with one pizza and say the other wasnt paid for online!!? The ABSOLUTE LEAST you guys should have done was call me instead of showing up at our door with enough food to feed half of the people. And have the nerve to ask us to reorder and pay another expensive delivery fee.

This place is employed by morons and the absolute laziest and rude people. Dont give them your business when there are plenty of other places that want your business.

My husband and I haven't eaten at a TGIF in many yrs and wanted to see if it was as good as we remembered it to be, and unfortunately it really wasn't. It's just an overpriced chain with mediocre service.

We arrived right at opening for lunch and it still took over half an hour to get a burger and a sandwich. My husband loved his cheddar bacon burger, which consisted of just as much bacon as hamburger, and my club sandwich was ok, but my ceasar salad was soaking wet in salad dressing and so salty it was inedible. The cost was $30 which I thought was not even close to being worth it.

Save your money and go somewhere else.

Stopped in for information about their hours as i was either looking to drop my car off today for an oil change in or get one done another day. The front desk staff acted like goofy, instagram teenagers. He was rolling his eyes, raising his eyebrows and turning his head to the side. I had planned to book an appointment for another day but the way they acted made me turn around and leave. The other girl just sat there eating a cookie behind the counter. They were not reassuring at all, that my car would be in good hands. I can only imagine how much business this place loses if people experience what I did.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: If you're looking for a typical hotel experience with room service, you won't get that here. As a Marriott member I expected much more. I even requested a transfer on our first day. I'm not used to the "modern experience." HOWEVER, the customer service was EXCEPTIONAL. They're always wearing a smile, and ready to accommodate. Our whole stay I felt appreciated and looked after: They did their very best to make sure I had the experience I was hoping so within their means. While I'm pretty high maintenance and expect certain things, they really went above and beyond.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My fist and last time at this place. Service was terrible after waiting 5 minutes for a server she arrives and didn't listen to one word for the order. When it arrived the eggs were horrible and inedible seriously. The crepes were even worst they don't use actual cream cheese but done generic version of cream with no cheese whatsoever it was not even worth eating. I asked for the hashbrowns cooked hard they came mushy and bland. THE ONLY reason I'm giving it two stars is because it was clean inside and presentable enough to feel like you would get a good meal but it's really really bad food. Really bad

These donuts are crazy. I love a good simple donut with some frosting and sprinkles. The first time someone brought some assorted into the office from Holy Schmidt, I was astounded! The donut included oreo crumbles and sour worms on top. AMAZINGLY DELICIOUS, but not what I am looking for in a donut. I could only eat about 3 bites of it before the richness eventually made me have to put it down. I would definitely come here for a dessert, or like an occasion I would need cupcakes or cake for. For a good morning donut though, I would go somewhere else.

The Screamery is SUCH a treat! 

It's Arizona-local, scratch-made ice cream, with a plethora of fun flavors that can be served either as a traditional scoop or in fun creations like "ice cream nachos" (ice cream over waffle-cone chips). They also offer ice cream flights, in case you're interested in trying six different flavors. 

The flavors themselves are really inventive and so, so delicious. Some incorporate ingredients like honeycomb, bourbon, or even bacon. Their offerings are sure to be a hit regardless of whether you like the more traditional flavors or go for the more interesting, unique choices.

Went to dinner here with my parents, who prefer Vegetarian Sushi, and we had a wonderful experience! We put our faith in the Sushi Chef and allowed him to make whatever he wanted. We weren't disappointed and were so impressed with the creativity he displayed. First course was a whole eggplant caramelized with a miso sauce that was to die for. Next was the abundant veggie sushi which ranged from a sweet potato roll to a spiced tofu nigiri. We also ended the meal with 2 desserts, the stellar fried banana and the must-try tempura ice cream. The total bill was $60. How can you beat that?!

Fantastic!  We have kids so we had a very early reservation.  I grabbed Chef Sbraga and mentioned we were big Too Chef nerds and asked if would he mind a photo.  He graciously took one with us.  Food was delicious and Chef came to check on us and see how we enjoyed it.  We told him we'd bring our fellow TC fans back and we meant it.

Only 4 stars because it happened to be the night of the Naked Bike Race down Broad Street and while entertaining, some of those people on bikes could definitely make your stomach turn ;-) Was a distraction from watching the staff work their magic...obviously not their fault.

WAY overpriced so-so food.  My wife had the shrimp and white beans app-the beans were from a can (which is unacceptable for a restaurant that presents itself as upscale).  I had the shrimp scampi as an entree.  FOUR shrimp on a plate with not even a full potato's worth of roasted potatoes for $19.75.  You could get shrimp scampi at a real Italian restaurant in South Phila w/ past for cheaper and it would be MUCH better.  No restaurant has ever survived in this location, and Franco's Osteria will not break this trend.  Unless they lower their prices and start tasting the food they're putting on the floor, this place won't be here in a year.

The only reason I'm yelping is because of Steve, a spin class instructor (who also teaches at the Graduate Hospital location). I just got done with an evening class about an hour ago, and he was nice enough to spend his own money on his class -- buying us beer, chips and salsa for after our workout (in honor or Cinco de Mayo) =)  Besides that, he is the most motivating and enthusiastic instructor I've ever had. 

As for the gym, I like it! It's smack in the middle price-wise, and it has everything I need. I definitely got in better shape since I joined!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Absolute worse hotel ever.   Run run run away fast.  The smell when you first enter the lobby should be enough to send you packing.   I stayed because I booked on Priceline.   So me and my kiddos arrived after being at Busch Gardens all day it was 11pm.  Room was dirty dirty dirty.   I pray I don't get bed bugs from this.   I have a newborn baby with me.  What am I supposed to do?   The reviews for this place are fake... they have to be.  The toilet button is broken.   So when you press it you get this green nasty funk on your hands.   The floor in the room so dirty that your feet get dirty from walking around!  Never ever again...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Great location, clean rooms, good cookies upon check in, close proximity to many places, safe neighborhood and affordable. The only thing that was missing and what I was expecting was a free continental breakfast.   
 
Major plus, the hotel is right off the freeway and would definitely stay here again in one of the balcony rooms. I like how this is a newer Hilton Hotel and the rooms are pretty spacious, but the bathrooms could be bigger. Other than that, the location is great for those who are visiting Downtown Santa Barbara and the Funk Zone.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: As a taqueria this place is a complete waste of time. What kind of taco joint charged extra for salsa on a taco?  What?!?  The atmosphere is boring and stark and the food is just okay. But if you want to have a beer and a taco and don't want to byo then I guess it is okay for that. So if you think of it as a place to have a beer with friends in a boring setting while bad music plays and wouldn't mind having a taco while there then maybe it is worth 2 stars. But I just don't get it.  Totally boring and annoying enough that I have to write a bad review while I finish my just okay and too dry tacos.

Lily's has some of the best tacos in SB. I used to love going to the one in DTSB so I was really happy to see this location in Goleta. They have such a wide variety of meats. Many of which aren't available at most taquerias that I've been too. So far I have tried have lengua, cabeza, cachete, adobada, asada, tripas, maciza, labio and ojo. I like all of them! My favorites are asada, cachete, lengua and ojo. Their tacos are always well cooked and flavorful. They have a good selection at the salsa bar. I was lucky to beat the lunch rush. After I ordered, the line was going out the door. Overall, Lily's is still solid and affordable.

It's one of the old gems in the Brandon area serving pizza for years. This place has been around since I was in elementary school. And it shows. Could use a little updating. But none the less the establishment low key casual pizzeria that is known for the double decker. If it's your first time. Get the babes special double decker. It's literally two pizzas on top of each other. Although it seems like you've walked into an old smokers bar,  the pizza is pretty good. Not come out of your way good but good. Their salads seem to be a little lack luster and didn't notice anyone ordering the sandwiches. That should be a clue.

I just checked in and I'm already extremely happy. Nice place, under renovations for improvement, great price, nice rooms, decently comfy beds, beautiful pool area + hot tub.... 

I'm most excited that checking in I told the girl at the desk Heather that I haven't had much sleep at all lately and asked her for as late of a check out as possible, and she said "How's 2?" ..... That's unheard of basically, and such a wonderful thing for a person with my crazy schedule. Thank you miss Heather... much appreciated :)

Overall I'm very happy I found this place and will probably stay tomorrow night too now.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Service was OK but this place was so empty it felt like they were just standing there staring at me eating. Soup was OK. No bread or crackers. Lunch was a sad $12 version of eggplant parmesan with a former description. What I got was breaded eggplant that tasted like it had been frozen and recooked and was so mushy I could eat it with a spoon. The only reason I gave this place 2 stars was because the pasta and sauce were OK tasting. Also I told the server I was staying at a local hotel (as the sign out front instructed) and she failed to honor the 10% discount.

Came here for lunch and had phenomenal time.  Ambiance is great!  It's new modern trendy.  Restaurant is on top floor of four seasons so the view is amazing you can see down entire Ben Franklin boulevard.  The attention to detail is noticable.

The prefix lunch had everything I could want.  I think for $45/person.  The portions were well sized.  Really enjoyed my salmon and the broccoli soup was so simple yet done so well.  Desserts were also excellently prepared and presented.  

The service staff was attentive and on point.  Overall we had a great time and would be back.

Kinda surprised by the lukewarm reviews. We came here for lunch after shopping in KOP and had a great time.

First the space is in center of the mall.  When you come upon it host greeted us and sat promptly.  Menu is limited but did the trick.  First I had watermelon sangria which was refreshing.  The pizzas were thin crusted and spot on.  Even the vegetarian pizza had a lot of flavor!  The roasted veggie salad was also a hit.  I also really liked the olive cake very subtle taste.  Service was prompted and nice ambiance.

The only knock is portion size is small.  However overall would come back.

My husband and I enjoy coming here whenever we're back in town visiting family. They have a large selection of beer, and we like to end our night here since it's open late. The service isn't great, even for a dive bar, and you can definitely feel the vibe that it's a locals' hang out. But we usually just order our beers, find a table, and enjoy our beers. So we don't really mind the service. We really just enjoy sipping on our drinks and sitting back to chill out. It's a great place to just enjoy beer and hang out.

Want a great philly cheesesteak? Then don't come here. While the flavor of their regular and deluxe versions of this famous sandwich is okay, they really skimp on the filling at this place. On the typical 12 inch baguette roll a full 4 inches will be completely devoid of filling and the rest will be spread very thinly. If you want philly cheesesteak-flavored bread, that's fine, but you shouldn't have to pay 7 bucks for it.

A very poor value for your money here. And slow service besides. The place only got two stars because the tiny dining area appeared to be clean. Probably because nobody actually eats there.

Two words: Never again.

Lobby was amazing. Burlesque bar was good and the staff were all great. We used a suite upgrade to one of the saint suites aaaand. It was weird. First, no way of room being dark. The curtains were fake and did not close. And the bright streetlight right outside window fully illuminated room around blackout shade. 
No Mirror in room at all except one very small one over sink.  Idea was cute but poorly executed with everything spray painted silver. Was so uncomfortable a space we checked out forfeiting the suite upgrades and moved to another hotel. Again. Staff was great. Room was not.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Probably one of the most disappointing Mexican restaurants I've visited in Tucson. Wait, the chips and salsa were good, that's why I gave it one star! We went for lunch and there were a few people there, decent amount of people. But I think there was just the one waitress. There were 3 of us and we all ordered off of the lunch menu. I ordered the chicken fajita salad. Big mistake! The chicken was basically frozen chicken, cooked and diced, added a few vegetables, that's it no flavor whatsoever. Unfortunately, I won't be back.

I kept driving past this place and finally decided to give it a try. I LOVE pizza more than anything and am still trying to find my go to spot in Riverview. I ordered take out and got the Old Town style thin crust. This has pepperoni, sausage, and bacon crumbles. The verdict is......WOW that was delicious! It had just the right amount of cheese and was loaded with meats. The thin crust was thin but  not too thin and cooked perfectly! Next time I will have to try one of the Chicago style pan pizzas because those look delicious too! I think I found my go to pizza place!!!:)

Great job! We just moved to Nashville and needed to get our 3 cats updated rabies shots. We arrived 30 mins early (not used to the traffic yet), and not only was everyone extremely nice but they took us right away. Maybe we came on the right day or even just the right time of day, but I've never had such prompt and courteous service! We were done with 3 cat's shots and having their claws cut before our original scheduled appointment! An extremely good value as well. Oh, and there was no high pressure up-sale for stuff the cats didn't need either! We will be back for sure!

Hard to give this place a three.  I'd had it once before ( delivery) and it was good pizza.  Very thin crust which I preferred. 
Ordered for pick up tonight. When I went in to pick it up I was very relieved I wasn't dining in.  The place has a very strong ammonia smell that is almost stomach turning.   
Nevertheless, I did try the pizza tonight.  The Florence is packed with veggies, but I found that they were too wet, leaving the base crust very soggy.  The ranch was very garlic-y and good consistency.  
Hard to say if I would choose to
Go back.  Possibly for the parmigiana wings ?

Awful. Absolutely awful. So awful, I can't even eat the order I just had delivered. The meatballs smell sour and weird and one small bite was so off-taste that I gave up. The chicken & rice soup did not contain any rice, although it was plenty greasy and did have plenty of chicken parts. Nothing recognizable. 

This was a 2nd swing and a miss for Leo's. I was willing to give them the benefit of the doubt after the first. I even ordered the exact same thing to see if they "normally" did it better. They don't. There won't be a 3rd swing. 

Good Italian food is too easy to find around here.

My husband and I came in to set up a joint account and credit card. It was so easy and painless. Super friendly staff. Great looking branch. 

We signed in and we're able to speak with someone within a few minutes. Michael talked us through all of the options for both the bank account and credit card. It was really easy to understand. 

He explained all the features and benefits and even talked us through setting up the app on our phones. 

By the time we left we had a new account, new credit card and all our questions answered. I'd absolutely recommend this place to anyone looking to switch banks.

BNA didn't seem to have an abundance of sit down eateries, at least not in the terminal I was in. Tennessee Tavern was then calling my name, bbq and drinks? Sure thing. 

I ordered a special drink made with cider and fireball, but they were out of fireball, I asked for another special and they were out of the bourbon that was used in it. Ended up with a Jack and Diet. 

They serve Neely's BBQ (despite the closure of their Memphis locations). The food was typical chain BBQ (think Sonny's or Dickey's quality). My brisket was moist enough and had enough sauce. The coleslaw was under seasoned, and the beans were slightly sweeter than I like.

Hotel amenities are good, but our room was on the side of the building right next to a strip of night clubs. Every night we heard loud music, bass, people yelling and cars being super loud (playing music or honking). If you're a light sleeper I 100% do NOT recommend this location. The hotel itself is nice and modern and the staff are very friendly and helpful. The free breakfast from 630-10am is pretty standard hotel breakfast food (baked goods, eggs, turkey sausage, ham, etc.). If we're in NOLA again we would not stay here because of its location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This was a good breakfast spot right in the middle of it all, but far enough away from it all to be quiet.  

Service was good, omelet was great!  The biscuit was not exactly on point taste or shape wise, but it reminds me of when my parents don't measure their ingredients when making biscuits.  That means they made in-house and I can respect that.  The omelet was my typical mushroom, tomato and swiss and was huge and yummy.  The coffee was coffee - nothing special, but good enough to do the job.

This is definitely a place I'd return to if I were in the area.

I heard this is a big deal in Ohio, but that the stores there would close down from time to time because of Listeria outbreaks?

I was worried but for the love of sweet things, I had to try this and prayed that Listeria did not travel to Nashville.

The good news is that I think I'm ok oh and the scoop of mango lassi frozen yogurt and
bourbon salted pecan on waffle cone were on point!  There's a long line of course.  I'm not sure though if I can tell a difference between their ice cream vs another's texture wise (creamy, smooth or not).  Also, I was disappointed that there were no other chocolate flavors other than dark chocolate.

Ok I normally don't review places after only going a single time, but I really liked Ulivo. I had avoided it because I had such a bad experience at the previous spot at the same location. Ulivo is light years better. I showed up with wine and no reservations. Even though it was pretty busy, we were seated within 5 minutes. 

Our server was very attentive and actually a lot of fun. I had the all'amatriciana and it was fantastic and the portion size was perfect for me. The desserts looked great but I just just couldn't fit any more.

I am definitely looking forward to going back.

Customer service wise this Starbucks is good. Fast drive-through, great customer service and clean restrooms, like almost every other Starbucks I've been to.  So why just two stars? The parking situation is horrible! The flow of traffic is really bad, in fact dangerous if you see how the patterns move. I would be very surprised if there haven't been any accidents or fender-benders here due to the design of the parking lot. Having said that, it's a block away from my office and convenient as heck, so I roll the dice to get my tall cup of Pikes...every single day.

I've been there a few times and always thought highly of them, very professional, nice, and great quality service. Today i went to get my battery charged and they tried to tell me i needed a new one, when i asked why it was so expensive ($180) they told me they were offended that i thought it was "overpriced" when really it was a good deal. They refused to put the new battery in since i would "clearly be unsatisfied" even though i had waited already and needed to get on with my day and honestly didn't care about the price anymore, just my time! I ended up going across the street and sears said i ddin't even need the battery!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Most of these locations are cheaper and a bit more rundown than Fry's and Safeway, but they aren't too bad. The selection at this location is pretty good, despite it being a smaller store than most. 

The deli section was very good, and the produce section had the cheapest prices out there. Best of all, is their variety of Hispanic foods, which are better than any of the other stores!

It had been 10 years since I visited a Food City prior to this visit, and I came away blown away, since I used to hate coming here. I highly recommend giving them a second visit.

Typical Subway. The food here is decent, but nowhere near the quality of what you would get at a locally owned sandwich shop, or even at a supermarket

The staff retention here is atrocious. Every time I have come here, there was a new staff member in training that made getting my food a chore. 

This is especially a problem during lunch, where I have a limited amount of time. I won't be going here at that time anytime soon.  

In addition to that, even though its cold right now, they never have soup available to purchase, even during the afternoon. 

Not a sign of great management. 

I'll pass.

The Barista's here need to take another course in customer service. They aren't kind. As many times as I've been to this location (over 25), it is always the same experience. They seem as though they are frustrated that they have customers, and the wait is unbelievable! Drive thru or inside, be prepared to wait over 20 minutes. As I sit in the drive thru line now for the past 15 minutes, I anticipate another 10 minutes or more since there are 4 cars ahead of me. If this wasn't the only drive thru Starbucks close by, I would definitely not return to this location.

Best delivery pizza in the area by far. I've had the garlic bread, margarita pizza, pepperoni pizza, and Sicily pizza. All delivery. They tasted great and I would give 5 stars, but they always forget an ingredient. Last time they forgot the basil on the margarita as well as the basil we added to the pepperoni and this time they forgot the bourbon glaze on the Sicily. The garlic bread was very bland - maybe they forgot the garlic. Just annoying when it's delivery. Other than forgetting ingredients 2 out of 2 times, it's good.

Food - 5 stars. Service, 3 stars. 

As the previous reviews mentioned, the food was absolutely esquisite. I got the pork chop, per the recommendations, and was not disappointed. Wine was also good.

Service was alright, few minor issues. Asked if I wanted bread, and then didn't bring it out, until I asked when my meal was served. Then he felt bad and tried to make up for it by asking how my food was every two minutes (probably not gonna change after the first time you ask). Petty, I know. But when the prices are higher (my wine cost more than my entire lunch), you have to expect a little more.

This place leaves me in a conundrum:
It's quite close to my residence, doesn't break the bank, but they are incredibly, almost astoundingly slow with their service. 
As you may read in others' reviews, this is not a "one-off" criticism.  For a simple oil change, with no one being serviced before my vehicle, it took over and hour to accomplish the simple things included in the price I paid. 
The proximity and value for cost are appealing, but just be sure that you have an entire morning to spare when you take your car here for care. 

Check out the other reviews and make the decision for yourself, as always!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Server was more interested in her phone and kissing the owners butt then being a server. Menu had soda on it . I had to get up and grab another one. I was only customer in restaurant. I had too get up two more times to ask to place my order and to ask for bill. Never got refill in drink . I went a second time this year asked for refill  after waiting forever and when I got it the lemonade was flavorless. It's pretty obvious the servers don't expect much from there customers and give them poor service. Portion sizes really have gotten smaller one chicken breast on a dinner entree ridiculous. Go elsewhere for Mexican

This Starbucks has a good vibe and decent seating. The speed of the staff seems up to par. The nice thing about this location is that there is 30 minutes of free covered parking in The College Plaza lot, so if you want to park, grab a latte, then head to Sobey's and the pharmacy in the building, you have enough time to do it. I gave them 4 stars because one of the days I went in they had run out of soy milk and didn't plan to have any for another 3 days. To their defence, the store was new at the time, so they were probably figuring out ordering quantities. This will definitely become my regular spot for latte's!

Visited 2/25/2019
Located in a small strip mall this place is nice sized with lots of seating.  Nice chip & salsa bar. Lots on the menu to choose from. 
Sadly this wasn't as good as we hoped for with the food just being average at best.  No table service and prices a little high for the quality of the food.  The lady at the ~register was very nice and helpful.  
Overall we were not impressed as we have eaten at 100s of Mexican restaurants over the years.  I'm sure there are many other good Mexican Restaurants in Tucson to try.

I was honestly very surprised. I know the Westin is a very well-known chain, but the outside of this building just seems so brown and unwelcoming. When you enter, there is an awesome lobby area that is very clean and spacious. The staff is helpful/friendly. I tried a few of their appetizers in the lobby bar. My favourite was the smoked salmon and capers/veggie and Boursin on a toasted bread it was awesome.

I was actually here for a conference. It was great. The staff were very accommodating and welcoming! Definitely more than I was expecting!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I made a reservation here months before my stay but a mistake was made and I didn't have a room when I got there. It was a busy weekend so the hotel was all booked up. I understand mistakes happen but I recieved no customer service help from a manager or anyone. The people at the front desk really just wanted me out of there so I wouldn't complain to other customers. I just wanted a sorry or maybe could of stayed at one of their different locations nearby. The lack of customer service makes me never to want to stay at a Hampton Inn.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
A SOLID STOP
- centrally located across from ACME
- intimate: seats just about 30
- has a lively piano bar
- 20% off for New Orleans locals

A CLASSIC FRIDAY BAR CRAWL ITINERARY:
Start with Old Fashioneds here about 3 PM-ish, then a Sazerac at the renown Carousel Bar, followed by Happy Hour (4-6 PM) and $4 small-plates at the Bombay Club with a Pimm's Cup, then a French 75 with soufflé potatoes at Arnaud's (opens at 5), grab a some apps and a Ramos Gin Fizz at Broussard's Bar and end up at the Davenport Lounge for jazz (9 PM) and Brandy Milk Punch.

VAPIDLY GLUM HIPSTER DINERS frolic together in maudlin detached silence. 

AFFORDABLE YET ODDLY LIMITED NUMBER OF INGREDIENTS: fed two on 2 huge razor-thin pepperoni slices & a Carbonara bowl: $17.

Hipsters have begun to creep me out... like John Wayne Gacy in a clown costume.

JUST A FEW TOPPINGS YOU CAN'T GET: 
1) Mushrooms
2) Canadian Bacon
3) Ground Beef
4) Italian Sausage
5) Sliced Sausage
6) Ham
7) Salami
8) Chicken
9) Steak
10) Pineapple
11) Black Olives
12) Green Peppers
13) Jalapenos
14) Banana Peppers
15) Spinach
16) Giardiniera
17) etc...

DEEP DOWN, YOU KNOW IT'S NOT GONNA MAKE IT
I mean it's not a bad place. It just doesn't have the energy to be a hang-out. Warbuck's feels sorta like pretty Missandei before the Mountain swats off her head. 

Next...

AND THE FOOD TRIES TOO HARD
See pics. The grilled Brussels sprouts were on trend 5 years ago so to feature them now seems a bit outdated. And while the grill was excellent they were so drenched in sauce I found myself wiping each bite off with my napkin. The lacquered pork belly fares better but still, isn't that on the Dave & Busters menu?

BEAUTIFUL HIBACHI BUT SALTY & BLAND
While it's unusual to find hibachi for one at lunch, rarer to get NY Strip under $12; this meal should've been notable but sadly it had no taste or heat whatsoever. And it's not because it was under seasoned every bite cloyed with salt. Conversely the salad's curry dressing was overpowering. But most unforgivably, the rice was mushy.

SOME EASY TWEAKS:
amp up the flavors, cut the salt and tighten up the rice. The price, portions and atmosphere are solid.

IF LUNCHING UPTOWN HEAD TO "THAI MINT"
on Carrolton. Their 3 course under $10 selections are clean and perfectly seasoned.

URBAN HONKYTONK: this is the kind of Bar (+food) where hunky contractors hang out after work, local gentry pick up late night take-out, regulars are known by name; and, true to genre, all are adroitly serviced by a flirtatious waitress in "hooterish" short shorts.  

MEH BURGER IS PRICIER THAN NEARBY PHIL'S. My cheeseburger was tasty but the bun was Sysco-like, with waffle fries it totaled $10.25. If it's a Grill (+bar) that you're interested in, by far the best price/value is Phil's build-your-own with a side for $9.75 just blocks away.

KINDA THE WHD'S FINN MC COOL'S but without the the suffocating cigarette smoke. Go to drink, eat elsewhere.

Near perfect!  A co-worker told me about this place.  We Yelped it and gave it a try. Boy, are we glad we did! The food is spectacular.  I'm crazy about Mexican fare and this restaurant is the bomb. Service was superb. Chips and all kinds of salsa was the bomb. 
    The interior is a mix of Greek and Mexican. Sort of a mish mash. The music was way too loud for my liking. But don't let that keep you away. We loved Hacienda. 
    Park in the back. Avoid the front few spaces. Enjoy a Corona and some great tacos.

Come on DD. You can do so much better. I ordered a hot fudge sundae made with Jamocha Almond Fudge. Nope.  They did not have this popular flavor.  So, I switched to Pralines and cream. 
     Hang on ; Here's the best part. The employee yells put to another employee "how do I ring this up?"  She does what she is told, collects my payment through the app. 
    Next up, I'm presented with a scoop of ice cream with chocolate syrup on it.  No nuts, no cherry.  That's a sundae?  No whipped cream.  I added a photo to show what I received.

My first Omakasè experience was very average. I went with a party of 6  a few weeks ago. It was either a Friday or Saturday night and we made a reservation but we still had to wait at least 15min to be seated .. we went their pretty late about an hour before their closing time. Their service was good but I felt very rushed while eating. We got the signature Omakasè and there were times where they would bring two sushi pieces on the plate. There were some pieces where the yuzu was very overpowering and made it too sweet. I think i would've enjoyed going to a nice sushi restaurant and spend my money there.

Two words- CUSTOMER SERVICE! 

While this place can feel a little too small and the variety of option even smaller- the customer service is AMAZING! The staff is always there to help you find the right products for your needs. 

I recently hosted an event and the caterer backed out the day before. Next stop- Heirloom! Patrick and the team there helped me pull together everything I needed for a great event! And it was so much cheaper than what I would have paid for catering! And they even wrote me a card (pictured). 

So happy they opened in my neighborhood!

Mmmm I was excited to come to this place for some sushi but won't be coming back .
Service : extremely rushed , our waiter pretended to be nice but the whole time I got the sense he just wanted us out of there quick as the rest of the waiters . Food comes very quick and as soon as u r done they are taking your place away.
Drinks : nothing spectacular 
Food: was good , I wished the service was as good so that I would desire to even Come back .

But I'm not going to spend more money on this business who really don't seem to care about customer happiness or satisfaction.

While this looks like a bank, it's not really a traditional bank. Only has ATMs and a handful of personal bankers waiting around to point you towards the ATMs. I'm certain Chase has its business reasons for providing non-traditional banks such as this, but its annoying walking in for teller service (which admittedly is a rare need these days), and getting told there are no tellers by one of the bankers - as if I couldn't see there were no tellers... Maybe Chase could name facilities such as this something else...like Chase Express.

I booked via 3rd party and the price dropped twice since the 1st time. When I arrived. the check-in process was incredibly easy... they found me and my reservation via the drivers license scanning on the kiosk. 

I got to pick any compact car on the lot, but there were only 2. A Versa and a Kia Soul. The mileage on each car was 26k and 18k respectively. I picked the 18k mileage Kia Soul. Neither had the smoking stench that I experienced with Enterprise. 

The return was equally as easy... in and out with a receipt... now if I only remember to sign up with their rewards system to earn some points

We have family who lives in Edwardsville, so visit on occasion. Annie's is a popular stop before making the 6 hour drive home. As I mention in a lot of my reviews, I have a tendency to get overwhelmed when too many options are in front me. So, I almost always defer to the experts. At Annie's, they're happy to make suggestions, and the frozen custard is delicious. The concretes are the star of the show, packed with syrup and candy. A little pricey, perhaps, when compared to fast food ice cream (e.g., DQ or McDonald's), but definitely worth popping by if you're in the area.

There are a LOT of choices when it comes to buying glasses.  But, at the end of the day, most of those places sell the same glasses.  The brand names may be different, but, overall the choices at all of them are the same.  Not the case when you go visit Eli at Dreyfus.  The selection is incredible and the service and expertise are unparalleled.  I am sure you can get glasses cheaper, but, I do not think you can find them done better.  I am very happy with my new glasses...highest quality optics delivered with a smile.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: By far the best yogert in Reno.  They have the "normal" yogurt and also a "custard" style yogurt that is low-fat and oh sooo creamy!  It is a serve-yourself type yogurt, where the cups are HUGE, so the temptation to fill them is almost overwhelming.  It has a fun "beachy" vibe there, and the tables are little surf boards.  Very cute.  I like that is doesn't have a chain feel.  It is he best I have found here so far, it is much better than the competation.  Hey, my husband doesn't even complain when I want to go to yogurt (and not ice cream), it's that good.

I used Budget Car Rental for the first time this week, and my experience was totally average. The car I got - a KIA Sportage - was very nice, new, and clean. No complaints with the vehicle whatsoever. 

The woman that I worked with before getting my car was somewhat short with me, and I felt like she was trying to rush me through the process. I didn't really appreciate that, but other than her disinterested attitude, the rest of my experience with other Budget employees and the vehicle itself was totally fine. I would rent a car through them again.

This hotel is beautiful....well, until you enter the breakfast area. Disgusting.  The floor is reminiscent of an adult movie theater...as I have been told.  Everyone had to pick up their sticky feet to move.  The coffee station was unkempt and nearly empty The food was cold.  The floor was littered with debris.  The eggs were sitting in a pool of water and tasted perfumey.  The dining area was filthy.  It was almost comically bad.  I kept looking around thinking this was a prank show.  So beyond filthy and unacceptable.  I would stay again but NEVER eat that breakfast.  I cannot even imagine what the back area looks like.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We ordered from here because we just needed to wind down from being in downtown all day. We called from our hotel room and ordered a 16" pepperoni pizza and a pepperoni Stromboli. The food was good, minus the crust being smothered in garlic. It was a taste that definitely altered the taste of the Stromboli. 

We were told 45 minutes for delivery and it was actually over an hour. We did call back and ask about the status of the delivery and was told it was on the way. Food took over an hour to be delivered, the delivery man was very personable though.

I went here because of a Groupon I had bought, after a late morning kayak around the harbor with my boyfriend. I liked how spaced out the tables were and the service was excellent. We ordered the Fisherman Boat (which we later realized was actually two boats), and it was nice and satisfying. The Dynamite that came with the second boat was probably my favorite part. It would've been nice to have rice come with the second boat since it has both chicken teriyaki and the dynamite, but we just ordered it separately as a side. Overall, pretty decent food, but nothing that stood out in particular.

Was referred to Blatt by a garage in my neighborhood to get bent wheels replaced, as the original garage doesn't do wheels.  Called around a bit and found that the guys I spoke with at Blatt were very friendly and accommodating to make sure I got the best price.  Brought my car in today and they took care of everything I needed in under an hour without an appointment.  Since I was also getting a couple new tires they offered to rotate them for free every 5,000 miles and tighten the new lug-nuts in a few weeks. 

Hopefully I'll be set for a while, but I would definitely take my car back there if I need to.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Crab Rangoon and a few chicken dishes were very good. Fried rice was very good as well. Their egg foo was offensively poor. Dry, bland, sopping with grease, and had been setting out a long time. Everything else was run-of-the-mill and/or could have been pretty good if it hadn't been out a long time. 

The food could be really good, as the smaller selection seems to demonstrate concentration on quality rather than quantity. But there were too many shortcuts for me to recommend this place to others. 

SOCO Hoosiers will love it I'm sure. But it misses the mark for me for sure.

Haven't been there for a month or so. When I returned I see a price increase, (not a big one) and expected as everything is increasing.  However I didn't expect to get a car wash not up to standard. You have always did a good job on my car busy one not busy, but today was a disappointment. Exterior was good.  I noticed when I got home my front window wasn't free of streaks and missed areas.  My dash wasn't done a all and the console had some area that could have been done better.  I will give you one more chance as I do like the hand wash since I have a permanent paint protection done to my car and they recommend hand washing.

Why does this place only have an average of 3 stars? No seriously, why??? 

This is my FAVORITE place now in Philly, outside of Luke's Lobsters....everything here is so yummy! 

My go to:
The bruschetta (just amazingly fresh!) 
The chicken Caesar salad wth kalamata olives (I'm obsessed with their olives!) 
The tres Leche cake....heaven 

The place is always inviting, clean and warm, and the staff is always friendly and they get it right every time! 
I'm getting hungry just thinking about this place! I definitely recommend!! 5 stars!!!

Yes found this on Yelp as we were Driving by on freeway. I love the Yelp maps. They show where u are and the dot moves. As u get closer. Anywho this place serves up plenty of food. Had chicken wings plain, cashew chicken. Their wings perfectly crispy and chicken dish had such perfectly cooked carrots and peppers and celery Mmm. Boy had mo Gillian beef. It was good but different flavor that what we r used to. And he had the lo mein. Well we ended up with a box to go ( ya think?) lo mein was bland we thought.. Soy sauce needed fo sho. Hungry Trk drivers surprise was good!

Horrible.  I just arrived from Chicago, and this is my neighborhood spot. It's clean and pleasant, thus the two stars.

The selection is awful. What they do have is extremely overpriced. The items I would buy at numerous different stores in Chicago are $2- $3 more expensive at this store.

Did I mention the selection is absolutely pitiful?

I also noticed that some of the bakery bread was misshapen and wet.

I don't know how they get away with this, but you would save money by going to whole Foods over this place. I'm really, really sad that this place is right across the street from me and I will probably never set foot in it again.

I checked Yelp before we went to Lambertville and it did not let me down!  This restaurant was phenomenal!!!   Great portions and the food just melts in your mouth.  I would rate it just like the Four Seasons in NYC as far as food is concerned.  I had the hanger steak which was amazing.  It's also BYOB so the total bill was lower than expected.  Save room for deserts!  Do not be put off by the small menu.  The specials are awesome!!!!  Heidi was our waitress and she was terrific.  A MUST GO if you are in the area.

This place may just be the most fun on all the Honky Tonk!
Was walking past the area looking for a fun music scene and Nashville Crossroads surely delivers. 
They often have great music and great service to go along with it. 
Truly a memorable time while visiting over thanksgiving weekend :) 
There is a "curfew" during the pandemic, where everything needs to be closed and cleared by 10:30pm. Not half as bad as many other cities! 
Social distancing is enforced and promoted as often as possible and of course, as adults, each is responsible for keeping safe, without ruining the fun that is! :)

How bad can sushi get? This bad. Then again, Philly is known for its amazing hoagies, great German, Italian and Vietnamese food... Just not its sushi... But, no, seriously, this is the very worst of the worst I've had around the world. And I had really bad sushi in a remote region of Chihuahua once. This place was worst. There was a piece of sushi that was the size of a vitamin. I understand Philadelphia is not by the sea, but this level of frugality and misery left us dumbfounded and feeling bad for everyone who thinks this place deserves anything more than 1/2 a star.

Great place the rooms are fantastic!! The decor is great. Downside... we didn't have any hot water the night of arrival and then next day. Due to the inconvenience the hotel comped one of our self parking fees... which are $47 each and we were traveling in two cars. 
The beds are comfy the room was immaculate. The checkin service was impeccable. He was so nice   and helpful. 
I loved the view I was in the 25th floor with a downtown view and it was the most amazing sight! Although there was the water fiasco I would surely return.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love that they offer primarily paper bags, I bring my own but paper is so much easier to recycle! Definitely a useful market to have, it provides a decent selection of organic and vegan options, as well wine and beer. If you like to cook you'll be satisfied with the selection of items, I was able to make a makati mushroom risotto and  get all I needed! However when I was looking for tortillas to make a salad wrap they only had the small ones.. overall it's a win. If you're trying to stay healthy and shop in Small quantities you've shopped at the right place.

An impressive looking facility until you get down to the fine details. The shelf in the closet had not been cleaned in quite some time, the molding on the inside of the door was coming off, the corner moldings in the bathrooms were in rough shape and there were no shears in the windows. With no shears you either have to close the curtains or open them...nothing in between.  There was a wedding in the facility on Saturday and the noise fr ok m the after party kept the room bouncing until well after midnight. The positive is that the staff was very friendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Nice little pizzeria in Metairie. Wanted to try the Chicago Deep Dish based on the other reviews, but didn't have the extra 45 minutes to wait. Had the meatball calzone instead. It didn't disappoint! Portion was large as I was able to make two meals out of it. Crust was a little crispy for my taste, and but I think it has more to do with the oven used. The staff was extremely helpful and the owner checked on us several times to make sure everything was good! Will definitely be back!! Hopefully with more time to try the Chicago!!!

Such a cool boutique. Part of SLH and now the Hyatt umbrella, Soniat House is completely out of left field in terms of outward appearances and actual experience. You walk into what looks like an old townhouse, only to realize that it expands into a cozy little garden surrounded by various hotel rooms. The decor is lovely and the staff super friendly. It really did feel like a quiet oasis in the middle of a bustling city. 

Absolutely loved my stay here and would recommend it for someone looking for something a little off the beaten path.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I came in and beelined straight to the cash register to order some tacos, but got redirected to the kitchen counter. So note to newcomers, don't order at the cash register. The tacos were delicious. I ordered 2 steak and 2 carnita - and my absolute favorite of those was the steak, it had a nice smoky flavor to them. The grilled onions that were handed to us on a plate from the kitchen was also extremely delectable and I chose to eat those grilled onions alone and not add them to my taco! I would definitely eat here again, but I'm not from the area at all.

First time stopping st this place. I have seen full in the past, so I decided to give it a try. 
Breakfast compared with Noshville, it really lacks choices and taste. I should have read the reviews before. 

I can't believe they don't have sweet tea! 

And the spinach in the omelet was MIA :(

The side salad was ok, and so was the egg whites. 

The service was quick since I was the one of 6 people in the joint...
 No live music this time, which is also sad. I hope to improve my ratings next time I stop by. (Note to reader, BNA is my Home airport, so I will give it a try again!)

We took my mother here for her 60th birthday and were mostly pleased. The menu was innovative, the decor was pleasant, and the food was very, very good. The reason I did not give 5 Stars: the service was good but it wasn't great. The young man that served us was friendly, but he was not speaking in a way I expect to be spoken to at a fine restaurant. He also never started order-taking with the women in our group, which was off-putting. Other than that, I highly recommend this spot! As my father said, "This place is so good that you'd never think you were in Delaware!"

Let me start by saying my husband loves this place and frequents it with his brother. He loves the mussels! I, however, thought the food was okay. I am not a fan of their white sauce (tasted like garlic mayo), which they put on many of the rolls. Also, just in general I didn't enjoy the roll flavor combinations. I will say I enjoyed the Carson City roll, and the service was excellent, very quick. And very clean. Just peep the menu before you go to make sure you'd be into the rolls. ALSO - of note, the prices listed are much different, $30 for AYCE lunch.

Honestly I don't know what's up with these other ratings. This place is authentic asf and with that comes maybe slightly slower service but if you've ever traveled abroad you understand this. Their food is excellent I don't know why this place has the ratings it has. Highly recommend for authentic Mexican food, and we eat out constantly and have palettes you can trust. Definitely go here. (FYI they're byob so bring your tequila and margarita mix! If you forget your mix, DiBruno bottle shop is nearby and has it!).

Booked this hotel for 2 nights.  Great location,spacious room but that's where my accolades end.

We indicated in our reservation there were 3 of us staying.  There was only one set of towels.  No extra pillows or blanket for our son.  Toilet paper almost out.  Also, when we entered the room, we saw a large indent on our bed, like someone sat there before we got in.  Cleaning left much to be desired.  

Their "free" breakfast consisted of tasteless coffee and stale muffins.  

I'll stick to airbnb next time in Philly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I have banked with these folks since 1983 when they were AEA Credit Union and they used to be wonderful. When we went to live in Europe for a year in 1993 they took care of paying our monthly bills for us and were genuinely excited for us. But these days they are less excited about serving their customers. They are the lone remote outpost of a Silicon Valley company, and the business model of KeyPoint is like any other bank: Try to extract as many fees as you can.
I still have accounts there, but my main bank is now Community West in Old Town Goleta, where they greet me by name when I walk in.

This was my GF and my 2nd visit to Mica. Our 1st visit was so awesome that we selected Mica to celebrate my 53rd birthday. Our appetizers of beet salad and tuna tartar were both beauty on plates. Our entrees of Arctic Char and Roast Chicken were delicious and the flavors were intense and layered. Each bite brought more hedonistic savoring. The service was outstanding, being both professional and efficient while remaining unobtrusive. The decor is minimal but enticing. Mica is a gem to be enjoyed and frequented often. We'll be back for many more meals.

Good and neatly made sushi, prompt delivery and decent price for the quality. However last night my 3 year old son took a bite of negimaki and we pulled a long piece of plastic wrap out of his mouth! I'm bummed at that dangerous oversight given we've enjoyed everything else! I also had a raging stomach ache in the middle of the night and was afraid I had food poisoning, however no one else got sick, and to be fair I'd baked a cake earlier and naturally enjoyed some raw batter haha. So I can't be 100% sure it was the fish.

Reviewer # 19

I've been to this location probably 20 times over the last 5 years. The restaurant is always consistent and friendly. The same people have been working there for quite some time, which says a lot. 

The services is pretty traditional of a Mexican restaurant-- they bring you chips, salsa and beans and the menu is the usual. I, personally, haven't seen anything extra special, but then again I don't venture too deep into the menu. 

Consistency, good food, friendly service, and a good location keeps me comin' back!

I went to this place, which I never heard about, because of the weekly yelp! Mexican food is by far my favorite! I have a weakness. However, I generally stick to what I love and haven't tried many other things when it comes to Mexican. I, however, wanted to try the tortilla soup, but I didn't. I stuck with the beef burrito supreme. It was super big and flavorful. It was somewhat on the dry side for me, but salsa fixed that. The tortilla was pretty dry and broke open pretty easily. I did eat it all and was super satisfied! Overall-- I liked it and would go again. There is a drive thru and much less greasy and drippy than others I've had.

We just moved to Florida from California and our Boston developed some very bad allergies. She broke out in a rash all over her stomach, legs, etc... and was itching and licking herself like crazy. We came here and everyone was so friendly and nice. The Vet recommended the plan to relieve our dogs itchiness and treated her with a cortisone shot. This has helped our Zilla tremendously and we couldn't be happier. We will probably have to get these shots for her on a regular basis but we are so happy she's no longer itching herself like crazy! This is definitely our Vet from now on!

Came here with my bf for coffee perk up. He ordered a cold brew and I ordered a latte with almond milk. There were no customers inside the store except us. They took over ten minutes to make our order. It's a basic coffee order. They gave my boyfriend iced coffee not a cold brew. They gave me latte with regular milk not almond milk. Lactose intolerant. Not cool. The cashier when we got there was like I'm about to clock out. The lady in the back was eating a granola bar while making the drink. Health inspection?

Well, I gotta tell ya.  I really liked this place, hit it for lunch, the drive thru wait wasn't all that bad, the service was friendly, the food was outstanding and I'm a picky pain in the Mexican-Food ass.  Refried beans, some of the best I've had.  Carne Asada, Great!   If you're in a hurry, go to Taco Bell, they'll get you through there in a Mexican second, but the food isn't really mexican, and maybe you can't tell the difference anyway.  

Big Juans may or may not have had some growing pains, but I'll tell you they're obviously working them out, I'll be back and if you don't, then great I'll get through the drive-thru even faster.

Had a great stay at the hotel! The staff was super friendly and accommodating. Special mention for following workers that went out of their way to make us feel right at home celebrating my friend's birthday: Tori, Brandi, Pablo, the night shift person the night of our stay (1/12/19), and the kitchen area worker the morning of checkout (1/13/19). She was so sweet! Would definitely recommend. Only downfalls were that there was a hair on the toilet when we arrived and that the tub faucet had a small leak. The room was excellent though! And the beds and pillows were out of this world comfortable!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We were craving authentic tacos and we found this place not too far from our house so we decided to give it a try. We went during a week night and it wasn't busy that busy. We don't speak Spanish and our server didn't speak that much English but she was very friendly and we still managed to get our orders just right. I did wish she was more attentive though because we were one of the very few tables that were there that night but still did a bit of waiting when we needed something. Food was great and satisfied our Mexican food cravings.

Stopped by after an afternoon movie and decided to give this place a try. The establishment was small but busy. There was no one to greet and seat us so we chose a small table by the window which hadn't been wiped down. After about 10min of no service and overhearing a couple behind me get the wrong order served to them (young waiter says 'my bad'), we were about ready to walk out. Ended up staying and getting the soup/salad and slice of pizza combo. The slice of pizza was HUGE and delicious and the Italian wedding soup was small but tasty. The food is awesome but the service needs work.

Grim, came here at lunch time, place was dead so I should have just got up and left. They have a $3.95 lunch roll special, got a spicy tuna, Hoosier role and Shrimp Tempura roll. 

Shrimo tempura roll was rubbery and greasy, like it was last nights shrimo. Spicy tuna was chunky and weirdly sweet. Hoosier roll had avocado which is the only good thing. Rolls were all losely formed, rice was bad. 

Service finally was poor, servee far to interested in talking to her friends.

Finally pretty much sure I am guaranteed gut drop.

We came after walking around Battery Park playing pokemon when we got hungry. We were blown away by the amazingly sweet and caring waitress (Lisa I think?) who was incredibly accommodating to us. Another thing I noticed is that every party that came in after us was a regular customer that the waitress greeted. That's a sign of a good restaurant. I ordered the chicken parm and he got the calzone, both of which were delicious and filling and were huge portions. I was expecting to pay about  $40 but only ended up spending $25. We will definitely be back again!!

This is one of the best Starbucks in Tucson. The employees are always cheerful, polite and very knowledgeable of the SB products. Andrew, Zarin and Ammie are always very friendly and cheerful, which is always nice to do business with them. If you are a regular or a first timer here, the employees treat you as if you are their only customer. It gets crazy at times, but everyone pulls together and this makes the flow of orders happen very smoothly. The Store Manager, Lawson, has a great attitude toward his customers and employees. Best Starbucks in Tucson. Thank you! Always enjoy going to this friendly store.

I like the automation integrated at this Car wash, from the touch screen drive through, to customer oriented staggered packaging with separate upgradable choices.
