This way you can get a simple exterior wash with a Rain-x or Tire Shine upgrade.  Pricing runs from $6 and up depending on if you're looking for a quick rinse or a thorough, long lasting shine.  If you're not sure how much to invest, think about the woman you're gonna have in that car.

Oh, and enjoy the free vacuums afterward.  Came by around 2pm on a weekday and took my time to suck out every nook and cranny myself rather than someone else do a quick swipe.

I've gone here a few times for gel pedis and you just can't beat their price- I think it was $38. They do a good job and the setting is pretty standard, but when you're getting a gel pedicure for that cheap, how can you complain? I haven't had any problems with my nails and they seem to last at least 6-8 weeks, which again, is well worth the money. They have a good selection of gel colors and are efficient, and it's usually not a problem just to walk in without having to wait too long. If you're looking for an inexpensive but good place to get a gel pedi, try them out!

Oh Jeni's we come see you almost on a weekly basis.  My daughter asks for you by name nightly.

Jeni's Ice Cream is worth all of the hype and all of the lines.  I had Jeni's for the first time in St. Louis on a weekend visit and when I moved to Nashville was so excited that they were also located here.  I am pretty boring and usually get my tried and true which is the Brown Butter Almond Brittle with Salted Caramel Sauce with that marvelous cookie.  My only critique is that they have recently stopped heating the caramel sauce.  I mean I still put it in my mouth but hot caramel sauce is AMAZING!!!  

One of my favorite spots!

Being from NY, it is interesting to me that this is considered pizza. That being said, I am glad my friend told me what STL pizza is because had I come in expecting NY style pizza I would have been very disappointed. The pizza was okay... I guess. The flat "crust" reminds me of a tortilla shell, and the provel cheese is interesting. All in all, the flavor isn't bad but when I say I am craving pizza, this isn't what I am craving. The fried ravioli was really good! I wish my friend and I had gotten more ravioli and less pizza. Service was quick. I'd go back for more ravioli but probably skip the pizza.

I arrived in Philadelphia at 11:30 am for a work conference and was staying at the hotel. My room was not ready and would be in an hour, so I went to explore for a few hours. I went back at 5:30pm, still not ready! So they gave me another room, I went upstairs I felt like it was back in time, the furniture was old and no USB ports and bed skirts were stained and the fridge was unplugged and smelled. The employees were amazing, they were so helpful and incredible. But the hotel needed updating. I will go back once the hotel is completed in the updating stage is completed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Come on Subway, for what you charge I expect more than a dozen tiny thin slices of roast beef and five or six slices of provolone on a foot-long sub. Topping that with a thin drizzle of lettuce, half a dozen scraps of red onion and maybe a dozen banana peppers is just insulting. And then you have the nerve to charge me over $10 for that and a large iced tea? Guess who's going somewhere else the next time they feel like a sub sandwich?

 In case you can't guess, I recommend to anyone reading this review that you go ANYWHERE else but here.

It's really a tourist trap. I knew that going in. I just wanted to try it. I usually don't fall for the touristy things. I just wanted to try it. If you really want to drink, you're better off. Going to a bartender off of the Bourbon Street and have them make you a drink. You can get a hurricane for about $8 and you can have them make a hand grenade for just a little more. That's going to be a little stronger and less watered down than these. But if you just want to walk around and carry a hand grenade bottle so be it. Just find your way and enjoy your time.

Great recommendation from Kelleigh (I owe you one!) I asked for Mai. She was great. Very detail oriented. 

For me, I'd rather spend alittle more time and have my nail tech get all of the gel from underneath my nails when painting. I mean, why should I have to pick dried gel polish off my cuticles and under my nail bed? Just sayin. No worries with her. 

My husband got his usual - Deluxe Pedi/Mani. He likes his nails buffed and his girl didn't do that:( He likes his satin finish. I know..so Pauly from Sopranos. 

We will definitely be back. Prices are fantastic! She will even do 3 coats of gel if you want!

Great Margarita, yummy Micheladas (my fav is with a Modelo Negra), Bacon wrapped shrimp and Asada, street tacos, pretty much all the food is great. Only complaint and why my stars are so low is the wait. It is always at least an hour to get your food. I have sat here multiple times waiting for my check for over 40 mins, that is after waiting forever for food and drinks. They need to hire more kitchen staff and waitresses. 

Also bonus! During nice seasons they have outdoor entertainment. The atmosphere outside.

I have only been here once and probably will not go back unless I'm desperate. This review is purely on the gym itself and not the staff/trainers. Horribly ventilated, stuffy and hot, not enough airflow. The cardio machines are kind of an afterthought. It's a very small location, and they don't have Rock Bot or the convenient wipes to wipe down the machines. Maybe I'm just spoiled from the North Valley and Red Rock locations but I would rather drive 5 more minutes down the road to North Valley than go to this location again.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Went to Longboard Pizza and since this was conveniently connected, decided to have dessert. Super friendly and helpful staff, and the place was very clean. We got the custard frozen yogurt. It was rich and creamy! I didn't try all the other flavors, but there were about 10 more. It's kind of pricey so be careful with your toppings. The one thing I wanted was whip cream which they don't have. 

They weigh your icecream at the end. My only concern is I think they don't account for the cup the icecream is in, I grabbed a bigger cup to be less messy. Next time I would just get a smaller one since I'm actually paying for the cup too.

Every time I visit the cherry hill mall, I HAVE to eat here!!! the food is always delicious and fresh. Their menu has everything from healthy to decadent options including lots of choices for vegetarians. I have never been disappointed!!! their pasta dishes are amazing, pizzas are fresh, so tasty and made to order, apps are fantastic!!! not only is the food fabulous, but the staff is great too!!! they're super friendly, fast, and accommodating! they refill my drink before i even have to ask, they're polite, attentive, and they always remember me and welcome me back! i always recommend this spot to friends, and visitors to the area!!!

I love this gym!  I used to be a member of club fitness, but went in for a free trial at 24 hour fitness and was immediately sold, despite the extra 15 minute drive.  

The gym always has plenty of machines available, it's relatively clean, people are friendly, and the gym just feels so much bigger and brighterthan some of the other gyms I've been to.

My absolute favorite part - the group ex classes.  I've been trying to find a kickboxing class for years and the one here is so much fun.  

I would definitely recommend this gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Good, clean room. Just what you'd expect from an Aloft. Same furniture/layout as all the others. 

Downsides:
-very thin walls, so you can hear doors clunking shut down the hall
-Internet was on the fritz during out stay (maybe due to the storm?)
-live music while we were checking in made the front desk agent and me say everything three times; turn down the amp a bit buddy

All in all, I'll go back when I need a quick place to stay on the road, but I'll probably give the Westin across the parking lot a shot if their rates are similar.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Unfortunately I had a bad experience here tonight. My fiancé and I came here for dinner. I am vegetarian who is trying to avoid eggs. So, I asked our server if the gnocchi had eggs in it. She asked an older male waiter. He came over and with a snarky attitude told me twice that gnocchi always has eggs. Then he immediately after said they don't have gluten free options-although I didn't ask about gluten. On the bottom of the menu it said egg free and gluten options available. Food is average but not worth the price. The service is sub par. We had to ask for water three times. We will not be back.

Met some friends for coffee here and I was a bit disappointed. Our brews were quite good. Their nibble selection was nice, however,  I couldn't get past how dirty the cafe was. Dirty tables and counters and the floor was littered. Chairs were esque and dirty. The bathroom was an embarrassment. They really do need to rotate staff to tidy the place up. Last, there are no comfy seats to kick back and just relax. This cafe is more aligned with the image of McDonald's not Starbuck's. Im sure its within the parameters stipulated by the Corp but it must be the budget model.

This is a "pickup or delivery" place. If you plan on dining in, bring your Clorox wipes. I don't know what the kitchen looked like but the dining area was filthy and served more like a storage area. The menu was okay. I had the beef with broccoli. A fairly safe choice. The flavor was good. The portion of beef to broccoli was excellent. The beef was pretty rubbery. I really wish the take out boxes were not those styrofoam clam shells. Sauce goes everywhere and I dislike the environmental impact of styrofoam. I suppose prices would go up if they changed their boxes. The service was super fast. I might try a different dish if I go again.

Whoa!  That's some cheap sushi.  Finding cheap sushi that's also good sushi is like finding water in an arid desert, but that's exactly what Sam's Sushi offers.  The crunchy shrimp was great and the Nashville roll is awesome.  The rolls are around $3.00 and are HUGE.  My only criticism is that there is a little too much rice. I got two rolls and ended up sharing half of it.  Don't go when you are in a hurry, don't go with an attitude.  The place is very small, it's a pick up and go kind of place. Give it a try.

We go here a lot, but this week's trip was exceptionally good. The outdoor seating is a game changer for this place... even on a really hot day it was pleasant out there in the evening. The hearts of palm and spinach dip served with pita is one of the best things I have eaten in months, and the strawberry cake was so fresh and "homemade" tasting! Best of all, in these days of really bad service at most Nashville restaurants, they remain consistently professional. It truly is one of the few excellent places to eat in Green Hills.

This is a nice hotel and we have stayed there in our past visits to Delaware; however, as I needed to book a couple dates in July around a visit to Delaware, we were hit with two unexpected fees of $14.99 for each booking through the Inn at Wilmington's online booking service (www.reservations.com).  This was not properly disclosed on the Inn at Wilmington's website, so be aware BEFORE you book any travel with this hotel.  (Note:  as I could not address my discontent through this website and the Inn at Wilmington uses them, I am writing my lack of unhappiness here.)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place used to be in the MacDade Mall for years. Their pizza was always delicious. Their pizza is still very good. We had the Philly Cheesesteak Pizza. It had chipped steak, onions and green peppers on it. You can get it with red or white sauce. We got it with the red. We ordered bruchetta as an appetizer. Their bruchetta is pieces of ciabatta bread with some chopped tomatoes, a little basil and some garlic. I've had much better bruchetta. The other half had a Yeungling Lager draft cuz he has to have a beer everywhere he goes if they serve it. Our waitresses was very nice. I'll probably be back to try one of the pasta dishes or sandwiches.

I'll say it: I'm starting to really like this place.

This is not the most authentic or innovative Chinese restaurant, but Evergreen is great at what it does - cheap, fast, tasty American-style Chinese food.  I always get the pork chow fun and an hot and sour soup, it's always delivered to me piping hot, and it always tastes really good.  I will continue to return to Evergreen for all my greasy-delicious Chinese food needs.

One star off on principle for being cash only (WHY, PHILADELPHIA), but you can order with a credit card on Grubhub and they'll deliver it to your house!

Some Employees are sometimes friendly, other employees are always nice, or bare minimum... cordial at least. Atmosphere is occasionally welcoming.

Gym stuff: there are always machines available and I almost never have to wait. It's never overwhelmingly busy, even at peak times. It's always clean, not stinky like many gyms. The spa area is always open and clean also. The bathrooms are nice. It's great for the person who wants to get fit, or lift basic weights, but not a body builder type place. Good for regular peeps who just wanna stay fit.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Three things that differentiate lower level big chain offerings from one another are noise, bed comfort,  and above all, housekeeping. This location is relatively quiet and does not have an HVAC system that kicks off and on all night long. The beds are decent if not kinda hard.

They fall down on housekeeping.  This time I had a semen stained towel (believe me I know one when I see one) and only decaf coffee packets in the room. Barely functional shower head. 

These are the details that housekeeping is responsible for and that make a big difference to road warriors. 

Twice was enough for this place. I'll go elsewhere.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I went to the Landmark on Saturday evening not knowing what to expect.  When I walked in I was highly impressed by the cleanliness and overall ambiance of the restaurant.  Since there was a baseball ball game on I decided to order some wings and I was not disappointed, they were literally some of the best I have had.  The service was great and the food came out quick.  Our waitress was attentive and answered all of our questions regarding the menu (which is a little limited, but at least its not overwhelming).  Overall a great experience.  This may just become my go to place.

If I could give 0 stars I would. Wanted a pedicure and go every 2 weeks at home but tried this place while in the Tampa area. I'm used to my cuticles being cut, heels and sole of my feet being scrubbed to get rid of dead skin and at least filing my nails down and NOTHING. I was told that my skin on my feet was too think and I'd have to come back every week for them to get the dead skin off?!?!  Lazy workers in my opinion. So unhappy with the service. I paid the $23 without even letting her finish. You're not calling the police on me saying I stole a service. Ughhhh!!!  Don't go here.

This review is for Whitney in general, not this specific location. I am a new Whitney customer. The good thing is that their checking accounts are reasonable.

The bad:

- SUPER INCONVENIENT HOURS. There is literally no time this bank is open that I'm not at work.
- Non-existent customer service. I exist online. I do all my banking online. This bank's online account has been IMPOSSIBLE for me to get set up. When is their customer service available? Oh, only the same times the bank is open, WHEN I'M AT WORK. 

This bank operates like it's still 1960. Totally ridiculous and unhelpful. Very unhappy so far.

My favorite for cheap Italian byo.  Wait staff are friendly and attentive, and its pretty easy to get a table of any size almost any time.  I also appreciate that outdoor eating is not only dog-friendly, but dog-encouraging!

Food is pretty good too.  I prefer the lobster ravioli to the (also great) stuff la viola serves, and having tried most of their apps by this point, I can safely say the mussels are my favorite app on the menu.

Did I mention that it's cheap?  A meal for four was about a hundred, and we all left satisfied.

La Viola is hands down my favorite restaurant in the city. It's the first place I recommend and no one I've sent there has regretted it. It fits my philosophy that the best Italian restaurants are cash only, so hit the ATM before dining.

The service is always impeccable, I don't think I've ever heard them say no to a request. It's not a huge location, though, very intimate seating, but great for couples. If you need more space, try their other location, La Viola Ovest.

I've had pretty much everything on the menu and it was all fantastic. I would also recommend trying the specials even if they sound a little strange.

Full blown circus on regular occasion.  Longest possible lines- not because it's anything special but because workers are clowns.  Peak hours on Saturday, line around the block for both drive thru and inside, when finally get inside they have a new guy training in the register while the manager is just walking around apologizing.  What a moron.  Owner needs to pay a little more and get the A Team employees there on the weekend, can't have first day at the job type people.  Train them during the week during slower times.  Can't believe I have to even say this should be common sense

Cute ice cream shop - in a 'strip mall' that is a bit cuter than a regular one due to its brick, or fake brick?
I opted for the Euro trash & cinnamon roll in a waffle cone - I do wish the cinnamon roll had the icing topping versus an extra sprinkling of cinnamon, but as long as you like cinnamon, you'll like the cinnamon roll ice cream. The euro trash is unique, I can't quite put my finger on what it tastes like but it says it has Nutella throughout. 
I enjoyed the cream due to it not tasting overly sugary, like most store bought brands.
Just under $7 with tax for the 2 scoops and waffle cone.

Customer service: meh. Wait in line: meh. Condition of car: meh.  

Rude employees who didn't seem like they had their things sorted out as multiple people came back in to complain about their cars. When I was finally called up to check in for my reservation, the woman didn't even look at us. We got our car and it was a rather new model but smelled smoky and looked like someone has just drove it through a mud pile. 

Drop off was easy and we didn't have to wait that long for a shuttle to the airport. I'd rent a car with them again because they were cheaper than their competitors.

Based on the one experience I've had at Derek's, I'll give it four stars.  The food was tasty, our server was awesome, and the pricing is what I expected for this kind of place.

I can see, however, how the negative experiences other people have had would happen.  Usually there are way too many annoying little richies sitting outside in their D and G glasses, which is why I never went in there, but the crowd was blessedly thin when I went.  That probably helped.  I was there on a Sunday with two other people at 6:30, which probably also helped.

I visited on a whim one day while I was in downtown Fishers. I got a vanilla latte which was good, but not amazing. Honestly, it wasn't a very memorable latte, but the woman behind the bar was kind and told me a bit about the coffee they use. 

This is very much a small place/business so don't expect anything fancy. I hope they more of a punch into the espresso shots and make their drinks a bit more flavorful. 

I'll be returning as this is better than Starbucks. But be warned: prices are right in line with Starbucks ($5 for a regular cup).

Of course, it would be me to not to think to take a picture of my car once they were finished, knowing it would only take one time of my girls getting in the car for it to get dog hair everywhere again. 

After several trips to the beach and my two girls long white hair, these employees had their work cut out for them! 

Mine did take a little longer than others because of the sand, fur, etc but I expected that so it wasn't a matter of how fast they work, just how much work I gave them. 

Afterwords my car was shiny clean and smelled great.

Bar taco.. eh, nothing special.. expensive hyped up taco spot that caters to the upper yuppie crowd.. we picked 3 small tacos for our order and ate them within lightning speed.. we were still hungry afterwards.. i wouldnt exactly call this a authentic taco spot and would not bother coming back as we were not exactly impressed 


Update 8/25/2019:: We gave Bar Taco a second chance today and have noted that they took more time out for my family today.. they ensured that we had enough food and went out of their way to remedy the last visit. We really appreciated this as it speaks volumes to their desire to ensure customer satisfaction..

I placed a pick up order . I had to call three times before anyone answered, when someone finally picked up I was rudely greeted and I placed my order . Having a bad taste in my mouth with the conversation I had I called back and asked to speak with the manager , who happened to be the person who I spoke with when I originally ordered. I explained that I felt like the person was rude and I would like to cancel my order . The manager said okay it's cancelled and hung up.  I would have to drive by at least 5 pizza restaurants to get to magpies , why would I order from them if they have no value of customer service? Never again.

Portions here are small for the price. They charged 20% tip on our table of 7...thought that the standard 18% would've been more fair. The decor was nice but it was really loud and I couldn't really hear the people I was with. Overall an OK experience I wouldn't come back. My younger cousin ordered from the kids menu which was supposed to come with an ice cream at the end of the dinner the waiter decided my cousin was too old for the kids menu and denied him of the ice cream.  He should've told us before we ordered what the age limit was.

Went for one night to enjoy a wedding at St Johns and a reception at the grand hall . I would say this was a terrific experience . The food was good (except the cake was a bit dry but I'm not sure it was their fault there ) when it comes to the reception and yes it looked well coordinated and well done with a great amount of effort . As for the hotel and its rooms I would say it wasn't bad either but it was a bit dirty and other than that I got nothing to complain . Overall a solid place all around . The icing on the cake ? The trains and clever statues inside .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: For a Best Western this is a great stay. Daughter is at Tulane, and though this is a little out of the way, it's not in a crowded part of NOLA. Very low key area (I.e. You go out of Westwego for experiences). The inn itself is great. Super helpful, kind, and sweet staff. Rooms just fine. Nice pool out front. Good hot breakfast. You can tell they put a lot if thought in to their upbeat decor. Remember, this isn't the Hyatt or Sheraton, it's a Best Western, and it's an excellent example of what these type of establishments should be like.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Maybe Covid has really interfered with their great service and lavish menu. We spent $114 and just felt a little ripped off with salty and bitter cocktails, a few shrimp after a lengthy wait to get the cocktail. The chicken was delicious . The atmosphere was a nice change of pace, but we were expecting to be blown away, but nothing to say 'we must go back'.  The hibiscus margarita from Buffalo Wild Wings leaves a bigger imprint in mind than the cocktail tonight. We asked about the bar we saw in photos, just wondering where it was because it was beautiful, and the server snapped back 'well it's closed' .

The pool area looks Nothing like the photos. 
First, yes it's on a rooftop, but the rooftop of the 4th floor. So that was initially misleading. 
We see the pool and it's Tiny! Nothing like the photos of grandeur and space. And the pool was filled with children. Next time I book somewhere, I'll be sure the pool area is 21 and up/
Not at all the relaxing night I was expecting. I've stayed at cheaper hotels with nicer pool areas. 

The room was clean, but the snacks at the minibar were already eaten and the empty containers remained.  

The location was good, but not memorable enough for the price to stay again or to recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My wife and I were not happy with the Hyatt at all. We had to stay here for a conference. We had a horrible check in experience, waiting 6 hours to get our room. We arrived at 1pm and the third person we spoke with said they were not told we had arrived. Our friend traveling with us had to change rooms after their bed was wet; which they didn't find out until they turned in for the night, so one of them slept on the sofa. The building is beautiful, the people are nice but for what we paid, the experience was lacking. We will not stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place needs an update! It's tired and old and barely acceptable. 
Front Desk "service" was grumpy and distracted. 
Reservation was for a King - they ran out of Kings - so 2 full size beds - not even QUEEN size. And the beds are on WHEELS - so as I was trying to watch television in bed, or even read - the bed was moving across the floor. I've never seen this before. Weird. 
There was a coffee machine and small fridge - but the rest of was pretty sub-par. 
And the neighborhood is pretty sketchy. Won't be staying here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place is exactly what you expect for a 5.99 buffet cheap food small selection of food most bland or overcooked noodles, the place smells a little like its got mold or mildew smell going the ceiling looks water damaged and makes your meal more unappetizing. the tables and chairs were sticky and dirty i had to wash my hands after i grabbed a chair and got food on my hand, I wish to say i was exaggerating but for your dollar it is what it is, i think a change of staff and good cleaning could save this place but i dont think there into making changes.

Clean rooms and friendly staff.  Have to give these folks a 5-star for all around good honest people.  We checked in Christmas night and out the next day to board a cruise.  Our 14 year old lost his wallet wIth $120 cash in it and no ID except his YMCA card.  The lost wallet was discovered missing  after we had left port for a 4 day cruise.  Upon our return on Dec 30 we called the hotel.  They had  found the wallet in the laundry room.  The wallet and cash were bagged and safely returned to my son.  Marriott will continue to be my choice partner for all of our vacation stays.  Honesty and trust always wins!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Much fun to be had at Anchor High.  Food is good bar food, drinks are strong and tasty.  Great live bands on the weekends.  This place gets PACKED - so if you want a table outside to hear the music you better get there early.  Or else, be told as we were this weekend by the hostess "you are NOT getting a table tonight."  Uh, ok then...thanks for nothin'.  

Regardless of her crankiness it's a great place to hang out in the summer.  Even better that you can get to it via car or boat.  Have Michelle the bartender mix you up something - she's way too much fun!

I've been a regular customer here since they opened, but today was the last straw. I had an appointment at 3:30pm. It's 4:20pm and I still haven't had anyone start on my pedicure. They had people coming in after me and they took them and started right away. Usually the nice girl is there and she runs that place really well. The shorter guy doesn't know how to run the place. If they were down 2 nail techs, they should've called and cancelled or pushed my appointment back. That was a waste of my Saturday afternoon. I will never go back.

This Wendy's is one of the cheaper options on campus for food. I usually go here when I don't have cash for the food trucks around campus.
The service here is adequate and will get your order right. 

The tables at this Wendy's are usually dirty. I haven't seen any employee wipe them down so I usually opt for takeout. Don't order food when they first open in the morning (9am), the buns for the sandwiches are usually cold and sometimes moist! They should defrost/warm their buns if they're serving them straight from the fridge.

I saw these pizzas in many of my friends' IG stories, and I had to try it once during this quarantine. They are doing pizza reservations which can be found on online. 

The white pizza was delicious. The pizza crust had a good crunch and chew to it. The cheeses were perfect, and the spiciness from the chili flakes gave it a nice kick. I was just disappointed there was only 6 slices. I could probably eat the whole thing by myself.

The service was very kind and they made sure to keep social distancing a priority. When I'm feeling fancy, I will definitely come back to try their other pizzas.

Sushi. I found a place in Tampa where you can have your sushi MADE TO ORDER and HAVE IT YOUR WAY. I hate when sushimen are not japanese. Even chineses I don't like. These one is a REAL japanese sushiman and the place is pretty neat, with fine people at lunch time. I like their prices too. You can have the roll (8 pieces) of "bagel sushi" (salmon and cream cheese) or Ebi (shrimp over rice) for only 4.75 and there are delicious combinations on the menu.  If you like sushi like I do, you definitely  should check this place out. :)

This is the best pizza place in St. Louis. I have read several negative reviews but it pretty clear they just don't like at Louis style pizza and that's fine. I have been getting pizza here for over 30 years! My father use to drive me to pick it up and I would ride home with the warm box on my lap and the awesome smell in the car.

North St. Louis county doesn't have to much going for it these days but it is nice to recognize those businesses that truly excel and remain when so many people and businesses have left the area!

we went on a saturday night after hearing rave reviews from a co-worker.  sampled a couple of flavors, which were fine, but really not all that spectacular.  i felt somewhat obligated to get some yogurt, but after taking my cup up to the counter, none of the employees seemed to notice that we were ready to check out, even though we were in plain view. after waiting for a few minutes, it seemed as if one of the employees saw us and was coming to ring us up. instead, he just talked to his coworker and did not come to help us. we left our ice cream on the counter and walked out. wont be going back.

The worst McDonald's I've ever been to. We were waiting in one of the two drive through line for 15 minutes without any response after repeatedly reaching out to get anyone's attention. We switched to the other line thinking the speaker was out in the line we were in but as soon as we pulled behind the three other cars in our line they started reaching out to the original line we were in. Waited 20 minutes to finally order our food to be told THEY ONLY ARE TAKING CASH. I'm very disappointed in the customer service provided at this location. No respect for customers or their time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very disappointed, I came to this store every other month to buy two boxes of Champagne and wine. When I'm at the registration getting ready to pay my order, one of the cashier gave me an attitude. Two boxes of wine is pretty heavy for a woman to carry, so the cashier asked me do I need borrow a cart to help me carry it. By the way, she refused to borrow me the cart and gave me a stink face. As a result, I have to carry back two heavy boxes of wine myself. Her awful service and attitude shows no respect towards me and had made me not wanting to ever come back again. Honestly, their service is terrible, extremely terrible!!

This was the only bar we passed in downtown Boise that had a PLATOON of jacked-up security guards. 
Immediately wondered what the deal was. 
Dirty Little Roddy's is a delightful jackbag dive bar. 
Mechanical bull? YES.
Stripper pole? YES.
Giant fridge full of Bud products? YES!
Many bottles of Fireball on-display? YES!
Convinced all of my co-workers and travel companions to ride the Mechanical Bull. That alone made a 2-week trip worth the while.
Dirty Little Roddy's is the seediest bar in downtown Boise but it has a ton of heart and soul. 
Highly recommended.

I'm being very nice giving even 2 stars. I have been coming here for bento lunch togo for about 4 years now. I thought it would be a good idea to eat here for AYCE. I ordered 4 orders of nigiri and 3 rolls. The rolls came first which I thought was weird because nigiri usually doesn't take that long. I just waited 41 mins for all of my nigiri. Ridiculous. It's not even that busy in here. Goodness. First Ijji went to poop and I have been in search of a new AYCE place. Ohana Sushi is my next place to try. Fingers crossed. Btw, 2 servers on a Saturday?! DO BETTER!!

The food here is usually spot on. Our main order for our house is combo fried rice. A few times they do not give enough shrimp or steak and it's mostly chicken. They have a rule that when they are too busy inside they can't take to go orders..yet you can come in and order and then pack up your food when it arrives. They must lose out on a lot of money this way. When we do pick up orders they are not all that friendly. Never seen any of the employees smile when I go in. Still, it's the closest for sushi rolls and real affordable prices that my sister loves.

Love love love this place!!! Lots of flavors to choose from. Today I had one that tasted just like banana pudding!! I love that they are so many options. My kids love this place as well! 

Today was the first time I've noticed "the kitchen sink" flavor. It's only $1 and it's basically whatever flavors they have left they throw together. It was perfect for my 2 year old toddler. It was going to melt faster than he could eat it so it's perfect!!! 

Great place to stop in for a quick treat on a hot summer day!!

Came here based on the reviews. I feel mislead. Ordered the Elvis sundae. Crushed up 'nilla wafers on the bottom, two scoops of ice cream (I opted for Nutter Fudger and Banana Pudding), peanut butter sauce, and bacon brittle.  Damn that sounds amazing huh?!  What was served was not a sundae. It was two scoops of ice cream, a drizzle of PB sauce, a wafer (if that), and bacon little...I mean brittle...I wish I had taken a photo...the pittance of accoutrements was a let down.  The ice cream was great, though...but holy cow guys come onnnn, throw some toppings on your sundae...but I repeat, the ice cream was very good.

I'm pretty neutral on this place. Environment feels a little awkward and decor is very feminine. 

Beer selection is pretty weak, especially compared to the other options in the area. My wife and I had a couple sandwiches. You could tell they put a lot of thought and effort into making them something original. They were fine, but nothing to get crazy about.

My main complaint here was the sides. They brought us plain old, straight of of the bag Ruffles (or Wavy Lays?). For the steep prices our meals were, it was pretty disappointing. 

Probably won't be back.

Went here for a casual lunch with my partner. Absolutely beautiful view of the golf course and ocean. It is so lovely you'll want to stay to bask in the sunlight. 
The food is classic and fairly tasty. Nothing too special with the food. We got the Ellwood sandwich and a side salad which tasted like a classic turkey melt with leafy greens and the Tuna Wrap with mango coleslaw which was a blandish tuna wrap with pepperoncini slices and a basic coleslaw with slices of unripe mango. 

3 stars for the food. 5 for the view. 4 overall, Sandpiper. If I'm looking for a solid view, I'll come back to see you!

I like this place, although every time I'm here for lunch or dinner, I am the youngest non-employee in the place and I am not a young man.

Great fried mushroom appetizer. 
Really good stir fry.
I've spent a couple hundred dollars here and have never had a complaint.

This time, since they sent me a $17 coupon for my birthday, I went with the Steak Diane.

4 medallions of filet mignon, cooked to med rare as requested, slathered in a wine brown sauce with plenty of shrooms. 

Give it a try, just because it's on 65th St. doesn't mean you have to be that old to walk in.

Everything I have ever had here knocks it out of the park. Delicious. My boyfriend and I come here every time I am in the Tampa area. Always for happy hour. 4-7 pm every day they have $3 martinis in like 13 flavors. Our favorites are the blue lightning lemon martini and the espresso martini, they sling em fast and make sure you're never empty. Also during happy hour all entrees and pastas are 50% off so I usually get the filet mignon for a bomb deal of $15. The corn purée served with the filet is one of a kind and my favorite part. Don't forget to ask for some fresh baked herb focaccia before your meal!

My husband is a Papa John's lover and always requests it. He usually gets the Works pizza which has a little of everything on it. I must say that the pizza and service is consistent and we have never had any issues.  On this particular occasion I did a pick up order instead of delivery and had the chance to take a look at the actual store. It was clean and organized, with smiling faces behind the counter. I always pictured my pizza coming from a place like  this. I know we will be ordering from them again soon and I look forward to the experience.

First time here. 

Visiting my friend in NJ and decided to visit for dinner and realizing the other restaurants had crazy wait times. I realize now why this place didn't have a long wait time: bland food and poor service. We were one of 3 other small families inside but still received pretty terrible service which included very long wait times and several things being missing from our order.

The drinks were ok but once I asked for the margarita with no ice it was served in a martini glass lol. What a rip off. Probably wouldn't return on my next visit to NJ.

This has the best pizza in the whole area in my opinion. it's the only place where they're able keep the pizza crispy when you take-out too which apparently is very hard to do. You can taste it's freshness. I have never had any of they're entrees but i would imagine that just as much care is put into them as their pizza. My only complaint is that on some busy weekend nights they close down the pizza oven because it's to inconvenient to go to that part of the kitchen? It's a shame when that does happen because there is no pizza place quite like this. Still my favorite.

This was the 2nd filthiest hotel room I've ever stayed in. Definitely the dirtiest room I've seen under the Hyatt flag. Will spare you the gory details but it was clear that housekeeping either did not care or was legitimately visually impaired. The shower, the bed, trash left on furniture, counters clearly not even wiped down. Sheets did not fit the bed. Several employees & guests not wearing masks. The room was pre-Covid disgusting and post-Covid dangerous. Not what we expect from a national brand. Absolutely disgusting. The 1 Star is for the view of the Arch.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Getting the car and dropping the car off is not an issue: great and fast check-in and check-out. I have been renting from National in the past couple of years, almost weekly ... and everything has been good as long you do not run into issues. I forgot a bag with some presents in the trunk of my vehicle and I realized that after I boarded the plane. I call the CS several times, I reached the national CS ... but nobody was able to help me in finding these items. Nobody seem to care even to call me back ... somebody did only after several emails and calls!

When we used to live on the west side of Tower Grove Park, this was my spot! I still go somewhat regularly to wash our vehicles, but typically opt for the self service wash. It is super affordable and the equipment is regularly maintained. 

The clutch time to go is early in the morning or late at night. If the sun is out in the afternoon, this place is packed. Hopefully, with The Blue Iguana and Waterway Express opening on South Kingshighway won't take too much business from them, but also will alleviate some of the heavy traffic.

It's ok to come here on a weekday, but don't come on a weekend.  My visit today...placed my order for here, but my food came in a bag, so I had to ask for a tray.  The ketchup in the lobby dispenser was orange.  I asked for packets at the counter.  My Big Mac was great, but the fries were a little over done and the bottom of my filet o fish bun was hard (stale).  Restaurant is clean though.  I stop by here on my way to work on weekdays and it's good for breakfast, but they definitely need to do a little better in other areas.  -Former McDonald's employee
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very convenient and easy to check in.  We were on the 5th floor with a view of part of the airport only mildly noisy but the walls are thin and the folks next door were so noisy between the tv and the moving around.  So annoying.  But the room was nice and bed comfortable.  We did watch some tv and had issues with some of the shows, just spun in place and had to restart it to get it to play again.  We checked out the pool, easy yo just walk out there and enjoy but didn't bring a towel so had to head to the room for one there.  Loved that it was right there at the airport so very likely to stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Will never go back. Tried it for the first time two weeks ago. Ordered a calzone that cost $8 and it was laughable. The manager said, "the cooks must not have made this before." I was given a gift card to try again. We ordered last night and was once again very disappointed. Ordered 15 wings and a "specialty pizza." It cost $30 and the pizza literally looked like a Totinos from Kroger. Pretty much every other pizza place I've been to is better. I hate to be negative, but I just don't understand why people go here and pay so much for such bad pizza.

This one is tough....  Their food is really good.  My Italian Mom highly approves and was delighted by the quality (she is an amazing cook and also, teacher of culinary arts)  However, small portions+ big prices doesn't work for our  big family.  If we have to order my boys Wawa after dinner, then not worth it.  Too bad, cause it is just a few blocks away, it is pretty and in a neighborhood void of good eating spots.   I'm ok with higher prices at a BYOB, but it better come with enough food for take home boxes.

I just tried this place about a week ago, and it was nothing short of delicious! We came in and were seated right away. Once we sat down, the server came right over to take our drink orders. She returned promptly, to take our orders. Within 15 minutes of sitting down, we had our meals on the table and they were exactly what we wanted. Server came over a few times periodically to check in and everything was amazing! Prices are good too for the quality of food! Would definitely go back again and again. Planning on another meal there very soon!

I've been coming to this location for about 20 years. I enjoy the thrill of choosing your own flavor especially now with the kids. But now this location has unfortunately gone downhill. The workers are normally unpleasant or unhelpful when we are there. I purchased an ice cream cake for my daughter's birthday and although the cake looks beautiful and I'm sure will be delicious, almost $30 to serve 6-8 is pretty steep. I know that they can't do anything about the prices since it's a chain but I definitely had sticker shock!

I bought a deal from dealfind with this spa. 

The exterior of the building leaves something to be desired, but as it is part of a larger complex I doubt this is the fault of the spa owner. When you walk into the spa it is very easy to forget the location. The interior is very lovely, beautiful floors and great colours on the walls.

The deal I bought is for several treatments. And I have no issue booking appointments, the service is good. Overall experience is really nice. 

I have had to cancel several appointment due to unforeseen circumstances and they have been really reasonable to deal with. 

I highly recommend this spa.

Publix is about as good as it gets for chain stores. Excellent policies and cleanliness is no doubt about the highest of standards I've seen.  The service is guaranteed to be the best; and if you complain, they will make it better! 
The employees are mostly part-time, and work VERY hard to please the customer. 
The profit margin is pennies on the dollar, but they make many dollars through good service. 

Fresh foods are the best available, and the management is good.  
Founder George Jenkins (friend of Walt Disney) was brilliant, and his spirit lives on.

The decore is amazing.  I wish I could say the same for the rest but I can't.  The by the glass wine selection (at the time), was limited be odd for a wine bar.  The food was just ok nothing great and the pizzas were horrible. We asked for a bottle of Champagne & had to wait for it to chill?!? I asked the "sommelier" (guy looked too young to be one) about the limited selection & all wines being from CA, he told me that they needed customers to spend more so they could get more inventory and options. WTF?!? I might give them another chance but I hope they turn it around

NOPE! This hotel was booked to full capacity on 8/8, there was no social distancing. I could hear the neighbors in room 204. Continental breakfast is lean due to COVID-19. I checked in at 2045, there is no airport shuttle available due to the pandemic. Gotta get a taxi or ride share from the airport. 

The hotel is dated as well as the room. I did not see any USB outlets anywhere, toilet seat was loose and the TV remote needs to be replaced. The room is basically a time capsule from the '80's. 

The bathroom amenities were not for one time use. No one should have to use a giant pump bottle to get shampoo, body wash & conditioner.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: HORRIBLE. My Hot and Sour Soup was more like, 'Hot Chili Oil w/ Tofu'. No flavor. Nothing in it but stale bamboo shoots, tofu, and mystery meat. I don't know where these other people ate, but THIS place is gross. Seriously. The service was matter of factly, and I had to PAY for hot tea....I was surprised that I didn't have to pay for the fortune cookies also! The Wor Won Ton was DISGUSTING. The prawns in it [one of it's THREE ingredients] had ICK floating in the broth, they were mushy and very nasty. DO NOT GO HERE. My mom had a bad case of diarrhea as soon as we got home from this place. BEWARE.

I really want to like this place but I can't. The few times I've been there, the donuts are never warm and the frosting crumbles off. I got the chocolate old fashion, strawberry cake, glazed holes and a few others and all the frosting tasted old. I don't have a microwave at work, so I was pretty bummed when they were hard and cold. The drink selection is pretty limited, too. The girls are really sweet and I'll probably go back if i'm in a crunch, I just hope they fix their frosting and keep em fresh. It's such a convenient location for alot of us, hopefully it gets better so I can give em more stars.

Places like this are trying to do something that isn't easy. It's hard to cook global food, from different cultures, with a high quality across the board. I had some incredible pho from a Vietnamese restaurant earlier in the week, and because I had such a great experience I figured I'd go with pho again.

Bad decision. It was really bad. Everything from the noodles to the beef and everything in between was just lacking. It didn't taste anything like what I experienced from an authentic Vietnamese place. I sent it back, and thankfully the server removed it from the bill. 

The Mac and cheese was pretty good though.

OH. MY. GAWD. 
The pistachio Macaron is too good. 
I can't even explain. Need to get a pint to take home. I demand that you do the same.
Also had the wild berry lavender which is pretty good even though I don't like lavender in my food all that much.
And the sugar plum was fkn crazy good too.
Jeni's is and will forever be one of the best places to get ice cream no matter what state you live in.
Great ingredients too, if you ever see them at Publix or Whole Foods/ sprouts, it's relatively clean ice cream. Go here and be amazed

I went with my lovely Mama to the new version of Vivace. We had a little trouble with the hostess seating us even though we were early and had reservations but we finally had that sorted out. We are huge fans of the St Phillips, Scordatos and had parallel hopes for this restaurant. They have updated the interior very very nicely. For some reason this place and its old incarnation and it's new caters to the older crowd. This was still the case.

I had the eggplant and have to say I was thrilled. It was really great. Light and wonderful. I really loved the meal. Other than the hostess bauble
It was great.

We stayed in the hotel, the Blake so we ended up eating here quite often and were never disappointed! We had dinner one night that was delicious, especially the French onion soup! We also ate breakfast/brunch here each morning and were really impressed with the food. I had biscuits and gravy every morning and they are delicious! We loved the staff; they treated us really well and were very friendly. They also have a good variety of speciality cocktails and beer that we enjoyed before going out on the town. Thanks for the yummy food and enjoyable time!

I think they're actually are three of these bars scattered across Bourbon Street. I know they'll hit each one of them over the course of the night but these places are awesome you can get your drinks in and out and a couple minutes and they also have bathrooms in the back that you can use that are not overcrowded. The drinks they serve here are really strong but Go Down Smooth. My favorite is the hand grenades which will set you back $10 and they also have a skinny version which taste almost exactly like the original so if you want to save a few calories it's a safe choice. Make this place a must-stop if your in The Big Easy.

My sister, a very good friend of ours and myself recently had a bad experience at another establishment. The job they did on our nails was awful. It took quite some time to fix the mistakes, but they did it. Our nails look beautiful, they took their time, fixed all the mistakes, gave us free water, they have free WiFi, and naturally relaxing environment. My sister and I will be returning in 2 weeks and highly recommend this place. They have massage chairs for getting pedicures that work amazingly well. They have full-body waxing and they even turned on the football game for us!!!!! Check them out they're awesome and well priced.

Hipster hotel conveniently located in the CBD on Baronne, within walking distance of the French Quarter and lots of restaurants and tourist attractions. Owned my Marriott, I was able to use points to stay here. The rooms are comfortably appointed. Our corner room was huge and had great views of the city. Found the hotel staff to be friendly. The bar staff not as much. Can't vote on food as the restaurant was never open while we were there. There is a charge for breakfast. A banana and bottle of water will cost you $5. The rooftop pool is teeny tiny. 3 feet all around. And little sun as it's surrounded by tall buildings.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Super cool spot in West Nash. The dude behind the counter was extremely knowledgeable and took care to engage the customer in front of me when he inquired about their coffee beans. His answer demonstrated huge grasp of their products as well as their approach to roasting (points for that). When I inquired about their cold brew he had a pretty exact decimal figure that represented the amount of caffeine in their cold brew (points for that). The dude was super chill. Based on his knowledge of coffee alone, I would've pegged him as a pretentious barista type (points for not acting like you're from Portland).

I have been to M Bistro for Reveillon for the past 3 years. The first time it was GREAT. Last year it was okay, but I thought maybe I caught them on an off night. This time the food was absolutely dreadful. We're talking 2 people and 4 courses at $80 each. That's 8 different items and each of them were disappointing and lackluster. E-I-G-H-T. The atmosphere is the only reason I graced this review with two stars instead of one.

If you want to stop by Davenport Lounge for a cocktail, I would say go for it, but stay the heck away from M Bistro.

The server was very friendly but the food arrived separately. Kinda pricey. The miso salmon tasted fishy but the teriyaki salmon was delicious. We liked the Queens prawn but it had hardly any asparagus, although lots of extra yummy veggies.  The sushi was rather bland and had very lttle ginger.  I didn't get any tea refill nor was I asked, but to be fair it was Christmas Eve and there seemed to be very little staff.  Probabaly won't go back.  We have three excellent Japanese resturants in Columbus and one pretty decent fusion place as well.

We were at the tchoup yard when it was close to closing time, and a worker told  us the bar was closing soon. We walked straight to one of the bars, and when we went to order, the bar  tender said that they were closed 20 minutes ago. They didn't close for another 30 minutes, but said that they said last call 20 minutes ago. I've never heard a NOLA bar say last call was an hour before the closing. Then a person working there came to our people and said that the place is closing soon so we should leave. How rude! 

I gave a 3 stars because the yard is awesome and the frozé is delicious!

There isn't much to say in the market of a McDonald's review. It's not that it's known for anything too special - there are the standards: egg mcmuffin, fries, etc. etc. etc. 

I had a midnight craving the other day: you know the type. You drink copious amounts of coffee, chew some gum, and hope the craving will go away. Well here's the thing: it didn't. No matter how much gum I chewed, I needed a McFlurry.

So I ordered one: portion size? Great. Delivery time? Great. Taste? WAYYYYYY too sweet. In fact, I couldn't even taste the Oreo in my McFlurry- that's how saccharin this was. 

I won't be ordering again, for obvious reasons.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: When I first got my cat I took her here, and they seemed very nice. My cat stopped eating, and when I took her to get checked out the vet made me feel terrible about not being able to afford a $1000 overnight stay at an emergency clinic or another very expensive option. He made it sound as though I didn't want to spend the money when it was very obvious I'm a student who can't afford that high of a bill. If I had the money I would have spent it in an instant. They wouldn't even allow me to do a payment plan when I asked. Any vet that views your pet as a bank is a vet that doesn't care about you, and even less about your pet.

I have to give this place 2 stars, because the rooms are nice and clean. The staff is very friendly. Here's my complaint: They advertise that their pool area has a hot tub. The description calls it a spa tub. It's neither. It's basically an extension of the pool and the water is cold. The ONLY reason we chose this hotel is because we wanted to relax in the hot tub. Now, we've wasted our money, because they don't have one. So, don't pay attention to what the website says. Apparently, a huge hotel chain can't afford a quality internet marketing team.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I've been wanting to try St. Louis style pizza for a while now and it's actually not bad. I called it in and it was ready within 15 minutes. The guys were here were very professional and kind. 

It's a thin crust pizza that's cut in squares, similar to Chicago style tavern pizza. Yes Chicago has two pizzas styles...not just deep dish. I ordered a large with sausage. It had a decent amount of sausage and covered in cheese. Provel cheese to be exact. It does have a much different taste than Mozzarella, but it was still very tasty. I wouldn't mind returning to Imos when ever I'm in a time crunch and need a quick bite on the go.

This place was really delicious,  spicy, & authentic. We tried the chorizo & steak huaraches & the al pastor huaraches,  both of which were bursting with flavor and heat! Their salsa is no joke. Their menu is expansive and fairly priced. The ambiance is pretty divey and we never got the appetizer we ordered (but it wasn't on the bill and the meal filled us up -in fact It was so large i got 2 meals out of it- so no hard feelings) so we will probably choose take-out next time. Overall the portions are large, prices are cheap, and food is delicious!

Came out for boston pizza's 50th anniversary. They had a special on for all their individual pizzas for $5. This is quite a good deal as normally these pizzas are $12 or more. 

The free parking they have outside is great especially downtown. The service that we had however was not that great. We came into the lounge early with no one else in the restaurant and still had to wait 10 minutes before anyone came to the table. 

The pizzas that we got were good. But I think they are worth closer to the $5 instead of the $12 on the regular menu.

The staff gets 5 stars from me, but the consistently slow drive thru takes away the perfect rating. The inside is rather small, the parking lot is kind of confusing, and the drive thru lines are so long. It's not the employees fault that the drive thru takes so long, it's mainly due to the amount of people coming off of I-65 mixed with a terribly designed parking lot shared with Einstein Bagel.

I've always had pleasant experiences with the staff and their outdoor seating has lots of options. If you're looking to hang out or get some work done, I'd probably suggest somewhere else because it's usually slammed in there.

Firstly I will say that this was my first and last time eating here at Grand Hacienda. The first thing I noticed were the prices were a bit high, but was okay if the food was of quality. Our drinks took a while to come out and again for the price, not worth it. I tried the combo fajitas. I got 2 slivers of chicken and very chewy steak and all of it tasted charred and very bitter. The only edible thing was chips and salsa, which they took away when our food came out. No desire to go back. Much better Mexican food in St Pete.

Three hour meal, anyone? Our group of 12+ (with a reservation) waited so long for the most expensive meal. The food was fine but overall the experience was not worth any of it. Staff never came out to explain the wait and when asked just shared food would come out soon. When food did come out everything was extremely sporadic and some items forgotten. No meals or beverages were comped and several members of our group, all persons working in the foodservice industry, had to be talked into staying for the meal because they were ready to leave. Will not return.

The hotel was nice enough, but the rooms needed a little work (cracks in walls, etc.). Unfortunately what could have been a nice view was me looking at mechanical equipment - even though all 3 rooms in our group were booked at the same time (they were on high floors). 

While they were prepared to help shore bags once I checked out, they did seem surprised. All in all it was fine.

Hotel bar and restaurant was frequently busy and the staff was very nice. Food was good (via room service and in bar area) but not seasoned well - too salty & acidic tomato basil soup, beet crab cakes, etc.

Hotel is conveniently located next to convention center.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I booked this room through Expedia, it was about $85 with insurance and I'd never stay here again.

The hotel is run down, the room was small and it smelled like mold and smoke. The carpeting in the hallway was dirty. The king size bed was an old, soft  mattress and the four pillows on the bed were small, soft square pillows that were maybe 18 × 18 inches.

There was noise through out the night, people talking, doors slamming and doors being knocked on.

It wasn't worth my time complaining, but you do get what you pay for.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This is one of my go-to all you can eat sushi spots. I usually make a reservation, especially if it's a weekend dinner time. When I do make a reservation though, we sometimes end up waiting 15-20+ minutes to be seated after the reservation time.
The food is great, but the service is a little slow. They have forgotten to include items that we ordered multiple times in the past, and we've had to ask them to bring over the remaining items.
Despite these issues, it's great bang for your buck and great quality food, so I will probably keep coming back.

I was looking for a cute coffee shop to come by and meet a friend on the weekend, and this ended up being a nice spot. The seating area is SUPER small (like 3-4 tables), and it just so happened that I got there early enough to get a spot. However, the tables were pretty close together, so if you're looking for a quiet spot, this is probably not it.

The drinks we ordered were both good, a hot chocolate and one of their seasonal chais. They are a little pricey for what they are, but it's a nice atmosphere to sit and have drinks in. I would probably come here again!

This place is okay. I've made several appointments for the first slot that they are open, and I've had to wait outside for 10-15 minutes because there was no staff there yet and the store was locked. There have been several times where it seems they either overbooked or confused scheduling in some way. Their services are a little expensive for what they are. I had one great experience with one of the women there (can't remember her name), and one "meh" experience with someone else. I like this location for its convenience, but it is honestly too expensive for the disorganization and issues that I've had.

We went here on the day of its grand opening and one time a week after. Its directly next to Bookmans so a collaboration between the two would be a fantastic idea. Maybe spend $20 at Bookman's get a free coffee at Crema or make a small library inside of Crema because the place is brand new and doesn't have any decor. 

We really believe the price of the beverages is great. If they add more food options along with music, board games, maybe a stage for open mic, spice it up a bit it will be a great addition for that side of town. 

I'm really looking forward to seeing this place grow.

This place has great potential to be amazing.. unfortunately it's not. I arrived at the drive through around 10pm and an employee gets on the speaker and says "we're closed and not taking any orders" something I've heard plenty of times before at random hours. Then as I'm about to drive off someone else gets on and says what would you like. When I asked if their open or not due to the previous employee I was met with so much attitude and rudeness. I know this isn't the owner or the company but employees that ruin things making customers stay away.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place is amazing!!! I received an ad in the mail yesterday so I wanted to check it out as today was their grand opening. The employees there were very knowledgeable and attentive. I received the assistance that I needed. Total Wine has probably everything you would need for an awesome party! They have all the liquor, beer, wine you could possibly imagine, local and non-local. They even sell snacks and an area for tastings! I probably walked thru the entire store twice. There were so many items I've never seen in your typical liquor store so of course I had to grab a few different bottles of wine, moonshine, and whiskey for the house.

On the plus side, this is a big facility with a layout that is well designed.  On the negative side, we walked in this morning with two staff members at the desk who could not be bothered with a hello or good morning.  The equipment is so old that the buttons on the bikes aren't even visible any more.  Only 2 recumbent bikes downstairs and the upstairs bikes are really old and in poor shape.  It's better to get in a workout than not so we will still be grateful that 24 hour has a facility in Northwest RENO but wish they made the investment in some upgraded equipment.  It's pretty out dated.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Decided to visit this new restaurant in Kenneth City. While waiting for our food I decided to open a Yelp page for them. It took a little while to get food because they were fixing a large to go order. Hubby got 3 tacos and said they were delicious. I do not eat meat or dairy so ordered some black beans and rice along with a tostada with black beans, veggies and no cheese. The beans were delicious but runny and blended. So next time I will request a mixture of rice and beans rather than just beans. We shall return, it's nice to have another spot here in Kenneth City. I do hope they get a better understanding of no meat and no dairy.

Fun new spot in a location that needs good food and drink options! Located right by U Indy, Jailbird has delicious unpretentious food and cheap drinks. 

My crew tried the PBJ which sounded weird (arugula? pickles?!) but was delicious. Pro tip: add bacon. We also got a chili dog and onion rings and curly fries. The curly fries and slightly spicy southside sauce were a hit.

Service was friendly and straightforward. And where can you get good food and drinks for less than $20/person?! Check it out, well worth the trip to the south side.

I don't know how I've lived in St. Pete my entire life and only ever came here for the first time a few months ago. This ice cream SLAPS OK! They have such a large variety of flavors you're bound to find something you like. The prices are on the more expensive side, but trust me it's worth it. Plus, the flavors are so rich that this isn't something you want to be eating every day anyways. They say their ice cream is homemade and you can literally taste it. Ugh I want some right now! 

NOTE: This place is cash only so FYI.

Last week I was planning to take advantage of the 12 munchkins for $2 deal and ordered 3 munchkins of the following flavors: glazed, blueberry, pumpkin spice and apple cider. After paying and a short wait, I was really disappointed to find I only had 9 munchkins in the bag. This was particularly upsetting because I had recently had a decent experience at this location after they offered a replacement beverage after previously leaving a similar complaint about an ordered prepared incorrectly on the last survey I completed on their review site. As much as I love Dunkin, not sure I can promise I'll be back.

Been here a couple times now and recently brought some friends from out of state. They were craving a taco truck, but it was almost 2am on sat and for some reason no trucks were to be found in there usual spots. Fell back to this place as they have never disappointed. Ordered everything from chicken, carne asada, to veggie tacos and quesadillas to nachos and as always nothing was bad. However that being said they do run out of meats late at night for obvious reasons I'm sure. They have plenty of seating in their own building on prater and plenty of parking.  Next time I go I'll be sure to snap some shots. Until then enjoy...

This place is intimate, cozy, and cute. We went during restaurant week. We tried the arancini, meatballs, bronzino, and the braised short rib. We also wanted to try a pasta so we ordered the gnocchi. I would say that everything was a good portion size and the flavors were amazing. The only thing I have to say is that the food was just warm not hot. I would've liked to see some steam when I cut into the meatballs, but that's just my preference. I would say my favorite dishes would've been the braised short rib and the gnocchi.

This is an old warehouse made over into hotel and I love that, service great, their stored our bags for us on our last day and the only bad thing was my sons little camera taken from his bag but the storage area is not secure so don't leave anything valuable in your bags.
Breakfast adequate.
Room on the small side but clean and comfortable bed and pillows which is all I ask for.
Location is great for convention center but a little far to the streetcar stop at Julia/river walk line.  Next time I would stay closer to a streetcar stop.
Overall great value
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: So decide to come here for Easter brunch. Call a few days before so they don't take reservations I was going to be there before noon they said it should not be a problem. We showed up table for six was told an hour wait which ended up being two hours. Food was mostly cold and mediocre scrambled eggs were unedible. The whole experience took us almost 3 hours, blah.  To top it off it was $20 per person, no way worth it!  We all decided we would not be back.  No photos because it's a buffet, a bunch of food thrown on a plate nothing to look at.

Really nice staff, Cute atmosphere but really lacking in the kitchen. I didn't try any of the cocktails but they looked awesome. 
I'm a Big foodie. They didn't have home made salsa, or any salsa in the fact. The Steak taco was super fatty, the blossom pumpkin quesadilla sounded so good, but turned out to be a kids cheese quesadilla. 
The shrimp tempura taco was good but they need to peel and waste the shrimp better, didnt like spitting out shell.
The only hot sauce they had was Tabasco, which I was thankful for because the food was pretty bland. 
Maybe I ordered wrong, I'm will to give it another try.

Pre-covid, I had no complaints. They have my favorite ice cream. However, during the pandemic, their service has been concerning. There's about 5 girls stuffed in this tiny room. While all of them have masks, they don't wear them correctly. Their masks are either not the right size or are worn under their noses. ALSO they don't require customers to wear masks. It's a very popular spot that gets packed quickly and almost none of the customers wear masks. It's a safety hazard. Won't be going here again for a while.

I'll start by saying that it's cool this hotel use to be a court house, and the service was good. There is a espresso machine in the rooms, and I love internet tv in hotel rooms...

But the beds are terrible and the pillows are even worse! The rooms seem a little warehouse feel but being this was a old courthouse I don't think the rooms are that bad.  Do I think it's a 4 star... NO, if they step there sleep comfort game up to better beds and better pillows, don't have the art in the room look like it was hung at Costco's then it could easily be 4 star!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
INCREDIBLE deep dish pizza! Cornmeal dough was perfectly cooked, pizza looked and smelled good, and YES I'll be back!

I got the larger pizza and muscled through half of it. Are the other half over the next two days. (Reheated well, btw.) I did the make your own with meatballs, mushrooms, and fresh basil. To their credit, when I picked up the pizza to go, they had the basil in a small container on the side, which allowed me to put it on when I was ready to eat it. Good move.

This place isn't a secret, so you might consider ordering ahead. Not even a block away from the convention center.

Let me give you a play by play of my experience today Drive through at 8:39am 
At the menu/speaker at 8:44am
Order taken at 8:45am (not total given at this time, bare in mind, I get the same order every single time, this is important later)
FINALLY pull up to the window at 8:50am
Total: 3.01
Why is it that my total is different for the same order every other day?
I'm genuinely confused.
I've paid $4.01 $3.25 $3.75 etc 

I will say today has been one of the quicker times I've gotten my coffee. I've waited 20min before. This is the most inconsistent Dunkin I've ever gone to. 

They need to get it the heck together.

Disgusting place. Should be shut down. Unsanitary and stinks of urine. Was scared the moment I walked in and the old woman at the desk was coughing open mouthed all over my paperwork. Didnt tell me about a 5 dollar walk in fee over the phone and because I told them I wasn't aware the old bag said she upped my fee to 40 because she FELT I wasnt being appreciative enough. That is ILLEGAL. I walked out and didnt have those Scumbags touch my baby. Glad I did. If you love your furbaby DO NOT TAKE THEM HERE!! 
DISGUSTING PEOPLE PROBABLY LIVE IN A TENT OUT BACK
Trash should not be allowed to practice medicine on a bug much less your loved ones.

Staybridge Suites Hotel are a great value. 
I have never been disappointed at any location. All employees great you with a smile. 
My recent stay was at the New Orleans Location. 
The city experienced a water outage. So no water in the hotel. The hotel made a decision to not charge hotel guests for the stay while water was off.  Can you imagine the money involved in not charging for any rooms?  They even had a service coming  to room with buckets of water to flush the toilet's. 
I will share my story over & over. This goodwill shown by the hotel will surly make up by lack of revenue for one night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: for being so close to the water, goleta somehow has a sad sushi scene. sushi ai is a small sushi restaurant in the goleta marketplace and their food is pretty average. you order at the counter and then a server brings your food to a table. i've been here a couple of times for their handroll special and its pretty good for the price but i would not go here and pay full price for this food. the service isn't great here either; the workers will stand around and socialize with each other before they take your order

My husband and I stayed here overnight on UCSB graduation weekend. We had made our reservations well in advanced. Upon room selection, we requested far away from the elevators and ice machine. We arrived Saturday afternoon, service was excellent. When we arrived at our room, it was a perfect spot as requested. The room was big with microwave, coffee maker, and refrigerator. The bathroom along with the room was clean. We also took advantage of the hot tub/pool. Next morning we had a complimentary breakfast which was perfect.

Service excellent, rooms and bathrooms clean along with a decent breakfast.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This will be a strange review. I do not use this vet for my dog's care, but I needed a city tag and they sell them. Rather than going to the city where they are sold I contacted Vista Animal Hospital and they made sure I got my tag. The person who answered the phone was personable, knowledgeable and efficient. They also practiced social distancing as I waited in my car as they brought my tag out for me. I paid over the phone. My vet is less than .5 miles from me, but it they were further away I would consider using Vista Animal Hospital for my vet.

Sally the owner is my long time friend.I admire her, and her kindness . She is the real deal. This is a charming little old fashioned Chinese place. It's homey. Most of the food is good. Except for the sweet and sour pork at this place.No matter when I forget it and get it, it is like pork rocks. This time it was carry out due to the virus. Stupid me for ordering it . I just thought by now it would be ok. So Sally dear , please do something about this. I know all your customers will be glad.This has gone on too too long.I know that you care.Other wise your food is really good.Thanks for years of kindness.

I always get weary of airport coffee shops. Mostly because they are trying to do everything quickly because the lines are always so long and the people are impatient. I definitely needed some coffee because I chose not to get any at the previous airport as I don't like having to use the bathroom mid-flight. I remember walking right out of the gate and seeing this Dunkin' like it was fate. The line wasn't too bad but the employees made it go quickly. I got a normal latte and it tasted just like always. Thank goodness. I also got a bagel and snacked while we waited for our next flight to depart. Overall, not a bad airport Dunkin'.

STAY AWAY!! I have a car loan through this credit union & let me tell you that they are the worst! Their customer service is pathetic at best. Don't hold your breath waiting for someone to get back to you if you have any questions or concerns about payments or anything else. Their website never works to made a payment & they don't accept online immediate payments through your bank. 

GARY GILES is the most ignorant, incompetent and unprofessional person I've ever dealt with. I'm still waiting for an email or call back from him from 2 months ago!

I was visiting from out of town and I stopped by this location to get in a quick workout.  This is an amazing place!  The owner was there and she was very welcoming and professional.  The equipment is kept in tiptop condition.  The entire place is clean and well-kept.  The temperature was just right and there were plenty of cleaning supplies available to wipe down the equipment.  There was an entire area with Rigs for pull ups and TRX.  There were med balls and boxes for jumping. I wish that I lived closer to this location because I would be here every day!  Thank you anytime fitness for a great visit.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
My experience at Motel 6 was absolutely awful. When I called to check on pricing I was hung up on and during my stay, the money I paid was not fair for the conditions of the rooms.
