My room smelled and has terrible shower pressure and the bath towels are WAY to small. The TV was cutting in and out of connection. There is NO free WiFi you have to pay like $3 a day for the wifi.
 I will not stay here ever again when I come back to visit. I rather pay a bit more money to stay at the red roof in that's here in Tucson than stay in this dirty motel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The last few times I've visited have not been good. The actual fish content in the rolls have been decreasing while the grease level in the non-sushi items have been increasing. The fish is not fresh at all and flavor is severely lacking in the rolls. The only positive comment I can make is about the customer service--it's been friendly and quick during every visit. However, it's the food we came for and unfortunately, it's no longer a reason to visit. 

I hope they can improve the quality of the food in the future.

I've been here twice with my boyfriend to get our sushi fix. First time was a good experience and we both got the AYCE menu. The second time we also got the AYCE but it wasn't as good of an experience as the first.

There are some fish that taste fresh and some that are meh, but hey, it's Tucson. Sake and Yamachi nigiri are my favorite. My BF recommends the shrimp tempura. Although fish quality can be improved and we didn't get all the items we ordered (even though we had small orders at a time), I still give 4 stars because the all you can eat is a great value.

One of my friends took me here and I'd already heard great things about it. I love the casual Tuscan style of this place - you would pretty much be able to dress up or down. I can't remember our waiter's name but he was attentive and knowledgeable. The owner and/or manager also visited our table but wasn't intrusive. My entree was delicious (Chicken Parmesan). It was a good-sized portion too and the prices were surprisingly modest. Unfortunately I didn't try anything else, not even a salad, but I expect to return very soon! This could easily become one of my favorite restaurants.

Use to be a great place...not so much anymore. Prices are good for breakfast but food is just not what it use to be. Last couple times it has been a let-down. The Tenderloin Benedict had virtually no flavor, meat was not cooked as ordered, Sunday Sampler had runny eggs with toast that was so hard could not eat. Waitress was nice. We told her we have been coming for years and things have been different lately and asked her to pass on...was same next time we went back. I think we might be done going unless we hear from some of our friends it is getting back to the great place it use to be.

Had to stop in and get the famous hand grenade everyone was talking about. It was $20 for 2 frozen hand grenades. I didn't even know what was in the drink as it wasn't listed anywhere. Due to covid the dining room was closed. But we were still able to walk up to the bar and order. The drink is interesting. It's a citrus flavor and has several types of alcohol in it. One of these is most definitely enough as it is quite sweet and sugary. The staff was working safely and reinforcing ppe with the customers and also themselves. If you're visiting NOLA definitely stop and grab one of these.

Stopped in on a Friday night to grab some dinner. The staff was friendly but there was one worker who wasn't wearing a mask and was talking to the person who was making our food. I found it odd that if we were walking around the restaurant we had to wear ours but he wasn't following the same standard. The rolls here are greatly priced. We ordered 5 rolls and 2 drinks and our total was $50. The fish wasn't the best fish I've ever had but it still tasted good. As we were eating the restaurant started to fill up more with local people so it made me feel better about their food standard. My favorite rolls were the spicy salmon and the salmon skin.

Food was absolutely delicious and fresh! We did the all you can eat sushi option which was $25 a person and it was absolutely so worth it! Even if you aren't a huge fan of sushi, it's still a fun experience! You definitely want to go with a group of people who are sushi lovers so you can try out all the wonderful/tasty options! There's a lot of appetizer and sushi options so you're honestly not limited with choices! My favorite was the Godzilla roll! Definitely going to be coming back. Also, with Covid, they are doing indoor seating and spaced out tables and it's pretty spacey.

It's really aight. I went with a group of 18 people for lunch, and that might be the reason why our service wasn't on top of its game but then they also could've had more than just one person serving us.. I was really excited to try their pasta since they make it in house, and the texture was PERFECT! I got short rib pasta, but the short rib was wayyyyy to salty. I'm not sure if anyone of us were satisfied with the taste of our food or the overall quality of service that we got. It definitely isn't budget friendly. Also it most likely won't satisfy your tastebuds.

Love the interior! It felt like I was in Japan. Was really excited to taste the food even before ordering. Maybe I expected too much. I was surprised that they didn't use sushi rice (vinegar, sugar, salt) to make their sushi. The fish on sushi was quite thin, not the way I prefer it to be. Pork cutlet was crispy and chunky. Perfect with curry. The curry had an addicting taste to it, little bits of meat inside. I also has sukiyaki, flavor was a little strong for my taste but very well prepared. Lots of meat and toppings. Large portion, other than sushi. Will be returning when I crave japanese food.

I go to Madison's at least once a week to catch a game.  I love this place!  I used to frequent Fig and Haley (aka Santa Barbara Brewing Company), but I heard they switched ownership which would explain Fig and Haley's completely inedible food.  Now, as for Madison's: the staff is friendly, the food is good (the waffle fries are a must), and the atmosphere is fun -- great place to watch sports if you're not a college kid and don't want to to Jagerbombs all day.  But if you want to sit back for a few hours to catch a game, a beer on tap, and some good food, this is your place!

Came to Ambrosia on a Friday night and I would definitely recommend getting reservations. The service was great and the food came out quickly. I got a cucumber salad and it was delicious and then the fettuccine Alfredo which was ok but definitely lacked seasoning and just didn't have a whole lot of flavor. Along with the bread though I was stuffed. One complaint with the actual restaurant though was that it was extremely warm. I actually got a bit of a headache because I got so warm by the end of the meal. Overall pretty good place in Broad Ripple.

Such a convenient restaurant near the airport and the Best Western Vista Hotel. I ordered the chicken fried steak with mashed potatoes and veggies and it was very good! Portions were a good size also. No leftovers and a good price. Hubby got meatloaf with mashed potatoes and it was very good but the gravy was a little bit too salty. Kids got taco salad and spicy chicken sandwich with bacon and they loved them both. It's not a 5 star restaurant but the food was quality for the price and the servers were prompt and very friendly.

I don't have enough words to express how much I appreciate Dr. Zeis and the entire staff at Watson Road Veterinary Clinic. My Yorkie (sister) Reese's went there regularly and they took such great care of her each time. My family had Reese's for almost 15 years. She recently crossed the rainbow bridge due to late stage of Renal Failure. It sucks this happened during COVID but the staff made this transition very comfortable. When Reese's passed away they sent us a card and her paw print through the mail. Dr. Zeis and staff, my family appreciates you.

I have been door dashing for the last 3 months and I'm Not one to be a Karen but this man right here is by far the rudest general manager I've ever encountered. I pull up to the drive thru to get my door dash order PER USUAL, every McDonalds order I pick up they ALWAYS let me get it from the drive thru , and his assistant manager told me it's " store policy " and asked if I wanted to talk to the manager so I said of course ... long story short when I pull up to the first window this man is already yelling at me telling me I'm holding up the line and threatening to call the cops. Very rude and angry man .
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I tried takeout here recently and the meal here was decent. I wouldn't say it's the best Japanese place in the city. It's a bit pricey here and the items on the menu is more westernized.  

For food I tried the assorted sashimi, spicy salmon maki, salmon don and the fantasy roll. The fish was fresh and thick. Presentation was pretty simplistic but the food was pretty good.

Overall it was an enjoyable meal. Service was friendly. I ordered in the restaurant and waited in the car for 30 minutes before picking up.

If I could give no stars I would. First off, the entire Morning team is just plain rude!  The one taking the orders at the drive tru whispers and when I asked her to repeat my order, she replied, I got it, drive up.  Second, is how to give change a dying art.  I have no idea how she managed to give me back 8.26? When I gave her 10.26.  Then there is my unsweetened ice tea which magically turned into a Coke. When I called them on it she told me I would have to come inside.  Never ever will I return to this location. Hardee's across the street has to be better. Custom
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Overall they do a great job. I admit that my car was a mess and they did a good job cleaning it. I did upgrade to the best cleaning and interior clean. So my bill was $50.00   My problem was the workers standing in the bay smoking. I did ask that a non smoker detail my interior. The manager acted like I was nuts for requesting a non smoker. I don't know that I will be back simply because all the smokers standing in the bay smoking. I suggested that the smokers stay out of sight but i doubt that anyone really cared what I thought.  Interestingly, they were several other customers who feel the same way.

Gave this one another try and they've been pretty good until today. Stale buns, wrong size whopper patti. Plus my credit card has been stolen 2xs . So I've been really watching what people do with my card. I noticed it takes forever for the one girl to give you back your card and she is writing something down . I can't accuse her because I'm not 100% sure but I'm suspicious of this Burger King because both times it has happened within a few days of using this Burger King, again can't prove it but it seems suspicious

Very seldom do I leave positive reviews. As bad as that sounds. However this Starbucks is my absolute favorite. It seems like I've always had issues with any other Starbucks. I've been getting coffee from them every day on my way to school and they're super awesome.  Their staff is really nice and go out of their way to make it feel like you're a valued customer. They've never gotten an order wrong. Not once. Bubbly smiling faces first thing in the morning before school definitely helps make my school day easier. Thank you !

We've been to New Orleans multiple times. This weekend we went for our anniversary. This was the first place we went and had a GREAT time. We made our rounds to all the other bars but we came back here, every day. Largely in part to RUSS. This guy literally made our trip a blast. We even went back on the way to the airport to say, bye. He is the definition of the word "asset" to a tourist based destination, like this. Whomever brought him onboard obviously knows what they're doing. RUSS, thank you, and we'll see you in 2019!

We have given this Dunkin a chance numerous times since they opened in hopes that there would be an improvement eventually. Every single time, they are out of products displayed on their menus. A splash of cream turns out to be more than half the cup and when asked to correct, half is poured out and filled with ice. When ordering cold brew, the majority of time we have gotten dark roast poured over ice. It's obvious because the ice is melted and the drink tastes like water. We are so disappointed with this location and will not be returning.

This is the only Starbucks near me so I'm forced to go to it in the mornings. I am not exaggerating when I say I've tried probably over 100 different locations of Starbucks because I travel for work, and this is by far the worst. This morning, I'm surrounded by 12 people waiting for their mobile orders to come through, and there are only 3 people working the entire store. I have no idea why the management would choose to have such few people working with such high demand. Also, my coffee is burnt every single time. I really wouldn't come here unless you absolutely HAVE to!

Crazy Sushi was great. The staff is very welcoming and attentive. The food was on point, from taste to appearance. The restaurant is clean and well kept. 

We got the tofu tempura, philly roll and avacado roll. The tempura was reallllly oily so Id stay away from it. But the rolls were really nicely cut and the plates were decorated so beautifully. The prices were decent for good sushi and pretty plates. 

The atmosphere was a little off for my personal taste - too quiet but still a great setting nonetheless. It's super tiny though, so big groups- stay away.

I don't usually go to nail salons but I wanted to do something special for my mother on mother's day. We went to the salon together and had a wonderful time. We both got pedicures. They provide amazing foot and calf massages along with a back massage while you wait for your nails to dry. The salon has a pleasant atmosphere, with lots of magazines to read and a big screen TV. The ladies were skilled at their craft and seemed to have quit a few loyal customers whom they know by name. My nails were so pretty and they lasted for three weeks!

Been to most of the Italian restaurants in Collingswood but never this one, finally decided to give it a go and was extremely disappointed. We had some iced tea with dinner and it tasted of coffee like it had been made in a coffee machine that desperately needed to be cleaned. We ordered the calamari which was bland and had no flavor. For dinner we got veal and porcini fettuccini. Both came out luke warm and some items on the plate were cold and clearly pre-made then scooped onto the plate. Pasta was undercooked. Service was just ok, if it were not for the dim comfortable ambiance it would have been a complete bust.

Small area, but lots of seating! 
Nice part is you're able to sample the flavor before dedicating and pouring into your cup! 
Very large array of toppings! Between the fruit ball gushers to cookie dough to marshmallows & peanut butter cups! So many options! 
They have a rewards program too, so super easy to come back for more 
Nice staff, quick to assist / answer questions, and all seating areas were cleaned promptly and well
Also, plenty of parking!
No matter what your tastebuds like, you'll find something you enjoy here!

Not happy with my shellac manicure . I stopped in because I was supposed to go next door to European wax , but they unexpectedly closed for TS . anyhow decided to get a black tip shellac manicure and the nail tech "Lauren " was kinda rude . She either didn't like her job , or she wasn't happy to be at work . She grabbed my hands , literally tugged at each finger as she worked on each nail . Then the color and shape is really shitty . $40 gone to poor service .  I gave this place two stars for the cleanliness .

Disappointing. We had ac/heat problems that were ultimately fixed. Don't go here if you are expecting to get solid rest at night. The hallways amplify any sounds like people talking or a door opening. And the walls and ceilings are thin and reverberate. Windows rattle with wind and don't block out parking lot noise. Bottom line is this place is super noisy. 

Rooms are decent size and clean, but we found the bed to be lumpy and the shower head was an epic fail, in trying to be modern cool, but producing weak water pressure in the process.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Horrible, horrible, HORRIBLE. With the new renovations, the walls are PAPER THIN. you can literally hear the person next door talking, even with voices lowered. I don't recommend this place at all. (I hope the college kids next door do well after practicing their speeches at 7:30 this morning!) Also, the beds are SUPER FIRM. For someone who works in the mattress industry, a plush feel on a mattress is better for everyone because it's kind of a happy medium. I woke up to my right side SCREAMING because the firm mattress was too much pressure on my side.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This Fresh Grocer has really improved over the years, but it's still 2 stars shy of greatness due to some of the employees and their attitudes. The store itself has seen its fair share of renovations and additions in the last few years. Most of the time it is stocked and has decent sales, minus the sugary beverages. Once in a while they may offer a tax free sugar sale, but hey the cases of water are 3 for $10 almost all the time! Lol 

The hot food and hoagies in this fresh grocer taste waaaaaay better than any other supermarket food that I've had. It's a nice amount of food for your money, especially the hoagies!

Booked an appointment a week in advance. Got there 10mins ahead and waited 45mins... because I was in desperate need of a hair cut, I waited. I was not acknowledged until I inquired if maybe I had the wrong appt. on my cal. ? Odd. It is a busy place, and very reasonable prices. I was referred by a coworker... I'm not sure I will be back since I'm 45mins away...and would not want to wait that long if I book in advance. Still thinkin about it, the hair stylist did okay with fixing my hair since I screwed it up in the first place.

This location is hard to get to and when you are inside, it is small, packed and very loud.  I was half way finished with my heated sandwich when my coffee finally arrived.  If you can avoid this Starbucks and go to one of the others around here you will be better off.  Not to mention that when I sat at the dirty counter and asked for it to be cleaned, yes she wipped the counter but it was so wet that I had to ask for a towel to dry it which I had to do myself.  Go to the one on Roger Rd , better service and clean.

Came here after an obstacle race, and we were starving! We ate 2 chicken and 2 cheese enchiladas so we could have both red and green sauce, 2 chile rellenos, the green chile combo plate, a birria taco and a fish taco. That's 8 ala carte items and a combo plate, and it was only around $20. So the price is right, and all the food was delicious! 

Some people tout the food at the pricier, well known sit-down Mexican restaurants, but I think this beats them for most food items. You just have to be ok with ordering at the counter and sitting at tiny tables while eating out of styrofoam.

10/10 would eat again.

I reserved a car at Hilton Head Airport to pick up on Christmas Day. The email confirmation and my call to Budget both confirmed a 3:30pm pick up time. I arrived at 3:15, but all the employees had left. I called Budget customer service and the representative told me that there was nothing he could do and to take an uber.  I am going to Miami, so an uber from Hilton Head doesn't work. I have to leave early tomorrow morning, but customer service could not guarantee that Budget would open on time tomorrow or give me any estimate of when it would open. WORST EXPERIENCE!!!!! ZERO STARS!

Good food..YES...service...not so much!!
My first time..I waited for friends at the bar...after 20 min..I called the front receptionist and asked her who I need to sleep with to get service...sigh...bar service is NOT the best.

Once we got our table...we had Wendy...she was clearly versed on the menu and how to treat a guest..Oh my goodness...If I can have her as a server again...this is SOO worth our trip to visit!
Wendy...you are clearly a professional and know what you are doing.I can't thank you enough!

Danielle was our server and everything was fantastic from the time we sat down until the time we left! Everyone was sooo friendly and the food came out quickly, everything was correct, food was hot and my drinks were filled the whole time. I always get nervous going to a restaurant when they first open bc service usually sucks and the food takes forever / comes out cold but nope!! Not with this place. I had the California chicken with mashed potatoes & gravy and broccoli as my side while my friend had the steak marinated in the Starbucks rub!! 10/10 all around.

Christmas time and my friends were looking for a bite to eat before seeing the Christmas lights out at Largo Central Park. This was nearby so we decided to stop in. Don't be fooled by the outside! It was dark and deserted. I was kind of wary since it's in a strip plaza but the inside was pleasant. There is tons of parking though! Seems like it's a family owned business since their kids were also playing at one of the tables. I love these kind of hole in the wall places! The prices were really affordable. We opted to get appetizers and one roll each. It was delicious and filling! I would definitely go back if I'm in the area.

You really can't beat the price for a hibachi buffet! 

Pros: price, food (when it's off the hibachi grill), location, staff is friendly, little kids eat free. 

Cons: run down, food (when they bring it from the back after the initial hibachi), slightly dirty. 

My biggest complaint is that once you get hibachi, your food will come from the kitchen. It has a different texture, taste, and is full of fat. Makes you wonder 

If you are looking for a budget friendly, kid friendly, hibachi buffet, I recommend giving it a chance and drawing your own conclusions!

I brought my car in to install 1 tire (i supplied tire) and rotation.  When i dropped car off i didnt get an estimate which i didnt mind because i knew this kind of labor doesnt deviate a lot.  When i picked up car i found the install was $22 (average-good price) and rotation was $20 (usually this is $10 at most $15 and sometimes free).  I sighed but i didnt mind too much except later i look in trunk and my spare was hastily tossed in.  If youre going to overcharge me rotation then at least put spare away properly.  Job took half a day and my trunk is very tidy by the way (one small bag one med bag one small box).
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This is the worst drink I have ever gotten from Starbucks, and I frequent this place. I ordered a venti Starbucks double shot and I swear they gave me a tall in a venti cup and just added ice! I even waited for the guy to come back to the drive thru window and he just disappeared. If I wasn't crunched for time on my lunch break I would've went inside  to have them remake it. So now I'm pissed with a tall size coffee when I paid for a venti and the damn straw doesn't even go into the drink BECAUSE THERES NO DRINK. WTF DO BETTER

The staff her was very friendly and moved quickly despite being short staffed and having an ever growing line. I just wanted a quick breakfast to go and ordered a crossaint with plain cream cheese and my sister ordered a plain bagel with strawberry cream cheese. Strawberry tasted a little off and was a little disappointed they didn't have chives and onion cream cheese.

This Dunkin is more expensive than other Dunkins I've been to. But they offer free WIFI and have a great outdoor seating area with a spectacular view!

2 stars for consideration, that this new restaurant is trying. I always drove by this place , so I wanted to check it out. I was hoping it would be the big ticket that would solidify its distinction between itself and the stereotypical American (Tex-Mex) in this city by being a legitimate Mexican restaurant. I ate "one time" at a Tijuana flats in my life, would gladly take that over this over priced hogwash. But then again it's all about location location. And unfortunately these ingredients do not meet up to par with my palate. I wish this place the best of luck, but it wasn't for me.

Typical airport restaurant with bar food and overpriced beverages. However, I must say the music and exceptional service make it stand out. Nothing like being able to hear live music in the airport when your flight is delayed for 5 hours! The gentleman playing solo this afternoon was really good and got the crowd signing along. 

Milad the bartender was awesome, he was engaging and hilarious. I enjoy going places where the bartender takes the time to actually chat with you and makes the experience pleasant. Wish we had found this spot earlier to hang out while we waited.

We were given a table in the basement dining area, and it was so loud that we actually could not carry on a conversation.  All of the other diners were in their early 20s, so I felt like I was at a college party.  Moreover, the restaurant crowded too many tables into the space.  The service was mediocre, but I suspect this is because of the over-crowding.

The food, however, was excellent.  If you want to try this restaurant, I recommend requesting a table in one of the smaller, upstairs dining rooms when making your reservation.

This is a sandwich and salad shops it's located in Franklin Market on 34th and walnut. 

We get free deliveries at my job so I figured I'd try them out. 

T.B.A.
- the multigrain bread was ridiculous tough. Nothing soft about it. This made it difficult to eat the sandwich since I was literally pulling at the bread with my teeth for a bite. 
- the sandwich was a reasonable size.

Sesame Kale Caesar 
- much smaller then I expected
- they charge extra for add on
- I added chicken and it was dry, tasteless and brown :/ - a waste of $3 

For 20 bucks, I could've made these two meals myself & still saved a few bucks.

Had a delightful dinner celebrating a friend's birthday in the private room of this little quaint restaurant. Some of our friends had their signature Alfredo dip in the cheese sauce and it looked absolutely amazing. I had the seafood pasta special and it was delicious, I ate every single bite. The price tag is slightly steep at $34. The Italian flavours are robust and their service is very good. But in light of so many new restaurants in the city, I'm not sure if traditional Italian would be high on my revisit list.

Dee and Mark were bartending when I stopped by for the first time last Saturday. It was a little early in the night so the dimly lit bar was still a little empty but great music was playing. The service was fast and the beers were cheap too! ($10 buckets of bud light that night)

As the place started to fill up I realized they were all regulars but even though I was new they welcomed me as though I was part of the family!

They also have a jukebox and an electronic dart board to play and the bathrooms were very clean. Over all I will absolutely be heading back to this neighborhood bar!

If you're staying at the Sirata or even on Saint Pete Beach make sure to drop by Harry's for some lunch and midday drinks. They have a full menu and all seating is outdoors by one of the pools. Staff is currently wearing masks during COVID. You can either order at the bar or sit down and a server will come take your order. Food only took about 10min to arrive at the table. Only downside is that the fries had absolutely no salt or seasoning on them but the wrap itself was tasty and fresh. The drinks were also refreshing and worth the $8. There also was live music all day (Friday).

This place does an amazing job with your nails. Sue, the owner is really kind and even though she barely speaks English, she knows exactly how to help you with stuff you need. 

Chris and Barbara are truly talented with helping me choose what color I want and giving the best mani and pedi. 

As far as the place itself, it's very clean and cozy. They give you a massage before and after your manicure. I've been coming here for a year now and they are consistent. 

Let's talk about prices, they are pretty decent especially for the mainline. They do have discounts from M-W for your mani and pedi so keep that in mind.

Went here tonight (9/10) for a quick dinner. I had a 15 month old baby in a stroller with me so I asked the hostess if we could sit outside to keep him occupied with people watching.  She sat me with a menu and I sat there and waited.... And waited... And waited. After 15 minutes of sitting there without so much as a water and a server who had come out twice and ignored me both times, I decided it wasn't worth it and left. I've had wasabi sushi at another location before and it was decent but this location is clearly lacking and I won't be back.

When I lived in New Orleans, this place was my guilty pleasure. I remember battling torrential downpours and the oppressive heat just for a scoop of their lavender honey. Now that I live out of town, I find myself craving their ice cream. Everything is fresh and made with care. The smell of homemade waffle cones greets you as you open the door and the staff are friendly and helpful. For chocolate lives, I highly recommend the chocolate amaretto cheesecake. To satisfy a sweet tooth, petit four will do the trick. On the lighter side, their seasonal sorbet is refreshingly satisfying. If you havent already figured, Im hooked on this place!

Love this barber shop! As someone who lives downtown this barber shop is not only very convenient but also very welcoming. Red's has an antiquated 1950's feel that offers not only amazing hair cuts with a complementary straight razor neck finish, but they also shoe shine services, many hair and beard products, facial hair trimming and back massaging! The pricing is fair for the service you receive and location is in the heart of everything downtown! If you check this place out plan out your parking situation since there isn't a lot, and I highly recommend requesting Tyler, William, or Elliot as your barbers!

We have been wanting to eat at Bettina for quite some time and when we finally did, it did not disappoint. It was so good! Last week we ordered the Carbonara to go. It was recommended to me by a chef friend. In my opinion this pizza was perfection. It was creamy, had a perfect crisp to the crust, and it was the perfect amount for two. Oh and the egg was cooked wonderfully. I know an egg on a pizza might seem odd to some but don't knock it till you try it. It was pretty amazing! All in all we will definitely be back to Bettina and I can't wait!

Love this place! The space is large enough that you feel free to move about, but small enough to feel intimate and not overwhelming. They have a nice array of different equipment options including free weights, isolation machines, cable towers, and special purpose rooms such as the TRX (CrossFit) and a more traditional "class" room. The staff are always friendly and customer oriented. 

It can get busy after work between 5-7pm, but early mornings, lunch hour, and weekend mornings are less packed sometimes even let you have the gym to yourself.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Love this place. I had a car wash at Crew in Greenwood and it unfortunately did not get the stains off my car. So I went to this place to get another car wash. They gave me a free car wash since the first Crew car wash didn't do the trick. They scrubbed the stains on my car before sending it through the wash. They got most of it but then told me to go through again to try to get the rest off. All free of charge. Awesome customer service and I will be using this car wash from now on as they value entirely cleaning the car.

As we walked the streets oh Philadelphia we got a bit hungry and came across this spot. It was apple lunch time so we did not want a big meal so instead I ordered the chicken quesadillas and my girlfriend had the chicken nachos. The chicken quesadillas were delicious. The tortilla was perfectly charred and the cheese and chicken was absolutely delicious. My girlfriends nachos were just as flavorful and top our surprise the nachos were perfectly crisp. No soggy chips at all, even the ones in the bottom covered by all the greasy stuff. The service was quick and attentive. We loved the place.

Second time here and I love this hotel. It is centrally locates to most of the sites we want to visit when we are in the City. The staff is always quick to help and lend a hand. The rooms are clean, modern and comfortable. Although this time the room was a bit smaller than the last time; it was still fine. The best part about this place is it's location. It is near plenty of restaurants, shops and tourists spots. The rates are also excellent. Great price for our weekend stay. We love it and will definitely be back to stay again. 
By the way, they have a restaurant, and small gym facility on the 12th floor.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I took my friend here for her birthday on Tuesday night. The food was phenomenal. And our server was friendly and knowledgeable but the hostess failed to mention to our server that it was my friend's birthday so our server didn't put a candle in our dessert. He promptly brought out another dessert with a candle in it once I mentioned it but it kinda ruined the night. It was even more frustrating because when the hostess called the day before to confirm the reservation, I was promised a candle would be placed in the dessert. Love the food, but I'm not sure if I'll be back.

Hot fresh mini donuts. This location is inside the mall, right by the Rain Forest Café.  All the donuts are made after you order. You can choose from numerous different toppings including powdered, cinnamon sugar, granulated sugar, Hazelnut spread, etc.
Overall, the donuts are pretty good but they are overpriced.  You get six for five dollars or 12 for eight dollars. You can also order larger batches.
We tried granulated sugar, powdered sugar, and blueberry lemon. I like that the blueberry lemon had an actual fresh blueberry on it. Powdered ones tasted like funnel cake.
The donuts are a solid 4 stars.   The price is 2 stars.

There is a auto repair shop on every other corner in the area, but Pat's stands out as simply the best.  Why? Because these guys are HONEST.  I've been taking my past (Saab & Mercedes) and current ('07 BMW) cars here and my experience's have been consistently outstanding.  Their pricing is unbelievably fair, they have connections in the area to parts/tires, always cheaper then I am ever able source online.  Things are done right the first time; and they would never fix something that simply doesn't need to be fixed, which is common at most other shops.  The two Pat's that run the place are very experienced and fair guys, give them a try.

Been there twice since it is right around the corner from me and both times I was not impressed. But people are people and they get their job done. The last time I was there I was asked to pull around and they actually forgot all about me. After about 20 minutes I went to the window and they did everything they could to correct the problem. I'm sure y'all are wondering where the 4 stars come from but the food is never lacking and I will continue to go. Sometimes we will find that past all the negative some people just need someone to be a person.

It pains me to write this bc I love krispy and it's always been my go to but my most recent visit a couple days ago will likely have me not returning for a while. I can always tell when the oil hasn't been changed out for a while. This mostly happens in smaller businesses it seems as I know it's costly to change it out so often. But the donuts were just terrible. You could see immediately that they were darker in color and then when eaten they tasted terrible and were a harder consistency. This is probably for the better anyway as I like to support local... time to try out some more donut spots!

I was craving sushi and Kabuki Sushi was the only Asian option on Grubhub that didn't have a ridiculously high delivery fee. I'm so glad I tried Kabuki! This will be my go-to delivery spot for sushi from now on. 

I ordered a Spicy Tuna and Philly Roll, both were pretty good. I also ordered a Strawberry Bubble Tea which was tasty. I'm a big fan of bubble tea so I'm glad they offered it along with different flavor options. 

They have other options besides sushi. Prices are reasonable. Giving this 4 stars because I can't comment on the service since I ordered delivery. I look forward to trying them again in the future.

Sushi was good for the price, but the spicy tuna and spicy crab had nothing on top. No spicy mayo or spicyness to the roll in general. It was worth it. But bland. Also is lettuce in a shrimp tempura roll normal? That was a new thing for me. 

But there was 9ish rings of calamari, cold floppy, small- some were not even breaded.  The kind a pizza place offers frozen. A rip off for their price. Won't order sides here again, but sushi maybe in person after restaurants reopen. Took about an hour twenty, but I'm assuming their take out is busy right now.

I can't say enough about Clear Vision Express. This is my second time getting glasses from them and I will continue to give them my business. David at the Oro Valley store was fantastic.  He recommended frames that I would not have normally picked for myself and I very much preferred his suggestions over mine.  He was extremely knowledgeable, clearly had a sense of current fashions and I can't say enough positive things about my experience. David was patient, understanding and was willing to give his opinion. For someone like me who can be indecisive, his help made the decision making process much easier. I'll be back soon.  

Thanks David!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: H&C is where I go to study when the Starbucks on campus is too crowded. In the other words, this coffeeshop is a good study spot. It is a mutually understood that we all came to H&C for the same reason to get some work done, so you can be guaranteed hours on hours of uninterrupted work from others. Whether you actually do the work is up to you! I always get the non-fat latte, and while I don't feel it's much different from a Starbucks drink, I like that it's warm and a good companion to help me conquer all my work!

A friend and I meet once a month to catch up over some liquid octane (Quad Americano. Get the stim, not the jitters!). Our location of choice? La Colombe.

Lack of WiFi and a less frenetic vibe makes it easy to unplug (a bit) and reconnect (or in our case, trash talk) with friends.

This location's predominantly grey interior feels more like a mess hall aboard the Battlestar Galactica than a cafe, but enormous glass walls/windows and quaint coffee mugs soften the edges. Rest assured that the staff and coffee are awesome.

Also, La Colombe has earned a spot in my heart as the owner (Todd) is just an all around awesome guy. :)

This hotel has a great location and the lobby is beautiful. The staff was great thanks to Chris the manager  he saved our already stressful night he was such a professional but unfortunately before he helped us I had to meet a clerk who goes by the name of nicollie she is the soul reason for the two stars  she was by far the worst rep I have ever had to deal  with my suggestion is for her to find a industry she actually enjoys working in it was obvious she was refusing to help us and not sure why is she a women hater ? A Racist? Wasn't sure having a bad day ? Didn't get trained properly? Either way thanks for Chris he saved the day
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place is A-OK. Its like a factory, they have lots of seats, so if you want to come with girlfriends its a pretty good bet that they can get you all in at the same time and next to each other. 

I've been 2-3 times for a pedicure and they are quick and have great prices, service and quality are nothing special, but in a pinch its a good spot. 

I went once for SNS (dip manicure) and I won't be back for that, my nails were THICK and BUMPY and I had to have them redone at the place I usually go. 

The parking can be tricky, especially around lunch time, so plan on a few extra minutes to find a spot.

This is the closest McDonald's to my house so I've been here more times than I can count. It's about as average as you can get. Classic McDonald's service where getting your order right the first time is a crapshoot. It's connected to a shell station so there's actually plenty of room inside. If you have kids, there's a play place inside as well. My favorite part about this McDonald's? They have the OG characters inside as the decorations. You know what I'm talking about. The purple blob dude, the hamburgler, and crew. It's a little bit of a nostalgic throwback to see Ronald's old crew still in use.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Really enjoyed our meal at this new made-to-order all-you-can-eat sushi restaurant. Most all you can eat places feature 100+ rolls in a buffet arrangement that ends up with sushi sitting too long and rolls that hide meh ingredients. Not so here. Everything is prepared to order and tastes fresh are generously sized. The choices of fish are a little limited, but I would MUCH rather have them do a limited menu very well than a huge menu poorly. The selection of rolls were good and tasty and the appetizers were quite good. Service was prompt and courteous. Kids under 10 are 1/2 price too!

The husband and I were craving sushi so we decided to come to Kabuki since it was one of the higher rated sushi restaurants in the area.  The location is a little awkward, house like structure located among other homes turned businesses.  Parking and entrance are in the rear.  Inside it is nice and open unless you get seated in the side room like we did.  We felt like we were in time out and not allowed to hang out with the others in the nicer area.  Although, this room would be nice for a large private party.

Sushi was a hit or miss.  
Would definitely recommend the sushi pizza.
Service was great.

If you end up purchasing a Hawaiian Pizza from here be aware it includes onions! After ordering and picking up the pizza we came to find onions on our pizza?? We called the deli and told them that and they said "that's how we do Hawaiian pizzas here." I'm sorry but every other pizza place does not include onions on their pizza's and if your deli does then you need to disclose that to anyone ordering a Hawaiian pizza. And the fact they would not do anything to solve the issue because it was our fault of not knowing really irritates me. Believe me I will spend the extra money and time to go to Papa John's or Argenziano's next time!

This hotel is really not that bad . It could use some renovations and lighting adjustments but you get what  you pay for.The location is pretty good only a 10 minute walk to the terminal market and most of the other attractions  in center city . The Self Parking is really easy and convenient . Unfortunately , it's pricey but there aren't any other options since street Parking seems non existent . Also, I found their staff to be very pleasant and easy going . Was very nice about late check out . The gym has everything you need like most of the sheratons .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I come here almost everyday and they look at me at the register like they have never seen me before and ask what I want. So I order and every so often they get it wrong, not so often to make me upset but confusing since I come in a lot and order the same thing. Anyways, today I told myself if they get my order wrong, I'm writing a bad review on Yelp. So here we are! I'm never going to this Starbucks ever again because I feel uncomfortable trying to order my drink knowing they will never remember me and will probably mess it up. Thanks!

The food was great here! The cheese bread to start was out of this world, definitely recommend ordering that. I had the Seafood Stew. The broth and octopus in it were particularly great. The carrot mole side was also good. 

The ambience is also really nice here, the outdoor patio is a relaxing place to just hang out for a while and have drinks. 

Our only complaint is that the service was very average for the price of the restaurant. The wrong food was brought to our table twice during the meal, and our waiter seemed pretty rushed.

Sick and tired of constantly needing an appointment for a haircut? I was so I decided to skip the salon and try a barber. Heard great things about this location so decided to give it a whirl. 

Located in Meridian downtown this small barber offers a classic feel with a classic touch. I was immediately sat and started chatting with the several barbers as they asked what I wanted. Didn't take long you explain my go-to-do and the guy was off!

The haircut was clean and looked sharp. The neckline was perfect and the straight razor shave felt great. Would recommend again!

I had to get an oil change so I figured since Dobbs was so close to my new house it would be a convenient and quick event. I was very wrong. They took over an hour for a simple oil change. I'm guessing it would've taken more time if I hadn't gone up to the counter and asked how much longer it would take. I don't know if they forgot about me since I was in the corner of their waiting room. When it was time to pay, they acknowledged that it did take longer than usual and gave me a discount. I have learned my lesson and will no longer ever use a Dobbs ever again.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I'm not quite sure how anyone could give this restaurant a good rating.  We ordered an array of items: sushi, pad thai, and dumplings.

Pad thai was possibly the worst I have ever had.  No flavor, served with a "lemon" (they said they ran out of limes), and literally tasted like bad Chinese food more than anything.  The sushi did not taste fresh and was absolutely drenched with spicy mayo sauce (disgusting).  Lastly, my girlfriend pointed out that it looked like something was crawling up on the wall..possibly a cockroach or small mouse.  Doesn't get much better than that!:)

We love Nicey. I haven't had a bad popsicle from there. It's easy to order from, you can buy in bulk and the staff is always nice-y.

Our household favorite is Watermelon. Taste like real watermelon, not the candy flavor like most water melon treats taste like.

If you love Hawaii like my husband. You need to get the POG.

Also cookie butter or any or their creamy flavors (my daughter loves strawberry) are super satisfying. 

We first tried them 6ish years ago at the earth festival downtown and our lives have never been the same :p

In our opinion Asaka is the best sushi in the greater Indy area.  It's also one of the only restaurants that serves authentic Japanese foods.

Their sushi rice is what makes their food so good. Honestly, rice can make or break a place. If you aren't judging your sushi place by it's rice, do you even like sushi? 

We love that they are family friendly and that they have staff who are tight knit.

They also have ever changing specials that are always fun to try!

It can get busy. I suggest making reservations or getting there right at opening! **follow them on Facebook, last time I checked, you can make reservations there too**

I can't recall a better meal in my recent memory. From the garlic bread to start through our delicious wines and main courses every single dish was flavorful and savory. During our Friday night visit the restaurant was full the entire time, and I was happy to have made a reservation. Our server seemed distant and distracted throughout the meal; for service, I would rate this meal as 3.5/5. However, the food truly was exceptional and totally made this a 5-star experience. Portion sizes were reasonable (gnocchi) to large (rigatoni)and the price seemed fair for the quality. I'll definitely be back for my next date night or special occasion.

Well I went there last night and bought my IPA beer for like almost $13 for a 6 pack. I had one last night and on my second tonight and was just staring and reading the bottle and saw the date was September of 2018 for the Enjoy by date. Like really I understand a few weeks but a couple of months come on. Will not be back. Of course they didn't give me a receipt either so it's just gonna go to waste I guess. I wonder how many other products I've bought here were well out of date. Definitely do not recommend as I saw another review of someone with similar situation. Definitely recommend somewhere that can keep their stock fresh.

Update: 2018 Wife ordered pizza from here again, even though we don't order from here anymore due to decline in quality.
Has gone downhill, found out today that there is a new owner. 
We're located 4 minutes away, takes far too long to arrive. Tried multiple times to order pie with extra cheese, lightly cooked.....unsuccessful.
Gave credit card for order, then had bank call us hour layer saying someone tried to use it to get gas!
Delivery person showed up.....

...it was the new owner.

We never went back. Never will

Yesterday was the first time my husband and I visited Jack Willie's since it has reopened. We were very excited since we frequented here during Football Sundays. We were very disappointed. The servers were friendly when we did speak to them but very slow. I ordered the fish and chips and was dissappointed the fish was lacking in flavor big time and a bit on the dry side. The chips were very good. The beer was cold. The burger my husband ordered also lacked in flavor... a little salt and pepper would have gone a long way. I dont think I would go back to eat but maybe just to drink.

This place was everything I imagined it to be and more. Very quaint bar that you can tell has been around forever. Staff was friendly and welcoming even though we were obviously new and not regulars. The little older bartender was so nice, and acted as the cook as well. Our burgers were made with love and tasted like a burger my grandma would cook me in her kitchen. Prices were great for all items on the small menu. Lots of small snack bags to choose from on the wall too. Check the backside of the menu for the "rules" of the bar. They're pretty fun and help you feel welcome.

You can smell the Dunkin' coffee as you enter the Market street exit from the station atrium. You'll often find a long line but staff move quickly to complete your order! Ample seating available but others will approach you for change and still take your neighboring chairs. 

The location is super convenient for being right inside the train station so you can definitely make your train - even when ordering 15 mins prior to departure.

Coffee is much cheaper than competitor, Saxby's, located right next door. Be sure to use the Dunkin' Donuts app (free) when ordering so that you can accumulate points and free rewards!

TEARS OF JOY!!!!!! First off- staff is fantastic. I was greeted right away. Store is huge so I asked where I could find the hard kombucha. The guy dropped what he was doing and walked me back. I'm gluten free. Waa waa. I'm used to slim pickings. So many options for everything!!!! Gluten free beer and meads and ciders!!! They have singles so you can try all kinds of things without committing to a 6pack. Prices are on point or lower than other places. The girl that checked me out commented on one of my choices so I ended up getting more based on her description. LOVE THIS PLACE. Worth the traffic!

This place was great for basic Italian! Loved the bread and oil that they give you for just showing up. The half portions are perfect sized and save you a good dollar amount as well. Great go to spot for American Italian. The service was a pretty slow and but the orders came out correct so can't complain too much. 

My husband had the chicken parmesan (that he could have easily been happy with the half order) and I had the seafood pasta with Alfredo sauce instead of red and it was so good! I'm getting hungry just thinking about this place.

LOVE Ginza so much that my husband and I eat here almost every week! The food quality is fresh, and WAY better than their competitor up the street. We appreciate how friendly and personable all of the staff always is. Great customer service is rare these days! Joy is our favorite! She is very attentive, and genuinely sweet! We are valued as customers, and again the food is super good! My favorite is the Dancing Crab Roll, their hand rolls, and of course the fried sweet dough and vanilla ice cream that we always finish off our delicious meal with! :)

Great place for a non-fuss manicure. I used Hannah and she worked meticulously to make sure I had a flawless manicure. When I get a manicure, I usually watch the person who does it like a hawk to make sure there's nothing wrong and this was not necessary for JFK. They took their time. Bonus- I originally went in thinking I only had time to take off my disastrously old gel manicure ($7) but when I realized I had time to get a manicure that day and came back in the afternoon, they took $7 off the cost of the manicure since they wouldn't usually charge that if you had your nails done there.

I come here for the all you can eat. I love sushi and here i can get alot of fresh sushi for a good price. I believe its 25.00.
You get two pages with a nice selection to choose from. I always order alot of sashimi and quite a few orders of the larger rolls.
If you love sushi, can eat alot of it, and think 25.00 is a good/great price...go for it. Its prepared fresh and its good to go.
The place is quite small and the restroom was not operational at my last visit. 
I ordered sashimi and was brought sushi (with rice) twice. I believe this was done purposely to fill my belly.
You cant share and you cant bring leftovers home.

This is by far my favorite sushi spot in the Greater-Nashville area. Extremely friendly and helpful staff. The restaurant is a little small but it has a welcoming feel and inviting ambiance. The sushi chefs are on point with all of their dishes and presentations. The value is fare on most and almost unbeatable on some. This is definitely worth a 20 minute drive to enjoy all this place has to offer. You would be cheating yourself if you didn't dine here at least one time. Be forewarned, that if you do eat at Kirin, you WILL be hooked and it will spoil you.

Took the missus here tonight for a nice Sunday dinner and was not disappointed.  The service was prompt and friendly, food served reasonably quickly (not too quickly) and everything prepared just perfectly.  This is my third time to this restaurant and I think it will definitely become one of my 'go to' destinations for great Italian good.

I also had an Old Fashioned (perfectly done) and my wife had a glass of Montepulciano (good).  We finished the meal with tiaramisu ... a to die for version of it served on a slate shingle.

Grab your coat and get up there, you'll enjoy it!

Really one of the best dry cleaners in the city.  They pay attention to detail, clothes come back as I expect them and the people who run this operation are really nice.

Some items are very expensive to clean, like a gown or tuxedo, but dry cleaning tends to be extremely expensive in New Orleans as compared to other major cities.

They have a small parking lot in front of the store and they watch it like a hawk for their customers because there is an extremely popular restaurant two doors down.  They want their customers to have a place to park when they come to do business.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I have a little dog (a yorkie) who gets very nervous with strangers and vets. When my baby (dog) got sick and needed treatment, I called Banfield and they were great with getting me in after work, checking out my dog, and giving her the right diagnosis. She needed extensive treatment (dental work and extractions) which was going to be an expensive vet bill. They worked with my budget and offered a medical plan that would help me give my dog the treatment she needed without making me get a second job. The vet techs were very friendly to me and to my dog. They even called the next day (after both appointments) to see how my dog was doing.

This might be my favorite restaurant at the moment. 

From the cocktails to the food, to the desert-- all amazing. Portion size is on point.

Broken down:
-- Spritzer --
Perfect blend of gin, bitters and prosecco. My favorite cocktail right now.

-- Brushetta -- 
Homemade super soft bread with prosciutto and balsamic. 

-- Swordfish Piccata --
Everything. Fish is perfectly cooked with a risotto Gordon Ramsey would approve of.

-- Saltimbocca Prawns -- 
Just, yes.

-- Flourless Chocolate Cake --
Not a huge sweet fan and this was perfect. Dark chocolate with homemade whip cream.

This dimly lit, somewhat dungy, cool spot is just right to hang out in alone or with a gaggle of friends. It's a great place to try some cocktails you have never heard of or some favorite standards. In addition to a decent mid to high-end selection of liquor, they always have at least 18 microbrews on draft. Anytime I've gone in there and asked about trying something new, the staff always has a suggestion, and a well formed one at that. 

If you want a change of scenery, just step outside and sit at one of the picnic tables or benches and enjoy some fresh Reno air while you sip your gin and juice!

While I am a huge fan of their dinner menu, as my followers know I like to write my reviews specifically based on my most recent visit. Tonight I went for dessert, and what a treat it was! My caramel espresso martini was delicious!! They make the best espresso martini I have ever had. I also had the dream bomba dessert, and what a dream it was!!!! Excellent. Peanut butter gelato with a caramel center, covered in creamy chocolate hard shell, caramel and chocolate drizzle and topped with whipped cream and a strawberry. Perfect for sharing, although don't feel bad about indulging in one all by yourself.

Sushi here is cheap but the ingredients seem lower quality. The shrimp tempura is over battered and the shrimp is rather small. The eel is half chewy skin and less eel meat. Their salmon isn't too bad. I like their alaska roll, nice big chunks of avocado. Their avocado's actually fresh and I like that.

The three roll special is a good deal and they really pack the trays full. Compared to Vic Sushi about 2 blocks away, I would go with Vic. If you don't feel like waiting for the slow service at Vic's though, Tsuki Sushi would work in a pinch. Tsuki's has online ordering, too!

I went here for dinner one night with my boyfriend. I ordered the salmon lover and he ordered the tuna/salmon option. When the plates came out we were both happy with the amount of pieces on both of our plates. It was a good portion size of fresh and tasty fish. It's something that is definitely comparable to Fat Salmon, and much closer for those in the Spring Garden/Fairmount areas. Pricing is fair as well. This is a five star place because of the food quality, friendly service, decent price, and byob option.

From start to finish my stay was great and I'll absolutely be back!

At checkin, Justin was professional and fantastic, really went above and beyond.  The lobby and bar are well appointed and have a great feel. I got there too late to try the bar but it looks like a fun, modern spot.

The room was nice with modern touches, and the bed was comfy.

Water in the shower got perfectly hot, which is a big deal to me. 

Location is PERFECT! Honestly couldn't get better, it's within walking distance to anything you want!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Nice employees BUT this place is a scam.  I don't have vision issues i have glare and night driving issues.  So i pay $60 i don't really have for "anti-glare" to be put on--the only reason i got glasses at all. NO DIFFERENCE WHATSOEVER! So i go back in and complain, they say it was the fitting that it needed to be tighter, okay so i tried it---STILL NO DIFFERENCE in the glare! Do i get a refund or even a discount since the service i paid for wasnt delivered--NOPE! Horrible business policies and scam artists!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Solid Four Points hotel near the TPA airport. Nothing particularly special about the rooms, but the atrium area is nice and not something you see as much these days. Solid gym and indoor pool of the atrium and free parking in a well lit parking lot. The guest rooms look like they have been renovated relatively recently but still show some age. The rooms are all suites and spacious thought the bathroom is small and felt crowded. Overall, the price was good and I would book again for a one night stay if I needed to be close to the airport.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Aiiiiiii we waited more than 30 minutes for our meal. Thankfully, we had a delay in our flight, otherwise, we wouldn't have have the opportunity to eat what was ordered.

Service is incredibly slow, and I don't know why. The place wasn't getting any new patrons, but the dishes just came out slower and slower...

Ordered an American burger with no cheese, no bun, with a side of fries. When the plate finally came, the burger had cheese on it. I'm gluten and lactose intolerant, but dang it, we were running out of time and I needed a meal--so I just consumed it and knew I'd pay the price on the plane. 

So. So slow.

Tried to order dinner for myself and a coworker through Grubhub. Placed my order at 5:46. Great. We're hungry and ready for some chicken parm deliciousness. 6:29 - the restaurant calls me and says "sorry, you're too far away. We don't deliver that far. You need to call Grubhub to have them cancel the order." Two things... 1.) You don't deliver this far away, fine. I'm sure you can adjust your settings in Grubhub to not come up on my search. (I put it into google maps, it's just over 3 miles, but that's beside the point.) 2.) You waited almost 45 minutes just to call me and tell ME to cancel my order? Very professional.

I love Dunkin and their menu choices. However I would love if someone would look at the "mobile order" system at this location. I LOVE mobile ordering, but this location is awful. I will hit submit order long before I know I'll arrive despite the warning the app gives me about wanting my order to be warm and fresh. Yet no matter what I always end up standing inside waiting for about 10-20 mins while I watch 5-10 customers come in, order and walk out with their order. As I wait, for my order I put in 15 mins ago. Please please please look into this.

This place was such a great find! You don't find many restaurants that offer endless sushi and hibachi, and for such a great price! Lunch is $10, and Dinner is $20. 

A few of the other reviews mentioned how slow service was. I was only ever here once, but our service was great. Our server was helpful, personable, and accommodating. 

The food was good. I've had better, but for that price it's definitely worth it. I just wish they had a better selection of sushi. 

If ever in the area again, I will definitely be back!

While it's a little pricey compared with other salons in the area, it's well worth the money. The technicians seem to know what they're doing and I always leave satisfied with the end result. They could improve on customer service; the woman at the front desk is wonderful and very kind but sometimes the technicians come off as very short and have a tendency to interrupt you when you're speaking. I've come to love this salon - Linda is amazing and will work with you to make sure you are completely satisfied with your nails. Even with the few minor complaints I have, this is the best nail salon I've been to in St. Louis.

This always happens when I do something last minute and don't check Yelp reviews. Well, you get what you get. The wait to get a car was very long even though everyone had made reservations in advance. The comments about hidden fees were accurate. We paid a lot of money for a crappy car that was dirty. We waited even longer for them to clean it out. When we returned it, the car lot was packed with vehicles and no one was at the entrance to tell us where to go to return it. The only good thing was that the AC on the car worked and it didn't break down on us.

I really wanted to like this place, since I heard so much hype on it. My boyfriend and I ate two Sonoran dogs. I have to say, my bun was soft and warm, but by the time I started on my second hotdog, the hotdog fell apart because the bottom of the bun was SO soggy. I was REALLY disappointment with the lack of toppings too. There was NO vinegar carrots and jalapeños, which is something I love to get at taco shops. No chopped onion or tomatoes, it was sad . The environment was clean and fairly empty for a Saturday, but the drive through was super busy. I'm iffy on going back.

Really good Mexican food! I have eaten here once and ordered take out once.

Dining in: it was a late afternoon and the restaurant wasn't completely busy. We ordered shrimp quesadillas and a chicken chimichanga. The food came out quickly and was really good! 

Take out: it was a weekend night and a few of us ordered delivery. I think it's really cool & convenient that they deliver! We ordered a bunch of different things and everything was prepared really well. 

Overall, food is GOOD, service is friendly and the prices are extremely reasonable. Will continue to order from here!

Some of the best Italian food in the area with prices that can't be beat! You are getting quality, HUGE portions, with delicious sides of soup/salad/bread. I usually get the eggplant parmigiana which is absolutely delicious. The penne vodka and tortellini carbonara are equally delicious as well. Anything you get ... you cannot go wrong! If dining in, it is BYOB so make sure to bring your favorite bottle of wine with you. Although, if you decide to do takeout, you are not missing out on anything! They still provide you with the mass quantities of bread and all the wonderful things you would normally get.

This is probably the best Chinese food I've had in Hamilton county. We moved away for a couple years and definitely missed this place. Now that we're back, I'm happy to say it tastes exactly the same!

You get sooooo much food for the price. I actually forgot how much you get. I ordered the Lo mein combo with pork friend rice. It was $8 so I assumed it wasn't going to be a lot of food. So I ordered more pork fried rice on the side. Well...I was wrong. I was only able to eat half of the combo and didn't even touch the extra rice!

Long story short, great food for a great price

If I can give zero I would already stress about a death in my family I had to rent a car this bitch yes bitch prolly the same Alicia person was so rude and unprofessional she hung up on me twice without answering my question I called back a 3rd to ask to speak to the manager and she says I am the manager and hangs up DO NOT come here I wanted to call Corp but even they could not help all around hertz needs to do better better staff better policies and better corporate dealing with customers but this place 6 Marlton never I repeat do not come here unless u wanna go to jail for dragging a bitch

Sushi here is pretty good. We had the Metairie roll, yellowtail, and super crunch. We seated ourselves, never got drink refills, our sushi was given to the wrong table, it took way too long to get the waiters attention... We had to walk up and ask for our check. Unfortunately, this seemed like the experience of all of the other diners as we heard moans and groans coming from other tables. The waiter was nice enough, seemed young, and maybe like he had too much on his plate. During a lunch rush having only one waiter is a disaster. We will not be returning.

I had to rent a car and when I saw the back window was filled with hair and dirt, I asked the guy why is it dirty? He took care of it right away and had it vacuumed out. Then in less than a half an hour I noticed hair all over the car, what looks like ashes from the last person who rented the car and just disgusting stains on all the seats. This is really gross service. I can't wait to get back into my own car. I can't see how Enterprise claims to sanitize the cars when they're not even cleaned properly. It's a shame and I don't recommend this business. Especially during a pandemic you need to step up your game

I bought my kiddy that had a raw hole in her cheeks. They didn't do zip but give me a script for antibiotics. Never telling me she had infected teeth. Then a big bill. I wouldn't trust them to ever touch a pet again such gross incompetence. My poor baby got a lot worst and took her to a good vet that truly took time to look deeply and fix the problem. Pulled the teeth and now she is so much better. All it would of took is taking the time to truly look and not a quick money flip.
The worst vet clinic I have ever been to.

Delicious Food! The staff was patient with my table. A few of us were 35 minutes late, and they still honored our reservation. They constantly checked in on us. Its a very small intimate environment, minimal decor, but the food is full of flavor. Our waitress was very knowledgeable on the restaurant week menu. I asked for advice, based on my flavor profiles. She advised on her favorites, and what drink pairing would be best. Its a very casual place, great Mexican food. Not a super "original" menu, but definitely a repeat. Last thing, make sure you stay for dessert. The tres leches + mexican tiramisu were AMAZING!

This place is great for the value! It's classic Americanized Chinese food, which I tend to crave sometimes. I ordered the General Tsao's dinner box, which came with the vegetable fried rice, wonton soup, and a spring roll. The quantity was good for $9.50, and it was enough to make two meals out of it.

The spring roll, wonton soup, and rice were typical, not too special, but decent. The chicken was the best part, the perfect texture and with a lot of sauce. Would recommend for a quick meal or if you're craving american chinese food.

This bar is blessed. It's captures the heart of St. Louis. There's an exquisite collection of liquor, including all tiers of Chartruese, Grand Mariner,. And much more. The Vintage Famous Barr decor, French prints and exposed brick,... the martinis are delicious.. the wine and beer selection is amazing.. and it's in one of the most wholesome, bubbly, classically St. Louis neighborhoods in the whole city. This place has the heart of the neighborhood that's for sure. I've never felt more at home in a neighborhood bar. This place is a treasure.

This is my 2nd time here. 1st time I was here just came in to the bar to watch some nfl and had a few beers. This time had lunch with a few friends. Service was fast, waitress was on point and got our orders in quickly. I got lunch special 3 rolls for 13.50 that came with soup just like most sushi places. Dynamite roll and salmon roll were good but did not really like tuna roll it seemed like it wasn't really fresh. I love tuna rolls and this one I passed on. I also had avocado salad which was good and fresh.  I would probably try another sushi  place if and when I come back to New Orleans.

Love that there is another place walkable from UIndy for lunch options. Underclassmen take note: this is a 21+ establishment. I opted for the chili and a chopped salad, though will try a burger next time. The chili, while good, was more sloppy joe tasting than actual chili. Not much soup to it. The chopped salad was a happy surprise. This was no basic iceberg in a bowl. It was attractive and tasty with radishes and green olives and a few other things I've forgotten. The lettuce was soft greens -- maybe baby spinach? My meal (water to drink) was under $10 before tip. Jailbird is definitely worthy of a spot in the lunchtime rotation.

The service here is a little slow, and everytime I come in the place seems to be almost empty. You don't get a hot towel, and the service is not very welcoming either. 

Almost every roll on the menu has cucumber, even rolls that normally don't. The scallop roll I got was mostly cucumber rather than scallop. The dynamite roll was so gross I couldn't eat it. The texture is horrific: slimy, fatty, and basically just fish mush. The rolls were very small.

For $20, I can go to Mikimoto and get WAY better sushi in a nicer atmosphere.

My last visit here was not so great. They were busy and seemed very disorganized. Some of the people on the assembly line seemed to have no sense of urgency whatsoever, making the work of those at the register a nightmare, in turn, making me stand around in a very hot pizza kitchen in the already hot summer weather. For the price, I think I'll just start going to Little Ceasars. My husband and kids are not very descriminating about their pizzas, and I'm not really into paying so much money for dough, cheese, a few pepperonis, and a hard time to boot.

This is a great spot for a quick lunch. I've been here many times for lunch, and the prices are very reasonable. The service is always great too. 

For dinner, the sushi does not live up to the pricing. My husband and I purchased the rainbow roll ($15)and lsu roll ($11). Both were very small with thinly sliced pieces of fish on top. However, the fried rolls here are melt-in-your-mouth awesome, if only a little small. The tempura batter for shrimp and veggie tempura are light as air. 

The ambiance here is very relaxing and even a little romantic. That almost makes up for the tiny rolls.

Not even worth a star!! They want $15/hr my ass! They asked repeatedly asked what the order was. Our order wasn't even complicated. Then we get to the window to pay. The manager or girl at the window is telling two other employees what they should be doing, but in an unprofessional way.  Get to the second window, girl goes, what did you order!? The heck?!! You should know! You should have had that drink going before we got there and the bag of food ready to give to us. They weren't even slammed!  Never going back here again!
They need a lot of help!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We stayed here this weekend, I have to say I was very disappointed. The air conditioning went out in the hotel. It was  steamy hot in hallways , and the hallway smelled damp and musty . The restaurant was crappy for such an expensive hotel stay . They put us next to all the machinery elevator, ice maker , soda and food vending machines. I got high from the pot smell in the hallways. Also charged 10 bucs to park at there hotel and they're not responsible for anything that happens . To say the least this place is way overpriced. I won't be back .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I've always loved Dunkin Donuts growing up so right off the bat I was stoked to know we'll have one in Reno. But, for the past few visits, I always get disappointed. It doesn't matter what time of day, but they usually have very little donuts available and their coffee usually taste unappealingly bland. 

I got two dozen of donuts today and majority of it were the same flavor due to lack of donuts for whatever reason. In addition, I also tried their new Iced Caramel coffee which I thought was okay. 

Service wise its not too bad, they're usually fast and helpful. I just wish they have more of a variety like most donut places.

Stayed here a few times, once for a business trip and one for a car show, very friendly and nice experience. The rooms were fresh and as always coming to Hyatt hotel it's always up to par. Being a member of Hyatt for over 9 years they have always helped me and gave me an amazing experience. 

This hotel was a little different they did have a little out dated things, and it seemed a little old honestly, I wish they updated a few things, so I am giving them a 4 star for that reason only.

The front desk guy at nights were very nice and the morning staff were nice as well. 

Thank you guys for the great experience, will definitely be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I harpered my boyfriend to come with me (more like drive me out) to this ice cream place since I hadn't been in a good 4 years. The place was just as I remembered but I wish I remembered about that deadly bump that'll scraped the bottom of your bumper (please drive slow going up)
As far as the ice cream goes, I wasnt as wowed as I thought I would be. The ice cream was thick (I can't remember the name of what I got but it was vanilla and I got it with peanut M&M's). 
Boyfriend got a strawberry hard ice cream in a cone which was a lot better than mine tbh.

STAY AWAY! I can't believe Hilton would be associated with this place. My wife and I stayed here a few days ago in the "Bouganvilla" building. For starters there were homeless people sleeping on the grass less than 50 yards away. The lights around the facility had open wiring. Homeless people roam the halls at night, we called the front desk and recommended they lock the doors as the sign says they will lock at 8pm but no one ever came to lock them. The vegetation is overgrown. You WILL be disappointed, especially after paying the high rates!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A dark, dim corner bar which serves food.  There is no table service, order at the "kitchen."  Staff working the kitchen are surly, but the bartenders are friendly.  The food is good, but very SLOW to get to your table.  On a second trip, I went with friends at lunch.  We called our order in 30 minutes in advance and still had to wait for it to be ready when we arrived.  Burgers are good, as is the blackened chicken, but expect to wait.  Don't get the mac-n-cheese. Honestly there was little cheese and mainly plain noodles in my order, with some bagged shredded cheese slightly melted on top.

The service at this McDonald's is always shotty. At our most recent visit, we waiting at the drive thru speaker for at least 10 min after being told 2x to hold on and other cars orders in the other lane were being taken ahead of us. When we finally placed our order we had to repeat it 3x before half of it was rung in correctly and the repeat the last item another 2x.  

Then when we got to the window, the person on drive thru was the manager, and they had the wrong order ready for us. I try to give this location benefit of the doubt but unfortunately it doesn't seem to get better.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
