I just spent a week at this location and I want to say the entire staff from the front desk to housekeeping was exceptional. The Operational Manager Marie runs a tight ship and interjects only if needed. Her front desk staff know their job such as MiMi who is pleasant as your are greeted upon arrival. The evening staff is just as willing and courteous.

It worked out well for me since I needed a kitchenette and plenty of space for a 2 year old. I'm formally from the area so I was centrally locates near shopping malls and plaza and nearby park.

Kudos
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The bathrooms were updated last year and they definitely needed it.  The TVs were replaced a few months ago and other than a clearer picture there is no change and actually they are worse.  A few TVs don't have audio.  Most of the TVs you have to turn the volume up all the way to barely hear what is being said.  I have tried 3 different head phones and they are all the same and any volume there is is only in 1 ear.  The picture on half of the TVs is not even full screen.  This has been reported to staff (they really don't seem to care) and corporate has been called and emailed.  They never respond.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I ordered an iced latte and got an iced coffee. I asked if it was supposed to be a latte and the barista looked at the sticker and said no.
I assumed I mis-ordered and took the drink.
I took a sip and just randomly looked at the sticker, IT SAID LATTE. So I took it up and asked if I actually could have the latte I ordered and the barista seemed super cool about it. When my order was called , it was a hot latte even though I ordered ice.
I didn't feel like wasting another drink, so I just dealt with it. I've never been inside this Starbucks, it's clean and spacious but I most definitely wont be heading back to this location anytime soon.

Seems clean enough, the room is nicely sized, staff was polite, shower was strong and hot, breakfast was on par with other hotels (always avoid meats during buffets). 

My main gripe, the smell of dog urine. I can smell it in my room and in the hallways. They need to rip up the carpets and not allow animals. Also, the ironing board is terrible... It left a pattern on the shirt I was ironing, which a decent ironing board is a must when traveling because you don't want to look homeless of unkempt when arriving to a wedding/work function.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've been wanting to come here for a long time and unfortunately my first visit was during the time of COVID. However, the experience was still great and we felt very safe. They have excellent safety protocols in place.

We sat outside on the terrace which was beautiful and well spaced out.

Our server was attentive and friendly and also respectful of space and distancing.

My boyfriend ordered a steak and I ordered a vegetarian pasta dish. Both were excellent. Can't wait to return one day post COVID and perhaps eat indoors which also looked lovely.

Gigi's has been on Treasure Island for years and we had kind of written them off years ago, but we went there for dinner this week and were blown away by the great food!  We had a white pizza and salad and both were fantastic!  The pizza crust was thin, crispy and flavorful.  They managed to get the spices perfect on the white pizza, just enough garlic without over powering the cheese and the salad was perfect.  The decor is still dated and really dark, but don't let that scare you away, the food is excellent.

After scouring yelp for some sushi options, we stumbled upon Hot Tuna. We went by for Happy Hour where some of their sushi rolls are $4. The Florida and the Gator roll were both delicious. I opted to get mine without cream cheese, just not a fan of it. The food came out quickly and was nicely filled, it was a nice balance of fish and rice. We ordered another roll of the specialty menu, can't quite remember the name but it was wrapped in rice paper and had lettuce in it. This is definitely different from my average sushi roll, but it was a very pleasant surprise. I'd go back to get my sushi fix, besides you can't beat $4 sushi.

My daughter made a reservation here for 13 of us to celebrate her graduation. The owner greets you, seats you, takes your order, serves you. His supporting staff is quick and efficient. The food was delicious. They opened and poured our wine, and cut and served our cake. This is a simple and small restaurant with minimal staff. The owner works his butt off. Anyone who has complained that the service isn't the best, or they waited for their table or food, has no understanding of what it means to own and run your own small restaurant. For me the quality there was way more important than speed. If I want quick I'll go to McDonalds.

God bless airport hotels! We had a late flight into Florida and needed an immediate place to crash for the evening. This Marriott Tampa was ideal given our situation. We paid a premium for the convenience but it's totally worth it.

Pros:
*Convenience because it's in the airport.
*Large screen TV's in the guest suites.
*Late night bites (onsite & room service) are available at the bar until midnight.

Cons:
*Wifi is not included in your room fee.
*Semi dated décor.
*Outdoor pool was not available during our stay.
*USB ports on the nightstand lamps is not set up well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went here on recommendation from a friend. It's a cute restaurant on a slight hill which allows views of the Catalina Mountains. The decor is Mexican style using lots of color. I ordered chicken tortilla soup. There were far more tortillas in the soup than liquid. It was a large bowl which had little flavor. My friend requested chicken enchiladas with rice and beans. The enchiladas had little cheese or taste. The rice was clumped together and beans were boring. The positive experience revolved around the chips and salsa. Salsa was tasty

So fantastic to have Five Guys directly downtown in the Mile Square! In my humble opinion this is the best French Fries of any burger chain. They also understand that malt vinegar is the bomb with hot and salty fries. This location was crazy busy at 12:15pm on a Tuesday and it's to be expected because it is a fast and delicious lunch. The wait was not too long and I'm sure the fact that is just opened added to the crowd. Burgers are made to order; served hot and tasting as delicious as ever. I'm very happy to have Five Guys downtown.

First time at Bartaco and WOW! The food was fresh and full of flavor. Our server took the time to explain the menu and his favorites. We started with the guacamole made fresh in house. It was probably the best I've ever had. Crispy, salty tortilla chips scooped up chunky avocado, onion and cilantro. For dinner I ordered the falafel, duck and ahi tuna tacos. Each was about the size of three bites. My favorite actually was the falafel. What a kick it had! Unfortunately I didn't save room for the delicious churros I kept seeing. I guess we are coming back as soon as possible.

America's go to donuts and coffee is Dunkin' Donuts :) 

I randomly decided to stop at this location for an ice coffee and they had some freshly made blueberry munchkins which I love I ordered a couple an they gave my a whole box full because they had more than enough for the evening, so not to be wasteful they get their extras to costumers. That's super nice I really hate wasting food and the fact that they rather give it away than throw away the food is the reason I gave this location 5 stars!!

Also there is free WiFi and This is the placement was very clean.

We went there for Our Anniversary. I thought it would be really good because of the reviews.The hostess was so rude.I understand she's Belgium. I asked if I could get the frog legs as a entree .They were thrown on the plate.They were awful. My husband had the rack of lamb.He said it was good.My husband joking said the price of wine by the glass was kinda high.She told him he should stay home and drink
 I then order for dessert creme brulle.The top was burnt.Our bill was 150.$.Not including tip. I will never recommend this place.I have eaten in Palm Beach.And never have I been treated so rudely or had such bad food

Only tried sushi club because we were dog sitting for a friend on this side of town. Friday night around 7 is insanely busy - expect a long wait. Also, we didn't realize that Friday - Sunday is all you can eat for $22/person. My girlfriend and I only order 1 roll each (had soup and salad too) but they automatically wrote our tab for 2 all you can eat orders - giant price difference from the cost of 2 rolls total. They fixed it, no big deal. I wanted to try the hot and sour soup but they were out. Bums. The food was good, but nothing we plan to return for.

I love the food here. It's amazing, legit the best wings in town! The main problem I have is they take the phone off the hook and the other "number"(seems to be a cell phone they posted on the fb page) doesn't pick up. I want to spend my money here and I want the food but they just won't take my money ! pick up the phones and stop taking them off the hook ! You are making it impossible to get food from you ! it's so irritating that when we want to get food we automatically have our second choice ready because, surprise surprise, we can't get you on the phone . I will forever be sad about this because the food is golden.

The girl somehow seemed puzzled when I asked for a trim and to freshen up my layers. She had no system to her cut and as a result it was uneven. I could barely tell she took anything off. I don't think she was comfortable with what she was doing. She also didn't speak the whole time she was cutting so I felt very odd sitting there. I wasn't happy with the 15 minute wait either, considering I was next and 3 stylists weren't doing anything. I will not be going back, even though no one was rude to me. The cut was not even worth the bargain price.

Cafe Michelangelo is the "go to" local spot in Northeast Philadelphia and Bucks County. I've been coming here with my family since I was a child. 

There's plenty of seating for large groups, and a bar for those who just want to watch the game. In the summer there is also out door seating and they also have a bocce ball court.  

The usual dishes I typically get are the fried calamari, mussels in white sauce, and the chicken Caesar salad. Their tiramisu is hands down the best I ever had. This is a local staple I'll always dine in.

It was ok. It's an older hotel in need of sprucing up and repairs.  It smells weird (thank God we travel with a diffuser), the ice vending machines are out of order, the drinking fountain is out of order and there are very odd looking "repairs" in the bathroom. See picture.  The bed was comfortable though and the linens were new and up to date. The carpet was not thoroughly vacuumed. There was a piece of dog food right on the floor in plain sight when we walked in.
I wouldn't stay here again unless it was the only place with vacancy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Breakfast for 12 is always challenging.... especially when you add the NHL and Gasparilla! We had great seating outside. We arrived.at.9am.to find our table ready.  We were immediately greeted by a server Elaine who was exceptional. She was supported by several servers and proceeded to take our drink/food orders.  Elaine managed our orders and kept the entire table quite happy. My eggs Benedict were awesome...so were the egg sandwiches!  All.served quickly and hot....no one was disappointed.  We had a great time and strongly recommend  the Waterside Cafe, especially outside seating on a beautiful day.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We used to visit this hotel regularly when it was Fess Parker's and loved it!  Now it is remodeled and clean but very unsatisfactory. They did away with many of the nice amenities. It is a good location and clean and the staff is pleasant but whatever you ask for they don't have or are out of.  The food is very uninteresting and we left the hotel to eat most meals. The casual restaurant in the lobby is now only open for breakfast and the only lunch option is the bar with a very limited and uninspired selection. We'll be looking for a new place to stay in SB!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A great place for a quick bite or drink in peddlers village. Even when there's events at peddlers village and looks like there is going to be a wait,I've only waited 15 minutes. And Even when it is busy service is amazing. Great sandwiches,burgers,soups and salads. My only complaint is there and tables and booths and they kind of jammed as many tables as they could fit along the windows in a cramped space so you're always pushed up against your table or bumping chairs with the person at the table behind you. Wish they would take one table away to make a little bit of breathing room. So I would ask for a booth or sit at the bar!

Initial impressions are everything. We walked  in a minute before opening. The wall was painted like a mural and we could see the chefs hard at work prepping for the evening through the open kitchen concept. But there was a huge problem, we didn't feel welcomed. When I come to a "traditional and family owned" Italian restaurant, I want that feeling. This unwelcoming theme resonated for the remainder of the meal. Sadly, the server added to it.

The plus side. The food was damn good. We enjoyed the veal medallions, squid ink seafood pasta, and eggplant rollitini. There wasn't a morsel left. The veal was perfection.

We decided to splurge and stay at the Hilton Santa Barbara this past weekend. The property is walking distance from the beach, pier and many restaurants. With your stay, you receive complimentary biking passes and wine. Without the pass, the bike rental range $13+ for every two hours. Overall, the room was clean and spacious, and the bed was very comfortable. Hilton as a brand is always reliable but in my opinion, this location was a bit overpriced for what they're offering. If price is an issue for you, I would consider looking at hotels close by (on Cabrillo Blvd) that can give you the same feel and vibe.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Took my kids in to get the highest prices popsicles they had ever had. Stumbled upon this place headed somewhere else and decided to go with it. 

The place was simple and to the point. Pick from a huge variety of flavors, pay, then enjoy your treat. 

I had pineapple margarita, mojito, and cookie butter. The pineapple was a miss for me, the mojito was ok, but the cookie butter was phenomenal. The flavors are pretty rich and pretty spot on. 

I would try it again for myself when in town, but probably wouldn't buy my kids $4 popsicles again. Lol

Can I tell you, MEXICAN food- this is the place to be!!!
I took my brother here after I sold him a house- a celebratory lunch :)
First time, but not the last!  We yummied over the lunch menu, finally picked our pair and opted for chips, fresh salsa and guacamole and HOLEY MOLEY GUACAMOLE! 
was it yumm- o!
We shared in the fish tacos, the enchiladas, the margaritas, oh my!
all in all, a wonderful atmosphere, friendly staff, fresh mex, it doesn't get any better than this.  Can't wait to go back with my hubby for date night! or a late lunch......

The service was quite poor on a not so busy sj day evening. Hostess seated us at a table after telling us everyone complains about this table (it's right next to the door so you feel the cold winter draft all evening long). I'd be willing to forget the device if the food was great but sadly the food is mediocre at best. Tried the garlic bread which was okay and the cacio peppe. This recipe is not supposed to have vegetables in it especially leafy greens and especially if they don't add to the flavor. Will not be going back!

This review is for salads only. I have given this place 3 tries and every time I am less than satisfied. Today I went back to try the Med Salad which is supposed to include cucumbers, tomatoes, peppers, chick peas and feta cheese. I asked to add edamame which they left out and there was no feta cheese. I also wanted the dressing on the side and instead received an extremely over-dressed salad. 
I basically thew the whole thing out. They do have really good rolls and the pizza looks good, but I won't be ordering a salad from there again.

To preface this bad review, I want to say that I have been to this restaurant three times in the past.  My previous experiences were positive, but this time was absolutely ridiculous.

This time I had a horrible experience with the wait time, service and food quality.  

They may have been short staffed, as our waitress seemed to be split between too many tables/areas.  

Our food took forever to get to us, and it was cold when it arrived.  Even after we complained, the manager was not apologetic in the least.  We had a guest in town from France, and this was her last meal before leaving tomorrow.  

I will not be returning.

Vic's is great if you stick to the 3 roll special.

The 3 roll special pricing is unbeatable here in Center City - you get 3 rolls for roughly $13. Unfortunately, it's not very filling. I've also tried their tiger roll, spicy combo, and the Samson roll, all of which are highly rated. My reaction to them all is, 'meh'. For that pricing, I don't think the flavors are strong enough. In fact, I don't think sriracha mayo and eel sauce are enough to bring the flavors together. I was quite disappointed by the mediocrity of the taste of the speciality rolls.

I would come back, but maybe I'll just stick to the 3 roll special.

to inquire about amenity, I called the front desk at 9:39 a.m. on Oct 31, 2018. 

The women's response is "I don't know.", which sounded shockingly unprofessional. 

She should have at least put me on hold to inquire some senior people when she did not know. I am not sure if she had an attitude or was not properly trained. 

This is the predominant reason for me to end up avoiding this place  for my trip to Nashville, as I feel her level professionalism may likely be an indicator of the service level of Hyatt Place Nashville/Brentwood
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Thanks to the rain the line wasn't too long and we were able to get a table without waiting! The drinks and food were served super fast. The Berry Pancakes was not only great but also came in such huge portion which might have been the biggest pancakes I have ever had! The farmers breakfast was also good but somehow the egg does not feel like 2 eggs... We also got the chocolate chip cookie which was yummy and chewy! Matcha latte and chai latte were quite nice as well. The whole indoor dinning experience was pretty good. Will probably come back for dinner sometime in the future!

The food is amazing but I just had an encounter with an extremely rude delivery guy. I was told the total was $15 so I made sure I bought down $17 so he could keep the change as his tip. He told me the total was $16.34 so now he could only keep the change from the $17. Before I could tell him I would go back upstairs to give him a bigger tip he immediately looked at the money I gave him and said "no tip". When I told him to keep the change he continued to say something smart that I could clearly hear because I walked away. This is not okay and unfortunately I will not be ordering from this establishment again.

Eh... I have had much better service in airport restaurants. Granted, it was ~8:00 and I'm sure the servers were exhausted from feeding hungry travelers. 

I had a chicken ceased salad and it was alright. Nothing to rave about, but surely overpriced for what it was. The only problem I had with the restaurant is that my (plastic) plate was chipped... I was a little surprised they keep chipped plates. The restaurant also didn't look the cleanest...

Probably won't come back if I ever have a layover in this airport again.

First time trying this place. We ordered tri tip & chicken combo that came with two sides and tortillas, tri tip burrito and the pork burrito. Yes, this is mostly a Mexican restaurant. That being said, the best thing we ate was the rotisserie chicken. Spot on delicious. The burritos were really salty. Couldn't eat half of it. The rice was good on the combo plate so we've narrowed the salt culprit to the beans. Would not order again.
But the chicken was tasty, moist and crispy skinned. Worth a revisit next time we see a movie.

I'm a regular here. Their $1 coffee is too good to pass up. I've had troube with mobile ordering more times than not but I'll keep 
trying. There's some really good deals on the app. 
Today I was very disappointed with my buttermilk tenders. They shrunk in half, literally. I posted a picture. I showed them to the staff and they thought they looked fine so I'm thinking this is the new normal.
Is it the cleanest? No but it's in a Walmart and a very busy one. They are regularly cleaning the lobby but a family four can tear this place up in less than 2 minutes
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Needed to open an account when I arrived in Reno. So far, glad I decided on Wells Fargo. So many locations, convenience of the drive up ATMs, drive up Tellers at some locations, my phone app. which I use often (I know most banks have apps nowadays), very very friendly workers, and most of the branches have lollipops, Weeeee Doggie, which I tell my nieces I got them lollipops and I'm a cool uncle. Not just a pretty face people! Hahahahaha! 
  Anyways, 4 Stars because I had a few small issues, but nothing real bad and it was resolved. Like I said, so far, happy I chose Wells Fargo!

I wish good intentions resulted in good food, and I wish I could give this place a good review.  This is literally the worst pizza I've ever had in my life, including cafeterias and airports.  It seems like they just slapped some ingredients on a pita and threw it in a toaster oven.  I've seen more appealing dishes come out of a college dorm room.  Even worse, the sauce is SWEET.  SO, SO SWEET.  I ended up throwing it away.  :(  I'm going to give the place a bonus star, though, because the fries were actually pretty amazing.

I've heard a lot about Buddy Brew and been wanting to try it.  Coffee is my favorite meal of the day and since I consume an average of 3-4 cups per morning, it's only fitting that I try the good stuff when I can.

Buddy Brew operates a café inside Oxford Exchange and conveniently provides their coffee to the restaurant. 

I ordered a cup, just plain, black coffee. It was dark, rich and had citrusy notes. The menu did not specify which roast it was but Buddy Brew has quite a few.

That being said, it was an excellent cup of coffee and only $3. Solid go-to for a quality cup of joe from a local company.

I tried Pumpkin for the first time last week, and had high expectations from what I have been told in the past! The restaurant is small, so do make a reservation. Nice ambiance and helpful staff. I ordered the burrata appetizer, salmon entree, and had the panna cotta for dessert. All three dishes were delicious. Both my appetizer and main courses used different seasonings or flavor combinations that I hadn't had before, and I really enjoyed them. Overall for dessert I wish they had more of a variety for options. 

Overall great restaurant, do make a reservation, and remember byob and cash only!

The place has the typical international speciality store vibe that you see with Asian, Indian or Mexican grocery stores, a lot products pack into a tight space. I did notice carry variety Cuban, Puerto Rican and some Mexican products.
We came specifically for there lunch counter type prepared food. We order 2 plates, which came with carnitas, Spanish type rice and fried plantains. The carnitas was good, refried so it had crispy bits but the rice had no flavor and plantains were a bit over cooked. Not my favorite but it wasn't terrible either.

Wow. One of the best dinners I have had in Philly. It's a very small, intimate space, which I actually loved. The wait staff was so attentive (it's almost guaranteed with such a small space!), very much accommodating to our party, and the food was superb. There were some new ingredients in my dish, which was fun! I had the scallop dish that came with this new vegetable I have never tried, can't remember the name but it looked like a succulent, and it looked like it was going to be dry but it was crispy, juicy, and so so delicious.

There are always many clients at Protein Nails, but they always seem to have enough staff to care for all in an efficient manner. Many of the nail techs are abrupt and few speak English, so don't plan to go there for conversation. However, my nails always look very nice and the services are reasonably priced. Owner Denise Nguyen prefers cash or checks only, but there is an ATM inside the shop. I have been going there about 10 months, after trying several other nail businesses first. Protein Nails is my favorite.

It's a Dunkin' chain, so the expectations are not sky high for over the top service or crafted with care food items. It's not always the cleanest inside, though lately it has been a lot cleaner. It's never too busy and mobile orders are always ready promptly. 

I've come to enjoy this location as a regular stop when I'm in the area. It's consistent, quick, and I've never had my oat milk swapped for almond milk so that's a plus! At most Dunkin's, I try to order ahead so I'm not waiting around. With this location, I feel safe to order at the counter because they don't keep me waiting.

I've gotten a lot of pedicures growing up. I'm talking twice a month April to October for 8 years. The salon is pretty standard, in a strip mall. Clean. I walked in and was the only one. I got seated immediately. All the staff were on their phones or tablets, that was amusing. One was asleep in a massage chair. 
This pedicure was pretty standard. The green scrub was....interesting. I'm not sure what the point was actually. They did lotion and massage and the hot towel. All pretty standard.
My one complaint is that the water my feet were in and out of was luke warm, almost cold.

Very poor experience at this location, I've brought my car in twice for electronic issues and upon picking it up the issues weren't resolved or they created other issues. This last time I had to have my alternator and battery replaced (charged over $1,400 for services). They had my car for 5 days, and upon picking it up had another set of electronic issues. Do the technicians not check over their work? Or do they just over charge customers and create more issues so they can do it to you all over again. 

Do yourself a favor and find another location for your servicing needs, I would not recommend toyota butler to anyone.

ok I'm really not trying to be that person but I'm just so over the M street restaurants. Just like any M street restaurant the ambiance is great but the food and experience is extremely underwhelming. I ordered the black spaghetti that was their signature dish. The size was small and I did not get the hype as it was basically pasta with marinara sauce with shrimp but with a $28 price tag, cuuuuute. To say I am not amused is an understatement. The only reason I even ate this dish was because I was 3 glasses of wine deep (whoops!)

Final thoughts:
Is this place horrible? No
Is this place great? No
Will I go back? No
Would I recommend? No

This hotel is an absolute PERFECT place to stay if you are visiting the historic sites of Philadelphia.  It's just a couple of blocks from the Liberty Bell and Independence Hall, oh, and the hotel is great.  The staff is so friendly and helpful--I really can't say enough about them.  My room was clean, comfortable and spacious.  I appreciated the several conveniently place outlets--no hunting for a place in this room to charge your phone or plug in the iron.  Also, the individually packaged Aveda soap bars and assorted toiletries were even a step above the usual Paul Mitchell standards.  I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Pros:
- Staff was always pleasant and very nice. 
- Clean hotel
- Excellent and safe location

Cons:
- No mini fridge in rooms (no cold water bottles or leftovers)
- No shower hooks (Why? Seems pretty basic...)
- TV channels (half the channels had no signal)
- A/C was noisy and loud
- Construction every morning starting at 9:00am
- Paper thin, thin walls

Overall: If you're looking for a place that's close to bars, restaurants and you're a heavy sleeper, this hotel will be just fine. They do provide ear plugs, however, I could still hear our neighbors at 5:30 am in the morning. We stayed on the courtyard side (pool view) and it was very quiet.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is definitely NOT a super Giant. My complaint here is the salad bar-the choices first of all were terrible-probally 15 choices of HEAVY pre-made salads, but no beets, no chick peas, no peas, the salad it self looked like it was ready to expire-i got a salad anyway with basic spinach,cauliflower and some cherry tomatoes as that was the only kind they offered. I got it back to my office and it was terrible-It just did not taste good at all-I just moved my office to this area and I am finding out the where to go places-this is not  one of those places.

The Red Key Tavern is a neighborhood watering hole that's been around for 70 years! We would know as we accidentally went for the first time on their anniversary, April 2nd. 

This place is a no frills, seat yourself place. The menu is small but cheap. There are no beers on tap, only bottles and cans. 

The cheeseburger was good! A thicker homemade patty with the fixings you want. The lettuce and tomato were fresh! They don't have many sides but I opted for the potato salad. A step down from the burger as it was very blended like mashed potatoes and pretty bland. I'm sure that recipe has existed for as long as this place!

This is the second time I have come to this location and the drive thru lady has taken my phone through the window for my mobile coupon. Has management not explained that that isn't allowed? All they are supposed to do is ask for the 3 digit code on my screen. Not to mentioning never get my sauces for my nuggets & my fries are half way filled. Today while I was in the drive thru the lady asked me at least 7 different times what I said because the background noise was so loud. I used to be a manager at the one on east Washington st and I know they can do better than that.

Ive used this auto wash a few times and will not continue to use it. The 2 stars are for only the do it yourself bays which if you have endless cash and want to burn calories, wil get your car semi clean. There is no dryer in the bays also. The touchless wash is inept and will not clean the car without leaving dirty residue. The dryers are extremely inefficient as they blow cold air while the sprayers are still on and continue to drip. Royce industries needs to update their touchless wash equipment as it does a poor job.

Was in the other side of town so decided to try this place. With the popular name of this chain I would expect a better donut. Ordered the 12 box and got a mix of filled and powered.  Staff was young and seemed confused most of the time. Pricing was decent. My issue is the quality of the donuts.  The filling in each one was basically nothing. I would say in each filled donut there was a quarter sized portion.  It seems they are skimping on fillings of their donuts. Other than that not bad overall but doughboys puts these guys to shame. I'll stick with doughboys.

Tried this car wash again after about a year of having a poor experience here before where it is a very Ineffective wash and pricey. This time I went through and purchased the full throttle wash at $10.  The attendants were less then thrilled and weren't really friendly.  The wash uses a combination of soap soft brushes and a pitiful dryer at the end.  The attendants supposedly scrub the car pre wash but as you can see by my pictures attached that was a worthless attempt. Won't be using this place ever again. Sad part is my car wasnt even horribly dirty and this place still couldn't get all the dirty parts off.

After a long hiatus from this location, I decided to return when I was in the area again. I saw that they had added a sub shop to this location. Weird. I got my usual original tart, which I love to top with granola or fresh fruit. I was disappointed because I had to settle for some strawberry (the only fruit available) that was soggy and seemed like it had been sitting there all day. The rest of the toppings were just junk. Then the guy that checked me out was rude and asked why I picked tart because he doesn't like tart, which he kept repeating until I just walked out the door. Um, okay. This location is going downhill fast...

Stopped by for dinner while visiting my parents.  I really enjoyed it.  

I had the crab cakes with the pineapple salsa.  There was just enough salsa to add sweetness to the saltiness of the seafood.  I was most impressed, however, with the meatiness of the crabcake.  It was a thick patty, chock full of shredded crab.  I really enjoyed it. 

It's been a few days since the visit, so I don't totally recall the quality of the service, but it certainly wasn't bad.  If back in town, I would definitely visit again. 

Recommended!

Tim is a rare breed: an honest mechanic. I took my 2008 Civic in for an oil change and a check on the front control arm bushings. Tim not only told me that they were in great shape and didn't need to be replaced but took me out to the garage and actually showed me what good condition they were in for myself. He also provided a short list of other items to watch (along with estimated prices for each) and actually walked me around the vehicle and showed me each one. Zero sales pressure. This is my new spot for auto work!

I have been to Speranza multiple times and will keep coming back. The atmosphere is great- like a restaurant out of a city versus a little town. The pizza is a medium size but is thin, crispy, and delicious. I have tried everything from the margarita to the meatball and my favorite, the Parma. All have been stunning. The must try? Their gelato! The peanut butter is to die for. 

Great little spot for chic, South Jersey dwellers who don't want to drive to Haddon/CWood. Pizza, salad and dessert for around $20. They accept LocalFlavor deals which will cut your bill in half if you plan a day ahead!

This location is HUGE and we really liked it. Harry at the front desk was great. We didn't have our card on us. He had us write our names down and he said it would take some time to locate our membership so he had us proceed to work out while he looked us up. Harry did find us because when Steve went to buy a drink he remembered to give him the Black Card discount. The facilities were well maintained and the restrooms were clean. They had both individual showers and stalls for changing and even had blowdryers. There were rooms separated for stretching, abs, etc. Excellent gym with exceptional service.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I was really disppointed with this place. After reading the reviews I was really excited to try out a new restaurant, especially one with gluten free options. There are no other Italian places that offer gluten free in the New Orleans area. When I asked for the gluten free focaccia they told me it was only available during lunch. They said my only option would be the gluten free pasta. While the regular pasta is all handmade, the gluten free pasta was obviously from a box and the texture was really strange. The tomato sauce was watery and bland. The service was really good but unfortunately that was the only positive thing I can say.

Came to Cinder House the week it opened and I was not disappointed! I was a frequent visitor of what it was previously (Cielo) but I definitely appreciated the idea of rebranding and loved it! We came in August and sat outside, with the Arch right in front of us which was one of the best parts! We had the feijoada which was a delicious bowl of "ham hocks, braised smoked pork belly, braised pork cheeks, braised beef, and served with orange segments" as well as fresh Missouri trout! Recommend- for locals and visitors alike!

Here for the 1st time ever!!!
I won a pair of tickets to the Tastful Affair to benefit FoodOutreach St. Louis.
I can't review all the restaurants that participated (over 25) but we had some Favorites.
Kingside Diner, Layla. Mushroom Naturally, Bugatti's, Social Affair,  Serendipity and Tempus!!
From everything from the Silent Auction. To the food to the Dancing to the Live Auction bidding.. it was a fantastic time.
The Theme was 70's Disco so you had some pretty great get ups.  And who doesn't love 70's Disco Music.
I am hoping Outreach raised alot of $$ for their great organization.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Staff here was in a word phenomenal. Olivia, who handled housekeeping for us on one of the nights we were there, did an outstanding job and left us a thoughtful note in the room upon our return from an evening out. Valet guys run to get your car and you can telephone before going to the lobby so they can retrieve your car and have it ready upon arrival. Live music 5-545pm every day lends to the beautiful ambience of the area against a stunning desert sunset backdrop, especially if you're sitting outside at the 

I will have fond memories of this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I was so excited to move to a place with Krispy Kremes! I have been to this location a couple times and have yet to be thrilled. On the first trip they had a minimal selection of doughnuts and said they were waiting for a delivery (I didn't realize they didn't make them fresh in stores anymore). The next time they had a ton of doughnuts but they were all mislabeled and I quickly realized they had a lot of only 3 types of doughnuts...bummer! Overall I the doughnuts we were able to get were good, even if they weren't our first (or even second) choices. The staff is always pleasant and apologetic for the doughnut selection.

For such a tiny gym $45 a month is insane. And when I got my membership I was told after 6 months I could cancel because I live 20 miles from the gym. Well went to cancel and I have to pay a fee to cancel. Something I was NOT told when I originally expressed my concern about the distance. Can we say sneaky car salesman. Out of all of the gyms in Reno Anytime is the most expensive and considering we have no other options in the North Valleys seems they like taking advantage of that. Tiny and expensive. Enjoy waiting in line for a machine.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
So if I were in New Orleans and I needed a go-to dog friendly hotel that was reasonably priced, Aloft would definitely be on my list. The rooms are adequate, minimalist decor and the staff was great, attentive and always gave Lia lots of attention. 

There is a dog park a couple blocks away at Duncan Park, but when we walked over that way early on a Saturday morning...it wasn't the most pleasant walk, so we chose not to go back that way any other time during our stay.

Overall a great experience, and a four "woof" review for sure.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is actually a little gem in my opinion. The rates are good, the staff are super friendly, and the location is pretty good. Some people might shy away from it because it's not on the main beach but the part of the beach in front of this hotel is more private. This place has its own private deck that extends out on the beach . You don't even have to bring a chair and umbrella on the beach to enjoy the ocean. There are also two beach bars on either side of the hotel so it's easy to get drinks.  If you are one of those people that want to stay in the room and just enjoy the view, don't go here. Otherwise I recommend
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I go to this Starbucks everyday sometimes twice a day. Usually I let little things go because I still always enjoy the drink but today set me off. The girl asked for a tip, I asked for light ice and they filled it up and I found 4 bugs in my ice. I figured since my cup was so full I might as well eat it and I went to go eat one and something looked off to me about it and that's when I noticed it. And she didn't even offer me my receipt. I am definitely finding a new place to go. I had to over pay got treated rude and found a bug. A

Tried this restaurant for the first time today and I am very impressed. The service wasn't great but don't expect amazing service when you're looking for an authentic Chinese food experience like this. I had the beef tendon cooked home style and crispy ducks and both dishes was amazing. The beef tendon was soft and melts in your mouth. It has the right level of spice and my mouth is watering right now as I type out of this review. The crispy duck definitely takes the cake for me though. It was tender and juicy but the outside was crispy. Great food!

We  just explored the south end going into Indian shores , Indian rock etc and was heading back to the hotel in Clearwater. We liked how it was more easy to find parking and decide to stop in for late lunch eat. This place had some people at bar but for most part kind of empty. There were lots of TV's as would be expected it had more of a bar type feel and the food was as such. They have attempted to spin some items such as maple syrup with sweet potatoe fries that had drizzle of cinnamon and the onion rings had dipping sauce as well. Service was good and food was ok

They just did a complete overhaul on all the car washing equipment within the past year (ish).
The people are always friendly and move the line along as fast as possible. 
The car wash itself is very good in deed. My 2 cars always look great after every wash. 
I am so satisfied with this car wash that I paid 49.99 a month for unlimited "ultimate " washes. 10 times a day if I wanted. 
With one wash costing 20$.. the unlimited is a steal. I wash my cars all the time. 
And with the unlimited,  you dont wait in line. They have a Express lane that you drive right through.

Salsa here was pure tomato paste and spicy salsa was all spice. Fajitas came in a good size portion but were very bland. We ended up having to drench the meat in lime and salsa to taste anything
We also ordered a michelada, it also lacked flavor but was a very good size! The margaritas were very sweet and came in a small margarita glasses that was closer to a martini glass size. Prices for everything were average. Service was alright, had to ask repeatedly for napkins to be brought and never got water refills. Overall it was just alright.

This would be a fine gym if it weren't $70 a month. I would say the equipment is equivalent to a planet fitness so why pay more than the $10 month they charge? 

They offer classes but at odd times and the instructors are not great. I sweat a lot in the class but I think it's because the rooms are kept pretty hot. 

The people who review saying they have good customer service are delusional they don't give a shit about their customers. I had a guy harass me a few mornings in a row and they laughed and said oh yeah he does that. So that's great.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
In the covid-era of things, Oak Oven is still open and doing curb-side pick up! 

After craving a good slice of pizza that would be reminiscent of one that I would have from Jersey, I think I found a decent place that will partially fill that hole for the time being. 

I got the carne pizza  For the price, I wish it was a bit larger but then again, I'm spoiled with tristate area prices. The crust also could have been a bit crunchier, but other than that I have no other complaints. I will definitely be coming back again.

A good taco place with a good atmosphere 
It opened up recently after being closed for Covid and before you step inside, you can smell the heavenly scent of steak being cooked. 

Other than that, however, the place is okay for the price. The tortilla chips were a bit stale, and when my steak tacos came out, it was on the cooler side. The taco shells are also very thin for the amount of meat and stuffing they give you (which is a good thing!) - however, usually, places will give you two shells to compensate. 

I got the steak tacos and the oyster tapas. Both were just okay for the price.

The best gluten free pizza I've ever had!  I love that you can get as many toppings as you like for the same price. Pizza cooked quick and in a hurry. I go for the shredded mozzarella over the balls which is the default I believe. I would give a 5 star but SUPER disappointed they don't utilize any of the more developed delivery services. You can only order through Postmates for delivery and they are expensive and both times I ordered through them the cheese slid to one side with it all sliding completely off with my last order.

I landed in Tampa and craved Udon but didn't want to drive too far from my hotel. When I arrived around 12:30pm the place looked closed but to my surprise it was not. The lighting is very dim and it has a laid back atmosphere. The Udon was satisfying and came with fried rice and soup. I also tried the shrimp tempura roll, kimchi, and shrimp tempura appetizer. Everything was delicious and the hostess/waitress was more than accommodating. She even packed my meal when I left. I didn't drink but the couples next to me really seemed to enjoy the Kobe Long Beach two for one special. Being that the entire meal was only $31.95 I'll be back for sure.

After going to this restaurant for several years the most recent orders have been terrible. We love the buffalo blue cheese pizza but the last 3 times has been very soggy and super greasy! We called and spoke with them when this first started and the manager told me when I ordered to tell them to drain the chicken so it isn't as wet. (its marinated in buffalo) we did that tonight and there was nothing different. Still soggy and extremely greasy. Looks like i'm done with vetture's and that really stinks because I really, really liked it up to now. :(

I'm an elite member and I had a reservation for 2pm. I asked if there was anything available at an earlier time because my checkout of my hotel is at 11am and didn't want to haul our luggage around all day with us, they said they had nothing available. When we got here all they had available was a Dodge Journey, which has no blue tooth option. The staff was very unfriendly, rude and short with me and had a little sarcastic undertone when saying it was the week of Mardi Gras. I have dealt with many Enterprise locations and this by far is the most disappointing experience I have ever had. Go anywhere else.

Never ever again. I brought my dog here twice. The first time they gave him zero treats or even made him feel comfortable. How hard is it to buy a bag of treats when customers are paying hundreds of dollars! The second time I brought him was during covid. His appointment was at at 10 am. Totally routine, they were just looking at a bump. They would not call back to tell us when we could get him. Finally they answered and said they were on lunch so we could pick him up at 2pm! 4 hours later!!! He's a rescue with separation anxiety. Screw this place I am never ever going back. Show some compassion and buy some damn treats!

The staff was very friendly and compliant with all the COVID-19 restrictions and rules. The inside atmosphere is rustic and has a lot of pretty Italian landscape murals on the walls. All entrees come with either soup or salad. The salad comes with mixed greens and an array of salad dressing options. I got the Scallops Savoia which was very similar to Marsala. The mushrooms were tasty.  The Scallops were a little gritty but also a pizzeria in the burbs so can't be overly picky, but they were large and not rubbery. Overall the dish was good!

One of the worst McDonalds I've ever been to. I'm not judging this on one visit because that would be unfair. This is the closest McDonald's to my house so I visit it frequently and I have had a string of bad visits to this location from waiting 15 minutes at the pay window for a McDouble and a drink, being charged for a additional meal that I did not order or receive and forgetting to give my debit card back multiple times. I can go on but you get the point. I know it's McDonalds and my expectations should already be set low, but this location needs better night staffing.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I wish 0 stars was available for this rude and inconsiderate office. My insurance wasn't going through on their end, and the receptionist was BEYOND rude to me. For some reason, my old insurance plan was populating on their system. I was trying to resolve it with her and figure out my options, and she cut me off and said "ok well let's stop talking now." We were on the phone for only a little over 5 minutes. I just wanted to know if I could still keep my appointment and have my insurance pay for it later, or if I should reschedule. That receptionist was super unhelpful and rude. DO NOT GO.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I never knew this place existed until a friend who has lived here his whole life took me. It was definitely what was needed after a long hot day and reminded me of my own hometown ice cream stand. I got the medium waffle cone with choc/vanilla swirl and chocolate sprinkles. The only reason I gave 4 instead of 5 stars was I ordered just vanilla but I wasn't going to complain about something like that so I enjoyed what I was given. The waffle cone was sweet and crispy as it should be and it was all around a yummy treat.

I order from this place pretty frequently because it is extremely close to my apartment. Sometimes they let me call and place a delivery order, sometimes they tell me to go online and order through grubhub. Whenever I use grubhub it takes 30+ min longer. Crab ragoon fried dumplings are my favorite chinese food and they make them terribly here
 :( There is barely any filling AT ALL. It's mainly just an empty fried dumping. Their fried rice is my go to and my boyfriend likes the sweet and sour chicken. This place is okay but do not order the crab ragoon. soooo terrible

My wife and I have been bringing our dogs to NHV for many years.  I highly recommend Doctor Gonzalez.  We have always appreciated Doctor Gs love for our pets, his compassion, and veterinarian knowledge is awesome.  Doctor Gonzalez is a special Vet and once you meet him with your pet you will understand his connection and love for animals.  We have been through a lot with Doctor G, to include putting down our beautiful girl Rylee Rue in 2018.  We will continue to visit Doctor Gonzalez for our pets medical needs.  Thank you Doctor G for being the awesome person that you are.

This McDonalds used to be one of the best in Philadelphia, but has seriously gone down hill. The manager JoAnne actually wanted to charge me for ice that I put in my own cup. (As an FYI I usually have Ice in my INSULATED cup but I hadn't filled it up and just fill the cup I get from them with tea to put in it) 

This isn't a problem at the two McDonalds in South Philly or any other McDonalds that I've been to. So I didn't expect it to be an issue here, especially since I've frequented it often for the past 25 years.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Dropped a couple stars because I've been waiting for 20-25 min. In line to pickup my Starbs and they should've posted by the Drive Through window that they are not allowing customers to pickup the order inside because I put my mobile order in, shopped at Aldi and tried to hop in to grab my drink but no luck - they're not allowing people inside for picking up their orders until May 23 FYI! I hopped back in line and it's awful - still waiting for a good while...I have to remind myself to never come here on the weekend!

I really love this super Publix! 

It's not as close as the other Publix, so we don't stop by as often or else I'd love to come here instead.

This location is clean and I get seafood here because it's very fresh. Today, they had Snow Crab clusters for $10.99 vs. normal price of $13.99. I also love getting my seafood steamed, such as catfish with Cajun seasoning for FREE - this way I don't have to dirty a pan when I get home.

For the most part, shopping their BOGO or items on discount is the smartest because it can def. Get expensive if you don't!

0.50 for a soft service ice-cream cone? I'm all in - got a big serving that I greedily ate all of it on my drive back home from Ruskin to Tampa after attending an event. Also, they keep on sending me coupons for BOGO whoppers + discounted meals, but I usually prefer McDonald's or Wendy's. I was pleasantly surprised by these deals - definitely worth checking out in the future. 

I received fast service with only a couple in front of me; it was 8:30pm at night, so it was slower compared to peak times. The bathroom was clean & loved all the comfortable booths they had!

Greasy food is a must after a night of drinking at home.

Their Spicy Chicken sandwich is not as good compared to Popeye or Chick Fil A. It has a spicy mayo sauce that tastes great - not too spicy or mild. 

Their fries are good when it's freshly made. The McDouble was just OK - fries and burger were less than stellar compared to what we've had.

We ordered through the app. For curbside delivery and it was ready in 10 min. & saved $2 on any order +$10! The coffee for a 0.99 is fantastic - 1/5 the price of Starbs & always have a deal on their app. 

Parking is alright - just the right number of spots by front entrance to the place.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Standard dive bar, would've given them 4 stars, but the bartender wasn't the nicest. I get it & think a positive attitude goes a long way - just sayin'.

POSITIVES:
-$2.50 Corona/Corona Light or Busch/Busch Light until 3 am (we arrived on a Sun. afternoon around 3pm). They have 3-4 drink options, so I'm down for those specials!
-A short list of food that included BBQ.

IMPROVEMENTS:
-No music, so we paid to play 4 songs for $2. Felt awfully quiet w/out any...
-Mens' bathroom had urinals with no dividers and toilets had half dividers/walls erected...LOL. You don't get any privacy whatsoever, so best make your business fast per my hubs.

Flat out, I love this place.  They have very good pizza, excellent chicken cheese steaks, fantastic soups, all for a fair price in a kid-friendly atmosphere. Never once have I been disappointed in their service.  Are there better places for fancy pizza? Sure, but not in the Newtown/Yardley area.  And I'm not dragging my kids to Center City or NYC for pizza.  By the way, I'm a beef/steak guy through and through but I get the Buffalo chicken cheesesteak regularly and they have a grilled veggie sandwich with provolone that even I would order.  My wife loves their chicken salad sandwich.  I've been a repeat customer for about a decade now.

My wife and I each have a membership. Both are attached to our credit card. I was told it would not be a problem adding my daughter if she likes it. I tried to add her and they want us to use my checking account. With all of the hacking going on today it is dumb of someone to do. When I asked for a corporate number, they refused to give it to me. So I asked for an email to the owner, they refused also. I have no way to file a complaint. If I owned a franchise I would want to know when customers are unhappy about something but the GM of riverview feels they dont need to know.

Craig Chaykin
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
The reviews led us to this fairly new place. We ordered drinks and appetizer and entree. 

My red wine was brought out in a brandy glass? 
Our appetizer came way after our entrees were served 
My husband was given the wrong beer. After he asked our server she assured that was the right one. It wasn't until we flagged another that confirmed what we knew. 

The food was tasty, however part of eating is out is also the experience. They definitely need to train their staff more. They were very nice, but a little clueless

On a weekend, this place is packed and has a good energy. Being from Chicago, I noticed it claimed to be a Chicago Bears bar, lots of memorabilia on the walls and neon signs. I came here to watch a Bears game one Sunday night, and they had one television with the game on and no sound. The female bartender was polite but the male one was very rude. Drinks were average, food was okay. Overall, not bad if it's on your list while you're bar hopping in Midtown, but I wouldn't go when it's not the weekend or if you aren't with a large group of friends.

Lived here for two years, and it's like pulling teeth to get anything done. Neighbors broke into my car, stole my assigned spot listed in my lease, etc. The management does nothing. When COVID-19 first hit, I asked about the President and AZ Governor's orders to halt evictions, and Cyndi bragged to me in email about how they don't need to abide by the laws and will still pursue evictions against residents. Of all the places I've lived in Arizona, Casas Lindas is the worst. Stay away from HSL properties if you don't want to be the victim of numerous crimes.

Nice ambiance. Good place for a date night, but pricey for average sushi. 
We ordered the tuna tartare which was pretty good but the chips were a bit greasy. 
The fried brussel sprouts were prob my favorite out of all that we ordered. 
For sushi, we got the Geisha Roll, spider roll, spicy tuna, and yellowtail with scallions. Sushi here is over priced and it all tasted average. The soft shell crab batter was not as crispy as I would have liked. And my boyfriend did not like the chewy texture of the yellowtail sushi.

The guy at the window took my payment walked away for a good five minutes until a guy making coffee that I just witnessed him wipe another customers coffee with his apron ask what I'm waiting for. I told him my order and watched him make my coffee as another employee is glaring at me. The guy who took my order came back asking me what I'm waiting on... MY WHOLE ORDER. He goes and grabs my food and comes back says have a nice day and I inform him I still don't have my coffee. It wasn't busy and the lack of customer doesn't even deserve an excuse.

Food is great.  Service great but a little slow.  Wine selection ain't so great.  We were there early Friday night (7:30PM) .  We caught the happy hour crowd so the place was a bit noisy.  

I had the Frutti di Mare to start.  It was succulent.  You know a restaurant knows how to cook their seafood when they can properly cook a squid.  

I had the Sliced Terderloin pasta. Creamy red sauce.  Beef cooked as I specified.  Eldente Pasta.  I've been disappointed with this combination before (steak and pasta) but they were able to do and combine the flavor yet flavor of each element shine.  

I will definitely be coming back again.

I've come here so many times, both to order take out and to sit and eat, and have never been treated less than wonderful. Usually with restaurants, I see great food and not so great service, or vice versa. At Umai, you can expect both great service and great food. The beef ramen is splendid. The atmosphere is enjoyable. The entire staff is so kind and welcoming. The decoration and the aesthetic of this place is so beautiful. This is honestly my favorite restaurant. If you need a place to eat great food for a good price, and be given great service on top of it, Umai Cafe is the place to go!

Wish I could give ZERO stars. I was there 2/2/19 around 10:30 pm. It was not busy at all. Service was slow and the customer service was atrocious. To top it alll off I got a cheeseburger.. simplest thing, and they decided to add a ton of mayo.. why?? I didn't ask for that? So I turn around drive back and they are rude to me when I ask for a new one. I am like beside myself.  I love McDonald's and this location has just did me so poorly that I will never be going back. Learn how to hire better staff McDonald's. Smh.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I've been going to Macha for all my eye care needs for two years and they have been nothing but great! I love how small and intimate their office is, it makes you feel as if you are the only one there. In addition, their selection of frame choices is top notch.

When I needed to get glasses for the first time, I was clueless. The staff at Macha really made me feel more comfortable and confident in my frame choice so that this new change wouldn't be so bad. I have had nothing but good experiences here and would highly recommend Macha for anyone that needs eye care!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
To be fair, we were a large group but it was dead when we walked in. Drinks took about twenty minutes to get, orders to get in took another fifteen, and then to get the food was a solid forty minutes later.

Our check was wrong. They brought out wrong food and then tried to charge us for the wrong plate plus the right one. Everyone's dinner came out sporadically. Food was subpar and cold. Drinks were flat. 

Overall we were there for two hours because she never brought the check, and it was wrong when she did. She never came back by to pick it up, so we had to go find her. Very unpleasant experience.

Ordered the 3-course meal for dinner, with limited choices for each course.

Appetizer was an unexpected bonus, and was the best bruschetta I've ever had. 5/5
First course I had selected was called 'meatballs', and unfortunately not the same dish I saw in other reviews here. This one was really disappointing, since the dish turned out to be 3 deep fried fritters that contained a lot of bread crumbs. I felt like my meal lacked any protein. 1/5
The second course was a red pasta dish, that was well prepared. 4/5
The last course was an apple pie for dessert. 5/5

Overall I give the food a 3.2/5.  Service 3/5. Final: 3/5

Stayed overnight here and was quite happy with the hotel.  Besides the slight mishap of them putting me into a dirty unclean room they rectified it ASAP.  The new room was clean and the staff was friendly and helpful.  The lobby was clean and the breakfast area had much to offer from scrambled eggs, bacon, pancake station and plenty of yogurts. They have a nice coffee bar area and there is a Circle K and Marcos Pizza across the street. This hotel is very close to Medical Center of Trinity for those who travel and work in the medical field.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ok.  A few things.  One:  plan on spending a LONG night.   Our reservation was 640. It was 815 when we got our salad.  I think they are trying to convince you this is a European experience.  Nope.  Just a bad one.  Lived in Europe.  This is not.  I'm not really sure why this is so highly rated.  We had high hopes.   When we finally got our meal it was really bad. I won't go into details except to say not good.  They did comp us and we left.   To each his own.  Just really.  It's not all that. Sorry.  I wanted so much to like this place but no.

We want to thank Dr. Aimee for taking a very stressful and sad situation for us and making it as painless as possible. Our 14+ year old pug had come to the end of his life rather quickly after being diagnosed with a collapsing trachea. He was suffering and given his age there was nothing more we could do. Desert Paws Mobile Veterinary Care sent Dr. Aimee and she was completely compassionate and professional. She gave us as much time a we needed with our pug Romney and even made paw prints for us. If you find yourself in a similar unfortunate situation and  in need of their services I would highly recommend.

Service was great, food...not so much. Absolutely awful. I don't think I'll ever come back here again. I ordered the Mexican Loco which had: Chicken chimichanga, chicken taco, and 3 jalapeño poppers. The chimichanga came with a tomato sauce, it was very small, and tasteless. The poppers were just ok, and I didn't even try the taco. I was so grossed out by everything else, I didn't even bother. My 6 year old ordered chicken "fingers" and French fries. She said the fries were cold, and the chicken was just a cut up patty. Even the chips and salsa wasn't good. Never again.

Of course we all love starbucks!

But lately I have found that my caramel mochiato doesn't taste the same as sometimes they don't have all the ingredients. Also, the location that I go to is the one on Town Center. I would order food in advance, go pick it up to find out that they didn't have what I ordered and I had to find some kind of alternative; then wait for them to prepare it which is what I wanted to avoid in the first place.

I wish that they would have called me in advance to let me know what they don't have in my order to spare me the wait. 

I learned my lesson not to order in advance, but on site or drive-thru.

First time here. Decided to go with a combination plate. Instead of two enchiladas, birria sope and a flauta, I swapped out one of the enchiladas for a carne asada taco. Just to get a good range on the dishes offered here. Enchilada was good, flauta didn't feel/taste like it was filled with any chicken inside. The birria sope I received did not have any birria. The carne asada taco was good though. I notified the server about the birria-less sope and they prepared one up right away. So I will give them that. Overall price was average. The flauta and birria would steer me away from coming back. Maybe I'll try it again another night.

My partner and I had food poisoning after eating Dave's single burger. I'm guessing it was the lettuce because the burger tasted fine. My partner was sick within 4 hours of eating the burger and it took me about 12 hours. Montezuma's revenge is all I can say!! Won't be eating fast food for a very, very long time!!  On a good note, we both lost around 12 lbs, but still don't feel like eating anything except chicken broth. Hopefully in the next day or two we can start eating solids again. Fast food establishments need to have the highest cleaning/sanitation practices and I think that's lacking at a lot of them around here.

I've stayed at a lot of Marriot properties and I think this is the most I've been disappointed. The decor was just okay. There was no WOW factor at all. My biggest complaint is the lighting in the room. Every light in the room was dim and even with the blinds being pulled back there was not enough light in the room. We also, had a faucet drip that drove my husband insane both nights. Additionally, no one could get comfortable on any pillow, there was a burn stain on the comforter and the bathroom wasn't too clean. Needless to say, we will not be staying there ever again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Went here this morning.  This is a new DD in our neighborhood. I'm not a huge DD fan but the girls wanted to go before school.  Hubby also got a dozen for his office.  
I got a coffee with cream and sugar. The coffee tasted sour...  The donuts the kids got were good. 
The blueberry one in the dozen was a little weird.  Instead of blue inside it was grey and no blueberries!..... they use to have actual blueberries in them. 
I will say staff was very nice.  I just think DD is loosing it a bit. Need to up their game in the donut coffee world.

Worst place ever! Wish I could give this place no star at all. When I drove up to the drive thru and no one take my order I waited 3 to four minutes and when I say "hello" then that's when someone said "just one moment" and I waited another 4 minutes and when they finally got my order I have to wait more then five minutes for my food. I thought that if I waited that long it's probably my food is being cooked. But no when I checked my food it's cold and the fries is cold and soggy. While I was waiting all the workers wasn't doing anything but talk and curse at each other. SMH!! Never coming here again.

I was really impressed with this place! It's not what you'd expect from a sushi restaurant (it looks like a hole in the wall), but they had some really good rolls for a REALLY good price. The Crazy Roll was our favorite, we also really liked the Nimza roll. They had a lot of good variety and it was a small place which made it feel homey (a weird thing to say about a sushi place, right?) the service was pretty good, and we were happy we came here. Definitely worth going to if you're wanting some decently priced sushi in Nashville.

I was so happy to finally try this place the atmosphere was great the staff and service nice. The best part of the meal were the small plate appetizers. The Brussel sprouts were to die for and the flat beard was amazing. Giving 3 stars bc the grouper cheek was good but the corn cake underneath was very salty. The Sea bed with  glass noddles was just ok. The glass noddles and curry sauce was a great touch but the Sea Bass had a chewy consistency that wasn't appealing. Over all great place just needs a little work on the seafood dishes.

This vet was priced fairly and close to where we recently moved.  However, I didn't feel like the "exam" was as thorough as it should have been.  I visited with my boxer/pit mix when she was having what ultimately is anxiety.  The Dr. kinda poked around on the dog, looked her over and asked a few questions, but I would have liked to have received more advice than just give her benadryl to make her sleep.  So I will probably won't return just because when I recently called for another issue I felt dismissed and of course they had no appointment either so....I will stick with my old vet and just drive the extra miles.

Waited for months for their re-grand opening and it was so much worth the wait!!! Hands down one of the best pizzas in south philly (for some reason I feel the small size tastes the best!!) . After revamping their shack, they definitely redid their menu with even better tasting ingredients. They also changed their grubhub options and although there isn't a minimum per delivery anymore, there is a high $4 fee for delivery, BUT it is still worth it! Prices are still great & I still recommend this place to everyone.

My dad and I pitstopped here on our way up to NY. Great choice! Everyone from the hostess to our waitress was very friendly as soon as we entered the restaurant. Located right off the road with parking lot. It wasn't very crowded. Most people were watching sports around the bar. Very rustic and dimly lit ambiance.

I got the seafood scampi and my dad got the chicken Parmesan. I loved the abundance of seafood in my dish. Most restaurants skimp you when it comes to seafood but not here! I loved the light lemon and wine flavor. My dad's chicken parm was very large and delicious as well. I ended up taking the rest for lunch the next day.

What a world of difference four months can make. If you came here back when they first opened, you'll remember the mad house it was.

The line for the drive through stretched across the street into the next parking lot and the interior line stretched outside the door on most days.

Today, we hit the drive through without anybody in front of or behind us. Insane! Lol.

We were disappointed that they didn't have my wife's favorite (sour cream) but we were able to load on my favorite (original glaze).

So if you were waiting for the lines to die down, now's your time.

Wish I could do no stars. Gross and not what you expect from a Mexican restaurant. First of all, no free chips and salsa. Now that's rare. Second. The menu is odd. Not much traditional mexican that we are used too. It's like they were tying too hard to be unique. 
My friend are I both got enchiladas. The sauces were pretty disgusting (I got mole verde and she got the one that started with a pipian). Both sauces were chunky. I got grilled chicken instead of shredded. It was grayish in color and did not taste good. Overall, both dishes smelled like burnt cardboard. 
Finally, the queso had no flavor and the salsa was watery 
Don't recommend

I have been wanting to try this restaurant since March when quarantine started and they closed, my reservation was canceled. It was most definitely worth the prolonged wait! 
My friend and I went for his birthday. It is a great restaurant to celebrate a special occasion. 
I highly recommend the brick chicken which was juicy and flavorful. I also recommend the S'more Pot De Creme. It is a dessert meant for 1 and is worth every bite. Loved the ambiance, loved the food, and great service. This is a So bro must go!

Interesting place. The patio is very big and has a nice layout. Lots of seating options. The fire pit is super cool, good focal point. The covid precautions are good - masks, sanitizer, etc. To order food, you call Nomad and it's delivered to your table. Service was varied - a few really friendly staff with fin attitudes, but a couple less cheerful staff who were actually kinda mean. It took a long time for anyone to come over and take drink orders but to be fair it was pretty busy. There are about 7 beers on tap and lots of bottles. No cocktail list - gotta come up with your own.

Update: there was a very friendly man doing drive thru today 7/20/19 around 12pm. He does a fantastic job! 



Leslie needs to retire from the drive thru window. Her customer service is god awful. It sounds like I'm literally causing her an inconvenience every time I'm making an order. Never ever friendly. Watched her drop change of the guy in front of me and then she did the same exact thing to me. No apology. She needs to go work somewhere else. Seems like she hates her job and doesn't represent you guys well at all.

I signed up for an account at this bank because I needed a bank with a local branch (I am with an out of state credit Union currently) and I got an email with an offer of $150 to open an account. Why not, I thought? I wish I had read the reviews. So far everything about this bank has been sub par. They place ridiculously long holds on deposits. They even held my direct deposit for two days! There are no branches open on the weekend and they close at 5 every day. Not very convenient. I'm going to wait for my bonus and find another bank.

Update: I've received multiple bullying emails from the restaurant owner, and one threatening voicemail from a female employee demanding that I take down my initial one star review. They believe that because they refunded me for my meal (their idea), I should remove the review. Since I did not (and will not) remove my review, they are threatening to charge my card again for the dinner that made my partner ill. This behavior is unacceptable. It is a violation of Yelp's terms and services to compensate a customer in exchange for removing a bad review. I

We originally booked a room at Hyatt Place but based on the reviews we decided to stay at Hyatt House instead. Glad we did!! Room was very clean which is our #1 priority. Enjoyed the fully equipped kitchen and full sized fridge. The location is excellent right by the KOP mall and in the same parking lot as the Melting Pot. 

Minor complaints which resulted in the loss of a star. The bedding was worn and needs to be replaced and the dishwasher wasn't secure. Again, room was very clean.  Still would highly recommend and stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We were big fans of Sekisui Pacific Rim, so we were a bit nervous about coming to Ichigo (like many people, we've been burned plenty of times when restaurants change chefs or management). It is a bit different, but we were equally satisfied! We tried a pretty large selection, including fried tofu (not as good as SPR's, but still very good), salad, crab cakes (which were incredible), sashimi, rolls, and some other items I had never had from ordering the Big Hirohito. Everything, except maybe one item, was really very good. In addition, the wait staff was even better than SPR's. We will be back!

Stopped in yesterday for the first time after hearing rave reviews from my Fishers-native boyfriend. The menu was pretty extensive. The general vibe felt like a step up from a Panda Express in authenticity, but still the same single-serving style. I ordered Empress Chicken and potstickers. My food was hot, saucy, and well priced! For two entrees, two appetizers, and two drinks the total bill was $27. It's nothing fancy, but works in a pinch. The only thing I wasn't jazzed about was the fried rice. Next time I'll opt for just brown. Will be back for sure!

Very disappointed with this property. We stayed in room 327 and it was outdated and very small. You could also hear toilets flushing on both sides of the room- very noisy. I also didn't like the fact that the cleaning staff leave a money envelope with a person's name on it-- presumptuous. I understand the premium cost ($300+) was due to the location - but, the room was so bad.  The common areas in the lobby and pool area are nice and that is the only reason I gave 2 stars. Not up to Marriott quality. Stayed there on April 5, 2019.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If you like outdared wiring that rarely works. Maintenance people who are incompetent and don't know how to fix issues, rude office personelle who want to argue instead of solve problems,  and pay high rent for the privilege then this is your new residence.  I had a flood due to faulty toilet mechanism and they brought faulty equipment in to help dry it telling me to leave my back door open to let it drain. FOR 2 WEEKS! Then refused to replace the flooring it destroyed.  Leaving mold and rotten carpets,  torn tile in kitchen  (which thry had laid tile over the top of old dirty tile)gross

I went in there to browse while I was getting my oil changed at the place across the street. Great place, they gave me a ton of discounts. So, I was looking at tea here when the cashier said I need to hurry up and leave because I was in there for too long. Definitely never coming in again and I'm letting my friends know not to either. Made me feel super uncomfortable. I wasn't doing anything wrong. If I could put zero stars I would. Also it was like 8am and no one was in there. There was no reason to be so rude.
