This is a very quick stop for lunch.  You can stay and enjoy your lunch upstairs or take it back to the office.  I usually run in and grab salad from the salad bar.  It is difficult to pass up the desserts, because everything I have tried was delicious.   The employees have always been polite and helpful.  Today I went in to supplement a poor lunch and the employee at the checkout was kind enough to see if I had a Marsh card, so that I was able to use the sale price.  I will continue to frequent Marsh for lunch when I am working nearby.

Sparks cleaners is a satellite establishment. They collect clothes for laundry and cleaning and send to the main store. They do alterations on site. I have had a few pants altered there and they are excellent in their work. My experience with dry cleaning there has always been a good one. The place is convenient for me to access, they do a very good job in dry cleaning or laundering clothes. I have no complaints nor regrets with taking my business there. If you are in the vicinity, give them a try. There is also a laundromat owned by the company that is next door to the cleaners that is constantly being used.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Service okay when purchasing frames but rude and dismissive when I went back to pick up my completed order with new lenses. Many people waiting and few employees to help. Tried to get rid of me without addressing my concerns over my new lenses. Told me I was "required to wear them for two days" before they would do anything. WTF!? Eventually talked to a different employee who was slightly less rude and got help with my concerns. Will NOT be returning next year. Wish I would have read these reviews before going there.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I love shopping there, even though I'm no expert on Indian food. The owners are kind and helpful, and the quality of the spices is beyond anything you can get at the supermarket. For instance, I've stocked up at very reasonable cost on cardamom seeds, cinnamon sticks, whole black pepper, cumin ground and seeds, fennel, curry hot and mild, golden raisins, and bay leaves. 

Well stocked with an array of spices, grains, nuts, dried fruit, rice, flours, and a small section of fresh produce (okra, ginger, peppers, squash). They also sell homemade samosas and flatbread as well as other goodies. 

Oh - and they do take credit cards!

Haven't checked in yet but when I arrived 1.5 hours early of the "official checkin time at 4pm" which is already late and uncommon, super unfriendly staff (young Latino boy) told me super rude how checkin time is 4pm. I said I know but whether the room is ready because then I could already go in and if not of course I'd wait. Without checking he repeated in a louder, aggressive voice: checkin time is 4pm. And how he's not authorized to change that. And when I asked who's authorized he got even louder and ruder. Wow really bad first impression. I wouldn't care but I twisted my knee and would have appreciated a bath.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This location has the doors unlocked and you walk into all the lights off. I wanted to order my food then go the restroom and get my food and be on the road. They tell me their serving floor is closed ok so I can't order inside? No! Can I at least go the restroom and then go through? No. 
Of the people I saw half of them had their masks under their nose or under their chins. If you walk in area is closed then lock the doors so people do not walk in at lunch time. I went to another place to grab lunch and go the restroom.

Always have enjoyed the food here. It's reasonably priced and really good. My issue lies with the service mostly. Today I had dinner here with a friend and we waited 10 minutes without a waitress or waiter coming to greet us. After we ordered, our food came out wrong and some of it was not even brought out. It seemed very chaotic and disorganized. There was also a hair in my sour cream which was pretty nasty. I think there are far better Mexican options on the Main Line but unfortunately they're not as cheap as El Limon

I was eager to try Golden China as there aren't many affordable Chinese takeout places in the area. We ordered won ton soup, an egg roll, a sesame chicken combo platter and mixed vegetables and chicken. The won ton soup was pretty standard, as was the egg roll. The sesame chicken was good, definitely a very generous portion. I found the pork fried rice to be very bland. The chicken and mixed veggies were okay- the sauce they were in was very bland though. I wasn't as impressed as I wanted to be, I'd say this place was just average.

I've been here a few times and have had decent food. Went here recently with some friends and got the cheeseburger. While it was good, I think it could have used some sauce or something as it was a little dry. We got calamari to split which I found very crispy and a good size. My main complaint about this place is the price. It definitely is a little on the expensive side for the quality of what you're getting. Service was good and the atmosphere is nice, but I wouldn't rush back because the food is just okay and the prices aren't great.

This place is a hidden gem! A friend of mine recommended that we go there and I am so glad we did. The place is intimate and the decor pays tribute to the prohibition era in the 1920s. The band that night was the Ibervillianiares and these guys' talents are off the charts! Adam who plays the trumpet and sang many of the songs that night was outstanding! Earl and the other band members were just as amazing! The bonus was watching the lead member Chance and his partner dance in perfect form to every beat! It was the perfect night New Orleans style. What a treat it was!

Coming from a large Italian family, I'm used to decent portion sizes. I wasn't too hungry at dinner, so I ordered the ravioli. When they brought the food to our table, the smaller portion consisted of three raviolis. THREE. 

Our waiter was great, so I asked him if this is correct. He said he would check with the kitchen. He came back and said that was, indeed, correct. I couldn't believe it. $10+ for 3 raviolis. Unbelievable. I knew that was not homemade alfredo sauce.

I would have given them one star, but our waiter was a really nice guy. Buyer be warned.

Decided to check out this nail salon during my lunch break and it was not my best choice. It was probably the most painful nail session I've ever had, and on top of that it was way more expensive than the normal place I go to. This place was very dirty and the staff was not friendly and very slow. Although my nails ended up looking fine, it was not worth the amount I paid ($50 for a full set?? Like what) and it was not worth the pain. My nail technician did not know how to properly use an automatic nail file. She filed the skin around my nails raw and also drew blood. Was not happy with this nail salon and won't be returning.

Had dinner there last night. I did not like the Eggplant parmigiana it was burnt on edges of breading and the skin was very crunchy, also very large seeds. I only ate 1/2 the eggplant due to all the burnt edges and having to pick out all the large seeds. It was covered in  a lot of tomato sauce, had to push most of it to the side. I rated as a 2 cuz the service and attentiveness of the server was wonderful. I would not recommend the baked entree dinners. My husband had one also. My sister had a white pizza and she loved it. The cream of mushroom soup was delicious.

Fat Salmon is a good sushi restaurant. No major complaints except that maybe the food is a bit pricey. 

There is a lot of peculiar special rolls that go beyond the standard dragon, Philadelphia and rainbow rolls. There are a lot of vegetarian rolls options like the kimchi-ya and the tofuholic roll. These rolls were not bad but I'd prefer to spend money on seafood. $10+ is a lot for a vegetarian roll in my opinion.

Compared to the other sushi restaurants in Philly, the sushi here is great. Appetizers are good. Adequate beer selections as well.

Overall, I recommend Fat Salmon for sushi especially if you are a vegetarian.

We stopped here after taking a detour off the Blue Route to avoid traffic during rush hour. We waited in the drive thru for a lonnnnnng time, like 15 minutes at least. So you are probably wondering "why are you giving them 4 stars?" Well, when we finally got our order they gave me an extra chicken nugget, like 5 bbq sauces and the fries were nice and hot. Sometimes when you wait forever everything is cold. Not this time for us. Hot fries will always raise up my star level on yelp. The employees were also very friendly on this particular occasion we were there.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Came here to stay while in Tampa. Service was really good upon checking in. They had availability late at night. Hotel customer service was very good, smooth process checking in. Upon entering the room smelled wonderful and was very clean. Looks like this is a fairly new hotel. Modern decor very up-to-date. Clean bathroom, very comfortable bed. Love the sectional couch as well. Breakfast is provided and they give military discounts. It's probably one of the cleanest hotels we have been to to date. Would definitely recommend staying here if you come to visit Tampa.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My sister told us how great the food was and invited my family out for breakfast on a Saturday morning. We were a party of 8 and the place was not busy as we got there at 9 when they opened. All the waffles were cold and my wife never got her food. My brother in law sent his back since his slinger waffle was ice cold. All they did was put it in the microwave and brought it back out 15 minutes later with over done eggs. This was the worst experience and I will never try this place again. One star is too much for this place.

The Family and I went on a Sunday tried the Chicken deal for $12.95 Let me explain on the deal this is all they serve on Sunday it comes with biscuits first and then Chicken 2 thighs 2 legs 2 wings and 1 large breast also served is mashed potatoes with white gravy, green beans and custard corn dish .So lets talk about the food Chicken was good not the best as everyone says the mash potatoes were cold and green beans also cold and no taste to them at all the custard corn dish was different is all I can say the white gravy WAS THE WORST GRAVY EVER I TASTED . IT TASTED JUST LIKE A SPOONFUL OF FLOUR . All in all this place is way overrated !!!

Charlie's Sushi is more than a Restaurant.   He goes above and beyond in so many ways.  Not only does he have the freshest fish and excellent techniques to maximize flavor, but he he treats his patrons like family.   

Most recent experience was for my birthday.  Rather than giving me a cheesy free dessert, he pulls out this excellent bottle of Sake and has a drink with my wife and I, Leaves the bottle and says Happy Birthday!

No other place in Tampa Bay makes me feel as welcome as Charlie's Sushi... I highly recommend The Spicy Salad, Lemon Pepper Snapper, Dancing Eel Roll, Nigiri, and Hand Rolls made with cucumber paper rather than seaweed.

Love it!  Take out or eat-in, delicious food.  The atmosphere is cozy and clean.  The staff is so friendly and helpful.  The sushi is fresh and flavorful.  The yasai gyoza is yummy!  I love vegetarian sushi and they will make a custom roll without hesitation.  The combination of cucumber, avocado, and asparagus is one of my all-time favorites.  The sweet potato roll is also exceptional.  My husband really loved the sushi deluxe, for all of you traditional sushi eaters.  The lychee martini, umi dream martini, and mojito are all great.  Go and enjoy!

We are going to new orleans in October for the 5th year in a row and this will be our. 4th stay here , so obviously we are fans!  Our first stay was 2011. We checked in after a cruise (myself, husband , daughter and son in law and 17 month old grand son). Same day hurricane started blowing through ! Manager was very nice about letting us check out 2 days early. Rooms have always been clean. Breakfast is standard. On site bar in the evening is not cheap but nice option. Our main complaint is they offer fresh Cookies 24/7 but never chocolate chip!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I don't often get things dry cleaned, but had a few back-to-back interviews and needed to freshen up my suit in between. A friend recommended this place to me, and it's super close to my apartment, so I stopped by. The suit had some deodorant stains that were difficult to clean after the first wash. The owner, however, was able to send the suit back for a second cleaning to make it look brand new! I was super happy with the results, but I had to dock a star because I was not told that the suit had been sent back until I stopped in to pick it up. A heads-up would have been nice for my planning.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
The food was good, and the lunch hour prices were awesome. But the groupon they had was highly deceiving. The Groupon itself did not mention anything about it only being designated for dinner time. The waitress had to lead me through a few extra clicks and scrolls on my Groupon to reveal that it was in fact only for dinner. Also, the miso soup spoon smelled too strongly of bleach. I could not stomach that at all. 

I'll be back to due the Groupon I have yet been able to use. Hopefully it'll be a better experience the second time around.

Just stopped in to meet up with someone and this was the perfect place! They have a little parking lot and there was plenty of parking. Parking is always a big plus for me, I hate when places don't have dedicated parking so I am happy with that!

I got a small matcha latte and it was good! It tasted very much like good matcha. I've only had more sweetened matcha before and I was surprised by the plant-y flavor of this matcha, but I ended up really liking it! It was a perfect warm up on this snowy February night!

The baristas were super friendly as well, which is always a good thing! :)

My standard is pretty high for coffee houses and I was wow-ed by this establishment the moment I stepped inside. 

The staff was very friendly and non-pretentious and the coffee was definitely above average.  I had the feeling that the baristas really cared about their products, which was a difference-maker.

I usually study in coffee house, so I'm looking for the following: 1) comfy chairs/tables, 2) temperature control (not too warm/cold) 3) decent internet speed.  Menagerie has all of these.  So if you're looking for a cute, chill and friendly coffee shop, this is the place to be.

Engimono Sushi was a tasty and enjoyable experience, but without anything particularly remarkable to set it apart.

The rolls we got were fresh and pleasing. The restaurant ambiance was polished and comfortable, though a smidge cafeteria-esque. The service was friendly, and we didn't need to wait too long for our food. They also have TV's on the wall, in case you want to follow a sports game while enjoying lunch or dinner.

Ultimately a fine meal, but not anything particularly amazing that I feel compelled to try again.

Here it is an "update". Fresh Market , st. Charles Ave is still fabulous and better than all the others. It's still fabulous! There's some new employees, but management stays the same. Lou is one, a great manager , a great guy and Bruce is the other,a very young and well rounded leader. Niecey and Taylor, and Mussett are some of the best staffers. The staff is ready to assist with anything you ask for. 

The produce is fantastic and fresh. The international condiments and the spirits are such a variety that there's something for everybody. I will elaborate on this more as soon as I get my pics in.

We love coming in for take -out orders.  The owner is always so friendly behind the register.  The menu isn't huge, but solid.  The food is always cooked to order and fresh.  The portions are huge and flavorful. The two entree combos are only $6.99 and come with either dried rice or chicken chow mein.  I really enjoy the Kung po chicken and veggie delight.  The batter on the chicken and pork in the fried dishes is a little thick, but there is plenty of white meat chicken.  A great neighborhood Chinese take-out place.

Really cute place. Great for a casual night out, best part is that this place is BYOB. 
My husband and I ordered the Calamari which was perfectly crispy. 
I had a pizza with truffle cheese, mozz, salami, and topped with a drizzle of honey. I was skeptical at first about the honey, but the waitress assured me it was not too sweet and it was actually one of her favorites. I couldn't agree more. It was SO good (only thing I would tell them to hold off on the meat -personal preference). 
My Husband got a calzone, which was Huge. Great flavor, filled with lots of cheese and meat. 
Can't wait to come back and try more items off their menu.

Worst $10 I've ever spent. I'd rather have contributed to a high school fundraising car wash held at a gas station. Please see photos of how the front of my vehicle is still not cleaned from bug splatter and my car door/window not cleaned from bird poop. If simple elbow grease can remove this, why can't your state-of-the-art car wash? It looks to me like they purposely down play the features and outcome so you can pay more at their establishment. The only positive thing here are the free vacuums. I'm very disappointed and won't be back.

I am giving this place a 3 for the deliciousness of its food and it's courteous staff. Sheryll was a doll and let me save 5 seats for our birthday party. The food was fresh and up to par. I did not care for the seating. I think the concept is fabulous but when you're in a huge casino full of hungry gamblers, I think they should have expanded a bit. It's a seat yourself concept, so first come first serve. I don't recommend coming here for an occasion or with a group. If you're at the casino alone or with one other person, than this is for you.

I was visiting Nashville this weekend with some friends and this was the first place we got food at. The menu was more 'upscale' than most restaurants and the food was amazing. I got the pork chop and it was seriously one of the best pieces of pork I've ever had. It was extremely tender and moist. I also ordered the cheese plate for an appetizer and that was really good too. It came with a few different cheeses, walnuts and some type of jam. Everyone was impressed with it. Also, I really liked the ambiance of the place. The decor was very nice and lighting was perfectly dim. I was satisfied with my overall experience.

I love Pi. The Delmar is my favorite but really nothing disappoints. Definitely order the large size pizza instead of the small. Just a couple dollars more and significantly larger in size. The small is really like a personal pizza however two people can get by on it if you aren't super hungry. They make the crust out of cornmeal and it really is delicious. The vibe in there is always pretty chill and it's just a cool place to hang out with friends also. They have patio seating which is really nice in the evenings.

I used to use this location on a regular basis and they had great guest service & they paid great attention to detail and they would offer great conversation while assisting me. Usually every year what I genuinely appreciate is when I go in around my birthday and they actually are very pleasant today I walked in and sure I was greeted at the door but the sour interaction I had with the banker Zuly was grotesque and unfriendly safe to say if I based my business on her interaction with me today I would NEVER recommend Wells Fargo

If the chips were just a bit tastier, Jalisco would get my 5th star!  I adore the carnitas, my sister loved the shrimp cocktail and Baja -like atmosphere, my bro in law thought everything was great, especially his chili relleno. Been here several times now and the service has always been friendly, efficient, helpful, and fun!  Top Shelf Margaritas are tasty and I'm looking forward to trying some other fun sounding libations now that I've actually read the drinks menu.  Best North Valleys eatery which I've discovered so far!

Surf Thru has a deal for their "Ultimate" package that costs about $29.99/ month. I use it almost daily, so I think of it as getting a nice wash for about a buck a day. The staff like Jade, Wyatt & Julia are friendly to the customers and to their fellow employees. They wave to me and welcome me back. They know what free items I like ( dash wipes ). Some employees have hat work at the other location in Sparks refer me to try out the 2d location as well. I like to use the free vacuum and airbrush that is provided. The customer bathroom is a bonus.

Pathetic excuse of a cheesesteak. We placed an order for two cheesesteaks. And there was barely any meat in it. We called and spoke to Sarah the manager and she gave us an attitude that we complained. She didn't want to give any type on compensation or anything at all to accommodate future customers. She said she has to speak to the owner first before she can make any decisions. I mean what's the point of her being a manager? If she could barely manage a simple complaint. I wouldn't recommend this place at all. We drove 15mins to try this place and it's a waste of time and money.

Innovative pop up Christmas bar with festive drinks to match.  Very fun to go with friends to celebrate the 2019 season.  Cozy and great decoration... seems they worked very hard on the menu and concept, so it was awesome to see this happening in Wilmington.  If they do it next year, hopefully they don't use plastic cups and utensils.  I understand it's a temporary bar but that kind of waste goes against current social issues and the importance of environmental health.  There must be progressive ways to incorporate into the concept : )

I am originally from south philly and now live in south jersey but when I really want some good pizza I take the ride back into Philly to reminisce and order pizza from here and bring it back. Pizza is a simple thing good dough, sauce and cheese but this place just does it right.  I love the texture of their crust.  I usually have to order toppings on my pizza (pepperoni) but their pizza is so good I'm content with just a cheese pizza cause it tastes that good I don't need the extras.  It's worth the toll
To go over the Walt Whitman bridge!

My daughter and I have made this our recent stop when we are running errands for lunch.  They have great deals for lunch specials when dining in.  The waitress is very kind and friendly. My daughter got their wrap lunch special and fries and I got their hoagie special with fries.  Needless to say we really enjoyed it and you can't beat the price. And it's always nice when you go to a place and their staff is friendly. Makes for an even better experience. Stop in for lunch one day their lunch specials run till 3:00 PM and are definitely worth the price.  Enjoy!

We recently made another trip to Philly as we wanted more time to explore the city and attractions in the area. One of the places I wanted to go back to was Menagerie Coffee as I had been craving their Mocha since our last trip to PA.

Before we started our venture around downtown Philly, we headed here for coffee. My fiance and I both ordered Mochas and were just as impressed by them this time as we were the last time we had them. They are so smooth and flavorful - I honestly have not found a comparison, yet. 

If you're in the area and want to try some really amazing coffee, you need to stop here!

So we decided to give Hertz another try (see "Los Angeles Hertz: An Appropriate Name For A Painful Experience"). But this time, despite a few mostly-understandable setbacks - for which we were compensated by the manager Pamela Matson in the form of a free tank of gas (unironic gasp!) and $50 towards our next Hertz rental (what an optimist!), Hertz fulfilled our initial rental agreement and we drove away in the XL SUV we had been promised would hold four bicycles and their riders, along with gear. Thanks, Hertz!

My bestie and I had the opportunity to visit Tampa for Wanderlust 108. I honestly chose the Aloft based on proximity to the event and boy was it an amazing choice. 
The Aloft is situated perfectly on the Riverwalk so it makes it easy to get to all of the local art museums, parks, water taxis, and downtown restaurants. The staff (including the valet fellas) we amazingly polite and ensured that we knew where were were going and that we had everything that we needed for our trip. The hotel itself was modern and classy with quite a bit of room that we did not expect. 
Overall this was a perfect expereine.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The sole reason I keep coming back is Diana. The food is awesome. Always is, always was.  But her customer service knows no bounds. She knows my name, my fiance's name, my brother in law's name, and the last time we ordered. It's one thing to take good care of people and serve good food. It's entirely different to make it feel like it's impossible to go somewhere else because the staff loves you back. I make a point of coming in just to say hello, food or not. I'm so grateful for the family vibe Diana creates. When I think to-go, I think the corner of 15th and Porter. Period. Diana rocks it.

Classic Starbucks experience, ordered my typical iced vanilla latte, and drink was on point. Took them less than four minutes to have my order ready. 

The store is a bit small but there were plenty of two person tables and the staff made sure the keep the place clean while I was there. 

On a random note, I noticed that almost everyone around me was simply drinking water. Not sure if this is a trend but I can see how staff may be a bit displeased when people come in, order water, and stick around for their free wifi.

Nice little spot to grab a cup of coffee at the Village!

Coffee is great and their pastries are quite yummy. However, I do think it's strange that it shares that same establishment as Rice Works and Calle 75 Street Tacos. I wish this place was its own little store but I may be asking for too much and have been spoiled with other coffee shops around town. 

Nevertheless, this place is ideal for those looking to grab a quick cup of coffee and hang around the Village. Be prepared for the volume to be a bit louder than what you are used to at a more typical coffee shop.

First off we really loved our Waitress she was so helpful and funny. I have been going here for 15 years i believe and had not been in a few years. A group of us reserved a table and it was ready as we arrived. Place is clean and thats important! Food was Meh like i have read in other reviews. I really thought that the food was over priced. If i wanted to spend that much on a pasta dish i would rather get dressed up and go to the Hotel Mac Donald Harvest room. We all left full but it seemed pretty bland all around.

Just wow.. I ordered 3 tacos, carne asada and al pastor. Top 3 best Mexican food outside San Diego, California. These tacos are as real as it gets. Their salsa is phenomenal, homemade. Happy they provided lemons too.

I'll order here everyday for the next week, while I'm in Nashville. Ya, that good.

Prices are on point too!

Update! 
They went from a 5 to a 2, inconsistent. 

Ordered here the following day and now ...  one of the meats were terrible, I trashed it... they forgot my drink too.

Don't serve aguachile if you don't know how to make it...

This is my favorite Chinese take out in the  Clearwater/Largo area. A dinner combo is $8.09 which includes an egg roll, pork fried rice and select entree. The pork fried rice has generous portion of pork and the rice (which is yellow) is not soggy. I usually get the chicken cashew or the bourbon chicken because it doesn't have excessive breading. I wouldn't recommend the orange or sesame chicken though. Otherwise China 1 (next to Publix at the shopping center at East Bay and Belcher Rd) is my go to when I crave Chinese food.

This was my first time here. I picked it because it was just around the corner from my location plus it had good reviews. 

When I walked in, it was oddly quiet despite the background music. The vibe is an industrial building with minimal decor. Everyone kept to themselves and it seemed a little too cold and off putting for my taste. There's no freshly brewed aroma of coffee beans or baked goods when you walk in. 

I ordered an ice tea which didn't taste anything special and cost a whopping $3.75. I should have gone to Starbucks and gotten a flavored fancy iced tea for that price. This will be my first and last time.

I wish Yelp did half stars. This restaurant is a 2.5 starts.

The food here is just okay. I have eaten here twice and both times just misses the mark. Today I ordered a seafood dish and the seafood was over cooked.  Ordered a cannoli pizza another time and it was so dry with barely any cream on it. We ordered cheese fries but the cheese was shredded so it hardened up. Ordered broccoli rabe appetizer and the broccoli rabe was not properly dressed so it was not edible. Overall if the company orders I will just get plain fries as they are very good.

I was expecting to wait in line for at least 30 minutes and I was totally ok with that for the most delicious warm doughnuts in the world.  When i finally got my order of a dozen glazed and a dozen assorted felt and tasted like they were just pulled from the fridge.  I was soooo mad! Why did it take 30 minutes to get cold doughnuts? I would've understood if the wait was for warm doughnuts. I'm never going to that location ever again, I'll just stick to my twice a years visits when I'm on vacation with a city that has a Krispy kreme. This location is s unorganized.

Just what I needed during a nice day in City Park. They have a nice to go window if you're planning on enjoying at one of the nearby picnic tables, the peristyle, or elsewhere in the park. 

While I was in the short line at the to go window, my SO and dog snagged a picnic table. We had a nice, hot order of beignets to split and I got a cafe au lait to wash them down. 

The nice thing about this location is that I didn't have to wait in a crazy long line of people. They do offer indoor and outdoor seating but might as well enjoy the park while eating your beignets!

This was my first time at Elise, I went with a gift card I had gotten from a friend.  I made an appointment but appointment time came and went and nothing.  I was getting a little peeved since I hurried to be there on time.  The owner came over and apologized and set things straight.  They must have been a little short on employees today because  one did half my pedicure and had to go to another customer so another finished it up.  But both girls did a great job and the fact that the owner tried to make things right so quickly made me think that I will be back the next time I need a pedicure.

I use to think this was by far the best Mexican place to enjoy. However, the very last time I was at this place. They charged me for a small bowl of sour cream. When I asked them why they charged me. The server gave,e a rude explantion. So I haven't been back. I didn't get a drink just water. I am trying to cut back on soda. It's sad they did this so I haven't been back.  If they would have given me a different answer or take the charge off my bill. I have never heard of a place that would charge for ketchup, mustard or sour cream before. Has anyone experience this?

This is probably the worst bar in Reno I've never seen any bouncer so Fucking aggressive with any one in my entire life this bar is probably the worst fucking bar in the whole country this dumbass bouncer thought he was cool and brought out his dumb Fucking dobermin pincher to try to make some fucking threats but these Fucking dumbasses have no Fucking clue about what is going on I recommend that no one ever go to this bar ever ever again in fucking history probably the worst bar ever it sucks no one should ever ever go there again

I am a Hilton lover I stay a Hilton normally for all my vacations unless I'm doing an all inclusive and this one was probably one of my least favorite Hilton hotels. When I first got there it took over 30 minutes to get a valet to help me with my car and that was only after I called the front desk for assistance. 

The rooms were clean and kept to covid requirements but nothing that stands out regarding amenities in this particularly location. 

I will probably stay at the Doubletree down the road next time I visit 

Until next review 
Kisses
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This restaurant owner has no idea what they're doing. Ordered food.. Took two hours to get delivered. Next time I ordered I went to go pick it up, they confused my buffalo chicken salad with a chicken cheesesteak... Not sure those sound the same but ok. I had to either take the sandwich or wait 20 minutes for my salad. I paid for the error too, mind you they did not offer a refund or credit and I didn't ask. we all make mistakes I took the sandwich. THEN we ordered again, they got the food wrong and had the nerve to tell my friend they never make mistakes.... Hahah keep it up.

This used to be my favorite dining in Nash but last night the food was underwhelming.  The salmon was cooked perfectly but served on a bed of lackluster lentils.  The duck was served barely warm.  It was tough and flavorless on a barely there mushroom sauce and watery cooked greens.  The clam pasta was just simply blah.  Even the cornbread was over processed and just not a dish to recommend.
In the end It was a lot of $$$$ for understated flavorless marginal food.
I understand they change the menu seasonally, I'll be holding out for the next season.

Time for a confession: when I first saw that we were getting another coffee shop in Fishtown, I bitched and moaned about it to everyone I could find. ("Haven't we hit coffee shop saturation already? Couldn't we have an actually useful business, like a dry cleaners?")

After my first visit, I had to take it all back. This is the best coffee I've had since I-don't-know when, and unlike Rocket Cat the staff here is friendly and helpful, and the space is inviting, and really well set up for reading, working, conversation, whatever. I'm psyched this place is on my block...though I'm still holding out for that dry cleaners.

Rented vehicle in early sept 2016.  Poor customer service. Rep didn't know what he was doing. Kept saying, "I don't normally work at this location."  Very short staffed. Only 2 people working and both were running around, legs bent (obscure Monty Python reference).

The car was FILTHY inside and out. Inside dash was coated in a film that made it hard to see out. I had to go to the Pep Boys located in the same shopping center to get a microfiber towel to wipe of the interior windshield just so I could see out to drive.  I was given the car with less a 1/4 tank of gas.  The Pottstown location is much better.

Rudest most unfriendly neighbors I have ever experienced. If you want a snobby environment to live in move here. I'm moving out because my neighbor is an old grumpy bitter man who pounds on my ceiling every time I drop something and harassed me in the parking lot, giving me an hour lecture on how long he's lived in Nevada.. Screw this! I'm the quietest neighbor here,  there are pets in every apartment who bark and babies and kids screaming, ppl leave their garbage outside their door for days. And yet I'm being harassed.

We booked this hotel for my wife's conference for ICU doctors that now due to the coronavirus has been canceled.  Due to the pandemic, she is now required to work in the ICU to save lives, but the hotel refused to allow us to cancel the hotel for anything outside of the full price costing us $430 per night as the conference that is now canceled had increased the demand dramatically.  We had hoped that due to COVID-19 they would reconsider and make an exception for a doctor who instead will be saving lives in the ICU.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I'm almost having a hard time giving this "hot and new" spot three stars. The service was terrible. I ordered a proseco (which they do not offer) and rather than our server offering me something else he just brought champagne and said "I figured you wouldn't mind". We waited about 30 minutes to order and when my omelette came it was filled with butter and unpromised ingredients. My husbands fried chicken sandwich was essentially all bread. Their only saving grace is the neat space and the delicious Brussel sprouts. I doubt we will be back again.

Decent Sushi.  The usual selection of Japanese dishes.  Nothing out of the ordinary except for a better than usual Sake selection.  Service was very good.  Prices were average.  We did an assortment including a bento box, a few rolls, salads and sashimi.  Also a bottle of sake.  All were good, with nothing standing out.  

We caught a Friday night dinner (8:30ish).  The crowd tended to be younger and more trendy.  Full bar.  Plenty of parking due to it's location attached to a mall. 

Not bad but nothing spectacular.  We will probably go back.

I usually always get the hot and honey wings, even told people they're better than PJs wings. Then today happened. The orange colored honey hot sauce was replaced with whatever this hot garbage is, or the sauce is on them but totally burnt rendering the flavor unbearable.

Other experiences: once had a taco and thought it was the best taco ever. Got the same taco a week later and it was super dry

There's another similar experience where I ordered a wet burrito and got a normal burrito instead. 

Either way, very inconsistent.

I get that this place is a dive bar and they have a place in the market, but stand apart from your competition with good service or being a fun place to come. This place is cash only. The bartender arrived later than opening time and I don't recall an appology for being tardy. She didn't remedy the bad service, I was handed a wrong beer. She then proceeded to give poor service because she was occupied putting up decorations for a party. Unless you're in the area or a regular there's no reason to drink here. Nothing special in the inventory or personally to speak of.

Amazing croissant and pecan roll!

We stopped here for breakfast after having run on the beach. It's a tiny coffee shop and one adjacent but non-connected sitting room. The big croissant was flaky, crispy and buttery. I devoured it within a few minutes. This was one of the few best croissants i ever tasted in the US. My husband had pecan roll which was also fresh, crispy outside and crunchy pecan. We didn't expect to find such good pastry.

The only reason I didn't give 5 stars was the coffee wasn't good. It tasted almost like water.

We live in the neighborhood and have been coming here for years. Typically since the pizzas are a bit pricey we reserve this place for special occasions.

Called last night, had to repeat my order on the phone a few times - no big deal. Go to pick it up, such low energy at the counter, also messed up the one request I had, the pie was not hot, toppings put on super sloppy. Get home, pizza cuts were all uneven. Like, these are the simple things.

Then the taste was very mediocre and forgettable. There are just many much better options nearby for the price. Sorry and good luck out there guys.

Been here many times. Tonight was a huge disappointment. Took 10 min to get a drink order. Took 30 min after that for our food order to be taken. One at my table got their food after 30 min then the rest 10 min later. The food-my burger was dry and tasteless, chicken tenders tasted burnt, the Philly cheesesteak was dry and tasteless. The servers were running their butts off while one gal took 20 min just to wipe off 2 tables.
Usually everything is good. Not going back for awhile. Not worth the $50 we spent.
They really need to work on their other items other than wings.

Attention veg*ns: do not eat here! I ordered the Ma Po Tofu, which is listed as spicy, with steamed rice. I got it home and noticed that the tofu is in huge, *completely* raw chunks. I sighed because I had been at work 9 hours and was soaked from rain. I decided to cook the tofu myself and go ahead and eat the veggies and rice. The dish was not spicy by anyone's standards, and it wasn't even a proper Ma Po, which has beans and wood mushrooms. This dish has carrots, bell peppers, and pea pods that still have the inedible strings intact. The tofu took 20 minutes to cook, as usual. Sooooo disappointed with this place and will not be back.

First sushi out in way too long.... Sadly for us it was just ok..... I love how small and intimate this place is but the music was turned up so loud you couldn't really have conversation. We were waiting to be seated when it was turned down. Only to be turned back up once the person was done eating us. 

The food was ok nothing really to write home about home about.  The lobster based roll had very little lobster in it and also included a flavor profile with green peppers that was just overpowering.  In the future while this place Los close I will probably go somewhere else.

We came here after seeing it on Bar Rescue. Most of the bars that Jon Taffer remakes shut down because the owners don't follow his advice so it was nice to see this one still open.  We bought a Resurrection drink and Barber Beer.  They were both really good but the Resurrection was definitely better. 

We didn't get any food while we were there but did get a t-shirt. One thing that was definitely confusing was seeing a Turtle Bay bar at another part of the city serving the Resurrection and Barber Beer. Good drink but weird choice.

Check under your lid before leaving, as the drinks are consistently underfilled here. This is not a complaint based on just one poor experience. I work nearby, so I've been here tons of times. I am sick and tired of paying for a grossly underfilled drink. The only reason I'm giving 2 stars instead of 1 is that the staff are friendly, and they maintain reasonable wait times despite frequent long lines. However, at the end of the day it's the product that counts, and it's insulting to not get sufficient bang for your buck.

We had a great Sunday night stay as a stop on the way to Nashville. We tried to check in early but no luck. The. Arrived at the beginning of check in and were upgraded to a suite. The beds were comfy and the bedding was plush! 

They def have a lot of rules to follow & after using our bathroom- the oiler power holder was loose and the towel rack came off when I took a medium sized towel off.. so obviously they've had some rowdy crowds. 

Also there was a blinking on the smoke detector but it wasn't bothersome
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Cedric is great. I have a 99 Saab convertible and it's difficult to find repair shops in the area that know what to do with it! He is very flexible and allowed me to leave the car while I went on a business trip. He fixed my issues, explained everything clearly, gave me several options and did not overcharge. The location is convenient as well I highly recommend for any foreign car - as Saab's are not his only forte. While taking the car to the shop is never fun, going to Cedric at least gives me peace of mind.

I absolutely love the HUGE beer selection of this bar! We were able to try Parish Brewing's Ghost in the Machine while in town and it was AMAZING. The bar tenders were friendly enough but they were a bit slow to ask if you needed another drink. I guess that's expected from a busy bar on Bourbon Street on a Friday night. We will go back, I really enjoy getting to try the different local beers. Cheers!  They also have beer and shot specials (only certain beers with choice of certain shots). This definitely makes for a fun night!

I came in the other day with an appointment for an oil change and tire rotation. Due to an overbooking error, I wound up sitting around for 45 minutes before my car was even pulled in from the lot to be serviced. The service manager, Dallas, went above and beyond to correct the error and provided above & beyond service. He personally worked on and looked after my vehicle and kept me in the loop every step of the way. In a time when customer service seems to be dimming, I was blown away by the accountability Dallas & his team took in their work. Truly impressed and a very satisfied customer!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Cute spot on Davis Island. When you walk up, there are outside tables and an alley way leading to their entrance. When you walk in you are walking directly into a dining room. The inside is cute and has a rustic feel. We started off with their housemade Sangria. It was very fruity and delicious. Service was prompt and attentive. We ordered the burrata appetizer and I enjoyed the shrimp and scallop scampi. My husband ordered the chicken parmigiana which he didn't rave about. They were pretty large servings. Overall cute little place. If you are already on Davis Island check it out. Otherwise, we wouldn't make the hike out there again.

Lilly's tacos never disappoint! The workers here are always welcoming and they are also very fast! 

I ordered adobada, cachete, and veggie tacos. I've tried the chicken fajita, asada, and lengua tacos in the past as well. ALL of their tacos are super yummy! 

I love ordering my tacos with a side of grilled onions. They're really tasty, and are amazing with the tacos. 

The salsa bar is great, and I love that it is always stocked with limes, cilantro, and everything else that is essential for tacos. 

I love Lilly's!!!

I went to Shiki tonight with my daughter and her boyfriend last night. Since I am on a low carb diet, I was disappointed that I couldn't have sushi due to the rice. So, I chose the Sashimi Deluxe. I am one of those people that thinks the rice makes the sushi so I have to tell you I was reluctant. I am happy to report I was not let down. Shiki always satisfies and the sashimi was no exception! I have never had anything on their menu that wasn't superb. Andy is always so gracious and friendly. Such a beautiful dining experience all the way around!

Great ambiance...had very high hopes for a new authentic Mexican restaurant in St Petersburg. If I never ordered anything and just had the salsa and chips I may give this 4 stars.  However, service...umm?  Let's just say, we'll see the blonde next Tuesday!  Generally love table side guacamole...and would have so, liked to see a better presentation of it. Our food arrived cold and cheese was not melted plates were not hot. Choice of beer was limited. I'm so terribly disappointed. Although I may give another try and see if second time is better.

Stopped by for lunch here and had an EXCELLENT all-around experience. All the food was fresh and tasty- much better than your average! From the miso soup to the vegetable dumplings to the bento box lunches- we were very pleased. Customer service was wondeful: Our server and the host up front were super kind and attentive. Furthermore, we visited with our newborn, and they were very accommodating, understanding, and friendly towards him being there. We would highly recommend this place and would definitely come back!

Food isn't anything special at all I was very disappointed after waiting 1 hr 20min. The bread was very good but my husbands food, sons food and mine wasn't anything special and or amazing at all. If this is the best Italian food in Boise I'm worried! I've traveled to over 40 states and this place does not deserve the rep it has at all. Waiter was very friendly and funny and made sure things came out on a timely manner and refills were on point wish I could remember his name he was great. I give 2 stars not for the food at all that's a 1 star but 2 stars for the fact that we had a good waiter.

I truly believe that Sump offers the best coffee in St. Louis. They have heavy competition, but overall, Sump is my favorite. The tastes have already been blended perfectly. Sump provided me the opportunity to try my first Mint Mocha that features mint leaves! Truly delicious. This weekend I tried their tea for the first time! No surprise - the staff was knowledgeable about their selections and the tea was delicious. 

As far as the atmosphere goes, Sump offers a peaceful and quiet ambiance. It's a great place to get some work done or just enjoy some "me time"

We only booked one night and while the room was clean - the room and entire resort look so incredibly run down. The shower was literally coming off from the wall, the mattress looks like it hasn't been changed in over 10 years, and the exterior of the building looks extremely dated. For one night - totally manageable but wouldn't stay for longer then that. In the course of an hour there were three pizza/Italian fliers that were slipped under our door. 

The Holiday Inn express is next door and next time we'll gladly pay the extra money to stay there just for peace of mind.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Pretty disappointing for a normally clean, no surprise Hilton experience. Booked a 2 room suite and it was far below expectations.  Dated decor, broken closet door.   Dismal.  
I have noticed this same sort of seedy look with several Hilton hotels recently.  I think this is because I have been loving the clean fresh new modern Home2suites and some of the Hampton inns are new.  Service is good as is the case with most hotels in Hilton family but from now on I'm asking how old the hotel is.  When it was renovated, etc.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Just had lunch at this place yesterday... And I was not impressed. It was very loud since there was a rock band playing but that didn't bother me too bad. I was helped almost right after I sat down so that was good. After I ordered it took about 25 minutes for my food to arrive and there really weren't too many people eating there... just mainly people having drinks so I don't know what took so long. My mom ordered coconut shrimp and it just tasted like chicken to be honest. I got a salad with chicken and the chicken was awful. It was hard to chew and very rubbery. I definitely won't be making my way back here.

If I could give less than 1 star I would. I used the subway app asked for a footlong blackforest ham on italian herb and cheese with provolone cheese toasted. No cheese and not toasted!!! Way to many bell peppers when I asked for 1/2  all n all the sandwich was barely edible and the people there couldn't speak english!! I seriously could not understand a word that came out of the womans mouth!!! If you are going to work in a restaurant then you should be able to read, write, and "speak" the language of the country you are in!

Ordered ahead (due to covid) and glad we did.  I arrived 30 minutes after placing the order as the lady said. They were crazy busy and it took an extra 30 minutes on top of that. 

Now my last few days have been hectic so I appreciate kind and happy service.  They gentlemen and ladies were fantastic and nice.  My food was fresh and hot.  

Ordered tuna maki, cucumber maki, shrimp bowl and green onion cake. Everything was really good.  

3/5 because of the extra long wait....but I'm glad it all tasted good and service was great.

My colleague and I were in need of a washroom and a great iced coffee so what better place to stop at than Starbucks to order 2 coffee Frappuccinos.  They make the best! It was refreshing and needed in a Friday afternoon.  I get mine made with coconut milk and it's got just the perfect balance of sweetness.  

I'm always pleased to stop at a Starbucks to use their facilities.  They are typically very clean.  Today was no exception the washrooms were very clean and our order took no time at all.  

This location is pretty nice great big windows and a nice patio.

I'm a Bonvoy member so stay at Marriott brand hotels all the time.  This was your typical Courtyard hotel but with Covid precautions in place, no housekeeping unless requested but enjoyed our stay nonetheless.  Staff is friendly, rooms clean and semi-comfy beds with a refrigerator, large desk/table.   

Had a balcony view of the pool.  Pool was nothing fancy but did the job to cool us down with Arizona heat.   Nice garden with seating areas.  

There are few restaurants and stores that are within walking distance of the hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Slowest Starbucks I've ever been to. There was one person ahead of me and maybe 3 or 4 after me. All I ordered was a cold brew and somehow I was in there for 15 minutes. I understand that the drive thru might be busy but there were at least 5 of them behind the counter. Baristas were slow moving and not very efficient. It didn't seem like anyone had a certain station, they were all over the place. I also tried to do the "order ahead" option the following day and for some reason, the app said this location wasn't taking those orders.

The location is great. I'm sure it'll be fantastic once all of the renovations are done, but we were unaware of this and you're paying for more than what you're getting. The front desk is friendly and motivated despite the problems I'm sure they constantly hear about. Something is very loud even in the renovated rooms (which are quite nice) that drones on and on all day/night long. The elevator is extremely slow. Mostly just annoyed that there weren't any notification that it was under construction. For what we paid, I expected more.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: So I schedule an appointment for 9am for a PA inspection.  The website asks what you are coming in for.  I arrive at the place at a little before 9am.  The assistant manger Frank tells me his inspector doesn't come in until 2pm.  What poor service.  The appointment scheduling is all bogus otherwise someone would have communicated there's no way to get inspected until after 2pm.  I guess they don't value customers time.  I did ask to get a call from the GM and regional manager... I'll hold my breath before I hear from them.  Terrible service!!!!!!!!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Apparently they're a Philadelphia ristorante that's expanded to have a couple of pizzerias/bistros. It follows Gordon Ramsay's formula well: elegantly simple modern industrial décor with golden-era nostalgia and famiglia in the form of blown-up black-and-white family photos on the walls, and relatively few dishes done very well: Italian-American favorites including brick-oven and other gourmet pizzas and red-sauce classics. Friendly service. And the price is right: "mad reasonable" as another reviewer wrote. My date and I were full for just over $20.

I loved my stay at the Tampa Marriott Water street. The location is immediately across the street from the Tampa Convention Center, the trolly stop, aquarium and so many more fun spots. A lot of restaurant options within walking distance. 

The room - clean, duel shower heads with removable option, lots of towels, beds were super comfy, balcony was perfect add on. 

The pool is not "rooftop" it's on the 3rd floor. But super chill and fun ambiance. 

Service - Christina was kind, courteous and offered many add ons. Note that any plus has a cost affiliation.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The pie is good but there were flies all over the place inside and outside. This is close to campus so I'm sure you can draw your own conclusions on the normal patron but if I didn't already know what I was walking into, I would walk right back out. I know that a "dive" seems to be more the aesthetic that they are going for but you can make a dive clean.

The reason for the 3 stars is saved by the quality of the pizza itself. It's good. The bacon potato slice is always great, and their specials tend to be good as well. It's on the expensive side for what you get, but it is a high step above your box pizza stores.

Decided to give this a try to test out a new place. I try to order online for delivery; they don't deliver to mount holly, which is literally 5 mins away. Ah well, I just go pick it up. Bring the food home and wasn't impressed. The pizza crust tasted like a cardboard box and the sauce for the gnocchis had a odd taste, couldn't put my finger on it. It was almost like someone couldn't determine if they wanted to use sweet or a more robust sauce, so they mixed both together. I'll just stick with my LaVita's from now on.

I am writing an update to my review. I was contacted by this establishment and asked to try them again. I stand by my original review. I tried them again. I dropped off two black business suit skirts. It was really obvious where the ironing board marks were slightly made on one skirt. On the other the wrinkles were not ironed out on the waistband. I took some pictures, but it was easier to see the wrinkles and marks in person. 2 skirts cost $9.95.

Note: A purchase under $10 must be paid by cash or check. You cannot pay by credit/debit card.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
5. Stars. Delicious, best sushi I've had in a long time and 3x8 pieces for lunch is more than generous. And you can pick almost any roll from like, 20 choices!!  Fresh, and proportion of rice to each filling is perfect.

They also have teas here which I ordered but I'm not an expert in so it was fine. If there was a downfall, the soup that comes with most entrees is a bit lacking in broth flavor but without a doubt I'll be back here (and have been). Oh, and right now they have a Yelp coupon which just is awesome!

Before, I would have to drive to Sushi Land in Bryn Mawr for my sushi fix, but since discovering Nami Sushi, I haven't been back (sorry Sushi Land)! 

This is a no frills, reasonably priced restaurant that still offers a great variety of both sushi and cooked foods. I've only ever ordered takeout, but the wait time has never been more than 25 mins (usually around 15). For something a little different, I recommend ordering any of the sushi with mango listed in the ingredients - it adds the slightest sweet burst of flavor! 

If you're looking for some solid sushi without the Main Line prices, this is the place to be.

I've been living in the neighborhood for 3 years and I think that beautiful location deserves much better. Better coffee, better space for community and visitors to get together or grab coffee, better service. Coffee is barely adequate and the space itself is clearly not managed by someone who seems to care. Please State Street Coffee Shop, you can so much better than that and get the support of local people and visitors. I never ever send anyone to State Street Coffee shop if they are looking for good coffee.

WARNING : There are aggressive homeless individuals asking for money literally on the steps when you leave the store. I gave money on the way here to someone and when another beggar asked me for money almost before I even got out of the foyer I said I already gave and he replied "F you then". Also, guys they are literally asking for money on the liquor store steps if they are looking for a meal or food its another story.

So if you are okay with dealing with the location the store itself is gigantic but I will not be coming back. 

In the words of Ariana Grande "Thank you Next!"

We like, we like...  Great brunch spot in wee little Narberth.  My favorite part of the restaurant is just the general feel of it, casual, cozy, lively, yet slightly upscale, and I love that we can walk here on a Saturday morning if we feel like doing a fancy breakfast.  There are outdoor tables too, for fair-weather days.  Everything we've tried here has been quite good - not knock-your-socks-off-good, but mmm, that's-pretty-damn-tasty-good.  I've been here for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and none of them have disappointed.  I love having this place right by our house, please stick around!!

Great little wine bar in downtown Doylestown. We stopped in for a drink with friends ahead of dinner reservations elsewhere. The wait staff were friendly, funny and very welcoming. 

The wine selection is really good, though I do think their per-glass costs are just a little high, even for Doylestown. This might explain why we were the only people in the place at 5:30 on a Saturday that had ample foot traffic all over town.

Pricing aside, a great little place to pop in for a great drink with friends. I'll definitely be back.

As PA state stores go, this is one of the better ones with a fairly broad selection. 

The true highlight of this store are several staff members with an impressive knowledge of wines. There is an older gentleman who works here - his name might be Jim, but I can't remember for certain - who has introduced me to two or three amazing "off the beaten path" wines that have not failed to impress my dinner guests.

Yes, it's a state store with many of the implied limitations - but you'll be sure to walk away with a decent selection, helped by a few well-informed staff members.

Why do I do this to myself?  Let me try to make wine out of water.  The staff are friendly and the tea is da' bomb. Thats it, See ya..... Please help me break the Mcd's curse. 
I should know you get what you pay for. Its yuk city baby!
The fries were old, the bigmac looked like it was on life support which is where I will be if I keep hearing the whispers of "sweeeeeeet teaaaaa" "sweeeeeet teaaaaa" every other mile when I pass the golden arches. Hey it keeps people employed, helps kids pay for college, Ronald Macdonald house is awesome so I guess i'll be stopping back in.  Whatever happened to the McDLT?
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Right in the lobby of Circus Circus Casino, this is a very convenient coffee & breakfast stop for casino-goers & hotel guests. There's basic seating available, but not exactly the type of place to do work since the slots are right next to the entrance. Service was pretty efficient. 

I ordered the dirty spiced chai, but it was okay. I wish it was spicier, but it might just be the powder used for the drink. It's also a bit too sweet for my taste. The bagel was toasted perfectly though! 

Will only come back just because it's convenient & if I wanted to try different drinks/goods.

If you aren't a "dead to the world" sleeper, I'd avoid this hotel. I'm writing this review as I wait for someone from the hotel to come get me to change rooms. The extremely loud noise the heat makes only pails in comparison to the shaking and impossible-to-sleep through noise of the massive cargo trains that come by probably a hundred feet from this room. When I checked in, the front desk warned there was some renovation noise....hoping this isn't what she meant. After a long day of travel and early meetings tomorrow morning, this is one of the worst hotel stays I've had yet. Will be finding somewhere else to stay for the remainder of my trip.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have several Dunkin's near me and this is my favorite one to go to. The staff is always cheerful, nice and helpful. It's never crowded which is nice even though it's located in A busy area of center city. The food is given to you quickly and the longest I've waited was probably about 2 minutes. It's kept clean which I appreciate since the one about 2 blocks is not. The food is standard Dunkin' quality so I  don't expect anything out of this world. What really keeps me coming back is how friendly everyone is.

This wine and spirits is one of the biggest ones I've been to. They have a very large selection of wine as well as liquor. Had a pretty funny experience today. The security guard comes over to us, at first I thought she was making sure no one was stealing anything then she says "What's up dog? I can't wait to get out of here, I'm bored as shit." Leans on the glass slides down it and walks away. We looked at each other and were like wtf? Not sure if she was doing a little wine tasting of her own but it caught us off guard. Other than that this store is great.

French market inn is in a great great location and the atmosphere matches the city. The courtyard is pretty! The bed though, is super firm. Some people might like that but I woke up many times through the night and body aching. Asked the front for a box fan so that there would be white noise, they didn't have any so we made a trip to Home Depot. The rooms are quiet so you can hear if anyone is being loud in courtyard. If French market inn could have better beds, offer breakfast or have a fridge and microwave, then this hotel would get 5 stars.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Haven't been here In Years. Went back finally after some time, and wow.... does anyone know how to do their job? It's curbside to go. You get the customer's food together, and let them know the price. Usually before u pull up. Pulled up... and wasn't told my total or anything. I was having a card issue Bc I'm out of state.. thanks Wells Fargo.. anyways I get my food finally! 
And get this it's not even all here!! Are u kidding me?! Why don't u pay attention to the order before u try and charge someone?! Is that so hard?!

There's a lot offered here. The rooms are beautiful and updated. 

The staff are friendly and helpful.

Easy access on and off I-76. Close to Manyunk. Conveniently located in West Philly. A short ride to Center City and all it has to offer. About a 20 minute drive to King of Prussia.

Many nearby restaurants such as Longhorn Steakhouse, Chipotle, California Pizza Kitchen, Panera, Fridays. Target and The Fresh Grocer are nearby. Septa bus stop outside of the hotel. Septa train a few blocks away. Free parking.

If you have a student at a nearby college ask about their special rate. There's a special rate for St. Joe's.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I highly recommend Midway auto service. I own my own pool company and I have trucks always breaking down. I take them to Midway and the turnaround time is absolutely what I have been looking for. Not to mention , he put a motor in my Xterra with a three day turnaround time. I  Was definitely not expecting that. I now take all my work vehicles, my personal vehicles, and I would highly recommend that you take your vehicles here. 
Customer service A+
Prices A+
Cleanliness A+
I am so glad I found midway automotive, and I guarantee you will be also if you take your vehicles there!!

Reviews are 100. Went this morning after reading so many great things about Frances and it was everything and more I could've ever dreamed about a cheap hair cut.

$20 for a shampoo (which consisted of 3 rinses and reapplies), head massage and back massage, hair cut, blow dry and she even straightened so she could make sure for herself that she did a good job. I tipped her $6 and the woman who did my shampoo $2 because I was just beyond happy and was expecting to pay $23. 

Seriously beyond estatic that I've found a new place. Thank you Perfect Cut Hair Salon.

Inconsiderate hotel patrons are shooting off fireworks literally outside my window in my hotel at 11:30 pm. I call the front desk and ask if anything has been said to them and the front desk clerk says in a condescending tone, "like what?" I said, "Like don't shoot fireworks in the hotel parking lot." He replied with attitude and said it's not illegal. WTH. I said, that's cool, I'll call corporate. Had I been playing music loudly in the parking lot at almost midnight in a sleeping establishment I'm sure I would have been deemed a nuisance. Not everyone is on holiday. I have to work tomorrow. I don't appreciate the attitude.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Absolutely great selection but you have to watch your prices. On some items you can shop across the street at the big box stores and find the same item for less per 100g. 

All the same, there is something to be said for walking out with all those little bags of your favourite candies. Sometimes all you want is just three or four candies, not a whole container. Reminds me of buying five cent candies when I was a kid. 

This location is always clean and the staff know their item numbers well. I have never been delayed at the checkout.

Best service we have ever received! Tony's made our  anniversary special right from the moment we walked in. They take your coat and put your napkin on your lap. We had 4 men at our service the whole night. The attention to detail was wonderful. Our steaks were perfectly cooked and the sauce was amazing. They were so kind to give us a piece of cake aat the end, which we did not have  room for but ate anyways. Loved this  place and recommend to everyone. Classy, clean and delicious. We are going back for sure.

My 15 month lease is ending in a couple of months. This is the time everyone dreads the most. Moving sucks. I've lived in many apartments and all I can say is Lenox at Bloomingdales has been by far the best luxury apartment experience. I am strongly considering renewing my lease. The increase was approximately a 3% increase which isn't terrible. The pool is awesome, great gym facility, trash valet is always timely and they do a good job, parking is a plenty, neighbors are respectful (there one apartment that blares bass at night till 1am, minor issue). Definitely check them out!!

I have eaten at Pomodoro Pizza for many years.  This time was the last.  I ordered an Italiana pizza and it was soggy all except 2 inches from the crust.  This is definitely NOT what a South Jersey Pizza is supposed feel like or taste like.  I realize there are a good amount of ingredients on it, but soggy pizzas are absolutely disgusting.I threw out the pizza.  The meatballs smelled suspiciously like prepackaged meatballs.  I am from south Jersey and my ex owned his own pizzeria.  I know good and bad pizza.  This was NOT good pizza in the least.

I got ice cream for my husband and I. We each got a size small and were able to get two flavors and a piece of cone. My husband got the non-dairy ice cream which is all coconut milk bases and his flavors were the texas sheet cake and cold brew with coconut cream. I was the only person ordering in the store at the time and was wearing my mask as was person taking my order. The person at the store was very helpful and I was served promptly. The ice cream was good but $5 each for a small just seems like a lot for ice cream. This ice cream brand in general tend to have atypical flavors.

Do you like being late to work? Waiting in line for 10 minutes after you order your drink? Then go to this Starbucks!  Before I discovered the mobile app ordering,  I would give myself 15-20 minutes extra to get a drink from here, I know that doesn't sound that bad but I worked not even three minutes from this location and I was ordering at 645am. I am honestly grateful for the mobile app so I can order my drink before and the fact that I no longer work in the area so I don't need to order from this Starbucks

Location! Location! Location! I came to Philadelphia for work and normally stay downtown, but when I saw that the hotel was a block from Liberty Hall, I knew I wanted to switch it up. The staff was so helpful when I asked about leaving my bags to go walk around, and even gave a few tips on how to see things without doing the museum tour.

Breakfast in the morning was a little disappointing, but that should probably be a review of Chez Ben instead of the hotel. Staff wasn't overly friendly... ordering a cappuccino instead of regular coffee apparently was not very appreciated.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My friend and I went there tonight for appetizers before a movie. We sat at the bar and informed the bartender of our food order. We denied his request of drinks twice and requested water instead. Bartender didn't put in the order. We decided to change our order and informed him of the new order and waited for our food for at least 10 minutes or so.  We called the bartender back to pay only to be informed he hadn't put in our order at all.  We got up and left. Twice no order was placed despite placing the orders and we never got the waters. Just bad service.

JW Marriott always lives up to mark and this one was no other. The rooms were good,service was excellent. The only reason why I gave 3 stars and not more is because the concierge lounge lacked options for vegetarians like us. For breakfast as well as snacks. We have been here for 3 days already and leave tomorrow early morning and all 3 days I checked their snacks. There are usually two things on the menu and they both are meat. Sometimes pork and beef,pork and chicken etc.
Apart from that our stay was smooth,nothing else to complain about.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Went for dinner on Friday night waitress was friendly but not very attentive.  Ordered crab bisque soup, to be honest I had better from a can, there were 2 pieces of crab and not much taste for $9.00 I would expect a bit more and it did have a few shells.  My husband had the rigatoni bolognese and I had the gnocchi gorgonzola not horrible but not great I would say just ok.  Waitress forgot our salads that come with the meal, we asked and she did bring them out, homemade dressing was tasty.  
Items were a bit pricey and you don't get much for your money.
Again, It wasn't horrible but I would not go back.

I had my wife pick up two combination platters on her way home from work. When she got home one of the platters was wrong. I called up to ask if they could remake it and although I could barely understand what the guy on the phone said, I could grasp that he would remake it and it would be 10 minutes. 5 minutes later I get up to the restraunt and they had locked the doors, turned off the lights, and presumably went home. I was/am absolutely furious and was forced to eat the wrong platter. I will never go here again.

Stopped by for a late lunch around 2pm on a Saturday.  While many of the other nearby restaurants were still bustling, Chambers was empty.  (a sign of things to come)  Ordered the day's special - cajun tuna sandwich.  Which turned out to be pretty plain tuna fish on Wonder bread, once piece which was ever so slightly stale.  The server was friendly enough but still not sure how it could take 10+ minutes to prepare something so simple when there was absolutely no one else in the restaurant.  On the plus side, it didn't make me sick.

Overall I can't think of any reason to go back here.

By far one of the best nail salons I've ever had the pleasure of experiencing. The pedicure was amazing. The foot massage could be a little longer but the chairs were nice. The salon seemed clean. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. I felt awful visiting just before closing but they understood my schedule and still got my friend and I serviced right away without issue. I also tried powder nails for the first time which was so amazing I'm now hooked. They had awesome options for colors in all types of polish powder and gel. I'll definitely come back.

Good size pan size 12 inch pizzas our whole family choose their own a bit over priced and charged us extra for our drinks we already bought at the bar so I give it 3.5 stars.

Service: Pizzas where done in a timely manner the staff is friendly and courteous.

Food: The white pizza with extra basil is a must. The waiter asked basil cooked or place on top after it is cooked. Great suggestion, so I went with basil baked with the white cheese.

Calzone: My son purchased his own 12 inch calzone which was $11 with bacon $4 and chicken $5 that was $20 total for him. Very expensive I would say.

Just grabbed quick coffees to go to drink in line for Biscuit Love. My friend and I checked the menu ahead of time to see what we each wanted since one of us was going to have to stay behind so we didn't lose our place in line. When my friend got there she didn't see either of the drinks we had chosen on the menu. Apparently they had just changed a bunch of stuff and no longer had those drinks. She went with a safe bet and just ordered two Carmel Lattes. They were pretty good, but I would have liked to try the Zebra Latte I had my heart set on. Overall, a very convenient coffee place that fit our immediate needs.

We stopped in here to try the drink that is this bar's claim to fame...The Resurrection. It comes in a plastic skull mug that lights up. The drink itself was pretty tasty. Paul described it as tasting like a pixie stick. The bartender was very sweet and she even added some more liquor to remove some of the over sweetness (this was towards the end of the night and we had consumed so many overly sweet drinks already). We actually hung out at this bar for quite a while and ended up ordering the Alligator Poppers. They were ok, standard bar food, hitting the spot after hours of drinking. I would return to this bar for sure!

As I work the 3rd shift, I have not had to deal with anyone from the day shift.  EVERY ORDER that is handled by the late shift, is either WRONG, or takes 20 minutes to process when you are the only car in the place. And their attitude is: why are you upset? Tonight was my last visit to this location. I have spent far too many lunch periods in line waiting to be served or have an order corrected. I Am A BIG Fan Of Wendy's......BUT this Location Need To Either Close Down Completely.......or Shut Down The late Shift. Giving an Otherwise Good Company A VERY BAD NAME & REPUTATION!!!

We are regulars at Lotus. We eat here at least once a month and have been diners here the last two New Year's Eve. In my mind, it's the best restaurant in Media and I wish everyone knew, so they could experience the great meals we have had here. Over the years I've had it all, seafood, beef, pork chops and salads. Service is always friendly and informative. Food is always fresh, inspired and delicious. Oh and the desserts are always worth saving room for. They deserve more credit for what they achieve and it's our hope they are there for us for dinner for a long time to come.

This coffee shop is so tiny I could hardly find it, but I'm glad I did!!  

There were two baristas there and they were both so kind and helpful.  They gave good descriptions of their drinks and suggestions on what alternative milks to pick.  Their customer service was on point. 

I tried their gingerbread man latte with oatmilk and whipped cream. It was good! It didn't taste artificial like some places gingerbread lattes can. *shout out to Starbucks* 

Looking for a cute coffee shop downtown, check them out!

I really like this coffee shop.
