I've only been in a couple times to grab a drink, but they're always hoppin'!  Especially on the weekends,  but I've always been able to find parking and a table despite them being busy.

When I stopped in the other day I asked about their eggnog latte, like I do everytime I go in.  And I got the same answer from a different barista, they didn't love it.  But I was curious so I got it anyway. I should have listened to their warnings. It was pretty awful..  Luckily they have other holiday drinks that are super good.  I suggest trying their spiced brown sugar latte, it's my favorite!

I had this yesterday. I don't like to eat red meat as much anymore so I always choose a grilled cheese, it tastes amazing! They have so many options here. I've even gotten my dog a "puppy patty" which they make out of the beef but don't include salt which is a perfect snack for my dog. The shakes here are the best, and I'm just happy that we have In-N-Out in Tucson now! The services is are amazing whether you eat inside or go through the drive-thru. Everyone is really friendly, and I always commend the people that work here. Everyone is always doing something. The food tastes so fresh and it's a better alternative to other fast-food chains.

I love French Riviera Fitness!!! They have great hours, friendly and helpful staff, and a great selection of fitness machines and exercise resources! The cost is well worth it and the gym is well maintained. Everything is clean and tidy and I find the people that go there are respectful and careful (during pandemic there are extra safety precautions and cleanliness requirements that are well maintained and enforced. There is a Women's Only section which I like bc it's generally less crowded than the main floor. I also love the big exercise room with wood floor for yoga and meditation. The machines are well kept. I really like this gym!!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Decided to try this new location out this morning after getting my car washed right across the street. I was a bit confused at first because I wasn't sure got to access the drive thru and if they were open. But Bri was so nice she was inside and gave me the go ahead to use the drive thru! I told her it was my first time there and she walked me through the menu and was able to help me make my decision. I went with the classic chai with oatmilk. I will say it's a bit pricy but the quality of the chai was absolutely worth it. Bri even gave me recommendations for my next visit. Absolutely amazing and will be going back!!!

Even though reaching the car rental area at Tampa International is quite a journey from the Delta concourse--moderate walk, short train ride, another moderate walk, second train ride, short walk, long escalator, and another short walk--I have always been satisfied at this National location.

Join the Emerald Club so you can access the Emerald Aisle. It allows you to handle all your bookings in advance with s very convenient phone app. It also allows you to bypass the counter and simply hop in any available car and head for the exit.

Good selection of vehicles, easy exit, quick return.

Prices are bit high and quality is OK.  I have had better, I have had worse.  I bought an assortment of their 1 quart iced tea bags.

My biggest gripe is the bags that their iced tea comes in.  They fill up with air and its hard to get the tea and water out. I would say 3 out of 5 times that I go to squish the bag (like I do with every single tea bag I have ever used) the bag breaks open and your tea is ruined.  For such expensive tea you dont want to waste is so then I am straining the tea through a paper towel.  

Not worth it.  Please change your tea bags and I might consider reusing them.

This place is horrible... I'm pregnant and all i wanted was an iced coffee with the wake up wraps...i ordered a medium iced coffee with 2 bacon egg and cheese wake up wraps. I get my order and i drive off of course because i didn't want to hold up the line...i get to my destination and i decided to eat my wraps. I've opened the bag and what do you know i only got one (pissed)...then i taste my iced coffee absolutely no sugar and it tasted so nasty i swear the coffee tasted like it was sitting there for 2 days...I'm telling you i will never come here again! Oh and i couldn't go back because they NEVER GAVE ME A RECEIPT! Never again

I was able to make an appointment as a new patient very easily and within the next calendar week. I was told I should arrive early to fill out some paperwork so I arrived 30 mins early, but ended up sitting in the waiting room for 50 minutes (20 mins) past my appt time anyways which was kind of frustrating. All in all the staff was super helpful and friendly; the only downside is that things seem to move at a little slower pace and I spent 2 hours there just to get new contact prescriptions. But if you're willing to wait and have the time I would definitely recommend.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Honestly since I've moved to the city I've noticed the fast food up here is just not what it should be. I don't have high expectations for fast food as far as the actually food it's deff a hit or miss but this location just takes forever all the time and it's been a handful of times over the year or so I moved to North Hampton that I've been and they are always very slow. Also ordered on the app cause I'd rather curbside or pick up in store picked the curbside option when I ordered and I got there and they had curbside and pickup as not an option so I had to wait in the drive thru line anyways which defeated the whole purpose.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Anyone who says El Guerrero Canelo doesn't make the best Sonoran Hotdogs should not be trusted. I recommend eliminating them from your inner circle and possibly avoiding any future recommendations or suggestions they make. Also, don't go there and complain about the service, lack of AC, condition of the tables, or any other meaningless detail. If you are focusing on any of those then you have gone to the wrong place or are there for the wrong reason. Go to El Guero Canelo and just order the Sonoran Dogs, walk over to a table, eat them, and be thankful this delicious piece of food heaven was created just for you.

I usually prefer to be left alone when I am browsing. However, the staff here are consistently helpful and knowledgeable, bordering on passionate. I have gotten into the habit of meandering about until I get asked the "can I help you with anything" so I can ask questions about bourbon, bitters, beer, etc. I have never been let down. 

One time they risked letting me down when they were out of my usual Angostura bitters. But I took a risk on a different brand (based on a recommendation from one of the staff), and discovered that I prefer Fee Brothers Bitters. 

Best liquor store ever.

I've had good and not so good experiences with the takeout at Tres Jalapenos. 

I've ordered the avocado salad 3 times so far and never has it come with cheese. Note that the menu says it comes with "fresh cheese". I've even asked for there to be extra cheese and still none at all. 

Tonight I asked for the dressing on the side so my left overs wouldn't be soggy the next day. And I received no dressing on the salad or on the side at all (and of course no cheese). So now I'm eating a dry salad.

I have had their taco salad which is very good and do recommend. Their nachos are very good as well.

Never again to this place. We ordered a special , a tilapia dish, chicken piccata and spagetti and meatballs ($19). The waiter insisted to get split order for meatballs since we ordered one, and I have two kids. Mind it, I could have split the plate myself. When the bill came, the split order came up to $23. I asked why the extra charge and the owner himself came running to the table, very rudely and gave us a jerky explanation. First of all, your food was not tasty, secondly, I did NOT ask for a split order. After we got up to leave, this owner ran to the table to see if we left tip or not. My gosh! What a Jerk!

Stopped in tonight with the family and made the mistake of venturing away from the pizza.  The pizza is very good, would recommend. Calamari as well. 

My wife and a pasta dish and the pasta was undercooked, bread served had been "forgotten to be placed in the oven"".  My lasagna, was terrible. Sauce was runny and I asked if it was FROZEN. Waitress confirmed; this was a Saturday night. Waitress didn't know when it was made, but stated it was thawed out in the oven. It was not the same temperature throughout and will have a hard time ordering anything other than a pie.

This place was alright. I'm not the biggest coffee drinker, I just started drinking it actually but the mocha I got here was enjoyable. I also got an almond croissant and I liked that a lot, and their other baked goods looked pretty good too. I guess the menu is a little limited in some ways, my one friend didn't order a coffee because they didn't have the flavor shot she wanted, so if you're a caramel fan you might wanna go elsewhere, i dunno haha. It was nice inside with plenty of space and the people working were nice too, and it wasn't crowded at all when I went

I often shop here for groceries. I find the prices better than T&T and the selection is good. After I get my groceries I like to have a bite to eat at the cafeteria there. They have an abundant selection from roast pork to pho and Bahn mi. They also have a selection of "pick 2 items and noodles or rice" kind of stuff. This is what I got today. The pork belly was tasty and the portions were big. I also got a mandarin juice with pulp which was super good. For the price it's a great way to end a shopping trip and fill your belly.

I'll start off with this review by the location of this restaurant. The area of this area is nice, clean, and safe. The atmosphere once you walk in is awesome! I began my night by starting off with a little alcohol, the Palmoma Welcome Punch was a nice smooth punch! The Drifter is also a nice drink as well.

Appetizer:  Guacamole  3/5
Dinner: ACTQ Tacos
Steak Barbacoa 1/5 
Baja Fish Tacos 5/5 - one of the best tacos.
Chicken Tinga Tacos 3/5 
Cauliflower Tacos 5/5 - one of the best tacos.
Dessert: Churros 3/5 - the syrup with the churros are delicious. 

Would definitely come back again!

So I've tried ALOT of pizza around the Tampa area, I love pizza, who doesn't?! If I must add I am from Long Island so I know what good pizza tastes like... anyways I have been hearing people brag about joes pizza for a while so one day I finally went through the drive through and ordered a large pizza and I FELL IN LOVE it's my new favorite place in Tampa for pizza!!! It's so so good irresistible good, mmmm. So I went again a week later and added a order of garlic knots to try and it was delicious (not that I expected any less) and the marinara sauce served with it just as good. Try this place out! Highly highly recommend.

I LOVE dr Lamon, she's the only doctor I'll see. My lela is a 10 year old beagle spaniel who is very anxious and she loves dr Lamon (the first vet she is friendly with). Dr Lamon is so patient and friendly and takes her time without forcing you into any unneeded things for your fur babies. Dr. Lamon operated on Lela this past Thursday, removing a large mass on her side. Not only did I fully trust her taking care of my girl, she did an excellent job and really helped us in all aspects. I cannot day enough good things about her!

Gave Grazianos a third try. Went once years ago and it was delicious.  Second time was terrible. 

We just moved back to the area.  Today my husband ordered a family meal (chicken parm) as I just had surgery. You could tell they pre make all of their chicken ahead of time. It was dry, cold on the INSIDE, and warm on the outside. It was so dead, I could almost guarantee it wasn't even from today.  2 stars because we love their salad, and, their sauce is decent tasting for what little sauce they put on it as it was super skimpy. Will return for take of salad only.  I'm not shoveling out $$ for leftovers

Friendly staff, but they are located in way too remote of a location (their "downtown" location seems to be on the outskirts), especially from the train station. The car they gave me had a dented fender, a dirty interior and the previous driver had smoked it in. They did not have anything else available. So to get me on my way they waived the requirement to refill the tank before I returned the car. However, I was only going to have the car for 24 hours and a few miles so that did not compensate much for the odorous interior. If I come back to St. Louis and need a car, I will try the other Enterprise location in town.

How to lose weight easily? Just try some pasta at Sicilian Pasta Kitchen on Jasper Avenue! Severe food poisoning and minus 7 lb in 12 hours guaranteed!

Went out for a dinner to Sicilian Pasta Kitchen and my husband got the worst food poisoning from pasta there. Looks like a stomach flue. Had a horrible night, and on the way to the emergency now. Taking leftover of that pasta to Consumer Product Testing Centre tomorrow, so stay tuned for the results.

Please be safe my friends! 

Happy Mothers Day! Hope you are having a better one then me

Loving our stay here at the Hyatt! Super affordable and worth way more than what we paid (shhh)! Our first experience with the staff was excellent and it's kept up our entire stay.

Walk in to a cute lobby, way nicer than what we were expecting.

Jaime, the guy at the front desk is our favorite part of the Hyatt! So friendly, easy to talk to, and genuinely helps/cares about your stay. 

The breakfast in the morning was good. Cute little set up, variety of foods, and I loved the little oatmeal bar. 

Our room is spacious, very nice, and clean. 

I 100% recommend this hotel and it's staff to everyone when visiting Tucson!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We reserved a 2 queen room, but we got 2 doubles. Do they not know the difference?
The bathroom is so small you have to straddle the toilet to open the door to get in and out. 
They only give you shampoo and bar of soap, so make sure to bring your own conditioner. 
The ice machine is hard to get to and kind of a hike. 
The fridge was turned off so it took forever for it to cool down. 
The beds were very hard, like laying on concrete!
The TV picture was horrible!
The parking is very limited so good luck trying to park near your room. 
The place is very aged.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I stopped in for a quick breakfast on a Wednesday morning about 8:30 , not too many people in  the restaurant. The wait staff was very attentive and very quick. I order cheesy hash browns with eggs. The hash browns came with bell peppers and onion mixed in but we're still raw to the bite,( meaning of bell pepper and onions) I  sent it back then ordered a basic breakfast of hash browns eggs bacon and toast, decent breakfast but no flavor to the potatoes.... if and when I have to go there again I'll definitely be skipping the potatoes

This Dunkin donuts is the best in northeast. It's very clean, and food is very fresh. All the employees are very friendly and sweet. The service is quick and very accurate. I highly recommend this Dunkin donuts to everyone. When I go there, I get greeted by everyone and if the manager is behind the counter, he makes sure everything is good and asks how I am doing since I go there very frequently. Love the drive-thru service too because it very quick in the busiest hours and the coffee is made perfect to my taste and order.

I am a very frequent flyer at Starbucks and I don't write reviews but I just had THE worst experience I have ever had at a Starbucks at this location. The barista was already remaking 2 others drinks when I arrived for my mobile order. My latte was WHITE and although I like cream in my coffee I draw the line at paying $7 for a glass of milk! The barista was rude when I asked for a straw and wanted to argue when my boyfriend went back in to have her remake my drink. Absolutely unacceptable. Never going back to this location!

Isn't it weird that the coffee maker is located in the bathroom?? Isn't that unsanitary? Bed was good enough. Room smelled nice when I first entered. I got two queen beds instead of king bc of a maintenance issue but that's no big deal. Room was large enough and had all the basic amenities I would expect except toothpaste. Flat screen TV is a little small but ok. Nice hot shower is always a plus. Plenty of towels. Breakfast options were decent to good but there weren't any scrambled eggs which I was hoping for. Overall I would stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We've always loved this place, even make 30 minute trip to get there. Sadly, it has changed and we will not be back. First, they have the restaurant so packed with tables, it's not a comfortable atmosphere. We waited 45 minutes for our food, with not one check-in or apology. Thinking that they would at least offer chips for our wait. Food portions were ridiculously small, I left hungry. Menudo was a bowl of hominy, very little tripe. Food was just decent. Then when we asked for a refill of horchata, which yes I realize is not usually free, but after a  45 minute wait you'd expect a glass to be empty and maybe throw that in.

Went for Tuesday lunch.  Service was good despite looking incredibly busy.
Chips and salsa quite good.  Side of guac OK.  Could use a little more onion and garlic.   
I had a fish, shrimp and crunchy pork taco.  The fish started a little fishy and the a little overwhelmed by the pickled onion and the same with the shrimp.  The crunchy pork was tasty but minimal bite.  Beans were good.
My wife had chicken and steak.  She thought the steak was good but the pollo loco was bland. Service took a 2 rating to 3.  
The room was also very dark.  Hard to read the menu.

Horrible management. I work at Giant and it is Christmas eve and on my way home I decided to  grab dinner from there for my husband, children and myself since my job was now closed and I only had a twenty a dollar and a hundred. My bill came to 23 and change so when I handed her the 100 the girl said I have to ask if I can take this. When she asked her manager she quickly said no with such a bad attitude and did not even look at me while they were directly in front of me. So I just left. Horrible I will never go there again. Sad.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I only come to this Dunkin if I am desperate, however most of the time I will drive 4 miles out of my way to go to another location. They never pay attention to Mobile Orders and they do not know how to make drinks. Whenever I order an Iced Coffee with Mocha, cream, and sugar they usually add so much mocha it's thick and the taste is so strong like I'm drinking a candy bar. Usually they have to remake it but if I'm in a rush, I deal with it and make hot coffee at work and mix it in. Once again, I only come here if super desperate.

Since the hubby is a veteran, we headed to Octopus Car Wash on Veterans Day.  Their offer, a free car wash or the Ultimate car wash for $5 (normally at a price of $28.99).  Great savings!  However....I still wouldn't get the $28.99 car wash from them.  I have to redo the inside as it is dusty yet, I can hardly see out the windshield when the sun hits it and the vacuum job was mediocre.  I should have just gotten the basic free car wash and did the inside myself.  However, props to Octopus Car Wash for offering the veterans of Tucson this service.

The customer service on this order needs improvement.  I placed a huge order for my office, to be delivered with plates & napkins.  The delivery driver was to be given instructions to pull into the delivery entrance and call me when he/she arrived.  Waiting and waiting, I am notified that the delivery driver went to the wrong location within the business.  According to him, he wasn't told anything and alas no plates & napkins.  Next time we have a company gathering and do pizza...I will be using another local business...even if someone has to go pick it up.  Thank you for a hassle of a time Magpies.

Unfortunately our cat passed away during neutering at this location yesterday.  The cat was young and healthy and we were told by a tech that this was the 3rd one in a few weeks here.  This really concerns me very much.  Just wanted everyone to know.  We have had another situation with this same doctor with our other cat a couple of months ago - I found he did not thoroughly check my cat out after $500.00 of tests.  We looked in my cats throat and found infection - apparently $500.00 doesn't cover looking down a cats throat if they aren't eating well.  I asked that doctor for an antibiotic and he did agree and my cat is doing wonderful now.

This is definitely the first subway I have been to that doesn't carry buffalo sauce so I couldn't get what I always get (buffalo chicken sub). I'm pregnant so I have pretty limited options unless it comes to chicken or meatballs. When I walked in I had to just stand there for 2-3 mins while nobody greeted me but I could hear the employees talking in the back. As soon as one did come out from the back she seemed perturbed that I was even there. The ordering process was fine but I said thank you before I left and couldn't even get a thank you back or anything at all. I will certainly keep going to subway but not this one!!

Were greeted and seated quickly on a busy Friday night they just renovated and the place looks clean and fresh a friendly server  fulled us in on the night specials we opted for the lobster cake which was very fair including the seafood bisque fair also.. cocktails with not that big and a little overpriced my wifes veal parmesan and my shrimp parmesan special were  good. So were the large desserts however I would suggest Pizza sandwiches and beer before or after the game here ..dinner and drinks a little pricey but I'm guessing they get a lot of traffic because there's not a lot of restaurants right in that it mt ephrim area

Sushi is hard being this far away from any ocean. Sakura didn't make it that much better. The food was as unimpressive as the appearance of the restaurant. The seats were very close together to each other and it was very difficult to not bump in to anyone while you sitting or if you got up to use the restroom. The sushi was dry and had little flavor, but again we are in the Midwest and fish is harder to come by. The soup came and it was ok but visually and taste was. The service was great and the wait wasn't too long. The shortcomings of this place could possibly be location bound so I give them that.

I'm originally from Chicago, so, believe me, it's hard for me to find pizza that I like on the East Coast. However, Tony at Felicia's makes great, authentic Sicilian pizza in his brick oven (and makes for great conversation as well). The crust isn't paper thin like New York's (a plus in my book), and the pizza is consistently very good. The toppings are always fresh and aren't just available to doctor bad pizza. Try the Felicia's Special: spinach, garlic, olive oil, and tomatoes. And the calzones are great, too. 

Trust me, once you try it once, you'll be ordering from Felicia's again before you know it.

I had lunch here a few days ago.  I ordered one of the lunch specials: shrimp in garlic sauce with rice and egg roll.  I also ordered some fresh watermelon.  The garlic sauce was excellent but the shrimp had a very awful chemical taste. They forgot my watermelon but were very quick to bring it and it was a hardy serving.  I gave the egg roll to my friend who said it was excellent.  I'd go again for that garlic sauce but pass on the shrimp.  Pretty good fast food.   There are only 2 tables.  It's more of a take out restaurant than a sit down.    There was no air conditioning the day I was there.  The front door was propped open.

Sushi on Oracle is a small but busy place. The decor was nothing to write home about, especially the colored cardboard cutout fish hanging from the ceiling. 

We were immediately served miso soup and edamame without ordering it which was nice. The soup was hot but the edamame was cold. Servers were kind and generally attentive but the food was just average. I ordered a combination chicken teriyaki plate with four California rolls. 

The chicken tasted like it was low quality and the California rolls were simply average. 
Based on the number of people who were going in and out of the restaurant I'd likely go back to try something different.

I always enjoyed that they don't require appointments and are first come first serve.  Have had two good experience there with two different vets. 
 However this week I took both my doodles in for ear checks due to shaking heads and scratching.  They both had ear infections.  The vet cleaned their ears and gave medication.  The bill was $213!!!  The medication was $50 and they charged an additional $160 for walking in the door, looking in their ears and cleaning them with solution (that I had been doing daily).  As expensive as an emergency clinic.  Time to find a new vet.

Awaken every time I'm here even if the door says do not disturb. Also the desk called and asked if I'm staying waking me after I just paid  in full for two nights. This is the fifth day here and they wake you up everyday by opening the door without asking at eleven am even if the door has the do not disturb on it. 

So I pay ahead of time and put do not disturb and you just open the door!!!!???

Secondly on phone asked for a bath tub in room she assured me the room had one and show up with no tub. Try to change room
And he said their full and can't. 

Went from a five star stay the first
Time to a two star this time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
If you are looking for someplace to get work on your car don't go here... The staff here at this location will not own up and take responsibility for their personal mistakes which in the end will cost you money! They simply forgot to put the lock nut key back into my glove box where they removed it from and now I'm spending $200 to have the locknuts replaced. Visit at your own risk... Because no one here will own up to the mistakes that they make! 

I guess I should've saw the two stars and gone somewhere else! Silly me!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Pretty cute ice cream shop built into the bottom of the Don CeSar: I swung by a couple of times for ice cream. I stuck to cups, but they have a variety of cones with chocolate/sprinkles/etc. 

Flavors: 
Butterfinger - pretty standard and peanut-buttery, could have used more candy chunks.

Salted caramel - my favorite that I tried here, there are hard crunchy caramel bits, in addition to small chocolate chunks throughout.

Strawberry cheesecake - tasted overly sweet and artificial, ended up being unable to eat it. 

Prices were $6-ish for a double scoop and $4-5 for a single scoop. Servers were polite and attentive.

YUM! This place is amazing! It's cash only, so make sure to bring some. Inside you can view all the flavors in the cooler and try them. They also have specials written on the chalkboard. I chose to get the I scream fudge sundae. I was chocolate fudge ice cream in a fudge coated glass with whipped cream and chocolate topping. My boyfriend had a banana split and they let him choose what three flavors he wanted. It was so good. You go sit down and they bring it out to you. I like how it feels and looks like an old time ice cream parlor.

The salesperson was very, very eager to convince me that I should get my lenses directly from them (and get a reimbursement from my insurance), rather than through my insurance.  She was less eager to make sure she was getting the order right.

She ran the wrong numbers and claimed it would be about the same price either way.  In fact, they ended up charging me about double (after the reimbursement) what I would have paid going through my insurance (and I had to come back two extra times to get the right lenses).
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
You'll smell the sugar from this place before you even get to it.  This place isn't big and you'll likely need to wait in line for a bit.  (We even saw a few folks from the bars down the street with a beer or two smuggled out waiting in line).  If you're sitting at the little tables that line the restaurant - you'll be cramped since you're pretty much staring at everyone in line. 

Ice cream flavors are interesting since it isn't all just a run of the mill.  We tried a few and liked:

Brown Butter Almond Brittle
Pistachio and Honey
Sorbets

Go with a bowl and get a few half scoops and a triangle of that waffle cone. Mmmm.  It's good.

First time at this salon. There won't be a second! Way overpriced and their front desk does not book correctly. Waited 45 minutes after my color was finished processing to get my highlights!  My stylist took ten minutes to blowout my hair that was $26.00 not included with the price of the color (which would of been fine if they made you aware of it) and my hair was still damp when I left. Had to have my color redone somewhere else. Unfortunately I will not be returning which is a shame since it is close to my house.

Looking for a place near me that served breakfast food. Found Chef Vargas on Yelp. The food was really good. I decided on the Chicken & Waffles. It was 2 big waffles and 2 nice size pieces of chicken breast. My daughter got the Creme Brule French Toast and a side order of pork sausage.  The service was fine and the place is small nothing too fancy. The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars is because of location.  It's located in a apartment building and the signs to find the restaurant are a little confusing. Plus there are quite a few stairs to get in the building :(.  Over all, now that I can find it, I will be going back!

Brianna & Jake were super friendly and provided us with great customer service. That being said, when searching for a frozen yogurt place, cleanliness is always a top priority in my books. This place is always super clean and organized. I've never seen the toppings in a messy setting or all over counter/floor. This is definitely a huge plus! They have a large variety of options to satisfy every taste bud. I will definitely be back again and again. It's also extremely convenient that it's in the same parking lot as several restaurants. We love fro-yo!

Well...this place is interesting. Uh...that's all I got to describe it. First of all, it has interior and exterior rooms. I had an exterior room and it was a cold day. Struggle. The room was ok until I went to the bathroom. That was the smallest bathroom I have ever been in. The shower was hard to get into as well. However, they did have a shuttle to Orpy Mills mall and good service. This easily could have been 2 star rank. Also, they have an indoor pool that you can smell from a mile away. Nothing like a cup of coffee and chlorine in the morning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: our dogs LOVE this place. They have cared for my animals, my parents animals, and i would recommend them to anyone and everyone. it's hard to find an honest vet that will always give your animal the same amount of love and care as you would yourself. These vets are truly that. they are ALWAYS willing to talk with you, follow up with you, or make time for your animals. I will continue to trust them with my babies and recommend that everyone do the same. Thank you Dr. Pace, Dr. Kunkel, and Dr. Frevert for your hard work and love!!!

This was the first time that I have eaten at this place, and I decided to get carry out. I called them and not 10 minutes later my food was done and ready to be picked up. I am absolutely baffled by how well their COVID 19 precautions are! There is no way for direct contact between staff and customers 10/10! 

I got an order of Crab Rangoons and the Chef's Special Sesame Chicken. The food was amazing! The crab rangoons were perfectly cooked and all food was hot and fresh from the carry-out containers! PS: their white rice was perfect! 

I can't wait to go back and try their other menu items!

Don't waste your time and money on this place. 
We called at opening time and ordered a double decker pizza last night and it was the worst pizza I have ever eaten and that's saying a lot seeing as I'm Italian and have eaten pizza from all over the world. 
The taste of the toppings was good, but the crust was so over cooked it was literally inedible. A good part of it was burned black and was as hard as a rock. And the part that wasn't burned up was as tough as shoe leather. We also ordered cheese bread which was ok, nothing special about it. We spent over $30 dollars and received a terrible meal for our money.  
Don't waste your money here.

I had high hopes for this place but was somewhat disappointed. First of all they have a bunch of passive aggressive signs up telling you "don't be a tasting hog" without actually specifying how many tastes relegates you to the world of tasting hoggery. According to our server, 1 was two many to ask for and seemingly bummed her out, based on her facial expression that is.

The ice cream itself was fine. They have interesting flavors but between the four scoops my friends got none were excellent... Perhaps if we'd been able to taste a few more...

We visited the Creole Creamery and knew immediately that it was going to be a treat due to the wait. And it was worth the wait. Unfortunately, the day we went they were out of waffle cones. The three flavors we got were diverse but flavorful. I was disappointed in the lavender honey as I couldn't detect the lavender flavor. However my second choice was really good. We were there on the weekend so parking at a nearby bank was easy. I'm not sure where one would park on weekdays. The environment was a fun place for people watching and it was near Tulane and not in the Quarter which was a plus.

This used to be a wonderful store. Lately however, no matter what day I attempt to do my shopping, their shelves are cleaned out of every single item I need. It almost looks like blizzard preparation in there. I can never get what I need. I have been to this store the last 4 days straight and they still can't stock their shelves. It's really inconvenient. I love the cleanliness and safeness of the location (compared to the other location in Lansdowne which is a nightmare). I just wish they would stock their shelves more often. I never have this problem at Acme.

Updated: this place has lost my business. After my first review (see below) I have had terrible experiences with delivery. One time they forgot to put my order in, the next two times it took over an hour and a half for the delivery. The food is still good but the service is horrible. The first time they gave me a 10% discount, but I had to ask for it. The next two times this happened I got nothing.

Got delivery in Phoenixville - fast delivery! Wonton soup was good, pork fried rice was good, General Tsos chicken was really good! Beef and broccoli had a little too much sauce, but still good. Great price too, got all of that for $30!

My happy place to grab a bite for lunch! The line will seem long, but it goes rather quickly. I cannot help myself, each time I'm there it's the steamed tongue tacos. 2 and I'm full and feel like I just had a cheap thrill and party in my mouth. The green salsa and a liberal sprinkle of onions and cilantro at the salad bar and I'm a very happy camper. Not to mention, a full one. Yay for these great people that run Lilly's! Oh, and the cachete tacos are super great, too! Indulgent, but sometimes ya gotta live large.

I'm not sure how this place has managed a 3 star average to begin with. 

We flew in tonight and are staying at the pear tree inn. With there being no food places open around here, pizza was our only option. I mean, you can't really mess up pizza.. can you? 

It took 1.5 hours for the large pizza & salad to get here. Pizza was awful cold, looked gross and tasted awful. The salad didn't even come with a fork.. were in a hotel.. obviously i can't just go to my kitchen and grab a fork. 

I totally understand busy Friday nights, but the pizza was seriously hours old by the time it got here. 

Extremely disappointing

Positano's is an old school Italian-American restaurant with no pretensions of being anything greater. The menu does not change, nor the wine list. The latter has no vintages and is nether large nor deep. The wine glasses are the same as the clunky water glasses. The wine prices are a standard double to retail.  I think a $40 bottle of wine should be served correctly, at the right temperature and not with glasses hot from the dishwasher. Our bottle was served at a good temperature, the glasses not so much. 
When busy the wait for food can be 40 minutes.

Came here one night and had to get the hand grenade. It was actually pretty good. Very sweet, but enjoyable. Didn't stay long the first time we came, but got our drink and went on. While we were there we saw the big commotion going on with the shark attack drink. So we came back another day and sat at the bar and ordered a shark attack. While we were sitting there a roach was crawling across the top of the bar. The people next to us didn't seem phased and the bartender did kill it for us. The shark attack was pretty cool. The bartender threw ice at us. The drink itself was pretty good.

Apparently this store stopped utilizing curbside pick up....yet on the app, that they encourage you to use, that option is available. The past 2/3 times I've ordered for curbside no one comes out to bring my food.  I've had to go in. Twice I've said something and all employees stare at me and say nothing. I had to call...manager yelled at me saying they don't offer curbside pick up and said its a subway issue not his stores issue... I asked to speak to the owner but he's in INDIA...and can't be reached. Go somewhere else.

Just stumbled upon this place while I was visiting my family in Louisiana. Doesn't look like much from the outside, but the place is pretty good. The flavors are decent, the portion sizes and presentation are great, and the overall taste is great. I gave 4 stars solely on the sushi being a tad warmer than I like. It wasn't like warm warm, but it wasn't cold either. The service was excellent, our waiter was amazing. All my years living in Louisiana before moving to Texas I never knew this place existed. So go check it out!

I chose these guys because they promote COVID-19 vaccination. The hair cutter Heavy cut my hair, and I be never had such an assiduous, careful hair professional. He was a perfectionist who took my crazy hair--uncut by a professional since pre-COVID--and worked it into shape. Not one detail missed. Unlike 90% of hair cutters, he did mostly a scissor cut. The environment was warm and friendly, if a little loud. Something I really appreciate  is that Heavy did not waste his concentration chit-chatting, but was 100% courteous and professional.

I've been in a number of times.  I started coming here because, basically, I hate the hard up-selling they do at Jiffy Lube.  I will steer clear of Jiffy Lube at all costs.  Give fast lane a try.  Local, and they are really friendly.  The best part is they encourage you to come talk to them as they work on your car.  Always a pleasant experience.  I took one star off because on my last visit one of the staff seemed like they were in a bad mood, and a bit rude because of it.  This was unusual though, and I expect that the next time I return this will not be the case.

I went here to have a face shave and hair cut. This hair was ok, but I felt like the person cutting my hair wasn't understanding what I wanted and I walked away with a young boys cut. 

The face shave I had however was awful. The razor was a disposable and the butter she used was to thin. The razor far from glided over my face, it tugged and ripped hairs. Moreover the disposable razor was definitely dull because it was the most painful shave I've ever had. 

The people were good people and very kind. However, their skill in cutting hair was far $25 worth.

I don't give 5 stars easily, unless completely earned.  This is a cool spot, with great food and laid back vibe.  The chefs creations are flavorful, hot, and abundant.  

We started with the calamari appetizer.   It was lightly breaded and cooked to perfection.   We had the ribeye special, the steamed shrimp special, and the crab legs special.  Everything had a great balance of season and flavor in every bite.  

Dessert tray does not disappoint either. Something for every taste.  

We stumbled upon this place by accident, but will definitely be back on purpose!

Nice space, the equipment and locker rooms are clean and the best I've seen at a planet fitness. Entry is kind of odd. Last time I went I was accosted by the downstairs security when trying to enter, he was rather rude. Someone should let them know not to yell at the businesses patrons just for going abouut their business. Will visIt again, also the staff of PF  maybe need an attitude adjustment when checking in guests. the second to last I went I didn't have my key card or app set up and the man behind the counter shamed me for having to check in with my phone number. Thought this was the judgement free zone.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Nice hotel. Nice staff. Very clean. Delicious complimentary Breakfast every morning. (Chef Colisha was GREAT) Nice rooftop bar. Indoor year round pool. Decent gym. Courtyard (didn't experience due to the snow, looked nice) Netflix equipped tv with complimentary HBO and Showtime. Kitchenette (no oven) with sink, dishwasher, two burner stove, microwave, apartment size refrigerator. Equipped with pots and pans, strainer, quality dishes and utensils.
Excellent stay overall. Made my very first visit to St. Louis and the Midwest amazing.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My daughters and I went one evening bypassing the Papa Johns we were actually headed out to pick up. We had hibachi dinners. We ordered the hibachi dinners and no sushi. It was astonishing to me how there was NOOOO flavor to the food! They used teriyaki on the meat but even that had no flavor. The rice had no flavor but the soup was delicious. The yum yum sauce was extremely sweet. Too thick & sweet to enjoy.  When I complained that there was no flavor to our food, the waitress didn't even respond to apologize or anything. We didn't eat the food and didn't take it with us. $80 wasted.

I've been the Bistro before, and I'll be honest, I didn't much care for the food.  I like the ambiance and it's a nice place to go after a show, especially if you get a seat by the window.   I went back about a month ago and it was excellent.  They changed from their old menu to a new menu, and if what I heard from the waitress is true, a new head chef.  Presentation was top notch and the food was excellent.  I deduct a star for my previous experience, but if I go back again and they can replicate the feat I'll give them the benefit of the doubt.

For the price I expected more but what do you expect with a hotel in the city. I think you get some discount for the parking lot but you wouldn't know from how much it is.  If you want to walk right out of the hotel and be in the center of the action.  It is the price you pay.  There is plenty to do in the area.  So sometimes it is the price of doing business.  The rooms are defiantly not big and depending on where your room is located.  You don't see much.  So it is a typical city hotel.  Go with a chain so you can at least get reward points.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: So I went in to get a gel manicure, I was so excited to find a place close to where I work but was very disappointed. Not only did the older lady who did my nails make fun of my nails because she had to pick off so many cuticles (it has been ages since I've gotten my nails done at a salon - which shouldn't matter to her since I'm paying her) but she also did a terrible job of fully painting my whole nail. I'm only giving a 3 star review because at least if you don't look at my nails closely, they look fully painted

Ordered Uber Eats from my hotel.   Had two different calzones and Lemon Pepper Wings

The Dolce Vita Calzone was absolutely delicious with quality ingredients.  Only downside was the ricotta cheese was missing , so I really got a Stromboli.   We actually decided against Donato's pizza because they didn't offer  ricotta in their calzones . A bit disappointed with that , but honestly it was tasty.   Just not what I had been hoping for.  Once you wait an hour for delivery  you hate to call and wait for a replacement .

Would order again but with a reminder to add the ricotta !!

Awful product quality. Waaaaay over priced. 8.00 for a seedless conventional mini watermelon. I get organic mini's of great quality at Whole
Foods for 3.99. PLUS...for an added bonus, shopping in this store during a pandemic is terrifying. They just pack them in no distancing. No alternating of cashiers.  The employees don't even bother to distance from the customers and don't wear their masks properly.  Don't bother discussing the mask situation or distancing with Jeremy the manager. I tried 3 times. All three times he stated, "I don't care."  I'm all for supporting local business, but I'll support the businesses that actually do care.

My review is based on total of 4 times I have visited. This place has the potential to be a good sushi restaurant, however it is not for a number of reasons. 1. Poorly trained staff. Some of the worst waitresses I have encountered in the Greater Philadelphia Area; unpolished and no manners. Inattentive and sloppy. 2. Depending on the hours, the fish could be acceptable or completely trash. I have had frozen sashimi served to me in this restaurant because I came in the afternoon. I would not come here again and I would recommend people to avoid this establishment at all cost.

This is such a unique spot with a grocery at the entrance where you can find Mexican candy and snacks! The taqueria is in the back and is super picturesque. 

Now for the food:
Tacos were definitely above average! I've tried many, many taco joints and this was easily a top 3 for me. I only had the shredded chicken (tinga) and steak (bistec) Taco and am excited to come back and try more of the menu. 

The horchata was subpar at best, I've definitely have had better and it left a weird taste in my mouth. 

I'll definitely be back when I'm in the area or at the mall nearby!

The restaurant itself was very adorable and spacious and the salmon I ordered was tasty, albeit very small. My table also ordered Margherita pizza which we all enjoyed. 

The issue here was with the staff itself. The restaurant was not very busy and my table was one of maybe three others indoors yet our service was ridiculously slow. We didn't even get our orders taken until well 20 minutes of sitting around and simple tasks like a refill took ages. 

We came to celebrate a friends birthday and when I asked for dessert options, I was told to hold for a second but never received a menu at all. We decided to ultimately skip dessert there.

It was okay, I can make better spaghetti at home. 
The Gorgonzola pasta special was good though and so was the focaccia. Their service people are good,  but they need more of them, our server was awesome but we only saw him every 15-20 min because he was serving 1/2 the restaurant. It took over an hour to get 1 pizza and it came out so bad we sent jt back. The sausage and broccoli was just steamed broccoli they threw on the pizza after it was cooked and it was complete covered in toppings, ratio was completely off.

This was my first time visiting and I just wasn't impressed. The pizza came out hot but wasn't well seasoned, though the garlic powder on the table definitely helped. The calamari I ordered took forever--probably 30-40 min to come out and when it did it was practically burnt like they'd forgotten about it. The breading fell off in chunks. Had I not waited so long already I would have sent it back. On the plus side the marinara was really hot and not ice cold like some serve it. I've always heard this was a fantastic place but it was definitely disappointing to me and my friends.

I have no high expectations for food quality or presentation, for obvious reasons, as fast food is good for what it is; convenient. The good and bad experiences are usually separated by the quality of customer service & this has excellent service. Today, (5/9/19) at about 2:30, the manager running the drive thru window couldn't have been more professional and helpful when encountering a pair of unruly customers. I wish I had gotten her name, but I got the time at least. She should be commended for handling of customer service situations as I will be back in large part to her customer service. Thanks again

First time here, after driving around with the takeout menu in my car for quite some time. I should've stopped sooner!! The tacos were awesome. Being the first time, I wanted to try a bit of it all so I started with some lengua, tripa, carnitas and the chorizo. Each one was awesome. Great flavor, tender meats, fresh veggies and great beans too. The server was sweet and helpful, and the one cook behind the line prepared the 8 tacos with beans and rice in no time. For seriously good tacos with authentic Mexican flavor, this is the place. Their menu is huge too. I will definitely be back to try more!! Thanks again!

I ordered for delivery tonight. They sent an order of plain fries rather than the super duper fries. I called and they said the driver took the wrong bag and he would be back with the right fries and said "don't touch the fries you got" The driver came back and gave me my Luke warm super super fries and took the bag of plain fries ...no other pizza place would EVER do that. They would apologize and say to keep the fries they mistakenly sent..they were taking fries that were in our house to deliver to other people..that is a so nasty. We will go back to ordering from other pizza places now.

So in regards to all Planet Fitness gyms.  They say it's a judgement free zone yet they judge those who have big muscles and call them "lunks".  I am trying to transfer to this location and they are telling me that I have to be a member for 90 days at my current location?  That makes no sense at all.  So now I will be charged after the 10th time I work out when I already pay for a membership.  WTF?  Don't join Planet Fitness unless you want to get ripped off.  They also don't have enough weights.  Their dumbbells go only up to 75lbs.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The location was great (right on the water), the live band was good too but the food for the price (MEH!!). We paid $72 for our meal that included 3 drinks (2 pina coladas and 1 big blue margarita to share).  We ordered the seafood sampler which was $16 & was left to be desired.  I ordered the shrimp tacos (chilli lime) not my fave and the tortillas were stale.  Not good for the price but good for maybe just an appetizer and a drink and listen to some music.  You want to experience GREAT food, this is not the place!!

I've been down Mass Ave dozens of times and never noticed this really awesome (and in my opinion, very hidden) bar that's right next door to the Eagle. What looks to be a pretty average and narrow space is actually three stories of mustached figures all over the walls. The quirky atmosphere and fun vibe-the place was packed on a Wednesday-made for an unexpected and fun night. The karaoke here was insane and everyone who sang was actually good. Mule drinkers will love the variety of flavors too. I'd definitely recommend checking this place out and try your hand at karaoke if you're looking to spice up your week.

I ordered takeout for an early dinner on Christmas Day through Uber Eats. I didn't know what go expect and I was impressed! 

I got the Sexiest Man Roll and the yellowtail scallion roll, with the optional fresh wasabi. Fresh wasabi is a treat and always worth the upcharge, in my opinion. 

The fish was fresh and firm. The flavors in the sexiest man roll were excellent: just the right mix of spiciness and creaminess. Both rolls were tightly wrapped which I always appreciate when I'm trying to maneuver them to my mouth without our dogs catching a stray bite!

Amazing service. The staff was very friendly and took care of me from the time I called to the time I walked out. The my outlined everything in descriptive detail so I knew what was going on. There was no pressure sales, just suggestions with explanations. They were able to do an alignment and 4 tires in half the time quoted from other tire shops. My vehicle is riding very smooth now. The pricing on tires is a little high but they WILL price match for the same tire if found cheaper. 100% suggest this place for tires and car care.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Have used Enterprise several times with good service in the past . My last experience at the Springfield , PA  location  didn't go well at all . They didn't have any sedans available so I settled for an SUV which was difficult for me to get into.  To further my displeasure the employee gave me the hard sell on  Enterprise's  insurance telling me that my business card insurance was useless .She kept on pushing the Enterprise coverage . I felt extremely pressured . I later  checked  with AMEX  and they verified the complete coverage of their premium car insurance  which I pay an additional fee for .

Just underwent a large renovation.  Tasteful, attractive inside.  Nice, cordial bartenders.  Very small cocktail list, maybe five or so drinks?  With some wine and beer as well.  I tried a couple of the light liquor drinks based in gin and vodka.  Both light and easy to drink.  Small, low lights, not crowded, intimate.  Very easy access if you're staying in the hotel.  Main reason I didn't rate higher is secondary to the very small drink list, which hasn't changed, best I can tell, since last year when we were here.

We have stayed here two years in a row and never had an issue. We usually get a suite and they are very roomy and comfortable.

They offer breakfast in the morning but sometimes it is frustrating when they only put bacon out 2 of the 5 days you are there (MORE BACON!).
The breakfast is good though so I can't complain about that.

Fix the doors in the back, you have to lift the handle all the way up on one and all the way down on the other but the card swipers make it difficult to do that as you have to hold it up or down just to get in.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I wanted to give this location a half star but yelp is too nice & wont let me do they get one star... I Just left this location getting my nieces a breakfast McGriddle sandwich....all I asked for was one without cheese & got home only to find out they not only left off the cheese but the egg off both sandwiches too. What the???!!! Anyway I spent my hard earned cash on those & when I tried to call to inform the store manager about the error I got no answer! What kind of reputable business let's the phone ring & ring like that??!! I will be contacting corporate after this review. That's unacceptable
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This Burger King is located right near the corner of the intersection of Dekalb Pike and Route 309 in Montgomeryville Pa. I have stopped in here quite a few times over the years for lunch, dinner or just because I was in the mood for chicken fries. It's a average BK as far as restuarant size/layout and food goes, and the service isn't too bad either, I never had any problems. It's not my favorite BK location and I wouldn't go out of my way to come here, but it is still decent enough and I'll stop by if its convenient and I'm in the area.

Although there are Dunkin Donuts locations a bit closer to where I live, I do stop by the one in Lansdale when I am in the area. The store itself is great, I never ran into any problems with employees, food/drink or the cleanliness of the store. One time when I came into the store when it was about to close and I got extra donuts thrown in the mix which I did appreciate! My only problems is getting back out onto North Broad Street or Cowpath Road can be a pain as they are both next to a crowded red light, that is busy at all times of the day. This aside, I will stop here again in the future.

I have a Wendy's much closer to where I live but I have stopped at this one a few times when i am in the mood and am in Souderton. The restuarant/building is renovated so that is a plus, and the food is what you would expect from a standard Wendy's. Employees seem decent never had a problem with anyone. My only gripe is the parking lot it small and can get crowded and backed up easily and leaving into the busyness of Hilltown Plaza (next to the light with cars always coming in and out) can make it a nightmare to leave sometimes. It's a decent enough Wendy's for the food, but if you dont like crowds and waiting I might look elsewhere.

Room was very dated. Old carpet. Old bedspread. Bathroom smelled like mildew. Had to change rooms because the first room had no working air conditioning.  Second room was better. Lobby restaurant was busy. Food was good but there was only one waitress to cover the entire place. Only got my coffee refilled once. Ugh. Van service was terrible.  Airport to hotel we had to take a cab. Hotel to airport the van went missing and had to wait for a cab.  Delay was lengthy causing an issue for our airport check in. This property needs an overhaul of management and the building.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Stopped by this tavern to grab a drink and appetizer before my flight. 
Seat your self restaurant. The tables have buttons you push when you are ready to order and when you are ready to pay. 
Waiter was very friendly and quick to respond. 
I ordered the wings which were really good. Seasoned very well and fried hard per my request. 
My sister ordered the pork kettle chip dish which looked amazing. I had a few chips minus the pork but she said the pork was very good. The chips also had a bbq sauce drizzled over them with melted cheese. 
Very tasty meal and the kettle chips actually taste better than nacho chips.

I ordered delivery and they got my order wrong. I got a chicken dish and they sent pork. When I called to ask them to refund me or send the right order. They told me no, that I'm wrong it's chicken. I'm telling you this is pork. They absolutely refused, they told me to send a picture which I did. Clearly it was pork but still they denied it, then they sent a driver to come back and picked it up! 

This was just so bizarre I've never been treated more rudely. 

Never heard back from them but they refunded me. Guess they finally agreed it was chicken...

Ok - this is a good neighborhood Chinese takeout place. It is very clean and one can see their food being prepared. There is no MSG and it is family run.
     China Taste's lunch specials are nice and for a good price as well. I would recommend their sesame chicken or the House lo mein. The Singapore chow mei fun is also delicious. If you are looking for something healthy, China Taste's steamed vegetables and rice are wonderful.
      This is perfect for an evening spent with friends, binge watching a good night of tv.

I'm going to preface this review by saying their Chinese is delicious and usually the only place we order from but not after today. The food showed up almost 2 hours late and was cold...2 HOURS FOR CHINESE! Not to mention it was only a few items and we're usually dropping $30 an order.  Never called to let us know and never offered anything in return for the wait or years of patronage. Because they did nothing, I will not be ordering from them again. Unless of course they see this and want to rectify the situation. Feel free to contact me.

Came here with my friend before seeing a movie across the street at BMFI -- it was the perfect quick inexpensive bite.  Started with chips and homemade guacamole, which was very mild but good.  I chose the chorizo soft tacos, which came with 2, filled with excellent quality just spicy enough chorizo and the rest of the stuff tacos come stuffed with -- they were awesome. I could've eaten more, but probably would have slept through the movie (instead of just for a couple minutes :).  YUM and sooo inexpensive.  The atomsphere is clean, cheerful, very casual.  Will definitely be back for more!

I wish I could leave 0 stars for this establishment. I was there for about 4 hours even after having an appointment. I was charged for services I did not ask for. One service I did ask for was not provided until I checked and said something. I was charged for a warranty I did not want, that I know is an option. They destroyed my lug nuts and then charged me for new ones. I also left with two half lug nuts they could not get off. See pic. I would never go here again. I called the customer service when I got home and was told that my number would be given to the regional manager. We shall see if I get a call.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Tried this Dunkin' out again and still going with the 1 star! 
It's horrible that they have great coffee but horrible customer service! The ability to get drinks made correctly is basically unheard of. I find this odd considering drinks are made to order.
Order a large iced coffee with 2 shots or SF vanilla; 2 Splenda and ONE cream. There is nooo way my drink should be this milky looking! And note it's not SF vanilla.
Also ordered two bacon, egg and cheese croissant. They have them on special for $5. My husband nor myself was impressed. Sandwiches are cold and bacon hardly cooked!
So unfortunately my rating remains the same!

Honestly this place is the hidden secret I wish more people knew about. I used to come here with my high school friends all the time to enjoy a good meal and....at that time our cell service wasn't that great so it made us really interact LOL. But the food was always phenomenal and this place will always have great after school memories of sharable dishes, good laughs, and at least one person around the table saying "you want more rice?" 

Definitely try to the chicken but my favorite was the sweet and sour pork and noodle dishes! Sad it's closing I hope someone else opens something similar to it!

I came for dinner with a friend on a Friday night and had a great time. The staff is very friendly and we were seated immediately. They have a very cute outdoor patio that is covered in case of rain. We ordered the Miso Soup and 5 different rolls to share. The rolls were 6 pieces each, so it was definitely more than enough food for both of us. We had the Yellowtail, Spicy Salmon, Spicy Crunchy, Dynamite, and Salmon Avocado rolls. All of the fish was super fresh and tasty! The food is all very affordable and I'd definitely come back to give the special rolls a try!

This place is bomb. I came here with my two sisters and a local friend joined us. We ordered several different tacos, all delicious, the salsas verde and rojas, plantains, corn (off the cob is the way to go), Asian slaw, and pineapple. My sister and I started off with nojitos (I'm pregnant and she's underage). Everything from start to finish was delicious! The vibe is fun and there is indoor or outdoor seating depending on what you prefer. The only downside for me was our server was a little too quiet when it's a louder environment. I can't wait to go back!

We went for happy hour sushi and the price is honestly one you cannot beat. I've been to mediocre to high end omakase sushi restaurants, and I think Asaka is the most worth it for the value and QUALITY of fish we got! 

Service was wonderful and attentive despite the seemingly few employees there (I think it's family run, which makes it even better!) and the full house on a Wednesday night. We got lots of rolls and sashimi and nigiri. All in all a great experience, and will definitely be back again to try the rice dishes.

Although it's over 25 miles from my house, I HAD to check out Sushi-Ten after I read about the half-price sushi happy hours (11AM to 7PM - that's a lot of Happy!) - I got there around 4 PM and it was half-full with customers, and while I generally only order my favorite "boring" rolls (California, Negi-Hama, Cucumber, Salmon + avocado), with the half-price menu I went for something a little more daring: Mexican Roll, which is spicy, creamy AND deep-tempura-fried! and Sweet Dream Roll - both VERY nice!  I ate like royalty for practically nothing and it wound up being my only meal of the day, it was so satisfying!  I'll be back, for sure!

Giving 2 stars because the mussels, rangoons and most of the rolls were good. However the service was not good at all. We made a reservation and when we arrived we were seated immediately. It started out promising. We got our drinks ordered after about 5 minutes not too bad. We placed our initial order and waited over 30 minutes for even our appetizers. No one even checked in to ask if we were doing okay. There was one large party and it seemed they got all the attention. Very disappointed. Will not eat here again and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone.

Our daily lives are changing and are left to take out foods, and nothing better than dessert!

My family had been craving ice cream and were happy to see that Baskin Robbins drive thru is still open during these uncertain times. 

Try the Banana Royale sundae or create your own! Our topping flavor was incorrect on both sundaes (reason for withdrawing 2 stars) but the customer service was great. There was a friendly voice over the intercom and a smile to greet us at the window.

Go out and continue to support your local business! 

Treat yourself to some ice cream!

Nice inside setting and decor for this pizza restaurant that can be overlooked in a crowded shopping center set back from a busy street. Plenty of pizza shop sandwiches, slices, wraps, etc. to choose from. The two people working for lunch were pleasant and made our orders quickly. I had a buffalo chicken wrap with fries and it was fine. They had a couple specialty slices on display but not many - maybe 4 or so choices. This is a fine spot for lunch if your looking for quick pizza, but no frills. Would be interested in going back for dinner to try more of an entree.

We are from IL and we love Chicago-style deep dish pizza and let me just say this place has the BEST deep dish pizza we ever had! From the price to the taste to the NOT greasy feeling afterwards. Definitely 5 stars from us! This is our new favorite pizza joint! I am so glad this place was recommended and we tried it out. Yum yum yuuum!!  When we called the guy who answered was laughing and sounded super chill! It was nice to hear a friendly voice that loved their job. Can't wait for Covid to be over so we can dine-in, my husband said the inside "looked like a nice, old italian place that has really good pizza!"

Pretty disappointing meal. I ordered penna vodka with chicken. There was little sauce on the penna and what was on there definitely wasn't vodka sauce. I'm used to creamy blush sauce with garlic pancetta and peas. This was just noodles with a light covering of marinara sauce. Not worth the $23. I also ordered a side of meatballs and they were actually good. Last time I ordered food from Ralph's was 5 years ago and I remember not being impressed then. I decide to give it another shot tonight and had instant regret the minute I opened the Togo box.

My washing machine broke, so while I was waiting for my new one to be delivered, I did a few loads at this place.  Whatever you do don't look up or too closely at anything while doing your laundry.   It hasn't been cleaned in years.  It's absolutely disgusting.  Gross enough to prompt me to write this review.  The machines look okay.   There are signs that they just signed a new 15 year lease and are getting all new machines in the next few months.  Hopefully,   they will take the time to clean the place as well.  I felt icky after leaving .
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
I've been coming to Oggi for years, this is the first time that I've been terribly disappointed. I sat at the bar and there were fruit flies... I ignored it, then a series of negative occurrences happened. 
1. Water glass with lipstick on it 
2. Dirty silverware
3. Cold/not fresh octopus appetizer
4. Poor service so I didn't order dinner and left
5. Witnessed employees not using gloves or washes hands and squeezing lemons, serving customers and touching Money and resuming squeezing lemons
Disappointed to see the service decline.

"Busy Hotel"

Busy hotel & parking lot is usually always full. Saw several cars covered with car covers in parking lot like the auto would be there a while. Guess you can park there for free instead of parking at the airport. Had a ground room floor. King bed was comfortable. Somewhat clean bathroom (had mold buildup in corners). Shower head is low--not good if you're tall. No vent in bathroom, so it gets steamy fast. This hotel is near the airport so the aircraft flying in/out is loud at times. Overall a comfortable stay. Check in & check out is quick.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I walked in to Supercuts wanting a trim and to thin out my hair. I normally would only go to high quality salons but with such a minor request I figured I'd give the cheap place a shot. While the service was quick and they were kind the only thing that went with what I wanted was to thin out the back of my hair. The slight trim and the "as little off as possible" was no where near what happened. I walked out with my hair about 2.5 or 3 inches shorter and I had told them I was growing my hair out. Very disappointed and will never being going back even for what seems like a safe 'trim'.

FINALLY the perfect neighborhood restaurant to fill this vacancy at 23rd and pine. I have been to cotoletta in Belmont hills so was thrilled to hear they were coming to philly. The owner and chef Beth makes you feel like you're at her house eating an Italian home cooked meal with her family. The cutlets are all amazing - marsala, chicken parm, really all of them. The stuffed long hots are also a favorite. Really everything - you can taste the love. Oh and don't forget the stack!! This will definitely be my weekly go to spot

Why you guys have to have a bad attitude? The amount of loyalty I have to Starbucks is ridiculous but I am brand loyal. This store may have been having a bad day yesterday but seriously...? Each barista was surly, curt and didn't have any people skills that the service industry expects. I can forego being accosted by a smoking homeless guy as I try and enjoy my coffee outside... but you guys have jobs. If service and being friendly isn't for you... get out. Plenty of other great Starbucks stores to choose from fortunately.

We were in the plaza so I decided to check out this custard place. I am not a local so this custard thing is new to me. I had Ted Drews years ago when visiting STL so I don't remember the taste. I had the custard place in ballwin that starts with an "f" and I thought it was alright. I got a kiddie size which was only $1.90 both the vanilla and chocolate flavors were delicious! It is a little bit sweet but the vanilla has this creme brûlée egg taste or the egg taste from a dessert egg pastry. I really enjoyed it and plan on coming back for bigger size to go!

I stopped here for breakfast with a friend after a yoga class in Yardley. We were seated outside & I have to say it was a really cute spot. Our waitress was super friendly and we got started with an order for coffee. This is definitely a good spot to get some strong and delicious cafe coffee. I ordered the grande cafe combo which came with pancakes, toast, eggs, choice of meat, home fries. Everything was delicious and after months of not having breakfast outside my home this REALLY hit the spot. I am looking forward to this being my go to breakfast spot now.

It was decent. I guess I was expecting a little more bang for my buck. The calamari was fairly tasteless. The rainbow roll was the best, absolutely delicious and not overwhelmed by roe. I had the tiger shrimp roll and it tasted oddly salty -- I think it was the sauce. The crystal shrimp roll was too heavy on the rice - barely any shrimp. I know it's all you can eat sushi, but I still expected better food. The service was excellent. I'm not sure I'll return though. All and all, about $20 for one good roll and green tea ice cream.

The new barista, a young African American woman, was very pleasant, great smile and very personable.

However, this place always looks like it could use a good cleaning. 

Before we could sit at the large bar height table I had to ask for a wet towel to clean off the spilled coffees and food crumbs.   I don't mind this but I have a problem with it when the baristas are standing around talking so VERY LOUDLY that their voices are overpowering ALL the other customers in the store.   

They could be attending cleaning opportunities.

Pretty okay spot for Mexican food if you want to stay in the Mooresville area! This is my 2nd time visiting this location. I ordered a sangarita and it was delicious! Although it is very sweet. For my entree, I ordered enchiladas rancheras, one of my go to meals. I will say there was a LOT of sauce on top of them, and it was supposed to come with guacamole, but didn't. I wasn't too worried about it though! The flavor was good and not spicy at all. Our server was also super friendly! We will return when we are in the area!

Cinder House is a rooftop venue on the top of the Four Seasons downtown with quality food and drink along with good views of downtown. The space is set up nicely during COVID to enjoy drinks outside or at the lounge and then move to a table for dinner. The area is large and spaced out. The pork belly and steak dishes were very good. The chimichurri sauce was a good addition on the meat, but I wish there was a dash more. The menu has a good mix of items to pick from that are more unique that other restaurants around town. Cinder House is a pretty classy and has nice atmosphere and view for a night out downtown.

We were seated on the deck outside. Our waitress was in lala land. We didn't have enough silverware, we had to repeat ourselves constantly, and ask 2-3 times for something before she'd bring it. Not to mention she took FOR-EV-ER with everything. She charged us for drinks we didn't receive. And left us sitting in the actual dark as we ate. Check out my photo.. They didn't turn any of the outside lighting on at all. People who ordered caesar salads; there was hardly any dressing. Driest salads ever. The total opposite of what a caesar salad is supposed to be. Insane! Screw this place...

Feel like I'm disappointed at least once a visit, be it selection (usually), customer service (occassionally), etc.  Obviously a very old store which hasn't been updated in 25+ years.  Also has to have the worse bathroom set up I have ever seen:  Beside the fact there is a 95% chance it's in use whenever you try, it's got a urinal next to a toilet, no partition, essentially making it a one-at-a-time restroom unless you want to talk to the guy two feet away from you taking a crap

Final verdict:  tear it down.  I head elsewhere whenever I can

Really great environment! Definitely whiskey bar speakeasy feels. I went on a Friday night and had the charcuterie board which was pretty fantastic, except didn't have a lot of the cheeses. Lots of fruits, nuts, and condiments filled up about 3/4 of the plate if not more.

My drink was good too (a refreshing cucumber gin drink) except the bar was so backed up I didn't get my drink until after I got my food.

I had a nice night but maybe it was a bit too crowded and backed up on a Friday night. I'd like to see how the main dishes are one day too so I'll definitely be back.

Nothing special..went here for brunch with my girls. First off, they misplaced our reservation, thought we had made it under a different name. Then they got us the wrong drinks. Our actual drinks were extremely diluted. Too much ice, very little alcohol. For food: we ordered the artichoke w aioli to share, avocado toast, Bricktop omelette and huevos rancheros. Our server was sweet, but the food was tasteless. They do have big portions so it's worth the price if you like somewhat bland food. Also, it was pretty packed for a Sunday morning, and I don't think there was a 6 feet distance between tables.

Although this location didn't have the best reviews, I was in a bind and stopped by. I drove to Philly without realizing that I was due for an oil change and wanted to get one before getting back on the road. I was helped quickly. After the courtesy check, the salesman Chip told me I needed new tires and breaks soon. I didn't have enough time to do it then but since he explained everything very thoroughly, I will go here on my next trip to Philly since I come pretty often and haven't found a shop in New York.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Covid-19 Review:

Over the weekend I decided that I wanted to order a pizza for dinner since I couldn't go out to eat. After searching online for the best and inexpensive pizza in my area, I came across Johnny's Pizza. They had a $19.99 deal for two large pies which they run all the time. The reviews were mostly good so I decided to give them a try. 

JP was the typical pizza place and I would say the pizza wasn't bad. The pizza had flavor and wasn't greasy. I'll definitely be back and recommend JP if your looking for quality pizza for a good price.

The person on the intercom was fine, the guy at the first window was great because I requested a change, but the girl at the last window irritated me because she handed me a regular Coke and I told her I'd asked for a slushy Coke. Her response was to stare at me blankly and say "you have to pay for it" OK so I have a drink in my hand that I have paid for but it's a major inconvenience for you to switch that out for the same thing but slushy form? She made no effort whatsoever to correct the error, the drink wasn't a big deal but the lack of customer service was.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
An oddly shabby member of the Hilton family. You get the feeling someone found an abandoned hotel and decided to operate it without the authorities knowing. Generally run down and in need of renovation. Mechanical systems made a lot of noise all night long.

Large, plenty of parking, close to king of Prussia and malvern.  Friendly staff.
