Not very clean, if you look closely.

Breakfast reminiscent of a Hampton, just ok. And the food at the buffet was cold, had to microwave it all.

Common areas were very cold, but it was only 17 overnight during our visit so maybe the HVAC was overwhelmed.

If in the area again, doubt I would stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Decided to randomly book the Conrad after going back and forth on it with the husband. Glad we did! WONDERFUL customer service! The champagne and strawberries in the lobby was cool! The pillows were a godsend. I took a photo so I could try and find them at home lol. I mostly chose this hotel for the large tub. I think I was in there soaking for an hour! Room service was perfect with the extra bath gel. Don't touch that $6 bottle of water or anything in that fridge unless you want to pay for it  only thing I would like to see is a microwave in the room! Not a big deal, just wanted to warm up my cinnabon! Will definitely be back!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: More than the coffee I liked the lights of this place. Modern interiors and ample seating, most unique point of this place is the location, right in front of independence hall. I visited here after finishing my morning tour and ordered a cafe latte, nitro cold brew and a croissant. I like the coffee and the croissant however felt that staff could have been a little more proactive. My coffee was kept on the counter without calling my name and it went cold. Only after I enquired about my coffee I was told about it.

I originally went there with some friends before a concert around 4:30 pm thinking they would be able to take us but they were not for whatever reason. They said they could take us at 9:00. So we came back later because we really, well I, wanted to try this place after hearing all the dashing reviews. It was completely empty and it didn't look like anyone was there before us. Nonetheless I ordered and I didn't understand why there wouldn't be anyone there because the food was outstanding. Truly authentic tasting Italian. Would definitely recommend.

If you are looking for gluten free pizza, they have a very good one!  They also have great pastas (regular and GF), and THE best french fries I have ever had - no joke.  

The customer service is good, the location is nice - right in the downtown area, and the gelato is on spot.  They accommodated where requested and also made it very special for my daughter on her birthday.  Also, kids eat free on Monday nights, which is really a treat, since kids meals come with gelato and are usually $7.  (1 meal per paid entree)

Fast food is fast food so my expectations can't be too high.  Sometimes i wonder if my palate will ever become elevated...lol. This McDs is closer to home and convenient so if I'm in a rush I'll stop here. Employees are nice,  but the food is corporate. Definitely don't remember it being like this when I was growing up.  I guess being a grown up, I should start eating better,  but being a kid at heart always pulls me back. If you get the latter night munchies definitely hit McDs up, but don't expect a donkey with all the trimmings!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I always found the little red head girl to be creepy (like three clown from the movie IT),  but I do like their chili on cold days! Wendy's is one of my vices and is cheap and quick.  The 4 for 4 deals are a pretty good deal if you're on a budget!   I definitely find it to taste better than the other creepy clown's food.   This particular store could ask the creepy girl to do some renovations, but otherwise it's been a good little restaurant.  By the way, I've never seen the redhead at this store,  which is good as if be a little more than freaked out...

So I like the food here, but service has become terrible lately.  Everytime we order it takes another 15 to 20 minutes past the estimated time they tell us over the phone for the food to be ready.  I'm assuming it's the sheer volume of orders they get as they are always busy and moving full bore in the kitchen. My guess is they actually need a larger kitchen and a netter expedite system.

Since the food tastes good I'll continue to come, but plan accordingly.  I'll assume the food will be ready an hour from the time I order it.  So that is my PSA for today!

With regard to Isaiah @ The heritage club barbershop. Someone should explain exactly what the heritage of this shop is to Isaiah. Is it to be 15 minutes late for a first time client and then tell the client that they actually aren't next because someone else "just needs me to wash his hair"? That's what happened to me with Isaiah. As I left I told him that he made a horrible first impression. What a bad look. So, Thumbs down Isaiah. You lost a potential weekly client and a great tipper. Our time is important. Think about that.

let me  start by saying i have been to other hiro's and have had great service. this was my first visit to the tarpon location  and I must say the chef and food and cost were  excellent  BUT the service was horrid my table  waited 20+ mins just to get our drink order in  and then another 20 mins for the  server to take our food order the manager said the hostess wasn't communicating with the  staff and was new  I am sorry that is unacceptable  especially on a  day like valentines day  to use a new hostess or server I have serious reservations on EVER returning to this location

This used to be my favorite lunch spot until another customer at my table found giant ants crawling around on his plate. When he called the manager over, he simply crushed one and said "yeah they get in sometimes" and walked away. There was not even an offer to foot the bill as an apology. Oh and I've seen them on multiple occasions take uneaten sushi off people's plates that have left and recycle it onto a new plate for other patrons. Now not only am I turned off from eating there, but management is absurd as well. No thanks. I will never eat here again.

I stopped in here about 45 mins before closing time yesterday with a flat tire. After just a short wait, they repaired my flat and didn't even charge me for it! I was stunned to see an auto service store "pay it forward" like this! The gentleman who helped me (Carson, maybe?) was so pleasant even though I know he must have been tired after a hard day's work. It really made my day! Thank you so much, Pep Boys! I'll be seeing you again next time my car needs some attention. But next time, I'll show up with a pizza or something for you!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I think I have found my new favorite sushi spot on the Main Line!

My regular sushi spot closed at the height of the pandemic so I had to find another restaurant to satisfy my sushi cravings. Sushi Nami was open and I was delighted with my order.

My go-to sushi order is a Philadelphia Roll and a Spicy Tuna Roll. Sushi Nami's sushi rolls are big and full of fresh ingredients. They do not skimp on filling the rolls. 

It's easy to place pickup orders online on their website. Their servers who help you check out at the restaurant are always friendly. Can't wait for my next Sushi Nami order!

I was craving ramen today, so I decided to check out this place! Walked in and was seated shortly. I love how simple the menu is and very easy to read. I decided to get spicy Tonkatsu ramen which is my usual order at other ramen places. When the food came out, I was amazed at how big the bowl was and how the portion was very good for the price. The ramen broth itself was delicious, but not spicy enough that I was used to. The meat, however was chewy and the egg was over cooked. Other than that, it was delicious and the servers were nice. I would definitely come back.

This place is really cool and different. The restaurant looks like a hole in the wall and run down but the service was really good. The food is adequate, nothing to brag about. The price is really good for what you get. I really do like though that they try to make the cheese the star. At first I was disappointed by that because I felt like they covered up other things that could have been really tasty (like my buffalo chicken) with a crap ton of cheese and cheese sauces, however, they are named the big cheesy. I would stop here again if I go back to New Orleans

Stopped by this place on the way home, and its so incredibly beautiful inside. In addition to all the furniture being brand new, the layout and spacing is perfect. It was cool to see the community room with a sink, although I'm not entirely sure how to reserve or use it.

The staff was super friendly and my drink came out fast. Definitely try the Nitro Cold Brew if you get a chance. Not sure if it will be a regular order of mine, but it was cool to try. There is also plenty of outdoor seating and a drive-thru, so I will definitely be back.

Overpriced and ho-hum.

For years I have eaten at Golden Dragon but am sick of the way they keep raising the prices, reducing the portions and charging extra so that you can, for example, get *enough* noodles to go with your chow mein by asking for more noodles than they serve. I'm done with Golden Dragon.

I don't understand that " quaint, quintessential Chinese restaurant decor" rave from the other reviewer who has apparently never been to a restaurant in a Chinatown like San Francisco, Manhattan or Los Angeles? The decor at strip mall Golden Star is ultra ho-hum.

Only stayed here one night, but didn't have any ant problems like other people had. Stayed here 1/14/22 in a bottom floor unit. (426). Great location, room was spacious and clean, bed was comfortable. 
Had a decent sized fridge, nice workspace, couch and patio. Front desk interaction was pleasant. Was given some vouchers for a glass of wine and water bottles. 
Overall a pretty good experience here and would definitely like to come back and stay for more than one night.  Shower was nice, but took a while to really get hot water.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The reviews are pretty bad but I don't know what people are expecting with airport food. We needed a bite to eat as we had a somewhat late flight. 

We shared the baja chicken sandwich without bacon. The lady who took our order was pleasant as was the manager (I think) who thought we hadn't been helped yet. We didn't wait long as we were the only ones ordering. I'm not a huge fan of Quiznos but when you're hungry and in an airport, you just gotta grab something.

I'm a foodie just like the next one and I recognize that this is not a foodie paradise. It's airport food and I recognize airport food for what it is--convenient.

I saw creole creamery on "Diners, drive ins and dives", and even though i think the host is a moron i knew he was on to something. Im from massachusetts and my one non-negotiable on my trip to NOLA was to stop by the creamery and it was worth it, worth it, worth it. I had it all planned out what i wanted when i got there...FAIL! I went for the cookie monster sunday with no regrets and sampled the lavender honey ice cream which oddly enough taste like the name. My only regret is that i couldnt buy some to go. Hotel had no freezer :( i'll yelp about that later. Oh and what made it 5 stars and not 4? The price. Bring $10 and leave bloated people!

Terrible customer service.  If you want to use a debit card to rent, they want to see a utility bill and a recent pay stub.  Really?  And, if you're a parent with a kid under 25, they charge an additional $40 per day PLUS want a credit card, in the kid's name, to put an additional $400 deposit charge on.  Not to mention rude and arrogant punks behind the counter.  I WILL NEVER rent from them again, and I was an Enterprise Plus member.    Oh and by the way, they close at 1 pm on Saturday and are closed all day Sunday, so if you think you can avoid being charged for those additional 18 hours, forget it.  Stay away.

I stopped by since I heard they make their own ice cream. I'm always looking for spots in FL that make their own ice cream so this was a definite winner for me. 

I ordered a kid-sized cone of their seasonal blueberry cheesecake. It was light and fresh, and not too heavy on the cheesecake and just the right amount of graham cracker crumbs and blueberries swirled throughout. The kid-size is one nice scoop, and I think it was enough to satisfy my sweet tooth for the day. :)

There's not much seating inside, so I was standing for most of the time.

Sakana Sushi is fresh, and sizeable. The hand roll was filled with delicious portions of salmon and fresh veggies. The staff especially Veronica at Somersett were knowledgeable and friendly. We sat down and we're served quickly. I was especially blessed to get a scoop of ice cream at the end. Personally, I'd go just for the ice cream which is home spun. The takeout special is a seriously great deal if you want to take home, but this time we ate in. Start with the miso soup which was hit and very delicious. Will keep going.

Wow. Hands down best Italian food I've found in south Tampa. I got the meat balls and spaghetti, best I have ever had (sorry mom). Fiancé got the seafood linguine and he was very happy with the selection. Purse pockets with Gorgonzola and pear are to die for, we got as an app to save room for dinner. Wine decently priced. Food is on the pricier side but the quality is the reason why. If going with a group might want to call ahead. Place is pretty small so either go early or go willing to wait if it's a weekend.

Pretty good food with nice drink options and cool atmosphere. Decent size portions of food which fill you up but don't overload your belly. Some nights are more packed than others for unknown reasons but I would call and make a reservation just to be sure. I like sitting near the bar area but it can get quite loud so a quieter option for a date or with children is best to sit outside. It's a good place to at least sit at the bar and order a drink to meet with friends and maybe even make friends. Cool location to be in if you're new to Tampa.

Sushi is my go to favorite cuisine, so my gf told me to try out Yokos and I wish I had sooner! The sushi rolls are pretty awesome, like their sunset roll that is topped with lime. At first I thought it sounded a little strange but decided to go for it and it has become my favorite. If you plan on going on a weekend make reservations as this place gets packed quickly. I ordered take out on a Sunday and it took 15 mins, take out on a Friday took an hour so plan accordingly. Went with a group of 6 and everyone was super satisfied with all the dishes. Alcohol prices are comparable to other sushi joints. This is now a staple of mine in south Tampa

First time I've ever walked into a place needing glasses so I am not familiar with the "process" but I have a prescription so I thought I could walk in here and ask questions....

But the guy who runs this place was strangely obnoxious towards me and had an attitude from the beginning.....

His attitude towards me while I was looking for my insurance info was completely unprofessional and felt borderline racist.

Learn some customer service skills you f'n prick, and your mask policy is ridiculous, I respectfully asked for one right when I walked in but the entitled Democrat owner acted like I was a piece of trash anyway...

What a joke...
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Pro: Close to the airport
Cons: Due to airport proximity they're don't need to upgrade the hotel any time soon

They charge you for everything like it's a luxury resort however it's really just like walking into a backstreet boys video.

Maybe this place was the bomb in 2002 but in 2016? It's kind of sad.

The lobby smells.

You can hear EVERYTHING going on in the rooms as you walk down the hallway

Use a washcloth when you use the remote- I don't have a lot of confidence in housekeeping 

But it's close to the airport AND the bed is comfy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I frequent a few planet fitnesses and this one is by far the worst. The machines are ok which is why I gave it a 3 but the women's locker room is horrible. I stood at a shower for 10 mins waiting for hot water. Moved over one and it took 5 mins but I got hot water. The water jumps every time the toilets flush. The showers are so small compared to other locations. Also the hydro massage isn't in a room it's out in the open in an awkward location. The massage chairs face a wall on the floor. The front desk woman is not pleasant. Definitely not approachable. When I'm in the area from now on  I'll drive to montgomeryville.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Was excited to see this place open. The people there are very friendly. The vacuums work very well. The problem is, the car wash doesn't thoroughly rinse your vehicle, and it also doesn't dry your vehicle. This means you have significant water spots when done unless you spend 10 minutes drying you car with your own towels. I spoke with staff and they are aware, but doesn't seem that they can do anything about it.
I'm going to go back to a full service car wash, as Bay Breeze can't rinse and dry my vehicle with their sophisticated system. I guess old school is better.

I went there once, and that would be the last time. I had an appointment set up by a friend who is a regular there, and when I came they did not even expect me. I drove an hour and a half to get my hair done. They fit me into the schedule. I had wanted a perm and the stylist seemed in a rush to the point where I was going to just leave, but I ended up getting my hair done anyway. My hair didn't turn out exactly as planned, and the experience wasn't that great. Prices were fair, but I wouldn't recommend this place for any lady to get her hair done.

I've been using starbucks as a second office for years. I just moved my family to a nearby location and so I've begun frequenting this starbucks. Food and drinks are good. The place is clean. But the staff seem really stressed out or something. The lady at the front counter was just acting weird and saying strange things, and she needed me to repeat myself a few times.  The other staff didn't seem aware of the fact I stood at the counter for two minutes hoping to get a packet of honey. Again, it's 7:00 AM on a Saturday, I wouldn't blame them for being exhausted. I'm sure I'll add more stars once the staff gets friendlier and more present.

24/7 McDonald's that has multiple drive thru lanes, because the place definitely gets busy during rush hour. McDonald's is McDonald's so I won't comment on the quality of the food, but I'm giving this specific location a 4/5 because sometimes they forget certain items like extra cheese on a sandwich, or giving me regular soda when I asked for diet, etc.

I've been to some bad McDonald's restaurants and this isn't one. The staff have always been pleasant and I've been coming here for a while. Please ensure you check your order though!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I love cooking Japanese food and was looking for a Japanese grocery store in town. Now that I relocate from Atlanta to Nashville I thought I'll explore the ethnic stores in town. I found this Japanese restaurant and grocery store. The food in the restaurant part of the store was fresh. My mom and I had Sashimi; however, the grocery section doesn't have a large selection of Japanese condiments or food items. It's okay for the curry Katsu I like to make or miso soup. Maybe you can ask the owner what you're looking for and if they can get it for you.

It's one of those things you have to try at lease once when you're in NOLA. You will blend right in the touristy crowd with this bright green hand grenade in hand. Cool decorations and fun atmosphere during daytime. Get the frozen hand grenade to cool yourself down. It can be a little too sweet if you're sipping on this for a while and if you do not finish when it's still frozen. I have no idea how much alcohol is in one of these but it is surprisingly strong, especially when you're not even tasting the alcohol much.

What a hidden gem!!! TempleTerrace is so fortunate to have this restaurant.
It is an intimate locale.  Food was exceptional. Appetizers were very tasty. My friends and I just grazed the appetizers how amazing.  When I looked at dinners at other tables they looked scrumptious . I look forward to returning and having dinner. Everything looks very yummy.  Nicole waited on us and took great care is us. I really hope this place makes it, we need gems like this in Tampa/Temple Terrace!!! Please go and give it a try, you will fall in love.

I wasn't going to write a review but since I can't eat my sandwich and I wasted $12 I might as well complain. I have been going here for 7 yrs. only a issue every few months but this time its ridiculous. Look at the picture attached. I had a chicken breast sandwich and asked for the olive, pepper mix. The kid grabbed a big scoop and to much oil and I asked to drain it the teen boy just looked at me and dumped it on my sandwich. Now I'm at work and can't it this greasy mess. Boohhhh!! Won't be back for a while!

Rudest pretentiousness with nothing to back it up but pseudo-Italian wanna be twenty somethings.  First on the phone, was on hold for 7 minutes at 2:15 PM. Then, they refuse to take a reservation for less than 6 and told me to come in at enter 5 or 8 and MAYBE I can get a seat.  Was there once already, the food and service is not worth the bother - I get treated better at Angelos and the food is better and authentic Italian.  If you are looking for something more upscale, go to Doylestown, don't waste your time here.

Buyer beware,  ....
they will sell you shocks and struts at high prices,  even though my car did not require those parts..   the tires were out of balance, due to my lack of rotation often enough....the correction of defect was to replace the worn tires....nothing else....Apparently,  other auto shops are aware of Tire Kingdom's reputation of every car needs $1200 shocks and struts that rolls into their store....I had Mavis tires replace my tires, now the car rides like new and no vibration of defective tire ware and balance issues....
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Sushi was suppper supppperrr yummy! Super annoying that they limit your mussels with all you can eat... it use to not be this way at the beginning? Great service by the waitress she was on top of our drinks I can honestly say I didn't have an empty glass the entire time! The place was super clean and have nice lighting! Cute little lit balls hung from the ceiling! They were super quick bringing out food as well. I have a three due to limiting with an all you can eat menu! Also the price was a little proxy they offer no price menu for all you can it but it comes out to 27.99 a person.

Brand new brakes and rotors all squeak after all being replaced at this shop. Took to another mechanic to check out all bearings, joints, etc and they couldn't find a thing wrong with my vehicle. Leaving me to believe after paying an arm and 3 legs later that they put the absolute worst products on my car and charged me way more than they should have. You'd think places like this would value customers that spend high dollars in their trashy shop to keep the lights on, give them satisfactory work vs trying to find a new mechanic or just doing the job yourself a few months down the road. Save your time and money, this place is a scam and a half.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Total Scam Artists Here!!   

Never take your car here.  Called to replace a part in the cooling system, which I have done in the past.  It's a PITA and wanted to send it to a shop instead.   The Owner quoted roughy $800.00 as he said he had to pull the motor to fix it (big lie!!!!)

When I told him how to do it, he gave a normal price.......

When he called to say the work was done, The 6mo old radiator suddenly had a hole in it.

I am filing a complaint with the State Attorney General's Office

Stay away from this place at any and all costs !!!!

Great place for fast, friendly service along with good sushi! Fresh fish and yummy rolls. We came in hungry and got the Sushi and Sashimi Set for Two w/ Miso soup - we specifically requested the Mt. Fuji to be the specialty roll that comes with it and the staff gladly obliged! It was all delicious. The cuts were good. Filled up the boat! We left very happy and satisfied with our meal. Their polite and prompt staff was worth mentioning.

They have AYCE sushi too that ends at 8 PM daily! Will have to try that next time :)

Fast food Mexican place with a drive-thru. Friendly staff but super super slow service. Food was mediocre, although very cheap.

Super Papas is your classic loaded Mexican fries. Big portions. Yum. Can't go wrong with that. The tacos, on the other hand, weren't too good. Super dry. Not seasoned well. Just a big disappointment. I wouldn't come back unless I really needed something to fill my stomach. I recommend finding a good food truck or even Filiberto's if you wanted good Mexican food to-go as they even have drive-thru service.

My friends and I eat at this place at least once a week. I have never had a bad meal, only shoddy service. Their breakfast wrap is very good - sausage, eggs and cheese - how could you go wrong? As for lunch, I usually order the BLT wrap. It is my absolute favorite. The bacon is always crispy and the fries that come with it are good as well. Recently I have been ordering the Donna's Delight salad. It is huge! Filled with vegetables, cheese and chicken! It is very, very good. Most of the waitresses are very nice and the food comes out in a reasonable amount of time.

Nice cafe, good mexican food but pricey, beautiful views and fast service. Nice place to meet friends and family.

Went here to meet some colleagues, we had the two shrimp entrees on their menu.  The food was good, but nothing special and a little bland for my taste. The portions are smaller for the price you pay (20$ or so per entree). The nachos and salsa are served complimentary. The salsa was really mouth-watering. 

The views from the cafe are awesome. Service was good, food came out fast after placing the order, especially considering the crowds on a busy saturday evening.

A nice place for sushi and Japanese food. We had our typical food that we always eat at any other Japanese place and it was all really good. Edmame, shrimp tempura, shrimp shumai, california roll etc. All was nice, as it should be. We had never had hibachi salmon before and we tried that. I wasn't sure if hibachi style and seafood paired well, but it was really good. I also loved all the veggies served with the salmon. The portions were lot and we had quite a bit of left overs. 

Service was great, food came out quick and servers were nice and friendly. The interior decor is nice and we enjoyed our evening.

Our first indoor dining experience since The End Times, and so we were scared. We were completely put at ease once we got inside. This was our second time, the first time was before all the troubles. It was just as good as before, if not better (the dessert this time was better, unforgettable). Both times I had high expectations based on the price point, both times the expectations were shattered. So fantastic in every aspect. I've done 2 other omakase places, this is the only one I would consider returning to again and again.

Love Kate!  This salon was recommended to me by a friend, and I have not been disappointed.  Kate is my stylist, and she always talks with me in depth before touching my hair to make sure we are clear on what she should do.  The salon recently relocated to Ybor, and it is clean with a fun, funky young vibe.  All the stylists are friendly and I have never been disappointed with my color or cut.  There is plenty of parking, and you may see an occasional rooster stroll by outside!  Fun place, great prices, highly recommend.

This car wash used to be AMAZING !! But the last 3-4 months I have seen a huge down grade. I always pay $18 for the highest level wash. I love that I get car scents and the dash wipe. The issue is with the wash part. The brushes on the inside are rarely working properly lately. The back of my mid sized SUV never gets cleaned. The tire shine has worked maybe 1 time. It's spotty and doesn't work properly. The guys who spray the car are texting half the time and the bug wash works terribly too ! For paying almost $20 it's not worth it for me anymore. I have to come home and re-wash again. I'm disappointed. Probably won't be back

I'm happy to have found this place. There are so many places in SB to get tacos and I'm still looking for my go-to place. I ordered 2 asada and 1 al pastor. Not bad. I would come back. I loved how affordable and simple the tacos were. The only downside is that it was my first time so I guess I thought they'd put some salsa, a lime slice, napkins in the to-go bag but they didn't. I got home and realized they didn't provide any of that so I'm bummed about that. Lesson learned, though. Will definitely ask next time for salsa and lime or they could've instructed me to visit their salsa bar if they had one.

My dad wanted sushi for his birthday, but he wanted me to pick the place. I was scared of disappointing him on his bday because of (UGH) last year. I chose here because my friend and I ate here in the beginning of summer. MY DAD WAS SATISFIED AND REALLY LIKED THE TUNA NIGIRI AND WHAT HE GOT! (One of the boat things with teriyaki and tempura). I, of course, got a tasty Oregon roll!!!! My dad was talking about how good the sushi tasted and his thing tasted. I was satisfied that he was enjoying himself!!!!! REALLY GREAT SUSHI!

I would give them a zero if I could - I made my reservation 2 months prior to my arrival.  I received an email from a Becky Crosby a month later notifying me that I needed to update my credit card info, within 3 days of the email, because original payment was declined.  I called back immediately the next day to give them my new card.  I just arrived for them to tell me that my reservation was cancelled and not to mention how nasty the lady at the front desk was.  I called Becky to explain how disappointed I was and she claimed she called me back and left messages.  (I got absolutely no calls or messages from her) 
TERRIBLE customer service!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This hotel is very conveniently located on Bourbon street.  I recommend getting a balcony room on the Bourbon street side of the hotel if you choose to stay here.  The experience will be unforgettable if you don't mind the additional cost of $100 per night.  We were able to enjoy a parade, street performers, and the very active nightlife of the city. The rooms were adequate and unremarkable.  The staff is rude and unaccommodating.  Unfortunately, I would stay at a different hotel next time due entirely to the bad manners and disrespect we experienced from the staff during our stay!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'll start with the food is good. It's not mind blowing or earth shattering. They have a nice atmosphere and the food is good comfort food. Eclectic and family feel. And then there's the service. We were told there would be a two hour wait for a typical Friday night dinner. When half the tables were empty and the staff were meandering about with no level of rush on their faces. Completely unapologetically as though this creates some air of elitism. Very arrogant feel from the establishment. Walked out then and there.

Room was clean, lobby was clean and the gym was really impressive. Nice staff and about a 30 min walk to Music Row.  We stayed through Labor Day weekend.

Would definitely return and highly recommend.

Minus one star for the congestion on Saturday with the valet.  There already isn't much room to work with in the driveway.  Not sure if it was valet disorganization or random cars blocking access but cars were backed into the street, including mine, and at $40 a day to park, I expect it to be an easier flow.

Also, water pressure in the shower was bad, didn't matter what setting. Very low water pressure.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This May be the most beautiful restaurant in Philadelphia, beautifully mounted mirrored high ceilings, amazing views of the city, waterfall surrounding the staircase and gorgeous flower arrangements. The food was delicious but didn't quite stand up to the physical aesthetic of the restaurant. The bread was soft but cold, the watermelon gazpacho amouse boshe was delicate, full of flavor and delicious, the tuna noodles were creative and incredibly tasty, the salmon was well crusted and cooked, but the whole meal left something to be desired. Would highly recommend for a special occasion just because of the grandeur of the restaurant.

The Ultimate bait-and-switch Place bringing a $34 coupon for an oil change cost 54 and then all they want to do is tell you battery which is odds is my battery is 9 months old and they're trying to sell me a brand new one then I went to bring my second vehicle there that usually $20 to get the oil change and they wanted $45 with a $15 off coupon border down to 30 still ridiculously high price for a standard oil change non-synthetic nothing. What really made them a premier customer service company is the air pressure light was on in my car they sell tires they did not even check the air pressure in the tires I will never use this company again
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I went here last week for the first time since a client of mine recommended this place to me. I got a gel manicure, the nails looked great for about a day or so then one chipped and the rest started to peel while I was out of town. I just got back today and gave them a call to let them know that I was unhappy with my nails. I went in and had the gel manicure redone, for free! I would have been happy with a discount but free is cool too! I decided to add on a pedicure this time too. The hot stones felt amazing. Maria is great!

Not great... went in thinking about a detail, but due to time restrictions,  decided on the Ultimate. Should have included all the inside- vacuuming, cleaning the dash, cupholders, doors and instruments. Did not. Had to ask twice if they vacuumed the passenger side and the kid just kind of stood there and had to go ask someone else. They offered to vaccum again, re did the side and we still ended up leaving with the car looking like this.  Not at all worth the $$. I honestly think the $8 package would have been the same. Won't be returning.

So far I am not impressed with the looks of the place.  It's almost dingy and could definitely use a refresh.  The bathroom is nasty.  The sushi is mediocre at best.  One roll is just drenched in sauce and it's all I taste.  Also, the Boston roll had avocado in it even though the menu said it didn't.  My wife is allergic to avocado and spent the rest of the night with an itchy/swollen throat.  Not cool.  People that say this is the best sushi they have ever had need to expand their horizons.  The price was totally not worth it.  I have had better sushi from grocery stores.   Blah.

Not sure why this place has less than reviews on here, it was an awesome experience!

I texted in like the billboard said to do and actually got my wash for free! I pulled right up and the automated system was super easy to use. I pulled up and out my car in natural like the young man noted on a sign. 

The car wash itself is noteworthy- one of the better washes you'll get with an automatic system. 

Vacuums and window cleaner are free! You just do them yourselves. That vacuum was STRONG! 

Staff was clean and friendly. 

I will definitely be back!

I have never had an issue with here. My brother ordered food three hours ago and it never showed up. It shows you are open in Grubhub and it was over $50 worth a food. Let just say I'm very disappointed in how no one even reached out or answered the store phone when u tried calling I called 8 times. I live not even 5 minutes from there and we always order food because it is quick and the employees are very nice. I just wished they would have reached out to us to let us know so we could of done something else for food.

Good selection! I've been a handful of times and on 2-3 occasions after walking through Opa and out back have secured a spot to be told that they are closing for a "private event". While I know things happen it would be great if the host upfront shared this or maybe even a sign can be posted as a warning. I've seen such at other bars and it's such a small but great way to ensure a pleasurable experience. 

Like other reviews mentioned, not much of a view here! More of a canopy tent with plastic walls and fencing...feels like an apartment backyard in the middle of the city.

New location, major issues. First off, the parking lot is actually sloped so there is no way your cart will stand still. 2nd, it seems the only reason they decided to build a bigger location was to carry a larger inventory of the same exact products. Instead of 3 rows of a given item there are now 9 rows. The only reason I give 3 stars instead of 1 is the management staff that had been at the other closed location on bustleton for years is now at this location. They are top notch and make coming here somewhat bearable. 

PS, 60% of their craft beer selection is IPA's. There are so many beautiful beers in other styles, please fix this.

This place had some hit and misses. It was super crowded but I think that had to do with the fact it was restaurant week. And the steak was amazing! It's small for the price but it is waygu beef! The roasted potato side wasn't very good and we ended up not eating it. I had the carbonara and it was good, just super super rich - more so than a normal carbonara. I can only eat about half because of the sweetness. Overall I think the food is really good, but it froze expensive as it is it should be. I gave it a better rating because the bar staff was wonderful.

My gosh, by golly, this is perhaps the worst McDonald's in all of New Orleans. Not only are the hours incorrect, I am yet to get an order right that isn't cold. Also for ride shares, I have gotten delivery requests from this restaurant countless times without them even being open. The management at this McDonald's needs to take a very close look at who they got working here because they all suck, zero in customer service. My followers will know that I am very seldom this harsh and honest in my reviews, but I have had enough of this McDonald's and it's time that the YELP community know to just avoid it until they do something about it.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is an updated review for my last visit to Target optical. I realized that I never came back on to do an update once I received my glasses. In my previous review I noted that Target informed me that they would call me when my glasses would be ready. They never called me so I went without my new glasses longer than the estimated time. Once I called, the staff were not friendly over the phone and seemed irritated that I was calling to check on the status of the glasses. While I love my new frames, I might look for a new eyeglass spot in the future.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I came here a few weekends ago with my mother in law as she was looking for some low carb snacks and offerings. Parking is a bit tight in areas but overall it was not terrible. The store is very decorative and had plenty to look at. Biggest downside was the prices and the staff were not friendly and often cut in front of us as we were looking around. The checkout counter was very narrow and awkward to walk into especially with social distancing being a thing now. My mother in law found some snacks but I don't know if the price is worth coming to Broad Ripple to get them.

Some Dunkin locations are really hit or miss and I've never had a problem with this location. The coffee is good and fresh tasting as well as the donuts. One time I came by and they didn't ask about hot or iced and they gave me iced when I wanted hot but let me keep the iced drink as well because they would have had to throw it away. The service is fast and friendly. Sometimes if you are in rush hour- it might take a bit longer. This is near a hospital so business is typically busy not terribly long. It is easy to get in and out of t location. The building itself is nice looking and I have been inside before but I typically use the drive thru.

Basic coffee house, they've got different teas to choose from, and some house coffee drinks, but their espresso isn't anything special. There are tables for working or chatting at, and I'm not sure if this is always like this, but when I went, there were several people in there working or reading, and it was dead silent. It felt really uncomfortable to even have a quiet conversation. The table I sat at looked like the top just decided to stop trying, because it was like sagged down on the edges. Fun area, though. Saw a lot of cute dogs walk by while I was here.

My co-workers and I eat here for lunch at least once a week.  We love the atmosphere because when you sit upstairs, you have a nice view of the entire restaurant and it's nice and cozy up there.

We usually all get soups with every meal, and the soups tend to be delicious.  They seem to always have the roasted red pepper soup and rotate two other specials.  You can't really go wrong with any of them.

The main courses themselves are very satisfying.  The salads are HUGE, and every burger I've ever had there has been fantastic.  The staff is also super nice and attentive, so it proves to be legitimately relaxing break while on our lunch hour.

Super helpful staff.  For a beer distributor, this place has a huge and diverse selection.  They are responsive to their customers and will start carrying a product if enough people request.  I'm not sure what it does yet, but they have a frequent shopper card - I'm very curious about this.

I know I asked for some specific craft brews, but they didn't have what I was looking for (Great Divide anything, Yards Saison, or Omegang not a variety pack).  Only because I didn't get exactly what I wanted do I have to hold the rating down to 4 stars.

There was no line. Only drive thru was open. Lobby was closed. Inconvenient for people traveling. Ended up walking to Carl's Jr. Which is where I should've gone from the beginning. 
They had no milkshake and no smoothies. They had no change and didn't even give us napkins or ketchup which should be standard after they requested for me to go to the parking lot to wait. Let's no mention you can't even go left so you would have to go right to make a u turn. Fries were cold even though we waited. 
Employees were polite. Management please provide a better environment for these great people to work at.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
It seems the only reason this hotel is still in business is due to the convenient location attached to the Philadelphia International Airport. This is evident in the disrepair and poor customer service during my short stay. 
It starts with the front desks attempt to dishonor the room selected in the reservation. The room provided was then small, cramped, and the decor unpleasant. Upon preparing for the night I found the sink did not drain, the vending machine incorrectly stocked, and the WiFi only available with additional payment. This hotel is only here to unfairly take advantage of weary travelers. My recommendation is to avoid if possible.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have no idea why this place rates four stars.  Everything is frozen food service, mostly deep fried, even the pizza crust is frozen.  The French dip, the standard by which I judge any grill is served tough as a tennis shoe, on a anemic bun.  Frankly the only half way decent thing is the voyager burger.  Many of the wait staff lack training and common sense.  Service is slow and haphazard.  Waiting for your check then having to go stand in line in the store to pay is a hassle, clearly a sign of dishonesty on the part of the employees.  If it was not in the RV park I would never eat there again.

So, I've been coming to this location for about a year now with a client that I work with. The staff is always friendly and your greeted as soon as you enter the gym. Whenever, I have questions about a particular machine, the staff is always their to assist.  The equipment seems to pretty up-to-date and in good shape. Everytime, I've used their locker room there always clean and well kept. I usually go in the morning time, so I'm unsure if the cleanliness of the gym changes throughout the day. However, everytime that I visit the gym it's always a pleasant experience.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Beautiful ambience. Great Service. Food misses the mark. 

I had the Hen of the Woods mushroom, with nduja, garlic scape, and matsutake. Chewy and over-sauced. Was it suppose to be served room temperature? Hen of the woods is such a wonderful treat but the sauce hid the mushrooms and the sliced kitchen mushrooms on top added nothing to the dish.

For desert I had the Fig leaf panna cotta, with balsamic and amaretti. It was ok. Nothing memorable.

$55 including tip for one person is a little pricey when the food isn't up to par. Would love to revisit when the menu and preparation is improved.

I think bartaco is extremely overrated. The ratio of chips to salsa/guacamole is way off, we ended up with a ton of salsa left. The tacos are tiny, so you need to order more than a few to fill up. While the description of the flavors seem inventive and fun, the flavor is lacking. I had the carne asada, falafel, rock shrimp, and glazed pork belly tacos. The only one I really liked was the crispy rock shrimp, and even that was kind of dry and did not have enough toppings. The mojitos were great, though! I was told to go back and try the corn, so expect an updated review if that happens. :)

The location of the property and site is wonderful. The hotel staff are friendly and helpful. However, the rooms are average and seem to be older. The balcony was not kept up properly. Checkin was quick,however, check out was a process because their was a another conference checking in when we were departing. The elevators were full and got stick. The hotel doesn't give complimentary anything. So, I go back I would look into staying at the Embassy Suites across the street. The hotel is in walking distance from the convention center.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have gone here several times but I am looking for somewhere else. The staff is very friendly and the business itself is very clean. My issue is that they are extremely expensive and they don't deliver the quality that comes with the price tag. I get a Gel Mani and a Gel Pedi every two weeks. The gel polish  application always has some slight issues on the sides of my nails which makes me crazy and I can't seem to ever get the dead skin off of my feet since going here. I gave it several chances but it is time to go somewhere else where I am not paying $100 for mediocre services.

This restaurant was recommended to me for an anniversary dinner, and I'm so glad we chose it! Top notch all the way. The food was great and table side service was really cool. The service was perfection! From entry to exit we were treated like a special guest. The owner, Vincent, came out and spoke with us and other diners for a bit. I got the impression this is a nightly thing for him. Though pricey, it was a dining experience I'm not likely to forget and will definitely visit again...for a special occasion.

Pizza Guys in Sparks has been my go to pizza place for the last year as until tonight the pizza always arrived piping hot!

Its only getting 2 stars because tonight my Mexican Taco pizza arrived 1 hour after ordering and was COLD. The wings on the order arrived nice and hot, so it appears they sent a L Taco Pizza that had been sitting around.

Not good.... Until tonight i would have given them 5 stars, but now only two because who wants their fresh pizza delivered COLD! And before its asked, i requested NO LETTUCE as it gets the pizza a bit soggy. So Lettuce didnt make it cold.

Incompetent!! Rude!! Slow!!!  13 minutes at the drive-thru with only 2 cars ahead of me.  The clerk asked for my order (one coffee and one donut) so I gave it to her, a few moments later she comes back giggling on thr speaker and asks me to repeat my order.  I begin to repeat my one coffee and before I even with my one donut she cops the biggest attitude with me.  I ended up pulling away and I went to the location on Gall Blvd.  

This Rt. 54 location has always been bad but it is closer to me BUT I will continue to drive further to not have to deal with the incompetence and attitude.

I am absolutely blown away by this wonderful establishment and the professionalism that was shown to me today. I showed up without an appointment needing to remove my back plate and was taken care of within an a half hour or less. The guys here really go above and beyond and I was not charged for plate removal and plate replacement. I also got a price quote for vehicle maintence that was significantly cheaper then their competitors. I will most definitely be getting my vehicle serviced for any future needs at this location and I recommend anyone else reading this do the same.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Now I've added my wife's Prius to service here. Full synthetic change and free rotation.  Xtra charge for balance. I ll balance next time. Parking lot is full and only one person in the lobby. 
They do nice work here I trust them. 

Update June 11
I called at 2:30 to check status to be done 
"Come on down "

I show up and the guy says up to two hours. 
Only have one guy working in shop with multiple bays. And a car in every slot but one. 

I ll come back and but ask all the questions first. 
Wasted trip to first street
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I saw the sign up outside for discount haircuts. 7.99
So I might as well take advantage 4 chairs operating. I didn't check in on line. Looks like a 2min wait 
Update mid June 

This time I checked in on line and drove down to wait. 
When I pulled up she checked me in on the sidewalk.   No chairs inside. So no waiting inside. 
I got right in for a cut, your preference for cut art in the computer. She prints it out and you confirm it.  Pretty organized..
Good prices , $13.00 for Seniors. Works for me. I think I got a nice cut. 
All good!

I m ready for tamales and eggs. These chipotle beef tamales are the most flavorful. 
The offer a discount if you take 6 or more. 
A dozen is very expensive here. So I got a half. 

I buy them Frozen, they come in sealed bags of two.   

Can't wait for breakfast!

They also offer salsa but I make my own with jalapeños I roast on the Barbie. 
All good. 

Update:
I ve had 4 of the 6 I bought over two meals.  
They have changed making style. More Masa less meat. We ll eat the last two but no more from here. Too bad the Tamale I chose was used to be great.

This is right at the airport. We planned to walk over but called the 24 hour shuttle at midnight. Came straight away. No planes fly 
In or out midnight to 8 am. So a good nights sleep is assured. Now it's 0830 and they are taking off. But I still got a great nights sleep on a superior bed. Easy check in al all for 69.00 usd and a driver tip for the 
Shuttle. Delightful.  Side info, all the FedEx drivers stay here as the team hotel. 
That expense and trust just move them up for our in my opinion. . I know the restaurant is nice but we won't use it. We have a late check out, 2 pm, if we can sleep thru the jets.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This bank has always said yes when the two banks across the street said no or put up road blocks. 

Again it happened. I need a Bank Medallion counter stamp on HH Bonds to be sent
Back to the Federal Reserve. 

Mainly, for this service you have to be a active bank user. So we had to open a min savings account. There are more bonds coming due so we do need to be able to repeat. 
The service was included in benefits. 

My wife set all this up yesterday, got the stamp done and I m going back this am. To be added on as a user. A Appt. Is needed and two forms of ID. 

I knew they would come thru based on past experience. 

Thank you Chase.

I have finally found a nail spa open on Sundays! I love this. They are all really nice and do they do a great job. I even bring my 5 y/o son, and they trim his nails for him. It's clean and always seems busy, so they must be doing something right. 

I only gave 4 stars because I notice sometimes they rush you out the door when it's closing time, or 30 minutes before. I also feel slightly rushed when picking my color. But I think they is how every place is! 

I will go back, the pedicures are amazing. They have really great chairs with the massaging feature. 

Lonnie is super nice and would recommend her as well!

We order their catered food all the time.   This time we decided to try them for dinner.   We loved the sirachi maple bacon, it was sweet and spicy and just delicious!   My husband had the seafood over linguini and I had the porterhouse.  My husband loved his food.  
I thought the porterhouse was horrible.  It was not cooked well at all.  It was almost boiled looking.   The steak had no flavor and it wasn't crispy or broiled on the outside.  It looked almost gray.   So it was a huge disappointment for me since I was so looking forward to a nice porterhouse.    And it was $45.  For that price I expected a better steak.

Dunkin is one of my favorite places to get coffee! They are always fresh and serve as the perfect pick me up. I am not a huge fan of their food which is why I gave it a 4. They have the best iced coffee and their ice drinks are a pretty good size. You definitely are getting your money's worth when it comes to their iced drinks. A little helpful tip tor coffee drinkers: do not get sugar in your coffee because they put a lot of sugar in it. If you like sugar, then only ask for a little bit. Trust me when I say you will be thanking me for this tip.

I went with my friends for my birthday to grab some ice cream. Before that point, I had never tried this place before, however each of them had nothing but stellar reviews. It's not the worst place I've tried for ice cream, but I feel like I've had better.  I got the brownie a la mode special with butter pecan ice-cream. The ice-cream did not taste like butter or pecans. I feel like I got something less than vanilla, which says a lot. The brownie was eh. 

I guess go here if you're in the area or you're a student at Tulane or Loyola since I see a lot of college kids here.

This was our first visit for lunch. The restaurant was empty, our table and another couple. It took over 30 minutes to get our lunch. The manager said there was someone with seafood allergies and they needed to clean the grill...really? Shouldn't restaurants have 2 separate grills, one for seafood and the other for everything else???  The food finally arrived, it was good but disappointed we had to wait so long. Friendly feedback, keep your customers informed vs having them bring this to your attention.  Also offer a discount or dessert for the inconvenience.

Being in Ridley Park for over a year now, there's not many good food places around, but Great Wall Chinese is definitely one of them. They are affordable, consistent and delicious. 

From the menu, I have tried cheese wontons, egg rolls, spring rolls, pad thai, lo mein, fried rice, chicken wings, and honey walnut shrimp. 

All the dishes are great, but my favorites are their chicken wings, spring rolls, and honey walnut shrimp. Even their dishes like pad thai, when you order a small you honestly get so much food. To avoid long waiting, order ahead of time and pick up. There's only a few tables within the restaurant.

Amazing! First time dining at Solstice and I was extremely happy. An amuse bouche was served, we got the charcuterie board, a perfectly cooked steak, the homemade pappardelle, and doughnuts for dessert. This is for sure a more fine dining meal but in an atmosphere that feels more open and relaxed than other places. The lighting and open concept made me feel comfortable unlike some fine dining places. 

I would not change anything about the food we ordered. And I will be back likely next week for dinner or brunch!

Tried a class at Sweat on Friday morning. The class was great and challenging. I dropped my three year old off at the play room while I attended the class. Two hours later, I came down with one of the worst stomach viruses I've ever had. The next morning my three year old woke up with pink eye. 
I rarely visit gyms so i am almost certain we both picked up the viruses from sweat. The stomach virus is one thing, it's going around I could have got it from anywhere. But pink eye suggests that the play room is not cleaned regularly which is disgusting.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I recently had my vehicle serviced here. The individuals I worked with were courteous and professional. There was a mix up with my vehicle and another clients, they started performing the work without my okay because they had confused the two of us. Perhaps a little extra care or a change in the process will prevent this in the future. Overall the experience was great and they gave a discount for the mix up. I agree that these guys are honest and aren't looking to charge you for items you don't need. Thanks all!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Bogie's is a small barber shop (only 3 chairs) in the heart of Broad Ripple. I had a 5 PM appointment and was promptly welcomed right at 5 PM. The hair stylist was very conversational and throughly cared about my input in the haircut process. It was a quick and professional cut and he even shaved the back of my head and applied a nice after shave. The haircut was topped off with some nice style gel. This entire hair salon experience was only $13. Phenomenal place to get your haircut, especially if you're looking to save some money. I will be coming back here in the future! Thanks Bogie's!

Nestled between Strands Hair Salon and Sasha's on Demun, you could easily miss this awesome place. It's relatively small but the ambiance is fantastic...it's no wonder you'll have to make a reservation to sit at one of the tables or else you will have to eat at the bar. Which is what we did and nonetheless, the experience was amazing. I got the Roman Gnocco, Pork Ragu, Bechmel, Percorino....it was very delicious! The menu is small but mighty! Don't take my word for it...go see for yourself. I highly recommend Louie!

First of all they permanently removed the buffet.  It was the draw for many people.   

We have gone there 2x since reopened during pandemic.   The menu is limited, not like it used to be.  Maybe menu with more selections with come out after pandemic is over.

The last 2 times, the food was off.  Not prepared as ordered.  Took longer to get and restaurant was not packed, even with covid limited seating capacity. 

We may try it once pandemic is over but who knows.   We were disappointed with our dinner lastnight.   It used to be so good but alas those days are probably gone.

Loved this vintage, old Hollywood style hotel in Montecito! We had our wedding on Butterfly Beach and the front desk arranged all of our transportation along with coordinating all our rooms and who should go where. Nick was awesome (Front Desk) and made our stay so comfortable and cozy. Its walking distance to the beach and to lots of fun shopping. Rooms are a bit on the cozy side so if your looking for large spacious rooms this may not be your spot, but if your looking for romantic, sweet and lots of history this is the place for you! Thanks Nick and all the staff. We will see you again soon.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This is my favorite sushi place on the south side. I've never gotten anything I've disliked at Ichiban and the service is always prompt. Most of the time I order for pick up and I've never had anything wrong with my orders. I'm always excited to get Ichiban. 

My favorite things to get are the Kate roll, Cliff roll, mango roll, and salmon nigiri. Their salmon nigiri has such good flavor and never feels slimy or weird. If you don't want sushi, the Japanese udon noodle with beef are always so delicious. 

I definitely recommend heading to Ichiban next time you want sushi. Prepare to become addicted!

Seems to be a lot of different people working here these days, and the business has declined.  I made an appointment on a Monday for the following Saturday morning........Went to pick up my car at 4 pm, ( they close at 4:30 ), and my car was the very last one in the shop.  Just an oil change and tire rotation.  They also charged me for an "extra" quart of oil.  Had the vehicle over 5 years and never had that happen at other places.  Definitely not the same service there and I doubt we will be back.  Going there off and on since they opened.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I had an excellent experience at New Hope Auto when I recently went. I was starting to hear some weird sounds in my car and looked into trustworthy car repairs on Yelp and found Hope. She was super friendly, knowledgable and sweet. As a woman I always get worried that I will be taken advantage of at car repair shops but I never felt that way with Hope. I had my brakes done for a very reasonable price on the same day I brought in my car. I was very impressed with my service here and very competitive pricing and will be going back again should I need further car repairs.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I've been to this new location twice and have to say that it's only made me miss its predecessor even more.
First off, the Cafe au lait here is not cafe au lait. It's just coffee with warm milk. Let's face it, the loss of Morning Call means we lost the best cafe au lait in the city.
Beignets were great the first time and just ok the second time. I also preferred the Morning Call beignets because you added the powdered sugar.

And yeah, there's no table service so I'm taking off another star for that or I would have rated it 3.

Passed through this joke of a town heading back east. Women's and men's bathrooms were DISGUSTING. Chewing tobacco all over the men's toilets, urine everywhere, stalls beyond atrocious, and the women's was just as bad.

The employees laugh at you when you say there's an issue with cleanliness. I can't imagine the sanitary regulations that are broke every day in this building. They must spit chewing tobacco in your burger meat on-top of probably a 1,000 other kitchen violations.

Like the other reviews, I wish I could put a zero star rating. It's pathetic management hasn't done or cared to do anything here. What a disgusting town that must be.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It's probably about 5:30am I decided to go to this McDonald's for some breakfast burritos. Got my burritos and sat down in the dining room to eat them, took my time and enjoyed them, after I'm done and as I'm getting ready to leave the lady behind the counter goes "sir, our dining room isn't open until 10:00." Like, it wasn't a problem for the past 15 minutes, and I'm done anyway, so I guess I'll just go screw myself. Like McScuse me bitch? There were no signs, or barriers, nobody said anything to me. What sort of 24/7 McDonald's closes their dining room anyway?
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Ever since their recent reopening, I've been frequenting this place as often as my time and budget allow for.
Plenty of bars in this city offer some grease in the back kitchen for hungry patrons, but very few actually give a damn.
Marie's kitchen does give a damn: many damns, even.

All food is made from scratch, always on-point, kitchen gets deep-deep-deep cleaned weekly: they do everything they can to do what they do as well as they can. Twist your tongue over that sentence, then twist your tongue over the double-stuffed Italian sausage-pork loin sandwich.

Order: washing 4 Comforters

Pros: the attendant was super nice and on it! He met you at the door with a rolling basket and he knew what washer I should use. Since it was busy, he made sure people stayed on top of their load so that everyone could get in and out! He was also seen disinfecting the tables on a consistent basis. By far the best laundry mat i've been too! Plus the drying was free!!!!! Total amount I spent to wash four comforters was $10.75. I was able to wash all 4 comforters in a 8x washer!!! Took only 25 mins to wash and another 20 mins to dry.

Cons: none
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I usually have a good experience at this branch. But today I need it too cancel to online checks and had a very hard time doing so. I do my banking there every week 2 withdrawal deposit and transfer and today I got a phone call checking on my activity even though I was just there a half hour ago with two bank tellers taking care of my transactions. I understand they're verifying transactions but I was in there every week and they should know me. it shouldn't be that hard to void an online bill payment check so my rating for today is poor

This place  never gets a complaint from me!

Ordered two steak tacos loaded. I normally just like them with cilantro and onions, but wanted to try something different. O M G! Heaven Sat inside this corn tortilla. They even grill the Totti, until it has a bit of a crisp.

Added to this order was a small burrito. Not sure how it taste.. As I ordered it for someone else...

Now for the little baby Jesus of this establishment.. The taco salad.. I hear the food angels singing, and the trumpets blow. There's really no words for it.. OK, maybe two: THE BOMB!

First time and had a very pleasant experience. Started with the meatball appetizer, delicious! Had a house salad and the chicken pesto pizza. Salad was a good portion and very fresh, house dressing was great. Watch out for the banana peppers if you don't like hot! The pizza was good, thin crust plenty of topping but very little pesto flavor. Had a slice of the margarita pizza and it had more flavor- nice sauce! Service was good, we did have to wait 15 minutes even with a reservation. BYOB but you can buy wine at the table.

I went through the A&W drive thru and was disappointed with my experience and the quality of the food. 

First of all, the wait was longer than normal and the staff at the window were less than thrilled to be there. Due to the long wait, I figured we would get fresh food but i was wrong. The egg on the bacon & egger was not completely cooked and it was dripping everywhere. This ruined our appetite.

People don't mind waiting and paying a bit more for quality food, however, I can confidently say I am not in any rush to go back to this location.

Went in with a flat tire since I purchased the tires here... was told there's a 3 hour wait. Seriously!? To repair a puncture? There are only two cars in the bay and about 5 guys wandering around aimlessly. I have to go to work, so  I had to schedule an early AM appointment on Monday (two days from now). We will see how that goes since the last 9am appt I scheduled to install the tires I had to bring my car back at 6pm bc they had screwed up. 

If everything goes well with this appt, I will update my review.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Strange experience with the delivery guy(s). I got the knock on the door and opened it to one guy standing there without the pizza in normal clothing and then this other guy with his shirt unbuttoned down to the last button handed me my pizza. I'm talking chest/ chest hair out, shirt almost completely unbuttoned. Not exactly the most appetizing experience. The pizza ended up being just warm but not hot and felt room temperature about a minute after opening. 

Pretty strange experience. Keep your delivery guys in check WP. It's nice to have things stay professional.

If you're staying in the Tampa Bay area, the Double Tree is only a short trip to tons of great dining, shopping, and nightlife spots. Nicole at the front desk checked us in. She was great to encounter throughout our trip, and made an effort to ask how we were enjoying ourselves. She's really friendly and professional! Exactly who you'd want on the front lines of your business. The hotel could use some updating and renovating, but the view from our room was to die for. We also enjoyed the pool and the restaurant bar.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I called at 3pm and got an appt for 4pm, same day. They told me it would be a little bit longer of a wait, which was fine. What I'm not happy about is that someone who walked in behind me, without an appt got in and out before me! (They were having the same service done).
They are very friendly, but that is frustrating as someone who called ahead. Overall, they were great. They estimated the time very close to what they stated over the phone, just a little longer. I would go back again, but just not on a day when they have a long wait.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Good sushi and love that it's byob but honestly one of the rudest restaurant experiences of my life. Came here in a group of 6 for our friends birthday with a reservation. Even though they ACCEPTED our 9:30 reservation, they couldn't have been more rude about ending our meal as soon as possible. One waitress even told us we had 2 minutes left before we had to leave..... who does that?! We even tipped them a full bottle of unopened wine and we were still treated like we didn't matter. Will NOT be coming back. Do not understand how they think they can treat their customers that terribly.

Overall, very disappointed in this hotel, i'm a lifelong Marriott Platinum Elite and was looking for a hotel I could come back over and over again. This location failed to deliver, first off, for some reason they have a $10 per night parking charge. This place in located across from a mall, not a convention center.

Check-in staff was fine, but manager had a could careless attitude when i challenge the parking fee. Wasn't until she was told my status that she changed her outlook.

Rooms are just ok, they needed some major work and upkeep. I was only here for a couple of days or I would have changed hotels.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: WHY spend the money to own a franchise and run it into the ground.  This is the closest location to me and sometimes when I get there they are just closed.  It's only one person there most of the time.  Once I just ask a question and in the background I heard someone call me an expletive!  My simple iced latte is different every time.  The employees are totally untrained and could not care less.  The owner must be a cheap ass who doesn't pay well.  If he was open more he could afford to hire better people.  Guess it's Starbucks for me.

Update. I've been using the monthly membership service for a year now and I still like it here. 
But two things I want the NASCAR car wash management to consider:

1. The dryer is just not as powerful as it was before. It leaves a lot of moisture on my car, although I patiently wait until the green light comes on. 

2. Your locations in other states offer free vacuum, so why not do that here? That will be a very attractive bonus to come here. Or maybe grant 1 or 2 free vacuum for monthly customers ?Many car wash places are offering free vacuum nowadays and I would love to see that happen here also. 

Thanks!

Good customer service, staff is friendly, very accommodating. I have a clear bra on my car and usually I don't use car washes that have brushes, but this car was is very high quality and they keep things clean especially with the large brushes, their dryer is one of the best, it actually dries up most of the water. Most car washes do poor job at drying. Overall I am happy with them, it's not a car wash I'd use everyday due to clear bra and need to protect he car against swirls, but one in a while if you need a deep clean this is the place you should check out. Plus their prices are very reasonable and affordable.

I didn't eat here, was chased away before I could by a rude waitress (who, in her defense, was probably understandably frustrated about having dropped a piece of fried chicken minutes earlier). There are two entrances, one main and one side one. We mistakenly used the side one, were confused, and took a seat. The waitress huffily explained that we were to check in at the front. Too much attitude. Can't give lower than 3 stars without trying the food, but I won't try the food, too many good alternatives in the area for a second chance.

This place continues to be a hidden jewel on the southside. The steaks are second to none and cooked and seasoned to perfection. Love that you can get pasta side dish or roasted potatoes and veggies. The mushroom appetizer is a don't miss food item. The building is cute and should have an intimate feel in side but it is LOUD and bustling every night; so a great place to catch up with friends or a celebration but maybe not so much for a quiet or romantic night out. Pricing is appropriate for the quality of the food. Dress is what you want -jeans to dresses.

Second time here first time in the bar area. Enjoyed sitting at the bar and talking to Jacob the owner. The atmosphere was good and the bar and the prices were on point. It was a "full bar" but with a limited selection of spirits but the choices they had were good quality and mostly my preferred choices in each category. He made the drinks with care so good experience. Food was really, really good. Took some time to get ordered and delivered but good once it arrived. I like now that I know it is family owned (they bought from previous owner) this will now become I regular Mexican spot.

Wondering where the last reviewer was who complained about the drive-thru service here: There's no drive-thru at this location. But, the dining room was open and fairly clean during the lunch period. 

Service was quick, ingredients were fresh, the sandwich was typical Subway: unexceptional but nothing disagreeable. 

This location had a sign saying it didn't accept Subway BOGO coupons, but a customer who asked was told she'd have to order online for the offer. Reminded me of an episode of the TV series The Office where orders were to be placed online to justify the investment of a website.

Great hole in the wall filled with regulars, good food, cold beer & great music. I have been coming here for years. Never have I sat inside. Why would you? I wish there was more tables along the water. The tiki bar is fun too. Seems like a large piece of property where the owner could invest and make some great upgrades- fingers crossed. Until then, I'll be back to enjoy a cold beer, spinach salad with salmon, gator bites, hushpuppies, cheeseburgers, the nachos, crab dip, and shrimp baskets ..... and so much more!

I loved this place.  The Classic Hummus appetizer was fantastic.  The name is deceiving though because it includes a lot more than just hummus.  They should change the name.  The basil pistou was yummy.  Olive tapanade although good was a little salty.  The Shrimp and Grits were great and the Salmon over spinach and lemon ricotta polenta with crispy chick peas was yummy!  Even the spinach was good.  Many items on the menu I wanted to try, but was very happy with the choices I made.  
We sat outside which was nice, but it did start to get slightly buggy.
5 stars for food, 4 for service ( a little rushed).

I ordered this through Postmates, wanting a cheap, and easy meal. While it was both cheap and easy, it was also mediocre and not very flavorful. There are a ton of Chinese restaurants in South Nashville that are better. For food that is so salty and has so much MSG (I could tell it did because my heart rate was elevated after I ate), I don't know why there isn't more flavor in the food. I got steamed dumplings, vegetable fried rice, chicken teriyaki and hot & sour soup. The Hot and Sour Soup was mostly broth. I was underwhelmed with everything. While it wasn't terrible, it was just okay and I would not go there again.

The office staff is nice but they really aren't on top of their game at calling in prescriptions to pick up elsewhere. I love Dr. Mackie she is the reason I go back. NEVER get a prescription filled there if you can get it somewhere else. They charge a flat $15.00 rate to fill the order if it is 1 pill or 100. They also over charge dramatically. Examples: I got an antibotic there for 30 pills it was $40.00 but the next time I had it called into walmart and it was $8.00. My dog had cancer. The medicine was going to be $150.00 there but at costco it was $54.00 for the month. I could give more... love the place but they rip you off for drugs.

Amazing location with lots of things to see and do within walking distance. Staff is friendly and rooms are well lit with just enough space for your stay. Only down side, at least right now there are no benefits at all to Marriott loyal customers. Also the WiFi is inconsistent. Hotel is clean, right now there is no housekeeping service and the executive lounge is closed. There is a starbucks inside but they keep running out of food. I'd say here again, maybe not during Covid. Great if attending a hockey game.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It has a good atmosphere and looks clean. The sushi options are vast including many vegetarian options. I love the sweet eggplant roll. Ok so youre probably thinking id you have such a good experience why 3 stars? Well, the glassware was so dirty. There was a red lipstick smudge on mine but i wasnt wearing any lipstick. And then we ordered a bottle of Pinot Noir and they chilled it for us. Why would anyone chill a red wine?! To make it worse the service was SO slow; it took forever to get someone to just come by and take our order and then longer to get the check. I would go back just for the sushi tho because it's delicious.
