full disclosure: I didn't try the pizza. I love wings. I saw Anthony's at the TOP of the "The Best Wings In Delaware" list.  I don't think I get it. They marinate and roast their wings, no fry. They're served with a handful on fried onions thrown on top. 5 for 7.99.
 The flavor is a charry, lemon pepper natural chicken roast - almost prepared more like a rotisserie chicken. That's the bad things tbh. it tastes very similar to rotisserie chicken that you can get at any Whole foods. The fried onions add absolutely nothing to it. The chicken itself isnt MASSIVELY flavorful either.  Just not it!

I'll start with the 2 good things, the breakfast and the front desk/concierge/valets were great. The compliments end there. The managed, male whose name starts with "A", was either having a bad day or needs to be retrained in customer service. We had a large party, 2 rooms, and we had to ask EVERY DAY for housekeeping to clean the rooms. There were issue with double-charging credits cards and not returning the money quickly/easily, etc.  Horrible experience and will never stay there again. It's unfortunate because this is actually a great location but next time I'll be at the Sheraton!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Honestly it's kind of luck of the draw when it comes to this place. We've gone into the drive-through and went through quickly but most of the time we end up sitting for a long time. There's been multiple times where has been upwards of 15 minutes before we moved at all. We also have mini occasions where our food is incorrect after we leave. 

Also if you're thinking to yourself "I bet it's better if you pull in and park." We've done that too. There's been multiple instances where no one has answered our buzzer. We used to go fairly often but now we hardly ever do. It's a shame because we all like the Sonic Ice Cream and food.

This YaYa's is very outdated. Does not offer half of what the YaYa's in St Pete does and does not accept debit/credit cards! You must use their "atm", pay an additional fee of $1.50, however, no money is dispensed to you, it goes to YaYa's. So it's not really a ATM? Not sure. Its so sad to see such a great company lacking. Food is decent at best, that's being gracious. It doesn't seem very cleanly and it's not an experience I'll ever repeat. 
Matter of Fact, I work less than a mile from this store but travel all the way to St Pete on my lunch to get some GOOD Yaya's!

My husband and I needed a bite to eat and we decided we'd give Zing Zing's a try! The restaurant is quite small and we decided to get carry out since all of the tables were occupied. The menu is huge... so many choices it was almost a little overwhelming. I ordered the shrimp chow mein and my husband got Szechwan beef and scallions with rice. Carryout did take around 30 minutes and we were very hungry, but once I tried the chow mein I was very happy- it was so good! Hubby's dish was great too. Large servings so go with an appetite.

This is the perfect gym for someone with a busy schedule who is looking to stay healthy and active. There's four different types of cardio machines, and an array of free weights and strength machines, with a few Smith Machines as well for squats, chest press, etc. PF gives you 24/7 access, for ten bucks a month. It's a steal. 

This location is almost never busy and you will rarely have to wait for a machine. The gym is always very clean, the staff greets you every time and is nice in general. 

I also read that there is free personal training... I didn't see that advertised but I will have to check it out next time I go!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Solid sushi place at a decent price. 

I am not much for "speciality rolls" but my sister is so when I go here with her I have tried a few and found them pretty tasty. 

Simple choices are more my speed and I think they do a fine job with them. 

The fish and sushi rice are tasty and stand up to any other place I have been that doesn't burn a hole right through your pocket. 

Overall the atmosphere is this tiny establishment is quaint.

It isn't anything extraordinary. It is a place to eat if you are craving sushi.

I have been looking for a nail salon close to my new place and stopped here. The salon itself was quiet and relaxing.  My pedicure was amazing especially the massage. My manicure turned out good as well. I chose 4 stars instead of 5 because my left hand is still a little sticky and I don't know if it will smooth out. I will be back though because everything thing else was great. Thanks Tommy!

I would like to update that my gel polish started chipping two days later and now 4 days later the color is yellowing. Unfortunately I'm out of town so there isn't much I can do to get them repaired.

I look for the little things.  This may not bother others but it did me.  I don't like having to work for the hotel.   That includes having to go back to the parking lot to place a parking ticket on my car.  

If the hotel has a problem with non-guests parking here then it should create a parking lot access that requires a room key or payment to exit.  Or it should have someone outside making sure that only guests park here (and giving the added service of security).   But I don't like having to enter the hotel and then being required to go back out to my car for the hotel's benefit - not
mine.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Had such a good experience at this location. The customer service was one of the best I've had. Dionne (I think that was his name) was amazing. He gave great service from beginning to end. We had a misunderstanding&I received a classic roast beef instead of the beef n cheddar. We took it to him&asked if he could just add cheese. Instead he just made us a whole new sandwich. Before he even took our sandwich he said "Can you please give me a second to wash my hands" I was very pleased to see that they made sure to have clean hands before handling the food.

I came here alone today, because I wanted some food before Christmas shopping. The dishware is beautiful by the way. I was ignored at the door of the empty restaurant and given a lunch menu that was absolutely covered in soy sauce and drawn literally all over. So then I order an appetizer, then was told I wouldn't be allowed to order anything else because they were closing in 20 minutes. When the food arrived, the sushi was meh and the tempura was extremely greasy and deep, deep, hard fried. It was worth it for the fast food and the fact that I was starving, but I'll never come back.

To be honest, the car wash was average and I don't know what it did to my tires, but my rims were dripping some dark liquid in which I had to wash off myself. Unlike other self serve car wash places, this place does NOT OFFER TOWELS to dry your vehicle. Other locations  have window cleaner, interior cleaner and towels. This place only sales the towels and spray. When I approached the front desk and asked him where the towels were to dry my car, the gentleman told me they were for sale and handed me some paper towels- very poor customer service. I was embarrassed for the employees.

Service: 3.25 Out of 5
Nice lady;however, I am a creature of habit. I've tried a lot of hairstyles & know pretty well by now that it should be a fade from 1/2" and up and a trim to thin out the top. Unfortunately I was not too satisfied when I left because she didn't agree with my opinion. I tipped more than I usually do cause I don't think I'll be back. 

Location: 5 Out of 5
Great location especially if you're coming from the M-F line or you're in the H Mart area.

Overall: 3.75 Out of 5
Sorry I don't think I'll be back for a while.

Apartments are nice, but the bugs from the lake are absolutely horrible. If you are in buildings 10-12 there is no trash compactor or dumpster and you have to drive through two gates to get to the nearest trash compactor.

When my AC failed, they did respond very quickly. Within 10 minutes they were out to recharge the AC unit to get me through the night, as they ordered a new AC unit that was installed by the time I was home from work.

This community would be great if they fixed the trash situation on the South side of the property, and came up with a solution for the Midge flies coming off the lake.

I will start by saying I am a sushi snob. I have had pretty good sushi in a few different places. This restaurant was a complete let down. The service was really slow. We ordered fried rice which was okay and spring rolls which were also just okay. While they have a lot of options for sushi, the rolls we ordered were not good. We got the Fuji and the caterpillar roll. The caterpillar was not extremely bad, but it was drowned in eel sauce and spicy mayo. The Mount Fuji was awful. I've had much better sushi, but this is bar far one of the worse.

Pros the cleanest room of any hotel or motel I've ever stayed. 
Cons first night my wife got locked in the bathroom due to a malfunction of The lock. I I could let her out from the outside.
Television some channels not very clear. No refrigerator in the room only place of this quality that did not have one in the room. Came back second night card key did not work. I could not find a manager for 12 minutes called the office and he came out as the phone was ringing. Choose this due to location near Longwood Gardens will not be staying in Marriotts again. Just found out the hot water is down but may be working soon.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: First, let me say, there is no good food in Gibsonton, FL. There just isn't. I don't care that The Show Town bar & grill says they have the best burger in town, they have the ONLY burger. Hard not to be the best. Anyway, we crave Chinese food. Good Chinese food. Sadly we are still looking. New China is not fine cuisine, it is fast food Chinese and it is not bad. The food has a good flavor and just yesterday I had one of the best servings on Egg Foo Yung that I have eaten in a long time. If you are stuck in the Gibsonton / Riverwiew are and you want some decent Chinese, this could be the place.

I have never had a problem with the service or the overall quality of the food. If you are in the Wesley Chapel area and want to experience a great sports grill, Winners is the place. My only complaint is that when I ask for a burger cooked medium, I expect medium, NOT well done. When my wife asks for the onions on her patty melt to be cooked well done so that they are caramelized and dark brown, that does not translate into "bring me some barely sweated onion for my burger" in any language. This place has tha atmosphere and they have some great food, now if they could just teach someone to cook it.

I'm a physician (human). I've raised 5 kids and have had a lot of animals. I served as the first cardiologist for the UF College of Vet Medicine until they could get a Vet cardiologist.....
The docs here are good if you can get to them. The infrastructure and support staff is horrible. Don't expect a timely appointment, courtesy on the phone or any other usual benefit of decent customer service.
Follow-up for chronic conditions is sketchy....
They need to hire someone from Sonic to help them out.
We are going elsewhere.

never ever ever do business with these people.  major rip off!!!!!!!!!!  brought a car back 1.5 hours late, they were going to charge us $175 per hour!!!!!!!!!! ended up charging a full day, $150+ instead of $500....because at first the guy said $175 per hour AND another days rate.........plus to top off the gas tank, they charge $10 per gallon..........absolutely ridiculous.  i'll do everything in my power to prevent them from getting my business and the business of everyone i know.  facebook, here i come...

Ate here with my husband last week and the food was amazing. 
He ordered the lemon wings for an appetizer and meatball pizza. He loved both! I orders a chicken Cesar salad and we shared a side of tomato risotto. My salad came with a grilled stalk of romaine. i was a little leery of that but it was good. the risotto was also delicious but we didn't get to finish it all because of the amount of food we ordered.  I beleive the prices for everything was very reasonable.
The waitress was so nice and very accommodating. the restaurant was very well decorated clean and a nice relaxing atmosphere. I would go here again with out a doubt!

Having a go-to barber is key to any man's story. We are creatures of habit when it comes to getting a good cut.

I typically have a barber shop close to my house, but was in a pinch and needed to get a cut close to my office. 

I found Skillz using yelp and I was familiar with the shopping center they are in because it had just been recently renovated. 

I walked in and met Mike and he listened to what I was looking for and delivered. 

I think I may have found a regular spot for when I am in the office now!

The quality of the sushi is concerning. I give the quality and freshness of the fish 1 star. It made 2 of our party feel sick. I have been to most of the sushi places in reno and sparks and this one, while the cheapest around, had the lowest quality of food. Their customer service is prompt and considerate and I upvoted them only for their friendliness. I voiced my concern to the wait staff and she said they had more complaints about the salmon that night, than just mine. I advise customers to stick to well cooked entrees here and avoid the salmon and tuna.

5 Stars for the quality of fish.
1 star because there is so much rice you can hardly taste the dish.

I really enjoyed the food here it was tasty and they were very friendly, but the rice ratio is seriously distorted. Not to mention they had signs posted everywhere threatening to charge if you leave rice on your plate or leave sushi uneaten. Thats definitely not what I want to see when I go into any restaurant. The service was nice, the food came out regularly but we never recieved a single refill even when asked. Overall it was a good experience; excellent fish but WAY too much rice.

My BMW is out of warranty and when it WAS under warranty the recommended oil change was once a year as it's paid for but should be done every 6 months or so.  Anyway, 'where should I go' I asked myself and so I called Bavarian Auto and spoke at length w/Jeff. Day of my appt ( I called last minute & they had an opening) Jeff was so gracious and friendly to chat with!  Got right in and took about 45 minutes.  The waiting room was clean as was the bathroom and had plenty of reading materials on hand.  They checked my fluid levels and the total cost was the quoted amount. Bet happy w/ Bavarian Auto

This Starbucks I have altered my review a couple times now. They fluctuate in quality of service and services they offer. While they have expanded the rewards program to grocery Starbucks they still do not offer everything a normal Starbucks does, such as online ordering. Like many smalltime food businesses, it suffers from not having a large enough staff or inventory. So they are often slower than a large Starbucks with a large staff, and they frequently run out of basics like cups and ice coffee. Recommend going to a 'real' Starbucks when possible.

I would give the nigiri we had (salmon and tuna) 4-5 stars--it was good. The seaweed salad was also good. However, for some reason, the sushi rolls just aren't my favvvvvorite. Though I have only ever been for happy hour, so have only ordered off of that limited menu. I'm guessing I would like some of the sushi rolls on the regular menu more. The prices during happy hour are great! Other than that, there were quite long wait times between getting there, ordering drinks, ordering food, getting food, etc. All things considered I'd give it a solid 3. Out server was very kind so that made waiting a bit more manageable. 

Xoxo,

Is this thing on?

I have been coming here for months and have never had a bad experience. The coffee has always been good until yesterday. The coffee was still good but the barista was taking her sweet time cleaning the machine in between each drink. In a business driven area this is not ideal. I didn't say anything until my group today came in. I had the same slow barista and when we mentioned to another lady  that we were in a little hurry she turned around and let her know and they both proceeded to have an attitude. Love this coffee shop but not enthusiastic about these employees.

I wanted to get donuts for my brake guy at Les Schwab for fixing my brakes and doing an awesome job!

With all the bad reviews I almost didn't come to Dunkin but I wanted to give them a chance to prove the reviews wrong and they did!!

The store in Sparks is clean, had a full selection of donuts to choose from at 1:00 pm and the young gal who helped me was friendly and also let me know the Long Johns were .40 more when I selected a couple for my dozen. 


The donuts were fresh and nicely boxed.
The guys at Les Schwab were thrilled to get them!

Who doesn't love Nicey Treat? The first time I tried it was at the local farmer's market. I went in with super high expectations based on all of the raving reviews, and my expectations were only exceeded! The first one I tried was the Mojito which had actual pieces of mint in it and tasted exactly as you'd hope. 

I can never pass up Nicey Treat, and my day is always a little brighter when I see the Nicey Treat stand at the farmer's market or a local festival. Pretty sure no other popsicles will ever compare!

This is a good place for doing laundry and having the kids with you if you have any. The staff is friendly and helpful. The place is decently clean and rarely crowded. This place is taken care of well, if anything is not working, they will get it fixed by the next time we come in. Good variety of washer sizes and a good amount of dryers. They also have games for the kids to play. Vending machine available as well. Parking is the only thing they could have more of, but it's not bad. We will be back for more laundry to be done!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Nice intimate atmosphere and cute decor. We made a reservation through open door. I would definitely call or book online if you plan to go in the weekend. Before dinner they served bread with oil and balsamic.  I got the Cacio de Pepe the noodles were my favorite part. My friend got the truffle risotto which was also tasty. Portion sizes were perfect. You had enough food to be full but not stuffed and leave without leftovers. This being said we didn't have room for dessert and wanted to check out other bars in the area.

There isn't a better vet out there. Last year a neighbor shot our 7 month old hound puppy in the face with a 22. The bullet went in under her bottom lip blowing out some of her bottom teeth and completely destroying her jaw. Dr Andrews and his team saved her life. They took out all of the bullet and bone fragments and made her a brand new jaw out of wire. She's as good as new. We have two hounds and see both Dr. Andrews & Dr. Davis. They've been our vet for years. They are amazing, caring and always affordable and honest. Joni the receptionist is sweet and helpful....it's like family.

Normally in an extended stay type hotel the plates silverware etc are already in the room. Not here
Dry blood on a pillow case
Toilet is broken the water keeps running
The smell of latex is in the room also someone below us keeps smoking in their room (this is a non smoking hotel) 
Asked for extra pillows and blankets. They had one blanket and zero extra pillows available. 
Construction next door makes for an early morning. 
Side door doesn't properly lock and can easily be opened from the outside without a key 
Rainy day... Water leaking through the window.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
So mad!! I asked for a basic mani and I went to check out and it was double the price I usually pay in Fishers because apparently she gave me a "spa" mani because it included a massage? Then after letting my nails dry for 10 mins and they sprayed them I get to my car and one is already messed up. I typically wouldn't do this but I went in to see if they'd fix it and all they did was put more polish over it which now looks like crap. Fool me once - jokes on you, fool me twice - jokes on me. I will never try a new nail place again.
The only reason I gave 2 starts was because the nail tech was nice and the place was clean.

text:
This is a standard reliable Dunkin' Doughnuts/Baskin Robbins. There is only a few seats in the place so you may have to take your food to go.

I showed up here within 30 minutes of closing (I hate being one of those people). Even with it being so later, the staff was very friendly. They were cleaning up but didn't seemed bothered by serving us some ice cream.

I had a classic chocolate chip ice cream. It was pretty much what you would expect from a basic ice cream cone. My girlfriend had Rocky Road and she seemed very satisfied by it. All in all, this place is close enough that I will probably come back.

Went this morning. Haven't been here in about a year or so. Literally didn't do anything I asked them. First off, I do not eat plain eggs. I asked for a sausage and cheese croissant, the guy repeated it back and a small iced caramel latte with sugar, whipped cream and Carmel swirl.. got home and the croissant had egg with it and when he gave me the latte I seen no Carmel on top.. typical!.. they really need to pay attention more. I don't care how busy it is in there... Everyone deserves their food the way they LIKE it

Pretty standard as far as McDonalds go. If you want fast food in New Orleans East this is an option. This location has two drive thru lines which cause for faster service. Also, the inside is pretty clean and this location has plenty available spaces for parking. The customer service was pretty good, the employees are young but they're fast and efficient which is always a plus. 

As far as food goes, if you had a Big Mac at one location, you've had them at all locations. McDonalds is a pretty standard with the taste of their items at all locations. You will always know what you're getting, no surprises in the taste department.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Probably my favorite Starbucks ever. After being tired of the store on Edgewood never getting my order right, I drove out of my way to come here. I have been coming to this location ever since. Baristas are all super friendly, even when they're busy. Drinks are always made pretty quickly. It's nice to go to a location that actually makes you feel welcome. I got a drink to try and I thought it was gross one day. They made me something I would like instead without any fuss or extra charge. Manager (tyree) is super friendly and I always see her working just as hard as everybody else. I can absolutely respect that!! Try this place!!

I had a terrible experience here and will not be returning. I ordered the new iced  brown sugar oatmilk shaken espresso and what I received was nothing like it. I've ordered the drink before at other Starbucks and it was always made perfectly , but this one was nothing compared to it. It was sooo watery and tasted like milk and water. I even went back in to let them know so it could be re made, still received the same exact drink. I posted a picture of what it's supposed to look like since I had it before and a picture of what I received. Two different drinks. Do not go here. They do not know how to make their drinks.

I've stayed here many times and this last time we had some problems...The hotel now charges a $10 a night parking fee which makes no sense in a suburban environment. Its a money grab plain and simple.

The drain in the tub didn't work and had to be cleaned out (filled with hair). The shower curtain wasn't clean, cables are hanging out of the TV mount, and the outside lights shine right in through the windows.

The entire place is in need of updates / renovations and they need to do away with this BS parking fee. I'll be staying elsewhere unless these are addressed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
South Tucson is not known for sushi - I know this. This place was bad. Went for lunch. Walked in to a table with a MENU and was told I needed to order before I sit down...I should have left

Ordered veggie tempura and a spicy Tuna roll. Safe, or so I thought.

My drink cut went empty twice and when the tempera came it was good but a bit soggy. This is the only reason they got 2 stars instead of 1.

The spicy tuna was a joke. I am not even sure it was tuna. The color just didn't seem right. As I am writing this I hope I do not get sick tonight. It was not good and I will not be returning.

The hotel itself is decent. The rooms were clean,updated and quiet. The valet service system was terrible. I say that because most times when we arrived there was no valet person waiting to take our keys. We often had to take our keys to the lobby and turn them in. Once again,the staff was nice but the system sucks. You pull to the door,take one elevator to the lobby on the 11th floor,and another elevator to the room floors. Overall the hotel experience was good just felt $42.00 plus tax per day for less than good valet service was a total rip off
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The hotel is clean, and the staff is very friendly. Parking is frustrating if you are trying to find a spot to unload near your room as the restaurant next door has valet and takes up endless spots. You CAN park there, but good luck finding a spot. The rooms were bright and cute. The water view is only (from our rooms) if you open up your back door. The breakfast was nice and well taken care of by staff. Needs a little bathroom updating by adding a fan, and the shampoo and conditioner were sub par, so just bring your own. Again - the staff was great - just a few little things would make it better :)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
A lot of the reviews I read are based off the customer service but this review is based on just the service. There wasn't too much interaction with anyone from the business other than the guy yelling at me to put my windows up. Whoops.

I really appreciated the fact that were were several extremely powerful vacuums available to use free of charge. They car wash it's self was very easy and quick to access. I was in and out within a matter of 5 minutes for the $15 wash. I do think the quality of the car wash I received was worth the money so I would definitely come back and recommend others.

I heard a lot of hype about this place, but it did not live up to it.  It was very....average.  The food was alright.  The chicken was really good, but the rice was very dry and the beans were just average.  We did have a party of 30, and they handled us extremely well and efficiently; this is the main reason for the A-OK 3 star rating.  I will say (though it means little), the food smelled amazing.  Some of the best smelling food I've ever had the pleasure of smelling.  It made my nose happy.  It was too pricey as well, but that's not a huge dissappointment for the area.

The staff and location are amazing. The amenities are good not great. The restaurants were either closed or limited hours - due to COVID. The pool was nice but not fun - lack of a party - so could be good for some. 

The rooms are large and clean. The showers are hot. We upgraded to a balcony, however we moved back to a regular room because the balcony is shared with the adjacent room. My wife was not having that. 

They have an entrance right off Bourbon Street, so you are close to the action without being immersed or overwhelmed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I wish I could give them more stars. Went there for dinner. The party of 5 got right in. Service was  great. There server was attentive and stopped by several times, the menu has alot interesting Mexican cuisine. The manager,  Jose checked on us early on. He answered all our questions and made some drink suggestions.  They were willing to make additions the menu items. He even brought out a sample of the Mexican spaghetti.  (Excellent choice). He said they use FRESH ingredients.  The food reflects that. They have dishes from southern Mexico. Again.

I am annoyed almost every time I come to this location and get ice cream and now it is to the point I will be contacting corporate. On my recent trip there were two young girls working and one completely botched my order and when I went in to correct it and took it home my friends ice cream had a hair embedded in the ice cream. When my friend called to make the girls aware of the issue one of the girls put my friend on hold and my friend could hear the girls in the background say "whatever, she's just trying to make me mad" and then hung up the phone.

I'm always in and out of this Publix as it is close to my house.
I am always greeted with a smile when I walk in.  
There are always carts available.
The supermarket is always clean.
The food is good quality.  Everything is easy to find, and if it isn't the staff is always available to help and guide you in the right direction.
Today I noticed they have a lot of cashiers available so the wait is never long.  I walked up and was checked out immediately.
They have a good selection of beer.  A lot of craft beers available.  Sometimes the beer is even BOGO.

Simply put this is a barbershop destined for greatness. Came across Drew (the owner) through his Instagram page....@drewthebarber.. Sent him a comment if he was available and he was able to take me within the next hour. The shop is very nice, still in the works he says, but honestly looks great to me. The haircut was to my liking, he was very humble and I like that because some barbers act like they are too good for customers... Yet they wouldn't be shit without the customer. Just the few mins I did speak with Drew, I could say he's a cool dude and best of luck to you and your future endeavors. I'll definitely be coming to see this guy again

I made an appointment first online. They were supposed to call me back to confirm. They did not so I called back to schedule. I had a 4:30 appointment but was there early. The guy said there wasn't an appointment booked. And they were backed up and couldn't take me even though I had made an appointment. 
Sorry place... I would never return and wouldn't recommend anyone to go there.
Unreliable.... unprofessional... I was highly disappointed. I left work early to be told oh well sucks for you ( in other words).  I couldn't post without leaving a star but if could rate I'd say -5
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I was in the drive thru this afternoon 4/14/2018 around 3 pm. It took the staff about 25 minutes just to take my order. By the time I left the restaurant with my food it was about 3:50 pm. When I drove up to the window, the staff did not display any kind of urgency. I realize that help is currently hard to find. But it is plainly obvious management does not know how to schedule their current staff, or does not know how to motivate them. Lead by example. Not by punishment, Otherwise you will continue to receive similar revues.

My favorite overall spot for food, drinks, and atmosphere. I've been coming here for years and I'm constantly bringing new friends here. You can dress up and get fancy or come casual right from hopping around ybor bars. Great spot ! They do $3 martinis everyday until 7, and they are tasty ! They have an entire menu of different martinis you can try(mango is my fav). From 4-7 they have half off pastas and entree. You literally can get a filet meal with sides for $15!!!!!!! Servers and bartenders are always friendly and quick. I'm always impressed when I come here. I have to recommend the beef carpaccio appetizer !

Sadly disappointed. I really wanted to like this pizza, but it was way too oily for me.

When we got there we asked the waiter which one she recommended and she said the pepperoni is a must and then a few other pizzas. We got the pepperoni and carbonara. Both were super oily. I had to ask for napkins to soak up the oil because there was so much excess oil from the pizza. 

I don't know if all their pizzas are like that, but those two were. I should have gotten the margherita, so I could at least have some sort of comparison

So you copy and paste your previous lies that have nothing to do with my current post.  Goldie went to the bridge on 4/13 by her real vet, later you send an email birthday card in May which was inappropriate, and you just copy and paste your responses to my MANY complaints and the death of our two pets by incompetently by your practice, our Siamese cat on 3/21/21 then you misdiagnosed Goldie and we found out the truth 4/13 by her real vet and had her put to sleep?  Why do you keep copying and pasting your previous responses?  They are lies and to keep reading them is killing me.

Although not directly related to Publix their pharmacy needs to get it together.  So, you pick up you prescription and you are required to sign for it using their pen.  When I mentioned I didn't want to touch it I got no response.  So either sign or no prescription.  Nice!  Of course they had no sanitizer to use!!!  I'm no expert but I would assume if you were to catch this somewhere this would be the place, where a lot of people pick up their prescriptions.  How about a little peace of mind, at least, even if it does not work!

I frequent this location frequently as the building is connected to my office. I come here usually at least once a week and there's always a quite a few people here. They tend to run out of items frequently (sandwiches, strawberries for the refreshers, etc.). I always do the mobile order so that I don't have to wait as long. This is a clean facility and the staff is very friendly and willing to help. If you do order something they're out of via your phone, they provide you a gift card once you arrive which is very nice!

Went here with a big group of people for a friend's birthday recently. Typical sushi place in the CWE, due to this it is hard to find parking so keep that in mind before heading over.

Food was good, and they have great service, were very on top of refilling drinks etc. However, it didn't feel like the ac was working very well and it was fairly warm inside. 

Something to note is that they add the tip in automatically, however most of those of us in our group were unaware of this. I don't mind leaving a good tip, it just felt like they were hiding that fact and tricking you into tipping more.

No frills but just what we needed and at a great rate! Private beach, private pool and hot tub, small kitchenettes in each room, balconies (only some with a view), perfect view from the beach, awesome location right on Clearwater beach with lots of fun activities, good bars, and restaurants in walking distance. We'll be back!
Note: The new building next door is WAY too close, but that's not this place's fault. No view from one side of the hotel. Parking was really tight on 4th of July weekend! Glad we got there early.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I stopped in to Antonio's on a whim recently.  Luckily, it happened to be a Tuesday...Taco Tuesday!  I ordered the carne asada street tacos to go.  Service was very fast and friendly and I had my tacos in no time.  There were 3 small tacos in the order and they were perfect.  Well seasoned and just a bit spicy with fresh veggies and cilantro, these were just what I was looking for.  I'm not usually one for fast food, but this was good.  I'll definitely be stopping in again to check out some other items.  Or perhaps for another Taco Tuesday.

We picked up our car at another location and returned it to the St Pete airport.  Be aware that there is highway construction outside the airport and construction in the airport parking lot/rental car pickup and return area.  Returning the car meant following the usual signs plus dodging the orange cones and construction activities.  There is a small Budget sign that tells you to take your keys, mileage and gas tank reading to the desk inside the terminal.  There is no one in the lot to assist you.  A more prominent sign(s) would be an improvement.

Ichiban is my FAVORITE Japanese Restaurant here in Nashville. They have the Best Sushi, my favorite is the Dixieland roll, even their crunchy shrimp room is good. I ordered it for a friend that doesn't like to be too adventurous with sushi. I so always order the yellow tail fish neck & the soup, I forgot what's it's called but they know exactly what it is because I order it every time I go. Normally it's ramen noodles, but I like the udon noodles instead with pork and veggies. But I guarantee everything there is delicious and fresh. Oh and I love the grateful dead drink, it's a Long Island with chambord liqueur. It's strong, but good.

This is usually my go to hotel when I come to Philly; so it really hurts my heart to make this review, but it's starting to get real lax with some things especially the cleanliness..upon my initial inspection there was a pair a grown man socks on the side/behind the front dresser they have...not a good sign ...I could have excused that but I put the heat on because this weather is super bipolar and the smell of a weeks old mayonnaise sandwich, I've been sniffing the air in this room trying to identify exactly where the smell is coming from and I still can't identify it ..let's just say this went from being in the top 5 to the below 2
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I absolutely love the ambiance at Fresh Market! There's always some jazzy music playing. Walking through an entrance full of flowers & potted plants can brighten up a gloomy day. It's a great place to find gourmet & specialty items. Going to a party & need a gift? They have boxes of specialty chocolates or grab a bottle of wine on the second floor & a bouquet of flowers. The have a great selection and wine gift bags as well. They also have beautiful & exquisite special occasion cards. It's a great place to grab lunch & sit out on their patio. The only thing I don't like is the effect on my wallet. But as they say, you get what you pay for.

This is a solid Roma. We ordered delivery, were told it would be here in 45, it was 55, but that wasn't a big deal to us at rush hour in E Nashville. They got our order right, and the food was good, considering the price. (Hey, if you want Maggiano's, go to Maggiano's, right?) We ordered two lasagnas (only complaint is that there was a TON of marinara sauce to fill the foil to-go container- could have done without that) and a small cheese pizza. Lasagnas came with good salads- lots of veggies and cheese, not just lettuce. We also got cheesecake and chocolate cake, both of which were solid, again, for the price.

As many others have documented here, they offer good pricing but have major problems honoring their appointments. When you buy a set of tires you just don't expect to have to invest over two hours waiting for them to install and balance them and do the alignment. The fact is, when asked why scheduled appointments result in two hour or more waits, the service staff are not only unapologetic, they tell you that's how they do business. Having a manager log onto Yelp and try to deny this is how they operate just rubs salt in the wound. You folks OVERBOOK scheduled appointments, that's the root of the problem.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Illegal contract renewals and predatory practices.
The only way out of contract is through the Consumer Protection Bureau. Once you sign the initial contract, it goes to an external management company based in California (Paramount Acceptance)and from this point forward the Frencg Riviera has no control over the contract. Not only one is forced into paying in advanced for the two year contract, but once it is set to expire,
renewal is automatic despite express request for cancelation. 
This is a terrible way of doing business and my advice is to never ever sign a contract with this gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I've been an obsessive NOLA visitor (truly an aspiring New Orleanian) since 2006.  My bestie &  braved a VERY smelly Uber in order to have the infamous $0.25 martinis at the Commander's Place.    Unfortunately (or maybe fortunately),  shorts at a CP lunch are a big no no...   An adventure down Magazine Street lead us to a frozen Pim's Cup nirvana!  Jordan, our adorable bartender, was awesome!  After a couple of wedge salads, he created a couple of strawberry basil cocktails that were phenomenal!  Mixology lives on Magazine Street at Warbucks!

I'm a regular here whenever I'm in Santa Barbara! And I always check in to get the free steamed edamame. (:

My rainbow roll was adequate. Some of the salmon tasted fishy but nothing to complain about. 

Parking can be kind of tough if you come during peek hours for dinner. There's usually a spot behind the restaurant, but the lot is quite bumpy.

I enjoy being seated at the traditional Japanese tables because I like crossing my legs while I eat. However, it's not for everyone and there's a space to put your legs into underneath the table. 

Thanks for the great times, Ichiban!

Some of the most unhelpful people I have ever met! 
I don't understand how this planet fitness as gotten so unhelpful. Workout is someone we should all do every day however coming here is dreadful and it's takes a toll on a person working to be better. However it is the only place open at 4am so I am stuck here and to another gym opens up earlier or I moved to Philly! If you can go to a different gym please do! The one star is for the hours.. 
so because of this review the cops were called on me today. So please don't give them a bad review.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I wish I could give this place 5 stars. I thought it was going to be AMAZING based on how many people have told me about it. To be honest, I was impressed with the presentation of the sushi rolls, but the temperature of them kinda freaked me out. They were a little warmer than room temperature. I prefer sushi to be the right amount of cold, otherwise I worry about the temperature danger zone of fish. My guest loved it, so maybe it's just me. That's why I gave 4 stars vs anything lower. Will try some of the other locations.

Visited this on a weekend trip to Franklin. We originally planned to go to Chuys down the street, but it was a Saturday night and they were packed. Found this place searching Mexican restaurants on Yelp in the area. The reviews were great so we thought we would give it a try. There was no wait and the food was amazing. The only bad thing was the lack of speed and urgency from our server. We asked for our check quite a few times and still waited an unreasonably long amount of time for him to bring our check then still had to wait awhile for him to take and process it. At least the food was great which is what matters most.

Employees all wearing masks which is a big plus.  Donuts seemed smaller than normal, it's been awhile since we've been here.  Employee seemed a bit confused with our order of 4 donuts. Rang us up at the drive thru register, so had to keep walking back and forth from there to the counter where we were.  Even had to take my phone back to register to scan code, which I wasn't too keen about.  No clue why he was working the front counter but logged in on the drive thru register.  Made a check out of what should have taken 1 minute take about 5 minutes.

Absolutely great family vacation! The staff was very accommodating, friendly and professional. The concierge Damion was outstanding he was very helpful with things to do in the city. Damions personality was felt in the lobby each morning as he treated each quest individually always and with positive energy. Renovations were going on during our stay and it didn't bother us a bit. The burgundy bar was great as was the bartering ambiance was amazing. Our rooms very spacious and comfortable no noise so slept soundly. The breakfast was great as were the wait staff. We will definitely be back to stay..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Asaka's quality is always very good, and the atmosphere is cozy.  My friend from Japan recommended it to me, and it is now my go-to place for sushi. 
 
If you go between 5-7PM during happy hour, you can indulge for a very cheap price.  Although sometimes you can't get some of the fancier rolls on the happy hour menu, the basic rolls are still very good.  Miso soup is cheap.  You get discounts for cash payment too (never seen this before).

Now when I am craving sushi, especially nigiri, I love to go to Asaka!

Came in for a weekend, and this was the one fancy dining out we did.

Great vibe and great wine selection.

I was pretty underwhelmed by the Carbonara I got with the soft egg - wouldn't recommend. The guanciale pork which was allegedly in the dish was no where to be found. Tasted like a basic macaroni and cheese with corn thrown in. Unfortunately the Margherita pizza was nothing to write home about either. 

But I tried my friend's Black Spaghetti which was delicious! Also the Brussel Sprouts are MUST - especially great for sharing as they are a big portion.

Really love this bar as a hangout. Even did a Pinot's Palette event there and LOVED it!!!! Staff remembers your name and knows the beers (and wine!) on tap! Love the pool tables, the "jukebox", and the open mic nights. 

SO, why three stars??? The food! As the "Flying Pig" I'd expect a pork themed menu to rock my face off!!!

There's (sadly) been plenty of times we passed on coming because there isn't really good food options here. Especially with amazing food (BBQ, Mexican, burgers, sushi, and more) just down the road.

These reviews are not helpful!  Let's call it what it is, fast food.  After a long day of work I want to sit down and be served.  I'm standing at a counter ordering off a menu on the wall.  I can't get a glass of wine but I can grab a bottle  water out of the fridge on my way to the cashier.  This is not similar to downtown Indy sushi.

Crab Rangoon is really good!

I wish I knew it to be what it is so I could change into gym clothes before going. 

Not the place for a nice dinner out.  Paper plates made that really clear.

Fine for a quick bite but not a place for a nice dinner.

Lili's Fresh Authentic Mexican is a good option for tacos when you are in the Bryn Mawr, Pennsylvania area. The tacos are full of flavor and the portion size is good, as well. Prices are not horrible, but I thought they were a bit high. It might also be that living in Florida, I have gotten use to eating great tacos loaded with protein with a price point of like two or three dollars. Since this was my one Mexican dining experience here, I do not know if the prices are competitive. 

All in all, a good place to head to if you are looking for some good tacos.

A MUST GO TO LOCATION  Spirits On Bourbon had been our go to place during the adventures in the big easy. The staff specifically LA and Dan added to the already welcoming feel of atmosphere by being personable and attentive to our drink and food needs. My advise when looking for a well poured drink on Bourbon St. is the one and only Spirits on Bourbon. The entertainment is a plus as it will not disappoint with a large verity of music from the dueling pianos. This place really has it all covered and not only reasonably priced drinks and food.

I would give 0 stars but that is not an option. 

Best Food In Town- Clayton NJ was just horrible to my niece tonight. On Christmas of all nights. I ask all my friends in that area to boycott them until they apologize and have better service. 
She went to pay for her Christmas dinner for my mother and they claimed her card was declined. My niece had proof from her bank the money was taken from her account. 
They did not give her the food nor refund the money. 
Ridiculous to treat long time (years) customers or any person like this. Especially Christmas night. 
#Shame on Best Food in Town Clayton,NJ.

Stayed here for one night. Check in was at 4, there was a long line waiting to check in. The room was nice. Has a king size bed. It was comfy. Our view sucked but we didn't pay for a good view or anything. The showers water pressure was bad, and it didn't drain fast so you stood in a puddle of water. We ate at the steakhouse there and that was good. They have parking underneath but you have to pay for parking. It's $30 for overnight. The hotel is right across from the arch but that was under construction so a bummer. Then close to the stadium village. Overall it was alright.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Amazing food and fabulous fresh tortillas made right in front of you... but $1.50 for chips and salsa?!?! Eff you too!! Does Red Lobster charge for their delicious garlic butter biscuits? Does Olive Garden charge you for those delectable Andes Mints? Does Casa Molina charge for chips & salsa (and b-t-dubs they have an all you can eat brunch buffet on Sundays)??   NO!!   So, don't think you can get away with this $1.50 none sense. It's Tucson. I can get Mexican food at 50 other locations with free chips and salsa. Get over yourself. Bye Felicia

I called and scheduled my eye exam, as I was driving to Valuevision and before seeing the 1 star review for this store. The review made me concerned whether I had made a mistake.

Fortunately, I was pleasantly surprised! All of the employees that worked with me were friendly and very helpful. The doctor was personable and the man helped me locate the section of frames that I would most like and explained the different lenses. 

I haven't ordered my glasses yet, because they were closing before I decided which frames I wanted, but I will think things over tonight, and buy them tomorrow!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I brought my cat Gatsby in for emergency care when he appeared to be having difficulty breathing and walking. He ultimately was diagnosed with large cell lymphoma and has since passed. Dr Cai was extremely compassionate and informative in providing me with the diagnosis. Dr Taylor helped get my cat started on chemo and I am grateful that Gatsby had relief from his symptoms and a wonderful couple of weeks before his health again decompensated and he eventually passed on. The techs and office staff were extremely understanding and compassionate in allowing me to spend time with Gatsby even during covid.

The all you can eat special is the star of this restaurant. Came here for lunch with no reservation... big mistake seeing as though this is a popular place! There were people waiting inside and everywhere outside I waited about 30 minutes before being seated.

The atmosphere is very dark inside with nice decor and very loud. 

Only tried two sushi rolls, they were good, not the best but definitely good. But then again for the price they were amazing. I also ordered the shrimp hibachi with vegetables and rice and this was good too. 

The service at this establishment was very frenziedly and fast.

When in the area I will be back for the special.

Buyer beware! The hotel appeared to suffer structural damage to the flooring due to flooding. My wife substained mutiple injuries due to taking a fall from the extremely warped flooring, the end result was our trip being cut short due to injuries my wife substained at the hotel. We notified the hotel of the issue & nothing was done.
We spoke with the hotel representative named Kathleen Langle, who first responded back but after an email or 2 she's transformed to extremely unprofessional & has since ignored all means of contact. She has ignored all calls & emails.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The only reason I'm giving it 2 stars is because the manager went and tried to fix the problem after I complained. I have never had good service here but I assumed it was because I would get the economy. I keep a VERY clean car for a mom with two kids. I decided to get the ultimate today. For $22 my car still had pretzels all over the back seat and the back of the car was not wiped down. The manager did re-vacuum after I asked for my money back while the teenage kids working there rolled my eyes at me. I then had to park and wipe my own interior doors. Never going back.

I'm just putting this review about the new frosty cookie sundae. It's a new concept worth trying. Wendy has converted the original frosty into a special frosty with chunks of chocolate chip cookies with ghirardelli chocolate sause. Just looking at it makes my mouth water.  Well as soon as I heard the news, I went on it to try it out. Superb! Although as with any frosty, if you don't eat it fast, it will melt quickly. So try to order it and give yourself a minute or two to eat and enjoy. You can order either in vanilla or chocolate flavor. Either way you wont be disappointed. Great concept idea from Wendy's.

Disclaimer - I haven't been to the eye doctor in 10+ years. But my exam experience went well. Saw a doctor who was nice and explained my results. I was told how much my insurance would cover for frames and all glasses had prices on them. It was an easy process that took about an hour. There is a backup on making frames so what usually could be done in an hour is taking about a day 1/2. No issues for me since I'm not desperate to get the glasses. The people were nice and thankfully my insurance covered a lot of their frames.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Gorgeous new location! It's very trendy and looks unlike all other locations in Nashville. The store is still very new so they may have a few kinks to work out, so I can overlook a few mishaps (extra wait time and not adding almond milk to my coffee...definitely not the end of the world!). They have a cooler for a greater variety of cold to-go food options. It's an odd layout because the front of the store is the drive-thru ordering station so the windows are on the back of the building. Give it a try if you're in the area!

I have to keep the review at 4 stars because something was forgotten again. This time they forgot to put the sweet and sour chilli sauce on the Flamenco roll. The sauce was the main reason we ordered this roll and it tasted on the drier side without it. 

Once again I am very pleased with the taste of the food. Amazing flavors, fresh fish, and great size!! I love the variety of options and especially the pictures accompanying the sushi on the menu.

Next time we will dine in so hopefully any mistakes can be prevented.

BYOB, I hit up the Pennsport Beer Boutique across the street for beer on both of my visits.  
Small and intimate place.  Been here twice and the lunch crowd was very small.

The brick oven pizza is what you come for in my opinion.  I ordered the Portobello Pizza in a personal size.  Fresh Plum Tomato, Portobello mushrooms, Roasted Garlic, Rosemary & Mozzarella.  
A bit pricey and the pizza could have cooked slightly longer, but it was crispy, charred well on the bottom and the cheese was very flavorful.  

The service was prompt and friendly.  I'd come again if I was in the area and ask for the pizza well done.

I stopped in here for lunch on a weekday and had a lunch combo. For $9.45 I got a 7 inch personal size pizza and a side salad, which was quite good. The pizza had a lot of cheese on it and it was served pan dish style, so the crust was quite thick. The salad was also very nice, as it had lots of mozzarella cheese on it. There is both inside and outside seating, but I must say the interior of this place is in great need of a face lift, as it is actually sort of dingy inside. Don't be fooled by the decor, however, the food is quite good.

I came here for what was supposed to be a quick lunch with my dad before work, but it wasn't as expected. They forgot to wipe some parts of our table down, so it was a bit gross. We kept our orders minimal: some sashimi and vegetable rolls, yet they came so slowly. They forgot our two pieces of tuna nigiri. Our sushi rice was warm and unpleasant and the fish didn't taste fresh.

It took 30 minutes after we finished our meal for the check process and I had to cut off early to go to work and my dad stayed by himself and had told me he had waited a while after I left to get his card back. Not impressed.

Bernini's is my go to Saturday Happy Hour spot! They have $3 martinis with different flavors. My favorite is the sweet peach appletini! On Saturdays after 4 I believe, the entrees and pasta are half off. I highly recommend the Crispy Duck! It comes with mashed potatoes with a brown gravy. Really good! I have also had the Atlantic Salmon and Pistachio Grouper. I felt both of these dishes could have used more flavor and seasoning. They also have a lot of pasta dishes as well.

If weather permits I recommend getting a table outside. It's nice to enjoy the sites and sounds of Ybor as you eat... for the most part. You get dinner and entertainment

Came on Valentine's Day. Not busy which was good. Seated right away and then waited and waited and waited some more. Chips and salsa showed up but no drinks or waiter yet. Continued waiting and finally the waiter showed up. I ordered the El Paso burrito and a margarita. Salsa was spicy and decent. Margarita was ok. Food took approximately forever to show up (on a non busy day) which obviously is a concern. When the burrito showed up it was "Yuge" in the Donald  Trump sense lol!! It was also tasty. So while they were slow the food was muy Bueno.

This branch has been closed for at least a week. I do not know exactly when it closed because there were no notices sent out. My safe deposit box is located at this branch. I have tried repeatedly to contact this branch, or anyone at Bank of America to ask when the branch would be opened and/or how can I access my safe deposit box. No one will respond to my inquiries. How can a bank prevent customers from accessing their safe deposit boxes? This seems like a serious breach of the banks fiduciary responsibility.

Great experience here. Came to eat with a friend, both of us had never eaten here before.. we sat at the bar and were greeted right away, got our drinks within a couple minutes of being inside! Hard to decide what to order, the whole menu sounded so good. Ended up with the shredded pork burrito combo plate. The food was made all fresh and only took around 10 minutes which was great. The owner (really nice lady) served our food and gave us 3 salsas and explained each one! How great usually they just leave them but she went into detail. The burrito was huge, though I finished it! Great family owned place! Highly recommend

Decided to try this place out tonight after dropping off a cheesecake order. I was surprised at the speed that our food came out and that's when the wheels fell off. The onion soup and small salad was good. I had the NY steak and shrimp and my Karla had the filet and chicken. My steak was a little over cooked and tough. Shrimp was good. The chicken sauce was good but the chicken was dry. Wife's filet wasn't very tender either. The biggest disappointment of the night was the yum yum sauce. It tasted like ketchup and Mayo mixed and tasted funny. Definitely not what other Japanese restaurants serve. Will not be returning.

Love this local bar usually filled with regulars and one bartender/cook. Every time I have been in Dolly has waited on us and she's always so nice and attentive. I'm pretty sure people have no idea this place offers one of the best no fuss burgers in Broad Ripple / SoBro. You can tell it's a fresh patty and cooked to perfection. Some people may complain it's cash only but they are super upfront about it so deal with it! Also it's a great place on a nice day to sit outside and enjoy a beer. Do yourself a favor and accept the glass they offer with a bottle or can of beer it's a small little glass that adds to the experience.

This was terrible.  The service was appalling.  Felt like we were being given the bum rush all night.  Never asked us if we wanted cocktail.  Hadbto beg to get a glass of wine.  I had the seafood and pasta which was terrible.  Who serves seafood with an angle hair.  It ended up being a ball of dough with seafood around it.  My husband had the veal saltimbocca. It was a boiled piece of meat covered in fake cheese.  My son had the tiniest piece of lasagna I have ever seen.  This meal was so disappointing.  I dont ever remember being so underwhelmed by an Italian restaurant.

i came to the car wash this afternoon to get my car cleaned obviously and i asked them will the windows be wiped out inside and out ?yes...and a full vacuum. great well my car is done in less then 10 minutes even better but the kicker is i open my door there is still dirt all on the floor like a half way job on vacuuming. Then on my back windows which i specifically asked to have cleaned because i have kids and there are fingerprints they are still full of finger prints!! ugh and i go to turn around and say something theyve already pulled another car up and sent me on my way!!! ugh what a waste of money!!! never again. CRAP!

We got a one night weekend stay for $69, so we were satisfied considering the price. We did check in around 10 PM, and left the next day at 11 AM, so it was just a place to sleep and shower. 

The room was clean. There was shampoo and conditioner, but no lotion which would have been nice. 

Free breakfast was pretty basic: a waffle maker, bread, bagels, cereal, scrambled eggs, yogurt, orange juice, apple juice, and coffee. Not extraordinary, but I wouldn't say no to a free waffle! 

I'd stay again for this price if I return to Tucson in the future.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have to honestly say that I have tried every nail shop within a 5 mile radius of this shop, and they by far beat hire competitors on all levels. They make sure to great you and put you in a seat at least 5 minutes from you walking. The work they do is outstanding. They pay very close to details, and won't let you leave unless you are completely happy. The only reason I didn't give them a 5 was because they don't carry the line of gel color I Love by CND. If they got the line, I'd have no reason to go elsewhere! I still undoubtedly recommend them over all the shops in the continental ranch stretch!

It was just OK. I had pizza and it was good, my mom had linguine with clams which she enjoyed. My sister didn't love the chicken parm. The service was ok. Our server, Alex was a young kid who was sweet but my biggest pet peeve is auctioning off food. There aren't that many tables in the restaurant so you should use seat numbers and know what your guests ordered. He kept making jokes and was trying to be funny but we weren't the right audience. I would return but again it's just OK food and service is OK. Nothing special

Love taking Sunday walks to grab a delicious coffee from ReAnimator Coffee. It is an adorable coffee shop with great staff. Very well trained, knowledgeable, and efficient. However, if you are in a rush this may not be the place for you. I highly recommend this coffee shop for individuals who want to do work for a bit, meet up with friends, or like taking the time to enjoy the art of coffee. It is pricy as well- for an iced vanilla latte and a chocolate mocha (small) I paid $11.20. It's definitely not your everyday coffee shop, but it's one of the best coffees I had. Treat yourself!

This is my absolutely favorite lunch spot. I only go out for lunch about 1-2x a month and this is always my go to! I highly recommend the Mexique pizza- Delish! It's best if you can eat the pizza somewhere else because during lunch time it can get packed and there are only long bar-like tables. 

Prices are very reasonable for the size of the pizza. I usually am able to eat half the pizza before I call it a day and save the other half for the next day for lunch. 

Staff is very friendly and help you out when it's your first time. 

Once you get your order in the wait is about 5-7 minutes so relatively very quick for a fresh pizza.

Coffee was good. The people were nice. I asked for a water with my order and they only have bottled. I was just annoyed they don't provide water to paying customers. The coffee I bought was a luxury, water shouldn't be. I always get a water with my coffee, so I won't be going there. Probably a small issue to most and I'm sure they won't miss my money, seeing as it's in a middle/upper class white area. You know it's not because they can't afford to offer water. They're just taking advantage of their demographic.

Great food. I live closer to a vegan diet and they are always happy to accommodate and offer vegan option. Great service. I saw the review about the awkwardness of the servers and honestly can see what they mean to an extent. The servers by no means are off putting or uncomfortable, however. They all seem very happy to be there and to offer you a great experience. They have a great wine selection and you can tell they care about the knowledge of the wine. I'm not about all the wine talk, but I appreciate when restaurants care about what they offer. Great restaurant. You can't wrong with Asiagos.

Ehh not so great. In Cali we have a grilled cheese food-truck  "Grilled Cheese Bandit's, that is amazing and they use Texas Toast. So I guess my thoughts were a little too high for it. I ordered the quesabirria melt $12, Grilled cheese w provolone/white cheddar $7.60, and grilled cheese w American cheese $6.60. It was just basic grill4d cheese sandwich you can make at home for the cheese ones, definitely not worth $7, was super flat. The quesabirria was yummy, very spicy, but pricey for what we got. Oh and by the way, don't order via Uber Eats because our driver didn't even let us know he delivered our order. (No not dinging company for this).

Called yesterday for an oil change at the Maplewood . Mo. store. Was told it would be in within two hours .Ask to br taken to a restaurant about four miles away for lunch. After eating I called for a ride back and was told they weren't going to be able to bring me back  Right I was stranded. Five and 1/2 hours later and a $25 Uber ride later, had my vehicle. When I got to the store I was told that it was common knowldge that free shuttles were "one way". It is easy to see why this entire chain is rated so low. Avoid these people (especially in Maplewood) at all costs. Telle Tire has free courtesy shuttles to AND  from.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The two stars are only because the staff is incredibly nice. Everyone prior comments on the free coffee, and yes there is definitely free coffee. Its 2019, so most hotels typically offer that, along with water in the lobby. As a frequent Sheraton patron (weekly), this location is not one I will ever return to. The rooms are old, and not clean. My bed has a mattress so worn, there's indentations you will inevitably roll into despite all efforts to avoid. The remote had white, crusty film on it. While a convenient location, not worth it if you can't even set foot in the shower.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been missing the Dunkin'-on-every-corner convenience of Boston, so I stopped into this location on a Saturday morning on my way to pick up a bike from a Facebook Marketplace listing.  I got an order or bagel bites and snackin' bacon and a large iced coffee.   The girl at the drive-thru was nice.  My bagel bites were delicious and my coffee was on point.  The Snackin' Bacon was amazing and the little paper bag they come in was packed full. Sweet and salty and bacon-y.   Made my morning just that much better!

I wanted to write again since I just got back from having a quick dinner and drinks this evening with my girlfriend and wanted to make people aware...  

Food was great as always and the drinks were great also.  Tuesday is $4 burger special...however they charge you for EVERYTHING you want on it....no exaggeration..$.25 for pickle, $.25 for lettuce, $.25 for onion, $.25 for mayo....I even got charged for my mustard and onion on my hotdog.  Seriously.  

I can understand charging extra for cheese since it clearly said "hamburger special", but the level of nickel and diming here was crazy.   This really soured my experience.

Stopped by on a Friday night to try this small place tucked into the corner of a small shopping center near West Napoleon and Transcontinental in Metairie. This place is located next to the Coaches Corner bar. We ordered a small meat lovers pizza and gyro special wrap. The pizza was fresh baked and was average in taste with the right proportions of toppings evenly distributed amongst the pie. The gyro was really good. The staff's attitude was respectful, but lukewarm given that we were the only dine-in customers in the restaurant at the time. Maybe the staff was tired but they didn't seem to focus on customer service.

Honestly, if you are reading reviews and expecting to make a rational decision about where to grab a good sandwich about Subway, you probably deserve to eat Subway. Reno has some GREAT sandwich shops like Beach Hut Deli or Full Belly Deli. Port o subs is much better quality and actually originated in Sparks!! Subway is the McDonalds of sandwiches. It's the truth. Right now there are more Subway restaurants than McDonald restaurants in the United States. You know what you're gonna get. The meat to bread ratio is all wrong. 

Now I'm really craving Beach Hut Deli

This Safeway is okay but there are a few things that they can improve on. One of those things that can be improved on is having more registers open during their peak hours. The second thing they could improve on is their Bakery department never seems to have alot of their baked goods no matter what time you get there. So you just have to hope they'll have what you need. As for their Deli and Meat department they are very well stocked with their items and always very fresh. The people in both of these departments are wonderful and respectful and knowledgeable people.

This hotel wasn't the best for me. I got it for a great deal, but the rooms were very cold. The bathrooms are very small, but the rooms are large. (Very weird). It felt geared more towards the business crowd, than leisure purposes. I did enjoy the location. It's perfectly placed in the middle of everything. Shops galore, restaurants, it's easy to catch an Uber here at anytime due to the location right in the heart of downtown. They also have bottles of water that you can refill, which was great and complimentary. I wouldn't stay here again. Simply because the lack of amenities weren't my thing.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've decided to stop by here since it was the only place I saw by City Hall and glimpsed "McDonald's" in the distance. The restaurant looks extremely outdated, like it's stuck in the 1960's. It needs a major renovation and revamp. It didn't look very clean either, as some tables still had food left, napkins, etc. There were a lot of homeless and sketchy people here, hogging up the soda fountain. The best part was the cashier, she was extremely sweet and had a smile on. The burgers were made right, everything was good. Wifi worked fine as well.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Where is Ray Croc when you need him. I read that this McDonalds location will be getting a remodel soon. But why spend the money!  Visited tonight at 6:30 pm and could not believe how filthy this restaurant is. We all just waited and waited for someone to take our order. Also every table was dirty, trash on the floors and the bums drinking cans of beer hanging out inside.  If Ray Croc was alive the franchise would be take away. This place is now competing with all of the rundown Burger Kings  in the area. What a disappointment. Don't waste your money remodeling. Just close and sell the building.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I am not sure how we lived in Santa Barbara for some long without going to sun sushi. This review is for take-out during the pandemic which we have done multiple times. We have always called it in but they also have online ordering. They typically have it ready within 30 minutes. We love to get the salmon and yellowtail sushi as well as rolls such as the Mexican roll, eel avocado roll, and state street roll. Picking up the food is easy and the staff are following covid19 precautions. We always look forward to sushi night!

This is a classic place to go for a custard. Not only are all of the concretes and sundaes really good, the location and vibe both make it a memorable place. There is a nice outdoor seating area with overhead string lights and it's  a fun place to go on a nice summer evening. We go almost every week and just relax while eating the amazing custard. The employees are all friendly high schoolers who do a great job. There are tons of choices with a handful of favorites including gator bait! If you're looking for a small town nostalgic type of ice cream joint then this is your place!

With all the hype around the birria tacos , I had to try some. I wasn't aware that this place even existed until I drove past it one day and saw a sign. 
So I hopped on the chance. Unfortunately the whole menu isn't online so I had to call and ask if they had them, which they did. 6 tacos and 2 consumes were $21.50 which isn't too terrible. I opted for three fried and three regular. I would highly suggest the fried taco, especially when dipping in your consume. It holds way better and doesn't get soggy. 

The meat was tender and the broth rich. I would definitely order again.

I made the mistake of taking my mother to this restaurant for her 92nd birthday some years ago.The restaurant was crowded and VERY Noisy,  I had my service dog with me she was licensed and tagged and was under the table SILENT. The owners wife totally freaked out when she saw the dog dogwhicj  was not disturbing anybody!  the Damn owner's wife caused more of a disturbance in the dog did!  WeAll then left... iI'll be some years again before I ever go back! Fortunately Now they're closed, hopefully will remain closed forever... over and out!!

Hello, I'm a Starbucks addict. I'm 9 hours un-caffeinated. The last time I drank coffee was at a Starbucks on Eagle Road. The service there was great and I enjoyed my large iced coffee with vanilla. I was there with my friend Parker, he got an orange juice of the Naked variety. There was seating inside and outside. There was plenty of parking. I know my Starbucks addiction costs me about 3 bucks a day, and I understand how it shames my nonexistent children. Thank you for listening, and keep fighting the good fight.

I really enjoyed this place. The ambience was fun and casual. They had live "chill" music which added nicely to the atmosphere. The food was exceptional. I had the Mother Clucker sandwich. This sandwich exploded with flavor and freshness along with a side of their super slaw which was both tangy and sweet - very unique and thoroughly enjoyable. Unfortunately, they were very lean on the draft beer offerings mainly having the usual macro brew swill and only three local drafts of which they were out of one of them. Would recommend that they add more local craft drafts to their offering.

The real Shogun should be ashamed. I get that it's suppose to be 'fast food' which it was ready fast, it shouldn't be advertised as hibachi. The veggies were frozen steamed veggie and could not have touched any part of the grill. The rice was incredibly dry, as was the meat. I'm not sure what they were going for but it was not hibachi. Period. I will not be going back. I could've gotten better, cheaper elsewhere. 

The picture was my meal. 

This was after I doused it in soy sauce to not choke on it because it was so dry. The steak doesn't even look like steak. It looks like the steak you get in frozen dinners. Horrible. Do not eat here

Brought my kids down to John's Pass the Sunday after Christmas and we were looking for a quick bite to eat and stopped in to Pirates Pub and Grub and just happened to be able to get a seat right away.  This is a small place and we happened to time this just right as it filled up pretty quickly while we were there.  The place is small and nothing fancy but the food was good and our server was great.  I had a burger that was very tasty good size, my one daughter had chicken tenders and my other daughter has a calamari basket.  The only downside was that fries with the burger were a $2 up charge and the portion was very small.

Just got home from an excellent dinner at Nunzio's with the wife. She ordered the tuna carpaccio with capers and arugula, it was very good. I got the buffalo mozzarella with prosciutto and tomato and it was out of this world. For entrees the wife had the branzino special. It came with crab meat and shrimp and mashed sweet potato. She said it was excellent. I had the veal sausage and broccoli rabe over orecchiette, and it was fabulous. Haven't been there for years but it was always good back then and can't wait to go back for more!!

text: My husband and I stopped in here for a quick lunch. The restaurant has a nice Mexican decor. You get chips and salsa on the house. They were tasty. My husband had the steak and chicken tacos. I had quesadillas. The food was good. The best part of the meal was the guacamole. It was so fresh and one of the best guac's I've tasted. The restaurant has great happy hour specials. At first we shared a house wine. It wasn't to my liking so, the hubby took my glass and I ordered a margarita with a Grand Marnier float. It was heaven! The place is great! We'll be back for sure.

Went in craving some delicious ice cream full of cookie chunks and creamy ice cream, but ended up getting a poorly mixed scoop of ice cream. My toppings were really just set in the center with ice cream folded over. Chunks of cookie dough were not crushed and mixed in at all, and the dough tasted freezer burnt. And the spoon they provided was cheap and practically broke when trying to gather a bite of ice cream. Maybe provide customers with decent spoons if you are not going to even mix the mix-ins. I won't be back, only cold stone from now on.

I come to this  McDonald's occasionally and they mess up my order 4 out of 5 times. I always get happy meals for my kids and they're always either forgetting the sauces or giving me a wrong side. It's really not that complicated! During my last visit I decided to walk in and order instead so I can check everything before I leave,  and I was treated with very rude customer service!
