I think during the whole encounter the lady only said 4 words to me, which was telling me how much the order was!No hi, no thank you, but after reading all these other reviews I guess I should be glad at least I wasn't cursed at.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: So, the night staff was very friendly, morning not so much. I asked her about the Breakfast and she had no idea what I was talking about. I mentioned that there were hairs in my shower and it was disgustingly dirty and she acted like I was a martian.  The breakfast doesn't specify that you are paying $12 for one. The poor lady doing the Breakfast, Saturday, alone was running around like a mad woman, trying to do everything. The food is less than mediocre, save your money for a good food experience. Clean the rooms up. We ran the fan all night to keep the noise at a minimum, it's a very noisy place. You could do much better. Disappointed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
HORRIBLE PLACE !!!!!
i sat in the drive thru for 25 minutes while they took 8 cars in the second line before i finally got so upset i pulled to the window to speak to the manager and all he said was that he just came in duty . It was freaking 9:45 a.m. what time did this idiot start his shift? No apologies or even a " f-off". He just stood there and looked at me with an ignorant look in his face. It really doesn't help to complain to the management. They consistently get the orders wring and just don't care. We need to find out who owns the damn place and hold THEM accountble.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I know that people are tired of hearing that they should go to Jeni's but there's a reason everyone says that you need to go. First off, the service is just wonderful. My husband and I both worked at ice cream places in high school/college and know that the job is tiring and not always the most fun. The staff at Jeni's is ALWAYS kind, welcoming and very knowledgable about the flavors. 

Plus- the ice cream is just stellar. They have lots of great staple flavors but always have fun and unique seasonal options too.

How do I start this posting, there are so many things I can say about Yen Chings. 
We have been eating here since it 1st opened over 32 years ago. It is the most authentic Chinese Food one can find in Indianapolis. I have eaten every Beef, Pork Seafood and a couple Chicken (I don;t like chicken) on the menu.

A must have each trip is Hot Sour Soup -= Pot Stickers -

Then the hard part is deciding which entree - Hot Braised Pork or Shrimp - Yusang Beef or Port or Shrimp, maybe House Shrip with 3 dollar shrimp added. 

Can't go wrong with any of them. 
If you are looking for ambiance, Yen Chings is not it. It is clean and Excellent food.

Great sushi choices, fair pricing, and a parking lot!

My first impression of sushi circle will definitely be bringing me back. The owners were very sweet and attentive and the small intimate setting felt just right. 

The sushi itself was good! I don't eat fish (so take this review maybe with a grain of salt??), so I ordered the veggie combo roll and have no complaints. 

My boyfriend (loves sushi) really enjoyed their Philadelphia roll and salmon roll. The smoked salmon in the philly roll was all sorts of perfect (even I braved it to sample it). 

Check them out when you're in the neighborhood!

Ran out of food on Father's Day and still stayed open.. they had maybe 4 dishes to choose from and one or two sides. Awful management. What restaurant doesn't order extra food when there's a holiday during that week? And why would you stay open only to make people mad? Several tables stormed out after hearing about the lack of food. Manager tried making excuses about how they don't get shipments until Monday which was the very next day.  and the one time we went and actually could get food, it was dry and bland.. will never be returning. My tastebuds and stomach deserve better.

If I could give 0 stars I would. The entire complex was without water for a week. I called and emailed the office over the span of 5 days before I received a return email, stating their "plan" for our water outage. I heard what happened with the water on the news before the leasing office got back to me. I asked them if they would reduce our water bill for last month, as we only got three weeks of water. They emailed me and said they provided everything necessary during this "project." They also said they kept everyone updated the whole time, which is not true. Then they proceeded to tell me the the rent was due immediately and in full.

The only reason I'd give this store any stars is because once in a while (in the afternoon) there are a group of really efficient kind woman and girls who are quick, other than that, this McDonald's is a bummer. A lot of the time you will wait for more than 10 mins to just order at the drive through. If you go in and order, you get ignored. There are a couple of workers who are very kind but as a whole this store is upsetting. 

Just to further my point, I came to this McDonald's to cure a hangover in the afternoon, and the team there was so quick, fun, and friendly. They are a five star team.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very cozy, byob, cash only Italian joint. Food here is good, service excellent! It's a small place, and very intimate atmosphere. Because of its coziness and authentic Italian food, this spot is very romantic. My favorite dishes are the lamb (they only have it sometimes as a special), and linguine frutti di mare. My husband has tried their lobster ravioli and tilapia special which he also likes. Their desserts are good, but not great. Love the service here! The servers are very attentive. The manager, hostess, and entire staff make you feel welcomed.

I order here frequently, and the service and food is usually great; although unfortunately I came in tonight around 930, ordered two pizzas, one of which was their new pretzel crust pizza. I should have checked the box I guess, because the pepperoni I ordered was cut unevenly, and pretty dried out, which wasn't so bad, but the pretzel crust pizza had almost nothing on it. The toppings and sauce looked like they were just tossed in the middle and cooked. I try not to complain, because I love their pizza, but I was super bummed when I got home to feed everyone.

This is probably worst hotel I've ever stayed in. We were put in room 201 right above the office where some contractors were doing roofing and left finally with a mess in walkways. The bathroom had a broken towel rack and the tub could fit a child only. There was no phone and we had to go to the clerk downstairs to get ice and a blow-dryer and even towels, which she was not in the office half the time. The WiFi was not working and the person who came to fix it had to call the main supervisor who told her to look in the laundry room where they found her. Comfortable bed and clean was only redeeming quality.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Came here during lunch, and it was quite busy for a weekday. We were seated immediately. Service was good and minded their own business, didn't interrupt with the whole "how's everything going" during a conversation. The buffet price seems reasonable, but there are many limits on what you can order. Tuna - 1 per person, Banzai roll - 1 per person, eel - 1 per person. You would think at the price they would just let you get what you want. The food was pretty good, but the $5 "leave your food on the plate" charge seems sketchy and stinks of cheap. I might come back here if anyone else wants to go, but not on my own accord.

Hotel is clean and staff is friendly. Two big issues that we came across. One, $40/day to park your car valet, and no there are no other options. So that sucked and was unplanned expense. Two, there is no pool... They said we had access to the hotel next door but it's an exercise pool not a pool for kids. That hotel doesn't even recommend it for their guests for swimming, they send their guests to the hotel next to them... Oh and it's $10 per person to use the pool. None of this advertised on their website or told on the phone. The hotel is hard to access if you drive every where too so we walked everywhere which is nice to do.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The entire resort property is gorgeous, except for one glaring defect: the pool area. Literally, it was rusted over in patches all over the pool. It looked like a tetanus hazard. Additionally, the pool is quite tiny. Probably smaller than many community pools in Southern California (where we live). The jacuzzi bubbles have a 60 second delay for turning on so you think it's broken until they randomly decide to turn on. 3 stars because the hotel returned my resort fee when I complained. Also, they admitted the pool is being redone this year, so they know it's not in the best condition currently.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I ordered a hand grenade in a cup and I must say that it was great way to end my trip in New Orleans. The drink itself tasted like a mango heavy with alcohol and is definitely not something a rookie drinker would want to experience unless they want to wake up the next day not knowing where they are or seriously hurt. The facility was really nice and had a balcony with patio tables where you could relax while looking down at the crowd walking down Bourbon Street. There's also a band downstairs playing all sorts of music so it's definitely a must check!

Great pizza! Always have been nice people working the counter. This pizza is one of the things I miss after moving away from St. Louis. We visit here almost every time we are in town. I'd highly recommend it for the food. The only bad thing and reason for loosing a star is the eat in area reminds me of a school cafeteria. But hey. It's an eat in area. The other one in this area doesn't have one. There is a tv and usually only a family or two in here eating so that's nice. If you are in town and hungry for pizza don't pass this place up!

This gym is pretty good the price can be a little high but its still lower than the other 24/7 gyms. The only thing I would recommend is to go to the gym in the morning and avoid going after 6pm or after work. I did and couldn't help but notice only 3 people in there. Once I got off the treadmill and rested a bit one of the guys talking to his 'friend' pointed at me and jester to his friend while saying out loud. "See that girl?" This made me felt so uncomfortable and I decided to head home and do some sit ups at home.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
My car was backed into over the Christmas holidays and took it in to be repaired.  Enterprise came right to the dealership and picked me up and even helped me get two car seats out of my car and into the rental care.  

I was impressed by everyone working on Monday, January 8th.  The insurance company I was working with didn't use Enterprise so I had to put the rental on my card.  They were very helpful with getting me all the paperwork I needed to summit my paperwork to the insurance company.  

Kudo's to all the guys at Enterprise Rent A Car on Lafayette Road.

Tending away from Eggs bene or an omelette, I decided to go with three scrambled eggs, home fries, bacon with rye toast and coffee. The eggs were done very nicely, in other words, not runny and not rubbery. There was an ample supply of home fries that were good but not great (no real additional flavors included like several places add). The rye toast had just the right amount of butter to add nice flavor. The bacon was wonderful and the coffee (and water) were kept filled with very good service. A 4 rating overall and worth ordering again.

The staff here is very welcoming.. The food was okay.. if you are looking for authentic Mexican food I don't recommend coming here. The mango chicken salad needed more mango and jicama in it. The fajitas where okay beans didn't have much of flavor.. the guacamole dip was just avocados with cilantro. No flavor. It was missing the onion the tomato the lime juice the salt. The only thing I liked about coming here was the services. Our server was great. On top of it all food was way over priced for the quality of the food.. I can't believe the avocado dip was $7 bucks I can buy everything I need to make homemade guacamole for $7 bucks.

Lately I have expirance not so good customer service. So it's my 1st time renting from this location and when I picked up the car was great customer service was ok. 
So today I called to let them know that I might be returning the car the following day maybe after hours from my original day.  So the customer rep for this location changed his attitude from friendly to upset and he pretty much hang up on me. Than he calls back and tells me that he had to charge my account 139$ dollars more to keep the car or I need to return it A.S.A.P I am not even in the same city I rented the car from. Not very happy about how the situation was handle.

A completely Mind blowing and out of body experience. We had not truly dined until eating here. Their waiter is a sommelier who paired wine/sake with every course, and every course was better than the last. Easily one of the greatest restaurants in the city, and easily a contender if not the best Japanese restaurant in the Midwest. The service was outstanding - the owner greeted us as we walked in and when we left. My wife had her coat draped over her shoulders and was approached to let us know they were turning the temperature up. I can't say more about the hospitality and attentiveness we experienced here.

My search for the best pizza in the area ...continues. Not the worst but not the best. The pizza is a thicker crust than I was expecting (for reference, not quite as thick as Pizza Hut's pan pizza but definitely on the thicker side).
I asked for my pepperoni to be placed on top of the other toppings so it could crisp up because seriously, that's the only way to enjoy pepperoni. They obliged and put it on top but it was definitely not crisp. I ordered carry out and it was ready a few minutes early and the staff was nice but unfortunately this will not become my go-to pizza place.

I love this gym. It has the equipment I need, in a very clean spacious atmosphere. I love the hydromassage chairs, the nice locker room, and circuit areas. I would recommend this gym to any beginner or intermediate exerciser. This may not be the right gym for the very advanced member, however it's perfect if you are looking for a place to workout several times a week. The staff is very polite and helpful.

Quick update- The new trainer, Heather, at this location is wonderful. She is very knowledgeable, and worked with my mobility issues to create a beginning workout.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Can ya give a negative star? This place has serious health issues, and lady's put toilet paper on the seat before you use it. And for "real" pool shooters the tables aren't level so don't bet on your shot!! If you use house darts 90% have bent heads so best bet is to bring your own. But most importantly if you're a mix drinker, look closely at you glass and contents as you may get some not so wanted added ingredient(s). But what's a hair, or dirty glass among drunks right?!  Seriously this place needs a visit from health boars

Located close to my house so it is convenient for me to grab essential ingredients. I usually don't shop here though bc the produce isn't as fresh as other local markets. 

Lots of workers and checkout lines. I don't remember the last time that I wasn't the next person in line. 

However I think this place could use some renovations. Not only does it LOOK old on the outside, but it also FEELS old on the inside. But hey maybe they're just trying to preserve the history of this place.. It IS one of the oldest markets in the city after all

Cashiers have been welcoming. Always greeted with a hello and smile. They've been helpful when ordering, suggesting less expensive options that offer the same amount or more food. However the place inside just feels- dirty? Everything feels so outdated. And there's hardly anybody in here, ever, which makes me wonder if they clean the tables and floors if not many people come. It's sad because I used to love Burger King. But why is it $10 for 2 whoppers? Make those whopper juniors then please..... To go. Stay on the lookout for 2 for $5 or take your pick deals. Otherwise the sandwiches are not worth the price

My husband had a minor auto accident with an employee of this bank.  We asked them to get an estimate for a SMALL scratch on the front of their car.  They had prior damage to the front of their car and tried to get the body shop to add it to the estimate.  For a small thumbnail sized scratch, they tried to extort over $4,000 from us.  The body shop broke out the estimate into two parts because of the prior damage.  Luckily the body shop refused to lump it into one repair.  Our insurance agent is investigating this and will only pay them for the damage my hubby did to the car.  Awful Opportunist Greedy person!

Review for Sushi only. Purchased a raw sushi roll that was supposedly made that day. Consumed it within 10 min of leaving the store. Rice seemed old. It was kept at the right temp in the case though, so that's good. There was no Low Sodium Soy Sauce available in the bin. I got there kind of later in the day 4:30p and there weren't as many non-mayo choices. I hate Mayo in Sushi! It was ok for a quick bite. I thought $7.99 for the roll was a bit high. They get bonus points for selling cold Powerade Zero though. My personal go to drink.

Did you know they now have curbside pick up?! I had a grocery pick up at a competitor and they had more than several items that were out of stock that I needed that evening for my dinner! I placed a curbside pick up with Publix and by the time I drove the 1.5 miles to Publix the employee was standing in the parking lot waiting for me! 
WOW!! And I had an order of at least 15 items AND they were messaging me about a couple of items they had questions on and were STILL waiting on me! 
Their prices might be a little higher, but their customer service and actually having products in stock sure makes up for it!

This place is awful! Their stoves are dirty and need to be replaced. Their menu is overpriced. Oddly enough they refuse to substitute their noodles that come for hibachi with rice.  They even have a policy that they will not under any circumstances substitute noodles for rice. Any restaurant you go to they can substitute anything you want. These ppl want to charge you 3 dollars for fried rice as a side. Our first time we went our waiter was very hostile we decided to go back after awhile thinking it was that one waiter but no they are all like that. This place is overrated. Go to To-Kai instead

Fountain Porter's alright. It's never really a destination for me - more like, I happen to be doing something directly in that 2-block radius, and don't feel like smelling like an ashtray like I do after the usual smokey dives I frequent. Only then will I head here. 

The crowd's a little too hip, bartenders aren't overly friendly (but service IS fast), the $5 burgers are pretty much exactly what you'd expect for $5, and yikes does it get crowded. 

Beer selection is always pretty tight, though. And Kenzingers are crazy cheap at happy hour (IIRC, $3?) Like I said, not a go-to, but definitely serviceable.

The pizza was delicious, and also the cheesy garlic bread had a perfect balance of flavor. The best part about Pizza Guys was you receive a free pint of ice cream if you spend over $18 and pick up your order!!! My little brothers devoured the pizza so with that type of approval I will be returning when we have that pizza craving. As for not giving 5 stars, on a previous review and when I used the address listed on here- sends you across the street. Please update your address Pizza Guys. However, when I called to ask where they were, the customer service was top notch- answered the phone promptly and friendly on the phone.

I hadn't been to Bistro 7 in a while, so we decided to visit. It was such a disappointment. I remembered the food as being interesting and delicious, and what we got was bland and boring. On top of that, the service was uninspired. Took our order, but made it clear that since we were not regulars, we would not get any more attention than what was absolutely necessary. When it came time to pay the bill, we weren't approached to ask if we'd like anything else, or if we were ready for the check. The server just continued talking to his regulars. I would not return anytime soon.

While they focus on getting the cars through the drive-through in a timely manner, they lose focus on what a five dollar cup of coffee should be. I gave them two tries and I got quite possibly the two worst cups of coffee I've ever had. A call to the store with my frustration was met by a very young and sharpie voice telling me to come back and let them remake my cup of coffee. Doesn't that defeat the purpose? The bottom line isif you're looking for a good cup of Starbucks coffee and have a few extra moments make the drive to Winthrop.

Beware of this McDonald's!  Apparently a group of elderly men believe it's their private club.  Went there at 11 on a Saturday.  My 4 year old had a temper tantrum over toys and I was trying to handle it the best I could. Keeping calm and not giving in.  This old guy yelled at him. And then yelled at me to take him home for disturbing his conversation.  It's a freaking McDonald's with a play land!  The staff is even older than the patrons and move like sloths.  They did nothing about this guy yelling at me.  These bullies must hold court there regularly. This experience literally left me in tears.  The fries were cold too.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I didn't like when I first came, but I tried another technician to give them another chance. I came on the 24th of January for manicure and gel pedicure before my Vacation. The following day my pinky toe & big toe polish popped off. I hadn't even gotten in pool or ocean yet. I go there first thing this morning after getting back from Cancun. January 31,2018. And they act as if I am bothering them. THEIR CUSTOMER SERVICE SKILLS SUCK BIG TIME. They understand your English when taking your money. But if there is a problem they seem not to comprehend well. She asked if I wanted to purchase another PEDICURE. smh

I have been coming here with my family a couple of times a month for the past year and it's been ok. We ate here again tonight. The check came to $38. I left the waitress (who I think is the owner's wife) a $6 tip and took my kids to the car. As my wife was leaving, the waitress chastised her for not leaving 20%. Some nerve! 

If you're the owner and you're reading this, please issue an apology. I'll call you back and then you can have your waitress apologize. Otherwise, we're never coming back! There's a lot of competition around here and if you treat your customers like this you'll be out of business!

Please DO NOT TAKE YOUR BABY HERE IF YOU HAVE AN EMERGENCY. It Took us one hour to see the "vet", After our appointment time. ( they only came to get the dog cause we called to see what's going on) ... after 2 hours they call us to say a bunch of stuff without having any test. We gave them an explanation that shes is discharging a little of blood after peeing ...  today SUNDAY.. and all they were saying was, we need to give her test and the cost was over $600. 
Not empathy at all... 
"Your pet can't wait to feel better" ... after 3 hours and 170.00 dollars came home with NO diagnosis and no medicine.

As a fan of Bar Rescue, I had to have a drink at this place.  It was smaller than I expected, but the servers were quick and the beer cold.  Yes, I also had their blue signature drink in the light up skull mug, but it was nothing special.  Took a shot in the barber chair too.

It's a dive bar on Bourbon Street.  Don't over set your expectations, and this place is fun and fairly priced.  With so many choices, I'm glad we came in.  Hard to go beyond three stars for any bar of this kind, but compared to other in the area, it's top tier.

Dr Cherry is wonderful! Such a kind, caring, knowledgeable veterinarian. 

He was able to come to my home same day when my cats health declined rapidly.  He was just so nice and thoughtful of my feelings and my cat, Dracula's, comfort during the euthanasia process.  

I've been through the euthanasia process at home with another pet.  It's never easy, but having someone like Dr Cherry there for you makes the awful process as easy as it can be. 

About 2 weeks later, Dr Cherry personally dropped Dracula's remains at home.  I truly appreciate his care.

Visited sushi wasabi for a special occasion. This is a moms and pops kind of shop, very obviously family run. The decor is very unassuming and slightly on the side of an aging joint.

The quality is top notch and very fresh although the prices are shockingly high. The value is slightly lower than that of other quality sushi restaurants although this is made up in the freshness of the seafood. 

Service is average and we would consider visiting again but only if in the neighborhood. Would not recommend for special occasions if only for the lack of ambiance.

3.5/5 is more like it

It's your typical, local, pretty good Chinese food spot. This place has been here for years and I've eaten here somewhat regularly for at least 15 years now. My recent go to meal is the honey chicken meal with rice and the egg roll. 

Larger than average portion sizes, but typical hole in the wall quality food. That's definitely not a bad thing, though: sometimes getting right around average food is super tasty if you're wanting to have a cheat day every once in a while. 

Overall, def not my first choice for Chinese food, but still an addictive place to go for a quick lunch.

Forget this place unless it's important to be hip and trendy. The wine and beer offering is extremely limited and all over priced. $9 for a can of IPA. I'm not at an arena. 
The cheese steaks were meager. Not enough meet. The gnocchi and greens are not worth the price snd they have the audacity to serve it in a bowl. The salads are expensive and way too much dressing. The crab dip appetizer did not have a crab taste and they are served with Pradeep dinner rolls. This place should be embarrassed to call themselves a restaurant. Will not return. Bob

Super Cute Mexican restaurant!!! Very Tex-Mex... We loved the homemade tortillias, and the queso and salsa!  The kitchen is right in the main dining room which was really fun to watch everyone prepare the food!  Our kids loved it- they could be a little silly and loud with no worries!  The night we were there they advertised a fresh banana foster bar made to order!!! (We didn't order because we were sooo full but- it it it looked DEEELISH!)  We ate indoors and loves the atmosphere- but sitting outside was the most favorite for everyone that night!  I am glad we found this place thru Yelp while on our short trip to Nashville!!!

So I'm currently at the Skyye "elite" bar and the service is HORRIBLE. Literally forgot all our food and drinks i had to ask for everything again. I'm mid way done with my food and no drinks out. I was literally about to choke i had nothing to swallow down my food with. The ladies at the bar seem to be more interested on what's on there phone then to help us. They are talking and talking and talking. I've seen two people go up to them and literally asked them to wait while the two ladies finished the conversation. Then helped them. I am beyond upset and i had to review this.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Why do I have to keep repeating myself on yelp with all the Dunkin' Donuts? Do you have a couple people working in the store, do you lock the doors, but you still turn on Uber eats so the drivers can come there and wait a half an hour to get someone's order. We are not going to do that. Now there were 14 cars in that line and you're still letting people order Uber eats so let me tell you what happened I canceled the order I still got paidAnd I left. So you think you could just do what you want sooner or later corporate's going to find out. If you lock your doors turn off mobile ordering!

Ridiculous the fact that you can walk inside to pick up a Uber order but you can't get a cuppa coffee while you are in there is flat out ridiculous. I am so tired of Dunkin' Donuts hiding behind Covid and doing whatever they feel like doing that make their life easier. Half of them are closed on the inside they don't wanna let people use the bathroom it's just plain Lazy and rude when they should be happy so that they have a newfound business with all this ordering through ride share. How do you tell somebody who walks through the front door and he standing there that they have to go to the drive-through to get a coffee?

Went a few weeks ago. Summer weekend easy to get in, everyone was away. It was okay. Nothing great. Heard about how Great the pizza was. The sauce lacked flavor, it was bland. My husband got the chicken Parmesan. He loves chicken Parmesan, not theirs. Same thing lacked flavor. Pasta was over cooked and mushy. When we walked in folk outside were talking about where they drove from to get there. Save the gas. I live around the corner and I won't be back. PS It's also really expensive for not a lot of good food.

Went to Tuscana 52 last night to celebrate my birthday. I will not be back. The food was ...okay,not worth the price. The waiter was the pits. He had US stacking dishes. They forgot to give my husbands credit card back ,so today he had to go back , the manager asked if he knew who our waiter was. My husband said that he was terrible, the manger shrugged his shoulders and said sorry. He did not care that we had a bad experience . 
There are so many good places to eat in our area, I don't understand the manager not caring.

If you're into good food with lots of flavor and plenty of sauce, then this is the place for you. The ladies up front were friendly and nice. They have a small menu which makes it better for them to focus on giving you such good food. I was wanting to try the wings but they were sold out so I tried the next best thing. The salmon nachos. Even though they are an appetizer they fill you up. I also had the egg rolls and they were crispy. Just how I like it. I can probably guess everything you try here will be top notch. I will definitely have to get my hands on those wings my coworker had their quesadilla and he loved it.

A neighbourhood bar with a bit of a difference. The Thirsty Rhino is a (relatively) new addition in the north end of the city. The decor is pretty chic, and yes they have a rhino head on display - shiny silver, not real! 

The beer offering is your standard keith's, Rickard's red etc, so not too special. Where the Thirsty Rhino really shines is the food. They sell flatbread pizzas - the Italian sausage was delicious! The burgers are pretty decent and the tacos are great! 

For a local watering hole they definitely get the job done.

When you're absolutely ravenous at lunch time, and have to make it through a tough afternoon at the office, a bento box from Edo can be just what the doctor ordered. 

With a whole whack of options available, you can change it up quite significantly each time you visit. On my last trip I opted for chicken teriyaki as my main, and took the tempura shrimp and the California Rolls as my sides. Other favs include the edamame. The chicken was decent, the sushi pretty darned good, and the tempura just the right amount of fried goodness. 

The soup options are also a good bet! 

Scrumptious.

I usually like to come here to get my fingernails done, and so was excited when I Walked in for a pedicure the other day. Felt like I was rushed in and out pretty quick however, and I noticed my toenails were all still pretty a little crooked and somewhat a little jagged. When I got home my girlfriend said it looked like I did it at home. I noticed the gals seated next to me were there for much longer as well. So I probably won't be coming back for this service considering the price  of 40$ +15% tip ($6), and what I got.

I've been coming here every Tuesday for vegan donuts over the last 2 months and I initially thought they had an amazing product! Sadly, the last 2 weeks, the donuts have been awful. Two weeks in a row, the vegan fritter was so hard I couldn't even bite into it. And the sprinkle, the maple,the PB&J, the cookie, and the maple espresso donuts were dry and were the worst donuts I've ever had.... They tasted a week old. I drive 25 minutes each way to support their vegan donut day and now it's just not worth it. I hope they get their product back up to the quality I loved and enjoyed so much!

This is a lively small bar towards the end of bourbon street. It was featured on bar rescue.

I went in an ordered the Resurrection mug. It was 15 bucks! It was a good blueberry flavor. I don't drink a lot but when I drank this it just about knocked me out!

I stopped back to see a girl taking shots on the barber chair or I should say molested. They put her on the chair, spun her around,  the female bar attendant proceeded to rub her breasts all over her and performed other acts in a sexual manner while giving her shots. I walked away drunk and shocked!

I regulalrly stop there on my way through town on Rt 309, as it's right off the exit.  Reasonable food at a reasonable price.  The salad bar always seems fresh. They have a surf and turf burger that I like.  Frozen in the center chicken croquets were served the last time I was there.  The waitress offered to take them to be reheated, but we chose not to, as we didn't feel like waiting around longer. When the cashier asked if everything was OK, he was told of the problem, but just said "Sorry about that", and charged full price. Might not go back. So their stupidity probably lost a repeat customer. Sad.

The menu was a little confusing for being a first timer. There is an option for tea soda or tea snow. Since I wasn't feeling carbonation I opted for snow, thinking it would be a blended drink,but the employee said it was a snow cone. So I went back to the tea soda but then they asked if I wanted regular water instead of soda water.. so I got that. The whole thing was confusing and in the end it just taste like a flavored black tea. Nothing too fancy. Since this was strictly a tea shop I was expecting a little more... don't think I'll go back. .

Last night was not our first time eating here but it might be our last.   The room was extremely dark and we had difficulty looking at our menus. Later on I wondered if it was dark on purpose so we wouldn't be able to see the quality of the food. I ordered a southwest chicken wrap and french fries and macaroni and cheese. The chicken wrap was dry and tasteless. The french fries were barely warm and dry and tasted like they had been prepared the day before. The macaroni and cheese wasn't even up to the standards of Kraft macaroni and cheese. The pasta was semi hard. And the sauce was runny and did not have any flavor.

This is definitely an authentic Mexican experience! Our waitress actually didn't speak English and we were the only people in the small, but crowd restaurant not of Hispanic descent. Their specialty is a soup brought in a pitcher that you mix yourself with cilantro and onion and then a pay by weight stringy meat. You put in all together and into corn tortillas. Definitely not like anything I have had before. It was very flavorful and tasty. One star off for odd hours, they close at 6pm every day. Definitely brush up on your Spanish skills as the menu is in Spanish and most of the wait staff only speak Spanish.

Every time I try to get my money out at this bank, there is always something that goes awry. Last couple of times I went there, the ATM wasn't working and I couldn't withdraw cash. When you go during business hours and withdraw cash from the tellers, it's painfully slow. Tellers are condescending and tell you to use the ATM, which I would if it was working. They lack professionalism and talk to you like you're stupid. It's no surprise that other reviewers share the same feeling about taking their banking business elsewhere.

Decent hotel. Not a boutique hotel like first impressions may lead you to. Clean, air conditioner worked well but loud. Double beds with standard mattresses. Good water pressure in showers. Probably not the best value. Parking is $20 a night across street $5. a night. Better than average lounge. Agree with other reviewers, staff is just sustaining not overly friendly. However location is fantastic if you are interested in the downtown bar/restaurant scene which is very active and diverse. Walk to all in 1 minute. If you are looking for value probably look else where. For great location to downtown this is it. Paid $170 night
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Had a quick outdoor brunch at the tables set along the Pinellas Trail.  I would say the menu here is primarily breakfast, and maybe brunch.  I would not say any menu items are lunch.  It could be they scaled back for Covid.  Had the Country Skillet and Breakfast Burrito. Both were excellent.  Eating outside was fantastic, they should make it even more attractive, and I would consider it even if I were not biking.  I would have given it 5 stars if it had something approaching lunch.  Definitely a good stop on the Trail.

This location is ok it varies from person to person. I've gone at times and had an employee mess up my order I've had other times where everything was was right , hot and fresh and times when fries were nasty and cold. I try to avoid this location at all cost. It's a mickey d's so I can't expect much. Also depending whose the manager on shift they at least try and fix everything for you with out a problem. Keyword depends whose the manager on shift i have encountered managers who are rude and seem like they don't want to be there.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Yes -never had a really poor Dunkin experience in all my travels and saw this location was new but had some bad reviews. I thought - I am just getting coffee at 7:30 am on a Sunday how bad could it really be? ...sad to report that the reviews for this location are very true. We ordered 2 hot pumpkin coffees. The drive through server was very confused by this order but after another 5 minutes at the window she served us 2 iced pumpkin drinks instead. She told us to pull up front into the parking lot where we waited another 5-7 minutes for the order to be corrected to hot in front of an overflowing Dunkin trash can.

Sits right on Monon trail near the heart of Carmel's shops restaurants and more. Perfect overnight stay after catching a show at the hotel's Feinstein dinner theater lounge, at the Carmel Performing Arts Center, or at the Booth Tarkington Civic Center. Also a great stay for just enjoying a day in Carmel. Everything is a short walk from this hotel including the Arts & Design District, and  Midtown Plaza.  More new shops and dining are on site surrounding the hotel plaza and have a Las Vegas flare anchored in some natural beauty provided by dozens of small parks squares and fountains as well as the Monon Trail that connects it all.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Wow. I am SO impressed with this particular location. They accommodated my crazy schedule when my very anxious kitty had an injury. They were so sweet to her (and me) and gave me the time and support my kitty and I both needed. Definitely recommend Dr Cunningham. I haven't had another dr here but I'm sure they are wonderful as well. Dr Cunningham answered my million questions I had about my sweet kitty and she was so kind to us both! Staff there is incredibly friendly and accommodating as well! I won't be going to another Banfield location anymore-- this is my go-to location now!

First time guests since the ownership change. The salad was tasty, and the toasted tabs were fine but tasted like frozen you could get anywhere else. The pizza (meatball) was tasty but the crust seemed to be pre made.
The beer / soda choices were fine. The price was s touch steeper than what I could get elsewhere but not s big deal.
Not very crowded for s Friday night and my biggest issue was customer service. I never saw a single employee smile the entire time we were there. If the employees are not happy the guests will ultimately not be happy.
We will probably be back but it won't be the worst thing if we aren't .

I hosted a dinner for my bridesmaids and we were able to sit in the back room called the wine room. 

It had a large farmhouse style table that could fit over 12 people comfortably. We had our server Tina, who explained the specials of the day and offered delicious suggestions based off of all of our different diet restrictions and preferences. The meal was perfectly spaced and we felt like we were having dinner at one of our family homes! The owner also greeted us and treated us like family. I can't wait to bring my fiancé there.  Each of our meals had traditional Italian portions and were absolutely delicious!!

After scouting this place out today for our venue for our future holiday dinner... We decided to try the food. I was looking forward to the buffet to be able to sample the variety... The hostess kept telling us they were really really busy upstairs and that it would probably be best to order from the menu (but we could still do the buffet if we wanted too). Well we went ahead and ordered from the menu due to the fact we were on a time schedule. The food was really good just feeling a little disappointed about not having the buffet.

I definitely give this a hotel a 4star. Yes you loose out on free breakfast but the restaurant definitely does not do disappoint. I am very thankful towards the staff because we checked in after midnight and the staff were so helpful with our checkin and any information we needed. I would definitely recommend this to anyone who is looking for a quite place not to far from the beach and if you are a boater perfect location. Yes a little minor things hear and there but nothing that takes away from the view and relaxation.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We stopped through this Starbucks drive-thru location on an afternoon.  We only wanted coffee, apparently in the afternoon the only thing they brew is Pike (must not be a heavily trafficked Starbucks to have such limited options.  They had just ran out of Pike and had to brew another pot.  The woman was very apologetic and gave us our order for free, we just had to pull up and wait about 4 minutes for the Pike. As we were not in a hurry to be anywhere this was not a problem, however if you're trying to get somewhere quickly I would not recommend stopping at the Drive-Thru as it did take awhile.

This used to be one of my favorite weekly places to eat.  I have not been there in months. Tonight I discovered that portion sizes of my favorite foods were literally cut in half, but the prices are still the same.  The food still had the same great flavor, But we felt cheated. Coincidently, there was a large group of young men drinking and sharing shots with the waitstaff.  They were loud and vulgar and the establishment condoned the behavior. Needless to say this was not one of my most pleasant dining experiences.  I don't know if I'll be back.

The husband and wife team who run this establishment are delightful. They are so friendly and they do great work at very fair prices. 

I've had a few items dry-cleaned here and had them tailor a romper for me (the bottom of the romper had to be completely refashioned to fit) and I was very happy with the results both times. 

The business is moving from the North Valleys to California Ave. While we're sad to see them move further away from us, we'll continue to bring them our business and hope the move helps their business!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
This company is truly a piece of s***. "Customer service" is brain dead, apathetic. No listening
 communication, comprehension, analytical, or critical thinking skills. They could be replaced by machines and artificial intelligence.

Yes artificial stupidity would be an improvement.

Stll cannot access my credit card account online due to Chase IT glitches . . . . Despite  enduring 3 days and 2 hours of incompetence and being hung up on. To think I closed a Chase account 10 years ago for bad service just to give them another chance. Close your accounts and put them out of service. I'm closing mine.

This place is amazing. The owner came out, greeted us and gave us a tour of the menu.  The tea is brewed 
in-house, they offer regular teas, tea lattes or creative flavor combinations for their tea sodas. You can order it still or sparkling & even add an energy boost for additional caffeine. We ordered the Bayou & Rainforest sparkling tea sodas. They were both so good! The owner came out again & asked if we enjoyed it. You can order through the walk-up or they have a drive-thru. You have to try out their teas!!

The drive thru at this location is the worst. If you don't have minimum of 10-20 mins to wait for your order go to another Starbucks. Today 2 cars ahead of me. No idea what first in line got but one in front of me only ordered 1 hot beverage.  Took 9 mins from order until I drove off with my 1 refresher. 1 beverage 9 mins. Ridiculous. Worst Starbucks drive thru in Sherwood Park. Maybe it needs more employees I donno. The staff is always pleasant & order is always accurate so I'd like to give more stars. But the drive thru is sooooo slow.

Have to agree with other posters. The chips are weird & cheapy feeling. Portions do not substantiate the price. Portions are small not very favorable and way overpriced. I had the shrimp tacos for $28. It was not worth the price & it was bland. There was 3 soft tacos with next to no filling. The actual portion of shrimp was ok but they had no flavour and there wasn't anything else with them, except for a tiny cup holding appx 1 tablespoon of beans & same size cup of salsa. There are far far far better Mexican restaurants in Sherwood Park.

I had a very bad stay . I gave it two stars because the front desk receptionists were very pleasant professional . The rooms are standard , just ok but cleaned everyday . But the noise and the partying is out of control !!! It kept me up all Saturday night . I really think there was a straight up brawl . Like someone's life was being possibly threatened I heard women screaming , cursing , loud bumps and thuds , loud music playing outside my room as well . I A hot mess ! Don't come here if you want a little peace . Week days might be better .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My husband and I decided to dine here today for lunch with our 6 week old daughter. The food is average and the service is slow, but that's not the issue at hand. A member of their kitchen staff was told to come out into the dining area and start painting. We were not the only patrons in there, there was about 6 other tables seated around us. This act is illegal and also unsatisfactory. The only good thing there is their chips and salsa which was on our table before the server even came to get our drink order.

The most unappetizing Big Mac I've ever had. I don't know if they had to scrape it off the bottom of the tray or not but I wouldn't serve something that looks like that to someone who paid for it. I asked for fresh fries and got an excuse of we close in 3 mins. Well I've been waiting in the drive thru for about 10 so... she made me wait longer for what was supposed to be fresh fries and they were fresh mixed mostly with old fries. So upset about my meal. If I could select negative stars I would right about now.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Poor even for an airport restaurants.
When I arrive, there was a guitar player/singer.  His mic was WAY too loud exacerbating the fact that he sucked.  I sat as far away as I could.
Once seated, the waitress took my order.
In the meantime, a party of 8 came in and sat near me.  They got a LOT of attention.  
My food came and I asked for a glass of water. 
I asked again for a glass of water and another glass of wine.
The group of 8 finished their food, paid and left.
No water and no wine ever came.
The waitress got mad when I pointed that out. 
I almost missed my flight.
I will NEVER go back.

I'm still eating here. Quality of food remains high and the servers are
always pleasant.  Windows galore so the view enhances the experience. 
I find myself here usually for breakfast but have enjoyed a few lunches, too. 

One thing you should know is the parking situation. You can't drive in to their parking lot. It's valet only; so, if that bothers you be prepared to find street parking most of which is metered. Try looking east for some free spots, but the service is good so an hour on the meter isn't bad.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Don't waste your time.  Too many other decent places.  The waiter was rude and didn't have the time for us.  He stopped by once after about 10 minutes and took our complete order.  Returned to drop off 2 plastic water cups and stale bread, then again to deliver all the food at once - even the appetizers with the main course --slammed them on the table, turned and left.  The food looks as is it all comes pre-cooked from Smart & Final or Costco and just re-heated.  It was so bad I warned a couple waiting at the bar and another looking over the menu at the Front Door.

Took my handicapped father here for lunch before a dog show.  Had to stand in line for 20 minutes while he sat on the seat of his walker before being seated. The food was below average with all the sandwiches ordered dry and uninteresting.  Some of the fries were cooked some were hard and overcooked. I am only giving this three stars because of the awesome waitress who treated us like gold. After standing for so long, my father was tired and weak and she contacted security to bring us a wheelchair so he could get down to the dog show.  Kind and caring, thank you!

Upon check in to our hotel on our most recent trip to NOLA we received drink vouchers to 21st Amendment.  I do not turn down free drinks so we promptly went and found this bar.  
It was a nice place and had some good live music.  The decor hooked me right off the bat.  I love the 1920's vibe and made me set to try some cocktails. 
The drinks were classic and tasted really good.  The prices were a little high, but I wasn't paying for the first round so it was ok.  I would have liked a little more selection on the menu for the price.  This place is worth it though.

We've ordered from this one a few times. The first time was good, but these last two have been awful. They take forever for delivery and I understand 45-60 minutes, but it was over an hour and like 20 minutes once. We ended up calling them because we thought they forgot about us. They were overwhelmed with business and didn't give us a proper estimate. This last time they arrived on time but the food didn't taste great. The buffalo wings barely had any sauce on them. The boneless bbq wings were hard on the inside and the pizza was tough. Also the driver had a nasty attitude and of course didn't show it until after we have him a tip.

A cute new addition to Hyde Park! I love ice cream, so obviously I had to try Hyde Park's newest sweet treat. They have unique flavors and a cool interior. 

My main complaint is that when serving such unique flavors like Buckeye or Vegan Grasshopper, I would expect the menu to list some sort of description about the flavor. Instead, I felt like such a bother when I had to bother the poor employee with my gazillion clarifying questions. 

Definitely worth a try if you're into VERY out there flavors that go against the typical flavors you see in other ice cream shops.

This is one of the best vets that I've seen in Indianapolis. They care so much about the well being of your pet. After every visit they always call to check on my cat and see how he's doing. My cat is very old and rather than put him through a bunch of procedures they've been trying to keep him comfortable and happy with the time he has left. They also make sure and talk me through every test along with prices and if something is too expensive they try to find alternatives. I can't thank them enough for everything they've done!

Every time we come here, we play my least favorite game: "Will they get my order right?" Unless you watched them pack your order, check it before you leave.

I ordered via the DD app one time. When I arrived, they had no idea what I was talking about. Not willing to even try that again. 

Pros: The restaurant is clean enough. They offer DD and BR products in the same place. If you go late in the day, sometimes they throw in bonus donuts.

Cons: Most employees treat customers like an inconvenience and are very hard to understand. Better (or at least faster) service is offered at the drive-thru than at the counter.

Cozy and friendly atmosphere, and good food. The server was polite and on top of good suggestions. The table bread is great. The plating and taste was very enjoyable of the entrees we ordered. I cannot compare it to fine dining, as it is not fine dining. However, it is an enjoyable mid-level restaurant with good service. The ambiance is decent (not a fan of their chairs), unless they are busy - then it gets a bit tight space wise and noisy. They only take reservations for large parties, as I usually say - be patient while waiting. Parking can be tight. Overall a decent establishment.

Expensive....very very expensive and all the pasta dishes were terribly mediocre
Are we the only ones? Or everybody is just ordering pizza?!?, which granted is awesome. We ordered 2 pastas, 2 slices of plain pizza, 4 cookies (butter is the main ingredient, yes, but not worth $2 each, specially when the chocolate with salt is way too salty) and 3 draft beers and came to $70.00 before tiping .
I will not recommend it again and unless I want a plain pizza I am not coming back...sorry. the concept was great but they got too full of themselves... but they are nice people...go figure! Maybe is just a chef thing..

Not bad for the price. But very dirty place.. we got seated at hibachi and the table was disgusting. Very greasy and dirty, still have bits and pieces of food and you could tell they wiped it down. The grille was nasty, they didn't clean it after cooking on it just wiped it off real quick so when our cook got on it he didn't even clean it or wipe it down before he cooked. It also took over an hour before we got a cook because they thought it was smart to have one cook working "because it's usually not busy". Well I can see why. We decided to try this place bc we heard the food was good and it was decent. Just not sanitary.

My first time here. The food was good. We waited a little too long for the waiter to return with our food order. The large black ventilation system is an eye sore,  they should paint that Brown. And it's very dusty. And there was a fly buzzing around our table. They Just need to spruce it up!
They took a long time to bring food service but quick to take the plates and the check. Never refilled my salsa,  had to ask for refill on chips.  And then saw a BIG ant crawling on my table!!  C'mon people. Makes me wonder what the kitchen looks like.

My wife took me here for a wonderful birthday dinner! Great spot in the Italian market section of town. Feels authentic and homemade!

We got a nice little bread and butter basket in the beginning. 

We ordered the fried asparagus as an appetizer and then for our entrees we got the eggplant parm and the baked rigatoni. 

Can't state this enough, but the authentic feeling was there. The atmosphere was outstanding, almost as if you were eating in a cute little place in Italy! Service was phenomenal and drinks were priced well!

To top things off, the tiramisu was outstanding! 
A great experience, we will be back!
Just remember.. cash only!

We saw the sign on west bay and decided to go in. The food was delicious. I had the eggplant grinder with sauce. For those of you who don't know what a grinder is; it's a "hoagie", "sub" "Italian sandwich" or "poboy". Mine came with a side and it's basic no thrills potato salad. Depends on where you grew up. The sauce is sweet not spicy. My husband had the pizza and the crust was crunchy and thin - medium. Great lunch specials and reasonable prices overall. When you drive into the plaza it looks like a small place but it's pretty good size inside. Friendly, professional and good food! Please support your local businesses!

This place is never packed and I always wonder why!  I love it though cause I never have to wait when I walk in. I love coming here because I know I'm going to get excellent service with a smile and a delicious cocktail. The food is southern comfort inspired and they have some vegetarian options as well. Good environment for a date, as well as small parties with its outside option as well. Sometimes they have a local grass fed beef meat store out in the parking lot where you can get incredible meats for great deals!

I went there for all-you-can-eat. I was very impressed. The rice to fish ratio is just right. More fish than rice. They had a great selection of sushi rolls and nigiri. I had some really great unagi, scallop nigiri, and salmon sake. The vegas roll is not as good as Sushi Garden, but it was still good. Too much on the sesame seed for that roll. I was too full to try another one I really wanted to. Definitely going back. The sushi chef also gave me free ice cream on the house. He recommended a "red bean" ice cream. It was really great! Definitely put a smile on my face.

We went here twice while in town because of 2 reasons: they have gluten free pizza & a nice outdoor patio.

The first night the service was great & food was good. The gluten free pizza is decent. The second night we went the service was super slow- we waited over an hour for our food to come out. In that time our server only came by once to see if we wanted more drinks. So 2 drinks in over an hour.

While the food was decent it was a bit pricey ($17 for a 12" GF pizza). My husband had a regular pizza & he said it was just ok. Another night he got a salad & said it was excellent.

This was our go to spot a few years back. Their prices were reasonable, and the rooms were adequate. At some point during the last year the prices nearly doubled. On top of that, the last time my wife and stayed at sandy land, homeless people were staying in the unit adjacent to ours. The 3 or 4 characters staying there had their bicycles parked in front of their unit. Then, one of the homeless people came over to me and asked if I was the manager of the motel. I was observing what looked like a drug deal happening in broad daylight. Do yourself a favor and skip staying at this place. It went from modest to sketchy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My daughter who was getting married, my mom and myself went to get gel polish manicure and two sets of nails done for the wedding. We had heard good things so we made appointments. It seemed very rushed - one person was doing my and my moms nails and there were people waiting for their appointments. The atmosphere was ok except for one person, I believe the owner, has a potty mouth and cusses like a sailor. My mom went back a few weeks later to get a fill of the clear color with white (painted on tips) and was charged $50. Price seems high for a clear colored fill. Lost our business and won't refer anyone either.

Not we expected!!! I wanted to go to a nice restaurant for a date and what we got was less than par. The staff was engaged but not with us with other staff and we felt like we were inconveniencing her to even ask her to take our order. I ordered lemons 3 times and waited for my wine longer than I should've because she forgot. I will not waste my money eh for sub par food and terrible service. Business owners cheap young work is not always the answer, set a standard and have adults around don't expect your teens to run your restaurant.

Just signed up today at the Planet Fitness with my wife Enjoyed a light workout on treadmill and loved the massage chairs which are included in the Black Card package.

Also tried the Hydrotherapy table (which doesn't get you wet) but feel like whirlpool jets running up on down your back. Very soothing but watch out if you're ticklish.

BeautyAngel total body enhancement was interesting that my wife tried out. Bring sunglasses  if this is one you want to try it. Mild shaking is experienced in this one and do heed the warnings.

Overall Carmel location was nice
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
My wife purchased two pair of glasses and our daughter bought her sunglasses here. 
They were both impressed with the knowledge and friendliness of the staff so when I couldn't find my sunglasses, that's where I headed. The selection was good so I spent a fair amount of their time making a decision and placed an order. Upon returning home I found my old sunglasses in a jacket so called For Eyes the next morning to cancel my order. I was fully expecting a lot of questions, snarky remarks and the possibility they wouldn't cancel. Instead, they were friendly, asked very few questions and canceled my order. Thank you Monica!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: We enjoyed a Saturday afternoon lunch!  I love that everyone my family can get exactly what they want.  My hubby and older son love choosing their own toppings for pizza.  My younger son loves the boneless Mac and Cheese!!  I really loved all of the toppings I could get on a wonderful salad!  The food is fresh and made right in front of you!  Pizza and pasta is delivered to your table hot out of the oven.  The price is great and you definitely get your money's worth!  The owner came around to each table and offered us a free sample of their new ice cream!  It was delicious!!

I'll m updating my review, because the last two times I've been here the food has NOT been good, or they mess up your order. I ordered a bean burrito with cheese and 3 carnitas tacos. When I got home I ended up with a stale bean burrito, and three greasy "carne Asada" tacos with absolutely NO flavor. Hands down the worst food I've gotten in a long time. The beans were so dry and had a funky taste, and the worst part is it was cold inside. Yuck!  No one wants cold beans!!! 
  I ended up throwing 90% of it away. I hate wasting my money and food.

Wow, this place has really good pizza crust, probably the best I've eaten in Nashville! The taleggio and pear pizza was the star of our meal with its pillowy soft crust that had a super thin, crispy exterior and was the perfect amount of burnt. The other things we ordered were decent, but not necessarily worth the price in my opinion. For example, the pulpo de ajo had good flavor and the potatoes were delightfully crispy, but I thought the portion of octopus could have been more generous (we only got 3 pieces, see pic). I would come again but probably only order their pizza because that crust is absolutely incredible.

There are a lot of Starbucks locations around me. I try to avoid this one because every time I have gone, my order isn't up to par. If I am paying $6 for a drink, I expect it to be perfect. I ordered my usual (strawberry lemonade refresher with no berries and 3 scoops of matcha) from this Starbucks yesterday and it was gross. They didn't shake it up so my matcha was just sitting at the bottom and they put berries in at first and i'm guessing pulled them out because there were random little chunks floating in it. Disappointed. Won't be going back to this location which is unfortunate.

I haven't had much experience renting cars. I was able to get a state employee discount but they never sent me my confirmation so I had to call back twice before it was finally emailed to me. Then once I received I noticed they conveniently leave off the price they quoted me. I didn't think too much about it until I went to get the car and they gave me a higher price then I got over the phone. Fortunately the manager honored my price even though I had nothing to prove it.  We were happy with the car and getting out was easy.

Unfortunately I can't give this a very high rating. It was disappointing from start to finish. Our rooms weren't ready upon arrival even though it was past check in time. The hallways were freezing and the rooms smelt like mold. The hallway carpets throughout the entire property looked filthy. I was never given any wash clothes during my 4 day stay but the worst part was that housekeeping barged into my room without knocking at 8:30am. Fortunately I was dressed but found this very disturbing and reported it to the front desk. The location is great and close to convention center but will stay elsewhere in the future.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stayed in this Marriott last weekend and found one thing rather negative.  There was some times but clearly not always ice water in the lobby.  There was no coffee in the lobby - rather this place focused on selling things out of the Bistro.  Don't remember a Marriott not having free coffee in the lobby in the morning.  Room was clean and ok but nothing special.  Parking is limited so you are forced to pay for parking over night.  Think the experience could have been better and don't see what the big deal is with most of the ratings.  I have been staying mostly in Marriotts for the past 6 months and this was one was not the usual experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Went to French Press to study around 10AM. I wouldn't suggest coming here to study early on in the day cause there's a lot going on, but I'm sure it's different during the afternoon. Had a bacon, egg, and cheese croissant on my visit here it was pretty good. Cinnamon Bun here was straight, cheese danish was straight. 

I'd return for a quick pick me up of coffee, and breakfast only thing deterring me from studying here is that it's kind of small, and it can get pretty stuffy depending on the volume the kitchen is cranking out.

This restaurant gets four stars for their customer service, price, and the quality of the sushi for price you pay. Their all you can eat option is extensive, just don't let your eyes get bigger than your stomach!

Most of their "special rolls" consisted of the same ingredients, in different ways. It was still delicious, nonetheless. I wish they would add more to their nigiri/sashimi options for their all you can eat, but I do understand they do have to save on costs. Overall great experience and would definitely come here again the next time I'm in Tucson!

I called and ordered general tsos chicken and plain lo mein . My order was delivered wrong when I called the restaurant the man was rude asked me for my address and said ok and hung up . I called an hour later stating that the fix had not arrived he confirmed my address and my order said he would have someone deliver the replacement. I called back two hours later the man was rude started yelling at me said he could not prepare that way and hung up
on me. I immediately called back and asked he had hung up on me and he said yes and started to yell and when I asked for a refund he hung up on me . Do mot spend money at this business

I tried several donuts for the first time to see what the hype is all about. They start with a regular hole donut and then they make to order your donuts depending what you want on it. I give them credit for their originality. The server was very friendly and accommodating. She actually spent some time going over the different types of donuts. The donuts looked good but for me the taste was not there. I wish they had a stuffed donut but they tried to make a Boston cream one by filling the hole with custard. It was ok but not great. Each donut was $1.75 which was a bit pricey as well.

I went in to have a manicure and a pedicure and had a coupon for a $20 pedicure, essentially $5 off. Not only did they not honor the coupon, the guy (Danny I believe) globbed on the polish and didn't bother to clean the cuticles around the nails. You'd be better off having kindergarteners painting your nails.
I've been to different nail salons all over the US and other various countries and this was by far the worst experience ever.  The staff were unfriendly and spoke only in Vietnamese even with customers in there. I can definitely see why the reviews were so terrible. They will not be getting mine or my family's business.

Maybe because we came in on a Sunday 30 minutes before they close but we had a very different experience this time around. 
2 got a carne asada plate and both plates were dry and the rice was very salty. 
Another got fajitas they were good again the rice was salty. 
My taquitos were cery dry and gross I honestly only ate them because it was late and I was starving and again salty rice.
The guacamole was the best part. 
My family said it is not normally like that they eat there all the time and enjoy it however I have to give my experience.

I have never once had a problem with these guys. They are always super affordable. They always get the job done for me. A couple times I have come in and told them what others have quoted me and said I need and they have scoffed at those 'repairs' and prices. 
They have even helped me out for free before. My particular make and model has a spark plug issue. I was spending $300 a year to get my spark plugs replaced. One of the guys looked at it, switched my spark plugs around, and it was perfectly fine. He didn't charge me either. 
Great guys. 
I'm actually going there today for an inspection and oil change.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We only get fast food if we have coupons. McDonald's app is cool because you always get coupons...... Until the manager who comes back makes you feel like crap for using it. "I f'cking hate this app, I know exactly what it is every time I see it rang through, it's bull shit"    Cool. A manager, who is supposed to be setting an example for the next generation of managers is acting this way. McDonald's made this app to stay competitive. Had it not been for that bull shit app you would not have had my business today and would have been that much further away from hitting your numbers. Good job manager at 2:02pm on 3/26/2016
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: They are very nice. The enchiladas have red sauce but it taste mostly like tomato paste on them. The hamburger meat  inside was wonderful. The salsa was good.  The rice taste like it was flavored with ketchup. Everything has a up charge. $2 more if you want cheese sauce. Margaritas have flavor up charges. Steak fajitas have a $3 up charge from chicken. I believe it was the sauce , made my daughter sick. She ate all hers. I scraped mine off the 1 enchilada I ate. I'm sure it was just the acid from the tomato.

Rude! Wow. I totally get the fact they are short staffed but wow! Only reason for the 2 stars is the girl who finally answered the drive thru was polite...mostly. The one at the window literally o lay said thank you as she shut the window. That's it. Now to discuss the food. The chicken sandwich wasn't bad, once we put it together as it was falling apart. Ordered onion rings because I can't have potatoes. Didn't get the rings, got fries instead. Got chicken fries, always a safe choice right? Nope. They were old and stale. Again, just wow

I really want to like this place because there are no other places nearby, but it's just awful. Half of the flavors are out of order. I always seem to stop here on Wednesdays which is "no weight Wednesdays." I know this may be hard to understand for them but I just want a small amount for one individual. I don't want to fill a ginormous bucket with froyo. They declined my request to just weigh it and have me pay the price. Employee told me to just go fill it more because "that's the price." I like to watch my intake and that's not what I wanted. Why is it so hard to find a good FroYo place?

5 stars for Susan Irwin-hua as she has been great to work with throughout the years! She's very knowledgable and will get things taken care of one way or another for you! Susan and her staff are awesome!! 1 star for WFB tying their business bankers hands when it came to the PPP. What a flop when small businesses like our own needed them the most. Luckily enough we were able to withdraw our ppp application from wfb and re-submit through a smaller local bank which lead to approval within 48 hours. Wells Fargo small enough to service but too big to care when it came to PPP. Valuable banking relationship lesson learned here.

This was my fifth satay over the last 6 years. I adore the location and sleek sexy lobby. Unfortunately the hotel is showing it's age. The cleanliness was average. They no longer have a bar inside the hotel. No more door man and the up keep is slipping. Things like grout in the showers, paint and carpet need to be addressed. 

During our stay room turn over service was only available by request. Probably safer with covid. However a house keeper whom spoke no English came to our room 2 time a day. Why idk? I told her we didn't need anything and she kept coming back...twice a day... 30 minutes apart a 4pm...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Worth the drive!  I live in South Saint Louis City, but the ride to West County was so worth it!  Trattoria Marcella's Sister restaurant knocks it out of the park!  I was with a big group, so we tried the arancini, wings, and ravioli for appetizers, all outstanding.  I then moved onto the caeser salad, delicious. For my entrée, I had the Beef Tenderloin and it was amazing.  However, the table shared a pizza, and it was truly the star of the show. Then to top everything off, the service and atmosphere was perfect. West St. Louis County, you have a gem in Mia Sorella.

I drove all the way to this location for my favorite drink the peach tea lemonade which was an available at the location closer to home.
It's a long way but I'd rather go there and know that they have exactly what, rather than to drive around locally trying to find a location with it.
I love the bacon Gouda sandwiches as well and they had them readily available which made me happy only drawback was it was extremely busy and even going inside and ordering was an extended wait in order to have my order fulfilled.But at least I got what I went therefore and I just hopped back on I 75 S and headed back home.

Scheduled a nice day for hubby and myself for Valentine's Day.
Arrived for check in in it took a while due to the computer system being new and wasn't functioning properly.
Our room was OK it was like a loft with a view of the marina which I like the furniture downstairs was a bit dated and the couch had a hole in the bag and one of the cushions was stained but other than that it was an OK stay.
Was disappointed that I wasn't able to play mini golf, but maybe some other time.
Went to Jimmy Guana's to check out the live music later in the evening,but ....was overwhelmed by cigarette smoke.
It was an otherwise uneventful stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The perfect  place to be and you better have paid a deluxe room (8th floor for me) with view to enjoy the best city  and Arch view

I did not had the chance to have breakfast  at the hotel , cause I found an amazing place near by. And about the staff : please this is a great hotel ok  great location  ok , great lots of things and the guys of the vallet service were so much kind thn every receptionist I had to deal with! It wasn't the worst I had but the repecption really needs to work on its way of customer service thing , that's not a bad comment, is to encourage.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went through the drive thru Friday morning a little after 7am on my way to work. Surprisingly there was no one in line. This was my first time at this location. I ordered a large iced coffee with one pump of vanilla and one cream, and a sausage egg and cheese wake up wrap. My coffee was made timely but as I drove off and took a sip of my coffee, there was definitely more than one pump of vanilla or they added sugar because it was way too sweet. This location is on a very busy road next to US 19 so I did not go back to get my ordered corrected. It would have taken too much time and I would have been late to work. My food was warm and fresh.

Wanted to try Bettina and had a few hours of kid free time. Decided to go and give it a try. I was squeezed in at the bar which was totally fine since I was riding solo. 
I'm a Vegetarian so I ordered a Margherita Pizza and 1 glass of Pinot. 
They were pretty busy but the bartender was attentive. Observed a couple of order mistakes next to me but were taken care of. 

My pizza arrived and was good. No real complaints. Was fresh! Pizza wasn't super hot considering it came out straight from the oven. 
All in all was a good experience and should give it a try. Good atmosphere, Pizza, glass of wine, and decent tip $40. Enjoy!

It's weird when your experience doesn't match the other reviews but I had no problem with my visit an hour ago. It was New Year's Eve so there was just a few people sitting at the bar and none in the dining room. The bartender took care of us and checked back several times. The cheeseburger and bison burger were excellent. Lots of tvs and a weird combination of music. More of a pub scene but that's what the area needs. I'd go back. Sorry others had a different experience. Maybe it's one of those hit or miss places...

Nice little find. It is in my opinion a very normal bar. I had a Manhattan. It was pretty good, nothing to complain about but that was about it. My wife had a Martini also pretty good. I guess if your just going in for a normal drink nothing fancy, pretty good place to go to. I don't think you will get anything out of this world just standard. I went on a Sunday afternoon, very quiet when we walked in we were the only ones there. Later it picked up. I probably wont go back. I think its a decent place for a mediocre drink, but I can get that anywhere.

Lucky I can't give you no Stars
This how you piss off customers over $15
