Car wash breaks after I pay for wash ok cool I should be able to redeem my wash when I get time to wash, I mean I paid for it, and you broke down when I happen have time to wash my car. WRONG 

Took two months and multiple emails to get a response to even dispute my claim.

So you email a "Free wash" to make up for break down and a upgrade to make up for the months it took to respond, BUT  I had to redeem 7 days from when the email was sent... TF!!!!

This coulda been easily handled but now I wouldn't recommend a toy car for a wash!

Came here while in town, cause why not? Its Coyote Ugly! But we made the mistake to come early, was pretty dead. Typical Coyote Ugly, bras hanging on the ceiling, bartender inviting girls to dance on the bar.

We came for the cheap $2 beers but didnt get them cause only broke college students drink  Pabst. We had some IPAs and just chilled and watch some bride maids girl have fun. Cool fun decor, sure this place is cool at night.

Was a pain to get service here, since the bartender was the only entertainment and she was busy dancing on the bar.

I'm sad to say that I will never be eating at Gino's again. Me and my family eat there all the time and we really enjoy the food. Unforunately I called tonight for Delievery and my street is one block out of there delivery zone. I asked if they could make an exception since it's literally one block and since me and my family spend a good deal of money there. The girl told me the owner wouldn't send the driver because of the neighbor changing. Not really sure what that even means. One block away is safe but apparently my block is not. Very disappointed.

I have used Buckingham Animal Hospital for more than 15 years. During this entire time i have had an opportunity to interact with all of the Doctors and most, if not all, of the staff  as well. Each of the doctors are wonderful, caring , capable & knowledgable individuals. The staff are also really really great & will go out if their way to answer questions or help when needed. I am rather fussy about my pets & as i have had several animals,  dogs & cats, it was important to me that they all received good capable care & treatment.  I am more than pleased with this group. It definitely deserves a 5 Star rating.

Great food if and when they give a sh!t. My friend ordered her with carmelized onions on the side and cooked extra well. We said this twice! They forgot them and when they did give us the onions on the side the were in no way cooked extra as they had a refrigerated temperature so basically f#%k what we wanted right? My order was wrong, it's fine mistakes happen. Then when I get mine after everyone else ate. I can only assume the small curly hairs were perfectly placed And i never once acted rude about the previous mistake. F#%*ing garbage and no one in there seemed to be management or gave a flip! Should be called the big shitty!

This used to be a good location but it has gone horribly down hill.  Firstly the washroom is beyond disgusting. I've been to cleaner campground outhouses. Second they got my order wrong and overcharged me twice. Third the napkin dispensers were both completely empty. Third the fries were way too salty.   I should qualify this review by saying it was completely empty when I came and a bunch of employees just standing around. 

I mentioned the washroom and napkins twice but nothing was done during the 30 minutes I was there.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I ate at Villa Barone for the first time this week and absolutley loved it. The service is great and so is the food. I must say that the bread and the oil dip served first is by far the best bread I've ever had! I was almost too full off of the bread to eat my meal. I had the Linguine, crabmeat and spinach and it was fantastic. Most places hardly give you and crabmeat with your meal but not here, it was loaded with meat. Villa Barone is BYOB just like almost every place in Collingswood because it's a dry town, so bring a bottle of wine or a small case of your favorite beer and you won't be disappointed!

COVID is only drive thru open and sometimes it can be a tad bit of a long line, but it's always worth it in the end. I am obsessed with these doughnuts. They are always so light and not heavy on the icing or batter like most doughnut places. I never had a bad experience and if you have the app they tend to do specials which gives more reason to go! They also have limited editions ones changing constantly. Never had a bad doughnut from there and if you go when they neon sign is it lit. It means they are making them fresh out the press! If you love doughnuts this is definitely a place you have to try!

This USED TO BE my favorite sushi restaurant in all of Tucson. They had an amazing all you can eat buffet. Even though it had some order restrictions, it was an incredible value. I just walked into the restaurant on what should be a busy Saturday night, the place was practically empty! That should've been my first clue! No more all you can eat buffet, and the menus don't have the prices for any of the items! When I asked the waitress, she said, "you order, I tell you and you pay." 

I walked out and headed to Sushi on Oracle!

Super Friendly New Owners 

They take pride in quality of Bread, ingredients and Customer Satisfaction 

I love how Friendly they are to Customers 

I had the Veggie Patty-Veggie Max. They warmed it in oven as well and added lots of veggies of my choice of the Italian Herb Bread with Pepper Jack Cheese. I also had the Jalapeño Chips. That along with Sriracha Sauce was perfect combo.

It was so delicious that I ate the entire 12 inch for the 1st time in my Life

It was very filling 

Plenty of parking and easy to find

I had my friend pick up an order that I had called in. 
I ordered a veggie soup, and a fried rice for my friend. 
The order was ready super fast because they weren't that busy.
The soup was amazing. It was still hot 20 mins after I got it. 
The veggies were all super fresh and amazing. 
My friend also had nothing but good things to say and about her rice. I'd say this place is an American Chinese style of cooking. Will be coming back have been a customer for many of years. Thanks for the great service keep up the good work.

I have two experiences with Bucas and Pastas -- one I would rate as 4 stars and the other at 2 so I settled at 3. We picked up some lunch -- very simple cafeteria style selection of pasta types, sauces and side items like meatballs. We liked the variety of kinds that we got. They also come with nice rolls and butter. We wanted to get some lunch for a little bigger group and called early in the day to see if they could cook up a lasagna for us. They were very short and said 'no lasagna just come and get pasta.' So we didn't.

Amazingly delicious food, made with high quality ingredients, perfectly prepared. Ordered the Chilean sea bass special - crispy outside and juicy, tender, and soft inside - melted in my mouth. Served with saffron risotto and roasted carrots. Husband had the bone-in pork chop special, also divine. Grilled calamari appetizer and katifi dessert, with complimentary limoncello. This place is BYOB so bring a good bottle with you and let the restaurant chef and staff do the rest. Excellent, friendly service.  We will be back!!

Burnside Inn is one of my favorite bars on Mass Ave! It has 3 floors that all have different vibes; the first floor has a player piano usually hosting live music and a bar, the second floor usually has more retro or country music and a bar, and the third floor has a pool table and extra seating with a great view of Mass Ave below. I love getting their lavender mules and hanging out on the third floor since it's generally more quiet and easier to have a conversation with someone. If you want a unique going out experience, you could spend your whole night in Burnside Inn.

I'm not a huge nitro ice cream fan to begin with, so I don't want to blame them for my own preferences. However, I have seen it done really well (Smitten in San Francisco is really good) and I think they are missing the mark beyond just the nitro style. The toppings seem fun but are a little stale and not super imaginative (besides the syringe delivery of the sauces). Given that the smoothness of nitro ice cream is what I think is unique about it,  a more minimalist, high quality toppings approach might highlight it better.

Tried it once and it is already my favorite ice cream spot in Tampa. Dense, creamy ice cream with flavors that are interesting and well-executed but not trying too hard. I've tried olive oil ice cream before, but this was the first time I was impressed enough to order a full scoop of it. Also loved the guava pastel, closely followed by the honeycomb and chronic popcorn. The staff were very patient and enthusiastic even while giving me all these samples and helping me through my lengthy deliberations about what to order. Reminded me of Jeni's quality with a local twist-- hats off!

I'd heard good things about Luciana's, so we stopped in after church.  Children shared nachos while the adults had carnitas and chicken fajitas.  The restaurant was crowded but we were seated quickly.  Our waiter was friendly and attentive, as were the food runners and hostesses.  Three stars because everything was.... fine.  Nothing was remarkably good.  I had heard rave reviews about the salsa, but we found it bland and runny.  To be clear, nothing was wrong with our experience- it just won't be our Mexican restaurant of choice.

We used to go to this El Rodeo all the time, and our recent visit reminded me why we stopped.  My margarita was good, but overall it was just meh.  No one finished their food (or took it home).  My carne asada tacos weren't anything special, and my husband said his carnitas were bland.  Our friend enjoyed his dish (a burrito), and may have finished it if the portion wasn't so huge.  So I guess that's a plus.  The service was spotty- we waited about 20 minutes for our drinks, and there was a strange rule  about beer on the patio. Terrible?  No.  But there are better Mexican joints in Indy, that's for sure.

I have used this car wash on and off since it opened. It is an okay car wash if your vehicles are not modified or if you don't care about your vehicles. The quality of work is unpredictable. Today, I took my new modified truck to be hand washed. I asked for a wash and vacuum. They used tire grease and used so much that once I left it splattered on the sides of my truck. And some how, they were able to ruin my front emblem on my truck, even with doing a hand wash. Like I said, my truck is new and there were no issues with it prior to taking it and now I need to get my emblem re-wrapped. I am not happy and will not be bringing my vehicle back.

Stopped in on our bar crawl down Bourbon St, came just as one band ended. There was a guy filling in between sets. He was HILARIOUS and knew the crowd. Sang a lot of classics and would hold out microphone so individual people could sing the next lines into the microphone. His ad-libs and mannerisms were also so krazy. Would 100p come back for him.

Bar was definitely crowded, but grateful that bartender saw me and got my order. Got beers at the bar for $9, including tip. Shots girls did come around asking if you wanted shots, but backed off when we indicated we didn't.

Bathroom is in way back, and it is so small. Hold your bladder.

Had several bad experiences at this location. They all occured with ordering after 6pm. I complained to corporate and the manager called me the next day to applogize. He was very kind and genuine and took the time to hear me. He sent me vouchers and thanked me for the feedback. I was really impressed how he handled himself.

This location is strictly breakfast only for me due to the experiences i had with dinner. I never had a problem with the brekafast meals or the staff there in the morning. They are helpful and plesant.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I understand that TD is trying to be safe but they are running the most inefficient process I have ever seen. 

Both ATMS are out of service. They are only taking customers by appointment. The drive through and virtual teller experience is awful. I've been waiting in the drive through now for 45 minutes and it looks like a circus in the parking lot. They are averaging about 30 min per car. Ridiculous. 
There has to be a better way. I've been to multiple other banks during this pandemic and have not experienced such chaos and lack of urgency.

Horrible experience and wasn't the first time. Called in an order for my wife to pick up. She got there In 20 minutes and was told we never put in an order and was belittled saying we called another one so I called them and said is this the location next to Wegmans using my call log and was told yes by same woman who took our order and was told we never called it. I have the screenshot of my call so much for the customer being right. Will never order from them again. Has happened before and service is terrible. Who belittles a customer rather than make it right.

I went to China Express this afternoon at 2pm and ordered one of the lunch specials. Picked up the Snowpeas and beef which came with pork fried rice, a spring roll, and an ice cold can of Coke . All of this was under $7.00 and everything was delicious and very filling. The Snowpeas were plentiful and tender. The beef was a nice amount and also very tender. I loved that there were a nice amount of water chestnuts in the dish too. Definitely a great meal and a nice price. I will definitely be going back again!

Went through the McDonald's drive thru tonight at 9pm and ordered a triple cheeseburger and a small order of fries. After paying at the first window, the girl at the second window asked me to pull up to the third window as they needed a few minutes to make the cheeseburger. It only took about 4 minutes and I was on the way home with my order. I've got to say everything was perfect. The fries were hot, the freshly made cheeseburger was really good! All the employees were nice and friendly too. Nice job McDonalds!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is my favorite place for getting take out! The food is better than many other Chinese Restaurants that I have tried. I love the roast pork egg rolls. Ordered 4 of them today and they were delivered screaming hot. Had to wait about 10 minutes before I could eat one. The flavor of these is fantastic. I also ordered a pint of the chicken with snow peas. This might become my favorite dish. Chicken is very tender and the snow peas were plentiful and cooked perfectly. Also tried their General Tso's chicken. It was the best I've had anywhere.

Not the best location, better go to one on cottman ave.At first they were slow. and it weren't even that crowded at 5-6 pm approximately. So I used coupon from app and got 5$ Dave's special or sum. My friend each paid 8$ and complained that it was expensive ( should listen to me and use coupons). So my one friend got her fries and they were greenish and one still had root in them. I should have took a picture. And they don't have refill machine. But it's only this location. 

Hope management will see it and do something.

Hmm so what to start with. Do it my first time in a long time that I tried McDonald's. Veggie were fresh, chicken had chicken meat, bread was good. 3  cuz something was missing. Sandwich was good for price, but that all. The main thing is pick up was confusing, not enough space, both ordering like and pick up is combined. You can't see the screen if ur order is ready or not. Some orders are being called some not. Mine was taken outside, even tho I requested pick up. If I didn't mentioned my number they wouldn't call me probably.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Came here out of curiosity. Been passing to and from work for a while and wanted to check it out.

Ordered a salad and the Chicken Sonata. Salad was good. The chicken entree was a way too big portion for one person, it was oozing off my plate. Was underwhelmed by the taste - ended up taking 1/2 of it home for re-heated lunch. Was actually much better the second day.  Over all, it was just 'okay'. 

If friends wish to stop by again sometime, I won't object. Might even try the pizza. But I won't go out of my way to return either.

One of the most premium sushi restaurants around. Yes, it is definitely more expensive than the others but it is for a good reason. The fish quality and overall food at Ooka is far more superior than any of the "50% off sushi" places around. They are 50% off for a reason, the fish quality is junk compared to Ooka. If you want some truly quality sushi and willing to pay for it, Ooka is the place to go. Also, the Willow Grove location is a bit cheaper than the other Ooka locations if you want to save the extra few dollars.

The staff are great: professional and courteous. They do their best to keep the place clean too. This review is negative because of the patrons:  Trash constantly thrown on the floor, despite the place having ample waste containers.  People using 2 - 3 different pieces of equipment at once so no one else can get anything done.  I tried to use a piece of equipment last week and some guy from across the floor came up and said he was using it and got in my face. Thuggish behavior - Gets old very quick. Clowns like this can ruin a business.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Dumpster fire. Was in lane 2. They proceeded to take 2-3 orders on lane 1 for every order they took on lane 2. To top it off, when I got to the order kiosk they couldn't hear me which meant I couldn't tell them my order until I got to the first window. That obviously slows down an already excruciatingly slow process.  On top of that I expect the food to be crappy as usual. Absolute disaster.

Just got to the window and got no apology or greeting from the manager that came to the window. 

I provide feedback on mcdvoice almost  almost every time and they NEVER improve. Absolute disaster. 

And to top it off my 10 piece nugget only has nine.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
If I could, I would give the place 3.5 stars. The chips and salsa are good. The service was excellent. My main complaint is that the spinach quesadilla that I ordered had canned spinach on it. Yes, that is correct. It was disgusting. How much does it really cost to buy fresh spinach? My friend ordered the taco salad which looked delicious. 

For dessert, we split some churros. I give that an A. They were fantastic and it was a large portion. 

The margaritas were an A also - not too terribly sweet. 

Overall I would return here but not necessarily go out of my way to go there. 

Please buy fresh spinach. The canned is like eating slime.

We came for happy hour and got lots of amazing food on the happy hour menu too! First of all, the service was ON POINT! The waitress was very sweet and the food came swiftly . Did I mention the happy hour sake ?! Omg it's actually two pours in one ; it comes in a sake box filled with sake. We got the entire happy hour and it was DELICIOUS! Very fresh and not over the top with sauce . The roles were light rice and a great amount of fish for happy hour ! We live a block away and we will be back often ! We are so excited to have a good sushi restaurant around the corner . Life is good. Ask for Jenna the server. She is amazing .

This is a new hand roll sushi bar that recently opened.  I was lucky to attend the soft opening.  The place is really small so I recommend making a reservation.  The food was great.  We ordered just about everything available on the menu.  Sorry, I forgot to take pictures.  I was just too hungry and the food was just too good.  My favorite was the Fried Yellowtail collar.  Most places broil the yellowtail collar.  This was the first time I had it deep fried. It was unique and different, and it was mighty tasty with the Yuzu sauce that came with it.  I would highly recommend this place and would definitely be back..

By far the WORST McDonalds around your order is never what you order, the staff is horrendous, ignorant, unfriendly everything you would expect from a fast food employee I guess...it's to the point where it is worth it for me to drive 10 minutes further down the road to then next McDonald's where they repeat your order back to you to make sure it is correct. Save your self the aggravation and go to a different fast food place...side note it baffles me when they say cert isn't items may take a few minuets to make... Maybe it's just me expecting too much all around
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
We tried this place because it was highly recommended so we drove a ways and picked up takeout for two - a lot
Liked the food but had issues. The Calamari was very under cooked and could not eat it. The wings were close but not quite done. Tasted  much better the next day reheated. Plus on the wings they just lumped the sauce in the box so it was really bare wings you had to try and dip in a clumpy garlic parm. 
On the other hand the Trio plate was great. As was the sausage. 
I know take out is tough and nothing beats eating fresh in the restaurant, but the food still need to be cooked till it's edible.

They didn't clean any of the stains on any of my clothes despite me showing them when I dropped it off. They still tried to charge me full price, and threatened to call the police when I said I did not think it was reasonable for them to charge me $70 when none of the stains were removed. They started saying racial slurs and told me I was a "cheap Indian" which was very hurtful. His wife started pulling at my purse to get more money. They eventually gave me $15 off the total and I got my cleaning done at another place.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Smart casual spot for wood fired pizzas, traditional drinks, and other Italian favorites. I went here in a group of three to try their restaurant week specials. I ordered the pear salad, the Sfinciuni pizza, and the cannoli for dessert. Everything was great overall. The only reason I didn't give this place a five is because I thought the pizza was a little dry, and the crust was slightly bigger than average. They also ran out of some items that night including one of the ice cream flavors and decaf coffee. Would go again to try different pizza options.

Tried the newish(new to me) location last evening, service was good, woman advised us that the special Tuesday drinks(Moscow mule)  was 6 bucks, but when bill came they were actually 7 bucks, when my friend ordered the burger , she never asked how he wanted it cooked and when he asked she said they come out medium.  Found most he food over salty (rabbit fettuccine, stewed pork) , meatloaf was awesome , and the pic is the 'medium' cooked burger that was served.  Appropriately it was comped.  Not sure it's worth the 20 min drive and parking hassle from south Tampa area.

I love this place! Best outdoor bar in the city. They have an awesome selection of beers on tap (which they give to you in a chalice- hilariously makes me feel like an old time king) and a full liquor bar as well. There are two areas, one inside one outside which is great for when it's raining. They have great varied seating (ie round tables, picnic benches, high tops) so you can find the perfect spot for your group size. There's also a section set up with cornhole which is so fun! As another bonus the food is AMAZING, I got the spicy chorizo "supreme wrap" and it was to die for. Would absolutely recommend you come!!

I've been to a lot of coffee shops in my day.. Every city I check out the best reviewed third wave joints.  I visit my family in STL every once in a while and am always looking for great coffee.  This place has it.  They also have one of the dumbest ordering systems you've ever experienced.  Pretentious, silly, annoying.  Let me take care of my business during one trip to the bar.  Don't make me wait twice at the bar, especially if you're going to chat it up with your buddies for 5 minutes.  I'll continue looking for a decent coffee spot when I visit.

This hotel is just ok..for the price it did what it was supposed to do. The beds were comfortable and it was close to everything we did. The staff were ok although the front door men could be a little more friendly. The room itself was not that great (a little small) bathroom was small and I had a great view of a brick wall. The ac unit wasn't working so well the room felt warm. Idk why everyone keeps saying the breakfast was good here. I didn't care too much for it or maybe I just caught it on the wrong day. All in all it was ok for two nights. Wouldn't book again though
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Tried Folk for dinner on Monday night and to be honest I was expecting a little more given the hype. For me this is a 3.5 restaurant but rounding up since service met the expectations of the group. Ambiance was relaxing and well decorated. Cocktails were worth the price. Pizza was good (4/5) but would have loved too see more traditional options on the menu. Now the shareable items I wasn't impressed with...we ordered the salad, beef carpaccio and the beans. I would rate them as average (3/5) and not really impressive. Overall we had a good time, did not feel rushed and enjoyed the meal.

This McDonald's is convenient to go to, and it is very clean. The service is hit or miss. Mornings seem to be the best time to come here. If I swing by in the evening I always notice the drive thru has lots of staff, but the order still gets messed up. Tonight I  saw my small cup of coffee pass two sets of hands and it was ice cold when they gave it to me. That meant that someone poured it cold and then put cream and sugar in it. Only one example. The food taste is McDonalds and McDonald's always tastes like McDonalds - nothing to review about that.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
The location was selected by the event we were attending. The proximity to the Farmer's Market was great. We could walk there! 
I was surprised that breakfast was still a buffet in this day and age. They did not have more foods that were sealed. All I would have was the coffee. A few breakfast bars would be great. 
No medallion upgrade for our Marriott level and no Marriott gift. (Yes-I asked.) 
Yes, it was clean. I requested extra pillows however we never received them. 
Overall clean. 
Would we stay again - yes - if that is the hotel selected by a family event. Otherwise, not our first choice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
There were 10 of us for dinner. The server had a great attitude. 
My husband got the stuffed mushroom caps with escargot - those were pretty good. And a Caprese salad. It was just okay. 
I got the peppered tuna steak that was supposed to be served medium rare - it wasn't. It was more we'll done. I was hungry and since we were such a large group I wasn't going to send it back. 
Our daughter got the ravioli and enjoyed that. 
Our son got the fettuccini with grilled chicken. It was a Huge potion. 
They have an extensive wine list. 
The place was very busy. 
If we lived closer it's not a place we would go back to for dinner.

My husband got the stuffed mushroom caps with escargot - those were pretty good. And a Caprese salad. It was just okay. 
I got the peppered tuna steak that was supposed to be served medium rare - it wasn't. It was more we'll done. I was hungry and since we were such a large group I wasn't going to send it back. 
Our daughter got the ravioli and enjoyed that. 
Our son got the fettuccini with grilled chicken. It was a Huge potion. 
They have an extensive wine list. 
The place was very busy. 
If we lived closer it's not a place we would go back to for dinner.

Pretty nice colorful authentic Mexican restaurant. The Queso with beef and chips .. . I would recommend their steak Quesadilla as well. Reasonable price on majority of the dishes. The tables we were given were not clean and it seems they were training a few waiters and hence when we were dining their focus seems to be on the training than the customer and hence we felt that they failed to pay attention to details. Overall we had a nice time and had a few hours to kill, since we just had to get some work done on the car next door at plaza tires.

This is one of the few bars that is all wood and non flashing lights with extremely loud music.  The bar tender knows her beer.  Will gladly provide samples for you to make a decision on.  This is a cool hang out place.  I was lucky.  Place got packed really quick.  I tried 12 different beers and really liked the Voodoo line.  However they have more beer types than the average person can handle. AWSOME.   I must say it does kick in after a while.  So drink accordingly and never drive.  I say Check it out and hang out.

Why would you grab the working end of the big spoon with your contaminated glove, place the lid of the container face down (the side that touches the food) on the dirty counter and then expect me to be happy with what you served me.  Why is it impossible for the person at the register to place the receipt in the bag, place my coin change in my hand first and then give me the bills--oh no, we must stuff all of it all at the same time into my hand so the coins can slide off the receipt and bills so I can sort through it all to put it away.  Morons, incompetent morons!

Our last time eating here!  Sat near the bar and watched servers and bar staff use their bare hands in the cherries, olives, etc.  One put a glove on to dig out hand fulls of olives then used wet gloves hand to screw the lid back on.  She then proceeded to use both hands (one bare) to stuff the olives--no hand cleaning was observed.  Bartender was adequate making one of two of my drinks--both on their drink menu.

Food was hot and good.  Kudos to the kitchen staff.  They were busy but staff not effective.  

Too many good or fine dining restaurants in the area to return here.  Sorry...

Avoid the all you can eat Sushi on Friday night. The food was good, not great. The service wasn't good. We were there for two hours. It over 30 minutes after we ordered to get our first round of sushi. No one came back to check on us for over an hour. Our drinks had all been empty for 45 minutes.  When inquired about the rest of our order, It was clear they had lost the 2nd half of our order. Then they brought us a tray of sushi that was not part of our order, but we were so hungry that we ate it anyway. 

In the end the bill for 3 people was $95 for food and 1 drink each. It would have cheaper just to order the sushi we wanted.

Service was friendly and they weren't busy, so it was nice. Atmosphere made it seem that we had to be quiet, like in a library or something. I had the Rafael Burrito and it was just ok. Actually, it was very disappointing. $9 for a burrito with no flavor at all. Our meal was $36 (just two of us) and we had two burritos and chips and salsa. $36!!! What???? I've had better burritos at Taco Bell. Not sure of the 4.5 stars! Anyways, won't be back. Also, the salsa is not good and the chips are store bought. We tried it. Should have went to HopCat.

Okay, four and five star reviewers... Have you ever BEEN to a REAL Starbucks? Or are you just buying bottled water here?

This is a franchised 'bucks, not a corporate one and it shows. If service was a vacuum cleaner, this place would be a Dyson. Seriously. Rude people that can't get a venti tap water right. Heaven forbid you try to correct them. Can you say stink-eye?

The store is beautiful and comfortable, but I drive all the way up to Marsh Rd where they know how to make drinks properly, they remember you after one or two visits and they're some real friendly folks to boot.

Perfect location co-located near the Mall near plenty of other shopping areas.
Service is always great, greeted at the door when walking in and always friendly smiles when taking your order. 
I ordered the triple (3) shot Americana for my morning boost! Can't go wrong with their bagels either. I routinely get them toasted, with butter and creamcheese.
When not on bagel kick, the banana bread it my Jam! :)
The parking can be crowded during peek hours, so keep that in mind.
As with most all SBUX stores, the inside is very clean and offers a great meeting place for business or just to catch up with friends and family.
Cheers!
Rob

This true Mexican authentic small gem is tucked away off the beaten path, behind the Toyota dealer with plenty parking outside. 
There is also a linear type bar seating outdoors. 
There was a gentleman playing some nice Mexican music and guitar while we ate.
The food portions were quite large as you would expect.
What stood out to me was the Rice water which was a first for me. Taste great like a thin milkshake. 
They had 2 for 1 margaritas too.
The soft steak tacos with cilantro are amazing!
There were 7 of us in our party and they had a large table to accommodate our group. 
Overall nice place to eat if you like Mexican food.

DO NOT USE THIS ENTERPRISE!!!!!! They don't even deserve one star. I rented a car from there because of an accident. Returned the car today and there were "new" scratches that somehow appeared in the 20 minutes since I left work and drove to their location. The guy checking in the car totally did this on purpose!  I will NEVER use them again and will spread the word about how underhanded and corrupt they are. The guy demanded that I pay them my $500 deductible then and there!  Are they for real?!  I pay my insurance company or the shop the deductible not them!  I raised enough he'll and refused to pay.

I think I have found great value for the AARP rate hotel in near Phila area. This is third stay and everything is great in rooms which comes with HD TV, refrigerator, microwave and most of all Luggage Rack for my suitcase. Breakfast is served with make your own waffles, egg/cheese patty and usual choice of breads , banana, yogurt. Best part is all items are constantly being refilled by waitperson. This is very amazing. I stay at least three to four nights in hotels each week and most places they stop refill fifteen minutes before close time and employees want you out I mean out of breakfast area!! Not here..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is what life during a tropical storm and COVID has come to, I'm reviewing a McDonald's fml. FYI McDonald's team NO mustard does not mean slather the entire sandwich with mustard. Come on you are serving burgers not curing cancer, get it together. Anyway I didn't return due to the storm, however the burger is sitting on my kitchen counter with the receipt and I will be back to get this fixed. Again thank you COVID for making me batshit crazy enough to keep a burger on my kitchen counter so I can return it!!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Meh. I can't understand the positive reviews for this establishment.

The plating of specialty rolls was colorful and exciting to the eye, but the flavor was always lackluster. For instance, we ordered the "Albacore Habanero Melt" for spicy lovers, but we're confused when we ate it because there was no kick to it at all. The toro we ordered was a bit fishy, and the uni appetizer we tried was skippable. 

This might be a good place for people who enjoy lots of mayonnaise, pesto, beet sauce, or cooked fish on sushi rolls, but it is not the place for me.

I loved checking out the Peacock room! The ambiance is awesome; very elegant and chic. This is a really good place for appetizers and drinks. (I don't think they have happy hour deals, so I wish they did). I got an Aperol Spritz ($12) and loved it! Our waiter was very attentive and kind. 

I would keep in mind that they only have 4 entreé options, so if you're coming here for dinner, I would keep that in mind. The Peacock Burger was very good and a decent size for a full meal! I do wish the Pimento Cheese and Tuna Crudo came with more bread/crackers.

Definitely a cool space but the coffee is overpriced. They have a nice selection of pour overs with very diverse flavor profiles but it's like $7 for 12 oz. I had the cold brew ($5.50 for 12 oz.) and it was pretty tasty but not $5.50 tasty. I guess you're just paying for aesthetics here. Staff were nice enough and lots of people were working/meeting so I will give it props for being a good space to stay for a while. All in all, it is good coffee, but I feel like the price tag reflects their perceived level of prestige, not its actual value.

Let me start by saying the service was exceptional. Incredibly nice folks that run the place, they treat you like family. The waiters were top notch and on point. Truly exceptional service. As for the food, it really is just average and it kills me to say it. My veal Marsala was very bland and chewy. The red sauce tastes like its from a jar of ragu from the store. The salad was not fresh and did not have good flavor at all. The only thing that was really good was the gnocchi. The service alone is enough to get me to come back and try again, but the price and low quality of flavor makes it hard to go back as well.

I have been grabbing lunch here off and on for years with mixed results, though mostly good. Tonight, however, it was horrendous. I ordered the tri-tip tacos, and they were inedible. The alleged tri-tip consisted of tiny little briquettes that were of the consistency of gravel. Because I had taken the meal home after a long hard days work, I was simply too exhausted to return the dreck and demand a refund, so I scraped off the charcoal and had veggie tacos instead. 

Beware and check your order before you leave if you deign to eat here.

Another fuel charge ripoff story.  Budget forced me to send my gas receipt after they erroneously added a $14 fuel charge on top of their already deceptive, hidden, and bloated "fees."  Their customer rep informed me it will now take an additional 3-5 business days to correct their mistake and remove the charge from my credit card.  This after I paid them $183.57 for the privilege of driving their "$66.00/day" vehicle a total of 25 miles in 24 hours  34 minutes (including the time it took me to top off the tank on the way back to the airport).  Recommend avoiding BUDGET like the plague for their price gouging and poor business practices.

Just went to the pool to sit in the hot tub. There is no hot tub. Fine, whatever, a swim will do. Look at my pictures to see the condition of the pool. Algae along the bottom and the outdoor pool was closed and appeared to have been closed for a long time. The bottom is covered in chunks of what appeared to be drywall and tons of algae on the outdoor section. If they would clean it, it would be a nice pool, but add a hot tub. 

This hotel gets worse and worse each time I try something new. 

Oh, and a double vodka drink (well) is $15. Sorry, but outrageous considering the rest of this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If you like a generic, south jersey style pizza joint, this place is for you.  Really, they have nothing interesting. I've now tried the sandwiches, salads, fries, wings, etc. How can you you go wrong with wings, make them flavorless and don't include the celery you claim they come with. My three strikes out rule will apply.  Boring, bland and I threw out more than we ate tonight. One plus, always delivered timely so if you're into fast over flavor, give this place a spin. So tired of sh*tty food around here.

When I walked in a female approached with an arrogant greeting. She polished my 10yr old nails. My daughter had to use the restroom and messed up her thumb. She asked the female to fix it and she was nasty and referred her to Tom. I was going to leave but I knew she wasn't going to be doing my nails or my daughters again. I was put at ease once Tom started working my hands. He paid very close attention to detail. I was pleased. He patiently fixed my daughter nails. It sad that the establishment almost got a bad review due to one unprofessional staff member. I noticed Tom and the other guy to be professional and give good service.

We were seated immediately as it was not at all busy. We waited about 10 minutes and another table was seated close to us. About 5 minutes after that they got their drinks while another table was being seated. 5 minutes after that the first table was placing their order, the second table was getting their drinks and no one had even looked in our direction! I said " excuse me" to one of the waiters, who ignored me. My husband went to the restroom and when he came out, no one had been to our table, so we left. VERY disappointed!!

I've often wondered why this chain is called Burger "King". King of what? Sales? That goes to McDonald's. Quality? Five Guys and In n' Out Burger run circles around these guys in terms of food quality and service. 

More like Burger Pawn. This location messes up orders, the burgers are often COLD, the wait staff doesn't talk to you...i.e. tell you how much you owe for your order, etc. 

Folks? Why do we tolerate such low standards? Vote with your dollar. I'll keep driving up to Warrington for Five Guys. Smiling faces, hot REAL burgers. I only wish they were closer!

The beds were comfortable. The breakfast was okay. The pool was small. Now having said all that. We booked three rooms. Security guard called up to the room to loud asked to turn it down we did. Who calls the cops, five of them, to a room where the oldest is 80 and the youngest is 37. I know the hotel called but a guest did also because the cops said they got a call of rowdy teens smoking and having a party. They said they were they to escort us out of the hotel.
When asked I feel like untruths were told. Needless to say 1st and last time. Some Happy Birthday.....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I decided to wash my 2 month old 2020 Toyota Camry at this car wash since U was driving past and it was a nice day.  When I got home I noticed that my front right fender was popped out.  I was eventually able to push it back I to place.  Then I discovered a 1" square piece of black fabric from the brushes wedged into the space between my headlight and the fender.  I've never had anything like this happen at other car washes.  Based on the other reviews they aren't maintaining their brushes well.  Avoid this car wash!

I want to love this place so bad but I'm about to give up. It's a very atheistically pleasing BYOB. The food isn't terrible but it's hard to justify the high price for the quality (especially when you compare to the other options in the neighborhood). We've tried almost every roll. I do no recommend the Yanako roll, ironically enough. Our favorite roll happens to be the green fields roll which is vegetarian- the interesting part is that my boyfriend and I love seafood so we're kind of grasping at straws when we order this veggie roll. We've left twice and gotten slices of pizza on the way home because we were still hungry after spending $60

As has been said - this isn't the best pizza in town. However I also grew up with it - and frankly the deep dish pepperoni is pretty impressive here.

Also the customer service is spot on - no matter what time of day. The store is stuck between a laundromat and a cell phone place - so you assume "great, gonna be rude people here that hate their jobs" - not at all.

Professional, friendly, and quick - really can't ask for much more out of a place like this where you stop for a last minute pizza. Good work all around - one of my regular spots because of it.

I just read the review where the customer took in her dog for one shot, and told the front desk that her dog was there prior 6 weeks ago and that her does not need an annual exam. When she was done they charged her for an annual exam because they said a doctor was present. 

This just shows me they are all about the money, especially when they examined the dog 6 weeks earlier. This totally turned me off to Stoney Creek Animal Hospital.  You start losing customers like this and little by little you lose more and more. 

Dr. Jennifer Johnson is NO longer there anyway, she sold this business.

Negative Stars!! Jake at Fitness 360 is the worst business owner I have ever met.  I walked in today and because I didn't smile a big hello to Jake he kicked me out, and cancelled my membership. He said the $10 I pay a month wasn't worth it. I have been training here for over 2 years, paying $70. an hour, $500 a month. Then he chased me in the parking lot to scare me. He is a little man. Sorry for all the members that have to put up with his enormous ego. There are a lot of gyms. Time to continue my health journey somewhere safe.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: If you have ever eaten at a Subway then you know what to expect with the food and the weekly sandwich deals. This location in particular gets packed during lunch but is generally quiet the rest of the time. Service can be hit or miss depending on staff available and they strongly urge you to keep the line moving to get in and out. The bathrooms and sit-in eating areas are not welcoming or pleasant which prevents loitering and lingering but detracts from the overall experience. Do yourself a favor and just do take-out from this location.

Upon check in to the JW Marriott, we were given the keys to a room that was already occupied. We entered the room, saw other people's belongings, then left and went back to the front desk. At the front desk, the Marriott member did not apologize for her mistake, she simply said "the system said it wasn't occupied". That is, after she finished texting and acknowledged us. When we went to our new room, we were given 2 double beds instead of the requested king bed. Additionally, all 3 rooms we were given (as we have 2 rooms for our stay) are the noisiest and are the closest to the elevator.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Disappointing compared to previous tenant's offerings.  No table service, no food other than beignets, no beer--just lacks a lot of the charm the Morning Call establishment offered.  Thought they promised to do some of this during negotiations?  They did keep the messy bathrooms.                                                                                                   
I am a very frequent visitor to City Park and live in the neighborhood. Hopefully they will improve and I can change my rating, particularly with the development occurring near there.

This is a good place for music and dancing.  I was here for a special occasion, not by choice.  Food is average.  The owner, Leo, is NOT receptive to any criticism of food.  I have a food allergy and was promised a meal that I could eat, however, there was cross-contamination and Leo refused to learn or listen.  Please be aware--food allergies can be FATAL and people can get very sick, sometimes immediately after eating.  I tried to explain things to him, hoping he would educate himself and his staff, but no luck.

The bad reviews are funny, I don't know what these people were expecting for $98 a night in New Orleans East. I for one was pleasantly surprised with this hotel. We ended up booking this room because it was the closest we could get to Bourbon Street that wasn't $250-350 a night. We knew we were taking a risk, but the hotel was actually not bad at all. The front desk employees were very friendly, the grounds weren't too shabby, the room was nice and clean, and even the breakfast, which was only toast, muffins, grits, fruit, cereal, coffee and juice was perfect after a night of drinking!
I will definitely stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We stop here for breakfast often before work. The food is always good and the service is nice. The 3 stars is pretty much just for the cleanliness practices behind the counter. 

Masks by everyone were worn either below the nose or completely on the chin while making food and taking orders. One girl walked across wait line while eating something, and then went back to make food wearing the same gloves she ate with. 
No matter your opinion on whether or not masks work, anyone serving food to others should show cleanliness in handling it. 

Also they forgot to give us the donut we ordered this time :(

Completely ridiculous, One kind of bread.  The poor kid behind the counter had no idea how to make the sandwich my my mom ordered, She has to make another choice.   So many toppings were out, I felt bad for the guy.  What an embarrassing situation to put someone in.  So many people we walking out, This is very unusual for subway.   Is there a manager that oversees the business??  If so, Where is he/she??

I am always floored when there isn't a response from an owner, This place needs to be shut down.  I think I will take this a little further.

$150 after taxes & fees for a shit stay! There was no toilet paper, the phone did not work, & the people next to us had a dog that barked until 4 AM. Tried to call front desk about toilet paper, but realized the phone didn't work...had a reservation so stopped and got toilet paper on our way back. Listened to the neighbors dog bark until they got back at 4 AM...called the front desk from my cell phone, they did nothing about it! The rooms are being remodeled and the one we stayed in was not bad. The bed was comfy!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Just writing this review, I am excited to go back here. Candidly, I felt like I just had an all-around okay experience. But since I have been there, so many friends have come to me and said how much they love it, so I am dying to give it another chance.

The food was good, no complaints, but my meatballs just weren't thaaaaat impressive. The eggplant parm was solid though. 

I loved the restaurant though - the aesthetic was cute and they have a quaint outdoor patio which is a nice breathe of fresh air being located in the think of the city.

Not overly impressed, not unsatisfied either. Just your standard Chinese cuisine.

The General Tso's chicken platter was good. Fried rice was full of veggies and the portion was great. Just thought the sauce was a bit gelatinous. 

The egg roll was again, very standard, nothing wrong with it.

Also had an order of the fried wontons, these were tasty. Perfect sweet sauce to accompany, and I received way more than I anticipated.

Overall, the pricing was awesome! So affordable for what you are getting. Could really see this being a great option for feeding the family or just a lazy date night.

I usually love Dunkin' Donuts but this location is a let down. I've come here twice, and had the same issues each time. All of the others I visit in Nevada as a truck driver have garlic or onion bagels, both times I've come here they tell me their discontinued. Not true since I had one yesterday in wells, nv. They also throw sauce on sandwiches with out even asking, a unusual setup compared to other locations. Just to top it off the plain bagel I had was super hard and the bacon not up too other locations standards. Doubt I'll be back a third time.

Came for the first time and was not impressed.  Had the salmon and grits. Salmon was seared with something that made it crunchy, not an unpleasant thing, but maybe it was salt? Because it was SALTY and the salmon itself wasn't seasoned otherwise so pretty bland.  The parmesan grits and broccolini were good.  Hubs had the fish tacos, he didn't mention them at all, so I'm guessing they were average at best.  The staff was attentive.  But for the prices of items, I will probably never go back unless their menu rotates and I see something I MUST try.

This has to be my favorite ice cream spot by far in St. Louis! With it being 10 minutes away from my place the ice cream never gets old and as soon as you walk up to the door you can't help but go in because of the smell. My favorites are the Brown butter almond brittle and bramble berry Crisp! Tried a new one today called Raspberry Rose Jelly Doughnut suggested by one of the employees and I was amazed! The waffle cones they make themselves and are very tasty! The employees are always nice and really care about the customer. I'll be going back next weekend lol

I've ordered from Zasu a few times and it's always good. This might have been the best yet. Ordering is easy online. You schedule your pickup time and they bring it out curbside. Super easy and convenient!

The salad was good. It was a salad. Not much more to say. Now for the exciting part. Lobster Pot Pie. It's not your traditional shortcrust pie but more like a lobster "chicken and dumplings". It's amazing. A rich, creamy sauce covering huge junks of lobster meat topped with gruyere drop biscuits. Big seafood flavor.

Zasu has an ever changing menu so you never know what's next but you can be sure it will be worth the money and the calories!

The mgmt needs to control the restaurant surroundings, as much as I'm sure they don't want to, every night there are multiple people obviously drunk or on drugs who are knocking on Windows in the drive through saying they need money and food and when mgmt is told they do nothing. This is discouraging. Also very very slow location DT is always backed up and lot is covered in trash. Nobody wants to eat somewhere or patronize a location that welcomes drifters to panhandle, as unfortunate it is for their situation, that is what churches and outreach is for.

I got an email yesterday saying my glasses were ready for me to pick up. I decided to call to confirm, as my hubby had gotten a similar email about his glasses last week, and when he showed up to retrieve them, they said, ooops, our bad; they're not ready yet. So, when I called, I was put on hold. Over 10 minutes later someone else in the office picked up the phone and asked if she could help me. So, I had to start from square one, because the person who had originally answered and put me on hold had forgotten about me and gone to lunch! That's two strikes and you're out in our estimation. Too disorganized and unprofessional.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
We were excited to finally try a restaurant we've heard so much about. 
Food was good but their Service and Operations were the pits. 
Waited 45 minutes for our order to be taken, another 30 for the food. I was given the wrong order but was too hungry to send it back. 
There appeared to be plenty of staff running around and some open tables, so we can't really figure out what the hold up was? 
When the server came by and asked if everything was ok, we said; "Actually, no. " He looked at us and said, Great! And walked away....
Restrooms were filthy.
Really dissatisfied with experience won't go back.

When my husband and I first arrived at this location, the line was wrapped around the building. We were very much deterred from waiting in the line. After making another stop and getting some drinks, we decided we still very much wanted ice cream and joined the line. We later found out it was a very small space inside so they are really only allowing 1-2 parties inside at a time which resulted in the long lines outside. I loved the trio sampler as it gave me the option to try a variety of flavors. The peach jam with biscuits was good but my favorite had to be the gooey butter cake. The ice cream was definitely worth the wait!

Been there many times and even the mgr is just not friendly or interested in customer service. Doesn't make you feel welcome. It's like they don't care if you get what you need or not. I try to give grace "maybe they are having a bad day" but every time I have been there this past month, the service has been atrocious. Y'all could do better. Be grateful that you are working because lots of folks don't get to do that anymore. 
This used to be a beloved place where I knew a lot of the faces and names. Not now. I hope for better days for this place.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Yup, it's all true. Dirty, long lines of deadbeat customers, aggressive panhandlers, rude and unfriendly service,  variable quality, etc... Sometimes the fries are hot and the bag is full, and sometimes they are luke warm and the bag is half full.

The prices on the menu on the wall are wrong. I read that a small soda was $1, but the cash register girl rang it up at $1.40. When I pointed out that the menu on the wall said a small soda was $1 she told me the menu is wrong.

I saw a dead cockroach on the floor.

Just go somewhere else. This place is disgusting.

Great Mexican food fast and extremely reasonable.

They now have a vegan menu as well :)

This time I went my daughter ordered a kids bean and cheese burrito it was $3.99 and she was only able to eat about half. These burritos are packed and look like full size adult meals.

I got the vegan nachos and the cheese was delicious. The nachos were filled with Soy meat, cheese, guac and beans.  Well worth the $10.00. ( I did add non vegan creama ) 

The Street tacos are about $3.50 and are the size of 2-3 tacos from other places.

We went for lunch on a Saturday. Thought the valet was complimentary, but turns out they had just stopped doing that. Not a big deal, but kind of a surprise. After waiting 45 minutes past our reservation time to be seated, we were not that impressed by the patio. I'm sure for dinner it's better since the pool would not be full of hotel guests, but for lunch it was loud and the views were obstructed by pool umbrellas. The food was good, but pricey. Overall I would definitely not return for lunch and am a bit hesitant about trying it again for dinner.

My fiancé and I love this place! We love the vibe and drive to this location specifically even though we have one closer to home. It could use an update, the curtains kind of gross me out but it's okay lol. We always get great service. The margs are never overly sweet and the salsa has a kick. You also have to order the queso with chorizo in it. We get it every time!! Their chimichangas come with the queso on the side so it is still crispy when you get it rather than soggy. We can usually split that and we both get plenty of food having the chips and salsa/queso as well. Highly recommend!

I have to say.. My food was amazing.. But not enough of it. I could have eaten dbl. what they served me.  I'm a little girl too. Our server was not attentive.. She never even told us her name.. She was rushing us all night. The runner delivered  to 4 of us.. Then we sat waiting for the other 2 to get there meals and I had to flag our server down to find out what was going on.  Then we got out check and I figured out that the grat. was added on.. No wonder she didn't care about our service. I wish I knew her name.. She was wearing red heart shaped dangling earrings... We won't b back

Long wait times and busy but they somehow make each customer feel like they are the only one. Took out of state vehicles on for PA inspection which turned out to be a bigger deal than I had anticipated. It took longer to repair 2006 Honda and cost a lot more but now it drives great and feels like a brand new car. They seem on the up and up and take credit cards. No appts so get there early or plan to leave your car all day (or two).  Thanks Jim K (Mgr) for helping to make sure my vehicles are safe on the road.

Usually, I'm up for a hole-in-the-wall, mom and pop Mexican restaurant,  but this left alot to be desired.

I ordered the 2 tacos with rice and beans. My husband had a burrito. The food was very bland for Mexican. The little toppings bar didn't have guacamole or cheese or sour cream, so that was disappointing. It had pico de gallo, limes and cilantro and that helped spruce up the tacos a little.

We also got the chips and salsa. The chips were really greasy and the salsa was mostly chunks of tomato and onion in tomato juice. 

I seriously doubt we'll be back.

Cool spot downtown, pastas were good & cooked properly (Cacio e Pepe was lovely). For drinks- the Old Fashioned was delicious. While some items were tasty, some weren't great. (Im finding a recurring theme with the M street restaurants). 

We were seated by the windows, which were gorgeous but my god, it was a cold night & it was so drafty. If you are like me, I have trouble enjoying my meal if I'm super cold. Bummer. 

Service was pretty good. Definitely give it a try if you are looking for a cool vibe. 

I'm feeling like this place is a solid 3.8 (but I'll round up).

I'm giving this Subway one star.  As another person wrote in review, t it is hit or miss on your sub.   Most of the time I order a veggie delight and at this store there is never enough toppings.  Been a huge subway fan for thirty years. Over the years I have seen the bread change and less toppings to my dismay.  But this store takes the cake on that.   Disappointed every time.  I still go because it is close.  I would never go there if I had more healthy options near by.   They would have a whole lot more customers if they took the subs seriously and maintained a dependable product!

I recently had the occasion to have my 60th surprise birthday party at Chiarella's Ristorante. Balloons and a surprise visit from my best friend topped off the evening. The waiters were attentive and the food was very good. It was a party of 8 and they didn't miss a beat. I was greeted at the front door by the owner and he made me feel like I was the queen. It's a nice, homey, "relaxed feeling" place. I met some people there who came from Jersey and loved it also. If your looking for a stuffy, quiet, frew-frew place, then you shouldn't go to Chiarella's. It's a down home, busy, busy place.

I really like this place for acrylic fills. Last time I went I decided I wanted a acrylic removal and a new full set in a different shape. The nail tech didn't want to soak them off, instead pried off each nail using a nail tip. This was extremely painful and my nails still hurt days later. The only reason I am giving 2 stars is the set looks fine. But I can hardly type or use my phone because the pain. I'm very sad about the damage done to my natural nail. Ripping the acrylics off is not standard practice. Soaking them doesn't take much longer and is way better for the natural nail. Disappointed.

This place is way overhyped. When I first moved to the area, I was told everything here was just THE BEST. Not particularly. Not awful though either.

The food is good, but not good enough to justify the price. The drink selection is millennial. Don't ask for a rum and diet unless you want a piece of bacon and a bottle rocket in it (or whatever the kids are into these days). The staff is generally standoffish or rude, mostly they act like they are better than you.

Anyway, if you want to check it out, go for it. Just be prepared for a hefty bill and a slight feeling of disapointment.

went for our 10th wedding anniversary, ordered the Chef's Menu cause why wouldnt you?  No words can tell you what you will experience.  It is fantastic and the best we had in the STL yet, and we have been to nearly all of the top 15.   Jordan, our server, was a walking chef.  He made us salivate before even eating.  He is also as jovial and connected to his clients as they come.  sorry we didnt get the names of the others that helped us, but Jordan's personality was infectious..  Personable and made our evening.

Not too expensive ice cream on a warm NOLA day that's wonderful to share on a date! We ordered two flavors: Cafe-Au-Lait and Lavender Honey. The cafe-au-lait simply tasted like coffee with milk and cream, nothing extraordinary, but hit the evening coffee craves. Lavender flavor is always a hit or miss for me, simply because I am always reminded of my lavender soaps! The honey sweetness came through, but this lavender flavor was a miss for me - my fiancee enjoyed it however! We also got a homemade waffle cone to go with it, which was not as crunchy as expected, but smelled really good.

Beautiful property. Well maintained. Great amenities. Staff is AWFUL!. They are rude and dismissive. There was one lady in the office who was sweet and helpful. Kristin has an Attitude and I didn't catch the name of the male manager I dealt with. He had a tree up his butt. You'd think I was a homeless person at the Pebble Beach Golf Club the way I was treated. Good luck getting a call back; I had to call until someone actually picked up the phone. The treatment I received on my first time here left a sour taste in my mouth. I'll keep looking!

Place has the good exercise equipment like most planet fitness. Not very clean. I find they wipe on occasion but if there's dirt and layers of dust in between the gear, how clean are they? I do not like the contrary message management sends either. Telling masks are optional! Really? But yet they wear them. How can the planet fitness website says they care about our health when they opt out. Funny huh?!?! Spent a year without planet fitness because of the pandemic. I guess they want your money more than you being healthy. 
There's other PF out there so we will find a cleaner, healthier place.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I went to the Fireside Lounge several times and I like it. Lots of seating area, small circular booths, and you can sit by the fire (my favorite!) and its very nice. They play music videos around that fire area and the volume is not that loud so you can still talk. They had a full bar and the waitress usually checks on us to see if we need more drinks, etc..Service was very good. Prices is decent, similar to the other bars. Its a nice place to hangout if you'd like to stay away from the casino noise. Definitely recommended. Oh, Adios cocktail was amazing !!!

So I'd give this a one star or less yelp is very political and I'm not sure this will be added literally just ordered woman at register with glasses was scarfing down a muffin as she was taking my order and answering calls then she proceeded to make orders after her hand were in her mouth from muffin savaging. After cooking someone's order with fries she picked a few with her bare hands and wrapped up the order as if I wasn't there. I asked her to use tongs I was dismissed I won't eat here most Chinese places seem to not care about this issue I'll gladly take a recommendation for a cleaner establishment I'll suggest passing on this place

This is my first-time trying out this buffet. I like how it is 24/7 and the place is self seating which I enjoy because in able to pick my own seat. My first impression was there wasn't much of a food selection but enough to make your belly full. Very simple salad bar and meat selection are minimal. They have fried chicken, pork chop and pepper steak. They have an ok amount of desserts such as brownie, cornbread, and pies. But for $13.99 and a free refill on soda, I can't complain. 

The service was good and the staffs were friendly.  If in the area around or hungry in the middle of the night I will come back to this place.

I just love love love  McDonald's!!

I crave their cheeseburgers & fries!  Hubby got  me the Big Kids Meal that comes with a toy (it was the red car from the Disney Movie "Cars" ). My dog was very happy for that. 

When I ask my kids what they want, I sing the song. I can't help it. 

"Big Mac, Filet of Fish, Quarter Pounder, French Fries, Icee Coke's, Thick Shakes, Sundaes and Apple Pies. And the Cup ran away with the Spoon. Yeah!"  

Sorry, I couldn't help it. I can't believe my kids don't recognize this song. I guess I am giving my age away. 

5 Stars ALL the WAY FRom Me!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I received a gift certificate for my birthday and decided to make an appointment. Upon arrival, no one greeted me at the door. I was confused as to where to go or who to tell that I had an appointment. Once I told them I called in advanced I was seen. The staff was not friendly or warm at all. The salon itself is nice and trendy but the mood was very strange. It was tension between the staff and the manager and there was lots of whispering and side eyes. It was very uncomfortable. I got the gel nail manicure ($30) which I thought came out nice. I would not go back again, unless I received another gift card.

I was excited to spend Valentine's day with my husband at Brickside Grille; made the reservations almost 2 weeks in advance and yet, when we arrived, we were seated in the 'overflow' section of the restaurant (to the right of the lobby).  That would have been find EXCEPT that everytime a car started up, we were blinded by the headlights-see the photo.  Not only that but the filet mignon I ordered was a very poor piece of meat-I could have gotten a burger at McDonald's and it would have tasted a lot better!  I will definitely not be coming here for a long while.  Very disappointed!

I have to say I'm a pretty big fan of habit burgers, and the original habit on Hollister makes them the best. I've frequented quite a few habit burgers throughout SoCal, and others seem to leave the burger buns on the grill too long or overcook their onion rings. This one consistently delivers satisfaction for my cravings. 
Also highly recommended if you're looking for a quick milkshake! I can't say it'll beat a freshly made McConnell's shake, but it hits the spot better than almost any other. The oreo is my favorite.

Didn't even know this place existed until this past weekend when it happened to show up on a google search for new ice cream shops!  My boyfriend and I went and had the soft serve cones and got a doggie dessert for our pup :) (complete with a cute dog biscuit on top! how adorable is that!)

The soft serve was delicious!! The doggie dessert was also too cute! My only complaint is I wish they had smaller sizes for smaller dogs (we had to eat some of the ice cream before giving it to my dog, not that we complained getting a little extra ice cream ;) but still) overall, we  will definitely return!

I wish I could rate this place higher I really do :( my boyfriend and I were SO excited to try this place because the menu is EXTENSIVE and looked so awesome.  Tons of flavors and loads of sundae combinations and the option to create your own.

Here's my problem.  The workers there are not the brightest.  I ordered a sundae but asked if they could change the ice cream to cookie dough instead of cake batter as I HATE cake batter ice cream.  They confirmed and wrote it down and I still got cake batter ice cream.  COME ON. And they would not make it right.  I was very upset and honestly most likely will not come back here.

Great food! Downside is the wait and acknowledgment from the staff. I totally understand such good food will likely have a wait, but the staff seems to discourage it. It's like they want you to leave. If you do have the time to wait it out you have to be prepared for another wait for food. It takes on average about 45 minutes for a entree on an average night there. The last time we went the server finally said after an hour "the order didn't make it, but I will take care of your drinks....do you still want me to put it in?" Hopefully they can get some help!

The property is dingy, trash cans stuffed almost to overflowing.  Staff was surly and apparently annoyed by having to prepare food for paying customers.  The fries were a bit sad, like they had been made some 2-3 hours ago, though they did almost taste like Rally's fries.  The Big Buford, which I was certain was my favorite drive-through burger, was limp, dull, and bland; but at least it was served lopsided on a soggy bun.
I hope to retain faith that Rally's as a whole maintains a higher standard of quality.  As for this location, it has left a bad taste in my mouth.

Hands down the best pizza in the Carmel area! Even one of the best pizza I have ever had! We tried Lou Malnati's a few times in Chicago, this taste exactly the same!

We ordered a Chicago Classic style, the sausage is so flavorful but not greasy. Tomato sauce is very fresh, taste freshly made. The crust is very crispy after taking the pizza home, it is still very crispy the next day when I heated up the leftover slice in the oven. The mozzarella cheese is very tasty and high quality. 

The pick up process was a breeze. It took us less than 10 mins from the time we arrived the parking lot until we picked up our pizza. Highly recommend!

Some good, too much bad. Cheese plate was very good. Nice variety, good quality. Butternut squash soup so sweet it should have been a pie. Oysters good. 2 friends ordered salmon. So salty, they sent it back. 2nd try, it was not cooked. Sent it back and settled for sharing. 2 friends ordered steaks and liked them very much. I ordered crab cakes which while tasty, were supposed to be lump meat, but were not. Served with bok choy and lemon aioli. Nice complement. Cheesecake was dry. Cappuccino was terrible. Very watery. Pricey meal, so the expectation is top quality start to finish. We were disappointed. Our waiter was good!

This was the second time I have eaten here. The first time I had the American Kobe Cheeseburger. It comes with a very delicious tomato jam, which is all I put on the burger because I wanted the beef flavor to be the star of the show. It was juicy and  cooked to perfection. The next time I came back I ordered the Tablerock Cobb salad. And it was amazing! With smoked trout, candied bacon, ballard 
cheddar, pickled egg, white beans, green 
onion, tomato, and a huckleberry vinaigrette! Again, it was amazing! Everything on the menu looks really good and I look forward to coming back again. Next time, perhaps the Bison Meatloaf!

We probably got here around 3 o'clock in the afternoon on a Monday wasn't that busy there were five of us we sat to the left which is not the main part of the outdoor seating but it's shaded and service was bad. They forgot one of our lunches and it took a really long time to get the bill. A couple of us had the crabcake sandwich I wasn't really that good it didn't have a lot of seasoning and the spicy mayo has horseradish in it one of my least favorite things. I'm sure will give them another try but this time definitely not up to par.

Super excited to try this place but was a little let down unfortunately. 

The elotes were AMAZING! My husband and I were huge fans! The guacamole and chips were good also along with the beans. 

My husband liked his chicken enchiladas with green sauce but said they were dry inside. 

I got the chicken fajitas and was super disappointed. The chicken was so dry it was almost inedible and the chicken, peppers and onions had no flavor at all! 

Will probably go back again to get more elote and give some other dishes a shot.

I was in there a few weeks ago for my annual eye exam.  I never received a phone, email or text reminder.  Luckily it was on my calendar.  The staff was having a very tough time with the new computer software upgrade.  Their computers kept crashing.  They need to purchase new hardware to handle the new software.  I thought it was quite odd that everyone, including the doctor, I dealt with was talking into their collar.  It was very Orwellian and kind of creepy.  Not sure I want to return.  I can't be impressed with a practice who doesn't consider their support staff when "improvements" are made.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Great things about this place prior to washing their these stations with long brushes that you can do a quick once over with clean soapy water. After you have your car washed you can utilize the free vacuums, fresh towels and cleaners at each station. Couple downfalls it's a bit pricey and if you could see from the pics my husband paid and extra three dollars for the tire shine and pics speak a thousand words  DO NOT GO ON THE WEEKEND ITS MOBBED. I would never go back there however he would just because of the convenience but he's never paying the extra for a tire shine.

What's not to like about this Safeway? The products are always plentiful and the staff are very nice. Since I'm from the US, I didn't know about the separate liquor stores and there's one right next door in the mall. 

Being from out of town, we appreciate the local goods that are made in Canada. Snack items, cookies and such are great. The liquor store next door: it's Canadian Merlots. Always a crowd pleaser as with the rest of the mall.

At least your Safeway is a heck of a lot cleaner than my neighborhood Safeway.

Whelp..... I gotta say I was a bit disappointed unfortunately.  The food wasn't as good as I was hoping.  Food seems to have been sitting out for a bit too long.  The selection is ok.  But nothing to write home about.  The servers seem nice.  They smile a lot which is always pleasant.

The restaurant is clean.  Bathrooms were clean.  But overall.... not a place I feel like I would really want to come back to.  Sorry... not for the top of my list.  Looks like we will keep looking for a Chinese buffet place to call home.

I've heard and read a lot of really great things about  Little Nonna's and it didn't disappoint! We arrived about 10 minutes late for our reservation, but it wasn't an issue and we were seated right away. 
We sat in The "outside" garden area which was tight, but really cute overall with lights strung overhead. 

All of the food was great, but the wild mushroom arincini and the Bronzino were the best parts of the meal. The Bronzino was quite possibly the best I've ever had. We ordered the tiramisu for dessert which was okay - not great, not bad. 

Overall, great experience and I'll definitely back!

Renter a "premium" class car here. Received a base model Chevy trax that was 5 years old. Half the radio buttons don't work. No cruise control, power seats or anything. I'm also not real sure how safe it is. It's pulling to the side a bit and shakes whenever I stop. Something is broken or out of balance. 

They should never have attempted to give this out as a premium car. An economy car maybe but even that's a stretch. Now I'm told they are sold out can can't swap it with anything. 

Very unhappy, do not recommend especially when there are several other companies at the airport with better cars within a few bucks of these prices.

Don't try to hide from your name Fessparker. No worry, I added my original review below so you can't just change your name and hope to get a new yelp score...

---Original Review---
Oh you wanted air conditioning?  Negative
Oh you wanted good smelling rooms? Negative
Oh you wanted good food? Negative
This place is a joke and I challenge any employee to tell me differently.

You can't hide behind a beach forever.
Hilton should drop the property immediately

My experience there makes me never want to stay at any Hilton ever again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
