Terrible. DO NOT go here. Rented a Toyota rav 4, and after waiting two hours for my vehicle- they tried giving me a huge mini van. I told them this isn't even comparable to what I ordered. Now I'm waiting an additional unknown amount of time for the vehicle I ordered and HAD A RESERVATION FOR- they won't even tell me when it will be ready
I will never do business with Hertz again and you shouldn't either. this has pushed back my trip at least 3 hours 
How are you going to make a reservation on a vehicle you don't even have?

At first glance the restaurant is beautiful with a midcentury modern theme.  We had the charcuterie board as an appetizer which was great and well appointed.  There was a small snafu with them giving us the wrong cheese--Apparently they were out of one of the cheeses we selected and I wish that they had notified us rather than just trying to make a switch and hoping we didn't notice. The Sea Bass was a bit dry but the salmon was very good. Pastas were also very good albeit a but salty for my liking. I gave it three stars for now based on my experience but hopefully they will get some of the kinks worked out.

My in-law's were in town from New Jersey and they wanted boiled crawfish, so we took them to Pepper's. They were not crowded and they were adhering to all COVID protocols. 

There were 4 of us and we ordered 8 lbs of boiled crawfish. They were so tasty. They were spicy, but not too spicy. We also ordered corn, sausage and potatoes and they all had the spicy flavor of the crawfish. 

We met the owner, Jodi, and she told us the history of the place. The recipes are all hers. 

They have daily specials and we were even able to make requests for upcoming weeks. 

We will definitely go back.

love love love LOVVEEEEEEE Jeni's Splendid ice cream. I love the ice cream itself... I eat it by the pints from Publix! This is my first time at this location and it was nice! Decently sized, they had tables to sit at to enjoy your ice cream. I had the 3 scoops with the waffle cone, it was so so so good but I love all Jeni's flavors! No matter the location I just love the ice cream itself. But it was clean here as well, and the workers were friendly and patient. It gets 5 stars because the ice cream is delicious, the workers were nice, prices are decent and location was clean!

My wife and I occasionally have Friday night dinner her with our friends and neighbors.  The only reason we go here is because our neighbors really seem to like it here and it's close.  Would not go on our own as it is VERY challenging to get service in the bar on Friday night.  Food is Indiana - Mexican average and service is less than good.  C- at best...  wish we had better Mexican food and service in Fishers.  If you are looking for a strip mall Mexican so-so food with hard-to-find parking and not enough servers who are less-than attentive, this is the place for you!

Whoever owns this dunkins needs to stop in evey now and then. I have visited 3 times in the last week and it is always a complete mess but today was the worst. 
The store was very dirty. Donuts on the floor. Very few donuts to choose from. Napkin dispenser in dining area empty.
The girl behind the counter was face timing her boyfriend. Another Afro-American male employee came in from his break and referred to his friend as "nigga" and was dropping the F bomb. I don't see this location lasting much longer at this rate.

It's the perfect little place on a Friday night after work with family or a Saturday evening with friends, or even, as I found out, a great option when an out of town friend arrives as we were under hurricane watches (rainy and windy outside, cozy and delicious in!) 

Update: March 26, 2020
I returned last night to pick up my favorite pie. They had set up the cutest little table outside for curbside pickup, due to the coronavirus pandemic. They had an awesome set up, complete with wipes for everything, and little condiment cups of their signature bubble gum, offered at the end of each meal. I just love this place!

Not my first visit , never really a bad experience the food is good , atmosphere is good , prices are okay . 
So i ordered the machaca chimichanga & i was a bit sad on the portion of it as you can see in my picture , i will say it was okay , not really machaca'ish , i felt it was more like a birria chimi . I had to order rice and beans on the side i hate when they make you do that . The waitress was fast nice and made our night out a good one .  The beans were fresh as can be ' im a big rice guy but it wasnt so good .

Sushi ten sushi ten i think sushi ten is thee first two words that come out of my mouth when i hear someone say sushi. It is my favorite sushi spot to go to when im needing the fix , very very good sushi awesome portions i never feel cheated , the waitresses are the shit besides the Chinese nana lady who tried to steal my trippy pen but other than that ive never had a bad experience , happy hour happy hour happy hour i cant say it enough how important it is to go when its happy hour once again HAPPY HOUR ! Lol best sushi spot in tucson !!

So.. just wanted to warn people.. don't give your bank information to Anytime Fitness.. OMG. It has been awful trying to get them to stop. Also, they say.. no contracts.. no cancellation fees, however, you have to give 60 days notice to cancel.. sounds a bit like a cancellation fee! They also hit me with some kind of a gym fix up fee,  two months after I joined.. what?? I spent more in 3 months at Anytime Fitness than I did in a year for my whole family at Planet Fitness.. Just a little frustrated.. needed to vent. Back to Planet Fitness for me.

PS.. the gym is pretty standard.. certainly not worth the amount of money they charge.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Well, I try to give my honest opinion when I try places I have never been before. This time I will have to tell you how disappointed I am.
Ever since I saw the " chicken salad sandwich " on the tv advertising it I couldn't wait to try one.
Today was that day..
First , the sandwich is made from 2 pieces of wheat bread which is fine but I could of done that at home.
Second, where's the chicken salad?????
Third, all lettuce.

I also had the orange shake/icee.. it was good.

So since I have been home, 6 hours ago, my stomach has been upset. Will I go back for another. NO!!!!!

So disappointed.

If I could give this no stars, I would.  Just went today for my birthday lunch.  Finishing up my soda before returning to work; get to the bottom of my cup and THE ICE IS FULL OF BUGS!  When I showed the restaurant folks the cup, the staff decided that a swarm of flies must have flown into my cup while I was drinking.  Clearly not the case.  I think I would have noticed if any bugs were swarming me and why did not a single bug fly into my companion's drink!  DISGUSTING and an unacceptable response from the restaurant.  I will never be able to eat here again.

We really enjoyed our visit to this place! We heard about them from all over and were stoked to try their famous coffee and beignets. The beignets are delectable! Cafe du mond is located in a perfect spot, city park! You can grab coffee and walk, or sit and eat! We did both! Sitting to eat, before strolling around. The coffee is strong, and super tasty! Our one complaint is that there are no dairy free options for coffee. So while the coffee tastes great and the scene is amazing, the coffee definitely upset my stomach afterwards. I would strongly suggest adding nondairy options for those with allergies or sensitivities!

We were doing something down the street, and saw this on Yelp and came to check it out. We got there right when they opened thankfully, because more and more people kept coming in the door after us.
We did edamame, miso, and four rolls. They were all delicious. I especially appreciated that the spicy tuna roll actually had a kick.
The only not great part was my husband's roll had a small fish bone in it--but not a big deal. The presentation is gorgeous, and the food is equally yummy.
On a side bonus note, also loved that they don't do the disposable chopsticks and didn't automatically put straws in our drinks (pet peeve of mine).

We got here tonight and were greeted with great service. They immediately checked us into a room and accommodated our special requests. They went above and beyond. 

We got to our room and it was immaculate. GREAT views of the arch and the Mississippi River. Can't wait to wake up to this tomorrow. If only we could stay longer! 

Have been on the fence about joining their reward program as the husband and I have been shopping several hotel options and I think we were just won over. Looking forward to many more Regency stays, hopefully more here in STL! Thanks to Nick for his service at the front desk. 

Again, highly recommended.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Stayed here for a week for a conference. The location of this hotel is amazing as it is attached to the convention center and walking distance (or scooter distance) to anywhere you could want to go downtown. Although they did not have daily room service, it was super quick and easy to get what you needed upon request while passing the front desk on the way back to the room. I was able to obtain additional towels and toilet paper. 

The room was super clean and we had no issues. The bar at the hotel had decent food and great drinks. I would definitely consider staying her again if I ever return to Indianapolis.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Do not go to this nail salon. The manager, Linda, isn't friendly and doesn't care if she hurts you. My daughter had set up an appointment for us to have pedicures and get our nails done, 2 weeks in advance, for her wedding.  They called her less than 48 hours before our appointment and told her they  couldn't do my nails because I wore them too long. WTF!! It's a nail salon. They should be able to handle nails of any length!!! We've been going to Canyon Nails for almost a year, every 2 weeks like clockwork, but we won't be going back!!

There are surprisingly not a lot of true frozen yogurt spots in the city. But hey, one great one is enough. I have only been here during the pandemic so I haven't experienced creating my own bowls, but hopefully I will one day. Their options are a bit overwhelming, they have Frozen yogurt, Sorbet, Gelato, Milkshakes, Cookies, Custard, and loads of toppings. I have had the yogurt, custard and icecream. I prefer the Yogorino yogurt which has a nice tartness and the Custard. All of the flavors are great, you really can't go wrong. So if you have that frozen treat craving, head on down to south street, you won't be disappointed.

I want to love this place.  I know the story of how they got going and really want to be blown away.  I've been there 5-6 times over the last year or so because many of my friends want to go.  I have yet to have anything outstanding.  Everything is just okay.  Not bad but nothing I'd say ,"oh my God!"  

Just yesterday we stopped in.  I had the Mid West Whiskey Pecan and the Banana Cream Pie scoops.  I tasted no whiskey or bananas.  Seriously- if you're going to put WHISKEY in the title - I'd suggest dialing up the whiskey.  What they should have been called was "Unremarkable Butter Pecan" and "Vanilla with yellow streaks. "

I expected better, to be honest. $20/person to park started off the rather unmemorable experience. There's no direction signs to show you where the front desk is so I stood for a couple minutes like a moron. 

The room was gorgeous and modern and spacious with plenty of light. The bathroom was large and well appointed. The bed was lovely and comfortable. 

But. The WiFi is expensive, they charged $1.99 for a local call made from the room, and the tub was narrow for a soaker. Everything was outrageously expensive, which I expected. I didn't expect so many nickel and dime tactics from a superior-rated hotel. Honestly, I don't think I'll be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: During check in the counter person did not great us, did not acknowledge us and continued to work on something while we stood in front o him for several minutes.  Pricey weekend rates, the shower did not regulate the hot water well and got really hot, units were clean, beds and pillows were comfy and not worn out like other places, great basic place to stay with modern upgrades in room such as HD tv, improved lighting, bathroom counter and sink, plug in outlet switches and power slots for USB charging.  Location was close to shops, restaurants and beach areas.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: After moving to this area last year, we have been searching for a nice restaurant with good food where we could converse with our dinner companions.  Last night we located it!  Bazil's not only has delicious food prepared just right but the service (Sean) is also excellent.  The antipasto salad served family style (i.e. for 4 guests) was lovely with tasty dressing, the pasta/bean/tomato soup which came next, also very nice.  Then the entrees, spaghetti/meatballs for me, clams with angel hair pasta for my husband, chicken piccata for our friends were all appreciated along with the bread.  We will return as they say!

I love the habit location near my hometown! This one kinda disappointed me. At this place last year the #1 combo was 7.25 but it's now raised to 8.25 not including tax. Which is fine to me I guess cause of inflation. The food was also served pretty fast (came at 5:30pm). When I ate it the bottom piece of bread was sooo cold cause it was touching the lettuce and tomato. But still it should not have been that cold. And there was a lot of sauce so the burger was mushy and soggy. Still, it tasted decent and the fries were good. Just disappointed at the quality of my burger but I'll be coming back bc. It might have just been that one day.

We go here for the crab leg nights on Wednesday.  The wait staff is a hit or miss.  The bartenders do have to work on serving rather than paying attention to a selective few at the bar.  

We tried the seafood feast that occurs the first Friday of every month.  I was told when I called that I had to make a reservation for the seafood dinner because they go quick.  I don't know why the reservations were necessary since we were the only two in the busy place eating seafood.  Perhaps the other 18 orders were coming in later in the night.

A good place to hang out and have a few beers with friends and the Phillie games.

Tuesday and Wednesday is half off sushi. That's it. That's the review. Just kidding lol. If I'm in the Avon area I definitely stop in for the sushi it's delish (and cheap). Our server was a little persistent in taking our order and after a long day of work we were kind of in the mood to relax and take it easy. Everything went well our food came out good, we ate and left. I've only been for the sushi and Haven't experienced the cooking at the hibachi table. When we left around 7pm it had gotten quite busy. If you want some inexpensive su

So many of these negative reviews are about things that should be expected on opening weekend. So here is an honest opinion about what's important, the donuts! I got here at 730am, no line, packed display case, friendly staff, and a beautiful view in store of all the donuts being made fresh! It was beautiful to watch that glaze coat a fresh batch of donuts. Everything I tried (an assorted half dozen) was fresh and flavorful. Personally, they were super sweet and a bit heavy handed with the glaze, but that's just my preference.

I rarely give 2 star reviews, but this place was so disappointing. They have a nice selection of donuts, and in the case everything looks good. I got 3 donuts; glazed, chocolate frosted cake donut, and a blueberry jelly filled. $3.50 which is the normal donut price so no issue there. That's where the fun ended. The actual donuts were all stale. For a Saturday morning at 8am I was shocked at how tough and hard the cake donut was. The yeast donuts reminded me of the ones you can get in a grocery store or gas station. There are a handful of good donut shops in town, this one won't be getting any return visits from me.

Because of the covid restrictions we weren't able to taste any of the flavors before buying, which is a bit of a shame as you kind of have to gamble on your choice. I'm not a big ice cream person so I don't have a standard go-to flavor.

I had some sort of coffee/dulce combination which was too sweet for me but nice for a couple of bites and partnered well my espresso (purchased elsewhere). I preferred my friend's choice which I think was pistachio and white chocolate.

I've seen other reviews about portion sizes being small but ours were definitely generous. Customer service was good too.

This place popped up on my instagram explore feed and I was lured in by the interior design. We came at 9am on Sunday with no reservations and were seated promptly at the bar.

- Beet cured salmon on rye: 5/5
This was SO GOOD. So many unexpected layers to the dish and beautifully presented. 

- Baked eggs: 3/5
This was a typical hearty breakfast option. It was filling but I thought it was lacking in the flavor department.

Would love to come back one evening to try the dinner options. Service was great and looks like it would be a great spot for date night.

The location is decent, good cars slightly overpriced but you can get a good deal depending on who you see. Shuttle service takes too long and the lines can get crazy. **WARNING** stay away from the buck toothed ghetto lady on the far right corner at the main counter, this ones got an attitude and a nasty facial expression if you disagree with her. Don't expect a smile in return or a "hello how are you doing today" unless you were ghetto or from the area [*hint*]. Overall the rest of the employees are fantastic, if only they got rid of the troll then I would give them a 5 star.

Stopped by today for lunch. Won't make that mistake again, employee' that took my order, laughing and not focused,, employee at window number one to take my money, didn't say hello or thank you, window number two same thing. Probably felt as unappreciated as a customer could feel ....no hello, no thank you nothing. Worst forms of human life on the planet. And the quality of the food was poor like the service. There's a Wendy's across the street although the line was wrapped around the building, people probably interested in that fresh never frozen beef not like the garbage customer service and food they are serving here.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Very inconsistant. I had good...then bad Steak Dianne...the bad was mushy steak that tasted like it had been around a while and tasted like waterlogged pot roast. 

Last night the pork on mash potato special had veryy dry pork with a greasy sauce to hide it. My neighbors noodle dish was colorless and salty as if a lot of juices had evaporated leaving a salty concentrate.

My girlfriend ordered Reisling...was surprised at the tiny half full glass...and blown away at the $8.50 price.   

Lastly..the waitress was 'pseudo friendly'.

I love their spinach melts...love their salad dressing...love some of their beers.

I keep returning wanting to believe everything I've heard or read about The Refinery.  Unfortunately, it has bee consistently disappointing.

The menu is so intriguing yet the execution is a total fail for just about everything I've ordered.   They always seem to be out of the wine that they offer by the bottle on the wine list.  I also find the wine list very limited for the type of restaurant.  

I love the rooftop dining in cooler weather and the little quaint bar on the second floor so I give it 2 stars.  Otherwise it would be 1 since there is no other choice.

The worst customer service from any restaurant From anywhere in the world. Nowhere in this country or other countries has there been customer service this egregious; it's consistently and aggressively bad. It's so bad that it seems as though all the employees are filled with hate/ resentment. Impossible that they have a manager or supervisor that that checks in on this location.. ever..

It's a shame because it's often a convenient location for me.  

I average less than one review a year, but I feel I should put it in writing.

I'd call it average. Selection of rolls was odd - very heavy in options with shrimp and crab stick.  Tuna was not great. 

Service was good and friendly. 

The highlight, As a previous reviewer commented, was the salmon. Salmon sushi looked out of place next to the others. Salmon was full and great texture. Tuna, yellowtail, and scallop were all low average at best in both taste and texture. 

The building is odd. From outside looks closed. There are 'No Trespassing' signs in the front window.  Not sure I would be in the area after dark. 

If you're in the area, or delayed flight and near the airport it's ok.

I love sushi and I kept hearing up Tuna Bar from friends so you know I had to check it out. I had a little trouble finding the entrance but it could have been because I was freezing and has almost fell 2x on black ice. The restaurant is quite small and quaint and dimly lit. It's very cute and definitely to my liking aesthetically. We started with the creamy rock shrimp which was yummy but wish we had a bit more portion wise for the two of us do share. Then we got 5 different kinds of sushi to try out from specialty rolls to the basic spicy tuna. They were all good, nothing crazy. Great drinks too!

It was my first time experiencing omasake and Hiroki made it so perfect. Every dish was delicious and beautifully crafted. I also tried the sake pairing. It was $65 each person. Oh wow each sake was served perfectly to compliment different dishes. 

Our table of 2 was really lucky as we were the only table booked at 6pm on Thursday. The 8pm slot was fully booked though. Because of that, we had the whole restaurant to us. How awesome it was  

I would recommend this place to anyone who is interested in omasake for special occasions. It is $180 per person and 20% tip is included in the bill as well.

Went through the drive through. Stated my order. What was repeated to me wasn't anything I ordered. So I re-stated what I wanted. It was repeated to me correctly, verified it was accurate on the screen. I wanted my chicken sandwich without tomato and add cheese. The lady at the window wasn't the same person that took my order but she was so nice. It wasn't busy so she was making small talk. I get my food and take it back to my office to eat, sandwich has no cheese. I love friendly service, but I'm paying for my food and want it the way I order it. Don't forget the cheese!!!

I live right by George's and I'm a regular, I eat here almost every week. The food is always awesome and they have great menu with options for everyone - which I appreciate since I'm vegetarian. The service is always good, I know most of the staff by name and vice versa. Great live music and dancing at night in the bar, nice outdoor seating when it's warm. There's also a private party room you can rent which is nice. George's is one of my go to places to eat! Try the caprese sandwich it's HEAVEN! Also the Mediterranean salad is good and obviously the chicken velvet soup (from my former meat eating days)

Carrie is an amazing hostess! Great helpful attentive personality. Food was down right tops! Red pepper coconut soup sublime. Celery blue cheese soup was in the running...Filet mignon very flavorful. Duck breast so tender and paired wonderfully with gnocchi. Vanilla bean creme brulee was the cherry on the experience. 

We were seated next to the bar which felt really crowded but the porch area and booths looked cozy. Went on a Tuesday night so don't know about noise level but there are many tables in a smaller space.

 Definite gem!!!

Went here last week for the first time. Was very impressed with the quality and amount food as well as the reasonable prices (I got 4 enchiladas with rice and beans for $10.99). I even ate the leftovers the next day for lunch. Our server was very nice as well, but they were out of some of the flavored waters listed on the menu which was a bummer. The only thing I didn't really like about this place is that the ambience was pretty stale, and it smelled strange in there (not a bad smell, just very strange). There also seemed to be some leftover food in the menu and on the floor, but like I said, the food was honestly great.

Last night was my first time try this place and definitely gonna be my last time also.The choice of the food is very limited...I mean,very limited.What's the point that I spent that kind of money but only get several kind of sushi?There are only 4 kind of sashimi...I'm literally speechless.

Most of the food is tasteless.Such as the sauce of all the teriyaki food.The only thing I like is the BBQ rib and the Maki rolls.

I guess all I can say is I wish they can serve more choices of food.I love sushi a lot but this place just make me feel not worth it AT ALL!!

If you're craving some Americanized Chinese food, then this is your spot! They are not open for indoor dining. They also take COVID very seriously, as they have plexiglass open when you are picking up your order. I put my mask on to make the lady feel more comfortable, as she was wearing a mask.

I called right when they opened at 11 am and my food was ready right at 11:15 am when I came in. I ordered 2 lunch specials - the Mongolian Beef and Sesame Chicken. It was smaller than I expected but for $5.99 each, you can't really beat the price and it satisfies the craving.

Probably the best pizza I've ever had. I went back twice in one night

Really love this place! It has become one of my favorite spots in St Louis. I  love the sweet red sauce that comes on the pizza. 

The staff is super friendly, and I go so much it feels like Cheers : "Where everybody knows your name !"

It's a fun place to stop before going out, not much seating but most people dash in and out. They always have music going and it seems to be loved by everyone-neighborhood kids who have a good relationship with the staff and regular Cherokee street hoppers.

It's good. Then it's bad. Then it's good again. It's inconsistent.

The Pasta with Rosa Vodka sauce is a good choice. When I order takeout you get the equivalent of 4 boxes of pasta. The Chicken Parmesan is also good. Thin and crispy. But it's served with 3 strands of linguine (if you choose pasta instead of a vegetable side) and it's overly wet with sauce. 

I've liked their Chicken Piccata and Chicken Marsala. But again, it's too saturated in sauce.

You can't go wrong with the Stractiatella soup though. There could be a heatwave and I'll still order it.

*This is strictly my experience with takeout.

Food was adequate. Service was awful and very smart mouthed. Wait on food was acceptable, but wait on waiter was for ever. We stayed here in the hotel for the weekend and the hotel part is incredible and friendly, but the guy taking our order and serving our food was probably the worst service I've ever personally received. He acted like it was a HUGE inconvenience to him to refill our drinks or even bring us our food. Hotel and food quality were good, but the guy serving us ruined the whole dining experience. Won't be back.

Went there on a first date so this vibe was a little weird....

Started with the caprese salad, and was v underwhelmed. Tomatoes were too ripe, and the cheese didn't have good flavor.

For mains we got the lasagna and split, one with red sauce and one with white sauce. I was honestly a big fan, it had great flavor. 

Then he got me the three cheese raviolis to take to work the next day for lunch and those were honestly amazing. 

The wine we had wasn't good but it was probably a poor choice on his part lol. 

Would go back, need to try more.

This is one of my husband's favorites & I've come to share his opinion. The food is always delivered hot & fast. The difference with this particular Mexican place is that they are fast without tasting like it's premade, reheated assembly line food. 

The staff are always kind, warm & helpful.  I had an issue with a dish on one occasion, and the server and manager corrected it immediately. 

I have an allergy to avocado and do not ever feel concerned that they don't take me seriously.  They do everything they can to accommodate their patrons.

Rude customer service. Bought a Dunkin cup without a straw given. Who sells cups with no straws??when asking to return the cup.. no one knew how to do a return and when the manager (short white lady) came out she looked at me and ask me what the problem was.. I said how do you sell a cup with no  straw? She said she can't accept returns because of Covid... understanding.. but not understanding why you would sale cups without straws... she said straws do come with it.. welp... why didn't I get one when I purchased a cup.. then she gave me a blank stare... ugh... common sense!!?!

Randomly searched for a sushi spot and found Koi. Seemed nice so my wife, daughter, and I went and checked it out. It's in the beautiful part of Skippack and nestled up a small hill surrounded by trees. This made for a very nice and cute place, great for date night or a place to just relax.

Service was nice and felt more like a 4 star dining experience while still managing to feel a bit casual. The outdoor seating is definitely the way to go.

Finally, the food. All I can say is try everything. We could only eat soo much but wish we could try more. Everything gets a 10/10. We will be making a serious effort to come back again

This place is a rip off! After sitting in the drive through line for over thirty minutes my order was incorrect and the fries were cold. I tried to go and retrieve the items that I paid for that were missing from my bag but the manager slammed the window in my face demanding that I get back in line and wait another 30 minutes for a mistake that was made on their end. The workers here are rude, and honestly I feel like they come to collect their pay and go home, no REAL hospitable service is being provided here and I will NEVER spend money here again

It was my first time here and we came after dinner since we were in the area. I ordered the Brownie Melt Sundae with no whipped cream and with chocolate custard instead. It was very tasty! I love the richness of all of the flavors since it had fresh brownies and hot fudge! If you want it less rich, you can enjoy it with vanilla custard like it normally comes. My husband ordered the Birthday Cake concrete and said it was a little too sweet; but my mother in law enjoyed her Hawaiian concrete. We came on a Saturday night and they were busy, but the wait wasn't bad at all.

It's very frustrating, they get my something in order wrong almost every time I go and this time they got every single thing I got wrong so honestly at this point I won't be returning. There's a McDonald's on W Chester Pike not too far away and they always do an outstanding job so I'll be going there from now on, obviously it's the same business but you can tell by the food and service it's run much better. It's crazy to me that management styles can make such a drastic impact on the food but I guess it's true, so I'm sorry to say I would not recommend this MD location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: When I order drinks I like to order with light to no ice because I get more drink for my money and the drink is still cold regardless of ice. Unfortunately when I asked for light ice, the employee said that the drink would not be full because the size is based on how much ice is put in the drink. I asked how much regular ice would fill up the cup and she said they put ice all the way to the top! I just settled with regular ice but what a scam. You're paying for ice and a little coffee. This was my first time trying out Dunkin' Donuts and just based off that I won't be coming back.

Great sushi spot and my go to place when I'm in Philly by myself for dinner.  Some of the least friendly sushi chefs...no welcome
Or thanks but waitress kind and helpful.  Kind of small portions for the high price but great quality and unique dishes.  Highly recommend the sashimi sampler, spicy jumbo lump crab special roll and truffle eel daikon. All of that plus tip and no alcohol $71. Left to take beautiful after dinner walk on the river and got amazing homemade mint and chocolate chip popsicle at lil pop shop on 20th. Next time might have to
Try strawberry rhubarb pie.

We have been customers at this restaurant for over a decade, and I feel bad about writing this and giving them a 3, however in the name of being objective:

We don't go nearly as often as we used to because a couple of years ago the price went up and the quality went down. The rolls got smaller and fell apart easily, but hey, at least they have shiny gold boats now *eyeroll*. 

The Crispy Kyoto Roll is still to die for, but the rest isn't all that exciting anymore. If you're nearby and have a hankering for sushi it'll do, but grocery store California rolls hold together better and have more filling. 

Sorry guys. :(

Finally got to stop in and try this place out! I have to begin by saying that this place has its own parking lot across the street from the restaurant. Parking shouldn't be an issue. I would recommend making a reservation to facilitate your visit. It can get pretty busy! However the food is worth the wait.  We didn't make a reservation but were seated within minutes! The food was delicious and the portions were plenty! I had the 1/2 order of spare ribs and mac and cheese. These ribs were absolutely delicious! They fell off the bone! I'm drooling just writing this review. I will be back for those ribs!

We were waiting to order at the two lines. We picked the first lane and we were waiting about 5 minutes while the right lane went through 5 cars while we were waiting in the left lane and nobody helped us. We thought the speaker box wasn't working so we switched to the right lane to the second speaker box and the drive through worker switched to the left lane where we originally were. This was a huge waste of time and they didn't apologize or anything to us. It's the little things that matter, especially in customer service. We will not be returning.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
After waiting two hours only to be delivered cold food, the last thing a customer wants to do is wait more for food that one can only hope won't be cold. That's what Pie Hole asks of customers--and without even a refund for all the trouble. It wasn't the waiting that frustrated me as much as it being cold; the box was soggy as though it had sat in the driver's car *awhile*. I had been pretty into this place but in the future I shall avoid spending my money on cold food hours after I order it.

In-store they're everything and more, but their drivers could use some horse-sense training about area codes and such.

Having the unlimited monthly plan is very much worth the price however the service is fast. This is both a con a pro as your car was is rushed and most likely will require a rewash. Although the staff is friendly is can be tedious to get a rewash if you are not on the already monthly plan. A con of the monthly plan is that you do not see someone; con because you will want a back windshield wiper cover if you have one. 

I personally have had a wiper cover come off and get lost in the wash. Which the process to get something replaced or repaired should be handled by the local store. 

Please keep this in mind when going to any Crew Carwash.

We went for lunch and were NOT disappointed.  The Healthy Green Quesadilla was full of goodies and wonderful.  2 tostadas were a meal for me (even at $2.99 each).  The carnitas was excellent.  The pollo was a bit over cooked, but very tasty.  They were the best tostadas I've had, east if New Mexico.  Service was excellent; the decor was very nice; the booth benches were not very comfortable.  Hopefully they'll put seat cushions on them
I'm looking forward to their winter menu, when they add tamales to their menu.
No free chips and salsa, but excellent sauces and molés for your meal, if you ask.

Terrible service. Never coming again. 

Notorious for closing randomly and will refuse to take orders. One time I was in the drive thru with about 15 cars behind me at about 10:45 pm and they decided that they had enough for the day and turned out all the lights in the place. No one knew what was going on no one told us the place is closed or was closing. Not sure if the place is short staffed or what Bc they claim 24 hour service but that is just patently false.

Maybe during the day you'll have better luck but I'd go somewhere else for better options.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Went today to stock up on wine and used a gift card my son gave me. I am a reward member at Total Wine and had saved multiple offers online.  I purchased six bottles of wine and I didn't have to worry about which coupon to use and I didn't have to! The registered figured it out for me and used as many coupons as it could and I spent $68.00! Woot!! Woot!! I was so excited!  They have such a vast selection of EVERYTHING! It's like being a kid in a candy store (but for adults).  I spoke with salesman John, who told me about a few of his favorites, which I gladly tried.  I'll let you know how these bottles turn out!

Had lunch today at Laredo and the food was really good.  I ordered the enchilada dinner and my husband had the fish taco.  He is a real fan of fish and said that was perfect--crispy and tasty.  My enchilada came with the verde sauce and I had expected the red sauce. The owner came over and said she would gladly replace it and I said it was my fault I ordered the wrong kind. She had me taste the 2 red sauces and made me another enchilada. I ended up liking both sauces and was impressed with how the owner was really interested in helping me enjoy my lunch.  Great experience--we will return.  Restaurant is very clean and good atmosphere.

Not the most convenient location unless you're on a business trip to the surrounding office park. Reserved a room for two nights using points. Foul weather up north caused me to cut one night off my stay. The desk crew was very helpful and industrious in helping me get one night of priority club points back. Room was large and well appointed. Location is quiet and serene and my abbreviated stay was quite pleasant and uneventful. Very comfortable place to visit, north and east of the normal Tampa chaos, and well insulated from the hoody USF and College Park neighborhoods.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been going here since before the name change and this place never disappoints! The wait can be long if you go on a Friday/Saturday right at prime dinner time but it's worth it! Drinks are awesome and food is delicious. Along with friendly and quick service and a super fun and lively atmosphere. They have great specials on weeknights (and you avoid the longer waits!) if you dine in. Take out is also always ready on time and delicious!!!! Tacos and guac are great! We also love the quesadillas but I pass on the street corn (love street corn but here it's just ok while you can get a lot of other great things on the menu.)

Contrary to what Yelp says- this location has not closed. They closed for a period of time to fix and upgrade some ice cream machines but they are back open and serving up ice cream for all. 

32 flavors? Count me in. Brings me back to childhood grabbing some ice cream with my sports team after our win. 
Hands down my favorite flavor is the cookies and cream. It must be the richest heavy cream possible in this mix but it makes it sooo good.

There are other really good ice cream places around Broad Ripple but a perk is that this one has a parking lot so you can get in grab your ice cream and be on the couch in no time!

This review is crazy. I never thought I would write something about a Burger King. The food is what you'd expect from a Burger King (so not great and pretty much just flame grilled fast food yuck but you know that going into it). I'm not sure why I ate here this day, but I decided to do it. The staff at this Burger King, wow! Honestly, I have eaten at nice restaurants in the area where the servers and managers were horrible. I spent 7.50 here but the team working was outstanding. The food is like a 1 or 2 star maybe, but the staff is the friendliest around. Have it your way is still alive and well here (at least at lunch time). Amazing!

A few years ago I was initially pleased with Brookville. A few years ago she went in twice to get ripped toenails removed. They didn't say anything about it and finally when it happened for a third time, had a vet tech at a separate hospital tell me it was an autoimmune disorder that needed a specialist. 
Recently my dog started having some concerning symptoms and they couldn't get her in for 2 weeks. (To their credit, they did call to see if I could bring her in when they had a cancellation.) Her labs came back fine so told me to call back in a few weeks if things aren't better. I thankfully got a second opinion and she's on the mend now.

Ok listed up kiddos. You essentially pay 12 bucks and get all you can eat. Some items are good, some items are terrible, but you get a lot of it. Please tip the wait staff. I can't imagine working someplace were you just watch people east 40 dumplings in a sitting. This is like an idea place for a work birthday lunch or some garbage like that. They have a variety of sauces, which help mask the cheapness of the food. High point: little egg rolls/ pan fried dumplings. Low Point: All the meat on the Hibachi, jeez that stuff is bad.  Keep it real, but not too real.

I was impressed with the young lady that helped me open an account. The major problem I have with them is that though I have over $4000 in my account and a very good credit rating and direct deposit of my pay check,  they will not let me use more than $100 a day without asking permission  for three months. This practice makes it very hard to pay bills, so I must keep my account at a different bank account active for an additional three months. I am almost two months into my wait, so I am going to hang in, but I would think about their practice of not of not trusting you to use your own money for three months before choosing this Credit Union.

This is by far the best pizza ever! If you are looking for a true NY style pizza, you've come to the right place. We discovered them at my son's football game. They were there selling pizza. Mind you the pizza was so amazing we had to ask, where is this pizza from? They are a bit far from us the but the trip is well worth it and they even deliver to our home regardless of the distance. Oh and the new restaurant they have is cozy but very modern and beautiful. It gives you a true NY feel. Mamma Mia's pizzeria is the bomb!

I booked my car a month in advance on Priceline. I arrived to the airport and I have been waiting about 1 1/2 hours so far and I'm only half way through the line. There is ONE agent helping a line of dozens of people. Then from what I am told, after checking in, you have to walk over to the car to meet another agent, then that's another one hour wait since it's only one agent !! 

It's not cheap either. I'm paying $250 per day. Do yourself a favor and just Uber or take a cab. 


Good luck trying to talk to anyone. No one picks up and no one is available .

We decided to try this local Italian cafe for Saturday night dinner. For dinner we started with appetizer Bruschetta Toscana, and for dinner we ordered Fettuccine Alla Giovanna which is a vegetable pasta and Shrimp Scampi pasta.
Bruschetta Toscana: It was okay. Actually we didn't like the sauce which it had. Otherwise it was okay. 3/5
Fettuccine Alla Giovanna: The vegetable pasta was okay and we believe that it was missing the correct amount of spices. 3/5
Shrimp Scampi Pasta: Shrimp scampi pasta was also okay. 3/5
We will give this restaurant try some other time again.

This chain restaurant has 2 locations in New Orleans, and I tried the one on Veterans Blvd.  We ordered the chicken and beef yakisoba. They were okay, but bland. They should have used more sauce to season the noodles. I also got a lot of fatty pieces of beef with my yakisoba, the chicken pieces were better cuts of the meat. The other Causeway location did a better job cooking the yakisoba when I visited them before.  I would probably not come back to this particular location. I will have to go back to the Causeway restaurant again to confirm if it is any better.

Kinda surprised this location has such a low rating. I will say the morning crew is great and the evening crew is iffy, at least in my experience. I always get in and out quick in the morning. The morning crew always says good morning, thank you, have a nice day, etc. which isn't always common at fast food restaurants.

The only issue I usually have is they don't really have a full menu posted, more like highlights. Sometimes I order things and I'm just guessing if they have it or not, like a vanilla iced coffee.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I had a meeting at AMP this morning and, since I've never been, I was excited to try something new. Tinker Coffee did not disappoint. 

I had the Cinnamon Maple latte and it was a perfect fall drink. Everything on the menu sounded delicious.

There was a pretty good crowd around 8am on a Thursday and I saw at least two other groups gathering for a meeting.

The staff person was friendly and quick, even though it was pretty busy.

I'm not normally in that area of the city but I'll definitely stop in again next time I am.

This location is a little skimpy on the cream cheese, but I'm supposed to be eating better for health reasons so maybe it's just the universe telling me to stop eating bagels with cream cheese.

I used to go to the Dunkin closer to my house but since it's always packed, I've started coming to this one closer to work. They usually don't have as long a line and I can get in and out quicker.

They staff are friendly and I usually get out of the drive thru quick.

Right now they only have the drive-thru open, the dining room is still closed. Staff are wearing masks and gloves.

No No No... take my advise please don't waist your time or money. 20 min wait on drink order, 15 more min for dinner order. Cheese dip was cold and tasteless. What we ordered was basic make at home in a crockpot Mexican food. We had no booze to drink small cheese dip and two entrées 30.00 you can get real authentic Mexican food just right down the street both ways.. we were rushing home in the car to both use the bathroom.. I actually threw my leftovers in the trash when I got home.. never ever again will I waist my time.. you shouldn't either

I spend about 150 to 200 nights in motels on an annual basis. Last week every other "choice" brand motel in the Boise area was full so I was forced to stay in the Econolodge in Boise. 

It was easily in the top 2 worst motels that I have ever stayed in as far as cleanliness and overall customer service.

I could go on and on from the room have completely missing lightbulbs in 2 of the 5 lamps; cigarette butts left in the nightstands of this non-smoking room; no room service one day as just didn't have time; etc...

Bad experience - please do yourself a favor and get a motel 6 room, it would be
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've taken my car to this place at least once a month for the past two years, and I never had any complaints until today.

Today, I was told that the place has new management, and they won't allow vehicles with roof racks or bike racks to go through.  I drove 20 minutes for my regular car wash and was told "you'll need to remove the luggage rack off your roof before we can wash your car".

The guy telling me this was very apologetic (like "I understand how stupid this new rule is") and said they've had to turn away a lot of people recently.  

It's really unfortunate, but I guess I'll be finding a new car wash to go to from now on.

Really wonderful dinner! Went on the advice of other yelp reviews and couldn't be happier. Ordered the kake udon and 6 sashimi, and they brought me miso soup and edaname. 

The sashimi was quite good - fresh and very nice. The udon was wonderful, flavorful and satisfying. A great meal for $20!

No liquor license but you are free to bring your own beer or wine. It's not a fine dining ambience - more low budget but tidy and clean - but the food could compete with some of the better Japanese restaurants I have been to

Pros:
- Views from apartment and common areas
- Resort style pool
- Proximity to entertainment, restaurants etc
- 24/7 security

Cons:
- Overall building cleanliness especially on weekends. Vomit in amenities, first floor bathrooms are practically unusable, grout in hallways needs major attention, dirt buildup on elevator walls and doors
- Treadmill televisions don't work
- Cleaning wipes in gym not replaced (goes weeks empty), despite notifying staff
- Not keeping promises - when first moved in was guaranteed assigned parking based on lease sign date, not accurate info

10/28/21- Thursday in the night, 
to who may concern: 

I been coming to this Starbucks several time give them the opportunity to get better service but no result, the service on the following areas need to be corrected on the costumer service at the cashier is very important eye contact when your are talking to the clients (for example: I ask the Cashier (male) why I cannot have eye contact during my transactions he answer me very rough "I don't like it" 
His hat was on his whole face. Also the order aren't been give Correctly to the client. 

I hope this issues can be corrected for the best of the company.

This pizza is, by far, my absolute favorite in STL! However, service is hit and miss. Definitely do not order on Valentine's Day --(waited 3 hours for our pizza and when I called to check my order, was met with an extremely rude person who told me it's their "busiest night of the year" and "you'll get it when you get it", when it arrived, it was the size of a personal pizza and cost almost $40!!) If the pizza wasn't so good, that would have been my last order. Definitely don't order there as often now, though.

Stayed here because of a conference.  Unless you are attending events at Superdome, this hotel is not that conveniently located---Marriott and Sheraton are much much closer to all the shopping and great restaurants at the French Quarter.  As for this hotel, it's big.  I was on one of the lower floors and water pressure was horrible.  I can't imagine higher floors.  Because water pressure was bad, it took forever to heat up the shower---wasted  a lot of water to get there.  Overall, it's  not convenient and it needs renovation.  I won't stay here if it weren't for the conference.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went to Mimi's last week after my daughter said she likes it there. I usually go to K&J nails but wanting to spend time with my daughter I went here. After 2 days the gel polish on 2 of my nails are peeling. This is not OK. The employees are very nice and the place is clean and it's amazing that they massage you while your nails are drying but to pay $32 not including tip for a gel refill and eyebrow wax and they start peeling is not good. I doubt I'd go back. I should've really thought twice about it anyway considering my daughter was going to have her nail polish fixed for the same thing.

I like this place a lot. Been going there since they fixed my son's glasses (which we bought somewhere else) while he was home from college, and didn't charge us a dime to do it. Good selection of glasses, they took our eye care insurance which knocked the price down to a very reasonable level every time we've gotten glasses there, and, since I wear frameless glasses and they're delicate, they put them back together at no charge when I break them. That alone is worth being a loyal customer, in my book. I've already gotten them fixed once since I bought them.  ;-)
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I've had numerous dealings with this veterinary group and I think they're the best I've ever known. Every vet, every tech and even every reception person is warm and friendly and very professional. The waiting room is pleasant and nicely decorated. Waits are very short and they take you fast if you have an emergency. And the one time I had to have a pet put to sleep the vet cried too. I used to go to Banfield, in PetSmart, till they forgot to show up for an appointment (!). You'd never have to worry about something like that at Mount Laurel Animal Hospital, where they care about the people as much as the pets.

I used to love this spot but for some reason I think the quality of food has gone down a bit. For example, our food was cold when it arrived to our table. Not lukewarm but cold. Our chips were slightly stale as well. Even the amount of food has significantly decreased. If you take a look at my Chimichanga meal, that's supposed to be a double serving a rice.....  however the flavors were still there. I probably won't be returning because there a ton of amazing Mexican restaurants in Carmel with a higher quality of food.

Under whelming to say the least!!! On the bright side the service was amazing, our waitress was super sweet and was quick with our orders. Our appetizers were really good, we got the fries as well the bread with the different dips. I had high expectations based off of the appetizers. I ordered the wild rice tamales and they were SO bland, they had zero flavor. The tamales came on top of a bean and corn mix and that was okay. My boyfriend got the pasta and his was way too seasoned and super pricey $20... for pasta and vegetables? Our friends got the fried chicken and that was over cooked and they sent it back. Meatloaf was the only thing good!!

This hotel needs a major renovation.  Carpet in hallways is frayed, wallpaper is peeling, no USB ports in rooms, there are HDMI ports to hook your laptop to TV but who carries those with them?  From 5th floor can see Busch Gardens, and watch the fireworks.   Breakfast is currently free, but is going to end on Nov 1, unless you are a member of some Hyatt club. Only 1 elevator was working, and that one is slow and very hot and floor was dirty.  Not great seating for breakfast.  Shuttle service to USF (3 stops) and Busch Gardens, or within 3 miles.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I wouldn't recommend this animal clinic to anyone. The prices are reasonable and okay, but they don't take good care of pets. Got my cat spayed here only to find various lined cuts in her skin, showing they shaved her belly too harshly and deeply and left marks. Not only that, but one of her nipples was also cut. I can see they were careless shaving my cat and unnecessarily injured her. I've got my other pets spayed and this has never happened before, I'm incredibly disappointed in this place. I'm going to a different vet from now on where they can actually can take care of a pet.

Usually ok but every time I order an iced coffee they always screw it up! They need to do a better job at  the drive thru on their introduction. Saying a one word syllable and then something in Spanish to a coworker and then saying go ahead when you're ready is not a proper introduction! Please work on your employees and their interactions with the customers, y'all kind of suck!! Also train them on the proper way to make an iced coffee and to mix it well, not just leave it all in the bottom, that's being lazy.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Love this place for pizza, hoagies and wings.  

However, I wish they'd get rid of the special sandwich part of the menu.  Had the salmon sandwich and at $9.50, expected something special.   I was let down.  Some chopped up lox on a hamburger potato roll?  Diced onion, capers and cream cheese?   I go to a pizza shop for the fresh Italian roll, why oh why would you give me a potato roll that I serve my kids????   Please at least put a disclaimer on the special sandwich menu that things will go sideways if you stray from the classics. 

I'll be back, but this one hurt and I had to write about it.

I pulled up to this McDonald's on my to a job site hoping I would get fast food. At first it was just me and I was told to wait at 0730.  About 6 more cars roll up and I'm waiting then I say I'm ready. The man on the speaker rudely says, sir I need you to wait. Mind you there's nobody he's helping. I wait and 0745 hits and still nothing. I let him know this is ridiculous and he needs more staff. We come to get a quick breakfast before work and now here I am starving. Can't even take my meds this morning. Absolutely do not recommend this location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We had a wonderful meal that was full of savory, salty and sweet, unexpected tastes.  The melange of flavors was wonderful!  Chef John was attentive and customized a cheese plate for us to our desires, with a few extra tastes on it.  The portions were generous, the atmosphere was attentive and not at all rushed.  They have changed their policy  and now accept credit cards, checks or cash.  Everyone was happy and considerate.  It's so nice to have a fresh, non-chain restaurant open in this area that is now overrun with Craker Barrels and Applebees.  This is my new favorite restaurant in Downingtown!

There's no denying these guys (including owner Rick) can cut hair. The problem is Rick is an asshole. I almost whipped this guys ass today cuz he thought he could talk some shit to me in front of my kids because I was 30 minutes late to an appointment. So I've been coming to this dude for almost 3 years and he treats me like a day 1 client for one tardy appointment in 3 years?! As one poster said, he has issues on how he talks to folks which is why he keeps changing out barbers. He's super unprofessional as he told me he had sex with one of his barbers. what kind of owner tells a customer that he's sleeping with his co-workers??

Went in for glasses (that I've been wearing pretty much all my life) because I had previously lost the ones I got from somewhere else & being that they're the closest thing available I decided to give him a try. Staff was friendly, for the most part and when I went in for my exam (I was due for one) the doctor did a few, random tests & decided I didn't need glasses, gave me some reading glasses that I can't even use bc they're too strong and give me heaadaches. Long story short I'd rather travel and get a better prescription that I know i NEED than go back to him.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The first and only place I will get my haircut since living to Saint Louis. Definitely recommend making an appointment. They book up really really fast so you have to plan in advance. That alone should tell you what a great job they do. I've only been personally cut by Billy,Hess,Peachez and Knux, and they all did a great job. A very welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. Booking and paying online and in advance helps me get in and out. They do take walk-ins,but usually you have to wait quite a bit because the line forms very fast. Trust me...make an appointment. I can't se show anyone would have anything negative about this place.

My car was blowing hot air when the A/C was on, so I looked up a few auto a/c repair places in Tampa and was surprised by how high the reviews were on here. So I gave them a try and they did a quick look inside my car and found the problem within 5 minutes!! My car was fixed overnight and they charged me less than $300 with a 6 month warranty. Another place I went to charged me over $600 for the same issue and didn't even fix the problem. Would recommend this place to anyone with a/c problems.. they definitely know what they're doing and are experts in the field. Very very sweet gentlemen.

Service is slow. The toilet backflowed and it took one and a half hour to send someone. Housekeeping does the minimum and only if you ask them to send someone. I have been here 4 days and no sheet change. The keys had to be replaced 5 times. If you call the front desk expect an answer 30 minutes later. Refrigerator doesn't work. The staff is not friendly alway rolling their eyes and hate answering amy questions. The pros are rooms are big, brakefast is included in the morning and light dinner 3 times a week. I still have two more days to go ugh.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Cada Italia is beautiful new gem in Indian Rocks Beach. There is a small bar, and both indoor and outdoor seating. It is a family owned and operated restaurant whose skill and commitment shows in the decor, service and food. The salad are always crisp and fresh and I love all of the veal entrees. My go-to favorite meal is the veal piccata, Caesar salad and tirimisu. The pricing is very reasonable and appropriate for the quality of your meal. 
They also have convenient take-out to carry across Gulf Blvd to watch the sunset.

There aren't a lot of "true" Chinese take out places in Media, but for what it's worth, Jing Fong takes the cake. The food is not spectacular, but from my experience, they are consistent with their food quality; a lot of the dishes taste similar to other above-average Chinese take out establishments. The prices are reasonable, maybe a hair bit expensive, but I think it's worth it. Overall, when you want Chinese take out, you usually want a combination of two things: quality/taste and price. I think Jing Fong has the right mix of both. You won't be blown away, but you won't be disappointed in the quality of the food.

Overall, this restaurant is pretty good! I liked the atmosphere when I went (pre-Covid) and the service is prompt! While the sushi is better than the other place in town, it still isn't fantastic. I think that it lacks the finesse that other restaurants in the greater Indianapolis area have. Since Covid-19, I have ordered carry out and was satisfied with my order, except with the crab Rangoon which was too sweet. I think that if you are craving sushi and want a quick bite, then this restaurant is good, but if you really want a nice sit down experience, you may want to look elsewhere.

We were there on a Tuesday night and they were packed.  Our server was a bit scattered and it took a long time for our food.  Other tables sat after us and were paying their bill and we were just getting our entree.  We didn't even do appetizers because service was so slow and it was getting late.  Two of us had the eggplant medallions which were absolutely delicious.  The other person had the lamb and didn't care for the Demi glacé.  She said it was very sweet and didn't go well with the lamb.  4 stars for my entree.. I picked well!

I have lived in TN for 11 years.  I am from NYC and grew up eating wonderful Italian food.  Very disappointed with the so called "Eyetalian" food in the South.  Until now.  This place is wonderful.  I had Veal Parmigiana that was whole muscle --not the ground processed garbage.  Expertly breaded and seasoned with al dente linguine.   My wife had the Linguine Alfredo.  It was expertly prepared.  Sharing a bottle of Chianti with friends and the authentic Italian food really made our day.  I highly recommend Meatballs Italian Grill

So, I stopped by to get my coffee. Since I have been traveling so much,McDonald's coffee has become my favorite. I ordered my usual "decaf coffee" like most places they didn't have it ready so they gave me a number thingy to put on the table. After a few minutes a lady brought my coffee, she asked if I needed anything else, she also said she was going to check back on me. Maybe  twenty minutes later, she actually came back and checked on me. I don't know is someone from corporate was hanging out, but the staff seemed very active and interactive with customers. I truely enjoyed the short experience. The place was also very clean.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
This is a cute little restaurant with great service and knowledgeable staff. It's also BYO which is a nice plus! 

I found the menu to be quite limited, and there weren't many things that stood out on the menu that I wanted to try. I believe the menu is seasonal though so this may be different during another time of year. 

I ended up going with the gnocchi which did not have a sauce, and I was not a huge fan. It didn't have much to it and I was underwhelmed. My boyfriend ordered the short rib pappardelle, which he liked but the portion was quite small.

The room itself was fine at first glance but it wasn't taken care of at all.  We had a suite and there were small rips in the couch, refrigerator was dented, some of the lightbulbs were out and the bathroom door didn't close all the way. The worst thing was that the AC unit was SUPER loud- sounded like a popcorn machine when it was on. Two positive things were the pillows were amazing and the staff At the front desk was Very friendly and helpful. 
We stay at hotels in this area a lot and I won't stay here again. Needs renovation inside the rooms as it appears the outside was done.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I went over there for quick lunch and ordered fish tacos , I asked cashier what kind fish is that but she didn't know when my order came I think was cod fish but they sliced and after than fried that was horrible fish I had so oily and it was hard to eat ,
About Rice and beans was good not too salty tastey both was good,
About mexican desert I love cream caramel but this one was not fresh and tasted like bitter I don't know why maybe too much baking powder that's reason when your desert get Bitter taste.
I hope next time they doing better.

I ordered fish tacos from this place and didn't get much fish.

Three tacos came in the order and sadly I could have combined the meat from the other two and still been disappointed. 

There was a lot of the "fixings"(lettuce, tomatoes and cheese) but very little else after that.

The chips were fresh and the salsa was great but I didn't go for the accompaniments. 

It wasn't busy so I can't blame a rush hour for it.

Sigh.......I'll probably drive past this place in search of an establishment that's more more generous with the meat.

Taco Express is located in a building strip on Pendleton Pike. 

I ordered the nachos with the chips on the side so they wouldn't be soggy by the time I got home. 

They charged a 1.00 to separate the meat from the chips. 

They were doing Karaoke tonight which gave this a more lively environment. 

Many patrons entering were not wearing masks or asked to although the sign is posted. 

Now for the food: 
The Special Nacho had shrimp, chicken and steak. This was well full of flavor and very filling. 

They forgot to add my Tamale so I'll have to find out later what I missed. 

Overall, this is a good place for Mexican food.

This place is fine as long as you aren't expecting much.  It is forgettable pizza, but it's never terrible and they have a lot of options on the menu for such a little spot.  The service leaves a bit to be desired. It's not unusual to call in an order, show up to pick it up and have to wait another half hour because it seems like they don't put it in until you walk through the door for pick up.  If you're starving, it's an okay place to get a slice and a soda if it happens to already be convenient, but wouldn't go out of my way.

First I want to say they did a huge and amazing effort to make the place Covid safe, they've  built 6 greenhouses, equipped it with heaters and speakers and it came out very cozy, comfortable and safe. The service is implacable! 
We love Japanese fine dining restaurants, we even went to Japan for our honeymoon, so we do have an idea what to expect. Unfortunately we didn't feel like the fish verity was big or unique enough, same for the flavor. We don't feel it's a meal worth $400 bill! We were excited to try Hiroki after being many times at Mulherins (same owners and building) and it's one of our favorites.

I ordered from them last night, the food was horrible, inedible. The sweet and sour pork seemed to be made with a peanut sauce, awful! The dry ribs tasted like it was made with jerky, impossible to chew. The beef and vegetables had three pieces of beef and the sauce was off. Everything was so greasy. I attempted to return the food today, no apologies and the "manager" accused me of trying to scam them. They refused to refund any of my money, even after I offered to pay for half. So I am out 62.00, this after I have been a loyal customer for almost 30 years. Don't waste your money, call another place, which is what I am going to do from now on.

I remember this place being amazing and then it just isn't anymore...I ordered 2 bento boxes to go. Walked in and it looks like they are slowly packing up to leave that please. They had a couple of covid related signs and a sign saying check order before leaving. There was a bunch of paper towels and cleaning solution right at the counter (good sign I guess) The lady that checked on my order and handed it to me was nice but the food was just not good. I'm giving it 2 stars because I think the sushi was great and if I had just ordered that then maybe this review would be different.

FANTASTIC. Very interesting menu but certainly there is something for everyone. Menu has snacks, appetizers and entrees. Loved the charred broccoli rabe, gougeres (pastry stuffed with Brie) and the squash schnitzel. I could continue with all the other delicious items but suffice it to say that everything was absolutely delicious, beautifully presented and expertly served. The BYOB made it particularly enjoyable as we were able to enjoy plenty of good wine. Our birthday celebration ended with delectable desserts. It was quiet and cozy. Perfect!!

The wife and I went for dinner the food was good but the service was terrible so slow. We'd order the same thing I'd get mine and four or five minutes later she'd get hers. we were constantly reminding our waiter about our food. This went on the whole time we were there. There were two orders we didn't get but by that time we were ready to go. The waiter told us that they were short staffed in the kitchen.  that's why I'm giving them three stars I'll give him the benefit of the doubt would also like to add the place was so  dark I needed to use my phone flash light to see the menu

Good sushi, large rolls, but extremely overpriced. It was an easy $50 dinner for two people. I guess I just expected to pay that type of money in downtown Reno - not in Sparks. They offer an all-you-can-eat option for about $23...which may or may not be a good deal depending on how much you eat. My husband did the all-you-can-eat while I got 2 rolls. (Rolls are just under $10.) Again, not the best price. We will most likely come back because it's right across the street and we had good service, but it probably won't be a weekly or monthly visit as sushi used to be at our old place.

Hands down, this is my favorite sushi place in all of Tampa!  It's tucked away in a small plaza on Waters Avenue, but don't let the location fool you.  This place is always hopping with people at lunchtime.  They have a two or three roll lunch combo for $11-13 that really hits the spot.  Everything is made fresh to order.  The fish always tastes fresh as well. If you are feeling adventurous try the Scorched Earth roll, or the Chili Shrimp roll.  If you like sashimi, the portion size of each piece is very generous.  Definitely give them a try, you won't regret it!

Been here several times. Service was excellent. They have really good guacamole. That is a must-try!

I always love their chips and salsa, as well as the queso dip. My daughter ordered the chicken fingers and fries and she loved it. I ordered Quesadilla Rellena. The Arroz con Pollo, which was what my mom ordered  was absolutely delicious. Next time, I'm gonna order that for myself! Lol

For dessert, we had churros. It was light, delicate, and just the right amount of sweetness to end our meal. Next time, I'll probably order extra chocolate to dip the churros in. 

Salsa Fresca is our reliable go-to Mexican restaurant.

Hit and miss on food and service. When they are on it's really good. They have an updated menu with the typical Tex Mex type food. The best part of this restaurant is the salsa bar that has tomatillo salsa, hot salsa (hotter than the table salsa), limes, pickled cactus and other things. Some days they make homemade corn and flour tortillas. Excellent. The Service is usual pretty good as well. We frequent this place and one of our favorite items is the grilled ribeye with that comes with grilled onions , pepper  and shrimp. They have flavorful tacos as well. Prices are fair and restaurant is clean.

Drove through two times, every single time it didn't dry my car, left water spots everywhere, left soap drippings on the back of my car. I got out looked at other cars going through and for sure they all looked the same. I tried again the next day different location and the same thing, didn't dry my car left spots and some soap. I asked a guy coming out and he was like yeah it's always like that, he just wets it to remove the salt, that's all it's good for... Heck, The gas station drive thru works better and is cheaper. Not worth it.

This place has awful customer service. It doesn't matter if you have an appointment or not, you will wait hours for basic service. I have been sitting here with an appointment for over 1.5 hours waiting for a tire to get patched. They have come in twice trying to sell me stuff I don't need. Then finally, when I expected them to be done, they said they can't fix the tire and want me to buy another. But they no longer sell my tires that I bought 12 months ago and I have to buy a tire that doesn't match. I asked for my old tire returned to a rim, I will plug it myself...they refused. 

Their service is awful and I don't trust them.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I would select No stars, but yelp makes you make a selection. After losing my pet I called to cancel a specialist appointment with the Mt. Laurel Animal Hospital. I was disconnected 4 times after holding for up to 30 minutes each time. When I finally reached someone I said please do not hang up on me again and was told it wasn't her that hung up.  I will not post her name but she was very rude. Not even an apology  for my inconvenience or sympathy for losing my beloved pet. I will be advising my regular vet NEVER to refer me to Mt. Laurel, Red Bank and North Star are much more pleasant to deal with!

This IS the BEST SUSHI in Philadelphia. The atmosphere is pristine and the crowd is cool and sophisticated. But even is you are ordering delivery or take out, this is still THE BEST SUSHI IN PHILLY. Here are my favorite items on the menu: Steamed shrimp shumai, naked gyoza (with tuna or salmon whichever you feel like), edamame, salmon nigiri, tuna nigiri, smoked salmon nigiri, tempi roll, rolling fire roll, and sweet meadow (this roll is Vegetarian) roll. Nigori sake to drink, and for dessert: one green tea, and one vanilla mochi ice cream.

This is our all-time favorite restaurant.  I never dared hope that an italian restaurant in Valrico/Brandon would be the best italian restaurant we've ever tried -- but it is. The food is addictive and it was hard not to order spaghetti bolognese every time we went, but when I got around to trying all their entrees, I was amazed to find they are all heavenly. The staff is savvy, very attentive and combined with the heavenly italian decor and soothing background music, this is a night out you'll want to have every week.

I'll be honest, there are better taco places around Santa Barbara. For example, Mony's & Tacos Pipeye are pretty up there on my list. Lilly's toritillas are just the most generic. Also, Lilly's meats were just kind of bland. Generally I feel like other places have enough flavor in their meats where u can eat them plain if you reaaaally wanted to. This is just a side note, but I tried a guava Jarrito there and it was also whatevs haha but I never drink soda so maybe that's why. Lilly's ain't bad, but I just think there are places that are much more worth

Solid place for a good, decently priced Mexican meal. The portions were big and very affordable. Sadly, you have to pay for the chips and salsa (big believer in complimentary chips & salsa at Mexican places) but the portions were big for a small price. The salsa was good and the chips came warm, we ended up ordering a second round of them. The burrito definitely satisfied my craving, and the margarita was good. The inside was pretty nice and I'd love to go back when it's warmer to sit on the patio. Service was wonderful. Overall a lovely experience, would definitely return!

Went to the longest standing restaurant in the Italian Market (been around the past 120 years), and visited by celebrities like Frank Sinatra & Taylor Swift: Ralph's Italian Restaurant! 

I do think their employees are heavily understaffed & overworked. Their patience and empathy was greatly appreciated at such a stressful position! 

My personal favorite was the bruschetta, it was like none I've had before! For a main course I had Fettuccine Alfredo. The alfredo sauce was so creamy and authentic; no store bought sauce could do it justice.

I have not had PapaJohn's Pizza in years.  However, recently I received a coupon for their new cheeseburger pizza.  I decided to try it.  The flavor was OK.  However the dough had the texture of an exercise mat.  Granted I have not ever tried to eat one,  It's the only thing I can think of to which to compare it.  Also, the ingredients did not seem to be particularly fresh like I would get from a good local pizza shop.  In short, I wouldn't recommend Papa John's to anyone who would ask me for a good place to go for pizza.

First time going back here since they're revamp and wow it is so much nicer! I used to come here for taco Tuesdays almost every week! They added a cool outdoor bar area and there seems to be less seating now. 

Food quality was good but it did take a while for us to get served even sitting at the bar. 

They have great deals on Tuesdays for tacos but since they're revamp, a lot of tacos were taken off the taco Tuesday deal. Sadly to say all of the ones I liked were still full price :(

Other than that they have great (and strong ;) ) margaritas and 4$ Pacifico's!

The only waiter in the restaurant seemed more concerned with wiping down the empty bar that even acknowledging me.  I sat at a table for at least 10 minutes before I had to get up and approach him.
