He looked right at me several times and ignored me.  Once I did ask him for a menu, he seemed irritated.

I got the house salad and was disappointed.  There was a big hunk of the base stem of a head of lettuce in my salad.  It was mediocre at best.

If you are looking for a place to eat before a flight or during a layover, I'd suggest the gift shop.  At least they act like they want your business.

I was looking for Italian restaurants in this area of Goleta after having been disappointed by Pascuci and Ca Dario. This restaurant is in Isla Vista and allows you to build your own pasta dish as well as your salad.
I tried the chicken parmigiana and found it to be really tasty. My wife had the carbonara and was OK with it. 
I bought a spaghetti and meatballs dish with all the fixings I wanted and took it home to enjoy later. I opened the meal and found two puny tasteless meatballs and I was surprised. 

An issue you might encounter is the parking but the restaurant is great.

This is a dive bar. Not like, "consciously cultivated dive atmosphere", like it is genuinely seedy end low class. Not entirely in a bad way. The drinks are about at cheap as you can find in the city. You can come here in pajama pants on Saturday night and no one will bat an eye. There is a fairly large back patio. Apparently there is pizza, I've never risked it. They will not read or give a damn about this review. I'll probably be back soon.

P.S., they no longer have Golden Tee. This is the only major change I've seen here in years and it was a mistake.

Went for my husband's birthday as a recommendation.  Ordered the bread service and it was nicely presented and delicious.  A variety of 3 breads, olive oil mix and soft garlic butter.  I had a glass of Pino Grigio which was perfect.  We ordered the Nduja meatballs and the Rustic Bolognese.  The meatball meal was not special and a little blend. The bolognese was very good despite some pieces of meat containing fat. The tiramisu was nicely presented and delicious as other reviews mentioned.  We had a great server, Eric and felt the restaurant was small, nice, and classy.

The most elegant portions of food, i.e, small. No rice or  beans slopped on the plate, so order sides to fill up. I would have enjoyed the meal more if my seat didn't shake each time the hostess who wore bedroom slippers stomped by. And, she stomped by a lot. I watched. The other staff wore shoes. No matter what the size or weight of the people walking by, customers or staff, she was the only one to make my seat shake and my teeth rattle. [It's the girl with the many lines of script tattoo on her back. She needs to put some shoes on. Hopefully it will minimize her walk from an Ent to a troll or ogre.]

have to say that I have been living in Reno for years, and I have used Vinney's repeatedly.  When the dealership says one thing, it turns out to be another, and usually a much cheaper repair.  Vinny has been around a very long time, and seen it all, so when he says something doesnt need repaired, he is right on the money.  Only complaint - there isn't 14 of him and his crew to get my car in sooner!  Price is always right, and if he knows it can be done cheaper at the dealer, he will tell you so.  How many repair places would do that for you?

If he ever gives up the business, I will have to give up my ride.  :)

Expected much since it was associated with the name Gaylord.  Basic hotel with a $20 shuttle to airport in top of a healthy nightly cost.....   Clean, roomy. Nice staff.  Shuttle was not clearly marked as the Gaylord.  It's Sound Waves.  No one at the Gaylord desk to tell you at the airport. Waited through three of them before hotel sent a car for me and another guest. Front desk staff was helpful and pleasant.  Hard towels and well worn beds (sleeping ruts for two in the kings bed I had) Had a couple of kinda rude shuttle drivers to the mall over to the Resort for my conference. Decent fitness room.  Overall, decent stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Weekend date with my wife and dessert was completely underwhelming. My wife had the cookie and ice cream . The cookie was a bit over cooked and the ice was average. I had the Apple Pie with Guava Cream Cheese ice cream. The apple pie wasn't good but the ice cream was creamy and actually pretty good. We both thought the waffle cone chip was flavorless and could have been thought through a little more. 

I guess it wouldn't have been so bad if the the price tag wasn't so steep. I could have had this in my living room for a couple of bucks but because we ate this at Armature Works we paid $18. This, unfortunately, was a case of buyer's remorse.

Today, we wanted to check out a new pizza place, and I'm glad we did. We were welcomed by a lovely woman who immediately showed us to our table. We wanted the pizza buffet, but unfortunately it isn't in operation now due to Covid. However, they had several lunch specials from which to choose. The mozzarella sticks tasted handmade and the breadsticks were the bomb! That dusted cheese made them! The pizzas had plenty of meat and cheese. We look forward to trying out the other menu items and eating there again!

What can be said that hasn't been said? Employees think about service after cell phone checked, arguing with Shaneesa about not getting break. The sounds coming from behind counter make me nervous about even being here! The customers are a distant 2nd consideration. This place is consistent in its crappy
  Disgrace to humanity! Why not hire people who can at least look like they give a shit. Sounds like a Zoo behind the counter! Filthy and about as welcoming as a rabies shot, wtf is wrong with McDonalds??????
  300 lb women "employee" literally beaten a machine that won't comply!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Love this place. I'd often go here whenever I needed to make food for my korean class potlucks that we'd have at the end of the semester. The owners are really nice and helpful! The woman even told me how to properly cook Japchae when she saw that I was making it and asked what it was for. Thanks for the tip! They have a wide assortment of foods, too. Although mostly Korean (not complaining) they do have some Japanese and Chinese options as well. We're not so lucky to have an H-Mart here in Arizona, so I'm thankful for Sandyi. ~!

Wish I'd taken a photo! I've been here twice, once for the first time with a friend. Ordered the Super Hiro roll, some shrimp noodles and takoyaki. All delicious, except for the takoyaki, but that was on me. I don't like octopus, I knew I didn't like octopus, but I still decided to venture out and try octopus. Blegh! The second time, I ordered the same shrimp noodles, still as delicious as the first time! I highly reccomend this place, the food is authentic (well as authentic as it can get in a desert state haha) and delicious, as well as reasonably priced. The hours are weird though...

People are friendly (only to regulars really) shop looks very nice but it's a bit expensive for the mediocre nail work. They wanted 35 dollars for a gel manicure! My friend got acrylic nails here & her middle finger on both hands were crooked & poked up. She also didn't get the shape she wanted (asked for coffin got weird stilleto looking nails) I just got a normal manicure & you could see my nail towards the tip. It also chipped within 2 days!!! That has never happened to me before!! I think I would return only because they don't talk about you in another language.

Convenient sushi spot near me that sells pretty good food. The sushi never blows me away but it does taste very good, great prices and a lot of options. 

I also tried the seafood miso soup and pork gyoza. Seafood miso soup comes with a lot and has a generous amount of seafood. Broth was delicious but seafood lacked some flavor. Seemed like the seafood was just boiled then dumped in the broth. Seafood was a bit bland so could've used some seasoning.

Pork gyoza was tasty and filling. It was not pan fried, which I thought was unusual because gyoza always is. Still very good though!

This place deserves a big Zero stars the manager Marcos that works the front desk is very disrespectful towards guest treats them like peasants can't even have your TV on without him calling the cops with no warning  and evicting you with no money back sounds like a scam to me especially since I see similar reviews after My stay. Please for your own good avoid this place at all cost the rooms also smell weird and the beds are uncomfortable. People like this should not own a hotel especially if your going to treat guest like peasants. Also noticed the guy Marcos does Racial profile so just a heads up don't be surprised.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Love this place!!   I will return to shop for wine, that will be a trip just for that.  Large selection of bourbon/whiskey, I didn't see anything that I had to have.  Now tequila was a different story.  I've been looking for 123 for sometime and couldn't find it locally.  Victory!!!!   I also found two beers there I've not seen often, old nation brewery m-43 and pax verum beers.  It was fun just to browse the store.  I'll go back when I have more time.  The wine selection can be overwhelming, but there seemed to be plenty of staff on the floor to assist.

Most overrated ice cream shop anywhere. The location and parking are horrible. You are lucky to get out of the parking lot without having a crash. When you walk in there's really not much room to form a line. Servings are very small and pricey. Staff acts like they're doing you a favor by serving you. They have some unique flavors of ice cream but the quality is very average. I have requested malt powder multiple times and they just don't want to listen to the customers. The Interior decor or lack of it is very cheap.

This is the worst McDonald's I have ever set foot in.  To start with, health code violations such as leaving open cups of milk out on the cashier's counter for at least 15 minutes, and a dirty customer went behind the counter to help the cashier operate the milkshake machine.  Then my egg mcmuffin took at least 15 minutes when we were first in line,  and the manager said it takes awhile to cook the eggs and bacon fresh.  When I asked for a refund, she refused.  Never mind that there was drama in the restaurant with a group of methheads and the manager.  Avoid this dump.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Bartaco was great! The food was tasty but the drinks were my favorite. Smoke on the water is a must try! They have lots of vegetarian options to choose from. I ordered a falafel taco and a Brussels sprouts taco. The Brussels sprouts was the best but I wasn't super impressed with the actual tortilla. It completely fell apart and didn't seem very fresh. Most importantly, though, they did an AWESOME job social distancing. Everything was ordered on your phone and the tables were well-spaced. I'd definitely go back!

I'll drive to a further Dunkin to avoid going to this location. Orders are wrong most of the time. Ordered coffee with sweet and low and was given packets to put in the coffee myself instead of them stirring it in. Once ordered a donut and an egg sandwich, was given a bag and I asked him if the donut was in with the sandwich and he said yes. Of course I find it wasn't in the bag when I got home but I was still charged for it. Once ordered a sausage egg and cheese on bagel, they completely forgot the egg. Drive to the Dunkin on Frankford and Knights, their service is excellent.

Stopped in for dinner with my daughter on the way home. Limited selection of food but still plenty to choose from. Everything was clean and while I liked that they are using plastic plates and utensils, they would not be my first choice. The green beans were my favorite of all the selections. I saw a sign saying you have to wash your hands if you want to serve yourself bur they are not enforcing it so I'm guessing that's from when we were in full lockdown. May visit again and see if they have more selections to choose from.

On my way home from running errands,  decided to stop in for a quick meal. Got the sesame chicken lunch special and some crab rangoons. The sesame chicken was ok, felt like the chicken needed more sauce and was rather dry.. seemed like it was more breading than chicken. The rice was ok but could have used a bit more seasoning. Crab rangoons were just ok. The restaurant is clean and of course, no inside seating in this current environment. I noticed that they do deliver but your order does have ti be at least $15. If you're ordering for one, that could be a challenge. May try them again in the future

I went here for dinner with my friends on a Monday night. Unfortunately I will not be coming back. Needless to say the worst service I ever received, the server looked like she hated her job and did not want to be there. She did not introduce herself to me or my other 2 friends that came in after 2 friends that originally got the table. She did not come to check how the food was or refill our drinks,including the fact that I never received one of my tacos. To top of the horrible service me and my friend also got sick from the food. I really wanted to like this place but unfortunately they need to make some improvements.

Trying out this restaurant for the first time, good selection of wine and cocktails menu.. 

We ordered char octopus(one of the specials)- this was ok, but I would say could use less seasoning, nikos burger and scallops. Burger was over cooked (we ordered medium, it's more like fully cooked). The scallops were so salty I couldn't even finish the meal cuz I had to drink so much water with each bite.

Overall, nice clean decor, food is disappointing to say the least. I probably would only come back for happy hour or night cap, not for food anymore.

Went in this morning for breakfast and the waitress wad so rude telling me that my party would need to wait. I'm a regular here but when the customer service gets a bit nasty, management needs to address the tone used toward customers. There are too many diners in the area to be embarrassed by an employee talking down to customers. Tripps, Joe's are all great diners that are alternatives.  I'd suggest a bit of customer service training for this young lady. I'll still eat here but it only takes one employee to start the decline. BTW...I did leave sms went to Joe's this morning.

Sub par. The decor is better than the food. I tried a few different specialty rolls and didn't think they were very good. The rice wasn't right (too hard) and the tempura crumbs they put on top were kind of soggy, not crisp and crunchy. I even sampled a few pieces of their nigiri and found it to be just barely satisfactory, especially considering the price per piece. It's better than its counterpart in the immediate vicinity by a long shot but by no means is this the best choice for sushi in southern Illinois!

It's really quiet and awkward in here. They could really benefit from some music playing in the background. We ordered two drinks from here (chai latte and a cold brew) and the cold brew never came out. They totally forgot to make it. We had to go back up to the counter and ask about it while the workers stood around doing nothing. Total lack of commutation between the workers taking orders and those who are making drinks. 
It's cute inside but I don't think we will be back. Prices are extremely high on bags of Kaldis coffee ($15! You can get them for 8.99 at Schnuck's)

Can't believe I forgot to edit this. It's been a year since I stayed there and STILL haven't gotten a refund for the ticket that they got me in the rental car. Apparently the valet I mentioned in the original review parks your car in a public lot about a block away and there's some kind of fight between the owner of the garage and the Dream management but the garage gives tickets very regularly. So they got me a $150 ticket and excuse after excuse but I still haven't been reimbursed for the ticket they got me
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've had Tinker coffee from different partners but never from Tinker directly. So when I saw them at the AMP, I had to try it! There was only one person working when I came and she was very personable. She was prepared to answer all of the question I had. I ordered a vanilla iced latte, a classic. The espresso is superb. Very smooth, strong aroma, and pairs well with the syrup. I actually got the largest size and it did not taste diluted at all. I saw that they also sell jugs of cold brew for $15, which I may have to return for. Great coffee!!

Wow!!! This place is my new standard for 5 stars. Amazing cocktails, beautiful ambiance, excellent service. We went for Valentine's Day and they didn't up charge for the evening. We got the white bean hummus and prosciutto de Parma appetizers... amazing! The highlight of the night was the special that I ordered... braised flank steak rolled and filled with cheese, crimini mushrooms and spinach over polenta... my mouth is watering just thinking about it again. Anyways, I HIGHLY recommend this restaurant. I can not wait to go back.

I've been here a few times since moving to Indiana. It is hands down one of my favorite restaurants in the state. I'm originally from Chicago and have a high standard. This has met and exceeded my standards! Every time I've come back the food just gets better and better. This was also the first restaurant I tried shrimp and grits and it was INCREDIBLE. Cooked to perfection. Our wait staff is always sweet and wonderful and the hostess is charming and very personable. If you live in Indiana or are driving through this restaurant is a MUST!

Great location right across the street from the beach, with ample parking, and 15min walk to State Street and Stearn's Wharf. Price started decent enough for the beachfront location and being dog-friendly, but there are additional charges for pet stay, parking, and resort fee. Staff was all super friendly and helpful. Room was huge, with a partial ocean view. Based on previous reviews, we had tempered our expectations. But those expectations were exceeded, and we look forward to staying here again next time we're in SB.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very relaxing spot to get away from the college stress and chaos! Piano, couches near a full glass wall entrance and view of outdoors plus a patio outside. Wine presented properly in a  relaxing atmosphere with nice music. Owners are friendly and accommodating. Food is delicious and comes with toasted, flavorful focaccia. I highly recommend this place as a refreshing standout restaurant from the sticky, dirty, fluctuating moderate service from all the other places accommodating only the typical college student.  Italian Gelato for dessert!

Hit or miss! I've had good nails and not so good coming out of here. 

The owner is RUDE. She talks on the phone the entire time she's doing nails and very loudly. It's obnoxious! You cannot ask questions she loses her cool and is just mean because you are interrupting her conversation. She will also stop doing nails abruptly and yell, assuming at the person she's speaking to.

Because of this specifically I won't be back. She is loud, rude and obnoxious.

DO NOT TALK ON THE PHONE WHILE DOING YOUR JOB! It is annoying, rude and obnoxious!!

I like fresh bread daily,I'm picky that way. 
So I go to Safeway practically every day. This Safeway has the worst white sliced bread you'll find anywhere in the city. Once out of every 40 times I get a loaf of bread worth eating. I have complained to management. Nothing has been done to rectify the problem. It is over cooked, dry and zero moisture. I'm not sure why they can't get a simple loaf a white sliced bread right. But they can't. It seems like a simple fix to me. ( don't cook it so long) but it is fine for a day. Then back to crap. I only continue to go here because it's the closest Safeway to where I live.

Went in here for dinner on a Tuesday night. Yes it's a Tuesday but there was no one in there. My friend and I were skeptical of going here for dinner since it was just us but we decided to go for it. We were seated right away and was given warm bread with butter. It seems like they have a designated person to pour water because it was different from our server. Overall the food was mediocre nothing special. Service was decent. However, there's something about the atmosphere that makes me not want to come back.

Wowza! This is one of the best custom pizza I've ever had! I got the hot little honey and it had the perfect amount of spice to it. The drinks they offer is great also; definitely one of the best fountain drinks. I knocked a star off the review because of the employees attitudes. The woman who made my pizza looked annoyed and did not communicate with the cashier at all. There was also another employee on her break and once she got back, she looked really miserable and hated the fact that she was working. This just brings the vibes of the place down a lot. I am definitely going to order to go next time.

I always come to this place. And last night me and my family were very disappointed. The OVERALL service was horrible it was all terrible the cook was new so the food lacked them our waitress kept disappearing. When I explained to the manager that the service overall was terrible and I was disappointed she didn't care either she shrugged her shoulders like oh well. So it may not make a difference that I don't return but this place will soon be shut down by the lack of customer service and respect for customers I wish I could have gave them 0 stars

Went there yesterday 2xs once for breakfast n dinner not only were my hash browns hard as a rock I was able to drop it in my table n here the bang I tryed to call but no one answers I finback at dinner bother my woooers were over cooked fries were stale onion rings oldso good to say yet again they got me for another $26 if imyou want BK I suggest taking a ride to any other but this one I have video I sent to the health department yesterday so they can see this place is ripping my ppl off by serving food made hours ago

Yet again I gontheu the drive thru the girl workin has ear pods in n is very ignorant when I'm taking to her she can't hear me bc I guess she's busy listen to her music‍ they r out of onion rings n certain sandwiches stop being lazy n drop the food they have a delivery truck man standing over the sandwiches with a tank top on n arm pit hair  that I can see when my husband asks why he's there she shook her head it's a Friday night at 10pm if we see her again working we will not come back she's ignorant n a bitch sorry but it's been multiple times or mayb she just dont like white people I wish I could give this location0 star

My wife and I decided to give Aroma Joe's a try this morning. We had already made our selections before we pulled into the drive thru lane. We both ordered the egg, ham and Swiss cheese croissant sandwiches and coffee. Boy were we very pleasantly surprised! The eggs were perfect. The ham was thick and looked and tasted like it was freshly cut from a honey-baked ham! The Swiss cheese was tasty and generous. The croissant was warm and very fresh! The coffee tasted really fresh and flavorful. The service was quick and pleasant. We will be back. Say goodbye to Dunkin Donuts! Bob n G (The Dynamic Duo)

Not a huge fan. It was Mexican but very Tex mex or what you would expect in Carmel, Indiana Mexican. There wasn't a lot of flavor. The food kind of just looked like what we ordered but all tasted the same. The quest was flavorless. The chips were flavorless. The price is pretty high in comparison to other Mexican restaurants. 

The location is what saves this place. Great location. Easy parking. If you don't want to drive far, live close by, and are super hungry, then sure head here but if you're looking for authentic Mexican or close to it, go somewhere else!

Pretty much one of the best ice creams ever. So many delightful flavors! We took a special walk over last time we were in Tampa because they're just that good! I've never had a cone that I have literally wanted to eat by itself. The smell of the cone, the flavor of the cone... it is amazing! I've had the goey butter and the Texas sheet cake and both are winners! The chocolate lover in me is all about that Texas sheet cake (which is also dairy free) but man, that goey butter hits the sweet spot wonderfully too!

Well... being that it was Friday I was extremely tired i wanted to just grab something quick.
Wasn't in the mood to cook and definitely had a craving for some good ol' Penn Station.
Well... i was disappointed.
Oh while the sandwich was hot... it was definitely dry.
Definitely wasn't what i was use to especially from Penn Station!! Idk what was going on!
But the sandwich was dry i ended up throwing it away.
No this won't stop me from going back maybe it just wasn't my day.
The customer service was great though!!!

I have been getting my hair cut here for the last 8 years by different stylists. Most recently Michelle, and Nemah before that (before he moved on).  I have always been very happy with the haircuts I have received from everyone over the years. I used to be exclusively a walk-in client and rarely had to wait long to get a hair cut. In the last year I have been making appointment with Michelle and always been very happy. Some men might consider $19 expensive for a men's cut and beard trim, but I have always felt like its well worth if you're looking for more than just a buzz with the clippers.

Not at all impressed with the lack of ventilation in the shop. Every manicure station was full, every pedicure chair was full. I would not mind waiting if I could stand the immense chemical fumes. Do better or those customers with breathing issues. Also, when a customer states to you that they have a broken nail do not tell them they are wrong, and just keep filing, and polishing. If the customer jumps and indicates to you that the tool that you are using to remove the old polish maybe listen to them and address it rather than continuing to hurt them, every other nail. Will only schedule appointments with this shop the minute they open.

Hubbard's and cravens is a super nice coffee spot! I visited around 8:30 and all the tables were full but I snagged a comfy chair with a side table to do some work. The feel is definitely sort of posh, feels more like  "uptown" and not so much "downtown" which I'm not a super fan of but thats just my opinion some people love that! My mint tea was good but this shop looks more like a Starbucks than a hometown coffee shop.
I will say there were lots of people talking and smiling and shaking hands, and that was super nice just as far as vibes go! I'll visit again maybe around slower hours.

It would be nice if the branch manager ACTUALLY knew how to process an insurance check. We got the run around about how "that branch" would do things, yet that was no help with trying to deposit an insurance check after a claim. These people have no clue what a mortgage company endorsing a check looks like, or how to even read a mortgagee clause. Take your banking needs elsewhere! We went to the Northtowne WF and were taken care of with superior experience and no issues. At least they know how to do their jobs!

I have been here several times since it opened, and it is the best sushi I've had in the greater New Orleans area so far.  The dishes are good, and some are even creative!  One sushi dish I ordered came with 4 huge slices of seaweed-wrapped roll placed fish-side-down on the plate, and each slice had been piled high with a wonderfully textured (and tasting) mix of fish, roe, and sauce. 

I think the service has improved since they first opened.  I would recommend this place to anyone, and even go out of my way to go there.

I only stayed here for one night this past weekend, but I absolutely loved this hotel. Clean rooms. A big kitchenette area that has everything you could ever need. The shower could be updated but great water pressure. We really want to come back and stay in the "King Master" room which has a tub in the middle of the room. It was really busy this weekend but that didn't affect our stay. Also, don't confuse this hotel with "Hyatt Place" which is around the corner. I've never stayed there but I think this is the better of the two. Oh and lastly, they do offer breakfast. It's a little mediocre (not a lot of options) but it tasted good.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
If you're familiar with El Pollo Loco and Juan Pollo chains, then that's what I would compare Fiesta Chicken to, except on a much higher level in terms of quality and flavor. This has quickly become my husband's favorite for Mexican rotisserie chicken. 

For us vegetarians, or when you don't feel like eating meat, they have a very delicious veggie supreme burrito. I also recommend a side of the potato salad. Salsa bar is great (green sauce and spicy carrots are my favorite!)

Atmosphere is casual, like a taco shop (they do sell tacos too), and very friendly and helpful staff! Happy to have this place walking distance from our home.

This Hotel is SEXY!! If you are trying to be romantic and or get ya freak on lol this is definitely the place to be!! You don't even have to go to the front desk to check in bc you can use your phone!! Big plus!! It's right on the strip so you are walking distance to almost everything including the famous Bourbon street. I did the valet parking and our headboard was a mirror!! Yassss! Lol let's just say we had FUN!! I would definitely stay here again very elegant classy and quiet! They even have a pool table downstairs in the lobby. If your into mirrors this is the place for you! Have fun!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Average restaurant. The entree dishes are not very good as they are bland or are lacking substance. The sushi is very average with some variety with their specials such as the fatty tuna. The sashimi/nigiri typically comes out warm and not chilled but that's perhaps due to how long it takes. Some things they do well are the sable fish, salted salmon, and yellowtail collar. The market is really cool to shop in. The kind lady is helpful and they have uniquely Japanese products so if there is something you want but can't find elsewhere  they typically will have it.

On a positive note, the Baconator Fries are delicious. Good thing, since it's the only thing I'm eating. 

I'm so aggravated. I places an order on Door Dash. The total came to $18. You'd think for &18 they could got the THREE items right, right? Nope. Apparently not. 

I ordered the Taco Salad... no chili or chips!! Seriously? Without those two things, it's just lettuce with tomatoes and cheese. Oh and salsa. GROSS. 

I ordered a Frosty... it's missing, too. 

And not a napkin to be seen. 

I quit, Wendy. Get it together.

The beignets are good.  The workers are overworked, surly, no customer service except for those who buss the tables- they are very nice.  The counter staff completely ignored everyone in line for at least 10 minutes.  Wouldn't even make eye contact.  One guy behind the counter had a neck gator on and all you could see was his eyes below his hat.  Strange.I think the lack of staff is exhausting them.  It's a shame if tourists get this lackluster experience.  You can do better.  You won the bid now provide the service.

Went in today for a late lunch and started with their bread, olives and marinara. The bread wasn't fresh and unfortunately the marinara tasted like Ragu from a jar, and the olives were unbelievable salty. Hopefully the calamari will be better- it wasn't. Oily, tasteless and way too much breading. Moving on to our entrees, I ordered the salmon- not bad if only it wasn't swimming in oo. My hubby ordered the chicken parm and he was happy with it. We finished the meal with tiramisu that looked like a home ec project gone astray.

Checked it out and doubt we will be back. Maybe we should of gotten the lunch special....

My friend and I celebrated our November birthdays at Vivace during our last day in Tucson and we are glad we chose this restaurant!  Our server, Brett, was great!  Attentive, but not overbearing. Sitting on the patio was so relaxing and the perfect ending to our trip. We both had the Chilean Sea Bass and split a mixed green salad with their homemade basalmic vinagarette.  We received a delicious complimentary crepe brûlée as a dessert.  Will absolutely come back here when I return to a Tucson.  Highly recommend!

My hubs and I love the flavor of El Limon's carnitas, but we DON'T love the huge chunks of fat that we often have to pick off of the tacos like we did tonight (see picture in case you think I'm exaggerating). By the time we were done, all of the excess grease solidified and made for a disgusting, pasty mess. 

I've made carnitas myself, so I know that pork shoulder/butt is fatty by nature, but come on. This has happened more than once, and we're getting tired of it. Get your ish together, El Limon. We were excited to have a close location in Limerick, but I guess I'll be making my own carnitas more often.

Creole Creamery was a fun little ice cream shop; but, due to covid, it's just a regular, no sample, rush you through and out the door ice cream shop.  They have a huge selection of flavors but won't let you sample anything.  I ended up choosing a flavor that sounded good but was mediocre at best.  Don't get me wrong, ice  cream is one of my favorite foods, almost regardless of flavor; but, a sample would have helped big time. 

I recommend visiting Creole Creamery if your nearby, but until they get back to 2019 style operations I'd have to say "ehhh..."

While the teppanyaki was energetic and fun, he was probably the only thing that had me somewhat liking this place. The food was dry, veggies underdone, and potatoes in the vegetable medley?! Why do that. The rice had a burnt taste and the shrimp while flavored well were half burnt. The chicken was real dry. Also waiting 15 minutes after a drink order so they can bring out everything is rough. And the checkins werent that frequent dont expect anything from the bar for atleast 25minutes after seating. I will admit the dressing for the salad and the small salad was great but i wasnt here for the salad!

I don't really know what some of the other reviews are talking about it being overpriced or the key fob not working at other locations...it worked for me out of state, and I was paying 120 a month for a gym that was dirty here in Reno...so 39.95 a month to me is a bargain for a place that is ultra clean, has all the equipment I need, and offers all kinds of classes from spinning to ballet barre and yoga. The owner Suzanne is really nice and friendly, and her staff is as well, so, I'm going to be going here as long as I can work out and my body is in working order ! :)
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Staff is pleasant. No complaints.

Bed was extremely hard and uncomfortable. Sheets stiff and scratchy. Pillows should have been tossed long ago. The bed is what kept this place from 4 stars. 

Restaurant on site as is a fitness center. I didn't use either and so won't comment. 

Location near river but you'll probably just look at a parking lot and construction. Walls very thin.

No microwave?? Mini fridge not very good. 

Room was clean. Thank you!!

Parking is free! Yay! Parking is not attached and I wasn't comfortable with the lot next door. Boo! 

It's ok. Is it worth the premium? No.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A great local pizza shop with delicious wood fire pizza. Tucked away in a parking lot in Ardmore, Felicia's serves up a wide variety of gourmet and traditional pizzas packed with flavor. The gourmet white pies in particular stand out thanks to Felicia's in-house garlic sauce and quality toppings. Prices are very reasonable and wait times are relatively short. The only drawback is that their pies are made with a cornmeal crust, resulting in a very messy, albeit tasty eating experience. My personal favorite items include the Felicia Special, Clams and Garlic Bianca, Grecian, and the Four Cheese with Sweet Onion. Four stars - Recommend.

Saw this new restaurant had opened when I was getting my nails done a few doors down and was pleasantly surprised with all the positive reviews for the first location in Boise.  We went for dinner and are so glad we did.  The restaurant does not take reservations but there was little wait.  Our waitress was super attentive, knew the menu well, and quickly had our food ordered.  The Caesar salad was delicious but I would not order if you don't like Parmesan..... there is a good amount of it in the salad.  Garlic bread is served while waiting for your meal.  We had the lasagna and scallop risotto.  Both were flavorful and ample portions.

I would give less then one star if I could. The Area Director Jeremy Ramirez is even less helpful then the crew member working on her own and had no help. She gave my wife the managers telephone which was called but no help. Jeremy was trying to turn the bad experience around on us the customer I never heard of a customer service driven company of doing such. The one on Tucson blvd by the airport way better food and customer service. I do not know why Jeremy Ramirez is a Area director or any kind of manager member. Jeremy might need to find a job cleaning out barns on a horse ranch. Again do not eat here!

I wish I could give more Stars to Lolita but I just can't. They were the only place on a Friday night with open tables and I can see why. Upon arrival there were 3 open tables and we were star closest to an alley that produced an unpleasant smell quite frequently. Chips and salsa were overly priced and overly salted! The nachos were so toasted to the point of a burnt flavor. The saving grace was the fish tacos which were fresh with a yummy chipotle sauce. Staff was nice, place was cute, but I probably won't be returning.

I don't go to Media much but it was nice stumbling upon this sushi place. The inside wasn't very big but everything was nicely spaced out. 

I dined in for lunch specials and was very pleased! I got a teriyaki shrimp bento box that came with shrimp, rice, California rolls, egg rolls, and dumplings. So many things to munch on and taste. The star of the dish was the shrimp and yummy egg rolls. All the sides were all veg friendly too! 

The sushi was good! Nothing over the top exciting but worth a lunch try. The lunch rolls didn't have much of a description so I have no idea what the spider roll was but again everything was good!

Busy night during the holiday season there was a 20+ minute wait for dining room but open sitting at the bar top.  Female bartender was solid, made great drinks! Shared some apps and salads- the Greek salad is one of the best I've ever had and the fried ravioli is amazing! It's not heavily breaded at all so you can really appreciate the tasty filling and the cream sauce the comes with it is delicious!  I was impressed at how fast the food came out considering the place was full; will definitely be returning for more.

2 stars go to the quality of the sushi and the music. Minus three stars because of the service is very slow. The staff was very friendly though. I have frequented this restaurant a few times and have noticed that the service is extremely slow but friendly. The restaurant was very empty except for a Togo order which they where being taken care of first instead of actual diners. I was starving and didn't have  time to wait around so I grumpily left. I'm not sure if I will be back again because of how slow the service is. Its a shame because the food and music is so good.

I've been to Sal's many times in the past, never really had a bad experience until tonight.  The service was slow but in these times it's to be expected and patience is required.  Only bright spot of the meal was the calamari appetizer.  Salads were lightly dressed and watery and for real who puts onion on a Caesar salad?!?!?! Entree ordered was chicken piccata but it came alone on the plate in a pool of sauce, without a single caper on the dish.  I know I'm the weird one that actually enjoys capers but without them it makes it just a garlic lemon chicken dish.  I think that next time I'm craving I'll just try to make it at home.

Upon walking in to get a friendly greeting and seated right away or not too much of a long wait. The food here I believe is pretty flavorful. The salsa isn't bland and the drinks are strong. The steak tacos are seasoned really well! Very good looking set up and clean. The night we went our server was awful and seem to be in a rush to leave his shift. He was more focused on his side work then us. I had to stop him to ask for silveawear after my husband begin to eat like a caveman lol. Once I stopped him he seemed really upset. I would reccomend trying this spot regardless of our service. I am sure they have some great ones.

Holy cow! This is good. I haven't been able to eat many carbs for a little while now and pizza crust is out of the question. Along comes Lou Malnati's on Yelp and they have a crust less pizza!  It's basically a big meatball/sausage spread out in a pan with globs of cheese and tomato sauce. The meatball/sausage crust is crispy and delicious!
Do I miss the crust? Of course. I l-o-v-e bread. But this doesn't make me whine about it. Filled with flavor! You can add toppings, but you don't have to. I'm going to order it again!
The salad and homemade dressing are good too!
Thanks once again, Yelpers. You don't steer me wrong!!

The service was excellent. They sat us upstairs and at first it was great because it was nice, quiet and quaint but we should have realized that upstairs is where they seat large parties which means lots of noise. No sooner had our salads arrived that a large noisy group arrived at the same time and that was that. We also shared the New York pizza which was ok. We didn't have any pasta or desserts so we can't attest to the quality or taste of any of those dishes. We will definitely be back to try the pasta dishes and next time if they try and seat us upstairs we know better.

I don't even know how to account for the 1 star they're receiving. Walked in...zero acknowledgement, no assistance, nothing. I've been wearing glasses for over 20 years, never have I received this minimal amount of customer service. I also worked in retail for a couple years..what has happened? Are we now discriminating against people whom do and do not wear masks? Needless to say the lack of sanitation contradicts the whole purpose of being considerate.  Either way, they should do some reflection because I initially intended on spending a decent amount of money at this location. This is not it. Off to Sarasota I go!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: We're die hard lifetime members of Marriott, just completed our 596th lifetime stay. This property was gross, not well taken care of whatsoever. The property needs a total makeover and sooner rather than later would be beneficial. We've NEVER stayed at a Marriott property that was in such terrible condition. I'll attach a few pics of the room we stayed in. Marriott should have one of their Senior VP's walk this place from top to bottom, even common areas were dirty. Saddens us to leave such a heart breaking review on a Marriott property.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The staff is friendly and the place considered clean.  It is a fast food after all.  I was here for the 5 for $4 since I saw it on commercial.  Really, hard to beat the deal and the food quality better than I thought.  If you need a quick meal, either no time or no money or both.  Not a bad deal.  However, if I have a choice, I rather go to other fast food chain. A dollar more but to me the food tastes better there.  This location also has their bathroom locked and guess to discourage unwanted guests due to the area is a bit rough.

Admittedly, I think I mistook this restaurant for another 'China Spring', but, nevertheless, it's Chinese takeout we're talking about here...this is nothing new. 

One order of Veggie Lo Mein, one order of Chicken Lo Mein, two spring rolls, and one egg roll. 
Let's just say I've had a lot better. It was edible, but I usually go for more than that when I'm eating dinner. The rolls were just something, which, hey, fried=tasty at least to some extent. The Lo Mein was very unspectacular. Lot's of sauce, not enough flavor. No freshness. 

I don't know that I'll give this one another go.

My car dealership has a rental agreement contract with Enterprise when my car is under warranty maintenance.  Received my Reservation number.and called at 349pm to ask for a ride to facility.  The agent stated pickup would be around 445-530pm. I was told the driver would call when near.  No one showed.  Not a call. This is not the first time this location has provided poor service to family, friends, and myself.  Chose another location!  This one lacks professionalism and customer service skills!  It is NOT okay for me to loose income.  It is not okay for me to scramble to try to find alternative transportation for school and work.

Excellent spot and I don't know how I hadn't been here before!  Highlights based on what our party of 6 ordered were the spare ribs, braised short rib "meatloaf", and shrimp & grits.  The spare ribs were by far the best I've ever had and really fell off the bone.  Their spin on "meatloaf" was both creative and now my new favorite way to eat short ribs.  The Thyme Out and R&B old fashioned were fantastic cocktails.
Would not recommend ordering the grilled peach and burrata salad, as the peaches were not grilled much and were just not ripe.  It was served as a salad with spinach, which detracted from the peaches, tomatoes and burrata flavors.

We just had the best dinner EVER! Delivered by Door Dash.
We had: Chicken Caesar-delicious chicken, shaved parm, fantastic dressing. Penne vodka- creamy, yummy! Mozzarella in Carrosa- this was 2 beautiful fresh thick cut mozzarella, lightly breaded, fried, and covered in an amazing tomato sauce, penne Bolognese- one of the best I've had, the penne and meat sauce were are mixed together not just poured on top of pasta- so amazing, pizza margharite (sp?) was perfect (although I like my basil cut small and this was full leaves.) So, as you can guess, we'll be going back there for incredible Italian food! 10/10!

Probably the best customer service I have ever received at any Starbucks ever. I normally don't go to Starbucks for coffee as it's a little pricy but my wife and I really wanted to try the Irish Cream Americano which was very good. 

The person (wish I would have got her name) that was working drive thru gave us the best customer service I have ever received. It took awhile to make the coffees but because she was delightfully having a conversation with us it didn't feel like we waited long. 

For all Starbucks fans I would strongly recommend this location.

Very nice breakfast. Perfectly cooked, amble portion of steel cut oats, delectable bowl of hearty shrimp and grits, the coffee was very good, and the atmosphere was relaxing and quaint. The only critique is they were a little skimpy on the half and half. I don't think places fully appreciate how minuscule the amounts in those tiny little cups are. We had to request more every time we had our coffees refilled. All in all, a little gem of a place not far from our hotel for a quick walk to a nice late breakfast.

Not good! Have eaten here many times and it was alright for the area.  Decided to try their buffet. The buffet food is NOT the same quality of food as if you ordered that as an entree itself. Even the rice was disgusting! To top it off it was more expensive and they were not attentive. 2 totally different experiences. When I asked how come the difference she just looked at me. When I told her I would not be returning she replied "Okay ". That experience alone I will never return. #customerservice #standbyyourproduct

The food and service at this place is beyond great. This is the gold standard that restaurants strive for. 
We've been here several times and while it can get a little loud, it never disappoints. the menu is fresh and changes frequently and the staff is attentive and genuinely friendly. 
We love being able to enjoy innovative food without going to the city and without the pretentious snobby attitude you find at so many places.
Be warned if you go on a weekend, the parking in Conshohocken is less than ideal, be prepared to walk.

I wish I knew of this place when I bought four new tires for my car this past summer. I got a nail in my tire this morning and it was completely flat. I had to drive on the flat for a bit, and as the guy from roadside assistance was putting on the spare doughnut tire he said, "You'll probably need a new tire." Stopped here this afternoon to see if I could get it fixed or buy a used tire if need be. The staff was super friendly, and it turned out my tire was able to be patched. The prices were fair, and I was in and out in 15 minutes. Will definitely be back for anything my car needs.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This place would get 5 stars if they changed just one thing. When I think of California Mexican I think of healthy Mexican with Avocados, Shrimp, Carne Asada,  Jalapenos, Tomatoes, No Lard etc. Problem....everything I tried on the their menu tastes like the number 1 ingredient used is SALT! Mexican food from California is healthy, Salt causes congestive heart failure. Allow the produce, meat, sauce to be the flavor. YOU DON"T NEED Ten Barrels of Salt in Everything. The chef that makes the recipes needs to cut salt by 90 percent. Then you will get 5 stars.

The food here is pretty good for a fast food Mexican place. I love California burritos and this is the only place I've seen that does them. However, the wait is always really really long here--long enough that we will probably find another spot. We ordered to go tonight and waited for close to 30 minutes for two burritos. The woman who rang us up didn't complete the transaction before walking away, so our ticket was never added to the queue. The staff isn't the most friendly either. If you don't mind those two things and just want Mexican, enjoy!

I love me some lions choice, but since the pandemic hit...this place has really taken a downhill spiral.  They have lost a ton of business from me.  Service isn't good.  Never say hi. Have a good day.  This is all your order..nothing.   Just hand me the order and close the window.  They cram 3-4 king meals in a little bag.  I ask for sauces and I never get them(I do however check now before I leave the parking lot).  King roast beef sandwiches and fries seem to have smaller portions.  Just sad and disappointed my favorite restaurant has come to this.

So sad. Used to love this. Friday 10-2 called they said 75 minute wait.  I should have ditched it but they have not let me down in the past.  When we got, 5 minutes early, there a good 10 minute wait and got home to a stone cold pizza.  If you call and they tell you more than 20 minutes, go somewhere else. All I wanted was a good, hot pizza. And I was willing to wait. And to management, next time tell the customer we can't deliver quality. I would have been a lot more respectful if you had been honest of that statement. Kind of like calling a restaurant and they say, no reservations.

The food was amazing. I had fried chicken tacos, which was amazing. I also had the guacamole. Possibly the best guacamole I've had. Service was great. Unfortunately, the 3 stars comes from the disappointment in the tres leche cake. Don't get me wrong, the cake was good, but it wasn't an authentic tres leche cake. Tres leche cake is a moist cake and the cake presented to me was far from it. I'm Hispanic and had my fair share of tres leche, so I'm expecting to get blown away, but my expectations fell short. The food was amazing though.

Very friendly staff! Always accommodating. I always miss breakfast because when I'm on vacation I don't get up in time for their continental breakfast that they offer with your room. The staff was so accommodating that they actually took care of me after the breakfast was over. If you need anything, anything at all they will get it to you! Smiles and happiness great conversation and ideas of what to do we're provided to us. I highly recommend this location only six minutes to the airport!  Nice pool and very clean! I'll be back
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I didn't love this place.  But it might be because I ordered the wrong thing -  my dining partners got sashimi and sushi and loved their meals.  

I ordered the ramen which I was really looking forward to.  And our server helped me pick which ramen I would want.    I also ordered an app.  My ramen came out first about 10 minutes before my dining partners' meals.   Then my dining partners' meals came out.   And then my app came out when I was more than halfway done my ramen.   Sadly, i found the broth of my ramen lackluster.

If I come here again I would definitely get sushi as that was a hit with the rest of my table.

Another awesome experience at Bella. Went to stop for dessert and the panna cotta was delicious! It's the first time we had it and it was the refreshing perfect way to end the night. The tiramisu was delicious as well but the panna cotta was the winner in our visit. I recommend Bella Napoli for date nights the vibe is amazing and perfect for dates, catch up with friends it's not loud you can hear each other. The service is awesome we haven't had a bad experience. The staff is always so friendly and checks on you often.

Six of us met on a Friday night. The food was really good. My husband and sister  had the Tuna Carpaccio, described as excellent as was his Bison tenderloin special. So. & I had the Lobster Bisque which was very good, buttery with chunks of lobster meat except it wasn't hot enough. The eggplant parm.  was also  well done. Others in our party enjoyed the Bronzino, Veal Parm. and seafood stew. Other than the temp of the bisque the only negative was that the room temperature fluctuated from too cold and blowing to overly warm. Bring a sweater to resolve that. The food makes it worth a return visit!

Monthly membership is a Great concept. I have the $20 monthly. For the most part not too bad. Need uniformity between locations. Bristol location had no soap applied during one visit, Only clear water. Fairless Hills location does not include blow dry, but has soap during wash cycle. You have to have the Works car wash at $29 a month to get the blow dry feature..Haven't tried the Bensalem location yet so I can't comment. I must admit my car has never been so clean. All memberships should include wash, rinse and blow dry. Competition offers free vacuuming. So only gave 3 stars.

People had been recommending Faustos to us for a while so finally decided to go and check it out.  They have a good lunch special that comes with bread and salad so we went there for that. 

We got the crawfish pasta (we asked for a different sauce but they forgot about that request); the manicotti which was stuffed with spinach and cheese, and the stuffing had no flavor; and the eggplant parmesan which had a nice sauce and was alright

Overall, it tasted more homemade than restaurant - which can be good sometimes - but it was an average tasting meal.  I didn't get the hype, but that just my opinion

After a long walk in the park we worked up an appetite. Didn't know what to try next so we settled on sushi. Luckily near by just 10 minutes away we found this place and decided to give it a go. Placed our takeout order and patiently waited forgetting it's a Saturday night and everyone usually eats out. It was worth it though. About an hour wait, we finally got our order. Sushi tasted fresh, had some of the usual normal rolls and 2 special rolls. I forgot which ones we ordered though hahaha. One had mango and I believe spicy salmon....it was tasty. Also ordered the wasabi sumai. Everything we ordered was yummy.

Oggi is my favorite Italian restaurant anywhere!  They took a dingy old bar on Davis Islands and turned it into a quaint restaurant with an outside dining area that will remind you of Italy.  But it's the food that keeps me coming back.  I crave the Creamy Smoked Salmon with Pasta, and just to mix it up a bit, will sometimes have the Butternut Squash Ravioli.  Both are awesome.  The customer service is wonderful, and the way they have set up takeout orders during the Pandemic makes it so easy to get a wonderful meal to go.  Oggi is well worth the trip to Davis Islands.

THIS PLACE IS HORRIBLE!!! Do not move here!! The good reviews were paid for by IMT! I have attached photos of the DISGUSTING garbage rooms!! The maintenance is a joke, the office does NOTHING to make improvements. People they let move here are trash! They allow aggressive breeds! A pitbull bit my neighbor in the hand!!! People speed in the garage and driveway almost ran over myself and my dog. STAY FAR AWAY FROM HERE TRUST Me - and yes his review is for the new management IMT not Matrix!! Also the lights that have been "repaired" in the front are out again. It is pitch black out there at night- dangerous!

We used to live closer to the Banfield on 60 and we're pretty happy with the service there. I'm sad to say all banfields are not created equal. This one is consistently poorly run, behind schedule, disorganized. It's frustrating to get in to see a vet and even dropping them off is a hassle. It's never quick or painless. We have our huskies on wellness plans but we will be canceling them to use Brandon Lakes animal hospital or another local vet. The vet techs don't always seem like they know what they're talking about when trying to explain the vets notes which is concerning. I would recommend you follow suite and find a different vet!

Alright, the food was okay.. The Sunday Gravy came out in intervals - I don't think that's really how it's supposed to come out but it was okay at best. There isn't a very large drink menu, the waiters will try to convince you to order what they think is the closest to what you really want - however, I wouldn't listen to their suggestions. After the food came out, our waiter didn't come back until she asked if we were ready for our check. So the service wasn't what I had expected it to be. It's in a great location, I'm sure there's better things on the menu but my first and last impression of this restaurant is that it's just not for me.

Giovanni's for lunch provided a pleasant atmosphere with decent food at fair prices.  A bit disappointed because several people had touted it as the best Italian restaurant.   I did not find it superior to any of the other area Italian places where we have eaten in the last 40 years.  There was only one soup offering - Pasta Fasogli (sp?).  The broth was thin and did not have much flavor.  Eggplant Parm and Steak Sandwiches were tasty with a good ratio of filling to roll.  In fairness we did not sample the pastas or the pizza - perhaps, that was why we were not overly enthusiastic.

First of all this is definitely not California Mexican food. Let's start there.

The food was ok but I couldn't give it a better description than "just ok". I got a California burrito due to their gigantic eye assaulting sign that says "Home of the ORIGINAL California burrito." It definitely was not impressive. It was pretty bland but not bland enough for me to stop eating it just bland enough for me to give an audible "hmm" after each bite. 

My husband ordered a Torta. He said the same thing...bland. Just ok.

We did get a churro that resembled a cinnamon sugar covered paper towel roll though. 0/10.

If you guys visit this place on a Sunday and happens to know the song "taking it easy on a Sunday morning " yeah! That's this places. It seems like your dealing with a sloth.  They only have two people working on Sunday.. I walk from target which is there's a Starbucks there inside, I should just stay there and get my iced coffee. However, I'm very patient with this place and waited 10 minutes standing in front of the counter and wait for the employee to help me out. 
Happy Sunday,, note to everyone: don't ruin your day for a very slow service in this place and keep moving forward if this happens to u.

I think you have to go the trust route. I had a house salad, Cesar salad and pepperoni pizza and it was very forgettable. Just tasted so processed and like buffet pizza or something lacking quality. I believe this place is a chain and maybe I didn't order the right thing, but I wasn't impressed. Also if you're into Pizza ranch don't bother because the ranch tastes like hidden valley, not special very average. I'm going to give it this visit a score of 3 out of 7; so that's a 43ish percentile and that equates to something in the 2 star range. 

If I ever go back I'll try the pizza with a twist, just not sure I ever will.

Ordered a Italian Sausage 9" on the Monday special - but it amazed me - I've been going to Hogie House for over 30 years and honestly never had such a dismal sandwich in all those years whether a Monday during the week or a weekend 3' 6' or 8' 
As you can see by the picture or possibly not but 5" of Meat on a 9" roll. 
Just very disappointing, even if it was covered 
With vegetables it would all vegetables and no meat 
Maybe they will improve - I won't give up but hope the cook does improve 
Thank you Hogie House for being there for all those years

I loved the shrimp Hibachi rice, it's a good portion to feed a few. The family tried a crab rangoon for the 1st time & likes it. I was referred here by my sister who orders often for her family. I ordered late & picked up right before closing. The restaurant was blocked off for COVID restrictions but I noticed how beautiful the restaurant is. After paying my bill, the lady took the cash & walked off, & I immediately thought to myself, "wow, no thank you"... it would've been nice to be thanked so I'm giving 4 stars for the food only.

My daughter told me about this place so we visited on a Sunday. It's pretty busy & ordering takes a while as people are able to taste Ice cream before deciding. I tasted the rum raisin & ordered the pistachio which was good. I initially ordered a Lolli-Waffle (waffle on a stick with toppings) but they were out of it ;(. My daughter had some snacks like Doritos with a special topping that includes corn & mayonnaise & cheese mixture, she liked it, I didn't. She also something similar in a cup (pictured). It's in Kenner, pretty far from our house. It was a pretty cool visit.

This was our first time trying St Mary's from a recommendation from a friend. The problem was that we came in a group of 4 and had a total of 3 orders. Our friends got their meals within 10 minutes and it took myself and my husband 35 minutes to get ours. We all ordered the same thing, chorizo, egg and bean burritos, so that was very disappointing. Our friends meal was cold before we got ours. The food was good but nothing better than a Filiberto's or Roliberto's. Will probably hit something else next time we are craving Mexican food.

I like this location they are friendly and They are usually cool at this location. Lately every time I ask for the dark roast coffee they lie straight to my face and say they don't have it. I let it slide the past few times. Today I called them out on their not so good poker face and told them stop lying to me about not having the dark roast blend (hot coffee) as soon as I did that all of a sudden they had it available. They just don't want to brew it for some reason. What's up with that? I read people very well you can't bs me!

I moved to the area earlier this year and have been looking for an honest location that does good work. Vince's delivers hands down, and I know this because they suggested against expensive repairs other shops told me I needed, when I requested Vince's do the work. I've brought my car here for inspection and they are able to do so within the same day and accomodate my schedule to allow me to have my car for work. All the mechanics here are polite, patient, and knowledgeable and even though I know nothing about cars, take the time to educate me. Take your car here, you won't regret it.

Great car was makes the rigs look very clean and the included vacuum are nice too great suction to get all the funk outta your rig. Only reason for 4 stars and not 5 is when signing up for their "vet protect plan" ($30 wash for $20) great deal  they charge you $30 to start you off then "refund" $10. Then supposedly the system will only charge $20 monthly after that (haven't had a monthly charge yet to know if it works like this or not). Wife's been going here for just over three weeks and still no refund to our card. We've talked to three people so far the latest being today to solve the issue. We'll see if it happens this next week.

I have had take-out from here twice, and so far so good. The food is pretty good and one of the better Chinese places here in Boise.  I dont recommend and of the shrimp dishes, for some reason they are extremely fishy tasting, and while it may be a good thing for some, it wasn't for me. 

I also thought that Top Wok was fairly pricey for Boise. They are more expensive than places you go to in San Francisco. Not sure why their prices are so high.

All-in-all food was good, and the customer service was great. We will be back

This place used to be so good but for some reason it just went down hill.  We got the tacos de lengua and tacos al pastor and both were so bland. Absolutely no seasoning at all. We ate it all cause we were so hungry but I wished I would have gone elsewhere.  The asada fries were better but still lacking flavor too.  The best thing was the grill onions and jalapeños. The girl at the drive through misheard our order as well so she gave us 2 asada fries so now we are stuck with 2 orders of boring and tasteless fries. Disappointment is an understatement.

Believe it or not, I've never ever had Krispy Kreme and was understandably very excited when I heard that they were opening up in sparks near me.  We waited a few days to go after they opened because the line was ridiculous and it was still crazy when we went (we waited an hour and a half in the drive-thru) but let me tell you, it was just as good if not better than I expected.  I got 2 dozens of original glazed and it was so soft and really sweet. I went just a week ago and got their spring edition minis and they were adorable.  Will definitely go again

Yummy teas! Heard that too soul tea is the place to go so we decided to stop by.  Super cute orange building that you cannot miss. Was greeted by really nice staff who answered any questions I had. I ended up ordering a bunch of teas since I couldn't choose one. I got the peach pomegranate tea, pineapple mojito tea, passion fruit mango tea and maple bar tea.  All were so different but very delicious and refreshing.  The interior was very clean and welcoming with nice tables and seating area. They also sell jewelry too which is super cute. Will come again.

First and foremost, I am not a fan of Indian food at all. But I have been craving pizza and usually always eat at Grimaldis or pizza plus but saw great reviews for Chicago's Pizza with A Twist and wanted to give them a try.  I was very nervous ordering since they have an Indian twist to their pizzas but I ordered the Buttered chicken pizza (it was so good!,) Three Idiots (absolutely delicious,) and Curry Paneer(pretty good but was different.) The pizzas looked and smelled great and taste great too. I really enjoyed it and will definitely come back to try more of their pizzas and appetizers!

Don't bother using Hertz! The people are the airport we're awesome and helpful but the company it selves are crooks!! I was quoted one price and prepaid to lock in the rate. Once I returned the vehicle it came out double the original price I paid! I've never had to deal with this in my life of renting vehicles. I always prepay so I get the  best rate and only pay for extra services at the end that may come up. Such at $15 for them to clean the outside of the vehicle! I tried to talk to someone in customer service and she was no help at all! Went around in circles and got no where! Stay away from Hertz!

When yet another fast food burger joint opened in Cahokia a few years ago, I rolled my eyes. But to my surprise, this place is actually a gem. Their menu is somewhat simple but the quality and service are exceptional. The burgers are the best in town. The Mexican food is generally good too, but can be hit or miss. The staff is courteous. The dining area is very clean and comfortable. The owner is usually on-site which likely accounts for the good service and food. Now even better, they serve margaritas, and they're cheap!

Tasty mexican food. I had tacos de cabeza. I've never had this particular taco the way it was made here. Tasty but I prefer the street taco way. Not deep Fried. The menudo was AWESOME. The only thing is that they prepared it before I got it. I don't like the fix ins. With that being said, let them know In advance. (Unless you like it) Otherwise the flavor was definitely there. Also, the owner was incredibly sweet as well as the cook! They both came to our table to make sure we were happy. 


*side note- they were very clean bathroom and all**

Great product!  How can you screw it up, it's Krispy Kreme, right?  Not so much.  So many employees standing around with 1-2 worker bees. It's filthy after being open for a month. Have to scream over the music for an order, and the OG Glaze donut is over-fried. Red Light means you get 2-4 hour old donuts. It's not rocket surgery, it's donuts. Not warm, or Hot as the sign says. I can get better product at a Circle K or Dunkin' Donuts without the attitude and indifference.  I hope they do better and stay open, but the hype has died down.  I give them 2 years.

I have observed chef's behavior since hygiene is first and foremost requirement of any sushi restaurant. First the chef wore the glove, took the credit card, touched a bunch of buttons on the pos, swiped the credit card, pull the receipt, gave the receipt to the waitress. While still wearing the same gloves, the chef grabbed empty dishes, open the knob of a plastic container, dug out some ginger by hand, opened an another container lid, grabbed metal utensils and scooped some wasabi. Do you see anything wrong with the whole thing? If not then give this place five stars yourself. As for me, this place gets zero stars.

Not very good .... lady who took our order was VERY rude and the entire time waiting, we heard them yelling at each other. (Unprofessional) After taking our food home-20 minutes later- I was finally ready to relax and settle in and yuk.. the chicken taste like complete"ketchup sauce"(suppose to be sesame) the teriyaki chicken sticks were the same way!!! Veggie fried rice contained only onion, peas and carrot slices which seemed to be from Save a lot! Defiantly not fresh... save yourself the hassle and just travel a few miles down to oldsmar .... Chef Li is soooooooo much better and authentic. We won't be returning

we ordered to go on a Saturday afternoon. Place is rather hidden. The small space was empty with no one other than the host and cook. Food was decent, definitely laking salt. We ordered the penne alla vodka with chicken and ziti with beef sauce(totaling $27-ehhh)....The chicken was flavorless and tough and both dishes could stand to have more cheese or perhaps a better quality of cheese... the two were very similar in taste and definitely something I could make at home. Wedding Soup was tasty but the small container was filled maybe 3/4 of the way. Not terrible but I'd probably try other Italian places before coming back.

I had lunch there because I was craving chicken picatta; I ordered it and it was pretty blah. Not very flavorful at all and the chicken was 2 itty bitty pieces of chicken, not happy to pay almost 20 dlls. for this plate. Also the other dish ordered had a TON of sauce that looked from a can...disgusting. Bread was not good either and the minestrone soup tasted old... Caesar salad was made with arugula instead of romaine lettuce so kind of disappointing. Need to improve A LOT!
Also the kid serving the tables was talking to some girls all through our meal hardly paying any attention to us. I won't be giving it another try.

Came here at 3:30 the other day with my mom and had an absolutely amazing time! The staff is wonderful and very knowledgeable about the menu and so friendly. The food is delicious and beautifully prepared. I got a Spinach & Farro salad and added on chicken to it. I honestly didn't expect the chicken to be quite so big but i was happily surprised. We also got the biscuits which had the best sauce paired with them and to finish off we got bread pudding which was absolutely wonderful. It was just the right amount of chocolate and salted caramel and of course topped with freshly whipped cream. I would definitely come here again!

Every time I've been in here, the employees look like they haven't showered in awhile and act like they hate being here. They yell at each other with contempt as well. They have no clue about customer service nor are they trying. The donuts are nasty and my vanilla latte was so sweet I had to throw it away. The second trip I got regular coffee, but they wouldn't let me put in my own cream & sugar and they put in way too much, and it's not hot. You'd do much better going to the High Brow coffee shop down the street, but real donuts are hard to find around here.

A couple of weeks ago I was waiting in line to order my food. When it was my turn, one of the 2 American American males looked past me and asked the people behind me to place their order. The people walked around me and I saw they too were African American. I  took this as a racist act and walked away.

Today as I was leaving Walmart I asked the African American woman standing at the counter what time they open. She ignored me and when she realized I wasn't going to leave without an answer, she turned her head and in a hostile tone said 7.

I don't know what their problem is, but I know their behavior is racist. I am a middle aged white man.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The general cleanliness of the room/facilities was fine and the staff were generally cordial. However, the toilet seat in my room was broken and was never fixed. The remote was also not working.  They eventually replaced it after handing me another remote that also didnt work.  The worst part was that after returning to my room on my second day there, the door was open.  Nothing was missing and the staff said it was probably an error on the cleaning staff's part.  If I am paying over $100  a night I expect things to be working and not broken and certainly not have to worry about the door being left open.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The coffee is fine, but when someone comes into your cafe and wants to sit down with a cup of coffee and a snack, they should not have to have their ears blasted with two different kinds of loud, cacophonous music! When I tried to sit in this place this morning, a very loud radio was blasting music from the kitchen while different music was piped into the seating area through the sound system.

The staff was oblivious, the clerk who took my order mumbled so badly that he could barely be heard or understood. No one was wearing a mask despite the worst and most contagious outbreak of Covid 19 we have experienced so far.

I love the pizza when it is made correctly.  The problem is that they are inconsistent.  Yesterday i had an overcooked dry pizza.  It was disgusting.    You never know what you are going to get.  Also, the guys behind counter are rude, unfriendly and some are just plain dirty.    They touch money and go right to making sandwiches.   They need to take a class on customer service and personal hygiene.    

Update: nothing had changed. Great pizza if the right person makes it.  Filthy looking workers and rude.   Scraggly bearded guys making food with no hair nets.   Come on guys!

This area is fortunate to have some good Italian spots. This place holds its own. The location is good and there is an option to sit both inside and out. I even think they keep an outdoor option into the colder months with the use of heaters. 

This was my first visit and everything that my husband and I ordered was good. We started with the pancetta with shrimp and the caprese salad. For dinner we had gnocchi with mushrooms and the clam linguine. Everything had good flavor and it came out in a timely manner.

I got a pepperoni pizza for a get together a few days ago, the guests claim it's their favorite pizza place. Personally I have visited nearly every pizza place in the area, Morty's pizza places around 4th. The pizza had a pleasant taste, but was fairly soft and greasy. Normally I like thin crispy pizza, this was not that. I will say the most unique thing they did was treat the crust as if it were a garlic knot (garlic, parm, and butter) that was a fairly surprising move as not many do things to the crust. I appreciated that greatly. 
Bottom line if you want something wet and tasty this is it, if you want crispy pizza then look elsewhere.

I am usually very impressed with my Marriott stays.  This time not so much.  When we got to our room it smelled like fish, im assuming the people before us cooked fish in the kitchen and the cleaners did not do a great job to get the smell out.  The front desk girl was very polite and accommodating,  she changed us to another room right away.   As far as the breakfast,  until they go back to normal openings I would just stick to cold breakfast. They offered a bacon egg and cheese muffin that was horrible.  The bacon was undercooked and limp,  the egg yolk was not full cooked. 
Overall it was just an okay experience
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Fresh fish/ sushi  always packed with almost no seating area, have to get take out every time, but still very good. The tuna dumpling (filled with avocado) is an interesting combo, but both creamy and rich taste/texture kinda lost the freshness of the fish. Seafood medley (sunomono) is a great app for fresh fish lovers, with multiple diced sashimi combination and ponzu sauce. A great place to try sea urchin (uni) if you never had before--it can only be enjoyed fresh and they only serve it when they have it fresh: absolutely buttery and melts in your mouth!

We came here after Arizona opened up and boy, we shouldn't have.
