This was our favorite Ritz before but it made us really sad to see how many people were here, pools slammed, no guest really even trying to social distance, and the peace ruined with numerous ratty, screeching kids with their California families. Plate after plate in valet was from California. We cut our trip short a day early because we could not get any peace at the pool or on the property except our room and even then, was awakened early with the sounds of doors slamming and kids crying. We told the front desk and they didn't even seem to care at all. We doubt we will be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Visited Sushi Ai for the fIrst time.  I ordered the bento 2 item combo special.  The miso soup was ok - meaning it was hot.  The rice was ok.  But this is  where the meal takes a turn for the worse.  

The salad was mushy and the dressing watery - as if the greens were washed and then drowned with dressing without first spinning the greens.  The beef teriyaki was pretty tasteless and the meat itself a little tough.  The California roll was dry - the rice tasted  "old".   Overall, a disappointing meal and a waste of calories.

Service at this location is not good.  Long wait times - even if you make an appointment.  The "greeter" should not be greeting - but instead running one of the teller booths etc to reduce the wait time.  The cashiers can be a bit rude too. 

I don't understand the plexiglass rooms opposite the tellers.  They are definitely NOT sound proof.  I was sitting  on one of the couches in the middle of the bank waiting for my turn and I heard EVERYTHING the banker and the customer were saying.   I had an appointment but still I waited over 15 mins for my turn.

Amazing new neighborhood nosh joint but oh so good.  Pizza, harvest and focaccia bread from their Naples imported clay fire oven, white bean hummus with mint. Winter salad with farro ,pomemgranet and pumpkin seeds and a special dressing made me want to lick the bowl.  Entree was gnocchi with pork ragu, as good as in Florence!  Great Italian wine selection with suggestions by very knowledgeable staff. All in a warm, inviting atmosphere.  New but you already need reservations if you want a table as opposed to the bar counter service. Will return often.

This place is very tight for large groups but then again it's worth it. The place is absolutely clean from top to bottom. I prefer sitting in the upstairs for a bit more privacy.
We have eaten here before but only having the pizza being the lentin season when all my sister's and brother get together.
So I was down again in South Philly at my sister's house she asked if I wanted a cheesteak cause her fiancé was on the way to go for take out. She recommended a cheesesteak or chicken cheesteak. I got the best cheese steak ever. It was on their own fresh baked bread.
I'll be back very soon

Been here for a week the last 2 years.

I was very pleased with the cleanliness of the room, the service, Good Steak in the Watercolours restaurant.

They have a nice inside Bar/ Lounge music on Friday and Saturday.
Rick Williams is the bartender, but he is much more than that he is a true Mixologist.
He can make any drink and they are all great. Rick is also great  at conversation he makes you relaxed, and feels like he just talked to you yesterday no matter who you are.
 
Stay here have dinner and some drinks with Rick-You will not be disappointed!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Decided to get some Krispy Kreme after the long lines finished. My bf and I walked right in and got our glazed donuts within 5 minutes! So easy. The staff was nice and quick. I haven't had Krispy Kreme in years and it was very nostalgic. I remember getting KK in high school when I used to give students a free donut for every A they got on their report card. Wonder if that's still a thing! Recommend if you are looking for that nostalgic feel. Of course, I usually buy my donuts from local biz -- but Krispy Kreme is good every once in a while.

SUSHI CLUB HONEST REVIEW hola comó estás

This place...where do i start? 
Pros-
Good water (pure tasting and deliciously perfect)
The chicken is scrumptious
Don't even get me started on the A.A.C. Roll. Yum!
The avocado is good but don't get the avocado roll
Vegetable roll - scrumptious
Honestly deserves more customers
Cons- 
Tuna is disgusting along with the salmon
Why would you ever put sour cream in a roll?!
The chicken is served over onions - bad choice
Food takes a second to arrive
The service is mediocre

We normally are huge fans of this restaurant... but tonight was just a bad experience all around. The staff was not friendly and seemed very off, not how it normally is. Hope to just had catch them on a bad night.
Our server was Kayley at the grove. We sat for 15 mins outside after not being recognized we walked inside to ask if we needed to order inside or outside. After someone finally coming to take our drink orderes they told us our server kayley would be with us shortly. After 10 mins of waiting we asked the chef if our sever was coming soon. Once she approached she was very unpleasant and condescending.

Shop around. Can't comment on their actual work. Review is about pricing reliability only. Called to bring in my vehicle for inspection. Mike tells me it's $80 plus tax for inspection and emissions. Get to the shop, now it's $85 plus tax. I inform him that my car is emission exempt because under 5K miles. Father says that in that case, I should wait until son gets back from picking up coffee to see what the price is. Son returns and tells me it's $95 plus tax for inspection regardless of emission exempt.  I went somewhere else. Don's down the street was $35 less for inspection and emission, though still same cost if exempt.

I took a chance on a random pizza place tonight because I was sick of hitting Grotto on my way up 202 north back to PA.  For once in my life the chance was worth it.  I was very pleased with the pizza.  It is cash only, which I actually like, helps keep costs down.  Service was great and the people working there were very welcoming and pleasant.  My only criticism is the fountain soda machine needs the syrup/water mixture adjusted.  The soda was so sickeningly sweet it made the hair stand up on the back of my neck.  I'll plan on stopping again for lunch or dinner next time I'm in the area.

Mostly get take out pizza from Pomodoro, most of the time, it is good pizza, but at other times, it has very little sauce, even if I order exert sauce.  When it is good, it is very good.  When it isn't, it is a disappointment.  They need more consistency. 
I also usually order a cannoli, which is supposedly made fresh each day.  Twice, I have received cannolis which were soggy, obviously not fresh.  The first time, I complained to them through their website, but never heard back.  Tonight was the second time, so I am publishing my complaint on Yelp.  They charge over $5.00 for a cannoli.  It should be fresh.

Welcome back to Northern Nevada, Krispy Kreme.  Hope you will stay this time.  The Sparks/Reno area is growing fast so it seems the perfect time for businesses to come in.  Day 3 of the grand opening so I expected it to busy so I brought my patience with me.  There was a long line both inside and at the drive thru.  The employees were all very nice and although they are new and still learning, they did very well and it did not affect the service as a customer.  So if you will be going the first few weeks, give yourself enough time to get through the lines and be kind.

I so desperately want this independent local grocer to be able to compete with the evil corporate chains! They are the perfect size, have a good selection, and are convenient BUT what good is a grocery store with mediocre produce? Please step up your game! You would absolutely sell organic fruit in this neighborhood. The oranges are usually tasteless too. You guys need to expand this whole section! Please please I don't want to support Whole Foods or Fresh Market. You guys could gain so many customers - I'm sure you're aware you're in an affluent area.

My new go to spot near my new job. Kind of disappointed in the service and the food. I ordered a medium coconut caramel iced latte and they literally gave it to me half full. When I gave it back to them to fill to the top they looked at me with disgust. Then when I got my drink and drove off, IT IS ALL MILK!!!!!!! no coffee taste whatsoever. I don't even drink cows milk I can only handle a little of it but the fact it's all milk made my stomach so upset. I won't be returning here at all. Horrible drinks and my croissant was not the best. Will not be returning.

Fuck this establishment their milkshakes make my stomach hurt, their burgers do not look like the pictures and they also gives me stomach pains, and they also do not give out water cups....... a water cup is and should b free at every restaurant. I walked here after my first final because I had no money and I wanted a nice cup of ice cold water to cool me down from the heat and my unairconditioned school. I now have to walk back to my school in the heat sweating because I was refused something that is suppose to be free. Good thing starbucks gives out free water cups.

The drive thru line takes forever and once you are in it you can not leave. My drink is made incorrectly every time to the point that it tastes bitter instead of sweet and fruity (I order the strawberry refresher). The staff never wear their masks correctly, they hang under their chin. Why even bother wearing one if it isn't actually on? I also get the feeling that the staff couldn't care less about the customers, like we are bothering them. I now go to the one on York rd, just a couple miles away. That one is amazing!

Took my Buick here for half shaft replacement.  While the car was there I was called and told the tie rod ends needed replacing.  Well about 2500 miles later I went to take off the front wheels to check the brake lining.  The person who put the wheels on must have torqued the lug nuts down to about 200 foot pounds.  Had to use a breaker bar with a pipe extension to get them loose.  One stud snapped off.  Once the wheels were off I found out that the tie rod ends were never greased....totally bone dry.  Fortunately only 2500 miles so was able to grease them myself.  Will not be going back here again.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Sitting in the room using my cell phone data since I didn't want to spend $13 a day on the "Free" WiFi. It's a Florida summer, so it is hot outside and freezing inside. Set the thermostat up, but still cold. 

Parking - $14/day

On the plus side, couldn't be more convenient to the airport. 

Room is nice, bed is comfortable. 

No offers of free food as I've seen in other reviews. I am a member of Marriots club, but not gold.

The rooms are amazingly quiet despite the fact that it is overlooking the TPA ramp.

If I had a single overnight, I'd be back.  Longer stay I'd look elsewhere.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Service:
-Really good, although immediate refills would have been appreciated

Ambiance:
-Really cute and romantic. Went for dinner and sat out on the patio--yay heaters! Music was also nice.

Food:
-We got the Parmesan fries, which were unfreaking believable (would go back just for those), the meatball linguini, which was decent, and the bbq chicken pizza (which I thought was a little bland, while my partner didn't but he agreed it was missing something).

Price was about what you'd expect from this sort of place.

Overall:
Would definitely consider going back!

Usually great food and service until today. Went today and was treated rudely. Immediately upon entering was stared at by the entire staff. Was not asked name for pick up but just continued to be stared at. Ordered a half pep pizza and got all pep. I let this slide as this could of been an honest mistake. Upon picking up the food the counter woman slammed my bag of fries with a side of sauce ontop of the pizza. I get home to see sauce spilled all over the bag. Overall, great food which is why I still give three stars but service is spotty and the staff are very rude at times for no reason.

Call me biased, but this Cafe Du Monde is falling way below the line compared to Morning Call. I was so shocked when I realized they don't do table service. Why?.. I realize it's a new company now and they do things different but I feel like it's a bit of a slap in the face to not only stop table service, but to take away the other menu items such as the Mango freeze and hot dogs etc. 2 stars for the beignets coming out hot and a clean building but the menu is too expensive. Sorry but I don't like this new change and I will always wish Morning Call back

Ordered delivery online. Prices are reasonable and the wonton soup is good, but we didn't enjoy the chicken & broccoli. The sauce was very watered-down and lacked much flavor. Broccoli was crunchier than expected but that is a matter of personal taste. My mother enjoyed it, I didn't. Even the free crunchy noodle chips (you know what I'm talking about) were stale and not fresh. I had initially ordered online for take-out, but called to change to delivery. Giving 3 stars for the good customer service,  speedy delivery during rain, and wonton soup.

I went there about a week ago and the manager messed up my guys pizza wings.  We said we ordered a different kind and he argued with us!  Instead of fixing the order he gave us the "correct" sauce and didn't apologize.  We went yesterday,  we were going to get some groceries then get pizza so,  we parked right outside.  The manager came out and said he would tow us if we parked there.  We asked if it was just for employees,  nope.  He was going to tow us for no given reason.  He had been rude with every encounter.  We will never be going there again!

I am not happy with these guys. They nickel and dime you to death. Since getting a 0% credit card with them I have sent in payments far in excess of the minimum due every month. Nevertheless, they have found ways to charge me fees on two occasions over the last year. This time my payment was due on a Sunday - and "Oh Gee," they didn't process my payment until the very next day on Monday and BOOM $27 late fee! Really? Just plain wrong. The whole scam is to reel you in with 0% interest and then find every little way to add unreasonable fees. Find a different source for credit!

It seems as every time I or a member of my family come in here there is something we can't find. No big deal. It happens. However, we always ask an employee for help and the answer always seems to be "Sorry we don't have that". Then as we continue are shopping we end up stumbling across the item we had been searching for. Management you may want to do a training with your staff. All of them on the location of items within your store. Of this happened once. No biggie. But this has happened more than 4 times. With 4 different people. That's a problem. More training on product awareness please.

The breakfast 'pastries' are really awful!!  I thought the Cinnamon would be like the Cinnamon bun they used to have.  Not even close.  It was like something out of a vending machine.  My brother tried the Apple Fritter and threw it away after the first bite.  He said it didn't taste like anything but dough.  I had the the Blueberry which was really terrible.  Didn't taste anything like a Blueberry muffin.
I don't think they bothered to do taste testing on these, they are really, really awful.
Save your money and the calories .....these are NOT worth either.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I went to sushi nami for my birthday because I saw the great reviews on here. I was not disappointed. Byob is great to cut down cost on your bill. While there are cheaper sushi places around the area this place has better sushi and sashimi.

The comparison to this restaurant is Nectar in Wayne. While both places have great sushi, Nectar being a tad better, you will pay for alcohol at Nectar and the prices are almost double compared to Sushi Nami.

I'd highly recommend Sushi Nami for great food and an intimate atmosphere.

We have eaten at Five Guys all over the country. I don't know what this location is doing but it's not good. The burger was way too thick I thought I had got a double. Threw everything off. Not sure what the problem is but come on, guys! Get it together! We spent $75 there tonight and no one thought it was that great. Sad day for our fam. One of our favorite restaurants! Fix it! Someone is cutting corners or something. You may think we can't tell but we can tell. Maybe why at dinner time the restaurant was totally empty. Five Guys are never empty. Come on.

I was so excited to try this pizza after having visited one of their Chicago locations. Three different times, we tried to order but didn't follow through because the waits were over two hours long. I finally got a short wait tonight so I ordered a veggie deep dish. When I got the pizza home, I thought I had ordered the wrong crust. It was much thinner than I had remembered and the crust was very crunchy and charred in places. 
Roselli's Chicago pizza is hands down so much better with a softer, butter crust. This crust was not good. Too thin and crunchy with no flavor. 
Looks like we will continue to order from Rosellis!

We got take-out, and they only did personal pizzas. The dough was really good and the ingredients and toppings were fresh and tasty. However, it was a little too small to really warrant the cost. What we paid for one personal pizza was about the price we'd pay elsewhere for a large pizza that would feed one extra person and have leftovers.

I don't think I'd be going back unless I were seeing a friend I haven't seen in some time and we weren't too hungry but felt the need to sit and eat together. Or I really wanted a treat. In short, the pizza is really special and different from the usual... if you're willing to pay a little more!

i live in the neighborhood and find myself here often. Beautiful flowers.
But a couple of weeks ago i learned no baby products at all, no sundries. before that on a visit no jack cheese. last week no whole chickens ( i guess all the pieces in the "butcher's" counter are pulled that way from cartons. Today no phyllo dough though they do have puff pastry- 2 kinds.

If you need milk or beautiful flowers it is perfect, if you have a list, go to Rouse's or Whole Foods. I left the market in total frustration, my only regret not buying those flowers. Rouses had phyllo.

Where is there a complete vegetable market in this whole city???

I have lived here for 3 years so I have been here awhile. I am moving out because I had people move in above me and constantly fighting. Called police 6 times and informed management that I was no renewing my lease and the reason I was not. Manager said she was going to give them a 10 day eviction notice but never did!! My rent in October was 688.00 dollars and now they sent me a bill for over 3,000.00 dollars. This place is not a good place to live. Would not recommend this place to anyone. You will be sorry if you rent here!!!

I live down the street and have gone to Bricktops more than any restaurant in STL because it's consistent and I like the food and atmosphere more than Brio. However the last time we went the service was pretty horrible. Waited an hour before we were served bread and had to waive down staff for another drink and to place an order. It wasn't even that busy. The bar was so loud that we chose not to sit there but the carryover noise into the dining room madd it difficult to hear our own conversation. I ordered a ceasar salad with chicken breast and was charged $8 just for the chicken and it was a tiny salad.

I was provided someone else's personal and financial information when I requested a receipt for myself.  When I submitted a complaint, I got a "Sorry for the Inconvenience, and thank you for letting us know" response.   Not only is this horrifying that a breach of someones information receives a canned response, but I have now had to lock my own personal card since I don't know if my information may have been given to someone else.  Also the receipt includes personal addresses, I don't even want to think of some stranger now possibly knowing where I live.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
One of my favorite sushi places in Boise! From your classic raw fish rolls to cream cheese and jalapeños, they have something for just about everyone - I'm partial to sushi with more raw fish like the rainbow roll and nigiri myself. :)

I used the 'waitlist' option on Yelp for the first time recently and it's helped me gauge the best times to come during peak hours! Not to mention, the waiters/waitresses and chefs (even with reduced staffing) are super kind and very knowledge of the menu. 

I appreciate the cleaning measures they've been taking as well. Thank you, Yoi Tomo!

Ordered a pizza online for delivery. 15 minutes later, Papa Johns called and explained they had a computer failure which would delay the order.  They  offered to either deliver the pizza later or offer a discount to pick up the order for carryout. 

While I was a disappointed about the delay, the prompt call, explanation, and discount on the order made up for it entirely. Great service in owning up to a mistake and making it right.  

Pizza tasted great and had no other issues with the order. I'll be continuing to order from this Papa Johns.

This is a great sushi restaurant. I was so impressed with the rolls, not only were they delicious, unlike other places the rice was only a very thin layer compared to the nice portion of fish. Another plus was the generous pours of wine! My ONLY complaint, if that, is that the rolls on the happy hour menu are all fried or cooked. For those who like that it's a great deal. I myself do not like cooked "sushi." That does not bring my rating down though since they have many items on the menu that I can't wait to try!  Oh and I adore their baseball theme, definitely than other sushi places but we liked it.

Really great mechanic. He is old school, and really knows cars as the back of his hand. I had a problem with my engine, and I took my car to a mechanic and he changed a solenoid and said it should be good now. But, the check engine light went on with the same error code. I took my car to another mechanic that didn't listen to me saying I already changed this part and it does not solve the problem and changed the part again, with the expectable result. Till I got the car to Mr Hien (the first time) and he just knew what is wrong with the car. He is also honest.

Horrible service. Felt like the old man reading the paper called me a mulian as soon as I walked in the establishment. No biggie because I was raised in south philly around a million Italians. So being called a "n-word" doesn't offend anymore. But business is business anybody spending their green should be looked at as an equal if your all about a business. Food was horrible tho pizza extra salty.. the girl standing at the front desk said nothing but sir your food is ready no greeting or nothing as a hostess

Went to the Arby's this afternoon at Foothills Mall and was just a awful lunch.  Ordered the beef and cheddar combo fries were old there was hardly are meat on the sandwich. The young lady who took my order had a hard time processing my gift card even asked her if she would like me to pay with cash that frustrated here a little more.  Now this is the second time I have been to this location around three years ago went there with my wife and they had no beef for the beef and cheddar it's time to close this place and also the mall it is just TERRIBLE!

Great food for a great price. 100% worth the money. 

Recently found this place and the menu showed this is different than other traditional Chinese restaurants in Indy.

Menu is very simple and not a lot of options like other Chinese restaurants. 

Bought fried rice and lo mein for dinner and it priced under $15 and they were really good. Portion of the food was not super great but considering the price this was a reasonable enough portion of food and it indeed was good enough to satisfy a good appetite person like me. 

Would definitely recommend this place.

The best Italian Restaurant in the Tampa Area! The food was amazing and they will create anything that you could dream up, even if it is NOT on the menu! I highly recommend the Lobster and Lump Crab Meat Pasta with Pink Sauce (Actual Chunks of Crab Meat and Lobster) and the Lasagna! The prices are very reasonable considering the quality and the portions that you get! If you are in the area, please stop in and try it out! Just a heads up, they have about 12 tables in the restaurant, so you may have to wait a little bit, but it is def worth the wait!!!!!

You'd think the Ukranian in our midst would order a cocktail; after all, she comes from a family that buried a bottle of vodka on the day of her birth and offered to open it when she turned thirty (a fashionable blonde, she has most definitely aged better than the vodka).  Alas, she ordered sangria--her first!--while the rest of us kicked back margaritas.  Cacti were spotted on the menu, and having recently read a cactus recipe involving the word "mucus," I insisted we try the spiny vegetable.  The doctor at the table said they tasted like grilled peppers and resembled bodily discharge not at all.  I was content to take him at his word.

I've been meaning to write a review since June and it looks like they just moved from Uptown to CBD. I had a $65 haircut with someone new to staff and I am STILL growing out my butchered hair 5 months later!!!!!!! It was 2 different haircuts in one and the day after I tried to get the same girl  to fix it but the mistake was too drastic. I then spent another $55 at another salon and she did the best she could but there's a chunk of hair that's still 3-4 inches shorter than the rest of the layers around it. Such a bummer!

I'd love to give this place 5 stars but the quality of food is inconsistent.  Excellent atmosphere with live music several times a week.  Great beer selection with reasonable prices for the beer.  Buck a shuck on Wednesday's is an amazing deal and they have so many varieties of oysters.  During covid they made great outdoor seating and this place has become our once-a-week (or more) getaway.

Nachos are huge. Chicken jerk wrap and jambalaya are excellent.  Seafood is also very good.  Skip the steak and hope you get a good Caesar salad (50% chance).

Pretty decent. The ambience is a bit odd and the decor is having an identity crisis of sorts, but the food exceeded my expectations. They offer a pre-fixe dinner for $25 which includes an appetizer, salad and entree. The crabcakes are small, but made in-house and appeared to have no filler. They were tasty. The calamari was also perfectly cooked and delicious. The entrees were delicious. We ordered Chicken Parmesan and a Chili Chicken Rigatoni and were impressed. The flavors were full bodied and we left with leftovers. I recommend this place, unless you are dining with self proclaimed foodies. You also have the option of the regular menu too.

This gym is twice the price of all the others, Equipment is minimal, place is dirty. Staff is unfriendly and the gym etiquette is non existent. People sitting around on the equipment talking on there cell phones and BS with other folks. I have been going to gyms for 30 years and hands down the worst experience I have had. Even the controls for the TVs that are on the cardio equipment keeps falling off. If your into standing around waiting on equipment then this is the place for you. If not find another establishment

Only upside was the trainer Gina, works hard at developing programs for you.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I was out for an afternoon with my sister and everything was just so extremely slow. We sat at the bar expecting service to be quicker... no. The bartender took forever to take our drink order we interrupted him to put in our appetizer order. The breaded mozzarella was wet... yes very confusing. Then we couldn't get his attention to put in our order. Finally 45 minutes after we ordered our turkey sandwich on a croissant finally arrived and both arrived wrong. Yes it was a busy day but we were not the only people who were unhappy. The food was mediocre, service terrible, but the vodka was good! Disappointing and I probably won't ever come back!

Definitely the best meal I've ever had in St Louis. Extremely creative dishes served with panache. A chef and team that appear to enjoy what they are doing and want others to enjoy it as well. Everything from the amuse bouche to dessert was different from anything else I've had locally. The soup was delicious enough alone but the seared sweet foam island floating in it made it an experience. The smoked caviar on bacon jelly was an incredible combination and served in a half egg shell floating in a moss nest. The fish was served floating in turnip cream.  Just fantastic.

Stumbled in after a great first Friday in Old City, attracted by the decor and the strangely shaped building it's in! Pricier than most sushi places in center city but the interesting roll flavors were worth it. Truffle oil in the appetizer was a bit overwhelming but if you love truffle oil, shouldn't be a problem. 
We enjoyed sitting at the sushi counter! There are mirrors above to see all the sushi making action. Servers were attentive and lovely. Clientele were hip and expensive looking, we felt sorely underdressed in our first Friday art seeking garb. Probably would need a reservation too; it was a cold day and we just got lucky.

Pros: affordable prices, standard quality soy sauce and ginger! Plum wine is a great choice to drown away the sorrow of this food...
Cons: unapologetically dirty tea cups and dishes; uneatable Hip Hop roll which was made out of a sad blend of spicy spoiled fish-mush tuna/salmon combo and shumai with unpleasant taste of a mystery meat...we left feeling sick after eating few pieces of that meal...very unfortunate because this used to be one of my favorite sushi restaurant that I've recommended to so many people...very disappointed

Eek! Me thinks not. As one star is too much, this would be an opportune time to have the option of zero stars. This organization is devoid of all the professionalism that is implicit with the use of the Dr, moniker. Firstly you are directed by a desk jockey to purchase a pure upsell of an 'optional' optos scan ...do some research about this upsell profit center and then decide for yourself. Now on to Diamos herself, WOW! Not my first encounter with a condescending professional, but this one is in a league of her own (check the buried reviews for conformation of this).
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The waiters , waitresses and bartenders are wonderful. I don't understand how one Raffertys can have a French dip and this Raffertys only has it for lunch one day a week. The Raffertys at Rivergate had five dollar appetizers, our Raffertys did not. The potato soup that supposed to be so fabulous , is so thick that you could stick a fork in it and it would stand up on its own. Last but not least, how difficult is it to bake a potato? Theirs are hard, Is it from sitting around forever? They do a great sweet potato on the other hand.

This is a great restaurant. They are very friendly and accommodating. We had the fried cheese ravioli to start which were delicious and just needed a little salt. My husband got the seafood ravioli with the alfredo sauce. Which was the best seafood ravioli I have ever had, but also needed some salt. I got half chicken and half artichoke raviolis with the pesto sauce. The pesto was hand made not processed in a food processor and both raviolis were delicious. The only complaint I have is that all the food needed salt, regardless I'll be back.

Honestly this place AMAZING!!! The food is super fresh!!! So I placed my order over the phone & she (the owner) was super friendly! & when I got there just to say the place is SUPER clean & overall great energy to be there! The family is super sweet! The food is great tastes good! & the entire family is very welcoming!!! Highly highly highly recommend it! On top of that I forgot my wallet there & bamm they called me told me i forgot it there & SUPER sweet by offering that they would drop it off to my house!!!!

Literally have been sitting in this line for 20 minutes for a Java chip and there's only two cars ahead of me why is it so hard for y'all to make a cup of coffee dog I do not understand why I have such bad luck with choosing the worst places to go hi this is an a good part of Charlotte pike where there is a lot of money that sits around here.   
Like where I'm from I live in Antioch in the Starbucks the line could be wrapped around the building and I would still get through the line quicker than this place so sad. They should definitely come in an retrain the staff or restaff the entire location. It shouldn't take this long for coffee.

I tried this place for dinner . I had takeout, a combination plate of beef & vegetables with fried rice and an egg roll. The combination plate was a good value for the money.

Everything was good, but none was really great. The beef with vegetables was the best thing on the plate; the beef was tender, the vegetables fresh, and the portion reasonable. The fried rice was OK, but nothing special, same with the egg roll.

The woman who took my order was pleasant and the order was prepared accurately and quickly. Overall appositive experience. I'll be back.

Well just moved Cherry Hill and was out shopping and wanted to try a new restaurant so we did. Well probably the last and only time we will come back to Distrito. We ordered the steak and shrimp fajitas and we were very very disappointed in the dishes for the price. First of all it was all onion and very very few other vegetables. There were some peppers but very hard to pick them out. The steak was probably just a skirt steak thin and extremely disappointing. I think you got my drift no need to go into the shrimp fajitas more of the same like the steak. We were really disappointed.

Hate is a strong word. I hate this Starbucks. I feel like I waste my money when I come here. I always try to give them another chance but they absolutely suck. They literally don't care what you order or the details. They half ass everything. I say light ice for every drink and get half a cup of ice every time. I need to stop coming here altogether. I've called to let them know they mess up my drink and don't care to fix my drink and acted like it was inconvenient if I came back. I go to Dutch bros now. No matter how long their line is they still pay attention to detail.

Our room felt very dirty and outdated. Dirty walls, chipped paint, lots of dust. Hallways and lobby weren't much better from what we could see. It's advertised as having no resort fees, but there's a $10 charge per night parking fee. Parking lot where we were told we had to park seemed like a staff lot and entrance. 
In our 3 days, we witnessed 2 separate arguments between staff members. It was uncomfortable for us to say the least to be caught in the middle. 
The pool was pretty, and the beach access was close and easy. However, our overall experience here wasn't great and unfortunately we won't stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I came here expecting very good italian food. It was good for its basic food, but i dont consider it a real italian place. Their blue cheese and italian dressing were a little off, like too rich or something and i didnt like the tomato sauce. My family agreed that everything we got was slightly off, and we had wished it would be more of a homemade feel, but it was alot of young, very nice courteous, waiters/waitresses; very nice. It didnt remind us of italy is the impression we had, but they were all nice people. But for a basic eatery, the food could be considered within another category.

Had been thinking of going to this place since i moved to DelCo, and finally made the decision a few weeks ago.  The location mainly have me weird vibes which probably helped push off the visit, but driving by on this specific day i decided to go for it.

Went with a pizza, cheesesteak, fries, and onion rings.  Fries and onion rings were cold, and the pizza was not very good at all.  Store bought dough, reminded me of slightly better bowling alley pizza.  Cheesesteak was passable but even that wasnt too good.

Overall i would not recommend.  Its worth the extra time to get Coccos in Brookhaven or Brothers in Glen Mills.

Placed an online dinner order (pick-up) on New Year's Day.  Thanks for being open as we were dying for sushi.  We ordered:  spicy tuna, spicy salmon, spice girl and amazing tuna rolls.  The order was ready at the end of the estimated timeframe.  Little Tokyo has good COVID safety measures in place with plexiglass barrier at the counter with a small pass-thru for payment and larger pass-thru that allows the employee to place your order on a table for you pick-up.

The rolls were all excellent with generous portions.  The 2 special rolls were both indeed special.   The prices were reasonable.

Little Tokyo is our new local favorite for sushi!

Being from the Midwest, cannot explain how much I love this place...nothing like it at least in Northern Wisconsin :)  I love everything...the drive in down the narrow market streets...sitting 4" from the people next to you...the loud conversations...it just seems very authentic to me like a place like this should be.  It is my second visit here and I refuse to visit Philly without a stop.  Nothing fancy but the red sauce...guess I am supposed to call it "Gravy" is incredible!  Ordered a special plate with sausage and meatballs.  Simple but pure.  Fantastic...this is the way Italian should be and if I had a last meal, this is a contender :)

I decided to try this spot out, since I like checking out different salons to see where I can get the best job done at.
I had the Latina girl do my nails (I forgot to ask for her name & yes, I did ask her if she was Latina, I'm not assuming here). She did a great job! I think she's been the only person I've found so far who actually shaped my nails how I wanted them.
I'll definitely be going back to her to get them redone.

The ONLY "complaint" I had was that I did wait 20+ minutes, due there only being two people working that evening.

Other than that, I recommend this place.

Lai Ta is wonderful! He and his wife Thao own this shop and were good to us! We got our towed over a little late yesterday and he waited on the tow truck driver who we think may have gotten there after closing time with traffic. He called us this morning, and our brakes were fixed. Not only efficient and did great work, his price was more than fair and they fussed about us giving them a tip, but we insisted. Thank you Vinam Automotive! We will definitely refer you to everyone we know in Tucson and bring our cars to you any time we need help.

A hole in the wall spot that not many people know about, Sake House is one of my go-to's! It's usually not too busy, which I like, and they have great lunch and dinner specials and drink specials that appeal to my wallet. The sushi is really good, I love the Clearwater Beach for example. The mood of the location is great, with dim lights and private atmosphere. Only reason I don't give five stars is the service is lacking a little, but not enough to turn me away! They do the minimum they have to, but they still are there, so I can't really complain! Great place.

Yikes!  Despite my tried and true rule to check the price in a new place went ahead and ordered a couple of beers (Stella Artois, draft).  The GF enjoyed the Stella we had in the French Quarter yesterday and asked for another one.  Total bill for 2 draft beers - $24, plus tip!  The same size beer in the French Quarter was $5 ($10 for 2)!!!  This is crazy.  I know it is my fault for not asking, and Atrium does have a captive audience (no other bars in Concourse C except for a wine bar), but I do not believe in highway robbery at any time.

The food was ok but the service was atrocious. Our waitress Jade, if you want to call her that, was absent and awful. The two times she came to our table it seemed like we were bothering her. Asking for water does not require the rolling of the eyes. I asked for the manager and was told he was working at the bar. I don't really care where he is working. He took a measly $4.80 off of our bill. Needless to say we will not be returning. What a poor experience. The only place we "landed" was angry and disappointed.

Called on a Friday night to see if we could come in and was easily able to get a reservation. Just coming back from Hawaii, we were a touch crowd to please with the fish but kampai was delicious.

Started off with the agedashi tofu which is probably one of the best I've had. The outside was crisped perfectly and the tofu was in a delicious broth with scallions and finely diced pickled ginger. 

We got the fire dragon roll which came topped with eel and was delicious, the west pine roll which was our favorite with blow torched salmon on top, and the dynamite roll.

We went here for a birthday celebration on a Saturday night. It was very busy and we were a party of 8. (4 couples) Our server was very polite and professional and the food was outstanding. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for great Italian food or fresh baked pizza. I would suggest going during the week as it was very noisy and hard to hear each other speak as the place is very small, but again the food was awesome and the desserts were fabulous. I would have given it 5 STARS if it wasnt for the noise.

Nice branch. Good parking. Drive thru. Convenient to TMC. Great culture with TMC employees. Nice location on Grant. 

The credit union merged with Pyramid Federal Credit Union Jan 2013 and as a result can now offer mortgage services, digital banking, many more branches, and shared branching so they're available everywhere. I use most of these... and I use this branch occasionally as it is convenient to my driving patterns... not that I use branches that much. I prefer their  eBanking, mobile banking, text banking and mobile remote deposit.

I switched to PF about a year ago as I was tired of the constant upsell of my previous gym. I found a new clubhouse with PF on Chippewa and S. Kingshighway. Yes, it is not in the best part of town but the staff is superb. The are constantly cleaning, putting weights away, and making sure everyone is having an enjoyable workout. I travel a bit, at least before COVID, and have been to dozens of PF's from WI to FL. This is one of my favorites because the folks that work here are a pleasure to be around. Leave your old gym and join this one.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This place cannot handle a large flow of customers. Went there after the hurricane 8/4 since many other places were closed. Apparently a lot of people had the same idea however staff seemed very overwhelmed and left a lot of people standing around. No interaction with customers and just left us staring at them. They never gave a number over the phone yet they kept calling  out numbers and seemed upset that we didn't have a number and had to repeat what he ordered. 

Pizza was not the best pizza I ever had. Seemed like it was just thrown together quickly. Pizza was over cooked in spots.

Foolishly I tried other sushi places after moving to Edmonton hoping to find a place that actually served decent sushi.  It wasnt until I tried Mikado that I could say "yes- Edmonton has good sushi"  

The quality of food I had here was absolutely great.  My friend and I shared the tuna tataki salad, tempura shrimp roll, and the brad roll.  All three items I would order again. 

The service was ok- it was a full house when we went and I understand service can suffer when you are busy like that.  But all of the servers were really nice and brought us what we asked.

I will definitely be back.

this is the worst Macdonald in the world the employees are the total garbage they left me waiting 30 minutes and they did not answer me, and since I did not have a car they did not want to attend me they did not go there, they look for a way to screw up your life they treat you badly and do not value our  money or maybe they are racists I really don't understand why that kind of treatment towards us should change the staff or close the store at this difficult time with the situation of the covi 19 they don't care at all they want people to starve I think  me, they are in a bad mood paying with us
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have been coming here for years. I'm not sure what happened.  The people people at desk are not the caliber in looks or actions. Brought a friend here for a birthday lunch.  They were supposed to tell the server. She was slow getting to us. The gal at the front desk forgot to tell her. I ordered a wedge salad with grilled chicken. The lettuce was had an dense, and so had I had to try to pry it apart.  I had huge hunks of lettuce on the bread and butter plate ( we were never offered bread) ....you would have thought the server would notice? I couldn't even taste the dressing. The chicken was rubbery.  Worst meal I have ever had there.

Terrible. Every time they get the order wrong in the drive thru. Today, 11/3 at 9am, I ordered 2 sausage egg mcmuffins with cheese and got ham instead of sausage. Why? Oh, and they were cold.  Why? Other times they repeat the order back and it is wrong. Why? This really isn't rocket-science. The only good thing is the very pleasant woman who works in the first pay window of the drive thru on weekday mornings.  She always is smiling. Not sure why but she makes my day....unlike the food and order takers and bag fillers in the drive thru.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: 8pm on s Sunday. 2 employees working....no supervision that I saw. 2 cars before in drive thru.  Our order took forever ... it was a sizable order $30.  Got home and yes...missing part of order. Went back and now had to go in which defeats purpose of drive thru. 2 employees were fair. Not very motivated, confused by my complaint. They did replace the missing part of our order which was appreciated. The 4 sandwiches from the dollar 1, 2, 3 menu were hard hockey pucks. Ugh disappointing. Would appreciate if management would train and supervise their staff better. Going to go to Havertown location from now on.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I did not have enough quarters for the wash and neither of the change machines worked. I had to wait for a guy to finish vacuuming his car to see if he had change and he did. I used the vacuum first--no complaints about that. The wash machine is unclear and I wasn't sure what settings to use first so I started with the foam brush. My car is new and the brush left faint scratches on the hood. I did not get to wash the sides and ran out of time before I finished rinsing and I hustled. I will never go there again.

Excellent Customer Care

I purchased a set of windshield wipers a couple of months ago at this Pep Boys during a rainstorm. It turns out that one of the windshield wipers on the passenger side was the wrong size. It flew off when I was having the car washed.

Two days ago I drove in to Pep Boys to ask for advice. A young man named Francisco was incredibly helpful and competent. He not only looked up the correct size windshield wiper, he also credited me and then went on to install the correct windshield wiper on my car.

Whatever your customer care training is doing, keep doing it! Many thanks, Francisco!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The people are friendly and they have the basic equipment, however their hours are awful especially for a silver sneakers establishment catering to retired and special needs people. They are closed during the prime hours of the day when many older people especially those with arthritis feel the best. They say it's from 2-3:30 that they are closed, but they really close at 1:30. Most of the afternoon the facilities at not available to you. I for one as a cancer patient have found that the  hours at the  gym just doesn't work with my needs . I wonder if Medicare is aware of their strange hours when they awarded them silver sneaker status?
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I am here right now at 3:54. I asked the girl if they had the sale for $2 lattes & cappuccinos going on. They always have a sale from 2-6. She said do you want a small? I said, sure if that's what's on sale...

She proceeds to charge me $3 and some change. So I'm like, whatever... they're supposed to be on sale. She took forever so at this point I don't even care. Just charge me extra.

After I mixed up the foam, there's literally nothing in here. Look at the photo I'm about to upload, the cup is half full! 
Waste of a trip. I could have saved money and gotten more coffee by going to the other Dunkin.

This is a real gem in the heart of Bella Vista. Owner / chef Carlo Nigro is a genuinely goodhearted man who cares about his dishes and his customers. The ingredients he uses are VERY fresh. The dishes are worthy of any local high-end establishment but lack the price tag. The dining room feels intimate and warm. The staff is happy to lend a hand with deciding on menu items. The seafood is very fresh and cooked to perfection. BYOB's are a big part of south Phila restaurants, but Carluccios Way is a step above the rest.

Excellent BYOB. We had flatiron steak and arctic char. The char was probably the best I ever had-the waiter said he'd tell the chef, I was the second person that evening to say so. Even better, believe it or not, were the bits of beets that came with it. Oh, my. Again, the best ever. Beefy, earthy, pickled just so. The steak, too, was excellent. Tender, juicy, cooked perfectly with the slightest of searing, and served with a sauce that brought out the flavor wonderfully. Complementing, never overpowering, the meat. Service was friendly and efficient. And there was no corkage fee. All in a very charming little room of ten tables. Loved it.

Way overpriced compared to other vets. even the medication. They wanted to keep my cat for a overnight stay for 2200.00. when the other hospital only would've done it for 1000.00. then when he had symptoms again. i called for a antibiotic. they insisted seeing him again. Why? they said as long as he was peeing he would be fine. ill tell you why to overcharge me again. this vet is all about the big bucks. not the welfare of your pet. just reading the other reviews proves my point. even the good ones say expensive expensive. the vet was not sympathetic at all. all they wanted to discuss was how much i could pay. not recommended at all.

I can't attest for their Chinese food yet but I can -- without a doubt -- say that it has the best and most authentic pho in town. Not many people know that they serve Vietnamese and most people recognize it as a Chinese choy suey. Just ask for the Vietnamese menu. The other Vietnamese dishes are OK but their pho is sooo good. Their bun bo hue is pretty good too.

I always recommended this place for Asian or Vietnamese food. It's a little dumpy looking and the service isn't the best (but it's not bad either). Don't like the looks discourage you, check it out!

Went here for lunch to go with my dad, and it was alright. Wouldn't answer their phone when I called so it took a couple tries. Guy at the front was nice and attentive, the food was fine, interior was clean, not amazing but by no means bad. We had the margarita pizza and the Italian beef sandwich, pizza was pretty good but a little charred on the bottom so kinda bitter, the meat in the sandwich was pretty tough but it tasted fine. 

But please PUT THE DRINKS ON YOUR WEBSITE, it seems like nobody lists their non alcoholic drinks on the website and it's so frustrating, really makes no sense.

The atmosphere is cool- I do like the whole sports bar dynamic since there isn't a whole lot of those in Doylestown. The food was pretty good as well. I do think they could improve their service though, which is why I am giving only three stars. Our waiter was very inattentive, never even gave us the draft list (until I asked half way through my meal), and took a very long time to take our orders. I don't like having to take ten minutes to track down our waiter every time I want another drink or want to place a food order. If the service was better, I'd give 5 stars.

We get coffee at the Dunkin' next door from time to time. The last time we noticed there was a sushi place there. My fiancé looked on Yelp and we were surprised to see 4+ stars. So, we both agreed we needed to try it. Went there for lunch the next day. Doesn't look like much from the outside. Not a big space inside, but nice and clean. We really enjoyed everything we got. We'll definitely be going back. Next time with a bottle of wine (as it's a BYOB). We're pretty excited to have a quality BYOB Sushi place so close.

We stopped in here randomly for a relatively quick lunch before work, and walked away completely blown away! We were seated immediately and attended to diligently. Not only was our food delicious and plated beautifully, we were graciously given a complimentary appetizer! The service was beyond phenomenal. 

There were only a couple other patrons at that time, but I think the chefs were practicing their art, so we spied on their preparation. It was so entertaining to watch -- very precise, careful and skilled. 

I would recommend to anyone and will be back!

Do not go to Plymouth auto! It's a scam! They should be reported. My car had a leak so I put it in to get looked at. They called to tell me my total was 900$ with a list of things wrong with it. I was shocked especially since my car isn't that old and just got an inspection. I declined the work. They told me I owed them 120$ as a diagnostic fee! They never told me that when I dropped the car off about this fee. I took my car to other place down the street. Nothing major was wrong with my car. The place down the street charged me 60$ to fix the leak.  I asked around about this place and other people had the same experience.

If you are a group looking for a restaurant in Collingswood do not chose Nunzio's. They charged my Credit Card for a deposit when I explained to the manager that the group was going to split the entire bill. I then reconfirmed with the waiter to not bill the CC because the group will be splitting the entire bill. Today I received a phone call from one of the managers who proceeded to blame me and didn't listen to  a word I had to say. I will definitely not be returning and will be a big advocate to many to eat Italian else where.

The pictures of the hotel are very misleading! We were surprised at how old and in need of an update this hotel is, especially for the price for our stay. This does not look like a 4-star hotel! The hotel lobby was very unimpressive. The bathroom is very small and we found a bug on our floor. The shower head is low and the wallpaper is peeling a little. There was also a stain on the wall. The walls are thin and we could hear the guest next door opening and closing something. The food at the hotel is also just okay. 

The pool is nice and the front desk was friendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Abruzzi Pizza is a MUST if you are in or around the Brookhaven area. I've been getting pizza, hoagies and cheesesteaks here for so many years. The quality, service and consistency brings me back every week. There are many pizza and sandwich shops in the area but they're so inconsistent or they just close down. They make killer cheesesteaks and chicken cheesesteaks and the buffalo/bbq sauce is great. Had my kids party recently, ordered tons of food and they delivered, it tasted great, was still hot and fresh!

Bad service and lazy employees, if you go at night you always have to wait at least 5 minutes till someone notice you....employees always on the kitchen spacially at night chatting and carless....if the drive thru person sees you, won't service you and u have to wait till the front desk employee show up.
Starbucks should be the same anywhere you go, except this branch use all bad beans or wierd flavors one...

I don't nno if the manager knows about the night shift but, it's pritty bad.

1 star is even to much for this location

This is a dive bar if I have ever seen one. The bar was sticky and dirty and there was a horrible smell throughout the place. The bartenders where extremely pushy to me and my friend making us take body shots and not giving us an option to say no having our husbands buy them even though we didn't want them. We went in the afternoon and it was pretty dead with an older crowd. Women do not have an option of saying no to dance on the bar. I suggest if you have a bachelorette party to visit because it would be an experience you will not forget but if you want to sit down and have a few drinks to relax I do not suggest going here.

Look I love The Habit's food but the prices compared to the amount of food you get coupled with the wait time is outrageous. I understand the wait might be longer with COVID-19 going on and that's fine, but the amount of food you get for the price is appalling. I personally will not be coming back to any of the Habit locations in the future. I cannot justify paying that amount for how little food I receive. If the prices/portions improve then that might change. 


(Mind you this is a kids meal but I still don't believe that the price matches the quantity of you that you get).

They charge extra money for EVERY SINGLE THING! You go in expecting a cheap mani/pedi (considering the salon quality and reviews) but end up getting charged extra for every "add-on". You might as well spend the extra money at a nicer salon. Extra $5 if you want coffin, stiletto, or almond shaped nails. Extra $5 for french. Extra $3 if you want them a tiny bit longer. Extra $18 for gel. I've gotten my nails done a million times but have never been charged SO MUCH for gel. A whole bottle of gel polish doesn't even cost $18!! They'll up charge anything. You're better off going to any other salon.

Ok,  i'm not going to lie,  i was extremely skeptical when i first walked in.   Small bar trying to be a restaurant was my first impression.   Kinda dirty,  kinda grungy.  Ok,  give it a chance and order.   Menus,  small, not cluttered with a bunch of different items, good thing.   Bad thing,  they were dirty.   Definitely worth investing in new menus.   Ok,  give it a chance.   I ordered 3 taco combo.   DELICIOUS!   OMG, food is amazing!  I will DEFINITELY go back.   Girlfriend ordered the steak fajitas,  omg amazing!   Steak was amazingly tender!   Perhaps our new date night dinner spot!

This has to be the worst Dunkin' Donuts in Saint Pete. They rarely have regular menu items in stock whether it be the coffee flavoring or simple things as a bagel other than plain flavored. When they do have what you ordered it does not taste correct for instance my French vanilla swirl iced coffee tastes like too much cream and no flavor what so ever. The customer service is terrible and the employees seem miserable and rude. I'd recommend visiting the Starbucks two blocks down for a beverage or a bite to eat because at least you know the food tastes fresh and the beverages are made how the customer orders!

the absolute most disgusting marriott i've ever stayed at. All i wanted to do was shower when i got off the plane and i was welcomed with hairs in every corner of the shower. i asked for my room to be re-cleaned when i checked in at 5:30pm letting them know about the hairs, walk back into my room at 11pm and my bathroom was cleaned again EXCEPT for the shower i specifically requested to be cleaned. SOOOOO gross I don't think i'll ever stay at this JW ever again

update: bathroom still not cleaned & now my toilet is making noises

text: This was awful ordered a chicken club and a mushroom Swiss this is what the mushroom Swiss looked like as you can see it's a petrified patty the cheese is not melted the bread is burnt and there's no mushrooms no anything and the chicken I'm sorry was an unrecognizable kind of meat discolored on  a bun unlike the picture petrified bacon the cheese was not melted and the chicken was chewy so half of the dinner fed to the dog disgusting and I think it would've been more than $10 without the discount I could buy lots of  food at the grocery store for 15 bucks

I'd recommend taking the trolley or walking instead of trying to find somewhere to park. It is a cute place though and is near Tulane and Loyola. 
I do not eat sushi but I got the lunch special that was a chicken teriyaki bento box. I really loved the chicken it wasn't too sweet it had an amazing balance for flavor. Also it came with a little bit of noodle salad which is good. It came with tasty fresh fruit that paired well with the chicken. White rice and a house salad was also included that was good as well. Keep in mind if you order soda you will be paying for refills. 
The service was really nice.

Will not being going here again my lifetime. Dropped my car off for a new upper oil pan was told it'll take 2-3 days... they didn't even start on it until 5 days after we dropped it off. When they finished the car they said they took it on a test drive and when they came back it wouldn't start.. they tried to charge us 100 dollars an hour for a problem they caused to diagnose it... you think when you spent over 2 thousand dollars these guys would be way better but they aren't! spend the extra few hundred to go to a trusted shop. you won't regret it!! these guys are slobs
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: My family and I were not impressed with the food.  With only 3 other tables of guests I figured the quality of the food was going to be lacking as an empty restaurant is a sure sign of a restaurant in decline and I was correct.  I got the sausage and chicken in a red bell pepper sauce.  It was very bland and the chicken was gross, leather like in texture.  I expected to get food poisoning but thankfully I didn't.  The rest of our dishes were less than mediocre.  There are a number of quality Italian restaurants in Indianapolis, this is not one of them.

Its our second time here.  Like last time there are no seasonal or daily dishes so we find the same offerings.  6 dishes of chicken with varying sauces and the standard offering of pasta variations. We tried the pollo toscana (with mushrooms), a giant portionn of chicken swimming in a non descript sauce.  It tasted neither of mushroom or broth, just brown with too much arulula on top.  The pasta sausage was good, but light on sausage.  There is no bread service but both dishes came with bread immersed in each dish.  No wine service and no meal variety means we will not come back any time soon.

I've been to this car wash many times because the location is really convenient for me but, i will not be going back. i always pay for the 24$ wash and gas so it runs me like 80$ so id expect at least a decent wash, the outside is always streaky (i end up going home and wiping down all the streak marks there are so many)  and the inside doesn't get anything more than a quick vacuum. its still dusty and does not feel like a clean car...the guys who work there are sweet but they just take on too many cars at once and have to rush to get them done. the quality is not worth the price.

Worst pizza in Franklin!  Our large supreme wasn't even round!  It was kind of oblong shaped, was not cut evenly, so half the pieces were huge and the rest were tiny.
There were hardly ant toppings, and most of the cheese was on one side of the pizza so it was sliding off when a piece was picked up.  There was so much sauce they could have made 2 more pizzas with it... and, I had ordered "light on the sauce."
Overall, this was the worst pizza I ever had.  This-is also the third bad experienced in a row.  Won't be back, and don't suggest anyone else go here either.

Broke it but didn't tell me. 

Had the oil change/car wash combo. As with every oil change outfit they showed the air filters and said it needed changing. It did not but no big deal. 

The problem is that they twisted the heads off all four bolts that hold the cover on. With no tight deal the filter is not really keeping dirt out properly. 

I have used them for several years. No one had touched it since the last change. I won't go back. 

I discovered it only when I changed the filter a couple months later. before

i work 12-15 hour days, sometimes the first thing i want to do is stop and get coffee & breakfast. i work so close too that it really hurts me to say i won't be coming back. the staff is usually "okay" but today- exceptionally awful.  i order a bacon egg & cheese bagel- she goes "plain bagel" i thought she misheard me so i repeated what i want, so she's slowed it down for me & got worse... "plain bagel?" with attitude& then standing in front of me taking my payment talking bad about other coworkers.. being very rude. and that's just one employee i've encountered today. it's never a gun experience here.

I went here for the first time yesterday and I ordered the matcha iced dragon made with oat milk and whip cream on top and it was so good that it was addicting but there was way too much ice in it so it didn't last long at all. So then I tried the iced matcha latte made with oat milk and it was addicting too but not as sweet and way less calories and not too much ice this time. I also had the mini plain French donuts. At first I thought they had an oily feel to them when I bit into it but in the end I liked the texture of them and the taste. I live in Illinois but the next time I have a hair appointment next door to here I will drive back!

Got here at 9:30 am thinking I would not have to wait too long. All I am getting is an oil change, tire rotation, and new battery. It is now 12:15 and I am still waiting. They are very slow. Then, they tried to charge me $128 for a battery and another $100 to install it! I told them no way I could do it myself. They said they would do it all for $85. Let's see if they charge me what they said they would.

Edit: I finally got my car back at 12:30...3 hours later. I raised this to 3 stars because they did a decent job and stuck with the price they said it would be.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
This place is staffed by assholes. Specifically, the type of assholes who lack the self-awareness (or awareness of anything) to know they're assholes. 

Once when I was here and I was at the counter paying for my tea, I spotted a basket of assorted cookies near the cash register. There was one that was dotted with what looked like poppy seeds (to this day I'm not sure what they actually were), and I gestured to it and asked the counterperson what it was. He said, "a cookie." 

However, he was perfectly cordial to his three chatty friends who dropped in for the sole reason of chatting and scoping out his workplace.

First let me start by saying I have been a client of Banfield for 14 years with just one of my dogs. We have always been to the other locations until they opened the new Brentwood location close to our home.
The staff at the  Brentwood office front desk are
so dismissive and disrespectful. They walk around without a smile on their faces and they speak to you as if you're a burden.
We WILL NEVER GO BACK!!
They do not care about the pets and Betty makes everything harder.
If it were not for the other locations being excellent we would change veterinarian offices.

This place is awful. It's in a poor neighborhood yet they triple the price cause there the only place a person can walk to. They're vultures preying in the poor.
I remember when the place was owned by a very kind man. He charged very fair prices because he knew that the folks in the neighborhood were poor. That's been over 20 plus years ago.
I just stopped in to see if these people who owed it had grown a heart. When  I asked why the prices were so high the clerk got really rude with me & told me if I didn't like it I could go somewhere else.... 
I most definitely will

Agree with others, this was great when it was MacDill FCU.  Then became Grow, and incredibly they bragged in email newsletter about their support of a Leftist cause... why, why, why insult half your customers? (probably more considering the conservative military heritage). Wrote to Grow President, no answer, and emailed customer service - basically told my values must adapt to (some) present day attitudes. So, as promised, I closed all accounts with entire life savings, after 40 prior years of positive experience.

I began using Avis a few months ago and I am extremely happy.  I'm sticking with them.

Avis folks have gone out of their way to help me every time I've needed it.  They're so willing to help, I'm thinking of asking to borrow a twenty every time I see one. haha

Seriously, last night Lauren was absolutely wonderful with something at drop-off. I thank her.

I'm new to Reno, so don't know if this is the right address of where I dropped it off, or even if this is spelling of her name.  If not, hopefully there is someone at this location named Lauren who spells it this way.

Whoa, I took a picture. There she is.

I would have 5 star this place but the one thing that killed it for me is the fact that I am now 100% sure I left my gold chain with a cross there. I know exactly where I left it too. I called back and I was told to wait a few days till the manager was there and that he would call me on a specific day. They never did and I called and was told to keep waiting. That piece was given to me by my parents so it means a lot to me and plus it was worth a fortune it being 3 types of gold. So don't come to this place with any heavy jewelry.

text: I don't normally write bad reviews but both of my two experiences here have been AWFUL!!! I'm sorry for saying this but the workers here are a bunch of monkeys. They are the rudest workers I've ever experienced. When I got to the window to get my food, they didn't even make eye contact with me or say a word, instead they were complaining about some manager. They complained, gave me the order, and closed the window. NOT A WORD TO ME!!! You're joking!!! It was like this the first time I went as well. I've experienced poor costumer service but this is simply unacceptable. If I could give no stars, I would.
