text: Went in Monday night 1/27/2020 around 7:00, and was abruptly greeted by Jerry. I was attempting to order a cold brew with almond milk and French vanilla. Jerry asked me how many pumps I wanted, which I was never asked so I said I don't want it too sweet. With that he blatantly rolled his eyes and said that's not what i asked, how many pumps do you wAnt...:. Once I was given my drInk it was slid across the counter, and  I went to thank him and all I got was him to shake his head. That is horrible cusTomer service. I will never return to this Starbucks. Save your money and go somewhere that they welcome and appreciate their guest.

I'm officially boycotting this place simply for ending lunch hours. Manny's was one of the only places in town to grab a decent lunch or slice of pizza. Not anymore. Any of the new food I tried was decent and I will say I'm happy to see them clean the place up considering all of downtown Palmyra is a dumpy wasteland. If they expanded and made it a real dinner restaurant, I'll be back..but I just don't appreciate the concept of a dinner only restaurant disguised as a small town pizza joint. I'm not sure they understand the market here.

PLEASE DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME COMING HERE GO SOMEWHERE ELSE Please I KNOW BY exprience I've been living here for two years and I can't wait til my lease is over! The  maintenance here is horrrrrrible !! I put in a request for them to come fix my dryer almost a week ago and still  they haven't came to fix it I'm stuck with no dryer, all they can say is "Okay we'll put in a request" I had to call five times with the same respond!! I think every apartment complex needs a good maintenance service and these apartments don't have that.

Living near here for only a year or so, I wouldn't have ever believed people would eat any food from this place when I stumbled upon these reviews.  As the last guy said, some of the people appear a little sketchy.  But his impression that this is not a good neighborhood is incorrect.  It's the Store that is the epicenter of any weirdness happening in the immediate vicinity. The store just appears to be a super overpriced, dirty, poorly stocked, front. At least they sell beer and ciggs.  But they both cost more than Birdies, just a few blocks away.

During the pandemic it's hard to get help.  I had a charge on my debit card that I wanted to stop or reverse.  I called the 1-800 # and was on hold for about one hour.  So, since the bank is across the street, I decided to walk over there and talk to a manager.  Well -- there's no manager at THAT bank. I had to make an appointment with another branch about 1 mile away.  WTF?  So I ended up having to complete an online complaint form, scanning it and sending it in; and also mailing it in.  I know that everyone is under quarantine with this crisis, but you would think the banks would have FULL service because it's people's money!!!

The good: Hotel was very clean, beautifully decorated and a great location.  Breakfast buffet was delicious.
The bad: I think the walls are made out of paper.  When we first went to our room, we could hear the neighbors talking as though they were in our room.  Fast forward to night, the drunken people coming back to their rooms at 1, 2, 3 a.m..... doors slamming, vomiting, loud laughing.  I have NEVER been in a hotel that was so loud and I have stayed in many.  We were incredulous.

If you want to lounge in a beautifully appointed room and on a cushy bed but get zero sleep, this is your spot.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I received a terrible, uneven haircut at Salon Orange Moon...and then went and got it fixed the next day at A Do Hair Design in Broad Ripple (where they worked wonders).  My appointment at Salon Orange Moon took 3 1/2 hours for a cut and color, and although the color turned out fine, that is way more time than I have ever spent for a cut & color appointment.  I will say that the employees here are friendly and this salon definitely has a "laid-back" vibe.  They offer their clients beer, which some people may enjoy, but to me it came off as trashy in a salon environment.  Overall, I definitely would not recommend this place.

I shopped through the store, made choice, approached check out and was given quite a chilly reception. No greeting whatsoever! The man behind the counter looked at me as though I was about to steal what I was about to purchase. He looked at me with much disdain. It was awful! The woman that rang me up was not much better. They could not wait for me to leave. Once I paid, the non-melanated man behind me was greeted warmly by the man behind the counter. I am not local as I am visiting family here. The purchase I made will be the only one I'll ever make at this store. Disgusted.

One of the best meals I've had in Nashville recently. Celebrated my moms birthday. The service professional. They need to work on communicating the portions and food that should be ordered for a table, that was a bit of a misfire. Most of the food was exceptional. One note: the kohlrabi Caesar is not exciting. It's textbook caesar dressing and kohlrabi (although the server seemed super jazzed that it was spiralized that doesn't do it for me) But the pate and carrot dishes were especially delicious. And the bread, but that's why you come. 

Also a very nice space in a slightly different area from all the other things.

They may or may not have good customer service but they have excellent selections. I did arrive late at 6:03 PM and they do close at 6 in their defense. Customers in the store, doors unlocked and every bay door wide open so I thought they are open but they were not. Luckily they suggested that I try Einsteins Oilery and they were right, they were AMAZING!!!! Full service including free drinks brought to you and a newspaper, a freaking newspaper!!!! Not to mention it cost less and was lightning fast. So if you need a good suggestion on where to spend your hard earned money I can suggest no one more highly.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: It was extremely cramped/crowded, but the food was good - yet expensive. I paid $24 for a seafood plate and the waiter started taking it from me with about half of the food left and my fork in my hand! Hey!!! What's up with that? Not even going to ask if I want a box? Fork in hand?!? Too busy for your own good, in my opinion. I still left a decent tip because that was apparently just a mistake. But please, don't take my plate without asking first. I had a hard time finishing my meal because I felt rushed after that. Others at the table were still eating too and the crowd had subsided by then, so why the push? No plans to return.

Hit or miss when I go in person I get exactly what I ask for they have been through a lot of employees and some are rude some are sweet. Ordering delivery from this place is the worst every single time I order I get the complete opposite. 

With no car there's nothing I can do because it's delivery. I'm so over dunkin I'm ready to call corporate. I'm a coffee person so to give me something I didn't order pisses to the point where i want to catch a Lyft just to straighten them in person... literally every single time.

Rushed from start to finish.  They didn't even take off the previous dip all the way.  They forgot to file my nails and then barely did.  The dip didn't even cover the whole nail, then they Drilled through the dip.  Didn't paint the top coat on my entire nail either.  My nails are thick and lumpy and bumpy and totally scratchy because they didn't cover the nail in topcoat and the glitter is coming through.  I'll be going somewhere else to get them off tomorrow.  It was my first and last time there and I'm so frustrated.

The manager/host at this location is RUDE and CLUELESS when it comes to Customer Service.  About 6 weeks ago our party of 6 arrived for a 6:30 reservation and were told we had to wait. No problem. Well at the 20 minute mark one of our group went in to see the progress. This then turned into an argument with above mentioned manager/host. The manager/host then came outside to continue the argument with the member of our party. Thats right! The guy came outside to argue! 
Hey, the food is good. Takeout always prompt. But this guy needs a lesson in customer service.

Just ate there last night.
The food was excellent but the experience was horrible. Arrived for our 7:30 pm reservation. Did not have a hostess to check in. Had to elbow our way to the counter. Still no one cared to check us in. Must have been 15-20 people waiting for tables, some in the unheated "hall of shame". Finally we spoke with an employee who said we would have to wait at LEAST 25 minutes for a table, for which we had a reservation! Sorry, but this is NOT the correct way to run a business. 
Some may say "Oh, its just Frankies". I say that Frankie could give a s*** about the customer.

Went to go see an apartment.

Took two weeks to get scheduled bc no one picks up the phone or returns messages.

On my tour, the woman showed me two units. The first one had mouse traps and bug traps in a few areas and she causally said that those pests should be expected bc the building is old. Seriously?? Major turn off.

The units were ok.. they don't look like the pictures but they're not terrible, just oddly shaped.

It's pretty ridiculous that a load of laundry will cost you $4.

Overall disappointed but it's not terrible. Definitely secure and the gym was solid. Depends on what you're looking for

We're from LA and decided to do a staycation in SB, and this was by far the best value for the money. The views are wonderful. It's location/proximity to everything is wonderful. The service/staff is wonderful. The room service and food on property tastes great and wasn't too expensive. The pool is quite big, and the rooms were beautiful. They're still doing some renovations to the hotel since Hilton became the property manager recently, but we didn't mind at all, and think the hotel looked wonderful. Everyone was accommodating and kind. Spa services were AMAZING. We'll definitely stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I've Been here a few times, however as of late if you want a friendly greeting and if you have any coin change it will never be brought to you, only the bills. A 2 count pour is not the norm, not st my work st least. Then it was so nice to see the bartender with her foot up on the bar cleaning the bottom of her shoe with a straw and then going back to work last night  
I hear you, so what she keeps .60 per bill. That adds up after 100+ customers a night. I've never seen a bartender on their mobile constantly as well and then bitch about her texts to the other bartender that was working hard.

If I could give zero stars, I would. Horrible management. Called early in the evening, around 5, to inquire on their hours for dinner. We were informed the kitchen was open until 10:30. We show up at 9:45 and are turned away, saying it was closed. But not before taking us to our table, then having someone yell out to the waiter. The waiter, as pleasant as can be, had to inform us that we had to leave. Very embarrassing to us, and him as well I'm sure. Management needs to get a clue and not change hours on a whim. Unprofessional to say the least. My apologies to the waiter, he was very polite.

My poor dog decided she was more hungry for my kid's toys and various chunks of garbage than she was for her dog food. So low and behold she ended up in surgery cutting mini toys out of her gut. I did some calling around and these guys were much more reasonable than some.  To her to a pet Hospital and they gave me the hard sell and guilt trip like a I was killing my dog if I didn't let them take her right then. That's why I shopped around a bit.. They took her in and took great care of her. Have been back since with other things etc. Staff id great and doctor is nice and caring.

While the popsicle itself was delicious, the service was awful. My friends and I were being judged about what we ordered (like dude it's a popsicle why are you judging if we get chocolate dipped key lime), judged about how "we all look the exact same," and then we were being rushed out. The worker taking out orders said "alright let's wrap this up let's go". Two of us accidentally started talking at the same time and she goes "you cannot all speak to me at once." It's also ridiculously expensive ($5.75 for a popsicle!). The horrible service kind of ruined the true experience. If you do go, I wish you luck with being judged and rushed :(

I am new to the area and don't understand why this place can't do a request.   Third time in a row..  asked for a big Mac with xtra onions ... the first time I got no onions at all and the next 2 times I managed to find approximately 3 tiny onions.   NO JOKE.   Clearly no one cooking makes any effort at all !!!    I'm DONE !   Will go to the McDonalds further down the same road by Publix.   Lost me and my family and I will warn everyone I can to NOT frequent this place as my family has also gotten home missing  items that were ordered and payed for as well.   No excuse when it happens again and again.

text: Would give negative stars if possible.  Went to drive thru at 5:15 pm.  Only 1 car at drive thru.  Sat several minutes at speaker before I said hello several times.  Finally, someone answered.  Not busy, only 4 cars in parking lot so who knows why it took so long.  Got chicken mc nuggets and fries.  Mcnuggets had a weird texture and we're so greasy, pressed them in to napkin to soak up grease.  Fries were barely cooked and not even warm.  Worst meal I have ever gotten at fast food restaurant, not to mention less than acceptable service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Food is usually pretty good, but it's so cold in the restaurant (this is May) that my wife and I couldn't wait to get out.  Another customer was complaining about the cold also, but nothing was done.  In fact, when we asked a server why they keep it so cold her only answer was that she was freezing too, but couldn't do anything about it because of the manager.  He was sitting back in a office near the restrooms where I noticed it was notably warmer than the eating area of the restaurant.  We will go back but have already decided that we will leave if it's as cold inside. There are more comfortable alternatives.

We went on Saturday night one person ordered chicken chow mein when it came the diner called the waiter over and asked what the slimy thing was . He got very annoyed saying it was something that we didn't recognize. Said they've been making it like that for 20 years . The diner said I've had it here a hundred times never like this! He didn't take it back or offer to remove the price and it went uneaten! Then I got extremely sick about 2 hours later and vomited all night!!! Very very disappointed and a little pissed off !!!!! Will never ever go back ! It's 11 am next day and still can't eat or drink anything and keep tasting that food!!!

After a long process and communicating with NEW MANAGEMENT I can honestly say that I'm satisfied with how things are being handled from now on. Hopefully new management is the answer to this community getting better. I love Elsa she is absolutely amazing and so far Rene has been handling all the mess that Denise left gracefully. Good luck to her and I'm glad that they are trying to improve and make their residents a priority. Maintenance really needs some work aside from David - he is awesome and very friendly but new staff really. Oils use some help.

Our whole family went today for my little girls birthday and I decided to treat myself to a gel Mani. 

First, they started on my husband and both kids before me. My service was going to take the longest, so they should have started with me first. So when my kids and husband were finished, they were just starting on my Mani. We should have just left then. 

 This was the end result of my gel Mani AFTER I asked him to fix it. If you aren't a regular here or don't establish yourself as such, I would avoid this place 100%. 

They were really sweet to both my kids, that is why this isn't a one star review.

I ordered from here last night on Uber Eats. They messed up my order so bad I had to leave a review. I ordered the Artisan Grilled Chicken...They sent me the bacon smokehouse fried chicken. Which was room temperature. Then the fillet o'fish sandwich we got was room temperature and only had a half slice of cheese on it. Then two orders of fries were cold. They had obviously been sitting out all day. Then the next day we were both sick. I understand it's Mcdonald's and mistakes do happen but food that is obviously not fresh is unacceptable.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Wonderful ambience. Excellent service.  After appetizers, couldn't imagine why it did not get great reviews.  The eggplant and artichoke appetizers were just fabulous.  But everything after that was why it's 3 stars.  Ordered a Caesar salad with no croutons.  Did not come out until after entrees and with croutons.  Ordered $38 filet which was tough and barely edible.  Clearly they start with a budget cut of meat.  Again the service and ambience was fantastic - but I just could not believe that in such a nice restaurant, the filet would be worse than what I could have had at LongHorn.

Bad customer service. I received a delivery from them which I did not order. It sat on my front porch for 3 days in upper-90 degree heat before I noticed it. This was their mistake or their delivery service mistake and they will not pick it up to dispose of it. My garbage had already been picked up and it will sit for another week in 90+ degree heat and rain. I will not bring rotten food into my house to wait another week. This is more to document in case there are any repercussions that will need to be pursued.

A great place to go get your fix of donuts. I'll just go ahead and start with the downsides. The donuts depending on what you get are bland and in need of far more glaze. The interior layout is just a tad bit off, and if you visit on the weekends, you can expect a big crowd to tackle. Besides those however, this donut joint is unique. It gives a very wide variety of donuts to try and many to enjoy. The Frosted long Johns are amazing and always something I get in a trip to jacks. The staff are nice and are always able to get you by with the right order. The environment is calm and relaxing which provides and easy safe place to eat your donuts.

Saw the ad for $8 haircuts and the Minion mascot in front. That is what earned 2 stars. Everything else was just a bad experience. People inside seemed nice, so maybe some of them know what are they doing, but this guy cut my hair like he's a waiter or something and this is his side gig. I think that the Minion would do a better job. As someone said in previous comments- I looked like a Muppet after the 3 minute haircut. I thought that the goal of half price haircut was to attract the customers not to scare them away. I guess I expected too much from a really cheap haircut. Good service is just really hard to find these days in US.

I should have came for yelp review instead of believing TripAdvisor review. Standard 2 queen bed side was 410 plus resort fee for additional 30 dollars a night. So it is 450 and parking was additional 30 dollars per night. 
Here is a kicker. The standard room
Side hears train ALL DAY LONG. 
Yeah 480 dollars a night shouldn't feel like Motel 6 night. 
So I requested room change w additional 40 bucks a night. 
I cannot believe how expensive this hotel is. It is a rip off. 
Never again.


Oh it gets worse. Next day, even after we paid extra so we don't hear the train, now they say No hot water from 11-5 PM. Are you kidding me?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: These donuts are amazing. However, I fucking hate liars. Their hours say they close at 8pm. So NATURALLY I thought they'd have mostly all of the kinds. I was super pumped to go and I get there and they've got like two kinds left. I asked why that was all they had at 1145 when they close at 8 and the guy shortly said "yeah we close at 8." I pause and look at the two kinds of donuts and he says, "we close early if we sell out, we don't keep making donuts." Which, in and of itself is totally fine. But then don't fucking say you close at 8 and fucking destroy a child's day and expectations. Fuck this.

Typically the SunCityCenter location is pretty good, considering the amount of business they do, help is the big problem at times --while the gfood order was ready, they were out of diet coke, so asked i wait at the yellow line while they refilled. That turned into a 10 minute wait, so now the gfood is cold, went inside asked for a manager who redid the order and hgave me large cups. Again all about the help. I have learned good help in florida is hard to come by, nobody here seems to want to work hard and do the job right. From every day business to medical, pretty much all the same lousy service.

Come on Nationwide!!!  You seriously need to get better front end help. I have been coming here for 7 years now. And it's the same service every year. BAD!!!  They are rude act like you have a big fat nerve even walking in the door. Or asking a question like "What frames are in my price range"?  And don't get me started on the wait time.                    I'm giving two stars because once I did finally get to see the optometrist for my exam. She was very nice and answered all my questions.

text:
During check-in, I specifically asked the front desk clerk if the rooms were thoroughly cleaned and sanitized and she assured me it was. I took my clorox wipes and cleaned every surface and of course, it was not cleaned by the staff. 

The rooms smell very moldy and the carpets have not been cleaned. 

Because we are staying more than 3 days, housekeeping does not come inside to clean which is fine. Instead, you have to request room items. So I requested toilet paper, and they gave us napkins instead. She said thats all they have. I can deal with the other stuff but no toilet paper?!?!?

text: I stood in this crowded restaurant yesterday waiting for my order and a huge, pregnant roach started walking across the glass! I was completely disgusted! I asked for a refund and the guy said no we cooked the food already. I said I can't eat this, there's a roach right there! He said that's not a.... Ok I will give you your money back. I took my refund and ran! The girl ordering in front of me did the same. Still thinking I need to contact the health department. I'm not eating Chinese food for awhile. Too much to think about.

I had a wonderful experience at Visionworks. I was immediately greeted by a young man (I think his name was Craig) who assisted me with my paperwork and walked me back to the doctors office where he did some preliminary tests for the doctor.Dr Kristie Draskovic then saw me and was thorough and really made me feel at ease.
   I was sent back to the retail side and an Optician by the name of David explained my insurance information and helped me pick out two pairs of great looking glasses. All in all, I was very pleased with my experience and will certainly be back!
  I would highly recommend this place to anyone.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Ordered a large order for our business...early enough 10a.m. for a noon delivery. First and foremost, the guy that took my order was either on something or very slow.  For cheese and pepperoni pizzas doesn't take a rocket scientist to write that up and get the amount.  I was on for 20 minutes.  Asked for a delivery.. didn't have driver.. grub hub scheduled for delivery at noon.  Had to pick up pizzas myself.. delivery never came.   Don't order from this business if you want a scheduled delivery... You will be disappointed

I see that this location has 2 stars which is extremely generous. 20 minute wait time on a quarter pounder and fries.  The employees appear to be an even mix between white, blacks and Hispanic but the manager communicates almost entirely in Spanish. I dined in and can count on one hand how many English words I've heard her speak. At first I thought the employees were the issue but by the looks on their faces they are just trying to cope and make the best of things.  Absolutely the worse I've ever seen in a McDonalds, even worse than Burger King! Hopefully someone higher up the chain will see this and take some corrective actions.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Arrived on opening day...... Decided to come back on a different day to review this place. 

Anywho, got the tacos (asada) and a torta (carnitas). Immediately, the tacos are a hit. They are big and filled with meat. Definitely a must buy. 
The torta was decent, a shame really because tortas are underrated ! Never the less. This place is awesome becuz it brings variety to the '24/7' fast food restaurants around the area. 

I will come back and try the California burrito. Until then, I'll let the people know where to get some bomb tacos!

This place is okay, I arrived on a Saturday in the afternoon. Luckily nobody to wait for or nobody to be waited on behind, for I usually like to take my time on things. Immediately off the bat, 70% of the selection was gone. All the good ones I mind you. I asked if they were going to make more, and they said no. I mean, they would have too if they still had 4 more hours of operation. Regardless the cheapest donut is $.95, and they aren't anything special. I would like to give this a higher rating but first impressions say a lot. It's hard to say I will ever come back, but I would like to try an original glazed donut.. make more please.

This place is starting to reveal its scam artist ways the more times you come here for the same problems over and over again. We have been coming to this place for years now and it seems we are having the same problem with no advances done to the vehicle. The last time we was there, we were charged to take off the rim out the tire, after telling us the wheels are staggered and cannot be swapped. I have more stories on why not to come here anymore, along with a hand full of BETTER repair places. Thank you for reading, please note I have been coming here for years and fed up with the way the service has been. We deserve better German star.

I've been here twice in the last month. Similar experience both times. Service is friendly but very slow. During our last visit, we arrived around 5:15 to a mostly empty restaurant.  There must have been some confusion among the servers as to who would be helping us, because it was 10 minutes before we were brought chips and salsa. At that time the server arrived and took our drink and food orders.  Drinks from the bar took a while. In fact my drink was forgotten completely.  The food was delicious, but borderline worth the wait.

DO NOT STAY HERE. ZERO STAR RATING. The manager ,Marcos, is scamming people out of their money. Not sure how he is getting away with it. We got evicted for playing music and we're not given a warning. Instead of using common sense and reaching out asking us to lower volume he came to our hotel room with cops to kick us out. When we talked to Marcos about the situation he got up from his desk and walked away, without any explanation. Even the cops believed that we were done wrong but could not do anything about situation.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Don't get me wrong guys, the sushi here is great! But I ran into some trouble with their "Rules".... first of all, YOU CAN NOT share your food with other people when you order The "All you can eat for $25!".... Which in my opinion is pretty fucking stupid and then you CAN NOT leave any left overs because YOU will be charged $5 DOLLARS PER ROLL!!! I just don't know why their rules are meant to be this way, but I think there should be some adjustments! In the mean time I will not come back to this place ever again because they basically told me to stay away since I didn't understand their "Rules" very disappointing.

I stayed here with my teenage sons. The hotel was conveniently located near the venue where we were seeing a basketball game. We were within walking distance.  The valet was super friendly. Check in was a breeze, and we found our room pretty easy. It was on the second floor so we saw the antique train car, too.  Very cool. Our room was pretty average, but nice and clean. We ordered room service after the game and the food was there quickly. The food was good and priced fairly (which is unusual!).  Overall, we had a good experience with the hotel, and I would certainly stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We've been to many different Habit locations, so on our road trip we decided to stop at the original location. From the get go service wasn't great. We had a coupon for a free burger, and was rudely told by the cashier they don't take them because they're system is too old to accept them. Then there was some blue stuff on our shredded cheese on the Caesar salad, we took pictures. The salad was also waaay too lemony and the chicken was very dry. The only redeeming factor were the green beans. We'll stick to our locations back home.

New user here.  The wash itself was great.  The process was not. First I had a $5 certificate that disappeared as soon as I pulled in (10 minutes after puling it up).  Next I joined their monthly newsletter or whatever it was and a 50% coupon off their premium wash came up so I decided to use it.  The guy in front of me had issues so Someone came out to help him then returned to his office.  After I had issues using the coupon on my phone at the pay station someone finally came out to assist and into the wash I went.  Again, the wash was great, the process more difficult than it should have been.

This is by far the best veterinarian clinic I've ever been to. I've had animals my entire life and I've never ever felt so trusting. I truly feel Dr Naguib has a huge heart and is a very rare kind man with a huge heart for animals. He cares for your pets as if they were his own. 

Cash and Tia absolutely trust this vet and the staff that work there are incredible. It's rare, very rare to have a business you can TRUST and I love and am so happy I found this vet I wouldn't take them anywhere else no matter what. 

Thank you Dr Naguib
Ashley

I have been coming here for YEARS and really like the burgers. Today I came in for a breakfast burrito. I have had them before and they are usually not too bad, the tortilla is always pretty dry but other than that they are delicious. This morning was the worst I have ever had here or anywhere, I paid 7.75 for petrified tortilla with some ham, bacon, cheese and GREASY OVER COOKED HASHBROWNS, I do not like eggs so I leave them out. Going forward I will make sure to NOT order a breakfast burrito here again, and they used to be so good, but the last couple of years not so much. How hard is it to keep a tortilla moist, really- NOT THAT HARD.

George's is nothing special.  Just OK in my book.  Sandwiches are reasonably priced but nothing to rave about.  Entrees are overpriced. Appetizers a bit overpriced, too.  It really deserves 2 1/2 stars because you can never get someone at the front desk when you walk in...so you have to wait a while.  I'll give them 3 because it's a local joint owned by locals.  They are always short staffed.  Waitstaff is friendly.  That's a bonus. These kind of restaurants could be so much more.  I'm glad it is local.  I wish they had more interesting things on the menu.

This is THE worst McDonalds I've ever been to. I created a Yelp account just to tell you how bad it is. First bad experience I waited 30+minutes and received none of the food I ordered. Second bad experience waited ANOTHER 30+ minutes and didn't receive my full order. Drive thru is always backed up, lines inside are always long,staff stares at the order screen for what seems like hours and they still get your order wrong! I almost jumped behind the counter and made it myself! Do yourself a favor and go somewhere else.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I usually go to the MMG in Turnersville, but I was in the Cherry Hill area for 3 days a few weeks ago and went to this one. The food is not as quite as good as Turnersville, but close. However, what turned me off, and my reason for giving 2 stars, is the staff. The girls at the counter barely say hi, look absolutely miserable, and just make me feel completely awkward when I order my food. The first day I though it was a fluke, but the second day there was a different girl at the counter and she was equally uninterested and rude. If I get stuck in the Cherry Hill area I'll just go somewhere else for lunch.

What a treat!  Outside seating as the sun was dawning.  A Sunshine Martini on this warm, sunshiny day was a perfect way to start the cool down.  The celery bleu cheese soup was everything it was touted to be here on Yelp. I could've ate a bowl. The grouper over lobster risotto was excellent! The saltiness of the seat in the grouper was a nice balance to the tangy sauce.  The lobster risotto was perfectly cooked and I subbed green beans for broccolini (I recommend).  Service at the start was a bit slow, but it picked up and the staff was very friendly.  Unfortunately, they did not have creme brûlée so I went to Jeni's for ice cream.

I've been going to Ybor and watched this hotel gouge the hell out of folks staying here. You can go to a doubletree and find real class and service for less cash than this place. 
Don't get me wrong, the staff are top notch. 
But the hotel charges more than a four star with seriously two stars of everything; from the rooms, decor, amenities. 
The main reason, they are one of two hotels in Ybor. So when there is an event in Ybor, they jack the rates over $300 a night and force a two night minimum! For that I can find better, and with Uber and Lyft, yes I can get there when I've had too much party in town, for half what they charge.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Went on a Thursday night as a party of two.

The all-you-can-eat price isn't bad. The quality of the food was okay, maybe decent, but nothing to write home about. If this was all, this would be 4 stars BUT

The service was quite slow. Granted, it was busy and I'm sure the staff were working as quickly as they could but this isn't ideal for a order-as-you-eat style. It took 30 to 45 minutes for them to bring out each round and this was only for two people. 

I've been here before and know that they can be better, service and food wise. Hopefully, I just came on a bad day! I'd probably still recommend this place, however, on a less busier day.

There are some wonderful people living here and so far, I have yet to see any drug dealing or psychos around here. The apartments are okay. I wouldn't say they are stunning, but they are decent enough. The office people are friendly. Maintenance? Not so great. Sometimes it takes several work orders to get anything fixed. They are doing a lot of repainting and repaving right now and it is looking better and better. As far as people go, there are many good ones and the not-so-good ones are not here for long. It is quiet most of the time. My husband and I have lived here for a few years.

I have taken my car here for oil changes in the past. I decided to get an inspection. I needed a new windshield sprayer to pass which they charged me an arm and a leg for. A few months later it stopped working. Because it was outside of the 90 day warranty they would not fix it. (Just passed)  however when we took it apart ourselves it wasn't the part that was faulty but how they installed it. The fix was easy enough but sad they wouldn't stand by their work. Don't go here unless u want to over pay for shotty service and poor customer service.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Emilio's is a cute little quaint Italian spot across from the Beach with a great view and is within walking to the hotels, who's guests keep the rent paid.  It is pretty decent and the service is good, but it is not a place that comes up, in my mind, when I crave Italian.  It is worth checking out though, for sure.  It's great for couples and travelers who like a safe menu, and something close to the beach, where you can take a nice stroll along the boardwalk after if you like.  It's very clean and the atmosphere is very pleasant.

Never again. Simply put - the food here is substandard. We ordered spring rolls. I don't know what freezer burned freezer they chipped these out of before dumping them into a fryer. Not only were they awful but they were served with take-out small packets of duck? sauce. We both ordered tempura. This came with straight out of the grocery store pre-cut lettuce scraps. The miso soup was also from a dried reconstituted mix. The tempura was ok but served with a bowl of soy sauce which was already on the table. The plus side was the wait staff - very friendly and attentive. I did hear the sushi was excellent.

Food is good but difficult to order from. They don't honor their own specials on the web when you call in order. They charge you a higher price and tell you that is the best they can do. While on the phone trying to order from a very nice young lady, i can hear a male supervisor talking in the background with an attitude and saying "we don't do coupons" and it was not a coupon, it was their own online special. Second time I have had issues with this so not worth the aggravation for me, there are plenty  of other good places that need business.

The manager, Brian, refused to honor the Pay At Property disclosure which the parent company (Choice Hotel Group) acknowledges as an available option to pay on their website. This incident led to funds being drafted prematurely and from the wrong account which created an undue hardship two hours before a flight. The hotel does not care about the consumer and you can read more of my experience on the BBB website. This hotel, Brian, threatened to cancel my reservation after he refused to honor CHG and Hotels.com policy. I would not recommend for anyone to stay at this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I came here for the first time today. It is confusing as to where to go when you pull in. Then they have a half ass  menu for  your wash choices. After spending $27.00, I really wasn't satisfied with the wash. They have 5 guys wiping your car down after it comes out of the tunnel. But it's almost like they are just going through the motions. After getting home I had to wipe down the car to get the rest of the water off it. And btw, they don't wipe down anything inside for that price. Probably won't come back here.

First time here. The service was good but the food left a lot to be desired. The salad was alright. Not too bad but the pasta was terrible. I ordered the cannelloni and was brought manicotti.  No offer to make it right. How about make it hot?  I asked if they could take it to the kitchen and heat it up. She took my plate and brought it back the same temp it left. I enjoy my food hot. 
I had high hopes when we walked into this charming place. But come on.....  offer to make my order right, don't charge me for the wrong order and just stick it in a micro so it's not room temp. 
Prices were wonderful but food.....  not so much.

I was not very impressed with this place. Quite honestly the prices of their glasses was kind of high. I bought really simple glasses that were 'no name' brand and were 'on sale' but I should've just bought my eyewear at my own doctors office and got something way better and more stylish. The one thing that I didn't like about this office is they didn't even take the time to fit my glasses on my face, because they didn't! They handed me the glasses to try on and look at me from the front and said everything was good. I don't know what happened to servicing your customers nowadays.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The pizza itself was okay, not horrible but nothing special either. The 'deal' really turned me off. I got a $10 gift card (coupon offer) in the mail from Five Star so I gave them a try. I ordered a $15 pizza, told them I had the coupon, and after taxes and delivery charges, the total price was...$15. I gave the delivery guy $5, so my total cost for a medium sized, mediocre pizza was $20. I know I could have gotten a carry out at Dominos for under $10, and it would have been a better quality pizza. Maybe they should call themselves Two Star Pizza so customers wouldn't have high expectations.

First off, this is not your typical hotel bar and restaurant! This is SOOO much more! We had the margaritaville Shrimp to start, delicious! I highly recommend the Key Largo frozen drink and the crab stuffed shrimp! As good as the food and drinks were, it was just icing on the cake! If you're looking to unwind and have an enjoyable evening I highly recommend coming here, and sitting on their deck. Live music, we saw a pod of dolphins and the sunset was gorgeous... and the sunset shots made it even more fun! I'd give them 10 stars if I could. And it's also great for kids and families too!

Called to make a cleaning appointment  for my dog , Leah  the office  manger  if that is her name wants to me what my dog needs so they can charge me more money she is diagnosing  the dog over the telephone  not to mention  they get for medicines  they charge $2 a pill and trifexis thats a hundred dont tell me that they are giving discounts only people  that they know . The office manger  acts like she is the veterinarian  , i will go back to the other  veterinarian where the front dosent try to control the appointment.

MY wife had some work done in castleton.  They did not tighten 3 or the 5 lug nuts.   The car was rattling on the road.   I have no issue with the Castleton branch, accidents happen.  The Castleton manager ask me to take the car to the Greenwood Midas (I was in Greenwood at the time and it was not safe to drive back to Castleton). This redneck manager  in Greenwood guy started yelling at me because he said the bolts were not loose.  I check the lugs by hand and could move 3 or the 5 with just my fingers.  This could have killed me or my son.  I am just trying to do business, not play the blame game.  His response was the worst I could imagine.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Came here for the first time on a Saturday night and it was amazing! Super nice decor and lighting. 
The Appetizers were amazing and the sushi was fresh and delicious! We typically like lemon on our sushi so we simply asked for a thin slice of lemon on our spicy salmon roll. I noticed someone mention "smushy fish" and it made me chuckle. This is not the case at all! It's the spicy salmon which is made the same way as the spicy tuna. Same texture. I personally love it. The staff was so kind and accommodating! Thank you Amanda for your service tonight! I will be coming here from now on.

Overall, I was pleased with my first visit with our Boxer; friendly and attentive.
Shame on me for not checking the bill before I got home.  What I thought was a free bag of dog treats (complimentary, or perhaps for first timers or me just being naive?) and 4 pills that he might need (which he did not) resulted in $9 of unnecessary and unwanted charges.  When feedback was requested via an email, I made note of it and (after 3 days) haven't heard back.
Advice; suggest checking your charges prior to departure.

I really wanted to like this place but it's nothing more than average. 
We came in on Sunday afternoon, and there were two other tables occupied, along with one waiter.  
We ordered chicken fried rice, the Naruto roll, spicy salmon roll, and one other roll (forget the name). The fried rice was okay, the Naruto roll was literally tasteless even though there was ponzu sauce :(, the salmon roll was decent, and the other roll was good. 
Server was attentive and came by to check on us and filled our waters. 
Clean restaurant.

Customer service via phone is terrible.
After calling 1/2 a dozen times, I then stood on the sidewalk outside this establishment in plain view of the order window with no customers in sight and continued to get the, "we're helping other customers..." outgoing message.  When I asked the girl at the order window I was told that walkup customers get first preference but there were NO walkup customers.

For the 'original' Habit', especially during this Covid crisis when customers likely prefer to order via phone, I would expect better service.  

Decent food, terrible service.

Have been going to the Boulevard for some time now . The wait staff could be a tad more friendly. Noticed a significant price increase this last time went in for breakfast Blueberry Pancakes for myself regular pancakes (2) each for my husband coffee and a club soda and a side of sausage links .Bill came to $23.00!! Plus the $4.00 tip for the waitress who sat with another couple ( guess she knew them) until we could get her attention for the check use to get the continental breakfast of oatmeal,fruit,and coffee for $5.99 but now noticed it's $8.99 won't be going back anytime soon

I have a member of this credit union for several years, but this my first time using them to finance a car. This past April I went through the  auto loan process. It was very smooth. Jeffrey B (bank associate) was very professional and patient. The process took about an hour but not complicated nor stressful. Everything was explained clearly and the Credit Union offered a great competitive APR. They even ensured you that you were getting a good deal from the dealership by giving you a value comparison. I will definitely recommend financing through here over a dealership. There is really no comparison.

Took my family here post graduation (6 of us total). Had a delicious meal and of course loved being our own bottle of favorite wine to share. Problem is....this place is small. The group of 10+ middle aged adults next to us we're done eating when we were seated, but continued to hang around, open more bottles of wine, get belligerent and terribly loud. We couldn't hear any of the conversation at our own table. We notified the waitstaff but they did nothing.  Of course they noted that we complained about them and then they started harassing us. Again, waitstaff did nothing. We ate quickly and left. Great meal but won't be back.

Let me start off with a few issues:
1) I entered my room and there was a horrible chemical smell. 
2) night shift front desk staff is extremely rude and do not care about guests. 
3) My shower handle is broken and I cannot adjust the temperature.  They told me they do not have 24hr maintenance.  Maintenance leaves at 11:00pm.  I have never stayed in a hotel without 24hr maintenance. 
4) My room is also extremely hot and nothing can be done about tonight.  I have been traveling all day and I am exhausted. 
5) SAVE YOUR MONEY AND GO ELSEWHERE!!! DO NOT  STAY IN THIS DUMP!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I wish I could give this place a zero. The rooms are decent but front desk employee was horrible. He was extremely aggressive banging his hand on the counter and screaming at us because he was on the phone. A member of our party with a minor child was not able to check-in. We asked about his mannerism towards guest and he refused to check her in.  This employee was extremely unprofessional and threatening. We are a group of 3 women with 3 minor children and he scared us all. Our options our limited and we are extremely confortable staying her the night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
After trying a few different pizza places in the area, I fell in love with this place. Been here a couple of times and the store is always clean and customer service is always pretty awesome. The first time I tried the gluten free pizza I was shocked about how good it was so I had to try it again for a second time and to my surprise it was just as good. Definitely going to add this place on my weekly dinner list. Also tried the wings for the first time today and the buffalo wings were pretty good can't wait to try the other flavors.  

P.s I also got free ice cream!!!

I booked a car rental through Hotwire and due to the Covid (crap), our flight times were changed. I tried to modify our pick up and drop off times (less than 4 hours difference) and they wouldn't help out. Due to unprecedented times we are in, I feel they should be more flexible. The flight time change was not my doing. Now they want me to sit at the airport for 3 hours to wait for my rental car. No thanks. I'll eat the money and rent from someone else that is more understanding. I will never rent from National or book with Hotwire again.

7/22/2021. Went through the drive through and waited 35 minutes to finally get our order, and it was wrong. We asked for a plain cheeseburger and it came with all the toppings. Then had to ask for our plain cheeseburger. Got a twenty piece McNuggets and it came with 17 nuggets. And they asked for what sauce we wanted, which was Buffalo Sauce, but our order came with no sauce. So waiting for 35 minutes, not getting what you ordered and getting 17 nuggets instead of 20 then this is the place to go!! Horrible!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
The food was tasty, but overpriced. The green salad is just a big bowl of greens with tasty dressing - $13.00 or $14.00 dollars - probably cost them 50 cents. Our friends ordered the sausage pizza with EXTRA sausage and there was still a very minimum amount of sausage on it.
The pizza crust was good, but soggy.  The shrimp was good as were the carrots, but again, small servings. The place is cute, nice atmosphere, wonderful owners and servers. But, I'm not sure what everyone in Montecito is all excited about....

Haven't been to a Laundromat in more than 50 years but the MUDSLIDE made me do it. Boy! How times have changed! My recollection & expectation was grunge and musty odors.
What a pleasant surprise to walk into a sparkling clean and spacious area with more machines and friendly employees than I would have expected. Whoever came up with the idea of a monetized card instead of quarters really made life easier.
Although this was my first visit, I's say that the Modern Laundry sets a new standard for what used to be an unpleasant chore. Let's rename it the Super Modern Laundry!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: So disappointed. Bought the 'ultimate package' which said it included everything I was looking for. I even specifically asked if it included the trunk and I was told yes. The whole car wash was rushed and done in about 7 minutes. I go to get in and the whole dashboard is dusty, the cup holders have crumbs, the handles and doors were not even wiped down and the trunk that I specifically asked about was not done. When I asked about it, I was told my package didn't include any of that? A ultimate package for interior and exterior doesn't include a dash wipe down?

This location is extremely frustrating to go to due to it being completely inconsistent. Half the time something is missing or wrong with the order. You can ask them to cut s bagel in half and they refuse. You can send it back to be cut and it comes back not cut in half. They will hand you a small plastic knife. How is a person supposed to cut s bagel in half with a plastic knife, let alone in a car?  I find them impressively rude and because of our last experience we will not be returning. We've lived in Harleysville for fifteen years and have visited this business multiple t

DO NOT STAY HERE!!This is the WORST place I've ever stayed at! If I wanted my bathroom to be across the hall I would have stayed at a hostel. It's freezing and there's no thermostat. I went to complain and was told they're sold out. The hallways are dingy and the back alley view just puts a nice bow on the whole experience.
Cont...I waited overnight to post this in case my anger subsided...it didn't because of the drunks partying in the alley outside my window at 3am. Btw...slept with clothes on because it remained freezing all night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Food is DELICIOUS! We have been trying to find a good Chinese food restaurant near us with a lot of disappointment. This is by far our favorite. Only negative is they don't deliver. Staff is relatively friendly and inside is clean. This last time we ordered the General Tso's, Mongolian Beef, and Pork Lo Mein, asking them to add some spiciness. The General Tso's was just a tad too sweet, and the white rice was a little mushy. But on the whole, really delicious....I tried to eat too much because it was so good and ended up with a stomach ache.

I've lived in China and Japan and in Philadelphia, not too far from Chinatown. Now I live in the suburbs and I'm happy to say that Gong's Market has everything I was starting to miss. Well, close enough. There will always be one or two things you're a given shopper won't find here and they may make a judgement on that, but for me, Gong's is as complete an Asian market as I'd hope to find out here. There are also a few other quirky markets in the same complex that I recommend visiting. A shoe repair guy there does excellent leather work, for example.

I've lived in China and Japan and in Philadelphia, not too far from Chinatown. Now I live in the suburbs and I'm happy to say that Gong's Market has everything I was starting to miss. Well, close enough. There will always be one or two things you're a given shopper won't find here and they may make a judgement on that, but for me, Gong's is as complete an Asian market as I'd hope to find out here. There are also a few other quirky markets in the same complex that I recommend visiting. A shoe repair guy there does excellent leather work, for example.
Ignore their website: They are closed on Mondays.

we had to go to three different enterprises to pick up a rental car we have had booked for over a month. when we finally got to the third one on 135, we were helped by a man, Blake. we were informed we cannot get the car because of not having a major credit card, but we can pay for everything else with it since it is also a Visa. he was very rude and not helpful at all. after dealing with this for over an hour and finally dealt with wonderful, helpful people at Avis and got an even better rate with no trouble at all. thanks for nothing enterprise! 

(not even worth the one star that is required to leave)

Nice experience as an Emerald Isle member - the vehicle was clean relatively new and in great condition.  However, I selected a vehicle because it had the Sirius XM sticker on it.  To my disappointment - only after I hit the road on my trip to Kansas - did I discover that while the vehicle was Sirius XM ready - it didn't have a subscription enabled.  Made for a long 9 hours of driving......... 

Shame on me for not verifying before I left the lot, shame on National for having that sticker on the car giving me the impression that it was enabled.

I started coming here around 2 months ago and as a man I will never go to another salon again. I like how this place is straight forward and cuts my hair. I've gone into places and asked for a trim and 5 minutes later and 20 dollars they are done.. When I asked him to cut my sides it was literally like he was using digital calipers he was so precise and took his time and at the end he shaves my neck line with a straight razor I was impressed with this place and if your a guy you should try it out I bet you won't go anywhere else.

This place continues to amaze.  Lots of great variety and great flavors. Menu changes on a frequent basis and continues to add fresh and flavorful ingredients into the mix.

We were there on New Year's Eve, so could not give 5 stars due to the decrease in the attentiveness of service.  Could be part of the fact that patrons had other plans for the evening and may have been hurried, unlike us.  Also, tight seating led to many "seat kicks" during the evening with staff using the space behind my chair as a primary thoroughfare.

I do not go here anymore. I used to have the most expensive membership. I watched an employee dip a scrub brush in some water, then touch the ground with the bristles and then started scrubbing the hood and bumper of a car in front of me. I've seen this from multiple employees there on different occasions. That's like dropping a wash mit in the dirt and still using it. I don't blame the manager because he seemed like an intelligent person. But he seriously needs to educate his young employees about car care. If they had a 4-500 dollar a month vehicle payment they might think twice about the things they do.

This place is SOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO average - AT BEST.  I go here with older relatives monthly.  Sure - it's reasonable BUT not good.  Pasta dishes are 80% pasta; sauces are bland; entrees have NO imagination.  Once, I ordered an eggplant dish - the eggplant was literally cut, cooked and served in minutes.  You do NOT prepare eggplant like this. No excuse - just "sorry".  This place will do well because it's inexpensive & a BYOB in an area that has very little to offer.  Go down the street to New Habana for quality and taste.

Had not dined here since 2011 and know I remember why. 
Terrible food why and would this place still be in business. Caters to older Foothills crowd. 
Ordered Veal Marsala and was super thin, tough and very bland watery sauce. With Vivace's prices the same with much better quality food, I will stick to dining there or Tavolino. 
I think this place should stick to pizza but even that was mediocre at best. 
After stating how disappointed I was, wait staff did not offer to bring me another entrée and asked me if I would like a box? No cars in the world. The waiter was offended that I did not care for my entrée

Room was clean, good amount of towels, bathroom was a nice size. The tv was an old tube tv and the microwave was a dial so if you need to microwave something for 30 seconds it's near impossible. The breakfast options are cereal, Otis Spunkmeyer muffins, boiled eggs, and bagels. The bagels were pre packaged Lenders and they were almost all moldy. I threw out almost 4 before I found a good one. Pool was clean despite it being in the middle of the parking lot. Not bad for the price. Staff is very friendly!!!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Pre ordered and pre paid.  I went there shortly after and asked about the order. She said she didn't know what I was talking about. She stayed I could get water across the street. I showed her the paid receipt on my phone. She said I was at the wrong location. I showed her that I was at the right location. She says I don't know what to tell you and walks away. Rude from the very beginning. I see coffee sitting on the far end of the counter. I walk over and my name is on the receipt. WHO HAS TIME FOR THIS CRAP?

I moved to the Main Line area a couple years ago. It has taken me that long and trying four other salons in the area to find someone whom I trust to do my hair! 

Gabby understood what I'm looking for with my color and cleaned up the disheveled cut and color I had just gotten six weeks prior. Also, she had great guidance when I inquired about trying a straight perm. 

She's pleasant and funny, someone you would enjoy spending a couple of hours with. She did a great job updating the space which is clean and cozy. I am so excited to go back.

I absolutely loved this place! Everyone addressed me by name, rather they were actually working with me or not.  They were all extremely friendly, accommodating, fun and professional.  I enjoyed the complimentary wine, the decor was top! And my nails are perfect.  My only complaint would be with the latex gloves.  I have an extreme allergy to latex.  Once I was able to explain this, she took the gloves off.  I understand why you want to wear gloves, go that extra step and have latex free.  I am visiting here, I really wish this shop was st home.  If I ever come back I will make sure I come back to Nail Bar NOLA.

High quality ingredients and good quick service. A ton of fresh options with local ingredients for whatever you are feeling. I got a meat slice and a cheese slice. Both were delicious. The pizza is premade each day and they run it through a quick oven cycle when you order so it's a great quick lunch place. I would get 3 slices next time as they aren't super filling. 

Good bottle/canned drink options as well. 

The only thing I wish they had was fountain soda and that the pizza was crispier. I'm sure they would have run it through their oven one more time if I asked though.

Terrific employees. But they should warn you of the nighttime bar noise from American Social Bar 10 stories down. Room was clean and comfortable. Parking is expensive and the Car hops need personalities. Noise ran till about 2 am.m from which I fell in and out of sleep. You really don't want to stay anywhere near this bar. The noise is incredible. Beautiful view from the room. And I repeat, the Hotel in another location would have rated 4-5 stars. But not where it is. Thank goodness Starbucks is close. Don't say you weren't warned. Charged my card 50 for incidentals. Says it takes 3-5 business days to clear, as I did not use it. Hmmmm.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We stayed here for three nights. It was fine for what we needed. We had two adults, three kids and two dogs. They seem like they had a good outdoor area but we were so busy we didn't have a chance to use the pool or gym areas. The biggest complaints we have were breakfast and customer service. Breakfast was very plain with just fake eggs and sausage and oatmeal. They did have muffins and juice but that was the extent of it. I did ask for our room to be "refreshed" and it never got done so we ran out of toilet paper and had a tower of garbage. Again it was enough for what we needed but it could have been better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I paid for a booklet of coupons for the Ultimate level wash. It seems that I always end up with the basic wash and they always have an excuse for why I didn't get what I paid for- some song and dance about how it is all computerized.  

They are supposed to vacuum, and they don't.  They don't wipe down the dashboard or running boards.  The windows are streaky.  When I had the car detailed, the detailer said I had double paid to have the mats cleaned- it was supposed to be included in the detailing I had paid for.  The place needs a serious managerial overhaul.  I will go to the new Franklin Auto Spa in Frazer from now on.

BREAKFAST! They open at 9, have mexican eggy things and great coffee in cool mugs. Also where i tried chilaquenes, a mexican breakfast food that supposedly goes with coffee. 
I like everything i've had here and i crave the chicken enchilada soup. Enjoy their wings and got some for a party once...only $14 for 20; pretty cheap. Been her a dozen times only meh thing i ever ordered was a taco salad lunch special... iceberg lettuce etc. boring. probably because taco salad isn't even mexican. Otherwise comida buena!

I thought this place had good food but it does not!!!. The employees are friendly I can say that but the chef or whoever cook does not know how to cook Mexican at all. I order a chimichanga and I decided I wanted to add shrimp. Worst mistake I ever made the shrimp still had the black poo inside the shrimp and it wasn't just one or two it was all of them. I also order some fries, they were saggy and tasted old too, they even look like they have been refried 3 times of how old they looked. Love the customer service but not the food.

Thought about putting some support behind this new establishment. Until I saw the owners wife take their child to put in the car. After getting the child sorted she cleaned her garbage out and threw it on the ground!  Literally right in front of their own business. I called and although the guy answering admitted he was the owner and that was his family the most he did was look at the garbage out his window.  We were in the area for another hour and nobody picked up her trash.  I find this a disgusting display of ignorance.

Seriously low quality ingredients. It's amazing that in a location that has proven to fail that the owners open up there and pair it with terrible food. 

Owners are lovely and the place is so clean I hope they have the flexibility to up their quality.  We tried it tonight out of nostalgia for the 80's SP memories. I regret this choice and it's 2 hours after the fact. Bloated with a yucky metal taste in my mouth. 

I would urge you to go anywhere else and I hate to do that to a small family run business.   If you are the owners I would suggest you taste the food from a customers perspective.

My company booked this hotel for me and for a one or two nighter alone, it would have been doable. But, with my daughter and I, it's too small for the whole week. There was no where to sit and relax in the room. They need more hooks in the bathroom. It's like tiny house living. With that, it is a downtown old hotel so I do allow for the tiny-house feel.  There are many positive things too tho. Free snacks, coffee, filtered water, and location to shopping is great. The staff have been uber friendly! Good stay for the price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We're visiting from out of town and really wanted some Mexican. The food was average like most of the chain type Mexican joints, but our service was horrible. Our server had very little patience, she was unaccommodating, and just down right rude (she actually rolled her eyes at one point). When we were on our way out, I overheard her speaking Spanish to some co-workers where she called me some not very nice names. Very unprofessional and not the experience I would've wanted to have with my family while on vacation.

This nail salon greeted me with amazing hospitality on my first visit. I was very impressed with everyone's kindness and what seemed like efficiency. My gel nails were perfect, but my feet left just as callused as they came in. The following visits the polish was mediocre, ive never seen a gel manicure so neglected. They were clumpy and the nails were filed so unevenly I wondered if it was the nail techs first day, but I'd seen her before. I'll never forget the hour and a half it took to take the gel off my nails because they were so thick and disgusting when they were finished. Impressively deceptive salon.

We came to NOLA for a vacation and chose the Courtyard due to its location near the French Quarter.  It's easy to walk to the local attractions and it's right on the streetcar line.  The hotel is relatively new, very clean, comfortable, and the staff is helpful. The hotel gets 4 stars because we got a room with an exterior view.  About 2/3rds of the rooms overlook an interior light well.  The rating would have three stars if we got one of those rooms.  The fitness room is fairly well equipped. There's a small bar/ restaurant in the lobby that serves breakfast (not free) and lighter items at dinner. The breakfasts were fairly good.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This use to be my favorite place, however I am pretty sure owners have changed. They forgot part of our order to start, when we called, they recognized the issue and told us we could pick it up. Instead of making a newer, fresher order, they gave us the one that had been sitting for an hour. The food was bland, all of it. The potstickers use to be the best in St. Louis, now they are just ok. The beef lo mein had 4 pieces of beef in it with hardly any sauce. I'm sad to say that we have made our last trip to Chinese express, Ye is missed!

ODD,i have been in multiple planet fitness gyms,this is the worst,there is a person who is there for late night and early morning hours10pm to 230 am everyday  who has taken over the gym,loud speech,harrassing and threatening activity,there was no way to use the gym without being bothered,had to change gyms,he didnt like the way i lifted weights,interfered with his supposedly teaching other people management is MIA to allow a customer take over the gym,NO JUDGEMENT ZONE  not true,sad to say i have been going to gyms since the early 80`s AMERICAN FITNESS CENTER,and i have never seen so much judgement as i have seen at planet fitness
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Food is very good, service not so much.  Servers always seem miserable and food takes forever.  Be prepared for a long wait.  When the male manager (owner??) is there, the dining room is always very loud because he walks around and talks to everyone, which is fine, but he has a very LOUD voice.  Sometimes you just want a nice quiet meal.  The angels on horseback pizza is excellent, even thought it was left off the menu in the last printing.  The onion rings are pretty good too.

and Biago A- I tried to email you 8/14 and did so again today.

We booked a room for a 4 day weekend. The first night there out AC stopped working, the came down and fixed it right away. The pool was pretty warm which was awesome but the best part of all is how they can work around my daughters extreme dairy allergy. At breakfast she was able to get a omelette with no milk in it and they have plenty of fruits, drinks and cereal (dry) for her to eat which was very nice. The water is a little touchy when you take a shower but that's the only negative about this place. The staff was very nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: WENT FROM THE BEST TO THE WORST... Out of holiday coffee flavors ever week during the holiday season. They tell you at the window "it's corporate". Just out of curiosity I emailed corporate who informed me that places are "privately owned" and it incumbent on the owners to order their own product which "corporate has an abundance of." Drive through averages 15 + minute wait. Order donuts?!?! All you get is "we're out".  I now avoid this DD and the one on 41... same owner and seek out other DD or go to Starbucks. My money is green and is welcomed everywhere...

Alesha had no interest in customers or taking their orders, both times I repeated the same menu item. Nothing custom, just a sandwich and hash browns. She brought her 3 elementary age kids to work, which sat in the lobby (no other adult around), so that may have distracted her. The girl at expo looked off in the distance and was expressionless. She didn't say a word. $15/hr would fix her mood. Please...
I gave a score of 2 solely due to food quality and cost.
Columbus/Dale Mabry managers would not allow this disconnected demeanor.

Absolutely. Disappointing. Spent over $1000 for 2 nights, you would expect to at least get a worthwhile experience. 
Only positive part about this hotel is the valet/bellboys- they were amazing, so personable and a pleasure to be around. I cannot say the same about any of the other employees, including their "manager" Tatiana. There is absolutely no customer service in this hotel. 
The room was nothing special. We ordered room service: a burger, 2 pizzas, and juice/sprite for a total of $150. $40 was added for delivery/service charge/tax. 
Overall, never again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: After hiking Tumamoc Hill on a warm Saturday, I came across nearby St. Mary's Mexican food for lunch (order at counter.) I'm mostly glad I stopped in, as, a.) I was very thirsty and got the equivalent to a big gulp-sized soda; b.) worked up an appetite; and c.) was not in a hurry. I got two chicken tostadas with guacamole which were delicious, and inexpensive - $7.50 for food/drink.  But, beware -- it took 45 minutes for food to arrive - not exaggerating! So, I recommend for the food and value, with the caveat of slow service during peak time.

Messed up my order 2x but really 3x because the second time they messed up and i ain't feel like going back . How i ask for CHICKEN tacos and you give me beef ? imagine . and the burrito was so skimpy i thought it was nothing but tortilla.  60$ spent and was not at all worth it . the queso was good though , that was the best part of the meal. I'm thankful for the little man who works there, very helpful and understanding. maybe it's because they're new to the area or just nervous but i won't be coming back .

I grew up with Mexican food in Southern California and now the Bay Area.   My family moved to Brentwood and they took me to dinner at this place.  It was really good.
Chips were light and not greasy, salsa was good, guacamole was not adulterated: don't know how they caught the avocados at just the right state of ripeness, but they did.
I had the best chile relleno I can remember.  I believe it was a Hatch chile, lightly breaded, cooked just enough and no more.
The rest of my family had a variety of things and they said they were all good.
Staff was very attentive.
I expect we'll go there on future visits.

This coffee place is just okay. Their dirty chai is really good, as is their other coffee. However, they run out of food early and don't replace it during the day, so don't go in expecting to get a snack with your coffee past like 10 AM. I ended up getting one of four bagels that were left, and then I had to toast it myself. The cashier also didn't know how to take the new 2018 axxess card, which is unfortunate since it has a 2-for-1 coffee deal. Overall, the place just doesn't look that nice, and the furniture is kind of dirty. The staff was fine. Overall I'd go here once to get my axxess deal, but probably not again.

I took my car for a routine inspection. I also recently purchased a catalytic converter lock, I asked the guys to take a look at and if it was not too much trouble, to put in on for me. They informed me that the lock would not prevent people from stealing the part(which happened twice in the past six months) and ideas on what to get instead. They recommended a shop that specialized in that area of mechanics and never charged me for the work they did on the car. The service was great and with all the work and inspection, took under four hours.

Such a disappointment tonight! We ordered pizza from them last week after our swim lesson and really enjoyed it! This week, my husband placed an order before swim and when he went to pick it up, they had given it to someone else! 
As a business owner, I know that mistakes can happen, but I also know that you make it right by either compensating the customer or offering them a free dessert, etc. 
The only thing we received was our food almost two hours after we ordered it originally and an "I'm sorry". 
Unfortunately we will not return as a result!

They seemed to have forgotten that they provide a SERVICE.  And if you act pissy towards your clients, they don't come back.  No one smiles, especially not the clientele stuck in there.  Lots of people that aren't clients come and go, and lots of people are lounging in a back TV room.  There's lots of something going on there, but it's not professional hair styling.  My hair cut was just ok once I got home and personally made necessary repairs.  Service was poorer than average.  OK for cleanliness, it seemed.

I loved going in on Tuesday nights. The bartender, Lisa was about the best there is. She served you once and knew your order anytime you returned.  Went in recently and the place looked aweful! No friendly greeting and no Lisa.  The patrons at the bar said the son of the owner took over after he died, fired Lisa.  Miss you Bob! Hope you have lots of chocolate milk where you are! Lisa, where are you? I'll be there, girl you are one of the best. Doubt that I have any desire to go back to the RM if Lisa isn't there. So sadď

Good food but terrible service.  Went with 4 friends on a Sat night and it was packed, so noisy you could not hear your table.  The waiter was rude and had an argument with the manager right at our table as we tried to order drinks.  One of our party left.  

We asked for another waiter who was very nice but started there two months earlier and told us how bad his last job at Amazon was; he even sat down in our friend's empty chair while he wiped the sweat from his forehead and complained.  The table next to us order the "flaming" pasta dish and that waiter almost set my hair on fire.  Despite good food, the service makes it a nightmare.

This place is garbo. There are so many better mexican restaurants in the area. First of all dont even bother trying to get delivery. We tried twice and each time took upwards of an hour and a half. The estimate was 30 minutes. They even had the gull to call the postmate over and then promptly force the poor dude to wait 5-10 minutes for rice. When you're finally graced with the food some of it is cold, most is unseasoned, and none of it is satisfying. 2nd time also made me feel mildly sick as well. Just avoid it

Went here Saturday night; got squeezed into a table for 2 in a corner where we could barely move. The unpleasant waiter could not even come right to table because he didn't fit. He dropped the gross basket of COLD leathery bread with no napkin in the basket from behind me. I asked him about he Linguine with White Clam Sauce and he suggested I order the red. I said I only like the white; he rolled his eyes. When the white got to the table and I saw how disgusting it looked I realized I should have listened. It tasted awful as well.   I would never return here and I don't think it is worthy of even one star...they have everyone fooled!

DISGUSTING .  It's so dark lighting wise you can't even see what your eating.  The whole styrofoam crap makes it worse.  Sushi is subpar at best and their hibachi food has ZERO flavor.  No sauces are given unless you ask which is ridiculous for any spot that sells sushi!  Don't waste your money a fast food sushi spot is better! The food you see in pic is what was left we couldn't bear to eat it the general Tsos or whatever was fatty type pieces.  On top of all this a combo hibachi meal of scallops and shrimp were ordered but they listed 3 separate charges on bill.  IF YOU WANT GARBAGE EAT HERE!

Always good food and wine here but I have to complement the customer service. As I dined with friends this past week, one of our cars was broken into while we were there. The staff was very apologetic, assisted us in getting with the police, offered a shop vac to clean up the glass, and gave us a free bottle of wine.
