They were so nice- nothing can replace the anger of a break in but they management was awesome. The food is always excellent and the wine as well. Also great that it has its own parking lot. I've never had break in problems in the past. Just the wrong place at the wrong time.

Fantastic place to stay and excellent customer service from checkin to the time we left.  Lessie and Asone were amazing.  This hotel is clean, beds are comfortable, is in a great location, and their driver takes you within 3 miles of downtown.   Even when the van was broken, they paid for an uber to pick us up at no cost - who does that?  Staybridge that's who.  They have a happy hour during the early part of the week too.  We will definitely stay here again and hope that management recognizes their excellent staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I had the WORST time at this burger king. I took my beloved grandson here and ordered a hamburger kids meal for him. It took TEN minutes for me to drive up to the window because the woman at the register was chatting and exchanging PHONE numbers with a customer. Once finally I got to the window, she REFUSED to gice me my change. After getting the manager involved I was finally on my way out. BUT - when my precious grandson opened the bag the order was WRONG! The poor child didn't even get a toy in his kids meal... He said 'I would give them negative 1 stars grammy!' and I whoeheartedly agree....

This is my very 1st non-5 stars. I usually won't comment if I'm not hyped.
Cafe Napoli always consistently serves 5 star food. The sauces, seafood & pasta rival all others. My only complaint today was my pick-up (they set the time, but had me just sitting out front for 20 min. w/o anyone providing any kind of customer service. I saw waitresses milling around outside & valet out front. When I called inside they kept apologizing inc\ the receptionist who finally brought it out. We, who are still reluctant to eat indoors, deserve better.

Dishonest staff. I always ordered from Soprano's, at least once every 10 days... never again. My delivery was $31 which Included the delivery charge. I have the driver $60 thinking I gave him $40 and asked for $6 back. He took a $23 tip plus the delivery charge. I called them literally 2 minutes after he pulled off when I put the food down and realized I gave him $23 on a $31 bill.... they said, "sorry you should have known."
What I do know is, the extra $20 will cost them. I don't do business with dishonest people.

Went shopping for essencials. Lined up people were required to wash and have their baskets/carts wiped down before entry. All good. Now once inside it was mayhem. No social distancing was being practiced. The cashier, a lady with long hair flying all over, coughed into her hand a couple times, wiped her hand on the back of her pants and proceeded to grab the groceries, fresh veggies etc, of the person in front of me. I abandoned my groceries and walked out of the store. Absolutely discusting in this time we are in. Covid-19

Ordered take out on Friday evening. The food was hot and a great deal for what was given. I ordered the steak cooked medium rare and it came with two sizes. The steak was cooked to perfection. The garlic smashed potatoes and salad was hot and well seasoned. My only issue is that the pick up for take out is right outside the bathrooms. When you are waiting for your food you are directly in front  bathrooms and blocking the entrance and exit of the bathroom. This was a turnoff. But the safe was friendly  and food was good.

This store's employees makes Walmart on Tchoupitoulas look like Neiman Marcus. I was there last night and watched 5-6 high school aged employees running a muck trough the store. At checkout NO REGISTERS were open and I was forced to self checkout. I scanned and bagged my own stuff while three kids in Winn Dixie uniforms "chilled" a few feet away. I asked why there wasn't at least one register open and was told it's the store's policy. I asked for a manager and was met by an 18-19 year old male kid with a woman's hairstyle, who said he's in charge until 8:00AM. I noticed there were only two other people shopping...now I know why.

Dinner tonight at a well known Italian joint on Victoria Street... TV... First bite of my appetizer... Chomp... Into chards of porcelain! Blood every everywhere... Discretely let bartender know... showed him my bloody napkin... and the broken porcelain... His response? "Wow that looks dangerous!" 
Un-f'ing believable! Yup... that's my blood... and that's a piece of the white porcelain chard... At least he took the appetizer of my bill... gotta love the restaurant biz in SB.... I think maybe I should own this place now!

Bad experience all around. The staff was friendly enough but messed up every aspect of our visit. Our server kept forgetting things we ordered (coffee, the toast I had to ask for repeatedly) Also, my wife ordered a hamburger, they brought a cheeseburger. When we returned it, all they did was scrape the cheese off (not even all of it), flip the burger over and give it back to us. Rookie move. I ordered the Eggs Benedict and was seriously displeased. I didn't even eat the grits after trying them. How do you mess up grits? 
All in all, we're pretty disappointed since we live nearby and are looking for a good local spot. We won't be back here.

I just needed a basic trim because my hair had gotten too long, but I was on a budget and couldn't do a full style and color like usual so this place was perfect. My hair ended up a little shorter than I'd plan, but I think part of that was due to the fact that my hair is wavy so when it dried it ended up much shorter than where I'd intended. But it was even and they didn't add unwanted layering as I've had many places do. So for a simple trim on a budget, I'd recommend this place. Plus the app was handing so I didn't end up sitting for an hour waiting to get a cut.

Extremely overpriced for what you get. Italian is great because it can be delicious but also pretty cheap to make. Example: The Scaloppine Piccata here cost $28 and you get 3 little, bit-sized, pieces of veal and only spinach. No pasta included like anywhere else that would serve this dish! To get pasta, it is $11 extra, as a side, and is not cooked in the sauce that makes the dish what is should be. Sorry, but we cant come back for a $39 dish that can be easily made at home, for a fraction of the cost, with a better result.

This hotel and it's staff was one of the very best places l have ever stayed. The staff , every single one of them , was extremely helpful and courteous.  The hotel itself was very clean. The free breakfast was good not just ordinary.  They provide free shuttle service to Busch Gardens  on a definite schedule and even call the room if you are scheduled and aren't  there for pickup.  The one shuttle driver was so special, Harold, was so kind and helpful . They all were but he just had that special touch.  Thank you all for making our trip really great!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Casual, warm, BYOB restaurant on a busy Saturday night at 8:00 pm.  Red formica tables, clean, friendly and quaint.   Catherine our hostess and waitress was wonderful, kind and efficient.  The three of us shared a large tomato pizza pie with prociutto, and mushrooms, a bowl of pasta which included a house salad and two orders of meatballs.  Everything was served fresh - hot and delicious - - really loved the thin crust - only wish they had more than one bathroom, more menus and more staff.  We will return -- it was really tasty!

This is the worst McDonald's in the entire world. I downloaded yelp and wrote this review while waiting for my food. I've been here a few times because it's closest to my house, and the drive through is ridiculously slow. Tonight I decided I'd see if it was quicker to go inside. Nope. They literally don't take people's orders. Instead they tell you to use the one working kiosk. Also people beg you to buy them food, which is uncomfortable (and made my order cost twice as much). 45 minutes later, I'm finally out. I will never go back to this awful place.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Arrived at this place, no one was there initially, told you have to order before you sit down. The young girl had no idea how to host or be a server, little knowledge about Sushi. We sat down after ordering, the edamame was cold, no salt on it. Never received our soup,but charged for it. 40 minutes later received our food. The Sushi was pretty good. Received our bill which was not itemized,and difficult to understand. We were over charged. The restaurant overall wasn't clean, the bathroom floors and hallway near the bathroom were very greasy, and no toilet paper. The overall service was poor. I will not return or recommend this place.

Room was dusty, lightbulbs out, patio very unkept. The deal breaker was that we were given certificates for two free glasses of fess Parker wine. We don't drink wine..we were told to bring the coupons to dining room in the morning for complimentary coffee. When we arrived at the dining room we were told they would not support two free cups of coffee. I inquired at the front desk about their response.. they indicated it was their policy. The front desk attendant told us when we arrived we could use the certificates for coffee if we don't drink wine . 
Bottom line..we won't b back
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We intended to dine in, but the owners were eating with their family - which included a couple of painfully loud and energetic children - screaming loudly and jumping all over as if it were at home during playtime rather than in a restaurant in which customers want to enjoy themselves. We got it to go. 
This was our first (and only) time there. The food was exactly what you would expect if you were staying in the Holiday Inn and ordered Chinese from the place next door - mediocre at best, but if you're desperate or drunk, it'll get the job done - I guess. Take a drive elsewhere though.

Used to visit this Chinese restaurant a lot when I was younger and I always remember it being so good. Regardless of all the negative reviews. I decided to try it again tonight with the bf and I wasn't impressed. I gave this place three stars because he ordered a Saint Paul sandwich and really liked it. On the other hand,  I ordered vegetable fried rice with crab ragoon. The crab ragoon was great, the rice... Not so much. The rice was crowded with onions, seemed extremely oily- and greasy; so much that I couldn't finish a small order. Overall I wasn't happy with the quality of food and will not be returning anytime soon.

I rented a vehicle for two weeks from National.  The service engine soon light came on the first day I had the vehicle.  I called the 1-800 national number and was told to go to the local national rental store and switch out my vehicle.  When I drove 45 minutes to the branch, they sent me away and told me they did not have a vehicle to replace my current rental.  I have since drove the vehicle from Philly to Houston and still have the vehicle with the service engine light on.  No one will return my calls and I cannot reach a person.  I will never use National again.

Nothing good to say about Sage. In fact, we didn't even try the food. They turned us away for dinner at 9:03 pm. We had called 15 minutes earlier because we were lost on the way to the restaurant, and we asked whether they were still serving. The host assured us they were. When we did arrive, the host was showing us to a table when a manager brushed past and said gruffly over his shoulder, "We're closed," and kept walking, without the slightest attempt at apology or sympathy.

Their Website says they are opened until midnight. Don't believe it!

Needless to say, we won't be going back. There are better, friendlier restaurants in St. Louis.

Goes without saying. See earlier comments re unnecessary bill gouging that has been posted under 'TIPS'. There are many more examples that could be cited here but just wanted to make folks aware and to be wary.  They are convenient to use for boarding if you live in the area. But be prepared for some ailment to be discovered and a phone call to run up another bill.
$850 for a broken toenail, avg ear infection they run bill up to $400+ 
Brought in my older ill dog and in 30 min they ran a bill up to $850 before putting the poor thing to death immediately after the useless tests. 
Avoid them as there are plenty of alternatives.

After going to this salon for 3 years I showed up 10 minutes late to my appointment and was told they would have to reschedule because of their 15 minute late policy. I got my phone out to show them I hadn't met their policy, but at that point I wouldn't have let her do my hair anyway. It's sad the way they treat their longtime clients. I have never been to the business without waiting at least 10 minutes for my stylist. Needless to say this is not a place I would give my business to after the treatment of long time clients. Beware. They were very polite in their rudeness if that counts for anything.

Just happened to pop in en route to a business meeting. Service was so slow and no one was even in the place. Ordered a 16 Oz Americano with 4 shots and had to ask for another because it was so weak. Watched the shot being pulled and when he put it in my cup he didn't even pour the whole thing. Weird.  Not a lot of hustle going on and yet there were 4 people behind the counter they gotta get past the dreaded millennial ambivalence.. drives people nuts. They aren't slow because they are being friendly and chatty either.

This place was great! I was welcomed once I came in even when I came a few minutes late and they were still nice!!! Lol. My appointment was with Natasha, but before I sat down the hostess gave me a run down on the salon. Once I sat down my consult went pretty easy, Natasha listened to what I wanted and was able to guide me into making a decision. She let me know what was going on step by step which I appreciated so much. And let me tell you my shampoo experience... GREAT... love my hair, love my cut, love the color!!! The place was very clean and very social distance friendly. Already can't wait for my next appt!!!

I've been going to Dr. Isaac for probably about 10 years now.  I have some challenging vision issues that means getting the best vision possible requires a bit of work, and I can say without hesitation that Dr. Isaac is the most caring, qualified, and professional doctor I have ever seen.  He doesn't brush you off if you have a problem, and instead gives careful analysis as to how to best help you see.  I know from experience that all eye doctors are not like this, and it is for that reason that I am (highly) recommending him here.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is for the prepared foods. I've observed that the food workers use their plastic gloves as a way for them not to get their hands dirty, the gloves are not for the protection of the food. I ordered a pizza and ended up walking out when once again I watched the person preparing the pizza touch everything, including walking through the store and grabbing corn meal off the self, returning back to the prep area and not change gloves. Then she literally dumped the corn meal into a container and started running her dirty gloved hand through the corn meal. They absolutely have no idea that the gloves are to keep the food from being contaminated.

This place has horrible staff, if you want to see people who truly hates their job and have no problem letting everyone know it, then this is the place for you. The food was ok but the staff was a constant drone of whining, sighing, and generally disrespecting every customer. They gave us coloring paper for our daughter but had no crayons. We asked for a booster seat that never came. We asked for a childs milk and was charged for a large. I hate to be nitpicky but this was among the worst dining experience i've ever had. Avoid this place at all cost.

I'll never use Avis again!
They up charged us on gas both coming and going.
We returned it full, after only traveling 20 miles after we filled the tank and then the charged us $20.00 to top it off. 
When we picked the car up it was suppose to be full but it was only 1/3 of a tank.  We tried contacted them with pictures of the gas Guage but they never answered the phone and we let it ring for 1/2 hour. 
When we finally got through the the main customer service,  they said they would check into it.
It's now been over a week and we haven't heard back from them.
They also gave us a dirty car.

Aside from the fish not being good, the service seems to keep declining. They took our order and brought out our soup, salad, edamame, rolls and sashimi at the same time. We were sitting at the sushi bar so why they thought that was appropriate is beyond us.  We've been going here for years and this service in combination with the low quality food  was bad enough for me to write a review a week later. After years of patronage, and in spite of this restaurant being the closest sushi restaurant to our home, we will never go back. We can spend $75 on dinner somewhere else and have a far better experience.

Due to family circumstances outside of our control (unexpected travel out-of-state and tending to the failing health of an 88-year-old mother), we were 3 days late in canceling our membership. Even though the yearly renewal deadline is still 4 days away, your "zero tolerance" requirement for either certified mail or on-site cancellation indicates that we will receive no consideration for these real-life circumstances. You give me no choice but to give your "remote control" fitness operation a FAILING GRADE - so much for your "judgment free" claims! BUYER BEWARE.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Vano's Pizza. Small family owned restaurant. Always fresh, delicious food. First a wonderful, friendly family that knows how to prepare food from  pizza to steak sandwiches and wonderful veal and chicken parmesan  platters. Unfortunately their are many sites showing incorrect prices on menus for their individual websites causing much confusion. My suggestion is to go to their personal website (Vanos Pizza.weebly.com and read the correct menu prices. I do not know how the other sites can list incorrect prices but it's wrong to hurt these folks and their restaurants reputation.  I would rate this 10 star if it was available.

From the smell of marijuana that's coming through my apartment, roaches all in my bathroom to the Loud freaking neighbor that's below me this has been the worst freaking day ever. I really hate that I re-signed a lease:( but thankful that it's only 10months but I will be giving my notice 6months in advance because it's seems that this apartment can not get anything right not even take control of people that's living here. I never in my life had so many problems with somewhere that I'm paying my money to live...something has to be done!!!

I recently purchased 3 like new dresses at a consignment shop, they looked clean, but smelled like Frabreeze, or possibly perfume. I took them to this dry cleaner so the odor could be removed. I picked them up today, and there's no difference. When I called to inquire if they used perfumes I was told that they can Guarantee the dresses are clean. As far as I'm concerned if the garment still has an odor then it's not clean.  I've taken other consignment clothing to other cleaners and the perfume odors have always been removed. As far as I know, all they did was put the garments on hangers.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
1. Pub - bottle of Michelob ultra and yuengling draft too waaay too long to order and receive (20min). Lots of tvs is a plus if you want to watch games and don't care how long it takes to get a beer.
2. Grill - was out of three sandwiches (cheesesteak, Rueben & Cuban ) 
3. Service - our server was great and polite - restaurants needed about 3 more of these guys 

Result - we left paying cash for our two beers for fear we would have to wait another 15 min to checkout with a credit card - went to another restaurant for food

First time in the new hilltop location. Definite upgrade, although not as intimate as at St. Philips. Outstanding service. 

Bread was amazing, and I am really fussy about bread. We sat in the main dining room between two pillars so the four of us could converse. All three of their locations have been noisy, so be aware of this ahead of time when reserving.

My wife and I split the lunch seafood soup. It was better than ever before, and we've eaten it often. Generous split portion, and excellent value.

It was raining (hooray) that day. On a typical sunny day the patio looks inviting. Will try it there next time. Well done, Vivace.

I had an extended warranty claim that was going to cost hardly anything. They keep writing me to get additional information. This has got to stop. If I was handling a claim and it cost less than $50.00 and it made sense. I would just pay it. I wouldn't spend anymore time on the claim as to it is not cost effective. The extended warranty that Chase is offering is worthless because they are not paying the claim. They want you to jump through hoops in order for them to pay the claim. Do not let them get away with this. Sue them for it otherwise they win. This is ridiculousness. I had a claim with American Express and never had any problems.

I visited on a Monday evening. The service was fast and overall friendly. I tried 3 rolls from the regular sushi menu - Philadelphia, spicy tuna, and yellow tail - but none of the specialty rolls. All were average quality, though the yellow tail was very bland and I was missing the spicy sauce that usually comes on a spicy tuna roll. 
Prices were excellent!  
I would try this place again knowing now that it's more of a fast food type place than a fancier Japanese restaurant. And I'd definitely try the specialty rolls instead.

I was very hesitant to try a new sushi place as I only go to Aragato and Sakana here in town.  I live here now but am from Los Angeles originally. LA does not have a lack of good sushi.  Unfortunately Santa Barbra has limited choices. This place had fresh sushi.  The uni was the perfect color.  I also had the Salmon 6 piece taster...perfect!  It was a little on the prices side, but what good sushi in Santa Barbra is it?!?! I would definitely come back and recommend this place to anyone that is a sushi connoisseur.

So a little after 6PM today, I went to this Dunkin Donut in order to use the Valentine's Day free coffee coupon. The lady behind the counter told me "it is after 6, it is no more" and will not let me use that coupon... I went to another DD nearby in order to try to use that coupon and the guy there gave it to me...so there is no time limit and can still be used as long as it's still 02/10. The coupon doesn't even say there is a time limit and 6pm sounds like a pretty normal time to me. This is so unreasonable.... if they ever refuse to give you something because it now a certain time but still within eligible date, DO NOT believe them.

The restaurant did not honor the promotion or the internet price!  Went there to notice thevredturant is not clean, not busy, the delivery truck outside the restaurant was dirty and full of trash and it was rusty!
The food is not that tasty at all! The chicken was burned, and the stake on the pizza looks like shaving thin paper!!!
The bottom line, not clean, price is high, food is not that good. I was disappointed with the food, service, and price. 
Look for another place, or get $7 pizza from one of the large pizza places.

Honestly have had a pretty terrible experience as far as my black card membership goes. Horrible communication. Horrible service over the phone. There have been a couple of employees that were nice and welcoming, but there is one woman there that is very unpleasant almost every time I go. Never got a tour of the place, never got my black card membership bag or whatever they're suppose to give you so I had to ask for it. The facility is nice and it's not ever full when I would go in the mornings, but that's about all the nice I can say about it. Big mistake and a waste of my money for an entire year.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I stopped going here for a while because my last pedicure was painful. I decided to try it again, and this time, my pedicure was good. In a crunch, I let the girl wax my eyebrows. The wax was too hot and she rushed through it. I didn't feel as if I could tel her because the WHOLE TIME, she was talking to her coworkers. She waxed my eyebrows extremely thin and took a chunk out of one. That's the last time I give them business. Hopefully they can read this and maybe think about doing some type of customer service education for their staff.

Why why why do  restaurants change their way of doing business after customers have fallen in love with them and are loyal?  Like  changing the salsa and chips to save money reducing the guacamole pot size? ... No longer having an extra taco on the Taco Pastor... All these little things add up to just annoying loyal customers who have come to expect it to be one step above the rest... Anyways the food is usually very good, The service can be a bit slow but they are lovely staff, but the little things you have been knocked down a peg as Mexico Lindo does not stand out above the competition anymore.

LIARS. They straight up lie to you and steal your money. Read the fine print they swipe quickly through on the ipad when signing you up for a membership because they are SCAMMERS. Was told the membership was month to month, then told no it's for a year. NOW AFTER A YEAR AND SEVERAL MONTHS I AM STILL BEING CHARGED. All after trying to cancel for over 8 months. I would not recommend this gym to anyone. They have minimal and outdated equipment, there are many nicer gyms in the area. The customer service is some of the worst I have ever experienced in my life - Rich D'Antonio deserves to not only be fired but a good slap across the face.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: My eyeglasses from a previous visit to a competitors facility never seemed right.  My experience was so bad I didn't want to go back, and decided to try contacts instead at Stanton Optical.  I was greeted and helped as soon as I stepped foot in the door.  The in-office music wasn't half bad, and that made the short wait time enjoyable.  Everyone I interacted with here were professional.  The prescription from their competitor was way off, which is why I really couldn't see with the eyeglasses, but with Stanton Optical I was given the correct prescription and contacts that are extremely comfortable to wear.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Omakase is my favorite way to enjoy sushi and I have experienced it at numerous places in many cities. Sakana makes for an absolutely amazing and authentic omakase experience. Their renovation is gorgeous and perfects the experience. The chefs are extremely skillful, the quality of the fish is superb, the rice is amazing (super key!) and the BYO is a super nice touch. Great customer service - the servers are so kind and the chefs interact with the guests in such a nice way. We are returning for our third time this week!!

Just moved to Riverview and this is only my second time using service. Clothes were dropped off in time to be picked up when needed, 2 suits were delivered to the wrong store. I drove to the other location to pick them up and received 20% discount for my inconvenience. My time is worth much more than 20% for an error on your company's part now I'm stuck in rush hour having to go pick up my clothes. 
It seems your company is much less organized than other cleaners I've been to, I think I'll drive to a familiar company going forward. Only reason receiving. 2 is because the lady was very helpful behind the desk.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Pros:
The staff was always courteous and kind. They even had someone in the front of the building greeting and ensuring guests had their masks on. Very helpful to give us restaurant recommendations when requested. 
Cons:
The bartenders were way overwhelmed. I ordered a martini and the bartender said I have to get a glass and literally walked out of the bar and didn't return for 10 mins! 
The room was starting to show signs of wear. The bathroom tile grout looked dingy. 
The coffee shop because of Covid was laid out pretty odd.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Never again... will I step foot in this rip off place. The lady with the blonde hair originally told me that she would charge me $15 In order to replace a simple zipper on a skirt. I get there and there is someone else ( a younger guy with pierce nose, tattoos) and he charges me $25 and came up with some bullshit excuse that my zipper was a " special kind" of zipper.  I am just sick of this poor inconsistent customer service. When you quote a price, mean it. For the damn price that they charged me, I could have just gone and bought a new skirt.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I really really wanted to give them 5 stars, used to be my go to place ... stopped going since the prices got so high and food went downhill awhile back before Covid  ...  tried it out again today ... my daughters burger was amazing ... fries were good, prices too high still.l thought ... 12.99 for a burger and then fries are 5 bucks extra for a basket ... my prime rib sandwich was good, just not amazing ... we'll try again, I love that they are local ... my daughter's burger was huge and very good ... can't wait to try their wings again ... might check out Thursday burger night too

Their spicy mustard is different and weird. My husband threw away his shrimp and noodles after one bite. It was slimy and tasted gross. The crunchy roll had avocado (it normally doesn't) and he does not eat avocado so he couldn't eat his roll either. The salmon tasted very very fishy. Our "salad" was lettuce and a single tomato. Now I remember why we don't eat there and have to go into the city when we want sushi. Giving two stars because although he couldn't eat the crunchy roll, it was the only one (of three) that I actually liked. Spent $30 and half of it was thrown away.

This salon delivers a cozy artsy charm and kick-ass hairdressing expertise. The salon is privately situated behind the chaos of State Street with convenient parking, which is a great plus. I only trust stylist Cindy Renga with my hair! I've been living in Los Angeles and will make a special trip to Santa Barbara just so I can go to Cindy. Whether I want a bold color or cut she always brings my vision to fruition. Renga is a true artist and projectionist, she will go to great lengths to assure her client is happy.

I have traveled half the world and this was worse that most. Shower backed up and they send a maid to the room with a plunger for the shower drain. She literally tried to use a plunger through a mesh drain. They move me to the next room where the staff slams drawers and doors all night long while they are laughing with each other. I guess they realized that they were keeping me up since I had started to turn up the TV since there was no chance that sleep would be gained from the noise that they were making. I think the park bench outside would have been more peaceful than this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Nastiest, rudest, most unhappy workers I have ever seen. Everyone running around but no one leading. Show some customer service. Pre Ordered donuts but still waited in line for 20 minutes because, on a busy Friday, they only had one person at the register. She was unhappy and even rolled her eyes at customers when they gave their orders. She was furious with me for using Krispy Kreme gift cards. Seriously? I will NEVER give them my business again. Lots of other options with better donuts in my opinion. Learn some customer service skills!!!!

Poorer experience tonight. Ordered a meal by number and description in the menu. A5 chicken on a stick. I got A5 boneless ribs. Clerk repeated it back to me but I could not understand her and my fault for not double checking then and before i walked out. The boneless ribs were fatty and dry and in an unappealing cherry red sauce. So yeah probably my fault on the order, but what I got was pretty bad. Also got shrimp and vegetables again which were ok but not much flavor.  Vegetables stir fried and crispy as I like. The sauce was just pretty bland. The place was very busy. The clerks were keeping up and the orders were moving.

In my opinion Sakura has the best sushi in Bensalem! If I haven't had sushi in a bit I always have to come by and pickup some rolls. My all-time favorites are the spicy crab roll, spicy tuna roll, black angel roll, rainbow roll, spicy girl roll, and their halo jalapeño appetizer! Alongside their sushi, they make great hibachi for those who aren't into sushi as much. I think it says something when my sister who never even liked sushi before ate here and fell in love with the spicy crab roll. Never forget the side of spicy mayo!

If I could rate it a ZERO I would!  We were told we had a non smoking room.  The room smelled so badly of cigarettes.  There were burn holes in the carpets.  We were moving out of our house and needed a bed to sleep in before we hit the road on our 17 hr drive to our destination so we sucked it up but this place is awful.  I slept with my hood over my head because I didn't feel putting my head on the pillow was clean.  Long pants, long sleeves, a hoodie and socks to completely cover my body in bed.  I can not believe that a large corporation puts their stamp of approval on this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've gotten two gel manicures from Sami, and they have been the best gel manicures I EVER have had.  They each lasted 3+ weeks with no chipping, the top coat remained perfectly smooth and shiny- I am still in disbelief.  When I went a second time, Sami remembered details from my life and asked me about them- she is so thoughtful! She takes her time and is an artist.  Last time she put a tip on my broken index finger's nail, my first experience with any type of fake nail, and it looks amazing.  It hasn't budged or lifted at all.  She is a magician!

I'd like to thank pfcu for always supporting me in my endeavors and providing the proper resources to assist me. I would also like to personally thank Diane Bergen and Danielle Cook. These two ladies are a true asset to pfcu and exhibited the ultimate professionalism, courtesy, and patience to assist me while we navigated through some challenges during the process. I truly hope that pfcu recognize these two individuals and go above and beyond for them as they have for me. It is because of people like this that keeps me banking with pfcu.

The vehicle I recently rented smelled like the Marlboro Man took a cross country trip failing to abide by your no smoking policy. There was even a cigarette burn in the passenger side arm rest. Being a former smoker myself I was totally put off by the amount of residual nicotine smell coating everything. Had we not gotten in so late, during a snow storm, we would have asked for another vehicle. We were leaving immediately for my sons graduation from boot camp at Fort Leonard Wood, which was a two hour trip from St. Louis.
I emailed Hertz upon my arrival home and have received no response.

The Hilton Santa Barbara finally, received a much needed remodel.  The Hilton rooms are much better compared to five years ago, newly remodeled rooms.  The staff at the restaurant was great.  However, other hotel staff (front desk and housekeeping) the staff seems disgruntled, unhappy, with fake smiles.  Not sure why?  Santa Barbara is a beautiful area to work.  I did observe a job fair taking place during my stay.  Anyway, at this time it is 3 stars, average.  The management team and staff members need to change and do better taking care of the hotel guests.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place barely makes a 2 star.  The ventilation system is horrible and EVERYTHING is damp.  Showers have mold. Hot tub has been broken for weeks. When we arrived, the sliding door was open to our room.  This just added to the dampness in our room.  We stayed here a week ago and was promised the hot tub would be fixed.  At that stay EVERYONE was kicked out of the pool/game area at 10pm.  Last night the people were still in there at 11.  The hotel staff is very passive and has no answers and no eye contact.  The 5 of us were very disappointed. This place is an embarrassment to the Wymdham name.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Superb!! Quality sushi, incredibly fast service, friendly staff. I've read on here complaints about the "rudeness" of the staff. Hogwash. East Asians tend to be reserved, not the gushy emotive types Americans seem to expect everywhere they go. This is nothing more than a cultural difference. (On the same note, does the average American even know that the sushi restaurants around here are owned and operated by Chinese? How's that for a cultural lesson?) I love sushi, and this is the BEST sushi restaurant in the Philadelphia area. Your want fancy atmosphere and exaggerated prices, sure you can go elsewhere. But I'm going back to Sushi Kingdom.

Ive gone in here at least twice a week for the last year now and recently the customer service has gotten terrible, I went in with my friend and it was only us two in the store it took about 20 minutes to get are orders and the girl taking our orders in a grey and pink hoodie didn't say was a single word we just had to tell her what she wanted and she ended up getting my order wrong anyway and when I told her I wanted the other topping she still didn't say a word and just put them both. I noticed a week ago when I went in they had some new staff they were very nice, I would like to see more of them

This has become our go to place in N. Wilmington.  If fact, I almost hate to recommend it becuase hidden away, in the corner, so to speak, it is usually not over crowded.  We love to sit at the bar and enjoy some wine, and simple, well thought out and well prepared meal.  We drive by  11 "dining" chain restaurants to get there, and at the bar or table, we have never been dissapointed.  If I had one suggestion, it woulld be to bring in a nudge higher cabernet to add to the wine list, even if it were bottle only.

Went there on 3/27/2014 at 5:59 AM. The Hashbrowns we ordered were cold, so I went inside thinking it wouldnt be an issue to get them redone for my girlfriend. I guess it was bc when I was driving off and bit into them, there was a black mans pubic hair tucked under the hashbrown sleeve. My worst fear has finally come true after 25 years of being a McDonalds customer. I knew there was a problem when the guy ignored me when I thanked him twice.

STAY AWAY FROM THIS MCDONALDS.

I cannot believe someone would ever violate someones food just bc they wanted it to be hotter. I WASNT EVEN RUDE ABOUT IT. i thanked him twice.

disgusted...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Just visited this past Sunday

As expected we were all pleased
I brought a party of four and we all had different entree's . We wanted and early dinner and we're seated immediately. When we left it was busy because it's a good stop. 

My steak was perfection  and I always enjoy the
House Salads My guests loved the quaint atmosphere  and the comments on the seafood were all good. 

Keep it up guys  we'll be back ! 

One of our favorite local restaurants and we enjoy it so much because the owners care and want you to be happy and their food is exceptional.
BobM

Went to get a couple dozen donuts there yesterday. 

They had NOT A SINGLE DONUT at 2 pm in the afternoon. Nada. None. Zilch.  

And from what the staff said - this is a regular occurrence!  

Seriously, you're a donut shop, with some add-on items - but your business name has the word donuts in it.   

But don't worry about us or the people we were planning to treat to donuts - we managed - we found another Dunkin Donuts that manages their inventory better.  

Guess what - you might be the closest DD shop to my home, but you're not going to be my go-to location.

I usually shy away from national chain restaurants. But in this case I'll make an exception. We stopped in for dinner on a recent weekend night. It was a great experience. Greeted promptly at the front door by a hostess and led to our table.  Our server was efficient, friendly, and fast. Try the fried mozzarella appetizer. The chicken marsala was great, perfectly cooked and seasoned just right. The lobster ravioli was awesome, with huge chunks of lobster meat. Did not have dessert, but they all looked great.
Bertucci's definitely stands out among the national casual restaurant chains. We'll be back.

If I could only give this place zero stars! Completely rude!!  I asked to talk to the manager and it turned out the rude ass person I was talking to was the manager!! He did not believe I had a reservation and was very sexists when my fiancé walked in! His total demeanor and attitude changed the moment he found out I had someone with me in my reservation! He even declined to look at my receipt along with my reservation. More than 100% DO NOT RECOMMEND! They need to learn some common decency and RESPECT!!  #imgoingtobeakarenonthisone!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've been coming here for 4 years and I love the spot. Gilbert cuts my hair every time and he's one of the most genuinely kind and professionally competent people I've met. 
The men's haircuts are $18, and if I want a technical haircut like a fade or a hard part, Gilbert will take his sweet time to make sure I leave 100% satisfied with how my hair looks. 
Listen, I never leave Yelp reviews, but this is a local, family owned business with good people and great service. Come here if you want a quality haircut by a friendly barber at a very fair price.

Note:
This is NOT Sonoran cooking but one of only a few good things to come here from SoCal - definitely SoCal BajaFresh greasy cooking but still pleasantly good.

Update 1/19/19
I used to use the drive thru but after a bout of eruptive gastro distress, I decided to order inside. 
The guy cooking behind the window is sitting there wiping his face and nose (sweat?) with his hands and then goes back to making my burrito. Seriously, he couldn't use a towel or wash his hands afterwards?
I tossed it in the trash and won't be visiting anytime soon....

What is it with these people?

Two years ago I took my difficult cat here for a leg injury and they were great. However, they really try to gouge you with expensive tests. She had a pulled muscle $300 later. The same thing happened the next two times. I had very young, new vets. Their first "jump-to" again was tests totaling almost $600. Neither time was my pet cured of anything. What has happened to compassion and experienced intuition? I am actively seeking an older vet who uses their years of familiarity with animal health and make the pet's comfort and well-being the priority, not fleecing the pet parents for everything they're worth.

We were there in the beginning of September for one week. 
The rooms were clean and the staff was friendly. They got a nice workout room with basic workout tools and a nice pool and hot tub outside. The pool area was always clean, and they were open till 11pm at night which was great. The breakfast was alright nothing too fancy. 
Their stuff was nice and really helpful.
The Clearwater beach is like 20 minutes away (with the car). Next to the hotel is a small park, nothing adventures but good enough to go for a short walk.  
It was also easy to get from the Airport to the hotel (or back). 
I'd stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very poorly served. Three diners and food came one item for one person followed by another item second person moments later and one person not getting any food until other diners finished eating. No checking table for beverage refills. Very bad when other patrons, who came after us, were getting food before us. Food was okay, nothing special, but entire experience ruined by poor service and lackadaisical attitude of the issue by staff.  At least the bill came and they did not charge for two dinners. Could have better acknowledged mistake and advised he was not charging as amens.

Staff barely speak English. The endless sounds like a good deal but it's really not the quality of the food is pretty low and had no flavor. Our hibachi cook started cutting up little pieces of broccoli and tossing it up at people to catch in their mouth which was funny at first. But it was excessive went through 3-4 people, threw it at me I said no and dodged it. On top of that they added 18% tip into the bill (I usually tip 20%) without any option which I just don't like not having the option. Brining food out was disorganized and slow. Ice cream was good though.

I don't know if its the locations fault or higher management, but it seems the news ordering kiosk thing menu doesn't match what is actually available on the restaurant menu.  For instance, I wanted a side salad, and a fruit and yogurt parfait, and for all the searching I did,  i gave up and ordered at the counter, which they seemed to resent.  Face it, the orderings kiosk is not that intuitive, and it takes awhile to figure out and I am a person knowledgeable and comfortable with computers.  If I could order without dealing with a pouting teenager i would, but it was impossible.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We have been going to this restaurant for over 5 years.  It has what we nickname "box glop."  A lot of dishes are not freshly made. But once in a while we get a good one. We have had good pizza delivery and terrible pizza.  Seems like only good to great food is when the owner cooks ..... But you never know when that is.  Why do we continue to go there? Only on those occasional nights when we are too tired to cook and feel like Italian food. Our expectations are not high, so we are not disappointed when we get so so food but we are thrilled if we happen on a good night or pick a dish they ace freshly made.

I absolutely love sushi but this place made me and my entirely family gag. The raw fish rolls stank like old fish. Raw fish should not have a flavor. My sister had to spit it out. The ginger salad was soaking wet with dressing. All of the soups were cold. The clear onion soup literally had soggy fried french onion that you put on top of green bean casserole. Who does that? The tea smelled like chlorine water. By far one of the worst sushi places I have ever been to in my entire life, not an exaggeration unfortunately.  Don't waste your money here. Service is also terrible and slow and there's barely any people at the restaurant.

Two people can't split the 2-for-1 happy hour margarita...a fact not shared until after you get your first order. 

We got food to-go and the bartender forgot our chips and salsa while we waited and wouldn't settle our bill until the food came out, delaying our departure and forcing us to reheat our food when we got home. 

The Carne Guisada is spicy with a generous portion of tender meat. The Mexico City Enchiladas were tasty but not made as requested which reduced enjoyment. 

Overall we will give them another shot but it might be a while.

Reminds me of renting in a corrupt third world country.... Avoid unless you have additional hours to spend, unlimited $$$ for all excess addon and hidden charges, want limited mileage caps if you are in state, only plan to travel in state (going out of state is prohibited), want to pay additional $500-1000 deposit, are prepared to videotape/photograph every single dent or scratch on the vehicle....You get the picture. Stick with one of the known major car rental brands. There is absolutely no savings to be had here, you will end up with migraines and paying a LOT more than you thought you were saving.

I went in for a gel acrylic fill. This is what my nails looked like AFTER  I walked out of the building. They are great people but rush doing their service in order to keep other customers from leaving. I returned to get my nails fixed two days later and I was told to come back a few hours later. When I returned a few hours later, two people were helped before me. I waited for over an hour to get my nails fixed. I was told that I could not get a refund. I won't be returning. Do your self a favor and only use their services on days when they are not busy and have no other customers.

I went for the first time today to drop off a lap blanket that requires dry cleaning.  I fully expected to pay $2.99 which is what I thought was advertised.  My lap blanket is costing me $10 and won't be ready until Wednesday.  I was getting into it with the person I thought was the manager and told him I felt totally ripped off since it appears everything is $2.99.  I don't know if he actually heard what I was saying because the music was ridiculously loud.  I left the blanket as I don't know where other cleaners are.  My fingers are crossed.  Luckily I don't own anything that needs to be dry cleaned other than this blanket.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I've been a loyal customer ($24.99 member) for a while now but along with the unrinsed soap & water spots on my back window, it's time for Metro to go. The lack of energy & pride in the employees work ethic (specifically the pressure washers in the tunnel) is disgraceful. Next time you are there, take notice how they hold the pressure guns. It's like senior citizens fresh out of viagra. There's no drive & it's us the customer that pays, both, figuratively & financially. Poor teamwork is a direct failure of poor leadership. So who is really to blame?

Decided to try the new garlic and parm crust while it was a $10 special. My friend was in the mood for breadsticks so I added those as a $6 plus some extra sauces. The pizza was weird and there was nothing special about the crust. It was pretty flavorless just tasted funky. We each only had one slice before throwing it out. The bread sticks came in very amusing shapes (see picture) but tasted fine. The delivery guy was nice and did his best to get the food to us (he was confused as to which resident hall we were in). I would've tried to call and get my money back but I used my $10 reward coupon so it seemed pointless.

Dr Newman is the BEST VET i have ever been to. (his staff and his wife at the front desk are also amazing! they clearlyyy care!!)   If you love your pet and DONT want to get ripped off go to Care animal hospital.  My dog Rocky is an 11 year old boxer and has seizures.  Rocky is my baby and its so clear that Dr Newman cares about animals.  He even wrote a book about loss of a loved dog !! "Meet me at the rainbow bridge"!!!!!  I am a physician so i have a different insight into healthcare and i can tell you Dr Newman is the only one i trust.

It was alright. I ordered steamed dumplings, chicken fried rice, and egg rolls with a boba tea. I have nothing to really complain about, per se, but nothing to really rave about either. It was just... average.

Even though I didn't really order anything too adventurous, I was still surprised by how bland the fried rice and the dumplings were. I pretty much had to drown everything in sweet & sour and soy sauce. The bubble tea was delicious, but you can't really mess something like that up.

Overall, I probably won't go out of my way to go here again like I did this time around.

Horrific!!   I reserved a room with two queen beds through Expedia.  Checked in, got to the room about 7pm, and found a king bed in the room. 3 adults.  What do to?  I called the front desk and they had no queen rooms left!  Apparently someone at front desk tried to upgrade my room to a deluxe but paid no attention to my booking.  Aarghh!   Marriott, I'm so disappointed as a rewards member, and will be dropping you.  Courtyard, never again.  Expedia, you really can't do anything at all???  Travelocity here I come, Hilton here I come.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We took my parents who came to visit us from California on a Saturday night. Unless you can find street parking, parking will cost you $16. Luckily when we got there the wait was about 5 minutes. It's a small sushi restaurant and we were seated in the back. They have a variety of speciality rolls as well as traditional ones. The miso soup was a little salty and the fish wasn't as fresh but also wasn't bad either. However I would much rather eat here any other sushi places in Nashville to fill my sushi needs.

Typically don't go to Starbucks, would prefer supporting local businesses. However, I received a gift card and needed some cold brew this last Sunday. Ordered 2 plain cold brew coffees, there were a ton of people waiting for drinks. The place was total chaos. Essentially only 1 person making drinks and multiple people standing around. I ended up waiting 20 minutes and when I asked about my order the cashier said I have 10 drinks ahead of mine. I walked out without my coffees and went to Nola beans. This Starbucks needs to add people or train employees to handle the busy times. No plans on coming back.

We stayed here for 8 nights the week before labor day. And being there that long the guys working the front never spoke more than 3 words if that. Never asked how our stay was or anything. They fail to tell you that the elevator is too small to carry your bags up unless you do it one bag at a time. The room was nice but the bathroom sink did not drain well. The a/c cord had been spliced and had bare wires showing. Bed was comfortable. Friendliness of the staff sucked. Will not be staying here again and wouldn't recommend this hotel to anyone.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Initially walking in waiter was rude.  Service got better and food was good. Had chicken parm.  Waiter presented check which was1/3 what it should have been. Wait staff not paying attention to details.  Left decent tip off of discounted bill. Left with my date. Then manager comes running down the street yelling that we underpaid. Explained to manager his was his problem , not ours.  Being chased down the street was unacceptable and embarrassing. Ended up paying $10 more than we should have because i was ambushed on street and manager demanded money.  Is that how to treat a customer??  Wont be returning and I hope you wont spend money here.

The location was convenient to the Convention Center. The upper floors have renovated rooms which are pleasant. The old rooms feel dated (thus, the renovation). I am sure when they get done with (major) renovations it will be better but things kind of felt like a wreck, with a makeshift "lobby" on the 18th floor, water outages related to the renovations, flickering lights, etc. The price was lower than other places around town and again, the location is nice. You just may want to wait until the renovations are over.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My family and I frequent this little place often.  I'm sad to say the quality of the food is definitely slipping down hill.  And the service is def hit or miss, much more on the miss side now.  We had a rather unpleasant experience with the bar tender / waitress this week. She "schooled" me on a dish I've been ordering for my son for about a year now.  I often wonder why waitress forget they work for tips...anyway that sealed the deal, we can find our authentic Mexican food at one of the other billion little quaint joints Philadelphia boasts of.

This "dry cleaners' is the absolute worse place ever! They do not clean anything, and I gave them 3 chances to actually clean my clothes. They 
give you your clothes back with a note stating that the stain was not
able to be removed! DO NOT take your clothes there! The manager
is sooo rude to his customers also! One star is WAY to much! My clothes
look exactly the same as when I brought them in!  I'm not even sure they
have actual cleaning supplies. They put them in the dryer and hang them 
up and that's it! Very frustrating to bring my clothes home and still have
to take them to the laundromat or another cleaners! Cleaners, HA!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Went there yesterday. The line was wrapped around the building. When you got to the speaker it was broke.  Had loose leg paper telling you that. Finally when we got to the window there was 3 young ladies all in the same area talking and laughing. I said you know you have a line around the building and of course received  a young ladies attitude stated they were aware. Well if they were aware why in the heck they were holding up everyone. If this is the only type of workers The owner can get. He should close it down. These young ladies were very much rude.  This business is being falling apart due to worker such as this.

Great lunch spot.  Really fast service with proper covid protocols.  It's an online based order, which was faster and more sanitary than a lot of places.  I really hope this lasts.  The margarita is amazing, love all the fresh lime juice in it.  The tacos are great, and they have the option of doing them on lettuce which is not common.  I'm not a fan of cilantro, but they were able to easily remove it for me.  Lastly the chicken soup is a hidden gem, I actually had to get some to go, I was so impressed with it.

How this restaurant gets anything but 5 stars is beyond me. My wife and I finally tried it after driving by it numerous times and commenting that we should every time we did. Itzianna was our waitress and she was a delight. She came to us within seconds of us being seated with chips and salsa and was very pleasant. She even brought us an extra salsa that had more spice when we asked if there was a hotter one. I had the steak campirano and my wife had fish tacos. Both dishes were way more than we could eat, cooked perfectly and couldn't have tasted better. Great restaurant and we look forward to our next meal here.

This was the second time that we tried Babe's. The first was when we got the double decker, which was way too much grease for us. It just wasn't impressive & made me feel sick afterwards. This is expected considering its two pizzas stacked on top of each other. This time I was still disappointed. It was much better than the double decker, but it still lacked a wow factor. We got a single pepperoni pizza. It seemed dry, & the crust was way too flat & hard. It was like a hard saltine cracker. The garlic cheese bread was good. If you like very strong garlic, you will enjoy it. Overall, this place seems average to me with nothing overly exciting.

Awful awful awful. My friend lucked out in a corner room with double beds, which was spacious and had light. Any other room is like a prison cell. My room smelled, dirty carpets, hair and dirt all over the bathroom and bathtub. Terrible bed, lumpy hard mattress, gave me back pain. One narrow vertical window which opens into the middle pool area- so, no sunlight, and incredibly noisy by 8am with kids yelling in the pool. The staff was very sweet about it-- I left two days into a week long reservation and they cancelled the rest of the charges.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: On my initial call to the salon I spoke with my stylist Toca and I knew she would be good, just didn't know how good! This is a cool comfy stylish loft and the girls are friendly. I've spent a fortune on salons from Clayton to Chicago and Miami and this place delivered with the best of them without the sky high price. My cut is beautiful, the color perfect from hue to being super shiny and the blow out is beautiful. This salon is in a very convenient downtown location and they offer all services at reasonable rates.  I will be back, I love my new do Thank you

10 of us decided to brave the cold on foot to see Christmas in the Oaks at City Park.  First we stopped to fortify ourselves with some hot chocolate, cafe au lait  and of course Beignets!  Bring you vax card or you won't get in!  The beignets were freshly made, still hot, great!  The coffee was rather lait au cafe!rather strong.  Due to the shortage of servers, ask for everything with your order.  Including water!  If you're able to lower your expectations from three years ago... you'll enjoy it this time around.

Had some pesky leaking problem with my car for over a year and no one seemed to nail it.  Chad at Midas was running an oil change special and I stopped in.  When handling that, he noticed the leaks, showed me what was happening in several areas.  After a generous discount on estimated services I agreed to do it.  While it did take longer than expected (2 days became 6), IT WAS FIXED with NO further problems.   The most important thing to me was the quality of the work, not the time.  Chad's team delivered and I will be back!  Finding a good team can be difficult, so I'll keep this one on my side.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I have been eating Wendy's chicken strips for lunch several times a week since they have been introduced. I have also noticed that they are slowly getting smaller and smaller. The strips are good and they're awesome sauce is great but just wondering how long it will be before the chicken strips turn into nuggets. (The pepper package is a reference to show their actual size) I have also noticed that there is a woman parked in one of the 2 handicapped spots without a handicap plate and she is there every time I come to Wendy's just sitting in her van.

First, the food: Best sushi I have ever had. Fresh; delicious; properly seasoned; ingredients artfully prepared and assembled. Good presentation. Fair pricing for the area--worth every cent for the quality and taste. The lobster salad on the roll we ordered really tasted like lobster (unlike most places). Nice variety on the menu. Not just blah green tea--gunpowder. Second, the ambiance: Awesome decor. The sushi bar has skylights and is decorated to feel like a courtyard. Pretty cool. Good service too! Highly recommend.

I just ordered food from here and it was COLD!!!!! I called and informed the staff. The man I spoke with was so nice and apologetic, but he did not offer to bring new food or any reimbursement. He offered a 10% discount on my next order. I'm really not a Karen, but I honestly don't think it would have been that difficult to reimburse/bring new food. 

In addition, I heated up the cold $40 food and it was genuinely terrible. Clearly all frozen and not fresh. Do your wallet and palate a favor next time and just and grab a Tostinos from Kroger. You'll save $39 and won't be disappointed.

I love checking out new places, especially ones that look so promising from the outside. The inside decor was promising as well - a sophisticated decor fit of an independent high-end pizzeria. 
I decided to play it very safe, and ordered a cheese pizza. 
Well, what I got was an average minus pizza, the kind you get from low-end pizzerias that try to compete with the big chains by offering a pizza lunch buffet - we have several of those in town, so you must know what I mean.
What a waste of a great location and decor.

Great prices.  Great, friendly service.  
Average food.  Usually a wait (due to many customers, not slow service).  

It's a pretty good place.  And your money is way better spent here than at McDonald's or other fast-food joint.  

However, I'll never understand the elation Californians feel when they see that another In-N-Out is opening somewhere else.  

Best burger for the price, absolutely.  But if I really want a burger and fries, its well worth it to cough up the extra $5 for Graze or Guys...

While I don't have a specific criticism of the burgers, I do find the fries to be rather bland.

The first time I went, I wasn't that impressed. But then I had the carne asada, and I've been hooked ever since! I had to go back two days later and get it again, it was so good! It's by far the most flavorful carne asada I've ever had. And you get a lot of it, along with two sides of your choice, and guacamole  and pico de gallo, which ate both delicious. And the wait staff, especially Rosa, is very friendly, very helpful, and want you to have a good time. They are as accommodating of a table of 20 as they are of a table of one. Give it a try. There's so much to choose from you won't be disappointed.

I've been coming here for years and always enjoy the food. On my most recent visit we had an overzealous wait staff that constantly asked if we were finished or wanted to-go containers while we were in the middle of our meals. After being asked this a fourth time in the matter of minutes (while we were literally twirling spaghetti into forks), we gave in to the pressure, got a to-go container and paid the check. We had planned to have dessert but didn't want to be rushed through that as well. It was an awkward and disappointing experience. I'll probably be taking a break from Ralph's for a while.

Terrible service. Ordered online direct from their website. Received confirmation and when I went to pick up order they said it was never received. Woman said she heard fax but it was getting the orders. She didn't even offer to take my order. She said they were slammed and left it at that. I would have expected them to offer something instead my family waited a lot longer for me to find some dinner. Who relies on fax? I received an email confirming my order, why wouldn't a business get an email with orders as backup.

I started going here since I moved to New Jersey. They helped me through the most scary part of my puppies life- when he got parvo. Dr Lach explained everything to me and was there no matter when I needed my questions answered. She always reassured me and has great bed side manner. She is kind and compassionate. My puppy loves all the staff members there. He struggled his last visit there due to his hospitalization but staff was accommodating and reassuring. I also can pick up medications with ease. Dr Lach and her staff are amazing

It was just okay
I thought it was a little pricey
When they moved , they left behind the quaintness that set them apart
I think the food quality dropped a bit, but what really fell off was the service
Not that it was bad. It just seemed very corporate and antiseptic 
I understand that there are no career waiters here, and turnover probably haunts every restaurant like this 
But you can either be a hometown pizza joint,, or a big corporate restaurant 
But not both.  And when you play both ends against the middle, the middle usually wins

Came here a few weeks back and got my haircut with josh. Josh is a friendly guy and was very professional and cordial. He ended up charging me $20 and took his time to blend in my skinfade. I went by today to hopefully see him and got my haircut by the blonde lady. I didn't catch her name but she did not do a very good job and also seemed rushed. I saw josh was still cutting a customers hair and he was there before I got there. She did not pay attention to the details of a skin-fade and I was left with a very poor blend and She charged me $25. I am generally fair and consistent but I call it like I see it. I would not go back.

I've rarely had such a  negative experience with a veterinary clinic, and the vet in particular ~ as an animal lover and former foster parent of more than 50 cats/dogs, I don't say that lightly. This vet could hardly be bothered to lay her hands on my beautiful senior German Shepherd, basically saying of my dog, old age "is her new normal". It took nearly 3 weeks for a signature on a Chewy.com prescription, despite repeated attempts by dedicated Chewy staff. When I called about it, I got a lot of "attitude" from front desk staff. Absolutely DONE with this place.

So close to home, yet so unpredictable.  Sure, the lines are long and workers seem to have one slow pace.  But the worst is when they don't get the coffee order correct.  Now I just ask for black coffee with creamers on the side.  How can you mess that up? Well, pour the creamer in your coffee and you'll find out.  It will curdle!  Long after you pull out of line, of course.  This happens too often, and only at this location.  What causes curdle?  Older creamers!  It may or may not be safe to drink.  But it sure does not look appealing.  Not to worry, there's a WAWA nearby.

I've been in Tucson for nearly 8 months now, and within those 8 months my Civic has been wonderfully cared for at Sooters Auto. They offer competitive pricing with mom & pop service. They're willing to do whatever they can in order to fix what needs to be fixed, and sometimes they'll do it for nothing out of your pocket. They genuinely care. 

This is the one place I'm willing to hand my car over to with no bad feeling in my stomach. I have absolutely no issue giving my money to Kim and her crew, they deserve every penny for the hard work and service they provide every single time I step into their shop.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We do not feel the same about the bad reviews. I read them and I was worried but everything turned out great. The server was very attentive & personable. The food was great we all had something different and we we tried each others. All of it was good. I would recommend this restaurant highly, the chicken dishes were tender and delicious with the right amount of sauce. The shrimp were large and tasty. The wine was very good. The tables are a little close together and it gets noisy but over all a good place to go.

Ordered delivery from Ho King and they appear to have really stepped up their game. The Moo Goo Gai Pan had chicken breast that was thinly sliced, flavorful, and MOIST. So many places over cook their chicken breast and it ends up dry and rubbery.   Not so here. Their spring rolls had big chunks of shrimp and were not greasy. House special fried rice also had large shrimp pieces that were cooked just right. Perfect dinner for two on a weeknight. Delivery was fast! Thanks, Ho King, for being a great go-to place when we don't feel like cooking.

People should know, by now, that coupons and 'deals', are to get you, in the door.
Then comes the , up-sell. 
You need to read your owners manual, and learn what your car really needs, before you go in the door.
That way you can defend yourself, when they  try to sell you the more expense oil, or some kind of fluid flush. etc.etc.
The store on Oracle, is the worst.  Twice, they told me my battery needed replacing, when it didn't. Sunrise/Swan, is a little better.
Make an appointment, it will cut down on the wait time.
Don't be afraid to say, No Thank You.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The only good thing I have to say is the employees were kind, and that it is the closest one to my house. Other than that, the price for alterations are higher than other ones. They don't pay much attention to pricing, so my order had to be fixed for a pair of shorts instead of a jacket. I'm not sure how you can mistaken those two different things together. Also, they aren't even able to give a quote until it's ready to be picked up. If I knew off hand how much it was going to be, I wouldn't have wasted my time coming here.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: It's almost impossible to preorder from the grill. I love the cheese steak but decided to take my business elsewhere.  Every time I call nobody will pick up the phone. If the pizza guy receives the call he will immediately put you on hold.  I stopped ordering pizza because the manager (miserable older guy) has the worst attitude I've ever experienced. It's as if he is doing the customer a favor.  Guess management will figure it out soon as De Lorenzo's opens!  Obviously McCaffrey's isn't serious about pizza with the joker they have managing the pizza department.

Excellent! Love the food. Love the service. Just as good as the one on the Hill. 
I had the Seafood Pasta Suzanne. I get a similar dish at any Italian restaurant we go to. This one far outshines all others. The pasta itself is SO good. The sauce had such flavor. It wasn't plain. My husband had the lasagna. I tasted the red sauce and it was excellent also. Love the bread too. Light but very flavorful. Can't wait to go back. 
The only drawback to this location is the casino and the smell of cigarette smoke inside the restaurant.

I had a two week rental and my car had a dead battery the morning after I got it. They sent a tow truck to get it and replace the battery and then offered me an Uber to get it from the shop. They told me over the phone that I would receive a discount when I returned it but when I returned it they said that they couldn't do the discount there at the location and that I needed to call corporate. I called corporate and they said that there was nothing they could do because the transaction was already completed but wanted to offer me a $100 discount on my next car. I told him where he could put that.

Ralphs can't seem to get their employees to follow simple mask wearing rules.  Stopped shopping at the downtown Santa Barbara Ralphs for this reason, but thought I'd check out the one on Hollister in Goleta, hoping for a better experience.  Unfortunately, the experience is the same.  Both employees servicing the produce department couldn't get this right - one wore the mask on their chin (not covering their nose or mouth), the other wore it below their nose.  These are the people that are in the store for hours at a time.  My experiences at Vons in Montecito and Cliff drive have been much better - that's where I'll shop from now on.

Soooooo nuts that this place is in the middle of a mall and the food is so darn good, not just mediocre, but delicious excellent tasty fresh food. This place will pleasantly surprise you and you will continue to sample from their extensive menu. Have not had a bad meal yet over there, and we go to the cherry hill mall just to eat at the bistro, NOT TO SHOP at the stores!!!! This place is a true gem, and you can tell because they are always packed with patrons who are over the poor selections of food in the food court that CANNOT  and does not compare to this place. This was my lil secret but word is out, great food served here!

This place sucks!!! I went in with a Livingsocial voucher and, got to the end of the line and they wouldnt even honor it. They told me they were not accepting Livingsocial vouchers anymore. What??? So then I pay out of my pocket for the pizzas and they suck. All they do that is amazing is make a pizza in a few minutes but, they taste horrible. Will not return ever! 
You want great pizza with a little wait, there are soooo many better choices out there. Mamas Pizza, Renes Organic Oven, Magpies, Tonys, need I go on...you get the point.

Yoko's quality and value were excellent before.But recently, I noticed that they have a lot more business, and the value dropped. They cut down the portions generally. One of my favorites was calamari. The portions are less than half of what they used to serve. I don't understand how much cost they can save by cutting down the portions, but I think it is not a smart decision. As a frequent visitor, I don't feel it is worthwhile to spend $8.99 for a palm-sized portion of calamari, so I would rather go to other Japanese restaurants. I hope they will improve, unless they think they have too much business already.

I just had my first visit to this salon. Ehmed is good, efficient, and friendly. I don't like some stylists are too talkative. Ehmed talked just enough to make you feel comfortable without draining you out. He was more focus on his work, so I felt he finished a lot faster than other salons did. The result is very good. Don't expect he will turn you into a superstar though, but it is close to the top 10% of my satisfaction. If I want to find a better hair stylist, I would have to go out of town or spend at least double amount of money to get it.The price is very reasonable. I would definitly go back to chic Salon.

I just wanted to update my previous review.  Our first trip to Luciano's was not great but the past 4 dinners have been very good....we just started off on the proverbial wrong foot...it has become our favorite Italian in Boise

We enjoy the cold salad (no iceberg lettuce) and other veggies in it.  The house dressing is good, the appetizers have been very good too.  I don't like every entry, who does, but we have found some we enjoy.  The downside to Luciano's is the wait...there is always a wait but you can call 30 minutes ahead and that always makes the wait tolerable...we have please service each and every time.

Ordered shrimp fajitas and quesadillas. Total was nearly $30. Received 6 shrimp in my $16 fajita and 3 quesadillas that were smaller than tacos for $11. If I received this food as a dine in customer I would have walked out. Unbelievable. The food wasn't good. I should have made a turkey sandwich and flushed my $30 down the toilet. It's honestly insulting that they can justify giving 6 shrimp in a $16 fajita. That's not even a complete serving size. At least give 9. Or charge half the price. No words on the taco quesadilla. They were not appealing either.

I went here one afternoon for lunch. The website stated that they open at 11; the bar was open, but I was told that the cook wouldn't be there for a little while longer. I had a beer and enjoyed the beautiful river view. The cook got there around 12:30, and I was super hungry by that time. I ordered a hamburger and wings. The burger was good, and it was only around $4, so that was nice. The wings were edible, but super greasy and seemed to be over cooked. I would recommend this place because the patrons and staff were very nice, and that view is great! The outdoor seating was ideal.

The pizza was great.  The front counter employee - lady with short cut- taking the orders was rude.  Every question asked was met with a short, frustrated answer.  We are new to the eatery and we were very excited.  If she was having a bad day, maybe she should not work the front counter.   The employee who brought the food to the table- lady with black hair and a cap- was very nice and friendly.  
Rude people should never work the front counter in a restaurant, they can spoil a person's appetite! 
I would have given the experience 5 stars but the front counter lady cost a star!
