Chilly winter night called for ramen, so my family ordered pork ramen and kitsune along with a couple basic rolls and seaweed salad. Seaweed salad was good, smoked salmon roll was fine. Oddly, spicy tuna roll was not great as it tasted old and sort of gummy. I got soba noodles with my kitsune, which were pretty good though the kitsune broth was mediocre. It came with one *very tiny* slice of bean curd. Apparently the "spicy" pork ramen was "awful". Not at all spicy and just msg. Essentially an instant noodle flavor packet that costs $10. Don't bother with the ramen here.

First time there a few weeks ago and I loved everything about it. The staff was super friendly and accomodating as we decided what we wanted. The price was comparable to places like Fat Burger. 
We got a burger, a hot dog, a milkshake, and shared an order of fries. The place was packed but we recieved our food very quickly and it was hot and fresh. The fries were good and the portion was huge. The burger was exceptional; juicy, thick, and delicious. It wasn't a giant burger for the price but certainly enough to fill you up. Will definitely be going back!

A little disappointing for a JW Marriott.  I come here regularly for work, and the wifi has always been a little spotty here, but I still stayed because of the amenities.  Last time I checked into my room to find lots of trash behind the desk and TV stand, including food.  I was in a rush so did not have time to call the front desk, but even after housekeeping came the next day, it was not cleaned up.  Clearly they aren't paying a lot of attention to the housekeeping of the rooms.

The pool and gym here are one of my favorites, and I always appreciate the concierge lounge and breakfast, but food behind the furniture is where I draw the line.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This used to be my favorite spot on the beach. I have spent a significant amount of money and brought so many people here over the years. They now have a locked fence on their patio and do not let you access the beach. The owner or manager told me to bring my business to PCI if I want to be on the beach. I am extremely disappointed in this and there are SO many better options now on the beach to drink and actually spend time on the beach such as PCI, Jimmy B's and the Toasted Monkey. Also undertow does not have food or live music which the other bars do.

Decent place, clean and updated.
Housekeeping certainly wasn't the best-had to request our room be cleaned after being skipped a day. Still wasn't the best job. 
Pool was nice but so insanely cold nobody swam in it but instead just put their feet in. That was disappointing!!
Front desk staff was helpful and friendly. Rooms were nice, clean and spacious-except the bathrooms. Had to stand in the shower to shut the bathroom door! Our room had a funky smell and the front desk lady came to spray something which worked for a little while-smelled like a mildew issue.
Overall a decent stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Absolutely phenomenal work! My girlfriend's work colleague told us to visit their shop and ask for "Little Alan". His quote was anywhere between $1100 and $1500 for the repairs needed. He said he would try his best to save me money and repair the one spot as best as he could with polish. Within 5 days, Alan had my car back, the cost was under $1000 and best of all - great work! You can't tell anything was damaged before. I highly recommend Alan and his team at Kirkfield's Auto Body Shop. You won't be disappointed!

Lee's is quite pricey... I recently brought 7 shirts and a pair of dress pants to them for dry cleaning and was told I would have them back in 2 days. Nearly $41 later, I was a bit shocked by the sticker price. Having said that, they did fix one shirt that had some stains on it and also fixed my dry clean only pants that my girlfriend accidentally washed and might have been a lost cause. The lack of parking, especially on Metairie Rd. on a Saturday, can mean you are circling for quite some time to find a spot. I don't send my clothes to the dry cleaners often - Lee's is definitely pricey but I also can't complain about the results or service.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I would give it 5 stars for location, 5 for room cleanliness, 4 for customer service, 2 for views (my room looks out into a parking garage), 2 for perks (we are Hilton Honors-Diamond level, and that earned us nothing, bumpkiss!), 1 for no bar or restaurant, 2 for the continental breakfast, and we didn't make the nightly social hour (M-Th) so I cant rate that. We stay exclusively at Hilton properties all over the United States and abroad, and while this wasn't the worst property I have stayed at, it wasn't the best. But, with that said, the proximity of the hotel to downtown, all the attractions, and Nissan Stadium, is hard to beat.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Hotel was okay.  Nothing over the top, but nothing to shabby either. We paid for the concierge level which was suppose to include breakfast and evening snacks and drinks. But do to a "private meeting" we did not enjoy the evening perks at all and one morning was told by someone from the meeting (I assume) to get our breakfast and go.  The meeting had not started and no one was in the room, but it was "set up".  The elevators were down both days we stayed. The hotel staff worked their ass off accommodating us in the staff elevators.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: While I was out of state, the battery died on our 2014 Chevy Traverse, and it was towed here on 05/19/2017. The dealership said they couldn't diagnosis it until Monday. They had no vehicles available so they called Enterprise Rental, so my wife would have a vehicle to drive to her cancer treatment, assuring her that they would cover it. On 05/22/2017, they called and said it was just a dead battery, and nothing was covered by GMPP or Major Guard. They tried to charge us almost $500.00 to put a battery in, and we paid another $150.00 for car rental. These people are complete crooks!

I would give this bar a better rating except for ONE bartender who was less than friendly and could NOT make a drink to save her life. She is a younger GIRL (who doesn't even look old enough to be behind the bar), she is short like 5'2" with medium length brown hair (the other bartenders are mature women).With an attitude like hers you would think this girl would know how to make a drink!!! That is not even the case, not to mention they charge a $1.00 more on their drinks then other local bars. My suggestion is to leave and come back later to get a better bartender with more experience. They truly make that place more enjoyable to drink at.

Im continually surprised at the people in the rita ranch area that have no idea what good food is. Sure anywhere you go in Tucson lousy service is the standard but the food at china spew was horrid. The service was at or below Tucson standards and Im surprised china spew lasted as long as it did. Lets face it there are NO decent restaurants anywhere near rita ranch. Fry's and walmart have better chef's/food than the sit down restaurants in the area. And now we will have a mama lousyias? They should fit right in.

Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice, shame on me.

1st time - ordered via GrubHub, arrived at stated pickup time and was told order was lost. Had already paid so waited the 20 minutes for the order to be made.

2nd time - to avoid what happened the 1st time, called in the order, was told it would be ready in 30-35 min. 

Arrived 30 min after calling, was told "15 more minutes, we're super backed up." 30 minutes later, asked for an update, it was clear the order was again lost and was told "at least 15 more minutes."

Left after that, and will never go back. I suggest you don't go either.

After much thought, I would have to say my dinner was abit of disappointment.  My wife and I started with the Antipasto salad.  Very unimpressive.  The dressing they gave us was pure vinegar.  Luckily there was garlic, cheese and salt to Doctor up.

As for the Pizza, well that was disappointing as well.

We ordered the Hawaiian with bacon.  All we tasted was salty bacon.  We had ordered double cheese and barely got any cheese.  The ham and pineapple was sparse at best.  Lastly the sauce was minimal and the crust was doughy.

Not a fan at all.  Best New York Pizza here we come!!
.

Worst place to get car tires rotated, lights replaced, or anything done to your car in general. They not only replaced my lights  with the wrong bulb (which the police kept pulling me over because the light kept shutting off) but they also rotated my tires and one of the nubs could not be removed when I got a flat tire. I've been going here for my oil change, and each time they come out wanting to repair something. I will not be fooled again!!!! Car wash is the only good thing about this place. Warning: do not let them fix, replace, rotate, touch your car unless they have a spray bottle or rag in their hand only to clean it!!!!!

Decent hotel, but poorly managed.  The only elevator was inoperable for the entire 5 day stay; they should have expedited the repairs, and maybe apologize on checkout.  Shower drain didn't work.  One day the room wasn't cleaned for no reason, even though we had left early.  Needed three requests to get pillows for pullout.  Had to check out at the desk vs. a bill under the door, although they said they normally do that.  Pool towels the size of a dishrag.  The attitude of the staff for all of these was a shrug and an OK without an apology.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We finally went to this restaurant after wanting to try it for some time. Unfortunately it didn't live up to our expectations. The atmosphere is quite acceptable, and the service was excellent. The view about which I had read in other reviews is nothing special. The food was plentiful and well presented, but it was neither particularly good nor particularly bad. This applied to the entrees ordered by all four people in our party. The tapenade in the antipasto misto was quite good as was the gelato. Otherwise there are better choices in Reno for Italian food.

I cannot speak highly enough about this practice. Drs. Lach and Koch walked us through a tough last few months with our aging dog. They always listened to our concerns about our dog's aches and pains and never nickel and dimed us. What may have been a normal work day for Dr. Rachel Sclarsky and her tech, Amanda, is a day our family will never forget as we laid sobbing on our kitchen floor saying goodbye to our family dog. They were respectful and patient and most of all, gave us a peaceful ending to an amazing life for our beloved Barkley.

I had been going there for haircut for few years, but the recent visits were horrible. horrible experience, bad service, bad stylist.  People work there were trying to rush you out the door. This place gave me a reason to start writing reviews. 2 days after I perm straight my hair at the salon, i found my hair not straight at all and it became dry and dull. the hair product they used totally damaged my hair. ( it was first time I perm at this salon because it is closer . I had done several times in NY and never had problems )

Stacy checked us in. What a fantastic personality!! Great customer service
2 room 2 queen bed room was very nice
Lots of room nice couch in living area with desk big tv and fridge. 
Large bathroom 
We ate at the restaurant for dinner. It was ok. Caesar salad was good. Romain good have been better. Dressing was very good. The catfish dinner sounded good but it appeared to be frozen breaded catfish. The hamburger was seasoned good. What was outstanding was the gooey butter cake and ordered it with ice cream 
Service was excellent with Cavelle. The bar was busy but he made sure to constantly check on us in the restaurant area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Not too crowded, staff for the most part is courteous. Typical Plant Fitness BS about working out too intensely (setting heavy weights down, breathing hard or grunts to lift).  Kind of ironic that it's a "judgement free zone", but they harass you and judge you if the volume of your workout is turned up too high.  What do you expect from a "gym" whose dumbbells only go up to 75lbs?  Bottom line they cater to a certain type of person. Gym is very clean and the staff can be seen cleaning during the day.  If your looking for a real gym, this isn't it. It's a couple of notches up from a hotel gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Went for lunch during restaurant week. They didn't have the appetizer I wanted to I settled for the Caesar salad, which wasn't anything special. I had the lobster ravioli which was really good, I'm not much of a seafood person but I loved it. Lastly, I had a coconut dessert that was also really good. My girlfriend got tiramisu which was definitely the better dessert. The view from the window was pretty boring and the street was very busy so I would recommend eating inside. 

We noticed the place had 12 health violations though so that's a bit concerning. 

3 stars.

This use to be my go to place, but the last three times we ordered there it has gone down hill. There's only two good cooks, yet everyone cooks. I had ordered a pint of veggie lo mein and a pint of chicken lo mein. The veggie lo mein was excellent, but the chicken one was inedible. The boneless chicken dish was extremely skimpy on the vegetable portion of it. Ribs were good. My advice...don't place a big order so you're not out too much if it's inedible. Oh and the over abundance of broccoli in every meal with vegetables is just overkill!

Great family owned restaurant. Warm, family atmosphere with really good food. Don't leave any food on your plate because Sal will get upset!  Super nice man.  I prefer the thicker spaghetti noodles prepared al dente instead of the thin spaghetti noodles.  However, this is a small complaint for the excellent dining experience here.  My husband ordered the lasagna, which even in mom and pop places is usually only ok.  It was very good.  I was pleasantly surprised.  The house red wine was excellent.  Be prepared to spend a longish, relaxing meal there.  We had a Groupon, and it was accepted without issue.  We will return even without a Groupon.

We were fans of the Dale Mabry location and were delighted to see Best NY Pizza come to Wesley Chapel. Their pizza's are really good. Take one home and you will enjoy and probably have left overs. Twice now we have dined in and twice been disappointed. It doesn't look or taste homemade. The  two different chicken dishes we ordered arrived with identically shaped and formed chicken patties. Marsala was quite watered down. The garlic knots were in a big bin at the front counter when we went in and arrived lukewarm at best and halfway thru the meal. It just doesn't taste fresh like your original location does. It feels heated up almost.

We encountered a terrible maintenance guy who came out to fix our heater at 1am. He didn't fix the heater and refused to return after another call was made to the front desk, we had to pack everything up and switch rooms at 2am! 

Even though we experienced this problem with this staff member the other staff was nice and helpful. 

Valet was a bit pricey, the hotel was just okay. We stayed at the Baton Rouge Renaissance before checking in to this location. The BR location blew this location away as far as the decor and overall feel.  Not sure if I'll return to this location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: No issues , pretty straight forward . Picked up at the collision shop and left with Hyundai Sante Fe for 8 days. Only issue due to the holidays(Christmas - New Years) had to call corporate on where to get a flat tire fixed. I had to replace wiper blades due to streaking and unable to see. I was issued credit for them as I gave them the receipt and old blades. They employees were very friendly and gave me no issues. They did thank me for changing them. I would definitely use this location again if needed. !!!

The food was delicious, getting it a chore.  When I phoned in, encountered difficulty getting through. Eventually got through to place my order. I like to try a new place by ordering standards (chicken, pork, fried rice).  Orders were generous size, fresh, tasty and reasonably priced. However the counter staff was rude and condescending. I may go back there, but not sure if it's worth (believe person taking orders was counter person and kept hanging up on me).  Rating was knocked down for the quality of the service (food was 5 stars)

Been coming here for years, & we've always received great service. Doug always greets us by name as soon as we come in. He also keeps us informed about our service. If ever something additional is required he thoroughly explains why and offers recommendations on the need to perform the unanticipated service immediately or if it could be put off for a while.  I really appreciate that he can offer advice but not pressure us just for the sale.  I am more confident knowing that my family is driving safe because Doug has given his thumbs up. Thanks!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I'd give this place 3 1/2 Stars if I could. This place just popped up as an option on grub hub for me (I'm by the art museum). I order the miso soup, kani salad, a spicy tuna and a spicy crab roll. 
Delivery took about 45 minutes, which grubhub got on the nose. The miso was really bland even by miso soup standards. The rolls were well made and the fish was fresh. They were ok rolls, I'd say a step or two above whole foods. The kani salad on the other hand was extremely good. Spicy enough and the cucumbers still had some crunch.

Went for lunch on a weekday. My sister and I are from a St. Louis Italian family and we both agreed this is the real thing. Reasonably priced delicious food with friendly service in a casual relaxed atmosphere. The pizza was a step above Farotto's -- thin crispy crust with more body and just the right amount of toppings--with provel, of course. Spices were exceptional! Italian nachos were hard to stop eating...what a innovation. Kudos to chef Mike Cunetto. Well worth the trip, even coming from St. Louis burbs. We are taking a group there later this month. Cannot recommend it enough!

We ordered carry out on NYE and the food was great. We were so excited we left an 80% tip. We tried to order again tonight and were told it would be ready in an hour fifteen. Showed up an hour and twenty minutes later and we were told it would be another 25 minutes. No problem people get backed up. 25 minutes later we were told it would be another 25 minutes so we had to cancel. It's almost 8:00 on a Friday night so not sure where we'll eat! I get things are crazy right now but if you can't handle the orders just don't take them. I don't think we'll be back which is really too bad. 5 for food if you can actually get it!

My wife and friends had made a reservation for 17 for lunch on 4/6/17 , requesting  a separate room. Not only they were seated in the main dining room where it was very crowded, but their various pizza orders were messed up. The food was good, but not the service. Later, the waiter accused my wife of not having paid her bill, and would not let the last 2 ladies leave, when in fact. her bill for two was paid in cash and the money handed out to that waiter!!  He reluctantly had to agree.
So, needless to say, this group of retired schoolteachers will never come back and are not recommending Lonzalos.

When I was eating here October 20th, 2018 at 7pm a very rude woman came up behind me and coughed all over my French fries. She was there with a morbidly obese woman who weighed about 500 pounds. I was rudely shoved out of the way by her at the pop machine. She then rang the bell loudly on her way out after she was done harassing me. She then smiled and laughed she enjoyed harassing me so much. My fries had burnt crud of some sort in it and there was chunks of some foreign matter in it. They always put the fries touching the dirty foil of the burger for some reason. The burger wrapper is always all greasy.

If you're used to decent Italian food don't eat here.  Bland, bland, bland. 
Zero seasoning, zero depth of flavor. 
We had calamari & a sm pizza for apps. Two veal dishes and a gnocchi dish. Could have had the same quality from frozen case in grocery store. Sad house wines. My mom's Assisted Living facility serves tastier food than Positano's. VERY dated decor/atmosphere. Hot as hell in the dining room (AC set at 78 degrees!) Service was ok, but she was a bit crass in dealing with other staff.  There is no reason for us to go back ever.

Rooster has been one of our go to date night spots, but this was such a disappointing evening food wise... but the service was exceptional.  We ordered a charcuterie board that was pretty good, but our entrees were fair at best.  I had grouper cheeks that were way over breaded and NOT FRESH! Very strong fishy taste.  My husband's Gnocchi w/ short ribs really lacked depth of flavor.  What even shocked me more were the short wine pours that we witnessed... maybe 2.5 oz??? Fortunately we were drinking beer! Our server was excellent in making perfect suggestions for a beer novice and a beer expert!!! Not sure that we'll be back anytime soon...

We went around 8pm on a Thursday. The line wasn't too long, but by the time we left it was out the door so we came at just the right time! There are lots of flavors to choose from! The prices are reasonable with the 4 mini scoops at the price of $5. It's a nice way to get a taste of a few flavors. I gave 3 stars because the ice cream wasn't that great, it was just ok. I got the black and gold crunch, creole cream cheese, red velvet, and salted caramel. Of the 4, the creole cream cheese tasted the best. I was a bit disappointed because there were such great reviews given by others so I had high hopes.

Angelina's was able to fit us in for a reservation at the last minute, and we are so glad they did! The food was absolutely delicious. We got the meatball and burrata appetizers and the pappardelle and veal chop as main courses. All of it was amazing, but the pappardelle was the best I've had. The sauce was perfect and the noodles were nice and thin and homemade. It's a very small, family-owned operation with a mom and daughter doing the cooking. The service was great, and we had a chance to talk to the owner for a while at the end of the night - everyone was so friendly! We will definitely be back and recommend to all of our friends.

The people working the second window are extremely rude.  I have had extremely rude service for the past month. I heard them yelling at the very nice lady that takes your payment at the first window.   I reminded her that I wanted no cheese on my sandwich.  They yelled at her "we know we told her okay".   I pick up my sandwich, guess what?  To no surprise there was cheese on the sandwich.  I see "now hiring" signs on the lot.  I am sure it is difficult to fill shifts but honestly I don't think a few of your current employees deserve to be working the window and greeting customers.  They should have other positions.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If I could give less than 1 star I would. The bathroom door didn't close without putting my full weight against it. We actually got a staff member to try it. The shower handle fell off in my hand. The bathroom sink leaked from both handles. The kitchen being fully equipped is a joke. We were welcomed as though we were an annoyance. Marriott should rethink the partnership with this brand. We were reserved for 3 nights, checked out after 1.  Upon checkout the same dismissive attitude when we explained why we were leaving. First and last time, from a Marriott titanium member2 nights short of 1000 nights.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I made the mistake of walking in to place my order, BIG MISTAKE! At the time  I was the  the only person is line and watched as multiple cars placed and received their orders before I received my one cup of tea.  The customer who came in after me received his order, had time to chat with the employees and even left as I was still waiting for mine.  I order the same item over and over and it's never the same. I don't understand why it's so inconsistent.  
I'd rather drive out of my way to another location than stop here again.

First I have to comment on how friendly the front desk agent was.  Evan deserves to be recognized for outstanding service.  A friendly young man who clearly takes the time to make you feel welcome. 

Located in a perfect location with so many stores within walking distance.  Nice, clean modern rooms.  Really enjoyed the all day availability for coffee and tea.  We stayed for a wedding and it was absolutely perfect.  As a heads up, if you need to make a left on Easton Road when leaving the hotel you must make a right and go towards the Walmart to the light.

Highly recommended!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Love the staff and this is my favorite Starbucks. I feel like they WANT to be at work when they show up everyday. The issue, while small, surrounds the supply chain issues. I totally understand the need to purchase goods and supplies from approved vendors, but to be out of things like Splenda for weeks is too long. A branded item such as Splenda is easy to purchase 500ft away at Target, which is what I had to do to have it in my coffee when I visit several times a day. Again, I get the supply chain/approved product thing, but it doesn't apply to branded items that are available at the store.

Bad experience tonight at Leo's. I ordered the Veal Marsala and my wife ordered the Chicken Piccata. We both had the menistrone soup. The soup was watered down and lacked flavor and ingredients. The veal was chewy like rubber and the Marsala sauce was watery and without flavor. The Pene pasta was soft and over cooked. My wife's chicken was decent but the piccata sauce also was watered down. What was good was the wine and bread. Very disappointed because we have eaten there before and the food was good. Hopefully it was a bad night but undecided whether to return.

This was a great experience from beginning to end. The reservation process was easy, I received a follow-up email and confirmation call and the table was ready for us when we got there. The hostess was super friendly, we threw her a curveball by adding a third person and she quickly accommodated. We had three appetizers, the mushroom, the octopus and the shrimp and I can pick which one was the best, they were all super delicious.
We each had a fish dish and they also were amazing. Great wine selection, knowledgeable waiters and great service not to forget that the place is super cute. Go get there quick!

This room was booked with the Sesame Street package on SS website. Book at the Sheraton! We found the previous owner's towel on the back of our door along with long hairs behind the door. Room had seen better days, but pool was ok and breakfast was good. We only saved $15 on the van to SS the first day because we were waiting forever the second day. Funniest part was this was book with a SS package and other than having your reservation they don't know anything about it. SS people told us to get info from front desk but they had squat for us.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: BUYER BEWARE:  We received a quote on 2 tires.  The quote was more than 2 times another quote for the EXACT same tire.  Based on other reviews, they might have good service, but you will need to price check before using this location.  I am so glad I did.  When I called the store back about the huge difference, they said they might be able to get the tires cheaper but wouldn't know until they came in.  I definitely don't trust anyone that gives me a quote and then says when questioned that they might be able to get it cheaper.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This has become my new salon in the past few months. I left my old salon because pedicures became less than 20 minutes per visit. At Portobello,  I'm able to relax and enjoy a 45 minute experience and not feel like I'm being pushed out for another customer to take my place. Also, I switched to doing powders before coming here and was very disappointed. Since coming here,  I am very happy with the SNS dipping powders. My nails are growing and are stronger than ever. Traci and her staff work very hard so please and accommodate her clients! I've sent my friends to her as well.

This is most definitely the worst restaurant I've ever been to. The service was absolutely horrible, we had to wait an hour for our food. And that was just our first round of food we wanted. The food was way too small and salty. The waiters were very rude to us and told us to keep waiting when we asked where our food was. This was after we waited for 30 minutes. While we waited for our food, we noticed that multiple people  were storming out of the restaurant in anger. The overall experience was just horrible. I would never recommend this restaurant to anyone ever, unless I didn't like them.

Three of us had dinner here this evening.The service was friendly and attentive. Between us, we had Guacamole and Chips, the Corn on the Cob, Paella, Chicken Enchiladas and a Carnitas Taco. Everything was fresh,  delicious and the Cilantro sauce with the chips was especially tasty. We did split a piece of Tres Leches for dessert which was heavenly. This is a wonderful addition to the restaurant scene in Moorestown. Folks were standing in line awaiting a table. Reservations are probably wise. What a wonderful evening!

We stopped in this place during Artwalk down town and were not impressed. The music was extremely loud for such a small bar and we had a difficult time enjoying our groups company because random guys kept coming up to hit on someone in the group at some point. The bartender did very little to assist with keeping the drunks under control and we were forced to handle things ourselves as politely as we could. One visit was definitely enough for us. But for women who are trying to hook up, I'd say there are some easy pickings for guys in there.

This is is my second visit to this location and once again over an hour and a half wait.  This is by far the WORST place ever. Second visit today took two hours. No eye doctors in office, everything is virtual. This place is a joke - waste of time and waste of money. First visit my prescription was in correct I was told to wait 5 days and come back. I make an appointment and I'm still waiting yet two hours with an incorrect prescription. Staff lies and says everything will be done in 15 minutes, just a complete waste of time.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Had to download Yelp just to leave a review for this place. Every time I go, they're out of something. Today, they could only sell burgers. Nothing else. Also, most of the time I go the food I order is not complete. I got a bacon mcdouble with only one patty of meat last time I went and today I got half the bacon that usually comes on it. No pickles or mustard on the quarter pounder I ordered either. Finally, it usually takes forever to get food here. I will be avoiding this place from now on. Still love you McDonalds, I know you're better than this
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: My first experience I rented a car from Avis. A Ford Fusion to be exact. My pick up time was 2:30am - 8:00am same day. I made this rental through Priceline.com which altogether costed me $93.11 and after returning the car..few days later I was charged $127.38 on my credit card. Someone please help me make sense of this? I believe I was overcharged for nothing. I thought to myself never again. Im still pretty upset about it until this day. I don't know how will I ever try to rent a car ever again. I'm so mad just thinking about it and never called to ask about it.

Brought in several people from Ohio today along with a few of my Co workers
The chili with cactus was surprisingly good
Just had an issue that I never had before
The chicken sandwich was so dang tuff that I was unable to cut it with a knife..it happened to my order and everyone else had a great food and service experience , this is one else of the restaurants that always has good food and the service has always been first rate
I would have sent it back but did not want to be a distraction from the lunch meeting 
To bad for me today

This was not a good experience at all.  Overpriced food that leaves you leaving hungry.  Not handicapped accessible at all and then the handicapped person is made fun of.  Veal wasn't as big as your cell phone and tuff.  Food arrived Luke warm and we had reservations for 8:00 and we had three different servers all of which left a lot to be desired.  Never received our food until 9:45 and then we complained and we were told to go in the back to speak to the owner.  Worst experience I have ever had in a restaurant.  Will never go back.

Slipping. I ordered pick up tonight and was quoted 20-25 minutes. I arrived in 25 and waited 22 minute, which was understandable I suppose as it was around 6:15pm on a Wednesday. The female cook was in charge of two young trainees so she had her hands full. However that does not excuse all the improper handling of food instances I observed while waiting, including touching her ear and mouth, as well as one of the trainers picking up spaghetti from a warmer with his bare hands and placing it directly on a plate. In the end I had half my order remade but I'm not sure I'll be back all things considered. Too bad

So, I stop by this location someday every day on my way into town, heading to work.  Usually, mediocre service at best.  Very little smiles oh, and most people don't seem pleased to be employed.  TODAY, I stopped by and ordered my large sweet tea with NO ice... Needless to say, management needs to drop the attitude and half-ass replacement when THEIR staff gets a minor thing wrong on an order, and it's asked politely, to be fixed.  Be the leader, not a spoiled brat and fix it RIGHT.  SIMPLE! Once more, and corporate will me notified.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Went there with my very Italian parents.  Always the potential for a bad evening.  From the moment we were greeted at the door things went very well.  The calamari was lightly battered and tasted very good.  Our Cesar salads didn't have that pre-made chill to them as if they had been made hours ago and have been sitting in the fridge.  Croutons were home made.  The veal piccata was very taste.  The egg plant rollatini was good and other dishes were good as well.  Our server Irving was outstanding.  Good food, good service.   Definitely going back.

Update 7/29 - The night my friend played I went home and woke up with lots of bites on my feet.  I visited again 2 weeks later with 3 other friends and had a great time but again woke up with bites on my feet.  They allow lots of DOGS to roam the back deck and I am getting FLEA bites while having my meal at this restaurant.  Very frustrating experience.  The itching from the bits has lasted days.  

A friend was playing in a band and had a gig here one night.  Then crowd was fun, the burger was one of the better burgers in St Louis and the beer was cold.  I'd go back!

This place is amazing!!! The Owners live there and they manage every problem that comes up. We went there and booked every room for a wedding party and truly had such a wonderful time. They were very flexible with all the festivities that were happening all weekend long. You are staying in an Old Jail that has been turned into a hotel. They have FREE wifi, a very nice common area (which has everything), only 1.6 mile jog down to the Mississippi River where the French Quarter & Bourbon Street await your presence. Had a long weekend and this place is what we called home! Thanks to Raul & Liz for being humble and having patience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
If I could give this place zero stars I absolutely would!!!!!!
1. There was hair in my food
2. I went to go get some sushi and the ginger smelled of Clorox bleach.
3. When I told the wait staff about it she asked me "why do I like complaining so much"
4. I didn't come there for the meatloaf but once I had a glance at it automatically made me want to throw up

ALL IN ALL It was the worst buffet I have ever been to in my life, I recommend going there if you like hair in your food and a disgusting waitstaff!!!!!!

KEEP LOOKING! Over priced. (Atleast $75 for basic pedicure/gel color) Sloppy work. There's always an issue with the quality of service. It has a nice decor and plenty of polishes to choose from. Overall, I'm never satisfied with my service from the two times I've gone. The pedicure/manicure seems like it's missing a few steps. The polish is never on point. Gel chipped within a few days from here. (WOW, I know) I usually go to Green Tea in Feasterville PA, but I recently moved and this is more convenient, but now I have to go looking again, because this place is horrible.

I just visited this location for a late lunch & to avoid afternoon traffic.  The restaurant wasn't to busy which was great. My server Santiago was cool but the food quality was awful.  My entree was lukewarm borderline cold.  I requested it could be sent back to heat it up to normal temperature and it was but the 2nd attempt it was still just warm.  The plate was hot but the food wasn't.  On top of that it was extremely salty. 
This use to be one of my favorite Mexican spots in Downtown Nashville but I now see why it's been over a year since I last visited.

Loved this place! The rate I got online was amazing. Great location, friendly staff and really nice rooms.
It is a short walk from everything. We had an inside room, it was clean and quiet.  I was really impressed with the Aveda bath products and super comfy pillows.  Lucys restaurant is across the street, they have great burgers and Mothers restaurant is a couple blocks away.  The rooftop pool was clean and stocked with towels. It was a great place to sit in the evenings to watch the sunset. If I return to New Orleans I would return to this hotel. I have nothing negative to say about it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Food was good, although overpriced. Cocktails were okay.  We had to wait in the bar for our table, but we're not offered drinks.  Should definitely have servers in the bar area. Lost $100 by not serving us pre dinner drinks. We were stuck in a room in the back, even though there were several empty tables in the main dining area and it was late. There, we were promptly forgotten.  Half hour wait for six drinks,  food orders messed up, desserts forgotten.  I would never go back, there are lots of better restaurants around. Was the worst experience in Nashville, the rest of our visit was great.

I called up and the sales women was not very friendly. I wanted to rent a small vehicle for June 27th. They were not open early that Saturday so I had to pick it up Friday night. They are only open to 530pm. Ok fine. I could return the car by 7pm Saturday ( to be safe on travel time). Well if I didn't return it by the same time I picked it up I get charged 2 days. Ok whatever fine. 
Here's my problem I needed a gps 
I was told I was not guaranteed a gps they can put it in my notes but it may not be available for me when I pick it up. 
How is that good customer service. ?!

Ridiculously expensive, and so thin that you cant even get a slice out of the box without it falling apart. I needed to use a spatula and tin foil to get it into a toaster oven. The whole large pizza weighed almost nothing, and would properly serve about three at most. Maybe I got the new guy or it was a bad day, but every below average lousy pizza place that Phoenixville is loaded with seems to be cheaper than here. What's the point? TD Alfredo's will get you similar low-quality pizza delivered to your house at literally half the price of picking one up here.

It does not deserve one star!!!  This Wendy's use to be a good one to stop into for a lunch on the run.  NOT anymore!!!  I have now stopped by 3 times since August and it is always SLOW.  AND  no one seems to care!!!  I agree with other Yelp reviews...  The staff has changed for the worse and no one smiles... Rather frowns!!!  French fries as the worse.  Soft and barley warm.  The chicken sandwich had what they consider a slice of tomatoe... but it was yellow, green and a rim of pink!!!  NOT RED!!! This is the last time I stop in on the go!!!  WENDY'S Corporate should really look into this place...

I've been to the Lakehouse at least 7 times.  All for somebody I know that performs there during the summer.  Every time I have gone it has been crowded.  Which is great.  Has a good atmosphere, and friendly people.  The only thing is the wait staff has been horrible.  It's not that they mess up orders, or are rude.  They just may never comeback for refills, or well anything.  The food is not good.  It's all dry, and basically frozen foods presented nicely.  Salads are your best bet.  Things might be better during weekdays vs. weekends.  Great views, and good crowds.  Just really bad food, and under staffed.

Coworkers told me that this was the best pizza in Delco. I respect people's opinion, but this pizza isn't even in the top 5 in Delco.  

Pros: Fresh, real ingredients. 

Cons: Crust is too think. Sauce has no sweetness and would be better with spaghetti. Cheese is fresh but barely any saltiness. Also, volume of sauce totally overpowers the cheese. It's 2018 and they still don't take cards. Fun Fact: Even toll booths take credit cards now. 

I'm glad I tried Gaetano's but you definitely aren't the best Pizza in Delco.

This review is 100% based on my phone customer service experience with the front desk rep.  Let the record show I never even checked in.  I was 'on-call' for federal jury duty last week and called everyday to see if I had to report the next day.  Each day I didn't and each day I'd call to adjust my reservation.  I spoke w/ the same gentleman every night and he recognized me by weeks end; he was so very accommodating.  He immediately sent confirmation emails and fully convinced me that when the time comes I'm summoned again, this will be my first phone call.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went here to get some lenses switched from one frame into a new pair of the same frames. Look, I get that they don't have any interest in helping someone who isn't spending money there, although I was totally willing to pay for the service of switching my lenses. But that's no reason to ruin a pair of perfectly good glasses. The guy warped my new frames, causing the plastic around my left lens to be taller than the plastic around my right lens. The glasses now look very uneven. I hope I can get this fixed somehow. Stay away.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I visited this salon today for a gel mani.  I have been to this location many times since it opened.  I have always gotten excellent service, the staff are all nice but I feel compelled to mention the music that was playing today.  Actually the last time I was there about a month ago I noticed it also.  There is piano music playing, which is very nice and relaxing, but today and the last time I was there, it was ONE SONG playing repeatedly.  I'm sure the staff gets immune to the music.  Jason was not there or I would have mentioned it to him.  Otherwise, always a pleasant experence.

Ordered a carne asada taco & carnitas enchilada combination today.  The taco was OK, if a little dry, but the carnitas in the enchilada was mostly all brown, dried, & hard.  Seemed like it was the leftovers from lunch that they wanted to use up, and all of it was placed into my enchilada.  There was also no sauce on my enchilada (that I could see) which made the whole thing very dry and chewy.  If I had dined in, I would have asked for a replacement.  The only reason I rate this meal even two stars is that the rice and beans, and the taco, were OK.

Used drive thru. Ordered a McRib value meal. 
I parked in the parking lot to eat and discovered a fish sandwich. Went to delivery window again only to be told "We don't have any McRibs." Why wasn't that communicated when I ordered?? 
I then asked for a Quarter pounder at the delivery window. 
Was asked to go to the drive up wait space. I should have declined. Waited there 10 minutes! I went into the store and told the cashier what happened. It was another 10 minutes! I asked the manager what the hold up was. She was rude. Will be contacting the district manager. UNACCEPTABLE.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Very good value for the price. Went with a few friends and had a ball. You WILL leave utterly stuffed. Staff was very nice. Waitress explained how to order as your table orders as a group which was fun in itself. We ordered the salmon, tuna and mackerel sashimi, same for the sushi. We also got salmon roe, tobiko and avocado n salmon hand rolls. The rock shrimp, shrimp tempura, bbq squid, fried calamari, pork chops and seaweed salad was really good too! Planning on returning with more friends who love sushi. Plus it's a BYOB. Can't go wrong with that!

Since the former owners sold this restaurant, the new owners have destroyed this place. I will never order from this place ever again. I had hair and a metal piece in my food and when I spoke with the owner she didn't care and just told me to come and pick up my refund without an apology. The food doesn't taste nothing like it use to when the former owners owned it. The former owners made this pretty similar to New York chinese food, unfortunately the new owners have no clue about chinese food. I would give this place a zero o star!

Took my car in for the first time using a GroupOn that included tire rotation and balance, oil change and an air filter.  I've learned to always check this kind of service.  The oil level is OK and tire pressures were close to correct but not to spec. The real problem is that they didn't properly torque (tighten) the wheels, which is a serious safety problem.  Of the 20 lug nuts, 7 were under torqued.  They use a gun with preset torque so this is just sloppy work, or bad equipment.

They get 3 stars because the oil was changed and the tire were rotated OK.  Be real careful using these guys.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: While in the past we have liked this restaurant today I give it one star. If I could give them a zero I would. I have a shellfish allergy and specifically asked for them to please not put shrimp in our dish and made them aware of the allergy. Even on our receipt it says no shrimp. Halfway into eating my dish what do I find? A shrimp. after several doses of Benadryl and epi penn on hand, I am writing this waiting to see how bad my reaction will be. Are you kidding me people! Not that hard. Now that I had this experience during COVID time, I won't be back.

This is a great hotel to stay in if you want to stay on Bourbon Street.  The staff was the best!  Super nice and helped us any way they could.  Whenever we go back to New Orleans we will def stay here.  Pricy but worth it due to the location.  We never used a public restroom.  We always just walked back to our room.  That was wonderful!!!!  The only negative thing I will say is that our a/c wasn't the best.  At night we put it on 60, which was the lowest it would go.  I still woke up sweating during the middle of the night.  Other than that all was good.  Carry you're own cooler....no refrig in room and no microwave.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Because Cantina Felix is owned by celebrity chefs, I had expected it to be a cut above the other nearly Mexican restaurants.  It isn't.   We had the carnitas and the short ribs enchiladas -   nice presentations; but really good Mexican sauces have a depth and complexity of flavor  (not just heat) which is unique to Mexican cuisine - this was lacking in these entrees.  The tortilla soup is served with the tortilla strips, avocado, and cilantro added in, not on the side as is traditional - so the burst of fresh flavor is absent.  
The decor is beautiful, service is good, and the food good but unexceptional.  Prices are on the high side.

I purchased my glasses a year ago from a different Target location. I never liked the fit therefore, I brought them to this location to be resized. They were sized PERFECTLY to my face and were comfortable. The lens were 'crazed' during the process therefore, I brought them back to this location. A staff member by the name of Nicole, ordered me new lenses and provided the BEST customer service to resolve this issue. Nicole was kind and apologetic...normally an issue like this would make a customer take their business elsewhere BUT because Nicole gave the best care, I will continue to go back to this location.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

Very fuck poor customer service!!!
My wife and I went in to get copy for our account,and the ladies said for us to go to teller and she can print out for me and then we went to speak to teller,then she letting us know will charge 6.00 for that!!!
I got pissed off I alway get free copy!!
Shouldn't charge for that!!!
I shouting and they notice how I get mad!!
So I guess they change mind not charge at all then got copy and we walked out!!!
When Conoravirus over I'll come back to close chase bank account!!!
Chase bank sucks!!!!
It really so stupid for 6.00 fee to get copy..
I alway get free every year depend as need!!!

Unusually rude customer service. My husband and I were toold to leave after asking what the difference is between their"AGREEMENT and a CONTRACT".  I guess that's what you do when you don't have the answer. When I got home and googled it....they are synonymous, no difference. Asking questions should never be something you are attacked over or shamed for. If they cannot answer a question they are not trained right or they are hiding something. But apparently they do not want you to ask which is the truth. Not reasonable!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
We initially went to this vet because it's nearby and has high ratings. Our cat is a diabetic and we were shown how much insulin to give, it was an incorrect dose and we were also given the wrong needles according to our new vet. 
So much so that our cat suffered a hypoglycaemic episode and had to be rushed to ER. After visiting several other vets, I realize now we were not getting the full care or picture of what our cat needed from this place. Not a good place for diabetic cats who need continued care and check ups as they are not thorough.

Best Pizza in Plant City.  We've tried Espositos (better the second day), Old Towne (who cuts their pizza in squares?), but neither of these were very good.  I ordered pizza for 12 people when I had a crew here installing windows and there wasn't much left after we were done.  The pizza is hot, ingredients were tasty (except for the canned mushrooms) but it's definitely worth a try. You can order online (discount coupons available) for pickup, or they will deliver.  Even though it's part of a chain, the quality is exceptional.

My usual hair stylist--since the five years that I have lived in SB--was very ill so I tried Cowboys and Angels at the recommendation of two others. I was very, very pleased with the results. Norma cut my her quickly and rinsed it afterwards, plus shampoo, at no extra charge and at her insistence knowing that I had to return to the office for the afternoon. The price was also right. My hair is thick and difficult to cut but was no challenge for her professional, experienced hands. Those other two reviews as of the date of this review are most likely complete anomalies. Ignore them and try Cowboys and Angels.

Stopped in Boise for a night during a road trip.  Italian sounded good, so I use trusty old Yelp to help find a good restaurant.  We ordered Spaghetti with marinara and meatballs, chicken marsala, and a caesar salad.  Staff was very friendly.  Spaghetti marinara was basically tomato paste.  We definitely agree the sauce should have a strong tomato base, but it seems that's ALL it was.  The Chicken Marsala had enough garlic to close down Transylvania.  Overwhelming with garlic is an understatement.  Caesar salad is wonderful.  Would not recommend this restaurant.

We tried this place when it first opened and thought it was decent. We get takeout from Sakura about twice a week so we thought it would be nice to try somewhere different. I ordered the candy cane roll that's suppose to be red snapper, white tuna, "krab", and shrimp. What i received was Krab, wrapped in rice, topped with more krab and sliver of shrimp. It is a $14 roll made with nothing but $1 of fake crab and a sliver of shrimp. Total ripoff. Maybe they thought i just wouldn't notice. Never going back. Better options in town.

Clean, comfortable dining inside or on patio.  You can get Salad, Pasta, or Pizza for a low price (under $8).

Crust is thin, taste is great; crispy.  One pizza can feed two people, but I've seen many people eat a pizza by themselves.  Pick your favorite sauce.  Pick your own toppings, and you really can ask for "extra" .... Friendly staff and nice service.  Unlimited self-service soda / iced teas.  Lots of lunch time visitors, but you get your pizza quick, usually w/in 5-7 min. after it hits the oven.  

Sad to see the $5 pizza (happy hour) special go away.... but still a great place to visit and very much worth it!

I'm modifying my review from over a year ago from 4 stars down to one star. The complex has undergone a change of ownership and the complex is starting to go down hill. Quality of tenants is not what it was and crime has increased a lot, gang activity and drug use are everywhere . Maintenance requests get checked as complete and were not done. No hot water and no air conditioning seems to be a common occurrence.
The location is great, office staff are friendly though ineffective.
There's a waitlist to get into the complex and my unit will be available as soon as my lease expires

I have had KK donuts at Penn station in NYC and they are always fresh and delicious.  The ones in Manoa Shoppong Center store leave much to be desired.  I bought a dozen and noticed that the employee was not taking the donuts from the case in front of me, but others from somewhere under the case.  I thought that was odd.  After I got home and tried them, they tasted 2 days old.  Dry and stiff on top, only ok inside.  Basically stale.  Now I read on Yelp that these donuts are cooked off-site and reheated at the Monoa location !  If this is true, no wonder they were subpar.  I definitely will not go back, which is probably just as well.

I was craving Japanese food and decided to give them a try on Doordash.  The sushi was satisfactory, but what really turned me off was that their chicken katsu (cutlet) wasn't breaded in panko like it traditionally is and tasted bland as a result.  Their miso soup also had an off taste to it and had noodles in it, which I found odd.  I gave them three stars because they didn't miss anything on my order and the yakisoba turned out okay.  I wouldn't eat here again.

Note: I lived in Hawaii for 18 years and Japan for 10 years so I probably have very high standards when it comes to Japanese cuisine.

Food is good, pizza is delicious but the sewer gas odor from the restroom really ruined our meal.  It was more noticeable when they seemed to be washing dishes or when someone opened the ladies room door.  It made our whole meal very disappointing and we have enjoyed our meals there in the past.  We mentioned this to our waitress who said they were aware of it and kept spraying in the restroom. We should have asked to move but you would think they wouldn't seat us there if they knew they had a problem. Unfortunately, we will probably not return.

Hotel was nice, bar was as well. Service was a little slow but there was a big event going on so understandable. Lunch at the bar was fantastic. Downside was breakfast. $40 for two people and the food was your typical buffet spread with a highly inflated price. Also, when I lifted the bacon/sausage lid, I was burned by the steam. They had the heat way too high. No visit from management to make sure I was ok, no comp on the breakfast, not even an apology. Save your money, and go eat in the airport. Price may be the same but at least you shouldn't have to leave breakfast with an injury.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Actually I would give a 2.5 stars. I love having local businesses and restaurants right around the corner. It makes our community great but I have to say I am very disappointed with my take out this evening. I ordered the spaghetti with clams in white wine sauce (my favorite). It came in a small container which I thought was odd for Italian food. I figured it must be pretty full. I was disappointed. There was very little spaghetti, I could see the bottom of the container. 10 clams. Pretty expensive for such little food.

Always a good price for what the gym offers especially since I travel for work the Black Card Membership works ideally. Only Downfall is the hours of operation on the weekends at this location. 
4am workouts are my go to, 7am is too late to start the day and thus it ends up packed in result. It'd be nice if it were open 24/7 not 24/4 1/2. ‍ I work around it though, sometimes a late night workout on a tempting Friday night is helpful for remaining dedicated and not partying your hard work away. Great spot though, clean and kind staff. Been to a-lot some stank this one is good.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Yum!! Went to Ulivo for a Saturday 8:30 reservation with another couple. We were seated almost immediately.  The appetizers were good, but nothing over the top amazing.  The calamari was a little too heavily fried, but still tasty.  The tomato mozzarella was very good though.  As for the entrees, everyone loved itheirs.  The gnocchis were outrageously good.  Light, but filling.  The other entrees were equally delicious.  Service was good.  Atmosphere was nice as well. Would definitely return.  Price for party of 4, each getting an appetizer and an entree was just under $160.

The waiters at Black Powder are always friendly and helpful.  The restaurant is fairly quiet even when crowded, probably because it is broken down into sections.  The Parmesan Polenta Fries were good and fun, but for me it was a "one and done" type of food.  I love the Honey Mustard Chicken and that is what I order every time.  My friends have ordered the Short Rib Grilled Cheese (and love it) and the Salmon Ruben (which appears to have been removed from the menu).  Parking and getting a table have never been a problem.  This is one of my "Go To" places where I like to take visitors to the area.

Came here for a Saturdate night. Ate in the lovely courtyard. It was about 50 degrees that night, but with the heater and the roof situation back there, it was comfortable enough for my date and I to take our coats off. 

Great service, and I can tell the food was made with care. We ordered too much to name, but for our main entrees, I enjoyed the gnocchi (without the sausage) and my date's chicken parm could have used a bit more seasoning. Oh, and our "warm" pumpkin cake was NOT warm and wasn't anything special. Overall, it was a really cute date! The food was enjoyable but the ambiance and great service really set the evening right.

You know how you have a craving for sushi, so you get it and it's the best feeling ever? ...this wasn't that. It was satisfying enough though. I've eaten from here twice, but Ive had better both times. I've only been able to order delivery because Covid, so I'll give it benefit of doubt that it's probably better from kitchen to table. Oh and the inside of the spring rolls felt mushy, the miso tasted more watery than it should, the to go sauces were watered down, the ginger was dried out, and the wasabi wasn't spicy... so, there's that.

I needed a car within three hours so I booked it over the website.  The clerk at the desk was very helpful to me and renting was very easy.  When I got to the selection area to get a car I was given the option to select a model more appropriate to my needs than the one supplied over the website; the cost to rent the car was less as well.  Checking the car back in upon the return from my trip was hectic.  The employee checking in cars was clearly overloaded with work; however, my wait was only about 10 minutes.  I'm coming back to rent from them again.

Food is good but inconsistent. On weekends especially. Maybe the chef takes off and the kids run it? We recently placed a large order that was satisfactory. The delivery person had a rude disinterested attitude about him. As if he was doing me a favor. As it turns out, it's the owners son. This is not the way to promote a business or treat repeat customers. Of note, some of the guests at my house had never eaten at Roma and are new to the area. The son paints a picture of ignorance and entitlement. He needs a talking to.

Ate there recently. I'm through. The owner Giuseppe bugs you throughout your meal. I don't care how successful you are. I'm happy for you. I know that your food is the best in the area ( so you say). My chicken parm tasted twice cooked. It was hard and flavorless. My son's chicken cheesesteak was full of grease. Definitely. To a place I will return. I will take my business down to Angelo's where I can enjoy a meal with my kid and not have to hear of an obnoxious owner. People go out to eat to have some downtime . I don't want to listen to some loudmouth bragging the whole time, especially when the food is subpar

I was looking for something a little more special than cheesesteaks for lunch when we stumbled onto Pizzicato. Outside seating was nice, it's always fun to people watch in Philly. I ordered the Pear And Walnut Salad with baby greens, crispy pancetta, dried cranberries, and gorgonzola in honey lavender dressing. The waiter suggested shrimp on top - they were marinated in something yummy and grilled to perfection. The dressing was really unique. I loved the combination. The staff was friendly and attentive without being overbearing. I would love to go back for dinner.

Just a wanna let anyone that is looking to relocate out here to check this place out. McEwen apartments are by far the most beautiful apartments around here and I'm glad I decided to move here. My view out the patio looking out to the water fountain is amazing and relaxing to hear at night. The staff is friendly and so polite, Nelson has giving me a hand and gone above and beyond with helping me with my apartments. His knowledge was very helpful helping figuring out this ac. Another great thing is the pool,this place makes me feel like im living in a resort. Thank you for everything that y'all do for this place.

This spot is just okay reason being the pie is kind of costly at $15 with no toppings just cheese.  I suppose Detroit pizza uses cheddar on their pizza which I am not a fan. Also, having to pre-order a pizza due to low stock is odd. Most people want pizza spur of the moment not having to plan ahead to pick up their pizza. 

Once inside it was a rather quick transaction with employees having the opportunity for a polite welcome but did not. Translation our pizza speaks for itself and we don't have to speak to you. LOL 

I already have my favorite pizza joints that I will continue to visit up or down the street.

The accommodations were suitable and clean. The staff accommodating and many of their processes for safety during COVID-19 good such as distancing procedures during check in and breakfast procedures of bagged breakfasts or sandwiches and Keurig pods to heat in the room. Signs on door requiring guests to wear masks. Stars omitted because not all front desk staff wore masks. In the morning when I went to get on the elevator, housekeeping staff were on their cell phones, no masks, and one of the staff coughed as she got on the elevator.  In times such as these, I was disappointed to see this occur.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I am positively a HUGE fan of Montys pizza.   just don't order the tuna sub.  you will get about a tablespoon of tuna.  very disappointing.  the service is always top notch.  and the pizza is incredible.  their tuna sub used to be great.  but the last 2 trips was disappointing.  the taste is still great, but the portion size of actual tuna is very small.  but why?  I understand that is albacore but come on man....I love the staff and manager.  I made an extra effort to get there today also.  For a good albacore sandwich,,,,toasted Rye etc.  provolone.  Fredas on Ulmerton.  not as tasty as Montys  but you will get some tuna.

We used to love this place, but after tonight we will not be going back. I called to make a reservation at 11am for 5pm. I explained we had a large group with multiple young kids and they explained how kid friendly they are and looked forward to seeing us. Got there before 5 and waiting until 5:30 to be seated. Part of our group had a hungry unhappy kid who was throwing a smaller fit and they were asked to leave if they couldn't make their kid happy. 
We are so upset and can not believe that happened! We won't be going back and are completely disgusted with the way that was handled.

My wife took her truck to Ben and he began working on it immediately. He had the work done the following day even though additional parts had to be ordered that he did not anticipate. Even with the additional parts, he did not add additional costs from what was quoted when we dropped the truck off. He explained that once he quotes a price, that is the price. Even though sometimes that doesn't work in his favor, that is his policy. We had a great experience and will go to Ben if we have any future issues with our vehicles. We would highly recommend him to anyone.

Been coming here about 5 years and I'm still member giving it one star because of this one idiot work named Roy...

Never met a disrespectful worker like him ever gives me attitude doesn't let my friend in with guest pass charges me $20 when a month is $20 all the other works are cool except for him be aware don't talk to him ever total ***** I thought about quitting this gym and leaving because of him 

I stopped going to the Kenner gym because he worked there now he is at the veterans one... Everyone in the gym talks about him and how is mean and not helpful wish he would get fired
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Very good coffee/bagel/sandwich shop right down town.  Bagels are fresh, hot and have a "New York" quality.  I've tired the Chile Relleno quiche and it was out of this world.  Also had a dark chocolate brownie (not all on the same trip!).  Decadent!  A couple of things I didn't love - it was very cold when the door swung open (which was often).  Hard to enjoy breakfast.  Also, the lines to order food, coffee, and pay are all separate and there are also a lot of people milling about waiting for their order.  Chaotic and hard to know when it's your turn to order or pay.  Over all very good!

The food was good, the hostess was fake friendly when she answers the phone to take orders. We ordered almost $200 of food to go and she had no finesse in her communication skills. The two guys working in the to go side are both super friendly. They accidentally dropped part of our order when we came in to pick it up but they immediately remade it, and added complimentary food to make up for the inconvenience which I appreciated. But we live 30 minutes away and that was our first time going, we would come back but it would have to be a HUGE craving for it.

I suppose this place makes its drop-off service a priority, because walking in here is a bit troublesome. The place is very clean and well-lit, and the staff are very helpful, if needed.  However, no prices are posted anywhere, and we found ourselves re-monetizing our "wash cards" many times when it was unnecessary. The way the dryers are set up there's no obvious way to just add time when you've already got value left in your card.  It seems as though the place is making a huge profit from this obfuscation.  All in all we might try someplace else before returning.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Made reservation through Open Table, restaurant called 30 min before reservation time to inform me they couldn't keep reservations, and suggested 1-1/2 hour later, told the hostess to cancel.  Wasn't able to rebook another restaurant through OpenTable due to restaurant not being able to cancel in their system.   After calling and asking them to cancel reservation was told they didn't know how.  Now I have no dinner reservation and locked out of my OpenTable App.  Rating 1 star for poor business systems and poor customer service.

While the front desk and vet tech staff have always been pleasant and helpful, the quality of veterinary care at this office has decreased significantly. I took my (then) new dog here for the first time about a year ago and each visit since has been more frustrating and disappointing than the last. The entire veterinary staff has turned over and we had a terrible experience with the new vet during a standard annual visit last month. If you want your pet in competent hands, I strongly advise going elsewhere. Even if it's just to the other Pet Mechanic location in Northern Liberties.

I use to love to rent from National until the management took over.  When him or her took over the Special weekend promotions went away and for somebody who rent from them almost every week this has not been good.  This is forcing me to use a different rental company for most of my rentals.  
Some of the cars don't be fully cleaned but nothing major.  The counter agents are always friendly and helpful so I really enjoy renting from National before this management change.  I hope they start back offering weekends promotions at the St. Louis location again.

As a long-time Petrini's customer, I love a few things on their menu, especially the toasted provolone sandwich.  Today I deviated from my faves and ordered the minestrone soup/bread "light lunch" combo.  What a disappointment (and way overpriced to boot). I was offered the option of garlic bread in place of the French roll and ended up with two strips of dried out, chewy bread with an orangy, oily topping and a few dried basil flakes. Even dipped in the soup it was terrible. The soup was OK, but definitely not worth the price. Their pasta & sandwiches (on FRESH bread) get 5 stars.  Today's lunch gets 1 (barely).

This used to be my go-to for sushi & Japanese food but no more. The last two times I ordered takeout, I got home to discover the order was wrong. Instead of the teriyaki tempura combo, I ended up with the teriyaki chicken dinner both times. As Beatrice C. mentions in her review, it is bland and so unappetizing. Tonight they did not even include dressing for the salad that comes with this entree. Upon realizing I was charged $15 for this - a couple chicken thighs, a scoop of rice and dry, shredded cabbage that I did not order, I called the restaurant. I am so annoyed, I will be stopping in tomorrow to get my $15 refunded.

Adam - the branch manager has the worst attitude and customer service I have ever experienced. I'm on vacation here in New Orleans and was having trouble with my account, he refused to help and sat there and was dismissing my questions and concerns and was all together very condescending. He knew I was coming in to see him because I had been at another branch and he was the only one who could help and he did not want to hear me out or help. All in all - closed my account with chase and am moving my business elsewhere.

I ate here for the last time the other day. When I walked in, the workers were eating their own meals, which is fine. But I noticed that after eating their food and handling my money, they prepared my food without washing their hands and without the use of gloves... the worst part is, I ordered California roles, and I noticed the fish smelt kind of odd. I ate it anyways... I then had probably the most painful bowel movements of my entire life for the following 12 hours. I have never experienced food poising that severe. DO NOT eat here. There should be a health hazard sign right on the front door.

Just opened the bag to feed my son. The photos tell everything. 
This is why you order curb side to go for burgers anywhere else or go to five guys!!
Who is this manager? Why isn't anything double checked? What's the point of ordering? 
They just give you what they want. The the fact they only gave me one of the two fries I ordered and got that rectified made me feel lucky. I read the stickers on the burgers and thought at least the burgers were right.  Jokes on me!! 

The last time I visited this location they didn't have any kind of chicken. This time they can't get an order right. We will boycott this establishment.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
While the cream is good quality, the portions are ridiculously skimpy. Every time we go it seems like it's the staffs first time ever dipping ice cream.  If they are going to roll like that, they should sell by weight like Freddy Hill does. 

Just tried this place again, hoping it would have improved. Apparently not. The portions are still ridiculously small I just about five dollars a coon there's two tiny little micro scoops that a two-year-old would devour in about 30 seconds. Oh well, I guess we won't be here this season again.

Located within a shopping center I have to admit I was a little weary lol but they offer specials that drew me in and parking is soo accessible.  Monday- Wednesday they offer mani and pedi for $30! and I believe gel mani and pedi for $40!  On a bustling Saturday a mani and pedi is $33 and they take card! You can make an appointment or walk in. They sterilize the tools and the pedicure sink was clean. They have a large, organized choice of nail polish to choose from including OPI. They seemed to have build a rapport with their customers and they create a comfortable and clean environment to keep you coming back.

Bad times at the Sandyland Reef Inn, Absolutely the most Awful, I would not stay at any price even if I was payed to stay there cheap, dirty, ugly, bug ridden,  transient stayin, unbelievably rude staff, very noisy, no sound proofing, mold in shower having, right next to freeway and all around horrific place-should be shut down. It teminded me of the horrot mivie Bad Times at the Hotel Royale. read the bad reviews-they will tell the real story about this operation-The 5 star reviews may have been written by someone other than hotel guests possibly. I highly recommend paying a few dollars more somewhere else and have a good night sleep.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Tommy's Tire is absolutely amazing. I had to return a u-haul and there was a problem with the bill and Tommy spent well over 30 minutes past closing time on the phone with U-haul getting me my fair price. Then as I was leaving, Sam (another mechanic) heard something dragging under my car and ran after me so that he could tie up the piece of plastic all just because he knew it sounded bad. Again, this is going on 1 hour past closing time now for them. This was completely free and just because they are good people. I will forever get all car maintenance done here and definitely recommend them! They are honest and will take care of you!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Love my Starbucks, but it seems the drive through has become more of a priority that those who take the time to go in for take out. Love the atmosphere, enjoy my Starbucks coffee, but frustrated waiting for 3 lone staff members to finish serving several cars before pouring me (the only person in the cafe) my one simple regular coffee. Also wish they would change their sizes to small, medium and large I keep ordering a tall and getting a small. 

Other than that there is so much potential and I will keep going back.

I ordered two McRibs with extra sauce since the last two times ordering them they had ZERO sauce and when I got home and opened the boxes sauce was EVERYWHERE!!! The entire bottom bun was so saturated with sauce that you could not pick it up. There were onions on the outside of the bottom bun just floating in sauce.  When I called to explain how I got the food I was told "well you ordered extra sauce " and was hung up on. DISGUSTING way to serve your customers #Mcdonalds. The next time I want something quick for my kids I'll go to Burger King, where at least they will offer to fix the mess up
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I've gone back a few times. Probably 5 or so. Every time I hope it going to be better because it's in a good location. I always make an appointment and they never start until 30 minutes later.  That's happened multiple times now. I walk in on time, tell them about my appointment and when I ask how long until someone can start they put me in a pedicure chair so I won't leave. On average an hour for a pedicure. If the place was cheap I'd deal but it's not. It's pretty pricey. I really wanted to like this place but won't be going back and wouldn't recommend it based on my experiences.

I'm not going to write a huge book here bottom line unprofessional and expensive.  Oh and if they lose your personal possessions they don't care but they sure will take lots of your money.  There left hand doesn't know what the right hand is doing and the vet says she leaves instructions on take home sheet wrong lady go back and look at your own notes.  Stay away bring your animals somewhere else.  Also seems to be like a car salesman trying to get you to buy tests and services your animals really don't need what a joke.

I used to love Lolita but my experience last night was the worst I have ever experienced. The cucumber jalapeño margarita tasted like lemons and nothing like it use to. My carne asada was rare when I asked for medium. The waiter didn't even check in on how our meal was till 15 mins after we got our food.
