Even when I complained about my food, he went on to take two other table's order before even coming to take back my food back. Lolita used to be amazing and the quality was always the same but something has changed. It could be the last time i ever come. Sad to see a good restaurant go down the drain.

Actually not an entirely bad supermarket.

The food itself is good, prices are decent, layout is TONS better then campus Fresh Grocer, and they'd easily be four star if they could simply clean the place up.  

The downside is the broken glass that rarely gets cleaned up from the parking lot and general sketchiness of things at night (they do have an armed guard, but that doesn't seem to 100% fix the problem), 

Oh yeah, and if you want to use your credit card, make sure you have your drivers license--they card EVERYONE.

It's been a couple days since my haircut. It's actually getting worse. I hate it so much I wish I never went to this awful salon. Leaving two stars so everyone sees this and knows not to go here. My hair is actually embarrassing and I have to wear it in a certain way so it at least looks somewhat normal. 

---

Worst haircut of my life. The more I think about it the worse I feel. Guy did not listen at all! Avoid avoid avoid! Would give zero stars if possible. The floor was also dirty - no one swept in a while! Worst salon ever.

I visited here at 9:30PM on 4/29/2019. Both outside doors were locked. I knocked on the window because their sign said lobby open until 10PM. Idk if they didn't hear me, I had to pound quite hard for the lady at the counter to look up at me. Then she said hang on and walked away. Finally an older person came and opened the door saying the others had no sense. They told me I couldn't have a tray, only a bag, all trays were gone. No biggie, but odd. 

Food was good. I left and checked the door, still wasn't even 10 minutes till 10. The door again locked when I left. That's kind of wrong to have posted hours and lock the doors before then.

I found Joe at Salon Bass by googling "ombré hair Philadelphia" after getting pretty awful balayage highlights elsewhere. Joe did a fantastic job on my hair. It has the ombré look I wanted, and you can't even tell that I ever had stripey, ugly highlights. I wish I found him the first time around, but better late than never!

The salon is in a convenient location and it's a great space-comfortable and open with tons of natural light.  Everyone who works there was friendly and fun, and the prices are very reasonable.  Highly recommended!

Worst McDonalds in Tucson. We live not too far so we come for dinner or breakfast every once in a while. In the drive through, three times I have been pulled forward and forgotten about 4 times now.. Sitting there waiting for food while I end up getting out, going in and they are stunned I have an order. Restraunt is disgusting, not clean and 9/10 they will get your order wrong. Ordered cheeseburger only bacon and ketchup for my daughter, got mustard and onion and no bacon. Mcdonalds is already bad enough, this one is nasty. Employees are not even apologetic, almost like this is their norm.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I have been to any number of 24 Hour Fitnesses and enjoyed them and their amenities. Unfortunately, this one is filthy and badly maintained. Went to a different health club and letting my 2 year costco membership simply run out. 

Heard and thought that they were going to make major improvements after 24 hour fitness was bought by an investment group (a teacers retitement fund) and had continued my membership. Unfortunately the Santa Barbara facility stayed same (actually got worse).

Pluses: like some of their equipment. Minuses: dirty; no parking.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: My son raved about this place for a while before he agreed to pay for dinner for the family if we could order their pizza. I agreed- what teenager would pay for the pizza if he didn't have to? We ordered the Buffalo Pizza (his fave) and the Supreme. Both pizzas were beautiful and full of toppings. We got home and tried them, and I was pleasantly surprised! The Buffalo Pizza is spicy, but not overbearingly spicy; the chicken was seasoned well. The Supreme Pizza had lots of pepperoni, green peppers, sausage and cheese! The crust doesn't taste like the frozen pizza crusts at fast food pizza places which is nice! Over all, we loved their pizza!

Honestly not a fantastic place. We ordered some salmon dinner combos and it was dull and flavorless, majority of the flavor came from the sauce it was drowned in. Cold in the middle, sent back, cold again. Sushi was not the best either, it was clearly not fresh and the staff put us at fault and got upset that we didn't like it. They were clearly annoyed at us and service kept getting worse and worse. The food is super over priced for such bad quality. On top of that, they charge the most ridiculous amount of tax. Don't think I will return here, hope they improve for themselves.

Large number of gnats in the room, I have a creepy feeling they are biting - raises a lot of questions about why there would be gnats in the room. I'm going to have to sleep with the covers over my head and buy bug spray tomorrow. Sink drain does not drain so I have to brush my teeth in the tub.sinks that don't drain gross me out. On the upside there is a coffee maker, microwave and mini fridge in the room. People in the office are nice enough. But right now some very loud people in the room next to me, walls are thin. Carpet could be replaced.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Was there with my sisters on one occasion and my mother on another and both visits were unpleasant. The Dr they see is nice and very personable but the associate working the front, named Sally is ignorant. On both visits she had an unnecessary attitude with my family and myself.  Once over glasses pricing and the visit before that she just seemed so miserable and like we were a burden. I'm in the customer service industry and this is unacceptable behavior. She should work in the back away from customers if she can't fix her bad attitude. My family and myself will be going elsewhere.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is a belated review, but I wanted to express that Dr. Bufkin did such a wonderful job helping me when I had to put my beloved Akita to sleep during the Christmas Holidays last year. He had cancer, and it just broke my heart to have to put him down. He was everything to me. She came to the house, and in a very kind and caring manner helped me send him off to heaven. I am so happy I chose her, and would recommend her to anyone who wishes to have a mobile vet. She is a sweet woman, having even sent me a card after the ordeal. Thank you, Dr. Bufkin.

When I drove up to place my order, I was told, "one second." So I waited & they took someone else's order who came 5mins after me. Then when I got to the window to get my food, I was asked, "you got the 20 piece?" I said, "yes." Then she continued to asked me again, "did you get the 20 piece?" With a attitude & I replied "yes." I drove off with my food while they laugh & giggled. It led me to think that they had tampered with my food. They need to get rid of the employees there & start fresh. I wish I can give this McDonald's zero stars because it does not even deserve 1 star
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Didn't like this place. I really felt like my food was inedible. All the vegetables were severely over cooked. My broccoli in my garlic broccoli was very pale in color and mushy. The Buddha's delight dish was equally bad. Over cooked, mushy vegetables. The tofu didn't taste like tofu. Both sauces on these dishes tasted off. I couldn't bring myself to eat this food. The vegetable fried rice was the best of what we ordered, but that isn't saying much. I am not sure how this place is still open. I haven't met Chinese food I didn't like until now. Definitely would not go back. #yuck

Found out about this place a month ago and was very excited to try it  .I placed a order tonight of  a crispy chicken salad and chicken strips with a dessert  tiramisu. food came and the salad didn't look like a crispy chicken and more like  over cooked chicken from a few days ago and the tiramisu was horrible to say the least .I was visiting my mother and wanted to treat her to dinner but it was a hit and a miss . I am still confused because I orderd from this place last night and the food was great.  tonight just horrible food . Never again!

3 stars is being nice but I don't wanna give 0 bc our actual pizza was good. We ordered cheese bread sticks. My advice, check your food carry out order before you leave. I received flat as a pancake, burnt to the crisp, and hard as a rock "cheese bread sticks."  I called ASAP and they couldn't deliver a new one (insert eye roll) so they are going to credit me to have a new one next time I order. I'm hesitant to even order again. I don't even know who thought this was a good idea to box up. CLEARLY, this isn't edible.

Worst rental company ever!! I waited almost an hour at pick up station. No shuttle!!  come to find out, they are off site. Not even at airport! When I called their office they said it would be 20 min. Lies! Finally when he came he said you should have waived when I drove by!! 6 lanes over from pick up area.  Stated " I can't read your mind". Get to their office, they have no car for me.  Very rude  at counter. Stated  "well he can't keep driving by, you are late"!!
Oh also stated I now have to pay a reinstatement fee. so now I am in an Uber 1.30 after landing.

We have lived in the Lawncrest neighborhood for about 4 years, and Salerno ' s has always been our go to for pizza.  The food quality has always been consistently good.  However, when we ordered delivery last night everything exceeded our already high expectarions.  The girl who answered the phone was friendly and thorough to make sure she had our order correct.  The food came in about 25 minutes (really fast for a Friday night) and everything was hot and fresh.  We ordered a small tomato pie, minestrone soup, cheesesteak, and curly fries with cheese.....all delicious.  Thanks Salernos for providing this neighborhood with quality eats!

I'm only giving a one star because I have to click something. I only ordered breadsticks over the phone. It took me to a foreign country (even the cashier said that) and took forever to order breadsticks. When I got their I ordered another garlic sauce. Cashier turned around and told the young man she needed a sauce. He raised up with a full sub (subway, cup was on shelf too) IN HIS MOUTH. He was actually eating over where the pizzas a cut and boxed. How unsanitary. I cannot imagine how many violations he broke with the board of health plus the lack of professionalism. I went from chatting with the cashier (friendly) to absolutely disgusted.

Excellent service! I recommend this store for all of your car maintenance. 

After my first visit here, I was left with a minor valve issue (unknown to anyone at the time) that snowballed into a costly tire repair. Within minutes of me returning to the shop, the owner Ryan went absolutely above and beyond to resolve the issue. Both he and his staff are efficient, knowledgeable, and honest. I cannot thank them enough for the way they handled my repair. I have found my new go-to and will trust this Meineke shop for all of my car needs.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Been here twice, and the first time I had pizza. It was ok, but nothing standout. Second time, my husband and I went and ate their chicken parmesan and the rigatoni, I believe. I don't know if it was an "off" day as it was around the time when restaurants started closing for coronavirus, and we also arrived close to closing time, but the food tasted reheated and almost cafeteria-like. I wasn't super impressed with it. The service has been good both times, though, and staff is friendly. I do like the atmosphere as well. Feels quaint and romantic.

Hart's Tavern does not deserve a '1' - but it's the lowest option.  It has been 20 years since i tried this place.  Returning in 20 years would be too soon.  One of the worst meals ever and  not even worth the reasonable price charged. This restaurant obviously gets all of the food frozen and heat it up.  Terrible, terrible.  Walk 1/2 block down the street to Caleb's which is a "scratch kitchen" and reasonably priced.  At least it will be 'real food'. i wish we had done this.   Hart's does not deserve to be open !!.  Don't go here - EVER!  "Atrocious" is the word

I've always had a decent experience at Osaka, but tonight left a very poor taste in my mouth.  My family ordered takeout and was told the wait would be 40 minutes.  Fine with us, except when we arrived to pick up our food 40 minutes later, they hadn't even started our order.  Cut to nearly 20 minutes later, we've finally received our food; however, they messed up the order!  Needless to say, we didn't want to stay any longer for them to remake the part of the order so we just took it and left.  What an awful customer service experience!

I can't believe how highly Rittenhouse Fitness it rated, it must be based solely on price.  Quite frankly, I still think it costs too much given the state of the locker rooms and how every single day at least one treadmill is broken.  I think I could handle the broken machines if the locker rooms weren't so gross.  There's a difference between no frills and decrepit. There's been a hole above one of the showers in the women's room for months and it's just generally unclean.  I assume the only reason it maintains members are the lack of options in the area.  Hopefully the new Graduate Hospital gym will serve as a better option.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This has been the worst experience I have ever had at the eye doctors. There was a complete lack of customer service. The receptionists seem to have personal vendetta's against a select few of their clients, they are rude and completely unprofessional. Quite frankly I don't know how they have not been fired. They also have been unreliable on keeping my eye records, and only seem to care about the $$$. I will NEVER recommend this place to anyone. Some advice? Try to be nice to your clientele so that we want to come back.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This place can not get a drive thru order correct if their lives depended on it. The people are all nice, the food is okay but I don't remember not having an issue with getting an accurate order. I work close to here and this particular Wendy's has become a joke among us that you can go thru the drive thru and you never know what you will get. More likely what you won't get. They are able to accurately ring through all the items correctly but somehow they lose focus when getting the order into the bag. The wait time I usually pretty long too.

I pulled my last review of this Anytime Fitness because I've seen a lot of changes since I started my membership -- and they're for the better. Here's what I love: the camaraderie of the members (everyone smiles and says hello and encourages me); the fitness classes (especially yoga!) are included (and they now have times that enable me to make it after work); and they're upgrading the equipment gradually and spiffing things up in the changing rooms. Our options in South St. Pete are limited but I'm really glad Anytime's here! With 24-hour access there are no excuses for not going! :)
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: While the selection of beer is big, many of the prices are simply outrageous. Here you can expect to pay up to twice the amount of $ for the same beer that can be found at other nearby places. For instance, they were selling Lagunitas The Waldos for $22 (before tax) whereas every other place around was selling it for around $13. Guy at the counter tried to sell me some BS about how their prices are determined by the distributor! Yeah, right.... he changed his story when I called him out on it. Oh, and they opened at 11:30 on a Monday even though they claim to open at 10 am.

This was in Sep, 2020

Good: The hotel is very nice and at a very pretty location. 

Not so pleasant: The room has water leaking from the AC and a technician had to come and rewrap the pipes; The bathroom ventilation was not working and a fan was called in. 

Not convenient: The property had no laundry room. 

Thought provoking: Right behind the hotel it is an area with factories and buildings that are not so pretty. It is probably just one street away but you feel like you have entered a different world. 

Overall it is a very good experience. I just feel for that price, I'd expect a bit more quality.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I arrived to the dunkin and order my iced chai latte with almond milk and snackin bacon. I paid for my order and was handed the chai. Then the man that was working asked what else I was waiting on and I said my bacon. He then went over to sand which station and DID NOT put gloves on and reached in the bacon box and used his dirty hands to grab the bacon and place it in a bag. I work in the food service industry and know that not wearing gloves is 1000% against shop policy as well as Health Inspections. I will be calling corporate to inform them as well.

I was with Grow FCU back when it was MacDill FCU in the 90's.  They always had great service and no problems doing business with me. As long as I treated them fair and well, which I always did, even during the Great Recession, they were good to me. 

But more recently they seem to act like just another big name bank like Chase or BoA. That's not what a credit union is supposed to be. After all the years I spent with them, now GTE Financial and more recently Achieva CU seem to want and value me more with service and great rates than Grow, like my long and very good history with them means nothing anymore.

This McDonald's is one of the worst I have ever visited. Drive through worker takes forever to get to you even when no cars are in line. You wonder if you should leave or say hello so they know you are there. They have no idea what they serve and give incorrect information. They always get the order wrong and try to make it seem that it is your fault. The workers walk in in what looks like pajamas with shirts untucked and sometimes no uniform at all. There are an abundance of flies near the food although it is winter. The workers act like any work is an inconvenience and have terrible customer service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Worst service ever. I understand it's the time of covid and the world is short staffed, but this place was not. There was two other tables with 4 waitresses. It took about 15 minutes before someone checked in on us. The waitress just walked so slow and was not friendly at all. We waited ages for the food, like I said, only two other tables. The appetizers were good, the rolls were hit and miss but nothing special by any means. We were there for an hour and a half and it was truly grueling. There are much better sushi places in Reno, avoid this one!!

You can't go wrong with the place.  Solid sushi, good atmosphere, great prices, and BYOB.

While I'm certainly not a sushi connoisseur like some other reviews, I would like to think that I can taste the difference between good and bad sushi.  Shinju Sushi consistently impresses me with their fresh, creative rolls.

Worth noting is that this place is SMALL.  Reservations can be good idea.  Also, the service can be a bit slow but never inattentive.  Considering the size of the space, their almost non-existent kitchen and great prices I've never found the service to be a problem.  Just don't expect to dine and dash.

My family lives five minutes away from Voyager Bar and Grill so I didn't expect our food to be luke warm.  We ordered a 16" meat pizza and a burger with fries.  Well the pizza was kind of doughy and not hot, we had to microwave it.  I ordered an angus burger minus the bun and lettuce only with fries.  The burger tasted alright except for the burnt bottom of the patty and the lettuce was wilted and brown, I was glad I had my own lettuce at home to replace it with.  The french fries were barely warm and we had to microwave them as well.  We will not be going to the Voyager Bar and Grill again even though local residents have recommended them.

Hole in the wall Pizza spot. It's hot as hell inside, nowhere to sit, plus The Pizza is trash & overpriced.  The pizza is typically burnt or lacking toppings.  But worse of all, The owner is a complete *sshole. Being a small business owner myself, I went there to support him a few times, but he's a dick. There's a heap of firewood out front, and on my recent visit I polity inquired about buying 1 or 2 pieces for a home fire pit - he completely dismissed me in the rudest way. I definitely won't be supporting this place again.  

Ardmore Pizza Is Way Better

The food is good but the service is terrible. First, the app doesn't work -- hell, it doesn't even list the correct phone number!

The cashiers don't pay attention. I don't know if they are poorly trained or just don't care. Last time I ordered I arrived to see my order sitting in the shelf. The cashier printed my receipt but did nothing to check on the order. I asked about it three times and was dismissed each time. She didn't even look at the name on the order. 

Finally, after the fourth time asking, they gave me my order. 

This is poor service. I hope they read this and fix the problem.

This place is an absolute mess. The customer service is terrible. I went there today (8/20) at 9:45 and there was a line in both the drive thru and inside. No help at all! Meanwhile the supervisor was arguing with a staff member. The supervisor was berating the staff member in front of everyone while customers were standing around waiting for service. Ridiculous. 

On other occasions staff have been sitting. They don't even acknowledge you when you pull up to pay. Rather, they stick their hand out for your money dismissively. The food isn't even that good.

There are plenty of choices around. Try those.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
These guys are mechanics you can trust. I've been there 3 times and have been 100% satisfied each time. Both foreign and American vehicles. The Fontaine's are very nice and extremely professional. They bend over backwards to accommodate their customers. I love how thorough and quick they are. Each time I assume I will be without my vehicle for a week (as has been my experience with most mechanics) they tell me it will be done the next day. And it was each time. I can only hope they stay in business a very long time.

Thank you.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This was our 4th time here in a couple years.  This time the place was beautiful inside with the painted tables and chairs making it very inviting.  This time I got the large sampler of starters just for myself and I could bearly eat it all.  Delicious.  What a wonderful surprise.  My wife thoroughly enjoyed her chicken/avocado salad.  Her ONLY complaint was no coffee or hot beverage of any kind.  She loves her coffee.  So that lack cost Chulas one star.  There must be a new manager because the ambience is awesome now.  Made a great New Year's dinner for we 70+ year olds.  Best in Hernando County so far.

A small sports bar beach handout, that doesn't serve food.  No steaks  or burgers here. A good place for a evening drink  
The shuffle board game is fun, and cheap to play. If you haven't done  this in years it's time for 
You to shuffle in.   The most food is a bag of chip that you'll get here, so arrive to drink.  
Most locals hit this afternoon and nights, there are happy  hour prices in effect most days.  The biggest draw for Reds is the NFL games, hockey, baseball  and hoops.  Check with the locals who are friendly to avoid tourists traps.   And go and enjoy a good cold  beer  .

A cat was attacked by dogs in my neighborhood.  We scooped him up and started to banfield to try to save the cat.  Though the cat was in very bad shape, we wanted to do as much as we could for him.  Banfield told us they had regular appts and were too busy to see the dying cat.  They refused to see him and told us we'd have to go somewhere else.  We tried two locations and both refused to see him.  I understand having a schedule, but if you bring an animal to a vet that needs help, you would think they would help it.  We are now making arrangements to bury the cat.

We usually overlook the poor, and sometimes rude service, because we like their crispy chicken sandwich. Until tonight. There was a wilted piece of lettuce the size of my thumb. Not even on the sandwich but in the wrapper. The chicken was inedible. Tried to pull it apart but couldn't. It was all grisly and rubbery. Threw it away. My husband looked at his Chili. It was all liquid nothing else. So bad service AND bad food. We will not go back. It's too bad. We don't have many options here.
Didn't even want to give it that one star.

I am from Yonkers NY and regularly travel down to West Chester for business. I make sure to stop at Fellini's every chance I get.  The food is fresh and consistent with huge portions. I am always well received by the manager who is kind enough to humor us by attempting to speak to me in Italian. I typically dine by myself when I am at Fellini's and have never had any issues with being seated.

I'm not very adventurous but I typically order the same dish each time. I always ask for the grilled Italian porkchop with a side of broccoli raab. I don't understand why they don't have this as a regular menu item...

Went here for lunch for the first time and we were pleasantly surprised by the atmosphere, staff and food quality. Even the 1/2 prices sushi was well above what was expected. 

I had a shrimp tempura roll and a NY strip meal. My wife and son had the shrimp hibachi. The chef was great and funny. The food was seasoned and cooked so well. The only thing that we felt that needed improvement was the clear soup. It barely had any seasoning so it was more like water than soup. The rest of the food was really tasty and we can't wait to come back again!  What a hidden gem.

Being a CWE resident, Kampai is our go-to sushi joint.  Consistently well done.  Friendly staff.  We usually sit at the sushi bar for dinner, but the times we've sat at a table the service was good.

We don't typically order rolls, but focus more on a tempura appetizer and the freshness of our simple sushi.  Theirs is always extremely fresh, well presented, and the rice underneath is just right.  Occasionally the sushi chef will slip us something interesting on a small plate for us to try.  

We highly recommend Kampai. (Then why only 4 stars and not 5?  Five is reserved for the "absolutely blown away" dining experience.)

The tacos are great here. Small portions - so you can try quite a few and enjoy the variety.  Apps and atmosphere is great as well / good indoor and outdoor seating.  The drinks are well made craft cocktails - the old Thymer is like liquid heaven in a glass.   Before pandemic I would have given this place 5 stars every time we came.  However last three times we've come they have new system where you order all your food online - no servers.  Each time our food has as come out at least 30min ahead of any drinks - so you end up enjoying your meal and your ready to leave... then your drinks show up lol‍‍

To start off my wife started out original account with AZSSCU in 1999, almost 20 years ago. 
When the name changed a little while back and all of your long time employees quit the branch it was a sign. Any semblance of customer service has gone out the window. 
The last 6 months have been the worst. Constant turnover because you have disrespectful staff. After all these years of business today will be my last time setting foot in your Alvernon branch. 

Thank goodness for Michelle and her team at Park. It's a further drive from my house but 100% worth it!!!

Can't even rate the quality of the food because I didn't eat it. Service was horrible. Say fir an extended period of time waiting to order. When the server delivered my food she didn't even look at me as she sat it on the table and walked away. I wanted condiments for my burger. I waited and waited. Never could get her attention, nor did she ever come to check on me, until I stood up to walk out. I offered to pay for the drink but the food was cold by the time I finally got her to the table. I told her I wasn't eating the food now that it was cold. I also had a flight to catch. Definitely not a good choice for dinner.

So the first thing I don't get is how this Macdonalds upgrades all fancy and they end up being twice as slow. Second, after coming here after a long drive very hungry, I was excited to get home and start grubbing. Sadly, when I got home and started eating, my wife and I were very disappointed in our meal. I feel like our food was not made with love. What I mean is that your workers there don't care how they prepare your food. They just throw it in a box and make you pull out front and wait for them to bring it all to come home and find out there's no love in it. I don't think I'll be coming here anymore after my experience at this location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: They have decent food! However, the customer service is HORRIBLE! My family and I went here on Mothers Day, and we ended up leaving after waiting 45 minutes to place our order. The waitress brought our menus out and some bread (bread wasn't even all that good nor hot) after that she went ghost. The manager didn't seem to care once we got his attention. Multiple of my family members walked around the restaurant to find our waitress, she was nowhere to be found. We luckily found the manager and He said he would come take our order but he never did. So we left after waiting patiently for 45 min to place our order.

Decided to try out an actual meal instead of the pizza. About 30 min later , started to feel nauseated.  I should have known better when I saw the waitress take a  huge barrel that contained salad dressing, and started filling it up the new dressing with the old. If she was doing this in front of the customers, can you imagine what the hell they do behind close doors? Just go to another place to eat, plain and simple. As you see from the many comments pertaining to the horrible quality, not one mention from a manager stating otherwise. Even they agree!

Went here today ordered a fish filet sandwhich and a deluxe quarter pounder and we received this. Definitely does not look like pics on web site.  I'm sorry but this is not what you server customers. Is this the way the cook eats his food. It's disgusting. This location definitely needs improvement. 
I also went here last week and they forgot to give me a item. So I had to run in and manager told me well I was telling you to hold on and you just got out of line. When I didn't even have the manager serving me my food it was a worker. So rude... they don't even say hi or bye when you pull up.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We ate in the dining room, although I've heard the bar food is better?  Outrageously expensive for some of the worst Italian food we've ever experienced! Family birthday dinner for 8, only one good meal among us. Crabmeat pasta was clearly canned crab meat, vodka chicken meat chewy and gravy not at all impressive, Linguini Alfredo - the worst (small bowl $20 with no meat!), Raviolis were poor to fair, and gravy was totally unimpressive.  Meatballs were decent and Calamari was good. Fruit flies in wine in the middle of winter indicate a problem!

The service that I received from AMANDA ALLERS was nothing short of disgusting!  She has no customer service skills and does not belong working in a bank. Further, the teller that I had to deal with had absolutely no concept of how the TD Visa/Debit card functions in the U.S.  She was unaware that it doesn't function as a debit card the way it does in Canada.  But she was such a rude know-it-all, she refused to listen. 
I'm a long time TD customer of this branch (over 20 years) and they demonstrate no appreciation or respect. Major attitude adjustments needed at this branch!

I came in to get my tires rotated and balanced and the lady quoted me 8.00 for balance and 10.00 for rotation so I'm like ok cool, good deal for a used tires place. I went to pay and the lady talking about 50.00 total so of course I looked at them like they crazy.  The man in there talking about its 15 for suv wtf??? Then had the nerve to tell me I must have misunderstood and it's 8.00 per tire for balance.  Clearly if she would have told me that,  I would've refused. Why would I pay 50 for a balance and rotate there when I can get it at Tire Kingdom for less.  This place is garbage
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Frankie provided a five stars service.
I didn't have a reservation and didn't mind sitting by the bar, but my seat was terrible everytime someone entered a gush of cold air hits my back, I asked if I could be re-seated somewhere else but with no luck. 

The food now I can't remember everything's name but I am attaching pictures. I didn't like the spicy thing on top of what I think is the volcano order or something that was recommended because I like spicy I don't know. 

The superstar was the ceviche, was just perfect 
And Frankie was great :)) I really enjoyed my experience

I went here with a couple friends on a Monday afternoon and was not impressed.  Firstly, the restaurant was absolutely freezing to the point where I had to go out to the car to get a sweatshirt on an 85 degree day. They had a total of one chef and one waiter for the entire restaurant so the service was extremely slow.  I sat at the sushi bar for 15 minutes before I finally had to call the chef over so I could order something.  The rolls were ok at best but the fish was fresh at least.  Waiter was very slow at clearing our plates.

I will not be coming back here again.

I have a CD that comes due in mid March but I am leaving the country for a month. One week before it is due I wanted to stop it's renewal. I can't do that with out sacrificing 3 months interest. I have to remember to call from Australia in one week and put all the #s in answer ALL the questions wait for 10min for someone to answer to just stop a CD from being renewed.  I have 3 accts all paid on time at Wells, a mortgage, very active CC and CD and do you think they would cash a $100. ck from MY Union Bank tax acct? Topper is that I have (soon had) been a customer since 1969.

I've just moved to Indianapolis and this is the second vet I have visited. The staff members were friendly, but not as professional as I had hoped. They were also quite young, including the vet I saw.

I was told that they would need to sedate my cats just to trim their nails, yet my cats have had their nails trimmed at vets in Bloomington, Texas, and Israel nearly every month for their entire lives without needing sedation.

Rather than taking the time to get to know the cats--not to mention me, who spends a fortune on the little darlings--I was told that if I refused to sedate them I was welcome to go to another vet. I am disappointed.

If you're looking for an old-school barbering experience, keep looking. This place is supercuts with some Phillies junk on the walls. The tools of the trade (hot lather machines, straight razors, shave brushes) are on display, however they are for display only. There are in fact no barbers at this barber shop, it is a bunch is hairdressers or stylists that are far more interested in gabbing with each other than giving a decent haircut. They don't even shave your neck, what kind of barber doesn't shave your neck?

This place is nice and their work is pretty good as well. Some things I did notice is they pack people in like sardines. No plexi glass anywhere to protect the client,the chairs are not 6ft apart,every station is full plus 3-4 people waiting.  Then the Asian man tech at the very last station in the back of the salon is on some kind of drug. I could see his mouth going a mile a minute under his mask and we were not talking
He was fast but not in a good way, his work felt and was very rushed. My fills look as though they already have regrowth and are a week or so old. This place is a bit pricey.

Craig miles  of the location is rude unprofessional and heartless .. i rented a truck in Bosie ID for work travel to Twinfalls , my wife is going through cancer treatments and I was called home immediately.. I spoke to the Twinfalls counter help they were brilliant, they said just call the Bosie location and let them know.. I did and had to leave a message   .. so I get a message .. full rate and 500 dollar drop charge ,, I call and end up with mr.. CRAIG MILES  explain my situation .. his answer ... tough shit ... love you Craig you heartless coward we will meet again..

My sister and I both had our dogs cared for at Narberth Animal.  Dr Jill Stetz and her staff were warm, caring, and very available to us.  Dr. Jill explained each problem to us thoroughly and carefully and answered our questions fully.  In each case, she told us what care or treatment options were available and she gave recommendations when we asked for them.  When our dogs got old and sick, Dr. Jill euthanized them with loving care.  She cares deeply about the pets in her care and their owners.  Our experiences were always 5-star, and when we have our next pets, we will take them straight to her.
Judy D and Jack G

Authentic! Delicious and great service! Attentive knowledgeable servers! We had the portabello appetizer and it was served chilled with tomato, arugula, burratta and balsamic glaze! Outstanding! Then we had the lasagna which changes daily. Tonight it was lamb and had the choice of pink or red sauce. I opted for pink which was slightly sweet and amazing flavor. I would recommend this very quaint and yet casual dinner spot! I'm just sad I've never been here after living here so long! That will change forever now!

Food is really good but it's annoying they always charge me for things they never bring. Last time I ordered a bunch of food. My Caesar salad was missing and they argued with me I wasn't changed for it until I had to show my receipt and they finally gave it to me an hour later. Then tonight they charge me 2$ for a side of sauce for my Stromboli and of course it's not there. I'm just about done with them. And it's a shame bc we were going to have our xmas party catered by them but chose to go else where bc they are so ridiculous.

Fish didn't look good through window at bar (dry). Tasted as bad as it looked. Place was pretty empty early afternoon on a Saturday. Started getting stomach ache within 20-minutes of finishing "all you can eat" & then pretty upset stomach (and what goes w/that) for over 2-hours after :-(  Doubt food poisoning, but definitely not fresh fish. The service was good & friendly staff, but that's about it. Pisces in South Reno (South Meadows) is definitely the best & trust me we've tried most of them in the 22-years lived in the area!

If I could give no or negative stars I would. This is a self service car wash. There are no attendants there. The vacuum cleaners suck. They won't even pick up a small dime size piece of paper. No suction at all. The carpet cleaner works when it wants too. The actual car wash part is ok as long as there's actually soap and stuff stocked in the brushes. Trash is always over flowing and the way the lot is set up if your just there to vacuum up something the vacs are behind the actual wash building which makes you slightly secluded. With there not being any other frequently operated businesses real close this is so Not safe.

The best part about the Montebello is leaving it. We moved into a mice infested unit, our dog was mauled by a large Akita that was an unregistered neighbors dog  (thank goodness it wasn't a child), every grass area in the complex is covered in feces, theres an overwhelming amount of trash in every trash station and the gym/pool area are extremely unkept. The one thing they do well at the Montebello is fight you for you deposit. Don't believe me, read the other yelp reviews. If we can get at least one person to NOT move into this place by writing this review, then it was worth our efforts.

Dunkin, please keep the miserable employees away from the window. This guy: when I pulled up: silence. So I hand him my debit card. Silence. He hands me my card and the receipt. Silence. He hands me my coffee, silence. Then I had to wait for my bagel order. He leans out on the window sill, in silence. Bagels are ready, he hands them to me, in silence. Perhaps he took a vow of silence? Maybe if you have employees that take vows of silence, you don't put those people at the window where they are customer facing.

The room was very clean, so good job housekeeping!
I was disappointed that there wasn't a bathrobe, but not a necessity, so that's fine!
There was complementary coffee in the room, and there is a complementary breakfast buffet every morning, which had a small selection, but was warm and filling, so it was perfect!
There is a pool and a gym in the building, and vending machines on most floors.
At first, I thought it was great that there was a deck, but with no seating on the deck, we didn't spend any time out there. Also, there is no smoking aloud on the deck, and a hefty fine if you do smoke there.
All in all, a decent place to spend the night!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I live right down the street from Cinco so it is my go-to Mexican restaurant.  I even order the exact same meal each time I go.  I have always had great food and service-until last night.  

Both service and food were horrible and for a slow Tuesday night, it was a little difficult to understand why.   My order came out wrong, chips and drinks were not refilled in a timely manner and once my order was corrected, it tasted horrible.  I am really hoping that this was all an one time issue.  I plan to give it another shot in a few weeks and hopefully the food and service will be back to acceptable standards.

Decided on a mobile vet due to our senior dog and difficulty getting her to the vet.  Definitely the best decision I could have made for our sweet girl.  Dr. Ashley was very knowledgeable and extremely thorough providing me with a great plan to make our girl comfortable in her golden years.  She listened to me ramble on about 13 years of pure joy our dog has provided for us which is why we want to do everything we can for her.  Absolutely great experience and I would recommend using this service for anyone..our reason was particular due to senior issues but I would recommend Dr. Ashley for any pet at any age!

Fair price and close to the casino. But no access to cabs or shuttles to it from there. The rooms were relatively nice, but smelled of way too much air freshener and fabric softener. I know they were doing renovations, but the place looked like a shithole. One of the elevators had the message "Don hearts crystal meth," so you know some classy individuals stay here. But then again...it's St. Charles so no surprise. The pool is a nice touch, but the only ice machine is on the first floor. I'd only stay here if you're on a serious budget.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place has gone down hill big time in the last few months. Yesterday the soap dispenser wasn't working. One guy used a soapy brush to go around the car quickly before starting the wash cycle. Result was as to be expected. The time before the blow dryers weren't working and the car came out like it was just hosed down. Before that the wax dispenser wasn't working. Directly outside the exit of the machine, there are three large pot holes that you have to avoid if you don't want to risk a flat tire.I'm now looking for a new car wash spot.

The people are nice  and the clothes look great , however , you will pay an exaggerated premium.  I don't like that they don't have prices listed like their competing  dry cleaners  . If you dropped something off and they happen to email a coupon ....forget about the discount. Unfortunately if you don't print it and provide it while dropping off they don't honor and a couple of times I have had happened they "forget" to input the info.

I believe their business plan needs an update when so many corporations are allowing people to work from home where dry cleaning may be obsolesced.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Dr. Sterling is OK, although she did attempt to prescribe me $200+ eye drops without giving me a heads-up about the price first. My real issue with the practice is Pat, the receptionist/technician, who is generally rude and argumentative. When I brought my eyeglasses in for adjustment, she kept telling me they were fine, when I could see with my own eyes they weren't. She finally relented, but she never could get them right, and the optics and fit suffered because of it. They never were comfortable. To me, it's worth avoiding this place just to not have to deal with Pat.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Brought my 2011 Chevy Silverado work truck in for an oil change yesterday.  The bottom of the truck was covered with mud.  The mechanic told me he could not change my oil because he could not find the oil filter due to the amount of mud on the underside of the the truck.  I took the truck to Take 5 in Brandon and they had no issue finding the oil filter (they were able to show me the filter).  They were surprised that someone could not find the oil filter.
I would not have confidence bringing another vehicle in for a for an oil change at Car Wash on the Greens.

We had a great first time experience at Eric's Auto Repair.  Just got our car back after a $400 repair which was a lower price compared to other local shops.   The job actually took less labor time than Eric's initial quote and they reduced the price without being asked.   We will definitly be going back to Eric's for future inspections and repairs.  Learned that Eric and his team have been at that location since 2002 so we're also happy to take our car in for maintenance/repairs to a longstanding local family business.

I go here cause it's close, but I don't get meat or anything else that requires refridgeration. Frozen section is fine. During the summer, they kept their front (supposed to be automated) door open. They probably wasted so much money on keeping the store cold, not that it has that "I trust the food here" grocery store feel otherwise. Produce is overpriced. Milk that was past the sell-by date was on the shelf. Checkout clerks are friendly. It seemed like they hired more people in the last year, which is good. Avoid at 6pm, though. Still long lines.

We have lived here for 6 months and have no complaints! We have two small dogs and they are always accommodated for! Many pet stations around the community and such a great location to walk your dogs down Westshore and the surrounding neighborhoods! We love the amenities and find that they are well taken care of! The staff is always kind and tried their best to make sure we are taken care of. Trash collection is always on time and I never have to worry about bringing my trash down stairs. A great complex to live in!

This place is very small very outdated and not well-kept at all to say the least. We have booked another hotel closer to where we live just so that we can take a shower we have not even taken a shower at this location. We were basically tricked into staying here through Priceline who gave us the worst of three choices and took our money which was nonrefundable so we have no choice but to stay here for Valentines weekend and we would never recommend this place to anyone not even for just an overnight stay because you can't take a decent bath here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place has the best carne asada in Tucson. We used to come at least once a month. Slowly though, over the last couple of years, this place has gone to hell. Their hours apparently changed - more than once we've pulled in and they are closing at like 6:00 pm! They also stopped selling guacamole - they only have that runny avocado sauce now. Went today and the rice was hard & dry - like it had been sitting a while. Very disappointing. Still love their carne asada, but I don't know if I'll bother coming back now that they can't seem to serve anything to go w/it.

I did not pick up at airport.  Awful drop off. I'm 48 years old, have rented 
Numerous cars in my life. Upon drop off rude young lady employee 
Is present. I politely state, I don't need receipt,  she barks at me , well I 
Don't give them. Wow. This was early March 2021. This escalates. I am aware gas tank was not full . I was aware I did not vacuum car. I was 
Already prepared for a fee of 100.00 for gas and vacuum.  A few days 
Proceed, they email me a 450.00 bill. What? I have tried a few times to 
Negotiate a fare charge, can not reach them. What a scam.

Amore Mio is definitely an amazing authentic Italian food restaurant! We had their prosciutto pizza, spaghetti with meatballs and seafood fettuccine. All three dishes were more than amazing! The taste as well as freshness of the food were out of this world and the service was exceptional (felt just like if we were visiting family). I wish we would have known about this restaurant earlier. I guaranteed once you eat here, you will never go back to any other chain Italian restaurant!! Don't forget to try their desserts too.. the tiramisu and limonecello cake are to die for! We can't wait to go back

The selection at this store is always average at best. However, it will suffice when you're in a rush. The biggest issue with this store is their personnel. The employees who work there are rude and completely uninterested in their jobs. I had one employee disrespect me when I politely asked which register was open to pay at. I spoke to the manager before leaving the store but got the impression that they're all friends and there would be no discipline for the rude employee. I rather walk a few extra few blocks and not be treated so poorly.

I can't believe I'm reviewing a fast food place, but this location is ridiculous. In the suburbs, your options for late night food are this and Wawa. Working until late night, i pretty regularly swing by for a snack in my way home. I don't remember the last time I've had even like-warm fries, much less hot ones. They never give the right number of chicken nuggets- I'm not talking about a 20 piece or something- I'm talking about a four piece. Today, I got two. And the frosty machine hasn't been working for about three months. I can't believe that- I think the staff is just too lazy to make me one. Just horrible.

There's much I like about Bettina, namely the food and drinks, but sadly, it's the service that leaves a bad taste. I have experienced two friendly and helpful servers (and pretty sure one of them unfortunately no longer works there), but there are others here with real attitudes. I get it... we all have bad days here and there, which is why I've reserved judgement until now. Hey girls, it's the SERVICE industry. If you don't like people or have things to complain about with one another in front of customers, find a different line of work.

Stopped here with a friend on 4th of July for dinner after finding that all other restaurants were closed. Cashier struggled a lot with taking our order but did apologize and say she was new. Overall vibe of the workers was uninterested and unappetizing. There was confusion with my order and I got the wrong sandwich. My friend got the pecan chicken salad in a wrap which they literally just rolled up without tucking the ends so it was impossible to eat. I picked at my fries and we both left hungry and confused. Wouldn't recommend unless it's your only available option.

I didn't know you could bring your dogs to do laundry.   I looked up today on 2/24/2017, and there was a lady with her dog. Not only was he in the laundry, she had him in the basket where we put our clean washed clothes.  I think it defeats the purpose of having clean laundry if you're going to have dog hair on your clothes.  The attendant just sat there looking at her as if she didn't see her.  I made a statement to the lady, " I didn't know you could bring your dogs here".  She gave me a real mean look. I took that as a no you can't but, I can!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I've been eating at this taco giro recently. I'm amazed at the difference in food quality and quantity amongst the taco giros. The shrimp tacos and lunch ceviche are some of the best tasting choices I've had here. The bean dip salsa is a crapshoot as some days it's watery and the other days, it's really good. The service could be a lot better and the seats are just ok. Big windows on the front let's all the sunlight reflection from the cars hit you in the face. Basically if the food didn't taste that good, I probably wouldn't eat here.

I have to say this Hyatt Place is CLEAN and CONVENIENT for anyone who visits the Reno area.  Arriving to the airport, we were greeted by ASHLEY, with a smile and helpful hand, she loaded our bags and brought us back to the hotel.  Along the way, she told us all about Reno, and where the best places to visit while staying here. When we arrived at the hotel, she quickly arranged for our room while offering us a delicious buffet breakfast while we waited.  Our room was clean an comfortable. Although no shuttle to any of the nearby casinos, an UBER or LYFT was inexpensive at around 10 bucks each way.  Definitely coming back!  Thank you!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: New to Nashville and decided to check this place out because it was close to where I was running errands. I liked the atmosphere, the separation of chairs/privacy, and the lotion bar was pretty cool too! However I about fell out of my seat when I learned the price for a basic pedicure and gel manicure was $80! The manicure was not included in the gel. I'm from a nice part of FL and never in my life paid that much before. Not to mention the gel started to lift and peel in 10 days and my toes chipped in 2 weeks! Overall I was very disappointed and won't be going back.

The first time that we picked up a pizza from this pizzeria, we were pleasantly surprised. Very flavorful and cheesy- a bit  on the greasy side but after all, grease is good for your coat right The Second time we bought a pizza from Crust, we tried a pepperoni. The amount of pepperoni on this pizza was way way too much! The grease that this pizza had on top, in the crust and on the bottom made it almost inedible. After consuming one square of pizza, there was a literal puddle of grease left on the plate. We'd love for this business to succeed so we'll give it another chance.....

It was the cheapest place we could find and that was at $100 a night.  The rooms were good size, the beds were ok and bathrooms were of good size.   That's the good, now the bad.  The room was dark no matter how many lights we turned on. parking was a mess, it's first come first serve and it's a small parking area.  They had a BBQ area that had some sketchy people using it,  the outside decore looked like something you find down in Tijuana, Mexico.  And the bathroom had a window to a back alleyway, that had something eating on wood every night,  the shower area was old looked it.  Over all just have to remember you get what you pay for..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Had a good experience overall. Was very pleased with Dr. S as she was thorough, patient and explained things well. I felt assured she had done a good job and was confident when I left. 

All staff was really pleasant, but the place wasn't that busy. No one really greets you or tells you where to go to start. 

Reason for 4 stars is that I arrived a few minutes early for my appointment and then waited 45 minutes before being seen by the doctor. I wish they had told me it would be a while, I would have looked for new frames while I waited.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Smelly, dirty, uncomfortable and unsafe. Absolutely gross and dirty walls and rooms. My dad was bitten by a bedbug and the beds had cigarette holes burned into the comforter. The doors, walls, and baseboards were all black/brown filled with stains. So many drugged people around and the cops circled in every half hour. Please do not be fooled by the pictures, I paid $120 for the grossest place I have ever stayed at. $90 room and $20 pet fee! I had to give my sweet pup a bath next morning because he smelt so bad the next morning! Due to location, has such a great potential to become a good hotel, but it doesn't seem like staff cares much.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: You might want to rethink this one!  Not that the food is awful, but the owner is dishonest.  If you have any coupon such as Living Social he will take the tax amount of your check and deduct it from your coupon amount.  So, if you buy a 50% off deal and your $50 meal has $5 in taxes you will only get half of the $10 you were supposed to get in free food from your $20 coupon.  Even after trying to explain the guidelines of the deal, he would rather loose repeat clientele.  The owner has a lot to learn about running a business,  What an idiot!

Ok.... so where has this place been all my life? The atmosphere gives you this super trendy and chic feel with tons of neutral colors! They even have crystals handing in the room (rose quartz and amethyst). And I could feel the energy! 

The customer service ... PHENOMENAL. Everyone was super courteous and helpful. 

My pedicure was awesome. Very relaxing. I recommend the lavender. It just melted away the stress! And at add to the ambience and bomb scent selections, the quality of work was great too! Definitely stop by here and make sure you grab a glass of something bubbly to add to your experience.

The actual nail care was good. My pedicure was done very carefully and toes were painted neatly. The massage portion of the pedicure was not so great. I was surprised when my nails were painted first and then my legs were massaged briefly. Because I had wet polish on my toes only the tops of my feet were massaged. The foot massage is usually the best part! I also was pretty surprised that they charged $35 for a pedicure. I thought that was expensive. I've been to other salons that charge $35 for a spa pedicure with hot towels and hot stones.

Disappointed and feeling like we were completely taken advantage of by so called specialists!  My puppy has terrible allergies and is scratching herself raw, but we are told she is too young to have allergies!  I call b.s.  They charged us a ridiculous amount of money and prescribed her the exact same meds as our regular vet!  I think they are all just about the $$ and pulling on your heartstrings cuz our pets can't talk. It's crazy bull!  I would never recommend going here! Read more reviews.  Plus, they do not return calls!

With no explanation at all, despite the fact we had 5:30 reservations, the restaurant was CLOSED. I received a call that morning, at 9:45am, but they didn't leave a voicemail. I called back, left a message noting I'd assumed they called to confirm.

I called again last night, after showing up to a dark and locked, closed, restaurant. No answer, and as if 26 hours later, no return call.

Considering the reputation, I'm shocked and extremely disappointed in the events of last night. Luckily Fayette Street Grille was open, and was able to accommodate us.

I've been to wasabi several times. In the past it was solid, but it seems to have taken a turn for the worse. I'm giving two stars instead of one because I have had decent experiences in the past. The rolls were wet (strange, I know) and didn't taste fresh at all. 

I don't want to seem unreasonable by giving two stars, after all, it could have just been an off night. My issue was not only the food but the bathroom was disgusting. Disgusting like they haven't cleaned them in over a week. My three year old had to go, but it was so nasty I wouldn't let them go in there.

I won't go back!

The good:  clean room; excellent water pressure in the shower; pretty decent breakfast in spite of COVID restrictions and very friendly and accommodating staff.  We got the breakfast hours wrong one morning and they gave my mom a breakfast burrito in spite of this.

The could improve:  toilet not securely bolted; no extra TP in the room; used coffee pod in the coffee maker, and strangely, our pillows smelled of smoke in a non-smoking room.  I deducted a star for that ick factor.

We would stay here again.

Well done, Inn America.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We stayed here on 5/5/2021, after previously overnighting October 2020.  The room was again adequate; however, had been smoked in, and instead of sanitizing the room, the property apparently decided that an entire can of air freshener on the bed would fix the problem.  We both woke up with some serious breathing difficulties.  I notified the desk of this issue, and she immediately took $30 off the bill for the inconvenience.  I didn't even have to ask, so this gesture had impact.  Overall, I would give this property another shot.  Would stay again?  Yes.

Grade:  C, but would have been a B without the air freshener issue.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My partner and I did not have a good experience using the fluff and fold service at Modern Laundry. When we picked up our fluff and fold order we had some missing items and a damaged item. I talked to the manager without much success at figuring out what happened to these items, but then the owner did get in contact with me. We spoke over the phone and we worked out an agreeable solution. Although we will never use the fluff and fold service at Modern Laundry again, the business does have several nice washers and dryers available for you to use and the space is clean.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
When I first arrived to Philly (Dec. 02, 2012) this was the first place we ate, since it was right across from our hotel. I had the 'Fresh Mozzarella Panini,' it was very good. My husband had a 'Pepperoni Stromboli,' it was also very good. He really loved the dough. 

On our last day of Philly (Dec. 13,2011), we ended our vacation with having dinner at this place. This time we ordered a 'Pepperoni Stromboli,'  to share, and I was in loved. My husband could not stop talking about how good the dough was and now I understand why. 

The wait was a little long to get the food, but it was worth it. I will missed this place.

The food at Riverview has never had great food, but my husband likes their catfish, and until tonight the service has typically been friendly, down home southern. 
But tonight the service was absolutely terrible.  I'm almost 50, and the bartender made a huge issue over my not having my license, in spite of the fact that the restaurant was essentially empty and I'm clearly middle aged.  My husband had his and said he would order the drink in that regard, to which she said, "Well, then you had better drink it." Ridiculous.  Laws are laws, but it was rude and completely unnecessary.  We won't be back.

Few gyms offer Table Tennis in the city, so, they purchase one and now the staff will not allow us to play. The cardiovascular work out is phenomenal but again, the staff will determine if you are allowed to play.  We are the members paying their salaries,  yet they determine what I will do at the gym? I DO NOT THINK SO. When an over weight staff member and an out of shape partial owner turn on you, it is time to leave. Can you imagine a gym that purchases equipment and then regulates what you can and cannot do? Unreasonable people!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I have been going to this cleaner for the last 3 years.  For day to day dry cleaning it is okay, I would  never take anything good or expensive.  Yes, they lost a pair of pants, but they did reimburse me, but only a portion of what I paid for the pants.  Lately been having an issue with clothes not being ready when I go in to pick up.  The other day my clothes were not ready, and the person at the counter said they would be ready after 5 - it was after 5 when I went in, in fact closer to 6.  But in all reality you get what you pay for and for the price I do not expect perfection.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Good beer and pizza selection. We went with a thin special and then thin build your own. It was pretty good and above par. Had the wings for appetizer which had a dry rub on that couldn't quite place a 'weird' taste. Server was friendly and attentive.
Two star from a potential 3 star review due to the restroom. Their restrooms are shared with other business, so maybe that if why they are so bad and filthy. Paper, trash and human stuff splattered in places. Come on - I know it's shared but have some ownership and pride. Spoilt the experience.

This was first visit, and I will absolutely be back! I was welcomed immediately, assigned to a pedicure chair, and immediately relaxed.  The massage chair was wonderful!  While I did wait a bit for my service, it what worth it and I was incredibly relaxed the entire time. The pedicure itself was fantastic! Julie was attentive & detailed. The environment was very much like a family - people asking about children, grandchildren, renovations, etc. I am so happy to have found this business & I'm already looking forward to returning for my next pedicure.

I went here for the first time today with my son and a friend. They had their brunch going which I had heard good things and The Social did not disappoint. I am a brunch and breakfast junkie and I had the Sunrise Flatbread which was out of this world. It has to be one of my favorite breakfast meals I've ever had. EVER. It was phenomeal and I can't wait to go back. I didn't even have my Yelp app on my phone but downloaded it again just to write this review. Do not miss out on their Sunday brunch, it is worth it!

I stayed at this hotel twice, the first time because it was one of the cheaper, but still decent hotels, the second because I enjoyed my first stay.  This hotel lacks some rating because it's run down a bit.  Perhaps the rooms could use new carpet and a coat of paint.  But the plumbing worked fine, and the beds were comfortable.  We found this to be very down-to-earth and homey.  We stayed at a higher rated hotel while traveling to another city, but we liked this one more.  I would definitely stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I use only cardio and weights.  A lot of the equipment is in poor/mediocre condition and I've never really seen any staff cleaning the equipment while I've been there.  Also, some of the rooms can be very stuffy during the summer.

For some reason, people there often stand right in front of the dumbbell racks when they do curls and stuff, which is annoying when you're trying to either get some weights or put them back.  A sign asking people not to do that would be helpful.  

Overall, it's definitely not terrible given the price, but it's nothing great either.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The location is really nice and so is the coffee. However, do not come here from 10:45-12:00 p.m because they are always packed during this time and you will wait no less than 15 mins for your coffee. I usually go around 1:30 p.m and they always make my coffee right, but for the past week I've been coming in around 11:00-12:00 p.m and they have consistently gotten my coffee wrong and I usually wait around 20 mins for my coffee. I really do love this location and the workers but don't expect to be in and out of this coffee shop within 10 mins if you go between 10:45- 12:00 p.m.

I've never posted a review in my life. However, being a chef at the Fountain-bleu and a huge foodie, I must. This is the worst Italian food on the planet Earth. Avoid it like a plague. The fresh mozzarella was hard, not a creamy burrata. The clams casino, was a large clam shell filled with red breadcrumbs. And my two sons had pasta dishes, with four forkfuls of pasta. The shrimp scampi was over cooked and tasteless. Finally my flounder franchisee was drowning in a gooey hollandaise sauce. OMG!!! PLEASE SAVE YOUR MONEY and STOMACH! You've been warned...Myles

The reception of this establishment was very welcoming but let that not distract you from the lack of communication between staff/employee and its customers. When i go to a barber to ask for a simple fade or a taper which is common for any black man, i expect to be given a lovely haircut not have my entire hair (afro) shaved off. The employees were very nice yes, and of course i respect the work but at the same time if you do go here you might want to pay very close attention and instruct your barber very clearly and criticize their work before it gets too late.

Another amazing dining experience!  Belle continues to exceed all expectations in meeting our dining needs!  Her wait staff, Mia in particular was so attentive and professional.  The meal itself was very savory, delectable and authentic. I traditionally will always eat sushi and my favorite Steak Udon.  This trip, I ate the Beef Yaki Sabo that was an absolute delightful meal.  Sushi continues to be the best you will find. 

To Belle and her team...you are so amazing and kind and we will continue to bring people from out of town to share in the dining experience with us!!

Thank YOU all so much for such great service and food!!

Came to this facility this morning asked for a trenta pink drink no strawberries 4 pumps of vanilla . I got 4 scoops of strawberries and vanilla! The berries get caught in the mouth piece and the straw! So I came back this the facility this evening order same one even said please no strawberries explain what happen this morning I get my drink there was a strawberry in I said no strawberries she said oh it just fell in it like no bug deal !!! I will go else wheee ! They need help the line was so long there was 4 ahead of us took 47 minutes have a great day

Very overpriced.  How expensive would it be to put one more egg into a tiny $9 omelet, or put one more tiny piece of toast on the plate?  Had to ask twice for butter for the toast, and twice for pepper for the omelet.  Sent the omelet back because it was way too salty.  No apology from the waiter, but I was informed when I got the second (less salty but still tiny) omelet that the chef said he hadn't put too much salt in the first one.  Sigh.  We won't be back.  I notice that their web site has nowhere to send comments directly to them.  Guess they're not interested.

Someone mentioned the smell of this store, However, ​I didn't notice at all nor it did not bother me. They are also very friendly and helpful.
This store looks old from the outside but very clean, well organized in most of the area, a big grocery store that carries a lot of products.
Vegetables are fresh and prices are very fair!  
If you are looking for Japanese - 納豆、味噌、たれ各種、お米、玄米、山芋、根菜、きのこ類、その他野菜、麺、梅干し、日本のキムチ、お豆腐とかこんにゃくとか色々ありましたよ。(Not sure if Japanese character would appear correctly..)
Overall this store is more than enough to needs of Japanese products.

Don't waste your time here for anything other than an oil change and that's only if you have a coupon. Got charged over $85 for a single head light replacement on a honda accord. (I called after the fact unfortunately and everyone else charges between 30-35$).  I asked why you are triple the price and then the manager claimed that it was complicated and other mechanics are not being accurate. Then she said 'well your oil change was a good deal.' They give auto mechanics a bad name. Do yourself a favor and go elsewhere.

OK, you be the judge. I pre-paid for a car in July for October the 15th. When I arrived to pick up my car I was told that because I arrived later than I had said I would when I made the reservation, they went ahead and rented the car ( that I had pre-paid for)  to someone else and if I wanted a refund of the money that I had given them three months earlier, I would have to plead my case with the customer service department of their company and I may or may not receive a refund

Would you do business with this company?

What a kind staff! I was searching for a new vet after my regular vet retired and had a bad experience with the new vets that took over his practice, so I was feeling a bit cautious and a little burned over that but what a difference! Happy receptionists and knowledgeable and patient vet techs, a vet who was honest and not looking to make money off of me or devise problems. My dog struggled with major anxiety and they were so kind and helpful despite that and she came out happy and fine at the end of the visit. I was so pleased with my first experience and look forward to going back!

We have dined at Bistro Daisy several times.  Last night was a disappointment.  The tuna starter was very appealing--the tuna was not of a good enough quality to be served raw.  No sear at all.  Duck entree did not wow either--a little dry and overdone.  The onion soup lacked flavor and depth.  We have loved this neighborhood gem--just a one block walk from our home.  Service was very slow.  We did not get our drinks until long after the starters had been served.  Couldn't get water glasses filled without asking twice.  Hoping next time is better.

wooooow. so i call at 10:20, they don't close until 11, i'm placing my order & my total was at about $12 (minimum is only $10) & she said that wasn't enough & i needed to order more, so i got another order of soup, she again said my order was too small, but hung up immediately after saying it this time. when i call back, a guy answers the phone instead & tells me that they don't deliver to my address (i have gotten delivery from them plenty times before) that was completely rude & uncalled for, they don't close for another 40 minutes & it's a saturday night

This place is horrendous! If I could give them zero stars I would. NEVER rent from this location! I reserved a vehicle weeks ago for vacation and they called me three days before my reservation to tell me the vehicle was unavailable! The manager was COMPLETELY USELESS and didn't give a shit that they ruined my family vacation.They should be ashamed of themselves. I wish I had read the previous reviews before trying to rent from them because apparently they do this frequently. They are completely incompetent and disgusting!

Based on my in-person visit: 
Drive-thru lanes were both full, but the parking lot was near empty. So I decide to go in. I order and came back and made sure my fries were fresh with no salt. I check my fries and they were tasted fresh and saltless. 
I'm giving this place 4-stars for the main reason of the manager coming up to me to make sure my meal AND fries were to satisfaction. 
The only down side: the toilet paper wasn't on a roll and the floors (lobby and bathroom) were sticky. Might be that the cleaning solution isn't mixing right. 
Other than that it's fine.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I decided on a whim to stop by here. The place is really nice. at my regular nail salon I get dip nails for 35 and my nail lady usually does my cuticles a little if they're too bad. At this place, dip was 39 I believe + 5 for cuticles. 
Not a big difference in price however huge difference in quality. 
I didn't like my nails, they were too thick and bumpy and too round. On top of this, the lady that did my nails and the lady sitting next to her spent about 20 minutes talking badly about other customers that had came in before. Super unprofessional. 
Would I come back? No.

I decided on a whim to stop by here. The place is really nice. at my regular nail salon I get dip nails for 35 and my nail lady usually does my cuticles a little if they're too bad. At this place, dip was 39 I believe + 5 for cuticles. 
Not a big difference in price however huge difference in quality. 
I didn't like my nails, they were too thick and bumpy. On top of this, the lady that did my nails and the lady sitting next to her spent about 20 minutes talking badly about other customers that had came in before. Super unprofessional. 
Would I come back? No. 

Update: a little under a week lager and the dip nails are peeling

The veterinarians at Fall Creek Veterinary Medical Center are the only people I'd trust to care for my dog, Lucy.  The entire staff is professional, and the doctors are knowledgable, empathetic, and always listen to my questions and concerns about my dog.  Dr. Luth provides exceptional care for Lucy and understands Lucy is an important part of my family. 

As a testament to their caring practice, the clinic is having to expand to a new building to accommodate all their clients.  Looking forward to taking Lucy to see the new clinic!

Ralphs is incredible and a must visit for everyone living in and visiting Philadelphia. The food is amazing every time I go, and just when you think it can't get any better, they always outdo themselves. I have had eggplant parm a million times all over the country and I thought I made it the best, but Ralph's is the best I've ever had, and better than my own. Service is impeccable-courteous, efficient, and excellent at what they do. Add on top the beautiful atmosphere. Always our family go-to for special occasions.

I made the mistake of staying here. This hotel is horrible. I can't believe that Homewood Suites/Hilton would allow their brand to be brought down like this. The Covid cleaning they talk about on their website was NONEXISTENT.  That sticker on the outside of the door means nothing. The room was not cleaned. The furniture was worn and dirty. The elevators were dirty with the same dirty marks on them all day. No common areas were cleaned. Trash remained at the end of my floor all day. People were walking around without masks and the front desk staff said nothing. Don't waste your time and money or risk your health by staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is by far the worst 24 hour fitness I have ever come across. It so unbelievably dirty it really blows my mind they have kept this location going and have any members at all.
