The equipment is very outdated, mold on the ceiling under the pool, horrendous locker rooms, and not a very appealing crowd that attend this gym. It has the square footage to be something worth while, but 24 hour fitness as a company simply chooses to not allocate any money or resources to their SB location. Cleanliness seems to be off their radar completely. Dirtiest gym I have ever seen, kind of hard to exaggerate honestly. Would not recommend.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: My experience with Starbucks today's was awful. I did a mobile order today thinking I could walk in a pick up my drink cause I was late. Instead of that they made me wait in the long drive thur line to pick up my drink. Took me 30+ minutes get though the line and by the time I get there my drink warm and water down cause all the ice was melted. (never end up drinking it)So I ask the employees for a cup of water, during that process she sneezed and proceeded hand me the cup of water. I could never feel soo disgusting.

My first experience with Hikaru.  It was very empty in the place(2 tables) I was craving some good sushi and was already on South street so I decided to try it. I ordered the Gyoza, Vegetable rolls and the Sunshine roll. The Gyoza was good but I got 4 tiny pieces for $6. I was definitely not worth it to me. The rolls were not great. 

My usual sushi place is in Liberty Place at 16th and Chestnut street. I honestly really like their food especially for the price. I was already on South street and was so craving sushi. It should have just order pad thai across the street or Steam shrimp and vegetables from South Garden.

I rarely go to the Burger King in Golden Valley as every time I have ordered the Whopper Jr it is cold....and that's the sandwich I like....so usually I go just for the ice cream cone....a couple of days ago I ordered the cone for the low price of  $.92 the girl drops a nickel of my change and laughs....and then says I'm sorry....I replied with there is a nickel out here if you'd like to come get it....she stops laughing and looks at me like I said something horrible. I don't understand customer service anymore.

This was my second time here for an oil change and I will not be returning. The 1st time was great. However, today after making an appointment they told me it'd be 45min to an hour to get in. I had my 5 yr old with me so that wasn't the best news since there was no sitting area available. When the car was "ready" I told them I had a coupon for the full synthetic oil change and was told that's not what they put in my car because that's not what it takes. Fortunately, full synthetic was used last time because if not I doubt they would have changed the oil the way the conversation was going.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Very disappointed in lunch today. I used to go here all of the time. Today the food was okay until we found black chunks floating in our drinks, a knife covered in dried food, and hair in our food. Lunch took over an hour and the restaurant was half empty. Watch your bill as well as the price was over $1 difference. It's sad this used to be a great place to have lunch. The manager discounted the 2 peoples meals that got drinks. I will not be going back for a while. I would not recommend the restaurant as well.

I moved to Reno a little over a year ago, tried many different nails places and didn't really love any of them. I just figured that the places here couldn't compare to what I was used to in NY until I walked into Glitz Nails this morning. The space is super cute and clean and all of the girls are very friendly.  I called yesterday for a morning appointment today but they were booked, so T offered   to open early to accommodate me. They also do powder dip manicures which many places around here do.  I'm so excited that I finally found a great nail place here in Reno!

Long line.. long waits.. sure.. but only two people running the entire store! I got food at 11:15 at the McDonald's tonight on 9/18/21. It's incredible how well just TWO people were able to professionally handle the situation and still keep a level head and professionalism. 

I come often and Jose is always incredibly eccentric and helpful. The other guy is super cool and they both always apologize for the wait. They'll keep me coming back and I hope everyone else can realize they shouldn't be complete clowns to them because the store itself is understaffed! Keep rocking night crew.

This night crew needs a RAISE!!! Get them PAID!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Sign out front "Walk-In's Welcome"! This is now the third time in the past 9 months I've attempted to get my hair cut at Danny's and was turned away. Twice by Stacey and once from one of the guys because they were booked with appointments... all the while during my attempt to get a haircut on 06/08/21 Stacey was standing next to her empty chair with no client in sight. Great! If you're fully booked with appointments, lose the "Walk-In's Welcome" sign! Reading the other Yelp reviews it seems to be a common theme with this establishment.

My parents are elderly, and they tried to call for help about their account for pickup/delivery. The person they got wasn't helpful, but I don't mind...when you work for minimum wage the desire to help someone just goes out the window. The problem is, if I were the programmer that wrote that code, I'd be fired! There's no excuse, that code was horrible, who wrote it?  And then, we call customer support for help?  They don't know what's wrong. It's idiots teaching idiots...and that's the problem...
If I wrote that code, I'd be fired faster than Trump fired Comey.

I've been here twice, once as an emergency with my mom's dog who had colitis and yesterday for a planned specialized dental procedure for my senior chihuahua with heart disease. Both times we were beyond impressed with the kindness and compassion of the team and the knowledge and positive outcomes. Of course veterinary care is never cheap especially in these situations, but both times the final bill was slightly less than the low end of the quote as well. I am very impressed and will recommend SVS to all my friends and family.

No line in drive-thru or inside. They took forever to take my order. Why? You were standing right there talking to coworkers laughing about who was going to take it.. I had chicken fries and they were over cooked while my fries were undercooked.  They had boxed my order and left it in the hot box area for several minutes while continuing to talk. Probably the worst fast food place I've been to in the area. I've worked in other fast food places. Food quality and customer service is usually a priority. Here it is not. They need corporate overhaul STAT.

Food:  

Cold stale butter for warm bread- and dry. 

Appetizer special of crab bisque was thickened with flour/Wondra? Made it heavy and gummy. The shallow bowl it's served in and the texture unfortunately made it unappealing. Bruschetta had mealy tomatoes and undercooked focaccia. Undercooked bread?  

Ribeye was ok.  Flounder special was ok. Just ok.

Service:  Inexperienced. Nervous and bored. Servers were rushed in an empty dining room and the host sat on the couch by the podium with her head in her hands-- looked defeated.  Leadership will rectify that. 

Looking forward to our next visit.

Food is better than the atmosphere, HOWEVER, that might not be a fair account.  We were there the night of December 8, 2019, and the restaurant's ceiling experienced several leaks, which kind of ruined my birthday meal.  What disturbed me the most is how they kept serving, despite the steady flow of rain water falling in the restaurant.  That's not dedication to craft, it's dedication to money in liue of the well-being of customers.
Service was good.  A menu item that I'd specifically come for was off the menu.  All in all, I've had better experiences than the most recent at this place.  Give it a try, but be warned.

Dr. Leuth is rude and demanding. She admitted that she did not give my dog enough sedation.
After she took my dog to get blood work and Xrays, she failed to recognize that my dog was not sedated. When my dog became agitated and aggressive, rather than stopping the examination, she continued, further traumatizing my dog. She was not able to get a blood sample, was not able to X-ray my dog, and then charged me $260 for doing nothing. Pure incompetence.

She really wanted that $1,000  X-ray dollar office visit.

My boyfriend introduced me to sushi after having mixed feelings about eating raw fish. I should not have waited so long!! I'm glad I did wait and had my first experiences at Cafe Mochi! My favorite is the Spicy Tuna Roll!! So delicious! Tried it at another place and it just doesn't compare! We just tried the Volcano Roll and it's AMAZING!!! We go once a week for Happy Hour!! So much sushi and at half price! Go hungry, leave with a happy belly full of sushi! You will not regret it one bit! I know my boyfriend and I don't!!

Where the hell is management?  I walked in today and ordered coffee server didn't know how to get into cash register.  After a few minutes  she got it.   I had some time to kil so I decided to sit down. Every table was dirty. And what was even worse there was nobody there but me.  After cleaning a table myself I then was witness to one employee berating and complaining about a recent customer to another employee.  Never again in this place. .And what bothers me most of all is this shit hole is jammed packed on weekends.  .. SCARY

C'mon Dunkin Donuts, get your act together!  Came in and took forever to order because it seemed like there were only two employees in the entire place.  The cashiers hair fell down while ringing me up so she put it back up with her bare hands and never bothered to wash them before serving other people their food.  She also got my order wrong and failed to give me my change back until I reminded her I had given her a $20 bill.  There were trays of donuts that hadn't been put up on the display laying around and a crumpled pair of used food service gloves laying out on the counter.  Really???

Great dinner tonight. The shrimp shumai app was juicy and delicious. I had the unagi donburi and my dining partner had the Caterpillar Roll and a smoked salmon cucumber skin roll. Both meals were very good. We also started off with "quail egg shooters" which was basically a raw quail egg, sesame oil, green onion and soy sauce in a shot glass. It was good and a really different eating experience. The service was very good, and I liked that a restaurant downtown on a Saturday night at 8 pm still had a quiet modest feel to it. Not overly crowded, no one dressed up, just a neighborhood casual feel to it. I will definitely be back.

Being an expat I was struggling to find a decent place to get a haircut, and ended up going over a year without one. After reading the review for the Metro Barber shop on Fort Road, I decided to try it out. To say I am very happy would be an understatement, and I will be going regularly. I went mid afternoon on a Saturday and was seated straight away with the guy doing my hair very receptive to my requests as well as offering his own advice. Great hair cut and I might even get a full shave next time aswell. Excellent value for a great haircut.

Only reason i gave this "hole in the wall joint" 1 star is because there wasn't an option for none at all! Place smelled like cigarette smoke and marijuana, stains were all over walls, curtains, broken appliances including the broken cooling unit on floor with raised edge in which my niece cut her leg with. The front desk employee along with the general manager all the way up to the hotel owners were absolutely rude and disrespectful. Pictures included. This place is the way it is because of the people who own it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: These apartments look great from the outside, but looks can be deceiving. We have been here for about 4 months and are on a wait list to get on base, hopefully soon! We've had problems with our freezer, the dishwasher is cheap, and doesn't clean dishes well. We've had problems with our fire alarm going off in the middle of the night, which took several days for them to figure out the problem. There are NO lights in the bedrooms, so you'll need a a lamp- that was a big disappointment!  On the upside, the pool was nice

This place has gone down hill.  The last three times I've tried to go there, they don't have enough help.  Tonight I walked in at 6:40, and signed in for a manicure.  I just left at 8:12 with no manicure while all the owners good friends walked in after me and she put them ahead of me.  I don't care if they had 8 pm appts.  It's not my fault they don't have enough help.  The owner is rude and can't pronounce English names well.  
Every time I thought I was next, a anicure person would switch jobs and start doing pedicures on people who walked in after me with no appts.  
I'm a great tipper it they just lost my business for good.

Brought my truck here for new tires--it's always a bit of a hassle to bring in anywhere because it's a tall/wide load with a camper installed.  Everyone I interacted with was very kind, they had absolutely no issues with the height of my vehicle, just replaced the tires outside the garage with manual jacks.  They didn't pressure me to purchase unnecessary add-ons, which is something I've experienced in other shops.  Their fees were all very reasonable.  I left about an hour after my appointment time, which I consider very speedy service.  

The staff here is professional, polite and competent, and I would definitely recommend this shop!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Being quarantined we've looked forward to our traditional Friday pizza night and checking out different local spots to support businesses. We were excited to get Felicias as the first we had it at a party it was pretty delicious. Well o should of read the reviews here first. The owner is an absolute jerk. He was extremely rude during ordering and pick up. Then our food was completely lacking and effort and feel limited. I will certainly moving forward support businesses who take pride and produce quality food as well as those who are hospitable to their community.

Oh Dunkin'. Listen, Dunkin is a pretty inconsistent company in my opinion. Each store seems to do their own thing and the drinks don't always come out the way they are suppose to. This Dunkin' gets packed in the morning, the drive thru line is always busy. I have been to this location several times and I've been here once during a busy time where the sandwich was hurriedly put together. I have also been here in the morning 6am where they made my drink wrong and made a large iced coffee instead of a large iced green tea. The afternoons seem to be better; shift change the staff seems to be on it, I've had less mistakes.

If Only I could do a zero!! The worst Wendy's ever!! Single burger only pickles NO cheese! Of course it's wrong on the screen and I tell him before my order is complete. Pay for my order now I have to pull up to the door to wait but remind him again NO cheese only pickles...it comes with everything no pickles. I tried calling but it's the fax machine. They remake my sandwich it comes out wrong again...asked for a refund but they don't do refunds!! A bunch of BS. I'm arguing with a young dude that's said it always comes with cheese!!! WRONG!! It comes with what I want on it. I will never go back and I mean never!!

Went there on the evening of June 4 2020 no chocolate chip cookies. The gal lied saying she just sold out. Asked about how long to make some, she didn't know. Went up this morning to get biscuits and gravy and still no chocolate chip cookies. The kid said it would be 30 minutes before they'd be ready.  Got home had to take the biscuits and gravy back , he melted the biscuits to the plastic container. Went back three hours later and still no chocolate chip cookies. He said they had been busy, but three employees standing around. Guess Subway lost another customer. Wonder how much longer they'll last.

I LOVE Snap, but this location isn't like the other location I've been to. They were out of several toppings, and this has consistently been my experience at Ardmore so it wasn't a one time thing. 

Once I reached the checkout, I went to pay with a SNAP gift card I'd been given and the lady at the register looked at me and said they aren't equipped to take SNAP gift cards. She didn't apologize for something that was clearly an issue with the store. 

This is my first time writing a review, and it's merited. It was such a bad experience, and my kids agreed this was the worst SNAP we'd ever been to.

Was there for a soccer tournament weekend and we decided to take a few kids for lunch between games. what a horrible experience we had at Tonys Pizza. from the moment we were greeted we were treated like we were a not welcomed. the waitress kept giving us attitude from where we wanted to seat to which side the forks and knives had to be on. A fork a plate end a wine glass where extremly dirty. an ant was inside a salt shaker and to make it more horrific where the prices.Food was ok but got seated under the ac and everything was cold in less than 3 minutes. this is one place i will NOT visit or recoment next time we are in town.

Banfield Carrollwood has everything you want in a primary veterinarian's office - cleanliness, polite friendly staff, ease of scheduling appointments and timeliness. My dog sees Dr. Michael Kearley, who is extremely knowledgeable and fantastic with animals. He truly cares about your dog's well-being and takes the time to answer all of your questions. He and his technician also review costs, future visits and optional tests/vaccines thoroughly too. I feel very comfortable and confident having my dog's health in their care.

So all restaurants are closed, drive-thru only!!! Well I live almost 2 hours from town and am trying to get all my errands done. This McDonald's refused us service bc of our small trailer. (Which I've taken in drive thrus before). Asked if we could walk up or order & have food handed to us. They refused.  So now we got 3 hangry children to deal with!!! Way to go McDonalds during our national crisis!! And found out later from a friend that we could order online and pick up but the employee never offered up that information.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Monday night after 7 so it should be a smooth experience. We ordered the small chefs tray, which came with guacamole and whole tortillas, 6 tacos (we got pork belly, chorizo and fish), two sides (cucumber salad and cole slaw) and two tamales (pork and mushroom). So a great selection overall. The problem is everything tasted pretty bad. I can only describe everything, literally every single thing we had, as a strange combination of bland and vinegar. Service was good. Ambience was good. The food, all of it, not good. I hope it gets better.

EXCELLENT service! Whenever I come in- I'm greeted my name! Delicious beverages- always made perfectly. AND, the beverages are always made really fast- everyone there sees my work t-shirt and understands that I've got to get back, and I've never even had to say a word! So considerate of them! I am never given a hard time for not knowing what the cup sizes are called- or the fact that I can't pronounce all the beverage names! Your refreshers are delicious, and the bagel I once had was so yummy! Perfect texture, with REAL butter that was in its prime! GO STARBUCKS ON CENTRAL! I hope you keep prospering amidst this pandemic.

New spicy jalapeño sandwich was good, but the service was awful. Rolled up to the order mic, "help you" was all that came over the speaker. Staff was very rude. Ordered 2 frosty's, got straws with them. Went to ask for a spoon, and the woman at the window gave me a look rolled her eyes at me, when I told her they forgot them. I love Wendy's food, but I am seriously dissatisfied with their staff. Lastly, if you have signs on the door stating to wear a mask inside, unlock the doors. I don't understand why they don't unlock the doors, so people don't have to walk up to the drive thru window, to get a damn spoon

After struggling for years to find a reliable and  honest auto repair shop in Tucson I finally have found just that in Borst Automotive. The people at Borst are thorough, professional, and considerate. I've had such good experiences with Borst that I won't even take my car to another shop for so much as an on-sale oil change. I'm a 
Borst customer for life. They are good at what they do, they don't over charge, they are honest, and they are courteous and professional toward their customers. Highly recommend this outfit.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Everything is priced low and cooked fresh to order. For $20, my guy and I got two generously portioned entrees, egg rolls, a side of Crab Rangoon, and two drinks. We were stuffed and had enough leftover for meals the next day. An added bonus, the dishes they serve the food in have a lid that pops right on the top so you can take your leftovers with you. Don't go here expecting to have THE BEST Chinese food you've ever eaten. It is your typical strip mall Chinese restaurant. So for what that means to you, overall, it's pretty tasty and fresh.

Met some friends for dinner and we were looking forward for some good Tex-Mex food. We were seated in a booth in the back next to a group of very happy, loud women. The overall noise level made it very hard to talk with each other. Our waiter Manny was very attentive and service was good. Fresh made guacamole, salsa and chips were very good. Nice size maragarita. I ordered a pork chimichanga which was average. My husband had the carnitas burrito which he said was a little dry for his tastes. We had a good time but the food was a  little disappointing.

Underwhelmed. Duck tamale was middling. Main-dish salad with chicken was deeply mediocre -- chicken was gristly, greens were flavorless, and dressing was bland. 

Fish tacos weren't bad. 

The server tried his best, but he seemed pretty ill-at-ease, and I can't figure out why. We weren't demanding -- we placed our order quickly and decisively, didn't ask for specials/substitutions, didn't complain about anything, and paid/got out of there quickly enough so he could turn the table over on a busy Friday night. 

All in all, I won't be rushing back.

Not sure if it's more the restaurant's fault or GrubHub's. I placed an order for at around 4:45pm. Estimated delivery 5:30-5:50. 6:15 came and still no updates. I called GrubHub and they said 20 more min. Had to call again because food didn't arrive until almost 7. 

Sushi rolls were so sparse and little portions of fish. Tuna did not seem fresh. Also I asked for diet Coke and recieved Pepsi. Special rolls are small.

I have worked in restaurants for almost 10 years, especially half of them in a sushi restaurant. The quality is not good. Over two hours + over $40 later, and kinda dissapointed. Sort of the only option for sushi, but whatever.

We pulled up in the drive-thru and asked what matcha is, the lady taking our order acted like we were stupid and put in no effort to explain it to us. She was very rude and had a bad attitude. When we got up to the window we asked if we could try the matcha latte to see what it taste like, she had an attitude and said that they don't do samples, so then we asked if we could add just a small matcha latte, and she said that we needed to get out of line and go back around to order, even though there was NO ONE behind us. Never going here again, horrible service.

It's the only spot in Wilmington that is jazz-centric.  Aside from the Grand, which does feature great artists but isn't exactly a "pop in any time" type of joint, this is the hot bed of local talent.  I would like to see more music through the week, but with the current market I can understand weekends.  The highlight of this place, other than the great beer selection, is the Saturday afternoon jam sessions.  I never knew how many great players were in Wilmington, and I look forward to getting schooled every Saturday.  As another review said, it's the place to get away and get a nice stiff drink..  but the tunes are nice, too!

Terrible service! These employees need to be trained better. The drive thru wait was a much longer wait than normal. I got to the window and after getting most of my food (again waiting for a bit) I was told it would be 2 more minutes for one of the items. I asked if they would like me to pull forward and park, he couldn't answer my question. He had to ask another employee who still wasn't sure how to answer. 
I pulled to the front of the restaurant, parked and waited. The employee came out with the mozzarella sticks not even in a bag. I was shocked!

Ricks is a great little, non-pretentious place for good Italian food. Portion sizes are generous. The decor is nothing fancy and you actually feel as if you are in someone's house. It is small and gets busy so I would advise getting there early or expect to wait, and yes, make sure you put your name on the list on the wall. BYOB is a big plus and the local liquor store (5 minute walk away if you forgot some vino) actually does have a pretty good wine selection. Prices are reasonable.  I highly recommend giving Ricks a try.

The customer service is unmindful, neglectful, irresponsible. I was about to have an accident. At closing time, I needed a couple more minutes because I am a diabetic. But no one even bothered to ask or check if there was still someone in the dressing room. Suddenly, they turned off the lights and I couldn't see anything. Even my cellphone failed me. I even hit my head trying to open my locker room. It was dark as hell. I even told the receptionist. 'That was not cool,' but not even a simple comment of concern was expressed. But one thing I know, leadership at the top...as it is above so it is below.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Staff are very friendly.
Rooms were not cleaned very well .
Came as a large group. We had several rooms.
One room had old-food in the fridge and frozen food in the-freezer. Several-rooms had garbage from previous guests in trash cans. We checked in at 9 p.m . 
Tubs didn't drain all the-way. Not on the right angle.
Breakfast was tasty and the correct temps.
Very small pool outside.
They don't use bags-in the garbage cans in the rooms. Came back after they cleaned the room and there was stuff stuck on the bottom of the garbage can.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Came to this place last Sunday with a girlfriend & had service that was rude and was rushing us. I completely understand if it's busy & you want people in an out but it was definitely just a slow afternoon, so no excuse. We would just get our order and they would be like anything else & that's fine we'd say "not yet" because we just got it, then 2 mins later they'd ask again "no, thank you, not right now" we'd respond and I'm not kidding this happened 5 more times and got ruder each time like we couldn't talk just eat the sushi and leave is what they wanted. Idk how to feel about coming back to this location

Worst place ever - no menu, no prices posted, staff acts like you should know what you want when you walk in. COLD donuts that are more like bread rolls with icing, Dierbergs has better donuts. The store was so dirty I didn't want to sit down.    Walking in you are greeted with a dirty old dough mixer and bakery racks.   The counter, tables and chairs were nasty, covered in grime and fingerprints and I don't even know what else it was.  The walls were dirty and scratched up.  NEVER STEPPING FOOT IN THERE AGAIN.

This place is a joke.25 minutes to get 1 egg Mc  muffin .I ask where is my order her response it hasn't come up yet.I sure wish i was as smart as she is .Amazing that she works at Mcdonalds she should belong to Mensa.The huge manager runs to the back and hides when it got busy.Thw whole time the cashier is flirting with some guys and giving them free food.Only good thing about this dump is it seems they have ran off most of the drug dealers that use to deal inside and outside the front door.I'm sure this won't last
A burger chain needs to open up on Canal St.and put this miserable place out of business
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Ordered two pizzas tonight. Was given a price and estimated time for delivery and they didn't show up. Called and asked where they were and they said the pizzas were on their way. After another 45 minutes we called again and this time they said they didn't know anything about the order.  So after waiting 2 hours for dinner we gave up. 

Go to the nearby Jets if you want pizza in the CWE. I've grown up on Imo's but this franchise on Forest Park has always seemed bad with service and response. This was the final straw. 

Seriously, order Jets.

Their washes aren't done badly, although the outcome varies. In all, that part is acceptable. What is not acceptable is that they didn't lower my antenna once and it broke, and while I calmly brought it up to the woman at the register all she did was glower down at a magazine and utterly ignore me. A year later, I forgot a computer hard drive in the back seat, and after I got home found it was missing.

They should get one star for gutter-level customer treatment, but the only other place near us is reportedly owned by the same gentleman. So, now I go there only after having taken everything last item out of the inside.

Was back in town  for first time in over a year. Could wait to get to this great establishment. Guess what?  It did not disappoint. It was 430 pm on a Sunday and the place was filling up fast. The host was awesome but we were in a rush. We found the take out side had a table area. We ordered "pastina"soup first  second course salad and the most amazing Sicilian pizza slices. Third course chicken parmigiana with spaghetti. Forget about it. Watched football. Service and food was great and made it to airport. Sunshine on a rainy cloudy day. Love it.

Sophia's was a good fiinding. The restaurant is beautiful inside, and the staff are friendly and welcoming.

In general, the food was good. It wasn't remarkable, but it wasn't bad.

The Calamari was spectacular! It was so beautifully done and tasty.

The petite ribeye was ok. There was more fat in it than actual meat, but overall it was good. My partner ordered the lamb shank, and it was also very fatty. He didn't finish his plate because of that, by the way.

Our dessert was really good. We got the Tiramisu. It was very well presented, and super delicious. 

I think I'll come back another time and try their other plates.

Pros- Store in general always appears clean. cashiers are great and very friendly, seafood department has good selection for a grocery store and everything has been fresh, bakery makes delicious fresh products.

Cons-
produce department is awful, had the same brown lettuce out for 3 days (multiple trips back to check for fresh lettuce) and tomatoes are often soft. Totally looking forward to sprouts and Aldi for options

Pharmacy- does not go out of there way to help you get the refills you need as other pharmacies have done for us. They will send a couple of faxes but no follow up.

I'm sorry to say it but this is Thea solute worst McDonalds I've been to. I've tried this location several times and it's just horrible. The drive they is e trembly slow. There are either not enough people inside to work the windows or they are just horribly inefficient. It's never taken me less than 20 minutes to get through. One time I gave up and just went inside and that was no better. The person working the drive they window was also trying to help at the counter. Someone. Weds to do some training here. I won't ever come back. I'll drive 20 miles out of my way to avoid this one!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is one of my favorite places on broad st. I have been dining here for about two years. My six year old son loves the crab gnudi. Yes, the six year old. The scallops are great. Honestly, I haven't tried anything here that did not disappoint. The ingredients are always fresh, the food cooked perfectly. Service is impeccable. I am in my twenties, but I love the working professional crowd. Nice atmosphere. Great place to impress a date, or meet a friend for a cocktail while people watching. Bliss will always be one of my faves!!!

We tried a basic NY style pizza and I was not at all impressed. Neither my girlfriend nor I liked anything about it, especially the crust. We warmed it up on a pizza stone the next day hoping it was just an off day for our taste buds, no luck. Her teenage son tried and felt the same way. 
In fairness I know lots of people like them and the dining room, bar and staff were exceptional! We will try one more time, this time the Chicago style, and if anything changes I will amend my review accordingly. 
And for the record, I could eat pizza 7 days a week as long as it was from different places.

Congratulations -- this property has made it into my 'dirty half dozen.'  We were assigned a room on the first floor next to the laundry. The carpet is so dirty, we won't walk barefoot in the room. 

And, the smell -- an amazing combination of pest control and disinfectant. The smell was improved slightly be spraying the room with my husband's Right Guard deodorant.  

I took a shower -- the tub wasn't draining properly and something black floated into the water. I hope my feet don't rot and fall off. I adviced my husband to stay dirty. 

I will spare you my thoughts on the breakfast. 

This will probably be our last stay at a La Quinta.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I used to really enjoy this place for good Italian foods however, the quality I think has decreased. My husband was trying to be nice and brought me home what used to be one of my favorites as a surprise for my birthday, the Insalata DeMar, a seafood salad. All of the calamari was in edible, hard and rubbery. The muscles in there, I question as to whether or not I will be sick tonight. It used to contain regular size shrimp, now it has salad shrimp that I can buy at the market for a dollar a bag. What used to be a neighborhood favorite for me is now on my do not go to list. I'm sorry to say Allegro, you have lost a customer.

I guess it was my lucky day because Manny got back to me within 30 minutes of me requesting a quote for 4 new tires through Yelp!
He offered me a super good price, a 24 hour turn around, because the tires I wanted needed to be ordered. He was pleasant, professional, and helpful.
At the shop the next day I also received excellent customer service. I was treated with respect, felt I was listened to, and although even with an appointment the service took quite a bit longer than the quoted one hour I will nevertheless be returning.
Probably best to come in the morning if you can and not towards the end of the business day.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I'm done with this place! All these posts from the last few months and no mentioned that the menu price in the store AND online are significantly lower than what they charge you! EVERYTHING is upcharge at least a dollar. $5-$7 more than any other Chinese restaurant in town. This is the 2nd time in a month I checked this dude, I said, why is the receipt higher than the menus? Just take a free 2 liter he says? I ordered a quart of wonton I swear it has 8 wontons in it, it's all broth!? I added chives because there were none. The only reason for the 2 stars is cause the food is good...not great...good. Check your receipts people see if I'm lying?

I've been a member of this gym since June 2017. Join a semi private training. Im having hard time to do some moves the first month i joined but now i can see improvements. Trainers are so nice and approachable specially "TARA" that you can tell them that you cant do a certain move and they will modify it for you. Exercises are challenging. Its different every time so you will not get bored. Its fun to sweat with other members which are very nice.
This facility is clean.
Plenty of parking space.
Overall this is a great place. 
Its worth it
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: My initial impression was concern due to the atmosphere on a Saturday night, as well as the menu having a variety of options; making me think that not one thing would be exceptional.  However, our waiter started the meal off with a kind attitude and available to answer any questions.  He suggested the best appetizer out of the 2 that I was debating.  The stuffed jalapeños turned out fantastic.  The entrees and sushi were perfect, good spices, right amount of heat(spicy), and good combination of flavors.  Defiantly a place that I misjudged, and a place that I would visit again!!

Long story short my brand new truck was full of water because in associate didn't shut the door all the way. They're not supposed to touch or go in the vehicle I was told. Didn't ask anybody to do that. So $467.61 later my truck is dry and clean. Now the general manager Peter low. Is playing games as far as paying me. He put it in writing that he would at the end of the week. I was told Tuesday would be not a problem. Nothing but lies. PS if you're going to be a general manager. For God sake's buy a razor and look the part. And maybeStand up for your customers they're the ones that pay your check !!!!!

I drove through White Glove for the first time this morning, around 8:30am on my way to work, without very high expectations (based on previous reviews). Boy, was I pleasantly surprised! 

The staff was friendly and very helpful. I paid $9.50 for a basic exterior wash, which did the job just fine! 

After I went through, they towel dried the entire exterior of my car. I asked the man if I could borrow their shop vac while he dried it, and not only did he allow me to use it, he detailed and armor-alled my wheels (for free!!) while I worked.

Great customer service. I will absolutely be back.

After the terrible experience to top things off I get a call asking me what happen. After explaining the whole ordeal this guy says he'll call me back in a few days. He never called me or left a message as he states he did on the reply that was written. Instead I get two coupons for a free oil change. This was the problem in the first place ,that they didn't honor the coupons I presented to the Manager. As if I'm going to present a coupon lmao.
Also I forgot to mention I asked for the old parts to be returned to me and was told over the phone by Adair that they always return the old parts. Another lie....
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Worst drive-through experience ever! At 6:00 pm I waited for 15 minutes in line with three cars ahead of me. Got up to the window to order and they told me my line was closed and I could not place an order. I pulled up to the window to order, and they refused to allow me to order at the window and told me I needed to drive around and get in line again! Ridiculous. I will never return to this location again, my neighborhood Burger King. They definitely need to hire a new manager. And, yes, this was the manager who I was speaking to. She definitely needs to find another occupation that does not require interaction with the public.

I just moved here from Las Vegas 
The quality of the Sushi didnt compare to the places I'm used to. 
Ot wasn't horrible it was three star quality i took pff another star because pf everything else.  
I got the all you can eat and it's really limited compared to everywhere else I've been. You cant get seaweed salad or garlic edamame no desserts and alot the regular Sushi rolls are not included. The manager wouldn't even make an exception on the shrimp and vegetable rolls to just get the shrimp rolls and not get the extra two vegetable rolls, so they're not very accommodating either.  I won't go there again disappointed.

My fiance and I went here for happy hour for a casual night out.  Obviously, the beer selection is awesome.  The bartender helped us pick what we might want to have next and offered us a taste of the ones we were curious about.  

On this night, there was a live musician, which was fun, but we didn't get to check out the juke box.  

On the downside, this is a smoking bar, and being in a basement, there is very little circulation (those tires on the fans are NOT doing anything useful).  it smells bad.  Also, there was a big bug on the bar at one point.  It's kinda grody.  This didn't get in the way of having a good time, though.

Good WiFi, good, cozy seating, STRONG coffee, quick service. All here at the Oxford Exchange outpost of Buddy Brew (420 Kennedy Blvd, downtown Tampa). The setting is way cool in the renovated Oxford Exchange Building, where you can grab a quick (or leisurely) cup of coffee and scone/muffins/etc. while waiting for a table at the next-door restaurant, or read the newspapers left on the side tables and comfy chairs, and/or just people watch. It's all good, as they say. It's also all strong, so I hope you like your coffee that way.

The Boulevard is the best place to go for freshly made meals, great taste, and friendly waitresses at any time. I have tried so many lunch/dinner meals and I can tell you each is unique and tasty. I started going there when I heard their soups and salads were really good- and, they really are. All the staff work very hard to make the customers happy. 
There are loads of places to eat in New Port Richey, but I would honestly like you to know that the owners are always working to be better and make customers happier. I love eating there, and I think we have a jewel in our area- The Boulevard!!!

This is a nice basic gym, I joined anytime fitness in another state and recently moved to the Boise area this location is closest to my house. This is my beef with this location, for the past few weeks maybe you can get in maybe you can't. The gym is hardly ever staffed and when it's not you use a "key fab" to get in. Problem is it only works about 25% of the time, other members have the same problem. My key has been checked and it's fine so it's their doors. So you wake up super early to go work out and then can't get it unless some other lucky person is there to let you in
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I really wanted to love this place, and went many times when they were first open.  But it seems like now they mostly do something with fake crab and a mayo sauce.  Yuk.  It is true they will make you something if you ask but the last 2 times the chef's seemed very grumpy and put out.  

I think they just don't get the traffic to keep good fish and then cannot afford to put up plates of it when there is hardly anyone in the dining room.  I wish Boise would get someplace like Blue Island Sushi in Federal Way, WA.

Late night at the drive thru, rude employee with no respect. Ordered spicy mcchicken sandwhich... one of them turn out raw. Went back to the drive thru to notified of the problem... they refused to resolve it. One it'd leave the drive thru... its out of their hands. Bull shit I call bull shit on it. Serving a raw chicken is a health hazard.
Since they refused to corporate... and I still have a raw chicken. I will be calling the credit card company to Recind the charges. 
I'm not happy with the services or the food.
People steer clear of this mccdoanld if you value your heath.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It took over 2 1/2 months to get a basic pair of black plastic glasses. They had an attitude about it. Oh and when I went to pick up the glasses, they didn't have a record of my payment. I had to look it up in my online checking account to show them. So if you're looking to wait a very long time, deal with people that are not professional, and possibly be overcharged, this is the place for you. I have been buying glasses for over 30 years and I have never had an experience like this. I won't be back. You shouldn't either. I'm sure there are better places.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I've come here every year for many years to get new glasses and contacts.  I've never once had a bad experience.  The staff has always been helpful, my eye exams were thorough and the doctors have always answered my questions and discussed options with me as my eyesight gets worse.  The last time I went here was only a few weeks ago and as per usual, I left happy.  My contacts and glasses arrived only a few days later.  I'm really surprised people complain about the service here - seriously, not once in all these years have I ever had an issue.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Hands down the absolute worst McDonald's restaurant in the entire city. I won't even waste my time listing the numerous customer service complaints. Just read the other reviews and heed their warnings. This store is poorly managed from the ownership down to the high school kids they have running it. How a store like this can continue to exist in the Geist area is beyond me. Do yourself a favor and drive up to 96th street. At least there they know how to serve a hamburger, a task this store can't even get right a majority of the time.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
It gets worse and worse here. Service was horrible! Our server had the audacity to charge us gratuity! He messed up our order and came back to our table to tell us why don't we all get our food the same way because all the ramen looks the same and it's going to confuse him and the kitchen. How are you going to tell a paying customer how to eat your food. We couldn't modify our food. Took over an hour and a half to get our food. Only for
Him to mess up some of our orders. Management needs to pay attention because he told countless groups of people that they won't be able to accommodate them.

Peddler's Village is a really quaint shopping experience. We waited in line to eat at Hart's - a step down from "Cock & Bull" & "Porterhouse" and a step up from the "Peddler's Pub". At 5:30pm in a Friday in mid December there was a 30min wait line. We eventually scored 2 seats at the bar. The combo appetizer was fine - wings were really good. The chili was average and the corn and pepper chowder was flavorful. It was more of a soup than a chowder. Of three bartenders one was working so very hard, but the two younger ladies were rather lax.

Oh, the "Italian La's". LA Viola, LA Fontana, and Bistro LA Baia fill up each Thursday, Friday, and Saturday with college students with boxed wine in hand, attracted to the cheaper priced Italian BYO. It is a perfect place if you fit into the under 25 crowd looking for a cheaper plate of pasta to compliment your Franzia. But for those looking for great food, great service, or a great evening, the many other restaurants that make up the Philly Italian BYO scene may be a better bet.

I would bring my fraternity brothers, but not my grandmother.

This place needs a lot of improvement to deserve its name. The rooms are old, the bath was rusty all around, and the AC is not centralized. The staff is not very customer service oriented, especially the guy that works night shifts, who's completely rude and seems like he really doesn't like his job (and doesn't like customers). I was offered NOTHING as a gold member. I stayed there on June 23 and 24th, in case anyone would like to look into it. He didn't want to be bothered answering questions, changing one of our rooms, booking us the hotel shuttle, and simply talking to us. I've NEVER come across anyone this rude in an SPG facility.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If you are REALLY on a budget and you REALLY can't afford to stay anywhere else - stay here.  This is by no means luxury so if you are one of those people that goes on vacation (or whatever) to relax in the room a great deal of the time, this probably is not the place for you.  I will also say that the rooms on the 10th floor were good.  I had a co-worker with me during the trip that stayed on the 16th floor and she thought those rooms were worse.  The staff was friendly and accommodating, though a bit slow on check in.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love this White Castle! It's honestly the best one I've been too which is why what I'm about to say is extremely disappointing. There is an older man there probably in his late 20's but way older then my friends and I. He asked us our age and knew we were young but didn't care and continued to hit on us. It made us extremely uncomfortable and this has happened a few times. It has officially made us never want to come back until he gets fired. I feel bad but it's extremely inappropriate and makes us so uncomfortable and scared.

I've been going to this location off and on since it has opened. Though the yogurt and topping are good, I cannot continue to patronize. The cleanliness is just so poor and continues to not be addressed. It starts with simple things like, there is never a clean table- even though there are plenty available. The windows are so filthy you can nearly see through them and the outside has so much spilled fro-yo that you can sit out there with the swarm of flies; the ground is black...maybe power wash?! 
This is so disappointing as this is our local place. We will need to find somewhere else.

Can you  believe that I have gone to this store twice in two weeks.  Last was Sunday  a.m. before  going to church and when I paid,  they don't  have change. That they asked me  was it ok.  They short me 1st time four cent. This Sunday it was nine cent. When I said no! The cashier  got offened and walked away. Mgr came to register  aggressive  and said here's your  5.00 back. You don't have to come here again.  On top of that, it was a female worker with red hair eating a sandwich at the  counter while on her sell phone.  Totally  ghetto  staff
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Went in April for a quick polish change (not even a big production service like a pedi) and I walked in right after they opened. Four other customers in front of me and only two people working there. You've got to be kidding! Who runs a salon like that? I left after being ignored for 25 minutes, as did two other waiting customers. Not even so much as a "Good Morning" or "It will be just a few more minutes"...nothing, not a word. Horrible customer service. And it was FILTHY inside their shop. Never going back and wouldn't recommend anyone else to go there either.

Ordered from here on 1/22/2020, was told about 45 minutes for the delivery. An hour and 15 minutes later we called to ask what was going on with our order and were told "were swamped today and only have one delivery driver". Our food came roughly 10 minutes after that call and was ice cold. I contacted them again and requested a refund because I wasn't going to wait another hour and a half for replacement food at this point. Whoever I spoke to stated he would only refund half of the money and then hung up before getting an order number or address or any information for the refund. 


Never again!

Papa Murphy's has good pizza and we really enjoy the thin crust version. 
However, I have learned that there is a lot of variability between stores and this is one store to avoid.  It must be fun to work there as the manager and employees are always busy socializing.  But when 3 out of 4 phone orders had the wrong crust I brought the pizza in to show the manager.  He agreed that it was not a thin crust pizza but that was all he did.  No apology, no offer to make things right he just kept repeating "that is bizarre".  What I found to be bizarre was his approach to quality control and customer service.

I am a customer of the Papa Vito's in downtown Belleville, but thought I would try this location on NorthBelt, since it was on my way home.  It was my birthday and I could not wait for my double cheese with mushroom pizza.  How disappointing it was to find the pizza with hardly any sauce nor cheese, talk about sparse!  Taste was so off due to this limitation.  I don't care where I am in the future, I will always go the extra mile for the Belleville Downtown location, where orders are made consistently... correct and great tasting!

Today my cousins, grandparents, and I drive around the area looking for food. We stumbled upon this place, the Taqueria del Sol. There was a little stand for menus, although there weren't any. We ordered out food and say down in the cold. I was told there would be speedy service, but our appetizer took a while to come out and the servers brought it out twice. This happened more than once tonight, with my cousin receiving an extra taco he did not order. The food was tasty, but small and I expected more. I recommend this place but order more than one taco.

I bought take-out from this restaurant for the third, and probably last time. The food is average, and if you order a shrimp dish, you get a total of 4 shrimp! The rest of the bowl was filled with rice and vegetables. While the rice seemed fresh, it seems they are very stingy with the protein which is more expensive. But when I can get 2 lbs of the same sized shrimp at ACME for 11.98, it seems very overpriced.

A second order of beef suffered from the same. A small amount of a cheap cut of beef with mostly rice and veggies.

The food is not worth it unless you are desperate.

I guess their posted hours mean nothing.  Took my daughter there this AM before school, was having a breakdown over her hair and this was the only place open before school as they have 8AM opening, while most others are 9AM.  Perfect.  Farther away though, but worth it since open early.  I drove her out there, got to the store at 8:35 or so, well after the posted open time, and CLOSED.  Just nobody was there.  Ended up going to a different store that opened later, got it done, and went to school.  

No wonder their ratings are so bad, they don't seem to care about customers.

Now named El Beto......Went on the morning of Saturday 8/27/2016, saw the BIG signs in the window showing egg, cheese, potato breakfast burritos $3.99. Ordered 2 and pulled to the window, as the burritos were ready to hand me the guy says, "$11.00 please". So I ask about the $3.99 special, he says not on weekends. WTF? The sign says noting about only on weekends. Anyway, the burritos were yuck. Potatoes were not cooked....(GROSS!!).

This place is ripping people off, and are very dishonest. GTFOH with your rip off burritos aholes! 

PS. I hope they close this s-hole down soon!

Best ice cream in New Orleans, or that I've ever had for that matter! Nowhere in the city(not even limited to ice cream parlors) have as good of service as Ice Cream 504. Came in right before closing and felt bad for it, but the owner adamantly encouraged us to try damn near every flavor they had available, even after I *thought* I knew what I wanted. Did I mention the ice cream is literally the best ice cream I've ever had?! I genuinely melted for flavors I didn't even expect to like at all, such as toasted almond coconut. I recommend this place to everyone and will continue to do so. Thanks so much for doing great business Ice Cream 504!!!

Most ridiculously rude employees ever!  I.e., 'I'd like a shamrock shake, please'....'We don't got no shakes!'  "No shamrock shakes?'  'NO SHAKES!!'  What?

Or, 'I'd like a .....'   'We don't have that'  'I got that here two days ago.'  'NOT AT THIS LOCATION YOU DAMN WELL DIDN"T'  I mean, really?  Yes, I did...but even if I didn't, that's not a very good attitude.

This is seriously the worst McDonald's to which I've even been....sad, just sad.

And, as another reviewer said, check in your bag before you leave!  It appears they put random things in there, not necessarily what you ordered!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
The food was just okay.  Nothing special.  We ordered veal parmesan, chicken parmesan, and lasagna (which the menu says its "very special").   Nothing came out great but nothing terrible either.  The sauce is too salty for our tastes.  I can make a better sauce and lasagna at home.  

The cheese ravioli and the Italian wedding soup that came with the entree were good, but nothing spectacular either.  The place is very small and the decor is dated.   It was super crowded the night we went.  I honestly don't understand why.  We will not go back.

I ate at Papa Vito's this evening and ordered a pizza.  I received a thin crust pizza instead of the hand-toss crust I prefer. The thin crust pizza was soggy and cut in small squares making it impossible to pickup.  The server told me Papa Vito's is famous for thin crust pizza which I never heard before or seen advertising making that claim.    Only 2 servers took your order, delivered it to the table and never followed up about the food or if you needed anything. This the second time in 2 months I ate at this restaurant and didn't have this experience the first time which is why I returned. Disappointed!

Enterprise wrote, telling me to email them. I did so on the same day. I received an email response, telling me they would be in touch. It's been two weeks, and still no contact from their customer care. It would appear they respond to Yelp reviews so they appear to care, then do not follow up.

On the bright side, I rented from them again, giving them one last chance, since my prior experiences had been positive. They gave me the class of vehicle I reserved at the price stipulated, picked me up and dropped me home after the rental. I'll upgrade my review to a 3/5.

I went to Cassellis for fathers day.   The prices were reasonable, for what we ate.  However, they didnt accept credit cards or debit cards.  They do have an atm machine but they charge $1.75 to get money.  I feel like they should incur this time, if they are not going to get with the 20th century.  Also, I took my father there to hear the guy sing italian.  Instead I got a loud piano that was not italian.  very disappointed... the service was slow and the tables were too small.  the food was good though and the atmosphere was nice.

This place is conveniently located, so I decided to try it.  Unfortunately the chicken in my chicken broccoli entree was tiny slices;  I thought it was some kind of flat noodle.  Also, I've never had this dish without a sauce on it?  It was simply the "chicken", broccoli and carrots.  Chow mein noodles were mushy, and General's Chicken was highly breaded.  Egg roll was very greasy and had only bean sprouts in it?  Maybe they're just getting started, as the place has changed names several times in the recent past.

I'm giving the hotel 2 stars, not because of the hotel it's self which was great BUT because the manager clearly does NOT like her job. The manager was rude, condescending, and not accommodating everyone else in the hotel were great from the bartender to the security
However the manager may want to find better employment that suits her passion in life. 


Dear springhill suites find a manager that enjoys what they do because the one you have currently is very unhappy
-signed a customer that loved your hotel but not 
Your manager.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
First time dining at Tony's for 30-year anniversary.  A great experience.  Quiet table (arrived 5:30pm Tuesday!).  Attentive respectful service.  Loved my Pancetta risotto special and Grilled Shrimp & Lobster with Mustard Sauce.  Damn that dish is addictive!  Very tasty, unique flavors.  Wife loved her Spinach/Roquefort salad and Grilled Salmon.  Dessert (almond torte with walnut ice cream) delicious also.  
I read the reviews, but was suspicious of so many favorable comments.  It's real; this place is special.  Recommended.

I booked a "non-smoking" room. When I got in the room it REEKED of cigarette smoke.  I was given a disabled room also.  Was not happy about that. Cost an extra $26.00 for the parking. The crowds were massive.  People yelling and carrying on all hours of the night and morning. As a result I did not sleep very good.  If you want a quiet peaceful place to stay, this hotel is not it.  Housekeeping service got a fair to good rating.  If I ever come back to New Orleans, I will not be staying in the midst of the downtown district where all the "action" is.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Beautiful hotel with great service ...no doubt ...read the other reviews but beware of the following though. Outrageous price to valet car $36 dollars a day, self park $30. They charge to bring anything to the room. They charge for Internet in the rooms all services that should be included in their high rate. No shuttle to airport and taxi runs $40 one way !!!This is a money making machine and is always near full so it can. Not a great value ..more for a splurge or corporate expense.. Also want to mention the ridiculously high playing club music in the lobby and restaurant at 6 am ....so much style but no tact - think about the guest JW.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We were anxious to try their pizza after we had read how wonderful it was. Special brick oven that cooks a pizza in under two minutes. We were disappointed. The crust was nice and thin, but it was only crisp around the edges. Most of the crust was not at all crisp. The taste was OK though.
  We got a side order of meatballs since their website said they were voted the best meatballs in Phila. NOT true....not even close. They were on the hard side and we didn't like the texture at all. The red sauce was quite good though.
  Caesar Salad was OK and the soup was good. 
I am not in a hurry to return.

Fairly new beds with pillow top, friendly front-desk folks, not huge room, but we weren't hosting the Rockettes!!!  Musty, mildew smell in lobby is off putting but decorated with pots of flowers and clean.  Breakfast was crowded on weekend and about what you would expect.  Only real complaint is single-ply toilet paper and neighbors who waited until midnight to start chatting and fighting.  Smack in the middle of the Gayborhood so many interesting restaurants and a Starbucks two blocks away - no huge complaints.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We saw a lot of roaches in the bathroom when we woke up , just for us to also see that the bed had a large dark stain on it as if someone body had peed on it and they just tried to conceal it. It was just so nasty. When we called the front desk there was no sense of urgency in trying  to resolve the issues it's as if they were not surprised like this has happened a lot of times.  It's really not worth the headache coming here, I can't even believe that people left 5 star reviews cause wow standard is low man.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: So I ordered a few pizzas one I ordered I customized with all types of veggies and I was bound to enjoy it until I found not one not two but three really long pieces of blonde hair in between the crust and the tray. When you order from there the crust is already laid out and on the tray so whoever prepared the dough had to of did that. I spoke with manager he said he lays the dough and he's bald. He was nice and marked my name down for a replacement of my 30.00 dollar pizza but I was soo grossed out I won't be ordering from that franchise. There's other Papa Murphy's

I only give 3 stars for the views and restaurant/bar staff.  The hotel front desk staff need some training in customer service.  We seemed like a distraction to them whenever we had any interaction with them.  I wish people in the customer service industry realized that the customer is the reason they have a job. 
They need to greet customers timely and with a smile,  or perhaps get a different job that makes them happy. 

I do want to reiterate,  the bar and restaurant staff were awesome!  The views of the bay. ..beautiful!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I'm 16 and have been getting my nails done here for about a year and a half now. I loooove it here, the people are so nice and they do such a great job on nails. I usually get a basic acrylic or gel mani, depends on my mood. I haven't been there in a while but I do miss it and plan on going back really soon. It's such a relaxing environment and they actually take their time to make sure your nails are perfect, unlike most NJ nail salons I've been to. Me and my mom always go here for our girls days when we need a quick mani and then get a bite to eat after. Can't wait to come here again !

I have now been to this Wendy's twice and both times I have literally not been able to order. The first time I went there was a sign on the mic that said the power was out and nobody was there but the lights were on so ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ and the now second time I finally got to talk and I said one second please and then when I had decided I said I was ready and she said hold on and I then sat there for 5ish minutes and then said hello and still nothing, while there were people inside eating. I just think it's pretty ridiculous that I've been here twice and haven't been able to get food. Fix your shit!

Clean, well run with friendly staff, convenient location with access to SIUE, Edwardsville and Glen Carbon, located right near I-270 but with no freeway noise. Breakfast is boring but serves its purpose. Hey, you're not paying for swank food here, nor do I want to.

My only complaint is that soundproofing is poor. We could hear footsteps in the floor above, conversations in the neighboring room, and every door clunking shut in the hall.  Oh, and starting room cleaning before 9 seems like a dubious idea. Make sure to put out your "do not disturb" sign! Next time I stay in a corner room on the third floor.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have had decent pizzas from here a few times in the past. However today a pizza was delivered and took twice as long as they told me it would. Then, to make things worse, the pizza was cold and several slices had no cheese at all on them. I called and was told they would come pick up the pizza to make sure it was in poor condition and refund my money. They never came. I called again and they refused to refund my money. They even hung up on me. One of the most disrespectful businesses I have ever dealt with.... I have worked in the food industry for over ten years and never dealt with anyone this disrespectful.

My go-to hotel in New Orleans.  Convenient to the Quarter and CBD.

Over several stays, rooms have all been well-equipped (decent iron, fridge, etc), and ranged in size from very large to huge.  Housekeeping has been consistently good.  All in all, no disappointments or surprises in the room.

Special thanks to the front desk for accommodating a request for a room during a busy convention week.  Service up front has always been cheerful and welcoming.  If you're Hilton Gold, complementary gummy bears at check-in!

Recommended.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is nice.  The customer service is excellent.  The food is very tasty.  The feel if the restaurant is comfortable.  The pricing is reasonable except it doesn't match the portion size.  Although the food tastes great the entree should have been hotter in temperature.   The staff is very attentive to your needs even when you don't ask for anything.  The chef even came out to check if our meals were ok.  I would definitely go back here for another meal because I know it will taste good and the staff is very attentive.

I've been drinking Dunkin for over a decade in multiple locations and states, and I would rate this one at the bottom of the 25 or so I have visited. Floors, service area, and especially the bathroom is always very dirty. Bathroom reminds me of those bathrooms in many old auto service shops (garbage overflowing, ring around the toilet, grime on the sink, and filthy floors. Service is decent but there's a lot of employee nasty talk about other employees in front of customers. Coffee is good - not always consistent - but location is great.

Food is good, atmosphere good...SERVICE IS THE WORST...You feel rushed and uncomfortable as all the servers stand in front of the restaurant and stare at you making comments to each other.  And usually just playing with those damn phones?  Don't  they have anything else to do, perhaps clean.  There seems to be NO MANAGEMENT ANYWHERE.  This goes for the restaurant on Park Blvd .  Same story.  ( except there the Manager just sits behind the cash register.  People have to get up and look for their server for ANYTHING.  I WATCH THEM AND JUST SHAKE MY HEAD...
If owned this restaurant, I'd kick these servers out on their lazy asses

***ROACHES*** ***Infestation***
I sat down to eat my plain cheeseburger they added everything but the meat paddy! I returned it. It was not busy but took them 7 minutes at a fast food restaurant. 

When I sat down I looked at my partner and I saw next to her a Roach in the corner booth. I saw a roach and told her. She jumped back. I looked back in disgust. Never have I ever dined with bugs sitting next to me! 
When I looked over to my right there were roaches swarming the corner around the leather. (Going in and out this is disgusting!) Action needs to be taken
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: so as a recent transplant to NO i found myself in need of  good groceries at  a decent(affordable) price. after much  Yelp surfing, i settled on Rouses...its close to the house, has good prices, a little messy, but i get it your renovating- understandable. the one and pretty much ONLY negative?? the worlds RUDEST cashier!  i'm hoping that this trip was honestly just a fluke and next time i go there for my sustenance needs i will have a cashier who actually paid attention during customer service training! but, that aside their prices are decent, so i will be returning....

Verti pizza in Fairmount is excellent. The pizza in k of p had NOTHING to do with that naples style brick oven pizza. Just call it by another name. Don't take a known brand (that's good) and do whatever with it. This is a thick square Sicilian style pizza that they reheat in conventional pizza ovens. We ordered a salad two bottles of water and 3 slices for $36!!!!!! Will never be back or recommend. All you had to do was copy paste what philly Verti pizza is already doing so well. Seems impossible to find authentic Naples style brick oven pizza in the suburbs.

I was excited to try this place based on the good reviews but I have to admit it was not my favorite. The appetizers (meatballs, & hot longs) were great but I went with the linguine & clams as my entree and was not particularly impressed. There were very few clam shells and majority imitation clam which I don't mind in moderation/mixed with real clams but this was a bit overwhelming. I'll likely go back to give it another shot & I plan to order one of the chicken dishes as that seems to be more their strong suit.

My experience here was nothing but pleasant. After having my air conditioner break down in my car I was in a bind to find a car rental quickly. As an insured driver with a debit card, which Enterprise or Hertz would not take even with my valid driver's license and willingness to pay a deposit, my day turned around with the welcoming and friendly customer service Chris gave me. A super smooth experience. I got in a new and air conditioned vehicle and even received a good remainder of my deposit back when I returned the next day. I have never been so grateful for nice customer service. Thank you, Chris!

Don't know what happened to The Grove.  They have nearly doubled their prices and cheapened their amenities.  We had a few family members stay here for a Fam reunion.
When they went down to the "Luxury pool and Soa/Work out area", there were screaming babies in the pool taking swimming lessons from town.
Why is this luxurious?  Babies think it's a bathroom.  
For their meals often people not staying in hotel were eating there and there were no tables for them to sift together. 
It seems strange that someone pays for supposed top rated hotel and the whole sitting is there swimming and eating like it's a Community Center. Just peculiar.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've eaten here once and probably won't return.  The other users' pictures of the sushi look good, but I ordered the Chicken Teriyaki entree and was disappointed.  The meal came with two bland, barely seasoned flattened chicken breasts that had faint grill marks similar to what you see when you use a George Foreman grill, then it was doused in Teriyaki sauce and served with a miniscule side of white rice.  $15 for a meal that probably cost $3 to make.  The only reason this isn't a one star review is because the servers were friendly.

Watch out for these guys. They get you signed up without explaining everything. You think you're getting a great deal until 2 months later you have a 40.00 annual fee takin out of your account. When I called about it he said that it was in my contract. I understand it may have been but I asked the guy when I signed up about all fees and he said there weren't any except my monthly fee that would be takin out every month on the 16th. So he completely lied to me just to get me to signup and to make me think I was getting a killer deal!!!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I'd give them zero stars if I could. The girl doing my nails was on her phone the whole time. Texting and watching videos. I asked for a metallic pink. Yet I got that on my toes and my nails are a glittery brown. Not what I asked for. I was too pissed to ask for them to Chang it. It was dip so I couldn't really see the color till she was done. 

UPDATE... They offered to fix it. But I was getting on a flight in the morning and didn't have the time for it. I was told to reach out when I came back in to town but now they won't answer my messages.

The hotel itself was nice, and the employees were extremely courteous and helpful. The food in the restaurant downstairs was quite good, too. I give low stars for the management that is not enforcing the mask mandate. As a visiting healthcare worker, I honestly did not feel safe staying here due to the high number of guests blatantly walking around the inside of the hotel without a mask on. As there is a mandate within the city, it's quite frankly unacceptable. I can't respect an establishment who fails to protect both their own employees and their guests during a worldwide pandemic. No politics- just common sense.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Revisited this spot after a long absence due to living in Washington, DC.  The food now is only average.  It is no longer the same Ralph's that I remember.  The decor is the same, but not the food.  I had their "famous" veal parmigiana, but there wasn't anything famous about it.  My companion had the spaghetti with chicken livers and the livers were overcooked.  Dessert was also a disappointment.  The cannoli was not as good as we've had many places elsewhere.  The cannoli cake was just too darn sweet.  Sadly, don't go out out of your way to dine here anymore.  All good things must come to an end, I guess.

I have given this place a lot of chances. They have been messing my orders up over years, but I have never complained because I love some of the food. Tonight, after not coming for a while, I got the half chicken Philly and fries. I had about 10 fries in the order and a quarter half of a sandwich. It was lieterally half of the half sub. Extremely disappointed. The amount of food wouldn't even fill up a 6 year old. I have given them so many chances and ignored it all, but today was unacceptable on so many levels.

Food is delicious however our server was AWFUL. Drinks were not prepared as ordered and we were charged extra for items we didn't even receive, an additional charge for blue cheese olives that they didn't even have behind the bar... not to mention an extra charge of $3.75 for a martini served up rather than on the rocks. When the staff was asked about it they were rude and dismissive. There was one helpful/ kind waiter who we wish would have been our server rather than helping resolve issues from our actual waiter. Very disappointing considering how great the food is. Would be a 1 star if the food was not as good as it is.

This is long over due since I'm pretty much a 'regular'.. lol.  They have the best food in the area.. and I LOVE Chinese!  I've tried others and keep coming back to China Garden.  They are crazy fast, and their prices are good.  I live close and I've never had to wait for my food.  They are carry out only during Covid.. and have great Covid precautions.  but honestly.. I wouldn't have dined in anyway as they are in serious need of a remodel..and if I can give them one piece of advice - Clean up/remodel.  The appearance makes you question how good the food is and you don't want that- because your food is awesome!

I recently signed up for a Chase Southwest credit card.  I thought I was receiving 50,000 bonus points for this transaction.  Turns out i made an error and signed up for the wrong promotion.  When I contacted Chase about the issue they said there was nothing that could be done.  I have been a Chase customer for over 30 years and this kind of treatment was a surprise.  I do not understand how a change to my account could not have been made.  The points mean nothing to them.  And they were willing to lose me as a customer over a simple error.  Guess you can't rely on loyalty anymore.

This is for the dog wash.  I was there 3 months ago and it took $25.00 to wash and dry my 60lb dog.  That included time to sanitize and vacuum the tub.  I was there the other day and after $25.00($1.00 per minute) my dog was still wet and didn"t have the time to clean the tub.  They obviously put a cover over the water nozzle so the water pressure was low and it took FOREVER to first wet and then rinse my dog.  There is also a smaller cover on the dryer so drying took longer.   I came here because the hours are convenient but I will not be back!  With the adaptions they made it's cheaper for me to go other places!

Went with a friend and we ordered the shrimp fajitas, chicken tacos, guacamole and drinks.  The guacamole was delicious!  The tacos and fajitas were good but the fajitas had way too many onions and very little peppers.
