great place for either a cozy meal for two or a group night out. excellent service and organic, locally harvested food (for the most part) are going to bring me back to this place.

all the veggies and meats are from the area and are free-range or organic. the exception being seafood, highly doubt their are squid farms in chester county.

the wait staff was very courteous and non-obtrusive to our conversations.

an open kitchen allows for patrons to watch the cooks work, which is always a plus in my book.

it is byob, but they do have tasty mixers for sale, and they keep your beer cold while you dine.

After a very hungover wake up to try to find breakfast, I stumbled across Marathon.  With very friendly staff, they aided me in stumbling to my seat.  They had cookie dough pancakes (and who doesn't love cookie dough) which were amazing (especially as hangover food).  I also had sides of sausage and bacon.  The bacon was cooked perfectly (which rarely happens most places).  I would have given 5 stars, but I wasn't a fan of the sausage.

It was so good that I'm thinking about heading back over for a 2 day in a row visit.

Amazing hospitality from check in to check out. The roads were blocked because the sugar bowl was on; John the bell hop gave amazing directions and Dawn at the front desk had such a good sense of humor and patience. After delayed flights and dealing with hunger, these two really put us in a better mood. The hotel owns 9 buildings, although you'd never guess it. The location is prime, right on the river front. The rooms are spacious! The beds are comfy, and the maids are so friendly. I will def stay here again if I'm in NOLA!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
perfect for what it is, a clean motel along a busy road close to where i needed to be.  the rate was where it should be, the beds were clean and new (just as pictured), bathrooms clean, all around good value.  only complaints are the free breakfast ends at 9 AM which is way too early, and a firehouse is next door which went off 3 times in the afternoon but luckily not once at night so sleeping was fine.

all in all, perfect for exactly what it should be, a simple, clean short stay at a motel.,  free wifi as well
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: It wasn't until the familiar smell of rotting garbage grabbed me that I remembered having been here a few years back. Then I truly regretted having sat down. It was already 830 though and we were starving after a day of sightseeing. The drive here from our hotel was dark and therefore slow, nothing would be open at that time. There was no turning back now. The service was rushed and impersonal. The food was bland and the ambiance even worse. That's all remained the same in the three years since I visited the area on a prior trip. God I hate it when restaurants have no TASTE. UGH!

A group of 5 came in and we were immediately seated in the back area. I loved the décor with the wood paneling and photos of all the presidents. Very tavernesque. I ordered the key lime pie martini and it was delicious. I could have sucked it down quite easily. We had the pretzels and grilled cauliflower as a starter. Pretzels were good but cauliflower needed a bit more flavor. For my entrée, I had the Big Ale Prime Burger. Again, I could have easily eaten the whole thing. Between the drinks, the food, the ambiance and the service, I was a happy camper!

Ryan's provided the wine for our wedding in August, and helped this clueless couple with a wine-loving family pick out the perfect wines to complement our dinner menu and garner compliments from even the most elitist on our guest list. We gave them a couple of examples of pricier bottles we like, and John suggested a few similar ones at easier price points for us to sample before the big day. We're not sorry at all that we had a few leftovers. Ryan's knows their grapes and their customers and blends the two beautifully. A belated thank you for this crucial part of the reception!!

Decided to try out this restaurant one day while exploring Tampa. I was extremely pleased with the friendly service I received at the bar. As a newcomer to Tampa Ryan and Sean were more than happy to answer all my questions and deliver great service. 

I had a caipirinha to drink which was delicious. All fresh squeezed and perfect for a Florida summer. I ordered the redfish ceviche and it was the best ceviche I've ever had. Then I had the ribeye taco and the redfish taco. Everything was amazing. Great atmosphere and really great staff. Highly recommended.

Last weekend I traveled to New Orleans from New York for a wedding. After this long winter I was in desperate need of a cut and color... esp since I had been coloring my hair at home the color had become over saturated and unbalanced. 

Jessica was amazing!! She worked so hard to get my hair back to one color and gave me a fantastic cut. 

I was willing to pay 3x what they charged me because she was so good. I will be traveling back to NOLA for Jazzfest and plan to visit Jessica again!! 

Who says NYC has the best salons.

It's been really hard to find a good, affordable Mexican place in Philly but this place is it! The food was great and good portions! The atmosphere was friendly and relaxed!  We went on Monday night and they had Texas Hold Em poker- free with your meal!  The owner was there and super nice and outgoing.  He played poker with us, too.

We started wiht chicken nachos which were really good.  I had enchiladas- yum!  All my friend's got different meals but everyone liked their food!  We will deffinately return here!  Oh- also they had BYOT and provided ($6) margarita mix on Monday night!  Not sure if they do that every night?

I was a little disappointed with Sushi on the Rocks - the whole experience had there with my husband was much to be desired.

I received a GROUPON coupon for them for half of of $50 worth of sushi and dilligently made a reservation that same day.  When we arrived for our reservation, the hostess stated she didn't have a reservation for us, relegating us to the bar.

The drinks were severely overpriced, the staff wasn't the friendliest and the sushi was just.. OK.  

I will definitely be sticking with Naked Tchopstix and Sakura in the future.

My first time to the new location and it was beautiful!  Nice decor and beautiful views.  Our server was attentive and thoughtful.  The food was amazing!  Each of the 3 of our party had something different and we all shared.  The manicotti was delicious, chicken and asparagus risotto was yummy, and the star was the goat cheese, artichoke, and spinach cannelloni!  As it was a birthday celebration we received a complimentary tiramisu (also delicious).  The dessert star was the croissant bread pudding with caramel sauce.  Amazing food, amazing wine, amazing server = amazing experience!

First all I don't like to give a bad review but it took almost an hour before we got our sushi. I had to track down a waitress just to take our order. I normally go to sushi on oracle but my son wanted to try something new. I was pleasantly surprised to see cheaper price but once the sushi came I was disappointed. The rolls are half the size of what we were used to but it they weren't bad. I ordered a sakebomber they have on the menu for $7. The Sake was cold because they said they didn't have any more warm Sake? and then they tried to charge me $10.75. Make sure you check your receipt. Sorry to say I won't be coming back

The food isn't bad, but that is the most positive thing I can say. I had the paella which was somehow bland and even included a mussel which was not opened. I don't think the dish was cooked together. It tasted like the seafood and meats were all cooked independently then tossed into dry yellow rice.  A calamari appetizer was chewy and the dipping sauce couldn't decide if it was supposed to be sweet or savory. 

The wait staff was passable but a little absent and aloof. 

You will have a better experience at any of the chain restaurants on Bay Street.

If you're really hungry for Chinese food and want it delivered to you then stay a way from this place at all costs. My food took 2 hours to get to my house and this place is not even a mile away from my house. We even called after the first hour and the lady said it would be another half hour. Yeah, times that by 2. The ONLY way this could be forgiven is the food was amazing which it is not. It's not disgusting, just not good especially for the price. I guess I should have read the reviews before I ordered. Looks like other people have had the same issues in and out of the restaurant.

Worst car wash ever! Paid $30 for a wash that left a little to be desired. The outside looks decent. The inside had a puddle of water in the back seat on my plastic floor of my Honda element. I asked one of the employees for a rag and he handed it to me and watched me sop up all the water by myself. He then went on to say that I should armor all the floors and they would look better. Isn't that what I just paid $30 for? There's still dirt on both driver and passenger side floor. The cup holders still had gum wrappers in them which means to me they did a piss poor job of vacuuming. Save your money and do it yourself. This place sucks!

Had a terrific Valentine's dinner here.  First, BYOB is great. You get to save money there. The waitresses were very friendly; they were busy but still kept us happy. The complimentary bread was terrific and plentiful.  We had the prix fixe menu (3 courses $50 which is very reasonable.  Had a terrific salad, bacon wrapped shrimp, and Surf and Turf.  In the end i was very full and happy. 

The location is a bit strange but the inside is very nice.  It's small but quiet.  Great spot for a date-again the byob...

Would love to go back

A little pricey but potentially a healthy meal. You are charged by the bowl size. Your goal is to cram as much meat / veggies / noodles inside as you possibly can. Bowls start at about $7 for a small.

There's free white rice served, so if you want to get the most for your money, fill your bowl with meat / veggies and avoid noodles. Then, just eat that stir-fry with the rice. 

There's over 10 different sauces / oils to choose from.

I'm hesitant partly because cleanliness concerns, but I guess because everything is cooked, that mitigates some concerns.

Really the best sushi in the area. Can't go wrong with their menu. It's a little bit pricy for the area but worth it if you want to treat yourself to a legitimate sushi lunch or dinner. My only issue with Umai is the spotty service. It's too slow to go for an hour-long lunch break, and it can be really frustrating when you're done eating for 20 minutes before the check comes, after waiting a lot throughout the meal for refills. I am not sure if I get a different server from the other reviewers or what. But I can only take away one star because the sushi really. Is. Amazing.

Here's another great example of the kind of authentic Mexican you can find when you bypass the trendy areas and go out into the neighborhoods. 

All five of us are for around $50... and there were some doggie bags!

I always go for the tacos on corn tortillas with cilantro and onions. There's nothing like a good taco al pastor or chicharron, and these are pretty darn good. I have to say, though, when I saw the steak quesadilla, I really wished I had ordered that instead... wow, it was huge!

If you're in the area, I recommend you give this spot a try.

So this is fast food? Got here at 11:30 am, ordered a salad at the drive thru, and then had to wait outside for over 5 minutes in 13 degree weather.  Store was nearly empty, so not a traffic problem. Finally - went in to see what was going on.  Manager was apologetic, but I was told it takes 11 minutes to grill chicken for a salad.  Bizarre - just wished they had said something when I ordered it, since I was on a tight schedule.

At the same time, the manager did offer a refund due to the delay.  I appreciate that, but would have preferred not to waste 20 minutes getting a salad.

Stopped here on the way home for lunch. I'm torn--on one hand, it's your standard burrito/taco joint. On the other, the portions are huge and the service nice. There's a good outdoor seating space, always a bonus. But the food was just ok. We live in a majorly Hispanic area, so I'm used to top-notch burritos and tacos. These were only so-so. The carne asada was tough and flavorless. The guac was good, though--thumbs up. My husband's burrito was huge and seemed to be packed with the carnitas he ordered, but the balance between the rice beans and meat was off (too much rice.) All in all, a solid place but not the best ever.

lobby, restaurant and rooftop bar are fantastic.

the rest of it is just an average hotel.  small-ish rooms, noisy hallways, lots of weird mechanical noises at all hours of the day and night. poor attention to detail (for instance, the clock in my room was an hour off).

loved the decor, and the staff was pleasant and seemed eager to please.

I guess if you want to stay on the loop, or are in town for a show at the Pageant, it makes sense; but there are better options out there if you're not tied to the loop. I got a good deal online; had I paid full price I would have felt slightly cheated.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've only been once and not sure I'd ever go back, because they took one of the greatest dishes of all time and screwed it up.  The pear purse pasta was slathered in a sickly sweet cream sauce.  This ruined the dish, because the sweetness of the pears was buried in this sugary sauce.  It was like eating a giant plate of dessert.  Boo to that.  When done right this is one of my favorite meals of all time, but they really screwed the pooch here.

Also, butter served with bread instead of olive oil, ugh why?  That is a big pet peeve of mine.

Ambiance was ok if a little cheesy and over the top.  Service was on the slow side but adequate.

I am spoiled living near Detroit so close to authentic Mexican food in Mexicantown and several other fantastic spots through the suburbs, but this place makes me weep for the citizens of the Nashville area... You just don't know any better? I've had better Mexican out of the freezer section of a grocery store. This place makes Taco Bell taste authentic in comparison. I'll grant one star for the great service and another since the portion sizes and cost ratio are appealing. However, no horchata? No tres leches? No bueno!

Second time trying Sankyu for lunch. It's location is convenient and it draws a decent lunch time crowd of suits and skirts. The rolls are overpriced in my opinion, but the take away offerings in the cooler are a bit more reasonable. The special rolls are pricey but the size/protion of the rolls compensates. They offer substituting brown rice in their dishes at an extra cost, which I thought was great. I would like to try the bento boxes as I noticed that a lot of people were eating them.  I liked it as a change from my regular sushi lunch joint but I don't think I'll be frequenting Sankyu.

Milano Inn is a classic in Indianapolis.  It's been here for years and the food is still delicious.  I recently went there for dinner and was pleasantly surprised to see that they have remodeled within the last year or so.  The restaurant looked great and the outdoor patio looked tempting.  I cannot wait for some warmer weather so I can try it out.

This restaurant is great for groups.  They are very accommodating and allow you to bring your own dessert (or at least they used to). 

The service can be a bit slow but all in all... it's worth the visit!

Good but expensive

I stopped in here for lunch on Friday. They serve lunch specials until 2pm (but if you walk in at 1:55 you're outta luck). Ordered the pork cutlets bento box which was pretty good, however the sauce for the pork was wierdly tart (I prefer mine sweet). Also had the tuna nigiri which was very fresh.

Why only 3 stars then? After ordering the bento box (~10) (which didn't come with rice (2) ), tea (1), and 2 pieces of nigiri (3 each) , my bill was around 25 after tax and tip. Talk about nickeling and diming you.

If the smell of an uncleaned goldfish tank doesn't turn you off, the total lack of social skills possessed by the staff will do the trick. The building is in deplorable condition, particularly the upstairs which appears to have last had a repair done during the Regan Administration. 

The actual food is nothing to write home about, however if the building were in better condition with smells that didn't offend; the food might taste a bit better. 

I now drive to Newtown to go to Oishi which is spot on. Shame nobody opens opens a Sushi place in the New Hope/Lambertville area to compete with these clowns.

I agree with previous posts, the Dr there is fantastic. She was thorough and thoughtful. The customer service at the desk was lacking. My trial contacts said they would be in within 2-3 days and it took over a week to get notified they had arrived. Since I wasn't planning on getting frames/lenses with them, I had asked for a copy of my Rx. They seemed quite bothered by this. Hopefully the Dr will stay there as I liked seeing her. 
I cannot comment on the prices, as my insurance paid for the appointment, and I did not purchase frames/lenses with them.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Went for lunch. Liked the space. Service was crap - took 10 minutes to get offered drinks/order, and total lunch for two took over an hour. 

Enjoyed the pickles and the soda shrub (a drink based on macerated fruit, tastes somewhat fermented).

Had the hot dog. Was ok. Should have gone for the fried skate.

Swiss chard fritters were tasty.

Tap room?? I only saw beers by the bottle, but I didn't ask, so I could be wrong. That said, the beer selection was very nice.

I don't think I understand what this restaurant is going for.

This was our least favorite stop in the city. It was hot and thick with smoke. We waited a long time for service even though we had seats at the bar. The bartenders were rude and overwhelmed, but seem to be just rude. We ordered food and were told they were too busy to make food, and the bartender was rude to someone in our party when he asked to see a manager. Finally, we decided to leave, but it took 20 minutes to cash out. Probably a cool happy hour place, on a different day with different servers and after they ventilate.

If you want a great hotel at a great price and close to the airport this is the one for you.

Now that I have picked up Indiana again as my territory I will stay here every time that I come to town.

The front office staff were great and I enjoyed eating dinner here each night also.

The gym was big enough and I was able to work out every day, which is important to me when I am on the road.

The location to the freeways is awesome as you can just jump on and get anywhere you need to be.

I didn't have one thing about this hotel that was negative.  I didn't give it a 5 since I have stayed here only once now.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Wasn't impressed by the chargrilled oysters.  Not much flavor in them. Fried pickles were great at the beginning, but the bottom of the pile was super greasy. Wish they would have come with a dipping sauce of some kind (maybe a spicy ranch or remoulade)  Buffalo shrimp wrap was decent. Thin cut onion rings had a light and crispy batter that I loved.  Husband said the ham club wrap was good. 

Menu has a pretty wide selection, so I will definitely go back to try other items. Service was kind of slow, but they were pretty busy, and the waitress was very friendly and helpful, so I wasn't too worried about the slow service.

I would have given this restaurant 4 stars if it was only based on their food. I ordered on Grub Hub from them last night. I read the food was good, but they always screwed up the orders. I kept it simple and hoped all would be ok

The food was good and fresh. I thought the menu had a lot of items

I was missing an item on my order- bean dip and nachos. I called the restaurant right after the driver left. A woman said he would be right back. 45 minutes later I called again because still no dip. Another woman answered and said it would be over.  I waited 30 minutes more and nothing. Finally called grub hub to get credit for item

Three years passed by since the last review and this company has not changed.

The only reason I gave this 2 stars because they are smart about advertising their listings, especially on Craigslist. 

Here is my experience with this company: their touring specialists are basically someone to show you the house, I experienced two, one actually ditched me, he did not show up twice; the other one has zero knowledge about the places she is showing, even the fucking locations for Christ sake.

And the guy at the company itself is not better. 

Don't bother unless you can suck up terrible customer service for a rental.

First off, after reading the other reviews, the night we went, they didn't offer the seafood buffet, which was disappointing, since that was what I was looking forward to.  The place itself does have a great outdoor seating area with a wonderful view of the Delaware River just south of the Delaware Memorial Bridge.    The service was okay, but the waitress did leave us looking for her a couple of times.  The food here was also just okay, prepared well, and at a good temperature, but underspiced and on the bland side.  One of the tastiest things here was the Strawberry Mojito that my lady had.

Seeing that the chef worked at "Blue Hill Stone Barn" your expectations would be very high.  Admittedly there was not one disappointing thing about our experience.  The food was excellent and creative, the service and staff were way better than a lot of places we have eaten at and the location had that "farm to table" charm.  I would recommend ordering a few plates to share.  This way you can try more and not get too filled up.  I would recommend the caramelized cauliflower.  It was served roasted whole with a madeira cream sauce & mushrooms.  The wings were really good too.  Give it a try

If you are all about quantity over quality, which some of the time I am, then this place is just fine. Notice I used the word fine. It's exactly that. Not great, not good, just fine. It's also not terrible. For an all you can eat lunch buffet of both cold and hot entrees as well as six different sushi rolls to choose from, a person can't really complain about a nine dollar price tag. Nobody should be surprised that they aren't being served some new Japanese culinary masterpiece. This place is a means to end. It will fill you up and leave you satisfied, just don't expect anything memorable.

The remodel of "the first Dinosaur McDonald's" has brought it up to date. Now there are ordering kiosks, curbside service for mobile orders, and a self-serve drink station. 

They kept the T-Rex statue out front, but removed the maiasaurus from the rear to make room for mobile order delivery. 

Sadly, McDonald's has removed Coke Zero from its beverage options. This is a corporate thing, so it can't be blamed on any one location. 

Food quality is excellent. I've been here twice and the experience is consistent.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I don't know what is/was wrong with this place but the rooms are at issue. Including our janky toilet that you had to wiggle the handle to get it to stop from making that draining sound all night. 

Don't worry the story gets better...as in better for you to laugh at (our experience) because it starts off Creepy and it's not even Halloween. 

Service ok. 
The food service was above par
Layout Functional but exiting from the elevator to go to your room or find a banquet/meeting room can be confusing like heck. 

Key card needed for all rooms above 3rd floor. 
Pictures posted for your viewing pleasure... muah :*

Will write more later.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
A totally mixed bag. My ravioli was amazing AFTER an hour of waiting to be seated beyond our reservation time :-( 
The hostess must have been having an off night because she could only apologize but appeared to be powerless to rectify the situation as we watched other diners come & go. 
The server was pleasant but seemed scattered which further pointed to an off night scenario.
With so many other amazing restaurants in SB I am not likely to return there anytime soon to check if this was simply an anomaly. 
I'd actually give it 2.5 stars but rounded down because of the egregious timing errors.

Oh Creation Cafe, what happened?  You were one of our favorite spots and then you had to go and demolish your menu. It pains me to see that you scrapped most of what made you stand out.

The new menu is small. Gone are the peppy pickles, some of the best deep fried dills in the city.  Missing too are some of our burger favorites and some others as well. 

The options that survived the purge are decent and the pulled pork is pretty tasty. Unfortunately, at least for us, the draw is gone. We'll still be back, I'm sure, but I can't help but feel disappointed.

You don't want the insurance?  Good luck with customer service past that!

The experience overall wasn't horrible.  We had tons of cars to choose from...except in our class...in which we had one (you heard that right...one) car to choose from.  There were quite a few dingers and scrapes on the car...so we made sure to take a ton of photos before leaving.  They didn't bother to check...nor did they check all that hard upon return.

Like I said...it's not a bad experience.  I'd rent from them again if I needed to.

Coming from SoCal, this place I guess does justice for Reno residents. I've traveled across country for good tacos and even TJ. 

Ordered 4 tacos: 
Intestine - over cooked so it gives a bitter Crisp when over tried. 

Tongue - decent but not the best tongue I had. It's better then the rest. 

Tripes - typical nothing special. 

El pastor- dry. They had it precut in a steel container. So it's not fresh cut off from their grill. Perhaps I will get lucky next time they have them fresh. 

Overall the flavor is not all there. Though I do have to commend them on their corn tortillas. It pretty decent and fresh. Presentation is nice as well.

Visiting from NH. 
Nice gym. Newer and clean. Hardly anyone wearing masks though heading toward the peak of this Covid19  pandemc! All employees were though, but wearing a mask was not enforced for patrons. Employees were nice. 

Treadmills were newer but I didn't care for them. Most were unbalanced or wobbly. Felt like I was going to lose my step during a run. Just don't care for the new Life Fitness Treadmills. I prefer the old style better. More solid.

Gym area is bigger than my home PF gym in Nashua NH.  

Overall good experience.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Disaster..!!  6 months ago I reserved a mustang convertible. I get here and "I'm sorry sir, but we don't have any convertibles available on the lot."  What's the point of a reservation?!  How much further ahead of time should I be making the reservation?? 

Their solution, take a Buick lacrosse (which my 70 year old parents drive!!) and drive to other dollar rental sites to see if they have a convertible available at that very moment.  Don't bother calling ahead to ask because they won't hold it there if someone else gets there to rent it first. 

There's lots of other rental car options..  Don't waste your time/money.

I was shopping today when I spotted Wasabi across the parking lot.  Having lived in Hawaii and Japan for 10 years I was up for some sushi.  I ordered Sake, Hotate and Hamachi Nigiri.  The fish itself was alright-I wasn't expecting it to measure up to Japan, of course.  The rice however, was horrible-dry, sticky and hard and definitely not molded well.  This was the first time in my life, I've left half a sushi meal unfinished  but it was that bad.  I am not a picky eater, but I truly did not enjoy this sushi-I pulled the fish off the rice and ate that.  I cannot recommend this place-it was the worst Sushi place I've ever visited.

This hotel really isn't too bad. I found it on hotels.com for $60 a night. My bed was comfortable, I had good running water, and felt safe. Plus, free wifi that actually works!  I also liked how they renovated the entire building.  Could more be done? Yes. I dont like the carpet or the air freshener they use. My room still smelled a little smokey-ish, but I opened the window and moved on. However, for the value I paid, I knew I wasn't getting a four seasons or boutique hotel.  I recommend staying here if you are looking to stay on a budget. I'll stay again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Wow! I booked this at the last minute and got a better deal at the front desk than on Kayak.com. For $59 dollars we got a charming room bedroom with a queen sized bed, microwave, wifi, free parking, and an LCD tv with cable. The room was very clean and charming. It had beautiful hard woods, a non-working fireplace, exposed brick, and an old fashioned four poster bed. There were no signs of bugs, the linens smelled clean and were soft, and we had plenty of towels. We could not control the ceiling fan or AC but the room was nice and cold compared to the sticky and hot humidity outside. I will be staying here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The machines work and everything..which is the most important thing  

However, I never know how to feel about this place. I'm grateful that this place is so close in the neighborhood but there's always a mess either inside or outside of it.

I'll never forget my first time there and the place was filthy: the garbages were filled to the brim, there was garbage on the floor, lint balls everywhere, discarded under garments in the machines. I've never known a laundromat to have this kind of problem. 

You'll either catch the cleanliness of this place on a good day or a bad day. Otherwise, the machines work fine
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: WORST experience I've ever had at a hotel. Booked a non-smoking room only to show up and have the first room we were given reek of smoke. The desk clerk then showed us 4 other rooms, all of which had obviously been smoked in.  After refusing to stay in one of these rooms, they then said they couldn't refund us because they required 24 hours notice. Such poor customer service and quality. The manager is extremely dishonest in my opinion. Don't stay here unless you want to get completely screwed over. Also did not feel like the safest area particularly for single women, as some of their other clientele seemed a bit shady.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I was a little hesitant due to the bad reviews of this hotel. I do believe that most of them were prior to the renovation.  To my big surprise the entire building is spotlessly clean and fresh. I will stay here before intercontinental in tampa. The lady who checked me in was super friendly. I have worked in hotel for many years and she still pleasantly surprise me with the customer oriented attitude.  I had to change my schedule so I needed to leave a day early and the lady manager did accommodate me to my needs. Yelpers and PC members please give this one another shot.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I usually visit this restaurant because they are quick, affordable and tasty. I love Steak El Maguey, and lunch #9. The Chips and Salsa aren't bad either.
I have visited different El Maguey and they all seem to be about the same in terms of prompt service and quality. But this location is my favorite. I wish this particular location had a better decoration and look, but since the food is good, that is not as important to me anymore.
The place keeps busy, and that is a good sign.  
They also have a lot of veg options and some low fat dishes. My mom enjoys their their rice and beans side, with avocado. Yum.

Came to St. Louis to visit family and arrived late during a rain storm. The front desk was very nice and gave me an upgrade because I wanted to be checked in while she handled incoming calls. She was the only behind the desk. The room was great, which includes free WiFi, free parking, and free breakfast. What a great deal. The building, rooms, and parking lot were clean. You are close to the highways, airport, gas stations and restaurants. I enjoyed my visit and when I come back to St. Louis I will be staying at The Express!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I went here over the weekend for restaurant week with a group of 5.  We picked this place to go because the menu looked delish and it is BYOB which is always a plus! 

The atmosphere is okay.  It's a very small and not much goin on.  But the staff was very friendly and was always checking on us.

The food was not so good.  First course was awesome I had the mussels in red sauce.  Second course was some type of shrimp thing?  It was disgusting! I don't even think that the shrimp was cooked.  The rest of the meal was pretty decent, don't know if I would go back.

the wine, the cut of fish, the company- all fantastic. but the truffle dessert.....i must admit i was a little disappointed that they didn't offer a chocolate ganache or mousse or something of that order but oh oh my god, the world stopped for these truffles. i literally forgot all sense of being and was momentarily engulfed in waves of chocolately goodness. now on a mission to see if anything in the city can beat this. so far, the zone:1, the city: 0.


*************************update******************************

boo yah round two- good as ever and the truffles...heaven

My GF and i are in town on a mini vacation and stopped by here for an early dinner. It was very good. The bread was fresh and warm, the oil for dipping was excellent,tons of garlic and hi grade olive oil. I had the pesto salmon, very tasty. The sauce was good not to overpowering and the mashed potatoes were some of the best i've ever had, very creamy. My gf had a ceasar salad which i tasted and was very good and the linguine carbonara and she liked it also. The waiter was very nice and attentive. We had a nice expierience here.

This is the best sports bar in Santa Barbara! I am giving if 4 stars for what it is, a sports bar that serves good food. This is not the place to come for a romantic or super nice meal, but it is the place to come on Sunday's for every football game on multiple TVs. You can sit anywhere in the place and see every game. They serve beer in big goblets and are reasonably priced. They have good Monday night football as well and it is my favorite first stop on Thursdays due to their $2 well drinks. Their mohitos are pretty good as well and I have always had great service there.

I'm updating my review... I was in love with this place, but no more. The last 2 times the pies I've ordered from here were foul. The time before those, their mozzarella carroza, which my Sicilian boss recommended I ordered (he grew up eating them in Queens) came out overly greasy and undercooked. 

Their Grandma pie was nothing like I've ever had in Brooklyn, Long Island or North Jersey. It was a cracker with some tomato sauce on it.

Unless they tighten their game up and get back to basics and making better pizza, I'll make the trek over to Santucci's. Shame.

Stayed here for business and was very impressed by the amenities and customer service of this hotel.  The moon theme is very pervasive all throughout.

Food at the restaurant was good and the ambience was very warm and welcoming.  Views from the rooftop bar are spectacular.  

My room was terrific - shower was awesome, bed was comfortable.  My only complaint was that the hallway light was very bright and, due to the short distance between my door and my bed, illuminated my room which is not an ideal sleeping environment for me.

All in all though, I would definitely recommend this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My girlfriend and I ate at Michael's for the first time this morning and are sold. The service is incredible; we were never without coffee, water, or refills and the food is without parallel. I had the Challah French Toast, which despite actually being Brioche French Toast, is an absolutely incredible combination of filling, doughy, sweet, and fresh. My girlfriend had the Orange Ricotta Pancakes, which, despite sounding somewhat bizarre were absolutely great; they were light, flavorful, subtle, and the perfect balance to the heavier french toast.

Although the service at sushi king is wonderful, the food is mediocre. I went there twice with my friend and we used a coupon that I purchased on restaurant.com, but the food was still not worth it. The sushi there was very bland and lacked flavor. It kind of reminded me of the sushi you can by pre-packaged at a grocery store. 

A really nice thing about sushi king is that they give you fresh fruit as a complementary dessert at the end of your meal. It's quite elegant and the fruit has always been quite tasty and sweet.

I would still never pay full price and I probably won't be back anytime soon.

I've been a member at this gym for over 12 years and the only reason I stay is because it's cheap and convenient. The size is decent and the equipment selection is pretty good but depending on the time of day you go, it can be really crowded, especially right after New Years when the "Resolutioners" take over. There's a fair share of obnoxious meatheads and girls prancing around in booty shorts. I like their classes, but some (especially spinning) are so full you have to pay to even make it on the list. Overall, it gets the job done for a good price, but I'm sure there are nicer gyms in town.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
The reason that this gets 2 stars is because the barista was very nice. The tea and coffe, on the other hand, not so much.

I asked for earl grey tea and what i got was brown water. I asked for them to remake it, which they did happily, and it came out the same way. 

I decided, well maybe they had old tea, or a bad brand, so i tried a "Thai Coffee." Please understand, espresso with lots of cream and sugar is not Thai Coffee.

The bagel was good, and the barista super nice, but I probably won't be back again. There are plenty of other Coffee/Tea places in the area I can hit up!

I've never eaten in, only takeout, but every time has been good. The Grandma's pizza is great. Texas fries are great, too, especially considering I've only ordered them for delivery and they haven't been soggy or weird at all. What compelled me to finally write a review was the fact that my boyfriend and I were lost as far as what to do for dinner on Super Bowl Sunday, and so we ordered from Frank's, fully expecting the delivery time to be at least an hour. It was SURPRISINGLY quick (I want to say under thirty minutes), and everything was hot and fresh and the delivery guy was great.

Their pizza just isn't that good.  I would rather eat a frozen pizza than a golden crust.  Their fries are rather tasteless and there's something about the texture that makes me wonder if they're re-heating yesterday's batch.  I also wouldn't recommend the gyros.  The gyros meat seems soggy and they never put enough tzatziki sauce on it, but the bread is okay.  I would recommend the pita bread.  Perhaps there is something else on the menu that is good that I haven't tried yet - I just wouldn't order the pizza.  They are inexpensive and service is average.

The Delta Marketplace is a great concept, but it cannot keep up with conference crowds.

The place is designed to provide Starbucks coffee, quick food 24/7, and some upscale snacks. The Starbucks portion is very tiny. They have basic drinks, nothing special that is currently on the menu. Food is not Starbucks food, but stuff that the Gaylord is preparing. 

We waited 20 minutes to just get in the door one morning, and another 15 to order and get food. Lattes are a hit or miss. I had some bad ones, and good ones.

This is the only place serving Starbucks at the hotel, so you almost have to suck it up.

I enjoyed the fried catfish sandwich  after it being recommended from a friend.  The fish itself was huge and dry/slightly over cooked, but easily masked by having all the fixins on it.  I enjoyed the spicy fries that weren't spicy ( boo).  The employees were all very nice, but we did have to wait behind two cars, who apparently didn't call ahead.  My friends enjoyed burgers that they said were good, but nothing special.  This is the perfect place to call ahead to have a hearty meal on the go or to take home.  The price was super reasonable, we had three sandwiches and two fries for under 25$.

I just left here to get a wash on my car because I was on the road this past weekend. Well, let's just say the car looks JUST like it did before I brought it in. There are still a few bugs smooshed on the front of the car and the windows WERE NOT touched AT ALL. How do I know this? Because, a bug splattered in my windshield as I was getting off the spillway and his residue is still lingering on my windshield. I stopped coming here a whole ago, but since I was in the area I figured I would stop in and get a quick wash since Safari was packed..well lets just say this will be my LAST time coming here. A total waste of time and money.

I was at the gym a couple days ago and noticed the perfect fade on one of the guys haircuts.  I asked him where he got his haircut from any told me from Elijah at the chop shop. I was able to get my haircut today and must say Elijah did an amazing job! I told him how I usually get it cut and asked him to fade it. He not only got it spot on but had impeccable detail at every angle! The quality supersedes the price paid for this haircut, I am extremely happy I have found a barber of his quality at such a great price. He also is a super chill guy and easy to talk to.

To be honest, LBF can serve some tasty food.  When you're looking for greasy comfort food, it is right up there.

The reason I give it 2 stars is because of the disgusting habits of the staff.  We watched the guy at the register 1) handle cash (dirty), 2) move a chili dog into a serving plate and lick the chili off his finger, 3) handle more cash, 4) play Big Buck Hunter (fun game, dirty gun), 5) handle more cash, 6) handle hot dog and bun with bare hands.  Nasty.

The "cook" also played Big Buck Hunter and used the same hands to place raw onions on my dog.  Thanks a lot.

Is this behavior even legal??

This may actually be the best ice cream on the planet. Went here on a whim, and this is going to be a regular spot when the craving for ice cream hits. 

The flavors are non-traditional but what do you expect. Even the "traditional" flavors have a twist. The vanilla you can taste the vanilla bean and extract. It has that homemade cookie taste. The Oreo ice cream tastes exactly what a ice cream version​ of the cookie would. If I had more time would have tried a few other flavors, but those and the two my wife chose were my only samples for the day. 

Will definitely be back!

Every time I come to this restaurant, I am blown away by the entire experience. The food is excellently prepared, the drink options are extensive and the service is wonderful. I've had most items on their menu and every single one has been delicious.

If it is still on the menu when you visit, I highly recommend the pork "porterhouse" with the IPA pan sauce and the red velvet cake.

If you're looking for a great place to eat in Tucson, especially if you're on the northwest side, you have to check Jax Kitchen out.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at the French Market Inn (Feb. 4-8).  Most notably, the employees are extremely friendly and kind, truly the most welcoming and hospitable stay I've ever experienced anywhere (no exaggeration!).  And I concur with the other five-star reviews: the French Market Inn is full of charm and comfort, is superabundantly clean, and the location is wonderful -- it's quiet when you want quiet but it's close to everything... a very short walk to anything you'd like to do in the quarter.  Cannot recommend it highly enough and will make it my go-to whenever planning a trip to NOLA!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
My husband and I have been using New Way for over ten years, and there's a reason for our loyalty. They do a great job, are always timely, and do great alterations. If something is missing a button or needs extra attention, they catch it even if we don't. 

I can remember just once when something wasn't ready on time. Since my husband drops off shirts at least once a week, that's quite a track record in my mind. We've never had an item damaged. 

My only complaint is the location. Depending on the time of day, it can be difficult to get in and out of. But this just means avoiding those high traffic times on Stonecrest Blvd.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Cool rooftop, mediocre beer list. We came just after it rained and the ceiling on the rooftop dripped on our table a couple times.

What shines here are the burgers. A friend recommended the peanut butter burger ("the refined") and I was skeptical but it holds up. Did the weekly burger on our second trip and it was also good.

The big disappointment is the house made ketchup. I normally love house made ketchup but this stuff is nasty. My wife described it as watery ragu. If you're going to check this place out maybe swing by McDonald's first to pick up a few packets, because they don't have any heinz available as a back up

I have never in my life been so unhappy while eating ice cream. I have also never seen my boyfriend throw away ice cream. Not only is it tasteless and expensive for what it is, the service was abysmal and concerning. While the girl who took our order began to fill the cone, another co worker or manager says,  "Go wash your hands." And she responds that she did....uhhh...did you? 
I appreciate that this is local and has been here for awhile but never again. Not worth the money or the space in my tummy. My taste buds were so disappointed, they were afraid that they weren't working.

If you like a rock hard bed and a pillow that reminds you of toilet paper balled up & then shoved in a pillowcase, you've found heaven. This was a $106 a night room that I would have paid $45 back in Chicago. I didn't mind the bar out back because the talent there wasn't bad, the night we stayed, they were done by 11pm. But this ol boy is accustomed to a memory foam mattress and that just wasn't an option here. Damn you trivago!

Oh! I almost forgot about the continental breakfast, it was in room 368. I hope they told the people staying there because it was from 6:30-9:30!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is not the location you are looking for if you want to be close to several food options, shopping, entertainment or great views.  It's close to the airport and the hotel offers a shuttle.  Free wifi and a fridge are a plus, along with a good bathroom size and room size.  The staff I have encountered were all very friendly.  The rooms do not have enough outlets for those that have a few electronic devices and the nightstands are kind of short.  You cannot see the clock while laying on the bed.  The fitness room has 2 treadmills, 1 elliptical, some free weights and even a scale.  Small but decent pool.  Nothing special, but nothing bad.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Why I think it's the best traditional sushi in middle Tennessee is because of the simplicity and proportions. They have Americanized rolls if you really want them, but the sashimi and sushi are the way to go. The vinegar balance in the rice, the petite raw fish atop it, the wonderful fresh flavors. This is what real sushi is. 

Don't get me wrong, I like to explore sushi with fruit, nuts and cream cheese, but if you're looking for sushi like they have in Japan, this is your spot. Andy is one of the friendliest sushi chefs and managers around. I eat here 2-3 a week every week. Can't speak highly enough about this place.

We have only been able to actually eat here five out of ten times having tried. They turned us flat away once when we went in for lunch. They closed at two. We showed up at one. They said they were too busy and that they were closing early even though we called to verify their hours before showing up. Other times you show up and they are so crowded and the wait is long and uncomfortable because there is no room and we had to leave. Either show up early or don't bother. Go to China Yuan- there is better atmosphere and it is easier to get a table and the food is just as good.

Nothing to brag about. Huge restaurant on the water. If you sit outdoors be prepared to be on verge of attack by seagulls. They're fearless. Ordered a salad and well it was far from anything described on the menu. Said fresh mozzarella. I got supermarket grated white cheddar, not mozzarella. It said pancetta well I got bacon bits. 3 stars are for misleading customers to believing they're paying $14 for an entree salad and getting toppings described and getting a cheaper quality and still paying $14. If you can't deliver on toppings described then consider reducing your entree salad pricing.

Worst service I've ever encountered.  The employee that works here clearly just doesn't want to work here. I observed 5 interactions and he cared about nobody. 
None of the trays are labeled correctly. They are out of their caramel glazed donut which is on special.  I watched two people walk out because they were out. 
This is literally the only Krispy Kreme in the area - we drove 35 minutes to watch this guy be miserable. 
Couldn't figure out how to apply my birthday coupon. I paid and left.  I will be back but only because I like the product and this is the only one here. Hopefully Happy Harry quits by then.

In a town that is considered to be a "food town" this restaurant stands heads above the rest. 
I found it to have a slight "hipster vibe", which is not unattractive in this setting.  I love that the servers were hip, good looking guys dressed the part. No uniforms for this crew, unless a great shirt and a pair of jeans qualifies.
We ordered four different items off of the menu. The french fries were amazing, the summer salad was superb, the mac and cheese to die for and the goat cheese app was tasty indeed. 
What more can I say than...we'll be back! That is saying a lot in town with so many food choices!

Sigh... the 1970's color palette alone should have been enough of a warning sign for me... yet... I fell into the ingenious name of "California Mexican food" (which it is absolutely not". ‍ the jumbo taco also should've been a unmistakable sign yo not eat here... but I had to give it a shot. Well played CMF. Well done. You got my $8 on half eaten, level above Taco Bell (maybe 2 levels...), same thing as Los betos, Mexican food. Sigh... never again. Don't waste your time if you're looking for real California style Mexican food. You're better off at tacos el Rey and places like that.

We arrived at enterprise after waiting 1 hour at Payless car rental and getting no where! I went up to the desk literally sobbing. My husband and our 16 month old had been up since 4am and delayed flight so we were exhausted and just wanted to start our vacation. The lady working was so nice. She apologized for what happened to us at Payless and matched there price! We were in a car in 5mins!! All the check in people were so nice and don't bully you into getting extra insurance when you know you have it. Highly recommend!!! Thank you enterprise!!

Considering how close I live to this restaurant, I'm happy I found this place. I thought it was a little over priced, but then when I got my food, the portions were larger than expected. I got Hamachi, and Suzuki sushi, as well as a salad with ginger dressing. I'm a bit of a tea snob, so was pleasantly surprised when the tea I ordered was of a high quality. Service was very nice, efficient and attentive. Since this place is a BYOB I can't wait to go back with some beer and saki! I went in jeans and a hoodie and sat at the sushi bar, but if I were going again with people, I would dress up slightly.

I like this new Giant. It is a good grocery store and has all that you need. The pricing is about right. There is a good selection. 

The one thing I have a problem with at this giant location is SOME of the staff not all. The staff that carried over from Genuardi's are the ones that I truly enjoy and our helpful. The newer staff need to smile more, stop acting passive aggressive and drop the attitude. Half of them don'e even pay attention to customers because they are so immersed in talking amongst themselves. 

It is great for a quick stop and shop but I say Wegmans is where its at!

After eating here for the first time I was not impressed the decor was nice however the place is small and seating was extremely cramped the pizza was ok however not over the top.  The biggest disappointment was the lack of fountain drinks.  

A pizzeria without fountain drinks are you kidding me?!..  Price was very very high especially when there are no refills and no pre meal appetizer.  

Needless to say the Wife and I will not go back there anytime soon Bertuccis Is a much better bargain and the price is much less considering the amount of food/pizza size and free fountain free drink refills.

The hotel is in a perfect location in downtown Santa Barbara and it's a converted older hotel, so there is lots of character. The price is good and Holiday Inn Express always provides breakfast, so good for families. Be aware that this hotel is VERY loud. If you are looking for a relaxing place to stay, this is not it. Rooms are right on a main drag and cars drive by throughout the night. It's also a popular spot for the bar hoppers given it's location and price point. Bars close at 1AM, hotel hallways full of screaming dudes by 2AM.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The Jasper Ave location has a self-serve wand wash that is barely functional and in total disrepair. I had a machine take a couple of "toonies" without allocating time, so I told a staff member, their response was "I guess you'll have to go find a manager.", that's not exactly an acceptable level of service to me.  Their "spotless rinse" broke a couple of years ago and they seem to have decided to use a sharpie to cross out the option, rather than fix the issue on all of their units, That in itself speaks volumes about their attention to detail, which is ironic, considering they're a detailing business.

I came in here looking for a bar I had visited a few years ago that had awesome "classic" country music. I think I found it! I was with 5 of my girlfriends. The bartender (female) was GREAT, very attentive and friendly! The drinks aren't as pricey as they were at some other bars. The band playing that night was Eskimo Brothers, and we LOVED them! They had a Johnny Cash vibe and had some great original songs! We started out at a table towards the back, but after a drink or two, found ourselves dancing in the front! We stayed here for several hours until the band stopped and decided to explore a few more bars. I will definitely be back!

Oooh.. Yikes. I usually like the Wyndham.  This hotel, however is outdated and just not great.  Stains on flooring, switched rooms due to my tv not working, no soda machine near ice machine, the overall look of hallways and rooms are just kind of grimy.  The staff I encountered, from the van driver to the employees who checked us in, were very pleasant, so this review is not to reflect them.  They were great.   Unfortunately, a friendly staff isn't enough for a great stay. This hotel needs a makeover, to be a WYNDHAM hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The Mopper Kitchen was just "OK".  Not horrible, but not great.  I actually was disappointed that we wasted our last meal of a business trip eating here.  It was close to the motel and recommended by motel staff.  With that being said, as I mentioned above, food was ok.  Server was friendly and checked on us often.  Restaurant was stiflingly hot/stuffy.   I had chicken fried steak.  It had a nice crispy coating on it.   This place is a small step up from Denny's, but nowhere near casual fine dining (which it doesn't claim to be).  There was a full service bar so that is nice if you are staying nearby.

meh. that about sums it up. the only thing this place really has going for it is a good location. the hostess was unnecessarily haughty, for no apparent reason whatsoever. that aside, the service was slow and the food was mainly forgettable. to be fair, the rigatoni bolognese was decent, with a rich, flavorful meat sauce. my wife's arugula salad w/ filet mignon sucked. the filet was overcooked and not seasoned at all. the pizza was not very tasty. even my kids, who love pizza, weren't into it at all. given the good, open air locale, it might be a spot to hit up for drinks with friends, but not if your primary concern is a good Italian meal.

This is the first time I have eaten here since the new name. I can say the food is better than before. I ordered the big biscuit breakfast. It sounded interesting. Kind of like a biscuit version of eggs Benedict. It is a biscuit, sausage patty, egg and covered in sausage gravy (you get two). It came with a side of home fries. Now I am very picky about my biscuits and gravy. The biscuit had a consistency more like a cake and a little chewy. The sausage patty and sausage gravy was a little much.

The bathroom was clean and the restaurant also felt clean. Overall, you get a lot of decent food for the money.

Seriously. I think this was the best squid ink pasta I've ever had- and I've definitely had a few. Quiet, intimate atmosphere with attentive- not overbearing- staff who are so welcoming. Honestly, when I was told that the chefs could probably make almost any pasta even if if wasn't on the menu as long as they had the ingredients, they'd already gained points with me. I could tell throughout my dinner that customer service is a big deal with everyone here, and it was really appreciated. I can see why locals love this place so much

Some of the absolute worst tacos that can be found on the planet are served during the Tuesday night $5.99 all-you-can-eat taco special.  Swimming and dripping in excessive orange liquid grease, the taco practically spurts this oily mixture when you bite into it, and smaller even than Taco Bell's cheapest models.   My hands still smelled like the rancid grease the next day despite multiple vigorous washings.  If it was possible to imprison people for serving atrociously bad tacos, this would be it.  Service was mediocre at best.   You'd be better off at Taco Bell.

It's a little gem hidden in a strip mall. Delicious, no frills Italian food. Sure, the plates aren't anything fancy and there aren't any crazy menu items, but the menu is full of delicious Itailan classics that are very generous in portion. I usually go for the linguini with clams in the white sauce and it never disappoints. This place should definitely be on your radar for Italian joints in the area. 

They also do banquets and large parties. A friend had their rehearsal dinner here a while ago, and they were able to serve all the meals, hot and delicious, to a large crowd!

Come here for great deals on seasonal local produce. Pineapple upside down cake from the bakery for old school awesomeness. Only place that I know of where I can buy veal knuckles in the meat case every day without having to beg a butcher. Otherwise pretty typical. Family owned and run, big plus for service at all customer contact points. A better than average selection of gourmet/foodie type items, but it's no Dorignac's. Much cheaper than Winn-Dixie...and why would you want to give them of all people your money anyway?? Support local businesses and local products!

Not a hotel if you're over 35. Best way to describe it is a "hipster" vibe. You check in at the bar. The person who checks you in is also the bartender. You do get two free drink tokens. Although, went I used mine to get a bourbon with a "splash" of water, she filled my glass to the top with water. 
The lobby is filled with games. The hallways and doors are painted a dark blue. The rooms are quirky. No dressers. Hooks across the wall to hang your clothes. No mini fridge. Beds on platforms. TV kept freezing and coming back on. There are some great restaurants in the area. Definitely a hotel for a younger crowd
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
United Terminal D - near gates D11-13.
Immediately seated - just seat yourself. Probably 50 tables plus folks at the bar stools. Took 12 min to place an order and 8min to get a glass of wine.
Not good when you are pressed for time / flights.

Tried to order a bottle of Chardonnay that was on the menu initially - but not in stock. 

Plenty of TVs for sports fans.  Slight beer smell in the place.  Moderate noise level for easy conversation.  Place would be cheerier if lights were turned up a bit.  Table was wiped clean when we sat down.  Many IPA beers available.

Boneless chicken wings served that were dry and served cool - not even warm! Yikes

I hate to admit how much I enjoy McDonald's every now and then. I saw a commercial for the new "artisan" grilled chicken bacon sandwich and went to go get it today. The cashiers were laughing and looking at me like there was some inside joke I wasn't in on... Then I opened my bag and glaring me right in the face was a long black hair sitting right on top of my fries. It was OBVIOUS. Their laughing and looking at me with the smiles that weren't friendly smiles make sense when I saw the obviously placed hair. Trashy and immature. 12 noon Monday 4/38/15
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is the absolute cleanest gym I've ever been to. The people working here are always friendly and keeping things tidy, even moving equipment to clean underneath it.  Seriously they work their asses off.  Everyone cleans up after themselves and practices common etiquette.  I've been with a few dozen gyms primarily along the east coast and am pleasantly impressed with this one.  It's a nice place to workout, with nice people, and I'm not afraid to take a shower. Also it's right near an aldi and indian restaurant so you can't go wrong.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This place had a nice, warm, friendly look and feel from the street. We were greeted by the bar tender and given menus the second we sat down. Great giant screen for football watching. Then the dream bubble burst. The single server walked by us no less than six times, never once even glancing at us. It was just the two of us plus about four others in the place. Surely one of the other 10 staff members milling about would notice our abandonment, but alas nobody to the rescue. I swear we took showers earlier!  Had to leave. Hotel clerk later confirmed it was a bad choice.

This review is mostly for the bar. My husband and I had  driven past Mangos several times and always mentioned wanting to check it out. We finally got a night out and decided to try it. New were greeted right away at the bar by Chuy and offered a few of the specials. We got a bucket of beer for 9 bucks! Say What?! We tried the chorizo dip and were pleasantly surprised.  We usually go to Rio bravo go to for a beer and a dip ,but I think we are jumping ship. Bartender was awesome, very attentive.  Rio bravo not so much, and beers are cheaper but location is nicer. It's a no brainer.

We were there a couple of months ago for dinner on a Saturday night.  The food was good, but came too fast (if you can believe that).  We wouldn't be done with one course before the next course came.  The drinks were excellent though.

Today, we went for the Sunday brunch.  It was the worst brunch we've ever had.  The place was dead, which should have been a clue.  The potatoes were cold, the bacon was one big lump and the chicken nuggets were tough.  I couldn't cut through the carved roast beef or the eggs benedict muffin.  Service was OK

Try this place, but don't do it on Sunday buffet!!

We love Sakura. It doesn't look like much from the outside, but the inside is a really cute and hip Japanese restaurant. We generally dine in because take out takes longer than desired, and the wait has gotten much longer for dinner since this place has started to catch on.

50% off all day sushi sounds like it would cheapen the food, but the sushi is always incredibly fresh and really good. Our favorites are the black angel roll & sweet potato roll. They also bring an orange to you after the meal, cut up into a fun shape. It's BYOB so feel free to bring your own beer, wine, etc. Love it & wish I still lived close to it!

I like the idea of a hotel without a casino but for the price we paid, I would of expected far more. The view of the river was awesome and the bed comfortable but we found things still either broken or not finished. Next door there literally is a room with a whole the size of a grapefruit and there was painters tape in our room. All food within this hotel stops at 10 so if you're hungry or want a snack, good luck. The room was odd that it had random space that wasn't utilized and just made it weird. This will be our first and definitely last time staying at this place, I'm so underwhelmed... the two stars are for the view we had.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very good solid New American cuisine. The outdoor eating area is an absolute gem, tucked into a corner so you're away from the street noise & traffic, and is illuminated with strands of lights around the trees. There was mellow live jazz being performed the night we were there which really added to the already delightful ambience. Service was great. Decent wine list. They even had 2 European Rieslings by the glass , which is in my experience almost never available. Service was good, if a tad slow, but it was a weekend night after the St. Louis Art Fair, and they were slammed.

We rarely do take out and are glad to have used this place. Since we live up the street, we picked up. The establishment is nice and clean. The food was very good. Nice juicy and meaty bar b que ribs (with bone). seasoned well. Clean crisp vegetables with nicely seasoned sauces. Beef with the mixed vegetables was flavorful as well. Vegetable egg rolls were good. Plenty of food to eat. Glad to know this take out is very doable. We made our own won ton soup and were just looking for something to round out the dinner. Rice and fortune cookies too!

During the seven years that I lived in Morrisville, PA, this was my go to spot. There were not many food options in Morrisville to begin with and Cafe Antonio was just a few blocks away, so it was certainly convenient, but what really kept me going back was the food. I mostly ordered take out, but dined in a few times as well. If you decide to eat in the dining room, keep in mind that it's BYOB. Try the Capellini Antonio. It's awesome. If you opt for take out, I highly recommend either a meatball or chicken parm hero. Both are AMAZING. The sauce is outstanding and they bake their own bread. Bonus points for a super awesome and friendly staff.

We had a wonderful day and nights at the Renaissance Hotel. The Room was large and well appointed. The beds are very comfortable, and the view was nice over the river. The Best Part is the staff. Everyone on the staff is eager to help and very friendly even to the point of getting to know your name. Vicki the General Manager and Robbie her assistant were very helpful and made our stay even more amazing. They gave us a $50.00 comp for our dinner. The food was really great dinner at the Shore Room. Our New favorite place in Reno.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went on the hunt for frozen yogurt and a place to just hang out and people watch. Was really disappointed in the selection of toppings for the yogurt -- it seemed as if the staff put the toppings out first thing and never went back to check on them as the day wore on to see if anything needed to be refilled. Many of the toppings ended up being mixed probably as customers were using them -- so coconut ended up on chocolate chips etc. The line to checkout was really long and took forever to move so by the time we sat down to eat our FroYo -- it was half melted.

Came here as a tourist from NYC as this is the oldest most famous Italian restaurant in America. Service was good. The meatball appetizer was great. Their red sauce is delicious. Everything else however was pretty disappointing. We had the mussels, penne a la vodka and the cheese cavatelli in Gorgonzola cheese sauce. We really wanted to love this place but it just didn't hit the mark. All the food lacked flavor. Save yourself the time and skip this place, go to La Nonna's (which we went to the night before and was fantastic) or try another place.

Tasty original designs, quality fish, comfortable interior, competitive pricing and friendly people. The menu is refreshingly updated.  The creations include all manner of non-traditional rolls as well as a good number of the usuals.  The fish is a better quality than you will find anywhere else in the Reno-Tahoe area.  I learned that the owner goes to some lengths to get fish that is not typically available in this market.  The difference is noticeable.  You should try the chef's seared tuna nigiri.  It was the best! Oh and one more thing you must try is the mussels.  Soooo good.

Pizza my heart is some of the best pizza around, especially in IV. They serve by the slice or take whole pizza orders. I recently discovered that they have really good bread sticks too! The best part for me is the stamp cards; you can really quickly earn free sodas, salads, and slices, and it's overall a really good deal - especially because the salads are really delicious. They have super awesome daily specials, but all their pizzas are excellent. Plus the district manager that works there is always really nice! As are all of their employees, of course. I always like coming here with friends; there's usually room and they're very accommodating

The husband and I decided to stop in as we love the original Crusoe's on Osceola. The ambience here was odd, similar to the many restaurants that started off in the city and expanded to the county. Just not the same.
Had the chicken modiga which was very tasty. Husband had the smothered chicken, very bland. He wound up eating mine. Glad that they had the two entrees for one deal, otherwise we would've felt cheated. Paid $3 per drink with no refills. Couldn't find the waitress. Would go back for the same deal.

This place has been good to me but lately their service has seem to gone down. 
I go in for a walk in because they have a sign that says walk ins are welcome. So I walk in and don't even get greeted by the two barbers and I sit and wait 15 minuets for the next guy to be available then he decides to ask if I had an appointment and I told him no and he said he can't take me because he has an appointment coming in ten min. Would be nice to be greeted from the start and not waste my time waiting to be turned down

Overall Score: 2.75 Stars (Too Greasy)

My wife and I ordered the same thing - duck and fried rice. She had very little meat and she loves to eat meat off the bone, a lot of fat and non-crispy skin - very disappointing considering other folks reviews. I had a very different experience - not fatty, enough duck for a meal although my skin could have had a bit more crisp. The egg roll we shared was crisp, non-greasy and tasty. The fried rice under the duck was good, nothing exceptional. We were there right before the lunch rush at Reading Terminal Market. For us, a little disappointing considering the reviews.

Thanks

Went to Lorenzo's for the first time to celebrate mine and my parent's anniversaries. My parents had been there previously and loved it. Had no problems with the reservations, were seated promptly, server was very attentive. Food was absolutely delicious. Slightly pricey, but I thought the entrees were mostly reasonable for the quality of food. Thought the drinks and the soups/salads/desserts were slightly over-priced (our total for three drinks and three desserts came out to approx $66 of our total bill). Overall, I would definitely be back, but may have a drink at a neighboring bar before dinner!

It may not be the cutest place, or the cleanest (at times), but the staff and the food make it all worth it. I've never had a bad experience here. I lived in Alton for almost 2 years before finding this place. I usually go with The Godfather's breakfast since you get a little bit of everything for $7ish. My favorite place to order scrambled eggs - they're always light, fluffy, and perfect. I substitute Reese's pancakes for zee plain too for a little extra. 100% worth it! The staff members are always friendly and attentive - even when it's packed. This little Alton gem is a must.

Would I come here again probably not. Why? Because to be honest, it wasn't really memorable. My dad and I ordered a cheeseburger (I had the sauce on the side), a BBQ burger, fries and zucchinis. It was nice because the burgers had shredded lettuce on them...the buns were soft..and the service was quick. The zucchini I thought were a bit greasy, the fries, nice and crunchy which was nice, tasted average, and the burgers were alright.  Its a great place for a stop over quick meal at a good price. Worth a try, but if you want something memorable, try the Boise Fry Company.

I was running around REI and decided to get a quick haircut I  walked into this place and the only free person was a little Asian woman, greeted me with a big smile so I said to myself what the hell. her name is Rosemary and she is normally at the end. she was nice, followed my directions trimmed me up she also trimmed my eyebrows used warm shaving cream and a straight razor to do my neck. after all that she hooked me up with a minute neck and shoulder rub. After i stood up I had a smile on my face and kind of felt high. easy to give her a 8-10 tip. she's a very sweet person. I been going to see her for the last year. always a good experience

Had a great experience dining here alone on business. Sat at the Chef's bar right in front of the kitchen so I got a show with my delicious meal. I tried the meatball appetizer (same meatballs as in the spaghetti and meatballs entree) and it was excellent. Huge meatballs stuffed with cheese atop polenta, coated in red sauce. Caesar salad was good, loved the polenta croutons. Also tried the famous wild mushroom arancini - wow. It's fried ricotta balls with truffle oil - so amazing!!! Can't wait to visit again.

Possibly the most over priced over rated Hampton I have ever stayed at.   Over $150 a night and they cannot even provide a airport shuttle.   What they did do though was reserve me a taxi for that turned out to be a car service that charged me $45 for a ten minute ride to the airport.   Very deceptive there.    I have also never stayed in a Hampton Inn that did not have microwave or refride in it.   You would think for the over inflated price charged it would at least have that???  Will never stay there again while on business in Nashville and cannot recommend to even my enemies.  At best this is a 3 star hotel charging 4 star prices
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My husband and I went here for the first time on Friday night. I ordered the blackened shrimp tacos and my husband got the firecracker burger. Both were absolutely PHENOMENAL. The shrimp was seasoned perfectly with a slaw and amazing sauce. The burger was cooked just right and my hubby was raving about the quality of the meat. They had live entertainment, the place including the bathrooms were clean, and our server Nicholas was very attentive and friendly. The homemade sangria was fantastic as well!! We will definitely be back and will recommend this place to everyone!!

Pros : quiet for the most part. Low crime. Ladies in the office are nice. 
Cons: overpriced, deffered property maintenance everywhere. Landscaping is terrible. Lawns are piss stained and flooded. Trash all over the place. Pool is broken alot and they are not quick to fix it. Never see security patrolling. Parking is a joke. People don't care if it's theirs or not. Bug infestation in the common areas. I mean zillions of them. So gross!!! Rocks cover most of the ground and are scattered all over driveways and parking area. No maintenance people clean it up. .. ever. It's mind-blowing how much we pay and how dirty it is.

Without a doubt, a local gem. Warm service, delicious food, homemade pasta. What could be better. Oh, how about not having to drive over the bridge (unless you are coming from Philly, which is worth your while) or pay to park, or the fact that it is BYOB? Not sure if I can pick a favorite part of our meal, but one standout was the octopus with crispy pig face. Try it. So good. I also loved the short rib. There is something for everyone on the menu, which, I believe is about to change with the season, all the more reason to go back. Can't wait to try brunch in the near future.

A whole restaurant dedicated to mac and cheese? I had to try it.  So I went with my brother who is also macaroni and cheese lover and we were so excited we couldn't pick one; We decided to order The Classic, Black and Bleu, and The Hill and share. I'm not sure if I over-hyped it for myself but I definitely was disappointed. 

This was our experience. When we tried The Hill tasted strangely like a Totino's Pizza. I wasn't really sure what to think about that. The Black and Bleu had such a strong blue-cheese aroma it was over bearing. The Classic was decent but truthfully, I'd rather stay home and eat Velveeta.

Stayed here one night for a conference in Philly with my mom.  Neither of the room keys worked, went down to the desk to have them re-done, and when I went back up one worked and one didn't.  No big deal.  

Remote for the TV was erratic, and someone brought up a new one.

Beds and the bathroom were fine.

The restaurant downstairs, although a bit pricey, was decent as well.

The pool is tiny - basically one lane with a little leeway at each end.  The fitness center had a few more resistance machines than I usually see in hotels.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Had a pleasant date night here.
