Came because of the reviews of the meatballs was not impressed. Solid meatball but nothing special. Fortunately I ordered the gnocchi which was perfectly done. Light cloud like pillows with a delicious sauce nicely plated. Service was attentive but not overbearing.
Not likely I will return as I don't live in Philadelphia but very happy I came in they are doing many things right here. I have recommended it  and gotten positive feedback Just not my preference but if in the area worth a try

Not much to review ... it's a Starbucks; what can you say, except to be glad they have one in the mall! You get your drink, and hope it's up to par. If not, they'll make you another one. So relax, and hope they get your drink right. Also, prices are a little higher than other stores, the barista couldn't explain why. But that's ok- maybe they're a privately operated. 

There are few tables and chairs, so it is convenient to stop, have coffee, and strategize shopping plans. 

They use the app, and it's convenient.

A whatzit that is surely cleaner and more glamorous than lower-end spots without being much more expensive, but not as enjoyable as other "good" hotels.

The woodsy room is better for architectural interest than function, with a strange non-contiguous toilet that isn't in the bathroom. The main entrance is also unpleasant as someone else noted. 

This was the first time ever that has a hotel hasn't allowed any kind of late checkout. 

The location is excellent, close to a wide range of trains and buses, various food and coffee options and Rittenhouse Square.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Usually the brick oven pizzas are good, but Saturday we ordered a large plain cheese pizza and it was terrible. My husband picked it up and it was so dissappointing! Extremely salty, greasy about three tablespoons of grease came off the pie, we let it drip. Also bottom of pie was burnt. I called and asked to speak with the manager, she was not in left a message with the girl who answered the phone asking what changed- we order pizza from here about every two weeks, but she did not know. Oh well not sure I want to chance it again.

Creative cuisine, nicely cooked, served well (thanks Egan)....all made for a memorable evening. We had Scallops, Halibut, Foie Gras and special Veal. Each delicious, though my vegetables (with the Veal) were a little over-salted. Bar cocktails are very good, as were the glasses of wine we both enjoyed. This really is fine dining and much enjoyed. We'll be back, and very soon.
One suggestion: the cream on the otherwise excellent Irish Coffee's should be poured, not whipped.
Thanks to all for a special evening for us!

Delightful Sunday dinner with friends, with the fixed-price menu ($30 sans drinks and coffee). We had salmon, which was delicious and very nicely prepared and presented. Dessert choices was further limited, as our first selection was no longer available (though we spotted other diners being served the preferred dish long after we'd attempted to place our order). Nice cocktails and good measures of wine (Corner Bistro to note please!). Table service wasn't the best, our server was doubling as the bar-keep and we had to go collect him twice. Overall though, a very nice evening of of good food and company.

Bon, j'y suis passé en 2006 lors d'un périple sur la Route 66. Ayant vu le film Harold et Kumar de 2004, j'avais prié ma chère et tendre de m'amener à un White Castle.

Il faisait plus de 40 degrés ce jour-là, nous y sommes passé à la nuit tombante lors de la fête nationale du 4 juillet. Les silders, ces petits hamburgers miniatures étaient mangeables mais le restaurant lui-même, situé sous une bretelle d'autoroute était un lieu de rencontre notoire pour drogués et prostituées. Le spectacle était surréel mais après y être passé, je pouvais fièrement dire que j'avais mangé à un White Castle...

So one of the girls from Holiday Inn suggested we go here, out of all WONDERFUL  places to go, we were starving so we just went to the closest place possible. I wish we didn't end up here but we did. I think she may have suggested this place because its connected to the Holiday Inn right next door. Anyway, the service was ok, it was clean inside, but the food is like soooo NOT authentic  New Orleans food. Tasted like a robot made it with a set of instructions. They have a breakfast buffet in the early part of the morning , that Holiday Inn gave us a discount coupon for, but we didn't use it; cause I mean what for....

Not impressed at all. Started with the cheese board, which was completely uninspired. The grapes were not fresh, had seeds, blackberries were mushy and flavorless. The three types of cheese were (disappointingly) similar.  I had the ravioli with shrimp for dinner. Although it was advertised as having a "light" pesto, the sauce was very creamy and heavy, completely over powering the dish. The shrimp was very salty and barely cooked (and almost seemed like it had been boiled?)  

Considering there were only 2 other tables occupied the entire time we were dining, I'd say the word is out that this place is sub par.

This was my first visit and expected it to be busier.  I was greeted by a friendly young lady who I informed that I needed to order a take out and the waiter/barman offered me a refreshment whilst I looked over the menu. I ordered steak and chicken Fajita Quesadilla's, one to drop off at a nearby office and one for myself. I do not think I can truly base my option on the takeout as I am sure if the meal had been served in the restaurant it would have tasted and looked better. I was slightly concerned how quickly the food was prepared, so maybe it is ready cooked for the quick lunch service.

I really wanted to like this place and went in with high hopes. We went in for lunch, this being one of the few sushi places that doesn't close from 2:30-5. The service was good, and the waitress did what she could but the food did not match the atmosphere. The sashimi was almost 1/2 an inch thick, and lacked any grace. I should not have the bite-off a piece. When I realized that a roll came covered in eel sauce (of which I can't stand) they would not remake it because it was already made. I was told they could remake it but I would be charged for both rolls. All in all I will NOT be going back.

Working in Indy for a few days at an all day basketball event, so options or limited. It's concession stand food or delivery.  I opted for the latter and went with Hong Kong.

Food is not BAD at all.  I split the General Tso's chicken and the hot and spicy chicken with a friend.  We asked for it VERY spicy and while they did not oblige to our requests, the food was quite solid.  The lunch specials don't come with egg roll or soup, so if that is your vibe, you have to order ala carte.

I also forgot to mention, it is CHEAP. 6 bucks for a lunch special in the middle of 2021, so can't beat it in terms of bang for your buck!

My father and I went here while he was in town recently helping me move to Philly from LA. Our friend recommended this place for a slice, and we brought my 10 month old daughter with us. As soon as we walked in the door, we felt welcomed and well taken care of. The dining area is super casual; they had a high chair for my daughter. The whole experience was very laid back. If you're looking for a good slice at a cheap price in a comfortable, laid back environment with great customer service - this is your spot.

The food was great, but the service lacked greatly. They had to run across the street to refill our sodas, and I finally got so thirsty I just ordered water, which came with 3 pieces of ices and three floating "unknown" objects.  Their sushi-boat concept is a cool idea, but they don't explain it to you so we didn't know how it worked until we had spent the money on rolls.  I'm not a sushi expert, but I guess I was supposed to know how it worked.  The service was slow, and there was nothing telling us what each roll was on the boat. I would NOT suggest this for a lunch-hour, you won't get in and out in your hour.

Worst service ever. Apparently only the drive-through is open which I understand with Covid but I waited in line for 10 minutes while people played on their phone instead of waiting on me or even telling me that I was waiting without a purpose even though I try to get their attention multiple times. I am an avid fan of Dunkin' Donuts and I will never come back to this location ever oh. And I know they weren't using the phones for work because I saw a girl checking out her Instagram and talking To another a police specifically about somebody else's picture on that platform

I have been using this place for my alterations so I didn't think twice about having them alter a scarf I bought. It was an "infinity" scarf and I just wanted it cut and hemmed. I paid $10 for the scarf. I go to pick it up and they charged me $20. Really? They don't even charge that for hemming a pair of jeans, which has to be much more labor intensive. I felt taken advantage of and I feel the price was DOUBLE what it should've been. I won't be going back. There are plenty of places to go that will value my business more.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: This place is OK.  I've been there a few times while visiting Tucson, only because it's really close to the place we stay, but I would REALLY like to find something new.  The atmosphere and service were nothing special, though not particularly bad either.  I did enjoy the chips and salsa (though I'm not that picky with salsa, unless it tastes like ketchup)...but the food was just mmeh :/  Again, nothing special...it was very comparable to the (not-so-authentic) Mexican food we have in California...except for a few items, like the Sonoran Dog.

We walked in to finally try this restaurant. After standing around for 5 minutes, we were seated. It took 15 minutes to be brought chips and salsa, after other tables that were seated after us were served. Another 10 minutes went by and we still didn't have drinks and other tables were being waited on. Finally someone came over to get our drink order and came back another 5 minutes later with drinks. We waited another 15 minutes and still no waiter came back to take our food order. We left enough money to cover my husbands soda and our chips and salsa and left. Wouldn't come back to this location. Disappointed.

My husband and I stopped into Charlie Gitto's on a Sunday evening around 8PM. It was quiet with a nice ambiance. We were promptly seated  out our waiter was attentive and helpful. The restaurant has a upscale romantic feeling to it and the linens and, silverware and glasses are nice quality...it's fun to feel fancy occasionally. 

My husband ordered a whisky cocktail and I ordered a delightful pinot noir. My husband's dinner was the Italian chopped salad with anchovies added to it, and I indulged in the chicken rigatoni in a Asiago cream sauce....amazing.

When when we are back at Hollywood Casino we will check Charlie Gitto's menu further.

I started working in Old City in May, and searched high & low for a coffee spot to fulfill my specialty coffee needs. I have since discovered Menagerie, and haven't stopped drinking their coffee since. 

Their hand pours & almond milk cortados are my go to for beverages. I am also a fan of their cold brew (in the summertime). The atmosphere and layout of the shop is extremely aesthetically pleasing. I have always had a friendly and pleasant experience with every single barista. April & Elysa are the best, they definitely know their stuff!

I am constantly recommending Menagerie to clients & friends, and will definitely continue to do so.

Wonderful place, location & decor.  Staff was amazing.  We signed up for the priority membership, offered snack & drink when we arrived.  Snack was nice, but out of the Fitz root beer, brewed just down the street.  The awesome staff manager ran down the block to fetch us some.  Did I say Awesome?  Yup, I did.

Parking is free in the back, valet is available.  Rooms are updated, beds are very comfy, plenty of outlets.  Love the blacklight in the hallway for room numbers.  Room service was good, food was good (we were too tired to go out to the amazing restaurants in the area).  We hope to stay there again soon.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: You know that Chinese restaurant you find and ALWAYS order from, yeah, this is that place. Nothing extravagant about this place at all but the food is great. The portions are huge, I don't know how they close the containers sometimes b/c there is so much food in them. I'm not sure if they classify themselves as a "take-out only" place but it seems to be since they only have 2 tables and usually there kids are playing PSP or computer games on one of the tables. The lady that gives you your food is VERY nice and will hook you up with as many soy/duck/mustard packets that your bag is full.

The food was okay here.  Nothing that stood out, but good enough to where I couldn't really say anything bad about it.  Order the California chicken sandwich and there wasn't much to it, but managed to hit the spot.

Service was pretty good and we were always being checked in on.  They also had a pretty good selection of beers on tap.  

It was just a very standard bar with very typical bar food.  The vibe was good as we were watching the football game and it would be a place I'd come back to to grab a beer or have a quick bite to eat.

Yes, it's nice, it's cheap, and not too far away from where I live. However I joined and cancelled within a week because it's far too crowded. There was always cardio equipment available but the free weight area was not large enough and didn't have enough benches available, so I couldn't complete my workout. Annoying! I'll pay a little extra for another gym so I don't have to fight the mob scene that is Planet Fitness. Their parking lot situation is just as bad, so no thanks. Great for folks who can handle crowds of college students and traffic jams.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Yeah, I know it's a chain. "Boo! Where's your sense of adventure?"

Blah, blah, blah.

Well, sometimes you find youself in the suburbs and there aren't any "good" restaurants around, and in my opinion  Macaroni Grill is the lesser of all the evils. 

Most evil? Applebee's. But I digress.

We've all been to a Macaroni Grill. So instead of a writing a real review I will take this opportunity to tout the create your own pasta dish I created last night. It was pretty awesome.

Penne.
Vodka Sauce
Chicken.
Sundried Tomatoes
Mushrooms
Broccoli.

Yum.

Right on Bourbon St. where all the action is. Comfortable enough beds, directly off Bourbon St., free internet, lenient in/out parking privileges, reasonable overnight parking prices, friendly staff, and nice room setup. The internet was not great. Lost signal during the day while trying to work. Beds were small (double and 2 of them) and not that comfortable. The 5th floor had a terrible smell but they did try and remedy this. Great deal for the week after Mardi Gras! Would have liked a suite but it was comfortable enough!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been coming to this location for over half a year now and it's been good to me. Since it's not a stand alone building like some other crunches there are few amenities not present for instance a pool or a dedicated spin room etc. I go to various crunches depending on my current location but this one has always maintained a friendly staff from what I can tell. Patrons are consistent and most are friendly or will wave to you. Yes there are fees but everything is addressed in the contract. Well maintained and clean facility.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I love coming here for the Cappys Chicago Deep Dish Pizza (small size)! The service is a hit or miss, normally we don't have a problem but I think there are a few new hires, one of whom was our waiter who was not very attentive at all. The only other issue I've ever personally experienced was the dough seemed undercooked when we ordered a Large deep dish. Sadly I overhyped the place to my parents who were visiting and my dad still remembers to this day the undercooked dough, long wait, and doesn't want to go back. The small size deep dish dough has always came out perfect for me  Definitely a pizza place worth trying at least once!

The food was definitely quite good here but it was really the service that I was most impressed by. We were a very hungry and weary group of seven when we arrived with lots of questions because of dietary challenges and they could not have handled us better even willing to pull tables together in an unconventional configuration to accommodate us. They have a special deal on margaritas and kept the chips and yummy salsa coming. The only disappointment was the guacamole which was a bit frothy and didn't get eaten. I ordered something off the children's menu which they allow for just an up charge another thing I really appreciated.

The black cod here is probably my favorite thing to eat in Philly and what keeps me going back. The prices are a little high, but you're paying for quality of food and for quality of food preparation.

My Japanese-Italian friend with peanut allergies visited and I took her here. Being Japanese, she's very picky about her sushi restaurants. Being italian, she's very vocal about her likes and dislikes. She loved it. As a bonus, because she has peanut allergies, she asked about how everything was made, and we learned how thorough they are in the kitchen. They even make their own bread for the bread pudding (which was delicious).

Ok the hotel looks great from the lobby and has a nice bar.  The meeting facilities are also good for small to large groups.

The rooms are recently redone....So you are probably wondering why a 3 star and not higher.  The reason is that the walls in the rooms are paper thin!!!  I could hear the TV next door, a guy getting up in the middle of the night to use the bathroom upstairs, and a person talking next door.  Too bad that the hotel does not have good bones to limit the sound issues. If you are not a light sleeper you will love the place as it is clean, inexpensive, and very good service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This was my sushi restaurant of choice for 5+ years. The services was great, friendly, the food was awesome, portions sizes outstanding and properly matched by price. However this was pre-Liquor license. Now it seems the portions are smaller but my bill is much larger. The service has changed also to a round robin serving style(we had 3 or 4 diff servers), perhaps because the place was empty. Sigh! I will always be a fan of Mikado.  The Food is still great and the lunchbox are still packed... Just a couple things they need to resolve to put them back at number 1.

Food was passable.  Not much flavor in my brunch items when there was plenty of room to add herbs and spices.

They need a new bar manager or train this one better.  They keep tawny port in the refrigerator, there was some confusion regarding how to make high end cocktails (Sazerac, Old Fashion).

The deviled eggs are very good and worth the trip.

Did not appreciate the look given by the waitress when I asked that my salad be tossed in the dressing before bringing to the table.

These comments are after three trips to the restaurant.

Despite its strip mall location, this place is a little gem. The food is excellent -- especially compared to its sushi competition in the area -- and it has a very nice atmosphere.

We ordered take-out on a very busy night (holiday), and they seemed a little overwhelmed with the crowd, which is why I give it 4 starts instead of 5. That said, we will be back, probably many times, because the food really was quite good. And as a local, it's always nice to have quality, successful, BYOBs in town. If you haven't given this place a try, you really should.

I like this place a lot .. it's centrally located.. the staff are all nice.. except the only bad thing about the place is ... the parking!

First off I want to say.. it's a Holiday Inn Express.  Don't expect it to be a 5 star super sexy hotel.. be realistic. It's for convenience. 

Second... yeah so the parking sucked.. but they have valet which is nice. If you're not familiar with the area, park your car at the hotel (they will charge you) and then just walk everywhere you need to go. The bars are SUPER close. YAYE
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Worst paint job ever. I'm giving two stars because the manicure was great but the paint job, which is typically the easiest but most integral part of the process, was awful. She rushed me out of the chair which caused me to accidentally bump three fingers and mess them up. She rolled her eyes at the fact she had to repaint them and proceeded to huff and puff while walking me to the drying station. I don't write many negative reviews but this situation last night has been on my mind since I left the salon. Customer service is lacking at this establishment... Never going back.

Went here with my wife for an inexpensive Friday night out.  The food did not disappoint and the service was excellent.  The waitress refilled our water a couple times without even being asked, offered up Marg. mix for our Tequila (byot!) and had helpful recommendations on the menu.  I had the Shrimp Diablo platter (spicy, but not crazy hot, and delicious).  The dessert was also quite good, and was homemade dough balls with ice cream and cinnamon and honey....mmmm.  Overall, and great meal for 2 for less than $35.
Will definitely be here again.

I'm not someone who is super picky about my hair or anything and I hated this place. All I got was a simple trim and it was uneven (I was in such a rush to get out at the end I didn't notice until I got home). The woman doing my hair asked if I wanted a blow dry. For 8 dollars I turned it down and after she was finished with the cut she just left my hair dripping wet. I had to squeeze out the water as best I could before walking over to the eyebrow waxing station. She didn't use any kind of cream after the waxing like I've always gotten at other places. Generally I felt like a bother. Maybe I caught her on a bad day but I won't be back.

I've gone to Katie at Salon Bass for over 5 years and continue to commute from New York City just for her to work her magic!  Katie has always respected what I wanted and offered her suggestions when I had no idea or was in need of a change.  Katie is absolutely fantastic with color; we've done partial and full highlights, and she always makes sure I leave the salon a perfect sun-kissed blonde.  Katie never pressures me to go for new trends.  Instead, she knows exactly what I need for a professional looking haircut.  Plus, Katie is warm, hilarious, and has THE cutest dog. Simply put, she's the best.

Auto Air Conditioning, A/C repair

Todd Puglisi, owner  - did a great job on my 2011 Subaru Outback.  We had other cars repaired by him when he worked for the previous owner.  

Fair price, realistic repair expectation, Todd communicates the status and updates of the car to you.  He showed me all my damaged parts.  I was able to leave my car for a couple days while parts arrived and he could work me into his busy schedule.

I highly recommend Todd and his growing business, if you can be accommodating with time he will use OEM parts, give it 12 months/ 12,000 miles support, and be super professional.

This place is my new obsession. I just moved to the area a few months ago and found this place from tags on Instagram. It looked pretty good from all the pictures, so I wanted to try it out. My friend and I split chips and guac, each got chicken tacos, and she got a shrimp taco. All were phenomenal. I also got a margarita, which our server told us is what they are known for and it did not disappoint either. The menu originally seemed complicated and difficult to navigate, but Summer is very knowledgeable and was super helpful. I would recommend this place to anyone!

A week ago had a seminar at st. Pete and found this place next to Hilton hotel. As a fan of crispy duck - ordered one there - it was okay, but lucking some flavors. Carrots and  zucchinis very steamed just to the right softness but lacked flavors too. Soup of day - Italian wedding soup was better but somewhat on salty side - I do not know why cooks like to put maximum of it if a client can always add some to his liking. paid $38 with tip for meal and tea. Service was okay, place looked clean, but food did not impress me.

Fresh on the heels of a horribly bad experience at the Chart House, I went to dinner with my family to Jimmy's with low expectations. But Jimmy's turned out to be a really good experience. I ordered a burger, my wife ordered the Ahi salad. Both were very good and served in a timely manner. The live entertainment  started after we finished dinner and it was very nice. All in all, the drinks were good and the food was good. We enjoyed our time at the restaurant and left in a great mood. It was a really nice dinner.

Late Review -- we ate here on 1/24/15 after my fiancee picked me up from the Nashville Airport.

I ordered a Country Fried Steak w/ mashed potatoes and fried squash.  Fried Squash was bland, no flavor, but rest of my meal was pretty good, I liked it.  My fiancee went with a 1/2 chicken dinner, collard greens and mashed potatoes -- she liked her meal a lot, it was a very generous portion of chicken.

Service was great also, didn't catch the name of our waitress, but she was funny & attentive.  Would certainly drop back in to Norman Couser's if we're back in Nashville, they make some decent Country food.

After reading some of the negative reviews, I am baffled because this BYOB delivers everything one could want in an eating experience: delectable food, excellent service, and cozy ambiance. The Roasted Beet Salad with Ricotta was seasoned just right and encompassed the perfect balance of sweet, savory, and creamy.  The Teres Major was simply perfect--juicy, tender, and flavorful! We were too full for dessert, but everything that came out looked decedent. All items are made to order, so this facilitates a relaxed eating experience. Don't expect to be rushed. Take your time, sip your wine, and enjoy.

Went for the 2 pairs for $89 deal. It's a great deal if you need the slightest of vision correction. If you have the need for "thicker" lenses but don't want coke bottle glasses, you have to go with the polycarbonate lenses which adds to the price. If you want "transitions" lenses it's more again. 
So the original price is great to get you in the door, but be prepared to shell.out way more money.

As for the staff, they are very friendly and knowledgeable, the store is clean and well organized. The eye doctor was explaining the tests she was doing as well. All in all a good place
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: So I work on the beach, my coworker and I work night shift so we don't have many options, when we saw McDonald's open we were stoked to not have to order dominoes again, since they deliver until 3am. Well I leave work and get to the McDonalds and arrive at 11:36pm on 2/7/18, and the doors are locked. It clearly states its open until 1am. Guess we'll just have to have dominoes....again. Thanks lady. Also, change your times on every internet website that says you're open until 1am. Yelp, TripAdvisor, etcetera.

text: Shout out to Plaza Liquors for coming through with the perfect recommendation. My wife tells me that she doesn't want a sweet wine, but also doesn't like really dry wines either. My wine knowledge only consisting of those two types, I went to Plaza Liquors looking for some guidance. The gentleman recommended this Adesso Cagnina Di Romagna and I don't think I've ever seen Belen so happy with a wine. Then, he told me the alcohol content to look for if I can find this particular bottle. Just great serviceall around!

The coaches offer practical advice and guidance on how to start, and grow into, a personal fitness plan that meets you where you are - no matter where you are - in the journey. text: The worst Mexican food on the planet.  Go to Taco Bell! Seriously I could not eat the food and I was starving when we got there.  It started off well with chips.  Then we ordered our drinks, I asked for a Coke when the drinks arrived I tasted it... Pepsi.  I dislike Pepsi, so I asked for water.  Then ordered the food,  2 beef tacos and a chili reano. The tacos meat was nasty and the taco shells were stale.  After I took my first bite I wasn't sure if I could swallow it.  Refried beans and rice were completely tasteless and blah.   The service was not great and we will never return.

I use to come here frequently. But this will likely be my last.

Their follow-through is horrible.

I had to ask to have the car re-wiped down, they got armorall on the glass and they scratched my paint!

I've had the car for less than a month and this scratch is deep and 6" long.

They couldn't even be bothered to put my floor mats back in properly, they are just strewn on the floor.

If I believed I would get correction I would speak with Management.

I'm appalled at the product they sold for $26.00

Don't use this location for any service.

4 stars as long as you understand it's a Springhill.  It's a remarkably average property in the grand scheme of things but that's exactly what a modern Springhill is supposed to be. 

Clean, quiet, comfortable-enough rooms. Property seems fairly new or at least renovated in line with the recent RI/Courtyard updates. Only missing furnishing is a Netflix-capable TV.

Solid wifi, small but adequate gym for cardio and very basic free weights with DB up to 50 lbs.  Decent location with a 5-10 min drive to grocery, restaurants, or Washington University.  There's one BBQ place sharing the parking lot that actually looks good.

text: I wish I could give this raggedy a$$ hotel negative stars. We ended up at this dump after hotels.com messed up our hotel for Essence Fest. The customer service is terrible and the employees are rude. I have requested a refund, but nothing has been done. I will be calling corporate when I arrive home.

text: My girlfriend and I have been going to Amani's once every few months for the past couple years now and it never ever disappoints. It's become our "go-to" date night restaurant when we don't feel like trying something new and want to be sure we'll have a great dinner. Seasonal menus, nightly specials, complimentary limoncello with dessert, and the owners and wait staff are always friendly. We've probably tried everything on the menu at least once and have enjoyed all of it. I can't say enough about this place.

Let me start off by saying the food was good...
But the second we walked in, it was very clear that one of the employees getting ready to serve us, was VERY unhappy that we walked in at 8:50. When yelp and online says they close at 10. The same employee huffed and puffed and even said to another employee "Do you see these people walk in at 8:50." She frustratingly asked us how many orders we had and when we said 3 she rolled her eyes. We were made to feel very unwelcome. Disappointing because we do like the food. 
Will not be going back there.

Been going there for years, and it was mostly ok, convenient location to my office, etc. Went in today and asked to order new snow tires to replace my old ones. I have an extra set of rims that I have snow tires on for winter - a common practice. Manager tried talking me into all season (which I already have on my other rims). I tried explaining and he said they don't usually do snow tires. A surreal experience - a Tire shop that won't sell snow tires. I walked out. Sadly this may have ended my 12 year relationship with the shop.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
We went to Coyote Ugly to end my friend's bachelorette party with a bang. We saw the movie when we were young so we knew that we had to stop by when we visited Nashville. 

It was actually super dead! There were like 10 people in the entire bar excluding our eight person bachelorette party. 

We still had tons of fun... The ladies made our bachelorette party feel really special. 

Overall, I'm glad I went and we can say that we danced there. Erase the idea that it will be just like the movie from your head though.

Great new upgrade from the old Italian Bistro. Stopped in here after work to check it out and decided to stay for dinner. 
the menu is very diverse, but is a complicated read. I hope the owners read this and simplify the menu.
The service was sub par. My waitress was not very "on the ball" order was taken quick, but that is about it. 
The food was excellent and a welcome change from the old, tired restaurant that was here before. 

I suggest that you try Via Napoli, just be ready to be confused with the menu and just ehh... Service. If it were not for these things it would be a 4-1/2 to 5 star restaurant

When my kids were small we went to a kiddie specialty place. They got "traumatic" haircuts. The stylist was rough, they were cut by the clipper and the cuts were sub par. 
Fast forward...I've been bringing my twin boys here for 6 years now. They love Miss Kathy and beg to get their hair cut when it touches their ears. She greets them like family, cuts their hair exactly as I ask, takes extra time to make sure they are comfortable to blow off the "itchy" hair. 
Check in online and get in fast, even on busy Sundays!

I got the pick two lunch which was a half salad and sandwich. I ate the delicious roast beef first. .making it hurt to only give 3 stars. My "Greek" salad looked like the kind of salad a sandwich place makes--- miscellaneous types of leftover lettuce, mismatched peppers - you get me? Sorry. Greek salad doesn't come with balsamic vinegar as a dressing. Such a disappointment. 

3 stars because the sandwich was delicious but any salad lover will be disappointed. Oh and don't gorge to pick up your own silverware and napkins- because they won't tell you and otherwise you're food will arrive and you will look silly staring at it.

Disappointed to say the least. Ordered online. When I got there a customer was telling a worker his pizza was wrong, no one would fix it, employee complaining about customers, and my pizza was terrible. It looked liked they literally just dumped the toppings on in the middle. The bbq sauce was runny like they added water to it. Crust was missing on half the pizza. Employees seemed like they were miserable. Manager yelling at someone about toppings sitting out too long. I love papa Murphy's but I'll never go back to this location.

The service was fantastic! Greeted when I walked in the door and they got to me quickly, even with three people ahead of me. I told my stylist the cut I wanted and she was completely honest in telling me what I picked would be a bad cut for my hair. I thanked her for that. She asked me a slew of questions to get a further understanding of what I wanted in a cut and started trimming away. She did a fantastic job! At the end she gave me a card with three coupons for haircuts, and let me use one the day I was there. Haircut at half the price! Definitely go here, the service and workers were wonderful.

WORST ASIAN FOOD EVER. When the food arrived, you thought, wow, big portions. But, that just meant bigger portions of horrible food.  The Yakisoba, NO TASTE, NONE and the chicken was just as bland.  The Teriyaki, didn't taste like teriyaki, but more like barbeque that had been left out for a couple days.  The meat was tough and fatty and it tasted horrible.  The SUSHI, the Boston Roll was NASTY. I am used to salmon that isn't firm, but it isn't supposed to be so squishy you can't tell it is salmon. It was almost like a paste. To top it all off...25 minutes later, my wife vomited up her meal.  AVOID!!!

Been there a few times for lunch. The food is good, and pretty authentic. Not particularly my favorite Mexican in Philly, but pretty close. They give large portions, and every time I've had a doggy-bag to go.

The service was excellent, and staff friendly. The food comes relatively quick, which makes it nice for a limited work lunch break. The location is perfect for those like myself that work in the city. Parking not the greatest, which is typical for any downtown restaurant. The ambiance was cool, with nice decor.

***update since my last review---they no longer give the discount card. 


I have been going here now for about 5 months and am so happy I found this gem! Lee is very kind and so are the two other women. I am very particular about my manicure. I tell Lee what I want and he does it correctly. They even have a card they stamp for each visit, so you can get a free service after 10 visits. Very clever! No other nail place does this. Prices are competitive and they do not charge if your nail breaks. Try it out, you wont be disappointed!

I can honestly only say the saving grace here is the woman I go to for my pedicures is so sweet and kind. She does a great job every time. 

The downside to this place is that they overbook and the clients who do make appointments end up waiting at least a half hour for their nails because they take walk ins. What is the point of making a freaking appointment?! There have been many instances where I have seen people walk out due to frustration. 

So, just beware of when you come in, especially on a weekend. Try a weeknight. Ask for Kimmie for a pedicure.

Ive only ever got pedicures here and they have been pretty good. I get the regular polish because I find the gel polish to be expensive, that is why I gave them 3 stars. They dont spend a ton of time getting the dead skin off around your feet, so another reason I gave them 3 stars. Ive always had a good experience with the polish looking nice and staying on. 
They do use a hand held massager around your shins and calves but I opt out of that and prefer a regular massage with their hands.  
They are clean with using sanitized tools and they use a plastic wrap in the tub that they change after each person. They only accept cash tips!

LEMON CHIFFON and BLUEBERRY BASIL was the perfect flavor combination to fit the mood my taste buds were in- they wanted something a little sweet and lite and that's what they got!

I loved the service here, Michael, patiently, let me sample just about everything and he kept a smile on his face the whole time. He shared warm family stories about ice cream making memories and we even talked rare jewels- an interest of his. Such a nice visit. Ice cream parlors should make you smile! If the food is sweet so should be the service.  

Geesh, I just love good customer service. It'll take you from 4 stars to 5!

My girlfriends and I stayed at the Hyatt this past weekend for a little getaway. The staff was super friendly the whole time - the lobby offered live music, free infused waters, snack bar and am extensive free morning breakfast. I gave the Hyatt 3 stars because during our stay, one of the elevators broke which caused a lot of angst getting to and from our room. Although they opened up the freight elevator to the guests, two elevators is hardly enough for a hotel that size. I spent more time waiting for the elevator than enjoying what the Hyatt had to offer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I did an online order because it's quick and when you walk in you just pick up your order and you don't have to wait in line. Normally I don't have issues with my order being messed up, but today I was disappointed. I got the chipotle chicken melt guacamole salad. Problem number one: no guacamole. Problem number two: no cheese. Missing 2 items in the name of the salad. Normally this salad is awesome but today the lettuce was also wilted. It just appeared very unappetizing. I love subway but ill probably go to a different location from now on.

I was pleasantly surprised by how amazing the food and service was. I ordered the general chicken and beef and peppers for a large takeout order. I was planning to eat the chicken but I didn't get to it fast enough (the staff bashed the chicken)  the beef was my only option. I hate beef served at Chinese restaurants because it usually taste like mystery meat. I tried it anyway and there was not a mystery to this meat. It was the real thing. The fried rice was delicious and the vegetable egg rolls were the best!!

We try..

maguro, tuna-Good
sake, salmon-Taste Good
squid/ika-my girl ate both i assume its very good then.
scallop/hotate x 2-Recommanded
they didn't have the sweep shrimp. T_T

mountain roll-I recommand this one
ring roll-this one is meh.i didn't like the basil cream sauce that much.not a fan of basil.
Spicy crab roll-this one also if you like it spicy!

Total came to around $55 

Not bad.
For 3 People.

Since if it was only 2 people we probably would have gotten the all you can eat. Too bad it has a time limit of 1 hour kinda sucks.

Went for brunch on a Saturday.

Service was good but for awhile we were the only table in the place so that might not be how service always is.

Food is very good. I know some are not a fan of the chickpea fries, but if you know what you are getting yourself into (it's the consistency of hummus inside), they are actually very good chickpea fries.

The one downside? You cannot sit on the 2nd floor for brunch. I had to remove a star for that because half the reason I wanted to go was to sit under the skylights. If you are going to close a floor since you have staffed less servers, close the bottom floor. It's nothing special.

They say "HUGE PORTIONS". OK - Chicken Parm dinner $21.95. Two PAPER THIN small pieces of chicken and a pound of spaghetti. Seriously ! This place gives you a huge portion of pasta that's .59 a pound and not much else. They do two-fers now and Groupon and others because they have NO BUSINESS both there and FAMMINA their other place. The meat is beaten thin to nothing, heavily breaded then huge plate full of pasta. Try it now and you will see I am exactly precisely correct. They are in financial TROUBLE ! Wonder why ?

this credit union operates more like a (rip-off) bank. they will fee the hell out of you, on things that aren't properly explained when you open an account. they are very poor about working with you on issues. account manager "Brittany" did not explain things properly when we opened the account. and "anna" was not helpful whatsoever in resolving our issue. we will be closing our account, and switching to a different credit union with better reviews. we have never been treated so lousy by a credit union! if you look at reviews for vantage west in general, it is apparent that this credit union used to be well liked. but it is no longer.

For me, a dining experience is about the quality of food and the service.  The sushi here was some of the best sushi I've ever had in Philadelphia! However, holy lord the service was awful. Our waiter didn't check on us once and took forever to even ask us if we wanted a drink after being seated. I sat with an empty glass of wine and still no sign of waiter for waaaay to long. We would've stayed to order another drink & roll had service been even remotely decent but left instead.  Do take out if they do it!!!

This location is our favorite and all the people who work there. We've gotten to know many of them well over the past two years. We treat everyone with respect and kindness which they don't always receive. I've heard and seen outrageous behavior by others, and it's embarrassing. 
When you treat people nicely, they will go out of their way to help such as bake a loaf of bread for you because you have a soy allergy and sourdough is the only bread you can consume. 
The meat and produce departments are amazing as well. And we adore many of the checkout people and sackers. 
We wouldn't go anywhere else.

296468 1JG8RV
 
RENTER
HOUSTON, JAY

I rented a car for one day from this location and returned it with full gas in perfect condition at the airport location 15 minutes away. How complicated could that be? 2 weeks later I get a bill from this location saying I rented a car for 6 days and they stole $300 from me. I called them and they said they would take care of it. They have not. DO NOT use this location. I REPEAT. DO NOT USE THIS LOCATION OR ANY ENTERPRISE if you don't want money stolen from you.

I stayed here a few nights ago. The guy at the front desk was very nice and the hotel was impeccably clean. The walk to my room was about half a mile so I was nice and tired by the time I got there. Then I went out to dinner so I had to make the long trek back to my car. Once I returned I parked in the back of the hotel so that my walk wouldn't be so long to my room. The towels felt like sandpaper, no kidding. It literally hurt to use them. Other than that it was a nice stay. It is also close to many things.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: While this is a nice hotel the prices and everything you have to pay for is not nice. Was here on business for a couple of days and realized that parking was outrageously expensive. Do yourself a favor and park a block away for $12 less. Over $40 for got valet is nothing short of robbery. Even WiFi is crazy expensive. If you're looking to spend less money on everything stay at the Embassy Suites around the corner (free parking, free wifi, And free breakfast. I will say that the staff was super nice and the rooms are roomy. I appreciate that it came with a small fridge and a free bottle of water.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I give this place two stars but they really only deserve one. The only saving grace was the service at the bar and the decent wings. The floors (carpet) is dirty and the atrium like lobby makes it seem louder than it really is. The room was smelly and dirty. The staff doesn't care about the fact that they are in the service industry. The front desk person was just sitting in the lobby at night while she was supposed to be working. Other members of the staff were sitting with her cursing and being unprofessional. I would NEVER stay at this hotel again and I would suggest that others stay away as well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have to say... I really like this place because the menu is simple. I went on a busy weekend day. The place looked way under staff. One waitress with what seemed like the owner. The service was very slow and rude. I would suggest hiring more employees. A Restaurant team should be able to handle a rush. We got made to feel like we were inconveniencing them because we wanted to order food to go. The wait was 45 mins for takeout. Sounds like you have one person working in the back having to carry the line all by their self :(

This is a very nice hotel. I was skeptical when I booked; I usually go for Hilton then Marriott brand hotels, mainly for the rewards, but all were fully booked in this area. My room was spacious, way more that enough room for lil ole me. The bed was very confortable but the AC/heating unit was loud. Luckily I had some ear plugs. The best part of the suite was the jacuzzi in the bathroom...verrryyyy nice and relaxing after a hrad day's work. Breakfast was average but there was a pretty decent selection of items.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Yummy! This place is great. The sushi was fresh and delicious, I had the rainbow roll and I really enjoyed it. I also had the miso soup and egg rolls. They were decent. I ordered the hibachi filet for lunch and it was a decent portion for 12 bucks. The filet was very juicy and tender but lacking in the flavor dept. I doused mine in the ginger sauce. I went back the same weekend and had the hibachi scallops and filet. Prices go up for dinner of course but the portion size in comparison to the lunch for the price was underwhelming. $75 for two hibachi dinners and a rainbow roll. A bit on the pricey side , I mean it was good but I have had better.

I've lived in this area for 40+ years and became a lover of sushi about 10 years ago.   I cannot believe this place was right under my nose the whole time and I didnt even know it.    This place is simply awesome.   The fish is fresh fresh fresh.... everytime we go (about once a week now).  The presentation is phenominal.   The selection is endless.  The prices are unbelieveable (compared to the prices of Margaret Kuo, Hikaru, etc)   The service is friendly and quick.  The atmosphere is authentic.   
If you like sushi and live within 15-20 minutes what is taking you so long?

You have got to be kidding me, I only wish I could give zero stars. The women working their with their crappy attitudes, huge eyelashes that look like there gonna fall off and their lack of knowledge on how to properly make a sandwich ( if you dimwits are reading this there's 10 slices each salami and pepperoni on the footling spicy Italian) they tried to give me 5 of each and then argue with me. They never wash their hands, their excuse is the gloves their wearing. It doesn't work if you touch everything else and food. Stay away and get something else, Rouses market across the street has a huge selection and great attitudes.

I think some of the reviews are skewed! On that note each time I have ordered from this establishment they have been nice and I have never had any attitudes from any of the staff. 

I will give their pizza a solid 8, the cheese is gooey and stretchy (the way it should be) great sauce, and a good variety of pizza toppings. I would most definitely recommend this pizza place to those from Northeast while it's not like a "true NY pizza" it's definitely a tough one to boot and is well worth buying to get your pizza fix. Happy eating folks'.

I'm a fan of Mcdonalds and know what to expect when I find them on my travels. This place had a very slow drive thru time of about 10 minutes during my time of driving the field.
Around 10am and 8pm is when I would stop by about 4 times total and everytime it was the same slow times. Worked at Mcdonalds and was a crew trainer before and know how it works and the average times all watched by corporate. No giant orders in front of me, just lack of urgency when it came tot he process.
Food was good and the standard like all other places.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Steve saved us! We were visiting Reno the weekend (my kid had Freshman orientation at UNR) and the inverter in the back of our Sprinter van stopped turning on. It's Saturday and we are going to go back to Vegas Sunday we were searching for a repair shop but none of the audio or video shops knew anything about inverters. We tried Audio Express and Encore AudioVisual Design. But nada. Then I called the flying Scotsman! He arrived to where I was in 5 minutes and 20 minutes later we had power again! Thank you Steve!

Absolute rip off..this was possibly one of the worst optometrist I have been too. They charged me excessive amounts of money for trial pair of contacts and contact fitting and a video that I watched all which took 10 minutes.   I ended up paying $179 and this is with insurance. They then contacted me and asked me for an additional $79 because I never brought my disposable contacts that I had on for trial back.   Apparently this was in the paperwork but they never mentioned that I had to return my two week disposable contacts. I feel outraged and completely taken advantage of and would not recommend this Eye clinic or optometrist to anybody.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: What a wonderful date night my husband and I had on Friday!! It was the best food we have had in a long time, and our server Santos was so pleasant and acted more like family than a waiter. The only thing I was a little disappointed in was how long it took to get our first glass of wine. The restaurant was extremely busy, but it should never take 25 minutes for a drink and bread. Also, we did get charged for an extra glass of wine and beer.. But these things happen when restaurants are under staffed and I think that's just what happened :) BUT.. Great experience! We will be back very soon!

We had a mixed bag with out stay.  The waterpark is great for kids.  The hotel has signs of wear but clean.  I can imagine with the amount of children that go through here that's about as good as it gets. 
The customer service varied from awesome, to terrible.  The front desk person who checked us in was distracted and doing five other things, when we came in.  The person who checked us out was amazing. 

We had a room with a fold out couch and a king.  The fold out clearly needed a new matress.  We ended up leaving early because one of my children got sick.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I am hoping we had an off night as I would've loved to give this place 4 stars. The staff and ambiance was a solid 4.5 stars - just an amazing energy and vibe thanks to it being snuggled in the beauty of the Ritz. 
We ordered the bisque and all had different seafood dishes that were presented well and overall tasty. The only issue was all the dishes were a bit too salty. Seafood shouldn't require much additional salt so not sure what happened. 
I will for sure give this place another try just in case it was a one off oops!

I walked into Ralphs to buy a few products and saw someone I knew who worked there.  I walked up to her and started talking to her and some guy with shirt half tucked in and scraggly looking hair saw that I was talking to the employee and he gave me a dirty look.  I asked my friend who is that?  She responded, that's the store director, I told her that if that's the looks he is giving customers no wonder the stores going downhill.  Other than that, all of the employees I have met there are extremely friendly and courteous.

I really want to enjoy shopping at a liquor store. I mean, it has all of my favorite things in one place! I've worked in a liquor store, so I know that it goes a long way for someone to say hello when I walk in and for someone to check in on me at some point while I'm shopping to make sure I'm finding what I'm looking for. Unfortunately for Maryland Farms Wine and Spirits, they have employed people that lack in all things customer service. Their beer selection is very thorough, but their wine selection leaves something to be desired. If it wasn't so convenient for me, I would have picked someplace else a while ago.

2.5 

For $108 including taxes, I've definitely had better experiences elsewhere. 

Pros: 
- free breakfast
- free wifi
- free parking
- room has microwave and fridge 
- bed and bathroom are clean enough
- 15-20 minutes away from Philly
- very close to Walmart and about 4 mins from Cherry Hill mall

Cons:
- AWFUL smell (but then your nose gets used to it)
- It just felt like a shady place and a really cheap motel. I didn't feel safe but that's just me. 

There are a lot of pros but overall I wasn't very pleased with my experience. I wouldn't recommend this hotel especially if you're a girl and staying by yourself.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Stayed here for 2 nights this week. Very friendly and helpful staff. Lots of places to eat within walking distance. Clean rooms, comfy beds, great shower. It is very dated in appearance but also clean and comfortable. The free continental breakfast was nothing special. Dried out biscuits, runny gravy, boiled eggs, over cooked sausage patties and dry cereal. Would have loved some fresh fruit, yogurt and waffles, but we made due. I didn't stay because of the food, so no big deal. I would definitely stay again in ther future if needed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
de la vina roll:  crunchy yet soft.  good as an appetizer for two maybe even for one person since there's only 5 rolls.  it's topped with caviar :D

japanese mackerel: good but can't compare to my mom's non japanese mackerel xD

spanish style mackerel (raw): it was kind of bland

sashimi:different raw fishes like salmon and tuna.  delicious but squid was way too chewy.

green tea mochi: loved it!

=$120ish; kind of pricey but it's the best sushi place I've been to in SB  

4 stars because I was craving seafood, there's free parking, mochi came with the sashimi, and because it was my friend's treat :D

I finally found a great Mexican place in town. You can custom make your burrito, taco, nacho etc with a nice variety of meats and sauces. I had tacos al pastor with corn tortillas and and a pork tamales. The tacos were very flavorful and loaded. It stands up to well to tacos I've had in the southwest. The tamale I had was very fresh. Often places make them dry or compact but this was made almost perfectly. It could have used just a little more meat but it was seasoned just right.  I can't wait to come back. Bon apetit!

The food was excellent overall. However, (i) I ordered a side of macaroni and cheese and it never arrived; and (ii) I ordered an entree of fish -- the most expensive option on the menu -- and the portion size was ridiculously small. That's fine, but the server should have at least warned me about it. It was also supposed to be served with lump crab cake, and I think it was, but I could barely find it in the dish. Seriously, the amount of crab cake was similar to the amount of caviar one would expect to see on a similar entree. Finally, it took 15 minutes for the check to arrive after I finished my meal.

Really good food hiding in a strip mall just off the main road. I came because of the vegetarian option: papas con (vegetarian) chorizo. I had a burrito with this. I tasted the potatoes more than the chorizo, but with the salsa and guac, it's forgivable. They've got a variety of traditional aguas frescas, I had a 20oz cup of horchata. This brought my total to $9.99 before taxes.

No real complaints. It's an independent approach to fast casual burritos & tacos á la chipotle. The interior is warm and colorful and does the traditional meets modern thing pretty well. I'll probably check it out again.

Dr. Karnes and his staff have taken wonderful care of Jackson. He was pretty sick with liver & gallbladder issues and he took plenty of time with me and my dog to thoroughly check and evaluate him on all levels. He even did a diagnostic X-ray free of charge. Him and his staff are always upfront about costs and provide estimates before administering treatment. He really goes above and beyond and truly cares about his patients. 
I'm always able to get an appointment and Dr. Karnes calls me personally with lab results or to answer any questions I have about the care of my dog. I would definitely recommend Buena pet clinic and Dr. Karnes!

Went in for three specialty cones that you can only get here...
But "sorry we don't have that...sorry there's none of that....sorry we are out of that....sorry there's none of that left either..."   etc etc.


We ended up leaving with three plain chocolate and one vanilla cone in 1980's style cheapo cones...$20 lighter than when we went in.


Better quality for the price just picking up the supplies you want at Save-On across the parking-lot.and making it at home.

Overpriced fad that we will not be supporting any more.

I'm leaving two stars because 1.) it was a Saturday night and 2.) the band was lively. The server was clearly overwhelmed, the food took about an hour, the server placed plates on top of items that made the plates teater, didn't bother to make sure they were placed flat (with red sauce being served, this scared me). The chicken on my Greek Salad was cold, not sure if it was supposed to be? My boyfriends chicken parm was good except drenched in an obscene amount of sauce, and the rolls were luke warm and tasted like freezer burn. I don't usually leave such a long review but I was pretty disappointed with the food.

This place was decent. I had a tough time finding anything that really would WOW me. The shrimp tempura roll, a classic, did end up impressing me with just the sheer size of the roll. You get what you pay for with that one. Now, the scallop roll I got was supposed to have tempura INSIDE but it seemed they forgot that part, so it all ended up mushy. I was NOT a fan of the texture of that roll. 
The service was attentive and quick. It's not a place I would go out of my way to visit, but it was a good, quick sushi lunch.

This is a very small gym. They don't have many of the most common machines. I didn't even see a stairmaster in this facility, which was a disappointment. It did seem high-tech and pretty clean. The bathrooms are impressive, and large!
 Of course, location is what sells this one. It's in a great little plaza with a Starbucks and a yoga place, great spot for a gym. One member of a couple could do yoga while the other gets a workout on in this gym. I don't recommend for those that like intense workouts, you might not find a necessary machine.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I'm in 20-30 supermarkets a week for my job. These range from Giant, Acme, Wegmans, as well as produce stands and small shops. The stores are located in SE PA, DE and NJ. This is the worst one I've been in. Parts of the store are serviceable for a quick food run or a cup of coffee, but most of this supermarket is just awful. The produce, the area in which my job services at other stores, is embarrassing. The shelves are rarely stocked and if they are, the product is less than satisfactory. It also is the first produce section that I've been in that regularly is out of plastic bags for loose items. I've seen better product in delis.

Went there for Sunday brunch with some friends.  Voted "Best Brunch in St. Charles" - eh....don't know about that.  The buffet was filled with ok food - nothing better than you would get at a run-of-the-mill banquet facility. However, for $16 you do get bottomless mimosas, champagne, and bloody mary's.  The champagne was cheap and sweet, but it did the job.  The restaurant itself is dated and could really use and overhaul, in my opinion.  I think my friends and I were one of four tables that morning.....I think we will be back, but it isn't something I would drive out of my way for.

The beauty of Pizza Hub is that it's not trying to compete with Beddia or Pizza Brain. It's not attempting to have the best pizza in town, it's attempting to be the nicest pizza shop in town. They're open early, they close late, and most importantly they're always kind to you. The staff continue to say hello to me when I walk by or even when they see me somewhere else in the city. 

I really enjoyed the pizza, especially the slice of sausage that I got. Much better than places like Central Pizza, Tommie's or Fishtown Pizza. 

They're not always the fastest or the cheapest but they're definitely a comforting place to hang and grab a slice.

I find it incredible that when asked for the managers supervisors phone number, they just hang up on you.. Since when does someone need a appointment to speak with someone at the bank about a problem?? Then after speaking with the " Manager" gives me his card and says, " that's my direct line" only to find that's its the branch trunk line..And it`s not just this branch, the Sparks branch is just as bad.. When I had words with a associate, She had her Boyfriend go on my Business`s Facebook page and start adding shitty reviews , when he hadn`t any idea of what I do !! Bank with ANYONE else... These guys customer service is horrible...

Once again an experience that can not be beat!  We reserved outdoor seating and were given the perfect table to celebrate our wedding anniversary.  This is our second time enjoying the outstanding wait staff and the amazing food.  Since we wanted to order everything on the menu we chose the Fall tasting menu.  The second best choice we made, the first being choosing to come to Dettera.  As the food starting rolling in course after course, we enjoyed our cocktails that were amazing.  Thanks Dettera for everthing, we had a great night.

It's been almost four years since I wrote a review after my first visit to this gem of a dive. If you're Mexican or a foodie that loves authentic comida mexicana, you have to try El Pique because they never disappoint. You can't find better tacos or burritos in the area and the Lamb Consomme is without equal!  The tacos are stuffed with loads of carne so you won't leave hungry, or broke! I only wish I could move this place to Colombia when I move there next year. Seriously though, I'm going to miss this food.

Hands down the best tacos around, economical and like a king you can have it your way. Choose from like 12 meats, (if you like spicy go for the spicy pork, otherwise I recommend al pastor or carne asado) and 4 toppings selections; I go for the original which is authentic Mexicana, cilantro and onion. Then there's the standard salsas green and red. TIP: If you go for spicy, like them or not the radishes are cool and refreshing to a mouth that's on fire. I love this place; so if you drive on by because it looks like a dive it's no skin off of my nose. (Seating is limited and I can't wait until I get home to eat.)

Worst service with sarcasm. I tried to explain I wanted cold brew with some honey and that the honey would have to be diluted in hot water or coffee before adding to cold brew. with sarcasm she said "don't worry (wtf look). When I received my cold brew there was solid honey. I brought it to her attention she apologized sarcastically and did it herself and asked me to wait somewhere. I said "that's why if add honey to a cold beverage it solidifies and the reason I asked for it in that manner." She replied sarcastically again "that is right that's how honey works."

I went to pickup dinner around 9pm. They asked if I wouldn't mind waiting 4.5 minutes, which I was alright with, and they asked me to pull forward, so I did. 15-20 minutes later, I still hadn't received my food. I finally got fed up and went inside. They had no idea I had even placed an order. When I did get my food, my chicken was tough and dried out, my fries were soft and soggy, and my Frosty was frothy and half melted. I told the manager, and she seemed to be apathetic about the whole situation. Worst response I've ever seen.

Staying in the Holiday Inn attached to this bar and restaurant. I had the ribeye with green beans, rice pilaf, and house salad. The steak wasn't too bad considering the price, but I likely would order it again. The green beans were from a can, but were ok quality and had been seasoned with bacon and black pepper so I liked them. The rice pilaf was good also. The house salad was simple but all the ingredients were fresh and crisp! Ate at the bar. The service from the lady working behind the was friendly and fast! If steak had been a little better, the might have earned another star.

Tonight was the probably the last time we will eat here. We have been loyal to this restaurant for 2 years now but the quality is slipping bad and the kindness of service has been missing for a while. 

Tonight the sweet and sour shrimp was absolutely nasty and I do not use that term of food often but it was over breaded and dried out (almost retried shrimp) disgusting! The fried rice was not fried and had no egg, no vegetables, only oil! Awful!! 

I wish this was not the case but you should avoid this Chinese and drive a bit further for better quality.

Hummmm. I found a good deal but the staffs were... I usually give 1 or 2 stars for this customer service but they have many good local beer and wine.

Variety: Good. They have many local beer and wine.

Price: Some are pretty good.

Customer service: They didn't know the price of my 6 packs. I told them it is $7.99 but the cashier didn't believe it and sent a staff to check it. He came back and told it is $10.99. No! I took him to the spot and he picked up the price tag and showed $7.99 tag to the cashier. So this is no good.

Parking: Free.

Amazing out of the way TASTY PLACE!
Remarkable flavors. Great choices and AFFORDABLE!
They will make anything you request including any meat or fish and produce you purchase in the super market which is in front of this restaurant I The basement of the building.
I always have the Fish and Chinese greens with black mushroom added along with some peppers and Chinese greens. All this over rice with tea for $7.50.
Must have the salt and pepper Chicken wings. Outstanding. Just ask the waiter for recommendations, they will guide you to a heavenly meal. Enjoy

Very nice cafe. It was a hot summer day, one of those that it was 100 degrees but it felt like 110 degrees; so this Cafe saved me... since it has AC; and I cannot be more grateful. Since I was already there, I tried Beignets. Not going to compare beignets to donuts; just know that if you are in New Orleans don't say they are the same. And btw they are not. They were good. Beignets do not cost much, and this cafe's beignets orders are generous. I could not eat them all. And here is the thing; beignets is the type of food that if you have good company, you can eat a bunch of them and not notice; mmm much like donuts... go figure :).

I've used this Dobbs several times for both my vehicles and have been very satisfied. Each visit has been fairly quick, despite the amount of customers, and reasonable pricing. Today I needed to have more work on my Jeep than they could accommodate and the sales clerk was happy he could point me in the direction of some great 4x4 garages. The waiting area is clean but if you don't want to sit around the shop there's a lot of restaurants and shops within walking distance to pass some time. I'll continue using Dobbs for light work such as oil and filter change, tire rotation, fluids checked, and brakes.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I received a high-quality hair cut at Great Clips. I previously went to the Irvine location, and now I have patronized the Santa Barbara location. Note, this location is $2 more than the other Great Clips place I went to.
My favorite thing about Great Clips is that they record in their database the specifications of the hair cut you want. So they printed out and gave me the same type of hair cut that I previously received. 
I checked in online before I drove over to Great Clips, and I didn't need to wait on a slow Sunday afternoon. I was in and out of Great Clips in 15 minutes with the hair cut I wanted. Much recommend.

The consensus was solid. Nothing to write home about. The cool thing was knowing the history and feeling like  you were in good company.
The wine list was nice. You had a range from very inexpensive wines to really nice wines. The bread they serve was tough and stale. Kind of disappointing. We ordered antipasto, which was okay but had very plain presentation, on  wilted lettuce in a white bowl.
My husband had the veal parm and thought it was good. I had the pasta with peas, prosciutto, cream sauce and shrimp. Both were good but not crave-worthy. We opted to get dessert elsewhere.

Excellent and very efficient. For only a few dollars more we were able to upgrade to a luxury vehicle, which was a little larger than our original reservation. The vehicle was brand new with just around 300 miles on it. We enjoyed driving it for the almost two weeks we were in Florida. This was a much better experience than we had at another rental company in Tampa a few years before. Thank you so much for the excellent service, which was also quick and efficient I also like that you can skip the kiosk, even though we didn't do that this time around because I made some changes within 24 hours of our trip. It is an option if you are in a hurry.

Always had enjoyed the Macaroni Grill in Willow Grove and Plymouth Meeting until they closed both so we came to this location.  Sadly disappointed.  Service was ok though I  had to ask 3 times for lemon and sweet and low for my ice tea and my son never got his appetizer. We always get the same thing Chicken Scallopini -very disappointed it had no flavor what-so-ever - it no longer is prepared in a creamy lemon butter sauce -  more like dripping in butter even though the menu says lemon butter sauce - the artichokes were absolutely tasteless - so that will be the last time we visit this location!!!!!!!!!!

This hotel was very modern and comfortable.  The service was EXCELLENT, the location was great: safe, easy to get to, nearby lots of eateries, shopping, and close to a major university campus.  The city is VERY pet-friendly and so is this hotel.  I intend on taking my furry friend with me the next time I vacation here.  I felt very safe here, even after dark.  The room price was a tad pricey, even with a Triple A discount, quoted at $172/night for the room we had booked.  Overall, it was great!  Room service was quick and easy, too.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We regularly order take and delivery from this place. I don't know what's going on, but lately it's gone downhill. They changed their fries and they literally always taste stale and old now, and yesterday I ordered a salad and the chicken was rotten! That's right, it smelled and tasted like rotten chicken. I had to throw it in the outside trash cause my cat kept trying to dig it out of the garbage. I called them to let them know, but no one seemed to care. The manager didn't even call back after I let the phone person k ow that takes the orders. Ew.

Decided to grab a slice of pizza after having a not so great meal at another restaurant in the casino, and I'm glad I did!

I got the meat lover's pizza. It took about 5 minutes to heat up - the crust had a nice crunch and bite to it, and the cheese had a good amount of pull! The meat on the slice really helped to make it filling. We got a slice for my baby niece too, and they added some extra cheese and olives on top. She seemed to love it!

I'd say it's a pretty decent size for $5! If you're hungry and looking for a quick bite that's satisfying, for sure head to Hidden Pizza.

Was a very nice, traditional Japanese restaurant. Sushi chef/ owner is friendly and from Osaka. He will make onigiri if you request it and the ramen is wonderful with a well-balanced broth. The location doesn't seem to match the quality of the food though and from the reviews I've read that is because of their move from Vendy. 

Pregnant currently so can't try the sushi but I am sure--from quality of everything else we ate--it would be spectacular. 

Hope they do well and it is definitely worth driving off the beaten path to get there!

Good spot. Very good Italian food. I love my italian food authentic and this did the trick without breaking the bank at all.

It's BYOB (even though it seems like there's a bar up front) so you can save by bringing wine. And happened to come here last minute for Valentines Day this year with my girlfriend because we didn't want to pay the ridiculous $75 (!!) per person at a different place. In the end my bill was in the $60's with an appetizers and two huge meals that we took home.

A very nice Italian BYOB in South Philly.

Shouldn't even give this place one star. While trying to enjoy a Fourth of July weekend, my friend got a cut on her foot and they apparently "don't have a first aid kit" even though Based on Federal OSHA Regulation Standard 1910.151.b states that adequate first aid kits must be readily available. It's cool though, because after she tried to leave they refused her and another friend access to leave their property. Once I informed them I had a Master's degree in Criminology and they could not keep her on the property, they eventually let her leave after much debate. Moral of this story: don't go to the Undertow.

I'm sorry to say that this place has changed. We moved to town almost exactly a year ago. It was my first meal when looking at houses. We used to eat here at least once a week, but now we have been disappointed the last few times. I think it's a new owner or new management, but their food is not as good.  The crust seems like it's been overworked bc its too chewy. The portion sizes vary widely from too big which is great unless you are the one on the too small side. The service is not nearly as friendly. Sucks that our go to place in town has become a place we try to avoid.

Not a "fancy" hotel, but definitely way nicer than I was expecting it to be!

The lobby is very nice and they have a restaurant/bar. All the furniture looks new and it's very clean.

I love the setup of the room. The bathroom is bigger than majority of the courtyards that I've been to. The lighting in the bathroom is good for doing makeup! Everything was nice and clean! I was surprised to find a balcony in the room with a nice little view to a courtyard and the pool.

There is a shuttle that runs to and from the airport, every 30 minutes. Service was great, no complaints on that!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It's the least expensive option I'm aware of in SB, the facilities are functional, and it has all the equipment you would expect from a corporate gym.  The chlorine scent from the pool tends to pervade much of the lower floor area though (where the weights are).  And I notice a lot more questionable activity going on in the locker rooms here than I did when I was at Spectrum.  There's a lot of lingering in the locker room, and out of the seven shower stalls, it seems like the person who enters after me picks the one stall directly across from mine that affords an unobstructed view of my showering about 90% of the time.  I'm just sayin'.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I don't know why it took me so long to get to this, but I absolutely love Salon Bass! Treated myself for my birthday to a fresh cut and bayalage treatment. I came equipped with my Pinterest board. Joe was incredible! He was so patient, looking at all the things I wanted and talking me through them- giving his opinion on what would and wouldn't work for my hair. I love when a hairstylist is honest and doesn't give you false hope for something that just won't work for you. I wound up with a stylish lob with bayalage treatment. Happy girl!

We went out searching for some authentic italian food and we weren't disappointed. This place  has a cozy but elegant decor.  The staff was really cordial, and extremely professional.  We started with cocktails at the bar, then moved into the dining room.  At each step we were mire and more impressed.  From their signature drinks to the hand made pastas, everything was superb.  Even the desserts are made in house.  I went with friends, but will return with my boyfriend.  Can't wait, in fact I think I'll make the reservation now.

I called & double checked that certain rolls were fully cooked because I'm 24 weeks pregnant. I also ordered a cucumber salad with ponzu sauce and went to pick it up.
