I got home and found roe (small orange fish eggs) in the salad which are too small to strain out. I was pretty upset since I really was craving cucumber salad. Be careful to communicate very clearly with them - I'm not sure how else I could have stressed no raw anything but at least check your food before you leave. *** UPDATE*** after calling to report this, the owner personally called back & offered us a $20 gift certificate. Very well handled. Great owners

Some age shows at this Embassy Suites.  They are in need of some updating and some clean-up.  The rooms were clean, but when we pulled up the front entry way was dirty with trash.  Likewise there was a pile of dirty laundry in the hall and it was still there in the morning when we left.  This is a smaller Embassy Suites and it doesn't seem to have the vibe that most of their hotels have.  The hotel is close to the airport in an area with not a lot to do and virtually no restaurants.  We were uncertain about the hotel restaurant and could never find it.  Access to the hotel is difficult too with the street not clearly marked.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Ive used Grace Cleaners 3-4 times now with excellent results. Im always greeted in a very friendly manner, their service is efficient and pricing fair. Tonight they went above & beyond. I brought in 10 shirts that needed to be pressed before we left town tomorrow evening for several weeks. Initially they would not have been ready in time but they made room in their load to get our shirts done before we left. The woman was so nice and understanding. I appreciate how accommodating they always are. I love that they are locally owned and not a chain.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Ordered the carne asada plate and it was good!  My only comment is the serving is smaller than Faustos/Robertos in LV for just about the same price.  I like being able to split my meals or share it but this time, there just wasnt enough to save for later.

Anyway, the place is big enough to accomodate about 40-50 people, maybe more. Looked small from the outside but once you're inside, it isnt.  Cashier was polite and servers were nice.  One came and checked up on us several times to see how we were doing with our food.

Definitely going back here to try some of their menu.

Serving up all local cuisine with a new menu every night. Maize is certainly as good as it gets. They manage expectations by letting you know up front that their dining experience takes about two hours, and every course is certainly worth the wait. The Maitre D is kind and courteous not to mention extremely knowledgeable and very attentive. Occupying an intimate nook in Perkasie, Maize could give any upscale city restaurant a run for their money. I am vegetarian and frequently find restaurants falling short of my expectations, but to describe my wild mushroom ravioli as delicious would be a gross understatement.

On a vacation to Tampa we took a trip to St Pete's beach and found ourselves at Undertow for some of the Rangers/Bolts hockey playoff game. 
Drinks are nicely priced around $3 and they have other posters etc promoting special beers and events. 
The crowd was take 'em or leave 'em and i enjoyed there was a Ranger crowd in the mix! 
Sat in the big chairs off the barside and were able to get out of the heat, catch the game, grab a beer all seamlessly 

When i find myself in St Pete's beach again, i'll be sure to swing by Undertow

Let me just start by saying, this place is very chic, modern and beautiful. The decor is very fitting for the vibe here. That alone is the only thing that made the trip for brunch worth it, especially since the DJ was great.

BUT the food is very very very mediocre. There is so many great brunch spots in Philadelphia and this place should not be known for its food. I had the shrimp and grits, and as you can see from the picture nothing was special about it. No flavor and the portion of grits were TINY for $20. 

My friends got chicken and waffles and they also we're happy.

I would say eat before you come and just drink and enjoy the party.

Could have been better. I will say it was clean,shower was ok and bed was good. The sliding door to the bathroom slammed shut and made a noise that shook the bed every time, the staff were nice enough but dressed poorly. The breakfast bowl of eggs fries and bacon was a microwave mess and inedible. Same with my wife's waffle bowl. 12 dollars to park your car.  Good thing I used Priceline, the reg price of 200+ dollars  would infuriate me. Euro styled room which I found uncomfortable and IKEA like, but my wife loved. USB ports and free wifi a plus.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Clean restaurant with friendly enough staff. Coming from California we were very impressed with the service and sushi presented here! Came on my birthday and got the Sakana roll, red dragon roll and rainbow roll. We get a rainbow roll wherever we go, and by far this was the very best one we have ever had. Calamari was our appetizer and was delicious. They are doing a wonderful job here and should be a success for years to come.  I work for a multimillion company in the food industry and believe they are going to be just fine! Great job and keep it up

I hadn't been to this restaurant in quite some time and it's definitely not a place I'd go back to. I felt bad for bringing 2 people with me. The crab cakes were just awful. They were fishy and it's hard to believe that their made fresh. They tasted like something you'd purchase in the freezer section at the grocery store. The fish tacos and rice were absolutely amazing! The entire dish deserves 5 stars! The key lime pie tasted like it had sat in a refrigerator uncovered for a week. I was very disappointed by our experience this time.

Still the most haphazard cheese section i have ever seen. They should just remove the section of items wrapped in house. A new shelf was put in (or just reorganized, but that part looks better) for some retail items, but it's still an avalanche of garbage under it.

I came in for one drink and grabbed one confection and a deli item. Both items i grabbed cost more at the register than the price tags nearby. 

This should be a store for grab and go ease, but after the third time here I'll just skip it.

I'd give this place one star, but their mix and match beer offering is pretty great.

Wasn't awful but also lacked flavor. We got the vegetable lo mein, which only appeared to have mushrooms and onions in it (and had huge noodles which I was not a fan of); chicken and broccoli, which was in a thick white sauce that had no flavor; and vegetable egg rolls, which were actually tasty. And I thought for portions we received it was very expensive at $25. The following morning my stomach was upset from the food. We won't be back and will drive to Chengs Beijing or just buy a PF Changs frozen meal next time we are craving Chinese (as the portion size would be the same and it has more flavor).

Easily and by far the slowest fast food restaurant I have ever been to. That is not an exaggeration of any kind. 
This particular day, the MANAGER was helping get food out of the window. Twenty minutes after I order and get there, I was handed the wrong drink and wrong meal. This is probably about 9/10 I've received an incorrect order. 
On one occasion I was cussed out by a manager after receiving an incorrect order. He didn't want to make the correct one because it was causing his drive through time to go up. Ok. Needless to say, today was the last day I'll be coming to this McDonald's.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The quality of the food wasn't amazing it was just so-so. You only had an hour to eat so the sushi chefs were taking their time, in my opinion. I told the guy our orders of 4 rolls but he forgot about us and went to the other side of the bar for the rest of our visit. Our waitress was so sweet though, she filled our waters and checked back on us every so often. It's also in the back of a Mexican restaurant for all-you-can-eat. Next time, we would search for a better quality and service in Midtown and not in the casinos.

I was really looking forward to trying this out.  Not a great first experience.  The place is nice.  Friendly staff. But our server seemed to be all over 1 table and forgot about us.  Our appetizer was a no show and other customers that came in after us were served before us.  She looked at us like "OMG I totally forgot about you " look and after 30 minutes our 2 rolls came out.  Yes thats all we ordered other than the appetizer we never received.  So to say I was not happy.  I will give it another try but first impressions are the ones that really count.  Let's see if they can up the Star count next time.

This was such a terrible experience. I have rented from enterprise 3 times in different states in just the past 2 months and expect better customer service.
the last time I rented, the agent said sometimes walk in prices can be better than doing a reservation.
When we arrived the manager was extremely rude saying we should do our homework to save money next time when we requested an economy car and there were none left.
The car we Received was not only more expensive then we planned but completely dirty (I will upload pictures shortly) 
U

My go-to sushi spot at least once a week! Kevin knows me by name and order and is always VERY hospitable and accommodating. Since I'm pregnant I'm confined to all of the cooked rolls, my fave being the Hawaii roll (basically a Mexican roll with pineapple and Sirracha, YUM). You can never be to sure about a sushi place, but this one is a GEM.

The restaurant is extremely small but VERY intimate, perfect for date night or a girls night. The only issue is the outside, there's some construction going on in the plaza so it can be easy to miss or at least think that it's closed.

The website is very misleading for this salon. They claim walk in service is available but you will find it is not so available much of the time. The salon is a group of contractors so there is a great variance in products available and skill levels. They do seem reasonably popular so the average quality seems to be regarded as good.  The look of the salon is fairly typical and leaves something to be desired for an atmosphere.  The staff are friendly and willing to accommodate your concerns well. I personally can think of better options in the boise area for hair care but if you get lucky and find the perfect stylist it might be for you.

Best pizza in Tampa!! If you've been to the Grimaldi's in Brooklyn and enjoyed it, you will be happy here. It's not identical, but it's darn sure close and much better than the rest of the coal fired attempts popping up around town.

One evening I got a few pies to go, and when we were eating them at home, my husband bit into an actual piece of coal! I called and spoke with the manager and he took care of us the next time we came in. 

We consistently receive good food and service,  so I definitely recommend.

Meh pretty much says it. This is the kind of restaurant that would be good in a small college town, but is not up to par in the Philly dining scene. They need a reinfusion of creativity. As other reviewers say, at this point, the food quality does not warrant the prices. None of the food was terrible; the only big problem was that I had to send back the first two glasses of wine I ordered, because both tasted like cough syrup. I was about to give up and order a beer but the bartender opened a new bottle of chianti which was fine. Who knows how long the others had been sitting around.

I usually don't leave bad reviews but today was definitely the last straw. This place is such a hit or miss. Sometimes it's good and sometimes it's like they make drinks with their eyes closed. How is it that I get a caramel frapp and I get no coffee in it. Maybe a dash of coffee was put in it? Starbucks is a coffee joint right? It tasted like nothing but creamer and water. Like seriously? How can you mess that up? I didn't even complicate the order like some ppl tend to do. I just ordered something right off the menu and you mess it up. Maybe I just need to find another Starbucks to go to.

Passed this restaurant for years and we finally meet my son and his family. First it's very loud in there. It's a small restaurant and it was packed. Chairs have to move to get to most of the tables. With that said I really had a great time there. People were very friendly. First they brought the bread. It was better than average. I had the Caesar salad and it was delicious!! My husband had the anti pasta. He said it was very authentic. I had the Salmon. It was bland and over cooked. Husband had veal parm. He said it was very good. We'll definitely go back.

I've been here a few times and I've always received good food of good quality. Their food is good for if you want to go out for a pizza or a cheesesteak.  The service could use a bit of improvement.  There is one guy who has a bit of a nasty attitude the last two times I've been there.  Both times I've talked to the manager about him and he's managed to correct the situation effectively.  The manager is great and he definitely knows how to run a pizza place despite one guy who's there.  Overall, I would recommend this place for anyone who wants a pizza or cheesesteak at a reasonable price.

My wife and I agree that this is currently the best AYCE sushi place in Boise.  One of the things we like most is that there is an excellent selection of appetizers that are available when you do AYCE.  The tempura, the miso, the octopus salad, and the jalapeno bombs are just outstanding.  I'll agree that there is a little lack in diversity in the roll selection compared to, say, Fujiyama.  But you're bound to find a few favorites and with all of the appetizers and nigiri sushi, you'll have no trouble getting full.

The wait staff here are outstanding and the sushi chefs are fast.  We never experienced a long wait for an order.

This was quite an awesome eating experience.  Came here on a cold Friday night and it was the perfect place to warm up with fine cuisine and your own personal bottle of wine (BYOB!).  The food was classy, filling, creative but best of all, unpretentious.  The crowd was pleasant and service was outstanding.  

My favorite items:  The borscht and scallops were my top choices.  The menu changes all the time so just ask the server for their top recs, ours took interest in helping us choose.  For dessert, the beignets are a MUST.  They are made fresh and are just delectable.

It was a pretty decent hole in the wall spot. It took about five minutes for the hostess to notice me waiting to place an order because she was on her iPhone browsing with another server.  I had ordered some late night sushi to go, and it was made pretty fast which is always great. Being a sushi chef myself, its always good to be prompt, yet detailed. Personally, i thought the rolls had a decent amount of fish but WAY too much rice! I guess it depends on the time of day. The chefs may have just been trying to push out rolls and compensate for lack of ingredients. But overall, it was an average first impression.

The staff here deserves good stars Becasue they put up with some shit. If you are looking for good care at cheap prices go here. YOU WILL PROBABLY HAVE TO WAIT 1-3 HOURS. Totally normal for a high volume walk in clinic. I reccomend parking in back, they will call when ready for you. Take your dog on a walk, sit in the grass and doodle on your phone during the nice day. Don't sit in the lobby if you can refrain from it as it is beyond stressful due to everyone in one location and other people's dogs being unruly.

I've been coming here for several years. Today I had the experience with one of the washers not extracting all the water from the clothes in the spin cycle. The clothes came out of the washer very, very wet, much more so than usual. I explained the situation to the attendant and asked for a free dry cycle given the circumstances (worth something like 35 cents). She flatly refused and insinuated rudely that I was trying to scam the laundromat and that no other customers complained about the washer. Really unforgivable customer service. Do not go here.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: If I could give this location a poop emoji I would. Sushi No Go is more like it! Great idea and location, horrible execution and organization. Believe the past reviews on poor fish quality and food poisoning!! Better off saving your money and buying a pound of tuna from the corner fish market and making your own at home. I'm a local and there is no loyalty to locals, all about the tourist dollars. Which I won't forget in December!! Spreading the word that this place is a culinary joke and makes sushi look and taste so bad!!

Enjoyed a nice brunch at this glass walled venue with a view of the Arch located on the 8th floor of the Four Seasons Hotel.  Food was good, but service was only fair; server may have been busy or having an off day.  Daughter dining with me asked for hot sauce and received two microscopic bottles of Tobasco which wasn't enough for her but we laughed and photographed them.  It's a beautiful restaurant & worth an adventure.  Be sure to walk outside onto patio to view the year round pool, jacuzzi hot tub, seasonal patio seating, and arch view.  We saw Mylar proposal balloons when we visited; we must have just missed the big moment!

Save yourself a few bucks and go to the next one. And just so you know, the employees at this location are the owners (probably because they're too greedy to pay anybody else) and will charge you for two six inch sandwiches if you are two people wishing to share a footlong so that they can get extra money. We were charged $15 for a footlong sandwich and when i tried to explain that it was bad customer service she (The Indian lady) just got louder and ruder talking over me. I choose not to support disrespectful and greedy owners / employees of any sort. Very ugly treatment toward their patrons. Save yourself a few bucks and go to the next one.

This is the second time we have gone here and both times we were seated and served very quickly. The first time the house was packed and they were able to accommodate our party size. Today it was a slow time and food started coming out as soon as we placed the ticket. It was like the sushi chefs were listening to us as we wrote our order down. Literally the fastest we have ever been served at a sushi restaurant. The only reason I didn't give a five star was both times they missed something on the ticket. No big deal at the time as we were very full.

I've been meaning to write a review about St. Francis for a while. I was referred to them by many people when I first got my puppy, but I was hesitant because I had heard about how pricey they are. I am SO glad I decided to take him there. They have been exceptional every time I've been in... going above and beyond to make him feel comfortable and to help me find the most affordable option. I even had to take him to the 24 hour clinic once, and when St. Francis found out, they checked up every day the following week. Great service, great people, fair prices. I completely trust Dr. Lawrence and the rest of the staff with my dogs life.

The Farmer's Daughter feels like a classic country inn albeit slightly too roomy and with a hint of new construction ambiance upon entry.  The food quality mirrors this disappointing experience.  

Charcuterie and cheese good but certainly not great.  Squash soup very disappointing.  Greek salad flatbread?  MEH.  

The elderly and middle management type clearly gobble this stuff up.  But if you're a food snoot keep driving and get into Philly for some real food at Osteria where the menu is surprisingly similar and worlds better in terms of value.  

Regretfully,

FS

Overpriced, unclean, and horrible service.

Giving 1 star for the scenery and the scenery only. We came around 6 PM on a Friday and were seated on the deck. I ordered the shrimp tacos. Food was average, and the service was beyond lacking. The only times our waitress came to our table were to take the order and give us our food. No one checked up on our table whatsoever. Absolutely terrible. We had to flag down another waitress to grab our paycheck because ours was never in sight. That waitress took 20 min to bring it back, and then another 10 min after that for our change. Also, be aware of the unclean deck. 

I would not recommend this place.

This is a good looking barbershop but when I get my haircut from somewhere that looks expensive I don't go in to get it cut by somebody that's in training or somebody that's not going to give me 100% of the barbershop. Especially when I pay $35 for a haircut and a beard trim and it looks like something that I can do myself. This place is clean friendly staff but every Barber their has to give a class A haircut. Not impressed.
I don't give 5 stars for a failed first attempt. You got to make sure you shave the neck.

Clean comfortable hotel. This hotel is not situated near restaurants or commerce which does not make it friendly. It's most definitely a business stop hotel vs a vacation stop. After our rented house near the French Qtr. lapsed...this hotel worked for our last night. It is convenient for accessing the airport on your departure day. Our hotel breakfast was limited in selections, clearly driving home its point of being a work stop hotel. Our room had a nice overlook of the lake. Staff was professional. Thanks for reading. Avram Hilton
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is not a great place for groups, couples, anyone who wants to hear each other at dinner and anyone who enjoys personal space. It seems to me like they converted someone's living room into a "functioning" restaurant. The place needs a serious makeover or remodel, the tables are extremely close together and there is no music because it's so insanely loud so what's the point. The service is also terrible so why the two stars? Honestly, this is only getting two stars because it's a BYOB and the food was actually pretty good. However, I would not go back again by choice and don't really recommend you do either.

I went here with my son for Valentines Day and they were super busy but the service was really great. We were seated immediately and the server was there to get our drinks almost instantly. Same with our apps, then our order. Food came out in about ten minutes which was surprising bc of the crowd. Servings were large for a sushi spot and food was very good. The spicy tuna was a little too spicy for my son but he's a lightweight! We will definitely be back!

Great service, good food, nice ambiance. Thanks for a lovely Valentines Day!

Service was sub par on all levels. 
Some menu items were very good others weren't impressive at all. 
We ordered the Brie special for an appetizer along with the calamari which were great starters. 
The cesar salad was the best part of the meal. 
Then the main entrees came after waiting for almost an hour (from the salad timing and almost an hour and a half from when we ordered). The rigatoni, eggplant and veal Parmesan all came with errors to the order. The food was good but not the typical Italian flavors you'd expect. 

I think if they invested a bit more in having better service both front and back of house it would be worth the money.

Menagerie is the latest on my list of amazing places I have gotten to try outside of my typical Rittenhouse bubble. While I wish I were more of a coffee connoisseur (alas, call it my character flaw), I can definitely tell if coffee is amazing or horrible. Luckily Menagerie's coffee is AMAZING. It is delicious and refreshing. I got the iced oat milk latte and my friend similarly agreed that she loved her cold brew (which is saying something, given how simple cold brew tends to be).

We grabbed iced drinks from here and roamed amidst the historical buildings. 11/10 would recommend!

Today was my first time ordering from this restaurant. I GOT SICK. I literally made this yelp account to warn others to eat at your own risk. I didn't throw up, but I felt like I had to for about 2 hours. It wasn't because I ate too much. I didn't eat half of my order. It was definitely food poisoning.

Even if I didn't get sick, it was completely tasteless. I ordered Gerneral Tsoa's Chicken, and the sauce that was on the chicken had no flavor, but the sauce that touched the rice did......just weird. I WILL NEVER ORDER FROM THERE AGAIN.

The food here is fantastic! Their veal parm is delicious. I also love the limoncello cake. My only complaint is about the owner/manager. She's very racist. I have friends who have worked there, and they have told me she uses racial slurs and dislikes anyone who is not white. The last time I ate there, she would not stop staring at me. If I didn't know about what she's said behind closed doors, I wouldn't have payed it any mind. It's such a shame. I would keep coming here because the food is spectacular, but I'll just take my money somewhere else.

Awesome food!  The staff is very welcoming and always have a suggestion if you're lost.  Absolutely try the cobia!  It's an awesome Vietnamese fish dish!!  One main dish and a small dish seem to be the perfect amount of food for me.  

The beer and wine selection are on point for the Seminole Heights area.  The always seem to have a great Angry Chair beer on tap which is my go to.  My friend got a a bubble rose which she let me try and it was awesome too.

I love sitting at the bar, the bartenders always make great conversation.  It is a must try for out of towners and a staple for Seminole Heights!

I was craving for sushi and decided to check out Goleta Sushi House after seeing good reviews. My husband and I were not disappointed. They did have about 3 tables if you wish to dine in during Covid19 and that's what we did. We had the Dynamite and Syder Roll and for appetizer we got the shrimp and veg tempura. The portions were good size and their presentation was beautiful especially for a small restaurant. Wish I had taken photos. Their prices were reasonable and their service was great. Checked on us several times. Definitely will be going back again very soon.

This place is my go to for anything buffalo...they really get it.  I'm someone who could eat buffalo chicken anything all day everyday.  Their buffalo chicken calzone needs an award, idk which one but something.  It's simply amazing and a large could feed 4 people twice.

We've gotten pizza a couple times and every time it's stellar.  Vegetables are fresh and not mealy.  Perfect cook time.

My girlfriend likes lighter food and everything she's ever ordered she's enjoyed.  Food is fresh and it's simply a fact that every time I order, it's done sooner than expected.

Keep on rolling Jeans.  You're my go to spot in Mayfair.

Their tacos are cheaper than Taco Bell's soft taco supremes(this is not a serious comparison), and they taste better too. I come here for lunch a lot and I am always pleased with what I order...either three tacos, a burrito, or a quesadilla. I recently sampled their Consome, and it was very rich in flavor. I may have to order that when it gets colder out..the spices they put in their consome were a bit heaty. 

Other than that, this joint is one of the better places to grab food in Delaware. I've had my fair share of California Tortilla, El Diablo Burrito, and Chipotle, and this place tops them all.

I usually get happy wonderful service here. But for some reason the woman in the drive thru this morning was short. I was going to get a few more drinks, but got frustrated and kept quiet and only got my 1. Coming from a customer's point of view, customer service makes or breaks an experience. I am sorry to say, that I will be driving to AZ Pavillions from now on. Even though they are busy as well, and a bit out of my way, I have NEVER had a short barista. I do not appreciate "we'll have your total......." before asked if there is anything else. I'm sorry. Maybe it was a bad morning for her, but please leave it at the door.

We scored last minute tickets to Wicked at the Academy of Music on a Friday night and had to cancel our dinner reservations in Old City and since we had passed Fratelli's we decided to give it a shot. I went for the Penne Alla Vodka and added chicken. The vodka sauce wasn't the worst I've had nor the best. It was just middle of the road. The chicken was rubbery and fairly flavorless. My wife had chicken parm that was also just ok. I wouldn't go out of my way to go here again and if I found myself in a similar situation, I'd try one of the many other restaurants in the area.

So I have to say its a slice of brooklyn in tampa. The waitstaff and decor are really what made me put a 4, but the food was more 3.5. The best dish we had was the gnocchi, which they do a french version of. The salmon crudo was beautiful, but the number of ingredients they tried to incorporate didnt really make the dish shine. We also got the rabbit dish with chicken liver, which was good but chicken liver taste dominated the dish.

I would def go back and try new dishes purely because the experience and concept was great. I see a lot of potential in this place.

Hip spot, good eats with a selection of craft beer.  Place can get busy, and service can seem a bit slow at times, as long as your glass is full you should be alright.  The wait staff really does try their best.  I had The Colonial Burger which wasn't cooked to Medium Rare like I was expecting, but It was still good.  My wife had the Summer Squash Bar Pie which is their naming convention for pizza.  It was really good!   I definitely will revisit, maybe on a quieter night and sit at the bar.  Their Happy Hours looks good with Calamari & Wing specials.  This is a good place to get away from your typical chain restaurant, and try something new.

I'm beginning to hate this McDonald's. I used to love this MCD because it wasn't too busy. The last 3 times I have had problems with their service. 1) the drive through speaker on the aisle I went through didn't work & no indication that there was a problem. Exasperated employee when I finally pulled forward to tell them. 2) drive through cash register didn't work & instead of taking order, they told me I had to come in to order (with a small infant that can be challenging). 3) had to pull forward & wait 10 minutes (15 min from initial order) for a Carmel frappe. Food is typical for McDonalds but the service is just getting worse & worse.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I work in the Maplewood area and am always use to going to Joy Luck Buffet when craving Chinese food. Wong Inn's is priced well for whole orders, but even better priced for their lunch specials.
 
Their sweet and sour chicken was good, similar to most Chinese restaurants. It came with fried rice and two crab rangoon. I also ordered hot and sour soup which had a unique taste compared to similar restaurants. I was not expecting the large portion of soup I received - be aware of the size.
 
At a decent price, I recommend this place if you're looking to order Chinese take-out during the typical work-week.

I love everything about this place.  They focus on hair (imagine that) and are true experts.
A friend turned me onto Joanna, one of the two owners, Jon being the other.  Both have loyal followings for good reason. I get so many compliments on my cut and color by Joanna. Sula is another operator who used to have her own shop.  She is super-talented and my sister-in-law swears by her.  From Georgia at the reception desk to Alison, the best shampoo you can get, it's a treat to go there, yet the prices are reasonable!  My mother and niece both got great blow-outs.  I heard Georgia and Alison do hair on Sundays. That's a win for everyone.

If I could leave ZERO stars I would. This is the worst hotel, consisting of the most incompetent staff, and a poor choice based on the hotels in the nearby area.

DO NOT STAY AT THIS HOTEL. Of the two rooms I stayed at, they are outdated, old, smelly, and the AC's do not work properly, meaning No cold air!

Worst of all are the rude, incompetent, loud staff that fill the halls and MIGHT clean your room if they aren't too lazy.

Do your customers a favor and fire the entire staff and hire employees who actually CARE about providing a positive experience to customers / guests.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
My fiance and I came to Philadelphia for the night.  We got a good deal in a room here through Travelocity.com.  After some minor issues with our first room the staff was quick to accommodate and move us to another, much better, room.

The hotel has a great restaurant called Davio's and it's centrally located to everything.  You're a quick walk to just about every major site in town.  Parking is across street in shopping center parking lot, but you do get a discount from the hotel.

I would DEF stay here on my next visit!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We have been taking our dog to this location since 2017 when it first opened. The staff at the Banfield in center city (and all of petsmart) is wonderful.  We come here often for comprehensive visits and other issues. I booked an appointment online and I guess i didn't finish booking it- so my appointment wasn't on their schedule. The staff still made time to see my dog and squeezed him in for his comprehensive visit. The staff and vets here are always kind and listen to all your questions and concerns. They remember Winston by name and are very thorough during exams/ procedures.  Thank you Banfield!

This location needs some improvement; definitely need the workers to be more aware of customers that come in and make sure they're accommodated. I walked in one day and I was left standing at the register waiting to take my order. Didn't get a "I'll be right with you sir" from anybody that was at register. A young man that was late to his shift helped me quicker than the workers that were already there. 

2 stars only because they got my order right, but they need to fix their customer service. They're very slow.

Dinner with the wife.  She had a pasta entree and I had the NY strip special. The steak was cooked well but the onions were undercooked and it was definitely not worth the $39 charged on the bill.  Our server was nice but my glass of wine for dinner wasn't delivered until after we had finished the meal, and the pour was light too. There was also a private party upstairs which was loud and caused mass confusion with the coat check coming in. I would have been fine with all of this because the food was better than average.  But $75/each for a drink, appetizer and entree is center city pricing and this fell way short.

Tried the breakfast buffet.....don't bother!  Tried it for dinner one night.  Lobster bisque was good.  Buffalo chicken dip was very tasty but the chips on the stale side.  The bucket punch was pretty good but not quite worth $12.  Waitress.....very poor.  The also sat us at a table right next to the kitchen traffic which was annoying.  Too bad this place isn't up to snuff with the hotel attached because that would be very convenient.  However, I won't eat there again...too many other better choices in Clearwater Beach.

So we wanted to give this place another try before going to Wicked and once again the same ole service issues. Place was pretty busy w a convention in town. We were told 10-15 minutes and couldn't help but notice 3 dirty tables that the staff just kept walking by? Needless to say we waited 15-20 minutes and once again were told it would be another 10-15 minutes LOL! High school employees didn't seem to worry or care much about the poor owners business obviously. Its a shame, we left and had tapas next door as well as 2 other parties that gave up waiting.....

Great food period! You can tell these guys are passionate about their craft. We sat at the bar and marveled at the 3 induction burners and a convection oven; proof it's not the equipment that matters but a passion for cooking. You witness the chemistry these guys have w their chef right away. We started w the oysters and I personally could have eaten 2 dozen, perfect balance of flavors and the shaved ice on top sealed the deal. Cheese slate great!
Pork belly great! Wahoo & stewed tomatoes fantastic, gnocchi, great! Great service by one of the chefs wife and just a great dining experience overall! Wish they could all be like this

My husband went through the drive thru tonight. Sat there for a couple minutes. A car pulled up behind him and the employee took that cars order from the "second" screen. When my husband said something to get someone's attention, the employee argued then was extremely nasty with my husband. If you are that miserable, get another job moron! This is not the first time this location was a complete disappointment. It will be the last time we ever visit this McDonald's! They will most likely be all out of a job soon when this trash closes.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Tried this place again, figured they couldn't get worse. Wrong. Still slow, still mess orders up. Forgot one of my 7 items, noticed when I go home. Called and "Joel" apologized, said they should have counted the items. Blah. Blah. Offered me a "free" replacement next time I came. Asked Joel how it's free when I paid for it but never received it, seems to me it's more like I paid for it well in advance. Had to ask what else could be done, offered me a free drink with it, which costs the company may be 2 cents. 

Again, avoid this sh*thole like the plague.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: First off, my wife and I go on date night every week. First things first, we order drinks and we get asked for ID's, though we clearly look over the age of 21. So we ordered our sushi, which was very delicious but am saddened to say that I did not know which sushi was what from what we ordered. Any other sushi restaurant we have been to, the waitress has always explained what each roll was. Out waitress never stopped by our table to ask how we were doing. Only to leave my wife with no refill on her drink. And to end it all, it took more than 10 minutes to get our check. We will give it one more chance and hope for better.

We went to Asaka for the 5pm-7pm Happy Hour on a whim.  I was really wanting sushi but didn't want to go to one of the fancier spots in town.  We ordered five different rolls (which proved to be a lot) and edamame.  It was really tasty and very cheaply priced (roughly $3-$5 per roll).

If you're looking for a nice ambiance and a romantic setting, this isn't the place for you.  However, if you want an after-work meal, it is great.  For the price and the amount of food, it's a great spot. 

I wouldn't take a first date there.

Went for Valentine's Day. There were many empty tables and we were told the delays were due to them  being busy. Took an hour for a sushi roll. They forgot out appetizers and went to our meals. Did not even comp one that we asked to home since they forgot. Ordered beef scallion roll up from the menu...then they told us they don't have and suggested the skewers.. Which we ordered. Unfortunately they were not prepared. Other than the obstacles... Food was delicious.... Shrimp tempura, Peking duck and schezuan Kung pao chicken.

The gym has all the necessary equipment for a full body work out. When equipment breaks they either get it fixed and/or benches recovered.

The staff is helpful. The gym is clean. I love the key fob to enter 24/7.

It's a good mix of patrons. Inspiring, fit people - new patrons learning the ropes - runners - those who enjoy primarily the classes - etc. Find your niche and comfort level and go with it. Just be sure to wipe the benches when you're done using them!

Never hired any trainers. I've watched them for years though. I suggest hiring the one with the physique most like what you want to achieve.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The worst McDonald's I have ever been to asked for light ice in my soda and they handed me a cup that had a 2" air gap between the lid and the drink, I might as well have had regular ice in it. Then the person working the drive through was annoyed when I asked to have it topped off. Like they wouldn't have done the same thing if roles were reversed??????????? Then to top it off the soda tasted like c&*p. The burgers I received I wouldn't feed my dog. The fries were average. NEVER EVER AGAIN WILL I GO TO THIS MCDONALD'S!!!!!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If you are looking for cheap bland food than this is the place for you! The Buffett is only $6.99 on the Sunday we ate here. Cold chicken wings, ok pizza, and ice burg lettuce. I tried to order a gyro meat salad, I have been spoiled by good creek food. Their gyros have no veggies and bland cucumber sauce. Spaghetti special was a good deal, $5.99 for a big platter. My kiddo loved it but he's 9 so bland spaghettis is right up has alley. My 13 year old ordered her own pizza since the buffet did not look appetizing. The staff were all very friendly. Two stars due to friendliness and price.

Shittiest bk ever. The idiot working the drive thru didn't know how to put a veggie whopper into the system! She eventually left, manager came on and was a total frazzled asshole. "Hold on I'm trying to work 3 systems here" he yelled twice over the speaker. But he JUST asked what else was there to add to our order. On top of that when I went to order a mini Cinnabon, he decided to tell me how many he has left.. Unprofessional much? He was brass, rude and just unprofessional all over. Don't think I'll ever be here again. Still in the parking lot as I write this review .. Judge me.

this place is truly a hidden gem. the burgers are made fresh - which means a bit longer wait than other fast food restaurants but, trust me, they are worth it! they used to have huge loaded baked potatoes in lieu of fries - i don't like fries - but it appears they took them off the menu. the onion rings are decent and the milk shakes are delish! freshly made cheeseburger and vanilla milkshake - yum! it's my go-to spot when i'm in the area. the building and decor could use a bit of updating but it's hard to care when the food is so good and we always take-out anyway.

Actually embarrassed and disappointed in myself for ordering from them. We ordered the stuffed crust, nope. Ordered cheesy bread, nope just a small pizza. The wings were wrong. And there wasn't any extra sauce like we ordered. There are too many pizza show in the area for this place to even be open. When I called there wasn't any one in charge to speak with and the English was more difficult to understand than how they could mess up already prepared pizza! The way the pizza was cut would've been funny if it wasn't mine! They shouldn't be allowed to sell pizza and I'm embarrassed for even ordering from this place.

DO NOT GO TO THIS TIRE KINGDOM. I just recently moved from Orlando and for years have gone to Tire Kingdom, my first visit to this location was awful. They will get you in and out fast because they don't do their job correct. I went in for an oil change, fluids, and tire rotation. They did not check any fluids or refill them, which I was unaware of until my engine started over heating. They also did not fill up the tires with air or rotate them when I had asked. I went to Ollin Mott and they fixed all the tire kingdoms mistakes
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I've ordered from them 5 times now (either grub hub or seamless). 3 out of 5 times, they have delivered well past the promised 45 to 60 minutes. (2 times 1 hour 15 minutes, 3rd time I've passed that and I'm still waiting for them to arrive. 
Their hot wings are not tasty and not very hot. However, I found their garlic Parmesan and Cajun BBQ very tasty. They were good enough for me to give them a few chances, but three strikes and you're out for me. 
Also, every time I ordered fries as a side, they came soggy. I know the options for ordering wings are very limited in Philly, but I think no wings is better than waiting around for these wings.

The Philly Cheesesteak is amazing. The meat is high quality and has absolutely no fat mixed into it. The bread is never stale and the French fries are tastey. I find myself getting in the mood for Cheesesteak once and a while and this place never fails to deliver a great sandwich. Their garlic knots are also the best I have ever had to date. They don't skimp on the garlic and olive oil and use fresh ingredients including basil. I never think twice about traveling to pick up food here because I have yet to be disappointed.

We decided to meet a friend from out of town as well as a few friends from St. Louis at the newest Pi location downtown.  Pi never disappoints, the pizza is always fabulous.  We tried the Delmar and Kirkwood, and no one could decide which they liked better.  Our waitress highly recommended the apple pie for dessert and she was completely right.  

It is great to have a restaurant that is so great to take out of town people.  The waitstaff is always friendly and helpful and the food is outstanding.  And, it get to look forward to lunch today too with leftovers!

An outdoor bar where the entrance is through an alley (well you don't have to but it avoids the lines and makes the experience much more interesting). Must say, it has a very 90s chill vibe complete with the music being played from an old 90s boom box. 

The beer selection will satisfy most after-work happy hour seeking individuals and the prices are very fair. Not much on tap and if you like their more exotic side of selection, you'll get it in a can / bottle. 

There's a fire pit, board games, jenga, a friendly staff and a good crowd. It's a great place to start off the evening and has the relaxing atmosphere to end it as well.

This place is terrible. 
I am a "President's Club" ($250 annual fee) Gold member. I booked a reservation on line last night at the Hyatt Regency location. When i got to the Hyatt i found a kiosk not a counter. After waiting 15 minutes for an on-line agent to answer and 10 minutes of conversation I told "to take a cab to the Convention Center location to pick up my car"
What an abortion. I have a message to Hertz, you have my last $250, enjoy it and you will never have a reservation from me again.
Your service SUCKS! and you seem to be unaware that we have choices.

Great outdoor area in Philadelphia.  They have a drink to fit everyone's needs.  They have 3 dollar PBR cans for those on a budget and wonderful mixed drinks including a vodka fruit punch and a passion fruit lemonade for those who do not drink beer.  They have a great selection of canned and draught beers as well.  Each table is equipped with either connect 4 or jumbling tower so that always adds a bit of excitement to the outing.  Can't comment on the food because I've never sampled it.

The only downfall is that if the wind blows the wrong way all you can smell is the scent of the dumpsters in the alley...yuck.

Everything you could ask for in a salon.

I've had my haircut and glazed by Joe (the owner), as well as Linda.  Both experiences were amazing.  I really had no clue what to do with my hair and they both were able to help me figure it out. Both times I walked out of Salon Bass, I literally felt like a million bucks.  Not to mention they are really cool, down-to-earth people (no pretention whatsoever) you just enjoy being around!

Every time I'm in Philly, I'm going to make a trip to Salon Bass - they are that good!

We have not been here in quite a while at least a little over a year. Service was exceptional (Alicia was our server/waitress and was perfect). I ordered just the steak and the rest of the family had the buffet and hubby added a chopped steak. Best part is that they are doing brunch from 10am- 2pm on Sunday. My family was.very pleased. The wings are better than the fried chicken and the wings are one of our favorite items. I really like that the food is on the buffet in real pots and pans and that it is not as crowded as Golden Corral. They will see us again.

Well, I was really looking forward to it opening but was  very much disappointed. The building was eye catching and  the name I'm sure brought a lot of California's like me there. I walked in and ordered one of their popular dishes according to the cashier.  I got the food and was greatly disappointed. The food was very small portions and didn't taste good at all. It's like going to Betos but a lot worse. Don't t get me wrong I like Betos but this is like a crappy version of that. Overall, not a great meal there that's for sure.

Terrible service. They wouldn't accept my coupon because I showed it to them AFTER they had gotten my clothes from the back even though I showed it to the attendant as she was ringing up. "Once it's in the register it can't be changed" and "sorry but she's new she wasn't paying attention" I spoke to the manager and she wasn't helpful at all. Because of a new hire's inability to pay attention to the customer they wouldn't accept a change. DO NOT GO HERE. Or if you must, make sure they know from the beginning you want to use a coupon.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Great yogurt but my god do the girls working here need some personality...it's almost awkward how bland and robotic like the staff are. The only person who ever is friendly and welcoming is the older gentleman. The girls literally all say the exact same thing every time, don't smile and have zero personality. Management needs to work on customer service and not just going through the motions but making your staff enjoyable to interact with. Please get some happier people working your establishment instead of these grumpy little teen girls. Everything else is great! Great yogurt, clean place and we love the guy when he is working!

Wonderful property, however the poor customer service during our most recent stay may cause me to book the Westin or Conrad the next time I'm in Indianapolis. I called prior to our arrival and asked if it was possible to have a rollaway in our room when we arrived--as we were getting in at midnight--and was told it was not a problem.  Unfortunately, this did not happen and it took over an hour to have one delivered--then we had to wait another 30+ minutes for a pillow and blanket!  The icing on the cake was when housekeeping knocked at the door at 8 am--repeatedly!  Not a good night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I only gave this a one star because I have to per Yelp reviews. This place only specialty is taking people's money. They misdiagnosed my puppy which could have led to life threatening emergencies if as dog owners were smart enough to know something was seriously wrong. Not only did Dr. Michelle A. Fulks misdiagnose my puppy she gave her medications she didn't even need and didn't give medications and shots that were in fact needed. I recommend anywhere else besides this place in Tucson because they obviously don't care about your animal's health only the money in your pocket.

So yeah...this place. I hate being Captain Obvious by giving places like McDonalds low ratings for service (it's like telling Precious she could lose a few pounds) but this one deserves it. Drive through order takers here are usually rude, often combative. Today one short changed me by a few cents and when I told her, she told me they were out of pennies like I was bothering her. She gave me a couple pennies back with an attitude like I was being a cheapskate. But still shorted me. The food window people are usually friendly and my order is usually correct. But yeah...this place. Low rating is well deserved.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is the most disgusting hotel I have ever stayed in. If I hadn't been dropped off here by my wife, I would have run out of here. The room stinks of mildew. It hasn't been painted in 10 years. There is dirt and stains every where. The shower is gross. I don't even want to remove my socks, much less get into bed. Thank god I will only be here about six hours before my flight. This place is a red hot mess!  I will be canceling my Choice Club membership. Choice corporate should be ashamed of themselves! I feel trapped like a rat in this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I had high hopes for Megu being my new default sushi restaurant, but the two rolls I ordered were a disappointment.

The spicy tuna roll seemed to have been pureed- I couldn't see any fish at all when I took a closer look.  I have a pretty low tolerance for spicy things and I can honestly say that this roll could barely be considered spicy.

My Philadelphia roll was decent.  The cream cheese had an odd solidity to it that made it taste almost like mozzarella cheese.

However, the service was really good and it had a nice atmosphere.  That doesn't make up for terrible rolls though so I doubt I'll be returning.

Stayed here 8 nights. Housekeeping during the week we're wonderful but weekend housekeeping was terrible. No coffee,bath mat and didn't make the bed just tossed comforter over sheets that had popped off the corners. Very noisy kids running in halls doors slamming and loud music from the bar across the bay. The view from the balcony was breathtaking. Most staff was friendly. One staff (a small man about 40 with blond hair and mustache ) was dismissive when I asked if the front desk had an item I'd lost. He didn't even look just said no. I asked a nice gal the next day and sure enough my missing item was right there at the front desk
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Always walk by this place and it's empty.  Figured the food and/or menu sucked.  Finally decided to give it a try.  The menu was actually very appealing.  Ordered a Cobb Salad which was decent.  Girlfriend ordered another salad with chicken added.  She said it was just OK.  Her salad was the size of a side salad at any other restaurant but ended up costing about 16$ once chicken was added.   Moral of story: good menu but small portions and over priced.  Food about average.   Server was super friendly and good.

Did not book a reservation here but I was here twice because my friends were staying here. 

Very exquisite hotel. Located on a quiet street even though the next street over is Bourbon St. Liked the spiral staircase. 

Rooms appear to be set up as a 1-bedroom townhome. The bedroom is on the 2nd level with a 1/2 bath. The full bathroom is on the 1st level. Some rooms have a balcony. Both floors have a TV. If you are 6 feet or higher, the ceiling on the first level might be too low for you
  
Nice pool - deepest end is 8 feet.

Some rooms are haunted.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I'm an avid Chinese go-er - this place is pretty good, the staff is very friendly, place is clean, and the food is fresh!  I had the General Tso's which was VERY (big emphasis on very) spicy, my boyfriend had the Empress Chicken which was doused in the sweet n' sour sauce it looked like.  Not his favorite.. but overall it was good and I only gave it a 4 because I love spicy food but I can't tell you how much my tongue still hurts because it was so spicy lol

FYI This is not your hole in the wall Chinese food.. I'd compare it to Panda Express

I took my car here for a state inspection. Unfortunately, they failed my car saying I needed rotors & breaks replaced (around $500-600). Because I was a little skeptical, I took my car to the dealer for a second opinion. The dealer felt I still had around 18k miles left prior to replacement and my car passed inspection without any difficulty. Joe (the owner) reached out to me after seeing my Yelp review and offered to refund what he initially charged me. I am not a car expert, so there may be some subjectivity to when rotors & breaks need to be replaced that I don't understand. Nonetheless, the experience here was stressful for me.

I just came back from staying at the hotel. I truly enjoyed my stay. We arrived early and the staff was more than accomodating. The room was very nice. The cleaning staff was professional, friendly and did a great cleaning job.  The front desk and room service were very promt with my requests. The breakfast was also great. They were very kids friendly. They also have movie night. One night we watched Rio 2 the next night was The Lego Movie. The onsite Coco Keys Indoor Water Park was a plus. Can't wait to return.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Mu friends and I were visiting North Star decided to up to Cabelas and then decided to have sushi. A cashier recommended Sakana, boy were we happy he did!  We caught the lunch price all you can eat, which is $19.99 and it included ice cream. They have a large selection on their menu and the sushi is freshly made.
We had a party of seven, we were seated right away, and the serve was very nice and professional. Sakana offered a 10% military discount. The restaurant is clean and the ambience is very relaxing. I would come here again if I'm in the area.

I can understand everyone is uptight over the virus and all, but I would like to have been treated better this morning. I need two more of what I bought and asked the cashier. Oh don't think we, I stopped her and I said I saw them in the back. She sent someone to get them. He could not find them and she had to go back and show him. She rang me up, I went to grab a box to put them in, as I always do, in a very rude voice she said ' Please do not touch those boxes, they are for something else, I will find a beer box for you. Told her not to bother. 
Need better customer service.

Went through the drive- thru. It was an average speed. The person taking our money was complaining to a co-worker about having to work for another hour. It looked like the parking lot was fairly clean and inside it was busy, so it can't be that bad. 

Definitely in a run-down location though - we were asked for money twice while trying to get out of the parking lot and there were lots of people just lounging around in the parking lot. I suppose considering that it was still super nice so I'll bump them up from 3 to 4 stars.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Worst car rental experience I've ever had-- or rather, I wasn't even able to rent a car even though I called earlier in the day and got confirmation of a car rental for later that day. After traveling across cities and taking a cab to the Avis Car Rental center I was told they had no cars in the lot. Our only option was to take a taxi to the Philadelphia airport or I'd be stranded. Car renters beware of unreliability at this location.

Fortunately, the manager at the Philadelphia airport Avis center took good care of us and made us whole.

I was really excited to try this place for restaurant week after reading such great things. I made an indoor reservation weeks in advance.

When I arrived, the hostess tried to give us a table outside. After asking for an indoor table, she huffed and told us we could only sit at a high top near the bar. We sat there without contact from a server for nearly a half hour! Finally a waitress came over, but the restaurant seemed horribly understaffed.

Food was meh, definitely not worth it for the price. Same goes for the drinks. I'm not planning on returning.

Called ahead for prices (17.00 for men's cut), and if appointment was necessary. The lady who answered the phone was very nice and informed me that I could walk in, no problem.

Unfortunately that's where the customer service stopped. As I walked in, a lady with blue hair coldly walked up, no smile or greeting,  and took me to my chair. 
The haircut was short, awkward and sloppy. As I listened to the stylist next to me engaging with her customer(actually asking how they were liking the cut), mine stayed silent.
This stylist was either having a bad day, or lacking in customer service skills.
Will never return.

I've been here 3 times within the past year and all 3 times did not disappoint! I've had the Salmon Dorino, Scallops in penne, and crab meat in Angel hair and all 3 entrees were amazing! The service was also great for me every time. Also, their pizza is great, but the only thing that's confusing is that the Margherita pizza isn't actually Margherita--it's a plain pizza. Their Napolitano is actually a Margherita pizza, just something to be aware of when ordering. Great portions and reasonably priced. Definitely recommend trying this hidden gem of the Northeast out at least once!

Location is excellent. Parking garage is easy to navigate. Price wasn't outrageous. Housekeeping was so-so...they didn't restock all of our towels and coffee items.  Reserved 7 weeks ahead of our trip - requested a king got two full size beds. 7 weeks in advance seems enough time to guarantee a bed preference.  Bathtub didn't drain.  Parking garage exit kept malfunctioning.  Front desk staff was unorganized and didn't seem to care about our preferences.  We stay at Sheraton hotels when we travel...this is the worst Sheraton we've stayed at.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Have tasted better sushi restaurants. Sat inside the tiny restaurant and it was loud, I could hear the clanking of pots and pans from the kitchen, and the waiters were rude and unfriendly. 

Ordered the miso soup as a starter, it seemed like it was just microwaved from a packet of miso soup in the kitchen- did not seem fresh at all.

Ordered the shrimp asparagus roll which was okay but really plan- didn't seem like anything special. 

You can get better sushi elsewhere in Center City - stay away from this place.

When I come home to STL I crave Chinese food, actually I leave the airport and head straight to the restaurant.  Press for time I could not go to my favorite Chinese restaurant so I headed to this restaurant because I know they have good food.  Anyhew, when asked could I get chopsticks they cost .25 each, then I asked for fortune cookies I had to buy a pack of 5.  I've been eating in STL Chinese restaurants for YEARSSSSSS and have never been charged for chopsticks or fortune cookies.  Needless to say I will not use this restaurant as my emergency to place again.

We arrived here on June 15, 2015 for one night. Check in was easy and the room with two beds was clean--it was on the first floor with the main road just outside. Some street noise could be heard in the room. But it died down after 10PM. There were some early morning noise issues experienced during our stay. The GYM WAS LOCATED NEXT TO OUR ROOM. Around 6AM there was this pounding from someone running on a machine. SO avoid this room if you're staying here. I would stay here again if in the area but in a different room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Thieves. I left a nice button down shirt in the hotel and called back to get it the same day a few hours after I checked out and they refused to call me back. I called again in the morning and they had nothing in the lost in found! Gee...I wonder where it went!

As for the rest of the hotel, it's a decent place to stay right next to the KOP mall. Since it is the cheapest option in the area, the parking lot had been crowded with people making it feel not very safe. The continental breakfast is average at best.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The store is huge. Always clean and tidy. I give them not quite five stars for two reasons. First, I like Bohemia beer and most of the time they don't have any. This has been before the current shortages of today. Second, they have a rewards program. Initially, I always made sure they had my phone or email address to ensure I received the proper credit. After being robbed, I went to Lee's as I had bought a lot of liquor on sale. They gave me some ridiculous amount. I questioned how could they be so wrong and was told the program was way off. So, when I go back, I don't even bother trying to get credit.

Went for a quick bite during my work lunch break, and ordered a sandwich and side salad. Took 10 minutes for the three-bite salad to arrive. The panini took 40 minutes to arrive. Two other parties came in after me and were served first!?! And it was the worst tasting chicken parm I've ever had - I could barely eat half of it. Management was apologetic and comped part of the bill. Staff was friendly too and the atmosphere was nice. I can appreciate trying to make it right, but with Cafe Cibo nearby, I'll stick with that for my Italian cravings going forward.

My last stylist's prices were getting too expensive, so I needed to find a more affordable place. Plus, while she was super sweet and I loved her color jobs, I never liked how she cut my hair, as it's super thick, heavy and wavy. It seems as though I've been trying to grow it out forever, since she kept cutting too much. Well, I came here last week and got both a precise cut (with alot of texturizing) and a meticulous, non-messy color job. Price was great, and in the end, she didn't push me to buy all the products. After 3 days, I washed my hair and no color rinsed out. Awesome! I will definitely be back!

The Sign is a little difficult to find on this restaurant heavy avenue. Went here for a nice sushi double date where we found decent prices and sushi. The service was great and very attentive. Being from the New York area, I found the ramen sub-par. At first glance, it appeared to have it all. But to be critical, Broth wasn't full of the pork-based masterpiece flavor found in the east parts of world and United States (NYC). The noodles also did not have the same flare. I didn't finish the meal yelling "Kaedama"!

I really like this sushi place. They give you the spicy mayo in a squirt bottle. Totally changes the experience for me, since I love spicy mayo and hate asking for it. All the rolls we got were amazing. Service was a little slow but they were pretty busy. It's a small restaurant. I also got to go food from there last week. The sides of fried rice and noodles were a little disappointing. The rice was just white rice with some soy sauce on it. The noodles were just noodles no veggies and the portion size was pretty small. But they have the sushi on point.

I was taken here by a coworker as a gift. I had a rough experience.The haircut was done well. We then proceeded to the portion of a face shave. I could feel the barbers long finger nails gripping the skin as he went against the grain. I was a little torn because I wanted to be grateful of the gift since my coworker was a huge fan, but I knew it didn't feel normal compared to past experiences. The face shave was far from relaxing and ended without a face massage. Probably because I was bleeding all over at the end. Check out the pic I loaded.

TLDR; If you're craving sushi and want a slightly fancier option, this will do, but really nothing special. 

Came here with a group of 4 on a Thursday evening and did not have to wait long despite being a walk in customer. The ambiance of the place is nice with dimmer lighting and nice booths to facilitate group conversations. 

My main two complaints are that the food is on the pricier side for what you are getting and the service was underwhelming. Each time we asked for additional place setting or refill on water, the waiter made it seem as if we were highly inconveniencing him.

I came here with my fiancé for his pool league and we decided to eat dinner while we were here as well. I had the BLT and he had the cheeseburger. I was very impressed with the BLT as it had quite a bit of bacon whereas most places only put 2 or so small strips. His burger was very thick and juicy. Worth the money! My only complaints are the soda was watered down and they don't have the air on in the dining/pool table area, just fans. The bathrooms are nice and cool though so I'm not sure what the problem is turning the air on in the entire building. Otherwise I'd say I would eat here again.

I wasn't staying at the hotel, but on Wednesday afternoon I had an appointment at the salon. I had left my husband down the street about 3 blocks at a restaurant. When finished with my appointment it had started to storm. I had no way to get back to my husband because I had walked. There were to very nice gentleman who worked there at the door when I exited. They offered me an umbrella to use, but when they saw how scared I was of the storm, they offered to shuttle me to the restaurant even though I wasn't staying there. I just wanted to say thank you for being so kind. You made my day by being so kind and thoughtful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stopped at the Burger King on Lebanon Road close to Briley Parkway the food was good but the lady at the drive-thru didn't give me enough change nor a receipt... when I realized it I stopped but the car behind me was too close for me to get back to the window so I had to go inside and tell them that I didn't get the correct change.... the person that waited on me got my correct change and my receipt I don't know if it was intentional or not but the lady at the window never said anything to me ....now if she short change enough people throughout the day that's a nice little lining in her pocket.

Paid $32 total, without the extra tip I gave, which included "The Works" and the $9 to wipe down interior thoroughly. Found dirt on leather on back of seats, and car seats not vacuumed at all or around them. Looked like none of the interior was really wiped down properly. Rubber mats were removed and washed but dirt still in them once dry. Rear view mirror not cleaned. Tried to save myself time by going here but I still ended up cleaning it again. Outside of car was fine.  Not worth the money if you don't get what you paid for.

I've been coming to this place for a few years now and it continues to be my favorite Mexican restaurant! I don't say that lightly as I have tried many different places around town and this place remains my #1! I always get the margaritas and fajitas. The seasoning on the fajitas cannot be beat! The price of the margaritas is absolutely perfect! A lot of bang for your buck here and flavor is always amazing. I always have two meals out of my dinner fajita and have left overs for lunch the next day. I've never found fajitas this big anywhere else! 5 stars without hesitation!!!

So this was a pretty delicious Mother's Day brunch. A little pricey but that is to be expected at such a nice place with items such as Coddled Farmer's Egg. I added the house smoked salmon to the egg and it was a great combination.  They feature bottomless Bloody Marys on Sundays as well which I think is a great concept. The waiter was more than happy to refill our glasses a few times which made the dining experience a real treat. If you have some time on your hands, stop in on a Sunday, order a handful of small plates and a bloody and I think you'll really enjoy yourself.

We stayed in a room with two queens for a decent price for two nights. The rooms were clean, the bathroom was really nice (spacious shower). Didn't trust the breakfast, you're better off going to one of the local eateries. The parking price for the actual hotel is outrageous, HOWEVER they offer discounted parking in the garage across the street. Totally worth it. They also give you a discount card for a large amount of restaurants and bars downtown which is amazing! Staff was polite. All in all this is a solid place to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I stayed here 5 nights for a nearby conference. I had to change rooms immediately after checking in- my bathroom was very dated, clean but stained yellow and peeling. The hotel clerk was very accommodating and apologetic, apparently not all of their bathrooms have been remodeled yet. I also had to request and pay for a small fridge, not standard in all rooms. My second room was nicer, still worn down. Located near river (ask for a river view, not city view if possible) and short walk to conference center and restaurants.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This is a really, really sketchy motel. The bulk of their customers are homeless or in active addiction. There are broken down cars and shopping carts in the parking lot and barefoot junkies wandering in and out at all hours of the day and night. Expensive vehicles only make brief stops, if you catch my drift. I've seen people camping in the next parking lot over only to stay here for a couple nights and then go back to camping.

If you're from out of town and need a place to spend the night, you'd do well to avoid it. If you're looking for trouble, on the other hand...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Where to begin. The management here is a joke...called the front desk in regards to bug bites and our room not being cleaned. Was informed that we could change our own sheets if we had a problem. Finally got a new room after showing them the bug bites on my body. Kept calling and asking about what kind of bugs were in the room. Naomi the manager kept ignoring my calls...threatened to have my lawyer get involved and that's when they finally admitted that it was bed bugs! I have over 20 bite marks on me. Stay away from this place!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I took my lovely Bengal kitty, Tycho, here when he was just a little kitten. They made sure he had all the necessary vaccinations, and when it was time, they neutered him. Super professional, the doctor and staff are really friendly, and I'll be back in about a month for Tycho's checkup.

It's a bit on the pricier side as far as vets go, but you get what you pay for - a pleasant experience in an environment where they really care about your pet. I'd definitely recommend the French Quarter Vet if you live in the French Quarter or surrounding neighborhoods and aren't on a super tight budget.

Vinnie and Troy have both reached out to me after my initial 3-star review and offered me a 2nd haircut. Unfortunately it is just too hard to book an appointment. It looks like Troy is usually open in the mornings (I need afternoon), but Vinnie is booked out at least a week in advance. I really don't like to wait two weeks for a haircut when I need one now. Sorry guys, I appreciate your willingness to provide me with a better customer experience, but I have to stand by my original review. I'm sure some people will really dig this shop, but for the price it just didn't work for me.

Wonderful old style red gravy restaurant. I hadn't been here in a while and missed the relaxed atmosphere and comfort food. We had seven in our Mother's Day group and everyone enjoyed their lunch. The kids ate Ravioli and chicken parm plus lots of bread and butter. The adults enjoyed sausage, mussels in white ( the best around),fried asparagus,villa salad,spaghetti with seafood, etc etc. We ended up sharing plates and the kids ate more than usual. Service was good and our waitress made the kids feel very comfortable. Good family restaurant and we will be back.

I'm not quite sure if the restart after a tough closure due to covid has effected the quality here but i had hopes based on the reviews i read. The food and the drinks failed to match my expectations.

Tacos - We tried crispy fish and chicken tacos both of which were extremely bland and uneven in their taste.

Veg enchiladas - It was better than the tacos.

Drinks - For a mexican cuisine spot, the clearly pre made blood orange margarita was hugely disappointing. The tamarind sour was quite decent.

I truly hope the place finds it feet quick again and i hope to go back some day to see improved food.

I lived here for three weeks in 2007 as part of a summer internship, and was terribly sad to have to move into a campus apartment.  It's a nice hotel--clean rooms, very comfy beds, pretty landscaping.  There's free coffee and juice in the lobby all day.  The free breakfast is really good (I'm a big fan of the waffle irons).  There's also happy hour from 4 to 6 (Mon-Thurs) with free beer and wine (plus cheese and crackers)--the bartender is really cool.  
I also stayed there for a couple of nights in 2009--nothing had changed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The beans could use some updating as I found it too much of a mush. The fish tacos are awesome but my fave is the vegetarian enchilada! What a great surprised with fresh grilled veggies that were still crisp and great flavors! 
I am from California so I have great exposure to Mexican cuisine and while they excel with food flavorings, they can improve on the beans and tres leche! its too condensed and the whip cream seems more like frosting.... this dessert is suppose to be extra light and should dissolve in your mouth.

We came here at 8:55PM on a Wednesday night for a drink. There was no one in the restaurant other than a handful of people at the bar. From the moment we walked in... we have never felt so uninvited in our lives. It was very clear that the employees working just wanted to go home. They were so terrified that we may want to order food (from the kitchen that closed at 9pm). We felt so uncomfortable that we left within minutes of sitting down. I can't imagine that this place will make it. I know we won't be back. There are too many other great options to tolerate this kind of treatment.

Bad. Really, really bad. I got the chopped steak platter because I wanted to try the salad bar. Years ago a chopped steak platter was just that, chopped trimmings from freshly cut steak. I understand almost everyone now just uses the same meat they use for burgers. Fine. At least use quality ground beef! There sure was a lot of salad bar. Only positive thing I can say about the food. Unfortunately the majority of it was unseasoned and tasteless. Since when does homemade chicken soup have frozen vegetables mixed in? Cut me a break! Somebody there must remember how to do it right

Usually you get a veggie burrito and 1 bite tastes like sour cream and another bite is solely veggies, but rest assured this is not that place.  This is also not the exception.  I have been coming to Super Taqueria since they where on the corner of Double R Blvd and Damonte Ranch Pkwy, and I have never had a bad meal.  Although the taste of their burritos are good by themselves, don't forget the hot sauce bottles (green or red).  No matter what one you choose, you will not be disappointed, but the red adds nice heat and I generally find myself emptying half the bottle.
