Once I realized where I booked I panicked. So close to the airport (literally attached) and so far from everything else. However, I was pleasantly surprised! The hotel was very nice. The bed was super comfortable and room was clean. The bridge connecting the hotel to the airport also leads right to a train stop and it's a straight very easy train ride into city center. Everyone was very nice there and check out is later than normal at 12 noon. The one major downfall was parking. It was such and ordeal to get out of the garage, but to be fair, that wasn't the hotels fault. Nice place for sure.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I would give this restaurant a much higher rating (the pizza is very good )... But every time I eat there , they find a way to nickel and dime me. Any special request has cost me an extra buck (eg my wife is a vegetarian so we share a salad but ask for the bacon on the side , extra buck) ( didn't give enough dressing for salad, ask for more l, extra buck) 

They also don't put a lot of pizza sauce on their pizza (it is good sauce) so next time we asked them to go heavy on the sauce, extra buck

Belleville doesn't have too many good options for pizza so we will keep going here, but just is frustrating to get charged extra for everything

Lucky 13 better step it up or they will be lucky to exist a year from now. I'm not sure whey people rave about this. Bread sticks were flavorless and tasted store bought. The white sauce that came with it tasted like weak garlic flavored miracle whip. The medium sized pizzas were small for the price. The crust was bland and nothing special. It honestly was about on par with DIjourno from the grocery store. The place had awesome outdoor seating and a cool vibe which was a plus. Aaaaaand their water was nice and wet so it quenched my thirst. Will not be returning. See Michelle's review for further info....

I new I wasn't going to have a good time from the beggining.  My waiter had two ask me for my drink order over and over again and kept forgetting to order kitchen items from me.  He told me he was tired. First of all as I human being I understand, but as a paying customer I don't give a rats @ss!  If you are too tired or sick to do your job competently then do not come to work.
I received sour tempura shrimp from the kitchen.  Gross!!! A manager assured me that they had checked the batter and stock and ensured that it would not happen again.  

The sushi chef was nice and attentive.  Both stars are for him.

Surprised to see not so good reviews of this place. It's hard to find decent Chinese food (lots of Thai, not so much Chinese) around St. Louis city that's reasonably priced and this is the place for me. I don't come here often, but when I do I'm never disappointed. It's no frills, quick, they're polite without being your best friend (and why should they be?) and it always appears busy with people calling in orders, waiting, or even eating in on occasion. I've had a couple of different dishes -- the cashew chicken and the Hunan chicken. Both were good -- I may like the Hunan chicken a tad more.

I really wanted to give ZERO stars. This was one of the most mishandled and poor doctor offices I have visited since wearing glasses for over 25 years. I went for a check up to see my eyes and had issues with my prescription and received 2 different scripts from the office within a 6 month period. I decided to go to a different eye doctor who looked at the script that was "corrected" and they were saying how wrong the script was. The new doctor corrected the script and was able to get my glasses with the correct script.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
This McDonald's consistently has MUCH worse service than any other McDonald's I've ever been to.  I use the drive-thru here, and my order is almost never filled correctly.  Today I received the wrong drink, no straw and the wrong meal.  Sadly, this is a typical experience here.  

I have even had the shift manager argue with me about reimbursing me for a completely mixed up order, after I had to drive all the way back to have it corrected because I was given something I couldn't eat due to food allergies.  Purchase here at your own peril!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The best thing this place has going for it is its ambience. I'm a sucker for places with old arcade games. However, for a place that's all about waffles I wasn't too impressed with mine. The toppings and flavors were good but the actual waffle was kind of disappointing...more than than the Belgian type and therefore not all that filling. I left there looking for another place to grab food. It would have been a nice after-dinner elsewhere dessert. My boyfriend really enjoyed his Elvis waffle as he's a sucker for bacon. The drinks are also on the cheap side which helps.

Nice spa but the service is terrible! I asked if they could get me in for a second service, I made the appt for 4:30 at 2pm at 3:30 I asked to cancel it and they refused! Said it would be a full price charge for canceling. I also confirmed that the person providing the service did not get called in just to service me but was already providing services till 4:30pm already. I see this as unacceptable when I already had dropped $700 in spa services. At a Five star spa I expect better service than at a restraint like Prep and Pastry and sorry but the Ritz fell very short.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Definitely not your typical pizza place. They specialize in wood oven thin crust pizza as the name would suggest. It's also a little more upscale inside then a typical pizza place with a nice bar to watch the game or whatever else at. The service was fine . Nothing extraordinary. I liked the pizza I got (cheesesteak) but I definitely didn't love it. In my opinion it was a little overpriced. It was $10 for a personal lunch sized pizza. I like my pizza with a little more dough then theirs has. Overall I had an average experience here but would suggest it to others but just warn them it is a little classier then just a pizza joint.

I love this place! I have tried probably every nail salon in a 15 mile radius and I have ended my search for a great nail place with Wonder Nails. All of the technicians are very friendly and efficient. They never cut corners (figuratively & literally--i've gotten some painful manicures at other places!) I get an acrylic full set with gel polish and they always come out beautiful. They have the largest selection of gel polishes that i've seen and my nails usually last 2-3 weeks before i have to get a fill-in. Normally priced, not expensive for what i got and the quality and time spent. I would recommend Wonder Nails to anyone & everyone!

Not overly impressed.  The coffee was so cold I could leave my hand on the pot.  Adding cream made it lukewarm like it had sat for maybe 30 minutes off the heat.  I told the cashier but he just touched the pot and said nothing.  One if our Bavarian cremes had no creme in it.  They were nice enough to replace it so they don't get just 1 star.   The selection was very small also.  No chocolate cake, old fashioned, fruit flavored, or anything really interesting.  The donuts we got were OK but nothing to wrote home about.  Maybe I'm spoiled by the good donuts I had growing up back l east, but I just can't seem to find a great donut in Nevada.

This shop is definitely designed for Temple University students, and that's about it. I don't understand why anyone else would come here to get frozen yogurt, since it's about as average as it gets. 

The flavors taste a bit weird, and there's usually one flavor that's out of order. The toppings are usually pretty fresh, but half the time the fruit looks like it needs to go in the trash. 

The staff here is super nice, and they do accept Diamond Dollars, which is perfect for Temple students. They also stay open fairly late, so it's a good place to go when you need a late night treat.

I had the Super Burrito with carne asada.  It was incredibly delicious.  Their salsa labeled Abanero was amazing.  I couldn't get enough of it.  I would give 5 stars, but the restroom only had about 1" clearance between the front of the toilet seat and the wall, and that wall facing the toilet had the toilet paper dispensers.  I'm over 6 feet tall, and it was impossible for me to sit down without having my knees up against the wall.  Definitely not ADA compliant.  If they make the restroom ADA compliant, I will change to 5 stars.

We arrived shortly after noon on Labor Day. At the time there was only one server and he was swamped. Most tables hadn't been wiped down properly. More help came soon, and the service then actually went pretty smoothly.

I had the Lunch Special Burrito with beef tips. It was delicious. My wife tried her standard go-to, a chicken quesadilla. It was stuffed with shredded chicken with lots of taste and moistness. Again, a winner.

We found that the chips had a bit of a strange flavor, but not too bad.

The menu is huge, and if you like Mexican food, you're guaranteed to find something tempting. The things we ordered were well prepared and tasty.

Nice atmosphere. Overly nice and excited staff: everyone was happy and attentive! And get the plantains- those were yummy!

I must say, though, the food was fair. It tasted good but nothing excited. And the tacos were small. 
If you get their salad make sure to choose a different dressing because it taste like they just squirt limes on there as the dressing, which wasn't my thing.

Also it was pretty pricey for the drinks. The food prices were also a little high for my small taco.

And can someone ask what's with the chopsticks at the table? I thought it was Mexican?

If you're looking for cheap, authentic, and delicious tacos look no further! Lilly's is the best of the best for quick a easy dinner or lunch stop. I personally enjoy eating the beef cheek tacos! Each taco is less than three dollars and are totally worth it! I don't think you can get more bang for your buck. For anyone looking for street tacos this is your place! It's a very casual atmosphere with people going in and out quickly. They also have cilantro, onions, salsas and lime in a separate stand so you can self serve those which is always a bonus!

A group of us dined here on a Friday night, at a patio table. The view of Bourbon Street was fantastic. I ordered the beef brisket meal. The meat was cooked to perfection. It was very tender and had an incredible taste from the sauce. It also came with fries and cornbread cakes, which were totally delicious. The only downside of the meal was the waiter. We had a hard time understanding what he was saying, but his service was good. Not sure about all the bad reviews - we thoroughly enjoyed our meal and time here.

I have frequented this place several times recently (both eating there and take out), and each time have been very satisfied. Their seaweed salad and miso soup are both excellent choices. I don't always order tempura rolls, but I can't get enough of their shrimp tempura roll. And if you're in the mood for a more simple roll, the tuna roll is the way to go. 

If you choose to dine in, the atmosphere is intimate, but not crowded. And if you choose to do take out, the food is prepared quickly. This is always a solid choice for sushi.

Absolutely the worse hotel I have ever stayed in.  The staff was nice and the actual room was OK, but getting to your room you have to pass an incredible stench.  It smelled dirty and not worth the price.  As we arrived I looked to my daughter and said, "I'm not sure if i can do this" . It was that bad.  My recommendation would be to drive a little distance for a better hotel and not to stay here.  Also, they allow dogs, which normally is ok but one of the rooms had like 6 dogs in it and they were small but had a loud bark.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The Landing boasts some really nice views of the river, which is what drew us here. We sat on the patio and started out with the fig and goat cheese flatbread. It was good but a good portion of it was bare- I would've expected the toppings to have been more generous for $13. For mains, we tried the turkey BLT, hot pastrami, muffuletta and ahi tuna sandwich. Everything was average- good, but nothing to write home about.

It's a nice place to sit outside and have a drink, but next time I would probably dine elsewhere.

I went here for the first time today & got the $50 spa pedicure with Abby. The money was well worth it because of all the extras it came with. Parrafin wax, a few lotions, extra leg & foot massage (with hot stones) & the massage chair. I also got a back/shoulder massage as my toes were drying. The staff was very warm & friendly & the place is very clean & nicely decorated. They have many polish colors to choose from. My only complaint is that I made an appointment & they were ao buay I still had to wait 45 minutes. Other than that it was the best pedicure I've had in a long time & will definitely be back.

What a disappointing date night thanks to the landing. The landing has the perfect location, however time and time again the food service is subpar. We ordered food as soon as they took our drink order, thinking it wouldn't take too long. After watching at least 4 tables get served that came after us,  we asked them to check on our order. Someone who wasn't even our waiter returned with the food and our actual waiter never even came to apologize . In all, what should have been a relaxing date night turned out to be us waiting for an hour to eat (by the way we ordered salad and sandwich- neither of which takes too long to make)

Great restaurant. We ate in their dining room upstairs which was less noisy and crowded then the dining area on ground level.  Drinks were moderately strong. 

Their pizzas are tasty but not big enough to share between 4 people. We ordered the wild mushroom (it has goat cheese which melt perfectly against the mushrooms) and the Di Palma pizza. The Di Palma had a sweet balsamic glaze which even out the bitterness of the pound of arugula that was throw on top with some salty and delicious prosciutto. 

Both the pizzas and ambiance deserve two thumbs up!

So frustrated! After submitting an order via the Subway app, 3 of the 5 sandwiches we ordered ended up missing a significant number of requested ingredients. After going back to recheck the order we made, in case we had left out the ingredients ourselves, we saw that we had not. To give an example, we ordered a steak and cheese sub with lettuce, provolone, and mayo. We received a steak sub with no lettuce, cheese, or mayo. What a waste of money to get something not worth even eating!! We will have to make a point to go to a Subway further away in hopes they can get our order right.

Over priced for bland, disappointing food. The "carnitas" were not carnitas at all. They were small cubes of super dry pork that were pretty inedible.  The biggest disappointment was the enchiladas. Always my favorite, I've ordered them at pretty much every Mexican restaurant I've been to. They've varied between the different places, but never before have I had enchiladas that were sweet. The sauce truly tasted like it had sugar in it! This went past disappointing to land fully on gross! 

I can't fault the service or the cleanliness, but save yourself the money and the disappointment and keep driving to Taco Bell.

The service was excellent but the food wasn't. I had eggs benedict with country potatoes well done. The potatoes were so burnt, that they you couldn't chew them. They also were flavorless. The Canadian bacon on my Benedict was sliced ham with fat on the edges.Also flavorless... the redneck Benedict Was greasy and very Bland also. The bacon tasted like it sat in the window under a heat lamp for a few hours. But on the bright side my daughter ate all her chocolate chip pancakes and hash browns. Don't think we'll be back to this place in the near future.

I feel sorry for my drive-through cashier Catherine, because everything we ordered on the menu this McDonald's did not have in stock. I ordered a signature sandwich a chicken sandwich with guacamole and the new chicken tenders neither one was in stock. We settled with two McDoubles french fries and a Coke. French fries are cold two McDoubles are cold and thankfully are coke is cold. These poor kids having to work under these conditions is horrible for the McDonald Corporation! The frustration they must deal with on a daily basis is not made for children but made for a GM of a major corporation like this McDonald's you need to sharpen up!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It's pretty simple, if you're looking for a perfectly sparkling clean car wash, don't come here. If you want a quick, easy, cheap, and surprisingly GOOD wash for a drive through system, THIS is your spot! I love this place. I get the basic wash for 6 bucks and it does the job! I'm also a HUGE fan of the free do it yourself vacuums. This is a 5 star car wash in my eyes. Not for a perfect cleaning job, but for the convenience and price.. And the free vacuums! They also sell leather/interior wipes inside if you're looking to do a quick wipe down after you vacuum!

There are almost zero Chinese restaurants in St. Louis that are any good, to me. I never have bad food from Hunan Wok. It's not amazing but consistently good and that makes me happy. However, stepping into the place gets worse with every passing year. This time, it smelled funky and just looked unclean. The disgusting fish tank at the front doesn't help much either. Ick! Get rid of that nasty thing! Overall, I will take 1 hour out of my day to drive out to pick up food from Hunan Wok because I find the Chinese in St. Louis Hills to be absolutely disgusting.

Nice setting and ambiance. Enjoyed the scene more than the food. Food took forever to get to us. One patron even asked had anybody seen his food. I think most of the clients had a long wait. I had the loaded fries. The beer fondue was not good to me but my friends wings were a lot better. The fries were warm and a little soggy instead of crisp and hot. The bacon was decent. Only one waitress in a full restaurant. I won't order the loaded fries with beer fondue again because it definitely had me and my friend a little queasy.

The ice cream was very good. I had salted caramel and milk chocolate. The service, on the other hand, was painfully slow. There were about 10 people in front of me in line, and it took more than 30 mins to get through. There were only 2 people working, and a third employee was eating ice cream at the bar while distracting her coworkers. The line extended to 20+ people behind me during my wait, and the employees didn't seem to notice or care. One employee even dumped out the tip jar, counted it, put it back in, then came over and sampled 3 different ice creams herself before walking to the back ignoring all the customers. No urgency.

It's a McDonald's so it is what is. Nothing super amazing about the food and that is not a knock on McDonalds they are just known for serving the same food at all locations.

This review is more about the service. Every time I go to this McDonalds I have always had great service. I've been to a few others and the service was horrible.

My most recent visit I ordered and they were a little slow to get the order together, the girl at the window gave me a free large drink! Now I know that may not mean much to a lot of people but it did to me. The girl apologized and said have a nice day.

Good customer service
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Leslie is consistently rude. I visit this location once a month and somehow find her as my teller every time. No matter the day of the week or time of day, she is short and lacking in customer service skills. I came in just before the new rule for no cash deposits into someone's account for non-members and she didn't think to give me forewarning that I would need a cashier's check next time. My bank tells me that BofA is going to be replacing their tellers with machines in the coming years and I'm looking forward to something helping me that doesn't need an attitude adjustment like Leslie does.

Great bargin if youre lookijg to be near the parties and stay cheap. Hotel is an 8 dollar cab ride from downtown and a little less than a mile walk. We used hotwire to book and we were pleasantly surprised. Rooms were clean and came with a microwave and fridge. Out tv didnt work but for this trip we didnt care. We didnt make it to breakfast because it goes from 6 to 9. Air conditioned worked great and the pool was nice. Would recommend bringing your own shampoo and conditioner though theirs is the super cheap stuff. Would totally stay again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Had the short rib bento box, the short ribs were really tasty although they were very chewy and had a lot of fat which made it difficult to eat. The rest of the bento was delicious except for the seaweed salad. The chicken and shrimp kabobs were great. And same with the tempura. We order the pizza sushi to start and it was such a neat appetizer and I would def order it again! All in all I would be curious to go back again, but I wouldn't order the bento box. Also, the mandarin Cosmo? I think that's what it was called, was delicious

I have been a long time client of the Dr's when in Andorra. But I have had wrong or missing prescription in my latest glasses and I have referred people in the past year who have been unable to see out of the prescribed glasses! obviously they have changed labs or companies they send out to make glasses and I am very  disappointed in response of the staff to handle the  complaint! I am still waiting to hear back from them as to when my glasses that I paid in full will be in. Sorry to say very poor service this past year!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Came here after a long walk on the canal with the dog.  The place has a great atmosphere and lots of libations to choose from.  The service was incredibly slow and nothing over the top.  Our table had two sandwiches and it was 40 minutes before we got our orders.  The food was nothing to rave about. The me u had some good looking items but I would imagine they are all just as flavorless as our sandwiches.  I may come back again just because of the location and that I can end a dog walk here.  I would not come back for the great food or great service because both of those are non existent here.

I tried it the first time it was ok not bad.  I called the next time and I didn't get a greeting on the other line I thought I dialed the wrong number.  Nonetheless I place my order for 2 sesame
Chickens with white rice and a few egg rolls.  To my surprise when I picked up the food she automatically charged me for the quart size!  The bill came out to $28 and she whispers you can get a free bottle of soda if u want.  Im sorry but you should have asked me before upcharging me.  The food was bland this time and I am not impressed at all.  Vegetable egg roll was filled with oil

Easily the best vet in Santa Barbara. I bring both my dog and cat here and absolutely love the staff. I have never trusted a vet as much as I do this office. My animals vet, Hilary Quinn is the most caring and empathetic vet I have ever met. After my cat started acting weird I took her to VCA and they falsely diagnosed her with a pregnancy when she actually had Pyometra. Dr. Quinn was able to diagnose this and do the emergency spay very quickly. I would recommend this vet office to anyone and everyone. 

DEFINITELY take your animals here, we love them!

My wife and I stayed here for our 30th wedding anniversary.  Even though it's only a couple of blocks to edge of the downtown strip it's an "oasis" from the typical casinos.  No smoke filled slots, very clean, recently updated, exceptional rooms, nice view overlooking Truckee River, big open spacious bar and lounge area with both indoor and outdoor Bocce Ball Courts and if you want to have a drink and or snacks you can have one on a decks with fire feature beside the River.  Will definitely stay here next time and try the food and bar.  And the bed was one of the most comfortable I've slept on in past decade.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not a very happy first time experience. After an hour of waiting for our table, almost half of our food was forgotten about. We had to get up and ask someone where it was. Food wasn't that great, the best thing was probably the miso soup. When we reminded them about the food we were missing they didn't seem like they knew what we were talking about and at that point we didn't even want it. Waited another 30-40 min for our check, something else we had to get up and ask for. For a Sunday night, it was even that busy. Very disappointing, probably won't be coming back.

These guys can't do math.  I have been here 8 times and every time paid cash but got the wrong amount of change back (always too little).  I am beginning to think that the whole crew must be doing it on purpose. The first time I gave $10.43 when the bill was $5.43 expecting $5 back but they gave me $1.00.  And every time after little screw ups with the change.  It's hard to screw up coffee, but apparently very easy to screw up giving the right amount of change back. If you go here and pay cash, count your change.

Prices are fair, got a good quantity of sashimi for $50.  Quality is unbeatable, fish was all great.  They will hold off on the fish you don't like (mackerel), add more of what you like (white tuna).  Added in a soft shell crab roll that was well worth $8.50.  Overall, an amazing restaurant for the quality of the food.  Good "reward card" also, where you get 5% for future use.  Just realize that this place is very popular and therefore, will be crowded every day of the week during dinner.  This is a necessity for a good sushi restaurant though, how else would they be able to provide fresh fish everyday?

My dog has been a patient at Hope for many years. His cardiologist, Dr. Ellen Davison, is amazing. She is knowledgeable, thorough, personable, and sensitive to my dog's needs and my needs. She explains everything thoroughly and takes time with us and I couldn't ask for better. 

He also had major surgery at Hope done by Dr. Brian Bretz, and he was also phenomenal. 

The facility itself and the staff - both reception and the nurses - are professional and accommodating.

I highly recommend Hope. It is not inexpensive but I fully believe that you get what you pay for.

Josephine is very convenient for us, we walk from the house. My first thought was it is a little bright in there for a "fancy" restaurant. Wine list was not very exciting. None the less, we enjoyed our night there. The fried oyster appetizer was quality, but we were really disappointed in the crab dip app.. very average. I had the hanger steak, it was quite good. Others at the table described their Pork Schnitzel and Salmon entrees as "good but not memorable". Best thing in the table were the Brussel Sprouts, would absolutely those again. Most entrees priced high $20's - low 30's. I forget our servers name, but he was very good.

I love this gym but the weight floor here is so frustrating. There are very few machines and limited space for free weights. No matter the time of day, there are always 20+ people in the very small weight area upstairs and it always feels like you're in someone's way. At first I thought maybe I was coming at peak times but nope. I've come here 8 am on Monday, 1 pm on Wednesday, 3 pm on Thursday, etc trying to figure out if there's a down time. There's not. However, it's nice that there are always open treadmills and ellipticals.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I went here tonight for about the third time. 

While the service is by no means speedy and the atmosphere is certainly something I have never experienced anywhere else (I often feel as if I am inside someone's very compartmentalized house), the food is good. 

I recommend getting the fried chicken with seasoned fries. Add in some hot sauce to your chicken, and you are in for a good meal. The cod is also decent.

The food is inexpensive, and the service is friendly. It hasn't been around for so long because of luck.

I had been to a couple of different places in the neighborhood and spent over $400 trying to figure out WHY my car kept randomly dying.  No one knew, they would keep it for days, and everyone kept trying to sell me more stuff I didn't need.

I had seen Everything Automotive being built/re-done this past year, so I figured I would give them a shot and drove my car straight there when it died on me again.  

They were polite, got me right in, called when it was done (Same day!), let me pay over the phone, and it turned out to be a easy and cheap fix! 

I definitely found my new mechanic!

Service was pretty subpar, aside from consistent water refills from the greeter. We were essentially acknowledged at the beginning, when we got our food, and well after we were ready for our check. After being dissatisfied with what I ordered I decided to send it back, an extreme rarity in my life. I was charged for said item, which while not entirely surprising, definitely did not add to the experience I had. The second meal, the beef soba, I got was far better and is the only reason the restaurant receives an additional star.

So disappointing and UNDERwhelmed.  I came to celebrate my 40th birthday with my family for their Feast of the Seven Fishes...although the menu SOUNDED fantastic and mouth-watering, all of the courses began to taste the same - OVERLY salted and citrused!  Bleck!  In addition, our service was sub-par...each server simply plopped the family-style dish on the table and walked away without explaining one single thing about the course - and there were multi-courses!  Chef Marcie Turney and her partner Valerie Safran should be ashamed of themselves...charging $50/person for what we experienced...and dessert wasn't even offered!  Skip this place!

Had a terrible experience at the Midas right down the street before coming here, the workers there didn't even greet me for about 10 minutes and once greeted the worker had a bad attitude and was rude. You can't trust someone who doesn't even respect you with your car. I left and went to Jiffy Lube and had a great experience.They get you in and out and are very informative, they let you know everything going on with your car. They even vaccumed out my passenger side. Don't go to Midas go to Jiffy Lube around the corner. You're welcome.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Pleasant, bright space with tables and couches . . .  coffee was good . . . service somewhat inept: tall trans gender woman dumps change in your hand with no "thank you" or eye contact, and Barista had no place to set my coffee mug down, so that I could pick it up by the handle - instead she has her finger in the tiny handle and tries to make me grab the body of the cup, and I was afraid it would be so hot that I'd drop it and spill coffee everywhere - eventually she figured out that she should put the cup on a saucer to resolve the mini standoff.

Ordered from here for the first time last night. Place is nice inside. Ordered a tomato pie, surprised to find unlike other places they don't put any cheese under the sauce. Very disappointing! It was literally just a pizza crust with sauce. The sauce was good though. Ordered a white pie with tomato and garlic. That was nothing special cheese tasted cheap and ricotta is extra. Also had mozzerella sticks but they were your ordinary boxed variety. Going to try this place once more just to see how their regular cheese pizza is.

I can't give negative stars. 

Went into McDonalds at 7:05 pm to get 2 ice cream cones. Told that the machine was down and had to wait 20 minutes for the machine. At 8:40 pm we are told (after paying) that the machine will be down until tomorrow. Then he has the ... uhhh... and asks us if we wanted something else. SERIOUSLY? We couldn't get our money back?!? 

So, husband got 3 apple pies. Yeah. Riiiight. They were so over cooked they were CRUNCHY. Congealed insides and crunchy outside.

I'd like an hour of my LIFE BACK... covered in chocolate please!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Not a bad hotel. I booked a 2bd, 2bt suite with a living room. You can definitely sleep a lot of people in this room. One of the bedrooms had 2 queen beds with a bathroom, the other room had 1 queen bed with a bathroom, and the living room had a sleeper sofa. Breakfast was also included. 

Cons: Fire the electrician who designed the room. Light switches were on the outside of the bathroom. I plugged in a battery to charge, and it blew the breaker and shut down 1/2 the rooms lights. Some of the small details in the room and hotel need attention/updating. 

Overall I got a good deal on a mini apartment.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I was so skeptical about the quality of ice cream from a place called "Daddy O's" but the saying is true- "Don't judge a book by its cover." I walked in on a Saturday afternoon and was greeted by a fantastic assortment of ice cream of every possible candy creation kind: Reese's pieces, birthday cake, cherry, strawberry, vanilla, chocolate, etc. 

I had the regular birthday cake scoop in a cup (3 scoops to be exact) and it was heavenly! My bf had the strawberry with sprinkles in traditional nostalgic kid fashion. Needless to say, we both left extremely happy!

Enjoyed dinner here a few nights ago but it didn't quite live up to hype that 2 of my family members gave Limoncello. Service was somewhat uneven - our water glasses were constantly refreshed but dirty dishes remained on the table. The window in the front was dirty and had flies on it. Had to wait for the check after we were obviously done eating. My New York strip tasted bland. Waitress was very attentive to the younger members of our party. La Bombe dessert was excellent.  I was glad to be able to sit and catch up with family members but the overall experience was just average for me.

Great atmosphere, food, and service!  Quality, fresh ingredients make some incredible and unique tacos.  Fried oyster taco and falafel taco are to die for.  Avocado taco that was the special for the day was outstanding as well.  Tacos are small but well priced for the quality, you can order as your hunger dictates through the meal.  Fresh guacamole and salsa verde with fried but not greasy tostadas were excellent.  Freshly squeezed juices used in great cocktails and nicely balanced margaritas.  This place is yummy and Zac and Javier were great.

Came here for happy hour after work with about 10 co-workers. You'd think such a big table would have more enthusiastic service from the wait staff, but our server was scarce for much of the evening, and it was like pulling hens' teeth to get her attention for refills or other requests. One in our party ordered a burger & wanted mustard with it. No mustard on any of the tables. Who does that???.. & finally another in our party left the table to hunt down our server to request mustard. We ordered nachos and chicken fingers to share off the appetizer menu. Nachos were meh. Chicken fingers were perfectly flavorless.

Prepaid for the rental car. When I turned the car back in, a day early at that, was told at the desk to leave the keys I was good to go. Turned out they charged me $105 for filling up the car with 10 gallons of gas when I returned the car completely full. When I called and asked questions, the branch manager told me my questions were ridiculous! I don't think it is ridiculous to want proof when I have the proof I filled the car up minutes before turn in. Needless to say, do not rent from here. It is a rip off and customer service is horrible!

Stay away.  Not business friendly.  Not flexible.  GM Brian Medlin cannot and will not accommodate business travels.  Our company books on average 8 hotels a week through a 3rd party pre pay format.  About a 1/3 of those are Holiday inns.  99% of the time, all hotels work with us on refunding cancellation within a certain time frame.  Brian will not.  I have a room booked on 2-16-17 all ready paid for.  He will not credit us for this room that we are not using.

Thanks to Brian Medlins efforts, we will not longer book any Holiday Inns.

It must be nice to be able to afford to lose repeat customers.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I grew up eating from this place and as much as I enjoyed their food, it paled in comparison to "China Wok", which is located in Croydon Manor.

Furthermore, years ago I purchased some lo mein and found a piece of steel in it--I shit you not. I was flabbergasted. I approached the management with this ordeal and they approached this situation as if it were an ordinary thing; not only did they refuse to give me a refund for my meal, they simply just threw out the piece of steel and expected me to finish my order. Yuck! Can't trust them on that one.

Won't be returning. Go to China Wok in Croydon Manor instead.

Doesn't quite look good on the inside or outside but the food was good. They used a lot of soy sauce so I had to tell the chef to scale back on mine. I wasn't impressed with the initial level of service upon arrival because it took them a while to seat us but once we arrive at the hibachi station they served us immediately.  The hibachi chef was entertaining and still full of energy despite the late hour. I probably would have rated a 4 if the hostess was a little bit more responsive and friendlier. The place could also use some updates.

OK, let's talk about the good.
There has been a chef hired for the past few years who has made DRASTIC improvements to the food.  I've had cheese steaks, cuban sandwiches, chicken sandwiches, and of course, their world-famous Dreek Fries (what I call their cheese fries) which are some of the best in the industry.
The bad?  Not too much.  They often run out of the "nicer" beers (i.e. Victory or Sam Adams Seasonal) and the "female companion" once had a so-so salad.  Other than that the atmosphere is great and we've happily come to this jewel many times.  Actually, I miss this place a lot.  It's great.

Vincent's is a New Orleans institution. 

The service is quick and efficient. The food is delicious. Vincent's has breadsticks on the table, and all of the food is delicious. The chicken parmesan is well done without being drowned in breading. The pasta is really good.

For dessert, the bread pudding is amazing. It is one of the best bread puddings I have had in the city. The cannoli is also quite tasty.

My only complaint is the restaurant is somewhat small and has tables packed together really closely without much aisle space for the waiters/waitresses to walk in between.

The pizza here is good, but the menu is relatively small and so are the pizzas. They are about 12 inches in size and wouldn't be able to feed more than two people. This would be fine except the pizzas themselves are pretty overpriced for being so small - around $16 or so.

My group of 5 ordered the Legend, Thriller and Margherita pizzas. All decent but nothing over-the-top amazing. In addition to the pizza, I got the white peach sangria which was delicious. 

I'd say this place is worth a try, but there are other pizza places in St. Louis that are better.

I have had nothing but satisfaction at this new location. Quick, efficient, never messed up an order. Today however, is a different story. The drinks were satisfactory, sure. But what came through the straw of one of our drinks was appalling. What I thought was maybe a remnant of blueberry was in fact a piece of rubber. It was the most unsanitary thing I have seen from a Starbucks. I sincerely hope this was a one off and nobody else at this store encountered such. We will not be coming back to this particular Starbucks that is just minutes from my home.

I stopped in here for a couple of slices on Thursday evening - cold and rainy, just wanted something quick to take back to NJ with me. I ordered 2 regular slices and an interesting square slice, with tomatoes and cheese.  I'll assume it was the owner (?) that slipped in a couple of other slices, on the house (it wasn't even closing time!), and it was greatly appreciated.

What was MORE appreciated was the taste; good pizza, guys!!  SO many pizza joints out there, it all starts to taste the same after a while.  If you like thin crust, gooey cheese, and fresh sauce, go to La Villa!   Can't wait to go back and try a sandwich or a meal.

I came in for an oil change tire rotation. Got home and had oil in my driveway. My husband looked under my car to find the oil drain plug barely screwed. I could have possibly lost my car and damage my engine!!!! It's very hard to recommend a company that can cost you thousands of dollars in careless mistakes.  

I went in and they reviewed my recording and made it right. They apologized and did the right thing. I would still have to say this mistake could have very costly if my oil leaked out more than what did.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I don't really expect much from McDonald's it's pretty common for something to go wrong because it's just fast food but it's a waste of my money when multiple things go wrong! I ordered a Diet Coke and got a Dr.pepper with zero ice, while handing my ice cream cone to me the workers hand was all in the ice cream, I didn't get any ranch, and they hadn't closed my nugget box and had put my French fries in upside down so all of my food was just chilling on the bottom of the bag. It also took about 30 minutes to get through the drive through. This isn't the first problem I've had at this location! I recommend going to a different one.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is my favorite hotel in Edmonton.  Sister company to Matrix which is located downtown and Varscona a little further down whyte. One of the only boutique hotels in Edmonton.  The complimentary wine and cheese every evening is amazing.  The hotel is a little older but it's clean and close to whyte ave which is the busiest part of Edmonton.  The staff is always friendly and courteous.  It can be a little loud on the weekend so ask for a room facing the back and not whyte ave.  I would highly recommend staying here if you are in town for a short trip, as you can really explore the best part of the city without needed a vehicle or taxi!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Yum!!! I love this place! It has a really nice vibe and tons of drink options. Really unique cocktails and great beer. I got the shrimp and butternut squash Mac and cheese. Wow it was so delicious. My boyfriend got a burger and that was also very good. We have come here for brunch as well. I enjoyed this spot for dinner more but the brunch was fun and offered lots various options. Lastly, the service is always really great. Very good servers and knowledgeable about the menu. My only complaint is that it's a little pricey which keeps me from going more often but overall it's worth it

This is a very nice HIE.  It is only a couple years old and the rooms are very nicely decorated.  Most importantly the beds are comfortable and clean.  I have stayed at this location multiple times and have always had a great experience.

The location is convenient if you have a morning flight without worries about traffic. 

There are good restaurants within a five minute drive of the hotel.  The only thing to be mindful of, certain weeks may be booked and room rates jump due to activities at the nearby university.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Decided to grab some sushi in Philly and chose to go to Kabukiza Sushi, conveniently located near my hotel. Of course I had to try the signature of the city, the Philidelphia Roll, and grabbed one of the chefs specials, the Marriott Roll. Service was great, and pretty fast, and the sushi was delicately prepared and extremely delicious. Very fresh tasting and perfectly proportioned. Left feeling very satisfied and will surely return if I'm in Philly again. Price was decent, ate for under $20 and it was worth it.

This place inside Reading Terminal Market is always busy and I got to go there for lunch one day and it was very .. average. 

I got the roasted duck wonton soup with a duck roll appetizer I wasn't too impressed with the duck. My duck in the roll had a taste that I wasn't too fond of .. kind of sour a little .. but the duck in my soup was fine. 

They definitely have a lot of options so I will try the other entrees before giving this place a solid rating. 

According to other Yelp reviews, they have an actual restaurant outside of Reading so maybe going there would be more worth it!

Don's is the best auto repair shop in Philadelphia. His prices are fair, the service is speedy, and the work completed is top notch. My favorite part about this place is that Don is upfront and honest about what your car needs. My boyfriend took his old beater in and Don told him the repairs cost more than the car was worth and he wouldn't rip him off and complete the work. I have been taking my car to him for years and he never over charges or does repair work that isn't needed. I attribute my 2007 100thousand mile car running as well as it does to Don.

The place can only seat 14 at a time so be prepared to wait. I like the interior, it's quaint and smartly designed. Clean as well. 
The food is a bit pricey. We tried the calzone and three different types of pizza. The calzone was my fav this particular day. Crust is good, fresh ingredients. The red sauce is ok. One of our pizzas was a white pizza with sausage, broccoli rabe and mozz. The sausage was very mild. Unimpressive. And the broccoli rabe was slimy and kind of gross. 

Other than that it was good. Not great, but good.

We did all you can eat (max one hour). I am not impressed with the service or the food. The sushi place is small (inside a Mexican restaurant). It fits about 24 ppl max! We (4ppl) got seated right when they opened for lunch. I would recommend coming early if you want to try this place. The chef started taking our orders right away, which was great. Our server took about 15 min-ish to come by to take our drinks order. We asked for miso soup, but didn't get it until we almost done eating. The only service we got was from our chef. We tipped him directly!

On a trip, I needed a rental car in an urgent situation, just for local travel for a day. I called the reservation number to see if they had anything available - sure did, and I gave them all the details, address, driver's licence number, etc. I got to the Enterprise site 15 minutes later and  they said oh sorry we don't have a car available, nothing at all, we were going to call. 
If they had just said no right away, okay. But the availability for a rental should have been accurate, they wasted a half hour of my time on a difficult day.

Was there last evening, very beautiful, met with sales manager Danny
gave some tips on how to improve their marketing....need a billboard or on side of hotel, which can be easily seen from Rte 95...telling interested parties HOW to get to hotel

Once you get there you will be extremely happy, wonderful Ha hr and social hour, wine and beer heavily discounted, especially on Weds 5:30-7:30pm
clientele business and airline

Let them know Elaine recommended!

Only reason not 5 Stars a little complicated to get there
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We always get take out from here 2-3 times per month. The soups and dinners are always good but, last night we just wanted to have fresh rolls (Vietnamese) with our salad. I was very disappointed, took a bite and the wrapper completely fell apart with all the chunks falling into my Greek salad. Then, on the 2nd bite I tasted what felt like a wet, mushy flavorless piece of meat, turns out to be the shrimp! And the chicken was definitely OVER boiled in water. I picked them both out and squeezed them and all water. For $5.25 per 2 piece order I was expecting GREAT rolls. I hope next time will be better as this is our go to take out joint.

Decent hotel, served as a good home base, but kind of dated and nothing too special. Kind of small room, and a nearly non-existent window. However, this place was much cheaper than comparable hotels, and it was worth the savings.

The good was that they had a water bottle refill station, and great front desk staff who had good recommendations for us. The lobby space was also very nice.

Discount on the parking across the street, but i'd still recommend using Spot Hero, because it's probably still going to be cheaper.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Very good fresh sushi.  Portions were a little on the small size, especially given the fact they are a little pricey.

I got a rainbow roll, (had many that are better).  They do the minced mayo based imitation crab filler (not a fan).

I also got the Geisha Kiss, not too bad, but the cucumber wrapper was overwelming so you only tasted cucumber.  I ended up peeling most of mine off.

The Puff Daddy was decent.  The fried crawfish were so-so.

Overall, decent sushi, but nothing to write home about.  And for what you are getting, they are smaller portions and on the high side for $$$.

In town for business and we were recommended this place by the hotel. As soon as we walked in they asked if we had a reservation. When I said no, the guy rolled his eyes and asked why not! If it wasn't for the fact we were starving we would've walked out. The food came less than 5 min after ordering. I had the spaghetti Carbonera. It tasted like someone boiled noodles, tossed a stick of butter and some eggs in. Was not good at all. Place is small and cramped but kinda of neat little place. I wouldn't recommend going here if you want good Italian food. It's mediocre and service isn't good at all.

This hotel is conveniently located within walking distance of the Convention Center and offers amenities that are expected at a Westin, including valet service, and fantastic rooms with outstanding views. 

I believe they missed out on an opportunity to wow us, however, when we returned later in the evening and asked about room service at the desk, only to be told that there was a function earlier and no more food was available! Not even a suggestion was offered as to where to go to find something, let alone an attempt to do something as simple as look up the number for local pizza delivery!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This property is well located for business and shopping. The rooms are nice and clean. They are updated. The beds are comfortable. The AC is quiet. It does blow on you though in bed. That's a problem...
The shower is nice. It needs more places to put stuff though. There was little to no noise from outside. The club level food is average. The pool is average to small.
Housekeeping has some problems...
The breakfast downstairs is average.
There are several excellent restaurants very best by this hotel. They probably deserve 4 stars but housekeeping needs work ...
Worth a look...
Have fun.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Don't go here! It's good food but it's over priced and the manager (I think that's her title?) is extremely rude and unprofessional. I had a small issue to discuss with her and she avoided my phone calls for a week. Finally she responded by TEXTING me, I guess I'm not worth her time. She said I should "push my luck" by calling so much. I was reasonable and I did not use any kind of offensive laguage but she didn't want to hear it and her last text to me was, "This conversation is over." Don't support people like this. There are so many great restaurants, I will never take anyone here again.

I want to love this store because of the concept, location, and focus on prepared foods....BUT the location is now the only winner after a few months of shopping here. Last week I tried to order a sandwich and they didn't have the Roast beef to make it. I settled on a pre-made roast beef sandwich that was labeled turkey. Half of the refrigerated shelves are empty, which is weird because that is prime grocery real estate, and they have Boar's Head, totally over Boars Head ABF their 120 options forced on you.  It's also pricier than Rouses, comes in handy when u run out of tp but they've made it difficult for everyday shopping.

Every month my parents drive from Media to come here to eat with me. Nick, the owner, always fusses over us. He always makes sure that the food is top notch. The prices are very reasonable for the portions you get. I almost always get the New York Strip, but have had the pork chops too and all very delicious. I had a burger today for lunch and let me tell you for just under 12 bucks, it was one of the best bacon cheeseburgers I ever had. LARGE beef patty tons of cheese and fries. Would recommend this place any day or time. They also have a happy hour with drink specials and free food.

Rooms are clean and updated from previous posts I've read as far as technology goes. Only thing I would focus on is fixing the drain for the shower.

The reason for -2 stars. The breakfast is below average and not worth waking up for. Also, the maids need a better process and communication on what rooms to attend to. The maid woke us up at 7 knocking at the door only to realize it was the wrong room. THEN at 1030AM when we haven't even checked out yet, they attempted to open the door to come in. 

My advise lock your door at all times and bring your own food for breakfast.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I give it a 3 because the food is phenomenal. I've given this place so many chances but every time im met with piss poor service. I only ever sit at the bar. This last time I ordered the tuna poke, the pork belly tacos & the duck tacos. My poke & pork belly tacos come out with a mushroom taco, taken care of immediately probably got my duck taco in 3 minutes, however there was a bone or some hard substance in my duck taco. Strange? Always takes me forever to get a drink, the cocktails are yummy the food is great I just can't get over the poor service. Hopefully if I try table service things will get better.

I must say I was a bit skeptical walking into this place but to my surprise it's a cool little restaurant. They have some great drink deals through you the week like Wednesday is half off bottle of wine and $4 lug beers. The all of their the menus are huge: beer, wine and food. The club sandwich was delicious and i have the clam chowder as a side. I wouldn't not recommend the clam chowder is was not good at all. The spinach melt honestly has to be the best the on the menu. This is a good little unique place to try it one night.

I've been looking for a salon that understands and knows the techniques of coloring blonde hair. After several unpleasant visits to other salons in town, I was THRILLED when a friend recommended Jason, from Cowboys and Angels Salon. Jason (the salon owner) has extensive experience with color and highlights. He transformed my brassy, overprocessed blonde hair into a beautiful, golden blonde - complete with highlights. I have never been happier! Jason does the best color in town, by far! I love getting my hair done with him so much that I see him every 3 weeks! :) Def. stop by! The customer service is great as well. :)

The food here is pretty standard Chinese takeout. Nothing that outstanding. I ordered beef ho fun, beef with string beans, Szechuan wontons, and General Tso's tofu, and fried chicken wings. The beef ho fun was really overcooked. The noodles were all mushy, and the beef was really chewy. The Szechuan wontons weren't spicy at all but was just really salty. The General Tso's tofu and beef with string beans were just okay. The chicken wings were good though. Was hoping to find my go-to Chinese takeout spot, but sadly no.

2 stars is generous... We work across the street from Opry Mills, so we ran over to Friday's, instead of going downtown, to save time. We should've gone downtown... it didn't look very busy, so we were really expecting a quick lunch. But we ended up waiting about an hour for our food. No excuse. Our server Quinton was great, but whoever is managing that kitchen is terrible. There were 3 of us, and one of the entrees was actually cold. The rest of the food was good. Too bad that quality food is dramatically overshadowed by experience-ruining service.

I don't know which reason I go to Nicey Treat more for.... the smiles or the treats.

Any summer/spring day you are sure to see a grinning dog/person loitering around the outside of the building with a scrumptious frozen treat in hand (or paw), which draws me in right away. I originally tried this irresistible goodness at the BRipp farmers market before the brick and mortar version existed. Don't miss this local treat! 


Faves: Key Lime Pie 
            Pistachio (dipped in dark chocolate for extra     decadence)

The food is okay. They don't serve margaritas, which kind of kills the whole Mexican food vibe. They do have beer.
The service was pretty bad. The waitress could use some training. After she brought me my food, which wasn't right, she never came back to check on me (so it wasn't made right). She was nice but I'm not sure she knows how to do her job well.
This has the potential to be a good place. Right now it feels like they aren't ready to be open, although they opened two months ago. Definitely need to add margaritas and work on the customer service piece. Will try again in a few months.

I LOVE this place, I've lived in Philly for 5 years and it's by far the best chinese place I've gone to.  I don't remember a time when the food hasn't been good there, although I usually stick to a couple of favorites.  The lo mein (varying kinds) always tastes like it has been cooked and mixed up fresh, and the general tso's (which is my favorite chinese) is great....a little spicy, but not overboard, and the chicken is never overcooked.  I've ordered from here on multiple occasions and still haven't had a time when it's bad or even subpar.  Make it your new chinese spot!

Yep, we're talking old school America Chinese food. Lots of sweet and sour oozed on meat of your choosing. Feels like your stepping back 30-40 years when you walk in. Biggest problem I have is No Beer??? The food quality stands out as fresh and not from a can veggies. Different take on egg flower soup which isn't complimentary but the kid said it was the besstest ever. Huge servings and I know some say it be greasy is all get out. I asked after and server says they use a lil MSG which gives that grease like sheen but you can order it without which you might like a little more and probably leaves a more natural flavor after taste

Didn't like this hotel. I normally love holiday Inn express. There are no stairs and the elevator is wicked slow. The guy that checked me in was really hard to hear because he mumbled the whole time. He was also very slow moving and was eating at the front desk. The rooms felt cramped and the bathroom door would not close unless you did it just right. The a/c worked for half of the room but the other half was hot, odd because it was a small room. It cost about $30 per night to park the car.

However, it was in a good location as a 15-20 minute walk brings you to the French Quarter. Breakfast was fine as well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is located inside a service plaza travelling on the turnpike I76W.     Have stopped here multiple times but always found it to be one of the worst ones. Service is very slow and they take their own time in attending to the customers. I had only two people in front of me and I had to wait 15 minutes for my order of two cups of coffee. The coffee was also not good and was not even hot on top of it. They are even slower when they're busy. Have a bunch of snacks also including nuts, snack bars, Madeline cakes etc. to choose from. Avoid it if you can.

Was kind of intimidated to go in, mostly because straight guys kind of make me feel weird. I did a 9am walk-in and was able to be seen at 11. It's a busy shop, so plan ahead. I ran a few errands and came back a half hour early, had a beer and chilled. Also, they keep the a/c on blast which is such a redeeming quality in an establishment, in my opinion. I got Amber. She was extremely personable and chill and understood exactly what I wanted. Service was great, atmosphere was great, cut was amazing. It's affordable and you get what you pay for. I feel so good with this fresh cut. Thank you! I will be back in two weeks!

If all hotels around me were not booked, I would ditch the $103 I paid here and move.  I'm certain that if any health department bothered to come in, it would be shut down.  Filthy carpeting, dingy sheets and towels (I've lined the bed with towels choosing the lesser of two vile things). The back door entrance is OMG functional but the brass handle is broken off so you see the metal innards.  Least on my list is the attitude of the front desk person which was zip. Mine would be as well if so worked here. I'm grossed out!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My husband and I stayed here during our recent stay and have to say the location is outstanding. We were able to easily access all of the attractions around us. The noise wasn't too bad and did not keep us up at night, although they do give you ear plugs in case you are sensitive to sound at night. It's an older building but had everything we needed. The front desk was great, incredibly friendly! We would have liked the restaurant attached to be open longer, and the tv to maybe be slightly closer to our bed. But other than that, no complaints and would stay again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I see many negative reviews about the quality dropping as new owners took over. For myself I just started eating here so I can't truly compare. I will say though for the oldsmar area they are hands down the best restaurant that delivers to my office. The deliveries are usually pretty quick and you can't beat the lunch combos for around $4. The wonton soup is definitely their best soup and the spicy cashew chicken is always solid. Going to be ordering from them today. All in all - very convenient and well worth the price. More than fair.

I definitely recommend Battle Born Eye Care. The staff and provider were kind, helpful and went out of their way to answer any and all of my questions. They all took the time to make sure I was comfortable with the process, along with explaining insurance and determining what would be the best deal for me. I felt like a priority, rather than just someone that they wanted to get in and out. This was especially amazing since I was a 5:00 pm appointment. I plan on continuing to use Battle Born Eye Care and referring all of my friends and family.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I'd love to review the food but it never showed up. After 40 minutes we got a glass of water only no refills. We asked for chips. They never showed up. Other tables arriving 20 minutes after us had chips.  Finally we asked again and was told our food would be on the way in "maybe 15 minutes" the restaurant was woefully understaffed. The food we saw  seemed nice.  I would have liked to have tried it.   I'm not certain how a business with such extreme poor service will be able to stay in business in this town.

My pregnant wife had a very specific list of donuts (and backup choices) she wanted from Dunkin Donuts.

On a Saturday morning at 9am it was very busy and apparently this particular location did not anticipate people wanting donuts on a Saturday morning because they had about 50% of her list. No glazed munchkins, no strawberry with sprinkles, no strawberry, nothing with any form of pink frosting whatsoever, and no powdered munchkins.

Not sure how a donut shop forgets to make donuts? I can't imagine this was the first Saturday morning they experienced an influx of donut eaters.

If you have a vision prescription that is not from Spectrum Vision Care, the glasses will be subpar, no matter what you pay.  The people who we interface with when ordering glasses are no trained properly and are not Optometrists.  

When I picked up my glasses the vision was blurred.  I told the person and she told me, "No it is not".  The person did zero adjustments on the frame fitting, proper alignment of lenses, etc.  She just walked away.  They can just blame the problem on someone outside the office.  The premium Essilor lenses provide much less vision detail as standard lenses.  

This is not an ophthalmologist office.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I literally drove to McDonalds because I wanted fresh cookies. 

I pulled up to the speaker and the girl told me we can only order from a few items because they were closing soon. I asked if they had fresh cookies the girl said "uhhhh yeah we do". So I said fine I'll take 10 fresh cookies. I pull up to the window the Asian girl hands me a bag of HOT cookies. I mean burning hot! She didn't give me fresh cookies she microwaved the cookies! I tried them they were disgusting. I called to complain to the manager and the girl told me to call back in the morning because she was already off the clock. 

What a joke. Hire decent people!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I did a comparison taste test between this place and my usual sushi place. The best quality is not as good, the tases really lacking.  I didn't even finish the megu sushi.  I compared tuna roll, salmon roll, spider roll.  

Beyond fish quality is rice quality.  The rice at Asuka is more flavorful.  Texture is better too. 

Everything at Asuka sushi was better.

Megu offers uni and toro, which I did not get.  So this review is based on the more standard fare.

If you don't believe this review, I encourage you to try both side by side and let me know what you think.

We live right down the street from Mosaic Cafe and have dined in the restaurant and picked up food to go on many occasions. Over the last couple of years, it seems like the quality of food has gone down and the portions have gotten smaller while the prices have gone up. We picked up an order to go tonight and we were very disappointed. The serving of beans that came with the entrees was very small. The cheese crisp also seemed smaller than the last time we ordered and seemed overpriced at $8.00 for a plain cheese crisp. I think this we will be last time that we order food/dine at Mosaic, which is unfortunate because it is so close.

Great food with slow service on a busy holiday night made for a bad experience.  It was a busy Labor Day Monday so I get it that service might be a little slow. But I can't understand the wait for soup and salad. My families food didn't come for 1hr45mins or the wait for like 15 mins when I drank all my water wanted a refill. 

Food was good, no question about that. Service though sucked. They forgot the honey mustard on my kids chicken fingers. No big deal for an adult but for a kid, a problem. And forgot the extra mayo on the side for my son's turkey hoagie. And the flys. Sorry but I didn't order flys.

Unfortunately, I ordered via grub hub twice, and the food was inedible both times. Note that I had worked long nursing shifts both times, I was exhausted and starving to death, but both times the food was gross, and I mean stomach turning. I am the least picky eater of anyone I know. The mushroom with burnt bread crumbs almost made me throw up. The garlic mashed potatoes had no flavor. The eggplant Parmesan was just ok. I only ate about an 8th of my food and this is very unlike me. I won't be saving the leftovers for later either.

The Hotel was nicely kept and located central to all of our needs ..The Roof top Pool was awesome.. Complimentary Breakfast was always fresh..hot and fully stocked. Coffee was fresh and a nice " Perk ". The Staff was friendly..some were a little rough around the edges but nothing too abrasive . The bathroom are kinda small but it makes up for it with room size and sink is located on the exterior side of the bathroom . There is a microwave and Fridge ..plenty of outlets ...Coffee maker..Iron and ironing board.We definitely will be coming back to stay . Safe Travels .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Years ago,  I caught the ultra high gloss red paint of Los Betos as I was driving down Fairview and my heart fluttered as I hit the breaks.  I knew this was a distant cousin of the corner hole in the wall Mexican restaurants that grace every corner of my old home in San Diego.  Alas, Los Betos does not stack up to many of the super gloss painted hole in the walls all over San Diego (Cotixan, Santanas...).  However, this is Boise, Idaho and if you are in the market for some rolled tacos con guacamole or a Carne Asada Burrito that will knock you on the couch, then this is as good as you are going to get.  Yo me gusta Los Betos

Just finished a nice meal at CDB's and it was a good experience. The best part was the food, which is the best anyone can hope for at a restaurant. We ordered the Meat Lovers and the Bacon pizza along with a giant salad. Both pizzas were great and the salad was very unique. The downside was the darkness of the restaurant. I expected a bear to crawl out of a corner of the restaurant from hibernation at any point. So dark! Mix in a lamp or two. The wait staff was not overly friendly, but did get everything we asked for and took care of a bad soda mix for us. The price is a bit heavy, but not too far off base.

not very impressed.

our server was very nice, but the pizza was awful- overall watery and flavorless. on each of our pizzas, it literally looked as though there was water sitting on it- and it tasted like... not much. ingredients were not good either, did not seem high quality at all. there was also a super cheesey duo singing super cheesey songs uncomfortably close to us- not comfortable. 

and for an appetizer, two pizzas (single entree size), and two glasses of wine, we spent almost $75 with tip. not even close to being worth it- i wish we would have just waited at Mafiosza's instead of going here. will not be back.

Not worth the money. 
I have yet to find a great Japanese restaurant in SB, and this place was alright. If you're dying for Japanese food, this place might be a bit better than the other places, but you'll be paying a lot for average quality food. 
During lunch, my bf and I ordered three dishes (chicken katsu, one baked roll, and vegetable udon) and it came out to $50. There was nothing special about these dishes, so it was a bummer that the cost was so high. 
I won't be coming back, unless I really really craved some Japanese food.

This sounds crazy, but this is actually still one of my favorite places to get pizza! It's relatively fast and it's cheap! I like that they have so many options and combinations. I made the mistake the first time coming here getting a premade pizza from there menu, but I highly recommend just looking at the toppings menu and getting creative. You can also combine sauces which is awesome!. Like them on facebook and keep an eye out for their deals, because sometimes pizza is super cheap and there is free wine on Wednesdays.

Carpinteria Athletics is a fantastic local gym here. During my short stay, the staff was very welcoming and knew members by name. There's all the equipment here to do the big lifts (bench, squat, and deadlift) as well as some unique stuff like heavy tires and battle ropes outside. There's a set of dumbbells in the back, a yoga/stretch studio upstairs, and personal small lockers. The gym isn't too busy and the wait times aren't bad at all. The owner is an honest dude and the staff is either helping someone or cleaning the equipment. Probably the best gym in Carpinteria for the price and environment.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This was actually pretty good! I was expecting just, 'I wanted sushi and now I've had some sushi' good -- but this was actually legit good. Very fresh. Fried sweet potato was crispy and warm even though I got delivery! I can't even remember the name of the specialty roll I ordered - I think it was tuna and salmon and had a slice of fresh jalapeño on top - very good.

I reserve 5 stars either for truly exceptional quality or truly exceptional value. This was neither -- however, for a neighborhood sushi joint that isn't fancy schmancy, this is about as good as I could hope for.

Thanks for adding to my day!

Very authentic and the food was O.K.  But for something as simple as a taco, they could not deliver. It was far from authentic and I couldn't even find it on that book of a menu they have. A taco should be carne asada with onions and cilantro. The taco they served was dripping with juice and tons of lettuce and cheese on it. They need to take some pointers from the guys across the street and cut down their menu to, 1 page, 2 pages max... How many combinations of the same food can you possibly put on the same menu! Cut the menu down and focus on what you do best!

I want to once again voice displeasure at this location. I've currently been waiting 20min. There's trash on the floor (& only one trash receptacle in the entire place - with the creamers) & boxes strewn everywhere. There were at least 15 cups lined up when I ordered. I understand bad days & maybe someone called in sick & it IS Sunday, but this is consistent. I stop here when it's on my way. 
I've heard rumor that the Cool Springs store is one of the higher volume stores in the region & I believe it. I have no idea why this store can't get it right.

Pasta is tasty and authentic, but the service is very poor and slow. I highly recommend getting take out, and avoiding the sit down restaurant experience.

Expect dinner to take around 2 hours, even if it's not a busy night. It's a family run business, but doesn't feel professional. Had to wait an entire hour between getting bread appetizer and starter salad. Waiter didn't bus the table so we had to stack our plates ourselves to make room for each serving. 

Pasta was really delicious! But avoid salads or pizza. Those are sub-par.

The appetizers and desserts were great! Not much selection on the sushi, but well made. Everything you order comes in very small portions to avoid waste, which makes sense but I felt weird asking for a triple order of something just to get a regular portion. 

The hibachi was not so great with lots of onions and very little meat on the plate. Their ordering system and portion sizes leave you ordering food throughout your visit. It was busy when we went, so food was coming to the table 15-20 minutes after ordering. 

Overall the it was good for the price. Will probably return, but definitely with a better strategy next time.

Service was horrible!  I came in for the second time to fit trial lenses  which I called to have them changed  one week prior....when I got there they still Wernt changed and I called back twice to do so before the appt the optical MGR never called me back and then they made me wait  again to ask me which brand I wanted when they were supposed to already have this information . Dr is horrible!! Not personable and  goes thru the motions.. very monotone.  And asked me the same questions whe I answered them when I previously was in the room 5 min before.  And they NEVER apologized for the mistake .Take your Rx and business elsewhere
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: i wrote a review on Guintos pizza once before. I still believe it's the best delivery pizza in the area. This time I'm writing to say thank you during COVID for being open. I've ordered delivery of pizza, calzones, and pasta dishes. they always come fast and hot. I live close by that may have something to do with it. But in any case I hope we all can support this local business. They have been there for our community and need some appreciation. Thanks Guintos and I'll be ordering the Guinto's special and a cheese pizza every week.

If you don't mind staying in a run down motel that reeks of cigarettes throughout the entire building, sleeping in roach infested rooms with decrepit bathrooms and the smell of marijuana from the 'Employee Only' rooms this is the place for you. Not only did this place have disgusting rooms the service only made it worse. Rather than fixing the issue and making things better the only thing they had to offer was an "I'm sorry". The only silver lining to this motel is the steps to the beach other than that you'd be better off sleeping in the public parking lot.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Anytime Fitness Center Grove is all about community! Whether you are a beginner or have been on your fitness journey for a while, at AFCG you will find a supportive community of staff and members that want to you succeed. 
Affordable memberships give you access 24/365. With a wide range of equipment, large selection of free weights and kettlebells, and even private showers, there is something for everyone at this location. 
Personal Trainers are licensed and knowledgeable. They are well equipped to deliver individualized programming proven to move people to adopt sustainable, healthy behaviors and a more active way of life.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Let's see what can I find that's good about staying here. Although relatively inexpensive we showed up to the no towels in the room my brothers room wasn't ready at 4:30 PM leaves little something to be desired.  No towels in room at 5 pm.  Went down early in the morning and there is a complimentary coffee in the lobby as the breakfast not open yet.  Nothing in the coffee pot and person behind front desk on a personal cell phone.   The price for the room was good but, must be an older hotel.  No ceiling in the elevator grounds a little dirty, broken ice machines around the complex.  It is a bed and shower.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This rating is for the restaurant or the thing they call a restaurant.  You would think a place like New Orleans that is sort of famous for food would not offer a restaurant of this low caliber.  I ordered breakfast and the waitress took the cold food from the buffet line.  Order the eggs over medium and got the usual runny egg whites.
