Cold sausages where you cold see the cold grease hardened.  Are you serious?  Close this restaurant or the thing they call restaurant..  And don't listen to anyone there that says go to the Ruby Slipper or Harrah's.  They almost suck as bad as Double Trees.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Disappointed. I feel like three stars is being generous. Service was adequate. Decor was bizarre at best. Food was nothing special, uninspired. I also question how Salmon is locally acquired, along with a few other items on the menu that seemed to have dubiously acquired the farm to table status. Price point is definitely high. And desserts were a bizarre pile up of somewhat related foods. We ordered oatcakes, which were delicious, but were accompanied with a melted marshmallow on the plate piled on top of that was a blob of vanilla ice cream and all of this was surrounded by limoncello sorbet. Bizarre.

If I could give 0 stars I would. I ordered a plain spicy chicken sandwich and medium fries, AND THEY STILL MESSED UP MY ORDER. I might as well of hopped over the counter and made it my damn self. It was completely dead empty in there like what were you doing to mess up an order that simple. Meat, bun, fries. They gave me a box with lettuce tomato and mayo squirted on top. I had repeated myself 3 times that it was just meat and bun. Annoyed and baffled this was even an issue. Call yourself the king of burgers? Pull your shit together.

I've been here a couple times and though the service is good and sushi mediocre, today my experience with the hibachi was not great at all. I'm guessing the person that cooked our food was new? He dropped one of his utensils on the floor and still used it to cook our food. I ordered the shrimp and tofu, the tofu was overcooked and my friend and I literally got 5 pieces of shrimp because he accidentally gave some shrimp to another lady who didn't even order any and dropped a piece of mine. The sushi is now premade sitting out so the sushi tastes dry and some fishy. Not sanitary at all. I think I'll take a break for a while. :/

Being new in town, I hadn't even had a chance to get my dog in for a regular exam let alone know which one to take him to for an emergency. I called and talked to Heather, who found a way to fit us in on the same day. Dr Cameron Stotter was fantastic - she called me throughout the day to give me updates on my dog (Diego), and came up with a plan to get him back to his normal basset self. The rest of the staff was amazing and patient as well. I'm so glad to find such an amazing vet so soon after moving here. I'll be recommending La Cumbre to anyone who asks!

Beautiful hotel with amazing amenities but the entire experience was ruined by the extremely loud nightclub across S.
Peters street, the Republic. At midnight, with the windows in my room literally throbbing from the extra loud music just outside my room, I called the front desk to find out when it might stop and was told that it depended on the crowd. Could be as early as 1am! Now I understand why they supply ear plugs on the night stands. Unfortunately,  they might mask sound but they do nothing for the bone-rattling vibration that prevents sleeping. Find another hotel!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Their service is ok most of the time.... they have forgotten a few thing here and there in the past but no big deal, my fault I didn't check before driving off. Today we got food and ice cream on the drive thru and when we got our 2 McFlurry's there was half of the cup missing. The ice cream only came to half of the cup. At this point I didn't want to wait to get a new one since it was late. As soon as I got home less than 5 minutes I attempt to begin to eat this and realize that it's a big ball of ice cream and it is melted at the bottom. At this point I did feel crappy that I ended up with no edible ice cream, and ended up paying for it.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: There are only a few reasons why I am not a vegetarian.  One of them is that I LOVE a good Reuben.  I decided to try the Tempeh Reuben, and I really enjoyed it.  I am now one step closer to becoming a vegetarian; however, this place did not sell me on veganism.  I have had some really good vegan cheese before (Daiya products are moist and melty), but the vegan mac and cheese here was dry and tasted like cardboard.  I actually had to pour some of my water into it to moisten it a bit.  I also had the braised cabbage and poblano peppers with white beans, which were pretty decent.  I would say this place was not bad, but not impressive either.

We walked over to Reading Terminal Market and after walking around a bit we opted for the duck at Sang Kee Peking Duck.

There were two stools available and we ordered a couple of bottles of water, a Peking duck roll, duck with rice and vegetables, and duck with noodles. 

The Peking duck roll was delicious but right when I bit into it juice streamed down my chin and all over my shirt. I smelled like the duck and five spice until I finally got into our hotel room and could change.

Our entrees were both delicious and very good portions. The duck was tender and flavorful in both dishes but the noodle dish was a little strong for my taste.

I really enjoy going to bartaco. The flavors are very unique and I love the way the food comes out in small trays for everyone to share. The reason why I can't give it 5 stars is because there have been times when I've gone there and waited by the front door to be seated and no one is around or is paying attention. These are on days that haven't been busy. It obviously won't stop me from coming back but I'd like to see the staff pay more attention to the front where people are walking in and waiting on them to be seated, it would overall make the experience better.

So, the past few times that I've gone back to bar taco the service has just not been right. Tonight is probably the last time I'll visit. I walked up to the take out counter and barely got a greeting. I placed my order to go and also ordered a lemonade. It took a good almost 10 min to get a drink. They were busy so I was trying to give them the benefit of the doubt. After waiting for my order I went home, and I wish I checked it while I was there because unfortunately it is not what I asked for. I ordered Baja fish tacos and received instead lettuce wraps with tuna in it? Really disappointed.

Wow this is a hidden Nashville gem on Nolensville pike. I went two days in a row and it was AMAZING. I went with the smoked half chicken both times which came out steaming hot with the perfect combination of refried beans and rice covered with pico. The chicken is covered with an phenomenal spice blend which is addictive to the palate. And all for $7! What a steal.

If you drive up they will take your order and have it to you in less than 5 minutes. Would love to try other things on the menu but the chicken is too perfect as is. I will definitely be back when I'm in town!

The place was very busy, so they clearly have repeat customers but the best part of my meal was the bottle of wine I brought from home. We had the meatball and sausage with hot peppers appetizer, which was tasty. But the dinners were not good. My Gorgonzola gnocchi seemed like the gnocchi was not homemade or if it was, it was really heavy. My husband's veal parm had no flavor.  The red sauce at an Italian restaurant is everything. If you're red sauce is no good, most of your menu flies out the window. I had high hopes, so I'm bummed with how it turned out.

First of all this is the best pizza in Tampa, everything is great My problem was that I was told 45 - 60 minutes, which is usual. Pizza arrived after 1:20, I asked the driver if my food was still hot but I knew as soon as put my hand under box it was cold. He apologized and told me he was home and they had to call him in to do deliveries. When I called the Pizzeria I was told it went out hot, which I knew was a lie. $36.00 for cold food and no offer of a discount on next order. They've lost me as a customer.

My favorite little "dive bar"!! --- Only complaint is the beer selection is limited. Shock-Top is their premium beer.

This place (or any other outdoor place in Florida,) can be brutal in the summer time. --- Be prepared to sweat and swat flies!! (I'm OK with that though!!) -- A nice evening storm often cools things down for a bit!!

Great neighborhood atmosphere -- Great Fish Taco's and Buffalo Shrimp!! -- Good Music most of the time!!

For what it is, "a neighborhood dive" with a beachy atmosphere, it is simply quite enjoyable. -- I only wish they had a better beer selection!

I love Josephine and i feel like their menus just keep getting better. Right now, their duck wings are delicious and super flavorful. Not spicy, just a lot of flavor. Rainbow carrots are great, brussel sprouts are too, although, i wish they weren't as sweet as they are sometimes. Their beef cheeks are alway a favorite in our family. And the Josephine Chicken is by far one of the best dinner investments you'll make this month. Highly recommend it and recommend you have them cut it for you. 

Drinks are very good. I think i've tried just about all of them and they are delicious.

Staff: Friendly, attentive, helpful.

Rooms: Outdated for Holiday Inns. You'll be lucky to find an open power outlet in your room, and it will be nowhere near the desk. The hotel has no power strips or extensions to compensate. Big, big downside if you travel for business and have work to do.

Ammenities: Pool open to midnight. No fitness.

Parking: A joke. The lot is big enough for half their rooms, and street parking is limited to non-existant. Also, there are a bunch of meth heads sitting on their porches on the street watching cars park. Reeks of bad news.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This was our first time here and I was really excited as the reviews were really good. The restaurant itself is quaint and had a great atmosphere. The service was a bit slow. The food was okay. Not impressed. I ordered the Salvaggio, which was mushrooms garlic and blue cheese and was recommended by the server if you like blue cheese. However, when I got the dish there were only a couple crumbles of blue cheese and no blue cheese flavor. I had to ask for more blue cheese on the side. Could have been a fluke night. Willing to give it a second chance.

My husband and I stopped by this place on Broad Ripple, it's a quite, quaint shop to buy a sweet treat. Staff was friendly and informative about the desserts. We've only had peach and piña colada, both were very delicious and surprisingly flavorful. The downside was that the price was a little high for the size of the popsicle. They have lots of unique flavors and vegan options. It was a nice alternative to ice cream, since we were still full from dinner. I personally wouldn't go very frequently, but it's definitely worth checking out!

We came to the Brass Tap at the mall just to get one beer. It didn't turn out to be just one beer. They have a very good Sunday special , they have $4 drafts , and the selection is really good. If you are a Pokemon go player , this is also a very good place. I was able to catch my Pokemons and get more Pokeballs because this place has a pokeStop nearby.  
Me and my husband had a very good time drinking beers and just enjoying the scenery. They do not serve food at the Brass Tap. But the Cheesecake Factory is next door and they can't deliver food,which is a very good option.

I've been here a few more times since the poor experience. As a person of habit I can't help it especially being I'm not overly familiar with other sushi places yet. Anyways, I've not had that problem again. I've easily come here quite a few times about a few months after the incident with no trouble. On account of repeat positivity and yummy yums I raise my review.  Flavor is there and I've still never been more happy to know I have a all you can eat sushi place near home. 

No issue with dirty dishes these past few times, flavor is there, nothing sour or bad tasting or funky looking.

I feel compelled to update my review. The last several times I've gone, my pedicure has not been great. It's been mediocre at best. Rough edges remain on my nails, dead skin removal has been too rough, and polish has been applied in a sloppy manner. (It's the kind of situation where I have to touch up their work when I get home, to ensure the pedi will last a couple weeks...) Polish selection grows worse by the visit (hardly any Essie or OPI to choose from anymore). Atmosphere still seems nice and clean, but that's the best I can say. I am looking for a new nail spot.

Went to the restaurant on March 22 to order a large calzone I called it in they said about 20 mints it was 9'40pm when I call I came to pick it up my husband and I it was not ready went back out my husband went in told him 20 mints it was about 10"45 when we got our order .we went home and found a piece of plastic that was cooked in our calzone .which we took a pic to show them .the kitchen is slow has ever they do not greet customers unless you have a big party they have poor customer service none tried to acomodate us for waiting .need to be close down very upset about the service

I expected so much more than average.  Although the atmosphere was nice the noise level was so high that you need to be able to read lips if you want to have a conversation.  The tables where way way too small to fit everything (I could only put the water *OR* the wine glass on the table at the same time)!  The service was ok but they need to pay more attention to the customer and be a little friendlier (some training may be beneficial).  The food was good but not memorable.  We will give it another try in a few months.

We came here between hockey games to fuel up... reviews looked good, so we checked it out. 

Love the yelp reviews!

Yes, this place is tucked away in a strip mall. It is hard to miss. And worth finding. 

Walked it, seated right away, lunch time.  The place was clean, and the service was very attentive. 

While the reviews were good, I was a little skeptical bc there were many 'spicy' things on the menu ... and it was all good! And fresh!

Our group had:
Eel, tuna, tuna tar tar, and a variety of rolls.  One better than the next.

Visiting Philly, looking for great sushi, tried Fat Salmon based on reviews. Solid choice. Great value. (If they charged more I would lower rating.)

They have a lot of house specials. So if you are looking for something new and different, this is a good place to experiment. 

The fish was fresh and good. Solid place. 
Service was a little slow and very helpful/cheery. 

The spicy edamame was addictive. Little messy to eat, and addictive.  Sweet and spicy sauce.

For fun: they  presented my son's order in a boat. His first one. He was so excited. (Thx u!).

st time eating there and I ordered the tostado. It came with guacamole which I don't like. I was unaware it came on it. I have never been to any other Mexican restaurants where they put it on the tostado. I asked for one without guacamole. Without any hesitation she brought me another one with out advising me there would be an additional charge. But when are bill arrived I was charged for it. I asked the manager and waitress about the charge and they both refused to remove it. I have never had this happen before. I will not be back due to the poor customer service. And all this was over $2.50!

Hard to believe that the Safeway Store on Duval Mine Road can charge more than a store in Tucson.  Not only are Green Valley residents paying more for their gas, but now we find out that groceries are cheaper in Tucson.  A recent ad showed that the ads were the same, but the prices were higher in Green Valley than in Tucson for the same product.  I bet that Safeway wouldn't honor the Tucson price here in Green Valley.  Stop shopping at Safeway - go to Frys or Walmart - but stay away from Safeway unless you like being higher prices.

My wife and I were looking forward to having cocktails at the newly renovated Marriott waterfront outside bar. 

We walked in at 1:15 on Saturday afternoon. Maybe 10-12 people at the bar. Nowhere near busy. We sat down. Watched the two bar tenders walk by us two times each. Neither said hello or even looked up. 

We walked out after 3-4 min. 

If you're going to spend the money and renovate a bar to make it more appealing...don't ruin it with shitty staff. 

Will wait 6 months or so before we'd try again. Maybe the management will realize their staffing reflects upon them. 

Lame.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We stopped here looking for a place to grab a beer. It was a great little beach bar. It is a beach bar I don't expect much other than beer and sand. Since it was snowing back home sitting on the beach in December was all we could ask for. The bartender wasn't all that social but he kept a full beer in front of us. Only wings and fries available for food but you can order from the place down the street and they will deliver at no charge. The food was really good. We had the shaved prime rib sandwich and blue cheese wings.

A pretty average dining experience for the price. I think there are better Italian options in St. Louis (especially since The Hill is a neighborhood full of excellent Italian). The staff was a little bit awkward, and the ambiance was too sultry for my business dinner. We ordered a seafood platter to split which was fine, just a sampling of fresh clams, crabs, and shrimp. I had the scallop pasta, which was pretty good but the flavor was not where it needed to be for the price. I'll stick to other Italian options for now.

Recently moved to the riverview area and looking for a good shop to keep up with my undercut, and I think just may have found it. Good location, clean shop. I went in the middle of the day during the week so the shop was pretty empty. Lauren was who took care of me and I was happy with the job she did, especially considering it had been a while since I had got my haircut. She even fixed the last guys mistake. Pretty affordable for the cut..I'll definitely be back next time I need a touch up. She even gave me a coupon for $5 off my next cut!

I don't think I need to talk more about its beignets and cafe au lait.  I love this location because it is super clean, clean tables, chairs, clean restroom.  Not crowded - lines are not long.  Most importantly, there is free wifi from the City Park.  Highly recommend to go to this location instead of the one in French Market (French Quarter) if you have a car, parking is not an issue at all here.  Food wise, I think it is a bit better here may be because they are not in a hurry to make their food and drinks?

I am very upset we dropped our doggie off this morning at 8:45 to get a comprehensive exam. I called there at 12 to see what is the status on my doggie and the guy that answered the phone told me Ike was up next and the guy told me the doctor would call me in an hour. Well the hour goes by and no phone call so my boyfriend and I at 130 headed up there. We get there and the guy at the desk tells us that Ike still has not been seen at the time we tell them that we just want to take ike home!!!!! This horrible  for all the animals that have to stay in the cages in the back for 5 plus hours!!!! I will never take my dog there again!!!!

This by far the worst hotel that we have ever stayed in. I would HIGHLY ADVISE that you DO NOT EVER STAY HERE. The room they gave us was not checked out yet by the people staying in it. They did not give us clean towels when they cleaned the room. Every trash can in the entire hotel was overflowing for 2 days. There was food all over the carpet throughout the hotel. The breakfast was not kept up on as they were out of everything. The milk they put out was spoiled. No one was at the front desk anytime you went there to request something. The WORST SERVICE I HAVE EVER HAD BY FARRR!DO NOT STAY THERE EVER.......
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Being a chef and a fellow foodie I was dissapointed in this place but since there is only one other restaurant within 20 miles that is simliar, unforantely it will survive. The food was good, but about $5 to $10 over priced per dish based on the quality and presentation. Go to Sola, a much better deal and quality. The bartenderes are the worse i have ever seen and the bar is tiny. It felt like my friend and I waited 30  minutes for a beer. The only high point was the bathroom, but that will not keep me coming back.

Mediocre at best. Many slips throughout our dining experience. First of all the edamame was served with sugar sprinkled on top instead of salt. It was corrected but served with way too much salt and in a puddle of water. The owner did salvage it by taking it off of our bill. I ordered sushi- the waterfall sushi was excellent. My husband ordered Mongolian beef. This dish fell flat as the beef looked like it was par boiled instead off stir fried at a high heat. The meat did not get seared. Stick with the sushi if you come here to eat.

Room wifi is super slow. Conference room wifi is decent. 
The bed in Room 505 is saggy in the middle and uncomfortable to sleep in. 
Free breakfast and snacks on the 11th floor are pretty good. Food from Room service is okay. 

They denied to give me late checkout at 1PM.  only 1 hour late. 
The shuttle driver asked for tips bluntly right when people stepped inside the shuttle. He said "the hotel and I treat you nicely, so I hope you will treat me nicely as well". It's not like I won't tip, but ask for it from the beginning like that is just weird.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Read this one to the end... I arrived and LOVED this hotel it looked clean, it smelled clean. It was convenient right off the exit. They had a fitness center, a hit bfast, large rooms that again even smelled clean upon entering.  Everything about my stay here was spot on I had nothing bad to say about this hotel, and then... This morning I discovered that the bed comforter I had been snuggled under all night in fact had a huge, bloody booger wiped on it. Now I have no expectation about a room being 100% free of fluids and hair but knowing for sure I wasn't alone has ruined my day. I do expect clean sheets when I arrive!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I really enjoy the ambience and the service here, no doubt. The waitress was seriously one of the best and accommodating waitresses I have ever had. Although, I was not impressed with the food at all. This was my 3rd time here. The big eye tuna tartar is nothing special at all for $28. I wasn't even impressed with the mixed green salad - the ginger dressing is usually the best part and it was nothing to rave about. My sashimi was good but the portions just don't match the prices. I enjoyed the brussel sprouts but they were simply sautéed. There are just way better places in the area I'm sure.

At first, our rental didn't go well because we thought my wife specifically reserved a full size 4-door sedan.  When the agent pulled up with a Dodge Charger 2-door model, I knew my wife would flip.  The manager quickly apologized and went to get us a Nissan Ultima 4-door sedan.  From that moment on it was smooth sailing.  We drove from Philly to Connecticut,  and then to New York City.   We finally dropped it off in LaGuardia Airport station.  No problems whatsoever.  The car had plenty of room,  very comfortable front and back,  and gas mileage was fantastic!  First time with Enterprise will not be our last.

+++ For great sushi
- For not so good noodles
+ For delicious "dynamite"

One of my favorite places when I'm in the mood for sushi. However, I wasn't as pleased with the food when I ordered a lo mein entrée - The waitress forgot that I ordered it, so I got it really late. When it came out it was just mediocre, I wouldn't order it again. It was overpriced for the portion size.

I've been there three times and the sushi has been consistently excellent. Great menu with some sushi options I've never had before. Stick to the sushi though and stay away from the entrées.

Very average Chinese food. I ordered the beef and broccoli, which is my standard selection at almost any Chinese restaurant I visit. Unfortunately this dish was extremely bland and soupy, and I can honestly say this is the most tasteless version I have ever had. My wife, however, said she enjoyed her sweet and sour chicken. The good news is that if you order here, you will likely receive a freebie or two (two free drinks in our case), but if you are looking for truly great Chinese food, this is probably not the place!

I came here for breakfast with 5 other people. Our wait time in line was not bad and the food we had was good, but the iced coffees were horrible. Myself and 3 of my friends ordered iced coffees and we all had the same issue. They were about 90% cream 7% ice and 3% coffee. The iced coffee literally just tasted like water and cream. I went up to the register and asked if they could dump some of it out and just add more coffee to it. She insisted on making a new one for me. I get my new coffee and it is literally the same thing. Very disappointing.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have been busy and haven't had a chance to go to my usual waxer. I live locally and read that people had had good experiences getting their eyebrows waxed here. Boy was I wrong! I happen to have somewhat thicker eyebrows and typically just go for a clean up. When the woman was finished, I was left with two thin lines with little to no shape! My arch was gone, as was any hint of their natural shape! I now have to spend the next 6 weeks PRAYING that they all grow back--not the experience I wanted  or would wish on anyone!

The hotel is clean personal friendly, they are going into remodeling phase 8th floor is done unfortunately we are on the fifth floor and the air conditioning doesn't work they have been twice to fix it but no luck and the thermostat is on a motion detector sooo you got it no walking around your room it shuts off. The coolest I've been able to get it is 75 and they have no fans and the windows do not open changing rooms is apparently not an option as they haven't offered and no clean towels available at the moment! What the heck
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I came into Bay Brothers after being lied to about work that needed to be done on my car by chain/corporate mechanic shop. I was greeted immediately and my car was taken back for an oil change. Luckily they weren't busy and it took 45 min! I worked on their free wifi in the waiting area until it was done. BB offers a membership program for $105 that includes your oil changes for a year, tire rotations, free wipers, and a discount on other car repairs. The owner, Juan, was super sweet and answered all my questions. Excited to have found a trustworthy place to take care of my car.

Asaka was not something I had heard of before deciding on a whim that we wanted sushi. We were by the mall and didn't want to travel and oh man, I am so glad we stopped in.

It's a quaint space where one of the FEMALE owners serves you while her sister is the chef. Obsessed with the vibe and glad we got into the place, because she told me they usually have a full list for every night. They have a great happy hour menu! My suggestion is to call ahead, get ANYTHING on the menu as far as sushi goes, and get the gyoza!

Ordered delivery from here a few weeks ago. We are new to the area and want to find a "go to" place for basic Chinese grub. This place wasn't horrible, as the fried rice and crab rangoons were pretty tasty. Had the Lo mein and couldn't even eat more than a few forks full. It is a weird texture and not flavorful! Delivery was very slow, and driver forgot our drinks. He brought them to us, but they didn't come back to us until after we were done with dinner and no further compensation was offered. Not a bad place, but will continue our search.

5 stars for the beverages and ambiance (we've all come to enjoy and know Starbucks for their drinks which are amazing)

2 stars for service, this is not the first time I've had issues with service

I came in and stood at the register for 5 minutes as "Bee" and another employee looked at me. After awkward contact I was finally asked me "If I had been helped"..I was the only person in line, and 2 other people were seated in the store.

Took 5 minutes to get a cold brew with cold foam, which came out wrong the first time but it was delicious ‍ obviously or I would have took my business elsewhere.

Today, I tried Public House. I ordered at 5:45 and didn't get my food until almost 7p. I love supporting establishments especially those that are minority owned. However, to not be considerate of your customers time is down right rude. I wasn't impressed with meal. They were out of nearly everything and my pasta didn't have shrimp in it, yet I paid full price. I am sure they can probably do a better job and would consider trying it again, but the owner really needs to rethink the way in which they are currently operating. It's just not sustainable.

I had a wonderful experience here, though I had to put my cat to sleep. Everyone was so empathetic. They see this kind of heartbreak everyday. I actually mailed a Thank You card to all the staff who tried to save my cat, or at least, made her comfortable away from home.

My experience several years later was very different. I can only praise Metropolitan again now that Dr. Valerey isn't on the payroll. He was cold and unfeeling, sarcastic and obnoxious. These are not attributes you want in a vet who is sending your darling pet to Rainbow Bridge.

I would consider returning there in the future in case of emergency.

My family never gets to eat a meal together, mostly because my wife and I work opposite each other. Which is why we were so excited to have the night together. El Maguey was the first place we thought of. Google has them listed as closing at 10, we arrived at 9:15. We were told by the manger "no.we couldn't dine in." We could get take out which confused me. If we could get food Togo? Why couldn't we sit and eat? Is 45min not enough time to eat a meal. Maybe it was the way I look, maybe it was the fact I had a 9 year old with me. Either way, I was hurt and disappointed. From now on, I'm going to Chevy's.

I've gone to this White Castle location several times and had no problems however.... On 6 September 2021 I was told they were not offering sliders. I understand the need to clean. However, this location is 24 hours. I've come at the same time many times before. And yet... I
 Kever order slider which have never been a problem. I'd rather you just say "no... I don't want to work" then I would understand. So instead of sliders from White Castle I'm getting burgers from McDonald's. My money might not be a lot to share holders but it's all the world to me. I would tell the employees "do better people, do better".

Thankful for this starbucks inside the hospital where i work! Very convenient and service is fast considering that they cater to every medical professionals, hospital staff, visitors, patients and students who are in need of starbucks. The baristas are also very warm and welcoming. The only thing I'm disappointed about is that they don't have the tomato and mozarella panini that i love and usualy order at any starbucks. Otherwise, starbucks saves my coffee craving! After all, at the start of every work shift I'd so want to skip, the smell of good coffee is all I need to get through it!

Walked into subway on May 24,2016 for lunch and heard previously from someone that works there that they had moldy onions in their food line. While my sandwich was being toasted i was looking to make sure all the vegetables were fresher than what the person told me previously about some of their items. I looked at the onions and once again they had mold all over them. Very disgusting to see their food sitting like that for people to have that added onto their sandwich. Have a picture of the onions that i secretly took without their knowledge but very disappointed on how this store is being run. No longer a return customer.

If you want median rent payments, with a short drive to all the interstates and can put up with the sub par (corporate) maintenance... this is the place for you! 
(Not to blame the actual maintenance workers, they seemed to actually care I was using a set of pliers to operate my cold water faucet in my shower for six months)
Plus the rolling hills that are my living room floor. (Complete with wood-like flooring that is actually linoleum) Blamed on the sub-floor. Make sure to pay attention to all the fine print which includes lead paint warnings and notices for pest control that doesn't happen.

This place is down the street from my house, so I got there often since my bus stop is also around the corner.  Usually very busy, so there is a bit of a wait.  I've never had an issue with staff. I actually like a few of them.  I think the location is a bit inconvenient, because it's hard to get in and out of the parking lot, if you drive.  There's also two parking spots on the side that are a bit dangerous since you have to back out into a busy street corner where traffic can turn, so I would never drive there.

I've stayed at this particular SleepInn several nights while traveling in Illinois for business. It was the first hotel I've stayed at in this area, and I liked it enough that I'll keep coming here. It feels safe, the renovation is cute, and it's (mostly) clean. The shower wasn't completely clean this time (hair stuck to the walls) which was disappointing. I did like the oreos in my welcome bag (I'm a Choice Privileges Gold member because I stay in hotels way too much!) - I will keep coming here when I have to stay in Illinois.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Scam alert!!!!! Only takes cards on the vacuum and the first vacuum didn't work so I had to pay for another vacuum and when I was done there was no button to end the transaction and it kept adding more time and charging me more money!!!! It charged me for an hour worth of vacuuming when I only wanted 5 minutes and I had to wait the entire hour to make sure the machine stopped so other people did not come and add more time onto my debit card!!!!!! This should be illegal. No contact numbers or way to get ahold of the owner. Don't go here!!!! Wish there was a 0 star option.

Had dinner here a few days ago and it was delicious! The Dragon roll is amazing and the spicy tuna was good as well. I enjoyed my meal so much that I decided to order lunch for work the next day. I ordered the chicken soba noodles. They heat up well and was a perfect lunch. The price is a bit expensive but that is to be expected with sushi especially in Chestnuthill. I sat at the sushi bar and although my particular server did not come over often, the hostess, bartender and other servers made sure I had everything I needed.

This service at this subway is wonderful. The woman that works here is kind and goes out of her way to please the customer. It is subway so the sandwiches are the same but service is key. It is also the cleanest subway I have ever been in. As I was leaving the gentleman working was on his knees cleaning the legs of the table that people rest their feet on. They wipe down everything and are a great franchise representative of Subway corporation. If you are out shopping and want to grab an inexpensive bite to eat I highly recommend this location.

Although their tacos are very good and authentic, they close and refuse to make orders whenever they want. I ordered from them on UberEats and they just up and cancelled my orders right before they were supposed to arrive without any notice. It's really upsetting when you're hungry and are expecting your food to arrive at a certain time and they wait till the time it's supposed to arrive and then cancel. They've done this maybe 3 times over the past few months. Their closing time is 7 pm. Today I went to get food there ag 6:20 to discover that they were closed.....their food? Incomparable. Their customer service? Awful.

Lovely. This Conrad location is the quality you would expect from the brand. Not quite on par with the Conrad in Chicago but still a great hotel. If you like artwork, you should stay here. It is a literal art gallery. Lobby is small but efficient and the elevators are fast which is always helpful. Grabbing a cab isn't as easy but ordering an Uber or Lyft was quick. Stayed on the 12th floor and didn't hear anyone else on the floor. I'll assume there were other people staying but the rooms are very well buffered.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I made two orders. I asked for a starbucks double shoot on ice. I had to repeat to the guy 10 times that I want a starbucks doble shoot on ice. He gave me a venti cup that was filled half way with ice and 1/4 coffee. I told the guy I want a starbucks doble shoot on ice with little ice and two percent milk. He added more milk and told me that so I dont get confused next time Espressos dont get to much milk. I didn't ask for an espresso I asked for the drink that is called Starbucks doble shoot on ice. I get the gouda sandwich and leave. I taste my drink and it's not what I ordered, he still gave me an espresso and a half frozen sandwich

We were recommended to visit this place as we are staying at Silver Legacy Hotel. When we sat down, the table was dirty, the manager was herself there and she apologized. She even cleaned it herself. Then, we started choosing what to eat from the menu, the waitress came, took order and we were waiting approximately 30 min for sushi. The knife was dirty, plates not clean, I asked for the coke, they offered pepsi. Anyways, this place deserves my two stars because sushi is really delicious. We ordered  3 kinds of sushi and they were super tasty!!!
So, best choice will be to order food to go I think.

Service is slow , food is nothing special . Menu is really nothing to be desired of . The worse part is , i found hair in my food , the server apologized and took my Bill. When I went to leave they stopped my and told me i had to pay for my drink . I agreed , the drink was 2.25 they rang up 4.50 on the register . When I pulled out my wallet she then told me that it will be a minimum of $5 for a credit card purchase . To summarize , food suck , service is slow and very unprofessional . If this was the last place left on earth I still would never return . Worse experience ever

We had a really loud airconditioner, which didn't work at all. The upper levels were to warm and the housekeeping knocked from 8:30am at the doors to clean the rooms. I jumped outta bed to tell them we need 30minutes, unfortunately after 10 minutes they asked it again and gave them the same answer.

The next day we placed the sign at the door, but because they were loud and the doors were slaming, we woke up ealy again. 

The view is nice and the hotel is a at central location. We went two days to the beach in Clearwater. 
 
We experienced better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We are staying at the Hilton in Clearwater, which is where this restaurant is located. We made plans to walk around town and find a nice place to have dinner, but it started raining pretty bad so we ended up at Jimmy's. I was pleasantly surprised at how good the food was. I had the shrimp tacos and brownie Sunday and my boyfriend had blackened mahi and key lime pie. The rice wasn't dry, the tacos were delicious, and the mahi was cooked to order. Everything was excellent! Service was great too. If it hadn't been raining, there is a section where you can sit outside that is waterfront and it is an amazing view. Would highly recommend this place.

We are not from Carpenteria, but so happy that we found this gem!! The service was amazing!! Our waitress (possibly the owner) was super friendly and had a great positive attitude which made our whole experience even more enjoyable! We shared a grilled chicken Oaxaca burrito, shrimp tacos, and fish tacos!! The Oaxaca grilled chicken burrito was my favorite, it was huge and tasted so delicious!! They also gave us free salsa as an appetizer and it was really good salsa! We sat out on the patio and enjoyed our surroundings while eating. If you want authentic Mexican food and a good time, definitely come here!!

Workers here have poor attitude. Came 15 mins before closing and i walked in and everything was already put away soda machines off and the lady was like we are closed. I looked at her and said no you're not, you close in 15. She just gawked at me and said we are closing soon. So then i said you cant make a sandwich in 15 minutes? Got annoyed and walked out. 

Whoever owns this subway, consider training your staff members in proper respect and timeliness. You lost a customer and I'll be heading to the other subway from now on

Disappointed, while ordering a plain cheese pizza and cheesesteak fries.  My hotel host suggested them, said they have great Jersey, NY pizza.  Maybe if I got it fresh!  Cold pizza and soggy fries are not going to get three stars.  I understand, they may have gone to the wrong hotel, but those taking orders need to be the ones who speak and understand English the best.  2 miles away, and they called me 2X, to tell me it was on the way.  Weird?   If I am ever in a bind, I would love to give them another try and update the review, but two stars stands as a gracious rating today.  I hope they just had an off night.

Had a wonderful dinner tonight with my daughter.  From bay area and accustomed to great restaurants. Sat outside on patio and people watched.  Daughter had the farmers salad with grilled chicken....super delicious.  I had the red snapper special.  Beautifully plated, unusual presentation, and absolutely fabulous. Very unusual and snapper was exquisite.  Serve was helpful and lovely. Restaurant completely packed.  Can't imagine the bad reviews. Look forward to dining here again.
P.S. The food at other tables looked delicious too!

I wish I could give 0 stars! I was told my oil change for my vehicle which take a synthetic blend would cost $16.95. Well long story short they are liars!!! I got there and was told my car requires full synthetic! My car has NEVER had full synthetic. So needless to say my $16.95 oil change turned into $72!!! Absolutely ridiculous! What kind of business is this! I did speak to Vinny the first time and he was great! However the other gentleman that checked me in basically fed me a line of BS! I would not recommend this business to anyone!

After having such a terrible experience at the quality inn down the street we were told by an employee at quality inn to come here. It was the perfect hotel! The staff are incredibly nice and the pool view room we had was amazing. Clean, beautiful and comfy. I would highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking to stay in this area. The only thing that took me by surprise was the $75 deposit fee which wasn't stated anywhere but was told it would be given back in about a day. Literally no complaints though, this is one of the best hotels I have ever stood at!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Pizza is sub-par, there are much better options within a 1 mile radius. Our server was possibly the rudest I've ever had. I've worked in the food industry, so I understand the stress and pressure, and try to be understanding but it was another level. The place was half empty and he made us feel incredibly unwelcome. Cut us off twice in the middle of ordering one appetizer to leave. Snapped at us for asking any questions. Was hoping for a great bar and pizza joint in the neighborhood but would recommend avoiding.

In this age of big, anonymous box stores, it is nice to find a good local market that has friendly staff and a good selection of groceries.  i am a big proponent of local businesses, and believe that we should get out and support them by buying local when we can.  Osborne's Bi-Rite on Belmont has limited selection compared to a larger chain, but at the same time they have some items that come as a surprise from a local market.   They have tremendous New York Strip steak at a very reasonable price!  I would highly recommend shopping here.

Took my husband here for a celebratory dinner. This place did not disappoint. The food is so fresh and absolutely delicious. The service was fantastic and super quick. We went on a Friday night and it started to get busy around 6:30pm which is about the time that we left. The restuarant itself is located between a mechanic shop and a dispensary. It looks like a little hole in the wall type place from the outside. The parking lot is very small and tight. You might have to find parking elsewhere and walk a little but the food makes it worth it. Definitely recommend if you are craving sushi. Quality place.

This Wendy's is close to work so I'm there often. It's actually a really well run store! The employees are always friendly; the food is always hot and fresh; and the service is pretty fast, even when they are busy...which is most of the time! The dining room is also very clean.  One day they accidentally gave me a chicken sandwich instead of the hamburger I ordered. They fixed it right away, and honestly if I hadn't been in the mood for a burger, I probably would have just kept the chicken sandwich. Their chicken sandwiches are awesome. And, bonus, they just brought back the Taco Salad!!

If I could give 0 Stars I would. They have lost my several items of mine in the past. Shirts ranging $100+ were lost and they refused to make it right. No refund, no cleaning credit, nothing. I waited about a year before I went back and took some more shirts in. They some how managed to STAIN two of my Egyptian Cotton button-ups. Again, refused to to make it right. I had just purchased these shirts and only wore them one time. I took the receipts in and asked for reimbursement and the employee simply walked away and said he couldn't help. Do not trust these folks with your nice clothes!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Ok. To start off we were told over the phone that for two people it would be twenty minute wait. It was  one hour and twenty minute wait. The host was an arrogant kid who didnt even know how to be gracious host. Then once seated it took forty five  minutes to get our food. Mind you that food was a burger. There was nothing there that was amazing. The only saving grace was our waitress Elizabeth. She apologized profusely for the ridiculous wait and inaccurate time given by the girl on the phone. It's a shame because the place looked like it would be a winner.

Took my son & his friend here for lunch. Every roll we ordered that had any kind of fish in it was EXTREMELY FISHY and left me wondered what quality fish & freshness we were consuming.  We had the M&M roll, Heart Attack roll, Crunch Dynamite roll, Dragon roll & the Crab Stick roll. The only one worth eating was the Dragon Roll. They were all fishy and bland in flavor. The kids ate the rest. 
The only reason they get 2 stars...the service was very attentive and friendly. There are far better places on the Westbank!

Priceline fail. The booking didn't transmit and I had to wait over an hour to get it straight with a rude front desk person. The front desk was cluttered and the floors and furniture needed a good cleaning.

This place is touted as very clean on Priceline. It's worn out. Wallpaper is peeling from the ceiling. There were other people's pills on the floor in the bathroom. There was also dust and debris on the floor.

If I wasn't already so exhausted, I would have moved to another hotel. The only saving grace was adequate black out shades.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Worst pizza and experience ever.  I ordered pizza (St. Louis hand tossed Spinach, Tomato, Hamburger) and cheese garlic bread online at 7:35 pm.  I arrived at the stored 20 minutes later and was told they just received the online order and it would take 20 minutes.  We did not get our pizza until a little after 8:30 pm.  The wait was NOT worth it.  The spinach is the spinach from a can or frozen not fresh spinach and the pizza sauce was bland.  Overall the pizza had no flavor.  The cheese bread was ok but the bread is about an inch tall and they don't put enough cheese on it to compensate.  Never going back!!

Great pizza and food. They have a $5 bar menu that you can get at any time during the day at the bar. I got the ravioli and mussels they were amazing. They also have a great happy hour and everything is reasonable. Although the service is less than desirable, the food certainly makes up for it. We also got the long hots, arugula salad, Italian job pizza and the sausage pizza. All were delicious. Only reason they did not get a five star review is because of the horrible attitudes that the staff had. Other than nasty waitresses the place is amazing!!

Went in here while I was visiting. I got a gel manicure and spa pedi. They were extremely short staffed. I initially had to wait 30 minutes, which I totally understand since it was a walk in. Well, 45-50 minutes later that they started. I'm used to having someone do my mani and pedi at the same time. Unfortunately, they did them one after another. I felt like I was there the entire afternoon. To top it off, my gels usually last at least a week and a half plus, my nails started chipping/ peeling before a week was up. No bueno!!!

Passed by Jimmy's while staying in Clearwater it looked good so we went in, beautiful outdoor deck and plenty of seating, with live music. Well that's where the good ended. We ordered a drink and 2 waters, we got one, asked for a second said it'll be right over. Never got it. Ordered appetizer and 2 burgers, 35 minutes later saw the waitress asked again for the water and was told be right over. Passed us 2 times with water for other tables. 30 more minutes still no food or water. Went to the bar to pay for the one drink we had and left. Was told they were busy, there were lots of open tables. Do not reccomend eating here.

The Bay Harbor Hotel has a wonderful view of the bay. The rooms are clean and spacious, with nice flat 42 in. tv and a small refrigerator. They have a nice decent gym for those who enjoy staying fit. The pool was clean with lots of chairs and beautiful lounge chairs. Their restaurant has indoor or outdoor seating for spectacular view of sunsets. The outside bar has Excellent Margaritas! Also, try and rent a jet ski while you are there... Very friendly staff. I didn't give them a 5 star, because the toilet seat was loose and one of the tiles on shower wall was missing. Otherwise... Hotel is very pretty!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My insurance company recommended I use Hertz so I gave them a try-what a HUGE MISTAKE! So I made arrangements to pick up a car but at the time we were going to get it they called to say "sorry, we don't have any cars" WHAT?? A rental car place with no cars, ok??? So next day they tell me they got me a car and I said ok my kids will be in to get it later today and they tell me they can't hold it so they rented it out. This place is a complete joke!! Enterprise has my business!!! Guess this is why Hertz is hurting....adios lame company!

If I could give it zeros stars I would. 

First off, bed bugs!! My husband, kids and I were all bitten. Still praying we didn't bring them home.

This was a like a college frat. People drinking everywhere all night long. Hallways smelt of weed. Parties in rooms on each floor. 

Breakfast wasn't free (I had a Groupon for the room). They provide ten dollar vouchers which doesn't cover the cost of a meal at their restaurants.

The pool is very dirty and they never have enough towels. 

Stay away from this place. Yes, the view is decent but it's not worth bed bugs!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Staff greeted us and made us feel welcome upon arrival and had our room ready early for check in.  Elevator was out of service which was inconvenient but provided an opportunity for exercise. Indoor pool was clean as was the fitness room. Guest room was clean at first sight but when a quarter rolled under the bed I wish I hadn't gone after it.  Lots of food and debris scattered under there!  Beds were comfy and AC worked great.  Easy drive to downtown St Louis.  Breakfast was hot and had a nice variety with eggs, sausage, biscuits and gravy in addition to all the cold items and waffles
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have lived in Indianapolis for four years now. I have not found a good Chinese food place but I had heard multiple times that Lotus Garden was the place to go. I finally found a lazy Sunday to go out and try a new restaurant. Unfortunately it did not live up to the hype. The staff was great, friendly and attentive but unless you love soy laced food I would not recommend this place. Every bite I felt like my sodium content was rising 200%. I can't stress however how good the staff was, this is just a personal preference when it comes to taste though. I might be one of the pickiest eaters on the planet.

Food was okay. Restaurant inside is super cheesy, Wasn't sure if they had pizza slices for sale because it looked like a pizzeria but no food was out. Looks like they bake their own bread which is good. We got a variety of pasta dishes with the penne being over cooked and the other linguini being cooked well. Plate of pasta was huge but for 17 dollars it better be. The house salad dressing was good, a little weird; tasted like a riff on thousand island. I live super close so I might come back but there is definitely better food in the area.

Delicious food, generous portions, great service. I have not been able to say no the guacamole...made fresh and chunky. If you are ready to try the not so standard fare, order the seafood soup. Shrimp, mussels, fish, crab, etc swimming in a clear spicy broth was a tasty delight with each spoonful. Our son had one of the largest burritos I've ever seen loading with so much filling the tortilla barely overlapped. My husband had the fajitas...meat tender and juicy. Give it a try! So much good food...so little time.

The worst. I would give it a 0 if I could. Smallest room with broken beds. No room service the second day. Clean up crew came in the the door without knocking on our last day. One of us just came out of the shower semi- naked, and we were horrified. This was 40 minutes before check out time. When we called the concierge, the lady picked up the phone with an 'I dont care attitude' no apologies, just connected us to housekeeping manager, who blamed it on the concierge who told them that our room was already checked out. Theres never been any type of apologies from the hotel. Its the worst.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: It's  a close call between a 1 star vs. 2.  I had pork chow fun. Where do I start? It was so bland. Chow fun should have onion, sprouts and or bok choy...this? No, carrot and snow peas, little bit of bamboo shoots and still no flavor. I also asked that they cut the amount of pork in half, but it doesn't appear that they did. The egg roll was ok, typical of most other places,  it the sweet and sour sauce that I requested for it literally tastes like dish detergent...ick. Won't be back...I'll stick with Chef Li when they reopen.

I was hesitant to try a new salon, but I'm glad I did! I heard a rumor that Kate Clark was 50% magic and 100% skill, but I'm not sure what that reviewer was thinking... Kate is most certainly 100% magic AND 100% skill! I'm pretty sure Criss Angel would be asking, "How did you do that?"

As a guy, I really wasn't intrigued to spend money on a haircut, but KINK is worth every penny. The KINK crew are all very friendly, and Kate is simply FREKIN' amazing!

If you want a great haircut/style and a fun experience, check out KINK!

Ahhhhhhh.  6:29 I order a gf pizza.  They tell me it'll be 45 min - 1 hr.  7:05 "manager" calls
To tell me they are out of gf pizza (btw prolly 3rd time in a yr), and I order wings and other food ... He tells me 30 min.  It's 8:32, I called 10 min ago they said 5 min... I'm still waiting.  It's always at least 1:30 ... But come on....  Plus, I have 4 yr old twins waiting for their diner... Eating pb&j....

So 9:00, owner delivers the food for free.  He's young and excited to be relevant.  I feel bad but he has to do better ... Too much competition....

Seriously the most disgusting bar I've been in especially for Nashville.  The moment you walked in it smelled like sewage. The only reason we went there was because my friend and I were handed coupons for $2 domestic beers which for Nashville is a great price. We sat down at the bar and waited a few minutes before even being acknowledged. A lady bartender walked over and said we'd like the domestics for $2, looked at us and walked away. Went to talk to a group of guys at the end of the bar and never returned. Walked out shortly after that and will not be returning.

The store is very affordable for families needing to stretch their dollar. It is also very ethic centric meaning any culture/ethnicity can go in and find what they are looking for. 
I use them occasionally when I am in the area and enjoy the fresh fried chicken. 

Another added positive is that the store is very good about keeping toiletries reasonably priced so you can get your paper towels, laundry detergent, aluminium and non food items right there. 

If you want to save $$$ this is the grocery store for you.

Bad services waited over an hour to get my sushi , and every time my hot tea or water keep running out I had to ask waiter if I could get more hot tea or water . I had to keep asking them for the paper to order more foods after the second time of ordering food I gave up I just wanted to leave . I usually go to the Franklin mills one in Philadelphia , but they close down heard one of my friend they open one up in Jersey my boyfriend and I went it just completely bad service. Not going to come back the food was okay , but the services was just bad .

Walk-ins on Tuesdays have increased to the normal $23 ever since my first cut last year -- but it is definitely worth it! I intend on coming here more often. The barbers have great personalities, they consistently give great cuts, and there is a phenomenal overall vibe to this shop! I've had great fades/trims by both Chase and TJ, and never had a problem! I really recommend coming here, especially since the shops around are either corporate chains with below-average barbers or are necessarily overpriced. Looking forward to my next cut.

Ate here for a friend's birthday dinner. Typical pub food, nothing earth shattering, but totally solid. Just good food. I had the Korean salmon. It was cooked perfectly and the sauce on top was delicious. My husband had the shrimp and grits. Really good, nice and creamy. Would have been even better if it were spicier. Cocktail and beer options were really good. Reasonable prices. Again, this place isn't forging any new culinary paths but the food is really good and the atmosphere is welcoming. The host told us to let him know if there was any particular game we wanted to watch on the TV and he would make it happen. We'll go again for sure.

We got take out so I'll start by saying it's probably not as good as eating at the restaurant. Good portions for the price, gave us an abundance of tortillas and chips, but taste overall pretty average. Mole sauce has no kick, pretty flavorless. The queso was tasty but way too thick, we practically had to cut it. Guac was awesome- fresh, huge chunks of avocado. Beans and rice just average, nothing special. Burrito was good but a huge mess of a presentation; we couldn't initially find it in the container. Not good enough to return, unfortunately!

Ok so i live a few blocks away from this dunkin donuts and have been going for the past 8 years. I cant break it down any simpler as they all just suck. Id say with out even any exaggeration they maybe get my order right 2 out of 10 times. I ask for iced coffes every time and i like them a certain way. And they never ever get it how i tell them! As far as the food goes i never really have a problem worth writing about, but my coffees i do. I actually called the district manager two years ago about my problems and still seems to be the same.

Made a spontaneous decision for a late Monday lunch stop, when we found Las M. Convenieny parking is located behind the buildinh.  They feature standard Mexican-American fare. We ordered the Chimichanga platter and the Enchilada-Burrito-Tamale combo. The Chimi outshined its neighbors, partly due to its white cheesy sauce covering.  The combo shared the same red chili sauce, which was good-not-great and tended to blend all the flavors. Next time ordering a combo, think about alternating the white and red sauces.

Called in for a special order of one of their items, could not have been more helpful and accommodating. Substituted two ingredients to a dish and they did not skimp. Chicken friend rice was wonderful in amount and quality of chicken and veggies. But it lacked a little flavor. Nothing you couldn't dock up at home. Also ordered teriyaki beef and was pleased with overall quality and flavor. They offer free delivery so I will definitely be going back in addition to the quality of food they serve. Prices are awesome as well.

Stopped here to workout after a meeting I had after work.  This place is disgusting - I hope people don't actually pay for this to be their home gym.  I'm under the impression they don't have that many patrons anyway because I was one of three people working out...after work!  This place is just old and grimy.  If they would actually clean it, it could be a really decent gym - it has everything you would really need but it's just too grimy and gross.  ESPECIALLY the bathrooms - yuck - I would have rather changed in my car on Pennsylvania Street.  I would never pay to come here and wouldn't encourage anyone to.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
For the umpteenth time, I've gone to this McDonald's and ordered a Dbl Quarter pounder with cheese and bacon, no onion. And for the umpteenth time they've forgotten to put bacon on it; sometimes they put the onions. I know it's a small request, but every time? They even wrote it on the little receipt on the box my burger comes in. Plus I'm pretty sure they charge for bacon. 
I have a huge liking for McDonald's and would never belittle the establishment as a whole, but how hard is it to put a couple pieces of bacon on it and not put onions?
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We have started out with my new kitten here and absolutely adore Dr. Shaw! She is real with you and loves on your pet the entire time! They are great about checking in with you after every visit to see how your pet is doing and they also have "fun visits" so you can swing in at any time, weigh your pet in the lobby and they get a treat to help them fight off those vet visit gitters. The only reason I am giving them 4 instead of 5 stars is because the pricing is on the high side, but we keep going because I know my baby is getting the best care!

hey i am usually a big fan of residence inns but this one didn't seem to be all there, it is a great layout of apartment like units, 2 levels and has a pool and here access to a health club across the street......service was very pleasant, breakfast was good, i guess my issues are with the physical plant
room ice maker does not work
bed has insulated comforter so you need the ac but ac is LOUD
the tub water controls are plumbed backwards, hot water comes on first, probably an osha thing
local tv channels were poorly received although the network channels seemed ok
free wifi was sometimes extremely slow

a disappointing visit
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Melt met all my expectations and more. My fiancé and I went for a lovely breakfast Saturday morning. The atmosphere was eclectic (as promised) but still comfortable for casual dining. We both took turns at the pinball machines and we're not disappointed. They have a change machine in the front and the bar is willing to break up larger bills. The waffles were excellent - I had the Granny Fanny and he had the Wake N' Bake. He also had a Pomegranate Mimosa which was surprisingly tasty (I don't like pomegranate or champagne). Seems like a great place for families and was definitely a fun, casual date!

this place is pretty solid. we had yellowtail, tuna, california roll, as well as gyoza and boise spring roll appetizers. but the best of all was the eel and cucumber hand roll--very good. my husband spent many years in asia, and has higher standards for sushi than i do, and even HE said he'd be happy to come back. he also liked that the tv was small, and only on one wall, and the music was innocuous. i have to admit, i'd rather not be listening to crap pop music, myself, and i was thankful that fujiyama didn't inflict it on us.

Unfortunately we have gone to this restaurant for several years but it has gone downhill. Tonight we waited over an hour for our meal and when we questioned the waitress she was unapologetic and actually told us that we don't need to rush. I agree we don't need to rush but an hour of waiting for our food is too long. It seems to me they need to get more help in the kitchen and on the floor (waitresses) to accommodate the amount of people who are starting to come in. The food is good but it's not worth the wait and the rudeness of the staff.

This is my favorite ice cream place in Tampa. It is a specialty ice cream place for the nitrogen ice cream, so yes it is pricey but worth it. The staff are always friendly. The actual ice cream is amazing and taste and quality of food is what matters to me. The only reason I don't give a full 5 stars is because it is expensive- $10+ for the nitrogen ice creams, but they are so big I always have some left over for a second dessert. Also, since Armature Works is popular, the line and the wait can be crazy which is annoying. But full 4 stars for the taste.

I am surprised to see all the positive reviews for this place. 

The service sucked... we sat at a family style table and servers kept hitting my chair and we were neglected for about half an hour without our meal and without seeing our server.

In addition to the poor service, the food was sub-par. I ordered a salmon roll, which was chewy and nothing impressive. In addition, I ordered the Sansai noodles, which I like to describe as an "old sock soup" taste.

I know my Japanese food and this place definitely does not make the cut. Save your money and time.

I ordered from here last night on GrubHub and thought I had selected to pay cash; apparently it went to my card. Without realizing this, we gave the delivery person the bill in cash plus a 20% tip. When I realized in the morning what had happened and called GrubHub, they investigated but the delivery person said I only gave them $11 as a tip. Pretty slimey, will not be ordering from them again. There are plenty of other Mexican places around the corner that are just as good and don't lie about ripping off their customers.

My husband and I come here often. We love their sushi. Sadly tonight is the last night we eat there again. We orderered 3 rolls and one of them took about 30 mins. We sat there waiting for that one roll, since we didnt want to be rude and cancel. As we were sitting there, a big cockroach was crawling on the wall right next to us. We told the waiter and she grabbed a napkin and killed it. This was pretty gross. We didnt make a big deal but we have decided we will not be back. If theres one cockroach then I can imagine theres more. I hope they do something about it.

I never had a bad experience while at this gym. The staff was friendly and the environment was great as well. It's a smaller gym but pretty much has everything you need to get a workout in. Also felt very clean and I often saw them cleaning floors, equipment and bathrooms. 

Yes, sometimes machines were broken for a good amount of time but usually could find something to substitute for a workout. And there is only one squat rack so I would have to wait a while to use it some days. 

Overall if you want a clean and welcoming gym to get a good workout in, this location is great.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
After a long day at work, coffee can make the rest of your night better. Well that is what I was expecting when I pulled into the drive-thru at this Dunkin' Donuts. What I did receive was a disgusting iced coffee. It was warm and not made how I ordered it. I specifically ordered french vanilla swirl with sugar and cream. The first sip was bland and chunks of sugar were floating around. 

In conclusion, an all around bad experience. This Dunkin' is definitely not up to par with other locations. I would definitely not recommend traveling to this one.

Rude, disgusting and has roaches! 
I took me and my daughter roaches continuously crawling on our feet i told them and they knocked my daughter nails off they wash out their disposable clothes and reuse to many items. They only have a few pedi chairs that work and they water heater must've been broke cause the water was like ice. I will never return to this hell hole the put it in the hood where half these chicks don't know anything past what these ignorant motherfuckers offer and they curse them out but still come back in two weeks ‍ i hope this place close soon

I was extremely disappointed with this place considering it's right across the way from my apartment complex. I ordered the tri-tip combo with the cucumber salad and cole slaw. The tri-tip had no flavor and was tough. The cucumber salad was soggy with no crunch what-so ever. Honestly the only thing that was good from here was the garlic bread and soda. The place itself is clean and conveniently located but the food sucked. Hopefully the owners close this place down to allow another restaurant to open up with some good food.

Just took my minivan in this past week for the very first time with a broken flex pipe and leaking rack and pinion.   I have to say, I refuse to go anywhere else now.  Everyone has been so great and so helpful.  I trust them.  I have had many issues with other places not being honest and I have always ended up feeling like I couldn't trust what I was being told.  That is definitely not the case here.  I feel like my car is in the best of hands.  The problem with my car was explained in detail and I was shown exactly where the problem was.  Everything was crystal clear.   This is where I will be taking my car from now on.  Thank you all!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Very disappointed and would not recommend to anyone. Within minutes of being within the venue, our group of 5  was approached by the "manager" and we were instructed "don't make to much noise or you will be kicked out" despite the fact we were not making any noise. Bartenders were friendly, but manager ruined the experience. What a disappointment! Will not be recommending this place to any friends and will not be returning. Not deserving of our money. Lots of cool, nice local bars to check out instead! Highly suggest ANY other place.

It's ok. Clean. Nicely decorated rooms. Staff seem friendly. Cons-staying in a room for 4 nights with no fridge or microwave was a drag, very limited channel selection on TV, pretty compact rooms, breakfast buffet is mediocre at best w/ wait staff non-existent during this time. Couldn't get coffee, juice or water to save my life. Nothing useful nearby such as gas station for getting beer/wine. Target nearby for other needs. Limited restaurants within walking distance. Probably great for a single night stay but if you're staying for a week you need a little bit more than they have to offer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Visited this café during my stay in New Orleans.  

It was convenient since I was staying at the Blake Hotel.  It is located in the Blake Hotel off of the St. Charles Ave. car line.

I ordered the Crab Cake Benedict, which was a brunch special.  At $16, I thought that was pricey at first.  But when the food came out, I was pleased with the presentation and tastiness of the food.

The ambience at this café was nice as you can see great views of the bustling city.

You definitely need to arrive at a good time for breakfast (between 8 am -9 am) as this small café tends to get crowded very quickly.

I remember going to Japonais over 5years ago- it really was spectacular back then. I still think they're a great japanese joint & probably still one of the best sushi places in Edmonton. The quality (&value) may not be as great as it used to be, & it is a tad bit expensive. However, I would still highly recommend this place. 

I usually try their makimono (specialty rolls) but tried a few different things off the menu this time. 

Had the pressed salmon sushi, calamari, bento boxes (that came with a great selection of sashimi, nigiri, tempura, & miso soup!). 

Complimentary salad :)

Just came from Arigato Sushi and tried Edomasa on the recommendation from a fellow Yelper.  For a better deal and better sushi this is the place (so far).  It's only 5 minutes west of downtown and worth the trip.  I went and got the sushi & sashimi combo for $3 less than Arigato and much better quality and quantity of food.  Edomasa's combo came with nice slices of fish and came with rice, miso soup, veggie pickles, Daikon, ice cream mochi and good green tea.  The fish was good quality and the overall meal was satisfying and delicious.

Their chai tea latte with oat milk is my favourite. 
BUT
The place needs a facelift. It's showing it's age with scuffed walls, no merch, USB ports that don't work, etc. What happened to the Second Cup brand? This store is kind of a dive. Staff clean it but they can only do so much!!
The management is not good to their staff. There should never be one person on staff at a coffee bar. Come on! Especially later in the day. 
Management treats staff poorly. They make scenes in front of staff and guests. It's embarrassing. 
Again with the brand - what happened to Second Cup?

Worst Mexican food I've ever had. The margaritas were neon green and tasted like lemon-lime kool aid mixed with battery acid. The chicken tasted like it was from a can and the rice was dry and crunchy. Would never go back. Service was subpar and argumentative. When we asked to have the drinks taken off our bill because we didn't like them (and didn't drink them), we were told that everyone else who goes there loves them and we were basically wrong. Additionally, the windows we were seated next to were cracked from top to bottom and held together with packing tape. Save the money and the headache! Do not go!

Nice enough hotel. large rooms with small fridge and microwaves...so that's a plus. Construction at the moment set off the fire alarm one night. You could hear the dings on the elevator 5 rooms away. There are 2 buildings to this hotel, not connected except by lobby floor....easy to take the wrong elevator since no signs let you know what rooms they access. The hotel rented the pool out for a function on a Sat from 2-10pm. Imagine not being able to use the pool on a hot weekend afternoon. Good breakfast everyday 6-10.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This is a nice place. Good service and a nice menu. I had a Paris summer cocktail which was tasty albeit a bit tart. My huckleberry salad was great with awesome presentation, my husband had the pork shank which was excellent.  My huckleberry short rib was good but a little dry, 
same with my potatoes and is why I gave it four stars . It was nice to have the valet parking as we were traveling with suitcases in the back of our pickup and nice to not have to look for parking. There is no charge if you are eating there and the valets were superb.  A great choice for dinner

Been here for 2 1/2 weeks service is ok. Cleaning ladies are super loud! I work nights and they act like nobody's around. Even called the front desk guess it pissed them off so they got louder. Breakfast sux's too. "Continental my ass" ! Options are limited, food is the same , breakfast starts at 6 and it really does. Nothing is ready so you gotta hover the small breakfast area to wait for food. Don't know how they got so many stars? Must be from paid people. I've stayed in many Hampton inns this one is not the worst but it's up there.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Honestly, sushi doesn't get any better than Osaka. From drinks, to service to quality of food, it's a home run all around. My first experience was on Christmas Eve. We ordered several different types of sushi, the shrimp tempura, and the tempura appetizer. All were delicious. Since then, my boyfriend and I have been trying to come weekly. The waitress' are always so kind, have great recommendations. The sushi is fresh and comes in large portions. I definitely recommend the speciality rolls. They are very filling.

Kind of disappointed, it seemed so promising at first! The food is really, really good. The interior is very modern and clean as well. The reason I'm only giving a 3 star rating is because of the service. Although the employees are friendly, we had to tell them nearly everything at least twice. Drinks, more food, payments. Eventually one worker would just forget about something and another would come along asking what we needed again. I won't tell you not to come by, though. Everyone's experience is different!

So disappointed with how my hair turned out. She gave me a quote of $330 for balayage, hair treatment n hair. I told her I wanted my hair grey and to make sure it wasn't brassy if its going to cost me that much. She agreed. Well first thing is my hair cut took 5 minutes because I didnt want to cut off a lot n I was still charged $50. Got to the register n they end up changing me $399... I paid it n tipped her. My hair was grey so  I was happy but the next day I wash my hair and all the grey is gone. Now my hair is brassy and dead even if I use the purple shampoo they sold me. Very disappointing when i spent over $400.

I would call my meal here wildly mediocre and my service subpar.  Was dying for a spot to eat in Fitler Square, but this didn't do it for us.  The rigatoni and meatballs sauce was missing flavor,  it was bland.  Salt helped the dish but it was so underwhelming.  The signature Cotoletta stack was good,  but that's it -  just good.
