Decent flavor in it but the lack of flavor from pasta dish left us dissatisfied.  Place had a lot of patrons so I hope that they're figuring out the kinks and can get it together,  but from my experience-  not worth it.

The ice cream was just ok - definitely not worth a cheat day treat. Baskin Robbins offers better tasting ice cream. The rating is mostly for the inflexibility of the servers. They would not put my mother's banana split (her once a year treat) in a non-boat container even though we explained that we had to travel 20 mins and it would spill everywhere. They gave us a box to put the boat in. I placed it in the vehicle and the lid popped off the banana boat. It was a soupy mess. We eventually went to Dippy's to satisfy my mom's banana split craving.

Don't waste your money. Get better quality ice cream and better service elsewhere.

Wonderful!
This SUV had to be used for a month of construction work, as in, all supplies in the back :(   My wife was ready to have a cow!   Its her car :/
The people here were very professional and did a beautiful job.  Everyone was extremely nice and helpful.  This was a pleasant experience with a nice waiting room full of cool car products available for purchase, coffee, tv.
I'm glad I wasn't scared off by the bad reviews.  I purchased the $39.95 Amoral Special.  
I'll be returning.  They really did a beautiful job!

What a great ice cream place in NOLA! We came here for a treat on our first day here and absolutely loved it. The speciality here is definitely the waffle cones and the scent SMACKS you in the face - in a good way! - right when you walk in. Let me tell you, it smells DELICIOUS in here!

There are a lot of really unique ice cream flavors here, and most importantly, you can ask for samples before committing! Highlights were definitely the creole cream cheese and dark chocolate. We didn't order them in waffle cones, but I really wish I did. Will for sure come back when I'm back in New Orleans.

Stopped in for a "why not" drink after work with a girlfriend. Lived in the area my whole life and it seems like a great local dive bar, with pool and cheap drinks. I'm female and it seems like it attracts the male crowd, given that it's that type of bar, but everyone seemed pretty okay and not exclusive which is great. 

We ordered mild wings and I can't believe I'm saying this but for a tiny bar, they were absolutely amazing. And good price! Great local bar for Telford where there isn't all that many options! Only downside is they allow smoking and it's very smokey.

Came in 2006 nails fell off and went back twice recently great experience for the most part. Until I came with a friend made an appointment and I got my nails done by Lilly and she got her nails done by a guy with tattoos and a hat didn't know his name a week later all the nails on her left hand fell off  I called and they simply said it was because her nails are short or if she did them very unhappy with this will never come back if they can't treat me or my friends with a little respect she paid over $40 for her nails and it hasn't even been two weeks and they were trying to argue with me

Most impressive: the spacious rooms! I had a one bedroom, and it felt like an apartment. There is a fully equipped kitchen, a dining area with two chairs, and the living room couch is quite comfortable. There is a TV in both the living room and the bedroom. There is plenty of closet space and a sink area separate from the shower and toilet. Breakfast was nice with plenty of selection. There were some things that made it feel not very well kept up-- hand prints on the windows in my room, the front of the TV stand falling off, scratches and mess all in the sink drawers. Overall, a decent place to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: While this hotel was quite nice, the price for the breakfast buffet was incredibly overpriced. The food choices were just "ok", and for $20+ i was expecting something more. What was quite odd however, the server always "sang" her response after I said thank-you if she brought me something. It got old quick. The bar had decent food. I had the chicken wings there which were moderately priced, however the loud drunk people sitting at the bar made the experience off putting. It was hard to ignore their behavior. The staff at the front desk were great, and quite friendly which is always good to see.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Be prepared for something simple. For me was acceptable as I booked on the same night and was looking for something cheaper.

Breakfasts is suuuuuper basic. 

Was quiet. 

Room old and dates and dirty carpet, but was clean. 

Coffee machine with issues, but I could make it work with some workaround.

They extended my checkout for 1h, what was good. 

Unfortunately I'll not return.

I recommend a remodeling in the rooms and organize the wires of the TV, and enhance to only one remote, and better aircon control.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The food was fine and exactly what we ordered/expected from a Wendy's, but the staff was very short with my wife and I. All I did was ask what condiments came on the baconator and the register lady Mina looked at me like I was an asshole and rolled her eyes and sped through what was on it. Also, I've been here a few times since they put in the new Coca-Cola Freestyle machines and consistently every time there is never any syrup in it. I'm drinking FRUIT PUNCH FANTA. NO ONE LIKES FRUIT PUNCH FANTA. Obviously I'm not expecting much because it's a Wendy's in New Castle, but they don't have to be rude about everything

Overall, we enjoyed Tutti Frutti. It was clean, quick and easy. BUT, we have one big complaint/suggestion: 
We tried cookie and cream flavor and cheesecake. The cookies and cream was very nice and refreshing but the cheesecake on the other hand was the kind of yogurt that you will get sick of after a few big bites. The biggest issue was that the flavor was far too sour. It tasted more like custard than anything or very cheap gas station cheese cake. Was it so bad that we wanted to kill ourselves? No , but we contemplated it. Anyway, overall good location.

I used to swear by these guys.  The last time they did a shoddy job, I figured it was just a bad day.  This afternoon, I paid for "the works" as I always do.  When I got back in, my dash still had a thick layer of dust on it, my cup holders and other nooks hadn't been touched, and my touch screen was still layered in fingerprints.  I'm not expecting a full detail for $20, but they could have dipped the vacuum in the cup holders and ran the rag over my dash and door handles while they were wiping my seats.  

On the upside, my floor mats look great and the cashier woman was super nice.

This restaurant is our favorite place to dine in (wife & I) for a nice peaceful romantic dinner.

We are always greated & seated fairly quickly but please make sure you try to make reservations in advance as that helps being seated sooner. Our waiters & waitresses have always been respectful & punctual with our meal orders.

Food selection & specials are phenomenal and way better then Olive Garden or Romana Mac Grille when you compare taste & cost.

I highly recommend this restaurant!

Thank you, Allegria Italiana & staff.

Dr. Bufkin came to our home to perform in home euthanasia for our very sick, old dog Caesar. The experience was everything I hoped it would be. Dr. Bufkin was amazing, she provided the closure we needed; to know we were making the best choice for our old boy. He got to leave this earth surrounded by his family, on his favorite couch. Our other dogs were able to see him after to give them some closure as well. We still were able to opt for the cremation we wanted. I would 100% chose in home euthanasia with Dr. Bufkin again.

Horrible experience last time I was on vacation...cashier was very rude, and didn't even shake the McFlurry I ordered because they were "busy" and they didn't "have to do it". I was very disappointed when another customer ordered a McFlurry and they shook it for them. I just thought the service was bad and they had limited items (they didn't have parfaits, no ice cream cones). I saw the manager doing his job and others in the kitchen, but everyone I talked to was having a hard time with the ladies on the register.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place serves great neapolitan style pizza! My husband and I shared a caesar salad and a margherita pizza. Both dishes were delicious. The sauce was really flavorful and the cheese and basil were plentiful. Criticisms would be the restaurant decor: replace the ugly long dead roses in the vases and clean the grooves in the tables where obvious crumbs and other dirt is accumulating. Also, the size of the salad didn't seem to justify the price. These defects don't change the fact that the food was fabulous, hence the 5 stars; we'd go back in a heartbeat.

Ya so, the commercials are way better than the actual food you get. Not surprised. Ya me either, but this ones way off. I was looking forward to some brisket and what I got was so thinly sliced you could literally see through it. And it was 9 bucks!!!  Coke tasted like Diet Coke and Dr Pepper tasted like soda water. Ok, I get t. It's fast food. What do you expect. But when your paying $9 bucks, you start to question these things. I think I'd rather pay $10 bucks and go to Dickies for my next brisket Sammy. Just saying. Why pay restaurant prices but get fast food quality. I like to leave something positive, so, the fries were good. :)

Food is good, but I have yet to get an order right. There is always something wrong. Order tomatoes and lettuce on the sandwich, it comes without. Order a grilled chicken on a kaiser, you get a chicken cheesesteak. Order a white pizza, get a regular plain pizza. Lucky for them, I eat almost everything, so I am pretty forgiving, and I dont complain. But, I do wonder, when I am placing an order online - How are you consistently getting it wrong? It's not like you misheard me on the phone. It's right there! Like I said - the food is good, if they could get it right, I'd give them 5 stars. But they never, ever, get it right, so 3 stars it is.

Classics is pretty much the best place around Tioga. However lately they have really been slipping. The only time I get good food is if a manager is there. Yes I have been paying attention. Just last night I got buffalo wings which are usually awesome. Last night they were over cooked, hard, not great looking at all! Another night I ordered a steak Stromboli and it had nothing but cheese. Hardly any steak or onions in it. Please get it together because I really like the staff and food but it has been hit or miss with the food lately and I don't like wasting money.

I would not recommend staying at Hotel ML. The room was dirty with stains on the bed skirts, walls, curtains and floor.  All of the furniture is worn down with tons of scratches. The popcorn ceiling was stained as well and looks like it has had water damage. Our room did not get cleaned by house keeping for the duration of our stay.  As for the water park it was very disappointing.  We did not mind that is was on the smaller side but the fact that the water was cold, it was over crowded and dirty was not ok.  Honestly, any clean hotel with an indoor pool would have been better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Cash only  / BYOB

Taco portions are generous and very fresh ingredients. Same with generous guacamole ($7)! Complimentary chips smothered with refried beans and queso fresco are delicious, especially with the green salsa (tomatillo?). Al pastor tacos ($10 for 3) have a lot of flavor and spice. Pairs well with Mexican coke. Flan ($4) is creamy, with deep caramel flavor, and addictive! Overall great portion and authentic quality for the price. Bill for dinner for two about $30-40. 

Cute atmosphere/decorations inside and just two blocks from Fishtown/Girard ave main drag, and Girard MFL stop.

This place is crap. One caveat was the dude at the counter, he was courteous and helpful with a nickel as well... the food on the other hand was poop. I mean I know all they are doing is reheating pre-made patties and ingredients, so I'd expect you to at least do that right.
 As I sat at this location with my Mother, and trying to cover the taste of the atrocity I just took a few bites of ( I couldn't force myself to finish this $5.00 piece of crap) with the coffee, she starts to look like she needs to go home. So later on she tells me that the sandwich she had ordered made her feel ill. Thanks DD !

Second time getting nails done here after a good first experience. Made an appointment (at beginning of their day!). Ended up waiting 15-20 min past my appointment time before they got started. Then the woman who did my nails didn't talk at all so it was awkward the whole time. And she didn't prep my nails at all, so my acrylics lasted a whole 3 days before they began literally just falling off. SO disappointed. Will not be returning as that was a complete waste of time and money! Literally would give 0 stars if that was an option.

Taste = good.

Price = on the expensive side and portions are skimpy.

Service = irritated and impatient staff (One customer: "Can I get a sample taste?" Staff: "Only if there isn't anyone waiting.") There wasn't anyone waiting - so why say it? Does it take THAT long to serve up a sample taste?

Don't bring a coupon because you may be greeted with an exasperated sigh from the staff. 

Maybe the ice cream at Daddy O's tastes better than the kind you buy at the supermarket...but the self-checkout register at Shop-Rite doesn't give you any attitude when you bring your business there.

You could at least pretend to care about your residents and properly clean off the walkways after winter weather. I watched a small child plummet to her face this morning trying to navigate herself on the slippery, still packed with snow, sidewalk. You make no attempts to even salt or de-ice walkways. You are slumlords at best. Do better. What you charge in rent alone is a crime for the absolute blatant disregard at proper property management and residential treatment. 

Do yourself a favor and never rent from here. You will sorely regret it. I promise you can find better than this, for the same price.

I had to bring my friend to the airport recently, so we stayed the night at her relatives. This bar was about ten minutes from the house on foot. It was a great experience. We didn't get to eat there as we had already had dinner, so I can't speak as to the food quality, but the drinks were made well and were priced very decently. The bartender was very nice and attentive. We sat outside on the patio and it was a great time. I would absolutely come back again. The only thing I can say that needs attention is the liquor display. It's a bit lack luster, but hey, it's a nice place to have a beverage, so it's alright!

The food was okay but there are definitely better sushi and hibachi joints in the area. What really threw us off was the service. Our waitress stood 3 feet from our table and watched us eat and drink. I felt so creeped out like we were being observed. I felt like I couldn't even have a normal conversation or dinner with my boyfriend because we were being watched and listened to so intently. Our plates were being taken away before we could even put our forks down. I would say they were trying to rush us out but it was empty in the restaurant and it was nowhere near closing time. If you're looking for a pleasant dinner, look elsewhere.

I gave it 2 stars because the food was OK. The attitude of the house staff was horrible. Table of 10. 2 people ordered the special sea bass. 1 came out looking beautiful. The second looked like it was thrown on the plate at the last second. when asked why we were told "you got fish,spinach and risotto what more do you want". The special rib eye steak was at least 40% fat. There are so many great restaurants in this area for anyone to go here and be treated to OK food at crazy prices and get treated poorly. Go somewhere else.

This was a pretty convenient car wash because it's on my way home. You go in and they have several options on how well you want your car washed.i chose the pretty basic one which is only $6 bucks. Once you're done you are more than welcomed to vacuum your car and I haven't done so in the longest so I went with the vacuuming. Everything went well but the vacuums don't have the best suction, I had to go from one to the other, I blame people who suction the big things. Anyways staff was very friendly. I would highly recommend you to come if you need a quick wash for your car.

Went there tonight for takeout. I used my restaurant.com certificate for $5 off when you spend $10. I had a taste for fries, so I got the turkey burger since fries came with it. Well, the owner was rude and impatient when I was trying not to spend over $10 to use the certificate. Service went from nothing special to crappy. I was told it would be a 5 minute wait. It was 20 + minutes. When I got home, I saw they took extra time to burn the fries. Burger was decent, if not lukewarm. Apparently, this is what you get when you use a coupon or discount.

I went in with an asymmetrical (and pretty complex) cut that needed touch up trimming. The young woman who took care of me, Tiffany, did her best to match the original look. At one point, she got a little stumped but she didn't hesitate to ask for help. This is something I appreciated more than I could express!! Most stylists will go with it and butcher your hair without a word. Tiffany was kind and patient. And even though she struggled just a little, my haircut turned out even cooler than the original I had!! Thank you, Tiffany! I love it.

My groomer moved out of the city, so in search of a new place I came across Pet Vet Clinic. I called at the beginning of the week and got an appointment with Lori for that Saturday and she even called me when an earlier appointment opened up in the morning. She did a wonderful job on my little Amelie! She was done within a couple of hours which I really appreciate...I hate when I have to leave her at a place for a long time because she gets very stressed out. She came home perfectly groomed and in good spirits! So happy this place is a half a block away!

This place is fantastic. This is my second time here and both times were Phenomenal !!!!! The first time I got the bread service and enjoyed kind of making my own pizza with the unique sides. This time around I got the street corn pizza. It was also so uniquely delicious. I would probably get the bread over the pizza but I am so glad I tried it. I just wish I had someone to share with me. I also got the chocolate cake. It is slightly molten and very rich. I brought 1/2 home and plan on adding a lot more whip cream but well worth it!

I think these folks are dealing with serious start-up jitters. We had dinner here on Sunday 11/24 and it was OK but just OK. It looks like they are setting themselves up to focus on high end entrees but they need to convince their customers they can do the basics first. My miso soup was good. My cucumber vinaigrette salad was very good. My crab roll in cucumber wrap was not bad. My wife had shrimp pad Thai and the shrimp were over cooked. The noodles and the sauce were good but a bit too highly seasoned for my wife.
We will give them a few more weeks to overcome their startup pains before we give up on them.

Went to PI with three other people. We all ordered small deep dish pizzas. We all loved our pizzas. The only complaint is that one of the signiture pizzas had both banana peppers and Kalamata olives was a bit salty. The wait staff was pretty friendly, except that when we arrived we were the only customers in the restaurant and we were seated in the back of the restaurant rather than being asked if we wanted to sit by the wall, window, or ouside. Also when we were leaving I asked the hostess for a bag and she in her very bored state sent me to the bar. Great waitress though, nice ambiance, and great pizza.

Such a shame. We love Baskin Robbins, there is nothing else like it. But this one keeps going downhill. They are constantly out of something...every single time we go in. In the past 5 visits over several months, they have been out of rocky road, pralines n cream, butter pecan, nuts, and even bananas. Especially in the pre packed quarts.  How are you out of bananas when there is a publix directly next door?? The employees never apologize for being out of something. If you cannot consistently get what is on the menu,something is very wrong with the management. I hope they stay open, but something needs to improve.

To respond to the other poster, my wife and I have brought our vehicles to Joe's for years.   We have no complaints or issues.  Joe's people are fair, upfront with their feedback about what is best, and are connected to many local auto places to find part options so you are not paying dealer level price for everything.  

If you want good service without being sweet talked into something you don't need, bring your vehicle in.  They are usually busy, so call ahead to see when you can get everything checked out that you need.

Visited near the holidays. Decorations were lovely and though it was busy, it wasn't overly loud. The server was incredibly nice and mostly attentive. The Bacon Wrapped Shrimp appetizer was plenty for two, and the flavor was wonderful. We both ordered dishes that had scallops (e.g. lobster/scallop ravioli dish that was a special of the day) and the scallops were cooked beautifully and the flavors were amazing. The wine selection was good. Just a nice place with good ambience and good food. Definitely planning a return visit.

My friend and I went there for a pizza and salad.  Nice new atmosphere except for the table we were sitting at backed up to the seats at the counter and the waitress hardly had any room to get through.  I'm used to ordering my pizza the way I like it and you couldn't do that as it is all pre-made.  It was also not cooked to my liking as it was very soggy in the middle.  It could be me, as others have raved about this place.  I personally will not be back for pizza.  Staff was very friendly, but pizza not so much.

I have used this place about 10 times since I moved to south philly and 7 out of 10 they was LATE...YES!! 7 out of 10, I keep going back because I wanted it to work and it was convenient. The last time I went was the final straw, they was once again LATE and now they lost my tie. I had to go back and forth for almost two weeks, until they got it right. I could care less about the lost tie but the way it was handle, was pathetic at best. If you like having your items go missing and receiving it late, this is the place to go, if not KEEP AWAY!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
In all my years of dry cleaning experiences I've never had to request creases in a men's long sleeved dress shirt. 
I've used this dry cleaner several times and finally remembered to ask about the creases and the young man working said creases were done by request only. 
I also had to request the collar be paid attention to because I noticed they were coming back dirty.
They were new shirts, worn a couple of times so it wasn't like the collars were filthy and had been worn for months without being cleaned. 
I won't be returning.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: We had the most amazing stay at the Moonrise Hotel!  From the wonderful staff (thanks Justice & Yvonne) to the out of this world decor to the perfect amenities (love the aveda products) to the comfy bed to great neighborhood (The Loop) right outside the door!  It was perfect.  This one night stay just made me feel so happy and geekishly wonderful!  I have never been affected by any other hotel like this.  I am excited to come back - not long enough!  This hotel is a must if you are traveling to St Louis - and well worth it if it is the reason you travel here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My wife and I have been to the El Dorado and the Silver Legacy a number of times, but had not tried this pizza place.  After walking in, a group of three or four employees were a few feet away from the counter all huddled around a phone or something.  We approached the counter and did not get even a hint of acknowledgment from the staff.  I had to say, "Excuse me..." to finally get their attention.  I asked how long they would be open, and the female employee kind of shrugged and said, "around 2:30 or something ilke that".  We ended up choosing to eat the buffet instead - the buffet had very good pepperoni pizza, btw.

I will never go to this car wash again. They do a horrible job. I took my daughters car there today and paid $16 and the car was still filthy when they gave it to me. I asked to see the manager and showed him the sand and dog hair and asked him to redo it or do something and he refused. He said that wasn't included in my price! The outside was still dirty. The rubber mats were still filled with sand.  More importantly he was rude to me and basically said he didn't care that I was unhappy.  He just told me thanks and walked away.  I said "don't you care about customer service?"  He said no.  Disgusted!

Stayed from Monday to Thursday, check in took some time but that was due to the fact that there was an annoyed customer so the front desk took care of that first. The rooms are definitely smaller than anticipated, but everything was fine inside. I saw reviews about how dirty the room was (rusted door hinges, old putty in the shower, etc) which I did observe but it wasnt anything for me to be angry over. It's an old building. The restaurants food was great and didnt cost an arm and a leg. They have a gym and a hot tub(which never got hot? But kinda bubbled...) it was a good decent hotel. Nothing new or fancy but we didnt have an issue really.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
If you want some place quick and not meticulous, this is the place to go to.

I'm not an extremely picky person, but I'd like for someone to hear me out and cater to what I want. I got a color change and the technician who did my nails has a different way of doing things. First, she didn't remove my old nail polish right all the way. Then she rushed through painting my nails and some coating is thicker than the other nails on my hands. I left unsatisfied, but I was over it and decided I do not want to go here ever again.

I don't like wasting time and resources. I showed up for my appointment. Due to a "mix up" in scheduling on their part, no doctor showed up. In fact, no doctor was scheduled to show up for the day. I was already seated in the exam room when the news was shared. The staff members were apologetic, but it was definitely not professional for the business to negatively impact an office full of patients. We're too advanced for an error like this to occur. Not to mention I received a call from their office a day prior to confirm the appointment and my insurance.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: If you want the most violent case of food poisoning this is your place! I ate here on Friday 8/11/17 around 4:00. I will never eat at a McDonalds again after how sick I was. I got chicken nuggets, and clearly they weren't kept at the proper temperature. Eat at your own risk here. I tried called all day on Saturday to let them know so they can try to be safer in the future and never picked up the phone all day. I finally got through to a manager named Sarah on Sunday at 6pm and she was extremely rude and unapologetic, completely unprofessional. For the sake of everyone out there, avoid it!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is usually my favorite pizza spot ... was very disappointed with the take order I picked up .. I ordered the everyday large pizza wings and cheese fries special for 20.00.. what a waste !!! The cheese fries were missing the "cheese" someone threw a bunch of soggy unseasoned fries in a take out container without adding any cheese .. the large pizza was definitely a small pizza .. the slices are usually very big and this pizza was not a large .. the 5 wings were terrible as well .. the service was also rushed ... extremely disappointed with my order and when I called about my fries no one picked up

Stayed at the Westin Indianapolis for a night in early November and can honestly say that it doesn't come close to other Westins properties. Granted, the location is ideal as it is connected to the Convention Center where you can walk indoors directly to/from Lucas Oil Stadium. It definitely is beneficial and helpful during colder weather months.   
That being said, my room was ok and customer service wasn't helpful at all when I called in to report an noise complaint. Pretty disappointing, to say the least, and will definitely stay somewhere else when I return to Indianapolis.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I frequent Gus and generally find the staff pleasant and helpful. However on Tuesday 6 30 I had a disappointing encounter with Dave . Dave was on his knees stocking wine. He had a mask on but it was only covering his mouth. I asked if he could put the mask over his nose since I would be within 6 feet of him to select my wine. Dave became angry and told me he didnt have to put his mask over his nose. I told him I am a nurse and he is wrong. That he is contaminating customers by wearing his mask improperly.  He actually was arguing and I walked away. Did not feel safe.

We come for the burrata ...  and for the feeling we are like their family! Seriously this is the ultimate in family cooking but with class. Having just come back from a week
In Positano where burrata is king, the melt in your mouth mozzarella at Girasole tonight was fabulous. 
And the ravioli special has homemade pasta so light and fluffy I could have eaten two portions. 
A jewel on the Avenue of the Arts here in Philly.  Sometimes a bit too quiet , I hear that     their special pizza oven arrives soon and crowds will follow and I know that our host Michelle will smiling even more!

It's a mixed reviewed place for a reason. I've had good and bad experiences here. I've had great Bloody Mary's with great service on random mornings/early afternoons, and I've had terrible service at night. Same goes for the food; it's hit and miss. It comes down to who is working on staff when you visit. My suggestion if you are curious from 'Bar Rescue', stop in for one drink in the early afternoon. Feel out the vibe and see if the staff working is attentive. It's definitely a 1-2 drink stop as you move on to other places. Unless you want that glowing 'Resurrection' cup.

So... It's a hotel lobby Starbucks. Pretty typical. Small and limited seating. 
Today, however, the crew seemed to be somewhat flummoxed by the whole process. The two young men at the counter were trying very hard to provide good service but they seemed to be a little overwhelmed by the process - not providing bags, forgetting if they had rung things up, etc. They both were very friendly - welcoming each customer and saying "thank you." I appreciate that. 
The coffee is fine and better than the mass-produced brown stuff in the conference urns!

Stopped in for lunch and was not disappointed. Laid back vibe, quickly seated and provided with our drink order. Waiter also brought Italian bread, oil and Parmesan cheese to start.

I ordered the Piacere and was not disappointed. The clams and shrimp were perfectly cooked, linguini was just this side of done done. The dish was well spiced and had just enough heat.  

The meal came with a house salad and the  salad was mediocre. The assorted greens were pretty limp and weren't a good mouth experience. Everything else, delicious and I would return.

Rented car from Souderton location.  Car reserved not provided and provided with a car not of same caliber yet charged same price as a luxury car.replacement  broke down stranding daughter and wife on side of road for 5.5 hours waiting for tow truck .  

Family had to find own transportation to nearest enterprise 3 hours away then wait another 2.5 hours for a replacement car. 

Have waited almost one week for response from enterprise as promised to address this service fail and no one has reached out in spite of them promising to do so fo address this.

My mom is a cancer surgical patient at Ochsner Medical Center and this hotel was one recommended by the hospital. I had no problems with the room or with the staff, but definitely with the guests and I blame staff for that. It's a little before 3am and I haven't been to sleep because guests are being loud and obnoxious (I'm on the first floor near check in so night manager has to hear it and I've complained). We've had people randomly knocking on our door and leaving too. I'm too exhausted for this. What a complete waste of money. I guess if you rent a hotel room for anything other than sleep, this place will be fine for you.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I purchased an oil special from Groupon for $54 it just so happened I received a discount that day. It was supposed to be 3 oil changes in a pkg. I thought this was a Great deal. I called to book my apt and was informed by the receptionist there was an additional $19 fee for each oil  
change. I said this is totally outrageous, who charges $19 for enviro fees.? The lady then told me if I didn't like it you don't have to come here. Go somewhere else!! 
Well guess what, I did go somewhere else and I sure didn't pay a $19 enviro fee. I paid Nothing!!! MY advice is Buyer Beware and read the fine print.

When we walked in, we noticed their AC in the hibachi area seemed to be broken. There are also no hood vents/ ventilation so the smoke from the surrounding grills floated over to our table. We were seated at one of the hibachi grills and the floors and menus were sticky. The menus were also in very bad condition (ripped, stained, etc). Our waitress wasn't very friendly, either. We paid for our untouched drinks (yes paid) and left. Very sorry to see this place go so far downhill; we've been customers for 13 years.

Two stars for dedicating a lot of time to help me research tire options. However I was disappointed in the pricing even within their own chain. Though I do know they are independently franchised, the quotes weren't even remotely close. For the same branded/model tire it was close to a $400 difference. There was also a failure to mention there was a rebate for said tire for $70 savings. It was only offered for the sister brand ( and lower quality option). I ended up going to the same chain just different location and getting my desired tire for less than the quote on the low end option.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Was craving sushi so I thought I'd check out one of Tucson's sushi places I hadn't been to yet.  Went at 8 on a Sunday so the place was dead.  

This place has pretty average sushi, nothing special but it's still okay for the middle of the desert.  It was on the cheaper side which is always nice.  The best part was the speed and the completeness of the meal.  I was seated, ordered, ate 2 sushi rolls, a salad, and miso soup, and paid all in less than 45mins.  The salad and the soup was included which is always nice and helps round out a sushi meal.

My husband and I just moved to Tampa and we've been looking for an all you can eat spot....glad that we found this place! It was super clean, the service was great, and the food was delicious! Also the AYCE price was $2 cheaper from what we normally have in Colorado. There was a wide variety of appetizers, sushi, specialty rolls, and ice cream flavors. They also have a bar for alcoholic drinks. They looked so pretty so we definitely have to check those out next time. We had a great experience and we will definitely be back!

Potential to be a great local BYO with great service and extensive menu but there were fundamental issues with the food.  Balsamic calamari was tough and rubbery.  Pasta sauce had no taste and the linguine with clams promised garlic but again was tasteless.  Too many specials to chose from and most attractive main courses were priced above $32 to $40.  The biggest issue was the pasta.  It was not fresh and tasted like a generic grocery store box.  Bread was fresh and desserts looked great but everything in between was disappointing.

I'm a bit baffled by the negative reviews. Enterprise offers a free pick-up service, which I don't believe other companies offer. (However, they do not have a fleet of taxis, so the expectation of immediate service is unrealistic.) The staff at this location is helpful and the cars have been clean, reliable, and reasonably priced. I had to rent from a criminally understaffed Avis across the street recently when Enterprise didn't have anything available, and after seeing the ONE young woman who does everything, including cleaning the cars (!!!), which leaves her ridiculously overworked, I was even more glad for Enterprise.

We had dinner with another couple last night and were seated near an open window.   The restaurant is very nice and the wait staff was very helpful.  I thought the prices were reasonable compared to other surrounding over priced locations.  I had the rigatoni with a red meat sauce that had a very good flavor, however a little lite on the sauce.  My wife had one of the ravioli dishes (something with lemon in it) and said it was okay and wished she had ordered something else.  All in all it was a great place to have dinner and conversation with friends.   Romantic setting, good people watching location.

Went here for breakfast. Coffee cup was filthy dirty, had to ask for clean one. We got the buffet. Omelette was bland. Breakfast potatoes were terrible and didn't taste fresh. Muffin was great, that was the highlight of the meal. Took awhile to get coffee creamer from the server. No juice refill offered. 
We had a free breakfast voucher due to being Hilton Honors members... I'm glad because we'd have been very disappointed to have had to pay for this meal. We love this hotel, it's our favorite in the city. Nice, clean, accommodating, great location. But we'll definitely skip the breakfast next time, even if it is free.

The sushi selection here is phenomenal. My fiancé and I really enjoyed the sushi we picked out and the two appetizers we got were really tasty. Everything was put together very nicely, the presentation was beautiful and everything tasted sooo fresh and yummy. We will definitely dine here again anytime we're craving sushi. The ambiance was great, the decor inside was gave a very sophisticated feel and it's a great place for date night. Service was fantastic also! They definitely take care of you and make sure you're happy with the food you ordered.

This place has a lot of potential. Quaint location in the perfect neighborhood for its appeal. However, the price of the dinner entrees doesn't match up with reality. 25-30$ signals exceptional which is far from what they deliver for the dinner entree. The brunch is reasonably priced but the dinner entrees surprisingly are not nearly the level of the pastas or appetizers (I love the gazpacho and risotto but the entrees are not nearly as good for twice the price). Some of the dishes are great which keeps me coming back. Ambiance and neighborhood won't keep steady business unless the dinner service is revamped.

Free breakfast and dinner is pretty good. Employees are quite nice. Room itself isn't so great. Garbage disposal is broken and makes the living room smell horrible. Don't think they know this. Sofa bed is just horrible. Bathroom is way too small and not shabby at all. The place isn't run down just a bit outdated. It is simple and cozy which I like, but needs a lot of upgrades to make this place better and more modern. One of the cleaning ladies purposely kept slamming the door to the room she was cleaning which was across from us. Apparently she didn't like the fact that we had the do not disturb sign hanging up!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I moved from out of the area so I came here as it was the closest salon that was an aveda salon. The location and salon itself is great if you are in the Manayunk area but after 2-3 visits with my hair - I was very displeased. I never hated my hair but when you are spending 250+ every two months or so, I expected more. I tried two different stylists and maybe they just weren't right for what I was looking for. I decided to leave the salon all together and try a different avenue. I am much more pleased and getting the quality treatment I was looking for. I do miss the Aveda products but I guess you can't win them all.

I cannot speak to the beignet and coffee quality compared to the other locations, but I can say we had no wait on a Saturday morning while there was a crowd in line down in the French Quarter the day before. 
This was our first taste of NOLA dough, and it sent me to heaven (and even my partner, who has no sweet tooth to be seen). Take a bite, drop it back in the bag, and shake to cover again in the mound of powdered sugar. Goey, warm, and crunchy. 
Café au lait (pronounced: cah-feh oh-leh, as the man at the window corrected me) was good, not great. We like stronger coffee in our house, but the chicory came through as a great note.

I'm sad to say that although this location is prime, the customer service is awful. Not only were the walls thin, the maid service sparse and the view lackluster, but Jasmine at the front was combative and rude when dealing with a room key error. The security team was fair but judgement all when dealing with guest issues. The people working in the restaurant deserve accolades as they were incredibly nice and helpful throughout my stay. Even though I won't stay here again, I will certainly come back to this amazing city!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My boyfriend and I were at the mall and I wanted Chinese for dinner. This was the closest Chinese buffet so we went here. I was first disappointed to find that there was no white rice. We sat down to eat and my boyfriend and I both just looked at each other because the food did not taste decent to either of us. We picked at our food for a little while (I didn't eat any more than a few bites) and then decided it was time to see if the desert was any better. My boyfriend went up to get ice cream and there were no bowls... The one good tasting thing I had was my drink. I do not plan to eat here again and I  would not recommend it either.

The Greenfield location is awful. We have been here for over 30 minutes and have seen two pizzas and one order of breadsticks (totaling only eight breadsticks). Nobody is touching the second pizza, which appears to be bbq bacon. There are no breadsticks left; one pizza; and several people who have not had one bite of pizza or a breadstick from this PIZZA BUFFET. My family has at least had a few pieces, so we feel bad going up for any more pizza. I understand growing pains, but this is astoundingly bad. Don't open until you're actually ready for business.

Best donut in town!!  Good deals too!  Looking at a half dozen or dozen the prices really aren't much different than dough boys- and the quality literally cannot be compared.  Everything is tasty, creative, and sometimes beautiful.  Lol, plus if you are willing to let them pick for you, I know it sounds risky but if you're up for it they offer a dealers choice box for an EXTRA good deal.  (Vegetarians turned off by the bacon maple like myself can opt out of that one in the random box, fyi!)

Just want to update that since I've moved out of Reno a couple months ago I truly miss the Chai donut!!  Someone, please, order it for me and cherish it!!

After a long day at the zoo we tried this pizza place as it had good reviews in another publication. Certainly not everything we had hoped it would be. The staff was super unfriendly. Just plan angry to be at work it seemed. The pizza was okay. Just a basic thin crust seems like you could get it anywhere. The restaurant was not all that clean appearing. Only good thing was the garlic cheese bread. Not good enough that we would go back but at least something tasted good. Disappointing to pay almost $30 for 2 people one of which was a young child.

I had one load of bedding of just whites, including an heirloom bedspread that my grandmother crocheted. I put it in one of the commercial washers (took 18 quarters) and added soap and a little bleach. Once washed I transferred the load to a single dryer. A while later I checked on bedding and saw that everything had spots of discoloration.  Either the washing machine or the dryer had something in it that caused blue, pink and brown spots. The employee on duty was polite but offered nothing more than "I'm sorry". Not really good enough considering how much was ruined.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Overall a great dine in experience. We ate here
for my friend's birthday lunch. COVID19 friendly, follow arrows, not every table was open. Great service from staff and servers. Washroom was clean. 

Delicious and very generous proportions  We ordered:
-The nachos el muneco was a winner with
my friends and I, we chose to pork meat and
it was the best!!! 
-The tacos el pastor and adored the pineapples in it. 
-Enchiladas verdes was delicious juicy and tart 
-Tostadadetinga, crunchy and a mountain of 
toppings.

We definitely had leftovers and they tasted just as good the day after.

My new favourite Mexican place to eat

Ricco's is a great pizza place. It's one of my favorites. I found it thanks to a friend. When I lived closed by I would go and get a calzone every other week. The staff was very nice and they knew my order after a few visits. Their pizzas come in a lot of sizes and they have great specials. They also have a buffet in the morning that is really good. Like I stated before I always get the calzone and it's the best. The only reason it has 4 stars is because parking can be a nightmare, the little shopping center where it's located is too small and it can be hard to find a place to park when it's busy.

I'll make this short and sweet, if u are a person who has a tight schedule or value your time, DO NOT COME HERE! Made an appointment for 11:30, they told me to come in early to fill out paperwork, I did, walked in stood at the counter kept being told that someone will be with me shortly, 11:43 someone gave me paperwork filled it out and was told to sit and that I will be seen in an hour or so.... (12:45) then the exam and all that would take another 30-45 minutes. So it takes 2-3 hours to get in and out when I have an appointment? What's the point then!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I went to Cynthia and got an amazing haircut by her. I usually leave a cut feeling like it's going to need to grow into the style I wanted but I left feeling great about it off the bat. I originally got the Groupon for a ladies haircut (I am on my boyfriends yelp and can't for the life of me figure out how it switch to mine) but I called her up instead to see if she'd honor the Groupon price, which she happily agreed to. She was cheery and did a wonderful job so I will definitely be returning. Would certainly recommend!!

We had dinner at the restaurant and had a great experience. The waitress, Debbie, was very attentive as we had two small children with us. There is a piano player there who provided some lovely background music. We spoke to him briefly and he entertained us. The food was great. My in-laws had tomato based dishes, while my wife and I had spaghetti with clams and shrimp scampi respectively. The portions were perfect (definitely not a pound of pasta) and we appreciated that. There is no children's menu, however chicken tenders were available. We will definitely be going back!

Let me start by stating my previous experience had been good with this hotel and I made the choice to stay again. This time was horrible. Stayed over the weekend one night because apparently they have a know issue with shower temperature or should I say they have NO hot water. When I complained upon leaving the front desk stated " so sorry you should have never been out in that room" yet they still charged me full price and offered me a free cup of coffee.  Marriott is kidding right?? Never stay there.  So disappointed that they cannot even take accountability for their mistakes
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've had a few problems with this McDonald's but tonight was the final straw.  I went to the drive thru and was asked to pull forward because they were waiting on fries.  We waited almost 6 minutes only to get our food and the fries were only warm,  not even fresh, I didn't get a straw or receipt and I needed one to do a survey!  Why did they pull me? I understand speed of service because I manage a Taco Bell and drive thru times are important but we are NOT allowed to pull cars.  We will NEVER go back to this store and if all other McDonald's continue to pull cars we will just give them up for good!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Got take out from here as was very pleased. All of fish was noticeably fresh, which is crucial. Loved that the we picked some regular rolls (not sashimi) and rice was minimal. I hate sushi places that just pack rolls with tons of rice and a little bit of fish. This place does the exact opposite! It's also nice, especially for take out, when rolls aren't drenched in sauces and mayo. Our order of sushi was delicious without the heavy sauces! Definitely recommend giving this place a shot, for take out or dining in. When picking up I did notice that the place was very nice but pretty small, I would call ahead and make a reservation!

This is somewhere between a 4-5 star review, but I rounded up because why not. Thank god for Slice, because now I can order fresh, delicious gluten-free pizza! It took me 2 years to find gluten-free pizza delivery in Philadelphia. This city is finally catching on. I order from them on a regular basis. Wish the gluten-free pizza's weren't so expensive and came in bigger sizes, but hey, you can't have it all. One time the pizza was delivered and it had slid the side and was all messed up, but shit happens, and it came from the Italian Market location.

One star for the view and music.
Average food and some even below average for the prices they charge. Our grouper sandwiches were ok. The buns tasted like a Hawain roll you buy in the deli
to go with fried chicken. The sweet tea was so bad I spit it out on first swallow!!!!!!!!!! They make instant or something strange and unusual! I hope none of the Northerners come down south and think this is how real sweet tea tastes!
The crab dip was ok at best. Normally, I would eat the hell out of some crab dip but I kept trying to figure out what was so strange about it as well? I wouldn't come back here myself.

The restaurant is very clean and orderly. I feel it is way to bright and sterile looking which is great for a hospital but not for a quaint town like Haddonfield. I have not tried any of the other locations. I found the pizza to lack flavor and the pasta sauce to be very can like in flavor, definitely not home town Italian red gravy. I have given this menu two chances and I am sorry to say they will not get a third unless I hear of some improvements to the ingredients. I will say the staff was wonderful, it is just a shame that such a beautiful establishment has such below par food.

The upside and best part of my stay were the staff.   They were great.   The downside,  I had to get up at 4a and there were constantly people outside my room talking.   I wasn't able to even try to fall asleep until at least 12:30a because it sounded like they we right in front of my room.  Granted,  I was next to the elevator but there was no reason for everyone who spoke to sound like they were in my room. 

I would recommend this hotel only if you don't have to be up eary because in sure the sound is the same regardless of where your room is if people are going to be talking.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Listen.. liquor stores aren't federally regulated in this state.. it's a liquor store and you're buying your 25.00 bottle with the guys getting their 2.00 liquor samples. But my man at the front was super friendly, big guy, lots of tats, and as I'm friendly and a true southerner, he started a conversation and not only made a GREAAT RECOMMENDATION on vodka, but he offered me a discount WITHOUT me asking for one! I'm a fan! And as a timeshare owner, and this being my only spot in Nashville, we will always come here!

Do not eat at this location! Very dirty location. Tables and chairs were very dirty and sticky, multiple dead flies in the windows, and the service was terrible. Our waitress forgot 5 items as well as gave a member of our party a meal she suggested instead of the meal the patron ordered. The food was bad; eggs were like soup.    Sausage was burnt, and they didn't have any clean silverware or napkins so they took paper towels out of the bathrooms for us to use. We eventually got silverware but It still looked dirty. It was a hot mess.

Lolita definitely hit the spot! Nice little place nestled among the many restaurants in the area. We had reservations and we're promptly seated. We ordered the guacamole for starters and it was on par with guac we've had from other venues. Girly girl ordered one of the vegan entres; the gazpacho soup made from to tomatillos and an avocado base. She loved it. I had the fried chicken tacos which were nicely spiced, served with a light blue cheese dressing. Not always my thing, but not bad at all. Good service and price as expected.

Ordered dinner take out for the first time last night. A little pricey, but we were full and satisfied. We got the chicken lettuce wrap appetizer, brussel sprouts side dish and 6 maki rolls (Philadelphia, yellowtail scallion, spicy tuna, soft shell crab California, salmon avocado and tuna avocado). Everything was quite yummy! we noticed that the sushi rice was properly seasoned unlike many other sushi places in the area. The brussel sprouts were delicious, I will definitely order those again. The chicken lettuce wraps were okay, left something to be desired but tasted fresh and fairly healthy. We will return!

Franzone's has the best pizza in Pennsylvania, if not on the planet. I have been getting pizza there since the early 90's, and my Father has been getting his pizza there for much longer. The sweet sauce on the pie is my favorite, and I prefer my pizza well done. Whenever I am in the area I always make sure to stop in for a pie. The people who work there have always been very friendly, and the owner is a great guy. I even bring a pie or 2 back to the city to share with my friends and family. I definitely recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a great pie in the area.

We had a large group trying to find food on a busy Friday night. Zolo's invited the nine of us in just 15 minutes before closing time. Waiting for the food we read the reviews so our expectations were very low... we were all pleasantly surprised. From lasagna to shrimp to chicken dishes, everything was delicious. And then, the desserts. Obviously homemade cannoli filling and light as air limoncello cake were big hits. Service was very sweet although oddly slow considering we were the only guests. I will definitely return if I come back to this area.

Always wish 0 stars is an option but that be sad to see how many there'd be. Well. First off, wanted ice coffee didnt have it. Ok well what about frappes? Just ice coffee is out.... oh wait and frappes also. Second, grill chicken sandwich. Got a fried in my hands... shitty little 3 pieces of tomato. Not even a full slice. And this place is really pathetic. Shut this one down and make it into something else more delightful.


Also just saw the not recommended reviews and honestly think they all need to be put up for the public to see because its all true and this place needs to be shut down for real.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It's a great place to go accept for a Saturday or Friday night. The bread is amazing, you can taste it's fresh. Service was over attentive and great personality. I can tell when it is not the servers fault but I had ordered the spaghetti and meatballs. It came out with under cooked pasta which was no big deal just sent it back for a new one. Forty minutes later came out with the same dish, and it was still undercooked chewy hard noodles. Every other time I've been here I've really enjoyed it but avoid going on busy days

If I could give this place 0 stars I would. Walked in because I heard good music and what appeared to be a chill vibe. This place lost their stars because of the service. One of the girls serving shots in trays approached me directly and was harassing my boyfriend and I to take multiple shots. She also did this with a neighboring couple. Forcibly pulling people and pouring shots in their mouth (which she all charged of course) is not cool. Moreover, promising entry shots and taking it back, and overcharging for drinks is far worse. Would never go back in if it meant having to insist on rejecting drinks when I clearly don't want them.

I normally haven't had a problem coming here and I've come here a lot. I needed help with a dryer that I paid for twice, thinking my card was the issue, unaware that it was a "quarters only" machine. Usually there is a sign there if that is the case. There was not, and I was told it was removed. The gentleman who helped me told me he was not refunding me, and only provided the money I paid once, not twice, when I should have been refunded for the extra money I paid due to THEIR error, and he blamed me for it. Awful customer service, and I could find something closer anyway.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Lee consistently does a fantastic job on my nails and always makes sure I am happy with them throughout the process and before I walk out the door.  He is able to do a dip manicure that is very thin while still being sturdy and has done a number different styles for me.  I have only had to use the 10 day guarantee once( my fault not his!) and I was able to get the nail fixed quickly and easily for free.  The gorgeous, relaxing setting definitely doesn't hurt either.  I have recommended many friends in the area to give this place a try and they have all been very happy with the results.  If you get Lee, Holly, or Ruby you won't be disappointed!

I came here to have a good time and I honestly felt so attacked. The waitress that knows everyone tried to forcibly make me eat my leftovers and after completing my satisfactory meal and FULLY paying for it, we left a tip that was reflective of the service that we received. Apparently, the waitress was not pleased with our money, and proceeded to CHASE. US. OUT. We were already out of the establishment and across the street when she RAN AFTER US OUT OF THE RESTAURANT. We are strongly considering never coming back.

The Spirits Bar doesn't exactly look like it did when it was given it's makeover during Bar Rescue. The decor is a bit cluttered and the place looks like any other bar on Bourbon St. The dueling piano part of this bar is what makes it fun. While they arent the best we've ever heard, it was the only reason we stayed as long as we did. Corey was our server and kept the tables laughing; quite the character, lol. Their Resurrection drink with flashing mug is actually a nice touch....the drink tastes a lot like a Blue Hawaiian...very good. Overall, not a bad place to visit!

This place is definitely not what it use to be. And if you complain to the managers they will tell you that no one else feels this way. They must have gotten a new chef because the food was not as good as it was when I visited a few months ago. For now I will not be returning, but I may give them another try in a couple of years. The portions have gotten smaller, the entrees less flavorful and overall just isn't what it use to be. I want consistency. And this place doesn't measure up anymore.. To me at least.

The desk clerks were awesome. However, the housekeepers don't give new glasses or new towels everyday. The surrounding community is downright dangerous. Its in the hood. In hindsight I would have stayed at the Hilton near the riverwalk had I known as its relatively safer. The nearby mall is full of criminals. Just look at the crime stats of the area near the courtyard. Short and sweet...you will feel like a prisoner at this hotel. Drug dealers on bikes, and others constantly case the hotel looking for things to steal. The nearby mall is dangerous. Dont go alone EVER.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have been going here for a few months.   Last night i went to get a manicure and they had 30% off a pedicure  so i decided to do both.  When they were finishing my nails she said something about me being new.   I just let it go not worth saying i had been going for months now.  When i went to pay she charged me more than what i have paid in any other visit for a mani/ pedi.   ( i always get dip on my fingers and gel on my toes) When i questioned how much i was getting charged she became irate raising her voice telling me I'm wrong.  She made such a big scene and was so rude that by the time she finally took my money i knew I'd never go back.

We had reserved an SUV and prepaid for it.  When we arrived we were told there were no more standard SUV's available and they were going to put us into a full size car. We could upgrade to a larger SUV for more money.  That did not sit well with me.  After some searching they found a Hyundai Santa Fe and I agreed to it.  When we got to where the cars were they told me it was already taken.  Then they offered another car and it was also taken.  Finally I was told I could take any SUV I wanted at no additional cost.  It took quite a while but we were finally to get the vehicle and get under way.

Stayed here 2 nights with my husband and daughter. It was a great stay! Front desk staff was very friendly and helpful. They offer a free shuttle service within 3 miles of the hotel. Both drivers we encountered were friendly and had recommendations about the area. That was convenient and saved us some money since we were without a car and using Lyft. Within walking distance of several restaurants. There are several bars and restaurants down the street but despite this it was a quiet stay. Very happy with the breakfast offered. I would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I hate to say it because I would love for them to succeed: it was the worst Mexican food I've ever had. 

The "Salsa Fresca Nachos" with chicken were just chips with shredded chicken and melted cheese. No peppers, no onions, no herbs or flavoring. Nothing else

The chicken quesadilla was soggy and tasteless. The guacamole was clearly from a can. 

The chorizo tacos were so salty that I could barely finish them, and the corn tortillas had absolutely no taste. They are clearly using the cheapest ingredients they can find. Stay away!

I had an extremely poor experience previously, but gave Dobbs another chance.  I have to praise, the workmanship.  I truly believe they fix car issues completely and they do it the first time.  They stand behind their work.  On the other hand, their customer service, scheduling, and time/workload management is lacking. They make appointments but don't honor the time of those appointments.  This is not the place if you're in a hurry, I would only recommend using Dobbs if you have time and an extra car to drop your car off and come back later.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
A once-decent hotel that is now a bit worn.
If you're traveling for business, there were no easily accessible outlets on the desktop or lamps for laptop or cellphone charging.
There was mold growing on the ceiling in a few areas in the bathroom.
The non-smoking room reeked of smoke.
The blackout curtains were broken and wouldn't close all the way; remained open by about 18-24".
There were brown stains on the duvet.
The mattress was worn and sagging considerably.
The $59 Hotwire price wasn't a 'deal', it was the most this stay was worth.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The Kimpton Hotel requires a deposit of $100 per night for incidentals. The deposit will end up being more than the total of your stay. Save your money.

PROS
- Bed is comfy
-Room was clean
-Bicycles available 
-Service was great

CONSTRUCTIVE CRITICISM 
- Need way better lighting in the bathroom and the room itself if there's only 1 window on 1 side of the room. ??
(Basic Room)
- Water pressure is too low and the water does not get hot or cold enough. What's up with that? Wasn't a pleasant showering experience.
- Decor was blah

Overall, mediocre experience for a 4 star hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Tasty breakfast, but my omelet wasn't really very hot, I mean the cheese never melted. I see others have commented on food items being cold. Why is that? I don't get it.... Anyway, all the rest of the food was good (GREAT steak with the steak and eggs!). Tables, silver clean, good service. Bathrooms small, sink and toilet clean BUT the floor was really nasty, made me cringe. Would it be so hard to spiff it up a bit, at least for us ladies? We'll give it another try though but do I really have to send my omelet back to be warmed? Hmmmm

Worst McDonald's ever. Every time we get stuff from here it's either messed up or they forget stuff. This trip they almost didn't even give us all our food. My husband had to tell them they forgot our food. Didn't even give the toys they're supposed to be giving. We got Pokémon stuff. We were expecting Sing 2 or Encanto toys.  My daughter's cheeseburger in her happy meal had onions on it. Never once in all the times we've gotten a cheeseburger happy meal has there been onions on the burgers. And they didn't even give us her juice with her happy meal. Seriously if I could give 0 stars I would!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: There are not many "vegetarian-friendly" restaurants in Belleville, but Fletcher's vegetable pie is my go-to when I want something tasty nearby.  Most places have a couple of iceberg lettuce salads on the menu and they think they're catering to the non meat eaters, but Fletcher's actually has things besides salads that don't have meat.  Pros: it's not a chain, the food is better than most places in Belleville, they have a bar with nice bartenders and a back room you can rent out. Cons: the parking lot is a cluster and it's loud inside.

It's a different type of menu with a different take on the traditional waffle, and it is delicious!!!! I had the Farmers Tan, my girlfriend had the Psycho Monkey, and her sister had the Wake and Bake. The farmers tan was savory and flavorful but not overwhelming. The psycho monkey was deliciously sweet without feeling as if you just developed Diabetes. The wake and bake was on the more traditional side while still being its own unique version; it incorporated both sweet and savory, and it did it very well. We will eat here again

This location is just straight awful. I have yet to go through the drive thru and get my correct order. Case in point: about a month ago, I went through the drive thru at roughly 9am. I ordered a bacon, egg, and cheese biscuit and a sausage McMuffin. Not a difficult order by any stretch, simple and straight to the point. I received a piece of ham inside an English muffin and a McGriddle sandwich with just egg. Of course I didn't open the bag until I was way out of the way, which is my fault as I should've known better. But seriously? A ham sandwich? This McDonald's is the absolute worse. As everyone says, I wish I could've given it 0 stars!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We came for dinner. Cute and cozy decor. Friendly and good service. I ordered halibut and acorn squash. The halibut had a good flavor but was overcooked. The acorn squash was bland and undercooked, so I gave up on that. I ordered a cup of coffee after that was terrible. Its not very hard to use great coffee here in Nashville. I feel like I may have had a below average experience here and perhaps the executive chef was off the night we went. I would give it another chance but its hard to dine in places that can not achieve consistency when they are places like Rolf Daughters,Silo, and Lockland Table that I can go to.

Absolutely loved our stay at the Q and C. I got a good deal through bookit.com and at first I was a little nervous. When we we arrived to the hotel we were really pleasantly surprised. The front desk team was super duper nice, our room was very chic, loved the decor of the bar and recreation areas and the food was pretty decent and convenient. Would definitely stay here again. It's walking distance from Bourbon without having to be in the middle of the craziness. The only minus was the bathroom in our room which would flood while showering as the water spilled out; there was no shower door.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Such a long wait! Don't come here if you're hungry and ready to eat. Waited about 5 minutes to be seated, 15 minutes to get my order taken, and AN HOUR to finally get my food. It wasn't even a busy evening. Terrible! The waitress was nice, but I noticed how she was constantly walking around the tables apologizing to everyone for the late sushi orders. And after a while of me not getting my food, she just totally stopped looking in my direction. On top of that, food was mediocre. Nope, just nope. Don't come here unless it's 1 1/2 to 2 hours before you're ready to eat.

Waited until I got home to start sipping on my chai tea latte and get home, open the cup, and my medium looks like a small! The tea was literally filled up half-way. 
I come to this location often and have contemplated leaving a review multiple times either from terrible customer service to slow staff when there is a line wrapped around the building. 
I don't like to complain usually but honestly when your waiting for so long to get your items and then you get half of what you pay for, it can be frustrating.

Most authentic Mexican food in Idaho. Open 24hours with multiple locations in ADA County & Canyon County. good amount of food for the price. Its a straight RAW mexican spot. By that i mean its not the cleanest or fastest & the staff doesnt speak perfect english but who cares, the food is awesome. I seriously come here 2 or more times a week! My faves are carne asada burrito, california burrito, texano burrito and breakfast burrito mixed. I'm from L.A. where you can find good Mexican food just around the corner, but in Idaho good luck.

The wait time was out of this world for "fast food". The girl at the window never even apologized for the long wait, in fact, she didn't even properly greet us when we pulled up to the drive thru window! "7.32" was her greeting and it wasn't even for our order because the car in front of us got tired of waiting and pulled off!!! As if that wasn't bad enough, the top to the soda wasn't on properly and soda spilled all over my car. It was supposed to be a late night food run and turned into a major annoyance. Will definitely NOT be back to this location.

Very impressed with the customer service & quality of car wash. My car came out fresh, clean, and shiny. I like the vacuum system which is strong & able to do its job well. Also, I like mat cleaning machine which works efficiently. However, I would highly suggest that they should have a sink & soap to wash hands for customers after cleaning and vacuuming their car because many people use the vacuum, so I feel like my hands would have lots of germs on them. Especially, since Covid happened, people are aware of hygiene. Other than that, everything went well with my first time.

This is a horrible moldy place! Don't move here unless you would like ur hard earn pennies to go to these crooks. It's not all of that!!!! HAVE SEVERAL SEATS KORMAN!!!  
Utility room collapsing and this was before it fell more.  Leaks and sh++!!!!! Get ur ish together! I'm hot as shit in here can't even lay under the covers during the night because the air conditioning system doesn't work properly and doesn't get the place pass 77 degrees even on a cool day! You earn one star and if I could give u zero I would!!

Ok, so I love pizza!! My brother had told me about this place awhile back, I am just so mad at myself for not coming here sooner. It started as soon as I walked in the door, the patrons in the restaurant and the staff were very friendly,I had ordered online which was very easy,  I had the Chicken Cordon Bleu and my sister had the S.O.B. Wow, the pie was awesome the owner said he had just added it to the menu, and personally told me I would like it(he couldn't have been more spot on)
Thank you all at Monte Bello's you have brand new customer for life!!!!

Had  a reservation through open table, my husband and i were anxious to try a different byob. Arrived and was promptly seated at a table for 2, right near the waitstaff area, busiest place in the restaurant. We ordered fruitti di mare, for our appetizer, lots of seafood in a lemon vinegrette, but could not taste any lemon, have had much better at other italian restaurants.  My entree, crab and shrimp risotto was very good.  My husband had linguini with clams in a white wine sauce, which was ok.Where was the complimentary limoncello? Probably will not go back, too many other exceptional Italian byob in area

I had nearly given up on this place. One flavorless machaca and egg burrito, another green chile burrito that was like full of soup. It was good green chile pork, but it was so soupy that it just didn't belong in a burrito. It spilled everywhere.

But then, I tried their carnitas burrito. I think there was a different cook when I went. It had fresh tomato, onion, and guacamole, and the carnitas were perfect. The green salsa is especially good with this burrito!! I definitely do reccomend. Their burritos can be hit and miss, but the carnitas one is very good, so I suggest you try it.

I have been using Son's for four years now since I moved to Philadelphia.  It is right around the corner from my office, so its very convenient.  But what keeps me going there is the quality of the services they provide and how friendly the staff is.  Sara, the owner, is so great!  She is super friendly and happy to be there.  They have done a great job with not only cleaning, but hemming and sewing my clothes.  I have to have clothes hemmed frequently and have never had a bad job from them.  Definitely worth is!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
I have eaten at this restaurant several times, but I was disappointed in the food and service this time. The waiter would disappear a lot before we would see him again. My chicken dish was disappointing more so because the chicken had a rubbery texture. I did mention it to the waiter and again to the staff when leaving. 

They said they would tell the chef but I felt they should have accommodated me with maybe a discount or a dessert since I left most of the Chechen on my plate. I could have sent it back but then I would be eating without the rest of my party. I like this restaurant and will return with the hopes that it's better next time.

The sushi here is tasty, the service is good, the atmosphere is average and a little annoying. 

The Positives:

Good, tasty sushi with many many specialty rolls. There are many varieties and options, a very nice menu to choose from.

The service is good, very nice servers and sushi Chefs. 

The price is on par with other sushi establishments in the area.

The restaurant is clean.

The Negatives: 

The walls are bright orange, its in a strip mall and they play a really bizzare soundtrack for a sushi restaurant. You will be eating sushi listening to Q102, Lady Gaga and Bieber.

I've now officially been to every French Truck in New Orleans! I love this one, especially the covered patio on the greenway. The only tricky part is parking. There's lots of spaces, you just might have to walk a bit or even bike there! There were lots of places to sit an there is free wifi, so a great work option. Lots of tables were full with small groups or people enjoying themselves. I would recommend this place to anyone. The service is fast and friendly and everything is really good. You can't go wrong with anything you order!

Most likely will not return here... the drink specials were good, $3 martinis can't beat that! But the food was horrible to say the least. I ordered the gnocchi with short rib, 99% of the meal was straight sauce. Maybe 4 or 5 gnocchis in the entire dish it was highly disappointing,. My boyfriend had the filet which was not awful just not cooked to how he ordered it. As if the food wasn't enough, my boyfriend went into the men's room to find the employees offering each other "a line of blow" while smoking cigarettes in the restroom. This was supposed to be a nice date night for us but it was not a good experience at all...

Service was good but the food was very bland. We ordered the pambazo which tasted like sour cream on slightly bitter Guajillo sauce soaked bread with the remainder of the filling being largely tasteless, and steak and pork tacos. Both the steak and pork were unseasoned - not marinated- and very bland. A side of rice and beans was also ordered and was average in terms of taste. Also, it was June 28th and hotter inside the restaurant than outside and it was in the 90's outside. Nice people and very friendly but not worth going back.

My date received a positive covid test result the day of our long awaited reservation and obviously had to cancel. I knew about the cancellation policy on OpenTable but I would assume not risking to spread the virus to restaurant staff and patrons, if not the entire city of Philadelphia, would be grounds for policy exception. WRONG - This establishment clearly does not care about covid-19 protocol. When I called to cancel my reservation I received no cause for concern from them and no mention of actually being charged a cancellation fee. Was charged $50 for our reservation for 2. If you care, beware.

I recently went back here after moving out of state for a couple years. This used to be one of my favorite local froyo spots. Loved the taro flavor. But unfortunately it's gone downhill.
