It's almost as though they are phasing out the froyo. They only have two flavors at a time now and the toppings are scarce, maybe like 5 options. The quality of the froyo is good though and you get a free one with any meal which is the only reason I would opt for froyo here. There are plenty of other spots around if you're not looking to get a meal too.

My wife and I stopped in here before our dinner reservations at a nearby restaurant. It was not packed at the time. The drinks were priced just like everywhere else in town. The bartenders were friendly but a little obnoxious. They had a planking competition with some young guys. The guys were on the floor and the bartender on the counter top. They wrote on the patron with lipstick. If you are into a childish environment than this place would be good for you. Might be a different atmosphere later in the night.

Orders are slow.  Could  use more staff to accommodate patrons.  Washrooms are locked between 11pm and 8am so you are unable to use the restroom to wash your hands or do any thing else.  Asked for the key to use the washroom but was told they do not have the key on night shift.  Really ??  I do like to wash my hands before eating since almost all food is touched with your hands - burgers, fries, etc., but am unable to do so.  No, I will not go back to this place nor recommend it to anyone - simply because of the washroom factor - I do need to relieve myself everyone so often like everyone else.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Room is nice and neat. No safe or fridge which I feel are pretty basic appointments to any hotel room.  No bath venting fan :/.    I do enjoy the added security of room key swiping to access certain floors in the hotel. Clean lines, muddled tones of greys, blacks, browns and splashes of teal work well with the Correara marble floors throughout the lobby.  There is a hint of expense in the style but overall the offerings are pretty underwhelming. Gym is ok but the pool area looks more like a maintenance area for AC water run off.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My husband and I came to blackfish Friday night as a special occasion and it was definitely worth it! We had a really great experience- service was superb and the food was wonderful. We never felt rushed and the timing of courses was perfect. All the staff were very attentive and helpful. We didn't do the tasting menu, which is perhaps why I feel that the dishes were much larger than I expected- 3 courses and I was beyond stuffed and couldn't finish. Each dish was prepared artfully and everything was delicious. Can't find fault with anything here.

Pros: convenient location to Forest Park, 1mi from WashU.

Cons: 
Place is a constant work zone. Dust and workers everywhere. 
Constant noisy traffic (it's at Union and Forest Park).
Inconvenient to decent grocery shopping, bars, and restaurants.
Limited parking. 
To my knowledge Management hasn't provided a convenient and available means to get large items, grocery orders, etc. in so you'll have to buy a cart, pay for delivery, or haul it yourself. 
Pushy sales staff. 
Very poor water quality - I bought 2 different brands of water filters and both clogged up within a day. I am constantly buying bottled water

I found 3 hairs in my chicken sandwich. Pulled the first one out of my mouth and almost gagged. Called and spoke to Justin who was awful!!! He said I was most likely lying and if not it happens sometimes. No offer to replace the sandwich or apologize. His only
Offer was a sarcastic comment that I could bring the hair into restaurant for him to inspect if I wanted him
To believe me. Quick to let me know he does not care if I never return. He had plenty of business and nobody at McDonalds wIll care about hair in the food!!!

Beware if you have an issue with hair in your food!!!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Had a wonderful experience at Personal Expressions with Christina over the weekend. I have naturally curly hair, and always struggle to find a salon/stylist that's a good fit. Christina was friendly and polite without being too chatty and I left the salon very happy with my haircut. She took the time to listen to what I wanted and made adjustments post cut despite having to juggle multiple customers. She also explained all the products she was using on my hair and did not push any of them on me. 
The salon itself is neat and has a friendly atmosphere. Definitely recommend the place!

Lame place. Rude service. Both times I went thru the brushes never touched my car or truck. I have video proof of that from both times going. Pete was a jerk both times as well. 
And we are all saying how we feel. Your are ones being asses and accusing us of lying over the gals car. Grow up Rocket Express Car Wash some people are telling the truth. Get over it and fix her car!! I don't even know the gal and I didn't have a good thing at all to say and plus you blocked me from doing a review. That's pretty lame. Thankfully Mister Car Wash ID Meridian is a lot better on everything.

I was excited about the Hotel as the reviews were good. 

Unfortunately, I have to say the walls were thin, you hear ever time the water is turned on up to 2 rooms away. Also, there was supposed to be a reception our first night, never was. We asked after the first night and they said there wouldn't be one the second night either. The free wifi was very iffy and pretty much worth just that.

But most notable was our room service, we left our room at 10 am. to see the city, when we got back at 5 pm our room had still been not made up. Shame on Wyndham!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I am very pleased with this Brakemax location and I will never get my oil change anywhere else. They are also usually open on Christmas eve which was wonderful for me when my car broke down. It was ready to go within a few hours. They do a check on your vehicle and keep record of their recommendations and advise you of any problems with your vehicle. Leroy the manager is very cordial, patient, and will answer all of your questions. They will let you know of any coupons they have available. Scheduling is very easy. 4 out of 5 because pricing could be a few dollars more then other places but worth it.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I have been coming here for years as a local, and they recently expanded and renovated the restaurant, so now it is even bigger and better. Excellent menu selection- both for drinks and entrees. Even the appetizers here are impressive. I had the pork belly with apple, and it was very dense and filling. I enjoyed the hipster feel of the restaurant as well- super trendy and unique. The people behind designing this restaurant really had an eye for detail. The tapas style menu is really cool as well, especially if you'd like to go out to eat with several people.

Been here 3 times. Always the same story - these people little organization, or follow through. Our first doc wrote in incorrect prescription for contacts, so we had to come back a second time. Our second doc entered the wrong numbers into the computer when my wife was getting fitted for contacts. They said they'd call when the contacts were delivered but never did. Now we're on our third visit waiting for a doc to come out and see us. The third doc checked the second docs prescription decision, and explained explained everything and made things make sense. Thank you!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
This is a dive. Its dark, dingy, unkempt, and loud. BUT, the music was great. AND, they made me the best lemon drop ever. AND, the grilled oysters were fantastic! Really! That was completely unexpected...but they were f'n great! The quesadilla was excellent too. I could not have asked for better service. They get 4 stars from me. I'd give them 5 stars if they had brought my food sooner. But, I think slow food is a NOLA thing...I experienced the same everywhere I ate in this town. It should be known as the "the big relax and sit back, this is gonna take some time, Hun." 

I will definitely go back to Vaso next time I'm in NOLA.

I transferred Banfield hospitals due to location. The Speedway location is a very nice, new office but was surprised with service and a referral. A procedure was repeated ($$) which was previously documented in Harley's records. The vet also suggested that I try another clinic to have my dog's operation. The referral has led to dozens of unreturned messages with a business that does not seem to care. Why would you refer a unreliable place? My Harley still needs her operation but now I am not sure where to go.

The food is always great. However; I can not say the same for the noise level. It was impossible to hear my guest due to wooden chairs being moved in & out from the tables & the the cling clanging of dishes being banged as food was being removed from used dishes & aggressively placed in the plastic tub to be cleaned.
This Chef is maticulous about his menu. I feel that he should think about placing some sort of tip at the bottom of each heavy wooden chair & ask his staff to be a little more considerate of the guests that are watching him rush thru the dining room to clear & clean tables. That part was very unpleasent.

I was looking for a place that can help me with my curly hair that recently was not healthy and didn't look good.
I found recommendations on Yelp for Personal Expressions and decided to take my chances as they are in my town and within walking distance from my home.
I was schedule with Christina, and she was professional and friendly.
Christina explained me every step of the process and and how it would be better to treat my hair at home on daily base.
I loved my hair after all the work she has done and I will definitely will go back.
Recommended!

If I could give 0 stars I would l. New to the area and wanted to try a chinese store. The food came and it looked good but 1/2 my order was missing. I called the store back the man was very rude and told me he did not charge me and he will make it and I have to pay. I said you repeated the order back and told me and I confirmed my order. Long story shot I paid 40$ for 2 sesame chicken platters and 2 order of chicken wings. AND FOR THE OWNER TO ARGUE WITH ME AND ALSO NOT SEND A RECEIPT. They are get overs never again.

I am in love.

Why are proper taco's so hard to find?  I searched a high and low to find a little authentic Mexican place that puts meat, onion and cilantro on a pair of corn tortilla.  And El Paso does just that.

I ordered four tacos for $2 each; chicharones (belly), lengua (tongue), chorizo, and cabeza (head). I also ordered the ceviche. 

All that taco's were delightful. The ceviche was in a tomato sauce, not my thing. I prefer it less tomato.

They also have menudo and horchata, I will be back to try those.

Less than impressed. I know many think this place is wonderful. The decor is pleasant. The service was adequate. Not exceptional. Ordered a glass of wine, less than 1/2 full. Noticed other tables, their glasses were 1/4" from rim. Dinner salad, for extra charge, was excellent. But noticed the same salad cost more if ordered with a small pizza. My friend's spaghetti was good. Thought I ordered a special, but was charged more. And whatever I had was dry and bland. Management removed my meal from ticket. At least they made that right. Won't be back. Disappointing.

CUSTOMER SERVICE HERE SUCKS!!!!  I stopped at this location for my usual coffee and I was not acknowledged by non of the employees. There was a guy making drinks who made eye contact with me and did not acknowledge my presence. There was a lady at the counter who also did not say anything to me but she sure was able to have a non work related conversation with another customer. I come from customer service background and I know acknowledging the customer is a big deal. There's plenty of other Starbucks in the area that I can go to and will go cause they will treat their customers the right way

DO NOT GO HERE  AND WASTE YOUR MONEY! Horrible place. The owner is an ass times 10. They do poor work. I asked if they'd wipe my dashboard and they said they don't do that. My hood had dirt on it and they said go somewhere else then. Wow. That's great customer service huh. I was patient and nice about it. They cleaned my seats and it smelled like mildew. I was patient and nice and asked for a refund. The owner told me to get lost and find another car wash. I was like wow that's your customer service? He's a terrible person and don't let that old lady at the register fool you. She is conniving and useless. Shame on them.

I'm so confused by the good reviews. I was excited based on the reviews here and on Google. No offense but I wonder if some people just don't know what good sushi is if they think this is good. I got the red dragon roll and a spicy tuna as well as some yaki soba. They use that tuna mush instead of actual pieces of tuna which is such a disappointment. I'd rate the sushi a 2/10. The yaki soba wasn't anything to get excited about. It was at least edible. The entire meal felt like a complete waste of money. Lesson learned.

You get what you pay for. It's about a 15 min drive from The French quarter so that's a good thing.  This hotel is very old and had some mechanical issues with the room like the door knob on the bathroom door was busted.  Customer service wasn't the best I had to tell the front desk girl how to do her job she forgot to give a car tag to us so we didn't get towed.  The wifi wouldn't connect to any device I had probably due to bandwidth. Despite these issues the hotel was some what clean but for $100+ I'd try somewhere else.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The staff were sincere, but it took four calls to get the ever-running toilet repaired, and it never happened. Our second night other guests on our floor partied violently till 2 am, and my call to hotel security resulted in five minutes of peace; no more. The breakfast buffet is dreadful; everything was cold. The water park is swell for very young children. It's close to Philadelphia. We couldn't check out because the computers were down, so I still don't know what it cost. Could be worse, I suppose; could have rained in the room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've been going to Fantasy Nails for maybe 3 years now.  The lady Wihn does a fantastic job waxing, and she is careful and thorough.  I have also gotten manicures and pedicures and have always been satisfied.  I also do not see a cleanliness issue: the instruments are cleaned in front of you and I've seen the foot tubs washed after every use.  They have an impressive selection of nail colors as well.  Their prices are standard, but I keep going because I always like the job they do and the employees are very friendly.  In addition, even if there are people waiting ahead of me I never have to wait long.

I love the food but am disappointed in going in to pick my food from the take out designated area. The cooks yell, cuss and make derogatory to the staff and each other. I have called in and spoke w a manager before. I wanted to give them a opportunity to handle it and hold off just tossing up a negative review. However, I just went in today, 7-31-19 at 7:28 and just heard a ear full. It made me feel very uncomfortable. If this is something that is accepted, then I would recommend putting up a  partition, so customers don't have to hear the nastiness.

Don't come here. The customer service is terrible. It took 30 minutes to get my cheeseburger and french fries. There was only 2 other customers in the order/pickup line, both with small orders. And 10 cars left that drive-thru before I received my meal. And when I asked when my meal would be ready they said "soon ma'am" and shut the window in my face while I was talking. And when I talked to the manager she told me "the meat was being made". Which was false because out of those 10 cars I highly doubt no one got any beef. Overall a terrible experience.

Use to live there loved it close to a 10 year mark, after new management many moved out including me, I gave them 30 day noticed moved out early. APT. was spotless  mngr. Basically took white glove to check to see the cleanliness. Gave them keys etc. All is was well.
Now that am looking for new place I have some freaking Eviction on my credit.
Funny Mngr. Was friendly and all we shook hand and they labeled me as being evicted!!!
Fight not over very disappointed basically manager sucks to hold up to there end

The food is ok but the service is terrible, esp. as a first time customer. I went to their website and saw a 10% off coupon if ordering more than $10 worth of stuff, ordered about $20 worth of food, got to their store and asked about the 10% off and she asked to see the coupon. I pulled out my phone and showed her the coupon on their website and said she wouldn't accept it because it WASN'T PRINTED OUT. SERIOUSLY??!!! She gave me a menu with the coupon on it to use for next time. The entire exchange really left a bad taste in my mouth. Make sure you print out your coupons, or better yet just don't go.

THANK YOU Antonio and Victor! I commute between LA and SB and noticed my tire pressure light came on just south of SB. I pulled into Big Brand where Antonio immediately greeted me in a friendly and professional manner. He inspected the car and I dropped it off to take care of some business while they did a more thorough inspection. Within a few hours they noticed me that they found a screw in a tire and successfully patched it. I could not have asked for a more efficient, helpful, and stress free experience. Thank you, gentlemen!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Just went to this location yesterday: Horrible service and the food was sub par. First there was no one even at the counter when I arrived. After 5 or 6 minutes, I heard a voice say from around the corner " I will be there in a few minutes." The girl was very rude the whole time: slopped together my sandwiches, threw them in the wrapper and bag and shoved them at me. When I got home, the meatballs in the sub were hard,old and inedible, the veggie patty had hard bits in it, and the veggies were soggy, the lettuce was brown. I will not go there again.Worst experience I ever had in a subway.

I blew out a tire at the end of the day and called to see if big brand would be able to install a new tire a few minutes before closing. The staff was very accommodating and even stayed open a little bit late to do this.
Enrique was exceedingly helpful, attentive, and friendly from start to finish. He even brought me a cold bottle of water. And the staff was very polite and patient with a very grumpy customer that seemed to be giving them a hard time. Prices were fair. I would definitely do business with them again.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
My husband and I have been eating here for years but lately seems that things are not as good as it once was. The last two times our order was incorrect. The last time we orderd takeout I repeated my order 3 times. When we got the pizza it was wrong and also the salad was incorrect.   I called the manager to inform him of the error and he did not care one bit. Also told me the computers were down so he would have to research it tomorrow. CLICK....

I would hope that they would have better customer service skills and if they did I would return back .

I stopped in because i heard a familiar voice singing and it was Clay Shelburn the Walmart rocker. I asked if I could get him a drink and he says sure margarita. Asked the waitress for a margarita. She charges me for a double of everything that's in it. And then get this. She changed my $2 tip to a $22 tip. On an $18 bill. I think not. Disputed it. Should get the money back. Shame on you and your terrible service. Thinking you can take advantage of people flying out because you think you will never see them again. Fortunately I keep my receipts so you better check your accounts if RICKELL was your waitress. She's a thief.

Great customer service. Quick and easy pick-up and drop-off. Ask for Bobby he's great! 

The only downside of my experience this time around is that I was charged an additional $50 when I got there because when I scheduled the car I chose special car and they wanted to give me a mini-van. So make sure you chose the car type you would like in the reservation or else they'll charge you extra. I'm an Alamo insider so they should take better care of their repeat customers. But I don't think it will hinder myself from renting with them in the future

Ate here the other weekend with a friend on a Friday night. I was going to get a beer but they were advertising a patron margarita for $8 so I thought why not ?!  There was not ANY tequila in the margarita! I told them this and commented on the color. They brought me a new one that further convinced me the first was a virgin margarita. Then we were charged $10.99 for tacos and I had to physically show the person at the register where it said 8.99. This place is a scam that I will probably never go back to. Save yourself a trip (and money!) and go to Rositas.

I came in here for the all you can eat sushi lunch.
The menu offered plenty of choices and I sampled a little bit of everything
I ordered a few sushi items, one hand roll, and one special roll
When my order arrived it didn't look all that appetizing
Not a lot of attention to presentation here although everything did taste good
As I stated previously, plenty of choices on the menu although nothing really inspiring stuck out
All in all I would say this is a good enough place to come for sushi in Boise where really good Sushi is just not an option.

Service was excellent

Received great service here recently.Not only was the cost of my synthetic oil change here substantially less expensive than elsewhere, but they also filled my fluids and rotated my tires as well. Additionally, they advised me of the need to repair my brakes in the near future which I did already know about but the folks at Les Schwab had completely missed. The manager at this Meineke even took the time to explain the need for replacing the not just the brake pads but also the calipers. I was very appreciative of his advise as well as his willingness to offer me a small price discount.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Cool concept but poor execution. We came for lunch on a weekend and this place was empty. We were literally the only table. That's a bit concerning seeing how big the place is. Service isn't great. The guy who took our order didn't seem too happy. We also had to take glassware from different tables just for water. The pasta wasn't good. Extremely bland and tasted like something I could make at home out of a jar. The prices are actually quite pricey if you start adding extras. Overall, it's not worth the time or money. Better to just order pasta from another place with all the extras included.

Have visited this place twice and will not return. Food was just barely adequate the first time I ordered the fish and chips. The price was very high and fish extremely greasy. On my second visit I decided to try the finger steaks. Not sure what I was served but they were square nuggets of fat, gristle and very little badly seasoned meat of some chewed up stuff. I did like the onion rings as they were like homemade. When I tried to eat my order I did not finish even one of those square nugget things. I was very disappointed with the food quality and will not return for a third time.

First time to order from here and we were not disappointed. We ordered Sam's House Special pizza, zucchini sticks and chocolate pie. Ordered in the early evening and had our food delivered in less than an hour. Small portion with the zucchini sticks but they were hot and delicious. The chocolate pie was delivered half frozen and wasn't that great but everything else was really good. Pizza had lots of meat/toppings on it. Nice and thick with the toppings, just the right amount of tangy sauce and a good crispy crust. Order came with four cans of pop since it was over $30. Will definitely be ordering from here again!

Zero star actually! 4:30pm on the second day of our stay, we came back from all day activity to relax. Our room wasn't ready. No one ever came in to clean it...I mean 4:30pm? Seriously? And every weekend, there's a drumline performance going on outside. It is so loud (even our room is on the 15th floor) that my children are having a tough time falling asleep at 11:30pm. The hotel operator is not sympathetic at all, which doesn't help the situation.
WARNING: DO NOT stay at this hotel if you need a good night sleep.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I absolutely love this place!! In fact, I crave it on a weekly basis. I have had many items on the menu; tacos, burritos, salads, enchiladas, chimichangas- all excellent, fresh and authentic! I love that they make their salsa fresh each day using ingredients from the Trenton Farmers Market. Also, everyone is so friendly and the prices are extremely affordable. You can even BYOB. My husband and I will often bring a few coronas with us when we eat there! So fun! Apparently they are doing so well they opened another restaurant in Hamilton. I've been to that location twice and it is equally as good. You need to eat here. It's great!

This place never fails to impress us, service is always warm and friendly, menu affordable, the sushi is the freshest I've had in this city! Aside from a watermark here and there on a glass once in a while, this restaurant is always clean and well maintained. Also very spacious, quiet, and fairly kid friendly. The homemade ginger dressing is amazing, the rolls are always perfectly made...the rice doesn't sit like a brick in your stomach, unlike some place. They also do custom rolls, anything you want, for the same price as the special rolls. I will always come back to this place

Stopped by to grab coffee and saw a familiar face behind the counter. Tyler worked at another coffee shop in town my family and I used to frequent, and needless to say we were all excited to see a friendly face at our new regular coffee stop. The entire staff was working so hard during what appeared to be a crazy rush, but they all had a smile on their faces. And the same could be said for Tyler. He was working just as hard as we always remembered, and we can't say enough about his attitude, politeness, and eagerness to help.

Stopped in here for lunch on the spur of the moment. We were greeted by a very friendly staff and immediately shown to a table. Our waitress was also very pleasant. We had the pasta fagioli and a creamy tomato soup which was recommended by our waitress. Both were excellent. Also had a roast pork with broccoli rabe, provolone and roasted red peppers sandwich and a spring mix with pears walnuts and gorgonzola salad. These were also delicious. Prices are very reasonable and the environment is casual and clean. The dinner menu looks great too. We will be going back to have a dinner here soon.

We decided to try La Locanda  on the recommendation of a friend. The hostess was fairly friendly but the rest of the staff did not make us feel very welcome to say the least.The appetizers were very good. We had the Calamari and the Beef Carpaccio. The main course however was pretty disappointing. Capellini Pescatore was tasteless and the Veal Saltimbocca was very salty. Desert was just OK  and our waiter was dropping the check before we finished our coffee. There are many Italian restaurants in the area that are much better than this one. Especially for the prices they are charging. Won't be returning.

I have been ordering takeout from Palermo's in Lansdale once to twice a week for over a year now. I've noticed the quality and consistency of the food has gone downhill the past couple of months. Tonight was my final push when I ordered a cheese steak calzone, halfway into the calzone I bite down on something hard and sharp to find a piece of glass about the size of a dime in the calzone. This could have been dangerous, how do you allow a broken piece of glass get mixed into the calzone? Way too many other pizza shops to choose from in the area. You have lost a good customer.

This was by far the worst Hotel I have ever stayed in.  The rooms smelled so bad of smoke I had to go buy Febreeze in hopes my son and I would be able to breath thru the night.  And no they were "booked for the night" so they would not change our room even though we checked in by 4pm.  To top it off the night manager was so inappropriate with the people sitting in the lobby it was down right embarrassing what he was saying to them.  Needless to say our 2 night stay turned into 1 as we checked out first thing the next morning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: In decline? I have been coming to Pumpkin for over a decade and have always thought it was amazing and underrated by most. Recently the service and food have been consistently good, not spectacular as in the past. The food used to not only be amazing in taste, but with beautiful presentation. The last visits have consistently had heavy handed playing and average service and flavor. Perhaps it is because the chef is often not there (even on busy weekend nights!)? I'll give it a few more tries, but it may sadly just be an average Philly restaurant now.

Do not use Mountain American Credit Union for auto loan!! Dealership got me to go with them, they had lower interest then my credit union. MACU does not allow principal only payments. When you call, they have to relay message to someone else to get a call back. No one knows what they are talking about, they said oh you made so many payments during 1st month, any other payments will go to principal because there isn't payment due for 5 months. I didn't believe them so I tested this with paying an additional $1.00... guess what, 100% going to interest?!?! Yea, I'm refinancing my loan now.

Came here with the girlfriend on a Wednesday night. Definitely was excited that the opened another location closer to me! Place was kinda of dead when we walked in. We ordered carnitas burrito, shrimp tacos and nachos. They messed up her order and given her a fish tacos instead. My carnitas burrito was good. Salsa was pretty good. The portion of the michelada was HUGE! That's a plus. Nachos was ok. Portion on the nachos was very little. The service was ok. Good place if you wanna grab a quick bite to eat. The North Reno location on Mae Anne was a lot better. Kinda bummed that this location was not on par with the other one.

Called ahead to see if they still offer contactless curbside. They said yes which apparently meant I can park in the front (usual parking), go inside, meet with the associate and take my own cart back to the car.  So no. Just shoot straight if you don't want to offer it anymore. Also, it would be nice for large orders to placed with eg cardboard separation so they don't break. Maybe that's the discounted part too. Idk. Guessing the employees aren't paid enough in these times- they seemed miserable. Wine selection/variety & prices were very good. Balance the customer service out though.

Kind of pricey. I think a little more than it's worth, but Ichiban is very close to my home and my girlfriend really likes it. Depending on how much food you want, or what kind, it can easily go from $$ to $$$.
Service by the waitress is definitely *not* the best. Things are often forgotten, and one woman with more seniority likes to yell at and belittle another waitress, then vent to customers about it. 
Sit at the bar- you will get much better service and be able to talk to the sushi chef, ask for reccomendations, questions about the rolls... Plus, when your food is forgotten, he can ring a bell for the waitress to come back.

This BPs should not have bad reviews! It's so quiet, how can you not like it?

Every time I come here I get quick and good service when I eat in the lounge. I've never eaten in the restaurant before. If there is an Oilers game you can always get a table. I just hope this place doesn't shut down because it's never busy, but its so reliable. You can always eat there. It's one of my favourite places to watch a game. 

Menu is a typical BPs. Not much to say about that. The staff is always friendly though and because it is never loaded with people the food comes out so quickly. I'm in and out within an hour.

First visit and during restaurant week.  Seating was awkward and the hostess seemed aloof, clueless that the table she put us in at first had tight seating.  And we are not big people.   After finally moving to a better table, it got better. Food was very good. My friend and I agreed the entree lacked, but the sides, starters and dessert were great.  Loved the celery blue cheese soup and cheese fritters.  Service was below average, server was not well versed on server skills.  You don't ask if I want another beer, when you are about ready to get dessert, should of up-saled and ask if we wanted coffee.

Just returned from a one night stay, although the building is beautiful and the hotel appears "high end", the cleanliness is shameful (see pictures). The first room was so dirty, we asked to be moved to a different room which was just as bad (apparently an upgrade to a deluxe room), I had to call housekeeping to mop the bathroom. We had requested a later check out, but were woken up by housekeeping barging into our room when we were sleeping in the early hours of the morning. Walls were also super thin. Overpriced parking (31$/day).
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We love Tsuki Sushi - a totally unpretentious but delicious sushi spot for a quick casual yummy dinner. It's also really close to the Schyukill trail so takeout & a picnic/biking/hammocking date are always fun.  Not the prettiest dining space here but their service is always friendly and quick.
Definitely check out the spicy yellowtail apple roll, and regular faves like spicy shrimp and eel avocado. They have 2 and 3-roll specials for lunch and dinner (includes salad or miso for lunch), and the price is right

They people who say this is a dive bar...it's the beaches, people.  
You are supposed to be able to walk in wearing shorts and flip flops.  Not a jacket & tie...not a dive bar, a beach bar.

O.K., now that I've said that...this is a great place to hear music and the bartenders are young, but not snobbish or stuck up like SPB and I'm a local who was given a discount my 1st visit on top of very cheap drink prices and strong drinks.

The pizza place next door is great and we had a pizza from there & ate it while listened to music!  :)

This place has character!  Taste soooo good! Don't get my wrong, Ice cream always taste good. So with ice cream it's often about unique flavors or techniques or extras that make your shop different. Revolution has some of the most unique flavors I have ever seen. You can trust me on this because I am a certified ice cream connoisseur. They have a blueberry muffin flavor, a habanero flavor, too many to list really. You have to try it out if you like sweet treats! 

I got my cone head badge here so I'm a little bias ;)

My first Yelp review was inspired by Tokyo Express, sadly. I come in here regularly, as it has more variety in 'fast food' sushi than the Edo in north St. Albert. It's a special trip, as Edo is closer to home. On this particular occasion, my boyfriend and I were gazing at the digital menu, deliberating on our order, when the young chap behind the counter snapped at us to hurry up as they were closing soon. Not cool, man. This is not the first time I have experienced poor customer service here, mainly in the form of overt rudeness from staff. Lost my appetite...

Sushi is decent and probably one of the "better" sushi in Philly although still not the best sushi I've had overall. I recommend trying the specialty rolls as they are more unique and the combination of sauces are definitely interesting. Other items are pretty average to Japanese restaurants. Would definitely prefer dine in than taking out as rolls with tempura or cooked fish do taste better when they're warm. Ok size of pieces although most rolls are cut to 4-6 pieces; you do get decent amount of fish compared to some other places in center city.

I used to visit this Starbucks nearly everyday for years! I conducted a majority of my studies while attending an online school there as the environment was easy to focus in. I established connections with some baristas which supported me as I grew and I am appreciative for having interacted with them. This was my favorite Starbucks even before the renovation, however after I had more the reason to go. The added space was a fantastic addition for such a bustling store!  Furthermore... of course the coffee was great.

Terrible customer service, front desk clerk is a loose cannon. Watched him verbally assault a man over a non-smoking room, then hand him a fist full of cookies after he was shown wrong. Then he slammed the phone down on the counter while talking to a customer and ultimately hang up on them. I witnessed entirely too much chaos just in the check-in process. The room smelled horribly of cigarette smoke and heavy cologne, when I phoned the front desk. The clerk yelled at me stating that I was in a non-smoking room and he wasn't changing the room; he later called and offered air freshers.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Ah Public House.  I do not miss working next door to you at all.  How many negatives can I put in one review?  Terrible food.  Even worse service.  Overpriced drinks.  The clientele after 6pm makes me sick from the stench of cologne, cheap perfurme, and hairspray.  The ridiculous velvet rope on weekends (yeah like you're soooo exclusive).

It's reached a point where I wouldn't step foot in this place even you paid me.  I know I know...it's not like there aren't any better bars in Philadelphia.  Oh wait a minute, there are only about 500 or so.

Brought a brand new Jeep in to get the $28.99 Ultimate Wash. It's an in and out kind of place, but I still expected the job to be done thoroughly. When the workers let us know the car was done, I noticed that the backseat wasn't fully vacuumed and the back cup holders weren't wiped down. The center console was also not polished with armor all all the way. You could tell where the shine stopped harshly. We were the last car at that time so I don't know why the job was so rushed it wasn't done properly. Not totally satisfied with the results, but it's also not an auto detailing place.

Some of the best Italian food we have found in Tucson. 
Portions are more then fair, their garlic knots are amazing !  The only thing that I would do different is a little more sauce on the pasta and the salad I wish was iceberg lettuce and not the fancy field greens. My husband and I find these very difficult to eat. It looks nice but give us cold crisp iceberg any day!

Wait staff was amazing food was hot and prepared perfectly.  Definitely will go there again. 

Olive Garden and Oreganos could take a lesson from this place.

This is a great place to go for whatever your vice may be. Very large, nice selection. My only complaint is that the cashiers aren't always that friendly. Once in a while I'll come across someone kind of rude who actually will bite my head off for holding the pen the wrong way when signing my name on the debit card machine. This is what happened to me last time I was there. Not exactly a big deal but it did bug me a little so thought that I would mention it. I mean ever hear of manners? Being polite is a part of the job you know so learn some!

I have great memories of going here when i was a kid. The food was very good. Unfortunately, i remember the service used to be bettter. When i stand at the counter waiting to be served the guy wont even acknowledge my presence. When im finally waited on they are usually very gruff. Then you usually end up waiting for a while even if they're not busy. There was a particular time where i was treated very rudely when i didnt understand what he was saying. He pretty much talked to me like i was an idiot. After that i didnt go back for quite a long time. So to sum it up good food, bad service.

My friend and I were super excited to check out The Melrose Apartments this past weekend. Almost instantly, we were treated as if we were an inconvenience. Alexandria, who was working in the office, acted as if we were a huge hassle to her. She basically acted annoyed and hurried the tour as quick as possible... complaining the WHOLE time. It was the worst apartment tour I have ever been on. 

We quickly took off Melrose from our list, due to lack of professionalism. I don't want to live somewhere with rude management.

Stayed two nights, May 6-7, 2019.  First, the room was clean and presentable.  But there were three problems: 1) Door latch did not release to close door. Had to jiggle handle every time. Unsafe. 2) reading light on left side of bed did not work preventing wife and I from reading in evening. 3) TV picture constantly jumped and distort every few seconds. Very annoying. I report all three to desk clerk in the morning. I said we would be gone for the day and OK to fix while we were gone. She entered my complaints into computer. When we returned later that day, there had been no attempt made to fix any of these - not even the unsafe door latch!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place deserves zero stars like another reviewer mentioned. I called in an order of schezuan pork and yellow rice, both extra spicy. When I got there the lady told me I called in chicken instead. It was starting to rain so I just took the chicken because I didn't want to wait. The chicken was disgusting to say the least and didn't taste fresh at all. The rice was even worse and none of it was remotely spicy. It was all inedible. This will be the last time I'll be getting takeout from here for sure. Liang's bistro across the street is so much better and not much more expensive. Save your money

This is one of my favorite restaurants because of the great salads and yeast rolls. But my previous experiences were tarnished on Friday night.  I ordered Eggplant Parmesan. When it arrived, it looked yummy but as I consumed it,  there were only a  few small pieces of eggplant...it was crammed with pasta, instead...very disappointing.
Then there were the TV'S on the walls...all tuned to FOX. I go out to dinner to relax, not to be inundated with disturbing news provided by people I never watch. Sports or weather, please.

Once again just blown away by poor customer service. My husband and I travel quite a bit and spend dumb money on hotels and restaurants. We chose the Westin for my birthday weekend although it's not our usual brand but we thought we'd try something different. Never again. No upgrades, the beach was suppose to be private... It was NOT! Every Joe and their mama came through and to top it off.., the goose down on the bed when held up to the light looked filthy but the housekeeper said that's the way the goose downs look worn. We packed and left immediately.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: There is no way I got the same Italian hoagie that won the best of Philly 2014, and judging from the restaurant, I'm not the first one to have this experience. The place was completely empty. The sandwich was filled with soggy iceberg lettuce and limp translucent onions. 2 slices of each meat and 3 slices of provolone with some oil and a shake of oregano. It looked and tasted bland. The roll was meh, not soggy or crisp/ but at least not stale. 2 stars for quickness, but that's all I recommend. If you need to eat something fast it's fine, but don't expect more than just a passable sandwich.

I've been to many Planet Fitnesses and have had memberships in 3 different states. However I have had the worst customer service at this location and interacted with some awfully rude people here. I've never gotten responses to any emails (I work 3 jobs so it's hard to call during regular business hours) and the rare times I do call for questions about my account or charges no one seems to know what's going on and very rudely usher me off the phone. Hate the people here...or at least the people I've had the unfortunate opportunity to interact with. Goodbye Planet Fitness and a big screw you.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Started with wings and shrimp for appetizers.  The wings were good, shrimp was ok.  A little tough around the edges.  My husband had the linguine and clams in red sauce, he loved it.  I had the lobster tails with asparagus. The lobster were a little over cooked, dry and no flavor.  The credit card machine wasn't working, due to loss of power from a car accident on Street Rd.  We had to wait a good 20 minutes for the machine to start working again, since we didn't have cash.  The waitress was very apologetic but should have offered a free drink, or dessert for the inconvenience.

Most of the time the car wash is decent enough. I do the 5 passes a month for $30. But as of late I've been going through x2 to get it clean and the guys on the front end see me going through and still don't clean the dirt off with the pre washing and brushing. 

However, today I decided to run the truck through since we've had a snow and they just wet the vehicle and didn't even scrub it with the brush. The most disappointing part was that there were 6 employees huddled around just shooting the s**t. 

If it were so cheap for 5 washes and the vacuums weren't good I'd have canceled before now.

I had my appointment in late January and the Dr told me that I had cataracts, although he didn't think my insurance would pay for the surgery, so I assumed he knew what he was talking about so I purchased some glasses.  Within a couple of weeks I noticed my eye sight was worse so called back and requested a referral to a cataract specialist.  I wish I would of done that before I spend all of the money on the glasses because my insurance will pay for the surgery.  So if he tells you that you have cataracts, request a referral before buying the glasses.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
This is a great neighborhood restaurant!  Unfortunately, it's not near my home.  
My wife and I met some friends last night to have dinner here and it was a fantastic time and meal!  
First the waitress was very kind while we waited for our whole group to show and then made some great suggestions on what to get.  My wife had spaghetti with balls and I had the ball salad with ricotta.  Both were delicious.  Our friends had the Sunday Gravy and another ball salad and everyone was happy and full.  
We did add a cannoli to push us over the top!  
Great spot and worth the trip for Jersey for!  
Thanks

Came in for a pedicure and for my daughter to have her toes and nails painted. The staff is extremely friendly and the salon itself is clean. I was impressed with the time taken to make sure her nails and toes were perfect. You usually don't see that in a lot of salons when it comes to the younger clientele. My pedicure on the other hand was not so great. My cuticles were cut very poorly, and my feet were scrubbed with the loofah for maybe .5 seconds. I felt like it was a very haphazard service and just wish more care would've gone into it.

I had to give them a star to give a review.   We checked in today for a two day stay.  We went up to our room, everything was fine then we left for lunch.  After returning from lunch we went to our room only to find a man in it.  They gave our room to someone while we were at lunch.  Along with our luggage.  I went to complain as I was HIGHLY upset.  They apologized and gave us a free breakfast card.   Are you freaking kidding me?  All of my belongings were in this room.   When I mentioned that to front desk they told me our stuff was probably not looked through because the person they gave our room to was a pilot.  Really?  Unacceptable
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I used to go here for months. I was a repeat & loyal customer but got screwed over the last time I went. 
My nails looked good usually and it was cheap but the service was not good. The last time I went,
 I made an appointment with the same nail technician as I always did & once I got there, I had to wait 20 minutes cause she decided to take another client before I came in even though I made an appointment with her. And then one of them gave me an attitude before I even sat down to new person who did not do what I asked (maybe she didn't know how??). As soon as I got home, I redid my nails myself cause I didn't want people to look at them.

This place has REAL Mexican food, not tex mex, not California mex but real, authentic Mexican dishes.  The barbacoa tacos are the bomb.  Get barbacoa anything, it's delicious.  I don't what kind of spices they use but the meat is always tender, juicy and savory.  I also love the rajas conqueso tostadas, poblano peppers, beans and cheese, yumm!  They give you 3 different types of salsa with your chips as soon as you sit down.  Sometimes the place is packed (everyone else loves it too!) so the service isn't always stellar but it's worth the wait every time!  This place (and Milagro) set my standards for Mexican.

I went into the cleaners today since they are in my neighborhood. However when I went in I was not greeted as a valuable customer and seemed annoyed. I was asked why did I want one of my shirts dry cleaned what was so special about this shirt???? I was perplexed as to why I was being asked this. Nevertheless I expressed again what services I wanted. When asked the prices she was very short and nonchalant. I left my clothes and got the cleaner ticket. 
After I left I really felt unvalued as a customer and went back to get my clothes and left. I will never return here I'll find another cleaners or iron my own clothes.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: THE BEST experience we have ever had in a hotel.  Stayed a week in January 2015.  Good breakfast and weekday dinners included, kids love the pool, gym is well equipped, in-room kitchens are awesome, clean rooms...everything one would look for.  For me, what really sets them apart is the staff.  All team members we encountered, from customer service to housekeeping, were incredibly helpful, courteous and sincere.  Some went way above the call of duty (in my opinion) to take care of my family's needs.  Highly recommend and will stay there the next time we're in Boise!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I was there on Saturday night,  When I made the reservation 2 weeks in advance I asked for a quiet table and told them it was for a birthday.  Well, we were seated at a table by the aisle and it was so loud I could hardly hear.  

The food was good but I ordered eggplant parm - the eggplant was tasty but there was no cheese on it.  I asked about cheese and was given a little container with grated parm.  Hmmm....first time I've had eggplant parm without the cheese melted on it.

No mention of birthday by our waitress.  I wanted to make this a special occasion dinner and it turned out not so special.  

Next birthday I'll go somewhere else.

I come here every morning. I would say 4/5 days a week I'm waiting around for my order which I place when I leave my apt. Which is ten minutes away giving them plenty of time. I don't mind waiting a couple minutes I know it's busy but waiting 15-20 for a breakfast sandwich they pop in an oven for two min and a coffee is redic. Recently, on two different occasions, they said someone took my order by mistake. Some of the girls are really good consistently make my drink well and are quick. The shorter one is so slow it's painful to watch. This morning I waited 20 min which is the reason for the review

We have travelled to this area many times and tried many of the hotel options. Unfortunately I would not put this location near the top. The rooms are nice but no exhaust vents in the bathroom, not ideal for a family of four. Furniture is pretty dinged up and seems like it could just be cleaned and would look much nicer. Available breakfast has comparable options as most hotels, quality was lacking. With that being said the staff is courteous and helpful. Our room was next to the elevators and we did not hear any noise from that.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Rachelle is who I go to at this salon. 

She's a master at sculpting hair and always gives me a stellar haircut. Rachelle knows I don't use product and am only willing to spend 2-3 minutes brushing and drying my hair. Her cuts are, in my opinion, worth her high price due to time saved from not having to fuss with my hair to make it look nice. People always comment on my hair even though I do very little to style it and don't use product. That's worth a lot to me. 

Front desk isn't warm and fuzzy, but I come for an excellent haircut.  If you want to be sucked up to because you're spending more than $50 to get an excellent cut, move on.

This hotel makes effort to meet your needs.  Kelsey and Jason at the front desk found us a great room with easy access and low noise when the Broadway La Quinta was unable to meet our needs for less able travelers (no elevators! Second floor space? (Place the rollaway wherever you want. Make the bed yourself.). Our room was very roomy and modern. It was clean and comfortable.  No evidence of what other reviewers were complaining about. We stay at lots of La Quintas when traveling because we travel with dogs.  Kelsey helped make this one of our best ever - we will seek to return whenever we stay in Tucson.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Horrible customer service at The Parkway Hotel!! We stay here out of absolute necessity when my sister goes to Siteman Cancer for treatment. Her oncologist frequently cancels appointments the day before.  Depending on who you talk to and if you book through a third party, you may not get a refund! In April, I was able to get a refund, in May I was out $ 158.54. The Rooms are average.  Breakfast buffet definitely poor. Ryan the night supervisor is not helpful at all and does not want to be bothered with customers. Unfortunately, there are not very many options regarding places to stay near Washington University.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The great thing about Kabuki sushi is that you pay for what you get. The rolls were really small and thin but with such cheap prices it makes sense.

I ordered the shrimp mango roll and it was mediocre at best. The sushi its self wasn't packed very well and the contents were falling out as soon as I tried to pick it up with chopsticks. I also had the sweet potato roll and that was decent but not exciting. 

All in all you pay for what you get for. If you want cheap sushi and a light snack this is the place to go.

Avoid this place like the plague.  they had my vehicle for four months after they broke a glow plug off in the head and charged me $3200 for their miss diagnosis and crappy repair  now it drives worse than when I took it in. they refuse to do anymore work to it for fear that something else may go wrong. They now want me to take it to the dealer.I plan on suing the shit out of these people once the dealer is finished seeing what they screwed up .. this place used to be great . But  avoid at all possible costs
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: My husband and I typically stay at Staybridge properties when we travel. This location was by far the best location thus far. There seems to be two separate sides of the hotel. We stayed on the upgraded side. There is a work out facility on the 4th floor and a lounge area on the 3rd floor that was very spacious. Breakfast was decent. There wasn't a variety to choose from if you have eating restrictions. Also, check in is at 4pm. I know a lot of hotels allow early check in, however, it didn't seem to be an option they like to accommodate, so plan accordingly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Do NOT get a pedicure from this man. If I could give 0 stars, I would. Worst experience ever. He was so rough with my pedicure. As he was scrubbing the bottom of my feet, he was paying more attention to the tv than my feet causing him to scratch up my ankle. With that being said, when he applied lotion to my leg, my leg burned. He then proceeded to "massage" me with hot stones which burned me again !! And it was not even a massage. He was moving so fast I dont even remember the massage. I will never come back to this place

This McDonalds location has one of the best consistency ratings in my book. We're a pretty busy family and we appreciate the curbside pickup whenever possible. We're one of those people who always have food preparation modifications when it comes to ordering so we prefer ordering on app through curbside instead of in-person to avoid any confusion. I've worked in Food and Beverage all my life so I understand how frustrating taking orders like mine can be so I make it easy for them and they always deliver flawlessly. Thank you McDonalds for making life just a bit easier for me and my family. Definitely will return again and again!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Terrible service!  My husbands brother knows the owner and raves about this place so we thought we would try it.  When we arrived there was about 12 empty tables and the hostess asked if we had a reservation.  We didn't.  After about 5 minutes of her deciding if we could "fit" she decided to seat us and asked if we could be done by 7:45... We felt unwelcome.  The owner walked out at one point and glared around the restaurant and retreated back to the kitchen.  Took forever to order, food was ok.. But we won't be back.

I ordered a cheeseburger with just mayo/ cheese with  fries. And the fries came with it. I ordered a pizza slice too When I got my order My pizza slice was cold, was okay I had better elsewhere. 
When I finally got my entire takeout order It wasn't what I asked for, the  cheeseburger at all. This place gave me a all the way burger, made it into a combo and I didn't even get the drink, I got charged for it Way overpriced and they can't even get your order right. Doubt I would ever go back there again. Would not recommend to anyone at all

This is easily my favorite sushi spot. The place is small and cozy. The service is always very quick and fast. The rolls are very tasty and their wasabi tastes better than your average one. What I really like about their rolls are that they don't use excessive rice unlike a lot of other places. My favorite rolls are the Pink Lady, Tamago, and Xmas. Their beef negamaki and aged tofu are great appetizers. The price is very good too! It's literally half the price you would normally pay for sushi. 

I highly recommend giving this place a shot

I am a client of Banfield and have recently started going to this location. During these trying times of uncertainty and having a pet that isn't feeling or acting well adds extra stress pet parents don't need. I couldn't reach anyone at my regular office, so I called this office, and I am glad I did. The staff at this office was great. Dr. Rivera called me several times discussing what she wanted to do and what it would cost. Monica took great care of my son's little girl (cat). Our little girl is on her way to recovery. I can't say enough great things about the staff and how they treated not only our pets but also us as owners.

I can't comment on what the room is like. They lost our reservation, so my husband and I had to book a different hotel. Of course, that didn't stop the SpringHill from charging us for staying there, even though we called and they told us to look elsewhere since they were full. It's been almost 2 weeks and no refund. At this point, hubby has spent literally 2 hours on the phone, either with the hotel itself or their customer service center. They still can't find our reservation (funny how they found our cc) and they keep transferring my husband to the manager's answering machine.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The staff was very polite at check in. They were down to two elevators which took 20 minutes to get up to the rooms. Even though they are suites the air conditioning is so loud you cannot sleep with the noise and it though it was low at 65° it felt like it was 80. This is not a hotel I recommend during the heat of the summer or the fall or the spring. Just no circulation and so loud you cannot sleep. Somethings were broken down like the ironing board the hangers the leaky sink. It's a hotel that seems to be falling apart fast but better keep up with the updates or they will lose their clients
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Good food, good quality, and good service. We came in early afternoon on a Saturday and were concerned that it was completely empty but soon after we sat more people came in.. We were just early it seems. The chips and salsa were pretty good! We're both vegetarian and options seemed limited but they were very accommodating and said pretty much anything can be modified if we wanted which was very appreciated. I got the enchiladas and they were sooo good! Everything tastes fresh and made to order. The restaurant is festive and fun decor. Can't wait to come again!

This Arby's has been closed  for quite a while now, at least since last winter. Actually the only restaurant left  in the Foothills Mall "food court" is an Asian place (don't recall the name). Maybe their questionable practices caught  up to them. However I would heartily recommend the Oracle and Magee location, next door to McDonald's. That  location has friendly people and quick service. Only gripe I would say is that the chicken tenders are a little on the small side. The honey mustard dip is to die for. Delicious!

This place is okay. I've come here a couple times, as it is nearby the house. I don't mind the old school dark decor. It adds character. Their caprese salad is decent. As are their pastas. Everything is fairly decent. Not exactly memorable, but certainly not horrible either. Recently, being sick of bar food -  the only abundant food on the beach -I was craving vegetables. I ordered the antipasto salad. It was iceberg lettuce, with three chunks of cheese and three chunks of salami, some celery, a tomato, and a few carrots, and peperoncinnis. It wasn't bad. But it wasn't great. Especially in direct comparison to other nearby Italian places.

I am sure the employees at this Hertz location work very hard, but this Hertz location is the worst one I have been to in my frequent travels. As a frequent Hertz renter, I normally do not have any problems getting a rental vehicle. At this location I have consistently had problems renting a vehicle. The current rental experience was by far the worst. With a valid rental reservation I was made to wait for almost an hour to get my rental vehicle. While pleasant, the counter people were very slow. I will try very hard to not rent from this Hertz location again.

Just OK. Hotel in general is kept in nice condition. Rooms, or "suites", are pretty small for any party over two people (we had four). And they are not true suites; rather, they are one room semi-divided by a partial wall. Nothing in the way of privacy. Housekeeping was mediocre.

The pool is a bit of a joke. It's indoors and nice, but about the size of our room. Literally.

Towel test: My new method for rating hotels. I want big bath towels. Give me small towels and get a lower rating. This place gets four stars for their towels.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My wife and I regularly visit Bartaco, probably about once every 2 weeks. It is our go to for date nights, bringing family from out of town, business lunches etc. Craig the FOH manager always makes it a point to say hi and give a quick chat if he can. Every hostess, server, food runner, bartender we have ever had has been outstanding. Food is always hot and fresh(make sure to ask about the secret tacos of the week). Atmosphere is awesome, the balcony doors and windows are open when the weather is nice, and is puppy friendly.

Wanted to support a local business but was pretty disappointed in both the service and food. Ordered a 14'' veggie deluxe pizza and a side of jalapeño poppers. I picked them up on time but both items were room temperature. After getting home I realized that the deluxe pizza had no red sauce on it (it tasted okay but I was really craving red sauce) We called the store asking about this and the worker said "thanks" and then hung up on us. The jalapeño poppers were delicious (would be even better if they were warm) but the pizza was less than mediocre.

Don't stay here, period.  Alot of local people just hanging out in a not so good part of town. Security is tight, highly fenced in if that gives you any idea of the area.  The front desk staff were inept at check in, and no effort to be polite or accommodating. Its an old place, they are trying to keep it clean but the staff and neighborhood are not worth the hassle. The cost is fair and its close to downtown, about $6 bucks for an Uber to bourbon street. Within a mile there are much nicer places for just slightly more.  I even had a local say she wouldn't stay here, always trust the local opinions.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Might be 5 stars but a few things... sink stopper didn't work, always closed apparently even for the maid because sink was dirty. No hand wash rags in room, just 2 shower towels and 1 hand towel for sink. Typically it's overpriced, (although we found a great deal)
Other than that it's  great place. Large and beautiful lobby area. Good location and parking right across street. Rooms are smaller than typical but plenty big enough and  all the essentials...bed, desk, tv, bathroom coffee pot and outlets. Clean and everything worked fine. Extremely helpful staff. Would recommend... but keep an eye out for price deals online.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Great bar and friendly, efficient wait staff.  But the food -- not so much.  I ordered "Meat Lasagna".  When the order came I cut into the serving and found quite a bit of this orange-looking stuff.  When I asked the waitress what it was -- she said "carrots - the chef puts in lots and lots of those -- although some people think it is a little "weird".  Weird, indeed.  The menu should have said, "Carrot Lasagna With Some Meat Sauce".  

To be fair I will give this restaurant one more shot, but I hate it when a chef takes standard Italian dishes and "improves" them or makes the into "nouveau cuisine".

I had high expectations of Lolita, but it still exceeded all of them.  The velvety queso complemented the crunchy veggies mixed in to it.  The spicy tuna guac was unique and delicious.  Fried chicken tacos were, I mean, fried chicken tacos...I could have died inside one.  The make your own shrimp taquizas were cooked perfectly and the salsa Verde and jicama/orange slaw was divine.  The flour less chocolate cake tasted like it was made with flour but was nonetheless amazing.

A star off because drinks weren't the strongest but I mean whatever

I've been doing the bulk of my shopping here for over 12 years. Good people and a clean store. It frustrates me that you can get seated at Bern's Steakhouse quicker than you get a pound of ham at the deli counter at 5:00 pm. They never have more than one person! Employees in other departments will just stand idle and look at you. I don't understand why they never have enough employees in this section of the deli. Also, they should do the bulk of the stocking after hours. The isles are narrow (small store) and often blocked with stock carts.

We came here tonight for dinner. This is our second visiting at this restaurant, and it will be our last.
 My man ordered lasagna. I Ordered Thursday special bouillabaisse. He enjoyed his meal while I didn't. His food was small potion and My food was cold. Seafood wasn't cooked properly. It tastes like they put their precook seafood in hot water for few second and then add it into  a separate bowl of broth, and then serve. The mussel shelf was still cook. the shrimp has the same salty taste that I usually buy from frozen cook shrimp from the store. It wasn't worth for 22.95$
2 star for a nice waitress and because my man likes his food.

Terrible! Watch out for hidden costs!!
We booked a car for 279 on internet for 9 days. After adding mileage and 30% AirPort tax the car cost 1233 dollars!! Moreover We felt they were cheating. My father does not speak English but he hurried us and did not give us time to read the contract. Unfortunately we signed, and after reading and turning back the car after 30 min, we still had to pay 139 dollars. He were also lying to us that SUV does not come with extra costs!! We are shocked. Did not expect to be cheated by budget.

Went to Glo as a walk-in for a pedicure. Overall, it was fine.

I didn't feel like things were particularly clean or efficient and the cuticle on my big toe was a little mangled by the time I left. The man who I'm assuming was the manager wasn't wearing a mask at all for the duration of my appointment, which made me a little uneasy since the salon is so small and he was walking around and talking quite a bit (this was before the mask mandate was lifted).

My pedicure lasted a while and looked good enough, but I probably won't go back.

Omg! 
Okay so I was out one day and someone mentioned how YUMMY their shrimp & grits were. I love and enjoy brunch. It just is my happy place. 

Anyhoot, fast forward and I get a chance to try R&B. This place does not disappoint (outside of this amazing Cesar salad I guess they used to have that was fire). I ended up getting the bottomless mimosa (whew and was buzzed) and the chicken & waffles. The chicken was crispy, juicy and cooked to perfection. That waffle   Everything was delicious. So delicious I attempted to go the following weekend but they were packed

My family and I go to this restaurant frequently as there's not many good options in north valley's area and the food here is usually pretty good. All the employees are very nice, but the past few times we've gone in, the wait time is extremely long. There's been days where they're not very busy, and days where they're super busy and regardless we wait close to an hour or more to get our food. They also don't come check on you during this time, and ask you if you need refills on drinks or anything. Again, the food is good and they have a good selection on their menu but I do believe they need to improve on their customer service.

Ordered two different sushi combos and a bento box. The bento box was okay, but the sushi and sashimi were not fresh. The miso was good. The tuna rolls were salty and squishy - even slimy. When we complained, the server didn't know what to do. She simply gave us the bill and seemed a little embarrassed - no apology. Oh - she did offer ice cream. By then, one of our party had become sickened (complete with an urgent trip to the restroom) and we were grossed out and could not finish our dinner.
An unfortunate experience.

The best all you can eat sushi we have ever had! 'All-you'can'eat' sushi has it's own stigma lol but this place breaks the stereotype. It's clean, friendly, and the sushi is amazing! We drive 2 hrs from Champaign to get here, and it has always been worth it! Never been disappointed! 
Love their shrimp tempura. All the sashimis are great! I love their jumbo soft shell crab roll (crunchy spider roll? sorry can't remember the exact name), but we get multiple of it, it is delicious!

Friendly staff, and all in all great sushi every time! Will visit again soon!

So WHITE CASTLE SLIDERS are amazing anywhere - so the food is good but WOWZAAA this location.... SO SLOW. I ordered online through the app utilizing the promo code and ordering in advance while road-tripping through ST LOUIS.... ordered to pick up at 5:27 (actually received my food after 5:45). Needless to say using the app made no difference because our food wasn't being prepared until I walked in (we ordered 8 sliders).... but having no WC in Oklahoma meant the wait was necessary. Overall store was clean - staff moved slow - sliders tasted good.

Needed a cheap car for the in laws.  And Hertz was the cheapest.  The fun begins, go to pick up the car.  They moved to the other side of the parking lot.  
  Nice guy at the counter, getting close to closing time.  He gets a call, someone needing a car.  He apologizes that they are out of cars.  Then gives me a choice of 2 cars.  
  He then did a quick hose off and fills the tank.
Going in knowing I was going to get bad service and car that was questionable road worthy.  They actual did better than I expected.  So here is one more star.

Went there last night to try it out. Terrible experience. Asked for a sample of some of the chipotle chicken and the owner says no. Jokingly we say "qdoba gives samples" ... obviously it was a mistake because the owner starts a huge scene, opens up his wallet, hands us $10, tells us to go to qdoba and says "I am a celebrity chef I've cooked for j lo" obviously not because of how unprofessional his manners were. All of this started from asking for a sample. 

We went to qdoba and it was delicious and didn't disappoint as always! Thank you QDOBA 

Will not be returning here hopefully the place burns down

So I'm hungry and I have a lot of studying so I decided to get Chinese delivery from here. I see the prices and I'm like "wow so reasonable and free delivery". Food arrives and I take a bite of the egg roll and it taste like  rotten so I smell it...straight up garbage. Taste my other food, basically a combination of salt, oil, gross, and sadness. I order chicken in garlic sauce; absolutely no trace of garlic and it was fanta orange. I'm like "should have read the reviews first". Open my yelp app: 2.5/5 rating. Look on google: failed health inspection in December 2016, only 2.5 months ago. Honestly not worth the price.

I went on a Sunday. Had my exam in a timely manner. Felt extremely rushed in my choosing of frames after I waited close to an hour for a tech. Received my glasses in a timely manner and the script was not right. Had to redo my exam and wait another couple of weeks for my glasses. Still not happy with the prescription. Have gone to the Vision Works  in West Nashville and have always been happy with the exam and prescription and they will spend all day with me if I needed to to make a choice in frames. I will never go back to this store and would never recommend this store to anyone. Do not waste your time.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
The atmosphere at this establishment is absolutely breathtaking. When we walked in, the host and staff were very friendly and greeted us with smiles. I enjoyed the trip until Mike at the Jimmys night bar was less than enthusiastic to serve my family and I on our yearly vacation. 

Anastasia, our server, saved our experience. She came to our table and promptly asked us if we needed anything even though we already had purchased drinks at the bar. She offered appetizers by name and the rest of the staff that brought the food was very prompt and polite. I would come back to Jimmys for sure, I won't let one bad apple ruin the batch.

Mediocre. The place is beautiful, great music and neat waterfall wall. And service was friendly and good. But the food was mediocre. Avocado salad was nothing but iceberg lettuce with some avocado and a touch of caviar on top. Ginger dressing was decent but not the best I've had. Avocado roll was alright. Godzilla roll was decently good but not spectacular. Dragon roll was the biggest disappointment, there was crab stick in it instead of crab meat as the menu suggested. Ginger was the pink kind, wasabi seemed low quality. Overall was not impressed. Probably will not go here again.

Today is a 1 star day at Olde Town in Plant City.  The strawberry salad is the SHOW PIECE of the restaurant and today was a very disappointing day. I realize it's a "first world" problem when we are unhappy with a food place but the Yelps like to know.  Soggy leftover strawberries  and a portion half the size.  3 -$12.00 salads and a 1 hour round trip drive out there to impress my friends with the great salad just didn't go as planned.  
Be better girls, lettuce doesn't cost that much and Plant City has plenty of strawberries.  Reputation is worth more that whatever you saved not doing it right.     Just my opinion.

I will not be staying here again. The best part about the hotel is the location. Plenty of places to eat nearby if you are a foodie like myself. 
PROS:
Location
Front desk ladies are friendly

CONS: 
Bathrooms are tiny and have little to no counter space at all. 
Curtains had stains on them
Carpet had stains on them too
The sheets and bathroom floor had hair all over them. (Yes I could've switched rooms but after a long day of driving and setting up a booth I just didn't care anymore)
Breakfast is your typical Holiday Inn Express breakfast but later than normal... starts at 6:30am.
Overall this is a solid 2 stars.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I will make a blind nod to the dingy decor, but I will definitely give a cheer to the food. The tacos al pastor with pineapple chunks were perfectly spicy, and the guacamole and fresh chips were divine. My only complaint is that the hot chips melted through the styrofoam container on my brief walk home, but I only had to sacrifice two chips. The small bit of leftovers for my lunch the next day were even better, and it's all I can do to keep myself from ordering a container of guac everyday! Great little place...

I lived across the courtyard from La Viola for a year and a half. Let's just say our building was infested with mice and cockroaches, and that the workers frequently left shrimp tails in the gardens when they ate their early dinner out there. All I ever got from them was attitude when I glimpsed into their filthy stock room when I walked past the back door. There are so many other places for great Italian food like Le Virtu and Tre Scalini down on Passyunk Avenue in South Philly. Run, don't walk, away from La Viola!
