This place is under new management. It has so much potential to be good, but sadly it is not. They had a full kitchen of staff which is great but only one waitress. The service was really slow and sloppy and it wasn't because of the understaffed waiters. The waitress spent most of her time behind the pizza counter giggling and telling stories to the other employees. Your aloud to have a social life at work but not when there are several tables to attend to.
Other than that, the salads are big and great for sharing. And they have really nice crunchy bread for their paninis (though I wouldn't recommend the eggplant panini).

Nice and courteous.  Dr. Page tries to be very thorough in exams (though I respectfully declined the pupil dilation because I did not want it that day).  Told them very matter-of-factly that I get my contacts and glasses elsewhere.  They did not push me to get them there.  Only thing is that I ordered contacts elsewhere and the office did not update the fact that I got an eye exam a few days ago and updated prescription...so my order got declined.  They must be busy--I was disappointed though.  However, no big reason to change optometrists.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Haven't tried the sushi yet, but I had been looking for a decent place to pick up Korean food for lunch.  Just got bibimbop and must say that it's pretty good!  

I'm picky with Korean food because I won't pay for what I can make at home.  I've been looking for a decent Korean restaurant in Center City (for lunch), but the other Korean restaurants that I'd been to in Center City were just 'eh'.

Makiman Sushi has very decent bibimbop.  The lunch bibimbop comes with a side miso soup. I'm looking forward to trying other things on their menu.  Too bad they don't have a large variety of Korean food--I guess it's primarily a sushi place.

Have you been in search of some of the worlds most renowned beignets?! Cafe du Monde is here to dissatisfy those expectations at a RAPID pace. I walked in through the humid putrid air and inhaled an absolute cloud of powdered sugar. What lies beneath that mountain of powdered sugar you may ask...a beignet that was almost as fragrant and tasty as freshly microwaved cardboard. I chose hot chocolate as my beverage and it was like Swiss miss warming my throat. I'm not sure if this place was any better before the hurricanes or downfall of society but I'm hoping they make a change soon. Can't wait to never go back.

My wife and I have owned many dogs over the years and have been blessed with many excellent vets to care for our fur babies. Dr. Kue and his staff far surpassed our expectations and is by far the most caring veterinarian we have met. They were friendly, professional, unrushed, caring, and sincere. Dr. Kue explains the diagnosis, expected charges, and procedures in clear terms. If you are looking for small animal veterinary care anywhere within 45 minutes of this office, this is the place to go. It is worth the drive for the quality of service.

The addition of Handel's to Royersford has been absolutely delightful! They have a variety of creamy, flavorful ice cream. My personal favorite is Oree-dough. Oh, and if you're looking for the most refreshing and vibrant sherberts, look no further!!! They often carry orange, pineapple, and raspberry sherberts. They're equally delicious! For an extra special treat, get yourself a sherbert parfait with their super creamy soft vanilla. If these wonderful desserts aren't reason enough to visit, the owners are extremely friendly, caring and always go out of their way to make you feel welcome! We love this sweet, family-friendly gem in our town!

I used to love this car wash (I had a monthly set of 5 washes) until they changed their policy (without notification) and no longer use the automated brush on roofs of cars with racks (which rules out my Subarus).  As far as I'm concerned, an Ultimate Car Wash includes washing all the vehicle's surfaces.  There are many car wash options in Reno, and leaving my car dirty is a deal breaker.  I gave them 2 Stars because their staff is very nice and until the company made this change, I was very happy with their service.

Maybe my expectations were too high, but I have had much better tacos from Capital Taco, Loli's and Acapulco's. Forget about the small size of the tacos...the food wasnt that great. The fish taco was over salted, the steak taco was over-seasoned and low quality shredded beef, the shrimp taco has too much vinegar, the falafel taco was dry and the tortillas were store bought. The atmosphere is the best quality of the restaurant, and the guacamole was good, but aside from that, there are many other places for Tacos that we would visit first, including HabloTaco at Channelside.

Stopped in on a Sunday afternoon for lunch and waited quite a while for a waitress.  Explaining that I have celiac and must eat gluten free, I asked about Gluten free options.   I was told that the salad dressings are made in-house, but that no one in the kitchen would know if they are gluten free.  I settled for oil/vinegar, much to my dismay.  We were never asked what we wanted to drink and had to flag the waitress down for drinks as well as the check.  The food was good; however, lack of service and of gluten free knowledge will stop me from returning.

Saw this on DDD on food network. 

The variety of menu items is vast. Lots of options. 

I had one of their specialty sandwiches on GF bread, roasted red pepper tomato soup, and sweet potato chips with whipped goat cheese. 

Which was about $19

It's in a cool place that is shared with other eateries and bars. 

Fun and lively atmosphere. 

The food quality is decent, but the portions are a bit small for the price. 

I'd go again and try some other things on menu. 

Their shakes seem really good but, they were out of the coconut vegan ice cream I was excited to try.

Used to be our (roomates and i) bar of choice but I had to deal with a shit bouncer that was on a power trip. I'm 22 and been to the bar plenty times. He said my ID DIDNT look like me. He asked me to leave. I showed the card to the bartender and she said that it DID look like me but the bouncer had made up his mind. This is the first time this has ever happened anywhere. I walked home(2 blocks away) to grab other forms of ID. I walked back and showed him multiple cards. He just looked at me and said, "No...no." It was infuriating. Shame they cant hire decent bouncers. Wont be going back.... GRIF is amazing though, always chill.

Can't believe I have lived in Chesterbrook for almost 3 years now and this was my first time at BPT.  First, the menu offers such a variety... from great sandwiches (I had the Short Rib Grilled Cheese), burgers (the Italian burger basically has a huge mozzarella stick on it-omg), and appetizers (pretzels with cheese sauce and honey mustard was so good) .  I'm sure everything else is just as delicious.

This doesn't even play into how great the service was.  We sat at a high top in the bar, and our main server (I think also a bartender) was awesome.   

I will definitely be coming back here very shortly!!

I've been to this restaurant twice in the last week and have left disappointed both times. The ordering system is confusing- as per some of the comments from a year ago.  They want you to order at the first counter but there was no one there to take our orders both times.  The food is mediocre at best. I had chicken with portobello and my husband had chicken parmigiana. Chicken was very over cooked. Husband wanted red wine and they only had chianti left... glasses were dirty. Kids meal is a good deal but flavour is lacking. Now that I have used up my groupon, I will definitely not be dining here.

Seriously.. we ordered a pepperoni pizza and there were 10 pepperoni's total on the entire pizza and it was slightly burnt. This place used to be very good but apparently the chef was not here tonight and the pizza was absolutely terrible.!! Very disappointed. They took off the $2 pepperoni charge... seriously!! 
It used to be good here but I hope this isn't an example of a decrease in their quality.
Today it was one star for the food quality but I gave it 3 stars just because I know it can be good and the staff is always good.

The food was decent, but not outstanding.  The service, though, left much to be desired.  Not very friendly, forgot side orders, and never came back to our table for a coffee refill.  Essentially just took our order and then brought us a check at the end, so how is that much different than a fast food outlet?  Now, to be fair, this could have been just this server but the register was also unmanned, with that person talking to others in the back when we went to pay.  We have friends who go here often, so we'll likely give them another shot.  I hope the next visit is better...

Two words: So. Good. 
There is frozen yogurt and then there is amazing frozen yogurt. This place has amazing frozen yogurt. It looks like one of your typical froyo places, with ample space between furniture and a few tables outside to sit and enjoy. I tried the raspberry lemonade, I believe it was (something lemonade!) with the cookies and cream (no I didn't mix, they were side by side) with a few toppings which were very fresh. They had brownies and of course I had to put a few on the cookies and cream side, and they were absolutely delicious. Overall, I liked the place and the froyo. I will definitely be going back. Happy eating!

My mom and I came here while at a conference in St. Louis - and I wish we could visit all the time!  We had great wine, and when it was time to make our dinner choice decision the owner/manager asked if we needed any help.  I told him the few choices I had narrowed it down to and then he took our menus and said he would take care of us - and boy did he!  They reallly tried to accomodate our wishes and in turn we left stuffed and happy.  I would happily recommend Tony's to any in the St. Louis area for a great meal and an excuse to get dressed up!

Years ago, I had gone to an O'Gradys in Pottstown, which was the ultimate!  So, when I moved to Telford, you can imagine how happy I was to see an O'Gradys near by in Souderton.  Well believe you me, when they say management can make or break a restaurant, they were right.  This O'Gradys leaves much to be desired....I've been there several times and the quality of the food is not that good.  I've complained to the waitress, but it was like, "not care".  They don't really have much to offer except a clean establishment and a nice salad bar.  But if your looking for quality food, forget about it.

Staff is rude, Starbucks and the restaurants are closed yet they don't tell you til you get there. If you want food you either have to order their high prices room service or go out to eat. Normally i wouldn't care but it rained our whole trip so we tried to just hang at the hotel .. I come to three or four Saints games and 8-10 Pelicans games a year, usually stay in a Marriott property but wanted to find something closer so less walking .. guess I'll stick with the long walks when i come back for football season
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Had weeknight family dinner at Lolita. The food is fresh, tasty and well presented.

However, the wait staff looked disinterested and were in a rush to go back to the counter and get the order served. Even if they were not particularly rude, they seemed disinterested.

Of the dishes we ordered, we liked the veggie nachos and the fish tacos. And also the coffee tiramisu. Also, for the portion sizes (they were not small, but smaller), we felt the dishes were priced a little higher than should be.

While the food was tasty, the over-all experience stops me for rating it any higher.

We enjoy coming here for lunch you can't beat the price of 9.95 for endless dish. We never have a bad servers. The food is a bit of a wait.The only thing we don't like here is the host. Every Time we enter the restaurant the host never seem to be welcoming. On Saturday lunch the young woman host doesn't even greet us we had to say how many party is here to get her to attention. On our way to seat our table once again she doesn't smile or talk. 

If your not to serious about service this is a place for you to come. If you want to get your money worth of service find a difference place with a nice warming host.

This hotel is top-notch. Great service, big rooms, fast elevators, great Wifi, comfortable beds, roomy bathrooms. I'm not sure about the housekeeping as I declined it during my stay, but otherwise I would definitely come back here when visiting St. Louis again.

However, like all other Westins, they nickel and dime you. Wi-Fi requires money, same with breakfast. I didn't park here, but I know they have valet so you'd probably have to pay for that too. Great for business travel, not so much if you're spending your own money
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I find this hotel very convenient since it is just across America's Center where GFOA conference is being held. A lot of restaurants around the hotel and found 2 convenience store too. Commute is also made easy since - Metro link, Downtown trolley is just across so you can get to the place of attractions conveniently. 
The room I stayed is just the right size, clean and nice and has high ceiling so you don't feel cramped. Pillows and comforter are so comfy and feels clean. Bathroom is made of white tile looks clean and wouldn't hesitate to use. 
There's also free WiFi for Marriott rewards members.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We have rented cars for years but have rarely been pressured as much as we were this rental to buy insurance and to upgrade.  We told her we were covered but she went ahead with her spiel which would have confused a lot of people into buying unnecessary insurance.  Then she told us we would be uncomfortable in the car we rented (Nissan Versa) and that we should seriously upgrade to a larger car for comfort and a better ride...for just $11 per day more.  When we declined her facial expression told us she might have missed a bonus.  Anyway...we did not upgrade and the car was just right..no problem what's so ever.  Just watch the hard sell.

This hotel is located across the interstate from the entrance to the Boise Airport. It shares a parking lot with the Holiday Inn so check that reservation closely. It also has an Applebee's in the parking lot for a dining option. 

The hotel meets the expectations of the Holiday Inn Express chain. The rooms are spacious, clean and comfortable. I did not experience any noise issues while staying there. The breakfast in the morning included hot and cold items. 

Located about 10 minutes from downtown and the university, this hotel was convenient to where I needed to be.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Tonight was our very first visit and let me tell you it won't be our last. The food was AMAZING! The service was good and the place was clean. I can't wait to try other items on the menu. The brick oven pizza was perfectly cooked. The crust was crunchy on the outside and soft in the center. The fresh mozzarella was perfect on top. We also had the chicken parm.  It was a large portion and tasted wonderful. I wish I could remember what my desert was called because that was the perfect ending to a very satisfying meal. Looking forward to our next visit.

Over the years we've enjoyed many a good meal and good service at Cardwell's but, sad to say it appears those days are no longer. 
Organized a lunch for 11 other friends, as I've done at Cardwell's a couple of times per year for several years but this time nothing but road blocks. They've become so difficult to work with. Such a hassle!
Today was the lunch and we had the absolute minimum of service. As the restaurant wasn't very busy and we ended up 11 paying customers one would think someone would care. But no. 
Doubt we'll ever be back.

2 stars for the great food however completely poor hand hygiene. I watched the girls at the counter handling food with their bare hands then also handling cash at the register. I observed this while I ate for an hour, I also watched her wiping the counters with a soil rag then touching her personal cellphone followed by again touching money and serving slices. How is this allowed? Very unsafe.. I'm surprised people have not gotten sick from the lack of poor hygiene. Never the less... Have a bottle of hand sanitizer available  at the counter or one person handle the register/orders and one handle the food. Poor management if you ask me.....

I'm only giving this a 2 star because the manager is great. Other than that one employee has ruined every experience I've had at this location. Every time I go in there a older woman named Kat is rude, impatient, and will skip over me to help anyone else because she doesn't like me. She says I'm rude. When someone cuts me off multiple times ask I'm trying to give my order and I ask them to not cut me off nicely I tend to get annoyed repeating myself. Now I am rude to her because she is nasty to me. What sucks is this location is the closest to my job so I'm stuck not enjoying your food over ONE person.

I've going to this gym for 16 yrs now because I have a life membership that only costs me under 50.00 a yr.  This is the only reason I still go!  The equipment needs updating badly.  Even if they don't update, they could at least keep the old equipment in good working order.
Also, When you walk up to the front door the first thing you see is the nasty old gum all of the sidewalk with pigeon feathers stuck all of them.  I have never the gum removed in all the yrs going.  It's really gross!  You don't have to be updated to the latest and greatest, just clean!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The food is very good here, some of the best in Vail which really isn't saying much considering the limited choices. This restaurant is poorly managed and the servers are not good. They have no training or don't care about service or both. If you decide to go, set your bar low for service and you'll be fine. If you go right when they open, don't expect food to be fast. This place needs a managers attention fast and train your servers on the drink menu if you're going to offer a drink menu. I'd give this place 1 star but the food is very good which is the only reason I gave it 3.

I routinely drove 20 miles to the same salon for over a year.  She started over booking and the nails showed it.  Signal Nails is right next to home and I noticed the poor reviews were all old so, I gave it a shot.  This is my return visit for a fill and pedi.  Tyson applied a full set a few weeks ago.  Due to my career, the acrylic always start peeling quickly. These have NOT.  Once again, today, Tyson has worked his magic !   I am leaving  with beautiful, nails that look natural. Not too thick!  Simply perfect !   If you book with Tyson you will absolutely leave happy !!

Bad morning for them. Not terribly busy when we entered but took almost 40 minutes for two breakfast orders that were served wrong.
Asked for eggs sunny side up and have no idea what I got, looked like two poached that they fried to cover up the mistake. They and the plate were soaking wet and rubbery beyond being edible. Same with a side of French toast, maybe thirty seconds on the grill? No where near cooked. Asked for manager and she politely agreed and comped the entire order.

I then had to go get breakfast somewhere else...

We knew nothing about this restaurant before coming here for our 25th anniversary.  It was mid week and we were dressed pretty nice.  When we walked in I was underwhelmed my the casual decor and the fact that the place was fairly empty.  The hostess escorted is to a corner table.  When we got the menu I began to get intrigued.  Everything looked great. The waiter suggested the 5 course menu. We told him any particular food dislikes.  The chef then put together an amazing meal.  Each course was unique and delicious. For definitely a memorable night.  I highly recommend this place.

Really disappointed tonight. We were stuck between two local spots to enjoy happy hour and Taco Tuesday at and this one had listed on their website better happy hour drinks. We've been here before and enjoyed the food and atmosphere but were really disappointed to find out not only would they not even honor the pricing on their website BUT they didn't have ANY drink specials what so ever. We waited around for about 20minutes in hopes that they would decide they could honor the websites post but they would not. Heading to the other option. Very upset with how that was handled.

We had a wonderful lunch on the patio today. The Brick Street Market in the village brought us out on this beautiful day. Heading home we decided to stop for an outdoor lunch. Greeted and served by a very nice lady, we were given great info about the menu, types of pizza, etc. they have a hand tossed crust or a thin crust. Decided on the veggie hand tossed. It was delicious!  Lots of cheese, just the right amount of sauce. Green peppers, sliced banana peppers, Red onion, mushrooms were plentiful.  I really loved it. 
Iced tea was refilled and fresh brewed. We will definitely be back. We were told they offer beer and wine as well.

I worked for a performance company during this past weekends NFL Scouting Combine, where our headquarters was located in this wonderful hotel. The staff was very friendly and highly accommodating. Regularly came by to make sure everything was okay and if we needed anything. Based on their hospitality alone, I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking to do a conference in downtown Indianapolis. It's connection to the Convention Center makes it very convenient, and there are plenty opportunities for dinning and entertainment within a 3 minute walk from the hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I was very disappointed with my stay at the Hilton Garden Inn Indianapolis NW. The hotel was very clean, and the staff was courteous, but it was very hard to get any sleep and I normally sleep like a baby in hotels. 

The bed was way too firm which made it nearly impossible to get comfortable. When I finally was able to get comfortable I couldn't sleep because I could hear my neighbors television through the paper thin walls like it was in my room. 

I don't care how nice the appearance of the hotel is, if it can't offer a good nights sleep then I certainly cannot recommend it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Awful service - ordered a coffee on mobile app and usually go thru drive in but did walk-in as I wanted to stretch my legs - 2 women working that were absolutely so slow- another gentlemen was waiting to order at counter and they didn't acknowledge either one of us that were waiting for at least 5 mins - we both had to request that they wait on us. I used the restroom and came back and she made my coffee and let it sit behind the counter where I couldn't reach and didn't even have the courtesy to tell me it was ready - and yes she knew my # as I asked her multiple times if it was done - won't be using this Dunkin' ever again

Before you rent a car from Alamo make sure that they don't have your credit card information handy because they'll come up with false reasons to bill you upwards of $200 months later for supposed multiple "tolls" or "moving violations" that never actually happened and then pass you off to multiple "facets" of their associate companies in hopes that you won't report them to your credit card company. Complete scam and what's sad is that up until I came home from vacation I actually had a really good experience.

Alamo car rental has this new service where you go directly to the cars, chose one, get in, and drive off. You check in on your mobile phone. All you have to do is show your license at the gate on the way out. It is fast and convenient. You drop the car off and they hand you a bill that has already charged to your credit card. My car was brand new with under 50 miles on it. I had no problems at all. I would rent with them again. They also provide a shuttle to and from the airport. The Alamo representatives I did encounter where very friendly and helpful.

I've been to this laundromat twice because it is the closest one in my neighborhood. The off street parking is nice and it is never too crowded. Most washers are broken, however, and the doors to the dryers keep opening so it's best that you stay there and watch your clothes as they are being cleaned. The worst part is that it is pretty pricey but the laundromat does not give you quarters. There is a machine for dispensing quarters but it is always out of order so you need to make sure you have quarters before you go.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
The food is ok, not great.  However, the service is awful! We got the wrong appetizer and the waitress came over and told us this is what she ordered. She said to my husband "you said gyoza" (which is impossible because he would have never been able to get close to saying it!), and was a little confrontational. I'm pretty sure we paid for both appetizers in the end, even though she took the gyoza away (impossible to tell because they don't give an itemized bill!).

Prices are expensive and not really worth it.

I don't know how this place averages four stars.  It's a dump located between a drug dealers parking lot and a taxi cab depot.  But as scary as it looked outside the lot was full so I thought this dive was top rated I gotta try it.

HORRIBLE.  The place was empty.  A hundred cars outside and not a single table.  We ordered anyways.  When the sushi arrived it smelled off and when we tasted it it was old.  Gray tuna, over cooked shrimp tempura roll, avocado was slimy as was the yellow tail and the octopus.

I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone.

Went with a group of 6. Service was horrible. Food very average at best. Ran out of water before we even got meal. Waitress came by and ask one person at the table if she needed more. Really empty glass and still did not have meal, what do you think. We asked for water for everyone came back with a couple pictures set them on table and left. When she brought food she handed plates across the table. We were sitting at a round table with plenty of room all the way around. I have had better Italian food at the spaghetti warehouse and there food was terrible. Not going back.

This cafe is run out of love by two men in the Italian American community. It is a place for local Italian Americans to hang out; they don't do it for profit. This community originally immigrated from Maida, Calabria, and the owners (as do other community members) maintain strong ties with and visit Maida often. If one has been to a local cafe in a small town in southern Italy, one will recognize how authentic it is. The gelato is good and the pastries are homemade from family recipes. Dried pasta from Calabria is for sale. Try the hot chocolate for winter. Yes, not a huge selection as others have indicated but what is there is excellent.

There are a few mexican restaurants down the street from this one and I would recommend any of those over this place. I feel bad saying this as the service was good but the food was just awful. I got enchiladas which come with 3, but could barely get down one because the chicken on them was really nasty. My friend got tacos, which were just meat in a tortilla, and he said the chorizo was good but didn't like anything else. For a drink I got sweet tea which was gross and tasted like the instant powder tea. The prices were reasonable but regardless I will never come back.

Update: the business apologized, provided a full refund, and gave me 2 coupons for free washes. After an initial disagreement about how I chose to voice my frustration, I was treated with respect and excellent customer service. 


Left side doesn't work and wouldn't let me exit. I tried to get a refund with no luck. Eventually I tried paying a second time, and it took my money without letting me in (red light). No one on site, customer service number is cracked and peeling, covering up a number which gives a busy signal.

Went for dinner and they were quite busy even at 4:30. I don't know why because the food isn't very good and neither was the service. Our server sat down in our booth to take a picture of neighboring table, without asking first. We had to ask for place settings and when we got them they didn't look clean- hopefully just water spots. My MIL enjoyed her rigatoni. My husband's four cheese ravioli was OK. Average. I had Lobster Ravioli and everyone agreed it was just not good- bland and covered with a floury-tasting white sauce. Just not good. And the pasta dinners do not come with salad, as they commonly do at other restaurants.

They changed hours for covid, but have not changed them back yet. They don't open till 6 am and I need 5 am. I used to love this place but can't go till they change their hours again!! So frustrating. At the gym I was told that corporate people set the hours and that the gym would like to open earlier. The worker claimed she would welcome the additional hours. PLEASE open earlier. Convenience is the reason I chose Planet Fitness (close and early hours) but will have to go further to a different gym soon if I can't start using Planet Fitness again
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: So we ended up at the wrong location bc they were out of cars and the website automatically transferred the reservation to the airport (the next closest one) with out me knowing which was terrible. But the girls were friendly but don't expect Enterprise to pick you up (like the commercial) or to even go out of their way to get you to the other location, though they were sold out and about 6 employees were standing around looking at each other. So we had to Uber from the port there and then pay another $28 to Uber to the airport to pick up the car.  Just poor customer service when they could have assisted.

My husband and I recently moved to Tampa. As I was pregnant at the time, I want eating sushi. Well, after having the baby I was excited to have some sushi so we followed the yelp reviews and tried the restaurant. While the service was friendly, the sushi was disappointing. The quality was average, but the most disappointing aspect was one roll I ordered was rolled with cucumber instead of seaweed, which I don't care for, and the other roll was so spicy I couldn't eat it. I got the menu to order something else and reread my original order thinking I misordered but the descriptions were in fact way off. I'll be trying someplace else.

Had our 15th year anniversary dinner at Little Nona's and really enjoyed our time. Great atmosphere and service. Sat out in the garden area which was a pleasant and cozy outdoor covered space.
The garlic bread with roasted garlic was really good (must get). The grilled octopus was done very well along with the mixed salad that it's served on. The pan seared gnocchi was awesome.
Only knock for me is the extremely short  beer selection (2). A couple local craft beer options would probably suffice...(hint).
Would like to go back and try the swordfish and shrimp scampi entrees which the table next to us ordered and looked and smelled amazing.

This is an older HI Express in a nice city area. The rooms are in need of an update. Service was good but when I arrived back to my room at 4pm on my 2nd day the room was not cleaned. There were a couple of cleaners and another who appeared to be checking rooms that had been cleaned. When I asked if my room was going to be taken care of they all looked at me and said nothing. I finally told them to just get me clean towels and some Kurig coffee refills.
The bathrooms are tiny and they only have tiny showers. The shower curtain was always hitting me and did not do much for keeping water off the bathroom floor.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ive been to many gyms in reno over 10 years and this is the best gym I've ever been at. I've been going there for about 30 months never had a problem with billing. If there is a problem they help you right away.  The facility is always clean.  The restrooms,showers etc.. the machines are always working. If you're looking for a trainer they have GREAT! Trainers.  Troy is my personal trainer and is great trainer very very knowledgeable and explains everything from A-z.  I highly recommend this gym to anyone that is looking for gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Cancelled my membership recently due to not being able to take the water aerobics class on Saturdays and the work out classes being offered during the week at 5:30pm versus 6pm. 

Pros
Friendly customers and some of the staff. They have battle ropes.  Offer daycare for those who have children. Great sauna and steam room.

Cons
Machines and weight s are pretty old. No TVs on the machines. Workout classes are during a prime time customers are getting off of work. Bathrooms are not as clean as they should be. Weights are pretty old. You have to physically come in to cancel account vs. Online.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Do not book here!!!! Overpriced!!!!! Hotel room very small. Minimal working space if on business. No jacuzzi/hot tub. Toiletries are okay but basic. The elevators are very Aggressive and will close/shut while walking through. Josh Rhodes happened to be the very rude and nasty customer representative that refused airport shuttle services although they are advertised as being included, they are not. Wifi also not free and costs $12.95 for basic internet. Water in showers does not get hot but lukewarm at best! Parking lot very small for size of hotel and difficult to find decent parking
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Poor customer service. I complain about the 10 cents upcharge that I didn't order. That fine. I was clarifying it then give me by 10 cents. When the order come, they have not gave our soda  cup. My niece told the staff that she didn't order the large cup. Bottom line, when the manager talk to you with her back and accusing my niece on the mistake order of the large cup. I told her to look at my receipt. She wouldn't. 

When a customer is talking to a staff,  the staff should be apologetic and facing the customer not their back behind them.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It was very empty when I arrived my services were started right away. I went for a refill with acrylic and get polish. I also needed one nail replaced. This all totaled 45 dollars which is very expensive to me just for nails. A few people came to get their eyebrows waxed. My technician was very quiet. They also opened the door to get the fumes from the acrylic out so I'm assuming they donot do acrylic nails much. I overall felt weird and like I was being stared at. My nails look pretty good I did have to ask for her to make them thicker. The overall vibe was okay but not really what I was looking for in a shop as far as price and ambiance.

This was a really great go to location for Mexican food but as of last night. No more, food was good but after seeing what appear to be human fecal on the floor in the ladies bathroom just shock me awful. I did let the wait staff know an she was thankful...I could no longer eat there as this was just awful! Never before in my life have I witness this filth in a restaurant .....trash cans over flowing yes, need more supplies yes but never fecal on the floor! I will never go back there again. What kind of person does this ugh filthy!

I'm now convinced this is the best spot for tacos and burritos in Indy, just wish they could have conveyed that in their name.... Seriously though a burrito sounded good so we grabbed a large Al Pastor, small carnitas and small beef burrito with 2 tacos and guacamole.  The guacamole was a hidden gem for sure, so fresh and green but they run out sometimes because of this.  Exactly what I was looking for and great service you may not usually expect in a taqueria style restaurant.


Love these guys, keep it up!

I am sorry that I can't give them lower than a 1 star review.  They promised me service would take 45 minutes with an 8:00 appointment.  I was 15 minutes early.  They were 15 minutes late.  They kept promising it would be ready, but it took them 4.5 hours to change a single tire.  The price wasn't the lowest in town.  They also agreed to rotate my tires, but they only rotated two of them.  The only response from corporate was to offer me coupons to force me back to their awful service.  Do not go here.  Go anywhere else.  The platform is disrespect for the customer and gimmicks across the board.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I've been there 4-5 times now (always on sundays when they have the buffet) and every single time brought a feast of delicious Japanese food with great service. I thought the sushi was pretty good but was even more impressed by their tempura and beef tataki (among other things). I also enjoyed the buffet with the great mochi and miso soup. It's hard to get fresh seafood in Edmonton  but Kobe seems to be doing something right as we've never had a single issue.  Fantastic service every time and consistently good food. No complaints.

My hairdresser, Kristina, recently started working at this salon. I have been with her for years, so there was no question of me following her.     

My first appointment was last night. Happy with my cut, Kristina suggested adding more layers and it looks fabulous. I love her new home! Great boutique salon located in safe neighborhood with free 2hour parking. They had curtesy coffee and candy for customers, which was a nice unexpected treat!! 

Plan to visit in a few weeks to try Aveda color for the very first time.

Remember the Alamo...remember never to book through this car rental agency.  The check-in agents were officious not friendly and although this was the first time we ever had to wait for a car they were not very apologetic.  The agent first told us it would be a ten minute wait.  It turned out to be a forty minute wait.  We were supposed to get a "deal" through an online Delta airline and rental car package.  We ended up paying as much if not more than we would have had we booked a better car rental brand after all the taxes and special fees.  Alamo and Delta should be ashamed of this scam.

While I normally only post yelp reviews when I find myself pleasantly surprised by the food and service, this happens to be the opposite situation. A group of us came here after a rays game and after waiting a significant amount of time without service, we left without getting a single drink. Truthfully, we weren't even acknowledged which was surprising considering there weren't but 15 people at the bar. The bar back managed to get served a shot, but paying customers like us were overlooked. I will not be returning to this place and I urge others to think twice as well.

We enjoy going to Anthony's but are never able to take advantage of "Happy Hour" since it is only made available at the bar and a few high top tables. 

These are always occupied by folks who linger, so it's frustrating. It's funny, though, when the host seats you in a non-eligible area, you are still provided with a Happy Hour menu that states in extremely small font that you're basically screwed.

I e-mailed Micah Levy, General Manager, inquiring as to why those of us retired who always try to save a few $$, why they do it that way. Of course, no reply.

Had to find a Sushi place in town. Not particularly well versed in that department although I do enjoy sushi. Googled it and stumbled upon this one with good review. Booked it and went with it. Although it's on the 'rougher' part of Jasper Ave. I was pleasantly received by a warm hostess and got seated promptly. The food was delicious and the service very good as well. However, since I'm no sushi expert, I cannot say if they were "AMAZING" sushi or not. I enjoyed it. That's really all that matters at the end of the day right? :)

Trendy and hip is how I would describe this place. 

Food was tasty. We had the bison burger and fries, crab cake appetizer and deviled eggs. Eggs were a bit to spicy/mustardy for my liking. But I did enjoy the picked egg part of it. 

Overall it was a pricy place to eat. Above food including tip was over $40 for lunch. So it will not be a normal everyday type place for me to go to. Unless I am meeting up for a special occasion with some friends. 


Would not bring kids here. To hip and trendy and pricy. As well they seem to play "unedited" music. So the F word was clearly heard in one of the songs.

You want GOOD FOOD or do you want a pretty place where you feel that your a Queen (which you are not) ? 

Rick's offers very good food, nothing fancy on the plate, nothing fancy to look at, and a BYOB with decent prices.

Those who claim the sauce is "plain" probably like everything they eat "Americanized". 

Staff are friendly (as long as your no lump on a log yourself), service is just right, the specials are always good and the basic Italian dishes are JUST RIGHT !!  We go there every time we are in Lambertville or New Hope.

Disappointing. The room was fine and people are friendly enough--just lots of irritants for a hotel of this price. Called room service and got an outgoing message. Regular elevator is also service elevator so shared with dirty laundry, dirty room service dishes, and opens into frankly dirty work area. Looked to have dinner and drinks in the rooftop lounge but private party underway. Later, headed  up to bring a drink back to my room and not allowed entry without ID (I'm 55). Parking is catch-as-catch-can. 

I know, "first world problems", but Yelp is about telling it like it was so here it is.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We spent two nights here and loved it. The view from our balcony was perfect. The pool and outdoor bar were great. Prices for drinks and bar appetizers were about what you'd expect for a hotel. The hotel is about a 10-15 minute walk to the beach at sand key park across the street. The restaurant downstairs, watercolour, was really good (I'd recommend the steaks and crab cakes). The spa, Antonio's, was a bit overpriced, but my girlfriend loved her relaxation massage ($130 for 50 minutes). The staff gets an A+ too. I'll definitely be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ordered from Luca recently about 4 times within the last 2 months or so. Me and my wife's favorite is a onion pizza. Well the first one we got was overpacked with onions and they were almost full length, but even worst is was extremely soggy and just wet! I know onion pies can be a bit on the wet side but this was over the top, uneatiable. We tried again and it got better then again and better again. But it's still hit or miss. Never tried anything else. There price delivered to my door 4 miles away for 1 large pie with onions was almost $19! That's just crazy. Sorry Luca, u need to improve if your gonna charge top $ for your food.

I noticed a lot of negative reviews of this place but my fiance and I went last weekend and love it. We were registering for our wedding and decided to stop by for a drink and a few appetizers. We loved the atmosphere at the bar and the bar tender seemed so nice and genuine. We had some beers and ate the crab cakes and mushroom soup. Both absolutely delicious (although the crab cakes were a bit small for the price). Someone else on yelp commented on how they didn't like they soup but it was truly amazing. We definitely want to go back and have dinner soon!

They were ill equipped to handle the crowd on cinco de mayo. Waiting time to be seated was only about 12 min., Waiter was young, helpful and attentive. Food was just average and it took over 40 min. to get the first plate. I was the last to receive my meal and my daughter was more than half done hers by that time. So the food was served in three waves. They were out of horchata (really on cinco de mayo). Don't waste your time here, there are many restaurants much better not far from this location. I would have overlooked the long wait if the food was exceptional, but it was clearly not.

I went today after work and sat at the bar. It took 15 minutes to be acknowledged. Then the greeting I got was have you decided on what you want? I mean she asked me this as if she asked me 15 minuets ago if I was ready to order. Long story short through out my visit I was never checked on and the bar was staffed with 3 waitresses. I enjoyed my meal but the service was horrible. Well my service bc certain people were checked on and they even had casual conversations with the other patrons. I won't be going back.

Food is decent. Service terrible.  The last few times we've been there it's been slow.  Today was the last time we go.  We had a table of 12.  We knew it would slow it down SOME.  Fajitas came out for 6 of our people. No plates. No condiments. The family of 6 was passing a bite at a time of meat to each kid.  

However tables of new customers around us were promptly being served.  We had to beg for water and chips.  

When we asked where the manager was the response:  "somewhere around here"

Don't waste your time.

Listen, the hotel itself is great. It's clean and up-to-date. But the room service is by far the worst thing I've ever come across in my life. It took an hour and a half to get to my room, which is fine if they hadn't told me it would be up in 30. We ordered french toast (it showed up burnt and with NO syrup), grilled cheese (hard as a rock and freezing. Actually couldn't eat it because it hurt my mouth), two caesar salads, and a coke (that never came). 

I'm not a picky eater. My boyfriend actually gets mad at me for having such low food standards. So for me to say food is disgusting basically means rats wouldn't eat it.

The End :)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I am not sure what is going on with the management of this car wash. Half the time I go there and have started through the car wash when one of the attendants, who job it is to was/brush windows on one side of the car, finally shows up from the office. Once I went there and they were not even open. Yesterday I visited and had the same experience and neither of the attendants worked on the windows. I noticed the back window of SUV, especially, and cleaned it when I got home. Don't waste your money on these car wash operations. They are simply not worth the cost. I am canceling my monthly membership.

Good Cup has become the Not-So-Good Cup under the new ownership. They've dropped organic coffee and dropped organic soymilk, and they no longer buy their coffee from a local roaster, all of which were happening under the original owner. The new coffee is good however, and they do have a nice vibe, good service and interesting and unique gifts. But the place is often too loud to study (lots of students here), and it smells too much like burnt coffee (which it always has). If you want all organic and cheaper to boot, it's just 30 steps to the south.......

The worst McDonald's that I have never meet before!! I had waited 25 minutes for my meal but they talked to me "no more wraps" !!! However I had to restart order and they talked to me this meal is for free as compensation.  I spent almost 20 dollars for my meal but they didn't even refund and that restart order costed me 16 dollars is meaning I pent 4 dollars more for this "free meal" !!!  At the end, We ordered one larger french fries but that french fries look like never be ready and we just left !!!!  So angry
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The absolute worst ice cream shop I have ever been to. The place is always busy because it takes 15 minutes to make each order. I get that's part of the cold slab novelty.  There is no system for them keeping track of who's order is who's. They wound up switching my large order with a kids small order who was behind me. After waiting over 20 minutes to get my ice cream, which was not even mine; I decided to just walk out. I will never go back to sweet Charlie's and I would be surprised if the cool springs location stays in business more than a few months.

DO NOT GO HERE!!I just left this restaurant. Disgusting doesn't describe this place! I found a ROACH in my food! Then as I looked around the place it seems they don't vacuum or upkeep this place. Holes in the rug surfaces not clean. I can only imagine how disgusting the kitchen is. My server was a kid who could care less about what was going on. It was such an unbelievable experience. I'm traumatized by my experience. Lord! RUN AWAY FROM THIS FOOD POISONING WAITING TO HAPPEN! This place should be shut down! Bar rescue Taffey would lose his shit if he saw this place.

I'm new to Reno and decided to try Battle Born Eye Care because it's close to where I live and had good reviews online. They also have online scheduling, which is really convenient. I am so glad I made an appointment here! I saw Dr. Chris Nannini for my first appointment, and I am very happy with the service he provided. He was friendly, professional, and provided a thorough eye exam. He sent me home with a new pair of contact lenses to try, and so far they are awesome! I highly recommend Battle Born Eye Care!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Do not stay at this hotel, under any condition. A nightmare. The mini-fridge in our room did not work. We asked for a replacement, which was provided while we were out at dinner, but when we got back, our room door was open. When we checked out, we were presented with a bill for $40 room service, which we did not order. 1/2 hour later, they told us they could not locate a room service delivery form with our signature, and promised we would not be billed. However, i just received my Visa bill, and they charged me anyway. Bad business.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I highly recommend staying away from this place if you plan on getting a contact prescription. My husband got his eyes checked and the ladies in the front refused him his prescription. Apparently, he needed a trial pair of contacts before he could get a signed prescription?!? The whole scenario seemed bizarre!  Two months later (yesterday) they called to tell me that my husband's trial pair of contacts were in stock. Sorry visionworks, lens crafters gave us his prescription and had his contacts in stock the same day.. not two months later.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is on of my favorite Chinese places in Boise. The service is always fast and pleasant. The door is always quick and hot and delicious. Nothing flashy or super exciting but the food is always super good. I can't give it 5 stars only because it is a bit dated. The rugs are worn but clean. Everything is a little worn but clean. But the food is always excellent and the price is very good. It's is a family restaurant with only 3 employees. Even so we have shown up with our whole family and extended family   17 in total and they were great. I have found out since that all of our kids go there on their own they have take out as well. Love it.

I liked this gym when I was a member.  The staff is very nice and the yoga classes are fantastic.  The annoying thing about this gym is after work all of the cardio machines are taken and you have to wait.  I could deal with waiting if it was cheaper.  It was also difficult to get out my membership first I had to wait a month for the window to tell them I wanted to quit.  Then the next month when I wanted to leave they told me I had to speak with the owner who hits you with a hard sell to stay a member, I was very uncomfortable.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
If the people you are with starts to pull into Oobatz's parking lot, dive out of the car and run screaming into Drakes located behind them!
  Oobatz is AWFUL! I checked it out for the 1st time with a friend yesterday...Decor was the only thing going for this place! Ordered an app "garlic knots"~it was stale and bland. Then ordered sirloin and scampi (med-rare) It arrived as a burnt hockey puck! Had to ask for a new one, and finally after an hour of waiting for new one, it was a big blob of grizzle and fat! PUH GROSS! Never going back, and I reccomend that you stay far, far away from this place!

Love the pizza! My kids won't eat any other pizza since we starting going here. Love their Mediterranean and Israeli cuisine. Absolutely love the Israeli and Dan salad and the fresh lemon juice olive oil dressing. Humus is good. Eggplant Parmesan is delicious. This is all we ever order because it's all so good and we are creatures of habit. We have never eaten in always take out. Restaurant is very nice and clean. Best is if  you spend I'm not sure how much you get a magnet which is a slice of pizza you collect 8 and you get a medium pizza for free.

I love this place! I'll admit, I'd see reviews for Chinese places that spoke about real versus fake fried rice and I never really understood the hoopla. Let me tell you: this place has real fried rice and I won't eat that yellow garbage any more!

I order their lunch specials fairly often, sometimes delivery which is fast to average every time. The food is always hot and delicious, with great portion sizes. The staff is always friendly when I stop in to get my order. 

The only place I get Chinese take out from anymore!

I really enjoy this place, good sushi at a decent price. The lunch combo number two is what I typically order. Comes with five or six nigiri, a shrimp tempura roll, soup and salad all for about $14.  The waitresses are always very friendly.  The only reason I am giving this four stars instead of five is because for lunch today my friend had a large bug floating in his soup. The waitress offered to get a new one and was very apologetic, but makes me question the cleanliness behind the scenes.  We never had this issue before.  Despite this, I will still be back.

I had heard alot about this place but was underwhelmed. The bread while good was sliced too thin and we only received 4 pieces for 3 people. We ordered an app for the table then soup and salad. It all came at once, so we aked that the soup and salads be taken back. hen they came out the soup was lukewarm. The entrees were decent however the gnocchi was rather heavy and over sauced. We ordered the canolli for dessert and while the shells on the display tray were dipped in chocolate what we got was not. Overall mediocre.

I stayed here with a group that was competing at the Convention Center the weekend before Mardi Gras.  The hotel was well prepared for our large group and a perfect location.  

The room was perfect.  It was clean, well supplied and quiet.  The breakfast in the morning had a large selection of items and different both mornings I stayed.  I will definitely stay at this location again when I return to New Orleans.  It is far enough from the noise of the French Quarter, but easily accessible by a short walk.  It is truly in a perfect location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not recommend!! Very high priced services and pet medication. Good doctors which is important but most of the staff more then makes up for that. Expect long wait times especially when in the examining room waiting for the doctor. If you need a medication refill then this is not the place. They are so over booked most of the time that medication refills seem like a hassle for them but the price isn't. My biggest tip is this, avoid Joeann at all costs. Your pets Heath is only as important as how much Joeann likes you.. Sad but true. You been warned!

This is one of Tucson's best finds. I'm in love with their seaweed salad, yakiniku don and their sushi platter. I almost hate to talk about the platter for fear they'll raise the price. It's beautifully arranged, making quite a show for 4 people. It's a great deal. 

The Samari is tucked away into a little empty strip mall and not directly on Oracle, so it's easy to miss. They do get busy, for good reason so a wait is not uncommon. I recommend calling ahead to order for pick up. They could easily fill up a place twice their size. This place is a must!

How hard is it to screw up and order of two cheese enchiladas? Pretty hard, most of the time. But these are terrible. The ench sauce is bland and salty. Really salty. And they couldn't get my order straight at the speaker. I had to wait to get to the window. I also asked for mild salsa and they had to give me both red and green because they didn't know which was hotter. I live a block from here and I get stupid and eat here every couple of years and they're always awful and overpriced. I could also tell that they were screwing up the order in front of me from the conversation they were having. Go to Jack in the Box.

Food was good but very very slow service.  I do not think it was our waiters fault.  We had a 6:00 reservation for an 8:00 show, which they knew, and we ended up inhaling our pasta which was delivered at 7:35 and running down Broad Street to the theatre.  We made it by one minute.  And, the mixed drinks aren't served cold, which I hate.  I ordered a Cosmopolitan which I sent back and asked them to shake with ice.  Why wouldn't they do that automatically?  Big negative for me.  I'm not sure I'm going back to Girasole.

My granddaughter found this restaurant,  was excieted because she is vegetarian and it was close to hotel.  Very disappointed.  Her grilled cheese was barely grilled and mine was burnt. I sent mine back asking for a sandwich that wasn't burnt. 10 minutes later my burnt grilled cheese came back to table.  They had scraped the burnt off. I could have done that, but thought I should have a fresh sandwich.  It was cold and tasted burnt . Idefinetly won't go back, and wouldn't recommend this place to man or beast!

We just took our chocolate lab to Garden State Vet for the first time. Due to Covid they allowed one of us to go in with him so my husband did since our dog is strong and pulls a bit. My husband said it was like night and day compared to our usual vet. The usual vet wasn't thorough in checking our lab or keeping good records of our visits. But Garden State was so thorough, professional and caring toward our lab. He has had some medical issues and we needed a vet that we had confidence in to care for him. We believe we have found that.

La Terrazza is a cute little restaurant.  The service was great, but the food didn't live up to my expectations.  I ordered the lobster ravioli and my 2 friends ordered the Mediterranean salad and the cheese ravioli.  Both raviolis came with a house salad, so I got to try them first hand and all of the salads were overdressed.  I recommend asking for the dressing on the side.  The rest of the food was great and the chocolate gelato one of my friends ordered for dessert was fabulous, however, the chocolate mousse cake I had for dessert was a little bland.

I went to The Nail Bar today only because I had a gift card here and I have to say, I'm not at all impressed.  Yes it's big and fancy with nice chairs, but I typically go to my small, hometown salon, and feel much more comfortable there.  The employees at The Nail Bar were not overly friendly and welcoming, and it seemed more of a rush than anything.  My pedicure looks good, but not worth the $35 plus tip (luckily I had the gift card).  Parking is very limited.  Going to stick with my usual salon for the future.

I Highly recommend this place, it has a great atmosphere which is perfect for all ages, and while it seemed modern and classy it also felt very inviting. If you need to grab a drink it has a full bar, with big beer selection. The pizza was fantastic, great sauce and a perfectly crispy crust. I'm from Chicago so it is hard to impress me with pizza, and they sure succeeded. We piled on the veggies on the pizza and they were not shy about putting toppings on, you sure will get your money's worth. Great job and next time in St Louis I will return for this pizza it definitely rose above the rest.

Today was my first visit. I had been going to one salon for 3yrs but decided it was time to change. I am so happy I can to Madam.

I had been to two other places this day, but had to leave because they only had two employees and I don't like to wait. I was amazed that when I walked into madam there were 6 employees! 

I was able to get in and get out within 30min for my fill. Usually it takes at least an hour.  The lady was fast and my nails look great!

I love that there is a receptionist. I think I found my new place :)

I would tend to agree with the other reviewers - re: honoring promos, etc. 
In addition, their bread here is missing something. Cannot put my finger on it but it lacks substance. It appears normal but it pretty much disintegrates when you eat it. Other Subway stores have better bread. 
Hate to chime in with only a low review but I've been coming here for years and it's never that good. The only thing good about them is they happen to be located in the lobby of my building. (Where I work)
Update 
Bumped them up a star since the joined the modern world with the ready acceptance of credit / debit cards and Apple-pay.

Hadn't been here for some time because it is always too crowded. Took 8 family members here for a birthday celebration. We ordered two calamari appetizers for the table which were great. Then the main courses arrived. All were piping hot except for mine. I sent it back. All they did was put a laddle of sauce over top and sent it right back out - didn't plate a new dish for me - disgraceful.  This place was overpriced marginal food to begin with, but if you are not going to serve your mediocre food hot and fresh, hang it up.

I am giving this hotel a full five stars, but this was only due to the utterly caring and amazing service we got from Jennifer in the Nicolino's lounge and restraint. She immediately noticed we had a very rough day (awful flights, ruined luggage, given a few occupied rooms, etc. ) and came and talked to us, I ended the conversation telling her that she was the highlight of an otherwise challenging day. It is the honest truth. A person like her, who knows how to treat people in distress, need to be the manager of a hotel. Seriously.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Note to out-of-towners: The entrance to the plaza is from westbound Tampa Ave only.
My wife and I came here after a day of hiking, sunbathing on the beach and visiting Tarpon Springs. We were parched, and did not have to ask for more water even once.
We ordered from the early menu and took advantage of happy hour, and felt like we got a very good value. The salad and Shrimp Sophia were very fresh, and the mushroom soup and porkchop were delicious. The kitchen delivered, but the wait staff was exceptional. We're glad we found this restaurant.

We had the most horrifying encounter at this McDonald's the other night. I witnessed one of the employees run from behind the food preparation line and proceed to the bathroom where we heard him vomit. 10 minutes later he walks back out from the bathroom and immediately goes back behind the line and prepares more food for customers. Absolutely disgusted. I told the manager and she proceeded to tell me that his girlfriend is pregnant and he is having sympathy pains and is getting sick because of it. Really?? Unacceptable. I will never return to this restaurant ever again and neither should anyone else.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
We live in Somersett and visited Sakana for the first time during their soft opening in late Jan 2014.  Had a great meal - delicious rolls, great service, nice décor and clean! 

Both owners were there and 110% committed to ensuring great meals were served. 

We paid for the "all you can eat" sushi...The rolls are NOT big rice bombs...they are smaller and have more fish - delicious.  Plus, with less rice, the more you can try different varieties.

Super impressed and happy...looks like we may have a winner in Somersett!

Not sure where some of these people were staying but not this hotel.  Dogs barking in the room across the hall, someone bouncing a ball on the wall in the room next door, heating unit on some kind of sensor so it no one is moving in the room it cuts off till you jump up because it cold(I mean it only 28 degrees outside).  If you smoke weed it seems to be the place to be.  Hotel management did nothing, thank goodness for corporate, which is who I called, they couldn't get the hotel to do anything but at least changed me to a better hotel and paid for if as this hotel would do anything.  Stay away from this hotel!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I just discovered this place and went there after reading the great reviews. I have nothing but excellent things to say about my experience. First, I was able to get a Sunday appointment in a short booking window which is key for busy professionals. Second, the woman, Allison, who put in highlights and cut my hair was sweet, competent, and professional. And third, the pricing is extremely reasonable, especially for the Mainline. To be honest, I usually go to salons based on Groupon discounts and float from place to place. Those days are over. I found my hair salon and have no intentions of going elsewhere.

I've been going to Kunda for years and it gets better and better. As far as selection and industry trends, they are in top tier! The staff is very knowledgeable and friendly. They are a family run business and it shows in everything they do. I meet up with friends to buy for beer swaps and they all love the selection. Also, they are my "go to" place for kegs when having a party. I just tell them how many people and the beer styles I'm looking for, and they recommend the quantities and all the supplies (cups, ice, tubs, soda, etc.).

I went for a nice vacation from LA and decided to come here due to good reviews well the lady was in a rush to do my nail and now a possible problem she mentioned I had to be cleaned up and it was the worst pain ever she went to deep and now I have a possible infection nd my toenail might fall off because she cut too deep in my toe nail on my Ingrown and made me bleed and bleed and covered it up with nail polish I immediately went to a store to get nail polish remover and begin treating my nail my skin had a huge while and my cut and toe is yellow. Not a good place to go especially for the price.

Well where do I start? I pull up to the drive through, the manager proceeds to tell me that they are only accepting cash at the moment. That wasn't a problem considering that I intended on paying with cash to begin. Then she tells me after I wait for 5 minutes that the entire system is down and she cannot take my order for 30 minutes at minimum. This is not the only time that this McDonald's has done this to me. This is probably the 3rd time. I expect something better from this large chain of fast food especially because the location is in a good area.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Salon is perfect bc they actually have a conversation about what u want without the pushiness to but more , but this salon listens. They or gainers clean and never a wait they don't double book so your rushed and that's not how u want to feel after a service - rushed.
I recommended everyone in the shop excellent review 
- prices sensible , no pressure to buy unneeded products . You shouldn't want your hair dresser to work as a sales pusher at the same time.


Great experience. Have recommended both women and men And all returned

First time staying at the Marriott Grand in St Louis.
Here for three day/two night business meeting, hotel centrally located to just about everything in downtown area.  Plenty of restaurants, sports bars and craft breweries within walking or Uber distance

This Marriott property is well-kept.  Rooms are clean, several look like they have been renovated or updated.  Hotel has large bar with TVs in central location if you don't want to leave the property which is convenient. 

Very friendly and polite staff working here.  Would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: False advertising. My husband and I were excited to drive by and see the HOT sign on. We even made an illegal u-turn to go back towards the warm deliciousness. Upon getting our box, however, I noticed right away as he handed it to me and put it in my lap - it wasn't warm AT ALL. We stopped in the parking lot to each grab one at peak freshness and were both horribly disappointed to each pick up a room temp doughnut. Now, let me be fair. They  weren't gross or full of bandaids or anything. They were just boring, old plain doughnuts, not unlike any you'd grab at a gas station. They were not worth the illegal driving move or the calories. :(

Had Sunday dinner at the Interstate Drive Shoney's today. Didn't mind the restaurant having a 90 score & air conditioning unit broke. But what really appalled me was broken sink pipes in the bathroom, water & paper towels on the floor, and smelly toilets!! This store by the stadium should have a much better facility. The overwhelming population that ate there today were African Americans! If the economic climate reflects the quality of this restaurant, then something is seriously wrong. 
This restaurant needs a major face lift cosmetically & administratively. Come on SHONEYS you've got to do a better job!!

Gotten take out 2 times in last month, I must say WOW both orders for 6 people + perfect!! From salad(always awesome) to main course.... then to get it all together and get it right, well, they did not once but 2 times. One item wasn't on menu and they maid it to perfection. Just a rarity on a Friday night. Price was fair, food perfect, ready when they said. I'll be ordering again, maybe tonight if not tomm. Just to much to bring whole clan in. Appetizers again wow!!. Way to have a great eye for detail for the clients. Well done!!

I get sushi here at least once a week. This is one of only two places in NOLA that has good (not okay, not average, not edible, but good) sushi. 

I have not had anything like the eel sundae before, but I have gotten it nearly every time since I first ordered it. The salmon martini and ocean pyramid appetizers are awesome, too. I'll typically get either two of those appetizers for a meal, a lunch special or early bird dinner. 

The prices are reasonable, especially for lunch and early dinner. This isn't like the places that charge $7 for a salmon roll that's all rice. You get actual good food for your money.

I used to belong to this gym when it was Vigor Works.  After they closed I joined Bally's which was completely filthy....or so I thought until I joined Broad Street Fitness.  This  place makes Bally's look like a palace!  There are never paper towels, they have no hand sanitizer, the locker room is gross and the water never drains in the shower.  To top things off, one of the group instructors (not even management) just informed us today that as of Monday they're going to be charging $10 per class.  What a rip off!!!!  Guess it's back to Bally's!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Just ate there for our Red Hat Luncheon.  I was really disappointed as the place got such good reviews.  I had a lunch special of lobster bisque and caesar salad.  The bisque tasted nothing like lobster bisque coming out cool and the salad was very small with no parmesan cheese with one crouton.  I had that, a club soda (which most good restaurants don't charge for), hot tea and some awesome chocolate mousse cake costing over $25 for lunch.  My recommendation is drive by The Olde School House.  Service was excellent and ambience was very nice.

First you have to understand that Carmine an old Italian, he's 79 years old.  He's been a barber in this town for over 50 years, in fact he was my dad's barber.  His body is old and tired and probably hurts every day.  He definitely knows how to cut a head of hair, but he doesn't tolerate much any more.  He prefers to only take appointments so make sure you call first and bring cash only.  If nothing else go see an old time local legend before he hangs up his clippers for the last time.  Just stepping into his shop there on court street is like traveling back in time, it's quite an experience.

Okay, I've tried to give this McDonalds the benefit of the doubt, but I can no longer do that.  On at least three separate occasions I've ordered food and the items placed in my bag were not what I've ordered. Once, I ordered a sausage biscuit with egg and cheese. What I received was an egg and cheese biscuit.  Second time I ordered a Quarter Pounder with cheese. I received a sriracha big mac instead. Third time I ordered sweetened iced tea, but received unsweetened ice tea.  Three strikes and you're out!  The next time I want a quick meal before heading on the turnpike, I'll just go to Wendys.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We have had only great experiences with Creek's Edge Animal Hospital.  We have never had to wait more than five minutes in the waiting room, our dog's prescriptions were fill promptly (as long as I called in ahead of time to order them which is normal procedure anywhere), the technicians are extremely loving, and our 14 year old dog's disease was diagnosed and treated promptly.  We have seen Dr. Fox for the most part.  When we finally had to say goodbye to our Golden, they were very loving, gentle and respectful to both us and our sweet guy.

They sell wonderful frames that other stores don't.
But...
I had a pair of glasses that needed new lenses because of a new Rx.  I had to go there 6 times until I was finally able to get lenses that I could see with.
I bought a new frame & so far I've had to go there 4 times, the 4th because I received an email saying the glasses were ready when they weren't.  I still don't have the glasses.
In both cases they had to re-do the lens even though I told them in advance what they needed to do.
One time I had to wait for 50 minutes.
Way overpriced for the poor service but if you want the frames...
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: If I could leave this place 0 stars I would.  I noticed damage (my car looks like it's been keyed twice) on the passenger side from the front light all the way to the rear light.  It clearly looks like it was damage caused but the automatic car wash.  I called them about the issue, when the owner called back, he was rude and hostile on the phone, and was questioning my truthfulness and the timing of when I called them. He said he is not willing to do a damn thing about it. This is HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. STAY AWAY!!! Not to mention that I paid 12 dollars to vacuum my own car and clean the inside of the car on my own!!

This is one of my favorite restaurants around town. I've had many of their burritos, tortas, and nachos, and I've never been disappointed. The food is delicious, and the portions are huge. The employees there are always friendly to me, and the lines are never very long. The parking lot is a bit cramped and sometimes fills up, but they're in a neighborhood with lots of street parking within a very short walk. They have daily specials, and I love being able to get a high quality burrito for a pretty cheap price (by Santa Barbara standards).

My wife and I were here last night for the first time. We were highly dissapointed.  The salads were excellent, it ended there.  My wife had the lasagna, very dry and a odd spice the flavor was like no other lasagna we ever tasted.  Zero stars for the lasagna. 
I had the Fettuccine Alfredo, it was ok, just ok... flavorful but the consistency was off, parts were perfect but some were wet and runny. The service again was ok,  waitress brought my wifes salad, but forgot mine and had to return to kitchen to get it, that took about 3 or 4 minutes. 
We would not recomend or return to this restaurant.

Food was delicious. Our waitress really tried her best and we were appreciative of her efforts. I guess the evening was hectic for them so we were ignored for a good chunk of the evening. From the service that I've observed from the other tables, we were definitely treated subpar. It is what it is. I received an email earlier in the week advertising their Sunday specials but none of that was available tonight - wish they would've fine printed that they didn't mean the Sunday after they sent out the email aka THIS Sunday. I've read great reviews on here so I was a tad disappointed with our experience.

I'm going to "lovably" dub this location as the Snafu Starbucks. This location runs out of menu items more frequently than any other Starbucks in town. Come after 8 on a weekday and they're pretty picked over on breakfast items. You'd think they'd eventually figure out to stock adequately to meet demand. Still more frustrating are inexplicably long waits--even when there are just one or two other customers in the place--and the frequency with which they mix up orders. Today I waited a ridiculously long time for a breakfast sandwich, was handed a bag by the barista, and got home to find myself stuck with a multigrain bagel. Um, thanks?

Beware of staying here on the weekends if you are planning to sleep.  

When we checked in I thought it odd that the were two pairs of earplugs on the desk in our room in the second building of this hotel.  Turns out that our room is facing an open air bar about two blocks away that has live music on its rooftop deck until closing time on Fri/Sat nights.  Would have been a key piece of information to have had when I made the reservation and/or checked in.  No mention on hotel website or from front desk personnel at check in

Otherwise, hotel is newly renovated and staff is very friendly.  Would stay here again, but only Sunday through Thursday.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My wife and I had lunch here today and it was amazing. The food was absolutely outstanding. From the chilled salad to my chicken tempura bento box, everything was amazing. This place is truly the perfect trifecta!!! 1) The food is incredible (Every time and I have eaten here at least 20 times). 2) The service is outstanding. 3) the value is very very good! This place is a hidden gem in a small strip mall! Treat yourself and pay a visit, I will guarantee you will be come a huge fan. There is absolutely NO reason not to!!!
