Trash. Simplest uber eats order ever, all of their sandwiches come with two mandatory selections: cheese and egg. For cheese the options are: None, American, and White Cheddar. For egg the options are: No egg, Fried egg, Veggie Egg. I selected the first of both on not one but two sandwiches. How do you read the same order twice and both times miss the line that says no cheese? It's the one in the middle of the order! I really hope they pay a little more attention to meeting safety standards because their food preparation is completely haphazard

This was my first taste of Jules pizza.. I was intrigued by the menu and ordered #5 vegan pizza. Although I'm not a vegan, I am dairy free and enjoyed delicious tomato pizzas at various restaurants throughout the Phila. Area.. Unfortunately Jules was not very good. The garlic was weak, sauce needed flavor.. The spinach was half cooked/half raw. A pizza restaurant should be able to make a delectable crust and sauce, not rely solely on cheese to make it taste "good". I think they have a lot of room for improvement. I definitely would not recommend their pizza unless you rely on cheese for flavor.

Found out about this place from Restaurant.com. Ate there for dinner. I ordered the chicken francese and my husband had a meat pizza. The pizza was huge, cooked to perfection and was very good. The chicken was also great. A tad bit too much garlic for my taste but still yummy. Huge plate, had enough for lunch the next day.  Overall we had a great experience. Waitress was very friendly & her service was above average. She had a great sense of humor & she put up with my husband's off beat jokes! We will be going back soon!

We came across Tacos PIPEYE by accident one late Friday night after everything was closed in SB. Their food truck was parked on Milpas and 'wow' did we hit the jack pot. We recently went vegan and their veggie burrito is really the best we've ever eaten. We couldn't wait to return to theIr restaurant (on Milpas across from TJs) the next Friday night! Seriously, if you want authentic food w homemade tortillas and beans, fast polite service at a decent price, go here. We've been in SB for over 45 yrs and we now have have our favorite Mexican food place, ever!

Sushi didn't look or tasted fresh...Almost sushi buffet like quality. I ordered 4 speciality rolls and 3 normal rolls. Total was around $85 
The crunchy toppings that they put on top and inside the rolls tasted stale. I also ordered fried calamari from the appetizer which looked like it was either doubled fried from the day before. It was not appetizing and also fishy and came with a weird sauce. 
I've had better sushi else where. Very disappointing on the quality. I remember coming here years ago and loved it but this must be the reason why we stop coming here. They did practice 6 ft social distancing which was good.

Deserve nothing ,A NEGATIVE star should be rated...gave me a broken car,needed to argue with them to get another one..no customer service at all..when I was line up to check in,I overheard a customer called and disputed the toll charges on his rental car.when I was listening to the conversation,I thought the customer over the phone was not reasonable,then I found out why..ACE blocked their car plates,so no one can registered the rental car on the sun pass even u have your own..what a trap..then they can bill u tons of money,go to somewhere else to rent your car..u think they are cheap,it is the bait to get the big fishes only..watch out..

We went to Treemont back in mid December. I was looking for a potential "gift" to give to my parents for Christmas. I knew this place was relatively new so I thought we would give it a try. 

The food was pretty good, although I can't really remember what we had. I will say that the celery root soup was awesome. They had some decent cocktails too. The atmosphere was a little loud. We were in a party of four and had a hard time hearing each other. 

I am not dying to go back, but it was an overall good experience. I did not end up sending my parents.

This is one of the worst eating experiences of my life and I am 70!!! The food was awful, the service was non existent. We sent everything back except the salad which we had eaten with reservation. When the bill came the salad price was twice the price because we "didn't eat the entry so the salad is the regular price!" When we explained the food was just not up to our standards the owner came over and said they have been serving these aged recipes for years and no  one ever complains.....please, just stay away until they update the entire place....Friends did tell us you only go there for the pizza, never anything else. Be warned!!!!

The car was clean, the rental process was easy.....BUT the person at the window offered a Toll Pass device and assured me there would be no charge, unless I went through a toll, then the price of the toll would be on my credit card. When I received my Bill, there was a $19.95 charge for the device. I have emailed and called National but have not recieved a response other than the automated "we received your email" note.

If my account is credited the toll pass amount, then I'll upgrade my review. As of today, I'm not happy. Especially since I did not go through any tolls!

Recommended by a friend plus my wife has eaten here.  The service is a little slow.  My 2nd order was very late to the point I asked for a to-go box because we needed to leave.  The place is very dark but the atmosphere is ok.  Not a big Japanese food eater but the food was good.  $9.95 all you can eat for lunch.  All they ask is that you eat it all or you will be charged which is a novel idea to get people to eat all their food.  Felt like I was at my grandma's, "You will eat all your food before you leave the table."  The place was busy for lunch.  Overall pretty good...

Horrible, Horrible - No management here. It is slow. It Smells like urine through out the restaurant. , Chili cold (Previousl week).. Drive thru 15 minute wait.with 2 cars. Laytoa the manager used the excuse when I went in from the long wait in the drive thru,and said that someone added food to order? Right ! Left the drive thru line and went in and found all the employees huddled talking and joking. 
It is by far the worst Wendy's I have every been to. I have been here a few times because it is close to my home. It is consistently BAD. It is like the inmates running the asylum,

I went with my wife to the Taco portion of the restaurant on the ground floor rather than the full restaurant upstairs. Although this area was fairly empty (only four tables out of the dozen and no one at the bar) it took the waitress five minutes to come take our order. I ordered the happy hour beer and my wife a margarita both of which were nice, but not spectacular. Having grown up in Los Angeles I am very picky about my tacos; that said the tacos at Distrito were solid tacos, but not worth going out of your way for.

Ate there twice while in Clearwater Beach. Excellent view for the sunset. My wife had the seafood platter with 3 different fish, unfortunately you could only have it prepared 1 way, all grilled or all fried but she still liked it. I had the shrimp platter which came 3 fried, 3 coconut and 3 peel and eat, it was very good and the shrimp were a nice size. Came with a salad so I  had enough to eat. The next night we had the Wisconsin Burger with 3 different cheeses, grilled onions and fries. It was a half pound so we split it and was more than full. I recommend this location, good for a family.

Friends rave about this restaurant located inside the Renaissance hotel so we gave it a try for a birthday dinner. The service was outstanding; friendly, attentive and capable. Unfortunately this restaurant is set up more for casual than fine dining. Most of the restaurant is open to the lobby or the bar. This is problematic on weekends because the hotel has recently decided to compete in the youth sports teams market so it is overrun with kids. Although our dinner was very good, the experience was not aligned with our bill. I will not be back.

I see lots of people pointing out various things wrong with this place and for the most part they are spot on. No variety in the menu at all. Frozen food, they use microwaves, they over charge the heck out of you for sides and other nonsense. The people who work here seem to be even more unhappy than the usual restaurant folk. The only reason you are eating here still is because you area 75 years old and your taste buds left your general area aeons ago, or you haven't heard of Vivace yet. Nevermind Vivace, try Chef Boy R DeeeeeeZe nutz.

We went to Louie for the first time last night.  We did not have reservations and hoped on trying to get a seat at the bar.    We received a very warm welcome from Max, the host, and were almost immediately seated at the last two seats in the bar near the wood oven in the back of the restaurant.  We loved the seats as they allowed us to watch chef Josh Poletti make pizzas and speak to Matt McGuire the owner.   My wife had the Italian Salad and the Marinara Pizza.   I had the Butternut Squash Agnolotti.   Everything was outstanding and the service was amazing.   This will be a regular spot for us!

Don't valet, you can park literally around the corner for $15 a night if you aren't too lazy to look for it. Our stay was great, the double queen room was clean and very spacious. Only issue was the bathroom door didn't slide easily but for $100 a night I won't complain since the room was nicer than many other hotels I've stayed in that were way more expensive. They also provide Bliss brand toiletries, the shampoo and body wash is in a dispenser in the shower which is Eco friendly. Also if you decline housekeeping you get $5 per day.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It doesn't look like much from the outside, but this is one of the best places around. Excellent beer selection, both bottles and tap. Nice local atmosphere with great food and a friendly staff. Kiersten, Kate, Erin, and Sheila have been there forever and are some of the best! They like to let you sample the beer and give great suggestions. I'm there almost every weekend for lunch. 

If they have bread pudding, do yourself a favor and get it! If not, try the Dark Side of the Moon cake. You're welcome!

They also sell bait, if you're heading across the street to go fishing at Lake Nockamixon.

This place is literally the Wal Mart of gyms. Yes it is cheap. But if you can afford ANY other place in New Orleans do yourself a favor and go elsewhere. One, there isn't enough parking. I had to park across the railroad tracks and walk back to the gym. Two, their "busy" hours are absolutely horrible. I walked in and walked out because there were lines waiting to use the 4 benches and free weights. Plus every other bench and dumbbell was being used. I signed up a week ago and asked for the refund today. Which they won't do. Do yourself a favor and go elsewhere.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Doctor McQuirk is hands down, the finest vet in Reno!
I am so very grateful to have him for my darling Ruperts care.
I have experienced a dramatic loss and he has helped me through 
this extremely tough time. I am indebted to his ability to
Decipher what is the appropriate approach in my case.
I cannot recommend this office highly enough!
They have recently updated the entire facility.
When I went into the exam room there was a cute chalkboard 
That read "welcome Rupert!"
Thank you, Evan. You are truly the best.

Restaurant is now CLOSED, less than 4 months after it opened. :(

I loved this restaurant when it was Copa, and I still love it.  I was so glad to see it reopen after being closed for several months (changing from Copa to Cassava, and renovating the decor).  Burgers are still delicious, and there is a bit more variety to the menu. We've been there 3 times since it reopened, and had the fajitas, burgers, and quesadillas - all were well prepared and delicious.  The drinks are great (I can still get copa lemonade!).  Hopefully, Cassava will do well and stay for years to come.

Excellent home cooking at very affordable prices! Best Chinese home style spicy cooking in Philly! The dry pot stir fry is outstanding, and the Ma La soup is superb. You can choose which fresh ingredients to go in your dry pot and soup. Very fresh home style with these two specialties, cannot miss if in Chinatown. Plates can be made mild or not spicy. Service is good, the waiters are attentive and will bring you whatever you need. And the dining room is cozy, bright, with Chinese karaoke classics going in the background. A+ hao chi!

UPDATE: The food was good the first time but they lied to us about our second order and the time it would take to deliver our order. We waited 60 minutes and called only to be told that the order had not even been made yet. We would never have ordered if they had told us 90 minutes at the outset. Not impressed. Would you wait one and one half hours for food, we won't! Not to mention the minimum $50.00 order to get delivery. When we called back to cancel our order the owner lied to us about another restaurant and then told us to never call again.

SO SURPRISED!!  I had an appointment at a hair salon and needed to get my nails done. My regular nailery wasn't near my hair appointment so I looked on Google and found T. Happy Nails. It was a 1-minute walk from where I was so I gave them a try. I was surprised to see how spacious and welcoming it was. The shop was super clean and well maintained. My wait wasn't too bad considering some naileries I've been to. Once I was waited on, the tech was precise with what I asked for. She was fast yet efficient. I was in and out in no time at all. Whereas it was kind of pricey, it was worth every penny. I am very well pleased and I will be back!!!

We visited this on our trip to Nashville and I will quote my beautiful wife regarding her meal, "It hurts to swallow." It wasn't that it was bad, it just wasn't good. Everything was slightly off. Awesome space, but it was more than a little cold. Pork belly (yum) but cooked like chicken parm (odd). Beef cheeks with root veggies, and throw some raw apples on top. Everything was just a little off.  Bottom Line: seemed like they were just trying a bit too hard, like a PB&J with avacado.  Next time just make a really awesome PB&J. *note: this is not an actual menu item, just a hypothetical.

This restaurant had one of the worst pizzas I have ever eaten, and I have eaten plenty.  I only like cheese pizza, so I ordered a large for takeout. Wow. Cheese, but no sauce. Called and talked to the manager who explained they don't use much sauce on the pizza. Mmmm, ok. So he reordered another one. Same pizza. Little or no sauce, slimy cheese. So greasy that the box was wet. Papa John's has better pizza. Or Peel's Pizza. Or Charlie Gitto's or Pie Hard, the food truck. Someone definitely over rated this place.  Too bad.

The hotel itself is nice enough, but they charge for wireless internet unless you're a rewards member and book your room through one of their websites. So if you go through something like Expedia, you're looking at an extra $14 a day. 

The room itself was clean and nicely put together, but if I'm paying $100+ a night for an "upscale" hotel room, wifi needs to be included. Luckily, there are several other open networks within range, which should really give pause to the management - if businesses in your area give away Internet for free, you're going to have a hard time justifying the charge.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Beware!!!Beware!! This place is something else. They say one thing then it's another thing. Better off going to America's Best. They will give miss information and charge you extra to fix it. The workers there are the worst especially the bald white guy with the glasses, he messes up everything. The price for frames and lenses are overpriced I paid less for the same thing I got at America's best but it was $300 here. They don't know how to adjust your glasses right either they have them too tight or lopsided, if you have a round face. Listen to me and take your money and time somewhere else!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Had the wrapped bread sticks as an app. The alfredo that came with it was very bland and luke warm. I ordered the veal marsala as the main course. I've never had any kind of marsala that is served with the pasta on the side with spaghetti sauce. The veal was disgusting and very tough. The spaghetti sauce was cleary not fresh and obviously had been sitting in the hot well for far too long. It had a paste like texture and was very bitter. The best part of my meal was the ceaser salad. Overall very poorly executed menu and for a total of $35. Not worth it at all. Could have had a better meal at Fazollis.

We stayed here using our Best Western points.... so not bad for a free stay.  View from balcony was breathtaking. ... best part of stay.  Bed was not very comfortable and pillows... or lack there of... was terrible.  Four half size... like a throw pillow on your couch... on a king size bed.  Walls are thin and could hear kids running around hallway.   Plus side did have a restaurant/bar attached so that was handy.  Front desk was helpful for the most part depending on who was working. Shuttle was convenient.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Everything here is authentic and amazing! I would eat here every day if I lived closer. Whenever someone comes to visit me in Philly, I take them here. Everything I've eaten there is delicious, prepared with care, and brought to the table by FRIENDLY waitstaff. The waitstaff is friendly, accommodating, and patient (...having trouble deciding or waiting for the last member of your party to arrive).
I could go on and on and on about how much I love this place. Check it out for yourself, you will not be disappointed.

This is the worst system I can imagine. To get your car you wait on a long line to pay at a machine. Then you travel to the floor your car is on, wait again on a long line to have someone ask you what your car looks like and then they bring it to you. By the time you get to the gate with your paid ticket, it has expired (too much time between paying and exiting) and another rather rude person has to come to the exit far to let you out. All in all a 35 minute experience. Not worth the few bucks saved on the cheaper price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went for an early dinner, there was one other table there (party of 4). The bus person sat us and then we waited for over 15 minutes for some one to wait on us. Seems like the waiter could not handle more than one table, we weren't even recognized. I was just about ready to leave when the bus person asked us if we wanted anything to drink. I asked if this was the level of service we could expect if we stayed. I think a new waitress came on the floor, at which time she immediately helped us. It's a shame, we have eaten here many times and never had this problem. As always, the food was very good. Hope they address this issue.

Used to go to Gina's a lot b/c they have NFL Sunday ticket and would indulge me by letting me put Broncos games on.  But, truth be told, I was happy to go up there for the food, too.  They do a nice pesto sauce on their pizzas.  The bread/crust isn't really anything extraordinary, but, then again, what pizza in SoCal is?  Seriously, what does it take to get a decent pan pizza pie west of the Rockies.  Gina's also does good calzones and serves beer.  In fact, during school year they have $3 pitchers.  Its good enough if you've got a hankerin and are in the area.

They ruined a dress and a skirt. The dress had delicate sleeves which came back completely torn. The skirt was taken in so they could sew an area that was torn. They sewed that area but the skirt came back with a tear in an area that was not previously there. I know the tear wasn't there because the seamstress and I inspected the skirt together before I left it there. I didn't Take the dress out of the plastic until it was too late to complain. When I brought the skirt back to them, the seamstress had every excuse in the book why it didn't happen while in their care.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I would give 5 stars but I don't like liars!!!! Don't say a car will be ready at a certain time and then lie and say it won't ready for another hour. Some people have lives and places to be. And can't cancel!!!! Don't trust Bob or Bobby whatever his name is! Get it in writing or record him when he says a certain time!!!!!!! You drop your car off in the am and they don't even work on your car till later! Nah I don't play that shit and they said I said can be picked up anytime ummm NOOOO I didn't say that. If you asked me I would've said I need it fast but you never asked does later work! Don't try that with me!!!! Screw yall
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We've been to this location countless times. We've also had some good experiences and bad. My last visit was a Bad one because for the amount of money that you spend on a meal, you would think that the chicken would be Seasoned properly but it wasn't. Also, we've encountered extremely SMALL pieces of chicken in the Wing dinners. So small, they didn't even cover the palm of your hand! Disappointed and probably will not visit again because this particular visit was specifically to see if they could've REDEEMED themselves from the previous visit but Failed.

I found Annie's to be a disappointment after hearing good things about it. The salon has a dingy feel to it and I was greeted by a man with a pack of cigarettes in his pocket. That turned me off immediately but I decided to give it a try. While the staff was friendly enough, neither my manicure nor pedicure looked like it had been done professionally. Over 24 hours later my feet still feel raw from the scrubbing. I know that many local women love this place so maybe my manicurist was having an off day, but it was enough to ensure that I won't return.

I wasted my money. I ordered chicken noodle soup and got a water version of chicken and rice. I tried to push pass the appearance and taste because my throat hurt and I needed the broth or should I say hot water. They really need to change their rice brand. It was very hard and gritty. The chicken was more like the fat of the bird, yuck.  The "pork," veggies, and favor in the dry rice was missing with the exception of a few very small pieces. They got one star because the shrimp and broccoli had decent favor so I was able to mix it to get some down. They lost our business.

We lived here for 3 years up until August 2014.

They had a major bug problem that ruined the carpet (we had no pets and are fairly clean people, plus we're never home). They charged us 600 dollars to replace it. We found out later, they just put in hard wood floors and were charging the former tenants to pay for it.

The area is nice, people are okay. Some ghetto assholes can ruin an entire building, but mostly everyone's chill.

I would say other than the BUGS, BUGS, ROACHES AND MORE BUGS, it's a decent place to live.

Middle aged biker type dive bar.  No frills place to get a cold beer and catch a few tunes. I've been there a few times to see a musician friend, Mark Shane.  He plays at dive biker bars all around and this is one of my favorite.  Whats weird is that the "unrecommended" reviews of this place I found to be more accurate.  Some of the people look rough but it is just a close knit bunch of locals looking to unwind.  They are friendly, just talk to them! Sit in the corner, and you won't be bothered. Right on the water with a decent outdoor area and cheaper beer than almost anywhere makes this place a winner to me.

Live in neighbourhood and use to frequent the Cafe' regularly.    Lost track due to Covid but am reminded two times in June how great the food is.  This is not a regular cafe but a Resturant on its own and attached to the Blake Hotel.   Seafood dishes, burgers, salads, soups, and breakfast have always been good but now actually appear to be getting better.   Love eating here knowing the staff keep the food fresh and tasty.  Thanks Kevin and Chef.   You guys are great for our neighbourhood.   We look forward to returning and bringing our friends again when they start visiting again.   Tim

If the old lady who owns this location doesn't want black people in her establishment I personally would have appreciated a sign of some sort. I wouldn't have been so appalled by her attitude and side comments (that she doesn't think you can hear) had I not been with my kids. This is the second time I have gone to this location and was once again met with her racism and sarcasm. I WILL NEVER STEP FOOT INTO THIS PLACE AGAIN!! 
And on top of that... The yogurt sucks!! It was hard and lacked flavor. I had to chop it up and stir it a bit to make it even worth me not throwing away.

Atmosphere is nice and pleasant...clean establishment as far as the eyes can see for the most part. The one thing that will have me NOT going back is they recycle the paper slippers and toe separators. Not recycle in terms of wash and reuse, but when they lady took my toe things, she threw them under the pedicure care to be used again. When she finished with my toes I wondered if the reused them because I'm use to a fresh pair out the pack and that wasn't the case...and upon leaving my suspension was true...if you get a pedicure...BRING YOUR OWN KIT!!!

The only good thing I have to say about this restaurant is the wait staff are very nice and know what they're doing. The view is okay of the Delaware River. But 0 stars for food and ambiance (unless you like the smell of mold). The "Crazy nachos" were drenched in a cheese worse than Velveeta... barely edible. My fiancés crab sandwich entree was almost the size of a quarter. My brother got mussels and it was so small of a portion, it was almost a joke. The live music was terrible. Stay away from this place, unless you're a local towny out for a drink.

We stopped in on a Sunday eve. Seated and greeted at table immediately. Chips were a little on the hard/thicker side. We prefer thinner, but that just a preference. Salsa was tasty and mild enough for my kiddo to enjoy. We got the spicy mango margarita and the coconut lime margarita. Both were tasty, but the spicy mango comes with a seasoning coated straw (tajin I think?) that was a bit too much. The seasoning being on the rim was great, though, the writing on top was just a neat little touch. Carnitas were fall apart tender, my partner really enjoyed them. Not the best Mexican I've had but still glad we stopped in.

This place got 1 star from me bc I couldn't put 0. I've tried this car wash twice and left upset both times. I had some water spots and dirt on the side of my Jeep from road construction so I thought I would  get just the basic wash to rinse off the dirt and I'd be back in business. The rinse did get the dirt off, however the wash didn't blow dry at the end leaving me with even more water spots. I went home and hand washed my Jeep to fix what the car wash made worse. I will not return to this wash and I will not refer anyone here, total waste of time and money.

Ever wonder why on a hot summer day this ice cream shop is empty, while the DQ two blocks away has a drive thru blocking traffic?
It's because they do not know what they are doing. They never mix the ingredients properly, they have untrained staff that half heartedly puts everything together. Hence why I will often have a single chunk of cookie dough in my ice cream.
Help your business; train your staff to actually mix the ingredients and make the ice cream off of your menu properly. It seems like a nice family business, I sincerely want to see it become successful.

This place is going to be around for a long time. After winning best pizza destination in Philly 2018, the owner Dan Gutter finally opened his own place. Both the circular style and square style are both great but the crispy edges on the squares give it the edge for me. Sauce has great balance of acidity and sweetness and the crust has great texture. Simple, traditional toppings but elevated to another level. Look forward to seeing what the chef comes up with next! Brand new shop with an old school feel that leaves you eating more slices than you thought you could. Can't wait to go back. Worth every penny and you will be satisfied for sure.

Old favorite spot to get coffee. Debey has been rude to me on 3 occasions, making me never want to go back. Once she ignored me as I waited for her to never look back at me after handing me a half full cup of coffee in the size I ordered. Another time I asked for a drink to be split, never was a problem in the last 2 years for this, but she acted suddenly angry I asked and gave me a small hot cup and no lid for an iced drink. I waited for a lid  but she ignored me then also. I am tired of feeling this rude person's passive aggression. I wonder how many other have fallen victim to this. She should not work with the public

Best cabbage salad EVER! 
My friend ordered the Chicken Teriyaki lunch and it was cooked and great. Here's where the problem lies...I ordered the Chicken Yakitori and it came half cooked ( meaning STILL RAW)- the server set it down on the table with a measly little blue flame fire and told me to finish cooking it. What? 
The fire burned out- it was still raw when i looked inside the piece of Chicken. It terrifies me that some people would have eaten it uncooked and most likely would have become ill. 
I understand Sushi is raw but Chicken should never be raw. I will go back for more salad though.

Coming from Los Angeles, we were used to really good sushi and we're disappointed to find out that there really aren't very many good places in Santa Barbara. Once we saw this new place open up near us, we were super excited to try it out! 

The staff was very friendly and attentive as well as professional and respectful. *PRO TIP* sit at the bar! 

The food we ordered was very good. We ordered 4 rolls and enjoyed all of them! Only thing I would change is portion size. The rolls were very small, but tasted great! We will definitely be returning with family and friends!

I wish I could say that I liked this place. It's a local chain that sends out a lot of coupons and often offers a free drink and ice cream. But, the pizza just isn't good and delivery is absurdly slow. We ordered from them twice and delivery took about 1.5 hours -- which is ridiculous. The pizza was greasy and the cheese separated from the rest of the pizza the last time that we ordered. It's a nice touch that you can get ice cream and a drink, but I won't be ordering from here again. Instead, I'd rather pay twice as much and get a decent pizza from RoundTable.

St. James crossing is a quiet apartment complex in a great central location, but it's way overpriced. I'm not renewing my lease because my rent was going to increase by $100. $900 hundred dollars a month plus water, sewer, trash, pest control, and convenience fee, and mandatory renters insurance would quickly make the 1 bedroom apartment close to $1150 a month. These apartments are too old and dated to be worth that amount and their are no washer/dryer hookups. My current building has three empty apartments due to renters moving out and I'm sure it's due to the pricing.

Could not take my order correctly even after it was given three times (large iced coffee, 3 equal, little bit of cream) and once more after it was in the computer and they had taken the next order.  My resulting drink was white, not off white, white.  I asked them to please add more coffee since I only wanted a little cream I was handed back the drink in the picture I posted for this location.

The store also had no A/C in August and left up old promotional materials and was indignant when you asked about them as if we should know they're discontinued. 

Terrible.

Big slices of good, crispy-crust pizza and awesome bay fries. Better yet, they really take care of their customers: I drove all the way down from PA (near the Delaware border) to pick up my order in terrible weather. When I finally showed up about 40 minutes later (more than double the time it took to make my order), the manager said "I tried calling you to see if you wanted it delivered instead" and I said "Nah, I'm coming all the way from PA." He then gave me a slice out of a fresh pie and said "You've got a long ride...here's one for the road." Now THAT'S service.

We had the pepperoni and fresh mushroom pizza. We went there expecting to find Fortels Pizza since we're long time Fortels pizza lovers. We saw the name changed and turned to leave but then decided to try it. We're glad we did. 
The crust was buttery, crispy and cooked just right. If you like loads of sauce, ask for extra. The pizza was really good. We noticed the next table ordered salad which looked really fresh.  
Check it out. I suspect when word gets out, this place could get crowded. They do carry out too.

went in for a gel manicure, was happy with the OPI color selection.  
However, the application of the polish seemed to appear bubbly from the nail tech rushing (even though it was not busy at that particular time)
Some of my nails were not filed down to the same length, one even crooked.  
The polish also did not cover the entire nail ... You can noticeably see part of the side of the nail has no paint. I always feel rude inspecting what the nail technician did and telling them what to do but $30 later, i wish i did.
I will not be going back. I have yet to find a good nail place in Voorhees.

This is my all-time favorite Starbucks location! I have been a loyal Starbucks Gold Card member for some years. There have been a lot of Good, even some great locations... but this one by far is my favorite. It is very convenient for me because it is on my way to work, but there are times I have had to go to other locations for different reasons. Every time I do, I am disappointed because of the HIGH BAR this location has set. The manager is exceptionally helpful, friendly and professional. The staff is AMAZING. Friendly, upbeat, proficient. I have never had problems with my order. They're smiles make my day! KUDOS! I'm a fan! 
~Annie Kidd

My wife and I have been big fans of this place for a very long time. We order the same things every week and we know how much it's going to cost. We did however have a bad experience and I wanted to wait and calm down before posting it. My wife had ordered an enchilada item. What she received was a burrito item instead. Before the plate was set down we both told the waiter it was wrong. He said 'Well it's the same thing. What's the difference?' We had to make him take it away. At the end of the meal we received the check and it too reflected the wrong item. We've not been back since. I guess I've not calmed down yet...

This is the worst bank I've ever done business with. The employees are rude and treat their customers like garbage. I have been banking with them for over 15 years. They do have great rates, but when you need customer service... Don't expect anything but attitude. I used to have multiple accounts with them, and am now down to one. I don't speak to them often thankfully, so the years pass, but the moment I do need something... I am reminded as to why I am down to one account with them, and I will be closing that one as well. Find these rates at another credit union. Being treated this way is not worth any amount of savings.

The Velocity is the best place to live not only in The Gulch but also in Nashville! What I love most about it, other than location, is that the management is amazing. They always say hi to you when they pass in the lobby or the halls which to me makes it feel like a community and alway clearly communicate updates happening in the building or neighborhood- super helpful and informative. The amazing gym, which just got re done, and covered parking garage are just two more perks of living here! The rooftop lounge is in the process of getting re done as well and I cannot wait to see it!! Thanks Velocity!

Disappointing. We live near by..never ate here..read reviews, decided to try.  Ordered beef lo mein..very soggy noodles, very little sauce..tasteless.  also ordered war won ton soup..it also was equally tasteless, and won tons which were soggy and disentegrated...   The delivery was super fast..but food very sub par.  We ordered right at 4:30pm..when they opened.., so the food should have been fresh..but it taste like 2 days old, and very soggy.  Cannot recommend based on our first and last experience. We do not plan to ever return.

The people are friendly but the hotel needs a remodel badly. The shower leaked and tub backs up while you shower. I paid more to stay here than I did in Clearwater Florida! The breakfast did not have a big choice in items, in fact on the 3rd day of our stay there were no bagels at all, no fruit, no muffins, and the juice machine was broken. So I had toast. Almost $800 for a few days- and I had toast. The pool has scummy walls. I have stayed at other La Quinta Inns with better service- now I regret staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I went to Cinderella nails this evening to get a manicure. I called the salon and confirmed they were open until 9pm. When I arrived to the salon at 755 I was told they could only take me if their 8 o'clock appointment didn't show up... I pointed out that I called and was told they were open until 9 not that the last walk in or appointment was at a certain time (other salons specify that they take the last walk in at 8) he said we are open until 9 and take people until then... I'm confused... I rushed down with what I thought was ample time for a simple manicure... Main Street isn't the easiest for parking... What a waste of time!

These guys squeezed me in at the end of the day and I'm glad they did. 
I went for a bowl of tortilla soup to start with and I can say the authentic flavors of the soup were right on. Chunky shredded white meat chicken, slices of guacamole, rice, cilantro and herbs topped with tortilla strips. I could have stopped there for my meal and I would have been perfectly happy but I was hungry and also ordered a huge Burrito.  the El-Rey didn't disappoint for deliciousness either. Thank you Urban Cantina. Your fast, super friendly service, delicious food and great vibe gets 5 stars from me.

I had been going to this restaurant for many years but I have noticed it has declined quite a bit.  The last time I was there (about 6 months ago) I got the chicken pot pie for dinner.  There was very little chicken and lots of potatoes in the pot pie.  The most disturbing thing, however, was when I found 3 rather large pieces of chicken skin in the pot pie - not even cooked enough to be broken down.  Kind of took my appetite away and I haven't been back since.  When I showed the waitress she kind of shrugged it off.  Very disturbing.

Very bad service .. 

De principio a fin 
1- Nos cobraron $5 por entrar (íbamos a cenar eran las 9pm no habían más que 2 personas sentadas en la barra) 
2- El staff no tiene mucho conocimiento de lo que ofrecen y no regresan a la mesa a preguntar si estas bien
3- la comida (no se si porque era tarde) insípida.. esa pechuga de pollo no tenía ni sal .. 
4- Para pagar hay que esperar que tu mesera recuerde que tiene mesa (y si habían más clientes a esa hora.. pero nadie comiendo) 

Muy malo todo .. la administración tiene que interesarle el bienestar de su cliente no solo el dinero.

So Ken's Sushi was the closest sushi to our hotel near the airport.  From the outside, I was a little nervous BUT I must say the warm customer service and great sushi made up for it.

The sushi was very fresh tasting.  And the rice was seasoned perfectly.  

We had the spicy tuna, red dragon, "nasty nate" and a california.  They were all very tasty and the chef used just the right amount of sauce.  

The staff (including Ken) were super nice and friendly which made me want to come back for that "everyone knows your name" feeling.  

Good job. (Oh and the prices were GREAT!!!!)

Tuna Bar has quickly become a favorite of Philadelphians alike and trust me it a great experience! Top tier service from the moment you walk in being that you're so welcomed! Tina is exceptional (thank you Tina! ) I have eaten here quite often and have never thought to do something like write one of these but I'm really hoping this encourages others to visit Tuna Bar! The food quality is among the freshest in the city with all dishes, and the wide variety of options is a treat every time! The drink selections are excellent as well... just top to bottom they did not miss! Thanks again Tina and crew we love the Tuna Bar!

Have ordered here multiple times and this last time is the last time I will give them a try. They are always late with deliveries, they tell you 45 mins and ends up being close to 90 mins. Today we ordered and at the hour mark I get a call saying my address won't go into the drivers gps, I've ordered delivery a lot with them and when I tell them this they say they have no record of me ordering. But when I called to place the order they confirmed my address right away, but now I'm not in their system? They offered to still bring the food but after 2 hours no thanks! Will never be ordering from here again

Covid excuses....usually we have 9 people on the line, but 5 called in sick.  Ok, so tell us before we sit and have expectations of a wonderful dinner.  There are so many places nearby and we would have come back in the future.  Now...probably not.  The good;  Relatively friendly service, lots of options, good wine variety and a couple dishes were good.  The bad; waitress was overwhelmed, the manager had to make excuses for everything..and all the fish dishes(salmon and the special) were weak.
The zuppe de pesce was good and the bread as always was great.  Good luck, but you've lost me.

The food is consistently good and I dine there about once or twice a month for  breakfast about Noon. 
The food is good  but here are the shortcomings.
There is always a wait even when you first walk in and there are open tables.
The initial service is slow for a server to come to your table and take your drink order.
The kitchen is slow and there is  usually a noticeable wait for your order to arrive. Your check is delivered promptly but there is always a line (similar to a grocery store checkout) to pay your bill.

Went to lunch with some work colleagues and it was very good.  We each ordered something because the prices were so reasonable and it turns out there was way to much food for us to finish.  The portions are huge.

All of the food was great but my favorites were the Salt and Pepper Calamari and the Spicy Yummy Chicken.  Other dishes that were also very good were the Beef With Chinese Broccoli and the Orange Chicken.  

The service very friendly and fast.  We had 12 people at our table and got served inside of 10 minutes.

Great experience overall.

This place has huge promise, and I'd love to see them continue to grow. On my first visit I had the $5 Florida style pizza deal (probably one of the best deals in town by the way) and was thoroughly impressed by the portion and quality of the pizza. The next day I went back to try the Chicago style, which was still very good but not quite as impressive. The crust and sauce tasted a little flat, but that can be remedied easily with more seasoning. Mr. Sunny is super friendly and very serious about using fresh ingredients. I intend to keep going with the hopes of giving this place 5 stars soon!

Just moved to the Tucson area and was scared by all the bad reviews featured on every vet's Yelp page. Glad I took a chance on Pet Doctor. They answered my phone call, scheduled my appointment within two days, called to confirm, and brought me back to the exam room as soon as we got there. 

My dog is a barker at the vet, but they handled him so well and so quickly that he never made a sound. The prices for vaccines/exam are way cheaper here than Nashville. I would have paid $300 for what I got done today, which only cost me $112.

I'll definitely return to this vet!

I've been eating here for almost two years now, bringing my family and friends. This evening just might have been my very last visit. The chips were stale. The server reccommended the "burrito Texicano", which was very disappointing. The cheese sauce was extremely watery, and the burrito was doused in a pile of lettuce with zero flavor. For the $10 bucks I spent, Taco Bell would have been a better choice. Not to mention, I made a special trip from downtown just to eat here tonight. In the future, I will choose El Rey on 2nd Ave for mexican food.

Stayed on a Saturday night. If you don't want any sleep this is the place. Got woken up at 11:50pm to loud thumping bass and yelling,  thought it was in the parking lot outside our room. We where on the first floor. It was from a room on the 2nd floor. Complained to the front desk and they sent security up there. It was quite for about 20 minutes then back to the thumping and yelling. The smell of pot in the hallways  on both floors. Then getting woken again to more yelling at 5:45 am from the room next door. What Kind of people behave like this?  No human decency at all! Thanks Philadelphia
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: It's McDonald's so I've never had high expectations but this particular location sucks the most. Aside from having the slowest line ever they purposefully give you the wrong order. Every time I order Dr Pepper they without fail give me coke. Sometimes they say they're out, or they used to. Now they just give you coke without telling you you'll be getting coke. I thought it was a mistake the first couple times but it's obvious that they're just too lazy to even say they're out or get you the right drink idk. But when all I order is a soda and you can't even get that right....
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I went in and said I wanted an eye exam for glasses but would look around other places before I bought and wanted my prescription.  I spent over an hour there and after the exam I asked for my prescription.  What they gave me is not sufficient to get glasses.  They don't give you your PD.  I called today and was told that I would have to come back in and they usually charge for that...   they wasted my time.  They misled me and lied that what I had would be my prescription for glasses.  I called to complain and the 'manager' hung up on me.  I wouldn't recommend this location to anyone.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Do yourself a favor and go to Frenchy's. Lower prices, better quality food with larger portions and better service. Jimmy's is overpriced and underwhelming. Ordered the mahi and it was the smallest piece of fish I've ever had with a couple of sad pieces of broccoli and a couple of potatoes. I was still hungry after finishing. My wife's meal had shrimp and they were the tiny, frozen kind. Pretty sad when you're sitting there overlooking the water, imagining that fresh, local seafood can't be too difficult to get your hands on.

The staff here waters down ALL drinks, even if you ask for no water (waters down coffee, hot drinks if they don't make enough to fill the cup, ALL teas so they don't have to keep making more, lemonade, etc.) If you catch them watering it down they give you so much attitude and end up wasting more product in the end since they're so often asked to remake the orders. Moreover, it's very rare that they're fully staffed or even friendly. This is honestly the worst Starbucks I've ever been to and would not continue to waste my time or money if I didn't work across the street.

There were a bunch of flying bugs inside the coffeeshop! Very icky! There were two baristas out front when I went in. One was visibly very sick and was coughing all over the place. I understand needing to work to pay the bills and all, but she was much too sick to be ignored. The other barista was very friendly and happy to answer all of my questions.

To give credit where it is due, the coffee I received was exceptionally good and was the price was on the cheaper side for Boise coffeeshops. The coffeeshop was delightfully spacious and not crowded like most other coffeeshops downtown.

I would like to shout out a huge THANK YOU to Asiago's for being so accommodating during the Boise State Graduation weekend. I must have altered our reservation number multiple times. However, I never once felt like it was an inconvenience. They were incredibly friendly and professional during our correspondence on the phone. When we finally arrived, the evening of May 6th, our experience couldn't have been any better. Not only was the customer service stellar, but the food was incredible, especially the sauteed mushrooms in the champagne sauce. Thank you once again for making our night so memorable.

Went for the third time last night. Service has been very friendly and on point. The margaretas are very good and the food is superb. Best Mexican food that I have found in New Orleans. Have had an enchilada dinner, combo fajitas the 2nd time, and the Cookout last night for two. Bring your appetite- plenty left over and a reasonable price. If you like hot salsa ask your server. They have a separate version that is very spicy on its own but if mixed with the regular salsa takes it all to another level. If you are looking for Mexican (there are few good ones in NO) I highly recommend Don Jose's. You won't be sorry.

I was pretty impressed with this place. After reading the other reviews I was really questioning what we had gotten into. I thought the place was very clean! The decor was up to date and the staff was helpful and friendly. I was extremely sick while there so I was in bed the entire day and night and the bed was AWESOME! The only complaints we had were small like the bath tub didn't hold water well and the phone didn't work well it had a lot of static. But other than those two things I was impressed! I would def stay there again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Food was low quality and taste was barely average and definitely not worth the price. Service was sloppy. Would have been one star but food arrived quickly. Waitress dripped water on my plate and food as she reached over me to pour for others. Showed up at our table and asked probing, personal questions repeatedly about things we had been discussing privately. She would not leave when we tried to keep our replies brief and avoided eye contact - appeared tone deaf. Very uncomfortable experience. Would not eat here again.

Just had an excellent dinner at Lotus.  I had the chicken - a perfect, healthy dinner.  So moist and flavorful, with potatoes, mushrooms and spinach.  My husband had the mackerel and loved it.  We shared the 5 cheese plate with bread.  Nice pairings of fruit jams with each cheese.  The dining room has a quiet vibe even though there were a few groups of 4, and several couples. A nice change to be able to hear your dinner companions.  Service was very attentive, and not rushed at all.  BYOB is a bonus.  We will definitely be back!

The restaurant is beautiful inside, very old world, so I was expecting authentic delicious Italian food.  Service was fast but unfortunately, the food was not very good.  For a place that places "wood fired pizza" first on their sign, they should really improve that particular menu item.  It was bland, the middle was soggy and the one we ordered was overloaded with briny flavors.  Calamari was good, crispy and light, but the aioli sauce was basically a glob of mayo plopped on the plate, super unappetizing. Disappointing.

Convenient location in the heart of downtown Philadelphia, but, unfortunately the convenience stops there. The staff put an extra hold on my debit card that made me have to cut my trip budget tighter. The first room we were given had a broken heater. They allowed us to switch rooms with no problem, but the amenities at this hotel are just not worth the price. Biggest problem: The blankets are so heavy! The weight makes it feel like you are being crushed. It was our anniversary, and I feel like other hotels would have ensured that our experience was better than it was.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Wow so disappointed! Our group ordered an appetizer and 3 meals and sadly none of them tasted good. I read reviews that people loved this place, so not sure if you just have to order the right thing or what but we were sorely disappointed, especially for the price we paid. Service was ok. Nice looking place and the food looked like it would taste amazing but it was very bland all of us kept adding salt (which I never add salt at any restaurant) and still didn't help. Very sad. By the way you cannot use the yelp free appetizer if you are using a Groupon.

if i could give this train wreck of a "restaurant" a zero star review i would. i used to love going here for lunch or dinner when it was under the old ownership but ever since a new owner took over it has been a mess! half the time the cooks don't even know how to make the items on the menu and it comes out wrong, especially some of the pastas. the wait times have gotten way too extreme and the expensive prices no longer match the quality of the food. i don't know what happened to this place but i will no longer be a loyal customer!

This original 12 South gem is a staple for any Nashville local. Great selection of "hard to find" beers from many out of state breweries. Very cool aspect of enjoying a draft while shopping for that long forsaken brew that you once enjoyed on a trip, or when you lived in a past city. There are a few tables inside to sit and chat / play a board game, as well as patio seating for when the weathers nice. Overall, this no frills, local watering hole, will be a frequent stop for as long as we live in the Nashville area!!

Hotel has been 're-branded' as a Wyndham.  Stayed here the first few days of April.  I think every employee said 'hello' or 'how are you' everytime they saw me.  Location was great; within a 5 minute walk of the Liberty Bell, Independence Hall, the Philadelphia Mint, just to name a few.  Room rate was reasonable for the location.  Overnight parking seemed a little high, given that I was a hotel guest and that the public overnight rate was only $7 more.  No complimentary breakfast (like I'm use to at most other hotels).  I do plan on staying here in the future when I do a family vacation with my son, mainly due to the location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Tuesday night , 6:00 PM. The entrees were very good, we had the shrimp scampi and the Merryman. The service was the issue. There was only
One server and the hostess was not there to great us. It took a few minutes to get seated. The service was inattentive and fairly slow despite the the fact that the entrees came out fast. One roll was given out warm. At least make the effort to break up the bread. I think I would Coke back for the food alone, I would
However hope that coming
On a weekend would help the poor service be more attentive.

When I first started going here they had a very sweet woman that worked at the front desk. She's been gone for a couple months now and if I see someone at the front desk, he's there for a couple minutes and then he disappears. I've seen people wait until they leave from frustration. Also when I joined I was under the assumption that the place was a renovation in progress. I've been a member for 6 months and nothing has changed. TV's on cardio equipment doesn't work, shower isn't even installed, 1/2 finished shoddy work everywhere. Stay far away from this place, definitely not worth the money.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: It was my fourth time here because I really really try to support local businesses.  The first time I came it was great but since then it has just been downhill.  Today the tacos were so dry I had a hard time chewing the chicken unfortunately.  And the shells now appear like they came from an Ortega box like you buy at grocery store.  My friend had a chimichanga and it was also very dry but at least he had guac and sour cream to moisten it up.  I'm so sorry to say it but I honestly have had better tacos at Taco Bell in years past.

We bought our tires here at Tucson mall sears due to ease and convenience of dropping off car and then just shopping during the hour or so while having tires rotated....but it has always been a nightmare checking in.  Usually only one person both manning the phones and also trying to get cars checked in.  Today was my last straw.  Waited 25 minutes. JUST TO CHECK IN THE CAR.   They are almost never done when they say they will be.  
We won't be returning ever and will be buying our stuff at discount tire or elsewhere. This is much too frustrating 
I only give one star because they staff is very friendly usually
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Get the buffalo chicken biscuit!  Drinks and service are great as well.

Was very crowded when we got there but were quickly given a seat at the chef's bar by the lovely hostess.  

The server was definitely busy but very apologetic and still managed to provide great service.  He gave us some awesome recommendations.  Among them were a lovely whisky/watermelon cocktail that was perfect for brunch on a warm day.  I wasn't in love with the kale salad but both my boyfriend and I loved the buffalo chicken biscuit - delicious and unique.  Definitely worth a try!

This place was ok. The food was fair for the price. The one problem is that it is too cold in there to be enjoyable. When we decided to go eat there (8 of us) ALL in our party were so cold. We spoke to our server and were told there was nothing that could be done about the temperature. We have been to eat there many times, as we live in the area; however, we will not be able to go back unless they turn the heat on! I cannot imagine my staff having to work in such an unpleasant environment if I owned it. It is a shame.

Visited Indy with a bachelorette party last weekend and we loved Wild Beaver so much we went back 2 nights in a row! The bartenders were all nice, funny and engaging. The karaoke was inviting and judgement free. We especially loved when the employees sang songs. They also have a selection of Wild Beaver shots to choose from which were all very tasty and not too pricey! (I sampled most of them of course!) 

On our second night we had reservations at Howl at the Moon and ended up at Wild Beaver because it was honestly so much better and more fun. If I ever visit Indy again, I will definitely go back to the Wild Beav.

First time diners.....and at 6:15 p.m. the place on a Tuesday nite was empty!  So, we got the cute, chatty waitress all to ourselves for a while.  She brought the hubby the largest and tastiest martini he's had in a long time...$8.  Not a Happy Hour price!  We tried their Caesar salad....needed a squeeze of lemon! Then, shared a dish of spaghetti & meatballs.  Yum.  Good thing we shared.....even took leftovers home.  Nice place, friendly staff, and we'll try something more substantial next time. Maybe next time we can get Ivo to flip a few bottles for us!

Great NY style pizza, not too doughy like the rest of these PA pizza places. Just beware, they do NOT take credit/debit over the phone! A little bit of an inconvenience when I wanted a family member who was driving past to pick it up for me. They also do not deliver either. All not major cons, especially since the pizza is good. They use lots of garlic, which I like, but some may be sensitive. However they will adjust if you ask or at least the guy on the phone offered when I asked about how much garlic they use; I was asking for extra garlic as most pennsyltucky places are alliumphobic. Prices are good.

Worst experience ever.  Two hour wait for a car with a pre paid reservation at supposedly not busy time.  Had three slow walking people cleaning long line of waiting cars is all so it took about twenty minutes per car to come to long line of waiting people.  worthless manager.   They would pull around and call a name and if person didn't hear it they just called another immediately and that person was out of luck   Charged almost $60 for pre paid gas on a compact.  Rate was four times usual rate and charged over what my pre paid quote was ....   never rent here!! We usually prefer hertz but not here!!!

I have used Don's Auto Repair on Passyunk Ave for all of my auto needs since I moved to Philadelphia two years ago and have had all good experiences. They have been honest and given me fair prices for all repairs and maintenance and new tires. They are very busy every time I go but they are efficient and do the work while I wait. Their communication with me has always been professional. I am writing this because they deserve the praise but also as a favor to any of you out there who need a good and honest mechanic and are using Yelp reviews, as I did when I moved to Philadelphia.

Won't be going back. Good food but the service was the worst. Multiple tables walked out due to poor service. We had a reservation but it took 45 minutes to get seated. They allowed friends of the restaurant to come in after us and get a table. All downhill from there. We had to bus our own table, get our own plates and napkins, etc. They forgot four of our plates and needed constantly reminded what was missing. They acknowledged that the "wait" was bad but didn't offer to make it right. Don't risk it, this place is a disorganized mess.

could not make my glasses right ,twice .After 2 months still wrong, they blamed my insurance company saying they wont let them fix the prescription again.Called my insurance company who said that was a lie they have nothing to do with the material.They just don't want to fix their mistake.
I asked for a refund and they said" you signed all sales are final " I thought it meant if they actually made my glasses correct. To them it means they can give you the wrong prescription,not correct it and you are stuck with 2 pairs of  useless glasses.
Don't trust your eyes to shady business tactics and dr's and staff who will lie to you face.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping
