text: What is going on at this store?? Second time before 10 a.m. they had only a few flavors (literally 4 gross flavors no one wants) to choose from??? NOT ONE GLAZED OPTION?? In my opinion there should ALWAYS be the most popular flavors. And the glazed, choc glazed, and straw glazed are a much simpler donut? You guys killed it when you first opened, but are absolutely not killing it anymore. We are coming from Verdi to support this businesses!  We will no longer be supporting this business. If you guys can't even have glazed donuts available a few hours after opening, this store will fail just like the Reno one did.

The service was prompt and we were served chips and salsa as soon as we sat down.

I ordered a combo plate with a cheese enchilada, taco, beans and rice.  The food was not good.  The enchilada sauce tasted like tomato soup, there was absolutely no chili spice flavor or any other spice flavor.  The cheese was an very salty tasting white cheese.  The taco was ok but the ground beef was unseasoned.  My husband ordered a beef enchilada and found a bay leaf in his ground beef.   The beans and rice were standard.  I will not be going back to this restaurant.

Older, pretty rundown place. I gave it three stars because although the rooms were older, they were clean, the beds/linens were super comfortable and there was a mini-fridge and microwave. The staff provided excellent customer service and delivered a DSL cable line all the way to our building (E) late at night. *There is free wi-fi but for some reason my laptop did not detect it. My building was probably too far from their lobby/network. They have a hot breakfast buffet but we didn't make it before 10am closing.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We went to the location on Washington, which is a busy location with lots of restaurants and bars going on.  There was obviously no on-street parking available on Washington, but we weren't expecting one, and knew a spot on a side street a block away. The restaurant was pretty empty when we walked in, so it was also fairly quiet. We forgot to ask, but the waitress brought our sushi on a boat. Woot! We had a lot of fun eating sushi (the boat made sharing our dishes much easier, and left more room on the table), and the quiet meant we could actually have a conversation. Wonderful experience.

Long long wait- I think they send out for the tires; the guy working on my car ate lunch at @ 11;00 am while working on the car.  Took over 3 hours for brakes and tires- I would have went home and came back.  Workmanship good- but customer service blows big time.  No apology or anything.  Some of the white shirt managers are a couple of lug nuts short to.  This excursion for tires started on Monday and the guy at the desk was barely alive- he did not order my tires or return my calls.  I think ill go to Pep Boys next time!!!!!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I wanted to love this place.  The atmosphere is great. Portions are huge. Chips and salsa were as good as I've had.  Parking was a challenge, but they have valet.  It ended there.
Food was bland. I had the Chili Relleno.  The poblano was small with a little bit of cheese melted in the end of it, and the shredded chicken stacked on top and covered with salsa.  Chicken had no spice or flavor.
Not sure if the tall gentleman is host/manager/or owner. But he was a buffoon. He did nothing to improve the experience .  Doubt I'll return.

I with most of the other reviewers here. Worst McDonalds in Reno!! Hitting the drive thru usually around 5:30 AM and always encounter either closed drive thru (this is a 24 HR location), extremely slow service, bad service and inexperienced employees. You would think if you waited 20 minutes in a drive thru you would get hot fresh food but NOPE, not here. food is cold and gross. If you go inside, the place is filthy and I don't think the windows and doors have ever been cleaned. Will not waste my time here again! Wish I could give zero stars!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It's too hit or miss. I'm not a big coffee person, so I only ever get the caramel macchiato when I need a pick me up. Sometimes it's good, sometimes it's nasty. It almost tastes burnt the last few times I got it. Recently, I brought it back because it was nasty and burnt and I heard the lady say under her breath "she gone drink half the cup then bring it back." I had only taken like 3 sips! And even if I would have drank more of it so what? It's nasty and I want it remade. But I still come here every so often I just hate that I have to have my fingers crossed like I hope it will be good this time.

This place would have received a higher rating had it not been for all of the hype...

I went into this place expecting 5-star taste, but what I got was just an average burger. It was good enough, but nothing spectacular. Their staff is very friendly though, and the entire experience was enjoyable!

As for their fry sauce, it's just thousand island without pickles... It was good, but I think they put in more mayo than ketchup, so it was pretty heavy.

Overall, I'd definitely go again if I just wanted a burger for lunch, but it's not as good as everyone raves it is.

There were two other Asian buffets in the USF area I preferred going to (Hibachi and China 1) but discovered both of them were closed down.  I had been to China Buffet during previous trips to Tampa and decided to eat there yesterday.  As usual, they have a decent selection of food including dim sum and sushi but the latter didn't seem that fresh (although more was being made when I was leaving).  I was surprised not to see lettuce in the salad bar.  I was also disappointed the Mongolian grill is open only on weekends.  Aside from all that, this is an OK place if you desire all-you-can-eat Asian food.

This location is my primary store.  I'm not sure what's happened lately, but the quality has slipped. Compared to other locations, the foam beverages are practically foamless and I had to call and speak with a manager about it.  I had rewards expiring last week and specifically told the barista/cashier that I wanted to use them. She acknowledged my request and charged me anyway AND my star rewards expired the next day.  This is just a couple examples  of things that have not gone well lately.  Very disappointing!  Please don't let this location go the way of other Township businesses that didn't listen to their customers.

Pros: The optometrist was the best I've ever met. He was patient, he listens, and he gives a great description to my questions. 

Cons: The front desk are gossipers, drama queens and rude. They complained about dealing with certain customers. Well....you have no room to talk. All you do was sit in your corner, check your cell phone and even plugged it in to charge it while you gossip some more. Then you don't acknowledge customers in front of you. Your either that rude, blind or self absorbed. You can see from the previous comments that I'm not the only one who noticed this. Are we in high school or a job?
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: If you like great coffee and great people, you MUST try this place. When Josh first explained the NITRO brew process and let me taste the different ones they have, I was instantly hooked.. The pour of a high quality nitro brew from their tap into a glass resembled exactly what a Guinness pour looks like. The taste was very smooth, no bitterness whatsoever and after a few minutes and few sips, the caffeine started to creep up and I got a jolt of energy like never before from a coffee. I now have new appreciation for quality coffee and this place has become my favorite spot not just for the coffee, but the all around atmosphere and people.

This is not the food quality I would expect from a Hilton restaurant, but then again, this isn't the nicest Hilton either. My wife and I got to the restaurant at 9 pm. It was open until 10, so we thought everything should be okay. Service was great, But food was horrible. We got the crab stuffed grouper, which did not taste like grouper (or crab) and the meatloaf, which resembled a hungry man tv dinner meatloaf. Rice was cold. Grouper and meatloaf very dry. Only reason for two stars was our server was great.

I can no longer recommend them for anything. Since my previous sterling reviews, there have been numerous instances where I have been lied to (a biggee for me), the work has been poor resulting in it costing me later (example : they replaced a fuel pump. Later one of the fuel lines came loose, resulting in a 98.00 tow bill), and lastly they are useless for diagnosing problems, at least this has been true for me on several occasions. I won't even get my oil changed there anymore, as once they didn't get the oil filter tight which nearly cost me an engine.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I am up here visiting from out of state and had this place recommended to me. I haven't even tasted the pizza yet but the customer service was not that great the guy at the register was nice. I asked for a couple of things of ranch and some cheese and peppers and the guy at the register was nice and went to get me some but I'm guessing his dad or whoever the other guy was started talking to him in their native language and I'm about 90% sure he told him that I needed to be charged for the ranch I just spent 25 bucks at their restaurant and they're going to charge me for pretty much four squirts of ranch I thought that was sort of sorry.

Hotel staff is extremely nice and helpful.  Hotel is pretty tired.  Needs update.  Beds were very comfortable but pillows not so much.  Attention to details in rooms needs to happen.  Cracked soap shelf in shower.  Door to outside hallway majorly at an angle, bathroom door sticks to the point someone had to punch on door from outside to get me out as it was stuck.  Maid doesn't replenish coffee each day, sporadically.  Requested extra towels from maid and didn't receive them even though we tipped her.  Room finally cleaned a day later.  Found maid didn't speak English.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We used to go here weekly but unfortunately we have moved on to the competition. We wanted to support a small local business but each week we started receiving less and less "topping" in our cement (concrete equivalent). There was hardly anything in there and this happened over and over again. Despite the lack of generosity, they do not offer peanut butter cups which in my opinion is a pretty common mix-in for any ice cream place. Kind of a bummer. I love that they offer different combinations each week, it keeps it exciting.

Staff was great, very helpful and polite...that is why I am giving them a 2 instead of a 1 star review. The house keeping here is terrible. Upon arrival the bed was hardly put together, the bathroom was dirty, shower curtain hopefully had a lipstick stain on it and not dry blood, carpet was not vacuumed and the bathroom floor was sticky. We came back after a long day to our room still unsatisfactory. The floor still not vacuumed and the bed was just thrown together...I honestly don't think they gave us clean sheets...given the clottage, i am pretty sure it was blood on the curtain but I don't want to assume.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The food is authentic (try their catfish soup) and amazing. I went back to my favorite "Armadillo" bowl, served still literally boiling in a huge lava bowl. Being out of town for over a year in an area not known for diversity, it was so nice to have great Mexican food again. Their service was great, the orders were delivered accurately and timely, but I will admit that in the past, it was very hit and miss, especially when they first opened and were trying to get their bearings. I'm very glad they are still in business and doing well, as I plan on making this a regular stop again.

I was with the gym for 2 months before Covid hit which forced me to stop going as I am type 1 diabetic. While I was there I was treated like a paid customer. The trainers knew my name after meeting me once. There was never a packed gym. Finding a cardio machine was never a problem. Unfortunately even though they reopened Florida I personally chose not to go back due to being high risk.  I paid the remainder of my contract with no complaints because I had a contract to fulfill. I'm pretty sure in December 2019 when I signed up nobody knew the world was going to shut down nor did Joe
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Worst McDonald's I've ever been to. Previous reviews were right- homeless people drinking infront, smelled like marijuana. Rude employees, got several orders wrong and the staff was irritated when you try and get the right order.
Customers begging to use the restroom but were being denied entrance because it was being cleaned. 
I hope corporate sees this and address the issues of this restaurant. 
Southern hospitality is not found here. 
Avoid this McDonald's please at all cost. 
If there was a negative star , this restaurant deserves negative 5 stars.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: So on yesterday me and my family came here & the service was awful . Starting off the waiter was very short with everything we asked him . Then my mother tried to order a beer and everything she ordered was out . Then when they brought the food out it was so plain & the shrimp fried rice it only had 4 shrimp . My mother ordered some Asian fried chicken the chicken wasn't fried all the way through & they cut some broccoli on the side of the plate which was not steamed or anything . I don't recommend this place to anyone.

Whoever owns this place should be kicking himself. So much money left on the table. Weekday lunch I walk in and the tables are nearly empty but the line is a mile long. 4-5 trays on the counter unfilled. I figured I hit the rush, right? wrong. The line barely moves at all. After 5-10 minutes I notice the people who have already waited in line for probably 15 have now been waiting for their food for 10. So close to 30 minutes for FAST(?) food in a muggy restaurant? No thanks. I went somewhere else after I realized this.

Used to come here 3-4 times a month, for lunch, work nearby. After this I'll avoid it.

My husband and I came to Vivace to celebrate our Babymoon in Tucson. The restaurant itself was very clean and has great decorations and some tables have a wonderful view of the city. They followed COVID 19 guidelines with social distancing tables. The staff was wonderful and friendly! The manager greeted and congratulated us. Our server, Jackie, was also very sweet and attentive! The food was amazing (we got crab cakes as a starter, I got the crab stuffed chicken, husband got the pork chop parmigian). Tiramisu for dessert. We highly recommend this restaurant, definitely make reservations! Thank You, Vivace! We will be back!

I just found out the hard way that this so called Credit Union - and apparently ALL credit unions in Tucson - are starting to lard in the fees usually only charged by the evil big banks!

They charged my friend $5 to cash a check written on my account, just because he had closed his account a few months and no longer had an active account with them.

I expect this ill treatment from banks, NOT from credit unions.  Calls to Vantage West and Hughes revealed the same ridiculous fee!

I know I, for one, will be moving my money back to my out of state home credit union.  At least they know how to treat their members!

After going to America's "Best" and being extremely disappointed, I decided to go here. They were great, the employees were friendly and helpful. They have a wide selection of frames for men, women, and kids. I got an appointment for an eye exam quickly and my glasses were ready for pick up two days later, which for sure beats America's Best's 12 days. I took a point off for their "buy one get one free" which isn't, in my opinion, an actual sale. But I'm happy with just one pair. When I need a new pair I will most likely be back.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: We have enjoyed the Biaggi's in Fort Wayne and Carmel but last night was NOT ENJOYABLE.  I ordered lasagna which is normally fantastic.  It took almost 30 minutes before our meal arrived after we finished our salad.  The restaurant was not that busy.  When the lasagna arrived, it was completely overcooked.  The cheese was rubbery, the edges of the meat were burned and the taste was nothing like we have ever experienced.  I did not send it back because it took almost 45 minutes to get our meals after they were ordered.  I am only sorry I did not complain to the manager as I should not have paid for my meal.

As a avid sushi lover, I would give this place three stars at most.
It's not terrible, but not amazing. I enjoy eating udon quite a bit and I was glad to see they had that on their menu. The broth is quite tasty but I guess since its only an appetizer, the amount of udon noodles they give you is quite pathetic. I don't really recommend any of their "fancy rolls" since I don't think they are worth the price but the regular ones such as crunchy spicy tuna is not bad. The roll size and thickness(?) is appropriate.

My wife and I decided to try out the happy hour since it has reopened. We parked in a marked handicap parking space and displayed my placard. As we walked to the restaurant, employee Joseph, told us we could not park, there as it was valet parking only. I said thanks, we'll remember that next time. Joseph insisted we drive through the valet and he would park our car in the same handicapped spot. Certainly this did not make much sense. We told him we would not be visiting their establishment in the future and left.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I reserved a car online to be picked up at this location.  When I arrived I was told that no cars were available and would not be for "a couple of days".   They were extremely rude and unhelpful.   I called the Hertz 800 number to find out why I was allowed to reserve a car that was not available.   I was told this location failed to update the reservation system with their available cars.   I was told the manager or area manager for this location would call me about the problem.   Still no call after 2 days.   I would recommend steering clear of this location.

Tsuki Sushi is all I could ever ask for in a neighborhood sushi joint- and having lived in San Francisco prior to Philly, I am a tough sushi judge!!

Inexpensive but tasty and quality sushi at very affordable prices, open all the time AND byo? Amazing! This is the best non-fancy sushi place in Philly in my opinion (tied maybe with Green Garden near Washington Square). My favorite of their standard rolls is their version of Spicy Tuna, and all the specialty rolls I have sampled so far have been tasty as well (White Jade is my favorite). 

The price on the 3 rolls special can't be beat!

My apartment was broken into from the cheap windows that anyone can push in and stole my electronics I'm so heated cops and management can't do anything and i think since it's "secure" they should have cameras around the buildings since so much crime is committed here. My next door neighbor told me someone tried kicking in his door too. That same day around 1-2am 3 cars were set on fire and some were vandalized and it's also all over the news. We let security at night know I personally let neighbors aware of this crime and told them to spread the word. Set cameras around your home and alarms.

Yup, now called Dots.  I think this is the third season under new ownership. First, it's difficult to navigate around the indoor reclining lounge chair and other oddly placed items under the tent in front of the order window. I thought I was on a porch in a north philly ghetto. The person who took my order of a gelati seemed confused, asked if I wanted the water ice in the same cup as the soft serve. Got past that hurdle and was very disappointed with the water ice as it was pretty tasteless. Maybe I'm too used to the flavorful ices at Rita's. I live so close to here but just don't see the point of going back.

We have been enjoying ABC for almost 5 years but today was bad. I have previously ordered the large Greek salad but asked for grilled chicken instead of ham. Today I did the same but when I got the check there was a $2.75 up-charge. I asked at the register and was told he always did that. Why didn't he mention up-charge? Also, when we used to go to the buffet (pre covid) sometimes the pizza crust was very soggy. Today my sons pizza crust was soggy (probably sitting under the heat lamp). I didn't notice it at first but mentioned to cashier and it didn't matter. No wonder there were only 2 other people in the restaurant at lunchtime.

America's best? I think not. This is the worst 'hotel' I have ever stayed in. There were no sheets for the pull out couch, we asked for someone to bring some up, and 45 minutes later they still haven't come. The tv is as small as my laptop and is probably older than me. The carpet is disgusting, there are hardly any blankets on the bed and there was a USED soap bar in the shower, also not with a dirty wet towel. To top it all off, we discovered to used coffee filters in the coffee pot. Upon arriving home, everyone took a hot shower for fear of getting bed bugs. Please do not make the same mistake we made by staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Overall a good experience! My pedicure was relaxing and my nails turned out great. I loved the color options. My only complaints are minor: I had to ask for a few of my nails to be filed again evenly. I also didn't like that rather than wrapping my previous gel nails like most places, they had me soak my nails in a bowl of remover which they put on my lap while in was getting the pedicure. I was worried it would spill and its left my fingers very dry. But otherwise I had a good experience. I would go back again.

This is the best takeout Chinese food in South County. I used to go to a place off Telegraph until I tried this place for their tofu. The management and employees are so nice and generous. I order through Grubhub and only one time I had an order wrong. As soon as I called the store, they made a correct entree free, gave me bonus sides, and wanted to deliver it to me. Their portions are huge. Their tofu is delicious and they're one of the only places I've seen have tofu on their menu. If it's out of your delivery distance, I think it's definitely worth a drive.

I got Hikaru for take out since I live in the neighborhood and had never tried it.  I started with the house salad with ginger dressing. Normally I am a huge fan of ginger dressing, but this was creamy and almost tasted like it was made with mayonaisse. Then I had the gyoza with chicken, pork, and veggies. There were 4 tiny dumplings that taste just like the ones you buy frozen. Really salty. I finally had an Alaskan roll with fish eggs, which were bright red and slightly disturbing. The sushi was ok... Nothing special. I won't be going back, especially with Sushi Planet and Headhouse Cafe nearby.

Giving 4 stars because I can tell that this food would be great fresh. Take out is an issue though. Salads are strangely compartmentalized instead of tossed, so you have to pick around all the corners to construct a bite. About half the pizza, starting from the center, was just a soggy mess. Such a shame because based on the outer part of the pizza, I can tell the crust is great! Maybe it was just stretched a little thin in the middle. The flavors were fantastic, but no one likes soggy crust that falls apart. Again, 4 stars, but I think you probably have to dine-in here.

My new favorite spot ! I have been going for a little over a month now and absolutely love it ! They do an awesome job on my nails! Everyone here is so friendly and the salon is super clean ! I recommend this salon ever since the new management ! They have awesome deals so it is not expensive like 20% off Monday Tuesday and Wednesdays and 10% off other days when you pay cash ! I have had at least 3 friends change nail salons and start coming. to Diamond nails ! They have so many colors, even gel colors and can do so many awesome designs ! BEST NAILS PLACE IN THE AREA !! check It out !

A filling meal that lacks finesse. You cant fault cuca's for not giving you your moneys worth. The burritos, quesadillas, and just about everything comes in a super-sized portion.  

The problem though, is the meat is fatty, the ingredients aren't well mixed together, and the quality of aforementioned ingredients is questionable.  

Overall, Super Cuca's is a decent choice for an afternoon meal, that will leave you with leftovers. The location and ambiance is quite enjoyable, right in the heart of the westside. Just dont expect an authentic, carefully prepared meal.

My husband and I recently stayed here on a weekend trip to Nashville. I bid on Priceline and received this hotel. The hotel has recently been renovated and is very nice. The bed is comfortable, the water is HOT and the bathrooms are clean. The hotel is located right next to the Vanderbilt stadium and is about 2 miles to music row. The staff was quite friendly, especially the guys outside at the curb. The hotel is expensive (or at least it was during the weekend we were there) which is why I bid on Priceline. Still paid more than I would have liked but the hotel was great. I would definitely stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been going to Lamberti's on and off for years now. I'm not sure if management has changed, but the quality has significantly diminished. Recently dined in and noticed for starters the lack of staff and service. The food also left me unimpressed, I ordered a pasta dish with chicken and noticed it had little to no flavor. Lamberti's has potential to do well and be great again, but management really needs to take note of some short comings and take ownership of them. Overall, I will not be coming back to this Restaurant.

This is my second time coming here. The first was a great experience, though waiting on the food took longer than i'd have liked. Tonight's experience- was horrible. The service itself was great, but the food hit my fiancé and I hard. We both shared the steak(undercooked at first/was sent back) and then shared the yummy spinach gorgonzola gnocchi. Unfortunately not even 30 minutes after we left we both got violent stomach pain that resulted in us having to pull over before we could even make it home. Not sure if the food had been contaminated, expired or what but it was not a pleasant situation. I will not be returning here again.

I have been to Cafe Mochi before and actually recommend it but would not based on today's experience. 

I wanted sushi because I wanted something fresh, but the sushi and seaweed salad both had a soggy, unappetizing texture as if they were thawed before being served to me. It was inedible. 

The server seemed hell bent on ignoring me. She did not check in after my order and would walk past me quickly, avoiding eye contact even though the store was empty.  I essentially paid $25 to sit quietly in a corner with some sake before heading elsewhere for food.

Surprised by the negative reviews.  After the departure of Von's, had to find a new grocery store.  Haggen's incredibly overpriced, poor selection.  Friends recommended this Ralphs.  Lived here over 25 years and never patronized until now.  This is a great store, wide aisles, plenty of selection both organic and non.  I found the staff to be very friendly and they helped me sign up for my Ralphs rewards card.  This is now my "go to" store.  Prices are good, and I no longer need to feel robbed by Haggen's, Whole Paycheck and other overpriced grocers in the area.

Waitress was great, Karen I believe.  Tomato Bisq was incredible, chicken Caesar salad left a lot to be desired, not much chicken, and it was hidden at the bottom of the salad.... Weird. Used to be grilled and laid on top.. Way better...IMHO.  Also bring back the famous Lobster Mac and cheese! The original, not the pinwheel imitation stuff. Overall great atmosphere, friendly staff but food selection and quality has definitely gone south. Lots of folks i know now go next door to BBQ place. New management??? Fix it and they will come back!

BTW... what happened to the Prime Rib?????

If you like poor service and stale, not-made-fresh (they don't make dough in store anymore) donuts, this is the place.  Honestly this location has the worst service.  Waited in drive thru this morning, 3 mins sitting at speaker before being acknowledged, then literally 5 mins at window while I watched the person at the drive through take out the cash drawer and count money with a calculator.  Never acknowledged me, nor did anyone hand me my difficult order of a black coffee and a donut which could have been rung up at another station.  I drove off, and will not be returning.

The hotel itself was amazing. Friendly front desk staff, room was really cool, dogs got their own little "goodie bag", and the rooftop bar was unlike anything I've seen before. The bartenders however  were not professional at all. I bought a $6 beer with a $10 bill. I sat there waiting my my change back and would have tipped him accordingly, but never received any money back. It's pretty arrogant of him to expect a $4 tip. Also on top on the poor service the drinks were not the quality that I paid for. So besides that bad experience, I would recommend this hotel to a friend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Went there last night after not having been in a while because the customer service is horrid. Nothing has changed. The young piled the ice cream as high as he could treated me like a nuisance for wanting whip cream and wouldn't allow me to use my coupon nor did he explain the "new" program which is the reason why he wouldn't accept the coupon. For $20 for two desserts I expect to be treated like a human being not like I'm bothering someone who applied at a job to serve people ice cream. I was not rude or disrespectful to him and I was treated horribly. Thank you it's my birthday and I'll never celebrate at this place again.

Great vibe, great food, decor and service.
I was in last week with a group of friends and had a great time. 
We tried all sorts of apperizers and went our own way on Entrees.
The JH toast was my favorite app. My husband preferred the mortadella corndogs. Yes, corndogs!! There is something for everyone on this menu.

As for entrees....the braised beef short ribs, delicious! But i must say, the scallops were my favorite. These things were gigantic! A meal big enough for two.
Although sad to see Duffs go, i couldnt be happier with its replacement. Great addition to the Central West End!

In town on business and stayed across the street. This place has 4 stars on Yelp and the parking lot was full. Only once have I been wronged by my fellow Yelpers....now twice. There were four of us for dinner and each of us had the same exact experience.....WAY TOO MUCH SALT. It makes me wonder if the cook smokes, because there was clearly something going on with someone's taste buds. I sent my soup back and the others ate only part of their meal. When we told a few people about our experience, they were not surprised. How did this place get 4 stars??

Made a reservation on line 01/29/18 for a suv/awd to take on a trip. Went earlier today 03/01/18 and was told they had no more suvs/awds. They gave them all out due to the nasty weather we have this next couple of days. Asked if we wanted to upgrade to a bigger awd and said the charge would be at least $300.00 more. Since they gave our car away they should at least give us the upgrade for free. Never, never ever will I use Budget Rental Cars from the Reno AIrport. You make a reservation and you expect them to honor it.  By the way it seems as if they TREAT LOCALS like they don't matter.

Planned to spend a nice relaxing day by the pool   but was not able to get one of the 2 umbrellas, 8 cabanas($150 - Need prior reservations not no one tells you that when you book or in any communications) and not even a lounger by the pool.  Only chairs in the sun away from the pool in the bar area.  After complaining an attendant came over and said she would look for chairs and get us an umbrella- never came back after 20 minutes.  If you think you are going to spend a nice relaxing day by the pool - I suggest you look elsewhere.  This is not the hotel for you.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We stopped in for a quick bite on the way to a concert. Service was friendly and efficient. Food was a disaster. I ordered a Beef Sizzling Teriyaki (without onions) and it came out on a chilled salad plate and it was undercooked and ice cold. My wife ordered the same thing and it was on a hot sizzling platter. The waitress was apologetic and I ordered a replacement Shrimp Sizzling Teriyaki. She once again brought me a chilled salad plate with severely overcooked shrimp. She said that should be hot enough for you! Of course it was barely edible and the vegetables were soon cold because the chilled plate. Do not recommend!

Over the years I have had some pleasant dealings with competent USF employees. Unfortunately they are more the exception than the rule. You will almost never get through to someone when you call, "no one is available to talk with you at this time". If you leave your number you may or may not get a call back.

Their loan rates are usually very competitive but the hassle of dealing with them on practically anything has lead me to take most of my business elsewhere. They may deserve more than 2 stars in some areas but customer service is not  one of them.

We found this place looking for esquites. Their esquites( corn in a cup with mayo butter and chilli powder) are  on point. We then decided to come a try their tacos and they dis not disappoint. They put onion and cilantro (how it should be) and not lettuce and tomato (). My husband got a chicken quesadilla and said it was really tasty i believe him cuz he's VERY picky. We go horchata to drink which was also good and cinnamon-y. When we first came just for the esquites i got an agua de jamaica and it was super tasty not everyone gets jamaica right. Will definitely be returning here, yummy authentic Mexican food!

Loved this place...can't believe or understand why I haven't been there in years. Was back this past week with a LS deal that was about to expire so the place was mobbed, but the food was delicious.  Both myself and my dining partner thoroughly enjoyed our fish dishes with pasta (I had the Alexandra--so yummy with the most delightful rosa sauce).  It was mobbed but they did their very best to accomodate us and the food did not take half as long as I had expected.  I would go back in a heartbeat and sooner rather than later! Also, love that it is a BYOB!

I booked this stay because many hotels were surcharging stays because events going on. I understand you get what you pay for, however after a 9 hour traveling day and a migraine I was DISGUSTED to see a massive cockroach in my room. Then when I was moved a curly hair, ( I believe to be a pubic hair) was in the bed the moment I laid down. After my day I just said screw this I'm laying in the other bed. I'm extremely annoyed that no supervisor or higher up contacted me and apologized for the pest in the room. I will NOT be staying in any la Quinta again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Here's how much this gym costs:

Day Pass: $10 

Fitness 19 costs:
Monthly Fee: $12
Day Pass: $5

Though this gym has a wide range of equipment for you to get a solid workout done, it lacks in size, cleanliness, and amenities.

The equipment was dirty, rusted and show signs that it hasn't been properly maintained. Space is limited making free weight use difficult during a busy day. 

There is no pool/spa, sauna, locker room or fitness staff to help with exercises. All of which fitness 19 has.

I don't recommend this gym nor do I see myself coming here again.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Dear Twisted Sisters Nails,

I wanted to like your shop, but my experience was horrendous. I showed up on time and my manicurist was 5-10 minutes behind me. The salon wasn't open yet so she had to open it and she could not find her keys. Then the manicure/pedicure I received took close to 3 hours, and it was ruined, ruined by later that afternoon because of clumpy polish.

Oh and the last thing, the manicurist went on and on about her personal drama, and it was extremely personal--ex-husband, kids.

I think the owner of the shop is nice, but hopefully this particular manicurist no longer works there.

I had really high hopes for this place.  There aren't a lot of good restaurants in the Main Line, and their menu looked promising.  Cute space and service is friendly and attentive.  Tons of kids in the restaurant.  

Unfortunately, the food is just meh.  Our kale salad was pretty good, nothing to complain about.  I paid $23 for a lobster roll that was tiny and had very little flavor.  My husband had a totally underseasoned kabocha squash risotto.  His snapper was well cooked, but also flavorless.  We didn't feel the need to try dessert.  We won't be back - total letdown.

Tim and Joe's was a fantastic, comfortable spot for lunch.  I visited on a Wednesday afternoon last month and took advantage of the Wed. special for Anheuser longnecks.  I went with the classic Reuben sandwich, and my oh my was this a tasty one.  Tim and Joe's gives you the horseradish on the side, and believe me, it only takes a little to really add some zip to your sandwich.  The horseradish was just excellent.  Our server was very down-to-earth and outgoing.  I really look forward to stopping in again during my next trip to the Midwest.

When I went to Kokopelli's for the first time, I thought it was going to be a mediocre experience since it is in a hotel.. esp. Circus Circus. I've come to realize that it's super amazing. The chefs at the bar are really cool. We got a spanish speaking guy so my parents really got into it and we didn't even have to order. The guy was giving us rolls left and right and telling us to try this and that. My drink was never empty. The place is kind of cramped but other than that the food is delicious. I love this place. I wish I lived closer so that I can eat there more often. Definitely try this place out.

Ordered on Grub hub, too tired after long weekend to go out.

What a mistake that was! We live in south jersey with some of the finest restaurants  with very moderate prices surrounding us.

 I ordered a tray of of sushi For 29.9, fried calamari was burned to a crisp ,  the miso was very watery, the tray very cheap ingredients, barely had any fish in it .

I used to Joke that's it's almost impossible to make bad sushi unless it's deliberate ! 

Major con!  + fees and tips !

Makes you wonder about their business acumen when they deliver a very shoddy meal to a home in their own locale.

The Marlton one on route 73 in south jersey is pretty good. service is slow, but sushi is fresh, plentiful and price is excellent at $26 per person all you can eat. Puts the rest of the sushi places to shame, for less than the supermarket sushi, you can enjoy fresh thick slices of fish, fresh Salmon Roe, their hot appetizers, miso soup and seaweed salads.  Calamari salad, crabs fresh house ginger  all their salads and grilled teriyaki, and tempuras

There's a reason there's a 1 hour wait on the weekend, they don't accept reservations.

Not fine dinning, only your palette  and stomach will be impressed here.  Your wallet will

Real, good Mexican food, with beautiful and homey Mexican decór.  The chef is from Veracruz, and it's reflected in the selection of fish dishes.  The ceviche mixto is spiced up with jícama and mango, and served in the authentic way, with crackers.  We split the molcajete arrachera, but our waitress heard us debating so she brought out a ramekin of warm molé for us to taste.  It was incredible--rich and complex, a little sweet.  I guess no two molés are the same.  If you're looking for some great Mexican food at a nice but unpretentious spot, Las Bugambilias is it.  I will definitely be back.

First time eating in at the restaurant - had take out in the past.  Nice atmosphere, food was good and beer was cold. Service was adequate - checking in at just the right times during the meal.  I will go back again. 

However, I will park in the Rita's parking lot in the future.  Turning off Lancaster avenue into their rear lot, I drove a little into what I thought was a puddle.  It turned out to be a deep hole that loudly banged the underneath of my car, and I was giving this too much thought throughout my meal, thus my 3-star rating. Be careful if you have a lower profile vehicle. 

Would've been a solid 4+ otherwise.

I went to Sassy Nails for the first time today after reading a bunch of Yelp reviews. The woman who did my nails was a complete professional (I think she was also the owner). I got a gel set and they look amazing. The nail tech took her time with me and did not rush at all, even though the salon was getting crowded with walk-ins as my appointment progressed. She even told me about the various coupons the salon had available and where to find them so that my next appointment would be cheaper. My nails look very professional and will be perfect for work. I will be going back in a few weeks to get a refill.

COVID Warning - Lamb chop - bandana chef was running around the bar and dining room all night with no mask, what a poor role model for the hostess, dining room and bar staff who all wore their mask properly the entire time. Same for the drama filled food runner who wore his mask like a scarf.

Furthmore, the maskless chef should spend more time in the kitchen tasting his bland pasta dishes. 

I will say that the creator of the Tiramisu (which I changed to go due to a large party of drunk frat boys seated 2 feet from my table) is a rock star - best ever.

This is my go to hotel in New Orleans from now on, Jack with Valet was very kind and helpful from the second we pulled up, I had mistakenly booked the wrong night but Justin at the front desk made sure there was no stress and handled our mishap real quick and made us feel very welcome , the rooms are a great price and bigger than your average with all the amenities necessary and some. The Hotel is THE SPOT.
The location speaks for itself.
Everything you would want to do at walking distance plus amazing hospitality from Justin and the rest of the great staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We went for dinner on a friday night with the kids. Great atmosphere. Cool interior, small and loud, but not in an overbearing way. Open kithen and very nice waitstaff. We had personal pizza, fried chicken and mash potatoes, turkey burger and pulled pork burrito. Everything was delicious. The menu has so many choices, it is hard to believe they can do it all so well. I was skeptical, especially when i saw the great prices, but i was pleasantly surprised. We would definitely go back and try new items. I hope they do well. Nice to see something besides a chain in the area.

So many good things to say about United Tire & Service! They have done excellent work on both my car and my hubby's car. Inspection, oil changes, brakes, tires, engine mounts and more. They keep us informed by phone or text (including photos of damaged/worn parts) so we can make informed decisions about repairs. Their prices are very reasonable and they never try to up-sell us. Their customer service is excellent; they have gone above and beyond to help us out with both scheduled and uh-oh repairs. We are 100% satisfied!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Couldn't be happier with my outcome...
Had a "low tire pressure" notice on my car for months. Took it to a local westchase full service repair shop on multiple occasions with lots of explanations but the issue never resolved (and yes, I asked about a slow leak in the tire which they said was not the issue - on multiple occasions). Came to Mavis - the culprit a nail. Tire plugged and fixed - no charge and in/out same day (no appointment, just dropped in).  And guess they are more then tires and brakes (which is on their sign so never thought to go there for service needs). Will be a customer for life now and will happily refer them to others....
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Do not confuse this location for the normal new Hyatt Place hotels.  This is a poorly renovated version of Hyatt Place. Next to major freeway and the noise is unbearable if you get lucky enough to be put on that side of the hotel.  Rooms are a lipstick makeover version of an up to date room.  Dust on all the phones and night stands. Musty smell in room. Beds are a joke as far as comfort. Definitely not worth the$169/night.  I have stayed at other Hyatt Place Hotels and am normally a big fan and don't mind paying the higher rate but this location is sub par.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Sad to say I have made my last visit to this location.  I was a frequent customer, and have never gotten a correct order.  My last visit yesterday was the absolute worst!  I was very specific about what donuts I wanted and 5/12 were correct.  All but 3 donuts were slightly cold as if the were left from the night before and refrigerated.  It was 6:05 AM so I was anticipating fresh donuts, not day old donuts.  I'm not sure what the problem is, but it needs fixed!  I'll never know if it does as I won't be back! This place should be called Duncan Day Old Donuts! Peace out!

Not the first time at Jax but figured I should write after I visited a few nights ago. Overall service was very good, but the food was very marginal. Hangar steak was overpriced at $23 and the amount of food received was not enough. Steak was very tough but had good flavor. Friend had the scallops and they were SO salty they were almost inedible.

I think that the food at Jax is decent but it is overpriced for the quality and quantity. Drinks were very weak and chairs also very uncomfortable. The service like I said, was good as they were attentive. But I left feeling unsatisfied with the meal and the price.

We recommend Talus Point Apartments for its great location, quietness, abundant parking, pool and excellent management. The units are large & have good light and air. Kelly & Team do a wonderful job of managing. If you're a good tenant, you'll have a great experience. It's an older complex but very well-maintained. We put in a couple of service calls on minor items and they were fixed right away. We really enjoyed our large 2BR apartment and the environment & moved because we bought a house. Our kids are still there & they enjoy it too. We commend Kelly and Team for their attentive management. We had a great stay!  Tracy & Mike and kitties.

First time here. Its... Clean. Door to the kitchen and back door is open. Bathroom: clean. Daily special board is in the rafters. The menus look like an arts and crafts project, C-. TINY California roll 4.50.
Orange chicken was decent 9.95.

Hostess was older but was accomadating. Language barrier. The problem arose when we finished our meal. The hostess was nice, but Idk if there was a culture barrier as well. She proceeded to take the lemon slices from my finished plate, peel the rind off and feed it to my 15 month old. An awkward pause followed by "check please!" made me feel like we were running from a Balrog upon exfil.

"Run You Fools!"

After dealing with this clinic for years I will never deal with this clinic again. I got every expensive glasses costing with lens alone costing $750 in 2013. I don't need a new prescription however the finish on the lens is peeling interfering with my vision. So they offer me an insulting 20% off plus tell me that they only guarantee lens for 1 year. Something of course they did not bother to tell me at the time of purchase or I would never have bought lens that expensive. So myself, my husband and our sons will take our business elsewhere.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This morning I went to get some yogurt. A man named Ivan whistled, commented on how incredible my body was, and then stared me down as I got my yogurt and walked away. I told the manager at the store that I was an attorney and I did not like the way Ivan treated me. Even though I live closest to this grocery store, I will go to publix from now on to shop at a store where the employees do not sexually harass customers. Obviously this store does not care if women can have a comfortable shopping experience or they would never let a man like Ivan have contact with customers. The manager I spoke with apologized, but I will never go back again.

Update:  Although the issues in my original review are worth considering, it is also notable that after it was posted, three individuals from the hotel's managment group reached out to me with concern, apologies and even a small refund for our trouble. It may be that what we experienced is so rare at the French Market Inn, that their team acted quickly to remedy those unusual imperfections.  In any case, every member of the hotel team, from front door to highest management, demonstrated exceptional people skills and kindness.  The place is so pretty and is in such a great location that maybe you should give it a try!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Unfortunately, this place has gone slightly downhill. I don't know if there's new management or if they just let a bunch of people go or what. My roommate and I ordered it last night and it took over an hour and a half to arrive. That was after being quoted 45 to 50 minutes for the delivery. We called once to check on it and we were told that the driver was "on his way". He showed up 20 minutes after that. The food wasn't quite as satisfying as it once was. It's been like this the past few times we've ordered. We decided last night that we may have to find a new place :(

Terrible experience here! We came to Philly for the day and decided to try this place. We waited 45 minutes for our appetizer, and waited an hour for our entrees and still did not get our food. We had even made reservations for this place for party of 3. Two parties, (1 party of 6 and another of 4) both were seated at least 10-15 minutes AFTER us received their food BEFORE us. I mean that's pretty ridiculous. And the food it tasted like shit. I could have made better nachos at home. Honestly, there are plenty of better Mexican restaurants in the city, don't waste your time and money on this place!!

This hotel is well located.  That's about it. 25 dollar breakfast buffet and I'm a rewards member.  Ice machine was broken.  No free wifi. Carpet is grimy and buckled.  The wall paper in the hallways is torn where the housekeeping carts have been run into it.  Every hotel in my home city has a shuttle to the airport.  You're on your own here.  The gift shop staff was friendly as was the check in staff.  I have stayed at sheratons before but this is the worst ever.  The Sheraton in Miami had an airport shuttle when I was there, by the way.  This one doesn't.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We just ate here for the first time and it was delish. The order was ready when they said it would be. I got the Orange peel chicken and hubby got the sesame chicken. I think what makes this place good, at least as far as how the chicken dishes compare to other places, is that the pieces are lightly fried and crunchy on the outside without relying on tons of batter to get that crunch. So it tastes fresh with not a ton of greasy breading. The fried rice was similar... It didn't leave a oily feel/taste on your lips. The egg rolls were great. I am not always an egg roll fan but these were good!! I recommend for sure.

Hotel wasn't too bad, proximity to the French quarter is definitely a plus.. The front desk was front desk was happy to point out that they were running on reduced staffing due to covid. The problem I have it two fold,  1st of all thebeds were too soft and they woke up each morning with backaches. Secondly nowhere in the trivago app I used to book this or the sheraton app to see the hotel's amenities and policies did they mention that parking is an additional $40 A-day if you self park and $60 if you Valet Park.  Not only do I find this glaring oversight on the Sheraton's part but had I known th8s up front I made a book somewhere else.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My husband & I have been coming to Hana a little over 2 years now. It's our absolute favorite place for sushi. We usually sit at the sushi bar when we're alone but we often come in groups of 7 or more & they always accommodate us without a problem. In fact, if friends of ours go without us, they usually ask about our whereabouts. :) We LOVE the No Name roll, it's the best! We also get the Louisiana roll often along with the Hana Special roll & the Mango Salmon roll. They also serve a free little noodle salad once you order...

It's ok gets busy mid morning on weekends but there are plenty of machines except when the Chester folks roll up on the  First of the month to do there once a month wash. So I come at 6 AM cause there just getting in from partying all night from check day on the first.  Just a tip. But after the 9 th there broke so no problem on any  time issues. And  I usually throw my wash in and hit the Sun Dance saloon but time it right get back before your wash is done. The bar will hold your seat the laundry mat attendant will pull you wash out if it's busy and one time I seen him sniffing a pair of woman's panties. Ugh. So just keep that in mind.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: This is is probably the worst McDonalds I've been to. It's very dated and quite dirty inside. Orders are rarely completely correct. Staff is quite rude. In one visit I ordered 6 piece McNugget meal when I got home and opened the box it contained 6 chocolate chip cookies. The latest debacle was the incompetent  employee in the drive through charged me 3 times on my debit card for the same order. Total lack of customer service. Have been trying g to call to get resolved and was told call back after lunch we are busy. When I tried calling back no one answered phone. McDonalds corporate should be ashamed of this location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Great old school barber shop - I've been coming here since I moved to Philly. I tried a few other spots around town and most were too expensive or didn't listen to what you wanted. This place is perfect. The price is right, the people are friendly, and the cuts are on point. 

A few things to keep in mind - it's cash only (I'm sure they'll let you leave to hit up an ATM but don't be rude and pull out some cash beforehand) and it's on first come first serve basis, there's no reservations or appointments so make sure when you come you're not in a hurry. Sit down, enjoy the conversations and get a great hair cut.

WOW! If you want a sushi experience like the one you tasted in Japan, Sakana is the place to go. Hands down, the most authentic sushi restaurant in Philly. You will eat pieces of fish here that no other Japanese restaurant in Philly will have. The selection and freshness of fish is hands down the best in the city. The Toro is the best I had since returning from my trip in Japan. Melt in your mouth experience. Every piece of fish here was top notch. Follow there instagram at philly_sakana to see their fresh fish. Uni was out of this world also. Highly Recommend the Sakana Omakasè chef's menu. It's a 20 course meal worth every penny.  I will be

Ah Jeni's Ice Cream!  Ice Cream was great here;  I was happy the weather was nice b/c we had to wait outside. Only one group at a time inside.  I get teh whole covid/distancing thing, but one group in a huge empty restaurant with four people behind the line.. it felt a little over the top to me.  The ice cream was great, but it may not hurt to be a little more welcoming and allow a few more people in at at time instead of having everyone stand on the sidewalk so one group at a time can go in.  Would still go back but only on a warm night.  I would not go in bad weather if I'm forced to stand outside again.

River Rock Alehouse is very bad food, wejust left there wasting good money on food that was 't worthy of being considered restaurant food.
The prime rib was tasteless, the fettucine was just bad and the pulled pork, was something pulled, but it certianly was not pork.  The cooks also seemed to have the exhaust hood blower turned off as we all left ans smelled like we stoked the line.  The only recommendation would be if your thirsty and have no other opitions you can get a beer,butsave your cash for food elsewere

I came here for a reception in the banquet hall. The first downfall is the lack of parking. It look 10 minutes just to find a parking spot. Then every course that I received had some kind of dead insect in it which was a HUGE turnoff! I sent so many dishes back and there were also flies flying around as I ate. The food was alright but I was extremely hungry so I can't truly judge. The only reason I rated a 2 star is because of the waiter named Marco who was very attentive and went out of his way to please me.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Ive only encountered friendly and helpful people at Grow and this branch is no exception. 
Having only one single ATM at this location is both puzzling and frustrating. Especially those occasions when the only one ATM has a problem or malfunction which seems to happen right about the time I come up to use it.  One example is when it was not taking cash deposits and there were no night depository envelopes left out so I had to drive to the nearest branch in New Tampa. 
But bottom line is even with the few frustrations I have every now and then this credit union is by far a much better experience overall than ANY bank.

This place is beautiful and clean inside. The decor is beautiful, as are the pedicure seats. The staff is polite and attentive. I had to wait about 20 minutes for a walk in appointment, which is pretty standard and I expected this. The selection of colors is lovely, and the staff is polite and attentive. I've gotten many gel manicures, and this one lasted about 25 minutes longer than usual. The quality also was worse than I expected. My gels started chipping within 3 days and by day 4 a whole nail had fallen off.

PHENOMENAL!!!!!! Bliss must have gotten a new chef because I ate there last night and I can't say enough about how amazing the food was!!!  Divine is a perfect description.  We sat at the bar and it couldn't have been better.  We had a quail egg salad, tortellIni special (which melted in my mouth), and the best crab cake I have ever eaten in my entire life!! All food came out hot and was executed perfectly.  The staff is best trained staff.  They are all so friendly and on point.  The bartender was great.  
I cannot say enough great things about Bliss!!

Avance needs a pie in the face. Give me a break w your bacon and egg. Who the F wants to eat foam eggs. The only thing decent about this place was the bread. After spending about $150 my husband and I went back to our neighborhood bar, cookies, ordered City Pizza, drank our drinks and were finally happy w our food. Btw my husband is a chef so we know when food is good and when restaurants are trying to make something out of nothing. Save your money and get a slice of pizza! The staff is extremely friendly and the food came out hot and efficiently.  Not their fault the restaurant is what it is!

Absolutely love the food here, and have eaten in their dining room many times, but tonight we made the mistake of ordering our meal to go.  A pretty simple order ... pizza, cheese garlic bread and a pork sausage sandwich.  I arrived about 30 minutes after placing the order, waited 10 minutes and they brought out the pizza.  But, I had to then wait another 30 minutes for the cheese garlic bread and sandwich and fries.  The fries were already cold and rubbery and the sandwich was served plain (after requesting lettuce and tomato).  We had to re-heat the pizza at home, discard the fries and dress up the sandwich.  Not a great experience ...

Wow! Friday, September 28, 2018, 12:15pm... $4 bottle of Tecate and a GENEROUS $1 tip... Ok! Louie's Bar or Nancy's Boondocks is a much better experience. Senior citizens welcome! Midtown Tavern is all about seniors... Good ole boys, spend that retirement money. Everyone else, enjoy your time of libations at Louie's or Nancy's!

Party Foul! Leaving a full bottle of Tecate! Can't stand the stagnant atmosphere and stale vibe of a jaded old bartender! The cook is upset because the patrons actually want their food cooked and clean... Wow!!!

I would normally give this restaurant a higher score (though not by much), however, I was very disappointed today. My daughter and I decided to go for lunch at Hikaru after checking their website to confirm they were open. It clearly read "open," the lunch hours listed as 12:00 to 2:30. We arrived at around 1pm, eager for our sushi lunch only to find the lights out and the door locked. Making matters worse, this was the second time we experienced this with Hikaru.  This, I would say, is bad business. With all the Japanese options in the city, my next sushi lunch will no doubt be somewhere else.

These guys are total weasels. So are the Jiffy Lube guys next door who said my reciept was worth half off at Royal. This still remains unclear what it actually is good for. For $45 incl. tax and tip  they did a job that didn't equal what my regular outfit up on speedway charges $20 for. They seem to have merely sent the car through the auto wash. I had to have them do the wheels, address the bird droppings still stuck on etc. They did do an awesome job on the upholstery though. 
They are unscrupulous, yet icky. Caveat emptor.

So, sushi at the casino, eh?  Could be an adventure!  Actually, it was quite good! I can't claim to be a sushi connoisseur, but I loved what I ate here!  Got a good tuna/salmon roll (Beautiful Girl) and some nigri sushi pieces. All of it was delish!  My only complaint was the octopus wasn't quite thawed from the cooler but it was still good, not chewy like it can be. And the prices are reasonable considering where we are. Service was great! And the Ching Tao is COLD!  Will definitely be back... Now if I can just find someplace to watch Monday Night Football...

They used to have a lunch special which was great.  As I recall you could get a Sonoran Hot Dog for about a buck fifty.  The first time we went there for that special we were really impressed.  This was in early 2012.

However.... and a big HOWEVER, things have changed.  We have been back for two dinners.  One in March of 2012 and again in October of 2012.  Very disappointed.  The portions were skimpy and the food tasteless.  

There are way too many other restaurants in town to waste time and money here again.

My husband and I needed a nice date night and we decided to try Luciano's after hearing from friends that it was legit Italian food... Well they were right! My husband and I fell on love instantly just thanks to the bread and oil/balsamic. We decided to splurge and get a bottle of wine and they had a great selection of local PNW wine. We also had to have  the caprese salad and it was amazing!! The portions are HUGE so we had leftovers for the next day lunches! If you're looking for a great date night try Luciano's!

Not very good. Service was good. Table side salsa was the best thing about this restaurant. I had the shredded beef chimi, my companion had chicken enchiladas. Both of us noticed the sauce seemed congealed - like it had been sitting for a while then put in a microwave. The sauce had very little flavor. I had been to the location on Prince Road before and absolutely loved it. But I won't return to this location. It did not seem any better than the Macayo's restaurant that had been there before but was more expensive. Big disappointment.

I really wanted pizza delivered to my house tonight. The last time I ordered pizza from this Magpies location was probably a year and a half ago. Always thought the pizza was great. The poor reviews recently made me think twice, but none of the higher rated pizza joints deliver to my area. So I took a chance. The pizza was delivered a half hour earlier than promised and tasted really good. Perhaps a bit more doughy than I would have preferred in a perfect world, but still stood up to the extra cheese I ordered. I will recommend this Magpies to my friends.

Ate here for lunch recently. The service was impeccable. The views/ambience lovely. I am a picky eater and was disappointed to see so many dishes featuring mushrooms or seafood which are both a no go for me though I know most people don't share 
my food issues. I ordered the pene with sausage baked with fontina cheese and it was divine! It was my birthday and I ordinarily would not have advertised that but another member of our party did and I was given complimentary tiramisu. I am not a great fan of tiramisu, but this was delicious! I am excited to try Vivace for dinner one of these days!

I have been renting from this location about a couple times a month for the past 3 years. I have NEVER had any problems with dings, scratches, etc. Every once in a while you'll get a car with a light smoke smell, they do their best to get it out, but what do you expect? There is always an idiot who decides to smoke in the rental. You can't just brush the smoke out! The customer service has ALWAYS been great, I've never had any issues whatsoever. I love coming here and won't go anywhere else for my rental cars. Thanks Enterprise in Doylestown!

I've been here a few months. The only perk is how conveniently close it is to my jobs. But I moved in with a room mate but they only gave us ONE key for the front "gate" and on top of that they changed the visitors code so you can't get in after hours and they decided not to inform us. The apartments have paper thin walls and crusty old wooden doors and appliances in the kitchen. They really need to do a major reconstruction on this place to better their image. Repaint the buildings and remodel the apartments. The least they can do.

Extremely disappointed. We order 3 entrees, soup, and dumplings. The soup was the worst hot and sour soup I have ever had. It was sweet not hot or sour and very grey looking. The noodles had no flavor and the dumplings were just super thick and soaked in grease. The only thing that I would eat again from there is the fried rice and egg roll. I would definitely  recommend driving me the 20 minutes to go to some place like China king in Oldsmar. It is disappointing to know there still isn't a decent Chinese takeout place in Clearwater.

Of all the pizza shops in my town this is one of the best. I have been coming here for years. The pizza is great and the staff is very friendly.

I normally get either Stromboli or the italian style cheese hot dog (my personal favorite). I'd recommend the Mozzarella sticks and the bruschetta. Also try the margarita pizza! Now I'm getting hungry.

The sauce is excellent... I am a big sauce fan so it's a deal breaker for me. I like my food well done and crispy and that has never been an issue for them to leave it sit in the oven for me. 

I didn't realize the had cannolis until I asked. YUM ;-)

In 2016 I was a guest of someone who had a membership.  Now 3 years later (November 2019) I am getting a letter from an attorney claiming I had an account at this location.

I never had any membership --- in fact, I only used this facility once as a guest then I had no interest since I was a student and school was my priority.  They hounded me nonstop to use their services until they got me on the phone in 2018 and I told them I am not interested in their services, plus by that time, I was already back in California.

RUN DON'T WALK FROM THIS COMPANY - THEY ARE LIARS!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We visit NOLA often but this was our first stay at this property. We knew we would be ok because of the Best Western brand.  But once you come through the doors it certainly doesn't look "Best Western" --- you are in a classic New Orleans hotel.  The front desk staff was super nice and very accommodating in allowing us an early check in.  The room was plenty large enough for the two of us and everything was very nice and clean.  It had quick Wi-Fi and we enjoyed the continental breakfast the next morning.  We will definitely make a return visit here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Bistro Albertino is a hidden gem. It is quaint and cozy. Everything is fresh and they use the highest quality in products. I had their special, their Bronzino fish and it was delicious. Their tiramisu was also very good and from what I recall, it is made in house. Our waiter was helpful and very cordial. I have been to this restaurant several times. I have many things from here and everything was yummy. If you love Italian food, or you want to try something authentic and fresh, come here. You will not be disappointed.

I've been debating on how many stars I wanted to give this Starbucks but I settled with 3 stars, since you can't do halves. This Starbucks has its really good moments and also really bad. First, the bad, about 50% of the time they give us the incorrect order, or give us someone else's order. This happens often during the drive through, I'm not sure if they are such in a rush they are sloppy about their work. However the good, the staff is always super friendly and happy to replace the items, however it becomes super annoying if you have to keep going back to get a replacement.

I have been to this nail salon many times and have always had a great experience. It's great because they have a Groupon. I usually buy the Groupon for the manicure and pedicure. Today I was told they changed the terms of their Groupon and I could only use one at a time. I originally was but then understood and politely paid with cash (which I received a discount for doing!!) Upon paying with cash the woman that was helping me tried to short change me $20!! Probably because she thought I was a college student who wouldn't know better. Disappointed in this.

This place was awesome I had to Seabass usually when I have Seabass is like a big hunk of fish with no skin on it this was a whole fish with the skin on it and that is the way I would preferred from now on my wife always gets fettuccine Alfredo with chicken she said it was amazing the only thing was the side of spaghetti that comes with the fish they need to rethink this and it was just plain Jane tomato sauce and noodlesIt wouldn't be that hard to make an amazing side dish with the fish was amazing and for only $26 usually when I get Seabass it's $35 -$40 definitely a great place to eat!

Horrendous attitude. I recommend going to the Pearle Vision on 15th b/t Walnut and Locust or elsewhere.

My insurance covers eye / contact exams, but the old blonde woman at the front desk insisted on arguing about it and refused to call the insurance provider hotline to clarify, even after I called the insurer myself and confirmed that this place is supposed to take insurance. 

The woman and another man got sarcastic with me and told me to go elsewhere and even compared getting contact lenses to buying drugs (what?)

Extremely lazy, impatient, unprofessional, and unfriendly. Was happy to take my business elsewhere.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I recieved a $25 pending charge for a 4 minute self serve car wash.
 Upon calling the location, a message advises this is a temporary hold by the cc co.. I think this should be reconsidered as it could cause issues for some people who have limited funds and this temporary hold could in fact mess up their account!!
 This is not a customer friendly tactic at all. The owner may want to consider another option as this could result in more hassle then it's worth IMO. What's wrong with the world still blindly using good old fashioned debt notes and play change???

It is convenient to my home, but nothing special.  The shellac manicure left thick run off edges around my cuticles.  What is worse though, they took advantage of my neighbor.  My neighbor took HIS 5 and 3 year old daughters to Happy Nails for manicures and a pedicures.  He didn't know the difference between a regular and a shellac manicure, but they sold him shellac two manicures for the five year olds and a pedicure with nail art for the three year old.  I don't even get shellac pedicures!  Shame on those techs for taking advantage of a good man just trying to treat his girls to a special day.  I won't go back.

Stayed 10/14/19
If I could give this place a MINUS rating I would!  We also want to mention if we could have found another place that accepted pets and if it weren't so late we would have left. Filthy dirty place!$ They put us in a room that was in the back building which you could see that they use for extra parts to fix the front building. The bed was comfortable and the sheets were clean minus the comforter (that was taken off). Everything else was falling apart, carpets filthy, stained furniture, peeling wallpaper, holes in the walls, rusted out fixtures.  
We are payed $98.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Great quality pizza! Fresh. As Dave Portnoy (owner of Barstool sports) would say, it doesn't droop. I do recommend eating it right then and there to maintain food aesthetic unless you want to reheat it when you get home but overall it's really good tasting stuff. I ordered a Cotto and a Regina. Both were really good choices. The only reason I'm giving this a 4 star review  though is because I feel that the prices were a bit expensive for 10" pizzas. Now you can make the argument where it's all about the quality but a few dollars here and there add up.

Tomato pie at its best.  It's the thin crust version.  Always fresh and tasty and they don't cut the pie in triangles!  The house salad is good if you like sesame seeds.  The toppings are delicious...thick cut pepperoni, sausage, vidalia onions, black olives...others, too.  Not a huge variety, but it's really good. Cash only.  You can get the pie with or without cheese.  They also have a white pie.  They have specials on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Sundays.  The family who owns it is very friendly.  It's a cute place, small and cozy or get take-out.  Never disappointed here.

My sister and I had a great experience at Forno Antico! First time being there.   We both ordered specials off the dinner menu. She had a seafood special that she couldn't stop raving about and I had veal special which was very good. Their calamari was fresh and their red sauce or gravy was delicious. We both wanted to use our bread to soak up the sauce it was that good. It's a byob so dinner with dessert ( tiramisu...delicious)for two was less than 80.00 in a beautiful atmosphere and being greeted by chef/owner!

Just when I thought I would never find a decent nail salon in STL a friend suggested this place, and now I have officially given up. Bare nails is the new polish! I will say this place seems to be clean and you can look out the window while in the pedicure chair. But the actual pedicure was a waste of money. The "massage" was just a weak tickle, they barely exfoliated the soles, and the polish is chipping off after three days. I was disappointed that they didn't polish the "tip edge" of my nails either. All for $27!!!

Both times I have used this hertz I have had a terrible experience. The staff here were slow and unprofessional, complaining about their personal lives and making mistakes that prolonged the process unnecessarily. I rented as a result of an accident and was upsold on insurance I did not need, given cars that were double the price I was quoted over the phone, and then made to feel like I was at fault for listening to them in the first place. Shame on me for being burned twice, but there will not be a third time.

The pizzas and garlic knots were really good. Very flavorful and the marinara sauce was tasty. All the food would have been much better if we would have known when it was delivered and it hadn't set outside until it was cold. We ask to be called upon arrival. Delivery person never knocked, or called. Probably would not order from these folks again. I understand businesses are struggling currently, this is not the time to disregard customer service. If the management team reads this, Please take the extra 30 seconds it takes to knock or call upon delivery. Thanks

Went in to get my hair dyed. Showed my stylist a picture of how I wanted it. It looked nothing like the picture. Asked for her to trim my hair and she ended up cutting so much off. It took everything in me not to cry. She blowdryed my hair mediocre and the end result looked like there was no effort put in. I had to go get it fixed at another salon. I tried to act happy as I left because I hate confrontation. It's also extremely overpriced. Everyone in the salon was on their phones and talking to each other. Super unprofessional.

The bald guy working rental car return is extremely rude and unprofessional. Dropping off a van and my mother was behind me in a car that belonged to sixt, the booth next to theirs. He starts screaming at her and threading her to have the police come and ticket and tow the car before asking any questions. They weren't in the way, the lot wasn't even close to full. Totally uncalled for. The same guy said he would email me my receipt and All he sent me was a blank email. Tried making a complaint and received an email the case was closed. Don't rent a car here. This is not how a business should be run

This is really the only semi-decent Chinese restaurant I have found in the Nashville area. The staff is wonderful. They treat you with such kindness and add extras (drinks, dessert) to the order for free alot of times when you come in to pick up and order. I have found many of the menu items to be hit or miss. My favorite is the sesame chicken, but they cut the chicken into tiny pieces, which makes it difficult to eat. I don't love the fried rice, but it is better than nothing. I most recently had the salty crispy chicken which was a little greasy and soggy.
