We took our kids here for our little boy (Seve's) 3rd birthday!!! Our server was John and he was ABSOLUTELY AMAZING!!! He made our visit a great one. He played with the kids and was super helpful, informative and accommodating!!! He made us feel very welcome!!! Our little boy was so happy that John sang Happy Birthday to him when he brought his dessert!!! Thanks so much for making us feel at home, we will definitely be back again!!! Food was great, atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the restaurant was clean!!!

This was really good.

First, the menu is different from the other Mexican restaurants in Bellevue. Sure, they have the usual suspects, but they also have creative new dishes.

My wife had something with chicken and bacon that was excellent. I don't see it on the online menu, so I can't tell you the name. Sorry.

I tried the Dinner Combo, which is so big it comes on two plates. The menu isn't clear that nearly all of the Combo items are beef. I'd substitute chicken in the enchilada or burrito next time, but that's just my taste. The food was excellent.

Nice dining room.

We'll definitely return.

I have to say I was extremely satisfied with my experience at this salon.  The prices are a bit higher than most, but they have 10 pedi and 10 mani stations, plenty of workers who actually speak to you and carry on a conversation,  and the deluxe pedi with chocolate mask was awesome ($30) and mani was very good ($12).  Han earned a great tip.  Most importantly,  she tore open a new set of nail implements for my service,  which is very important to me.  One infection from dirty nail tools will make this mandatory for you too.  I will be back! !

Nice atmosphere... Caesar Salad, very good - attractive presentation.  Margarita pizza, not very good.  Tasted like jarred sauce with a few pieces of basil thrown in top - nothing special.  But the main reason for the two stars was the $1.98 sharing charge when we did not ask for anything to be divided in kitchen nor did we ask for additional plates or silverware.  Will not patronize any restaurant that is so willing to gouge their customers with sharing charge. Leaves a bad taste that overwhelms the good salad.

I got a deluxe wash since we were selling our car and wanted a bit more than a regular wash. I was not happy that only one person was drying and he had to stop to dry all cars coming through after me. I felt I should have been told about this before I entered. There is nowhere to stand inside and it was cold outside. However, the owner happened to stop by and when I explained my issue, he gave me a nice refund and said he would instruct his staff to be more proactive with this type of information for customers. I will use again and hopefully the problems described by other reviewers will be resolved.

Great experience here on a recent quickie biz trip. Nice boutique-ish hotel w most of the amenities of a larger place but with the charm of a smaller one. Well-appointed rooms, thoughtful, efficient bathroom, and tasty, reasonable room service. Connor checked me in - and out - and, unlike most lodging places, seemed genuinely happy and eager to help. Helped bookend a nice stay well. Only downside: It is in a bit of a college-student drinking area, so there was an instance of um, happy, people yelling on the street.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Seriously, what is the magic "window of time" to get a fresh pizza from here?!  Every time I order a take out pizza, it's painfully obvious that it's not fresh!  It's been one sitting under the heat lamps for slices and I just happen to be the sucker who calls at the wrong time and they just give me the "slice" pizza that hasn't been touched yet!  But today they topped that!!!  I got a cold pizza with a slice that obviously didn't fit in with the rest of the pizza.  So steal a slice from one pizza and put it mine to make it "whole"??  REALLY?!  For almost $20 for a margherita pizza, that's messed up.  Cold, stale, sucks.

Pictures are awesome.  The pizza is just okay. The cheese pizza definitely needed another 30 seconds in the oven and could have used less tomato sauce & little more cheese . The margarita pizza was ok but definitely not what I would expect in a margarita pizza in my 40 years experience in tasting pizza from all over . It was just another cheese pie with the more cheese lots of salt  and tomato chucks spread over in lumps. Staff are wonderful so I'll definitely try again just in case it was an off day for the cook and I'll let you know.

Delicious and HUGE sushi rolls.  The service was less than stellar but the rolls made up for it.  Mom and I got the soft shell crab, rock n roll, Alaskan, and the Caterpillar roll.  I personally didn't like the Alaskan roll because of all the roe that was on it and it was too big to eat in 3 bites let alone one.  The soft shell crab was to die for as was the Caterpillar (my personal favorite).  All of that was too much for us to eat and regrettably we couldn't take the leftovers with us because we were going shopping.  Definitely will be going back.

Had breakfast this morning. My meal was bad and service was non-existent.  Don't get the pancakes...crispy on the outside, tasteless on the inside.

Front end of the restaurant needs a manager. Back end needs a good cook. No one to greet you, take you to a table, take your check or ask you how the experience was. Seems like everyone is running around but nothing getting done. Plus, meal took forever to come. 

The décor is nice with old elements from the general store it use to be. Big bright windows and outside seating. 

Will try one more time in a couple of months...hopefully it will have improved.

Overall okay. The return policy is odd. 

My Aussie guest rented a car a week ago (and paid) for his return trip to LAX ($40). We then considered that we might drive to LA, go to the LA Art Museum and then drive to LAX (his flight is at 11:00 PM). 

However, even with a 5-day beforehand request to cancel the car rental ... the cancellation fee is $50. So, we decided to pick-up the car and then immediately return it. Problem is, we can't get the car until 2:00 PM ... so the plan got goofed-up. 

$40 to rent the car, $50 to cancel the car (5-days before pick-up). Odd.

They are clueless as to style and customer service. They got two stars because the cleaning aspect is good. The problem is they sent back my entire wardrobe with pleats. Everything from summer time shorts to expensive suits are now creased and pleated. Not sure the last time I saw shorts or casual jeans pleated, but Earl's managed to do it. Awful customer service to put hard pleats in someone's clothes when they did not ask for it and not a single piece of their clothing had a pleat when dropped off. If you use Earl's, you must specify even the simplest of details.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
This was my first time trying Linda Jean's. It was 10:00pm on a Fri night and I was looking for a local place that delivers something other than pizza.  Because of some of the reviews I didn't know what to expect. 
I was very pleasantly surprised.
I ordered and paid online and less than 30 minutes later the food was at my front door.
My hot roast pork sandwich with spinach and provolone was hot and flavorful, the roll was crisp and the accompanying sweet potatoe chips were a nice touch.
My salad and onion rings were also good.
I will definitely try again, maybe eat in next time.

Probably the worst Hilton property in the St. Louis metro area, but if you're in the Hilton Honors program the breakfast is probably free and pretty good. But watch out for wet carpets, some very good staff but others who are awful, wrecked elevators from all the family reunions they book on the weekends, wrecked door locks on the rooms that will cause housekeeping to leave your room unlocked, and broken toilets and showers. If it wasn't one of the least expensive properties, it would have shut down a long time ago.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I just don't understand the hype... went back a second time to make sure I wasn't unfairly judging it off of one visit.  The sauces on the dishes are extremely bland and the chicken tasted like it was old and boiled or poached. It truly confuses me how people rave about such a tasteless and unimpressive place; then again, we love our locals. I will say the brie was among the best I've ever had though... unfortunately I wasn't there for just the brie. The Hawaiian-looking gentleman with the long hair was probably the most polite and well informed server I've ever had, giving them 3 stars instead of the 2 that it tasted like.

Unfortunately I work until five-thirty, and this branch closes at six. As a working stiff myself I understand that everyone wants to go home, but by the time I get there, the line is always five people and thirty minutes long because everyone has cashed out fifteen minutes early so there is only one teller left open. I would like them to a bit more professional, suck it up, and provide decent customer service until close. As I haven't made it here outside of that time, I can't comment on how there service is other times.

One of my favorite places! I have been coming to T.I. For about 30 years, and staying at Residence Inn for the last 7 years or so. It's pricey but it's also comfortable, clean, the staff is awesome. I love that fresh clean smell when you walk into your room. The pool is a bit small but the beach is right there. One down side: it's pet friendly which is great for me and my four-legged baby. But that's about it. They allow you to bring your pets but there's nothing else. Since pets can't stay in pool area I wish there was some nice chairs and picnic area to hang out. But that's not a deal breaker. I still will stay there pooch and all!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Sat on the patio, which is nice.  Basically the place is OK, but over-priced.  Menu includes some pizzas ($11 and up) and gourmet dishes ($24 - $45 and up).  The food was good but over-priced because it didn't knock our socks off for the price.  The service also was kinda blah.  Slow to get our drink order in, then we had two different waitresses try to tell us the specials.  Didn't get to really check out the wine selection.  Next trip.  The place looks great.  Interesting concept, hope they can start kicking butt and be around for awhile.

Terrible experience. When we arrived we were greeted with large groups of teens in the parking lot and in front of the hotel. When we got off the elevator on our floor there was a strong smell of marijuana and random people standing in the hall. We went to the end of the hall where our room was and there was a 5 gallon bucket in the middle of the hall with water leaking into it. We then went into our room and discovered that it was directly over the pool. It was EXTREMELY loud and it was open until 10:30. We used booking.com to book this hotel and I will never trust their reviews again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We placed a rather large order for curbside pickup. It was expensive. The chicken wings were pretty good. The three pizzas were just average, fairly flavorless; frozen Organic pizzas from Sprouts are so much better.  The calamari was terrible--way over done and more breading than calamari. We threw it out after tasting it.  One of the servers we saw was wearing a face shield without a face mask beneath it. CDC does not recommend the use of face shields as a substitute for masks. We will never go back or order from this restaurant.

We decided to try this cafe after reading good reviews on yelp. A nice, casual cafe with very good food that we were surprised to find! Getting our meal took a while and my second tamale was needing to be freshly made which was then forgotten, that I no longer was really wanting it, but the flavors of most all items are great. We liked most the Mexican slaw, red chile beef tamale, green chile chicken tamale, and the red salsas (the green one was almost perfect!) The music choice was quite surprising. Those with kids or older people probably won't appreciate it. I would definitely return for the food!

I ordered the brat sandwich. The roll was fresh and had poppy seeds. The brat was tasty but small, too small, the size of a hot dog. If I didn't have the macaroni salad for a side I would have left hungry. I also ordered the lodge draft beer. It was a hoppy red, again nothing special. While perusing the menu I saw salmon and New York strip for $25 each. Better off at Texas Roadhouse for $15. The service was also prompt and good. The big bummer was fruit flies. Lots of fruit flies. On my beer and food. Not a good sign for cleanliness in the kitchen. Bottom line, typical pub fare, nothing special, the fruit flies will keep me from returning.

My professional stylist did an amazing job of making my first visit a good one. I would give it 5 stars but the acrylic dust from the next booth wafted over...to each it's own!

Conveniently located in Roxborough with lots of parking, I would gladly travel from Chestnut Hill to get a weekly mani/bi-weekly pedi because of the friendly service, clean, bright cheery environment and fabulous hot stone leg massage. And for just $38!  They even have a frequent visitor card that offers discounts and incentives. 

This is a little gem that I am convinced will attract fellow "hillers."

i came in for a pedi, and my daughter came along for a full set.  one girl did a fine job with my pedi (didn't get her name), but tracy did my daughter's full set and didn't even trim or push back her cuticles.  also the pedi price was higher than stated, but i didn't get the deluxe pedi treatments.  i tipped VERY well because i paid after my pedi was done, before my daughter's nails were done. i was trying to be nice since they had reopened recently after Covid restrictions were lifted, but I learned my lesson.

The now owners have really screwed up the service. It was great until Grand Cleaners came a few months ago. I took some shirts and pants for a total of $46, and honestly the shirts came more wrinkled that before I took them in. I will have to iron them myself or take them elsewhere. If you are opening a business in Cool Springs and are charging premium prices then please be sure to do your job correctly. We don't need another mediocre service. You will soon see as your business goes belly up from poor service and another one takes your place. Good bye Grand Cleaners...
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
I have been going to Wilson's for 5 years and I have never met a more honest group of people in the auto business. I have both a Toyota and Honda and they have serviced them exclusively. Wilson and Sid are great to deal with, professional with very fair pricing.

Frankly if you hear otherwise, it is because these are not long time customers or have had a one off experience. Even then, I know that Wilson goes to extreme lengths to make it right. They truly believe in customer service.

Highly recommended from someone with high expectations!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I chanced upon this friendly pizzeria while getting some gelato in the fine new store next door. Angie waited on me and was friendly and welcoming. After plying me with some surprisingly good Pinot Noir, she Introduced me to the menu. They have a varied menu with a wide variety of salads to start with. The pizza I ordered was excellent. The crust was thin and crisp, the cheese proportional and the vegetables were loaded as toppings. Exquisite food served in a great ambience. I would highly recommend it for an excellent meal in a casual atmosphere.

Cool environment and good service, no complaints whatsoever there! Sushi was less than impressive though. Not much flavor, not against going back if I'm ever in town but will avoid the sushi and go a different route on the menu. Generally I will give it a second try in case it was just a bad choice on my part. This wasn't the case, I got two rolls and chose one that is usually my go to and serves as a good comparison to food back home. For what I paid, the rolls were small, lacked creativity, and quality taste.

Decided to try this place for my solar nails. The lady was nice, took her time shaping my nails and asked me if it looked okay which I liked. Some salons just do whatever they want. 

Two things I didn't like though. The nail file was black but you could barely tell with all the white buildup. (Unsanitary?) The file didn't work too good but she kept using it. I had to re-file the sides of my nails at home. 

Also, the nail brush by the hand sink wasn't sitting in that blue liquid, I think it keeps bacteria away. It was sitting on a towel so I didn't use it for sanitary reasons. I gave them 3 stars because of the unsanitary issues.

Tried to book a block of rooms and a bridal suite here for my wedding next year.  Called and spoke with Nolan and he was very nice-I reserved the rooms and he said he would be sending a contract my way.  I waited two weeks and never got anything.  I called back and spoke with his assistant as he was on vacation.  She looked in the system and couldnt even find my info.  She insisted she was putting a note on his desk to call me the Monday he returned from vacation.   It's been months and I've heard nothing.  I booked with Aloft--they are SO nice!! Ashame to lose business on 20+ hotel rooms..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have gone here numerous times to get hoagies as well as to order hoagie/sandwich platters for parties and family gatherings. I have never been disappointed and inevitably get asked by at least one person where I got the hoagies. Most recently we got an assortment of hoagies for Father's Day. The quality was exceptional. We had leftovers and usually I don't care for hoagies that are a day old but American Family Market's hoagies are the exception. As another reviewer stated this place is a hidden gem. BTW Gina was super nice and helpful with our order.

Being a native of the area I've been to a lot of the pizza places. Fortels is one of the best, it isn't a flashy place but the pizza is great and fresh! They never skimp on the toppings and sauce and the thin crust is absolutely perfect! It's greasy but in a good way and you will never walk away sick! 

The silverware is cheap but clean the restaurant is clean the tables are clean and the drinks are good! No loud music just sports on the tv and you can enjoy conversations without talking over the music. No servers to bug you either everything is seat yourself. 
 
Great pizza place with none of the fluff!

Love the doctor, but he needs to reconsider his office and staff. Have called 40 times (according to my phone) in the past week during their business hours and they never answer their phone. Message box is full so you can't leave a message but it doesn't matter because they said they don't listen to them anyway. 
Have horrible hours and will close during business hours whenever they don't feel like coming in. Even though the doctor is cheaper than other vets and is friendly, go spend a couple more bucks at a vet office that actually WANTS your business.

sad

Staying in the just reopened Hyatt Regency in NOLA.  Brand new amenities and lobby, very nice.  Nice people working at the hotel.  They have a Starbucks which is nice and all the furnishings are brand new (hotel has been closed since Katrina).  Rooms are small - nothing more to say, but they are small.   Similar size to what one would expect in New York.  Location is great to the dome, lousy to the French quarter.  $10 cab ride to Jackson Square.  Happy to see the hotel open, and price was attractive, but would probably look elsewhere next time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Bad experience and I won't go back to give them another chance. I am a frequent sushi eater and I often drive up to Tempe because, quite frankly, Tucson does not have good sushi spots. Anyway, my first time here I was excited when I saw the rather large looking nigiri. Then, I tried the tuna and immediately was overcome with a fishy taste and oily texture. Not good. I lifted the tuna off the rice and saw a sticky residue and also noticed a red tinge to the rice. Gross. I showed the owner and he insisted that the fish was fresh, but did say that I didn't have to eat it. They also use way too much rice in their nigiri. Not good.

Went here once before and like most of the other reviews, this place is mediocre at best. Went again and and left before we ordered. The "waiter" brought the chips out in one hand and had a dirty dishrag in the other. I asked for the spicy salsa for my chips and was rudely told to dump hot sauce into the salsa my wife and kids were going to eat.  I've gotten spicy salsa here before and any other Mexican restaurant btw. We should have known something is up with this place since it was empty and it has already changed names once. Mexican restaurants are a dime a dozen around so do yourself a favor and go somewhere else.

We were out on a conference and wanted to get something quick to eat. As we walked in, the lady at the front yelled at us, making us feel unwelcome. They were out of ham, white bread, Italian herb bread, and flatbread, and they no longer have the personal pizzas. The staff acted like we were a great disservice to them, and they rushed us along like animals. As we left, we went to talk to some of our friends in the back dining space, and we saw 4 roaches climbing around the wall. The health department needs to inspecting this place before someone gets seriously ill.

I was here two weeks ago for a gel mani and it held up great. Went back for another gel mani and a regular pedi. They were packed and the girls were rushed. My girl did not put a top coat on my pedicure, I thought she would when she got done my manicure. She was moved to another customer. I told the guy who had me when I was finished that I didn't get a top coat on my toes, the girl who worked on me first got defensive and said she did put it on. I was sent out without a top coat and when I got home to put my own top coat on I realized she also didn't cover my full nail with polish on 3 of my toes. Will not be going back here in the future.

I am definitely not the type of person that leaves reviews for places, but I wanted to for this Starbucks! I come in here to do homework every now and then and the employees are always super friendly and kind to everyone! They always try to keep the tables clean when they have downtime. They take the time to ask you how you actually spell your name, ask you how you're doing and have a legit conversation with you (which may not be important to some people but it is to others). I just appreciate their kindness!

This place used to be out standing, but now they have all new staff who seem to have never been taught how to do their job. Also very rude people. Everytime I order from here my drink is not even filled to the top and it is ALWAYS made wrong. There is ALWAYS about a quarter left empty in the coffee. Wtf. I paid for a venti and y'all cant FILL THE CUP?! It is now to the point where I do my best to avoid coming to this star bucks, or I will go to the dunkin close by. Seriously, wtf is going on. I hate to sound like a karen, and Im all for benefit of the doubt, but its happened at least five times now. Do better.

My experience at Autohaus was amazing. On a trip back from the Central coast and heading to San Diego, my water pump went out on my Dodge sprinter. I stopped off in Santa Barbara and luckily found Brian at Autohaus. He shuffled his projects around to accommodate me and start on my van the very next morning. I showed up at 830 in the morning and Brain had all the parts waiting for me and started in right away. Only a couple hours later, my van was ready and on the road back to San Diego. I was so thankful to have found this shop and Brian is a great mechanic with fair prices.

Can't beat the view.  Especially at sunset, but you won't be seated on the deck unless you order dinner.  Service was above average but I can't say that for the food.  It wasn't bad, but just average.  I had grilled Mahi and it had a texture that makes me believe it was previously frozen, not fresh.  I'm from Florida and have eaten Mahi enough to tell the difference.  The live band and the atmosphere made the average food worth it.  Had to remember this is a hotel restaurant in the Holiday Inn, so maybe my expectations were a bit too high.

Always loved Concetta's. Always recommended it. Not sure I can do that after tonight's visit. Ordered Beef Arcobasso. (Always been the best thing on the menu) but tonight things went really wrong. I ordered the Beef Arcobasso medium rare. Instead of a piece of 8 oz. beef, I was served 2 separate skinny pieces of meat stacked on top of each other and cooked well done. Never happened before. Asked the 17 year-Old server if I could try it differently - he said no, that's how it's served. ( it was never served like that before) and if that's how it's served, I'll never be back again. Really disappointed.

Shark fin antenna cover came off during car wash. Noticed it was missing when I got home. Went back to get it and the manager told me about a disclaimer  excusing them of any responsibility for the shark fin damage. Mine not only came off but was damaged as well. it was obvious they didn't care. It would be a good idea if an employee there would notice this 'shark fin ' problem before heading into the wash system(I'm not the first one to have one damaged in a car wash)and call it to the attention of the car owner. But judging from the attitude I doubt that would ever happen. I guess they work in a car wash for a reason.

Vacated property 7/21/17. Have not received initial deposit of $600. Left apartment immaculately clean. Despite emails and phone messages, have not received any correspondence. Did receive message from staff that manager is 'new' and 'behind'. Manager was at office when phoned & she refused to speak with me. This is the third manager in 2 years. Also, left messages at their corporate location in Tennessee and no response.
Maintenance is wonderful and the apartments are bright, tech friendly and comfortable. You can hear every noise including running dogs from apartment above. Would't classify as 'luxury apartment' yet you pay the price of one.

Made a reservation for our traditional New Year's Eve dinner at Bernini's in YBor - 4th Year. They were not as busy as past years and our server seemed to have the most tables taking her away from good service. I ordered the Osso Bucco, one of my favorite things on the menu. The Osso Bucco looked delicious, but was ice cold with actual ice in the center of the meat. It was easy to lose an appetite. The server and manager made it right, but it definitely put a damper on the evening. Was our first bad experience and may be our last.

Rick's is the best restaurant in Lambertville.  Consistency, character, service and quality are all there and the charm of this non-pretentious spot fits the vibe of the town perfectly.  The menu, while simple, is executed so well and the specials I've had have been equally great.

I've never had anything other than an awesome meal.  Go there on a cold night, bring a bottle (or two) of wine and indulge on awesome Italian.

Sometimes it's tough to get a table, which is the only downside but is also the sign of a great restaurant.

Ugh. I should have been more skeptical of a PJ Wehlihan's owned establishment which tries to pass for a fine dining experience. Food and service were mediocre and not worth the price.

Quick rundown that turned the stomach.

GIANT dried lugie hanging in the bathroom. That thing had to be there for at least 3-5 days. Its right at eye level in the men's room. Gross.

Hair in our bread basket

Fly in my water. After I discovered it, I put the glass off to the side and was waiting for our server to come over to discuss, and someone came by, refilled the glass, and was off.

First, the good. The rate was good and the cars are at the airport.

Now, the not so good.
Waited in line for almost an hour to be processed. Had the hard sell put on me, with the harsh warning that I needed a gas receipt within 5 miles of the airport, so I paid for them to refill the gas tank. I do not enjoy this kind of pressure on vacation, and this lady was a pro.

The car had some wear and tear on the exterior. I later found out that the back seat was quite dirty and should have been cleaned before we rented it. 

If we fly into Tampa again, I will consider other rental companies over Alamo.

What a dysfunctional hotel. Stayed here because a wedding I was attending blocked rooms off for guests. I called early on the morning of check-in, explaining that my boyfriend was the brother of the bride, & could we get an early check-in. They say yes, room would be ready at 11 am. Get here at 12:45 pm, & not a single room was ready. They finally got us something by 1:30 pm, leaving us 30 minutes to get ready. Then, we come up to the room after the wedding, & the key doesn't work. Go downstairs, come up, key still doesn't work. So annoyed. Never again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I flew into Nashville on Friday, December 20... Feben Y. was at the Alamo car pickup area and was absolutely delightful.  She wouldn't take "no" for an answer on whether I needed help or wanted an extra water.  She was the epitome of southern hospitality.  She represents your brand well and is an amazing "welcome wagon" for your customers who are road-weary having flown in to visit Nashville.  Particularly with all the local airport construction, her positive attitude and helpfulness really stood out as a cheerful highlight in the midst of a lot of "grunge" and started me off on the right foot to go see my family for the holidays.

I am so happy with the service, quality, and pricing at Visionworks in Cool Spring Galleria.  Brandon is my new favorite eyewear provider.  He has helped me with four pairs of glasses now, and I do not intend to go to anyone else. There are discounts available for older folks that help tremendously - ask or look for coupons before you go. 
Also, the thoroughness of the optometrist was amazing.   I thought - a mall doctor?? but then I received a careful exam and thorough explanation of everything.  I recommend Visionworks to all my friends and family.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This place is fantastic, great food, atmosphere, wine list, etc. BUT they do not post current menu's online (it's 2014...um) and the only way to access them is to have them FAX it to you. Who has a fax machine anymore? I asked if they could email but they said they didn't have a scanner. They should at least have a Facebook page where they can post the daily menu, for those who would like to pick up their meal. Otherwise everything here is perfect just please post your daily menu online somewhere (restaurant website, twitter, Facebook, etc.) please.

I am updating my review. I dropped my car off this morning to get inspected. I then get a call telling me my check engine light is on (it definitely wasn't on before I dropped it off). They told me that the thermostat is bad and needed to be replaced, costs around $700. I refused and will be taking my car elsewhere. 

When you leave your customer with a feeling that they've been ripped off, there is no coming back from that. I had been taking all 3 of my cars here for the past 5 years. I'll never be coming back.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I ate here for dinner one night and the food was good. Howeer, the attitude I got from the staff was rude. When I entered the dining room it was 3/4 empty. The waiter wanted to seat me at a two top against the wall, and I wanted to sit at a four top as they weren't busy. He wasd not going to allow that! Then when I went to leae, I asked them to phone for a ab. The waiter asked the bartendeer to do this. She gae me all kinds of attitude een though she only had 2 or 3 people at the bar. The food is not good enough to put up with this really poor attitude!

I was impressed.  The young woman who was there gave us a tour and brief description of how everything worked, because we had not been there before.

She then let us sample the flavors.  I was impressed with all I tried.  The blackberry, cheesecake, and red velvet flavors were right on.  The topping bar was also impressive.  Candy bar bits, chocolate chips, mints, fruity pebbles (this surprised me), and beautiful fresh fruit.  

A delicious place for dessert in town.  Well worth the price and I will definitely be back for more.

Okay, my phone is dying so I'll be quick. I'm saying everything straightforward. The food is decent, it has my approval. Although, the service is okay and the wait for the food is SUPER SUPER SUPER SUPER SUPER SUPER SUPER long. I think I spent 1 hour waiting and half an hour eating. The fish-rice ratio overall is nice. That's all I have to say pretty much. I have some mixed feelings about this place and I might not come back. There's that one time out of the blue that I'll come back. But otherwise, I most likely won't be a usual customer here

Okay, my phone is dying so I'll be quick. I'm saying everything straightforward. The food is decent, it has my approval. Although, the service is okay and the wait for the food is SUPER SUPER SUPER SUPER SUPER SUPER SUPER long. I think I spent 1 hour waiting and half an hour eating. The fish-rice ratio overall is nice. That's all I have to say pretty much. I have some mixed feelings about this place and I might not come back. There's that one time out of the blue that I'll come back. But otherwise, I most likely won't be a usual customer here.

This place is small and you could almost miss it! They have an unusually large amount of items on the menu to look over. I didn't know there were so many different sushi combinations! The lighting was rather dim, so it took me a few minutes to read the items. I had the vege fried rice, Tofu garlic & peppers, and Thai Style tofu. All were very good. The fried rice was very tasty even with brown rice! The garlic noodles were nice and spicy, just like I expected, and had lots of veges. The Thai Style tofu was also good. You get a lot of food for the price and service was quick and friendly!

I've called 10 times over 45 minutes. Let it ring until it automatically disconnected me for excessive rings. Went online to place an order, and the big Imo's website set me up with a different Imo's for delivery. Figured they must have folded among the pandemic. Drove by, pulled in, and a guy standing in the parking lot on his cell phone said he was talking to them at that moment and they were open. I've called five more times since then, no answer. I don't know what their problem is, but they're not going to survive this way. Not in this neighborhood.

My son and I were in the hunt for a Chicago style pizza while in town last night and thought this was a Rosati's location due to the confusing Yelp information.  We were wrong, but glad we gave it a shot anyway.  We ordered the Chicago Monster and the guy that took our order said we would like the homemade sauce due to the fresh tomatoes.  He was right.  The pie was thick and full of cheese, sausage, pepperoni and veggies.  The rust at the center got soaked through with juice and grease, but that happens a lot with Chicago pies.  Nonetheless, it was a good pick.

Wow I am so glad my husband decided to try this place! The food was excellent! The service was good, however they only have one guy making the food and taking orders. Strange. It makes for a long dining experience, but he did very well and my husband won't shut up about the place LOL!

My only complaint (and I let this slide on the rating) was there was one other girl there "working," but from what I can tell she was just walking around doing nothing, and was VERY disrespectful to another customer who had a concern about her side. Not sure why she is even getting a paycheck there!

Delivery time was good for a Friday night. Took my order fast and correct. Prices are very good. I haven't eaten here in 3 years, the food was a lot better then. They have not updated the online menu. I eat my food but I'm not saving anything for later. Got a salad with bread bowl which was not fresh. I didn't eat the bread it was horrible. The salad was ok, lettuce wasn't the best because it had a lot of big pieces like stem. The fries where just warm, mozzarella stick were smashed together. Everything was eatable except the bread bowl.

Been going to this establishment everytime we visit Indianapolis. This April, went there again. Not much changed in terms of decor or service but some dishes were disappointing. I ordered as appetizer softshell crab. What I got was 4 globs of oily fried batter where it was hard to know how much of it was actual crab. The sashimi is still great and on another visit had Chirashi. Still very good quality with right amount of sushi rice and variety of raw seafood. Wanted to try their famous Sakura Roll but was too full. Next time. Maybe the softshell crab was a glitch?

This hotel got all of the extra niceties right: Great pool, hot tub, basketball court; free social events with food and drinks M-W, free shuttle, goody bag for elite mbrs, breakfast was pretty good for being free. 
Unfortunately, the hotel failed at a lot of the basic hotel things: uncomfortable bed, loose shower handle, clogged tub drain, broken TV remote. Out of fairness to the hotel, I did not report any of the above so they didn't have a chance to correct any of it. Finally, the location is not a short distance to any nice hangout area, more like the business district.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Their website claims they opens at 11am. I drove by and saw a girl waiting to get in for a interview at 11am. I walk inside at 11:10 and ask if they are open. Owner says yes about 1130ish. I told him that is not what his website says and he asks me what I want to eat. I told him the rabbit. He tells me they haven't had that on the menu in a while and the menu is updated all the time. That is the first thing I looked at before I left the house. He didn't seem real concerned whether I ate there or not. Now, I am not sure either.

We finally decided to try this place and regretted it. The salsa was water thin, no pieces of tomato at all. We both ordered Arroz con Pollo. Let me preface by saying this is my favorite Mexican dish no matter where we go but this was awful. My chicken had no grilled flavor and the rice was just white rice. I only ate half and didn't take the rest home. If anybody wants an excellent Arroz con Pollo go to El Meson. We both ordered water but our bill was more than it should have been. The price on the board was $9.99 but our bill was $23.96.  We won't be back ever. Taco Bell is better than this.

I don't usually write reviews, but we had an unusual experience that I wanted to share.  We were in Nashville with our young grandkids for the weekend, and based on the good reviews, we ordered pick-up.  The order and pick-up went smoothly and the food tasted quite good.  However, after dinner, all of us experienced extreme thirst, drinking multiple glasses of water.  The 2 year old woke up several times at night, crying for water, which never happens.  We were fine the next day.  Not sure what was in the food - msg perhaps?

Tonight's visit left me wondering if proper training was provided. 
Doesn't seem right to me that the manager would say that the shake machine is broken so what I can do for you is give you free coupons versus just returning your money

When I got home with the sandwiches, they were crushed.  Looked like someone stepped on them to smash them. 

The soda machine was overrunning onto the floor from the overfill tray.  

Yes they are new, yes Riverview needs more restaurants but how many people will just not come back when this is your first this impression.

This is my FAVORITE restaurant. Every dish I have tried has been excellent. The ingredients are locally sourced and fresh. This restaurant is on par or better than the best restaurants in Philly, but there is far less traffic, parking nightmares, and pretentiousness at Maize. The biscuits that come out to the table are the best I've ever had and the popcorn is awesome too. To top it all off, its a BYOB!  Every time I have been to Maize I have been there for 2 hours or longer, it is definitely not where I would go if I am looking for something quick.

This location never ceases to amaze me with their incompetence.  Used the app to do a curbside pickup to make customized order a little easier.  The custom ordering was ignored and they forgot a 10-piece nugget.  EVERY other fast food place in or around O'Fallon can get it right except for this horribly run location.  Nashville and Freeburg make McD's taste like gourmet meal compared to this travesty.  Owner should really do something, but won't because it's always been like this.  Go next door to Dairy Queen for quality food.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: My husband and I haven't been to CTO for years because we have a place closer to home. But one night, on a whim, I decided to get some food from CTO to compare it to our new place.  The woman that helped me was super nice! But the food was not good! Granted by the time I got home, it was no longer hot, but that is no the fault of the restaurant. We orderd an appetizer sampler and some beef and broccoli. I ate some of the appetizers, they were average. But the beef and broccoli was inedible. The beef tasted funny. I guess we will stick to the place closer to our house.

I have been a Black card member for 2 yrs. In the last 3 months it has gone down terrible. The people are very friendly but the place is a mess. It use to be so clean. Now there is cobb webs in the corners the bathrooms are filthy. I ran a paper towel on one of the machines it was disgusting. And the tanning beds are very old. I go to a lot of Planet Fitness around the USA and these beds are the worse. Please get the cleanliness level back. And look into getting some new or newer tanning beds.
Thank you 
Linda
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Took my car here for seemingly simple task to change my oil. Ended up they stripped my drain plug and I had to purchase a new one myself. Extremely condescending to anyone who isn't a man and explained to me for about 10 minutes why I need to rotate my tires (I know why I need to and have done this recently). Would not recommend going here if you don't want to have them mess up your car and talk to you as if you've never driven a vehicle in your life when they can't even properly change oil. Also, expect to wait at least 2 hours regardless of if you make an appointment.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Poor Nico's. 

85% chance you will not get what you ordered

50% chance they will take your name and promise a free replacement on your next order.

100% chance when you ask for your free replacement - they don't know you, and you're not on a board.  You're scammed and will pay again.. With..

85% chance you still will not get what you ordered.

It's like the song.. "There's a hole in the bucket dear Henry, dear Henry"...  

The food is good.. But what a mess getting a family order correct and complete!  Not gonna happen!

I have used this location on multiple occasions.    The customer service is usually very good.    Occasionally when they are busy it may take a little time to get waited on but it is obvious they are working with other customers or completing paperwork.   The cars are normally clean when I get into one the gas is generally full or close to it.   Only downside is the addl. insurance required to protect yourself in case of an accident.   It can double the price of the rental.    I would imagine other rental car companies have similar charges for the same protection though.    All in all I have had good experiences with this location.

I'm new to the area as well. This place is not at all what it apparently once was. The owner is not there any longer. I'm told he is more involved with his bar business downtown. The beer is gone. The barbers are two women, middle and late middle aged. When I came in the only other customer was a women getting her hair done.I can't complain about the haircut I got. Scissor cut and eyebrows trimmed without asking. My point is that this is not the " man's barber shop" that others have said. The really good news is it's right next door the the truly wonderful El Cap!

Had lunch here, there were only a couple other tables occupied but it took nearly 40 minutes for our entree to be served. The sushi was "meh", not bad but I'd had better luck elsewhere around town. The interior and atmosphere was very nice and comfortable, and they have a large menu with many options for those who may want a grilled habachi alternative to typical sushi restaurant. The servers may be hit-and-miss, ours did not seem too great (maybe newer, or language barrier) but I overheard one of tables over that seemed to be doing a lot better job, explaining the specials and making recommendations.

What is happening.  Use to go several times a month.  Really enjoyed it.  But the last two times poor service,  just had a very bad expeience again.

Went to have a nice dinner with the family. We got seated they served some garlic rolls and then after ten minutes without and additional service had to ask for water.  Food was fair.  When I went to pay the cashier asked how everything was.  I kindly explained the service was bad and the food fair.  They did not say  anything,  no apology ,  just a "oh."

Time to find another local Italian restaurant  for dinner with the family.

Miss the old Basile's,  what happened?

So my fiancee and I went to Dettera for Valentine's Day because their menu online looked really good. However, when we got there, we found out there was only a price fixe dinner (even though there were no advertisements on the web), and we weren't allowed to order from the regular menu. That fact wasn't bad, but the server was a snot, couldn't pour a beer correctly (most of it overflowed and the beer was more expensive than most of the wine listed), she couldn't be located half the night, etc.

The food was really good, although the pricing should be adjusted (market vegetable salad was price-comparable to a side dish with caviar).

I have read through some reviews and try to be fair on my end. The sushi rolls are fine. Sashimi is warm during my visit too. We only ordered salmon sashimi, it was a safe choice. Nothing much is weird except the temp. The tofu in the tofu soup is a bit sour. I suspect that they have left them in there for too long. But after reading the review of one with roach floating in his soup. I definitely felt better. It's a mediocre place. I don't get all the five stars and I certainly think it doesn't deserve an one star too. Just a place to try out when you are running out of ideas.

I decided to stop in for pizza as I walked to the train station.  I was starving and looking for a quick bite.  It's easy to miss SNAP because it is on the lower level of a building across the street from the train station's parking lot.  Unique decor.  I ordered a cheese pizza.  The guy at the counter was pleasant.  The crust, sauce, and mozzarella was fresh.  Didn't wait long for my pizza.  It was DELICH.  As I was leaving, others started pouring in...people of all ages.  After eating, I noticed a kids menu... I would have ordered a small kids pizza since it was just me, but all in all, great place.

The service could definitely be better, but the food is pretty good! The service is definitely better during the lunch hour when the waitstaff aren't too busy to pay attention to you. They have a good asian salad I always get if I visit for lunch. 

I have been twice for a happy hour and was always surprised at their higher-than-average prices, and then extra-surprised once the happy hour ended! 

I recommend visiting for lunch rather than for drinks, and the location is pretty perfect for my those of us on the JFK, Market, and Arch street highrises.

This McDonald's either disappoints you all the time or sometimes. Everytime someone of my family goes here something's missing, wrong or not cooked. I ordered 3 LARGE fries and got half fries that weren't even cooked or hot at all. I got a mayo burger and squished cookies. I understand you're working in an environment where it gets busy late but YOU signed up for that job and you need to either do it correctly or find another job. I understand how it is to work in the food industry but the attitude and the quality is the reason why people don't want to come back.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I was excited to try this salon for the first time so I made an appointment, however when I showed up, I was told that I had been scheduled with a lead stylist, therefore the price was significantly higher than what I had been expecting. No one had mentioned this when I was making the appointment. Total, the time spent with me was about 30-45 minutes, I felt like there wasn't really any attention paid to detail and was really disappointed in the overall professionalism. I guess I was hoping for a better experience as a new client... not planning on returning to this salon.

Rented a car to drop in Chicago because I was buying a used car up there. The car had a flat and I had to change it myself because they now charge for roadside assistance. I also went through a toll booth without change, stopped at toll plaza to pay it in cash, and now my credit card has a $16 charge for a $1 toll. BRANCH not helpful, but local corporate office was VERY friendly and helpful at getting the charge reversed after I sent a photo of my receipt from IL tollway. Ultimately it was the fault of state of IL which I try not to travel to much.

We love sushi and eat it often. Saw good reviews and over 4 stars and thought we would give it a try. Ended up there during happy hour which meant sushi was half price. No biggie and potentially awesome because we've had great luck in the past at other places. Ultimately, we found it rather disappointing. The fish was room temperature, everything was mostly rice, there was barely any shrimp tempura in the shrimp tempura roll, and they were under-staffed which made service relatively slow. We probably won't go back.

The pizza is awesome and worth the wait if it were not for the rude, impatient and unavailable employees. I had one good experience and several terrible experiences. On my most recent trip, the bar tender instructed us to sit anywhere and handed us menus. After we decided on our order, he came back over and told us that we could only order pizza and salad. He was rude every step of the way and even called the manager over to explain why we could only order pizza and salad. In the end, we left without any food. This is not the way to run a business.

Took kids to play at Pitman Theater to see a play. Afterwards, walked down the street to this restaurant.  The food and service were absolutely outstanding.  The kids had pizza, which they devoured and was delicious.  The adults had salads, shrimp, chicken and lots of dessert.  
The place was extremely clean and the ambience was warm and comforting.  The servers were attentive, accommodating and gave great recommendations.   Even met the owner who personally visited our table to ensure we were satisfied.  
What started as grabbing a quick bite to eat has turned into finding a gem in which I will definitely be returning!!u

Had my first experience at el pique and all in all it was pretty good. I ordered original style tacos - steak and chorizo.   I got them to go and they were very good.   If I go back I will try the Texas style which had some additional vegetables on them, not that's it's a complaint but it seemed like an interesting option.  Yep, if in the area I would go there again for sure but the value isn't as good as my local taco shop, and neither is the interior.  But don't let that put you off - it's still really good!

I was hesitant to try them out because the ratings weren't that high, thank god I did.. they are WONDERFUL! We had 4 different Sushi rolls as well as the green tea moshi and banana tempura and ice cream and it was all 5 stars! Our waitress was so sweet and took time to explain everything to us. She even talked us into trying a specialty roll with eel.. which I always steer away from and I'm so glad we listened. The interior is quiet and elegant and just a little dated but it's nothing compared to the food and service. I'm surprised they weren't packed. I will definitely be back!

I've been going to this restaurant for years and it is definitely the best restaurant in Chinatown. Fast service, VERY cheap food (compared to other better looking restaurants around), delicious, nice waitress, etc. While the food is occasionally too salty for my taste, I suppose it is standard for Chinese food. I always order the seafood soup and salt-baked squid, but other things are good as well. This is one of the few restaurants I want to come back after the first try, being more of a home-made food person. Definitely worth a try!

This place is the best chinese restaurant I've ever gone to! The food is cheap yet delicious, the staff is nice and helpful (she took the time to explain when I asked what each dish is). The food came out fast and fresh and most of them has plenty of meat, unlike some chinese restaurants that have 98% noodle and 2% everything else. I come here everytime I crave chinese food because there's no need to look elsewhere, it has all that I want in a chinese restaurant, especially the salt baked squid and seafood soup. One bad part about this is you would want to puke all the good food you ate once you enter the bathroom, but that can be avoided.

Have eaten many times the last couple of years at this comfortable, friendly trattoria. The staff is accommodating, the cocktails ample and the food reliable.  However, I am weary of a food item or an aspect of service that is "off" and prevents the restaurant from being anything but slightly better than ordinary. Why is a classic affogato served in a small casserole meant for a baked food item rather than in a piece of glassware? Why can't the servers write the orders so that the staff serving the food don't have to arrive at the table with each plate and ask who ordered it before serving it? This place needs some serious fine tuning.

The service is always great, the sushi and hibachi is made to order and for about $20 you can eat anything you want to order. Make sure not to leave any sushi on your plate though because their is a small charge per piece of sushi that is not eaten. The restaurant doesn't want you to waste food but they do want you to enjoy and order whatever you would like to eat. Ever since being introduced to Koizi, we have introduced many more friends to the place. I only wish they would get so much business they would have to open a second location closer to the Carrolwood area.

Meh. At Best. Pettanusca was horrible. Sardines were so macerated they could not be tasted. The spice was so high you couldn't taste anything else. I asked for extra garlic, but it wasn't forthcoming. I asked for a roasted garlic on the side after the entree, but it took forever, like they've never roasted a garlic before. My husband's scampi was tasteless and not at all flavorful. The best part was the focassia and garlic bread. The service was wonderful. Was a Friday night and easily seated, but not worth it.

This location needs to post the menu on their website and allow online ordering for pick up (as every other restaurant who is aware of the existence of the internet does).  This makes placing an order for carry out ahead of your arrival exclusive to calling in.  Unfortunately, when I did this, the lady taking my order struggled with English thus forcing me to order when I arrived and making me wait.  Even then when I got home the order of 6 items was incorrect on 2 of them.  Lastly, the food was mediocre, at best.  I learned my lesson and will continue to patronize the Chimis location a 1/2 mile west on Olive the next time I eat Mexican food.

Horrible fucking place ever!!! Everything is old and office people are there to "help" but they don't really fucking do anything! I've had an on going issue and they still can't fix! It's fucking ridiculous what we go through and they still don't fucking care in the good people that like here! It's been almost 3 months and I just wanna get the fuck out of here! It's ducking ridiculous the games they play, with their oh well she said he said bullshit game! Like get up if I'm telling you I have an issue and go check it out not just sit there in your desk bullshitting around!!

I've been going to classic over 10 years my favorite has always been the Buffalo wings I received a platter and every single wing was fried and over cooked very very disappointed I called to informed them and ask to make sure that I do not receive old wings the lady on the phone decided it was best to disagree and almost argue with me as if she actually made the food, never apologized she basically called me a liar this happened 2/21/2018 @6:00pm hopefully the managers will correct whomever this rude rude female was. I will no longer order from classic

Comically bad.  We were the only people in the restaurant on a Friday night.  Waitress forgot our appetizer. The "yakisoba" is just lo mein and in addition to being tasteless, my udon was served literally boiling. By the time it cooled down to an edible temperature, the fish was wildly overcooked.  Waitress did not care about anything - she never came over the table and barely apologized for forgetting our food.  This place is a travesty to Japanese food.  Will never be coming back and I recommend you don't either.

We finally made it in to try Memo's last week, and we've been there twice already! The food is incredibly fresh, tasty and obviously made with care. So far we've had the huaraches, street tacos, carnitas, and albondigas. Every single thing we've eaten has been amazing! The cocktails and desserts are also fabulous. This is by far the best Mexican food we've had since we moved here from Chicago eight years ago. Definitely check them out on Instagram because they post specials there regularly (which is how we knew about the albondigas offered last week).

I went there for the first time 2 weeks ago on a Sunday..I had read they do half price sushi on Sundays! (yay!) The server (I can't remember his name, beard-longer hair?) was super nice, answered all our questions plus chit chatted some, and always got us what we needed etc before we needed to ask. The food was excellent and they have late hours which especially helps on a Sunday. They had a very extensive menu (mostly sushi with some bento boxes, Udon soups, and stir fries). If you are going on a differnet day, the price of the sushi rolls will add up quickly but the quality and service make it worth a stop.

Today I needed hair ball stuff for our cat. I stopped down there to pick some up since that's where we brought our cat in the past,Yes he is a patient. I was informed because he wasn't sick this year the wouldn't sell me hair ball stuff. Shocked at what I believe to be the dumbest policy for a animal hospital, I left and will not return when my cat need them as they obviously care more about the repeat dollars than my animals well being. Dumb policy if you really care about animals. Look at what they do not what they say.

I am so happy Sakana opened a second location even closer to me! 
I had quite a few rolls, all of which were absolutely delicious but I really enjoyed the crouching tiger hidden dragon. And of course their homemade ice cream to finish off the meal was as good as can be! 
I also really like the decor, the place looks amazing inside, and the music is great as usual!
Thank you for letting my friend and I come in for your soft open, I can't wait to come back with more friends when you're officially open to the public!

It's a run-of-the-mill, run-down auto wash with people to towel dry at the end. The soap is not top grade and if you're paying $20 for an ultimate wash, it should be worth at least $10! This wash may have been worth $5. The wax is nothing to hoot and holler about like they promote on their signage. The pre-wash consists of a hose down with diluted soap, it's not even a power wash hose to loosen up real gunk or get the most bang for your buck by the time you wash and get that wax. If you don't care about car washes and think all of them are the same, go here. If you care, find another.

The food overall is very good. The staff, especially in the casual part of the restaurant,  is very cold and unfriendly. 
Regardless,  of what time we've been there they never have any slices. Very frustrating. However, aside from the food and the above comments, my husband was once in the restaurant and overheard the owner speaking to his employees. The owner was very angry and made a reference that he could be like "Hitler" . I think anybody would be offended by this comment. This left us with our jaws to the ground. Maybe this type of behavior contributes to the attitude of the employees.

they were extremely rude. i will never in a million years ever go here again. The staff was extremely condescending and rude. I recommend never coming here because their food isn't good and they are extremely rude and don't care about their customers safety for Covid. Two members of staff were not wearing masks, no one was wearing gloves, they had dining where people were 2 feet away from each other, along with a party of at least 10 people were sitting outside of their establishment. I would give zero stars if I could

Don't trust reviews. Went in with over a 2-3" beard. Asked for a "slight end trim and fresh lines" even showed a picture of a desired length. 
"Kendrick" the barber and so called hero decided a 1/4" cut was best,.. as I was turned away from the mirror... Then he used scissors to make very weird and random snips of loose hairs. After washing I now looks VERY patchy and WAY WAY WAY too short for what I asked for. 
That was my first and will absolutely be my last trip to the barbershop.
Never trust another man with YOUR beard/hair. Lesson very harshly learned!!

Went there for 1st time yesterday. Was told it was similar to Moe's. No, not really. Staff seemed young & disinterested. Confusing to order with no real help given. I had coba bowl & hubby had chicken quesadilla. Best thing on mine was fresh cilantro & black beans. Really should have left, as seemed dirty in there. Silverware by salsa bar dirty. Salsa bar messy. Both of us were queasy last night. Moe's is way better & has a much better vibe. Guess if we were young & drinking alcohol, wouldn't have mattered about the food.

This is the absolute worst DD in the county. Their store is always dirty and their staff is unfriendly and incompetent. Their turn over is so high that they change almost weekly. The service is terrible. Every time I stop in here I have to wait forever to get service. I had 4 employees tonight and they all stood around counting a money drawer. 10 minutes with a line of 9 people because they didn't have a cash drawer to take orders! I left, as did 2 others. I wish the store could get their crap together because I'm in the area 3 nights a week. I hate driving 10 more minutes away to get my coffee elsewhere. WAKE UP DUNKIN. Close it or run it.

3 years ago This McDonald's location was one of the best and fastest drive thru , food was always pretty good.
I am not sure what has happened here.  
It now is the worst!!  Slow and Nasty.
The last 3 times I have ordered a Big Mac in the drive-thru,  I had to throw it away and couldn't eat it.  You owe me $30.  
Do we really need, those maggot resembling onions, piled on a half and inch thick??   Or how about the Big Mac sauce, should it be all over both inside and outside sides of the bun and on the container and the bag too??  It was everywhere.  It is more like a Big Disease,  than a Big Mac!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Terrible place to go if you need to see the doctor. Seems like the doctor chooses when they feel like coming in for an appointment. I've booked two appointments weeks apart, and both were canceled within days of the appointments. I will be booking another appointment somewhere else. This is the second time multiple appointments have been canceled, which leave me waiting months for an eye exam and new contacts. Very lackadaisical in showing urgency for customers. I'll be switching locations or even switching eye doctors eventually.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I had a few day trip, needed to keep it cheap and simple. Alamo worked for me. I prepaid and used the kiosk to check in, so I did skip the line of people waiting who just got off of the same flight with me. They had two cars on their lot in my category to pick from and I was pleasantly surprised with both. The vehicle I selected had more features than I expected for the lower end range I rented in. For my return flight home I was running very late. I pulled into the car return, tossed him my keys and ran for my flight. On both sides, it was a non-event experience for me, which was perfect.

Still a great crust and good selection of toppings but the sauce seems different somehow, way too pasty near the edge of the pie. Pasta dishes are good and servings are generous, likewise salads. New, major annoyance: an auto-answer that says they're too busy to take the call, try again in a bit. I  redialed a few times and finally got a person, who put me on hold. Sheesh! Otherwise service is prompt and friendly. Two Girls used to get my four stars but since the move to new digs I give it  three to three and a half.

How sad to see such a decline in a restaurant that's been a mainstay for years. We've counted on them for takeout since COVID-19, but last night's was beyond disappointing.

I was served eggplant that was sliced too thin,  breaded too heavily, and fried to a greasy dark brown, almost burnt. They used to prepare a thicker slice, cooked to a golden brown, and a heartier portion as well.

This follows a recent pizza they undercooked. It was a soggy-in-the-middle mess when we got it home.

In review, prices have gone up, portions are smaller, and quality has suffered greatly. We need to find a new go-to. It's not Two Girls any more.

This was our fourth visit to the Santa Fe MexicanGrill and was disappointed with both the service and food, we ordered the No. 5, 6 and 10. The beef tacos were very bland, I tried to dress them up with the salsa and asked for some sour cream (was charged extra for that).. our waiter never returned to check on us and when we did manage to get his attention he sorta slouched on the table behind us as we called out our request. The strawberry margarita was great, my regular frozen margarita was watery and bland. Will be trying other Mexican restaurants for awhile and will check back at a later date to see if there are any improvements.

This place is overall great - but can be pretty hit and miss. I've had the best and the worst nail experiences here. It depends on which technician you get and how rushed they are when you come in. Today I had a dip manicure by technician Bao Nguyen and he did a fantastic job! He was thorough, careful and didn't rush his work despite the walk ins piling through the door. Johnny is always excellent and several other consistently do great work too. But sadly I've also had a few doozies here where I've been rushed through and left with the worst dip nails. I still would recommend though!  80% of the time, this place is absolutely fantastic.

As a road warrior, I know what to expect at a Residence Inn ... but this property is just plain terrible by any standard. Furniture looks like the dog ate it (truly), filthy couch, dirty bathroom floor, sagging bed ... and the list goes on. Breakfast was OK and the only thing about this property that was marginally acceptable. Plus the price is no bargain at all.

The front desk staff (Manager?) said a renovation is scheduled  ... no time frame given. So strongly suggest staying somewhere else until a major re-do is completed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Go to Arigato!!! I would give this restaurant negative stars. Poor, poor poor customer service. We were told 40 minute wait time. We did wait, only to be told we are next multiple times while two top tables where sat in front of us, why they didn't think to combine those tables for our party of 4 is beyond me. After an hour and a half we left. It became comical just to see how long they would have us wait. The food is ok but nothing to write home about. Again, go to Arigato downtown. Better food and way better service.

Location is 100!  Out the front door and your on Bourbon St. walking distance to everything.  Rooms small but clean but stale smell was off-putting   They've painted the windows closed. The bathroom is tiny. I wouldn't suggest for a larger person as the entry door is narrow.  Definitely request  a balcony room facing Bourbon next time for fresh air and a view of the action at night.   Iits Bourbon St so expect noise all night they do give ear plugs.  Jeff was great. Night security and bellmen great.  Most of front desk was friendly. Cafe staff meh. Pool was nice. I would probably stay here again in a pinch
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Chase has to be right up there with wells fargo when it comes to being straight forward and honest. I was on the phone over an hour just trying to get answer to a simple clearing question I had for my account.  It was frustrating trying to get a simple answer, they refused to give the simplest of answers.

Finally A manager/team leader only identified by Terrie, supplied me with the information.  Chase bank is much like the far right winged confuse, redirect and place blame on others. By-far one of the worst banks to deal with on a CS level.

By far best place to get beer and growler fills. Has a great selection of beers and keeps a good number of them cold.  Majority of the store can be a mix-a-six. Also the variety of growler fill options is real nice and being able to sample them before hand is good if you want to try a new beer. They like to support the local brewery's as well.  Nice selection of cigars and they occasionally do a tobacco sample on their patio for anyone who pipe smokes.  Staff have always been friendly and extremely knowledgable.

The first time I went I had a fine experience, the second time my stylist was horribly rude and even asked "Did you cut your hair yourself?" Nope. I had it done at Stardust 6 weeks prior. Three times during my appointment she had the audacity to ask me "So....you like being this blond?" then blamed my previous California residency for my preference. Excuse me? Not only was I pissed she insulted my hair multiple times, but also threw out a tired west coast surfer stereotype.   Horrible. Infuriating. I want my money back and will never return to this place.

This place is great!!! I've been there twice already. First time was for sushi. It was fresh and well prepared, which made me very happy. I went back 2 weeks later to try something different. I got a hibachi entree. That was good! The service is good, and the owner, Yan, is very friendly.

Here's a "warning" - they have big bottles of Yum Yum sauce on the tables, which is great for dipping. Their fried rice is great on its own merits, but after putting on some of that Yum Yum sauce, it was almost as addictive as crack!

I'll be back again in another 2 weeks - this time with an entourage.

I hope they stay there permanently.

We ordered delivery. It came quickly, but with the exception of a special roll my husband liked, the sushi rolls were particularly mediocre. But, our bugger concern was order accuracy. They sent an avocado salad instead of seaweed salad. Additionally, we had asked that they package the fish sushi in one box and the veggie sushi in another (as I don't eat fish).  Instead of this, they mixed all the rolls up together. We did not call and complain (as we couldn't wait for them to fix it) and so do not know how they would have responded to these problems. We probably won't try them again though.

This may have been the worst Mexican food I have eaten. The restaurant was clean as was the men's washroom. I ordered a Coke. It was watered down and no refill was offered. My wife ordered a horchata; she said it was good. The carne asada tasted like steakum. Everything was under seasoned. Chips were not served while waiting to order. The chips served with the guacamole appetiser were deep fried, but served cold. When we walked in initially the music was extra paisa, but then they changed it , unbidden, to a Puerto Rican channel. My wife's dish ,which would traditionally served with queso fresco, was served with feta.

Disappointing, unremarkable food. Very bland. Appetizers were inconsistent. My octopus had three small pieces of baby octopus. Lobster and oysters were good. For entrees we had the almond crusted grouper and halibut. Halibut was overpowered by the kimchi and a very narrow "slice" of fish. Grouper had absolutely not a hint of almond flavor in the crust. Expected much more from Sue considering her abilities as shown during her time at Gautreau's. Some dishes were interesting and tasty. Just not enough, overall, to bring us back. Sorry!

The menu looked promising. We have dietary restrictions and severe food allergies. After asking clear and concrete questions about the ingredients in specific foods and were assured we could eat them; imagine our concern when we found out on the next visit that we were completely mislead. We were very clear about whether the vegetable soup was vegetarian and what it contains. We were shocked when the next time we ordered the same soup to find out that the vegetable soup is chicken based. Completely frustrated and annoyed! NEVER again.

After reading reviews at Ripoff Report (highly recommended) , I see a pattern of one of the ways Midas conducts their rip offs. It goes like this: they quote an estimate for a partial repair then they encourage you to do a full repair for an additional egregiously expensive amount. If they try this routine on you, go elsewhere, you probably don't need any repair at all. If you take the car in for a problem and the price seems out of line,  leave and get an opinion from a friend. Check parts prices at Auto Zone. Midas will inflate these prices steeply. Better yet, don't go to Midas at all!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Staying here for a work conference. Room is clean and smells good. A little outdated but clean. Halls are clean. Thermostat in my room doesn't work on auto fan but will on "fan on." The shower drain doesn't drain fast so water backs up while you're in the shower and takes a few minutes to drain. Aside from those two problems, my priority in hotels is cleanliness and safe area. Both of those have been 

Update: Shortly after I wrote review a maintenance guy came at 9pm and got me out of bed to tell me that my thermostat was working correctly. It wasn't. Apparently they located me through my Yelp review.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The waitress we had was not friendly at all. She seemed terribly annoyed to serve our party of four. She did not introduce herself and was very short with us during our meal. The strawberry margarita was great. We ordered the bacon and pea guacamole and the mango guacamole. Both were good but not as good as other establishments . I ordered the shrimp enchiladas and the dish only came with 3 shrimp. It was a disappointment. Someone else at the table had the shrimp build your own tacos and it has plenty of shrimp. The others had chicken tacos which were good. The deserts were a flop. The food was a 3 and the service a 0.

The best sushi I've had!  BYOB plus 5% off if you make a reservation.  Went in at 6:30 on a Friday and had the palce to ourselves until 7 or 7:30.  My GPS had no trouble finding the address (I updated it on my computer that afternoon)  just make sure you distiguish Pennbrook Parkway from Pennbrook Ave.  If you're worried, use your GPS to get to the Pennbrook train station, it's right across from the restaurant.  Very friendly staff.  It was a little expensive, but for a treat (and for fantastic sushi) it was well worth it!!

Lazy Saturday afternoon - came a little after 3 - dining room was clean - service really good and overall the food we chose was good.  Started with chips and salsa - both fresh and salsa nice kick at the end. Chicken soup enough for two - once again fresh and delicious. Taco Salad Fajita Shrimp - a little heavy with onion, guac but not enough lettuce. Shrimp very tasty would recommend grilling both sides. Pollo Sante Fe - fantastic chicken was tender and the shrimp tasty. Fresh vegetables grilled very well.  Definitely recommend trying it out.  Will venture out on the menu next time.

I ate here yesterday and I thought it was ok. We ordered the mussels and calamari to start with- they tasted good. For our main courses we shared the special which was a black 
Linguini with salmon and shrimp, the shrimp was over cooked, the pieces of salmon were vey tiny and overall this dish was nothing amazing. We got the gnocchi which was good. The spicy veal marinara pasta had very little veal, the marinara was just not spicy... It was bland. Nice service but overall disappointed from the food, thought it would be much better bc I heard a lot of good things.

Ate here  last Saturday night for the first time in about 10 years. The food was just OK service was excellent prices of wine very good. 
The bathroom , at least the ladies room , needs some serious attention updating and cleaning. The tile and grout is very old and very dirty. Needs paint and fictures!  I have a real aversion to eating in restaurants who's bathrooms are not sparkling clean. Makes me wonder how the kitchen looks? 
I may go back again to sit at the bar but i wont use the loo. Please spend some money in the bathrooms ! long overdue! 
Otherwise its a quaint cozy local restaurant!

Nice location but...

Check in person was very sweet and informative, but sadly our room was not as expected.  We were given a handicapped room. Neither my husband or I are handicapped and we did not request one. My hubby is over 6 ft tall, so showering 
Is difficult because the shower head is low.
