Also, the bathroom tub is sorely in need of an upgrade. Peeling and stained.  Also, drained super slow.  Deadbolt on the door was also broken.   

Always loved Marriott rooms but sorry, can't say that I'd recommend this one.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Used to be the best. But now when I have a very sick cat, no replies to messages. Finally got someone to answer the phone and was told to go to another ER vet. Did that. Cat needs follow up and after waiting 2 entire days, NO call back even after being promised a call back....twice. I understand things are difficult now but to not take 2 minutes to call back and refuse to make a follow up appt. for any day?? This is how a client of 10 + years is treated? Disgraceful. Had to call back ER vet to get follow up.

I'm so excited to have found a great restaurant in our area! This place has it all: super cute, excellent food, great service. And it's a BYO to boot! It's been a while since I looked at a menu and was overwhelmed by so many delicious looking options. They have a great variety. Each person in our party of 6 raved about their dish. And then there was dessert. My 5 year old looked at me and said it was amazing. I concurred. We had a really wonderful meal and enjoyed every aspect of our time at Pomodoro. My hat is off to this restaurant. We cannot wait to return.

Love it! Vegetarian friendly ! It is not fancy (kind of a Mexican diner) but it is clean and friendly; give it a chance. There is not much on the menu for vegetarians, so you just tell them what you want. Burrito with veggies, cheese, rice & beans? No problem! Veggie tacos? Sure! Quesadilla? You get the idea... They just whip up whatever you want. It is fresh and flavorful. They have three great sauces on the tables (a green one, a chipotle one and a basic salsa) . You can judge a lot by the quality of sauces. The margaritas are great.  Also, chile relenos are solid.

Not a fan, been there a few times and the service stinks!! Went in for dinner tonight around 4 o'clock. The place was pretty empty only two other tables had patrons. Took forever to get our drinks. It was absolutely freezing in the restaurant and I am typically hot. My husband and I had to go outside to warm up before our food came. Waitress did not come and Check on us until we were almost on our food. Then she wanted to know what we wanted for dessert before clearing off our dirty dishes. It's the small things that make a restaurant great and they have not figured those small things out yet.

Did you know that the Broadway location delivers? I ordered last Saturday and the pizza was mutilated. When I called back to complain nobody answered the phone. I left a message but nobody called me back. We were able to unfold it and it was a delicious dinner. I called them tonight and was told that it was too bad I ate it because to remedy the issue they would need a pizza to take back then was told I should kept calling that night. It already took an hour and half to get the pizza. Anyway, it's great pizza just don't have it delivered.

DD at 700 34th st n in Saint Petersburg 
I ordered a cup of coffee and a side cup of ice. Person at register said "I have to charge you .27 cents, is that ok?" 
"I said no, I will drink some of my coffee and come back and top it off."
She said, "I still have to charge you the .27 cents"
"Really?"
"Yes."
She was very apologetic and I can feel for her in her position...she said boss's rule.
Have you read some of the other reviews? OMG, how does DD allow an asshole like this owner to allow them to represent their BRAND? The thing that gets me, you pay MORE for less and leftover coffee when you get iced coffee...
NOT returning here again...
KMA

Nothing like bringing a dog in and having them take the dog without providing any details besides they want to keep it warm. Waiting for the "specialist" to come for an hour (so far) as the "Doctor" has seen two different patients across the room while the staff wonders around aimlessly through the halls. No one is checking in on us and it's to the point where we have to go say something because no attention had been paid for this long. These people are definitely not animals lovers. Posting with no intention on changing my review because there's nothing these pathetic people can do at this point.

I give the optometrist Dr.Spalding at Target in Fishers In no stars. I called at 2pm stating I had abrasions on my cornea, noted by my MD that recommended I see my optometrist, when I called them they were more concerned about me asking for a refund. I said no I need to be seen and have my eye looked at as well as an exam because I am seeing things blurry. I was told they would relay the message to her and call me back. 5pm I called and was told she had left for the day! Unreal!! I guess it was not a concern to her. I'm never going there again.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Another disappointing Mexican restaurant in Indiana. Are any of them special? Their fajitas are slivers of beef and chicken. So typical of this state's version. Why not a nice strip of skirt steak like places in the Southwest? And why is it that when we order fajitas for 2 people, we get 1 serving of beans and rice? Huh? Never had that happen anywhere before. So far,  Chuy's is the only Mexican place I've enjoyed in this state. It's average in Texas but the best in Indiana so far. If anyone has a good Mex suggestion, please let me know.

We have been to dozens of sushi places in the greater STL area and this is at the top for us!  We moved to O'Fallon a year ago and were disappointed with the mass amount of chain restaurants and little of anything else.  Sake Sushi was one of our first dining destination and we were pumped!  Sushi is always fresh, diverse menu at great prices.  If you leave in the area there is absolutely no reason to drive to downtown STL to Wasabi or Drunken Fish (althought both are very good) because Sake is better, closer and cheaper.

Nice Resort to visit if your coming in the winter. BEWARE OF Mosquitos and Sand Fleas. This resort is located near several ponds on a property next door and inner coastal waterway. I am cutting my trip short. Even with bug repellent it's unbearable to lay outside day time or night. My travelers
and most guest are scratching like crazy with bites. Awful! Hotel says use repellent, I am like get someone to spray or fog constantly the property. Besides that the hotel is nice and I normally would recommend but, camping I thought I had been bitten.. Nothing like this!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: What's with the 3-star rating? I love this place. We have been going there for years and think it has the best lo mein, mei fun, won ton soup, egg rolls and beef szechuan. The "spicy" food is not spicy at all, but they would probably make it spicier if I asked them to. Make sure you look at the coupons to see what free dishes you're eligible for with your order. It's not a 5-star ambiance kind of place, not anywhere to take a date or anything, but if you just want some tasty Chinese takeout, this place is great

Stayed by here late the other night. Came in on the late side. Apparently their system has issues if you come in late to check in. Had to wait and wait and wait and we were really unhappy with the late hour being from the east coast and time difference. Otherwise hotel was nice and clean but really unhappy to stand around to hear we couldn't get our room yet bc of their computer issues until it decides to work again in 20 mins. Apparently this wasn't a one time deal and the woman didn't seem to be to bothered by it at the desk. If I wasn't so tired I probably would of left and went somewhere else that night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We enjoyed our stay while in the area. Usually we stay at the JW but the Ritz was definitely very enjoyable and more zen during these crazy times. They have an gated area upon entering towards  the hotel ,valet parking, a beautiful room with terrace,  spacious lobby that was beautiful as well. ( very open to the outside) Water and newspapers were available as well complimentary to enjoy. The beautiful 2 pools were extremely nice with umbrella's and very attentive staff with water, Drinks and food. The pool food was quite good and large portions as well. Would definitely recommend staying here and enjoyed our time while here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Am a fan of this place.  So wanted to support them during this crisis.  I called to order the takeout meal and was placed on hold for 5 minutes.  I finally hung up and called back.  I got a man on the phone who was not too pleasant.  It almost seemed like I was inconveniencing him.  Lots of great local restaurants who need support.  Limoncello's entire staff needs to get that.

As for the meal, it was wonderful!  We ordered the family style meal.  Everything was outstanding.  4 course meal that could easily feed 6 people for $50.00.  Amazing!

Terrible customer service on more than one occasion. If you do not walk to the window and insist, you will not be helped. They will not call you to the window. I had to be escorted by another employee while waiting in line to the window of the available teller who was casually texting on her phone and talking to another employee. As I'm withdrawing a fairly large sum of money, the teller continues to turn around and talk to her coworker while counting my money. Maybe one word was spoken to me, hello. It was a rather uncomfortable experience to say the least.

I've stayed here many times before and have found it to be convenient and friendly.
This time, the staff is completely indifferent.
The renovation means that all access to a VIP room is closed.
Bathrooms are not being well maintained.
There's a tiny recycling center in the lobby, but there's no effort at recycling in the rooms.

I expected a mediocre room based on the price and my previous experience. I did not expect to find such unhelpful, unfriendly staff this time. Bring back the folks with smiles and great attitudes!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ate here for the first time tonight.  It was ok.  I didn't realize they had a pizza buffet until after we already ordered.  I ended up spending $30 on a medium pizza, breadsticks, and waters.  My son and I could have eaten for $15 with the buffet which would have included salad.  I heard the server tell others when they were seated about the buffet, wish I would have known.  The crust had a flavor that was pretty good.  Unlike any pizza I've had.  Pretty doughy.  It felt like it could have used a few more minutes in the oven.  It's a cute enough place, we'll probably try it again and go for the buffet.

This is the best subway I have ever eaten. Believe me, I have been to many subways in many cities and many states. This should be one of the best of all. The vegetables are fresh always. Every time I visit this subway, I am happy to see the freshness of the veggies. The shop is always super clean. I wish all the subway owners who are not doing so great with their freshness and cleanliness come visit this place. When you are in the Marlton/Evesham Twp area, don't miss this amazing place. Also the staff are very friendly too.

I'm not sure why this restaurant is so highly rated.  My friend's food was simply so-so.  I ordered a slice of chocolate cake.  They do not have a dessert menu with prices, so I had no idea that this small piece of cake was going to be $8, and it was really mediocre--very dry.  The ambiance is typical of an ethnic restaurant you'd find in a strip mall--cheesy murals painted on the walls, cheap-looking furniture and decorations.  I could overlook the ambiance if the food was either outstanding or cheap, but it fails to be either one of those things.

Super slow, don't follow national deals all the time, always out of something, to lazy to make coffee, oh and ROACHES!!! I don't mean roaches crawling on the floor.  Last time i was there while i was ordering a roach fell from the ceiling landing right next to my sandwich he was making, he just brushed on to the floor with out saying a word! I was shocked asked for a discount, he said "no discount" so i walked out and will never go back again.

There is a much better subway about 2 blocks away on St. Charles go there

Stopped in for drink and appetizer.... Initial vibe was awkward. We were greeted before the couple already standing in front of us. The receptionist had no control over guests and tables and availability. Finally sat ... 15 minutes went by & finally 2 different waitresses came over. Clearly not knowing who is covering what tables. Chicken nachos were basic. And not worth the $9.50. Sigh. Glad we didn't want to stay long because service in general was terrible. Will give another chance... Because the patio view is great. But that's about all they have going for them.

This isn't a 5 star hotel, but they don't advertise it is. It is a great place to sleep which is all you need a hotel for when you are on vacation. Very unique, free parking, and half a block away from St. Charles. We have stayed here for years the first weekend of Mardi Gras parades and the location is awesome. It's a good walk to Bourbon but well worth it to see the city on your way...then take a cab back. The rooms are older and sometimes might need a little extra cleaning, just ask and they will do this for you. Don't forget...free parking! That saves you plenty.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Yes I give them 5 stars, all in the wrong direction as being the crappiest business in Brandon! I pull in there with not a mark on my new car, and pull out with over a thousand dollars in damage! Of course they want to point the finger at everything instead of taking responsibility for the damages, and just try and blow me off! Well big news for you guys I may have to take a thousand dollar hit, but be assured I live in a 10 fold Karma world, so I can sleep easy knowing that you are going to take a 10k hit just down the road! Anyone is a fool to take your precious vehicle to these asshats! You definitely have the right name!

First let me say, I'm more concerned with how my food tastes, not necessarily my surroundings. That being said, the food here is authentic, fresh and delicious. The restaurant itself could use a little freshening up, but that doesn't detract from the taste of the food. There were eight of us that were here for dinner and we all had something different and all of it was great. Service was prompt and friendly and the food came out quickly and was eaten just as fast. We definitely will return to try other things and I would recommend to anyone not to be put off by the location, because truly - good things do come in small packages.

I've stayed here a few time's.  This time was different very different.  There was candy left on the floor from the previous guest.  Blunt paper left on the side of the couch.  *in a non smoking* Dried pee left on the toilet seat. The shower curtain was not all the way on.  To top it off, hair was in the bed.. . not my hair  .  I could tell the  hadn't been changed.  Oh I need not forget the spider  webs.  This was a penthouse suite.Costing me about 270 a night... We stayed on New Years Eve..  After about 4 calls someone came to help.  I asked for a manager and was told he's cleaning rooms and was offered his email address.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This small business is worth supporting. If you love raw fish, this is the place to go! Their fish is of such a high quality and so fresh and delicious! Their prices are amazing. It is well air-conditioned. The staff is friendly. I love it!
Also, their Goyaza (gyoza) is delicious and the sauce is spicier than most places! My boyfriend ordered the steak dinner bowl. He said that the steak was a little bit tough, and so next time he will try the chicken, but the sauce, rice and vegetables were all top notch! 
I look forward to trying their Chirachi next time! :)

Was great many years ago. Has underwent many changes for the worse. If you want to sit in a dead bar that doesnt know what it wants to be and pay thru the nose this is for you.

2 years ago I loved this place. Today ... oh my. Its not goth, its not metal. It has the high bourbon st prices without any traffic. The scary old charm is all gone. Its a side stop for fat fratboys. The bartenders knw how to open a beer and make a hiball. Thats the end of their skill. Prices at times more than drinking from a hotel mini bar. 

The Dungeon went from so cool to such a joke.

Great ice cream ... Terrible service! The man in front of me had an issue with the wrong order the girl at the counter was very rude the man ended up leaving furious and saying out loud he would never be back. I ordered a sundae but asked for no whip cream or cherry. This girl Destini I believe her name was extremely rude when I politely told her I ordered with no whip cream and cherry. She yells "well what am I suppose to do throw it out?" Another nicer employee remade sundae and apologized. Really sad to see such a place with high product have such rude high schoolers working there!.

This neighborhood salon used to have its own website where you could see the people working there now.  I guess now they are economizing; no website. I stopped going there because every time I went I was charged a different price for a haircut.  If the 'stylists' charging the highest price had given me the best haircut and styling it might not have mattered.  But this was not the case.  I think the owner is tired of the business and is just in it now to milk what he can before retiring.  Sad.  We need good local businesses we can support.  But this is no longer one of them.

We usually like to try new restaurants in the area. Today, we decided to try the sushi and sashimi from Zpan. We did not leave disappointed. 

We ordered the sushi and sashimi combo, spicy salmon roll, eel & avocado roll, and salmon hibachi for lunch. 

All of the fish was fresh and well presented. The ambiance of the establishment provided a soothing environment with blue LED lit under the sushi bar counter and above the bar. 

One of our complaints to the manager was that the "Open" sign was hard to read during the day.

So I never eat fast food. Especially mc Donald's. But tonight we were in a bind so we stopped here. Ordered my kids happy meals, both contained 2 bags of fries(?). Weird but ok.... Now for my meal. Simple fried chicken sandwich with pickles and extra mayo. And orange juice. 
My juice contained ice. Very odd but again, ok then. Got home got kids fed and went to eat. Open my sandwich and it's a grilled chicken on a gross bun with not a speck of mayo or a single pickle. 
Only thing that got this review 2 stars was the very pleasant girl with the white glasses who handed me my food.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Flies, Bad service, and bad coffee. Ofcourse there are a few nice employees, but the bad ones outweigh the good. I remember one time when an older gentlemen came up to get his drink and they had forgotten about it. They apologized to him and for compensation gave him the other drink that was waiting at the counter, which happened to be my drink! I could get over the bad service if there weren't an abundance of flies. I'm not talking one little fly, I'm talking about 6 flies EVERY TIME I GO THERE. Absolutely disgusting. Starbucks is supposed to feel classy and comfortable but this one feels gross

We went here for my wife's birthday with 8 other members of the family.  The staff played along with my little charade to surprise my wife and then made everything special.  The service is top notch, the food is exquisite and having Mr Bommarito come and visit the table, topped it off.  He even took our leftover veal and melanzane back to the kitchen and made two sandwiches from it, without us even asking.  Even the valet had our cars waiting for us before we ever got outside to give him our ticket.  This is the place to go for the best dining experience in STL, no matter the price.

Absolute incompetence all around
Had a shirt button put back on
I had to walk into the back because there was no one at the front despite my yelling
Dude was taking a nap on a table in the back.  On a Tuesday afternoon!  The shirt he goes me back has the button SEWN ON THE WRONG PLACE!   How high do you have to be to put a button two inches lower than the corresponding button hole!!?!
They lost items before, ruined the buttons on another shirt, and now this
They are just two blocks from my house so I keep giving them a chance but these idiots need to go out of business.  
DONT TRUST THEM WITH YOUR CLOTHES!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
The place is shabby, but most of New Orleans is like that. No, the low rating is due to the filthiness of the place. It looks like they barely pass a broom over the floor, the signs posted on the wall are just covered in old dust and dirt and dryer lint, and half the machines are broken. Dryer #9 barely dried my clothes after an HOUR. My usual laundromat dries all 3 of my loads in one giant dryer in that time. I do not recommend unless you're in a tight bind.

They do offer wash and fold for $1 a pound, so if you don't have a lot it may be worth it.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Check Better Business Bureau (www.bbb.org) before signing up with any gym, especially Conshohocken Health and Fitness.   Review your contract carefully.  If you're signing an annual agreement, cross out anything pertaining to monthly charges or "continuing month to month" or 60 days notice.  Otherwise they'll start hitting your credit card with outrageuos charges at the expiration of your first year without giving any notice.  

Aside from questionable business practices the facilities were clean and usually in working order.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We reserved a midsize car (Toyota Corolla or similar)  via Priceline for weekly rate. When we came to the office, there was only one compact size car Nissan Versa (we reserved car the almost week before). The manager Jason Rezsonya (Clayton Branch Manager of Clayton MO) told us for a long time that this is a midsize car, although on their website it is indicated that this is a compact size car. The main office was closed, as Sunday. We had to go, we had to take this car. Our son rode for 8 hours with a suitcase in his lap. Be prepared to be deceived and robbed (the rent of a compact car is cheaper, but no one has given us a difference).

Absolutely horrible quality. Ordered Katsu, Teriyaki Beef, Chicken Kra-age, and Fried Soft Shell Crab. The Katsu was completely dry, and the chicken very chewy. The "Teriyaki Beef (which was described as filet) was fatty, chewy, and covered in a stew like sauce that tasted/looked like a canned gelatin gravy. This brings us to the Kra-age, which was so overcooked and poor quality that neither of us even tried it. We live in Carmel, minutes away from this restaurant, and will never go back, let alone recommend it to anyone. This is the first review I've ever posted, but felt compelled to do so after this experience.

its been a while since i stopped here.  service and food were suffering last time, hasnt changed.  Pizza sauce is strong flavored, not enough cheese at the edge, sauce very pasty.  Generally not enough cheese at all.  Seating is way too close, hard to get o the counter when 3 tables are lined up across the front and none of the women will sit close to the table.  place is very noisy, not conducive to enjoying your meal.  Prices are gigh, and i think i was overcharged by a few bucks.
All in all, i think papa murphy's is a better deal and the pizza is better from there.

I went to the drive through the other morning for bagels and donuts and
the girl took my order fine, when I got to the window to pay she took my money and was given my change. When she claims I removed my hand
 and the dime fell on the ground and I
 asked her nicely to give me another dime, she refused, I was in thr process of getting out of my car, when the supervisor snd gives me the dime, saying "I don't want you holding up my line". the employee was at fault not me,. I won't be patronizing this dunkin donut again, the gurl gave me a smirking grin and told me to "have a nice day" very sarcastic.

Outstanding, but very formal, service and great food. Carpaccio is exceptional. The wild mushroom risotto is a don't miss and especially the authentic parmigiano to top it with. Veal parmigiano was too heavy on tomato and cheese but the tre vitello was absolutely wonderful. (Veal with three different sauces) The wine list is wildly over priced but a handful of wines (not well known) exist if you know your wines. We had three waiters assigned our table so that nothing went amiss. We did note that the jacket required is not enforced. A lovely evening and the highlight of our short visit to St. Louis.

I am surprised by all the negative reviews, but apparently they just changed owners so maybe those were for the prior management. Anyway...

I loved how clean and neat looking the salon was. No television on (hooray) just some nice spa/massage music. My pedi turned out great and I had my nails buffed for my hands, but they were a little uneven. Massage was well done (firm, how I prefer it). My technicians were both super nice.

Only down side is I think it was a little expensive; but I'll definitely be back.

Went to Jeni's tonight to get a pint of Almond Brittle, as we do many weekends. Also, many times they are sold out, but the manager has always hooked us up, if we can wait...which is not a problem. Well, this evening was quite a different story!  Different manager and basically said it was too busy. There were people in front of the counter, maybe three families...definitely not busy, by Jeni's standard!  So, sad story short, we left with no ice cream!  Ridiculous!  The manager went back in the back to sit. He should be fired! This was Saturday 16 June. LAZY millennial to say the least!!!

Toro and blue fin tuna were their special of the day, and it was specially tiny!

They charged full price and thgave food actually worse than all you can eat sushi place.

This is a pretender. Similar price like high end sushi places but no class here......

Save your money!

Max, when you charge Full price for Toro and Blue Fin, you are essentially dealing with customers that enjoy these type of food regularly. 

Don't go to SUN Sushi if you expect high quality Toro/Blue Fin, let alone tiny portions. If you go, and not satisfied, tell Max you saw my review here!!!

Very good food terrible service not one smile from waitress waited forever for the food did not come back and check on us had to get up to go get our own to go box never got a check went up and told cashier what table we were at so we can get out of there after more than an hour. Will not be setting in reds section ever again she actually yelled at the hosted when it was brought to her attention that we had not been greeted or given a menu after more than ten minutes.

Thanks for the great time next time When I want to be ignored  again I'll be back

The hotel is clean and usually quiet but that is it.  Restaurant closes at 8pm.  Bar closes at 10pm.  Concierge lounge he still closed due to "lack of staff".  No hot breakfast.  Grab and go breakfast has zero source of protein in it.  No single serve wine or beer in the "gift shop".  The gift shop is actually just a closet with snacks and drinks available for sale.  The rooms are starting to get dated but it was clean.  As a lifetime platinum elite member the amenities offered here at this time are less than what you get a Courtyard.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is the most Ghetto ass Dunkin donuts i have ever experienced!! Even the manager is ghetto asf. They (as in all the employees) talk about the most inappropriate things, all in front of the customers. Just entirely too much horsing around. Im trying to get my coffee n go not listen to a bunch of soap opera bs. Management as well as the staff...sucks. im not just some passer by either. Im someone who lives in that area n go's in  ALOT!!! n this is an everyday thing. Id give this place a 2 on the scale of 1-10coffe doesnt even taste as good as it used too either. Smh

Went to this shop for years. Always a good cut but never felt like one of the boys. That's ok, I enjoyed listening to the conversations. One busy day I had waited my turn, about half an hour but was told that a guy who had just walked in had an appointment so I got bumped and had to wait longer. A few weeks later I called to see if I could make an appointment for a cut and was told "we don't take appointments". Time to move on. I found a better shop that treats their customers with respect, thanks for the push.

We went there this past Friday (10/17). We read all the great reviews, and were very excited. And l can't say anything bad about it, but to us it had no "wow" factor. The food was good. We had the cauliflower soup, the mozzarella cheese, the mussels and sea bass. All were good. The service was good. But.... It is small and loud. There's nothing to absorb sound, like tapestries. The menu is small, and that's because it's seasonal. I would recommend this restaurant, but there are better in the city. Oh, and it's cash only.

Two guys came in without mask and the cashier took their order. It alarmed me since I thought everyone had to wear a mask while  being inside. There were guys from corporate standing around chatting by me and I asked him if this was ok. He said "no" since it's not keeping the employees  and other customers  safe. And guess what he did. He did NOTHING! He looked down and walked away and did NOTHING. The guy without a mask walked past all of us to use the bathroom and he didn't say anything. Thanks for keeping me safe.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Don't expect them to work with you...all smiles until you need something then you will see fangs.!!

Joanne is as fake as can be...the reviews are right she is friendly to your face, but definitely NOT genuine!!  When you need something you will not see smiles...just fangs. 
Be prepared to bend over and grab your ankles. This place stinks!!

Place does have gorgeous views, but you can here everything from your neighbors showering to talking.  Everything echos in the hallways...no privacy for a hefty price!

Go elsewhere!!

I had to post to help others because I'm  honest and sincere and want to help you not make the same mistake we did!!

I can't say enough good things about Dr. Snyder. She is knowledgeable, thorough, caring and really takes the time to figure out what might be going on with complicated situations. My dog has been coughing for 6 months due to a combination of tracheal problems and recurring infections. Today she's quiet and happy for the first time, due to Dr. Snyder's care. I also couldn't believe that this quality of care could come at this affordable price. My dog's care means everything to me, and I'm ecstatic to have found Jefferson after having recently moved to St. Louis.

For context, this was takeout so keep that in mind...but still, was pretty awful and I expected better.  Caesar salad extremely bland, main course (eggplant parm, chick parm, baked ziti) all very small portions and really tasteless.  Minimal sauce and no taste whatsoever.  Side of escarole had sand or glass in it...we werent sure which but crunchy hard pieces in all three bites so we decided to throw it away.  They forgot the side of spaghetti and refunded us the $3 but clearly would have preferred the food over a measly $3.  All in a really poor experience and bad food.

Don't bother using Citadel if you like online banking. Their site is SO user un-friendly. Every time I login I have to get a "secure access code" and the only time I made an online payment, the bank didn't receive it and my account went to collections. I had to provide proof that the money had been withdrawn from my other bank account of course ONLINE, which was a pain. It takes WAY too long to do anything. If you're one to call in to make payments, Citadel is fine. If you ever think at any point you'd want to do online banking, skip this place.

If only I could give less than one star!   From beginning to end, just a negative experience. The most simple insurance question is met with eye rolling impatience.  The ridiculous and extraneous fees that they can find to charge, that your insurance won't cover, are imaginative extortion.  If it wasn't criminal, I would admire their determination. The only saving grace to this store is ROBIN, sweet angel Robin, who is simple lovely and is the only employee who seems to know what is going on. The other employees are either incompetent or surly. Please, please stay away.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Pleasantly surprised with this place, which belies the exterior facade. Sushi was rolled nice and tight, fish was fresh, and overall was tasty. Started off with veggie tempura, miso soup, and salad which were all typical fare. Then ordered the green Dragon, soft shell crab, spicy conch and cucumber, and the red rose rolls which were all very good, with the red rose and green Dragon being are favorite ( we've had better soft shell crab in New York and the spicy conch and cucumber had a limited though fresh flavor profile). Definitely will add this as a go to place if we're in the area.

My boys were in the mood for Habachi as we left Philadephia. We found this restaurant on yelp and gave it a try. ABSOLUTELY LOVED our experience. Show was good, entertainments 5 boys ages 7-12. Very good pricing (we were there by 6 on a Saturday and benefitted from the early bird offering). Food was delicious!!  Every plate was clean!  The service was top shelf as well. She kept our glasses refilled and very attentive. We can also recommend the spicy tuna and spicy salmon sushi rolls as well. All and all, we will be back and you will be glad you try it!!

I was in the area and saw that this restaurant had good reviews. This place was Awesome!!! The atmosphere was fantastic for 2 people or a group of 8. The decor was country / modern with great art on the walls. Our waitress was the nicest and clearly experienced she made the evening very enjoyable. The food was PERFECT! I had the veggie sandwich, my group had white pizza, margarita with extra cheese pizza, chicken pesto sandwich, and eggplant sandwich. Everyone loved their meals. The place was clean and you can tell it is privately owned and run with care and passion for the food and business. I will definitely be back!

I absolutely love Sakura.  My friend recommended for me to try this restaurant because it has 50% off sushi.  I went my very first time on a Sunday in the afternoon right before the Eagles game.  Boy was I in love.... 50% off fresh sushi & delicious hibachi - how can I not love this?  Every time I want sushi I always visit Sakura now, there's no other place I would rather be.  It's BYOB, if you are a daily customer they recognize you and greet you nicely, service is wonderful (never had to wait too long for sushi), and I am just plain satisfied.  They also have one of the cleanest public bathrooms..  I love Sakura.

Before recently i actually had a completely different view of this company because of a prior expirence 3 years ago and the manager here (Leonardo) at this mpg location on Oracle and Magee was so kind hearted and genuinely helpful. The  crew of mechanics diagnosed and fixed my car  issues within a time frame that was promised. I will not take my vehicle anywhere else my perception of MPG has completely change for the better. I would recommend MPG to my friends and family because quality service on something so essential like your vehicle is so important and hard to find.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The 5 star positive reviews have me scratching my head. My 3 visits do not match their reviews. My first indicator of trouble ahead should have been the lack of customers during its grand opening where young smiling faces stood waiting for customers yet to show up. My second visit was met with only a couple of choices to select from... as was the third. They are not light, or soft, or well priced. They are heavy, dense, lack in taste, and expensive for a donut. Sadly, I foresee this location closing as fast as the Indy location.

Saturday, July Fourth weekend; we were there when they just opened for lunch at noon.  Seated in the back patio; pleasant surroundings.  Server, Josh, was about what you'd expect for a moderately upscale eatery.  Ordered from the lunch menu.  The sandwiches come with a SMALL salad.  Glass of Chianti for $10.00 [I'd guess about 4 ounces, being generous], and the sandwiches vary from $10.00 to $20.00.  Spouse had eggplant veggie and mine was the $15.00 steak sandwich; YES $15.00 for a steak sandwich.  Food was good, service was good - but were they good enough to offset the price - NOT for me.

STOP TELLING ME WHAT YOU "CANT" DO. Literally EVERYTHING on your menu can be ordered individually. Just because your POS can't register a McDouble in a combo, or substitute a McFlurry for a drink in a combo DOESNT MEAN IT CANT BE DONE. Idgaf about price, if I ordered something in a combo that isn't on the combo on the menu doesn't deserve a "NO". If you have to input each item into the register then stop shaming me for ordering. Also, your drive thru guy was a sarcastic prick. ITS A DRIVE THRU, it's not that hard.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This midas is awful me and my fiancé went in to have the battery changed in my cadillac.... Simple right?... Oh no not here we sat in this place for almost 2 hours before the "manager"  decided to tell us he was waiting for a part from NAPA for our car, info he never volunteered while we sat and waited and at one point we even walked somewhere to eat lunch when we arrived at 9:45am. Please do not waste your time or money here, 2 hours of wasted time for a battery and a manager with no customer service skills. If I could give them negitive stars I would cause they don't deserve the one I had to add just to write this review.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Great hotel. Nicely decorated, budget friendly and great location! Located at the edge of the French Market, and only a block and a half from Harrah's casino. Just off Canal street, so it also close to the streetcar stop. The free breakfast was better and had more variety than other complimentary breakfasts that I've had. The only downside was a lack of water at breakfast. It would be so nice if they offered some bottled water at breakfast. The staff were very friendly and helpful. I will make it a point to stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I have struggled to find a boise vet who brings warmth, excellent service, reasonable pricing, and pragmatic advice. No more. My sweet old pup & I visited Dr Broshar yesterday for the first time. Dr Broshar delivered devastating advice with compassion and humanity. He was gentle and kind to my pup, and to me. He offered a set of alternative options and I felt no pressure or judgment to elect one over the other. His descriptions of her ailment and the paths forward were simple yet intelligent. 

I am so grateful I found Ada Vet Hospital for this final journey with my longtime companion. Thank you De Broshar and staff!  Truly.

I've been bringing my dogs here for a little over a year now, was always friendly and professional. I was told you pay for an exam for each dog once a year. I took 2 of my dogs in to get rabies vaccine. One of the dogs was seen 11 months ago. They told me they charged me the exam fee because he was going to have to be examined in a couple of weeks anyways. WOW, they say he is good for a year then 11 months later charge me again. DON"T  TRUST THE WORDS COMING OUT OF THEIR MOUTH. They lost a loyal customer who use to rave about them and send people their way. Lost a great customer.

Amazing - high end, but well worth the splurge! Started with melt-in-your-mouth scallop-risotto appetizer, followed by delicious usuzukari tuna (incredibly thin and beautifully presented), specialty soft shell crab-shrimp and Kennett Square mushroom rolls. Just when we thought it couldn't get any better, we sampled an exquisite, heavenly mini dessert trio - black sesame cheesecake, yuzu creme brulee and fluffernutter dumplings. For a fleeting moment, I thought about licking the plate clean (but didn't). Excellent service by Pete was a bonus for our anniversary dinner!

WTH was I thinking?  It wasn't like I didn't get a warning.  So I was told that these hand grenades were ass-kicking drinks.  I took a sip and thought to myself "ummm, these things are like midori sours - those never get me drunk!"  so I continued to sip away from my green plastic container..... then ordered a second one to-go.  Sipped more and more while walking back to the Ritz then suddenly - I was effed up!!!  It was definitely a creeper - hence my mad hang-over this morning.  I can't seem to get myself out of bed!

It's $8 for one and then $7 for a refill.  For $15, I was goners!

We stopped here to eat because we wanted some Japanese food and I remember driving by it a few times. I thought it was going to be one of those fast food Japanese places that wasn't super good and probably going to make me sick. Little did I know, it wasn't that at all.

We went during lunch. I had a hibatchi chicken, which came with tons of delicious veggies and noodles. My boyfriend had the sushi lunch and really enjoyed it. Both came with a soup and salad. 

This place is excellent if you are craving Japanese and don't want to pay a super expensive amount for it (think about teppanyaki places!)

As someone in the public eye it was vital to find the right salon after my stylist moved away. After talking with several friends, it was unanimous! Go. See. Ashley. 

Having known Ashley casually over the years, this was great news - I reached out and have never regretted it. Her attention to detail is amazing and her use of color is almost magical! 

She enhanced my signature blue tip and gave me a vibrant shade that held on for dear life until our next appointment. Currently working on a limited schedule thanks to Covid, if you are patient and searching for a new stylist - one who will treat you like one of the family - Ashley is golden!!

Nice, casual Italian fare. 
Went here before the second half of the WS game that the Phillies clinched.
Service was a little weird - they were very "hands-off" waitstaff, not pushy with fabulous Italian? accents.
Started off with the spinach gnocchi - a little heavy for my taste. I am not a fan of spinach but that wasn't the issue - it was too thick.
For entree: Vitello alla Viola - very nice. Good flavors and generous portion - the sauce was great.
We were in a hurry to get to McFadden's to watch the game so didn't partake in dessert.

BYOT? Bring your own...trumpet? tulips? tasty treat? Ohh no. TEQUILA! Yes- I said it...Bring your own Tequila. El azteca will provide you with the margarita mix and you make it as strong ( or weak) as you wish. 

The decor doesn't do much for me and the kitchen is only open until 10, but the staff will let you hang out until about 11/11:30 to party with Mr. Cuervo. Good for big parties, but make sure you make a reservation first. 

I actually didn't eat, but my friends looked pleasantly stuffed (and drunk) when I arrived to meet them.

This bar is OK. The face lift and new theme from John Taffer and his team from Bar Rescue was great, but you can see that the management is starting to go back to their old ways which got them in trouble in the first place.  

That said the Resurrection is probably the best mixed drink concocted by a French Quarter bar. It taste good, looks great, doesn't taste overly alcoholic and the slice of jalapeno gives it such a good flavor. I never would have thought to do that but its the best part of the drink

Worth a pit stop just for the Resurrection, I know I will.

WOW!  That is the first word that comes to mind when I walked in the newly renovated Double Edge.  I was amazed at how the new owners transformed the formerly dingy tavern into a classy and updated sports bar!  Although I have not been there on a weekend yet, I was excited to see a built-in DJ booth.  My boyfriend and I came for beers and apps and we were not let down.  Plenty of beers on tap and the wings were amazing -- crispy and the just right amount of 'hot.'  I also got one of the homemade desserts (apple cake) which was out of this world.  We are looking forward to going back to the Double Edge soon!

I have found that this is the only place in Nashville where I can get good Tofu dishes.  The Ma Po Tofu is excellent (order spicy) and cheap.  The General Tso's Tofu (like others have stated) is also particularly excellent.  The egg drop soup is just fine.

I've ordered items that I didn't particularly like here (vegetable fried rice comes to mind) so I would just recommend giving it another chance if you don't like what you get.  Yes, the prices are dirt cheap, and that's why I tend to avoid anything here with beef in it (but the chicken, pork, and tofu dishes have been great).

This place needs more love from yelpers.

First time at this location and they messed up my drink although it was clearly labeled on the cup, they offered to remake it, but I was in a hurry and declined.  They made no effort beyond that, in the past I have at least been offered a remake and/ a free one for next time.  The bathrooms were dirty, which totally grosses me out in a coffee shop.  There were five employees working behind the counter and another person who seemed to be the manager.  The manager type person didn't seem to be assisting the team, even though they were very busy.  I still love Starbucks, but I wouldn't say I will make this one a regular spot.

Super dirty / run down. Racks, benches, locker room, weights, everything. Actually, the cardio machines seemed fairly well maintained. Weird layout / compartmentalized, very closed-in feeling. No windows. Most 24's are not very nice in general, but this one is well below average. I use this gym regularly when I visit SB, and each time I come to town I think 'They have to have fixed it up by now..." Sure enough, if anything it's worse every time. At least they have heavy dumbbells and plenty of benches. Staff also seems nice enough.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
My sister and I stopped in here needing a late night bite and needed an escape from the craziness of Bourbon street (not our scene!) I was torn between giving this place two or three stars, but my deciding factor is always whether or not I'd come back... and truth is, I would not. 

Our food was really just "meh" and did not feel worth the price. We both ordered a cocktail, and while they sounded great on the menu, they both fell seriously flat. I couldn't even finish mine.

Service was fine, but not overly friendly. I can't fault them for that though, I'm sure it takes a thick skin to work in the service industry on/near Bourbon street.

Just a little past Bourbon and Canal, it's one of the first bars on the Bourbon street strip. It's an ok place to stop in on your first night (especially if you've never been to a dueling piano bar) but don't make it a nightly occurrence. We made the mistake of going here two nights in a row (it was the closest place next to our hotel) and heard the same lines, same jokes, and even all the same songs played the night before. I would much rather hear a jazz band than listen to two guys clunk around on the piano playing Benny and the Jets.

The Catbird Seat is delightful. The entire team is hellbent on bringing you edgy but relevant food and drinks. Every detail has been carefully considered, from the moment you arrive.  It is all about texture and flavor and balance. Yummy, for serious.  Josh and Erik are amazing. Mayme and Tom highly skilled. And, Jane Lopes one of my favorite boozy personalities working the industry.  Loved it. 

And, with the seasonal rotation of dishes and ingredients, I anticipate that each trip to Nashville for dinner will have new, delicious dishes and pairings!  Looking forward to the next time.

This inn is located right by the Raymond James stadium where massive GB Packers fans were walking to for the Tampa game (which they lost 38-28).  It's also near the George Steinbrenner field & the TPA airport.  It's basic, clean, with breakfast so you just can't complain.  It probably deserves more stars esp for its fab location but it's just not luxurious so for what you get it's better than bare bones.  They were definitely fully booked as I heard the clerk turning people away who inquired & the rate is $56-$79 depending on how early u book.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Had a pleasant experience here. Had a view from the 20th floor that overlooked the SuperDome and part of the city. The Starbucks was convenient and the restaurants were good for a quick bite. The premises were well-kept and I enjoyed the view from the gym.

Because I was in and out of my room for a conference, I didn't get as much housekeeping as I would've liked. I was there for a few days and a maid only came in once. I know I was in my room at inconvenient times, but would've liked my bed to have been made every day.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
After a long LONG day running around the French Quarter and watching parades we got in the car, slowly crawled through traffic and mobs of people in the street only to discover we had not drank enough WATER during the day and I forgot to leave my water bottle in the car. We saw the arches way up the road and knew we had to get there before one of us expired from dehydration. 

The lines were long but the iced tea here is super good, nothing bitter about it, as most Mc D's have that issue. So props to them for good tea and friendly service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
First time doing laundry "by myself". 
I walked in. 9:30am. Only one other person here. Walked up to a machine with a confused look. Greeted by a gentleman, who walked me through the steps; warm or cold water (hot would "bleed" what I was washing) $1.75 to wash. $.25/8min drying. 
He told me when to add soap, how much to add. 

Also has free wifi. 

All-in-all a great experience. If I lived here, I would definitely be a repeat customer. 

Reason for coming here: In my friends community you need a special "Mac gray" card to use machines. No option for cash. Lame.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Came here. 4:30pm. Picked up a friend early from work and passed by. 
Friendly staff. Helped me order. 

I ordered a rice bowl- balsamic wine. feta cheese +balsamic vinegar+red wine deduction with steak. 

Free-style coca cola machine. 125 different flavors out of one machine!! 
The technician helped me. You can google freestyle coke recipes. I did fanta orange and coke vanilla for an orange creamsicle(?) flavor. Awesome! 

Strawberry Daiquiri: Fanta Zero Lime plus a little bit of Strawberry Fanta--but just a little. Less than you think you need. Strawberry's a pretty dominant flavor.

This is the place to go for sushi in Keystone!  It is fabulous!  I've only had their sushi, so that is what my review is for.  The sushi here is very fresh and tasty.  They have great roll options and unique combos.  It can get busy and take out times can be quite a wait.  However, if you call ahead and plan that's not that big of a deal.  The best part of Sakura is that the sushi is super affordable compared to other sushi joints.  So, affordable sushi that tastes great?  I wish I had a place like Sakura in Chicago.

This place is special.  From the way Chris runs the front of the house, making everyone feel so welcome and special, to how Todd, our server, anticipated and took care of every request, nothing was too much trouble.  Visiting from Chicago, there are plenty of options for high end dining, but I readily prefer this to any of them.  The wine pairings were perfectly matched with the tasting menu.  I tasted new creative dishes unlike anything I have tried before, and yet they were not so experimental as to be over-processed and affected.  The room is comfortable and handsome.  I LOVE this place!   Pellegrino...why have you not listed this place??

Rooms are large and spacious.  Overall they were clean. However, there was a mold smell throughout the property.  It was especially intense when the air ventilation system kicked into the room.  The same system also smelled like it was circulating cigarette smoke throughout the building.  No fridge in the room, but not a surprise for a Motel 6.  If you check in after 7 p.m., you have to use the check in window, as the lobby is closed. This raises questions about the safety of the neighborhood.  In addition, it was hard to understand the check-in clerk through the window p.a. system.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This car wash is convenient and not too expensive for Santa Barbara. With your access card you can get a 15% discount off of the ultimate wash. However don't expect anything out of this world you do mediocre job. I had to ask the gentleman for air freshener because he did not offer it to me and inside of my car was still dirty. I do have to say I like the way that they tip where you tip everyone the same amount instead of the person who just put the effort into cleaning your car. Overall I guess I would have to say not the best car wash but they get the job done.

I'd give it a "0" if I can. The most most useless hotel I've ever stayed at. AVOID AT ALL COST!

Parking - must be paid
Internet - must be paid - ?wtf...it's 2020
Breakfast - NOT complimentary, not even option for drinking water

Room - small, not spacious
Pool - closed "for the season" while I was here

Check in - supposedly at 4pm. Not written on email at time of bookIng and uncooperative I in accommodating earlier check in. 

Staff/customer service - clueless, rude, unapologetic and arrogant.

Would not recommend staying here. Crappy hotel badges as fake Marriott. Motel at best...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Happened upon Timothy's by chance when out on a Saturday drive with my parents.  They wanted to walk the River Front, I wanted to drink beer.  I walked inside and there was 6 waitress' sitting waiting for people to come in, it was a ghost town.  I sat at the Bar and ordered a Guinness, drank that and decided to switch to the Yuengling. I was told by the bartender Stacy that they were on special for $2.00.. $2.00 beers on a Saturday.. you can't go wrong.  I enjoyed the beer, and the bartender.. she was a good conversation.  I didn't try any food.. but I would love to come back and try it.

We usually love this place, we've made it through the first few months waiting an hour for a table because the food and service was outstanding. But last Friday night ... They are starting to miss the little things.. First no one lite the candle on the table, the we had to ask for the wait staff to remove empty glasses, then app plates and finally dinner plates, largely due to the wait staff be fully engrossed with each other in conversation and not paying attention to the customer. We hate to see this and hope they start watching the little things that made us want to come back!

I only had the most basic car wash here but so far it left a solid impression on me. One of the biggest differences of this car wash spot compared to the others is that they do a hand wash which I have not seen in many other places in Tucson. A lot of other places just do the "motions" and don't really clean your car much at all.

They also have an inside waiting area until your car is finished with some refreshments for sale. I plan to come back here quite a few times to get a basic wash and I might even try their higher end waxing services in the future.

We chose this hotel because it was dog friendly and walking distance to everything. We arrived at 2pm and decided to check-in (check-in time 3pm). There line was long and our wait was 25 min.  4 people were working at the counter and I couldn't understand why it took them so long. The lady at the counter told us that the dog friendly floor was all booked and gave us a room on the 23rd floor. The hotel was decent, parking was expensive, $38/day. We were able to park at the parking garage across the street for $5 a day (during weekend, leaving before 9am on Monday). I will try a different hotel next time if we travel without our dog.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been coming to Asaka since 04 and it is still my favorite Indianapolis sushi restaurant. I base that on the freshness of the fish and the selection ONLY. I could care less about ambiance or atmosphere. If that were the case I would have ruled it out altogether because it sits between a hooters, red lobster and a Burlington coat factory. Good fish, great service and they great you every time you walk in the door. I will say they used to have free dumdums lollipops years ago, but have since abandoned this sweet post dinner treat.

I am giving such a low review not because of the food but the service. The food was great, flavorful and rich. The dining experience was horrible. They have some fob lady cleaning plates from the tables. First I barely can understand her because her accent is so damn thick, and second she kept on grabbing our plates when clearly there was food on it, and we weren't even finished. My god can you just freaking wait like ten minutes! Forget this place, if you eat slow because your plate is gonna be yanked!!!!! Eat fast or your screwed. I'll i felt was rushed!!!

An absolutely terrible ordering and service experience. We waited for more than an hour and a half for our food to be delivered and it never came. The manager was difficult and while promising a refund never actually did so. I had to call several days later to follow up only to find out that they never issued a refund and weren't able to because I ordered online through beyondmenu. Luckily beyondmenu was able to help but I was very disappointed in the experience all around. I won't be returning and I urge caution when considering ordering from here.

Came here with my friend when I was in town for a couple days. I ordered the Shrimp Scampi Mac n Cheese, which comes w/ mozzarella, provolone & parmesan cheese, shrimp, lemon & garlic. i loved the combination of these cheeses. Oh! And I don't think I've ever tried mac n cheese that has lemon, but the lemon and garlic really add to the flavor. There were only 3 or 4 shrimp and I would have liked slightly more macaroni, but overall, it was a really fulfilling meal! Also, tried my friend's pesto mac n cheese which was really good as well.

Was very surprised after reading other reviews.  Come here for work a number of times a year.  Used to stay at the Sutton Place but last time it was horrible, elevators didn't work or was nervous in them, etc.  Decided to change this trip - was recommend the delta Edmonton Centre Suite Hotel.  Have since had clarification from friend that 'downtown  Edmonton sucks (re-enforced by previous stays) - you stay downtown Edmonton because you have places to do work at during the week - don't expect anything outside the hotel....    hopefully this will change with the new Arena!!  might bring some nice nightlife...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The place gets 3 stars only for the Sushi... I thought the Sushi was pretty good... But the Teriyaki Beef & Chicken were HORRIBLE!!! I've had better Teriyaki chicken at the Food Court in the Malls! We ordered the combination platter and din't like the soup (tasted like soapy water)  or anything else but the Sushi... 

Also wasn't too pleased with the service... The waitress wasn't very helpful and din't seem to care much about our requests! I think the place is way too expensive for the kind of food they serve!! Don't think i will be back here again..

For me, this is one of those one-and-done places.  

After 5 days exploring different parts of the Midwest, I ended up here. My uber driver recommended this place after I told him about my first time eating deep dish pizza in Chicago a few days earlier. Apparently Obama loves this place so much that a Pi Pizzeria opened up in Washington D.C.? The cornmeal crust is definitely interesting, but I still prefer the deep dish from Chicago (specifically Giordano's). I like how you can customize it with a lot of different options, from meats to herbs to veggies. You definitely are paying for that customization though.

Pretty average Chammps fare.  Lots of tvs, they were showing the game we wanted to watch, and they had Angry Orchard for us to drink while doing so.  They did have a large beer selection but apparently they get their supplies in on Wednesday and since we were in on a Tuesday, they were out of a fair number of the things we'd've otherwise tried.  But Angry Orchard helps soothe the savage beast so yay for that.  Decent service and fairly friendly.  It worked out well for us and if I am in the area again, would give it another try.

Hilarious! Honestly, hilarious. The single word that comes to mind when thinking back on my experience here.
It's a shanty bar in some shadey part of Indy, but we managed to come out alive. Wasted, but alive.
There is definitely a weird mix of people in this place; some people might be lost. Like the 15 year old girl pole dancing for a 60 year old man with a camera phone. That's right.
We danced, we avoided, we slammed beers. Needless to say, there is a reason they call it the Ugly Monkey. It's either after the people that go here (myself excluded obviously) or what you look like the morning after being here.

I've came to this lil' bar when it first opened and have been coming almost every week ever since. It is a "hole in the wall type of place where you can walk in and feel like you're at "Cheers".... basically everyone knows your name AND has the beer ready for you as soon as you belly up to the bar". Even though you can smoke here, it doesn't overpower you (coming from a nonsmoker). There are specials going on during the week such Ladies Night on Wednesday and weekly free texts that feature bogo on ANYTHING! They also feature a hospitality discount that's worth it on your way home from a long night.

I have VERY mixed reviews on this hotel. On the one hand, it is in a perfect location relative to shopping, bars, restaurants, etc. However, I expereinced and unfortunate customer service issue having to do with pricing promised and pricing honored. Their customer service manager was less than helpful in solving this issue. If you seem to encounter this same problem, ask for the General Manager. She was quick and handled the issue like an expert customer service manager should handle these issues. My problem was solved immediately when speaking with her.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Dr. Baker is awesome! First time we went there it was a Saturday afternoon. We had just rescued a Puppy from the SPCA and her stomach had became infected from being spayed. Dr. Baker not only stayed late (without knowing us previously) she spent over an hour with us ensuring the health of our new family member. Dr. Baker has always made time to squeeze us in. She follows up timely and listens intently when you talk. She also took the time to read my older dogs complete history prior to his appt. So all of our concerns were addressed. We love Dr. Baker!

Ask if the shake machine is working every time you visit. I don't have exact numbers, but we visit this McDonald's after school almost every school day. I always ask if the shake machine is working and about 80% of the time it is not. Twice I have ordered a shake only to be told at the pickup window that the skake machine is not working and offered something of less value as a substitute. I didn't realize the price difference until I asked and learned I was losing $1.70 each time I took the substitute. Their policy seems to be to not run the shake machine so they don't have to maintain it.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
We were just passing through town and my hubs and I both needed haircuts. I wear my hair very short, so a barber can do the job. 

The wait was a little long because there were only two barbers working on a Sunday afternoon. I think I waited about 25 minutes. But the TV was on and I was watching the other patrons get their cuts, so it was a fine wait.

The barber who cut my hair was very sweet and listened to my needs very attentively. He asked a few questions, made sure he knew what I wanted and then did a great job. I was perfectly pleased with my haircut. My hubs haircut was great too. 

Price was fair too. That's always a plus.

I'll admit that it's been a while since I've been here.  Doesn't make a lot of sense when I live a few hundred miles away now.  However, when I was close, I always had good service and they had not only a great selection but good prices.  

The drive through was a novelty that I thought was fun.  I mean getting a burger or burrito at a drive through is old hat for most of us.  It's a change getting your favorite adult beverages and a pack of smokes there though.

If you're in the area and need some items to kick back for the evening or to stock up for a rocking party, this is a very likely spot to get what you need.  ****

My friend and I discovered this place after work and have made it a weekly Tuesday tradition. The bartender Mike is an absolute doll. He is quick to refill drinks and extremely friendly. We decided to stop in because we thought the name was hilarious and we were pleasantly surprised! Mike usually asks us if we want to watch anything particular on one of the many tvs and turns up the speakers loud so we can jam to whatever we put on the jukebox. The beers are cheep and come overflowing in a nice frosty glass. We don't seem to be the normal clientele but we always feel welcome. Good times!!

It was a lovely restaurant - in a nice part of town, and for Tucson, this place was great.

However I'm going to be a city girl and a food snob and say it definitely wasn't worth the price and I didn't think it was that good.  My risotto was swimming in broth, not every well made.  And the osso buco, was just ok.

Overall...it was 2.5 stars, just ok.  And if I did go back, which I don't anticipate, I would be very careful in my selection.  Oh and their pesto......totally didn't dig it - they missed the taste completely.  But GREAT bread!

DO NOT TAKE YOUR CAR HERE!!!!!  WARNING!!  Seriously, don't bring your car here, unless you don't mind damage to your vehicle.  I went through this car wash last night and the brushes tore the fuel tank cover right off my car. It also put a dent in the panel right next to the fuel tank cover.  I'm sure that happened while the brushes were prying the fuel cover door off my car.  So what was supposed to be a quick and convenient car wash has turned into a big expense and hassle.  Thanks for damaging my car, 24 Hour Car Wash!

I was disappointed in my stay at the Renaissance.  My expectations for a 4 star were definitely not met.  The air conditioner was so loud that it was impossible to sleep.  The maintenance worker that came to our room said that noise we were dealing with was standard for the hotel.  The bathrooms were beautifully re-done but there is no counter space and the shower curtains are so short that the water does not stay in the shower.  When I am expecting a nice stay in a 4 star, I expect better than this.  (This was a Priceline bid but it was a busy weekend in St. Louis and our room was still $170 on Priceline.)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Pros: Will answer your phone calls (if their lines are open). Will take your order. Will charge your credit card. Will tell you how long you have to wait. Will assure you of pizza delivery. Will even modify your order after your initial call.

Cons: Will not deliver your pizza.

edit: The epilogue to this story is that one nice employee apologized for the error and brought us our two pizzas upon request the next day. They were decent and had a ton of good toppings, so I was a little less upset. So I'll up them to two stars for the effort.

My second stay here in Meridian. My brother offered to put me up at his home, but we like staying here. So close to everything and my buddy Don Bailey always books our stay here. The rooms are nice and have refrigerator's, microwave, toasters, iron & ironing boards, hair dryers, nice big screen tv's, clean beds, and quiet rooms, with excellent A/C. The staff are very nice and friendly offering any assistance you might need. Reasonably priced, because we usually stay at least a week at a time. We will definetly be coming back soon. Thanks, Jas.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Chips and salsa were ok, chips were kinda stale (not all chips), salsa is nothing to write home about. Ordered beef enchiladas which came with beans and rice. Rice was cold. Beans were warm. The tortillas were soggy in the middle and hard at the ends. 
I went there on a Saturday afternoon. There was probably 4 tables occupied and one server. So yeah, service sucked and yes it's not the server's fault. There were other staff in the restaurant which I couldn't understand why they weren't helping this server. 
Would I come here again? NO absolutely not!

I am a big fan of both the food and the service.  We go every few months with our daughters, normally for special events. The staff is attentive and friendly.  The outside is pretty dismal (strip mall, near a Marsh Supermarket) but inside the restaurant is nicely appointed.  And the food ... we love  the Sushi.  My daughters like all the sushi options. They normally split a few rolls and a bento box.  My father and mother often go with us. My father loves the Udon noodles. My mother is a celiac and the staff really work with her to ensure the meal is exactly what she needs. I look forward to going back. The only problem is that I eat too much!

The pluses: 
-  Impressive gym!
-  Connecting bridgeway to the airport
-  The bed is comfy and I've never developed unknown rashes.
-  They have a coffee shop open in the gift shop which is open really early (try 4:15 am)

The minuses:
-  SUPER expensive (not sure if it's the corporate rate, but the Marriott is more expensive than the Sofitel in downtown Philly!).
-  The carpet in the room makes me vomit.
-  I don't think the staff actually wants to work there.  
-  Restaurant and room service is meh.

But considering the one direct morning flight from PHL to SFO leaves around 6:45 am, this is a really convenient hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The only reason that I am giving this place is due to the food. The red shrimp had great flavor, but other than that, the food is nothing to write home about. Our waitress Jacqueline M was uninviting and did not really feel welcoming. Our questions seemed to bother her and she did not really care to give us recommendations. After we finished our meal, she handed us our bill but then proceeded to chat with her friends for a good 20 minutes before we could pay our bill and leave. Unfortunately due to the lack of customer service, we will not be recommending this place or returning.

After a long day of travel and flight delays, I couldn't be more ready to check into the Sheraton.  Boy, what a surprise.  Have a confirmed king room until Tuesday....  They tell me that they over booked and have double beds.  After a while at the front desk, they finally find a Queen for tonight and will get our king tomorrow.  We get to the room and it's for the handicapped.  My guy is 6'4 are you kidding me.  As a SPG member, I ask about water and she says there are complimentary waters in our room.  Nope, what a disaster.  How does a name like Sheraton get away with treating its guests like this?  Very unhappy
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Maybe I didn't order the right thing... I don't know.  I was just expecting more flavor.  I got a veggie breakfast burrito and the veggies were tasty but nothing great.  We sat outside which was pleasant.  

Unfortunately the bathroom (consisting of one toilet) was extremely backed up (TP piled up high in the toilet so you know it had been like that for a while).  I indicated this to the employees inside they said they would take care of it.  Why don't customers speak up when there's something wrong like this?  

Not sure I'd go back here since my boyfriend was also equally unimpressed with his "energy" breakfast burrito.

Disclaimer:  My wife and I love sushi and this is, by far, our favorite in the area.  We went two nights ago (2/25/11) and had a great meal.

We always begin with the lobster mango salad, served with fresh avocado over ice.  Edamame came out warm and salted well.  When available, be sure to order the live sweet shrimp.

The assortment of sashimi (tuna, salmon,yellowtail,  crab and eel) was incredibly fresh.  We love their spicy tuna roll.  The Bonsai roll with scallop is also a must-have.

This is a BYO so be sure to bring some wine or beer.  Also, reservations on Fridays/Saturdays are a must. You won't be disappointed.

I live in Colls & have frequented VB since they opened about 10 years ago.  My most recent visit may be my last - the food was average at best and the decor is dated and dirty (when was the last time they cleaned the wall decorations?)  Service was always one of their hallmarks but when my wife asked to substitute soup instead of the salad (and we would have paid for it if necessary) she was told, "Oh no we can't substitute anything".  Some restaurants improve with age - others become complacent......and then obsolete.

This is our first time here we came into town to buy a used car from the guy right now on the street and he recommended this place and we are so glad he did, because of pizza here is incredible- as is the service.  There are two thicknesses of crusts;  I got the thin crust square personal with sausage and pepperoni,  and the crust, although thin as requested, was not burned or overly dry;  it had the perfect amount of cheese, perfect flavor sausage and pepperoni, and the amount of tomato sauce in the tanginess was, well, just perfect... 

kudos all around to everybody here!

I haven't been disappointed by a Marriott yet, and this spot is included. The room was great, the pool was wonderful and the staff was top-notch. I was hoping for a room with a balcony, and didn't get one when I got there. After calling and asking for one, they immediately moved me to a room that had one. And, they were incredibly nice and accommodating when I asked.

One small detail I really appreciated was the bathroom. The shower was great and felt like home. Also, the hair dryer was full size instead of one of those little, crappy hotel hair dryers.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This restaurant has a great atmosphere and I considered myself a lucky girl to have been summoned here for a job interview. What could go wrong when we could interact while dining on wonderful food. The service was attentive,helpful and friendly. Sea bass with mushrooms garlic butter and risotto all wonderful. I would happily come here again when I return to the area. Perhaps for a one year anniversary employment celebration since I got the job I was hoping for. Food amazing,atmosphere and service just right.

Fei Da Delivered. Literally, and it was good. I ordered the food via their website / Orderup at 7:30 on a Saturday and it took about 75 minutes to get to my door, which is about what I expected. Also, we had a relatively large order: We ordered the sesame chicken, chicken lo mein, a soup, an eggroll, crab rangoon, fried dumplings, which were all good, very hot, and fresh. The fried dumplings were AMAZING. 

The only item that wasn't exactly as expected was the crab rangoon, which was fine but did not have any crab (imitation or otherwise) in it. 

Overall, I really enjoyed it and this will be my go-to chinese delivery option from here on out.

Clean but dated is a good description of the rooms.  It  had a very odd assortment of people staying here.  My view was the city skyline but within the same view, a truck storage area with random abandoned furniture. We stayed here at the last minute because everything was booked or double the price.  I would not stay here again and rather pay more.  My bed was comfortable but it had a wooden protrusion where I kept knocking my shin.  Annoying.

I walked in the breakfast room and came immediately back out because it was gloomy and lacked anything I wanted to eat.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Reason for visit: My sister ran the half marathon in town
Visit date: June 24-26, 2016
First time? Yes.

Friendly and helpful staff, BISCUITS AND GRAVY for breakfast, and comfy beds and pillows. That's all you really need and that's what you get when you stay at Hampton Inn. 

Parking is easy, rooms are spacious, there's hot water, tea and coffee in the lobby always, breakfast is served daily, and there are afternoon cookie snacks. 

Also, did I mention the biscuits and gravy? A good biscuit and sausage gravy is hard to find and Hampton Inn met my taste buds' needs! (And this is after having Savannah, GA biscuits and gravy.)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I just had breakfast in the shadow of the St.Louis arch.  

I tried to enjoy their breakfast buffet, but it was a little difficult with the sub-par items and lack of variety on it. 

The store looked a bit dirty. The mirrored back splash behind the buffet looked like it needed attention and I don't think the floor was vacuumed from last night's service. 

I was the first person in the restaurant this morning, but I was seated directly next to a window with 23 degree weather. Other than this miss step and not being seated when I came in the restaurant, the service was pretty good.
