I'm your typical Starbucks girl because it's always convenient and I know exactly what I want. Once in awhile, I like to jump out of my comfort box and try new places. 

My friend and I only went through the drive-thru but I'm completely obsessed with this local coffee house. I had the biscotti flavored coffee, and it was delightful. I can't comment on consistency but whoever the barista was that day, my coffee was on point. Not too sweet, and just enough of a coffee kick to make me write this review. But, I do suggest that this coffee come with an actual biscotti. Wouldn't that be tasty and cute?

Just looking for a snack while we waited on our tire being fixed at Discount Tires we decided to try this place and were glad we did.   We had the crab puff and a couple of drinks then decided to get duck mu shu to go which isn't on the menu but they made it for us specially.  It was the best duck I think I have had in AZ. Lots of meat,  really crispy and tasty sauce.  The crab puffs were freshly cooked, very hot and crispy.  Loved them.  They also served good wines and beer.  The service was very helpful and friendly.   We will be back to pick up another duck mu shu next week I think.

My boyfriend and I ordered take-out to eat in our room and the food was pretty good.  We shared a Santa Fe Burger and Fish and Chips.  The burger was cooked to a perfect medium as requested and the meat was really tasty.  The burger came with a side of fries, potato salad or cole slaw and we had the potato salad, which was a little bland.  The Fish and Chips came with four huge pieces of fish and a ton of fries.  The total including tax came to about $25, which isn't too bad for the amount of food that we got.  The food was pretty decent...nothing mind-blowing but then again, what do you expect from Reno?

Every once in awhile, we all stumble upon a meal we'll remember for years to come.  For me, that meal is Blackfish.  One word: extraordinary.  I've fallen in love with the place and have been dreaming about going back ever since.  The agnolotti in brown butter w/ sage was the most delectable pasta I've ever had.  I'm still trying to figure out how Chip Roman crisped up that sage... it was heavenly.  The poulard was the most tender I've eaten.  I sampled everyone else's dish at my table and everything was a taste explosion.  If I could give Blackfish 6 stars instead of 5, I would.

I've been to Pizza D many times and most of the times I've liked it. The reasons I am giving it 3 stars is because is very inconsistent. I ordered the Caesar  salad one time and it was delicious another day had so much sauce that I could barely eat it. Today I went back and had the strawberry arugula salad and it was ok. What really threw me off was the broccoli rolls they were so greasy I fell sick all day long. 

So all and all I've had bad experiences but I've also had good ones. I would probably come back and hope I get them on good day.

We stopped here overnight during our cross country move.  This location is odd as far as Motel 6 goes; it's clearly been a different brand in a former life.  The furnishings are definitely a step up from other Motel 6 locations, though they're old and pretty run down (the chair in our room appeared to have its leg stapled back on; I'm glad I didn't sit in it!).  This also means that unlike the other Motel 6 locations we stayed at, this one had an elevator and luggage carts.  When you are traveling with a cat, it's very nice to not have to lug all of her stuff up the stairs.  Overall, though, our stay was pleasant and uneventful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The patio area was great for people watching and especially if the weather is nice, like yesterday! The service was very slow, if you plan on eating here during the week and you have time constraints such as work you may want to choose another place.  We were there for an hour and a half.  It took a very long time to get drinks and the menus.  

I ordered the ravioli with cilantro pesto sauce with chicken.  The ravioli was good but was expecting something else out of the sauce.  I was excited to try it because its different than your every day tomato and cream sauces but I felt it was lacking something!

Hip hotel, with a down-to-earth staff that still maintains being efficient and pleasant.

Room was clean, with little signs of wear.  Shower door had an inefficient design thus letting a good bit of water leak out.  No big deal, but make sure you employee a doubled over towel at the entrance of the stall.

Pool was convenient and clean, if but a bit overly chlorinated.

Complementary internet was usable, but ultimately slow.

Overall, if you're passing through our great state and need a rest from the road or visiting the aquarium and Philly for the weekend, I would recommend spending your nights here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This hotel is depressing. The beds are comfortable but bring your own pillow! The walls are like paper. You will hear everything and I mean everything. The front door has a breeze so if you don't set the heater you will see your own breath. The hotel is very clean and the housekeeping doesn't miss a beat. They did an awesome job. I have never stayed at a Holiday Inn before so this is my first impression. I won't be staying at another one unless it is my only choice. I thought this company not only put up new signs but remodeled their hotels. Guess it was just the signs and marketing.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I have never been more petrified as I was in this McDonald's.  (you can see my last mcdonald's review was scary... but this place SERIOUSLY made the worst Boston McDonald's look like Burlington, VT  Applebee's)
Why was breakfast served until 11am on a weekday?

I was one of maybe 20 people in the place... I would estimate that 4 weren't homeless meth addict hookers.   no joke, it was scary.  i put my hoodie on and started my little twitchy-fake-crazy routine so that people didn't suspect me of having an actual wallet.

Just don't go there... unless you are a meth addict who wants a 10am breakfast.

I'm not a frequent HI guest (I usually do Starwood/Sheraton etc.), but I was pleasently surprised.

PRO:
- Refurnished bedding and bathroom
- Relatively clean
- Different types of pillows that you could even order (firm, soft, u-shaped, etc.)
- Free Wifi in the room

CON:
- The bathroom has NO LOCK! Really? How do you have a room with two double beds and not have a locking bathroom? In addition you could hear the bathroom user's "business" taking place through the door quite easily.
- Old TV. Not a big deal, but still a con.

Overall a decent hotel near UCSB or if you are going wine tasting but a couple miles away from downtown Santa Barbara.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The place is very worn and run down looking, both in the common areas and in the rooms.  The room furniture is WAY overdue for replacement -- the desk was beat up, the desk chair fabric had stains in it, the carpet floor in the room was dirty and stained.  And it is so close to the highway, that even with the 1960's style air conditioner on "high", it is as if your bed is sitting out next to the highway...  it is very noisy with traffic noise even in the middle of the night.  The only plus side is that the staff is friendly.  (There is free wifi, but it does not work very well.)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We come to Clearwater once a year for vacation and this restaurant is always on our "must eat" list. Main dishes and pizza are wonderful- literally can't go wrong. The desserts are usually wonderful as well. However, on this visit we received a visibly burnt cannoli. It tasted horrible- not only burnt, but like it was cooked in very old oil. There were 5 of us and we ordered appetizers, main courses and desserts. Our waiter refused to replace the cannoli, stating that it was perfectly fine. We have eaten cannoli all over the US, and I can assure you it was NOT fine. Very disappointing end to our much-anticipated visit.

In a first in more than 30 years of dining out, my husband and I, sheepfaced, sent back both entrees at Moro. Appalling. My boar was reminiscent of an undercooked pork chop and my husband's bronzino was so fishy he feared to eat it. Both replacement dishes -- squishy pasta with seafood and dry filet eignon -- missed the mark. But by then we just wanted to get the H-E-double hockey sticks outta there.

We are $150 bucks poorer but ever so much the wiser. Sorry, Moro. You cannot rest on your laurels. This was a special occasion night for sophisticated patrons who found you sorely lacking.

An older parishioner at church knew I worked down the street from Angelo's and commented that he and his wife used to live in Black Jack and the pizza at Angelo's was outstanding. Since today was a school day with no kids present, I decided to check out Angelo's for a quick lunch. 

I was the only person in the restaurant. It was very quiet. Since I was eating alone, I did not order a pizza but had the Italian meatball sandwich. Great service. Great food. I brought some takeout menus back so the staff members at my school could patronize this wonderful place. Support a wonderful small business!

My wife and I had recently spent lunch one weekend here.  We were immediately greeted in as we approached the door.  

The menu selection was good, but this time we stuck with the lunch specials.  I ordered the meatball sandwich.  My wife ordered pasta with meat sauce.  We both got to enjoy a cup of clam chowder.  That really hit the spot for me.  It was easy for us to go through the basket of bread provided for us.  

The sandwich seemed pretty good.  I quickly ate it without hesitation.  Overall our meal was good and service was very good.  The price was decent since we ordered the lunch specials.

I was pretty happy to have lunch here.

One thing that irks me  when your food arrives cold and you're one of 15 people in the entire place.  

When asked if they had  a guacamole tostada. The answer was a definitive no! It didn't seem like the waitress was too happy to be there.  And yes both items were cold. I had them redo the enchilada.

If you want below par service this is the place. Ugh so disappointed! I expected more considering I drove across town to get here.

They do know how to make it hot because my second enchilada was piping hot as opposed to the 1st!.

Sorry for the poor review...

I met a cousin here for lunch while in town and was skeptical. I LOVE the Mellow Mushroom and at the time, there wasn't one where I live, so going to Nashville and not going to the Mellow, I was worried. And while I think they are two totally different places, I loved Pie in the Sky, too. They had happy hour going on which is always a bonus and we split a pizza doing half and half. It was really, really good!!! Atmosphere was good and the place was busy, but not too crowded. Staff was very friendly and that always makes a huge difference! Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely go again.

The location is fantastic and any time I can get a bucket of beers - I'm pretty grateful. But this place is bro and bimbo city. Definitely a certain type of scene for a certain type of people. Nothing about this place is chill - from the obnoxious fence blocking off the beach - to the college kids still trying to figure out how their liver works. 

I will say, the view of the sunset at night is gorgeous if you can block out the noise going on behind you and actually focus on it. Also, it's wayyyyy better than the Toasted Monkey down the street.

Typical DD. Parking lot is small but inside seating is normal. Service was quick and accurate.  The staff is friendly and seem to know the regular customers that come in.

The DD is clean and well kept which is always a plus. They have a lot of folks working to keep things moving. 

Stopped off hear on our way to a business meeting but figured I would give a review.

Gave 4 stars because the DD was exactly what I expected. No point deduction, just being the normal DD. I appreciate that and even when no customers are at the counter staff is keeping busy.

Golden City used to be our favorite Chinese restaurant in the area. We would bring all our friends and family who came to visit from NYC because the food was almost as good as you could get on Mott Street! 
Lately. I would say in the past 6-8 months the food has gone down the tubes! We went back tonight just to give it the benefit of the doubt only to be served 1) stale noodles 2) dried out old spare ribs 3) nasty Peking duck 4) bad scallops that ruined the fish stir fry in XO sauce! I don't think we will be returning there!

If you have never had tacos in Goleta / Santa Barbara / Isla Vista, STOP WHAT YOU'RE DOING AND GO HERE. 

NOW. 

Lilly's Tacos is pretty much the best taco place in Goleta. They do more or less one thing: tacos. They do tacos RIGHT. 

These are as close as you'll get to authentic street / truck tacos, and they are - unlike everything else in this town - reasonably priced. Their salsas are fantastic. When they have chile verde, GET IT. Some folks say the carne asada is too salty; I think that's a personal preference. 

I would eat every ounce of carne asada in this shop if I could. 

Why are you still reading Yelp reviews? GO NOW!!

Not a good experience at all. But let me begin with the good stuff. Price wasn't bad, one night with breakfast & 2 day water park tickets. Breakfast was delicious!!!  Staff was courteous all around. 

Now the bad...our room was dirty. Hair on the floor and in every drain. Someone left a used coffee filter on the counter of the bathroom. And finally, the worst for last, urine stains all over the toilet bowl!  

We also saw a roach at the water park. 

Probably our last time here.

Oh they did, however, give us a 20% discount after complaining. Like I said, staff was courteous for sure!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I was here for a work training for a week. The rooms were great. No complaints. Clean, spacious, good amenities, and good water pressure in the shower which I hate when there isn't! We also were in their conference rooms for a week and the staff always kept refreshments and snacks coming. The staff was very friendly and the check in was the fastest I have ever expereinced. My only complaint is that when I checked in, it was about 1 hour past the approved check in time and when I arrived at my room, the housekeeper was just starting to clean it. It was ready in about 20 minutes so not to bad. For an older property, it seemed well maintained.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
this is probably my worse review so far, so listen up.

-this place is so bad if i can give it negative stars it would be -3.
the food is terrible and they are cheap on topping like seafood or meat on pasta. 

-so bad i rather eat at spaghetti factory and i hate that place too.
-salad taste like its its out of a bag that's been sitting there for 3 days.
-had a bone head waiter that didn't have a clue what he was doing.
-for what u get its expensive.
-calamari was OK but would not order again
-cant believe they feed this to humans!
-only the wine was good cuz they don't make it in house! was expensive too

Stopped for dinner and found everyone else had the same idea  found a couple of seats at the bar which turned out to be a wonderful thing. The bar is almost 3 feet deep so we had tons of room for our dinner and beverages. Roger was tending bar. He was totally slammed with orders but he and the other bar tender handled it like the pros they appeared to be. Roger got us our beverages, made suggestions about our order and was very attentive. We ordered the Fajita mini-chimis with carnitas and the Machengos with carne asada. It was served hot and flavor was DELICIOUS. Can't wait to come back SOON!

I know that this is cheap Italian food in a college town but come on. The food had little flavor, little sauce, and was a little overpriced. After reading the reviews here I kinda knew to expect it but there were some that weren't so bad so I figured we might as well. I had pasta with meat sauce. It basically was way too much pasta with hardly any sauce. And no flavor. My husband had the lasagna and said about the same. The caprese salad, which we looked forward to was okay, definitely had better. The service was quick, which is why I gave it 3 stars.

No white glove service at white glove car wash.  Not only is my car filthy, on the outside, but the inside still has a leaf on the dash and dirty Windows( inside and out), to list a few.  They didn't do express vacuum, window cleaning or even wiping the door frames.  When I tried to talk to a manager about it the employee  drove my car to the business across the way parked it and walked away.   They basically refused to help me at all! Worst customer service I have experienced for a while.  Downingtown, or Exton friends avoid this place like the plague!

We recently stayed here a few weeks ago and enjoyed the hotel. The reason for the  1 star review is we have yet to receive a refund for money they took out of our account to hold the room. We paid through orbitz and they still charged us on the debit card. We've called over and over and my husband even spoke to the manager in person before we left. The manager, Misha Hudson, assured us we would receive a full refund within a few days. We have been calling and calling with no return call back. It is very frustrating. If not for this we would have given this hotel 4 or 5 stars. The valet guy OJ was great as well as the room and bar downstairs.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
OK on the first visit of the review below the owner had to correct what the barber in the last chair did. He did his best. Went back today and the barber in the second chair faded my hair up and it's spotless! Amazing guys! Owner is so nice and friendly. Just avoid the guy in the back!

Possibly the worst haircut I have ever ever ever ever received!  Showed a picture, haircut looks nothing like the picture and then he tried to blame it on me and say he asked this and asked that. I showed you a pic, if what I showed you and the questions you asked won't look the same then don't do it! @%&-''$%:  Seriously a very angry patron right now.

Reading some of the other reviews I have to say that if this is the best MExican available in the Brandon area, I really feel sorry for folks that live there.  The atmosphere was pleasant (there was a live mariachi band there the night we ate).  I always judge a Mexican Restaurant by the quality of my favorite mexican dish, fajitas.  The fajita ,eat (steak) at Luna's was kind of bland, but the accompaniments were good, so overall not too bad, but not enough to make me say wow.  I would eat there again to try some of their other dishes.

Really great and quick customer service. The staff are kind and knowledgeable and the store manager is so welcoming, he greets every person that walks through the door! Best part is you can come here and not feel pressured to add on additional services like at other auto shops. No, you need to get these wipers or your car will blow up or you need to change your air filter right now or you'll die from monoxide poisoning, which is nice for someone like me who doesn't know a lick about cars and can be suckered into buying any and everything!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We were excited to try Fiesta Chicken we bought a family pack with rice and beans. Upon opening our box we saw that the pieces of chicken were very small the drumsticks were honestly not that much bigger then my thumbs. We went for it grabbed a tortilla and took a big bite. The chicken was hard, not very fresh, marinated in a slightly spicy rub, which my kids weren't a fan of.  The rice tasted of freezer burn and was not good at all, the beans were great. Although the beans were fresh and tasty this place is called Fiesta chicken not Fiesta beans. I was disappointed I don't think we will visit any time soon.

Stayed for St. Patrick's day weekend 2015. No complaints about room. Large and comfortable. BEWARE of the valet parking. First night they left my car unlocked and unattended. Left to go eat and go to the quarter.  Got in late, had to park on the street, go find the valet attendant. Found him inside studying. Next morning called to get my car brought up, No answer. Went downstairs to get my car. At first they couldn't find my car, as the attendant from the night before didn't log it in.

What a freaking mess!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: One of my go-to restaurants when I'm anywhere near Delaware.  The meatballs are worth the flight from Italy in my opinion.  Tender and huge, a must-get!  We've also enjoyed the calamari in a red pepper sauce as a starter.  Gnocchi Verde is easily my favorite dish.  Made with ricotta, so delicate and the Verde sauce with fresh tomatoes, spinach and crab meat are so damn good.  You won't go home hungry either.  We have also ordered the Peanut Butter and Chocolate Italian butter cakes.  Incredible!   Staff is always friendly and ready to make you feel at home.  Don't pass this place by.  Plenty to see in the area as well.

Location is great, views from the water-side rooms are awesome. Aaaaand that's about as much positivity as I can muster. 
This place was tired in the 90s, and has been continually used and abused since then with little regard for cleanliness and aesthetics. 
So much potential, but the owners have clearly made the decision to put exactly ZERO money into updates or repairs. There's deferred maintenance EVERYWHERE you look. 
It's okay for a boozy weekend with the boys, but the  classy ladies are going to be grossed out by this place.
Just make sure you understand what you're getting into.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The rooms are a little worn check in with a challenge with the young man with a wrinkled shirt looks like I woke him up rooms are located not sure this is up to standards for Marriott it's probably a a franchisee.  There is a Residence Inn across the parking lot that might be the better choice. I asked for the manager's name Himalayan challenged or sleepy night auditor tried to give me the engineering managers name so I still don't know the general manager to share my comments but I'm not sure I'd recommend this as a quality Hotel
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: 3 weeks ago I had my hair butchered by someone over at Fantastic Sams on Waters and Sheldon. She literally cut my hair twice as short as it should have been and I was incredibly upset. She also completely screwd up my highlights. i finally got the courage up to go to a salon to see if my hair could somehow be salvaged. The lady there was absolutely fantastic! She not only fixed my hair but she made it sooooo much better than what I wanted before my first haircut! I could not be happier and will be recommending her to all of my friends.

I went to Ajia a few times in college, always for the all you can eat. It's a great deal and you can really walk away satisfied. The all you can eat menu is a little sparse, though. I've been to other all you can eat sushi places and have seen more variety. As mentioned by other reviewers, the wait can be a little long between rounds - I guess they're just waiting for that rice to expand and you can't eat any more!

To their credit though, the last time I went was with some friends to see who could eat the most sushi. Suffice it to say, almost 200 pieces were eaten between 3 people. It was awesome.

This place smells funny when I first walked in but the pizza was pretty good & not greasy at all. 

It was our last day in Reno & I was hungover as poo so my boyfriend saw this spot as we were heading out & we decided to grab a few slices of pizza, the service was alright, the dude that was at the register was on his cell phone 24/7, but he was very attentive when we were asking him questions & ordering.

The prices were good as well, had like a 3 slice combo & a drink & it was fairly cheap. 

Overall I would come to this spot again. :)

Not a very good experience at this Barber Shop.  First thing I explained to Steve the Barber was that I had a Wedding on Saturday (it was Thursday when I got my cut).  He proceeded to shave my head and I told him I wanted a fresh shave around all the edges and outlines and then to my beard as well...

I left the shop less than satisfied.  He even nicked my head in several places so that it will be seen in my WEDDING PICTURES!  Not cool.  And they charged me $45!  Def not worth it.  And I also had to fix up my shave on my neck because it was not close enough.  

Sorry, but I will not be coming back.

We arrived late and with a reservation. We were told that there was only a smoking room left, but my bf has asthma so that wasn't an option. When they finally found a room for us, they just slid me the key and ignored me. I heard the staff tell anyone else with a reservation was out of luck.

Cons;
There is no elevator
The bedding was stained and I don't think the outside covering had been eased in a long time
The bathroom had not been deep cleaned in a long time
Carpets were gross
Breakfast is not included 

Pros:
Quiet location
Beds were comfortable 
Checkout was easy 
Location is really easy to find off of the freeway
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Awesome and flavorful burritos!

I didn't go in but while I was in SB, my friend went to the store and stopped by there to get some grub before heading back to his dad's place in SB. He ordered 3 burritos with a side of beans and rice. The food was quite tasty and good and would rank up there amongst my favorite Mexican restaurants. The chips were pretty good too. The salsas were alright and runny. They were both mild and would like them more spicy.

I didn't give it the 5th star because it is the first time I've eaten there and needed to try it out a couple more times before doing so. Plus I would need to go in there myself!

Yum! Tried this out due to the great reviews and we were not disappointed.  Got the marinated pork, beef tongue, and the crispy tripe, and they were all great!  Also, if you have an extra dollar, be sure to get the grilled onion and jalapeño - I think it was worth it!  

The only cons to this place was that I wish they had a more robust salsa bar.  I know I shouldn't compare to the ones we have in LA, but my expectations of a salad bar are tainted by what I usually get in Tacos el Gavilán (which had beans, lettuce, jalapeños on top of the salsas and radish).

Our gate was right next to this place so we tried it for lunch.  The food was alright, nothing spectacular.  The beer selection was pretty deep.  Tons to choose from on the tap.  

The wait staff was pretty substandard.  They seemed more into talking with each other rather than doing there jobs.  We were right next to the register so we got to hear all the goods and gossip about the other customers and wait staff.  

Anyways, it's probably better if you just go to drink and don't mind waiting.  If you are looking for food, it would be better to go elsewhere.

Our group stopped by here since we heard about it from Guy Fieri on Diners, Drive-ins and Dives.

The over all look of the restuarant is pretty interesting. They keep with the trailer theme very nicely. The service was good as well and seemed really friendly. The food over all is ok. I had the Trucker Mac & Cheese which was cheesy enough, but felt the texture was not as great since the different cheeses were separating.

Overall was an ok experience however we might skip this place the next time we're in the area.

Open early in the morning!   

After a long night at work and not in my home city; but, desperate for a haircut, I had to "YELP" a barber open early am.  Fortunately I came across D & D Barbers and I was there by 0745.  Already two people ahead of me this morning but it was still less the a 30 minute wait.  Deb was friendly, knowledgeable & fixed me up quickly.  

There is plenty of parking in front and a ATM inside since they are a cash business.  I will be more then happy to visit D & D Barbers next time I'm in need.

This was our first experience and we were not disappointed.  The place was recommended as having the best chicken fried steak breakfast.  Share the meal with hubby, just ordered an extra egg.  We substituted biscuits and gravy instead of toast.  What a meal!  The chicken fried steak was tender and juicy.  The hash browns were toasted on the outside and moist and flavorful in the middle.  All in all it was a great meal.  My only suggestion I would give them is to carry half & half instead of non dairy creamer so I can have coffee to wash down all of the fat and calories next time.

Only native St. Louisans like Imo's.  If you aren't familiar with St. Louis-style pizza yet and are used to traditional New York or Chicago style, you probably won't like it.  For some reason, Imo's does not use mozzarella cheese.  They use provel, a processed blend that will remind you of cheese whiz, only whiter in color.

For out-of-towners looking for good pizza in St. Louis, Racanelli's makes a good New York-style pie, Black Thorn does the best deep dish, or Pointers if you need a bunch of pizzas delivered for a party.

The customer service was alright, not the friendliest people but still able to get you a cart in a timely manner.  The location sucks as it's on a frontage road off of the highway and to get to the highway you have to drive around a bit then hope you get on the right highway.  It's not a big deal if you are from here and know the area or you've gone to Avis a bunch of times and are used to the route but if you're from out of town and trying to learn the route, look at your gps/smart phone, and trying to drive at the same time it can be a bit much.  There are better car rental places to choose from.

This was a little difficult to find, but I'm so glad we did. The service was friendly, and the waitress who served us gave us excellent hot sauce recommendations from their wall of hot sauce to complement our meals. I got the chilaquilles, which was cheesy goodness. It could've used a little more sauce but I enjoyed it. My partner got the cajeta pancakes, which were fresh and a lot of fruit. Our friends got the huevos rancheros and the Caribbean Benedict, the latter of which is perfect for someone who eats gluten free. We definitely want to come back for their Mexican night.

Great place to enjoy a fusion of Asian hot dishes. I really enjoyed their teriyaki dishes but my favorite is the general tso and lo mein dishes. They are delicious. They have an excellent sushi menu selection with options for all pallets. I personally love the nitro and kiss of dragon rolls because I love their spicy tuna. Atmosphere is great as I was able to watch my Butler Bulldogs on tv and when I came on a Saturday night they had a talented young lady singing great songs. She had a great voice and played some classics I didn't expect here to know because she seemed of a younger generation. Great place to dine in and also carry out for home.

When you  are looking for some good Mexican food and are not sure just what review to believe.... BELIEVE THIS ONE!  we did come at a very slow time (before dinner) and were seated immediately. But beyond that, the chips and salsa and the food was AHHMAZZING!! Fresh and hot and tasty and just what we were craving. The prices are very reasonable and the portions are good sized! You should not leave hungry!! 
We were surprised to see it not  at least a 4.5 star on here! It was, however 4.2 with over 920 ratings on google which is why we tried it. 
Soooo glad  we did and it is going on our favorites list!! It should go on yours too!

Delaware needs more restaurants like the Corner Bistro; ones that feature creative menus, friendly and knowledgeable staff and a welcoming atmosphere that is "cool" and "casual." 

Don't let its North Wilmington Strip Mall location deter you from dining here, whether for lunch or dinner or brunch. Some of my best experiences here have come at lunch and simply ordering a soup and sandwich and drink and sitting down at a booth in the front section of the restaurant. The food is excellent and the ambiance is relaxing. CB's wine list and dessert menu are also impressive.

Mostly good. Channel 70 Productions was in town to subcontract work to other video production companies. The shuttle came quick to pick us up at the airport and check-in was fast. Nice rooms as usual for ES. Good drinks and food at the restaurant. Friendly staff. Free wi-fi. However, it took FOREVER for outside callers to get the hotel operator to answer the phone. The little meeting areas downstairs were perfect for interviewing prospective contractors. We'd give higher marks, but someone needs to start answering the phones first.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Had an opportunity to dine here while visiting St. Louis. The place was bright, airy and clean. The staff was helpful. I chose the Shrimp Scampi Mac and Chesse. I ordered the regular size. It was really good to me. It was not overly shrimped but  I think that there was a reasonable portion of shrimp for the size and price. The taste was primarily that of shrimp scampi but it was perked up with the taste of homemade mac and chesse. It was an excellent combination. It was filling enough for lunch. I would definitely go again and try some other choices.

I was at a nearby hotel and was looking for quick and tasty takeout to bring back to the room.  Tasty = yes.  Quick... not-so-much.

Iced coffee was strong (yum), though a tad expensive at $3.50 for about 12 oz.  Bagel sandwiches were pretty good but also a little pricy at $4 for bagel thin, egg, bacon, cheese.  

It took more than 15 minutes to make the sandwiches due to electrical problems they were having in the kitchen.  Not the warm hospitality service I experienced elsewhere in N.O. as the cashiers didn't keep the customers updated on their situation and did not apologize for the delays.

Eaten here a few times and overall I feel mixed about it.  
Food is fine and prepared fresh, but nothing truely special. Staff is friendly and they provide free chips and salsa. 
However, two issues (one small, one large):
First, the place is kind of dingy, and not in a "it's authentic" way. 
Secondly, and more importantly, both times i've come here for lunch, I've had to wait 20-25 minutes for a burrito.  Now, I don't necessarily expect Chipotle-like speed, but it's really unacceptable to have to wait so long during my lunch break for a dish that is basically assembled.  

Not sure I'll return as it's not really worth the wait.

What a beautiful new Court Marriott!  The room was quiet, clean, and super comfortable.  Upon arrival, we asked about the possibility of an upgrade (using Marriott points or $$), and a one-bedroom suite was available. Wow! We were tempted to cancel the rest of our trip and just stay there for more nights!!  The room included a microwave and fridge to give it that home-away-from-home feeling and Marriott beds are always the best.  Staff was friendly, courteous and very professional.  We look forward to returning!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We decided to try out the new restaurant and it was delicious! I got three tacos - one chicken, carnitas and al pastor. They use fresh corn tortillas, cilantro and lime. Each was really good and authentic. My husband loved his chicken fajitas and couldn't stop talking about how good the rice and beans were. Totally different than what we are used to from other Mexican restaurants. One interesting thing is that the chips & salsa are not free ($3.50). We asked about it and came to find out their salsa and chips are homemade in house. It wasn't a bad thing - we didn't leave feeling overly stuffed. We will definitely be back.

My fiancé and I went here after an afternoon of wine tasting. We didn't realize they had an all you can eat deal, which we're always a sucker for. I think, though, I've been spoiled by my local favorite all you can eat place. Tomo was good but their all you can eat menu was so tiny. No sashimi options. Very few special rolls. A very small list of appetizer and warm choices. No tempura. And no dessert. Not even a hint of green tea or red bean ice cream. I left wanting more. So while I'd call their sushi adequate, the general mediocrity of all you can eat sushi was not made up for in choice.

I'm sorry but they are horrible. I went in for a gel fill (coffin shape).  I'm new to Nashville so I was excited about the whole cocktail/nail experience. Long story short. Bad customer service but the nails were the absolute worst I've ever had. Some of my nails are square some are coffin. The polish is lumpy and no two nails are remotely the same size. And every time I tried to correct her she ignored my request and spoke in a different language. My nails are so hideous, I'm embarrassed to post a picture. I was bleeding n one nail was burning. Soon as the pain went away, I took them off. STAY AWAY.

Made a reservation 4 months ago for the Philadelphia Marathon weekend in November. I got an email yesterday stating they had a computer error and they had to cancel my reservation! At this point all of the other hotels are booked! They said to call the Marathon booking group (which was passing the blame since they were the ones to overbook!) I would like to thank the Sheraton for ruining my marathon plans that I thought I had figured out a long time ago! Will be less likely to book at any Sheraton hotels now!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Garduno's had wonderful green chile picante sauce flavoring my "Fiesta Enchiladas"= one enchilada each of chicken, beef, and cheese. Yummy to the max! 

However, the service was poor for a couple reasons. 1. One person in our party had to wait for their food for almost 10 minutes after the rest of us received ours.  2. Server left before even giving us the check, so we waited for 15+ minutes, only to realize that we needed to get check from other server.  

Overall, I may give them another chance, but it's not at the top of my list.

I have been coming here for a while for my eyebrows. But today was my first time getting a different service. It's my daughters birthday ski got her a mani pedi and I opted for the pedi only. We loved how friendly everyone was and accommodating. She mentioned that it was her birthday and he gave her complimentary flower design on her nails. She absolutely loves them. My toes look amazing and my legs feel so soft after the massage. The prices were very reasonable. We will have to make this a regular treat for sure. Thank u!

I used to love going here years ago, but things have changed. I tried the "Japanese" food this time instead of the sushi. Our server was great but It seemed like management had her hands tied.  We had a restaurant.com coupon but it took her a while to get it resolved because the owner wanted more documentation. The food was actually really good but there were many improvements to be made all over the restaurant. I would have been ok with these "details" if this was a "coffee shop" type of place, but it isn't. If they are going to be as expensive as they are, I definitely expect more. It'll be a while before I come here again.

Well priced hotel, but not a great location - 9th Ward. But we didn't care about location too much - we were driving everywhere. Almost brand new hotel. Rooms and furnishings were clean. Double room and had pull out couch so we could sleep family of 5 without issue. 

Breakfast food was good but very crowded unless you went early. 

Desk staff was very friendly helping out with local recommendations of places to go and what to avoid. 

Pool was small but kept the kids entertained. 

Overall would highly recommend for a family on a budget continence trip to NOLA.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I came here for dinner since it was walking distance from my hotel and had pretty good reviews.  

We got 2 rolls a rainbow roll and the pizza roll and it came to nearly $30, no drinks just 2  rolls. The prices aren't on the menu so after the underwhelming rolls I was really shocked to see the price for such a hole in the wall joint. 

The rainbow roll lacked flavor, I didn't really taste the fish and the pizza roll took forever to come out.  Only after we asked after waiting for a while did they tell us it takes 15+ minuets for it to be ready. 

The waitstaff was really nice, but it was just too expensive for really average sushi.

One of the nicest hotels I've ever stayed at, once I found the front desk... 

Almost impossible to make your way around, very little signage to help, had to find an employee to help me find where to check-in.  Parking sucks, but you're in downtown NOLA, so that's to be expected.

But oh man, do they have some posh accommodations.  Beds felt like clouds, room was beautiful, view was average (I was on the river side)... I sprung for Regency Club access and it was well worth it, the 32nd floor club was had amazing views and very good food, free wifi and attentive staff.

I will be back, now that I know my way around.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Oof...this is phenomenally good pizza. Ordered close to $100 in pizza for delivery to the local Moose Lodge #548.
Several, and I mean several, members stated it was the best local pizza they've ever had. Many, by mere habit, ordered from Scotto's, and they ALL stated this pizza was exponentially better.
Growing up in South Jersey, you come to expect good pizza. But, when you "discover" an amazing Local Pizza Joint, it's like hearing Mozart for the first time. Job well done to the Angelo's Family in Berlin. Making a great pizza is a work of art, and you've mastered it!!! Expect more orders for the Moose Lodge in the future...

I went out of my way to come here and eat when I visited Philly based on great memories I had from first trying the restaurant circa 5 years ago.  At the time, I thought it was outstanding.  I also visited last year for happy hour and thought they had decent margaritas.  This time though I must say I prefer the food at Chipotle and could not comprehend why they would ruin a drink by adding sour mix to my drink which was clearly listed on the menu as mezcal, St. Germain and lime.  Definitely would not go back!

Our new favorite Italian restaurant in the area.  The place is great.  BYOB,easy parking. Great food and the owner is a great guy,we just met him recently and feel like we've know him forever. The waitresses are all great too. We met Toni tonight and she is going to fit in just fine.  We've even ordered pizza to be delivered from the pizzeria section. We're excited to have this place in our back yard.  Give it a try,you won't be disappointed! They also have a nice area for larger groups. We are going to book for graduation party.  Welcome to the neighborhood Salvatore!  Salute!

The location is VERY convenient with a short walk to the French Quarter and nearby public transportation. Staff was very friendly and welcoming! Our room was large, very clean and well appointed but the layout of the room was a bit odd (our bathroom door opens into and hits toilette).

The bar downstairs was modern and also had great staff. The breakfast options were a little limited. Food was good but the staff was fantastic and gave us lots of good tips on where to go and what to see.

Overall, a very nice stay! Would happily stay here again the next time we're in town.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Terrible as expected! (/Desired?)
Likely the true White Castle experience!

The facility was actually nicer / cleaner than expected.  Almost too much so - everyone was slipping and sliding around on the mopped floor.  

Our order was simple (5 combos), yet they left out the fries on 4/5 (at least they got 20% right...).

The burgers / sliders were soggy, the fries were under seasoned, and the chicken rings were reminiscent of those creepy dinosaur shaped ones from the froze aisle. 

Overall - met expectations for our first (& last?) White Castle outing.  Now we know!

The location of the Montecito Inn is fabulous.  Great restaurants and shops within walking distance and there's wonderful history associated with the hotel as well. 

Our room was dated and incredibly small, the bathrooms were tiny and horribly laid out.  I couldn't go to the bathroom and not have the door hit my knees.  We could hear our neighbors in their rooms and our room was excessively hot.  When we contacted the staff  to correct the issues (they where incredibly helpful), it's just the way it was because it's an old building.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Let's just say hypothetically that you're here for a conference and you meet some association members at the bar and the tab gets to be really big and everyone disappears on you.

Staff is going to want you to pay that ginormous bill.  They are going to call security. The police are going to show up.

BUT, in the end you are only going to be asked to pay your portion.

Even though you've probably been over served, you are pleased with the outcome and tip appropriately.

They do their jobs well, even when adults are not adulting properly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This was my first time getting my hair done in Canada since I am from the states and my first time getting my hair done by a complete stranger. 

I've been a hair stylist for 13 years but unfortunately I am unable to highlight or cut my own hair. I don't have many friends here and none in the beauty industry. 

I read some reviews and decided to give Kristen a chance! She was awesome and I am in love with my hair color. I went from brassy blonde to a lovely Ash sombre, Bravo! I'll be coming back as a client.

I would never think twice about going here if it wasn't for the yelp reviews. It's a hole in the wall but the food is delicious and authentic (I've never been to Mexico, but compared to other South Philly taquerias this one is awesome). While it's not the nicest restaurant I've eaten in, everyone I ate with enjoyed their food (california style steak tacos, fried plantains, plantain and pork burrito, steak burrito, fish tacos, guacamole, traditional steak tacos, and  fresh squeezed orange juice). The service was prompt and friendly and everything was cheap! Definitely would frequent this place often if I lived in South Philly.

I liked the idea of the restaurant and it didn't disappoint. Each dish was unique, simple, but full of heart. It stood out of their own and you would be hard pressed to find similar dishes elsewhere. The chicken was a cooked to perfect with an excellent crispy skin, but a little bland. Although if you combine each bite with the pickled lettuce, it was a bombshell. The service was average, edging towards the low end. I was looking forward to the octopus dish I ordered which was clearly forgotten but no amends were made. Overall, promising with room to grow.

I've been going here for many, many years. I love their fresh-baked bread! It makes for delicious garlic knots & sandwiches. I'm also a fan of their homemade creamy garlic salad dressing and the baked gnocchi. I've also picked up pizza a few times when it's been too late to sit down inside. I've never been disappointed. Service is always friendly. 

The only thing I don't like is their lighting. They have these weird string lights all over the place that make me a little sick because they seem to be vibrating somehow. That's why that last star is missing.

Chicken Francese was cooked to perfection.   The six pieces of chicken were infused with lemon and butter.  There is always a selection between two soups, which are made daily.  The house salad comes with creamy or original house dressing.  Both items are included with the dinner entree.  The garlic bread is a loaf of Italian bread cut down the middle and loaded with butter, garlic, and spices.  Oh and of course it's BYOW, bring your own wine.  This place is the definition of a mom and pap south jersey Italian joint.

I've been coming here on and off for almost 10 years. Whenever people ask me for recs in the SB area, I ALWAYS tell them to come here. It is homemade pasta (what else can you ask for), flavorful and fresh ingredients, charming small town  ambiance, a lovely back patio, and great service!! It's owned and run by a family and you can feel it in the service and food. During this insane covid-19 pandemic they remain a beacon of cozy food and have been doing take out. I've picked up take out from them 5x already while we shelter in place (lobster ravioli, ciopinno, pancetta salad, burrata appetizer, all the pastas!).

The prices are great and the food is decent.  I got the lunch chimichanga and it was huge,  and covered with cheese sauce. I ordered beef and got a very mildly seasoned shredded beef with huge pieces of onions and tomatoes inside,  which I didn't enjoy.  

The mushroom quesadilla was good. 

The guacamole was lackluster,  kind of runny and also containing giant pieces of onion. The tortilla chips tasted burnt though they appeared to be perfectly done,  which makes me think the oil needed to be changed. 

I've had enchiladas here before and liked them.  Next time I will just get them again.

Snap is a great 24/7 gym. It is very compact but has ample space to do everything I want. There is quite a bit of cardio equipment and pretty much every weight machine you could ask for. It is fairly limited in free weights (outside of the big dumbbell set and benches) which is the only reason it gets 4 instead of 5 stars (although if they were to have free weights I'm not sure where they'd be put). 

Brandon does a phenomenal job keeping the place clean - it seems that every other day I'm in there he's mopping, vacuuming or wiping down equipment. Overall an excellent little gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The service was bad. Our original server must have forgotten about us because another server came to refill drinks. I didn't see one server with a smile on their face. Our server seemed like he didn't want to be there. This wasn't a rush time either. The food was ok. The ribs were more bone than they were actual meat. The burger was really greasy. Everything was just very blah. It kind of grossed me out that the servers didn't change the table cloths, they just flipped them over. The food was a bit overpriced too. This was my first and last visit.

Horrible management! Threatened to call cops because i was unhappy with the chili rellenos that were made with prego spaghetti sauce. It is my son's birthday and they ruined it by insisting prego is the norm for chili rellenos! Asked me if I had ever had them before and everything! Duh! Been goin there for years ....will never go back and I suggest not ordering the chili rellenos. Threatened to call the cops because I told her she ruined my son's birthday. She said she was the owners daughter! I told her she had no idea how to deal with people! She didn't! She just threatened to call cops over 11 dollars and 67 cents. Do not go there!

The rental process was pretty easy.  The two agents behind the desk don't have a shield or glass to protect them or their customers.  The reason I am giving 2 stars, the agent that assisted me was not very friendly and definitely not a people person.  She didn't go over the contract and definitely didn't notify me it would cost more to add another driver.  Didn't offer any maps or asked if we knew where we were going.  The other agent was super friendly and so you can't blame Covid.  It's a real shame I didn't get her name as she deserves a shout out.

Finally had a chance to check out this place with our group of 5. Crazy impressed with the quality of the rolls and food in general. We all took advantage of the all you can eat, and it was a lot of fun having a variety of rolls on a big plate to choose from. The AYCE also includes appetizers and an ice cream dessert! Such an awesome value.

Would also like to point out that with how busy the restaurant was, our rolls and appetizers came out in a timely fashion (was not expecting that with the crowd). A+ for food and service!

This place gets 2 stars for location and reasonable parking.  That's the positive

Negative:
- Loud - every time a door is shut in the hallway our door would rattle a little

- sounded as though there was a elephant above us.

- this is an odd one ...we had a "do not disturb" on our door.  They called and hang up or call to see if we were in our room.  We left with the "do not disturb" sign on the door, they still came in as soon as we left the room....if there is a sign "do not disturb" it means: KEEP OUT OF THE ROOM!, DON"T CALL THE ROOM TO SEE IF WE ARE THERE!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Friends, if you want the best in caffeinated bean beverages, this is it. Whether you're more of a Peruvian Huaco or a Ethiopian Guji kinda drinker or you lean towards a more jammy, Mediterranean Yemen Haraaz, Sump's got you covered. They have nitro drinks too. They also have matcha and other teas, and they won't even judge. The vibe is a cozy, quiet, chill Death metal feel, and the owner guy is super friendly and helpful. I'm just sad that there's not one in Chicago. Definitely worth coming if you're in STL and worth a trip from anywhere even if you're not from here.

Overall the ambience was good. Nice, but not too stuffy. The service was mediocre. Our waitress was super sweet but it took forever to get our food. We got a steak and the duck confit. The steak was decent, duck was good overall. The brussels sprouts came highly recommended from our server and they were the most disgusting brussels sprouts I've ever had(server graciously removed them from our bill). We got a pizza for an appetizer and it was great but nothing to write home about. I'd go back for drinks but not dinner.

The food was very horrible.

1. Bread was pretty okay. 
2. The salad was horrible.. Especially the honey mustard. Blegh! All the salads were just tasted weird. I guess the caesar was OKAY, but it was too cheesy.
3. THE FOOD WAS HORRIBLE. The sauces for the salmon were too salty and limey. The spaghetti was really plain and not worth the money. The sauce was supposed to be"chunky" but it wasn't and there was too little.
4. The price is way too pricey. Like ~25$ for pasta and salmon is too much...

One star for the service though!

Upon arrival, we were slightly concerned by the exterior of the building (renovated old warehouse) but the inside was charming and the rooms were comfortable! 

Overall, the room was clean and the staff was very friendly/helpful.

I would stay here again. Make sure you research the cost of parking in advance. Like most hotels in New Orleans, parking is valet, and it was $38 on top of the cost of stay. It was worth it for us so we didn't have to deal with our car, but just a heads up.

We were impressed with this hotel and I would recommend a stay here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Overall the meal was good, restaurant was clean and people were nice.  I had the veal chop which was bland which is the main reason I'm  only giving it 3 stars considering the price.  All else was good and everyone else enjoyed their meal.  I feel their menu is too big and I often wonder how a restaurant with such a large menu can maintain everything to be fresh.  In all fairness I will go back since on the way out I saw a bottle of wine from my home town in Italy.  I'll also be sure to order a more traditional dish.

Pizza: 4.5

No exaggeration, this is probably the best pizza I've had in the USA. The oven is from Napoli, and produces this absolutely delightful crust that is light, fluffy, and amazing. With a smoky wood-burnt taste which reminded me of Florence. Wow. You can see it being made in that bright red oven.

I got the Sicily -  duck confit, Georgia peaches, buffalo mozzeralla, parmigiana,drizzled with bourbon glaze. Wow, perfect balance of umami ingredients and sweet peaches. The highlight was the crust. Seriously the 3rd/4th best crust I've had in my life.

 The only downside was the overly dry duck. I prefer it to be more moist.

Check it out.

First,  I would like to say that our server was very nice, although in my opinion she was overwhelmed with tables to serve and stretched too thin. The restaurant is too dark inside, I don't mind a bit of ambiance, however I would like to at least see what I am eating. The food is served on styrofoam plates and bowls. ( I understand they may be doing this as a result of the pandemic.) The sushi was not as good as it had been in the past. On this trip, it just wasn't good at all.  The hibachi was ok at best. I can honestly say that I won't be going  back.Overall, I was disappointed with the food.

In the land of sub-par eateries known as New Castle, this place offers some edible, non-chain food that you won't instantly regret or make you run to the bathroom. Actually, the salads here are very nice, especially the Cobb. The pizza is more authentic than the other neighborhood Italian joints, hands down.  The Texas chili has some kick, not the greatest, but definitely a good starter for the hungry patron... and this is an Italian restaurant, after all.

Worth the trip, and I dare day, a diamond in the rough.

Went at noon on a Sunday. Got seated immediately.

Ordered the chicken wings, and a split pizza (paulie's pie, and broccoli rabe). 

Chicken wings were very crispy but a little salty. If it were less salty, they would've been great! Came with some bread and parsley.

Pizza itself was great! Even though it's wood fired, it is somewhat a cross between fancy wood fired and regular pizza at a pizza joint. If you like a lot of toppings on your pizza, Anthony's is a great place to go to. 

Service was excellent too!

I'm hesitant to write a review because I have had mixed experiences here. It has outdoor seating with heaters (that actually heat) so that is always a plus. I remember thinking my dinner was excellent the first time I went here but when I went back again, I ordered the same thing as someone else I was with - I liked it, she didn't. 

So, I don't know. There are so many Italian places downtown and some that are really good and different and interesting. this place is not exceptional so that's what you're looking for, go somewhere else.

This refers to an experience about a year ago: The service here is indifferent at best, negligent and worst. I was rushed through the checkin process into a car that Hertz should have been embarrassed to rent: scratched, bent hubcap, the works. The agent said not to worry, he was taking pictures. When I drove it off the lot, it pulled severely to the right - but when I tried to call the office, it was closed - no one answered. I finally reached someone, and they said they didn't have another car available. Luckily, the return process was uneventful. I definitely won't rent from this location again, and maybe not from Hertz.

I'm giving this hotel 4 stars based off of what it is. A red roof in motel...the price was right, the beds were comfy, the location was key, the room was clean but most of all Kenia & Helen at the front desk made the stay amazing. They were extremly helpful and courteous. They went out of their way to help us out a few times and that really stood out to me. If you are looking for a luxurious hotel with tons of amenities you are going to want to look elsewhere. However, if you are just looking for somewhere clean to crash without breaking the bank this hotel is just fine!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Horrible service. This is one of those local spots that don't really take kindly to new people. While I'm waiting to order a drink, not one, but 4 locals come in and dominate the bartender's time. Instead of taking orders in the "order" that they come, she proceeded to take care of her friends first. When it was finally my turn to patron their silly establishment, I ask if they have Bulleit Bourbon, in which she states, "no, can't you see what we have over there?"

She names off everything that isn't a bourbon until I shut her up and say I'll just have a Jack Daniels. What a joke!

Terrible service, average food.  Do not bother.  Waited 15 minutes for her to return with my drink but promised the cooks were faster than she was.  Food came in a timely manner but when finished I waited for quite some time before she came back to check on me.  Cleared the dishes and said she would bring the check.  Waited another 10 or 15 mins the whole time I could here her talking about her love life at the bar.  Brought the check finally and waited again so I finally got up and took it to her so I could get out of there.  Have no idea how they remain in business.

Called and got same day appointment for two pedicures ( was very thankful ) Sat down in the chair and the lady immediately gave me the option book and turned to the most expensive top one and pointed at it. I said no thank you I will stick to a basic pedi this time. She said ok and I feel like since I declined.. that I didn't get a good pedi. She didn't even try to get my ingrown toe nails out, barely did the cheese grater and pumice stone and put some lotion and scrub on and rub for less then 5 seconds each leg.. kinda disappointed. I even made sure the basic pedi included ingrown nails and cheese grater!!! Color came out great though.

Paid for the parking and shuttle service only to be left stranded at the airport in the middle of the night by myself for 2.5 hours because they kept saying the shuttle was on it's way but it never came. Then I had to pay for a different transportation option. I left several messages for the manager about getting a refund and to let them know about the horrible customer service I received, but of course with no return phone call. Even the corporate office took almost 2 weeks to respond, only to tell me they couldn't help me either because the locations are independently owned. Never again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Agreed with Miranda T. Had the same experience with I'm assuming the SAME bartender. They just recently opened up the barn, and I was there last weekend for my first time since they opened up the inside. This guy was so unbelievably rude to me. Then he blatantly ignored me when trying to order. I don't know what his problem is, but I was talking about it at the other bar on the opposite side of Tchoup Yard and a random guy next to me knew exactly who I was talking about. "Manager" or not, he does not belong in customer service. He was so unbelievably rude. Other than that, I LOVE tchoup yard and won't let this man ruin my experience.

Lived in the area for years. Place has sucked for years. Takes 20 minutes for a cheeseburger you know that's been sitting in the hot window for hours. But tonight I broke and literally downloaded this app because I took my stepmom through the drive through and got a dirty look for asking for an extra ketchup and she handed me 3 packets. 3. For a cheeseburger and fries. 3 packets. SORRY TO BOTHER U AND MAKE U MOVE YOUR ARM BC U DO LITERALLY NOTHING ELSE. burn this place down and give us something worth our time pls.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: -5 Star.  haha!  Stopped in very late at night because nothing else was opened and we just needed a bite to eat.  Awful food!  We've never been to a White Castle and decided we needed the experience. We didn't need that experience.  Horrible soggy buns, sprayed on meat, plastic cheese. Fries out of bag from Costco. Waffle chicken......yuk!  Really bad.  Never going back to a White Castle.  They don't have them where we live (Oregon) and I will petition to veto a White Castle if they ever set foot in our state.

Pizza is fine. Staff is very friendly. My main complaint is that while I was waiting for my husband to grab a pie to-go, I was sitting on the (empty) patio with my dog and a member of the staff came out to tell me to leave because the owner called him asking why a dog was on his patio. Apparently he was watching his security cameras from home. I fully respect restaurants that have a no pet policy but certainly do not appreciate being asked to leave a sheltered patio while it's raining and I am waiting  for the pizza I paid for.

Stayed here for 3 nights. The location was great. Elevators are a pain unless you are either very patient or like to waste a lot of your time. It's not the fault of the hotel, but it is an issue. Checking in and out is smooth, but it appears there are only two total luggage carts for this big hotel. So if you have a lot of stuff, sorry. Rooms were clean, but wasn't cleaned very well while we were there. Manager reception was awesome. Breakfast was good, but very tight spacing. Luckily it didn't rain or else I have no idea how they would fit everyone in the dining area. I guess overall a little disappointed for a hotel with a big price tag.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Completely dissatisfied with this visit. The only reason that I gave this shop 2 stars is my husband got a decent haircut. When he showed up, there was no customers and four barbers, but no one seemed to want to give him a cut.  When he went to pay, he pulled out his credit card only to learn they don't take it even though it is clearly posted on the door. After returning from the ATM, they couldn't provide him any change for his $15 haircut even though he only wanted $2 back.  Congrats on your $5 tip. It will be the last $ you see from us.  Don't waste your time at this shop. There are other better shops close by.

Sarah is the best! Sarah got my to blonde safely and keeps my fine hair healthy. I have learned, as I got older, that there are certain things you just need to pay full price for. Your hair is one of them!! It is expensive- but I have never left not loving my hair or my experience. 

 I also love that they have continued education for their stylists and apprenticeships for new stylists. I think this keeps them accountable to their work and therefore give you, the customer, a better outcome and experience. 

The salon is so beautifully designed and I have always had a professional experience with the staff.

I ordered a breakfast sandwich my girlfriends ordered the Derfs omelette (she added spinach).
My sandwich was pretty good, tastes like I could make it at home just as good but it wasn't bad. Home style potatoes were good, don't get the hash browns. Hash browns were mushy so was the omelette.. They were mediocre at best.
Cool location with an outside deck to eat on. Self seating, I would come back maybe try something different. I would rate a 2.5 stars maybe if I got different food it could be a 3.
Order the mimosas they were good!

Sport level location but definitely on the lower end of quality for that tier based on my experience at other 24 Hour Fitness locations (home gym is in Denver, Colorado).  

Limited cardio equipment (2nd level) and decent amount of weight lifting machines but still less than what I would expect.  Full basketball court and large class studio. 

Parking was easy and not too busy right after work so that was a major plus. Locker rooms seemed ok and they had complimentary temporary lockers that people can use. 

Place felt clean, but overall not a top end 24 Hour Fitness location.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I just want to say WOW. I LOVE this place. Jennifer was our bartender both nights we were in and not only was she super knowledgeable with the drinks- she talked about the bar and was just so very sweet. She let us stay after close while she cleaned up (We are staying at the Dauphine next door) and was so accommodating. She even gave us a bottle of champagne to enjoy at midnight because it is our anniversary. I have never had such a wonderful experience at a bar. I will always make time for this place when I am in town. Thank you!!!!

I did not like this place at all. We came here for lunch on a Sunday at 1pm. Our food took forever & there's no bread or anything while you wait. The restaurant wasn't even 1/3 full. Out of a 9 person group, 2 enjoyed their dishes. The grilled flat iron steak was not good at all. It tasted old and the chimichurri sauce didn't have much flavor to it. Prices are alright for a hotel restaurant and our waiter was ok (never stopped by after taking our order or after bringing it to check up on us). but I don't recommend this place.

Wow, so happy I found this place! Michael did an amazing job from start to finish. I came in with a botched haircut from another salon, hoping he could fix it and make it look at least somewhat decent, and he did way more than that--- it's one of the best haircuts I've ever had! He made me feel very comfortable by explaining exactly how he planned to cut my hair, first a dry cut, wash, then a wet cut. He was very thorough and took his time to ensure it looked just right.

I could not be happier with my hair, and am so happy to have finally found a stylist that I synced so well with. Will only be going to Napoleon Blonde from here on out.

It's so loud I can not sleep and I have a super early fight. I informed the front desk and they did not take care of the problem. The only reason I'm giving them three stars because their housekeeping is amazing! They went above and beyond expectations. The service in the restaurants was really excellent. The food was good overall. I'm really disappointed and I'm not looking forward to how I will feel all day tomorrow. Sleep is important and you would not think the Ritz would allow people to party and keep their balcony doors open for everyone else to be disturbed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Horrible service. Their hours of operations for Thursday is until 10pm. We got there at 9:20 and they told us that they would not sit us as they close at 10 and they need time to clean. I told them that if they advertise closing at 10 they should be tending to customers until 10. If not they should just change their hours of operation. They were rude and they just wanted to clean. In this age of the pandemic it's unnerving how they turn away paying customers. I will never go back and I will not recommend them. Horrible customer service.

Use the TURO app!!
The manager, Destiny answered the phone and helped me confirm my cargo van rental. She told me since I reserved it 5 months ago it should be no problem. She told me she would call back to confirm and she did not. I called the next week and she told me she had no vans. She gave me a number for a van center that did not work. I called the national rental center and they were no help. No vans in the USA.  So I went onto the app TURO and I found a van!  It's an awesome app you rent from private owners.

Used to come here when it was located in Baywalk many years ago. First time back since relocating. Food is still on point. Tonight I took my 8 year old son to have dinner there we had the mussels in a garlic wine sauce as an appetizer and split an entree that was off the menu tonight. 12 oz ribeye cooked just the right temperature as requested with shrimp, crab topping and asparagus paired with garlic mashed potatoes and seasonal veggies. Oh my god it was delish! I don't know why it's taken me so long to come back!

Riddle me this... Why would you be charged a premium credit card processing fee when you have a paper gift card? Unbelievable. I've been coming here for  4 years and this is the second time something like this has happened. Won, please feel free to call me to discuss. This is once again not how you should treat someone who's in your salon every two weeks. Not to mention It is illegal to charge a premium processing fee for using a credit card. Every time you go here and use credit card they are pocketing an extra 3.00!! Pay cash or don't go at all. Don't let anyone but you a gift card here either!!

This is one of the poorest McDonald's I have been to.  Customer service is terrible.  Although I have had some positive experiences here... I am uncomfortable pulling in due to the inconsistency and not knowing what kind of service to be expecting.  
One time the guy ON DRIVE-THRU SPEAKER told me they were closed... when the signs said "open 24 hours"... go figure... And the WORST is "ice cream machine is down"... they should have BACK UP  ice cream
machines. Just my opinion.. they apparently don't take pride in their work as a whole... Although the few employees that care are obvious and I genuinely appreciate their contribution.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Would I stay here again? YES. Is it haunted? YES. Other than that it's honestly very cute and homey the front desk has lovely employees. The rooms are fairly small but it is an old building, the only thing I did not like was the lighting in the room. We had a window so we had a little bit more light but at night it was really hard to see anything. The outside patio was super cute and the history of the hotel is very interesting. I would stay here again! It's close to EVERYTHING Cafe Du Monde, Mississippi River, Cathedral and more. Make sure you catch a ghost tour with Ghost Adventures great story telling and history!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This is a quiet spot compared to the Hut.
A bit overpriced for the food but on the water. The food came out really fast. Our server was friendly and was wearing a cheesy pirate costume. We ordered 5 import beers
5 domestic beers. We liked how the bartender and waitress names are written on the chalk board- more personal when ordering food & drinks. Especially when the beer starts flowing.
Plenty of tables and chairs outside as well.
Plenty indoor seating, we appreciated that the air condition is not super low. It's a small bar but gets the job done.

This place is okay, but please, PLEASE get Abel out of there. Two times I've dealt with him, and every time is a hassle! He thinks he mentions something when he didn't, and when you bring it up he instantly just gets defensive instead of just apologizing and correcting himself. Every time I come in and see him, I want to leave but I can't because the prices are good. I wish I could just deal with the manager, he is really cool and acts like an adult. Maybe Abel just needs some more training or something. Other than that, I love sears auto center.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: To the owners of this subway. Looks like almost everything I came to write about on this review your other customers have taken care of. Showing you have made no changes. Sad because this is our neighborhood subway. In addition to what everyone else has said (which I agree with) you should also change your "coupon policy". I think this is the only subway I've ever been to that does not participate in any coupons digital or print. Can't afford to give your customers a dollar of a foot long? We'll take our business elsewhere.

I had a wonderful experience with Enterprise in Brandon. Joe helped me out so much. I needed a vehicle to drive from FL to MA with and the car was amazing. The customer service was great. We had some paperwork problems at the end, but we called up Joe and he cleared all our worries and fixed everything for us adequately. I definitely recommend their service. I had no worries at all. I was placed in great hands with this company. I've had rentals before with past problems but they were great. I will definitely be going back again to them!

I'm so glad I discovered this neighborhood spot for some authentic Italian comfort food. My family and I loved our experience here, and would come back in a heart beat.

The portions are very very generous so come hungry! I can't recommend the braised beef tortellini enough. It's creamy, savory, tender, and bursting with flavor.  I loved the Brussels sprout salad as well, it's very light and fresh. 

If you're in the mood for some fantastic Italian food at a reasonable price point (spent around $120 for our family of three) this is your go to spot in town!!

This is such an awesome place for a quick grab and go treat! They do have plenty of outdoor seating if you wanted to sit and your treat. I've heard lots of great things about Frtiz's and finally made a drive out to check it out. 

Amazing staff members, they were all so sweet! My order was ready before my card even processed - really pleased with the services on a busy hot summer afternoon. 

I got the junior size, and chose vanilla custard with cookie dough toppings! It came with a cute little cherry on top and some chocolate chip flakes. Delicious, creamy, and just enough for a single serving :) 

Loved this place, must try!

This is my second stay with Country Inn and Suites in New Orleans, and both have been thoroughly enjoyable. I love the character of the hotel, and the service and rooms complement it so well. The location is great - centrally located to the convention center, French Quarter, and arts district. We were never too far most places. 

Rooms were clean and comfortable, staff was attentive and it truly was like its name - Country Inn. If you like the city within a city of the large downtown hotels, this is not for you. It is a quieter, more comfortable retreat tucked in the bustle of New Orleans. We enjoyed our stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We stayed here for a night while transiting New Orleans. Can't really say too much. The rooms were large and clean, the beds comfortable and the shower pressure was great. So for me that's all I need for a one night stay and a good nights sleep. 

The breakfast was disappointing compared to other Best Westerns I've stayed in within the USA. Poor selection and what was there was pretty inedible. 

If you're looking for a one nights stay at a good price and want to know you'll get something you'll be happy with then stay here. It's a Best Western so you know what you're getting.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We just picked up our pizza, and first let me say, it was so big that it would only fit in the back seat of our car, and the crust was overflowing the box....it was hilarious and made for a good laugh all the way home.
