The pizza was just awesome and NY style delicious!   They accommodated our pickiness without question.   We ordered half pepperoni and half white.   Most pizza places will not attempt a red and white sauce on the same pizza.   The best part of the whole experience was the staff acting extremely friendly in a manner that it was obvious they genuinely loved their job and customers.  What a great pizza place!!

We were searching for a local restaurant to eat lunch at and decided to eat here after seeing good reviews. The restaurant was quite small and was lacking exciting/vibrant decor. The decor and ambiance will not be very memorable, but the food will be! My sushi and Chicken Teriyaki was very good. Our waitress was very friendly and the food came out very quickly- almost too quickly because we hadn't finished our soup and salads! This restaurant was good, but nothing spectacular. Although, if I was craving sushi and in the area I would definately give it another try.

we found several lackluster Italian restaurants during our short stint in South Jersey. La Locanda stood out as by far the most enjoyable. The owner was always friendly and engaging... though it could have been that he liked my wife... but anyway :-P The atmosphere inside is so much more than the strip mall exterior facade implies. The food is fresh and delicious. We never had a bad meal. I can't offer the 5th star because I did find it a bit pricey by South Jersey standards, and I've had some damn fine Italian food in my life, so can't say LA Locanda is "the best," but it is a VERY good restaurant.

Found the Aloft on a third party site for 145 on a Saturday night which I thought was a good rate for New Orleans. It's in a good location and is only 2 blocks from the quarter. Check in time isn't until 4 and checkout was noon. They charge 39 dollars a day for valet parking or you can park at the end of the block in a garage for 15 dollars per 24 hours. 

It was a nice room, but the air conditioning was really noisy whenever it would come on. The room also didn't have any windows which really threw me off when sleeping. This was my biggest issue with the hotel. I also wish they had provided a second complimentary bottle of water in the room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place is an interesting concept: imagine trendy coffee shop meets dimly lit restaurant.

It took us a while to get seated but once we did, the rest of the night was wonderful.

Notes: 
- The mussel broth is more salty than kimchi but delicious nonetheless. Can skip the sides.
- If you're on a date, do the tasting menu. It's $49 per person that gets you a raw dish, a starter, a salad/veggie, two entrees, a side, and a dessert. (The porterhouse for 2 and the grilled dorade for 2 count as 1 entree!!)

Must orders: the sea scallops and hamachi crudo.

Reserved my hotel by calling them but I didn't know they booked me on August when I wanted July. Didn't bother to check my email for the confirmation so some of it was my fault. I finally checked my email and saw the mistake, called them up and the lady on the other line said it was't their fault. Can't be my fault because I wasn't the one who was putting in all the information in the computer. They also charged me over one month ahead of schedule so I told them about that. They said they will refund me for that charge. That was last week...Now I have to call my credit card company to dispute the charge.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have lived here for 6 years went there to buy cigarettes and coffee then stopped when I was getting over charged for things I knew the prices of It is hard to even walk in the door of the place because it's turned into a hang out for the homeless I had 4 people ask me for money in 20 feet of the place then I get in they doubled the prices on everything and cigarettes I walk up to the counter and the 2 guys looked like they have not taking a bath in months I bought the cigs was so upset how dirty the place was I WILL NEVER GO BACK

My wife and I ate here a couple of days ago. As the courses are small, I wasn't surprised that I was still a little hungry afterwards. That being said, the food was amazing. If you enjoy challenging your taste buds, this is a must do. My only complaint is that I felt a little rushed at times. We both added the wine pairing. The wine for the next course kept being poured while we were still enjoying the last course's wine. We  both drink wine at a reasonable pace. The ambiance was intimate where you felt close but not in the least bit cramped. If you have the money, I would recommend checking it out at least once.

Awesome place to stay if you want to be in the heart of Nashville. Walking distance to everything! Very clean hotel. They have fresh infused water  when you enter (perfect for hot days). Breakfast was better than the normal, they have egg white and normal breakfast sandwiches that were delicious. Local artist play at the bar, both nights we sat and listened either before going out or on that back from dinner. If you want a quick snack with a cocktail in the afternoon, their hummus plate is awesome with 3 generous servings of different hummus. Staff super friendly. When visiting , I will stay here again !
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I visited this place for the first time the other night. I had the crab and shrimp risotto. It was delicious and the crab was lump and you could taste it. Sometimes, restaurants miss the crab in the entree but this was great. Even had left overs. My friend had the salmon which I tried and was done just right. 

The only downfall (not 5 stars) is that everything is al la carte that can get pricey. The food was delicious!

Although they have a wine list, you can bring your own which is great. 

We did get a $10 coupon to use again. I would like to try the pizza next time. 

I'll be back!

I have just had great experiences with this hotel chain, try not to stay elsewhere. Complimentary shuttle service from airport is on call only. Hot breakfast as always. Their executive suite looks exactly like a normal suite so don't waste your money unless you need the computer hookups in the room. They booked my room after I prepaid weeks earlier, so after complaining about the situation, they set me up appropriately. Bottom line, all members and prepaid customers should get their exact room, no exceptions.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have always loved the food at Italian Pie and this location is so tasty. I love love love the white gourmet and the lasagna is pretty scrumptious. The building was beautifully redone and the patio area outside is very nice. The service is very hit or miss. I frequent here often and sometimes we have a wonderful experience and others we wonder why we just didn't order take out. The restaurant is never really packed but our food always seems to take longer than might be needed.  Now, The drink specials are very reasonable and would recommend them to all.

When visiting FL, I must eat two things: Bern's mac/cheese and the Szechuan dumplings from this place. It's not fancy, but the food is consistently delicious. I'm leaning towards a 3.5 for this place, so I rounded up to 4 b/c of their consistency. 

Service is kind of abrupt, but whatever, it's to go Chinese food, not fine dining. Prices are low, and the food is prepared quickly. I've had the Szechuan dumplings, moo goo gai pan, chicken lo mein, cashew chicken & egg rolls. It hits the spot and they give you good portions.

Perfect place to stop and grab fresh fish on the harbor! I got the M3 special which included 2 tuna, 2 yellowtail, and 2 salmon nigiri pieces as well as a 10 piece crunch roll. The crunch roll had avocado, tempura shrimp, crab, and cucumber topped with tempura flakes and eel sauce. It's a togo restaurant so by the time I got my food back to the harbor, the crunch roll was not crunchy anymore. The nigiri on the other hand, was perfect. The tuna and yellowtail were so fresh it basically melted in my mouth. They were also generously sized pieces of fish on perfectly sticky sushi rice.

This place is a great new little gem on the south side of Indy. They have what I believe to be the best burger in Indianapolis! The whole menu is pretty creative and definitely not ordinary. Their beer selection is top notch as well. The service hasn't been that great the last couple times I've been in there, but that's to be expected in the first couple of months. And it's not bad enough to keep me from coming back. The atmosphere is kind of like a biker bar, which is not exactly my thing but I don't feel like I don't belong there either. Definitely worth the trip!

Stayed here for one night for an AACSB seminar. It's handy they are connected. It's a nice hotel. Bed is comfy. Amenities are nice. Good water pressure. I had lovely views of the water.

The pool/patio area is smaller that you'd be led to believe by the pictures and not easy to get to. 

Clearly needs some updating but based on posters at the hotel that's happening this summer. Also, the website says wifi isn't free except you get a code a check in. Decide which one it is. I would've been mad to have paid to find out it was free.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I don't know what all the poor reviews are about. Matt and I went here on Friday night and had a blast. The crowd changes drastically as the night wears on and thats the reason for the four stars. Well that and the fact that a crowd of drunken bridesmaids and another group of drunk frat boys were fighting over our table and who was getting it next. 

Paige our server was a bad b*tch of a server. She was on point. 

Food was ok nothing to write home about but to be honest, who goes to a bar for the food. Overall a great experience.

A place that offers a small selection of items, but all items are done well!!!

Small space, one waitress, and a whole kitchen staff. They are pretty busy on Saturday starting at 9am. 

My friends and I enjoyed breakfast here for the first time--ordered eggs Benedict and an omelette. 

The Benedict was delicious with just the right amount of hollandaise sauce and a crunchy buttery muffin! 

The home fries were skillet fried with peppers an onions. Everything cooked right and all under 10 dollars.

Coffee and drinks were constantly refilled and staff was attentive. All in all, just done well!

You want to go where? The Tuscan Grille?   Save your money and settle for a PB&J at home!!  To be blatantly honest, folks, I'm sorry to say that this place totally sucks ...  A few months ago we stopped in to check out their menu.  The guy at the front desk had so much Polo cologne on that I was ready to vomit ...  When you're really hungry and waiting patiently for your dinner, it finally arrives, and then you end up spitting it into your napkin because it tastes freezer burnt and as if it were straight out of a can.  Seriously!  Not an enjoyable experience at all people.  Run and don't look back!

First and LAST! WASTE OF MONEY...PIZZA came with no sauce I called and the lady on the  phone wasn't apologetic she said that's never happened I said it's undercooked soggy and no pizza sauce. I asked for a refund and her answer was NO I even said someone could come and get food she said ok but no refund so we drop the food back off and she didn't even apologize offer refund nothing the phone ring with another customer didn't even put that person on hold to finish with me..so as I walked out I let her know that I have disputed almost $40 worth of food that did not get eaten due to it being undercooked in her refusing to give us our money back

We had a terrible stay here. Our next door neighbors were very loud, so we went to the front desk to ask for another room and they were sold out. When we returned to the room, we checked the mattress for bed bugs because a friend of ours stayed here and had gotten bed bugs from this hotel last year, so my wife pulled back the sheets and found blood all over the mattress. Our Next stay here my wife was bitten by a spider and upon our return home our Doctor put her on antibiotics to fight the infection. I do not recommend this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We arrived at the airport on the last flight of the night and all of the rental cars were taken. We called ACE and they sent a representative to pick us up (at midnight) within minutes. We were driving to our destination less than 15 minutes later. They even got us in an SUV! It was a very basic no frills vehicle but it got us around with no problem. Returning the car was effortless and they shuttled us to the airport (entire process was maybe 5 minutes). I would definitely rent from them again. Oh and they cars were WAY cheaper than anything I have rented through the major chains.

The only thing that this hotel has going for it is location. Marijuana smell throughout. Our room had mold above the shower where the ceiling was peeling away. When we arrived the toilet still had toilet paper in it from before our arrival. The closet had dirt in the carpet and looked like it had never been vacuumed. Parking garage was confusing and the check in process took quite some time as there was one person at the desk and a line to the door. The elevators are engraved with graffiti. This place is dirty, understaffed, and outdated.

DO NOT STAY HERE!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The hotel and conference center and Restaurants and Bars are Amazing!! But the ROOMS ARE HORRIBLE! The Bathroom is located inches from the front door which is across from the ONLY MIRROR in the room and the only place to put your luggage, it's a large foot stool. Very inconvenient when your partner is getting ready and you are in the shower. How are there no open counter spaces for Luggage? Or Luggage Stands? No mirrors in the sleeping area? The bed was too firm for my liking . I will attend events here but will not stay here. The staff is very courteous and friendly, the restaurants serve delicious interesting good and drinks.,
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My friends and I were in need of some quick-basic food & drinks so we chose this place because it was open later than others & closer to where we were staying. I'm trying to remain unbiased because I didn't feel well when we went here and they could have been understaffed. However, it took a veryyyy long time to even get our basic drinks and longer to get margaritas. FYI if you're here the frozen are much better than one on the rocks. The food took quite a while & was pretty basic. Nothing surprising. They also closed the restaurant an hour early while we were there. The staff was nice but just don't expect something special when you go.

Got our rental here this morning after arriving in Philadelphia. 

Pros:
Great service. We were offered water and pretzels off the bat and greeted by several employees. In and out quickly and efficiently. Choice of several vehicles.

Cons:
Price. Insanely expensive. Over $500 for a mid size for one week. Extra $20 per person per day to drive. They tried to convince us to add stuff on. Also the keys are together on a keychain nearly impossible to open, so what's the point of giving us two?

I still like Enterprise but wow..can barely afford it anymore.

We've ordered Sam's for lunch a ton over the last two years at our company. Recently the prices have gone up, the delivery minimum went up, and the quality of food has gone down. It was a favorite and easy to order for everyone in the office, but now it's going down hill and we are on the hunt for a new lunch place that has something for everyone.

Lower the prices or at least the delivery minimum. We aren't the only people in the building that order, so I know we provide a ton of business for you that you didn't have before.

Safe area and convenient to the highway. The bed was comfortable and staff was friendly the walls were pretty thin and we heard teens and small children running and screaming in the halls well into the night. A staff member used an access code to let a large group of children into the pool- children who clearly didn't belong bc they did not have a room key and neither did the adult with them. They were rambunctious to the point we left the hot tub due to getting splashed and getting headaches from the screeching in the pool. Otherwise it was an ok hotel. We slept good, had a mini fridge and decent tv channels.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
A Rita's in a deserted parking lot.

I wish that's all I had to write about this, but my Elite status won't let me.

I go to Rita's for custard. A VARIETY OF CUSTARD. This one had two flavours that night: chocolate and vanilla. The two most boring ice cream flavours to ever exist in the history of mankind. Yes, I said chocolate and vanilla are boring and I'm not apologizing. How do you go to Rita's and get vanilla custard topped with some nuts and think you're revolutionary?

Because I'm here to tell you you're not.

I had to settle for a pear Italian ice that wasn't even that good. It was just green and sweet, no pear flavour. What a letdown.

I am new to the Wilmington area and have been very hesitant to find a new hair salon. After seeing Salon 828's reviews and a recommendation from a friend, I decided to give it a try! And I am very glad that I did! The staff was very friendly and welcoming and the atmosphere is very cozy yet professional. Even more importantly, I was very impressed by my hair stylist, Jill. She listened to the description of how I wanted my hair cut, made a couple of suggestions and delivered a great haircut and service. I will definitely be going back and recommend Salon 828 to anyone!

Honestly, wish I didn't have to give this shithole a star but unfortunately, I have to rate it. Firstly, I'm gonna say customer service is terrible. Heard the employees giving other customers attitude. I'm not one to give bad reviews...much less, even give a review but this was a terrible experience. The women with the blonde half shaved head who cut my husbands hair was a straight up bitch to him after he said he was in the military. She wasn't even looking while cutting his hair...his hair came out uneven. We definitely won't be back. Please, get your attitude together.

I was here for 5 days and let me tell you I highly enjoyed the restaurant Champions!!!! I ate there twice a day lunch and dinner and it was primarily because of the friendly staff! My favorite person was Hans Temmee! He was the best because I was primarily by myself and he made sure to make me feel welcomed knew me by my name and always had what I wanted ready for me before I even ordered! This is what I called exceptional service! To be treated like a family member at a restaurant is invaluable! Thank you Hans for making my time there so welcoming:)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The food is amazing! I'm a big sushi lover and am always astounded by how delicious it is!

That is basically the only reason I come here. The service has been terrible each time I have dropped by. The first time they were incredibly busy so I came again on a Tuesday afternoon around 3pm. I drank all of my water and had to start sipping on my boyfriend's before it was refilled. Also the AT&T guy came and the owner was yelling at him. 

A little more effort from the owner and staff and this could have been an amazing experience!

The sushi here is delicious, so I could've given it 5 stars based on that. I had been there several times, then I learned they had a great happy hour menu. It is a great deal, $3 on select items. Well, I went there for the deal and my boyfriend and I were treated awful. They made us feel embarrassed for going there for the deal. The restaurant is down the street from me, and the food is great, so it's a real shame. So if you want to go, don't go there for the happy hour special, they'll make you feel bad and cheap. They shouldn't even have it if they don't want to serve it to people.

Not sure why this place has such low ratings.  This place was at par with my expectation of airport food.
FOOD: I got the angus steak sub. They gave me enough meat, it was a bit messy and bread was mostly soggy, but hey, it was filling and less bland (mushrooms are flavorful) than other airport foods I have tried. Ask for a cup of water it's free.
PRICE: ~$8 not bad for a filling airport food
SERVICE: They have enough employees working here, so not a crazy wait.
BOTTOM LINE: If you are expecting airport food, grab a sub, get some sauce, jalapenos, banana peppers and dive in.

Typically Dunkin' isn't my coffee place but I received some coupons in the mail with the holiday drink promotions so I figured, what the heck I'll give it another try. The Merry Mocha Mint Latte sounded right up my alley, I always get Peppermint Mochas at my usual spot. The promotion ad said absolutely nothing about it not being out yet so the cashier had no clue what I was talking about and then rudely told me that it hasn't started yet. So I tried to order a normal Peppermint Mocha, sadly that is only seasonal as well, so I settled for a Caramel Mocha...not good. Glazed donut was good, but if I want coffee it definitely won't be from Dunkin'.

Paganini Ristorante has disappointing food, prices and atmosphere. Four of us paid more than $200 and left Paganini Ristorante hungry and unsatisfied. Although we requested an outdoor table through our reservation, they did not sit us on the patio that we were greatly anticipating (and had the room to accommodate us), but squeezed us into a little area on the porch with 8 other people in the corner of the building. To add to this disappointment, the food was overpriced, served in small portions and lacked flavor and creativity. I will not be returning or recommending this restaurant to anyone.

I've been to this location a few times, seems I've always had to ask them to "finish" the job in one way or another.  This time, my wheels were still filthy, while they dried off the car, there we still dirt in the some door jams including where the trunk lid comes down, they couldn't have opened the doors to wipe them down... there was still dust / dirt on the dashboard and instrument panel as well... my car wasn't even that dirty, and I paid for the $25 360 (interior/exterior).  unfortunately, 3 mediocre experiences, so that will be the last.  Too bad since they have a nice waiting area and the staff is very friendly.

Its a shame that the service was unacceptable.  We were sat and waited 20 minutes before I had to get up and ask who our waitress was.  Server blamed on hostess and hostess blamed on waitress.  Ordered drinks and tap was blown. Was offered a round of drinks for our trouble and had to ask at check time for them.  Settle for 2 of the 4 drinks.  On the other hand the snapper sandwich and the blackened shrimp were fantastic. The sauces and cook on the food was great. It seems if we were regulars we wouldn't have had any issues. Very regular crowd.  Will try again, only based on food.

I wanted to like this place. It seemed very cute from outside. My roommates and I got stuck in a back room where the temperature was 63F. Then it took over an hour for our food to come, and my friend's steak was undercooked for his preference. The waiter practically ignored us and almost never came around to check on us. Another table just a few away came in 15 minutes after us, and they were done eating by the time we got our food. I'm sad. The tortellini was some of the best I've had, but the food isn't enough to get me back there.

I met up with an old friend around 8pm on 5/13 for beers and the first thing I noticed was the strong smell of urine as I walked in the door. My friend and his buddy already had drinks and called the bartender over to take my drink order but as soon as she saw I was female, took a good fifteen minutes to do so. We all ordered a different shot and after she served us never came back to our end of the bar to see if we wanted anything else. I would give a one-star but she did make my chocolate cake shot correctly but that's the only saving grace, will never go there again

Our usual Chinese place closed earlier this year, we tried a couple of other places that were just so-so. One day I searched for nearby restaurants and just thought I'd take a chance on this place. I wasn't disappointed, my entire order was amazing. After tearing into my food, I realized the egg rolls and crab Rangoon are handmade. The wonton wrapper on the egg roll wasn't quite cooked all the way but I didn't care. The filling was so good! My toddler loved everything I put in front of her; egg foo young, vegetable fried rice, pork egg roll. I told my husband we now have a new Chinese place, looking forward to trying more!

This sushi place has a wide selection and variety of things to order from. The appetizers, sushi, desserts..endless options. The service here is also really good. The waitresses are respectful. When you walk in you are greeted by the hostess at the front of the restaurant. My favorite things to get here are the shrimp tempura, the eagle roll, pink lady roll and so much more. The miso soup is very warm and taste good too. Overall, if you are in the mood for an all you can eat sushi, Sushi King is the place to go.

I was mixed in my rating here. I'm 3.5/5 but more on the positive side. 

Pros:
- Very close by to other things in the area, workwise
- Recently renovated and looks good
- Breakfast area was good; food was as expected
- Plenty of parking outside
- Staff was friendly at all touchpoints I had with them

Needs Improvement:
- I believe the restroom could use a couple passes to make it cleaner than what it was
- I must have been in a room that was formerly a smoking room prior to renovation. It was okay but noticable; since i wasn't in the room but to sleep I was fine.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Solid 4.25/5 from me here.

- Arriving was pretty easy. Your GPS may get you there but just remember to Valet its in front and not in the garage
- Check-in was smooth and the staff were nice upon our arrival
- Room was clean and organized with no items that would be expected to be in the kitchen or bathroom were missing
- The breakfast was lots of the items you would expect: fruit, oatmeal, cereal, toast, waffles, eggs, omelets, etc.
- As far as proximity there are several places nearby - the shuttle will go as far as two miles for dropoff, one mile for pickup. you can do a lot with that!

Will be back!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I signed up last year as part of their NYE services. I've stayed with them until this point; but I paused my account for the summer (so it doesn't count as time spent there) and I had to pay to cancel. We were told it would be a $50 fee to cancel after the initial 6 months, but what they don't tell you is you have to give a month's notice, THAT THEY STILL CHARGE YOU FOR. This makes it $70+50= $120 to cancel the membership! I would have just kept it at that point. The fact is they only care about your money and how to get more of it. Pick another place to spend it.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Let's just say it needs a lot of help. Besides the fact that we paid for 2 people and we got 1 washcloth and I packet of coffee- there are no USB ports for your hone or tablet. The furniture ( chair and bench) were disgusting dirty and old. We were sitting outside by the pool, enjoying a glass of wine and talking to friends, when a security man came and told us we needed to leave! We weren't bothering anybody! The hot tub was warm at best. 
The only positive I can think of is you don't have to pay to park and you can walk to the stadium.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Pros
-In the heart of philly, walking distance to historic sites
-Priced decent (before you add parking) RIP OFF
-Pretty hotel
-Amazing bed and pillows 
-Clean room

Cons
-Zero personality of one of the female front desk people. The male was actually nice and helpful.
-Parking is sky high ridiculous, almost $40! A complete turn off. I checked in around midnight and still had to pay the full amount. For that I rather it be included in the rate so I'm aware up front and can chose my hotel based on an accurate budget. 
-No micro or mini fridge in room
-No darkening curtains
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have been in this subway a few times recently and have regretted choosing this location each time. The vegetables have been not yet ripe when served to me, therefore, they are very tough and acidic. I typically get a veggie delight so it ruins the entire sandwich. They also seem to have new employees who do not seem to be fully trained due to many mistakes and miscommunication. This subway has impressed me in the past and I hope to write a better review once they fix these problems. Otherwise a very clean location.

Great to be able to see well again. I really appreciated the optometrist's guidance as to what tests I actually required. 

The retail store is far and above many I've been to in my 43 years of wearing glasses. They helped me pick out exactly what I needed and what looked best on me. They were very patient and helped me go through dozens of pairs. I finally got down to 2. The staff helped me pick out the one that looked best - surprising it was the cheaper of the 2 by $200. Their goal was to have me happy with how I looked in them, not just to make more money.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Came highly recommended, but didn't live up to expectations. Staff very well trained in customer service, but seemed to lack warmth. Husbands quail was over cooked, but the beef tenderloin it was paired with was delicious. Table side service is a plus, as sauces served piping hot. My golden beet salad was fresh and tasty. However the halibut can be best described as mushy inside. The lemon and caper sauce was ok, but not flavorful enough so the dish lacked dimension. Waiter seemed annoyed with his helper and as a result passively refused assistance from him which delayed processing our credit card for 20 minutes.

The most delicious and fresh sushi I have ever had. My brother also eats a lot of sushi and he said this was the best sushi he has ever had. Don't even get me started on the calamari, we had to order two. The salad was enormous and delicious, along with the ginger dressing! Highly recommend the shrimp tempura roll, dynamite roll, and the fluke specifically on the sushi appetizer. The service was also amazing and the server specifically was very helpful and knowledgeable! I highly recommend. We will def be back. It truly deserved 5 stars.

When it comes to value, you get what you pay for. I can't speak for dinner but for lunch. I think I would have been better off eating my 10 dollar bill. My water had no ice, the food took way too long, the servers walk slower than the food. There is more rice on one piece of sushi then fish on the whole plate. It also seems like they don't pay their electricity bill, it was a light show with all of the lights going in and out. I would not recommend this place to a friend, there are much better all you can eat sushi places in Tampa.

Cool place for a drink....  Wait staff is friendly, but they really need to hire a cook!  

Ordered the octopus for app.... Underwhelming and smothered in mayo.... Spanish I think not.

Poke bowl was decent
Ordered the fried chicken and street corn

Chicken a little bland and slightly undercooked
Street corn way undercooked....  I'm questioning if they had on the fire.  Hope I don't get sick!

Hope you make it, but please pay attention to the food prep and quality control.  You all seem cool... but the food was blah.  Sorry?!?!?

Next day - not sick, but the thought of their food makes me want to gag.

Was able to get a room here when my airline canceled my flight and stranded me overnight. Staff were pretty busy when I was checking in, but were friendly and helpful. They have a free breakfast however I'll be leaving to early in the morning to take advantage of that. They have a pool and a workout room which seem really nice. I did have a small fridge in my room.
PS - when I checked out this morning- again the staff were very nice - they said some of the breakfast was out and to help myself. That was nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Don't bother with this idiotic place. My party of 3 included 2 people who do not fit in booths. All the tables are 8-toppers. At 7:20pm on a Friday night I counted 6 such tables completely free. Even so, we were told only parties of 5 or more are allowed tables. They refused to seat us just in case more people would show up. They lost money turning away paying customers in the hopes other people would show up?!  WTF?!?  It certainly explained why the lady coming out as we walked in said, "Sorry I don't have a party of 28!"

The only good part about this place was it was clean, pretty and quiet. That's why I have two stars and tipped $10.00
Other than that, I got a full set, she rushed the whole thing, burned me with the file on more than one occasion and left polish all over my fingers. Not to mention my nails look like total shit and I wish I had time to go get them redone before leaving town. Then when she dropped polish remover on my phone I almost said something. Slow down Lynn, u look like ur in a rush and it shows in your work.

Visiting family in Indiana and had heard great things about Jack's. These donuts were fantastic. We got a Jack's Dozen which was such a great value. My kiddos loved their chocolate frosting with sprinkles. I'm not a fan of cake donuts normally but theirs was soooo yummy in donut hole form. I judge a donut place by their yeast glazed donuts. Jack's did not disappoint- not too much dough and a lovely tasty glaze. My husband loved the tiger tail and apple fritter. Will definitely come back next time we are in town. The workers were very friendly!

The room was nice and the bed comfortable. The entrance staff were very helpful and attentive. Be sure to ask for a internet code at the desk though. My main complaint is with the housekeeping staff. We had until noon to check out and were planning to stay the whole time. We had the door locked and the privacy lock turned but housekeeping came by at 9am, knocked and woke us up. They came by again at ten and knocked and then again at 11. By the time we left we were quite annoyed with the lack of consideration of our time and privacy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've stayed in many Red Roof inns and this was by far the worst. My room smelled SO strongly of mildew that even after driving 9 hours and arriving at 2:30am, I nearly went to find another hotel. I slept with the window open to let some fresh air in. There were also brown stains on the walls, a hole in the fitted sheet (looked like a small piece of ash fell on it and burned through) and random hairs in the sheets. The floor felt permanently moist so I kept my shoes on as much as possible. The hallway smelled like weed and cigarettes. I didn't sleep as long as I intended, and I got out of there asap.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The service was extremely slow here. Even though it wasn't full, the three waitresses were busy chatting with each other instead of helping the customers. I waited 10 minutes to put in my order and then another 25 minutes for my to-go sandwich order, which doesn't look good for people who might need to catch a flight. 

The sandwich itself (BBQ chicken) was also not good. The chicken was of a weird texture, and had almost no flavor. I had to smother it in ketchup to make it taste okay. Fries were mediocre. Thank goodness I won't be returning to St. Louis Airport anytime soon, and if I do, I will not be stopping here.

Almost perfect. Lots of new equipment, bathroom layout is cool. But I hate it that they let people in here in there friggin work clothes to work out. Like utility workers. It really takes down the quality of the gym. I don't wanna see a guy in his whole construction attire And work boots on the treadmill. Like what is that? I wanna feel like I'm working out and not walking around downtown. Plus it's already mad construction going on all over the city, I don't wanna see any signs of that madness when I'm in gym mode. This has happened numerous times, and that's why I'm ranting. 

Everything else about the gym is awesome.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I'm here right now, just finishing breakfast. Stayed over one night because I went to the Friday night Shen Yun show (which was good but overrated and overpriced). Great location, good service,  clean and comfortable bed, pillows, and room plus plenty of amenities.  I paid $123 total for 2 queen bed room. In summer they even have an outdoor pool.  Just finished very good free hot breakfast, 6:30-10:30 am.   Check-in 3pm and checkout a generous 12 n. 
I would come here anytime if I needed to stay in Philadelphia overnite. I didn't have to park so I didn't need the $30 parking, I had taken the train in.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Came here for the third time to make sure I didn't get the wrong first and second impression. This time was the last straw. I was very excited to eat sushi on date night in my neighborhood, and I ordered my two favorite rolls: spicy tuna and cucumber, and the soft shell crab "spider" roll. I think only two pieces of the spider roll had crab in it. I felt nauseous while eating these rolls. "Maybe it was too much mayo?" Is what I kept telling myself. I don't know what it was but it made me feel vile afterwards.

We usually stay on the beach in treasure island but we went last minute and  most hotels where booked or way out of my price range. WOW I love this hotel with kids. breakfast was great every morning saved time and money the room was modern with a great shower! Easy to get  and park and 3 mins to beach ℝ and Publix grocery right there. Pool was clean not in the most beautiful spot in parking lot but has hammocks and palm trees help. Staff was excellent never felt scared or creeped out like some of the older properties. Planning on next trip and will be staying here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It gets two stars because its convenient to the airport and the rooms are ok.  The front desk was also nice and helpful.

Room service delivers wine in plastic cup and will not deliver water unless you buy bottled.
The ice machine on the my floor was out of order for the entire stay.
Me and another person waited at the bar for ten minutes for a bartender and left after nobody showed up during lunch.
The operator gave me attitude.
There was no "Do Not Disturb" sign in my room.
The TV worked, but the colors were way off.
There is a faint mildew smell in the hotel.

Bad Marriott property.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The people were great, nice, hospitable, service at the bar was great (I remember because I only had pop :D ) but the karaoke was a tough crowd. It wasn't really as happening as I expected. Coming from Vegas, maybe my expectations were high? But if you're looking for a fun, interactive experience where the crowd gets into it with you, this was not the experience I had. Every one was disinterested in everyone else and that's not what I'm used to, where everyone is cheering everyone else on. The staff from the security to the bartenders were all great!

Passed this place a bunch of times on my way to clinic so I decided to give it a try. The ambiance was very homey and felt like a family owned Italian restaurant. My mom ordered the minestrone soup and the Mediterranean salad and I ordered the same salad and the sausage frittata. Both of us were surprised of how much crab meat was given in the salad and found the whole meal to be enjoyable. Service was awesome and our server was very friendly and attentive. There wasn't really anything amazing that stood out but overall, it's a nice down to earth restaurant to enjoy with some good company.

Popped in randomly for dinner on a busy (unbeknownst to us) Saturday. We stopped at the bar for a quick drink before dinner. The bartender was rude and dismissive and constantly demeaning. However we had an incredible dinner and our server david was absolutely nothing short of amazing! The special with burrata and eggplant ravioli.  Unfortunately, the bartender dulled our experience immensely that it left such a sour taste. Recommendation: sit down and enjoy the experience and never deal with the arrogant bartender.

Around 7:30 last night I was ready for dinner. I'm staying at the Resident Inn right next to this location so I figured I could go for a sandwich. But, when I got to this Subway the doors were locked and the open sign was turned off. The girl standing behind the counter just looked at me. It was only 8:00pm yet it clearly states on the door and on here that they don't close until 9:00pm. It's very unprofessional to close early when hours state otherwise. Service could not be acquired, so I was very disappointed.

I am part of the Delayed Entry Program of the United States Marine Corps and I was very interested in this chain of gyms. I signed up yesterday on the one at Neil Road and I have to say that this gym is slacking compared to its counterpart the one by the mall. They need to update their workout equipment, keep it more sanitary, and the staff at this one aren't bad at all just not so welcoming. I was told by others that the energy here was low and now I believe them. I want to get stronger, but I also like an energetic gym and I am referring to the staff. Not a bad gym. Better than most, but it could be better.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Seriously beautiful and modern.  Post renovation each room is breathtakingly sleek, with comfortable beds, modern step in showers, a Keurig, and beautiful concrete floors.  The main dining, lobby, and bar area are also incredibly well designed.  I happened to get my room on priceline at a steep discount but the quality of the rooms could easily be several hundred a night.  The only minuses are that there was no office for computer use or printing (but the gentleman working at the front offered the use of their front desk computers), and no other amenities such as a gym.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Big Brand saved me! My car broke down at 7:45pm on a Friday night in the rain. I had my car towed to Big Brand Tire and Service because they were the only shop open on the weekends. The manager was still there at 8pm helping another customer out in crisis. He was so polite and kind to me even though I was holding him up even longer. I had my care back in my hands by noon the next day with a new alternator. They did a fantastic job, showed me my car and tried it out with me before I paid. I will always come back here and so will my friends and family!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Bistro 7's happy hour is amazing! They have lots of very delicious items on their menu for a very great price that you just can resist. My friends and I love to come for happy hour when we are super hungry because since the food is super cheap, we each get two plates each sometimes. I myself got the fish tacos and the artichoke dip. The fish tacos were sooo delicious and fresh! I can't wait to have them again. Their drink options are incredible too and they have lots of options to choose from! Check them out for happy hour!

Had lunch and ordered the crispino pizza and linguini with clam sauce. The pizza had a perfect balance of garlic, tomatoes, cheese and sauce. This was also a thing crust for those watching carbs. One of the best pizzas I had and you can tell the ingredients are fresh. The linguine with clam sauce was a home run! Sauce had a perfect balance and they use fresh ingredients. Could see the chopped parsley was done my knife. I would recommend this place to anyone who is in the area. Modest ambiance and high quality of food...

We made an unexpected to trip to Dino's before going to the World War II history museum in Nola. At 1 pm in the afternoon, there were only a few other patrons in the restaurant. Even then we weren't allowed to sit anywhere we wanted and had to be escorted to our table. 

I believe I paid $17 for a chicken wrap that was mediocre at best. My other friend paid $16 for a chicken sandwich. I believe these prices were too high for what the food was. 

Dino's may be different at night or to grab a pint with friends. But for the food, it may be best to go somewhere different.

When I'm in the mood for good Chinese food, I always order from here whenever I could. I've been eating here since I was young, the staff was always respectful and very nice. My sister and I got a free two liter soda once and we didn't even spend that much to deserve it. This family owned business has the best general Tso chicken and beef and Broccoli I've ever had, right up there with their chicken wings with rice special. It's simple and unmatched in the area. I wish I could give a six star review, but I'm not allowed. I am however allowed to recommend virtually everything on their menu. The prices are reasonable as well.

I only come here on Wednesdays for country night, and it is always a good time! Priced well ($5 cover and well priced beers), but I almost wish they raised the price on the cover though, as it is waaaaay too crowded. The staff seems overworked, but they are still very friendly. 

The dance floor is small and the music is DJ'ed, but that is expected for any southern California country music night. They play an awful lot of club hits for being a "country night". 

Tailgate Taylor is a great host, and the people are really fun- if only it wasn't so damn crowded!!

While staying at IU Methodist I found this shop via Google. The atmosphere was old world with a plethora of men products (razors, hat, shoe shine, etc). I arrived when they opened and got right into a chair. One of the barbers Bryan took my request and went right to work on my hair. He was professional, courteous and good. 20 minutes later I was restored to my grown and sophisticated self. Get job Reds and Bryan, the next time I'm in your city I will be back. I loved the fact that it was minutes from Market Circle.

We were staying at the Maison Dupuy Hotel and this place was like a block away. We already knew we wanted to try a Hand Grenade that we'd read about so this was our 1st stop of our trip. We walked in, it was like 430 in the afternoon on a Tuesday and they had a band playing and the place just had a good vibe. The bartenders were really friendly, we ordered our grenade and stuck around for a few minutes and off we went. We were too excited to just sit still lol. After about 20 mins we both looked at each other and and were shocked and how quick these things were hitting us. It was a great way to start off the day !

I think that for what it is, this motel was fine for one night: inexpensive, seemingly clean, ideal location, fridge, microwave, and a provided breakfast in the morning.  My only complaint: Our room was pretty noisy throughout the night.  We were in room 118, and I think we must have been right next to generators or something. I am used to outside sounds since I live relatively close to a freight train when I am at home, but this was pretty loud. At around 6am when I was still laying in bed I could also clearly hear my hotel neighbor's toilet experience. So I guess my suggestion to future guests might be to bring earplugs.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've gone to the other place in the area, and let me tell you Wing Wah is head and shoulders above them. The food is consistently satisfying-- especially their hot and sour soup. What's even more satisfying than the food is that the family who runs the place is kind, personable, and polite-- every single member. I once watched the owner carry an elderly man's take out order back to his car for him-- patiently walking with him, opening the door and everything.  

Good food, and good people who deserve your business.

I was in need of assistance in a Trust matter and went into the closest Wells Fargo Branch for help. It was rather a difficult situation and I was assisted by Susan Irwin-Hua. She is a business specialist. Instead of shuffling me off to some department deep in the Wells System, she jumped right in and within a day had procured the needed documents. She did a thorough and marvelous job. That's the third time I've gone to Wells Fargo about a difficult matter, and I have to say, I have been well-taken care off.  Thank you. A Barbera

Place was very nice, service was a little off but I guess it is understandable due to the fact that there are many customers and it is also an all-you- can- eat sushi restaurant. 
Two menu was given, one for sushi and one for kitchen (fried and other food) 
All the sushi was very unique and was very appealing (highly recommend to anyone and everyone), however, the tempura and fried food was not on par with its sushi. 
The tempura and fried food is a little plain--seem like there was not any kind of seasoning on it (would not recommend)

This airport terminal quick service food counter is no better than what you would receive at the mall. It even comes complete with a plate out front offering free bourbon chicken samples. While you have to choose between rice or noodles as your first option, you can then choose two meat/veggie combinations. It's a lot of food but the price is higher than the mall and the quality isn't delicious. It's fatty, sugary chicken. I was more pleased to eat the broccoli than I was the accompanying chicken. Sadly there aren't many options for food in this terminal but I would skip here.

I wanted to go here because I use to go there all the time for pharmaceutical meeting and have had the best food. I went with what was on special and that was the spaghetti for 9.50 well I didn't know it was all you can eat cause first off it said it on a board 9.50 for spaghetti it didn't say all you can can spaghetti and the second our server didn't even bother to tell us the specials today and after I ordered it he still didn't bother saying anything about it. I am a server and I would have approached my table with all the specials for that day I am really upset that I didn't get more spaghetti and I could have.

I have been going to this restaurant for 15+ years 3 to 5 days a week every week . I actually could tell you the names of half a dozen or more people that have been there for almost 15 years. In my early early-morning hours (5am) I stop by there to get a sandwich and a drink. It looks like a ghost town. I gave them five opportunities to have things speeded up.  So now I go right around the corner get me me some breakfast tacos from steak and SteaknShake, because the wait can be up to 8 to 10 minutes at the McDonald's drive through.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I love this place! I've been coming here for almost 4 years now & have never once been disappointed. I first found Dafne after an at-home root touch-up that came out orange. I totally panicked because I was flying out for an event in 2 days & needed professional help A S A P. Dafne saw me after hours, toned out the orange, & added ash to bring me to a natural, light reddish-brown look. It was absolutely perfect! I've since had cuts & color done by Vera & Anna who are also kind, patient, & very talented. Can't recommend Beauty Salon V enough!

This is a great authentic taqueria. The chips are made there and the salsa and queso are great. We ordered ceviche for the table and it was gone in no time. We were seated in this oddly separated section from the large dining area so the servers were a little hard to get ahold of, but once the food finally came out it was amazing. I ordered a la carte tostadas with roasted pork and it was great. The only thing I didn't eat was the fried tortilla because my fork couldn't break it apart very easily, but this place had some fantastic food.

DON'T stay here, especially your car, vandalism is a very big problem in their garage. We were told it was safe to park and paid reluctantly and hoped for the best. Bleep *^~* the next morning our vehicle had been broken into and all our belongings stolen. The police were wonderful to us, and stated it was a recurring problem at this place , which has changed its name from a Crowne Plaza. Shame on the hotel for their lack of attention to safety and hospitality. My disgust to Priceline as well for using this place on their site, Neither  one took responsibility.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces
