text:
As others have noted, there aren't a ton of restaurants in this area. There are two main Mexican restaurants in the Mooresville/Camby area, but this is definitely my favorite. The menu is pretty big, and there are actually vegetarian options that include more vegetables than peppers and canned mushrooms. The salsa and chips are great as well.

One thing that makes this my favorite is the fact that it's usually less crowded than the other Mexican restaurant. You can almost always get a seat and prompt service, which isn't a guarantee in this area.

If you're looking for someplace to go for a regular dinner out, this is the place to go in Camby.

I lived here for two years. It's okay it's not great. I moved in and there were stains in my living room and apparently I never noted it for the walk in so I had to pay the difference for the rips my dog caused, but they weren't willing to deduct anything for those stains. 
Also, it always smells like a dumb in this neighborhood. No one picks up their dog poop and no one takes care of the dog play area. The only good thing about this place are the workers. They are helpful and nice. The ladies in the office are all nice as well. 
Overall, I wouldn't live there again.

I ordered from here for the first time tonight using Uber Eats, I'm pretty sure they were busy but I had great expectations. However I ended up underwhelmed by the lack of flavor in my chipotle steak tacos. Despite that the ingredients were fresh and well cooked, the portions were generous, and everything came well packaged. I also ordered the plantains and chips and salsa. Both of those were pretty good but I definitely preferred the salsa verde to the salsa morita. 
Overall I'd be willing to order from here again to try different salsas to see if there's one I like better, and to get sides that pair better with my entree.

The staff was amazing! My best friend and I came into town for the film festival. I had reserved for one person with a king bed and needed two beds it was not a problem and the lady was super sweet about trading our room. They have hospitality down baby! We had a slow drain in the shower mentioned it to Lonnie in the hallway and zap it was like bran new! At check out time it takes a little time to get the car but hell... It's check out time! Over all very very pleased! If they have rooms open next trip I will be staying here mofo!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Very disappointed with this place. 
The sushi was mediocre and I hardly could chew the fried calamari. Never had such a bad calamari in my life.
Happy hour is a total BS, to be able to order for that menu you must order a drink and I personally never drink any soda. And if you get a drink your sushi will basically will cost u the same as a full price. 
I asked for spicy mayo and guess what they charge you 1.00 for couple drops of spicy mayo which no place ever charges. 

Overall I don't recommend this place.

I stayed, received a good rate and a complimentary upgrade because my wife had a very bad experience when she stayed. There was hair in the shower, An old wash cloth hanging from the shower curtain rod, and food stains on the window curtains - almost like someone used it to wipe their mouth. They went through a pretty big renovation, yet my room had visible ceiling repairs that were poorly done. There were families there that allowed their children to run through the halls on Saturday night, yelling and screaming until 2:30-3:00 AM and mgmt did nothing to quiet them. I'm sorry, but no incentive will get me to stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I really did like this place at first. But when the best nail tech, Dawn, I was devastated but still came to see who else was good in the shop. They had a rule posted at the door that says only speak English out loud and with customers, and since Dawn left (someone who abided by that rule), barely do you understand your own nail tech there. I gave a new man there a chance to do my nails, the first time it was okay. Second time horrible. Sloppy. Shaping Was terrible and I'm either going to find Dawn or find another place. Sorry. This gets a one star from me. No stars if i could.

Had lunch here the other day, the food is bomb and pretty affordable. Had the chicken salad for 7 bucks this time they really hook up a lot. The Salmon teriyaki is suuuper good. 
The service is nice here atmosphere is peaceful and laid back but quick and neat.  shoutout too Dom who took our order and was very welcoming and pro and Daniela for being so sweet and present we had nice convo while she continued to take care of the store and multitask. Overall this joint is A+ i like the staff and service- tasty food/ beautiful girls working always. 
Nice place

Terrible service, ordered online for curbside pick up and when I arrived I waiting 25 out in my car before finally going inside to retrieve my order! Then when I arrived home to eat my sandwich, there is literally like 3 pieces of turkey on my foot long so I was pretty much eating bread and lettuce only. Absolutely ridiculous. To top it all off, I ordered cookies as well and they were so hard. Like a rock! Probably yesterday's leftovers. Never will I return to this location again! And subway needs to learn to add more meat to their sandwiches instead of charging $4 more for the amount of meat that should originally be on the sandwich.

I paid for the ultimate car wash (priciest on the menu) which is to include a vacuum, dust dash and center console and a mat clean. They sprayed my mats off but didn't actually clean them so they are still dirty. They failed to clean/dust the center console area and also failed to vacuum my front car seats. I have come to J's multiple times and normally this service takes 30-45 minutes, but today it took maybe 10. I didn't get a chance to check my car over since I went there on my lunch break and had to get back to the office. Extremely disappointed considering I paid for these services.

Checked in today and was planning on staying for 5 nights. Pierre, the front desk rep was by far the most rude employee I have ever encountered at any Marriott. I prefer Marriotts because I've been fortunate enough to gain platinum elite status through their reward's program for several years. He is the first Marriott employee that I have encountered that has been completely incompetent in customer service. I see that another customer left a review about him being very combative and rude. I will be going across the street to the Hilton to stay the remaining nights.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Typically this Starbucks has friendly employees and pretty good service but last week I had an odd experience. I was driving to Orlando when I went through the drive through. My coffee tasted normal but when I got to the bottom I discovered it was full of coffee grinds. After that sip full of grounds I noticed the sleeve on my drink had a message that said "Be Kind" and the rest of the sleeve was shaded red. No idea why this message would have been to me since we didn't really interact with anyone for very long and went through the drive through. In any case I'm disappointed and we may be skipping this Starbucks in the future.

I decided to order from here, even after reading some bad reviews. That was a big mistake. I order general Tso chicken with white rice and a order of crab Rangoon. When I put the bag in my car I felt like it smelt kinda funky, but I continued my drive home. When I first opened up the box I could smell the funk even worse. I decided to try a piece of chicken. When I tell you this was probably some of the worst food I've had in my whole life. I didn't even take a full bite spit it out and took the food I immediately back and asked for a refund.

If I could give this restaurant zero stars I would. This is the absolute worst restaurant in the Reno-Sparks area. First, I found a hair in my sushi. Then, I got violently ill off the food with the worst food poisoning of my life. Then when I filed a complaint with the manager, she was extremely defensive and basically told me that she did not care that the food coming from her restaurant made me sick. The service is rude. The food is repulsive. I'm unsure how this restaurant is still in business. DO NOT EAT HERE.

I'm a huge fan of Bar Rescue so when we decided to come to NOLA for our honeymoon it was the first place I wanted to visit. The bar seemed dirty and kinda dingy. We ordered 2 resurrections, shrimp po boy, bacon wrapped cheese balls (can't remember the name). The drinks were super sweet and not what I expected. The po boy was okay, the cheese balls were excellent. The service kinda sucked despite it being absolutely dead inside. The only waitress on the floor kept having to do "chair shots" and even almost fell (twice) doing them because the floor was so nasty and wet. I'm glad I got to go, but definitely not going back.

This is my 3rd time going. Food is tasty! Pretty good and the restaurant is clean. All 3 times I order spicy ramen. Is was good with big amount. Today I ordered spicy ramen with shrimp spring rolls and dumplings. The ramen same as usual and the dumplings can't go wrong with dumplings. Today I felt like trying shrimp spring roll. It come with 3pc and a nice chilly sauce. Is was good but had too much oil. But besides is was awesome. The ramen is good here but a little salty. Wish they put little bit more noodles. This place is good to get something simple. Never tried their sushi yet but will soon.

I did not rent a car here, just dropped off my Alamo rental.

Was not prepared for the crowded 15+ minute bumpy, noisy shuttle bus drive around the perimeter of MSY to the new terminal. 

Long drive, no doubt repeated endlessly every day of every week.  Environmental concerns? Air quality concerns?  Apparently not.

Or . . . plans for a new car rental center are in the works.  

The existing one was very efficient, and took only a few minutes to shed the car and grab the paperwork.  About all that can improve is the location.  And it sure needs improving.

My daughter wanted a pizza delivered to school to celebrate her birthday with her friends during lunch. I ordered the pizza online at 7 am for a 11:15 am delivery.  I called to  confirm my order around 10:30 am,  just to make sure there were no issues with the online order.  They assured me that the order was received and she would get her pizza.   Needless to say, my daughter spent her entire lunch period (ON HER BIRTHDAY) in the office waiting for a pizza that came an hour late.  She and her friends didn't have lunch that day! NOT HAPPY!!!!

I was a member for 3 months and I was highly disappointed. The owner of the gym is hardly ever there. When I tried joining she never answered the phone or was present to sign me up and was locked out of the gym twice. She will also post a sign saying she'll be back at a certain time and she never showed at her stated time. What a joke. 

There is also a shortage of clean towels. I swear 80% of the time the towel rack is empty. Lastly, there is no bench press machine if it matters to you. I really wanted to like this gym but the owner seems to have checked out.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Walked in and immediately met with glares from the patrons at the bar. This seemed to happen to every new customer that walked in. Maybe that's just how the regulars are? But it was odd. We ordered a third burger after the first two sandwiches left us hungry. Onion rings were rock hard. Ordered a few shots of the day and watched our server go back to the bar and continue her sidework instead. Had to approach the bar and ask a different server for the shots we ordered.  Stopped in for some "cheap" drinks and food and somehow still managed to spend $70 between two of us. Left feeling "meh" about the place.

I have had my hair done multiple times at Homegrown. The owner was so booked cause she's so great, passed me on to one of her trusted coworkers  who did an amazing job. She analyzed my hair after coloring, decided that a dry-cut was best for my hair type (not my first time with that because I have thin hair) and killed it. I've received nothing but compliments on the cut/color/style from public/friends in the industry. I'm so satisfied! Feeling SO GOOD and confident after the whole process. Couldn't have had a better experience.

When someone tells you to walk through a Holiday Inn to get to a restaurant, you can't help but give them the side eye... I am happy that I did not listen to my judgmental side and gave Jimmy's a shot. The views are unbelievable and we even saw a few dolphins during our meal. 

Get: the Grouper Bites appetizer, Mongolian Beef Bowl (ask for less sauce unless you like your rice drenched), and Mojitos!

Skip: the Philly Cheesesteak and Rum Bucket

Sidebar: you can tell that they are short staffed, please be patient with the staff!

We were very unhappy with our meals this evening. Our waitress mixed up our order and brought two wrong dishes. We had to wait for the kitchen to make my meal separately.  In the meantime our friends meal was going cold because they didn't bring any silverware. Waitress was not interested in keeping us happy and she was very inattentive. My meal was supposed to be spicy but there was no spice at all. Apparently my husbands meal was so bland and had hardly any taste to it. Needless to say, we would not recommend this restaurant and will not visit again.

Great food and service in a local Tucson neighborhood area not far from the U of A.  Same location as Trader Joe's and Thrifty ice cream right next door.  Local feel to the restaurant so don't expect white tablecloths; it's casual and focus is in the food, which is authentic and dinner items are well portioned.  If you're having sushi rolls, you might need one or two. My son really likes the Saba shioyaki and it's served as a full half of the fish! The sukiyaki beef udon was really good, total comfort food and a huge portion! We eat here every time we visit.

I was disappointed with almost all aspects of this visit.  When my family and I walked in I received blanks stares from the "hostesses."   Not a hello or welcome.  I had to say table for 4 and then still nothing.   I ordered the oven roasted tilapia
And spinach salad.  The salad was dressed with an abundance of oil and had no flavor.  The tilapia was fried and sitting on a layer of bland dressing.  The kids weren't impressed with their meals either.  All half eaten and no carry out boxes.  The waiter was nice.  That's why I gave one star.

I've taken my dog to Banfield for years when we lived in Arizona. So, I continued once we moved to PA. We're still very happy with the care, but our last visit to this location was less than satisfactory. The examination room was filthy. The floor was almost black from dirt, and there was animal fur wedged in the corners (as though it was cleaned at one time, and the fur deposited there). In a medical facility, extra care should be taken to ensure cleanliness. Unless they clean up their act, we'll have to go to a different location. 

But I hope not to have to do that.

Overall it was a good hotel, we stayed for the weekend to go to Busch Gardens. The hotel room when we arrived was clean, also the lady at the front desk who checked us in was very sweet, and helpful. The only reason I didn't give a full five stars is because we weren't able to connect to the wifi at all for our work the two days we stayed. Also the house cleaning didn't empty out our trash and was just left it there. Other than those two complaints this was a good hotel stay for Marriott because whenever and wherever we go we always Book with Marriott.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Amazing little brunch restaurant in the hotel. The whole establishment is open to locals, they're welcomed in the restaurants and the pool on the third floor. Our waiter, Peter, was extremely helpful and went absolutely above and beyond. I have a gluten sensitivity, and when I mentioned that the gluten free bread was amazing, Peter secured my own loaf from the kitchen. He didn't stop there, he brought out the executive sous chef to talk to me about his distributor and the best way to make gluten free bread from scratch. It was absolutely incredible, the service was amazing, and I've never had such concern for my allergen. A+, 10/10
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This location has always had a superb wash outside of the touch free unit.  It was horrible but, NOW THEYRE UPGRADING IT AND IT PROMISES TO BE EVEN BETTER THAN THE AWESOME ONE THAT IS CURRENTLY OPEN!!  I can't wait!  And the lady that is there today did the MOST OUTSTANDING THING ANYONE AT ANY CARWASH HAS EVER DONE FOR ME!!!  God bless your soul mam!  . I'll be making it up to your company very soon!  And the blond dude with the stach is too cool.  He cracks me up with his humor and is always more than kind to me.  5 stars y'all!!!  I'm a customer for life!!!

This was my first time going to salon bass, and I have to say I felt like I was treated as if I was a long time customer. I believe my Stylists name was Sydney but I could be wrong :/ I'm not the best with names. Long story short , I have long hair that I haven't cut in 2+ years. Let's just say I'm frightened of trusting anyone with scissors near It. When I said I want a trim, that's exactly what I got here. I originally needed a trim because the knots in my ends were becoming unmanageable. Now after the best trim ever... not a knot in sight! I'd give more stars if I could for this review honestly!

This place is awesome!! I am not really an Italian food seeker or a pizza or heavy bread place seeker but this place is definitely worth eating at! The patio outside is so beautiful with lots of greenery, they had a live band, fans blowing to keep a nice breeze and the bugs off you. We went on Monday and they have early bird specials, happy hour, $4 margs and Mojitos on Mondays. We really enjoyed our time here. We did notice their mojitos were watered back which was a little disappointing. We each had 5 mojitos and it was as pretty clear they contained half the alcohol of a normal drink.

I have ordered from this restaurant numerous times through grubhub.com. Several negatives have caused this restaurant to lose one of its most regular customers. I am disgusted with the level of customer service or lack thereof. I was told by phone that the order would be 30 minutes late. It has been almost three hours and I finally got them to answer the phone. They suddenly stopped delivering on Sundays and changed their hours. Did they notify me? Nope. Did they take their service offline? Nope. They did say sorry, they forgot. Well my hungry family didn't forget. Let's see if I even get a refund on my credit card.

I've been coming to American nails for years. They've always done well with doing my nails and did them how I like them. Lately that hasn't been the case. The past three times that I've been here I've had to FIX MY OWN NAILS because they've been crooked, uneven and overall terrible and embarrassing. I just want to rip them off. I guess I'll have to try elsewhere from now on. I love it here but they've just stopped caring.
Attached are some photos showing you how crooked my index finger is and how uneven the polish is on literally every finger. Purple was my last visit and yellow was today.
How do you let your customers walk out like this?

Came here years ago until all my clothes were stolen as soon as I went to grab something out of my car.
Woman running the place is hostile, rude and yells. She immediately demanded to see my laundry, told her its in my car and before I could explain I wanted to be sure she could give me smaller bills for my $20, she yelled at me that she's heard this story before, she's never seen me here, change machines are for customers only and kept yelling to see my laundry. This place is STILL THE WORST and the thought of being near this angry, bitter woman with an attitude for two hours seems worse than hell itself.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Had a nice stay at the Marriott, the room seemed clean. Spacious. No loud disturbances. Lobby is pretty big and with snacks available. The pool is also a plus specially with little kids. It's not terribly huge or deep but enough to stretch some little legs in the water. The towel rack however was lacking refreshing. Low quantity of towels was a little unexpected but there were about 18 kids in the pool at the time when we went, with hardly any adult supervision. Overall conveniently located near restaurants, highways, wal-mart, etc so it was a perfect midpoint for us.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: There is a large selection of glasses but most are up-marked in price. The eye exam was pretty quick about 5 minutes, and what I'm usually used too is a bit longer. Another customer actually came in to have his young daughter's glasses fixed because the prescription was inaccurate. My issue is specifically with one of the front working employees. He asked to see my glasses during check in, for what reason? It was not specified. When I left the store I realized there was a scratch on my right lens of my glasses. The scratch was on the inside of my lens.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is by far the best pizza place in the middle Tennessee area! We have been frequenting their business for the last 20 years since they were a small family owned business in the Factory at Franklin.  I'm shocked that more people don't seem to know about this gem.  They make the best crust and use all of the freshest ingredients!  All of the employees we have come across have been very friendly and helpful as well. If you haven't tried it yet, you are missing out. Head on over and get yourself one today - you will be glad you did . I give them an A+!!

Where do I begin... This is the worst place I've ever stayed. Moldy corroded bath tub dead bugs and lumpy bumpy beds for starters. Room service never came had to go down and get towels for the next day.  No manager on duty no ice in the ice machine for two days straight, the pool restrooms were completely trashed with filthy debris God knows what else on the floor. The breakfast buffet had nothing went down at 10 o'clock and everything was gone including the coffee!  Beyond disappointing as this was parents weekend I would never want my any parents or children to stay at this place
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been there twice, and had poor experiences each time. The first time my suit came back with some strange polyester like threads and lint all over it. I had to take a sticky roller to it just to clean it off. The second time I showed up at 3 o'clock on a Saturday and the lady wouldn't let me in to pick up my clothes because she said they closed at 3. She was extremely rude, dismissive and did not care at all. There are too many dry cleaners in the area for me to reward their poor service with my business
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Came here with my husband kids and dog. Really nice and clean new building. Dog friendly. My husband went in and got his coffee after he was finished I went in and went to the restroom. I asked for a cup of water and the girl had told me they charge $0.25 for water. And then just ask if they could unlock the bathroom so I can fill my dog's bowl with water and she said yes. Then the young man that worked there said that he could give me a cup of ice put in the dogs water as well. I appreciated that, i am sure our dog did too!

Food is always good there. The employees not so good. (This particular location) Couple days ago I went there around 12am and there was nobody in line. I stand there looking what I want and when I looked in the window no employees where there. I knocked on the window and still no answer. (10 minutes later) When someone did come, there was a car in the drive thru. The employee looked at me and COMPLETELY ignored me. She went straight to the car. When she finally came to me, she didn't even apologize for taking so long. 
She said " what do you want " terrible service

This place I think is a mixed review for everyone. because I looked up reviews for this place once and it would be like 1 bad review, 1 good review. Not a lot of betweens.

My brother and I went here once during their happy hour. 5 minutes after the happy hour ends, they bring us the check without the discount. We were not happy about it.

I've been here with a group several times and we've all been happy. The service might have been a little slow but still good.

I came here once with one group and the service was terrible. They couldn't remember orders, forgot rolls. My friend wont go back there.

When I'm in the area, I always go here.

I've never had a bad experience here and it's my go-to take out place now. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because I feel like the longer they've been open, the less I enjoy the atmosphere. It was fun and hip when they first opened, but now it feels kind of quiet, dark, and sad. Something's missing and I can't quite put my finger on it. The bathroom is dirty 8/10 times I go which is annoying but I'm not sure if I'm annoyed with the people that make the mess or the lack of cleanliness more? Either way, I love their food.

Similar to other reviews: I really want this place to suceed and love giving business to small locals but I have to be transparent about some flaws.

Cool atmosphere and theme for sure, however they are wrongfully assuming they can charge premium prices on what is average ice cream imo due to their location and absence of direct competition.  I dare not even ask to try a flavor before buying (apparent vibe) and each topping is $0.75.  If interested check this place out before you can't, I give them one summer if they dont wise up :/

I would give zero stars if it was a possibility. 

I had a reservation for a vehicle, well in advance. Pick up time 12 pm. My family and I get to Tampa, only to find out they are closed at 12! paid $200 for an uber to get to our destination. Call them only to find out that they re-sold our vehicle because we didn't pick up. How would we pick up a car at a time when they are closed???? Horrible customer service. A complete rip-off. I will be posting anywhere I can to detour people from using this place!!!!!!!!!!!

I've been here twice and both times there was no hostess at the entrance despite the sign saying we must wait to be seated. The second time a server seated us. As soon as we sat down he told us the kitchen was closing soon so we had limited time to put in our order. Maybe if a hostess had been doing their job when we entered the restaurant we would have had ten more minutes to view the menu?

The food is decent and our servers have been fine. It's just frustrating to not be greeted when entering. Not very welcoming.

Never been to Platt's.  Never even heard of them until given a Free Pizza coupon - so we tried them.  Isn't this why you give out a coupon - to entice people in?  We ordered wings and a Margherita pizza.  Wings were OK (have had better) and the pizza was only OK too  (I feel I'm being generous with an "OK" review as we had to throw it in the oven when we got home as it was soggy and undercooked.)  

Would I recommend Platt's  - no way!  Sally O' Neal's is way better!   And to add insult to the injury of their food - they didn't even honor the coupon.  Lame!   Go elsewhere.

So, rented a car from this place for almost 8 months because of an accident.   Bottom line it the company is so big the DO NOT care at all about us the little guys.  This location is poorly managed and we were charged at least four different rates during our rental  We were then told to go online and we could get a better rate.  I ended being told to go to the airport and rent a car and it would save me $ 200.00.

They are not honest or they are just clueless.  Bottom line it I will never rent from this company again, there are a number of other options.  Right now I am using Thrifty and they seem great!   RUN don't walk away.

Nothing says bad management like receiving a old & cold burger during lunch hour in drive thru.  I called and spoke to the manager who was nice on the phone about this. She told me they do not use warmers and that burgers are made fresh. Clearly this burger is over 1 hour old because of the dark crusted edges and cold temp.  Check your food before you leave with your order... never going back even though she said she'd give me my next meal for free. Incompetence is unforgivable when it comes to public health.

We decided to try this place the other day. Walked in and sat ourselves (didn't see anyone). Grabbed our own menus. Girl came out twice and didn't see us. We almost left. But once she did see us we had a great dinner. Food was a lot better than most Italian restaurants. They only have beer and wine but that's ok with us. Price was very reasonable. We will definitely go back!
We had the spaghetti with sausage, garlic knots, fried ravioli, pasta alla vodka, Caesar salad and Italian wedding soup. Everything was delicious and seemed homemade.

I'm sorry but WTF ya'll. How hard is it to get an order right? I waited 15 minutes in the drive thru for 2 cars ahead of me. I ordered a harvest salad and ya'll didn't even put a fn fork in the bag? Not only that but the salad was old and ya'll didn't even cut the tomatoes fully. I didn't get any of the harvest salad toppings or the right cheese. LAZY is what it is. If you hate your job and wanna ruin reputation for quality then fn quit. I paid 9 bucks and I got a dollar sandwich and a rotten salad. Get your stuff together cause this is a travesty.

This was the Oracle Road location.
I ordered takeout in June, 2020. Chicken enchiladas. Five stars. DELICIOUS!

I ordered takeout again in November 2020. The same order, chicken enchiladas.
It was horrible. The corn tortilla wrapping was raw. ( The corn tortilla is supposed to be oiled and fried on both sides before adding the filling). 
Compared to the same order in June: There was hardly any chicken in the enchiladas. Hardly any refried beans. Hardly any rice. Maybe a new cook?
What a disappointment!
We will try one more time, hoping for the best.

I went in on Mother's day so I knew it was going to be busy. And it actually wasn't. Got in and greeted by a guy who asked if we had  reservations. We said no and he said they could only sit us outside which was kind of cold outside. But then a lady came and said that we could be sitted inside. But food is over priced and not that good. And my chicken was burnt and undercooked. Like how is thay even possible?! I told our waiter that and ahpwed him the pinkness and said "oh no it's cooked" I was so annoyed I just paid and left.

My mom lost her wallet that consists of over $2,000 in cash & credit cards. I called this location cause we for sure lost it there. The workers said they didn't see it & they WOULDNT let us view their camera. One of the workers had it this whole time cause he wanted to keep it for himself. I threatened to call the police... & THEN he finally brought out the wallet & told me he found it outside near a bush. Get the eff out of here. If you guys ever lose something... Those workers will keep it. They won't tell you. Those filthy savages.

Go for the food not for the service, received our sushi with zero explanation on what roll was which. That's not after we had to explain to 4 different servers that we wanted water but would order drinks in a little. We sat down and not even had 5 minutes to look at the drink menu and they wanted to rip it out of our hands. Server didn't even ask if we liked our food or if we wanted more. It's a shame because the place has GOOD sushi... Very good. But their service is awful. Prices are on par for what you get just the service needs a ton of work. Enjoy!

With all the great Italian restaurants in this area it is very hard to receive a 5 star rating. I've been going to Gia Nina's for ten years and have never been disappointed.  They carry a small menu but everything on it is good. The price is very reasonable and the portions are large. It has a cozy atmosphere with music on most nights.  Their many kinds of pizza are all great and the waitresses are very nice. What more can you ask for. Be sure to get there early or you will have to wait for a table. South Jersey's best kept secret.

This was our first time to this place.  It was busy and we started to leave.  We had to wait an hour but we stayed and we were all so glad we did.  It was amazing!  Where do I start?  The Salsa is freshly made at your table and was SO good along with their chips.  My daughter and I are Vegetarians and they have a nice selection for that.  (The Chili Rellenos ) were awesome!  The Talapia dinner was fantastic per my granddaughter.  The service was wonderful!  Will we be back?  In a heartbeat!    Will go back the next time we are there!!

Avoid this restaurant...fast food would be a better choice.  The service is horrible.  I waited 15 minutes just to get a host to seat me when the restaurant side was empty.  I had to ask the front desk twice if the restaurant was open.  I should have taken this as as sign.  

The food is below average.  The 'chopped' salad was a basic iceberg lettuce house salad, nothing chopped about it. The sea bass fish was extremely greasy -- I could not stomach it.  The food is on the level of the free breakfast at a Fairfield Inn.

My wife and I had a nice meal at the Brickside Grill on Saturday night. Service was great and the delivery of the drinks, appetizers and the entrees were timed just right.

We started with the Buffalo Shrimp. Finally, a restaurant not afraid to make something buffalo with a kick. These four shrimp were actually hot.
For dinner, I had the prime rib and my wife had the blackened prime rib. I found the prime rib a little fatty but it was cooked just right (medium). My wife liked the blackened prime rib but they should leave off the cheese.

We will be going back since there were many items on the menu that we would like to try.

Time, and time again, I give this location the opportunity to improve on their customer service. Yet every time I find the experience lacking. So again, for the 3rd or 4th time, I am again left without a receipt for my order. It is not the responsibility of the customer to request a receipt for their purchase, it is the obligation of the seller to provide a receipt. The franchise owner needs to make it a policy to provide their customers with a proof of purchase. I am sick and tired of using the drive thru, returning home, and finding myself without a receipt.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Am I missing something? Y'all are crazy saying this is the best pizza in Philadelphia. I totally had high hopes from reading other reviews. Had being the key word. I could compare this to high-school cafeteria pizza, except the pizza at my high school was excellent compared to this place. And to boot, they're cash only and couldn't give me a receipt so I couldn't even get reimbursed from my job for this mistake of a pizza I ate. This place would do in a pinch, like if my car broke down and all I had was cash and couldn't quite make it to Main St. or Ridge for better pizza joints. All of which would probably never happen :-). Sorry Alex's!

We decided on Cafe Napoli for our anniversary dinner this year.  It did not disappoint!  Everything from atmosphere to service to food was spectacular.  We started with the arancini and the crab Caprese salad.  Both were delicious.  The Chilean sea bass was a real treat.  It paired perfectly with the restaurant's unique take on rigatoni carbonara.  My husband had the penne vodka which he really enjoyed.  You must also try the bread pudding even if you take it to go like we did.  The meal was delightful from beginning to end.  We definitely made the right choice for our special day!

We came in for lunch and order from lunch menu. Reasonable price with just right amount of food. But I experience hair on my nigiri and ask for a new one, No need to be exaggerated. Staff apologized but I expected more than that to be honest. Our staff quite confused with our order but the food still come out right. The restaurant is clean in overall as I seen. We ask to substitute the California roll to yellowtail roll but they will add $2 extra which is funny for me when the yellowtail roll is cheaper than California roll. So we just stick with what we got. The food was mediocre. Im gonna look for a better Japanese food restaurant.

Needed a room last minute so I booked here. The lady at the front desk was super friendly. When I got to my room there was smell of smoke. The smoke detector was also hanging off the ceiling, there were candy wrappers next to the chair, and stains on the bed. I called the front desk and the woman upgraded me to a bigger room. I got to the room and the couch had stains all over it, the chair was messed up, and there was sticky stuff all on the wall in one area. The rooms are also very dim. The only reason I give two stars is because the lady at the front desk is very friendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We came here after seeing the bar on spikes Bar Rescue. The resurrection was terrible. I felt like I was drinking blue kool-aide with an overwhelming taste of sugar and coconut.  It made me sick to my stomach. I went to use their restroom and it was dirty. Water all over the counter. A lingering smell of urine and puke. I came back out and asked for a margarita. She poured just straight tequila into my glass and served it to me. I politely returned it and asked yet again for a margarita. It was not that great of a time.

Wow.  I was pretty disappointed with my experience.  We called ahead because it was a long day and needed to get some food for my kids quick.  When we arrived we checked in and then were forgotten.   We had to remind them we were waiting.  They promptly seated us because it was slow.  Then we waited for our waiter. Then we had wait more..... our drinks...food...refills....dessert... It was a bit absurd.   Although everybody was very pleasant it was just a lot with two small kids.       The food was good but how could it not.  All carbs and fat.   The espresso martini was awesome and i recommend that.

Been coming to Phils for many years and typically have pretty good experiences. But just finished a meal and still at the table after one of the worst dining experiences I have ever experienced. Clue to management, don't put adults and older teenagers in a room where you obviously seat families with very young children. Just had to listen to screaming children for an hour while we tried to eat our dinner. Wait staff did nothing and worse the parents did nothing to control their children. My 14 year old daughter was even appalled at their behavior. Management needs to be more considerate when seating. Tonight was a waste of 90 dollars

We went to have dinner here last night for the first time. We were told to pick a table that was available. Our server was switched 3 times before placing any kind of order.  We then ordered a Caesar salad and 16inch New York style cheese pizza. The salad came out with VERY brown pieces of lettuce. You could see them as soon as the plate was set down in front of us! Gross. We then waited almost a hour for our pizza. Which was a 5 out of 10 stars. Pizza was just ok. Service was mediocre. Would like to try their deep dish but not sure it's worth it.

Been shopping at Neptune publix for 30 years very Happy with service and products.  Now convenient the Britton Plaza Publix.  This store does not seem to have the same standards at all!  Have found numerous expired foods like Hummus and little smokie wieners several others too.  The deli department that makes the salads does a very poor job.  Salads are frequently under stocked.  There is little care with there prep i.e. old lettuce that is wilted and brown. Today I had 7 layer salad that had big gross fatty pieces of meat.  Please try to improve this department and the overall management of this store or back to Neptune I'll go

Nothing could top this place!  I was very skeptical because I knew their prices were super low, so I went in expecting a barely tolerable experience. However, I am pleased to report that the sushi was very, very good in quality, quantity and presentation. They did not seem to be skimping on anything. Normally back home when I go out for sushi alone for lunch, it costs between $30-$40. At Osaki, I made it out of there, dinner, stuffed full of delicious sushi plus dessert, with a doggie bag....for 19 bucks. No joke.

My friend and I went here hoping for a good time and found a trashy bar with nothing great about it.

First the bar is huge which is great but at least shave enough bartenders to cover how busy you're going to be. We waiting a very long time for a drink which was way to strong.

We had high hopes for this place and it didn't live up to it. We were traveling from out of town and wanted a great girls night but this turned into a two drink and go home type of night. The clientele there are just as trashy as the bar.

Bleh. Save your time and money and go down the street to El Rodeo. 

This place sucks. One determining factor of a Mexican restaurant is their chips & salsa- and this place's salsa tastes like straight Tostito's! I honestly wish I was kidding. 

Next, the service is meh. We waited forever to be greeted, order and pay. Seriously waited so long to pay we contemplated leaving. We didn't. But it was that bad. 

The food is bland and generic. 
The place is dirty with sticky floors and unkempt tables. 

I'm honestly surprised this place is still open.

We are regulars at Fletchers. We love their steaks and grilled zucchini. We also enjoy their burgers. I have to admit I am more prone to post a negative review of restaurants. I have done so with Shenanagans and jeffersons. We love Fletchers so much that we chose them for our wedding Jan 1st 2019. They grilled steaks to perfection. Management and staff were incredible. We brought in our own entertainment. If you have never been to Fletchers you owe it to yourself to check them out. They do a booming business and may not need this review. They have never disappointed us. ENJOY !

I would rate this place with 2 stars, but the guacamole saved the day. It was pricey, but delicious (I asked with no cheese). The sauces and toppings are a good variety. I don't recommend ordering the chips, the sauce is good, but not worth the cost. I ordered the steak burrito, it was ok, lots of meat, potatoes and cheese, and some avocado. I like the place, hated the Christmas music. The taste of the epazote on the beans and rice is not for everyone, but some of my friends loved it. Another friend ordered the tostadas, she loved them.

I just checked in and they had me wait over 10 minutes to have my temperature checked then the sales associate checked her watch and asked me what time was my appointment.  No I am NOT late.  She then asked me what kind of insurance did I have the same question she asked on Monday when she called speaking rude.  I have good insurance through my job and my insurance had not changed.  I have been coming here since 2014 and the other Female that use to run the front was a sweetheart.  Too bad I'll be switching locations due to poor customer service.  There is no reason why you speak to customers in a harsh manner at an eye appointment.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
The food is reliable and good for the area. The lack of adult management and/or supervision is the problem. The young women at the counter are not pleasant to deal with . No one is wearing a mask . I witnessed them dropping pizza boxes on the floor multiple times and putting them in the *to be used pile. When I walked in I paid and was told it would be a few minutes. 15 minutes passed and she had apparently forgotten who I was and asked me what I was  waiting for even though I was the only person in the shop.  
Two days later similar experience.

worst dunkin donuts ever!!! the woman manager working here is rude, ignorant and blames customers for inefficiencies of this store. i placed my order and was told to wait for my order total by an employee while i was in the drive through. than the manager yells at me for holding the line up. how does that make any sense, thats your employees fault for telling me to wait in line for it. than she proceeds to yell at me and say the order total doesn't matter. to make matters worse, the sandwich i ordered was mashed together and looked like garbage. this store needs new management and i will make sure others avoid this location.

I was just there minutes ago. I went to both doors, both locked. Would have been helpful if there was a sign that said drive through only. I drove through and  emptied about a half inch of water from my water bottle. The employee told me not to do that because someone would have to clean it up. I told him it was water. I would never empty anything else. He told me again not to do that. It was already done by the way. I told him again it was only water and there would be no clean up... again, told me not to do that. He was rude  and my food was cold. Won't be back.

Bottom line up front: If you need a car in the southern Indianapolis area, call this Enterprise and ask for Carter!

I am in town for two weeks for Army training and on my way down my check engine light came on. Long story short, I needed a rental car to cover me a night and day until my car could get repaired. I ended up here off of a recommendation and had really great service and was set up with a pretty sweet car! They're very professional, and they make the rental process quick, efficient and painless! I hope I don't have car problems again, but if I do and I'm nearby, I'll be coming back here!

FOOD 5, SERVICE 1

The house was only 70% full last night, so that wasn't the problem.  The waiter was surly and had no interest in explaining what came on the specials or the taste profiles of the many beer choices.  He was combative and insulting when asked simple questions about the menu.  Pity, because the food was top notch.  I normally give servers all the benefits of the doubt (bad day, new, too many tables, etc.)  But this guy was an eye-rolling, combative and ill-informed exception.  For the record, this is only my third Yelp review in ten years.

Where's my food and where's the manager? Ordered soup and cold onion dip as apps. Burger and fish sandwich came out first, asked where my apps were and they said they forgot but would be on their way out. They brought the food back into the kitchen but told them I didn't want it sitting under heat lamps, but they ensured me they wouldn't be. Food came out 20 minutes after we finished our apps, asked for the manager and he didn't even have courtesy to come by and check on us or acknowledge my request to come over. Food was mediocre at best. Husband was charged 19$ for plain cheeseburger. Won't be back

Such a disappointment!  We reserved there food truck for my son's high school graduation party. We had it reserved from 2-5 and the truck didn't show until 4:30. I had to contact them asking where the truck was and it took me calling both stores and the cell phone that was provided to me. This guy had one excuse after another and then he have me a minimal discount because he was worried about losing money on the deal. We had been going to Beto's for years. It's unfortunate that we will never go back. I wish they knew a thing or two about customer service.

I am always seeing & hearing recommendations for this particular restaurant. Since the Chinese restaurant around the corner from me has gone downhill (service & food), my family decided to go a little out the way to Kum Fong. To me the food was ok & too expensive. We ordered General Tso's chicken & shrimp egg foo young. It cost like $7 more than our normal spot. The food was not better though. The Egg foo young was packaged in the gravy. I didn't like that. I'm used to the gravy being separate. Their packaging caused soggy egg foo young the next day. I didn't care for how they prepare General Tso's either. Just me maybe.

This is place is a nice addition to the Downingtown restaurant scene.  Its a bit off the beaten path but we had no trouble finding it. The service was great.  Our waiter was very friendly and attentive and the food came out quick and hot.

This place has some of the best Lasagna I've ever eaten.  The sauce was excellent and the layers were perfectly balanced.  I make good stuff but this puts mine to shame.  The chicken soup was also good - tasted home made.

Contrary to some of the other reviewers, we did not experience any disagreements between the staff.  Everyone seemed happy to be there and we had a very nice time.  Definitely going back!

Visited TN all the way from Texas on 12/4. Service was terrible for everyone around me and I felt bad for them and the staff. I would have complimented their meals for the family sitting next to me, and I was tempted to pay for their meal because they were so miserable. The manager, I assume he was the manager, came and apologized for the wait AFTER the family that had a long wait left. He should have gone and addressed them personally. The sushi however was as fantastic as ever. It is even better than the sushi in Hawaii! Had to knock the score down to 3, hopeful the management will take to heart this feedback.

The staff is very rude here.  I found a pair of frames for $130 and when she priced them out with my prescription she said I would have to pay $265 fur the basic no add on lenses and that was with my insurance coverage that covers $150 plus and extra 20% off the difference.  They are always rude here.  I ended up going to lenscrafters and getting a pair of Michael Kors glasses for $65.  The doctor here was fantastic and so was his assistant but the sales people are horrible.  I suggest getting your prescription from Dr. Abbate but going shaw where for your glasses.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: My husband and i just left Coyote Ugly. We walked into the the gift shop area and i saw a sweatshirt that i planned on buying on our way out. Then went into the bar and it wasn't packed but had a fair amount of people there. We went to the bar and waited over 15 minutes. The bartender looked our way a few times but neglected to come over to take our order. We even made contact with the one bartender and had money in hand and she still walked away from us. We left and I refused to even buy their merchandise. Very disappointed. Rather spend My money else where

Worst car rental company ever. And the fat man that works at the front desk is rude as hell. When I went to pick up the car at 6 on the dot it was already blacked out & I had to re adjust my entire trip and come back in the morning to get the car! They gave me a free car upgrade to try to smooth things over but when I returned car a few hours late and they were closed they lagged on my final close out and the fat boy was rude as hell and hung up on me before I finished talking. Take your money elsewhere. These people SUCK!!

good food (average japanese) but TERRIBLE SERVICE!!!!!!!!!! as a table full of servers, we were in awe at the manager and our waitress. astonishing disrespectful to our faces and actually said "i have other people to wait on" when we were asking questions about what to get. i understand being understaffed but as a server myself i would NEVER be this way to anyone. the food is not worth the stress of wanting to get up and not give anyone your money because of how awful they were to our faces, and i've seen a lot. DONT COME HERE!!!!!!

My leopard gecko has been sick and I was worried I was not going to being able to find a good reptile vet but I was surprised. The staff here was very nice. I saw Dr. King and he was very knowledgable and good with my geckos. I will definitely be coming back if any of my other reptiles get sick. The visit was very affordable for a poor college grad like me. Only $30 for the visit and free medicine! Only problem was hard to find parking. I am very happy with my experience here and would recommend them for anyone with exotic pets.

If I could leave a zero star I would. I was told I needed new brake pads and rotors in the front + back and that it would cost over $700. The manager, William, went into a lot of detail about how damaged my rotors were. Something told me he was lying. Took my car to Budget Brakes down the road, and they showed me what my brake pads and rotors looked like and they were perfectly fine. They weren't anywhere near needing replacement. The guy at BB couldn't believe I was told they needed to be replaced. The manager at Midas completely lied to me.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Hibachi was really great! Well seasoned, fresh veggies, properly cooked meats. And not everything on the plate tested the same! Salad dressing is the ginger kind that's orange-pink- my fave! Service was excellent. Our server was prompt and they cooked our foods with special request of low sodium for one person on a restricted diet in our group. We were celebrating a birthday and they sang and used the gong, which was fun! Oh and I almost forgot (!!!) - the sushi was fabulous! We had the tuna amazing role and the salmon sashimi roll. The salmon roll might be my new favorite of all the area sushi places!

If I could give less than a star this place takes the cake. The "white" towels needed a gallon of bleach to be any color other than disgusting black ash. Shower head and handles halfway out of the wall. Mold everywhere. Sheets gross. As for the room entirely I'd feel safer sleeping in an alley in Chicago or on a booth seat in the back room of a strip club. And for dessert I will smell like cigarettes until the year 3000. For $62 I'd rather sleep in my truck and buy a bottle of NyQuil. Pretty sure if you left them an upper decker they would take it as a compliment.

This would be your place to spend $20 an "hour" if you know what I mean.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Took my family for the first time tonight.  Arrived at 8:35p and spent about $38. While ice cream is delicious the staff is not accomodating.  All chairs were up and when asked if we could put some down was apprehensive but agreed, informing us they were cleaning up.   While my kids were eating we were approached and told we had two minutes to finish up.  Note to owners- you should train your staff properly and telling customers they have to leave as your young staff wants to go home is unprofessional and will lose you business.  Staying open a few extra minutes would be nice.

Love my stay here!  Tired from a LONG holiday travel weekend - arrived and was greeted by a welcoming, friendly staff & comfortable, inviting atmosphere.

Room was very comfortable & restful.  Happy hour with 3 free drinks (beer, wine, or cocktails) served by pleasant staff was sooo nice!   This included dinner as well (included in cost of room), so it was wonderful to get everything (room, food, drinks) upon arrival.  

Coffee was fabulous!  Beds comfortable; bathroom roomy.  Shower very pleasant - I would HAPPILY stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This place was just okay. I loved the roasted sweet potato,  but the burger was not appetizing to my dining partner. The fries were also good (big potato planks).  I ordered the roasted broccoli and received a beautiful dish of broccoli that seemed to have cayenne pepper generously sprinkled on it. I found it inedible.  The waitress was happy to exchange it for a small cup of what seemed to be steamed broccoli which was okay, but way overpriced for what I got.

The service was your basic airport service basically.  Next time I'll go down to Emeril's.

My aunt told me to come here telling me it's soooo good. I was little disappointed as I found the ice cream mediocre. The flavors are exotic. You'll find goat cheese and sour cherry, a play on rocky road with almonds, dairy free dark chocolate, whiskey and pecan. For my two half scoops of mint and chocolate it was almost 6 dollars. The ice cream tasted powdery and I just didn't feel like the taste and quality matched the advertising of it being amazing. They make their cones in store and they looked yummy but I went with a cup. I liked that the cups seem to be made out of a recyclable material.

We just had the most horrible experience at this location. Waited five minutes just to place our order with no cars ahead of us. Pulled up to the first window to be asked what we ordered. Twelve minutes later, we're asked at the second window to pull up and wait for our food. Five minutes later someone brings out our bag but without the drinks. My husband asked him for our two cokes. He went back in and never came back. So we didn't get our drinks that we paid for and our food was cold. We will not be going back to this drive through any time soon.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: They charged me $10 MORE than my bill. Good thing I checked my receipt tags before I walked out. When I voiced the mistake assuming a mistake of course, the reaction was like when you catch a kid doing what they aren't supposed to... made me feel weird. The attendant didn't really explain and quickly just opened the drawer and handed me a $10 bill and said nothing. I said "I'm glad I caught that" and she avoided eye contact. 2 Stars because they actually do good dry cleaning, but c'monz. I'll be checking receipts Every time now.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Got my pedicure and gel manicure there a couple of weeks ago. The gel manicure did not last more than 4 days and the pedicure did not either. I went in yesterday to talk to manager and show her pictures and she said she was sorry. I said the only thing I wanted was for them to take the old gel polish off my nails and that would have satisfied me. She said that would be 10.00 charge. I was very disappointed that they would treat a customer that way. I will NEVER go back and will tell other people of my experience. Poor customer service!!!!  Janice B

The garlic cheese bread was phenomenal. Unfortunately that did not make up for the rest of the meal. The Soprano pizza had numerous pieces of pancetta that were just large chunks of gristle and fat and were inedible. The Stromboli was cool in the middle and the cheese was not melted. My husband found a rubber strand from a pastry brush in his pizza. The noise level was terribly loud; I was unable to hear conversation on the other side of the table. 

This was so disappointing, especially since we have had great pizza from here before!

I have had and paid off loans and banked with VW for nearly five years. Recently they would not approve a loan for me despite my excellent payment history and good credit. 

There have been hidden fees when I thought I was paying off my credit card balance and service has been less than friendly. 

When applying for a Home equity line of credit, the woman told me I didn't qualify and when I asked how much I was off being able to qualify, she tells me 2 points. I took it upon myself to re-finance my vehicle with TFCU so that I would qualify to get the HELOC. It's like they just don't even care whether they get your business or not. Sad.

Tried to get my haircut there today - I didnt have an appointment, but you can normally see the owner sitting in the window looking real bored so I didnt think it was going to be an issue.  I was walking up, and noticed he was finishing up with someone - again, not thinking it was an issue, I go to walk in and he cracks the door open, and says "what?" - a little taken back I asked if he had any availability this afternoon - without evening thinking, he said no and slammed the door. (ok not really a slam but certainly aggressive!) 


Needless to say, I will not be going back and I hope the owner figures out why he's so miserable.

I usually don't leave reviews for fast food places. But I could not let this experience go to waste. My co-worker always orders food from here so I thought I would give it a try. 

The young gentleman taking my order on the phone was patient, and very polite. I ordered an eggplant parm sandwich, fries well-done and fried mushrooms. This order was DELIVERED. My soda was cold, my fries were well-done and (the most important part) my sandwich wasn't soggy!!! There is absolutely nothing worse than ordering a cheesesteak or sandwich and having it arrive with soggy bread. 
 
The food was amazing. 10 out of 10. Would recommend!!

Worts service ever we come from Texas and we're looking for a place to check up the car before we go back and the employees are super sure I don't think that this place deserves even a single star because their service suck don't even waste your time to bring you car because they even make up prices they wanted to charge us $700 for a small piece that in autozone it's $117 I took my car to a mechanic and they only charged me $247 better than the price they were charging me so don't come here because they rip you off and steal your money
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I've been here multiple times before and it's always been a pleasant experience - clean shop, friendly staff. This was my first time seeing Rahnay though, and boy let me tell you - it won't be my last. Don't let Rahnay's "stylist" background fool you gentlemen, she can fade with the best of them. My hair can be difficult to fade but she did an awesome job! You can tell she prides herself in the quality of her craft and aims to please. The icing on the cake is she is also super nice, professional and offers great conversation. Rahnay, thank you for the killer cut - you've happily earned a long-term client.

Living in California we were spoiled with many great sushi restaurants. We've been looking for a good sushi restaurant here in NW Tucson. We had a very good experience at Sushi on Oracle this evening. Service was very good. Our miso soup was good, though it could have been hotter. The veggie tempura was crisp and light. The rolls we tried were well made and tasted wonderful. A couple of the pieces were cut large and a were a little more difficult to handle, but we managed to put them away as well! Recommend!

Hope corporate reads this. Coffee Bean needs to upgrade their look and vibe. Just spent a few hours here and I don't believe they've changed the interior since it opened. The loud hum of machines and constant beeps reminded me of McDonalds. Times have changed and Starbucks has realized this and is in the process of making their locations more comfortable and modern. Coffee Bean still has the box look going and is not a comfortable place to be. The lights are also bright. While the coffee is still great I hope they change with the times and modernize.

I would definitely stay here again! Everything was GREAT! The bed was so comfortable, the room was extremely cozy-- I loved that they had an iphone dock in the room! The pool and spa were amazing, and I enjoyed ordering drinks by the pool while relaxing. The restaurant in the hotel was great, and my absolute favorite thing about it was the short walking distance to the mall and all the shops and restaurants in the area! It was great! The staff is extremely friendly. You could vacation at this hotel and be totally satisfied. If I ever end up in Tampa again, I'll definitely be staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Went with my sister for a quick stop to grab some mochi. There were only a limited amount of flavors though - I think 3. The ones we had were delicious though: chocolate strawberry and mango. 

I really hate spending money on such a little piece of mochi - I feel the same way about macaroons - but theirs is incredibly good and if you like mochi you should get it here. 

The atmosphere was a little gloomy but still quant and intimate if that's possible. 

There is an orange couch. And a variety of chairs with different colors and shapes.

I used to love going here!!!! Breakfast is one of my favorite meals and the fact that you could get it until 2 was a huge seller with us but my main problem is, why on earth did the owners let Lynn and Penny go????? They were the reason we came here week after week. Thank god we tracked them down at The Sports Shack right up the road!!! But like I said, we went there because of Penny and Lynn. Those girls are 2 of the most amazing servers we have ever been lucky to come across. They were, in my opinion, the real selling point of this place. It's a shame the owners didn't realize what they had with those two...

My studio was decent. This hotel does not have any King sized beds. The shower seemed a little old. The phone in my room didn't work. The parking area seemed a little sketchy only because it was in a different lot diagonally across the street right in front of this run down building. The breakfast was mediocre at best. It was edible, but the eggs looked like they were powdered and the sausages looked pre-frozen. I will say the front desk person Elijah was awesome. He was very respectful and super friendly. He gets a 5 star in my book!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've tried many different sushi places in Franklin and Knoxville and this place is hands down one of my favorites!  My brother first introduced it to me when I came back from college over break. So far, I've tried their Mango Shrimp Roll, Spicy King Roll, and Sashimi Appetizer. The Sashimi typically speaks volumes to the quality of the fish and is usually the indicator of taste and overall experience. They start with great quality of fish (sashimi), follow through with fantastic rolls, and finish with a satisfied customer.

My fiance and I used to love this place! It was super close to the house in Somerset and the food was great, service was always fair at best. As of the last 6 months it went from fair to absolutely sh*t. Ask to be seated at the bar. Response 45 to hour wait. 3 people sitting at 12 spots they left it a mess on purpose to not seat. The kicker not one open table. They make snyde remarks and constantly act inconvieniced. Worst service in a restaurant in reno. Don't go here an support these people!!! Go to 2 the joint and get the best service ever and not get treated like a second rate customer.

Situated perfectly in the Historic Downtown of Philly--which is exactly what you're paying for. Staff was pleasant. Room was okay! 

Cons: One of the lamps didn't work, alarm was unknowingly and unexpectedly set for 6 am (on our second morning but not the first and not by us), toilet paper was less than 1/2 full when we first checked in

Pros: bed was comfy, sheets were clean, bathroom was decent, bar available

Info to know: there's no complimentary breakfast, self parking is $35+ a night

I would personally stay somewhere else next time in Philly, but all in all, my stay was average!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The margarita was so strong that I started giggling. Polite staff, good atmosphere, fast service. Good location.... ya know how after a long day you are starving and have to find a bathroom? That is why I picked this restaurants had the pork tamales which were good but I would not have been upset if the sauce was a bit spicy. 

They do advertise as being authentic Me Ivan but the menu is pretty basic. Good food but not great. Nothing special that would make me say... hey when in town I need to eat at this restaurant.

Stayed at the Montecito Inn for the second time.  The first time, our room and bathroom were so small, it was not a pleasant experience.  This time, we booked a larger room and it was fantastic- spacious and comfortable.  The only minor downside was that room was on the first floor and on the corner so it was a little noisy.  But, the room was so nice, it made up for it.  The staff is friendly and efficient and the valets are great.  Morning coffee bar and pastries are also a nice touch.  We would definitely return.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stopped by in between baseball activities. Kiosk was easy enough to order from but when we wanted to pay cash for otber items later, I was standing at the register, cash in hand, and about 10 employees completely ignored me. After 10 mins of waiting, decided  the extra apple pie and chicken nuggets weren't worth it and left. Even the manager walked by several times with out even a "someone will be right with you " no acknowledgement at all! Ridiculous!! They definitely need better customer service skills at this place. Won't be back.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
3/5 Al pastor tacos: Was a little surprised that it looked more like a glob of meat as opposed to chunks and slices of al pastor. Not too dry, but a little less than what I generally prefer. The house-made tortillas were delicious, soft, but still held their own against how much meat they stuffed in it!  Salsa roja is very spicy. Due to COVID, their salsa bar was closed and I didn't know they had guacamole sauce which I know would definitely have elevated the experience. 

My friend said the barbacoa was her favorite so I'll be sure to try that next time.

Went here for a family brunch buffet. The price was great, the staff was friendly, and the food was ok. Unfortunately this place is a complete dump. I'm not a local so I don't know the history of it. The place reeks of cigarettes and everything is nicotine stained from the years of smoking in the bar. The decor definitely is from another era. My biggest complaint is the ceiling that was falling off by the waffle station on the buffet. Probably will never go back. On a good note apparently Mario Lopez from SBTB will be there as there were flyers all over announcing this event.

DO NOT SIGN UP HERE. Very unsatisfactory, they didn't have the equipment as advertised, the amenities i paid extra for monthly we're often out of order or unavailable and the staff isn't helpful. They also make the cancellation process a nightmare. I requested to cancel before Covid came about and someone dropped the ball and I was left with the charges every month until I noticed the annual fee come out of my account and they refused to refund me the charges amounts. I will continue to make sure people know about this bad experience through Facebook and Google and that more people leave reviews as well so more people are aware of this scheme.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I would first of all like to start off buy saying  this,the service was very nice....
   The main reason for going is the food and that was extremely  subpar with an not out of the ordinary,got less than I expected..I order a garlic bread with mozzarella cheese and it was the grossest this I ever tasted,the garlic butter just saturated the bread and dripped down your chin.
   I will say this apon further review if I had a chance to go or not go again I would choose not go
   This has been your local food critic,
               The hungry man

The best most accommodating hotel I have ever stayed at! In St. Louis for a wrestling tourney, had to leave around 7am. The staff actually started breakfast an hour early so the wrestlers could eat!  In my mind that shows excellent customer service which very few businesses would have done.  I highly recommend them for any sports teams which are traveling into the area and this hotel chain will always have my business! Rooms are big, nice, and very clean. Comfortable beds and actual good pillows not those cheap hotel pillows!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
RACISM AT ITS' FINEST. 

Incredibly RACIST establishment. Don't bother going if you're not white. They went out of their way to try and kick us off their "sand property" and even once we moved they went to the establishment next door and had them try to kick us out. Then they called the COPS (again) to try to have us removed from the beach completely. When they complained, cops had a good laugh at how ridiculous and blantantly racist this beach bar owner was. Don't recommend ever.

A video to sum up the experience:
https://www.facebook.com/OfficialHolyZeus/videos/10155411993413040/

First tried this place in NY at broadway bites. Granted, the prices were way higher than here and they were also out of slammin salmon so when I came to philly, it was a must that I tried hai street kitchen.
I ordered the slammin salmon and the matcha green tea.
It was a good meal. i thought that the slammin salmon had way too much sauce but it was still good. The best part of the meal was the matcha green tea. It was delicious! By the time I wanted to get another one, they closed :( 

There was only one person working when I went. This food court is kind of dead in general. The most popular place at the food court is chick fil a.

I vistied this location for the first time this past weekend. I am new to having a puppy especially the breed. I had her neutered and he was having difficulties I was recommended to the jefferson hospital. The receptionist was very nice. Dr Snider is amazing. She answered all of my questions. She provided medication and home remedies for the issues I was having. She also called a couple days later to check on my puppy. I was shocked and appreciated her questions and concerns. I  liked the fact that I could call at anytime and the she would return my call the same day or next business day.

Everything about this place is great but these soda machines bro, are from like 1992. Also the contractor that is in charge of the renovations is extremely rude and inconsiderate. Yeah the little bastards running around in black shirts that don't speak English, yeah those ones. They are so loud at god awful hours of the morning. You ask them to stop and they look at you funny because I don't think they speak English. It has gotten to the point where I'm about to get police involved and or I'm ending my lease early. I haven't decided yet.

I'm visiting the Nashville area and was in desperate need of a manicure. At the last minute, on a Friday, I called to see if they had any afternoon appointments. To my surprise they got me in. I had to wait a little bit past my appointment time,  but that was fine. It was well worth the wait. Tran gave me a full set of nails for less money than what I normally pay in my home town, and was better quality. Everyone was especially nice. When I'm back in town I will most definitely go back. I highly recommend their services.

We wouldn't have picked Hertz on our own anyhow, as they are way overpriced, but our insurance chose them. It turned out that the only rental location open was on the other side of town from us. And now that we are trying to return the car, there is no way for us to do it. They are closed on Sunday and they have no key drop off or any other way to get rid of the car we no longer need. So now we have to pay for an extra day, more miles and more gas for another trip across town because this rental agency doesn't have their stuff together.

Two thumbs down.

If I could give a 0 it would be -0. Employees cant speak English very well no customer service at all management is very rude and just pushes you to the side  and don't want to deal with you causes  it's in the middle of the night and the phone service sucks to cause you can't understand them. Please don't waste your money with them. I called a day before and the truck was ready then the next day the truck was not there and they force me to get an upgrade or I didn't have no car. Was quoted $369 and I paid $940.00

This is an amazing salon !! I came with my daughter who is 8 months pregnant . We both got pedicures .They were nice and caring and the massage is such a plus . They use hot stones on your legs and while your drying a nice neck massage and Also used the hot stone! This is so different than any other salon I have  been to . The attention to every little
Detail is amazing . The place is clean and I did not feel rushed .. I highly recommend .  I left a lot more relaxed than when I first got there !!! Thank you ladies :)

This place is a beautiful hotel. The bell hop and check-in workers are awesome... however the bartender is a freaking a hole who needs to learn how to work with people. The social skills of this individual are are so subpar it almost ruins the atmosphere of this beautiful hotel and bar. The way that he made me feel was so degrading I almost wanted to boycott staying at any Marriott hotel. Very disappointed in my stay here just based on this absolute horrible human being of a bartender.  FYI his name is Kyle.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Ah! Putting a bad review out there sucks, but so does having a terrible experience with a company. 

I used the online option to order delivery from this place and received my order confirmation immediately. About 20 minutes later, the restaurant itself cancelled my order. 

I called to find out why and they simply said they're super busy so they cancelled my order. That is SO unprofessional! Someone should have contacted me to see if we minded waiting instead of them throwing in the towel and deciding they didn't want to put in the work. 

Swamped or not, they absolutely should have honored the order that was already put in and confirmed!

I was pleased at check in after a long flight to be warmly greeted and upgraded. Crowne Plaza understands the intent of Spire status (Hotel Indigo pay attention).
The room was clean but could use a little attention. The sofa is worn out, the bathroom fan needs cleaning or replacement because it squeaks when it runs. The linens and pillows are high quality, the Air conditioner could double as a snow machine if it wanted to. I would have liked having a safe in the room, but nothing was stolen. All-in-all a good stay. I'd book here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

Forget this place.
