Speed and food were great.   This is a brand new McDonalds has only been open about 30 days.   Both times I have been in this McDonald's it's filthy floors are dirty and the burger line is gross. 
Tables are dirty and very small space.  The Manager Layla both times I've been in there is horrible to the employees who work around her she treats all of the employees horrible in front of customers and does nothing herself when it's busy... everyone else has to do it even if they are busy too.     Really good first impression on a brand new location.   First impressions are everything, I'd rather drive out of my way for better service.

text: If I could give this place no stars I would first of the  guy working behind desk was very rude.... Then got to my room and opened my door and it was very messy I thought someone was still in there so I kept yelling hello and got no answer so I ran to my friend who was couple rooms down in room 618 I believe it was and told her she came with me back to the room so I called front desk and told him what was going on and he gave me attitude and started asking me question like I did something I was omg really I just left your office how the hell am I gonna do that kind of mess in seconds so never again this place needs to be shut down
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: 2 stars for staff and a ok room with dated dresser and desk. The first impression is diminished by the lack of exterior care. The lobby is so dated that it looks like it was in its prime in 1996.The bed was ok and the location is right off the hwy with free parking and a short ride to all the happenings. The hotel seems to be a cash cow property where there isn't any pride. The staff were polite and hardworking. If I did not book this hotel through Hotwire at $100 bucks a night I would be pissed, good thing its only for 2 nights. Look elswhere if you expect a true Crowne Plaza or prefer at least a 3.5 star hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: One of my friends highly recommended Safari nails to me, I was excited to finally go into a place that I knew someone had a great experiences at. Raquel I think was the lady's name who did my nails. She was very friendly. Once another client came in her entire attention switched to her, I understand if u have more loyal regular customers. But because of the quality of my nails and the service that I received towards the end of my visit. They have lost a potentially regular customer. Sad because I really wanted to like them

This place has never disappointed me food wise however the service is something else. Came here with a friend one time and my sushi came to like $16 so I paid with a $20 and they never came back to my table with the change... I confronted them about it and they said "it was for tip". Never told them the rest was for the tip but whatever. They handed me my change back and they shorted me a dollar saying again it was for the tip??? I'm usually a nice person but the whole thing was really bizarre and ending up tipping badly because of this

Worst car rental experience ever. The shuttle driver was nice but the people at drop off were a nightmare.  Cursed me out and when i asked for manager. Tim appeared but he just listened as counter woman continued to curse scream and tell me that my contract was void because i was 20 minutes past my scheduled drop off time. She could charge me whatever she wanted and F*** you was her preferred language.  Today they told Expedia that the location was closed. I will be doing a chargeback and will never again rent from dollar.  It was a bizarre experience to say the least

I would have given it one star, but the guacamole was good.  My husband and I both ordered the enchiladas, beef for my husband and chicken for me.  My husband's beef filling was very tough, and my chicken filling consisted of a little bit of shredded chicken which was overpowered by the corn tortilla.  The rice was undercooked and very chewy, and the beans tasted like Old El Paso refried beans right out of the can.  While we were waiting for our check, a different waiter than ours was telling the next table about the specials.  Our waitress never mentioned any specials!  We will not be going back.

For the price & amount of food you get, this place is pretty solid for a local pizza joint. Their cheesesteaks were actually pretty solid & I loved how spicy the hot peppers actually were. The only thing that bothered me is how none of the employees seemed to know how to properly wear a mask? Especially in a food establishment... during the height of COVID? If you're prepping food, the least you can do is keep your customers safe by masking up. I don't know how they get away with violating the state mask mandate since it doesn't seem like I'm the first person to complain.

I highly recommend. I have been a customer of Apex Nails for around 15 years. They have recently expanded and it looks really nice. While they have always been a clean establishment, I felt very safe during a recent visit while in the pandemic. 

They are friendly, consistent, quick, no up-selling, and thorough.  It''s calming, quiet, comfortable chairs and relaxing. 

This is more of a "no frills" establishment, not fancy but clean and nice. Anytime I have to go to another salon, I always compare them to Apex Nails and I always come back. I get standard pedicures, standard manicures and gel manicures. They all just do such a wonderful job!

I met some conference attendees that mentioned visiting a bar to get a local experience so I decided to tag along. This is a hole in the wall dive bar for the locals. The bartender was borderline rude so I kept my distance. I received a couple of free drinks - apparently a local regular bought the bar a couple rounds. I was unexpectedly served a fried fish plate which consisted of a piece of fish and potato salad. The fish was right out of the fryer and was seasoned well. I later found out that the fish plate was a Monday night special that you received when you bought drinks.

I will never go back here. It's only taken a while for me to write a review. But I had a 515PM appointment arrived a couple of minutes early and was not see until close to 6PM without an apology or explanation. When I asked for assistance I was brushed to the side. And then told my contact prescription brand did not exist, event though I was holding my prescription with the brand in a contact case in front of the employee. He then said it wasn't true and tried to show me another brand. I was then yelled at and ended up leaving with out purchasing anything. Worst customer service ever.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Went for lunch today for my first time. The quality wasn't impressive, and the restaurant itself felt a bit humid and sticky. In fairness, it was raining outside but every surface in there felt sticky/greasy. I've eaten at countless all-you-can-eat sushi places, so I have seen my fair share of places like to for a fair comparison. The sushi wasn't GREAT and frankly the price was higher than I'd expect to pay for this experience. All in all, it was decent sushi but I'm not certain I'd go back there unless I had zero other options and was really hungry. I wish I could give it 2.5 stars. 3 stars is generous and 2 stars seems a bit harsh.

Let me first say that I'm not a fan of St. Louis style pizza. I'm not from St. Louis originally as I grew up in Pittsburgh where New York style pizza was the norm. So if you like St. Louis style pizza, my comments don't apply. I found the pizza mushy and too salty and the salad we ordered was loaded down with Provel cheese. So I found the food mediocre at best. The place is small with not exactly a lot of ambience. It's a pizza joint for people who want inexpensive St. Louis style pizza. I don't plan to go back.

Came into this bar on a Saturday night because they had a 3 for 1 deal and decent music. Complete tourist trap since "one" whiskey and ginger ale was $12. They said they give you 3 but in reality it was more like one part of whiskey still and 3 part ginger ale. It was so watered down. The bouncer asked me to leave my hand grenade on the table so I don't hang it out on the balcony and I did so that I can grab it on my way out. I came out and bouncer had threw it away. The bathroom there was a complete mess; the toilet overflowed and the hand dryer was broken. This bar was KRAZY but not in a good way

Pathetic is one word to describe them.

Owner is never there. Workers are not friendly.

They lost my $125 button down shirt and told me they would give me money if they could not get it back within 3 days. THEY GOT IT BACK 11 DAYS LATER AND NEVER GAVE ME MONEY FOR IT. The owner "promised" to call and let me know if my shirt was found. She never called me at all. She sucks, pathetic business woman. And when I went and picked it up, they never said sorry of offered me free dry cleaning on my next visit. 

DO NOT GO THERE PEOPLE
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: After the snow storm couple a weekends ago I thought I should clean my car to remove all the salt from it. I found this company online and decided to use their service. I paid $18 for "Full service" which includes interior and exterior cleaning. The car wash machine did most of the work and then 4-5 cleaners were working on my car pretty quick but it wasn't not good enough. Overall disappointed because the inside of the car still found dust and dirt on dashboard and on the carpets and water marks everywhere on the outside . Their service were poor and sloppy and definitely not worth $18! I was hoping for more but got much less!

I booked this hotel for my birthday.  Since it was a surprise trip, and never having been to Nashville, we wanted to stay close to activities. 
The staff was very pleasant,  but this high end hotel is like an expensive Aloft.
The room was cute, small, and no coffee available in the room.
The shower-tub combination was bare bones with no place to put anything.
Horrible loud dance music playing all the time.
No bottled water in room, and this hotel doesn't have any bathrooms near lobby.
I must say I expected more from the hype.  They cater to a very young crowd, so keep that in mind if booking.  I will stay at JW Marriott next time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Bacco is a pretty decent family style Italian restaurant.  I can't speak for the pizza because I haven't tried it yet, but the pasta selection is good.  I particularly enjoy the lobster stuffed ravioli.  The restaurant's seating is a little over crowded but it has a fairly romantic feel to it via candle lighting.  Our service has always been prompt and friendly so no complaints there.  The place can get pretty packed on weekends so I'd recommend making reservations.  Prices could be a little lower but they do give you huge portions so you often end up bringing some food home.

I've been going here since I started working, and paying therefore for eye insurance. I chose them out of convenience, but I'll keep going because of the service! They have an excellent selection of glasses and a very knowledgeable and friendly staff. I recently went in because a coating was wearing off on my new sunglasses and the immediately checked my file, let me know they were under warranty and sent them in immediately to be fixed. They are also very helpful with my insurance and letting me know what is covered and what isn't. I would definitely recommend to anyone in the area!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
El Pique (302) 655-0659.   Per owner, zip is 19804 .  Open til 10pm. 
My favorite, followed by Taqueria Los Primos.  . My rule of thumb for selecting great mexican food.  1. Minimal english; its where the locals go.  2. Taqueria in the name, also likely to be a please. Great selection of meats.   The stars are deserved. My first experiences wtth Yelp: Montreal Pizza shops run 5 stars, right along with fine dining establishments like Au Pied.  Its Taco'clock "The blissful time that depicts the moment of a great culinary escapade wrapped in a tortilla."

Ummm.. pasta was completely overcooked amd not very tasty at all (got mariniera, you need skill to ruin something this simple), but the most offensive part of my order was the so called turkey burger. A frozen patty between two pieces of bun and... literally NOTHING else. That was a complete joke, not a slice of tomatoe, piece of lettuce or even a tiny bit of mayo or ketchup. Just a naked aweful patty. Took one bite and spat it out. I will never order from this place again, i d rather starve. You should het your shit together, this is beyond insane.

Friendly staff! Very modern style. The bar does barrel aged cocktails. Didn't get a chance to try any but will on next visit. We parked in the mall lot for $22 for 24 hours. The mall connects to hotel. Everything you could want to do is in walking distance. We walked to slippery noodle and heard 2 great blues bands! Had take out sushi from place across the street. It was gross. The bed was very comfortable for husband who likes a firm mattress and myself who likes a soft fluffy one. That was some kind of magic!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Ok let me first start this off by saying I am a wanna be sushi lover!  It looks so good and I tried it and tried it and just yuk.  I found this place by accident t and thought... hmmm let's try this again.  I ordered nothing raw, shrimp tempura and this delicious crown something.  It had cream cheese, crab and lobster salad on top with crunchy things.  Holy!! It was all so so good.  I love sushi! I think I will ONLY get it from Osushi they were amazing. I did try the mango roll and it was just boring and not great but all the rest were delicious.  Highly recommend for first timers try the tempura and crown sushi also get extra spicy Mayo!!

Went to the restaurant spent over $800 for a friends birthday. Our server didn't take everyone's order, kept forgetting things. There was no communication when it came to splitting the check. Then the manager was super rude to a member of our party, then got security called on us and then asked to never return. Then when I asked for the general managers information. I was told I could call as speak to him. I thought the four seasons hotel was  a "high end" hotel. Thank for showing my grief could have a birthday there
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I am a connoisseur of Mexican cuisine and this is one place I would not revisit. The chips tasted like they came out a bag, the food was not even seasoned that well. The margaritas were lacking in alcohol (and the frozen machine was broken). The waitress was nice, but I was not pleased at all. This place solidified my theory- if the decor is not totally ethnic and there are white people working there, the food will not be that good. Nice place inside, but doesn't feel Mexican at all. And I won't even talk about how absolutely bloated I am a day later....

This is one of the worst hotels I've stayed at. They do not have employees working at night so any of your nighttime needs will go UNANSWERED. Tried requesting blankets and more than the 2 single pillows they provided and there was not anyone able to help us until 6am. The rooms are hardwood, cold, and very uninviting. DO NOT PURCHASE A ROOM HERE. You will feel under appreciated and overall not welcome. Not only is there no staff to help, it is a PAIN to get on the phone with the "off-site receptionist." I often travel and am not picky AT ALL about where I stay but this was truly a horrific experience. BEWARE BEWARE BEWARE
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Visited this afternoon. I'm not from the area, so I looked on YELP for some direction. Found this restaurant. It didn't look like much from the outside, not so great coming in the front door but the dining room looked nice and friendly. The menu was large with many tasty sounding food items. We went for one of the specials. It was an eggplant dish, rolled up and stuffed with ricotta and spinach. Pasta on the side preceded with salad and finished with desert. Complimentary red wine. All for $16.95, the food was great. I'll be back when I am in the area again. O don't let me forget the homemade garlic roll.

Nice place, but service very rude. I came to ask for coffee & bagel with cream cheese ,but the you lady behind the register said " no cream cheese you want just the bagel ".
For me it's fine if there is no cream cheese, but you don't have to be rude with Custmer. I have been in restaurant business for 14 years and I believe that Custmer like to feel welcome and they deserve a positive attitude ,so can have a good experience. Not a negative attitude that make you lose your appetite. Anyway, this isn't first time in this place. Not coming back for sure.

Unfortunately, not a very positive experience. The rooms themselves were nice enough, and the breakfast was decent. However, the shower floor had someone's footprints on it, which was pretty gross. We also had a bad experience with the shuttle driver, who told us he couldn't drive us anywhere unless we had a full shuttle (13 people). Why offer a free shuttle service if your guests can't use it without a big group? We also had the housekeeping people enter our room TWICE when we had the "do not disturb" sign on our door. Luckily no one was undressed, and they did apologize. However, we felt this was inappropriate and an invasion of privacy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Pasta in miso soup (instead of traditional tofu) was just strange!  

We were put at a hibachi table alone (everyone else was seated together at another table) and we had to wait a long time for our chef, who was mediocre in his presentation (probably from lack of an audience), and the rice and noodles were so-so.  The scallops and shrimp I had, however, were cooked perfectly and seasoned well.

The floors were "sticky" and I felt the place generally unclean.  

We won't be back, not when there are so many better places in the area.  Sorry Hiros you lost two customers anyway.

Not surprised there is only 2.5 stars for this location. Disappointed that they couldn't offer refills because of COVID (even though lots of places have somehow figured it out) and to add salt to the wound, the manager made us pay for a spill. I don't know about you, but where we come from, a child dropping their pop is an automatic free refill. Now I get we're from out of town, but come on. Shouldn't you treat us better since we are tourists? Disappointed Golden Arches, disappointed. 

Sincerely,

It's pop, not soda.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Our party of four went in on Memorial Day and it had to have been an off night. We were seated right away but though there were other empty tables  we were seated right in front of the door. 

Our service started out fine chips and salsa super quick and drinks were keep full but when it came to our entrees it seemed to take quite a while. The five servers seemed to be bored and were slow to check in on us. It took a good 10 to 15 minutes to get our check  once we were finished eating.

The food was good I would try them again. Our group got a wide variety of things from enchiladas to fajitas and there was no complaints.

In Nashville for the weekend and found this little spot - my sister and I both lived in Asia (Taiwan and Singapore) for years, and found this a very acceptable walk down memory lane! Xiao long bao (small steamed buns) were good,  and Taiwanese Salted Crispy Chicken took me back to the streets of Kaohsiung. Service was solicitous and friendly; they were busy, but got our food quickly and hot. Prices are average ($8.95 for steamed buns, $11/plate for entrees) but portion sizes are generous. Rice was the only disappointment, a surprise at a Chinese restaurant, but we had so much food we didn't miss it. Orange slices for dessert were a treat!

Room service could not have been worse. I made it very clear that I did not want cheese on my burger (and the receipt reflected that), but the burger still came with melted cheese on top, and without the wine I ordered. It was an easy and fixable mistake that has taken over an hour to correct (I still don't have the burger or the wine). 

I was on the second floor. Picking it up would have been faster. To make matters worse, its It's a shame that the hotel adds an 18% tip automatically without informing you beforehand or letting you know.

Such a great hotel and a prime location for those staying and going to Sesame place ! Rooms were very clean and spacious! The dining room that held breakfast always had space, and the noise was surprisingly tame for the clientele that they attract! The food was quite filling and always tasted fresh ! I highly recommend the omelettes if you get a chance! 
The shuttle service they provide to bring you to Sesame Place is a huge bonus as well! It's a quick 5 minute drive and you don't have to pay their parking fee! Would absolutely stay at this location again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The people who work here are great and helpful--this is more for the complex itself being "luxury" We had to re-sign and they overlapped two months rent and were going to raise the price of the new apartment we were moving into if we didn't move out of our current apartment by the 22nd---it's honestly so dumb and the place is not that great....the sinks are old, the washer and dryers are old, the finishes are gross----I've lived in many other luxury apartments in Nashville that are WAY better and nicer, I would suggest Riverhouse, Terra House, Skyhouse...

I've been mainly to the outdoor bar here. NO beer on tap at the outdoor bar; they need to fix that. "The cost was too high" I've been told. Anyhoo, there's a large TV above the bar. The bar staff is always friendly and usually prompt with drinks and menu service. Nice to watch a Phillies game outside and light up a cigar afterwards. Since the bar is technically outdoors (there's a large roof overhead), they are OK with patrons blazing up. If you have a problem with cigars smoke, stick with the indoor bar.

The Kobe beef burger is pretty good. Crab Cake sandwich is not bad. Not too pricey for bar food.

My husband takes my kids here a lot when I am not home from work.  They love the pizza which comes out hot.  They do have running jokes about what the waitress will mess up.  Typically they order french fries as their appetizer and seems like most of the time they don't get them.  Other than not great service the pizza and steaks are great.  I prefer more ambiance when I spend $15-$25 per entree so typically don't order entries.  Sometimes we will get a entree and split it for "to go".  The portions are large.  Lots of garlic and lots of cheese typically.

Love this place. Great service and amazing food. I'm from Maryland and in my area the chinese not rise to par. Great Wall Chinese gives me hope for my area that one day we will rise to the challenge and have actual food. The food here is greatly price, it's not greasy it's fresh it's delicious tasting and the portion sizes are also good. When I walk in the woman at the front always has a smile on her face and is grateful for my business. I just orderedI six dishes for the lunch special and it was only $38. If you ask me, this is a spectacular deal for the quality of the food.

My very first review on Yelp and I would like people to know how bad this place is. They cut my long hair to very short, and to achieve the so called 'curve' effect, they cut my front hair really short and back hair really long. I have to go to another saloon to fix it the next day! This is definitely not what I want!! And I brought it up to them towards the end of haircut, the barber said 'this is what it supposed to be. There is no way we can do what you want.'.... So what am I here for? Getting a bad hair cut and bad mood? 
Also remember: $31 and cash only!! Not worth any penny.

I came to this restaurant for lunch based on the reviews. I was very disappointed. The lunch service was extremely slow, and the restaurant was empty except for two other tables beside ours. Asking for our drinks, bringing them, asking for the order, and finally bringing the order was painfully slow, and when the food finally arrived my wife's medium rare steak salad has the stake completely rare, it wasn't even close to medium rare. After they brought the food we had to ask for a steak knife because nobody bothered to bring one as part of the steak order. All in all, not a good experience.

I have been taking my car to Don's (found him on Yelp btw) and I highly recommend his services. He is amazingly quick and he is extremely fairly priced. The best thing is that you can truly trust him. Today I brought my car in for inspection. I knew I needed work on my brakes. I dropped the car off at 9am. He did the inspection, replaced my rear brake pads and a headlight that was out and called me at 10:19 am to tell me the car was done. I'm so pleased with Don's and all my friends who have used him feel the same way

Service was great! The restaurant was reasonably occupied and the staff still attended to the customers diligently, and were incredibly polite. The actual food was however not as exceptional. We received a roll that wasn't cut properly, so it was difficult to eat. We ordered a fried roll that by description should have been flavorful, but was absurdly bland and nearly soggy. Presentation was lacking, even by 'All You Can Eat' standards. This was my second visit to Sakana, and will probably be my last after not seeing an improvement from last time to now.

We had ordered their square pizza once before and it was fantastic! Today, we ordered the same plus a chicken Caesar salad and were quite disappointed. The food didn't arrive until almost 2 hours after ordering. The pizza was cold and the crust tasted rubbery... Almost like Play-Doh. The cheese looked like it was barely cooked. On the plus side, they do give you a ton of chicken with the salad, which tasted great. Unfortunately, there wasn't enough dressing to cover the lettuce hidden underneath. The "croutons" were soggy and warm. Not sure if we'll be ordering here again any time soon...

I've been banking with Keypoint CU in Goleta for the past 8 years and have always had a great experience. Most recently, I had the pleasure of working with Ana on a car loan. In just 10 minutes at the counter, I told her what I needed and she was able to email me my pre-approval letter. We then finished the loan with a phone call and docusign for digital signatures over email which was most convenient for me. She was prompt, thorough and courteous. It couldn't have been easier. I had a great experience and look forward to using Keypoint again for a future loan. Thanks, Ana!

I went for an interior detailing but went through the automatic car wash first and like some of the other reviewers, one of my wiper blades was ripped off.  The detailing however was excellent.  I've had my car detailed before but no one has ever done such a thorough job. My 5 year old mini van almost looked new again.  So while I might avoid the automatic car wash, the detailing was great and I would definitely recommend! I killed some time while I was waiting with my daughter in the map store next door.  They have a great travel book section.

I must have gotten the wrong thing, because it seems everyone else loves it. I was looking for a decent falafel and decided to give Pita Pit a try. For $6.50 I was not too impressed. Barely any tzatziki sauce was put on the sandwich (in fact, I don't even think any was on there), the falafel was just a cold ball of mush that didn't even look like it was once fried. The large majority of the sandwich was just lettuce. Very sub-par. For the amount I paid, I expected something better. Should've went to Jimmy John's.

What the hack happened to Yanako? This sushi restaurant was my go-to for dine in and take out. Tonight I ordered 7 rolls only to find out that they shorted me one. I ordered and paid through the eat-24 app so I can't imagine how an entire roll was skipped. The host was respectful and had the staff complete my order, however, it took 20 minutes for the vegetable tempura roll. 

The real reason for my recent dissatisfaction is the lack of portions. It seems like with every month their rolls shrink. Here's what $54 of sushi at yanako looks like.

Otherwise the quality and atmosphere of Yanako is fantastic.

Maybe they were low staff. I know Starbucks can get crazy inside but I feel like people should try their best when they can. I wanted to try the new mocha cookie drink and I asked for no whipped cream. There was a new girl working there who put the whipped cream on, when I asked someone about it they made me feel like it was my problem so o proposed a solution of scooping it off. The lady who took my order took my cup and sloppily scrapped the whip cream of. It did not look appealing at this time but I took it and went on my way. The drink wasn't ruined but I felt the rudeness.

I'm not someone who rates a place harshly and I always tip 20% or more. Went here with my family. They weren't overly busy but service was slow. No condiments were available. They did not refill the chips and salsa. The dish I ordered was the pork carnitas. It came as several large pork medallions. Tortillas were by request. Not to be picky, but we went out to eat so I didn't have to prepare the meal. So I shredded the pork and moved on. Everything was only ok. Margarita was fine but nothing super special. It's been a while since I've had service that poor and food this sub-par. Will not be back.

I went here for a friend's birthday with a few other people. They all ordered sushi but I ordered the pork dumplings because i'm not a huge fan of sushi. The food was amazing- no problems there. The restaurant was clean and set up nicely. The service was good. Our server was attentive but she could've been friendlier and smiled more. The food came out at different times which was odd, so half of us were eating while the other half watched. Only two problems we had were those. If you like sushi this is a good place to go

One of the worst places I have ever been to. The bar is OVER crowded with people! There is no limit to how many people they let in. The music is SO LOUD that you can't even have a conversation with someone else. The DJ could be nice and turn down the music and I bet people would still have fun! Instead my ear drums hurt from the super loud music. The music that was played was ok to listen to but the music was too loud!! I didn't have any fun because the music was super loud! Be aware that the bounces are rude. Be aware that the bouncers can't keep their hands to themselves. Worst bar I have ever been to. Will never go back!!

This was our last  day in New Orleans  and had a taste for  a  great steak and we found  it here at Spirits on Bourbon  street.  This steak was so tender  and moist, it was served with a potato skin with cheese and becon bites. My husband had a beer and I  tried one of the specialty drinks the Resurrection! Chef Gerg was great if you are ever in New Orleans and want a great steak this is  the place! If you are  not in the mood the all the hustle and the crowd there's  a nice garden in the back of  the  bar priceless. Chef Greg  see you  soon

I got the 3/4 Lb delirious burger. Huge. You pick your own toppings. Only issue was bun could not handle the size & weight of the patty and toppings. Got a little messy. Salad was good. Fresh ingredients. Fries good, not amazing. 

Service was good, had no issues. Accommodated party of 10 with no problem. Gave refills when needed and checked on us plenty of times. 

Kids meals come in a little cardboard car. A nice touch for the kiddies. 

My brother did the 1 pound burger and got his picture on the wall of fame. 

I'd definitely return but I would probably opt for a smaller burger next time as I currently have the meat sweats.

First off I e checked in which authorized my credit card. When I get there to check in my room isn't ready so the guy says he will just change our room. Ok kool. Well then he runs my card again! So now I have a double amount hold on my card. Which is really frustrating. The desk people aren't the friendliest at all. One out of four we tlked to was nice. The room was decent. Had a strange smell at first and the bathroom ceiling at yellow spots all over it. The bed was comfortable tho. The pool was good. My niece really enjoyed it. Sucked had to pay 20.00 for parking tho. And the food there is outrageous.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Usually when you come here you expect the horrible service and miserable servers but the sushi is cheap and good so you deal with it. All I ask can you at least have one or two servers that actually understand English. My wife is pregnant and needed her cooked rolls on a different plate from my raw ones so after trying to explain this simple request six different ways of course  they all came out on the same plate. I should have known this was gonna be a ordeal they don't understand when you ask for a fork or club soda

This place reminds me of my favorite Mexican markets and restaurants in Houston. The market is great and the restaurant's food is absolutely delicious and AUTHENTIC. The ingredients are quality, the dishes are flavorful and delicious, and everything is exactly as I would expect from a the best local spots back home. I can attest to the quality of this market/restaurant as I am certain my Mexican family and friends would be ecstatic to try this place if they could. 

My girlfriend got the shrimp tacos (pictured) and they were insanely good. The sauce was flavorful and sweet and paired well with the fried shrimp.

Well it's a McDonald's what can you really say but the kids love it for breakfast and it was close to 6am so it was open. It's the least we can do after waking them up at 3am for a road trip. Cause according to the youngest one it was one delicious breakfast, not to my talking stomach it wasn't lol. Nah just kidding that only happens with Big Mac's now that I'm getting old lol. 

My sister got a sugared water, oops I mean a iced vanilla coffee yeah it was pretty bad a good thing we had our own espresso in the cooler to fix that. But at least the girls were happy and the food did come out quick. Crew at counter were nice and friendly.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I was thoroughly disappointed in this place. Maybe just our waiter but we ordered a pizza and a half salad to share, the salad came AFTER the pizza and although delicious, I would have preferred to have it first. Then the pizza came (Pineapple Express) but it was cold, like cold. It was lightly cooked but clearly it had been sitting for some time before the runner brought it to us. It's Sunday 4pm and it was not bust at all. Just lazy. Not a good experience. I'll try it one more time to see if it's better but I was left disappointed. I had high hopes. At least the crust is good.

1- instead of honoring the local tv commercial discount (s), the a.m. mgr. made excuses &  did not honor what was advertised.
2- lack of service - for only one mcmuffin, had to wait for ...more than 4 minutes. had to remind a front line employee about order, prior to receiving. sad!!!
" will never return to this location & must warn all on social networks to not waste time, fuel & $ (not 1 red cent)  here."
if, the owners really care, hopefully, they will wake up & know how much they lose & will continue to lose due to the power of social media.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place is terrible. It is highly advised to spend this money on a Hilton or Days Inn instead. This hotel is way too expensive for what your getting. The hotel is pretty broken down, and that is sometimes okay, but the problem is that it is really dirty and most things do not work. Outlets don't work, shower temp goes cold & hot, and so much more. We stayed here for $100 a night! The staff is terrible too. There is also a sign that you'll get charged $20 for missing towels. The pillows have Kmart tags. Pretty sure they don't cost $20! This hotel is taking advantage of people.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Hotel was nice but customer service could be better. There was a lady working at night that had a rude attitude. Her attitude changed towards the end and she was nice after. She was rude to other employees as well as customer. I belive in killing people with kindness and wonder if it was the reason she ended up beeing nice at the end. I almost canceled my room but did not have the energy to look for anotherone. My 3 friend and myself decided not to go to this hotel again. With 300 for a room you can find somewhere else that will treat you better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went here to have a night out with a few friends and the guy seating us had terrible customer service. He automatically looked at his watch and hesitated to get our menus. He then made sure to let us know they close in an hour and was very rude about it. Also google said they didn't close until 11pm when was an hour an a half from when we got there so they should probably change there google information. And working in customer service for many years you should never turn away a customer. Overall I'm very upset with this experience.

If I could give 0 stars I would. I come here sometimes and it's honestly not the best Mexican food out there and the staff isn't the friendliest but it's decent I guess. I ordered some Carne Asada Fries and I was extremely disappointed. I LITERALLY saw them putting my fries in the microwave and to top it off I'm pretty sure their "fries" are the same ones you buy from the frozen section at Walmart. Not to mention the fact that there was BARELY any toppings on the fries. It only took about freaking 40 minutes to make such a disappointment. Needless to say I will not be returning to this place.

I have been to this location many times most of the time I get the wrong food or have missing items one example I order the BBQ burger no pickles and I get a burger no pickles but I don't get a BBQ burger I talked to people on the app the tell me I will hear from local store and I hear nothing I have many options near by that give me everything I pay for and the correct items not what ever they feel like giving me it is hard to review what I ordered since I didn't get it and it has been over 2 weeks since I was told I would hear from them way to go awful experience here

I paid $10 for the supreme car wash. I was prompted by the machine for payment and it was confirmed. I waited for the green light to flash and it never did. I went into the bay and the wash never started.

No employee was on site to provide assistance. I went home called the number and kept ringing and no option to leave a message. That occurred on Wednesday and it's now Saturday and I've been calling and the phone rings off the hook. I'm currently out $10 and I have to go down to the car wash hoping somebody is there and just not answering the phone.

The menu sounds good as are the ingredients and the employees.  The food, wings and the meatiest pizza were totally unseasoned.  The chicken was tender.  The pizza; something is wrong with the pizza. Either the oven temperature, the dough or something.  The bottom of the pizza was charred which was good but the middle was raw dough.  They put it back in the oven and offered to remake it,  but it didnt help enough for me to give the doggy bag to the homeless outside.  Im sorry for this review as I wanted it to be a new favorite place.  Im sure they are only following a bad recipe. I hope it changes to when it was getting better reviews.

Love the food. It's always delicious. However, I'm not sure who the gentleman they have answering and taking orders is, but he is not very efficient. It took us 15 minutes to place an order for 2 cheese steaks (1 w/fo), Lg. Plain pizza, fries and a sprite. It is very frustrating. And while I was and am patient with him, it takes just as long to order as it does to get the food. I just feel like they should have someone more efficient answering to place orders. I know they've lost orders bc of this man, I've seen it.

Solid 4 star hotel that would have been 4.5 stars if I could have posted that way.  We went for a 2 night work event and night 1 we hung out in their Bocce Court and game area. HUGE!   Bar, inside and outside Bocce courts as well Ping Pong, Skeeball, Foosball, etc.   

Food was good and they had a great restaurant out next to the Truckee River.  

Also there is a very cool walking path along the Truckee River that goes for miles.  

Cool bars and restaurants in the immediate area as well.  Fun place to spend time with a group of friends.  

Room rates reasonable as well.  Clean and close to Reno Airport.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This restaurant does a great job of social distancing. Went there last night  for dinner with my husband after a long pause from dining out. Meal was fantastic and well paced. Started with the bread with liver mousse and red snapper ceviche followed with main meal of beef tenderloin with beef cheeks.  The meat was perfectly seasoned and cooked. It came with a side of creamed spinach with an egg on top. I wanted to take a few sides of the spinach home!  A wonderful dining experience for our first time out since COVID hit.

Honestly would have would have given more stars except I don't understand the food situation. I asked when they would have a full menu up an running was basically told the Charcuterie/cheese/pickled items were the only thing they were doing. This blows my mind because, while there are other places to eat on the Ave, there are not enough. Certainly these guys know that food is a draw to get people to drink more right? Doesn't make business sense to not utilize the full kitchen in the basement. I just don't don't get it.

Amazing tacos at a great price! I'll admit I was a little bit nervous about trying out this place seeing it from the outside. But we pulled out car into the parking lot, and we were not alone. So many other people were already there and talking about how amazing the food was. 

We purchased steak, carnitas, and pastor tacos. All were great but the pastor was incredible! Now these are authentic street tacos so they are a little bit smaller. I'd recommend buying one or two more than you normally might at your favorite TexMex shop. After all these are only $1.50 a pop!

Where do I even begin? The entire staff is probably the friendliest I've ever seen! Everyone is focused on making sure their clientele stays happy and comfortable throughout their visit.  Alaina did such an amazing job with my hair! She's very passionate about what she does, and she makes sure to take great care of you and what you want.  She explained everything she was doing, which for someone who isn't the biggest fan of going to hair salons, this was probably the biggest standout to me.  I got a fresh, beautifully executed hair cut, full highlights, and a really pleasant hair mask.  Please go see this awesome business and ask for Alaina!

Found this place for lunch passing through Santa Barbara. It's seems like it's in a bit of a sketchy area but we felt completely comfortable. 

PROS: 
- huge portions
- good flavors
- friendly atmosphere
- good variety 
- vegetarian options

CONS:
- generous portions of cheese but my cheese enchiladas were cold and cheese hadn't melted yet. 
- Chile relleno didn't have enough cheese so it wasn't really "relleno" (stuffed)
- bathrooms was sketchy 

I gave it a 4 stars because I would eat there again but be aware of their shortcomings.

I like some of the food.  The general Tso chicken is always my go to for take out Chinese and it's not good here.  The issue isn't the seasoning - that is actually good.  For some reason, most of the portion is breading and not chicken - I have had entire large pieces with no chicken in them.  It'd be one thing if a few pieces were that way - but I've ordered this three times now over the past few months and each time most of my tso chicken is actually missing the chicken.  That is disappointing to see them trying to cut that corner...

The market was small, but carried a good Turkish assortment. However, I made the mistake of purchasing something that did not have a price tag. They rung it up and told me it rung up incorrectly and was twice the price. I said ok but have since seen the same product in other shops for less than the original price it scanned. I'm not Turkish, so I guess they thought it was ok to take advantage of me. Everything seemed slightly higher priced than other Turkish markets I have been in, except my kunefe which was jacked up.

The manager literally threaten to call the cops on us and used the "F" words multiple times. Here is what happened: we had a table for 2 and asked them to switch us to a table for 3 / add a chair. The server did not want to help us at all, so we decided to leave. Then the manager came over and said "sit the fuck down and eat." He was literally yelling. We were pissed and told him we were leaving because of his attitude. He then threatened to call the cops. I have never seen a manager that rude to a customer. Do not come to this restaurant. They treat u like shit

Pre-Covid Review: 

We went on a busy Friday night, no reservations so we were told wait time was 1 hr. Well...we actually waited about 2 hrs and if it wasn't for my friend, I would have gone elsewhere. When they finally took us in, they gave us the worst table in the whole place. I understand no reservation but it was very uncomfortable and felt like they were not treating us right for whatever reason.
Tacos were great, beware of the falafel taco its pretty spicy and no warning.
Tequila drinks were good too! Overall it was an ok experience, just not dying to come back but maybe I will give it another chance any other day.

I have been here a few times for breakfast and it was ok. Went on Friday and ordered breakfast chipped beef on toast and potatoes. So disappointed my potatoes were burnt so badly as I did not eat them when I mentioned it to the server she shrugged no response. When paying the bill we mentioned it and he stated maybe it would be better next time. Neither mentioned it to the cook or anyone else. When you serve something to a customer if it looks that burnt don't serve it. The place always looks closed and servers don't care about you. Not returning and I live in walking distance. They don't respond to comments and don't improve.

Came in to have some breakfast with my kids I wasn't aware that they couldn't break 100 dollar bill if the purchase wasn't over 25 dollars. The girl at the front counter  was very rude when I handed her the money. She wasn't professional in explaining to me as to why she couldn't take my money. since when have they had that policy? I could only imagine ordering in the drive through having to wait and when you are ready to pay them not being able to take your money because the order isn't over 25 dollars. It's irritating
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Food was good and plentiful. Wife and I ate the lunch meal for both lunch and dinner. Ordered chicken and broccoli, garlic chicken and broccoli, wonton soup and crab Rangoon. All was good. The only reason for 3 stars was during this Covid time, only one employee was wearing a mask. The lady at the counter. All the cooks and lady packing food had one hanging from her ear but not wearing. Wife contemplated refusing it , but did end up taking it . We hoped it be good cooked fresh and in a hot wok would kill any virus but still concerning. Food handlers, I know it's hot but please wear the masks!

I went to Sugo's for the first time today and so glad I did.  We were greeted immediately by the staff.  I was so impressed with the server.  She was friendly and answered a couple questions I had about the menu.  And the menu, while short in size, packed a big punch.  It was full of little surprises, like having a bottle of cold water to share.  I ordered the bolonegne.  The flavor was plentiful and the order was big in quantity.  Only thing I'd suggest is that they offered garlic butter for the bread.  I will definitely be back for more.

There are much better gyms out there. This one is just OK. The temperature is a bit on the warm side. The TV station numbers are not in sync with the equipment. Also it is very irritating that the music and the video are completely not in sync. Come guys spend a little time and contact your tech guy. The AC  is very loud andsounds like it is on its last leg. Perhaps that is why it is a bit on the warm side. One side of the gym has air flow from 2 huge fans. The other side lacks air movement. I guess it depends on what you go to the gym for but this one lacks in many respects.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
For the morons here that think that they are comparing this little Jem to some $100 plate joint in Manhattan while working for the NYT, and 5 stars is reserved for God alone. You're stupid. 

A tremendous selection from a daily defined menu, I enjoyed my bacalao today and couldn't eat much more than half of what was served. And I'm a big guy.

Fun fact: I was the only guero in the joint. 

Fun advice: it helps to be able to speak Spanish, but you can point and the cashiers are bilingual, and respond in kind if you speak Spanish to them.

Having had unruly, disastrous naturally curly/wavy/frizzy hair all of my life, i finally found the one person who truly changed my hair forever!!!!  Anna is a gem.  She knows exactly how to tame my mane and I wouldn't go anywhere else!!!!!  I have been a customer for over 4 years now.  I highly recommend her  and the Japanese Straightening and wished she could've been there during my awkward teenage years when everyone was making fun of my hair. Now people want my hair instead of teasing me about it.  Thank you Thank you Thank you Anna!!!!!!!

This is just about my favorite place to go. I like to go here when I anticipate having a couple of busy days because I don't have time to make food and their portion sizes are big enough to last me a couple meals. I can't get over how they allow you to get unlimited toppings for one flat, low price. You can choose between pizza, pasta, or salad, and create from there. I love mixing red sauce with Alfredo to make a yummy pasta sauce. And all the veggies I put on it allow me to feel less guilty about eating such a large portion when I'm super hungry.

This place is an absolute rip off. They will diagnose your dog with anything they can think off. Took my dog in for a one ear infection. They go ahead and treat both ears instead of one, charge me $110 for it, I had no idea. I thought they only treated one since only one ear was the one that it was starting to get infected. Go the following week for the second treatment and that's when I find out they treated both instead of one. Still made me pay for the other treatment, this time just one ear. Bunch of rip off. Not going back ever again.

Good food.  HORRIBLE service.  The last three times we have had to wait over 30 minutes past when they said the food would be ready.  One of those days was a Wednesday, which isn't the classic weekend rush.  This past time, we sent our order in at 3pm to be picked up at 5:40.  We ended up having to wait until 6:30 and even at that time, they only had half of our food done.  They never even put in our second pizza or wings!  It makes me so sad that my hand has been forced to go to chain restaurants now instead of supporting a local restaurant.

Today I purchased some meat and cheese from the deli. When I got home it was not in my bags. I called and they said bring the receipt in and they would replace it. I stood at the customer service counter waiting for them to bring my replacement deli items up for over 20 minutes. When they finally brought it up the customer service lady just handed to me with a smirk and didn't say one word. I told her, sorry this happened to me and I'm sorry it took me so long, she still had nothing to say, not even a hint of an apology. 
Rudest customer customer I have ever seen by far!!
Publix will be my new grocery store needless to say.

Literally the worst McDonald's I've been to. Ordered the Southwest grilled chicken salad at the drive-thru and they totally left out the sauce! the grilled chicken was hard and overcooked, unlike the other ones I had at different Mcdonalds. And the large diet dr. pepper I got literally tasted like carbonated, bitter water. The supposedly "Dr. Pepper" ended up being some sort of unknown liquid that tasted like shit...I guess the soda machine was down just like how their ice cream machine is "down" 24/7? lol never going through here again
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Not pleased at all. We ordered 5 different rolls and when they were delivered, they were all in the same tray, vegetable rolls touching shellfish rolls. As a sushi establishment I would hope they would be conscious of the fact that some people are allergic to shellfish and should NOT be touching non fish rolls. Now I can't eat my food because everything was mushed together. Would love to review the food itself if I could have eaten it. Will be calling to get a refund. Word to the wise- you will need to specify different orders to avoid everything being a mushed up mess.

We arrived at 6:15.  There was a lengthy and obvious line of people waiting to put their name in, and no one came to the counter for nearly 10 minutes.  We were the only party of 2 on the wait list, saw multiple open tables for two, and still weren't seated for another 5-7 minutes.  We set a timer to see how long the food would take.... 1 hour 22 minutes for 4 rolls.  We paid over 60 dollars (we were unwittingly charged for refills each time because they only serve soft drinks in bottles).  The sushi was better than average, but there are too many other, more affordable sushi options in Nashville to go here again.

Completely average hotel - noting to rave about, nothing to complain about. Adequately clean. Average soft bed, huge TV, comfy couch, decent work out facility, small pool, lots of fluffy towels. Rooms were small, not sure i could have shared the King room without climbing over each other to get into the bed. And where a third or fourth person would go for the pull out couch is a mystery. Free wi-fi was adequate for my purposes, could even stream Netflix early in the am in the gym, but not later in the day in my room - assume more guests using the bandwith.Quiet space for working and sleeping. I would stay again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love this place! The Italian mamma that owns it is the sweetest and best at preparing your orders perfect! Well..thet since got a new store in Largo and congrats to them but they will lose this store if they don't step their game up. Whoever runs it now they just seem unorganized and like they don't care. I was shocked hen I went in today! No people ,counter had no fresh pizza only a few very old looking slices. The bathroom was gross and no toilet paper. My other friends been coming there for years and said no more! Do we have to drive to Largo now this was so convenient. Feeling disappointed.was a 5 star now a three

Stopped in to get some yogurt.  Asked for tasting  cups and they didn't have them. Ok.  So I was getting the kids one and thought I might want one so I put some of the kind I want in my daughter's cup.  Asked for a spoon so I can taste if I wanted to get it.  They won't give a spoon out until you pay.  There is no logic that you can touch the handles but not for a taste to see if you like the flavor. It's not like she was even kind about it.  She either is the owner and not friendly and needs to figure out you won't save your way to prosperity....or the owner really needs help finding friendly staff.

We went here while in La., visiting family.  Stuck in traffic, and boy were we happy to find this place!  

Very clean inside, tasty treats for any time of day, and delish drinks.  The southern pecan was quite delish without being too sweet or sugary.  

Coffee wasn't bitter, and family had tea that was also nice.  

Overall, clean facility, clean bathrooms, nice lighting / ambiance and has a lot of parking, drive thru, food, and quality coffee.  What isn't to like. 

If you stumble upon this place, be sure to treat yourself!

Place an order for some wings I was  told 15 minutes I waited 20 minutes when went to pick my wings . I was charged and told it'll be a few more minutes sat down for 15 minutes went up to the counter and ask the cashier how long more I was told they were out of wings no apology from the manager she's extremely rude she needs to be retrained for a place that just opened she's not building any kind of relationship with the customer she's just chasing people away. My family and I was so excited to try this place because we live right in Meadow Point . I do not recommend this place.

customer service is dead in 2015 at this location. confirmed by the overall 3-star reviews here, if i could give them negative five, i would. other cj's locations are certainly better than this one, but i will never give another dime to a company that does not answer for the shoddy products they sell...and do everything they can to lay fault and blame on their customers rather than meet their needs. mark my words, this location will see great failure now as ), one way or another, god corrects all trespasses against me :(
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This Subway has only made my order right once. I've been back twice within that last two weeks and my sandwich has been completely wrong. The first time I ordered a chicken bacon  ranch on Italian herb and cheese with olives, lettuce and ranch. Somehow it ended up having onions on it and it was on Italian bread. Then today I ordered the same sandwich as last time. This it didn't have onions but it was on the wrong bread. I let the first one slide but now I'm fed up with this store! How hard it is to make a sandwich?

I used to crave Vic sushi, especially the tuna dumpling and the specialty roll but they switched owners recently and frankly its no longer the Vic I love, crave and rave about to everyone who would listen.

Don't get me wrong, the menu is still the same and the rolls still sorta look the same as before but its just not as tasty anymore.  Oh how I long to find the original owner as apparently he's the one with the magical touch and can turn fish and rice into something magical.  I heard he opened a new location but no one seems to know where. SOB!

I was so excited to come here last week. I asked for the special chef sushi that some couple customers had good reviews on. It came up with NO LONGER AVAILABLE! Kind of disappointed me :( My boyfriend and I ordered other kinds of sushi instead. The sushi was ok. Nothing special. But the price is expensive compared to many sushi places that I have came before. No free miso soup and if you want to get one, it's $1.5/small one...!!!!!!!?!? The service was ok. The only reason that I give them 2 stars instead of one is this place is really clean! Never come back again. Not really impressed me!

Without a doubt one of the worst experiences ever in a hotel room. Extremely small room.  Went to put leftovers in the mini-fridge and stuff was growing in it (no joke).  Also went to get an extra blanket (found one in the closet folded and in a zipped plastic storage bag).  When I fluffed/spread it out over my child sand came pouring out all over him, electronics, sheets, etc.  Is there even a beach in Philly?  You even have to get into the fetal position to pee, as the toilet is shoved under a bathroom counter.  I've read other negative reviews and all the appear to get back is a canned response.  Save your money and go ANYWHERE else!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My boyfriend and I tried this place on a Sunday and was pretty busy when we arrived. We got there between 11:30 and noon and didn't get our food until sometime after 1(that's about when the crowd died down).  When our server finally brought our food I asked if she could discount anything on our bill because I felt we waited awhile for our meal. They were really cool about it and comped half of our food. The food and drinks were good, service was slow, but I'd definitely visit again. The atmosphere was pretty awesome too!

A couple of years ago, this was one of my favorite sushi restaurants, I would of given them 4 stars, but my last visit was awful, some of the rolls were still good but some were just  horrible, no tast, just heat.  We went there because we were going to watch a movie after dinner and you can get discounted movie tickets there. The service has always been slow, but this time it took us over 2 hours to get our food and eat it.  The wait staff seemed cold too.  I will not be going back. There are other great sushi restaurants in Reno, don't waste your time or money at this one.

This place is disgusting I did not enjoy my stay here at all the pool is FILTHY it's filled with dirt I thought it was a saltwater pool not a dirty bathtub. The bathroom in the pool area are filthy . I came here with my family and they could all see me shower threw a cloudy glass in the back of the shower which shows in the room. The beds were uncomfortable, no book in the rooms to tell you where anything is or that there are no ice machines you have to go downstairs to get a bag of ice . I will not be coming back here under any circumstances. 
Ps. The one star is for the very nice staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Do not stay here! Every bit of it including the parking lot was filthy. There were cigarette butts strewn so heavily around the cars if you weren't careful they came with you to your room on your shoes. The room had cigarette stains on the tub. The floor was stained with who knows what. No tissues. Smelled like mildew and urine. We were stuck sleeping there. We just got dressed and left!!! La Quinta's are normally clean. The photos looked nice. We stay at La Quinta's because we have a pet. We thought with Wyndham buying out La Quinta's they would ensure a good standard. Hope they read this.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place is the absolute WORST! The owner is a sexist bigot. I came in with my girlfriend and her son. We waited probably 20 minutes when he told us he didn't cut women's hair. I have a men's haircut, so I was pretty confused. I quickly realized he was in fact just being sexist and discriminatory. I normally get my haircut at Mac's barbershop, which is AMAZING, I just was in the broad ripple area and decided to give this place a shot. Also disappointing that not one person waiting to get  their haircut said anything to this horrible man. If you go to this place, you are, at the very least, implicit in the hate this establishment promotes.

I used to swear by the service, however last 3 times it has Benn non existant. First time had to ask manager to get my drink. Drink arrived about 2 minutes before the meal. Second time I had the drink but the chips and salsa was never delivered. The last time the server never came to my table. I sat there for 15 minutes and watched 2 other tables that came in after me receive their orders. I finally got up and walked out. The only reason they got a 2 instead of a 1 is the food is fantastic if you can order it.

Came here on the recommendation of a coworker. Spoke with Bill over the phone and described the issue I was having. He had me drop the car off in the morning, and by late morning/early afternoon, the car was ready for pick-up. Bill and his crew diagnosed the issue and fixed it quickly. Everyone was friendly, and I did not feel as if they tried to hassle me. I also received a call from Bill as to what they planned to do to fix the issue, before starting. I know many mechanics who fix the issue without a word, and then charge hundreds of dollars. This place was not like that. I would recommend to others.

I go here regularly, and I've enjoyed most all of the staff and gotten a good haircut each time. Had to go back to get something fixed once but they were glad to do it.
I do have preferred stylists and they are ok with that. The staff is easy to talk to and are usually in great humor. As long as you understand that each person cuts hair a bit differently and has their own style and attention to different aspects it's worth the stop in! As with any place you need to communicate what you want in an understandable and comprehensive way.
Thanks for all the great haircuts! I'll see you again soon.

We ordered this on recommendation of the hotel we were staying at. We got the general tso's chicken dinner combo, chicken fried rice and veggie Lo mein. Their fried rice was disgusting. It was almost black and had way too much soy sauce. I will now always appreciate good fried rice. The Lo mein was just okay. We didn't try the egg roll or the soup and the crab Rangoon was sub par. The saving grace and the reason for the 3 stars was the General Tso's chicken. It was actually really good. I would definitely like to have it again.

We came to this place for Valentine's Day ( first experience service wasn't the best but food was great) and were seated right away. We ordered the calamari for an app and it was like eating a rubber band and was burnt with no seasoning. Then we received our meal, I asked for the pasta with shrimp and crab. My meal had two little lumps of crab and three over cooked shrimp. I only had one bite and when asked how our meal was I nicely said "I'm sorry it wasn't the best" our waiter didn't apologize and still charged us for the meal.

I come here often for lunch and am always pleased with both the service and food quality.  The servers are friendly and quick to bring miso soup and edamame or salad, which many places in town don't offer for free with your meal. I'm not a raw fish gal, so I stick mainly to rolls. They're consistently good, well rolled (don't fall apart when eating), and well priced. They have a happy hour daily from 11 - 7 weekdays and 11 - Friday and Saturday with half price sushi, a great deal. The decor leaves a bit to be desired, a little run down and in need of a good coat of paint. Overall, a good meal for a great price.

Staff is clearly just going through the motions. Apartments are under constant maintenance. I have seen rats and bedbugs in just my short two year span. Rather than calling an exterminator they just nailed a board over the mouse hole and let me listen to rats scratching at the board until they died. I have had ovens that were not working during move in, rude and incompetent staff. It seems the only way to get things accomplished here is to write poor reviews and show anger. If you are thinking of moving here, DO NOT.

Received a call from JP Morgan Chase and was asked about my recent credit card application. The call was kind of suspicious and would not like to disclose confidential info over the phone since the application was several days ago. So, my husband and I dropped by the Chase Branch in Montecito and we were helped out by the branch manager - Ray Torres. He was very professional and courteous in handling my inquiry. He made a few calls to verify the number that called me and double checked my application. I am overall pleased with the great customer service shown by this branch especially with their branch manager--- Ray Torres.

Great happy hour pricing and when the weather is great is nice to sit outside!

This is a regular for my friends and I on a Friday night. The sushi comes in huge portions and is pretty good. I also recommend trying their entrees for something lighter.

Sometimes during happy hour it gets very busy and service is slow. There tends to be a lot of lingerers who hang out after dinner and cause a wait in tables. Finally, they charge $3 for carbonated water from a well - if it isn't sparkling San Pellegrino or a like item it should be free.

I asked for a sweet tea the girl gave me a splash of decaf with unsweetened tea then added sugar so there was an inch of sugar at the bottom. I told her I didn't want that. She took the cup poured it out and added the fresh sweet tea. She could of asked me if I wanted to wait for the sweet tea that she only had unsweetened. Now I have a decaf coffee flavor tea. On top of that I tried to redeem my donut rewards on my receipt and it doesn't work at this location it said this rewards number has already been used

Used this hotel for my wedding guests- my mother in law did most of her family's bookings and asked multiple times for her mother (with dimensia) to be in a conjoined room. At check in she wasn't and they couldn't change it. When I arrived after the wedding with my new husband- they hadn't touched his room and there were pizza boxes and tuxedo bags all over  from the boys getting ready that morning. The bed wasn't even made- what a great room to come back to as a newlywed. Luckily I have awesome friends who talked the staff into sneaking them a room key so they could personally straighten it. Way to go, Marriott.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I walked in for a gel manicure. The salon was clean and my manicurist seemed pleasant. We made conversation for a couple of minutes. I was surprised that no massage was included in my manicure. I paid $27 for filing, cuticle clipping, and three coats of polish. I'm not sure if that is standard for this salon or not, but I expect more when I have the rare opportunity to treat myself. I even asked in the middle of my manicure if they were busy today, and my manicurist said they were not. I don't think I'll be going back to this salon.

Worst McDonald's EVER! If I could give it no stars I would. They don't even deserve a star. It took over an hour to get my food, on top of that they gave me someone else's order... 
The staff was rude and very immature and unprofessional with the way they handle their mistakes. This location needs to shut down and fire every single person in there including management because they don't even really care how customers are being treated. I recorded how the staff approached me and will be sending it to corporate along with a screen shot of all these bad reviews, leaving it to Corp to handle those rude child like adults working in there.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Well two times in a week the front of my truck was not wiped down.  This time it was two young girls that wiped the truck down.  I was able to watch the one with the pony tail as she wiped down the truck on the passenger side.  

She never walked to the front of the truck and it seems that she didn't really want to be there, because she was SLOW and did not bother to wipe down the truck, only certain areas.

The greeter is always friendly to the customers and she cares about her job.  The others, not so much.

Worst DD location I've been to around the country. Ordered coffee, asked if it was fresh before ordering it. The employee said yes. Ordered with Splenda and cream.  Coffee was only slightly warm, almost cold. I was already on the freeway to Chicago before I realized this. I opened the top and there was black floaters in it as well, and it didn't look like coffee grounds. Stay away at all costs. This place is in a great area. Would have expected much more. Also, the employee acted as if they didn't care about the job or the establishment at all. Clear sign of poor management and terribly trained employees.

Horrible service! The baristas do not know what they are doing and have zero experience. They have no clue on how to make a latte or a simple coffee. I asked for an iced green tea latte and they gave me a HOT latte instead and had to make it a second time. Still they made it wrong and i had to get my money back. I gave them 3 chances the three times i went there and the service was HORRIFIC. Please do not go there. You will be wasting your time. How do you work at a starbucks and not know what an iced macchiato or green tea latte is? Nice decor, horrible service

I've tried working with this club. I paid money to work with a trainer but he hasn't showed me much and he has failed to show up for our last two sessions. I can't work with a club that won't work with me. When I went to request a new trainer, the girl at the desk began to tell me how she won't support this gym even as an employee because they don't provide her health insurance and she feels the club is know for taking people's money and not providing services. How can I make this work if your own employees talk this way.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I thought I was really going to like this gym. When I signed up I was made to believe that this gym was geared more towards average people or people with health issues. I was promised that I wouldn't have to feel uncomfortable surrounded by body builders. Today was my fist day in the gym without my trainer and I couldn't work out. All the machines were taken by big body builders that were mostly standing around talking to each and sitting in the machines so no one else could use them. I left without working out and feeling like I lost all my motivation to come back.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Boyyy..let me tell you...still sitting in there as I write this review..the south-asian man serving me refused to remind me of what a BMT was? He said he didnt remember...then when i pressed a little more, he decided to get me out of his face quicker by telling me.
Never asked me if i wanted it toasted...but said "What else? (on the sandwich)" i had to ask that he not continue to veggies but toast.
Snatched my card etc.
Listen..rule of thumb...meanness is an illness, you should have called out of work.

3 stars because the lady who was there, i heard how she interacted with other customers and she was polite

I have ordered twice from this McDonalds location through Uber Eats. Both times they messed my order up. The first time I ordered a double quarter pounder with cheese value meal and ended up getting a quarter pounder with cheese meal instead. The second time I ordered a quarter pounder with cheese value meal and did not receive a drink that came with it. This location also had shoddy customer service and rude employees. I have also observed someone working behind the counter wearing clothing that definitely was not appropriate for work. I will never done at this location again whole this bulls*** continues to happen.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Fernando, good Barber, short temper.  Does not have a business like attitude.  Two missed appointments due to work and child duties, and he wasn't having it.  Straight up told me to find another barber.  Sorry I'm on call, some of us have more important things that get in the way in the most unexpected times.  Totally disappointed in him.  I have never had a problem with any Barber in Texas except here in the state of Arizona.  The first Barber Shop I went to, the guy was hungover cutting my hair and now this guy and his attitude.  Frustrating

We selected this spot as it has a nice presence on the main drag in Ybor.  There were tables on the street with table cloths all filled with patrons on a Saturday evening in September.  I recommend a reservation if you want a table on the first floor which has nice ambience.  There are three floors and we were seated on the top one.  Service was good, food ok.  I had a pizza and it was ok, not great.   My wife had blackened salmon which she said was very good, but served without rice or potato.  Generous wine pours.  This is a popular Italian restaurant and I would have rated it higher but could not based on the mediocre pizza.

Let me start by saying that I understand how detrimental COVID-19 has been to businesses. I can understand the need to cut costs and I think that cutting ingredient costs could be justifiable. Overall the food just wasn't prepared well at all. My wife got the pepper steak and while the steak was cooked and hot the peppers and onions were still raw and cold. The fried rice had the exact same issue along with being obviously precooked, stored, moistened and reheated. Your customers still deserve freshly prepared food, especially when it costs $22 for 2 to go meals.

This was the worst dining experience I have ever had in Philadelphia. We had a 6:00 reservation and got our food at 8:00. Friends who had a performance had to leave without eating. My parpadelle with mushrooms contained four slices of shiitake and about a pinch of tomatoes and water at the bottom of the bowl. No seasoning. We ordered a Pinot on their list but they were out so the waiter just brought another inferior bottle ( same  price) and poured. They comped us the wine and did not charge for our friend's food after we complained but so what!  We wanted a good Saturday night pre performance dinner not bad food and aggravation.

Have it as an option if you have one car around your area and not own a car. Also, do not use it for more than 3 hours as a daily car rental could be cheaper. I only used that enterprise car rental for picking up someone at the airport and taking the groceries home. Other than that, is better to use UBER or discount car rental. Discount could be messy but they gave me great upgrades whenever things did not work properly. I must say also that never took discount rental's insurance so I paid many times 20 for nice rides a day.

I've ordered food from here multiple times and i always get delivery or carry out. I've had only a few bad customer service issues with them, and I'm always understanding. As someone that works in the restaurant industry I understand stuff happens and the food is what i expect from a little pizza joint. however, i have received raw chicken wings for the third time. I didn't bother calling again because no one really seems to care when l have complained. I don't want anything for it, just maybe an effort to not happen again. my hubby and i are gonna take a break from ordering from them awhile. maybe they'll be some improvement in the future.

I am so glad I switched to this Salon ....They do great color, blowouts, and waxing. Next I am going in for a cut.
