Tiffany gave me a beautiful new variation on my own color and Alma is the best at waxing and shaping eyebrows.  She also gives a fantastic blowout that lasts for days. There is a new blond stylist who's name I forget (it begins with an M) who also does beautiful color and really listened to me when I told her what I was looking for;  It seems that all the stylists know what they are doing and they treat their customers well, unlike other places where people seem to have "attitude."

This is the first time that I am writing a review here on Yelp. I am new here in Idaho and Luciano's been my fave restaurant so far. The ambiance, the food and service is really awesome!! I love the bread that they serve for starters and we actually order that for to go! Mostly we just order pastas and not even a time they disappointed my taste buds. My hubby and I loves their stuffed mushrooms, pesto linguine and carbonara. I like their ceasar salad as well. I am excited to try other dishes on their menu the next time we go their and maybe try their featured dish when we dine next time. Will definitely go back here again and again!!

Let's start with the upside of this place. Amazing, authentic food at great prices. I like the three taco combo. You can choose from a variety of meats and it comes with a side of rice and refried beans, as well as a roasted jalapeno, if you're brave. I also go for the Jarritos to wash it all down. The downside is there's only outside seating. It's only a downside in the dead heat of summer or on rainy days. But you can get your food to go or eat it in your car. It's also cash only, so hit the ATM before you go. The quality and taste of the food, as well as the friendly service earn a solid five stars.

This location is utterly sexist. I made a reservation online with my credit card (I'm an authorized user under my husband's account). When I came in to pick up my car, they refused to give it to me because the credit card was in husbands name. When I told them I do not have credit cards in my name and am only an authorized user, they told me a I cannot rent a car. This is ludicrous and shows a complete lack of common sense. I will not being using Hertz until they come into the 21st century and treat women appropriately.

Food is very good. Servers are very nice and helpful. Owner is extremely rude. Talks to people unprofessionally. If it wouldn't be for food would never go. Placed an order and ten minutes later owner came out and said they didn't have what we ordered but we could see another table had same dish he claimed he didn't have. Owner is extremely moody and if is in bad mood will treat customers or staff very hostile. 
The only reason this restaurant still in business is because of staff and food. We  were loyal customers but I will no longer spend my money at a place that conducts business in this manner.

Food is very good. Servers are very nice and helpful. Owner is extremely rude. Talks to people unprofessionally. If it wouldn't be for food would never go. Placed an order and ten minutes later owner came out and said they didn't have what we ordered but we could see another table had same dish he claimed he didn't have. Owner is extremely moody and if is in bad mood will treat customers or staff very hostile 
The only reason this restaurant still in business is because of staff and food. We  were loyal customers but I will no longer spend my money at a place that conducts business in this manner. Not nice place or nice owner

Good vehicle but it takes too long to get checked in. I rent a car twice a month for work and normally use hertz for the ease of just walking to the car and going. Enterprise you have to stand in line to get checked in, then the associate types in all your info and pushes the extras on you. Then you have to walk out to their outer office and wait while someone goes and finds you a vehicle. Then you wait more while they do the walk around inspection. Hertz takes 5 minutes total from the time you walk out till you're driving out the gate. Enterprise takes me 20 to 25 minutes every time I try them.

Staying in a 2 queen bed room on the third floor. Only down fall is my room doesn't have a heavy curtain that blocks out any trace of sun. So, being directly on top of the main entrance there is a decent amount of light flooding into the room. A slight annoyance is the fridge in my room squeaks, but a good hip check puts it back in place. Beds are neatly made, room is stocked, and quiet. Pool appears well maintained and I am hoping to indulge in breakfast before checking out tomorrow morning. Would most definitely be staying here again if the need arises!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Staff was friendly but ineffective. First room, the ceiling was falling in and there were ants. Second room had no towels, a dying roach in the tub, and we later found a dirty sock under a bed. Also the tv remote didn't work. At breakfast, there were no bagels, no bread, and only 3 bananas for fruit. Asked to speak to manager, she said if have to talk to general manager, but did give us towels to take up with us. Got back to hotel at 3 to give our 3 year old a nap and the room had not been cleaned yet. They showed up at 4 to clean, had to turn them away. Never heard from general manager.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Reno Tahoe Car rental made my weekend trip to Tahoe and then drive up to San Francisco a breeze. The entire process was seamless from pick up to drop off. They even met me in San Francisco to pick up the car at the airport before my departure. Nick worked hard to make sure I was taken care of, and made the entire process easy at a time when rental cars were completely booked in the area. I appreciate his responsiveness, flexibility and willingness to work with my travel plans. I would highly recommend Reno Tahoe Car rental to anyone visiting the Reno/Tahoe area. A boutique business with exceptional customer service.

I booked a room with Hotel tonight. It's an app where you can book last minute rooms. We got in late. I walked in to the hotel and they said they didn't have a room. They immediately refunded my reservation and put me up in another hotel. Jowell was so nice and very accommodating. She deserves five stars herself. It was just really annoying to get there at 3 am and not have your room. It was very underwhelming. The hotel they sent me to wasn't as nice as the one we had originally booked. The worst part of it was I called the hotel earlier in the day to confirm the reservation and they said there shouldn't be any problems.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stop by from work today to get a snack for the road home. I purchased two donuts  and chocolate milk..being from California where donut shops are plentiful but seem to be scarce here..i was excited to have a donut..i got a vanilla cream  and a cheese square Carmel cheesecake donut..both donuts tasted like day old store..i was sooo disappointed...the cream tasted like shorten and   cheesecake..what can you say when it did not tasted anything like cheesecake...the two stars was for having my favorite chocolate milk.

This is a refined contemporary Italian restaurant equivalent to a few new places in NYC(e.g. Da Claudio).    It is not Italian American Bronx style, nor old school southern Italian, nor Italian Southern (Noble crust?) but rather a place that reflects attention to exceptional ingredients.   Fine authentic flavors: Burrata salad, great risotto, Bolognese, pork saltimbocca all first rate. The desserts are special;even the cannolo was done right. The only negative was the noise level. With no sound absorbing material, conversation can be a stretch.

There is ALWAYS suppose to be at least one employee in the sign in area at all times. Today when I came in, once again, no one to be found. The doors were even closed to the employee room so no employee could even see what was going on out there. The reason for this complaint: I come in almost everyday and there is always this homeless guy upstairs that sleeps all day/hangs out in the studio room. Today he was there and made several other people uncomfortable because he just talks to himself and stares at people. I enjoy working out but not when there is no security! What's the point of paying a membership if anyone can walk in...
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Several coworkers and I went to Zinc for dinner last night. We went to Zinc on the recommendation of a coworker that has been going there for many years. When we arrived we were seated at a very small table, 5 people at 2 tiny tables pushed together. We asked for an additional table but the request was denied. When one of our coworkers drank out of someone else's glass by mistake, we were squished together, she requested another table and they grudgingly gave us the table. We placed our orders. The food was delicious. Why they stuck us in the middle of the room is beyond me.  Since this was my first experience with Zinc, it may be my last.

The staff is nice and helpful.  However the hotel is dated.  Our room smelled moldy and the ceiling had a huge water stain.  Beyond the dated rooms, the room service absolutely sucked!  At all other hotels in the world, room service is delivered on a tray with plates and glasses, etc.  As it should be considering the tremendous uplift in cost.  Not hear in this smelly dated hotel, they deliver room service in a plastics containers, with plastics forks and in a paper bag! Even McDonalds gives your food to you on a tray.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: They took 1 hour and a half to bring me cold Pizza! Then I get a call saying I'm banned because I requested a refund from Grubhub. That is so unprofessional! I had contacted Grubhub after 1 hour and 15 minutes of waiting for my order and Grubhub gave me a refund because of how late it was. That's customer service which apparently the restaurant doesn't have. After I explained what happened, the restaurant did apologize for the communication error, but I don't like how they just called me and told me I was banned without asking any questions.

This place put the gel on my nails WAY too thick. I was here on vacation and when I went back home to my normal place to get the gel removed it took them 40 minutes to get the gel off. This typically takes like 10 minutes. My regular spot had to file my nails down so thin I wasn't able to put color on them. I have to take a month break from polishing my nails since this salon damaged my nails so badly!!! She must have put like 8 coats of gel on. Beware if you get gel done here that they don't put too many coats on.

I came here for happy hour on Friday. 
Parking you have to pay and the gathering at the bar isn't Covid safe but the staff was friendly and the food was good. 
My main complaint is that I had the honey fried chicken , it came out underdone and bloody so I couldn't eat it and of course not to mention the health risk and liability. I told the server and it probably should have been removed off the bill since it wasnt edible but still had to pay which isn't right but could have been a mistake or careless what ever. Worth trying, as my friends was cooked okay, just not mine.

Do not even bother paying Beth's review any attention. This place is incredible. I mean, Soy Gringo, so it's pretty easy to fool me into authentic Mexican food, but also, this place really does ooze authenticity. It is true, that there are no chips and salsa. But those are empty calories meant to distract us from establishments that are afraid to stand behind the worth of their entrees. I had the Mole Poblano and would recommend it to anyone. The richness of flavor was very much present. I've got to start driving, but yes, amazing place.

Paid $60 for a dip manicure, which is supposed to last 3 weeks. Within 1 week the top coat chipped on almost every nail and a few nails have cracked. She also rushed through it and I didn't get a full manicure (no cuticles cut, no massage)... JUST TERRIBLE. 

Follow-Up: I went back in today to see if they would fix it...  the same girl did, but she commented that she didnt like the color I chose and then tried to charged me again... for FIXING HER BOTCHED JOB. All I can say is stay away from this place. Terrible service and quality!

Hotel is ok for a weekend get away. We came here from phoenix to do a baptismal so we stayed the night here. My wife booked the rooms on line at a great price. Our room came with a kitchen and a king size bed with a couch. Its a balling on a budget kind of place, its nice but needs a few things worked on. The breakfast is great i loved making waffles and the there is an omlet guy there ready to make one up for you but i do think it cost $3 for the omleat. The pool is nice and big and they have some big bbq grills out by the pool. We missed happy our but it looked like it could be fun. There is also music playing out by the pool which was cool.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is my new favorite Japanese hibachi in the area. The food is excellent, the service is prompt and friendly, the atmosphere is warm and inviting, the prices are reasonable, the master chef puts on a great entertaining and artistic show, and the owners and staff work hard to make every customer a repeat customer, which I am.  They have a great hibachi lunch special that is eminently affordable, and the Chirashi sashimi lunch special equally so, and both are excellent.  And I have to add, the chicken wing appetizer is astonishingly good - not the usual Asian restaurant wings. Simple, crunchy perfection.

Visited BB Nails for the 1st the today. I was a walk in & I was greeted by the friendliest owners, Vu & Kim. They are so kind & easy to chat with. I had the "Special Pedi" comes w/ a citrus scrub & cool mint mask w/massage. It was wonderful! I also got a gel manicure. Their salon is very clean & many many color options!  You can also book a party & bring your own spirits & food! You'll be very impressed when you walk through the door. Prices very reasonable! Stop by & see them for your next mani/pedi. You will not be disappointed!

As someone visiting NOLA with not many options for hotel delivery, I really wanted to order delivery and be able to leave a good review for Dolce Vita. I even included a 25% tip when placing my order on EatStreet to encourage it. It came in a little over an hour on a Wednesday night, which would've been fine if the pizza had been warm and / or better than average. I also ordered the Rockefeller which was ok (I didn't eat more than a few bites) and slightly warm, but I'm desperately trying to get it out of my hotel room now because I can't stand the smell. I agree with past reviewers--stop delivering. I should've just ordered room service.

Food was good - service wasn't so much, but she was new so I didn't rate them poorly because of that.  But the appetizer came out with the pizzas and came with a tiny side of dipping sauce. We asked for more in order to finish the rest of the bread and were charged $1.50 extra and she asked if I wanted more soda - then charged for that too! Not that I care about $3 - but it's the principle (I think you should have to tell me it will cost more) Also they ran out of their only dessert :(  Sorry we took an $8 can ride to get there!

OMG- I expected so much more but this restaurant surely disappoints. If you have been to sushi restaurants it takes alot to be disappointed. The server/host says "What you want"? - Maybe a seat and a menu! Forget about getting a drink here!!!
The food was mediocre edible. Rice was al dente firmness. If you were cooking risotto- that would be fine. The fish was not fresh and not spark or pizazz to their rolls- very blsai. I love a good tempura- but this was not! How can you screw up tempura.
Live and learn- Never go back and I don't care how convenient it is to my hotel. Terrible

Asada tacos were a little too dry for my liking. Not the best taco spot I've been to. Very cheap tacos (~$2/each). I guess this would make a good place for the drunchies. 

The restaurant doesn't seem to look the cleanest. The food came out ridiculously fast (less than 5 minutes). 

I ordered the asada and lengua tacos. I liked the lengua more. If you want diced onions & cilantros, you can get some at their self serve topping/salsa bar. Sorry but I thought the carne asada lacked flavor. No amount of salsa can mask the flavor of the meat..

Lots of seating and parking spots. They accept cash/credit/debit cards. 

Just an A-OK taco place. Meh.

My family hosted our rehearsal brunch the day before my wedding at Antonia's. From the beginning, Antonia was incredibly nice and accommodating to me and my family. She went above and beyond to make the day really special for us. I visited ahead of time and had breakfast with my dad and the food was awesome. On the day of the rehearsal, I was a little too nervous to really eat, but everyone enjoyed themselves. The staff was amazing and the food came out really fast considering they took almost 30 orders. I would highly recommend this for any brunch outing or a special occasion.

Awful!!! Don't walk, run away from this hell hole! This is a motel with a Westin name on it. I have had the unfortunate pleasure of staying here twice for a meeting there and then for a volleyball tournament for my kids. It is old, dirty, dated, had holes in doors, old tvs, loud plumbing, dogs accross hall and always long lines at check-in (which is ALWAYS late!!!). Not sure who the GM is but he or she should be fired immediately. It is in a great spot for the convention center, but do yourself a favor and stay somewhere else and Uber to where you need to go, this place sucks!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great Location, Near Santa Barbara Airport, but not too close (no noise to speak of from jets, etc). Staff and Front Desk were AMAZING. We needed to be in Goleta, so it worked well for our needs. Santa Barbara is right down the fwy. Everyone did their utmost to be sure we were comfortable. Band plays on the fourth floor, so if you are on the third floor and like quiet from apx 5p - 9:30/10p, be sure to mention it to them. Our room was quiet enough. Bed was slightly lumpy, but we decided not to mention it, but I bet they would have done everything they could if we had asked.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I recently took 5 dress shirts in for dry cleaning and only 4 came back undamaged. The sleeve was torn on 1 shirt and they would only refund the price of the cleaning the shirt. Touch of Class Cleaners destroyed my shirt for "free" in all fairness. When I asked for a refund, I was told to try back when the manager was on site. I checked with 2 other cleaners, and this is not protocol for damaged clothing items. This is a low-class business with bad customer service; I would suggest making the drive to Express Fabricare of McNatt's in Tampa for your dry cleaning needs.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: These ladies are the bomb! I get a Pedi about every 3 or 4 mos, and Linda and Kim are my fav gals! They are sweet and have great personalities, and do an awesome job. I show up at opening time, get in before I start my day and feel absolutely gorgeous when they get me done. I took my daughter here to get her 1st Pedi for her 24th Birthday.(Of course, I had a Pedi too). About half-way thru, she said "Thanks, mom, this was a great idea". (Rockstar Mom Status achieved!!! Woot!!!) We are doing the Pedi again this year, because my daughter liked it so much.

For a few business trips, I rented cars from Hertz at MSY because they offered a good price. I definitely was getting what I paid for, though. While the rental process was smooth, I had a lot of trouble with my vehicles. I got one vehicle that smelled strongly of cigarette smoke that had been covered with air freshener. I got another vehicle that had the "check engine" light displayed on the console, and when they gave me a replacement, it had an ant infestation. How does a rental car get infested with ants? After that, I got my project manager to grant me a bigger budget for rentals so I could rent elsewhere. No thanks; not worth it.

Had a few bad experiences with the wait time and my order being messed up. Food was great the first two times even after getting my order messed up. This last week I ordered and was told 30 min for pickup - turned into a hour with me waiting 25 min in the store/ bar. Order was messed up again after waiting a hour for pickup - ( pic below) hopefully it's  because they moved and have new cooks. Pasta was wrong and zero toppings that were listed from menu were on the food l, also just covered in pepper and couldn't even it it .May give it another try and hopefully they can get it together.

This is the only Hibachi restaurant that I'll go to in the area.  I've been to the others but they don't compare.  I've only done hibachi and I've been happy with their service.  Sometimes the wait staff takes a long time to bring drinks but the Chefs have always been great. I usually always get the Filet Steak and Chicken dinner.  Food is always cooked well and I've never had any issues with the food.  I actually brought a party of 15 people here for my Birthday and the manager was very nice and made sure that we were taken care of

I went here with friends and I was very impressed.  It's very deceiving from the look of the building out front but inside, it's very modern. 

They offer two menus, one at regular prices, then the other at 50% off prices but almost the same menu options.  Both waiters couldn't really give us a good reason as to the difference but we said "why not,  let's just do the 50% off".  

The quality of the food was very good and the steak and chicken were excellent.  It's BYOB which is great.  If it's really crowded, it can be somewhat noisy but the check was definitely reasonable.

I like the service here however they have a nail technician that is male who has crude jokes when or if you ask to use their public restrooms. He will ask if you or your child forgot your diaper at home. And one time my son had MY iPad which happens to have a pink Otterbox case on it and he asked my 6 year old child if he was a sissy boy. I normally wouldn't review a business with decent service however I just want to share my disgust with their only male technician. If you can avoid it do not let that crude man service you because he rude.

Don't bring your pets here. When few years back when Dr Baker wasn't busy she would call after my dogs visit and ask how my dog was doing. Even my own doctor doesn't do that with me.   

This time. My dog was sick. We called thursday around noon for emergency visit. Didn't get a call back until next day at 10am.  Took the dog in at 11 am.   They called back. Should be able to take dog home around 5:30. It is now 8pm. Still waiting to hear from them. 

When doctors get to many patients that they can't handle they stop taking on patients to better serve the patients they have.

Not taking my dog to Dr Baker anymore.

This is our go to restaurant for a date night or just getting together with friends.  I love restaurants that have a regular menu as well as specials that change daily.  Rigolettos not only offers a specials menu but the specials always include am appetizer, a pasta, a fish and a meat option along with the regular menu choices.  Hubbie's favourite is the rib eye but I almost always try a special.  Service and food are always consistently great.  I cannot say enough good things about this restaurant and it's staff

While I was really hoping this would be a great place to get Mexican Food.  I was very disappointed.  I grew up eating great Mexican dishes so when I read these ratings I thought it would be great.  I thought it would be a diamond in the rough.  Sad to say, it was worse than Taco Bell if that's possible.  When you read things like "authentic" that's what you expect!  Unfortunately there was nothing authentic about the stadium cheese sauce they put on their nachos.  Is fresh shredded cheese too much to ask for.  Is anyone tasting the food.  There is absolutely no flavor.

I hope something will change.  I want them to be successful.  I truly do.

Great gym, but unfortunately, for some reason, nobody knows how to wear their masks or wipe down gym equipment properly despite the numerous signs and announcements stating so.  The staff at Gold's Gym don't do a great job of monitoring this so a lot of gym members are freely seen with their masks not covering their nose or just completely off. It's a shame. If I hadn't prepaid for an annual membership I would work out at a gym whose members know how to follow protocol and whose staff care about actually keeping their gym open.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: These people are scam artists and what's wrong with businesses in general today.  We got a quote for  $150 for neutering somewhere else.  We didn't want to wait, so we went here instead.  $150 here doesn't even cover the bs blood work done beforehand.  $400 was the neuter price.  Then they try to sell you a monthly package, which we had problems with in the past.  On the way out the door, they tried to hit me with a $40 office visit.  It'll be a cold day in hell before that happens.  Do not go here unless you like pissing away money.

I liked the place. Great friendly staff and great breakfast bar. Only issue i had was that we had ants in our room. And we were on the third floor. Called front desk and they didnt have a maint guy on staff to spray for the night, wanted to move us to a different room. I didnt want to lug everything to a new room so i said we'd deal. They said they'd bring us new sheets (i killed 10 ants on our bedspread) but they never arrived. I gave up. Honestly it wasnt a huge issue. Just thought I'd tell anyone who is scared of em, be weary of ants!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I am not sure that I have ever had a positive experience at this particular McDonald's.  Either they screw up my order, or it takes a ridiculously long time.  Occasionally, it's even a combination of both.  At the moment, I have currently been waiting in the drive thru line for over 30 minutes, with three cars still ahead of me.  They seem to be serving one car about every 15 minutes, which is absolutely asinine considering it is a fast food restaurant.  I don't think I will ever have the patience to return to this location ever again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
We had better housing when we were students.  The outside and inside of these apartments are filthy (our windows were so dirty, they were black, and we could hardly see out of them).  calls for help to the office are often ignored.  Apartment staff thinks it is ok to peak inside people's apartments (no privacy!). 
 this is def. not a place for young children.  after painting was done, there was paint chips left all over our floor...painters never covered our furniture (as they promised), and things had to be thrown out.  (Multiple roof leaks were the issue).  Every apt. on our level was affected. Place was very poorly built.

Three coworkers and I arrived on Monday night for a 3 day stay, but we were not provided the breakfast coupons we were entitled to, and we were not told how to get the free WiFi we were entitled to under the hotel's agreement with our company. On Wednesday we ordered appetizers in the bar, but didn't receive them for an hour, after others who ordered after us had already received theirs, making us late to dinner. Each of us had a malfunctioning light in our room. In general, the rooms looked old and run-down. The front desk staff was not friendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Walking around New Orleans looking for coffee shops and on the way to another highly rated spot we stumbled across this one. Saw the sign on the street and followed the arrows down a short alley. What a stroke of luck as the coffee is good and with an assortment of Sweet and savory pastries and sandwiches. I had the 4 shot americano and was feeling quite jazzed up for my day. 

Also tried the chai and while I'm not a tea drinker, it was pretty good as well although maybe a bit weaker. Keep in mind I was halfway through a robust coffee myself. 

Give it a shot (or four), it's a cool spot.

Fiesta Chicken is good, very good, but be ready to pay for your sauces. I usually purchase either the nachos or the taco salad. We have never been charged for the dressing, until now. You usually get dressing with your taco salad, but not anymore, now you have to pay for it, on top of the cost of the salad which is a little over $8.00.  Prepare to pay at least an extra $2 dollars for the salad dressing, they are 50 cents each and the containers are only filled a 1/4 way. Also, they are very stingy with napkins, so bring your own.

Highly disappointing. I came here because I like the conveyor belt style sushi restaurant. I know the quality in conveyor belt places isn't as good as you get in a traditional sushi places, but I like that they give you the chance to try a lot of different rolls. I came in and watched two sushi chefs slowly fill take out orders while the same three plates went around the track for thirty minutes. I had a few made to order rolls which were ok, but the conveyor belt was a bust. The whole time I was there they put maybe three plates on the belt.

The mamager or owner of this bar is a total JERK.  We bought our draft beers and asked if we could set up the shuffleboard to use.  Yes, we were ready to pay for its use.  He got obnoxious about the fact we wanted to sweep the silicine off and set it up to play.  He used his hands and swept the silicone into clumps all along the table and walked off.  Total jerk move!  IF YOU DON'T WANT PEOPLE USING THE SHUFFLEBOARD, JUST REMOVE IT!!!  Needless to say, the mgr/owner sucks on customer service.  Just go elsewhere if you want any customer oriented service.  No wonder why the bar is practically empty; a dickhead runs the place.

Pizza and pasta salad wasn't too terrible, but the service wasn't that great. The "general manager" Everett I believe his name is (what is on the receipt) had been the person cashiering me. Upon paying he said "what type of large drink would you like?" Which wasn't a part of the combo I ordered, unknowing this I just said a Pepsi not realizing I'd be incurring another .30 cent charge. Not sure what type of scheme you have going on there, but doing that to every customer is bad business. The money isn't the issue, it's the principal. On top of that, he was rude to his workers, do not see myself returning to this place!

When here for at least 5 years...Rene did my nails...almost did a terrific job..when Rene left Sandy took over my standard appts..every other week..then all of s sudden I go in for my appt one day and I'm told Sandy left...so someone else did my acrylics...didn't really like the way they were done but I figured I would at least go for a bit to give her a chance...well needless to say after s our 6 to 8 weeks my nails were a mess...do I decided it was time to go to another salon...
Things certainly changed after Rene left...very disappointed...

The reason why this place only costs $10 for a one person all-you-can eat sushi buffet is because the ingredients aren't fresh. Hell, it even taste like it's FAKE. I have tasted so many dishes at countless sushi places around Florida and this immediately goes to the bottom because of their lack in creativity, food quality, and service. The only reason why people come here is for their Hibachi service (which is very good), and their surprisingly cheap prices. After eating here, I learn a very important lesson: you get what you pay for.

Since the beginning of the quarantine my husband and I have bought our groceries at this Kroger. We go at 7am on Sunday, when they open. There are very few other customers there at that time. The store has been fairly well stocked and the employees are competent and friendly. This morning there were more shoppers than usual and only about half were wearing masks. I hope this was an anomaly, if not we will need to find another source for groceries. We are high risk and we enjoy being around people who believe in science and care about others.

Food was mostly mediocre, though the bruschetta appetizer was pretty good.   pasta was delivered ice cold, not lukewarm, literally as if it was pulled from the fridge.   pasta also had only a splash of cold sauce.   waitresses were rude, failed to take drink orders and became visibly irate when asked for napkins.   waitress managed to serve our party but managed to leave one person waiting for thier plate which made our lukewarm food even colder.  A lot of room for improvement in this place.   i don't think i would come back unless I heard of sweeping changes.

Do not open a safe deposit box here. They lose your sign in card. They lose your contract and even if you have your ID and both keys, and have paid via automatic debit year after year, they will not give you access.
I was there for 1/2 hr. waiting, and they passed me on to one person after another. They just shuffled papers, looked on the computer and could not help.
The branch manager said he only had that job for 3 years, so that was his excuse. No apology either.
INCOMPETENT! BAD CUSTOMER SERVICE!
Your valuables are NOT SAFE with them.

In all honesty, I'm in between a 2 and 3 star. The atmosphere is awesome, the service could use some help but was still great, but the food was mediocre at best and lacked a lot of flavor. They also don't give a military discount where most companies in the treasure valley do. However, besides the mediocre food, the other deal breaker is we were there to celebrate and put that on our reservations but weren't offered any type of dessert, let alone a dessert menu. We were brought our check without even asking. Will not be returning when celebrating big events.

Worst, worst, worst ever. This Burger King is worse than any Popeyes I've ever been to. It's close to my house so I stop by once in a blue moon and every time I get so pissed. The line doesn't move. I've been sitting at the ordering screen for over 10 minutes. How hard is it to flip a friggen burger????????????? Seriously how hard is it ‍
Update - It's 5 minutes later and they said they can't take my order because they only have two cashiers. What?? You only need one. Please, please stop dumbing down America.

We booked this hotel just for a place to sleep after a 1 a.m. arrival into Indy. That's about all I would recommend. The carpets were filthy. The lighting was fluorescent. There was a disgusting amount of hair between the bed and the headboard. There was some unknown black fungus-looking stuff on the outlet plugs behind the dresser. The staff was friendly, helping us find food at such a late hour after we checked in. That said though, it's definitely the type of hotel you want to leave immediately in the morning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
First there are so many great ice cream places in St. Louis that I would go before this place. My kids love getting whatever toppings they want, so you know what kids win sometimes. 

My big problem with this location was how the only employee working closed the store early on a Friday night in mid-July. Luckily we got served, but while we were eating we saw at least 5 families come up to the doors to find them locked at 8:35, when they clearly were supposed to close at 9 (picture was taken as we left). This is unacceptable, especially during the summer months.

The food was a 3.5, service was a 2.  Some of the food was better than others.  The fajitas that my son ordered looked really good.  My daughter's chimichanga was really good too!  My corn tortillas that my chicken street tacos came on disintegrated, so I ate them with a fork.  The chicken was lacking seasoning.  I wouldn't order that again.  The salsa, chips and guacamole were really good.  The waiter never refilled our drinks and we had to ask 3 times for to-go boxes and 2 times for our bill, and they weren't even that busy,

First of all, we didn't receive all of our order. They dont bring you your whole order so everyone can eat together. The waitress has no idea what she is serving to us,training is needed. There is no Manager or Owner around to speak with about their issues.Very unprofessional service from their staff and sushi chefs. Forgetting orders isn't helping for return customers. I don't see good reviews in the future unless they change their ways. I suggest not going to this establishment,and thats all she wrote.....

Elegance Cleaners? HA! There is nothing elegant about this place. I live within walking distance of Elegance Cleaners and am in the area all the time, but I would much rather drive 15 minutes to a place I can actually trust. Not only is the staff incredibly rude (she has literally chased non-patrons off her property for parking in her lot--even chased them home!), but they are also unprofessional. I once brought in a bridesmaids dress to get altered, and the seamstres didn't even ask me to try it on! I suppose she relies on guess-work that actual craftsmanship...

Bottom line: STEER CLEAR!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I only found out about this place because I worked in the area at one time. I talked to Vikki and she seemed very knowledgeable about what I wanted to do with my hair. I had tried this style before and it went terribly wrong. I now have gotten my hair done by Vikki three times and I won't get it done anywhere else. Vikki's talent is EPIC. The color in my hair is so wonderful and I have gotten compliments even when it has grown out. Yes this place is on the expensive side but honestly I don't mind paying for the results I get.

Order Pizza and wings here the other nite to help support local businesses t .
The person on the phone was very pleasant and took our order saying delivery would be a half hour , which was right on the money so that's the first stars! 
Wings where great that's the second star ! Now the bad .....  thin crust pizza was over cooked (burnt) couldn't even eat the crust ! We ordered bacon olive and pineapple which it was but they also threw on ham ( maybe Canadian bacon ) which we don't like , that's why we order bacon ! Had one slice each picked off the ham and threw the rest away !! Was very disappointed!

If your in a rush and want to grab sushi real quick. Definately a place to go. Not always packed which is a plus. Be sure to order there coconut shrimp appetizers. One of the many reasons why I come here also try there outback and the chef special, literally the best sushi here. The only downfall is they limit your appetizers. If your gonna pay $24.99 you would expect to get literally "all you can eat". A little disappointing cause I would love to recommend them, but there are plenty of sushi places where "all you can eat" meets what it says. Other then that. Last call is at 8pm It's aaaiiiggghhhht!!!

A group of us luxury apparel retailers get together for dinner brainstorming session in the Plymouth Meeting area twice a year, and we have gone to From the Boot the past two years.

We love the BYOB factor; we all bring our favorites and share among the group. It's become a competition of sorts.

Our dinner last night was the typical tasty meal. I had the mussels in white wine sauce and gnocchi marinara. The gnocchi was a little puffy though, but still with good flavor.  We shared the bruschetta - mmmmmm. The service was great.

As much as I love to try new places, this group will continue to return.

We ordered a couple different nigiris, a gyoza appetizer sukiyaki and chicken cutlet. The server was nice but the food was pretty bad. Our nigiri tasted of ammonia. We tried it with and without soy sauce and it was just not good. The ammonia taste was there. Told the server and he was apologetic and we told him we didn't want it. He took off one of the nigiris from our tab but that was it. It is what it is. We never got our gyoza either. We didn't eat much of our entrees as the flavors weren't quite there. Maybe we had high expectations for this place as it had great reviews but it just was not it for us.

This place is a joke would not recommend that anybody stay there. Got into Florida late from Michigan and booked on line ,the pictures on the computer it looked great but once we got there it was like a crack house from Detroit went upstairs to look at room and had one person try to sell me drugs and on the way down had prostiute  try to sell me something. They did not want to refund my money but thankfully my bank put a stop on the payment, pnc is a great bank they got my money back for me. Please if you value your life do not stay here it's nasty and very dangerous, place should be torn down
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I thought a Westin would at minimum be 3 stars.  This was 2.5 at best.  This place has great bayfront views and a wonderful staff.  The rooms are outdated, dirty, musty, and just plain gross.  I don't even want to discuss the smell in our room but being a race weekend no other rooms available. Bathroom Amenities are 
Similar to a Days Inn.  The carpeting throughout the entire hotel is stained and worn.  This place has great potential but needs a facelift before I ever stay here again especially when it was over $200 each night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I've eaten at this location three times and twice at the location on the Hill.  I've always enjoyed my experience at both locations.  Here are my take on the PROS and CONS of this location.

Pros: A nice relaxing environment away from the hustle of the casinos but also very refined where you can always expect good service.  All of my waiters/waitresses have been very professional.  I would recommend the Crème Brulèe for dessert.  Maitre D' is more than willing to help you in any special occasional needs.

Cons: A bit on the pricey side when you look at the portion size.

Easily one of the worst gyms I have ever been to. I got a membership here due to the fact that there were no other gyms in the area, however, I decided I would rather drive farther to a different gym rather than pay an outrageous amount for an outdated anytime fitness. The machines here are so old, there is only 1 stair machine, and the weights are so outdated that I got rust on my hands every time I touched them. The worst part is they charged me $38 a month to be a member. More than I have paid at any gym before (including LA Fitness and Golds which much better facilities) and I'm not sure what their reasoning is behind this price.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Although not as many options as other All You Can Eat restaurants, all of their options are great and refreshing. Also, at least in my experience, there is more food in the plate compared to other restaurants I've been to. Four stars instead of five because servers sometimes forget to bring some orders. The last time I went, I had to order crab Rangoon five times and only got it once on the last time while the table next to us kept receiving their orders of Rangoon. It makes me think they were receiving mine.

I am a big fan of Bar Rescue so of course I had to check this place out.  I'm typically a lover of dive bars and can relax as long as there is a drink in my hand.  This place however, had a smell that was faintly Port-a-potty that I just couldn't get over.  I did sample their signature blue drink with a jalepeno and it was just a little too sweet for my taste.  I do think it would do the job if you drank the whole thing, though.  Woah, baby was it strong!  Definitely a place to stop if you are a regular viewer of Bar Rescue, but I wouldn't recommend sticking around for long.

The manager (Olga?) has got to be one of the more unpleasant managers I've encountered. VERY unprofessional, very rude and just uncool. I had a coupon, and instead of letting me and my kids do the order in person, she insisted we had to use the app to get the coupon (it did not specify that in the coupon). BOTH of the other ladies were very pleasant. They seemed just as shocked as I was that the manager was being so rude. I live 5 minutes away and have been going to this location since it opened. I will not choose a different location or a different restaurant. She was ridiculous.

Service was great but food was lacking. Went in for ravioli Monday from a friend's recommendation but that was a mistake. The value was there, $20 for an appetizer or dessert choice, ravioli of choice (including the chef special as an option), and a glass of house wine.

We tried the pumpkin and chef special (duck) raviolis. Neither were satisfying. We took a couple of bites, boxed it to go, paid, and left for a meal elsewhere.

I hate to let things go to waste so I tried them both the next day. The duck tasted better the second time around but definitely won't be back.

I highly recommend this restaurant to sushi lovers. This is one of my favorite sushi places to go to. I come here at least once or twice a month. Here are some reasons:
1. The fish is always fresh and has amazing flavor
2. They have many rolls to choose from for whatever you enjoy
3. Everything is super tasty!

Some rolls I recommend:
-Nemo roll
-Godzilla Roll
-Spicy Rock Roll

Everything is amazing. Although they give a nice quantity of miso soup, I've had some experiences where it's extremely salty, but generally Otaya is awesome!!!!

I ordered take-out from here yesterday. I have never eaten here before even though I have driven by it numerous times. I ordered crispy chicken and General Two's chicken. Both were lacking sauce and therefore were dry. The General Tso's chickem had more breading than I'm accustomed to. Overall their prices are high. They discontinued all lunch specials and soups. I was disappointed in the amount of money I paid and the dry food that I received. This business will have a difficult time competing with other Chinese restaurants in the area. Not planning a return visit.

The only reason my review gets any stars is because of the ONE good server. Our blonde server was the only one who seemed to know what she was doing and was attentive with tables. I saw a tall male server sitting and eating in plain view of tables when there were multiple tables that needed help  Sadly we were able to get in TWO appetizer orders before our actual sushi even came into the picture. The chefs were slow seeing as the restaurant was not busy at all it was kind of strange to get our food so late out. Maybe get some faster kitchen staff, or in general more staff.

Complaint!!!

What are these people doing?  OMGosh, The Orange Creamsicle shake is made too well!  So perfect on my lips, but it's going to be disastrous to me....I had one two days ago and have now been craving it....It makes my heart hurt to know it is a limited time thing.    Anyway, I had lunch the other day, chicken tenders were great.  Ordered them in the drive thru and had to turn around to go back in the store, because they weren't in the bag.  But hey, it's new, it's busy, and we all make mistakes.  Love the honey mustard sauce too!  Thanks, Arby's.

One of the best hotels I've stayed in. Very nice spacious rooms. Excellent staff. Free breakfast and dinner (Monday-Friday) for dinner. The pool and jacuzzi were excellent. They have a staff member Jessica who does breakfast in the morning and she is awesome. She learns everyone's name and is very accommodating for anything you might need. The only small cons I would say about this hotel are the WiFi seemed to drop a lot like once per day while I was online. The second small con is they only have 2 washer and dryers for the whole hotel. Again these are super minor cons but I'd definitely stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
WOW if I could give 10 stars I would. 
Amazing pizza and even better service
Circles and squares knows what they're doing. 
Hands down the best pizza i have ever had and I'm pretty sure I'm gonna be dreaming about the white pizza until I can taste it again. 
The crust of the Detroit pizza is to die for nice and crispy with the inside dough some how light and fluffy.
My only regret was not getting more toppings as the mini pepperonis were cooked to perfection 
We also reheated slices over the next two days as we tried to savor every last slice and it reheats perfectly in the oven!

I would not recommend this establishment. They are convenient, but the staff is very rude. I went in to buy some beer and a lottery ticket. The one young guy gave me a nasty look, like I was disturbing him when I came up to pay. He was at the register without the lottery machine. When I told him I wanted to buy a ticket; he looked annoyed and rolled his eyes. During the whole transaction; I felt like I did something wrong; just by walking in!! Of course he didn't even thank me! I definitely will not be giving the Liquor Barn any more of my business!!

I had the rudest experience I have ever had at any business from this place I walked in to make an appointment and then a lady who works there said that I was making her nervous even though I just asked a question on if I could make an appointment she also treated me stupid and then when I asked her why I was making her nervous did not give me a good answer confused me and then said I had to leave at once and so I wanted to make sure that I was not going to start a problem so I did and trust me I know I sound like the bad guy but I did nothing wrong other than ask to make an appointment

I have enjoyed ordering from this restaurant for years, but they are not following proper COVID precautions. I recently stepped into the restaurant to pick up a take out order, and none of the employees had masks on - from the girl ringing up my order at the register to the cooks in the back preparing my (and others') food. They have signs up stating that patrons must wear a mask at all times, but do not adhere to these standards. This is a very disturbing public health violation, and I am not sure if I will be ordering from here again until the pandemic is under much better control.

Pretty authentic dive bar.  Here are the plusses and minuses of this one:

- It's New Orleans.. which means smoking inside is fine. If it's going to be a problem that 10 mins in here will make you smell like a stale pair of chimney sweep's underpants then you'd better stay away.

- No drafts beers. There were a few decent bottles and cans, but this really is a bud and a shot kind of place.

- Great jukebox. Bartender spun some cool tunes while I was there.

- Chill, laid back, local but not unfriendly vibe.

- There's a pool table.

If this was my local, I'd probably be popping in fairly often but wishing they served up some draft beer.

When this establishment first opened service was beyond slow so they overfilled the foam containers with food. Now they give you Tupperware sized delivery containers filled with rice and a scattering of the entree on top. Smaller size containers and more rice keep their costs low and your value as well. My second time trying delivery. The first time the foam container was filled with lo mein and just a bit of entree in the corner and the delivery driver got lost. I will not be patronizing them any longer.  If you consider this the best in St. Louis, God help us all.

If you saw what this place was like before it got a facelift on Bar Rescue, well...it's essentially the same place but with that new blue drink. I ordered two Jack and cokes, and the bartender (with great lethargy) gave them to us in huge cups which jacked up the price. They also have dueling pianos, but it's a rip-off of Pat O'Brien's down the street and the musicians are not very good. Also, they have scenes from Bar Rescue playing on the TVs, including that scene where the chef throws up from the gumbo. Puts you in the mood...

This is a tried and true local favorite that will never let you down. The staff has always been courteous and attentive. Recently, after making our order selection online, I called to verify our selections were gluten free due to my wife's allergy. 
Erica took the time to carefully review every item and also assured us she'd alert the kitchen to be extra careful to avoid any cross contamination. Our food was ready and hot at pickup. Corner Bistro remains among our favorite restaurants. Always delicious. Always fresh.

Ive been to this place 3 times. The first time about a year and a half ago and it was fantastic no complaints. The past 2 times, the last being in May more specifically, was not good. I'm giving three stars for their awesome service and clean restaurant. I don't know if their sushi was bad the last couple times Ive gone or if they are ordering from somewhere else under the new ownership, but I think I got food poisoning from the last visit. I only ate one roll and had their salmon and mussels and felt very uneasy. I'm not sure if I would give them another chance as there are many other awesome places in Reno.

The best red sangria I've ever had! Order the red. It's amazing, comes in a giant glass, packed with fruit, worth every sip! But will definitely sneak up on you, so be careful. The food is really good too. The first time i went, i had the vodka rigatoni. Was delicious. My friend had the braised short ribs though.. to DIE for. Best we've ever had. The tortellini is okay, nothing to write home about. Nice, small, quiet place in Morrisville. Packed on Friday but not at all during the week. Atmosphere is older but we made our own fun.

We have been using Boulevard Animal Hospital ever since Dr J Geffen started his practice. We have had 4 dogs and 4 cats and have always recieved excellent care for our pets.  The staff is just great and knowledge is superb.   I would never think of changing to a different vet. We started using Dr J Geffen over 30 years ago when he only made housecalls.  We now use Dr Brett for our 2 Siberian Huskies and when he notices a potnetial problem he reacts to make sure that there is not a serious problem.I have full confidence in these vets and I would never think of changing.

This is the 3rd time I have tried to come to this location, once during the early evening only around 4-5pm. Every single time, with no fail, the drive through is closed! I don't know how people are even supposed to know if it's open or not because they always have cones up in front of the drive through, yet have a sign up saying drive through is open. I tried going inside tonight and they were closed? At 8:30 pm even though both google maps and their website says until midnight. Not worth it to waste your time

Nice place, comfortable beds. Way over priced for the tiny room though. Bathroom was really nice and the view of the stadium arch was really neat. Staff was very great and bartenders and waiters downstairs were fun and nice. Glen the bartender was super funny and very personable. The manager guy who was working was a complete jerk and very rude when any of the ball players were around acting like he was the FBI and nobody could even look their way. All in all, I have stayed in better places and for $584 bucks a night should have been top notch!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I used to like this McDonald's at this location. Unfortunately, over the past few years they have gone down hill drastically. Their drive through takes forever and without fail every time I place an order something goes wrong. I never take the time to write reviews but my experience has been so bad at this location that I felt compelled to do so. This location used to hire/employ a lot of Mexicans (back when the service was good). I had mixed feelings at the time. Now they hire only Americans and the service sucks. BRING BACK THE MEXICANS; illegal or not.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Dirty room hairs on the sheets I showed the polite lady who checked me in. She was very apologetic. I called the manager she told me she would give me a fifteen dollar credit for a dirty nasty room. Not acceptable. The whole hotel needs a renovation. They have a indoor pool. Really humid area. They have sliding glass doors on the exterior of the property which is open to let out the humidity. Very unsafe any homeless person or criminal, pediphile can enter the guest room area. The manager acts like she doesn't like the heroes in blue.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Nice hotel in downtown Philadelphia.  Easy walking distance to lots of good restaurants.  We also walked to Independence Hall, The Museum of the American Revolution, and the waterfront a few times during our stay.  Takes about 20 minutes (1mile walk) to get to Independence Hall and maybe 30 to make it to the waterfront.  Easy walk down Chestnut St.  The hotel also has a really good steakhouse where we ate twice: Davio's Northern Italian Steakhouse!  The rooms are a little small but clean and staff was friendly.  I would stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The food is delicious, but the service is consistently terrible. We had a reservation for 7:30 PM. We didn't get seated until 7:45, and didn't know who our waiter was until 8:15pm! We asked four different people for water, including the owner, it was ridiculous and almost humorous how long it took them to bring us water. It was Valentine's Day, so we really had no other options. This was the second time we ate there, and had to ask for a waiter after zero service.... If this restaurant was in a city, they would go under in a heartbeat, but they have a handful other restaurants to compete with in a small town. Bottom line, it's poorly managed.

This is a new(ish) Chinese restaurant in Fountain Square. I was pretty excited when the place opened because that is one genre of food the area is lacking in - and Hong Kong fell about exactly where you would expect for the price point. The most unfortunate part was that after placing the order via phone, I was given a 15 minute timeline to pick up the food. Unfortunately after arriving, the food was not ready until closer to 35 minutes. 

It seemed that most of the orders that evening were grub hub and the staff were confused by a call in order. 

However the Kung Pao chicken was right what you would expect.

My dog had swollen neck and just not himself. I called the nearest vet by our place and was told they didn't have any openings. So, the vet referred me to come this place. Biggest mistake! As soon as we walked in, we were told there's going to be an hour or two hours wait. Thats fine. It's been 4 hours and we are still waiting! And No one is giving us updates on the status of my dog! This is absolutely the worst place! Please do not take your pets to this place! The worst pet hospital I've ever been to! I regret taking my pet here and all they did was giving him benadryl. Such a waste of money!

This place was fantastic! The ice cream, albeit a bit expensive, was very tasty. The selection was small, but each item seemed to be expertly crafted. 

You have choices of of Sundae, but you can also buy Ala carte, which is what I ended up doing. The ice cream is quality, and probably some of the best I've ever tasted. The sauces are also very tasty, and they pile it on! 

The interior is pretty stark and open, and seating is sparse. On a busy night, I feel you need to eat outside, but considering its in the Central West End, you can't be in a better place!

Atmosphere, comfort, fresh. 

Was seated so quickly, as if i had a reservation. Food was fresh and the music+comfortable surroundings, employees and booths allowed me to really relax after the long day i had. Restrooms were clean. Tv's had the news on.

I would recommend something else play on the tv's besides news like perhaps a japanese show.

My thoughts after a couple days: 
I do want to return to try the hibachi but i feel like the prices were a bit too high. A little more of an elevated experience is what it would take for 5 stars. i love Japanese food and welcome this place to the community.

Over an hour and still hungry. Only the drive through is open. Drive through and then realized they forgot a burger. Got back in line, they sent me to a numbered spot to wait so I requested they remake the whole order so I would have hot food all around. Finally a girl came with the one burger only and was very flippant when I asked to speak to the manager saying good luck he was too busy. Got back in the drive through a third time. I really wanted hot food, manager just gave a refund. Now to find somewhere else to eat.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This Starbucks is in a very convenient location for me and it has a drive-thru but they cannot ever make my coffee right. I would say about 90% of the time I go here they give a drink that is not made correctly and I have to go to another location to have it remade because if I ask them to remake it they just cover it with whipped cream and try to kill me with caramel sauce. Not sure why this location can't get it together but when I am spending $5 or more on a coffee I would like it they way it is supposed to be made.

They were not at all professional. Did not help us pick out frames until they were close to closing.  Both times (I went to different locations) they told me it was cheaper not to use my insurance. They told my mother same thing and she has different insurance.  I couldn't see how I looked in frames because they didn't have magnified mirrors. They told me to take a selfie and then put my glasses on and look at pic each time I tried frames. Ridiculous! Her explanation of charges was not easy to understand. I left and went somewhere else.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: So normally this is a favorite place for lunch or early dinner.  Their app only ordering made it difficult to order.  We had to log in every separate time.  Ordered drinks.  Had to log in again to order food.  Had to log in again to order more food.  No one could take our order.  Just pretty annoying experience.  Food was great but hard to enjoy as it was freezing cold in the restaurant.  Miserably cold ( we live in FL) there is no need for a restaurant to be this cold, unless it is some management trick to turn over tables faster...

We have been coming to Pitman Animal Hospital for over 20 years. Just recently, our English bulldog had a complicated surgery done by Dr. Collada. After a lot of care and doing what we could for him, our dog had to be put to sleep.  Dr. Collada is the most compassionate and caring veterinarian we've ever dealt with. He is very thorough and takes the time to explain everything and answer all of your questions. I'm always very happy with the vet techs as well, they've shown our pets a lot of love.  If you go to Pitman, Dr. Collada is the best!

Don't go here. My optometrist Alexis Romero didn't correct my vision at all. After stating that I couldn't see with my new prescription they did have me come back in and charged me again. But she only changed the prescription for the contact for near sightedness. I STILL CANT SEE OR READ ROAD SIGNS. After informing them they still want to charge for a visit for maybe a more qualified optometrist in their facility.Why would I then come back here If they want to charge me again, I plan to visit another eye Dr. DO NOT GO HERE.I'll update when I get a new prescription from a more qualified Dr.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Bad bad food and they The chicken smelly not good waitress an excellent service but it's not her fault management they don't care and I did not see any manager to come to apologize for the lousy food they serveThe cashier acting like a manager but she have no clue what's going on after I left outside in the parking lot and people complaining about this cashier she wasn't friendly she act like she's the owner or the manager but we found out she's just a cashier anyhow is best service bad food I will not recommend it especially the chicken

A good friend recommended this place so we wanted to try it out..It was a Friday night and the crowd was pretty well managed thanks to the staff who had a good handle on estimating the timeframe for seating. They were really organized considering how busy they were.

We especially liked the AYCE (all you can eat) option at $26.99 each, since we usually order at least 4-5 rolls. Service was great, the wait wasn't too bad at all. For just $1 a roll we got Real Crab and it made a difference. Excellent Sushi, Excellent Service.

The recent remodel hasnt helped the staff friendliness. The morning crew is mostly more interested in their next smoke break than working. My most recent visit had a long time morning employee bring my tray out and drop it on the table and say "Here you go!"  I am just glad I already had my drink or I would have been wearing it.
The owner (Mr Eugene Krabs) is so cheap he doesnt even have napkins out for guests. You basically have to hope someone puts some in your bag or on your tray.
It is a shame because it is a great location. Too bad such crappy service is given.
Go only for convenience. Dont expect even somewhat decent service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: When checked in, we saw that the hotel was hosting a German Shepard dog event. The dogs barked both nights until at least midnight. Our room was dirty, there was mold growing in the shower, the bathroom ceiling had water damage and looked like it would fall, the shower either ran scalding hot  or freezing water.  When we came back to the room, our door was wide open even though we had a do not disturb sign. Also, the room hair dryer started smoking and caught on fire. Not a place I would recommend or stay at again!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Hadn't been here in at least 5 years...used to go all the time, but now when I'm in SB go across the street to Via Vai (same owners?).

Ambiance, service were all excellent.  Crowd feels very moneyed and east coast...think Greenwich.

Unfortunately, the food was pretty poor.  Both of us had pasta - my bolognese had a weird taste...I finished it mainly because I was famished.  Other dish never came together - special of shrimp, tomatoes, fava beans with a doughy, unpleasant fresh pasta.

Affogato was similarly uninspired.  

Won't be back.

Tonight I made an order online, which the online coupon did not apply. I waited the designated time as where the online "tracking" system was not accurate about. As I received my food, I was not provided a receipt, which I did not receive an email receipt either. The delivery driver proceeded to not offer myself change or a receipt. Once opening my food boxes I was displeased with the quality of my food. My pizza and appetizers were soggy, toppings falling off and just sloppily made in general.
This was my first time ordering from this company/location and it will certainly be my last.
NEVER AGAIN!!

Amazing!!  We have walked by this soo many times shopping in this center and it is always packed!  Today for lunch we decided to try it!  You seat yourself and we sat next to a couple who LOVE the place and eat here weekly!  They said everything is good, but the garlic wings are a favorite!  
We had calzone that was sooo huge and so amazing!!  The garlic sauce on the wings I used for the calzone!   Sooo great!  The staff is wonderful very friendly and helpful.  The chef made me more sauce so I could have more for the calzone:):)
We will be back!  Thank you Joey's!!

My boyfriend and I love eating here, unfortunately we had a bad experience here this time around. Upon ordering take out we had ordered a side order of noodles and a small steak plate and we found a shrimp shell in our noodle plate! Absolutely ridiculous, i spit it out and it was an awful experience, our order did not consist of any shellfish at all. We live quite a bit away from Sushi Cafe but we make the drive anyways, but upon calling the restaurant to bring this to their attention and asked for a refund they asked for us to bring it in. We are frequent customer but have been let down this time around.

It's an airport bar, so it's what you'd expect. It was decent but nothing great food for twice what it should be. I was hoping to relive my Philly cheesesteak magic, but no dice with the buffalo chicken cheesesteak (I guess that should have been my first clue.) The blue cheese on the side tasted like ranch with some blue cheese chunks thrown in. The fries were a nice texture, but fairly flavorless. 

There was a good beer list and the service was very prompt. If I were back at the airport on a long layover I might go back but I'd maybe stick to the appetizers.

Honestly don't know what the fuzz is all about. Had dinner here over the weekend and was very disappointed. Yes the service is great but that's about it. The appetizer was so mediocre!!! I ordered a special which was some meat board and it was terrible, I could get the same stuff at a regular market. Then to top it off the board came with 4 small pieces of bread so when I ordered extra bread I got charge for it! Unreal. And for the entrees, I had pasta with veal meat. Must say nothing special there. My advice is don't get the appetizer that is a meat board. Not worth it.

No mini fridge was such a bummer.. and $19.99 for a breakfast buffet that consists of everything other hotels usually give you for free. I've been to seedy motels that have done better than this. I've had flat rate brunches in NYC that included booze for less than this. Insane.  Oh, there are waffles in addition to fruit and cereal? Waffles do not cost $19.99.  

If I splurged for a "nice" hotel, I expect extra amenities and perks- not just a fancy entranceway and complimentary flavored water.

I'm SO disappointed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Waited for an ice cream cone for 15 minutes while employee at the drive-through was sitting there on her phone. Woman standing next to me was waiting for over 20 min for her meal. Another lady I feel bad for her she was so old and she was waiting for her meal for over 30 minutes before she even got her cups for soda. Very unprofessional. I've worked at McDonald's before I know damn well you're not supposed to have your phone out during your shift.  Next time might as well jump behind the counter and make it myself. I give this restaurant zero stars if I could
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I'm a Hilton Honors Diamond member and with that status I generally get good service and a great experience.  Not this time.  

I was able to check in a little early which was about the only positive of the stay.  The room was dirty, crumbs on the floor.  Tub/shower liner was discolored and moldy.  

The bar was never open for service.  Breakfast service was poor quality and poor service.  I watched the cook touch his face, wipe his apron then reach in the bacon bin with his bare unwashed hands and put it on food plates.  

This place is not clean, not healthy, I won't be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Small, crowded. Hipster Mexican, but really quite excellent if a bit pricey. Made a reservation and arrived on time to be told I'd have to wait. They comped me a Guac and Chips (really good Guac) the chips were different, a mix of corn, veggie and plantain but a nice compliment to the guacamole. 

Entree was the Carne Asada, smallish portion but flavorful. The homemade corn tortillas were quite nice, but small as and very delicate so it took two to make a taco-like bite. 

Definitely recommended 4.5 stars. The whole menu is an interesting take on classical Americanized Mexican (emphasis on the latter). Go. Eat. Enjoy. 

Make a reservation.

I had not been back to Vivace in 20 years since I moved from Tucson. I happily have visited twice in two years and finally made it back here with a friend for lunch. I had seafood soup and she had a salad with chicken. We both were very happy with our food choices. We had the mint chip gelato(one is large enough to share), made at Vivace, which was delicious! I don't know if it was due to being seated on the patio, but service was a bit slow although our server seemed to be working constantly and we were purposely there after prime time lunch service. Nevertheless, I'll definitely return.

The place looks good, they have private sitting area and all that but their food is not that great. 
Went there with my friend couple months ago, because it was Monday and sushi on oracle was closed. 
We had shrimp tempura, soft shell crab, and couple of rolls (don't remember what kind some kind of spicy roll). The spicy roll was not eatable. It tasted like hot mayo with fish, it really sucked. could not even have more than a piece. Although we told the waitress that it was not eatable, she just smiled and ignored us. 
Not gonna go back.

We decided to give this place a try and did so without checking yelp first. I'm GLAD we did because the previous reviews would have kept us from a good dining experience! Like other reviewers, I didn't care for the garlic knots or the "Caesar" salad. However, I found the service to be very friendly and attentive. Our glasses were never less than half full. The Fettuccine Alfredo was wonderful. Since the previous reviews were from quite a while ago, I have to believe that they've made significant improvements. We'll definitely come back!

cheesy room at very high price.  TV mounted funny over a desk behind a wardrobe, couldn't run the controller from the bed.  wall mounted air conditioner ground away all night, more like a motel 6 kind of place.  welshed on a  "free" van ride and spoiled a two day trip because the van driver wouldn't drive on the freeway ( two lanes would be a county road in CA).  room choices included a view of the soccer field (best), busy street, or the fire station and a weed lot next to the air port landing zone.  Bistro bar tender would make a great general manager he was very helpful, i'd give him 5 stars.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A great spot, came during restaurant week and they had a specialty menu. It's a small kitchen and dining area, but with a great atmosphere. Server was very accommodating for our group of 7. Ordered the buffalo mozzarella, shaved brussels salad, short-rib for dinner, and a cannoli to end the evening. A very very good meal, not a dish put in front of me that I didn't enjoy. The only reason I didn't give a 5 star rating was because the meal didn't amaze me. I would recommend this place to anyone, and would definitely go back again.

Poor quality and not sure how this is considered authentic. Got lots of Mexican food experience from L.A to Texas  and this is by far subpar by long shot. Gave it three tries with different items on menu and not impressed. Service is poor as well. See the server twice- 1st to give you reheated chips and salsa and 2nd to give you the food and doesn't return till you go find them and ask for the check. Very unfortunate since there aren't many restaurant options nearby feathersound and had high hopes when they opened. Lesson learned never again.

No Wifi. If wifi is important to you & yours this is NOT the place to stay. If u don't want wifi - then this is a great hotel. Also if u think you'll just use your phone as a hotspot - NOPE - the signals are too weak in the rooms. Wifi here goes out the minute you try to use it. It's the old bait & switch wifi - "Oh great I've got a strong signal" until u try to do anything then the signal drops immediately. In 2016 who'd want to get online anyway. Rooms are nice & the "free" breakfast - u get what u pay for there which is not good.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I ran my new black Blazer through this car wash about a month ago and was very impressed with how it came out. I was able to go over it a microfiber towel and it looked great. Fast forward to yesterday and so disappointed! After waiting to specifically come back to this car wash, I had to go through TWICE and still didn't take any dirt off the driver's side.  The cleaning brushes barely touched the side. Maybe the employees need to check the machines if people come back through because the wash isn't cleaning.  Super disappointed,  got it wiped down but took an hour out of an already busy day that should have been much quicker.

In my opinion, you have 2 choices of food when dining out: poor quality and great quality. There isn't really anything in between these days.

So glad to have found this place on Yelp. I travel for work, and rely heavily on Yelp reviews. 

Farm and Fisherman had the best, most knowledgable staff! The beers were great, the food was fantastic and the prices were on par with that farm to table style of food. All of their food is locally sourced, which is great! I think their beers could be a tad cheaper ... Mainly because I want more 

Get dessert.

I really like this place and it's super convenient however the last few times I have gotten food to go I have received (and paid for) extra items in my bag. I got home and did the math / looked up their online menu and it's become quite frustrating. Now I feel like I need to know exactly what I am going to order in advance and do the math beforehand so this doesn't happen yet again. A order of yellowtail is only $5.50 so I missed it upon ordering several items, but I am also a local and want to feel good about giving restaurants my business. Something smells fishy.

This spot offers omakase style sushi preparation. The chef is a former Mori Moto chef and comes with much sushi experience. 
The service is great.
The presentation is lovely.
The fish is a fresh. There are more exotic and hard to get dishes abs fish that I tried here for the first time.
I was not completely full when Dinner was done and wanted a little plate cleaner. 
The price is somewhat outrageous. A meal for 2 was $500 we had to omakase and 1.5 glasses of sake each.
I think the price is just too much for the quality of fish and minimal variety of flavors. I've had better omakase for way less. I won't be back.

Three stars for atmosphere/service, house salad,pasta fagiole, limoncello & tiramisu. With this being said it was very busy and difficult to hear anyone at my table and our main courses were just meh. I had the eggplant with "homemade spaghettini" ... this was HORRIBLE.
