The eggplant was soggy, mushy, watery and covered in cheese and just gross. The "fresh pasta" was not home made.  We also had meatballs with spaghettini and it also was just ok.  We will consider giving this restaurant another try with different entree's.

This was probably some of the best sushi I've had in a while!

The restaurant is really small and I would highly recommend that you make a reservation. Once we walked in, we were seated immediately. We got the yellowtail sashimi, Starving hand rolls, toro hand roll, scallops, and a bowl. Everything was delicious except for the bowl. I'd give it a 3/5 bc it was a bit dry and the pork cutlets were alright. However, everything else was *chef's kiss*. I fish was so fresh and smooth. The service was also great! The staff was very attentive and the food came out quick! Will most definitely be back!

Ordered:
Cheese pizza - medium
Pepperoni & sausage pizza - large
40 wings with multiple sauces  
Steak Stromboli - small

Tasted great!! Glad to finally find a good pizza place to order from. We are new to the area so we have been trying different spots. Nino's will definitely be our go to from now on. 

We ordered through DoorDash so the bill was quite steep. The 15% service fee is a bit higher than the 10% most others charge. Total was $111.79 after food, tax, delivery charge, service fee, and tip. Will probably pick the food up next time.

I went for an early dinner tonight, haven't been there before. I like the atmosphere. Service was friendly and pretty good, although we did have a few minutes of empty drinks. Unfortunately, the food just wasn't worth the cost. I got a prime rib dinner ($20) and ordered it rare. It was medium well, dry, and didn't have much flavor. The twice baked potato was nothing to write home about. My husband said the burgers tasted like they were from in n out. So save yourself some mula and go there. If you don't have better choices, just don't expect too much. It wasn't horrible, just not very good.

My wife Lori and I have lived here at Waterfront for a month and a half.  We are transplants from the Bay Area and we are thoroughly enjoying living here.  As others have said, the management routinely sponsor activities here involving food, exercise, and meet-n-greets for residents.  The staff, Heather, Sonny, Tony, Destiny, and others seem to always go out of their way to make us as comfortable as possible.  If you are in need of an outstanding apartment in a fantastic location, I would highly recommend you visit and consider making Waterfront at the Marina apartments your home!

Jeff and Lori Harvey

Have been longing to try this new place. The interior and decor are almost the same as the previous Domain Hudson. It was a Friday at 5pm, we were the first table except the people at the bar area, but the waitress seems busy. I love the soups, but a bit on the salty side for me. My husband love the Thai chili wings, and my two little girls love the wings too despite the fact that their mouths were on fire  I like the appetizers more than entrees, but everything is too sweet for me, especially the Korean salmon and meatloaf.

This place came recommended and I can't say that I will follow suit. 

Last Friday night I ordered 2 large pizzas, 1 plain cheese and the other a white pizza with spinach and garlic. Requested thin crust for both. 

Both were as bland as the day was long. Crusts were doughy and floppy. Cheese pizza was greasy. Both were way under seasoned and flavorless. 

2 were ordered to feed 6 guys and each only had 1 piece. No seconds. Had more than 1 pizza plus left.
$28.87 and we pitched the remaining slices. That says it all.

A buch of racist ppl work here. Walked in no one greeted me. A white lady walkes in every one (baristas)told her welcome. I was next in line the barista/cashier finished the order with the customer told them thank you, turned around and start3d to make them their order. I wad standing there for 5 min made eye contact with two other baristas and felt like they were looking right thru me. The barista/cashier that was making the order to the two customers that had just paid turned around looked at me and loked away. Damn never coming to this starbucks again. Been a gold member since 2014

From a Titanium Elite Bonvoy member.   This property does not hit the mark.   Ran out of hot water, nobody answering at the front desk.   Let it ring 15 times twice.    Low water pressure on 10th floor.  Not sure the staff here understands the level of care required by Titanium level guests.  Stay here if there are no other properties available.   Surrounding neighborhood a bit sketchy.   Gave an extra star because the restaurant food is excellent.   Food at the Concierge level club was average, but the service at the club was great!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went in for a pedicure ( it has been months for me) with my daughters and as soon as I entered the greeter was rude. After waiting about 2min I was called back by another tech. I told her I wanted a gel pedicure she looked at me like I'm stupid as if I was causing her more trouble to do it. I got fed up and told her never mind just do polish. As she started my feet she started talking to her co-worker and laughed. Then they had my young daughters wait just for polish change. After boot done they told they didn't have time. This was very rude to me and I won't be coming back.

The people are nice, but the rooms have thin walls and the WiFi was spotty when we were there.  The soap dispenser in the shower was empty and on a Saturday night at 7pm, we had to wait 45 minutes to get the room.  If I hadn't walked up to the counter, the lady, who was nice and polite, would have forgotten to give me my room key.  They try here, but they have some work to do to be a 4 or 5 star hotel.   Oh, one more thing - the flashing/seizure causing smoke detector (right above the bed) is quite the nuisance.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Great drinks and appetizer place with an even better atmosphere! Perfect date night place. Its decorated in dark, moody colors that lends to an intimate, romantic atmosphere. The chairs are extremely comfortable, an added plus. My husband ordered a sazerac and said it was really good. We split the pimento cheese and it was one of the best we've ever had! It seems to be pure pimento cheese with delicious spices, not like the traditional dip but in a good way! We loved this place and would absolutely recommend it!

Went here on a weeknight, we were 2/4 people in the place. Walking in, we weren't greeted and kind of awkwardly found a table ourselves. We weren't sure if we had to order at the bar or if we would have a waiter. The service was really slow and awkward. 

We ordered 2 salads and the Venice pizza. The salads were delicious and fresh. The pizza crust was too thin for the amount of toppings and everything fell off. But the ingredients were really fresh and it didn't taste bad, just hard to eat.

Overall, we might try this place again for takeout or delivery...definitely never dining in again, though!

Well if you are looking for all the garbage employees that were fired from ijji 3 look no further.  4 tables of 2 and 1 person at the bar.........3 waitresses and the service is terrible! When you fill out the order slip they don't bother to inform you that half of what you ordered is out of stock. No albacore, calamari, tuna, unagi, or crab. This place has fallen so far down the hill it's now off the map. Not kidding here folks don't waste your money or time here!This place was once a great establishment, those days are Long Gone!

Since they've remodeled this Ralph's, it's so fun to shop there! This is my go to grocery store and I feel like I'm in here at least a couple times a week. The staff here are always so friendly and helpful and it makes shopping so much more enjoyable. I also like it because it never gets super busy which is nice and I'm a person that doesn't like to be around a lot of people so this is a great thing for me! They have a redbox out front so you can rent movies as well and the deli makes great sandwiches! Their desserts are amazing and overall, just a really great grocery store!

I had a reservation for a specific time.  When we went through the rental process to pick up the car...we got through the entire process and only then got informed I was put on a waiting list for a car!  While this was not right, I ended only having to wait 7-8 minutes.  Others waiting for bigger vehicles were really upset.  Checking out the car in the garage and checking back in was good plus.

It doesn't matter the company, why is renting a car so painful and slow?  The industry needs shook up dramatically.  Next time I just might Uber.

First time ever coming here. Would give a 3.5/5. I got a burger and fries- the burger had barely any flavor but the fries and ranch were good. The rum runner (first time ever getting that) tasted like old orange juice and old cheap pineapple juice. I didn't even know that was In it until I looked it up when I got home. They didn't have a drink menu.. Although there Long Island ice teas are delicious! The service was good and great atmosphere .  I loved that I could take my 5.5 yo daughter here and she could dance in the corner while I drank. And the waitress' cheered her on. Will def return here for another drink and a quick bite.

Give this family owned place a try. Totally worth the price. I'm keeping my fingers crossed that they succeed given the last few places that have been in this location (O'Charley's and am Asian buffet). Great decadence inside as well. Try the items on the back of the menu which are all family inspired recipes. Pozole was amazing. Good chips and salsa as well albeit a little unusual to have to pay for this. You won't be disappointed ...this part of Carmel deserves a good locally owned restaurant, and this place answers that need.

I came here for a gel mani/pedi last week. The upside of this nail salon was that it was not busy during the day on a Friday, and they were able to do my mani and pedi at the same time. My nails looked fine initially. I'm only rating two stars because my gel manicure started to chip five days after and the entire polish from two of my fingers completely fell off. At other salons, my gel manicure generally lasts around two weeks. In this case it wasn't even one week. 

Since there are so many options in manayunk to have your nails done, I wanted to post this so someone else doesn't waste money on nails that won't last.

I ate here the first week I moved to Lansdale. I was the only one in the place, the person serving me was not friendly whatsoever. He would put stuff down and rush off. The sushi was too big, just too big and too fishy tasting. I have eaten in so many sushi places al over NYC (where I'm originally from) and know what quality sushi tastes like. This is not it. There is also such a limited amount of sushi. I would say if you don't care too much about the quality this is the place for you, if you do... for the price you could get way better sushi in philly.

My first time here, I went in with 5 of my friends and they were easily able to accommodate us which was nice. We did make an appointment ahead of time. The nail techs were friendly and did a good job, my gel mani was $30 which is pretty cheap in my opinion, so I was happy. 

However, gel manis usually last 2.5 weeks or more for me, but this one started peeling only a week later! I was really surprised because that's never happened to me that early.

Then I went back to my hometown to my usual nail place and got a gel mani and it's lasted a super long time.

I don't know why this place has gotten such good reviews. We came on a Thursday night and ordered the "Orange flavor" chicken. It took forever for our food to come out. Then a customer came in with some food he had been given that was not his. We were the only people still waiting on our food- it was obviously ours. They took it to the back, put it on plates and brought it to us. The "orange flavor" chicken had what tasted like orange flavored styrofoam in it... That flavored the chicken?- i guess. The chicken was overcooked and tough- not good at all. Needless to say a total disappointment.

My mom has been going to this salon for her acrylics and gel polish for about a year, and has never had any complaints. However, the last 3-4 times she's gone her nails are chipped within a day! Not even just a little chip, but completely peeling off of multiple nails. She went back to have them fixed once, and the same thing happened again! I think something is wrong with their UV light or polish. Gel shouldn't be chipping or peeling at all, and this has happened multiple times. After reading the reviews she's decided to try out Happy Nails instead.

Definitely not the same quality standard as most Sheraton Hotels. The halls feel dark, and the room I stayed in, though not awful, had noticeable wear issues, not to mention the (sole) light in the outer room being broken.

They also set me up with the latest hotel scan offered as a 'service', the Green service, which they failed to explain meant that they provide no housekeeping services to you for the length of your stay.

I'm all for conservation by not changing sheets/towels every day. But eliminating housekeeping service is simply a way for the hotel to cut their costs/staff without passing any savings on to the consumer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I've always had my vehicles done here and they're traditionally a top-notch car wash center.  Went in 2/16/2020 and was hoping to have my SUV done like they've done in the past.  To my dismay, I saw where they have apparently removed the rotating tire washing brushes.  The vehicle came out clean but the tires were still filthy.  I was so aggravated, I didn't even bother asking someone, afraid I may say something I'd regret.  Needless to say, they lost their tip and possibly my future business.  
Very disappointing.

Only my thoughts on the pizza: Maybe as good as papa johns or dominos. Upon first glance, it was a grease pit. So much so that the bottom of the box was moist with the excess seeping through. The crust is rubbery and chewy and oddly sweet. It was like biting into store bought hawaiian rolls. Just had a plain pepperoni, and the sauce and topping were both average at best, if they were legitimately good, the gallons of grease and sweet chewy crust masked it. Objectively mediocre, palatable, I guess, but there's a million better pizzas in this town. No reason to order this one.

Awful. Order took forever because they simply didn't care. It wasn't the driver's fault. They told me  what I've seen in person...a bunch of lazy people with orders they didn't care about. Had to cancel, which screws over the driver. 

Same happened at the other BK on Columbus. Maybe it's the pandemic, but other burger places have adjusted. These BKs are just crap. Even if you do get your food eventually, it's cold and disgusting. Honestly, I do like a whopper, but I suggest avoiding all local BK's until they get their act together. Too bad.

Just tried them out for first time. I believe they just opened where Hellas used to be. We got the Mac and cheese which was delicious. I really hope a place like this will stick around for a while. 

The owner was extremely friendly and she puts a lot of care in the food and the decor. The donuts were absolutely amazing. Some of the best I've ever eaten. She does have online ordering through their website which is great for COVID times. Excited be able to dine in when the pandemic is over and especially to have those donuts again!

The worst experience of hibachi I've ever had. The sushi was great after I finally got it. The waitress didn't pay attention to our drinks and they were empty for about 15 min. The chef asked how I'd like my steak I told him rare and my fiancé said medium rare. As I'm watching him cook this I can tell he didn't understand so I told him 3 more times and he STILL messed it up. At that point my 4 month old was crying and I walked out. As I walked past the front desk I told the manager I'm sure he was more in shock because I was pretty upset but he didn't say anything. As many of my friends have talked this place up I will never return.

The staff (valet, front desk and bellhop) were all fine.  The property is dated (80's fab lobby). The room was a WTF? Did I walk on set of a horror movie?  So much filth! The chair in the room used to be red. Now it's a grimy, greasy black on the seat and armrests.The cheap, veneer furniture was damaged.  The bathroom ---hell no! The carpet is a health and safety hazard. No wifi or refrigerator.  I took a 2 hour nap after checking for bed bugs and checked out.  Decided I'd rather drive all night than stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Enterprise Rental in Bensalem tried to accuse me of creating damage to one of their rental cars (which I never did). Ed LeVan and Chris Ross at Rob's Automotive went out of their way by reviewing hours/days of surveillance footage and phone recordings to prove I didn't cause the damage that I was being accused of. Due to their diligence, they found plenty of evidence to support my innocence, and shady Enterprise dropped their charges. 

Thank you Collision Shop! It's nice that there's still some good people in this world!!!

I will definitely give 5 stars to this company. This is my first time to wash my car here. ( also the 1st time to automatically car wash service ) I even do not know the procedures.  Then a guy came to me. Wear the mask and help me to use the screen to choose service, and explained all the steps patiently. They have a huge square to self vacuum cars. No rush no harsh. When I wipe my car use the towel. I found the machine did a great job. I drove on the snowing night and stay it for almost 2 weeks, but all the dirt stains are disappeared. I am so happy to wash my car there.

PROs Easy check in process with the app. Very cute coozy 

CONS The app does not list menu items missing until you're trying to confirm an order and even then, it's most frustrating. I placed 4 unsuccessful orders till my helpful server informed me that rice was unavailable for the rice bowl!
I wish this had been made evident on the menu since we had our heart set on the rice bowl.
Since it's an app, this is easy to fix and it's shameful that they can't be bothered to.
I also received an additional 1 dollar charge that is unsolicited and unattributed on my credit card

If you want your deposit stolen, book here. My family was trying to get there deposit back. And was told that the front desk lady stole there money and they fired her for it.  They then proceed to tell them that they won't be giving them the money. What kind of business let's employees steal and then don't give the money back. Not only that but they constantly kick people out who are paying the daily ratés. Then they want to call the police and ban you for being upset about not getting your money back. Management should be prosecuted for theft.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: A let-down! We went there last Saturday night with husband, son, and son's girlfriend and ordered apps and pizzas. I expected something that was better than what was delivered. The pizzas were only fair, but very expensive. If you are going to charge me almost $20 for a personal size mushroom pizza, it had better be special. This was not! The restaurant was not very crowded, but boy was it noisy. In order to get me back, the owners must do something about the noise level as well as the too high prices. I can go else where for better pizzas at a lower cost! I had high hopes for this establishment.

My reservation was for 8:30. They seated me at 9:15. Once seated, they brought me a complimentary albacore tuna crudo which was okay, and definitely the best dish of the night. I ordered the truffle tasting menu, which had no vegetables, was overwhelmingly rich, and no dessert for $69. Every course was below my standard for quality, taste, and execution. It's a shame because the menu sounded amazing. The wait staff clearly saw that I barely ate any of my courses, but never sent the chef out or the manager out to discuss it with me. Will never return.

I usually go to this car wash twice a month. Today, at the  station I was instructed by an employee Jeff to wait... yet he allowed 3 other white drivers to go ahead. I asked him why, did he make me wait and let the other cars go, he then said I could go now. I proceeded to leave the pay station to take my business else where, when Jeff decided to say some derogatory words. I drove away and went to Tommy's Express. Managers, if you want customers to stay, get someone that represents your company well.  Not only was Tommy Express faster and polite, but there was no one waiting around to see who was worthy or unworthy to get a car wash.

I would rate the quality of work they have done on my hair but unfortunately I have not even made it past the first step of booking an appointment. Every time I have called, a lady named Sandy answers and not only does she sound very hostile and bored over the phone but she is never very willing to be helpful or accommodating. It got to the point where I was afraid to call the salon because every time I talk to her it seems as if I'm putting her out and inconveniencing her. I know there are super nice stylists there but this woman alone made me just give up trying and instead take my business elsewhere.

Not only did this place have amazing customer service, but they also had an equally amazing product. I loved the story behind their Popsicles. The location was great because you are in Hyde Park. 

They had a very large variety and ranged from alcoholic popsicles to organic juicing Popsicles. They utilized a lot of different flavors and had many no sugar added options.they even had options that included vegetables like carrots and Kayle in their Popsicles. 

I highly suggest anyone who is a fan of fruit, Popsicles, ice cream, or enjoying something refreshing during a hot day to try this establishment.

Worst cocktailing experience I've ever had. The Manhattan was no where near prepared properly (I'm a bartender and server). It looked and tasted like watered down orange juice and didn't even have a cherry. When I ordered a replacement drink I found fresh pink lipstick on the lip of the glass (from our server!) I even still had to pay for the drink. All of this while our phantom of a waitress visited our group maybe once every ten to fifteen minutes and rolled her eyes as she did so. First time sending a drink back and first time writing a review. Deplorable service. Stay away!

Horrible. Staff during return were rude, blamed us for existing damage on vehicle, kept us waiting with a toddler for over thirty minutes while they "processed" the return (and didn't tell us what was going on) then lied to us, saying that they would honor the original contract... but then charged us $500 more without telling us. Now I'm trying to dispute it with the credit card company, but it was an awful experience all the way around with Alamo, I would look elsewhere for a car rental, even if it's a few more bucks per day.

As a female.. I normally am hesitant to take my car to shops because I normally feel I am going to get taken advantage and get charged more since I dont know anything about cars. But not at Auto Works of Brandon! They were fantastic, Its not every place that has a person that is qualified to look a hybrids. They were! I felt comfortable and the techs were so helpful. I truly trust them and will recommend them to all my girl friends! The owner was super helpful and so were the techs at diagnosing the problem and giving me options and the cheapest solution. A Plus! Great Service! I will definitely keep coming back!

Like others say This the real deal. I did 4 of their tacos @ a $1.99 fabulous, reminded me of when I was stationed in San Diego. I does take a bit of time to get your food, but that became totally acceptable when I saw what I got. Just looking at the meat told me this going to be exceptional. Homemade corn tacos rocked. The place has little ambiance,bottled or canned drinks are from a cooler. There sauce was a little on the tame side. I will ask for a side of salsa next time. The waitress very nice lady spoke little English.. 
I could not have asked for a better Mexican Food Experience.

Al D. is keeping a fine tradition going. He's a second generation old school barber with old world charm, who gives a great haircut at very reasonable prices.  

Al and his father before him have been cutting hair for families in the Greater Narberth Metro Area now for generations.  I've been going there for close to 4 decades. 

During the holidays Al serves his homemade wine, in the fine family tradition, as his father did before him.  Al Sr. used to play the accordion for his adoring,  well-cropped fans.

Thumbs up for Al!

Food was excellent, love that it's built to your liking. Super friendly service was even offered sample of soups. Only gave 4 stars because luckily there was only one person ahead of us inside (not including drive thru) and it seemed to take a long time for them to build our burrito and bowl. Slow but very accurate which is a good thing when building a burrito I suppose....nothing worse than a sloppy uneven burrito! So I guess thats not a complaint but there was quite a line behind us by the time we got our order. I will be back next time I am in the area! Great chips and queso and guacamole!

Wow, I too had the same experience as the 2 previous reviewers had. Bought a groupon type coupon for the most expensive option. The owner/stylist was 10 minutes late; gave me  orange highlights which I ended up having to pay extra for; hair was razored and I've honestly never seen anything as hideous as the cut she gave me; took almost 5 hours for what should have taken 2 1/2 max; and she dropped the "f" bomb constantly which is incredibly unprofessional. Definitely would not recommend and would have loved to have had these reviews before I had purchased me coupon.

Ordered at the app for walk-in p/u today.. the guy at the store responded so rude.. i was nice enough to ask if my order for p/u items are the ones on the table i saw  far left side from where im standing at; i was standing at a counter where the sign says "pick-up".. & he responded, " you ordered donuts & munchkins, right?! So thats it.." & his look was like pissed?! Really?!.. go change your sign guys coz its confusing.. i will always confirm coz i will never p/u items which might not be mine..& pls be pleasant.

Truly as good as it gets. 
I chose this place based on the raving yelp reviews and it was everything I hoped for. The salon was easy to find and has nice, relaxing atmosphere. Roxy took me in right away, listened carefully to the struggles I was having with my hair, and delivered exactly what I wanted. She was absolutely delightful to work with and gave me great recommendations on how to keep my hair healthy in between visits. I felt relaxed, pampered, and well taken care of.
Plus, this place is VERY reasonably priced. I will happily go back and recommend others do the same!

Dr. Baker is hands down one of the best veterinarians I have worked with. Our dog coco loves to see everyone in that office and is treated with kindness every time. Coco has had some medical problems this past year and I must say that Dr. Baker not only went above and beyond, she even texts us after hours to make sure coco was doing ok. If you are looking for the best vet in Reno, I would recommend Dr. Baker to anyone! Five star service, staff and most important the caring of our four legged family members! Thanks again Dr. Baker and staff!!!

First I had to get someones attention to take my order, I had to repeat it 3 or 4 times to get it correct. Returned from filling the drinks, lady mopping the floor ask;s what I'm waiting for. I show her the order number.

She props the mop against a drink machine, and starts to pack my food without first washing her hands. I tried to get her or the managers (standing 3 feet away) attention before touching anything to do with the food.

People should not be mopping floors and working the cash register and also handling food before touching any food.

The manager just shrugged it off like it's no big deal.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Poor service.   And always out of donuts.   I have used this location several times and I will never go back after today's events.   As I walk up to the register I was ignored and the cashier walked away the other cashier proceeded to take other customers that age behind me then gave me an attitude as I was the next person in line.   Then to top it off they have no glazed donuts vanilla donuts etc.  How can you not have donuts really people and to to it off they were not even fresh.   I will stick to the local shops from now on like alvernon donuts or donut wheel.   Sorry dunkin I am done with you. ..

The Airport locations has a Phenomenal staff. I have been renting vehicles there for over 20 years. I have yet to have a bad experience. On my most recent rental (March 2021), I had the honor of being serviced by "ASHLEY". She is the epitome of "World Class" customer service. She ensured that my vehicle  was in the correct class. She accommodated me for the delay in my rental that morning. She really "cared"!!! I unequivocally vouch for "ASHLEY" and the Airport location. Thank you and much love from Yusuf Abdullah.

This restaurant is very mediocre. We have recently enjoyed exquisite Italian cuisine and were quite eager to try Aldo's since it has such a great patio and looks so charming from the street. Sadly, we were disappointed by what is to be our first and last meal there. Our server was very polite and thorough, however the food killed the experience. From the caesar salad through the end of our two meals, everything was simply average. After talking with a few people, we have also discovered that this restaurant has a reputation of mediocrity.  Save your money and go somewhere that the food can hold its own!

The staff is short handed & rude. Had to dry my own car off by opening the car doors and wipe all the jams down. The rude cashier was to busy on a personal call with his earbuds in to answer a few questions about the services.  They don't use enough water when they rinse off your car but charge you extra for an SUV. Even while driving away no water sprayed from the side view mirrors. The car was still covered in foam when it came out of the blower area. I've been to this chain before in other parts of SJ & never experienced such a poor performance. One star is way to many for this place.

I have been here several times and have always enjoyed the food and the service.  Today was an warm fall day and so a friend and I decided to have lunch on the patio. The patio is covered but normally open on all sides but one, and thus well-ventilated and much more COVID-safe than indoor dining. But today we arrived to find that the previously open sides of the patio had been covered in plastic. Such a disappointment since this      makes the patio just as bad or worse than indoor dining in terms of COVID safety.  It completely ruins a great dining location for those of us who are still taking the pandemic seriously.

Have an unlimited Ultimate package.     Ran through the wash and received the downgraded Works instead of what I pay for.   Can back to the line to complain and got a very snotty attitude from the kid.   Wasn't willing to help.  Said the numbers must have gotten mixed up and he wasn't dealing with it.    I have noticed this downgrade sometimes in the last but haven't said anything.   (Are the cheating people?)     The manager also wasn't much help.   We ran through the wash again and didn't get a full wash.   May have to cancel the membership.

Enterprise is a great rental car company and I have been pleased to use them for over 20 years but this location on Leverington Ave. in Philadelphia should be avoided at all costs.  I had to extend a rental from a Friday drop off to Sunday and was told on the phone that since the location was closed on Sunday that I would have to return it on Monday and that it would be 2 days extra.  When I turned in the car they charged me for 3 days and then the agent I talked to on the phone blatantly lied and said she told me 3 days.  Absolutely no integrity.

My husband and I ate at the Jefferson Grill last night (8/1/15) and the food was great! I had pan seared scallops with a mixture of sautéed squash and zucchini and rice. The scallops were cooked perfectly, tender but not mushy or chewy. The squash was also cooked just right. My husband had Chicken Marsala with the same vegetables that I had.  The chicken was cooked tender and had great flavor. The bread they serve is three different flavored small loaves. I couldn't decide which one I liked the most they were all very good. The restaurant was very clean and so was the bathroom. We are looking forward to eating at Jefferson Grill again.

You get what you pay for. The prices were much cheaper than most. However, my pedicure was rushed and my nails as well. I went with my friend and was sitting in the chair next to her for 10-15 min before someone started my pedicure, but we both were finished at the same time. I got French tips for my mani and pedi and the lines were nothing more than what I can do at home if not worse. Some of the lines were crooked, messy, and just straight across. When I asked for them to be fixed, she completely disregarded me and continued to apply the final top coat. We will not be returning.

On Friday feb 10 I decided to go get my nails done and my cousin wanted a pedi first off they had a lady in there running over ppl feet with the vacuum cleaner then she was mopping the floor while ppl were walking around my daughter almost slipped and fell then she rush and did my nails I was so mad because she didn't take her time and she was talking every rude about other customers who didn't want to wait any longer after she told them it would be ten minutes before somebody could help them I will never be back.....

Went here for breakfast on new years day with a party of 8 people.  We called beforehand to ask if they could handle a group our size and they said no problem, but it took half an hour for the server to take our order, and a full HOUR after that before we actually got our meals.  Not surprisingly the food was cold by then.  The place was not not very full/busy, so I have no idea what took so long.  After we started complaining they apologized a couple times but never really gave a good reason as to why it took so long.  Food was pretty good (but cold).  Would not go back.

The food was delicious, atmosphere great - high energy and busy, always a good sign for a restaurant on a Friday night.  Service was friendly and good, up until we were finished eating. The waiters and host made it blatantly obvious that they wanted us to leave - to a point where the host was standing behind me with fresh linens over his arm the last five minutes we were there. I understand it was a busy night and there were people waiting for a table, but it left us with a negative impression after what was a great dinner.

I just went throigh the drive thru before work and when i got to work to eat my breakfast they didnt give me the hashbrowns i ordered AND paid for. I cant even go back and get it fixed. They charged me for something i ordered and never even gave to me. Their service is terroble all the time and they do not care about giving great service to customers. This is not the first time this has happened. Im done going to this dunkin donuts again and i will take my business else where since they dont have a care in the world.

They have the worst customer service I've ever experienced. You walk in and they want all this paperwork due to Covid snd take your temperature... as if the place had anything clean about it. Absolutely disgusting, dirt and dust all over nothing wiped down and they act like you are the Covid infection as if they don't want you to come in.

If you are wise... STAY AWAY! I will be calling the BBB as well the health department they can pretend with all the antics when you walk in but it's plain nasty. My daughter snd I ended up not staying due to this and how badly two peoples nails/toes looked.

This place deserves 0 stars. Front desk is horrendous. I was "helped" by a  front desk employee Eunice. She was absolutely rude. Not to mention she has absolutely no idea what she is doing. She froze up immediately when asked a simplistic question pertaining to the hotel. This hotel needs more mature, knowledgeable, insightful employees who actually know what they are doing. Please folks save your money and stay at a different hotel! This hotel is not worth your valuable time, and most importantly your money. Hope this review was extremely helpful :)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I stayed at this hotel for a night and it was phenomenal. The room was very clean. The hotel was fairly quiet even though there was many guests staying at the time. The front desk was very friendly and made checking in and out a breeze. Minutes from west Edmonton mall and lots of restaurants and accommodations. 

They do offer complimentary breakfast which includes items such as coffee,tea,cereal, toast, sausages, waffles, etc. Breakfast is served right when you walk into the lobby. It can be fairly busy and may be difficult to find a place to sit so make sure to get down there early. 

Will definitely be staying here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The vets we have seen are great.  The office staff however are awful. Rude, unprofessional, and unorganized. My mom has 2 dogs and I have 3 that have gone to the Pet Doctor on 1st and Glenn. They have lost 5 patients. Everytime we have been there we have had to wait anywhere from 30 minutes to 2 hours. When it was walk in only, the long wait times were to be expected. Since they have gone to appointments the wait times have gotten worse. We had an appointment made and were still waiting outside in the heat for 2 hours. We were never called in and finally left. This location has consideration and are completely unprofessional.

My Wife and I dined there last night. The caprese salad was OK, the 3 slices of cheese and 3 slices of not ripe tomatoes with very little basil was NOT worth the 10.00 . Serving size is not what you would expect for the prices. We had a wonderful server and Vito is a good host. . This is a good place to eat but the cost of this  Italian food is high. I would suggest to the Owner to go family style  to make it more affordable. I left there hungry ,my wife was fine..I would probably eat there again if they were open for lunch. The food is good but not worth the cost. Wish you luck Allegria, Ciao

I always go to this location and have never had a problem. I go here because it's the only place I've found that has fried pickle spears. The food is alway excellent and the service is great. Tonight I went here and was sooooo very disappointed. The grilled chicken sandwich was so dry I couldn't eat it and the fried pickles were so over cooked and the breading was literally fried right off the pickle. The pickle didn't even have any juice left in them because they were so over cooked. I did notice some new people working there so maybe they should learn how to cook before they try working as a cook!

Oh absence makes the heart grow fonder is so true when it comes to the real deal cheesesteak. Hard to believe but I think Nick's is getting even better. I had not been in quite a while and this visit was awesome. Perfectly cooked steak on amazing roll with the hot juice dripping off my chin - moment was cut short when my wife asked me if I was ok as my eyes were shut and I was not even chewing - just blissfully savoring it. 

Maybe I just did not notice before but the menu seemed more expansive than before with pastas, salads, soups. The Italian wedding soup was outstanding!!

You must give this place a try!!

I absolutely adore this place, I live across the street and come here often! The chicken basil sandwich is to die for, and overall the restaurant has a very nice atmosphere. We like to sit on the patio and have a few beverages and play Heads Up. The patio is the bomb diggity in summer. Good prices on drinks, good food, lively atmosphere. Those people who gave negative ratings must have been drunk or have some illness that prevents them from having a good time because I know for certain that this place rocks.

Used to love this place.   What happened?   

First, ordered a house Cab.....response: "no red wines"

Second, The giant vine collection in wall was gone.  Finally they did provide a "red blend"

Third, The signature dish, Short Ribs, was not available.   No crowd, hardly anyone in restaurant at 6pm, how could they run out of a signature dish?

Fourth, Lots of "unavailable or substitutions" on menu and dessert selection

The atmosphere was different.   Not many staff.   Something happened...sliding downhill. 

Will not go back, too many other good places to choose from.    Sad when a great place declines.

Bought a pair of Marc Hunter 7918 Aviator Glasses after my annual eye exam.
The first day I wore them them the left end piece of the frame broke off.
Upon inspection the frames are very cheaply made. There is a facade over the small fragile end piece attach point to make it appear sturdy.
I went back and was told there is no warranty. I asked ; How much will it cost to repair them? I was told they do not fix glasses and that I should try and find a jewelry store to try and solder them.
The replacement pair will be bought at Wal Mart.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
The wait time  at this place is horrible they make you sign in and sit down. They only had one person working there on a Saturday because the other person only did returns and government rentals. We brought in a letter  from our insurance company stating that we were fully covered and the sales rep went ahead and included it in our  fees anyway. I left a message for the manager expecting a call back and they never did. They charged us $22 dollars a day extra anyway. I've never seen a company that allows their employees to take personal phone calls while your in mid conversation with them !!!

Stay away from this place its not worth it.

The pictures on the website are not accurate. The pool is very small and seating is limited. If you are not up to claim a chair early in the morning, you will not get one. The poolside cafe was staffed with two people and took over 30 minutes to receive our lunch. There are no pool or beachside servers. You must go to the single bar and wait in a long line to receive a drink. Beach is on property, but is a walk. Nice sand, rentable chairs and umbrellas are available. Hotel is older but clean. We had a nice stay, but were underwhelmed. We expected more due to the pictures on the website.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
So I have always loved yellow porch and still love it for the food. The burger and celery blue cheese soup are old favorites and the salmon lunch salad is delicious!  But the service consistently stinks. Today they exceeded all my expectations of poor service. 

Evidently it was out server's 2nd day. So some leeway is understandable but we were largely ignored, given whatever sides he felt like giving us (not what we ordered) and left off part of the order. And we had nothing to drink from halfway through the meal forward. 

Whoever is in charge of the server staff PLEASE. Do something.

I am Polish native and crazy picky as far as we speak about things like polish sausage. This guys there, are making in house the polish sausage with the quality I did not had in years! That includes polish sausage made and sold in Poland. They must be using the old good recipes which are proofed and nonsense free. This is delicious, well made, without added water or other fillers ( fry-pan one, to see for yourself ). I honestly recommend this place. The best polish sausage your money can buy. Period. I am absolute fan. And yeah, reasonably priced too !

I come here through Drive-Thu sometimes on my lunch break. "Go ahead with your order" is how they greet you. The black girl in the window always has an attitude. On my receipt her name is Raushanah. She needs some training on how to talk to ppl. Her job is really simple, take the orders and give out the food. It's not rocket science working at a fast food chain. If she doesn't like her minimum wage job she needs to find another. People have jobs that require WORK so the attitude is definitely not needed on someones 30 min lunch break.

This is an older New Orleans Hotel but the rooms are large, updated, and first rate.  Our bathroom was huge and modern with beautiful marble.  The staff was very pleasant and Nick was especially nice.  The 6th floor small patio view and Jacuzzi (no pool on property) were a little disappointing.  The parking is all valets at a fair local price of $27 per day.  The location was perfect - a few blocks from most everything we wanted to do.  Join the Omni guest program online for free wifi, daily paper, and morning coffee.  This was a very nice hotel and a good value.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We were quite impressed with Don Jose's! The chips and salsa were delicious and we got a small queso that was Devine! My sister and I split the grilled chicken Texas Chimichanga which was huge and fabulous! Lots of chicken and grilled vegetables, rice, etc. topped with queso. My daughter had the steak quesadilla which was also fabulous! The three of us shared a prickly pear margarita which was so refreshing!! It is served on the rocks in a bottle! We loved our first experience here and will be back when we come back to town!

This is the bar from Mark Wahlberg's movie "Invincible". People on here will give this place bad reviews bc the Rosewood does NOT cater to the Hipster crowd. These "new type of South Philly residents" expect every bar to be the same and are surprised when any establishment does not welcome  them with open arms ! The Rosewood is one of the few neighborhood bars left for locals. Customers there mind their own business and don't need 70 different beers on tap with a famous chef in the kitchen. It's a place where you can go and just hang with friends...without hearing the loud, politically correct, narcissistic hipsters talking next to you !

My girlfriend and I recently had dinner here. Several of her coworkers raved about it and they were right. The staff was great and the food was delicious. We started with the calamari which was just ok. I had the Chicken Carbonara and my girlfriend had the fettuccini alfredo with blackened chicken. We both though are entrees were delicious. Both our hostess and server were very friendly. Our server checked up on us several times. We will definitely be going back and I encourage all to give Nonna's a try. You won't be dissapointed.

My family and I decided to have dinner here on Christmas. It was absolutely the worst service I have ever experienced in a restaurant. We waited over an hour just to get a glass of water and over two hours to get a cup of soup. We watched people walk out after over 2 hours of no service. One couple even said they come at least once a week and they also left after waiting two hours and never received service. Start to finish I think we were there for four hours. At no point did the waiters apologize or check up on us. We will NEVER go back and I strongly encourage everyone else to never do business with China Royal.

Came to visit a family member must say this place has gone down. Went to the pool a resident there invited 56 ppl from the neighborhood and I mean hood.  No one Comes around to supervise this facility.  One on the kids was waggling the shower I thought it was going to snap it out of the ground. How sad they have extremely poor management.  Someone is urinating behind the stairs in building 5.   trust me anyone can move in there they don't do background ck.  Consider moving here it looks great but it's poorly manage.

I was standing at the front desk patiently waiting to be assisted to request for towels that were never delivered to my room after waiting for 35 min. Then as I walked towards the lady (Nina I believe) to be assisted I was cut in line by a woman and her kids who couldn't decide which chocolate to purchase from the sundry area. Nobody apologized or even acknowledged I was standing right in front of them waiting to be assisted. As an ambassador elite member Ive stayed at numerous locations and I expect better service at a JW property as other Marriott property's provide.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Just tried this location for the first time (I think it's either brand new or recently updated), and the employees were so great! The food was done really quickly, and even with a couple cars ahead of me, I barely had to wait.

The burger & fries I got tasted fresh and were the perfect temperature. Plus, they didn't skimp on fries, ketchup, or napkins. I always forget to ask for ketchup in drive-thrus, but an employee asked if I needed any, so I didn't even have the chance to forget. I didn't catch her name, but I definitely appreciated it. No one likes a dry fry.

All in all, great Burger King trip.

This place is good and basically makes every regular Chinese-American dish you'd find in any takeout place, except the quality is way better and you can tell they use fresher ingredients. Be sure to get the calamari if you are going to get an appetizer and find seafood acceptable. Also, the structures of their dishes are such that you need to SHARE your meal amongst your party -- they give you a very large portion and you're supposed to scoop food from the main plate onto your individual plate. I went with one other person and we ordered two main dishes, not knowing this, and ended up taking home more food than we needed.

The bf and I were visiting Philly for the weekend and we decided on Little Nonna's for dinner to satisfy our Italian cravings. The overall food experience was just okay. 

The stand out was definitely the garlic bread. I loved the combination of grilled bread and whole roasted garlic! Delicious! 

The spaghetti and meatballs was disappointing though. The meatballs were extremely dry and the spaghetti was overcooked. Not a good thing for a restaurant to be named Little Nonna's when it can't put out a good spaghetti and meatball.

We moved to Maple Shade in July and we've gone three times to this place. Everytime I try to order the same thing. TenderGRILLED chicken sandwich. I've received in the bag everything EXCEPT a TenderGRILLED chicken sandwich. They don't seem to understand their own menu. Maybe no one orders it. Maybe grilled and crispy sounds exactly the same to the high school kids that work there... I don't know. All I know is every time I'm sad and disappointed. And this time I even said, "No crispy... grilled..." Still no win...

Ugh.  Where to start.  The Cobb salad was an absolute nightmare.  Overcooked clearly microwaved chicken, some less than  delectable rubbery raw pork thing that we were informed was bacon.  I honestly don't know a caveman could eat such a thing.  On to the second course.... Chicken quesadilla.  The same lifeless chicken with onions haphazardly tossed on a bed of over cooked peppers.  My pallette needed to cleansed after every bite.  I hope that if I return, Timothy will take this to heart. May God have mercy on his soul.

My experience was terrible at Grease Monkey. All I needed was a simple oil change. The workers tried scaring me into buying all sorts of new parts and fluids for my car. I take care of the fluids on my own so I know none of them needed refilling; and my dad (a mechanic) checks out all the insides whenever I'm home visiting. So my car is regularly checked on and taken care of. After numerous attempts of upselling, I finally was able to leave with just a simple oil change. It was a hassle but one I wouldn't want to live through again.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I left Busch Gardens with two hungry kids and went through the drive thru so they could eat before they fell asleep. Needless to say they zonked out before the food came since I sat in the drive -thru for 30 MINuTES!!!  Then when I got my order they were out of hot coco and the girl said is that ok. I said what do you mean is that ok? Then she came up with "would you like anything else" I said "my money back" she said pull up to window 3. I sat there with no assistance. I had to go in after all that to get my money. Luckily I had someone in the car so I could leave my sleeping kiddos. Get it together, isn't this college town?
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This place is great for families, couples and even larger groups (although, get a reservation).  I have had the pizza, calzones, chicken parmigiana, stuffed meatballs, spaghetti, lasagna...it all is wonderful.  The atmosphere is very welcoming and you feel like family.  They also do take out.  Souderton has a car show every year.  I get take out and bring it back to my car and everyone wonders where I got it - just call in an order to Caruso's and then walk over and pick it up.  They give you plastic utensils and napkins.

I have been coming to Persona Fades for at least a year now. A friendly place where the banter is about sports for the most part.  I am used to barber shops where customers are served in the sequence that they arrive by which ever barber is available next. Here , once you have been served by a barber, he will be your barber every time you come in. Marcus is my barber and does a great job every time I come. All the barbers seem to place a lot of effort to please the customers. A clean and friendly barber shop that provides excellent service.

Let's see. I'll start by saying that the fleet car I brought over was pretty dirty. So she said she would charge me extra... not a problem. I was happy to pay extra as long as it got clean. I got in afterwards & noticed that everything was sticky. 
Looks like dirt was just smeared around. Didn't smell good at all. Dash was still filthy, nobs and buttons extra sticky. 

This place is trash guys. Sorry to say. I came here because it was close to where we got the car serviced. I will continue to take all of our company vehicles to Mr car wash. 

Stay away.

I live in area so I have been there numerous times. Today I went there and ordered the new grilled cheese melt. It was disgusting. It was just 2 pieces of bread with cheese. It was like they threw it in microwave to somewhat melt cheese and warm bread. I will NEVER get that again. Also my son got a sausage, egg and cheese croissant. The cheese was cold like it was just thrown on as an afterthought. If I wasn't in a hurry I would have went back but I was unable to. I just hate I spent money on food like that.

My friend went there and had very high hopes for the food due to the amount of people that were in line. He got the special that included 2 meats and one side. He got spicy bourbon chicken and beef & broccoli with a side of noodles. It is said that the spicy bourbon chicken was decent, but the beef tasted "musty". Almost like it had been leftovers sitting around from the day before. The noodles were also very dry and had no flavors/veggies. If you're going to be a mall Chinese restaurant at least do the bare minimum and create satisfactory food for your customers.

I really love this nail salon! I have been to many places around Franklin and this is surprisingly the best yet. It's a family owned business: no showy decorations or coupon offers posted everywhere, unlike other local nail salons. The technicians are incredibly kind and I always receive amazing service. Their acrylic technique is incredible: incredibly thin and natural-looking but still sturdy at the apex. This nail salon is the only one where I see no peeling or chipping on my gel polish, even after 2 weeks. Definitely worth checking out if you live in Franklin!

Dirty and rude staff. I heard it might reopen. Hopefully they will keep it cleaner then the last one. 
Many times before we would eat on the balcony and staff would talk about customers, the boss or each other. Not even trying to hear and it was easy because of the placement. Sorry I asked for a rescoop and gloves. 
I was done with the no gloves, no hand washing. Best was when someone pulled a topping out the sink that was thawing where they were washing dishes and just added it to the belt.

Hopefully the new place will be better if it reopens

If you're going to New Orleans go to Fat Tuesday. The bartenders are super nice and super fast. 

They have reasonable priced daiquiris to purchase and cute little souvenir cups to purchase. I still have my little tumbler I got! 

The only reason I gave this place 3 stars because the drinks are terrible. I mean like kool-aid, sugary terrible. I specifically asked the bartender which were the best/strongest and I tasted many of them and just NO. It's a no from me. Those drinks are WEAK. 

I still recommend going to say you've been. However if you're wanting to sip on something good this ain't the place. Head on over to Tropical Isle!

I ordered twice through the app this week, and both of my flavor shot orders ("unsweetened and sugar free" according to the app) were sweetened. Not a big deal, mistakes happen. So I ordered in person today and specifically asked for a hazelnut coffee with no sugar. The coffee I got was even sweeter than the last two. When I asked for it remade, I was told that hazelnut is only available as a sweetened flavor and, "I can't take sugar out of something that already has sugar in it." Then I was told by the same person that there is an unsweetened version, but I "didn't ask for it." At least they did remake it.

Expect to be ignored unless you go through the drive through. Just went in and stood at the counter for about 5 mins. My boyfriend and I started discussing how long we planned on waiting before going to a different Dunkin when one of the employees came up front to grab a doughnut for a drive through customer and said "be right with you." About 5 mins after that, another neglected customer who came in after us leaned over the counter so those working the drive through would see him and when they did, they helped him before helping us. So we left. They should probably just put a sign out front that says "We don't want your money, please leave."

Ate dinner at vallartas tonight and when I went to the restroom I noticed a staff member from the back enter behind me. He used the restroom and did not wash his hands. When he noticed the ugly look I gave him as he walked out, he grabbed the towel he had on his shoulder, wiped his hands off, then threw the towel back over his shoulders. When I brought it to the waitresses attention that he didn't wash his hands, she justified it by telling me he was just a dishwasher. Great to know the people washing dishes their are not washing their hands.

Honestly this is one of if not the best pizza I have ever had in my life (and I've had a lot). I do not like square or thick crust pizza as a general rule and yet Dan's Detroit style with the crusty cheese edges just does it for me. I make it a point to try and get in once every couple weeks (on Wednesday as to avoid the line). Come for the square with pepperoni and/or one of the best alternative pizza toppings, pickled peppers, but stay for the almost as good thin crust with shiitakes which are better than most mushrooms on any pizzas. Must stop for a pizza lover.

Called to order a burrito the guy told me to wait then left me on hold for 15 minutes before I hung up. Went in to order the burrito for takeout in person. Waited another 40 minutes before they told me they were waiting on takeout boxes but that they would be there soon. Then waited another 15 min before I decided to just eat there. The server then brought out the wrong order and I decided to just get a refund after an hour of waiting. As I was trying to get my refund the server acted like I never said burrito even though I had the receipt. Very disappointing considering their food is amazing.

Got a postcard concerning a 15 year old that "factory warranty expires based on age".  Well, snap; my warranty expired over a decade ago.  A little tardy here for one of the most reliable cars in the world.  A phone call to 877-515-9966 (Missouri? Show me) was uneasy comedy and difficult entertainment.  Steve was professional, but was he shooting straight?  After I hung up, lo& behold, a phone call from a local number - National Vehicle Protection Services (I'm not in Missouri).  How...quaint.  One star...Steve did let me express myself.

Went on a Sunday. Took temp, made me use hand sanitizer and sprayed my shoes with alcohol. Wiped down each chair after use. Used plastic disposable capes. 

My hair was dry after wearing braids for so long. I got a hot oil treatment and silk press. Turned out wonderful. 

My issues were trying to communicate with the stylists was difficult because they didn't speak or understand English well.I had to use the translator on my phone to tell them what I wanted do e and to get the price. Then.....they wanted me to pay by cash app. Don't have cash app. Soooo. They got cash.

The place we normally order from went out of business, so that led us here. We ordered the mongolian beef and sesame chicken dinner plates. The mongolian beef was decent, but it lacked salt. The crab rangoons were definitely not the best I've ever had (we didn't even finish the whole bag, and that's always the first thing that disappears), but they were okay. The sesame chicken, however, was the best I've had in a long time. They also quoted us a 40 minute delivery time but made it to our door in about 25 minutes.

The salads here are quite good, but the ordering process is chaotic.  Not sure why it takes 4 people to make a salad.  But my biggest issue is that they never have tops to fit the salad bowls!  I had to ask the cashier to tape on the top today, so I wouldn't end up with a bag full of salad (again).

Update: I've been here a few times since my original review and it has not improved. Today, the food prep area was a mess, they forgot the cheese in my salad, and I was given a dressing coated bag (the dressing ended up on my skirt). Plus, they had no forks! Although the concept is good, I'm unlikely to return.

Had been wanting to try this place, and I'm glad I finally got around to it.  The atmosphere is warm and welcoming and the service was exceptional.  

The cheese, meats, and olives for appetizers were fresh and delicious.  I had the puttanesca pasta, which was cooked perfectly al dente.  Spicy and very good.  I loved the beer selection, glassware, and recommended beer pairings on the menu.

Only recommendation I have for the staff....scratch the parmesan in a shaker.  Your ingredients are much too good for that.  Go with fresh shaved, or at the very least, use a bowl and spoon to serve it.

I would DEFINITELY NOT recommend For Your Eyes Only. They are consistently late, to the point of being extremely disrespectful. I understand appointments running 10 or 15 minutes late, however, most most recent appointment was 40 minutes late.

I have continued to go to this place because of their work in schools, however, I will not be coming back after my most recent experience. The customer service was terrible.  In addition, they charged me the incorrect amount for my glasses because they didn't understand my insurance.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Not up to Hilton standards.  I stay here for work.  Can't get a properly itemized receipt.  This makes it difficult to get expenses back.  Any fast food restaurant can give an itemized receipt.  

Went to Breakfast this morning, no clean tables and no bread for toast, I asked for bread and they said they would get it but just went on with other business.  

No recognition for Hilton honors.  Not even a bottle of water.  This could be a nice place but service is just not their thing.

Don't expect any action from this review. I notice they don't read or respond to reviews
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Good drinks and food at a reasonable price. The Shrimp Tacos were excellent and actually had a lot of shrimp in them, and not bay shrimp. The waiter was kind and attentive. The bartenders for the most part were the worst part of the experience. For lack of a better word they sucked. They really didn't pay attention to you unless you were a popular guest or you wave them down. I wasn't the only patron who noticed this. Other than that I would stop by for a drink again, I just wouldn't expect much from the bartenders other than a drink at their leisure.

I've tried to give this place multiple chances. I asked for perfect match polish for my pedicure and matching gel polish for my nails. I have pink toes and nude nails. The polish is supposed to have corresponding numbers but I dont think the tech grabbed the correct match. Also, they are over priced for the results of the service they are offering. My gel nails are not smooth but rather bumpy.

Tech also sat with the phone on FaceTime the entire time. She was clearly distracted and didn't pay attention to something meticulous like painting and sculpting nails.

The reviews looked promising. But I Took My mom's car. Wanted to surprise her with a clean car. She has little kids so it's not the cleanest to begin with. Got the $21 package which o did confirm with them that was for both interior and exterior. While the exterior looked good. Once I got inside I was heavily disappointed. They barley did anything besides vacuum.  And missed tons of spots like doors and even the back seats. They said I got a fragrance at the end and they splashed it all over the seats leaving marks after it dried up. Now I have to go elsewhere to do it myself.

Worst experience ever!!!  DO NOT ORDER FROM HERE!,Ordered delivery at 6:30, told delivery in 40-60 min. At 7:45 called and was told delivery person should be there in 1 min. Called back at 8 and was told at this point, idk. No apology, no we are running behind, or let me offer u something for you experience. Delivered at 8:10, almost 2 hrs after ordered!!  Then, the food. Total sh$$. Everything was cold and hard. Wings had no sauce. Worst pizza ever.. if I could give it less than 1 star I would! I would call the manager to complain, but they would probably offer us a store credit, like I want to eat their crap again!,

This place is filthy. Outside the front entrance smells like an ashtray and resembles one as well. Why no one uses a good dose of bleach is beyond me. 
   Came the other day at opening time and there were a half dozen stray carts filling parking spaces....well, where else would you put them? Good management would dictate that all carts are collected and stored the night before, BEFORE the person responsible was allowed to go home. 
   As a previous review stated, it seems a bit disorganized inside. It is no Publix, that is for sure.

This was my first sushi experience in the Metro St. Louis area. The service was excellent. ALL of the staff greated us with smiling faces. You can tell they were happy to be there. The staff exhibited great team work. My husband drinks a lot of water and his glass never went empty. The appetizers and entrees came out in perfect timing. The presentation of every dish was intentional and professional. The taste of each dish was better than expected. The price point for value makes this place a deal. No need to try anywhere else in the area for sushi! Will definitely be back again!!!

My family and I have had our cars washed here for a few years. I've always been extremely satisfied with the job they do until yesterday. They are no longer doing inside the car through the pandemic. Much to my dismay. So I just got the outside done. It was the worst car wash I've ever received. The car is still extremely dirty. I paid $12 for nothing. You would think that if they're not doing interiors they would make sure they did at least a decent job on outside. I will no longer give them any of my business.

Maybe we came on a bad day but the sushi just wasn't it. The service was fantastic and the server met our needs but the sushi was not well prepared. The rice was very mushy and overcooked so when you were eating it, it just feels like a clump of soggy food. I work with sushi and could automatically tell the rice was overcooked. I personal would not recommend it for the sushi rolls. On the other hand the tuna tataki was very good and the shredded radish added a decent texture and the free soup/salad with a roll was a nice touch. Luckily we did enjoy the tataki and salad because we didn't eat the rolls upon tasting them.

I absolutely love this location, staff, drivers  they are the best ! I used to order from Pizza Hutt but this by far with customer service and in our busy lives they are always there with the utmost attention and care with the food they deliver. I couldn't ask for more. Last night I got a driver who brought sauces and plates and napkins! He was on the ball! My pizza was still steaming when it got to my door I can't say or express how the customer service is at this location it is phenomenal! Keep up the good work guys !

Wouldn't recommend. The nail tech Julie kept cutting my toe nails. I asked to do the regular cut & file yet she just kept cutting them. At one point I asked if she was going to file them straight since they were so off, instead she cut them again. I ended up filing them myself a little in the chair but there was no hope. They were too short to where my toes are super sensitive & sore. Also I'm worried one is going to get infected she trimmed into my skin so deep. I left embarrassed by my toes. I mentioned it to the desk girl & she said I should have said what I wanted when I clearly did.

All is okay with the exception of the wait time. I went for an eye exam initially and waited a long time. Time waiting to see nurse and doc, 1.25 hours. Time with nurse and doc, 20 minutes. I went back to purchase a box of contact lenses, with 4 staff sitting behind the counter not looking too busy and two other customers waiting in the store, I had to sign in and wait. I left after a 30 minute wait just to buy a box of contact lenses. I had my script. What's up??!! It boggles my mind!! Never again!! I highly recommend a retraining or training in customer service standards.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is an older Super 8 motel in need of a major remodle.   The room we had was okay with a heavy odor of fabreeze in the air.  The free breakfast was all carbs (except for the little sausage bits in the gravy for the biscuit - I saw that the gravy came out of a large can - yum).   You could make fresh waffles.  The only high light was the two restaurants on either side.  We went to the Mexican restaurant and was a great meal - I gave it 5 stars.  Olive Garden on the other side.  If I came back to the area - I would go to the restaurant but stay somewhere else.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
What a disappointment...
The food tastes and looks like it was frozen and reheated for presentation. 

Kani salad was a wet plate of cucumber with one little stick of crab meat. 
Shumai is clearly not made in house and reheated.  
Teriyaki is not even grilled with a bunch of bland sauce dumped on it. 

WORST OF ALL, HOWEVER, is the OLD SUSHI that is disguised with a ton of salt. That is potentially unsafe and I am not risking my health because they are cutting corners. 

There was also rice in the middle of the roll. What a cheap place, wow. 

I would never return to this place in a million years.

I took my car to the Meineke on GTown Pike for a simple oil change.  This turned out to be a massive waste of time.  The young man who took my car, came to me and said that he was not sure if the bolt that held the oil pan would go back on if he took it off.  I asked how much it would cost me if it didnt go back on--answer----$400.00.   Let me guess---the bolt wouldn't of went back on.  I told him thanks, but no thanks, and left the establishment.  

I went to SuperQuick in KOP today for the same oil change.  They did it in about 20 minutes, with no mention of any defective bolt.  

Moral of the story-  Do not go to the Meineke on GTOWN Pike.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: there was a two inch chicken bone in the middle of my taquito and the waiter didn't even care when I told him. he was very awkward and didn't really take the situation as serious as I was. if I had swallowed that or bit into it I could've gotten hurt. my friend wasnt a fan of her food, though that tends to happen when you try something new. the waiter asked her why she didn't finish it and she said she didn't really like it, no big deal. and he said that we still had to pay and we were like ??? obviously, we never asked not to. his energy was rude and I probably won't be back.

I highly recommend you do not go to Undertow Beach Bar. The owner was extremely rude to my friends and I. The brunette bar attender did not pay any attention to us because they saw we were young. We are 21 years old and can afford to tip you well. However, if you want to treat us poorly for looking young or "poor", then you will lose our business. I was also with others that were on the beach and they lost their business too. They laughed in our faces. If you like being disrespected and terrible customer service, then this is the place for you.

This was my first visit at all about eyes, it could not have been better. It quite frankly may be my best medical experience ever! From the moment I walked in the staff were extremely welcoming. Not to mention I was trying to fit in this week and they had a cancellation and contacted me right away. Very thankful for that! Dr.Susan was also very welcoming and explained each step of the process thoroughly. The next step was selecting frames and Kelly could not have been nicer. She helped me pick out the right frames and made the adjustment process easy. I can't reiterate what a truly wonderful experience it was. Thank you all!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This hotel has attentive to detail staff and are very personable. They make you feel like home. From Ms. Rose in housekeeping to Mr. Al and Mr. Martin at breakfast to Mr. Mark at the front desk, and the management team in Mr. Donovan, Mrs. Sharon, Mrs. Becca, and the rest of the team, this hotel will certainly be a stay well worth it. Near beaches, the base, museums, parks, etc... and a short drive to Orlando, Disney, and St. Pete beaches, you will have great experience and outstanding service. Too bad there aren't 10 stars!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Had Dinner there last month with the wife. Both of us got ill later. Reading their last health inspection report recently, brought the memory back in nauseating detail.

"What the inspector saw: Eight critical violations identified on July 17, including potentially hazardous foods stored at incorrect temperatures, flies observed around food-prep area, cook observed using same tongs to touch raw salmon and ready-to-eat chicken, cook observed picking up dropped piece of eggplant from the floor with tongs, then using tongs for other food".

The team at Volvo of Nashville has changed the way I view the dealership experience. Most dealerships try and take advantage of customers through excessive work or markups. In my three experiences at Volvo of Nashville, the team has demonstrated a commitment to customer service; clear, honest, and consistent communication; and, a willingness to back their craftsmanship.  For the first time out of many vehicle service experiences, I felt I was getting honest advice and quality work.  Recently, the team went above and beyond for my vehicle and I suggest giving them a visit.

Yikes! This is a rough one. Not only did I count 15 minutes waiting behind three cars in the drive thru (with no other customers inside), but the lady who served me at the window was extremely flustered and took her anger out at me for it. I asked for honey mustard and she turned and walked away without acknowledging. When I asked again, she snapped "I HEARD YOU". The owner of this franchise needs to address the poor customer service and the out-dated structure.

If Packer wants fast food on the way home, he'll have to stick to McDonald's from now on.... Please clean this place up

I just went to this location earlier tonight (8:10 pm) and went through the drive thru. No one answered through the monitor so I drove around to the front to see the hours. The location says it is open until 9 pm and I saw a worker in there on her phone. She saw me and immediately ran away. I then drove back through the drive thru and she then again didn't answer. I drove away one more time and she was hidden. I was very disappointed in the service! It was 50 minutes before closing so there was excuse for not being served. Needless to say I will never visit this location again and will recommend that no one visits it either.

Worst experience ever ! And I'm not even moved in ! I was trying to move in with my boyfriend.but good thing we decided not to .Management doesn't even care about you and they want nothing more then to rob you of your money .They won't call or answer back to your emails . Nothing saying they got what I sent . Had no issue what was happening. Trust me When I say this but I've been in the service industry and this management team is nothing but issues and fraud.and it's not just one it's all of their team.  Only imagine what would have happened if we did live here .

Do not stay here. If I could give it zero stars I would. I stayed at this hotel for a conference with pre booked room. Upon checking into my room there were unclean sheets and food all over the room. After alerting the front desk I was giving a new room with paint coming off the walls and holes in the sheets. After returning back to the front desk again I was given another unclean room with water bottles that were half empty. This was very unacceptable especially for a late check in at 12:30 am after a late train arrival, I decided to get a room at another hotel in the area. This was definitely the worst hotel I have experienced.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces
