text: The last couples of time I went to the car wash  the towels and cleaner was gone.  Employee told me they are trying to get people to bring their own. When I became a member a couple of years ago this was part of the agreement. The thing that gets me the most is, the company gave no notice of the change. Employees are nice and this is not their doings. I paid for two cars a months almost $60.00. I would like to be informed of changes in services. They should have our email or post notice on site!!!!!!!  I know people are taking the towels and cleaners, but let the members know. Thinking about STOPPING MEMBERSHIPs FOR MY TWO CARS.

We used to visit Moon's often before it changed to Sunrise Cafe and we are sorely missing Moons. We went today and our server did the bare minimum and neglected to check up on us. I had a dinner meal and it came out cold, clearly microwaved gravy. It felt very bad diner/cafeteria food like. My husband had breakfast and it was very "normal". Nothing great about it. If you're wanting breakfast, go to the Egg Factory up the road on Milwaukee and Fairview! You get much better food and larger portions for about the same price. And for dinner, try anywhere else.

This is the fourth time I've been to this location the employees need to start listening more carefully and not order and serve food way longer than necessary, especially for a fast food location. 

I do Uber Eats for example and this location of Wendy's tends to omit several orders for customers and doesn't even start the order until the Uber ETs pick up hilly, like me, comes and shows up to ask if it's ready only for pick up drivers to deliver them late. 

My Advice don't come to this location on Gulf to Bay Clearwater go to any other fast food joint or dine inn restaurant if your on your way to Clearwater Beach or Tampa.

Stopped in for a pour over after a long day touring the historic sites, and was definitely impressed. Super friendly staff, very knowledgeable, and really laid back atmosphere.
I had an Ethiopian pour over from Ruby roasters, while my girlfriend had a Kenyan pour over from them as well. The Ethiopian was especially bright while the Kenyan had prominent mango undertones. 

Super great shop with an all white La Marzzoco GB5 pulling Neon Espresso from Dogwood and great glassware provided by NotNeutral. 
Overall a great spot in a perfect location.

After reading some not so great reviews, I decided to try this place.  I have been there about five times now...If you want a beer , 30 flat screens and some bar food, this is the place.  Good beer selection, food is ok; however, overpriced.  I lastly went with a group of three people, chicken cheese steak, "chubby" sandwich, and their TKO burger ($12).  Everything was average to ok, nothing special, not impressed.  If its a $12 burger, I should walk away saying " that was really good" Grab a beer and watch the game, you'll be happy.

This hotel has the potential to be great, but isn't there as of now. I stayed from 3/20-3/23. The hotel was not finished yet. Half of the elevators did not work, the pool was not finished (although it said there was one online), and the fire alarm system malfunctioned 5 times during my stay. By malfunctioned, I mean loud siren and voice directing you to evacuate. One time was at 6am. 

Otherwise the service was great and everyone was very nice. I think once they get it together this will be a great hotel. I just wish they wouldn't have opened if they were not ready.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Okay so today I'm thinkin', "hey, I'm pretty much starving to death, maybe I should try the place literally right down the road from my house that I've never had before"

HOLY. GUACAMOLE. 

Ended up ordering a vast amount of food to split between a 5 year old, a grown man, and myself (who eats like a grown man). Wings, salad, garlic knots, chicken tenders, chicken penne alfredo, and baked ziti. 

If you don't enjoy this place, you just have a weak palette and that's you're own problem. This place is the greatest thing since president bush threw up on the emperor of Japan.

The waitress walked by me for about 30 minutes before I decided to approach the bar to get a menu. After getting my own menu (which was a packet of papers stapled) I sat for another 15 minutes before she approached me.  

So - service gets close to zero stars. The bartender actually helped me and was very nice and actually apologized for the server. 

Food was ok. Nothing indigenous to St.Louis on the menu and nothing out of the ordinary in terms of uniqueness. 

If your stuck in the hotel and have no other choice - then Malones fits the bill for a meal. Nothing special - although nothing terrible either.

This review gets two stars because the food was ok. But the real problem with this place is their lack of comprehension of the English language. I get you're not from here but if you are going to move to another country you will do your hardest to meld into that country's language and culture. The driver would not accept my credit card even after matching it up with the one I had used to order. The driver and manager could not understand anything I was saying due to their lack of knowledge of the English language. Do yourself a favor and pass on this place.

We just had dinner at Nunzio's this evening and the food was really delicious however- I ordered one of the specials, Osso Buco. When we ordered I asked our waiter the price of the Osso Buco and he said it was $29. When we got the bill it we were charged $35.50 for the Osso Buco. We asked the waiter and he just laughed and said "Sorry, do you want me to give you the six bucks?" I said it should be taken off the bill. Well, he didn't- we were charged $35.50 for an entree we were sold at $29. They really should have deducted the difference but didn't. We won't be back. Plenty of other good Italian restaurants in Collingswood.

This hotel is amazing, great service. Check in was smooth & the staff was helpful. Good price for July in Santa Barbara. It is a renovated hotel, so rooms are smaller but everything fits. Room 112 has a fridge & coffee maker, i dont know if they all do. Parking was extra & the lots are tiny but if there are no spaces you can hand keys to the front desk. Breakfast was good enough. Its complimentary so its hard to complain. All the basics are covered, premade omelet,bacon,sausage,pancake,bagel & sweets. Coffee! Glorious coffee! 1/2 a block to State street. Great location
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I am visiting family nearby for Christmas and went in on the afternoon of Christmas eve for a cup of coffee. The floor in front of the register was sticky, the tables were filthy, there was trash in the floors and there were employees standing around talking. It took 10 minutes to get a cup of coffee, and of the 5-6 employees I could see none of them did anything the entire time. I'm sure this is a busy location but there is no justification for a place being this filthy. Apparently, Dunkin survives on brand recognition and not good service.

This has to be the worse Chinese food I have ever ate in my life. The rice was all brown it looked nothing Like Chinese rice and tasted horrible.it had  no carrots or peas in it. The General Tso's Chicken had no taste at all. I asked for some  sweet and sour sauce it tasted like straight up vinegar (Gross)we also ordered some crab Rangoon's they also were so gross With no taste at all.The restaurant was pretty and  clean looking  but the food we ordered was so gross I sent mine back. I had to give 1  Or I couldn't leave a Yelp comment

Went here for far too long because it was so close. After having experiences with other vets/clinics I'm calling it after this $700 "wellness visit". They up sell you on tests and medication that aren't necessary and fly through the bill so you can't really argue it/decline anything. Only when you get slightly firmer in advocating for yourself do the techs level with you about what's essential. When there aren't any issues, the vet creates problems just to over test, treat, medicate, vaccinate. Over it. Go to House Paws or Voorhees Vet Center. Cheaper, more transparent and won't up sell treatment that's not necessary...

Great patio. Service was friendly but slow.

Food was not impressive. Tagliatelle tasted like noodles and olive oil! We requested more chili flakes hoping that would help. It didn't.

Lobster risotto was soup-y. I've had this dish at many restaurants and never seen it like this.

Beef carpaccio was not RAW, or even rare. It was tough. And the portion size was very small compared to when I've had it at other restaurants. This is on their appetizer menu. I ordered it for dinner. There is no way this could be shared between a group. 

It wasn't a terrible experience but I definitely would not recommend this to a friend.

Don't even want to give them a one but have to Want to warn any pet owners. Don't ever go to Banfield pet hospitals. We went in for annual shots, spent $273 and they didn't even give his shots.  They want us to come back in two weeks for a second exam and possible starting antibiotics for ear infection. Which will be more money. Then back again in two weeks for exam and shots.  We were told the initial visit would be $234 for exam and shots.     Pretty sure they are fishing for money.  By the way the initial treatment they are doing for ear infection, Steroids.  This nurse is not happy.  Please pass along don't get taken by Banfield.

I do not like posting negative reviews but I'm doing this with hopes to possibly help someone else avoid what I went through. Got a bad GI issue after getting my dinner from here. Full body sweat and the works. Thankfully it did not linger. Even the time before that, I had more minor GI issues but I wanted to give them the benefit of the doubt. Unfortunately cannot give them that benefit again. Wait times on the weekend for dinner rush are also INSANE. Hopefully this review can help this place get their act together and also prevent someone else from getting sick

This company doesn't even deserve 1 Star. They refuse to give the deposit back. It's been 13 business days. Priceline contacted them on my behalf (after I was unable to reach them) and they told Priceline they didn't charge me a deposit! Have disputed with credit card. According to the reviews this is the only way anyone gets their money back. This is on top of waiting in life for more than 90 minutes (with a reservation) and being charged full price even though they only had a smaller car than reserved. I only wish I had the reviews. Don't rent here - it's a scam!!

Recently relocated here from Orlando and hate dealing with horrible/bad haircut experiences. This place is great!

Cheap prices, great cuts. The first stylist I had was a little out there, but she's gone now. All the stylists seem fun and the experience of the whole shop feels more like a typical cuttery than a barbershop, but the ladies do a great job!

I would strongly recommend Mo! She listens to what you want and cuts it perfectly. I'm picky when it comes to my faux hawk and fade on the side, but she nails it every time!

Went there 3-4 times- different people every time. My nails looked fine but they severely damaged them- buffed them so thin they are bruised and told me they had to use the electric buffer to get gel off. My nails are a total wreck. The last time I had a man working on them that clearly didn't know what he was doing. He had to get direction from the woman sitting next to him. He was buffing my nails so much I had to ask him to stop- was so painful.

The shop itself is clean and nice, but the staff is unprofessional and clearly lack the appropriate training.

I give it 4 stars because the pizza is incredible, however the cannoli tasted terrible! I have not had anything else other than pizza and a cannoli so I am only rating that for food. 

The service was unique to say the least. I stopped there on a whim so I did not pre order. I ordered my food and the man taking my order was very nice. While I waited for my pizza all the workers came out of the kitchen to watch the tv in the dinning area and had conversations that were inappropriate to say the least. It made the wait very uncomfortable. 

I recommend the food but I would call ahead so there is no wait or have it delivered.

Local and had been coming here for twenty years. Doubt we will ever be back. The place looks like a prison now and could not be less welcoming. 

I walked in with my child today and her diaper bag. The gate attendant yelled at me to get out and that we couldn't be there because he didn't want to be "f****** bitched at" for letting us be there with a diaper bag. Profanity in front of a baby and totally unprovoked aggression. 

I called and tried to speak with a manager and couldn't get one. Don't expect a positive response from them but will be addressing this further. 

Undertow, there's a reason you were empty at noon during high season.

I recently had dinner here for a private function. The views are fantastic and the flowers were gorgeous. For such a high atmospheric bar, everything else fell below flat!  The food tasted like mediocre hotel food. There were cold pretzel rolls on the table that had not been fully thawed!  The black bass was beyond salty it was inedible. Dessert was a boring cake that also tasted frozen. I was very much looking forward to this meal and it was one of the most disappointing meals I have ever had!  Not to mention we tried to hang at the bar after and it was one of the most bizarre scenes
I have ever witnessed!

I love the atmosphere here. However, I recently ordered a matcha latte and as I was drinking it, I realized it was sweetened. They told me they only use sweetened matcha and that is what every uses. I have been drinking matcha for years and this was the only local coffee shop that had sweetened. I expect that from Starbucks, not a great local shop. 

The sweetened matcha is one thing, them managements response put this only at 2 stars. They did not apologize but rather told
Me I was the crazy one. That is not good customer service!  I won't be going back somewhere that doesn't want to listen to its customers!

Good coffee, tasty and reasonably priced locavore food when they actually have what's on the menu, slow service, dirty bathroom. I try Hobbs every few months, hoping they'll get better, and indeed they are but at an incremental pace. If you are craving good coffee in a cafe atmosphere, come. But expect multiple things on the menu to be unavailable and service for food to be weirdly slow and inconsistent.  When these complaints do not eclipse your experience (and in my case they usually do), it's a welcome addition to the decent-restaurant-forsaken Delaware County.

I went there for first time taking my aunt out..n it was horrible.the icecream was spoiled after my aunt bought it we all tried it amd all told the manager about it he refused to even pretend to check the machine..he also turned his back to us while we were talking to him and he also refused to replace our 4$ icecream that was obviously spoiled he said we should of sampled it first even tho there were no spoons or sign sayin go ahead n try it before u pay 4_10$ a little cup of frozen spoiled yogurt..so save your money and day dont go here..ever!warn others!

From check-in to check-out the hotel was great.   Upon our arrival, we were greeted with excitement.  The front desk clerk took the time to learn about us and provide local tips.  The hotel was very busy but the staff was well trained to deal with it.   Our rooms were perfect and exactly what we had requested.  Breakfast in the morning had hot and cold items and they even opened 10 minutes early when they saw two/three families come down.  Our check out process was smooth and friendly.  Could not have asked for a better stay during a long journey.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If you can go out to eat that is probably the better bet.  There were about 10 people eating when we arrived and we were seated immediately. The buffet had very interesting names, but was just the overall basics (Prime Rib, Potatoes, salad, fettuccine alfredo).  The food was warm, not hot buy any stretch.  Buffet was around $22 per person, with kids around $7.00 + plus the cost of drinks.  Servers were very polite.  Our meal ran about $130 when all was said and done, but the price didn't reflect the experience.  If you don't mind waiting to be seated at a local place, you can save yourself some $.

I had give up on Chinatown after it changed owners a few years ago. Recently, however, I've been back and very pleasantly surprised. Don't know if they got a new chef or what, but the flavor is back and I can't wait to go again. I've had the little steamed buns--more like dim sum dumplings, which were excellent. The pork with black bean sauce was fantastically spicy, and the lo mein was flavorful. The best review, though, is the number of Asian diners that now crowd the place.  You can't get a better recommendation than that. If you, too, thought the place was a washout  give it another try.

My wife and I stopped here before shopping. The drive thru was long but we didn't mind. She ordered the Big Mac combo. I ordered the egg McMuffin combo with an extra hash brown.  After leaving we discovered there was no egg muffin. I went back in and told them. No apology, no nothing from the mgr. My muffin tasted like it was a week old. Tough and hard to chew. The hash browns were limp. Her burger was tasteless and the fries cold and limp. She didn't finish either. I've never been a fan of their burgers but breakfasts have always been good. Something major went wrong that day. I think we'll stick with the one on stead.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Pizza was good but the service at this location is horrible. First off if you have a teenager that can't talk or listen while taking orders-don't have him work the front order station. At 1 pm on a weekday I was the only customer in the place. You would think I would get good service -WRONG. They forgot to make a salad. The tables were covered with food. All this while employees were joking around with each other and not working the resturant. This is the second time in one month I have had bad serice at this location of IMOs. I will never go back!!!

Worst apartment I've ever lived in. There is next to zero care put into the property and that includes the actual apartment. The front office can be very rude and dismissive. The apartment was dirty and the carpet smelled awful; had to shampoo it twice to help rid of the awful smell. Porch had cat litter still on the floor from the last occupant. Walls are cracked and appliances are ancient. Outside, there are weeds and dirt along with exposed wires and trash. If you need a cheap place to stay and don't care about quality, come on in!!

This is the absolute worst hotel to stay at in Tampa. If you're traveling with your family trust me this is one of the the places you need to pass by. Old furniture, broken ceiling in the bathroom, dirty carpets, no coffeemaker, safe or microwave. The best part was smelling weed from our neighbors the entire time we stayed there. Oh and not receiving towels and wash cloths for the room on a daily basis then having to call the Front Desk and no one answers. The only nice things about the hotel are the views and the lobby. This will be the absolute last time I ever stay here and I'll be sharing this with everyone I know.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Not sure I understand the negative reviews, but to each his/her own, I suppose...  I really do like Nat's Pizza - for a quick slice or cheesesteak in a pinch.  But I do very much enjoy the value and quality and consistency of their Stromboli.  I usually order the Cheesesteak Stromboli and really enjoy it each and every time.  The fact that Nat's has been a staple of the community for SO long is a testament to the quality of the food.  Keep up the tradition, Nat's - and thank you for continuing to produce such great pizzas!

If I could give this place a negative score I would. WORST car wash experience ever! They were very pushy and rude and then they did a cruddy job. Before going through I expressed that I wanted a thorough vacuuming and would be willing to pay extra for it because I had plant littler all over the back.  They assured me vacuuming was included in the Manager's Special. It looks like they spent maybe 5 seconds going over the seats and didn't even touch the floors or the back, there is still plant litter everywhere. I can't believe I paid $24 for this terrible service. You are better off just going to a gas station, paying $1 and doing it yourself.

The food was good but the young manager that was there last night was possibly the biggest douche that I have ever met. It took a while to be waited on. I stood at the counter while the manager came up to the register and didn't say anything to me. I waited patiently while he called one of the girls over. I was still waiting patiently while they worked something out. Finally, he looks up at me with a smug look and says "what do you want." DOUCHE! I think that he feels really important as being the manager at Arby's.

They cancelled my appointment ! I had an appointment for an oil change and filter for my 2 Toyotas They cancelled my appointment and said they no longer wanted my business ! Was told that I was just using them for oil change and filter. Have been a customer for over 10 years with 4 different Toyotas and Honda. Have had tune-up, wheel alignment, belts installed, front and rear brakes done, new battery,  brake and transmission fluid flush done, etc. over the years.Have not had my cars serviced elsewhere. I guess I have not been getting enough "flushes" done lately. A poor way to run a business....
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We had a birthday party for our daughters birthday at Margarita's.  Our bill was over $300.00 which was to be expected having a large family.  However; we didn't expect that our server was going to steal money from us, by adding an additional $10.00 to his $60.00 dollar tip that we left him!   We always check our bank account to see if there are any discrepancies, so you can imagine our disappointment and anger towards the dishonest employee.  We did report the incident to the manager, so hopefully this employee was fired.  We won't be back because of the bad experience, but hopefully this will raise awareness for others!

My 2nd time here. First time visit, my husband and I had the hibachi noodles and fried rice, was decently good, usually better when cooked in front of you, but we can deal without. This time, we craved some sushi and ordered the Dragon and Hicksville rolls. I wish the entire sushi menu showed what the orders all looked like, but only a few were on there. The Dragon roll was delicious, we never tried eel before and we didn't realize that until afterwards. Lol  Shrimp tempura had flavor, batter wasn't too heavy. Overall, will be back again.

Paid 220 a night here expecting it to be nice... WRONG. Smells weird, very old. The bar downstairs is actually nice. The pool and hot tub are gross. The walls are all painted a different color. The floors are sticky. The bathrooms are so small! The wood is chipping from all the walls. Everything is outdated. No blackout shades for your room so don't plan on sleeping in. Pipes are running throughout your room. Stains in the bathroom. A/c unit is covered in dust. Just not what I expected for what I paid... Huge let down.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I don't understand what's changed over the years a chocolate cake donut is clearly a chocolate cake donut but according to the this place it's a chocolate iced cake donut which are 2 very different items one is all chocolate that's like cake and the other is plain white cake donut with chocolate icing. Is this world so dumb we can no longer tell the difference. Trying to explain what you want a dunkin is like talking in a alien language. Let's resolve this with signs in front of the donuts that clearly have changed in what they are called without a memo being sent out to the general public

I have a simple head, so i have a simple hair cut. The gard part is getting rid of the hair in the places it shouldnt be.
 My son's head is more complicated, demands more detail, but its all in one place. Both if us get a great cut & style at a price that leaves ys enough to leave our cranial custodian a tip.
( yes folks, when its a good cut, and its not already $50 for a 20+/- minute sit, then its nice to tip, if you can. But dont let it stop you from getting a cut)
I'd give it 5 stars, but i've been to places that have pool tables and serve beer.

So far the worst experience I've had in a hotel. We had a king suite and it was filthy and the furniture was falling apart.  We were move to two adjoining rooms and while an improvement the rooms are very scarred and shopworn, not at all pleasant, and feature broken fixtures and even a jagged screw hanging out of the closet door where the knob should go. 

This is a shady operation, and when we arrived had drinks sleeping in the lobby to the apparent approval of the staff. 

My advice- pass on this place.  I booked on the recommendation of a friend.  Gotta question that judgement.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: BUYER BEWARE!!! HIDDEN FEES!! They claim $19.99 a month with no extra fees but they don't tell you about the enrollment fee, registration fee, childcare fees and of course the "yearly matinence" fee that I just randomly got hit with. Yearly matinence fee? Isn't that what I pay a membership for? For you to maintain your facility? The childcare room is so small and dirty that I won't allow my kids in there. They make a policy of children having to be "walkers" because they won't pick them up if they cry. Staff is rude and I often have to seek someone out for help. Very disappointing! What a waste of money....UGH
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
WARNING!!!!!!!!!
Stay away from this market , and OLD WOMAN (short hair Chinese) CASHIER , she horrify, if you're not come to her she pick a quarrel with you ,she talking too much didn't shut off ,nosy customer how much people shopping that's their money their business OH MY GOD she nosy and care about how much people shopping, I think she better know what her job what she doing in this market! I don't know why owner this market can hire one kind person like this .  And the items here look like stay there forever ,expired days they didn't check, the market smell and stink. 
GOOD BYE , NEVER COME BACK , SEE HOW MANY CUSTOMER THEY LOST !!!

I have gone here for years and was always happy with the service and quality of the product. However, today I went for a pedicure and had a terrible experience. The  manicurist did not trim my cuticles and left my toenails unfiled with rough points on the edges. It was basically a sloppy job. I didn't realize it until I got home. Later I decided to go back and ask them to fix it. Another manicurist took about 2 minutes to trim my cuticles and file my toenails. They are smoother but still sloppy. Unfortunately, I will have to find another place to go from now on. So disappointed.

Salon is spacious, clean, and well decorated; staff is friendly and polite. I got a gel manicure and they took their time, painting 2 fingers at a time instead of all 5 at once, to ensure the polish doesn't slip and becomes unevenly thick on one side. 

They gave a quick shoulder massage while my nails dry/cure under the light, following with a paraffin dip that was slightly too hot to the touch but I give them props for good effort.

The polish is even in color but I see mini air bubbles in a few fingers which is a bummer. Overall a great experience, I'll be back to take advantage of the stamp card they gave for $10 off after 6 visits.

This is by far the best Mexican in Philadelphia. I started with the tuna guac, then beet salad, and finally the chalupas. Everything was incredible. Oh and I ended with tres leches!  But I think more impressive than the food was the service. My server had so much knowledge of the menu and of Mexican food in general. I think she said she went to Mexico just to learn more about cuisine and culture! I can't remember her name, started with a "B", try to ask for her. She made dining out an actual experience, which is a rare occurrence in this town. Kudos once again to my favorite spot of the 13th street powerhouse.

Tried to call them 3 times tonight to make an order for delivery. Every time I ended up with a message saying the voicemail was full. If you cant answer a phone or even clear out your voicemail you don't want my money.

UPDATE: Ate their tonight, now I definitely have no urge to ever eat there again. Delivery took over an hour and a half. Really, nothing should take that long in Sierra Vista. Food was terrible, crab puffs had no crab, just cream cheese and as for the rest of the food, I am sure it came straight off the buffet line.

Went twice in two days, everyone moved at a snails paste.  They do not get the meaning of teamwork, that was obvious.  No one seemed to want to help anyone else, just stood and watched each other.
Today we got a chocolate shake, 1/2 was strawberry, oops!!.  Did not offer to remake it.  Also got a hot fudge sundae, two bites and it was gone, i think it was a kids size for the adult price.  
Yesterday we got two sodas and 10 piece nuggets, nuggets was cold.  The soda (Coca Cola) tasted funny, like an off brand of coca cola.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I/we have been using J-Brite cleaners for some time. As of late, product or service (whichever huh choose), has been drastically different: stains, excessive starch visibly along sleeve lines, missing buttons, poor communications regarding special articles (damage, inabilities, etc. 

 More importantly, in today's economy and competing industry: no monthly, weekly, or annual customer specials? No percentage for returning wire hangers? And. NO military acknowledgement or discount for any vet...really???? 

Definitely considering another agency for future use and I urge you to do the same. 

Thanks for your time!
Amy
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: We went here today for happy hour just to try it out.  AWESOME!!!!  We ordered tempura Japanese bagel roll, Mexican roll, Philadelphia roll, lots of nigiri and sashimi, and I think it was Alaska or Arizona (can't remember but it started with an "A" lol).  Everything was fresh.  We also had tempura ice cream for dessert.  It's very frozen ice cream wrapped in pound cake then fried.  Everything we ordered was good so we will be coming back for normal lunch and dinner.  It's great to find a good sushi place near Countryside.

If I could choose no stars, I would. This was the rudest employee I have ever encountered. The employee acted annoyed that we even asked for ice cream, and only talked to us from the back in the kitchen. Then when we wanted a pint to-go, took her 5 min of slumped shoulders to have to actually go and look for a lid as she shuffled her feet on the floor.  She was just going to fill it with out a lid. The other employee told us to ask the other one for our spoons, but she was too busy being annoyed that we wanted ice cream. 

What a joke this place is.

Dropped in yesterday 1/13/18as a local Causeway resident to see the place. Positives: great make over, bar design is great for viewing kudos on all the upgrades. Love the big doors can't wait for temps to get back to normal. 
Prices: ! Yikes! $3.75 for miller lite and $16 for a bucket! Know your competition $14 buckets at Frenchys couple of hundred feet away. Why would I want to pay $2 more for the same product at your place? Need to get some better happy hour and drink special during games at least. Should be better pricing all the time. $3.75 for a miller lite won't cut it for me kinda gouging in my boat.

The lobby hours are terrible here, almost every time I come to this location I get turned away saying its drive thru only. In my line of work I drive vehicles that donor fit in the drive through. To me this sounds like laziness in cleaning the dining room so they close it early so they don't have to or staffing problems. I was here one weeknight at 6pm...drive thru only. Who closes the dining room before 6pm?? When you look at the hours for this location, save yourself the trouble and drive through or go to one of the many nearby locations who would be happy to welcome you inside.

Dr. Lilly is fantastic. I love her, she is personable and knowledgeable. I have been going there for 4 years, however, the office staff are terrible. I have heard one office staff member speak quite rudely to a patient over the phone on several occasions, and was so glad that wasn't me. I have called 4 times, left voice mails 3 times, and actually spoke with a staff member who took my name and number, promising to call me back because they were with patients, and no call back, just to schedule an appointment. If they are so busy they cannot call back to make an appointment, I guess they don't need my business anymore.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
While traveling back and forth from Clearwater to Moffitt for 10 days, I saw a Krystal in my travels. I'm from Michigan and remember White Castle burgers very fondly and just had to stop

. I've ended up stopping 4 times in those 10 days and every time I stop, whether drive-thru or walk-in, I am met with awesome customer service as well as delicious little burgers from heaven!! The staff is always friendly and helpful and the food is fresh and hot. Definitely recommend this Krystal for its food and wonderful service!!

One needs to be careful with this place.  The apartments are nice enough, and the staff pleasant and business-like; however, there are a lot of hidden fees that can run the rental price up 15% or more.  For example, they charge you for water, sewer and trash, and it's not at all clear how they divide of this charge among the huge number of units (the numbers come out rather arbitrary).  The deposit is also rather high $400.00, but only  1/2 is refundable; there are several other fees (application, etc.), so all-in-all make sure you include these fees in the rental price.

Cleanish rooms but the girl at the front counter didn't see our paid reservation so the pre authorized another amount, so who knows when that will show back up in our account. Second the hallways smelled of rotten food from the hallways   Not the hotels fault but the could have someone picking it up once in a while especially after I complained. Back to the girl that checked us in, she not only double charged my wife she sent us to the wrong room! Not to be racist but a hotel like this in Reno Nevada should be able to speak English or have someone else who does.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Stayed on a Saturday night for a friend's bachelor party.  Beds are comfortable, room was clean, and the lady working the Not-Really-A-Starbucks was extremely helpful when I asked for a breakfast sandwich without cheese, she went the extra mile to accommodate.

$40 to park for 18 hours is exorbitant and a farce. Asked the front desk if they could validate parking...here, "validate" means charge it to the room, not forgive the fee.  If you stay here don't make the mistake I did of parking in the poorly-lit basement parking garage for $40.  There are lots nearby.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Absolutely amazing! Lots of gluten free options as well. I first went a couple years ago in high school for Christmas Eve with my family, and it was a buffet night. I tried the lemon chicken, a soup (brought for me being gluten free, not the original soup), the Szechuan beef, lots of vegetable options (best broccoli ever), and great gluten free spring rolls. The architecture and interior design is beautiful, opulent, and very authentic. The service is so amazing as well. I love this restaurant. The best Chinese food!

Like most of the other reviews, terrible service. A flyer for the pizzeria was placed under our hotel room door in downtown Tampa. We called to order a large pizza and we're told it would only be a few minutes. 45 minutes later we attempted to call - no answer. After an hour, we called again and were told our order was out for delivery. We went down to the front desk and were told this company was not to be leaving flyers in the hotel as they have no showed for hotel guests multiple times. 

Do NOT use this company. There are plenty of other great pizzerias and restaurants to choose from in Tampa

THE VERY WORST!  Yes, the winter has been horrible, but when I pay $10. for a carwash, I expect it to be clean! I don't expect to pay more with a coupon than what is on the advertising board....intentional, I believe.    I was asked if I wanted the wheels done???  Duhhhh....I will never go back.  The people who work there were rude and clearly in an altered state.  In NJ, which is where I am from, there is a nice, friendly, drive through, they vacuum the inside, the pre-scrub the wheels, they wipe the windows inside and out.  The car is never spotty or missed dirt on the doors.  YUCK!  Don't use them.

I like this gym.  There is great value here.  All classes are included with your monthly fee and without exception the instructors are enthusiastic, well trained and care about providing you with a great safe work out. The facilities are clean (the custodian is in there to mop up the spin room practically before the class is over). The locker rooms are well appointed, though getting a little short of space.  There always seems to be plenty of space on the cardio machines.  
 Complaints? They decreased the size of the women's only gym, and it is pretty crowded now...
Otherwise- this is a great gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
While I was out doing errands, I managed to run over a bolt and started hearing a tapping sound.  I pulled over and asked my son to check the tire.  He said there was a bolt in the tire and it was making a "hissing" sound.  I needed to get my tire changed ASAP!  The only place that could think of and trusted was BIG BRAND TIRES, so that became my next stop.  They were busy and still able to fit me in along with another car that was being towed there with a flat tire.   My son walked over to get a late lunch for us and before we knew it, our tire was fixed and we were off to finish our errands.

Thank you BIG BRAND TIRES!!!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Our rent started out 1,550 and now not even 2 years later we are almost at 1,900$ a month. We have had many issues with maintenance or them just totally forgetting about us. The apartment was built in a rush. The paint is not done properly, our sink is crooked and our wood is warped on the floor. They call these "luxury" apt when there was been burglaries and section 8 is here now too. They recently added a 100$ extra to my rent because apparently amenities are included and they "forgot" to add it on before. We are looking elsewhere to live now

We have been so pleased with our meals there and the wonderful  wait staff including Vanessa and Jackie.  The food has been exemplary ... until tonight.  We brought our visiting family in because we wanted to introduce them to this restaurant.  They both ordered Seared Beef Tenderloin at 39.50 each.  Both found the steaks too tough to chew and they couldn't eat  them.  Our very lovely and helpful wait person , Jackie, talked to her boss, there was nothing that person would do.  She was very kind to do that and we are sorry our guest had that experience such a disappointing meal and it certainly taints our feeling about Vivace

I was so disappointed in my recent visit.  We frequent Nunzios and decided it would be the perfect place to celebrate my mother's special birthday.  We had the WORST service I have ever had at a restaurant.  There was ONE waiter taking care of all the tables...but there were only 4 or 5 tables filled when we were there!  It should not have taken 30 minutes to get water and bread and another 20 for our other drinks.  On top of that my order was wrong and our food came out at different times.  This place is not cheap by any means and for the money you expect good good and good service.  I will never return.

Very nice neighborhood Italian restaurant in the declining area of Chambersburg. Food selection was reasonable. Roasted red pepper appetizer was nice, fresh and plentiful. The lobster bisque soup was tasty as well as the French onion soup. Entree portions were huge. Veal piccata was tasty and vodka rigatoni was also very good. Vegetable ravioli, chicken francaise was large and tasty per my family. Dessert was good some made in house and others local. Only disappointment was wine choices but there is bar service. All in all great value, large portions and tasty food. We'll be going back.

Amazing food and customer service. Everyone was extremely friendly. Something I find many restaurant's in the area have a hard time with. Eggplant is always delicious as is the bread and pasta side. House wine accompanies the food perfectly. Very clean and everyone was following COVID protocols and the right way (masked with noses covered). Again something a lot of restaurants in the area struggle with. Prices are reasonable for the quality and portion size. We make this a must stop every year. That trend will definitely continue!

I am extremely disappointed in The Station!!!!
We have been there before and it was okay....
Today was my husband's birthday and he chose that for his birthday lunch. 
We arrived and we were greeted by a friendly server. They weren't busy. There was maybe three or four tables taken. One gentleman sitting at the bar. She said to pick a spot to sit. We did. We waited. And waited.... We watched her check on the other tables that were already eating, to see if they needed anything else. She then proceeded to go clear an empty dirty table. 
We never got a menu/water....finally after, what seemed like an eternity, we left.

I came in today & ordered a cold brew. Waited 15 mins just for them to tell me they  were out .  SayiNg they called my name and no one came up - bullshit. Maybe talk louder when you know you have a crowd  .   So I ordered a macchiato - waited another 10 mins. Still nothing. Finally asked the girl at the register I if the man behind her was the manager and she goes "" uhhh i think so idk ". So I told him what happened aNd thankfully he made it right Away. So thank you to him for being so kind !!  The rest of staff - step up !! 

You lost a customer or 2 ...

Ok, I didn't expect much from this. It kind of looks like a dump from the outside, but the burgers are fantastic. I have a Triple Classic (three 1/4 lbs patties) with bacon and cheese. It was really good. I like my burgers gooey and juicy and it delivered. I wish I had a picture but I ate it too fast.

On top of that, the place is cheap. Really good prices.  Fries were good but not great, they have crinkle cut fries, which aren't my preference.  I also prefer Coke and they are a Pepsi place. But the important thing is the burgers, and they do them right. 5 stars.

This place used to be good, but now they just churn customers in and out.  Lousy service for a deluxe pedicure. Been going there 7 years and gotten progressively worst. Pedi should take 35-40 minutes for deluxe, this one took 15 minutes after waiting 40 minutes. 
It would be nice if Johnny greeted the men in there as well as the women, we are paying customers also. 
Overall, rushed service, not punctual, and not friendly at all. This is what happens when a successful small business opens up a shop three times the size it used to be and all the details that made it successful are lost. Take your business elsewhere.

I got the "Works Wash" but Im the one who got worked.  I had to wipe all the window spray over spray off, from the dash and seats.  They don't wipe down the dash or center console with their $12 wash.  didn't even dry the whole car.  Very poor work.  Vacuuming didn't even get all the debris and dirt from the carpets.  I wash my car twice a month and it is not dirty, ever.  This wash should have been very easy for them.  I will not be going back.  Also, its dirty and old.  You cant see through the windows to see the car going through the wash, the sheetrock is unfinished and inside is dingy.

Cottage homes are nice but parking is ridiculous.  People park on the one-lane circle and block driveways so tenants can't back out.  Safety is an issue because emergency vehicles can't get through.  Complaining to management does nothing.  They call the offenders and ask them to move but they come right back.  The manager says his job is babysitting adults and no one cares.  They can have the vehicles towed as it is private property but they don't.  Someone would care if their vehicle gets towed.  Don't bother paying for a garage that you can't get out of.

Awful gym. Staff is rude, facilities are filthy, and their membership is way too expensive for what you get. They will sneak hidden fees and charge you for random people that isn't even on your account. PLEASE do not sign a 2 year contract because once they sucker you in they will make you change locations to make it impossible to cancel once the 2nd year is up. I was young and was taken advantage of. I do not recommend this gym at all to anyone. I gave them a 2 week notice and was promised not to be charged then to find out I had to have a 30 day written notice so there goes another 60 dollars wasted gym membership that is out of my hands.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
We can into Tampa for the UCF fight and after walking around we decided to grab a cold beverage, we went to a pub around the corner and after 15 minutes we walk out because we were ignored
We decided to give
The Urban Cantina a whirl, and we were glad we did!  We were greeted with smiles and as soon as we sat at the bar, the bartender offered us a cold beverage , which was the coldest beer we have ever had!  We order the chips and salsa a chix quesadilla and rice and beans I have to say the chix quesadilla was the beast I have ever had the chips and salsa were awesome
And rice and beans yummy
I give this place 5 out of 5!

Tucked away in the annoyingly quiet unincorporated portion of Gretna known as Terrytown, Los Panchos might be the best hidden gem on the Westbank. Authentic Mexican food, cold drinks and a friendly, family staff serving wonder dishes and great vibes is what you'll find at Los Panchos. I'm a particularly big fan of the chicken and steak fajitas. Everything is great though. Drink specials on certain nights. Taco Tuesdays. Los Panchos has everything one is looking for in a Latino-inspired restaurant. Might be the best Mexican food on the Westbank.

This place UESED to be my go-to for cheap and awesome Chinese food, however the last 2 times I was there, there was definitely something different. New staff and new ownership, and as I recently asked, new cook as well. I always ordered the same tried and true dishes to go, and have yet to notice much of a difference in quality as of yet, however the service is definitely lacking (not that here was much of it before).  I'd say still go and try it for yourself, but keep in mind that all the positive reviews you've read/heard is basically for a different place.

I love Ulta soo much!! Customer service is really helpful. They're always there to help you find and suggest products that's best for you. I only go to one hair stylist which is Lataya. I really recommend you to go to her. She's engages into conversations,and it's not like going to a typical stylist. She has a very upbeat personality and will give you more of what you ask for. She's a very talented hairstylist.My hair has broken off in the past, and Lataya really helped my hair grow longer and healthier. I truly recommend to going to ulta. Very reasonable prices, and sales all the time!

This location has a process problem not a people problem . Andrea was very helpful with my rental
Car arrangements . Once at the counter she was friendly and  efficient. 
The problem was the long wait in line . Budget and Avis both have their preferred customer lines , so of the 3 lines 2 get preferential service . To get that level of service I suggest you down load the. Fast Break app or sign up while you are in line waiting so you can proceed to the faster line . 

Lots of unhappy people waiting unnecessarily. Can only imagine how that would go over back east as compared the chill vibe here in Reno .

We reserved a casita suite for our 51st anniversary and we were most disappointed with the suite.  The carpeting was stained, was frayed where it met the hard flooring, and was all-over dirty.  The mattress had deep depressions where people had slept and made for very uncomfortable sleeping.  The couch was broken down also, and the arm had a rip in the fabric.    All in all, it was a big disappointment for the money we spent for a suite that is long-overdue for upgrading.  We will not be going back to the Dove Mountain Ritz-Carlton.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Ordered Kung-Pao chicken. Service was friendly and the to-go order was ready within 10 minutes. 

Unless Chinese food is prepared very differently than the same dishes you'd get from virtually any similar restaurant in southern CA, I cannot recommend eating here. There was no heat and no flavor whatsoever, and there wasn't a single red pepper which is the signature ingredient of any Kung-Pao dish. I won't eat here again. But then again....I'm somewhat new to the area and maybe Chinese food in Reno is just exceptionally bland and that's the way every restaurant prepares it.

I am at this Wendy's currently in the drive through and literally waisted no joke 38 mins waiting in line for someone to take my order. The employees are coming outside to take the trash out and cigarette breaks as we wait outside. This happened last time I was here too. Terrible customer service and when I get to the machine to take.my order it's not even working properly and the guy puts me on hold for another 7mins and people behind me start honking at me! This place is total trash! Don't even waste your time! Go to McDonald's across the street!!!!!

Quite possibly the worst fast food restaurant I've been to. I worked fast food for 6 years, and this is not how you run a restaurant. I watched the drive thru girl bite her nails while touching all over the register just before she touched my food. I had to yell to stop her from touching it and ask her to sanitize her hands, she didn't. I watched another older woman cough all over a bag while her mask was below her chin. This is a disgusting, unsanitary establishment with nasty workers who do not know hygiene. Do not touch your mouth and then put your dirty fingers in my food. And these are the people who want $15 an hour ‍
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This was a year ago. I came here for a special birthday and were very disappointed. The waiter was extremely rude. When we asked about gluten free options, he was patronizing. Our two lentil soups, which were tasty each came with a hidden bay leaf. Since I choked on one once and know, as a cook, to always remove it, I politely mentioned it to our waiter. He said we put one in each serving. Are you kidding me? The chicken was tasty as was the salmon, but the attitude really set the evening off wrong. Very snooty restaurant.

Like the food and outdoor seating. But a pet peeve is hidden charges. Asked if I could substitute pasta for potatoes on my Chicken Siciliiano. Sure. Then the bill has a charge of $3 extra for the pasta, which was a small, sauce-less portion, that probably cost about $0.03 to buy wholesale.

Then, and this is bizarre, for your salad that comes with dinner, they ask "house or caesar's", and I took caesar's. Then there's a $1.00 charge on the bill for the caesar's. Huh? 

It's not the $4 upcharge, it's the principle of the thing. This place's prices are not cheap, so tacking on extra charges without telling you ahead of time is bogus.

The place itself is small and they serve your food in styrofoam and paper plates but the food was good. I had the Samurai roll which came with 6 big pieces for $8. The heart attack was extremely hot, like unbearable. I like spicy but this was hot in a not so good way. I ate 2 whole pieces and ended up having to take the jalapeños out and scraped the cream cheese and salmon out of the jalapeno so that I could eat that and not waste it, which ended up tasting really good without the jalapeño! They don't have a large selection but I would go back again.

Everyone tells me to try this place. Like it's amazing Mexican food! NOPE! It's Cafeteria style. You tell them how to build your tacos like you're at Subway. Right off the bat: terrible store-bought tortillas. Rubbery and gross. The cook is the back is a Hispanic male: NOPE. HINT.. all good Mexican food comes from the Latinas . If there isn't an elderly Latina back there making homemade tortillas, then it's not GOOD. Please wring our the meat please. By the time you sit down to eat your taco, the rubber tortilla is water logged and falling apart.  To top it off, it gave me diarrhea a little later. Thanks for the $20 gross experience.

This hotel is clean & the bed is comfortable, but the interior design is such that the noise is unbearable. The rooms surround an open center & all night, in a Saturday, people are loud & the sound carries straight up to the rooms. Children run wild & are yelling & screaming in the open area. The walls are thin & people are just loud & do not put any limits on their children's sound levels. Then in the morning it starts all over again as guests are eating in the restaurant which is part of the open area. Really hard to sleep at this hotel. :-(

There is no free WiFi in the rooms!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've tried this place multiple times, and I get annoyed at myself every time when I end up with mediocre sushi. The problem with this restaurant is they've sacrificed taste for volume. None of the sushi I got in my last order was flavorful. I got the sushi dinner and a couple of rolls. The rolls were fine, but the sushi pieces were big and not flavorful at all. It seems like the owners believe that people value a lot of food (big pieces of sushi) rather than quality. But the fish was very bland, even the salmon.  I've given this place enough chances, since NE Philly doesn't really have a lot of great sushi choices, but I won't be going back.

They have very good food.  The kids love the bean and cheese burrito. I really like the shredded beef chimi and I ask to have them fry it longer to get really crispy. We all love the shredded beef tacos, they are grand. We also all really like their guacamole and cheese chips. Next to mine, of course :), the guacamole is some of the best around, they aren't being cheap by putting in fillers like other places do.     

You really do get a lot for your money.  Well worth going out of the way for.  Drive thru service is very fast too people and are friendly and helpful.

Only negative is they don't take AmEx, but not a big deal.

My friends & I are from OH & I really wanted to take them out for a nice dinner. We decided on Jimmy's. After patiently waiting for a table, we were finally seated. Our waitress took 10 minutes to even come to our table. We ordered the pretzel app and it took a very long time to come out & when it did it was cold & hard. Dinner took over an hour to be served & again it was cold. We sent the dinners back to be reheated. The waitress never offered salt/pepper, forgot my hollandaise sauce & the dinners were tasteless. The mgr offered to take 10% off the bill & free deserts. For the price of our entrees I expected better service &  better food

If you want a nice, quiet atmosphere, don't book a table here. The night we went, the place was packed, we got a table in a bad spot, and the good food was unable to overcome the annoying noise and constantly getting bumped into.

You have to love a good BYOB restaurant, and we brought a nice bottle of wine that did mellow our mood. But as soon as we stepped out onto Fayette Street and left the din of the restaurant behind, we looked at each other and said "Never again"...

The meal was good, pretty creative, but this is one of those places that just is not my style. The wait staff was even frustrated by the noise level!

Delivery driver does not know where he's going and doesn't understand simple directions. I couldn't even get my food because the driver couldn't find his way around the corner. He insisted that he was "outside" every time he called. All eight times he called. Why would you call me to tell me that you're outside?! Bring my food INSIDE!!!  MAYBE HE ASSUMED THAT I'D MEET HIM AT HIS CAR TO PICK UP MY FOOD!!!! If you work in the area and you deliver in the area, You should know where you're going. There are too many pizza places in South Philly, I suggest you order from one of them.

This is a nice family run sushi & hibachi restaurant with reasonable prices.  The outside doesn't look very great and it's tucked back hidden from the main road (highway 267) but the food and service are good.  

This restaurant serves hibachi grilled food, but there's only one and you don't sit there. They cook the food and bring it to your table.  If you are looking for a sit at the grill hibachi experience this isn't the place.

I'd recommend the family sushi dinner that comes with several rolls, salad and miso soup.  Also, the Jalapeño Bomb appetizer is great!

This is really a great place to dine.  We were there on a Sunday.  We were told by the host that they offer a slightly different style menu of 3 choices of a 3 course meal.  Can I just SHOUT OUT LOUD how much every moment of my experience was so GREAT.  The homemade bread, the salad, the main course, well seasoned, and oh the homemade deserts - even the ice cream.  My husband and I dine out a lot, but, never posted a review.  However, after the experience we had at The House of William and Merry, I decided that I needed to.

The atmosphere was great too, such a beautiful place in a very beautiful part of Hockessen, DE.

Would score the gym lower then a two is because most of the staff is great and the manager is  wonderful 8ve been a member since the location opened . But the last 2 year the AC has not worked at 100%.  Before the virus struck the only unit that worked was in the locker room! I hoped that it would be fix ( but should be replace) during the shutdown , that didn't happen. It is super humid and so hot i can't work out.add waring a mash it impossible and it has to be a health risk.
The owners have a great location and the gym is well equipped fix the AC
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This used to be my favorite sushi in all of Philly. The rolls, while slightly overpriced, are excellent and the service used to be fantastic. However, I've tried to order takeout for the past 2 weeks and each time I call, they  tell me "sorry, we are not doing take out today". Well now you just lost a customer and a $50-$60 takeout order each time. Some of us work and don't have time to come sit down and enjoy a nice long dinner, unfortunately. Thankfully, Raw always has takeout available. Even on New Year's Eve. Goodbye Zama, it was nice knowing you.

I highly recommend Surf Thru.  Yes, you do have to vacuum the vehicle yourself, but with the ultimate wash, they give you a wipe for your dash and a scent clip.  Furthermore, every time I have been there, the receipt has had a coupon for $4 off the next wash.  If you get your vehicle washed again before the coupon expires, this works out to be cheaper than the other place on River and Flowing Wells/La Canada.

To top it off, I believe that they have a four-day rain guarantee which the other place doesn't.  Lastly, if you are Active Duty or Retired Military, they will give you a discount.  

All in all, it is worth the time and money.

This place was good and I'm not sure what happened the xl pizza got smaller and a 6 inch around salad was over ten dollars . Not only was the delivery driver kinda short with me but the manager couldn't figure out how to take 1 topping off of an extra large pizza and wing deal and simply add it to the second deal I ordered thus creating 1 xl cheese pizza and 1 pizza with 2 toppings with 2 orders of wings.. I spent over 70 dollars on pizza and it should come with service and a smile. I'm disappointed and will probably go to Rocco's pizza in tucson next time especially for the price

This is a great spot for the family - we often get takeaway but decided to eat in last night. Sadly, they were out of a couple of specials that sounded very tasty (oysters and live scallop)! 

Last night was a little off from my usual expectations - the sushi/sashimi was good, but didn't "pop" like it sometimes does. 

The japanese uni was very good, but I was a little disappointed that they no longer stock quail eggs, as I like that with my ikura sushi. Apparently, there was too little demand in the area. oh well....shikata ga nai! 

The service was friendly and complete as always, if a little frenetic.

I remember going here at its old location with great memories of their seafood and pasta.  So my boyfriend decided to go the other night since it has moved about two stores down on S. Broad.  The quality of the food has declinded considerably.  I got a chicken meal and my boyfriend  got some veal.  Both were very bland.  The asparagus that accompanied my dish was steamed to an extreme, leaving nothing but limp mushy strings of green.  

Pros: When we sat down, we were served some delicious bruschetta and mushrooms on toast.  Also the waitresses working there are fun,  sassy, older dolled up "chicks."

Place is awesome. The pizza (we got the Angelo)  is solid for two people. It doesn't make you full but just enough to get a desert afterwards! There's no flap in the pizza and it only gets better after the first slice!! There's a good balance between the crunchiness and the cheese as I was satisfied with it overall. 

The customer service was great and the owner knows how to run an operation. Definitely recommend for anyone from out of town or travelers who want someone more local! Can't wait to come back whenever I'm in old city.

Went for the all-you-can-eat sushi and was very pleased with the quality! The spicy seaweed salad is amazing. I also love that sashimi is included in the all you can eat menu. The white tuna practically melted in my mouth. My only issue with how this works is that you have to order collectively by table, so if other people in your party are not so great about judging how much they can eat and over order, it affects you, because you have to finish everything ordered before ordering more. And eat at their same pace. It would be much better if it was per person!

This hotel has a nice lobby but that's more or less where the positives ended. 

We had booked a King room, but when we checked in, we were told that there were no King rooms available in the 25 floor hotel. We were unapologetically told that we'd have to settle for two double beds. After we stood at the counter for ten minutes, the woman "helping us" magically found a king room. We thanked her but she continued to be rude. 

Pros:
 - comfortable, large king bed 
 - super friendly doorman
 - very nice view of the museums

Cons
 - found a bug in the room
 - counter service was terrible
 - too expensive for what you get
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've driven past Oishi Sushi so many times and always thought "I'll eventually stop in" and I finally did. It's now my favorite sushi restaurant in St. Louis. The service is exceptional, we always get boats (boats are fun) and, boy, was I excited when I saw the menu has pictures. The sushi tastes so good and fresh and even their basic rolls always have a little something to make them special, like pickled radish in a spicy tuna roll. The only bad thing I've ordered here was the Pad Thai, so I'd definitely just stick to the sushi.

I used this location, as suggested by a friend, when I was rear ended.  They were wonderful.  They took care of everything with the insurance company, even calling them directly to ask for an extension instead of leaving it to me.  This was exceptional.  They asked me which car I was comfortable with or would like and had it the gas full and washed before I was ready to leave.  They were very friendly and professional.  They are very good at what they do at this location.  They even offered to pick me up and drive me back.

I had been a regular customer for a couple of years as it's convenient to home and work.  The prices are good, the service is spotty, espeically from one airheaded waitress who doesn't seem to work there anymore and got confused when I asked for my salad dressing on the side.  Obviously that was a difficult concept.  The individual pizzas were usually pretty decent and fresh.

However, we won't be back anytime soon after purchasing food that once we got home was out-of-date.  I took the food back and got my money back and told them this was irresponsible...met with nervous laughter and annoyance from the cashier.  Ugh.

This is an old hotel that's been restored and modernized. We had a standard room on the ground floor and were quite happy with the large room and beds the were comfortably firm, but not hard. The bath is a reasonable size. The only downside, as noted by another reviewer, is the noise. There is a bar across the parking lot that was noisy, and we could hear water running thru the pipes every time our upstairs neighbor flushed or showered. Still, I'd recommend it -- although consider asking for one of the EVEN numbered rooms, which are further from the bar on State Street.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Love!!! Their delivery service now that the new owner has taken over. Soooo convenient to have a choice!  I've NEVER had a bad pizza and have been ordering since 2005.  Quality is very consistent. Their pizza sauce is unlike any other..not bitter. Just discovered their Greek salad and I am hooked. Order it with a side of grilled chicken for a complete meal on busy weeknight.  Cheesesteaks and chix cheesesteaks are packed with meat and usually last us for dinner AND lunch the next day. Their cheesesteak and hoagie rolls are delicious.

It used to be my favorite place to go, but now I see they have succumbed to the pressure of their "endless pricing" option which, unfortunately, has meant that their quality has dropped SO low. The food is, without a doubt, disgusting and inedible; even the miso soup has no taste and is free of salt! Their sushi rolls taste stale, probably because they mass produce and refrigerate them. The main point is: the food is not fresh. I would rather pay more (or in other places, pretty much the same!) for better quality and better food. Sad to have to say this.

i have to tell you after reading the other reviews ,, we were more the anxious about eating here but we had this Groupon and had always wanted to try it. It was the Friday night of the July 4th wkend , so it was quiet but not dead.  We were seated immediately by a friendly hostess outside. A few minutes later, out came our waitress , Joie,  who took our drink  and dinner orders. My husband ordered the salmon special and I ordered the seafood quesadillas. EVERYTHING came out perfectly. It was a lovely meal and our waitress could not have been nicer. I have no idea what all the other reviewers were talking about. Give them a try.

Food bland and mediocre. Wouldn't recommend this place. With COVID and these Variants they should never allow their children/employees to sit at the same counter to eat and hangout where food is being handled/bagged. Needless to say no one wears masks and should never be that close to customers food period. The hallway leading to the restrooms were very cluttered with boxes and looked to me like other junk which kind of makes you wonder if those boxes contained some of the food that they cook and serve their patrons.

05/07/19: Food was good. Host was a jerk! He was doing paperwork and didnt even look up when greeting us (apparently smiling costs extra). We asked for a table by the water and he said one wasnt available. I pointed out two that were available. Then he said "You people make this too difficult!" He then proceeded to seat us in huff...away from the water. When I asked again about the tables we wanted he said "ok, I'll just leave the menus here and you people can go rogue." We then had to seat ourselves. Waiter was very nice, but service was slow. Will NEVER  return.

Very disappointed with this car wash.  Don't mind paying the $21.99 for the ultimate if you get the ultimate, but there was no evidence that our car was even vacuumed!!  They did at least dump the sand off the drivers side floor mat because when we went to leave the floor mat was covering our brake pedal.  No air freshener either.  Should of just bought the cheap wash as that is what we got for the money we paid.  Now we will have to vacuum our car ourselves, after we paid someone else to do it!  And definitely not friendly or service with a smile...should have went back in and complained but didn't want to wait another 45 minutes!

Not only is this central spot beautiful on the inside and out, but their three restaurants (gotta love the choices!) ALL use salad greens from their very own ROOFTOP garden!  As a farmer, this was the icing on the cake for me.  You can't get fresher food in a city than a restaurant who GROWS its own food.  I hope in the future they have more veggies to choose from their gardens (right now I think it's only their salads).  And I hope other Marriott hotels around the country start taking notes from the Chefs who made this happen in downtown/Waterside Tampa.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Usually I enjoy coming to Jeni's. I love their ice cream flavors etc. However, today was disappointing. I placed an order for two half scoops of ice cream and was accidentally initially charged for three. Fine, I told the cashier about the mistake before they rang me up. However, when they went back to give me my correct order, the ice cream scoops that I got were smaller than my friend's kid scoop of ice cream and I was rushed out of line. I get that this place can be busy, but I did not get my money's worth.

I LOVE THIS PLACE! The atmosphere. The service. The price. THE FOOD! How is it possible to cover all bases? I love the 2 for $20. You chose between soup or salad. Chose an appetizer, then 2 entrees. You can even get 3 sushi rolls as an entree. And, I'm not even kidding, I teared up the food was so good. From the soup (what I chose) to the steak and chicken hibachi, to the large selection of sushi rolls. AND, it was all for under $40! For 2 people! What the...? Listen, just go there. That's all I have to say.

I have visited this restaurant four times in the past year and have been satisfied each time.  The all-you-can-eat option for both lunch ($10) and dinner (around $18) is a great deal and offers many options. Dining with picky eaters is not a problem due to the variety of items on the menu. The lines can be long especially on weekends for dinner and reservations are not taken. 

Respect the "all you can eat" option as diners are charged for uneaten rolls (this ensures that food is not ordered and wasted unnecessarily).

Overall, I look forward to dining at Koizi again soon!

This was our first time back after many years and we will never go again. We arrived at 6:30 and told the hostess/server about our 8 PM show at the Arden. We waited 20 min for her to even take our drink orders. After an hour of waiting for food (the table next to us were waiting even longer) we looked for the manager and told him we were running out of time. He disappeared. At 7:45 the server came to tell us she was sorry that there were problems in the kitchen. We were sorry too - that we had ever gone there - and we walked out with no dinner and no apology from the manager.  Food may be decent but we will never bother to find out.

The website is outdated. I was on the phone with customer service for an hour just trying to get my online account set up. Once it was set up, I learned I was unable to pay my bill from an outside account without filling out more paperwork and mailing it in. I have only been a customer for a week now and can already tell I'm going to have issues with this Credit Union.  I would not recommend this credit union to anyone.  

On a positive note, I spoke to a real person on the phone and he was polite and professional. He was eventually able to solve the problem.

Overall, the experience was good. On the upside, the food was creative, delicious, and everyone enjoyed their meal. On the downside, the party behind us was ridiculously loud, the burgers were served lukewarm, and most of us left feeling a bit hungry still. Simplicity of the menu is admirable, but the non-burger side of the menu was underwhelming to say the least. So, fancy burgers in a semi-classy atmosphere is about the best I can do to summarize. Pricing was fair, just wish portions were larger or an additional side item was served.

I've been coming here for years (since it was Benkay), and it's by far the best Japanese food in Nashville.  I'm now living in D.C., but when I go home to Nashvegas, I always treat myself here.  I've spent extensive time in Japan, and the food at Sonobana comes pretty close to the authentic stuff (sans some of the sushi rolls that are laden in heavy ingredients like cream cheese that are meant to appeal to the American palette - but to be fair, these types of rolls are ubiquitous in sushi restaurants throughout the U.S.).
The wait staff are always friendly, and it's a Nashville institution!

This is our favorite sushi place in all of Indy. The food is consistent, affordable and pleasing.  The service can sometimes suffer on a busy night, but out of about 125 visits to this restaurant, only a couple times have had poor service.  The Asparagus Tempura rolls are OUT OF THIS WORLD.  The sushi slices border on the extra large side, which is hard to eat, and the wasabi can be too light sometimes...but I wouldn't change a thing in this friendly, delicious and wonderful restaurant serving great food at a great price. They offer cash discounts, so bring $$.

I'm here on business so I stopped in. The food was very tasty. But my initial observation was that the owner behind the counter was clearly sick and had touched her nose and mouth. She handled my credit card and had coughed then proceeded to go to the kitchen where she was filling containers of either soy sauce or teriyaki sauce. I stayed at the counter observing because I wanted to have a word with her about washing her hands. After I spoke to her  about it she did in fact wash her hands and the cooks looked up at me and smiled.

There comes a time in everyone's life, where they must remember René Descartes, "I think, therefore I am."

I only say this because my experience at this quaint Italian gig was extraordinary!

Discard your Italian History professor, because the table next has the insight of men and women utterly crushed under the foot of Mussolini and his notorious Blackshirts. I myself have been interested in the history of the resistors of fascism, and found the discussion of the dozen Italian individuals to be riddled with personal stories and tales of romantic heroism.

Live on, spirit of resistance! I award this fine establishment five stars!

We recently stayed at this hotel for our trip to New Orleans-we are bonvoy members and love to stay at JW properties whenever we travel. The hotel staff are responsive and friendly, rooms spacious and newly renovated, close to the French quarter (10 min walk to Royale and Bourbon Streets) and local pharmacies/convenience stores. We did have a minor issue with our room being cleaned-after it was cleaned, there was a foul odor coming from the bathroom. The staff were great in adding a $50 credit to our room and moving us to a more spacious corner room. Overall great experience and would come back again! Highly recommended!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Attractive property but completely incapable management on site on a Friday night.  They had a large wedding party who filled the lobby with intoxicated young people, pouring their own drinks, bringing beer from their cars, etc.  Hotel guests (which most of them are not) were basically told we couldn't get service in the bar or restaurant because of the out of control mob.  Perhaps asking people to take their coolers to their room - especially the uncarded minors would have been a smart call.  Waste of money to stay in a full service hotel that can't provide service...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ordered a Machaca burrito. Been here many times before. Service is hit or miss, but usually pretty good food. The consistency is terrible. Sometimes you get a really nice big burrito and other times it's a sad dried up small burrito with no meat. Before I would have given them a 3 star. But tonight I bit into several whole egg shells, not small fragments. I've attached a photo. These hurt my teeth and it demonstrates a very poor level of care from the cooks. What else do they neglect? Likely hand washing and good food safety. Will not be coming back. To find massive egg shells in my burrito was disgusting and I can not recommend this place.

Nice clean rooms, good breakfast. I would've given this 5 stars but they didn't put a shower curtain in the bathroom, when we called they said we have to pick it up at the front desk and install it ourselves. I know sounds like im just bitchin about little things but I paid almost $200 for one room for one night. It started out as around $149 and then added all the fees and taxes came up to $188. Disappointed. I was just gonna shower with no curtain and they can clean up the puddle on the floor the next day, but just couldn't do it so heres the review.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Since we were tourists, we decided to do the touristy thing and stop in at Spirits on Bourbon.
