I won't complain about the price of the drinks- it's par for the course considering the location.  We went in and had a seat and we both had the Resurrections.  They were ok.  Not great- but ok.  The mug was cool, but I wouldn't get the drink again.  We sat for a while and enjoyed the piano shows- they weren't the best players or singers, but their showmanship and enthusiasm more than made up for it and it was very enjoyable to watch.   Only giving 3 stars because the drink was only ok.

The cars are decent, and the service fills an important niche for those of us that don't want to own a car.  I've been a member for years, since the early days of Philly car share.  That being said, prices have continually gone up, and service has continually gone down.  After hours service is quite poor. Most recently they required us to change our passwords online and then we were locked out of our accounts - their telephonic support could not fix the problem so we were stranded without a car during an urgent situation and had to shell out significant funds for taxis.

The servers kept on giving me dirty looks and they gossip a lot, lots of laughing and screaming. It was pretty dirty in there. I waited 20 minutes for my coffee, and when I got it, it wasn't even hot. When I asked them to heat it up, they acted like it was such a burden. I got sighs and eye rolls. Super uncomfortable! I definitely didn't feel welcome in here. I'm glad I got out of there. There's lots of other Starbucks around the area that are cleaner, faster, and nicer than this one. I suggest going to those rather than this one. I'm not coming back here.

Best pizza I have ever had!! The crust is the perfect combination of thick/thin and chewy/crunchy. I have had almost all the pizzas, the Milano my favorite. All the pizzas are made with just the right amount of toppings and sauce so you can actually taste the crust and all of the fresh ingredients. This is one of those places where less is more, good pizzas shouldn't be and don't have to be loaded down with toppings. If you are wanting a pizza with a meh crust, extra cheese/toppings and generic sauce go to Pizza Hut.

This is traditional fresh sushi, not the trendy fusion Japanese sushi that seems to be popular lately. I come here at least once a month, and over the years, have developed my go-to order of: south street roll (salmon, fish egg, scallion, mayo), negihama roll (yellowtail and green onion), green river roll (eel, avocado, cucumber, eel sauce, seaweed powder), dragon roll and california roll (to balance out my palate in between the other rolls).  Their salmon teriyaki is also really good.  The waiters/waitresses are always very courteous, and the restaurant is child-friendly (which I appreciate).  My little ones love the tatami tables.

This was convenient, since I was staying in the hotel (which is pretty great), but I was disappointed with the food. The service was pleasant, although I had my dinner before my wine arrived. They have an odd system of bringing food from the kitchen, and the server seems to be out of the loop entirely. Just an order-taker and then you never see her again.

As for the food, the kale was tough and the "seared" salmon was overcooked. It actually seemed to have been baked and was quite dry.  There are way too many other good restaurant choices in the neighborhood, and I never went back.

Spacious and comfortable, friendly staff, delicious complimentary breakfast, amazing pool, allows pets, happy hour at the bar...I stayed here for the Tour De Tucson bike event. It was the perfect place to stay as the rooms are very large, have space for the bikes and equipment, and staff are extremely friendly.  
This hotel is not a glamorous, over priced Las Vegas resort, so perhaps that is why there are some negative reviews.  But, this place is really, really comfortable, clean, spacious, inviting, large hotel.  
I will stay here next year for Tour De Tucson, and I will stay here any other time I am in Arizona.  Great Place!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Gym is ok and suits my needs. One complaint I have is that the treadmills need to be serviced. The tread skips or sticks on most of them when you try to run, which can cause you to fall. They're fine for walking. The machines work fine and seem to get fixed quickly. Could use heavier dumbbells. The weekend staff is awesome. The trainers seem very nice. The morning guy that opens up on Mon-Thur has zero personality and doesn't acknowledge patrons coming in unless they say something first. He opens up on time though so as long as he does that I don't care.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
The doctor did not even check the fit on my contacts after putting in trial contacts during my contacts exam. She said that "it would be fine" if I didn't feel anything painful or if I didn't have blurry vision. I think she was in a big rush and was not thorough.

Service also takes forever. I wanted to change my prescription and had to go in multiple times to ask them to order new trial contacts (they messed up the order), and I had to keep calling them to ask them to fax over my prescription. 

Would not recommend if you have other options.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
This place has such great ratings so my expectations were high when I had dinner here last night.  I was so disappointed!  The appetizer shumai and gyoza were not tasty, unsatisfying, and obviously store-bought frozen.  I couldn't eat them.  

The fish itself was average.  The sushi menu has more cooked fish options than raw ones.  The guy at the next table asked the waitress "what's sashimi?"  Seems like this place may attract patrons who are not very sushi-saavy?  The rolls were ok and well-priced but definitely not special.  I will not be coming back nor will I recommend this place to anyone.

Daddy-O's is a family favorite!  We love the variety of homemade ice cream flavors and their frozen yogurt and toppings bar.  The tables and chairs inside and benches outside are always clean.  I'm surprised by the other reviewers who mentioned poor customer service as we've always been greeted with a smile and as for prices, you certainly get what you pay for in the amount of ice cream they give you.  The only thing we would suggest is to have more chunks of cookie dough in their cookie dough ice cream.  Otherwise, Daddy-O's is great and we highly recommend it!

The worst experience at a Starbucks I have ever had by far. Their order online system and online store hours said they were open, but they closed early due to a "glitch in the system". I knocked to try to say that we had a mobile online order and the employee practically yelled at me and said sorry we're closed. I said we had a mobile order and it was shrugged off and said we can contact mobile to get a refund. Absolutely ridiculous, get your hours and staff right. Shop local folks, Starbucks is going downhill.

If you're interested in bartenders treating you like garbage, come to the moonrise hotel bar. 

After forgetting my ID I was told I couldn't drink, no problem there, but was  then I was told I had to leave. Multiple times. I would have grabbed my ID had I not felt so uncomfortable by this bartender. While waiting on friends to finish their drinks (maybe three minutes total), two more employees show up. Making a weird situation, even weirder. None the less, we all left as soon as possible. 

Hire a doorman in the future. 

This was my first, and will likely be my last experience at Moonrise Hotel Bar.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: First time customer in search of the best local NY style pizza. My last favorite place closed. This place is a little out of the way for me but I think it will be worth it. My son & I both enjoyed an XL Cheese Pizza and I liked the personal size Primavera pizza. Well cooked, not burned, plenty of cheese and you can fold a slice in half to eat which is the way pizza should be! Will be back again. If quality is consistent, I will up my rating to 5 stars. It's not easy finding good pizza in DE, but I think I found it!

PROS:

-Beds very comfortable
-Room clean
-Location great. 

CONS:

-About $40 a day for parking! GUESS WHAT - Right across the St. it's $5 parking for a day (overnight)
-$15 -18 breakfast (spend it elsewhere, not worth it here)
-Bagels not free - $2 for one (decent cream cheese selection though)
-Who charges for WiFi anymore??? People who have $40 parking, $18 just-ok breakfast AKA: this hotel
-$3 to use WiFi for one hr, $13 for 24 hrs, $10 to access till noon (weird), $40 for one week
-No mini fridge either. 

Bottom line: I slept well but woke up disappointed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Do NOT go here. The manager and bartenders refused to talk to me after they incorrectly charged me more than they should have. It was my fault for signing without paying attention in the first place I admit, but after I realized they charged me double what it should have they refused to talk to me despite multiple attempts. At one point they even said that they have have an armed guard and that I should leave. Threatening a customer after you overcharged them is pretty sketchy. 

I will never go to this bar again and if you are reading this you should avoid it at all costs.

I literally HATE this location and avoid it at all costs. Unfortunately this was the one on the way and the one I normally go to was not an option. They got our drink order wrong which was a regular iced coffee with extra cream and sugar and a French vanilla iced coffee with extra cream and sugar. They had us wait for 5 minutes before even acknowledging us, and then had us pull forward to wait for our food even though the place was empty. I've never had good service here... thankfully the workers were respectful today, usually they're rude.

This will be the last time I purchase from here, I ordered from ritual app went to pick up food as it said it was ready. I get there and it still takes 5+ minutes after they sort out where my order is. Once my order is put together the person at the register throws my bag down on the counter. I ask about sauce and he gets rude. Sushi was rushed, flavorless and falling apart and hibachi rice is bland and dry, but you have to pay an extra $1 for sauce. No chopsticks in my bag to which I had to eat my sushi with my hands.

MICROWAVE! Really people not 1 of these reviews have mentioned that they cook most of their food in 1 of the 2 microwaves they have!!! The rib eye carne asada taco and the grilled cebollitos appetizer (which were very good) was the only thing cooked on the grill. Everything else we ordered was cooked in the microwave including the California Steak burrito that I ordered. They filled a cold tortilla with rice, beans, and PRECOOKED steak and then stuck it in a microwave and warmed it up! This is not real Mexican food! RIDICULOUS! Would never recommend this place.

Have been multiple times.  Last trip - I couldn't travel due to surgery, so the wife took the kids.  Service was different.  Didn't honor our status level, worse made my wife feel like she was trying to persuade or lie them into thinking we actually were at that particular level.  I called to speak to the manager....silence.  Tried again the next day....not a word.  Concierge said they'd call back....never heard.  

Just didn't have a great vibe after that and not the experience you want for you family traveling across the country.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Took my wife to celebrate her new job at Lupita's and what a mistake.  There are so many far superior Mexican food restuarants in Tucson with better and friendlier service.  The food ranged from pretty darn bad to mediocre at best.  They use hamburger and frozen vegetables for their Carne Seca...what a joke.  Worse yet, this was the first time in many years that I remember having to dicker over our bill which sucked because this was supposed to be a special night out for my wife. People who think this place is good need to go eat some real mexican food on the south side of town.

I was on a cross-country road trip with a strict deadline and panicked when I saw the "check engine light" come on. I stopped by this auto repair before they were open, nevertheless the employees met me graciously and offered to diagnose the car. I went across the street and had a cup of coffee and within a half hour they called me and had diagnosed and fixed the problem! And the best part, they didn't charge me for the labor! I was shocked. Other auto repair shops told me it would cost $$$ and take all day. I highly recommend this auto repair shop for their hospitality and quick work!

I've seen a couple of reviews being simply disrespectful about the staff. I have gone to gyms 5-7 days a week for 20 years. I have never been to a gym that has consistently treated me like I was a valued member as the planet fitness in Mt Juliet. It is always clean and the staff is as friendly as any place I've ever been. There have been two different situations that caused confusion with my account, and they went WAY out of their way to handle the situation and treat me with respect. If I could give this gym 10 stars I would.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Horrible customer service. The girl at the window said absolutely nothing the entire interaction. I will not be back here. I had a feeling her attitude was because she was the only one working. I called the establishment when I got home and she answered the phone rudely and found out she was the only one working. It's just the simple fact she had a blatant attitude that has nothing to do me. She's lucky to have a job during this pandemic and needs to learn basic customer service skills. I am a customer and should be treated as such. I was really upset after this encounter.

I've been a fan of Bliss for many years and have recommended to family and friends.  I dined at Bliss this past Saturday, February 16th and had a horrible experience.  We were seated in the cramped upstairs location when there were available tables downstairs.  When asked to be seated elsewhere I was told these tables were filled.
Our dinner rolls were hard and tasted old.  My appetizer had a mushroom sauce that tasted out of a can and was not warm.  Entrees were ok.  Lastly, our server was not attentive and we continued to have to ask for service.
Very disappointed that one of my favorites will not be a place I dine again.

This Starbucks is different from a lot of Starbucks I have visited in the past. For one, it is very diverse and the staff seems pretty friendly for the most part! It is also rather small, which makes it rather difficult to get in and out of the store/parking lot. 

As far as the coffee was concerned, my Cafe Mocha Latte was amazing, perfect amount of chocolate and just enough espresso! I have had this drink at other Starbucks before, but the one I had here has to be the best!

The staff is usually very kind, and helpful! The only con is that the store could be a bit more cleaner, especially the condiment bar, other than that.. thumbs up!!

There aren't many Chinese restaurants in Marana.  Of the two I've tried, this one is the better.  However, that being said, I wasn't all that thrilled with the food.  It wasn't bad, it just wasn't all that good.  I tried the free egg rolls, wonton soup, spicy chicken wings, and house lo mein.  The egg rolls were all right, didn't care for the broth or wontons in my soup, I prefer dry, breaded, spicy chicken wings.  These were sauced with sesame seeds.  The lo mein was good, but ordinary.  So much for the Fortune Cookie restaurant.  If I'm in Marana and dying for Chinese food, I guess I'd go back, but I'd order different things.

Very glad we gave it a second chance. Our first visit was pretty miserable, but we were with a large, somewhat difficult, large group (my family!) very close to Valentine's Day. Our second trip was much more enjoyable. We're usually not impressed with the average Tucson restaurant, but we were quite happy at Jax. Food was very good, service is extremely attentive. I had the sandwich special, which was a spin on beef au jus, and the hubby had a killer burger.  As with most decent food in Tucson, it can get a bit spendy, and the Ikea explosion-decor is pleasant but predictable. Overall, 5 stars for food and service, which is the part that counts!

Santa Barbara Taco Tuesday tour stop #2 finds us at Super Cuca's Taqueria. Lots of authentic food items on the menu. I got the Carnitas taco combo. This taco was like no other I've had as the flour tortilla was folded and buried under all the yummy goodness. A bit messy to eat, the taco filling included not only carnitas but grilled onion, zucchini, mushrooms and whole pintos. Three salsas to choose from and all were delicious. I give this place  Also, I heard the $10 burritos here are huge so I'll get one of those next time.

Every time I go into this branch (even pre-covid) I get told I can't do what I want done. Today I went in looking for a notary for a 3 min session to sign over a title I have to mail into my insurance company. So I walk in and they tell me the notary isn't there today and I can come back tomorrow. I bank with Wells Fargo, well I used to bank with them. I'm going to open up a new account with someone else and only use Wells Fargo to transfer money to my family. Totally useless branch. They're not helpful for anything except taking your money. Do not go here. A total dog $h!+ branch, the employees are terrible.

Chinatown used to be wonderful.  Excellent food, friendly staff, and we loved going there.  Then they changed.  About the time they remodeled (about two years ago), they changed chefs.  What was once delicious, now is just average.  We used to love their General Tso chicken - it was so unusual in that it was so very lightly breaded and so flavorful.  Their egg drop soup was exquisite.  Since the remodel, we kept on trying it again, hoping it will be as good as it was.  Last visit was yesterday and it will be our last.  Alas, woe are we as it is now just another average Chinese restaurant in Nashville.

I have been going to this service center for 5 years and last year they were bought out.  Since then the service sucks!  Before I would make an appointment, show up on time and be out in an hour.  Today I went in at my appointment time, was told it would take an 1.5 hours.  45 minutes later I asked for my keys back since they hadn't taken my car back yet.  What a waste of time!  I'm not sure why they even make the appointments or at least tell me when I arrive that they can't get to my car for another hour, then I could run another errand.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Found this new spot because of yelp.  What a great find!  We opted to sit at the bar, so we could chat it up with the bartenders. The staff is friendly, the beer selection is great, and the food is to delicious!  We both got burgers, which melted in your mouth. While we we're waiting for our food, we continued to browse the menu and pick dinners for our next few visits.  I believe we may be a regular here!  This is the place South jersey has been missing for awhile. A good food, non chain, not pretentious restaurant, with a corner bar atmosphere.

Went through the drive through and ordered a medium HOT French vanilla latte. I pulled up and waited about 5 minutes to even pay for my latte. A guy comes up to the window and I pay for my drink, he tells me to pull forward and he will bring me latte to me. I wait a couple more minutes and he brings me my drink, he did apologize multiple times for the wait. But I get home and the drink is completely cold, I heated it up in the microwave but it still wasn't good and I threw it out. I work at a Starbucks and I'm guessing they just didn't steam the milk at all and poured in cold milk.

Pretty lively as I entered -  a little party in the bar area.

Got a seat right away as a walk in,  place was half full.  Elderly crowd indicated its more early bird than night owl here.....

Great Pilsner on tap,  and the cocktail menu is a bit odd -  a lot of "house infused" this and that.  Didn't try it.

Short rib was a solid dinner option -  came out fast which is what I expect in a slow cooked dish prepared a day or so in advance.

They snuck some truffle oil into the polenta -  and that's a pet peeve of mine.  Mushrooms were listed on the menu,  but nasty synthetic truffle is too much for me -  I wish I had been warned.

This Mcdonalds is beyond awful, I have had a bad experience 5 times in a row before giving up on this location. Ordered a Egg Sausage Biscuit and a Breakfast Burrito and I kid you not, waited 15 minutes at the reserve spot before they brought it out. The food was not freshly cooked so its not like the delay was caused because they needed to make more.

The franchise owner or the regional manager needs to physically get his or her butt to this location and clean it up. This specific location is pure 100% unadulterated fail sauce in every single facet possible.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Amazing food!! Fantastic margaritas!! Great to go curbside pick up! Awesome Mother's Day dinner even if we couldn't dine in.. be patient when calling. It took me numerous tries(42) but there phone is ringing off the hook . Reason because the place is amazing!! I wasn't giving up because the prickly pear margaritas were my Mother's Day request!!  When they do open up and this pandemic is slowed down we will be back to dining and getting table side sals made. and on weekends they have live Mariachi bands which just adds even more to the experience.

Dustin is very professional and thorough. Our Winnebago RV stopped starting after parked for many months.

Dustin tested both batteries and replaced them promptly after finding out they had bad cores. He then diagnosed the ignition solenoid. He explained 12.8V was going into it from the batteries but had no voltage sent to the vehicle's ignition system. He ordered the part and came back out to install it.

My RV now runs and operates like it's supposed to. I highly recommended his services. Dustin is very knowledgeable, has affordable prices, and explained everything along the way.

All the hot food was cold, and all the cold food was warm. Our table of 6 was one of two tables in the place and we still waited 25 minutes for our first course.  The "special" was a two or three course prix fixe menu, which 4 of us opted for 3 courses... The portions were embarrassingly small, even our server apologized when he put down a veal Marsala "entree" the size of a silver dollar with about 5 strands of pasta. Soft drinks were not free refills, yet the wait staff refilled them freely.  Stay away from this place,they seem to be on their last legs.

Went last night for the first time. Both got veal parm which was delicious however the appetizer left a lot to be desired.  Clams casino was on the menu as middleneck clams.  The clams we got were littleneck, the shell was the size of a quarter so you can imagine the size of the clam.   Six of them for $9.50 was a bit pricey. I worked in the food industry and know the difference of clams and also not to complain. The waiter was very nice though. We will definitely try this place again but not with an appetizer.

BEWARE! I got multiple pairs of glasses from here that were great but the last pair of glasses I got here on January 30, 2014 the lens had small cracks. I brought this to their attention and they said they fixed it however there were still small cracks in the lens when they gave them back to me that caused a glare when I wore them. Glasses galore refused to fix them and said they did not see the cracks. They made me feel like I was imagining the issue and were absolutely terrible. I left the store in tears and decided to get lasik. LASIK was the best money I ever spent to never have to deal with these people again. Go somewhere else!!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
We went to Gratzzi upon the recommendation of friends who owned an upscale restaurant in the northeast.  My thought was that if they recommended it, Gratzzi's had to be good.  Gratzzi's is much better than good...it's outstanding!!  The food was great and the service was equally great.  Without question, we will be taking friends there in the not to distant future.  By the way, we drove from Lakeland to St. Pete to eat there.

I would encourage those dining to ask their server to describe the dishes and make recommendations.  Our server was right on about every dish the four of us tried.

We love this place! I was in Yelp writing a review for a bad place and thought I should share what a fun place this is. We probably go an average of once a month but they remember us! The food is always well prepared and the ambience in the tiki room is just spectacularly "Florida."  The owner and his wife are always there making everything right and the jazz on Wednesday night is super. We love to dance and its a great place to do it. It doesn't get too much better than this in the Hernando Beach/Spring Hill area.

Could be an awesome place, friendly staff, drive through, good location.. BUT, for those of us who dry clean clothes on a weekly basis, this place is WAYYY overpriced. We just moved from Los Angeles and this place is 2-3x as much as we paid there. Almost $8 for a pair or pants, thats insane. Shirts are reasonable, $2.50 i think. But they dont have punch cards or any deals/incentives to keep using them. So unfortunately, we are finding somewhere new. I cant imagine they will stay in business long with those prices and lack of customer satisfaction.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Was good, but the chef went way overboard with the salt shaker.  It made things so salty that it was made what would have been good food practically inedible. A couple at our table had been there a few times before and said it was never as salty. Without the salt it would have been 4 stars.  

The sushi was very good. The fried bananas and ginger ice cream were phenomenal.

The couple from our table also had another great piece of advice. Wear old clothes when you go because the hibachi (oil) smell really gets into your clothes. They were right.

Joey is the owner and cook. Italian Cucina is Joey.
The food is superb, best in New Hope. Joey is a sweet North Jersey guy, always a smile. You're his friend as soon as you walk in, his best friend before you leave. He enjoys sitting and talking with each customer, and each customer seems to be an old friend.
Did I mention the food is suberb? The salads are a meal in themselves, so share one with at least  2 or 3 people.  The house made sausage and spaggetti sauce are as good as my Mom's, and everything else is better! Never had less than perfection at Joey's

Business must be good at this restaurant as it apparently is unwilling or unable to fulfill a Grubhub order. Grubhub said this business did not respond to their order and so had to cancel my order (an hour after I placed it). I called this business and was told they received my order but it was cancelled for some unknown reason. The person I talked to was very nice and apologized and I'm sure had no part in the screw up but the owner / manager certainly need to be answerable for this failure. But it certainly won't be with me - goodbye!

So excited to try this newly opened Restaurant after reading the news.  However, the "hard-Ware" upgraded version of Chinese restaurant need to improve their food quality.  The good, table and floor are clean and the serving plates look elegant.   However, the food quality needs improving.  Th bitter melon we ordered was burnt and looks messy although the serving dish was pretty.  The main dish they offer on the menu already ran out early afternoon.  
Really wish this Hunan style  restaurant could provide a good alternative to other Sichuan style restaurants in Philly but seems like they still have a long way to go.

This hotel was very nice. The staff was professional and courteous to our needs. We had an incident where another couple walked into our room unexpectedly (maybe they double booked a room). Natalie, at the front desk, was very helpful and offered a discounted breakfast for us. I would come back here again if I ever find myself in STL a second time. Parking sucks though so beware. The only other complaint is that the walls are thin and you can hear almost everything in the hallway :/ 
Everything was very clean and the staff was professional as well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Where else can you have your car vandalized, a shooting, 2 water main breaks, doors broken off of hinges, and have the nightly smell of marijuana in your apartment from your neighbors smoking - all within a month? I have lived here for 3 years, and while the property was marginal when I moved in, it has gone downhill fast and hard in the last year - with no signs of changing. The low rent is not worth it, your security is a cosmetic afterthought here, at best. I have lived in an apartment in the ghetto of Charlotte, NC and in an apartment in Detroit. This is by far the worst apartment I've lived in, both in management and quality of living.

I had high hopes for some delicious wood fired-fired pizza. We were sorely disappointed. Although the delivery time was quick, the pizza and wings somehow managed to be cold upon arrival. At $16 for a medium pie, the margherita sauce was void of any flavor or substance, the portion size equivalent to about 3 normal slices and the cheese bland, this place really missed the mark. There was no crisp that usually accompanies a wood-fired pizza. The wings were cold, tiny and covered in cookie cutter hot sauce. For the money we spent I felt gipped. Try somewhere else.

This is my second stay in this hotel. I come every year around the same time to visit a friend who passed away. Last year- someone tried to solicit my mother in the parking lot. This year, I got here to walk into a room that was dirty, not vacuumed at all, and then there was a dead cockroach on the floor. I went to the front desk with this photo and asked them to switch my room- the lady at the front had a little bit of an attitude about it. But I wasn't going to stay in a room with a dead ass cockroach dude. Clean your rooms.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: As a Starwood Preferred Guest member I tend to stay in all levels of Starwood Hotels across the country.  Le Meridien is supposed to be the flagship. This was not the case. The rooms were small. They charged $9 for Internet and $14 for high speed. Really??!!  Two bottles of water in the room. One was free the other was $5. Go figure. No mini bar. The restaurant and desert bar closed early. The hotel was average at best and since I chose it for location, I have only myself to blame. I would rather spend less money and get better amenities at their sister properties such as Aloft.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We stumbled on this hotel. We always stay at Marriott properties. Last minute trip to Indy, so I searched on Marriott app. Gorgeous hotel!! In the middle of Carmel City Center - shopping, ice skating, and right next to the Performing Arts Center. Will check for events and definitely be back.

Hotel staff was amazing. Lisa checked us in and could not have been friendlier. Had breakfast on Feinstein's and Ashleigh was literally singing as she brought us breakfast. Continental breakfast was excellent. 

Had a double queen room - very nice. Nespresso, Alexa, Marriott bedding (always nice).
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My experience with optometrists have been hit or miss, but I must say, I am so happy to have found Drs. Gronquist.  They have a cozy spot nestled a little off State Street, and a serene office - usually eye doctors offices are stark and bright, but this is the exact opposite.  I haven't yet been in to see the Drs yet, and will update when I do, but I have dealt with the front office staff who honestly could not have been more helpful and accommodating to my different insurance issues.  They also have cookies and treats for kids and age-appropriate books for them to read as well.  A great find!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: We have ordered a few times and it has been great. However this last time I specified to make sure everything was mild. Nachos mild, enchilada mild, burrito mild and what happened it was all very spicy. To the point inedible. I reached out on the website and never heard a word back. If I could have gotten through on the phone that night I would asked for a redo. However the phone rang and rang with no answer. There are other options around who will follow my directions and actually follow up we will try them in the future.

We decided to stay here at Hampton.  We got here and there was Long black hair and pubic hair all over our comforter when we arrived.  I told a white older man about it and be was like ok whatever we will see what we can do.  Nothing happened so we talk to brittney she did everything on her power to make our stay better.  The maides on the other hand just left the stuff for us to change.  Honestly in the first place they didn't clean the room and just threw on the same stuff to make the room clean without changing anything at all.  If it wasn't for brittney we would have had a crappy stay.  When you stay at this hotel please check your room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have never stayed with Choice Hotels and will probably never do so again. The sink had a very slow drain, room door would not close without a lot of force, air condition was extremely loud, worst part... Fire exit door would not open from the inside or outside. This was the door that we were told to use to get to the room and the door we needed to use IN CASE OF FIRE! Front desk staff was apologetic and offered a 25% discount. Are you kidding? Pending a formal investigation through code enforcement and the hotels parent company.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Decided to treat myself for an old fashioned shave so I searched Yelp "shave" and since I was in the area I came in. Joe is a GREAT personality. He greeted me and I told him I wanted a straight shave. To my dismay he told me he didn't use the straight razor but assured me what he used would do just as good. To make a long story short I paid $25 + tip and didn't the shave I desired. The whole process felt rushed and the cheap disposable razor he used cut me in several places. I didn't get my hair cut their so I can't comment.

This is my go to motel when I return home to Delaware! No matter when, they have the best staff around who really care about your stay. Even during COVID, they made us feel safe, with their clean rooms and employees in protective gear. The price combined with updated spacious rooms can't be beat if you are traveling to Delaware. Located by Walmart, Dunkin Donuts, Hooters, and other convenient eateries, you have it all within least than a mile. I'm a regular and I've never been disappointed! Thanks to the management and staff!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My colleague and I had multiple interactions with an employee named Steven. I believe he was working in events at the hotel. He was incredibly rude, disrespectful and also seemed bi-polar in some interaction. Will not be coming back to this hotel after having a bad experience with such a rude employee. I don't remember his last name so I hope this does not get confused with another employee if they have this name. I just think attitudes like that get passed down from a potential lack of management skills or hiring faults. He needs to be reviewed and reminded of proper interaction with guests. Thank you for reading this.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is an absolute joke. Their staff will tell you anything to get a contracted membership with you even false statements on no penalty early cancellations and then when you go to cancel, they tell you that you can not cancel until the end of your contract. Then after your forced to be charges for nothing for a whole year, and you show up on the day it is supposed to end, they still try to charge you more to cancel. I was given the district managers information and upon no answer via phone or email, they finally allow a cancellation after charging just one more months fee because their shady AF.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
First and last time for us. Service was really lacking. We showed up with 7 and they were trying to seat another large group. They had 3 servers and the manager ALL working on it. The hostess walked by and said we would be helped. Her attitude and tone of voice made me want to leave. The food took a long time. The waitress kept trying to get me to drink more. Split a burger and the Ahi Tuna. They were good. Really liked sweet potato tots. 

The singer nearly mauled my friend by singing very close to her. This was the last straw.

It doesn't taste bad and it doesn't taste good. It actually taste like nothing. No love showed up in any of the dishes we ordered. The veg egg roll is half the size then the average and small the amount of filling had no flavor. The hot mustard packet was the best part. Beef and broccoli  zero flavor. Not beef not broccoli not delicious "brown" sauce. I just hope the cooks see this review and start tasting there food. Maybe go out to eat and see what others have to offer. Give it a try maybe it was a bad night.

Never felt more ignored at a restaurant.  10 waiters and our service was terrible. Chocolate sauce on our caprese salad instead of balsamic vinegar,entrees plopped down in front of us as the waiter walked away never asking if we needed anything. No one ever came to see if we wanted coffee or dessert and no limoncello. Had to flag someone down to get our bill then had to take it to the hostess to pay.   Besides all of that the restaurant was packed with tables close together and it was freezing. I understand businesses are struggling but there were "10 waiters".  Won't  go back.

Their coffee is rather tasty, which brought me there on a regular basis for some time, and they let you sit and work, which is nice. However their attitude is of the most arrogant ones I've ever encountered. The feeling is that they do you a favor. They don't take responsibility for their mistakes. Its ok to make a mistake, it's not ok to blame you for them - and there are some mistakes which are less tolerable. like serving you milk based drink when you asked for almond based, which you drink on a regular basis at the place.

Although I had noticed some negative reviews prior to picking Church and Union for dinner, I thought I would give it a go nevertheless.  Unfortunately, I had a bad experience. While my server was on point, the food was very disappointing.  BBQ shrimp app was solid, but dinner bread was cold and my KC Strip was over cooked (was supposed to be medium rare and came out well done) - a big miss for sure!! With the initial food order coming out really slow on a Thursday night, I declined the manager's offer of cooking a new steak for me, so I ate my fries and rolled out. Long story short, trust the reviews and look for other options.

My son took his car to Dobbs in Manchester. He needed an alternator.  He agreed to add 2 tires with alignment & a battery. Cost $1,000.  The mechanic said future repairs needed are rear brakes and a starter. He picked up the car at 5pm and it did not start. Mechanic said we told you the starter would need to be replaced.  REALLY, that's the response?!!  Had he not stopped at the traffic light would they say we told you brakes were needed?  When they called to say the car was ready to be picked up it's assumed it will start when you are ready to drive away. Do not go to this Dobbs!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I had a horrible experience at Urban Cantina on Monday evening. I walked into the restaurant at 845 (not knowing they close in 15mins). 
The waitress seemed annoyed but I wasn't sure why.. although I later found out they closed at 9.
That may explain the horrible service but the food was even worse!
Cold queso, stale and rock hard chips. I ordered from the "lite menu" .. a slightly fried tortilla with guacamole and a bean/corn salsa.. it was a huge burrito! Not lightly fried at all and I pulled it apart looking for the guacamole! I found none.
I was very very dissatisfied. I will not be returning.

Granted, I did purchase the cheapest wash, but I was disappointed with the new sprayer that is supposed to spray the front of the car before the wash. I had a lot of bugs on my windshield after a 10-hour drive, and the new spraying device didn't even touch my windshield. Only the front of the car. So since my windshield wasn't sprayed prior to the wash, after the wash was completed my windshield still had bugs on it. Disappointing as in the past when one of the crew members sprayed it beforehand, it was always 100% clean afterwards. They should get rid of this sprayer!

this is my go to place to get my acrylics done. it is fairly priced, and everything is clean and sterile. my only complaint is to make an appointment, this place is getting very popular (which is a good thing) but they will have you wait for a while if you just walk in and ask for something. there's never really a good time to go here, a so just call ahead of time and make an appointment and it will be better. if you get acrylics, ask for tina or lucy. in my opinion they are the best. overall, my favorite place to get my nails done!

Nothing but greatness is what i receive from this store. It's right down the street from my house. Always order a large Iced coffee to go and it's always made to perfection. Although I ordered a medium frozen coffee today for my sister and it wasn't great. I tried it and it didn't taste like coffee at all. I simply called back to let the store know, spoke to Molly. She apologized and assured me to come back next time and I would get 2 free orders next time I visited. I don't know what happened 5+ months ago, but customer service is never a problem any time I go. Friendly staff, great smiles all around, my favorite DD in the county!

I always get my acrylics done here. They usually do a really good job (maria is the best). Everything is super clean and sterile. The prices are pretty good too. 

The only bad things i have to say is they constantly push you to get extra stuff done. Like if you're getting a manicure they keep telling you to get a pedicure and vise versa. Finally after telling them like 10 times they'll drop it. I understand its a business but pushing people is just annoying. Also, sometimes when they file my nails they'll file down my skin and make me bleed but i don't even care cause my nails always look good ‍

The amazing owner Claudia saved my daughters hair!! My 5 year old daughter decided to be her own hair dresser and chop off sections of her hair!! After the job she did I knew we had to have it fixed immediately! I had unpleasant experiences at the downtown location but seeing as this supercuts is newer I thought we would give it a try. The owner Claudia was fabulous, she talked my daughter and I through the whole cut! She made my five year old feel very comfortable and made a chopped up mess look great! We are really happy with the results and definitely plan on going there for all of our family cuts!

First off, i dont know where Carrie went but she definitely did not go to the Drayton Automotive i went to. Obviously an employee or owner created a false alias.

Furthermore, what i have to say is simple and quick. Ed Drayton is a scum-bag and con artists, who will rip you off. When asked for my money back on a false promotion and false advertisement, he laughed and said i should contact the FBI or CIA. Don't go to him, you will regret it. If there was any rating lower than a one, i'd post it, cause a one star is generous.

It's Boise's only 70% Hand car wash...they still have an agitate machine that hits  your cars paint. They do a decent job but ALWAYS LEAVE water on your car. They don't clean the roof and the power washer at the beginning only does the passenger side. For the money it costs for a single interior/exterior wash they should spend more time getting it dry and clean. They use a single squirt of tire dressing...by the 3rd and fourth tire there's nothing left. I have matte wheels that they try and skip out on cleaning EVERY time.  Also closed on Sunday's...really? The weekend?

Wow, just wow!  What a cool compound. I'd love to get a peek at some of the rooms!  School, Rectory, Convent and Cathedral now the hotel compound that houses the Elysian bar, super cool. I wish this would stay a secret repose from the FQ and Frenchman, but alas, word is already out and the place is already packed. Luckily we went late on a Sunday and it wasn't too bad, but I can see how the small bar would get super tight. Small and large plates, imaginative and well thought out, no wonder, Alex Harrell!  Probably too short of a walk off the beaten path to keep it quiet for long!

I had used these opticians for 20 years. Recently they have been having quality issues. Maybe it is the new owners. Two recent pairs of glasses were incorrect. One the lens was placed in the frame rotated about 15 degrees, which is huge if you are astymagmatic like me. In the other glasses the prescription in the lens was off by 7 degrees in axis and 0.75 in cylinder. These findings were given to me by my Ophthalmologist and confirmed by another optical shop. After a discussion they refunded my money. Which is why I gave they 2*.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
DO NOT go to this Alamo.  I rented from them last year and clearly said no to the insurance and they charged me over $100 anyway.  Against my better judgement I tried to rent from them again recently.  I have never been treated so poorly in my life.  The manager Nabil S needs a customer service course urgently.  Instead of making the situation better he chose to antagonize us and make it worse. I am not the type to waste my time writing reviews, so me doing so tells you how serious the situation is.  

If anyone knows how I can contact someone with authority pls advise.

Arrived approximately a hour early than estimated. Was told the only vehicle available was a luxury vehicle and would be a increased price. This place had "none" no midsize cars or SUVs available (I would have paid extra if one was available due to being early). Awful do not use, no help, no inventory. I'm guessing if I waited for a hour they would have had loads of vehicles arrive (sarcastic). We will never even try using this company again. I would have given 0 star if I could. Also the 2 miserable employees didn't help. Made us feel like we were a bother to them.

Bad customer service. I walked in to business one guy was at counter doing paperwork and the other 2 saw me pull up and went to garage area and the guy doing paperwork looked up at me and went back to his paperwork never acknowledged me or said be with you in a second or nothing then we he was done with paperwork he went to garage area so now I'm alone. I waited 5 minutes or so and then wrnt amnd talked to all three of them in garage and spent my money elsewhere I believe it was a black and white thing to me would never visit again

La Prima is a fantastic local shop for pizza and many other items on it's menu. My wife and I have been enjoying the fare there for over 10 years, and now our 2 daughters also love the place. I've read other reviews that the staff / ownership can be rude or abrasive, and yes there have been some wait staff over the was that were no good, Willie has always been a great host and always one to stop at our table and chit chat with us.

We were gone to Boston for 2 years and the whole time we all missed Willies pizza !

Best Italian in the area!! We drove up and made a reservation they said it would be about 40 minutes. We was seated in 20 minutes tops. Friendly staff. The appetizers are amazing!! They have a great wine selection! They bake their own bread it's really amazing! The house salad is amazing the atmosphere is great! The rest of the food is simply to die for went there with six people everybody bragged about how good the food was. Good portions great price!! The owner makes sure everybody is happy that means a lot nowadays. We will definitely be back next time we're in the area!!!

This was the first time I was renting a car on my own.  Alamo car Rental in Tampa was awesome! The representative at the ticket counter was great. When I returned the car, the representative Nikki was so Great! She ended up not charging me for the fuel that I used. I didn't realize that there wouldn't  be any gas staations close to fill up prior to arriving at the airport. It took me super long to get  there, because I was driving in the wrong direction for at least an hour. I felt super blessed that she was so kind to me. Thank you for an awesome experience!

We had dinner here last night and the food was very good. Service was great, too! But I have to say I really hated the atmosphere. The front bar room, that I've visited many times in the past, is very nice...soft lighting, relaxing vibe.  When our party arrived last night, we were led to the back dining room.  It felt like we were walking into a bad diner. The lights are so bright. Everything seems so out of date. And the hanging lights over the tables were really dusty. It's too bad because we really enjoyed our food but the atmosphere kind of killed the mood. I will definitely go back, but I'll likely just stick to sitting at the bar.

Was looking forward to the potential of a good Japanese restaurant in the area. I'm Japanese so was looking forward to the quaint space and the menu looked great. Unfortunately, servers are not familiar with Japanese food. Server watched watched tennis on tv just a few feet from us the entire time. Didn't know menu items. I ordered a tempura shrimp lunch and got a large plate of friend shrimp and veggies. No rice. No dipping sauce. When I asked for these things, the server was perplexed. Fish wasn't fresh for the nigiri. Spider roll was a mess. I won't be coming back.

This Burger King seems to need a lot of help in the customer service department, I'm there atleast 2 times a week and get the same bad service each time...the employees don't seem to give a care that you are even in the building and when they finally go to take your order they just stand and stare at you until you walk up...I ask my cashier today how she was doing and she didn't say a word...I told her what I wanted and said thank you and still no response. The only word she said to me was "name?" 
This BK needs a management overhaul, the current management team in place obviously lacks leadership

This place has a very charming back patio. The food and Pinot Grigio were good, but the service could have been better. There is only 1 other table occupied at that time, but our server didn't really check on us as often as he should and he seemed like he didn't want to be there which didn't give us that good experience. I think it would have been better if our server was more hospitable. He must not be having an okay day, but this is a lovely place to have a meal and I definitely recommend for anyone to try this place when you're in the area.

Was in Santa Barbara for a little down time.  Was walking the shops and then time for dinner.  Smelled good so stopped.  We sat outside in the cute patio with the heaters.  Service was good. The food was tasty - had the swordfish chowder, ravioli w/sage & shrimp and veal parmigiana.  But, ooooh, my gosh it would have been sooo much better if the food was actually hot.  The chowder actually had nice chunks of fish but it was totally luke warm.  Dinner entrees were just warm. Really should have had them returned but we were starving.  Too many other places to try to bother returning.

The Caesar Salad contained fresh lettuce and crisp croutons, but the dressing had been thinned out, possibly with milk or water... not so good. Because we had seen recommendations for the pizza, we ordered the BBQ chicken version, which was highly recommended by our waitress. The pizza must have been sitting in the back for quite some time, because it came to the table at room temperature. The chicken was plain white meat with no hint of BBQ at all. Overall, the pizza was very bland; apparently they don't cook with garlic or spices at Bella's. The crust was decent. Overall, with all the local options for pizza, we will go elsewhere next time.

Machines are good and plenty to use. Never crowded. Good personal trainer session area. Cons: they clean the machines ... while you are on them. The vacuum chord is like an industrial length size and a huge liability the way they plug it in to one end and proceed to vacuum a very large area. Seen many people almost trip on it. Plus: quantity of machines, kept in good use, inexpensive, owner seems lovely. There is a second gentleman I've seen mostly at nights that is very difficult to deal with. I've seen many customers arguing with him. Verdict: not bad, but for the same price I would go to Planet Fitness.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I went for an alignment and made an appointment online. When I left with my vehicle, it was jerking and unstable -- next day Took the vehicle to Firestone complete auto care, and learned that my front lower ball joints were extremely worn out on Both sides. vehicle was unsafe to drive. The fact that the mechanic did not notice this when the alignment was done is extremely concerning. When I called to get a refund, the service manager advised me that the reason they did not notice this is because I made my appointment online. Absolutely unacceptable. I will never go back.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I ordered take out for two people-  16 inch Hawaiian pizza, poppers and pepperoni sticks which came in just under 30.  My go to place was Palermos but not after this meal.  The dough on the pepperoni stick was soft yet crunchy.  The ham used on the pizza was a nice thick ham, not just thinly sliced lunch meat ham. I can't stand when pizza places use that thin lunch meat on a pizza.  No shortage of ham and pineapple either. The second awesome thing (and important to me) the poppers had a cream cheese filling and not that yellow cheddar cheese.  LOVE IT!  I can't wait to try other things.

this mcdonald's is slow on business there is always a line when you go up into the drive thru and when i went they took my order at the drive up and i said TWO sweet teas and that was on my paper and they were demanding me to give them $1.09 for another sweet tea when i paid for it all ready i don't think they are good on businesses at all they can't hear through the microphone thing and they need to get their working under control because they have some nasty mouths to the customers and they need to lose the attitude they have there
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This is horrible customer service that I am dropped off to pick up my rental for the time designated to pickup and your "customer service" makes no effort to solve this issue if they don't have a vehicle for me!!!!! Real smart and horrible unsafe customer service!!! I'm stuck with no ride in cold weather and rain!!!  Don't rent vehicles to people if you don't have them!!! I am stuck like chuck and you guys don't give a crap!!! It's literally 8am when you open and my reservation is for 8 and they were "going to call me" wow!!! Don't offer a ride don't offer ANYTHING!!!!!

Been a member for a year now. It's okay, but for the price, if you are looking for a true bodybuilders gym, look elsewhere. Despite the massive floor space; the equipment variety is extremely lacking. The free weight area is extremely limited. Dumbbells stop a 90lbs, there is no barbell shoulder press, and there is only one zbar and smith machine for the entire floor (BUT DONT WORRY they have 7 bench presses!) (LA fitness, PSC, and sweat offer a greater variety of equipment at half the price). They keep saying they are going to expand dumbbells but never do.

On the plus side it is clean and new inside and they have great hours.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I needed to get my eyes examined so I decided to google nearby Eye Doctors in the area.  Which brought me to Yelp.  I saw a great reveiw on Dr. Abbate, called and found out that he took my insurance and decided to make an appointment.  I am so glad I did.  Dr. Abbate was very attentive, patient and immediately made me feel at ease.  He took the time to talk to me and explain what he was doing as well as made sure I was getting the right prescription suited for my needs. Anyone who needs to get their eyes examined go to Dr. Abbate!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is the absolutely WORST DD I have experienced.  They are rude, slow and when it is convenient for them....they "don't fully understand the English".  They refused to honor the Eagles win on Sunday November 8 by giving me a free coffee.  The younger one just walked away from the window saying " don't know what Eagle you are talking about". Once the older women came to the window, she said I would have to prove they won or come back at 11 am, but she will give me a medium coffee for $.99.....I will be contacting the corporate headquarters!!!...The WORST!!

Was there a few days ago waiting on line to withdraw money using the teller. Short older lady with short black hair and a red sweater offered to help me deposit a check. I said no I'm withdrawing money and she looked at me like I had six heads telling me I could use the atm. I told her it was a lot of money and would prefer the teller. She proceeded to ask me how much it was which I found to be extremely rude. I get the whole social distancing thing but that was intrusive, made me feel uncomfortable as there were others around me, and poor customer service.

I use National quite frequently, and the service at this location is just not consistent. I have received the best service, and I have received the worst. Recent experience at check-in started very pleasantly by the agent greeting me and asking me about the car and the trip, until I brought up an issue, and the agent immediately became dismissive and aloof, and she literally walked away mid-sentence. The three star rating is for the operation in general, as this last experience deserved only one star at best.

The food was typical Mexican restaurant fare but the wait staff tried to overcharge us. First, we asked to order the 32 oz margarita which was listed as a special for the night. The waitress told us they didn't have a 32 oz margarita, which when we went to pay I confirmed it was listed as the special of the night. I ordered chicken and shrimp fajitas. Instead of ringing this up as Texas fajitas, the waitress rang up shrimp fajitas, add chicken for a difference of about $5.00. We received about 5 shrimp so not a lot of shrimp to us justify the difference. For typical Mexican fare, I would recommend going elsewhere.

For the price, this hotel is about what you would expect. The room was clean with the exception of some residual hair on the floor in the bathroom (which remained there even after housekeeping hard "cleaned" the room on the second day). It has a slightly dated feel but not overly so. The free breakfast is ok if you can stand the usual buffet vultures hungrily piling their plates high with the last of the sausage and eggs, sometimes shoving food in their faces before they've even got back to their table. The pool is ok but small, with a water slide.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Piada used to be my favorite place to get a fresh tasty pasta infused with a salad. I havnt been there for a while, and i was disappointed with the service today. The employees preparing orders had an attitude, they were picking vegetables with the same gloves they wiped the counters with. The tables were not cleaned, and i definitely did not have a clean meal as i threw up not too long after my meal. Today will be my last visit to Piada sadly. I hope management can work on improving their current situation.

"new ownership"?
They guy tells me everyone had to be fired because they were undocumented immigrants.  The new employees are clueless.  I tried calling for over 6 hours with a busy signal. I finally decided to drive there.  They never even realized the phone hadn't rang all day. They have NO pizza portal, no menu board working, the open sign was broken, dirt & trash on the floor, no idea how to make the pizzas.  After waiting over 25 minutes, I asked for a refund.  The guy did NOT apologize for my trouble at all.  They should be closed until further notice!!!

I had some business to do on Tatnall Street in Wilmington, and afterwards I was looking for a nice restaurant to have dinner.  I walked down Orange street to the Ameritage and when I walked inside it was like a transformation.   The environment and decorating was "first class".  I sat at the bar and had a drink and then proceeded to have dinner.  If you enjoy good food and good atmosphere then this restaurant is a "MUST".  Make this one of your stops if you get to Wilmington.  It is worth the time and effort to go out of your way to experience this dining opportunity!

Hit and miss with the food. Appetizers (egg roll and crab rangoon) are not universal, meaning you have to have certain dysfunctional level of taste buds to enjoy those. The princess chicken and fried rice were amazing but gollee this place is expensive. Also, my party had ordered steamed rice and he was able to fork and lift a couple good golf ball size clumps of Hard rice. When be asked for fresh rice she seemingly rolled her eyes, took it to the back, and pan fried it!! *face palm*

 Anyone know of a great chinese spot on the east side? Taking suggestions.

I have been a loyal customer of El Rodeo for years.  The food is consistently good, and the service is usually strong.  Many of the servers have become acquaintances over the years as I've gotten to know them.  

The food is good, and I've tried many different menu items.  My go-to dish when I'm just ready for something good to eat is the burrito loco...a huge burrito full of chicken and steak served with guacamole, sour cream, and rice.  I also am a big fan of the nachos carbon appetizer and the rodeo taco salad.

Everything is always fast and good.

I initially signed up for their unlimited car wash in April. The first problem that I had with them is their equipment broke my rear window wiper. They order a replacement from Amazon that took 3 weeks to get in. Then it didn't fit and the manager was going to order a replacement. this never happened and I ended up cancelling my membership on 5/27/2021.

Other issues that I had was the lack of their brushes hitting all the areas on my car. They have a limited number of vacuum spaces that on a weekend you can forget about getting one.

I would recommend trying someplace other than this one to get your car washed.

My car wasn't in the best condition because it is a 2003 however, when I went through the car wash one of the trims that go all the way across the top of my car and side of the windshield became broken (this was not broken before my car went through the machinery). Instead of returning my call after filling out a damage report it's been about 2 months without hearing anything from them at all. I didn't even expect anything (maybe a refund on the wash) or even an APOLOGY. Very unprofessional. Glad that's the only time I've personally ran my car through their place of business. Lesson learned

I've visited Coffeehead twice as I work around the corner and I have to say that I have been disappointed on both occasions. My first visit I ordered a regular coffee which I thought was very weak and on the 2nd visit I ordered a ham, egg and cheese sandwich and I was very disappointed to see that the eggs are not cooked to order and therefore the sandwich was incredibly tasteless. 
I wanted to like this place because I want to support local business. Also I do think that the staff is incredibly friendly and nice and helpful. Perhaps I will give it one more try for the homemade quiche.

recommended by a friend so we went...

atmosphere - very nice - used to be an old church

service - fast efficient - not too much personality, but she got the job done

food - eh... it was okay.  nothing too great - I felt it was a bit overpriced for what you got.  Not saying the food was bad or anything like that - it was just overpriced.

It is BYOB during the week (Which we didnt know) so we purchased one of their bottles of wine - 30 bucks for something that was in the state store for 12. But as a heads up - if you go during the week, bring your own bottle!

I've been using theses guys since they opened, I think.  Most of my experiences have been pretty good, but this last time was dreadful.  I had waited OVER an hour of my scheduled time while the staff was standing around chatting and laughing (the doctors, too.)  When they finally said it was my turn, I asked if I was going to have to wait in the exam room some more ... and when they said "yes" ... I walked out and went to a different company nearby. 

I truly can't say that I'll ever be back.  That was just so rude ... with no apologies, no nothing.  Most of the eye glass places are about the same price, so it probably doesn't matter much.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Do not waste your time or money poor customer service manager Alex is horrible they been charging my credit card since 3 years called many times to cancel they would not cancel over phone but also didn't mind to bother to tell me I can cancel by mail but instead charged my credit card $780 for 3 years when I never walked in the gym the only time I came in was to apply and after that because of health issues never went but they did not care to help to even offer to come back for at least a week for free poor customer service
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Basically, my thoughts on the place can be summed up with a simple "Eh.."

Food is pretty much tasteless - the best thing on my plate of French Toast, sausage, bacon, and eggs were the eggs. That's kind of pathetic. 

The place is not kept that clean - especially the bathroom where someone had left a dirty diaper on the changing station. It was pretty nasty. 

Our waitress was not friendly or polite and they weren't even that busy. But that seems to be the typical demeanor of most SoCal girls.

You are better off going to a Carrow's or Denny's or similar. You'd get better tasting food for a better price.

Stopped in with my wife and kids last night after dinner. Product was decent but the two employees were awful. The one was eating her cheese steak  behind the counter right in front of customers - disgusting and a major peeve. The other informs me that the napkins are on the wall after I have my hands on the stack of napkins next to the register. Fine, but drop the attitude. Apparently they were placed there only momentarily by an employee. Will I be back? Probably not, there are more froyo places popping up all the time. Those that combine good product and service will survive. The ones with crappy service will eventually close.

Really NO STARS. worst service ever. Waited. Gave order in drive thru of 10 of nugget meal, 6 pc nugget meal and 2 Oreo mcflurries. Finally get to pay, guy asks what's your order. We give it and says we didn't order. Seriously. Another person who had heard order over the system looked in system and couldn't find order. Another lady then tries to put the order in (hubby ready to pull away like the two other drive offs behind us). The lady is trying to tell us price  and there is nothing comped.  After waiting 15 minutes nothing. Hubby drives off.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have worn glasses for most of my life, lived in 6 different states and had eye exams in all 6 states.  The quality of eye care at Eagle Vision One is far superior to anything I have ever experienced.  The Doctors are outstanding, the technology is cutting edge and the customer service and selection of frames is beyond compare.  The sales staff does NOT work on commission like most eye care facilities in the area. The Doctors and Staff at Eagle Vision One are focused on your eye Health, not the amount of money you spend on your glasses. I recommend Eagle Vision One to all my friends and family.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Central Bar and Kitchen is an average hotel restaurant with a new menu. If they aspire to cater to anyone other than tired hotel guests, changes are needed. 

The restaurant needs to offer a more compelling burger to stay competitive in Nashville. The bun was nothing special and the meat so-so. Almost any restaurant near Vanderbilt offers a better cheeseburger. I paid $12 for an Old Fashioned and by the time the drinks were brought to the table the ice had melted considerably. The only reason I might return would be the outdoor patio area that looks newly renovated.

This was the first time in Tampa and I was glad we chose Le Meridien. There were "welcome"cookies in our room when we arrived.  The room was immaculately clean. I loved that it was the old courthouse, and many of the doors and terrazzo floors remained which added so much character while still being a very contemporary in style.  We were in walking distance to several restaurants.  We went to First Watch for breakfast. The front desk personnel were very friendly and helpful. I would definitely stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We came here on Sunday and while we waited for out to go food we were watching the kitchen staff... Yuck!!! At one point one of the cooks was walking with a bowl of fries and put his hands in it to grab some for himself but made eye contact with us and stopped. Just a few minutes later another cook dropped a grilled chicken breast on the floor and looked around to see if anyone saw and put it back on the grill! I about died! Needless to say we ate the chips and salsa and threw away our grilled chicken dinners!

There is absolutely nothing better than treating yourself to great Chinese takeout after a long week, and their number is in my phone contacts! They even have a dandy way you can order online, so you can order takeout from your Smartphone from the East side, and by the time you drive there its ready. PERFECT! Their soups are classic and delicious, and I have never had a bad experience there. Sitting down dining is always a hoot, the older ladies there are sweet and funny and always attentive. I tip well every time, no matter whether its dine-in or take out. You may even luck out with the occasional free eggroll if they're in a great mood!

It's 2:35am right now. I'm compelled to write this review based on the fact that I'm having trouble sleeping due to the high pitched squeak this place emits every 5 seconds. I'm guessing to repel birds? They must have gotten tired of cleaning up poop but that frequency is still within my ears' ability to take in and I think it's ridiculous that I can hear it inside the room.   The room is nice and big though. Clean. Fridge and stove and microwave. Bar prices not what I'm used to. $8 for a shot?? Some kids were having a hodown. Cops came. Woohoo
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: They did my nails awful. The lady said my nails were dry and she told me I was able to leave. They weren't dry. It was the ugliest manicure I have ever received. They chipped immediately & I had to paint them a few days later. I would have gone back but it was a ways  from my house. I went there because I bought a Groupon.  The nail tech seemed like she was in a huge rush to get to other clients or was she pissed because I had a Groupon? She said she has been getting lots of those and rolled her eyes.  I will never go here again.

Oh, i promised myself never to patronize this hell hole again. I lived here for a month when i first moved to town. I was desperate for a hotel because of Hurricane Irma, no power at my house. Check in is 3pm. I called earlier because i have to bring my dog and didnt want to wait. Well, still no room. Its 3:40. This useless manager walking around with nothing to do and 3 clerks. Saw 2 housekeepers and they were sitting around talking to each other. Unbelievable. I used to have my company employees stay here from out of town but they said the rooms and service are better at hotels half the price. The whole management team should be fired.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
A shout-out to our mechanic of 20+ years, Nas, the owner of Turchi Enterprise Automotive on 635 Germantown Pike in L.F. (next to The Persian Grille).  Nas and his other mechanic, Tim, put a new after-market catalytic converter in our 2009 Toyota Prius, after ours got stolen 3 days ago - and this one does not have the metal that the thieves like to steal.  (Nas said they can look at the converter and instantly tell.)    

Nas and Tim are incredibly honest and do awesome work.  They have worked on at least 4 of our cars over the years.   I highly recommend them!    (Be patient if you call, since they are usually in the garage.)

I was highly disappointed. The bolognese was less than room temperature and insipid. The sauce is from a jar, not even prepared in house. I was sitting at a table with a view to the kitchen and saw a cook holding a jar of red sauce. The seafood risotto was very salty and cold. The sponge cake in the chocolate mousse was very dry, not moist at all. The only thing I enjoyed was the mozzarella in the burrata salad ( very creamy and flavorful, not chewy) and the prosecco, which the restaurant can't take credit for. For the price, it is not worth the visit.

When I read the reviews, I couldn't wait for my food to arrive!! The delivery was a reasonable amount of time and the delivery guy was nice BUT the pizza was horribly cold and dry!!! The burger roll was hard!! I would never order here ever agin and I have great coupons given to me by the delivery guy and am still going to pass lol!! I don't know if ppl were hired to write these reviews but don't know which place their referring to because it sure isn't Mama Venezia's Pizza!! Disappointed and what a waste of a cheat day! From Lema.

P.s
I had the chicken parm pizza and a cheese burger...

I have used this location many times over the last couple of years.  I keep expecting it to be different but it never is.  The main complaint is the time it takes to get from the terminal to the Getz location.  They send a bus about every 20 minutes and most times there are two buses together.  If you are not there when it comes you have to wait 20 minutes longer for the next 3 minute trip to the rental cars.  The service returning isn't much better but they offer you a $15 ride back to the terminal if you want.0

It's hard to find a good sushi place in Santa Barbara with the limited options we have, but this place never disappoints. The outside look of the restaurant may throw you off, don't fret -- the inside is cute and pleasant. We have tried a lot of the menu and one of the favorites is the salmon sushi... it seriously is so good. The rest of the menu is really good, it'll be hard to go with a bad choice. 

Definitely come here if you're looking to have a reasonably priced sushi dinner with good flavor and freshness.

I never write reviews. I seriously went out of my way to download Yelp to warn people of how appalling this car wash has become. They used to be great. I'd come once a week. Their vacuums used to work great, now they barely suck anything up. They had a power wash, which was needed because their machines doesn't take everything off, and they took it away. I used to tell everyone I knew how spectacular this car wash was, now the only thing I'm going to do is urge them to find a new car wash place with a power wash and strong vacuums..

It's definitely not the spiffiest of setups, and the staff people are a little curt and direct (but this is Philly after all), but I have to give them four stars. I've worn contacts for years, but for some reason the optometrist here was the first to notice that my prescription (which I've renewed regularly and at different places) was not right for me, size-wise. So she caught something that other optometrists didn't know enough or didn't care enough to catch. Or they wanted to unload their regular stock of contacts. Who knows. It's made a huge difference.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The service is great! I got the warm spinach salad which I enjoyed. My husbands, the mushroom bruschetta was okay. The entrees were eh, especially considering the price. I ordered the chicken Marsala which was good but very salty. My husband ordered the limoncello which was below average. My daughter got the kids spaghetti and meatball (not plural). The sauce was bland and the meatball tasted like the frozen kind you buy in the store. Also the pastas were overcooked. The saving grace was our waitress who was attentive and very helpful as we have a lot of food allergies, but we will not be coming back.

We gave this place a try at 5pm on a weeknight so we could grab a bite with our toddler and not disturb others. The server was so friendly and kind.  Our baby loved all the mirrors, plus for mom and dad as that kept him entertained.

We ordered several rolls including a CA roll, spicy tuna roll and shrimp tempura roll.  All were tasty and not enormous, this is a good thing in my opinion because I could fit a piece in my mouth without that awkward monster sushi roll moment where you're struggling to chew and swallow!

We also got the chicken teriyaki plate.  It was fresh and healthy with rice and veggies. 

We will definitely be back!

I had to stay here back to back weeks for work and was unhappy with the cleanliness both weeks. The first week the shower and the towels were dirty.
