I had to go through two towels before finding a clean one. Told the front desk the next morning about the shower and towels. They said they would make sure it's all cleaned before I get back. It wasn't. 

Second week here and there's hair on two of the pillows on my bed.  

The rest of the hotel is pretty standard.  Staff is friendly. Small gym. Typical restaurant/bar. Concierge has full water bottles.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I find it completely offensive that our country gave them opportunity to better themselves but they don't enforce mask mandates. They are killing people one by one by letting people even as the CDC says no matter your status vaxed or not wear a mask.. they are only into collecting the cash. Greedy selfish people. Screw their customers so long as they live long enough to swipe the card. Disgusting. Ill NEVER go back there. BOBKAT LIQUORS IS RIGHT DOWN THE ROAD. its more upscale and enforces masks listening to the guidance of our government.

A 10 star stay. Came for our anniversary last minute. Property is well kept and beautiful. Tucked away in the mountain was so peaceful. The absolute best staff I have ever encountered at a resort. Not one person walked by without a smile and a greeting. Front desk, Housekeeping was excellent and pool staff great. The breakfast at the Core restaurant was exceptional and my compliments to Javier for his great customer service. I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a great stay. Management should be commended.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I didn't book the room, my husband did, and for the price, I made some assumptions.  I expected to have a microwave and refrigerator in the room but that was not the case. The room was nice and very clean. The staff were friendly and helpful. The restaurant hours left a little to be desired, but there were places close enough to the hotel that it wasn't too much of an issue. It is in a nice area, I felt safe going for a run alone at 530 in the morning. Because of the inconvenience of not having a microwave, I wouldn't stay there in the future.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Denied my 4 yo access to the bathroom even after another employee already said she could use it. If you hate kids maybe move your location away from the Monroe Carroll Children's Hospital that is RIGHT ACROSS THE STREET. Also, my 4 yo is being seen for a bladder issue at that same hospital, both her and I were already wearing the screening stickers from the hospital. It was blatantly obvious that my 4 yo does not have COVID, but uet some employee cares more about themselves than they do children. Will never return to this location.

My sister is/was a frequent customer of Great Clips but will likely never go back again.  She had a humiliating experience yesterday.  
When she went to get her hair cut, apparently "Lisa" was very rude to her and asked her "why are you here, you are never happy with what we do".
My sister is 81 and wears a very short cut.  She does not remember complaining only asking that they cut the back of her hair so it's off her neck.
Seriously, is this the way a business should treat a good, elderly customer who comes in every 3-4 weeks?
Very sad!

I've lived in Cito for 30+ years. When I was a kid we'd often come here for family dinners. We always had a great time and the food was tasty. We call their chicken soup "sick soup" and request it every time we have a cold or flu. It used to be delicious. (Even though they've always used frozen veggies and the chicken is terribly dry). This place has gone so far downhill in the past years. There is no flavor. It's about as Americanized as it can be, maybe dumbed down for SB's growing intolerance for spice. This is as close to Mexican food as the $2 tacos from Jack in the box.

Ate here again last night.  We were welcomed warmly at the door immediately upon entering and showwn to ourr table.  Water and breadsticks  quickly followed our seating and menus presented and specials described.  I chose tomatoe bisque and black and blue flat iron pork as my entree.  Portion was huge and cooked perfectly.  My wife chose scallops and was delighted adding throughout the Meeks how good they were.  
This is not our first visit here, we have eaten hEre numerous times and have always had the same great service and food, which is why we will continue to  eat here.  You should try.  Oh, and it's a BYOB.  Doesn't get any better.

We had their stir fried soba noodles with shrimp and fried rice with salmon. Those dishes were pretty good, the salmon could have used a little more seasoning. We had their g6 sushi roll as well. It taste pretty good, however, I'm just not sure it was real snow crab. It might have been immitation crab. The guy server who took out order was helpful and checked on us. Once he was gone, the two other female worker did not even check on us once. To get the check and Togo box. I had to come up to them. That's why I have 3 stars.

Our dog Ham became acutely ill one morning and we walked into North Hills veterinarians.  My husband and I agree we've never experienced such wonderful treatment for our precious dog and we can't say enough about the entire staff.  They were all so caring and we especially want to mention Dr. Carrie Lambert and her wonderful expertise and caring manner.  We had to leave him for the day but were so confident that our Ham was in great hands. Both the staff and Dr. Lambert called us during the day to let us know how things were progressing and it just made all the difference and it dispelled our worries. Thank you!  Ham is doing great!

Very friendly staff, previous day confirmation, and operates like a family business. 

The problem was the Chrysler 200 I rented. Their cars were at another location so it take over twenty minutes to get the car. The car had a heavy smoker in it previously. After driving it for about 40 miles, the brake light came on Intermittently. I took it back the next day however, the staff didn't care to check it out. They did offer to change it for another vehicle, however, I didn't want to wait for deliver. I was offered a free upgrade at my next rental.

I live near this McDonalds so I have been here more than a few times over the past couple of years, and I am DONE going here. I will go ANYWHERE else or drive to ANY other McDonalds further away to avoid this hellhole. The fact that they have, literally, NEVER gotten my order right is mostly just very very annoying. But serving me a burger that was raw?? (Photo of the raw burger is attached) Unacceptable. If only I had noticed before I had eaten almost half of it! I hope I don't get sick...if you don't want to get sick then STEER CLEAR OF THIS MCDONALDS! HORRIBLE food and HORRIBLE service!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I've been a customer for 22 years, with more than reasonable balances and never a problem for the bank.  For the first time, I needed help with one small item.  Joshua was absolutely worthless and could not have cared less. Fortunately, I called back and got Stephanie who is normally in the McCarren branch.  She did some basic information gathering, found the problem, recommended a solution, and gave me the number of the best person to help.  Three stars are an average of:  "0" for Joshua, and "6" for Stephanie.

Our first, but certainly not the last, visit here during conference.  Will makes plans to return next time in St Pete. Very difficult to make a selection because everything on the menu sounded wonderful, including specials as described by very patient waitress!!  Not the least bit disappointed in anything except the fact I did not have enough stomach room to put all my food----so very good, so much to eat!!  Italian wedding soup was delicious along with bread slices to dip in olive oil and Parmesan. Will have to try the Badabing next time, smelled awesome!!!!  You will not be disappointed....

My wife and I went early on a rainy Tuesday which is probably why we did not have to wait.
Since this was our first visit we both tried a different app., primi & main courses.
Every dish we ordered was very good and fine for one although if you are not a big eater some portions could definitely be shared. 
Service was excellent and attentive.
It is a relatively small menu but the choices are varied and creative.
I think for a neighborhood restaurant it might be considered pricy, for a destination restaurant not very.

Got the General TSO chicken with white rice for lunch on a Saturday. The flavor, amazing. The portion size for a lunch special and the price, really good. The chicken itself was so chewy it was hard to eat. All I wanted to do was pick my teeth the whole time. Some of the pieces I couldn't even chew it enough to swallow it. It kind of felt like the chicken was cooked yesterday and reheated today or something. Will I try this place again, I have to give it another try one day to see if this was just an off day or something.

I just got my car washed here for the first time.  I selected a $30 package which included wheels, wax etc.  I left once it was done so I wouldn't hold up the line since they were busy today but upon further inspection the car was streaked horribly and the wax was sprayed onto the car unevenly.  Last and worst part is one of the gentlemen working on it swung the door open bouncing it off the inside wall.  I thought at the time it was a padded wall but I guess not considering the hit broke the paint on the corner of my door.  I would not recommend this car wash to anyone who cares about their vehicle.

754 am Thursday morning my car is in the auto shop I took an Uber here and only had to walk a block over to go to work. I get there and they tell me the lobby is closed. Now I got to go to work grumpy with a coffee headache. Coffee and donuts are already pre made just have to poor it put donuts in box or put the sandwich in a microwave how hard is that? Update another week later and the lobby has been closed every day. I get my car back Monday I refuse to go to this location and spend my money that's bull crap they can't serve anyone in the lobby.

The pharmacy is bad .  The manager is great, but the lack of communication with the others and even the recordings leave alot to be desired .  I was  told to pick up my blood pressure medicine after 6:30pm so at 7:10 I arrived and it was closed !!!  I told the woman  behind the counter I needed my BP Medicine and was never told they were closing at 7 pm.  She could've cared less that I needed my medicine !  This really is upsetting .  If they'd have only  told me they were closing early I would've been there sooner .

I would highly recommend them if you are looking for a great eye care facility! I broke my old glasses and they were able to get me in within a week, even as a first time patient. Everyone was very friendly and it was by far the most pleasant experience I have had with an eye doctor in a long time. I only use my glasses for driving, so I try to get the cheapest pair possible and typically I get a lot of up-selling pitches from other eye care facilities, but none here. I also got my glasses within a week, even though it was over the Christmas holiday. Very pleased and will definitely be returning!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Was in town for a convention so this is a great spot right across the street from the convention center.

Pros:
cheap
good location
nice staff
there is a safe in the room

Cons:
small rooms with no decor
small bathroom with sink located outside of bathroom

Conclusion: I would stay here again if I needed to go to a convention but I would not stay here with my girlfriend or something like that.  It served its purpose to give me a bed to sleep in.  Not romantic in the slightest.

Its location is 1227 Race St., Philadelphia, PA 19107.  No idea why Yelp would have this in NJ.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
While I think it's great for the neighborhood I must admit I think price point is a tinge high for what you get. Don't get me wrong the food is good, but not GREAT. Cocktails are also not that great, but not bad. Atmosphere is lovely though and the vibe is great. I've had dinner and breakfast at this place. I have to say I think I prefer breakfast but maybe I'll have to come back and try something else for dinner since I didn't care for the meatloaf. Also wish the deviled eggs were bigger. 

Happy to see it's still pushing strong during the pandemic though, but just not a place I crave to go.

Decided to order in Chinese and try a new place.  Made the wrong wrong wrong decision of going here.  While not everything I ordered was bad.  Crab Rangoons were decent and boneless pork ribs were passable.  Everything else was a hot mess. 

The teriyaki chicken on a stick was swimming in a grey soup that tasted like mop water that was boiled on a grill that's never been cleaned. Not even a hint of teriyaki flavor.

The sesame chicken was bland and the breading was falling off every single piece.  Just a nasty place to eat from all around.  The bad food just looked like something that would give you food poisoning.   Stay away!

Been taking my American bulldog here since the day I got her. She pulls me in the front door. (Maybe because it's a pet store) but even when we get to the back to see the vet she's still wagging and happy. Never scared. Pricing has always been fair in my opinion. I pay a 35 monthly fee for one of their pet plans and I usually don't spend a dime when I go in. I highly recommend this place. Especially being a UPS driver and having been in the back room and seen the working conditions, staff, and other dogs. It's clean. The dogs are happy for the most part. And most importantly. The staff is very polite and knowledgable. Cheers from Sasha and I

Omg!!!! Awesome seems like an understatement to explain the Lavender Spa pedicure I just got. It was $50 for the special Lavender pedicure but includes 25 MINUTE LEG MASSAGE along with hot stones and paraffin wax on your feet. If you have an hour and want to feel totally spoiled you have to try it!!! My feet never felt so soft. Sandy did mine today and she is the best!! She used to work at another nearby salon and wow she is GREAT!!! Beautifully decorated inside......give it a try!!! You deserve it!  
It is December 2019 and I can't say enough great things about Lavender Nail Spa!!!! THEE BEST NAIL SALON AROUND!!!

Had reservations for Mother's Day with my family. Arrived on time and were seated and proceeded to wait over 25 minutes without anyone coming to even speak to use. We were seated in the middle of the restaurant and people were going out of their way to avoid making eye contact. My 9 year old really wanted a glass of water and no one would help us. My husband asked to speak with the manager and even the manager would not speak to us!!  We left without anyone saying a word and my Mother's Day dinner was ruined. I will NEVER return!!

Super friendly staff that are willing to educate you about all things coffee! The americano was crisp and full of flavor. I give it a 4/5 simply for the ambiance which is lacking. Being located in an industrial zone doesn't mean a place can't have A LOT of character! If this improves, it'll be a well rounded coffee shop. There was also a fabulous bacon sugar creme croissant that went perfectly with the americano! I will likely not drive back across town for this place simply because there are plenty of other coffee houses with much better ambiance for chilling and sipping on delicious java.

I have FINALLY found a parlour that I LOVED. I just yelped to find the nearest hairsalon, and to my surprise this place is far far better than any other place I have visited. My hair have not looked that good in ages. I have very heavy and curly hair,and I was looking for a haircut that will make my hair flow better and PLUS make my face look slimmer(ssshhh)...I highly recommend this place. 5 star to my satisfaction ! They accept only cash, if you dont have cash there is an atm next to the salon, in a bakery.  ATM charges $2 flat fee... you wonder why I know this :)

I accidentally ordered from here and it was huge mistake. I meant to call "Golden Chopsticks" not "Golden Cuisine" The General Tso Chicken was soggy and absolutely disgusting. It didn't even remotely taste like chicken or General Tso sauce. I wouldn't be surprised if it was just microwaved "chicken" please don't even bother considering ordering food here, I literally spit mine out because I thought I was going to be sick. Do yourself a favor and call Golden Chopsticks on Spring Garden its so much better and much cheaper too. Trust me!

A story.....it is indeed true that when a problem/irritant happens -- HOW it is handled can actually make you like the place, and its management, even better than you did! We eat there regularly, and I called about a Valentine's Day reservation. Frankly, a little snag. The manager called me back the following day, and all is well! What that tells me and all is their attention to their reputation, and to detail, and to the GUEST! Get on their mailing list, and the occasional coupons as well as the food, is all worth it! We are a fan!

Absolutely filthy. Trash all over parking lot. Dirty surfaces absolutely everywhere. Bathroom floors walls doors dirty. No toilet paper. Restaurant floor so dirty and sticky that shoes made noise when walking over several sticky areas. Flies on the soda area!!! NO ICE. One positive--the woman who waited on us. Polite, smiling, helpful, completely out of place in such a horrible place!! We couldnt eat in--no clean tables--took food to car. We stop at McDonalds on road trips because they are almost always clean. This place is a nightmare!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This was my first time there and I got cut by a male that was not Vinny. He was nice and cool but unfortunately that cannot fix my hair, I showed him a picture of what I wanted but he did nothing even close to it. The fade was way high up, cut a bald spot in the front and it's by far the worst haircut I've ever had in my life. I've also heard of 2 other people that he had messed up too. Maybe the others are okay but I will have to wear a hat for 2 weeks and pay again to get it fixed. I should not have paid them anything.

This was my first visit to Aldo's under its current owner. I was not impressed. I had some kind of pasta in "pesto" sauce which was actually pasta drowning in a little pesto and a lot of lemon. I've had better meals at Presto Pasta!! The bread basket they placed on our table was kinda dry and not even warm. The waitress told us they were rushing everyone since there was some kind of show going on at the Granada. Well, we weren't going to the show, couldn't we enjoy our meal? I won't be going back. On the other hand my boyfriend really liked his meal - he had the surf & turf.

On first appearance, there is reason for concern, but my husband and I wanted to try something new. First off, the bathroom was no different than a truck stop dump. Second, the chips served where 2 weeks stale. We were the only people in the restaurant and the apparent owner was talking about how to sell t shirts at a DB level, quite unbecoming of anyone professional. The food was subpar. The waiter got our order wrong even though we were the only people there. 

This place needs to be completely avoided. If your hard earned money and quality food is important to you, just...no. Keep walking by and go to B line.

Ok, so I've been to this nail salon about 5 times. I've been completely pleased with every experience I've recieved except for the one I just got about an hour ago. Amy did my nails this time and was very rude during my whole time here. I had asked her a simple question and she simply ignored me, was on her phone for about 5 minutes while I was waiting at the table for her to paint my nails, got an attitude when I nicked my nail and I *kindly* asked her to fix it, and gave me a funny look when I didn't tip her because I didn't like my experience. Very displeased with my recent experience here.

Nice little Italian place. Just thought I'd note some things from my visit. Thought it was strange that they charged for the starter bread, although $2 isn't that bad, I've just never personally encountered that before. Spaghetti and meatballs was good. One meatball was undercooked and I had to request another one. Usually wouldn't care about stuff like that, but because I am pregnant it slightly concerned me because what if I hadn't been paying attention to the inside once I cut it open? Other than that, atmosphere and service was nice. Waited about 20 minutes on a Saturday around 8:30 without reservations.

We visited this restaurant last night and we ordered a pitcher of margaritas for $35 and we had to question if we received the correct one as they were terrible.  They did bring some Gran Gala or Gran Mariner which made them taste better but still not worth the price.  Food was ok but nothing special.  The biggest problem was they said they closed at 10:00 but at 9:25 they turned the bright lights on as though they were closing.  We felt we were very rushed to leave as well as other tables.  Bottom line I do t think we will be back.

I get my coffee from this location several times a week and the girls working here are always pleasant and quick. Just today I was fumbling around with the two coffees I had ordered, because I still had cups from yesterday in my cup holders and the girl offered to throw the old ones away for me because I am obviously such a mess (haha). My only complaint is that the donuts are not as soft and don't have as much glaze on them compared to other locations in Jersey I went to before moving here, but obviously not a deal breaker.

Used to love the service and the pizza at the old location. Went here a few months back and the service was AWFUL. There's a rude teenager working the counter. We waited an hour for our pizza when there was NO ONE else there. We received no sorry or explanation.  The teen who brought us our pizza seemed annoyed that we were  hangry because of the wait. The worst part is, I got food poisoning later on. Management needs to work on training their cooks (to make the pizza in a reasonable amount of time) and on proper customer service. I won't be back anytime soon. Sad to see a unique place go down hill.

I usually don't expect places on streets like Cottman to have amazing food, but that should not be an excuse. I rarely give good reviews, however after hunting pizza places around this area  for a while, I'm happy I found Mario Brothers.  
I ordered a pick up, food was ready when I got there, it was a little cold, so they must of made it REALLY fast, however that didn't bother me. 
Most of the food reviews I explained in my uploaded pictures. I would give them 4/5 (which is awesome) and will definitely come back (Maybe until they screw up, hope not).
 Conclusion, it's nothing surprising or amazing, it's JUTS A GOOD PIZZA JOINT! That's it!

Sat for 30 mins waiting to get a letter notarized and watched 3 employees just wander around.  One lady told us it would be a ten minute wait and then went and sat in her office with the lights off.  This was 10 minutes after they opened.  One guy sat in his office, no phone calls r anything and only came out when he heard us mention asking for a manager and then said he was busy for 2 hours doing training.  Like dude I just saw you stare at a screen and get up to get hot chocolate for the past 30 mins.  That should be done before you open to the public.  Literally laziest employees I've ever seen.

I've been going here for a few months and it's always a hit or miss sometimes my nails look incredible and some times they look horrible. This time I went in to get a full set the guy made two of my nails bleed and it was very painful. Then a few of my Acrylics are not put on straight. But worst of all a few days after I got my nails done when they started to grown out I saw under my finger nail was full of yellow puss and the my finger nail started falling off and I'm not talking about the fake one I mean my real nail. And it wasn't even a ingrown nail. This was incredibly painful.

This place is so sorry and slow. And please don't go on a Sunday. I was placing my order and the lady asked if we had anything else and I said yes but instead of listening she totalled my ordered and said come to the window.i informed her I wasn't finished and she stated she'll add it at the window. That's just being sorry and sounded like she didn't know how to handle this many customers and had us waiting 5+ minutes just to order. We pulled up, but didn't make it to the window yet and just decided to pull off because we knew it would be a Problem adding more to our order at the window. And their food is never fresh either.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Worse  place to come !  My friends  i and were out  celebrating my birthday,  we're from out of town so, yes.  we were seated  in the front pario area which was nice, our waitress  was very nice but service was slow  and the place was not busy. It took 45 minutes  for our drinks  to be ready don't know  why  they took so long if it was only 3 people including myself in my group ,  they got my order wrong  2x , and when my food finally came it was cold, and to top it off i saw a small rat run  under a table next to us. Worse experience.  Definitely  will not  be returning.

Trash removal is an issue at this community, trash has not been removed completely for a month attached are pictures to show how bad the problem really is. Trash is scattered everywhere, and community smells like a landfill in areas. Additionally, when other residents park in your designated spot apartment community will do nothing to help you get the car removed from your assigned spot. Parking is slim in this community, so when you're assigned spot is taken by somebody else it becomes very difficult to find another place to park.

I was at Jimmy's last night with my daughter just to relax and have some drinks but we were moved from one table to another. The waiter came by and said I will be right back and did not come back. I told my daughter let's go somewhere else. leaving I told the hosts what happened and that they should all be let go. The hostess was very nice and understanding. I would not recommend this place to anyone. The worst part is that I'm staying at the hotel and can't even enjoy a drink there.  I ended up going somewhere else.

Woah! I came here with my grandma and we loved it! The salsa they give you with chips is probably the best I've ever had, so flavorful! For my meal I ordered a molcajete with carnitas. It was so huge and flavorful, they also give you rice and beans on the side. I would recommend sharing this meal although I did not mind the leftovers. Our waitress recommended the green chili tamale and omg best I ever had. We came just before noon but I can tell the restaurant would be very fun to bring a big group to in the evening

Almost always some sort of snag or issue with getting the car I booked and paid for months in advance.

Over Easter break and they are short staffed and pushing you to use their self serve kiosk system.  Last trip out, I did the kiosk and it overcharged me even though I paid in advance.  Wasted all that time at the kiosk and then had to wait in line again to talk to an actual human who could address the issue.

After all that, they downgraded me from a suburban suv to a mini van as they were out of them and actually told me there was no charge for the STEP UP in vehicles.

Do not sign a contract with these SCAMMERS!  When I signed up I told them there was a strong chance that I would be moving out of state before the 1 year was up.  I was told that if I move more than 5 miles that I could easily cancel my contract.  Not so much!!!   I now find out that I have to move more than 25 miles and there can't be another location within that distance from my new home and I have to pay them $50.  I was completely lied to by them.  I would never join with these people again.  They are extremely hard to work with.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Very nice car wash. The fact that it's conveniently located next to my apartment complex is nice too. The conveyor belt design is nicer than the normal track design that are other car washes. It does a good job getting the car clean still find small areas of left on dirt. The materials for the brushes and scrubbers seems better than other car washes I've been too. The free vacuum is fantastic has plenty of suction and the tips have the nice small pointed ends, to get in sides and hard spots of your vehicle. Overall pretty good car wash for the money.

I visited multiple coffee locations while I was in Tucson and I think this was my least favorite of the ones I tried. Their yelp said they were closed, I called and they weren't so I gave it a try:

The cashier definitely didn't seem like he wanted to do his job. He wasn't very helpful.

Besides the service, if you like a normal to strong coffee taste you won't get it here. It was very watered down tasting and didn't really have any special flavor to it. 

I'd definitely prefer Calle Coffee or Prest Coffee Drive Thru

My mother and I have been clients since they opened 3 years ago. I was so pleased with Dr Marshall. Now  that this is urgent care only, loyal clients have to wait just like everyone else. My mothers elderly dog has been in extreme pain. We were told that we need to come and wait just like everyone else. We explained that she is scared of the other dogs. The office manager suggested we wait outside. It's 100 degrees. If you don't mind waiting for hours Dr Marshall is nice but don't count on making appointments. Our vet won't make so we are forced to find someone else to get her in. How does that make sense?

This is honestly one of the best apartment complexes I've ever lived in. There are minimal noise issues, the property is well maintained and service requests are handled quickly. Parking can get a little tricky in some areas, but that's standard at any apartment. I've renewed my lease twice here, which also makes this the longest I've stayed at the same apartment complex. I downsized from a two bedroom to a one bedroom to save some money and Deborah and the office staff made that process really easy for me and gave me plenty of time to move from one apartment to the other.

The food was good I was expecting better but it was alright. I love eccentric places so me and my family thought this was a great place. Never would have thought it to be in the neighborhood. It so cozy. The waffles are good. My hubby got the waffle burger and my daughter got a smoothie and waffle and eggs and I got a waffle with bacon in it and tomato on the side and eggs. It was delicious. They have so many things that are vegan too. Peanut butter and chocolate waffle drizzled on top are just a few of the toppings they offer. Its so different and the cozy couches. Yea definitely coming back.

With all of the Italian places that offer delivery in my area, this has become the last place on my list. Over priced, takes FORVER, and screws up the order 80% of the time. I waited for over 2 hours for 2 large pizzas and some cheese fries on a random Thursday and when it was delivered it was ice cold. The next time, I ended up getting the wrong persons food delivered to my house! Luckily I caught the driver before he took off.  All I am saying is if they are going to charge insane prices, get it right...THE FIRST TIME!

Jan 2019 Night of Terror: BEWARE! Bedbug bites and cockroach dead shells under bed sheets. Two of us were bitten at separate times from bedbugs in less 2 hours there. I killed one and we picked up the dead body to take a photo and then we found dead cockroach shells under the sheet. We asked to change the room to a different floor where we also found another couple dead cockroaches under cover sheet. We reported and showed our bites to the night manager, Christopher C, who did not care about us and he refused to provide any refund.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: With so many NY pizza joints around Pasco county, I am not inclined to getting pizza from a chain pizzeria any longer.  I was at Publixs , and wanted a pizza, so I tried Marcos for the first time. My wife and I was truly surprised, what a great pizza!!! The topping were covering the whole pizza and were full of flavor, and the sauce was the best I tasted in along time with plenty of it, not dry. Honestly this pizza was better than all the chain pizzeria my wife and I have had. Customer service was very helpful and friendly.

We stayed at the ML for the first time this weekend for an event and was a bit disappointed.  The price was right but the hotel has seen better days.  I'm sure it was a high end place in its day but now it seems workout and many things outdated.  Our room was clean but had noticeable areas (torn curtain, chipped bath, etc.) in need of repair repair.  The hotel has a water park so is a draw for families with children but if the care of the rooms is any indication, I wouldn't step foot in the water park.  Not the worst hotel we've ever stayed in but definitely not the best.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I stayed a while back but when I got there, there were homeless people, drug addicts, and prostitutes in the outside. The room was nasty with other people's dirty clothes under the bed. Lots of dirty crap under the bed. No phone in the room, cigarette burn in the sheet, for two weeks after leaving, I kept feeling like I would throw up when thinking about the conditions of the room, bathroom, and sheets. Someone was mugged and really bleeding everywhere upon checkout. Carry light, hide your valuables, don't make eye contact with everyone, and don't look under the bed. I feel sick just thinking about this. This place is nasty!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The worst product!!!!!! Glasses had coating wear off making the blurry to look thru in less than a year. Told "yeah that happens alot with these".  Had selected highest premium for the lense option.  Replaced once.  Did it again within 6 months despite perfect care and no actual scratches.  Told so sorry you only get one replacement ever.  Totally rediculous for a $5-600 pair of glasses to expect replacing every year.  Staff very blase and so what attitude,  it even offer for discount to replace!
Get your glasses somewhere else!!!!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I am new to the area and stopped at Music City Nails for a quick SNS dip manicure before Christmas. I got this manicure on 12/18 thinking they would definitely still be perfect for the holidays. I always get SNS and they easily last at least 3 weeks. Only 1 layer was done and the dip was SO thin that I was worried about them breaking. However I know a lot of salons do SNS slightly different so I didn't say anything. It is now 12/22 and 4 of my nails have chipped. Extremely disappointed in the quality. Only giving 2 stars because the staff were very kind, but unfortunately will not be returning.

I was having an amazing time until I used my phone to take pictures and the flash came on. I've been away from home and was on vacation and wanted to enjoy New Orleans. The bouncer immediately approached me telling me not to video, I spent 2 minutes explaining to him that I am not videoing, showing him the phone that nothing was on it from the club. There are several girls taking pictures and enjoying themselves. So if a male does it, it's wrong? Or was it because I was one of the handful of African Americans with his white friends? This place was a great time until that moment. I immediately felt uncomfortable and left.

My wife and I have been here twice now and are both big fans.  Our first time was for restaurant week.  We loved it so much, that I asked to go back for my birthday.  In general, I am not a huge Italian food fan but I love to find places that can overcome my general boredom with the typical greater Philadelphia Italian food scene.  Little Nonna's definitely makes the cut.  Two of our favorites are the BVP meatballs and Wild Mushroom Arancini.  If you're there on a Sunday, don't miss the chance to try the Sunday Gravy.  Adorable atmosphere, fabulous food, and great service ... what more can you ask for?

Had lunch here this week. We were the only patrons. Never been here before. Service was good. My wife and I both had veggie Panini's. I am vegan and my wife is not. The sandwich is served on pita which is a bit unusual but it was fine. There is really not a vegan option on the menu so you just have to wing it and hope for the best. The restaurant is small with only about 10 tables or so. The atmosphere is nice and they have a dog friendly patio. Not a place I'm dying to go back to but I would give it another shot if I was in the area.

I was strolling along State St. searching for a good spot for lunch when my friend and I came across Aldo's. This is a nice little restaurant with a cozy family feel to it. The service was good. I had the salmon in pesto sauce with mashed potatoes and veggies. Overall the meal was average. Not the best Italian meal I've had, but it certainly was not the worst either. I did, however, enjoy the way they made their bruschetta. It was a little different from the way I'm used to tasting it, but it was good. Overall I'd say Aldo's is a good place for a decent meal, but don't expect anything phenomenal.

Haven't been for a month or so but found out today they have jacked prices on everything. Generic, pre-made deli sandwiches are $8 - $10 and not Wrights Deli quality by a mile! They seem to be hurting. The parking lot was mostly full but plenty of space by Fresh Market. Sprouts has great produce at a way cheaper price. Trader Joe's is better for frozen. Barrow's next door has a great sandwich. Even Publix comes close on fresh meat/poultry. Seems like raising prices is last gasp before better competition takes over.

A gym, health club, fitness center, what ever way you say it is for "the better of things".  For the same reasons a fitness center is there for people to look their best and feel great WHY then doesn't This Northwest Location practice this motto. Over years the sauna has become gross, spa pool not kept up, look close you see bugs, shower area are small and no privacy. Staff, it is a result that shows a lack of concern for members and defeats the very reason the business stands. Step it up, have some respect for your members and update the obvious.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Attended a large meeting at the Hyatt.  Very large and expansive hotel that was renovated after Katrina. The meeting rooms and gathering places were like a maize. It made more sense to me afterI was told that this was a prior mall that was integrated into a hotel. Service was overall excellent. Two areas of improvement are housekeeping, which was inconsistent, and front desk which was chronically understaffed at peak check-in. Very solid 4 stars.  There was complimentary in-room coffee, but it would have been nice to have complimentary water bottles in a Regency.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm done with this store. It's steadily gone downhill over the last 5 years. I got Covid last week so I'm quarantined and don't want to risk getting anyone else sick. So, I tried their online service and had to wait 3 days for delivery (I placed my order Friday morning and it's being delivered tonight between 6-10PM). I just received an update a short while ago and there are a number of items that aren't available. The other posts abt the deli being slow is spot on. I've had the same problem before. You'd think this store would be more upscale considering it's on the border of Newtown. Going to make a change. Not shopping here anymore.

I took my car in for a complete interior/exterior wash, and this is the worst experience I have had at a car wash. See attached photos for what was missed. They did not wipe down the bottom of the doors or the door sills. Nor did they wipe the back seat down. These remained in the exact condition that they were in when I arrived. They did, however, manage to knock off the plastic casing on the seat adjustment rail, which they just left sitting on the floor behind the seat. 

I am absolutely disgusted with the work that was done and what I had to pay for such a low standard of "clean".

This place doesn't even deserve a star, we were here for business and my book and a couple of items were thrown away by housekeeping and accused me of throwing away this expensive book in the trash so they threw it away. 
Also I wrote a note saying do not throw my bag away its important. Im furious, it was a brand new expensive book medical textbook. They said they will file a report, but i need the book tomorrow they were very rude. The sheets were dirty and had crumbs etc, the fire alarm went off too at night for an hour taking away from my night sleep.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have witnessed the slow fall from grace at this place for 15 years now. Through no fault of the people who work here. This a management/owner problem. One person works does everything here. Bartends, waits, clear dishes. It's pathetic. The menus have not be cleaned or re printed (they are just paper) in years. Everything is sticky and service ( due to lack of numbers) is pathetic. Oh and I've seen the owner here drinking in the corner not a care in the world. Last time I was here with two friends we ran a 56.00 dollar bill an they could not change a 100.00 dollar bill. Pathetic. What a waist of a prime location.

The setting of this place outside is lovely and the food is good but unfortunately the service is terrible. I joined friends for breakfast there today and it took over an hour to get our drinks and then 30 minutes moreto get our food. The whole breakfast took 2 hours to get through. They had one poor server for the entire outside area. We asked for water 3 different times and never did get it. Someone in our party had to leave just as her food was served and had to go inside to ask for a to go box.   They are completely overwhelmed. It's a shame but this is the third time we've tried it and decided 3 strikes they're out!!

As much as I want to give this place 5 stars, the second time since we checked in on Wednesday that there is no water and we didn't find out till we turned on the sink. I had to call the front desk and each time was informed "yes it is, we are sorry and don't know when it will be back on". We had to leave the resort for 3 hours yesterday so we could have access to a bathroom. We didn't pay to stay at this amazing resort to only have to leave just use the bathroom. Very disappointed. We are supposed to be here one more night but I am now second guessing if that is best idea.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not for vegetarians - A group of 6 of us came for dinner. My friend and I are both vegetarian and were disappointed that there were few options. We asked for the penne without pancetta. When it came out it had pancetta in it- which was disappointing. They replaced the dish without the meat but it was lacking any peas or mushrooms which were included the description. Also, no one apologized for the error. We were not compensated the appetizer or entree. Gratuity was also already included - which was annoying because we did not like the service. Our other friends who ordered meat dishes did enjoy the food.

My boyfriend took my car in to get detailed. $70 and 4-4.5 hrs later (as he is sitting there waiting, mind you), the car only went through the wash for 2 minutes, there was writing on the rear view mirror, a part is sitting in the trunk of the car and I have no idea where it came from on the inside of the car, the car was not polished, it has dry water spots on it. While they were cleaning the car, they decided to help themselves to the sunscreen we had in there for our son. The only reason I would take it back is for them to finish the job they started, and even then I don't think they're competent enough.

Absolute worst service I've ever had at any restaurant. Was at this place for three and a half hours for lunch.  15 minutes to order drinks, 20-30 to get the drinks, 20 to get the drinks she forgot, 40 to bring the food (never checked on how the food was), about an hour after that we got the check, and add another hour for her and two managers trying to figure out how to split it...  Talked to two managers and both could care less about our complaints. Will definitely be checking out the new restaurant across the street.

I love love love the food here but the Tampa location seems to have serious problems. I've had several visits here where food took over an hour to be served (the longest we've waited was an hour and forty minutes from when we ordered to when we were served), the wrong food getting served, and--most recently--finding a chunk of glass in the guacamole. The Bartaco staff was kind and made things right during this visit but it's a shame that stuff like this seems to keep happening. I've never had these issues at other locations I've visited.

Went there with husband and two "adultish-age" sons. Got seated quickly. Son ordered chicken parmesan entree which was burnt to a crisp (think National Lampoon's turkey). So regardless of ridiculously large quantity (no wonder Americans are so fat), it was not  eidible and made my chicken parmesan even more desirable to my kids. I ordered chicken quesadilla and it was so salty, I ate one of four quarters. Potato soup seemed "okay" as did turkey club. $70 later... Waste of money. Sorry we didn't just "make do" with what we had at home. Disappointed and no plans of returning.

I really like this place.  My boyfriend has been a long-time fan - it took me a couple gos to give it a fair chance since I'm generally not interested in fast-food fare and atmospheres in general.  BUT don't let their appearance deceive you, their food is very yummy, thoughtfully prepared, and a great deal $.  We most often get miso and various dons (rice bowls), they do chicken teriyaki just right.  Last time, I got a vegetable yakisoba and couldn't believe how large (and tasty) it was, I had it for lunch & dinner.  Great staff too.  Casual, tasty, quick & inexpensive.

The hotel doesn't disclose that they charge $6 daily for parking through reservations, nor do they disclose that information during check-in. Once the reservation is booked and you have checked in, there's really nothing that you can do about it at that point. I think that information should be disclosed so that the guest can make other arrangements or chose another hotel that doesn't charge for parking. I think this is a very sneaky way of profiting and can be detrimental to customer loyalty. The room was clean, so I tipped the housekeeper.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
After waiting almost an hour for a table, we had a delicious dinner last night. We ordered a chicken special (stuffed with shrimp, fontina and green onion, wrapped in bacon, served in a frangelico cream sauce) that was a huge portion, and rigatoni carbonara that was just perfect. 
The service was efficient but not intrusive. 
Be prepared to wait if you come on a weekend night. The place is popular. It's kind of really loud, especially if there's a birthday. But it's BYOB, the food is delicious, and the staff is great.

We have heard much about Square Donuts from enthusiasts. Starting originally in Terre Haute, this doughnut shop has moved into the Indianapolis metro area, and now to Fishers. We went there this morning and all I can say is . . . meh. The yeast donuts were insubstantial and unsatisfying, the chocolate icing gritty, and the selection very limited for early on a Saturday morning. Maybe it's too new a location and will improve, but I am a first-impressions person. And upon first impressions, I think we'll stick to our favorite bakery that's been family-run for 103 years. Sorry, Square.

We got a wonderful price on a one-way rental but were extremely dismayed with being told we would be charged for an additional driver.  We have rented from this location and Alamo over a half dozen times and never been charged for an additional driver.  The excuse was that "policies have changed" and even though we were "Insiders" it still applied.  This was unacceptable and it was not until the line became quite long behind us that "a one time waiver" of the additional driver fee was applied by the supervisor.

stopped by monday after seeing a sign in window that read monday large pizza special. I ordered a large pizza and was charged full price. upon questioning the price the owner said there is no special and the sign was in the window since the previous owner was there. which was at least a year. after I questionec him he became irate and came from behind the counter and grabbed my shirt. the guy is old and tiny so I laughed and shoved him back. all this after his sign read pizza special.  Needless to say I did not buy pizza and would never go back. too bad I have to give it at least one star

I got a private room for a surprise Engagement dinner for my fiancé. I walked her into a birthday party, because no one from the restaurant told me the room switched. 

I called and verified with a manager Thursday evening about how the tables would be set up, and the tables weren't set up properly the way I was told. One guest waited 45 minutes plus for a water. Another borrowed a steak knife so he can cut his steak. The food wasn't what I remembered it to be. The food at George's is great, however tonight it was cold. Mine was sub par. I know where not to have my Rehearsal Diner.

I would generally give this location a 5. The only reason I am writing a 3* is because the last week I have been buying coffee that is just coffee flavored water. I goo through here every morning for my large coffee and I like it because it's a single lane drive throuh. I will avoid the dual lanes.
My coffee is important to me and lately I have had to tell them many times to fill up the cup. They give me about 3/4 of a cup and on top of that I can't drink coffee that is so watered down it's like drinking hot water. 
If they don't start respecting this I will stay away.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If I could give a zero I would. Not from here and wanted fast food. Friends and I ordered sausage McMuffins and wanted to substitute the round egg with scrambled folded egg apparently we couldn't because they "were out" what would they have said if I ordered a breakfast platter? That comes with that. So we get the monopoly pieces on our food and we I was excited I got a free fry. I go back in to redeem inside to redeem and the guy looks at me and manager then they tell me I can't use it. He said I can't use it until my next visit. Manager was rude. Glad I won't be coming back to this one.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
This is a very chill bar, just off of Bourbon.  
  
We got there and the place was empty. We sat at the bar a bit and moved to a table. The four of us probably had 2-3 rounds.

For some reason they had a new and very experienced bartender. She couldn't really make any basic drink (Manhattan, Old Fashioned etc). There was a real bartender there, but he didn't help much - I blame him as he should have been mentoring her.  
  
If I lived near-by I would still likely frequent the establishment (I could help them make drinks I wanted :-). I REALLY like the space. Very relaxing and the mellow jazz band that was playing was very good (I bought a CD).

Highlights; Great location in the heart of downtown. One block from the metro station. The lobby area looks modern/renovated.

I like their fusion water they serve in the lobby daily. Just fill up your water bottle to get your electrolytes. 

Room was very nice. Super comfy bed, wi-fi included. 

Staff was very hospitable. They were there asking me if I needed anything and they went out of their way to find a band-aid for me. 

For the price and amenities and its location in downtown, I would probably book this place again (if I ever return to STL).
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My God, what a horrid place. One person who worked there was sort of helpful. Everyone else seemed to be busy making life difficult. I couldn't even get to the gin because the employees were moving things around and blocking the aisle (and not caring... except for the one helpful guy). Instead of answering a question about how much something cost, the cashier, who was more interested in her conversation with a coworker (I had to interrupt just to get her to look at me), just rang up the bottle. And the selection certainly didn't make up for the service. Go to Ardmore.

I've been going here since I was a kid and can honestly say that the food hasn't changed in almost 20 years - it's always been really good.  And they've obviously been doing something right if they've been in business this long, even after having to close for several months due to a fire a number of years ago.  Normally I just get takeout pizza, but the eggplant parm and chicken parm, and pastas are good too.  When I visit my family I insist on getting pizza from there because it's my favorite in the area.  Slices are huge though, so asking to double-slice is a good idea.

Roy's is always solid. Great food and drinks, unjust had such a positive experience there a few week ago I had to finally leave a review. A small group of us wandered state street looking for food during quarantine it was 9pm and all other restaurants were closed or no longer serving.... stroll up at Roy's and not only do they take our order at closing time, the deal for quarantine times is phenomenal. $20 for entree, soup, salad and bread. Dinner was phenomenal, we had the salmon, the chicken marsala and turkey dinner. I can't recommend this place enough.

My work uses Marriott, so I have miles to burn. Took a trip down to New Orleans to visit my sister and chose this Courtyard because of its location between my sisters house and tourist attractions. 

This hotel is odd to say the least. The rooms are strangely small, the furniture hasn't been updated in years, there is no pool and our room faced inward, so we got a great view of the lobby, but no the outdoors.

I always choose Marriott because their hotels are always so similar, so I know what to expect. Not the case here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Nasty. Red stained torn wallpaper. Broken furnishing. Trash strew throughout complex outside (beer cars, broken toys, food wrappings). Resident tenants treat the grass as their pets' bathrooms right outside your door at 3AM.

This is one of those places you book last minute because other places are full or too expensive, and as soon as you walk in the room, you regretted it.

Room looks NOTHING like the photos. Obvious they fixed one room up to be the model. Real room is old, full of broken/badly repaired furnishing.

One of those run-down motels that make money by purposing neglecting maintenance, custodial services, and upkeep.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
You have to enjoy and take in St. Louis pizza for what it is. Ok - get over it. Are you over it (Chi-town, NY, I'm talking to you). Ok, now that we're over the fact that this pizza is different from what you're used to, I enjoyed it. It is definitely different, but the seasoning and the cheese combination was great. Also, great toasted ravioli. The place itself isn't the best. It looks like they just expanded a store front pizza place with some tables and chairs. They could definitely make this feel more like the local pizza joint it is. 

So go try it and don't get a snooty about it.

The sushi here is fabulous. The salmon nigiri comes with more salmon than I have gotten at another sushi restaurant. The staff is friendly and the private little rooms are perfect for big or small groups. With the complimentary miso soup and edamame, it can be cheaper and just as delicious as a trendier place. I am proud of this "hole in the wall" place that my friends and I found. 

There are 5 daily specials (that are 50% off) that rotate day to day which makes for a great deal. Plus if you sit at the sushi bar, you usually get a diced up orange as a sweet way to end the meal.

This was our 1st year anniversary and I booked the hotel though Hotwire. We came that evening it was was sprinkling very hard.  As soon as we walked in, the front desk greeted us immediately.  We checked in and he told us about the continental breakfast, bike rental, etc.  As soon as we got on he elevator, it was cool, since I have not been on this type of elevator before.  

The staff was very friendly and accommodating.  It was clean, the complimentary breakfast was good and the furniture was up-to-date although the hotel was historical.  It was perfect for a one night stay.

Definitely will be back here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Maybe we caught this place on a bad day (a bad Friday evening), but the soup was lukewarm, the a/c was turned up too high and blowing right on us, the sushi was fishy, the self-serve tea in styrofoam cups was a big turnoff (not to mention they only had black tea bags... no green tea in a sushi restaurant??) and the service was very lackluster. With seating for only six customers, and 3 staff members, I would expect much better.  Very disappointing after seeing good reviews here on Yelp. Maybe this place is only good for take-out.

Location is great but everything other than that is NOT good. This hotel must be the hot spot for guys having bachelor parties. I'm sitting in a room as a type this review and I can hear the people in the next room doin the nasty. I can hear you over the tv blaring. I'm fairly certain this is a hooker and not a girlfriend/wife because I heard them walk in and then the noise started and they just left....all this happened in less than 20 min. I tell you this so you can know what you are getting yourself in if you go to this bad place. 

On the plus side the staff is nice and they have a new workout room
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Excellent hotel and conveniently located! Will and Jazmine at the front desk started our stay off right with very friendly reception and service. The lobby is stunning. Art collections, comfortable seating areas and a lovely bar certainly impacted our first impression! The rooms are bright, spacious and very clean. The building seems well maintained. We loved staying in the Warehouse District because you can get to local spots in the neighborhood of course, but the French Quarter and Garden District are a good walk away. Of my 5 times to Nola, this was my favorite place to stay!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I never knew florida could be this nice.  Sand key is beautiful, and the pool/spa at this hotel are resort nice with one of the top beaches in the country nearby.   The bed was really one of the more comfortable beds I have ever slept in and everything was always clean.

The one drawback is I have come to expect free WiFi at hotels when I am on work trips and this hotel did not have even pay WiFi available in the rooms.  In any case, this turned out fine; I used the crowded computer lab downstairs a few times which was good enough.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Had breakfast here, the coffee was TERRIBLE.  Basically coloured water with a kind of washed-pans-dishwater taste. The breakfast burrito was pretty good, but it's hard to mess that up... The chilaquiles were awful, like slightly moist nachos with tomato, not chile, sauce. And even the side-potatoes were kind of dull. The tortilla chips they used were pretty nice though.

Possibly the Oaxacan lunch/dinner menu is better. I read the menu, and it might be okay, but with so much good Mexican available in LA, I won't risk it.

The hotel I usually stay in was under construction, but that's great news as it landed me at a new place to stay. I think the staff is super friendly and helpful. When I walked in the door, it felt as if they were waiting for me.

The rooms are big! If you stay in a one bedroom, there is a couch that pulls out. If you stay in a two bedroom, there is a decent sized "living" room and I believe the couch pulls out in there as well. Both rooms had a kitchen-which I really liked.

Good price. Good stay. Close to campus.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The only reason I know I was here is because it says so on my credit card statement. I don't remember exactly what was there and why in the world I was there for. I know I had a red bull and vodka (we call in liquid cocaine in Miami). I know I had that because I had that at every bar. Anyway, either I was too drunk to remember what happened and/or there was nothing great about the place. So I give it 3 stars for having a decent drink ( i know this because I didn't complain about any of my drinks that night) and I take away 2 stars for not being memorable. The end.

Good coffee, interesting brunch menu. My BFF who goes to Swat thinks they have weird hours, but I wouldn't really know. We went at about 11am on a Saturday and they were open. I had french toast, she had an omelette. I wish they hadn't put syrup on the french toast, since they had smothered it in brown sugar. It was just too damn sweet. Also, they probably should have used a sturdier bread than what looked like sliced whole wheat sandwich bread from the co-op. And Reddi-Whip? I might just be a snobby New Yorker, but come on guys. 

Even then, it was still quite tasty.

Having finally moved back here from school down south in Savannah, GA, I was thinking I wouldn't find a good barber shop like the classic ones there.

But luckily there's one right around the corner from where I live! How swell. And also it was a great experience. I didn't deal with the wait like I've heard some people talk about (and even the guys in the shop were saying a few days prior had a line out the door) but I got seated quickly and got a fantastic haircut while talking all the while. Great stuff all around. No frills like the guy before me said. Just a solid haircut with men.

Go here. I'll be back soon.

TAKEAWAY: 
Beware of hidden fees and the guy buttering you up to upgrade your car. 

Worst experience with a car rental. Cirillo is the sweaty mess I had the unfortunate experience of dealing with. He's also probably the guy everyone here is complaining about. He acts like he's on your side, and you'll walk out with a rental many times more expensive than your reservation. Almost ended up paying THREE times my original reservation. He acted like my car wasn't available, but when I told him I'll wait- oh look, whaddya know, there's a car available. 

He's the guy they all warn you about when dealing with car rentals. Good luck.

Best find of the trip! Staff was bend over backwards helpful! Rooms where immaculate. I could tell the rooms were recently remodeled and I appreciate that they kept some of the historic charm. The brick walls really won me over. Beds were extremely comfortable and I like that they gave me a soft and medium hard pillow. I have not seen too many hotels do this. To top it all off you will be located within a couple blocks to all of your destinations and I liked that it was not right on Bourbon so that it could act as my oasis away from the madness when I needed some R&R.  When I come back to New Orleans, I will be staying here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
It's a hit or miss with this place. I have been here at least five times; a couple of oil changes, an alignment, inspections, and to replace a deflating tire on Christmas Eve.

I work nearby so 4 out of 5 of those visits I dropped my car off. I figure, it can't take more than 9 hours to work on my car. If it needed anything I would have them give me a call or text me.

I decided to wait one time for an oil change...

Long story short, if they say an hour and a half, just make it a whole three hours. Bring a book or two. 

They're not all that bad.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Late night on Borbon St. a group of my girlfriends and I, were beckoned by  a group of crazy guys, the kickin music, and Dj  playing that night in a grungy hole in the wall. We were able to bring in our "brown bags" into the bar without any trouble. 

Within minutes of entering and dancing, the Dj singled us out and knew our names and where we were from by the end of the night. Everytime we tried to leave he would sway us back in. 

Danced until 3am and the club never shut down...I figured they stayed open just for us!!

I'll be back Bourbon St NOLA, and to the Krazy Korner!!

I ordered toro (fatty tuna), but they didn't have any.  I asked for uni (sea urchin), and they didn't have that either.  What good is having sashimi on an expense account if you can't order fatty tuna or sea urchin?  

When the chef starts his show, he doesn't mess around, setting the grill on fire.  I think if I had been leaning forward to take a bite of salad, the flames would have singed my eyebrows.   So watch out for that.  

The fish was fresh, and they were cool about splitting the bill between three credit cards.

This is a cool concept.  It's essentially Chipotle for Pizzas.  You choose your crust, choose your sauce, choose you cheese, and choose your toppings.  Then, they pop it in the oven and bring it to your table a few minutes later.  The prices are reasonable and the service is just what you expect from a place like this.

I had the breakfast pizza with an egg on top and was very please.  Crust was cooked well and all the ingredients were tasty.  Just know what you're getting (this isn't Pizzeria Bianco pizza), and you will be satisfied.

The Sheraton Downtown is a decent hotel that offers several amenities and with a decent location. Situated in Franklin Plaza, it is somewhat centrally located to the downtown Philly scene. walking distance to Broad st as well as the Reading terminal Market, this hotel also boasts a nice bar with a good selection of booze. the parking is adequate, but a bit pricey ($38) and the room service menu is vast and quite tasty. I had the Turkey BLT which was made with fresh roasted turkey and apple wood bacon on wheat. All in all a nice hotel with very good service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Well- I live in the Bay Area and know sushi. The food here was excellent, fresh, and the service was great. There was a California blend with sprouts and other high quality products, and I completely enjoyed the meal. And the chef made me and my son a special roll just for fun- and for free. 

Seriously, I read the 1 star reviews, and all I can call is BS. Don't take advice from college freshman who think they know about service and food quality and how to run a business. This place was awesome, and I only do 5 star reviews.

Not a bad place to stay. 

Am here for a conference, and it is the smoothest conference I have ever attended. The hotel has everything he attendees need. Rooms are clean, halls are easy to get to, etc. 

The beds are VERY comfy. The location is great - can easily walk to bars and restaurants. Not too far from the airport. 

The bathrooms need fans. I did not eat at the Sula's the onsite restaurant, so can't comment on that. I tend to avoid hotel restaurants as we all know the prices are typically inflated. 

I would recommend this hotel to anyone in the area.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
For over $100/night you would think you'd get your money's worth.  Good: Next to Canal Street but far enough away from Bourbon party street.  Bad: Next to Canal Street but far enough away to be cheap enough for partiers to stay and wake you up at 4am.  3 phone calls later still being woken up.

Our room wasn't cleaned after we took off the do not disturb sign after 12.  I didn't know there was a cutoff time.  Continental breakfast was $10.  Did I mention how rude it was for them to put us next to really loud and obnoxious drunks?  Nice staff.  Crappy 90's CRT TV with channels from that era.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I went in search of some ginger-ale to soothe my upset stomach.  Instead, I found the highly recommended peach ginger tea.  I heard one of the clerks say she drinks hers cold.  I got mine hot.  It was suggested I sweeten it with honey and add lemon (They have packets of lemon juice).  I could have done without the lemon.  Next to this kiosk there are rocking chairs.  Sipping warm peach tea in a rocking chair while waiting for my ride definitely made me feel like my Tennessee vacation was already in full swing!

Should I expect better sushi in Tucson?

Location is good if you are near the Tucson Mall.

My 5 year old niece likes the miso soup and california rolls, but when it comes to real sushi, they are not up to par.

They didn't roll the rolls tight and it fell right out of my sticks.  The rainbow roll was not cut through all the way and the fish didn't seem that fresh.  It was Christmas eve but should this make a difference?

The people who ordered the tempura veggies thought it was good.

The booth we were in was not very clean.

Might go back just to see if this was a one time thing and if I'm near the mall.

The ice cream was ok. Good but not great. If it was a little cheaper I may think Fro-Yo was worth your hard earned calories. My opinion must be wrong since there are alway tons of people eating there. It must be the outside seating or something. 

Unfortunately, I will not go back to Fro-Yo out of principle. I walk in front of the store every morning and 75% there is trash all over the sidewalk. Empty ice cream cups and napkins are everywhere. I call it litter and as a University City local I cannot support an establishment that dirties up my street.

This is a restaurant doing among the top of the game food for Indianapolis, and for Indianapolis it's fine, but it couldn't compete in a place like Chicago or any other major city.  And I'm not saying that to be elitist, I'm certainly not- the food is good, but not great at this price point.  Our service was relatively bad for the price point of this restaurant in its setting.  It's a restaurant I'd like to succeed, but the kitchen is really going to have to ratchet it up and the staff is going to have to become more attentive.

I have mixed feelings about this place. It is over priced, but its in a hotel so thats to be expected. We had breakfast one morning, skipped their buffet which looked very boring and had waffles and pancakes (more exciting then they sound) and they were good. The waitress was great also. We came back for dinner and stood at the hostess station for 12 minutes before we left. The bar tender sat another couple in front of us but then went to clear tables, wipe down the bar and talk to customers right by where we were standing. Very aggravating

We just had a group meeting here for the past 2 days. The warm cookies at check in were great. The room was a good value, We were in town for a convention and enjoyed the walks to our destination. The hotel is close to the mall and restaurants. 
For a meeting destination it was great. The food at our lunch was delicious, the gumbo, the chicken salad...personally I loved the lightly fried shrimp (better than my meal at Mulate's). The breakfast has fresh fruit, a waffle bar, eggs, meat of the day, yogurt and lots of other goodies. We would stay here again! Just across the street from convention center and 1 mile to bourbon street.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We visited Santa Barbara on a whim for one night for my birthday! We absolutely LOVED this hotel!!!!! It was beautiful. We loved the architecture, decor and above all the service. We were treated so well by all of the staff. No one hesitated to help us. We stayed in a king room with a "fake" fireplace log but it was great for the ambiance.  From the linens, to the mattress, to the upscale towels in the bathroom...we were impressed. The hotel is old but well taken care of. We would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone who is looking for a romantic hotel that offers good service, a great location and relaxing stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Stopped by CB heading back from Pismo Beach. The store was easy to find and such a great spot for the downtown area. They offer seating both inside and out. 
The staff not as friendly as other CB locations, but quick in service! The one thing I loved about this location was that the drink holders and lid toppers were located where you pick up your drinks. Sometimes the baristas can get so busy, you won't need to worry about bugging them!

I ordered the hazelnut pu erh tea latte and didn't taste very strong like other locations. And my hubs coffee cup didn't leak like locations, which he was very happy about!

Staff is amazingly friendly! Room is nice and remodeled but not as nice as a lot of Holiday Inns I have been to in the last couple years. Old hotel means thin walls. Could  hear my neighbors laughing and talking- long into the night.
I wish I had realized this hotel does not have inside room entrances. It is really a motel with outside walkways and doors facing parking lots. And when my neighbors went outside to smoke, i smelled the smoke in my room.
The Closet was in the bathroom. Kinda weird.

I am still a fan of Holiday Inn but i doubt I would stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Honestly, not thrilled. I dig the the modern Japanese decor with the poppy and white plastic furniture, and the clean, sleek feel of the restaurant, but... the actual sushi was unimpressive. My chirashi was undersized and strangely bland - and therefore overpriced. The specialty rolls were larger and tastier, but I've had better for cheaper elsewhere.  No complaints about the service though ~ very friendly. 

Siderant: Can someone explain to me why a restaurant with such a modern and trendy vibe out front has a bathroom that looks like it was lifted directly out of an old-school McDonalds?

We came here for the first time on a whim driving around. FANTASTIC!  Our server, Nick, knew everything about the menu - even though it changes weekly. Every course was superb. Really, there was not one thing out of place. From the cozy atmosphere to the phenomenal food - perfection. I had the mushroom lasagna.  I believe it was the best thing I have eaten in, well, forever!  I might sound like an ad, but once you try this place, you will be saying the same thing!  I'm just upset that we live within walking distance, and it took us this long to discover this gem in Indy!!!

Update: my apologies to Hertz. They didn't charge me the extra $40. My boyfriend used my card to get gas when I got back in town. The receipt actually is quite informative and tells you the gas tank level when you checked the car out and returned it, as well as the $9.29/gal they charge you for fuel and services if you don't return it full, and the tank capacity of the car. It was indeed the ~$15 the guy told me it would be. (I just moved and the unpacking has been slow, so the receipt wasn't discovered until just now.)

Still didn't like the beat-up car with the GA plate, though.

I live down the street, but was walking from center city (round 2:00 PM), and REALLY needed to use the bathroom (don't judge me, we have all been there), I went in and asked to use to the bathroom, (yes I DID tell them
It was urgent), and they said, customers only. I would have understood if it was packed, or had any people already in there, but it was so empty, you could imagine tumble weeds rolling by. I looked nice, and explained that I live down the street, and my family and I were just in there for dinner last week. Nope! I will never ever give them business again.

I stayed here for a few days mid-week while attending a conference at the convention center (conveniently located about a block away).

Location is great for downtown Tampa and the decor is standard for a large chain hotel.

But no free Internet?!?  Come on!  I stayed here in 2011 and I think in-room Internet is about as important as in-door plumbing.

Compare this to the Marriott Residence Inn right up the road, where for less money you get a kitchenette, Internet and extra space.

I will admit, while I didn't get to partake, the pool deck looked pretty special.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Very good italian food for real reasonable prices.  BYOB.  Dinner for two with an appetizer was 70 including tip.

I got the veal parm and it was stellar.  I've had better lobster ravioli, but the sauce was very good.

So you know, the place is VERY small and loud.  You'll be sitting at a long table directly next to other parties, which isn't a bad thing if you have pleanty of time to talk to your party before or after dinner.  I went with my gf and we were there to eat delicious food, and we talked the whole ride home.  Not sure I would bring a first or second date here, because you can't hear anything.

This place was amazing. Very European style, but don't let things on the menu like duck hearts and cow tongue scare you. There was plenty of "normal" food as well including a delicious seafood Shepherd's pie with perfectly grilled and seasoned brussel sprouts. 

The appetizer of "snails on toast" was probably the best escargot I've ever had, dripping in butter and garlic, just the slightest salty taste and very tender. 

Great wine list, reasonably priced. Servers were friendly and the atmosphere had a really nice "small European bistro" feel. Great find if you are in the Convention area.

My first time there since I moved into the neighborhood earlier this week. 

Whole Foods pricing but quality is at best mediocre. 

Seafood (salmon almost crusted) looked good in raw form, but after cooking it the same night- it tasted somewhat spoiled and gave my family diarrhea. 

Tiramisu looked good but also fell beyond expectations upon tasting.
