Meatloaf also looked good but upon cooking as instructed, when I took it out after 50 minutes at 50 degrees, the meat was still undercooked. I stuck it on the frying pan and there was so much grease coming out fo the meatloaf.

This is my go to gym when I'm in Santa Barbara. Not too crowded, great vibe. I love the yoga classes and their hot yoga studio, Pilates studio and personal trainers. I usually don't enjoy going to gyms because of the crowd but Golds is a great spot to just get into the zone without having to worry about others being in your way. Jonathan for personal training is a great, he really focuses on form and will point out the muscles in your body that overcompensate for the weaker muscles. The parking structure has plenty of room so you never have to worry about parking. Highly recommend.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I came her because I was attending  a wedding in this little quaint city. My friend and I decided to have a quick bite to eat since we knew the wedding appetizers would not be served until 730 or so since the ceremony itself was at 6pm. After lunch I noticed CBTL... and whenever I see one, I have to order my DVTL no matter if it's 89 degrees outside. This branch was smaller but crowded. The location at a corner gives it easy access to people. Even if we stood in line we were in and out of the coffee shop in less than 10 minutes. Satisfied my craving since I live in a place where the closest CBTL is an hour and half drive.

I was here for a conference, it looked like the hotel was fully booked, there were multiple conferences going on at the same time. But to my pleasant surprize the elevators were operating flawlessly with very minimum wait times. The elevators are really cool... you swipe your room key and it tells you which elevator door will take you to your floor. If I were on vacation and I stayed at this hotel I might be annoyed by the conference people... The hotel is right next to the convention center and walking distance to all the action (and casino) on Bourbon st.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I love coming to this little car wash near my house. Has everything you could imagine whether you want to hand wash your car or use the automatic was that starts at just $4! (Prices are $4, $5, $6 and $8 for the auto-wash.)

I once used the vending machine and item got stuck. Went and told the guy who owns it and he gave me $5 after I told him what had happened. I will always go to this car wash because of this. Great customer service.

All in all, if you need a quick was in North Tucson, this is the place to go!

After finding some bad reviews on other websites I was a little nervous about what it was going to be like.  The room was clean and nicely decorated.  It was small, but I was in town for three days for a wedding so I wasn't in the room much in any event. It was just perfect for two to share.  The location is awesome, walking distance to EVERYTHING and short cab rides to South Philly for the cheesesteaks.  I would recommend staying here, particularly if you like to spend lots of time exploring and not in your room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
You have other options......and you should consider them!
30 minute wait for shuttle after I called, when I called back it would be another 5 minutes, not even an apology. Get to checkin area, only guest, and I had a reservation and it took forever. Get to the room, try to get internet ($9.95) and I had to call a help desk for them to fix connection. I go to set alarm and end table lamp by clock is burnt out. Start to see a pattern here. 
You have to believe that there is a Motel 6 out there where Tom Bodett will keep the light on for you.....take it!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Went to the "The Landing" on the recommendation of a friend. PARKING SUCKS! But what can you expect in New Hope on a Sunday. We followed the bricks to the back where you wait to be seated. View of the Delaware, made for a very relaxing lunch. I ordered a Turkey Club, which came on pumpernickel bread with a spicy mayonnaise, which I found to be pretty good. We will be returning. 

My friend recommended the Ruben sandwich - which I did NOT get since I didn't see it on the menu. However he told me next time to just ask for it.

This is our new favorite Italian restaurant in Philly.  The pastas are flavorful and prepared to compliment each dish (as opposed to the same generic spaghetti with every sauce).  The bolognase challenges the meals I had in Italy, and the Lasagna is rich but not heavy. 

On the occasions that the lobster or crab ravioli's are available as a special, I highly recommend them.

The service is also fantastic, and the ambiance is true to a neighborhood and kid friendly restaurant.  Nestled in amongst the trendy Olde City spots, this is a real find.

This is such a cute little hotel in such a cute city!  We stayed here for a night on our way north to get a head start on wine tasting the next day.  It was in the perfect location for hopping on and off of the freeway, but located in downtown Montecito with lots of cute shops and quaint atmosphere. 

The rooms are unique and have a lot of personality.  They were also very clean and the staff was very friendly.  There's all kinds of Charlie Chaplin memorabilia (he built the hotel way back when).  They have a free valet and free continental breakfast.  Check their website online for good deals.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I had dinner at Hana and really enjoyed it. It's located in an old, wooden house with very limited parking. I happened to go on a Friday night and the place was bustling; not packed and over-crowded, but just the right amount for atmosphere. I noticed a mixed crowd of families, couples, and friends all enjoying themselves. I sat at the bar, my friend ordered for me, and everything I sampled was delicious. Now, I must admit...I am by NO MEANS an adventurous eater and do not like raw fish, seaweed, or other sushi staples. I will eat anything tempura since it's fried; however, the crawfish and cream cheese rolls were amazing!

We loved our stay here at the  Montecito Inn. The staff was extremely friendly and helpful throughout our visit.  It is so nice how they have kept the Charlie Chaplin spirit and charm of the hotel with the contemporary luxurious furniture along the original cool 1920's elevator. Our room was nicely updated and the bed was very comfortable. 
We appreciated the complementary hot bar in the lobby offering organic coffee. 
The recommendations given to us were perfect, we enjoyed several of them. 
There are plenty of things to do in walking distance and it is only a short ride to Santa Barbara. 
We would definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
When I was still in college, this was the place to be. Back in the day, it was a great little out of the way kind of bar to have a nice drink. You could play pool, play apples to apples, all within the comfort of the old house. The bartenders were great and if I were still in Reno, this is where I would be.

Of the few last visits, I started noticing that more and more of the younger kids coming around, which is fine, it's the way of the world. I get older, they get younger. 

Either way, I would call it one of the bars that you would have to visit if you visit Reno, live in Reno, or anywhere near Reno. Pay this place a visit.

They did a really great job! My roommate and I came in for two pedicures and they took great care of us. They have awesome spa chairs that can recline and move easily. Multiple people kept walking in to inquire when they could be seen, and instead of rushing past my foot scrub to get to the next client like most places would of done, the gentleman took his time and stayed focused on me. I will be back! Plus they are right next to coffee bean so you can easily pick up some coffee to complete your pampering experience!

Huge place with a corporate vibe.  I am sure the majority of their business comes from the conventions they book that is their bread and butter.  As for the rooms... Uggghhhhhh.  Small rooms, tiny bathroom, nothing remotely special about the room... Think generic.  My room, in particular had a toilet that needed repair and minimal water pressure for the shower.  Did I complain? No.  I really doubt anything would have been done... If you are staying here free for your companies meetings, good for you, enjoy the free room.  Paying yourself? Stay elsewhere.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Ricco's is a family-oriented pizzeria where one can get a great deal on great pizza, huge calzones, scrumptious potato skins, chicken wings etc.

The ingredients are fresh, the pizzas are Napolitan style pies that are served piping hot out of the oven.  

The Pizza is good and they are always open to custom orders, this speaks volumes as to how they value their customers. The staff is very friendly and make you feel at home.

We ordered two extra large pizzas with 3-4 toppings each, drinks and appetizers all for a fraction of what the large chains charge!

Ambiance = 3 stars
Service = 4 stars
Food = 4 stars
Price = 5 stars

Recommended!!

I enjoy Anthony's pizza and wings. The flavor added from the coal is great and the thin crust is terrific. However, tonight I thought I was biting into the crusts and struck something hard. Upon further inspection it was a piece of coal. I told the manager about the coal and showed him. He was unimpressed and says it happens all the time with coal, and did not offer an apology. I have friends who served there before and they told me that has never happened to them in all the time they have served there. 

The pizza is good. The wings are good. The manager this night was not so good.

Looking for a great inexpensive pedicure? Go here! I've been to this creatively named place quite a few times now and every time I get a fantastic pedicure with a leg massage and everything for ~$25 and my toes look great for weeks- longer than most pedicures. The same woman is there everytime (the owner?) and she's attentive and kind and always helps pick out my polish. I'd recommend calling ahead since it can be busy and she's sometimes the only person working but it's worth it. There are plenty of nail salons closer to my house but I always make the effort to go to Nail Place.

I LOVE this place  . . . for Bellevue.

The crunchy , spicy tuna roll is one of my favorite things in the world! For $10.00 you get a spicy tuna roll covered with tempora and white sauce ( not exactly healthy but, naughty good).

The hibachi is dare I say it , onpar if not better than Kobe's. The prices are about the same but , the vegetables , and rice are much better. 

The house salad is sooooo good. Different from other sushi/hibachi places but , not so much so that it's all rednecked out with ranch dressing.

Plus , if you're a parent and want adult food on family night out the place is very kid friendly.

THIS IS A DISHONEST SHOP. Do not trust any other review on here. These are customers that don't actually understand or know the scam artists that work at this shop. I brought my wife to this shop after years of trusting the work they did on my personal vehicle - she had 3 check engine light codes, all of which we confirmed with another mechanic and brought to Cory Motors for their "quality" and "expertise." Unfortunately, after a $900.00 repair, the codes (the EXACT SAME CODES) came on just a week later. We got ripped off. Never again.

I will never go to this place ever again. I speak for me and 10 others who have always spent a lot of money at this place. The staff is f***ing terrible. They have absolutely no people skills; they are young and naive and litterally talk they just dropped out of high school. When there is a piece of action inside the bar, the bouncers take action and throw themselves on you before checking out what is wrong or who is at fault. This place is shit and they owe me a bottle worth $270 that they wont pay me back for and they owe my buddy over $100,000 in renovs that they wont pay either..... broke ass club owners!!
DONT GO!!

I'm updating my post because after my not so great experience, the owner was quick to refund me my money, and give me two free washes. I even missed his phone call and he followed up with me a few days later to get my mailing info. 


I paid $9 for the second best wash and my car now looks worse than it did going into the drive in. If I'm paying close to $10 for a car wash, I expect results. The towel I used to dry my car was completely black from wiping down ONE side of my car. I am extremely disappointed. I called the number and got the answering machine, I'm hoping this business owner has a conscious and will be refunding me my money.

I visit Sushi Ten quite regularly. As other reviewers have mentioned, they have a great happy hour. The happy hour menu is pretty extensive unlike some other sushi places in town. You can get a California roll for $2! Plus, there's complimentary edamame/salad and miso soup.

They have unique rolls like the Kiss Me roll which is wrapped in pink soy paper, but my all-time favorite is their Sweet Dream roll. My only issue is that the rolls aren't very tightly wrapped and they frequently fall apart when I dip them in sauce. 

All in all, a great value for the price!!

My sandwich was okay. The roasted red peppers, portobello and goat cheese is one of my favorite combos but the sandwich was cold and the baguette had a bit of a freezer burn taste. I think if the sandwich had been toasted after being assembled, it would have been much better. The fries were fresh  and hot but a bit undercooked but not too bad. The waiter seemed rushed even though the place wasn't busy and got my drink order wrong but did come by to check on me throughout the meal. I think dinner would be much entree here. For $8 though, a pretty good amount of food.

This review is NOT a reflection of Little Tokyo. After waiting 2 HOURS for my delivery, I contacted GrubHub.
I was told that Mark had to stop for gas and the bathroom, but had already picked up my food, and was on his way. So, I decided not to cancel. 2 minutes after my call, my order was cancelled BY GH. I called GH back again, only to be told that the driver couldn't be located. I told the rep that my previous call just 3 minutes ago ended in my order being en route. She said the driver cancelled and could not be located. So, Mark is somewhere driving around Metairie with $60 worth of sushi. I'm certain he enjoyed it.

Made reservations for 9:30, and with how packed the place is, we were lucky to get seats at all. Total hole-in-the-wall and the lack of space to sit and eat is very obvious. Sitting next to people almost like we're all at the same table; food though was good enough. Service was super slow but for it being packed wall to wall, I guess I shouldn't be surprised. Won't be coming back until they expand or move to a bigger location... AND START TAKING CARDS! This place is cash or checks only! Who does that in 2020!? It's not ok to pull that, especially since it's the reason the atm at the bar across the street broke "out of service" aka OUT OF MONEY.

You know how, sometimes in the middle of the work day, you suddenly have a craving for crappy Chinese food?  Well this place fills the bill perfectly.  Sushi on the salad bar is gummy and hideous, vegetables and products on the steam tables are all overcooked and limp.  They got their only star because the crispy chicken wings were actually tasty - the only item on the buffet I would recommend.

If crappy Chinese food is what you crave, then by all means stop at First Wok Buffet, otherwise, take a pass on this one.

I am of Mexican descent and grew up eating GOOD tacos. I got one taco al pastor and the thee carne asada. The al pastor was half fat and not as savory as I expected. I thought the taco de carne asada would be the saving grace but nope. They didn't use the traditional meat and spices for the simplicity and deliciousness of carne asada. I was left unsatisfied and hungry. The condiment bar was a nice touch. Because of it I was able to stuff my tacos with cilantro, onions and salsa. Which made the experience better. The salsas were good and the nopales were tasty, but be warned they are spicy!

We came in to the resterant on father's day and the wait was decent. After about 30 minutes later I was bombarded with other people's purses and elbows. This resterant has alot of fruit flies flying around the resterant, while other customers keep the door open for them to come in. The environment was not as good as a regular resterant. At least other resterant had air condition. The food was great but I could eat in a comfortable environment. I recommend you come back not on a holiday especially on father's day unless if u want to be bombarded with other people's belongings.

First off I would like to say this place has horrible sushi. Not only did I get past due salmon Roe I also had to almost go to the hospital because the volcano roll I order from Uber eats specifically said NO AVOCADOS ALLERGY but after eating a few pieces I started to notice my throat starting to get itchy and slowly couldn't breath. I had knowing that if I put NO AVOCADOS ALLERGY the sushi chiefs would know not to put it in there and yet they still did so I will never order from this place ever again know that if you have a food allergy they won't accommodate for it at all they will just make it as is.

Ok, so this is again an over all of 3 starts.

Went here with groupon, up to 42 dollars you can get the food here.

Food was really good. Steak in rare was perfectly cooked and fries were well seasoned. Ravioli rosa was good with addon of scallops.  Sword fish soup was also good.

However, with the groupon purchase, the "service charge" was 18%, mandatory. Plus, the waiter who took our order didn't mention that the sword fish soup was over the "side soup limit".

Overall the food was great but I'm not going to come back again.

Had a great meal here last night.  Many restaurants downtown were closed for Thanksgiving so we just wandered in looking for a place to eat.  The space is really eccentric and fun.  Prices were very reasonable too (four glasses of wine, two entrees + appetizer ran about $60 w/tip).  I had the chicken marsala, which was excellent and came w/mashed and veg.  My friend had salmon wrapped in filo, a very healthy portion.  The caprese was fresh moz and tomatoes, and was excellent.  Hand-written menu, feels locally sourced, great food.  Met Roy the owner/chef and he was very happy that we were happy.   Fair prices, a great meal.

My husband and I went here for a date night out while picking some things up in Deptford. We chose this place because our favorite places closed and they had good reviews. We were not disappointed. We got an order of the goyza, which was spectacular. I ordered the hibachi chicken and it was wonderful. This is the first place I've been where they give you rice and noodles. 

My husband ordered the spicy lump crab roll, tempura shrimp roll and the spicy tuna crunch roll. He enjoyed all of them. Their sushi selection lacked my go to rolls, but wasn't a terrible selection.

Sad experience. First room smelled of mold to the point we could stay inside. Second hadn't been cleaned and the door had been forced open. We were moved to a junior suite with an ants problem. I stay in Starwood properties once or twice per month everywhere in the world and this is by far my worst experience. I received 3,000 points and free valet for the inconvenience. Handled all that nicely with the manager but when I arrived at checkout, what was promised to me on the phone as "$105 plus 11,000 points for the stay" turned into "$105 per day plus 11,000 points for the stay", which just made this whole experience just not worth the trouble.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This hotel has it all: super comfortable rooms, perfect location in the city and some of the friendliest staff i've come across in my travels. Check in was simple and quick, the valet service at the hotel was fast and friendly and the room wise very nicely appointed. Great location within walking distance of everything you want when you're in New Orleans. The hotel is right next door to the casino so you can always swing in for a few hands of blackjack! There's a PJ's Coffee located in the lobby of the hotel that offers great service and even better coffee. I love this hotel! Everyone always had a smile on their face!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Let me start by saying the pizza was very good and my only complaint for that would be that there wasn't a bunch of cheese and the pizza wasnHowever it was very good and what I've come to expect from Racanelli's.

I placed a togo order online and the estimated pickup time was 7:10. I got there and called at 07:07 and was informed that it was still in the oven and had 7 more minutes. The order wasn't brought out until 7:30 and my drive was only 10 minutes. By the time I got home it was cold. I will say the guy that brought my pizza out was very nice.

My review is for the bar.  I have been to this place maybe 3 times in the last year.  I always sit at the outside patio bar.  I get the same bartender every time. Thin woman with long dark curly hair.  I order a Stella.  SHE asks me if I want a cold glass with it.  I always say yes.  She brings me the open beer and the glass.  She does not pour it for me, she just puts it in front of me and walks away. I guess opening the bottle is as far as her bartender duties go.  I am always a big tipper but will now take my business elsewhere since I can not get a full service bartender at this beach establishment.

While I 100% appreciate how kind La Quinta is to our animal family members, I have to say that we were really disappointed in this hotel. The staff was wonderfully friendly but the rooms were dirty, smelly and dingy. NOT the rooms advertised on their website! This place needs a complete redo! The chair in our room had white splatter stains on it that made me question what the rooms are used for! 

Thank you La Quinta for being so good to our fur babies but I am looking for your hotels to be consistent in cleanliness and comfort.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Is there a zero rating? Worst McDs I've ever been in.  Took forever to get my incorrect order! Passed over three times in line of numbered orders coming out. They finally realized I was still waiting. One lady tried to help and ended up dropping one of the breakfast sandwiches. Luckily I watched it hit the floor cause it stayed on the paper and ended up back in the bag later. Finally got order and missing one sandwich. Lady asked three times what it was and I found it was still wrong when I opened the bag. While waiting, saw a used bandaid in one of the display cases. Disgusting!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Most disgusting place I have ever stayed at. So gross!!! They have the most disgusting rooms!!! Where am I??? Bates motel? For the same price I could have gotten Hilton or Marriott. Omg this is literally the grossest place!!! And it stinks! My room smelled like mold and stale air. The bathroom leaks and is beyond disgusting don't ever stay here it's so dirty it's worse than a youth hotel in Europe and that's saying a lot! Cockroaches were crawling out of the bathroom tiles and gaping holes in the walls. The toilet leaked and the bathroom leaked the entire time we were there.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Finally!!! This Sushi restaurant is a good as it gets!!! I couldn't believe the freshness & quality!!! I live in LA so I get the best and Wasabi is better than most even out there! It is so delicious even the California roll was unusually tasty!!! The salmon was like butter, so great! The Uni was so fresh, flown in from Japan, best I've ever had!!! My Mother was with me and isn't a big fan of sushi but has now become a believer! If you want sushi you can't beat this place!!! I couldn't believe Sushi this good in Edwardsville!!! Yhay!!!
Also very clean, very nice staff & servers. Nice cute little very busy place!

I love the bartenders and staff...but when will the owners ever admit and acknowledge and address the septic issue? This has gone on far too long... cannot speak to the men's room, but the ladies room makes one hag. Again, the staff rocks if only they had more input.

Update: the manager Bernie took the time as soon as I came back to explain everything they are and have been doing to rectify the situation with the ladies room. Apparently it is mostly out of their control until the Best Western goes up next door. I appreciate him taking the time to let me know. My dinner was delicious as always!

I did an eye exam there, the whole process took about 5 minutes, so fast. They don't really answer my questions and try ask me pay. Each eye exam is $50. And the result is very different from my last(over half year ago) especially the cylinder part, 100 difference that's ridiculous. I don't trust it and I did again at another place. The result proves I'm right. My eyes don't really have changes. I use the second store's prescription brought a pair of glasses and that works perfect.  
This Eyecare they don't care about your eyes, they care money.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Literally been standing in line for 25 minutes just to pick up an online order. There is only one cashier named Lupe and she keeps taking care of phone calls and appointments instead of me. I thought the whole point of ordering online first is to pick up quickly. The other two attendants who I'm presuming are mechanics just sit there twiddling with their watch and thumbs and have absolutely no answers for any questions I have. I just want to leave and cancel my order altogether because this isn't worth the hassle. Finally seen after 30 minutes.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I have been in line for 20 minutes, and still have not received my food.  When I finally got to the drive up window, I explained my frustration to the window operator, and no "I'm sorry for your inconvenience", or "sorry for the wait"......nothing!  Crickets.  She slammed the door in my face after giving me my 12 piece nuggets.  Absolutely ridiculous.....oh, and by the way, when I drove past the first window, there was an employee eating in the closed window.  Really professional, whilst there are a line of cars that are paying customers, waiting for their food!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: They are so extremely cheap and stingy when it comes to condiments. Not sure why, considering they make a fuck ton from college students day in and day out. I went in and ordered a meal with zuchinni fries and they gave me no side of ranch. I went up an asked for some and the woman literally told me i had to pay extra for A CUP OF RANCH. And sometimes when you order food for delivery they include dipping sauces and sometimes they dont??? The workers are very rude and hesitant when giving things like extra sauces as if it comes out of their paychecks or something....

I typically do not leave 1 star reviews, but the customer service in this store is non existent. While I was browsing for a particular bottle, I asked for assistance, to which I got the rudest response to my request. The guy behind the counter, who seems to be the owner, is one of the rudest people I have ever interacted with. Customer service is 99% of the business in alcohol sales. When I also asked about allocated bourbons, he proceeded to string together a long line of obscenities on the topic. I will NEVER set foot in this store again.

More like 2.5 but the mushroom miso soup bumped them up. 

The rolls here are very meh. The fish is 2 stars but I have to say that everything was very fast. Service was quick but our waiter was not the friendliest, seemed pretty annoyed and idk if he ever did smile.... 

Cheap prices but at least they match the quality of the food. Left satisfied and there was a lovely small older woman who helped us at the register, wish we could've gotten here.

Will I come back? No.
Would I recommend? Yes, but only if it was really late and this was the lesser of the two evils.

I waited ONE HOUR in line for a beer during a fundraiser. They called last call and I was in the middle of the line. A waitress came up to us and we asked if we were okay to get beer still and if we should wait in line, she said "yes completely". So we decided to stay in line. Two people in front of me they said they were no longer serving beer. This was extremely frustrating and demonstrates the lack of communication between manager and servers. This has not been my only long wait. I've waited 30 minutes multiple times to simply get a beer. Highly displeased.

The Yelp reviews were convincing.  Maybe this is as good as it gets in this part of town.  I don't know because I was a visitor from out of town.  I like farm to table concepts and I've become a believer.  This didn't live up to the reviews.  It was good, don't get me wrong, but it didn't blow me away especially at premium prices (drinks were as costly as entrees). The menu looked like good American fare with exotic twists. Kudos for that.  The wings were good, but weren't cooked hard enough (i don't like hard fried wings.)  The cheesesteak was ok, but could have been better. (We were so close to Philly!) The mussels were great!

I give this place five stars for the food, the service, the outdoor seating and view. My husband ordered the blackened salmon and it was amazing. Great texture, blackened and crispy on the outside and soft and moist on the inside. I had my order altered and it was still good, but next time I go I won't be altering anything.

The outdoor dining patio with waterfalls overlooking the river and walking path is a beautiful setting. It is a bit pricey though. We went for dinner, I heard lunch is not as expensive. 

I'm sure I will be going back.

First time visitor. I will likely return, and may visit one of their other 8 locations. The food was great and arrived quickly. Barbacoa is in a spicy red sauce, chicken tinga is mild and flavorful, chorizo is mildly spiced and looks to be made in-house. Prices are very reasonable for the Main Line - $3 per taco, $8 for burritos, $10 for fajitas, etc.

My only real complaint was that the waitstaff seemed unable (or unwilling) to communicate with each other. Also they make a big deal in their ads about margaritas, but not a whisper was mentioned during my visit?

First time there today. The pizza was yummy and the crust reminded me of the crust on an Elicias pizza, which I absolutely love. The toppings were good on the Johnny B pizza and the Italian sausage was first rate.

The cheese garlic bread was so-so. Your typical Fabio's or Marconi bakery bread.

The toasted ravs were definitely homemade and had the perfect bite feel with tasty meat filling.

The salad had a nice, fresh vegetable mix with tasty anchovies.

They seem to run with a small crew so don't expect a quick dining experience. You are rewarded with fresh and homemade food for the wait, and it's worth it.

on 05/28 I came to this Auto center to get brakes, a alignment and new tires on my car. I came to this center after calling two other auto centers in Torrance, and carson gave me bad service on the phone. When I called This one I spoke with Carlos. He was extremely knowledgeable and was able to answer all off my questions. I came in as a walk in at 11:30am and to my delight my car was done 2:00pm instead of 3:00 like he had advised me. My car now drives even better than when I purchased it. I am very happy with the service I got from this location. It is definitely worth the drive 20 miles from home instead of going to the one 2 miles from it.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
This resort could be 5 stars, but it needs improvement. 

Pros: The resort is gorgeous and located in a beautiful, natural setting. The pools are great, and the water slide is tons of fun. There's lots of activities within the resort; hiking, golfing, mountain biking, spa-ing, relaxing, stargazing, and an awesome ranger station. 

Cons: The walls in the rooms are paper thin, and you can hear everything. Worst night sleep or lack there of ever! Service was inconsistent; a lot of the staff seemed inexperienced, aloof, and a bit clueless at times. One should leave a resort feeling happy and refreshed. I left tired and cranky.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I live and work in Santa Barbara and one of my employees rented a car in Burbank and because of mudslides is unable to return the car to Burbank. The employee lives in Sacramento and will be driving the car back to Sacramento and dropping it off there. The fact that your company is going to charge us an additional $300 because of a disaster is incredibly upsetting. Dad is taking advantage, even though they are your standard policy's, have your customers. My company will no longer be usingYour services. You should be ashamed of yourselves.

I'm going to report them to whoever I can for terrible and misleading business practices.  2 people in front of me and then myself were all forced to upgrade and pay a lot more for different cars.  The cars we all ordered were not as advertised (# of passengers. # of luggage, all wheel drive, etc).  Telling us a bs story of snow storm on its way (not for days and of course not guaranteed).  We all have in to get out of there but I'm going to write to whoever I can to get them investigated.  They also have the same people representing 3 different rental car companies....talk about collusion!  Should be zero stars!

Other reviewers weren't kidding. This gym sucks, as does planet fitness on the whole. Only perks are cheap membership, 24-7 opening, and massage beds/chairs, but it's definitely worth paying twice as much for a membership to 24 hour fitness or LA Fitness. Planet Fitness-Tampa has a crappy selection of equipment, flat and unfriendly staff, no soap in the showers, and broken equipment. Sad! Moreover, the limit of their response is typically a sympathetic comment and no fixing of the problems, which is sure to follow this Yelp review.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Cute, small hotel hidden in plain site. The standard room is tiny, however the building is gorgeous. There's free drinks, fruit and snacks everyday, and very nice staff. The only thing that woulda made this place extremely awesome was if there was a valet service. However, the location is great and Davio's (the restaurant attached) has excellent food...but that's another review, for another time.  All in all I would recommend this hotel. I live in New York so I've grown accustomed to staying in small places, but if that's a problem for you, you probably wouldn't like it here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
To be honest,
When I first came here I was leaning more towards 4/5 because it's a beautiful hotel. The lobby is decadent, the bar is fun and the staff is incredibly nice. 
And if it wasn't for those things, I'd rate this place a 1. I'm not sure what kind of bugs are these but THIS IS NOT OKAY! I don't care how nice your lobby, beds or ceiling fixtures are. It's disgusting and something must be done. 
A picture will be attached but if it wasn't for my job making me stay here I'd go somewhere else. 
Please, if you read this! Take care of it!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The hotel is nice and gives you that old school New Orleans vibe when you go in there. When I first got there we ran into some problems, but the hotel manager helped rectified the problem and provided us with compensation. The hotel staff was great in handling the situation and made me feel like they cared. Also the guy who greeted us in the hotel was very friendly and helpful. He recommended us plenty of places to go during our trip and he was a pretty funny guy. The next time I come to NOLA I will definitely be staying here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: For what it is, this was ok. I will say - for the price ($200) I was expecting much more. We couldn't check in until the moment it turned 3:00 which is not the end of the world, but we couldn't find any Uber or ride share, and then when we eventually got back the wall had it seems to be dried vomit on it and the TV remote had no battery which hindered us from watching TV. I say stay here if you least expect it but the extra 20 bucks is worth staying somewhere better. Save the money on transpo and hassle and stay downtown.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: It's like the TGIFridays of mexican restaurants. People flock maybe because of the bar/alcohol or because it's the only thing in that town. Don't expect a complimentary chips and salsa, gotta buy one.  It comes with a guacamole dip and a tasteless salsa. The Pulpo a la Planxa was meh. They sliced it so thin, I couldn't even taste the octopus. I could go to Osteria, pay a lil bit more for their grilled octopus and enjoy every bite. The Seafood Enchilada was ok, for the price, I'd expect more than 2 pieces.  For a restaurant in the suburbs, it's overpriced and the servings are pretty small.

This is my favorite place for sushi. . This place moves fish, the sushi is fresh and delicious.  The tempura lobster bits are amazing...rich lobster, light crispy tempera with a spicy sauce.  As for the sushi.... you get a hight ratio of fish to rice.  I like not paying for a huge rice ball.  The service has always been top notch, we are a.ways greeted with a smile, they remember what we like and we are treated with extra special tastes, tidbits and treats all throughout our meal.   I love this place great food and they make me feel special.....I wish I lived closer....!

I've rented through this location about 6 times since it's close to where I live.  I don't rent here anymore due to a lack of service.  Renting a vehicle shouldn't take 45 minutes especially when booked well in advance.  During most of my rentals at this location the rep taking care of me is busy answering the phone and making other reservations instead of just getting me out the door...and there's typically more than just 1 rep there.  Vehicle selection is typically minimal...I recommend going to Enterprise at Clearwater airport...

I would give them a 5 star but they are a bit slow with service at times.  The restaurant itself is very clean and very simple.  The family does have their children in the restaurant but I don't mind because I understand what it takes to make ends meet.  I've been to Miyakos quite a few times and their sushi and sashimi is fresh and very well presented.  I like starting off with the beef tetaki as an appetizer and then I usually order the sushi sashimi for 2 for my girlfriend and I.  I've never had a bad meal here but, once again, their service can be a bit slow.  I recommend coming here but if it's busy expect to spend a little extra time.

At 11:39pm I placed an order to 
EL PATRON, 9017 E. Adamo Dr., Tampa, FL 33619
I placed an order for a Chicken Gyro and onion rings. I place another for a Bacon Burger with Mayo, Lettuce,  Tomato and onions and fries. When the food was delivered my Bacon Burger had NO BACON,  NO MAYO,  ADDED 1/2 OF CHEESE,  THE TOMATO WAS THE VERY BOTTOM OF TOMATO. I called back and was told they decided to close early.  I ask for my money back she said we can get a discount tomorrow I explained I want my money back she said we are closed.  The flyer says they are open until 2am or later. No manager on duty.  I'll be there tomorrow! Third place deserves a 0!!!

The thing I love about Marriott is that you can expect fairly reliable & consistent service across the brand.  This Courtyard by Marriott is no exception.  While the hotel is older, there have been a number of updates.  However, I still found the lighting in the room & hallway to be inadequate. Although this hotel is quietly tucked away, the interior walls are thin enough that even casual conversation are overheard from the room next door or the hallway.  Not good.  This is definitely not the best Marriott, as demonstrated by being placed on the Bed Bug registry. That being said, I didn't see any bed bugs.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm sorry to say that after coming here for 4 years, I wont be coming back. The last 3 times I came for an acrylic refill with gel polish, my nails chipped after 2 days. Today I got a pedicure with no polish. My toenails were left jagged looking like I was chewing on them.  I was waiting so long the water got cold,  then she burned my legs and toes with hot towels near the end. During the whole pedicure I wanted to say to her "you really dont know what you're doing, do you?" Sad because the people are sweet but the quality of the work has tanked.

My friends and I were trying to kill some time and decided to get our nails done. We were just in town for a visit and enjoyed spending time at Angel Nails. My technician was very friendly and talkative. It was great carrying on with her. She laughed and joked with my friends like she was apart of our group. I started with a gel pedicure that felt great but when I went for my manicure the technician was buffering so hard that she cut my cuticle. In the politest way possible I asked her to take it easy but she still ended up breaking the skin. What would have been an overall great experience was ruined in that moment.

What an incredible surprise this Italian restaurant was! From the sweet accommodating hostess Elizabeth who squeezed us in without a reservation on a Sunday night to our excellent waitress (sorry I forgot her name)! I absolutely loved the marinara sauce, it had a little heat from the red chili flakes and good amount of basil! I ordered the mussels, which were so fresh and plump, and shared the eggplant park appetizer. I had no room for dessert but that just means I have to come back to try more! Very nice atmosphere, looking forward to my next visit back to Saint Petersburg.

Being from Arizona I tend to be very judgmental of what people call mexican food.  Let just say that Que Chula passes with flying colors! The flautas are heaven, the beans are perfection and the Spanish rice is mouth watering. I would also recommend the tostada's, the burritos, tacos and give the tomatillo hot sauce a shot.  I have to admit the food is enough to keep me coming back but the service is also excellente. Super friendly and always around without hovering.  I definitely recommend this place and think ill try to get there this weekend!

I have been here with friends for late night drinks a few times as well as for breakfast. 

The place is usually pretty quiet on a late friday night for some snacks and beers, everything has always been tasty. As for breakfast I had their chilequiles which were quite delicious after having been to the Boathouse and being disappointed by theirs Derf's were delicious.

They have great mimosas and bloody marys, definitely a great place to go wehn the line for Cajun Kitchen is long!

They also have an awesome out door patio for people watching.

Can't do a single thing right. I travel 120 days out of the year. No food order was correct, food allergies not adhered to, threw away a bag full of receipts for my company expenses. 

The staff is friendly. That's the only reason why I gave them two stars. Otherwise they are understaffed, our shower head was full of gunk and sprayed in random directions. The bathroom is 5x5 feet and cannot fit two people in there comfortably. The beds are comfortable, AC works decent. The walls are thin so you can hear a TV until 4am every night (which was our case).
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Stars are given for the ambience, our waitress and a fabulous Pino Noir. Stars taken away for the food.  The Marg. pizza was very disappointing. Too much cheese - and random pieces of yellow zucchini planted into about an inch of thick cheese  (am guessing the chef is not Italian?).  Salad was soggy and then discovered they had cut my bloody pasta up into small pieces and drowned it in sauce.  I am 42 years old people, not 5. I know how to twirl my pasta around a spoon.   Needs more flavor and less sauce. 
I will return to this place later on to see if things have changed.

Very meh but it was one of the few hotels left for our last minute trip up to Santa Barbara.  For $400 I was expecting something nice...instead the room was tiny as hell, barely big enough for 2 people, bathroom is old with a tub and ghetto toilet with the lever like you would find on a toilet at the gym or in high school, walls are SO thin you can hear neighbors talking and banging. Won't ever stay here again but on the plus side it was clean and it was a place to sleep when we needed a place to sleep...for four.hundred.dollars.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I have gone to this place twice.  Both times the eye doctors were really great and professional and always suggested pretty good contacts for me.  But also both times, the receptionists were rude and gave my mom attitude for asking to see/have the prescription.

When I was waiting for my turn, I overheard the workers there talking badly of the previous customer who just left.  That made me wonder if after my mom and I left if they would do the same.

If you just ignore everything else, the nice eye doctors are worth a visit.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: My husband and I stayed here the end of February and were very happy with it. It is a MOTEL for those who were disappointed with not having all the amenities of a hotel, so expectations need to be adjusted. Our room was clean and comfortable. The staff were friendly and helpful. We arrived late the first night and were advised to call when we got into the airport for directions on how to get in, since there is not around the clock staff. Got very clear directions and help finding something to eat at the late hour since we hadn't eaten since much earlier in the day due to traveling. We would definitely stay there again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Well, I meant to take a photo but was so hungry and it looked so good, I dug in and forgot. I got the Scorch the Earth roll.  To me, sushi is about texture, flavor and presentation. The presentation was great, sorry for no photo, the flavor, to me, had a hint of sweet when I first put it on my mouth and then a little heat from the spice but not too much. The texture was great with the cucumber giving it a little crunch and you can never go wrong with avocado in a roll. I have already text my son and told him I have a roll for him to try when he is in town. Great first experience and the staff was very friendly.

My sister an I went to their happy hour last Thursday. The server was really nice, checked our IDs which I like because they are supposed to do so. The sushi was delicious and they have great deals for happy hour! The only thing that went wrong is that we ordered a spicy tuna and instead we got a spicy chicken. Trust me, I would have said something if my sister and I didn't eat half of it before we both noticed it was wrong. It was really good though. 

We tried:
The chicken roll, the crazy horse and the Tampa roll

This place is just plain awful. Here is my experience. I first ordered through delivery.com - one pizza. Three hours went buy with three phone calls and nothing ever came. I complained to delivery.com in order to get my money back, and the manager did do the right thing and sent me a $10 gift card, so I was more than willing to give them another shot. I did so on two more occasions, each time ordering just one pizza. Both took an hour and half (really) to arrive, and both arrived cold. I think one of their problems is they use bike delivery so there is now way for food to stay cold, and obviously it takes longer...

I'd skip this place!

Just discovered this place walking around the neighborhood. It's super clean and really nice inside. They remembered when I made my appointment that I was going to an afternoon wedding and I woke up late that morning and came in an hour late and they did my mani and pedi at the same time to make sure I wasn't late to the wedding! I loved how personal and accommodating they were. My nails look perfect! The eyebrow wax was wasn't as good as I would like, but it did the job. She might have just been rushing since I was in a hurry to get out of there. This is def my new nail spot.

I like shopping here, but it's really the only asian market I've found since moving to Reno, so I don't know how it compares to it's competition (if it has any). I moved here from Ann Arbor, MI, which has a large asian community, and very large markets to serve them, so it's really quite small compared to what I'm used to, but it has a good selection for it's size and prices seem pretty good on most things. My favorites are the bulk rices (which will save you close to 50% compared to packaged rice - just make sure to bring your own bag for it), and the Thai curry pastes ( really good prices on those too).

Average nice looking hotel?!?! Ok sounds a little confusing. The building is nice and the staff is friendly. The gym is pretty good for a close to the airport hotel. The walls to the rooms are very thin as I heard the folks in the room next to me all night and they were just talking... No physical activities!
The restaurant/bar has a good atmosphere and the food taste good and has a nice presentation. If you need a hotel at the Philly airport this probably will work for you. Good shuttle service to and from the airport.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I am such a fan and love this place! I was able to tour the property with Katlin and she is so nice! It was such a pleasure to tour the property with her as she provided great details about the property and even had great recommendations on how to decorate the unit! The property is beautiful and the staff is friendly! One Metro is very close to the downtown areas but in a great spot to have a "homey" feel. I would recommend that anyone who is looking for a place to live in Nashville to definitely check this place out!

Great atmosphere. Very limited menu. Good cocktails and beer selections. Limited wine menu. Service was decent however we did order the braised short rib nachos and they were given to us with no short ribs on them. The server was very professional and said they could remake them or just bring out a side of short ribs. We just asked for them to bring the short ribs out on the side and we would dump them on the nachos. The amount brought to us was very little and didnt have much flavor. Overall it's a cool, fun, trendy place to go but a little pricey.

The pizza there is absolutely amazing and the server,Miranda,was great when we went the first time;the second time we had horrible service,the hamburger salad I ordered little had hamburger crumbs sprinkled in,soggy with dressing,my bf had a chicken ranch one,soggy,and only a few pieces of chicken.The pepperoni cheese rolls had minimal pepperoni and even less cheese-we paid 9 dollars for "rolls".I have called the manager,Cecelia,twice,and she never returned my calls-that is not good business or customer service for that matter.

MILITARY MEMBERS DO NOT MOVE HERE. I've been here 3 years, I failed to get promoted so I'm being HYT out but i have enough years to retire so I'm retiring. They will not honor the military clause because they said I'm not transferring, although the contract clearly says relieved or released from active duty. I'm being transferred to fleet reserves.  I spoke to the property manager MONTHS before turning in my intent to vacate and now she says it isn't a transfer. Almost 4,000 dollars to break my lease after serving over 20 years honorably. This is not my home of record and I'm leaving the state.

wow. im really easy-going but horrible staffing!! my glass had the famous lipstick print... uck. ordered the caprese burger w hamburger instead of veggie burger. cook sent out a regular burger w provolone, pickles, lettuce, onion and tomato. thats a regular burger! if u dont know what caprese is, dont put it on the menu. i felt for the waitress because she was stuck in the middle but when the manager wouldnt charge me for a regular burger she lost her tip. the cook made her argue w me about the burger being correct. ignorance is amazing!

Probably the best hotel we've stayed in. The people at the front desk are friendly and professional. The bar tender was quick, funny, and made some really good drinks. The ball park is directly across the street, the fireworks after a game are loud! The pool area is very nice and there's towels available there. My only complaint is there's also some kind of fitness thing going on at the ball park it's Sunday morning at 7:30!! So much for sleeping in. Besides the fact I'm listening to a guy with a megaphone yell at people to keep going the trip was fun, the hotel was nice. If we visit Reno again we'll stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stayed here during the Essence Festival and initially had some concerns from reading up on the place. Those concerns were quickly settled the minute I opened the doors to the lobby, met the friendly staff, and got a few minor adjustments done to my room. This place had an amazing courtyard the look better in person than it even does on in pictures. Best thing was the French Market location which was walking distance to ALL the main attractions including the Superdome, Conversation Center & Bourbon Street. There were several restaurants & bars literally within feet of the lobby doors. Definitely would come back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Stayed here during the Essence Festival and initially had some concerns from reading up on the place. Those concerns were quickly settled the minute I opened the doors to the lobby, met the friendly staff, and got a few minor adjustments done to my room. categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Made dinner reservations for our wedding anniversary. Walked in grouchy old man only spoke Italian and barked orders at the girl who seated us. I specifically indicated it was a special occasion. No happy anniversary. Drinks were good. Calamari was shoe leather. Good sauces though. House salad was lovely. The Caesar had so much dressing it was inedible. Eggplant parmigiana was good , the rigatonacci had a vodka cream sauce that was the consistency of cottage cheese. Not great. But we had good service and the bread was great. Will Not be back! There are too many new fantastic restaurants in DTSP for this tired relic.

A group of us consisting almost entirely of People with Multiple Sclerosis (MS) were scheduled to attend a drug sponsored dinner at La Vecchia.  Through a series of mixups and miscommunications, none of which were the faults of La Vecchia, the dinner ended up canceled and none of us MSers were informed.  
The Restaurant staff "stepped up" and made sure we were all very well fed and taken care of.  Their food was wonderfully prepared, service was impeccable and as friendly as one could hope for!  
I look forward to revisiting their very comfortable, beautifully decorated restaurant in the future!!!

Stayed here because we had a wedding down the street. So, first of all-we had to pay for parking-$56 for two nights. Really? To park my car in a space when I'm already paying to sleep in your hotel? REALLY?! Anyway, they have a convince store which is only open on the weekends with posted time. Yeah she was in there counting the drawer but the door was locked. So I went back upstairs and called down and they said it might be open again at 4-maybe. This is exceptional service? 
We called the front desk for towels because there were none in our room. 
If I ever stay in Philly again I will NOT stay here. Shame on you Sheraton
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place is amazing!!! 
Great coffee and espresso drinks, and they come out quickly and perfect! Free Wifi makes this a great spot to work. They have some farm style tables in the front and typically cafe tables in the back. The decor is a rustic modern feel and the people are super friendly. 

Baristas know what they are doing and always have a smile. Music is good, although sometimes a smidge loud, but that's just nit-picking. Definitely my favorite spot in Olde City to grab a coffee and work or catch up with friends.

I was torn between a few different places for a burger and based on the reviews decided to try Bad Boy. I am extremely glad I did as it was just what I was craving. I had the double bacon cheese burger and it was a delicious, big, juicy mess of a burger with just the right amount of cheese, veggies, and sauce. If I had to knock it at all, it would be that the bacon was a bit underwhelming. Next time I will probably skip the bacon. I also got the fries to go with it and they were pretty darn good too. Overall I really like this old school burger place and will be back next time I am in Boise and craving a burger.

Right now I really hate Bank of America. Today I was doing a deposit at this branch and their machine jammed after it had taken my last checks. I went inside to get their help and was told that I had to file a claim and that they would credit my account 10 days after I filed my own claim!

No help. No offer to help me file the claim. Just a factual answer that they would credit the account 10 days after I went and did my own paperwork.

I have been a business client with Bank of America since 1992.

Of course when I was finished they made up for it by letting me know to have a nice day.

Was in town craving for Chinese food not familiar to the area since haven't been home since the pandemic ordered $70 dollars worth of food for delivery really disappointed to makes things worst delivery is late delivery and the guy trying to give our food to our neighbor it's a good thing was outside I ask why he's in that house he said he didn't know the right address .. anyway it was ok understandable after trying everything this is by far the worst Chinese's food I ever tasted hands down definitely got 2 stars for delivering the food gave 20% tip for doing that.

I went to Red Door on a whim, I was on a girls trip from Columbus, OH and the bar was within walking distance of my hotel.  It was Superbowl Sunday and the game was on; the bartenders were really cool and the beers were nice and cold.  The bartenders gave us a free shot with our first round and later gave us bottle coozies with the bar logo.

I would go back in a heartbeat, it was a cool local bar that didn't mind having some out of towners bellied up to the bar.  Awesome prices 2 for 1 beers and well drinks.

Only reason 4 stars instead of 5 is that they allow indoor smoking (but, it was ventilated REALLY well, my clothes didn't even stink)

A nice overall experience but nothing out of this world. Guacamole, tuna tiradito and shrimp and fish tacos were good but nothing memorable. Plantains were yummy but could have been better. My favorite was actually the chopped salad. Service was fine. The location is great and the restaurant itself has a nice feel to it. I think it's a little bit expensive for what it is (especially, as others have commented, when it comes to the guac!) and with a slight improvement in the kitchen this place would be much more interesting.

My wife and I had dinner here the other night. This is a semi-regular stop for us, as it is always on point. Once again, they did not disappoint. I ordered the chicken fettuccini alfredo and my wife ordered the cioppino. Both meals were delicious and the portions were generous. The only reason for 4 stars and not 5 is that my pasta could have been cooked for another minute and my wife asked for no crab meat in her cioppino, but it was in there. Not a deal breaker for her, she just didn't want it that night. Overall, we really like it here and would definitely recommend a stop if in the area.

My daughter's car died on the street and we were able to push it into the parking lot at Precision Auto Center.   It had a parasitic electrical problem which no one could figure out.   The owner dropped what he was doing and spent more than half an hour figuring out what was wrong.  He figured it out and fixed it.  When I tried to pay him for his time, he told me not to worry about it.   I wanted to thank Precision Auto Center for fixing my daughters car and we will take our cars there the next time we need work done!

This hotel was the worst experience I've ever had. We arrived and were given a room that had not been cleaned with pizza boxes lying on the floor, bed with dirty sheet and unmade and used bathroom towels. When we went downstairs, they said they had no other available rooms and no cleaning service to clean the room. After speaking to the manager, she told us a room WAS available and gave us a new room, even though it was smaller than the room we had before. On our way up, we also saw a cleaning lady, so they clearly were working. They would not give us any compensation for the horrible service we had either. Horrible experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Stopped in for an early dinner on a Sunday late afternoon. Started off with the stuffed mushrooms, fried calamari, and the crab cheesecake. The stuffed mushrooms were actually pretty good. The fried calamari was over cooked. The crab cheesecake came out piping hot. It was actually very good too. 

For main course, my wife got gnocchi and I got a salad. The gnocchi was a decent size portion and was cooked nicely. 

The salad was an ample portion and was pretty tasty. 

As for service, our waiter was relatively inexperienced without a lot of knowledge of the menu. There was a waitress on hand who was awesome and helped out a lot.

This place was very quaint and artsy.  I loved the fact that it was an old warehouse that was turned into a hotel.  The open beams and old bricks gave it the perfect "non-hotel" feel. The hotel was clean and the staff was friendly. The freshly baked cookies daily was awesome and truly delicious! The only negative things I can say about this place is that the towels were hard, and the valet parking slow.  But we were getting our car during the peak of check out time, so I kind of overlooked that issue. We will surely stay here again.  Oh, and coffee is served 24 hours a day and it was actually pretty good.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: From what I understand, Maru Sushi just opened recently where Madame Butterfly Japanese restaurant was.  Went here for the first time tonight and tried a little bit of everything.  The sushi was very fresh and tasty.  The sautéed green beans with garlic were excellent (a little salty) but definitely delicious.  We also tried the chicken hibachi. If you are craving good hibachi you might be disappointed.  However if you are looking for a decent Japanese chicken dish it was good.  Highly recommend giving it a try and ordering the spicy tuna roll and the Cliff roll.

This place is classic Italian from the decor to the wait staff.  Food was grand the Veal Marsala was fantastic.  My dinner date ordered the Jumbo lump crab and shrimp parmesan but they ran out of shrimp which i couldnt understand being as someone who ordered after us had shrimp.  I also think the wait staff and manager was pretty much ready to go as they were pretty short and no nonsense when it came to explaining the food and actually charged me  for a a dish that i didnt order.  The food and ambiance is fantastic i was not however impressed with the service...

As an American well, there are many MC Donalds i have been to. I will NEVER forget this location. 
Personally, i always try to be nice and pleasant when it comes to service and drive through personal. However, this location THE WORST. Being a bad mannered client will definitely be best, no MANNERS, always rude and I personally got Ignored. I mean i dont expect a 5 start, excellent customer service,  but a solid 3 or 4 star can be great. They have messed up my order many times, but the 2 star just comes from pity. Keep driving down and evade this location at all costs. 
Sincerely Everyone.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
My husband and I used to go here frequently for lunch on the weekends and enjoyed it.  However the management and/or service staff have obviously changed!  The last time we went the waitress was extremely rude, interrupting our conversation 3 times.  When I asked her politely not to do so in the future, she became incredibly belligerent and nasty.  This was the worst experience I have had in a restaurant EVER.  I called the manager later to discuss the situation and he supported the waitress's behavior 100%.  I guess this type of customer service is perfectly acceptable at Bricktops.

We will not be returning.

We have food allergies which it hard to eat out but Bar Taco was very accommodating and attentive about our food allergy concerns. A manager came up and made sure the order was taken correctly. Each server is willing to assist even if it's not their own table. I love the card system to get the attention of your server. The pork belly bowl is amazing! I get it without the sauce due to soy allergies and it still taste great. Portions are just right. Poke bowls, according to my husband and 7yr old son, is tasty and fresh. Overall, I would recommend this place to everyone looking for a nice casual dining with quality food.

Oh! My! Gosh!  You can definitely tell I am close to Mexico!  You can't get food like this in Indiana!  I read the Yelp reviews about the salsa being made at your table so I thought I would try it!  I am so glad I did!  The salsa was the best I have EVER had!  They also make homemade tortillas that are amazing and HUGE compared to what I get in Indianapolis!  I had combo fajitas with chicken and shrimp!  The chicken was so plump at fresh!  Seasoned to perfection!  Eddie was my server and he was very kind and attentive!  I'm in town on business for 2 nights!  I think I need to come back tomorrow!  Thank you for a wonderful experience!

THE WORST FOOD not just Japanese food, THE WORST FOOD I EVER ATE. The service was terrible, they didn't acknowledge my hand raised until the third person saw it and they're was only two other families in there. The Beef teriyaki was trash!!!! And when I tried to return it he said he couldn't and that he could only take $5 off. So I paid almost $15 for something that I didn't even eat half of. DONT waste your time with this place. I wish I could rate lower. I really love Asian cuisines but this place is just a trash.

Pros: the hotel location is great with access to the convention center, Amalie arena, and Tampa Bay. The hotel lobby is bright, open and has a feeling of opulence. There's a Starbucks in the lobby, numerous bars, restaurants, cafes, a rooftop pool, and a beautiful waterside patio.

Cons: My room hadn't been dusted in quite some time. I sent up for room service twice which never came. There was no mini bar with snacks/soda/water. No robes in the room. The furniture was awfully banged up. All in all, it was a 3 star room at a 5 star price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Cute decor, great checkin experience, good location, but everything else needs work.

Waited 20 minutes for valet before ditching and self parking, waited 15 minutes at non-crowded breakfast bar for a cup of coffee and wasn't even acknowledged, waited 45 minutes at non-crowded rooftop lounge, left irritated. 

Room's bedside light didn't work, reported issue, wasn't repaired. Flashing light on smoke detector prevented a good night sleep along with extra large space under door that let in bright light from hallway. 

They've got some issues to reconcile before I'll stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Luisa Ristorante in St. Alberta is a gem! Went there for the first time last night and it certainly did not disappoint. Ed and Cindy the owners were outgoing and true hospitality people! You can tell the wine and drink menus are well thought through and there is a nice selection for almost everyone. The food menu has great variety and some standard staples of Italy. The price is very reasonable and the service was unmatched. The space is small and intimate but appeals to both families and date night. Cannot wait to go back.

Wow...so good!

I came here with my cousin who lives in town, for a Friday night dinner. This place is so cute...very cool/romantic vibe. Lots of people here on dates.

The bread basket is very good, and they give olive oil/vinegar to dip it in.

I ordered the gnocchi, which was probably the best I have ever tried. It looked hand-rolled and like it was made that day. The red sauce was so decadent and fresh. It came with a few crumbles of a feta type cheese.

At the end, we also split a tiramisu, which was really good.

Note that they only take cash, so come prepared!

Although the staff was nice, place was clean, they got me a pedi on a Sunday when others could not, still taking off two stars. I was over charged because the guy thought I got my fingernails done with them. If he wasn't for sure, he could have asked. I guess I should take it as a compliment but that meant he received a $15.00 tip...if they have only two employees working and the system is always to do pedi first, then hands(which was the routine they were doing)-he would have realized that I should have been charged $25.00 and not $40.00.

I came with two 10 year old girls about 2 o'clock in the afternoon. There was no one behind the counter for over a minute. We wondered if there was even any one working after hollering out hello hello. They did not allow us to have any samples. Pineapple yogurt was very Bland and tasteless. Had I had a sample I would not have bought it. The girls had some fruit and chocolate flavors and said it wasn't very good. Also, My mango was also not very Tangy. I will not come back here again , unfriendly staff, poor atmosphere and I thought very expensive over $22 for 2 mediums and a small cups.

Called for take out, 1st time I've been in. Girl on phone took my order, I asked her to repeat and it was wrong. Repeated and she told me she had it.  When I went in the staff seemed confused and an old cook was talking down to the counter kid. They asked for my number and when I told him he told me they had no order for me. when I told them the order the cook caught an attitude and said I had the wrong number. So I got items and left. When I got home the order was completely wrong. On top of that what I received was horrendous. All oily and unedible. I won't be going back

I was told this a must so of course I came.... I had a great experience even after reading some of the previous reviews. I ended up getting the shave.... 7 hot towels and continuous soothing products applied. Thank god for this! I went in with a proper beard that has not been removed in like 5 months. I have never had such a smooth shave and I would be delighted to do this again. 

Staff is great. Very hipster/old school atmosphere

Oh yea free beer after your shave. I think that is enough.

A little pricey but worth it. If I lived in New Orleans I would do the shave once a month

I really liked this place. The price was right, they took dogs and it was clean.  I called and asked what time check in was, the girl said four. I asked if I could check in early and she said sure.  I told her I would be there in about ten minutes.  When I walked in she was already hard at work starting my check in.  Cool.  the room was a good size with a fridge, and did I mention they took dogs?  There was a strip mall out back with a bar and a couple of good restaurants.  I would recommend this place with or without the pet.

Me Likes.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is such a hot mess! Lol I'm laughing because the fifth time in a row they've given me the wrong order. I work nearby so hey, it's affordable and convenient. But it's a game of coffee roulette. Which drink they gonna make today!? I have a simple order. Black Iced coffee, two cream, and one munchkin donut. I have received that order maybe twice? Lol one time they even gave me a coffee with "eight creams." Should've read that label before I left.  easy and convenient, but triple check your order before leaving. Even if it's a cold brew. Sometimes it comes straight out of their pitcher with sugar.

To be 100% honest Wasabi was an alright place for $20 dinner. Dining area was every nice. Now the nigiri was great, flavor was very tasteful. Sushi didnt seem to be completely fresh, the chief kept on forgetting to make our orders even at the bar, or getting it wrong. The sushi was a little dry. Not my favorite sushi place in Reno I believe the area is misleading for great tasting sushi. They couldn't even give us filtered water. Desserts and muscles not included with all you can eat. I just didn't really enjoy it.

This hotel is very charming and has a lot of history. It is centrally located close to restaurants and shops. The staff was super awesome and friendly! There were a few issues though that prevent me from giving 5 stars. First, the WiFi did not work at all. It said I was connected but it was just too slow. Next, the bed was too hard and lumpy and just uncomfortable. The shower floor is also full of soap scum and was a little dirty. We also found rat traps hanging around the corners of the room. The hotel is very nice and charming, but they really need to make sure it is being taken care of as far as cleanliness.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
By far the best Chinese food I have had outside of China, New York and San Francisco!  It's not your typical beef and broccoli American Chinese fare though.  Family favorites are:  salt and pepper tofu, salt and pepper shrimp, honey walnut shrimp, seafood fried rice with XO sauce (anything with XO sauce!), chicken in clay pot...

The original location is a hole-in-the-wall.  They don't take reservations and won't answer the phone during dinner on the weekends (too busy!) so plan on waiting a while for a table.  It's worth it though!  

BYOB.  Iced cold Tsing Tao pairs well.

We saw this restaurant while visiting The Shoppes at Cross Keys earlier in the week and decided to try it tonight.  We made a reservation for 8 p.m. but arrived early. We were seated immediately, and the service was prompt and friendly.  The bread was fresh and hot, and the dipping oil with spices was tasty.  I wanted tortellini but with meat sauce and not alfredo. Our server said "of course" without having to check with the kitchen. My partner ordered chicken florentine. Both dishes arrived promptly but were far from the best we've ever eaten.  We're going to try the place again...perhaps a different meal choice will do more to impress us.

Unfortunately I have to pick at least one star. First off, the hotel that I'm staying in has a unofficial letter posted in the lobby against these guys and doesn't even allow them on the lot. I only ordered because they snuck in the building and threw a menu under my door. Ordered a calzone and mozzarella sticks at 6:22 pm and the order came at 7:55 after I called twice. Accepted the order and the calzone was a slice of pizza with another slice on top and dude didn't even have the cheese sticks. Now I'm not sure but I think it's supposed to have sauce in it somewhere. Salty meat and cheese quesadilla is what I got. Don't do it!

This place was delicious! Complimentary miso soup to start (didn't finish mine because I had ramen coming my way), and plum ice cream to finish. We ordered the Las Vegas Roll and Fireball roll which were both awesome! The Spicy Korean Ramen, I ordered, hit the spot. Just the right amount of spicy. The plum ice cream was amazing!

Service was a little slow. There were only a few customers but one waitress. As it got busier, the poor waitress was still the only one. But the chef and busboy started to help out, and everything seemed to work out.

Definitely would recommend and will be going back for sure!

The sales representatives are definitely trying to make a SALE at the expense of the patron !! Lying to me by telling me my axel is leaking and needed a new one when My ex who's a mechanic told me it is NOT ! In addition, they said I needed an alignment and I just had an alignment the previous week and my car drives fine I know when I need an alignment...Sears Auto Center is good for an oil change if you have a coupon but that's it otherwise they'll attempt to sale you services you don't even need just to meet their sales quota
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Gorgeous hotel with a great location!  It's not at the heart of the French Quarter, as there's already one there, if you wanna check out hyatt FQ.  

I liked that it was a bit more remote.  It made our stay peaceful, and quiet.  We had a beautiful view of the Superdome and the Smoothie King - doesn't seem so beautiful as I'm describing, until around 7pm, when the sun sets over the bridge in the distance and you get a clear view from your room - of the sunset!

Special thanks to Ms. Robles, the assistant manager who is excellent at diffusing issues!  She made our stay hospitable, wonderfully relaxing, and unforgettable.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is easily the best auto shop I've ever been to. After my car was improperly "repaired" by Firestone and I was broken down on the interstate, I had my car towed to the nearest auto shop, which just happened to be West motors. The mechanic, Slim, was so helpful and made sure that Firestone paid for all the damages that occurred because of their mistake. He was awesome at communicating with me about what was going on and he went above and beyond to help me get my car fixed. Not only that, but he made sure that all the repairs were done right and I've never felt safer driving my car.
