Sooooo wanted to enjoy a nice birthday dinner here, but it just didn't happen. Was it an off night we'll never know as we called twice afterwards- only to have been told there wasn't a manager to speak with.

Ambience is lovely as long as you aren't seated in the sea of abandoned chairs downstairs (they store them cluttered next to your table).
The waiter forgot my husbands dinner. And it was his birthday.
My risotto was tough..with cold asparagus. 
They forgot my mother in laws wine until midway through dinner after being reminded.

We won't be going back.

Normally our go to hotel in Tucson, great location. 
Been coming to this hotel for over 20 years. Has really gone down but we stay here out of convenience. 
Today was a long day of driving, only to arrive at the hotel at 8pm... to find hairs of various body parts on the bathroom floor,,, and even a pillowcase. 

Hair all over shower. 

They are not overly concerned even though staff has seen evidence of the hairy mess left behind from previous visitors.

I had to change the sheets as housekeeping has left for the day. Light bulb out in a lamp to top off the evening! Just a bummer, I know they can do better. And care better!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It's a beautiful hotel it's too bad I ran from it due to the bed bugs crawling across the blanket. I was in room 702 for about 3 hours when I saw three bed bugs. 
I brought the carcass of one downstairs as I checked out. The employe at the desk was nice enough to call some surrounding hotels to find me another place to stay. He also let me know that I would not be charged for the evening. I should hope not. Be careful and check your bed before you settle in. I sincerely hope they correct the problem thoroughly. I have a hard time believing only one room has bugs.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Nice hotel and very price friendly but there are a few downsides to this one. First, it's a little odd of a location because it's in a industrial park right behind the train tracks. Two, the room we stayed in had a very uncomfortable sofa bed, and we could hear the toilet flushing in the room below us. Last, the help desk was rude and short on the phone and never delivered a certain item that we requested to our room.
The suite is nice for the price and has a full kitchen but other than that it's, meh, so-so. I guess you get what you pay for, in a sense.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The food was not great. But beyond that, the worst thing was the restaurant coupon rip-off. Okay, so all-u-can eat is excluded from the coupon, but then don't tell me that you are unable to back out the orders and ring them up ala carte because it's too hard!! It is not hard at all - just look at the order list! It made what would have been a decent experience turn into a terrible one where we left feeling ripped off and angry at the absence of an "owner" who could make a call on what should have been a goodwill building experience.  I won't be back here, and I wouldn't recommend it to anyone, coupon or not. Terrible deal!!

Normally I really like this place. It's a bit of a drive but I like the idea of the free vacuums and the wash is reasonably priced. 

However, I had called earlier in the day to see about their hours. The attendant told me very confidently that they are open till 9pm no matter the weather. I pulled up at 8pm on the dot after I got off work on a rather drizzly evening only to find that it was already closed for the evening. If they have set hours they should stick to them. I now have wasted my time coming all the way to  Chalmette  for nothing.

Great potential BUT just ok!

Hit or miss on the small and medium plates. 

Winners:
Sweat Potatoes 
Octopus (big time)

For dinner the lamb is a great dish 

Beets ok but not better (regardless of what they tell you and I love beets) 
Quail a bit less than ok 

Limited wine list and not great selections 

Hope they make it as I see potential, but lots of great choices in and around this neighborhood  

Service is quick and attentive but not refined - a bit of a weakness - unsure about the menu and unsure about ingredients

Came here while in Nashville for a bachelorette party with a group of 12 girls. We arrived along with a large group of guys that were in town for a bachelor party. Upon arrival, the bar was dark and smelled like stale beer. No one was dancing or even approaching the bar to dance on it. The bar was filled with middle aged men. This made none of us want to dance on the bar ( what we went there for ). We were pretty uncomfortable at first, but started drinking and the bartender started calling us up onto the bar. 

Beers were super cheap ($2) which definitely helped up warm up to this place a bit.

Why 3 stars? I spent 2 nights here. Some good points, decent size clean pool, pet friendly hotel  (extra charge), excellent full American breakfast (eggs, sausage, cereals, biscuits and gravy, fresh fruit, coffee,  pancake machine, oatmeal, juices  and more) friendly staff, quiet environment. The bad was the housekeeping service...garbage was left on the nightstand, items not restocked, and you could really tell the room had been done half fast. Wifi worked great for me (android) but my gf had I phone had some complaints. All and all I enjoyed my stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place is good as far as sushi goes. The portions are big, especially the nigiri. The daily specials (5 rolls that are 50% off) changes throughout the week so it can be fairly cheap depending how much you can eat. My favorite is Thursday and Saturday. 

The downside to Shogun? The service is awful. I understand that they get busy, but it's to the point where it's inexcusable. For about the hour and a half we were there, we saw our server 3 times. It took awhile for us to put in an order for the second round of sushi and to get our check.  

Overall, the food was good. Service was mediocre.

i love this starbucks location. i bring my dog into the drive thru at least once a week and the baristas are so nice to her & to me. i would understand if i got a barista who wasn't as friendly, since everyone has different personalities and i would never expect them to always be kind - but i SWEAR this is the friendliest starbucks in the sparks locations. i've been about 10 times and i haven't had any problems with my drinks, either. which is great cause my drink is pretty specific! thanks guys, keep up the good work.

Apparently, having the "best Mexican food in town" isn't saying much. There is nothing authentic about it.

It's hard to make a bad margarita...they succeeded. May as well have put a bottle of sweet - sour mix on the table and put some salt on it on the bottle neck rim.

I must say, the chips and salsa were very good.

I had the soft tacos with shredded beef filling: mediocre. Not even any Pico de gallo or cilantro. And their overlap with the runny beans made them impossible to pick up, had to resort to knife and fork. A felony in Mexico.

Went in to have a gel manicure and new polish on my toes. I have natural nails, not acrylic. So, rather than soaking the gel off, the owner filed all the polish off, taking with the polish my natural nail and beds. She did not soak my hands, just pushed the cuticle back with the file and did not bother even trimming them. So, $64.00 later it looked like a child painted my fingernails with gel and polish on my toes. By the next day all my natural nails began breaking off at the quick cause they had been grinded away. My nail beds are trashed and now I have to grow them again.

If I could give 0 stars I would. Absolute WORST customer service I have ever received. After ordering and being told 45 minutes, we decided to call and check on our order once it reached an hour and 20 minutes. At that point, the "manager" proceeded to tell my friend that there was a no refund policy (even though we never got out food... LOL at paying $60 for nothing), that he was being rude and hung up on him. DO NOT ORDER FROM HERE. these people apparently only want to run a business based on lies, aggressive behavior and horrible customer service.

First time here. Certainly not my last. I may live in LA, but man I will seek out this ice cream shop anywhere I go because it is just that phenomenal. 

No preservatives. No artificial flavors. Just simple, delectable, smooth ice cream and yogurts. What more could you possibly ask for? 

The mango lassi flavor was bold yet light, as was the wildberry lavender. They're incredibly fresh and creamy and just on another level from other ice cream places. This is truly one of a kind and everyone who can get access to a Jeni's should just forget about all other ice creams!

This shop is definitely old school as is Tim the owner/barber. I've been a returning customer and know Tim is skilled but only when he takes the time to execute his craft. He's very opinionated and speaks his mind freely, to the extent of becoming unprofessional. If you're a new customer or someone young, I wouldn't recommend this shop. Tim generalizes the youth and will always care more for a friend than even someone who had made an appointment. My last hair cut with Tim was rushed, he lacked pride in his workmanship and I had to go to another barber to have my hair salvaged.

First time at Bartaco yesterday with a few friends. Very pleased with the service and the food. We sat at the bar and Wes was our bartender/server. He was very friendly and attentive. The tacos were great. We tried the fish, portobello mushroom, duck, chorizo and chicken. The mushroom and fish were my favorite. The jalapeño hot sauce went well on all of them. Wes gave us some churros on the house that came with a chocolate dipping sauce. Get the churros. If you don't get the churros you aren't living right. We also filled out a comment card and got a few tokens for tacos on a future visit. I will definitely be back.

Not Im Pressed. I'm in hotels 3-4 times a year in this area for work but my job ended their contract with my preferred hotel. Looked on trip advisor and the views were decent so I went with this one. The staff was very nice when I called and theN I got here - the front desk guy was super dry not at all welcoming, the room is sub par... but the atrium is very nice. It's a nice sized living area but it not at all welcoming or even decorated. FIRE THE DECORATOR. the decor of the entire place is janky. I'll pass of this hotel the next time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The team at Seriously Strong Training is AMAZING. Everyone on staff is extremely knowledgeable about the body, nutrition, physical fitness, etc. They're also very interested in seeing you succeed in your fitness goals. Whether this means keeping track of your weightlifting progress, diet, sleep habits, or work stressors, the team at SST has your back! I trained with them at their Tallahassee location so when I heard they were expanding to St. Petersburg, I had to show my support. If you're looking for personal trainers who are flexible, down to earth, helpful, and interested in your success, please check out Seriously Strong Training!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: DO NOT ORDER FROM HERE!!! THEY ARE THIEFS! Took an order my order at 10:15 at 12:30 was told it was on the way. NEVER DELIVERED!! Had no problem charging my credit card. Impossible to get ahold of a manager, and was told they have a NO refund policy only exchange!! LMFAO!! THIS PLACE IS A JOKE! How are you not going to refund me for food that wasn't even delivered!? Hung up on multiple times after waiting 2+ hours. I was only staying a mile away at a local hotel. DO YOURSELF A FAVOR, AND NEVER EVER EVER ORDER ANYTHING FROM HERE!!

I slept on the pull-out couch and it was in the top three of the worst I've ever experienced. There were missing springs and stains on the cushions. I had to sleep with the cushions on top of the mattress to make it remotely comfortable.

Moreover, the wifi is aggravatingly slow, and the pool was closed for an entire month for maintenance. This is unacceptable. They also failed to provide free or reduced rate access to a substitute pool in the area. But hey, they've got really nice TVs, which is really all the sports-loving brahs who typically stay here care about, right?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Nice hotel, but good luck finding it with a GPS! You can't get to it using the South Capitol address. You have to enter from Washington St, and being unfamiliar with that part of Indy we had to have them talk us in by phone as we circled the block. Got upgraded to a small suite, which is certainly roomy. Dog friendly, with grass right outside the front door. The staff was friendly and efficient. Only stayed one night, but would recommend this as a good business hotel. Only drawback was you only get an hour of free wifi.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Look, people: it's a motel. What are you expecting? You get what you pay for, and for $74, you get a $74 motel. 

Our experience was a very clean room, friendly staff, and extremely comfortable beds. We booked via Expedia with no issues. Only slight gripe is the breakfast room isn't all that great. But again: you get what you pay for. 

Would stay here again. 

+ across street from Busch Gardens
+ close to every type of food imaginable
+ close to Yuengling tasting room
- breakfast is pretty lame
- outdoor access to all rooms
- parking lot is small for the size of this motel
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I don't know if what I encountered at this Starbucks today was a new barrista, sheer incompetence, or lack of attention being paid because I ordered a hot chocolate and receive instead, a cup of hot milk. My order was slightly complicated, but not hard enough to confuse hot chocolate with simple milk. The mistake was even more disappointing because there was literally no one else ordering at the time so the barristas were not in any type of rush. Will most definitely not be returning to this Starbucks. 100% waste of money.

This hotel is brand new, service is great, and it's well located, whether you're here for work or fun. 

But...there's a major downside here which is unfortunately out of the the hotel's control. There's another large hotel going up next door and apparently there are no rules around when construction can start. In my weeklong stay, I was woken up by hammering at 6:30 am and 4:30 am. Not great if you have a late night or an early (but not that early) meeting. 

Sorry to give 3 stars for an otherwise lovely property, but y'all have terrible neighbors.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This was my first visit and I must say I am very pleased. Dr. Yuhas was very knowledgeable and put me at ease. Regina, who works the front desk, was very friendly and even had some helpful tips for me as far as getting my cat to take medications and keeping her still while I clip her nails.

I thought their rates for service and medications were very reasonable as well. Not to mention they fit me in on very short notice. I called at 9:15am on a Saturday, and they were able to see my cat at 10am on the same day. Just amazing! 

My cat has a follow up visit in two weeks but I can honestly say I'll be back even beyond that.

Solid brunch for Father's Day!  Very affordable for the kids. My daughter got the tasty kids sautéed salmon and it could have been an adult order. 
The chicken/waffles were great, and the deviled eggs & millionaires bacon were awesome and could easily be an entree.  One in our party raved about the lobster bisque but not my thing. 
I tried the Eggs BrickTops which was very satisfying. Like a hearty quiche/omelette fusion with sausage and cheese; even the potatoes that came with were crunchy and tender. 
We ordered the homemade donuts for dessert but we were all full from the meal. Still really good! 
Great experience!

Straub's has been in the Central West End for longer than I have lived. They still let you run a monthly tab that you sign off on and go with ease. EVERYONE there is SO FRIENDLY and KNOWLEDGEABLE about all of the products and services that they offer. And if a particular employee doesn't have the answer they will find someone on staff that has the answer so you are completely satisfied with your shopping experience. Bravo Straub's! Keep up the good work and I will see you next year.

Andrew Dwyer
San Francisco, CA.
USA

Wish I read the other review before I went, I too am easy going about my hair but the lady that cut my hair did not even know how to do a fade/blend correctly. It honestly did take about 6-8 minutes and my hair is very uneven had to fix it myself.  I had to tell her 4 times that it was not right and in the end I just ended up saying I am done and leaving.  The lady had her cosmo license for 7 years, don't know how that is even possible if you can not even do a fade or blend right.  HORRIBLE will never be going back.

The reviews were pretty good and I like to support independent businesses so I gave F&G try.  The food came quickly but wasn't really hot (but that is to be expected with delivery so no knock on them about temperature.
I do have an issue with the following - ordered a pizza that was barely cooked and the toppings were really sparse.  Second issue was a chicken marsala dish that I asked to change out the potatoes for pasta - - which they did not do.  Not a huge deal but it means they do not read their orders very well.

I will likely try them again but eat-in to see if the first time was a fluke.

Great restaurant! I had the farfalle de pollo (misspelling) which is sundried tomatoes and chicken in a creamy pesto sauce.. portion size was huge! And BYOB.. so we brought in a bottle of vino... You really feel as if you are in Italy. The bread was amazing.. usually I never eat bread at an Italian restaurant but this one was delicious. Butter was even at perfect temperature. 
Only reason why I give it 4 starts out of 5 is because I felt as if I had too much pasta and not enough chicken. Maybe adding in another veg would be a good? 
Regardless I would be back!

I stayed at this Hotel over this past weekend. The location is great and the staff was helpful in assisting with an early check-in after we exited our cruise ship more quickly than expected. 

The hotel itself needs A LOT of cleaning and updating. The shower in our room barely worked and the toilet water overflowed out of the back tank of the toilet and flooded the bathroom.  The bed linens were ripped. 

Staff at check out offered to comp a breakfast for us.  If I were in the area again I would absolutely be choosing a different hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place really is amazing, I have been there several times and honestly have never been disappointed with their service. I know their portions are extremely small but the flavor is unmatched. I love the atmosphere it's casual but upscale at the same time. The staff is so friendly and helpful and they manage their wait time very closely. I had an incident that I was unhappy about but the manager made up for it, to the point that made my experience no less than a 5 star rating. Please keep up this wonderful vibe you guys have!

Donut Bistro is amazing. They have a great variety and everything is fresh. Their glazes and icings are perfect. The donuts are never dry or over-fried and  never tasting like oil. 

Their old fashioned donuts are the best I have ever had. They also have fun things like the large donuts and the fruit burritos so their is a format variety beyond cake, yeast raised and old fashioned types of donuts. 

We are from Chicago where the donut game is sub par so we visit this place at least once every time we are in town visiting and it's always a great treat

WLP residents and beyond!! If you want to find a small town local business kind of Starbucks this is your answer! But better! We usually get the bacon egg and Gouda sandwich on the ciabatta bread at Starbucks and the hot chai tea latte and this little place does it just right! The chai was not as sweet which is a plus and tasted brewed to me and the sandwich bread here is sooo much tatstier. They have all kinds of milk for those of us that are sensitive to cows milk. They have coconut milk oat milk almond milk soy (yuck)milk wow! Fast friendly drive through service too! Support Local!

We came here for my dad's birthday a few days ago . It was very convenient that they close at 12 AM we were able to make it after my dad got out of work. The food was great (we ordered so much of it too ) I wish our server was more attentive..I ordered a glass of Chardonnay every time he came to the table right before I finish my meal my dad finally  asked him to please bring my glass of wine . That was a bit disappointing I could've enjoyed it with my meal. But other than the service the food was great and we would be willing to give it a second chance

Overall, nice hotel, they have the best location, right on the water and the convention center next door, they have about 50 conference rooms so they certainly clean up. Food in the lobby was not that good, avoid champions if you can, very mediocre. I came in late and there was no food! Nothing opened, no room service, no vending machines, no gift shop nothing. Luckily I had some food in my bag, but they should really put a vending machine somewhere especially with a hotel this big. The rooms are very nice, not really luxury, but very decent place to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The macaroni was very good. We ordered the Buffalo Chicken macaroni, and you could taste the different cheeses and the buffalo sauce is good. The bubbling cast iron skillet that it comes in fresh to your table is a great effect. I just wish the feel of the place matched it. It's a little too fast food for the price. The furniture comes off tacky, and the staff was lax.

I would return, and now that I know the setting, I think I would go in with a different mindset, and be able to focus more on the food itself. I had really been expecting more from the restaurant itself.

I would recommend it to try, the macaroni was tasty.

What can I say about a grocery store that hasn't already been said? This one could use a deep cleaning and is in need of a bit of a facelift. However, the produce was bountiful and fresh, something I don't see in some other gorcery stores. Like most Union supported chains, the cashiers and other staff seem to be content doing the minimal amount of work required and lack the normal gusto one has come to expect from other parts of the retail sector. The excpetion? The "butcher" was very helpful, highly knowledgable and actually looked happy to be there.

I go to NTB for all my auto needs. I recently scheduled an appointment to have my car looked at. I arrived 30 minutes early for my appointment and was told by the manager that I couldn't be seen because they were busy and was told to step to the side. They got a walk in client and took him right away. The customer service was horrible. The whole idea of scheduling an appointment is to ensure service can be don't at a certain time. The manager didn't even give me an option for a later time. He told he couldn't help me today and continued to help the gentleman behind me. I highly doubt my family and I would be returning.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: lobby is horribly configured where there is enough room for 2 people on the check in line before your out the door , there was no king size avail or even queen instead got 2 double beds, rooms were a lil dirty, windows didnt open and overlooked graveyard we complained about the beds and got free breakfast buffet which was good, pool on roof is cool, hotel bar is a joke room for 3 stools, good location near tourist stuff booked on hotwire for. 82 bux i guess u get what u pay for, oh and its 30 bux a day to park
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Really enjoyed our meal at Tuscan Sun. Atmosphere was nice and food was very flavorful. Unlike another comment on Yelp, we really enjoyed the marinara sauce served with the bread. We ordered meatballs as an appetizer and both had pasta entrees for dinner which were great. Service was good - attentive but didn't pester us. 
Being from Chicago, there haven't been many places in the Tarpon Springs area I'm overly interested in because many places are just okay. This restaurant is definitely now on our short list of places to frequent!

Attended Coastline for a birthday brunch yesterday.  Boy what a let down.  I previously worked here as a bartender years ago and was never a fan of the food.  However, since this was a birthday occasion I of course came back.  The food was terrible.  I have a vast pallet and enjoy a little of everything; so when I brought three plates (with a sample of each dish) back to my seat I figured I could find something I liked.  ERRRRR, Wrong!  I ended up filling my empty stomach on a bagel, mozzarella, and salad as these were the only items I found edible!

DO NOT recommend. Everyone I met working here was incredible rude. For being a newer hotel place wasn't even that clean. I found a blood stain on my comforter. 

Then this morning I go down to the "bistro" for a simple bagel, but no the lady beside the counter told me "no. she closed 10 minutes." So they close at 10 o'clock on the weekend which is honestly BS hours. In the big scheme of things probably for the best because they sell overprice POS kind of food at the "bistro". Please don't waste your time or money at this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Guess I should've read the reviews first. Needed to kill time before work and Sushi Teri in Goleta wasn't open. 

Got the teriyaki chicken bowl.  Big mistake. I am a purist and just want chicken and rice I'm my bowl. They put in bell peppers, carrots and so much lettuce I couldn't find the rice. 

Their teriyaki sauce is a bit salty. I prefer the sweet teriyaki sauce at sushi Teri.  In fact I prefer everything at sushi Teri. 

The California rolls were okay but not amazing. 

The waitress/cashier didn't care that I wasn't satisfied.  So the customer service sucks

So we showed up, party of 2. Were told 10 minutes to be seated. Shortly after a party bus arrived, about 16-18 people. The party bus openly said they did not have a reservation. They did not even all have masks.. Even though they were there AFTER our party of 2, they were seated first. 16-18 people. No reservation. Seated before waiting customers. Will not be coming back. In addition to that, of course the restaurant was disturbingly loud afterwards. They let a party bus of 16-18 intoxicated underaged teenagers in.

Visited for my first time using the one time free pass that was on the their webpage. Their low prices definitely sparked an interest so I figured why not try it out. My favorite color is purple but the amount of purple in this gym actually gave me a headache! There were a lot of cardio machines which was nice but definitely not much else. Also they are currently doing A LOT of construction so the place kinda seemed a mess and some equipment was closed off. Overall not terrible for the price but not my cup of tea- so the gym hunt continues
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The food was good but I was a little let down by the service! I could be use to the Brandon location and the service that I've received. But the waiter started off attentive but it seemed like as the night progressed he was less available. We ordered chicken nuggets and fries for the kids and we didn't get them until after we were almost done with our Hibachi and we were at the grill for plenty of time. We barely saw our waiter after we received our first serving. By the end we weren't even in the mood to continue to eat there.

Do you hate COVID protocols? This might be the perfect place for you! Not a single employee I saw was wearing a mask when I entered to pick up my call in order.

I was taken aback by their lack of ANY pandemic protocols. Most restaurants have switched to plastic cutlery in sealed plastic sleeves. Nope, they're just in the tub for people to grab on their way out.

I wish I would have know before I placed my order that the people preparing my food were going against all CDC guidelines while handling it.

I will not be returning to this establishment, even after this pandemic subsides. I will NEVER eat here again.

Give Nicks a try, there are some new menu items, some like the eggs Benedict may not be listed. Just ask!
The prices here are very reasonable and the food is good!  We live in Jacksonville Fl but visit Nicks whenever in St Pete to visit friends there.  Nicks is very good for groups, Ive been to much pricier places that cant manage to get everyone's order out at the same time, or the correct orders.  Nick's does both with ease. My next visit will be for the Eggs Benedict or the really great looking Spinakopita ( layered spinach and cheese pie) that a table mate attacked with gusto and raved over.

Worst customer service ever! I called to ask if they sell roasted duck and before I even get the chance to say Hello, the employee kept saying hello hello hellooo, as if he was playing with the phone. When i finally got a word in, he then says "Hold up i have to put you on hold". When he finally gets back on the phone, i asked if they sold duck and this was the response, "of course we have duck. We've been here for 30 years, why wouldnt we have duck. Dont you know we have duck"? Why the heck else did you think i called?! There will never be any businesses from me!

I was getting my battery tested. From the start the man at the counter was trying to sell me a new battery - even prior to the completion of the diagnostic. I did in fact need a new battery and was given a quote. I said that I wanted to consult with my boyfriend before making a purchase. He asked why I couldn't just buy it and then said, "You said it was your boyfriend - not your husband or your daddy! That's not a healthy relationship." After this I asked for my vehicle and left. Another gentleman, came to apologize for this interaction, but the damage is done. I will NEVER return to this location and will spread the word.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
The hotel is in a good location and the front desk associates are friendly.

However, if you bring a vehicle save yourself some time and money! I paid $50 a day for absolutely nothing. The valet associates are lackadaisical, one was on his personal phone the entire time. Thank God I wasn't in a rush, it took them over 20 minutes to get my car during non-traffic hours. The texting feature wasn't working, so I literally waited outside for over 20 minutes. When i asked, I was told "It usually takes a while". Definitely worst valet experience.

There are parking lots and garages all over, I suggest you park there if you drive
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: filthy live bugs in rice and beans managers cindy and marion know about it and cindy stated " there is nothing i can do thats the way winn dixie ships out their products from the warehouse '  god help winn Dixie    this store could maybe benefit by having a management team come from the lutz store to help clean inside and out and organize and teach customer service skills to the current management this issue has been reported to MIKE HAll district manager and Jacksonville head quarters thanks for listening and will keep you all updated

I enjoyed my stay at this hotel. Room was very clean (complimentary Paul Mitchell shampoo). They were doing some work in the room across for me, but I never heard anything. Bed is very comfortable and the staff was very friendly and helpful.

The hotel is near everything, French quarter, bus and trolley stops and Starbucks is right on the corner which was certainly a plus for me.

Parking may be difficult- but you don't really need a car is you're just staying in town. 

All and all, it's a great spot to lay your head after a day of checking out the city, which is what I used it for.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Every employee we encountered was beyond friendly and nice. We arrived to pick up a mid-sized car. The first one didn't have the GPS we had asked for, so they gave us another model. I got in and it reeked of cigarette smoke. I said, "Someone smoked in this car. I just want you to know it wasn't us." They apologized and upgraded us to a Cadillac! We aren't complainers so were really surprised and delighted at how sweet they were. Anthony McKie in particular was the BEST! He is a management trainee, but he's perfect already - very well dressed, well spoken, handsome, polite, very friendly and fun! Well done, Enterprise and Anthony!

I know what you're thinking.  It looks reasonably priced and kinda cool/quant from the pics.  DONT.  DO. IT.   The location is tough - one side is the freeway, the other is the dumpsters for the restaurant next door.  The room is all of 110sq ft.  That's literal.  There's no food service at all - no restaurant, bar or room service.  Check-in took about 30 minutes and I was the only one in the lobby (though I can't figure out exactly who's fault that was).  Anyway, even for the price, better can be found in this area.  Bed is pretty comfy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I gave this hotel four stars, but 3.5 would probably be more appropriate. The rooms are nice, but a bit dated for what they cost. The beds are SUPER comfortable though. The restaurant is a bit small, but the food options are decent. I didn't get a chance to interact much with the staff, but they were friendly enough when I did. The hotel's best feature would be its location. It is very conveniently located (attached via skywalk) near the Indiana Convention Center and downtown Indianapolis. Also, very short walks to both Lucas Oil Stadium and the Bankers Life Fieldhouse.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've lived in one of the townhouses with my fiance for a year and we've had a great experience. The units are nice, they have landscaping done each week and maintenance is always quick to fix any issues. Occasionally parking is an issue if you get home late at night, but there are usually plenty of spots by your building. Some of our neighbors have lived here for many years and have had good experiences as well. Located right by South County mall and lots of dining options, plus it's just off 270 so it's easy to get to other parts of town.

I joined this gym in July 2015 and I was happy at first but then I started to see threw the initial facade. About half way through my membership they introduced SweatX. 

At first I was excited because the gym was getting new equipment. (Their equipment is old and rusty)  

As it turns out, they used the normal membership revenue to start a new program which excludes current members and requires you to pay substantially more to use the new equipment. 

Needless to say, this was enraging. I will be switching as soon as possible. I would not recommend this gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Had lunch here- the loaded potato wedges.  It was average, a little underwhelming for the higher prices.  However, the service was wonderful.  They accommodated a large party for us on a very short notice at a very small table.  The waitresses were absolutely fabulous, which is a huge part of the dining experience for me so overall I can mainly overlook the average food as others in my party really enjoyed other dishes such as the chicken sandwich or the turkey and Brie sandwich.  Also side salads are HUGE!! And one of us ordered a side of fruit and it was enormous!

Fast service and you're able to choose your car from whats available. Only thing is there were no economy cars and so had to choose compact car. Got Chevrolet spark with no problems. 

Only thing i don't understand is even though i opted for pre-paid gas, why am I paying for the full tank that is 30$ extra and not just for how much I used. My total bill was around 75$ which is not what i was expecting based on the minimal driving I did. Its not that way at any of the other rental companies. For that reason, i'd probably book somewhere else.

Cost,  ok. Bed was comfortable, location great. Place is somewhat  run down, but they are making improvements it seems. The smell coming from the drain in the sink/kitchenette was really nasty. I asked the maint guy if he  could check, throw some bleach in there. He just said let the water run for a while, old water in the trap is what smells. It didn't help much. 

Regardless, people there were friendly, very nice. Hotel  needs work, elevator broke but was fixed in a day. It's not a luxury hotel, doesn't pretend to be.  Average, good value, fine.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Went with a friend on a Saturday night.  Nice decor/interior feel.  Wait staff was very friendly and attentive throughout the entire dinner.  Nice to have sparkling water as an option as well as still.  Wines by the glass somewhat limited, but for a small place, not unusual.  The food was great.  Had the carrot ginger soup and the halibut.  Soup had a nice kick to it from the ginger and a good texture.  The halibut was excellent.  Light, flaky and done perfectly.  Quality ingredients and food all the way around.  I'll be back.

I came here today for the first time and I was pleasantly surprised! This little hole in the wall Mexican restaurant is on point! The salsa was super fresh, the staff was super friendly, and the lunch portions were just right! I ordered the lunch sized chicken fajitas, which was the perfect amount of food, even if it had been for dinner! I left very satisfied. Don t judge this book by its cover, it is located off of the beaten path next to a closed down gas station, but the food quality and ambiance are exactly what I want in this type of dive bar Mexican restaurant! I will definitely be back given the chance!

Stay here instead of another place because of pet issues. This hotel don't accept pets which is great. (sorry pet lovers but I can't stand the hair)

I'm very glad we came here - beautiful place and very comfortable room. I love the bed! Pool was nice - boys loved it. 

Very quiet and peaceful at the hotel. Staff were very friendly. 

Negative thing is - our room was in first floor and the outdoor light was shining on our window through the night so had to put towel to cover the light coming in the room but it works well. 

Wish breakfast was free. 

Will come back to stay here when we are in town. Love the place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We LOVE papa johns and are always ordering. We just moved to the area and this was our first time ordering from this specific location. I'm missing our old store ): Our cheese bread was more bread than cheese (which happens, we don't usually care enough to comment on this) but when we opened our pizza I was just ... sad. It looks like our pizza was tossed around before arriving. Toppings had fallen off the pizza into the box, the sauce was ON the pizza, leaving a dent and there is a large "glob" of ... I'm not sure. Taste was there, just very off putting appearance wise.

The staff here was very nice and it was clear that the hotel had been recently renovated. The decor, I found, was very odd with metal balls planted in fake grass.

We were upgraded to the "junior suite" for free for some reason, and upon entry in the room immediately needed to kill a very large bug. Still don't know what it was...  Overall the room was nice and large. I did note some peeling wallpaper with what looked like mold on it.  Overall, I wasn't unhappy with the hotel, but I'm not sure I'd stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Avoid this hotel at all cost! Unfortunately, my company has a contract with this hotel and I cannot at the moment get out of staying here. 

The rooms are absolutely disgusting! Not clean, they smell horrible (like urine and mildew), and they claim to always be out of rooms if you ask to switch. 

Floor never vacuumed (crumbs/hair/toenails everywhere)
Bathroom not cleaned (smells like urine/pubes all over)
Sheets not always changed 
Air conditioning doesn't work well
Walls very thin

Once again - do not stay here! This hotel should be demolished!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
My family and I travel monthly. We have rented many cars but I have never experienced anything like I did at Nifty. The girls in the office (Rachel being the worst) were so unbelievably rude and unprofessional. They were very confrontational with my husband and myself right in front of my 2 year old daughter. Rachel even made a point try and charge us more then what was advertised and what we were told our daily rate would be. She took it as far as  calling one of her co-workers right in front of us to discuss the commission she would be splitting with him. 
Worst customer service I have ever experienced.

This is definitely a nice hotel for the price. $89 a night and you have a little mini  kitchen. "2 burner stove top, full size refrigerator and a microwave" 
We had a great stay here. The staff were all friendly  
My only complaint is that the bathroom wasn't really all that clean. (Isabel) cleaned our room and i think all she did was wipe it down. I went to use the blow dryer and when i pulled it off the holder there was makeup all over it. Thankfully the front desk had some Antibacterial wipes. Also, our ice maker has ..i don't know what.. all over it...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I went to Serefinas after the restaurant across the street the Dandelion had a 30 min wait to get a table. I should have waited.... I entered Serefinas in hopes of getting a solid well prepared piece of protein .. The brunch menu had steak and eggs for about 23 dollars. The steak was an over cooked under seasoned cheap cut of meat with eggs sunny side up and frozen French fries.. The calamari was over seasoned way to salty for my taste.. And another gripe I have is ... It took at least 15 mins to get a cup of ice water in a rather unpacked restaurant.. Will not be back.. Will not recommend..

One of the worst meals I have ever had in a restaurant. Not only was the kitchen unequipped to handle the Friday night dinner rush, but both myself and my husband got ill from the meal thru lunchtime the next day, extra disappointing since it was my birthday. The waiter was very sweet and brought us a dessert on the house, after my husband complained that the table next to us was served before us although we ordered prior to them being seated.  Next time I am going to pay $ 30 for an entrée, I will be heading to Philly where the price delivers service, quality and quantity (we were left hungry by the small portions).

Don't expect the normal Marriott experience here. The service was the poorest I have experienced in a Marriott Brand.  As a Gold Elite with a night or two away from Platinum, my AC didn't work for a 3 day stay in 80 degree weather.  They didn't do much to repair it, move me or give a discount.  I asked for a bill at the end and they could not print one. They also made sure to collect the $6 a day for the "free for Gold" internet.  
9 trips to King of Prussia in the next 2 years and I doubt I'll be staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Horrible. Just horrible. Just walked out a few minutes ago after my girlfriend took a sip of her Malibu & pineapple and pulled a rather large bug out of her mouth. It was made all the more terrible when we told our waitress and she responded with "oh, it was probably just a fruit fly"...WHAT!? There was no apology. Nothing. We watched her tell the manager and he didn't even look at us as we left. 

Horrendous. Where the hell is John Taffer to rip these people a new one? 

Never go to Fratelli's. Walk down a block and take a right and go to The Corner. We're eating here now and it is both cheaper AND bug-free.

My friend and I ordered take out for the first time Friday night. We ordered the Sushi Regular platter because she wanted to try more sushi. She only has sushi one other time before this and I figured I'd help her learn to love it. Somewhere though, our order got mistaken and we ended up with Sashimi. This wasn't a problem for me, but she wouldn't touch the raw fish slices. Luckily we ordered a second order of California Roll for her. The food was delicious! The night wasn't a total bust either because I got to watch everyone in my house freak when I was eating my Sashimi! We'll definitly be going back!

This place threw away our grill and table we had on our patio. It was not in the way. They VERBALLY told my roommate ONCE to move it. I called the office and spoke with Amanda who is the "assistant manager", also extremely rude, and she claims that they had posted a note on our door. GUESS WHAT, there was no notes or letters. There was no warning. They never called and expressed the issue. They have my contact information and never said ANYTHING. I would NEVER recommend this place to anyone. I said it before in my last review SEEK LIVING ELSEWHERE. Extremely disappointing.

The service at Cafe Mochi was absolutely terrible. A friend and I waited 2 hours for 2 rolls and still never received them. So we told our waiter we were leaving and instead of appropriately apologizing for the slow service and long wait for our food. He said "OKAY" and walked off. We understand the hard times of Covid. Everyone is short staffed. We were not upset to wait for our food a little longer than normal, but TWO HOURS for two rolls is just crazy. The bigger problem here was the terrible service. No apologies, no accommodations, nothing.

Very satisfying stay. Their initiative to greet their guests with a fresh, warm and delicious cookie is fantastic. Makes you feel right at home! 
The rooms have the highest standards and the service is very friendly. For instance,  I had forgotten my phone charger,  the staff did everything they could to find me one. I was staying on the 8th floor and the view with the sunset was amazing. The pool is inviting but the gym could use more machines. 

I had a seminar to attend to in the hotel, the next morning, and the venue was very well attended to. 
Great organisation,  food and service. I recommend !
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Favorite franchise for an Iced Carmel Latte, but least favorite Tampa location. I have started timing from when I make my order to when I get my item, because it has become ridiculous. Either this location is short staffed, or not very good at multitasking. It should not take me 10 minutes in your drive through for an order. Many times I have driven off, because I have places to me. And other locations my order is ready at the window to pay and go. I know I cannot be the only one who notices the time it takes. Do better!

This place does not even compare to the Origami Sushi on Waters. I've made multiple attempts for them to change my opinion around, but I will never waist money at this location again. The waitresses are not attentive with only 1 table to serve in the whole restaurant. For take outs, the hostesses will not give you the specials over the phone. God forbid you come in during the start of business. Does there chef just serve leftovers from the night before? The sushi tasted horrible, the rolls were falling apart, and the chicken was over cooked (again, did they just reheat the food from last night?).

Walked into this place on a Sunday afternoon and even with them busy I was greeted right away and sat down for my pedicure. Felt a little rushed when picking  the colors and that's like the hardest part of the whole thing, lol but she took her time and it was such a good pedicure. While she was doing my full set he kept getting up and talking to the other techs, kinda annoying but oh well. Would I come back, yes but I might try out other nail places in the area. Reasonably priced and awesome selection of colors

Ordered breakfast to go this morning,  and keep in mind,  I live 5 minutes from Fiona's.. I ordered pigs in a blanket and a side of cheesy scrambled eggs for my daughter. First off, the sausage links were dry and hard and pretty much inedible, but I managed to eat the mostly flavorless pancakes.  What really kills me is the cheesy scrambled eggs...it was literally a small flat circle of overcooked (not just done, WAY overcooked) with a square American singles slice on top... I'm just saying have a little pride in your work.  I'm a cook and this was incredibly disappointing and frankly embarrassing. I will not be returning.

You need to try this place out! Hidden gem! Great sushi! Came with a girlfriend on a Friday around 6pm and we didn't have to wait. What I loved must about this place was the rice to fish ratio; I've been to too many places and they overload the rolls with way too much rice. However, this palce had just the right amount! Reasonable prices and good selection of rolls. 

The only problem I had was the waitress not filling our waters. We had to ask multiple times before she came around to it. 

However, overall I loved this place and can't wait to come back!

My wife and I ate here Friday night.  All I can say is this restaurant is nothing short of truly incredible!!!  Frank (the manager?) came over to out table several times to be sure all was well.  We haven't had a decent meal around Brandon ever since "Della's After Dark" closed.  The food and service at this place is truly phenomenal.  The Bread was the best I've had for years!!! We will be returning every two weeks.  The people associated with restaurant should be truly proud of this establishment.  Clearly, the very very best in Brandon!!!

I know to find a reasonably priced and good quality Japanese cuisine and sushi bars may be difficult in Midwest. But cafe mochi seems such one that I am looking for.  I dined during happy hour, so half price. I started from white fish and then tuna, and yellow tail nigri roll, octopus roll and endes up with eel roll. white fish, yellow tail are rich and delicious. Yellow tail roll spicy is great cuz it comes with good texture and layers of flavors. I like crispness of octopus, like Chinese dried pickles. The plate is nice and warm and the wasabi is the horse radish knockoff, substracting 1 star.

I have driven past this place a million times and didn't know it was a restaurant...I assumed it was a shoe store  A friend told me I had to check it out and I'm so glad that I did! The garlic knots were a great start, so fresh and yummy! We started with the stuffed mushrooms as an app and they were the best I've ever had. Next we had Caesar salads, also delicious. For my meal I ordered the homemade gnocchi in a vodka sauce. At this point I was stuffed from the knots, mushrooms and salad but j couldn't not eat what was in front of me, it was that good! Can't wait to go back and try the pizza!

This was the best restaurant I ate during my stay at St Louis. Hands on!!  
It's located inside the Hilton Hotel. I ordered the Cobb salad, which I quickly regretted as I tasted everyone's burger.  That's what I get for trying to order something on the healthier side lol. My salad was good, but their burgers were really good!! 

My husband ordered the bbq burger. Dad ordered the California burger and my sister ordered a different one (can't remember the name of it). These all had a buttery warm bun and the burger meat melted in your mouth!!  Mm-mmm!

We came here for dinner during our visit to Philly on a beautiful summer Sunday. The atmosphere is casual. The space is modern. We were given a table immediately. The waitress was friendly. The menu includes appetizers, tacos, sides, salads and mains. They have a drinks menu. As an appetizer we had the guac and chips. This was ok. We ordered the vegan tacos and the beef tacos. The vegan tacos were ok. A bit too spicy for my taste. My friend said the beef tacos were good. We also had a pitcher of the watermelon margarita. Not much alcohol which was nice. The food is ok, but pricey. The service is average.

If you like sushi for the fish, you will be disappointed. The Maki rolls have very little fish. I did not try any of the specialty rules because I knew it would be a little bit of fish and a lot of needless toppings. The pork dumplings are decent. The sushi has too much rice and only a thin sliver of fish or eel. Also the price was one dollar extra for the lunch buffet, I found this out when I saw a sticker covering the original price on the restaurant door. $15 for crappy sushi and rolls, I will try and find a lunch special that includes sushi with salad and or soup for the same price. On a positive note the service was very good.

I really loved how fast the restaurant was! The burgers were tasty too! 

As we drove through, there was a young man taking orders. He was quick & got our order right the first time. When we arrived at the pay window, the order was repeated correctly. By the last window, we were handed our cups in a cup holder and two bags. They didn't assume that we didn't need the cup holder. It was a no brainer for four drinks. Thanks for that! 

The one part I missed... Watching the employees cutting potatoes! Something about seeing them cut right there that gives you that reassurance that your getting fresh fries.

horrible service and slowest McDonald I have ever been to. ordered a fries with no salt on mobile and waited 15 minutes for it, in the end I left without getting it cuz I had to get to work. I mean only one fries, if I ordered a whole bunch of items that would be understandable. the people ordered after me got their food already. And most of the times they didn't notice the NO SALT part. people, you had one job and you failed it. LOL, the manager was more professional thou, she told the others that mobile orders suppose to be ready first that's the whole point of having it.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Sorry to have to leave this type of review.  When justified, I'm very generous with my praise and tips.  The food was so-so.  The service, meh.  If you are a regular, the waitress and the owner will be very friendly and visit with you.  If not, you are treated with indifference.  My husband and I are friendly people, but we probably shouldn't have bothered.
And that bathroom ... pretty disgusting - the floor was sticky, there were fingerprints on the cabinet that clearly have been there for awhile, and it was all around dirty.  Unfortunately, we won't be back.  I really wanted to like them, but it didn't work out that way.  Oh, well.

We came here for my in-laws anniversary. They say the decor hasn't changed in many years but it is very festive. They have a big menu full of variety. At first when I saw the prices I thought it was kinda pricey because at Chinese restaurants in Hawaii dishes are half that price. However when they arrived they were pretty big portions. Everything was hot, fresh and had good flavor. My favorite was the Szechuan beef. The peaches and cream with the shrimp was a little sweet for me. The service was timely and staff were friendly. Overall, would come again.

It's amazing how fast a bad employee can drive away business. As of tonight I'm done ordering from this location, the women that answers phone and works counter the last couple weeks is terrible. They seem to go threw people pretty fast so hopefully she will be gone soon and I can start going back. The foods not bad but it's also nothing to right home about. 

So they are now charging $2.50 for a can of soda tell me that's not price gouging! I understand fountain soda can not be sold but does not mean you charge $2.50 for a can of soda.

I'm a big fan of Kiwi yogurt...this brother/sister act is with the program. Clean, sleek stores with good flavors and toppings. Always busy. Average priced...about 5 bucks.

My only beef is that the upscale areas where most locations are located does not foster the most enthusiastic help. Lots of well-to-do teens with their perfunctary job, who have zero sense of customer experience, but politely ring up your yogurt while all the while wondering what they are missing on Facebook. It's becoming the norm.

Still one of my favorite shops...

Had dinner on a Friday. The appetizer, arancine, was very good. Those are the crispy risotto balls they have. However, the entrees were subpar. We had the ricotta gnocchi and the spaghetti alla primavera. The gnocchi was in a ragu sauce with lamb chunks, but it also had a mint pesto on top. The mint pesto just didn't match the rest of the dish at  all. It was a very awkward combination. And the texture of the gnocchi was not smooth. The spaghetti alla primavera was lacking flavor. Very bland. I would not go back. 

I will say that the service is very good. Our server was very attentive and pleasant.

We traveled to New Orleans to celebrate my daughter's 17th birthday so I wanted it to be really special. The hotel was presented as new in the description. I am thinking it would be nice and clean without rusty shower racks and broken tile in the bathroom. I rarely have my room cleaned while I'm here but didn't understand why the floor was clearly not vacuumed and the shower floor looks grimy before my stay. $300 per night! Not worth it. The 3 stars are for the proximity to everything and the room style. The visible dirt is less than desirable especially during COVID. Disappointed Titanium member.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Hands down the best Anytime Fitness in the Indianapolis area! More equipment available, especially if you like lifting versus a bunch of unneeded cardio machines taking up space. The owner Josh and his trainer Brandon are both great and always available during daytime hours if you need anything. They just had all the benches and machines redone with new material after they started to tear. Deadlift platform, which many gyms lack. The place is kept in great shape with an awesome staff, can't ask for much more. Gains are made in this gym!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This hotel was ok. Stayed here on the second night of a two-day trip to the Philly area. The room was clean, although there were a few stains here and there, the bed was comfy, staff was fine. Having stayed in a different hotel the night before that was much nicer for an even lower price, though, kind of cast this place in a shadow. 

I wasn't scared to death like some of the other reviewers seemed to be, but I will agree that the walls are pretty thin. If you stay on the bottom floor, you will hear every footstep above your head all night long.

Overall, it was fine.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I love these apartments! I've lived in a couple different apartment communities and this is by far the best in Nashville. They keep everything very clean. I love the "pet lounge" they added - which is so nice on rainy or colder days and there is an amazing dog washing station. You can walk to most everything in Germantown. And one of the best parts is that the staff is so friendly and attentive to things - they do their job right and go out of their way. Parking is great and the building is very secure. The workout facility is great as well.

Traveling full-time in our RV and needed to do laundry. This was near the Harley dealer I wanted to visit so I thought I'd get the laundry done beforehand. It's clean inside, there's a change machine,detergent machine, tables and chairs to work at while laundry is going, folding tables and a restroom. The main part of the building is clean and the bathroom wasn't horrible but the sink was kind of dirty and there was no soap for washing hands. Because of the bathroom is the only reason I didn't give it 5 stars, but it wasn't so bad that I wouldn't use it!  If I'm in the area again I would definitely come back!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I was in here today and had terrible service. It took over a hour and a half to get our food. Getting beers and our drinks refilled took a along time also. The  manager told us that " the food was worth the wait "but just because the food is good doesn't mean they can slack on service. The food we ordered did not merit the wait. Also there was a live band playing in the back and the music was so loud that it was impossible to have a conversation at my table which was in a different part of the building.This was the second time this has happened at this restaurant and it will be the last time we ever go back

This is the second time I've stayed here.  Rooms are small but fairly well furnished.  Location is pretty much perfect.  Parking is atrocious.  Doors let every sound from the hallway in and the A/C is LOUD.  Worst of all for a business traveler the internet is horrible.  Not only do you get slow DSL speeds but the wireless is so bad that is just goes in and out of service.  Can't do much more than browse internet because anything requiring a constant connection like netflix, hulu, gaming, etc. just won't work.  I realize is a reclaimed older building but . . .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Have been looking forward to eating here for a while, based on the reviews i was expecting much more. We purchased the chicken meal for $13 and some change, which sounded like an excellent deal. Instead we got a "whole chicken" pieced with only one breast, no cheese, and a small take home box of rice/beans with only enough for about three bites of each for two adults and one three year old. The taste was ok, but the chicken was dry. If you are expecting a quality meal with all the fixings you will be disappointed, but you cant beat the price.

I just went to get my weekly car wash, I have a subscription, and was told I could not go through the car wash because my car was too dirty! It's been raining excessively in my area and I drove through a little bit of mud on my way out of my driveway. I have never had a car wash tell me that I had to pre-wash my car elsewhere before I came through the car wash. Yes, I said car wash a bunch of times, it's a car wash, meaning a place to clean a dirty car. I asked where I should "prewash" and the attendant said, "not here". I am ending my subscription today.

Rooms are great, customer service is terrible and I don't need you to believe my review. This is my opinion. Anything you request to be brought to your room, Housekeeping will forget or Ignore. I'm on my fifth call as I speak. Restaurant inhouse bar waiter Edgar the immigrant is a total ass. Rude bartender and service was subpar. Manager of the restaurant has no experience and most likely slept with the boss to get her job. Stay as far away from this hotel and restaurant. I PROMISE you will have a better time at the Ritz Carlton! Like I said, I don't need you to believe my review, take it as you will. This is my opinion. Thanks for reading
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If there was an option for -stars I would have chosen that rating. I went to this establishment once and had the seams of two dresses hemmed and one shirt dry cleaned. I should have left them there, because the store manager charged me for also cleaning the dresses and when I told her I didn't ask for this, she was extremely rude and refused to provide a remedy. If I owned this business, it would be my vendetta to fire her for her lack of customer service and the need for an attitude adjustment. Not only are they overpriced, but the service was crude and the actual hemming was sub par.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I had a birthday party there two weeks ago. I rented out the whole back room for 23 people. The cost was a $150 downpayment that was taken out of the final bill. It was $35/person for a 3 course meal. we had the room for about 4 hours, and the staff was great, putting up with a bunch of people who were drinking more and more throughout the course of the night! the food was great - the menu was preset but  all of the appetizers and entrees were great. All of my friends loved the food and enjoyed the night Great idea for a large party dinner event!

One of my favorite ice cream shops in Nashville! Prices are decent and the quality is amazing! I really love the variety of flavors here, and the frequently updating flavors. I don't know if it's a seasonal menu or something, because they are relative to season (sweet potato eclair is in right now!). But it's awesome that there is always something new.

What really makes it is the phenomenal employees. I've been here several times and they are always friendly and great at suggesting flavors/giving opinions. Some of the best customer service and genuinely nice people, almost as refreshing as the ice cream! :)

Given that it is a customizable pizza place, I was quite impressed at the freshness of the vegetable and fruit toppings. I personally enjoyed the Island pizza. It came with red sauce, shredded basil, diced pineapples, caramelized onions and finished with a buttery crispy crust. My boyfriend got the buffalo flavored pizza, which is so good. It literally tasted like a chicken wing with a a side of ranch. Also, what's cool is if it's your first time, you get a free pizza (that includes the unlimited toppings too!!) on your next visit! So, I'm definitely taking advantage of that soon. I highly recommend it for students and family visiting the UA.

I can not say enough wonderful things about the incredible staff of LaVilla! We hosted my grandmother's memorial luncheon in the side room and the owner and staff were so kind and generous to our family! The food was, of course, Delicious!

I called maybe 20 local restaurants looking for a spot to host the luncheon and the owner of LaVilla was the only person I talked to whose first words to me was "I am so sorry for your loss," every other restaurant I spoke to was all about the transaction but the folks at LaVilla treated us like family. We are so grateful for the experience we had! My family and I will all be life-long customers!

Had a wonderful catered cioppino  dinner by Chef/proprietor Alberto at my home for 17 of my best sailing friends. The cioppino was to die for; shrimp, clams, mussels, halibut, salmon,scallops, calamari in a tomato sauce of local grown tomatoes and herbs. It was so fun to have him cook in the kitchen where all guests could watch and ask questions as he was cooking. I'd recommend him coming to your home and cooking especially if your stove is in an island. Oh did I mentioned his great Caesars salad with fresh croutons that he cooked minutes before serving the dinner. Fresh, fresh , fresh.

I feel bad... The staff are incredibly nice and the hoagies are good. The pizza wasn't that great ....
But on the positives, they are open beyond typical dinner hours and they are super quick with getting your order ready.
I will definitely be back when in the area, and who knows maybe I just caught the pizza on a bad day.
Though after a few days eating my way through NYC, 2 things are apparent:
1. These folks are way nicer than any of the shop keepers in NYC 
2. I just had some of the best pizza in the world so my comparison may be hard to live up to

Awful. I went here because my puppy was taken here prior to me getting him. I had to get emotional support paperwork completed. I called 3x and was placed on hold 6x. I just wanted to see if I could bring the paperwork in or fax it. Could not get through. Drove 35 min to bring the paperwork in, I waited 45 min and no one brought the paperwork out. I asked the girl I gave It to and she looked at me like I had 6 heads.. and said oh yeah I forgot let me check! Are you kidding me?! I am immediately changing vets. It's a shame because the Dr is very nice but the customer service is terrible and not recommended at all.

Great food. Awful service. I can appreciate an overworked server who's busting their butt however it wasn't that busy and the service we received was subpar. It took a while to order our bottle of wine and appetizers and then took much longer to receive both of them. Those of us who ordered salads didn't get them til after we'd been served our entrees and then reminded our server our salads hadn't come out. The server spent more time sharing music he's created than giving us quality service. I'm leaving 3 stars because the food was worth 5 stars whereas the service was 1. I will be eating here again but will order takeout.

I was really unimpressed with this place. I had the fish special which was some seared tuna on a bed of carrots and zucchini that had been shredded go resemble pasta. The tuna was very bland and the rest of the dish was just boring. The only thing I enjoyed of my meal were the chicken wings for the appetizer. As for the service, our waitress was friendly enough but when she brought our food out she reeked of smoke. Like she had taken her smoke break in a small closet with a dozen other smokers. It was overwhelming. If I were you I'd avoid this place.

I've been coming to this restaurant for years, when I'm in the area, and I've never had a bad meal. The food, for the most part is excellent. I especially enjoy the seafood risotto. I only wish that it wasn't so expensive to get a soda which seems to be charged as if one were sitting at the bar. But other than that, I enjoy the atmosphere, the extensive menu, and especially Andrea's service. She's wonderful and there's no extra entertainment charge to have her wait on you. :)

I'm getting hungry for a meal at MP just writing this review.

We ate her several times during the Feb Gem & Bead Shows.  I would say the food is fresh and good.  However, I would agree with the service is abit questionable.  We normally get free edamame beans.  We did not receive any so i asked for them.  Later we got our bill and they charged us for this.  We were told by the older lady that this is given only when they are busy.  Other tables received this so we really felt deceived.  I argued the point and they did not budge.  Really poor service when you think of it.

Another solid Japanese place. My favourite at one point was Mikado but I think for now I'm making the switch to Kobe.  I ordered a few things, nicely sized although I think my dinner was missing the sushi part I wasn't sure it was a pick up order so I didn't check before I left. That's the only reason I would give it a 4 star, only cause it does cost quite a bit. Otherwise the food was great. The sashimi pieces were fat hehe and big so it was worth it & tasted so good.  My favourite is the beef tataki. It was on point. There's lots of parking as well.

Comfortable atmosphere although the wall decor looks like a straight guy who normally does construction may have decorated it. None the less it was quiet and had a nice mood to it. The waiter steered me away from my initial choice which I appreciated any was okay with my 2nd choice. Everything was fresh and hot although upon asking for a second basket of bread it was not as fresh as the first but it is bread. The portions were good sized and the service was excellent.  Our server had a good sense of humor and we enjoyed him. There was a small issue at the end of dinner as we had a Groupon but we were able to come to a mutual understanding.

I've taken my animals here for years, I have taken a total of three animals here consistently. This morning my moms 16 year old cat who has dementia and keeps having seizures. After months of consistently losing weight and becoming more and more unlike himself, I decided to contact the hospital to schedule a euthanasia appointment. Since he is a "new patient," they refused to take him. Instead, they would prefer the animal continue to suffer and be in constant agony. I will not be taking any of my other animals to this vet ever again.

If you are looking forward to a great salad from what used to be a good salad bar, you might ought to pass. Lettuce and mayo filled sides is the best it has to offer. It is really a shame that the quality and consistency of this chain in Green Hills is not up to par to the "Simple and Fresh" image RT's promotes.  Waitstaff was helpful, but very disappointed.  

After talking with some friends in the area about my experience, they advised that it has been going downhill for several months. Wish I would have known prior!

Made an appt and dropped off my car for a tire rotation at 6pm. They told me they'll get it done by 7pm at the latest (when they close). I was waiting for their text but didn't hear back, so I ran over to sears at 7pm. They told me it wasn't done yet and they'd text me when it's done. I have no idea how this makes sense- they weren't even picking up phone calls and they locked the entrance door right after I came inside (when they realized they hadn't locked it). Did they expect me to pound on the door asking for my car...? A little dumbfounded. On a brighter note, my tires are rotated now.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Locale messicano molto molto carino. Si trova sulla 13th strada, una via piena di ristorante e locali, e questo non è da meno. 
Ci hanno fatti accomodare ad un tavolino sul marciapiede, un pò a ridosso delle macchine e degli altri tavoli, ma sinceramente non ce ne siamo neanche resi conto!
Cibo davvero buono e "pulito", molto diverso dal messicano (finto) che siamo abituati a trovare in Italia. 
La cameriera è stata davvero molto gentile e sorridente nonostante il ristorante fosse al gran completo e dovesse correre da una parte all'altra.
Consigliatissimo!

No need to set an appointment. Was told on the phone it should be roughly 45 minutes to patch a tire. Had an appointment for 1:00 and my vehicle did not even start start until 2:00. If you need somewhere quick look elsewhere. They do a good job but it's best if you can drop your vehicle off and not need it for the day. No mention of sorry you had an appointment and we were an hour behind. What I thought would be an hour appointment has now turned into two. Just had my tires replaced by them a month ago, luckily I was able to drop off my vehicle because it took all day to change four tires.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This location is terrible.   I know its just a "burger king" but its not even close to even competing with any other fast food burger place.  The whoppers are no longer whoppers, they should be called "whimpers".... home of the whimper.  The chicken nuggets were rock hard.  I called them, let ring about 30 times until it disconnected.   They are NOT  so busy that they cant answer.  Im done with this place. The only good item they have left is the double suasage egg n cheese croissant,  the have 2 for $5 at the moment. They are very tasty and a very good price ( for the doubles, the singles are "meh" plus the doubles are only $1 more)

This place is a disaster. After checking us into a room that oreads had someone in it, they gave us a new room and apparently added another night to our reservation without telling us.  After checking out the next day online, we were shocked to receive two days latter a new bill adding another night. We were not even there.  They had no customer service when we called.  Guess we will have to get a lawyer to solve this problem. 

Simple statement, lawyer up before you stay as you will probably need it.

After two days, they corrected the issue but still charged for an extra day of parking and Internet which was supposed to be comped.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The sushi here is legit. Always fresh and delicious. The takuyaki roll is to die for and the crawfish roll is also really good. I was not a fan of the Sonobana roll, the fake krab with mayo is not my favorite. But the real winner is the Big John #2. It's HUGE and a meal by itself (trust me, I can eat) it is basically 10pieces of fresh sashimi in the roll. It's quite amazing. I added a photo with a quarter next to it so you can have an idea. 

I gave it a 4 star because the place is outdated, service can be extremely slow.

It's undergoing some renovations especially on the outdoor areas, but there's little noise from them. They are building a giant building across the street so it's pretty noisy in the day but the construction stops around 7 which made sleeping no problem at all. 

It's a pain to get there as a ton of roads right around it are closed, if you don't use waze then good luck. Another problem is absolutely no parking and a crappy valet service that parks your car very far away. Other than those problems the rest of the hotel is super nice! Great pool area, good restaurant, great rooms, and a great view
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is usually one of my favorite restaurants but today totally disappointed and angered Me. The waitress got our orders wrong and was frustrated she had to change them. Then our food was cold and the taste had a funny taste of soap. Then instead of waiting for my guest to finish eating she took her plate and began to pile trash on it. Then a cook brought us the bill and literally stood over our table with her arms folded waiting for payment like we were going to skip out on the bill. Needless to say we won't be eating here anymore. I will not pay people to mistreat or disrespect Me.

Clay hooked it up. He's great with kids. If you're a hipster parent, or from the block, I'm sure you'd feel comfortable to come on in. Privileged folks, if you're looking for a good barber, just fu*kin suck it up and give these guys a shot, unless you're satisfied with going to your current wack a*s barber. Other barbers in the area couldn't cut it when giving my 4 y.o. son a nice fade. Crispy Clean Cuts will be my new barber for my son moving forward. 

I didn't have enough time to get my own cut, but I'll write another review when that happens.

Yum yum yum!! This is an amazing little Italian restaurant. We started with the meatballs and wild mushroom arancini. Both were amazing. The polenta that came with the meatballs was soft and creamy.
