The arancini had just enough truffle oil and was really nice. I had the pan seared gnocchi and it was definitely the most amazing gnocchi I've ever had!! It was soft and fluffy - like a cloud! The truffle jus and other vegetables with it gave it a nice flavor and I highly recommend this entree. Will definitely visit this restaurant again.

This morning I had a flat tire and went to Goodyear in Tarpon Springs Fl. AAA put air in it and followed me to make sure I arrived safely. Goodyear fixed it quickly and efficiently and for free! What had seemed to start my day miserably ended with a happy ending! Thanks, Jay at this location !!!  I'll be back and in the meantime will be a goodwill ambassador for you. And thanks to AAA too, because when you are a 73-year old woman, little things like this can seem overwhelming. It is good to know that some businesses still give good service.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: All I heard was great reviews about it. My friend referred me and I moved. It was great up until this month when they put eviction notice on my door saying I failed to pay rent. I never have failed to pay rent late in my life. I called for 3 days and left 8 voicemails for a call back. Not one person from office called me. I had to make 2 calls to the corporate office. Corporate was very helpful. Also, office kept charging me for electric with fees when I attached my teco bill and payments. Very unhappy with the treatment and looking now into filing a complaint. Horrible experience.

Wash Me Express has been inconsistent with quality of wash in 2021. The below pictures are from stains on the vehicle due to unclean water being used in the wash. Unfortunately, customer service advised that I would have to pay for a subsequent wash to remove. From my perspective the vehicle became more dirty on when it went in. The staff was nice and followed usual procedure. This has to do with the water only. My recommendation is to go to another wash until this water is clean. Customer serive may not correct their mistake to customers, like in my experience below.

I m sitting and typing this . Our server was not interested in serving us at all it seems . She didn't bring or offer any coloring paper for my 5 years old kids but  the other kids got offered or given that. 
She was quit ignorant to our demand for menu. She was not interested in explain his what all there menu has to offer . And she offcourse try to give us fake smile every time I was bit explainable to her . 
Food was excellently delicious. But the service  no star at all . I hope u guys read this and make it more friendly place for everyone .

My husband LOVES spicy Mexican food.....me, not at all!  So, we look for places to compromise and Ron loved this place.  I loved the salsa, which is made table-side by a lovely lady who asks how spicy you want your salsa.  For me "no spice" was the response and her preparation was perfect!!  The salsa was very fresh, nicely chunky and delightful!  She did the same with the guac I ordered, so that was delightful!

There was a mariachi quartet that  played lovely background music and went from table to table to take requests, which added to our enjoyment.

Ron's meal had just the right amount of heat for him and we really enjoyed the experience.

It is so oddly located that you will pull into the parking lot and wonder if this place is even open for business.  You will open the door expecting to see a depressingly empty restaurant.  Instead you will find a vibrant little sushi joint.  The place is never empty due to the loyal customer base who dine hear on a regular basis.  The prices are extremely reasonable, the food is always quality, and the service is fast.   They even have a kids menu with some quality options like whitefish nuggets and teriyaki chicken instead of Mac and cheese and the crap you usually see.

Stayed here July 2020 during CoVid 19. The dining room was closed for dine in but you could pick up. Nothing in town was open. The small "gift shop" had mostly empty shelves. I had reserved two rooms one of which the air conditioner didn't work. They said they sent someone to fix it but it wasn't cool in the room at all. We had to get another room. Both of our rooms looked like the beds were made by second graders. Also both of the rooms had broken bathroom cupboard doors. Both were actually broken off of their hinges. Needless to say I was very disappointed for a Westin. Very disappointed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: A really great coffee shop if you are staying at the hotel above. Far better than Starbucks across the street. Was I blown away by the food and drinks? No. But they were solid. I would recommend the quiche. It was far better than the oatmeal. They have it in a fridge then heat it up, but a big chunk of almond butter was in there and it wouldn't melt. It was so salty, I made a ~what is in my mouth is this flavor real~ face while trying a bite. Customer service was really great and they swapped me the oatmeal for the quiche. If not for the oatmeal, this would be 4 stars.

Was visiting Philadelphia to celebrate a friend's birthday. We waited over two hours for a table and when they sat us outside (when the weather was in the 30°s), we asked for a covered table because I had stage lV cancer, a transplant  and was suffering from neuropathy. That I physically couldn't sit there ...they just told me 'sorry it didn't work out for you'. Both the waiter and the host had the same response. Even though they could have accommodated us at a different table they were so pretentious that they didn't care at all, to put it lightly.

I used to come here because it is close to me but I was not satisfied with the work they do, it seems that they always want to charge you more and it bothers me that they speak to each other their language when they ask you something they seem to make fun of you. ok i just went and it will be my last time !! As much as I told her to leave my nails more rounded, she did what she wanted and left them VERY square, horrible apart, giants and the thick acrylic and is no longer used like that! I definitely DO NOT RECOMMEND this place other than it is already old inside, SO NO STARS FOR THIS

Worst dunkin donuts ever! Ordered a meal and the server repeated everything that comes with the meal questioning if that's what I wanted. I thought the point of the meals was to make ordering easier?! Once getting the food, the English muffin wasn't toasted, and neither was my friends bagel even though we asked for them both to be toasted. The hash browns were obviously microwaved - not crispy at all- hideously old tasting. The coffee coolatta was not well made- insanely sweet (I've had them before, this was extreme) The one thing they did well was the black coffee. Thanks for not a great morning.

I travel for work, and this is my first week in Tampa. Ordered last night due to the flyer under my hotel room door. My order was quoted at 45-55 minute delivery, and it took 90min. Not that big of a deal really, deliveries get busy. The pizza wasn't bad, but the wings were below average. The real kicker here is that after ordering over the phone with a card, this morning I wake up to a fraud alert telling me my debit card had an attempted $370 charge at a restaurant in Tampa. Coincidence? I think not. 

TLDR: pizza is okay, service is slow, and they have some shady people stealing card info.

We pulled up, tired and exhausted from a day of driving and just wanted an inexpensive, clean place to lay our head for the night.  We had a small dog; hence, a Motel 6 with no pet fee and close to Santa Barbara.  We got out and started to walk into the office to register when I looked and saw two of the creepiest men ever smoking & hanging out by the office sign that says no smoking within 20 feet of the building.  We were completely creeped out, we told the young woman in the office we were leaving and why.  She just said, "I understand".  

Ugh...found another hotel nearby, twice the price but worth it!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I was craving fish tacos and usually go to El Vez,but I figured I would try something new and Lolitas since it had good reviews.  Unfortunately, the fish tacos were Terrible!!  Though they had lots of toppings and what should have been a tasty crusting, the fish itself was unseasoned and bland.  I only made it through 2/3 tacos before I gave up because they were so tasteless.  For $14 (including tax) I was incredibly disappointed--if fish tacos is what you're looking for, skip Lolitas and head to El Vez instead.

First off: our server Mai was wonderful, attentive, and very sweet. I was just disappointed in a few things including the quality of the sushi, the rice seemed on the dry side and the fish on top of the sushi was sliced too thin. The ponzu sauce was nothing special but the spicy mayo was good. The worst was when I went to use the restroom and it smelled like a port-a-potty. There's a saying "you can tell a lot about a restaurant by how clean their bathrooms are." In addition to the restrooms, the menus obviously hadn't been wiped down because they were sticky and had dry sauces on them.

Order the spicy chicken taco, steak nachos, and rice and beans. The taco was perfect, although not spice. Otherwise, the flavors were really good and if I only had the taco, this place would get 5 stars. 

The rice was beyond dry and couldn't be helped by the beans. The rice almost tasted like it had been sitting out for a while. I only ate two bites.

The steak on the nachos was very chewy and overall the nachos were not flavorful. They were covered in beans and that seemed to dominate the flavor profile. I finished less than half before discarding.

So, yes, tacos from here are amazing but would not recommend much else

Dr. Baker and the staff at Damonte Ranch Animal Hospital are amazing. I have taken all four of my dogs to her. I treat my dogs like they are my children and would not trust anyone else with their care. Dr. Baker has always gone above and beyond what is expected from a veterinarian in my opinion. She is always professional, but yet treats you like a friend and your pet like it's one of hers. The facility is always clean, the staff has always been prompt, courteous and helpful. I constantly brag about and recommend Damonte Ranch Animal Hospital to all of my friends. Dr. Baker is the best.

Customer service is horrendous in this place. You walk in and the staff doesn't even greet you. I ordered food the other day and the staff was less than pleasant. They took my money and gave me my receipt, then the lady turned around and continued her conversation with rest of staff. Never gave me my food. When I asked for the food she pointed to the next counter and proceeded to tap to staff. So I went to other counter and got my own bag of food. They're just very rude. No wonder the place only ever has 1-2 customers at a time.

These guys are crooks.  They have shady, deceptive, duplicitous practices.  I used their mobile app to deposit a check.  The check was deposited incrementally, so $200 was made available initially, and the rest later.  However, the app showed that the entire check had been deposited into my account.  When I tried to make a purchase greater than $200 (which the app indicated I had), I was charged a $30.00 fee.  I called them and spoke with several people, including branch manager Erik Young.  They refused to credit my account.  Don't give these clowns your business.

Was excited to try this salon after reading the reviews. My roommate laughed when I came home and told her about Duke, the dog, the homemade cookies, the sample gifts but could not say if I liked my hair. I had to wait a few days and get used to it. The roots are darker than the ends of my hair. I had commented when the stylist only left the dye in for a few minutes on the ends but was reassured that was enough. I came to the conclusion the cut does not suit me, is not user friendly and not me.  I've given up in expensive fancy salons. It's back to the mall for my $40 cuts, no dogs, gifts, cookies :-(

I rented a car here to go to PCB. The tire blew out before we ever made it to PCB. We used the spare and made it to a Walmart to get the tire changed. I called customer service and was told to bring my receipt and they would make it right. Needless, to say.. I kept my receipt and still was not refunded my money for the tire. I placed a brand new tire on the rental because I had no choice.  I contact Hertz and the BBB still haven't received my money back. They asked for the rental number and receipts - I sent.... still no response. 
Do not rent from this company.

this is worse than the worst white person mall Chinese food I've ever had. the general tsos, ignoring it being frozen pre breaded crap, barely had any sauce, was soggy. it tasted like someone dropped it in a bowl of water after frying then put sauce on it and microwaved it. The bright red bourbon chicken was dry and flavorless, and the "sauce" was just a runny liquid in the bottom of the container, not mixed in at all. And lastly the pot stickers treated like and had the texture of styrofoam. this food is almost comically bad, like if you told an art director on a tv show to make bad looking Chinese food...

Firstly I want to say the meals my son and I had were good. Contrary to se reviews the noodles are freshly made the veal Marsala was very good and my son was pleased with the spaghetti and red meat sauce. The atmosphere was pleasant but commercial ( as would be expected a block from city hall). Now the wine list was minimal and did not show respect for good Italian wines. The list of entrees is small and, from my perspective, the chef showed limited imagination on what an Italian restaurant should present. My recommendation; good choice for lunch, and okay for dinner if you like a menu of familiar and traditional Italian meals.

DO NOT STAY HERE: BED BUGS + HOTEL FALLING APART + HEALTH HAZARDS

My family had to leave in the middle of the night because of a BED BUG infestation. Only 1 restaurant in the hotel where the waitress said we shouldn't order multiple dishes..I felt like I was in an episode of kitchen nightmares..Only 1 elevator was in service. The doors to the hotel rooms barely lock, and our toilet was broken from our check-in (luckily we were only there for a few hours). THIS PLACE SHOULD BE CLOSED.

**The bartender was nice though lol**
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm very selective about when I want tea, so I haven't had it here yet. What I have had are the delicious smoothies. I usually get the mango/green tea combo and its awesome. The only reason I give four stars instead of five is lack of consistency. Depending on who's working, when I come for my yummy smoothie, sometimes I'll get the delicious mix I'm expecting, and other times I'll get something else that is kind of similar but not what I'm looking for at all. I'm really not sure how I can be more specific with them to get exactly what I want every time, but time will tell. Other than that service is great and eats are fantastic!

Employees were extremely unprofessional, screaming and laughing with each other and absolutely not paying attention to any of the customers. When I finally got through the drive-through I had ordered just a basic double mushroom and Swiss burger and they completely screwed it up. The burger I got was chicken with cheese that was not even melted, maybe three mushrooms, and inexplicably some curly fries. It's not even that they messed up my specific order it's the fact that that's not even what the menu item is, or even remotely close.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If the customer service and phone manner was more on point I would have given a 5 star.  The food is always really good.  I have been ordering here for 7 years now and never order from anywhere else.  The margheritta pizza is awesome and so are the fried raviolis. I have had everything from salad to ziti to eggplant parm to pizza, fries, italian sub, paninis, cheesesteak and fries and never disappointed.  The only thing I would hope for is better customer service on the phone.  They are pretty short and unpersonable but other than that the food is great.

Saw the sign for Blue Parrot a few times and finally decided to go in. Upon, walking in we finally noticed the Madi Gra theme and was immediately excited coming off our trip to New Orleans. After being greeted, we sat down and order Jambalaya and shrimp creole. Had to send the food back because rice was mushy and shrimp was over cooked and the sauce was disgusting. Asked to speak to the manager and he came over and his customer services skills sucked. He snatched the plate from the table without saying a word and never came back to the table. We left immediately after. Will never go again!

Saw the sign for Blue Parrot a few times and finally decided to go in. Upon, walking in we finally noticed the Madi Gra theme and was immediately excited coming off our trip to New Orleans. After being greeted, we sat down and order Jambalaya and shrimp creole. Had to send the food back because rice was mushy and shrimp was over cooked and the sauce was disgusting. Asked to speak to the manager and he came over and his customer services skills sucked. He snatched the plate from the table without saying a word and never came back to the table. We left immediately after. Will never go again!

$25 for parking. That's all you need to know. It's a nice hotel, in a great part of town, and great value for my Starwood Points...but $25 for parking! This isn't NYC, it's Indianapolis. 

I've stayed at dozens of Sheraton's over the years, and parking is usually cheaper for those staying at the hotel, especially when I'm a Gold Starwood Member. I get it, I'm a spoiled hotel traveler who doesn't want to pay for parking. But seriously, if you're considering staying here budget for the ridiculous the $25/daily parking rate.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The staff are professional and friendly... but the gym can be frustrating ... when you go to use equipment and only a couple of dumbbells on the racks but the guys/girls next to you have 3 sets sitting on the floor next to them...and not even using them .... or the rude folks that don't wipe down their equipment after using gross... one more thing in my rant put your equipment back when your done with it .... learn gym etiquette ... wth
No jeans! No string tanks!  ....
So since the last time this equipment has been broken /out of service for over a month... the ARC machine not pictured has been broken for months...
Why isn't it being fixed?
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Priceline rates this place 3 stars  ?   Maybe if you hit your head against the wall enough, you might see more stars.  It's a solid 1 1/2 stars.  Not a chance at 2 let alone 3 ?  Staff are fine at check in.  Rooms are acceptable, flat screen newer tv..beds creaking and old. Fixtures look like someone tried restoring them.  Outside windows dirty. Bathrooms clean but dated.  Ice machine works on 3rd floor.  I did not try breakfast.  It's a fine hotel for night or two, everything works.  Just not a 3 star hotel as Priceline states. No house keeping I guess for stayovers  ??
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Service was not good. Employees were rude, and not helpful. My husband ordered a Wake Up Wrap and didn't realize there were options for the contents and was met with total annoyance when I asked what the options were. The lady who took our hot food order, then wouldn't take the rest of our order and said the lady next to us would ring us out. She didn't even have the hot food on there, so we had to order again...It was just total chaos and not even that busy!! Hot food was fine, no better than your average fast food place. Chocolate long john donuts were good!

This has got to be the worst McDonald's in all of the Indy metro area. I live right down the street from this location; they have the most inefficient drive-thru. Don't go to this McDonald's and think you'll skate through the drive-thru if there is no line; if there's more than one car in line, it's a disaster. I'm seriously talking about 15-35 minutes for 2 cars. This is not the exception, this is the norm! Several times, I have been waiting in the drive-through and telephoned the restaurant to make sure they were open (being facetious, of course). Go to the other 2 McDonald's in town if you can.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
As tourists in town for a youth lacrosse travel tournament during the novel COVID-19 pandemic, we had no expectations. This Hilton has beautiful lobby decor, practical and well-landscaped surrounding outdoor area for lounging and hanging out. 
Unfortunately, the pool was closed so I used the room jacuzzi as a replacement. No trash bin in our first room. No real breakfast in the lobby. Front receptionists are extremely welcoming, professional and entertaining. Hotel located in close proximity to restaurants and coffee shops.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I used to to like this place, but I think there is a new manager. This last time I went I got my truck back and the center cap of my rim was missing. I asked if they forgot to put it back on. They tried to tell me it wasn't there when I brought it in. I've had my truck for 8 years now. The center caps are impossible to fall off on their own. I assume they broke it trying to get it off (that's how hard it is to get them off).
 So instead of owning up to it they just lost my future service and they get a bad review. I wasn't even trying to get them to replace it. People make mistakes,..I just wanted honesty.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We went with another couple to ZPan for the first time tonight.  The service was fine and the food was delicious. When the check arrived, each couple presented a Local Flavor coupon. The manager would only allow one couple to use the coupon. No where on the coupon does it state one per table. Also,  the manager wouldn't accept the coupon on the phone, even though the coupon code was visible. She said the coupon had to be printed and turned in with the check. There are so many restaurant choices; no reason to go somewhere and be aggravated!

I stayed here because of a conference rate but I regretted it. It was nice to be right at the meetings but the hotel's beds are super firm and the mattress pad doesn't provide comfort. It really feels more like a holiday inn instead of the nice hotel bed feel that you would find in a Hilton or W or the like. 

Also, if you have a fear of heights you need a room on the 6th or 7th floor (lowest for rooms) because this is an open air atrium style of architecture. I couldn't even walk to my initially assigned room. It was like walking on the edge of a tower.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My girlfriend and I went to Tubby Robot this evening for the first time... honestly we weren't impressed! They refused to give a sample on an ice cream before I spent $5 on a single scoop cone and $8 on a fudge sundae! They are ridiculously overpriced! You would think with the prices they could afford a small simple taste for new customers! The ice cream was okay, but definitely not worth the price. The gentleman who was making the ice cream orders just seemed absolutely miserable! We will not be returning... the ice cream wasn't worth the price or the negative vibe!

There weren't a lot of customers in the dining room, but there was just one overwhelmed server. Our drinks came quickly and order was taken promptly. After that things slowed down. Our bruschetta appetizer took quite a while on its own. Then our two pizzas took at least 15 minutes after we had finished the bruschetta. 

The waitress "explained" that they had a lot of take-out orders. That didn't explain why our pizzas were no longer even hot. 

The bruschetta was actually very tasty. The pizza crusts were good but otherwise the pizza tasted bland and ordinary. 

With so many options for pizza in the area, this one is not worth another visit.

This happens to by favorite spot to work out at. I could use my apt gym, but Planet Fitness has everything I need. There is enough equipment, no one is staring at you, and the place is clean. Honestly, there is no judgement. I was having difficulty with a piece of equipment, and a nice woman adjusted it for me and went on her way. The price is right, you can take a partner with you for free. The hours are good from open to close. The interior is impeccable. I highly recommend it. I'm just a person who goes as a partner so I'm not sure about the other membership rewards, but I'm sure they are excellent.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I come to this location at least once a week and spend quite a bit of money at Papa John's. Today I received a pizza that was subpar to the quality I typically get. When I asked them to remake the pizza the manager told me that he would not because he made it himself and it was up to his standards. Wow! So I asked if he was willing to lose a customer that orders at least once a week over this incident...he replied "yes" and walked off. I wonder if corporate condones this type of treatment of regular customers!

Food is a 4, margaritas are a 3.  Gave them a 4 because overall it is a cool place.  Margaritas lack pizazz in my humble opinion.  They lacked a richness, seemed a bit light, and almost 3-D printed.  Also, the salt was like morton's from a salt shaker, and should be more coarse. Better than your average Joe, but you can definitely do much better at home with a little effort re the drinks.  I like this place and would definitely come back, but the Rita's were lacking. Service at the bar was very good, polite and attentive.  My advice to the owner - blood orange habanero and get real salt.  Nice spot in Philly.

Absolute worst banking experience of my life and poor management decisions that caused that today. After driving over an hour to cash a corporate BOA check from my insurance company the teller could not figure out why it wouldn't process. They then told me a red flag popped up and they can't cash their own check. I had my license and passport then also had the owner of the company on the phone to resolve the issue and the would not help. I have to take of work now and make another 2 hour drive tomorrow in hopes the will cash it this time....pathetic management!

Rented a car from Dollar. It was a Ford that had the iKey activated. iKey is a parental control capability that puts a hard limit on how fast the car can drive. Driving from Nashville to FT. Washington one must drive with the flow of traffic. The iKey prevented this and I almost ended up in an accident. This is a policing policy that Dollar has no right to exercise.  The assume they know all the traffic conditions that a driver will face and from that dictate how their customer should drive. I own a company and based on my experience I will no longer rent from Dollar and I share my experience with my entire network.

The good first...very clean rooms, super friendly staff, nice lobby, and an indoor pool.  The bottom of the pool had some debris and need to be cleaned, but the water was warm and clean.  The breakfast was just okay. Not much expected for free.  The biscuits were hard and the milk tasted funny.  The rest was okay.  There is an IHOP about a block down the street and I think a TGI Friday's.  If you need to shop, there is a Target, Home Depot, and some other small shops.  Applebee's and Cracker Barrel are just across the interstate.  Good location.  About 20 minutes from Philly and 20 minutes from McGuire AFB.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I took my car in for a stuck window and oil change and was informed that my car, a mini, would need transmission service they couldn't perform.  I was also told that the window would require a part that, with my transmission needing work, I decided against.  It all sounds terrible but they, specifically Eric and the manager, were so wonderful.  They explained everything that they felt would need to be done at a mini specific location and didn't charge me for putting up my window so at least it wasn't open.  Everyone hates car trouble but they really helped make a bad situation manageable.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I was trying to place my order over the phone and the lady Brooke answered the phone. I told her that I would like to place an order for pick up. She asked me what would I like to order. I get the same thing every time and I told her that I wanted the Louisiana rolls and she told me that they do not sell it there. So I said okay thank you. So I went online and looked up the menu and she to told me that they didn't have it. So I came in the store and I ask can I have the Louisiana rolls and she said they don't sell it once again so I showed it to her on the menu and she said oh. She doesn't know the menu and had a very nasty attitude

Food was good, and service was attentive. But a bit of a put off was a purchase transaction.  They had a special deal for a future meal which I took.  When the purchase was rung through, they included an 18% surcharge/tip, automatically (no mention of this in the sales pitch).  And the use of the credit card machine also asked for a tip amount in funds or a percentage.  I thought tips were related to service provided, when provided.  Bizarre, and took the edge off the dining experience enjoyment.  This tip business is out of control.  So is an interest in clear information of what is the cost of the purchase decision.

Like many said, above average prices, middling average food, and horrific service defines this establishment.

Beer selection was decent, food selection is typical "bar" food with a so-so Philly cheese steak (Mine tasted more steak then cheese), prices are on the high side ($12-$15), but service was just downright slow and bad.  They honestly don't care, there were 15-20 minute instances where we never saw our server (not only did she not stop by, we actually never saw her).

All in all, a decent way to kill a few hours at the airport but do your culinary taste buds and wallet a favor, come here as a last resort.

Was slightly disappointed.  They advertised a froyo pie which was an intriguing idea.  The pie itself was good, but the experience getting it was rather difficult.  In their ad, no where does it say that it takes days to make.  And then we did put in the order, they were supposed to call and tell us it was ready, (since it was anywhere between a 24 hour-48 hour wait).  They never called.  When we were there they said they had to wrong number, but when we looked at the receipt it had the right cell number on it.  The pie was good, but not worth the wait and service.

If you truly enjoy sushi and hibachi, this is not the restaurant for you. The portions were ridiculously small. I know it was all you can eat, but I felt I had to order 3 things at a time in order to have enough to eat without having to wait for someone to take my order. The only thing I enjoyed was the one scoop of green tea ice cream I got at the end. 

This restaurant is in the university area. If you really want inexpensive Asian cuisine go ANYWHERE ELSE! There are so many better options in Tampa some of which are extremely authentic, delicious, and cheap!

This was my first time staying at a Marriott Delta. Wow, everything about the hotel is done right. From check-in to check out the employees are helpful, and kind. They greet you as you enter and exit. The building is kept well both inside and out. Decor is rather beautiful in the lobby and dining area. There is a Starbucks on the property for those who don't want to make their own. Great place for a conference or overnight stay! 

The rooms are clean and cozy. I love that they give you extra toiletries. Zero complaints during my stay here. For sure one of the best properties I've stayed at.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I'm diving in and letting my natural silver grow out. Since I have been dying my hair since I was a teenager, I have no idea what 'natural' is. I looked for someone with a proven history of color expertise and style and I AM SO PLEASED to have Shannon taking control of this process. I did not want to just let my hair grow out on its own because I work with the public and I did not want the unkempt look of brunette/silver roots on red hair to distract.

She's making every step of the process look GOOD and I have full trust in Shannon.

The place was oddly sticky, I mean, literally; the floors and tables. Not sure if this an after effect of too much celebration but it was a bit unsettling. Nonetheless the place seemed clean.
The appetitizers: guac - very good, salsa - decent, ceviche verde - excellent, huarache special - excellent.
Main: fish taco - ok (batter needs more seasoning), black bass - good, Korean taco - ok (bit bland), plaintain - very good, cauliflowers - very good.
Drinks - Santana and Mango - very good, strong
I would recommend appetizers and drinks more than the meals. Appetizers had flavor, meals were pretty bland.

Homestyle Italian fare at slightly upscale dining price. Rustic and cozy vibes. 

Super yummy classic dishes like spaghetti and meatballs, shrimp scampi, and arancini; recommend these. Also got the rigatoni alla vodka, Sunday gravy, garlic bread with roasted whole garlic, and Caesar salad which were all okay. The watermelon granita is not recommended; fake syrupy flavor and creamy sorbet texture. Must get the cheesecake for dessert, so fluffy and perfectly flavored. 

7/10 would recommend.

Pros: intimate setting, date night
Cons: pricey, not good for large groups

As a family, we recently stayed at this hotel.  The front desk staff was friendly and attentive.  We actually liked it so much that we opted to stay an additional night. The room was pleasant and comfortable.  I agree with another yelp post in that a shuttle to Busch Gardens would have been a nice feature, especially when the park is so close.  Another feature that would have been helpful is some type of listing for nearby restaurants and/or delivery. Ultimately, we had a very enjoyable stay and the Bistro downstairs was nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Here is what you get with Pinelands: they will work with you financially. you will get continuity of care from the same vet.  Other facilities may have a vast staff who will read about your pet.  Pinelands remembers your pet ... and you.  And they can offer the kind of flexibility that comes from being small. 

Here is what you dont get: a brand new veterinary facility with a cleaning solution fragrance.  the cost of the brand new facility tacked onto your bill.
Specialists and specialists equipment... for that, you have the large hospitals that can take you in as a referral or emergency.

BEWARE HIDDEN FEES!
I would give this a zero star review, if I could!! 
I use the RentalCars app, to shop and reserve vehicles, when I travel. Never have I had an issue. 
I reserved a vehicle for $400, up front, with $218. due at the end of the week's rental. I declined all coverage and premium services when picking up the vehicle. 
The vehicle was returned by a second driver (I had an early flight) and my card was charged $618. When I complained about this I was told, repeatedly, there was nothing that could be done. 
This is a thieving company- you have many options! DO NOT RENT from Dollar or it's subsidiaries.

There was three people working, and I was the only customer there. It says honk for service sometimes can't hear bell, so I honked once after ten minutes, it took another customer showing up, honking twice, for someone to pop there head out and another employee to come out. It took 30 minutes for someone to take our order. The employee didn't apologize for the wait and was very rude to my partner. I will not be eating here again. This place has gone so downhill in the last year definitely needs new management.

The owner, Doc, is a blathering drunken fool. 
I've been to this bar one time, last night, and he was out of his mind drunk yelling at the patrons and behaving like an ass. I genuinely felt bad for his one employee, the poor woman serving a packed barroom of polite patrons, as she had the sorry task of maintaining a professional front while Doc stumbled around behind the bar getting in her way, boisterously hollering "jokes" in the general direction of anyone that made the mistake of making eye contact with Doc. 

I recommend people steer VERY clear of this bar, although it will be a fun gambling pool to see how much longer this idiot can keep

Used to be my favorite liquor store to find craft beer. Went in on Tuesday to ask about a beer release and was told it would be in on Thursday. Came in today and was told that they had it in stock, but it was put aside by the stores "beer guy" and if I knew him well enough, that is the only way I could get some. And, that he wasn't there and they couldn't tell me when he would be back. I have spent at least $1,000 at this store in the last year, and find this type of service appalling. I will not shop here again. Good job, folks. Hope the "beer guy" has enough customers to keep you afloat.

Just dropped $22 on an exterior wash - "The Works" plus RainX treatment. The passenger side of the car looks great. The driver's side of the car looks like it wasn't even washed; water droplets and residue all over from the windooooooows to the wheels (to the wheels). When I pointed this out to the guy wiping off the driver's side he stared at me and proceeded to wipe the window for about a half second with a bone dry towel, which of course did absolutely nothing. Then he looks back at me, shrugs, and walks away. Effectively I paid $22 for half of my car to be washed. Won't be coming back.

Last night, I booked a room at Club Quarters via hotels.com. Unfortunately, on hotels.com's end, the reservation did not go through. It was after midnight and we were tired. The front desk attendant, Aja, was very kind. She allowed us to sit in the lobby for over an hour while I worked out the problem with hotels.com, even though her hotel was sold out and she knew we wouldn't stay the evening. She gave us advice on places to stay and even allowed us access to use the restroom on another floor. Her customer service was above and beyond. It was very much appreciated. I hope to visit again soon.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
trendy, affordable, and very friendly service... this is the kind of place that Indianapolis needs more of... the decor and ambiance was very nice, gave it a big-city feel, the food was tasty and presented beautifully...  a good date place.. still have yet to try the martinis there, but will be back to write about it after I try this place out for the third time at a birthday dinner i just booked there...
so far, i definitely recommend it-- everyone has their own view of what's tasty and what's not, so try this out at least once!

Decor needs to be updated. Duck tape was holding the cover on my seat. There was gaming machines & a pool table which was nice. 

We ordered the fried craw fish as an appetizer, which were very good. My meal was the french dip sandwich which came with no sides. It didn't have any taste. I had to put ketchup on it. I only ate 1/3rd of it. My boyfriend ordered the tbone, which was cooked very good. It came with two baked potatoes (don't know why) so I ate one as my side. Sodas are $2.50 a piece with no free refillsHowever, iced tea had free refils.

Overall, the only reason I would go back is because it's 2 mins from my house & they have a bar.

Last June I went in for a trim because my bangs were at an uncomfortable length where I couldn't see anymore. I've gone to different locations, but just moved to the area and decided I'd go in. The lady was very social and extremely sweet, but absolutely BUTCHERED MY HAIR. I left the store in tears and had to go back the next day to get all of my hair chopped off in order to have an even cut(looked uneven because of the way i styled my hair). I haven't gone back since then and don't plan on going back either.

I love McDonald's! But tonight I didn't have a great experience. Now i work in a fast food place and honestly this lady doesn't know how to treat a paying customer. Her name was McKenzie. When I pulled up to the window she said the price and barley looked at me. She took my card then gave it back and shut the window without saying anything. I had no idea what I was supposed to do. She I looked in front of me and saw the other person looking out the window I knew that's where I was supposed to be. She didn't smile or say 2 words to me. The lady at the other window was a sweetheart and I didn't catch her name. I wish I did.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Done. I'm filing a complaint with the insurance company. I've had a number of issues over the years but always have them another chance since it's just an annual visit. They gave me the wrong contact lenses, insisted I come back into the office for a second appointment, and refuse to provide me prescription information to get frames in any other way except snail mail or by me coming to the office - despite a voicemail they left for me that says they can fax the information. They're methods are outdated and their customer service is poor. I was hung up on TWICE when I asked why they gave me conflicting information. Stay away.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
A bastion of sanity on Saturday afternoon Bourbon street. We came here to find our boys who had run off to watch the football while we were pottering  --  and we found them tucked in a quiet garden eating much-better-than-average steak po' boys and drinking craft beer. Whaat? But this is Bourbon street, it's supposed to be horrid. 

Our be-bearded server was charming and unpushy, the Gin & Tonic's were delicious and the peaceful respite from the Bourbon Street Vomit smell was quite remarkable!

I'm sure it gets much busier later on but for a mid afternoon drink and a snack - this place is definitely worth keeping an eye out for

The one star is for the front desk staff, the guy who dealt with us was great. 
THESE PICTURES ARE NOT ACCURATE!!! ACCURATE ONES ATTACHED. 
1. The outside is awful. Didn't take any pictures but it is very old, needs to be cleaned. 
2. The carpet inside was disgusting. 
3. The beds are very old, the foot of the bed was higher than the head. 
4. HAIRS on the sheets. 
5. A BUG ON THE BED!!!! 
6. The pool area and windows are so moldy and disgusting. 
Like I said, staff was great. This hotel is in desperate need of renovation and a deep cleaning!! Don't stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
My grandmom and I came here lunch, never having been before. The sushi was very good. California roll was fresh, Ginger was white, not dyed pink, miso soup was great, not too salty, and the green tea ice cream was dark green and flavorful. 
Darkish atmophere, but comfortable. Staff was very friendly, and food was served fast. 
Great sushi considering the location! I highly recommend. Prices were not bad either. Sushi/sashimi combo for $10. 5 pieces of sushi, 6 pieces of California roll, and 6 pieces of sashimi. Plus miso soup.
My rating:   :D

Not gonna lie but after drinking a ​couple of green grenades, this bowl of fries with delicious flavors rescued my​ day. I got the Southern Parm. A good size of a ​bowl with cripsy fries dressed in herb/garlic flavored butter and parm cheese with green chives on it. ​The first couple bites, it was really savory and flavorful but then when I​ got to the bottom, it got really greasy which was okay but I stopped eating it before then and gave the rest to a friend. 

Good price for what it is and they have other good toppings as well, hopefully,​ they can allow customers to ​switch​ toppings on their​ order next time. That would be fun for sure.

This is an unassuming little beer shack right on the river. You can pull up in your car or boat. The beer is cheap, cold, and the bartender gets it to you quickly. Weather permitting, I suggest sitting outside on the river while enjoying a beer with your significant other, family, or friend.

They have live music some nights or a jukebox should their be no live entertainment. They have a couple of televisions playing local sports if a game's happening. Finally, there's a place next door with some decent food to munch on with your beer.

The front desk girl is so rude and disorganized , the whole staff is . The first time I went in was to get my dogs vaccinations and they had my dog for 6 hours ... for him to get two shots? They'll give you time frames and then always have an excuse when they're an hour to two hours late because they had to make another dog a priority. I thought we had to make an appointment so that MY dog can be prioritized in that time span. I've been waiting for a call back from 6 days about my dogs ears and nothing . This place was so overpriced for the mediocre service they provide .

"Out of the Box" ... Outstanding service without feeling like being on the "big-box-store" conveyor belt! Dr David Shurtz really helped me understand problems with my eyes, answered all kinds of questions, was kind & patient.  The latest equipment, personalized professional service, lots of staff to help, and all this for the same price as 'wholesale' places!  Whether you get your glasses here or not, have your eyes examination done here. That said, the whole staff was friendly and helpful, and there were some decent prices on glasses that I took advantage of too.  5 stars for sure!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I'm usually a very forgiving and understanding person but service in here is super slow and this is our third time going here to give it a 3rd chance bc our first time going here, service was still slow,already a bad impression in the first place, they dont have enough ppl to serve customers and the worst thing is that they already gave off such a bad attitude and bad look to my family and our friend who's first time here! We dont even know who are server is, we felt very shamed unwelcomed and im a 2 yr server

If you like small portions and bland Mexican food then this is the place for you. The tacos were on a cold flour tortilla with very little steak salsa might as well have been tomato sauce way too mild for even my wife   The other thing that really bothered me is the soda came in a can oh and it was warm sure they give you a cup of ice but when was the last time you ate at a place without a fountain dispenser I guess refills are out of the question. I haven eaten fast food in over three years and still would go to Taco Bell before I went back here.

We stay here every time we come for Firefighting school. I have NEVER had a bad experience. The rooms are always super clean. The front desk personnel are very friendly and treat you like they WANT your business. The little cafe makes sammiches and stuff for lunch and breakfast. The prices are a little high for that but they are fairly decent, and they are quick and convenient when you in a hurry. You can walk/crawl/be carried from bourbon street in a pretty short walk. The biggest issue for me is parking. It's tough getting a full size truck in and out of their check in spot.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This is a nice store - could be nicer.  Doesn't really live up to it's potential.  Prices are a little high - come here for the convenience.  They do have a hot food bar that is decent.  Prepare foods to take home ....

The employees here could use some customer service training.  If you're lucky enough to make eye contact with the cashiers - feel even luckier if they greet you (after being greeted) or exchange pleasantries.  I stay close by, come here often.  Have yet to have  a warm exchange with a cashier here.

Dining in the middle of COVID pandemic is a nice break. The servers and staff all wore face masks. They accommodated outdoor dining on the side of Chabba Thai's side walk and even brought water for our 4 months old puppy. 

My daughter was craving sushi though their sushi menu was pretty slim and the rolls were made skinny. My husband and I enjoyed the $12 appetizer with 2 yellow chicken curry satays, 2 veg spring rolls, 2 fried dumplings, and tofu with dipping sauce. The pineapple/tumeric fried rice was to die for especially presentation.

It was BYOB. I like to support local businesses especially during hard times. I definitely would return.

I love pizza and have been disappointed so many times.. This place is absolutely outstanding!! If you ever get bad service in this place it's because it's packed and he needs a bigger place! Lol! The owner ALWAYS makes EXCELLENT FOOD! He can be quite entertaining as well. I am NEVER disappointed!! If you complain about waiting don't waste your time writing a review! The finished product you receive is WORTH THE WAIT!!!  We will be eating at this place as long as it stands. No matter where he goes, we will follow!!

Curiosity brought me in almost a decade ago and good food and cheap prices have been bringing me back ever since.  It's great for the price.  It's definitely what you'd expect from a greasy spoon Chinese restaurant.  Their food has consistently been good and hot.  I've never dined in, but the take out has never failed me.

Though I like this place it does have some detractors:
- Food can be a big greasy at times.
- Not enough vegetables in their General Tso's and other similar dishes.

If you're in the mood for cheap Chinese, then definitely check this place out.

I am a black card member now for 2 years and have been to numerous planet fitness locations. This specific location is closest to my house however, when I come to the gym, finish my workout, I have to wait more than 20 minutes to wait for an employee to either 1. get off their phone 2. hang up on a PERSONAL call 3. listening to music and ignoring members!! I am extremely disappointed and making me reconsidering renewing my membership based on this behavior. Absolutely unacceptable. Whoever the manager is, you need to reconsider some employees and their behavior....just saying.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: It was my birthday and we stopped here because there was a dueling piano bar. I love dueling piano bars.  It was all good until the piano players said they did not have any requests.  I requested a song with some money.  That is when it went sour.  We had paid for 2 rounds of drinks and waited for my song.  THEN the piano players said they needed MORE money to play my song.  SO more people put in money for my song,   But still not enough money!  Greedy piano players shame on you.  We left before my song was ever played. We were there 2 hours and no song.  NOT OK!!!!

Might not have eaten here if I saw the women's restroom before we ate. The bartenders were not the most attentive (mostly the reason we sit at the bar). They do have happy hour at the bar from 3pm - close and the feta dip was delish. I got the ratatouille, which came with polenta and was good. Hubby got a chicken with pomodoro "sauce" (chopped tomatoes and olive oil - a lot) and was nothing special. These bathrooms are disgusting. Seat covers were all soaked with water. No purse hook. Crooked toilet seat. Paper on the floor. And it was 6:20pm, not the end of the night.

A nice hotel with a great location convenient for road trips, close to the freeway, yet quite. The property has a modern feel, everything seems to be new. The rooms were spacey and comfortable, with a separate living area, work station, and a minibar station equipped with a refrigerator, microwave and coffee maker. The only negative experience was at the lobby coffeeshop when we were charged more than $5 for a Pellegrino water! Even the employee seemed to realize it was a ripoff; she apologized as she was announcing the price, as if she was saying "Yeah I know!".
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: So i call to order off of the menu (that someone who works for them put in my screen door)something quick for my son. I'm inquiring about if they take me amex card and bam the girl who answered told me i wasn't in the area that they serve. I'm confused about my having the menu from their store stuck on my door but they are saying that i obvi shouldn't have one due to my not being in  "their coverage area" I honestly think they just don't want to come to my neighborhood and that's discriminatory and lame as hell. But I'll spend my money elsewhere happily.

Do not order delivery from this place. They partner with DoorDash for delivery orders and take no responsibility for the quality of the delivery. I live 5 blocks from the downtown location and ordered a small pizza. It was finally delivered 1 hour and 10 minutes AFTER it was picked up by the driver, almost 2 hours after I ordered it- cold and soggy. When I asked what happen the driver gave me two different excuses, neither which made sense. Will NEVER order from DoorDash again and won't be patronizing Pi again anytime soon. Extremely disappointed.

Sooter's Auto Service is the best auto shop I've experienced in awhile. I have had a great experience with this company and I highly recommend them. Great and honest customer service. We were in a pinch to get one of our company vehicles fixed, and the customer service experience that we received was prompt and truthful. They answered all of our inquires and provided fast turn around. Kim seriously is a wonderful owner of this shop and seriously possess a wonderful customer service foundation. I will certainly be taking all of my company fleet vehicles back here for service moving forward. We are definitely coming back
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We have had the most bazaar experience in this hotel. We are on the first floor and Squirrels ran in the ceilings all night both nights  if you come to St Louis do not use this hotel. Staff is very friendly and we have had a good time but this place is filthy.  Furniture is filthy. We had to have couch switched out. Room was nice and beds were clean. Just shocked since Embassy Suites is usually the nicer place to stay. Just DONT STAY HERE. they have offered us no compensation  for the animals nor the torn filthy couch. Yikes!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Run run run. The cockroaches are sharing your room and vacation with you. Yes we were told we do not clean your room unless you request it before 10:00 am. 
The place was filthy. 
The staff said we don't clean due to Covid. What? What? No staff on hand to do the cleaning. Huh?
Run away fast don't check in. The roaches never check out.
Check out the pictures posted by the other guests that stayed in this dump. 
Made every effort to contact upper management regarding this property with my comments and observations. There is no reliable email address to complain to. Next stop 
Health department.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We put in our order for 3 large pizzas and 2 salads at 5:30pm for 6:45pm pick up. Pizza had very few toppings on our supreme and only about half of the pepperoni you'd normally get anywhere else. Very little sauce on pizza, under cooked and was cold when we got back to our condo. A 3 minute drive. Sad! Prices were a bit overpriced for the quality we received. Service was fine, but could have been better. We will continue to go a better pizza joint located in John's Pass. Hopefully they can step up and improve there product and service in the future.

Whenever the grandkids want McDonald's this is the one we go to. The restaurant looks a lot better since the renovations, but the service remains the same. The other night I stopped there after work and ordered three different meals. I get home and some items are missing. This wasn't the first time either. A few times before I had paid for items that were not in my order. Because there were so many missing things I went back to retrieve the rest of my order. They were nice about it but it was the inconvenience that bothered me. Plus eating cold food wasn't my idea of a good experience.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I arrive at 6:30am, as I pull up to the drive thru window a dunking donuts employees has his hand inside his boxers. I can be completely sure because his pants were around his knees. I skip the speaker box and go straight to the window and explain to the dunking donuts employee what i just saw, he apologized and said the the employee currently preparing the food does not have his hands in his pants at the moment. I'm never going back, and am spreading the knowledge not pubes like these dunkin donuts employees.

We stayed here for a week. Walking in to the hotel I  was greeted by a bizzare odor of stinky raw fish. I was not discouraged I pressed on thinking it could be the bars failed attempt at a fish special . Staff was polite and helpful at the front desk. The hallways were covered in trash and believe it or not dog poo was found by the elevators for a few of the days. Small bugs , maybe cockroaches,  were a frequent visitor in the bathroom.  Parking was 35 a night insane prices especially when you pay 200 a night for a room worth less than half. Location is key however and you are walking distance to the vast majority of attractions
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I really loved the location and ambiance of this hotel-it was right in the midst of the French Quarter, everything was incredibly easy to get to, and the place was adorable. However, the staff response was lacking-we had to call down multiple times asking for resolutions to various room issues, towels and k cups were never replaced, the bed was made with torn sheets, etc. Also, minor warning, there are no fridges in the rooms, at least not the basic ones we had. It wasn't a bad stay, just not a great one, and I'll probably try somewhere else next time I'm in New Orleans.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Wish I could leave a 0 star. I just went in with my mother, and the lady who greeted us was one of the rudest people I've ever met. We are people who understand and follow guidelines, however I am confused on their "one person policy". When I asked "even if we live together" (because I was honestly shocked) the woman rudely replied "uhm YES". So just because I am over 18 my mother can't come help pick out the glasses she's paying for? I also don't understand how making an appointment would change the "safety". Never going back.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I hate that this is my local McDonald's. I know of two managers at this location, One woman and one gentleman. The lady manager really is in the wrong career. The worst customer service possible, she is perpetually pissed off and it shows to the customers. She should choose some business that keeps her as far away from customers as possible. I know I'll always have a disappointing experience when I see her behind the counter. She never smiles and always yells, is not helpful when there's an issue with the food. For the most part anymore, if I see her in the store, I'll make my way to the new Wendy's down ridge ave.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I recently came to visit St. Louis on vacation. I am a coffee enthusiast from Los Angeles. With there being so many amazing coffee roasters and shops there, I wasn't sure what to expect from this place. But If you are into Specialty Coffee this place is AWESOME! EXCELLENT customer service from the owner, thoroughly explained what coffees he had and what to expect from them, and he ensured the quality of my moms cappucino with not accepting anything  less then a perfect shot to compliment the Organic Cream Top Strauss Milk he used. Would come back to this place again and again!

My boyfriend treated me to this place for my birthday. Unfortunately I was mostly disappointed by my meal here, I found the best part of the meal was dessert, probably because they didn't make the ice cream, it came from Woodside Creamery.  

I will say service was great, the waiter attentive, but my food was just bleh. I will concede that could have been my due to my choices off the menu, but I was expecting anything off the menu to have been great given this is suppose to be such a high caliber place. 

I suppose I'll give them another try in the future, maybe it will be better.

They say 3 times is a charm.   I will be back in Philly on business staying at...... you guessed it! The Spring Hill Suites Philadelphia Airport/Ridley Park for 3 nights.
 I contacted the manager  Jen via phone just like she told me to do (left a voicemail)  if I was ever planning on coming back to this facility, but she has yet to return my call. I will be checking in on Friday 2 Nov and staying until 5 Nov. I hope this stay will be as awesome as my first one was Christmas of 2017. Keeping my fingers crossed!!!!!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This location has really gone downhill. The service is very unfriendly. I think the one guy is the owner or manager, he's there everytime I've been, and he doesn't even smile. As other reviewers have photographed the furniture is falling apart. Most of the chairs are ripped or broken. The bathroom is old and looks poorly maintained as well. As a franchise I'd be very surprised to hear Second Cup is happy with this location representing them. On my last visit I ordered a soy chai latte and it tasted like it usually does at other locations, so the drinks are as expected.

First Timer for Brunch. Fabulous unique vibe, atmosphere, food, drinks and service. To top it off they are not over priced like other Newtown restaurants that think they are in NYC. I see there are lots of folks, obviously inexperienced in finer dining,  that think it is high priced.  Likely those who   "know the price of everything and the value of nothing". 
Solstice is real value and quality where there is a dearth of great places to eat. If you desire cheap stick to The Clubhouse. 
(PS I do love the clubhouse also, great wings and burgers. :-) 

My new favorite Bucks restaurant. You will love everything about Solstice,  I promise!

I couldn't decide between 2 or 3 stars but decided to go with 2. They were great with my 4 year old but she was done before my pedicure even started...then when my pedicure finally started the guy didn't even ask me which pedicure I wanted when they offer 3 options! He was so rush the whole time I didn't enjoy it at all and the last thing it was was relaxing. He also didn't give me the manicure I asked for when we first walked in. It's like they just want to get you in and out as fast as possible...not about customer service but about making money!! Not sure I will be back here :-/

Watch this place.  I thought I was buying car washes for one month for $23.  Turns out my card was charged monthly several times.  When I stopped in to resolve they said I should have checked my account more frequently.  They didn't care if I haven't used their services past the initial month.  I'm sure this happens to a ton of people because the attender was a pro at doing refunds and his BS comments.  I'll never be back and urge everyone to do the same.  The car washes aren't even that good.  Go elsewhere.

A must stop when I am in town, the first time my Husband has eaten here with me. Always delicious food, the clam and mussel marinara smelled and tasted like something I would pay triple for! The garlic rolls definitely leave with you, but worth the garlic smell for the rest of the night! The ravioli and vodka sauce was amazing, I would recommend it for anyone looking for good food. 

It's really cool the owner is always there making sure food is what the customer ordered and chatting everyone up, it's a great friendly atmosphere. 

If your in the area and looking for great Italian food check this place out for sure!

Service was terrible. The manager/owner was so rude to me, I guess she was tired and ready to go. Everything I asked it was like I was getting on her nerves, she wouldn't even let me complete a sentence thinking that I was complaining when I was only asking normal questions. She burned my fingers so many times because she was rushing. I just stopped her and didn't even get the polish. I was so pissed. if you close for 7pm and a customer walks in at 6:58 you are supposed to give them the best experience. Be careful who you think has a good business and im posting this on all revie sites. And y'all only got 1 star cause I had to leave one.

My cat had trachea lymphoma, and went to VSS for chemotherapy. This was five years ago, and I can't ingrained life without her. She's doing fantastic! If you read the reviews complaining about prices, keep scrolling. These are specialists in their fields, and the quality of care is unsurpassed. I also foster for a rescue, and I have had animals also there for ear canal surgery, diaphragmatic hernia surgery, eye enucleations, broken bones, and much more over the years. I cannot say enough good things about VSS and their staff.

I was craving sushi and remembered seeing this place by the theater. I got the rainbow roll and edamame just to be safe and it was really mediocre. It tasted like grocery store sushi and didn't taste fresh at all. Maybe I am lacking some knowledge on this place, but it definitely didn't come across and fresh or worth the price, even if it is cheap. I'd rather just skip on it all together and settle for the tacos next door. On top of that, I felt really sick for the rest of the night, but am not pinpointing it to this place, it's just something I noticed. Do try it and see for yourself.

The stylist, Michelle I believe, did not listen to what I asked for and butchered the cut. I would not recommend going to her. after I explained how I wanted my hairline she just shaved it off and then asked if that's  how I wanted it. I mentioned I don't want it high and she shaved it about 2 inches higher than my already established hairline .   She said that's how I do everyones hair, well maybe I don't like looking like every one else. That's why I went to a men's salon and not super cuts. Very upset with the cut done by the stylist.

Admittedly, I waited too long to call these people. I called 11 days past their 90 day window. But I paid a lot for a pair of bifocals. When I picked them up, no one tried them on me. I was handed them, tried them on and out the door I went.  The problem is that they never told me to begin with  that the bifocal would be like a bump out on the front of this pair of glasses. They are really ugly. So, I don't wear them. When I called and asked about just having them redone in single vision, I was told sorry...it's past your 90 day window. I will never return to this office.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I came here two times before the food and service was great.. For some reason I came today with a group of friends to have lunch. One of the people that I was with never had sushi before she kept it simple and ordered shrimp tempura(which she liked) and California roll she really didn't like..We called over the waitress to see if we could get something else, she told her no and asked if she needed a box or if anybody at the table wanted the food...I never experience anything like that before I thought restaurant support to accommodate their customers

The sushi is out of this world..its delicious! The service on the other hand is terrible. You are sat sometimes asked what youd like to drink..if not good luck getting someones attention. Want a refill...going to have to wait forever for that too. I used to give them the benefit of the doubt the first, second, third visit then I just had to accept that the service is just terrible no matter the day, time of day, amount of customers, sushi bar seat or not. The servers and sweet for the most part and like I said the sushi is delicious but make sure you visit on a day that you have lots of patience and no time constraints.

I read the yelp reviews and decided to give this place a try, and boy am I glad I did! I loved the food, from the chickpea fries and 24-hour onion dip and chips to the industrial burger and roasted cod!!! Everything was delicious and the waitress was so friendly, prompt, and she even divided up the kids order on two plates without me asking. I usually get 1 order because my girls who are 2 and 4 don't eat much. The ambiance is great, the place was bustling with patrons! I'm from NY, this place will leave a wonderful taste I my mouth as I'm heading back to the city tomorrow morning.

The quality of the food and service varies wildly at this location. They are inconsistent to a fault. I do not accept sullen indifference in lieu of customer service. I recently went through the drive through. I asked for extra onions. When I got home there were no onions. How hard is it to touch a button with an onion icon on it. I pulled up to the window and the black girl was literally mute. She did not say a word during the transaction. No hello. Thank you. or kiss my ass. Actually I think the kiss my ass was implied.

Tried the new fish restaurant today, and felt it was just okay. Sun king was out of my two first beer choices, but that happens. We were a party of 5, of which two were kids. Their meals were some of the best, and my Cuban was also good. The big disappointment was with the $12 calamari, which was more like stuffed shells or tortellini - not at all like a classic calamari. The lobster roll was also small and too sweet for $15. I'm not saying we won't go back - the table next to us had fantastic looking fish sandwiches - but I just thought for $120 it wasn't super.

This small but cute lucha-libre themed tex-mex joint was empty on Saturday afternoon when we stopped in. The chips and queso came out very quickly and was tasty. Both of us ordered the chicken chimichangas (they were the best looking option as well as the server's suggestion). They were very good as well and quite filling. The only complaint would be the red sauce covering one third of the chimi was dry and appeared to have been a few days old (See pictures). Total bill was $33 - mildly expensive for what we
We got.

Overall it was a nice little lunch while we explored downtown Tampa.

This is a second location for them and they just opened so I will be generous with my stars in the hope they get better.

The room is loud you can not hear the person next to you and both times I went there was no room at the bar.

The first time I went there was a ad on the table saying beer was 4.00 during happy hour, when I asked why I was charged more they said that was only for the bar and not the dining area. But, they did not remove the ad and they still asked for full price, the manager would not budge on this. Hopefully they can address some of the issues. However, I will not be going back soon.

Very beautiful hotel!. Felt intimate,  it was clean,  quiet. I was suprised not to see people outside in the courtyard playing or hanging out. Our room was very clean. I fell in love with the decor! Best part of it was the games like jenga, connect 4 with a Bon fire on the side.  It felt secured once we found out the big entrance door closes at certain times. You need to use your room key to go in.  The beach is literally walking distance like 10 minutes away.  The restaurant's are walking distance! I would of given it 5 stars but there was no fridge or microwave so we couldn't take our leftovers from eating out.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I don't ever write reviews but this time I had to...I ordered the lasagna And as soon as I opened it up it had a weird smell. My husband thought it was the cheese so I took a bite, it was definitely  bad. While dumping it in the drain the smell was worse And rancid from the bottom of the container. I'm only complaining because im pregnant .we did call and they were quick to say they were throwing out that batch. Still you are a restaurant and should know when you have outdated food. Thy Said next meal was free which was nice but sorry I wont be ordering there again.

The food was just okay; I've only made Eggs Benedict once, and I know it was hardier/better than this one. The Bloody Mary tasted like tomato juice--like it wasn't blended/stirred properly.  And lastly (and what unnerved me most), even after asking for water and my glass was clearly empty, other than when I had initially sat down and the hostess gave me a full glass of water, my glass remained completely empty the entire time.  When I asked for my check, the server finally brought back the pitcher to refill my glass as he was giving me my bill. Today I was a single party of one and perhaps minimal service was given because of that--pity.

I gave one star because I did not even get to get in. Drove from City Ave in rush hour to get there and was turned away at 6pm!  They said they couldn't handle any more guests, the kitchen was backed up.  There were many empty tables and 3 or 4 staff members standing at the door, and after seeing photos of the owners, I believe one of them was also at the door and he said not a word, I would think the owner of the business, would say sorry, please come back, or something.  I would like to try it, it looks like a good menu, but it seems like they need some time to straighten out the kitchen.

Delicious sushi! They have a ton of variety and are always adding new rolls. The all you can eat comes with appetizers and dessert. Only reason I don't give it 5 stars is because the facility isn't the greatest. Signs inside are pieces of paper taped to doors and a white board on an easel. Bathrooms are unkept, floors and baseboards are dirty, paint is chipping off the walls. The sushi makes it worth putting up with though. Highly recommend the following rolls: Avenger, Inception, French Kiss, and Bronco roll.

Have you ever lost a nose piece from your glasses and wondered where in the world to take them to get them fixed?  Especially if you are not close to the location where you purchased the glasses.  

I was in for a surprise when I visited Visionworks on North Dale Mabry. I walked in and was immediately assisted by Ariel M.  She took my glasses, replaced both nose pieces, cleaned my glasses and sent me on my way in less than five minutes.  And the cost was a smile and zero $.  Wow, that truly is service with a smile.  Thanks to Ariel for the assistance and this satisfied customer will be back when she needs new glasses!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: My best friend brought me here for a date night. It wasn't busy so that was a lie because we both were famished. I was a bit confused as to when we were seated and we left a space between us the hostess told us to sit back next to each other "for social distancing" I guess my definition is different. Nonetheless the food was AMAZING! Way better than any hibachi place I've ever visited, and better than Benihana. I will always come back when I'm back home visiting my family/friends. Portions are a good size as well.

Great atmosphere. Unlike any place I've seen in Indy. Eclectic as hell with an old school NYC pho hotel vibe (turn of the century Waldorf Astoria) but hipster modern too. Live music on the 2nd floor with a completely different feel. It's retro 70s schtick is rad. Lava lamp, ice cream sandwiches, chick wall paper.... it a cool place. No cover for the bands and the drinks are reasonable, if not low for Mass Ave. I stayed late and it turned into Club Burnside which I liked so much I thought I'd transported to another city! Cheers

I have three children, so we are familiar with most of the McDonalds in town. This is one of the worst. We were there a few days ago, so my younger two could play and eat while my older one was at a party. The play area was so hot that we couldn't sit in the room. The floor was filthy with dropped food everywhere. I had to search for a chair that wasn't sticky. The service took forever, and my salad was old. I know it's McDonalds, not fine dining, but there are many other locations in the area where you can have a better experience.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: This Five Guys is in the old Roselyn Bakery right downtown Indianapolis. The exchange of sweet baked treats for that of American hamburgers is a welcomed exchange as any city is prone to change over time. Indy seems to be in a transition of national chains over local cuisine. However, Five Guys is a great chain for the best burger in downtown. I've taken a few people from overseas to this location and they have loved it each time. I recommend the bacon cheeseburger with small fries (they are always so generous with the extra fries).

My boyfriend took his truck through crew car wash in Columbus he has spent a lot of money there. The last time he took his GMC truck through there the guy didn't latch the tail gate properly after washing it out it fell down as the truck was going through. This caused his tail light to fall out. The light was found in the car wash. It cost him over 400.00 to have the problem fixed.. He contacted Crew they offered him 50.00 as a customer appreciation.  Don't take your vehicle there if you expect them to pay if it's damaged.  I told Bobby to take them to small claims court..

Went to have diner with my wife on Saturday 11/16.   It started out with wonderful appetizers and a fresh salad.   Thinking the main meal was going to be just as good, but NO!  My chicken parm was horrible,  over cooked hard to cut dry chicken..   Of the 3 pieces I ate 2.  One cutlet had a funny sour taste so I just stopped eating.   My wife had eggplant parm and wasn't happy either.    Two Italian staples and you can't cook it correctly, shame on you!! If not for the delicious  appetizers I would have given restaurant 1 Star.
