Never again will we order pizza from El Patron... we stayed Downtown Tampa in a 4star hotel & order a large pizza & wings ... it took almost 2hours for our pizza to get to us... my husband called twice to check on our order... the 2nd time he called he ask to speak with a manager & was told there was no manager there for him to speak with....  by the time we got our food it was cold & nasty.... I will make sure to tell the hotel manager not to let this company advertise in this hotel anymore.... we paid close to $30 for cold pizza & wings & waited 2hrs... not happy

Great, accommodating rental place.  I was in New Orleans the week of 2/15-2/19.  Went to rent a car on wednesday and no place had any available.  My hotel told me to call Nifty and they had some cars left.  The people were so friendly and were able to set me up right away.  The first car they gave me had some problems so I called the company the next morning and someone drove out another car to my location which was Mississippi at the time.  Outstanding and thoughtful service. Could not have been happier even with the first car not being the greatest.

Short and simple I made the HUGE mistake of using my credit card when ordering delivery. The delivery guy took it upon himself to add a 3 dollar tip to my card. Glad I check my transactions! The owner Jason acted like it was no big deal and blew it off as a mistake. No way!!!! I told the delivery guy he wasn't getting a tip because he was incredibly rude rolling his eyes and down talking me because he had to wait under 2 minutes for me to answer the door and receive my order. If you do get food here do not use you credit/ debit card. These people are crooks!!!

It's a decent location. Close to arch and museums. It tough with so much of it being under construction. I can hear drilling inside hotel as well as outside windows at stadium. If you're a sensitive sleeper, then you should consider this before booking.

Leaving building to go to gym and eat is challenging, yet manageable. They don't have a mini store for small purchases- due to construction. 
Keep this in mind and consider options. 

The bed skirt was dirty. Kinda embarrassed for hotel to have a display like that... just a little more attention to the small details.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: First Internet Bank helped us with our Home Loan and they did an amazing job. We shopped around quite a bit for the best deal that made the most sense financially and they provided the best rate and overall loan package out there! First Internet Bank was really fast getting our loan a final approval during the escrow process and very responsive and communicative as well which was a HUGE deal for us. They no doubt deserve a 5 star rating for their Home Mortgage Loans. We would highly recommend them to anyone.

Worst customer service I have ever experienced. I called several times before my stay to make sure I would be able to check in by 3 they assured me that would be no problem. When I arrived we gave them our cell number to call us when room was ready. They never called so we finally tried to check in at 7 and the lines where very long. The front desk people did not say please or thank you they talked very low. I told her to speak up and she rolled her eyes at me and talked even lower. The room was freezing and they said there is nothing they can do. I have been waiting 22 hours to hear from a manager. Never again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If you like food from a microwave you'll surely enjoy this place. My order of bacon was $4.00 for 4 slices...I'd expect this if someone had actually spent time preparing it other than popping it in the microwave for 30 seconds. Not to mention being sat down and waiting for my wife to order only to be told they were out of what she wanted. The menu isn't huge to begin with so if the establishment is out of something it would make sense to let customers know that when you drop off the menus. Needless to say we won't be back.

Being from Metairie, I'm spoiled by Sushi Express (of Metairie). They offer free delivery, use LARGE rolls, and deliver during their happy hour. Regarding Value. Bonzai Sushi Express in Chalmette pales in comparison. 

They don't deliver during happy hour, charge $5.00 for delivery and they make small rolls. I guess you can get away with that when there's no, local, competition.

On the plus side, delivery is prompt and the food is tasty. It's just hard for me to pay so much for so little, especially when I'm spoiled when I'm at home.

Located in the historic Ybor district, this place was packed with customers on a Friday evening. We drove here as we read about the 'unique' flavors of ice cream they have to offer.

We tried the popcorn ice cream which wasn't the greatest (I love popcorn) and the vegan mocha ice cream which was very rich! 

We're not quite sure why they don't allow samples, considering they have flavors we usually don't see often. The covid reasoning just doesn't make sense because the outlet did not follow any other covid protocol. If we had a chance to sample, I probably would not have picked the popcorn ice cream.

I'm new to the area so I am trying to find my new sushi spot. Sadly, I don't think Ginza is the one. I was leaving the green hills mall and saw Ginza so i decided to place an order. The servers were every nice and quick, however the sushi was sub-par. It should be noted however the prices were more than fair. 

I ordered the Snow mountain roll and the tuna roll. The tuna roll was the better of the two, which was shocking considering the price of each. The snow mountain roll was pricier, yet the quality reminded me of something you'd pick up from a lower end grocery store sushi counter. Overall I'd rank it a 5/10

I am not a picky eater. It's extremely rare for me not to finish something, even if I don't like it. I ordered a salmon roll, philly roll, and spicy tuna roll from Kabuki and had to throw it out. It tasted odd and definitely wasn't fresh. 

Normally I would go back and give a place a second try but when I went to pick up the food I asked for extra soy sauce and the guy told me there was already one in the bag and i repeated I wanted extra. He made a big deal out of having to get another one.

Go somewhere else.

So I just moved to the area and took a chance on trying this spot for pizza, and I wasn't disappointed in how good it tastes! The only reason I gave it 4 instead of 5 stars is because I ordered a large cheese pizza, EXTRA cheese. I felt like they didn't put any extra cheese on it and it was just a regular cheese pizza. So if I'm paying almost $18, I'm kinda expecting it to be cheese that's practically falling off the pie. Also the guy who took my order over the phone sounded like I was bugging him for giving my business. But these are teens/young adults running the store. Other than that, good location with a parking lot and speedy service.

We love this restaurant chain. This was great the first time. Went back last night to extremely poor service. Waitress didn't know what was in the meals. There was little meat in our tacos. I brought it to the manager's notice and he said, I'm sorry! 

We waited to order more food  but neither the waitress nor the manager stopped by or gave us a look. We ended up skipping more orders at the end. 

The table next to us got better service and were asked if everything was good. Not us though. Other locations are much better. 

Not going back to this location again.

Food is great! Will keep ordering from here, have gotten delivery through their site- they have messed up the order slightly a few times which is why I give 3 stars - examples are delivering a tuna salad with no tuna and then taking 25 minutes to deliver the tuna to fix the order instead (I'm okay with mess ups like that but the fact it took so long to deliver to fix it and it just delivering tuna) or putting some wrong stuff on a wrap. The problem is more attention to detail for whoever is making the food itself, will be calling from now on to place an order to make sure it's right because the food is still really good!

I have been coming to this gym for years. But the new owners are absolutely horrible. They got rid of two of the best people there, Siana and Brittany. They were told the gym wants to go in a different direction. I hope you know that direction is closing down. We are a small community and will come together to back these ladies up. I canceled my membership, group training and personal training. And so have many other members. They will make a comeback and be stronger than ever before and the entire community will support them.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Went there approx 11 months ago and the eye doctor gave me a thorough examination and I had a hard time finding a frame in either titanium or stainless steel and the titanium frames I bought have not held up,1 pair is bent and cannot be fixed unless I buy another frame and the quality is poor and the frame's are thinner than I had wanted.The service otherwise is straightening out the frame's we're good but because of the poor quality and not wanting to replace the frame until the warranty runs out I will be going elsewhere for new glasses
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Been coming here for a while and have been noticing a decline. A couple years ago this would have been a 5 star review and if I didn't have some connection to this place this review would be a 1 star. The service is awful, had to wait 35 minutes for 2 of our 6 rolls and it's been almost an hour for the other 4. The waiters are terrible, have barely checked on our table at all. I use to rave about how good the sushi was here but it's just not good anymore. I am just sad and dissapointed. The mighty have fallen.

I love this place so much! They always have fresh fish and it also tastes fresh too. If you are not a fan of sushi then there are plenty more options on the kitchen menu. My favorite in the kitchen is the Teriyaki Chicken with miso soup. My family and I always come when we are in the mood for sushi or just whenever! I've been okay with eating sushi but this place pushed me to try new things and what do you know? I will actually eat raw fish now! Anyways the people there are so kind and attend to your every need.

Every Saturday, after waking up, we go out to grab donuts for the fam. We love Dunkin Donuts and know that the staff at the location closest to our home is unfortunately rude, impatient, and unprofessional.  We'll drive out of our way to other locations but every now and then we'll stop in thinking that something has changed.  This morning proved us wrong yet again.  The folks working the front counter were once again so unfriendly and unhelpful.  DD management has to step in and do something. Otherwise, we plan to stay away completely.

There was a few minute wait which wasn't bad at all.  This was on a Monday and it was getting quite crowded around lunch time.  Waitress was very nice and friendly.  I ordered a Caesar salad with plain (no oil or seasonings) grilled chicken and the dressing on the side.  While the chicken came out just like I has asked for, the salad was covered in dressing.  I didn't feel like waiting for them to remake it so I just ate it.  it was very good, though.  My husband had the brisket sandwich and said it was very good as well.  If my food came out correctly, they would have received 5 stars!

Very pleasant staff. The new renovation they did I believe is a miss. The black wall paper makes the room extremely dark. My rooms small window had a view of a brick wall on all three sides which made it even darker. With all the lights on in the room and window shade open I was still unable to see my clothes in my luggage. The bathroom was very nice and lit though. Great location close to all of the historic locations and restaurants. Parking is limited to a parking garage a half a block away which is very expensive.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I would give this place 3 1/2 stars but thought it was more 4 than 3
I'm a long time diner but first time rater of this establishment. I have enjoyed Vodka Rigatoni, Taco Pizza, Upside down Sicilian Pizza, BBQ Chicken Cheesesteak, Sal's Special Pasta, Meatballs, Lasagna- I enjoy their food....I hesitate to order from this restaurant because they use jarred mushrooms and you can still taste the fluid it's preserved in- its a big pet peeve of mine that restaurants especially any serving Italian fare should use fresh mushrooms as a mushroom lover I find that It changes the flavor of the dish

I've had my hair cut hear three times. The first time I walked right in, and got a cut right away. The second time was an hour and a half wait. The third time was the same as the second. They do a really good job on cutting your hair very professional. The problem is they have no personality. I had one guy eating his lunch while trying to cut my hair, and the long wait time. Today when I went to get my hair cut I got there an half hour early and waited until they opened. To my displeasure they no one showed up at 10. I waited till 12 after before I said forget it and left. It's time to find a new place.

Really like the products.  My wife loved the new latte caramel square.  But I asked whether they had refills on the coffee, and the answer was "yes."  But the way they define refills is that you order and pay for a completely new cup of coffee, except they use the same cup.  Some places do not charge for refills, some have a lesser charge, some tell you up front that they do not have refills.  Had I known they did not have refills, I would have ordered a larger size for $.20 more rather than $1.61 more.  They wouldn't do anything to accommodate me.

Had to update my review after a few months working out here from a 4 star to a 1 star. Putting it lightly, this gym sucks. While it appears well equipt, all the equipment is filthy and half of it is broken. Theres dead spiders hidint in  every nook and cranny in the gym, mould in the water fountain and 90% of the patrons do not clean up after themselves.
If youre looking for an internship as a janitor this is the job for you, otherwise just spend the extra five-ten minutes to travel to another location the owners care to maintain
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: People and room were nice. Only complaint I have is that they were doing construction on floor 20 and placed us on floor 19 so we had a nice wake up call. Even though we had checkout in 2 hours I felt like it was unnecessary to make us or other guests listen to that noise and if they were doing construction they could have placed us elsewhere. They had 26 floors but I felt like they did that since we booked on a 3rd party site. Also the hotel was not busy at all so we could have been placed in another room to avoid the noise. It sounded like a drill. It was obnoxious.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Wish I could've given this no stars. Pulled into the drive thru at 10 pm and was met with an automated message saying the location was closed and to come back during business hours. The location does not close until midnight. I got frustrated and said that's bs, to which a very annoyed sounding employee responded and took my order. It took 30 minutes to get through the drive through, and when I started eating the fries were cold or reheated fries. This location does not care about their customers, or the quality.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We were so lucky to have contacted Nifty for a rental car. We were stressed out about not having a rental car last minute over Mother's Day weekend. They told us to call back at a certain time to check if they had any rental returns. We called and they did have a car. We dealt w/ Rachel- who was AMAZING, such a sweetheart. She was so professional and SO HELPFUL! She made the process so quick and easy, and was so accommodating. We would most definitely recommend this place and would come back each and Everytime we visit LA. Customer service is on point.

Great froyo place! The gelato looks good as well but I didn't have that (it's kept in tubs rotating on a big wheel so you can see the flavors). Unfortunately they only have one flavor of froyo, but it's tart and a little sweet and very refreshing for a hot summer day. I came here to visit U Penn, and my friend (a current student) took me out to go there. I had froyo with chocolate sauce and strawberries. The chocolate froze on the froyo so it was crunchy but melted in your mouth. Strawberries were a little sour, but it counteracted the chocolate. All in all, a great snack place, and I would definitely go again!

I would honestly give this place no stars if I could. Tried to dine in here lastnight and 3 people were served their drinks and appetizers before i even got a server and I was there before them! I was sitting at the table for 10 minutes just watching everyone get served but me. I asked the host nicely to get a server since I had been waiting so long and I still waited an extra 5 minutes. I don't understand how a restaurant can do this to their guest but they sure did and I will never be coming back to this location.

I can't say it is the best room but the service has been great. The room has really nothing to complain about since we have been here it's small but really it is what we paid for. The hostess was nice and also the check in staff. The same guy that game me the valet slip took my bags up to my room something I definitely like. The hotel is well kept we are enjoying the pool at the moment it is not exactly hot but the pool is heated and my kids can tolerate it.  One of the best things is the location we are right across the street from Harrahs and a walking distance to almost everything.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Management/Cooperate clearly have this place understaffed. The inside is completely shut down and the drive through wait time is 15+. There's no way to get forgotten items easily. My family has had horrible experiences with the staff and the management in the past as well. You might as well skip it and eat at the cafes downtown.

The girl working the drive through was very kind, she just clearly needed more backup.

As for Dunkin' itself, their food is fine - their avocado toast is not worth it - but drinks and doughnuts are usually okay if you really want them.

My husband and I stopped here with our dog for an impromptu brunch a few weekends ago and had a nice time.  We sat outside (with previously mentioned dog) and ordered mimosas.  Our server brought our drinks as well as a pan of water for the pup, which we (and she!) always appreciate.

We split the french toast stuffed with mascarpone cheese and strawberries, which came in a "warm vanilla sauce."  It was sweet and rich and tasty, but it wasn't Sabrina's.  That said, I'd go back, even if the mimosas seemed weak,

Everytime I eat from this location I always end up getting sick. Back in may i ordered off door dash from here and found my apple pie bitten into. Food 9/10 is normally stale or feels like I've been handed something that's been there for a while. Countless times I had to refrain going to the hospital pregnant at the time because of stomach virus. Not to mention in front of the establishment looks like the walking dead fiasco. My son could've picked up the crap that was on the floor. Unappetizing. *dont order the chicken sandwich*.. eat at your own risk...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I use to go here for years when I was a kid and in high school. Came by with my son to get his hair cut. All chairs were full and we were the only ones waiting. After a 25 min wait two others were waiting and two chairs opened up at which point I was told I would have two wait another 20 min due They both had appointments. I told them they should have advised me of the time line before I spent 25 min on a Saturday waiting.  Went to Arturo's and they got us in right away. Even more they were up front and told us it was fist come when I go there.

This has to be, by far, the worst repair shop in the milky way galaxy. I made an appointment to have work done on my vehicle. I arrived at 10:30. Wouldn't you know, it's 3:35 and I'm still here. The mechanics here are beyond incompetent. The only thing they seem to be good at is rotating tires, because they certainly can't change oil without screwing that up. 

Don't even bother coming here if you value your time and your vehicle.

Sorry Joe. You're one of the best shop managers i've met yet, but your workers will get you fired. They're that terrible.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I really like this place.  They have a lot of variety, the food is pretty good, and the owner, Vinnie, is really great!  However, I'm giving the restaurant only two stars due to the service.  I've been coming here for years, but I've finally had it.  There is ALWAYS something wrong with my order.  Whether it's missing something or they just give you the wrong dish altogether.  I'm tired of calling and constantly going back to have things corrected.  They will fix it, but like I said, I'm just tired of having to go back all the time.  And the high school kids that answer the phone could careless so.... be warned.

You are definitely paying for location. Filthy carpets, wallpaper in hallways all marked/ripped. In my room the phone doesn't work, table broken, carpets gross and folded/lifted up. Shower pressure is a dribble so you have to stand directly under the shower head. I have stayed in some crappy hotels in my days... but I have never had to pay this much to stay in crappy hotels. Oh and parking is $50 per night. As if they are not ripping you off enough as it is. I come to philly every year but I will never stay here again. Only plus is location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: WORST SERVICE EVER EXPERIENCED. We had 9 people at our table ordered, went through 2 baskets of chips each before drinks arrived, more baskets of chips and all our drinks in a 40 min time frame before I finally asked what was taking so long and they went back to the kitchen and came back and said they were working on it and walked away, 10 mins later still NO food or drinks. We got up and left. Only 4 full tables in the building..... 2 tables sat down after us, got served ate and we're paying already when we decided to walk out. First few times I went there best service and food you could imagine. Now it's terrible. Beyond terrible!!!!

This place is horrible. And if you book through booking.com it's all lies. The rooms smell like urine and the carpet is moist. They say they have a shuttle but it only runs till 10p which is stated nowhere and even when I booked with a late evening check in, I was not informed of this. The website boasts about a steakhouse being in the same parking lot as the hotel. Well that steakhouse has been closed for over a year! The hotel is in the middle of nowhere. Nothing near it for food or anything! If we didn't get in so late we would have definitely went somewhere else!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I think that they should just go back to opening at 6:00 am since they can't seem to open on time.  Waited till 5:15 am and left since still was closed.  Several cars in drive thru also left.  Customers shouldn't have to drive halfway across town to find another location that is ready to serve customers.  I have driven over to the Plumb Lane location and sometimes they aren't even ready for business.

I guess the local McDonald's here is using the Sears management playbook.  And you know where Sears is headed...down the "you know what"
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The gym itself is really nice. Plenty of machines and great variety. The hydro lounge is heaven. Very clean. My reason for only 3 stars is the staff. When you go up to get something they are so busy on their cell phones they ignore you. When they do notice you ,it's like you are putting them out. They don't greet you (at least not if they don't know you ) and when you leave they say nothing. Most unfriendly staff I have ever seen in a business. I'm not there to make friends but it sure would be nice to be greeted with a hello and smile. Guess I'm old fashioned.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Booked a rental car reservation on Southwest Airline website in September. Received an email that Southwest has reserved my car with Enterprise for December. Went back last week to check reservation and neither Southwest or Enterprise could find it. Was told to just re-book, but the issue is I booked in September for Christmas holiday and now the prices are 2 - 4 times higher than what I booked at in September. Southwest is doing nothing to resolve issue and Enterprise will not honor price even though I have proof. I am now without a car for the holidays. I think this is really poor customer service. Enterprise should just honor the price.

This is the nastiest hotel, cockroaches are you roommate an not just one like 10-15 I killed 5 in 15 min an changed room killed even more, they don't take no pride in anything they do the elevators haven't been inspected in 2 years which they should be shit down you can few hit the wall stops short of floors, just all in all I would stay at the days inn behind the place that place is clean they don't allow the junkie to roam the property red roof inn is over priced dirty beds etc if anyone gives them a 2 stars an above never been to a descent hotel
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: YASSS!!!! This place is everything!!! We stopped in on a Sunday afternoon after shopping and my goodness I'm so glad we did! We started out with the mixed chips and salsa. A delicious trio of nachos, plantain fried strips and  a root vegetable (I think)  that was so good with two dips. I had a strawberry margarita that was PERFECT!! Our entrees were the morita skirt steak and chipotle shrimp tacos  with black beans, jicama salad and avocado slices. So good....REALLY, everything was delicious. The service was prompt, friendly and professional. Don't hesitate to visit this place, you will not be disappointed!

Lolita is now my favorite restaurant in Philly! As a native Southern Californian I didn't expect to find a fine dining Mexican restaurant here while attending a convention. The menu is a really interesting spin on Mexican cuisine that actually improves on the traditional, at least to me. The service and atmosphere are also excellent. I enjoyed lunch outside with some sunny fresh Spring weather. The loud street sounds just gave it the local flavor that many would expect. I was very pleasantly surprised!
      In five days I enjoyed three meals; that shows I am now a loyal fan of Lolita.

Terrible service. I kept making eye contact with the people to ask questions and they just kept assuming that I was waiting for my order. I finally got my order and the girl didn't even open up the box to make sure it was right, even after someone told her to open the box and show me. She walked away as I asked for a bag, I asked for a bag 2 more times while making eye contact with another girl at the front and she still ignored me. Hire people with better customer service skills. It was my first time here and I'm never coming back. I hope the pizza was worth the terrible customer service.

This place is almost always busy because their reputation is that good. We have been coming here for a couple years now and have had great experiences here. The owner is professional, courteous, and makes you feel welcome when you walk in. I love being here when he is there, everything always runs smoother when the boss is there  my boys love coming here, and Alex hooked my husband up with a fresh hair cut for our wedding that looked amazing. Even gave him some hair putty which was incredibly nice. We keep coming back here because they know what they're doing, they're reasonably priced, and make us feel welcome

Made an appointment for a tire rotation, told them I would be waiting. An hour later they had still not taken my car into the shop, after pointing this out to the manager they "forgot to write down I was waiting". What is the point of an appointment?

Bought previous 2 sets of tires here and starting to regret it. Name is always spelled wrong, always tell me that I did not purchase my tires from them, wait times are silly, and with the prices they charge I expect better service. I will take my business elsewhere the next time I purchase tires.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Do not rent from Enterprise IND airport location. They had NO CARS when I went to pick up my car on May5. Midnight! And I had a confirmed reservation for a "Premium Elite SUV" . The Enterprise agent proceeded to explain that they had 30 more reservations than cars! ISNT this illegal ? There were several others on line after me but I quickly ran to Avis where they found a car for me at a walk-on rate. The agent at Avis was great. Tho she told me that this happens "all the time" at Enterprise and she thought it was "horrible" the way people are mistreated at Enterprise. AVOID THEM!

I have been to several different places for my C300 trying to find the right place for my car. After servicing with Euro motorworks I believe I have found my place and will be permanently taking my business with them. Everyone was friendly and really took the time to listen to my concerns. The services that needed to be done in my car were done in a correct, and efficient manner. They even lent me a loaner car at a reasonable rate! The only thing I wish they had were more convenient hours as I am a very busy person.

I love this place and then I was turned complete upside down. The guy responsible for the bull rides is an awful person. He purposely gave my clearly gay friend his number just to mess with him. What kind of heartless a** does that. Awful and hurtful to any human. Would not recommend based on the cruel hearted staff. Grow up and don't make it harder for them than it already is. Purposely pretended to be into him waved to him etc. and even gave him his coworkers number to make it a joke. I'm sorry but I'm not sure how someone's emotions is a joke. CHECK YOUR STAFF MEMBERS. NOT OKAY. HEARTLESS, inconsiderate jerk.

We are new to the area and are temporarily staying at the RV Park until our home is ready so we didn't have a veterinarian here.  We have two small dogs and one was due for his rabies vaccine and bordatella.  Dr. Sarah came out to us and it was such a nice experience.  The dogs were relaxed and had no idea it was an exam.  Lol.  She was great with the boys.  Gave them both a thorough checkup, gave vaccines and the price was very reasonable for this type of service.  So glad we found Vet to Pet and will definitely continue to use.

We pass this quaint little spot daily bc we live nearby. My husband said he'd eaten there once, and meh, but I had read that Bistro Daisy had received an Open Table award, so thought we should give it a second chance. First, the setting is charming; like a few of our favorite spots, (Brigtsens, Cavan, etc), it used to be somebody's home. The waitstaff was professional, we had high hopes--then the food came. Tasteless mushroom soup, oversalted duck, and ice cream with freezer burn! All overpriced. You might be able to get away with that some places, but Nola has very high standards. We won't be back.

Worst subway ever!  Never order online.. even looking at the description of the sandwich I ordered but didn't get, the so called manager says she doesn't care what my order shows she cares what hers printed out which was full of onions and Chipotle both of which I'm allergic to. I guess when you order one, drive 7 miles, wait another 20 min to get a sandwich that you pay for and have to toss in garbage then have to cook dinner its just suppose to be ok.  Do yourself a favor and go to Jersey Mikes instead..if your order isn't perfect they will make it so that it is..

Located right on the main street of Ybor city; they have a few outside tables that can provide entertaining people watching while dining.

The food itself is Ok, but uninspired.  Had the osobuco, which was good piece of meat well cooked, but the sauce was fairly tasteless and risotto kind of watery and tasteless.  

Service was good.  Indoor dining is in a high ceiling old room, feels fairly bistro-ish, not formal or upscale.  Bathroom and kitchen area were run down, a little dirty.

So OK if your major goal is to sit outside end people watch, but not a food destination

Ordered hotel delivery after a long hot day. Delivery was 30-45 minutes and brought right to our hotel room door. Online order, payment, and tip made it very easy. Pizza was excellent. Got a small pepperoni and a small garlic chicken. Had to force myself to stop eating because it was so good. Crust was delicious. Would definitely order again. Also had sandwiches and pasta. One of us ordered a turkey sandwich and said it was good but the pizza was even better. We are headed back to the city soon and my kids are already asking about this pizza.

I have always had wonderful experiences at this office from the first time I had a free appointment for an adoption appointment for my first dog. Dr. Luth is absolutely wonderful to work with. He takes the time the explain everything and always lays out all the different options and his thought processes. He also willingly played a key role in helping manage my dog's thyroid while I lived in Texas for a year for school. I've never had anything but top notch care and service at your office.  The care, kindness, and time spent are always appreciated.

We recently started going to Sushi Cortaro on River because they offer a great selection for all you can eat sushi. I used to go to Sushi Garden but due to COVID-19, they discontinued their all you can eat sushi option. I have been here for three birthdays, my own included, and it was a great experience! The food was delicious and we had enough seating for our large party. I would recommend calling ahead to let them know how many will be in attendance. If you let the server know it's your birthday, they will give you a complementary scoop of ice cream. Will be going back!

My party of four and I dined here yesterday and was pleasantly surprised at this little hidden gem in south Philly. The menu was a little jarring at first but we wound up ordering the octopus, beef shin, oysters, lamb tartare, and ceviche. All of our food was tasty but the octopus and oysters were absolutely delicious. The beef shin was wonderful as well and was 4lbs which was more than enough for the four of us. The drinks were interesting and strong as well. My only con would be the portion sizes for the appetizers.

On this visit I was disappointed as usual in that "we are out of montserella cheese today" says a very polite young lady. The last time they were out of my favorite bread. P poor management who can't have sufficient stock on hand. No holiday week-end being mothers day . I doubt they were over run with sub orders. 
This franchisee needs to pay attention to his investment. But I guess on the other hand, I guess  he doesn't give a hoot, to say it politely.  
The personnel at  4:00pm. were very polite. Being better than most days.

For a family style restaurant, this one has some of the best food around and since we go there at least once a week, we find it consistent in its quality. I usually get the mini chopped Greek salad with salmon and it is delicious. The salmon piece is usually at least 6 oz and cooked perfectly. They have greatly improved their vegetables, which are fresh looking and perfectly prepared. They have a diner-style menu, which also has some wonderful vegetarian items on it. Breakfast is served all day and they have all-you-can-eat fish on Fridays. Service is always prompt and their wait staff is friendly - Nadine and Marti are our favorites.

I came to get a nail repair. The place was empty but some man with brown teeth was there. He was instantly annoyed when I walked in. Had the worst attitude when asking if I needed gel or regular. I asked how long the wait was since there was literally no workers inside. He yelled "DO YOU SEE ANY CUSTOMERS IN HERE?" I said "No but I see you have an attitude and I'd i don't see any workers" he said "JUST GO" and I told him I'd be leaving a bad review and he said he didn't care. A horrible man and a horrible business.

First impression - restaurant was empty, hostess seated us quickly without a greeting and the table was sticky

We ordered our food and during our wait 2 more families came to dine in the restaurant. Both families ordered and both families received their meals BEFORE us. Once our food was served, it was warm and tasteless. The sweet and sour sauce on our over fried chicken looked like it came from a jar. The "special" chow mein was hard, not seasoned, and the only items included were onions and cabbage. The fried rice was also hard and not seasoned, but VERY greasy! We will not be back!

Food is okay, it's a McDonalds. Service is bad, hygiene is very, very bad.

When we got there there was not a clean table to be found. Floor is even worse. We had to clean our own table and seats. With 3 hungry kids, looking for another place was not an option so we did it anyway.

The drivethru guy kept walking through the place talking to his friends who were seated there. Drivethru was quiet, he could have easily actually have worked for a living, take a rag and clean the place.

General feeling I got from the place: nobody gives a damn about the place they are working in. Management was not to be found.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Worst car rental experience. A very "friendly" woman at the desk totally ripped us off. Started talking about a lot of extras and we declined them all, checked everything before we signed but still they ripped us off on 900 dollars. The woman at the desk told us that the fee we payed was a deposit that we would get back after we returned the car. We waited the 28 days that it could take but no money on the account. We called and a man who barely spoke english said that he could not see anything about a deposit. That friendly woman was not friendly. She was an a**hole and Budget is too.

Stay away! Hair cuts are inconsistent but the saving grace was quick way to get a cut between running errands. However, today was first experience with "online checkin".  Today, a room full of clients experienced "new" people walking in door going before those waiting. After 30 minutes a customer asked why and was advised of online checkin.  So as we gave our names, no one advised that it would be extended wait times (irked me that I waited 35 minutes only for the girl to advise still had two people from online ckin before me!).  Convenience now off the table and hair cuts that are hit or miss, be aware

I placed a mobile order at this Burger King and came inside to pick it up. They did not have Frozen Coke, instead gave me Frozen Cherry without asking me for the substitution. We waited for about 10-15 minutes for food that was definitely old and not fresh. At the time of ordering, the restaurant was not busy and they could have made our order instead of having us wait for food that's been sitting in the warmer for more than an hour. The chicken fries and chicken tenders were dry and the fries were cold. The customer service was better than expected.

I've now lost count of how many times I've stayed here.  This year alone has been three times.  I have never had a problem with this hotel.  The staff has always been friendly and helpful.  Every receptionist I've dealt with here has been professional, more than willing to answer questions, and displayed a cheerful attitude.

The rooms have always been clean and comfortable.  Never had a problem with noise.  The complementary breakfast has been fine.  

Next time I visit Meridian I'll staying here once again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My wife ordered the mushroom appetizer and the roasted beet salad for her main course, and I ordered the caprese salad and puttenesca.  All were were very good--as good as what you'll find in Italia.  But this restaurant does not rate a five star.  The portions were small and overpriced. I mean, I understand if an expensive cut of meat or sea food is served in piccolo sized, but pasta?  The wine we ordered, the Chianti, was not worth the $9 per glass. Keep looking if you want an italian restaurant with good food and wine at reasonable prices and portions.

I am a die hard Dunkin' Donuts lover. I've been going 4+ times a week for at least 4 years. I am addicted to their iced coffee. It's delicious and totally worth it especially when it's $1 for special promotions or sports team wins. 8 times out of 10 they find a way to mess up a medium iced mocha with cream and sugar. Nothing special. Even I know the mocha pump/sugar/cream ratios. I usually end up having to drive back around and politely ask them to add more mocha, sugar, etc. I hate being that guy, I wish they would just make it right the first time. They always give me attitude and tell me that is what I asked for. It's so uncomfortable.

After a day of travel to Florida, everybody was hungry and grumpy. Checking the reviews on yelp, I figured four stars, how bad could it be?

Maybe it's because I'm from Connecticut and I know what actual New York pizza tastes like, but this place was absolute garbage. If you tried opening a pizza place like this in New York City I doubt you would make it one month before you ran out of money.

The one thing that earns a five out of five rating on is my family needing to run to the toilet after eating it. Avoid this place at all costs.

It is hard to write an A-OK review because I LOVE Bartaco, my husband and I visit very frequently. Best margaritas ever,  delicious tamales and amazing street corn!  Since we love it so much, I decided to try to host a dinner for a small conference I was planning.  I requested a quote for 35 people, nothing too complicated. Well, it was a shocker!!  They were asking for a minimum of $2,500 (food and drinks only) plus services and tax! That is over 80 dlls per person for a taco nigh!! OMG!! I was very disappointed, we had to move to Miguelito's, they also have great margaritas and tacos.

I ordered the prime rib Easter dinner for my family.  When we arrived, we were greeted by a super nice guy (I believe his name was Josh) who answered all our questions and was very courteous.  They had Easter buckets of various drinks for sale.  We got the mimosa basket with champagne, 2 wine goblets, an Easter egg with a free appetizer on next visit.  So for $100.00 we got 4 at least 20 oz prime ribs, salad, focaccia bread, broccoli, fresh mashed potatoes, our drink basket.  This was an amazing deal and the food was absolutely delicious.  Will definitely do this again.  I highly recommended giving Bubba's 33 a try.

We live about 35-40 minutes from Guadalajara. We drove there on Thursday night cuz that's where I wanted to eat for my birthday. We arrived at 9:07 pm and it was posted that they close at 10 pm. The doors were locked and they started shutting the lights off as we were walking back to our car. If you post that you're open until 10 then I'm not sure why at 5 mins past 9 the doors are locked. What a waste of time. Hours of operation shouldn't depend on how busy or slow the restaurant is, that's bad business ethics. Terrible!

Tariq the new manager is a terrible person and I hope he is fired soon! We definitely will not go back to ANY Holiday Inn unless they get rid of him. He is condescending and rude and completely dismissed me and walked away! Ive never had such a bad experience with any manager, especially not in hospitality! (And I rarely complain) I also try to say good things and give praise when someone is great. I've even yelped about this hotel in the past and how great Miranda is. I am so disappointed! I will add more and tell the whole story tomorrow. I will also definitely be calling the corporate office!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This Hotel is run down, and not well maintained. It is apparent they are making attempts at remodeling, but there is no actual work taking place (at least not during my stay.) Housekeeping is slow, and sloppy. Refills of supplies are infrequent. The common areas are dirty and the staff seems overworked and stressed out. The elevators are working (sort of...one of the elevators does not show what floor you are on...the other one is visibly beat up and sometimes the doors don't shut.) They do offer a shuttle to the airport, but you would be better off getting an Uber or a Cab as it is very unreliable. I would not stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Blue indy cars.

Crapy cars that cost twice as much as Uber and Lyft.  (This comes from someone that used Blue Indy).   Do yourself a favor and don't use Blue Indy.

Be advised that blue indy cars are designed for short people.  The seat has minimal movement and you feel uncomfortable after  five minutes in the car. 

Not to mention the car is plastic inside and feels like drive a geo metro. 

Another thing to know is every time you drive one along with monthly memberships you get taxed 17%.   What the heck.  Not worth it.   Do yourself a favor and take uber or lyft instead. 

Junk

This was my first time going to educated car wash and overall the cleanliness of my car was awesome. The guys who vacuumed my car and pumped my gas were great. The guys who washed, dried, and detailed my car were great. The lady at the front counter ehh not so much. She was very rude to 2 customers while I was there. She gave off a very negative vibe and never made eye contact with any customers. She seemed very annoyed to be at work. This place would have gotten 5 stars from me had the lady at the counter be polite and not give attitudes to people.

Well I had to give one star in order to write this review other than that this hotel wouldn't even get that much don't put your stay at this hotel you think your getting a suite when,all your getting is a big single room and they tell you it a suite and they don't refund your money for now on I will check reviews first before I do anything else I was so,mad I didn't even sleep in the room it a ripoff best off staying at the holiday inn and just,maybe you'll actually,be in a suite like you ask for,me pay less,money never again would i,book,a room with this hotel I wouldn't advise my,enemy to,come here Fatimah ricks
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The table-side salsa was ok, altho the preparer made it clear that she expected a tip. However, the salsa was the high point of the meal. The enchilada, taquito, burro were all tasteless. As was the refried beans. Service was prompt, but when waiter spilled a bit of our beer, he never cleaned it up. Also, he "forget" to give us coin-change when we paid him. Just a little bit, so we let it go. This is a Sonoran Mexican restaurant for midwestern older Americans. 100% segregration between restaurant staff and customers.

I'm sorry, but YELP reviews for this restaurant are way off.  At best, this is mediocre supermarket grade sushi and I ordered both off the menu and the belt.  What's worse is that it is SUPER PRICEY for both quality and quantity of what you get.  Since expectations were elevated based on ridiculous reviews,  I left even more irritated.  Just because you have a Japanese knife doesn't mean you know how to cut sushi.  In all honesty,  mine was butchered,  but I may be a bit more pretentious having had some of the best in SoCal.  The sad part, prices were more expensive here than many Los Angeles gems.  I guess that makes me the ATM machine.

I've been here twice now since it opened, and I had also been in the establishment when it was previously a buffet under different ownership (I'm assuming) and it looks SO MUCH BETTER!!! Everyone here is so welcoming and so nice! All of the servers are in a good mood and they're attentive of your order. The food came out with great timing and was delicious both times. I was even annoying enough to ask what song had just played in the restaurant, and our server Ken was sweet enough to look it up for me :') Great food, and people!

This was DECENT Italian fare but not sophisticated. Everything we ordered was so heavy on sauce the food got lost. We ordered bacon-wrapped shrimp as an appetizer and even that was smothered in tomatoes and sauce.  The lobster ravioli appeared to be devoid of any lobster chunks at all. But again - not bad. But leaning too much in the Direction of a large Italian chain restaurant to justify the prices. It's an easy walk if you're unfortunate enough to be staying at the very horrible Hilton in south St. Petersburg.

I ordered a sugar-free French vanilla ice coffee with whole milk. The girl that took my order forgot to make my coffee. I ended up having to ask another girl about it. When I got my coffee, I took my first sip, it was so bitter! It tasted as if no type of flavoring was added.  I went back to the counter and told the girl it tasted bitter. She asked if I wanted it remade. The second one tasted just as bitter! I then asked if she could add more flavoring, she did, but it was STILL bitter.  I could tell she was getting irritated with me. I just ended up throwing the coffee away! If you want a GOOD ice coffee, don't waste your time coming here!

We stayed there for the Thanksgiving weekend  

Pros- quaint inn , nice location . 

cons - The walls are paper thin - we could hear when the Room service knocked on the neighbors door ! The neighbors came around to complain about the music ( though it was pretty low - we have a toddler so cant put anything v loud ) ! 

The breakfast leaves a lot to be desired - i have had better complimentary meals in Motels -. It was limited and the server standing next to it would literally glower if we asked for more yogurt or croissant . Definitely a put off . 

All in all an ok experience and only because we were with friends .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We're staying in Green Valley for a month and both my wife and I were looking for some NY/NJ style pizza. We were delighted to find Two Girls and their pizza is as good as it looks. We had a large cheese pie and the first thing we noticed was that he cheese tasted just like we remembered.  Fantastic!  The crust was thin and slightly bendy, which is a must, and nicely cooked. The sauce was delicious, and just the right amount.  This is the best NY style pizza we've had outside the east coast and you will love it too!

Incredible sushi, terrible service. My husband and I used to love this place (our favorite sushi place in STL), but the last two times we've gone - on a Friday night - there's been a 40-60 minute wait on sushi once you ordered. Not cool! This is after the 30 minute or more wait to be seated when there have been open tables in view (party of 2). The last time we went, we got there at 6 and didn't leave until 8:45. 15 minutes of that was spent actually eating our food! I'm done with Cafe Mochi until they fix their service problem.

Even though we arrived after 9:00 PM (they stop seating at 9:30 and close at 10) the place was packed and had to wait 5 min. We had been recommended this place from a friend and the sushi did not disappoint. There are a bunch of exotic rolls that are jam packed or covered with extras: crab meat, avocado etc, that coincide with your standard garden variety. Normally we have to order about 6 rolls to fill up and 4 here was more than fine. The blue lights under the bar created a nice ambiance. Doesn't seem to bode well for parties larger than 2-4.

Stayed here for my 50th birthday and loved it!!! The staff was exceptional and professional by every measure. The room (316) was very clean and comfortable, although small. We had a view of the river and it was surprisingly quiet with all of the street activity below. There is supposedly a ghost that can be seen wondering the court yard, but it steered clear of us, probably because we were looking. They provide valet parking but be warned it can take a while for them to retrieve your vehicle. 
Overall, would highly recommend staying here, it's a great value, wonderful location, and pretty little hotel. Plus,  I felt very safe.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Thankfully I didn't order anything from this particular Wendy's, however I was with my friend picking up a Doordash order. When you pull in, you can't help but notice the sketch appearance and people that surround the place as it is right next to a very run down Motel 6. We had to go inside to pick up the order and the stench hits you like a brick wall... also not to mention this place is absolutely filthy on the inside and I don't even want to know what the kitchen looks like. I'm surprised the health department hasn't closed this Wendy's down because I feel like I would get outright sick eating from here.

The elevator system sucks! It took me 39 minutes to get up to my room and 30 minutes to get to the lobby everytime I had to leave and come back. Then I left some clothes hanging in the closet and unfortunately did not realize it until I got back home. I called and have spoken with multiple ppl and it was advised that nothing has been turned in or was found. I know for a fact that I left my brand new clothes in the closet and they have not been turned in so that means that The housekeeping hires theives and dishonest people. That is unacceptable.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Have been here twice for a pedicure, today most recently.  This place is awesome!  For $25 you get a professional pedicure, and a very long foot and leg message that is worth the $25 alone!  They even do a hot stone massage on your legs and feet before the polish.  Hot towels are then applied, and your legs and feet are wiped dry before the polish.  The staff is very friendly and nice, request Ellen if you can, I had her today and will be requesting her every time.  I don't know what the negative reviews are all about......but hey, if u don't like it here, don't come, less waiting time for us, who really enjoy a professional pedicure!

If you're hungry, go elsewhere.  Pizza came 1 hour after it was supposed to be delivered, which was an hour after it was ordered.  they are 2.6 miles away.  hmmmm.  I called 3 times after the promised delivery time.  15 mins late, 30 mins late, then 45 mins late. the guy who answered yelled at me for 4.5 mins straight so I could talk.  told me it was my fault. they have other customers, I'm not special and on and on.  I live in CT and had ordered the pizza to be sent to my finance.  I can't wait to visit her soon and swing by to talk with the owner.

I travel for a living and often grab a Subway.  Ordered subs twice at this location over the past weekend from inside the store. I did not use the drive-through.

The staff was very friendly and accommodating and they made each sub with care.

All the veggies were fresh and looked good. The bread was not old and stale, as is often the case in other locations. The subs were among the best I have ever had from Subway.

This store is one of the cleanest and nicest Subways I have ever been to and I can highly recommend it.

It was my second time done with the dipping power and would be my last time. The experience that I had for the first time was really well and great. HOWEVER, my pinky got bleeding while the lady was using the drill on my nails. When I asked her "is it bleeding?" "Not yet, almost." she said. After I washed my hand, I just realized my pinky was bleeding. Be honest, it wasn't bad but I've done my nails at so many stores and never ever had this experience. She did say sorry for it but NO other offers. I WONT BE BACK FOR SURE.

I was staying at the Sheraton in the West Port complex, so I walked over to try this restaurant.

At first it is inviting, the decor is understated and comfortable and the service is welcoming.

The food did not live up the promise of the restaurant or to the prices they are charging. I had a seafood risotto special, the seafood was lackluster and the risotto even worse. There was an overwhelming lemon flavor (I couldn't even drink my wine when tasting this dish) and no creamy or tender quality to the rice.

The check for a salad, the seafood special and one glass of wine was over $50. Definitely not value for the money.

Title says it all.  I stayed in a king suite (upgraded due to status) and I was extremely impressed.  Everything new, very, VERY nice, fabulous inner courtyard with fire pits and a swimming pool, in a quiet, very upscale neighborhood about 7 minutes from UCSB.  I also love, love LOVE the Keurig machine they give you for in-room coffee.  Very nice, and a huge step up from marriott's normally wanky coffee gizmos.  My only complaint was that it was a little pricy for a Courtyard, but it *is* Goleta.  My only complaint is that I couldn't stay longer and enjoy the fire pits!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We were in Tampa for five nights to deal with family issues. Our dinner was so good, we went back two nights later. The steak, ordered medium rare was cooked to exactly as ordered, and accompanied by a marvelous spaghetti squash mash with I don't know what, except it was a delight.our salads were fantastic, and the wines were perfect. it's rare to get such a wonderful meal in such a charming and peaceful restaurant where a group of four could talk comfortably, and all for under $100/couple, including wine. 

This gem of a restaurant should by rights by booked to capacity on all nights.

Pleasant experience in a unique environment. Having a small kitchen while also serving ~14 guests is no easy feat. I do wonder how limiting this is versus a full kitchen. At the same time, limitations push creativity as well.

I would rate the service at a Michelin star. It is really the small details, such as filling water when low, that I appreciate.  For the food, some were definite winners while others needed some development (too complex for me). I'm not a professional food critique, so take my comments with a grain of salt.

I recommend food connoisseurs to try this restaurant out. The experience is well worth the price.

Had car washed today with wax. $74+. They've done a good job with washing the couple of times I'd taken the car in and I had them clean my headlamps once to get oxidation off. Did a great job. Today, not so much. Terrible wax job. Missed spots. Left wax on car in places. Can pick bugs off. They were two of them and most of the time they just stood around talking. Advised them of spots they missed and was told "oh, forgot it" or "I did get it" when I had watched them not get it. They were not interested in doing a good job or even a job at all. Very unhappy and disappointed. Thought we'd found a good place.

Generally decent internet bank with (IMO) good rates.     3 stars only because the customer service is inconsistent.    Some reps are exceedingly good, while others clearly need training and to know when they need help to deal with customers.     IMO it is better to admit ignorance than misdirect customers, waste customer time, and possibly cause some grievous error.    I did notice that several other reviewers named particular Customer service personnel as great ones....this is consistent with my observations... some of the reps are not very good, and others are great.

When visiting NOLA, one doesn't usually eat Italian food, but we wanted a change at the end our week, so I found Vincent's on Yelp. I talked to some folks who lived in NOLA, and they endorsed Vincent's highly. Located in the uptown area off St. Charles St., Vincent's is what you envision in a homey Italian restaurant. The owner is going from table to table, greeting and hugging returning guests. The food and service were great. We throughly enjoyed the place, and noted most eating there were clearly residents, often known by the staff, and often bringing kids. Just a fun stop in the midst of the Cajon Mecca of the south.

The hotel is in a historic building. The decor is somewhat outdated.
Pros: Free breakfast, gentlemen who walks around  the restaurant is extremely nice and personable, food is good as well. 
Cons: The guy who works the front desk was rude. We tried checking out and in the middle of the process, he answered the phone so we just stood there waiting for several minutes. He was extremely unprofessional. (Both ladies that worked the front desk were extremely nice and went above and beyond.)
In the future I would pick a location closer to Broadway.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My friends and I love to support local businesses and though we enjoyed the atmosphere (laid back, welcoming) the food was not worth what we paid. It's a pub - so it should specialize in beer and inexpensive (mostly fried food) right? Not so much. My Alaskan cod was way over-fried to black. And when my friend ordered the shrimp Alfredo, it actually came with popcorn shrimp!! (This shouldn't even be on the menu). And sadly, our coleslaw was so drenched with sauce that it was inedible. If we ever return, we will not be ordering food.

A few weeks ago, I went into Starbucks on Main St, in Brighton to study for my college psychology class. I ordered a pumpkin cream cold brew after a friend recommended it. When I got my drink, it looked very professional with the different layers of coffee and pumpkin cream. I stirred the two layers satisfyingly together and then took the first drink and I fell in love with the drink. The texture and taste were so creamy. The atmosphere was perfect for studying. I would 100% recommend the pumpkin cream cold brew to anyone who enjoys coffee or if you are looking for something different than the Pumpkin Spice Latte.

I attended a conference/luncheon at the hotel and arrived early to look around this beautiful place. I found a lovely bar and had brought my laptop so I decided to have a glass of wine and get some work done. 
I was shocked when I got my bill for $18 for one glass of wine. That is absolutely beyond exorbitant. As a local I know there are plenty of other 5 star hotels in the area that have much more realistic prices and do validate your parking if you dine with them (Vinoy/Sandpearl). It's a shame because it really is a lovely place-just not 'local friendly'

I haven't been to Arby's in 10-15 years I'm visiting Nashville and I am not impressed whatsoever. I usually get the beef and cheddar which I did curly fries and a drink they did not have any of the condiments out due to covid so I had to get pockets of Horsey sauce I love horsey sauce. It was average it wasn't that crowded the employees were friendly but they did raise their prices. The tables were not clean from previous customers and for me to get enough of my Horsey sauce I had to get like six or seven packets there's nothing in those packets. Quite disappointed won't be back.

I've heard a lot about this place so I decided to finally try it out. 

My first visit I ordered the tempura udon noodles. Plenty of tempura and the noodle soup was great. 
Service was on the slow side. Our waitress was very sweet but she disappeared frequently for long periods of time. 

Second visit was for a pick up order. Hibachi salmon. 
They said on the phone it'd be 15 minutes. Arriving after 20 minutes, I then had to wait for another 15. Not a big deal, but I wish they would've just told me 35 on the phone. 
The salmon tasted okay and the fried rice was too dry. 

I'm kinda in between about this place.

It looks like I am not alone in saying that this not what I expected at all for a Westin. This hotel is in major need of renovations. I am really regretting staying here. It's on the Harbor, so great location but I recently stayed in a Best Western that puts this place to shame. For one thing doors don't seem to fit in the frames, so you have to slam them to get them closed. The result is that I got a terrible night sleep hearing my neighbors coming and going and slamming doors. Staff was great, but not worth it if you can't get a good night's sleep. Go to the Marriott across the street instead.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Under normal circumstances I would rate this place four stars.  We came here New Years Eve dinner. We had planned on having drinks and something lite before going out to a bar.  After we were seated for our reservation we were told they were not offering the regular menu but instead a 5 course prix fixe menu. This is something they should mention to the guests ahead of time, especially when they took the time out to call the customer to confirm their reservation.  The staff was nice and the food was good, but it was way too much food and really ruined our plans for the evening.

I had the best experience today. I'm not from Tampa and got a flat tire, it was a complete coincidence to find this place. People here are very knowledgeable, they made a quote for jist one tire and I decided to change all the tires since the price was songood that I could not let go this opportunity. The staff is really easygoing and professional. They explain to me everything that that did and showed me a couple of things about that thay did and found before I leave. I highly recommend this place. Thank you for the great service I received today.

Horrible service. Doesn't anyone teach these employees ever to say I'm sorry? They lost our ticket and we had to bring it up to them twice! When the cashier told the cooks, they just threw their hands in the air like it's such an inconvenience to fill an order. We asked to speak to the manager, no surprise, there wasn't a manager there. Their order system has you pay your tip when you order. Wow, wish I could take that back! Never an apology.
Is this the same SUSHI AI, INC. entity #C2397431 that the California Department of Corporations says is suspended by both the Secretary of State and the Franchise Tax Board? Wow.

Intentionally avoided this place before Taffer's overhaul. So my curiosity in how much Bar Rescue helped, is what drove me to give Spirits a shot.

I would give this place just 1 star, based on the horrible service I received, but The Resurrection was honestly delicious. Their signature drink, the Resurrection is def stronger and tastier than the Grenades that proliferate Bourbon St. Plus the mug is perfect for tourists.

My advice to management, remember that female bartenders that are assholes to customers are not a good look, especially on a street where there are tons of options  with better customer service.

Excellent service & delicious pizza & salads. Had the yardbird & subbed with bbq sauce - yum. Also had the margherita pizza & Parm Salad & both were perfect. 

We look forward to returning but have a few suggestions. In light of the current environment we are choosing places to eat based on their outdoor seating. Please remove the burning lamps that are positioned at the front - it's already in the 90s in the evening & having them there makes it feel like 115. Please install patio & ceiling fans outside. We were there at night & we were very hot so can imagine what it's like during the afternoon.

I brought my 2017 Ford Explorer for routine service at Walker Ford. The service department was unremarkable and the service representative was unfriendly and bordering on rude. The service waiting area was uncomfortable with no complementary refreshments offered. My experience with tithe Walker Ford dealership was the most unsatisfying I have ever experienced with a car dealership. I cannot recommend Walker Ford dealership to anyone. I will be in the market for a new Ford explore at the end of the year, but because of my experience with Walker Ford service department, I will not be doing business with Walker Ford.

Difficult to find any redeeming quality for Dawson's. 6 o'clock on a Thursday and the place is empty. Was with a group so we were not about to find a different place. This place is not clean and I fear the kitchen is the same. I was scared from the start so I ordered just a large ceasear salad. Wilted and the dressing was bad. Had two bites. Staff was nowhere to be found and there was less than 4 tables of customer's. Even paying was difficult. I doubt this place will be open in 6 months.  Even the front door is filthy.

Solid food truck....hand made tortillas. Tried the barbacoa, asada, and pastor. Four stars because the food is good, service is friendly and the price is right. 3 tacos for $5 beats almost any place. plus they do not hold back on the serving either, these tacos are loaded. The meat had plenty of flavor, I think there asada can be better, but definitely tastes better then most places. The salsa can have a little more flavor. The red is spice but nothing special. I would definitely come back next time I am in the area.

Won't stay here again. Room was nice and clean and big however I heard music piping through the vents all the way from the lobby. I called down to have them turn it down and they said they would send security to check on it and tried to convince me it wasn't the lobby. It was I checked by going down there. I also put my room service door hanger out at 9 pm and when I called down to check on my breakfast I scheduled for 6 am the guy told me they didn't even pick up the ticket until 6 am. Terrible and unacceptable for someone that travels a lot and has to be on schedule.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Stopped by for the first. Not sure what happened with the other posts but we had a different experience. We ordered shrimp and fish. Both of them had a good, seasoned batter. The shrimp especially tasted fresh. We also got the hot sausage poboy. They use Patton's hot sausage and doubled the patties at least for the full poboy. 

The way they set up their prices it's better to get the bigger version of everything including daqs. They only had 4 flavors of daqs but they also have liquor behind the counter. 

Overall we'd come again.

Nasty!!! I have been 3 times w/ my husband only b/c he loves wings and every time it has been worse and worse..they are pricey compared to other wing places and the food is dull or gross...last time they brought burnt chips to our table... and tonight i got food to go... the buffalo wings were under cooked, slimy and bland.. i  had some some mushrooms and they were very soggy!! also they forgot to add my blue cheese..we were going to just bring the food back..but it wasn't worth loosing our parking and the drive....I can't believe this place is still in biz..

Wow, I have never had an experience like the one our family had tonight!  After being told by the "owner" that we weren't allowed to park in the parking lot even though we had a reservation we went ahead and sat down at our table, ordered drinks, and then ordered dinner.  Before our dinner arrived we approached the owner and questioned why he had told us we couldn't park onsite.  At that point he became extremely hostile and aggressive towards us.  We then paid our bill up to that point and left.  I do not recommend that experience for anyone!

This place is AWFUL! service was the worst we have had in a very long time. The food, YUCK!! TERRIBLE. We ordered the lobster ravioli it was fishy, the lobster was wrapped in a piece of frozen dough that looked like a croissant it was doughy, really thick unpalatable. We also ordered the special  which was  bass, scallops in tomato pasta sauce. This dish was supposedly inspired by the chefs trip to Italy. Well, he missed the boat. The scallops were smaller than a dime, frozen the bass maybe 2 pieces frozen. Just TERRIBLE I do not know what this restaurant is thinking. It needs 
a lot of help. Starting with replacing the chef...

worst apartment complex ever. continually raise rent with no upgrades. paying high rent to live in a shit hole, maintenance is awful and doesn't respond to your problems with in a couple of days. have people knock at my door super late and my car broken into numerous times but security obviously picks there ass at night because i've contacted them and no response. i shouldn't be living scared in my home. hard credit score check which lowers your credit. laundry rooms disgusting with no a.c and machines constantly gross and leaking. so disappointed with this complex. please save ur time and don't move here. cant wait to leave!!!!

I love Tung Fong Market, my husband and I stop in as often as we can.   We live just up the road from it and thank goodness!  They have all the Coconut tea cookies, fresh pea chips, shrimp chips, seasoning packets and my favorite snack of seaweed chips!  We usually fill one to two hand carry carts of goodies before we force ourselves out of the store.  And the lady behind the counter is truly a nice lady.   The prices are incredibly low and everything we've tried has been fresh.   The products are authentic ethnic foods.

Imagine going in for a non routine eye issue, allergic reaction, the Dr. examines you and prescribed medication and tells you to come back in a week. You pay the co-pay and leave. Eyes get better, redness gone, but you go in anyway. Dr just looks at you and says it looks fine  waiting for him took longer than the re-evaluation. Surprise, that 5 minute re-eval cost is BILLED.  Unbelievable!  I really never paid attention to all the negative reviews, apparently they aren't exaggeration. So after over twenty years of Clarkson and all the referrals... my family and I won't be going back.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Love the concept!! Only reason there's not 5/5 stars is that many of the tables were a little dirty at the particular time we visited (granted, it was pretty late, so understandable, but still...) A couple of us also had a bit of a stomach ache after eating. Dairy of any kind is probably pretty difficult to have as a product, but then again, I still don't think it's ok to have that be an issue. Giving them the benefit of the doubt & hoping it was an anomaly. We ate here on a trip in mid-April and are now back in Nashville, but upon reflection decided maybe not this time.

Upon checking into the hotel everyone was nice and helpful, however we came back after dinner to a sweet 16 party that was literally making the floor to our hotel room vibrate from the music. This is in addition to the other party we had to listen to coming from down the hall of the second floor. So at 10 at night we asked the front desk for a solution and are still waiting in the hotel lobby 45 minutes later.  So if you want a good nights sleep without having to listen to bass all evening then stay somewhere else.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The Brandon Lakes team has taken extremely great care of my baby, Avi. They got me in quickly when I had concerns and became very familiar with him after he became a frequent flyer over the last week or so. Dr. Craver really took her time with me each and every visit as I tried to process everything that was going on and understand what we could do for him. Also so many amazing technicians called me and even sent me a photo always so polite and understanding while my heart was breaking. I truly thank all of you from the bottom of my heart. I know we'll see you again soon and I always feel like he is getting the best of care when he comes in.

Margaritas: per another reviewer, the normal margaritas were startlingly green. So, I ordered the "finest", which turned out to be a rather traditional margarita with a bit too much lime. Pretty good. 

Salsa: Bland. Tasted like canned tomatoes with diced onions thrown in. Looked that way too. I like my salsas with bright tomato taste, mild spiciness (as opposed to none), and a not-awful texture. 

Food: About the same as most other Mexican fare I've had in the Hermitage / Mt Juliet area.

Service: Normal. Acceptable.

Did an early dinner on a Saturday night before the crowd.  Ordered the linguine with clams.  I was surprised when my waiter asked me if I wanted that with Alfredo sauce.  Anyway the linguine with clams with the white wine sauce was phenomenal.  My wife got a seafood pasta which she also enjoyed.  Just overall surprised how the service seemed to the level of a local pizza shop not a nice Italian restaurant.  Maybe his girlfriend just broke up with him or something idk whatever I'll prob be back for the linguine.

Amazing staff!  Beautiful kid friendly pool,  water activities right behind pool area.   Booked here because of price but was disappointed by our room.  We are a family of 5 and had to switch hotels after 2 days because we were so uncomfortable.   We had 2 full size beds that really should only be for 1 person.   The pull out sofa mattress was probably 4 inches thick and you could feel every spring in it.   The mattresses on the beds were not much better.   You need to put 2 queen size beds if you say it sleeps 4.  Improve the beds and mattresses and this place would be 5 stars!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Tight would be an understatement.  Forget the reservation, it meant nothing.  We were pressed into the corner by the kitchen entrance against the bar and our group was collectively manhandled for 40 minutes as we waited for a table.  The wine list is light on quality choices, the menu straight forward, classic.  The food was fine, nothing exceptional though.  Everything we'd read about the place, we just wanted more.  Or something unique.  We got straight forward Italian food, over-priced wines, in a setting where you can feel the breath of the guy at the neighboring table on your neck all night.

Urban Cantina used to be one of my favorite spots in Downtown. Unfortunately, their food matched their service this time around. After drinking their water, munching on their chips and salsa, which now they charge for, and having a basic healthy meal, I felt like puking. Our waitress wouldn't know because she didn't check on us until we asked for our check. Not even 24 hours later, I was sick for two days straight. I regret to inform that I will not be going back, although, this place is great if you're on a cleanse and need to be cleaned out!

Hands down the laziest managers. Walked in the other day because I had a question about my lease.
