Both of the leasing people were helping people and another couple was just standing there waiting to be helped. I over heard the both managers in the office talking about her wedding plans. One of the managers finally got up and came outside the office but all she did was see if the other employees were busy, she then just looked at me and closed the door. I could still hear them talking about their wedding. Ended up waiting 25 minutes before someone ended up helping me. No thanks to the managers.

Excellent wine for very good prices.  However, staff is arrogant and not that interested in selling wine that is less than $24-$30.  I am new to buying wine and the salesman did not seem to  want to answer my questions even though there were no other customers in the store.  I bought a case of various wines and the salesman barely gave me eye-contact. I would definitely go back for the quality of the wines and the price, but would do research first on my own and know more about what I wanted when I walked in the store.

Koizi has a very good deal especially for those hungry expectant mothers! Although, call ahead for seating if you do not want to stare at other people finishing their meal while waiting for a table since they are constantly busy! 

The dancing krab roll is delightful! It is worth a try. 4 stars- for the service that the waiter gave us. He came to our table 2x the entire time we were there and had to constantly pop our heads to locate him. 

..but if you want endless hibachi/ sushi(?) this is the place to be!!!

Do not rent cars at this enterprise! I rent a lot of cars at other enterprise so I choice it. They likes to charge you twice and it's also happened on my friends. It's not coincidence. When this ridiculous mistake happened, their service are very bad. Finally I can just get help from local freindly and nice enterprise guys. The airport guy  insist they have no mistake. That's a "good" business. You earn much extra money and have no help for customers. Enterprise company should notice this situation that's bad influence for your loyalty customers.

This is the worst McD's franchise ever. It is close to where I live but now I drive several miles to a different store to avoid this one. I've done the drive thru at all different days of the week and random times, and they frequently have no decaf coffee! It's not that there isn't a fresh pot,  they say they are actually OUT OF COFFEE. Sometimes they don't have coke either. WTH, are those not McDonalds staples?  I have never experienced this at any of the other stores, and I get a cup almost every day.  Keep on driving to the next location...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I went there today and a really nice woman was giving me a pedicure another woman who worked there was telling  her to hurry up on me because they were busy. I then moved onto who I think was the owner for my nails and when she was sanding my nails she was rushing and burning me . She informed me I was a baby and probably should just get gel. I let her know I get my nails done all the time and they never hurt me. I asked her if she could please slow down.   Very rude!! I will never go there again to pay to be hurt. There are plenty of good salons in the area .

Stay was okay. The staff was great, the room was a bit noisy (someone nearby watching TV until 1am) but the most concerning part was a bedbug bite (I stayed on the 10th floor). If I could confirm they had taken care of the bugs, I'd consider staying again. I realize that bed-bugs are impossible to completely prevent since anyone can track them in. But they are incredibly frustrating to deal with and can be disaster if you unwittingly bring home. I'd try to confirm that this has been taken care of before booking a room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Eh this place was okay. The rooms seemed pretty clean and beds were comfortable. AC was not super cool or easy to use the patio was nice touch but to hot to use. The pool is a bigger pool then I have seen and great for kids but that is about it.  The morning as we were walking out the door to get breakfast two huge cockroaches were running right towards us and there were cockroaches everywhere in the hallways even in the parking lot. The breakfast wasn't much either, eggs were super watery. We ended up staying at the Marana La Quinta on our way home and had a much better experience even with the construction.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Truly terrible service and I hope that they retrain their staff. I called to place a carry out order and without hesitation the young girl who answered the phone said "no... we aren't taking orders". That's fine, but as soon as I started to ask a follow up question she instantly started talking to someone else and hung up the phone as I was mid-sentence. I don't expect perfection, but this was just a lack of common decency. I work in customer service and CLEARLY the staff here are in the wrong line of work. Disappointing.

Went here on Saturday at the recommendation of friends. It was Derby Day so there were a couple of big parties which seemed to tax the kitchen and wait staff. Thankfully we were not in any rush because the service was pretty slow. Once we got our food it was very good. My wife had the French dip and said it was excellent. I had a half rack of ribs and they were very good (lots of meat and fell off the bone).  We will definitely come here again and see if the service is more satisfying when there is not a big sporting event.

Very mixed feelings about this location. It is closest to my home so I go several times a week. Service is fast and usually friendly. I order a common drink with one simple adjustment. The teenagers there make it correct every single time and are very friendly. However, the manager almost never accommodates my request and makes the drink how it is listed on the menu. He is also always miserable, unlike his younger employees. I normally don't have time to go back so I just drink it but as a former restaurant manager it is embarrassing for your teenage employees to give exemplary service while management is preforming so poorly.

I'm lost on what I have to say but I can start by saying the GM Tim has some work to do his white shirts can't even do one spot in that store and I can't even tell you how many times I went through there and got my order wrong I waited 20 mins for two bacon cheeseburger meals with a 8 piece nugget and instead I was rung up for two bacon king single patty's but get this there was no bacon on the bacon kings amazing right!? Pls don't eat here if you want a Burger King experience the ones in tampa and Brandon are better managed.

We've eaten here twice. The first time was fine: decent food and service. The second time was an abomination due mainly to the horrible service!!  They were about one-third full and it took 30 minutes to get a shrimp tempura appetizer!  Even the wait staff was telling new arrivals that it would be 45 minutes before they could get food! I had difficulty even getting a refill of my green tea. So . . . I'm really torn as the two visits were so different. It is reasonably close to home but I guess I'd rather eat at Yoshimatsu or Sushi on Oracle given the wait time.

An honest, non-glorified review: They have good food at Sushi on Oracle. We've eaten there maybe 6 to 8 times and enjoy it. Our 9-year-old daughter loves it. We also like Yoshimatsu and it's sushi side, Sushimatsu. I lived in Santa Barbara 8 years, spent a lot of time in Japantown of SF, and I've eaten sushi breakfast at Tsukiji in Tokyo and many other delicacies in Japan so I have tasted great sushi and authentic Japanese food. Is this the best in Tucson?  It might be, but who can tell for sure without side-by-side comparison? What I can say is that I've always enjoyed it and plan on continuing to eat there. My family agrees!

10000/10. Everything we've ever ordered (and we've tried to go through the menu although we have our staples) is so delicious. We are obsessed with sushi and extremely picky and I refuse to order it from anywhere now but Asuka. Sushi is fresh and SO tasty (we always get spicy crab and shrimp tempera). Ramen is delicious and you get your option of broth. Hibachi is great too. They give you a lot of food and package it so well. I order from here weekly/biweekly and they continue to deliver the same quality. Love this place so much!!

Very impressed!  I ordered online for delivery and my food was delivered 15 minutes earlier than expected and was still very very hot. I am very impressed with the service and quality.

I ordered the Spinach Artichoke Mac and Cheese and added chicken. It looks and tastes like a dish you would order in an upscale restaurant, but it was only about $7! Plus, I ordered a spinach salad that had walnuts and cranberries for only $2.50.  You can't get any better than this. I would definitely recommend ordering from here, plus right now they have 10% off online orders.

Well Angelos lost a long time customer tonight.  I ordered a pizza burger and what I received when I picked it up was a chopped up burger with sauce, half melted big glob of cheese and a roll that was completely mush. They've increase their prices as expected due to Covid but what is unexpected is the quality has dropped and obviously the burger you get is so thin it falls apart when they cook it.  I complained and a second one was made, but it was just as bad as the first.  Both were thrown in the trash as it was just not edible.  On a positive note, The crinkle cut fries were okay.

We love George's!  Great for an intimate dinner for 2 or a larger group!  Recently hosted a graduation celebration in their banquet room and the team at George's made our celebration a memorable one!  Food was ready to be served right as the party started and tasted awesome!  Great suggestions for menu items that worked well for our group and foid was plentiful!  Our servers, Chelsea and Joel, kept drinks full and did a great job managing the room and treating all our guests well!  Selecting George's for our event was the best decision!

Nice gym to work out at.. Multiple equipment, clean, and a nice atmosphere. I pay $20 a month and get to bring guests, go to any planet fitness, tan, and use massage beds.. The staff at this planet fitness isn't always friendly though.. Half the time I'm there, when I leave no one says "have a nice day" or even a goodbye . There's always a ton of people on schedule it seems and they're so busy talking to each other where they don't welcome you or say anything to the customers. Planet fitness is supposed to be known as a judgment free zone yet it seems like the only people that judge are the ones that work there.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
The Holiday Inn Express can only be solidified by one word-Magnificent!
The Assistant Manager Marissa at the front desk needs to be promoted to the Owner of the Company, she is everything customer service is about. She is extremely helpful, Kind, patience and overall knowledgeable. 5 Stars for excellent service, when I visit Santa Barbara in the future The Holiday Inn Express will be my home. All other hotels reading this Take notes class is in session and Learn from the masters of the business

Holiday Inn Express forever!!!!

Paul Nitti
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Poor service.  Had to wait over an hour for room service. Room was dirty, extremely rude staff. Hotel smells bad...musty or almost like urine.  Slow elevators. Had to call 3 times to have the car brought around but couldn't get anyone to answer. Had to walk downstairs and then wait. I do not recommend this hotel especially if you are a preferred member. Worst Starwood property I've ever experienced.  Don't bother complaining to management.  They spend their time telling you whey you are wrong.  Its a 180 from other Starwood properties as far as how they treat their customers.  Too bad because the view was nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The worst rental car agency. This company is renting out cars that is 10+ years old with mechanical problems. Second day driving the car, the engine blew, leaving me stranded on the highway. I called Nifty, the owner literally cursed me out, and threatened to call the police on me if I didn't return his car. All the while I was still under the rental agreement. I even extended the rental for 2 extra days to figure out how to return the car, which by the way they did not offer any type of assistance. I was charged over $1000.00 for a 4 day rental, and had to hire a lawyer. SAVE YOUR TIME AND MONEY...RENT ELSEWHERE

Lovely restaurant -- great ambience, very tasteful, simple, and refined decor. Service was prompt and friendly but not overburdening so as to interrupt our conversation. Note that it is BYOB and cash only.

Food was expertly prepared and came out quickly. We enjoyed it all but were not blown away. Still an excellent place for a romantic dinner or to catch up with a good friend; not necessarily a culinary destination -- but that's okay. Wonderful, traditional but not stuffy, Italian in a great part of the city. Order the fried donuts for dessert!

Last weekend, I was in desperate need of an emergency color correction after an at-home box color fail. Aimee Kennedy took on the challenge when I called for a last-minute appointment . She took time to get familiar with my thick, long and course hair, looked at my before pics and my ideal color pic and worked miracles. A week later, The salon was extremely clean, all of the staff was friendly and I observed multiple talented stylists doing cool things to their clients' hair during the hours I was there. I'm really grateful to have stumbled upon this place-especially Aimee!

First 2 times I ate here I thought their Lil Mo burger with seasoned fries was delish.  A few months ago, I had a mediocre meal so thought it was an "off day.".  I ate there last week and it was horrible.  The seasoned fries tasted like they'd been cooked in fish stick grease, left out for 2 days and then microwaved.  Inedible, gross even.  The burger that day was not great either.  Only reason I gave it 2 stars is because it was so great when I tried it 6 months ago otherwise it deserves zero stars.  Will NOT be back -it was really awful.

Honestly, I don't know what the hype is about. My boyfriend and I ate here tonight and both of our meals were below Olive Garden quality. I got baked ziti which was not even baked. It was essentially watery sauce with half melted cheese microwaved with some pasta, a la high school cafeteria. And speaking of the pasta, they claim it is "freshly made" and it tastes like it's fresh from a box purchased at the Publix around the corner. It's not that the food is inedible, just that it's way overpriced and misrepresented.

Very nice atmosphere and a tad eclectic. The apps and entrees, that we had, were all very good. One of our diners found a small chip of bone in her burger and, when I pointed it out to the server, she told the manager and gave us free dessert - something I wasn't expecting. I would give it 5 stars but, where we were seated, near the kitchen, there's a lot of noise and only a partial partition so, sometimes we had to raise our voices to be heard.

The quality of the food was very good and the service was quick and impeccable. A very diverse and large menu. Since this was my first visit, I anticipating returning.

I was very nervous about staying at this hotel after the bad reviews. There is a burned building in front of the hotel as mentioned. However, the check in was quick, efficient and the lobby was nice. After getting to our floor and walking out, the hallway smelled awful! The room smelled better but is still lacking. There is barely any covers on the bed, and looks a little thrown together. We had no problem with the water but didn't have enough towels and washcloths for the three of us for one night. Not a bad place but not a great place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Older hotel with nice rooms, but i can hear the industrial toilet in the room above me flush and when people in the hallways close their doors, they rattle and you can hear people in the hallway very loud and clear as the doors aren't thick and there's a little gap under the door. Rooms have been redone but noisy to street as well even on 11th floor. Every time someone closes the door to the room my door rattles. A lot of water damage in the popcorn ceiling in hallways and in my room and bathroom, you can tell where it's been patched many times
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Dunkin' is usually one of my fav places to get coffee, but this morning was so disappointing! My husband had Dunkin' at the Lindbergh location for the first time in the past month and loved it. He was so excited to go back this morning but now says he'll never go back to Dunkin' again. His coffee tasted like it had spoiled milk in it. He ordered the same thing-a medium hot coffee with French vanilla and cream. It was disgusting. I ordered an iced coffee with almond milk, and it tasted like it was 99% almond milk. Very disappointing experience at this location today!

Overpriced, kind of pretentious, small portions, though decent tasting, but it was the bad service that prompted this review. The bus person was more attentive and helpful than our waiter. Waiter told us about 3/4 of the specials and then came back 5 min later with an uncooked steak to show us the last special. Then had to go put it back before taking our order.  Wasn't worth all that melodrama. The owner is nice as is the bus staff, but we won't be going back, which is sad since there are not many restaurants in town.

I'm PROVIDING MY FELLOW YELPERS WITH AN HONEST REVIEW. 
Besides the fact that the china family is uncommunicable, because of the lack of English, I was hung up on several times. When my order arrived, I was told that my card had declined and was demanded that I pay cash (which I didn't have). She continued to speak loudly in another language. Before leaving my work place with the food I had ordered, my coworkers food was thrown onto the counter. 
I used to order from this place all the time, but they'll never receive my services again.

Very poor experience.  I was promised a certain model via phone reservation.  Confirmed three times on phone.  When arrived they wouldn't even confirm they had one on the lot until I paid and walked out to check myself.  They didn't have one and the first car I tried had a dead battery.

Terrible customer service.  Avoid.

Contacted customer service and they offered me a one day free rental coupon.  That value is approximately 5 percent of my total cost from this visit.  They thought that was generous and offered nothing further.

I was expecting more from the food since seeing the high ratings.  The food was good,  not great.  The service was definitely not up to par, and we went during a slow time.  The server messed up our drink refills twice.  My husband ordered an extra side of rice-she brought out very runny refried beans instead. My son and my husband ordered chicken tacos- she brought out beef. And our table was full of dishes that should have been cleared. She didn't clear anything from our table until after we paid.  Very disappointed- I really wanted to like this place.

Third time I've eaten here since they changed over from Copabanana Northeast, and I'm impressed.  The hostess said that they improved the menu, but I scoffed at the time.  

After trying multiple dishes, I have to agree.  Cassavsa has much more than just burgers now.  My wife and I have tried 4 or 5 different entrees, and all have been excellent.  The burgers are still great, by the way.

The food price is right as well, and they have a great happy hour!  This is a neighborhood bar/restaurant for us, but we used to just come for the burgers.  We plan to come more often for the food as well.  Great upgrade!

I went to The Tire Pros to have a flat tire replaced. When they could not find the key to unlock my tires they started tearing through the trunk area and ultimately broke the hook that clamps my cargo net down.  Bad enough that they broke it, but they decided not to tell me it happened.  I found out the day after while cleaning grotesque oil/grease stains they left all over the inside of my car.  I still have not figured out how to get the stains out.  Do yourself a big favor and take your car somewhere else where they will respect your property and take responsibility for their mistakes.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I ordered the Sesame Chicken with Pork Fried Rice and two egg rolls...instead of one egg roll with choice of soup (dinner combo). The sauce the chicken was basted in tasted like it had a lot of tomato paste in it and it wasn't really that good at all. Definitely not what I expected and kinda threw the whole dish off. Egg roll was VERY mediocre and I wasn't all that excited to have the extra one I ordered in lieu of the soup. Overall the meal was underwhelming and certainly nothing worth writing home about. I may order again if I have a buzz and no where else to go! ‍

Service is good but the owner is cheap skate... Started to go there cause they offered me a military discount and you can earn points toward a free car wash. Well after going there the owner raised the rates but still gave me my military discount but now he wont let you earn points toward a free car wash cause I use a military discount...  What a cheapskate the owner is... So now my wife and I take all 3 cars to Pasadena Car Wash... Not to mention the word is out with my military buddies... Pasadena Car was is Awesome....

Beware of this store - they are masters at bait and switch. I bought 2 pairs of glasses under their $ 49.99 deal and paid extra for polycarbonate lenses and anti-glare coating for both. Both don't seem to have any coating. The salesperson claims one of them has a coating and that I paid for coating only on one of them. He says only the "premium" version of the coating will show the rainbow colors. My older pair from Vision Works I can clearly see the rainbow colors. The salesman was extremely rude. They sent me a text 4 days after my order saying the glasses were ready - but they were not. It took more than 2 weeks to get them finally.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I recently went in looking for a gym that both my wife and I could join. We had a few criteria we were looking for 1-clean 2-both weights and classes 3-helpful staff. When we arrived to Anytime Fitness we were greeted by the manager, Elaine, who is also the owner. She was extremely helpful and made both my wife and I feel very comfortable. We immediately knew this was the place for us. My wife decided to purchase a personal training package and fast forward a month , she has lost several pounds and inches ... we love our choice of joining Anytime Fitness in Luling and recommended it to everyone. David R
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This is the worst sushi restaurant so far we have seen. The menu they have is relatively small and lack of kitchen items so we only order sushi and rolls. 

They stuff tons of rice in everything and the rice tastes terrible. The rice is not well prepared and it feel like super sticky with no favor. 

The fish is not fresh and they cut it like paper thin. The sushi is like a mountain of super sticky rice with a paper thin layer of fish on top.

The only thing we satisfied is the server. She provides decent services honestly. Overall,we do not recommend this place to anyone because they dont show enough respect to food.

The 2 star rating is given because of the lack of listening skills on two occasions the hair dresser ignored what I requested and did what they decided. The low rating is also for the pressure the hair dressers place on customers to upsell them on hair styles that are complicated and require frequent trips back to the salon. The salon seems to prefer the "old lady" type hair style, and tries to encourage you to colour your hair. Even if you don't want to colour. The hair styles were drab, and only okay. Nothing exciting or cutting edge, only old stand bys are encouraged at this stale joint. Kick them off your list.

This place deserves zero stars and the health commission people needs to do a pop up inspection at this place.  Orders are consistently wrong, they never have what's on the menu, and they are rude when you ask them to fix the order.  I would love to see another restaurant or fast food place come in their place because these people do not deserve a job.  The night shift stinks and they are without manners.  I believe they do nasty illegal things to food back there.  I hope none of them ever need services such as hospital care, food, etc because karma is a bitch.  I wish they would closed down.  Keeping my money from this place.

I am new in town, heard about this place thru family. So if you don't like your salsa customized to your taste please go away. Save room for me and my family! They have a roaming salsa princess customizing salsa for the table, (tip her well, I think she has God's ear!) Next the food, Really good! Service was a bit light, but it was Friday night and new trainee, I have to cut a break here he was very pleasant & accommodating. Drinks are well poured & tasty. I will come back anytime. The menu is extensive, lots of seafood as well as the usual favs.

Itchy and dirty is all I have to say. Cousin got a free night here and now I see why. Disgusting!!! 

All the towels were dirty
Carpets had stains everywhere
Blankets had burn marks and food (rice) on it

Aunties room had blood stains all over the bed and she had to change rooms. Next room had dirt stains on the blankets. When we asked front desk for new blankets he didn't have any. Whaaaa!!!!? So we slept with no blankets and covered the pillows with our clothes. 

Omg not worth getting it for free! Never again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I can't say I'm too impressed with this place. The owners really need to spend some of their money on updating and cleaning. Even if they painted and cleaned it would make a big difference. Some of their booth seats have rips. I don't like the fact that their fortune cookies sit out in a large box and don't come in an individual wrapped packets. I never eat them. I don't feel like there selection of veggies and meats is huge. They do have a good selection of sauces. You always have to ask for rice instead of her asking if you would like a side of rice. I don't know of any other Mongolian restaurants in this area or I'd go there.

Third time we've been here with friends; but the LAST. each time there have been snaffoos. Twice w/ the computer to figure the bill. Been sitting here more than 30 min. waiting for the check. We smilingly suggested that a glass of house wine might keep us from becoming restless...but no offer. 
 Each visit at least two of the six entrees ordered by our party were not very tasty or served without key ingredients. Also, unusually long wait for the food has been the norm even when the restaurant is only partially full. 
We've since learned that part of our order was billed to our friends!!!
Bad!!!!

The service they provided was just fine, no complaints there. The issue I have is with one of the employees.  He didn't really explain any of the charges or prices of anything which was annoying. The main problem was how wildly unprofessional he was. While walking into the location he said to me "man it's f***ing hot out right?". While waiting the same guy was watching videos on his phone, leaned over the counter loud enough for me to hear from across the room. I wouldn't be opposed to going back, but hopefully that guy won't be there.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Food was excellent, but the service was awful! More than 30 minute between visits from waiter multiple times. All drinks, including water empty and couldn't get a refill. Empty plates on the table for long periods of time. After waiting more than 40 minutes for dessert and after complaining to the manager because the waiter was MIA again the dessert was sent out with no explanation or apology. Other tables were complaining about the service from the minute we arrived until we left. I would suggest ordering take-out and enjoying their awesome food without the hassle of bad service.

Overall this was a nice place to stay at. I arrived here in the early evening and the staff was very friendly and helpful. The hotel itself is very new and kept up well. The room was a good size and the beds were very comfortable. The breakfast was very good and the ladies serving it were also very friendly and helpful! Only complaint is the temperature in the room was VERY hard to control! I kept turning the A/C on and off and when it was off it was like a sauna, and when it was on it was like an icebox! But that was just a minor inconvenience, so overall this place was a very nice stopping point!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Curly-haired girls THIS is your place and CYRIL is your man. He is amazing! I have been a client of his for 3 years now, and I would not go anywhere else. He knows curls! And to top it off, he is an amazing colorist. I have checked out other salons in Center City, and after my long curls were butchered by a stylist (Joaquin) at Salon Thalia and another who gave me a blow out at Bubbles that left me looking like Simba from the Lion King....Cyril was my hair's rescuer. Not only can he style curly hair, he knows how to get it bone-straight! I HIGHLY recommend him!!

Disappointing service and high prices.
I've taken my pets here for a few years and I've never been happy with the diagnosis and treatments. They seem to be motivated by money and not the health of the pet. They continually prescribe medicine to treat my dogs symptoms instead of treating the actual problem. I know they make more money this way but my dog suffers. My other issue is that they are overpriced. They quoted me around $800 to spay my puppy. There are a lot of spay clinics that only charge around $150 for a spay.

Stayed here on 12/22/18 and checked out 12/24. Got home unpacked my suitcase and my brand new Victoria's Secret leggings were missing out of my suitcase. They were never unpacked due to I decided to wear a different outfit to the game. I called the manager of housekeeping and he stated that he would see if they were left in the room by accident. I told him impossible due to they were never unpacked!!! He said he would give me a call and the best he could do is allow me to file a complaint. Please beware!!!! This is something I was plan on wearing for Christmas!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The Enterprise Car Rental offices at Mill St, W 4th St and Moana Lane have gone above and beyond the call of duty!!  I needed 2 12-15 passenger vans for a National Event being held at the convention center. Our host hotel was the Peppermill. The staff at these offices corroborated to deliver the vans to the Peppermill for me and arranged to meet me in order to register my additional drivers saving me hours of work and lots of headache. Thanks to all of you for your superior customer service. You are my go-to car rental agency!

-Majority of the staff is friendly, always saying hi and bye.
-Clean
-Most of the people working out are nice

-There is this couple that always uses 2 of the squat racks and 2 of the benches for bench press. They then take 10 minute breaks between sets, which ends up being 45-60 minutes. Staff should do something as its very blatant
-Not enough benches for bench press, 2
-Not enough squat racks, 2
-There are some other people using machines or free weights not as intended, which I'd consider them being in the way
-Does get very crowded certain days, Monday for example
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Th food was amazing! 

The customer service during their lunch hours was only so-so. They seated the two of us back in the dark by the cash register despite there being plenty of seating towards the front of the restaurant. At one point the middle aged woman was walking by and her hand movement looked like she was throwing something on our table. Or she snapping her fingers at us. Finally when it came time to check out the same woman made me stand there not making eye contact and appeared much more concerned about something else going at the front of the store. I did not feel welcome. The food was amazing though.

Customer service has been consistently bad lately. I tell them at the start of my order that I'm getting two sandwiches but they only prepare one. As they finish making my first sandwich and proceed to ring me up I order the next sandwich which is met with rude body language and tone. I've even heard the employees complaining about this right in front of me despite having stated at the start of my order I was getting two sandwiches. This has happened multiple times and I can't ignore it anymore. I will not be returning to this location. I recommend seeking a different subway location.

Dr. Andrea is by far the best!! She treated our dog with congestive heart failure until the very end and was absolutely amazing with her (and with us). If I could only see her I would keep coming back. But, the new manager Missy is awful. This place has always been very disorganized, but I stayed because of the good prices. But when there is a simple miscommunication on their end and instead of an apology (which is all I really wanted in the first place), their manager was quick to call me a liar, say I was rude, and laugh at me when I stated that I was not. Completely unprofessional. I wish I could only go back for Dr. Andrea!!

I was going to rate AVIS higher but after the events of today they should feel lucky that I don't rate them lower. I needed to turn my car in early the next morning  however I was unable to locate what time they opened. I found the local number on my contract and called it almost 30 times. Not once did it go to the local number. I decided to drive to the location and get the info. I mentioned to the counter agent whom proceeded to tell me that it was a corporate thing and that thee was no one at a local level could assist me. I was told to call the customer service number. BTW the shuttle bus starts at 4 AM for the airport.

Normally, the food and service are very good.  However, this week a group of us went there for lunch.  We ordered peppers & eggs - $8.50 - waitress came out and said they didn't have the long rolls and only had hamburger type roll.  We said, fine.  OMG, the roll was not great, cheese was not melted - but put on the eggs and only a small portion of pepper & eggs.  Not happy campers....they should have also reduced the price of sandwich, since we got half the portion we would with the longer roll.  Also, the waitress was less than personable.  The previous waitress was fabulous...this waitress not half as good.

I've been using this vet practice for my dogs since the late nineties and though they are a bit pricy as mentioned, I always feel that my dogs have been given the best care possible.  We see Dr. Brett who will get down on his knees to talk to our dogs as if they were best friends- you can tell he loves animals. When they have their annual blood workup, some new testing may be suggested but we always have a choice and given an honest evaluation from the vet whether it is necessary or more of a peace of mind test, and I appreciate that we aren't taken advantage of. The staff is very friendly.  I wouldn't go anywhere else.

I'm from Belgium, and am always looking for specialty beers from my home country. Chimay, Westmalle, Bornem...I could not believe it, right there, with other fine brews! Beers brewed by Trappist monks according to century-old recipes...delicious!
The people are friendly and knowledgeable. 
Also, if you like a good sipping tequila, this is the place! They've got a guy named Jose who knows all about the agave spirit and can guide you through their remarkable collection. I learned that George Clooney has his own brand!
I highly recommend this place!

This place is a joke. Just let sears go out of business already. Came in for a three o clock appointment for a routine oil change and was quoted an hour and a half. Lol thats kind long for an oil change especially since its an appointment. Now that im sitting here its obvious why they quote you so long. The waiting room has a nice window to see your car in the garage and whos working on it. You also see the workers just standing around and playing on their phones. How about you guys get to work and touch my vehicle. One hour into this oil change and my car still not touched yet. Lol. Avoid this place at all costs.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: So I'm seeing folks complaining about understaffed etc. Seriously? This is really truly the best sushi in town and it's cheap cheap cheap at lunch and what do you expect? Enjoy your lunch. Talk to your family. Chill out. I've never been to a sushi place that was fast anyway. Never. Not even Sam in downtown Nashville back in the day. This is again I cannot overstate the best you're gonna get around here. And good by any standards. But this is super good and reasonable and the folks are kind and attentive. I can forgive the occasional understaffed moment for this kind of deal.

Always get food from here but during the day, everything is always good, never any problems. Tonight though we decided to get a cheesesteak and some cheese fries, the girl that answered had attitude and the food sucked. The fries werent fully cooked, there was like no cheese and barely any steak on the cheesesteak. On the plus side the delivery guy was nice. But it was very upsetting. You can tell a different person cooked the food and just did not put their heart in it. Its like they only have good food during the day.

I am completely and utterly impressed with the Planet Fitness Riverview location. I was greeted by incredibly friendly staff members. Carlos and Kevin really stood out. Both were extremely informative helpful and made my work out experience exceptional. Kevin was even kind enough to come over and help me during my workout session. Carlos was extremely professional and a great example for the other employees to follow.I so appreciate the cleanliness of the club, the mask enforcement and my overall experience. I highly recommend this club location
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Ok so, first off we get there and our waitress seats us asks if he needs a high chair for my little brother who's clearly 7 then asks us for our appetizers so we order then she comes back gives my little brother his edamame and he is sitting on his knees and the waitress grabbes him picks him up and says sit! put your legs down! After that we were just like ok then... then it took forever for us to get our food, we didn't get our waters refilled at all, we had multiple different waiters, and they just didn't have very good service all around. The food was pretty decent though.

I went to this car wash because the price seemed right. However I was disappointed when my car ended up getting scratched in multiple places from the washer. I suspect they don't clean their machine and as a result my car got scratched by debris stuck in the mops of the machine. I would recommend you avoid this place and either go to a touchless automatic car wash or a hand car wash. You get what you pay for. I was unable to contact the manager despite multiple requests. Bottom line the damage to your vehicle will be more expensive then if you just spend more on a proper car wash.

Very disappointed with this restaurant. We ordered through Waiter. We were missing a salad & there was a dead fly on my feta roll that I saw on the underside after I took a bite. I called the restaurant 2 different times over a 3 hour period to speak with the manager & was told that they were too busy to speak to me & that they have my number & will call me back when they have time. This is absolutely unacceptable! So 2 of us get no lunch & they don't even care. On a side note, Waiter was great & refunded the money for the 2 items!

If I could give ZERO STARS I would. Never ever take your car here. I made an appointment for 11am and had to be at work at 5pm and they close at 5pm so I saw no issue since I had an appointment but apparently that didn't matter. I was only getting a simple OIL CHANGE and it took 6 HOURS and was barely finished before they closed and I was late for work. There rude, stupid and money hounds. They also ruin my friends car while just working on his cabin filter and somehow his seat COULDN'T RECLINE and they almost CLOSED WITH HIS CAR THERE! he had also made an appointment for 11am.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: At a time when you are wanting people to vote you the best car wash, you might think about how your employees talk to their customers! I went through the wash and vacuumed and dried my vehicle for about 20 minutes. As I was leaving, I noticed a spot that I missed with the vacuum. So I turned around and returned to the vacuum. Then a young man walks up and tells me I need to pay for a wash. You might want to think about what to tell your people to say that isn't so confrontational. You're more convenient, but the other car wash isn't that much further.

This Starbucks makes the worst coffee in the area. And i love my starbucks so that has to tell you something. Cold brews brewed too long, giving it a bitter flavor. I only reason i ever come here is if something I want is sold out at a different Starbucks or because the line is always pretty short at this location. But I guess that makes sense it's their coffees not so great. Maybe your employees need a little extra training when it comes to making a more advanced coffee drink. But on the positive side, the employees are always friendly, store is very clean, and like I said Quick Service

I utilized Rob's roadside service for a tire change through Triple AAA. The representative of Rob's damaged my brand new car (3 months old), by placing the jack in the wrong place on my car so when he jacked the car up the weight couldn't hold and there was significant body damage. Shouldn't professionals know where to place the jack when changing a tire? To make matters worse, Rob's refused to take responsibility for their mistake.  I will never use or recommend Rob's service center for any automotive service. I found them to be unprofessional and dishonest. 
Michele Healey

This location has been horrible. I have been going to Viva at a different location my entire life and never had problems. Moved into this neighborhood about 9 years ago and still its been good up until the last few months and there has always been a problem.. Whether its the system down or fryer down or the staff being rude. I will not go back to this place. The attendant Vanessa told us she couldn't cook our food and ring it in later cause of change over! That should never stop you from serving anyone in a 24 hour restaurant. This is the 4th time not getting service in a row from this place management needs to step up!

We went for Valentine's Day. I've never been here before and was expecting really great food so I was excited. The restaurant is very small with a nice sized bar. We ordered a bottle of really good wine, the artichoke app. I ordered the gnocchi as my entree, it was mushy and cooked in a red sauce. I took most of it to go and ended up putting it down the disposal at home. My boyfriend ordered the rustic bolognese. He liked it. The tirimisu was very strange. Like a fruity creamy desert. Not tirimisu. The wine was great, the waiter was ok but I will not be going back.

Listen, this is one of my absolute favorite places for sushi for 9+ years. I am a Nashville local and have enjoyed this place since I've been in middle school. The host, Gin ( I believe that is his name ) , he is a younger looking boy was the worst host I have ever experienced. The older man with white hair is the best host, who I have seen for the longest time here and I don't know why he was not working. I genuinely just do not appreciate the irresponsible tendencies of the new hosts. I will obviously keep coming here when I come back in town, but the younger hosts have got to go!

Atmosphere was clean but a bit generic. Staff was friendly although a bit unusual for the style; waitress asked me if I wanted a cerveza in a Japanese restaurant? The real deal breaker was the food. The edamame was freezer burnt and dry. We had three different types of rolls and none of them were prepared well,l the rice wasn't sticky so nothing held together and crumbled in your chopsticks, the fish was not very fresh so everything tasted bad; almost inedible. 

If they stepped the cooking up the place would be okay.

Great new poboy shop in Algiers.  I had the oyster poboy dressed, my fave.  The oysters were cooked just right, not too crispy and not too soft, because they asked me how I wanted them cooked.  The bread is good but not Leidenheimer's I think.  My husband had the ham and cheese dressed.  He ended up removing the pickles since he said all he could taste was pickles.  The pickles did not over power my sandwich.  We'll definitely buy their sandwiches again.  We have not tried the burgers or NOLA specials but we will soon.

Stayed here over the weekend while attending a wedding in the local area. We had a king size room on the second floor and really enjoyed staying at this hotel. The room was very comfortable, clean and modern. The hotel staff were extremely friendly and willing to go above and beyond to make our stay special. The hotel is close to several restaurants, fast food and Kroger so we did not need to travel far to get breakfast or dinner. It is very close to I-65 and Nashville. I would stay here again if I have to travel here in the future.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Wow! If I could give 0 stars I would! What a horrible haircut. The owner of this place (Hispanic guy long black flow) sucks at cutting hair. First off he looks like he should be working in a salon, not a barbershop, I'm so pissed off at this man! He screwed up my part worse than I could have and he can't line up hair for SH*T. Take your money somewhere else because you will he left very disappointed. I'm curios if the owner has his beauty licenses to cut hair because I will sue. What a horrible experience. Never going back.

Only a 2 minute wait for the Alamo shuttle on the curb at Philadelphia airport which quickly took me to Alamo's counter to pay and pick up keys from courteous and friendly staff.  Only problem was:  I noticed after driving away that the gas tank in the car they provided was only a little over half full.  As soon as I noticed, I drove back to the counter where an attendant apologized and took the car to refill the tank, then brought it back and I was on my way.     So beware, check your tank before leaving the rental office.

If i could give this a zero, I would. I go to drive thru, get a coffee, go to pay for it, the Indian guy at the drive thru window hands me the coffee thru my car window and the top pops off spilling the hot coffee on me and the car. The jerk at the window tells me it's because of the paper lids. BS. It's because he didn't put the top on correctly. Never had that happen in 40 yrs of going to Dunkin and the idiot at the drive thru window is telling me lid popped off because it's paper. What a moron. Never going to that place again in my lifetime. F-ing idiot.

Good food, good  prices. Our server brought us chipotle shrimp tacos (we had ordered chipotle chicken) and then argued with us about four times that we had ordered shrimp tacos not chicken. She did write down shrimp, but it was because she heard it incorrectly. We don't like shrimp tacos, we would never have ordered them. 

Had she simply said "oops, let me get those out for you", I would give four stars. But it was the arguing and then condescending tone for the rest of our meal that puts me down to 2 stars.

When we arrived we were the only customers in the restaurant.  Waitress was on the phone taking an order and she dropped off menus to our table without saying anything.   Then a large family came in and she went to them with menus and took silverware and napkins to them and took their drink orders.   She was coming to our table but the phone rang and she took that call and went in the back to take two more phone orders.   We got up and left!   Terrible customer service, not enough staff and not good ambiance.  We will not be going back!

Needed a decent restaurant close to Woodbury and stumbled upon this gem. Small place that serves everything from special entrees all the way to pizza and sandwiches. Had the eggplant rollatini, which I get everywhere because it's my favorite and this did not disappoint. Was delicious with artichoke hearts and great sauce. Others had the seafood risotto, the lobster carbonara, and the crab and angel hair pasta, all equally delicious. Portions were large enough, but we saved room for the lava cake to share. Will make the trip to dine here again.

Añoche sábado 10 de Agosto del 2019 cene ahí 2 tacos de asada. Sabían demasiado salado y cuando los masticaba sentía tierra en los dientes. Claro que después de 2 mordidas los tire a la basura. Inmediatamente llegando a mi casa me empezó a doler el estómago y se me inflamó, me intoxique con esa carne vieja y seguramente recalentada de varios días.
Gracias a Dios tenía antibióticos y fue lo que me salvó de que la intoxicación fuera mucho peor!
Absténganse de ir a ese lugar insalubre y que te dan carne tóxica!!!

I was expecting a total disaster based on the reviews. I had already placed my order for delivery close to closing but they took my order and came within 10 - 12 mins. Very much appreciated since I've been in the bed all day with a bad back. The food was a little better than average. The shrimp fried rice was delicious. The sweet n sour chicken had a funny taste to it but wasn't over powering. Great portion size. I've seen the restaurant and it looks just alright. The construction makes it even worse but that's not their fault. I don't regret ordering and may order in the future.

My husband and I stayed here for our wedding anniversary.  It was just okay for the price.  The room was very small, nicely furnished, but small with a dated bathroom.  Although we didn't use it, the fitness room looked nice.  The kicker was the complimentary continental breakfast; it was a joke.  Barely anything there.  It was almost small and meager on purpose -- to make you go to the restaurant in the hotel and spend more money.  I guess I just expected something more impressive for the location and cost.  We won't stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place kicks so much haircut @$$ I drive 30 minutes from outside the city just to go there. The cuts are clean and contemporary. The barbers strike great conversation and are accommodating. 

They are busy, so it is important you try to be on time, or be prepared to reschedule if they can't squeeze you in. They are flexible but are not going to give you a rushed do. They only do quality work. Good people, great price, excellent style. There is a reason they are growing so quickly! They have certainly earned my repeat business.

Worst bartender I've ever encountered. I went with some work friends to this place on a Thursday night in the summer. The place was not crowded at all, despite this everyone had to wait at least 20 minutes to get a drink bc the bartender was on her phone texting. When I went back to get another drink I felt like I had to apologize when placing an order bc she seemed so frustrated with everyone. The only upside is that the outside space of the bar is really nice, but everyone agreed we'd never come back because getting a drink involved dealing with the hipster bar tender who sucks at her job. Terrible place.

We are staying one night in Philadelphia and chose Little Nonna's for some long-missed Italian (we live in Los Angeles where good Italian food is hard to find). Little Nonna's did not disappoint! The caesar salad with broccolini and polenta croutons was amazing - a meal unto its own. Tangy, warm, garlicky. I could eat a plate of polenta croutons. The spaghetti with meatballs was huge and the meatballs were incredible. Sauce and pasta were perfect. Wish we could stay one more night. Monday evening and lines were forming - reservations are a must.

We stopped here with a reservation at 730 on a Saturday. Our waitress told us later she had only been there a few days but she was not well trained to be alone yet.  We got bread three times, asked three times for utensils, had to inquire if our appetizers were ordered when we already had salads and then were served food that was mediocre in quality. We also had a third salad arrive with our meals.  I am not sure if it was bad service or bad kitchen preparation but overall with average food you need good service and good timing, and we unfortunately had neither    There are many better places to eat in the area

We had the best time there tonight. Food was great. Service was friendly. Outdoor set up is beautiful. He has the patty melt and I had the margarita flatbread and we had the fried pickle appetiser. If you're into food, the fried pickles had a well seasoned light breading that was delicious. I was unsure about the pork roll on the patty melt, but was pleasantly surprised. Definitely a good call. The margarita flatbread was a perfect ending. A little garlic, basil, tomato, mozzarella. Mmmmmm it was so good. I will be back soon.

I absolutely love this mcdonald's, i've been coming here since i was little but today kinda ruined that for me. The woman manager was very rude to the employees and wouldn't take our order like she was pretending to do something when she wasn't, the poor man being trained had no one training him at all. instead of the manager going over the order with him and making sure it was correct he gave us the wrong count of nuggets, we aren't complaining about it though because it's just nuggets. It's just the fact that she didn't care about his training at all.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Update: I got a bad stomachache a few hours later. 
Because of all the great reviews, we ordered from the lunch special menu. We got the three rolls (sweet potatoes, cucumber, and vegetable) and the pork katsu. The sweet potato roll was just fried sweet potato fries wrap in rice and seaweed. The cucumber roll tasted very sour go where I couldn't finish it. The vegetable roll was the only decent one and it was nothing special and bland. Pork Katsu tasted "expired" and the sauce it came with was sickly sweet. The sauce tasted like hoisin sauce mixed with apple cider vinegar but stale.

Visiting Philly from NYC, I picked the place at random & absent any glances at reviews. Was cautious before entering given the handful of customers for a sushi place, but it was a cold, rainy, Tuesday night, so I figured it was the weather & day of the week. SO GLAD I DECIDED TO GO IN.  I had a wonderful dinner & service, and partook of both sushi fare, as well as, a fabulous grilled sea bass special.  My company stuck with cooked items and was equally pleased. I don't get the bad reviews.....my criteria is far simpler. Would I go back?  Definitely.

This is used to be a great place to eat at but now the food is bad. Today I order, they messed up my order and there was a hair in my food. I had my daughter go pick up the order. When she came home the order was wrong, I called them. They said "Oh, you need to bring the food back for the cooks to check it and then they can add to it not replace it. She did not even say sorry. Oh, I did not understand really because I spoke Spanish. Not going back at all not very customer friendly. I do not know what happen to the customer service or food but I can cook better food.

This hotel is showing her age. Furniture is really worn out. Staff is sparse probably because of COVID-19. I didn't feel like  they cleaned very often the same sugar spill was there the next day. The poor bartender had to make drinks and the make food. My pizza was dripping oil and soaked the napkins. Rooftop pool was nice however I felt like I was on a cruise ship when people moved chairs around above us when in our room.  Thin walls I could hear next room talking.  This hotel wants to be nice but just not now.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Finally received our order an hour and a half after we placed the order. Btw, we were only 8 miles away. I called twice asking if the order was ever coming. It finally came and was the absolute cheapest looking and most generic food we've ever ordered. I honestly think they stopped at the Circle K and picked up the throw away food from the day shift. It looked like they battered feces and threw it in a deep fryer. Tasted very similar. Do yourself a favor and eat whatever you find in your sink drain from your hotel room, instead of ordering from this horrible "restaurant".

I ordered online. I placed my order at 6:29, didn't receive my order until 8:05. An hour and a half for delivery is excessive when I live less than 2 miles from the restaurant. I ordered the Mulberry special pizza, mild chicken wings, and garlic knots. Pizza was good and the wings were okay, but tops of garlic knots were black and the butter around them looked half melted or it had been sitting for awhile. The extra mild sauce we ordered had a chunk of something on the bottom and just tasted like oil. I was a little disappointed because of the decent review on yelp.

The hotel is Ok, but if you plan on having a car it's a big problem. First, the garage is detached from the hotel and with no elevator, so if you plan to go in and out it's a hassle. Second, it's packed with cars, you search forever for a spot. Third, the spots are extremely narrow! You may find impossible to park even a mid size sedan such as a Toyota camry because the spot is so narrow, and once you put the car in the spot you can't even open the door without denting the doors of the cars near you. Although the hotel is ok I won't use the Westshore again because using the garage is a frustrating experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I wrote before but it was removed. 
Went in for an oil change on my Ford which I have had done previously by other places one being the dealership that I bought from and another Brake Max. This Brake Max did a full synthetic oil change without asking me if that's what I wanted (which in the past was never done). It cost $93 for an oil change, never in my 44 years for driving have I paid that much for this service. It would've been nice if the manager would've asked me if that's what I wanted. His excuse was that "you need to take care of your car".
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The most DISGUSTING place EVER!!!! Where's the Immigration people??? More so Where's the health department???? You want diarrhea or the Hershey Squirts??? Eat this animal food!!! All the servers NO English... one said " I only get tips!!" Asians no paying them???? All the food ice cold... food on the floor.. bathrooms mold and BLOOD STAINS on the wall!!!!!! The food is not edible and if under 135 degrees is growing bacteria!!! And the cold food... even the watermelon was hot!! If ur a fat ... trailer trash... GO for it!!! It was the nasty most vile crap ever!!!!!!!!!

Waited fifteen minutes before someone poured us water and took our drink order.  After that, felt very rushed. Server did not describe specials or soup of the day.  Food was decent.  I ordered a seafood bisque (good, but a little salty) and a cheeseburger, medium rare (came out medium to medium well) on a yummy brioche bun.  Server did not offer dessert,  I had to ask for it. Ordered the creme brulee, which came with a huge mound of whipped cream on top with a sugar cookie. Overall, wasn't thrilled with the service or food,  but maybe it was just an off night.  Might possibly try again.

Had there Scottish salmon dish after attending a Bryan Ferry concert. Picked this place randomly late night and it turned out to be a great little place . There was some surfer looking dude singing hits songs through the years a must see in person for a good laugh. Food was good and the service was decent. Sat at the bar while having my meal and couldn't stop laughing at the live music karaoke style singer they had which the locals seemed to really love and enjoy. Overall a cool little place down town. Go Buffalo Bills!

Might be one of the worst Mexican restaurant experiences I have had.  Waiter knew nothing about the menu or the food items, multiple items were wrong, one plate seemed as it was a frozen item that was just dropped in a deep fryer. Found a few hairs in one dish (which I realize sometimes happens because we are all human and lose hairs, including our food preparers, but added to the rest of the experience, it just made it worse!) As a previous restaurant owner/manager... I can say this was bad. They did discount the meal, but whew.. It was rough.

This laundromat is clean, and most of the machines are functioning fine; the prices are also pretty comparable to the rest of the area.... However, the attendant decided my load of laundry was too big for the dryer I put it in and made me move it claiming that, "your clothes won't dry, probably." They would have. I've been doing laundry for 17 years, I think I'm capable of judging if a machine is too full. I was also harassed by a crack head the entire time I was here. Definitely won't be returning. What a horribly uncomfortable experience.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I have no idea why this place gets good reviews. There's construction all around making a non-stop racket, even on the weekend! Our room hadn't been fully serviced the night before - I ordered more coffees for the room and no one came to deliver them. There were holes in the pillowcases. I had to chase down a housekeeping cart to get toilet paper when I ran out while I was on the john!! There's no parking unless you pay $32 a night to use valet. And these are $300+ a night rooms! I'm a Westin customer but thought I'd try Marriott since I'm a Bonvoy Gold member - NEVER AGAIN!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Poor customer service ruined my shopping experience.  While going through the u-scan lane, 2 posted sales did not populate on the checkout computer.  The attendant who came to "help" must have been having a bad morning.  She gave my wife and I the third degree over sales they had posted less than 30 feet away.  At the point this employee became rude and combative, I walked away and went to my car.  Not worth losing my cool over $9.  I get that times are rough, and people are just trying to survive.  When your job is customer service, provide service to the customer.

Very disappointed in the delivery service - especially since it cost us $40. We had just checked into a holiday apartment that had their flyer on the door - so we thought why not! We rang to place an order for pizza, wings, and a salad at 5.11pm and it got delivered at 7pm. To make matters worse, the hot food was cold, and the salad was warm since it had been sitting on top of the hot food the entire time. This is potentially a food safety issue - clearly not stored correctly during delivery - good thing we have a microwave. Oh, and the pizza is ok... but pricey for what you get. And the Greek salad is definitely not worth $7.99.

We had a private room booked for about 20 people as we have done successfully for several years. All 20 of us arrived; they had our reservation but no rooms to offer "due to a mistake"; tried to crowd us into a room with 2 other large noisey private parties in progress where everyone would have been exceptionally crowded.  The front desk guy asked me if "we were all over 21"---our group is all in their 70's.
Huge disappointment, as we have enjoyed George's in prior years. We left and scrambled to find another place.

After having my alternator replaced about a month prior, it appeared to be going out on my drive home from work. I went straight to the closest garage I could find on Google Maps, and thankfully, it was Daniels Auto Repair. Mike Daniels took a quick look at the car, agreed it was likely the alternator, and graciously allowed me to leave my car parked in his lot overnight until a tow truck could arrive to tow it back to Phoenixville, where I'd had it replaced before. Throughout the whole thing, he was kind, gracious, and friendly--to someone who wasn't even a customer. I really, really appreciated his generosity and help.

Love the food and atmosphere.  Reason for the rating is that the management is extremely lacking.  We tried to call for reservations four times, requested a spot online only to be told when we arrived that there was no room and that we had a 45 minute wait.  I get that these are trying times but all I needed was to be told no dice before driving all the way down.  At least respond to calls/email!

Other than that is that they need to reel in the staff a bit.  Some of the conversations I have heard them having making fun of guests is a lil indicative of poor management.

Went here for dinner so we could get preferred seating for a Matt Andersen show at Tin Alley. I've never been to Serrano or Tin Alley before. The show was great, the food was not. Very small, almost tapas like portions that were full plate priced. Everything tasted fine but not outstanding. When you order roasted chicken with red quinoa and get barely more than a quarter chicken and two fork fulls of quinoa for $17.50, you just don't go back. There is a very good beer selection, but shouldn't be hungry after eating.

After an afternoon of shopping, I stopped by the bar to order a salad "to go". The bartender asked if I would be ordering a drink as well, I said no--just the salad. He told me he couldn't place my order unless I was drinking and was directed to the hostess stand.  I went to the hostess stand and asked if I could place my order, and sit in the bar while waiting but was directed to a bench. There were 2 people at the bar and I always tip 20% --even on "to go" orders so I'm not sure why you're considered less of a customer when ordering take out??

First time I went they kept my credit card, second time they gave me a caramel sundae and argued that it was hot fudge, 3rd time they were 'closed' (lights were on , intercom worked fine, during business hours) because it was raining outside. Give up on this place and not going back. Bummer bc I love the hot fudge cheesecake sundae. I know its just the area. The other belleville one sucks too. Out of ice cream, only takes cash (especially weird bc everywhere else is only card due to COVID) wouldn't be surprised if they were pocketing money.

So the late night Manager didn't want to take my order at 12:30 pm . I came to the drive through and he kept on saying he wasn't ready. I sat and waited and decided to to go the window. He said he will not take my order until I went to the window and said he will call the cops . So I pulled out my phone and Started to recording and he quickly started hiding and saying he was calling the cops . All I wanted was to order my favorite food instead I left cause someone gave me a threat on calling the cops . I hope you have the video to see our interaction

We had an experience at this establishment that I believe everybody should be aware of. Even though the restaurant was half full we still waited 10 minutes before our waiter arrived to get our appetizer order and drink order. After bringing our drinks we placed our main course order and waited even more time assuming the appetizer would follow shortly there after 15 more minutes went by and our main course showed up..... I asked the waiter where our appetizer was he said he must've forgotten but made sure that it wasn't on our bill. The main course was good but not bringing what we ordered left a bad taste in our mouths.

Went in for a manicure/pedicure at 6 pm. I told them I wanted a quick mani/pedi without massage, hot towels, etc. I needed to get in & out quick. I left at 8 pm!! Two hours!!! The technician was too busy flirting to get my nails done quickly! It was beyond inappropriate! They charged me for the full experience anyway-$80 for a mani/pedi before tip (which I should not have left)! Nothing relaxing about this place! The ladies at the front acted irritated that I didn't have an appointment & all of my questions were met with attitude!

Not sure what has happened to this place. Back in 2016-2019 I used to go here allll the time. I ordered the same thing all the time and it was good every single time. I would say over the past year or so, things have gone down hill food wise. The same dish I always ordered gets worse every time I order, which isn't very often anymore, once every few months. Today was the last straw. Pasta portions have gone down tremendously, but at the same price point $15+ for penne ala vodka. And the quality just isn't there anymore. It's disappointing.

This review is getting one star simply because there was no option for no stars. If you are looking for a stylist who will listen, RESPECT, and follow-through with your wishes, I'd suggest you do not allow Cheryl to touch your child's hair. She'll just do what she wants, then make rude comments about what you asked for. I asked to keep my baby's hair longer, and just trim, and she went ahead and cut off all his hair because "you don't want a mullet, do you?" Even when I protested that she was cutting it to long, zero respect. Thanks for the great memories from my baby's first haircut, Cheryl.

I'm a snow bird and selected Eclipse because it was easy to find. My first appointment was set with Cecilia.  Basically, I told her a few things that I like and don't like and let her take it from there.  I have been thrilled with the outcome.  It is more contemporary than I had before, but not "weird" and I think I look a bit younger.  She did something different with the hairline in back so I don't have to shave my neck and shaped it to make my wide face look less wide.  I would have given them a 5, but they only make appointments 2 weeks out so I can't set an automatically recurring appointment like other shops.

A long walk from the lobby to your room (2 different sets of elevators, and a football field length from one set to the other).  "King Accessible" room 2610 is very small, cannot fit a wheelchair between the tv stand and the bed to get to the window side of the room.  Bathroom has a tub, but no handheld shower head.  Chrome handrails in the tub are dangerous if you try to use them when wet.  The bathroom itself is roomy.  Decor is nice, staff is nice, but I wouldn't recommend this hotel if you are mobility impaired.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I just ordered there for the first, and probably last, time. I ordered a plain, cheese calzone. What they neglect to say on their website is that their calzones come with marinara sauce already inside them. While it's great to be different, warning people that you do something different than most is also a great idea. Especially for someone like myself who has an allergy to tomatoes and therefore has just wasted twelve dollars. When I called to comment, they offered me a few dollars in credit but failed to understand why there should be any kind of disclaimer. Great way to build customer relations.

If you like paying more for things simply because of the ambiance then this place is for you!  Why should I have to pay more simply so that I can think myself to be more righteous than I really am?

Personally I would rather shop at Whole Foods than Fresh Market.  Price wise they are about the same for some items, but at least I know that Whole Foods is more earth conscious in addition to having lots of specialty items.

If nothing else the staff is just better at Whole Foods.  I walked around for a good 45 mintues at Fresh Market and not one person stopped to ask if I needed help.  That just stinks.

Room was littered with dead roaches had strong odor of mildew. The motel (NOT A HOTEL) is dumpy and decadent, would be expensive at $59.95 per night. A cosmetic make-over did not help. We had booked via hotel.com, so much for them and their star ratings. Front desk staff were friendly and helped us cancel right away. They should change the name to Motel Hell. Tampa in general is a rip off. Hotels here in this town that has no beaches or decent parks and raunchy restaurants are more expensive than in Miami Beach. The beaches are in St Petersburg-Clearwater unless you want to swim with the creature from the black lagoon in Rankin.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Do not waste your money. We booked our room after we checked out their website.  The room and bathroom were so small, it was loud due to being in the alley of a restaurant, smelled like trash and had no air condition which its their policy not to tell guests when they are making reservations. They only tell guests what they do have and that we should have asked if there was air!! Those were the words of the GM.  Staff was rude and General Manager needs to take some classes in hospitality. We will never stay here again! They are dishonest and misleading about their rooms. Spend your money on another hotel!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We have spent so much money here. Their break room table is just outside our three week B&B. We have had dinner there; spending money. Politest guests as possible. Asked the chef politely to move the break table from under our window. He said he would take care of it. I offered to help.he did nothing.
Again the break table noise that we could not accept. I went over, saying that his chef lied. Nothing changed. He called me a "piece of shit.
When I asked who the owner is, he said "get the fuck away". 
Do not dine here
Will give across the street another chance.

Even if you call this place to make an appointment they will still keep you waiting. I had a pedicure once here and they do the minimal amount of work, it wasn't good at all. They love to nickel and dime you here, even if you are a long time customer. Only one technician knows how to do nails there, which is the most ridiculous thing I've ever seen in a salon. The one time I let another girl prep my nails, it was so painful and she pretty much butchered my nails. This is NOT a professional salon girls, go somewhere else first!!!

This is a very disreputable company.  I leased a brand new apartment from them and was told it was a nine month lease, but then when I went to sign it found out it was really a 10 month lease.  If you do not move in on the first of the month, then they round up the lease to the next month!  We had terrible maintenance problems, a mold infestation, aggressive dog breeds everywhere, fecal matter all over the property and completely unresponsive and rude management.  If it says "HSL Properties," run for the hills!

I pulled into this McDonald's at 10:20 to pick up an order for doordash and nobody had answered in the drive through, since it's a pickup, I just drove through to the next window. I called the store after 5 minutes of no acknowledgment. The lady told me they started closing at 10 this week and hadn't changed anything online, or through doordash yet, and they will not fulfill orders after 10, even though the app lets customers make an order... I just think it's very unprofessional to not change your hours before following through. Makes the driver look bad and customers unhappy.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
The worst attidude we ever had! Strongly rasisist! They treat african american and white people very nice, and yell to Chinese. Forced us to give tips while not imply it on the door and did not tell us that before we eat. And we found out they steal two dollars from our credit card after several days!!!!This is against law! Never go to this junky restuarant any more!
遇见过最差的态度！种族歧视！对待白人和黑人非常礼貌，对待中国人根本不理睬，从来不加水，餐具也不分发，服务员就在边上聊天嘻嘻哈哈，对待客人就是大喊大叫。强制给小费，如果不给就不让人走。但是在大门口根本没有标明强制，这是违反法律的！而且我们离开后还发现从我们卡里偷了两块钱！这样没有诚信的种族歧视的餐厅，以后我们绝对不会再来！！！

One of the best meals I've had in New Orleans...ever. The chef was fantastic and she stopped by the tables to greet her guests. The staff was charming and the decor is beautiful and lush even in its simplicity. (The Jason Horton painting was perfection) 
However, it is ALL ABOUT the food! The lobster curry app and the grilled octopus app were incredible. The radish, parsnip, and hazelnut salad was something totally new for me. For our mains: the potato & mushroom pierogi was killer as was the grilled snapper with white beans. Yummm! Lastly, the passion fruit creme Brûlée, and the chocolate pot was the best way to end the meal.

I really wanted to like this new place -- I loved both restaurants that used to be in the space -- but the quality of the food did not meet my expectations for such a celebrated chef. In particular, the gnudi was basically five small scoops of ricotta and they were COLD inside. For this, I paid $20. I have a tub of store-bought ricotta in my fridge and could have eaten some with a spoon for a similar dinner. Service was friendly, but I can't see me returning when there are so many restaurants in Nashville that blow me away, and this was just disappointing.

I was excited to try the Yellow Porch after hearing others sing it's praises. As I sat, eating my duck and drinking my wine, the wise words of Public Enemy popped in my head -- "don't believe the hype". 

The New York strip didn't have much flavor, crust, herbs, etc. it was just salty and didn't have any redeeming qualities. The duck was average at best, and the service was slow at times. The ambience, salad, and chocolate espresso martini were great.  

Overall, this The Yellow Porch is a decent place to eat, but it certainly wasn't worth the price on the check.

We booked on Expedia, so can't really comment about the hotels rates of it's own.  Hotel main areas were clean and staff was friendly. Breakfast was absolutely terrible...watery eggs, EXPIRED milk in cooler, hard biscuits, room temp (ish) cinnamon rolls (under warmer), breakfast attendant was not friendly at all!!
