It certainly wouldn't have hurt her to smile & speak to the guests!! Our room was dusty and wasn't the cleanest directly up against the baseboard areas. Light switch plate was removed from a wall and there was a softball size (ish) hole in the wall. No exhaust fan in the bathroom. Bed was comfy!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm giving three stars because my nails turned out great, but the experience was about a 1/2 star.  The shop just appeals as very unsanitary. No tools looked to be sanitizer or cleaned. They did not wipe down stations between customers. The tools are kept in altiod containers and when they painted my nails, they put the polish directly on top of the container and dipped into from there. The price was very uneven. They first told me 50, then 57, then 54. They didn't size check my nails, and it just was a very messy, unclean experience. The nail design turned out fine, but probably would not revisit unfortunately.

I scheduled a same-day appointment for 5p. I only waited for 10 minutes, which gave me time to choose my color and design. The owner, Quinn, is very sweet and caring. She took her time doing my acrylics and my spa pedicure. If I had an issue with anything, she fixed it right away. Saturday evening is a good time to go because they're not busy, so they can take their time. I witnessed every walk-in being helped within 10 minutes of wait time also. I recommend anyone to visit this salon, with an appointment or as a walk-in.

While staying in Philly last week, a friend recommended that my mother and I make reservations for this sushi bar, and we did. Our waitress was very nice and SO helpful and the food was the best I've ever had. Our Wasabi Lobster Roll was by far the best, (I'm not a big fan of anything really out there or of the fishy taste/ texture so I tend to stay more towards lobster and crab) surprisingly not spicy if you take off the small jalapeno pepper on top, despite having wasabi in the name, and after eating that I don't think I could ever go back to eating my plain old California Rolls.

This is classic authentic Italian restaurant. First of all, they have an interactive menu that describes each dish.. and the picture you see on the menu is exactly what your dish will look like. The veal is so tender and is so delicious. The staff is so friendly and inviting. We went back a second night because we so enjoyed our first meal.. this place did not disappoint, we had the meatballs, mussels in spicy tomato sauce and the sausage, beans and broccoli rabe.. each was so delicious ious we wanted to lick the plates clean..Italian cooking at its finest!!

We dined here and unfortunately we had a bad experience. The good first, the restaurant is cute and the hostess and waitress were friendly. The slaw salad was fresh and delicious.  The garlic bread was good. For our entrees we ordered spaghetti and meatballs thinking we couldn't go wrong. That was a huge mistake. The sauce was just awful super tangy and lacking flavor. The meatballs, overworked meat and burned on the outside. They were literally inedible. To charge $18 bucks a plate for boxed spaghetti and awful meatballs/sauce is crazy!!! How can u call yourself an Italian restaurant and not know how to make a meatball?

Since relocating to the Marigny, I've been averaging one trip a week. Their chewy, buttery, and flavor-packed garlic knots (yes to marinara sauce on the side!!) will keep Dracula away, and their Margherita pizza is consistently delicious, with beautiful leopard spotting on the bottom. Even their vegan pies are tasty! However, the dark horse menu item has to be the salads. Cannot stress this enough: order the Caesar. The sweet potato salad is seasonal, but when it's back, it's also a winner. Refreshing cocktails and decent beer menu, too. Bike delivery available locally, but it's better in person! Outdoor seating is dog friendly.

The worst hotel I've ever stayed in. The hotel looked smelled old, they hit you with a mandatory $26 a night for valet (no other parking available) and one of the valets caught an attitude when I didn't tip him. The room smelled of mold and mildew ( which made my wife sick). Did not offer any perks such as free Wi-Fi or free breakfast (breakfast buffet was expensive). Booked room for 3 nights, it was so bad we checked out after the second night, then they charged my credit card twice for the valet charge. If you ever go to Tampa, do not stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Whoever the door guy/bouncer was at this bar on the night of Nov. 7 is a homophobic *not allowed to use profanity but use your imagination.* My brother was visiting out of town and the bouncer told him, "We don't let fags in this bar." Really? They won't let them in, but I guess they let them work there...

Spend your money elsewhere. Let this place shut down since they are willing to hire people who turn away good people and customers based on personal, horrifying beliefs.

I will continue to post this on all their review pages. I'm still reeling days later.

I ate lunch at Little Tokyo on Veterans on December 09, 2016. I truly have to say the chicken teriyaki  bento box was one of the worst Japanese meals I have ever eaten in New Orleans. The chicken was tasteless and not tender, the fried rice was so bland I had trouble eating it and to make matters worst the California rolls were horrible and definitely not fresh. I will never go back to Little Tokyo again especially since the greater New Orleans area has so many wonderful Asian restaurants to choose from, however this place is certainly not one of them and the food here at  Little Tokyo is mediocre at best.

The volcano rolls are to die for! I crave it all the time! It is full of flavor and always hits the spot!! I have been here about 6 times total. Same watiress who is super nice! The steak teriyaki is delicious. I like it off the kids menu better because it's a smaller portion which leaves room for the other yummy stuff and they tend to present it neater. When I got the entree, the meat wasn't cut all the way and it was difficult for me to cut/chew. The house salad with ginger sauce is DELICIOUS!!!! It is so cheap..only 2 bucks and it is a decent side! I always get two orders!

This review is long over due. Last month I was dining with a friend of mine. The review is not about the food, which is nothing to rave about, it's bellow average. 
I heard the older lady, who is a manager, ordering a server to go and clean the bathroom, in the middle of the service. She got back after that, and carried on waiting tables, which I found disgusting and unhygienic. I wanted to find out if this is a normal practice, and inquired from one of the staff, who confirmed that cleaning of the bathrooms, during the shift is part of their job description. After learning this, I'll never come back and eat here again.

Let's start with this... if you don't like the smell of brown sugar candles DO NOT eat here. It was HORRIBLE... and now our hair and clothes reek of it. Completely unnecessary for a restaurant to smell like a fake sugar cookie. Ordered the chicken mudiga lunch special. Sauce was yummy. The pasta side is typically white or red, but I asked to have them mixed together. Well that was an extra $1.50... not exactly sure why, but I'm certain I'd not order it again. Pasta was extremely over cooked and neither sauce had flavor. I'm fairly sure we'll never go back (mostly because of the candle).

Used to come here all the time a few years ago but unfortunately a while back they decided to change the pizza to be extremely cheesy and it proved impossible to communicate that I didn't want gobs of cheese without getting no cheese at all.  Checking the recent reviews, lots of comments and pictures that show they are sticking with super cheesy. Used to be the only decent Chicago style thin crust in Tucson and you can see it in the older reviews - people complaining about square slices, complaining about the thin crust, and complaining not enough cheese.

My family and I came in for dinner. Two of them loved the place so I was excited to come in and see what the hype was about. I ordered the Alfredo a'la seafood, the sea food was well cooked besides a few legs left on the shrimp. The Alfredo was basic as basic could be. There was no seasoning in it at all. No garlic not even pepper, nothing to cut through the cream. The base they have down really well. Maybe they could add some flavour into the mix. Also the "garlic bread" was just greasy french bread, no garlic. I would order it again though. Good basic Alfredo just lacking more flavor.

Woke up on 8/30/2017 and found a bed bug on the second bed in my room.  The hotel verified the bed bug and heat treated my clothes.  I also requested they move me to a room at least 2 floors away however I can't sleep and I have to be here another two nights.  I'm still not comfortable going home.  Not sure if I'm going to just toss my luggage and clothes in the trash. Going to write their corporate headquarters to file an official complaint as the staff seemed unaffected by my report which tells me this is nothing new to them. I will never stay here again nor do I reccommend it to anyone.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This quaint Japanese fusion restaurant has limited hours of business but once you finally get the times down it's worth the price to sit down with friends and share a sushi platter and green tea that keeps coming. I hear the Sake does as well though we didn't have any during our lunch trip. The kareage was really good too and the yakitori was fresh and full of flavor. The staff was friendly and helpful with their recommendations and the restaurant had a certain ambiance that is traditional for family restaurants. I definitely go back for more.

Took me months to get a reservation -- but well worth the wait!  I've eaten at some of the best restaurants in NY, LA, SF and around the world and I can truly say that this made the top 10 meals I have ever had.  The chefs/staff are amazing -- well orchestrated 11 course meal and they still have time to chat with you to answer questions. Many fun dishes full of surprises and great with the cocktail/wine ($40) pairing.  And the 3 hours flew by -- a perfect evening. Not inexpensive but AMAZING value for the money. Wow!

Absolutely avoid this place! The owner is obnoxious, verbally abusive and  Impatient. I requested  a paper towel after the inside of my car got wet when I opened my window to pay him as a result of him pre-spraying it. This guy began to verbally attack me instead of just saying "sorry about that". Then he proceeded to project his personal mask issues on me (I was alone in my own car). Just HORRIBLE. I've frequented this place because of it's convenient location on my way to work for over 15 years. First time this has happened.Overpriced for bad service and car not completely cleaned to boot! They've lost a customer for life. Avoid.

Shout out to the staff at The Bistro in downtown Tarpon Springs! 
First time ever and we had a fabulous meal and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves last Saturday evening at the Bistro on Safford!  It was Wine Night, so the vibe was super energetic at our outside table.  Stacia was an informative and attentive server.  Dan, the owner, visited our table, too!  The Greek Cigars and Meatballs in Fig Glaze were out of this world yummy!  The dirty martini's did not disappoint!  Entrees were delish!  We will definitely be back!

While they have a decent variety of specialty pizzas, the quality of those pizzas differs from week to week. Take their taco topping pizza for example. One week it'll be perfect, firm crispy crust holding the ground beef, cheese, tomato, and lettuce topping without spilling. The next week the taco pizza would be so soggy that the toppings and juice mixed in fall and drip onto the paper plate and you're left with a slice of pizza with barely any taco toppings.  Another week you would have a taco pizza with what tastes like hot sauce or something near the crust, hard to tell.

Got here about 11:45 AM on 7-6-18. This is the third Rally's in a row that claims their shake machine is down. It's also the second of three that claims their grill is down. This location's excuse for the grill is "it's not ready, yet." So you've been open almost two hours and no one has bothered to turn on the grill? I'm lost. Still, too lazy to use and clean the shake machine. Get it together, Rally's. Your business model of letting franchises do whatever they want is unsustainable. I went to three locations today and got zero food because your locations obviously aren't ready to be open.

We decided to try it even though it is right next door to my favorite restaurant Apia's. But I am so glad we did. They had hot wings on the menu but we like garlic Parmesan wings and they jumped at the chance to make them. I love when I hear that instead of many restaurants that just sat "no substitution"! We had stuffed eggplant and a shrimp/sun dried tomatoes entrees served with so much pasta! Plates were enormous! We finished our wine in the garden and met and talked with the nicest people who were new to Gulfport. It was an excellent night out.

If I could give NO stars I would. I don't care what the hotel looks like...if the give away your husband's rooms he booked over a month ago because they "over-booked" they deserve a zero. His flight was delayed and didn't land until 1am. What a nice surprise when he had nowhere to sleep and was sent to a crappy replacement for the night. When his friend tried to check in the front desk guy was salty and unhelpful. Thanks for nothing, Marriott. I know I will never stay here...and will avoid Marriott hotels in the future if this is how you run your hotels!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The problem was that the coating for the glasses I bought was peeling off. I went in and asked if I could get the lens replaced--they said it would be better to get new glasses. I asked the representative to see if I could get an extra discount for doing so. I have never had a problem with photo-changing lenses before. The representative told me she would check it out with her supervisor and call me back. They never called me back; I am taking my business elsewhere.

For me, not returning business calls is a cardinal sin of business.

Truly disappointed.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: First of all, the restaurant was serving food off styrofoam plates. My girlfriend ordered 20 minutes after me and got her food before me. The manager came over and was slightly rude not apologizing but asking what she can do to solve the problem.  The server showed no concern with the fact that i did not receive any food for nearly an hour. talking to her friends at the table right next to my table.  I have eaten at Koizi many times and have never received such poor service from a server and a manager.  They were not busy at 7 o'clock on a Saturday night and i'm sure this is why.

Ms. Veterinarian is very cold and insensitive.  On 2 separate occasions I was unable to see (get an appointment )for my extremely I'll pet although I told the receptionist I felt it was an emergency  (my dog was passing alot of blood )they would not fit her in and was given an appointment for 3 days later, when I tryed to discuss this with the Dr. She defended the situation saying "I am just one person,  what can I  do?"
I would truly hope for much more along with some compassion.  The office has gone down hill and is anything but a "hospital "

Worst hotel experience ever and we didn't even sleep there! Owner was very friendly until we got in our room and it smelled of mold and cigarette smoke and my daughter went into an instant asthma attack. I used the bathroom and it wasn't clean, there was hair on the toilet paper as well. We had to leave and take my daughter to express care and could not stay but the owner refused to refund our money so we paid $275 for 10 minutes in a room and a trip to the ER!! Very disappointing- there are lots of other places for the same price. Try Best Western that's where we ended up!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: 12/30/2017...I went to the drive thru, and ordered an Egg McMuffin that was advertised as $2 on the menu.  I was charged a larger price at the window.  I questioned this price difference, and the girl told me that was because the sign on the drive thru was wrong.  They just hadn't gotten around to changing the menu.  She seemed very indifferent, and I was too tired to argue or ask for a manager.  They got my money with their false advertisement this time, but they lost a customer for life at this location.   Plenty of other McDonalds in the area to go to instead.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Was just looking for somewhere to eat on Bourbon Street and stumbled across this place. The staff was very friendly and respectful. Had three other people and the bill wasn't extremely expensive, but was a little on the pricey side. The food was definitely very good and had pretty big portions. I would rate 5 stars, but the bathroom wasn't that well kept. There was writing on the walls and the sink didn't look like something I'd want to wash my hands in. Other than that, it was a good experience and I would go back.

The restaurant opened with much fanfare, so naturally we had to sample it. It's a small place, staffed with very rude waiters and OK, overpriced food.

Even though many tables were empty, we were not seated. When asked, the hostess replied, oh the kitchen is backed up. Could we sit at the bar, we asked? No, she said.

So much for a warm welcome.

The couple behind us left by just witnessing this exchange.

Finally, we did get seated. The food was overpriced, and mediocre.

Go if you must, but be ready to be shown the cold shoulder by the owner and wait staff alike.

1. It's expensive for Mexican food
2. The beef/steak that comes in the burritos has a terrible taste to it. 
3. The ground beef is just the terrible tasting beef/steak mentioned above... Just cut up into smaller bits. 
4. The Caso dip I ordered was solid. It needed to be sent back to get heated up to eat. 

I really don't like adding a bad review for a place but this was the second time I went there and nothing had changed. There's a reason why they don't even get 4 stars. 

I'm sorry again for leaving this as a review, but I hope it helps you recognize your areas in need of improvement. God bless!

Highly disappointed in this location.   Asked for a bagel with veggie cream cheese, twice received with plain cream cheese.   Called to express my disappointment, spoke to the DM, she offered me a complimentary sandwich next time I was in.   Did that, came back asked for a plain bagel with veggie cream cheese and AGAIN plain cream cheese.   I'm not understanding what's so hard about this?  If you are out of the veggie cream cheese, please tell me, I will switch to an everything bagel.   Can you explain why this has happened 4 times now?

My fiance and I enjoyed our stay at Amber Tides.. 
We are simple people who love a home like environment. The owners we amazingly friendly and made everyone feel like home. 

We stayed in Room 4 it had a very comfortable king size bed, a 42inch tv with HDMI ports, in window air conditioner, ceiling fan, a full kitchenette, and a small bathroom with a tub.

The motel has 2 grills, 2 swimming pools and chairs that you can use for the beach. The property is covered in lush landscaping. 

It's about 15 min walk from pier 60 that area has most of the bars, shops and restaurants. 
 
We are definitely coming back here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Wish I could give negative stars. Pitiful excuse for a McDonald's. Waited 30 minutes in the drive thru at 5 o'clock on a Saturday and neither of the workers at the window even thought about apologizing and didn't even say a single word to me at that. I finally get my food and realize they forgot one of my burgers. So I go inside to address the situation and end up waiting another 15 minutes until someone finally helped me. Also let me say too that they were not busy either. The food was shit also. Worst experience I have ever had at a McDonald's.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We stayed here 5 nights. The breakfast they serve is a little inconvenient but I understand it is because of COVID-19. The hotel was very nice. They have a market, pool, laundry, and gym. The only flaw about this hotel is that we paid to have our room cleaned everyday. We got it cleaned once. We were very mad about that especially after they said we were for sure on the list. Another nice amenity was the shuttle to and from Madeira Beach, Madeira Beach Snack Shack, Treasure Island Snack Shack, and St. John's Pass. Overall pretty nice hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We ate there on a Saturday night, so naturally we had a reservation.  Unfortunately we still had to wait 45 minutes and they seated some waiting without a reservation before us.  Very disappointing.  Didn't start things off well.
The building is nice and nicely decorated.  Unfortunately its a noisy place, the floor is concrete and the noise just bounces off the walls.  All 4 people in our party mentioned it.  
The food was very good.  Even though its an Italian place we all had the steak and they were very good. 
Overall, its a nice place with good food, but I would have to put it in the average category.  Wasn't bad, wasn't great.

Back here for lunch today, after a long interval since last visit. Food and service still first rate, but need to fix the step inside the room to the left of the front door. Saw a man almost fall flat, as I myself almost did. When I brought this up to the host, he began a debate about said step with me, I promptly turned my back to him and left. So, either fix the step, or wait until someone takes a spill and you are sued, and speak to the host regarding the phrase" the customers always right", or just acquaint him with the words, yes, and ok!

I typically dread any auto car place only because it's not my area of expertise! 

However my experience today was completely different and I'm happy to say THIS WILL MY GO TO SERVICE PLACE! 

Jose customer service was amazing and I want to thank him for his patience as I asked multiple questions and took my time deciding on what I was going to do! He's very knowledgeable and informative! 

David did my service and for 4 tires and an alignment he had me in and out! He also took time to tell me exactly what he was doing and what would be best recommend for my car! 

Today was great! They were great! My overall experience was great!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Great place. We have been here for first time. Most of restaurants were closed as we were there about 10PM. Interior is interesting, colorful. I liked it. Food is tasty. Handmade pastas were awesome. We were party of 9 (with kids) and at the end Chef personally came and asked if everything is good and tasty. And bill was also affordable for us. Overall it was nice to be here and we glad that spent good time and ate tasty food. 
The only matter I'm giving 4 stars is, that there was only one server (she was really nice) and there were a lot of tables and she was trying to serve all of them.

The new freestanding building is architecturally pleasing. The location is very useful and was a smart and forward-looking move, but they are really struggling with the service. When I get to the window, they are almost always confused as to which order is mine. On three occasions I drove off after being given the wrong drink and on a couple of others they've forgotten entirely. Sometimes the drinks are great/normal sometimes they are very unbalanced. I know the store is new and they are likely working out the kinks, but it's taking way too long for such a large and organized company. 
Starbucks, this store needs your help.

Stole employees tip, hey guys if you come here and want to oder food then you have to eat it and pay for it, doesn't matter is it bad or not, cause if you dont pay for it the owner would call police on you. Now they automatic charge 20% for gratuity and it wouldn't go to waitress/waiter, it would go to the owner, doesn't matter you like the service or not. So goodluck for your visiting here. They would walk over y'all both customer and employees. So if you want to have some anger to yourself then welcome here. You dont need to listen to me, let get some practice and then see, hope i'm wrong and goodluck for that.

Today was our first time at crust. The service was wonderful and the food was very good. My favorite thing that we had was the cheesy garlic bread. It was wonderful and there was plenty to share with the whole table. We also tried the Parma and the bbq chicken pizza. Both were very good. They have to many options for unique pizzas and all of the ingredients are fresh. There are so many other things on the menu that I am eager to try such as a panini or the calzones. 

The only thing that I tonight was a little bizarre was that the pizzas only come in one size. However, 2 pizzas were perfect for feeding 3 people.

This place has very bad service. We had an appointment at 3 and they didn't take us until 3:20. I came with my mom and sister, they weren't happy. They started to take my mom at 3:25 and by then she didn't want to. They made my mom very upset. No one wants to see their mom upset. The people are rude. Don't come here unless you want to be in a bad mood. My sister was in the chair for 20 minutes before they took her. No mom deserves this and neither does anyone else. We saw another unhappy customer leave halfway because no one was tending to her for 15-20 minutes. Don't come here. Worst experience ever.

I was a little weary of going here after reading some not so nice reviews here on Yelp, but my mom really wanted to try it for her birthday. I have to say, I was very pleasantly surprised. I wasn't expecting much, but the food was fantastic. I had a spinach salad with dried cranberries and fried goat cheese, and my mom's salmon sandwich was awesome as well. The fries are perfectly seasoned and not too thin or too fat, like at a lot of other places. 
 The interior is tiny yet cozy, with a very laid back atmosphere. I would definitely go here again.

Evergreen is strictly a take-out place. You walk up to the bulletproof glass and place your order. The food is decent and ready pretty quickly. They happily only accept CASH.

I'd give them four stars but the last time we got Sweet and Sour Chicken and were very disappointed. I wish I took a picture: the dish was one box of heavily breaded chicken and one container of the typical sweet fluorescent red sauce. That's it. No vegetables, not even a sad looking piece of pineapple. Try Evergreen out but, try something else besides Sweet and Sour.

I had my tires replaced at Rosemont  Tire & Service. I later found out I had paid  at least 50% more than other places would have charged me. I also bought road Hazard for the tires which they did not honor when I had a flat a few months later and were extremely rude. They also had replaced part after part on my girlfriend's Honda Civic which never fixed her problem after her having spent all that money. They also had charged her for parts they never replaced. Please take your car somewhere else. The two guy behind the counter at Rosemont Tire are very dishonest and will be very rude if you have any problem with their repairs.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Absolutely the worse, went at 8:50PM and came to a locked door when the hours on the door clearly show 10PM closing. The Owner didn't even have the courtesy of explaining but just turned his back. No Customer Service and RUBBISH attitude. The full trays of donuts will probably be passed off as FRESH tomorrow morning.

Would much rather have a better owner or another Franchise take over this spot as this owner is downright HORRIBLE.

Update:
Contacted by DD and told to expect response from Franchisee within 48 hours, nothing more and now "ghosted" by Critian in the Customer Services team.

The Rot runs deep in this Company.

So disappointing.  I had pictures of the haircut I wanted and I had plenty of hair for the cut.
I now am sporting a bowl cut thanks to Cherice.  I showed her the pictures asked if she needed to reference pictures as she was cutting explained how my face is large to the last thing I needed was to be bald headed.  Nevertheless.  I have maybe 4 inches of hair and NO my hair does not even remotely looked like what I asked for.  If you can't do the cut just say so.  Because I will NEVER go there again and please if you know what you want DON'T trust them. Good Luck!

zero stars!!!!
Whitney the front desk girl is nice!
Amy the manager is useless....we had emergency issues with a contagious infection so we cancelled....refund refused! they want a doctors note from a 54 year old, like im 8 years old skipping school....
asked for Amy to call, she had a clueless underling call me back....still waiting for Amy to call me back....tick tock! probably never will.....warning to all readers! NEVER PREPAY! No more Holiday inns or Intercon's for us! they lost our business forever over 318 bucks!

Hotels.com is near to useless as well....but that will be another review!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I agree, this vet is way overpriced.
I was never unhappy, persay,  with the care I received, but was always shocked at the prices, even for a basic check up.  

I went there for about a year when we moved into the area because I did not know any better, but after I was quoted over $550 to get our second dog (a rescue) neutered -- which, of course, included a "mandatory" 2 day overnight and the boarding fees that this entailed -- I happily took my business and pets elsewhere.  

I guess if you live in the are and it is convenient, but there are many other area vets that provide excellent care without such a high price tag.

Generally I never have issues with Piada, but this evening was a first. I ordered my food via Piada website and was only going to take 20 minutes. When I arrived (on time) the lady said it wasn't ready (wasn't really apologetic for the inconvenience). Took another 5 minutes or so to complete and she just placed the bag on the To Go shelf. Never said anything about it being ready or again being apologetic. When I came home I noticed that both orders were wrong. I read the receipt again and what I placed via online was accurate but not the actual items. The food was fine just disappointed by the customer service.

If I could give them a zero I would. Their technology isn't up to par and their customer service is HORRIBLE. I work in the financial service industry and understand policies and procedures. But the fact they had to approve me in order to do a mobile deposit is ridiculous. Also the fact that they had to be involve in order for me to create a username and password for mobile app was ridiculous. I will never ever use them again for anything. I'm paying off my car loan as quickly as I can. I will also tell everyone I know to NEVER EVER use them. BEWARE and stay far far away from this bank.

Booked a reservation and we were seated as soon as we got there.  Service was good.  Each thing we ordered came out quickly.  We tried the sweet potato fries with molasses and powdered sugar which were good. Not the best sweet potato fries I've ever had but good.  We both ordered the fried chicken based on the positive reviews and the waitress' recommendation.  The entree portions were very large.  The two of us could've easily shared one fried chicken entree.  Both of us thought the fried chicken was just alright.  Not bad, not great.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR CLOTHES HERE. None of my items were properly cleaned or pressed AND several items of clothing were ruined (discolored, stretched, and permanently misshapen). The staff was rude and obnoxious (they told me I was a con artist, then suggested that I sue them). As opposed to taking your clothes here, you would be better off placing your clothes in a garbage bag, filling the garbage bag with mud, then driving over the bag with a vehicle several times. You could not possibly do worse than the Tip Top Cleaners on Clayton Rd.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Little Nona's is a cozy Italian restaurant with delicious food. I have been there twice in the past year and left both times feeling as though the wait staff are pretentious and unfriendly. I am usually immune to waiters' attitudes, but that is because most of my experiences are friendly and positive. This particular staff act in a way that is off-putting and almost annoyed when asked a question. It is unfortunate because I won't return due to the waitstaff's dismissive, albeit slightly cordial demeanor. There are Too many good Italian restaurants that understand it is more than just the food that creates a wonderful dining experience.

We have been customers for years and I looked forward to it every visit. Sad to say last Thursday will probably be our last trip in. The service was so unbelievably poor it defied imagination. Sat with empty glasses for almost the entirety of the meal. Bread arrived burnt. The timing of the food from the kitchen was terrible. You shouldn't wait that long for food, service, or anything and then have food come out in intervals. My main dish was the same as usual, but if the service is that poor I cannot justify giving my business to them again. It's too bad as they do have excellent food for the most part.

So so disappointed in Nino's. We have ordered from here at least once a week for years because of their outstanding chicken parm, marinara, chicken tenders and caesar dressing! Well, they recently changed their chicken tenders and they're awful now. Long Chicken McNuggets. Ew. And in our recent order, they seem to have changed their marinara! Oh no! I'm hoping we just got an off batch. And they sent me Ken's Caesar dressing. So so sad. I don't know if they are cost cutting or what, but PLEASE bring back your old chicken tenders at least!

Stayed 5 nights. Awesome location across from Conv. Ctr. Valet, Bell staff, front desk & Food & bev staff were all great. Excellent, courteous & prompt service. 
Room was well appointed but small. A/C worked great. HBO Go is included, Netflix avail for log in. Free WiFi for Bonvoy was decent. 
Only downfall was with housekeeping. Room wasn't cleaned until the evening on 2 days, 1 day I declined service because I was getting ready to go out for the evening, 1 day the room was cleaned during the day.
Would definitely recommend this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Couldn't recommend this place more. Not only was the service great, the food amazing, and the setting perfect; the cost was staggeringly inexpensive. We got away with an appetizer, drink, two entrees (with portions big enough that we took some home), and a desert for $27 before tip, wow! The ingredients in the food were clearly carefully chosen as everything tasted incredibly fresh. We will absolutely be back for more. Pro tip: if you have a smartphone, pay with the LevelUp app to get $3 off your first purchase and to get even more off after spending a certain amount.

The parking here is atrocious. I have a broken foot and because I get home late everyday, I have to park about a mile away from my front door. Parking on the weekends? Forget it! I never leave just to keep my spot.

The actual complex is alright. MOST workers are friendly, not. The unit we got was pretty clean when we moved in....just a few dirty spots, but nothing too filthy. They cleaned it up right away though.

Overall this place is alright if you need a place to live quickly, but forget about it if you have more than 1 vehicle.

Went here for the first time for a birthday celebration. The whole experience was fabulous. Our server was very pleasant and attentive. First she brought out bruschetta samples for the table. We then tried the Mozzarella Wheel of the day which was fabulous, stuffed with roasted pineapple and served with tomatoes, olives, arugula, and balsamic. The four of us each had different entrees which were some of the best food I have ever had! The chicken cordon blue special was the bomb!! Our server then surprised me a special dessert for my birthday! I really look forward to my next visit to this gem!

By far the best "fast food burger joint" in Boise and we have done them all. Seriously, once my boyfriend and I discovered them we haven't stopped going! Every single time is just like the last, their consistency is amazing. Always gives us our sauces, and literally never gotten an order wrong which I'm huge on. Friendly staff and quick service. On top of that, the food is delicious. A good old fashioned burger and fries with delicious fry sauce (it is .50, but the portion is huge). If someone asks where to get a quick burger I'm saying here!

The Riverloft and Aimco rental management company should be avoided at all costs.  The "community manager" is disrespectful and unpleasant in nature.  There is no communication when there is disruptive drilling from construction, foul smelling hallways from cat urine and dog feces, frequent false fire alarms going off at all hours of the day, and large annual price increases (do not get trapped by the incentives to get you into a lease).  I do not recommend this property as they only are attentive and service-oriented to potential new tenants and completely neglect their current tenants.

I received a response that was completely dishonest. They are mixing multiple service calls. We had no hot water for weeks. I have screenshots, and dated photos. The trash is picked up 5 nights a week and still there is litter everyone which brings the raccoons.  Before renting or falling victim to this crooked company, ask around the neighborhood, visit the pool on weekend nights. The office staff takes no responsibility and just make life miserable for the maintenance staff and residents. It's sad, could be a great place.

Ordered the chicken bowl today & was not a pleased customer.  Wait time was long, & the chicken had an unsavory sour taste to it.  The zucchini had an extremely fishy taste to it!  Without even seeing my food, the girl next to me in the room where I sat down to eat immediately commented that something smelled like salmon.  Considering that the ingredients boast being organic and sustainable or whatever, $8 was not a horrific price for these features...but organic/raw/local/humane or not, the food wasn't good.

Worst experience.... restaurant sent me fried chicken wings instead of the fried donuts I ordered and it wasn't grub hub delivery services mistake either. It was the restaurants mistake when packaging up my order. When I called to complain all they were  worried about was getting the fried chicken back and not delivering what I ordered. All the guy kept saying was he wanted to make sure I didn't have a problem with giving the driver the chicken back. Mind you at  first they asked me to  bring them the fried chicken.... unbelievable. I wouldn't even give them a star if it wasn't needed to post thiss

The food is good (loved the lobster bisque and the saffron linguini) but the problem was the service. There were minor problems throughout our meal, the two big ones was that our waiter didn't know which of the desserts doesn't contain raw egg and the fact that we found out they were cash only only when we got the check. There was an atm across the street but it wasn't working and they asked us to walk about 7 minutes for the next atm. There was no sign anywhere to prepare us for that. At the end, they did accept our credit card, but we left unhappy.

Overall this is a nice hotel and the prices are affordable. Issues I had were specific to me. Ice maker on 4th floor didn't work, spent 3 nights here and not once was my room cleaned. In fact the last night there I went to front desk to ask for more bath towels, I told the staff at front desk that I needed new towels because my room wasn't cleaned again and the staff never apologized or asked why. Breakfast was OK, first day the scrambled eggs were burnt, to the point the color of them were yellow and brown, how do you not notice that?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My husband and I walked into the restaurant at  5:40 pm on a Sunday and stood there in the entryway for a few minutes before we  were acknowledged and asked if we had a reservation, we said no so then we were offered to sit at the "bar" which was really a counter by the cash register by the door, we declined and were told we couldn't get seated without a reservation even when there were many empty tables, they didn't even offer to let us wait for anytime to get us in it was really awkward and we left there never to return again because no food is good enough to be treated like that.

The Manger at this Subway is extremely rude. I go to this subway all the time. He always has a attitude but has never been flat out rude until today. I asked him if he wanted to ring someone up for a bottle of water before he finished my so she didnt have to wait and he totally flipped out and told me not to tell him how to run his business. The other customer told him that she wished she didnt open the bottle because she would have left due to his rudeness. I would have told him to keep the the sandwich if I wasnt so hungry. Needless to say I will not be returning. I also plan to file a complaint.

I actually love this place- but they share a space with another restaurant and overall- the floors  are gross.  The bathroom is always gross and the overall cleanliness is disappointing. It's a brand new space which only makes me question standards elsewhere.  
The food has been great generally but I am celiac - I asked for a roll to be made without tempura and watched them make it with- usually no big deal- but my request to remake it was not warmly received.  ( kinda disappointing considering the price and that it's made to order) 
My feeling is- it's a brand new building.  Clean up your floors and bathrooms and I will always come back.

Probably the worst Double Tree we have ever stayed in. Trying to work this morning after getting in at 1 am. Hammering above our head and next door started about 7:30. Remodeling, although that wasn't mentioned when I spoke to them last nt to get the reservation, nothing is mentioned on web site. Who puts people next to and below construction?. Breakfast was stone cold, they comped the breakfast but should have offered discount for hotel room, she said she would but it wasn't on our statement upon ck out. Won't be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Honest and affordable mechanic. My '94 4Runner had been leaking coolant for about 4 months. My wife was driving the vehicle around on Sunday and experienced a sharp, sudden drop in power. I called around getting prices to fix the water pump and run diagnostics on the loss of power on Monday, dropped it off on Tuesday, and had the vehicle back on Wednesday.

Chris had great communication throughout the whole process, calling me with updates as he progressed through the repair. 

I generally try to do all of my own repairs, but will definitely be coming back in the future and recommend to anyone that needs repairs.

This Holiday Inn was one of the better ones that I have stayed at... It was clean, everyone who worked their was friendly and I was checked in really quickly (about 5 mins). It is about 2 mins from King of Prussia mall and good eats. I would suggest driving or taking a cab as there are no sidewalks and everything is highway. It is also literally right next door to a Hooters that you can walk to. I would definitely recommend as I stayed here for the Made in America 2-day music festival because everything in Center City was booked to capacity. It was about 20- 25 mins from downtown Philly. I didn't mind because I had my car.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Four of us dined, all with different dishes. I had the pork enchiladas (yucateca). The pork was very well seasoned. There was a green sauce which was tangy with a zip and was an excellent compliment to the pork.  For sides the Mexican slaw with a lime vinegarette and the grilled vegetables. That was squash, tomatoes, and onions grilled and then drizzled with crema or some other Mexican white cheese. Both were delicious and I would order again. All my friends loved their dishes too. The food was fresh, tasty and had a bit of a twist from the usual tex mex.

Rooms are ok, could be cleaned a little better ( hair in shower, on pillow, and on floor). Very good customer service!! Very nice people working the front desk! The pool is another issue, horrible, run down, and not for kids. The health club needs to revamp the pool or Marriott considering this is what they use. The lady at the front of the club yelled at my 7 year old with me standing in front of her because he was going to the window to look out and she said he's not aloud on the machines (he was going to the windows not the machines). Over all hotel is ok, but stay away from the pool.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: After visiting this restaurant a few times I can say with certainty it's nothing special. Appetizers and salads were really good, but for a pizza restaurant there pizzas didn't stand out. Also wasn't impressed by the service. Walked in at 5:00 for an early dinner and 9 tables were completely empty but we were told they were already reserved. Ended up sitting at the bar. Meanwhile, multiple of these tables stayed empty the entire duration of my visit. If you do end up going here you should know that a reservation is basically required.

Last month the carwash broke while I was inside.  My vehicle was trapped for 10 minutes.  The manager told me to bring back my receipt a wash.   When I returned, a new manager refused to honor the wash, saying it was "against company policy" and the old manger was fired for being a gun to the carwash. Yikes!    The new manager acted like I was trying to steal a wash, in my luxury vehicle, with my kid in the back.  He really offended me and permanently lost my business.  I highly encourage others to avoid this carwash.

Sadly the service and food quality have deteriorated over the years due poor management. The owner is so friendly and walks around making everyone feel welcome but unfortunately the managers don't have the same hospitality skills and clearly don't have a customers first mindset.  The handmade tortillas are still the highlight here but order them to pickup and enjoy elsewhere.  Also the prices on the online menus are incorrect and make sure to check your bill for overcharges. We won't be coming back after supporting the family business for 15+ years.

Visiting from NY found this gem on Yelp. We ate dinner there last night. Superb service and treatment. Our server, Tammy, was excellent and personable. We had Veal Parm and Capellini with oil and garlic ( off menu item) they were happy to cook it for my wife. Capellini is one of her favorites . Both meals served on large plates and large portions.  Veal was well pounded and soooo tender.  Capellini was not over seasoned. Prices were very fair and we give this Italian charm a five star. No complaints from us.

Some menu items excellent like the Bruschetta, Buratta......some are ok. I feel the menu is redundant. Very clean, people are attentive. My complaint...out of the last 4 times we have been there, on three visits one or the other of the owners have scolded, dressed down, or just been rude to their employees where the customers can hear the entire conversation or see the eye rolls. As a customer, this makes me feel very uncomfortable having to hear the conversation and then hear it again a bit later. I don't go out to dinner to hear this. Take it to the back office.

Since moving to Reno we have been enjoying trying different restaurants.  We found La Vecchia's food to be above average for Reno, fairly priced, and the setting /ambiance great.  The server  although very attentive, was inadequate.   I tried twice to understand the specials and ended up ordering one on a guess, not the server's  description . The server's native language was Spanish since he was from El Salvador. I tried to finesse the situation by going to the restroom in the hope that their would be  marquis describing the specials, there wasn't one.  I will try La Vecchia again but will be more selective regarding the server.

I wasn't impressed with this restaurant Buffet. They make you pay  as soon as you walk in and add the 15% tip. They make sure they get the tip out of you which is a shame because if the service was good I would pay more than what they charged me in a tip. Let it be up to me if I give a tip because if the service was lousy and yes it was they would've not got a tip out of me. The service was lousy and the bathrooms were so disgusting.  They did not have in my opinion a good variety of food plus they needed to refill the dishes because there was a lot of empty platters out there. The fruit looked old. I didn't really care for this place.

Arrived at this Ritter's 15 minutes before closing time. Waited in line for 30 minutes only to get to the ordering window and to be informed that they were now closed despite serving the person in front of me after 9.

Look, I get they close at 9.   But if you want to close up for the night, you need to get someone outside to let people know where the end of the line is.  I spent two years working in the ice cream business and always served anyone who made it through the door before closing time.

I've eaten at Ritter's they opened over a decade ago but won't be back.

It's located in the southwest terminal, fairly small island. The food choices are very limited, and mostly sports bar appetizer items. They were out of 2 items, which made it even more slim pickings, but did have the Club, which was a massive sandwich. We're talking maybe 4 inch clearance in height due to the huge chunks of ham and turkey. The meat to sandwich ratio was off, making it a not so great meal, but you definitely get your money's worth. As for the pizza stick things, they seemed like thin hot pockets, not my thing either. Did have a bunch of games playing though, and decent beer selection.

Stayed here prior to a cruise in February 2015.  Check-in was fast and professional.  The room was large and clean.  The hotel was located close to a major mall and a smaller mall with some good eating places.

The breakfast was outstanding with many selections.

They allowed me to park my car for 14 days as part of the snooze and cruise package.  The shuttle service to and from the port was just great.  The pick up was done by one phone call, and within 15 minutes we were picked up.  

We will be glad to stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I reached out to Fur De Lis to see about scheduling home euthanasia for my dog and found her to be extremely insensitive and rude. I understand text being a preferred mode of communication, but for a subject like this it was difficult to connect. Never once did she express any sympathy for the situation, and instead of truly trying to reassure me when I expressed how nervous I was about the whole process, she went on to tell she was a busy woman and to go read her reviews. 

Perhaps she's a good vet, but I would not recommend her for this particular service. She made an already incredibly difficult experience worse.

If you are a fan of Mexican food, it's an okay place to go. Food is really good! Super happy with food. Drinks are fine 
But they have to do something with customer service. Waited for super long to get a table. Had to wait for a load time to order food, wait ridiculously long time to actually get our food. Waitress wasn't able to answer some of out questions. Didn't have some desserts. And we had to wait long time to get out bill and we just went to the front to pay it. 
Overall, good food and drinks, not great at all customer service

After reading all the great reviews, both my husband and I were so disappointed in our pizza last night. We ordered half pepperoni, half sausage and mushroom. On first glance I was shocked to find that they used canned mushrooms, I can not stand canned mushrooms. I can get fresh at any chain restaurant. Once we started eating, the pizza was so soggy in the center you had no choice but to use a fork and knife. We live about 2 minutes away, so it was maybe sitting for no longer than 10 minutes. So much for convincing my husband that a local pizza place would be better than a chain.

I went there the other day to get a battery. I purchased online to pick up.  I have had problems bin the past with my reward points / money showing on my card.  Ordering online gives me a verification of points.  When I got there I was charged 20 more than what they are selling it for.   They would not do the adjustment.  I could return and repurchase for the 20 but I would loose the points money I used towards it?  That is erned money. Why should you loose it because they have to adj the price?   Redic.   Horrible customer service.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Just a little update, OH H*#@ NO! I tried again today for lunch since I was short on time. While I was waiting to place my order, one of the employees went to fill the ice bin portion of the drink machine and forgot to remove the lid which covers it. 
  Ice went all over the top of the machine as well as the floor. He then proceeds to dump the ice from the top of the machine into the bin. I asked him, "do you think that the top of that machine is clean?". He just mumbled incoherently. I would be very afraid to find out what other contamination is going on there. Never again!

Ceasar salad was so watered down I couldn't taste any dressing. The lettuce was chopped into tiny pieces. Odd for a non-chopped salad. Eggplant Parmesan was subpar; tomato paste sauce, flavorless, tough eggplant. The ridiculous amount of cheese tried to help, but just made it gooey. The waitress served our food, asked if it looked good & disappeared until she brought the check. I assume she knew my meal was unsatisfactory, since it was practically untouched. She didn't stop long enough for me to express my dissatisfaction. This place used to be SO great. What happened??? I won't be back.

This place is going through extensive renovation. But they are trying to maintain service quality during a tough period. I had a reservation issue where I had a printed confirmation wo a number. Dont know what system glich caused this but it resulted in no reservation when I arrived. I had to spend the night in another hotel at twice the rate. Then I had to rebook here at a much higher rate. When they reviewed my docs and was convinced I was truthful, they adjusted my rate to the discount and comped one night for the difference in what I paid for the first night. Service is a 5plus but the facility is a 3 during construction. This a 4 rating.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I had the same experience as previous posts. Eye doctor was decent but the staff / business side was an absolute joke. They were rude and had no clue what they were talking about. Told me my glasses would be ready in 1 week, didn't receive them for over 3 weeks. I called 4x to check on the status and the first thing said to me "if you didn't get a text or email they aren't in" until the next time i called (without receiving said text/email) and they had them ... picked them up the next day and no one was there to fit the glasses and not a single employee could have cared any less. Never coming back.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Alan Kirkfield is the best!  I've done business with Kirkfield's for 15 years. between my car, my daughter's and my business vehicles.  In different measures of calamity the cars always came back perfectly brand new and exactly when he told me he would have it ready.  If they are really swamped he might ask me to wait a day or two to bring it in, but he is always straightforward about the time it takes to get the job done right.  It's also really great that Kirkfield's is top on the list of State Farm and All State so it makes qualifying the cost quick & easy for me. This is your best bet, with an honest family owned business. First class.

The absolute best and smoothest experience of my life! I'm 19 years old and just recently moved into my beautiful 1b 1bath apartment with my boyfriend. Brandon (the property manager) made this process the easiest. We are in love with the complex and the apartment itself. It's maintained to the highest extent. Being so young moving into my own home was kind of intimidating and I know absolutely nothing about the process. But the staff at the leasing office made it a super easy and happy experience. I'm so happy we chose lansbrook village

I've tried Wrap's twice now and I can say with confidence that it is nothing special. The burritos are very bland. I tried adding jalapeños, hot sauce, etc. The grilled chicken had no taste. The pork was so salty I had to take it out of the burrito. Everything is completely flavorless. It is certainly not cheap ($8-$10 depending on what you get on the burrito). The only thing I can say is that it is a big portion. I just don't want a big portion of tasteless food. I'd settle for much smaller portions if the food was good and had some sort of seasoning.

Ya know, my wife and I been here a few times now, we like it, but can't get past the owner. Not a welcoming guy in the least at all, just sits at the bar and sneers and stares at you when you come in, never says a word, no Hi there, welcome... nothing, not even a smile.  I almost want to engage in a staring contest with him and ask, is that how you greet your costumers?  Nice!  This is very offensive to me.  If he wasn't the owner, I might expect to engage in an altercation.

(If it wasn't for him, we'd probably frequent more often.)

Anyway, if you can get past that, the food, service and decor are right on.

This place has multiple names it's called the Gibson cafe or Stage Cage. Either or this place is terrible. It is messy and seems to be ran by farm animals. The cheese burger is so dry and not flavored at all. It seems that they cook them and just leave them out under the warmer or they boil the patties. The place is a mess and the service of horrible. I was going to drop a $50 on alcohol because my flight is a few hours away but I never even got a drink menu!!! Take your money else where and go to Starbucks.

I think this hotel deserves 4 stars but I wouldn't stay there again. The primary issue is proximity to Amalie Arena. Streets are closed around the arena making it a pain to get back to the hotel whenever there is an event. 

Otherwise the hotel is lovely, right on the Riverwalk, easy walk to Sparkman Warf, and the streetcar to Ybor City. It's a very busy hotel but has ample staff. We liked the room, the amenities.

But there are lots of nice waterside hotels in Tampa, and the traffic and street closure issues   make it impossible to consider a return visit here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
5 people behind me got their drinks and I had to ask if the barista had my drink order- she non-chalantly says "yeah, it's over there"....hello?  If you know it's there why the hell aren't you preparing it?  I know it takes all kinds but you are in the service industry (SERVICE!).
Additionally, she prepares the worlds slowest Americano and proceeds to dump cream in it!  I tell her I wanted light room not cream and she looks at me confused not offering to make the drink correctly. I'm pretty sure this isn't the Starbucks standard.  Worst Starbucks experience to date.  Rude/ unprofessional staff.

Read the reviews, but we had a corporate rate and were pretty much expected to use it.  I was pleasantly surprised.  Large, comfortable room.  Clean and well maintained.  Staff was polite and the elevators were swift.  On the downside, the wifi costs $12, there was no refrigerator nor microwave in the room, and the restaurants were meh.  We parked next door for $14 a day because the hotel parking of $50 per day was excessive.  
It is very convenient to many areas of the city and I would certainly stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We had the most BIZARRE Cinco de Mayo at Laredo. It was as if they had no idea it was a thing. The customer service was HORRIBLE. It was as if the entire staff were "friends" the owner called last minute to come work (and they had no restaurant experience). Though they were super friendly, they acted surprised that 7 of us were wanting to eat there. We had to remind them every 15 minutes that we were still there. They were absolutely clueless and seemingly the rest of the patrons had a similar experience. The ONLY silver lining: the drinks and food were great. Super authentic. Will try one more time, but it was bizarre.

Paid extra for tire cleaning and you would have never known they were even touched let alone cleaned.  When I mentioned the tires they had a real attitude and still didn't hardly clean them and I'm not even that picky.  Also didn't seem like there was much organization or training.  Lot's of standing around and didn't appear there was much of a trained method of how they cleaned a car - unlike other car wash places I've been.  Would NEVER go back....don't need the attitude and lack of attempt to even do a half way acceptable job.

Came here with my wife. She ordered the fajitas which looked delicious. I ordered the taco sampler. The fish taco, carnitas and al pastor had tremendous flavor. The chicken and steak tacos weren't as good. We ordered margaritas which quite frankly had a strange taste to them. Not sure if it was just our drinks or if that is how they normally taste. We also had the fried ice cream which appeared to be wrapped in a type of cake. Normally when I have fried ice cream it is coated in corn flakes. But this was an interesting take on fried ice cream. It's worth trying. Good service and good food.

This place is awful. If you are fortunate enough to have any dealings with Damien you will know exactly why I think this place is so bad. I did not rent an apartment from them and I just received a "final bill" and threat to be sent to collections. I filled out an application for an apartment that had already been rented and they want $65.+ dollars from me! And now they want it to be sent to collections, WTF? This review wrote itself. They're behavior is unconscionable. I'm just sharing my actual story to prevent any one else from having to say... me too.

To start with, "Bland" is the word of the day here. 
Unfortunately the salad was a purée of dark red with a runny and flavorless consistency.
Chips were good and crisp but sparsely given.
Tortillas are supposed to be "home made" there. While they were hot and tasted fresh the exact consistency of each one (there was 12 of them at my table) was exact (size and thickness).
This leads me to believe they are store bought. 
Fajitas were flavorless BUT cooked perfectly.
While I really wanted to try and like a Mexican restaurant this one will not be revisited.

The staff was fast and efficient. But the restaurant itself was filthy. The serving counter and behind it need some heavy cleaning, the self serve soda area was dirty and dusty, it smelled sour, could be the tray or mat below machine. I used ladies restroom and that was beyond gross, floor was so greasy  in the restroom I almost fell. Sink, walks and door needs wiping down. Last but not least there were homeless/ transients  one sleeping on bench and others doing whatever. I guess their dollar menu is a cheap fee for full use like a hotel with amenities.

Horrible service! Waited over 45 minutes for a subpar pizza pie to be served to us, meanwhile people that sat down after us got there pies before us. The employees never gave us an update or even an apology as for the delay. Everyone that worked there was uninviting and didn't make us feel like our business was wanted. We did not want the royal treatment or expect something out of the ordinary. However if im spending money on food i expect for it to be at least be edible. Pizza at seven eleven is better. POC be ware of this place and spend your money where you are treated good, not judged by the color of your skin...

Pizza 1/10
Service -10000

I picked up 3 items there on Monday evening and ingredients are generally very good, but preparation and seasoning could be better. Several people recommended this place in another neighborhood forum and their prices looked excellent when I looked at the menu photos shared online, but when I arrived I found that prices were probably 25% to 30% higher for most items with some increases even greater. When I look at those menu photos now, they were uploaded at least 2 years ago and some 7 years ago. Lesson learned

Sweet Cece's is my favourite self-serve froyo place in Nashville.  They have a ton of ingredients, including nuts, candy, fruit, brownie squares, and even hot fudge.  The fruit is always fresh and the staff is extremely generous with froyo samples.  My favourite flavour is definitely cake batter, and the flavours always taste exactly like what they are named for. I had the apple pie kind there once and it tasted exactly like apple pie.  However, most of the ingredients and flavours are really sweet and sugary, so it might not be the best place for those without a sweet tooth.

When you walk into a restaurant you want to feel welcomed. If you are looking for mediocre food from a rude establishment this is your place. An example: when you are the only person in the restaurant and the television is on a foreign speaking station and you want to put the television on something you can understand  you are told by I believe the owner that the television is not for customers.  WOW.  It's facing the  dining room.  Who else could it be for. This restaurant is not for customers and that is why it might be empty.

We ordered online and it says 20-40 mins. That is fine but when we got there, I think they forgot or didn't receive our online order. We waited for another 30 mins before picking up our food. 
we ordered shrimp taco deluxe- 3 shrimp tacos are delicious. I will order again. Delux- I guess means refried bean and rice. They are nothing memorable. I won't do it. My husband got pollo a la parrillan - it could have been spice a little better but the chicken is juicy and tender just need a bit more spice. we  also ordered Flautas- bland and tamales-dry and we won't get them again.

Joe is awesome. My control arm snapped, and my axle fell and I got my car towed to Joe's auto electric. They were very quick to look at my car and give me an update. Joe was very understanding over the phone and answered all of my questions and let me know all of my options. He also looked over the rest of my car to give me peace of mind. They were priced very reasonably and did all they could to make sure I didn't pay for anything I didn't need. I got my car back within 2 days! Highly recommend and I will go back to them for years to come.

I had the pork ramen, the de la vina roll, and Santa Barbara roll. The ramen just tasted like ginger, The de la vina roll had too much sauce so it overpowered whatever flavor it was supposed to pack, and the Santa Barbara roll was decent. Overall, not worth the price on the ramen as it was mostly flavorless and packed with ginger. The rolls are definitely not worth the price as they are just big and filled with sauce and rice. Maybe I am just used to eating Asian food in LA, but I am definitely 100% sure that the prices in sb for Asian foods are generally not worth for what they are. How disappointing. The service was great though :)

Last Saturday night I stopped into Burger King for the first time in along while...now I know why...
ordered up 2 whoppers for $6 , fries, and a drink. When I got home to sit down and eat, the burgers were cold (not temped out like they should have been ..I believe around 165). the fries just as bad...lucky for me the drink was cold.  My helper was Denise I believe she should have known what she was serving  ( that means hot food or not).  After this experience once again I don't believe I will stop in again for NEVER...it is disgusting...

I came across this place and given that it was around 8am not too many options were available. I tried a breakfast sandwich, a bite of the asada burrito and a tostada de ceviche which I ate later that day. The best one was the breakfast sandwich, I know right, weird!! When do you prefer a breakfast sandwich over a burrito, well unfortunately that's how it went down. The asada was not tasty, it lacked flavor, however I've had worst. The tostada was just that, nothing special. Not a place I'd brag about but if you're like me that gets hungry early and have limited options then I'd try it out. Again, not the best nor the worst.

1/5 would not recommend. Legit took 5 minutes to just have someone to talk to (we sat at the drive thru microphone thingy for 5 minutes) just to be asked to wait longer. Then they were out of regular Coke. I've worked in the service industry, how do you run out of regular coke? Then we get up to pay, their machine goes down. At this point we've waited about 30 minutes with ONE car in front of us. 

Don't go here, go out of your way and go to the one at old state and Manchester, never had a bad experience there. Always have a bad experience here.

Would give zero if possible. 

Beware if you have allergies. Someone neglected my request for almond milk, and I ended up spending 6+ hours in the hospital. I had an allergic reaction due to someone's negligence. 

With all that, I still haven't gotten word back from the franchise, after corporate told me that they were going to get back to me within 24-48 hours. This happened on Friday (2/28) so it is well over that time period. 

Corporate and the franchise have both been very very irresponsible when handling this situation. My life was put at risk, and now I am (literally) paying for it. 

Don't go here!!!

Time and time again this restaurant has messed up our takeout order. They've missed multiple items in one order, and have given the wrong wings and messed up ingredients to be included on pizza/sandwiches/sides multiple times. Do not ever order takeout from here - it is a waste of your money and you will not get what you order. Food is decent quality, but only if you actually get what you order (which doesn't happen!!!). It's unfortunate to have to painstakingly go through each item in detail, and even worse when you get it delivered and it's too late.

Just moved to Edmonton and this was my first haircut. Had Alex cut my hair. Asked for a basic fade. I'll concede that my old barber just knew what to do with my hair and I had no idea what he truly did or how to articulate it to someone else, but Alex just took clippers around my head horizontally with no guards on and completely butchered my hair. he paid zero attention to the part. it didn't look bad at first but when I got home I noticed stray hairs everywhere and he had basically undone my entire style in a rush to get to the customers waiting in line. would not recommend.

Been going to this one for about a year. Even though it's brand new it's always dirty. Several machines have been broken for months even after telling the front desk. You'll only find about a few people wearing a mask and the staff just sits at the front. When I worked at a gym I was always cleaning. It's hard to keep up with the grime with so much traffic but these people don't care. I'd come to the gym more often if I felt more comfortable. Actively looking for a new gym. Two stars for the gym app that lets you know how many (maskless) people are there to avoid peak times.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I've been looking for a barber that I could trust since moving to Reno in June.  After finding this place through Yelp I decided to give it a try.  This turned out to be someone that gives a great haircut and someone I can trust to trim up my beard.

Pat was the one who cut my hair, but based on the cut I saw another guy receive while I was in there I would trust any of them to cut my hair.  This was the first time I had someone use a straight razor and it was great.  A true classic barber that is hard to find in this day and age.

Will definitely be back for my next cut!

I shop here regularly, in large part because I can generally get in and out in just a few minutes and still manage to get everything that I need.  It is much less of a hassle than other grocery stores at comparable times. With the rewards card, this is a convenient location with a reasonably large selection that won't break your wallet. 

I used to think the service here was superior to other grocery stores, but in the past several months it seems to have taken a hit, as has their produce section. It's a noticeable enough change that it prompted me to wonder if they are under new management. Perhaps they are working out some kinks.

I've previously had a couple of vehicles repaired here (minor hit and run damage), and service here was 5 star! This time, not so much! I recently took my current vehicle here for an estimate for front bumper repairs, and after slightly more than one week, my insurance company finally received Modern's estimate. A week has since passed, and still no call from Modern regarding an appointment for repairs. I highly suspect this place is under new management, since service has certainly deteriorated over my past experiences!

Not for tourists! I wanted to like this bar, looked like a nice quiet hangout, loads of beer options, pool tables, BUT a very rude, ignorant bartender. If you're a tourist, just don't bother. I went in with my 60 odd year old father and they wouldn't serve him as he only had a UK driving licence. They quoted ABC laws, there is no mandatory carding in bars in TN, only for sales off the premises, if it's an internal policy fine, just don't quote the law! In over 2 years here with just a UK License before I got a local one I was never refused anywhere and I'm 30 not 60

DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME GOING TO TOTAL BODY FITNESS!!!  The parking is atrocious!  They're actually asking you to park down the street and walk up because they don't have enough parking.  Then you often have to wait for a piece of equipment to use.  The bathrooms are dirty and not well equipped with products.  The equipment is rusty and dirty.  The weight room stinks - I don't think it's ever cleaned.  The owner Bob is definitely only interested in making money and doesn't care what his members have to put up with.  He's selling more memberships than he can accommodate.  It's much too crowded.  What a dump!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
We stayed at the Hotel years ago when it was the Wyndham. It was fine back then. This time as the Sheraton we were quite upset with the room. The bathroom had hair in the tub and on the toilet seat from the last guest. The room had 2 beds. The first bed had a large stain on the sheet. Upon pulling the sheet down on the second bed, an insect was crawling on the sheet. Very disturbing to say the least. Serious issues with housekeeping!
  All the Sheraton would do for us is offer a free breakfast and/or free parking. We didn't except either and just asked that the manager would be notified.
 "Will NEVER stay there again!"
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It's not the Enterprise it once was.  I have three issues: 1) the car I rented smelled like an ashtray. When I rented I was admonished not to smoke in the car. Fine. I don't smoke. After my rental all my clothes needed a wash and dry clean. 2). They have short hours. Fine. But no drop box for keys?  If you return you're car at, say, 6:30pm you will be charged a full add'l day. 3) returning the car upon opening the next day is not an acceptable alternative to short hours and no key box. C'mon Enterprises...you've lost that lovin' feeling. Hello Avis.

Their food is good and service has been good every time I've been. I've made sure to support them while dining out has opened up by coming by to eat. Which is why I was disappointed to be turned away at their door being told "we're closed" 50 minutes before their door or their hours on Yelp are displayed. I couldn't find anything outside their restaurant that said they were closed early and the place had the garage doors open and it was full of people. Didn't look closed at all. So if they don't want my family's business, I won't be back.

Pros: pizza crust is probably the best I've had...thin and crispy with a little chewiness.  Just the right amount of cheese but wish there would have been more sauce. It tasted a little on the dry side. 
Staff was very friendly and place was clean. We had just arrived when they opened the garage door or large security roll down which protects their storefront. We weren't sure we were at the right location until the door rolled up and we saw the Pizza Delicious sign...we got a laugh from that.

Cons: no off street parking, but that is typical in the city. Some of their tables and chairs are wobbly.

LIVE MOUSE NEXT TO TABLE.  It won't allow a 0. Waited to be seated for 3 or 4 minutes by desk person. They were not busy. Seated at STICKY table. Cordial waiter brought water and menus.  He came back to take our order and MOUSE falls off his pants into middle  of aisle. Multiple people eating see it. He goes to kitchen, gets broom and dustpan.  Scoops up very alive mouse and returns to kitchen. We exited. Had not been here in 5+ years and had hoped to enjoy Chinese New Year. Used to eat here often. TOTALLY GROSSED OUT.  Won't be back.

The rudest service and so uncalled for. The woman serving the window drive thru tried to take my sister's ID .. claiming it was a fake ID because we were from out of town. Didn't believe it was real and told us to call the cops. When we tried to call the cops, she then threw the ID at my sister and told us to leave. We have always came here and to be treated like this was absurd. We never were aloud to order a daiquiri and had to go somewhere else for a daiquiri which is fine, because we will no longer support this business.
