Vic sushi is a great sushi place in Philly. It's small, about 15 seats but the size does not diminish its quality. The sushi is always impeccable and the lunch combo special is a really good deal. They have a wide array of sushi from the classic hand rolls to their own special rolls. 

The ambience is casual and they do takeout. They are quite fast and would be a perfect place to grab a quick lunch. I would also recommended their miso soup.

I've been here many times and the quality has always been consistent. Would definitely recommended to anyone around the area to try out their sushi!

In a word...TERRIBLE. Not only are we still waiting for a room at 4:05pm after asking for early check in, we have now missed all of our planned events. We booked through Expedia, and they are just at fault as the hotel. The hotel explained that early check in is not guaranteed, but I guess regular check in isn't guaranteed either. We have a ghost tour scheduled for 10pm, hopefully we'll be in a room by then, but judging by the line out of the building and the poor customer service, that's only wishful thinking at this point.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The entire order was incorrect and the pizza was crushed and cheese stuck to the top of the box. It was all cold from being so late. I called to ask for a refund and was offered 50%. I said that is unacceptable and eventually I was told I would get a total refund. The refund never came so a week later I called and the manager on duty hung up on me. The girl answering the phone was very helpful and called the owner. I got my refund the next day. 2 stars for bad food and a terrible manager. Will not be going back.

Went at 9:30  on a Wednesday to get a neck shave and trim.The barber's hands smelled like an ashtray.When he was finished I gave him a $20 for the $14 charge.Though I was not the shops first customer,he said he had no change.The other barbers did not help.He asked me to go to the bank with him to break a $20 ! I walked to the door and said I would wait.I stood there over 12 minutes then went. Was this some kind of scam?
What business does not have $6,why did the owner not help ? I really wanted a good barber shop to get haircuts and the occasional shave but this is not the place!!

Food was ok at best. Had appetizer,calamara, which was bland ,salad with a glob of ceasar dressing, pasta, which was over cooked with a way too oily sauce and desert. The ice cream desert was really out standing . Then found out of course it is .... they don't make it ...figures. They ship it in from Italy . Duncan  was helpful and friendly  though another wait person, let us know that they were closing in 20 mins. Translation " Go home"  We had been there a little over an hour.  Would go back to try pizza and that desert again but would have to skip the the rest.

I can't help but recommend this barber to my friends and relatives-and they thank me later.  For myself, I'm VERY picky about my haircuts. I've tried the "bargain" chain barber salons, but they tend to be a training ground for beginners and those who can't gather enough of a following to go out on their own (better money). 

I hate cuts where the barber does a general shaping, but pats down the hair that sticks out and maybe puts some dressing on it to hold it in place...until after I leave the shop.  Max ALWAYS gives a sharp, no-complaints hair cut that will keep me coming back.  Thanks for your excellent service, Max and staff!

Took my car in for the oil change service. Once my car was finished being serviced I noticed valuables including my loose change had been stolen from my car. The store manager was a waste of time who did nothing to help. I called the police who came and after viewing the video footage told me that the footage is worthless. Cameras are too far away and cloudy to see anything. So I got a decent price on an oil change but robbed for over $600 worth of items. One of the worst experiences in my life. Don't trust these people.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I have tried to give this place the benefit of the doubt  multiple times but I can't anymore. I got a gel manicure one week ago and not only did the girl rush through it but I have three chipped nails than a week into it. I had this girl before and the same problem but last week I figured I'd give here another chance when she was the only one available, but I see the error of my ways. It's unfortunate because she is so sweet but she does a poor job. I've had gel manicures from there before that have lasted over two weeks

They have hardwood floors that are completely filthy. The bottom of my feet were black from walking around in there for a hour. Disgusting. No free breakfast. The staff is very rude and 3 just stood there and watched me struggle to get my kids and the stroller out of the door that isn't automatic. Been here a week and house keeping hasn't came once. Also since it's the hardwood floors if someone's in the room above you and drops something you can hear it loudly in your room. It's dog friendly but there's no grass for you to take your dog. Only a little strip by the busy road.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Let me start by saying, yes, the food was amazing. That is not debatable. On food alone, a 5/5. However, for ambiance, rather drab, the chefs/sous chefs, whom everyone raved about, seemed disinterested in serving us, like we were putting them out. And one continued to look down my date's dress every time he came to drop off a dish or pick up plates. Totally classless! Suppose you don't care about service though when you already threw on the mandatory 20%. So on service they get a 1/5. That gives my 2.5/5 final score.

The workers are disinterested in working and that shows up in the food and service. Zero fu**s were given in making my order. Soda had next to no flavor, fries were oil soaked/old, and nuggets were obviously cooked long ago. Sanitation was questionable too with 4ft long braids swinging about the food area. 

Wendy's product line is good but the employees at this location give minimum effort. Fast food chain menus and businesses are all very similar. Hiring, firing, and management practices make the difference. Two stores over Chick-Fil-A proves the point. Never wasting my money here again.

Worst I ever had. Went there earlier this year on a week night around 7:45 p.m.and there was no one else there, first red flag. Ordered something like a sampler plate. Great if you love everything smothered in cheese but not for me. The chili relleno was just a pepper filled with cheese sauce, not a true chili relleno. The red sauce was barely palatable, it had a burnt, stale flavor like it had been sitting on the stove for too many hours. I did not finish my meal or take the leftovers home as I usually do. Husband did not enjoy his selection much either. Will stick with El Potro, their the best I have had locally.

Twelve years ago my car had an unexpected problem and my neighbor recommended that I call Daniels Auto.  I would not have known about them otherwise since they do not advertise.  They don't need to.  Nick and Mike Daniels are possibly the most knowledgeable, friendly, caring, and honest mechanics you could ever possibly meet.  Since that first repair so many years ago, we have never taken any of our vehicles anywhere else.  They have advised us when we buy new cars, they have kept our oldest cars running great, and they have leaped to our aid after hours.  In short, you won't find a better place to take your car.

Worst place ever!!  You can tell  a good vet from the ones that care nothing for animal well being when they would not give me a 1 cc syringe to save the life of a baby squirrel that was found cold and dehydrated because "I was not a patient" yet I told them I have no pets!!  I live right around the corner within walking distance and needed a syringe ASAP!! You showed ZERO compassion for the life of a animal!! Shame on You!!!  If you want a caring, compassionate, not greedy veterinarian team for your beloved pets, find another veterinarian.

Went there with a friend. She got their first and signed me up. Got there and she was already seated and I got seated as well for service on hands. Somehow the manicurist got done with me first, didn't ask how long or short or shape I wanted.Friend was getting the same thing done. And soon after he was out smoking. Long day maybe ? But still..
A couple nails I got fixed before leaving.They were shaped a little off. 
Pedicure was better,different person but still did not get asked about length I wanted them. 
Not too bad but not great either. !! 
Need to work on friendliness and on communicating on what customer would like.
3.5

Unbelievable.  Had to rate them a 1 because I had to use the scale.  Had a reservation for a suite with a king.  Got there early was told I would get a text when the room was ready.  Checked again at 2:30, and was told my room was ready (no text ever received).  When I got in, it was 2 queen beds (what am I staying with my brother?).  I brought this to there attention and said I wanted to be moved.  They said they had no other rooms.  Really.  I'm not paying for what I did not book.  Management unresponsive. Horrible.  I've been a Hyatt rewards member for over over 10 years.  Sad.  Never again.  There is reason they only garner 3 stars.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This hotel was overall decent, rooms are a bit outdated but of good quality. Staff was overall friendly and the hotel is in a great location. My main issue was that the cleaning staff stole my $300 jacket from my room. When I brought this to the hotels attention, they said the jacket was never returned and to make a claim on "ilostmystuff.com". Another note for the cleaning staff is that they never refilled my bathroom supplies (shampoo, conditioner, soap, etc) or my coffee. Overall I would not recommend staying here unless you want to bring your own toiletries and lock your expensive clothing in your suitcase.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Didn't enjoy at all, aside from the cheap price. 

Coffee was terrible, couldn't drink it. Minestrone soup was pretty good, although nothing to rave about. Salad seemed like it was sitting in watered down dressing for a bit before being served. Not sure of the name, but good tri-flavoured ice cream.

When I mentioned to the server that my coffee was no good, he simply said "alright" and didn't take the cup away or offer another drink. He seemed distant after that. Shouldn't have been a big deal, bad coffee happens.

I'm not sure if it's short staffed or not but this location basically closes when they feel like it. I've been there at different times during the evening and night because I know the times showing online are not updated regularly. Still, they are already closed no matter what time I pull in. The outside lights are never on and they never answer the phone so it's no way of knowing what's what. I live on the opposite side of town so I only visit when I'm near but with this already being out of the way, that may change. It's just not worth it.

I am not impressed with this establishment. Each and every time I go to this car wash I don't see perfections unlike some other places.  I have a 2012 and the sits were still visually dirty. See the pictures. Also I bought a wheel cover from there. Left and within 10 minutes I return to see if I can swap it for another one and he would not take it back. Crazy since they are all wrapped with a plastic bag and are all open. The guy says because it was out and my wheel and open he couldn't take it back. Will be going to the other car wash on the Blackhorse pike. I love them.

q service, all the waitresses seem like that don't know how to smile. The guy is awesome but the the waitresses don't know how to smile or serve properly. There was maybe 4 tables including us, and it took them 15 minutes to take our order and 30 minutes to get our food. Took them 10 minute to notice we were done and even offer us a box. Let me tell you we were on our lunch break. Didn't smile at us once and then was upset when she received no tip. Sorry hunny bad service calls for no tip maybe if you would have smiled.

Very unprofessional, was in today & they literally were yelling at a customer because she requested her nails to be fixed or redone. From what I understood she had them done 1 week prior & the polish was already defective. The young lady was not being rude, just frustrated with their attitude & response. The shop owners daughter was completely out of line & argumentative.  I believe she's 17yr & obviously hasn't been trained in customer service, or for that matter ...none of them have. Didn't need to escalate to the level it did, but not surprised since customers are obviously a dime a dozen to them.

We really liked this hotel. It's about a mile to walk to Bourbon Street, but the intervening neighborhood is highly trafficked and seems quite safe.

This hotel, built in an old warehouse. has more personality than most Hampton Inns. It has a bar with interesting people watching and our room in the new section, while quite conventional in amenities, was spacious and clean. It was truly a bargain at $89/night. Service from the front desk to valets and bellhops was friendly and efficient.

Definitely staying here next time we're in NOLA.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have not been impressed with this place in the past, but decided to give it another chance today. I regret that decision. The food was fine, service from the waitress was okay, but the person I believe was the manager was extremely rude and unprofessional. Covid guidelines are not taken seriously here either. I was there on a first date and the 'manager' had the audacity to rudely ask us if we were done yet, then commented to the bussers that they would kick us out if we didn't leave in a minute because we had sat there 'too long'. Anywhere else would not have the disrespect to treat paying customers this way.

I understand and can appreciate the issues restaurants are currently dealing with because of Covid.

My son is a gm for a local restaurant and he shares his struggles with us.

This how's no excuse for a filthy restaurant. The bathrooms were disgusting. I was really disappointed with the food. The chicken was like rubber, the sirloin had no flavor. Even the vegetables were blah and not cooked, some were hot and some cold.

The sushi rolls were decent  but they were warm and cold. Service was really sub-par, understand considering the circumstances.

I bought a Living Social deal for an eye exam and credit toward a glasses purchase at Moody Eyes. And I had a great experience. I got an appointment the same day I called, and she even called me back after they missed my earlier call. Dr. Cardis was very nice and knowledgeable and Maria was great with helping me narrow down frames that look good on my face. With my glasses credit the final price was very reasonable. And on top of all that my glasses were ready in about 3 hours (they told me it would be the next day, and I would have been fine with that).  Overall I was very happy with their service and I will be back.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Getting checked in took upwards of 25 minutes - I appreciate employees being friendly with each other but it's more important to respect folks' time and get them in and out as quickly as possible - a lot of people are trying to balance an appointment like this while still attending work for the day.

Getting checked out was a wait of ~20 minutes because there was only one person at the front. Not his fault.

We weren't called when our car was ready and had to call and ask three hours after they said they would be calling.

It was a decent price but the customer care is nothing to write home about.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
This place is amazing. 

I go here with my friends weekly, and the food is the best. It is only a short drive from where I live, and it is just long enough to help us know what to order - everything is so good, there is no regular!

I have this one friend who is gluten free, and they have plenty of options for her! I sometimes say I have celiac just so I can get the corn tortilla! So goooooodd!!!


Point is: Good food, lovely environment, nice hosts, and help with your allergies. 

Their quesadillas are my comfort food.

I have been there several times.  The food was ok, not great, but the service has always been horrible.  We once waited thirty minutes just for our check.  I ordered on the phone for pickup tonight, and was quoted a price.  I called back to add something, and was told that my initial order was $2 more expensive, even though their website said the initial amount.  I was hung up on twice, and when I finally got a manager she said the online menu was wrong, and I would have to pay the more expensive amount.  I canceled my order, and she didn't even apologize.  I have never complained online about a restaurant, but this one really ticks me off.

Had dinner on Wednesday night during the rainstorm. We called ahead and were promised that the courtyard was adequately prepared for weather, but we spent most of dinner with ourselves and our food being rained on. It was so unpleasant that we ended up taking our entrees and desserts to go. 

The staff, particularly the manager, were dismissive and unapologetic. It's understandable that outdoor dining isn't ideal during weather and that covid restrictions don't make things any easier, but it would have gone a long way if the main attitude toward the situation was more than ambivalence.

I love going to Millis. The only thing is I wish they had a separate waiting room. My cats hate being in a room full of dogs. It would be nice to have a cat room. That being said, it is usually pretty busy, but the wait is never too long. They are very patient and thoughtful, and as an overprotective pet parent, are more than willing to take the time to answer all my questions and address any concerns. They also are great with my pets prescription food- I don't have to renew my prescription since it's on file with them and was prescribed by them. They are my go-to vet.

After testing several restaurants, my family chose this restaurant for a very special dinner party for our daughters graduation.  We were so glad that we did.  Working with the owner Stephen was such a pleasure.  The restaurant is beautiful, the staff is excellent, and the food is superb.  BYOB is a real plus.  We are from Florida and my husband is also in the restaurant business so we know quality.  It doesn't get much better than this.  Everyone should put Casta Diva on their  dining list.  Nice work Stephen.....WE LOVED IT.  Sandy & Evan Araujo

I wouldn't take anything of value/ importance to this cleaners! We were told our bridesmaid dresses would be ready by Wednesday at 4 (we dropped them off on Tuesday). They called me to ask if I wanted to have my dress off to a diff location because there was a spot. I said no, the wedding is Friday, DO NOT SEND IT. I called on Thursday morning ( they were not ready Wednesday pm as promised) to find out my dress was sent off to be cleaned! After finally getting my dress from the store around 4:30, they had forgotten the belt at the other location! They never said sorry and made me pay!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: This used to be a great place to eat, but not anymore. We ordered two entrees, one of which was a salad. The chicken in the salad was good, but the rest of the salad was inedible. The lettuce was so wet that the chips and the beans and all the other ingredients became total mush. The other entree was chile rellenos. There was absolutely no cheese in them. How can you have a chile relleno without cheese?  The service was OK except for the fact that we had to ask for silverware and napkins. If I were you, I would eat elsewhere. This was my second attempt at eating there and both were bad. I know I'll never go back.

The staff was nice enough, and the doctor was very kind. We had made an early appointment to euthanize our very sick cat. The procedure went very smoothly, although it was disconcerting to hear raucous laughter coming from the front desk. 
That being said, the place was very clean and professional, in a quiet residential area. A bit on the expensive side, though.

I'm on the fence about bringing my dog here regularly. I've been to a few different vets in the area (I recently moved here) and it's not my personal favorite so far.

Man, this is the best Japanese sushi restaurant in Philadelphia, food material is the best, because they all import from Japan and California every week, personal, Hokkaido Uni and Karma Toro are my favorite, sweet, fresh and tasty. Chef Sam is a nice person, always explains the sushi and how they are prepared like aging them for 1 week with soy sauce. It's a great place to eat and learn at the same time. Every time, I will order Sakana Omakasè which contains 4 small dishes, and about 20pieces nigiri, one dessert. And they are good enough for an adult. Alright, can't wait for my next visit.

We were so disappointed in our dinner last Saturday night. We made reservations for 6 pm. The restaurant quickly became crowded and our waiter was rushing from table to table. However we waited one hour before we even received our salads and had to ask for my grandson's food to be served as well. We did get our dinners but my pasta was cold and had clearly been sitting for a while. No manager checked on us and no one even refilled our water the entire time. On a positive note, we did receive the birthday celebration we requested when we made the reservation. However we will not do any more family celebrations here.

All around, this experience was beyond terrible. I left feeling completely ripped off. I paid extra money to get my trunk vacuumed - it doesn't even look like they touched it. Streaks on all the windows and spots left all over my car door. Not to mention the lack of professionalism by the staff. The employees blatantly stole a majority of the change from my cup holder. The male staff also acted very unprofessionally toward women. I watched them yell at several women driving by. I was alone and felt very uncomfortable as I waited for my car. I will never ever be returning to this place.

Used to be our favorite go to take out. Maybe they are understaffed and forgot how to make food during this Covid 19 lock down? Waited over an hour for delivery, and when it finally arrived the food was crap. They have no idea how to make a quesadilla, and when a quesadilla from Wawa is better than a restaurant, that tells you something. 

As far as the melted mess of a calzone, it was abysmal but my husband has an iron stomach and scooped up the mess it was and ate it anyway. 

I'll wait a few months and try again, before we write this previous favorite off for good.

I stayed at this hotel with my 2 sons for a first time trip to the St. Louis area. The staff was nice and the room was clean. They offer shampoo, conditioner and bath wash, which is installed in the shower. Pretty neat. Downside is they don't offer breakfast. There is a Bistro for you to purchase food in the morning, but it's very pricey. Overall, I was pleased with my stay. I'd probably look into a different hotel if I visited again, due to the no breakfast. But if that weren't a factor, I'd definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Almost 45$ for 2 burritos and super fries. & the girl in the drive through wouldn't give us more than 6 salsas. She had the worst attitude & acted like we were off the street begging for food, then the guy from the back came to the window practically yelling at us saying only 2 salsas per item!!!! Give me a break after spending that much money on just okay food, you could have given us more salsa!!!! I will not be going back, especially because you all were so rude. Here's a tip: say politely that it's only 2 per item and it's an extra cost for more. Easy peasy. Learn some customer service please!!!

So we came during restaurant week, we knew it would be busy. Zero problem waiting 30 after our reservation and the fact we had 1 out of 4 courses in the first hour: it's busy, it's fine! The issue was it was bland, we asked for parm over our pasta course and the waiter said "I'll see if I can find it".. I get it, there is chaos and what not but there are some things a restaurant can control. Customer service is one. Our cannoli cake was still frozen in the center. Underwhelming but perhaps an off night?   Okay but also TIP 20% plus no matter what because servers can't help 90% of this okay??!

Ordered take out recently....food was terrible! I spent $80.00 for minimal food. I would not have minded if it was seasoned well. It was disappointing. It was bland and my crab cakes were dry with 5 pieces of crabmeat in each crab cake. The potatoes were half cooked, the broccoli was bland as well and the bread was hard. I have dined in and ordered take out before so I know the food. It was a big disappointment. I ordered entree's which I thought came with some pasta....I didn't realize it was optional to ask for it. Too pricey for the quality of food.

Food was great, service was quick, margaritas were strong! I like how the portion sizes are small, I don't feel guilty eating my whole meal! 
Nice atmosphere/decor. 
Complaints: no chips and salsa complemented with the meal; the kids meal of steak tacos was just that -tacos with some steak and cheese. A veggie accompanying it would have been nice. Entire meal for three of us (two adults and a one year old) was quite pricey, and it wasn't the alcohol jacking up the bill.
We will probably return, and maybe try happy hour. Loved the fast service since its always dicey as to how long the one year old will sit still!

Very nice staff whenever I call to request a delivery. Everyone that's come here to deliver has also been very friendly which is sadly not a usual occurrence nowadays with other businesses. 

Their prices are standard but SLIGHTLY less than other competitors I've seen. Their pizza is pretty good but I've heard their pasta dishes are the best. I always get my food quickly and very hot with great service so I can't complain! I'm always going to get my food delivered from this place as long as we're staying in PA.

If you're in the mood for paying for disappointment, visit this Dunkin'! They are guaranteed to deliver mediocre service & the opposite of what you ordered 9/10 times! Even if you use on the go ordering, where you have the pleasure of writing EXACTLY what you want- they will still do the impossible and get it wrong!! Want a glazed donut? Not here! You get chocolate covered with sprinkles!! Don't bother paying the extra for the signature latte either because they will make it wrong! Guaranteed to ruin your Friday morning coffee treat! Cheers Dunkin'!

My fiancé and I stayed here Sunday through Wednesday the first night I had to catch an early morning flight with my infant son so we were supposed to be up by 3am but we woke up earlier because we had bed bugs in our bed! One came very close to my 10 mo old son but I actually got bit. We told the staff and they moved us to a new room. When we informed front office the lady obviously didn't care so I'm writing to warn you that you might get bed bugs and management is cool with it! See photos.. the photos of my arm is when I came home the next day and the rash was worst
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I would absolutely stay at the French Market Inn again. We got a petite exterior room. It was definitely petite, but that's what we paid for. The exposed brick in the room was beautiful and gave it a feel unlike any other places we've stayed. 

I was nervous about the street being noisy at night and hearing it in our room, but we didn't have any issues with that.

The front desk staff was always friendly and the woman who checked us in was really informative. 

This Inn is right in the middle of most of the action. We could've never hopped the tram once and still been busy every day just walking the blocks around this NOLA gem.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Ok place to eat.  It was a little cramped, but had mostly good food and the service was quick and 3 of the 4 meals we had were really good.  Pizza was a hit and even the kids chicken strips were delicious.  The only disappointment was the pasta con broccoli.  It was very bland even after adding salt and pepper.  It had no butter and hardly any sauce.  The chicken in the pasta was tiny little diced pieces, which is unusual, and it was tasteless as well. 
Overall, I would go there again, but I would never order their pasta.

This location has the worst order accuracy, terrible customer service.
The food was decent, but several items were made wrong.  Ordering thru the drive thru was a pain as two different people took our order.  The first woman seemed like she was high and/or just really didn't care about her job at all.  The second guy was better but still didn't listen very well and we had to repeat everything two or three times.  He seemed to be in a bad mood and was quite rude.  When we got our food, items were missing and we had to wait again for those to be made.  I do not recommend going here if you plan to order more than 1 item.

This is probably the worst hotel experience by far. In the middle of the night somebody walked into my room who happen to have the same room keys, that was already given to me. It was terrifying and horrible experience for not just me, also for the person who was given the keys. When I called the front desk I was redirected to different operators without being told who I have been redirected to and I have to tell the same story every single time. This is very unprofessional and unacceptable service from the hotel chain of this size.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I just moved here from Texas and have been searching for a place that does solar nails (pink and white)...I have been to 5 other places when I finally went in on Monday the 2nd of November and had Henry do my nails and give me a pedicure!  My nails look incredible just like I had in Houston!  My pedicure was wonderful as well!  Already booked my next appointment and booked appointments for pedicures for my sister-in-law and nieces!  If you are looking for your nails to look natural and not to pop off or break you need to come in and have solar nails done!

So my wife and I were in NOLA for a few nights and we stoped in at spirits on Burbon st. We were welcomed right away and for me that a big plus.  I mean come on I am here to spend money at least you can do is welcome me and they did just that. Anyway we started with the meet pies a resurrection. 
We enjoyed dueling pianos and waited for food to arrive
I had the most  amazing gumbo and my wife add the shrimp poo boy both this is were served quickly and was so good. 
I was not daring enough neither was my wife to do the shot chair but it looked extremely fun. Definitely highly recommend this place a must see if you're in New Orleans.

Very disappointed in this store.  Was always top notch and it's gone down hill so fast so bad. Flavors do not change often any longer.  They are filling the store with appliances like it was a gas station.  The cleanliness in the last 2-3 months have dropped increasingly.  The fun and nice employees have all left.  And finally I'm sitting here now and I see Kant's flying around the drip trays full of melted overflow.   This would have never happened in the past.   Either the owners don't care anymore or they can't not staff the store properly.   

It's all sad really

Very disappointed in this store.  Was always top notch and it's gone down hill so fast so bad. Flavors do not change often any longer.  They are filling the store with appliances like it was a gas station.  The cleanliness in the last 2-3 months have dropped increasingly.  The fun and nice employees have all left.  And finally I'm sitting here now and I see Kant's flying around the drip trays full of melted overflow.   This would have never happened in the past.   Either the owners don't care anymore or they can't not staff the store properly.   

It's all sad really.

The food is fine, but the service is generally bad. Tonight we got two rolls and were planning to get dessert, but after sitting for 20 minutes without seeing our server at all it was apparent he wasn't coming back. Some other gal came over and asked us if we just wanted our check, I told her we planned on getting dessert but we didn't have time to wait for it now. She didn't have a response for me and just threw our check on the table. Our server came back and continued serving people around us, but didn't ask us anything else. Really rude and ridiculous.

Make sure you're monitoring your credit card for billing errors. However, when you bring it to their attention, know that it will be fixed. 
I had another location taking money out of my account every month even though I never signed on with them. I spoke to 2 different front desk people and one of them gave me an email to someone that could help and she did. Vienna was so kind and patient and the issue was eventually solved. 
As far as the equipment, I don't ask for much in a gym so my only complaint is I wish they'd bring back the stair-master. They replace it with a stepper when it broke down but I miss it.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I was there around 12 am and keep incmind it is a 24 hour branch. My order was a couple big macs and drinks totalled $12. I was literally the only one in the restaurant and the order took well over 15 minutes. When I started to complain I got attitude from the first lady who claims it takes time and then kept on sercing the drive thru. The next employee tried to defend her when only 20 minutes ago he was hanging out with his friends outside when I came in. Get more responsible employees please its not like we visit you that often. Food was as average as it always is, stuffed woth Gmos.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Currently in Tennessee, one if the friendliest and military conscience states I've ever been in. Every place I've went to this trip I have been offered a military discount. Dollar car rental is the Only place that does not. They require that you register through a third party (that ive never heard of) and book through them. But... If you do an upgrade and spend more money than planned, they can offer a military discount. Long story short, military discount is only when they decide or when they force you to upgrade. I booked what I needed, upgrade isn't necessary. I'll never use again.

Signed up just to write this review.  I loved the old Lolita and could not wait for this new version to open.  I've been twice now and I doubt I will return.  Everything was just...okay.  Service was okay, drinks were okay, and food was okay.  That is the best I can say about it.  I loved bringing people from out of town to the old Lolita as a way to impress them with Philadelphia and its restaurant scene.  It always had great food and a really fun vibe.  I got none of that the last two times I was in.  I actually wonder if what I liked so much was really just getting drunk on a bottle of tequila.

On paper, this hotel has everything. It gets an extra star for it's location and friendly staff but otherwise - it's a dump. Expect that if you're on the first floor and your upstairs neighbor is rude enough to do something like walking, you'll be woken up. The windows on the first floor are also completely obstructed so you have zero view. Parking is an additional $16 and the breakfast is a microwaved smorgasbord specifically designed to satisfy no one. Lastly don't expect to sit on the toilet comfortably, it is too close to the sink in this poorly designed bathroom and the roll holder will be poking into your arm if you're adult sized.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My car had an issue. The mechanic swore up and down he could fix it. I had done business with them before and received good service, so I trusted his word. Two days later, the car broke down again. They wanted to charge me for more repairs and they did not fix the original issue. Intermittent running was what the car had been doing before. I was in a tight financial situation, and I pleaded with them to reimburse me. They would not. I highly recommend you take your business elsewhere, this is another scam auto shop.

Lovely place if looking for a pasta dinner! The atmosphere at Asiagos is wonderful, with beautiful decor and lighting. I ordered the Genoa Pasta - a tasty mix of spinach fettuccini, with a delicious sauce. Our table also ordered the fettuccini alla salmon, which was also enjoyed (although we liked the genoa pasta more!!) The bread served to the table was delicious, served with oil and vinegar. The caesar salad was wonderful as well. Bathrooms were adequate, but service was amazing. Our server was knowledgeable and kind. Would recommend for someone in downtown Boise!

The customer service was okay however, the vehicle we rented was dirty. I found pieces of food and peanuts on the floor and the car handle pocket. Makes me wonder whether the car was sanitized.

1/28/21 Update. After leaving my original review, I received a bill for over $1500 today on claims that there was damage on the vehicle. This is a month after I dropped off the vehicle on Dec 30. Also, I received a receipt the day I dropped it off and all was fine. I will fight this fraudulent damage claim but customer be warned, this location is highly unethical.

Delicious - we split the salad with pears, goat cheese and walnuts with a raspberry vinaigrette; perfect size for splitting and a great app before pizza! We got the margherita pizza which was delicious as well - sauce is sweet and bread is to die for. I did feel the pizza was a little oily and the bottom of the pizza was saturated (not crispy) but it still tasted amazing. Pizza and salad great amount to split between two. 

Service was great and atmosphere was soothing and open (we went for lunch). 
Reasonably priced (on the low end).

Highly recommend.

We were craving Italian food and wanted to look at their menu.   Before we sat down we had to use the restroom.  After my friend and I used the restroom the grandma hostess in her 60s or 70s scolded us and said we were disrespectful for using the bathroom and deciding to not eat there.  I politely explained that what we wanted was not on their menu but we would return another time.  She continued to scold us in front of her customers and embarrassed the people eating there who sided with us and said she was out of line.

What a great find! Came upon it because all the big name Italian places were booked up and we were so glad they were, this place was great! Food was fresh and delicious. Be prepared to enjoy a full dining experience, the ambiance is old style Italian right down to the Sicilian Donkey by the bar. It's in a beautiful old house with high ceilings - don't be put off by the outside entrance. Our server, Gina couldn't have been more pleasant and accommodating - especially with our extra bread and roasted pepper requests. We'll definitely be back.

The worst customer service I've experienced in a long time 

Order a sandwich and iced tea. Pay cashier says nothing. I walk away and sit down. Wait approx 20 minutes and nothing. Go up to counter and ask? In an unprofessional way, woman opens styrofoam box and looks inside. Here it is.....I then ask about the iced tea. Know nothing about it. What size? Fills the cup and slides it across counter. Again nothing. Some real problem with the customer facing staff. 

But sandwich was excellent. If you can put up with rude and insensitive front counter people, you'll probably get a nice lunch.

DO NOT WASTE YOUR TIME! If I could leave a no star rating I would.  I went after lunch hour in hopes of having less of a wait. Spent 40 minutes waiting for my FAST FOOD. An absolute joke! The staff is slow and lazy. There was no sense of urgency at all and they were not packed. The manager was also a jerk to his staff and not in the hurry rush way but in the rude, disrespectful way. No wonder they could care less about actually pushing food out. The one woman literally put the nuggets into the box one by one as if she was in slow motion. By far the worst Wendy's I have EVER been to!

Lunch Selections are the Best!

I've had lunch in some good Japanese restaurants, but I have never enjoyed any meal other than what I have at Woo Chon's!

The lunch sets are really good, especially their teriyakis and tempuras.
Service is a bit average when the place gets busy and it would help a lot if they turn down the radio a little bit so people can actually hear each other in their conversations. 
The Sushi Chefs behind the bar are quick, friendly, and courteous.

All in all, the ambiance and the food make your trip and money in this great place worthwhile!

I just don't have enough good things to say about this place. There were super busy. The staff handled the volume eloquently. We were shocked at the menu prices, they were all so cheap. I actually got a little concerned but I figured the hoard of people trying to eat there knew something I didn't. I was NOT disappointed.  I had the enchiladas and they were one of the best enchilada dishes I have ever had...... FOR UNDER 15$. I am still shocked. My husband had the taco sampler and that blew his mind too. I didn't even want to try his because mine was so good. This place is AMAZING.  This is a MUST try place.... hands down.

I was treated more rudely in this restaurant than any other restaurant in 70 years of dining out.  My wife and I waited for over an hour for a table.  Then a table finally came open.  Just then a party o 4 walked in so they got the table ahead of us who had waited for over an hour.  After we ordered the waitress came and told us, it would be an hour before we would get our pizza because they had to fill in the call in orders 1st.  None of the call in orders had waited an hour.  If you go there,  be prepared to be treated extremely RUDE!  RUDE IS THEIR SPECIALTY!

Betty Davis said it best, "What a dump."  Cheap rooms, so expect to get what you pay for I guess.  But really, they aren't even making an effort.  Really terrible maintenance of the facility.  Hallway carpets are stained, burned, and just disgusting.  Rooms would have been the same but they replaced with hard laminate, that at least was clean to the eye.  The water in the sink (in my room) only runs full on HOT.  The pool is covered over in July, so ignore their image of a refreshing pool on a hot summer day.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My family and I have had several experiences at this restaurant so this rating is not based on a one time occurrence. We kept giving it another shot because my son like the greasiness of the pizza. But after tonight's episode we are all out of second chances. Made a simple order at 6 o'clock and was told it would be there in 45 minutes to 1 hour, at 7:45 still no delivery. My advice would be to order the food before you know you need it and maybe it will get there when you do. I usually do not leave reviews but their four star average is wholly undeserved.

Not worth the long wait for your food. We sat for over an hour for our food to come out. For only three out of six of us to get our food served. We could of gone through McDonald's line 10 times for this kind of wait! This is ridiculous and by far the worst serves I've had at Jerry bobs. Let alone when the rest of the food came it was cold, and wrong. Didn't receive the full amount of side bacon that was order either. Waiting to even pay the bill.... looking around and noticing the other three tables waiting for food. Just not worth it. Pick literally anywhere else. Don't wast your time here.

It's a nice hotel right on the beach.  The pool area is so crammed packed with kids you can't even get a seat.  The pool was small.  So small I felt as though you couldn't swim or you would run into someone or thing.  Yes there were noodles, inflatables, and kids throwing balls.  We spent most our time at the beach where we rented a cabana with two chaise lounges for $25 for the entire day. For me that's a deal.  They had a golf cart shuttle that would take you from the hotel to the beach and back. Great beach for shelling.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Housekeepers are theives! Beware and keep all you belongings close! My daughter left the iPad in our room, and when we found out we called the front desk and they said they couldn't do anything untill mourning. They never returned our call. When we called back they were rude.  Never going back to a Marriott.



In response to courtyards response.

It's funny that this is the only response we've had from you company is on a public forum. Seriously!  I have the track your iPad to your location and you still have not done anything about it. So the Marriott is fine with stolen items. Heads up people!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I used this place a few times when I lived in the USF area. Overall, I'd recommend them as far as honesty and fair pricing.

There were a couple of issues with lack of attention to detail. Once I had gotten tire work done and had to return to get  a faulty installation corrected. This wasn't a problem, and the staff was very helpful and willing to admit their mistake and fix everything for free. Another time I was unable to pick my car up, and they left it unlocked in the parking lot... and this isn't the best part of town.

All things considered, I'd recommend them for routine auto maintenance.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Pros: Clean, variety of washing machines for different size loads, decent bathroom, lots of carts available to haul your clothes 

Cons: washing machines and dryers often break sometimes in the middle of the cycle, loud obnoxious attendants who talk about other  customers...

And in my most recent visit, there was a package of meat in the beverage vending machine in the back!!!! That has to be a violation of some health code!!!! I attached the picture above for proof. 

Do your laundry. Don't get the drinks.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: The food was delicious--absolutely wonderful!  Unfortunately however, our waiter was extremely arrogant and never returned to our table once our food was served.  We felt we were "sized up"  the moment we walked in the door.  When I asked him how to find the restroom, he pointed in the general direction of outside and said "up the stairs and second door on the left". Hm, he must have forgotten the are TWO flights of stairs?  I suppose I should have I known he meant the flight behind the tinted glass door.  The friendly bus boy should be promoted to waiter.  Just a suggestion.

pre COVID, i had been to Vincent's many times and enjoyed every bit of my experience. i must say that during my most recent visit I was very disappointed at the lack of social distancing in the restaurant. seating was basically at regular capacity because the tables were not spaced out enough. though there were plenty of empty tables, the filled tables were all crammed next to each other on the same side of the room. I've always loved Vincent's so it was saddening to discover that they aren't taking the pandemic very seriously.

I loved this place. They have great food and USED to have great service but now they are lacking significantly. They past few times I have eaten there with my wife and child we were forgotten. I have a great video to watch that explains their lack of service. YouTube "Give Them the Pickle". The staff would be wise to learn from the example of how to please your guest and pay attention to them as well. As we sat down we were never served our usual miso soup and edamame; also when the meal ended they never served our sliced orange halves as per usual. Give your customers the pickle and they will keep coming back!

My most recent experience at modern eye was the best I've ever had getting new glasses. Vanessa was patient with me and did not try to talk me into any frames to keep me moving along.  She was considerate and made a recommendation of something that was not in stock.  They ordered this frame for me taking the risk that I might not keep it.  Well, Vanessa nailed it and I did end up keeping them.  I even went back in and they helped me ordered lenses for a pair of glasses near to my heart and even helped refit them for me at no cost.  Unparalleled experience dealing with modern eye.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Hello everyone. I would highly recommend that if you need to use the restroom to bring a helmet with you and get insurance. I was using the restroom today and the lights were flickering. But as I was washing my hands, I got hit in the head by the metal framing of the light on the ceiling. I told the employees and they were just like yeah we will check it out. They didn't even ask if I was okay or anything. They put this sign up after though.  However, the food here was fine and is the only reason that this post is getting a 2 star.

This location SUCKS! At least 80% of the time my order is wrong, either missing something or a drink is not as ordered.  I frequent this location 2-3 times a week and have had enough.  How hard is it to put the correct stuff in the bag or make the correct drink.  I mean REALLY!!!! Prior to this Covid-19 we just went inside - only way to get it right, but now you can't go inside (which is completely stupid - everywhere else you can). This drive through is terrible!  We switched to the Wendy's next door and it's 100% better - they get it right!   Don't ever get me started on the removal of the dollar menu at McDonalds!  Jesus!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
We have been to joeys many times, both locations.  The food is excellent!  Pizza just like my favorite from back home.   My husband loved the baked ziti.   We did have a couple issues tonight, we are mindful of staffing shortages. However, we received tolls before drinks.  I never received my soup, which I asked if I could have it ASAP ... the pizza arrived without plates ... had to ask .. had to ask for meatballs my husband ordered, (ziti was actually penne) drinks never refilled.  The soup was still on the bill ... egad, rough night at joeys.  
It was a Wednesday at 5:15.   We will go back. The food is that good.

The veterinarians and techs are knowledgeable and wonderful, however the staff at the front desk are incredibly unhelpful and disorganized. Twice now I have brought my dog for routine shots/wellness visits and have either been forgotten or pushed down the list for "checking in late". I was 15 minutes early both times. It took 45 minutes to an hour for my pet to be seen. I understand that we are dealing with a lot of uncertainty during this pandemic, but a little more organization with the desk staff would be helpful.

My wife and I went to Dolce Vita on a Friday night. The atmosphere is very cozy and inviting. We were greeted by our server with a big welcoming smile. My wife and I both had soups that we loved. I even ordered one of the kale, bean and sausage soups to bring home for lunch the next day.,
I had the house made braciole for dinner over linguine. This was a great hearty dish with tons of flavor!!! Also my wife enjoyed the penne vodka. I need to go back and try the Cioppino.
I am definitely looking forward to having dinner at this restaurant again

First time here and I fell in love Food is so fresh and beautifully prepared and presented. We just went for a couple of small plates, we got the hand cut fries and sautéed brussels sprouts, as well as the charcuterie board-all AMAZING. I also had the Gin 1 Cocktail and it was delish! My friend asked for a custom cocktail and they were so accommodating! The food, service, atmosphere were all 10/10. You could tell that they were very thorough with cleaning and sanitizing. Without a doubt, I will be coming back!! Really want to try their brunch

I usually rent from Alamo. Unfortunately Alamo was sold out. My 1st time ever renting from Budget..... It really gave "The Ghetto" Its 2021 and it's no kiosk machine for self check out???!!! The line was literally out the door. The staff looked stressed out and underpaid. Their attitudes reflected that also. I wanted in line for 39 minutes. The guy at the counter was nice we exchange a laughs. Not to bad of an experience. Buttttt I'll never rent from Budget Again!!!!! Even the inside looked very dated visually looked like a subway train station. Smelled kinda funky too.

Clerk did not explain anything about the car when it was picked up.  Was advised that car could be turned in early and credit would be provided.  When the car was turned in early, it was explained that the car was not turned in "early enough" in the week to receive the credit.  Bottom line, better explanation about the car and return policies are needed.  A few days after the rental, I received a phone call survey from Enterprise.  When I voiced my dissatisfaction with the service, I was asked if I would be willing to talk with a supervisor.  I said YES and was told I would receive a call the following day.  That call NEVER came!

I love Starbucks. It is a wonderful treat every once in a while in the afternoon. But out of all the Starbucks I visit this is the slowest by far. I appreciate it when they make drinks correctly and understand this takes time. But this Starbucks is beyond just making the perfect drink. It seems to be a popular stop so you would think there would be more than one person making drinks and one person running the drive thru. If there were more hands on deck they wouldn't have people pulling out of the drive thru line after placing their orders. Unfortunately it takes just as long if you go in.

I absolutely love Dunkin, I have a cup almost each day. I decided to stop at this location a few times b/c I live the area. I asked for a medium hot coffee with milk on the side and 6 sugars on the side. This particular Dunkin is always denying my order as if all coffee drinkers drink creamer in their coffee. I've ordered this same ordered before at different location and never have I ever gotten push back. This location has had another associate yell in the intercom "mama she said we don't have it, please get out of line!" I've never been treated like this ever!!! She then says he don't have the machine to give you a side of milk! I call BS

I am not one to complain about my grocery store experiences, but this one deserves it. The cashier bagged the elderly lady's grocery in front of us and then proceeded to let her take each bag off the bag carousel by herself while she started our order and started to bag our stuff. And then didn't ask for our bonus card or coupons. When asked about it, "you can go up front if you want that taken off". Then the customer service representative ripped the survey off the bottom of the receipt when we mentioned the poor service.

We had a great experience with La Guera. Not only is their food amazing, but their staff was incredibly accommodating. I made a weird request and the woman who answered the phone took the time to speak with the cooks and make what I asked for. It sounds so simple, but in today's world, customer experience seems to come last. I really appreciate their communication and kindness, and of course their food is amazing! Would recommend their quesadillas, chiliquiles, enchiladas and guacamole (those are our go-to's).

We've been going here for years and unfortunately the service has gone down.....I'm allergic to onions and ordered a wedge Salad no onions along with xlarge pizza and a dinner side salad no cheese. I even made extra notes about no onions, allergy in the memo section.  It took 1-1/2 hours for delivery and my salad was covered in onions and the other salad was covered in cheese and the pizza was soggy & cold.  When you spend over $50 for pizza & salad and tip nicely you would expect service. Soooooo disappointed!!

They like to fry the pita bread for their gyros, so I asked them to please not fry it.
"Ok, no problem."
Drive up, pay for order, and ask the cashier to confirm that the bread won't be fried. She confirms this (as I watch a cook throw a pita bread ONTO THE F-ing GRILL).
Sure enough, it's my order. I watch them bag it and hand it to me. The bread it hot, seared and crispy.
"They fried the gyro," I tell the cashier.
She looks right at me and says, "No, they didn't."
Ffffffffffffffuuuuuuuuuuuuuu..........!!!!!!
They messed up my order like that once in the past, and I let it slide. But I'm done with them. So frustrating.

The lady is miserable every single time and she lies about not having a bathroom (debadged the door) and then when you ask the other workers they will lie and say they locked the key in it. All 3 occasions multiple months apart so I'm guessing they never let anyone use their bathroom and I'm pretty sure it is a law in Pa if you serve food in a place you must have a th room or else you have no way of cleaning your hands and it's just down right uncomfortable. I love Dunkin' Donuts so I'll give 1 star for that and a star for it being clean.

I went there with my fiancé for a quick bite to eat and it was exactly what we were looking for, great service and good food at low prices.  We both had the Frankfurter with chili, cheese and raw onion.  I loved my Frankfurter, but the chili was just OK. My fiancé love it, he licked his plate clean and then moved onto mine!  We will be going back!  This place also makes for some great people watching.  I will warn you it is very loud, so if your looking to hang out and talk, you might want to try somewhere else. Check out my blog, www.indianapoliseats.com for more of my reviews!

This shop has my business for life! I am a single woman who drives an old car, a perfect opportunity for unsavory mechanics. Thomas, the general manager, made sure my problem was completely identified, and then fixed for no charge as a goodwill gesture. Thankfully it was a very small issue, but nonetheless he made sure I was driving a well working vehicle before I left his shop. I had a great service experience in July when I went in for an oil change and today was just as good. Everyone who walked in during my wait was treated with good humor and kindness. Busiest lube/shop I have ever seen, clear evidence of his loyal customer base.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I had a reservation....They picked me up exposed me to 3 people in a small car then told me I could not sit inside (it was damp and 66 degrees outside, I didn't expect to have to wait and did not have a coat, the chairs outside were wet from rain) no one else inside and 5 or 6 social distancing spots inside.  They did not serve people first come etc. or check reservations ( I had one)  Took over an hour to get a car and many people helped before me.  Terrible.  they later apologized, but this is their business, should have handled this much better.

Outstanding Vet. My dog was treated in a very expensive Emergency Center, all that mattered was the money. Although my dog had never been treated at Strickland I scheduled a follow up appointment there. Dog's condition was explained to me thoroughly.  Also did lab work for hypothyroid. Medication needed to be reduced by 50%. Changed dog's diet to recommended diet for his diagnosed condition. It's amazing to see the improvement in my little guy. Everyone at Strickland has been very kind and caring. Thankful to have found this Vet., highly recommend.

This was a horrible experience that started with a quarter, yes a 25cent piece, in the crab cakes and ended with a dry New York strip for $23. When the quarter was discovered in the under cooked crab cakes the server offered to take it off the bill... thanks. The manager did not come by the table.  When the entrees came there were powdered potatos and dry meat, the horseradish crusted salmon was also very dry and over priced.  It was like eating with my grandfather in his retirement home. We will not go back and will tell many other about our experience.

I have been going to Meineke for over 10 years and they have also been incredibly helpful. They have saved me money with work on the car and even helped spot some problems when I purchased a Nissan Xterra. If they had not helped me with the Xterra it would have cost be $1K to fix the timing belt and many other things but since I learned of it, the issue was covered under used car warranty. What they really help with is noticing what may be a future problem and that is incredibly helpful. Its a great place and highly recommend it.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: If you're looking for a horrendous haircut this is the place to go. Literally the worst haircut of my LIFE!! I moved to Tucson recently and was in need of a fresh haircut so I went to the nearest barbershop. I don't do much to my hair to begin with but I like a clean light fade blended into the top, simple right? This guy sloppily cut my hair not even listening to what I wanted. To make it even worse he legit cut half of my bangs off. I definitely came out looking BUSTED w half my hair gone. I have never been so sick. Never again.

I am new to the area and have not tried many Japanese restaurants, but I believe when you try a restaurant and like it for what ever reason, I go back for that.  I feel that Zama compares to Morimoto's.  Granted Zama does not have the extensive menu items on a daily basis as does Morimoto's, but Chef Zama has the upmost regards for freshness.  I go to Zama now on the regular now and have the omakase everytime.  He got to know my palate and when ever he gets something that I know I would like, he will text me.  Therefore besides the food, which is great, the personal service tops it off.

This place has a nice rotating draft menu and the owner was a nice guy. Apparently they only fill one size growler and the manager was kind of rude about it. I brought my 32 oz growler in to get filled and the bartender filled it for me no problem... then she says it's $24. I explained that it should be 1/2 that since it's half a growler so, she got the manager.  The manager says he'll do it for $12 and then rings me up for $14 and tries to sell me a growler. He tells me not to bring that thing in there again, like it was my fault. Sure thing bud, I won't be back... then I get home and the thing is not even filled up all the way. Lame.

I used to go here but the prices have sky rocketed. they use to have this 2 roll special with miso soup and salad included. now they removed that and the other special does not include miso soup nor salad. my friend once found a fly in his salad so that is another reason we don't go there. he also once found a hair on his california roll. Yeach!! the portions use to be pretty big, but not anymore. i gave the place 2 stars because the manager was really nice and he once gave us green tea ice cream for st. patrick's day.

When we first arrived we went in to the main lobby and waited for the receptionist for 15 mins to come from the back.  She had no customer service skills, no greeting,  no assistance, and issued us keys for a room that was already occupied.  When my pregnant wife brought the keys back down and told her the issue she replied "oh (lip smack) ok".   While this was going on I was parking (an additional $30) in which the receptionist said was the only parking however, there was a lot for $5 across the street which was authorized for Westin parking.  Horrible experience.  The bed and restroom was nice but not worth the overall experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My first time in  Philly and the concierge recommended this restaurant. It didn't disappoint. It is a small location but cozy and well appointed. The service was excellent. A reservation is a must. We had several of their pasta dishes and they were creative and generous portions. I tried their famous meatball and have to say I wasn't the biggest fan. I am accustomed to my family's traditional recipe and these had quite a spicy bite. My teenage son loved them! And again, this preference could just be my upbringing. Overall, a wonderful spot.

This is definitely my new spot. David is such a perfectionist and as a picky person I appreciate it. He genuinely takes the time to shape my nails perfectly even if my finger are a little crooked. Also the work is very clean and hate when around my cuticles have gel on them. 
These nails could last up to 6 weeks and I am pretty rough on my fingers. No damage taking them off at home. They aren't cheap but the absolute definition of quality and good service. 
Also I'm a little shy so I loved that I am not forced to chat too much. 
The salon is super cute, clean and doesn't smell like acetone.

Was on a date and we had a late start - trying to find a place for food and a couple drinks after 9pm.  Walked into what seemed to be the only option on State on a early-in-the-week night (Blue Owl was closed).  Unfortunately, that was it's best trait. Two other parties in the place - a table of 3 and a solo at the bar.  Food was average, a salad was forgotten for my Vegan friend.  But the part that bothered me the most was the cocktails were $14.  For a rocks-size glass, Casadores  margarita?  Please.  That's insulting for locals.  Or maybe locals don't go there.  Lesson learned for the newbie in town.

Beautiful simple decor with a creative twist on traditional italian. This place exceeded expectations.  The squash soup, duck parpardelle and buffalo mozzarella were tasty apps! I had the ziti with the carmelized onions which was delish! The chicken dish, which my picky mother enjoyed, was juicy and full of flavor.  The server was a very sweet actress by day who added to the cool vibe.  For dessert- sumptious lemoncello cheesecake with huckleberries.  I had the mint and vanilla gellati which were superb. The diners were sophisticated and quiet, so it was a great place to catch up with loved ones.  All around, great byob in queen's village!

You get what you pay for! The food is cheap but it's pretty good-- the only problem is that all the waitresses seem like they are sassy teenagers. I've been here on and off over the years, and the service never changes. It always takes forever to get seated, takes forever to order, and if you need something the waitresses tend to ignore you. Oh yeah did I mention when you are done it takes forever to leave, so you can add an extra 30-45 min to your initial stay. It's a little annoying. I wish the service was better, but if you have downtime, the food is great.

I was so excited to try this place as I feel Reno needs more hip bars! 
When my friend and I arrived, we ordered two mixed drinks (two of the same mixed drinks). The bartender made the drinks then told us not to order any others like that. 
I assumed it was because it was a Friday night (9pm). After much debate in my mind, I have come to the conclusion that a bar should not serve mixed drinks if the bartenders cannot make them quickly and properly. We were paying customers. There are plenty of bars that serve beer and wine.... Work there if you can't mix a drink! 
Bleh. Disappointed!

I don't usually write reviews but - the food here was OUTSTANDING. I usually start to form an opinion with the chips and salsa. The chips didn't do anything for me but the salsa was terrific. Then the server brought out the "hot sauce" which was a pure winner. I tried the tacos since that seemed to be the specialty and they were really really good. Even the margaritas were exceptional. Just for the record. I'm not one who writes unless it's really really good or really really bad. I love Mexican food and this place will see my smiling face again and again.

Coming from  California I've never really had any luck finding good authentic Mexican food in the crescent city area. Los Panchos was a wonderful find thanks to the yelp community. Great food not covered up with some kind of cheese sauce, made with fresh ingredients full of flavor and concocted in a hole in the wall place at a great deal served with a smile. Didn't eat big, had the shrimp cocktail which was excellent with a carne asada salad and my wife had the burrito supreme all of which was very fresh and tasty.

The food was good but the timing of it was terrible. My two girls and I each ordered off of the regular menu; my husband ordered the all you can eat. The orders all came in a timely manner and it was delicious! My husband sat and waited. He got his first roll. Twenty minutes later, we were all done but him and he still hadn't been served any of the rest of his order. We sat there for an hour and a half waiting for his order to be completed. The tables all around us were waiting too. One table had small children and no food or service. Overall, good food, but be prepared to wait for it.

THE BEST RICOTTA CHEESE PIZZA EVER! I've been in NE Philly for almost 11 years. I finally found a pizza/restaurant to recommend! This pizza is EXCELLENT! Baked to perfection! The pie crust is awesome! The people I spoke to on the phone were so pleasant. The gentleman who delivered was also pleasant and had a huge smile! I can't say enough good things! Please go to Montesini's! You won't be disappointed. I'm 63 years old. I appreciate great food and great people! I can't wait to try more food from here. Thank you! Be safe!

This was a disappointing stay the Sheraton Wilmington South Hotel. The blanket had a red stain. The whole place was unkept. The pictures do not describe the outdated and the dire need of renovation. As of late, I feel like the Marriott brand has taking a turn for the worse. This hotel and our room was outdated. Cleanliness was questionable. Appearance and maintenance are lacking. Felt like a motel where they attempted to do renovations and gave up. Friends who are at the restaurant on the first floor said it wasn't worthwhile. Would not stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Good place to get your hair cut. Joe and Mark are fantastic barbers. Just watch out for the new guy they have working there. I went in asking for a trim up and came out with what looked like a patchy buzz cut. He isn't carful with the thinning shears, and will leave you looking like you're balding if you leave him to his job unmonitored. In all honesty you're better off cutting your own hair than risking a job with him. I understand he is acclimating to his new position, but he requires more mentorship before wielding a pair of scissors.

Had a wonderful meal!! Will definitely be back. Started with the seafood crepe which was wonderful. It was light and flakey with plenty of seafood inside with a light cheese filling. I had the duck breast with blackberry sauce for my meal. It was amazing!! So tender and flavorful.  Everything was so fresh tasting. We finished off our meal with the chocolate lava cake. Perfect end to a wonderful meal. The service was excellent. We felt very pampered. It is not a cheap restaurant , but the food is exquisite so definitely worth the price. Perfect place for special occasions. Very romantic and eloquent.

Worst customer service. Called to order delivery on Halloween and was told no delivery due to drivers all doing a no show. Attempted to order online and was put on hold 6 times. When I finally caught the hostess on the sixth "Please Hold" comment, I informed her that she had put me on hold five times previously. She rudely answered that the store was busy and that in house customers had priority over take out callers. This place needs a management overall. Ended up calling in for Mexican takeout. What a joke.

the business is under new management lousy as fuck! order my food togo at 5:45 pm told me it will be done in 20 to 30 minutes. took over an hour for the food to be done got their by 6:45 look at my food my fucking green mussel were burnt to black, but they still gave it to me. i told to take it back and redo it cause i was not happy with the long order time and burnt food. well they took it back alright, but shady as fuck!!! they just scraped off the burnt mayonnaise and put new mayonnaise on threw in the oven fucking ashame. the rice was dry and hard and the mussel had no flavor and taste like a rubber. get your act together sho gun.

We had an 8:00 reservation but because of a delayed AMTRAK train we did not arrive until 9:45.  I called ahead to let them know and they were extremely accommodating.  The food was fantastic , ambience was great, and the service was top notch.  This is a wonderful addition to West Chester.  You feel like you have been transported to a restaurant in NYC.  Even though we were the last patrons there they did not rush us out.  I highly recommend the poached pear desert.  Here is the picture of the steak 3 people at our table shared.  Thanks for saving our evening!

Not good. Check in counter told us our room was to be ready in an hour, turned out to be 4. The hotel is loud and the walls are thin. Last night while trying to sleep I could hear people's conversations from the adjacent rooms and from down the hall. The windows do little to muffle the noise of the city outside. The valet service is really expensive, and they have three spots to unload from, so you might have to wait just to get your bags out. Just stay somewhere else. This place sucks. I wish I didn't have to spend a second night in this dump. The room was clean although missing normal furniture (no chairs??) bathroom in need of update.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Located in Walmart Well the service   1 cashier 2 people working the line the wait time about 10 to 20 minutes  we order (2) 2 for 2  (1)sausage and egg biscuit (1) big breakfast with hot cake they only give 1 syrup you have to pay .33 cent for the otherwe wanted 4 smoothie but they said the machine not workingand soda drinks they don't do refills but they fill  the cups up with ice so you get less soda refill cost 1.11  this McDonald's  the only one does somethings different the best stores so far I haven't had problems with is on the westbank a full staff to get inside and drive Thur moving quickly
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I stayed at this hotel for a conference in November.  I was given a room in the un-renovated portion of the hotel. The door was inoperable as I found out when i tried to leave the room.  I complained and was given another room in the renovated portion of the hotel.  Unfortunately, when I woke up at 6:00 am, I found that there was NO HOT WATER!!!!! When I expressed that i was dissatisfied about the lack of hot water, I was told I would get 20,000 reward points, however, upon checking my account, it was never applied.  Do not stay at this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is so shady and I will never come here again. My boyfriends went to get an oil change not that long ago. He have been having issues with his car recently. He took his car to a local shop and they informed him he has NO oil. The indicator says he should have 40% however it looks like someone from Pepboys did not not do the oil change and he still got charged. This place needs to shut down or do what a customer is asking for and not try to sell me services that is not needed; oh that was also what they did to my car.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I have been using this Carwash for getting my car waxed for awhile, and they do a great job, but several months ago I got the unlimited Carwash drive through package, and every time I stop by to get a quick wash,the people operating the machine NEVER guide you into the track, they just watch as you possibly damage your own car. It's the only unlimited pass in the area that I know of, so I'm stuck with it. 
It's not very hard to point left or right. 

When I lived in Sarasota there was a great one it was cheaper and included much more, included hand drying your car for only 14 a month.

We selected First Internet Bank based on a phenomenal rate quote.  Everything went ok until the appraisal.  FIB used an appraiser who clearly was told to low-ball the value.  For example, we received "credit" for our finished basement of only $5.40/sf and only $20/sf for additional living space on our main floor.  And we had to pay $395 for this completely bogus appraisal.  Needless to say, we would not recommend FIB unless you know you have stellar credit and have enough equity in your home to support a very low appraised value.

Horrible Horrible customer service. Our dinner took 60 minutes!!! The biggest issue was the table to our left had over 8 people, came in 10 minutes after us but received drinks before us.  We had to go to the bar to get our own ice water!!! The received their meals before us as well. I asked twice about our meal & was told it's coming. Even when I asked for the manager the bartender asked how she could help me but nothing changed!!! Never again. This was our 3rd chance  As the service was horrible both times before!!!!!

I have worked out all over the world, in facilities both great and small and I have to say, one of my absolute favorites is 12th Street.  They have a TON of equipment, a great staff and HOT men who work out here.  If you are gay and in Philly, you need to lift here.  In the heart of the gayborhood, it is literally on 12th Street.  Easily accessible and a long time sponsor of many community events, it is really a community center of fitness.  Plus, I met my boyfriend and now life partner there (and he was in town from London), so yeah, I am a fan. Stop in, pump some iron, take a class and have a steam.  12th Street has got it going on.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
This place is awesome! Super friendly, welcoming staff from the moment you walk in to the end of your meal. Laid-back vibe in an upscale environment. Delicious, hearty, dishes. Recommended appetizers include the burrata (a cool take on this classic with pickled beets and arugula) and the duck fat friend chicken wings (wow).

The pastas (pappardelle with braised beef, or the rigatoni with lamb merguez) are made in house and are perfect.
