Recommended mains include the pomegranate glazed eggplant, and the grilled half-chicken which has a really incredible crisp and is moist, not at all dry (I hate most chicken dishes and love this one).

I have no idea what you guys are talking about... I've been there a couple of times a year ago and both times the food was great! The first time we ordered a sun-dried tomato and basil pizza. Everyone thought it was amazing. Second time I'm not sure what we ordered, but we also got the dessert (a picture of which i posted here). I think whichever pasta we ordered was a little dry but besides that everything tasted good and dessert was delicious. We got a table in the outside seating area and the whole experience was really really nice. Maybe you just went there on a bad day. Every place has one of those.

It's been a long time since I've been to Lucky 13, and it was at the old place. I had a small pizza for $13, which for Boise seems a tad overpriced. It was tasty however- it was pesto, artichoke, tomato.  No service as it was self-serve order at the bar.  It certainly isn't anything like the old place, which was constantly full of energy and people. Too bad Lucky 13.  I wouldn't send people here from out of town on purpose, but eat here if you just want an okay place. Don't eat here if you remember when it used to be amazing, because then it is definitely a one star in comparison.

Oh my GOD, Tuna Dumplings!

Came to Vic with a Penn Alum who had been craving his favorite old neighborhood sushi spot, and I totally understand where he's coming from.  The sushi was great, inexpensive, and it's just a sushi bar - so it's fun to watch the chefs roll up the fish right in front of you.  The Tuna Dumplings were the star of the show - these fresh, bright red tuna pockets filled with avocado, wasabi, and I believe tomato.  Served with roe, eel sauce and spicy mayo.  It's like an asian guacamole extravaganza, and I'm a huge fan. 

Next time I'm back in Philadelphia, I'll be sure to stop by again, as I'm craving them right now.

Hotel is connected to Terminal B/C via a walkway and right across from rental car lots. This place made my 6:45 am flight easier to swallow.  Gym is a good size with a surprising number of weight machines (ie many); also open twenty-four hours a day. Checkin/out were quick. Some rooms have a view of runway. It's a good idea to print your boarding pass before leaving the hotel - at the B/C terminal ticketing is downstairs from the walkway and only the down escalator was in operation that morning. 

The only possible improvements to the hotel that I can think of are fairly minor -  perhaps nicer towels, flat screen tv and more cable channels.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I liked the hand grenades and the other drinks that they had too. They were as fruity as they were doused with alcohol. My friend brought the cup back with him to its final resting place in Ann Arbor after spring break. 

Sure this place is a tourist trap, but it's not bad for a quick buzz on Bourbon. 

Besides the drinks, this place was pretty boring. There weren't too many people there and it was loud and looked cluttered. It's supposed to give you that beach bum feeling but I'd rather not sit in a place that looks like it was decorated by Jimmy Buffett.

I'd definitely come back here again the next time I'm in NOLA though.

I love all kinds of food, most especially from those hole in the wall restaurants. So a few local Fenton regulars brought me here for lunch. The group suggested that I order the buffalo chicken sandwich and an appetizer order of the "Trashed Wings" to share. I love buffalo chicken anything, and always a yes to wings of all kind, so I'm game...
The buffalo chicken sandwich was tasty and a pretty good size, I liked the fried dill pickle too, but it's the Trashed Wings that put a smile on my face that day :) I think could have ordered a pound (or three) of those wings as my lunch instead of the sandwich! Maybe next time...

Went here for a quick meal and a beer and had a pretty decent experience.  The atmosphere is a typical bar scene and the place is a little cramped but the food is pretty good.  I had a greek chicken sandwich which was better than the atmosphere would lead you to believe.  We also shared some nachos to start which were huge and delicious (c'mon how could tortilla chips covered in chili, cheese, and sour cream not be).  All in all I think this is the perfect place for a quick low key dinner, but nothing too special.  They did have a good beer selection which might be a plus for beer lovers.

I'm sitting in Sound Cafe right now.  Brilliant.  I orig stopped by Flora which is nearby and it was sort of gross inside w/ no open tables.  Swung up to Sound Cafe and was relieved and encouraged.  Lots of clean, nice looking tables near outlets.  Beverage area is clean.  Service was relatively fast Free internet is fast enough for me to stream my audio lectures.  Great chai and lemon ice, and the food looked great.  Tunes are good but not overbearing, definitely liked this a lot and would come back in a heartbeat if I had to study.

I was in Nashville for business and we decided on Sunset Grill on a whim.  It turned out to be a great choice.  Very good variety of food and TONS of wine choices.  We tried a newer specialty wine - actually one of the less expensive options, but it was great!  The waitress was able to offer me suggestions when I narrowed down my entree choices to about three.

I really like the option of the dessert trio - the carrot cake was awesome - quiet possibly some of the best I have had in my life.  We also had the chocolate peanut butter cake and the chocolate pot de creme.  I would definitely go back if I was in the area.

FIX YOUR SMOKE PROBLEM. There is absolutely NO reason diners should have burning eyes from all of the smoke in your restaurant, which drifts up into the Tin Angel. When customers asked about why there was so much smoke in the restaurant, the staff blamed all of the burger orders. Now, I'm no restaurateur, but I am pretty sure there are many restaurants in this world that can successfully cook burgers without subjecting customers to smoke poisoning. People pay a lot of money for your food and subsequent shows upstairs - you owe it to your customers, and the artists who have to play in these dangerous conditions, to fix this.

Deserving of 4.5 stars: Great menu, amazing sushi, super chill Asian atmosphere, busy yet friendly staff. Cannot go wrong with any of the sushi or sashimi. Some downsides: Staff and servers don't have a lot of information on food allergy issues like gluten free food. Also when they become overwhelmingly busy, confusion at the front of the house gets frustrating. They don't have a computer seating system, so you rely on the memory and pencil of the hostess who quickly becomes overwhelmed on a Friday or Saturday night. 
If you like Sushi go to this place...you've been warned about what happens when they are overwhelmed!!

Such a disappointing dining experience last night that I had to share.  Besides not being able to offer any sushi rolls that were not pre-prepared and thus could not have been served gluten-free for some reason, the black cod arrived smoking hot, but with a taste and texture of having been recently microwaved from a scandalous state of frozen not-freshness.   Great decor though.

I'll close with one final thought:  If sushi rolls arrive with a food court sushi appearance and taste, then they should be sold at food court sushi prices.

This place has really amazing gourmet ice cream. The workers were really patient with me as I wanted to try a million flavors which I really appreciated :) But can we talk about the Bangkok Thai Peanut ice cream? Holy moly. Probably the most unique tasty ice cream flavor I've ever had. I would also say that this is just as good and Bi-rite Creamery in San Francisco (yeah, I said it!) Came back home to Chicago and saw that they had a location here which I'm stoked about. This will make for an awesome summer time treat in the Windy City.

Our van door mechanics weren't working properly, and our experience with David was awesome. There was a mistake made on our end with communication, leading to him doing extra work, and he was super gracious about the whole thing. Communication has been super easy through phone and text. I trust him with our vehicles, knowing he will give me the best price and labor around Nashville. I'm south of town and going to be passing dozens of other auto body places driving north of town to get our other car fixed (with 3 kids in tow) by him!

We are here from OC and staying at the Hyatt Place kWalked to the gym over a small bridge to Gold's gym, which was less than a mile on the left side. It was clean and modern and better than LA fitness in my area. Paid $20 for 2 days to work out - inexpensive. Front desk was friendly and didn't waste my time. There are disinfectant wipes, paper towels and bottle sprays everywhere. Luv this gym and makes me upset that Im stuck with the filthy LA Fitness and their old equipment. Everything here in new. I would be here everyday if I lived here. Good AC and clean women's locker too.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This place is terrible.  I went with my parents and fiance for dinner late one Wednesday night on their suggestion.  We asked the waitress some questions about the menu, like, is the white sauce on the special cream based?  She was clearly unfamiliar with what she the product because she just read the description from her cheat sheet again (which provided no info).  She couldn't describe what fusili pasta was.  I got some kind of pasta with broccolini (sp?) and sausage thing.  The dish was dripping in oil.  The sausage was tough, and the broccolini was soggy.

Absolutely gorgeous hotel in a great part of town.  Centrally located and close enough to walk to the French Quarter (if you like walking...it's not really that close).  The rooms were spacious and well-appointed, with comfortable beds and huge bathrooms.  The bar area is gorgeous, and the live jazz band on Friday and Saturday nights is terrific. The gym on the 32nd floor is one of the best hotel gyms I've ever used.  It had a great view of the city and the Superdome.  Overall, I was very happy to stay here, even if it was only for a weekend!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We asked for a room with two beds when we called to make a reservation, but we only got a room with one bed, and a couch(pull-out bed.) The should have told us to wait a little while so we get a room with two beds, or they should have told us they will try to get a room with double beds, and let us change rooms when they get one with two beds. I did not sleep well, and was exhausted all of the trip cause I did not sleep well on the couch bed. My parents slept on the bed. I slept on the couch. The positives were the shower was good, there were two tv's one for the bedroom, one for the couch room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The place wasn't too shabby. The waiter was very helpful and pointed out items he liked (not even the expensive stuff!). Anyways, I had the oysters which was really good in their special sauce (no not that special sauce). The only problem there was that they only gave a few oysters! The beef brisket was actually pretty good. All in all, it was nothing crazy, but Embers definitely doesn't deserve less than 3 stars. 
PS - stay away from the balcony if you have a fear of heights. Its on a slant and I thought I was gonna fall off.

Hotel is pretty good.  The beds are super comfortable and the staff are really nice.  The maintenance guy was one of the nicest employees...he greeted me like we were friends and he was just walking down the hall.  Then I heard him talking to others in the hotel the same way.  I thought it was great.  I was there for a conference and I am not a fan of their banquet food...eggs were runny and the selection was not great (but it was a banquet breakfast buffet...so hey what can you expect).  They have four treadmills so there was not a wait to get on them in the morning which is a plus.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I just checked for my week stay for work and I am so disappointed. The gentleman at the front desk was very friendly and so is the staff but these rooms are filthy. The floors haven't been cleaned in months and same goes for the dusting. I have terrible dust allergies and it's getting me sick. I asked to see if they had another room available and they were accommodating but the room was the exact same--filthy!  
They could easily bring their ratings back up if they spent a little more time cleaning these rooms.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I initially stepped into this place because it looks really cool from the outside, but the food was meh... 

I will say that their tuna tacos are pretty good. What I didn't love was how loaded their speciality rolls were. I'm generally a fan of clean sashimi or simple rolls, but all the rolls were piled with mayo/crab sticks.. it was just too much for me.  Also, one of my rolls had plastic wrap on it, which the waitress immediately apologized for and took off our bill. 

Don't think I'd come back here, but it's worth trying out.

This hotel doesn't have a whole lot going for or against it. The room was clean, and recently renovated. I was surprised to see that it seemed like it was recently renovated to 1970, but it seemed like an older hotel so I'll forgive it. The front desk staff was friendly and the room was quiet. My only complaint was the lack of fitness center on site - you had to go somewhere within a short drive, but the inconvenience was a pain. This will be enough to keep me from staying here again, but if that's not a big deal I think you'll enjoy the good service and fresh cookies at the front desk.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We are very disappointed with my entire experience at the Holiday Inn Express in Hazelwood, MO. Upon checking in I was not informed that the my room in the hotel had significant water damage, noisy construction grade fans, open exposed walls and ceilings with hanging wires, and many areas (including the dining area and meeting room) were not a proper environment for a four day hotel stay. 

We have had a very difficult time obtaining a refund. The hotel has not made an attempt to rectify the situation or communicate with us in a professional manner.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Don't even bother coming here.  What a waste of time.  Waited in line 30 minutes just to drop off my car for a simple oil change.  3 hours later my car was still in the same spot.  And when I asked why my car hadn't been worked on.  Got a sob story how it got really busy.  Still no explanation why my car was passed over for cars getting more expensive work done.  And then I was told to get a appointment.  I didn't know I needed one for a 15 minute oil change.  This place is a joke.  They need to just close sears already.  The service stinks.  Avoid at all costs.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Apparently one of the most popular taco shops in the area, we tried out the carne asada, adobada, and pollo tacos.  They're cheap, at $1.80/taco, and pretty tasty.  There's something to be said for having a simple menu and executing it well.  Lilly's does that.  The salsa verde was nice and spicy and they give you plenty of cilantro and onions when you order to go.  my only quibble is that the carne asada wasn't as great as I was expecting. It was a little on the dry side.  Everything else was very good. We'll definitely eat here again when we're in the area.

The worst! We rent cars all the time. We decided to try Hertz this time and boy was it a mistake. The car we had rented a couple of weeks ago was not available because of a flood we had here. We have a reservation, we have a confirmation number but, there are no cars available. Why would you not call? I called Enterprise as I left the parking lot. They had a car available, not only was it an upgrade, it cost less! Thanks, Enterprise, you guys make renting look easy, thought others could do it too, ha. I'll never try another place again.

This is a great place to stay in the French Quarter.  It's really cute, old, historic, quaint, and definitely has character without being expensive ($119 for a room with two queen beds and a sitting area in late September).  It's just off Bourbon Street, but just far enough off that it's not very loud.  They have parking too but don't expect to use your car while it's parked in their lot.  The only thing bad is that the beds aren't very comfortable.

So if you're expecting a typical chain hotel then try somewhere else, but if not the Olivier House is a nice home while visiting New Orleans.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I came here with my SO during Mother's Day week and we generally loved it. We rode the Jolly Trolley everywhere went.  They offer a private beach for hotel guests.  I love it wasn't packed / crowded. 


Pros:
Proximity to the beach! The beach is right behind the hotel. But it's a quite a hike.  They offer rides. 

Cons:
The bathroom is too small.  There is no reason why the area in front of the sink is carpeted.  Noise: Inconsiderate hotel guests are allowed in jacuzzi area at 3am and they talk loudly.   I called the hotel and they did nothing.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I wasn't familiar with the area so I decided to have my assistant make a reservation for the Marriott in Tucson. The one near the University costs about $280 so I decided to opt for the Courtyard Marriott since Im collecting Marriott points as much as I can. The cost was $130 which is way more reasonable if you're just there for couple nights to crash. 

However!!!! I made the huge mistake of not noticing how far away the airport is from the hotel. Its about 35 minutes away with no traffic... Tucson is so spread out... boo...  

The room itself is a little outdated .. Ive been to cleaner and much newer Courtyards outside of Tucson.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Happily satisfied with this hotel!  Asked for a quiet room and it was a very comfortable room (612).  Hotel staff was EXTREMELY helpful.  As soon as I got there i was parched.  I asked where i can buy a water and the girl gave me a cold bottle water.  Didn't even charge me!  Also, they let me use the internet there and were always available when I would call down for a question.  An added plus is the outdoor hot tub on the 6th floor.  It was very relaxing and good atmosphere.   Great location.  Comfy beds.  Almost a 5 star experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I'm a platinum Marriott member and have stayed at A LOT of Residence Inns over the past 5 years... However I was slightly disappointed by this one.  The hotel was nice and the staff was great w/ my son, however the problem was housekeeping.  Several times we mentioned we were leaving for the day and wanted to have housekeeping clean things while we were gone...  Never happened... 1 time, no big deal, 2nd time ok a little upset, 3rd time when we got home much later and my son was late for nap and housekeeping was just arriving, BIG deal.

Also perhaps the worst hotel internet I've EVAR had
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I was looking to branch out to other Chinese restaurants in the area and I thought that I would give Evergreen a try. 

I ordered the Mongolian Beef and got a heavy order of the dish containing some beef and a overwhelming amount of onions and scallions. There was only a whisper of red peppers. They were the only veggies.

While I though that the amount of beef was on the thin side of fair, I was so disappointed to be served so many onions. 

The delivery was earlier than expected, so that helped them get 2 starts.

My husband and I had been driving cross country and had been staying at motel 6's since they are pet friendly. The motel 6's in this area were not very nice so we looked for another option. La quinta was a breath of fresh air for us, we were frustrated we hadn't looked into them earlier. It was very affordable, only 70 dollars after tax on a week night.  Pet friendly, the rooms were spacious and clean! Had a fridge and microwave and also offered military discounts. Had some breakfast there is the morning which was alright and we were on our way back on our road trip well rested and fed. We will be staying here more often!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I don't know if they were still jn soft opening mode or??? Most apps eeee not available yet?? Or that evening. We ordered variety. Ribs were great, rice was crunchy not good (come on)  steaks were flavorless... Vanilla nothing memorable, over cooked and sent back. Salads and apps were fine, although cobb salad no egg? And chicken  overcooked!!! Desserts... Fab. Most not made here, but the mango cheese cake they did make was great. Location is great. I hope they succeed ... But they won't with what was served this evening. Service great.

First let me start by saying that it was the cheapest rate for three days ... With that said. It all started with the longest line in the Tucson airport. Stood for 30 minutes just waiting but when we got to the counter the person was pleasant and tried to do their best. We decided to get a GPS bad call all  of their GPS are some of the oldest units and they don't update the map. Old maps = Lost in the desert and they charged us 12 bucks per day. Car was clean and ok but given the GPS nightmare I give them a poor rating

Don't waste your time. We ordered a burger and "the old standby" breakfast. Eggs greasy, burgers undercooked, and fries tasted like they have been fried multiple times, very greasy too. We all wanted a food redo. - 3 meals all sucked. GREAT atmosphere great beers , good beer buzz UNTIL the food showed up.   I was ready for the best burger ever.  Open minded.   It came.   Burger was way smaller than the bun.  It tasted like Bison. I tried to fill up on the fries but god sooooo greasy.  You can see the grease glistening in the sun.  If you are going to be all artsy and have a Soup Nazi attitude just make sure your burgers are on point.

We stayed here for five nights while in town for DCI. It was perfect because it is so close to Lucas Oil Stadium. The staff was super friendly and always helpful. They always had good suggestions for food. We stayed on the first floor and felt none of the train vibrations that people talk about. Next year when it is DCI time again I will stay here but get one of the train car rooms.

The reason I did not give it five stars because we went to the hotel bar one night to get some food and it took us 45 mins to get a sandwich to go.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
After our stay I sent a letter to the Resort Management.  I expressed how unhappy I had been with my stay, their policies, which staff members had violated my civil rights, etc.  

All I asked for in return was an apology. It's been well over a month since I sent that letter. I didn't/don't expect to be reimbursed for my stay. No response.  None.  That's okay though. I've posted this review everywhere.  I hope that people like me with service dogs will see this and stay away. If this is how they treat Disabled Veterans SHAME ON THEM.  I should have let my friends contact the media when I had the opportunity.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Well, I wouldn't recommend this motel for a guy that likes sparkling clean rooms. The rooms looked plain and bland, the lighting was dark and dim, even with all the lights on. The AC didn't work even when it was 80-90 degrees outside. Even worse, there was no free wi-fi, clearly I expected more of a motel that cost me $124 a night. 

If you're the type of guy that doesn't care and just wants a some sleep, feel free to come, but if you want good rooms that really represent how much you're paying for, steer clear.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I would normally have only great things to say about the Landing, bit this last experience was very unsettling. I was seated outside with my husband and 1 1/2 year-old twins. The hostess brought us booster seats and after that we did not have anyone come over to take our order. We had to leave after 10 minutes after watching the waitstaff go to every other table, but ours. It's a shame because we tip more when we go out to eat with our kids because they can sometimes get a bit messy. Your loss, Landing! Plus, people we know that live in town, prefer any other restaurant that offer outside seating.

The hotel is right by the freeway, rooms are small and dusty, the AC is not central but wall mount dust blower, the lights in the room are not working, bathroom is small and toilet is right by the wall; a bit closer to the wall and I won't be able to fit my 127 lbs on it. Room is small and crowded with unnecessary furniture. The walls are super thin and we are able to hear our neighbors. Breakfast is not included as listed at the booking. They offer pastries and coffee/tea. Hotel doesn't have sauna as was listed during the booking on hotels.com
I won't be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Jim is excellent. I couldn't ask for a better person working on my car. He is friendly, sincere, knowledgeable, and I really trust what he says and does regarding my vehicle. As a young woman, I have taken my car to many places where I've felt (or been told afterwards) that I was being taken advantage of or made fun of for my lack of knowledge. I've never felt anything like this from Jim. He really listens to what I want, explains what needs to be done in layman's terms, and tells me about the different options of what to do, when to do it, and how much it will cost. I recommend Quantum Mechanics and Jim Mabry to anyone and everyone.

Ron & Jesse at the sears Auto center, make a great team.
The Nissan dealer recommended a rack and Pinon steering replacement, also a power steering pump replacement.

Nissan quoted me $ 1,200 for the Rack and Pinon & $ 556 for the power steering pump,
Pep boys quoted me $1,128 + 48hrs to order the parts + 2 days to do the service, which meant we were also going to need to rent a car.

I talked to Ron and Jesse at the sears Auto center in the morning and the work was completed that same day for half the price dealer quoted me and they did a great job!

Ron & Jesse represent sears Auto center best professionals
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: DO NOT EAT HERE. I was craving for Chinese today ordered delivery to the office. My first thought was that bag looks really old.. I opened the food (General Tso) and I though maybe they just make it different then other spots. I took one bite n spit it out. I love Chinese n we order usually from East Cuisine once a month. Even sometimes if it's not the best it had Never been this awful. The rice was so soggy it was mashed potatoes. I called them and brought it back and told them I felt like I should call the health dept. it is 6 hours later and I still have a cleanser taste in my mouth. Rude owners too.

I thought the portions were a bit small considering their prices were a little extravagant.  Their linguine alle vongole was really awesome.  It wasn't bland like most clam dishes.  I was able to try some of the other pastas, and they were all spectacular.  You can really tell that they are "home-made" dishes.  That could explain the smaller portions.

This is also a great place for dates.  The environment is spectacular.  It's not too crowded, not too loud. There's actually enough room to walk in between tables unlike most Italian restaurants here in Reno.  Just, right.

Like most of Italian Delight customers, I am a loyal 22 year fan of their fare. I hope they read this, because I have 1 issue which I feel MUST be addressed. When I order a pizza from an ITALIAN owned pizza shop, I do not EVER expect that when I ask for mushrooms on my pizza, that they are from a can! That is shameful. Please change this Italian Delight, and change it fast. I honestly have been going to Anthony's of Wayne just because I am so disgusted. Italian Delight, I love what you do, but quit acting cheap. Cut some damn mushrooms.

Had gone here once for lunch and wasn't unduly impressed.  Only went to dinner because I had a gift card.  I had the fried oyster appetizer, not bad, I've had better.  My steak entrée was mediocre, the meat was tough and not well flavored, the side of stuffed pepper with rice was also lacking in flavor with the pepper over-powering the rice.  The crème de brulee dessert was good.  Generally I find this place over-priced with small portions.  There is much better food at other restaurants within a block.  Not planning on going back.

When I order a Spicy Tuna roll I am expecting a SPICY roll sans the wasabi. Many sushi restaurants do not offer the type of kick I look for in a "spicy" roll, but Tokyo delivered. Their spicy tuna was actually spicy and had tempura flakes which added a great textural element to the roll.

Along with the Spicy Tuna, I ordered the Manhattan roll. I am not a huge fan of spicy salmon, but if you like tempura shrimp incorporated in your rolls you will love it.

Overall, I was impressed with the quality of sushi I stumbled upon on a work trip to St. Louis. I will be back!

I like MMG... I've been here a few times and have always had a good experience. I usually get a wrap, but I'm excited to try their other options too. The restaurant is always clean and the staff is always helpful and friendly. They always bring the meal to the table rather quickly and I never feel guilty bringing my son here to eat because the food is good and not bad for you like so many other places are. Plus you can usually find a certificate to buy on restaurant.com or some other discount site to save a few bucks on your meal, even though their prices are already affordable as is. I would recommend it, and would definitely go back again.

My husband and I really wanted to like this place after moving to the area from Philadelphia.  Sadly, the food is very unreliable.  Twice now I've found beef or chicken in my shrimp fajitas when I don't eat meat, only seafood.  Last time they forgot to include the tortillas with my fajitas and this time I got two regular-sized tortillas and one comically small one.  The guacamole we ordered was much smaller than it's normally been, too.  The food is delicious, especially the hongos quesadilla, but there have been so many problems with our orders and surprise meat in my food that we're going to look for some place new.

I'm kinda surprised by the reviews on Yelp for Embers. This was our first stop for food once we got to NOLA, and I thought it was pretty delicious!

The service was attentive, the drinks were great, and the food was delicious. We snagged a seat on the balcony and it's true the view from here is pretty neat.

I had the catfish, and it was tasty. My only complaint is that on the night we went (and it was a Friday) they seemed to be out of a few menu items, like the ribs for instance. 

It's a nice place to eat, especially if you want a decent sit-down dinner that isn't surrounded by your typical bourbonites.

Oh ya, the Bread pudding... YUM!

Nice charming quaint hotel. Good safe area. Valet parking is abou 45 a day. Pricey when there is plenty of street parking. Use the parking app park in the street and stay on top of it to not get a ticket unless you expect your car to stay parked all day. I love the lobby really like the hotel but the rooms are average. No microwave or refrigerator. No coffee pot. But free cofee in the lobby until maybe 10am. Even to get ice I needed to walk to the lobby restaurant and ask for a bucket of ice, incovenient but still a very nice hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I lived here for a little over two years and really loved it. I went from a one bedroom to a two bedroom within the 6 months and for not much of a rent increase. The location is great! I had beautiful mountain views. The area is clean and quiet for the most part, there is an occasional siren since the firehouse is across the street. The apartments even though for being older are large and well kept. I only give my rating 4 stars just because the main inconvenience was the laundry facility. If the office was not open, you could not reload your laundry card.

Walking into this place I was immediately shocked at how many craft beers they had in stock. All the other beer distributors in the area only have the basics. I assumed the prices would be sky high, but upon further investigation and help from the friendly staff, I was pleasantly surprised they were much lower. 

I came through on a busy Friday night and the young manager was beyond friendly and helpful explaining what each craft beer was all about. I'll def be back as soon as my beer runs low, which won't be long now!

As an added bonus they were playing some great obscure music which def will keep me coming back!

Maximo's was a little disappointing.  The best part of the experience was the service.  Heather was very attentive and helpful with our choices.  Especially with wine.  Unfortunately, only a couple of our  dinner choices yielded good results.  The salad with Gouda cheese and lump crabmeat was very good as was the crawfish penne.  However, the roasted garlic soup tasted too much like flour or the roux.  Plus, the taramisu had a cheap chocolate flavor.  Overall it was a fine experience but with so many great choices in New Orleans I doubt I'll be back.

Went to Santa Barbara to celebrate my cousin's graduation. When I had heard where we were going I was surprised because I had never heard the name of the restaurant. 

It turns out this was her 15th (I did say 15th) choice of restaurant, everywhere else was full. 

The food was ok, its nothing special. The best part of the meal were the slightly burnt slices of garlic bread.  I ordered the pesto ravioli (Its supposed to be a restaurant special), the flavors were not the greatest, I was kind of bland. 

This place gets 3 stars because the service was good.

Please create a rating less than one because this hotel was far below satisfactory. I will admit the view was great but that is the last nice thing I can say about this hotel. The rooms were absolutely appalling. The fact that the health department hasn't close this place down is beyond me. Not only were the rooms to Scott stating the staff and cleaning crew were rude and lazy complaining audibly on the fingerprint covered elevator about how they can't even remember which room they cleaned. This place is a joke in the fact that hotwire reads it as a 3.5 star hotel is a scam. This place needs to be quarantined.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Vanilla latte is all I have to say!! I took a sip and the first works out of my mouth was its perfect. I was a bit shocked as I was not expecting a perfect balance for my pallet. I usually add something to my coffee, whether it is more ice or milk or sugar, but seriously guys - it was perfect. Amazing. Go try it. Like yesterday. I thought price was fair because of the quality of the drink but didn't give it 5 stars because the service was just service. It was quick but I it was just like they were just there - Bland

I was in Santa Barbara to speak at an event kicking off Distracted Driving Awareness Month. The hotel was so nice! The outside is gorgeous. My room was beautifully decorated. The bed was perfect as were the linens. In the lobby you can get coffee or tea at any time. There is also a bowl of fresh fruit to choose from. My favorite part was the free bikes! I did not have time for a long ride but enjoyed riding up and down the street, checking out all of the neat stores. The different shops are wonderful. If you are a shopper, you will LOVE this hotel location! When I return to Santa Barbara, I would stay at the Montecito Inn.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: What a little gem we found on vacation!  Sat upstairs on the deck, seating is not that comfortable but you forget all of that when food comes to your table! Dishes are so thought out, special and dynamic. My fiancé is a chef so I didn't have to use my phone to google what half of the items were so with that being said, this place is for people who appreciate the art behind food and are culinarily cultured. I won't say foodie because the term has been watered down but something along those lines. Service is great, everyone is friendly and knowledgable! Not a place for kids, this is an adult hang out spot. Can't wait to go back again :-)

Came here mostly for the ambience of the restaurant. The food was mediocre but since Violino is actually an old mansion, it gives off a classy and romantic vibe. I like the intimacy of the place - would recommend to anyone looking for a date night type of restaurant. 
My boyfriend and I ordered pasta, and neither of us were really that impressed. I'm no foodie but I tasted a bunch of different flavours in my dish, and felt like they didn't go well together. The sauce was also too rich for my liking. 
It was a nice experience overall though!

Wow! This place has the absolute best customer service I have ever experienced. Management empowers their employees to be able to make quick decisions and do the right thing. Daniel was a super star employee when we needed help, and really went above and beyond. The culture at this hotel truly is one that allows employees to go above and beyond to ensure a wonderful stay for all guests. I travel often and have rarely been to a hotel that makes you feel this at home. I Will exclusively be staying here when I visit Santa Barbara from now on and will recommend to any friends and family visiting the area
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stay away.  STAY-A-WAY.  You've been warned.  Atmosphere... cold.  Literary- they cannot manage temperature when it is cold out.  We sat with our coats over our laps to stay warm.  Food... Nothing to write home about.  Brussels sprouts were average at best.  Grilled oysters arrived cold ( they were sent back).  Orders of "side" dressing came dressed.  One salad missed an entire dressing.  Kids menu was okay but my kids even said "we will not go back, Right?"  Don't get me started on the bathroom.  The ladies room was FILTHY.  One more try...  STAY AWAY.

Horrible. The top coat used on my nails was old and bubbled when dry. After pointing it out to the nail tech she made it seem like it was my fault  and claimed she had not had that issue with anyone else all day. She continued to have an attitude while redoing the color only for me to walk out with a mediocre paint job and dried polish all over my hands from the removal. Needless to say, I ended up not allowing her to use their top coat and just finished the job at home. Lesson learned: I should have done my own manicure.

I love hibachi and this place has by far the yummiest I have had. I won't ever recommend Bennihanna's - but this place has the full package.

My boyfriend and I will sit at hibachi and ask for a sushi menu. We then always order an appetizer. The spring rolls are tasty as well at the vegetable dumplings. You will never walk out of this place hungry. The atmosphere is perfect, along with clean-cut, friendly staff. Also, I have never seen but a crumb go ignored - very CLEAN! This is something important to me.

When we've gone a month without going, we go through withdrawals! Yum!

I was so disappointed we wasted a meal at this place. I needed to find a kid-friendly place that also served decent sushi and looked at Yelp for help. Unfortunately, I was steered wrong. The sushi was pretty terrible. The fish didn't taste or look very fresh. 2 of the rolls we ordered tasted exactly the same (the Aloha and the Firecracker) one was supposed to be spicy! They weren't rolled very well either, they were loose and falling apart. The tables were dirty and on uneven floor which made it risky to eat with littles... I would've given this place fewer stars but the location overlooking the harbor won it 1.

The avocado salad was very good--not a ton of flavor but with the addition of salt and pepper it turned out to be a very nice part of the meal. There was a half of an avocado that was very fresh along with fresh mozzarella, tomatoes and balsamic vinegar. Entrees were just very so, so. We have eaten at Luigi's in Jamison many times and find it to be way better than Tutto Mario. The food at Tutto Mario was edible but not anywhere near memorable. I think that if they worked on flavor--maybe a couple of visits to Luigi's, they might learn a thing or two and turn this BYO restaurant into a local star. I wish them well.

Standing in this Papa Murphy's location as I write this review. My online order was quoted to be finished 10 minutes ago and it's still in line with only one person making pizzas. I've been listening to the guy out of the counter have to explain they're out of thin crust, out of mushrooms, out of this and that. I can probably start counting on two hands the number of times I've had to wait a significant amount of time for an online order and we don't order that often. I love Papa Murphy's so I keep coming back, but I need to revise my expectations. Double the quoted time and you should be good...maybe.

Tiny customer service area, you're not allowed to browse the stacks probably insurance/loss related, regardless it means you have to wait to get to the front of the line to ask the attendant to go get your beer, if they even have it. Attendant positively sneered at my request and told me "maybe go down a mile across the city line for that stuff". I drink beer to get a buzz and not blow my paycheck. Since I live a short walk away and just moved here I would have been a regular. Keep this snide crap to yourself or lose a customer.

Another overpriced restaurant for the Philly area.  A friend and I did the chefs tasting menu.  Mixed bag on the food yes everything was presented beautifully but I was so over foam and rhubarb by the end of the meal.  Highlights would be their foie gras, bacon and eggs and the steak was cooked perfectly  the rest I could have done without. 

For the price it just was not worth it.  To many other great chefs and restaurants in Philly that I will not be back. 

One last point the bathroom situation is horrific. One bathroom unisex single stall by the front door.  Just bizarre

Browsing through Yelp for places to go eat breakfast, I came across the review for the Hampton Inn.  I'm staying here right now and I'm so pleased with my experience that I felt compelled to review it.
The check-in process was not only painless, but enjoyable.  The agent was friendly and eager to assist.  The rooms are what you'd expect which is a good thing. Thinking it over, things are better than I expected.  The team here pays attention to the details (good job housekeeping) which is appreciated.
Next time we're in the area we won't hesitate to book here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I shared the Tradicional Guacamole, Crispy Fish Tacos, and Chicken Taquitos between 4, and the food left everyone more than full.

The Tradicional Guacamole gets a 4/5: the taste is fantastic, but it defeats itself as a dish. The plaintain and malanga chips are better than their alternatives, leaving the end of the dish feeling worse than the beginning.

The Crispy Fish Tacos get a 5/5: Well executed, delicious from beginning to end, and presented well.

The Chicken Taquitos gets a 3.5/5: Not because it wasn't delicious - it was, but because it feels more like a food to eat drunk than a food for an upscale Mexican shop.

I was referred to Mass Ave Animal Clinic for my foster dog who needed some test done before I could put him in obedience school. They accommodated us fairly quickly and we had an appointment in a few days. I arrived 30 minutes early, found parking right in front (woo woo!) and called from my car to ask if  we could be seen straightaway if they weren't too backed up. They had no problem with this.  Zeus loved them and they sent his results directly to the obedience school when I asked.
The entire staff is so friendly and professional. I'd definitely recommend anyone bring their dog here.

Came in looking for a great meatball sub- found it but the service was blah at best. I get we arrived during the lunch rush but come on. My Mom and I rolled in in jeans and sweats for LUNCH. Everyone else were in suits and ties, ok. I get we were a small  check as we shared the sandwich but our waiter took our order and then promptly forgot we existed.  My water glass sat empty for over half the meal. He was quite attentive to the 4 top next to us. By the time he noticed we needed refills we had finished and were ready to leave. Although the staff was polite and nice I will not be returning anytime soon.

The building is beautiful; the office admin staff is fantastic.  The maintenance crew is very attentive. 

My issues:

1. The building has no insulation, which makes for awful noise control.  I literally can hear people walking down the hall.  If someone is watching a movie with bass i  feel and hearit.  I've complained, but nothing has been done.

2.  The Internet, which you must purchase through them, is spotty.  I'm tired of complaining about it. The solution ordered has been to upgrade, which I've heard from other neighbors isn't any better.

Too bad I can't leave 0 stars. Very unprofessional employees, couldn't even enjoy my meal today because of the employees arguing about raises and smoke breaks. I came at 2:25 pm on 9/12/19 and nothing but rude and unprofessional employees. Their female manager was being very loud and expressing how she should be able to smoke whenever, and she needs a raise by next month, and on top of the shitty service and dining experience, there's no soap dispensers in the men's bathroom, no ketchup in the ketchup dispenser, and the fries were disgusting. Zero stars.

I threw out my whole breakfast this morning.   My first bite was a greasy piece of dried up sausage, next I tried a greasy piece of bacon that tasted like several different meats (probablybecausethegrillneededtobecleaned).  The eggs were weird looking when I put my fork in them.   The part around the yolk seperated on the fork and looked stringy.  The home fries were tasteless and the toast wasn't toasted and was rubbery.   I will never come back here again!  This is all during COVID-19, I am so disappointed!!!

A nice enough hampton.  Could use a slight update to the room itself, but the hotel is nice, things were clean, breakfast was decent, and the beds were comfortable.  

I wish that they put a nightlight in the bathroom like some other Hamptons -- that would help.

I would be tempted to give 4 stars, except I am taking 1 star away for poor internet.  I was completely unable to stream any video during the evening, or the next morning.  I have had much better luck at other Hamptons, so I think this property just needs to pony up for some upgrades.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It was clean & well built place. The rooms are spacious, beds comfortable, and have a very unique New Orleans charm & feel to them. 

Only problem, we would have them clean our room every other day and our room was not vacuumed nor were fresh amenities such as shampoo/conditioner placed in the room. Not cool!

Only a 30 minute extension for a late check out . Are you kidding me? It's Monday after the jazz festival was over and everyone is leaving.

Hotel is nice but staff makes this experience less than pleasurable of a stay .
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This was my first time eating here and let me say I was NOT disappointed!!! My boyfriend and I each ordered the taco combination plate--shredded chicken and shredded beef with rice and beans. They were AMAZING and probably the best tacos I've had. We ordered take out and it only took about 15 minutes from the time we ordered to when they handed us our food. Quick and amazing food!!!! They require masks and do temperature checks before entering, but also do drive up service. Will DEFINITELY be getting take out again!!

I'm changing my original 4 star rating to 5.  We are at the end of our long weekend trip in Philly and after eating out every meal, this restaurant was our favorite. 

Original post:
We had dinner with our kids. Overall a fantastic place.  Service was great!  The meat dishes from the kitchen were wonderful.  Oh the mini trio desserts were SO delicious.  It's hard to choose our favorite bc we got to try almost all of them.  The only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is that the sushi was ok, not great.  

We would definitely go back.  Our kids want to go back tomorrow!

Absolute worst service I've ever experienced, arrived to Philadelphia and sent one person in our group to go out and wait for shuttle while everyone got their bags.. By the time everyone got their bags it had been about 30 min, so we called the front desk and they said they'd send a shuttle. After waiting another 20 min still no shuttle so we desperately went on another rental car shuttle just to get over to the general area and hiked our way to budget where of course there was one person working and we waited another 25 min. DO NOT USE THIS RENTAL PLACE, the "Budget" is NOT worth the inconvenience!

This place looked abandoned from the road and the neighborhood was sketchy; we were glad we could drive anywhere we needed to go. WiFi was fine, room was clean enough, bed frame on one bed was unstable but workable for one night. We missed the 6-9am free breakfast because the desk clerk hadn't told us the breakfast hours during check-in. We chose this motel partially due to its proximity to Broadway, and it was close, but it was a drive through an industrial area. We would not stay again if we were passing through Nashville. And it did also smell a little weird.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Walked in looked nicely decorated. Got our chips and cheese and was good. Service was very slow and chips weren't refilled for a while. It was raining and there was a leak so I had water dripping on me. I ordered Mexican street tacos and they did not come out with the correct fixings but by this time I was over the waiting so just ate them. They were pretty plain.  My husbands did not come with the advertised fixings either. The margaritas were a bit more pricey than your typical Mexican place.  The best thing we probably had was my daughter's chicken fingers and fries which are probably just frozen. Needless to say we won't go back.

$6 for a cone, $5 for a cup and you get two free toppings. Love love love the store and the pure quality of the ice cream!! I personally don't think this place is over priced and I'm usually one to think that all dessert places are overpriced. I got to try all of the flavors I wanted and if I came back next time I would've gotten the black seasame because it was such a unique flavor, with a bit of saltiness that played so well with the clean sweetness. The taro I got was extremely good and they give you a lot! Comparable to Soft Swerve in New York City.

Yelpers beware- this place is not kid friendly in the slightest bit (contrary to what yelp might lead you to believe.)  we arrived around 5:30pm with my toddlers in hope of checking out their happy hour for an early dinner and because we didn't/couldn't sit at either of their bars, we were told we could not participate in happy hour.   It would be physically impossible, not to mention illegal at one of the bars, to sit at the bar with children.   Very annoying and discriminatory if you ask me.   I was so mad about the above that the annoyance at their lack of kids menu and cups paled in comparison. Needless to say we won't be back

Not impressed, but I'll stick with 2 stars instead of 1 since I'm not a regular. Staff was snooty (obviously friendly with each other, but I felt like I was intruding on the "cool" table at high school). My blackberry tea lemonade (not even an espresso drink) took forever to make, despite being the only one in line with 6 staff members. (Again, I'll give benefit of doubt...the drive thru was hopping.) Lots of outdoor seating, but who wants to be outside in southern Arizona? I missed the driveway 3 times trying to get to the dang place, too. All in all not a great place from what I experienced.

Gave it 3 stars as this is usually a great place to eat but tonight (10/19/17) the service was so slow, my food came out cold and they served my whole table creme brûlée that was over cooked and the eggs scrambled. After they took them back and admitted they were bad, they offered us different desserts though there were none we wanted. Then the server informed us that we weren't being charged for the creme scrambled eggs and almost seemed to be waiting for us to thank him for this tremendous kindness. I am hoping this is a single bad experience and not the beginning of a trend.

My husband took my daughter and our baby boy in...he had a picture of exactly what we wanted for our daughter. The lady kept saying no I don't want to go too short until the mom comes in. Super sexist. My husband and I have barely any free time and he had a moment to finally get her hair cut and he said at least 5 times to please cut it shorter. She didn't. It looked exactly the same when she left. I had to pay for a babysitter for my son while I later today went somewhere else to get her hair actually cut. The pics below show before after and what we asked for. Thanks for a waste of our very small time we get..

We asked for early check in at 12. We arrived at 12:45 and didn't get into our room until 1:45. We had two dogs and a baby and sat in the lobby trying to entertain them as best as we could. We didn't complain bc we didn't want to be "those people"...and we tried to be understanding of a busy hotel weekend. Got to our room. AC didn't work. Our baby found a liquor bottle in the corner and brought it to me. Lovely :). And the sheets were dirty. I hate complaining. But we are from Stl and stay at their Westin a lot for work events and the difference between the two Westins is night and day. Our room was 513 on May 19, 2018.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Horrible!!! We were starving and decided to try out this place. I'm giving them 1 star because the service was great but not the food. I asked what was their popular item and she said the hungry man's burger..so I order that for me. I also order their chicken strips dinner and chicken sandwich as well as their mozz sticks. Took the Oder to go..usually this places give you lots of fries and their burgers are gigantic!! Not this place!! the burger was tasteless, chicken burger over cooked and chicken strips well done! you get about 12 fries with your order and same way...tasteless! Prices are a little high for what you get! Will not go back!

My salad was great! The service and attitude was not.  We came in for a quick bite to eat before heading over to Creekwood Estate, and we were less than happy. Don't recommend the kids fish sticks (burned) (youngest) or the Pony Burger (husband).  I had the Cobb Salad with Salmon and my oldest daughter had a sandwich. The tea was good but it becomes super strong for the amount of tea:size of pot. The service was not great.  Only one server was welcoming, everyone else acted like they were too busy or too important to help us. Not really happy, probably won't come back. Don't recommend. Super loud too, very dry and open room.  Not for children.

This has been the longest eye exam I have ever encountered. In total we have been here over 2 hours. Picked our frames prior to the visit, so we were ready to rock and roll. After waiting to begin our 330 appointment 20-30minutes after, waited 20/25 for dilation, waiting on a doc 15-20mins to be seen. We were also asked if had been helped cause we were there so long multiple times. The people are pleasant for sure but also if it's going to be THAT long they should let a person know. Eye exams generally are 45 minutes to a hour this was ridiculous
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Worst barber I've ever been to.  He did not listen to what I asked for and started going to town on my head with the electric shears.  I asked for 2 inches off everywhere and he ended up taking off 3 or 4 at least.  It was also extremely uneven.  I would have been ok if it was just shorter than I asked, but it was poorly cut as well.  The sides of and back of my head were at least an inch longer than the top.  I was going to get it fixed at another barber but I have to wait a few weeks before I even have enough hair back.

Went here one night just for drinks. I ordered their version of a bloody mary, the bartender came back saying they were out of the mix. Then I ordered a chocolate martini. The bartender confessed he didn't know how to even make one, took him about 5 minutes to make since he had to look it up. It was drinkable, but not worth $10. The experience was okay until I ventured down into the bathroom. It literally looked like it hadn't been cleaned in months, and there was a dead cockroach belly up on the floor. 
This place isn't going to last very long.

2 stars for the poor customer service. Waiter forgot to bring us utensils and we waited for about 10 minutes before she came by again. And they only brought one of the dishes out so we had to wait for another 15 minutes before we could eat. To top it off, who asks if we want more chips and salsa, but then only brings the chips and leaves the salsa bowl empty?? Did we have to clarify that? At a Mexican restaurant?! Food was standard Mexican fare. Plenty of other Mexican restaurants in the area so consider another option.

The location of the Dolphin Beach Resort is perfect. It is right on a beautiful stretch of white, powdery beach. The hotel restaurant/bar prices were surprisingly reasonable and they had a very fun karaoke night when we stayed. They also have a large pool, shuffleboard, volleyball, and a poolside bar with balcony area. The hotel is near other restaurants and a Publix grocery store, which is helpful. The rooms are clean but otherwise not particularly attractive. The rooms do feature microwaves and refrigerators.  The staff was very kind and attentive. I would definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place is run so poorly.  I went for my eye exam and they gave me same contacts, had to go back because I was having trouble seeing, ends up my prescription had changed.

I used my care credit with the understanding that it would be put on a promotional credit, this is the second time I have been told it would not be a problem. Guess what, it was!  I called on Tuesday and left a message for someone to call me back and no one called me back, I had to call again today only to be told that there is nothing they could do about the promotional financing.  

I am so beyond pissed and frustrated.  I will never go back to this location ever again.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Nooooo!!!! I don't like it here!!!   There were cigarette burns in the comforter of our no smoking room which also smelt like smoke...Soooo there is that.    The upstairs has weird swinging doors that divide the hallways and I felt like the building we were in was actually an old psychiatric ward converted to house the people crazy enough to book at this location.  

In the end I wasn't murdered in my sleep and I didn't get bed bugs so that is nice and we seriously only paid like $30 bucks and if you only pay a little you are only going to get a little.  Plus free Wifi!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Was lied to twice within 20 minutes of staying there. First lie, I was told I had a pool view. My room was on the other side of the building. No where near the pool. 

Next, I was given a double bed room. I booked a king. I call the front desk and was told they're pretty busy and she'll have to check. Get a call back 10 min later...no dice.

I go downstairs and see another employee, probably a manager, and make the same request. "No problem! We can absolutely move you." Finally got the room I asked for, but still no reason for lying to a customer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is by far one of the hardest locations to find. We are from LA and this was the closest 24 to us while we were in SB. We literally walked around for about 15 minutes until we met a nice local couple who was going to workout as well. We follow them in and they even mentioned that this gym is very hard to find if you are not from the area. The gym has three floors (Cardio, Main and Free Weights). The set up was different to say the least but we still got our workout in. The overall facility was clean and the girl at the counter was cool.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: You get what you pay for with a place like this: cheap and easy. Check in was fairly seamless. I was able to leave some tickets for friends behind the desk which worked out well with her key. The room itself was fine and actually a lot more modern than I was expecting. The curtains blacked out well to keep the daylight out for sleeping in. Shower pressure left something to be desired as well see in the room amenities. My only complaints were a very tiny pool that was much smaller than the website alluded to as well as some very rude housekeeping staff that wouldn't take the do not disturb for an answer. Otherwise ok.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I was in philadelphia for the weekend and a friend recommended this place for dinner. The interior of the place is really modern and elegant. 
I can't eat sushi for different reasons so I ordered the Black Cod Saikyoyaki even though everything on the menu looked delicious. My friends got sushi and they said it was really good (we all live in New York and it's really not easy to find good sushi here) and we shared edamame.
My cod was delicious.. really succulent, crispy and well seasoned. The portion is not big so if you have a big appetite I don't recommend it, or get an appetizer with it.

Great stay! My recent stay at this property was an outstanding experience! Tge addition of the Bistro and remodel updates make this a very comfortable hotel stay. With Starbucks coffee, beer and wine, awesome salads and meals, everything you need is here. Add a warm and welcoming staff, clean, well decorated rooms, you'll want to stay here. The pool, workout room, and laundry room are all excellent. My client meetings were managed by Patty and everything went well! From room set up, to a served lunch and even local transportation, the meeting went very well.
Stay here !
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Service was pleasant, but the food was very underwhelming. Our appetizer took 20 minutes or more to come out, entrees arrived almost immediately after.  Our entrees were cold and the food was fairly bland, pretty disappointing considering the menu is pretty expensive. Fortunately, our server was polite and comped our food items. We did not see or hear from a manager for the entire dinner service, which probably explains the poor food quality and long waits. Very disappointing. We used to love coming to Biaggi's but the kitchen has definitely changed for the worst.

This place has my favorite açaí bowl in Philly, and I come once every two days for it, some week everyday. The cashier/server are all very very nice! Best hire! They say "sorry" every time for a long wait! BUT THE WAIT for açaí bowl is TOO LONG. 
I hope the manager can see this review. You need to hire one more person at the cashier! I came in multiple times and there's only one person. Today, when I come in there are two açaí bowl orders ahead of me, and thank god they are phone orders, so I can get mine first!  But still, I waited 20 mins, and there are two people waiting in line to get ice cream after me!!! Please, HIRE more!

I have no idea how this place is rated so high. The service is good. The food is subpar. I ordered the Chile Rellenos, don't get them unless you like the taste of freezer burn. Rice lacked flavor, meat lacked flavor. If you're looking for authenticity, it's about as authentic as Taco Bell. In fact, Taco Bell's chicken quesadilla is better and it's $5 cheaper.

Best thing I ate all night was the fresh guacamole, that was good. Trust me on this one, the food quality and flavor is lacking in a major way. I'm guessing they hope you have enough margaritas to forget about what your food tastes like.

Horrible. I sat in the drive through for five minutes, I can hear the person taking the order talking to a coworker through the speaker. I loudly say hello? Multiple times, no response. Pull up to the first window. There's cardboard over it. Pull up to the second window. Takes them 10 minutes and multiple honks of the horn to get anyone to come to the window. Finally placed an order, but they didn't have any fries ready so I waited. Finally got my food, no ice in a warm soda. This place needs to be overhauled or shut down.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If you want to get good sushi, try somewhere else. I like Sushi Teri for the chicken entrees and they have good cabbage salads, but with the sushi, something just never tasted right. Don't get me wrong, the Crunchy Roll got me to start eating sushi [maybe cuz it's deep fried with a bunch of cream cheese?] so I'll always have a special place in my heart for Sushi Teri, but after going to so many other sushi places, my love for this place has gone down. Maybe it's super authentic and I just want more spicy mayo and deep fried stuff like the American I am, but it's a lil sketch on the fish side.

Come in around 3pm in a weekday because it's in top 10 list sushi restaurant in Philly. The sushi is at max standard american sushi with no further selection. The restaurant is more like a indoor sushi vendor with self server drinks. 
One of the thing that set this rating at 2 stars was because while we are eating, one of the sushi staff suddenly reached the wall, driled and removed a very dusty mounted-speaker. His crocs and the dirty clumps of dust fallen down are the last things anyone want in their raw sushi.

This is a nice, clean and well maintained facility. The rooms are functional and look contemporary. However, the bathrooms have no hooks for hanging toiletry bags. 

The staff is super nice and helpful. My only gripe was that the housekeeper gave me more shampoo instead of conditioner. 

They do have a nice little food counter and bar. Since everything is made to order, you need to plan extra time for breakfast. I personally prefer breakfast buffets for that reason.

Overall, this stay was a good experience, and I would love to stay there again when I'm in Tucson next time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
For starters, this hotel has way more then they can handle in it. Everything is done electronically and breaks down often. We stayed here for five days and within those fives days we had to have someone come reset our room TV twice. 
The hotel staff were really friendly. 
The room we stayed in smelled really bad even with the AC blowing. Although the Hyatt in French Quarter isn't as high tech, I would recommend you stay there before going to the Hyatt on Loyola. 
Secondly, they doubled charged my bank card causing my account to accrue many charges and overdraft fees. Not a happy camper. My next visit I will not be staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Come during busy time and order carefully. You should already have eaten being you're in a foodie town. If you are stupid enough to pass on the terminal market or Koreatown and all the great local places, bakery just down the street, and you end up here to judge Philly food by, you're just stupid. If you get tanked and need to fill your soggy belly, come up here, have your last two beers, and hang out with a great bartender and food to fill your void. You did that, you missed everything and chose hotel food, dummy.

This is the worst service I have ever had. We waited over an hour for the shuttle. We called every number we could find and they either didn't answer or told us to keep waiting. We eventually paid for a lyft. When we finally got there they told us we should have taken an avis shuttle as their shuttle isn't 24 hours. But how were we supposed to know that??? Maybe if they had answered our calls. We refunded the cost of the lyft but we didn't get the hour and fifteen minutes waiting in the cold back. DO NOT USE THIS TERRIBLE PLACE!!!

Something is definitely wrong when you need to wait over an hour just waiting in line to get a rental car.  Keeping an eye on the other customers in the building, everyone had a reservation.  This means the management could have planned for the amount of volume they had the day I was there. Instead,  countless others and myself were kept waiting, a horrible customer experience whatever way you look at it.  Not certain yet which vehicle I'll get, if any at all, but I do know I'll try the competitor next time.

Tried this as I was in the area and it was alright. The decorations were very cute and the servers were very nice. The parking was painful to find if you aren't familiar with the area. The service was good, nothing different.

To be honest, I appreciate that the menu wasn't overwhelming with tons of items. Their sushi ideas were creative and have some that I haven't seen anywhere else. Particularly, I enjoyed the Hollister roll but the cucumber kept breaking up and I wasn't able to hold my sushi together. 

I enjoyed this place, but I don't think I'd come again if I was in the area.

In a nutshell below expectation
Would I stay here again - No

Have heard and read great reviews about this iconic hotel.

On the plus side
Great staff - valet and front desk very friendly
Location - nicely removed from Santa Barbara but close enough to experience State Strip

On the negative side
Very noisy with thin walls. Vacuuming starts at 6am. Rooms although updated still leave a lot to be desired. Bathrooms- no water pressure in the shower, the sink leaks water on to the floor, constant, cracked toilet seat
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We found this restaurant thanks to yelp and couldn't have enjoyed the food more. The restaurant is small and unassuming with a very helpful and personable staff. BYOB was a plus too. I had the pesto stuffed ravioli which was made in house and delicately delicious. My boyfriend had the fish special and he loved it. We also started with splitting an amazing caprese salad. Somehow, we finally found enough room for the most delicious lemon desert I've ever had, lemoncello cake. Creamy and light as air - to die for! If we lived nearby, we'd be back very soon!

This is the real thing - and the only ice cream served at the Chick and Nello's ("Chick's") Homestead Inn in Hamilton.  The other reviewer has it right - Arctic has the best peanut butter ice cream on this planet.  It formerly featured a beautiful lunch counters and road fountain (and apparently some of the best egg salad around, according to my wife), but now it's just ice cream, frozen treats and ice to go.  

I cannot impress upon you enough how good their peanut butter ice cream is.   I've had several other really good - and often seasonal - flavors, but good lord if you like peanut butter this is the place.

All I want is a consistently good Carne Asada Burrito. Thought I found it when California Burrito first opened. Sadly, it's been all down hill since then. Every bite was half fat and/or gristle. Was barely tolerable but I was hungry so I thought I would power through it... then came the nasty pre-packaged "guacamole". Ended up throwing more than half of it away. This wasn't my first less than good experience  but it has been getting consistently worse, so I give up. Anyone want to start a GOOD *Berto's restaurant in BOI, hit me up!

My 14 year old dog passed out and was vomiting and released her bowels. She seemed to be dying so we brought her here. They had her inside for 2.5 hours only to tell us they need $800 to run diagnostic and didn't even give us an update on her health or her status. I had to address it myself and ask if my dog was even going to survive, which they couldn't even give me an answer to.. This place is very impersonal and insensitive. If my dog was dying I could be holding her right now rather than her sitting inside the vet scared and all alone. Would never come here again.

I was visiting on a work vacation from Houston. I got of my shoot late and my girlfriend and I decided to try this Rally's place people were talking about. Service is horrible, I went through the drive through and the person taken my order sounded like she hated everything. I was asking questions about the menu and she snapped at me. I just ordered cause it was late and I was starving.

Got our food and I have to say it was decent. Fries were crispy, and the burger was good. If i'm in new orleans again, i'll defiantly stop by.

This Hotel by far EXCEEDED our expectations. We celebrated our 10 year anniversary in New Orleans this weekend and decided to stay at the Hyatt Regency.  The BEST decision we've ever made! We were welcomed and helped right away. William ( Front desk agent ) was professional and friendly. The room was clean, very comfortable with AMAZING views. When you stay at this luxurious and beautiful Hotel ask for Room 2405. I would definitely recommend this Hotel to all my friends. Great experience! Highly recommended!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I was the only person in the drive thru line at the time and there were maybe two customers inside. The only thing I ordered was a vanilla shake. I was met at the window three times by two of the employees. At the first meeting, I was asked what I ordered and I told the first worker a vanilla milkshake. A second employee proceeds to come back to the window with a strawberry shake. I finally received what I originally ordered at the third meeting. I was the only person in line. My order was simple and yet it was butchered twice in the span of 5 minutes.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I spent 3 nights here and for the price of the hotel there are a few deficiencies I have to mention. This hotel was not  at all worth the amount of money that was paid for this conference. 
The water pressure was very low, I moved pasted it, the billing was incorrect and we were given excuses on why it happened instead of immediate correction. I tried to move on, but where I draw the line is my food.it was LUKE WARM and under cooked. The worst part was customer service was terrible and I actually will venture to say disrespectful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This is hands down my favorite place to drink in St. Pete. Drinks are more than reasonably priced. Beer selection is good, and the mixed drinks are fantastic! They are all about freshness here. I suggest the Moscow Mule. 

In the early evening it is a laid back vibe, great for after work happy hour. At night, around ten, especially weekends, it gets bumping. They have some amazing resident DJs. The back room pretty much turns into a dance floor when there is a DJ. 

Definitely follow them on Facebook because they have some really fun themed nights, and new art exhibitions every month.

Simply the best. I am extremely particular when it comes to my hair and they are all amazing. I have been following Sarah around for about 7 years now and the salon she has created with Mel and Kelsey is nothing short of amazing. I have tried almost everything they offer so I have a really good grasp of just how good they are. I have done all the following with them: lash extensions, hair extensions, spray tans, eyebrows, hair color, hair cut, uberlisse treatments, wedding hair and makeup(a few years ago)! They do it all so so well! Do yourself a favor and get an appointment!!

I came here with a friend and ordered the chirashi. The menu states that this entree comes with "15 pieces of RAW FISH" (emphasis added) 

 When it comes out, I notice there are 4 types of fish, and 3 slices of each. I bring this up with the waitress and after discussions with the sushi bar am told that the shrimp and egg count.

 Then we had a back and forth of me calmly telling her that the menu says in explicit language "15 pieces of raw fish." The shrimp..sure? The egg is by no definition raw fish. Ultimately I decided to let it go, but, what the actual F? Just a head scratcher. I enjoyed what I had, I guess, but.. come on, people.

1 star is almost too generous for this place. Went in around 8 pm last night with the wife. They close at 10 on Saturdays and I get that the food won't be as fresh at it is during the dinner rush hours. But this was ridiculous. Limp lo mein, soggy crab rangoons, and chicken dishes that had been sitting around for too long is what we got. The ice cream area even looked a mess and was not good. Cleanliness of the place was also sub-par. I read other reviews saying that it's better during lunch and peak hours, but we won't be going back. Skip it.

Extremely disappointed to not find some key Thanksgiving ingredients stocked up.  It's the Tuesday before and there was no sage to be found...the shelf that should have chicken stock was empty except for broth and beef stock...I did find some strange brand of stock elsewhere, but I am particular about the stock I use.  Also no boxed brown sugar on the shelves.
