They do not appear to be prepared at all for important cooking holidays.  I think the remodel is great, but please think ahead and keep those shelves full of the key ingredients.  Whoever does the ordering didn't get it done this time.  Very disappointed indeed.

The accommodations were clean and nice. It seems they have made some nice improvements, because we had a wonderful experience with the staff and hotel. Everyone working would speak and ask how you were. The only reason I didn't rank it a 5 star was because the carpet could have used a good steam clean and the person who checked us in did not complete the checkin properly, so it caused a hiccup later. No major harm though, they fixed the issue politely! I would stay here again. (They said they were updating their wifi!)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My family has been coming here for years; it's the gold standard of Mexican food. I typically get the chicken chimichanga and highly recommend it. I have tried so many other local Mexican restaurants and there is only one other one that lives up to Mazatlan... and it's in Knoxville! Their soft drinks taste incredible, too! Some places have flat soft drinks or some that taste a little off but I could drink their Diet Coke all day. The staff is also great. If you find yourself craving a meal south of the border, head over!

While this hotel has a very scenic location and great views of the water, it is extremely old and run down. The rooms need renovations, the hallways smell terribly, and the pool is very inconvenient to get to. In addition, the key cards barely work and you have to try them multiple times to get into your room or to go up and down the elevator. On top of that, there is a lack of restaurants in this Harbour Island area. The hotel restaurant is the opposite of trendy and not very inviting. There is no vibe or atmosphere in the lobby either. You would be better off staying at the Aloft or Le Meridian on the other side of the bridge.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
If I had the time to report this complex to the authorities, I would.  
If you chose to live here, KNOW that the office staff is unprofessional, do NOT follow company policies and their corporate office isn't any better. 
Crime is HIGH. Cars and apartments broken into as well as massive vandalism. 
The grounds are filthy, and the apartment units are NOT up to code.  All of the units are infested with MOLD.  Cabinets have water damage & are warped.   Drawers do not work, doors do not close or open without getting stuck.

If I could rate this complex there woukd have to be a NEGATIVE star chart.

We understood that a party of two with no reservations might have to wait, so we were completely fine with that-  especially after being told it would be about a mere 20 minutes!
However, the minutes ticked to 45, and the thing that caused us to leave was the fact that at LEAST two other couples with NO reservations were seated before us. (We know.this because we were standing right next to the host.)

We were also accosted by a burning smell and plume of smoke the second we walked in, which lingered and worsened. Never again!

This is the first time I could not rate 5 stars for this restaurant. I couldn't even finish my (expensive) food it was so bad. It seemed like food that had been reheated, not freshly prepared: mealy shrimp, crunchy rice, rough and stringy vegetables. It was lukewarm upon delivery and late (deliveryman admitted that he had been across town and told "my" location to make sure someone else delivered my food, but that it was still sitting there when he returned later...). The only good part of my order this evening was the 2-liter of Pepsi®!
The attached picture shows how much food I couldn't eat/wouldn't save for later.

I went to this salon on a whim because I had limited time available,  I could not get in at my normal salon and needed my nails done before an event.   My fill was completely rushed and was done in 20 minutes. No surprise within 5 days I have 3 cracked nails.  ( I haven't broken a nail in the past 7 months with my regular place.)  When it came time for the pedicure, they automatically applied gel without asking me (which I didn't want) and I ended up paying $85 for a fill and pedicure! Way overpriced for a low quality service.

My family and I booked this nail salon to have our nails done for my wedding. We had made an appointment and when we arrived they were moderately busy. Making an appointment did not seem to make a difference since they took me, my sister, and my mom back and different times and didn't prioritize us at all. I was not happy with how my nails turned out. The acrylic was clear and he did not smooth out where he filed down my real nail so you can clearly see it. The white tips also start further out than my natural tips and you can see them through the clear acrylic as well. Overall not at all worth over $100!

Decent sushi spot, good-sized maki. Fish is definitely better than average, though not stellar. Prices are average, though everything is more expensive in Santa Barbara, so I guess you've lived here your whole life then you are just used to it.

Do not get the ramen-- unless you have never had real ramen in your life before, in which case, yes, this is a step above Cup Noodles. But definitely nothing like you'd get at a real ramen house or even one of the popular California chains.

Definitely a good choice for sipping some Asahi and enjoying some maki on the patio.

Great VW/Audi auto shop! I have taken two of my VW's to Stuttgart over the past six years. They have always been reliable, honest, and cost effective. I usually save about 20-30% over what the dealership charges. Even when I've had to take my car to the dealership Stuttgart has been there to answer questions and tell me the true price for parts and labor so I know the deal I'm getting. As long as I live in Tucson they have a customer in me. They're also an APR tuner now which is awesome! No more trips to Phoenix for tuning!

Their gel manicures are the tits! 2 weeks with no chipping! That's a A+ in my book. It is overwhelming with all the manikin hands however, you can see how all the gels turn out which I personally love. They will do a nail design you found on Pinterest but if you want foil lines just bring some. They have every jewel/rhinestone under the sun. If you show up early you'll have time to pick out a color and/or design without feeling rushed. They are a busy salon. The salon is also CASH ONLY. They do have an ATM with a $1 service fee but they return the $1 when you pay.

My dad loves seafood and sushi, and had been wanting to go here for a while.  We were visiting him from out of town and took him, and I'm really glad we did.  

It was a great little place, very quiet and casual. There was four of us and we decided to order the party platter called the "Love Boat."  It's essential a wooden boat filled with an array of sushi rolls (chef's choice) packed together.  

It was well worth the price and offered us a wonderful sampling of their roles.  It was more than enough to fee us all, but we did add on the miso soup.  

This would be a place we will definitely go to again on our next visit to Indianapolis.

There were things here I did and did not like. The lobby had a great touch screen to help you find attractions and events nearby. I really liked that. The room was super cute. Great open are withe kitchenette and working desk. 
I didnt like the way the walls seemed to amplify any and all noise! I fekt like people were right in my room! The door slams so hard! The  balcony slide doors you can't use, have trapped condensation between the glass and looks horrible. White streaks are so bad you can barely tell what youre looking at.  Elevators are slow. I guess thats about it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Holy God.  We tried this place based on the reviews here on good ol' yelp, but what a mistake.  I won't even talk about the terrible service, because our food experience was horrifying.  We ordered a ton of stuff, but the highlight was the chicken fried rice, which actually turned out to be COCKROACH fried rice.  We are so lucky that the roach was just sitting on top of the rice, and that we could just politely decline the food and leave. . .  Are there any health codes here in sunny Florida?  GROSS!  Sound unbelievable?  Check out the pic!!

Beautiful chandeliers in the lobby area and nice set ups in the rooms. I travel for work often, so I basically live in hotel rooms. The Magnolia offers awesome perks like free HH from 5:30-6:30, free "bedtime cookies" and free breakfast ( a little limited). 

I would say however the room is missing a fridge and microwave! I was bummed when I came back with leftovers and ended up having to trash it. :( Also the restroom was so small! I didn't like the set up and how there was no counter space.

It's downtown and a block away from my office so this is a plus in my book. Service during breakfast and their HH was excellent.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The people were nice but they seemed overwhelmed and taking on too much. Waited 20min with an appointment and while she did a decent job on my pedicure with cleaning my nails and calluses, once I said I wanted a nude color, she just did one coat and no top. Then when she did my manicure she didn't even fully remove my existing gel and just tried to stand it off. My nails weren't shaped or filed properly. She gave me a nail file when I paid and said I can keep it.

Update: even worse after my hands dried from the lotion all my cuticles started bleeding cause she had over cut them.

Went in for a quick haircut with my girlfriend this weekend. She got quite a bit of hair cut off, and I had a pretty normal haircut.

First. We both loved our hair dressers. She had May, who was very meticulous, and I had Ansen, who was quick and great! I particularly liked how Anson didn't really talk to me all that much - I showed him what I wanted and I was able to sit there peacefully and enjoy watching him cut my hair.

I was particularly impressed with how May went the extra mile and actually styled my girlfriend's hair for her!

This is a great place to get your hair cut, and I highly recommend either of them!

My account was locked after I had made an online purchase. When I called this branch to have it unlocked, the woman told me that I was mistaken because I didn't spend over $2500. I told her that yes, I spent much less than $2500, but I was nonetheless unable to make any purchases on the card. She told me that it was because I made my purchase online and that I need to call the 800 number (which hangs up on you if it can't solve your problem) each time I make an online purchase, no matter what the amount. This is absurd and disgusting. I won't be banking with Kinecta anymore.

Markus has been cutting my hair for 19 years!  He is a compassionate and talented stylist.  We've been through countless styles and colors together over the years!  Markus did the hair for my wedding and it was fantastic, he was a perfect calming presence on a hectic morning!  The energy in the salon is wonderful, friendly, supportive, and positive.  Markus and Chris are a fantastic team and really make all of their clients feel comfortable.  

I highly recommend the salon and have sent many friends and family there over the years!

Yuck!  The smell when you first walk in is disgusting.   Pia, our server was very snobby and when I had a bad piece of fish, she certainly had an attitude about it.   I did have one piece that was very good, but the other was very fishy.  I asked her if I could have a piece that was fresh and she stated she did not want to take a chance to select something else.   She was not very nice at all and way too snobby for me!   Perhaps an apology would have been in order.  If you look at the menu descriptions you want to run!!!  Pigs ear, calves tongue, need I say more!  It does not exactly get the juices flowing in a good way.  Never again for me!

A restaurant / bar located inside the airport Marriott.  Staff was friendly and even though they appeared to be short staffed they greeted me and took my order in a timely manor.  I ordered food to go to the room so I stood near the bar waiting for my order.  The decor was nice but the negative note is the floor was very sticky almost pulled my flip flop off my feet every time I took a step.  The food was good with the exception of the burger I ordered didn't receive time to rest before it was placed on the bun so the bottom bun was soaked in grease and super soggy  The fries were good and the cheesesteak my wife ordered was good.

I've tried again and again to like this place and every time I get my nails done they are never how I want them. I explained that I wanted round and after many times of asking her to round them out more, they were still more square. The actual colors never seem to match the example, which is frustrating. I've gotten acrylics done before here and they seemed to be the best bet for me because they wouldn't mess up the shape as much. But when I get a gel manicure with my own nails, they're not good and my nails are never the same shape. Sadly, I don't think I'll be coming back here.

I got a pedicure.  The end result was very good and the man who did it was very nice.  However, he was verrrrryyyy sloooowwwww and kept jabbing me with the cuticle cutters.  I kept pulling away and he did seem like he felt really bad about it and he did apologized every time.  He just seemed like he wasn't sure how to wield them.  The calf massage was not that great - a little weak!  It was definitely inexpensive which was nice.  The chairs are fabulous, some of the best I've experienced - they really dig into you.  Overall, I'll try the place down the street before I come back, but if I'm in a pinch I'd give them another chance!

Stopped in on a Monday afternoon, hoping to have a quick bite. Sad to say not at all what I was hoping. Service was so slow that (even for a Monday during slow service) we had to flag someone down twice. 

When we walked in the restaurant smelled fishy, which is never a good sign for a sushi restaurant. Noticed the sushi bar chefs were keeping the refrigerated compartments open. Gross. This was a constant throughout the time we were there.

The only good point was a server that tried to help us, but we still waited on a serving of rice that took 20 minutes to arrive.

Overall, completely unsatisfied with it.

If I could rate this company in the negatives I would. Lakeridge is the most unorganized incompetent group of people I've ever worked with. They were NEVER helpful, they were dismissive, they were "new" and didn't know what they were doing. Any service request I placed was never tended to. I had to submit MULTIPLE requests and make numerous calls before important issues such as water leaks were fixed. They tried charging me $200+ in BS charges after I left. They simple have no idea what's going on here and I HIGHLY DISCOURAGE anyone from ever renting an apartment here. I didn't read the reviews before renting and man did I wish I did.

Checked into this hotel on a whim and it's an interesting and different type of hotel I normally stay in. Would categorize as a hip type of hotel. Room was nice, bed was a foam mattress and I slept like a rock. Bathroom was large with walk in shower and shower head above you. Was very comfortable in the room. Prob not a place to bring your kids. Negatives were the coffee was cold in the morning, I don't think you get free breakfast, and it took me 20 minutes to check in at midnight. May or may not stay here again.  Trendy type of place for younger adult crowd.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I love this hotel!

The location of the hotel is great--located right in the city next to St. Elmo's, which is very convenient. It's also walking distance from several other restaurants. In addition, the rooms are spotless and beautiful. They have a nice modern touch but are very warm and comfortable at the same time. Lastly, their staff is wonderful--they are extremely nice and make you feel welcome, which is something I look for when staying at a hotel. Overall, I would definitely recommend staying at the Le Meridien,
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My wife and I visited a year ago and couldn't remember why we hadn't been back. We visited again yesterday around 4:00 and remembered. We stopped in for their half price apps promotion. We ordered chicken fingers, sliders and onion rings. Tough to go wrong with those, right? Wrong. All of the food was obviously frozen and had little to no taste. The sauces they provided were pathetic. There was some sort of mayo based sauce that was served with the onion rings that was just plain gross. The only flavor to the sauce was mayo. There were only 2 other tables full and service was still slow. We won't be back.

I wish I loved this place!  You can't beat the atmosphere and bar service, which is why I've come back several times.  They turn a standard mani-pedi into an exciting, luxurious experience.  However, compared to other, less trendy salons in Nashville, the quality is unfortunately sub-par.  Though employees seem to work conscientiously, the immediate aesthetic is lacking, and polish jobs seem not to last as long as the do at other places.  This paired with the highest prices in town.  I hope they can improve their quality and make this place worth returning to!

Arrived at restaurant only to find the door to the restaurant locked. At first thought there must be some private event even though we had called ahead to make sure they were open.
When we finally got the attention of a waitress she unlocked the door, stuck her head out and simply told us in a pretty unfriendly manner that the restaurant was full. When asked why the door was locked, she explained that the owner likes the door locked when the restaurant is full.
Uninviting and just weird. Needless to say will not be back.

The guys over here seem nice. Shop is impressively clean   Dropped my truck over here in limp mode and they had it for about half a day. Their response to me was " these trucks go out all the time" basically telling me the truck was no good. Didn't charge me anything for that great info so that's nice! Had it towed to Honest Auto Service on the Westbank and they fixed my truck for $500. They said there were a couple of electrical shorts. GR is probably good for simple stuff but maybe they don't have the know-how for everything.

During the daytime it's ok but after the general manager leaves keep driving and save your money going hungry is a better option. The service is unprofessional and rude, food is old and cold. And the later you go the worse it get! I'm off work at 2:00am I ask for a quarter pounder with cheese I was told "we ran out" I ask for a Big Mac I was told "we ran out", so I ask what do you have? So the young lady answered "sorry we're close". You probably ask why do you keep going back? Well because I'm hoping they get there act together and it's on my way home.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Pretty stellar nail salon. Usually can walk right in with little to no wait as it's well staffed. They do a really good job and the massage (foot and shoulder) are pretty nice! Pay in cash and get rewarded with extra "stamps" on your card that get you to discounted service quicker. Plus they pass out coups like it's going outta style. (I'm a sucker for coups). For whatever reason, I feel like they have some sort of magic beans mixed into their top coat because my nails always dry faster here than anywhere else.

The first phone call I made this morning was to say "THANKS!" to my friend that suggested Trattoria Vittoria for our dinner last night.

Food was terrific, service was just right, drinks were awesome (the best Mai Tai according to my girlfriend), if they repeat this performance on my next visit they will get five stars!

Ordered the Prime Rib Ravioli and Veal Tortellini with a side order of sautéed vegetables that we shared. Ravioli was our favorite and even the vegetables were awesome.

Small, intimate setting, tables are close together, we where there right when they opened so it wasn't to busy yet and we both liked the décor.

You can tell this is a brand new restaurant. Too many hard surfaces make it a bit loud, and the serving vessels seemed a bit "unpolished" 

I'd definitely give this place another shot. The food was really great, and the small plates make it great for sharing and watching your diet!

We went on a special event night. They appeared to be pretty well staffed, and the kitchen got food out without delay, but we probably waited too long just to be offered water and way too long for drinks. In one seating, we actually only managed one round....yet the bar didn't seem busy.

The staff was very friendly and pretty knowledgeable about the menu.

Wanna have a consistent bad experience.   Come to this hotel.  
I waited once again 55min for a van to Hotel all while calling 3 times and staff saying "10min they will be there." 
Room wasn't ready
Drinks at their "restaurant" you will be waving off flies left and right from trying to get into your drink.   Then stay on your sever or your Salad will take over an hour to come out with flies in it as well.  
Save your $$$ and go to a completely different area; because every Hotel is shared by ONE VAN and is way under staffed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Somehow got charged $5 per sandwich on the 2 for $6.
Mentioned it to the lady at the window and she charged me full price anyways. My water cup had Hi-C in it and I mentioned that to the lady and she gave it to me anyways. Asked for ranch and got both the lady at the window and the lady bagging food rolling their eyes at me. Kind of a mess of an experience there and I don't think the employees care about the terrible service they're giving. Don't think I'll come back anytime soon and I frequent this area. I used to manage a Chick-Fil-A and I'm just writing this review because I know from experience that good service is not that hard.

I come here very often, but my experience today was horrible. I ordered a spicy deluxe crispy chicken sandwich. Came home to find out it was just chicken, bun, and some little sauce. Where was my tomatoes? Where was my roman lettuce? Why did i pay for extra and didn't even get what I wanted?
I then proceeded to try and call them SEVEN times with no one picking up the phone. It was NOT during rush hour (it was at 3pm-ish) so there was no excuse to (1) mess up my order and make me waste my money and (2) not pick up the phone.
0/10. Bad experience. This was horrible
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I was there on Friday night and sat outside. I was pleasantly surprised that they had a live band. They weren't great but enjoyable, not too loud, you could still carry on a conversation. I was dissatisfied with the service. We had to wait about 15 minutes even to get a glass of water. Martini menu was also a pleasant surprise. The server and owners were very kind, but service was very slow. The lettuce was wilted, and seemed to be bagged lettuce rather than fresh cut which is what I would expect. Overall a good experience despite having to wait for water and drinks.

Update- Area Manager followed up and reviewed this and made it right.  Thank you.


Customer service - well I wish they knew what that meant.  There are a lot of companies to rent cars from, and I recommend NOT using Enterprise Rent A Car.  I have used this company in CA for 20 years and always received fantastic service but my one and only time now that I live in Plainfield was last weekend when it ended in a sour note.  I understand that all businesses are here to make money but the extra $70 charged has eliminated any and all future business from me.

Ok so I gave the place another chance seeing that they are the only place besides dominoes that delivers by me. They have totally redeemed themselves. 
They are under new ownership and perhaps just had to figure things out. However the pizza was great, nice fluffy crust with sesame seeds. The calzone is huge and delicious and the garlic knots were good too. 
The new owner is very nice. I decided I would go in and pick up my order this time and see what was going on. 
I continue to order from them once a week.

Three valet gentlemen outside when we pulled up and not one of them offered to help. Had to unload car myself and then ask them if they actually worked there and if they could valet the car. They seemed put out at my request for them to DO THEIR JOB. Once checked in, room had to be switched because we had three people in my party and the room they gave us only slept two... Once in the second room had to have maintenance come fix the A/C because it wasn't working properly and ultimately they had to bring a floor fan. 
Four diamond hotel proved to be anything but that.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Not recommended unless you want to part with your 10$ for no reason
3$ car wash at airport parking was a way better experience.
Bugs (fresh) and dirt from undercarriage ( which I paid for an undercarriage wash) and front bumper are still sticking on quite well. Don't believe that there was even an undercarriage rinse since the underside seems dry. The owner was at least courteous while another guy who seemed to be his relative was rude for no reason was yelling from the beginning while giving directions to steer. I was through the whole wash process in what seemed like under a minute.

Came in for breakfast,  my daughter asked for water, and never received it. After about 30 minutes we finally received our food. Mine was made incorrectly, and we had to find someone to get it sent back, which took a while. While waiting for my food to be made correctly the rest of my family was already finished with there food. Our waitress still hadn't stopped by to even check on us so my husband went up and told her to cancel my order since it had taken to long. We emailed the hotel about our experience, and not even a response back. The whole experience is not what I would expect from a highly rated resort.

I stayed here with my family on a 3 day vacation to the city. The location was fantastic, the room and parking was a great deal and a great value, and I genuinely enjoyed the staff. The rooftop pool was a nice touch. I have a3 year old son who loves to go swimming and I found it a very family oriented atmosphere. Would happily have given 5 stars except for the common areas smelled unpleasant. I'm not exactly sure what that was about but it lasted the entire time I was there. Also easy loading and easy load out and their  attached parking deck is super convenient.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've stayed here twice while visiting the Tampa,FL area.  It's tucked away in the Brandon area and I love that.  The staff is extremely courteous and accommodating.  During COVID the pool closes at 5pm.  Breakfast is included in your price and it pretty good.  My room was a suite with all the necessary appliances needed for an extended stay ( full size refrigerator, microwave, stove, and dishwasher).  All this for just a shade over $100.  Excellent value.  The bed sleeps well and the shower is great.  I love this hotel!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We are traveling on our RV and staying in Ruskin. Hubs likes to try out different restaurants and eateries. From the outside the bldg could use some updating as well as the interior. What made the stop worth it was the burger with works, fish n chips, fries and soup and that Gyro plate! Oh my goodness, never judge a book by its cover! Vast menu and plenty of different plates to try. I was very pleased and hubs too. Great prices and our waitresses were busy but still attentive!This is the second time we visited in a week...:)

Stopped in for a late lunch and had a great table on the patio with views of the Catalina Mountains.  Menu was much more than pizzas and burgers.
Ordered the Italian beef sandwich with house-made chips and my spouse ordered the hummus-veggie sandwich.  Both were excellent.  Served on their own baked bread which was delicious enough on its own.  At first, I thought the beef was a bit tough, but it seems I just had too much in my first bite!
Our waitress was excellent, Amira, and you'll be fortunate if she has your table when you're there.
A definite "go to" spot when in the Oro Valley.  We will return.

I made a reservation to pick up a car here and upon my arrival, I was told that they had no car for me, despite my confirmed reservation. No other rental car agency at the airport had cars available either so I was completely unable to get a car. I asked to speak with a manager who told me to take it up with corporate and there was nothing he could do. So after spending money on an Uber there to get my car, I had to get an Uber back, costing me almost $80 out of pocket due to them not having a car available that I had reserved.

Was recommended by a friend and I shouldn't have listened. My appointment was at 12:30 and i didn't get seen till 1:10. Then I wanted highlight and showed a picture and my end results were so bad. I asked to be toned and she said it wouldn't look good. Then after the shampoo I was left dripping wet for 30-40 mins while she took other clients. Honestly awful. She charged me 150 for the highlight and 40 for this "blowout" which is just a lot of hairspray and your ends flipped out. Honestly so bad. WILL NEVER GO BACK. Please please go somewhere before this place.

Lovely spot although only there for lunch.  Eclipse was recommended and we were not disappointed. I had the roasted shrimp salad and spouse had the "porkette" sandwich.  My shrimp (large, not farmed) were perfectly tender roasted. The green part of the salad is kale, beautifully dressed in a citrus vinegaret. A generous shmere of garlic aoili complimented the shrimp. 

 I've never seen my spouse take a bit of leftover sandwich to go, but he said his porkette was so god he could not let it go!  The atmosphere is very cool, even if the restaurant is in an odd location.

The service was terrible. The nail technician was very rude and yelled at me when asked them to remove the nail polish from my skin. The polish was very uneven and the worst. 

My polish crinkled under the light because the polish was so thick. When I asked him to fix my crinkled nails, the techician grabbed my hand and removed the polish from my nail and refused to fix it. Then he grabbed my other hand and proceeded to mess up all my nails.

I had to repaint my nails in the salon since I was visiting out of town and th3 techinician was very loud and tried to embarrass me for his bad service. Stay away from this salon.

First of all, the ladies were very nice, BUT sucks at communicating. I am deaf, they knew but they keep talking after I told them to write on the paper. In the end, they charged me $55 for me and my daughter, plus UV gel. I didn't know they charged us for UV gel (it was my first time) I told them I didn't know. The lady said she did tell me.. maybe she did but she spoke the whole time so basically I cannot hear her. I just kept nodding.... I will NEVER go there again, NOT deaf-friendly and the work sucked anyway. Too hot inside and barely warm water for pedi.. not great

Decide to stop on in and see how this gym has transformed. Pretty impressive.  Four different studios,cycling,hot yoga, Pilates and the Group room with tons of equipment. The heavy weight are downstairs and upstairs you can find more machines. Tons of cardio equipment and restrooms upstairs and downstairs.
The staff were nice and even provided coffee in their lobby. Cindy the Gm was super nice and it appeared her members loved and respect her. Tony front desk staff was also nice.  If I lived in this area I would def.look at making this my home gym.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Ordered 1 pizza and wings for delivery about 830 on Saturday night, took about 3.5 hours for delivery. According to the online order tracker it was boxed and sitting on the heat rack for about 3 of those hours. At 1145 pm I got a call from the driver asking if I still wanted my order. Told him yes and he arrived shortly before midnight. Pizza was obviously old and tasted as such. Tasted like they found a leftover pizza from a frat party and warmed up via defroster on the dash on the way over. Then, about 115 am our dogs started barking to a knock on the door. Apparently there was another delivery driver out there. Why?

Came here as a walk-in for a pedicure. I was seated immediately & the woman showed me a pamphlet which had a series of pedicure services. She told me it was 10% off & tried to push, of course, the most expensive service. I chose the most basic; a spa pedicure that included an aromatherapy 20 minute massage. The woman was thorough, the pedicure basin was clean & so we're the implements. I only have 2 complaints -- first, the nail polish job was a little sloppy & second, the woman sat on her phone & left me in the chair to dry. It was a little unprofessional, but for $31 I'd go back.

I rarely write a comment on Yelp, but i must say that i had a bad impression on Sushi Kingdom. To me, the food and sushi here were good, but the service is really bad. I wonder if the all you can eat sushi had a limit on how many times we order. We ordered food three times and the waitress torn the order right after she got it. We had to wait for the food like half an hour, and another twenty minutes for the check. We finally had to go to the counter to pay without any food from our third order. This terrible service made us do not want to come back here again.

This cleaners is horrible.  Been here many times and rarely complained about the quality of my garments which was often bad.  Rarely complained when it wasn't ready when they said it would be or if they needed more time.  My complaint is because they have horrible customer service on top of everything else.  The lady at the front counter went back and forth with me over nonsense and insisted on giving me my dirty clothes back with my money.  That could have been avoided with good communication.  So I have to go clean my own clothes because of her lack of patience and inability to communicate.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: First time in Nashville from Seattle and this was the first place we went! We ended up coming here 3 times in the last 3 days and will probably be back at least once more before we head home. Honestly the chicken skins are probably the best thing I've had in Nashville so far and we have had some seriously good food. It was also cool to see the chef working in the open kitchen and talking to various patrons throughout the night. I had the lemon ash pasta (which I'm guessing is seasonal) for dinner last night and it was one of the best pasta dishes I've ever had. Would definitely recommend this place.

We are only staying one night.
Leaving a message here to be helpful.
The staff is good.

Whatever you do, don't take room 242.
It sits in the middle of two hallways, with doors that slam shut making the whole bed reverberate.
It is not an issue at 2am because practically no one walks through the halls then. 
But mind you, you will be stirred up from your sleep around 6 (or was it 7) am. In a morning where you were supposed to be having a vacation for Mother's Day.
I wonder why they would rent it out. (I know I ended that statement with a preposition.)
At any rate, looking forward to a better brunch experience out in lovely Tucson.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Impeccably DELICIOUS!!!!!! One of the best meals I've ever had in Philadelphia!! Eating outside was delightful and it was so nice to have an alfresco experience. The staff was super attentive and always checked on us, kept waters full, delivered requests promptly. But THE FOOD was stunning. Truffled crispy Brussel sprouts are a must. I got the Fava bean ravioli and it was too good to be believed!!! Lastly, they had a seven layer cake dessert special that sent me to heaven!! I'm sad I don't live in Philly because I'd love this quality of food often but I'll be making a pilgrimage here every time I visit!! Highly recommend!!!!

I don't know what these people are talking about or seeing this place is horrific. Dirty, nasty, filthy carpets and gnats everywhere. My sister and I stayed here last weekend. The first room had feces and pee on the toilet. We were placed in another room gnats everywhere. The curtains were dirty smelly and disgusting. There was white stuff on the bed spread God knows what that was. Call the health department, close this place down. The only good part of the hotel was Keisha at the front desk. You have been warned!!!! If there was a zero rating I would give it!!! I can go on and on look at the pictures for yourself!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: First I wasn't served after waiting 20 minutes at your restaurant, second my room phone didn't work so I could place a room service order and when I went to the front desk she handed me the phone, third you gave me a room with a piss stained bed and then downgraded me from a corner king suite to a regular king. The GM I had interactions with lacks customer service. I have requested a health and safety inspection from New Orleans, LA department of health. The second room has a non working smoke detector that has been taped together!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My husband and I were doing the "hop on, hop off" bus tour and were hungry at around 2:00. This wasn't my first choice, but my husband wanted to try it. We both had the fried fish sandwich. I rate it about a 3/5- not bad, but not outstanding. The batter on the fish was light and crispy, but needed salt- which I had to ask for because they don't provide it on the table. It seemed that the beer selection was mostly bottled or canned; which I confess was disappointing. All in all, this place satisfied if you are hungry, but I wouldn't come back.

This is a decent place to stay.

We arrived at the airport and called the hotel for their free shuttle. Shuttle arrived without issue. Check-in staff was friendly, hotel was clean, pillow on the bed was very comfortable. We enjoyed the pool and the wifi was reliable and fast.

The breakfast buffet: this is the best continental breakfast I've ever had at a hotel of this quality. (Read: it's a Fairfield Inn, not a Ritz.) I was very impressed with the breakfast spread, and my children and wife were too.

Why isn't this a five-star review? It was a bit pricey. But everything here was good.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If you're looking for luxury this place isn't for you. Cleanliness and customer service is a problem. However a staff member myesha was very helpful and a joy to deal with. Everyone else not so much. If your looking for convenience this hotel is right up your alley. Very nicely located downtown and is walking distance for a lot of major attractions. Overall take the good with the bad. If your just looking for a place to sleep this place is fine. If your spending a lot of time in the hotel you might want to find a different hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I liked that the room had a fridge and couch. It is also a great location relative to broadway. A very easy walk. The bed was comfortable and pillows were pretty plump. Free WiFi was a big plus. 

Breakfast was convenient but there was a small variety.  It was included in the price of the room. The seating was very limited though. I did not like that the bathroom sink was not separate from the bed area. There was also no vent in the toilet/shower room. Valet was expensive and took a while to pull the car around when we checked out. The window shades would not close completely and let a lot of light in in the morning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I truly enjoy this place! I never had a problem with any haircut ive gotten from this branch! Well...until yesterday! An older gentleman with glasses that must have been new read me my note on file of a medium fade which is what I've gotten since i started going there. By the look of the guy he seemed like he was experienced. The gentleman even had a nice layout of cutters! I couldn't wait to see the results! The man gave me a High n Tight instead! Its not even faded in! I'm not going to boot camp sir! Anyways i still love the place, i will for now on let someone else go ahead of me if he calls my name for a cut is all!

I am going to give this place a one! We were here for a bachelorette party, and they did not accommodate us at all. They literally stood in the corner all 10 of them and talk shit about us.... I get it it's 12 girls for a bachelorette party but literally how much money can you make. We are all in the restaurant industry. Obviously not enough to accommodate they are the worst and the most judgmental people you'll ever meet! I can't believe how awful they were!  For an 12 party bachelorette party what a bunch of assholes!

Ordered a chocolate frosted with sprinkles "I'm sorry we are out of that" ordered a regular chocolate frosted "I'm sorry we are out of that" ordered a strawberry frosted "I'm sorry we are out of that" ordered a white cream filled donut "I'm sorry we are out of that" 

They should've just said what the did have to save us some time. We basically had to order donuts we didn't even really like. Now this was on NATIONAL DONUT DAY BUTTTTT I feel like that is no reason to not have any donuts in a donut shop!! They should have prepared better for a large crowd.

Went here for the first time tonight. The food is really good '. There wasn't 1 thing I didn't like. But the service is terrible! I see the manager commenting but I don't think he's getting it. Almost every bad review is about the service. The food is great but they really have to do something about the service. It's awful. Empty drink the whole time missing stuff from each order which we never received. Your pretty much ignored the entire time. They should just replace the entire staff honestly it's that bad. I give it 2 stars because in spite of the horrible waiters the sushi was delicious

The service is really friendly and the restaurants has a nice layout. but the sushi is not really exciting. They skimp on fish and give you ample rice... bummer. I had read other reviews that said that they give you very little fish on your rolls but wanted to give them a fair shake. Unfortunately it's true, you do not get much fish for your sushi. I see this is very common with all you can eat options. No I've been at a AYCE sushi restaurants that have great rolls with lots of fish so I don't think this is a universal point. I probably won't go back again.

If you are looking for a nice setting with a settle environment and very pleasant and friendly staff. Look no further because you have found it. You can dress up and not feel over dressed, it really is a classy place. However, do not feel obligated to dress up because you can dress down and still fit it. The lightning is also dim which, creates the perfect atmosphere for a romantic evening. 
 
The one down side is that the bread the waiter brought out to our table was not warm. It was cold and slightly hard. However it was good mixed with the soup. Simply because the soup was hot. Other then that I loved my time eating at this restaurant.

This use to be one of my favorite places to go for something quick, but I've noticed over the years the customer service and quality has gone down hill. Go anytime after 10pm and there's either someone baked or outside by their car while you sit there and wait in the drive thru ready to order and it's not even busy. I love to give fast food places a few shots after a bad experience, since you never know if it might have been an off night, but serving  barely room temp beans and crusty/crunchy  rice. I rather just get a TV dinner.

This is our new favorite sushi spot! what a hidden gem....these guys really know there sushi. They have different rolls, and make eating at the sushi bar such a delicious experience! You must try! Eddie and Chris are fantastic chefs. We dont even look at the menu...just let them do their thing! Wont go anywhere else! Super fast service! And the mussels are 2 each in the shell detached and so flavorful, the miso soup is the best we have had, and the green tea ice cream is a generous portion and very flavorful. Highly eecommend!

Wouldn't recommend staying here. The rooms Are  nice and it has an indoor pool and hot tub but 3 of the 4 people we've dealt with were very rude and not at all helpful, let alone the shuttle ride over to the laser spine institute where we sat down in a seat that was literally soaked from a leaky roof in the van, then on the way back they hadn't fixed it and had no sign or anything saying that it was wet for the next poor people who would jump in. I must say that the one man who was very nice (ISRAEL) who brought our bags up to our room for us was wonderful and is the only redeeming quality of this hotel. God bleed you sir.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I love taking my car here to wash it. The automatic cleans it beautifully. It always looks as if it has been done by a professional and I never even have to get out. Another thing that I love is the place is always very well lit up. It makes me feel safe. Not to mention that most of the time I visit here I see the owner taking care of things. Which is rare. Most self service washes you visit you never see an employee much less the owner. If ever I have an issue then I call the number on the building and he is quick to resolve it. Thank you. 
One happy customer.

Well I just spent $650 here in brakes, rotors, and calipers and didn't get so much as a "Thanks for the business, hope to see you again." 

The jerk behind the counter just took my two weeks of pay in exchange for his two hours of hard labor and $200 in parts, handed me a receipt and turned and walked out the door without any explanation of the service he had just performed. 

I hope I don't need to get any more brakes serviced in the near future but I will sleep easily knowing there are DOZENS of other places in my area to get them done. I will NEVER be coming back here.

Normally, the Westin brand is an upscale business hotel providing clean rooms with all the amenities you could want. Not this one. First, if you aren't doing business at the convention center, don't stay on Harbour Island. Nothing is in walking distance and there is nothing to do. There was food on the floor of our room, coffee maker was filthy, the toiletries were scarce as they failed to offer a shower cap or hand lotion, and overall, we may as well have been at a Holiday Inn. I've stayed at the Westin San Francisco - fabulous - in Seattle - Fabulous, and NY City - great for a NY hotel. This one needs updating and new management - Fast!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
A hidden cozy bar in Arizona! When my friend told me it used to be a morgue, I was a bit afraid of going to it... but it actually turned out to be the perfect environment for a snug place to drink with friends!

They have a very creative special, so make sure to try that. I noticed a younger crowd there, so it may get a little bit rowdy if you go later in the night. Not sure, we didn't stay there long enough to find out, but just my prediction!

I would recommend coming here at least once to see if it suits your taste!

Had the pepperoni pizza and got nostalgic - this pizza will make you remember how great pizza was when you were a kid. Crust is crispy, cheese is gooey, it's classic pizza that doesn't go wrong. It's also A LOT of pizza - this place is great for large groups. --and while it is truly worth the value, two people may not need an entire pie unless you're planning on taking about four extra slices home (which actually, is a glorious thing) - two slices is enough for one person if you're simply dining out, and you can order by the slice. The pizza itself needs no improvement, but more toppings could be offered!!

My husband ordered takeout from Little Tokyo on Veterans. We patronize this location just about every weekend because it is open late. Upon eating at home, a rubber band with hair was found in our daughter's soup. So glad that she noticed it and did not attempt to eat it, thinking it was a noodle. This is totally unacceptable. We will NEVER visit here again. How could this even happen? Hairnets or hats should be worn in the kitchen. How did the person not feel this fall out of their hair? There should be better standards put in place for employees.

Oh man. This place... I sat here at the bar for about 10
Minutes before I was approached by 1 of the 2 bartenders. Then the bartender asked me twice what I was drinking and poured me the incorrect size. I asked for a menu but was never asked what I'd like to eat. After grabbing their attention I ordered my Caesar salad which I am still waiting for (35 minutes and counting). I know the demand it high in BNA and no one will look at reviews when they are jet lag and starving but save your money. Service alone can make this a terrible experience. Just got my salad, looks decent...but not for $13.

Love this hotel!! It's clean and modern and was so perfect for us and our dog,the staff was really nice and accommodating 
There's  a nice lawn area for the dog to go ,coffee in the room,nice comfy bed easy access
After the temperatures this week a nice air-conditioned room was so wonderful
Wish there were more hotels like this when traveling with a pet 
They had a bar ...  had a nice cocktail before going to bed
Great  little area to eat outside and a little fire pit which we didn't take advantage of because of the heat but very nice!
Just perfect after a long drive from Eastern Oregon.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This was the worst car wash I have ever gotten. I had to have the car wiped down 3x after they were done. I paid for the most expensive car wash plus an interior dressing and wipe down. This was a joke. Completely didn't wipe down door jambs, part of interior of car, the whole car had wet towel marks on it, and windows were left dirty with streak marks from dirty towels. The sign in waiting area says 36 years of excellence and if your car isnt done to your satisfaction they will make it right. I was told to leave because I had been there to long by the supposed manager. I was very unsatisfied with this place.

It's taken me almost two years to write this review...life just got away from me. But, it's imperative that I offer praises to the great staff at Q&C Hotel. From the time we arrived and for the duration of our week-long trip we felt like family members. We were guided to the best (and safest) places to go for food, touring, and entertainment. We were nurtured and cared for by everyone there...especially Marlon who became like a grandfather to my daughter. Other exceptional folks at Q&C include Lonnie, Juana, Irish, Harold, Kevin, Kendrick, Brandee, and Elaine. We will definitely be returning to this hotel every time we visit New Orleans.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I frequently buy coffee at Starbucks in Memphis, Jackson and Nashville, TN. This was my first and last trip to the 21st street location. The counters and floors were not particularly clean, and there was a bug crawling on the brownie in the display case. I called there clerk over to tell him about it, and he told me that the food in the case was only for display because they couldn't get rid of the bugs in the case. After that display, we didn't order any brownies,  and I am not sure if I will be able to choke down the coffee I had already bought.

Service was very very poor. We stood there for five minutes at the register and no one said anything or even offered to help us. I'm normally pretty understanding but we were completely ignored. 


Then, after we finally ordered, we waited fifteen minutes for two breakfast sandwiches. Everyone was standing around talking. No one said a word to us and we were the only people in the restaurant. Then, once we finally got the food, it was the WRONG ORDER. This was like pulling teeth. I will literally go to any other place after this experience.

Been going to Cafe Roma for years and at the old location it was great. This new location is something to be desired and service wasn't the best. They ask if it's for here or to go then when we are at the table they bring it in a box then ask if we want plates. What did they expect us to eat it on. THEN they didn't even make the right pizza and the guy expected me to pick off what I didn't like on my half. WTF I sent it back. Very disappointing.May have the same name as old place quality surely isn't the same. Time to find a new pizza place around here VERY DISAPPOINTED!!

ZERO STARS.................. As soon as I get to the ordering menu I get told there only exception cash. I was to hangry to look for a different fast food joint. so I had two dollars in cash. I ordered a double cheeseburger. 20 MINUTES LATER I Get my ONE cheeseburger and it was COLD. I asked for my receipt and got told they can hand write it cause they're not printing. If i would've known it was going to take this long I would've went to Wataburger for better Quality food and service and got my self a whole meal cause they do accept Card after hours. DON'T GO HERE AFTER MIDNIGHT Worst McDonald's in town!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
This may possibly be the best sushi joint I've been to yet. The quality of fish that they serve is just top notch--SO fresh!! The rolls just melt in your mouth. With their rolls, the ratio of rice to fish is perfect..And believe me that is a huge deal to me when it comes to sushi. You definitely get your money's worth. 

In comparison to other sushi places, this place is a bit pricier. I've noticed that especially with their lunch specials (def a few dollars more than most places). Nonetheless, that doesn't bother me since their sushi is that good. It's as good as it gets here!

Stayed 2 nights. Very clean, quiet, close 64. Safe. Beds and linens nice. Lots of extras like ports for cells, etc on nightstand. Lots of lighting options. Robot brings breakfast to room. Still can't figure out how it made perfect Eggs Benedict.  Joke....its all packaged items, but was fine. 
Staff super friendly and helpful, especially the interim manager.  
Only odd thing is surprised that pool open and the shower products are in a shared container.  With COVID, would think the small personal bottles would be used. Hotel close to shopping, restaurants, etc.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: As a recent new resident of Williamstown, we have tried a handful of take out restaurants, and were impressed, and not impressed. We ordered from here last night, as I was really in the mood for a Cobb salad, and when my boyfriend searched "Cobb salad Williamstown" John's popped up. First, the salad was huge!! I ate it last night, for lunch this afternoon, and still had some leftover! All the ingredients were so fresh, and I am very picky when it comes to grilled chicken, I loved theirs! My boyfriend also ordered buffalo tails, and they were so good he ate them cold today! Can't wait to try more food from here.

Wish I could leave zero. Worst vet\business practice i've had. Wouldn't believe if it hadn't happened. Took $700 towards a future appointment that was missed due to covid pandemic and after missing appointment and trying to reschedule Indy Paws wanted the procedure amount up front and wouldn't apply the previous $700 saying i forfeited it because of missing the appointment.   I've heard of fee's for missing a doctors appointment but $700 unreal-criminal-jerk thing to do. Will be looking for a new vet that's doesn't act like bottom feeders

Ordered a small pizza at 730pm on a Saturday night...the guy was knocking on the door by 8pm even though they said it would take about 45mins.  I was impressed!   The pizza was better than average but I wouldn't call it authentic NY style.  The crust was a bit too thick for that.  The toppings seemed fresh...I mean it didn't come out of a can.  I ordered a hawaiian pizza...it came with extra cheese which was an oversight on my part which made the pie greasy...but don't get me wrong...it was good cheese, but too much makes for a soggy, greasy pie.   Delivery was fast and friendly, pie hit the spot...just not a super great pie.

Haven't been here in almost a year so went for lunch today... disaster. They didn't have any chips available the whole time I was there. My ticket time on 3 tacos was a solid 25 minutes. The bartenders were not in sync with each other and kept over asking people if they were ready and then repeating that there were no chips. The tuna was a little disappointing, not very flavorful. Now I'm home and laying down because I just got out of the bathroom and am so sick to my stomach. Come on guys, you're better than that! Not sure when I'll be back but hope it's a better experience next time!

Everything was ridiculously delicious, high quality, fresh & beautifully made here. A new favorite sushi place that I'm happy to have tried! I'll be back without a doubt & am already looking forward to coming back down to have it again. Yum, yum, yum!!! I tried the spicy salmon & spicy yellowtail. Next time I'll just get one roll as I'm beyond full but my goodness, the flavors were perfect. They had gluten free indicators on a menu & had gluten free soy sauce which was terrific. Happy! Everyone was kind here as well. New fav place to eat in Tucson & I definitely recommend.

We stopped in to the hotel for a drink after the Beach. We were greeted by A great bartender named Jody.  He gave us a great welcome with his wonderful smile.   I have never met such a energetic and enthusiastic person for the love of his job.  We chatted awhile before restaurant got busy.  He is a great mixologist which I have had done myself in the past In my younger years in Long Island.  The entire staff was gracious and very knowledgeable about the hotel.   We will certainly be back and hope Jody is there.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Today my friend and I came to the restaurant and wanted to bring some food for togo at 6:02pm. We walked to the counter for ordering but then the "blond hair Asian" waiter used a really aweful attitude to tell us that the restaurant hasn't opened yet.. so we sat down and waited for them to serve us. The other customers stepped in the next 2 seconds and that rude Asian blonde hair waiter served them right a way. I mean like why did he have to use that kind of attitude to us when we follow their schedule of open hour? And I swear they were all ready for the business ! Hope you guys won't see him there next time ! l

This place had a lot going for it. It has a great location overlooking the Delaware river with an outside patio that is dog friendly. However there are a number of issues:
1) Service is terrible: We waited for almost 10 minutes to be seated. Then almost another 10 to order drinks and 20 to receive lunch. 
2) I ordered the Chili Lime Chicken Kabobs. Chicken may be the easiest menu item to cook. Unfortunately 3 pieces were still uncooked.
3) My Fiance' had the portobello mushroom sandwich which she enjoyed for the most part, but it lacked any flavor.

Note to other visitors: I would stay away.

The food here is great.  When we eat in we have a good experience, but when we order to-go they always take twice as long and the sushi bar the last two times never got our order.  My wife is currently there with my four children to pick up 2 rolls and she called at 5pm right when they openned.  She was told 15 to 20 minutes.  She got there 25 minutes later and was told they were still finishing them up.  She waited 35 minutes checked in twice and was told the same.  I called and now they tell me the sushi bar must of lost her order and the manager is not available.   WHAT?!  So disappointed and mad :(

Stopped on the way back to Ohio. No fitted sheets, one of the two beds had a matress cover, and it was covered in body hair, not mine. The hair was accompanied by a gigantic yellow stain. The shower curtain had a wad of chewing tobacco stuck to it. There was something oranged splattered and dried behind the toilet, which flushed funny. The towels had blue stains...why? Any way, it was a cheaper motel, so I can't complain much about the awful service, sketchy breakfast bar, and how uncomfortable the unkempt beds are... but it sure didn't help the experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Service was absolutely unacceptable. The food sat stacked in front of the kitchen for more than 5 minutes. When the food was picked up by the server, 3 of the orders were incorrect and 2 were completely cold. We had to use the menu to prove that the orders were not right.  The owner offered to send the manager over, and he never stopped by. It's a shame that the service was so poor, because the food would have been enjoyable had we not had to argue with the staff for the entire time. The owner offered a gift certificate for $10.

It was weird that when you valeted you had to get on an elevator to the 11th floor to check in. The floors had dips in them like they were about to rot out as you walked down the hallway. In our room - 1190 - the floors creaked where ever you walked. The room was a lovely suite, but hot in the bedroom. The breakfast buffet was one of the  best I've been to. So..give or take, I'd stay again. The staff are really helpful and pleasant.
I wish I had researched parking because there is a garage next door with parking $20 less per day
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If I could give them 0 stars I would. We have nails sticking up out of our carpet, both the dryer and dishwasher are broken, the wall in my bathroom looks like it has hair glued to it and both bathrooms have mold. We have had 8 work orders in at once and the only one they came to look into was the nails sticking out of the carpet. The nice older gentleman hammered the nails SHARP END a little then said that's all he could do. I can't have my little sister here out of fear for her health and safety. This is a shit show and I can't wait to move the fuck out of this place. Don't bother touring. It's disgusting.

Did a crime ever happen at the store in 2010? At night? I remember coming to Tucson and by BF at the time drove up to the store at night and there was a little old white woman alone at the counter talking to a taller male while another short stocky make was standing in front of the door holding it shut motioning for us to go away.... Called the cops but never got called back... Always wondered if we interrupted a robbery or something worse. We drove around and came back and no one was there... Just curious...

New Orleans is full of rude people but that can't ruin your trip, right? This place sure can! I was yelled at by a bartender for my ID... Like really? I'm trying to get it out of my bag while I'm looking at your menu. RUDE is the name for this gringo while he was being races and kicking me out for being Hispanic. You ask another bartender for a manager and they tell you that they don't want to get involved... This is obviously a constant issue. With all the bars there is in this town you can surely skip this one. Buy the cup on Amazon lol

Took my dog in for a wound/cyst? Doctor prescribed ointment. Only issue is they try and shove the wellness plan down your throat before I got the price of the cream they were trying to sell the wellness plan, the doctor had to come back and put the script in because he forgot. Im there for one thing and they try and sell their package. What about my dogs issue and why I'm here? I could care less about her booster shots at this point I'm worried about whats on her. Not to mention the long wait times even with an appointment

One of my favorite sushi restaurants in NOLA. Cheap and HUGE roles. Good quality for the price. Service at dinner is very good, but service is not as strong at lunch since it is packed to the max. I enjoy the free noodle salad. Usually get a fresh salmon box, Who Dat roll, Hana roll, and snow crab roll. Their Hana sauce is excellent, and there is no charge for extra sauce. If you request it, they will bring the whole bottle to your table. Eat here once a week for the past 2 years. Excellent carry-out service as well.

Unfortunately, I agree with the rest of the reviews here.
This location and the manager should be ashamed and embarrassed. Customer service was severely lacking. I waiting 20 minutes for 3 happy meals. The cashier was very rude. This seems to be the culture of McDonalds.  Rude young kids- no manager- laughing and talking during work- eye rolling...
Additionally, the dining room was crowded because no one was working. The cashier had her mask under her chin. No gloves were worn while she took money and bagged fries (COVID doesn't matter here just like customer service).
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: It's cheap, I'll give you that, but it is not good. I ordered the curry chicken and hunan beef with fried rice. I've never had such watered down, tasteless curry in my life. The hunan was heavily lacking in spiciness but it was a decent tasting meal. The fried rice that came with my hunan beef was okay at best. I'm still interested in trying out more of their menu probably because it's got a lot to select and it's cheap. Hopefully I can find something I like and I will definitely update my review if I find that menu item.

The food is mostly good.  But,  I was early to get my order and stood and waited for about 10 min.  In that time 3 or 4 people came in and picked up orders.  Employees helped out took money.  Handed orders out and never stopped to wash there hands.  One guy took his hat off and ran his hand through his hair and then pressed out a pizza.  Never stopping to wash anything.   No good with me.  Not one person washed there hands the whole time I was waiting.  I get it help is hard to find.  But not washing hands can kill someone.  I will go elsewhere.

I would definitely not recommend staying here. My son who was home for the holidays was robbed on the elevator, so far I'm not in pressed by how this company is handling this I hope they take better precautions .my son is also a member of the  United sates Air Force ..this is how we treat our service men and women. Please don't let your family stay here it is unsafe... I hope this company can redeem their reputation by making this right ..and better security. .and personally I feel he way over paid 90.$ for a room to be robbed on the elevator... one pissed off mom.. hope this review is taking seriously.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Everything on the menu is amazing! My favorites... Black bean Nachos, fish tacos, chili, and crab cake sliders. The blueberry grilled cheese was.... interesting. Too many blueberries for me but I'd never had a sandwich like it so maybe it's supposed to be like that. The service can be a bit slow at times but nothing too horrible (I have not been when it is super busy though). There is a patio overlooking the river and is super nice especially on a day with good weather. The inside is nice as well, it feels more upscale than the outside but you can come dressed down or up!

UPDATE:  A nice young lady called me today to talk about my displeasure with my recent visit to the Hermitage Value Vet.  I explain what happened.  She, of course, apologized for what had happened.  More important, she promised to speak with the personnel involved in my visit to suggest better ways of handling worried pet parents when they arrive with a sick pet.  

I appreciated that they value their customers.  Maybe it was a bad day for the staff and they were stressed out - the other visits have been fine.

Outdated room, cheap beds/pillows/towels. The "breakfast", which was why I chose this place, consisted of stale cereal and no milk and powdered donuts. No coffee, the pots are usually empty and the owner seems to have no interest in refilling them. It's OK because the one cup I did get was terrible.

On the plus side, the walls are thick, there is a refrigerator, microwave, and TV with about 30 channels in the room. The shower worked well, but bring your own shampoo and probably soap (the soap here is cheap, just like the owner)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We were driving by and saw a sign on the side of a building that said "El Orginal Tacos Tijuana" on it and decided to try it out and was not disappointed. We ordered a variety (pollo, al pastor, asada, & chorizo). The tortillas were all homemade and tasty. The service was quick. We ordered 9 total and with drinks was only $23. 
-
The chorizo was amazing and I don't typically eat chorizo, so that's saying a lot. My husband said the al pastor had the most flavor (it came with pineapple).  They had a bit too much guacamole for the size of the tacos would be my only criticism. 
-
We will be eating here again for sure.

I was thrilled to find out the gym was opening down the street. I had been going to Planet Fitness on Airline. This one is smaller, often with waiting time for machines. I can live with that. What I find disappointing is that the customer service is so poor. I was expecting the same kind of energetic, welcoming staff as the one in Metarie since they share the same owners.  Instead, the employees looks low energy and sloppy. This morning there were two employees, and they never looked up from their phones.  I guess for $10 a quicker ride, I can put up with that I shouldn't complain, but the vibe is definitely not as upbeat as the other one.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I'll definitely pass on ever staying here again. The lobby is nice. The carpeting and the room decor seemed old and outdated. Then incidental charge is $75/night which is pricey for a hotel of its kind. When the hotel didn't have rooms available and the front desk agent advised the guest that check in is at 4, when it's in fact at 3 all over the internet. Only Vending machine sells soda and only takes cash and were out of half the items on all floor . Found trash on the floor by the Curtain. House keeping was very noisy and disturbed my peace
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ok so eight months later and I have to connect through St. Louis again.  Hungry no problem. I'll get a Whopper at Burger King. Get in line and see the sign.  Due to technical difficulties "Menu items with burgers not available."   Are you kidding me.  Last time they didn't take cash and were understaffed. This time it's no Burgers.  Someone call the "King".  It could be a coincident but come on.  Hope their lease runs out soon and we can get a respectable burger place in here.  I love Burger King but this location is the worse ever.

This salon is dirty and there gel chips in a day. I have been here three times as it's close to my house and I can get a quick gel polish change. Every time I have gotten gel on my hands here it has chipped in a day or two. Once I made an appointment to get a pedicure and they didn't even reference their schedule, taking people in the order they came in regardless of an appointment and told me multiple times " sit here a little bit". I would rather pay a little more for better quality and professionalism. Don't bother going here.

Came on a Friday so I made a reservation because this would be the first time coming to this restaurant based on the previous reviews I wanted to try it out. Got to the restaurant early and they sat us immediately. 10 min later we ordered our food. It took 25 min for our appetizer and almost an hour for our food.  Their explanation is that they ran out of pasta bowls?  Really?!!  How is that even possible!. Sounds like poor excuse. At least inform your customers what is going on instead of having us wait and ask what is taking so long . Well needless to say I may not return .

I honestly had no issues with the Dollar Car Rental in Santa Barbara. I was actually really nervous about it since I read reviews about Dollar Rental before my pickup (and this was my first time using them). The share a counter with Hertz so there was always someone there to help me.

The only negative I would say is that their cars are older. My car had 33,000 miles at pickup but all of the buttons were sticky (i.e. you had to really use some elbow grease to change the radio station or change the air flow).

We have been weekly diners at Zpan.  Our past experiences have been ok to good.  Tonight was our last time to eat here.  2 of our 3 rolls were very fishy and tasted horrible.  The manager, instead of approaching the situation with good customer service and offering replacements for the 2 bad rolls, she was extremely argumentative. She, of course, charged us for the rolls that did not taste fresh at all, and stomped off like a child.

I have observed the manager being loud and unprofessional in the past.  This time it happened to us, and we will not be back.

AWFUL!

Worst people to get an apartment with. They shown me an apartment and gave me the move-in date however, after I paid everything they told me the place was not ready, and they offer me a totally different awful one, So I asked for my deposit back, they took over Two months to return my money, plus they didn't gave me the full amount with a thousand excuses, never called me to apologize, and I had to go there several times to request my money. I'm glad I didn't move to that place I can't imagine how it is with the current residents, if it is like that with potential, and future residents.

I wanted to like this place because it's close to home and the nail technicians are nice, however the quality of service leaves much to be desired.  I came in for a manicure and was seated immediately. Great. Then a man comes out, sits down, no greeting (probably because he was on the phone). He then filed my nails and began one of the worst manicures I've had in a long time.  Afterwards I saw that my nails were uneven, cuticles not neatly snipped, gooped on polish.  I didn't have time to have him redo them but that's okay, I will never be back... by the way, he stayed on the phone the whole time.

this mcdonald's has to be one of the worst mcdonald's i've ever been to although me and my acquaintances often times will go here almost everytime we have been something has been wrong with my order today i ordered a burger and did not receive it after paying for it upon request i went back to pick up my order once again upon reaching my house i realized the ranch i also asked and paid EXTRA for was not in my bag upon calling to complain the worker not only gave me attitude but also hung up on me and this isn't even the worst experience i've had this place honestly does not deserve even a star
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Blahh, I travel to Boise occasionally and have eaten here a few times. No more. I came here from the airport thinking I could get a better meal but I was wrong. There was no one there but it took forever. Turns out it's because they were burning the bread on my sandwich and that takes time. Because it was so burnt and slathered in an ungodly amount of mayo it wouldn't hold it's filling and my sandwich was a mess on the plate as I held burnt bread. I have to get a plastic (Shane shame) utensil to eat my pastrami melt. Yuck! Who knew lunch in an airport was the better option?  I do now!

I used to go here a lot when I lived in Norwalk.  But only came here for oil changes and new tires.

I got a decent set of tires and of course I naturally got my alignment fixed.  Usually I would get my oil changed at the same time.

I'm giving them three stars because one of my tires did pop (weird) and they replaced it.  No problem.  But the wait times were so severe that I would almost regret getting them done here.

I would shop at the mall for like 3 hours and my oil change/alignment wouldn't be fixed.  I don't think it takes that long for an oil change.  Plus the wait time to have someone service you at a desk is an eternity.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Where worn and often dingy seating, walls, bathrooms and dated decor put a damper on any feeling of lavish accommodation, the staff more than made up for this with over the top service and professionalism. No place in the hotel could actually be described as comfortable with regard to temperature. Every room was either arctic cold or humid and warm. There are limited local restaurant choices within easy walking distance however the room service menu offers one of the absolute best cuban sandwiches Ive ever had. Ordered it three times over the course of the week we stayed and it was perfect each time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Don't tell me estimated wait time is 50 minutes and then I don't get my pizza until half an hour after that.

Update: Shoutout to Anthony our delivery boy for being sincerely apologetic and taking the time to call and apologize before getting to us too, I'll add a star for you.

Cinnamon thing was burnt and clearly looked like it's been sitting out a while before being delivered. Should've just picked up since food was already made when we called to check where it all was.

Later Update: They acknowledged the situation and made it better, thank you!

I stopped for a late dinner after work and the girl had no idea what I ordered when I got to the window. I told her what I ordered and she handed me a bag and my shake. I sat waiting for my soda and she asked me why I was still sitting there. I told her I wanted my soda. I left thinking my order was finally complete after waiting over 10 minutes for it, just to get home and find out they forgot my fries. I tried to call but no one would answer the phone. This is twice in one week my family has had a problem. If love to speak to management about this!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
