Fantastic, fresh, unique dishes.  Everything my husband and I had was absolutely delicious.  I had peach caprese starter... A fun summertime spin on the traditional caprese... Just swap peaches for tomatoes.  Light, sweet and salty, perfect. I also had a vegetarian entree of roasted veggies that was simple, yet heavenly. 
Our server, Ben, was fun and friendly and made great recommendations. We look forward to seeing him again next time... 
We made reservations in 2 weeks while we were still sitting at the table!!

Etwas überraschend findet man auf der Sansom Street in Philly richtig Kultur  nette Restaurants, ein Comedy Theater, richtig unamerikanisch :)
Dann kommt man zu diesem Sushi Laden. Eigentlich ist es ein Lieferservice, hat aber Platz für so 4 Leute an der Bar und einen kleinen Tisch für 4, an den wir uns zu fünft gekuschelt haben.
Das Sushi is sensationell. Frisch, lecker. Preislich super. Halt nur klein die Bude, aber es lohnt sich da vor Ort zu essen.
Warum dann nur 3 Sterne? Naja, wir sind in Pennsylvaniaes gibt kein Bier in der Bude, kein Sake, nix mit Allohol. Und es ist halt klein.wie gesagt

While traveling through Reno, we had noticed our breaks making a different noise. We got in, they checked the breaks for free. They said it would be about 45 minutes, but called me back in closer to 20 minutes. There was no problem with the breaks, and they explained to me that sometimes they can make a noise like that when they've been very hot (we had just driven through Death Valley the day before). They had the car ready in the front when we got back and we're on our way! So great to find an honest shop, especially on the road!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Nothing but high praises for this hotel! It has everything from a pool and hot tub to multiple lobby games like ping pong and foosball. It even provides guests with a business room in case you needed to get work done. The rooms are absolutely perfect. They look like a five star apartment. Comes with a kitchen a nice sized living room and not to mention comfortable beds. To top it off in the kitchen they provide you with silverware drinking glasses and cooking tools. I highly recommend this hotel if you are in the area! Nice and friendly staff too. Can't wait to come again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I was so disappointed with the exam they gave my puppy! I went there out of concern for what looked like hip dysphasia and the doctor looked at him for one minute, said he looks good and left the room. After consulting with another veterinarian we've found he is in pain, has very weak legs and needs x-Rays, pain medicine and blood work due to what is probably the beginnings of hip dysplasia. I'm just disappointed in their lack of care and time with my puppy! They Also have some of the highest pricing in the area!

Sashimi were chopped by an axe maybe. It's so huge that it's simply embarrassing to put it into your mouth. 

And the service was the worst I had in Tucson. They were not serving tables. They were bombarding tables with dishes and soy sauces and grabbing soy sauce from your table from over your shoulder without saying anything. I questioned one of them what they were doing and he looked at me as I am just ridiculous. No apology or whatever. 

If you are looking for mediocre Americanized Japanese foods and ATROCIOUS service, this is the right place.

I must have been to a different place than the other reviewers. The place is plain much like the food. The meals were bland and not appealing.  Probably the worst representation of food I've had in a while. 

I had flautas which had no flavor and were over cooked. The tamale served to me also was bland.  Wife had a combination plate that was flavorless too. Save yourself the time.  

Disappointed especially from the radio ad hype and reading the other reviews. I should have just went across the street to Taco Time. 

Staff was nice and always checked up on us. More of a lunch counter than a restaurant.

This is an update to my last review which was a long while ago. Not sure what happened, but the service was average and the sushi was not good at all. The cuts were way too thick on the salmon nigiri. It made everything we had with salmon taste awful! The seared tuna tasted like propane or whatever they use to sear it. It was a super disappointing visit. Not sure we'll be back after this. It was that bad! The only saving grace was the ice cream, which is top notch. Too bad. This place used to be one of our favorites. Now we will avoid it for sure.

Sweet and Sour Chicken, Fried Rice, Crab Rangoon and Egg Roll. Was below average at best. Ate one crab rangoon but could not eat another. the filling had a wax like consistency as did the egg roll. The egg roll was more like a frozen and then fried egg roll. The Fried rice was the best part of the meal. The Sweet Sour Chicken was okay just too soggy and too much breading. 
They were quick and friendly as far as service but the food is subpar. 
I travel all over US and definitely have had better. Went to the Target grocery store to satisfy my appetite.I guess for the money I could have gotten better heat and serve chinese in the grocery.

I have been with TFCU for a few years, they are all so friendly and know my name. However I was having a billing dispute with the cable company for two days. Amanda, David And Chisteanna not only did there jobs, but went above and beyond. Today before work Christeanna let me call them in her office so she could explaim to the billing department in bank terms and codes. The issue was resolved quickly in my favor. I will never go to the big banks again
 HUGE SHOUT OUT TO TUCSON FEDERAL CREDIT UNION!!!! THANK YOU!!!!

I was there I thought they know what they doing for replacing my Mercedes GLS2017 from yellow bulb to white bulb , matter facts they did not know what their doing , the light was flicker and have to go back to put the original back and do the oil change same time .
I bring check to another auto repair that solve the issue of mine and Harris auto shop don't even put my oil change in full only half... totally rip off and don't even bother to give the money back for the lights change that I even didn't get done . Totally never comes back again .

Is this the Marriot or the Holiday Inn!!!! I went on a visit with a friend from out of town. I raved about this hotel because it's been my favorite for years....only to find that it has been neglected over the years. My room was horrible...I couldn't change rooms because the hotel was booked. I was embarrassed because I informed my friend that the hotel was the BEST....the only excuse they could give me is that they are renovating soon. My room had holes in the wall and loose fixtures. I will not be returning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went with a large party last night and the service was awful. We ordered cocktails and waited for 20 minutes the waitress informed us that they are delivered in the order of your seat rather than the time of the order. That was the way the whole evening went. There was never an apology for mistakes made just an insipid stare at you. One member of our party had his meal forgotten and was served after most of us were done. The manager was barely present during this ordeal   I ordered a martini and was served 2 and was met with a shoulder shrug when I was served. Not a fun evening.

Horrible customer service! Never answered phone or returned calls! Changed rental rates after reserving and being a five star gold member! Never renting from this location again! Worst corp location I have ever been to and the rep wanted to argue with me. Unacceptable, was told it should have been more but was a computer glitch, not my problem and if there was a problem I expect you to pick up the phone and call to find a solution. Not change my rate cause you feel like it and then argue with me about your problem.

What a pleasant surprise this was!  Got it via hotel tonight just 2 hours before we arrived, having been stranded due to flight cancellation.  Super comfortable bed and comfortable and friendly from initial greeting by Sydney. Triumph restaurant in lounge was absolutely great for breakfast and dinner at pappys smokehouse right down the street was A-plus.  You can use the workout room OR walk across street to run on track at SLU.  Good price, good service, good location, safe, good rating.  Only quirk is that the lighting in the rooms is almost non existent so if you want to read it's going to be tough.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If you have a seafood allergies and you value your life do not order from them period. They have no care for there costumer life and will aurgue you down and hang up on you when you try to tell them they sent something you didnt order. I ordered from this restaurant and they messed up my order they sent me crab Rangoon  instead of chicken nuggets i am highly allergic to seafood. They are refusing to fix  the issue and have hung up on me twice. I am extremely  upset, my lips are swelling and my throat is itching. I beg them to send the driver back out for him to take a look  They are extremely unprofessional.

Okay, a beautiful hotel, great location, and very trendy. Hence, the two stars. But, the room smells like dog piss. And that is a major problem. Especially when the management can't seem to smell the same thing that we all are smelling in the room! All four of us in here. And their recalcitrance at providing any accommodation other than masking the odor is not acceptable. They think we are trying to scam them. But we just want some good air to breathe! It can't be that difficult, y'all. And seems low key racist, in that 3 of 4 of us are black.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My husband, myself, and our puppy had been living there for two years and recently had to relocate to another state but we LOVED living there!  The staff helped us out and accommodated us in countless ways, they were just like family!  They also loved our puppy and gave her treats all the time.  She misses them very much.  This is the BEST place to live to be close to the medical center, Whole Foods, and great places to eat but it is really the best place to live because of the staff!!!!  Everyone should live here!

This is the slowest McDonald's in town. Each time I've visited this place of business I've waited an extremely long time to get my meal. I work maybe five minutes away and usually frequent this place during my lunch time which is only 30mins. I never have an unusual order just Big Mac no pickle. I've been here three times and each time I still had pickle on my Big Mac. This McDonald's is connected to a chevron gas station so it's ideal to stop and get what you need from both places but the wait time is just a killer. I won't be returning to this location again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We went in for a late lunch on a Thursday around 2. There was no one in the building it seemed. We sat down at a table and waited just under 5 minutes before someone came to see us. We ordered pizza and a chicken parm sandwich. The food was tasty and hot. We enjoyed our meal, but the service was very slow. One other couple came in during our meal and that was it, yet it took a while for us to get our check. Just seemed like they were busy in the back with something else besides customers. TLDR; food was good, service was lacking.

We did the inside and outside cleaning for our car.  Generally, they did a good job vacuuming out the dog hairs, but the windows were horrendous.  When the sun hit them you can see all of the streaks and film left on the windows, both front, back and passenger.  I don't know if they tried to wash them with dirty cloths or what but they were worse after our wash than they were before our wash.  Also, the dashboard still looked like it had fingerprints all over it.  It was like they dusted it, but didn't actually wipe it down and try to clean it.  Very unhappy with the job for the price and won't be going back there.

Not bad for airport food.  I guess I came in during an extremely busy time as the table and menu were sticky, but the waiter quickly took care of cleaning it.  I ordered the chicken and cheese Philly with fries and it was just okay- it seemed the meat and bread ratio was off, with way too much bread.  Aside from the cleanliness and food experience, I can say the waiter was very attentive and pleasant, so that made for a not-so-bad experience.  I travel for work quite frequently and have had my share of airport meals in addition to eating in a few restaurants within this airport, so I can attest to rating my experience here adequately.

Beer enthusiasts rejoice! This local feel, hoppy paradise is the best spot in St. Louis to taste a beer on tap or create your own pack to take home. This operation started just a few short months ago by two brothers with a passion for beer. I had the pleasure to speak with these two gentleman about their business and it's beginnings. Their knowledge of the industry and excitement about all the product they carry will keep me coming back. Expand your existing beer knowledge or get your start. Pay a visit, you'll be surprised.

Please do not visit this store! The store is very dirty inside and out. Cant even think about what it looks like behind the counter. The staff is  usually standing around avoiding the dirty tables and trash's that need to be taken care of. I did take my order home to only discover the Chicken Sandwich was still frozen. I then remembered the person at the counter made mention to the other workers that the chicken sandwich was missing in the order. A few seconds later it was placed in the bag. I am very sorry that the name Burger King is on this building. Please save your time, money and frustration and try a different location.

The customer service was horrible. I had an old 20.00 bill and I was questioned by the cashier if it was real. Instead of having a pen to check it she was going to refuse my money. I offered a credit card but was denied because it wasn't 10.00.Another customer had to vouch for me that it was indeed real money! How embarrassing!! Then on top of it I ordered shrimp rolls and received spring rolls. My food was done in about 10 mins. The beef was so fatty and the rice was so greasy I couldn't even eat it. I will never go back there again!

This place is head and shoulders terrible compared to what it use to be 2yrs ago i been bring my cars here for over 10yrs and they have always done good work. Now i was willing to pay 7,000 to put my new engine in and these guys gave me the run around and refuse to let me speak to the manager. And flat out refused to do any real work on my car. I had to keep telling the manager to do the work and he said the owner told him not to do it basically as a excuse cause they were backed up and were lazy never ever will they have my service again
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Shame I have to post 1 star!! Don't trust this manager Aamer Ahmed. Aamer Ahmed told me the total fee with taxes took my card (Amex Gold which covers my insurance, plus my own insurance) and swiped my card. I then found out that Aamer Ahmed had charged me for both the top insurance and the second tier. His name is Aamer Ahmed. Aamer.ahmed@hertz.com I'd love to bump into him again! Come say hi Aamer Ahmed.  He has my number. Call me Aamer Ahmed.

worst rental car place I have dealt with.
I called ahead to get a car ready, had confirmation number and was told no problem it will be ready.
They picked me up in a filthy car, turns they wanted me to wait for them to clean it.  
Then I ask for any other car that was ready as long as it has 4 doors...so what do they propose...a 2 door Yaris.   Then 30 minutes later I am in the dirty Toyota (at least it has 4 doors).  Waiting to hear from the insurance so they can get this sorted out.
I have dealt with several rental car places over the years and these are by far the worst!

I paid $$$$$ for a pair of glasses.  I should have had my head examined for doing that in the first place.  They were to be ready on Thursday.  I went there following Monday.  Not ready.  No call.  I went back a week later on Monday.  Lenses were made wrong, had to remake.  Promised they would be ready today, Friday of same week.  

I just got off the phone - lenses were not ordered!!!!  Needless to say, I give up.  Canceled the order, getting my $$$$$ back and going back to Walmart for better service that costs $.

BTW - best price for the commodity service of an eye exam is $85 at Lakeview Vision on Harrison Ave.  5-stars from me.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Pros: Modern decor, free bike rental, complimentary bottled water & bathrobes in the room.  It is minutes from the Outlet at Riverwalk, the Audubon Aquarium, the French Quarter, and right next to Mother's, and Harrah's Hotel and Casino.  Cons: The room is on a smaller size and Wi-Fi is not free here.

The restaurant on the first floor is very chic with nice variety of delicious dishes.  Our favorites are Avocado Tartine and Pork Belly Benedict.  Also there is a bar in the front with an adjacent outdoor seating area with ashtrays on some of the tables.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: On July 28 we were entertaining our niece. My husband ordered Osso Bucco  which is his favorite Italian meal and this one was the WORST one he has ever been served. It consisted a very large non marrow bone and a very minute amount of meat. I give one star for service, ambiance and appetizers but his main course was unacceptable. The chef must certainly have known what he was cooking so it was a great disappointment. My risotto was passable but certainly not exceptional     and our niece's scallops were dry.  All in all a tremendous let down

We had ordered from this place several times in m the past and the food was typically okay. Chicken items were always good but the friend rice is dry. The last time we ordered they messed up several aspects of the order, food arrived only warm not hot, and the delivery literally took 1 & 1/2 hours. We could have watched an entire movie in between the time we ordered and the time or arrived. The delivery guy was apologetic bit we live 5 minutes away and I honestly regret not picking it up. The whole event just sort of soured me on the restaurant

Was entertained by the check-in clerk, who sang, danced and put on a little show. Nice fellow. He even upgraded my room. The room was comfortable and had a good view. Parking was in a garage under the hotel. Tight and dark. Weird people hanging around there. Room service trays were everywhere and still there when I left. The hallway was beginning to smell. Signage was sparse, so got lost trying to find the elevators. Used by a couple of airlines. Starbucks was nice. Not quite sure about the lounge floor and how it worked. Pricey even for a downtown hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
In short: the service here is definitely 5 stars, but the sushi (we got the unlimited option) is just not very good. 

We ordered the Japanese shrimp dumplings, spring roll and edamame and all were delicious. The sushi was just not good - the fish itself was bland, and the fancier rolls were either dry and flavorless or had too much going on that wasn't fish. I'd be willing to give the place one more try to see if the rolls not included in the unlimited menu were better, but wouldn't recommend the unlimited option.

I was here for bearings which cost  $500 for one side ..i was here for over 3 hours ...they then asked was there any lights on in my car uhh no the mechanic then tells me uhh your AND sensor is out and we will replace it for free yeah you think you broke it so I guess you would ..i sat another 1/2 hour waiting on the part which they should of went to infiniti and got the part ..i was told it would take 2 days and this was on a Wednesday...i am back today 1 week later ....i am very irritated because I came yesterday and was told to come back today because they only had 2 ppl working ...i will never come to this location .....
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Is there a way to give a negative star ?? Guessing not but anyway here goes.  Ordered an extra large cheese this place sends a meat lovers instead, normally no big deal, however the kids wanted a cheese and when I call them to explain the problem I find out I need to give them the wrong pie back and wait to get the one the kids want. Any other place tells you to go ahead and start on the one they sent while they get the right one on the way, well not this place. I guess the kids running it can't get the order right and needed the wrong pizza back to send to the house that ordered it. BAD BUSINESS will not deal with them again

I'm making a revision to my rating, I'f I could give 0 stars I would. Leo's Italian Grill no longer deserves my business, Last year November 2020, Leo stormed over to our table & told my wife & I we were no longer welcomed at his restaurant!!!! The reason he gave was: my hand clapping & disco style dancing!!!!!!   I thought we lived in a free country,  I guess we do not!!!!!!    Prior to this incident we have been served  sour lasagna & stale chicken cutlet parmigiana.,  So Leo take your restaurant & the food poisoning & shove it where the sun don't shine,  you parasite!!!!!!!!

We are waiting in a room and have been for over an hour and a half. The nurse came and took the temperature and then came back to take the weight both times promising the doctor would be right in which was a complete lie. We asked the front desk person and she said she would have to page the doctor. I love the use of such an elaborate euphemism. Oh really page him what is he on the golf course ?
What I want to know are facts like is the doctor here? Yes or no. How many patients are ahead of us? The place was empty when we arrived.

When the doctor finally arrived she took good care of us. The fees were reasonable for emergency service.

I visited Sakana Sushi today for the first time during my travels.  I heard about this restorant from my Mom who lives In Reno . Mom said that the best sushi in Reno/Sparks ".  Korean owner (Clay Lee) was kind and all kinds of food was Fresh & Good. I satisfied for my lunch absolutely due to I choose Sakana . Also homemade ice cream was delicious. I want to visit this place again whenever I visit to Reno.  And I'd like to say " Visit Sakana if you want to eat fresh fishes with fantastic dessert "  Today was my lucky day because of I had excellent lunch.

If your felling like sushi, this is the way to go. Wasabi has sushi, but they also have other options for people in your group who don't want or like sushi. With the change in management the food seems to come out faster. However, it may have been the chef we had but it seemed like our food was not as carefully constructed as in the past. Our server Ashley was amazing! She was on the ball all night noticing when we needed a refill on a drink or wanted to order more food. She was not to serious and we had fun chatting with her. We had a very enjoyable evening and I recommend Wasabi if your in the mood for sushi.

Horrible and Disrespectful Customer Service 
I placed an order through Grubhub here only to get a call that their drivers do not want to drive to my location and are not making my food. This is totally understandable so I then naturally asked for a refund and the restaurant refused saying for me to call back tomorrow. I called in the next day and received the same information and must call back tomorrow. The people who answered the phone were extremely unhelpful and rude. I still have not received a refund. Be careful when ordering delivery from here you may not get your money back.

Stopped in for dinner, we were greeted right away & seated right next to the fish tank which is pretty.  Interesting place. When you 1st walk in, there is a nice pizza oven but it seems like a pick up window. Decor is dated and odd but sometimes those are the best places. We were hoping to find a hidden gem. Not exactly. Kind of odd. Pizza had a great flavor but we had to cut off the completely burnt edges. We ordered the caprese salad but the tomatoes were VERY underripe, not even red. House wine was fine, but we all know MKs not picky there ;)

Just moved to Indianapolis and this place was recommended by my cousin who has gone here since college. Its a bit hard to find but honestly I will never go to another auto place. I had taken my car to a different shop and they quoted me twice the price. Pats gave me an honest estimate of what needed done at that moment and what I could come back for a few months later. And I did come back and get the other things worked on. I am soo happy and thankful that I found my new mechanic and can just go here from now on.

Check in is at 3. We arrived around 3:30 and was told that our room wasn't available yet.  We asked when we could expect it to be ready and was told by the young lady that she didn't know.  She did say that she would call us when it was ready.  We came back around 5:20 and the room was ready but we never received a phone call. The young lady never offered an apology and gave me a dirty look for asking for a late check out.  I would have given 5 stars because the rooms are great and anyone else we came into contact with was great. Might stay again if we don't have to deal with the young lady again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Food would get a zero if that was possible. However server was great and we were quickly seated so giving it 2 stars. Saw the good reviews and wanted to check this place out. Two of us ordered the New York Strip from the specials menu (without a price listed) and one ordered the scallops and grouper.  Both steaks were ordered medium and were served extra well done, so were sent back. The redo's were better cooked but the steak was bland. The scallops and grouper turned out to be a single scallop and a very small portion of grouper-maybe 2 oz at best. $38 per steak and $28 for the single scallop and grouper. Very disappointing.

Had a good stay during a conference in late February 2020, Right after Mardi Gras.The conference was in the hotel which is really nice and convenient. My room was off to the side in the north wing. it was a little secluded but I ended up liking the peace and quiet. The hotel does a nice job of accommodating requests; Just don't be afraid to ask for anything you need. Staff was very friendly and the service is excellent. Great to have restaurants, a convenience store, and a Starbucks located in the hotel. If I didn't want to explore I would never have to leave. great for business travel
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We had a party of 8 celebrating my daughter 21st bday...4 guys 4 girls. We wanted to dance and check out the place (the bar and the girls dancing on the bar).  We couldn't tell who worked there dancing on the bar it looked like a bunch of patrons and pretty much those same ladies the whole song or two or three (to long). The dj sucked played the same song twice with one song in between.  Needless to say we didn't dance and left disappointed.  The bar was dirty and the service was terrible we saw a server once and she brought 2 of us drinks.  Sorry to say 2 stars is all I can offer....the two are for the name and the pools tables (good idea).

Overall the food was fantastic, the service a delight. However, I felt the dessert menu fell off. They did such a good job with the menu items, and then going to a "a cookie" or an "ice cream sandwich" cheapened the experience. 

Food is very reasonably priced. The muscles were basically like two pounds. lol. And so good!!! 

I'm Italian, we have so many amazing desserts, they were poking from all over Italy with their menu items but it died with the dessert menu. Do a twist on a tiramisu, I make mine with ozzu. How about a classic tartufo? Something other than a cookie. 

Over all will eat many times again, Max was awesome!

We had the luxury of ordering pizza from our hotel from this next door eatery....which was a great convenience. I was a little skeptical at first after reading several reviews. However, it was late....we were starving....and we wanted pizza. We kept it plain and just ordered the triple play. It came with a large 2 topping pizza, breadsticks, and a salad. It was hot when delivered, and the thin crust was crispy. The garlic bread had smooth  silky provolone cheese melted on top of a slightly toasted bun. Didn't get a chance to taste the salad, but it looked amazing. I definitely recommend Imo's.

Do not bother making an appointment because they don't care they would rather take a walk in and do your automobile last made a 10:30 AM appointment was there before that I asked them if I could my car up in an hour and a half as I received A ride for that timeframe they said no problem I called an hour and a half they did not even move my car into the shop I noticed they were all new people in the show room they had their cars on the rack this is absurd why make an appointment they are greedy just to take other customers after your automobile has been there and you've gone through the trouble
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I normally go to this Dunkin since it's by my job and have no issues. I've been ordering an everything bagel toasted and each time comes out soft. I have now been ordering  it double toasted so I can be sure it's actually toasted. This morning I was asked to pull around and wait for my order and again received a soft bagel even after asking it to be double toasted with only cream cheese on half of the bagel and no napkins. I understand that is a busy time for them but if i am paying and i was specific.... why is it so hard. Not asking for anything crazy just for what i ordered.

As a platinum member, I have to say this is a disappointing place to stay. The staff is friendly but the place is in general disrepair 

Specific issues

No coffee in club lounge, broken
Main elevator has been broken for at least a month, wait times are 30 minutes. I heard some guest say they planned to throw their luggage over the rail in frustration.
Bar was out of most food and service was terrible
TV service was out site wide. I guess they forgot to pay the bill.

Very sad situation for what must have been a nice hotel once
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Wow, what a wonderful meal!  All of the reviews to this point on the Squash/Zucchini small plate being great were spot-on.  The pork chop was perfectly seasoned and incredibly tender. The duck breast was also very flavorful although less-adventurous diners should be advised the duck is cooked Medium Rare/Medium.  

The absolute show-stopper was the layered Nutella cake dessert.  I would go back just for that.  Overall, Josephine was a wonderful dining experience although the atmosphere was more on the noisy side.

I had a wonderful dining experience last night at A Mano. What a hidden gem in the Fairmount neighborhood. The food was excellent and quality was above and beyond. Usually when dining at a byo I feel you sacrifice the quality of food, but that is not the case here. I highly commend the chefs at a job well done. The menu is some what small, but that is a very good thing as it shows the chefs know these dishes and know them well. I can't wait to come back and try more of the menu. Thank you A Mano, for an outstanding dining experience.

Worst cleaners ever if I could give zero I would.  
1.  I waited over 5 days to get my clothes
2. They only take cash
3. The prices are higher then when I lived in Chicago
4.  I was returned a shirt with a stain on it
5. I asked a for medium starch and the shirts were all light starch and one was still wrinkled 
6. English English English when went to talk to owner about my concerns she said she could not understand me 

I apologize for the long review but I do not want anyone else to make the same mistake I did
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Chicken Taco Salad $9.99
It looks like black bean soup.  The guac & sour cream was good . The shredded chicken had flavor.  I'm not sure where the lettuce was. They attempted to correct it, & said the beans were the cause.  I didn't disagree. I just snacked on the guac & chips and was not interested in another salad. I've honestly have tried to give this place a chance.  I've had their beef taco and chalupa. The taco was bland. There are other Mexican food choices such as Carmelitas which is off the charts great. 
I will not be back.

Just awful. They DID NOT have wasabi. What kind of effing Japanese restaurant does not have damn wasabi?! The food was OK-ish but the service was awful. If you want actual japanese and not ghetto trash for an evening meal I would HIGHLY suggest elsewhere! Literally made by some dude named Juan. The pregnant hostess ignored me when I walked in and barely spoke English. When I go to Japanese restaurant I don't want to hear Spanish flat out. This place is a joke without a decent punchline! 

As I'm making it through my meal I realize that the food is just as bad as the service. Do not eat here if you do not want to get food poisoning.

Poor customer service, they rescheduled my interlock appointment & then boosted my rent because I couldn't make their appointment last minute. Also their own representative said that their device rent is $65, meanwhile I am being charged $90 & $130 for being 4 days late, even though I went in the day after my appointment & was told that I would have to wait for 4 days. My previous interlock company is still being charged for my profile, & I was informed chances are this company is pocketing my money because my profile has not been transferred out. I am taking this to corporate & the better business bureau.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Stopped in to get a quick bite before a late night out. No happy hour and the menu is a little limited for non-meat eaters, no worries, we adapt! Got a side of fries and the Hummus/Flat bread. The fries were limp and over seasoned and the flat bread was barely warm, no butter, no effort. And this was at a cost of $20. I'm just a tab bit disappointed! However the guy in the office who took my order was pretty nice, even though it took a few transfer's to even get someone. He took my order, which was ready when I came.i just wish the food quality was better

Called tires plus and spoke the Eric, I explained to him I was smelling radiator smell every time i turned off the car. I then explained I wanted them to do a pressure test to see if there was a leak anywhere. They did the test and nothing came back as a leak but they did see another problem with a small head gasket leak. Thank you so much for seeing this problem, I'm having the work done this coming Tuesday.
I give these guys a thumbs up all the way, very trustworthy, thanks again I will definitely be back soon.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The sushi is the best I've ever had in Reno.. However, the service is absolutely horrible. It is pretty cramped and they leave a table dirty for up the 15-20 minutes. We realized as a party of 6 AYCE, order as much as possible the first time so you don't have to wait around for another 20-30 minutes for someone to come around and take your order. Probably should sit at the bar instead of a table. I actually had to get up and ask for an order ticket so I can put the order in myself since we weren't being helped.

These guys were great.  Parker checked me in and was super friendly. Made sure I knew how long the wait would be, made conversation, was just a pleasant wait. I had a male stylist.  He asked what I wanted and really listened. Super cute, lots of layering, va va voom body. I would have to say that this was the barbershop vibe. Everyone was talking to eachother and it was like hanging out with the gang.  Parker accidentally over changed me 10 but immediately called me to apologize and figure out how to refund me the overage. Such an honest gesture is so appreciated.  Will definitely be back to hang out and gang my hair did!

My absolute place to get sushi!my husband and I have been going to this place for 5 years now and we've never been disappointed. I honestly tried so many different spots for sushi in and around Philadelphia but none of them could ever compare to Fat Salmon. 
Most of the time we get Sushi and Sashimi for 2. The amount of sushi and sashimi that comes in this combo is incredible. Plus a nice bonus of 2 soups and 2 salads. We always end up eating the whole thing:) 
The service is always great, we never had a problem getting a table there because we always make a reservation in advance. Sometimes we do take out as well because it's very convenient.

Mother's seemed like an inviting place to grab a quiet meal on New Hope's main drag.  My girlfriend and I stopped in, were seated quickly by the manager and settled in for a delicious meal.  We watched as one waiter, then another, then another passed us by in the all-but-empty restaurant.  After 10 minutes of no service, we decided it was time to leave.  On the way out, we noticed that the entire waitstaff was sitting around the bar gabbing away.  Adding insult to injury, one waitress thanked us -- we weren't sure if it was for coming or leaving.

This is a charming place to stay while in New Orleans! The gentlemen at the front desk were very kind and Accommodating. We went to eat at the place one suggested for dinner and it was a great recommendation. 

This location is perfect to walk around town, walk to the infamous cafe du monde, walk to the shops, restaurants and bourbon street. 

The building has old charm to it but is cozy, explorative, and enchanting. High ceilings, balcony walk ways, pool, trees and shrubs. Wish we had time to spend at the bar because they had candles lit and it felt warm and inviting. 

I would definitely stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Grossed out by the germs workers put into my car.  After my car was vacuumed and washed the worker grabbed a new towel, and then wiped the sweat off her face and neck and then used that towel to wipe down my dashboard and steering wheel.  So repulsive!  Got home and had to wipe down my entire interior with Clorox wipes.  I will never be back and will share my experience with many others in my near by neighborhood.  I must add that my bill was $15.06 and I presented the cashier with $20.06.  The cashier had no idea how to make the change, despite the cash register indicating $5 change.

Nice quiet facility that is very close to happenings in French quarter. Staff is friendly and courteous. Not crazy expensive given location especially with online reservations in advance. Room is spacious and has separation door from bedroom to living room for your privacy if more than two people. Has clean workout facility. Parking will run you $50 w/ tax and tip which around here is a little less than others so don't be intimidated by that if you want parking convenience. Safe walk back from French quarter late at night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A great new-York style place, pretty casual and low-key. The pizza itself is really good. Not too much cheese or sauce, and the crust is soft without being chewy. However, they cook the pizzas with half toppings, for example, half pepperoni, half veg, and sometimes the toppings do bleed into each other. Twice now I've gotten a slice with an edge covered in veggies and/or pineapple, and it really effects the taste. As previously stated, the pizza itself is fantastic, but be careful about which slice you pick.

Stayed a week on the La Salle University rate since it's the schools' hotel of choice and centrally located. I was very impressed. Hotel looks a bit older but room was great, bed was nice, towels were soft. Customer service was awesome, especially after a snafu with the room being charged twice. They handled it and got it reversed right away and we got a really nice cheese plate for our troubles. Which was unexpected and going above and beyond. Restaurant was good and the bar has great bartenders and a good selection of local beers on tap. Will definitely stay there again when visiting my son in the future.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I do not recommend this hotel (if you can call it that). No breakfast (due to construction), and  internet down. No compensation on bill either. They don't tell you that you will be charged a $50 deposit which is suppose to get refunded. When it did get refunded, only $30 was refunded because they kept $20 for parking in their garage (again never expressed to us). The hotel was in desperate need of repairs. No TP holder, stains on carpet, and don't get me started on the tiny shower (no tub) area. Only plus, walking distance to points of interest.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: For a place that is not busy, they sure know how to screw up orders. The girl taking our order walked away right in the middle of taking our order with no explanation. Another else walked up who was handling food to finish and had no idea what he was doing and deleted half our order. After the order was complete, the girl came back and the guy went back to handling food without washing his hands. None of the tables were wiped down, and when our order came up, two of the kids meals were short chicken nuggets. Again, it was not busy at all and there is no excuse for the terrible service

I want to like this place every time I go but the service is SO bad!!!! I've been for lunch numerous times, gotten carry out for dinner and then finally dined in for dinner and its official, I'm never going back. Do yourself a favor and drive the extra few miles to Mama Carolla's, you'll never be disappointed. Their food is better, the same price and you ALWAYS get great service, also a way better atmosphere. The only reason I gave Milano two stars is because their food is pretty good but never worth the wretched service.

I would give R Bistro 2.5 stars. I have eaten dinner at the restaurant twice. The first time I thought the appetizers, dishes, and desserts were a 4-star level. I went with a friend who is very particular about food and the chef was willing to accommodate his requests (no salad dressing, entrees with sauce to the side). Specifically because of this quality service (which can be hard to find), we returned a second time. However this time they would not accommodate these requests. We were disappointed given the expense of the meal.

The lunch buffet was horrendous. I would have rather went to a franchise buffet restaurant than here. 
I would describe the food as old people food. Everything lacked seasoning and taste. The selection is small so my hopes of quality were high; but alas I was let down. The ingredients looked good but the actual finished product deserved more care. 
The reoccurring theme was olive oil drenched food. Maria who ever she is should take her name off of the meatballs. They were dense lumps of under seasoned tasteless meat.

Just got the Educated car wash for a quick car wash that I desperately needed. So far the service has been amazing the staff is so polite and the atmosphere is beautiful. The entire experience is very nice! It is almost 5pm and it is very busy so people must really like it here! I decided to go with the $17.99 inside and outside wash. I also was filled up with gas by the employee which was very inexpensive. I see all types of cars here, trucks, coupes, BMW, Honda. Unfortunately I have to agree with most of the reviews prices cheap still there is a lot of dirt on the ground of a car and at least they could do would not come again.

Awful! Booked this place without high expectations, but looks like the bar needed to be on the ground. The hotel bar is closed. Took ys an hour waiting in line to check in. Once we got there the front desk paniced and said our room wasn't ready and that the shower curtain was broken. Mind you that check in was at 3pm and we had come by at 5:30pm. The elevators are out of order, the AC is almost non existent. Have not gotten our room yet, but I assume it's going to be disgusting. Tragic, sorry excuse for a hotel. Do not recommend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This looked like it was going to be a real find!  Looks can be deceiving.  From the completely uncaring staff to the over priced drinks this place had problems from the start.  It's very dark so the filthy interior wasn't obvious at first.  What was obvious was the broken stools and ripped seats.  The band was great so we tried to stay but the waitress lost interest in checking on us and the bartender wasn't behind the bar.  We decided to just go but first my husband needed to use the facilities.  Biggest mistake of the night!  toilets overflowing with actual feces and no one doing anything about it.  GROSS

I took my dog to be vaccinated only to be treated rudely due to his whining. Once I was admitted to the back I was left standing in a room with no chair for over 20 minutes. When I asked politely, "could you tell me what happens next and when it will happen?" The male vet tech rudely replied, "you're going to go back into the room, close the door and wait!" I was so shocked I could not respond. I gathered my pet and left. I then took my dog to the Pet vaccination clinic on West Washington and High School Road. I wish I would've gone there first, then I wouldn't be encouraging anyone NOT to visit this vile place.

Went in for an oil change yesterday. Am now stuck on the side of the road, at a mechanic somewhere in nowhere TN, thanks to them not tightening the bolts that hold the oil pan/gasket in. Check engine light came on, luckily, right before an exit for a 24 hour mechanic. Could have blown my whole engine if I'd made the drive I set out to. They also didn't bother to tighten the bolts holding the skid plate on all the way either. Don't know if incompetence, or just sheer laziness, but they could have cost me my car. If I could give negative stars, I would.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
This is a very nice hotel! The staff was very friendly and upbeat. Our first room had a problem with the AC and they immediately sent someone to fix it and in addition gave us a different room. They have a grab and go for breakfast not your usual traditional breakfast like other hotels but they had some really good deals for happy hour. 

The location of the hotel was perfect as well. We where a few blocks from the strip mostly everything you needed was in very close walking distance and if you wanted to shop you could just catch a trolley which was very affordable
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: First time visiting this place and it was absolutely amazing. Dr. Somji went above and beyond using state of the art equipment that showed the back of my eye in high definition. It was definitly the most thorough eye exam I have ever had. He spent time explaining every test he was doing and why. He was also very good with my two kids (who do not usually like doctors) and they have already asked when they can go back. The opticians helped me pick out a wonderful pair of glasses that I get compliments on every day. I am so glad to have found a place that can take care of me and my family's eye  care needs
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Very disappointed with their performance lately... I used to take my truck here once a month for an ultimate wash, $50 all said and done everytime. It seems they are having an issue with employees and their quality of work is showing that. I paid extra to have sand cleaned out of my center console and it was not done. Leather seats were not wiped down like usual. Floor mats left dirty, and the exterior wash was not done very well either! Still have bugs and road grime left on the front end! I will be looking else where for my next wash because it's very disappointing to spend $50 for an "ultimate" wash and receive a mediocre wash instead.

Food was great. Menus do change often. Servers very attentive and explained every dish served. When we went, it was more of an Asian fusion fois. we had gnocchi, Iberico pork secreto, seared fois gras with strawberries, crispy cobia collar, pork katsu, sesame ice cream and five spice donuts. We enjoyed everything, except the fois gras and the 2 desserts. The strawberry sauce did not go well with fois gras. Five spice should not go on desserts. Couldn't enjoy the sesame ice cream either. There are reviews from different people who enjoyed these desserts. Everyone has different tastes. We'll return to try different menus.

Third time in 3 months, Ithat I have been to the Lebanon Subway. It is the worse service at this popular sandwich shop, that I have ever experienced and I have been to Subways in at least 7 states. Also, unless they changed the quantity of meat they put on a footlong, they left off several slices of meat, & I ordered the deluxe, because of the last 2 Times I had been to the Lebanon Subway shop. The girl that waited on me never smiled, made me feel very uncomfortable,  made me feel like I was imposing on her. I will not go back to this Subway, the third time was the charm.

once again, I had to go to this Subway store, due to transportation issue. I had a coupon that expired at the end of the day. This time the only young lady there was very nice, quite, timid. she waited on me, this time they had all the ingredients that I wanted, however, I ordered deluxe, as usual, because the amount if meat vs bread is not sufficient for me. After paying I noticed that I was overcharged, approximately $1.50. I tried to explain this to the cashier but she was clueless.  I thanked her and told her I would return when there was a manager there, with my receipt, of course. The subway saga contines...

Had the rear main seal replaced on a vintage car.  The price quoted was fair.  On my way home realized my cylinder head temp gauge was no longer working.  Called, returned to find out the engine was pulled without the wiring harness/sensor being disconnected. Not the end of the world, but the mechanic that did the work (not Tom or Kevin) refused to accept what happened and got confrontational.....very confrontational This despite a frayed wiring harness sticking out of the body wiring harness. The car was ultimately fixed by them but still a headache.

The car was ultimately fixed by them but still a headache.

So nice.
The desk man greeted everyone with a smile and with patience. They helped direct me to the best Philly cheese steak in town. The room was clean and comfortable. I forgot my toothpaste and one was provided. There is a great fitness room (minus free weights).

People are super cool. Service is great. Water pressure is excellent. Iron flattens clothes. Bed was comfy. For lovers of white sheets, they have white sheets. My UV woods lamp revealed no unsightly stains. TV was showing mild to moderately funny things. The shampoo and conditioner smell citrusy and fantastically fresh.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I'm not one to post negative reviews over one bad order. People make mistakes and that's ok. But this is CONSTANT with Springfield Subway. We eat the same sandwich every single time and always have. We order online so I'll attach the order below. 
Everything is wrong. Wrong bread, wrong condiments, TONS of peppers and onions, zero mustard, Mayo, oil & vinegar... it's just awful. Do yourself a favor and if you HAVE to have Springfield Subway, order it in person. 
I feel really petty ridiculous writing a book on my sub sandwich, but whyyyyyyyy can't you ever get what you pay for at this place?!!!

They add a safe charge regardless and will not remove - unlike other Best Western hotels if you complain. 
The manager was unable to be reached and a message left.  No surprise - no return call..
Valet parking is $30 extra.  No self park and they don't encourage you to go in and out - so wait until you are ready to park overnight.  
Tiny room was clean but with only 2 pillows for a queen bed. Asked for more "if we have any I will send them up". They didn't have any more.
Internet very slow and dropped out regularly.  

Location is convenient to Bourbon st and French quarter.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This would be a 5 star hotel if they put as much effort into the rooms as they put into the lobby. Stayed here with my fiance for New Year's Eve a few days before our wedding. The shower wouldn't shut off so I could take a bath, the pillows smelled like BO, and there was a blood splatter on curtains like there had been a recent murder. However, complaints to the concierge resulted in quick action to repair both the bath tub and to replace the pillows. Unfortunately, we still had to stare at the curtains for 2 days.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The food quality and service were all wonderful.. unfortunately, that's where our good vibes stopped. 

Mica is the type of place where a more mature crowd comes for a fancy dinner in a super small town. There isn't much creativity or bursts of flavor in the dishes - more just beautiful presentation of somewhat bland "New American" food. Our BYO wine made everything much better. The food was good, but there are so many great restaurants in the Philly area with a less hefty price tag, we doubt we will come back.

I brought 2 coats for dry cleaning and dropped it off on a Wednesday, with their limited hours of operation the lady told me I can pick it up on Saturday which was perfectly fine. 
Arrived on Saturday she simply said "he didn't bring ur stuff back, maybe Monday !" No apologies for any of the inconvenience they costed me.
She also charged me $58 for an adult down and toddler down cost which I think it's a bit overpriced! 
I expect them to do an average job on my cleaning but given this bad customer service, I won't be back!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: We visited Amici after searching for restaurants on Yelp.  We were extremely pleased with the choice.  The food was very good and the staff were incredibly friendly, attentive, and accommodating.  When a local regular at the table next to us began loudly chatting us up, they even discretely offered to move us to the next room where the atmosphere "might be more 'romantic".  However, we stayed where we were and enjoyed talking with him as well as with the staff.  Overall, it was an excellent experience and we will definitely go back if ever in the area again.

Stopped in here after a long day selling at the Philadelphia Expo. We were tired and hungry and came here after reading yelp reviews. SOOOO glad we did! First of all: the atmosphere is amazing: nice and warm, cozy and not too loud. Just what we needed. Next: the service was superb. She shared her favorite dishes and why and also gave tips on the best sellers. And last: the food was outstanding! We started off with the cheesy Devils: I highly recommend: My husband got the salmon Reuben which he enjoyed. I got the Italian burger: great choice. If we lived anywhere near Philly: this would be a regular! Don't hesitate to come here .

Only 3 stars because of the limited menu. If you like tomato sauce you'll love this place. Most of the dishes were tomato sauce based, unfortunately, I'm not really a fan. I was looking for Alfredo sauce or a white wine sauce. I was hoping for chicken piccata or fettuccini carbonara but they were not on the menu.  I ordered the prime rib ravioli because many people raved about it here on Yelp. I would say it was just ok. The service was great, they had my favorite wine, valpolicella ripasso. My husband had the gnocchi Gorgonzola he loved it.

I work locally and used to go every morning for my coffee and oatmeal. I would either get the wrong oatmeal or my coffee made incorrectly. I have called the manager and I was offered free food. I don't want free food I just want my order to be correct. At work we used to order lunch from there at times but always the same issue. The staff talk to each other and hand you a bag and say it's been a pleasure serving you and when you reply the door is already closed. I would rather them say nothing then to be insincere. So for he last 8 months or so we have stayed away.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: My friend and I stayed here the other night. It was the only hotel with availability, and now I know why. We got there and the guy at the front was rude and unprofessional, and had his kids running around the "main lobby" with his wife at about 1 am. We get to the room, and found a dead bug in one of the beds, no cord on the phone, and part of the ceiling in the bathroom had fallen into the bathtub. The beds were disgusting and had yellow stains on the sheets. I will never stay at a Knight's Inn again, and will be advising my friends the same.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The food was very good, and the garlic rolls were a pleasant surprise. Between me and the two people I was with we ordered the Gnocci, Veal Parm, and the pasta special. All of us were satisfied with the food. The biggest issue we did have is that the portions were a bit small for the price we ended up paying. If the portions were a bit bigger or the price a bit smaller we would have been happier. In the end, I left satisfied with the quality on the food. The inside is nice and the service was fast, a great place for a night out.

This place reminds me every Chinese restaurant I went to as a kid - lamps, fish tank, lattice - it was great! My teenagers loved it.  No, the food is not challenging or unique. Their definition of "spicy" is on the tepid side.  All of that said, we loved the green onion cakes, crispy chicken and schezuan beef. Basically, white people Chinese comfort food. The service was impeccable. Some nights we venture into Chinatown and try something new. But if you aren't up to that challenge, you won't go wrong at The Lingnan.

I ordered and paid thru the BK mobile app. Upon arrival I was informed by the manager that the Alton BK does not support the mobile app and there was no way that they could help me. Well there were several ways they would have been able to help me but chose not to. When requesting information on what the name and number is of the franchisee who owns the location I was informed that they are not allowed to provide said info and I need to go to the website...BS!  I didn't get a chance to eat the food so I can't comment about that but the horrible customer service I received from the manager on duty Dec 18 at 4:30pm...I won't be going back!

I love this little gem in Seminole Heights. The menu changes every Thursday and I look forward to reading the details about the innovative dishes. My friends and I have enjoyed multiple culinary creations with much fervor. 

My only disappointment has been with the desserts. Out of the four desserts I have tried, only one of them was enjoyable. Room for improvement. 

The atmosphere is very cozy and approachable. Not at all pretentious. 

Overall, I like The Refinery very much and look forward to my next visit.

This place seems to the type that is totally unwelcoming unless you are a drunk locale who comes in every night. Barely acknowledged our presence at the bar, not the fun, friendly vibe at all that the rest of downtown Nashville has. WORST of all, there is a sign on the juke box that says, we have a right to skip any song requested, and guess what, they did in fact skip my songs right in the middle of them (and no I wasn't requesting spice girls or something annoying). Seriously, that is so LAME, why have it at all, just play your grunge music and keep frowning all day.

Who would build a beautiful new hotel right on top of a railroad crossing. The first train was at 4:58am and we were woken by the train hooting for a good minute. LOUD! It's now 6am and 3 have been through already. Yes, that's every 15 minutes. Bring your ear plugs. 
Otherwise it's a typical, clean, expensively appointed Hilton. Only open a few months so there are a couple of teething problems, toilet not fixed properly and a bit rocky, some electricity sockets not working. Slow service in the restaurant.
Make that 4 trains, I hear the next one coming...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Today was a heavy snow warning. I traveled from Niles to Indianapolis..hearing a spinning squeak sound from right rear on our 2005 Mercury Marquis. I called a few auto repair..telling them.I have to go home tonight..can you check it out? This was my 4th call..and they said, bring it in..we'll squeeze you in..I did..they took my car right away..in about ten minutes.The manager said, It's not a wheel betting, but your break pads are gone..
They did a fine job..and I'm mak'n it home on terrible roads safely..Thank you Good year..!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Worst liquor store in the area,
No matter what you pick the oversized Indian guy behind the counter would tell you " yeh yeh dis is gut staff take it take it"
"Only beer? That's it? No wine?"
He really made me feel weird shopping in his store.
And the worst part is he overcharges.
He pretend to be your friend and - BOOM he overcharges you.
I grabbed a 10.99 dollar wine, and a 6 pack corona which was less then 10 dollars took them to the counter and he was acting all friendly " my friend how are you my friend etc "
And tried to charge me 29$ without even scanning anything.
Stay away from this store if you don't want to get scammed.

Little Hidden Ruby- Fantastic warm and grilled Italian bread with  real olive oil, huge Caesar salad topped with tomatoes, pappardelle immersed with grilled scallops and shrimp covered in a subtle blush with tiny capers... clean, great service, excellent food, reasonably priced for the high quality. They also have a fixed price menu. The choices were many and all sounded delectable. I was happy with my choices and was thrilled with the authenticity even though the chef is Moroccan. Hard to find- the front is not well lit- had to drive around the block twice to find the location- ample metered parking in front(no money required after 6 pm)

Went there today with my brand new car.  They did a horrible job.  The tires looked horrendous, they didn't rub the product into the tires ..and it was dripping all over the rims.  The inside wasn't touched, but the mats.  Water spots all over and the running board at the bottom wasn't even wiped down.   I gave the guys a 10.00 tip...Now I wish I wouldn't have done that !!!  The best part of my experience was the cashier !!!! She is great !!!  I used to go here years ago and always loved it.  I don't know what happened.

I love taking my kids to Subway but I just will not go to this location again.  I have four young kids and was in the process of ordering multiple sandwiches and keeping tabs on my kids and the apparent owner who was doing one of our orders kept rolling his eyes at me and demanding my attention rudely by waving his have in my face and saying HELLO in spite if the fact that I was interacting with another employee at the time.  There was just no reason to treat a woman that way and there are so many other Subways to choose from so they will not get my business again.

I think this place has only been open a few months since the remodel. The hotel is beautiful but the employees have a lot of improving to do. Showed up for check-in and they didn't have a room...until 8:00pm!!! Went to the bar to wait, 30 minutes for the drink, didn't even know how to take our money. Went to the restaurant and that was another disaster. Screwed up the room but it was very nice and had a  very comfortable bed. All of the conference food was flat out "cold". They had a hard time just getting enough food out before we had to go to work. Service horrible...Hotel and room awesome.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I don't mean to be dramatic, but this dining experience could have been the 9th circle of hell. Service was exceptionally terrible; we got our food 1 hour and 21 minutes after ordering. The food was uninspired, totally lacked flavor! The waitstaff would not make eye contact (like they knew their restaurant was filled with unhappy patrons) and when we asked our waitress to check on our food after 1 hour, her response was "I already did!" and she explained that everyone's food was taking a long time. Ok? And she never offered us more bread or anything. Anything would have been a better alternative than this restaurant. I felt so happy leaving!

Watched an employee...I believe his name was something with a "K", maybe Karl. A maintenance man of some sort grope the receptionist. She did not like it. It took a lot for me not to say anything. How can they allow people like this to work here? I only saw one man really doing his job the whole time I was there. Told him hi every time I saw him. It was the same man being yelled at for drinking water. I will never return here. And watch out for the man who gropes women. Who is to say he won't come into your room at night???? Scary and disgusting.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This is my last time using Buck Road Animal Hospital. While Dr. Klein seems very knowledgeable, he insisted on muzzling my Great Dane puppy (140lbs) because (he's a big dog and I'd just feel more comfortable), which traumatizes him, making him wet himself and express his anal glands.  Absolutely unacceptable behavior from a professional. We will NOT be returning. 
Not to mention, their prices have become outrageous since dr. Klein has taken over. It cost $79 for the heart worm / Lyme click test which costs them $6.25. Outrageous!!

This is the kind of place that makes me love yelp. Just in town for a hockey tournament and Umai came up on our search for nearby restaurants. Has a quaint community feel and trendy type atmosphere. Staff warmly greets you upon arrival and luckily  we were early enough to avoid the crowds or any wait. Sushi was awesome! Excellent fresh fish and creative apps. Generous fish portions, only gripe was a little to much wasabi on our nigiri, but otherwise, wish I could call this spot MY local sushi joint! ps. BYOB

I found this stupid and cheating store through my insurance and had eyes exam in Nov 2017 with copay. Wait for few hours to say the "eyes doctor" who has no any knowledge as a DOCTOR. In 3-1-2018 I got a bill asked to pay $70 immediately with some stupid reason. I called my company vision provider and was told this stupid cheating doctor office said send out as a mistake! They have my insurance information and my insurance already paid but this store tried to charge me again! Why not make a mistake a send me a check? Stupid cheaters, slow, no professional at all. Please stay away from this "doctor" and this store!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Our hostess was very rude. Every time my family and I kindly asked for something she would roll her eyes and give us a dirty look. We had her every time we went there. Lastly, when we tried using our free appetizer from yelp she completely ignored me. When I asked again she had me come up to the cashier desk and when I showed her my coupon she grabbed my phone out of my hand very impolitely and when she was finished she handed me back my phone and I stood there for a few seconds because she did not say it went through and then she did not speak to me until she was like you can leave now. Very rude and made our meal not enjoyable.

We enjoy coming to this restaurant. Last night we did not.  Our waitress was too busy talking than doing her job.  We had our appetizers thrown on the table.  Had to ask for another plate- 3 people don't equal 2 plates. Had empty glasses on the table, she never came to ask if we wanted a refill or to see how our food was.  And the place was half empty, with waitresses standing around splitting tips.  Our waitress finally came to our table 15 minutes after we were done eating and asked if we needed a box.  Sorry meglio's but you need to teach the waitresses how to do there job and take care of your customers

Besides the fact that I didn't have new carpet when I moved in 6 years ago and they told me I couldn't have it replaced when it showed it's true color!  Right now at 10.47pm I've been trying to get ahold of the emergency line because I have had an ongoing leak in my laundry room from a valve above in the ceiling of the laundry room. I've talked to the 24hr person since 10clock but no one has addressed my water leak because they aren't responding to the on call person!!  How messed up is that!!!!  And I'm paying $1,185.00 a month now for no service and no decent carpet, I'm feeling pretty stupid and need to look at leaving this place

This is such a great place to get glasses. I have been going there for years and every time I end up with the coolest glasses. We always start with what I think I want and by way of fun and lots of testing different rims, I end up getting a fun and different pair of glasses. I now view glasses as an accessory and have started a collection with a few pairs for different moods. The sales people are awesome and fun and very competent. They make the process easy and at times have worked with me on price. I highly recommend Modern Eye. I frequent the store in University City.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I have been here a few times before tonight, and my experiences have always been pleasant. However , tonight our server Mara took our order promptly and accurately, yet our food arrived with only the basic fixings that weren't custom-made to her questions. When I tried to find Mara merely to ask for more ketchup to drown out the simplistic fashion on which my food arrived (inaccurate according to said custom requests), she was outside smoking. I waited for a few minutes, after which the bartender finally offered me the taste-smothering cover-up I needed. Might come back if it's convenient for the serving staff.

This was my first time visiting Sump Coffee. I've been wanting to check this place out for a while. I felt the gentleman behind the counter taking my order had a little bit of an attitude today. I asked a question about their coffee, and he seemed annoyed that I even asked a question. The coffee itself was excellent, and the gentlemen making the coffee were very nice. I would definitely recommend this place because of the great coffee; however, the gentleman taking the order needs an attitude adjustment to make everyone feel welcome.

First stepping in we had a problem with our seating having a vase underneath our table as the table "center piece", not to mention my appetizer plate that was handed to me had bits of lettuce and crumbs on it as it was handed to me. Not Every table was served butter and bread as a sitting appetizer and our table just so happened to not get any. Once we got our food, four out of five of our dishes was either poorly seasoned or just cooked improperly. The waitress was very polite in our service, but the overall cooking and what seems to be the management, is just very very poor.

Pros: 
The service was friendly and efficient. 

The portions were generous. 

The atmosphere was clean and pleasant. 

The restaurant was about 50 feet from the front door of my hotel. 

Cons: 
The fish in the rolls was flavorless (probably because much of it was sliced well in advance and stacked in layers with paper towels in between each - this is something you can see if you sit at the bar. 

The fish was sliced very thinly. 

The "krab" is the rolls was very dry and tasted badly. I was a bit worried I might get sick.

PSA: Sakana's combo deal is GREATER THAN All you can eat sushi. 

I was starving after a full morning/afternoon of hosting open houses. Craving sushi I went to Sakana. I was informed right away of their combo deal. 2 rolls,  miso soup, and a small plate for only $15. What a steal! Topher prepared my sushi quickly and presented beautifully. They no longer offer AYCE sushi and I think it's a great idea. Too often when I get ayce sushi the rolls are tiny, I'm starving an hour later, and have buyers remorse. Here their rolls are packed full of fresh fish, and I got to take my leftovers home! I support this change

Tons and tons of equipment here, especially for lifters. I mean rooms full of the stuff, set out over multiple floors in a funky floor plan, like "chest room", "legs room 1", etc. There being so much stuff it's not hard to get a spot at a squat rack. It's not fancy or shiny but it gets the job done. The locker rooms are nicer than I expected. The staff are friendly and chill without being pushy. if you're looking for a place to get your workout done in peace, in a city center location, this is the gym to pick.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The Liquor and Wine Grotto is a small quaint business on Coast Village Road. I have been going in and out of there for about a year.  When you walk in it feels like you're in a wine cellar. It had just changed hands in ownership and every time I go in there I see something new.  Last time they were setting up the shop for wine tasting.  It's actually a pretty cool place to hang out and have a glass of wine.  The new owners were very knowledgeable about their merchandise and last I heard you could order online and have wine delivered to you.

This is my favorite Mexican place in town. Their food is amazing!! I am seriously  not exaggerating. Starting from their chips and salsa. The chips are always so warm and delicious. They taste like they were just made.  Their salsa is definitely home made (not from a jar like many restaurants do) and it taste so fresh. Gosh, they have the best chicken enchiladas and the best guacamole. The fig and blue cheese guacamole is my favorite--It literally is to die for. And if you are into spicy food, you will love their three Chile's margaritas. They are the bomb! You can't leave this place without trying one.

My 15 year old kitty was declining fast on a Sunday morning. I knew he needed to be seen immediately, but I knew most vets weren't open on a Sunday. I discovered this banfield was open and they squeezed us in for a morning drop off appointment. I was so upset dropping him off because I was scared I was going to lose my cat. Everyone was so nice and the doctor was very understanding. They gave him some antibiotics and fluids. After that vet appointment my cat began to feel much better. He's back to himself and I can't thank the staff enough for helping him. Stinky the cat says thanks again (:

Won't be going back to this Firestone.  Second time I've used them.  Made an appointment and sat there and waited and waited while other customers came and went, and employees stood around doing nothing while my vehicle sat.
Typical list of things wrong with the vehicle when I was just getting a rotation and have not experienced anything wrong.  Brakes are bad?  They're only 6 months old -- doubt it.    Randy who works here was especially unhelpful.
The best way for me to complain is not to go back to this location, and I'll do just that.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This is a pretty good gym if you're an average human human that's trying to get/stay healthy and active. I wouldn't recommend it to body builders whatsoever; it's a very different environment. They keep the place clean, which is very much appreciated! However, I noticed that a lot of members do not wipe down machines when they are done. It's best if you wipe down your machine beforehand just in case. They offer pizza once a month, which I personally don't understand. But the size of this location is great, and I never feel crowded or have to wait for someone to finish on a certain machine.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
CHECK YOUR BILL FOR NON-PROVIDED SERVICES!
I was there for over 6 hours. Waited nearly 5 hours for x-rays to be taken. The attending doc looked at them, gave his interpretation of x-rays, then told me a radiologist would call me within 2 hours re. interpretation of the x-rays.  I was billed for "interpretation" ($84) and for "Radiograph Stat fee - 2 hour" ($46.50).  I was never called. Calling IndyVet the next day, I was told, "we don't have a radiologist". I was not called re. x-ray interpretation. 
I was billed  $130.50 (part of a ~$500 billing) for services promised but never provided.
*** REVIEW YOUR BILL! ***

Went through the drive through and ordered a Pecan Apple salad and 2 small vanilla Frosty's  I got to the window and was handed my meal, paid for my order and then had to ask for my Frosty's.  Went home and tried to give the little ones their Frosty's, but no straws.  I went to fix my salad and no pecans...Isn't the salad called Pecan Apple salad.  Well there was 3 slices of apple and 2 small pieces of chicken.  And no receipt.  Tried to call and complain about the service and my order, but nobody picked up after 10 minutes, I hung up.  This Wendy's always seems to have problems.

First of all, i just want to thank the guys that we're at the front for being super understanding, but i believe that the management should hire experienced/ good house keepers because this room was extremely dirty and disgusting. 

The beds had hairs and dirt all over them, so we just politely tried to ask for new sheets and we offered to even change the bed. but when we took the sheets off, the cover had blood and pee. so we tried to take the cover off as well, and the whole cushion was just as dirty. 

wouldnt recommend coming here :)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Charles Roybal, I came and talked to you 3 days ago and you gave me hope that a studio or one bedroom would be available the next month. You gave me your number, I called three time. 3 TIMES. Not once did you answer, not once did I get a call back (and I left a message every time). I go back in today, to find out that a one bed room was JUST RENTED OUT. What a help this place is.
