I guess if you get lucky that's cool, but if they hand you a card, you might as well throw it in the garbage. Thanks a lot, Charles.

In town for my daughter's college graduation from UIndy and had to reserve two rooms for the group that was in town. The rooms were nice, the bathrooms were good size and it was great having a refrigerator in the room. The kids enjoyed swimming in the pool and the breakfast was very good with a decent variety. My only complaint (and it was significant) was 7 of us got stuck in one of the elevators for a little over 10 minutes. The alarm in the elevator didn't work so I had to call the front desk on my cell phone to let them know about the issue. I had to keep calling the front desk to get updates.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Terrible Service! So RUDE! Don't even bother, you're better off sweating in the hot sun doing it all yourself than trying to deal with these people! I am not one to write reviews but experience was that AWFUL!!!

There is one girl and one guy there that are super nice, all the rest suck! Including the MANAGER!!! I had to politely tell him how rude he was being and as manager should pay more attention to customer service. He was in my face, talked to me as if I'm stupid, told me all the services they Won't provide. The others just give you horrible looks and ignore you. Never again will I go back!

Best sushi place I've tried in Philly so far. I've lived here for about 6 years now and of all the sushi places, this one is my favorite. Went here with a group of 5 and the service was quick, attentive, and friendly.

The appetizers come out quick, but the main entrees (half of us got sushi/sashimi and half got hot meals) took a bit but not painstakingly long. The sushi was amazing, tasted fresh and come in good sized portions. I felt very full sharing 3 different rolls with another person. The prices are also pretty reasonable for quality sushi. 

It's a smaller place but it is located in a nice area of Philly as well!

I have been doing business with H & H Automotive for 15 years. They have always been very courteous, friendly
and very professional. Scott Harris is the owner and a true 
Guru when it comes to automobiles, regardless of make or model. He is very honest, reliable and his office staff and shop mechanics are top notch. I recommend Scott and his most professional staff to take care of all your automotive care and repair needs. I trust my cars to H & H Automotive over and car dealership any day, and the prices are fair and reasonable.

Ordered 2 identical orders, sandwich, rings, soda and cookie. Only got 1 sandwich. Had to wait for second to be made. Sandwiches were the chicken, pecan, apple mix. Hardly enough of the dressing to hold ingredients together so it kept falling apart.

Floor by soda machines was disgustingly sticky, like feet stuck to the floor sticky. BUT the worst thing was seeing the employee SWEEP THE TABLE WITH THE SAME BROOM HE JUST USED ON THE FLOOR! Was this broom used in the bathroom? THIS IS HOW HEP A COULD BE SPREAD TO CUSTOMERS!

GROSS, NO. NEVER AGAIN. AVOID!

We have been to the Richboro location twice now in the past month.....have a group of 8 people on Friday night.  Food and service has been very good both times.  Would rate 5 stars except for a couple of areas. First, the small metal chairs are not comfortable; second, the front door has no barrier and the cold air constantly coming in from people entering and leaving is very annoying if you have a table anywhere close to the door.  And third, the  totally open concept results in a very noisy environment.....somewhat difficult to carry on a conversation.

ALWAYS tip your technicians directly. Do not give the owner their tip to give to them because he shorts them. My mother and I have been a customer here for years now. The last time we went I paid him in cash for the both of us. I really enjoyed my technician because she took the time to have a conversation with me. I gave him 30 more than our total and told him to tip them 15 each. My mother was still getting her nails done and he came over and only gave her technician a 5. Ridiculous and unprofessional behavior... I will not be back.

We used to love sushi to go - ordered once a week for delicious, fresh sushi at a reasonable price. Not as good as other places in the area but decent especially for the price.  

Sadly something has changed and not for the better. The sushi is not nearly as fresh, we have been finding bones in the fish and the final tipping point was the food poisoning poisoning my boyfriend got last week. They forget parts of the order, rolls will not have fish through out and the last order we got was just bad fish. Inexcusable. Too many bad experiences, will not be going back.

Horrible horrible horrible. Came in on a Friday night around 8:30 pm and it took 10 minutes for a host/server to see us standing up front waited to be seated. A server came we ordered drinks, only one drink got delivered to us and then we were forgotten about... for 20 minutes we waited and waited until I finally had to get up and go get a manger. Only then did a server come to the table and say sorry you were forgotten about can I take your order. Very bad experience we left immediately and didn't even order

I went here this morning to get breakfast for me and my friend drive thru line was long so I went inside. The people looked and acted very unfriendly and rude. My order took forever to come out. I and other customers were giving attitude. 3 people had came back with wrong orders. I ordered two large orange juices and one was not filled up all the way I asked them to fill up and the girl who was the only person who was nice to me said her manager said she would allow it only this one time. If I pay for large I expect to be full all the way.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Absolute worst customer service. Eric the "manager" is very unprofessional and should not be allowed to speak to paying customers the way he does. Whoever runs/owns this property may want to rethink this employee and they way you run your business. Had a car damaged, asked for who to speak to and file a claim. He refused to help, when we called he started yelling and cussing. This call was recorded as well as the entire interaction at the car wash. I would be embarrassed as a company to have this type of behavior at my place of business.

Definitely the best hotel for the price I've ever stayed in, the room was clean and spacious and everyone that works there had a great attitude.

The breakfast crew, consisting of one Mackenzie (as far as I could tell) deserves a special shout out. It seems as if most hotels that offer a free continental breakfast put food out when it opens and then abandon it. This was not the case at all, when I arrived everything was still stocked remarkably well and the staff member was ready and willing to offer help and answer my dumb pre-coffee questions at 8 am.

Keep up the good work, I would definitely return!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: What a horrible experience.  Ignored at check in while the staff talked amongst themselves, phone calls were also the priority.  They didn't have the room I booked available at 4 pm, housekeeping issues.  So I took another type.  That room had obviously dirty sheets, poorly made beds and a filthy shower.  The next room had water all over the floor from a faulty fridge and the maid left her cleaning supplies in the room.  The hallways and common areas are dirty.  The GM was too busy in her office to address.  I would AVOID this property at all costs.  I'm a road warrior for work and this is one very poorly managed facility.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: After waiting 20 minutes for a simple order I had to go back to the counter and ask the manager where my food was. It was there waiting to be brought out, lord knows how long it was there. Then I asked for napkins because the dispencer was out and I was told that they were out of them. I can't believe a restaurant could be out of napkins. Then I reminded her that the dollar store was across the street and maybe one of the employees could go get some(seemed logical, because there were a lot of people working but only a few actually doing something). If I could I would give this place 1/4 star. My advice is find another Mickey dees
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Nicely sized restaurant with very nice wait staff. Came for lunch special deals and were NOT disappointed! Hibachi came with very good portions and chef played some saki games with us as well. Ordered the veggie gyoza and was content with them. Owner happened to come by to check how things were going which was a nice touch. Place is BYOB so we brought in a bottle of sake for ourselves - they offered an ice bucket and made sure we had a good meal. Overall really impressed for a hibachi place in this kinda rural neighborhood but would def recommend to others.

This bar is easily the worst bar in Reno!!! The waiters are horrible, and the security is even worse. Last weekend the security took my buddies id, who is 23, and when he asked for it back he was thrown to the ground. The security is constantly getting physical with people trying to come into this bar. Also, while in the bar they fill my beer up 3/4 of the way. my buddies were ordering shots, and they were clearly watered down. Save your time and do not go to this bar. I can't believe it is still in business...

We only stayed one night, but that was enough. Although easy to find and across the street from a shopping center, the draw of this hotel ended there. Greeted by a large, well lit lobby and very polite and able staff, we were taken aback by the room. It was large enough with a good bed, but it contained no amenities. No frig, no micro wave, nothing. Obviously they want you to eat in their dining area on the first floor, so we went there for breakfast. We found a Starbucks, whose menu was filled with over priced. highly caloric foods. The hotel is obviously concerned with business travelers, but that's not us. A word of warning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been to Duncan Donut locations across the country and never experienced such terrible service. We went to this location this morning and your employee Michelle was terribly rude to both myself and my ten year old telling her to stay out of the other customers way when she was simply standing with me. She rolled her eyes at me when I order a dozen assorted donuts and told me that I had to pick them out myself and not to take forever about it. This is disappointing because normally Duncan Donut employees are polite and helpful. Due to the actions and attitude of Michelle I will not be returning to this location.

I had an AMAZING haircut and blowout with Christie... Maybe the best I've had!  I have long and and very thick hair, Christie was able to work to my hairs strengths and gave me fabulous shape, while maintaining my length.  Layers for miles!  It looks really great when I take the time to style it, and it also looks great when I let my natural curls do their thing. 

Haircut aside, Dandelion is such a relaxing and beautiful space, and Christie was so easy to communicate with about hair stuff, but beyond that, I felt like I'd known her for years.  

I'm already excited for my next service!

Very rude. My brother is visually impaired, so to see things more than a few feet away he uses a small telescope. Upon seeing this the cashier told my brother he could not use a camera in the store (it doesn't look like a camera). We explained to the cashier that it was not a camera and that my brother needed it to see things, to which he loudly responded "I don't like it, OKAY!". I then told the cashier if that was the case we wouldn't not be purchasing anything in the store, his response to which was "Good, get out!".

We were camping at a nearby campground and read about this on Yelp.  We decided to give it a try and it was every bit as good as the reviews described it.

They were out of lasagna that night so we decided to have pizza and it was nothing short of delicious.  The crust was amazing and the toppings were plentiful and fresh.

It is housed in an old house in Ashland City and only has seating for about 15 but that adds to the ambiance of the place.  Family pictures and a gold statue  of Elvis on the mantel.  Just the kind of place that I like to eat at, it was a great experience overall and I highly recommend.

We've brought our child in several times for haircuts here.  It's quite obvious that this barber shop has no interest in cutting children's hair.  Specifically, there is one woman with long blonde hair that was roughly pushing my child's head around and was so nasty and rude.  He was almost in tears.  The majority of the women in there are nasty except for one younger girl.  The only time I've ever witnessed them being nice and pleasant was when the owner was present.  We will be taking our money elsewhere after how poorly we've been treated here.

Can't really fault it, stayed only one weekend nite, it was quiet, rooms were spacious and clean, was reasonably close to the downtown attractions.  Very low key, good breakfast in the morning, friendly valet staff.  Only thing was we were driving a rental car in from the airport, and had never been to Nashville before.  Traffic inbound on the Nashville Interstates for a Saturday, sucked unbelievably, and if we had not had a SAT-NAV, it would have taken us a long time for us to eventually find it.

I've stayed in far worse downtown metropolitan hotels.  If we ever came back to Nashville, we'd likely stay again.....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I paid $15 for a wash and wax, didn't receive the air freshener or other things included in the package. A worker came out to tell me about the promotion, which the machine was also bugging me about, and meanwhile the car next to me finished up, so I think they got the wash I was supposed to receive. The spray did not get the bugs off my hood, and the spot free rinse left spots. The dryers on the end were so weak I had to hand dry most of my car. I should have bought the $5 package--probably would have gotten the same value out of it. 
The one positive was the powerful vacuum cleaners. Sucked up all the dirt and hair on my mats.

Heard great things about this restaurant and the 1-1.5 hr wait seemed to support that reputation. I ordered calamari, Caesar salad and the lasagna. The calamari was over cooked and had a strange musty pepper taste. The Caesar salad was over-dressed and the lasagna was spicy and gummy. The best thing I had was the focaccia bread...after I scraped off the garlic salt on top. Many people seem to really like it, but it wasn't for me. The service was good, people were friendly and when they recognized I didn't care for the lasagna, they very kindly removed it from our bill.

HORRIBLE... Do not go here. I'm here from out of town working and this place is located in the mall attached to the hotel where I'm staying. I ALWAYS check yelp, but I forgot to do so today. Big mistake. My nails look like trash..lumpy, stubby, uneven..I took a picture but trust me they look worse in person. Save time, money, and aggravation. Oh! I asked to get my eyebrows done (before I realized just how bad my hands looked) and she said no because the wax warmer was unplugged. Really? Do not patronize this place.

We ate here last night. Waited well over one hour to receive our food. No updates about the delay. They comped us one meal and gave us a card for a free appetizer in the future after we expressed our displeasure. However it ruined our evenings plans and I'm not sure I will be returning to this venue.   The general manager was delivering food to the tables and they were clearly understaffed in the kitchen. The food was fine, not spectacular.  I would not recommend this restaurant if you have plans following dinner.

Walked in around 7:30 pm and it was pretty dead only another person in a stylist chair. Asked for a shoulder length hair cut with side swept bangs. The stylist didn't part my hair but made a comment on the fact it looked greasy. I had coconut oil in it so yes it was greasy. She moved my head around while she cut the back. The side swept bangs she gave me are barely there. The hair length was lopsided. The short part had long hairs left behind. Not only has this happened before but this time it's been very noticeable. You would have to be blind not to see the horrible haircut!

I went to the Fenway Rooftop Bar Sunday afternoon at 2 pm. The Rooftop Bar was not crowded at all. Two bartenders on staff. After I joined friends at a table I waited 20 minutes for someone to come over and take my order. We had a party at 4. It took another 10 minutes to get my drink. The server put down no napkin, no coaster. Condensation from the glass dripped all over me every time I took a sip. Service  declined from there. We had to bus our own table. The computers were down and we were told they could keep our credit card on file and email a receipt. I smell fraud all over that. We broke down our check and paid cash. Spectacular View.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Terrible. 
Tried it when it first opened. Was terrible. 
Went back to give it another shot. Confirmed. Terrible. Terrible service. Ordered Edamame and it never came. Waiters are young and service is terrible. They look straight forward and can't get their attention to then order. 
Got a nice helping of rice and chicken was ok but tiny portion of veggies. Veggies!?  Asked for a bit more and was told it would cost $3.50. Ok. Fine. That order took 15 minutes!!  By then I was done eating. 
It's also priced too high. Everything should be $2 less. And hibachi shrimp is $5 more than chicken?
A must skip. Won't ever return.

Rat infestation!!!! Had to constantly threaten to sue to get our money back after living there for barely a month. Cion and Irenisha are bad people and allow people to live in rat infestation and bugs. They tried to play like there is not a PEST infestation there and the evidence is overwhelming that there is indeed a huge problem that has yet to be solved there. Do not waste your time and money. This place should be condemned. You would think it would be nice looking at it from the outside but in reality it's INFESTED. Completely disturbing experience.

I was in an accident. My insurance set me up with enterprise car rental. Enterprise really wanted me to buy the extra coverage. So i caved and told them id prepay for 3 days and if i felt i needed more i would extend it. Basically just to shut the guy up. Come to find out they saved me the trouble and extended for me. Thanks enterprise for charging me for something i didnt ask for. I told them i wouldnt be paying for extra insurance when i didnt want it. They took the keys and said i wasnt aloud to have the vehicle until i paid it. Needless to say ill never do business with enterprise again

My daughter and I visited today. I wanted a gel manicure polish change & daughter received new acrylic tips. We we both were ok satisfied because they were extremely SLOW......novice nail technicians & it showed (putting designs on and off, etc. it showed)  We arrived home. Within 15 minutes, daughter nail is broken down  beneath the nail bed  - normal wear. So unfortunate. Guess we will have to visit the salon first thing and have it repaired.  ....be prepared to pay top dollar for novice service. imma a heavy tipper,  not for breakage and repairs though! Geez!

Nice hotel, clean, comfortable, convenient, and good continental breakfast.  Staff is generally very nice, except the front desk folks were not that nice, both at check-in and check-out.  They appeared to want to talk more with other staff, rather than to talk with the customers to sincerely ask about their stays. Maybe it just me being from the south where people tend to be more nice.  The room was large and comfortable, but TV placement not that good.  Also, the comforter on one of the beds was not clean - had large crusty spot near the top.  Again good hotel, but could easily be great if some
 attention to details can be applied.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very dissatisfied with my encounter at this site. Reserved a mid-size vehicle and on arrival the process of having to detail personal travel information there was exhausting. After that the car provided had issues to where they of course had none left in stock leaving me to have to sit and wait for someone to return a car and then wait further for them to clean and transition it over for me to use. If you want a decent transaction I would NOT recommend this site at all. Be prepared for fumbles that will cause delay with no real recompense in order for your wasted time.

Just because the business is open doesn't mean people want to go to a physical gym location during a pandemic. Not only am I not able to go into the gym location due to currently residing in a different location, but sending a hand written letter to cancel a membership is just nonsense. After the gyms opened back up, I was charged the yearly fee, AND monthly fees when I haven't even stepped foot in a planet fitness location since probably February. This is just a way to keep the money coming in with ridiculous opportunities to cancel. Not only was the person I spoke to arrogant and condescending, but I was also hung up on.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Jerry's has THE BEST turkey club sandwiches in town!! The turkey is cooked fresh - REAL turkey not turkey roll! Great assortment of side choices. The menu is full of fantastic selections. I also enjoy the breakfast pork chop on occasion. Grilled to perfection - flavorful and tender, juicy. They just opened outdoor patio seating. Also, they offer customers great specials via e-mail every week, often 'Buy-one-get-one-free' meals on Monday and Tuesday's. The owner has an interesting back-story relative Boise. If you haven't eaten at Jerry's yet - give it a try - you'll like it!!

Went in with a friend to take advantage of the Quarter Thursday deal and they did not apply it to our order. It never said anything about having to mention social media posts in order to receive the discount, so it should have been applied. My friend and I asked the cashier if she could get us the discount, but she said she didn't know how to do that and there weren't any store credit or coupons to be applied to the next visit in return. She took down our phone numbers and said the manager would give us a call, but it's been months and nothing. Very disappointed.

I've only been at this club a short while and have to write I have all but one positive.  Staff is great, classes are well instructed and equipment is the best.  If I had only one change to recommend it would be the black membership.  I'm a $10 month to month white membership with only access to one club.  I'd get the black if it was either less money or didn't have such a great penalty for quitting.  I float between three locations, this has a PF close, another location has one 20 miles from it and the third has none.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Are you kidding? You give the place a one star because 7 basketball players could not sleep comfy in the room?

Well, back on this planet. The rating has to include the local market. Where else could you have stayed for the $? This Motel 6 is quite serviceable and probably 60% of the cost of the competition. Small, euro-efficient rooms. mediocre beds. Downside: I don't like paying for wifi ($3 per device per day), and I would like an explanation for the in room ash trays that has the no smoking sign on it. WTF?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The service was good...nothing first rate, but completely acceptable. The lighting was too bright, but the temperature was nice. The food though...yikes! If this were my restaurant, I would be embarrassed by the food. The presentation lacked inspiration. The flavors were very simple and one dimensional. Most people can do better cooking at home. The desserts were very good. 

Clark Street Grill is the kind of place one should visit out of convenience, but never for an exceptional culinary experience. I would not recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a fine dining experience.

Went there for a first visit back in June 2013 after recieving a personal recomendation.  The pedicure was great and the nail tech was professional and sweet.  I went back in September and received a completely different experience.  The man who did my pedicure watched the TV while he scrubbed my feet and cut my cuticles too close causing me to bleed.  I noticed the salon was not as clean as when I was there in June.  What a dissapointment!  I wish I had asked him to stop at the beginning of the appointment because in the end my feet hurt and it was a waste of time and money.

Having a rude front desk associate/manager or whatever Jeff's title is, cannot be good for Autotire. I've never felt so disrespected by a business. The way he interacted with me and talked down to me, a female, was uncalled for and completely unforgivable. Long story short, it took a phone call to the police and then going in there for me to be able to get my keys and vehicle back. What a crooked person this guy is. Unfortunately, there may be some okay people that work there but with Jeff at the front desk, it's not even worth taking the chance on.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This bank is awful tricky and underhanded! They offered me a "convenience pay" of $500 then a month later I wrote a check for $415 and they waited a week till a Friday before a 3 day weekend to bounce it saying that this feature can change anytime and they don't have to notify you. I received no letter no call nothing. Now they put a block on my account so I can't deposit anything but cash. I would find another bank or move my money to a bank that respects you. Rhonda, sandy, and their manager Darlene don't even email me back anymore. I'm filing a complaint with the federal reserve. I suggest current members should do the same.

Ital Motors is across from Victoria High School at 10827 101 Street, (780) 424-5210, so it's very centrally located and accessible. 

The place is family owned, small, caring, reasonable and as honest as the day is long. I've been going there for 36 years and have seen so many acts of generosity on their part, both to myself and others. They always try to save me money.

Ital Motors services all makes and models, and look after my Alfa and Subaru with equal expertise. If you want a fancy waiting room, skip the place, but if you want a shop that does good work and that you can trust, run don't walk.

Friendly. The company seems a little disorganized. Nice to have one stop shopping for alot of the apartments. I suspect there is an increase in rental cost because of the service.

Pros: Found a great apartment without much searching. They accommodated us by adjusting the move in date. 
Cons: We went to a showing and nobody was there because there was a lack of communication between employees at PAC. Their phone / internet service went down when I was trying to sign the lease and I had to do alot of communicating between my previous and current property management companies.

We were not expecting a lot when we booked this very affordable hotel. To our delight it over exceeded our expectations. They have a wonderful complimentary hot breakfast buffet every morning and Beverly ( the gal tending to the whole breakfast area) was beyond accommodating! She quickly refilled and replenished all of the food and we never felt like we were getting " leftovers" even when it was nearing closing. Thank you Beverly for your hospitality! 
My only criticism would be that our room had an odor that never went away. We bought a plug in air freshener which helped a little. It's clean and nice but not a five star hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: NY Pizza?? Really?? I don't know who would claim this to be the "Best NY Pizza" I ordered 2 cheese slices & my husband ordered the eggplant Parm dinner! My pizza looked like it was made hours ago & then the ran it thru a conveyer belt oven?? Unheard of! The eggplant looked & taste like a frozen boxed version of supposedly authentic NY Italian! No worries we True 100% NY's will Never eat here again a total waste of $$. The Absolute Worst! I'll drive the extra 20 min to get real NY pizza @ Eddie & Sam's Tampa!

We have taken our two dogs to Chesterfield for a few years now and really like them. We were with our previous vet for over 14 years and they wouldn't see us when our dog was in horrible (screaming out) pain. Dr. S took us within a few hours and immediately knew how to help. Our old man went on to live three more happy years under their care making it to just shy of his 18th Birthday. On his final day, the Dr and staff guided us through the process to ease his pain and though it was an awful day, they helped to make it a bearable. We will continue to bring our other dog and any future fur babies to Chesterfield.

This hole-in-a-wall gem is a must visit. The food was very tasty and proportions were just right. The Italian wine selections were very very good as well. More of a reason to come check this spot out is due the the positive experience Leo, our server, provided. He was truly knowledgeable and very helpful. Also, he has an excellent attitude and personality.

The only negative I have is the parking situation. Get there early or you will have a heck of a time finding parking. 

Regardless, Yup I will be back for sure.

-Friendly Staff from the outside, checkin, room service, kitchen, and cleaning staff. There was consistency in their familiarity in their roles. It was a good demonstration of a fully functional,  producing team. Keep it up! Good work!
 -The Front Desk was especially customer-centric, respectful, and helpful. 
 -Loved the computer area on the first floor. 
 -Fitness area had cardio, weights, and massage rollers. Machines had tech and health monitoring.
 -Room was neat, clean, and I loved the firm mattress with soft topper. 
 -Bonus: Beautiful sunrise. Lovely waterway. 
Great job! And a walk away to the conference. :)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ok... first of all, McDonald's you're fake as fuckkkkk. Yo ice cream always hella broke for no reason. Kind of suspicious if you ask me. This time was the worst offense though, however. Me and my comrade orders two vanilla cones. We were overjoyed (and surprised) to hear the total was $2.18. The ice cream machine wasn't broke for once! Yippee we thought... boy were we wrong. We whooped in happiness, only to be told seconds after that y'all ice cream machine broke as shit. Fix this problem ASAP. Until then, catch me at Burger King. Deuces bitches!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: For a place that will charge you 200 + for a full detail at least do what is paid for, never again will i return to this place the attitude and the , so famous quote of " CUSTOMER CARE " does not exist here the question i have is how has this place been here for so long with disgusting service yet alone not even detail the car for a company that focuses on car wash at least train your staff to the full potential of the business worst mistake i made by going there now off to find a business that strives in customer care and satisfaction. ... and it was there half the day !!!!!

Where shall I begin ???? If could be with the wait to get keys made that actually worked . It could be the glass of wine for $22.50 that was not published on the menu, just my receipt . It really was about the clerk who, when I informed her of the 80' temp in my room simply said "ITS FLORIDA". Then just to finish up the valet spent 30 minutes looking for my vehicle because no one bothered to note the space number on the ticket. 
This is relatively new management , a couple of years I was told . At this rate they won't last a couple more . 
Absurd...last time there! One star cause I couldn't give none.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: ROCKS?? REALLY? I used to go here all the time until last week when i bit into my taco and cracked my tooth on a rock. I called the restaurant and they were not nice to me at all. I cant believe that when someone calls with a problem that they would not at least say sorry. The owner was not in the restaurant so i asked for her number so I could get her insurance information and the manager would not give it to me, then the owner called me from a blocked number spouted off her insurance information and hung up. I will never go back here ever again

The food was nice! But, it was EXTREMELY EXPENSIVE for no reason! I got Chicken Parm which ended up being $16.00 for a piece of chicken and 1/4 of a cup of pasta. I honestly feel like this place is overpriced. Drinks, food, dessert, everything! $10 for a margarita?? The center table was very gorgeous. But the placemats are tacky, and there was sticky stuff underneath them. The chairs didn't sit back comfortably so I felt like I was falling off the entire time. Our server checked on us about..3 times maybe the entire night. Maybe I just had bad luck for a first time experience. But I really wasn't impressed.

Middle of the road Courtyard.  I stayed at the Courtyard at UD in Newark the night before, that property was more plush and great food. 

This PHL property has nicer Tea Tree bath products, but no lotion.  Fitness center is an overstuffed room (cardio equipment and a rack of free weights but no space to use them!).  Room was nice but showed signs of age and wear.  

The only real disappointment is that I made a reservation for the 5 am shuttle, they left without me and they only run limited shuttles every 30 minutes (would not run on request).
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I hate to write a negative review for this type of establishment, but I got the worst haircut I've ever had here. Like so bad that I wouldn't go in public till it was fixed.

Problem is, when your hair bad enough, you don't want to go to the same person or place to have it fixed. So I had to pay another barber again for another haircut. Nice guy (Dave I think), decent shop, terrible haircut. Since that's what really matters, the other factors can't fix t. 

Bottom line, I feel bad leaving a bad review for these guys, but the haircut I got here was awful.

This is the best place in tucson for affordable sushi! Great ambience, fresh sushi and the plum ice cream!!!! Soooo good! The service is usually on point too. My only complaint is that they "usually" give you complimentary miso, edamame and plum ice cream which makes the meal A++++ however sometimes they don't bring out edamame and other times they bring out nothing :/ it's just a bummer when you're expecting it (because it's really freaking good)  and then they seem to forget or don't offer it on occasion? I guess I shouldn't complain about complimentary things?!?! Anyway, go here!!!

They are trying to be an upscale, small plate, high quality restaurant but unfortunately the food is bland and mediocre. I've had more flavorful mexican food at cheap food trucks. The guac was especially bland and the avocados weren't ripe. The shrimp enchiladas were actually 3 tortilla thick cheese enchiladas with a few grilled shrimp on the top. Since when do shrimp enchiladas not have shrimp inside? Definitely in the low flavor high calorie category. The only thing I actually enjoyed was the street corn which was very good and the main reason I didn't give them 1 star. Don't waste your time.

I've stayed at this hotel many times and even though I've had issues, I've come back because of the location.  I never will again! Today I went to check in several hours after "check in time" and the hotel had 0 rooms for me to check in to because they decided to clean the carpets.  I had to wait 20 minutes for them to "release" some rooms even though they weren't on the side of the hotel where the carpets were being cleaned.  It didn't make a whole lot of sense. This hotel seems like the management doesn't know what they are doing.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
If I could give 0 stars I would give it, Ive been going to glasses galore since in 12 years old, and today is the last time I step foot in that shit show of a glasses store! Rude service, overpriced glasses , and the worst selection of glasses to choose from! 

To the lady at the front right desk, learn some basic business practice, people open a business to make money not to push people out the door. Worst experience I've ever had in my life and I buy glasses frequently, I will be shopping else where where I am appreciated.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
With an appointment or without you'll be looking at a very long wait time regardless of the service you brought your vehicle in for.

If you read most of the reviews for this spot you'll notice a pattern of long wait times. I've been coming to this location as long as the warranty has lasted on my tires. Now that the warranty is up I will never ever come back here. 

If I was told right at the beginning that I would be waiting almost 4 hours to have my tires rotated I would have much rather paid another shop to have it done quickly. 

Don't waste your money or time here.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I really like jacks donuts everyone is so friendly at the southport location. However, the last three times I have gone in I have been frustrated. About a month ago I went up there at 10pm and they had decided to close an hour early and there was a full case of donuts. The second time I went in it was around 2pm and they were completely out of any type of chocolate donut and said there wouldn't be anymore until the next day. The third time I just tried to go it was around 6pm and all they had was blueberry left. I know they are super busy but I do think they need to figure something out to keep up with the demand.

I am not the one to complain, but my experience was horrible. I order the shrimp tempura, and to my surprise it was hair wrap in the sushi. I actually pulled the hair out of my mouth. I told the manager and she took it to the back. She came back out and tried to accuse my friend. Mind you me and my friends both had scarfs on and the hair was blonde. We both have black hair. So after going back and forth with the manager nothing was resolved. Not even an apology. I will not recommend this place to anyone. Horrible

Arrived an hour and a half after check in time and told I had to wait for a room to be cleaned at least 30 minutes.  Restaurant food was worse than Denny's and the noise levels in the hotel were obnoxious with no resolution after discussing the issues with management.  Vending room had water and mud all over the floor.  Big stain on the floor in my bathroom.  I couldn't sleep because of how noisy the hotel was. Also be prepared to add 10-15 minutes wait for elevators or do what I did and just take the stairs.  Insane.  Marriott should not allow their name on this establishment.  Never staying here again. A motel 6 would be more restful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Small, uncomfortable, noisy and bathrooms do NOT look as pictured. I was really disappointed by my stay here. The pillows were lumpy and our room never got cool through the night and that's with the unit on blast and the fan. It made for a very uncomfortable night. Also you can hear every little thing our neighbors are doing in the restroom and they us, I imagine. Not only was the bathroom not private, it looked NOTHING like it is pictured on yelp or their website. Blue, white, yellow tiles and super small. I was excited to stay here but it ended up being disappointed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Today was the first time I ordered the eel box. As a lover of eel box sushi and eel in general I was very disappointed. The eel was cold. It wasnt straight from the oven and got cold it just never made it to the oven. I know what cold vs hot eel tastes like. Cold is what you would normally get on a buffet. Regardless they have a great happy hour and you cant beat the prices If you like what's on offer. If you are an eel lover you know how amazing hot eel tastes. I forgot to take a photo until after I ate some and by then it was too late. But trust, not hot at all. Xoxo

In St Louis for temporary military duty, and we were looking for a nice Mexican restaurant.  Saw Laredo's website where they advertised 50% entrée discount for military and first responders, and thought we would give it a try.  Service was nice, food was good, but when it came time for the check and we identified ourselves as military, we were told that they don't have a military discount any more.  We appreciate those establishments that provide a discount, but don't routinely expect it.  It is reprehensible, however, to advertise it on your website and then refuse to honor it.

Be very careful if you chose to stay at Staybridge Suites and book thru any of the online services ( Expedia  Priceline Bookings.com ) . All of these services contain a disclaimer which allows Staybridge Suites to give you any room they have available regardless of the room which was booked. Reads something like " rooms will be allocated upon arrival based on availability " . I booked a suite at Staybridge Reno and one wasnot available so they gave me a small room and refused to refund the price difference. Rude to boot. Avoid this place if at all possible.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I really had high hopes for this place. Their selection of food is really good and can't really complain about the prices. However, when you walk in you are not greeted like in most establishments. Sometimes you have to wait a long time for the workers to even acknowledge you, even when it's not busy. When they do come to your service it is not pleasant and welcoming, rather it makes you feel like you're bothering them. Would really suggest for the staff to get some training in customer service. The food is also inconsistent because workers will prepare it differently. Also an "order here" sign would help.

As time goes on, many ask themselves, does this pizza joint become better or worse? And the answer is, well, the latter. The lines become longer. The music becomes louder. It is obnoxious. The college town of Isla Vista, deserves more. PMH at one point was a safe haven for the rational to come together and enjoy a nice brewski, or even a slice. However, this year as taken a turn for the worse. Screaming keeds, obnoxious lip snycers, and a plethora of cringes filled to the brim (greater than the employees are willing to fill your beer). Let's make PMH sauce again. No Ragu, but str8 sauce. Tell the obnoxious to literally Kick rocks.

This place must have changed management in the past couple of years.  My Husband and I work close and use to like going here for lunch.  The past few times we have went the buffett tables were empty (At Lunch Time) and we sat down at a table and I picked up the salt shaker and it was sticky.  Totally grossed me out!  I'm sorry but one time we even walked out because again, the buffett table was empty.  You would think that Lunch time they would be prepared with the buffett.  We went a few times thinking it was just the day, but we are done and won't go back.

Both Mark and John are amazing. I had never before taken my car anywhere but the BMW dealership in Mt. Laurel. Mark charged me so much less than BMW to do the repair that I can't even tell you the savings percentage (it was way less than half). After I picked up the car I heard a rattle. Mark immediately told me to bring the car back and today spent over 4 hours trying to find the rattle.They finally found it, and even though it may not have been caused by the original repair, they purchased parts and fixed it without charging me for any of it! I would definitely recommend the business.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This place was a little, hidden gem. It is tucked away off of the main roads in a quiet, residential area. The shop is clean, and the owner was very friendly. She was efficient, did a great job, and my gel manicure and pedicure were more than affordable! Though some of the touches of fancier salons were lacking (i.e. hand dipped wax, hot towels, thorough scrub, etc.) it definitely did the trick for my budget and quality of service! Another client came in while there and also spoke highly of the friendly staff and great work. I will be returning should my nails hold up well in the coming weeks, and would encourage others to visit as well.

I love everything about this gym!  I have had memberships in much, much more expensive gyms in other cities, but I still like this one the best.  It is always sparkling clean, the staff is friendly, the music and color scheme are upbeat and energizing, and I've never seen it crowded.  There is a mix of people, from high school students to buff bodybuilders to the elderly-- but, thankfully, no little kids running around.  (Unlike gyms that offer child care). The equipment is new, state-of-the-art, and effective. And all of this at a low, low price!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Our entire trip was ruined by the atmosphere of the clients at this hotel. They had a group of young girls that took up all the tables at the bar at night, no place to sit. Then the next day they had inflatable rafts the size of cars out taking up the whole swimming area. Then decided all 40 of these girls would go in the pool. Splashing small children and other people. Everyone had to leave the pool as they had no consideration. When complaining to the hotel they told them to keep it down. Parents sitting there with them were just as bad and did not help. Never will stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
So there are positives and negatives. The location is great as well as the restaurant downstairs and pool and it's right on the beach. The cleanliness is ok, they wash the sheets every 3 days if you stay here for that long. Water pressure in the shower is kind of terrible, towels are small, you have to rent beach chairs and they don't give you pool towels. Make sure you ask for a non smoking room if you don't smoke. Marcia in the boca sands grille is a sweetheart. 

This location is great for a few days and just to sleep. Go to Johns pass marina for a great time or stay in Madeira beach, we will next time!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This restaurant definitely had 5 stars in location/view and service but the food was lacking. The bread and pesto sauce was delicious and so was the salad and appetizers; but I was very disappointed with my main course. I ordered roasted eggplant that came with a side of pasta with vegetables. They use way too much butter when cooking which made it less enjoyable to eat. I took my leftovers home and heated it up and actually saw a pool of butter. Would consider returning but making sure they don't use butter!

Best pricing in town and fantastic staff.  They offer Feline FVRCP FELV combo (two vaccines) for $30 per pet (I have three = $90) versus Countryside Animal in Mt Juliet that charges $25 per vaccine =$50 per pet (3x$50=$150.)  I save $60 going to Value Vet each year versus their competitors that charge $150.  The Dr. Mokhtari is fantastic and they have a wonderful Tech Toni Z.  Place is always clean, and I have never waited more than 10 minutes past my appointment time versus their competitor that have left me waiting for an hour (after I was told appointments running on time)!  I would highly recommend Value Vet in Hermitage, TN.

I would give this location zero stars if I could. I had a confirmation for a car reservation, and when I arrived at this location, I was told that they had no cars available and tried to pin the blame for the miscommunication on me! I had to scramble to find a different rental agency that had cars available. I then asked for Hertz to give me a ride to the other rental agency's location, and they flatly refused. The woman April at the counter had a callous and poor attitude, and the manager whom she was speaking to over the phone couldn't care less. So much for customer service!

If it was possible to give this place no stars I would. I have never ever (and I've had a lot of pizza in the city) had pizza this disgusting before. The sauce the dough the cheese... It's all bad. I would rather go into the freezer and make myself some ellios frozen pizza then even look at the disgrace that tower style calls a pizza. 

Not only is the pizza horrible but it took almost two hours to deliver and when the delivery guy got here he had a car load of people and was blasting music. My pizza was cold when it arrived. This place sucks there's so many great pizza places around don't even waste your time or your money.

Waited here for over an hour to just get a hair cut. There were a few (3) people in front but they were taking other people in front of us as they were walking in. There are three ladies working and it should've gone much faster. They were all taking their sweet time with each person and then taking over 5min to broom up under their chair after each person. It was my first time here and I'm never coming back. Also when I walked in there was no greeting and I stood around waiting to know if I was supposed to check in or just sit down.

Ordered the teriyaki chicken dinner. Literally a plain, zero seasoning, chicken breast smothered in an overly sweet, pre made teriyaki sauce served with a cup of plain white rice and 3 pieces of broccoli. Hubs ordered the New York strip rare and salmon hibachi dinner. Steak was sirloin at best quality, very chewy and salmon over cooked. Both had a less than desirable teriyaki drizzle. Was not served with yum yum sauce, had to ask for some & it was "not quite right." Sushi appetizer, Caterpillar Roll, was good. Sushi must be keeping this restaurant open because the dinners are at best made by a Waffle House line cook.

When the right manager is there this place is awesome a well oiled machine....if not forget it!!! Can't hear or understand 2 of the staff member tonight. The ones at the registers...that is a problem.  One mumbles and the other I am not confident completely understands english.  Nice guys but makes me worry my order is not right till I get it.  And the rest of the staff look like they hate being there.  But when the usual manager is there great food great service and no issues.... I hate posting bad reviews .

Have been an Aisle member for 20 plus years.  Tampa's aisle staff is as good as it gets.  There have been many times when I was not happy with the aisle selection in season (no choices)  They always run and fill with others immediately.  Returning can not be easier and everyone is always friendly.  

Somehow (not sure how) they will always remind me of what I left in the car as I start walking away.  They are not in the car at the time.  Must all be psychic.  This time it was my sunglasses that were up in the visor.

(1) The manicurist should not have been working today. With her coughing and runny nose, she had some kind of cold or the start of the flu. Luckily, I did not have anything but nail polish applied by her (i.e., no skin was cut for germs to enter) because... see item #2.
(2) She was unable to file my nails without being uneven with edges that weren't smooth. I asked for the file to do the job myself because she couldn't manage this basic step. Who wants to go home with fresh nail polish applied, only to have to even out the shaping because the edges are jagged and not even???

I have taken many things to Helen's before and have been very pleased. However this time was much different... I took in a dress that I was very excited about. After pinning it just like i had imagined... Helen gave me "advice." She essentially told me that next time I buy a dress it shouldn't be cut like the one I had just paid $50 to have her alter because my shoulders are too wide for the rest of my body. i didn't ask for this advice nor do I appreciate comments like this. I will pick up my dress when it is finished and after that I will not return.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Been to Harvest several times and wanted to give Charred a try, Meh is putting it mildly.

I won't waste your time with a lot of words, the pizza was terrible. I like thin crust, what I don't like is a soggy (read that as wet) pizza. The crust was done nicely, but the sauce was wet (under cooked), the sausage had no taste at all, none. A slice of pizza should never be "dripping" wet.

Service was very slow and inattentive, almost to the point I was going to walk out.

In the future I'll pass on this restaurant.

Stayed for a week. Loved the location, easy walking distance to many attractions, the water etc but not noisy or scary outside. Room service is via another restaurant. Used twice, first time order was not correct, second time it took a long time and was cold. Just go out, there are lots of great places to eat on the doorstep. Housekeeping didn't leave new shampoo/lotion for a couple of days but when I left a note, they more than compensated. Rooms are modern and love the separate living room. Wee but dark as only window is in the bedroom but overall great place to stay in NOLA.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Service is terrible.   The oldest server on the floor is a teenager.  We sat for 30 minutes before we were even offered water.  The only reason I give it the 3 stars was the food. It was better than average, although my wife's steak was served lukewarm.  I had the crab cakes, they were tasty buy served in a buttery corn chowder soup that was a little heavy and unnecessarily unhealthy for my taste.   Watch the happy hour prices.  We arrived at happy hour and we were charged full price for our drinks.  Decent atmosphere and cool old building. It is cold in the winter so dress warm.  The fireplace wasn't working when we were there.

Horrible place to do business with...... run away as far as you can from Josh or Scott. This place will give you are car loan.... then will limit how much you can pay online.... then will call you every 6 months to get you to send them proof of insurance even though they admit they can do this themselves...... you will send it in and even have your insurance company send it it and you will not here back and then one day you find out they added their own insurance that is like $300 a month.

Run as far away from this place as you can.

MAKE SURE YOU CHECK YOUR VEHICLE AFTER! There were long swipe scratches on my new Red car from the SURFS THRU EQUIPMENT.  Please comment/contact me if anything shows up on your vehicle as at this moment I have been called a liar by the Area Manager after he 'reviewed film'.  Surely you may be skeptical of my review, but if I'm not the only one on here I'd like to know because I've been bullied out :( I'm hoping I get some help through multiple cases in Yelp

Good luck, this company does not care nor take responsibility for any mistakes made

I was so excited when this DD opened since it is close to home. They started out strong and then it was all downhill from there. My biggest problem is they always try to jip me on my coffee. Maybe this is due to the constant turn over of employees or lack of training. Every time I get a large macchiato they try to only put in 1 shot. I finally started ordering a coffee with a double shot on the side so I know I get the caffeine I need. 90% of the time they try to give me 1 shot until I call them on it. They don't argue the point which makes me feel like they know they were wrong in the first place.

I'm surprised at the bad reviews on here as we have had great experiences with this location.  Maybe they have new management?
We have always ordered from them.  We live right around the corner and get our pizza in about 20-25 minutes, even on a Saturday night. 
Every time I've went in to the location for carry out, the staff is very nice.  Even get a greeting from the person making the pizzas in the back if the desk person isn't right there to greet me.  
I really like this place and would recommend.  I appreciate the pleasant customer service, and the product is great.

Have taken my cars here for years and won't be back ever.  Had car detailed they did good job took my other car the next day and they charged me $40 more. Talk to the owner Chester and asked him to honor previous day price.  He said I got a break the day before and if he did anything he would charge me another $40 for their mistake. Bad business and he has been in business for 40 years.  That means this owner has been ripping off the good people of Santa Barbara for 40 years.  Do yourself a favor Santa Barbara and do not support this establishment.

It's probably not worth the money you will save to stay here. As others have noted it is in a sketchy part of town, the rooms are extremely unclean, and the staff were unfriendly. You can play "name that stain" in your room, and I had a constant fear of creepy crawlers getting to us at night. The bed itself is extremely uncomfortable, and they give you 1 pillow per guest. The only thing good about this place is I woke up extra early to continue my trip, so it helped me stay on time because I couldn't stand to be in the room any longer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Horrible! Not only do most of the employees not speak English enough to understand what you want done on your nails but they make NO effort to get someone to assist you. I wanted a simple design on my toe even tried showing the lady a picture on my phone but she refused to look, the man told me to "relax, we got this" but it took her four times of painting and removing polish before I gave up out of frustration and just left the crappy job she did. I told her ten times what I wanted and it still looks horrible. She couldn't even get the color right Since ownership changed this place not worth going to

We used to come here all the time, but the quality of food has seriously gone down. This is not a high-traffic location, and Foothills Mall has recently been bought by Tucson investors. All that to say, the spicy tuna roll,or any tuna roll for that matter, is straight out of the can, admittedly so by the owner herself. I feel bad for them because they really needed to change locations a long time ago. The mall is dying and so is the food at this Sushi Garden. Save your money for 'all you can eat' somewhere else. I highly recommend Sushi Cortaro or Sushi on Oracle.

Been coming to this location on and off for around 2 years. Management has the opinion that towel availability is a "complimentary service" and one of their posted notes gives off the vibe that they're doing their clientele a favour by offering towels. That being said, there's usually no towels from Saturday - Tuesday and sometimes they're noticeably unclean. Literally any other location in Edmonton has consistently maintained towels. Everything else is okay, gym is a decent size, equipment fair. Could be better especially for the extra annual fee of ~20 for "upgrades
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Mexico Lindo is a great Mexican restaurant, they bring some salsa and tortilla chips following your menus, which were very tasty.  We ordered some guacamole to start and a delicious tequila cocktail that i cannot remember the name of, both excellent.  We enjoyed some delicious brisket tacos and some steak/pork/peppers/onions with tortillas, all of which were very good!  Finished the meal off with some corn cake dessert that i was not a fan of.  But all in all the wait staff was awesome, and very friendly, the food was great, and the atmosphere was very Mexican.

This place is great, but please increase the portion size.  We would have ordered the same amount of food (3 appetizers, 2 entrees, and 1 dessert between 2 people) regardless, but have left full, if the portions were bigger.  

Cash only and hand written receipts.... hmmmm.  Pumpkin can afford bigger portions.  If I didn't leave hungry, Pumpkin would have gotten 5 stars.  

That said, food was delicious.  Pork cooked 3 ways and sweet potato soup were the best.  

Small BYOB environment is very quaint.  Service was great too.

It's August 31st at 2am. We just had the worst experience. There was a girl refusing to take everyone's orders. 4 cars just got mad and left. She was looking at everyone and then just walking off an rolling her eyes. Thank goodness for her lovely coworker Tanise (we asked for her name because she deserves a good mention) who helped us. Tanise was obviously very frustrated with her coworker and was trying to help everyone. Tanise should get a raise and a promotion. Her coworker should be fired. No questions asked. By the way... It wasn't busy at all. Maybe 5 cars total
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I just want to come back and say that I've been a regular ever since that first time. Due to work, my husband and I were unable to go home for Thanksgiving, and he felt so bad that he promised me sushi every day for four days straight. Predictably, we got it here, and it was always delicious. Their service is prompt and they're all really friendly and helpful. Also they're great with regular orders.

I should note that the ginger and soy sauce issues were flukes - every time I've had their sushi since that first time, the ginger has been sweet and the soy sauce has been salty, instead of the other way around. :)

Having read the reviews, we needed to try the bar for a glass of wine, burger, and mac and cheese.  The mac and cheese was very good but a really small portion.  The burger was over-done and a disappointment in size.  For someone to charge $14 for a burger, I would expect a half pound burger not something marginally larger than In and Out.  The mac and cheese turned out to be $12.   With a beer and glass of wine the bill was over $40.00 (wine was 8 and beer 3).   While there are many establishments that serve samplings for outrageous prices, I would not have expected such at a Tavern.

Consistently good food and I've lived in Boise 22 years so I've visited their old Hyde Park (13th St) location and SE Boise (Harris Ranch) maybe 50 times? 
I almost always get the Canadian Bacon, Blue Cheese, Spinach & Chicken pizza. It's just too good. 
Many times I come just for the local/regional beer selectios on tap.
The only thing I've noticed lately is the dance club music every time no matter what today or time I visit. How about mixing in some Indie, Blue Grass, Punk or Rock? We are not all 17 and it's not 8th street on a Saturday night.

When me, my friend, and my 3 year old child requested 5 regular mcchickens, we were met with the answer "We don't serve those anymore:" But then we were told that they still serve hot and spicy mcchickens. How on gods green earth do they have spicy ones but not normal? Are the spicy ones not just normal ones with spice? I feel a bigger conspiracy going on here. My child is crying now. And for that, I hate this McDonalds and everyone involved. He is the light of my life and it pains me more than a bullet wound to see him this upset. Y'all made a child cry. I hope you're happy! #McDonaldsHatesChildren
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I hate this place. They were incredibly rude to me. I came in for a fill and the guy I got was so rude. He made fun of me and was very aggressive with my hands. I asked if I did anything to offend him and he said, "No No we are almost done." And then he kept asking if I'd been there before. Which I had one other time and got a fill. It was only 19$ then and today he told me it was 28$ I asked why and he just kept saying that's what it always been. Because I knew I couldn't argue I just gave it to him and left. My nails look okay but god I'll never go back there.

I've been coming here for a year and really like their work. However, a few visits back they put the wrong color on my nails.  When I checked out I told the manager and we compared color on my nails to the sample. She said sometimes the gel powder gets old and color changes. It was a big difference and she felt bad. She wrote $10 OFF on the edge of my stamp card and said use it for future visit. I was happy with that. But I just tried to use the discount today and they denied me the discount. They said they had no way to know who wrote that on the card. Really?!?!

This is a place that Swarthmore did not need.   It would be better suited to the basement of a college dorm than a prime commercial spot in our small community.  It's dingy and not very clean; the employees are rude, the service slow, and the product average at best.  Although it appears that tips are expected, there is little interest in customer service, and anyone under 18 or over 30 is clearly unwelcome.  Although it may be rather "unSwarthmorean" in many locals' minds, the Dunkin' Donuts across the street has better coffee and a more pleasant atmosphere.

Very interesting experience. Server jen was great. Food was not good. In any way . Presentation was disgusting. Meat was grey. Shrimp were old and or the oil was old. Not sure. . The food made no mention of sauces.. but boy did they have them.And ugh..  An amazing oportunity exists there. But do something w the food.. please. Menu is good. Food sucks. Atmosphere is quaint for a large place. And the outside is nice. Having said that..ive been in the biz for 20 something years. Their concepts is not defned. Italian? Yeah? No!! Menu is all over the place.  2 stars because of heather and jen.

We will see how the food comes out. But the service has been horrible so far. 20 minutes to have our oder taken. Asked for Jalisco beer and received a Heineken instead. Big difference in beer. There seems to be a priority in the to-go orders over the customers inside. I've been to multiple Mexican restraints that cater to locals and there is usually chips and salsa or some type of condiment to snack on. They didn't have any or an option to order it from the menu. It wouldn't have mattered if we weren't waiting over 30 minutes for tacos. Hopefully, the next guest reads this.

I ordered King Roll & Queen Roll, Under Control Roll, and Honeymoon Roll. The sauce went along pretty well with all of them. I got 50% off for my order which was pretty nice. I gave 4 stars because when I got asked for dessert and I said, "No." loud and clear. Still, a waitress brought to me an orange. The orange was cut and divided nicely but I was very confused of why it was still brought up. Then, when I received my receipt, the orange costed around $4 or something. I didn't complain but hope they will hear me better next time.

I had high expectations before visiting Osaka, which may have jaded my experience. We loved the front entrance, seemed very small and quaint, which opens up into a larger, multi-leveled restaurant. Seating was immediate, we showed up around 8pm on a weeknight.

Ordered the udon soup and assorted sushi and nigiri. The sushi was OK, tasted fresh, but was expensive for what you get. 

The udon was very disappointing unfortunately. It came bare with no garnish or fish cakes. Super salty, which was the only flavor. With the amount of restaurants in philly, I surely won't be back.

I just recently moved to the area and have tried a couple different places, but I enjoyed Sassy Nails. They do a really great job in terms of mani/pedis. I go during the day so its not terribly busy, and they've always gotten to me incredibly quick. I would definitely recommend. I had them wax my eyebrows as well, they did a pretty decent job, waxed/trimmed and shaped them, I still tidied them up some but I'm incredibly picky about my eyebrows, but for $7 I have absolutely no complaints. Overall a great salon, and my go to for nails/eyebrows in the area.

I grew up on Imo's Pizza and have introduced it to many people.  I have lived out of state for 25 years and when I come back to St. Louis once or twice a year, I always take back 3/4 1/2 bakes.  This trip was no different, I ordered 3-1/2 bake deluxe pizza's on line to be delivered to the hotel I was staying at, they were delivered, the "cheese" leaked out all over my rental car seat, by the time I popped them in the oven to finish cooking they were a soggy mess.  Manager Jeff tried to deny I even purchased the pizza's from them even though I have my receipt, ticket #2 of the day.  Jeff's resolution....NOTHING!

Went here with the family on Saturday night. It wasn't packed (our reservation was at 5pm), so we were worried at first, but it was a very nice evening out on their patio area. Service was great and food was good, everyone was happy with their meals. The only thing keeping this from 5 stars is the lack of a more formal dining experience, but they seem to be doing their best during coronavirus. BYOB, so don't plan on ordering a cocktail or glass of wine. Very surprised it wasn't full of customers, as there does not appear to be too many solid Italian restaurants in the area. Give this place a shot.

Lykon has always been my favorite mechanics ever since i moved to the Levittown neighborhood. They are not expensive and also provide timely recommendations every time i visit for an oil change so that i can plan those maintenance according to my time and finances. offer home drop and pick up so that you can relax at home and not worry about your productivity. They have recently renovated their guests lounge with a good ambience and have have even Netflix there so that you can enjoy your favorite shows of you decide to wait.

While the staff behind the counter is friendly, the donuts were AWFUL. I felt like I was eating a donut from 2 days ago which wouldn't surprise me. Also, OVERLY PRICED! $2.50 for a small round blueberry donut? Ridiculous. Furthermore, the 2 times I went in there, they were out of pretty much everything. You have certainly lost my business.

Either change up your business model Strange Donuts, or the 2 stars will keep rolling in.

For the consumers - save your money and go to a quality donut shop. This place isn't worth it.

These people tricked my 15-year-old daughter into spending $15 more than she planned, because she didn't know the nail color she selected was a "gel". I politely asked them to credit the $15, but they refused. Deception is no way to build your customer base. While this location is the closest to our house, we will drive an additional two minutes to give our future business to one of the 20 competitors in this area.

Fancy Nails II, I recommend investing that $15 wisely. This mistake will cost you much more than that.

I have been a member for more than 20 years and I am debating whether or not to leave. I have been without a debit card for more than a month and I can't seem to get any answers from anyone about when I will be receiving my replacement. I love in Phoenix and I can't swing bu a branch on my way home and get a temporary one. So every time that I call I am on hold for at least 10-15 minutes each time and I still can't get anyone to answer my questions. I thought one of the reasons credit unions exist was for more personal one on one attention, I guess not at Tucson Federal. I'm sad to say that do not recommend this as your financial institution.

I went today with my friend at at most nail places they don't have enough space in the nail place to sit near each other but they put us next to each other and the workers came to us. i got acrylics. this isn't my first time getting acrylics i've had them before but this was different. The tool was extremely hot and the lady wasn't the most careful and burnt me a couple times. i woke up the next day and my nails were in pain and my nail bed was extremely red. but it was an okay place and very fancy looking. would maybe try again

I had stayed at this property four or five times on business trips to the area. Since it's for work I just want a good budget hotel.  This had fit the bill, but recently their housekeeping has gone way downhill.

On my recent visit I had to exchange my first room because it smelled like mold. I think the air-conditioning ( it is Florida) leaked into the room and was never addressed.  The second room I was given looked fine, but the toilet was not cleaned.  When you flushed it smelled like a dive bar urinal. 

Too many options in the area.  Don't plan on coming back after being a loyal customer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I couldn't imagine taking my pets anywhere else.  Drs. Zeller, Hill and Lemann have been taking care of my crew for more than 15 years.  Whether it has been just regular annual visits or the more difficult end of life decisions, they have all been fabulous.  We usually see either Dr. Hill or Dr. Emily depending on schedules and availability.  (I like that my pets get to know and feel comfortable with both drs.) If something serious is going on Dr. Zeller ('the old master') always stops in to check up on us.  Even the techs seem to know and love my pets.   I couldn't recommend them more!  :)

My car broke down and my roadside assistance recommended taking my car to this shop as part of my maxcare plan. It was close to closing time and knew the tow truck wouldn't be to me before they closed. I called the shop trying to explain my situation to ask if I could leave the car there and I would come by in the morning when they open. 
The guy on the other end was an asshole to say the least, unprofessional and very poor customer service. He needs to be taught some manners and have the piss slapped out of him. 
Big bet!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
My husband and I stayed in room 520 at this Hotel last night. And to say I was disappointed is an understatement. The only positive I can say is that the Staff at the front desk was very friendly and accommodating. 
The bed was rock hard, it was on wheels that didn't lock properly on hard wood floor so moved constantly. The hallway to get to our non smoking room stank of cigarette smoke and looks as if it hadn't been vacuumed in months. Despite their no pets policy the floor was covered in animal hair. The room itself was mostly clean with the exception of some serious dirt and garbage under the bed and tables. We will not be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The overall environment and staff friendliness is appreciated. The accuracy of fulfilling orders has been frustrating. We have eaten in once and ordered takeout 3 times. All 3 times that we ordered takeout, our order has been wrong. Specifically for our toddler. We are either missing items or our food items are prepped with ingredients we asked to be removed. In the case of our toddlers meal, we have had to find something else for him to eat because theres mo way he could eat the spicy food. Double checking the specific order would go a long way.

Our server was Tim. He was very friendly and timely. The Mama Mi was on special. Which is three pasta dishes. I consider myself a vodka sauce snob. This vodka sauce was top notch. The pasta was cooked perfectly. The chicken Parmesan is moist lol. The lasagna was by far the best I have had. It melts in your mouth. The red sangria has a slight hint of cinnamon, very good. But I think the star of the show was the berry lemon cake. I had no room for dessert but we just couldn't say no to it. It was a great experience.

Edgewild has alot of potential to be an amazing restaurant but unfortunately has some work to do. Service is hit or miss. Our last visit we actually had the best service we have ever had. So there's hope it will continue to improve with each server. Food is hot or miss. It's either over-flavord or no flavor at all. There are some amazing dishes though.  Like any restaurant you just have to find what suits you by trial and error. I highly recommend the goat cheese dip appetizer-so good. We will continue to check in and hope for continued progress.

Beware! Staff acts friendly, but took advantage of my 85-year old father in law. He attempted to leave my daughter money for her college education shortly before death, but was tricked into signing an annuity contract by the local LPL representative. We won't see the money until the contract runs out in 14 years, if at al!. My wife, who used to bank there, recently cashed a large check from an insurance company, and they held the money for 2 weeks for the "check to clear".  Not the 'friendly little credit union' it pretends to be.

Don't not ever stay here! Had the worst experience of my life here! My family and I are here for only one night and decided to stay here because it wasn't too far out from Santa Barbara. The room was dingy and disgusting!! It smelled like cigarettes even though it's a non smoking room. Then to top it off some collage kids decide to stay here and just run a muck!! The front desk did nothing to quiet these people even after I made a complaint. I will be reporting them to the better business bureau and never ever ever staying here again! If I could give less stars I would!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Place is kinda old. I slept well though. Tiny bathroom. I used points so my 3 nights didn't cost anything. The free breakfast was just packaged bagels, muffins, bread, waffles. There was also cereal, yogurt and fruit.  It was free so I can't complain. There is a Starbucks around the corner and an IHOP next door. There are other restaurants walking distance too. Nice Mall across the street too. The pool was nice. Local restaurants are always slipping menus through your door which I didn't enjoy. I don't think they should be allowed to do so. Close to the airport and the shuttle worked out well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I am writing this at 4am because I've been awake for hours in a freezing room that no one can seem to get the heat to work and its 30 degrees outside.
