The engineers have come twice now and all they've managed to do is keep delay me from being able to move to a warmer room. My mother has arthritis and is wrapped in blankets, cold and miserable. Poor engineering, poor service, very small rooms, and an excessively long trek from the street via 2 escalators and an elevator to the room makes this hotel a bad choice. High tech elevators mean nothing if you don't actually get to sleep.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Horrible service. Asked for a Big Mac Medium Meal with a coke, and 2 Quarter Cheese's with fries and frozen coke. Instead I got 2 chicken sandwich and 2 cheese burgers and no fries. Got the drinks but the wrong ones. Instead of 2 cokes, I got 2 dr peppers. Got the frozen coke. AND WHO THE F*** GIVES 3 DRINKS WITH ONE STRAW!!!! CRAZY!! Step the work up or your losing another business member. I've been going here since 2015 and this is the 2nd time it happened. I was like "maybe they were having a bad day". NO THEY WERENT, THEY WERE SLACKING!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Can I give a zero ? Bad customer service is why. Made reservations for 6 for last night. They called back to ask if we were planning on attending due to snowstorm and advised they were making a decision as to whether they were going to stay open. That was hours prior to reservation. We 6 folks never got another call and has to figure out what to do for dinner after multiple calls to confirm status went unanswered. Snow or not, they really dropped the ball. Also, 24 hrs later, no text/call/contact to try to make amends even after leaving voicemail expressing displeasure. 

Been there plenty. No more. Can't stand rude.

Worst Customer Service.  Go with Imos Pizza instead.
Called in for a pizza delivery. "It will be about 90mins". OK I said, it was Friday night after all.  Must be busy.  The guy hangs up on me--must have misheard my OK so I call back.  Right back. Now I'm told it's a 2hour wait. "OK"
Address? He asks.  I give him the hotel and street.  What's the address? IDK, the hotels address.  "Can't deliver without an address" Really? It's the only hotel in area but Ok.  I ask him to hold a second while I look it up.  "Nope, you'll need to call back"
Long story short.  I ordered from Imo's pizza. Knows where the hotel is and will deliver in 30-45 min.

We ordered take out from Pat's last night - the Buffalo Chicken Pizza, a plain cheese pizza, french fries and onion rings. Not sure if it was the buffalo sauce, or the chicken, on their Buffalo Chicken Pizza, but there had to be MSG on the pizza. After feeling dehydrated all evening after eating the food, I remembered why we hadn't ordered take out pizza from Pat's in several months. The taste of the food is okay, but the quality is poor - their crust tastes like a Boboli pizza crust you can get at the Supermarket. We spent $40 on food that was not worth that much, at all. Never ordering from Pat's again.

There is a pandemic going on currently, and this company insists on having someone come right up to your car window without a mask, close enough to feel their breath on you to try to up sell or explain how to buy a car wash. I have two stars because I really do like the convenience of the car wash and it is a good value. Is it worth catching coronavirus because they think I am not intelligent enough to push a selection screen? No. Get with the times people, whether this pandemic is as bad as they say it is or not, why take the risk? If I can drive a vehicle to the car wash, I can push my selection on a screen. End rant.

Minorities be ware!!!! I attempted to try Matteo's, while my daughter was home on a quick visit from college. I was very disappointed! We sat and waited 10 minutes for water and then sat another 10 minutes before leaving, having never saw a waiter. There was only 2 large parties in the establishment with many other empty seats. As we began to leave no one asked if we were okay or what was wrong. We made eye contact with a female server and she just stared and began to assist other customers. It appeared that clearly Minorities like us, were not welcomed

If you were fortunate enough to have a Chinese grandmother who loves to cook -- and hasn't bothered to redecorate her dining room in 20 years -- Yen Ching offers the food and décor you'd expect to find in her home.  Show up anytime, in any clothes, and be ready to devour huge portions of authentic Chinese food that always tastes exactly as good as you remember it.  The dining room fills up even on week-day evenings as the locals continue to support this neighborhood institution, and their carry-out service has been the solution to many sudden horde-of-hungry guests situations.  Great value for the price!

Clean, casual and worth the price -- the portions served our party of three not only more than sufficed for an excellent supper, but also provided lunches for the next day.  Our server was pleasant and attentive.  My eggplant parmigiana was a good combination of crispy and tender veg and breading.  Our salads were fresh (recommend getting the dressing on the side to avoid over doing it), and the entrees were really hot!  Next time, and there will definitely be another visit, we'll all try the chicken soup with mushrooms.  The person who ordered it with bruschetta compared it favorably to the L.S. Ayers Tearoom's chicken velvet.

This is the best Chinese food I've had in West Philadelphia. I'm sure there are plenty good ones towards campus, but Evergreen always delivers to my sketchy area 15-20 minutes faster than their Grubhub estimated time. My boyfriend sticks with the General Tso's chicken but I've had every tofu/bean curd dish and can't pick a favorite. Bean curd with black bean sauce is slightly spicy and salty with a little crunch tofu and ma po bean curd has silky soft tofu, both get ordered probably 4 x a week. Seriously love this place and the drivers are super friendly.

Being diner junkies, we were passing Ruskin Diner and saw the parking lot full.  Being time for lunch, we decided to drop in and were glad we did.  Our server, Cathy or Kathy, was pleasant and funny.  While talking to her, we told her we were from So Calif.  She told us we would not be disappointed and she was right.  The menu is large with a great selection.  The portions were very generous, cooked perfectly and most importantly, very tasty.  (The tomatoes tasted as though they were just picked)

If we ever have the opportunity to pass through this area again, this would definitely be a stop for breakfast, lunch or dinner.

Not sure if he's still there, but they had this guy there who would literally sneer at you while you placed your order. Big guy. If you don't make it to the store, you will probably see  him driving the delivery car about town in an aggressive manner.

One time I went here, and this guy and a few of his buddies must have literally pumped $100 dollars into the scratch off lotto machine, cursing each time they lost.

In general, its a pretty low IQ kind of place, but two stars for that sweet sauce and cheddar which is pretty good on Mondays for 6 bucks.

Hotel is just not at Hyatt standards. Maids can't clean servers don't give a crap about their guests. Dishes were dirty, not spotted... DIRTY!! Food was both cold and over salted. (Sushi was good, but that's meant to be cold and most people don't salt sushi). Coffee was cold.... COFFEE. And when asked for a new cup because it was cold.... We got.... Cold coffee!!! The cleaning service couldn't even make a bed. The shower head sucked. I give it 2 stars cuz the front desk staff were awesome and the concierge was even more awesome.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Couldn't be happier with my experience. 
After a fall and breaking of my frames and scuffing the lenses I was worried that it would take an extended period to get an exam and new glasses but was able to get an appointment the very next day and my new glasses were in in one week.
Sure they were moderately pricey, but quality eyewear with specialty lenses always will be and considering my situation I was satisfied on that front; I've paid more and had poorer service with other places.
Professional, friendly and fast. 
I'll recommend to any and all!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: We live nearby and love Osaka for a quick and close dinner option. They've been closed for a while because of the pandemic, but we've still been calling every week or so because it's one of our favorite places and we wanted to support them. Tonight, they finally answered the phone! As of right now the kitchen was closed (it was the first night they were open again), but sushi was available. So, while I couldn't get the tasty chicken fried rice I was craving this evening, I was able to get a great dynamic roll and spicy shrimp roll. We're going to try for the fried rice again this weekend.

Very poor experience. We had 5 queen size rooms booked for our team coming into town. When we went to check in today, we were told the manager gave away our rooms so that he could fit a college rowing team (35 rooms) who booked last week. They tried to get us to stay in rooms that had 1 King but obviously that can not work. We are now staying at the Hilton down the road. Any hotel that would do that obviously does a lot more shady and untrustworthy things. We are now staying at the Hilton down the road, which is a much better spot for the same price. I would book here with caution!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Fresh fish and no ocean in sight--how wonderful! My choice of their nearly-unlimited sushi offer was most satisfying, tho I came perilously close to premature fullness from not knowing how generous their appetizer portions are! 
Yummy gyoza and bbq squid after warming miso soup, a fine start to a memorable meal. A creative selection of rolls is a good choice for a fine finish.
Hard to go wrong here, it is all fresh and delicious. Cortaro only misses the coveted and rare fifth star because my companion said the tempura batter was too thick for her to fully appreciate the contents.
Recommended.

Terrible delivery driver and equally terrible customer service. Ordered on Grub Hub and specifically stated where in the hospital to deliver food. Delivery driver calls and says he's there and I go down to meet him and end up waiting 10 minutes. Call him back and he's yelling and cursing on the phone. Finally find him and he literally throws the bag of food at me, spilling the bag. Call the restaurant to get a refund for food I am not able to eat and they deny it happened. Grub Hub only gives a partial credit for future orders. Will never order from here again- and will be disputing the charge with my credit card company

DO NOT STAY HERE!!! Got our room late and all I wanted was a good night sleep. Got to the room and it smelt like a musty basement. It was so bad that in the middle of the night my fiancé thought he was going to get sick so we had to switch rooms. They gave us a new room, which did not smell as bad as the other. However, the next night another guest came walking in on us in the middle of the night because the front desk never recorded that they switched our room. I thought it was someone coming in to kill us! Wouldn't have been surprised because this hotel is in the middle of nowhere. Save yourself and do not stay at this hotel!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I am a Sushi fan, I have talked of the best Sushi I have ever was in La Jolla California, I will have to say my visit to Wasabi Sushi has surpassed the Le Jolla meal. Although the service was a bit slow and unorganized the payoff was the food. I had the most tasty Sushi I have ever had the pleasure to consume, I could taste the quality in every bite, please don't take the service as indicative of your experience, the wait is well worth it. As with any new location there are hic ups which will be corrected as staff become familiar. I definitely recommend Wasabi Sushi.

Soniat House is a charming & elegant boutique hotel.  The entire staff (Linda, Scott, Jessie, Irving & Calvin) are exceptionally helpful & friendly.  While there for 8-days my husband became ill on our final day. Early in the morning the hotel staff found an open drug store & went there to get him some medicine. Claire, the hotel cat, is entertaining & amusing. Being located on the outer edge of the French Quarter, Soniat House is convenient and within easy walking distance to many historical sites & great restaurants, as well as quiet & peaceful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We went to Mica on Saturday night for our 5 time in the last year. The food continues to not disappoint. We had the tasting menu with 6 incredible courses. We had a course of onions and bone marrow which almost looked like a quiche when it was served. I would not normally order something like this off a menu, however it was one of the best dishes I have ever tasted. The chef stopped by our table once or twice during the meal and he accommodated all allergies and food preferences. The wait staff was friendly and attentive. I plan on highly recommending this place to all of my family and friends.

Tim T

The reason why I gave them an one star is not because of the food, but it was in concern with the service of the waiter.  My waiter (an older man in his 50's) was suppose to box my unfinished main plate to go, but he never brought it back.  I hope he didn't mistakenly gave it to someone else in the restaurant instead.  Just an head up for the management!  Need to retrain your waiters with proper protocols.  

And to anyone else, next time ask the waiter to bring back a box so you can avoid eating someone else's saliva.

I don't know why the other reviews say it is rowdy.  I have been there many times and it is laid back, people are having fun.  Everyone knows each other so it is safe.  The beer is less expensive than everywhere else, there are live bands.  I recommend you go down and have a good time with good people!  I prefer there over 20th hole.  There is never much going on there, not many people, unless there is an event.  Skinny's is full of the younger crowd, not my thing!  Also, The cops wait outside skinny's to give out DUI's.  Shack is the safest, and enjoyable!

Nicholas L.

I'm HHonors Diamond but this is one of those places where it does not matter.  Location is great but twice I have shown up at the normal check-in time and they had no rooms ready.   Rooms are small but adequate.   Breakfast is very confusing.  Sometimes they say its free and sometimes they tell you it's full price despite the coupons they give you at check in.  Do NOT valet park, they are very under staffed and the lot is off site.   There are paid lots and garages close by.  Usually competitively priced and worth it if you set your expectations appropriately.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Hubs and I headed here tonight after reading some amazing reviews of this place.  Definitely a pleasantly unexpected decor and look of this place interiorly considering it is in a strip mall.  We were sat right away, but were immediately turned off by not just one obviously filthy water glass BUT TWO!  Come on!  Do you really expect us to look a blind eye at this?  We were wanting to order sushi...aka RAW FISH!!  Sorry above all else, cleanliness is key with an establishment serving sushi.  Didnt even THINK of staying for the food.  Sayonara folks!

My folks and I waited for one hour to be check in into our room. So we went out for an hour and came back and said wait for another hour. So while we wait my mom saw other guests starting to check in before us. We asked again but without being easy. We waited for another hour and still other guests were being checked in before us. But the one lady always said no, later. When she left then we asked a man and he let us check in. The hotel was fine but I guess what I'm saying is the staff could improve their attitude, please.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The area is nice, The service and staff were horrible. I had to open my own car door, carry all of my own bags and open my own door while the Bell hoppers sat there watching me. Worse part is the hotel managers were watching them. I wanted to leave after the front desk person was dry as sand with no welcoming attitude. I felt like i was not wanted here.  plus the Ridiculous parking fees, Nice furniture in an old building with cheap  parts, like paint over rust.  Taking photos to prove my point.  I would pay $10 more and go to the Hilton across the street.  This place isnt worth it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I went out with a friend looking for cheap Chinese food. Wong's Inn seemed like the place. But even the low price doesn't warrant what I received in my Kung Pao Chicken. 
It was barely spicy (or had any taste besides the celery and other aromatics) and my plate seemed untouched after I picked through it to find the chicken I had ordered. The fried rice was bad, but rangoons were okay. 
My friend got the Wong's Sandwich special which he thoroughly enjoyed. They also sell glass Cokes which is a positive. Not enough of a perk to go back anytime soon.

Sake Cafe has been my go to sushi place for years. We order take out and would also eat there a couple of times a month but obviously something is going on because the quality and service have gone done drastically.  My past two take out orders were wrong, first order charged for and given items I did not order. Tonight ordered two of one item and when I got to the restaurant to pick up I realized my order was wrong. I mentioned it to the hostess and she said that I was wrong she repeated the order to me in a very rude tone. After years of patronage they have lost a very loyal customer.

Tonight might have been the worst customer service I've experienced. Kids running the show and complaining about having to scoop ice cream at 9pm. Hello, that's literally your job. Another customer had to ask the other employee to start scooping ice cream as the one complained, out loud, about how many scoops a customer presented him. To top it off, both of my waffle cones broke in route to my home because they were so undercooked, which is maybe 2 min away. I'd say go to Sonic down the street, but it is almost just as bad. Go to Publix, get a quart, and call it a night.

The food is overpriced given that the portions are very small. When we got our food it was cold and stale (we were never told we had to get our own food because the server does not take it to you and they never even called out an order number or name so we knew to pick them up). The asada meat had absolutely no flavor and was difficult to chew, meaning it was not fresh, and the al pastor was extremely red and much sweeter than it should be. If you're looking for an authentic Mexican restaurant in the sparks area I recommend El Taconazo, the food is amazing, and the portions are more reasonable for the price.

Please do not stay here. 

We got to our room and immediately left and got another room at a different hotel - I've never had to do this before. 

The only good reviews on here are suspicious, as if written by the employees themselves. When we got to our room there were people who clearly had been living out of their rooms for some time. The fron desk tried to get us to double pay for the room - be aware of this, they have down this to others as well. The room it self was awful, stains on the sheets and one bed was broken. 

If you stay here please be safe. To be honest I would feel better sleeping in my car in a better part of town.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I would bring a visitor here for a Linny Burger.. SO HUGE it's funny to watch a friends reaction!
However, I've  been coming here for years and have to say that most mornings the grill cook is more interested in what makes things easy for HIM. This morning my eggs LITERALLY had a sizable pool of oil right on top of them! This is a constant issue at Linnys and despite my bringing it to their attention multiple times, the staff REALLY DOESN'T seem to care. SOMEBODY TELL LINNY HE IS NOT PRESENT OFTEN ENOUGH ANYMORE AND HIS COOK IS RUINING HIS REPUTATION!!

Last night we hosted an 80th Birthday party for my motherin law and it turned out wonderful. This resturaunt has a separate room that accommodated our 29 guests perfectly. The owner, Patty was wonderful to work with. Their staff had everything set up the way we had discussed earlier in the week. They were so accommodating. The wait staff was friendly and quick. Our guests all had positive remarks about their experience.  The food was good and offered something for everyone at reasonable prices. They allowed us to bring in decorations and our own cake. I would definitly recommend for your next gathering.

Stay away!!!  Prepaid room not held and re-rented. Desk person blamed us??!!  Property is very rundown, unkempt. Trash and many cigarette butts litter the 'lawn'.  Workers do not speak English well or not at all. Cleanliness of room not good. Layer of lint and dirt surrounds edges of whole room. Bedspread and blanket smell as does whole room. Sketchy area, seems many folks live at hotel. Breakfast limited, and dingy, dirty hall area walk-thru to get to breakfast area. Would give zero stars if possible. Desk staff very customer unfriendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I sat on the roof top and the atmosphere is just lovely. The service was exceptional. I got the twigs and bark entrée for brunch. It is the only vegan, gluten free option on the menu. It was okay but the portion was extremely small considering I make something similar (and tastier) at home for less than $5. I also ordered the leek smashed potatoes. Leeks and potatoes are 2 of my favorite things but this side dish lacked flavor, i couldn't taste the leeks at all. The non vegan dishes look excellent from what I can see. Everything is beautifully presented.

We were intrigued by the great reviews and Zagat award, so we chose to dine here a couple weeks ago.  It's a nice, hipster-feeling place. Fairly small.  Friendly and helpful staff. 

However, we don't be dining here again.  The food was not at all what we expected.  Even with a clean eating farm to table concept, the food should still taste good.  Ours didn't. And that was across multiple different small plates and main dishes. 

This may be the place for some, but you really need to know what you're getting into.  Otherwise, you will be very disappointed like we were.

I've been here several times but this time the guy began cutting my hair without asking me how I wanted it. I assumed he had remembered from last time, and before I know it he starts shaving the side of my head completely. I stopped him and told him he's mistaking me for someone else, but at that point the damage was done. 

No apology was issued from his end. He ruined my hair for the holiday break. The worst part is when I was paying, the cashier had the audacity to ask why I wasn't tipping (I always tip well, but there wasn't much to tip for this time). 

Not coming back.

Please do not go here!  This place is beyond terrible.  My haircut was absolutely terrible it is uneven and the sides don't match.  I tried to tell the barber but he was super rude and didn't care about what I want.  At the end he just told me I'm done, he wouldn't even listen to me when I tried to have him fix it.  Even worse my wife was with me and she tried to help by telling him how to fix it.  The barber said to me never bring that women here again leave her at home.  I was so upset that was one of the rudest experiences I have ever had.  On top of that the shop is very dirty.  Do not give this business patronage!

Terrible service and utter chaos behind the counter.  Ordered 2 sandwiches.  After having asked several times for an update, got lots of assurances that they would be 'ready in just a few minutes'.  After waiting for an hour and 10 minutes, finally gave up and went to the country to demand a refund so we could go to Chinese take-out next door and salvage our evening.  Instead, counter help went to holding area and...voila...appeared with 2 sandwiches that had been waiting there for who knows how long.  We were happy to see this restaurant come to the neighborhood, but after today, we'll never set foot in it again.

Awful! I got a pedicure and a shellac manicure. They don't even massage your legs and feet during the pedicure. The lady coughed all over my leg and arm during the pedi and mani--spit landed on my leg and arm! Disgusting! On top of it, my gel nails are thicker than I've ever had! The lady put my hand in some bags with lotion and it got into my wedding ring! I would have loved if she even said more than 3 words to me or given me a heads up! First time and Last! Terrible ambiance, terrible service and Terrible workmanship.

Service isn't always friendly; they definitely are trying to get people in and out as fast as possible and don't necessarily care that there's a person attached to the end of the hands. BUT...I never had a problem with the quality of the work! Gel nails stayed put for three weeks, in fact the only reason I took them off was because my always short and stubby nails had actually grown out too long, strengthened by the gel. So if you're willing to put up with the lack of smiles, they seem to do exactly what they should, and if your experience is like mine, you'll get your money's worth.

Just awful. I ended up paying almost $160 to rent a car for one day when the advertised rate was $70 (including the car rental and insurance for a day), even though the lady at the counter when I picked up the car assured me the total amount I was going to pay was ~$70. They have tons of hidden fees and surcharges that they never tell you about. Of course, these charges are hidden in the fine print somewhere, so Budget is legally covered. These disingenuous and misleading business practices do not win over customers. I will certainly not use them again and recommend to everybody I know to stay away.

This used to be my go-to salon for pedicures.  They do the absolute best at whittling all the dead skin off my feet, and the polish always looks beautiful.  Sadly, the last three times I've been here, my pedis haven't lasted.  They started to chip after only a week.  I even brought in my own polish, but had the same result -- they must have gone to lower quality products.  It looks like they're really focused on their gel business, and may be leaving traditional polishes behind.  I see fewer and fewer OPI bottles to choose from.  I hope the quality goes back up; I'd really like to return.

I took my vehicle for an oil change , safety check , wheel rotation and then a wheel alignment, I was given an estimate of $185.00 for everything, there was a manager special for everything I was having done ? They didn't mention the special until I asked ! $110 plus $$20 more for upgrades oil $131 total . Then I was told I had a nail n tire which could not be fixed ? A replacement tire from Firestone replacing a Goodyear tire would be $245 , I then took it to Discount tire where the tires were bought and they repaired the tire for free ! WTF
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I'm beyond pissed. First of all I ordered a cheesesteak deluxe meal. How in the foolishness do you smush my steak into a container on top of my fries? My entire steak fell apart and liquids were on my fries. I don't like anything to touch my fries. I specifically asked for hots and sweet peppers to be chopped into the steak. This didn't happen. They slapped a whole jar of peppers on top of the steak unchopped. The fries were soggy because all the liquid from the steak was oozing on to them. I will never order from these folks ever again. Trash trash trash trash.... they don't even deserve one star.

I accidentally booked a smoking room and didn't realize it until I got to the hotel.  The hotel refused to switch me without forfeiting all discounts I got from expedia and pay an extra $20 for a room that costs an extra $4 on their own website.  

The room smells like stale smoke, and the nonsmoking room I was shown also smelled terrible so I had a tough time justifying paying twenty dollars for a room that also smells bad.  Towels are worn out, comforter is dirty and old looking.   Never staying at this brand of hotels again and I was disappointed they tried taking advantage of the situation to get more money.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Was excited to eat here because of the reviews I read but we had a different experience, unfortunately. Not only was the food not great, I saw the guy working in the kitchen eating and licking his fingers with his gloves on then handling food!  girl who took our order wasn't very friendly and no one knew what the heck was going on with the orders. There were two ladies cleaning the dining area who were very nice as we were leaving and that was probably the only positivity I felt the entire time I was there and the only reason I gave them 1 Star.

I cannot express how grateful I am to the Kinecta staff, especially Tammy S., for everything they did to help my business get our PPP loan. We had never banked with them before, but our account was set up and application approved before our normal bank told us anything about the application we submitted to them. Their staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and efficient. I had multiple people checking in on us to make sure all our questions were answered and our application processed as quickly as possible. If you are in need of one on one, quality help with any banking needs, they are the ones to go see!

Honestly, Pizza my heart has been my go to social atmosphere the past 4 years of my life in isla vista. I love the pizza, I love the beer, and I love the vibes. The moment that strikes my enjoyment of this place and ends it is whenever I go in and am "greeted" by a girl whos name is Ashley or Ashlynn. This girl is straight up rude to customers and every time I come in im surprised that she still has her job. I have no idea how her coworkers put up with her attitude, but it definitely brings the whole vibe of the store down. I hope that management does something about this as it has hindered my pmh experience and multiple peoples around me.

I found everything about our stay to be just what I was looking for. 
What it is NOT, is a giant, crowded, property full of families looking to splash in a pool all day. It's a boutique size (only 3 floors - yay!) with a wonderful blend of old (architecture) and a fresh, trendy design. There are creative & unique details everywhere. The spaces have a chill sensibility that resonated with me. The rooftop bar is a great space for outdoor experience - that I think we are ALL in search of during COVID - and that overlooks the bay. 
The staff is wonderful, the Walkscore is A+ & the cheeseburgers are DELICIOUS!!! Exceeded my expectations.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I never write reviews but Im just so uncomfortable with the attitude of all of the concierge staff. They will never answer a "good morning" they will just ignore you. They will hand your packages with the worst attitude and  laziness you can ever imagine. They have never a kind word nor a kind face to welcome you or your gets. 
It is just so sad that such a great building gives the worst attention to their residents. The apartments are spacious but the staff kills the whole experience. I don't know if it is because Im not American but It is just horrible.

This place really needs to learn about customer service... I have eaten here multiple times and always have the same issues.  we get seated and always have to track down our server for drinks, when its time to order and again when we are done and need our check.  The food has always been great quality but they seem to get the portions wrong when you are ordering alacarte.  If they get their servers on track to pay attention to their customers rather than disappearing into the server station all together at the same time we may go back again but we have tried it 6 times and always a horrible experience.

Seems like an overrated place.
1. Being a person of asian origin, we felt been given seats after others coming much later than us were seated.
2. Saturday evening is definitely not the same as other times we have come here. 
3. We were seated in a corner, along with other asian party...hmm coincidence?
I do not think so. 
4. I had to ask to clean the table. Poor guy spilled chopped tomatoes in my lap while cleaning with wet towel.
I could not wait to write the review, as I have already lowered my expectation, and decided it to be my last visit.

Just let me say i won't be spending anymore of my time or money @ Ralph's Muffler Shop. After half completing a strut job on my 2006 Sonata i continued to hear the same noises after spending 6 hrs. @ this Keystone location to get the issue fixed originally. I took the vehicle to Pep Boys for a second opinion, much to my amazement only one of the strut mounts were replaced. @ this point I took off work to return the Ralph's @7:45am...It's now 3:45pm I'm sitting here waiting hopelessly, pissed to say the least! #1LostCustomer

Extremely disappointed in this place. I heard it was really good. I'm visiting from Seattle. I only have one cheat day a week which is Sunday and I decided to get a pizza from this place. Over 20 bucks for a small personal pizza and a salad. The only thing good about this whole meal was the crust. I specifically asked for no tomatoes on my salad. It was covered with tomatoes. I couldn't even clear them all out. I just threw it away. The pizza was small. The sauce is very chunky. I hate tomato chunks. Be aware, the salad is covered with mushrooms too. Just totally gross. What a waste of a cheat day.

This place is a dump.  Stayed for one night and was extremely disappointed.  Room was not clean.  The phone in the room was covered in dirt, looked like it hadn't been cleaned since 1990.  Windows were filthy, could barely see out of them.  The wallpaper in the bathroom was peeling very badly.  A 20 by 10 inch tile in the bathroom floor was loose.  Needed an extra set of towels, called the front desk and they never came.  Tried to call the front desk multiple times and there was no answer.  They put a $75 charge on my credit card for incidentals, five days later they still have not reversed the charge.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I would've had a more pleasant night if I had just slept in the car.  Never again will I stay at a roadway no matter what state it is located this is the third and final time that I'm staying in these flop houses.  The room stink of cigarette smoke even though it's supposed to be a non-smoking room there was no Kleenex half a roll of toilet paper and a dirty shower.  The only thing good about this place was a nice Indian lady that checked me in but her replacement, was rude and contemptuous.  I give it one star because if you're a pothead all the rules on one side seem to have chairs out there with folks smoking ; enjoy
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Picked up a car at Enterprise in Leesburg, Va. to drive to Doylestown, Pa., and when we turned it in we were told there was major damage under the car.  We are not mechanics so we did not inspect the car underneath.  But, if you want to rip customers off just say there is damage underneath the car where they can not see for themselves.  Enterprise is a thieving organization.  Make sure you get under the car and inspect everything, because that is how they make their money.  Take pictures of everything. If they continue their farce, just file a complaint against them with the Attorney General.

This is likely the most poorly managed restaurant in the state of florida. I ordered ahead only to show up and stand there for 30+ minutes while the incompetent workforce dodged me because they knew that they had not made my order yet. I couldn't leave because I made the foolish mistake to prepay online.  The only thing worse than the food is the degenerate staff this place has running the show.  This "restaurant" is a disrespect to Mexican culture and should be shut down. I will never be caught here again as long as I live and I would recommend you do the same.

This gym is hands down one of the best I have ever had the privilege of working out in. The gym itself is extremely clean and the equipment is extremely well cared for. Kenny, who is a member of the staff at this Anytime, is an amazing guy. In all of my years going to various gyms I have NEVER seen someone actually taking care of the equipment and the overall  health of the gym the way he does. He knows most members by name and makes them feel welcome in the gym every single time they are there. Just an overall amazing experience.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I would love to give this 4 stars but we had Roaches in the bathroom and the Staff was not the friendliest. Also Bring your own beach towels as they offer no towels to take out to the beach. 
Now the good news. Our beachfront room was just that. Gorgeous view of sand, ocean, and sunsets. Room had just been redone with cute color scheme and carpet. (That's why I was surprised to see the roaches). Close to tons of restaurants. One of the few properties that had cabana rentals right on the beach. If you don't mind the bugs... Go for it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Yay!  The Starbucks at 30th and West End is open again!  

The staff is still in training, but my patience was rewarded with a hot, delicious mocha given to me by a smiling barista to warm me on a cold and dreary evening.   

The interior is contemporary and utilitarian with clean, uncluttered lines and an open, upscale feel.  I am not sure how I like the wide backless bench running along the western wall instead of chairs.  

Outside on the patio, is a conference table which will be great for groups.  The fireplace is no more.

My friend and I are visiting on this side of town and decided to try the closest frozen yogurt joint, this place. We walked in and no one was there until this person came out from the back. She stood at the register staring at us the entire time and wasn't very friendly overall. 
The froyo was subpar. As we left I noticed it quickly melted into a watery substance that wasn't very appetizing. The toppings tasted stale as well. My friend and I got Salted Caramel and my boyfriend got chocolate.
Not sure if I'd come back here again or just drive a bit further to go to Yogurtland or something.

Overall, hotel was fine and would've recommended except...my credit card got compromised by the hotel staff.  I know this because the credit card used was ONLY used for my hotel check in and never used again while in the city.  When I returned home I found that card had been used first at the hotel for additional charges (not a deposit) and then for some online shopping.  I called the hotel and spoke to the manager on duty and he didn't seem surprised.  He also promised a call back, which never happened.  I was hoping for a call / apology from corporate with perhaps a few points to my loyalty card for my trouble but nada, zilch.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love Marble Slab Creamery, but it seems as though the quality has decreased. I ordered a cheesecake milkshake during my last three visits, and was basically given sweetened milk. The first time, I let it go. The second time, I asked for a thicker milkshake and was told "we'll see." The third time, I was given a milkshake that was not only the consistency of milk, but was spilling out of the top of the cup because it was so watered down. The milkshake was definitely not worth the $6.57 I paid. If I didn't have to return to work, I would have requested another milkshake. Marble Slab has definitely lost my business.

Good location for sports fans.  Remodeled and beautifully done, BUT... A/C fan was very loud and cycled on and off every couple of minutes.  How loud?  When the fan was off I had the TV volume on setting of 18, and when fan came on I had to increase it to 32 in order to understand conversations on the TV.  Add to that the cost of in-room internet, and the hotel is not nearly as attractive.  How expensive?  $9.95 per day for basic service and $14.95/day for premium Internet.  They offer free basic internet in public areas, but I clocked it at only 0.88 Mb/sec.  Pretty pathetic.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I recently scheduled an ePay, and missed a confirm call from the bank. I tried online chat and was told I have to call.  Then it took me 3 calls, more than 30 minutes, including been disconnected, connected to the wrong department, to finally reach the right person, and confirm the transaction.  
Ten minutes after I completed the call, I received another phone call from the bank, asking to confirm the transaction.
I appreciate their concern about customer security, but nowadays, using a faster server and a smarter phone system, insteading of building new branches, they can save the customer a lot of time and improve the service.

Great Coffee. A very unique vibe when compared to the trend of the rising insta-worthy coffee shops. Sticking true to a type of Mississippi River - New Orleans - gothic vibe, but doing it really well. The owner has indefinitely confined himself to having an amazing beard by integrating it with the shop's marketing. His beard lives up to the legend. Dope. Amazing espresso. I believe they've received national recognition for their espresso. Regular V60 coffee is really great as well. If you're in St. Louis, you've gotta stop in and experience Sump.

If possible I would give the Hertz at the New Orleans airport a negative rating.  Booked our reservation on kayak and when we arrived the location was closed the lady working at the airport location was zero help.  She just said I can not help you have to call kayak.  When we called kayak they put us through to Hertz who informed us it would cost $350 to change our reservation to the airport location.  After the horrible service we received from the lady working at the airport location I decided to cancel my reservation and book with enterprise who I have to say was very nice and and accommodating.  Lesson learned never book with HERTZ!

Stopped in and picked up 2 pies after spending the day with my niece at Sims Park. My niece loved that she could write on the wall!! The gentleman that rang me up and made the pizza was extremely friendly and made small talk while I waited. He asked if this was my first time and when I said yes he told me all about the pizza and fresh made daily ingredients. The pizza was good and the crust was perfect!! I would recommend it and will go back!! They were out of the Sicilian dough so I will hopefully get to try that on my next visit.

The current management is rude, impatient, unprofessional and mean.

I have going to Cafe Roma since it was on Sophie Sophie Wright in the late 80's. I have never been spoken too the way I have been by a gentleman who claims to be the Manager since Hurricane Ida. 

To that person who  has been so rude, you should not be in the restuarant business and I hope can a job where you don't have to deal with people. You are not customer Service oriented and the next time I call and you answer, I will do business with someone else.

I wonder if the owner knows how much business they turn away based on what the employees feel like doing? 

Don't waste your time ordering for delivery. The driver's cherry pick. Despite delivering to my home several times in the past, 4 out of 5 times the same thing happens: Girl answering says "hang on" and returns with a "oh our delivery driver went home". Yet you can call later from another address for delivery? No problem! It's the same every time.

I suppose I shouldn't feel singled out - in talking to others, this is normal protocol for this location.

( I wrote this months ago but it just posted. As of May 1st, 2012 I saw Marcellas's was CLOSED and For Sale. I nearly cried.)

This is my favorite restaurant in New Hope. I have never had a bad experience. I do admit that the wait is long, but that's actually why I prefer it. I host my birthday party here every year because it means my friends and I can sit back for a wonderful three hour meal (we drag it on that long, it's not THAT slow) in a beautiful, unique restaurant. If you know the wait is long -- and you go and have a long wait -- don't leave a review based on that. You knew.

Food here is still good - but some concerns.

They have raised prices quite a bit over the past couple of years, and made other changes which detract from the experience. For instance, they used to serve nice bread with olive oil and spices as a sort of appetizer. Gone.
In the past, pasta was served on the side. Now it is on the same plate as the entree. Not a good idea. Portion sizes also smaller than before.
Wait staff is still friendly and efficient, but one gets the impression that Antonio is trying to save pennies wherever he can.

Thoroughly disappointing.  I was pleased with a very courteous check-in and newly rehabbed lobby - very promising.  I then entered the elevator and wasn't sure if I was still in the same hotel.  This feeling continued into my room:  popcorn ceiling, faded yellow wallpaper, dirty windows, stained drapes, old mismatched furniture.  I ordered a burger from room service.  I asked for a Yukon Angus burger (Supposed to come with bacon, fried onions) - medium rare.  What I got had no bacon, no onions - and was cooked well done.  Gross.  This hotel needs to study total quality management.  I will not be returning. Ever.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This gym has everything that you need! It is generally not too crowded, and all the members have been very friendly. It is very clean, and the staff is always very helpful. I have never worked with any of the trainers that are there, but they seem to be very knowledgable and care deeply about helping their clients. 

The free wifi is also a huge plus, as it allows me to stream music and track my workouts (something that many other gyms don't have). If you are looking for a well priced uptown gym, Anytime Fitness is for you! Also, the free 7 day is perfect for testing it out before committing to a membership plan.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I just took my car in this past weekend for 4 new brakes and 2 new rotos. Yesterday my car broke down in an intersection. at first glance I thought it was a flat tire. The next morning, after taking the car to a shop closer to my house to replace the tire, I was told that whomever replaced my brakes and rotors did not tighten them..which in turn caused the caliper to dig into my wheel and destroy my caliper and wheel. So, the work that cost me almost $600 is not costing me an additional $400 from another shop to fix their mistake.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Came on a Saturday around noon and they didn't have any openings but a guy did schedule us an appointment for 2:30 that same afternoon. We walked around downtown came back and then the same guy that booked us the appointment asked if we had an appointment we said yes he went on to say that the appointment didn't save and asked if we could come back at 4:30. It was really annoying that they didn't accommodate even though it was their mistake. Won't be coming back here. Make sure your appointments gets booked!

Zerillo's used to be one of my favoriteI talian restaurants in the Tampa area.  However, recently it has declined in both customer service and portion size.  On our most recent visits the waiter was obnoxious and condescending. My wife and I shared a meal and was charged a $3 share fee on the bill ( the waiter never mentioned this when we ordered)..  Plus, the lasagna we purchased was small in portion.  

I'm not sure if the ownership of this restaurant has changed but the everything elsa sure has. I would think long and hard before I would recommend this establishment to anyone.

Only giving a one star because you can't give 0... Do not order from here unless you get the dry ribs... Greasy nasty food... Even the war wonton soup was greasy and bland.. 3 wontons and 1 Broccoli in each soup and it's sent with  4 containers When you order two orders of it... And it's not supposed to look like milk was splashed in it so you can't see through it.. When asked they refused to do anything about it said she would give me only 5$ off next order when we spent 50$ already and didn't eat a bit of it...

Aloft checked me in at 3pm, had me swipe my card before telling me that my room wasn't ready and I should wait a few minutes. An hour and ten minutes later after I went back to desk the ask whats the holdup I was told the room I booked was not available. Instead at the same price they would give me a smaller bed.
One star for making me swipe before telling me I couldn't get what I paid for. Dishonest!
One star for making me wait without an apology or a gesture. This is not hospitality! 
This hotel allows dogs but I wouldn't even bring my dog here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We Gave this restaurant another shot after over a year since our last bad experience. Unfortunately it wasn't any better. The servers were really nice and attentive but the wait for the food was just way to long. Almost 40 minutes. And the food itself was just ok. We ordered chicken strips for the kids and they brought chicken Nuggets? Not a huge deal but for $8 each I would expect the right thing. The meat in my enchiladas was really good but the sauce on top reminded me vaguely of ketchup and it wasn't good. Giving the 3 stars for the waitress but we will not return.

The hotel is in a convenient location. We came for the 2020 ATA trade show and the Convention center was connected to the hotel. We did run into a few issues that made me rate it at a 3. The hotel has about 5 elevators and they worked when they decided to. We got stuck on our floor for 5 minutes waiting for an elevator as we heard them wiz by er ended up taking the stairs(this actually happened twice). We had an issue with not having hot water in our sink also. The room was a good size but I was disappointed with the hotel. Maybe with it being in a busy city it doesn't quite fit more then a 3 star rating for me!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Maybe for Reno this is considered good.
Food was very bland and very small in quantities.  We eat at a place in Sacramento called Wasabi a lot and their food is outstanding.  Their Lion King is actually baked with a sauce that is just incredible and has big pieces of tuna on it and the roll is so big two people can barely eat it. This Lion King was bland, no sauce, and the tuna on top was barely there and looked liked it was shredded or something. We actually ordered 2 rolls and they were quite small in size, tasteless and you needed a magnifying glass to find the sushi.  Overall, a huge disappointment and we'll never be back.

The main issues we found were just no fan in the bathroom, a loose toilet seat, and some rusty spots in the bathroom. The bed was a little too firm for our liking, but we've slept in worse. Breakfast was great! Warm cheesy egg omelets and sausage along with the normal continental, definitely worth the money spent though! Staff was friendly and smiling too. We also brought our dog with us and they have a small dog area for them to be walked and go potty. There are restaurants within walking distance and a gas station just up the street. Overall a great stay!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is real Italian food. A ton of Italian restaurants throughout the central/southern part of Florida and this is one if not the best place to eat good food. Not because it's Italian food, but good food with good ingredients. Aside from the attention and the service which is great. I don't know about you but if the food isn't there I don't go back, the service can be great but if the food is subpar you won't go back. If the service is subpar and the food is excellent you will return and put up with the service. With this place you won't have to worry about subpar anything, it is a great all-around restaurant.

Mike has cut my hair for over ten years, and I couldn't be happier with the shop's cleanliness, professionalism, location, and friendly atmosphere!

Whether you want to hear the latest small-town news, need advice re: local happenings or venues, or just want to relax without conversation, Librizzi's is the place to be.  Lots of magazines to read if you have a short wait, and the walls are filled with vintage toy relics that can bring back a lot of memories.

Hint: If you want to get your hair cut on Saturday morning, either get there "first thing" or come after 10:30 or so to avoid the inevitable rush.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

I honestly had the worst experience ever, one the nurses there was really disrespectful and rude and kept yelling at us to sign some papers when she didn't explain what was going on with our sick pup, I believe her name was Abby?! 
My mom speaks poor English and I had to translate to her and when we would ask her questions she kept talking over me and shouting to sign papers, we ended up leaving this place after $200 payed for nothing and fixed nothing all to just get yelled at and being treated like we didn't care about our dog. 
I'm never coming back, to say the least.

I come by this store a few times a week. Lately, it is a waste of my time. The young employees working the morning shift seem to not care about what they doing, and focus on something else, but want to play around and socialize and flirt with other employees in front of the customers. In one order, several mistakes were made, simple mistakes that are not made as carelessly as they were, which usually never happens with different regular employees there. I do not want to go to this store. It used to be great. The quality of service is null. Sad.

I really did not feel that they cared about my cat. They saw him, could not really diagnose him, but prescribed some medication. It did not help him. I took him back to his old vet and they diagnosed him with cancer. They were ready to help in any way they could but he was too far gone by then. My boy hung on for a while longer, comforted by love and pain management, and then I had to put him to sleep. To this day, no one from Creature Comforts has ever tried to check on him. They sent a postcard reminding me to get his shots. Sad. It is a longer ride now but I will take my other kitties back to their old vet.

Got turned away their opening week very rudely, as I had no reservations and wanted to have a quick beer at the then-empty bar. I understand their policy of only seating diners at their bar (I think it's silly, but no big deal) but still - you can't at least politely let me know? You can't let em know I'm welcome to give you my money but you have your first reservations coming in in about forty minutes so I need to be quick? In contrast, Clementine's right next door welcomes neighborhood regulars. I was wearing a t-shirt and jeans. Maybe they thought I wasn't a big tipper? Oh well.

Food was ok... We met friends there for dinner last Saturday night.  We showed up around 7:30 and found a seat right away.  The waitress was extremely friendly and knew the menu very well.
What bothered us was by 9:30 the place had emptied out and they were cleaning the floors with ammonia while we were still there!  Their website states they are open until 11 pm on Saturday! At one point they flipped the light switch.  When the waitress brought our bill we were contemplating dessert.  That never happened.  They wanted us out of there.  We never even got to order dessert. 
Very strange.

The service was great when I was checking in- they even drove me back to my apartment for free when I forgot my wallet. The car was brand new with only 3,000 miles. Everything about the rental experience went smoothly. I'm giving 4 stars instead of 5 because I told them that I was driving a roundtrip from Wayne to Atlantic City, and they told me that trip would use about 1 tank of gas- so I prepaid for the entire tank. The whole trip ended up using only half a tank though. Maybe that's more my fault than theirs.

We visited Dunedin for the first time and couldn't have picked a better place to stay. Sean, the general manager greeted us with a "Welcome to the coolest hotel in Florida". We had a lovely room, excellent service and a flawless stay. The pool was a great and they played jazz music in the background. The rooftop bar overlooks the gulf providing a great backdrop. Drinks were on point. Every evening the hotel guests gathered on the front lawn in comfortable chairs or patio bar and enjoyed the magnificent sunsets. Kudos to Sean whose customer service made our stay a memorable one. BTW it is the place in Dunedin for hosting a event or wedding.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went here for anniversary dinner. $89 per person prix fixe. Salmon was prepared deliciously with nicely crispy skin. My partner had lobster thermidor, which was a thumb sized piece of claw meat cooked in a tail shell. It was tough and inedible. They graciously replaced it with steak that was melt in your mouth tender. Dessert was delicious but disappointing. I had a sliver of chocolate cake about the width of a pencil (I am not exaggerating!). Tasty,  but tiny. There are better, more satisfying,  places to celebrate special occasions.  I'll go to Jansen next time.

I have been having mani/pedis done here for several years. They do an excellent job on my nails. 

I have complete strangers approach me in restaurants, in hospital waiting rooms, at drive through windows and compliment me on my beautiful nails! 

Their nail polish color selections are vast. The staff is helpful and friendly. They greet me by name as I enter this establishment.

I would recommend making an appointment for nail services as they stay incredibly busy and you may have to wait a while if you are a walk-in.

I highly recommend Beauty Nails.

Below average food with horrible service.  Tough combination.  Don't bother with this place. 

We fell for the 4 star yelp and wandered in on a Sunday afternoon.
Ordered our meals, had some chips+salsa and waited...and waited... and waited.
38 minutes (receipt is time stamped) our number was called.  The staff seemed ambivalent about our wait.  
And that was after they tried to aggressively up-sell us on some very spendy burrito or meal upgrades... it felt like a bad used car place.  

I don't get the appeal of this place other than nostalgia for folks that don't mind a long wait for a mediocre meal in a charmless strip mall box.

Just a warning to all that are thinking about going to this location. Had an awful experience there several months back and was curious to see if they had made any attempts to improve their service and product. I was surprised to find that the place was the same. Waited an excessive time to get someone to take my order, (while others were playing with the gadgets in back, I could see them!). Finally was waited on and ordered a carnitas burrito to go. Went to eat it and it was cold and tasteless. Very small portion of pork as well. I would highly recommend staying away from this establishment!

I had a wiper guard fly off in the wind tunnel. After 2 weeks they finally got back to me. Awful attitude and no sign of helping. They found another piece from a different car so this isn't just me that this has happened to. I'm sure the people working there are nice but the manager that helped me sucked. I paid for the inside of my car to get cleaned and they never touched it.  They are liable for a piece that was legit 20 bucks which is practically nothing. 
Go at your own risk and if something breaks they won't help.

You should go! Very nice experience.

Really good place. The staff were great. Super friendly and engaged. We walked upstairs to go to the outdoor seating area, and the upstairs bartender, instead of just a curt nod, asked us if we'd like to grab a drink before we headed out to the patio. That's how the whole meal went. Super people. The food was really good too, but that's covered in other reviews. I felt like I was in a real neighborhood place. Just so you are aware: We really liked sitting on the outside patio, but the view is nothing great. That's not a knock, just so you're aware that you will be looking at a bakery, or parking lot.

The Positives:
Great location, Nice Comfy Bed, Nice view if you pay for an upgrade, Nice lounge area downstairs. Close to shops and restaurants.

The Negatives:
A/C not able to cool rooms, when maintenance came up they opened the unit and the filter looked as if it had not been changed in a year. That didn't help and when I addressed this with front desk they were quite rude (like I was the problem) and told me it would cost an upgrade to a different room.
The next day I found a manager from the office and she helped me out right away.
Parking is creepy, and didn't see any security cameras, I guess that is why it is free.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We searched for a good place to go for dinner in the area, and decided to try Positanos. We were not disappointed in The first course which was a salad not just an ordinary salad,  it had a wonderful balsamic vinegar  dressing with cranberries and almonds and feta cheese. I had the shrimp Sophia which had a garlic sauce spinach, cheese, sun-dried tomatoes and olives. Truly spectacular. My husband had the eggplant Rollatini, which was a manicotti filling inside of eggplant, wonderful flavor! Seemed like a local favorite as it was very busy in the off-season and on a Thursday night. The service was excellent and we were very delighted.

Pizza was absolutely awful. Crust is obviously frozen, very little sauce, meatball was not meatball but just ground beef spread on the pizza, so was the Italian sausage. If you have had a true meatball pizza it has actual meatballs on it. Live less than 5 minutes away, pizza was cold when I got home. I tried this place years ago and didn't care for it then, so I tried to give them a second chance, there will be no third chance. I would have been better off ordering from dominos or even cici's. People who think this is good pizza have never had a real good one before.

This place was recommended by a friend while I was in Tucson. Atmosphere was good people friendly but I did have an issue with just two things.
1. While reaching for my napkin I noticed a long brown hair an since I'm bald, I'm sure it wasn't mine.
2. The sushi selection was decent so I ordered a few rolls. I thought it was me but something was making them really salty. (Maybe the rice) I asked my friend and she said the same. Overall it was ok and the food seemed fresh. Also I didn't have service issues like other reviewers.

It was AWFUL! The Caprese appetizer was supposed to have buffalo mozzarella, but instead had big chunks of something that was just like Polli-O mozzarella that you would buy at the grocery. When we complained, they admitted they knew the cheese was wrong but served it anyway to use it up. Then it took an hour for our entrees to come. When it came, the seafood mixed grill was frozen seafood, cooked to death until it was like rubber. The veal I ordered was overcooked, burnt, and dry, and the pasta tasted like it had been overcooked, but then put in the oven until it was hard, crispy and dry. How can a restaurant serve food like this?

Literally the slowest person I've ever seen make sandwiches (Lindsay). It took her 15 minutes to make 2 sandwiches. And then kept talking to the customer which slowed her down even more. Also, only one person was working and they definitely need 2 people. I come to this subway about every other week and it's always slow but this was horrendous. As she made the sandwiches for the 2 people in front of me, she  told me and the other 3 people waiting that we could sit down because it was going to be a while..... maybe she can practice her speed? She individually placed each veggie which looks nice but not necessary.

First no menus had to wait for menus. Then they bring dough with butter with Parmesan cheese no flavor.  I ordered Veal piccata...the veal was a frozen veal patty with 2 lemon wedges no sauce or capers or butter no flavor and plain noodles. So send it back they send out a boiled piece of meat with lemon and oil...it was so nasty.  My son got chicken Alfredo which was watered down and no flavor. The pizza was ok but nothing to brag about.  This was our second time and the last!! Took 50 minutes to get terrible food.  Don't waste your time!!

We arrived as a group of 3 with no reservation and we were told it would be a short wait as they just had to clean a table. About 5 minutes later a group of 4 arrived, clearly heard they had no reservation as well and maybe 7 minutes later they were seated before us. I approached the host to ask how much longer we had to wait and she said they just had to clean a table (again). I don't like to make things about race or anything but 3 people of color who arrived before a group of 4 white individuals and were left to continue waiting kind of rubbed me the wrong way. Food was okay.

The cost for my eye exam was more than any other place that I have been, even with my insurance.  The doctor never mentioned multifocal contact lenses.  I was told that my only two options were to have a prescription for one eye for near vision and one eye for distance (which made me nauseous) or to have a prescription that meant that I would still need glasses to read.  I wasted all of the money that I spent here because I had to go to another doctor to get an accurate prescription.  I spent less on an eye exam with the new eye doctor using no insurance than I did at Luckey Eye Care.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: We booked a room here and were told a the day prior to our reservation that they had "overbooked." While I never stayed here their staff was less then helpful. They claimed they could not book us anywhere close to the center city hotel and our only options were in south or north philadelphia. We were not compenstated for the cab fairs we would not have had to pay, had we been able to stay in our origional location. In fact we recieved no compensation to make up for their terrible organizational skills. My suggestion is only book here if your a risk taker who enjoy the idea that they may kick you out the day before your reservation.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE EVER!! Do not go there!! I went in for brakes left but I kept hearing a squeking noise so I called them back told them about the noose they said come back I said I can do it tomorrow. Came back the next day the same guy that worked on my car looked at my car came in and said and I quote " I'm not touching that car it's pretty messed up"  I was like what!?!? Then I get an oil change pay 70 dollars only to come to find out I was 5 quarts short!! Horrible horrible horrible go at your own risk!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
We went for all you can eat sushi, but what we got was all you can eat RICE! What a disappointment... the only good thing about this place was that they were pretty speedy on getting the food out. But the food itself was a major upset. The fish was cut so thin, only a laser could have done it. This place was an absolute rip off! I wanted to like it but after seeing roll after roll come out LOADED with rice, we won't be coming back. 
Obviously with AYCE sushi, they're going to cut corners but they took it to extreme. Don't believe me, check out the pictures.

Being new to the area, I was unsure where to take my car for an oil change and to check out my breaks.  I wasn't interested in going to a place that would try and upsell me everything under the sun! After reading the positive reviews,  I decided to try out fix to go. I was not disappointed! They were welcoming as soon as I pulled in. They did my oil change and Tony called to tell me there were no issues with my brakes! They didn't try to sell me any additional, unneccessary services.  Fair, honest, and quick! I will be going back for my automotive needs!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: It''s hard to find your way around inside the hotel. We were only there for a couple of nights while I was visiting my folks. Maybe with more time we would have gotten used to the routes. There is not one elevator to go from the lobby to the upper floors. It is a large hotel and it could be a long walk for some people. There are a good selection of restaurants including a casual pub upstairs and a nicer restaurant by the front desk. I did leave a piece of jewellery in the room and the housekeeper neglected to turn it in. So I suggest not leaving anything behind!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Their customer service is not what I had hoped for. I had a large check that I wanted to cash, they were more than happy to do it except that it would take three incremental payments over I think it was three weeks. I went to chase where I don't have an account but I'm listed on the account with my elderly mother they bent over backwards to cash that check for me.
With the exception of needing one check per month I do all my banking online, I called down there today and they're taking inside appointments and they're only allowing two at a time...they just don't seem interested in customer service.

As with all the other reviews we were not pleased. This hotel has tons of potential but needs to be shut down and completely overhauled. Charming surroundings and great location. 
Many many things wrong with my room, and I complained a lot, but to their credit, every person I talked to was super nice and did their best to help. The rooms are just very old and outdated and dirty, with odd, random, sticky furniture.
Once they get the entire compound redone it will be beautiful- but more expensive too. Ah- catch 22.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Well, we miss Winslow's Home. My boyfriend and I hadn't been here since it reopened. They decided to change it to table service which I didn't mind. We waited about 20 mins for a table and I ordered a vanilla latte while we waited: good but too sweet. I had a hankering for their awesome quiche only to find it was no longer on the menu. Settled on the frittata instead -- which was nothing special. It came with a sad romaine salad. The quiche used to come with this lovely "soft" field greens salad that was soo good. My boyfriend got the biscuit breakfast sandwich and reported it was nothing special.

I have been too this new restaurant twice and the staff were great! Tonight I took the family and the service was horrible very slow and seemed uninterested in serving us. What's more nobody followed up on drinks or water. Food was not bad but not good enough to overcome the lousy service. We expressed our unhappiness to the hostess as we departed and she was apathetic to our concerns even through she knew who our waiter was when described our poor experience. Will be a long time before we return, so many better alternatives in Doylestown. 
Very loud for family dining, would be better for watching a game rather than family dining.

I took my 6.0 powerstroke to get a water pump put in with a 7.3 adapter and also had a coolant and oil leak that I could not figure out where it was coming from. Not only did they figure out both leaks but replaced my bulletproof oil lines that were routed badly(not my fault) and leaking with some lines that look lot more heavy duty. It did take a little bit off time to get truck back but really its cause they are such a great shop and are very busy, I drove from San Jose to get my truck worked on by them just because of their rep and I would do it again. 3 weeks since I picked up the truck and not a drop of oil . I am very pleased

We live down the street, so we thought it'd be a great place to walk to.  When we walked in the door, the staff sort of just looked at us in confusion.  Definitely a "locals only" place, and we're local!  The food was fine, although it took a long time (for a salad and cheesesteak!).  Salad was not great, the cheesesteak was alright, though they really ought to upgrade their rolls to Conshohocken rolls.  A pitcher of lager for $8 was great, though we weren't looking for cheap beer.  I'd try it again, cause I can walk there, but I don't know that I'd reccomend it unless you were just looking for a regular bar.

GREAT BAR!!

Being a Old Dog in my 50's I found this bar by chance and was very happy to. Staff was friendly and crowd was a mixture of young and older folks. Music in the back reminded me of a party at a friends house, Great mixture of old and new music with local talent who seemed to enjoy hanging out with the crowd as well as playing. The idea of converting the house into a bar gave it a warm feeling and it was clean. The front porch gave it a neighbor hood a feeling that can't be matched.

Well be defiantly be back....

July 2011.  Ordered chicken breast for lunch. Asked to substitute the mashed potatoes for extra vegetables.  Was told NO!  The veg was asparagus which I'm allergic to. Asked if I could sub that. Was told NO again. It was suggested that I buy a side that I'd like - NO SUBSTITUTIONS. WTH. I received a chicken breast on a bare plate. My 2 friends who ordered club sandwiches had their plate garnished with a small salad. Of course there was no reduction in cost for skipping the potato and veg. What would a 3 bite salad on my plate or a piece of parsley have cost? Never go again.

I went to this repair shop for a simple oil change and inspection. I waited a few hours and endured 3 different upsells while sitting in the waiting room. Then when it came time to pay they let me know my rear brakes weren't working and I needed to replace everything associated with the rear brakes.

 I left without getting the repair and went to a local mechanic for an alternate opinion. He said the brake pads were getting low but other than that they worked fine. I paid less than 1/3 of the Meineke price and have a perfectly functional car.  

I do not recommend this place unless you need something done immediately.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Recently my company entertained several visitors from all over the globe for dinner at this restaurant. While the food was delicious as always, the service was absolutely awful. Specifically, we had one individual who was vegan and was the blunt of our waiters jokes all evening. The waiter even went as far as to deliver her meal claiming he had "doubled the bacon" just for her. After asking the individual to please refrain from making those comments, he proclaimed to the entire restaurant that "it's just a joke." I would still recommend this restaurant, however, I would not have high expectations for the service.

Spent 50 minutes in line at the Tampa airport today to pick up a reserved car and then another 12 minutes to listen to the up selling .  We had reserved a Jetta and then were told by Mary (Budget rep) that she had a  BMW she could offer us at a discount.  When we declined the upgrade she said there would be a wait for the car we reserved.  When we insisted that we only wanted the level of car we reserved she was able to produce the keys to the Jetta.  Disgraceful attempted bait and switch.  Will not do business with them again.

I'm not sure what's happening to this place, but it seems to be declining rapidly. It had become one of my favorite places, but recently the food has not been good. I decided to give them another chance today, but the shrimp in the fried rice are getting smaller and smaller. Also, I think I chewed maybe three shrimp peels with legs attached. It was not appealing nor appetizing, and I won't post picture as it just looks disgusting. I will give it two stars because I know that it used to be great, but I probably won't give them another chance.

I live very close and was a frequent patron of Winslow's Home.  When I found out that the restaurant was sold, it broke my heart as another beautiful, neighborhood space was gone...however, I went to meet a friend at Winslow's Table (affectionately known at WT) and it was delish!!!  I had the grain bowl with chicken and omg beyond tasty!  The servings are large and the atmosphere so cozy.  You can share a table with other people and look to see what they ordered, which is how I wound up ordering my dinner!
Suffice to say, I was not disappointed and will be back!

Not very good "Chinese" food.  Not even as good as Panda Express (which is not really even "Chinese")  The order of sweet and sour chicken had grizzle in the chicken. And my friends beef dish also had a lot of grizzle and the beef was very tough. I guess with all the money problems businesses are facing these days buying cheaper cuts of meat will start to be the "norm".

The sweet and sour sauce was ok.   The rice was under cooked.  The broccoli in my friends dish was over cooked and looked bad.

The restaurant was clean and the employees were nice and friendly.

This hotel is in a great location in downtown Philadelphia and has some nice perks - free espresso, bottled water, snacks, etc. However, it was not as clean as I would have liked (for example, there was mold surrounding the shower knob in our bathroom) and the staff weren't quite as on top of things as they would be at a better hotel (it took a very long time to check in and basic things like coffee cups were unavailable at times). It was well priced for the area and I would happily stay there again, but it definitely wasn't anything special.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Unfortunately this is another one of those bait and switch type places.
