They advertise all these great discounts and two pairs for this and that but if you have insurance you don't get any discounts you don't get any buy one get one free nothing and the prices are so high that even with your insurance you have to pay out of pocket. Definitely would not recommend this at all although the doctor is very nice I don't like their practices and I don't like the fact that they don't disclose all of their fees up front and you don't find out about them until you get there!!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
If you are able to go anywhere other than Nationwide vision go
Although the doctor is very nice the staff is not good at all offer no customer service and I wouldn't recommend going there for anything. I have insurance and it was going to be over $200 for two pairs of glasses with my insurance although they offer two pairs for $99 that's only if you don't have insurance and by the time they were done adding all the extras it was way more than that. Went down the road to one of their competitors and got two great pairs of glasses exactly what I wanted for $100 out the door.
This place is the biggest rip off!!!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: First time with Hertz - signed up for Hertz Gold......car was not ready and waiting upon check in.   Turned car in and told to go to the kiosk for receipt because the check in clerk couldn't give me one.   Went to kiosk and no one there.  Flagged person down and he told me to go to inside to get receipt.   Went inside and had to wait while same person who told me to go there followed me and and waited on another person.   Won't rent from Hertz again.  Told the clerk at front and she said she would "inform the manager", which means hurry up and go away in my opinion and amounts to lip service.

Seriously the BEST tacos I've ever ate.  Here from Sacramento and I'm so glad we found this gem  My husband and I are always searching for places that really make delicious tacos and have been disappointed many times. I am very picky when it comes to tacos, so we may have to travel this way more often just for this deliciousness. I'm so glad that yelp helped us find this place. I recommend the tacos suaderos and my husband loved the tacos de cabeza. Everything was so authentic, I love how we can see how everything is being made and the price is very reasonable.

I only feel safe getting things like soda, water or packaged goods here. The produce is often very picked over, the meat/fish smell and the overall store is not always kept up. I once came in at night and the employee stocking the shelves literally STUNK like Body Odor. I think in an area that could use a great super market this place is missing on a big chance. Between the families and college students they could kill the market, instead it's a very below average market with inconsistent sometimes expired offerings.

I will never go there again.  Bad business. My husband purchased $400 worth of gift cards for me and then covid hit.  This nail salon closed for some time and a nail salon was not a place to be in the pandemic.  Now that things have opened and are safer, I went to use part of the card and they are denying them as "too old".  They have no flexibility.  Very bad business.   I was a customer for life. Gift cards should not  expire anyways!   I like the nail techs, but very bad business.  They will lose way more $ from me over the next 20 years than if they honored my gift cards. Thank

Went to Mavis Tire on way from airport with rental car, due to low tire pressure, just what I needed at start of trip. Pulled in and spoke with Jim, stated there were about 4 or 5 cars ahead of me and would be about an hour or so. Must have seen the look of despair on my face, said wait a minute, came back said give me your keys, took car and found a nail in the tire, plugged it and didn't charge me, just said give the fella that fixed it a tip. I was on my way within 20 minutes. Will definitely go here for service when I have my personal car as I am moving to this area.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: It's really sad because the decor and the atmosphere is wonderful. I really think the concept is cute. But the actual nail job itself was a complete and utter nightmare. This was my first visit and I got a gel manicure and a pedicure. My mani was chipping within 4 days. Which should last at least two weeks... My pedicure was just okay and the polish was chipping within a week. In a weeks time, I was left removing the mani and pedi polish. Which is a shame, because they didn't hold up for the event I got them done for. Not worth the price for the results!

Stayed for 4 nights. Every day arriving back to room, room was made up, but no towels to be found, had to go to the front desk and ask for them. One of the nights, the woman behind the counter seemed very annoyed that she had to stop talking on her cell phone long enough to tell me I couldn't have any towels because she was washing them (after 5pm). Every night, had to have the key to the room re done because it didn't work anymore. Breakfast, which is supposed to start at 6:30, never got started any earlier than 7. This morning, no hot water in the shower. Service was absolutely horrible, wouldn't stay here again if you paid me.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I consider a pedicure a real luxury item, so when I spend the money for one I expect a luxurious experience. And, that is exactly what I got at Ongles! I live in Hillsboro Village and love supporting our neighborhood businesses, so decided to give Ongles a try. I walked into the salon and immediately felt cool, calm and relaxed. I sat back in bliss with my complimentary glass of wine in what appeared to be a very new chair. I decided to indulge and spend the extra $7 for the scrub and lotion. Totally worth it!! The staff are all very friendly and attentive. I will definitely be returning to Ongles!

I had an amazing dinner with a large group of friends on their rooftop patio. The view up there is breathtaking and is one of my favorite rooftop spots in St. Louis on a nice day. Our server was incredibly knowledgeable and was attentive to all of our needs throughout the evening. The service was fast and efficient. The GM made sure our expectations were not only met, but exceeded. The food was impeccable! We tried a variety of their summer cocktails, which were super refreshing. Overall, we had such a memorable experience and we will absolutely be back!

Robert and his staff are fantastic. While friendly and trustworthy, his team is also an authoritative source on diesel mechanics. I brought my '97 12 Valve Cummins to him for a valve spring job and his shop did great work at a reasonable price. Robert let me hang out in his office during the job, and we talked shop on and off for several hours. I always appreciate picking a mechanics brain and expanding my own knowledge base, which Robert was more than happy to participate in. I generally like to do most work on my truck on my own, but the next time I need diesel work done by a professional, I'll be giving my business to McDiesel again.

Let me tell you that this hotel is next to the Sheraton, where you should be staying at.

Here, at the Hampton inn I checked in for $128 for a junior suite and the bed was dirty with condoms still in the waste basket, no microwave, and lightbulbs that weren't working.

What's more, after asking the staff to report these findings to the manager, the manager never called me back. Poor service! Bad management! 

I have never had this unresponsive inattentive service from a hotel, especially for what was paid for the room!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Worst Holiday Inn Express we have ever stayed at! The carpet in the rooms are damp and the whole room stinks! Also, when we got here, the toilet was not clean and there was brown crud on the toilet seat! They didn't clean our room and when we called the front desk, they said they only clean rooms every 3 days?! Then why do you leave a card in the room that says to leave our towels on the floor if you want them washed?! Parking isn't free and there is no fridge or microwave. Awful stay! Can't believe they can call this a holiday inn express...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The gym itself is okay, but the management is awful.

I joined through a work program, and when I had to change my card due to a hacking incident, 3 different people assured me everything was okay with my account.

Well, it wasn't.

They were not communicating with the company that I joined through, and though they kept telling me things were fine and that they were connected, I was getting emails and additional charges from the corporate partner.

This all took about 6 weeks to work through, and 2 managers have been supposed to call me to discuss, and neither one ever has.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This review is for the food only, since I ordered takeout. I ordered the Ramen with shrimp and knew something was off immediately. The taste was off. Granted, I have never had the ramen from this location and this was my first experience here, so I am not sure how their food usually tastes, but this ramen tasted sour. The shrimp was very overcooked and was hard and rubbery. The broth tasted really funky. Sure enough, I spent the evening and next day puking. Even the fried rice was stale and the eggs in it were almost crunchy. My friend had the sushi and had no complaints, howeve.r

The food in this restaurant is great for the price you pay, the flavor is great,  the presentation, the server service (specialty Ashley, thank you) make a difference compared to the restaurants in the area. 

After having a minor problem,  the owner took a good decision and she waived the price of dish that took too much time to be delivered to my table and I could not eat all (I felt full by the time it was brought), I appreciate that,  that's the way the business must be based on: CUSTOMER SATISFACTION. 

Thank you all.......  again.

If you just need a place to crash, this place is okay. The walls are paper thin though, so keep your fingers crossed that you have quiet neighbors. At 4am, our neighbor was yelling at his girlfriend through what I assumed to be FaceTime since I could hear everything both of them were saying. A false fire alarm also went off on the middle of the night. So I wouldn't say I had the best sleep of my life. Also, there's no hotel parking, so you have to pay for the lot across the street. Staff was friendly and helpful, but for a place meant for you to sleep, they make that difficult.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I pay close attention to how my food is handled during this pandemic. I was at first relieved when I noticed the employees had face masks and gloves. 

What I found extremely disappointing was they were all wearing their masks around their chins. Mouths exposed. Talking over my food. Only ONE guy had his mask over his mouth... But under his nose. 

I do not think I will be patronizing this Arby's until after this pandemic is over. If they do not take their health seriously, I question their sanitary conditions when it comes to food prep.

Soda tastes dirty. You have to pick through the veggies because some are no good. Noodles are dry and sticky. Meat is weird, sliced, and frozen. Employees dont explain how the place works, you're kinda on your own and they hardly speak any English so it makes it hard on knowing how to do it. And how they cook it is very unsanitary. I'm from Vegas, this is a HUGE disappointment. I can say if you ever go to Vegas go to Genghis Grill! It's kinda the same concept but it's actually good and the employees are so nice

Awful policy of not taking debit cards .  I've  been renting cars from enterprise all my life.  I get to this enterprise and they won't take my debit card because I am out of state I want to utility bill and the Payroll receipt. My credit card was canceled because of some idiot doing fraud on my account so I had to close my credit card. I will never rent from them ever again I have a track record of always bring my car in with no scratches no damage I brought them my whole life  and they do this crap to me.  Never rent a car from them out of state and using a debit card.

While in Tucson for business I needed a spot to sit down for a few minutes and knock out some work so I checked yelp and found this spot.  It is well deserving of its high rating.  I was helped by Christina who recommended the Ethiopian Allona, Guji made in the Aeropress.  The recommendation was spot on and brewed perfectly.  When I decided to buy some coffee David helped me out and was very knowledgeable and helpful.
The location is a bit off the beaten path but easy to find.  It was a great spot to get a little work down and I'll be seeking it out on future trips to take advantage of the great coffee and ambiance.

I came here to celebrate my friends birthday I let the people at the front staff now however when we had our server she really didn't seem to be interested in taking care of it she pawned us off  on someone else. Ryan told us she was sick however she was still serving other people.  Ryan that his best however the food to forever there were several tables waiting ahead of us in the restaurant wasn't completely full.  The food was great but I'm just not sure about the service anymore I think they really need to work on that if service matters to you when you go to a restaurant then you probably don't want to come here.

Had my first eye exam ever with the kind folks at Berry Eyecare and Optical today! They check your temperature and ask Covid related questions (basically making sure you're not sick) before letting you inside. Everyone working was really kind and easy to talk to! It's refreshing to be able to go into a place and have them make you feel comfortable and welcome. They sanitized everything in between uses. Every test they did, they would explain how it worked and what it was meant for.  Also had an awesome selection of eyewear that I'll be purchasing from soon! Highly recommend this place.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I've gone to You Tomo many times - at least 30 in the past 6 years. Their food is excellent, but their management is lacking. Over 2 hours for a wait on a Monday? Come on. 

Aside from that, the wait can only be joined or canceled via Yelp? That is ridiculous. 

As a business owner I know that Yelp is incentivizing them for using Yelp's booking system. I am very disappointed. It is a Monday, and I really wanted to come for an important birthday - but I can't. They need to either start requiring a deposit for reservations, or do something about their limited space / staff.

Have children's accounts with them for years. For dormant, it used to be $5 fee after 18 months of inactivity (not sure when and why it changed). Now they have $10 fee for 12 months inactivity. This no longer works for us since we deposit gifts for them once a year. They were able to charge our accounts multiple times since we did not address in time. They did send a dormant warning via mail but did not open in time since we were away dealing with medical issues. We only have savings with them so will be finding a new place that meets our needs better once my CDs mature.

I am a fan of this place, but tonight they were very off. 

The calamari was hard to eat, very chewy, and undercooked. They forgot our stuffed mushroom appetizer and brought it out in the middle of our dinner, we did not want it since we were already eating dinner so they took it off our bill. 

The bread was good, as always, and our dinner was good. The kids got Chicken Parm, and the adults got the crab and shrimp special in vodka sauce, which was good. 

That said, going forward I will be avoiding their appetizers and staying with their salads and pasta dishes.

This place has hidden behind the same excuse as others...supply chain issues.  Well I have had no problem getting anything to make italian food.  However, they raised their prices, and their food tastes are horrible.  The salad is dripping wet, they one week a time removed what they used to add to their antipastas...They charge you extra for every little add on in the pizza, but they don't really add on the extra cheese, extra sausage.  I will no longer order stuff from here, nor will anyone else I know, as we all feel the same...
Stop hiding  behind covid!

Had to prepay and was a little hesitant. I was told if they "suck" I would just get a refund. Picked up my shirts and the collars were all creased and scrunched up. I was told "ya our shirt guy is an idiot" we will re-do them. I was in a hurry and needed my shirts for a work trip. They said only a manager can, waited for a manager, and he's wanting to debate about re- doing them. Didn't have time to argue, had them "re-done", still the same. Terrible quality and not convenient, will never use again for personal or business.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: It was a great service until after I received $15 penalty for going through EZ Pass.  I have done it before because I forget I am in a rental car.  Usually rental company forwards me citation and I contact EZ Pass and they charge me tool and all is good.   Enterprise does not give you that option and they don't even provide a way to dispute this with them, no contact info is provided at all.  Like I said, it was good until now.  But when company tries to take advantage of you, I am not doing business with them.  My tall was $2 and they are making $13, I hope it is worth for them to loose otherwise satisfied customer.

The food at this place was just ok.  I had the cheesesteak and it almost tasted like something I could have made myself.  It was a decent portion, so maybe that's how they try to wow people.  But there was a serious lack of flavor.  The appetizers we ordered for our table also fell into the same category sadly.  

The staff is fine.  Friendly and attentive.  The building itself has a really cool old school vibe to it.  Almost to the point where I could see myself hanging out there for drinks if I lived closer.  But as far as the food goes, nothing about anything I had struck me as being better than just average.

Okay, I'm from Trenton, so perhaps I'm spoiled, but this is not "Jersey tomato pie". I know. Why would I come to Morrisville, Pennsylvania for Jersey tomato pie? Well, DeLorenzo's in Yardley was closed, and Papa's was too far away... because I now live in Yardley. I have posted pictures of tomato pies from each place. The sad looking slice is from Cafe Antonio's. I could swear it wasn't like this years ago. I told the guy: "way too much cheese", his response: "this is how we make it". They don't need my business for tomato pies, and that's fine. Antonio is still a pretty awesome dude though, so I'm giving it three stars for him.

The food is good but the staff that takes orders has a lot to be desired. On multiple occasions we placed orders over the phone (and keep in mind we place the same order 95% of the time) and they can't get an order correct !!! Most recently we placed and order after doing work on our house and chose to pick up food , after finally getting back they didn't get order correct and we didn't have dinner for everyone ! Service needs some work , basic mistakes that shouldn't be done when so many good places to eat are in the area

Six of my girlfriends  and I were in Nashville for the first time. Sunset Grill did not disappoint us.  Everyone was exceptionally pleased with their entrees, including the fried catfish  with the Benton"s bacon butter beans, dill remoulade  and crispy shallots, the smoked pork chop dinner and the shrimp and grits.  The waiter was very polite, efficient but did not hover. An added bonus was that our hotel,
The Hampton Inn  Vanderbilt advised that The  Sunset Grill shuttle would pick us up and bring us back of which we took advantage.

The food here is among the best I've had in Philly.  My gf and I each ordered the $65 tasting menu (which was not on the regular menu)...I had only heard about it from reading reviews on Yelp.  Despite being expensive, it was phenomenal, and the portions were massive for a tasting menu.  The service was pretty good, as was the atmosphere.  As a very small restaurant with seating capacity of about 30 or so people, I wouldn't recommend for large groups.  However, if you're going on a date, and food is of top priority, this should be near the top of your list.

Ok, we're a nation now of convenience.  Subway is so far removed from a New York Deli that its actually its own "not much but convenient".  Next time you're at Subway, close your eyes, define what you're eating.  Give it a shot.  If you can't define what you're eating, then the question I have is why bother?  In a city that makes the best sandwiches in America, why settle for something less than?  We are not in Kansas.  We are New Orleanians.  I just don't get it I guess.  Food is a celebration of life.  Subway doesn't join in the celebration me thinks.  Neither here nor there.

I have been going to meglios for at least 20 yrs. I've always loved their pizza. I've noticed a change in the sauce and crust, and not for the better. The Mexican food is very bland. The wait staff just stands at the counter talking not paying attention to their tables. The one girl I had was on her phone the whole time, and everytime i needed something i had to go over to her. When i brought this up to the person in charge he acted like he didnt even care.  Another time I waited 15 min to get my check while she talked to another employee.

went in on sat 4/13 with my daughter to get a bite to eat- walked right out- the inside is literally falling down around you with mildew and all. it's raining from the roof with buckets everywhere. we attempted to go thru drive thru but that of course was SLOW as can be so we just left and ate elsewhere. the only reason I gave 2 stars is because we love the food here but the service sucks! it's FAST food not rocket science...get someone who knows what they are doing working the drive thru window and fire every manager in there for allowing the dining room to look like that- disgusting!

Absolutely the worst Chinese food Ive ever had I ordered shrimp and broccoli and a shrimp egg roll the shrimp and broccoli was so bland it tasted like they made it for an old folks home no flavor at all the rice was ok but taste more like box minute rice rather than the normal rice cooker rice you get from Chinese. Then the shrimp egg roll was like they took dough rolled it up and fried it there was nothing in it and it was just as bland as the entree this place is takeout only which is fine and is walking distance to my house if I choose to walk but needless to say I will not be walking or driving here EVER again!!!

Returned to the restaurant several weeks ago, after an absence of several years, and were impressed.  Their Wok Charred Salmon is great, especially with the Oro Valley Salad.  Went back a second time and enjoyed it.  The third visit was a disaster.  Waited 15 minutes for bread. Waited over 45 minutes for the entrée. Accompanying vegetables were not as requested. Excuse was that there was a big group, but gee if the establishment is full it does not matter whether there are large groups or not.  Bottom line, one can experience unreliable and uncaring service at this establishment. You take your chances.

Staff were very friendly, helpful and professional. I came in for an oil change and to get my brakes fixed after a cross-country drive. They brought me out to actually see the problems with the brake pads and rotors with my own eyes, and while it was expensive replacing everything, they included coupons and other discounts to make the costs more manageable. Service was quick, prompt, and well-done, and I liked that I could actually see what was being done to my car from the waiting room. Would definitely recommend.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
This is as close to West Coast Mexican cuisine that I have found in this area of Florida. Looks remodeled recently, bright colors surround you, comfortable searing for your meal. All good things indeed.

Be wary of the drinks, as they are a bit strong, but the food Ive eaten here all came out fantastic. Chips and salsa applenty, burritos are grade A delicious, the tacos are nearly ideal street tacos, and the corn absolutely slaps. Would recommend.

Dont be turned off by the lack of parking out front, there is plenty in back!

I am very picky when it comes to Sushi. First, I am not a raw fish eater and I hate seaweed. Kinda the whole point of sushi, I know.  Sushi Moto had soy paper that they used instead of seaweed for me and it was delicious!  The soy paper allows you to taste all the other flavors in the roll whereas seaweed tends to overpower the rolls. They were also kind enough to make all the rolls I ordered with cooked fish in place of the raw. The Ben Franklin is by far the best roll I have ever eaten! I will travel all the way from the far end of Spanish Springs just to get a Ben Franklin roll!

Roy may not be for everyone, and I'm fine with that. It is small, it is artsy, and they leave you alone. The drinks will be stiff, but most importantly, Roy will cook your food perfectly! And it'll be better than the menu description. If you want an uber creative menu, spectacular waitstaff, or the latest trend, then keep moving on down the block. If you want a good drink, a great meal served at a mellow pace, come in a stay a while. Roy was here before you arrived and he'll be here after you move on to the next thing. We'll make sure of it. Thanks Roy!

I had high hopes for the restaurant. It had been home for a couple pizza places in the past. The fact that it's a Mexican restaurant is a change of pace. There's nowhere else in the area that has authentic Mexican food. 
I was recently there last week and ordered the wet burrito. It tasted great and the portion size was huge compared to the low price. My boyfriend got chicken tacos and loved them. We've had them deliver to our house twice after. I hope this place stays around for awhile because I can't get enough!

The hotel was very beautiful. Parking was a bit hectic after the concert. The hotel doesn't offer a lot of parking spaces for guest, Valet told us to use the mall parking lot. 
I reserved two double beds and received a king and I stayed one night. The only downside was Alissa at the front desk. From The moment I checked in Alissa did not have a friendly and welcoming demeanor. She also gave me the wrong price when I asked how much it would be. Alissa told me $250 but I was charged $418. Also when I asked for soap and other things, Alissa did not seem too pleased with helping me as a guest.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I hate that this place makes you use the computer to order food when you don't have cash. However, they did change the play place so that I can see my toddler at all times, and they have a gem of an employee named James that works here. He was so kind to my daughter and I, and I witnessed him helping a woman that was so frustrated she was hitting the computer. He made sure to check on every customer sitting inside. He brought my review up 2 stars, and is the only reason I wanted to write a review in the first place! Truly a great employee!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
a day agoNEW

We ordered 3 different nachos to share.
Jamaican Jerk- I liked the plantains, husband did not. These nachos had a heat that crept up and lingered.
Crab Ragoon- I had actually ordered the Bahn Mi, but was given this and didn't realize it until I got home. These were just way too sweet. Too much sport chili sauce.
Ol' Standby - the sour cream did not look pretty on them. These were ok, and were standard nachos. They  come with pickled veggies on the side. I liked those, but the 3 males kept asking WHY is there purple cauliflower on the nachos?!??
Overall an "eh" experience

This is a great location which is centrally located to the downtown attractions of the mall, bars, clubs, stadiums, etc...everything is within walking distance.  The rooms are spacious and nicely decorated.  On the negative side, there wasn't a lot of closet space, and the kitchen seemed dimly lit.  Unfortunately, they were also out of double bed rooms (or a least one wasn't available when I checked in), so I had a handicapped room without a window.  However, the rooms were clean, the staff was very nice and the doormen consistently opened the doors and greeted the guests.  I'd definitely stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Every time we have gone to eat in, this place has been good. The owner is very nice, the servers are very kind, and the food is solid. We usually order the pork lo mein, beef and onions, and sweet and sour chicken. All of which are seasoned well and they will add lots more chilis if you want them (which, if you like spicy food, you do). Their tea is also really nice.

So why only four stars? We got take out from there once and it was not good. Much less flavorful, slightly cold, and nowhere near as good as when you sit in.

Always a trusty Chinese place which can be hard to find!

I'll keep this short and sweet. Not one barber that works in this establishment truly knows how to cut hair. If you want to get knicked up, this is the spot. They always have different random dudes in their cutting hair, but they aren't actual barbers. It's comical. Then, to top it off, the main "barber" Carlos does not know how to cut hair. Not much else needs to be said. If you want a fuck up, go to Pennsport "Barber" Shop. I'd recommend any barbershop (including Hair Cuttery) or even salon in the Tri-State area over this place.

My reading glasses lasted 4 months and an arm broke off.  Went back and they offered to replace the frame for %25 off. " why should I repurchase the same defective frames?"  A whole new set can be had for 25% off.   2-300$ at risk twice?  The lenses did not have glare coating and were not anti scratch. 

I handed the glasses back to the Mgr and said "you keep them!!"  

Don't bother with this operation -- get better glasses over the counter. $20 at. CVS. Rite Aid. Etc. 
I may mail  order script glasses from Oakley.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Not exactly good... Very large selection but unfortunately they chose quantity over quality. Not only does the food not taste good but it doesn't look appetizing either ...Usually walking down Chinese buffets ur stomach grumbles looking at all the delicious foods, This was the opposite. My waitress was kind but didn't communicate in english well enough to even tell me how much the meal was when i asked... it made me feel bad personally she has to serve people she can't even speak with. They should at lease be able to understand "How much is this?" . Also, $40 for a crab buffet is insane. $25 i could understand, but $40??? at a buffet ???

I have been here many times since it opened and I thought it was great and clean and one of the best frozen yogurt places.... Until I went a few days ago and they charged me $4 for a "pre packaged" fee. I do not even know what that means. I asked the girl who charged me and I still did not really understand why I got charged the extra four dollars. My friend and I got the exact same thing( minus a topping) and she was not charged. It would have been ok if they displayed somewhere that they do charge but they did not. Green Island is much much better........

The apartments are fine, it's the extremely horrible service that you receive from Edward Rose. They do not respond to emails and Internet service has degraded since opening everything is so proprietary might as well live in the old Soviet union! All the neighbors that I've spoken with agree that Internet service is awful, they don't respond to any requests and if they do it takes them weeks sometimes months to accomplish them. Again the apartments are nice and that is about it! There are too many places to live today to put up with this type of treatment. If you're thinking about moving to The Avant, DON'T!!!

One star is generous. The roof kept us dry. Furniture was falling apart. I think an Indian nail bed would feel more comfortable than the cement beds we slept on.

When we pulled in, we saw someone cooking on a portable little grill in the driveway and a dozen kids running around in the parking area.

The "executive" breakfast is a joke, unless you really like waffles with no syrup or butter. One coffee pot and never full. Overall, it was dingy and dank and it does not help when the manager can not speak English well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The new management couldn't care less about customer service. It takes FOREVER  to get simple things fixed by them. The office staff just don't care about it, and wouldn't even hide their horrible attitude. The previous management did a very good job earning their reputation, but it's all ruined now. The rent doesn't include water, sewer, and trash. Also need to pay $25 in addition because they send someone to put your trash in the dumpster. The problem is you can't opt out even though the dumpster is only 100 feet away and I can totally do it myself. Do not move here!

Elevators are horrible! Hotel has nice amenities several restaurants and bars. But the elevators are horrible! Called for towels and it's over three hours to receive them. This is my second request for towels.

At this price point I would expect the hotel to be more responsive to guest request. You have to take an elevator from the first floor to the third floor to get the guest rooms and if you're on a higher level you have to take the escalator an elevator then on the elevator to get to your Upper level floors!

Service finally delivered
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
gosh gosh gosh this is a bad slice of pizza. I went there with a friend at 8:30PM and we ordered two of their last three slices of pizza (they only had cheese). they needed to be completely smothered with peppers and Parmesan in order to be even remotely edible. fucking terrible mouthfeel. if it was under a dollar it would have been a justified purchase, but it was $2.60.

the saving grace (and reason for that second star) was the super great cookies (only like ¢60) baked by the very nice woman who served us.

The team at Stef's I'm sure are well intended but they missed the mark.  Not only did they hand me the wrong carry out order, which was unknown until I got home, they then suggested I responded to the wrong name when the server approached me with the bag, not true.  So they tried to make it right by sending correct order, when I opened the pizza box, it was so undercooked, whatever angle it was at in transit made it look like a mudslide, most the cheese and toppings had slid off the dough "crust".  By this time too frustrated to pick up the phone.  It had been while since ordering from there.  Can't imagine going back.

Just had dinner here and it was terrific. We started with the arugula salad which was simple, fresh, and the portion was generous. The roasted beet salad was also great. 

The real winner was our main course. The pizza is outstanding! I don't know how they do it but the crust comes out both chewy and crispy at the same time - it's delicious. 

We ended the meal with the Meza Luna (basically a calzone made with the amazing pizza crust filled with Nutella and marshmallows). 

All in all, the food, service and atmosphere was above expectations and we will certainly be back!

Ok place with good concept but not ideal location. Property surrounding hotel leaves a lot to be desired. Vallet was a 10/10. Don't think there was a self park option so add some $$$. Front desk was a 8/10. Food was 10/10. Rooms were small. Had a 2nd floor room away from traffic but was still noisy. I wasn't aware that their band plays most/every night. So had some noise from that while trying to sleep. And oddly enough food smells from kitchen seeped up to my room. Must have been above kitchen. Don't think I would return.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: UNCLEAN it's insane how a place where u go to clean your clothing is UNKEPT!  Since new management has taken over the place has an odor & it's not kept clean. I can only imagine what's actually inside the machines themselves makes me wonder when was the last time they were thoroughly clean. Sad part is there isn't any other laundromats in this area anymore  the ONLY pro is that they have great sized machines. THAT'S IT! It's such a shame bc aa patrons we pay a lot of money for these facilities but yet we have to settle for what we can get in these times bc we don't have a choice.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
This applies to Achieva as a whole, not this particular branch.

I joined some  40 years ago as a teen when it was call Pinellas County Teachers CU. Over the years it has grown, mostly by merging with other CUs. 

About ten years ago it started to change. Now they act as a poorly managed bank looking to generate fees than a CU that takes care of its members. 

So between now and summer I will be  closing my credit card and moving my banking to USAA. I am tired  of all the bad changes, poor management, account screw ups and lies.

My husband and I came here after a previous failed attempt at finding a place for dinner.  In the end, things turned out better!  We had an attentive, super friendly waiter and the outdoor seating was great.  The seating was in the corner so we could get the full effect of the breeze coming off the water and the ambient lighting was wonderful. As for the food, I ordered the grilled Key Lime salmon (it was delicious!) and my husband ordered the Filet Mignon which seemed to just fall apart in your mouth it was so tender!  We'll definitely be back :)

My debit card has been acting up and not always scanning at places. My current debit card expires in 2 months. The representative told me I would be charged $5 for a new card being the magnetic strip is damaged. If I were to wait till next month I would not be charged since the debit card is set to expire in 2 months. The card they are sending now will still have same expiration of current and I will receive another card next month with new expiration. I also bank at another bank and have never had an issue when needing a replacement card or been charged for it.

It was the second night open back from quarantining . My boyfriend and I came for dinner . Food was excellent as always but the the service was very very slow . Our server took 20 min to come over to us . Our drinks took 15 min to get to our table . The bar drinks i don't mind waiting for but a water and an iced tea should not take 15 min . 

All of the servers has gloves and a mask on and all food came in plastic to go containers ( because of the circumstances ) . Tables were set 6 feet apart from each other in the parking lot under a tent which I loved ! It was a beautiful night .

I made an appointment here 5 days in advanced. The staff told me that they were unable to find out what my co-pay would be with my insurance at the time, but they would have that information when I arrived for my exam. Well, that was a lie. After waiting in their office for 30 minutes, they finally told me that my insurance wasn't accepted by them, but I could still go back for an eye exam if I wanted to. Meanwhile, a 5 minute phone conversation with LensCrafters not only told me that my insurance was accepted and what my cost would be, but also got me an appointment. This place has terribly customer service, lost my business for life
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Place reminds me of a good mom pop breakfast spot from back in the day. Good breakfast sandwiches.  Really good breakfast especially during the winter months. The type that can "stick to your ribs". Diet conscious who stray away from a full breakfast be warned. You might want to hit the Starbucks up the block or Dunkin Dounuts across the street for a bran muffin and oj instead. I will say they have the best and most unique milkshakes in the area. They also have a drive thru which can take 5-6 mins per order but it is definitely definitely worth it.

I have eaten here twice. One time was about two years ago and the most recent was July 13 2012. Both times the food was okay, but not anything to get up and tell all your friends about. 

A major deal killer on this restaurant  is that the dining room on both occasions was too warm. I thought the first time that the air conditioning must be broken. Which is forgivable in my book. But 2 years later it was the same. So I don't think it is broken air conditioning.

The margaritas were tasty and refreshing. 

Based on the hot dining room I don't think we'll be going back anytime soon. There are others like El Jaripeo in Westfield.

It's sad when the manager of the store doesn't care. Nancy the older white lady with gold teeth on the bottom is just terrible at her job. She takes no responsibility for the store running so slow. She says she's an assistant manager and has no responsibility whatsoever. I asked to speak with the manager and she said she was the manager. You see how confusing that is. The service was so bad I asked for a refund. The only reason I gave one star is she refunded my money. Then she laughed about how terrible my experience was. Burger King it's time to find new leadership if you want my business back.

the woman at the counter was convinced my brand new ID was  a fake. She Brought the manager out and everything and made a scene. I'm 26 years old, place is full of people who assume just because the store is near Rowan, that every 20 something that walks in there is a minor. Now I got this bent ID everywhere I go, that actually looks fake now because of the ignorant cashier who bent it in half. 

Have been advising any and all to go to the discount liqour mart down the street from there since then and haven't looked back!

If you're looking for a job with no experience needed, this place is just for you! You literally don't have to know anything except tell people your repair will be fixed in a 30-45min window and call the customer back 2 hours later to let them know that they can't fix your tire and that you need a new one! I had no idea that a tire with no air, worn tread, and a nail in it would need to be replaced! Who would've thought? Thanks again guys for finding that conclusion after 2 hours! Bravo, bravo....trash af smh
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Business travelers beware. Concierge room is VERY hit or miss and there aren't any other options for food around this hotel except maybe for the awfully slow service in the hotel restaurant. Rarely is the concierge room open during posted times. Drinks and waters are hot to be prepared to get ice and pray that the ice machine is actually working (that'll be a stretch). Bed and bath in the rooms are good but everything else about this place is sub-par in many levels. Definitely don't expect the usual Renaissance/Marriott experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Decent homemade pies, really good homemade cheesesteaks, and a friendly Italian mother/son duo behind the counter.  Bonus:  it smells like my grandma's kitchen when they're cooking tomato sauce.  The only reasons for 3 stars are the cash-only policy and the fact that overall, I prefer a thinner crust to the breadier, doughier thickness of their pie.  Flavor, however, is spot-on across the whole menu.  Wish I could give 3.5 stars, and a thinner crust would up it to 4.5, but you can't please everyone all the time.

Stayed at Grenoble house in the latter part of May 2015. We had room 207 which was in the old servants quarters. It was quiet..very quiet! Room immaculate bed oh so comfy! Vince, Vic and all employees where a delight.From the early morning coffee to the afternoon respite in the hall gallery where a delight. Maintenance is on going due to Katrina.Yet it does not interfere. Pool is a delight along with jacuzzi. I like the European flair of a 24/7 concierge. Felt very safe. Very secure.
A gem for a quick weekend or extended stay. Our apt. had a full kitchen. Will return and stay here for sure.In the heart of the French Quarter!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The pedicure wasn't horrible and all of the nail technicians seemed nice. However, every person that walked in the door seemed to be a regular and were clearly prioritized even though I had an appointment. We waited forever, my feet soaked for 30 minutes before they began my pedicure, they were incredibly pruned.  I got a dip powder manicure and it was very rushed and they left my nails messy. See the picture attached! The extra dip powder is on my skin and I have to go home now and use acetone myself to get it off and hope that I don't ruin the manicure I just paid for. Honestly, just go to any other nail place. I won't be back.

Plenty of beers on tap, they just don't happen to be good beers.

All of the regulars are here, plus a few questionable ones...Grolsh on tap, really?

No Stone, no Rogue, only 1 Dogfishhead (60 minute IPA)?  The 20oz pur is $8.50, and I was able to get the Sam Adams Octoberfest, so that's not too terrible.

If you are in the E terminal (Southwest) and have a few hours to kill, I have a 'Very Good' ATT wireless connection and plenty of decent'ish beer to drink.

The food is pretty bland.  Burger was dry and disappointing.  The chips 'n' salsa appetizer was straight out of a bag, and not a good one.

Stayed here for a trip for work Oct 4-6. The area is very walk able. I got on yelp before my trip and read about the cemetery views , so upon check in I asked for a room that wasn't a cemetery view... I regret it. My alternative was the fire station view (and sounds). I struggled staying awake  during the days and could.not.sleep. at night. Just not the idea place for a hotel honestly. Friendly staff. Small hotel. The hotel food was so-so... drinks were decently priced and strong enough for a mommy who was extremely homesick.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I have always wanted to try white castle.  Now having tried them, I realize I wasnt missing out on anything!  I had 4 sliders and onion rings. I can feel it sitting in my stomach and want to just hurl it back out.  The burgers just tasted not good.  I actually do enjoy fast food so it's not like I am health nut or anything.  I just could not find anything tasty about these burgers.   

I did take off the top bun so they were open face.  That helped a little bit but I had to drink a ton of water to erase the taste from my mouth.  Then I followed it up with lots of fresh vegetables.    

In-N-out still is my go to for fast food burgers.

The sushi was actually pretty decent. This surprised me, as I wasn't expecting much.

I was eager to taste my friend's beef teriyaki, as it looked scrumptious, but it unfortunately turned out to be bland and overcooked, with a miniscule amount of teriyaki sauce. I asked for a side of extra sauce for my friend and it was served to us cold and clumpy.

In addition to the bad beef, the service was terrible. We were rushed to finish our food and pay the bill. They seemed almost angered that we were there in the first place. Not cool.

The first review said it all....it was exactly what I expect from a hampton inn ....great beds...really good breakfast....yes I too had trouble finding the hotel at first as well.  And in response to the comment about being made uncomfortable, when I checked in I was asked to sign a form stating I wasn't going to have a party. I am here on business....I checked in with luggage and my laptop by myself,and paid  with an amex....I don't think I was going to party...but apparently it seems they have that problem there.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Saw an article about this place and decided to give it a try. The place was packed about 1 pm when I went in. I took a long time for food, luckily I wasn't in a hurry. I tried the gringa especial and it was packed full of meet and cheese. Very good. Can't wait to come back for some tacos el pastor, they're  specialty. The owner come over after the rush and apologized for the wait and explained that 2 of his employees just walked out during the lunch rush. This was only the second day open. Give them some time to get the staff up to speed and they'll be fine. Food is great.

They have the best tonkatsu ramen here--best hangover cure!   Their pork slices were very tender, juicy, and the fatty part of the meat was jelly-like, it was so delicious.   I wasn't sure where the best place to get ramen would be because there aren't any ramen restaurants here in SB, but this is it!  

I know most people aren't thinking of ordering ramen when they come here, but it's a must-have.  The broth is on the creamy silky side.  The noodles tasted fresh and were cooked to perfection. 

It cured my hangover this morning.  Definitely better than Pho!

Lady in store at 715, doesn't unlock door.  She is using all the front loaders, Or plans to, as if she has them reserved. When I go to use a front loader, she tells me to move.  Talks back to me when I refuse to use another washer.  Then she moves her clothes to another washer and throws the clothes - underwear and socks - over washers about ten feet, like she is sorting. 

She was drunk or on some drugs.  Rudest person I've met in Reno.  Would highly recommend not using this location. She should be fired, in my opinion.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Wanted to stop by for some Mexican on the way to Los Angeles. And this place was a simple mistake. Took almost 45 min to bring out 3 meals with only 3 tables being served. The fish tacos were okay. The fish was cooked right but it was extremely boring and bland. My cousin had a tostada which was almost purely lettuce with little to no cheese or beans on the bottom. Not worth it if you can appreciate a good Mexican dish. The food was also barely warm. The plates should come out hot from the oven. Disappointed in the overall service and food of this place.

Really enjoyed this small, 20 seat BYOB place. We had their Sunday night wine dinner for $40 which included five courses of tasty food...highlights of our meal included a warm, silky cauliflower soup; amazing ravioli stuffed with ricotta & parsnips; a steak with roasted parsnips, purple carrots, and turnips; and lastly -- the best dish of the meal -- pot de creme with praline and caramel. OMG! This meal was an incredible bargain for the five courses. 

Couple of things to note -- reservations are highly recommended and they are cash only.

I wanted to give this car wash 5 stars until the wash finished and there was no dryer! I used the automatic car wash and chose the most expensive option which was $9 (thinking it would be on par with circle k or other decent automatic car washes). The water pressure was great and cleaned my car well. The disappointing part was there was no dryer option. I've never encountered this before. My windshield was so wet that I had to use my wipers in order to see throw the window. The wipers created streaks which defeats a main part of a car wash.

Great apartment complex!  I had a bad experience at Quail Ridge Apartments down the street and came to Linda upset but she was incredibly helpful and accommodating and I found myself glad that my other apartment did not work out.  Not only is the management staff warm, welcoming, and helpful, but these apartments are much larger than many in the area and the second story places have high ceilings.  If you're looking for a great affordable apartment in the Catalina Foothills definitely check this complex out!

This is one of the best coffee shops I've been to, it had all the things I've come to look for after living on the road for 5 months.

-Good Coffee
-Good Seating
-Great WiFi
-Friendly Service

I ordered the Almond Joy mocha ($4.50 for 16 oz) after reading a good review on here, and it was delicious. It was exactly what I needed to charge through an afternoon of work. I stayed until close and got a free coffee, which I was told was delicious. Gave it to a coworker who enjoyed it.

I'm planning on going back today!

Thank you so much for taking great care of our belongings!  We are on vacation and to be able to drop off laundry here, enjoy our day, and come back to clean things was a gift!  It saved me three hours at a laundromat or hundreds at our hotel. I would 100% use them again!!!

***Make sure you ask for anything you need hung gets separated from the bag, and make it clear. e.g., workout fabrics, include anything that might shrink in a hot dryer in that category!!  I had a few shrinkage issues!! And a white tank top is now tinged blue and not white.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
I'm being generous with this rating. BEWARE and be sure you are clear about which pedicure you want. My friend and I were in town on business and popped in for a pedicure. We both CLEARLY indicated which one we wanted from the menu ... it was a $45 thing with lots of bells and whistles. When we were done they told us it would be $60 ... that we had somehow chosen the most expensive pedicure. Nope. Not gonna happen. 
We paid $45. Businesses that think they can get away with this crap are slimy and I'll have nothing to do with them. 
The actual pedicure was average.

I can't say enough great things about Dinah and her service. She is precisely what a neighborhood  laundry service should be. She knows most of her customers by name and gives personalised service to many of them.
She has great.prices and on-time delivery of everything she promises. She will even text you when your order is ready.
If that wasn't enough, she also gives awesome dog treats, as well as love & affection, to all.pups that walk by. My Corgi, Shorty, literally drags me to her door during walks.
Bravo!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
This is a must stop for me when I travel to Reno to visit my mother. Sorry mom, I didn't get stuck in the snow last time, it just took a little  longer to find the bottles I put on hold....
Although their main focus is California, but wines from other countries are well picked out. I often find small producers from CA which is already sold out or allocated at K & L or The Wine Club here in the city. The staff is very knowledgeable and friendly. Get to know the owner, he might even let you see his private cellar...

Stayed here for a week while on a recent business trip. Centrally located across from a gigantic mall.  Accommodations are what you'd expect from a Hyatt. Spacious clean room. Mattress and linens were average but all fresh. Very nice & helpful front desk staff. The bartender wasn't very attentive and the food was just ok. The omelette station was good but the coffee at the morning breakfast was bad. Like really bad & not even hot. I'm a coffee person so normally I'd remove a star for bad coffee BUT they are a pet friendly establishment so they get to keep the extra star lol 
I'd stay here again for convenience and cleanliness.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Good tacos but werent fantastic. Asada was alright but not a lot of flavor, drowned it in chile. Adobada was pretty good. Chicken was terrible! Took 2 bites to give it a chance but it was BAD. Had a weird rotten sweet taste. 

The salsa bar was pretty good. All the salsa was good especially the dark one which what i used to drench the tacos. Radishes, onion and cilantro was available too.

All in all not a terrible place but probably wouldn't return. There's so many other great taco spots.

Oh, order yourself some grilled onions. ($1)

I was recommended this place while visiting St Louis, by the Sauce Magazine editor.  How thankful I was for the heads up!  This is an excellent bistro with French fusion gourmet.  I absolutely adored the beet salad.  The atmosphere was very comfortable yet upscale and service was wonderful.

They really promote their "chees bread", but really I found it unremarkable.  The liquid chocolate cake was absolutely to die for!!!!  I have to admit the scallop appetizer was quite dry, but the rest of our food was delicious!!!

Hotel gets 3 stars only for its location. Stayed in room 827 which is located at the end of the building so it was great because the only noise we heard was our neighbors banging. Hilarious! I think the hotel is doing constitution because you could hear them working on the floor above us in the morning. 

The front desk staff is super friendly. We were able to have a late check out for free. I don't really have anything bad to say about this hotel. We stayed here because of its location. We didn't care to spend more $ on a better hotel since we weren't spending much time in the room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The rooms are pretty well laid out and spacious which is a good thing.  The only real issue I had with my room was that the air conditioner had a slight rattle in it (I think it was room 510).  The plastic vent on it was broken so I think a piece fell in and that was what caused the rattle.

The front desk was very nice and helpful (I forgot my toothbrush and they gave me a free one) and they were able to give some good recommendations for food.  The pool was empty and the workout room was closed for the 2nd day of my trip because of the remodel.

The breakfast was on par with what you'd expect at a hotel of its price but nothing that great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: WORST SUBWAY EVER!!!! DO NOT GO HERE! I have given this place plenty of chances but I am tired of giving my money to this pile of garbage . The lady who works here is rude , lazy and cant even make a sandwich. The male owner is WAY worse. I have the lowest standards humanly possible when I arrive and they manage to screw that up. I feel like I was stolen from. The do not fill the ingredients to subways standards. They skimp on everything so badly that its ONLY BREAD. The ingredients are old, slimy and gross. GET A GRIP. Is there a Subway hotline I can report these scam artists to???

Some of the best tacos I've ever had! They keep it simple, which is the best! Lots of different meats to choose from: steamed, grilled, etc. and then there is a big bar for you to add on all your condiments...cilantro, onions, limes, different salsas, and lightly pickled radish. All of it makes for some of the best tacos that will have you coming back. 

Definitely a grab and grub place, everything is served on plastic plates, tables aren't cleaned super often and the customer turnaround is really fast. A must stop for everyone in Santa Barbara!

This place well defines Philadelphia. The people are unhappy, the prices are in an indirect correlation to the value for the goods, and they trap you because the place next door is even worse. We really wanted to have a relaxed meal after one of those brutal travel days and it only added fuel to the fire by stopping in here. You will see it too. If you have to stay at the DT Hawthorne Suites and it is after 7 pm - you will be here. I hope for your sanity that you get through it and thank your lucky stars that you don't have to live in this part of the country.

So fresh and so clean.

As soon as you walk into the hotel it smells of apples.  Not a hint of smoke anywhere.  We opened the door to our room and were in awe.  Beautiful modern rooms, fresh clean air, clean carpets, clean beds, you just gathered a sense of cleanliness.  It was nicely decorated too.  

Free breakfast buffet with eggs, waffles, breakfast sandwiches, cheese, cups of fruit and the all the other usual items, except they had biscuits and gravy too.  Did you read me?  BISCUITS AND GRAVY and it was good.  It was just what I was craving.

Room prices are a steal (but don't tell management that).
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
La Colombe has come to some new recognition because of their canned lattes (I tried one from Trader Joe's, I'll admit it was surprisingly delicious), but the actual cafe somehow stands up to the hype.

They have a pretty simple menu and a good selection of pastries. The set up for this coffee bar was kind of awkward (its in the lobby of some kind of financial building?) but there are some seats and wifi for working.

I got a latte and thought it was decent - foam was not too creamy and the espresso came through. 

Recommend if you're walking around and need to take a quick coffee break before braving the liberty bell.

The two stars are due to my bathroom being dirty. Like I grabbed a towel and it was filthily type of dirty. I've stayed here before but don't remember it being that bad

I will say this Asia and the front desk staff took care of me the whole Labor Day weekend so that was cool. That's why I even had two stars to give. 

The tv is HD but the signal is SD, such a rookie mistake. The (free) wifi sucked like crazy but what hotel wifi doesn't suck. 

Also let it be known I travel at least 30% of the year I'm not bashing this hotel just giving an honest opinion. The actual room is cool just like a regular hotel I guess. But could be way better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The employees here just flat out suck. Arrogant, overly sensitive, incredibly rude, manipulative and mean spirited.  One guy made me beg for my car (literally) because he was upset that that I was sarcastic with him.  If he's this sensitive to criticism he should get another job, preferably one that doesn't involve interacting with other human beings.  So it's Avis all the way now. Haven't rented a hertz vehicle in thee months. And the cars, old, hi miles, dirty inside, reminded me of the counter staff.  Don't rent from Hertz in Tucson, any other rental company is far better.

Only if it's 3 am and there are no other options, and you are really drunk.   I ordered one of their interesting sounding gourmet pizzas, and the unedible nachos.  What the hell are those nachos?   The pizza, I kid you not, was raw, and not even cut into slices.  I have never had that in my life, and I am 40.    
It was as if a new guy made my order in 4 seconds, blindfolded and high.     It took 1.5 hrs to get there, and was 23 bucks, plus the 3 I thipped the driver.  Driver was really nice, and apologized for the delay.   
Unacceptable.  Lucky for them, they were my only option.

I have had the opportunity to eat very good Japanese food and this fell short.  I went with my mother and a little girl who loves Udon.  I will say the Udon in broth was decent and the portion seemed to be large with the proteins.  The other dishes however were lacking.  The salmon was dry and the other dish had far too much sauce on it.  It was smothered in sauce and ruined the flavor.  We did not try the sushi that day because we were in the mood for something else, and I have a feeling I was glad we didnt since that food did not turn out well.  I also thought the waitress was rude.

would rather have slept in my car. not worth the drive from center city to get to it; crowded, loud, and mismanaged. pool area was unsupervised, I witnessed children falling on wet floors. check in system went down at check in had to be escorted up to room. I asked for a quiet room. first room I got was facing the parking valet, and you could hear everything. So they moved me to a floor that had a fraternity convention, teens were up all night. security did nothing. will avoid this brand of hotels for the near while.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
You have to have the right mindset to enjoy Amicis.  If you enjoy going to a hole in the wall unique environment, then you'll enjoy Amicis - it's definitely unique. Otherwise you'd probably prefer a fancier Italian restaurant. The building is older  (looks historic, actually) and the interior design makes it look more like a Mexican restaurant. Also, there's a lot of handwritten signs that give it character. I used a Groupon and am glad that I did. The price is a bit high for the quality of the food. Nevertheless, the bread is really good and tastes homemade. 

The service was excellent.

Hotel is a bit remote, but quiet. Staff is friendly and accommodating, but not very knowledgeable. Rooms are average size for this mid-tier category property. 

The room cleanliness was meh and as they state the hotel was recently renovated--elements proved the contrary. There was a sticky stain on the carpet, the towels were a mix of brights white and clearly old grey (although they were supposed to be white), the sheets were tattered, the bathroom was not cleaned well. Parking and wifi are free. Not a full service hotel as there were no bell staff. Rates are reasonable and the water pressure in the shower was fabulous!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I would have to say O'Bistro is hit or miss. My first time going to the restaurant I ordered soup and crab cakes. The soup was delicious and the crab cakes were horrible. They didn't taste like crab or any other kind of seafood for that matter. 

I went in April 2013 and the food was great! I ordered pecan crusted chicken and it comes with mac and cheese with andouille sausage. The chicken didn't taste like pecans but it was still good. The mac and cheese was amazing! Oh and my waitress was phenomenal. I would go again but I am definitely sticking to what I know when it comes to ordering.

This place is a gem of a shop. They've worked on both Audi and Volvo for me and every experience has been A+. Always done well and very timely...never feel like I'm being up sold. Shop rate matches or beats any other place I've called. On top of all that, they do little odds-and-ends maintenance without charge...Top off fluids, air in tires, overall inspection, etc. They even replaced a headlamp without my asking (I had purchased a bulb to do myself. It was sitting in the car).
Overall good folks who run a trustworthy shop.

Had three special rolls and 12 pcs sashimi. Not too bad considering that we were consuming this sushi in the middle of the desert. They give you free miso soup - little salty - and ice cream after your meal. How nice of them!

Sashimi was alright. Some of the pieces were very slightly frozen but yet still good. Wasn't the best out there but had enough flavor to enjoy. The rolls were small in portion but still good. 

For the price I paid, the quality and the quantity of the food, and the service was a tad bit subpar. Maybe it was bc we went there two days before Christmas... 

3.5 stars, rounded up to 4

Stayed here for my birthday and met with family. The hotel initially gave us the wrong room, so we had to switch rooms. The bathroom wasn't the cleanest, it smelled like urine and had hair on the bathroom floor and all of our showers were clogged. The one room had a leaky window which soaked their luggage and the other room did not have a comforter. The breakfast was very expensive and the wait staff was horrible. I didn't think we even had a server since no one came to our table until we were halfway finished. Everyone at the front desk was very nice and so was Ronny who helped us get a new room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
My boyfriend and I recently relocated here from out of state and love it. So far so great! Our apartment has a lot of space and storage and we love that we have a connecting garage. Gym is big and a great perk! The views from our apartment are gorgeous too. No parking problems or anything we can really complain about. Rent prices seem fair (though their pet fees seem a little steep) but we're really happy with our decision. 

Note: Before moving here I read HUNDREDS of reviews about this place. Beware of people who are upset about feeling cheated about anything. Its a great place for someone looking to relocate - would highly recommend =)

Negative: 
Shuttle pick up and drop off are very SLOW. Managers- if you read this which I doubt, this is the major issue. I almost missed my flight waiting for the shuttle. The 2nd time, the nice front desk lady told me that I can just cross the street to garage D and walk over! Only took 5min max- a lot faster than waiting for that shuttle! 

Possitive:

Cars condition and reservation/ billing- all great and convenient.

Now (since Mar20, 2017), Gold members can just walk to Gold zone and pick whichever cars they want. No more preassigned car. Not a wide selection when I arrived so not sure about this "new and exciting" option

Just had dinner and drinks at gio's had michaela and Matt as servers and they were fabulous! attentive conversationalists, and quick to serve and address any issues. Also had Ashley as a server and would definitely recommend requesting another if possible. She was snide, rude, and quick to fake smile and insult! Great pizza, affordable wine, and would most definitely come here again UNLESS Ashely was our server. So when in doubt! Go for it but avoid Ashley at all costs. She was a great way to leave a sour taste in your mouth.

I read a lot of different reviews of this hotel, this is my experience:

Easy to get to from the Airport, and there is a garage attached to the hotel. I fit a Durango in there no problem. The check in was easy, very courteous staff, and the room was clean. There is a Starbucks right off the lobby and they take the hotel vouchers for coffee. They have a club level which had good enough food every morning and evening... The showers were clean, hot, and good water pressure.. WiFi worked and was free for me anyway, I mean I really can't complain.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Overall a pretty decent mexican eatery.  

Decor is classic Mexican and is the same you will see everywhere else.  An occasional guitar player (even at lunch) can add to the ambiance.  Acceptable for sure.

The food is some of the best of its genre.  Mexican food can only go so far and Estela's seems to take it as far as it can go.  Good chips and salsa to start with an option for queso which is also pretty good.  The prices are fair and the portions are favorable and the food is delicious.  I have only had the basic options but they are all above average.

Had a late dinner here today. Got the tempura udon and the unagi don. Udon soup stock was a little salty but the udon was good, thick and juicy. The tempura was fried just right.

But they made a grave mistake with the unagi don. Forget about the fact that the unagi was smothered in sauce, masking the quality of the fish. The grave mistake has to do with how the rice was prepared. Who the hell uses long grain rice in their unagi don. It's like putting the fish on minute-rice. Dry, hard to chew, not cooked enough rice. Just turrible.

But the pickle on the unagi don was made perfectly. 2 stars.

I stayed here for a conference which was also held here. I don't recommend it. The room was in major need of an update for how much they charge. The shower was badly chipped, it was plane as could be and worst of all the road noise was awful. It woke me up multiple times each night. In addition to this the food that they served during the conference was disgusting and made me have to leave my conference early due to making me sick. I gave them two stars because the location is good and the staff was nice. I would recommend staying elsewhere.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I can't speak for dinner or the club/bar scene, but I've been here several times for lunch; it's the Gorgonzola Cheese & Honey Balsamic Vinegarette Chips that keeps me coming back for more.  They're served hot and are surprisingly delicious (I didn't even think I liked strong cheeses).  Anyway, that being said, I recently went here last week and they've completely overhauled their lunch menu with new items.  It's inexpensive (again, I've only had lunch here) and we always sit outside for some great people-watching/atmosphere.

The place looks good. The food, however, not so much. I ordered the three fish tacos and they were pretty much flavorless. I was only able to taste the tortilla and the veggies. My plate had side servings of rice and beans, a staple of Mexican restaurants everywhere. It's not to difficult to mess these up, but this place manages to excel at it. The beans taste like the bean dip out of those little Frito Lay cans. The rice, in my opinion, tastes like instant rice that comes in a box you buy at grocery stores... the generic brand, not the good stuff. I won't be returning for the food at this place.

Hien is perhaps the most honest, down-to-earth, and knowledgeable mechanic I have ever used.  He insists on showing his customers the problem-identifying and problem-solving steps he uses, so that you feel confident in his diagnosis and solutions.  More than that, he knows cars inside and out-- and won't overcharge.  Heck, he's turned me away before saying that the repair wasn't necessary and would just be a money-sink.  I can't recommend him enough for car maintenance and repairs, and have been exceptionally happy with every visit.

I recommend him to everyone in Santa Barbara that I can.

Guess what? 

You can experience food from heaven here on  earth;  specifically here at this pizza shop for only $13.99 deluxe large to go on Thursday nights.

It's interesting because they don't even have the name out front. It is a small town  so everyone probably knows about it but who knew that this tiny storefront would house heavenly pizza?! 

I truly marvel at how outstanding it is!
 I drive about 25 miles to go here. 

Of course I make a day of it and the town is darling.

Please note though the pizza shop is tiny you wouldn't want to dine in; I think they have maybe 2 or 3 tables but suit yourself. I take mine  num,num,num to go.

Conveniently located a short walking distance from the French Quarter, this hotel is great! 

My family and I stay here often for the Saints games and the staff is always friendly, the rooms are always clean, and the free breakfast is awesome!! 

The breakfast has tons of food to choose from and its all hot n fresh :) the hotel bar also make great drinks and the concierge will put you on the right path to anywhere you wanna go. 

This adorable and uniquely designed hotel also offers FREE WiFi!! Yay! 

For the price you really cant beat this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I would not recommend this apartment complex to anyone, not even my worst enemy.  If it snows you will have to slip on the snow until it melts because no one will remove it.  They will charge you an extra fee for a view.  The pond is listed at a feature but that thing will be completely green and covered with algae by May and it looks absolutely disgusting.  If you have a problem with a neighbor you will have to complain 7 times, call the police, and then maybe something will be done, but good luck. NEVER, EVER LIVE IN THIS COMPLEX.  There are too many that are in the same area that are comparable in cost to settle for this place.

My pictures tell it all  dirty sheets outside rooms from about 7p-8am; door latch didn't line up so couldn't use the lock, faucet handle and stopper broken; missing towel bar, damaged closet door; purchased a room with club access- I called the hotel before booking to ask what was included and to make sure it included alcoholic drinks. The Hotel said yes to alcohol, appetizers &  breakfast. We got one very small glass of wine and were told if we wanted another one we would have to pay for it. We had a drink in the lobby bar and the service was horrible. I did notify the front desk and they offered no apology or remedies.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
My favorite place to eat when in the area! Love it here!

Recently dined and the decor was very festive! Put me in the holiday spirit!
I had the ravioli with ricotta cheese, dark chocolate, orange zest, and carmalized pears and it was delish!!! Cant stop thinking about how they perfectly paired those flavors and it actually worked!!  I also love that they have different specials every week. So, there is always something new on the menu. 
Service was great! Staff was very friendly! Instantly seated.
Lots of parking and bar is nice for meeting friends for drinks.

The crust is to die for!
Quick visit from SoCAL visiting my bf Cousin who are locals here.

Food: crispy crust, great sauce, lots of love went into this dough. Self serving on soft drinks. Also have vegan options, beer and wine selections.

Decor': modern, hip, great design,  you have your menu on a lighted up screen, open kitchen behind the cashiers, so you definitely see all the action going on with your food.
Tables for seating inside and outdoor seating as well with a Zen garden and heating lamps for those cold nights. 

Service: quick. Helpful

Nice local spot for some good pizza!

Service: quick and easy.

I normally hate/dread going to car places because I always feel like I'm going to get ripped a new one. 

This time, I only needed to get tires balanced. They quoted 60-75 minutes for a wait time, and it was right around 60. Took another 45 minutes or so to balance my 4 tires. Only reason for 4 stars is they apparently misplaced my paperwork, so customers that came in after got to go ahead. But hey, stuff happens right? They were exremely friendly and their prices are fairly standard. 

If you live in the area, this place is definitely recommended.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I was hesitant given how low the price was on an event weekend. Other hotels were double the price. 
However, I was pleasantly surprised by this hotel. The staff was incredibly kind and friendly. The location was perfect and close to everything. The room was clean and spacious given how small the building appears from the outside.
