Only complaints were a tub that wouldn't drain and hard bed. Wouldn't recommend if you are looking for a pool to enjoy. The pool was tiny. We weren't there to swim, so no biggie for us. Valet isn't included in room stay and cost an extra $30.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: What a great cool spot on chestnut street, the place is big with two floors, we came here Friday night and Sunday for brunch. The drinks were really good and different I got the peddlers buzz whiskey, cold brew coffee, milk and vanilla syrup so creative and it was so delicious, the food service was excellent. I was glad we caught Sunday brunch, cause all we did was eat, smoke house wings, salmon toast, Mac and cheese awesome, cheese board too oh how can i forget the sweet potato fries drizzled with molasses ,for sure I will be back again to visit this great restaurant.

Be prepared to wait. The don't appear to be properly staffed. And don't try to use the automated kiosks, those are a total waste of time. It didn't seem that Hertz had planned their shifts appropriately to take care of the influx of people arriving on a Wednesday night. Strange, but true that this was a busy night. It was also apparant that only one employee had the access to offer cars and special arrangements to the customers. The other counter-help was indeed helpless in getting customers into their cars and on their way. A truely unfortunate experience that will not soon be repeated at the PHL Hertz because we won't be renting there.

Whoever owns and operates the business next door has the most rude customer service I have ever experienced from a person of color in the city of Nashville ! He patronized his lesser melanin guest as they entered his business but almost denied my friend and I of a parking space that wasn't properly marked handicap as he claimed it was . What a disgust to be yelled at by a man especially a man whose business we were going to support ! Get your customer service together and parking under control because gentrification waits for NO ONE !!

Came there for the second time, wanting to give them another chance after my first experience wasn't the greatest. Attempted calling a couple times before coming, no answer. I live around the block so i decided to just see if they had any available walk ins. I wasn't greeted by anyone when i walked in and no one else was seated, waiting to be seen. I sat down and smiled and politely waited, and waited, and waited. Nearly 45 minutes went by and no one had even greeted me still. Two other women walked in and sat and were seen within minutes. I will never go there again, as the customer service was obsolete. I do not recommend.

The best thing about this place is the location, earned it the second star. As a history nerd, I really appreciate the area a lot and enjoy walking around when not working.
Otherwise, the staff aren't the warmest, the beds aren't the comfiest, and the cleanliness is lacking at best. My bathroom had dirty towels hanging and a shredded roll of toilet paper. The desk is scratched up quite a bit - not a big deal at all, but with the bathroom situation it stands out a lot. 
Not sure I'd stay again. The bar was nice at least.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Do not stay here. The hotel immediately smells like some type of some type of bad fragrant food  as the bar is right behind the front desk. Our hotel room had a lot of humidity in it and the AC unit leaked. I'm not sure how long the unit was leaking but I'm severely allergic to mold. Myself and my husbands eyes were red and swollen, turns out I have pink eye and I didn't have it before I came here. I alerted staff so I guess they'll fix the issue after I leave. I stayed two days and couldn't take anymore so I checked out and went to another hotel for another evening.

The breakfast isn't free either!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If I could give negative stars I would!! Do not rent for this company. I was over charged $600 for additional days and late fees because they lost the car !! The car was returned per the contract, the attendant shouted leave the keys, walk left and get on the shuttle to the air port. Now they state the car wasn't returned and express "they are sure it's uncomfortable for us being charge $600". Really uncomfortable !? Looking at other post they are and have been know to do this to other renters/travelers !  Still no refund even though I sent my boarding pass and all the contract info !!!

Moved to the area almost two years ago, tried multiple salons before I found this one and haven't gone anywhere else since! Always busy which is a great sign, I book an appointment every 2 weeks and have never had a problem with waiting. I go to the same technician every time (Le Van) and I love her. She always makes sure I have a great experience and that I'm happy with my nails/wax. I've sent family members and friends here and they love it. Very friendly staff and well kept salon. Came on Mother's Day and they had a complimentary Mimosa Bar!  Definitely recommend. 

Only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because I wish they were open later ;)

Whoa....what you'd expect from an old Holiday Inn. Location is not the best. Somewhat industrial area walking distance to downtown core. Room rate was JACKED WAY UP due to convention in town. $400+ for a room. Typically qould be maybe 150ish? Neither remote for tv or microwave worked. Property not well cared for, dirty broken rail in elevator just not upkept well overall. Room itself was clean otherwise would be 1 star. Not happy with my limited choice. Bummed out with the property. Would not stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I had a dip ombré done last month and it was absolutely incredible - they did such a great job! When I came back to remove my acrylics and do the dazzle polish, I felt like the my nails were super lumpy looking and was hoping they would be fixed but they weren't touched up at all and I was sent home. I already had to put a top layer of polish to "fix" them and not even 1 day went by and all my nails are chipping when the dazzle polish is supposed to last even longer. 

I'm so disappointed because the staff were super attentive and nice but I have an event this weekend and have to do something with them now.

I'm not sure what has happened since Marriott became Monvoy but this is my 2nd bad experience in 2 weeks. Magnolia is the biggest disappointment at a Marriott property yet. Room not cleaned, discarded dishes in hallway for two days, torn carpets, front desk complaining about "black rappers" in front of hotel, broken tv, and overall poorly maintained property. When I inquired about the lack of maid service, I was told "we are overbooked and understaffed". Offered free drink tickets, delivered free breakfast coupon with some clean towels. Unbelievable. Maybe time to go back to Hilton. Oh yeah, I'm "Titanium Elite". Should have stayed at Motel 6.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I just checked in about 3 hours ago and my experience has been not so good thus far. The room is old and worn and not clean (thick dust on the shelf with my towels!).  The restaurant is just weird...I walked in and was ignored until I walked up to a lady who looked like she worked here and requested service, and she got me a server.  The staff is nice just maybe poorly trained.  I am laying in bed right now...it's 10pm and housekeeping is outside my room vacuuming and noisily cleaning the room next door. I am not a happy guest.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Beautiful new hotel in Downtown Nashville and only minutes to the Convention Center/Bridgestone arena/Broadway. Staff is extremely friendly and helpful. They exude southern hospitality. Complimentary fruit-infused water and coffee available 24/7 near the front desk. Rooms are beautifully decorated and very clean. I loved that the room had a microwave, mini-fridge and a Keurig coffeemaker which made it more convenient to have a cup of joe anytime. My only gripe about the room is that they seem to have forgotten to install towel hooks/racks so nowhere to hang wet towels for later use. Overall, I had a wonderful stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I come to this Starbucks enough to know when a bad experience moves from once in a while to consistent. It seems that some of the employees have changed so perhaps this has led to a change in efficiency level. Several times I have made a mobile order only to have to ask them to retrieve it from the printer five minutes after the order was made. I saw one woman waiting 10 minutes on one occasion. These are not during busy or backed up periods. Most recently, it took them 7 minutes to make tea though when I walked in there were only 1-2 drinks on the bar and no one in line....They just hadn't checked their mobile order que.

This Dunkin' Donuts is close to my house BUT unfortunately it is slow and filled with insanely rude staff. The manager needs an attitude and reality check. There was a new young girl working cashier (mind you it is thanksgiving day and she is NEW) the manager was yelling in her face and telling her that she was doing everything wrong in front of the customers. A majority of the staff is not very friendly... and the manager on staff today's departure...  ( a young girl with dark hair and piercings) may be the key to their success.

Food: 2/5 stars
Airport food sometimes good sometimes not so good. It tastes ok, skimpy on filling, not skimpy on price. Cheesesteak was very dry. Bun was microwave hard. Cheese was meh.

Atmosphere: 3/5 stars
Open bar next to dining area. Loud music. 

Service: 3/5 stars
Quick and friendly enough but not attentive. Waitress dropped lemon wedge. Oh shoot. Flustered. Walked away without cleaning up.

Expense: 2/5 stars
Very few airport restaurant deliver on value. This one was no exception.

Return: 1/5 stars
If I'm very hungry and passing by again I might. But again might not.

Visited Nashville for a Bachelorette party and made a reservation for our party of 12.  This place was perfect for the occasion. It felt like a beautiful upscale trendy non-pretentious bar, except it doubles as a nail salon.  Perfect combo.  The BYO concept is great - they provided us with champagne glasses and did a really cute set up with the bottles we brought, and also gave us a complimentary bottle of wine. Everyone who worked here was very friendly, and paid excellent attention to detail - we were all satisfied with our manis and pedis.  This place is amazing, please open one in Chicago!

Returned a car here recently on a one way rental from La Guardia. Traffic was really bad, and we weren't sure if we were going to make it before 7pm closing time, so we called the office and they said they'd stay open for us until we got there. After we dropped the car off (entrance is thru the parking garage on Broad, just south of the Bellevue hotel front entrance), Emad Eid was very helpful. We forgot to fill the car back up with gas and he waited for us, even later, to go back out and fill it so we didn't have to pay extra. At checkout, he also helped us find a discount on the rate. Overall good experience.

I live just around the corner (less than .5 miles away) and will never go there again. I am surprised they are still in business. The owner and managers should be ashamed.. Numerous times the ice machine is not working, food prepared badly and always cold and the staff are incredibly rude and give the impression they hate working there! I drive 3 miles to the next store by Einstein Hospital who have polite staff, machines are always functional and food better prepared. Trust me when I say spend the extra 5 mins in the car and go to the other McDonald's.. it will be worth it!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Had my birthday celebration there tonight,  food is always excellent.  Our server was great.  Only one issue my dinner was given to another table and the birthday boy had to wait 20 minutes to eat after the other 5 in our party was finished.  Server did apologize.  Would have expected manager to come over and apologize and offer me a drink or something while I waited but that never happened.  Should have went with our first choice of Mortons.  Would have never happened there nor would the manager have ignored it.

I totally agree with the other reviewers here - Sapori is delicious, the food is fresh, well-prepared and Chef Franco (as well as the other staff) are friendly and gracious.

Having moved to the area from San Francisco a couple of years ago I am always on the lookout for spots whose service and quality rival what we left behind and Sapori certainly fits the bill.  Try it - you won't be disappointed - and if you are, Franco will fix it.

As with all of the restaurants (and some of the shops too!) in Collingswood, Sapori is BYOB.

I called the restaurant directly to place a to go order. I had my son pick it up. When he got home we were missing a burrito. Usually not a big deal as they usually make it right. The manager was extremely rude when I called to let them know. I told him I would have my husband run down and just get a refund. When my husband got there the manager argued and said we should take this up with Uber eats even though my son picked it up. He essentially called us liars saying he made the burrito and it was in the bag for sure! I will never order from here again.

pros:
1). Love their lobby decor
2). Studio suite Room was clean and quiet
3). Very close to valley forge - a must stop if you stayed at this hotel
4) large modern bathroom
5) short drive to many stores including Cheesecake Factory and the mall
6). Friendly receptionists both check-in and check-out

Cons:
1) sofa bed has springs (daughter couldn't sleep at night, had backache afterward)
2) breakfast - not many choices, bacon taste weird, no waffle maker :((

Taking a star off for the sofa bed, but will definitely stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We were looking for a place in Reno kind of last minute and this place had a vacancy. I requested lower level and got that. Room was clean. The biggest problem was a loveseat that was shoved into the room between the door and the dresser so every time we went out and came back we had to turn slightly.  Hubby actually cut his leg in the edge. The lady in the lobby who appeared to be the owner was very quiet and with her Indian accent was hard to hear and understand. Toward the back part of the property there seemed to be either homeless or vagrants staying there; kind of trashy. But for the price it was okay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Nancy fixed my blunt, think, medium-length hair that I really needed to trim. I'm growing my hair out from a very extreme bob that was cut to the middle of my jawline. 

Before the cut, she gave me a moisturizing hair treatment along with a scalp massage. It was very relaxing and the treatment was effective! My hair is more soft & shiny without being greasy. 

The cut itself is great. I have a lot of hair and Nancy took the weight off without compromising the length! 

It was also nice that the s gave me a new customer gift with a sample shampoo & conditioner :)

The staff here was very friendly, and handled everything efficiently. We stopped a little later than we had anticipated (11 pm their time) and the staff handled everything like we were checking in the early evening. Very pleasant.
The rooms was nice, everything appeared clean and tidy, and the bed was comfortable. The free hot breakfast was good, with the usual fare of waffle, eggs, biscuits and gravy, cereals, fruit, yogurt, assorted breads and bagels, and juice. It was pleasant and tasted good.
A good value for the money, close to the highway, and clean and comfortable.
I would stop here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I stay here every time I come to Nashville. Never had a problem. This time I woke up to bed bugs! !!!! Totally grossed out! !!! Is this the marriott or an inn somewhere? ?? The clerk completely apologized and told me since my rate was already discounted he could only give me 20 bucks off my room.  He also said to email him when I return and he will see what he can do. I will not be returning!  Bed bugs, rats, roaches are intolerable and to not comp my entire stay is a slap in the face. Marriott last a loyal customer today!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is the worst Mexican food I have ever had in the state of Arizona. I had the California burrito and it really sucked. The carne asada was horrible. It was bland and tough. The worst part about this pathetic burrito was the French fries that were actually just boiled potatoes. They were tossed in at one end like a giant clump of boiled limp potatoes. It was really disappointing because I was starving and looking forward to some good Mexican food. I also had a beef taco and that was average at best. With so many good Mexican resteraunts in Tucson there is really no reason to go to this one. Save you're money and do better somewhere else.

I have to agree with most posts abt this place! I just recently moved to the area and although this location is very close to my house, I much rather drive else where because my order is always wrong or missing something.. Coffee is never made the same way.. Always tastes different than the time before. Not necessarily better! Employees are NOT welcoming or friendly and I also had the "pleasure" to meet the owner and wasnt friendly to me as well plus I heard him being rude to one of his employees.. Just plain wrong stuff all around this place.. Need new owner, employees etc.. New everything! Till then, I will be going else where! Cheers

I hope they improve or others read these yelp reviews.  this was a airport tip off i should have avoided......
Customer SERVICE & customer service : A+
* STAFF VERY FRIENDLY-ATTENTIVE
Price: D- Beer over priced I wouldn't of ordered 1 let alone 2 beers if I would have known I was paying $12 for12 ounce draft
Quality: not a lot of meat on the subs I ordered extra bacon and peppers and it was not close to filling up the hoagie roll.
Quanity for the price: D-
Taste: C not bad but not immpressed

Pretty bad when fast food is better then a sit down resteraunt.  JERSEY MIKES NO WORRIES FOR COMPETITION HERE.

Came here to celebrate an anniversary and the waitress could not have paid less attention to us. Took almost 15 minutes for the waitress to come
over and speak to us after being seated. I had to rely on the runners walking by to place drink orders and help with our meal. My boyfriends appetizer came out almost 10 minutes before mine. Once our meals came out, the waitress never asked how it was but was continuously seen walking by to check on other tables. Very disappointed, but the runner who helped us should be promoted and deserves the tips.

Jammed packed every day & long lines. Thank goodness for the Starbucks app! If you are an avid Starbucks goer, why in the world would you not have the app!? A dislike per this store is they do not have decaf brewed eliminating a quick half caf for us sensitive to caffeine. One employee told me, "We don't make a profit from decaf, so we don't brew it." I think that's crap along with the decaf Americana they offer you...when you're just looking for a quick half caf. Anyway...this needs to change & I look forward to the new store.

Stopped in for a bite to eat while on a layover in Philadelphia. The waitress was very nice. The food was mediocre at best. French fries were undercooked and soggy. The buffalo chicken philly was skimpy although had a decent flavor. The burger was overcooked and just average at best. The sweet chili boneless wings had next to no sweet chili sauce on them almost making them plain, naked boneless wings. A plus was that the draft beer was cold. Sorry, but not impressed with this place at all, and would not return or recommend. Definitely below average. 2 stars for cold beer and pleasant waitress.

Great, great location for the historical sites. Building is transitioning to a new owner so some things that need a upgrade are getting it. Terrible in-hotel dining choices. Nearest diner for breakfast was a coffee shop nearby (4 blocks). But great pool for taking afternoon breaks from historical touring. Shares the block with the burial ground for Benjamin Franklin (Christchurch burial ground), near Betsy Ross house. Wifi had problems on our 8th floor room. So while not super stylish, we found a great price for it on Priceline and were overall very happy once we found a breakfast nearby. Stayed with 2 adults and 2 teens.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: From the start check in took 2 hours, there were no rooms cleaned, or checked for availability. Finally was sorted out after an off duty manager showed up and checked us in at 10:30 PM. Our room was filthy and smelled of body odor, so we sprayed room freshener just to get through the night. Told the front desk to please deodorize our room, came back that afternoon to a filthy unclean room with a clogged toilet. Didn't even take a shit that day, so not sure how that happened. Took 2 hours for a plunger, so I finally went to Walgreens and purchased one. Sloppy staff, incompetent system and filthy rooms! Very disappointed!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've called this restaurant to deliver to my self and hotel guest alike. They are rude and short when ordering and make up various delivery charges to discourage people in the Brentwood area to order from them. This is one of two options that deliver late in the area and it's a shame that o wouldn't recommend them to my friends or customers because of their piss poor attitude and inflated delivery fees. They advertise one price online for their delivery and I was told that they would cancel my order if I booked online to get the more reasonable delivery fee.

Worst rental company I have ever worked with. Asked a customer service person before I rented the car if there was a penalty for returning the car early! He told me "NO"! So I went with Sixt as they had the lowest rate. Come to find out that in the fine print of the contract it says that if you return the car early, you will be charged a higher rate per day. If I would not have asked the question and been given the wrong answer, I would have thought "lesson learned"! Even if there was not a penalty per say, the guy could have said that there was an up charge if the car is returned early. I will never use this rental company again!

I reserved way back in March for August , a few weeks later plans changed , not only was I not allowed a free cancellation, I couldn't even change the dates without extra fees & charges. 
NEVER IN MY LIFE HAVE I HAD SUCH TROUBLE WITH A HOTEL. 
I will NEVER use this chain again & EVERY chance I get I WILL tell people this story ... there is still time to change this HORROR of an experience, just do the right thing & at least contact me and grant me a change of date on my reservations. 
#sheratondotherightthing
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Worst service I've ever recieved. Went in the day before and they said they were too busy so if I left it overnight they would get to it first thing in the morning. Then I decide to just bring it in around 8:30 (keep in mind they open at 8 and close at 5) they took all day to get to it. Then zi called them around 4:30-4:45 to see if they are almost done and they said I can come because it will be ready in. 10-15 min and I've been waiting almost an hour for my car. They are still not done and it's 6. It was just fixing a flat tire.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: If it weren't for the handful of friendly baristas here, I'd give this location one star. Otherwise it's quite possible the slowest, most inefficient Starbucks I've been to anywhere in the country. When the mobile order-ahead feature is working, it's still a 15min wait for my drink far too often. I've had my order made incorrectly more times than I can count, even on mobile orders that print out exactly what I'd like. They're constantly short-staffed, and have a much smaller kitchen/too few of equipment for a location this busy. This location needs a complete overhaul.

Ate lunch here the other day, while in town for a conference. Favorable reviews and walking distance to hotel led me to choose this restaurant from among three or four seemingly comparable choices.

In a nutshell, I thought it was great. Giant clam and Uni were not only on the menu, but available. The albacore was phenomenal, and they had sea eel, which isn't always available at many sushi bars. I had these, as well as their Yellowtail, also excellent. They had a number of rolls and specialty rolls that several fellow patrons ordered, but they're not my thing.

Highly recommend.

I was craving sushi but I didn't want to go out to eat I just wanted some take out. I came across this place on google searching sushi near me. The restaurant is adorable and the staff seemed nice while I was in there waiting on my take out. They have a take out special 4 rolls for $29 worked for me cause the 4 rolls I wanted would've been $40 I also ordered a hand roll for only $4, they messed up 3 of my rolls but tbh we didn't mine cause the just gave them to us yay free sushi! The HOT roll, the outback & the Godzilla roll are delicious we will definitely order again.

My coworkers and I decided to give two girls another try for lunch. We placed our orders exactly at 11 am. The girl on the phone said it would be ready by 1130. When we arrived at 1210ish our food was still not ready. Its hard to believe that it takes over and hour to cook a pizza. Granted the food was delicious but they really need to work on their timing. If I was a dine in customer I would not wait for over and hour for my food. Still waiting on a manager to call due to the fact this has happened 3 other times already. Disappointing.

I'm a Marriott gal but this hotel stay was awful. The light over the sink didn't work and the bed sheets kept coming off the not-so-nice bed. I requested an extra shampoo and conditioner via the app, and no one ever delivered it.

We woke up this morning to a clogged bathtub that hadn't drained from yesterday. It took 45 minutes for someone from maintenance to come up to the room, and he showed up with a plunger to fix a clogged toilet. When we said it was our shower, he used the same plunger to fix it. Gross on so many levels!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I'm giving it five stars because 
1, the price is reasonable for the quality and quantity. 3$/slice with lots of ingredients. It's fr3$h  
2, needless to say the food is delicious. I'm not sure if all thin crust pizza place are like Jules, they definitely have their dough:toppings proportion right. You taste the topping just a little more than the crust so the crust actually compliments and balances out the flavor of the pizza. 
3, lots of different choices of flavor and if you're a vegetarian, MUST TRY their veggie pizzas!! The wide variety of selection surprised me. 
4, they have the BYOB policy. 

I hope you enjoy the place as much as I do!

My wife and I came here for a week, May 10 - 15, 2021.  Stayed in a Gulf View King Suite room. The view was disappointing, we are looking over the tennis courts and the Gulf beach shoreline is at least 500 yards away. Not at all what we expected. We called the front desk and they said we were in the best room for a view of the Gulf. The King Suite was spacious and comfortable. Current guidelines only allow for room cleaning once every 3 days. The breakfast buffet was a disappointment. The scrambled eggs seemed to be powdered eggs. The pool is also undersized for the number of guests.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My family used to love this place, but I just picked up a $50+ order of sushi and they had only packed 2 containers of soy sauce so I asked for 4 more. The waiter brought me 4 containers but the woman at the register wouldn't give them to me and said she would make an exception and give me 2 more. So she holds back 2 soy sauce while I explain that doesn't $50 of sushi need more soy sauce and if we were dining in the restaurant would she limit the soy sauce we used. I had to argue with her for 2 small containers of soy sauce and now they've lost a customer over something so petty.

Its a healthy restaurant . My friend noticed that they don't have french fries (he was upset) I like the design and taste of food. I had chicken sandwich and cheeseburger soup. It was my first time to try this soup and it was lovely. The weird thing thou, they took my plate immediately when I finished it. Also, they asked us if we want the bill even though my friend was eating. I've seen this behavior as a very rude behavior and it was my first time been in this situation. They asked us for ID's and the time was 2:30pm. Whaaat??!!?!!

Went to go food, found a girls phone in the bathroom. IMMEDIATELY went to turn it in to lost and found to the managers.. WAS QUICKLY INFORMED that it was not a reliable source and they were very interested in what we found anyways. The staff then got upset and ignored us, refused to take our order.. simply because we wanted to wait to see if the girl who lost her phone would come back to redeem it.. and she did. Yet they acted unprofessional and we ended up walking out with NO FOOD despite the girl GETTING HER PHONE BACK!!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I've come a few times and everything has always been delicious. This last time, there was a small mistake made the the staff went above and beyond to remedy it and has made us lifetime customers. Ordered a roll with Soy wrap but it came with seaweed. They replaced the order but swapped the protein by accident on the next try. I ate it anyway but when the server noticed she brought the correct item in a to go box for me and gave us a small bottle of sake on the house. So kind and unnecessary. All the food was fresh and tasted amazing and with the awesome service it's our go to local stop.

I've been going to Aslan for almost 16 years. Love Neal to death and Tammy too. If I ever have an issue or the cut/color wasn't exactly what I was expecting, Neal will always correct it. He's also charming and by now I consider him a good friend and confidant. I highly recommend this salon. I tried several others in Reno after moving to Tahoe from the Bay Area and they just couldn't stack up. I also appreciate the effort that Tammy puts into ongoing training of her stylists. They are always knowledgable about current trends and products. Love you Aslan!

Went in for a quick afternoon caffeine fix while strolling Santa Barbara. My boyfriend ordered a drip coffee, which was not even hot, and tasted cheaper than a Folger's instant coffee. I ordered an almond milk cappuccino, which was definitely better than the coffee but still low quality. The barista and cashier were two teens who were impersonal and  and clearly very disinterested in their customers. The barista gave my drink to another customer that had just ordered at the front, even though I spoke to him directly when ordering and he absolutely knew it was for me. Would be worth your while to head anywhere else for coffee in the area.

Liars and cheats! We had a reservation for $14/day and they charged us $57/day. Our total cost for the 5 days we were here was supposed to be just over $100, but they charged us $315. The phone number to this location redirected us to the reservations line. They had an option to "Press 6 to speak to a manager". I was surprised by that option figuring this must be an issue for others if they actually have that option. Pressed 6 and instead of allowing me to speak to a manager, it transferred me to reservations. This is one of the worst car rental experiences I've ever had and I travel multiple times per month and have for many years.

this hotel is one of the worst I've ever been to. I planned badly because my friends and I were going on a road trip, and went to an amusement park coming back very late. First, the employees are on the rude side. Second, there is no free wifi. Third, you need to pay $50 dollars to park your car in their parking lot on top of $250 for a room. I thought that the Embassy suites were nice but I guess I was wrong. Don't come here if you are looking for an affordable nice room (with free wifi) but feel free if you want to waste your money. 

PS elevators are REALLY slow
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
It's 1:30 am, there has been a loud party going on in the outside courtyard for over 3 1/2 hours. There are signs in the elevator that tell you to be quiet after 10 pm. There is loud music playing, tons of people talking, partying and carrying on. Called the front desk twice and the gentleman named Jerome said both times, "I will have the houseman go check and see what is going on". We all can easily see, hear and know what's going on, it needs to stop so everyone with a room attached to the courtyard can sleep. 

Pool is empty and not working and their gym is closed for renovations.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
So this is my local Sushi joint and I came here because it was convenient and I had OK service here in the past that being said I'm sitting here tonight drinking sake out of a water glass there is nobody using a sake glass and they continue to tell me that there are no sake glasses available this may be one of the most ridiculous situations I've ever dealt with in my life how can you be a sushi restaurant and not have sake glasses available. Additionally this is the second time the waitress just came up to me and said she's 86'd on two of the items that we have ordered how do you not know what you're 86'd 


before you take someone's order

The room we stayed in was small. They were clean once the maid came in. The rooms were cold most of the time and the walls are super thin. The extra charges that continued to happen on a daily basis were ridiculous. the t.v. was hard to work and WiFi was slow. Also you had to pay for WiFi. most hotels should not have you paying for WiFI. 
One the upside, we were very centralized and away enough from Bourbon Street that we did not hear anything from the street. We close to restaurants, the casino, and the aquarium.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Waited months and months as their opening kept being delayed. Was promised a discounted rate for being patient for their opening and my 30 day free trial. Once the gym opened, before giving me my 30 day free pass, I was given a "one time chance" to buy a membership without the $99 "enrollment fee", but no other discount was offered. At $89-$99 a month, it's a little out of my price range. Nice space, but no one on the floor managing the place or there to help, unless you want to pay MORE to have a "WE/FIT" coach.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I have lived here for a year now and will be renewing my lease. The staff has always been courteous and it is obvious that they try hard to create a community feel . My mom visited over the weekend and was very impressed by the property. She commented several times about how well the grounds were maintained and the overall cleanliness of the common areas, hallways, pool, etc. It helped remind me that I may have come to take these things for granted. The train is quite annoying, but the location is great for access to all the downtown restaurants and shopping.

Best Mexican food in Indy!  I've been here twice now and don't plan on going to any other Mexican restaurants again.  Queso, guacamole, salsas and service were all amazing.  The Nachos Mazatlan are the best...can't even try anything else because it's so good!  Not only is it already covered in toppings and queso, but the server (maybe the manager?) brought me out a little bowl of even more because she didn't think they put enough on to begin with.  What other place does that?  Amazing food, amazing service, new favorite!

Although the salmon was indeed fat, I will not be returning.  Had a reservation but when we arrived they did not have a table for us so we sat at the sushi bar for 30 minutes until a table opened up.  At the sushi bar one of my comrades got hot miso soup spilled on her by the waiter and all she got to go with that 1st degree burn was an unapologetic "sorry".  When we FINALLY got seated, we waited another hour for our sushi to arrive along with a minuscule side of soy sauce which may not have been adequate for an ant.  The sushi was phenomenal, but the service was severely lacking and the thickness of the salmon just did not make up for it.

Service is excellent, food is mediocre.  The starter salad is mostly romaine, dressed with a mustardy vinaigrette that makes the greens instantly soggy upon hitting them, and a cucumber here, and cherry tomato there.  The Veal Saltimbocca boasted sad little pieces of veal, a gelatinous, near aspic like sauce, and heavy spices. The prosciutto was rubbery and bland.  The mushrooms were cooked well.  The accompanying pasta is insulting for the prices paid.  Across the table were lasagna and chicken parmesan which elicited a review of "It was alright" from the diners.  Overall, don't waste your money.

We stayed here the weekend of 11/13/15. I agree with the other reviewers - the location is great, the staff was friendly, and we got a good deal. But, this is one of those instances where you get what you pay for. The bedrooms are small, old, dingy, and the bathrooms are TINY. As the other reviewers have noted, there is no exhaust fan in the bathroom, and the hallways are noisy in that it literally sounds like someone is entering your room when another guest opens their door. Overall, this hotel is old and needs major updating.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Worst breakfast ever. The waitress was running around like a chicken with her head cut off. It wasn't even busy when we got there and she threw our
Silverware on the table. We were holding back laughing because she looked so ridiculous that it was like a comedy skit. Food was subpar and my husbands breakfast was missing home fries.  We never got a chance to say anything because the waitress never checked in on us. When it got busy her head nearly spin off her body.  For godsake hire someone else to help her out!

I've been here about 6 times and it keeps getting better.  I took a friend tonight who I just discovered is my foodie soulmate. We choose the tasting menu and I'm glad we did. We ended up with 8 courses and only one was good not great like the rest. Only one item was on the regular menu so we had suprise after suprise. My favorite was the rabbit with home made pasta and rabbit jus, I could have eaten a very large bowl of it. The dessert also was out of this world. Corn bread cake with blueberry lemon sorbet and peach chutney with cheesecake cream just wonderful. Service is always top notch.

For all you can eat sushi and other food, this place was not as bad as I thought. I came in with the expectation of cheap nasty sushi but it tasted decent and I liked it. The price to be honest though is not really worth it but going in a while is not that bad. Waiters were nice and came often to check up on us and the bathrooms were alright. Also this is a great place for eel lovers such as myself since you can get all the eel you want, this place is a dreamland. I ate so much eel that I am not afraid to touch eel for a bit. Yeah I recommend coming here with a group of people.

Before I destroy this hotel, access to the hotel from Tampa International was easy & convenient. The decor was very nice, with a sub-tropical decor in the middle with palm treats and a running brook.

Ok so now here comes the opportunities. The hot water did not work well. The shower fixture fell off. The bathroom for a Sheraton was tiny! The room also,had an OFF-SMELL to it. The complimentary computers left out we're a nice touch if the had internet for more than one site! I'm glad we just stayed one night...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I was recommended here to get my dog fixed. Called to make an appointment and the price seemed reasonable. They require you to drop your dog off with everyone else all at the same time and pick your dog up all at the same time. I take my dog home after surgery and she is completely infested with fleas. She has never had fleas before due to the fact that I treat her. But after picking her up they re just everywhere. I would not come here again knowing that on my first time taking my dog here she got swarmed with fleas.

Stayed there for business. Left my Ipad in my room when I left, called that same day and the security told me that the house keeping found it and they would recover it from the housekeeping department and call me to return it. I've called every day since then and they keep changing their story and say they cant find it now. I have come to the conclusion that the house keeping stole my ipad. They keep going in circles when they originally told me it was there in the hotel. I even called the general manager and have not been called back. DO NOT STAY HERE, THEY WILL STEAL FROM YOU!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The Chef's menu is very innovative and sounds as good as it taste. The Oxtail Gnocchi was great as well as the Seafood Risotto. I would eat both again, but the rest of the menu looks so good, I would have to try another dish. The service was attentive but not too attentive if you know what I mean. I have a background in hospitality, so my standards are high.  Water was kept full and wine was quickly served. This was also a busy Valentines Day Saturday. I love Tiramisu and it was very good. It was served a very unique way. I will not spoil it. You have to try it.

Probably the best place to get tacos in Trenton. The portions are great and the prices reasonable. I highly recommend the Carnitas tacos, they're my all time favorite. The location is usually never packed so service is very attentive. Be warned that the establishment seems to be family owned, so there may be a language barrier for non-Spanish speaking customers.  If you dine-in you get chips and salsa as an appetizer.  Another tip: if you get tacos ask for the "hecho a mano" tortillas which means hand made, they will charge you an extra dollar but the flavor is incomparable to regular flour tortillas.

Didn't have many options on this terminal so I thought I would brave this joint.  I think picking up a granola bar would have been a better option. 

Good:  I found a seat.  They had napkins.

Bad:  Turkey tasted old and only had a drop of sauce on it.  Whatever you do DONT get the green beans.  These are the hard bright yellow kind they serve in some pretentious place.  They taste like you just snapped them off the vine.  I promise you won't like them.  Tea tasted powdered and the only sweetners they have are equal and sugar. 

Won't return or refer.  You can do better than this Nashville. I know this is the airport but this is embarrassing.

I'm a really big fan of their iced blueberry Matcha latte, however it's a little out of my way to come and get it. I came today to grab it and a few other snacking items for breakfast and was disgusted to see that not one but two pieces of my bacon had a thick black here cooked into it with the glaze that makes the bacon sweet. Absolutely disgusting but no surprise considering all the girls that I could see through the window had their hair down. Beautiful dark thick black hair just hanging free to land on whatever food items you may have ordered

The food was really good but my steak was over cooked. Husband got the shrimp hibachi entree ,I got the steak hibachi entree & we also tried the shrimp yakisoba(Japanese noodles )-the container wasn't full & both the entree portions could have been bigger. Other places usually put the rice separate for an entree , this seemed more like the portion for a lunch special. Disappointed because all reviews so far said portions were large. Just underwhelmed for the price but food was still very good. Next time I'm going to try the sushi.

Service with the guy up front could have been a lot nicer, trust me. I've worked in the food industry before so I know he must be feeling tired, but at least try when I smile back... anyways the service was quicker than most drive thru fast food places and opening the actual to go container of food gave a great amount of everything. Their standard is two sauces- one green chile i assume (mild) and the other (CALIENTE AF and I can handle spicy). The sour cream serving is more than a yogurt container full, then a side of chopped FRESH lettuce and tomatoes. Quesadilla w carnitas- can't go wrong. Would totally recommend.

I was looking for a new spot. I'm new to the area. The reviews looked good so I gave it shot. I wasn't greeted. Very Quiet & unwelcoming. I asked the tech why he didn't use the foundation before applying the gel top coat and he ignored me. Then he goes in the back to blow his nose and didn't wash his hands. I politely asked him to wash his hands. I don't think he does nails, maybe just polish, which he tooook foreverrrrr doing. And he wasn't familiar with the ending of a set. Didn't wash my hands, half lotion with warm towel and no cuticle oil.

Had a really great stay here this past week. There are nicer hotels there but the staff was simply fantastic and so helpful. Loved the movie room and the fact that they let you watch DVDs for free in there. I made use of the gym, which had enough in there to get a good workout. I loved the social hour they offer on select weeknights.
It's within walking distance of the Convention Center and it's right by Lucas Oil Stadium. As for the rooms, they were spacious and clean.
The only thing that was just OK during my trip was the breakfast. 
I'd recommend this hotel and I compliment the staff for providing a great experience during my 3 day stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: One of the best sushi spots in the city that I've found so far. If you want authentic then this is for you. Everything that came to our table was beautiful aesthetically and flavorful to match. I am one to lean more towards sushi rolls and they suggested a hand roll which was amazing. Overall I really enjoyed the authentic atmosphere and the amazing food that I will say with confidence that I will be having again. Thank you to the kitchen and all staff for a wonderful service that I hope to experience again.

LOL I'm literally typing this review while waiting for someone to come fix the toilet in "the only available king room that's left." I don't know where to start. My door doesn't open (1032) unless you throw your entire body into it. I went down and complained and they said "oh an engineer just went up there and it opened no problem." No. Wrong. 

My daughter went to use the toilet and we got one flush and now the tank isn't filling up with water. The only saving grace is that the room is clean and they hooked it up with free breakfast. Won't be staying here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Idk how this place has 4.5 stars. Gave this place another shot tonight after the first time, and they somehow manage to ruin all my favorite and simple sushi rolls- philly, California, shrimp tempura, tuna, etc. Every roll is downright disgusting; you can immediately tell the fish is not fresh. I've never had to spit out sushi at at any other place before and I had to with the food from this place. The seaweed is unchewable too, had to spit that out multiple times too. Argh. Only good thing is the prices. Guess you get what you pay for. Worst sushi I've ever had though.

I'll never stay here again. Cockroaches, rust, OLD a/c units to the point it took hours to warm up the room. No garbage cans in room. Old spring mattresses. No fitted sheets. Really? And our door looked like it was kicked in. 
The pool was clean and so was the hot tub, the entertainment area was big! But other than that I have nothing good to say about this place. 
It needs to be fumigated to get rid of all the roaches, and needs a major face lift. It has such great potential. 
Until that happens. I do not recommend this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: When I paid them to clean the inside of my car they must have had a very very different idea of what "clean" meant. If clean to you means that the doors don't still have mud on them, that the floor mats are cleaned, and that everything is properly vacuumed, then do not go here. There was no manager on duty making sure that jobs were being done properly from what I could see. It is clear that the employees goal is to push through as many cars as quickly as possible with no care as to the quality of the work. Please don't waste your time and money here like I did.

I understand this resultant has several locations, therefore I would like to confirm that I am posting a review for the Bryn Mawr location. I ordered s veggie quesadilla and was sadly disappointed about how it was prepared. They burned it and the burned flour tortilla taste is not at all appetizing. It was too bad because the veggies were very well seasoned. 
The person who took my order was very thoughtful about my food allergies and made sure to keep me safe. I feel the cook might want to be more careful in the future to ensure the food isn't served burned.

Had my eyes checked and that process was good.  Went to pick up 2 pairs of glasses.  One set was bent and so they off the progressive lens. It took them 1/2 hour to figure that out.  Sunglasses were damaged on lens and had to be resent out.   Got a notification that they were ready to be picked up.  Went there and sat for 15 min to have them tell me they were not in fact there.  They should have been able to figure that out right away.  I should have never been told they were ready for pick up.  Bad processes at the front desk.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: My wedding dress turned out great after having it pressed. I would say one thing I was not happy about and for future reference, my wedding dress was provided to Peerless Cleaners in the zip up and white bag from the place I bought it from. When I got it back it was in a see through plastic blue bag. I get that it maintains its shape that way. But I was upset that the bag I had for it originally was thrown away. Make sure you let them know or take the bag off prior. Very upsetting. Wedding dresses aren't cheap and to repay for another wedding dress bag is not okay.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I can't speak to the quality of the cut because I never managed to get one. I showed up 15 minutes early and there were three others already waiting. One barber showed up and opened five minutes after the posted time. After another half hour the barber was still working on the first haircut because he seemed more interested in watching "The Price is Right" than working through the line of 8-10 people who were by then waiting for a haircut. I left and will not go back. I don't mind waiting for quality but I refuse to wait several hours for a haircut while the sole barber watches TV game shows.

If you haven't stopped by here, make a point to. By far the best quick service car wash in Tampa Bay. Not only do they have top of the line equipment, but the staff is also more than welcoming. Prices are reasonable and you can either do a membership or just swing in for a quick wash. The system they use makes it very easy for you to get in and out in record time. I hope the owners plan to expand their operation and build more around the Bay. I used to live in Brandon, but now I'm St Pete they definitely need one closer to home!

ive gone here before and i hated the service and food was nasty! i tried it again to see if it changed and it hasnt, they were very disrespectful and rude to me in the drive thru and the window and my burritos were HARD and dry and tasteless. im very disappointed in this place. and i did go around 11pm cause i got done with work and i get it it sucks working late, i work at a fast food place as well, but the restaurant i work at would never tolerate this service. no matter how tired or late it is treat every customer with respect and i didnt get that here.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The service is great. The frond desk person Charlene was extremely helpful with suggestions for restaurants in the area. The stars come in with the rooms. The hotel appears to need remodeling. The lobby area seems like it was updated they now need to start on the rooms. The room I had was a queen bed and a chair. The room is small which may be standard for the area. They have a standard alarm clock radio they have multiple outlets on the other side of the bed. The heating/AC works. I will probably try the Marriott the next time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I was so disappointed that this stay was so mediocre. We arrived to stay for an early morning flight. My party included me, my husband and my 6'4" son. When we arrived, I was told they were out of the double rooms "Would it be alright if we give you a king with a rollaway?" Exactly what are my options?! When rollaway arrived it looked like a relic from the 1950s. Shameful. My son didn't fit and had a difficult night sleeping. I'm not pleased and will think long and hard about staying at this Marriott again. The folks at the desk were very nice though. That Marriott's redeeming feature.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We had a reservation for last night that we had made nearly a year in advance so that we could stay overnight to see my sisters graduate from Saint Louis University. Upon arrival at around 8:30 p.m., we were told the hotel was oversold and they had given up our room. We did not receive a phone call ahead of time to let us know of this situation. The staff put us up in a room at a hotel further away from SLU, and it was not convenient for us to get to the ceremony in the morning. We were extremely disappointed in our experience and would not stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
ATMOSPHERE: Our triathlon team was hunting down a Italian place for a carbo-load the night before a race. The place was small. We ordered to go since we had a party of 12. Location middle of nowhere, but hey if you were in a bind like we were it works!

FOOD: I had a great Hawaiian pizza with there house pasta which was legit! The pasta was a really good size, not too big or small. The team was carbo loading which is why I ordered the pizza too.

PRICE: Affordable!

GO AGAIN?: Absolutely! The only problem would be finding a reason to be in that area.

This hotel is horrible. To start the front desk was very rude. Then the website said bar restaurant  arcade.  We booked this specifically for the arcade pool n bar. There was no arcade,  the pool had so much chlorine it burned my eyes when I entered my room. The drinks we're insane 4$ for a cup of juice. The continental breakfast is 10$ you can get better quality and more at Denny's for less. Our tv didn't work.half the cleaning crew we're Meth addicts the other half barely spoke English. the paint in our room was bubbled due to the humidity of the pool. The lights in the pool area never shut off so they shined in our room all night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Went for dessert & coffee. Dessert at any Neiman Marcus restaurant deserves ALL the stars always. But the coffee deserves zero stars. I ordered a capuccino, which should be espresso with steamed milk. I got drip coffee with steamed half and half, some weird disgusting hazelnut flavor and whipped cream. It was basically a bowl of watered down half and half. Asked for it to be replaced and got the same thing back. Service was great and friendly. Ambiance tops. Learn to make decent coffee! Do you even have an espresso machine back there?

So I have been here a few times.  The two stars are not for quality of service - the end product is awlays beautiful. The two stars is for the crazy amount of time it takes to get service. There were roughly 4 technicians not working with any customers and I waited 25 minutes beforeI even got sat at a station. Apparently the issue is very few technicians here are trained in shellac/gel nails.  While I appreciate that only trained technicians should do certain things-this is a very popular service- one which I would encourage more people to learn on this eatablishment.

I believe the quality on Sunday may have not been the best due to the overwhelming and exciting turnout of their grand opening. However, I believe things will improve! Our blueberry fitter was a little greasy and didn't have too much blueberry flavor. Our buttermilk crumb was delicious but the middle was undercooked and doughy. Lastly out of the few flavors I tasted, I believed that the glazed maple bacon was far too sweet. We are excited to give them another try in a few weeks though. I loved all the options and flavors but would like to see some more classic flavors too.

Worst service I've ever had. I've never walked out of a restaurant because of this type of service. The sign read "Seat Yourself". I sat for almost 15 minutes before the waitress that walked pass me several times finally acknowledged me. During their times walking pass me they were taking orders from customers that came in after me. He and the other waitress then began to go back and forth about who's turn it was to take me. We the bickering was over, neither immediately proceeded to my table. I travel weekly and will never enter this restaurant again.

I love bartaco! This is one of my go-to Mexican places in Tampa. Be prepared to wait, this place is always busy. I love that the tacos are ordered individually so you can mix and match your favorites. My favorites are the Baja fish and carnitas. The tacos are very small so you will need multiple to serve as a meal. They have fabulous Mexican corn that can be order off the cob for less of a mess. Save room for their awesome desserts. Churros or the key lime pie in a cup! The restaurant is so cute with the indoor/outdoor feel. I am in love with the decor! And what better location than in Hyde Park.

Thank you so much to the Nashville Airport Marriott for generously donating a conference room for two weeks to a local, high school ACT class. You went above and beyond to make sure the room was set up perfectly and that we had all the resources we needed. We appreciated the daily check-ins to make sure the temperature was alright and the room was clean! I can't imagine a better place to have had the course. The students and I are beyond grateful for your generosity and kindness. 

I would recommend this hotel to anyone looking to rent a conference space!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I was excited to hear that DD was coming to town since that's what I had growing up in MI.  My friend waited in the long line when it opened and bought 3 dozen donuts.  Unfortunately they did not give her anything she had marked on the form.  Strike 1.  I had been dreaming of those French curlers.  She went back this week and bought us another box.  The French curler tasted stale - not like the donut I was thinking of.  Strike 2.  It must be the frozen donut that I saw in another review.  You just can't have a good frozen donut.  In MI, they made the donuts in house.  Oh Well.

Had an early dinner reservation at 5pm. Was seated at a table right by the kitchen door. When asked to be re seated we were told no and that the tables were all reserved. The waiter was extremely rude for a "fine dining establishment".  After talking with the manager, we were reseated.  

The restaurant was half empty for the majority of our dinner. There was no reason why we couldn't be reseated. The sides were cold, meat dishes were entirely mediocre. 

For the price, and the extra attitude, we will definitely not be returning.

When many hotels that serve complimentary breakfasts are returning to the hot options they traditionally served this location left out small packs of muffins, cartons of milk, low end cereal, and tepid coffee. Gouges in walls, one elevator operating, and damp lobby requiring commercial size fans to remove humidity. Also, what's the purpose of placing HD tv's in rooms that are not equipped for that quality of signal. The screen images were blurred and unwatchable. Parking was free and there was a small underground garage.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My husband and I rented a car in June through Alaska Vacations (Expedia).  When we arrived at the counter, all was good.  We were asked for optional insurance and we declined.  2 days after we rented the car, our credit card was charged $192 for optional insurance that we declined!  After spending hours on the phone with Hertz and Expedia, we were told that our money would not be refunded.  Then, they tried to give us a coupon.  Why not refund the $$$ the unauthorized charge!!!  I will never use Hertz or book a car through Expedia again.

I stayed here in February 2015. The room was very nice. It was clean & didn't smell like smoke. I especially liked not having carpet floor. Down side - the walls are paper thin. I could hear everything going on in the rooms next to me AND the rooms across to me! Woke up at 4 am to the people across the hall. & then again at 6am to children running the hallway (which wasn't the hotels fault). Then it was just constant noise after that & never fell back asleep. But as a light sleeper, this is a terrible place for people like me. I was completely exhausted the rest of the week because I barely got any sleep in this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Do NOT stay here. I would give it zero stars but is not an option. We only stayed bc we had been traveling for 12 hours in the car, it was pouring rain, and we were exhausted. The front desk staff was unprofessional and rude when I asked to change rooms. The first room was not clean--not even slightly. The second room smelled like cat pee, and the third was barely acceptable. The facility itself is very run down and unkempt. We took a quick nap, and left the place as quickly as possible to head out for another 12 hour driving day.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Last night my husband, flying into Philly on business, stood waiting for Budget's shuttle bus for more than 30 minutes in 17 degree weather. Once he reached the office, it took another 30 minutes to get past the counter despite being a Fast Break customer. The clerk insisted that he didn't need a paper contract to get off the lot, which of course he did when he tried to leave, resulting in more delay. I had a bad experience with Budget last April at the Kansas City airport, so this will be the end of our using Budget, after many years where it's been our first choice for car rental.

This is the place to go if you own a VW or Audi. The techs are beyond knowledgeable when it comes to european cars. This shop has gone above and beyond for me. They were able to troubleshoot issues my car had in a day that the dealership couldn't figure out after having my car for almost two weeks. They were able to answer all of my questions and explain what was going on with my car in great detail. They never pressured me or tried to BS me into fixing something the way a lot of other shops try to do. This is one of the most upfront and honest shops I've ever had the pleasure of dealing with and I will be a lifetime customer because of that.

My family and I came here for breakfast on Saturday. We sat and waited for our food for over one hour. We asked how much longer our wait would be and were told 5 minutes. That time came and went and still no food. People seated before us had still not been served.  We ended up leaving, as did several other families, before our food was brought out. A true disappointment. How long does it take to make breakfast?? I hope they can change the way the kitchen operates because they will not be in business for long with that type of service.

I have stayed here over the past few years. When we stayed here in May of 2019 and found BED BUGS in our bed! They unfortunately found there way into our suite cases and a few weeks after returning home we found the all over the room where we keep them. This lead to spending thousands of dollars to remove the bed bugs from our home.
DO NOT STAY HERE unless they can full prove they have taken care of this problem. They have been less the hepfull to remedy this situation and we will not be staying here any more
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We walked in, the two very young workers were sitting on the counter watching their phones so intently we had to interrupt to ask if they could help us. Then, we ask for the flavor of the month and it's not available, okay busy month. How about a shake, oh we don't have any milk. Not much for courtesy, so because I now have to drive with a bowl I sit and as we sit there eating our ice cream we look inside and they are back on the counter but now the young boy has laid down and put his head in the girls lap. Thinking maybe he wasn't even employed here. Extremely disappointing experience

I'm giving two stars because of my cut up finger due to slipping drilling.. I also waited over 30 minutes before being attended to, but I wasn't in a rush so it's not a huge deal. I wish the polish would've  covered a couple of my nails all the way to the edge. Also, their selection of color changing polish is VERY limited. I came here not only because I was in the area but because it was cheaper according to their price list, but for some reason I ended up spending the same amount as I do at the location by me in ft.lauderdale (Gellac Nails and Spa) .

OMG WHY DON'T THEY DO SOMETHING ABOUT THE FRONT DESK STAFF!!! We were there last year and we had 3 rooms. Upon arrival, the front desk staff was horrible!! My mother and father wanted to leave and go to grand plaza. I convinced them to stay the room was fine, the outside bar was nice. We are coming back this year and needed 3 rooms in November. We called the front desk (with hesitation), and AGAIN....Total A HOLE ANSWERED THE PHONE. HE WAS SO RUDE, WE WILL NOTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTT RETURN!!!!!!!!!!! And it is bad bc this is a fantastic hotel with a fantastic pool and outside bar! Such a shame!!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Just adding another complaint to the cavalcade of negative reviews - I really need to check Yelp first more often. I came into this location this morning, and was not greeted by anyone. The cashier seemed annoyed by our presence, and rolled her eyes when my son asked why their weren't any donuts - maybe 15 left, mostly old-fashion. 

We stayed in for our breakfast, and were entertained by the manager telling long stories about how much she hates her employees, peppered with frequent obscenities. 

What a gem in the Dunkin franchise. Can't wait to get back to our home base.

I saw minimum of 5 buses from every other major rental agency before one hertz bus came. The Avis buses were literally one after the other. As were Dollar, Budget, Thrifty, Enterprise, and National...Hertz was literally nowhere to be found!  I was looking up the phone number for Hertz on yelp to call an ask what the problem was after waiting 20 minutes when the hertz bus finally pulled up.After that, it was pretty smooth sailing - steady moving line, nice customer service through the rental process, good car, easy return....But that wait for the bus was beyond ridiculous

The food is what you would expect for a DD but the service is HORRIBLE.
They treat customers with such disrespect and don't care what they give you. I had several of the employees snarl at me thru the drive thru because I wanted to use the coupon on my DD app and their scanner wouldn't accept it, you would have thought I committed a crime! They finally just handed me an order and I was so anxious to escape I didn't check. I don't know who's order I received by not what I paid for and when I called they were just as rude! Stay away unless you enjoy abuse!

Does not even deserve one star. This place is the biggest dive. Do not stay here. Sleep in your car instead.  I cannot believe Wyndham has their name on this place.  First room had a broken towel rack on the floor. Second room had non operational outlets in the bathroom. The bed overlays were dirty and their maids do a horrible job of cleaning. Our room was one facing an indoor pool and the room reeked of chlorine. When turning the heat on the electrical would trip and it did not work. I will never trust the Wyndham name again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: A bit disappointed with this trip's rental.  Rented a relatively new jeep and the AC didn't work!  It was 90 degrees this weekend and my poor 3 year old nephew and I were miserable!  The gas tank had issues and kept clipping off so I likely overpumped on gas.  Upon telling the attendant, she only took $10 off for the inconvenience.  I usually rent here every month when I fly home to STL because of the great service and accommodation but $10 off for overpaying on gas and sweating in the car all weekend was not even worth my breathe.

It is mixed feelings to write a review about this new gem.
I want to keep this place secret, so I can quietly enjoy more often. But I want them to be very successful.
The young talented chef had been with a couple of other local Japanese restaurants and just started this small place.
I tried nigiri sushies with no dressing on them to find out the baseline quality. 
Proportion between rice and seafood is perfect. Density and granularity of rice, which often becomes missing detail, was also close to be ideal. Already excited about visiting again.

This is the worst hotel I have ever stayed in! The rooms are dirty, something out of a horror movie! The"courtyard" is disgusting with a pool in the middle that no one can swim in till after 6 because they don't want to disturb the drunks that were up all night partying in the lobby. Alcohol bottles and cigarette butts everywhere even though it's a non smoking hotel. No food anywhere in sight. No trash can in our room. Sheets weren't changed from previous people, they just made up the bed. Towels weren't even washed from the pool, just dried and refolded. Wish I could give it negative 5 stars! Do not ever stay here!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I loved my stay at this hotel. I went for a long weekend to check out the city and the location is very convenient and close to many things. Most are walking distance especially during warm weather. The hotel is very artsy and modern. It's super duper clean and I felt comfortable staying at the hotel. The staff are so nice and accommodating. The lobby offers a beautiful bar where you can have a meal as well. What I enjoyed mostly at the lobby was the games they offer for you to play while just sitting back and relaxing. It also has a pool table that I played at for hours. I would most definitely come back and stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The hotel is right on the beach and the view is directly at the Gulf of Mexico.  We loved the accommodations.  The service team was excellent and they took really good care of us while we stayed a few days at this location.  The restaurant food was OK but the place is filthy dirty (we felt like the food may not be safe to eat....yuck).  Their ceilings have black soot at each of the vents and it is very dingy inside.  We did not eat in there anymore during this stay, we went out to competitors.  Time to spruce up this part of the hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The food was good.  It was a Tuesday night and they had a full house.  I am not sure if this is the normal or not, but the service was slow.  Our actual server did not take any of our orders.  Drinks, appetizer, main, etc.  the hostess/front of house person did most of the work.  

We found out that the bread is not made in house.  It is made at a bakery.  The downfall was that it seemed like the break had been frozen or refrigerated and thrown in the microwave.

Overall, I would try them again on a night they did. It seem as busy.  Maybe the service would be better.

I placed a delivery order on 10/3/16 through Eat Street on Yelp and the order never came. We called a few times and were assured it was on the way. After it still never arrived, we called back and they said they never received the order and that they would make it then. It was after midnight at this point, so we just asked for a refund. I was told I would receive a refund and asked for a confirmation email. I never received a response, a refund, or any email. It was an almost $35 order and they have not cared that I paid in full and received nothing.

Very Nice hotel. I stayed in room 1219 which had a beautiful view of Lake Pontchartrain and the Causeway Bridge. I only stayed one night but would definitely stay again. My only complain was that the carpet was poorly put in. Some areas were coming undone by the wall. I would have expected more from a Marriott hotel. I also ordered room service which was ok but a little pricey. I paid $50 for 2 po-boys and a small cup of gumbo. The Po-boys were ok, buy not what expected for New Orleans. Overall, nice hotel with friendly staff which would make me stay again!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Beautiful views. Great weekend getaway. Updated rooms were clean and spacious. Jason at the pool is phenomenal and he was the main reason we stayed poolside. The one day he was off it took 45 minutes for someone to even look in our direction and then we waited forever for food and drinks. Our food at the pool was prompt and consistent everyday. Only downside were the amount of kids and lack of parents watching them. Not the hotels fault but it definitely made the pool un relaxing and chaotic. Overall good stay and will probably be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: All i have to say is these people that work here are dumb! It's not that hard to make a coffee! If you don't know how to do it, get trained, or get out! Every time i go through the drive through line to get coffee it's always bad coffee, that or the wrong flavored coffee. And when they don't put sugar in my coffee i go to give it back to have them put sugar in it they decline me and try to give me  sugar packets. No I don't want sugar packets, if i did I would've made coffee myself AT HOME! Plus sugar packets for Iced Coffee goes straight to the bottom of the cup, liquid sugar does not! GET IT RIGHT!

We grabbed this hotel becuase it was a descent price. We came in pretty late from our travels and they had no complementary water. So we had to pay up the wazoo for 2 bottles of water, as there is no gas station or convenience store nearby. There is only paid wi-fi too. Then the beds were harder than the floor. I couldn't get a restful night of sleep. When I got up in the morning, my right side was cramped up. My husband said his left side was all cramped up so much that he couldn't more his neck. Do yourself a favor and skip this hotel if you want a restful sleep! Only reason it isn't getting 1 star is it was fairly clean.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Ice cream is just ok you can get the same quality in the grocery aisle and it's much cheaper. The professionalism of the staff is why I've given only two stars. There was plenty to be done while everyone was sitting in the back on their phones. And the young man that works there kept eating sample spoons of ice cream one after another. There was also a little girl there who must have been the daughter of a staff member bc she kept running behind the counter and all around the siding area running into us multiple times. Overall not a great experience and we were the only customers when we went so no excuses.

This was my 1st experience but after reading the reviews I felt good about Mamma Mia. Unfortunately my 1st experience will be my last. Not only was the order wrong, it took over an hour and a half for delivery.  I called the store multiple times to check on our delivery and the only excuse. You call to get the status of your delivery and are giving excuses and spoken to like you were not a paying customer and when you ask to speak to a manager about your $31 order the manager never comes on the line. Very disappointed in this experience.

HORRIBLE HORIBLE DUNKIN !! I have come here multiple times in the morning and they tell me the espresso machine is "broken" "being cleaned" or I get the "I'm new idk how to work it " this has happened almost every time I come and I come almost every morning. I also had to wait in the drive thru line for 30+ mins for my latte that they didn't have and decided to tell me at the window after I had ordered. I told a manager about this and she didn't do much. Going to this dunking rn let's hope the machine isn't "broken"
Once again I go and it is 730 and they are cleaning the machine the lien was 10+ cars and the inside was empty

Tried this place for the first time as I am her from San Diego and I was not disappointed! I loved the atmosphere and the fact that you could watch the chefs cook in the center of the restaurant! This place made me feel like I was back in San diego again, which is awesome! We got 2 plates to share, the gnocchi and the grouper cheek.
