Both were delicious and would recommend either of them really. The wait staff was super helpful in explaining everything and extremely polite, which is hard to find these days. Thanks for a great dining experience guys!!

Nice place to live. Clean, safe and apartments maintained well. Staff and maintenance responsive. Slightly dated appliances but work well.

Most apts are remodeled with fresh paint and carpet. Quite and can barely hear the neighbors. Complex is quite. 

Tennis courts is unusable but the pool is nice and maintained.  Workout room is good along with community center. 

New owners are putting on the tender loving care and good management that get better every day. 

Ground are nice but need better care and some weed killer fertilizer ( only noticeable up close).  Keeping up with the grass and weeds in the beds would go a long way.

After a run-in with the staff for sand in my scallops, which, by the way, they still charged me for the barely half-eaten $30 entre, I went home after dinner and a few hours later I was suffering from symptoms of food poisoning.  Not only is the manager a coward, terrible and never came to see us after we requested him for our complaint which would make me give the service in this restaurant 5 thumbs DOWN, clearly they are not preparing/keeping their food to proper standards.  If you don't know how to clean seafood, don't serve it!

I use the Glenwood location with caution. The shots are generally burnt, and the composition of their drinks is extremely "meh" at best - I have had to have them remake drinks on several occasions because they were undrinkable. I have gone to four locations in Boise, and this one is by far the least consistent. I typically order an iced Americano with cream, a caramel cream cold brew, or (as of recently) a shaken iced espresso concoction. They are always noticeably different in the way they are made at the Glenwood location. Very disappointing.

Hertz ticket agent in Tucson told me if I prepay for gas they will refund what I don't use. That actually is not their policy. So she was not trained in policy or she used a great scare tactic to try to get me to purchase gas in advance and I quote " one gentleman did not have time to fill up the tank and we charged him 9.99 a gallon. If you purchase gas in advance we refund what you did not use."  I'm not a frequent traveler and I never rent cars so I believed her. In short I paid $30 for 2 gallons of gas. No bueno, that "Hurtz".

She asks if the pizza at the other locations tastes the same as at this one. He starts talking about the pizza oven in this location. It's a CTX-70 built in 1982. They don't make them anymore. It's all electric, but no forced air. There is control for the top and bottom heat. Now, I don't really understand what all that means, but the bottom line is that the oven in this particular location is unique and cooks the pizzas in a way that the owner finds superior.

See my full review at my blog: https://eatthestreetsboston.wordpress.com/2015/04/21/detour-papa-vitos/

We booked a room here and it was advertised as having 2 beds and a pullout. When we got to the room (already paid in full) it was not only NOT the room we paid for but also extremely dirty. There was dust everywhere, carpet was ripped, holes in the wall, hand prints on the headboard. DEAD BUGS in plain view. When we spoke with management we were given attitude and told we were not going to find a better hotel for the cost and if we cancelled we would not have a room held for us. Needless to say we cancelled the room and they are holding our funds for a week. Do NOT book this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: VSS is simply the best. My French Bulldog broke her elbow in January 2020. She had emergency surgery at a local ER vet. This surgery did not work and she needed a second surgery to remove a pin mid March. After the 2nd surgery, she still had the bump & swelling (see photo). After seeing Dr Anderson, he removed all the pins in her leg and she healed quickly. He was very understanding of our situation and the fact that we were on surgery #3 in 5 months with a puppy under 1 year old. Can't recommend them enough to take care of your babies.

What a disappointment! We usually eat at the Fellini's in Newtown Square but tried the one in Berwyn hoping it would be better than it was the last time we were there. (The only reason we didn't go to Newtown Square was b/c it's closed on Monday). The "Fresh Red Sauce" at Fellini's in Berwyn is equivalent to (if not of lesser quality than) Ragu. Although the Cesaer Salad and Salad Mista were decent, the meal went downhill fast from there. For the same price, you get bigger portions and much better food at the Fellini's in Newtown Square. Go there, stay away from Berwyn!

Definitely a hole in the wall, with no signs. The food is great, very flavorful! 

The staff is horrible, it took a solid 25 minutes to get our drink orders and an additional 20 for our food order. The waitress was in charge of seating, answering the phone, taking orders, and cleaning the tables. The waiter just kept walking around in circles, and we had to stare him down in order for him to come to our table. The food was amazing, it is a shame how poor of a job the staff did. This is a spot you should only go to on weekdays or non-peak times.

This is a great sushi house with a very personable owner, Vinh. She makes you feel like family. The rolls are priced from $4.95 for regular rolls & up to $12.95 for the house special.  The rolls were delicious & fresh. Our party of 5 had 11 rolls, yakisoba, teriyaki chicken & miso soup. We ate so much, but made room for the off the menu dessert that Vinh made for us. Tempura macadamia cookies, tempura twinkies, & scoops of green tea ice cream topped with fudge sauce, whip cream & strawberries. It was delicious & complimentary.  This is now our go to sushi place every time we come to visit our daughter at UCSB!

Nothing bad to say about the hotel itself. But after a 3 night stay, we were over charged for valet parking, and now, 4 days after we arrived back home I have 2 charges from the hotel bar on my card and we never once stepped foot in the bar to do anything. The charges were applied the day we checked out, so there is no way we were even there at that time anyway. Even one of the front desk ladies said they have all kinds of problems with people being over charged for various things, and mostly valet parking. So if you choose to stay here, please pay close attention to charges on your card!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Oh heavens. We just came in from this meal. We live 2 blocks away and have been here countless times. Bar food. Pretty typical but the servers are extremely personable and sitting outside is fun. TONIGHT however we had to deal with the hostess/part owner who is enough to drive us away from one our regular haunts. As a 48 year old and former server myself, I have to say ive never, ever run into someone less suited to customer service. If you are in town, grab a burger, but watch out for that one.  She ruined our date night.

The service was horrible.  It took one of us walking up to the bar to even get a drink & then we ordered food that came out about 1/2 hour later.  The thing that kept us in there was the music....the Dapper Dandies.  Great band.  Boy that girl can sing & the horn section was impressive.  It took so long for the food that we were ready to go by the time it came out & wouldn't ya know, they didn't have any containers.  But the cook was nice enough to give us some foil.  Not sure if we'll go back, especially with all the other great places so close by.

For my first time going to Eclipse Bistro I had high expectations. Of course I googled ahead the menu and reviews of the place to see any red flags. I saw none and experienced none! Such friendly hospitality, an atmosphere of smiling faces all around not just from the staff but people sitting and having a good time. 

Minimalistic menu but I did have questions because I'm not up to date with modern cuisines and our waiter was super nice to answer them.

 Delicious drinks and phenomenal food at a price I expected to be higher. Thank you E.B. For making our night a little special.

I've been to this McDonalds a million times and up until recently, I've always had terrible service. The employees wouldn't speak to you or even tell you your total at the window, just put their hand out without even making eye contact, and I'd never been thanked for my business. However, someone must have gotten the message, because the service recently has been delightful! The employees smile, actually speak to the customers, and I haven't had an order messed up since I noticed this change. Thank you whoever made this change in employment or training, and thank you to the nice girls who sold me two #3 meals this evening:)
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I had the worst meal (for Wendy standards) tonight. Wanted to grab a quick bite after work and I ordered at 4 for 4 with a side of cheese sauce. First off I got four nuggets; my cheese sauce was chunky (gag) and then to top it off i went to go eat my jr. cheeseburger and all that was in the wrapper was a bun ketchup and cheese. When I tried to call, no one answred, I also live less than a mile down the road and the food was cold by the time I got home. Don't go here save your late night junk food cravings for Taco Bell or wawa!

This company is basically running a scam... When I was picking up the car they tried to charge me MULTIPLE TIMES even though I had already paid online. I asked for an EZ pass since I knew I would be taking toll roads and the woman at the desk said I had one and was set to go. The car did in fact have one and it worked fine for the trip, but I was later charged $96 because I never paid to activate it! I had specifically asked them about this at the counter and was told that I was covered when I wasn't. Do yourself a favor and spend the extra money to go with someone else because at least they will be honest with you.

Ordered Beef with Chinese Veggies and added cashews and General Tso's Chicken.  Food was very good, veggies were fresh and crisp, Gen. Tso's chicken had a good balance of sweet and spicy, beef was tender. Tree stars are for our wait. We were in there for over an hour and were two of the 5 people there.  We were also very hungry and did not expect to be there for a while. There was only an owner who took orders, cooked and delivered food to us. He was vey nice and apologetic. I hope they get a few more servers on board.

I visited Josephine's for dinner on Friday night.  My server was very exuberant and extremely attentive.  She gets 5 stars for her service and her suggestions.  We had the brussel sprouts, the krackle, and the stone trout that is flown in from New Zealand on a daily basis.  The brussel sprouts were amazing.  I finished off my meal with the nutella cake-that was nice.  Although my meal was delicious, I think that I would receive better value for my money elsewhere.  I don't mind paying an arm and a leg for food, but only if the price tag lives up to the expectation.  I'm not sure if the price reached my taste buds.

I'm a Hilton Diamond member. I stay at this hotel a lot and the people are very friendly, the hotel is in a fantastic location and easy to get in and out of. It's always pleasant to stay but last week I met a fantastic associate named, Tayetta. She went above and beyond the call of duty. As I said, I've stayed here for years but not had anyone to offer the service she did! You get the gold star in my book, Tayetta! When you encounter people who are willing to help you and you are away from home, it makes for a great day! The people in the breakfast room are also very helpful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Do you feel lucky today? Well then get in line at this McDonald's and test your luck. Stop by late at night and see if they will actually be open, if you're really lucky there may be someone inside to tell you they are closed. Otherwise you sit at the speaker and have to figure it out yourself.  If you are lucky enough to go to their 24 but drive thru that is actually open at night the next gamble is what is on their menu. We all know we may not get fish or some chicken items at night, but I've noticed the past few times have been breakfast only.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I took my family here after reading some of the reviews from my fellow yelpers but we were unimpressed. We ordered garlic bread, a focaccia urger, kids mac and cheese, and spaghetti with meatballs. The garlic bread was okay but didn't really taste like garlic. The mac and cheese was gritty and extremely hot when they served it (which I would prefer to cold but my 3 year old wasn't too happy about having to wait to eat it). We can usually tell if we are going to like an italian restaurant based on their red sauce and I would have to say it was just okay. The focaccia burger was also just okay. I don't think we'll try it again.

This place is horribly slow! I went in for a standard oil change at 10am Saturday morning and was told my car would not be ready until 1:30 pm. Fair enough, since it is downtown, I was able to run some errands. When I came back to get my car, they had accidentally locked my keys inside the car. They provided a ride back to my apartment to get a spare set, but the whole thing was really awkward and frustrating. I did give them two stars because they offered a free oil change for next time, but I had to specifically ask for the voucher when I returned with my spare set of keys instead of them giving it to me.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Worst experience I've ever had with a rental car company! I've never seen a guy who doesn't care about customer's satisfaction as much as Matthew doesn't care! I reserved an economy car via Priceline and when I wanted to pick it up at Hertz they told me it's either Smart or Fiat 500! 2-seat cars! both Priceline and Hertz website say an economy car is a 4-seat car. After half an hour of wait and then another half an hour of negotiating with the guy I had to pay another $100 to upgrade! 
Then I got a car that I couldn't start! which wasted another half an hour of my time... unbelievable! still feel sick thinking about that night...

Only good as a buffet, the pizza is too expensive otherwise. Then pizza is OK but for the price they want it just isn't that good.. I hate seeing that place dead I want a pizza parlor in the neighborhood since the closet one is pizza hut on Neil. I've been waiting for coupons in the mail or a special on their pepperoni so I can give them buisness but I truly don't think the owner cares. Maybe he needs Chef Ramsi or something. So unless you live in the Mira Loma area and want a decent pizza buffet for $7.99, stay away it just isn't worth the price.

The manager is very unprofessional. I've seen him scream at customers when they've asked questions. Had him scream at me when I stopped in to try and cancel my membership since I'm not using it due to being pregnant and working 60 hours a week. The staff is nice however the manager lacks in professional and ppl skills. They told me I'd just be able to pay month to month no contract and I could quit at anytime, went in to quit and they said I signed a commitment, then he proceeded to scream at me and tell me he wasn't going to discuss it with me. I will be taking my business elsewhere.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
My family and I were visiting my daughter at her college homecoming. We reserved 2 non smoking rooms with 2 beds. When we checked in the guy at the front desk we were informed they just gave away the last non smoking rooms but they had assessable rooms. Both these rooms only had 1 double bed each room for 3 adults, 15 yr old and 14 yr old.  The only other opinion would be smoking room. I went down to check the room out and was overcome with musty smell. Decided to use the rooms with 1 bed. The kids slept on the chair in each room. 
Horrible and will not return to this establishment!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Came here for dinner after a concert at the Opry, started out that they give us bread and never brought us another after we finisher the first which the other restaurants we have been to have.The salad that came with our meal was just lettuce thrown on our plate no bigger than the Size of a small fist did not look like a salad at all. It took about 50 minutes too get our pasta from when we ordered it... I used to go to Macaroni's in Minnesota and this was very disappointing compared to what I remember. Not worth Paying $70 for a meal.

Parked my semi in this area,  thinking with 2 places that are 24/7 I should be able to get something for breakfast at 4am.  Wrong.  Tried the Waffle House,  it's shut down except for to-go orders.   Kind of spooky seeing a Waffle House shut down with the lights off.  So I decided to walk over to Hardee's.  Many cars going into the drive thru and getting quick service.  I tried to order at the drive thru window and was quickly told to leave.  I explained I was a trucker and he again told me to leave and I can't drive my truck into the drive thru,  I had to wait until 5am. So America's professional drivers go hungry at this place.

TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE:  I ordered a pair of prescription sunglasses almost four weeks ago.  I was told that they would be ready in two weeks.  After two and half weeks I had not heard from them, so I called only to told that there had been a problem in the lab.  I understand that problems occur, but no one called me to tell me.  I then received a call telling me that they would be ready on the Friday or Saturday of the third week.  Again, no one called to tell me that they did not come in.  DO NOT ORDER GLASSES FROM THIS BUSINESS.  They need training in customer service.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: Diner beware! Worst sushi place ever! Their sashimi is as thin as a blade! When you tries to order many sashimi, they will tricked you, they'll cut it in in half of more to count it as one lol  they cheat you here! Not worth the money that we paid for! And their rolls, they'll put a lot of rice so you will get full in no time hahahaha Look at the picture that I posted here. Not worth it! Found ourselves the best sushi place here and it is called Asaka Japanese Restaurant at 82nd street I will highly recommend it than this junky sushi place

1. Pick-up time: very good. I was in and out within 15 minutes. However they tried to sell me extra insurance when I didn't want any of it. 
2. The car was okay. It smelled of spices though which was not very nice. 
3. Upon returning the car, they charged me $15 for fuel because I had driven less than 50 miles and didn't have a gas receipt. I wasn't even given the opportunity to go and fill gas at the gas station they have on site. I was very upset by the customer service and extra charge I got. I wasn't informed about it when I picked up the car and I won't be renting from them again.

This is the second time with in 6 months I have taken my girlfriend and kids out for some sushi here. Last time service wasn't good. Slow and hardly ever checked in with you. Well tonight wasn't any better. Ordered a sushi platter and a sashimi platter. Both were OK, honestly Kroger makes about the same or better on the sushi. Sushi rolls were warm (hope it was the fresh rice). Also I ordered a adult beverage and it never came and she had to take it off my bill.....Probably be the last time I come back. Mediocre  sushi and very very poor service! Save your money and go to Kroger and get sushi and a bottle of wine then Netflix and chill....

If I could select a negative on this chart I would do let me just say: if you want flies in your hot lunch bar, come here. If you want fruit flies in your fruit and veg aisle come here. If you want brown and not fresh red meat, come here. I was happy when they opened. Not anymore. At this point, date-check everything. Dairy probably still mostly okay. Highly over-salted prepared food. How can they hurt frozen food, so in theory that's a relatively safe bet. It has become a less than mediocre grocery and that is a generous statement, I am terribly sorry to say.

Went there on a holiday weekend when one of our pups got stung by a wasp, eye was half swollen shut. (insert awe poor baby here)

This pup is timid with new people and we mentioned this to the staff during the visit.  They were fantastic with her and she seemed comfortable with them.  Gave her a shot, checked for stinger and sent home with medicine.

While we love our pups, during this visit my inside voice was concerned with what the bill would end up costing us.  Felt there fees were very reasonable.

Overall we were were extremely pleased with everything!

This was a comfortable place to stay. Like others have stated, the beds are very comfortable. The room was definitely showing signs of wear but was clean. A fridge and microwave were included with the room which is a nice add. The downs was the location of the pool and fitness room. These were obviously added on later. The location of these were past the laundry facilities and cleaning personals rooms. Feels out of place when you are walking by in a bathing suit. Restaurant on site was good and very reasonably priced.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Truly one of my favorites! One of those you visit to completely transform what you think you like... the double decker is one of the most unique pizzas I've eaten, and is SOOOOO well balanced with sauce to cheese to toppings ratios. Even more to Babe's credit, it is still run with the small restaurant mindset that affords the nostalgia of an era gone by... when people say ace to face and had a great time at a pizza joint!
If you like unlimited refills, be sure to buy a pitcher of soda, as that same small restaurant mindset limits the unabashed amounts of high fructose corn syrup per serving. 
Highly recommended!

One of my daughters' favorite places to eat lunch. We don't even need a menu anymore to order. Lunch buffet is available weekdays. Ordering a pitcher of drinks which is refillable is a better deal than ordering individual drinks if you are getting the same flavor. Sign up for emails and receive coupons each month for discounts. They have a backroom section that you can reserve for meetings and parties at no extra charge. Each Monical's location varies slightly so you might notice some differences from location to location.

I love this restaurant so I brought my niece for a special 17th birthday dinner. She deemed it a highlight of her life! The gnocchi was perfect, as always. The service was spectacular, as always. She enjoyed a wonderful rendition of "Happy Birthday" sung by our waiter (Terry?) accompanied by a beautiful presentation of tiramisu (delish). The hug from Luigi made it a birthday to remember for her, she told everyone about it. The evening was perfect, she was over the moon and she will never forget it. Thanks, guys. Very well done.

Yokohama is a perfect example of teppanyaki style cooking - IE everything is prepared for you on a flat iron grill top. This is not an open flame, char your own meat like a barbarian style Japanese hibachi. The cook I had was personable and entertaining, the ingredients were high quality, and the seasonings was mild. The decor was tasteful, the place was very clean. The prices are on-par with other 'Benny Hannah' style restaurants. I think Yokohama is a nice dinner option for an otherwise mundane Tuesday night.

Since the manager (Kip) was let go ...the service is unbearable...the waitress have no clue about the menu....this is a byob restaurant we brought 1 bottle of wine where we waited 15-20 mins  for the waitress  to acknowledge our  table.  Finally  she just leaves the wine opener on the table and we assume she was coming back to open our wine, She never did!  In addition, she brought us dirty glasses.This happened twice since the old manager left.   We never had a bad experience here until now. We use to loved this place...!!!!!

Sad to say , we will not go back..too many other restaurants too choose from !

If I could give it 0 stars I would. First time ever trying Dunkin donuts...definitely the last time. I ask for a iced coffee with cream and sugar and the girl gives in a straight black coffee that tastes like 95% water and 5% coffee... I've never had coffee that looked like tea? Then I thought it would be an awesome treat to bring in donuts for the office & she hands me a 10 piece of the donut holes and says "we are all out of regular donuts" but there's donuts in the display? Don't get me started on the customer service. Would've been treated better at McDonalds.

DO NOT GO TO THIS LOCATION!! AWFUL

I have been an Accurate customer since 2008.  They have serviced two of my Acuras and my Honda Pilot that I purchased from them.  Their work is always done on time and without issues.  The service has included basic services like oil changes and serious work like timing belts.  I have never experienced any issues with the work performed by Accurate.  I always find them honest and very reasonably priced.  The waiting area is sufficient for me to get work done while I wait (free Wi-Fi and coffee are a nice perk).

Our room was broken into and a single pair of my dirty underwear was stolen, the room was ransacked, they went through our luggage and left food items ALL over the room. They also used the toilet and didn't flush. The troll at the front desk didn't believe me and refused to move us to a new room Bc we not only didn't feel safe, but there was URINE ALL OVER THE BATHROOM. Either someone has hacked their locks, or the employees are stealing women's underwear. I called NOPD and they took a report. This place a dangerous. Do not stay here if you are by yourself. Just don't stay here at all. Go somewhere else.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Dino's is a hidden gem tucked away under the Pontchartrain Expressway.

I've always driven past this establishment and it's quirky little signed, but never was tempted to enter. Well a friend and I were hungry one night and wanted so something low-key. So, we walked from his Warehouse District condo to Dino's.

To our surprise, once we walked in the place was surprisingly clean and definitely not what we pictured. The bartenders greeted us right away, told us to sit where we like.

We both had burgers, which hit the spot. What you'd expect from a typical bar/diner, but better. 

Would definitely return.

A little confused here I need this explained to me. I am a dark roast coffee drinker so when I asked for a cup and the young lady kindly explained to me she does not have that.  I asked you don't have it or you have to brew it?  She kindly let me know she can't just brew one cup and would have to brew the whole pot so she couldn't do it.  Umm, you sell coffee and donuts and you don't have your product ready to sell?  It shouldn't matter that you are closing in 20 minutes.  I'm trying to give you my money. Smh!!!

Currently sitting in the booth at this McDonalds. My Spicy Deluxe Chicken Sandwich was less than desirable. There was maybe a quarter sized dab of the sauce that even makes it spicy & it wasn't even assembled. Lettuce & tomato were loose in the box. Not only that but their indoor hours are posted on the door but they keep their doors locked to prevent people from coming inside to eat. Another customer leaving had to let us in, as with every customer after us. Hands down the WORST McDonalds in Indiana. Hands down.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
For the price of the room I felt The hotel to be lacking in many amenities found in lesser priced. hotels. 
1. There were four of us in the room but only three bath towels two face towels and two wash cloths.
2. Only one mirror in the room that was usable and when you have four people staying in the room that is unacceptable.
3. There were no hooks in the room behind the doors to hang a wet swimsuit.
4. You have to go up to your room to make the coffee there was no free coffee offered in the lobby.

5. The hotel staff was rude to a few of our party.

All I all although room was clean we found these deficiencies detracted from our stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I use to get the philly cheesesteak and it was the best in the world! We are going to get it again after years, I hope it's as good as I remember! --- that was my previous 5 star rating but now it's more like a 3, I went there yeaaars ago and it was Amazing! And the au jus was the best ever BUT this time it was nothing special really. The au jus was entirely different than it use to be and only tasted like water with a little tiny bit of onion/beef flavor.. It was all okay, just not my absolute favorite anymore like it use to be. Sorry

I went last Saturday to get a new acrylic set. The man who did them was so nice and so kind but he didn't do a good job. I managed to go the day with them still looking decent but the next morning I woke and broke of three my nails. They were very thick at the top and too thin in the middle so they just snapped right off. I went in today to get them fixed. And her response was you broke them so you'll have to pay for a new set. I was furious that I wasted all that money and they wouldn't even fix THEIR mistake. I do not recommend going there due to the fact of their community service and poor work. One star just for the kind older man.

If you're looking for inexpensive, quality food and a place to get your hair cut next door, then El Toro is the place to be. I would have loved to give this restaurant 4 stars, but the service was lackluster to say the least. We got our food before the waiter brought out our drinks, and it took a while to pay at the register. The chicken nachos were tasty and was the perfect sized portion for one. The restaurant was clean and parking was a breeze. The environment was family friendly and a great atmosphere for conversation with friends!

The car wash itself is fine and fast however when you get to the vacuums everyone is literally polishing their car or re-organizing the trunk in the "vacuum" space instead of vacuuming their vehicle which leaves you sitting there for 15 minutes hoping that you can get a spot to vacuum your car. There should be an employee regulating people vacuuming and leaving after vacuuming because the carwash rotates the cars too fast for all of these people to take up the spaces polishing their cars with a cloth when they can do that at home. Again the spots are for "Vacuuming" we dont want to sit and stare at someone polishing their vehicle

I pass this place everyday and always see people sitting on the picnic benches or in their cars enjoying their ice cream, so one day my girlfriend and I decided to check it out. It was great! They have a bunch of choices (hard/soft serve, shakes, sorbet, sundaes, etc) and the staff was so nice. A girl named Makenzy served us and was so sweet; we got our order right away. There are some places around the building that's really nice to hang around on those warm summer evenings when the whole neighborhood's out

We went there while I was in town visiting my sister.  We had a group of 5 and started with a round of small plates to share.  They were all delicious (Brussell Sprouts, Buffalo Cauliflower, Spaetzle and Sausage and Pork Belly.  Since we weren't all very hungry we got the Parpadelle Lamb dish, Hangar Steak and Scallops Dish.  Pasta was the best, steak was okay and the scallops were disappointing.

1 Bad dish out of 7 isn't too bad and it wasn't inedible, just not up to par.  Would go back again when in town.  Loved the variety of small plates for sharing with the table.

As an airport bar , it is spacious and has live music - something you rarely see in an airport bar.  Beer selection was okay with 8 taps of the usuals plus a couple of locals. Had the Fat Bottom IDA which was light and really tasty. Service is okay - not particularly friendly but adequate.  I didn't eat, but the travelers around me had a variety of selections that looked pretty appetizing. 
If stuck on C concourse with time to kill - you could do far worse than the Gibson Cafe. Don't forget to tip the performers (they work only for tips)!

I purchased a very simple ham and cheese sandwich for my kids.  There was a line of workers to keep things moving along somewhere along that line my sandwich was switched with the person next to me.  When I got home my kids sandwich was the totally wrong sandwich.  When I returned to the subway to get a correct order, and asked if they were going to compensate me for the 45 minutes of lost time they simply shook their head no and said they would make me the right sandwich.  Totally unprofessional !!!  People, and this means the owners of this place, should be responsible for their business and the mistakes they make or get out of business.

Food ok
Yesterday went to celebrate a birthday, chef didn't like that we were not impressed with his antics at the hibachi table- we have seen it all before.
Called one of my guests the big guy- not good.
Slopped food on my sister in law when putting food on the plate- rice burnt her as it was to hit the plate not her- 
I gave a 15% tip because I get that you tip- surprised to find on my debit card I was charged 20%
--maybe that is a policy- if you sit at hibachi table you have a service fee? BUT - very sloppy and disrespectful-

What a professional and great organization! Dr Laurie Prober is AMAZING- my little dog had been having GI issues for over a year. Multiple vets and ER visits (at other locations) later, we still had a sick pup. She helped with diagnosis and treatment and now he is eating well and happy without vomiting blood! She is a great diagnostician with an amazing bedside manner. Thanks as well to the great billing staff/billing manager- there had been an insurance snafu but they went above and beyond to make sure that it was resolved. Highly recommend.

This place is new. Is very clean very friendly they do a wonderful pedicure if you get a spa pedicure and a
Gel manicure is very poor. I've been getting them done since I've had my acrylics taken off which was back in August. Every time I get a gel manicure I have to go back and have at least one or two nails repainted because they chip! They try to tell me it's because my nails are weak!   I even bought structure gel to have them. apply and it still chipping.  Someone said it may be due to cheap bonding polish that they're using.  I give up!!!!    Next.....

After 4 days

Terrible place, bartenders drunk friend was belligerent and was allowed to constantly get in me and my friends personal space at first, yell from across the bar slander and later threats all at the side of and while chatting with the bartender. I asked the bartender if he was his friend and going to allow this and he just smiled and said ya. Both bartenders allowed it to happen till I left. 

Furthermore terribly mixed drinks ( no basic knowledge of cocktails), terrible wine list and ghetto unprofessional staff that aren't capable of anything but handing you bottled beer. There is literally nothing appealing this place offers.

Did not have a very friendly staff. Tried calling the front desk 5 times before heading down on vacation to see when check in was and did not get an answer. Our bathtub was nasty and leaking under it so my dad clothes got soaked and so did one of our towels with water that smelled absolutely disgusting. The first day was perfect finding parking because it was a decent size parking lot and then the second night we couldn't even find parking! We had to drive all the way back up to the front of the hotel to park and walk to our room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
They seem very nonchalant about their online presence and advertises prices that are no longer valid.
I offered to be the pick up person for coworkers and was told that the price for the dishes were raised by $3 and basically offered a take it or leave it scenario. I get that mistakes happen and things aren't updated as regularly as they should, but the check out person's attitude was nonchalant and disrespectful. What she basically said was she would rather throw out the food that honor the advertised price . Won't return!

The place is kind a hard to find sort of like a diamond in the rough. Once you get to Chef Vargas prepared to be amazed Did the core is comfortable the menu was wide and everything is made fresh to order he uses nothing about organic vegetables and fruits the chicken and waffles rivals Roscoes also The nutella French toast  is off the chain. I've heard Saturday night is Mexican night I have yet to try it but I can't wait to next Saturday definitely a cool spot to grab excellent burger breakfast or some excellent sweets. Check it out for sure

I had a wonderful experience here and just wanted to give them the 5 stars they deserve. I  was recommended here by someone who regularly gets her pixi cut here, so I was hoping for the best as I was about to take the same plunge. I saw John and he was so sweet and funny! He was sure to ask me questions of what my expectations were before just diving right in and I really appreciated that. He did an AMAZING job and I would certainly recommend to a friend. The staff were so nice and even got me in the same day I called :)

We had a 7:00pm reservation and weren't seated till 7:30pm. We didn't leave till 9:30 because it took forever to be served. We also had a toddler with us. Warning: don't even think about bringing a child here because it inevitably will take 2 hours for everything. The wait staff is not friendly and while some food items are great, Fellinis is a bit overrated for what you go through to eat. My husband had the braised short rib special and it was way too fatty. I had the striped bass special and it was bland. Gelato is amazing. I'll give them that, but that's about it....

I love McDonald's. I frequent all of them. Unfortunately, this restaurant consistently needs more help and better management. Not only did they close the inside dinning room, the drive-through was so slow I started using the curbside pick up, but today they've now posted handwritten signs indicating no curbside service in front of each parking spot.  The sign uses staffing as an excuse for the poor service, I'd feel bad for McDonald's except the chicken place right across the street always seems to have plenty of friendly, helpful, hard-working staff. I think we'll start patronizing the later more often.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Seminole Heights is an up and coming foodie area. So I decided to try the refinery for the first time for brunch. 
Be aware....parking is very limited. 

They serve southern style food and I'm really not a southern cookin type of girl. I ordered the Grits & Grillades because it seemed like the lightest and most healthiest item on the menu and my friend had the Daddy's Favorite. 

I liked my dish, but I wasn't expecting it to be on the stewy side. My friend's Daddy's Favorite looked like a heart attack waiting to happen, although she liked it.

I would return to try the dinner menu.

Don't let the one star fool you this property is a complete disgrace. The employees do NOT change the bed sheets on a daily basis (our bathroom was disgusting), the front desk people are as INCOMPETENT as they come, and the breakfast service is horrendous. Not to mention the flat out rude managers. Yes it's a new hotel but DON'T waste your time or money here, you will regret it! You are not a guest to them you are just a means to keep them afloat. Will certainly never stay here again and will be sure to tell all my fellow travelers as well as anyone else the same!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: First visit was a Groupon. (They are on Groupon for a reason). Sashimi was good, service was slow. Wasn't a fan of my entree. They didn't have duck in stock. I have returned twice for the lunch special sushi rolls, 2 for 6.99. Paid an extra 1$ for crunchy. Problem was the spicy tuna was not spicy, usually spicy tuna includes a spicy mayo but they don't serve it that way. I could tasted crunchy on maybe 2 pieces. Literally just tuna and rice.. so plain. Excited about the new sushi restaurant opening up next to Acme! I will not be returning to Kyoto.

The rooms were not well maintained. The carpet hadn't been vacuumed in weeks. I asked the staff to vacuum my room and they didn't. The closet door was broken. The bathroom floor was not mopped either. They designed the shower so that half of the shower water gets the floor wet. When I informed the staff about this they recommended I use more towels.

Also the mattresses were terrible. There was depression in the middle. This didn't make for a comfortable sleep either.

They shouldn't use the excuse that they are in the middle of a renovation. You can't polish shit!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My boyfriend has been wanting to go to this place since he moved to the Brandon area. We finally got a chance to experience it. The service and the people were friendly. I really enjoy the train theme and the small town feeling of the place. Our server was knowledgeable about the history of the place and friendly. We ordered the double decker babe's special. The crust was amazing each bite was perfectly crispy, I thought the sauce could use a little more salt. However my boyfriend loved it. It is a combination of New York and Chicago style pizza. I would would recommend this place if your looking for a small town pizza experience.

If I could give Hertz a zero star review I would. First they give us a van that is leaking gas, next we stay on hold with their roadside assistance for 7 HOURS before finally giving up. The next morning my husband goes to their location in the town we are staying as soon as they are open and they give us a car that is too small for us because 5 other cars have already been exchanged that morning......
We had to drive home with luggage in our laps and the best they could do was knock $200 off of the $1300 rental.
NEVER USE THIS COMPANY

As everyone is complaining about and they KEY thing that needs to be improved is the SHUTTLE SERVICE.... and I fail to understand how hard is it to fix that? Based on all the complaints about the shuttle service it definitely looks like no one from this location is monitoring the reviews!!! Which shows how much they care..

With the new "pick your car from the Gold lane or Presidential circle lane" its easy to pick a car, and at times there is a decent selections so I have no complaints about, the in/out process and the condition of the cars!!

Just fix the Shuttle Service and a lot of reviews will improve.

Horrible nail techs and owner in this facility......the guy that works there quits when he wants and comes back when he wants.  The owner always had an attitude.  The English is terrible.  one tech speaks no English at all.  I had an appointment that I arrived early for but was not informed that the guy quit until I waited almost 20 mins until she felt like stop point what she was doing to tell me because the pedicurist speaks no English......(the owner Toni said he quit but I think she lied).  I suggest taking your money elsewhere.......this place is not professional and has horrible service.

Lived at the Gossett 1 year and couldn't wait for the lease to expire! The Staff is non-responsive to office visits or emails, the key fobs don't work so you are constantly locked out of your home/building/parking, the walls are paper-thin so you hear your neighbors day/night, dog shit is everywhere including the pool and parking garage, my delivery packages were stolen 3 times even though they have camera and secured lockers, and the final incompetence  was $2.63 return check for $2265.00 deposit with no explanation or itemized bill!! Stay FAR away, it's absolutely horrible and deserving of such bad Rating!!!

We made reservations and showed up to find the hotel in full renovation. Water to be off from 12 to 2 and noise begin at 8 am. No where prior was this mentioned when booking. You pay top dollar for the pleasure of staying here and was denied a discount. After pressing for some kind of  compensation we got breakfast tickets for one day out of two days that we are staying. Parking is 14.95 per day! Hotel parking should be free. Since your in a city I guess you should be walking? We can deal with this for just 2 days but, Never again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Man. This pizza is not good. Especially for THIRTY GD DOLLARS. Ordered the 18" thin crust veggie lover with andouille sausage. The veggies were basically all raw. The green peppers crunched and overpowered the entire pizza. Black olives were definitely from a tin can. The sausage was so chewy. The crust. Ugh. Don't even bother. I've had better frozen pizza crust. It was SO DRY. Like a previous review said, it tasted like a cracker. I usually don't leave bad reviews, but this pizza is just... not good. At all. Spend your $30 elsewhere. Ugh. The two stars are for the service because the people who handed us our pizza were nice. That's all.

This was a disappointment. The springroll appetizer was flavorless and appeared to have been from frozen commercial stock. The sauce came in little packets. We told the waitress they were inedible and sent them back. Fortunately they were inexpensive as they didn't take them off the bill. The tempura was good (7.5 out of 10) and reasonably priced, but the accompanying salad was chopped lettuce right out of a bag. I was hoping for a nice Asian dressing, but only two choices: ranch (from a bottle I think) and ginger. All told, the place is OK but I won't be back.

I waited to eat carbs for two weeks for this pizza. 
I called at 630 and ordered two basic pizza. Immedately i was told it would take 2-2.5 hours. first i was like nooo way and i should have gone with that instinct. I continued to order the pizza and was told to be there exactly at 830 because of the them closing at 830..... on a SATURDAY LABOR DAY WEEKEND DURING A PANDEMIC. i showed up on time and it looked like they were still taking orders. pizza was soft and basic AF. for the wait i could have driven to ventura for organic pizza at fluid gardens and back. again BASIC AF

This Wendy's is the closest one to my house, which is the ONLY reason I go here at all.  The service sucks, the facilities are disgusting, but worst of all they ALWAYS mess up my order.  I even intentionally ordered 3 large number ones with cokes for all of them.  THE EXACT SAME ORDER!!!!! And they gave me a small frosty, 2 medium cokes, 2 burgers and a chicken sandwich.  On the receipt they rung me up for 2 small #2s. Are you fucking kidding me?!?  Don't waste your time going here, as I have.  These people don't give a shit about the job they do or anyone for that matter.

I just moved to doylestown and wanted to find the best salon to go to. Well being as though this place has good reviews I said hey why not. Well I asked for ballerina nails and I received round short nails. They are super thick and I think by far the worst nails I've ever got done. Worst $65 I've ever spent in my life. Super over priced and she rushed the whole time. I feel bad even writing this because the lady was so nice but, I literally left there and I want to take them off already. I can't believe I spent that amount of money on nails so awful.

It's a great location and the food was expensive but good, but we waited over an hour to be seated for two. We walked in and the hostess was on the phone and didn't acknowledge us. We waited for probably ten minutes for the seating hostess to help us but she never looked up. Another server finally saw us standing there, she put us on the list and promised to text us when a table was ready but then forgot about us until we checked in again over 50 minutes later. After waiting some more they found seats for us at the bar. Service was decent after we were seated, but definitely disappointing first experience. Not sure we'll go back.

I came in and got my nails done with 3 other girls. We called and made an appointment and was told $48 dollars for long acrylics. I will give them the recognition of good customer service, but the prices we received were not appropriate. We werent told until after our nails were done that we were meant to pay 100+ for mediocre nails. When we brought up the prices given to us on the phone they said that that was the price for short nails. They are not willing to negotiate and are very rude when you question the prices.

Ok, came back for follow up lunch. Cougars were too hung over to hang out with their white jeans. Restaurant wasn't as noisy and filled with old school main line wanna bees! Server was great food was beyond average. My brother in law ordered the tuna salad. He politely asked waitress if tuna was fresh and she said no! It is from a can with oil but we prepare the salad so you can't tell. Insane! They charged $13.00 for an .89 cent chicken of the sea canned tuna! Ridiculous! Stay away! Better to go to Whole Foods down the street! Below average! Over priced!

Below average food, service was ok after server jumped into action when she realized that the bar tab was going to be larger than the food bill. Parking is terrible, should have Valet....Lot's of room for improvement. NYC prices insulting with regards to food quality and noise.  Will try again if reservation available. Should not be a problem when the Main Line Cougars go back to the White Dog or the Cricket Club, or find a better place on Match.COM Great people watching, much better than the food. Not worth a Doggie bag with regards to the people or the food.

Dirty cars always smell like refer smoke and have warning lights blinking all in the dash. The location is about 15 min shuttle ride from the airport, meaning NO WHERE NEAR THE AIRPORT. They run one shuttle at a time, so you'll be waiting for 30 mins at each end. Ridiculous that this is sorted as "on airport" in travel car rental sites. Get hertz, enterprise or even dollar rental, their counters are actually inside the airport and the cars are just out side. DO NO BOOK WITH SLOWXT. I'll never book with them again. Caution they win almost all the discount site bookings, so be careful using those sites in Indianapolis.

Will never go back again. They are always rude and act like your not spending your money. I walk in the back to get my eyebrows waxed and they tell me they don't do waxing on weds! It was an insult because the girl who did it last time was there. Are you serious? They also need to get with the times. I go because it's close but I will drive out of my way for friendly service. If you are looking for up to date designs and friendly service cashmere nails on Westfield is the spot to go they treat you like family! Tina the owner stayed open later for me because I had an event! Now that's love.

I ate here in November 2020 as a last resort because the seafood place next door had a 1.5 hour long wait. The sushi was reasonably priced as most places I've been to but the food is extremely mediocre. I expected more from a place right next to the ocean. Also the trash can next to the door attracted so many birds that it is hard to sit and eat. I also saw one of the workers put her hand in the trash to push it down further, she walked back Into the kitchen, didn't wash her hands and grabbed more plates of sushi to bring out to people. I wouldn't recommend it. Plan ahead and go somewhere else.

Stumbled upon el doradito while passing through AZ from California on the road to Texas, and it was great! I had the beef fajita combo plate and my boyfriend had the #1 combo and we both enjoyed them. My flour tortillas were paper thin and tasty. We got chips and salsa also; the salsa was a little more watery than I was expecting but definitely wasn't lacking in heat or flavor. The homemade chips were definitely a plus! Super crunchy and delicious. Its close proximity to I-10 would bring me back if I am in the area again.

This is my new favorite restaurant in the area! The prices are surprisingly super reasonable and totally worth it for the taste and presentation of each plate.. the restaurant is very nice and the people working are so helpful and friendly! The chef, Alexander actually came out and made some suggestions that would fit our preferences which was super nice! Our server Vlad was very accommodating.. he brought us out samples to try when buying bottle of wine which were only $30 a bottle. Alex (Dave) made our desserts which were great! We loved everything ! I would  highly recommend this restaurant, such a wonderful experience :)

My 12 years old daughter and I went there to get our nails done. I told them what she was having done,  because they separated us and at that time. While she was with her Jerk of a tech, the tech kept trying to up sell her. she kept telling her that her mother would be paying for it and to just go ahead and have her eyebrows done and to get better nails services. which made my daughter uncomfortable although she told her no. The tech put gel polish on her nails which ended up costing more. I will NEVER be back. and the next day my daughter nail popped right off. Money and time wasted. Never again.

This is one of the worst establishments for service in the area. When in there had the buffet and it was 2:15 PM, buffet goes till 3 PM. They had very little pizza on their buffet in fact they ran out. We were only able to have one or two slices of pizza each and the salad. And for $8.95 they did not credit anything, And they did not let us know prior to ordering that they would not be putting anything else out on the buffet. Needless to say I will never be back and I'm giving it a one star rating for service and the pizza was subpar. Much better places out there for the price this was not worth it.

DO NOT STAY HERE!!! This is the worst hotel experience I've ever had. First, the night audit clerk was just an amazingly awful person. It makes zero sense to treat people the way this woman treated me. It would be one thing if I was rude to her. I wasn't. She was just gross. Second, i Tried to check in after I Pre-paid for my reservation through Hotels.com. I had to work late in NV which was four hours away. I arrived at 2:30am to check in. If there was a policy for checking in too late, it is no where to be scene on Hotels.com. "Monster lady" couldn't find my reservation. Never stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This was our first trip to Bella Aquila.

The food was good but not exceptional.  The service was better than average (our water glasses were never empty) and our waitress was pleasant.  The prices were OK and quality was fine.  The desserts were OK (chocolate flour-less cake and chocolate turtle pie).  They were served too cold and they looked factory made vs. something made at the restaurant (I have no idea where they were actually made).

Decent food, service, and prices, but nothing I'd label "great".

We may go back at some time.

Thanks to all the Yelpers who helped us find this fantastic store, with an amazing selection of craft beers at great prices that you can buy individually or in make-your-own-six packs.  (I will never understand PA beer laws, but anyplace where you don't have to buy 4,000 beers at once is worthy of note.)  The selection beat anyplace down by us (right outside DC), and there were tons of breweries we'd never seen before, as well as a good selection from bigger names (the Bruery, Hardywood, etc.).  Definitely worth a trip!

Just went there this morning for breakfast, Ordered Big breakfast, two orders of hotcakes and sausage and four hash brown. That would seem simple enough they handed me two bags did a quick peak all look good I drove myself so couldn't dig through like I usually would get home empty the bags...no SYRUP! two orders of hotcakes...no SYRUP!! it wasn't busy I'm guessing from the rain but to me shouldn't matter if it was busy these people wants $15 an hour??? Pancakes and Syrup wow that's difficult!! I'll never go there again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I called to find out if they would be able to put in a starter on my 2009 BMW Ricky answered the phone and was very helpful gave me an extremely great price .  I told him I was going to have my car towed over to his garage he explain to me again that he had a tow company that was very inexpensive and that they would bill through the garage. Within 30 minutes the car was towed to his garage and the work was done in three hours I have my car completed and under four hours before I even got out of work . I highly recommend this garage. I'm even going to get my brakes done tomorrow

We stayed two nights at the hotel, the staff was very courteous and helpful. Once we entered the room we noticed that room was very clean and smelled good. Once inside we tested the beds And they were very comfortable. The pillows were a little soft and crunchy. In the bathroom we noticed that the hairdryer was taped together at each end. The breakfast that they served was outstanding full of variety of things for you to choose from and the seating area was huge. 
The one negative that I have to say is there needs to be a ventilation system in the bathroom. It gets very hot and steamy in the bathroom.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Avocado was brown. I send the roll back saying the avocado was brown and the sushi chef argued with me saying that avocado changes color and it was perfectly fine. They offered me half price off the roll since they didnt find anything wrong with serving brown acocado in their sushi. Clearly the sushi chefs here do not respect their own food enough to serve fresh ingredients. I used to come here very often when I lived there but this is the first time I have been back in years. Something has gone terribly wrong with the quality control because they have no issue serving food that is not fresh.

Was there on 1/4/19 with 3 other friends and they had a sign outside advertising 2 for 1 Happy Hour.... after confirming the 2 for 1 happy hour at the bar, we ordered 4 drinks and when the bartender rang me up, it was $48! When we asked for clarification, she said the 2 for 1 was for beer only which she failed to mention initially. After asking to speak to a manager, we were told that there wasn't one available... the band was great, though! Just too bad they trick you to come in when there are so many other competitive bars to choose from on Bourbon!

It takes upwards of 20 minutes to get through the drive thru. More often than not, the microphone and or speaker won't be working, so you have to wait for the cars ahead to move so you can order at the window. At that point it takes 3-5 minutes for a simple order like a doughnut and black coffee to be ready. I've never gotten a wrong order or a bad attitude, but nonetheless the drive thru tests my patience each time I go. Rarely will there not be a line, but when there is, be prepared to spend way more time than at any other Dunkin'.

Rented at Philadelphia Airport from Dollar. The shuttle goes by about every 15 minutes. I had to wave them down because the driver was too lazy to pull over to the curb like all the other shuttles do. It took me 1/2 hour to get to the car center. The car was OK but beware, they will try to enter additional insurance without your approval so go over the contract carefully before you take the car. If you're not in any rush then rent from them. I don't have that luxury traveling for business. I usually rent from National or Enterprise. Their service is much better.

1* for the delivery driver.

Ordered Kung Po Chicken & Chicken Lo Mein. The Kung Po was over cooked and chewy. The lo mein was soggy and lacked any flavor. Everything smelled like shellfish. 

I called to inquire about the food quality and the woman at New China told me bring it back. I reminded her I got delivery, she told me to just bring it some other time when I can. She will look at it then.. huh? I requested a refund and was told no refund. 

Don't waste your money here. I just threw the food out and placed a replacement order with Asian Yummy House.

This place is awful. The apts are very small. You have to pay extra for anything. For updated appliances extra. Washer and dryer extra. They tow your cars. I got towed even though I'm a resident. Management is not helpful. If you want a cheap place to rent in St Pete then come here... I was looking for cheap but I would gladly pay more to live somewhere else. I recommend west port colony. I lived there last year but paid 1200 a month and was looking to save a little so I moved down the street to Lincoln shores. Worse decision of my life. I can't wait till my lease is up.

Can not get a hold of anyone from Chase.  Amazon keeps directing me to Chase.  Every time someone comes on line, they hang up on me.  I want to cancel this card, but Chase is hard to get a hold of.  DO NOT fall for their prime and rewards.  Rewards are useless unless you like trendy food places you have never heard of.  Very poor customer service.  They also transfer your call to different countries with different languages.  Cannot understand a thing they are saying.  Outsourcing our American jobs.  Shame on Amazon!  I will report to the FTC and Consumer Affairs that I cannot talk to anyone at Chase to cancel this card.

Wish I had looked at the ratings before ordering. Years ago I loved MG. I've even eaten in one of their overseas locations. They changed the penne rustica recipe. It was not hot, the penne was too al dented and no longer had sausage. The waitress said the house wine was honor system but immediately removed the bottle after pouring one glass, which wasn't very good especially for the $7 price served in the cutoff bottom of a wine bottle. They filled chapter 11 last November and I don't expect them to last much longer. Hope corporate reads this.

Sanja is amazing.  She is so vibrant and fun.  A consummate professional who clearly  has extensive knowledge and expertise in fitness.  I am visiting from California and have taken a couple of Classes with Sanja: Punch HIIT and Accelerate HIIT and she is phenomenal.  She does not talk down to attendees, she corrects movements and posture when needed, and most importantly she is such a great motivator.  I absolutely love her and will be sad when I have to leave.

They definitely need to put pull down sun shades up on the windows because it is hard to see sometimes when working out in the HIIT zone.  Someone may get injured.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: First off, this is no longer a Greystone property so that's false advertisement. I've been a resident for almost two years now and have noticed a huge decline in the quality of the management staff here since parting ways with Greystone. The maintenance staff no longer takes pride in the image of the property. They hardly pressure wash the building, they don't clean the light fixtures in the hall (dead bugs are piling up), the valet trash is inconsistent and "24 hour emergency maintenance" is not at all 24 hours. The only consistent thing about the upkeep of the property would be the lawn care. I would definitely reconsider before moving here.

Shopping experience was great!!! I love the sub sandwich from this the deli. Felicia and the staff are nice and efficient. Always good I've had twice and next time I'm in town or any city that has a Publix I will try again. Grocery shopping here is always a pleasure at this location. 

Headed to Miami soon and will go there when I go. I've loved Publix from the first time in New Orleans about 22 years ago. Always a very friendly people and food always fresh. When I travel I always attempt to see if they have a Publix and tell others about this store.

This is an  above average hotel restaurant, and worth a visit even if you are not a guest at Hilton Garden Inn. There is an awesome view of the city skyline, including City Hall with William Penn perched in top! The decor is relaxing with lovely contemporary design. And the food was excellent, altho we only had a salad and burger. There is nothing else like it near by for dinner. Reading Terminal Market closes at 6 and most other well reviewed restaurant s were in Chinatown. We  were very happy with our choice.

I will try other rental car companies at PHL and see if they are any better. I don't have an issue with the cars, but I think they only run one bus to and from the terminals. It takes forever to get picked up (I started walking over and it's much faster, but you do have to cross the terminal road to get there). Getting back to the terminal at drop off is incredibly frustrating as I typically wait at least 15 minutes for a bus to arrive.
I can't afford to waste the 30-45 minutes waiting for Hertz to pick me up and drop me off. Painful.

Not great.  Liked the location so I kept trying to give it a another chance (like 3 or 4 times).  Had different people cut my hair to see if that would make a difference.  Every time, I ended up with a mediocre haircut that was over priced.  Regarding price, you can expect to pay more in the city which is fine, but I also expect good service that would include a neck shave.  It really  just feels like they are in a hurry to get you done even if there is no one else in the place.  Sorry Duke, I hate to leave a negative review, but I really tried to like the place.

One star is too high of a rating.
Stayed here Mar. 21, 2017. Made advanced reservation a week earlier for a king bed and when I got there around 5pm they had no more kings. No discount, just sorry! They know they can jerk you around because of the lack of hotels in that area for the need.

*** Then I found a huge industrial size staple in my bed along with some unknown food item, between the fitted sheet and the flat sheet. See the 2 pictures. WOW! Unbelievable.

AVOID THIS PLACE, sleep in your car if you have to.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We've been regular customers of Magpies in the thirteen years we have lived here. At the old location, just north of Ina on Oracle the pizza was at least acceptable and occasionally even good. Since moving to the new location it is really inedible. We've tried it three times now, after calling and telling the store how bad it was after the first two, and nothing has changed. If what you want is raw dough covered with burned toppings go ahead. Definitely the worst pizza we have ever had three times in a row We'll never order anything from Magpies again.

Went to a sold out show here recently - I would try to avoid this venue in the future for several reasons.  1. It is cramped and crammed - the person who mentions 'its like watching a concert on an airplane' pretty much nailed it.  However, that is not the worst of it.  The person who runs the place (and I think owns it) is just plain rude and NOT a good host.  Getting a smile out of most of the staff is also a challenge.  In balance - the food was good and the sound was fine.  But overall - I hope artists I like to see avoid this venue.

If you are just there for dinner -- it is a nice place...

Went in and ordered a meatball sandwich, let them know I would like to have the works as far as toppings go as I have always done with no problem at other locations, but then I was told I was relegated to 3 toppings only, these are new people that are in this location now, I am hoping other locations are true to traditional subway shops where you can get whatever toppings you like and then to top it off I saw a fly buzzing around the food, needless to say I won't be patronizing there again, that place for now has turned my taste buds off for subway sandwiches for a very very long time if ever again, yuck!

We usually go here on Sunday mornings and I'd say 50% of our visits are alright. Half the time they get our order right, the other half it is wrong. It seems like they just dont care enough to double check if everything is right. We have gotten smashed food, wrong variations to our food, and today got a bagel with extremely little cream cheese. They struggled to understand our order, and after repeating it multiple times still got it wrong (a simple order of a bagel, 2 donuts, and a hot chocolate). I dont think the employees care too much about their jobs, and it shows.

If I could give just one point of a star that's what this Dunkin Donuts would get because they SUCK!!! I waited 25 min for a breakfast sandwich, that's with 4 people on staff at the 8 am hour, if I hadn't said anything it probably would've been longer. After I mentioned "Am I ever going to get my sandwich" it took them less than 5 min to make it... I advise anyone that lives in the Sparks, NV area to just bypass Dunkin Donuts and go to Donut Bistro on Pyramid, atleast you get your order right away. The manager and the owner better start rethinking their plan of service because we had better service when Krispy Kreme was on Reno...

The good: 
-drinks from the bar were delicious and stiff. 

The bad:
-waitress failed to give us straws for our water until after our entrees arrived. 
-mozzarella sticks arrived completely hollow with no cheese inside (sounds impossible, but see the picture)!
-appetizer plate contained incorrect item. 
-slow and in attentive service - we were only asked how our food was when we were handed the bill, despite multiple problems with our meal. 

Overall, this was the worst meal I've had in quite a while. Go somewhere else unless you're only sitting at the bar!

We were in town for a dance competition at the Gaylord.  ALL restaurants were packed and refused to take reservations.  Romano's accepted our reservation and the service was impeccable.  Our server's name was Jackie and she truly was the best server we have ever had.  We actually called the manager over to let her know what an outstanding job Jackie did  with our large group of 10.  Food was good.  You basically know what you are getting at Romano's.  Bread and olive oil are amazing and all of the apps we ordered were great.  Dinners are good but not great.  I'll be back and I will ask for Jackie!!!

I told them when I arrived that I would like to have a pedi with hard gel vs gel polish on my toes. I sat and waited my turn and after I was finally back soaking, they told me they can't do gel on toes. I have been having this done for many years and acrylic before then. I get hard gel because my nails are super brittle and it's the only thing that works for me. Otherwise my nails break down into the nail bed. I don't understand what the difference is if they can do them on fingers they should be able to do them on toes. I've never had an issue anywhere before and have even had it done here in the past, although that was several years ago.

Fabulous fresh and great prices on lunch menu. I had the grilled shrimp and spinach salad which was quite honestly the best salad I've ever had. All simple fresh ingredients like i would make at home. The mussel app was the LARGEST succulent mussels in a homemade red sauce I have ever seen or tasted. Yummy ! I am gluten free and the only reason I don't give this place 5 stars is they should consider putting a gluten free crust on the menu. A wood fired pizza oven should have that option. Also a gluten free pasta is easy to stock. If the owners read this, please add this to your menu and your place will be perfect!!!!!

This place is absolutely atrocious. Food is overpriced and sub par, Bathrooms are disgusting, and staff and management are unfriendly and ignorant. They treat everyone like a drunk 21 year old even if you are older. I was actually physically removed from the establishment by bouncers for wanting to talk to the GM for there being a receipt served in my drink. Completely unprofessional night shift manager. If hair or rats are served in your food or drink according to him he'll have whatever is left replaced and expects the full bill to be paid. I would not recommend this place to anyone.

Went for lunch 12/30/14 and it was lousy! The tuna melt looked like a small open faced sandwich I could make at home. At a restaurant, I am looking for a larger restaurant bread and a better display of food. The waitress was a bit short with her words which made it seem like she was being rude without trying. Also, the white curtains are very dirty making them seem very grey. Not to mention the pricey selections. The alcoholic beverage was not good at all either. This was the 1st and the LAST time I will be eating here.

My first time wasn't bad and my nails lasted for 3 weeks but My second time going there was horrible my gel polished chip the same day, I had one of the older ladies and she was beyond rude...I went in for a gel manicure and she just filed my nails didn't do anything else...my polish look like a 5 year old did it...when it was time for me to check out I gave her my card in her hand she threw it on the counter after she charged me...I never received this kind of customer service I don't recommend this place at all

I think it's wonderful that we're providing a place for homeless families to stay. That said, I think that ought to be disclosed. Because parents who are most worried about sheltering and feeding their families, and dealing with continuity of their children's education, are less concerned with things like noise interrupting other hotel guests.
The room itself was fine and I like the idea that they labeled the pillows- two soft, two firm- but it was darn noisy in the morning.
Also they should look around and dust once in a while- the amount of dust in the overhead radiators was awful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This hotel was absolutely dreadful. The only reason I rated one star was because that was the absolute minimum. The hotel staff was completely disorganized and lacked urgency when it came to checking in. Check in was 3pm, I arrived at 10am, and did not receive a room until 4:30pm. I booked this room weeks in advance and I had a conference at 5! Along with incompetent, the staff was very disrespectful. I called for an extra blanket the night I stayed and upon arriving, the staff member hit on me. Yuck! I will never stay at this hotel again or recommend it to anyone. I would have been better off at a motel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This hotel is a total gem! The lobby is absolutely gorgeous! Plus, it features a pool table and bar for when you're looking to get out of your room, but not leave the building. Although I was more than happy to hang in my room because of the really comfortable bed, mini-fridge, big screen tv (complete with Hulu and Netflix), and charging stations (which made charging my phone, iPad, and camera so easy). Plus, the view in my room was great! I also loved how this hotel uses the cruelty-free Bliss brand for their shampoos and soaps. Just a great hotel all around!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Eaten here many times and was great. Now since covid I have tried take out a couple times. 1st time gave me the wrong roll. 2nd time I checked carefully my order which was correct but discovered no wasabi or ginger. Had to go to grocery to get my own. It's details in service and getting the order correct to be successful and finding fresh fish in Reno. It might be the difficulty in finding good employees nowadays but just want let the owner know who I have met a couple times that I am disappointed and will not return. Also the sign at the front reception is horrible.

We've lived here almost a year. The fire alarms go off at LEAST once a month. The garage gates are broken at least every other week. Non residents are constantly taking spaces in our deck, but they have zero cameras or security. They say they will ticket and boot, but that hasn't ever happened. The elevators are also broken about half the time I try to take one. The staircases actually smell like urine. There is one that I literally cannot enter without covering my face in my clothes because it's so nauseating. But instead of addressing any of these issues, the staff throws three socials a month that are pretty meh.

Once we found this restaurant it became our "Go To" place when we want a fine dining evening. We went the first time on a whim and had a fabulous meal served by one of the best waiters we have ever had - his name is Sasha. They have superb wine selection and wonderful food. My wife's sister and her husband (back home) have two restaurants with an Italian flair, so we know what good Italian food should be like. Another good point is the valet parking as parking along the beach is in very short supply.  Overall it is just a warm and wonderful evening.

The food is generally good, especially their breakfast menu. I had lunch there today and the owner/manager served us, so I was surprised to see she was comfortable serving a sandwich  that didn't have the chips and pickle on the side, as described on the menu and that looked like is was cut in half with a chainsaw (it was a club, but the bread was torn apart so that the sandwich had to be eaten with a knife and fork). I'll likely go back, but The Great American Diner about four miles down 95 is a better option (albeit not as quaint).

I have found my FOREVER nail salon.  Anne and Michael did a great job on my Manicure and Pedicure.  Prices are also best in town.  The salon is so clean and calm.  I have finally found a salon that has the same technicians for years and not someone new everytime.   Anne asked if I wanted thick or thick gels - which is a first - so she is able to do them exactly how you want. 
Salon is on 66th - right off Tyrone - very convenient and lots of parking.   If you are looking for a Great salon - go here - you will be happy and this will be your Forever salon.

I eat here alot, and would give it four stars for the SJ area, but only three if you venture into philly or nyc.  There is better sushi if you're willing to go over one of the bridges, but of course, if you live in the neighborhood like I do, it's easier to travel 10 minutes and still leave satisfied.  I have been disappointed here only once on one roll and I value the consistency of a place.  I would rather pay for above average food that is reliably good than less for so-so food that often disappoints.  I would recommend this place.
