I came in with low expectations; I was very hungry, and it was late on a Friday.  I saw "white tuna," escolar, AKA ex-lax fishing the menu.  A very bad sign.  Once the food came, the salad dressing looked more like peanut butter than carrot ginger.  The California Roll was mushy, with bland sushi rice. The tempura used panko for the coating instead of real tempura batter.  I think they tried, but they just didn't use the correct ingredients.  Wish them luck with their future business, but I will not be returning.

Def wanted to try this place because of the reviews but was very disappointed by the service signing in.  Hostess was not welcoming, not friendly and seemed like she didn't want to assist us. She didn't even greet us, we had to engage her. The restaurant didn't seem very busy but we were ordering to go. I was told a two hour wait for take out which seemed exaggerated. I guess this business didn't need or want our business and the hostess definitely made it known to us with her awful service. That's fine but personally I wouldn't waste my time again.

Overall the south Reno Surfthru does an above standard job.  I have recommended it to friends who purchased monthly passes as I did.  The staff are always friendly.  My biggest complaint is with the accounting office.  More then once they have messed up my billing and it took forever to fix it.  The last time it happened I had to close my account and open it under a different card .  I have two vehicles on the ultimate program and for some reason they can't figure out how to bill so when I used a different card that seemed to be a good fix.  So far anyway.

The food my husband had was good . I never got my food. I ordered chef choice on sushi and nigiri but it never arrived. Our waitress never came back to follow drink or check on us. We had to flag another waitress down she sent our waitress back and she said no sushi. I mean come on I didn't even have a plate in front of me. 2other tables came in and ordered sushi along with a lot of orders to go.  Service is lacking for sure. Never did get my food. Husband had to go to register and ask for his bill. Hell at this point they should have said we are sorry . They did tell us to have a nice night‍

Horrible! 
-The ac didn't run consistently and it was July heat so it was a hot night for me. 
-The toilet wouldn't flush. 
-There was mini flies flying around. 
-The walls/door let in a lot of sound from outside. 
-The neighbors partied late and were loud. 
-The front desk staff was not very personable and didn't seem to know much or would help. 
-There is no shuttle to the airport. 

For the price it should have been better. I learned my lesson. Don't stay here if you have higher standards. I flew and rode the amtrack all that day and all I wanted was to relax in peace and cool down. It felt like a motel, not what I was looking for.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Their cancellation policy is absolutely ridiculous -- no changes within 30 days of arrival!   We could not make it as it turns out because my girlfriend got sick.  They would not allow any change to the reservation, or make any concession whatsoever.  No, they charged the entire $800 to my credit card for a 2 night stay!   The hotel was not fully booked, so it's not like they turned away anyone in order to hold my room.  

I think this is a very greedy and selfish hotel and unless you are the kind of person who never ever needs to change their plans, I would not advise booking here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My first night a mysterious wooshing sound kept me from sleeping. The sound resuraced every 45 seconds. I told front desk and they were surprised to hear this so they sent a sound engineer to investigate and also fix my tv which had no signal. I switched rooms and then it happened-- I heard the sound. Like a bad horror movie. I left the room and it became clear the mystery the entire time was the sound of the elevator. Whatever room you are in you will hear the elevator. They comped my breakfast buffet but the tradeoff was that I hardly slept for three nights. The staff was nice enough but the hotel is in need of a new sound engineer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I an soooo happy to have Mexican in Swedesboro! Its delicious and authentic. I wont fault them for being slow with service on a busy Sat night. They are still figuring out the logistics bc they are so new. Kudos to this family for taking a risk and opening a restaurant. We desperately needed some variety around here. The fact that its so authentic and not a chain is a bonus to me. Love this place, try the enchiladas verdes or the beef sopes! My husband gets the chicken fajitas with pineapple. Muy Delisio! If thats spelled right haha.

So my original review was a 1-star but hey...we can all change and grow. Imo's has grown on me a bit, through the education provided from a fellow friend and Imo's connoisseur (originally from St. Louis). Imo's uses *Provel cheese on their pizza so if you are expecting the standard fare, run of the mill pizza, you are in for a surprise/treat.  Education is key and Emo's is definitely worth a try. It's gotta be good my friend has them shipped from two states away...

*Provel is a white processed cheese product particularly popular in St. Louis cuisine, that is a combination of cheddar, Swiss, and provolone cheeses. (Credit Wikipedia).

This restaurant serves THE BEST authentic Italian food in the area.   Everything from the salad to the dessert is amazing!  They now have a new dessert  area with the most amazing homemade gelato, tiramisu and other Italian specialties.  Sometimes I have a craving so bad for their tiramisu, I drive there specifically just to get that!  It is well-run with friendly staff and owners.  The prices seem fair and it is BYOB.  It is always hopping when we go but they have expanded and even added an outdoor tent to accommodate their growing clientele.  I highly recommend!

I've gone here three times.  The place is clean enough, but the staff is not welcoming.  I once had one tech start my pedicure and then suddenly turn it over to someone else without explanation. Nobody has ever offered their name to me.  Last time was particularly unpleasant.  The tech, an older woman, actually cut me while trimming my nails, and ignored my request that she remove the parts of two nails which were digging into my flesh.  I went elsewhere today to get the situation corrected and was happy with the results.

Honestly  the worst gym I have been to ever
Me and a couple  of friends went to play 
Basketball and the man at the desk who apparently  is the owner told us that it's 10 a person then we where figuring out how much to pay each then he started  screaming at us and we asked him to calm down then he started cursing at us and to leave the gym  after we left the gym we where outside and heard screaming  the a group of 4 pole came out and told us that he also just kicked them out  . Rudd and obnoxious owner do not come here
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We've been going here since they opened which was maybe 10 years ago? The menu hasn't changed one itty bitty bit in all that time. And it seems perhaps the chef hasn't changed either and he's dying of boredom back there in the kitchen. The food is fine but basically so uninspired and over seasoned and overpriced. Also, PSA-Don't eat there on a Sunday since you'll get all the old food that tastes stale. The only thing they have going for them is the beautiful patio and their always friendly waitstaff. It's just a shame that friendly can't fix overpriced, unexceptional food. Not worth the money.

I'm not sure how this hotel even got semi-decent reviews. I have been to worse hotels but this hotel meets average expectations on a good day. There were stains on the chairs and beds, holes in the walls, hair in the bathtub, overall grimey and they do a bare minimum cleaning job. Worst of all we met a 3 inch cockroach in the bathroom on our last day there. Our vacation in New Orleans was great except the hotel, we found ourselves anxious to get out of the hotel room as much as we could. I guess we got what we paid for.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The service for mechanical issues is fantastic. Diagnostic testing of my battery and starter and alternator was perfect. While there I also purchased tires. That's when I made my mistake. The objective of paying premium prices for name brand services is to be able to get the same quality service and honored warranties anywhere there is a midas. Well I was rejected at 2 midas shops when I tried to get the tires serviced. I found myself driving all the way back home to my local shop to get work done. What a waist of a Saturday morning. You need mechical work done? Midas is your place. You need tires? Go somewhere else.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
UPDATE:  I CHANGE MY RECOMMENDATION TO ONE STAR!!!  REALLY BAD!

Well...It seems I wrote my evaluation too quickly.  I am sorry if anyone went there based on the above recommendation.  At this point, I am afraid I have to give the salon only 1 star.  Today is 9/8, less than a week since I had my nails done.  The first nail chipped in one day, I now have 5 nails that have grossly chipped polish.  This is gel manicure; it should have lasted at least 2-3 weeks, not 1-6 days.  The index finger on my right hand has the polish lifting off at the base of the nail. I need to have my nails redone already.  However, it will not be at this salon!

I remember why I always rent from Enterprise.  First, every other shuttle had come around twice by the time the Dollar shuttle came.  Great driver but that didn't make up for the delay.  Got to the Dollar counter quickly and was given a VW Tiquan.  Great car, but not well maintained.  I've never gotten into a rental and found a slice of pineapple on the console (seriously).  Also, there are some big dents in the passenger side doors that I didn't see until I got the car home, and I confidently expect them to try to come after me for them (in spite of the fact that you see rust in them).  Will update when I return the car.

This place is BEAUTIFUL, outside and inside! Got seated quickly and served right away. The table set up was very nice and clean. Waiter ran us through the history of the place and seemed very knowledge! Although I asked for a lemon in my water and did not receive one, not a big deal. Ordered the food, mine tasted great!  Waiter suggested to my friend to add meat but never mentioned the extra price, we did not really care but I can see how that could annoy others. Dessert was my favorite part. Overall great place!

Overall the experience was disappointing. This was my first time dining at Derek's and I was excited to try the menu. Our server was poorly trained and had an attitude throughout brunch. We had to ask one of the other servers to find him just to get water. We started with the fried calamari which took a while to come out and came out cold. Our server was ill-mannered by talking to other tables in the middle of taking our entree orders. I ordered the steak & eggs and was disappointed, the filet was not medium rare but still decent and the eggs were over cooked.  Unfortunately, I will not be going back to here.

Beautiful hotel, thoughtfully brought into the 21st century.. luxurious without the high ticket price. Top floor has "the" Cary Grant suite. Apparently a frequent guest here.. much of the original architecture remains. The architecture is stunning w careful planning of how todays digital guests need to//want to navigate a city/restaurant choices / things to see and experience. Was here in the early 90s (St Louis not hotel)-highly recommend!!!! Everything is convenient to location; safe; vibrant. Large spacious suite without the suite price.!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is the third time I have done a mobile order and my order was not ready, which is no big deal but never does an employee greet you or ask if you are waiting for a mobile order. This again would be understandable if they were short staffed but today I counted 6 employees behind the counter. I often have to get one of their attention and wait 10-15mins for a mobile order. Just very disorganized and doesn't seem up to par to the systematic structure of other Starbucks locations. Go to the one in Burlington or Mt Laurel, it will be worth the drive.

Damn! Was highly disappointed tonight with this place! Ordered a Steak Modega to go, a $40 meal and was told I'm going to pay $.50 for 2 slices of extra bread! It comes with 2 slices and any extra I was going to pay! And when I watched the "So called manager" sipping on the Sky Vodka at will, I decided I wasn't going to pay that extra $.50 and voiced my opinion.  She could of cared less!!! I think the vodka got tti her head because she let me walk out over$.50. I think she wanted to eat my meal on the owner's dime!! NEVER AGAIN WITH THIS PLACE!!!

What can I say???? The best pizza in town besides Pica's. I remember the first week Gaetano and his wife with their thick Italian accents opened up for takeout only. I went in there to get one of those pizzas that everyone in Clifton Heights was speaking of. I couldn't believe how good the pizza was starting with the pizza sauce which exploded in my mouth with delight. It reminded me of my nanny's homemade gravy. I could taste the fresh basil and fresh tomatoes that made this purely delightful pizza a shoe in for one of the best pizzas around.

This is a follow-up to an earlier post on this company. Since I last wrote, my dress was found. However, my main complaint concerning customer relations has not improved. The employee who returned my dress was brusque and unapologetic. The explanation for the mix-up was that the dress was mislabeled as a blouse, but there never was an attempt to reassure me that an earnest effort was being made to find the dress even after I assured the clerk that it was a dress. Nevertheless, I'm happy to have my dress back.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Worst service
The hibachi section was a 45 minute wait so we asked to be seated in the table section by sushi bar. The waiters were so slow and the worst was we ordered two hibachi meals which took 45 minutes and came out lite warm to cold. So yeah clearly the waiters did not monitor the status of the kitchen. 
I never get upset at lame service typically but tonight I tried to give him a cold piece of chicken so he understood how cold the meal was. I was offered a new meal but I just took ours to go and microwaved it in the hotel room.
Worst hibachi and should not get any zagat rating.

Horrible! Did you know the bus that picks you up at the airport only runs once an hour? So you may be waiting for a long time while all the other buses come and go - come and go - come and go.  Then the office staff members are rude.  No 'hello - how can I help you?' No 'thank you' - no niceties at all.  Several of the staff were on their phones and NOT A ONE of them did anything to make me feel welcome or comfortable.  I will NEVER rent from Budget again. Should have read the reviews first.  Not one good thing said by anyone.

Lexi was my colorist for my first visit to this salon. She did a fantastic job on my hair. Exactly what I had asked for... better than any stylist I've visited in years and exceeded expectations. I had balayage highlights and asked that she blend in my natural strawberry dark blonde color (with the goal of growing out old blonde and letting my natural color ease in) while still maintaining face framing highlights. She basically did everything I asked for and beyond. I'm very very happy with the results and highly recommend her. I haven't been this satisfied with my hair in a very long time. She'll be my colorist going forward. Thank you Lexi!

Book as far in advance as you can--so worth it!

My husband and I stayed here one night in August 2018 on a road trip to the East Coast.  It was outstanding in every regard--meticulously appointed room, beautiful grounds, wine, snacks, coffee, breakfast, convenient parking, close to everything. On any return trip to Nashville, we will try to book here first.  It's small and highly sought after so you need to book as far in advance as you can.  It's a "Select Registry" property as well.  Loved it.  You will too.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We go to this place often.  Great happy hour prices on drinks and appetizers.  They are also  with us airways dividend dining miles which we collect as an added bonus.  We have been to this place at least 3 or 4 times a month for about 5 years now and have never had a bad meal nor bad service.  My favorite is the gerber pizza and dirty wings..my husband delights in the loaded tator tots.  good burgers, steaks, and desserts.  You can also play trivia games via a tableside remote.  This is a comfortable local bar and grill..try them out.

Usually well run. We often bring our family of 7 to this restaurant. Tonight, however, we ordered chips with cheese only for my 6 year old. They charged us $7.95 for the loaded nachos. We asked the waitress about this charge. She came back and said she had asked her manager and he said there was no way to charge a different price and she ran the check. The manager didn't come over to the table to explain it himself. As we were leaving we asked him why we were charged the same price for what would've had beef, beans, lettuce, tomatoes and cheese and he said that's just how it is. They lost a customer tonight. We will not come back.

I was scouring the city looking for a fresh cup of coffee and when I found the menagerie I was starkly disappointed not only was I rudely treated when I tried to enter the location momentarily adjusting my mask after jogging through the city but then on top of that there was another patron who walked in who is verbally assaulted for not wearing his mask by some guy in a red beanie the guy in the red beanie was so mean so rude honestly I don't understand why you hired him.. save your money and find someone who understands humanity.

While the food was decent, the price tag was completely unexpected. I ordered the Mona Lisa - pasta with veggies and a tomato sauce. I asked if I could substitute the tomato sauce for cream sauce and was told it would be a little bit more expensive - not $7 more expensive (original priced was $14.95)!!! WTF! I was charged for a regular pasta with alfredo sauce AND then charged for the additional veggies. It was so-so to begin with and certainly not worth an extra $7. Lame. Plus, I hit happy hour and was charged full price for my wine. :( I will definitely NOT be heading back to this join anytime soon and I will NOT recommend it to others.

Food was good small portions no salad or soup but that's ok. What wasn't ok was service. Waited 50 minutes for table was told it was 30 minute wait. The server started good but the other half of dinner neglected us. Also for 4 adults and one child gratuity was included? First time ever had that happen, nonetheless we are good tippers and it was our server's loss. Don't think I'd go back again although their wings and crabcakes were pretty good. So was their desert. Biggest issue was their service and price for service - negative! Would have been back if better service and less wait and not gratuity included for four adults !

Do NOT rent a car from these people!!!! Under serviced cars I had to bring in Twice!!! NO Refunds just sorry!!!  I hate that word! 
I got my first car yesterday... service light on and I brought it back.
Today another car... service light went on and I brought it back!!! 
NO compensation just they don't service cars they rent them. And if you pre-paid your stuck!! 
Isn't prepaying, paying in full before you go???? 
The customer service rep. Was rude, under caring, big deal! They should be happy I brought there car back before someone really could get injured. 
I will never rent from budget again.

I would never take a car here unless you want it to become damaged. I took my truck here which was pretty clean to begin with but could use a wash. After the wash while vacuuming a noticed a bunch of scratches, and my center tailgate was broken. I went up to the guy on duty and brought it to his attention and he basically said their equipment can't damage cars and said here feel this one piece do you think this would damage your car? He didn't let me see the other piece of equipment for a reason. So unless you want a damaged vehicle I would complete AVOID this place.

Watch out for staff coming into your room even though you have your "privacy" marker on your room door.  In the morning while we were dressing to get ready to check out, an unidentified staff member did a quick knock while simultaneously opening the door and peeped into the bathroom even though we clearly had the privacy door card on the door knob.  No apologies like they were startled that the room was occupied, does not seem legit at all.  There were several maids in the hallway, none of them fit the description of the person who peeped into the room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not recommended. First, sliders not advertised as on menu. No cheddar cheese or pickle spear and not good. Second, the waitress brought us a large beer without first asking. She said the price not much different but that's not the point. Third, the worse chicken & rice soup I have ever had. Not soup. More like cream of wheat with rice mixed in! Fourth, I'm the first to like good old rock & roll but turn it down just a tad. You can only take so much of Peter Frampton blasting new your ears! Rarely do I post negative reviews but this place needs some upgrading.

So many good features: Fresh cookies and milk every evening. NO road noise.  Very quiet. Great lighting, including the bathroom.  Spacious and comfortable. Front desk was amazingly helpful.  Everything spotlessly clean.  

Be aware: they have a new climate control system with a set setting for the room.  If you want to manually adjust, cooling down at night or whatever, ask the front desk to put the room on over-ride.  I prefer blankets to an all-or-nothing comforter.  Front desk gave us multiple blankets to layer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I love this restaurant and the food and have been ordering from them for a few years. My biggest complaint is the website for ordering online. Its horrible! It's hard to navigate and very frustrating as it times out if you're deciding what food you want and restarts the order...gahhh. Also at the end
for checkout it has all kinds of floating things  on the screen impeding your ability to select tip which it automatically puts in for you at 20%...really? For delivery?! You need some serious reconstruction on this online ordering thing. I used to order about once a week...no longer...too frustrating. It gets 5  For food but 0  For accessibility

Dr Frank is great. She knows her stuff and truly cares. I feel comfortable bringing my pharaoh hound in as she has experience with the rare breed. Wonderful care at a very afforadable price. You are not told that you are required to have an exam or this or that to be seen on top of what you are already going in for. You tell them what you need, and they help you and charge you for that ONE thing that you came in for. I did not feel I was being swindled into paying for anything other than WHAT I FELT was necessary. This is how it should be everywhere. You can't beat it in this city. I've been around to know.

I went here and the lady I was working with kept charging me for things without even asking me. She charged me for a scratch warranty without asking after leaving I learned that they get commission.  I would never go here again she just cared about her commission and not me has a customer and she never really showed interest to me as a customer she was just talking to the other worker and not really helping after I picked up the glasses she rang me up and charged me for everything my bill was over 300 dollars.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: -5 rating if I could. These apartments are not worth the rent. Way overpriced dumps and COMPLETE con-artists. I allegedly owe them money (in addition to my deposit that happens to equal the same amount of rent). It's been years since I've lived there and I just received a call from a debt collector that "has record that I have been called and yelled at the lying front office b**** 7 times". Paraphrasing here, but she was a complete b**** the ONE time I spoke with her. She's got my forwarding address, and not once sent correspondence, nor from a debt collector. Do not be fooled. These ppl will f*** you over.

Third time staying here this year, and several times before the pandemic.  Tonight, I call for food only to learn there is a 2-hour wait.  No restaurant open, only the bar area, which is packed.  Yes, there is Bourbon Steak (and for the record, I have been there 3 times this year, and several times before that), but it is not a place to just get something to eat.  Was here 2 weeks ago when the hotel was full, and was able to get food, so this is just poor planning.  If you are going to try to serve a 500-room hotel with only room service and a bar, then staff and run it properly.  Next time, we'll just go back to the Joseph.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Simply the worst customer service EVER! Waited at speaker for at least five minutes. No other customers in sight. Finally I pulled up to the window to see if they were even open. A very rude employee opened the window and told me to pull back to the speaker if I wanted to order. I told him I tried to order there but no one responded. I suggested perhaps the speaker was broken. He proceeded to tell me the speaker was just fine and I should pull back around to place my order. And to reiterate, there were NO other customers. We went to Taco Bell.

We have been here since 2 years not tried pizza from this restaurant and finally decided to try out. All our excitement was over in a second after the Manager on night shift at 9:15 pm took our order with such rude attitude. We ignore for once but she continued her same attitude and finally we decided to leave the spot in second. We would not return such place where the manager is such rude, her first statement in her rude language was We close at 10:00. I would suggest no one should go to such filthy place.

Glad that there is a DD in the area but the service needs to improve. Every time I stop there, and I go inside, I have to wait 10 to 15 minutes before someone takes my order.  They have two registers but always only have one person working the front counter even though on many occasions the line is long.  There are employees walking around including the assistant manager and at times the manager and all seem oblivious to what is happening at the front counter.  No one notices the people waiting or they just ignore the fact that they need to help out.  They need to improve their customer service and be more aware of their customers time.

Order total was 23.71 
Walked in to pay and pick up my order and was charged 7 dollars more . Which wasn't a problem. Until I Showed the manager/worker what the total was online . And he didn't even attempt to fix it or apologize for the error on there part. Said that they charged us for rice and beans ( which we didn't order). Nor have we ever been charged and given rice and beans the plenty of times we've ordered online. He Only offered to take the rice and beans... but still charge us for it. Delicious food, but sadly felt disrespected.

What a joke. Our nightmare just keeps continuing. Would you enjoy having to follow up about a leaking gutter over 10 TIMES, in 9 months? Cause I sure don't. DONT LIVE HERE. Seriously, RUN. Oh and leslee, nice response. I have come to the office, nothing helps or changes. So nice try. We've given up on the management and maintenance actually knowing how to handle actual service and upkeep properly. It's gotten so bad that we're now working with the health department to try and break our lease to get out of this place....

Horrible experience: flight arrived at 1:30pm and then I went straight to hotel, they would not allow an early check in (empty parking lot, no other customers in lobby). Then once I came back at 3pm got into a room that had no hot water, then they switch the room and the shower head is messed up in the new room (sucked it up though). Stayed for 3 nights and each day the room remained with a full trash can, and half used shampoo bottles, torn "courtesy" water bottles, and then left pillows on floor (I guess they had no cleaners, which makes up for the not being able to check in early ?). Good for one night stay but no more than that!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Planet Fitness is the best fitness center I have visited in a while. The staff is always friendly with a warm greeting when you walk in to help boast your exercise morale. Like hey friend you made it this far, now have a great workout! The facility is very clean and well maintained. I actually don't mind showering at the gym. It a very spacious and never appears over crowded. I'm  in and out and always  leave with a great workout because I never have to wait around for equipment. Planet Fitness is the best judgement free place for beginners or veteran fitness enthusiast.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: We use to really love this place before  last night. The waitress was horrible, we had to repeat everything we ordered a couple times for her. She was rude and short with us. Then our food came out wrong and she had no idea it was wrong. We had to flag down another waiter to get it corrected... THEN we saw a cockroach!!!! The wait staff saw it too and was not killing it so my boyfriend had to kill it !! And to top it off we got the bill and 15% gratuity was added to our check and nothing was taken off for wrong food and a cockroach!!! Never again will I go back!!!!

I was very pleased with my experience at Salon West. Everyone was very pleasant, especially the young man who checked me in and out. Nicole was very professional and seemed genuinely interested in giving me the cut I wanted. She was honest about what I could reasonably expect from my hair and offered alternatives that would work for me. I couldn't be happier with the results, especially the foils. The color looks completely natural. The salon itself was clean and comfortable and the staff very attentive. I will definitely recommend Salon West and Nicole to my friends and family.

I had a wonderful experience at Zionsville Auto Service. I had initially taken my car to Firestone for an oil change and they gave me a list of recommended services. After seeing the amount it would have costed, (close to $500) for spark plugs, windshield wipers, tire rotation, and a new cabin filter I was immediately turned off and assumed they were charging me for labor that costs as much as the parts. I went to Zionsville Auto and they completed everything for $181! The service was delightful and the staff were friendly! Anyone reading this, do not go to Firestone, they are a rip off, Zionsville Auto is where the deals are at!!

Had a delicious meal on a date night with my gf.  Started with a cheese/meat board which was great, transitioned into the pork chop dinner while my gf had the branzino (seabass) which were both excellent.  To top it off we enjoyed wine (primarily a wine drink menu with two beers offered) and their tiramisu dessert.  Clint was our server and he was nice and made for a relaxing meal.  Overall, it was a fantastic upscale but casual/intimate dining experience perfect for those in the channelside area or further to try out.

The click-list aka order online and come pick it up is HORRIBLE! We called when we got there, like you're supposed to do, and an hour later... nothing. We called again after 40 minutes and they said "we don't know what happened, we'll be out there shortly."  My fiancé went up to the door and asked to speak with a manager after an hour... they said it was in the cart to come out but only one guy could deliver the stuff to your vehicle.

To make matters worse, I'm 8 months pregnant and had to go in to pee twice while waiting! Pick a different Kroger for curb-side pickup.

If you are looking for a hot meal forget it. Every time we've gone our food is always cold and have to send it back.  The staff is not busy and stand around and do nothing with no other customers in the store. There is no excuse why the food is cold unless it's been eating sitting there. Why would you serve this to a customer. We are a paying customer and this is unacceptable. Plus the cashier just stands and stares the whole we were sitting eating our food. Is this a policy of Burger King. To the CEO of Burger King it must be nice to pay your workers to stare and do nothing.

HORRIBLE HOTEL. I'm rating one star only because it is required. This hotel deserves no stars.  Logan Sales, the supposed general manager has horrible customer service skills. The room smelled and bed was only dressed with a sheet. Upon calling the front desk for a comforter an unfolded blanket was brought to the room. Called several more times for a comforter to no avail. The end result, Logan cancelled my reservation (which was for 2 nights yet he only refunded me 1 night). I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. You truly get what you pay for.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have never been so disappointed/stressed in my entire life because of this dump of an apartment and trying to scam people out of their money, even after almost a year of not living there and they still are hassling. Can this apartment have a completely new staff that knows what they are doing and that actually care.. if I were anyone in the Tucson area or just anyone in general, even if you are desperate and are thinking of moving here DON'T!  I would rather hide inside of Costco and live there then an unprofessional trashed apartment.

I used to love this place as an undergrad at WC. I still like the big booths for gatherings and the fact that you can have under 21's in there, but I have to say their service is hit or miss. Their happy hour specials are good, but their reg prices are kinda pricy for what you get. 

Maybe I'm being harsh b/c of my last experience. I got a $5 martini and noticed my glass had a lip stick print on it. I wasn't wearing lipstick and hadn't taken a sip of the drink. I asked my waitress for a new one and she clearly just dumped it into a new glass rather than mixing me a fresh one and putting it into an actually clean glass.

This hotel was great. I loved the large room and comfortable beds. The mini kitchen was amazing I loved being able to eat whenever I wanted to. The service was very kind and great ,especially Cameron and his friend.Although the food wasn't really good the snack bar made up for it. The pool was lovely and big also the water was great. My buddies and I loved hanging out in the first floor talking and enjoying spending time together. I also liked the free laundry. I like being able to wear clean clothes everyday. I'm looking forward to going back to this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: DONT GO HERE!!! I should have known better after the first time I went here. I have a usual salon I go to but this is near work. The first time I went I got a full manicure pedicure. The did not paint my toes equally and got the jel polish all over. I decided to go back a second time.. MISTAKE!!! I got a French tip manicure and the tips are all different sizes. I thought well just deal with it...but my husband suggested I go back. When I went back there were 2 two in the salon but she told me it would be a 45 minute wait and it would cost $15...ARE YOU SERIOUS??!!..I spent  $89 in your salon yesterday...

Don't waste your time! We tried calling twice this morning and were on hold for 10 minutes each time before they hung up on us. Went to this location and the parking lot was full. Only two bankers working and 35 people waiting. I'm talking about the line was wrapped around and around inside and then people were having to wait outside in the 10 degree temperature. No sign in sheet and it was chaos. We left. And may just leave Wells Fargo in general. If you plan on using the drive through services be prepared to wait behind 5 people too (if you can even get in the parking lot).

These people are the rudest starbux stAff ive ever encountered.  It was a sundAy morning at 10am and there was a line out the door.  THERE WAS ONLY ONE REGISTER OPEN.  When i called them on it, this nasty looking broad with a mustache started talking back.  So i told the manager who basically gave me the same attitude.   I called the district manager who said they would handle it after i told them how long they made everyone wAit.  Apparently this one girl Ashley (fat and obnoxious) is upset About and told me not to leave my water around.  Never have ive ever been told this at any starbux.

Room smells like cat pee, hair in the tub so clearly they didn't clean well, hot water heater on repair so showers are Luke warm at best (not advertised or told when u book a room), put on bottom floor facing common area as rewards member, breakfast ordered ahead arrived half hour late, do not disturb sign was ignored for four knocks until I finally answered. oh and no room service menu in the room or refill of the breakfast menu after "housekeeping".  I stay here a lot but won't be coming back after this visit... absolutely awful.
