text: We have been to too many Five Guys locations to count. All of them except this one had been a great experience. Customer service was poor. Order was wrong. Burgers were smaller than other locations and fries were not cooked long enough. Also, I cannot have gluten and all other locations change their gloves when making my lettuce wrap burger. This location did not and I already have a headache...I hope this review makes it to management as this restaurant could give the chain a bad name. And we LOVE Five Guys!

After a major mix up on my part, booked the wrong dates . Miriam at the front desk went out of her way to fix my mistake and make sure we didn't have our trip ruined. We really enjoyed the pool before the Rays game. Free shuttle anywhere within a 3 mile radius was a great perk for the hotel. Not to mention the free breakfast, the hotel also offers a free light dinner Monday-Wednesday. Overall it was a fantastic stay and again I can't thank Miriam enough for going above and beyond to make sure we had a great stay!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm not quite sure what the hell is going on with this store but the entire management staff should be replaced.  The shelves are constantly empty, especially in the produce section.  The shopping carts are horrible.....good luck finding one that's not broken. The fresh meat department is usually closed at 7:15/7:30 although the sign says it's open until 9:00.  And whoever had the brilliant idea (In ALL Giant stores) for the stupid checkout lines with the plastic bag carousel should be fired too. If you're going to do that at least train the cashiers on how to load a bag.

I just went there for lunch today with my wife on our lunch break.  She got her food and 20 minutes later I still did not have mine.  I told the manager and he went back and could not figure it out, he told me they lost the ticket.  So after originally ordering 20 minutes prior they started my order all over again.  The manager apologized and offered to give me A coupon for a free sandwich next time.  He never came back around, so we just left without the coupon.  Needless to say we probably won't be trying to do lunch there again.

Hertz  sign is on the ground as opposed to all the others that are up high at the return area. I did not see the sign and proceeded through the area and there was no escape.  I turned into another car rental companies area and had to wait until the cars moved out of the way so I could  take another crack at  getting the car to the proper location. Wasted a lot of time. I complained to the Hertz person who  thought I was the stupid one because I didn't see the sign. They could fix this by having signs in the same position as everyone else.

Do not get an air bnb here. Sooo frustrating. You have to use the latch app for EVERYTHING, even pushing a button on the elevator. The water pressure sucked, the carpets in the hallways were stained, and the hallways smelled like weed. Nobody was ever at the front desk as advertised (stayed here 4 days and 3 nights). When we called from our phones, it just sent us to voicemail. The pre check in cleaner was rude to us upon arrival and we later heard her bashing other guests on the phone as she walked down the hallway. Everyone we ran into store Burham seemed to feel just as frustrated by their stay. Get it together, Burnham!

The rooms here are nice enough but the meals are a joke. Breakfast was a microwaved omelet, soggy hash browns, bacon(always good), cereal, yogurt, lunch meat and cheeses. The evening receptions food was worse. It was supposed to be "taco night" but no. They had tortita chips made onsite that were either burnt or undercooked. The burnt ones were the only chips that had any crispness to them. Canned meat, canned cheese sauce, frozen processed chicken, bagged salad with no lite choices. You would think no big deal right? But the room rate goes up $50 the nights that they have the social.
Platinum member here...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My gas tank was on empty as my daughter and I drove down the New Jersey Turnpike and I had to get off to fill up. After filling the gas tank I realized I really needed something to eat and there was nothing super close to the highway. I drove about a mile and a half down the road to find this really lovely restaurant. It's small and unassuming but the food was excellent. In just a few minutes they made me a huge burrito that was absolutely delicious. If you need a bite to eat when you're driving down the turnpike this is definitely worth a try.

I have tried primos not one, not 2, but 3 times and every time I order something is wrong with my food. First the wrong sauce was on the pasta con broccoli, second time they forgot my dessert, and the third time my bread was burnt! Don't eat here unless you want to be disappointed, maybe if they didn't have a bunch of knuckleheads walking around and knew how to do their job they could get somewhere. Where is the owner in the midst of all this, oh wait I can hear him spouting at the workers like they are dumb every time I walk in. Thanks, no thanks. Will never try again.

Such a surprise to find delicious food and lovely service on our way up the coast to Paso Robles. We wandered in for dinner based on location ( easy access from the highway) and ability to safely eat outdoors with our dog. The restaurant is pretty and the staff are eager to please and make recommendations. Both the caprese salad and caprese torte were delicious first courses. The pizza Bianca had crispy study and a nice mixture of cheeses. Pastas were al dente with amazing house-made sauces. Carpinteria may not be a gourmet go to location but this place definitely makes it worth the drive.

I was waiting for my debit card to be printed and wanted to do something, so I grabbed a coloring page only to realize the only thing to color it in was a pen that was the same shade of black as the outline of the drawing. I was enraged although the customer service was phenomenal, they couldn't even provide me red to match the logo of the bank. Considering moving to Mexico as I am riddled with dissatisfaction and disgust at the inconsiderate thoughtfulness riddle in that singular BIC pen, couldn't even get a blue one.

The staff is so rude and horrible! I always order the same roll (fried St. Louis roll). Twice now, I have ordered it and came to pick it up and they give me the fried Philly roll. No big deal, mistakes happen. But this VERY rude employee both times has told me he's 100% sure I ordered the Philly, not the St. Louis roll, and pretty much called me a liar and gave me a stare down. I was pissed, that's no way to treat a customer, especially one like me who works so close and goes there 1-2 times a week. I'm never going there again. These people need a lesson in how to treat customers in a civil manner.

I have been going there forever. It seems service has slowed down even as the pandemic is finally over I was told 6pm pickup for a pizza that was called in at 520pm. After 630 as I was waiting first in my car then In  the restaurant, I asked the manager why an hour for a pizza?  All he could say is we're busy. So why am I writing this because a gentleman next to me said he was waiting an hour and all he was told was "we're busy". No apologies, no let me buy you drink while you have to wait, no pizza is on us. I don't think I am going back until they treat customers with more respect. I guess they don't need the money. Shame on them

Shuttle took a bit longer than the others, but the driver was super friendly... the manager, Ed, was very helpful, despite being overwhelmed by what he described as a crazy couple of days (nascar and something else this weekend).

All around a great experience. In and out in ~20 minutes, from shuttle pickup to in my rental and out the gate - with a midsized SUV upgrade to boot! I think they were short on stock, and a guy cut in front of me in line and Ed said he wanted to help me out since I had to wait...

Will be back next time I'm in Philly!

This is not in regards to the individual employees but in regard to the awful management. We sat in the drive thru line for 20 minutes and when we finally get to order, mind you at 6:01 pm, we were told they close at 6 pm (despite any online time stating they were open) and were refused service (along with the 3 cars behind me that had also been waiting for more than 5 minutes). Now I read reviews and see this is has been an issue for weeks which just makes the situation worse. Update your hours of operations as needed, it is NEEDED. You've wasted enough people's time.

Mosaic is hands down my favorite Mexican food in town. I also grew up on it so I may be a little biased. I'm vegetarian and gluten free and I can always find a variety of options here, which isn't true everywhere. My favorite is the huevos rancheros! If you don't like it hot be sure to ask for the mild salsa with your chips (or with anything, I get it on my huevos rancheros). They won't bring it out unless you ask for it but it's delicious and better than their regular salsa in my opinion. It can get pretty crowded on weekends and the service isn't always the fastest but it's worth it. I come here at least a few times a month.

Beware of the front desk at this hotel. A friend and I each rented a room over the weekend that we paid for with our personal credit cards. Then the office turned around on the day we checked out and also charged my company credit card the same amounts as well. I think the error has now been corrected but when I called they could not find record of my friend having paid for his room even thought later I found an email from them confirming payment. What a mess they have created on our credit card accounts. Very disappointed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Do not rent a car from here.  Reserved 2 full size cars to drive to San Fran and back, when we picked them up they gave us a Ford Focus. 1 of the cars had a mechanical issue with the transmission, and the location we rented from would not help arrange changing out the vehicle. I had to call 4 locations nearby to find a location with a vehicle. When we changed out they told us the focus is NOT a full size.  That is what I thought, but they charged us and told us it was at this S Virginia location. Thanks for nothing Kalani and Will T.

Did pick up through their web site (Chow Now) for St Pete location. An order was missing/wrong and the food that arrived was inedible. Husbands chicken Parmesan was an un-natural color and as tough as shoe leather. So overall $67 for inedible meal. Called and sent emails to restaurant who said we have to refund through Chow Now but Chow Now is not a website and all my confirms, etc came directly from the restaurant email. So nothing but a run around and no apologies or remorse for our horrible experience. Won't be returning.

Placed an order online on the 26th. On the 3rd of Jan. my card was charged, but I never received any shipping notice. Followed up on the 8th requesting shipping status. Was told that the one item I was interested in was out of stock, and they emailed me regarding a substitution.

I wouldn't give a bad review based on an out of stock item, but:
1. I've gone back through my email and spam and don't see any emails regarding a substitution. 
2. My card was charged for all items on the 3rd, but nothing was shipped.

Sloppy service. Waiting for my refund.

if I could rate in the negative stars I would. I wouldn't even give them one star. They are criminals. When checking in, they say they require a "refundable " deposit as long as I don't break or steal anything, in which I didn't. after a week of waiting on it, I tried calling them to ask about it, and they just hung up on me numerous times ( I w not being rude or aggressive) so finally I just go in and she first tells me it's the bank until I give her my card to check it she typed in there for a long few minutes then hand me my card back and say I did not check out on time so I don't get my deposit back it is a straight lie. They are criminals
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The only reason I'm even giving this place 1 star is because our server was very nice and understanding. I ordered a 'millionaire' roll and this sh*t was ass. The tempura shrimp was cold in the roll and it took 20 minutes to get to the table. And then when I asked the server about getting a new roll with fresh cooked tempura in it, he said that they only serve their tempura cold, and that they don't serve it fresh to every order. Not to mention, they advertised about sushi burritos and have a picture of one up on the wall, but that isn't even in the menu!! Who opened this place??

First, I got a room for $75 a night. That's cheap. And as the old saying goes, you get what you pay for. 

It was a small room with a TV and bathroom. Nothing fancy. Everything was clean and the front guest staff and housekeepers were friendly. No problems there. 

The problems were the other guests. Yikes. There were dogs barking, babies crying and people coming in and out of rooms all night. There were couples fighting and couples making their headboards bang against the wall at 4 A.M. The walls are paper thin so you hear everything. 

If it weren't for the other guests, I'd give this place a higher rating.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I brought my 5 year old son here for a haircut. His hair looks perfect! They do an amazing job. My son has thick hair and hates getting his hair cut. They were fast and made his hair look great.  The vacuum hose attached to the clippers keeps him from getting itchy. That's the main reason he hates haircuts. When we walked out he told me he likes this place. That says a lot coming from the kid we usually have to bribe with a special treat just to get him a haircut. Great price and excellent service! We will be going back!

We're so lucky to have the best of Chicago and the best of New York right here in Metairie, LA. Ordered by phone, a huge Chicago style Meat Lovers, a Large New York style Supreme and spinach and artichoke pizzas. Also, a 20 piece wings with a large Italian salad. Let me just say, we've found our new go to pizza place!  Well worth the trip from the Westbank. My next venture to try on the menu is the meatballs and spaghetti for me and the seafood platter for the hubby. The name certainly fits this place, so don't hesitate to show some love here.

Extremely disappointed with this place. It used to be my favorite place to get frozen yogurt but after my recent experience there, made me not ever step foot there again. The person at the register was extremely rude and disrespectful. She followed me and my boyfriend the whole time we were there wouldn't take her eyes off of us. We finally went to the register to pay for our yogurt and I asked her how her day was going, she replied "horrible dealing with you people". Not sure what she meant by that but I hope she didn't mean what I thought she meant.

I've been to NOLA several times and I always end up in Krazy Korner.  I bar hop several of the bars and always go back here for the band, Radioactive. They are amazing! The drinks are outrageously expensive and the bar tender is one of the worse I've ever met due to her attitude, but the band is worth dealing with the poor service. Yes, the shot girls are pushy, but nice if you take the time to talk to them .... and they do shove drinks down the mouths of minors without bothering to stop when they are told no (my daughter was only 16 when this happened the first time). In short, it's a dive bar, but the music is always excellent.

Not a great Marriott experience.  Usually SpringHills are much more updated and cleaner.  Stayed her one night. (12/22/18) while visiting family.  Checked in around 7pm.  First room remote wasn't working.  Called front desk. No one came up.  Shortly thereafter I smelled sewage and went into bathroom where brown water was coming up into sink.  Packed everything back up went to front desk where they seemed not surprised by the problem.  Staff was nice.  Switched room up to 5th floor.  Arrived up there where room was musty and paint was falling off ceiling. Just dealt with it and left the next am.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Do not go here!  This gym is shady, unprofessional and hustled me.  When I tried to cancel my membership (because the conditions of the gym are dirty, maskless, overcrowded and unsanitary), I was told if I wanted to cancel, I had to pay for an entire year up front in order to "buy out."  This was never communicated to me when I signed up for a monthly membership. It's a racket, and I've received better customer service from the likes of Comcast. Avoid this place and find somewhere that values their customers.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I've been going here off and on for the past 2 years or so. The previous review is correct in that they are quick for the busy woman, however, that does not mean that they are thorough or do a good job. I recently got a pedicure and an overlay (thin acrylic placed on natural nail) and while the pedicure was decent, I could tell she was rushing through the overlay and did not do a good job. I should have said something, but didn't. I've seen cleaner places with better polish selections, but if you want an in- and- out kind of place for a good price, this is a good bet.

Decent quality soft serve ice cream.  Chocolate or vanilla or mixed.  Impressive looking banana split.  They send to have random policies that interferred with the enjoyment of my group.  For example, they couldn't put a topping on a cone.  Ok.  But they also wouldn't put it in the side.  Because, they don't allow toppings on the side.  They won't let you get a cup of water.  You have to buy a bottle of water.  The lady was friendly, but the random polices weren't customer friendly.  Next time, we'll go elsewhere.

Where do I start? If you smoke crack maybe this place would suit you. Even if you do smoke crack, you would probably be annoyed by all the dramatic altercations going on around you. Couples loudly fighting over drugs, etc. ALL. NIGHT. LONG. 

1. Rooms are disgusting: mold, rust, etc. No fitted sheet on my bed either. 
2. Hotel manager Riz had a verbal agreement on the room rate then overcharged me $70 and refused to refund it. 
4.  Their list of "amenities" on their website is false advertising. Half of them do not exist. 

I would give this negative stars if I could.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: You somehow manage to ruin my already low expectation experience every time.  Simple orders are made correctly about 20% of the time (not exaggerating). Food is cold and stale 90% of the time (not exaggerating).  Service is not friendly 95% of the time.  Your location (Andorra) has compelled me to write the only two yelp ratings i've Ever completed. You must have rampant drug use, and no competent management.  There is literally no other reason I can think of for why you SUCK so badly.  Pull yourselves together, or SHUT down and let someone else who actually gives a f*** reopen.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: After a long flight from California, and an Uber drive to this hotel, we shortly realized that it was completely closed. I had already booked a reservation a month in advance, and was neglected to be told that the hotel was closed upon visiting due to Covid-19. The only way I was notified that we would be moved to another hotel was by a little sign on the door, they said they would email us prior but neglected to do so. It left us scrambling to walk to the other hotel, not even sure if we for sure had a place to stay for the night. Terrible customer service, made my first experience at Louisiana terrible.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Food is slightly above average therefore I am giving this 2 stars. Service was bad!  Like really bad. They forgot some of our entries completely. Ordered a Sapporo and they only brought the bottle with no glass. So I'm suppose to drink out of a big 40 oz bottle like I'm in college? When I asked for one they brought out a dirty glass. :( Also the drink menu is misleading. They had a picture of a drink but it wasn't even one you could order. Only there for show!  Didn't come to check on us at all. Really disappointed. There aren't a lot of sushi options around here and really wanted to like this place. :( Maybe they will hire better help.

STAY AWAY from these guys! Worst service ever. Took my car in and had to wait two hours and then they said they were too backed up to work on it and bring it back another day. Brought it back another day and they said a mechanic was out and it would take them all day to do an oil change. I left the car. When I finally picked it up they had not done the work properly and overcharged me, which they corrected after I pointed it out. plus they tried to sell me on things I know I didn't need. As you can see the reviews on them on Yelp are not good - I should have checked them out before I took my car to them. NEVER AGAIN!!

Worst experience ever! The food was decent, but I will never know about the drink I ordered. The driver forgot the drink and said he would be right back with it. 30 mins pass. I call the restaurant and they say he is on his way. Another 30 mins pass. I call the number the drover called me from, no answer. I then call the restaurant again and they say I will have to wait even longer because the driver was out. This is after I already waited about 1.5 hour, paid for me food (and drink) AND tipped the driver! Worst customer service & deliver experience ever.

Stayed here for one night with my son on 3/9/19 in room 215 and we both woke up the next day with multiple bed bug bites. I lifted the bed sheet and saw bed bugs crawling away. It was absolutely disgusting. I knew something was not quite right when we saw spider webs dangling from the ceiling to TV but the thought of bed bugs never crossed my mind in a Hampton. I reported the incident and hope they disinfected the entire room before the next guest. I never received a follow up call on whether the room was cleaned so be aware if you do stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Solid service dirty room.  Greeted by friendly staff, enjoyed the free wine from 5-6, an overall impression of the hotel was intially super positive.

Got to the room and clearly the cleaning staff left half finished... They left the vacuum cleaner in the room, which I called in was promptly returned.  Noticed the second time I dropped off stuff they'd left two kitchen sized trashbags full in the bathroom.  Called it in and when I returned that evening was still there.  Solid room on the 12th floor but they had 3 opportunities to clean my hotel room and didn't catch it.  Otherwise this would have been an easy 4/5 star.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Dinner on the patio overlooking the river is great, and the food was excellent. The calamari was tender, the fish tacos were done just right, and the scallops looked exactly like in the picture. The bar is well stocked, and has a large assortment of draughts. Prices are reasonable.

The server was friendly and attentive, but one problem was the kitchen's fault, not hers: it took a little too long for appetizers to come out, then the entrees arrived a minute later. The restaurant was busy, so the kitchen was probably going as fast as they could.

Also: this page says The Landing takes reservations, but they don't.

There are many different reviews about this restaurant. I had never been here I was a bit skeptical.. Our Experience was delightful. Our server was attentive and pleasurable. Our food was very good. Included with dinner was salad and soup. There was  escargot for appetizer. Dinners included chicken Parmesan, veal Parmesan,  chicken marsala, fried shrimp, shrimp scampi,and more. The shrimp were outrageous but the spaghetti it was on needed a little bit more spice. Maybe some more garlic? We were a large party of eight. We all left full and happy. We will be back. 
We heard there pizza is delicious. Maybe next time.

Wow! Going to this restaurant was an experience. The entire staff was warm and welcoming including the pizza chef. If you're lucky he might even sing to you! The bread they give you is addicting (we had several servings). We ordered a variety of things including appetizers, pizza, and pasta. The risotto balls are a must try! The sauce that is comes with is delicious. If you are going to order anything off the menu, I highly suggest the Bianca pizza. OMG! It melts in your mouth. Don't forget to finish off your meal with a dessert, they make their own gelato! Seriously can't wait to go back!

I'm a resident here at Camden Woods and I've got to say that so far I do love the community.  I had a few issues when I moved in to my apartment with things I've been fined for in the past by previous apartments and didn't want the same thing to happen here.  I contacted the front office and they were very happy to fix any issue I had with the apartment until I was satisfied.  The maintenance crew is very prompt and professional and will get the job done in a timely manner.  I have no complaints and would recommend this place to others.

I've been shopping in my neighborhood Fresh Market for 5  years about 3 or 4 times weekly. I used to love it but it seems to have gone downhill. In the past year, the quality has declined - recently purchases included a Beef Wellington from the meat section where the filet steak inside had gone bad, and an oatmeal cerial bar that was badly mouldy. They have a very limited number of hand baskets and it's usually difficult to get one now. The deli meats counter used to be diverse but it's all one brand now.  Their crown has slipped in my opinion!

First time going to Roman's shop. The place is well lit, clean and smells nice. Roman did a excellent job with my hair. I wanted my hair slicked back and to the side.  He knew exactly what do and made sure it looked good.

I'd describe Roman as focused, friendly and fast. My haircut only took about 20 minutes and only costed $15 (Student discount. It's regularly $20 which still would be an awesome price for this haircut).

Tip: He's become very popular and he suggested scheduling appointments a week in advance.

I can't stress enough how amazing Andy is! I followed him here from his last salon, and I can't imagine trusting anyone else with my hair. He's considerate and thoughtful, providing you with a great cut and color while making your appointments fun and enjoyable (even during Covid with all the precautions!)

He is such an expert when it comes to color, and knows how to produce the best results so you get the color you want with a natural look. While I can't rave about him enough, you'll absolutely look around the salon and realize everyone there is super talented. Everyone's hair always looks amazing when they walk out of the Artist Haus :)

So disappointed.  I walked out of Music City nails on a Sunday thinking I had a good Mani pedi- it looked great to start.  Today is Wednesday and my dip powder/SNS manicure which lasts weeks when I get it done elsewhere is severely chipped after 4 days....  and has to get completely redone. No dishes were done during that time, no hard work on the nails... Nothing.  Unfortunately I was visiting from out of town so I can't go back to demand it gets fixed.  Pedicure looks fine, but don't dare waste your money on any high priced premium services.... You'll be out of cash fast and for nothing.

The service from Rebecca was great! Smart and very friendly. You have all her attention during the whole appointment. However, the haircut was not what I've asked for...I asked for a trim, as I wanted to grow my hair long. She did some extra treatment to not have to cut much of the length (awesome service of course). But, she ended up cutting my hair with 2 inches.  If you have curly hair, this means that this looks like 4 inches shorter...Not sure why and what the disconnect is? Very disappointed, because I worked so hard to grow my hair long, which looks now with the length of 8 months ago

We asked for a 2 bed first floor room because I cannot climb stairs and they have NO ELEVATOR. They booked for 2 rooms, a one bed first floor and a 2 bed second floor.  Would not change it.  Clerk was snotty and not the least sorry. they have no roll away bed and no sofa bed.   They CHARGE for a buffet breakfast that is not as good as the included breakfast at most other places.  toast was cold, barely toasted, and dripping with grease (or margarine).  no waffles!!!! The waitress that brought coffee and toast was nice at least.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I was super excited to finally have a nearby Dunkin' Donuts near my school, but when I went there for the first time, let me tell you... the people there did not know what they were doing. My coffee tasted horrific and it took forever to just get my coffee. The SECOND time I went I walked in and one of the employees walked in to get their paycheck and was SMOKING while he was walking in. As I drove away I saw the same guy out of his car yelling at someone else in another car. These Dunkin employees need to learn self-control and learn how to make a cup of coffee!

Called from the Gaylord hotel. Was informed no wait. Valley's the truck. Walked in the outside entrance because the hostess said the mall entrance would be closed. Was greater. Said they would seat us in a minute. Watched the hostess go and talk to the waiter. He didn't want to serve us.  Not sure if it was because of our race or not. Eric or Erica Johnson was the manager who approved the hostess for telling us they were closing early and tough luck. Wasted my money and time to go eat here. We'll never eat here or any of their establishments ever again.

Was not disappointed after first visit to 
Elmwood ,Starting with the service  staff so knowledgeable and friendly , great atmosphere loved viewing the kitchen so busy  and attentive to meal prep.Music was just the right touch ,everyone  around seemed to be enjoying their dining  experience .
  I was open to the waiters suggestions from the menu. We all ordered separate  dishes and shared bits and pieces of each others selections .
  Lots of choices on the wine list and the cocktails were varied with fresh ingredients..
 I really think Elmwood is a great place to bring friends , visitors and return as often as I can!!!

Absolutely terrible customer service! Was told that our party of 5 would be able to sit in a few minutes. Waited for 30 plus minutes to be told that there's another party ahead of us and we would have to for about 2 hours. There were several open tables that they refused to sit people at because that section was "closed" not even reserved. Do not recommend if you want to be seated in a timely manner. In addition, when we request to discuss the manager she had a very nasty attitude and came out yelling out us. Very disappointing experience. Do not recommend at all.

The selection of food and taste of food was amazing and the atmosphere was very cool! The two downsides were the omelets were small for the price and the service was very off-putting. I told the counter person I'd never been there before and he just stared at me. When another employee brought our food to the table he forgot condiments and my chili. We had to go inside several times to ask for what we needed (syrup, butter for toast, normal things...) and he literally never said one word to us the whole time nor did he smile. I would definitely go back for the food as it was amazing but hope that the service is a little better.

I was at the Village close to Christmas so there was a wait to get seated but I was really hungry so I took a chance. I didn't have to wait long and was looking forward to the French Onion soup which is what I love. The service was slow but that can be expected with Covid and decreased staffing. The 3 star was actually for the soup itself. I have ordered french onion soup many places but this one, I would say, was the worse. The flavor of the soup was not good at all.  Onion soup is usually on the salty side but this was really bland. I even tried adding table salt to see if it would help. It was quite a disappointment.

IF I COULD LEAVE A ZERO I WOULD. NOT ONLY CANT YOU BE A BLACK MALE AND WAIT ON A FRIEND B4 U ORDER YOUR COFFEE U HAVE TO BE IN embarrass and be walked out in handcuffs while your friend meet you I've never in my life had to witness something so awful to the barista that throught her life was in danger I hope you never truly are in danger. As a franchise Starbucks should have procedures in order what to do when a customer didn't purchase anything and it shouldn't be calling the cops. I'm sad the situation is sad and you guys as a company old those men an apology and the Barista should be fired.

My mom & I popped in as walk in's (they usually do appointment only) this was our first time here & let me tell you we will def be returning! Everyone there was super friendly & welcoming. It was very clean & such a cute environment. The patience & attention to detail on our pedicures was beyond expectation my mom had a bad ingrown & her nail tech was able to remove it without hurting her. They take their time & the quality of work they do I've never experienced anywhere else definitely book your appointment ASAP you'll love it there as much as we did!

Tried out the new place tonight for some takeout. The person taking the order was friendly and polite. The pick-up experience was easy. The food exceeded our expectations since they have been open less than a week. Everything was delicious. The hand rolls were not your average roll you can get pretty much anywhere. You could tell they were crafted with some thought. Seriously some of the best rolls I have ever had. Will definitely be back. Likely many times since we live just a few blocks away. 

-Lisa's husband, Stephen.

This might literally be the worst bar in New Orleans. It has a dilapidated and dirty feel, which generally is an acceptable trait for most bars in Nola. However, it's the appalling service that makes this bar incredibly annoying and not worth anyone's time. Be prepared to wait a long time, get terrible service, received weak drinks, and interact with rude staff. The thing is, getting that rude experience requires you to wait 10 minutes at the bar, despite the fact that the bar is not remotely close to full.
Also, shots are $9 and do not come close to a full ounce. 
As a local, I'm ashamed that this bar exists.

I am very happy to find a nail salon like Frenchies since it is extremely clean. They don't reuse any nail filers or buffers and clean their nail clippers and such after every person with an autoclave to actually sterilize the equipment. Overall, I'm impressed to find a nail salon that is up to my standards in regards to cleanliness (this is the cleanest nail salon I have been to) so I feel comfortable going here. The woman who did my nails was friendly and did a great job. It is worth paying a little more to have your nails done at a clean salon!

Celebrating my 50th birthday and literally I would highly recommend this lodging option. I wasn't satisfied with my room and they went above and beyond to get me into a room on Bourban St. with a balcony. Michelle and Jeff were freaking awesome at the front desk and so nice and friendly. I also received a card and bottle of champagne in my room. I apparently  have another surprise coming that Michelle is sending up. Can't wait to see. Love this location and hotel. Highly recommend and you'd be right in the middle of Bourban St.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: About a week ago I went in to DD with my family and my 4 year old daughter spilt her water on the ground as we were leaving and when I told an employee instead of getting a mop to clean it up she handed me a dirty rag to clean it up my self. Very unprofessional. This morning I stopped to get some coffee and went through the drive threw they took my order but when I got to the window they were running around like chickens with their heads cut off. The manager finally came and helped me but she was very rude and didnt even give me my change! Dont think ill be going back. Extremely poor customer service.

My boyfriend and I came here hoping for excellent sushi. We were sadly disappointed. This was the worst sushi place I have ever been too. Not only was the sushi made with dry, old salmon, but the rolls had hardly any meat in them. On top of the food being horrible, the service was just as bad! I can understand if it is really crowded, but it was not! We waited a while to get our food and then even longer for the check. Then when we told the waitress we did not like our item, she refused to take it off of the bill and would not get the manager when I asked to speak to him/her! Lets just say we will NEVER be going back!!

I work out here, because it is the only place open where I can go after work. The place could be maintained a little better, but for the most part you can still do what you're there to do. The owner will not fix the air conditioning, and as the summer heat is just beginning i'm expecting the place to feel like a concentration camp by late-june. I like to get a good sweat going but i'm not looking for heat exhaustion. Sometimes it is impossible to get a peaceful workout going because the basketball courts are overrun with people screaming. You should definitely look for another gym unless you need to work out when most gyms are closed.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Tried to coming here as a walk in twice, no service. Waited 20 minutes the first time, plenty of open tables, left. Next day waited 10 minutes, had to call a waiter in order to get a table. 
We were finally seated, menu seemed nice. 
They had none of the food that we had tried to order. Seemed like they only had the cod and octopus salad. Waiter said that it was a very busy day and that it is "fine dining". 
In the end we had to go to another place in order to eat. 
Went to Dio Modern Mediterranean, very nice food and fun atmosphere. About a 3 minute walk from here.

We've gotten Limoncello's Family Meal several times since the pandemic started and every time it has been outstanding. What a great value and great food! We love getting to select each part of the meal and we've never been disappointed.
This weekend we took the Family Meal to my  mother-in-law who is Italian and grew up in Chambersburg, the Italian section of Trenton. She's picky when it comes to Italian food but she thought the Limoncello selections were wonderful and made me promise to call the restaurant to pass along her compliments (which I have done). She especially liked the sauce on the penne ala vodka and the tiramisu.

Most disgusting food ever. So bad we left a message for the owners to let them know how poor of quality the meal was. We spent $40 on a meal we literally threw in the garbage. What a waste.  The sesame chicken was like eating burned oil, the chow mien was uncooked and again, oily. The other items (pepper steak, egg rolls, steamed rice) were all off. We couldn't even pinpoint the flavor that ruined the streamed rice; perhaps dirty dishes or an unclean steamer. Whatever it was, the food was beyond awful. Save yourself the trouble and choose a different restaurant to support, where your money doesn't end up in the trash.

This place is a Sh*t show. Very poorly ran. No one seems to have any idea what they're doing. Staff will scratch their head hair then directly touch your food. The food is also mediocre at best, especially for the ridiculous prices! ($16 for a burger and regular size fry) You'll wait in line for 30 minutes while the cooks in the back is goofing around oblivious to anything going on. One cashier waiting on 45 people. Never again. Save your money, buy raw hamburger and make it on your own! It'll probably taste better too plus the manager seems like a total cuck

Shuttle bus was slow in picking us up. There appeared to be at least two buses that went by from each of the other major car rental companies before the Hertz bus arrived. Once at the rental location picking up the vehicle was quick and easy (Gold program). Leaving the facility took awhile as the gate agent was having technology issues with his tablet that shut down two or three times before checking me out and printing my contract. Returning the vehicle was quick and easy and the shuttle bus back to the terminal was waiting for us which made it very convenient.

The car was clean and full of gas upon arrival. They have you use a computer screen and tv monitor to check in, which was easy. I actually accidentally booked a rental car at another location and it wasn't an issue to change to the one I arrived at. My only issue was that the representative convinced me to purchase a tank of gas so I didn't have to worry about filling it. On my way back to the airport I decided to just fill it myself. Unfortunately, pre-purchasing a tank of gas from them was not refundable AND I ended up paying twice for gas. Boo. So don't do that. They should really refund you for that sort of thing.

A nice upscale interior, that feels more like soho than Dale Mabry. Staff was friendly and greeted me immediately. The complimentary whiskey was very cool.  Scalp massage, hot towel on the face all seemed to build up to a great experience.  Then the actual haircut began, the barber had been cutting hair for three years, so not fresh out of school which I liked. Unfortunately he seemed to have a hard time with my wavy/curly hair and told me that most people with my hair just buzz it off.  He was also talking and looking at me in the mirror while scissors were cutting hair.  

It is a great show, but I'll probably stick with my guy.

Worth the money!! Really nice place to work out!! All the team is really friendly, helpful, attentive and well-educated in fitness. The place is super-clean and people there are very considerate in keeping the work-out stations clean for other people that will use them after. There are plenty of machines to use without feeling that you need to stop your training while waiting for another one to be free. 
I'd like to also express my gratitude to Anthony Estrella, who helped my wife and I open a membership taking into consideration our personal goals and lifestyle. He's always been really attentive and comprehensible with our needs.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I have rented from the LARGO location several times now and have not ever been disappointed.  They don't always have the car your reserved but they seem to always find one better without any up-charges.  My last experience was with Jason and he handled my transaction professionally.  Will continue to utilize their services and recommend them to all.  I even had my daughter also rent a vehicle there last time during my rental.  Only change I would make is that they should have some child's seats available at this location.

Bland food. Hard to make Mexican NOT flavorful but somehow they accomplished it. Even the salsas were bleh and they were out of their "house" salsa - the only red salsa - by midday. Tables were left messy and other parties had to ask for one to be bussed so they could have a seat. There's plenty of better Mexican places within 1-2 miles or less of this location. They charge $6 for a side of queso dipping sauce. So basically if you're looking for expensive pricing to receive mushy rice, dry chicken, no lids for drinks, messy tables, and out of their main salsa during lunch service then look no further!

I have gone to the same nail tech for years decided to stop by here an see if they were any good  because they are right down the street from my new place I waited 20 minutes because an employee was doing her own nails at her desk and then I left with the worst lumpiest set of nails I've ever had I will NEVER come back here my nails are all different lengths and there is hair stuck in my polish just absolutely awful I now have to go an pay to get them fixed COMPLETE WASTE OF MONEY I wouldn't even give them one star please don't waste your time or money

Tried eating here after a bad experience over 5 years ago. We came in, albeit without a reservation. We waited in line for 15 minutes only to get to the front where the Young man at the front said that if we didn't have reservations, we'd have to come back in 90 minutes. Mind you, nobody asked any of the other people in like waiting if they had a reservation. What I don't understand is there were at least 4 tables I could see that were empty inside and at least 3-4 outside. It was a mess in there and they looked completely overwhelmed. I'll never attempt to go back again.

We often get take out here when visiting Green Valley because it's convenient to our relatives. But I find the pizza mediocre and overpriced---$55 tonight for three medium pizzas. Also when they're busy, it's very slow. I was told 30 to 35 minutes and arrived after 25 and the woman told me they would be out in a moment. Fifteen minutes later I was told the same thing. They were ready 50 minutes after I had ordered. When I said an accurate estimate would have been useful it was met with a stony silence.  This wasn't the friendly experience others report.

 10/4/2020
I was distraught because my senior cat had taken a sudden turn and his regular vet had no availability.  I took a chance on Art City Vets as an 8:00 AM walk in and I was totally delighted by their service. Their intake and waiting area protocols were COVID safe. The staff was very kind, patient, and understanding of senior cat issues that can take more time.  The vet was so considerate and thorough in her explanations that I felt relieved and clear to make future decisions. The entire process was smooth, efficient, and well thought out. I recommend them highly.

I recently moved here from Chicago where great sushi is easy to find. We were craving sushi and Fujiyama is close to my apartment so we tried it on a Wednesday night. We were the only people there--bad sign.

The presentation is very cool. We got a red dragon roll that looked like a dragon. But the taste was awful. Something was super salty--I think it was the soy sauce. The fish didn't really taste like fish. Texturely it was off. We had the fried calamari, which was edible, but very bland. 

I stopped at Chick-Fil-A on the way home.

I've stayed here MANY times and have always had a pleasant experience. I even stayed here for a little over two weeks when I was having a family emergency. Yes the first floor smells of smoke as it is a SMOKING FLOOR. Problem solved there... I love that they are pet friendly and my dog actually had made many friends while staying with me. The breakfast, though small, is adequate and fresh. The linens are always clean, as well as the floor and bathroom. I've never had any issues with the wifi, or other technology such as television or microwave. I will gladly stay here again the the need arises.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We have lived in several cities around the country and have eaten Chinese in all of them. Most of the time, take-out is pretty much predictable and good.  This place was the worst we've experienced.  The egg rolls hardly had any cabbage and the pork tasted off.  The dumplings had the same problem-the pork is just not seasoned properly.  My husband ordered garlic shrimp but was given black bean shrimp, which he hated.  He threw it out.  I had sweet and sour chicken and the chicken was OK but the sauce was not.  It was a brownish red and not very sweet.   We will not be back.

I came in for balyage with an unnamed stylist, and was traumatized by the event. My hair looked HORRIBLE afterwards even though I showed her photos and told her specifically what colors and tones work well with my hair. Long story short: my hair was stripey and yellow and 430 (!!!) dollars later I had to go to another salon to get it completely redone. 

Needless to say, everyone at the salon that fixed it couldn't believe how much I'd paid and how horrible it looked. It was almost laughable. Seriously, for over 400 dollars that i'm never getting back, this was the worst hair experience of my life :(

I can't even begin to explain my terrible experience. There was a tall gentleman of Caucasian decent who I believe was the "manager". I don't know what was going on but the lobby was a fucking mess. I mean come on... he had no employees cleaning the lobby and was on his phone! So unprofessional. There were fries on the working floor and music with profanity in the background. "Bitch" this, "n*****" that, one song even talked about murder on someone's mind. I don't know what exactly this place was like this as I heard that it was new. I'll never come her ever again and please believe me on that. A complete waste of money and gas.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Not impressed. 3 people were in line including me and no one behind the counter asked how they could help us for 10 minutes. One girl which was blonde with glasses and had tattoos on her wrist was very rude to one customer and I. Saying "I wasn't talking to you I was talking to him (me)" and saying "you guys need to let us know you are here" well you didn't ask anyone....She shouldn't be working in any type of business being like that. The taller older gentleman was nice to everyone (must be the manager) and took care of everybody by himself. Really impressed by him.

This was my first time staying at this resort. Our room was a little out dated.. the outlet cover was broken and exposing wires behind the nightstand . On two occasions our room was not serviced during our week stay. The guest service staff was friendly and helpful other than the resort manager who was very rude. Also a surprise.. you will be charged almost $11.00 a day to park in the parking lot  What the resort does have going for it is a nice pool.. descent restaurant & good location to other restaurants & shopping
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went to my local McDonald's drive-thru today.  I ordered an Egg McMuffin and a Hash Brown. The Egg McMuffin didn't have Canadian bacon on it and they forgot to include the hash brown.  I repeated my order back to the window person but it didn't faze her.  On top of all that, my sandwich was cold! Of course, I didn't realize any of that until I got home!  Boy, was I disappointed!  This is the McDonald's I frequently visit and there always seems to be something wrong with my order.  That's no big deal if you're actually in the store; however, I was not going to go back out after getting home.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have had two different barbers at this place and they both cut my hair pretty much the same they are a true barbershop sort of like they can cut hair for the military but they're not really stylist. The weird thing is you face the people waiting in chairs right in front of year so it's kind of awkward half the chairs have mirrors that you can see what's going on the other half don't unless they turn around but they constantly have you face the people waiting. So if you like to have an audience while you're getting your haircut this is the place to go.

I am very very upset. My husband took my Durango to get cleaned while I was at work. We had some pills on the door for my son. They were told not to touch the pills at all. The staff said ok. When we get the truck back the pills were gone. We went back to see what happened after he picked me back up from work for them to tell me they got vacuumed up. The pills are very expensive and I am not happy with the situation at all. They never cleaned the other door at all. So I got half ass cleaning and now I have to pay out of pocket for his pills to be replaced. They did offer another car wash in place but I am very  displeased

Ordered some donuts for co-workers off of uber eats. The driver was nice, however none of the donuts were what I ordered and when I contacted the store, the person that I spoke with just said "well we didn't have any made and tried our best". A courtesy call would have gone a long way for this as the ones they picked weren't even close to what I had chosen. The lady at the store ended up hanging up on me when I stated I was not pleased and disappointed in this experience. Would not recommend-at least not delivery.

Dont get suckered into an up sale! They do less than even adequate work there. We paid for a $50 car wash and the inside still looked virtually untouched. I had to go home and clean the inside again myself. The  place has really gone down hill and has gotten a bit shady. In addition to selling you a car wash they will try to sell you Beats By Dre... Which they claim are on the "low-low". Also I watched a guy take a bottle of water out of my car.. Open it and drink it. My mouth literally dropped. I would have given him a bottle of water but to take it out of the floor board of someone's car you don't know and drink it was disturbing.

I'm not usually one to leave reviews; however, I felt as though one was warranted. On arrival  I asked the cashier specifically if they're super nachos had beans, considering I didn't want beans, the cashier told me no. I placed my order and once received the food needed salt, which no big deal but I also wasn't given salsa which could've helped the situation. To make matters worse halfway through the nachos I realized that they came with beans even though I was told otherwise. Overall not my best experience and don't plan on returning.

Non-existent service. Once we were seated we waited forever for ordering drinks/appetizers.  Then bread came but no olive-oil to dip it in (which came about 10 minutes later.) The waitress was aloof and disinterested. An hour later we were still waiting for the main course. Mine, when it arrived had paper-clippings on it! I returned it and decided not to get a substitute dish for (a) what else could have been in the dish, and (b) I didn't want to leave any of my money to this place. Four people around me on the table complaint that their food was salty and the pasta cold. Not going back again.

I made reservations through AAA for this hotel.  We stayed here because it was for our anniversary and we wanted to try somewhere different in the city.  The hotel was nice but even though I paid for the room through AAA they still charged me  for the night so I paid twice.  I have called their billing office and have had no luck fixing the problem.  Hopefully someone sees this and actually does something.

**Update*** I got my money refunded.  I am still concerned that none of my voicemails regarding the problem were returned.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Nice hotel at a great beach location.  Check in was fast and pleasant.  Staff was very professional and explained details for parking, complimentary breakfast, beach towels, etc.  We booked the 2 bedroom suite which was clean and well equipped.  You get a partial view of the beach from your balcony (request a room closer to the beach for a better view). Beach access is easy. The pool bar is nice and drinks are reasonable.  Complimentary breakfast is good but a bit crowded.  Overall I think the hotel is a good value and we had a fun stay.  I would definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I'll give Samano's (Fishers) 3 stars for the food, but only 1 star for the service so average it at 2 stars.  Two of our party of three had finished our lunch meal before the third person's food even arrived.  They even came out and asked what was ordered like they lost it and it wasn't a unique order.  The man taking the orders at the counter was curt and seemed bothered by doing that job and more concerned about what or what not was going on at the grill and plating.  The restaurant was not crowded for lunch time on a Saturday so hate to think how it would be if it was truly busy.  The chairs are extremely uncomfortable too.

This outlet gave me two pairs of glasses that were blurry and said that the precription i provided them was older than one year and thats why the glasses were blurry however i am able to wear my old glasses which i also brought from Optical Outlet wuth no issues. I asked Optical Outlet how this issued can be resolved since they put the wrong precription in my glasses and they said they would get back to me and as of this writing they have not. Optical Outlets of Pinellas Park Florida is more interested in Sales than resolving Customer Complaints i will no longer do business with this Company.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
DONT WASTE YOUR TIME!!!!!!
Went to the location on East Bay in Clearwater and was extremely disappointed!! All of the employees were morons!! One employee told me one thing and then after I went ALL THE WAY back home to get the documents I was told I needed, I came back and was told something totally different by another employee.. the whole thing was the most infuriating experience and I can promise you I WONT be back!!! 
So if you're thinking about renting a car you should DEFINITELY NOT go to the Enterprise Rent-A-Car on East Bay Drive in Clearwater!!!!!
You're welcome!

Brand new hotel, so everything is updated, clean, and nice. The staff were very accommodating - checked us in a few hours early because our plan landed earlier than expected. It is off the beaten path/main strip, but that's not really an issue since you walk everywhere anyway. The on site bar/restaurant is also very nice. The bartenders and staff are great to converse with and can recommend some cool, local places. The only real con I can think of at the moment is that the construction can be pretty loud. Overall, I'd stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I went to this Burger King last night because I didn't feel like leaving base, but it's worth the drive next time. I pulled into the drive thru and the little boy that was working there burped first thing into his headset then asked what I would like. Then I pulled up to the window and the little boy gave me a bag of freezing cold fries.. I told him there is no way these are fresh. He asked me "oh you wanted them fresh?" 

Nooo! Please give me your oldest batch of fries. Please and thank you. 

Possibly needs new employees. I went nov 2 @ 6-7pm if that helps narrow down who to get rid of.

Came here in May for my birthday, stayed at the hotel next door. RUDE hostess, acted like the world owed her something, told us we could find our own seats. After sitting at a table for 10 min with no one checking on us, my friends and I went to the bar. The bartender was super nice n hot LOL she recommended great drinks, every food choice was on point, and she even gave us some great tips in the city and random stuff to check out. It is 2 bad a chick like that is stuck in this dump. When we plan our next guys trip to NOLA I hope I find this girl, working in another bar. Best shots ever.

Food was very delicious! The set up kind of gave me the feel of a diner. It was a little hard to find, housed in an apartment building. Food came out quick and fresh. I had the Belgian waffle topped with whipped cream, bananas, strawberry, chocolate and caramel syrup. The fruit was nice and ripe so deliciously sweet. I asked him to hold the pineapples. My friend got the chicken burger which was a breaded chicken, seasoned very nicely. You could definitely tell the chicken burger "patty" was made in house. Definitely planning to go back! The chef was our waiter so that was nice too.

I took my FOUR year old daughter to get her first pair of glasses. For those of you with small children, you know the attention span clock starts ticking before you exit the car.  We had Rx in hand from Vanderbilt and for 20 minutes no one said anything to us. We proceeded to try on different pairs of glasses and finally the lady at the front desk who had been busy the entire time asked a man that worked there to help us because we had been waiting for so long. At that point I had already decided to leave so I told him we would be going to look at other options elsewhere.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Beware the parking scam!!  They won't tell you when you make the reservation, but when you arrive to check-in they charge you $12 / night for parking.  I can understand why they charge during football games (because the hotel is literally next door to Lucas Oil Stadium) but when i checked in, it wasn't even football season!!! :)  To their credit, after some complaining they removed the parking charge.

Not quite "holiday inn express" quality.  The pool had no chlorine, and both of the two treadmills were broken in the workout facility.  Rooms were nice and clean...no problems there, which is most important.  Free WiFi.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have never written a negative review of anything....but I'm changing my tune. The area is beautiful and I love the atmosphere, but the management company is the worst I've ever seen. I went three days without air conditioning, which is illegal in Florida, and no one would return my call. Tonight I went to pay my rent so not to get a late fee, the door was locked, they looked at me through their glass windows and ignored me for 10 minutes. My dishwasher wasn't hooked up for weeks after move in. I think they should fire every last person in that office and I would not move here until they fix it. I give one star because yelp made me.

Would not stay here again! Its seems pretty neglected! They sent us to a room that was already occupied the first time, the next room was horribly out dated w/ only 2 channels on the tv, and matresses that looked high millage if you know what I mean. We requested anther room. On The third room the key didn't work. But we were satisfied upon entry. The following night the key didn't work again. This time it took 3 trips to the office to finally get in. Staff was nice and apologetic. Not worth what they charge. Should be under $50 a night
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very very bright! Pretentious. While ordering ice cream cones we innocently said how great it would be to have sprinkles... The barista responded as if we slapped her. "No sprinkles, nuts, whip cream of any of that. We are a coffee shop. Not an ice cream parlor." I said, you have an ice cream counter, which kind of makes  you both! The second barista said, " I agree with her. I'm a barista." Is sipping ice cream beneath you? Hmmm...marigny/Bywater coffee shops- too many to count. Ice cream parlor- none. Just saying.

Went to Reno for couple days, I was in a mood for seafood after checking a few restaurants I found tacos jalisco, decided to try, I ordered queso fundido with chorizo for appetizer not very good, then The Mega, the menu says shrimp, oysters, clams, crab... when I got my food never had any oyster or clams, crab is immitation, I ordered with no cucumber, server told me they can make it with out it and I still got cucumber in it. "Thanks God I'm not alergic", my wife ordered tacos al pastor and tripa
a good taco needs a good sauce, definitely I'm not coming back to this place.

I have called in to Planet Fitness two times to inquire about memberships. I liked the idea of 10 dollars a month obviously (that's so cheap and Planet has every piece of equipment a young woman would want,) however, when I went in to finally join my excitement plummeted because they wanted my account number. They refused to let me sign up with a credit card, let alone pay in full in cash. When I asked to atleast try the gym for free since I came all the way out, they said no and I returned in my car to be thoroughly disappointed and still without a gym membership. 

While the gym does look clean, I was sad I was not able to try it.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: This is hands down my favorite Italian restaurant in Tampa. The service is always attentive and helpful. The place is small so it is very intimate. I would recommend reservations but we often go without and do not have to wait too long. They have a wine bar a few doors down where you can wait and have a drink. The pasta is homemade and amazing. The portion sizes are perfect. I often bring home some leftovers which I love. The pink sauce is my favorite with many different dishes like the lasagna. The coffee is also amazing so make sure you get one when you finish your meal. This place is a must if you love real Italian food.

My husband and I love Yanako for the atmosphere and friendly service.

The food is good, but far too small for the price. We also dine-in or pick-up once a week and just moved here and are use to our beloved sushi spots giving us bigger rolls every once and a while when they see our constant returned service. That could be a little much to ask for from Yanako, but the rolls are definitely way too small and they really need to re-think their portion size.

If it wasn't for the portions, I would give Yanako the final 2 stars. Just too expensive for what you get!

So at the urging of my husband we ordered here again. Give it another chance, he said. Ordered lunch specials, husband went to pick it up. Brought it home, wrapped nicely in brown paper bag which he didn't open before leaving the restaurant. Opened it up. No soup or soda, as specified in the menu that comes free with lunch. Called them back. "Well you didn't tell me which one you wanted." was the reply. Are you kidding me? You didn't specify so we didn't ask and you got nothing. Seriously, get it together people.

Dr. Antoine was really really nice and courteous. He explained things thoroughly to me and helped me understand why I hadn't been seeing as clearly as I could. Going forward he's my Dr. for life. I really enjoy feeling valued while visiting an establishment. My only complaint would be my appt was at 11:20 and I wasn't seen until 12, hence the 4 star rating. I do not believe it was the Dr's fault, instead the front desk. Despite not being busy (myself and an older lady)and his office being completely staffed (maybe over staffed) I was just sitting there until finally I said something. Despite that, everyone was nice.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This place was okay, my nails looked fine. However one nail technician (not the one who was doing my nails) changed the price after she started doing my nails and kept asking if I was going to be able to afford it. I had to pay extra for length and for shape. It came out at $45 and they weren't even dry when I left. My hands were under a hand dryer for around 20 minutes and I was looking for my nail technician and asking for her to start it again because they weren't dry and she never came and ignored me. So eventually I just had to walk out with wet nails. Again my nails looked fine but with the price and service I would give it three stars.

Horrible experience! I went to pick up contacts for my husband, the first time the location was closed and never posted it on their website or mentioned they would be closed when we called in the prescription. Then a week later when we went to pick up the prescription, they were very very unprofessional 4 employees just were standing around the front desk doing nothing, and there were customers waiting to be helped. They had no communication with the customer, they were not friendly. Even when employees interacted with one another they were rude to each other, and lacked customer service.

text: Every one in our group ordered the breakfast buffet. Over all it was an great dining experience. The food was good. And the waiter was excellent. He stopped by often and refilled our drinks without having to be asked. One of our group ordered pancakes from the buffet and the waiter brought whipped cream for him. They had a wide variety of food that was well made. You could ask for buffet pancakes and eggs made how you like them. The only reason it will not give it five stars is that we found some food crust on a fork. The fork was cleaned so it was sterile but it was still a bit of a turnoff

I ordered take out here for the first time and there was a major communication barrier while trying to place my order. i repeated my credit card number too many times and then i was called three time for my address .once the driver arrived , he was friendly but the food was cold . I ordered beef and broccoli add shrimp , the beef tasted sour and metallic  the gravy tasted like an oily beef base mixture  and the Shrimp were doughy and tasteless and one of the shrimp had green and brown spots on it as  if it were raised in radioactive water . No WAy Ever Again!!!

I had booked a room at another hotel after driving for 15 hours.  The hotel I had booked was filthy and I refused to stay so my 2 dogs and me had to find a place for the night.  My dogs and I were tired and hungry when I arrived at LaQuinta and the people at the front were so nice and accommodating to us!  I explained my situation to them.  They promptly got us in a room, gave us suggestions for food delivery, even upgraded me to a nicer room!!  The room I was given was very nice and clean.  I was very impressed with the staff and my brief stay here!  Would recommend!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I just don't understand how I get the wrong order every single time I don't check my bag before leaving. Why would someone want hot sauce with a McGriddle? There should be some kind of brain power that tells the order taker they're misunderstanding the order. But no... instead of sausage burritos I have McGriddles with hot sauce on the side. It's almost comical at this point lol. I placed this order in the lobby so there was no screen to verify. I messed up by not asking for the receipt and reviewing it either. At least my iced coffee wasn't disgusting.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I went to Leo's last night.  Not only is it stuck in the 70's, but most of the clientele is as well.  As I am in my 40's, other than the polite waitstaff, my friend and I were the youngest people in the entire place.  I only ordered the Bruschetta, and it was very bland, not even a dash of cilantro.  My friend had the wings.  Although it smelled a bit spicy, he said it wasn't spicy at all. I'm sure it's great for the snowbirds that are a regular here in Palm Harbor, but for the younger people (read, under 50 crowd), it's advised to find another place to eat.

Hey Alex. My little sister just got home from the hair cut service you gave her...IN TEARS. Not only did I see the 5 inches of length she walked in with, I also reviewed the photos she showed you. I can't even begin to discuss the lack of customer service in your shop, because i'm too disgusted by your inability to listen to your customers wants/needs. This is unacceptable and should NOT be tolerated in an industry that is meant to make people feel better about themselves. The photos attached speak for themselves... I hope this doesn't happen to anyone else.

The Staff at Optical Outlets Largo are knowledgeable and friendly.  Dr. Plante was thorough in his exam and explanation of my results. Rachel (sp?) and Grace were very patient with some not-so-nice callers and kept their cool when parents left their children run amok in the busy waiting area.  
I've been a patient here for years.  Once I tried another 'cheaper' place, who got my prescription wrong and wanted to charge me again to correct it!  Optical Outlets re-examined me and provided me with the correct prescription and made sure I received the best deal available to me. 
I was happy to see they remodeled and enlarged the entire space!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: If I could give this zero stars I would. Hotel staff very rude, rooms were nasty and falling apart (can't even tell where their "construction/renovation" occurred. We were told pool was open...within 15 minutes of being in got kicked out due to chemical imbalance...then had to listen to pumps running outside of room all night for pool. They charged $4 for the breakfast, which would have been a great price, but food was cold, undercooked, and a few food items had clearly been improperly stored as they were dried out and nasty. Won't waste my money here ever again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If you consider renting a car at Thrifty just please go to some other place. I've rented the car for 6 days, the estimated price for a day was about 18$ per day. Then I had to return the car earlier, so the price for a day went up to 48$ per day, which ridiculously higher compared to any other rental company. Additionally, to that they made me pay 25$ fee for early return. Also, just to let you know if you're late for an hour, they will charge you the insurance fee for the whole next day. I would never come back to this company again.

I was so excited for this place because it was highly recommended by my colleagues. I had eaten twice there previously both eat in and take out . Every thing was so good and fresh and I got the Lava Roll it was so good and beautiful both times. So on 07/09/2018 I decided to get a take out again, and to my surprise and disappointment it looked like the roll was thrown in the box like my order was rushed. And it didn't even taste fresh I was so upset. Maybe it was a different person who made it and maybe didn't know how to properly make it . But I really don't know if I will give it another chance.

Room is great had everything you needed. Great breakfast each morning. Those are the good things, was not told when I booked that their pool and hot tub where drained. I am here for business I have a set government rate I'm supposed be tax-exempt they will not honor the taxi exempt even with the form I was given to give to them, and parking is $20 a night on top of the room I asked him to comp my parking or part of it since they won't give me tax exempt. That didn't happen.  They were very rude about it. Each morning they are very rude because I questioned them.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been dealing with these guys for years, and they've always been good to me so the least I can do is share my experiences on here. I'm either greeted with a smile by Hal, Dave, or Steve up front. I'm not too knowledgable when it comes to the inner workings of an automobile, but I can honestly say that I trust these guys and I never feel like what they tell me is anything but 100% true. My cars are always done on time for a reasonable price. I can give a full recommendation for anything related to your car that this is the place to go.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Horrible every time I come here the big lady thats a manager is very rude and mean to costumer and employee its not just once of twice its every time I come she's very mean to everyone. And I feel bad for the employees. And other customers I'm pretty sure her name is Rebecca. All the other employees are great.
