text: Not familiar with the area so we chose this place from the awesome photos and reviews. The actual menu is very limited with older photos of menu choices apparently from the previous owner. The pizza we wanted to order (the Royal) was something they didn't make. Settled for the pepperoni. We sat on the patio because inside was very hot. We had finished half our pizza before someone came back out to check on us so we could remind them that we never got our beverages. Pizza tasted okay but much smaller than expected.

Sat there from 10 in the morning till 3 the tech finally came out and said I need it struts and the new alignment and I just got an  alignment two months ago the tires were not Feathering or anything I was frustrated I said just put the effing tires on the car he threw the old tires back on the car and he says nobody curses at me and they threw me out of the building after spending over 4 hours there I tried to tell him I was frustrated from work and sitting there all day but that wasn't good enough if I could give that place a zero I would tires may be cheap but they try to rip you off everywhere else

Do not rent from them! The service at the actual place were nice, the car was in ok shape, and we got a fair price for the rental.. BUT bad customer service can make you hate a place! I was charged for Admin fees on my bills without being provided proof! They charged my account and I was forced to basically accept the fees. They expect you to provide proof for any fee you challenge according to their site but cant provide the same proof for their customers. I feel cheated and believe theyre unethically charging fees and getting away with it.

The reason I'm giving only 3 stars is because they advertise a free continental breakfast but when we went to have it they said all that was allowed was a corn muffin and juice or coffee. That is not breakfast! Otherwise everything was as usual. Nice room, nice staff, very close to the convention center and the reading market. WARNING: we were almost scammed in the parking lot when a man tried to sell us a ticket for parking but when I asked for a receipt he got sketchy. I luckily refused and paid at the kiosk. So only pay at the kiosk. Not really the hotels fault.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It's nice to get some low priced japanese food here, and I was a big fan of their Chicken Curry and Rice. That is up until I got some pretty nasty food poisoning from it (clutching the porcelain bowl for about 3-4 hours afterwards) and from telling friends and family, they assured me that they know of a number of people that have gotten food poisoning from this particular Sushi Teri. 
That said, I've eaten at this restaurant many times before without any incident, but it'll be a while if I ever eat there again

I refuse to take my car anywhere else.

I began using Pat's Auto Repair based on a recommendation from a friend when I first moved to Indy straight out of college.  I'm young (sort of), female, very naive about cars, and kind of a terrible driver.  They take care of me without making me feel stupid or embarrassed about my crummy Focus.  They keep it running at a good price and are honest about the work they can and cannot do.  I came from a small town, and I didn't realize that places like this existed in Indianapolis.  

If your car is broken, take it to Pat's.  That is all.

It's kind of sad that the only good thing that you can say about the food having good taste is when you add the commercially produced and purchased hot sauce they have on each table and the pop that they have absolutely nothing to do with making. The rest of the food here is very underseasoned and bland. A little bit more time on seasoning the food and the place would've gotten a better review. the restaurant is clean and like most Mexican restaurants it's got it's own little charms but that doesn't help with the lackluster food.

Budget surely stands out amongst the competition mainly because of its nationwide locations. Budget not only can be found in most major airports and cities, but also offers huge pay-now savings, where you can save up to 35 percent, with most other car rental companies offering only 10 to 15 percent. This car rental company has you covered if you ever encounter unexpected car trouble by giving discounted rates on all its models just for these circumstances. If that wasn't enough, its mobile app makes it simple and easy for on-the-go reservations.

Service has always been good in my experience, never had a problem there.

The breakfast food quality is garbage, although that might just be standard Dunkin' fare, so I probably can't hold that against this location. The coffee and donuts are perfectly good though.

I would probably rate it higher, if not for the fact that there have been multiple occasions where I showed up a few minutes after when they're supposed to open and there was nobody there. I can forgive it once, but this has happened several times.

This was our first stay at Bode.  The pics looked really nice and I loved the concept.  I was very disappointed upon entering the room.  We had single king room.  It was VERY small.  NO closet.  Just some flimsy 12" bar leaned up against the wall that immediately fell when I hung a few shirts in it.  The bathroom is tiny.  It's somewhat clean but I have stayed in much nicer rooms for the equivalent price or less.  It looks like they took an old rundown hotel and painted it dark gray to make it look modern.  Warning... this hotel in NOT as nice as the picture!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I visit and spend a lot Starbucks stores and hold them to a higher standard than a other coffee places as they charge a premium price for coffee and food, it's hit and miss Like others have said and this is just a slower store which is why it is always claustrophobic in there.
Many of the baristas are very nice but This location is not very intuitive and the older manager lady here is sour. Sorry I'm not the only one who has commented on this.
It would be helpful to put the mobile orders where customers can get to them.
I

When traveling for business, I want to wake more rested than when I went to sleep. This was not the case at the Doubletree. First, I was put in a room that had an adjoining room. This is as a gold status guest, so the rest of y'all better worry how they're going to treat you. So I was treated to all the noise of my neighbor. Second, there is a constant start and stop whirling sound that goes 24/7. It must be the elevators even though my room is not adjacent.  Incredibly distracting. The location is good and the room was clean, so at least they have that going for them.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
New owner seems to be a great guy,gym is low price.. I don't tan but its been added. Previously all of the equipment was broken and the gym had a lot of wasted space, new owner cleaned and painted everything.. all equipment is in working order now. The space has been optimized so that it makes sense. Locker room & showers have been cleaned and fixed.. text: Pizza here is good, not great. I appreciate the family run atmosphere, and the menu's simplicity  (only pies are cheese and sausage). But if you're going to keep it simple, the crust had better be damn good. This crust is mediocre here. The sauce and cheese covered area is quite tasty, but when you get to the substantial bones, for me they were tossable.  Made me feel like a seven year old to leave a pile of crusts, but they just weren't worth eating. I only come to this area a couple times a year, and while okay, I would hope this is not the best Philly has to offer.

I've been here about five times. Four of those were late-night snack attempts, all of which were thwarted because their credit card system seems to be unable to function in the wee hours. Four of five - that's a trend. The fifth time, they didn't have beef for the bigger burgers. Seriously. A McDonald's that couldn't serve burgers for multiple days. So in order to get close to a guacamole burger, I ended up spending a small fortune on upgrades to the tiny burgers, and it wasn't the same. And they weren't apologetic about it. They just pointed at printed signs and shrugged.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: 5 of us stayed in a 3 bedroom Bode and it was perfect for our girls trip. The location is VERY convenient and close to Broadway, the Gulch, and a great coffee shop called Crema and Brewery called Yee Haw.  We had so much space in the living room and kitchen, so no one ever felt confined to a room. It was far better than the tiny space that you get in a hotel. It was so convenient to have drinks on site and a fridge to store those items. It's just a great concept and we enjoyed the stay. Also, everyone agreed that the mattresses and pillows were so comfortable. I slept really well and had no issues with noise.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Still the worst car wash I have ever been to. Thought I would give them another try the other day.  No pre-rinse, attendants start brushing hood and trunk dry, inside the foamy soap is barely reaching the car, the overhead brushes were out of order and didn't move.  The car came out with two wide areas from front to back that were still completely dirty. Half hearted attempt to dry with old towels. 

Last time I went, a while ago, I was the first one there and had streaks of grease from the equipment on the car. 

Never again!

Worst Nashville Hot Chicken ever. It was basically just a pile of grease and bones held together by breading. This is the first time I've ever felt the need to leave a Yelp review mainly because I don't want to hurt a small business that might be having an off night so you knows it's bad. I guarantee this place is always having an off night. The Gibson Cafe is so off-brand it should be called the Epiphone Grill. Stop have a drink, listen to the live music but if you're hungry, you'd be better off at the Burger King in the food court.

We love this place.....classy , great service and awesome food for right price!!!!!! Yes it gets busy but if u want to eat good u gotta wait.......been there at least ten times and always had great time. One of my favorite places. Never seen management yelling at nobody or anything like and if u complaining about not being welcome there with kids please dont take em with u next time ......get a babysitter or go to c.cheese. and no we have kids too but at 8 pm dinner time they shouldnt be there....sorry thats just my opinion.....

They suck. They had orders backed the heck up. I asked for and iced coffee and tea with cream and sugar. The guy in front of me got a large iced coffee. The staff was slow and was rushing people's orders. When the guy got his iced coffee it was coffee at the top with all the cream at the bottom like all of the cream. I asked for and iced coffee as well. When I got the tea it was in a baby sized cup even smaller. It had no sugar in it at all. Then I got my iced coffee ok I left the place and got in my car. The coffee had literally no sugar just like my tea. I was furious and I wasn't goin back to their not ever again.

Staff was friendly, lobby is small but nice. Rooms are small, especially the bathroom! We stayed here For the Rock and Roll Half marathon and we were a little disappointed. I could deal with most of the things in the room but to come back from running 13 miles, you want to shower! There was no hot water, and the water pressure from the shower head was a trickle at best! So it was a cold shower for us! The best part about the hotel was their porch! I would not stay again next year, I'll be looking for another hotel!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: we paid close to $150 for one night. Not too bad but not that cheap either. we expect for that price a much cleaner room. the actual room was ok, just dusty and cleanliness of the carpet questionable but the bathroom was so dirty. Grout covered in black mold and floor corners obviously never get cleaned.  While the check-in was ok when I told the receptionist we wanted a quiet room, she supposedly upgraded us. Happy until we got to the room to find it was overlooking the roof with all the HVAC fans going at full speed as well as the Christ church cemetery. just not that pleasant.  ​
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: What can I say but YUCK!  The room had not been cleaned!!!!  One chair had cat food on it!!  Leftovers in the fridge, dirty floors.  Not a bit dirty, but needing to be swept and mopped dirty!!!  Handicap rails in the bath by the toilet were dirty with....afraid to guess.  This place needs new management, so when you go to the front desk about these problems with a handful of cat food just ask if it's clean now.  This place needs a deep cleaning!!!!  Get the dirt out of the tile grout!!!  should have slept in our car.  Next time we will try the Hampton Inn we saw nearby, can't be worse, can it???
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The food here is just not that good. Went here two years ago and had fish tacos that were dried out and bland. Thought maybe that was just one bad dish so decided to give it another try. Appetizers were good but most entrees are covered in sauce and not that flavorful. Thankfully the kids liked their meals but none of the adults did. The sauce for the crab cake sliders had separated and looked like it was sitting in the fridge for awhile. Only thing going for it is the location and view. Without that, I don't think you would see many people here.

We ventured out today for our first restaurant visit since Covid19 began.  We were warmly greeted by the hostesses.  The entire server staff individually thanked us for being there.  Our primary server, Tess, was absolutely wonderful.  
Vivace certainly did everything right.  Tables were positioned to provide proper social distancing.  All the staff wore masks and gloves.  The menus were on paper for easy disposal.  
An exciting experience.  We'll look forward to another great experience there again real soon.

I used to live in River Ridge and go to Breaux Mart in the morning after work sometime. I guess it was Ok for the most part, the older employees were Ok but it seemed like the teenagers were a little on the "smart ass" side, with their little blue knit shirts. Clean store, pretty good selection, not too crowded. I started going there more often after I went to the Winn Dixie down the street one morning and saw a kid hauling around a big pile of garbage, in huge leaking, grimy bags, using the same shopping cart you use for groceries. A customer "turn-off" you might say.

Upon sitting in the drive thru I witnessed a female worker with pink hair remove a head set from a male workers head and then place it on her head. She had gloves on and was in the middle of making a sandwich. She didn't change her gloves at all during this interaction. She touched another persons head with gloves she was previously touching food with and then touched a headset and placed it on her head to which she got right back to making the sandwich directly after. This is gross and unsanitary to the fullest. I will not be returning to this subway after seeing that.

me and my hubby stayed there 2 nights for a small honeymoon the water in tub came out a greenish color asked to be moved never happened 1st morning woke up to a fire alarm the excuse was a kid pulled it the 2nd morning fire alarm unexplained both mornings the alarm sounded through out the building ear ripping noise I was very upset the 2nd time manager viki said sorry there's nothing that can be done I would like to know if anyone knows the owners info so I can get the issue I have with this place resolved I usually stay at plaza beach resort and they treat their customers with care and respect unlike this place iam very disappointed
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went to the McDonalds on Mae Anne in Reno, waited 30 minutes in the drive through and the food was soooo bad. Know it's McDonalds so expectations weren't too high. Quarter pounder deluxe had super wilted lettuce and a weird extra piece of meat on it. Kid cheeseburger meal with out mustard had a ton of mustard on it and fries were soggy and cold. Needless to say the whole pile went into the trash uneaten. Won't do that again.  Have tried this McDonald's several times and always get something's wrong or even really gross. Won't be doing that again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
At first I thought all was well. I got my car inspected and and oil changed quickly on a Saturday. In addition to reasonable charges for the inspection and oil, my bill had a $15.75 charge for "shop supplies."  The description included profit for the shop. That's ridiculous after charging $11 per quart of oil. When I asked the manager to remove this charge, he rudely refused and said if he did , he would a remove coupons ( which were not used) to make my bill higher. 
Typical old school slimy auto franchise.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: this dunkin is less than a mile away from my house. i have been there DOZENS of times. My biggest complaint is the inconsistency of the coffee. Every single one tastes different. The second thing isle impersonal the staff is. The past three times i have been, while i am pulling up the the window the cashier sticks their head out the window TO MAKE ME PULL UP FASTER. Most of the time i am the only one in the drive thru. They do not say hello. They simply swipe my card and send me on my way. Terrible and rushed service that makes people feel like they are annoyed. UHHG

Many years I have been coming to Jack Furriers for oil changes. Today I decided to try this shop out for the first time. After the tech changed the oil, he forgot to PUT THE FILTER ON. Oil was everywhere on the bottom of my truck and on the floor. The Manager said there was a problem with the gasket on the filter and I asked why is there so much oil on the ground and the filter is sitting on his work bench....Then after he was done, I decided to check the oil level while I was there. Sure enough, it was a quart low. BEWARE OF THIS PLACE!

text:
While a great location for walking to many sites, this hotel was way sub-par on cleanliness, and response to requests and complaints. Mold on the tiles, rust on the bath fixtures, holes and stains on the sheets, dust on the clock radio, food crumbs on the carpet and BIG time mold in the ice dispenser. I have photos of all of this.
The toilet tank leaked so there was a puddle under it all through my 2-day stay. I complained 3 times and nothing was done. No washcloths. Asked for them, came back hours later and still none!

text: I needed to find a mechanic closer to home, and after reading these reviews, I had to give A & W a try.  I knew there were a list of things wrong with my car, but as Andrew pointed out, sometimes when you fix one thing, that fix can solve other problems.....and it did!  He showed me what was wrong, every part he had replaced, and explained the detailed bill.  He and his crew were very friendly and I didn't feel like I had been taken advantage of because I'm a women.  If you're looking for an honest experienced auto shop, look no further.

I absolutely love this store in general. I have been going to this establishment for years, and it's always a pleasure. The people working there always treat me properly. Except recently. Lately Everytime I go through drive through I am greeted with poor customer service from this gal named Alyssa. Always rude, no eye contact, and no conversation what so ever. It's odd seeing this behavior from an employee at this store after coming here for so many years. How unfortunate.. hopefully she doesn't scare away the rest of us.

The food is fairly decent in price here and it is not a bad place to get lunch. I don't get up this way often, but when I do, I find its better than some of the cheap mexican food places over at this end of town. Not sure why the reviews are so all-over-the-place. The food is not gourmet, but I have yet to find mexican food in Tucson that is as good as other places I have eaten throughout the US (go figure . . .). The soft tacos are good, the flautas are not bad, the drinks are ok (would like to see the margaritas improve).

My husband and I walked by and saw people eating breakfast and it looked good!  After doing a little shopping we returned from some breakfast.  We both got the french toast, scrambled eggs and sausage.  Their raspberry preserves were good great with the french toast.  Everything was very good and it was a pretty big portion.  The customer service there was top notch.  The orange juice was pretty good too.  It was the prefect way to end a nice weekend in Santa Barbara.  If I ever come back I want to try their Eggs Benedict.

Had ordered a mini sandwich tray for 20 25 people called on Saturday August 14 and gave my order to Allison the deli manager ask for order to be ready for pick up at 3 on Sunday the 15th was told would be ready when I arrives to pick up order they couldn't even find the order , if it wasn't for the great girl in the deli who worked hard to get it done and the amazing assistant store manager Chris for his awesome customer skills and for compensating me I would have walked out and never return to that store again which I shop at 2 to 3 times a week , thanks again

I would skip this hotel. The bathtub in the first room I checked into was filthy. It was as if there was a sewer back up and it was not cleaned. The front desk staff was sympathetic and gasped at the picture I took of the tub. They gave me a new room and offered a drink credit, which I did not need. My new room had dirt and lint literally hanging from the bathroom vent but I decided to just cringe and live with it as I did not want to be *that* person. The restaurant was understaffed and people were walking out without being served breakfast or even given a menu. Very pleasant staff, but appears to have poor management and attention to detail.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I set up a reservation for enterprise to meet me at my house with my rental car at 8 am (I had no car after a car accident- which is why I needed a rental). They did not show up, so I called and was told "oh we're really busy and will be there closer to 10."
I called two more times throughout the day, each time being told there would be a delay. Each time waiting on hold for up to 30 minutes. I finally had to arrange childcare and take an Uber to the rental place to ensure I got the car before they closed. When I arrived there was no car ready for me.

We ordered through Postmates and the initial time was a 25-30 minute wait. The time kept climbing as we waited and finally an hour after it's estimated arrival time (90 minutes) our pizza was delivered. It was barely warm. We had called the restaurant to inquire what was taking so long, but we were immediately put on hold for 10 minutes, so we gave up. I'm dissatisfied with the level of customer service. It appears that our pizza was left to sit for a long time before the app was updated and the driver could pick it up. The pizza was decent, but not worth the wait.

I have to give a shout out to this shop. I have a severe peanut allergy and I know I am taking a chance to eat ice cream from a  shop that can clearly have cross contamination issues without any fault of their own. This is the second time at this shop that when I alert the server that I have a severe peanut allergy and they have, without asking, go back to the freezer and pull out new tubs of ice cream, THREE different flavors and also a new scoop. Thank you so much, it made my date night with my wife that much better.

I've never had problems with Sakura in all the years I've been ordering there. Tonight we got our usual, but when we got home we noticed the spicy shrimp roll was missing. No need to drive back, just wanted a refund on the roll since they increased their prices during the pandemic as well. The owner said he would refund me then called me back and basically called me a liar because his chef (who makes probably 1000's rolls per day) said he made it. For never complaining before, you'd think he would show better customer service.

Do not stay here. The cleaning ladies have been outside my room all morning cussing, banging and carrying on. They have yelled and even had a toddler with them that was screaming! I have heard them open numerous rooms with people inside them still. They have basically been yelling in Spanish all morning since about 5 am. When I arrived last night they were doing the exact same thing. It seems my room is right by the closet they use for supplies and  this is terrible. They do not even try and be quiet. I have been woken up numerous times by them. Will not stay here again. Also the fridge is broken. Who wants a room with a broken fridge?
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

Recently separated from the military and, getting my place to work right here in Philly was a breeze, thanks to Michael Kaufman. His professionalism and dedication to finding my fiancee and me a little place to call our own were beyond expectation. Michael recommended the apartment we settled on, and it fit everything we asked for in our apartment. It's about to be a month and feels like we have always been here. Thank you again, Michael and the Philly apartment co you made this experience an excellent memory and if or when we decide to move we heading right back to you. 

Big fan,



Johnny Donato

Mostly great, my only complaint was the overnight staff member who checked me in was either very inexperienced or just not good at his job--e.g. he seemed confused when I walked in and said I wanted to check in, asked me if room number XYZ was okay (how would I know?), and ended up calling the room phone when we were in bed and almost asleep because he was having issues running our credit card (it turned out we'd already prepaid, so maybe that was why it wasn't working, but still, it was past 1 AM).

But the room itself was nice! Clean and comfortable, and there was a decent breakfast setup in the morning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I wouldn't even give them one star or a 1/2 star this place is awful!! I booked this through Expedia. I was in the hotel for 8.5 hours I got billed through Expedia ( expected) and 2 extra night through the hotel plus an extra $30.00. When I called they stated it was a computer glitch. So I where did the 30.00 extra dollars come from. They had no explanation. These people are very shiesty!! There is no doubt theses charges were intentionally done.!! The hotel was dirty smelled for restaurant food. Just say NO to this hotel!!! AWFUL  AWFUL
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Overall quite good
Inexplicably, my friend chicken was straight up bland, which I didn't think possible for friend chicken... Everything else was very tasty and the waiter promptly bright me some aoili and house ketchup when I mentioned about the chicken which did help, along w some salt. The rest of my party enjoyed their food. I'd go back. The cocktail I ordered was also very good, though I noticed that neither mine nor the one my mother ordered had the ice floating, which came off as cheap to me. Flavor was all there though.

What happened to the PRESSED cuban?  I used to live in the area and frequented Nick's on Alt 19 often as it was by my office.  I'm back visiting the area and learned that location is no longer there, but traveled another 20 minutes to get to a Nick's for their delicious cuban sandwich.  I've tried others all across the country and none were as good as Nick's. 

And now Nick's isn't even as good as Nick's was.  We ordered two large cuban sandwiches and they were basically open faced sub sandwiches.  I had raved and raved to my boyfriend about how great these were, what a letdown.  

I would not recommend them for an authemtic cuban sandwich.

Very disappointed. ...One employee, place was dirty, very very small selection of everything! I had a bacon egg and cheese bagel. The bagel was rock hard and non of the other stuff was close to being fresh. I should hace known I was in trouble when I heard the microwave ding. I also purchased a pumpkin and blueberry muffin, that were eaten later. Both were tasty and seemed fresh. My husband purchased a couple of donuts. What I heard him say to the lady and what he got were totally different. They must have tasted fine, he ate them.

Had a good last minute stay at this hotel, the hotel staff was very helpful and accommodating. We used the shuttle to and from the airport, as well as a few side trips, while we stayed which was very convenient. The hotel itself is pretty clean, our room seemed reasonably priced for everything it offered though I would like to have seen it a little more thoroughly cleaned and the pool was not clean. I would overall recommend this for a stay if you are waiting out a delay at the airport and just need something nearby.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Sonny does not respect his customers time!  I had a 5:15 appointment.  Arrived at 5:10.  He was just finishing up with a customer.  He put her at the drying table and as I stood to sit at his station, he told me to sit back down and that he would be back in 10 minutes, as he had to pick up his daughter.  I wasn't happy because this happens more times than not, but I decided to wait.  Waited 15 min. and he wasn't back , so I left.  Not good business practice and the sad part is......they don't care!  I'll never go back!n

DON'T STAY HERE!!! RUN AS FAST AS YOU CAN!!!
If you stayed here check your credit report. The staff makes copies of your CREDIT CARD and license which could be used to commit fraud and steal your identity. 
This is the nastiest, fealty disgusting hotel I have ever seen. The staff is unprofessional, rude and unhelpful. The hotel room was roach infested, smelled moldy, with dirty linens. They wouldn't give enough towels. The hotel is sinking and the drawers stay open causing a tripping hazard. I was unable to change hotels because of the hurricane. This hotel needs to be condemned.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I see that there are a bunch of bad reviews on here but I had no issues with my visit. I had a prescription already so I was just picking out some frames. The process was fast and they cleaned all of the frames that I touched. I appreciated this because of the whole covid thing. My only issue was that I didn't get a phone call when my glasses were ready I had to call and ask them if they were done yet. (I was told it would take 1-2 weeks and it had been about a week and a half) But when I called they let me know that they were ready and I could come pick them up so I had no issues there.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I work downtown so I've eaten here quite a few times.  They must have a new "chef." The mahi mahi wrap used to be excellent - grilled or blackened.  Today I got it and the fish was obviously microwaved, the wrap was stale and falling apart, and the sandwich was incredibly bland - couldn't even eat if after a few bites.  My friend got the buffalo chicken salad and could only a little bit.  Apparently the sauce was so thick and spicy it was difficult to eat.  Not sure I'll go back.  The waitress did give me a 15% discount because I said I was very disappointed.

I called to make apt for crome colors was told that had many not true, the lady did the right color but not Crome and the daughter gave me one price when I got there but st the end mom charge me $10 more so I told her that they told me other price she got furious and slammed her hand in the counter spoke her language to her daughter and she said that her daughter does not know only her b/c she's the one that does it they discounted $5 at the end but she made me feel so uncomfortable. I was surprise because I have been there before and had an OK servise

Our family have been loyal patients of Damonte Ranch Animal Hospital for sometime. Recently, while on vacation, our pet had a veterinary emergency while being boarded at another facility. Dr. Baker and the wonderful staff at DRAH worked closely with the boarding facility to get the care our baby girl needed. They stayed in constant communication with us and reassured us of all that was taking place. Upon our return, I received a call from Dr. Baker personally checking in on Gigi's progress. You can rest assured that the caring staff and doctors at Damonte Ranch Animal Hospital always have the best interest of your pets in mind.

This hotel is about where it is more than what it is. I am sure they are doing the best they can considering the age of the hotel and that people come here to party. 

Bourbon St: is that smell puke with a hint of urine or urine with a hint of sewer gases? Reminds me of Potterville. 

The rooms are small and not very well maintained, but they are clean. We had a communal balcony that looked down on all the action. The room comes with ear plugs (really!) because the noise doesn't end. At 2:30am a gentleman was outside asking someone to have love with themselves at high volume (Inside voice please).

It was good to stay just one night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Careful when utilizing the drive thru.
After enduring a rude order taker, we made it to the window, and handed over my debit card, had gotten distracted with the girl shoving drinks and food thru the window at me, l got on the road and suddenly remember not getting my card back, turned around and went inside, told them l didn't get my card back...the counter girl said what color is it?...huh? Ok,red...she returned with the card, and just handed it to me, just didn't ask for a name or any other ID. It was mine, thankfully.

I had a great stay at the Double Tree. There is a valet service so you won't have to worry about parking on the busy streets. As soon as you walk in, the front desk has warm cookies ready to be given out. The best part of the hotel is it's location. It is right in he middle of all the action. Bourbon street is  only a couple of blocks down the road and there is food on every corner. The rooms were very quiet and comfortable will good, firm beds. As an added bonus, there is a heated outdoor pool on the fourth floor.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The place isn't as good as it seems to be. I got my nails done and during the process, they cut three of my fingers which ended up bleeding from the sides and cuticles. The nails aren't what I'd expect them to be. I got medium nails that they charged to be long. On top of that they didn't do the design as well as I'd hoped. One of the nails ended turning out sideways, but the rest of the nail's shapes aren't bad. At the end, they charged me $138 which is way too expensive for what I got. Inspo photo is at the end, which is what I wanted. Nail's were by lynn.

I've been going to the Bistro for years and have never had a problem. Today will be my last. It's complete chaos. People create their own lines while waiting for tables with no structure at all. I almost got into two fights over a table I was waiting for because the people currently sitting there decided to tell the woman who was actually '4th in line' that she could have the table. I will never jeopardize my family's safety for sub-par food again! If you have servers who expect tips then you are not a food court and need some type of structure as it relates to seating!

I recently got my jeans length altered at Vogue Cleaners, and I have to say that the quality is very poor :( The tailor didn't even bother herself to pick the matching thread color, but what's more, she was not able to make a straight line! Also, when I brought my jeans, she was very impolite and kept asking very disrespectful questions like what my nationality was, etc. Thanks for not asking about my religion and who I'm gonna vote for! I never used their dry cleaning service, so, maybe, those guys are good, but I will never come back to their tailor.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I've read some of the reviews and seriously, have you never cooked or eaten good food before?  The guacamole was average at best and the crab was not incorporated in a way that enhanced the dish.  The fish tacos contained tasteless fried fish and the accompanying cole slaw and avocado were ther in theory only.  My korean short rib taco contained tender short rib without flavor and kimchee that tasted like it was made by a Caucasian without taste buds.  yes - the meal sucked.  If it weren't for the awesome margueritas, the stars would be in the negative category. If I had brought a cold beer to Taco Bell, I would have been happier.

We have gone here regularly since they've opened, but recently they have been out of almost every kind of donut they have by 9 am. It always seems they have 7 trays of one kind and nothing else. 

I don't know if it's my general disappointment every time I walk through the doors but the quality seems worse as well. Nothing worse than a dry yeast donut. 

You're better off going to get a good cake donut at Taylor's Bakery down the street or waking up early to go to Tims bakery in McCordsville for yeast donuts.

Awful. Never get all our food. The employees and the managers are super rude as well. What place can you go to get all your food and then the staff is mad at the customer about it???? The amount of time it takes to get your food seems like it should help with he poor quality but alas no. I get it working at McDonald's is probably not ideal but I mean no need to be down right hostile. I don't know... maybe my standards are too high but I should at least get the food I paid for in a somewhat timely manner or let it at least be HALF right!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: we were looking forward to this place. went there for lunch on a saturday. service was good. chips and salsa were good. ladies room had no toilet paper and we told our server. went back in about 20 minutes later prior to leaving and there still was no toilet paper. had to tell the owner. our food was served promptly. tacos were so greasy that you could see the grease run off and they were cold and so was the enchilada, rice had no flavor. we were very disappointed and would not recommend this place to anyone.

If you are looking for a local gym that truly cares about making your time in the gym a great experience snap fitness on Racetrack Rd is it. The owners here are always improving- great equipment, variety of classes (including bootcamps) and great commrodary. My husband is a 300+ pound heavy lifter - this snap fitness has more than enough weights and powerlifting equipment to keep his interest as well as mine. So if you are beginner, a seasoned gym vet, or a little of both this is a great gym with everything you need.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I came her for a 10K mile service.  
Not only did they do a piss poor job (I had to go back 2 more times to "fix" their service attempt) they proceeded to charge me for items that should have been covered.  

Trying to call back to follow up or get any sort of assistance?  Good luck. 
Make the effort and drive Darrell Waltrip Volvo if you like good service and don't go here.  

They don't have loaners.  They don't offer shuttle service.
But if you like to be ignored and treated badly...this is the place for you.

Updated review: Its been about nine months living here. Although I still feel the same way about the apartment it has gotten somewhat better. I appreciate Jenilee for helping me with the problems I've come across and getting them fixed in a timely manner. She is very friendly and fast to respond with any problem I have. The maintenance staff are great, I usually have repairs done same day.  Also there's a full size gym with nice equipment and my son likes the two inside basketball courts. Things have been better but will update if anything changes.

We went on a Saturday night for the prix fixe menu during restaurant week. Fabulous meal with service that was attentive but not overbearing. BYOB made it even better. We made friends with the couple at the table adjacent to ours and we ended up swapping glasses of wine from our respective bottles. This added to the experience. Given the expected prices in a big city restaurant this place was a very warm welcome surprise given the $35 per person price. I would absolutely go here again even if it wasn't a fixed price

If I have so much as a fleeting thought about this place i'm already on my way there. I would say the price for a single one is a little high, sometimes getting up to $4.60, but it is completely worth it and the proof is that I keep going back. I've tried about 12 flavors with my favorites being the Guava cheesecake and the honey cinnamon cheesecake flavors. They also change the flavors pretty regularly so you can never run out.

The interior is also very trendy and good for hanging out so feel free to take your time and enjoy one. It is also in the center of Ybor so there are lots of things around too.

They claim to be a full-service, Cadillac establishment and charge up the wazoo for it. Instead, they took two months to clean my leather jacket and didn't even bother to call me when it finally came in. They decided not to clean a dress because they were afraid the colors would bleed. Well that's why I took it to the dry cleaner, because they're supposed to take care of stuff like that. I've had this dress dry cleaned multiple times without incident. No one bothered to inform me that the dress wasn't cleaned. I just happened to notice the notation on the bill. Never going back.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
Was there Today!  The owner/Manager was rude and ignorant!  I believe because he was short handed!  It appeared he had undocumented workers because he said to me directly the person working on my car does NOT speak nor understand English.   Then after paying $20-2...he said because I asked for "ALL" my rubber mats to be washed and my side boards to be dried  I was too much trouble!  So he gave me $20 and told me NOT to come back!

My thoughts are we all need to drop ignorance which would be how he respond to a service offered by his car wash service but not provided on TODY!

The management is utterly incompetent and chooses to ignore any requests they don't like. The parking situation is abysmal as the gate is broken half the time, and you're not even allowed to cancel your parking fee even if you are no longer using the parking garage. The furniture is cheap, the walls are not walls but actually made of paper so you hear EVERYTHING. Don't live here if you have a choice. Look at all the new apartment complexes popping up in the area- there are so many better options! For so much $$, you could live much better than here.

I was a customer for almost a year. The car wash " normally " does a good job. Several months back, I noticed the tire shine wasn't working. I asked the employee's on-site about the issue. They stated that they are working on getting it fixed. That was 3 months ago. After 3 months of no tire shine and reminding the on-site employee's. I've had enough, they don't seem to care about this, and don't seem to have any idea when it will get fixed. I don't feel like I should be paying for that service when it clearly is not being provided.

Saw a lot of good reviews, so my husband and I decided to try and to support the local restaurant. To our disappointment, the food did not meet our expectation and I doubt that we would come back.

We ordered several tacos. The shrimp tacos were very bland. The pork taco was the most tasty one. My husband thought the steak taco was just ok. It was nice that the restaurant offers variety of sauces for you to customize your food, but the three sauces we chose were kind of bland. 

Did not try other food, so my comments were solely based on tacos.

Ehh...not good. Yelp rarely let's me down but this one did. This is not a 4 star spot. Sushi seemed like the rice was a little too wet. There were carrots in the sushi. That's new. 

Had spider roll. Let down. Had deluxe tempura roll. Would've been ok if the sushi rice wasn't wet. 

Then our server got openly yelled at by the manager because she agreed to split our bill. Then she continued to tell me and my friend how the server has to learn this about business. 

Ah - ok lady. Cuz no restaurant ever splits bills. Ever.

I've gone to this place a few times already with my new car, and it seems like every time i go they neglect to do a complete job. This time i noticed by the time i got home that practically all of my front end bumper, lights, etc. was still full of bug residue that didnt look like anybody attempted to wash off. I pay $27 to get platinum service and seem to get half ass service. If i do go again i most definitely will be bringing it to there attention to see if they can get it right. Overall a fairly good place to go to, but not for a detailed job.

I have been looking forward to trying Fat Salmon based on all the good reviews here but I was disappointed. The menu was a red flag- almost every single speciality roll is served with crab stick. There was hardly any that offered fresh fish. 
We started with miso soup and the gyoza.
The miso was a little salty for me and wasn't anything special. The gyoza was fine but I found it strange it was served with beef instead of pork.
I got the Locust roll. It was not bad, but I just generally try to stay away from crab stick. 
Overall a mediocre experience. There's much better sushi out there.

I recently went in thinking I had some issues with possibly needing new struts on the front and back of my vehicle.  I brought my car in (without and appointment) and they immediately put it on the lift to diagnose the problem.  After a few minutes, I was told that I did need new struts in the rear, but that the front were fine.  I brought the car in 2 days later and they were done in about 2 hours.  This place is awesome.  They could have easily told me that I needed struts on both the front and the back and I wouldn't have known any different.  They were honest and saved me about $500.  I'll be brining my vehicle here from now on.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
I had a room on the first floor by an exit for a few nights. Pretty noisey being by the stairs. I can hear whenever someone upstairs flushes the toilet too. Not necessarily the staffs fault, but noticeable. I think my upstairs neighbor is showering right now.

The hotel has a bar, but I didn't stop by. Pretty empty each time I walked past. Only person there was the bartender on her phone.

Staff was friendly and helpful, although they called me 3 times in the first 24 hours, including to check in on how my stay was within an hour of arrival.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place was good at first but the bartenders are incredibly RUDE. A drink that I normally order at other places did not taste right and instead of them topping it off with sprite or something they mocked me and made it seem likeI was lying. One of the bartenders, with a lot of tattoos, I didn't catch her name, made my drink and didn't stir. She poured alcohol at the bottom and sprite on top. I tried asking her fora straw or something to mix it and she wasn't paying attention. I then had to grab a plastic cup from their stack to mix my drink. The service is horrible! I will never go back there. Music was ok but not worth wasting time at.

This place is a local hotspot. The pizza is thin crust and awesome. I always have the margherita pizza so i really don't know the others. They have great bread which they buy from a local Santa Barbara Bakery... try the calamari and the bruschetta

If you want good italian food that is light on the pocket in a great location like montecito... this is the place to go.

One comment about the servers. I have had a 70 percent success rate with the servers. Honestly I feel that the lunch staff has been less welcoming than the dinner staff.

Pizza story? More like pizza nightmare. I have NEVER left a review anywhere bashing a food place but this one was just so bad that I had to. The pizza's are small and overpriced and DO NOT taste special. I don't mind paying more for a pizza but it better be a delicious master piece. This was far from it. The calamari was good, besides the fact that we only received 4 little pieces.  I was so excited to try this place, however, now I wish I never came across it because the food is absolutely horrible. Want a pizza? Do yourself a favor and order anywhere but this place.

Finally, a barber who gives you their opinion and knows what their doing. I used to get my hair cut at some cheap Asian place for years and never was satisfied. I finally got tired of it and decided to look around. I came across this place on yelp and decided to give it a try. It was worth it. The wife said it was probably the best hair cut I've ever head. Definitely will be going on the regular.

Went back the second time and got a half ass cut. I can't believe the drastic difference. Not going back again. The worst fade ever.

Aug 5, 2018 Long Weekend Interior Detail Deluxe.
$262.45 later. 
Beware!! The sales person pushes the most expensive cleaning. Using lies like this is our special price today. Not telling you what is available. There was an $80 wash & interior clean that would have been better than this; but didn't know until after. If I wasn't disabled I could have done a better job on my own. Beware they don't tell you all the Car wash information.  For this price I was very unhappy with the quality of service. Live and Learn, never again.

I'm a big Liminchello fan based on many visits to the WC location, I couldn't get a reservation in town so thought I'd try this location. 
Just a few thoughts for the ownership as they need to focus on this location to bring it up to the standards set at the WC local. From the drink prep, to proper table service (the server clearly wasn't trained)  to cleanliness (wine cellar out front which is pretty nice looking was filled with empty boxes?) all needs addressed including cooking Limonchello's signature dishes properly.

Don't believe the reviews, don't believe the 4+ stars, anyone who says these tacos are great doesn't know wtf they're talking about: go back to Taco Bell and give them 5 stars. This place is a HELLA whatevs taco shop. I will acknowledge that they have a wide variety of meats, it's just that they don't taste like much. You're paying like $2 each (basically top dollar) to have bland tacos and you don't let to-go orders fill up on the salsas in the taco bar? And the salsas arent good anyways? You can't even do carne asada right? How is this place thriving near a college? Step your taco game up, bruh.

Absolutely the worst!  1 Star only because negative stars aren't available.  Confirmed reservation for over two days with dire warnings about penalties if not cancelled within 48 hours.  ONE HOUR before we are due to pick up the car, we get a call that the car won't be available for at least 2 1/2 hours AFTER the scheduled pickup time.  No excuses, no offer of anything other than an obvious attitude of "Oh, well...it is what it is, and screw you and your plans". Complete and gross incompetence and lack of customer service that I, at least, won't have to endure ever again.  Pay a bit more somewhere else, but go anywhere but here.

If there were a zero, I would give it to this place. I was supposed to fly into Philadelphia Int'l and then drive to Baltimore. I get there with my confirmation number and hand them my license and debit card. I am told I can't use a debit card. So I am 2 hours from home and have no way to get there. So a company that is supposed to get people where they need to go, leaves a customer with a confirmed reservation stranded without anyway to get to the destination. The only point of their business, they couldn't accomplish. I will never use Enterprise again, which is the only rental car company I have ever used.

What a disappointment. I live in CA and was driving through when I decided to stop for a dozen donuts. Ordered assorted and they gave me a box with a dozen donuts. On opening the box, found only 2 kinds of six each. Assorted?? Extremely overrated, so bad that my 12 year old who loves donuts took just one bite and threw the rest away. We were actually excited at trying DD for the first time and don't understand why they were so bad. We used to live in Reno and loved Krispy Kreme when they were there. From reading other reviews I understand that they serve good coffee . However for coffee I will stick with specialty coffee stores. Major letdown

The only reason they got a star was for the interior design. It has a nice little pond with a bridge over it, but the good words end there. Let's start off with the waitresses, I don't even know why they were there. She didn't know what a single thing on the menu was when I asked and the funnier thing was when she went to ask another waitress, she didn't know either and then they went to ask a third one and finally figured it out. The food was mediocre at best and our drinks were never refilled. Left there really disappointed. End rant.

I booked a living truck through budget 1 month ago. I received confirmation email at that time. I also received an email confirming 2 days ago. This morning I showed up to get my truck and they did not have one available. They said they could search the closest location but it would take up  to 2 hours to find a truck. They said sorry for this inconvenience but this was much more than an inconvenience as we had a bunch of people showing up to move our entire house today. I now have a bunch of people sitting at my house waiting for me. Luckily uhaul was able to get us a truck immediately. I will not be using budget for any rentals in the future

If you're thinking this won't be so bad, you're wrong. The only thing we didn't see from the previous reviews was the rat. Not to say it wasn't there, behind the dingy mini fridge. Never had the breakfast- too scared to try. We were wondering if the roof was leaking. Turns out it was the shower head spraying everywhere. 
We resorted to a smoking room, it was their last available- burn holes everywhere. Checked for bedbugs and were surprised to fine none.
Housekeeping was helpful. Then we saw one in the laundry room wiping his sweaty face with a bath towel. Our car was never broken into or stolen so it went better than we thought it would.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Awful hotel!  Staff was unfriendly and the hotel does not fix anything!  Whoever manages this place needs to be fired!  This hotel could be great if it had an even mediocre manager.  The location is cool and the building and parking are all good in the sense that they could be awesome.  But since they dont want to fix anything or be nice to customer that is what you get.  The staff would probably be more friendly if they did not have to constantly apologize for owners/managers who dont want to take care of their business.  Avoid!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The place was a mess and sticky. It looked as tho it had not been swept or even wiped down in days. There weren't even napkins!! We even went in the morning and they were all out of stuff. Not only that but it took 15 minutes to get any of our items because they were too worried about taking the drive thru orders. There were about 5 people working there and only one person was cooking, one was helping the only other customer, the manager was counting money. This is probably one of the worst Dunkin' Donuts I have ever been to.

Hotel was nice and pretty clean. I was extremely disappointed when I checked in and they wanted to charge over double the price each night. I had made a reservation 3 months in advance and even received an email a day before I arrived with the correct hotel price. They told me since it was a holiday weekend management decided to required additional proof to get the rate I was quoted that weekend only without notifying me to bring any additional paperwork.  After driving 4 hours I had no other choice but to stay and pay the higher price since everything else was booked since it was a holiday weekend.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Food is adequate.  delivery however is horrible.  I am always told "1 hr" and it is always longer.  My last order I was told again "1 hr" - after 1 hour, I call ed and was told my food was sitting there waiting for delivery guy and he should be back in 10 mins.  My order finally arrived 1 hour and 40 minutes after I placed it.  If they can not handle the delivery business they should not advertise and offer it.

Also very difficult to understand employees on telephone.  And they make no apologies or refunds for delivery problems

Amazing customer service. Went in to get coffee this morning and I was running late (underestimated the rain/traffic). Long story short, I had to ask for a refund bc they were also running a little behind. The guy offered to fix my coffee for free before I left but at that moment I was already late lol. So I came back for lunch and the guy remembered me ! He again was very apologetic about the experience I had that morning and profusely thanked me for coming back. He was super nice and I appreciated his awesome customer service skills. He didn't have to do what he did!

I travel a lot so as a PF member I get to see a lot of various gyms. This one is pretty good. It was clean, well kept and equipment was working. People working out in here were friendly.
One thing I have noticed is that when there are individual tv s on equipment, the ones closest to yours changes channels when anyone changes the channel. I prefer it when tv s are up high and set on fixed channels and we tune in with your headphones. Makes life easier! 
Other than that, it is a beautiful facility. 
Younger staff at front didn't meet and greet like I'm used to but hey- didn't affect my workout so I am good! Still recommend this one too!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Drove by Tucson on our way home from taking my aunt to Nogales. I was craving a good green chile burrito so we got off the highway and found this on Yelp.
Big disappointment. Pork Green Chile was very loose and so were the beans so the burritos got soggy fast and squished out of the tortilla, it made a mess. We ate in our car to get back on the road quickly. But even more disappointing was there was not much green chile flavor at all. The cashier was nice and helpful. Maybe they have other things that are good but I would not recommend the green chile.

Terrible experience went there to get some Venezuelian food was waiting for food and was asked if we were customers the owner was drinking a lot so go there if you want to feel like a piece of shit because the owner has no people skills also stay off your phone she had a band playing and claims the phone was distracting them maybe if there were more them five guests there she could not hear the phone the bathroom hand dryer was louder then anything but she is the owner and owns the many drinks she was drinking because she will make it a point to let you know that instead of treating customers like crap get some people in your !!!!!! Place

First visit (lunch) excellent. Service was great-very attentive and helpful. The pizza crust is thin and tasty-not bland at all. The sauce is very fresh and not too heavy with respect to the cheese ratio. The Long hots are HOT! They don't have a basic salad on the lunch menu (though they have several that sound delicious), but when I described what I was looking for they simply made it for me. The grilled chicken is delightfully juicy and flavorful. Beer was cold and we are looking forward to coming again to sample the dinner menu!

Very underwhelming.  The chicken paillard was a chewy, overly seasoned but somehow still bland piece of chicken with soggy arugula. I'm assuming it was soggy because they packaged it with a drippy side of pasta so the arugula salad (it wasn't even enough to be called more than a garnish) had a "dressing" of rosa sauce.  Also came with three sad little spears of asparagus.  The entire meal was totally overpriced for what it was. An average-sized piece of tiramisu and small piece of limoncello cake were $10 each. I don't mind paying more for excellent food but this was a complete ripoff and not even good, unfortunately.

Their beds are the best! and the rooms are clean & have a pleasant atmosphere so you can get perfect rest!! This is So conveniently located and yet when you're there you don't feel like you're in the middle of things. The pool is clean and perfect temperature not too cold or too warm. Front desk gets At for hospitality! For pool, they take every precaution -only one person or family at a time,  and then they disinfect in between (you sign up on a schedule.) Loved my stay there and it was very affordable, as well.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place a little different than the rest of NOLA and it was refreshing.  Great design, super clean and minimal....  a great contrast to the local vernacular.  Maybe my opinions are tainted having been in LA for the last 10 years, but this coffee shop felt like home.  It's NOLA's version of Intelligencia (for the Chicago folks) or URTH (for the LA folks). Fresh, flavorful, hot coffee.  A nice break after experiencing mainly diner-quality coffee.  (Sorry Croissant D'Or)

Service is friendly and non-pretentious.... an all-around 5 stars!

I would recommend against using hertz. If you purchase the pre-pay fuel option, they do not offer pro-rated service. I returned my car w/ half a tank of gas and was charged for a full tank. It's not a lot of money but it is another example of extractionist policies by companies looking to hose the consumer for a few more dollars.

Oddly, I was offered a voucher for the amount I was taken for. I refused this, because I will never use hertz again.

Fortunately, companies like uber are eating into the rental car and taxi market. In the future, I feel confident that this review will remain up on a hertz location that is closed.

I've never had a bad experience here. The food is always cooked right, ingredients are fresh, the service is friendly. The prices could be a bit lower, but hey it's in a casino hotel. And no it's not Vegas so no special gambler's specials here so too bad. 

When we come to eat but don't feel like eating a sub or pizza downstairs with a bunch of kids, or don't feel like forking out $20 without a Kobayahi appetite............................. Cafe Sierra fits the bill. 

I recommend the salmon (surprisingly good!), chicken sandwich, strawberry waffle, and all of their breakfast entrees.

Zero stars -  horrible service! Had a 10am appt with my 2  sisters. Had to wait 20 minutes, even with an appt.  Then we are shown to our pedicure chairs. Two of my sisters are attended to as I soak. By 10:40 I am still soaking. By now I am frustrated -  we have plans for the day and they'll be done before I even get started. Got out of my chair and sat in the waiting area for them the get finished. I will NEVER return to this establishment. Service here has been steadily declining,  but thought we'd give them another try. Final assessment -  disappointed .

As an SPG gal, I get totally spoiled by Westin in STL but last time around, friends & I stopped for couple nights at Marriott and loved it. Lobby is so lovely, and they have multiple events through the week to keep the area very lively as well. I was also granted an access to the breakfast area due to my membership, and was pleasantly surprised to find decently stocked breakfast area & great staff who creameries is with the biggest smiles and were always so helpful & prompt. I took off one star due to the food, the Lobby restaurant has a great staff but dishes taste pretty mediocre. Overall, great experience
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It's a cute boutique hotel situated in the trendy district of Stratcona so it's close to restaurants and trendy boutiques.  The exterior is unassuming so I almost drove past the hotel.  The entrance is decent looking but the rooms are awesome.  It's very spacious, modern and clean.  Unfortunately parking is a hassle becacuse when you need your car it takes the valet a bit longer to retrieve the car depending if other patrons need it too because the parking lot is a bit further away.

If I ever visit Edmonton, I'll definitely stay at this hotel again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This is a pretty awesome place! I was really surprised to see a non-chain Italian restaurant in New Orleans! 

The food is amazing, I got the Veal Roberto and it was delicious! My husband ordered the stuffed pork chop and it was larger than we thought! Portions are good size the prize. Good appetizers and lots of bread and butter. Very attentive servers! 

Only thing that caught me off guard was upon entering the restaurant, you walk smack dab in people dining, there isn't a true waiting room but I can live with that, the food was just awesome! 

Also this is pretty close to Tulane University so it's a cute area to stroll around.

I recently signed up for the Lufthansa Miles and More credit card via a promotion of 50,0000 miles, 20,000 upon approval and 30,000 miles more upon spending $5000 in 3 months which I did. Guess what the additional 30,000 miles were never credited to my account. I have called Barclays many times about this and am always told the same thing which it was an error and the 30,000 miles will be credited right away. Guess what they never are!

They lied and now refuse to follow through with their end of the deal. I would not trust this bank..

Front desk staff were not nice at all.
Breakfast mediocre.
Rooms were spacious and beds quite confortable.
Pillow? Horrible.
Out A/C was making some funny noises and being a light sleeper it was not the  best night.
The bath tub faucet was missing a piece, I could see the hose that the water was coming from.
Hallway was quite dirty.
Huh anything else?  I got a good deal and also its very close to less crowded beaches and walking trails.
 Easy direction from the freeway.  Grocery store and restaurants  in walking distance.
Overrall, nice and quiet location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The artistry put into the care and creation of the ice cream here can't be measured in normal increments, once you go Screamery, you won't want to go back. 

Once in the door, Danielle behind the counter greets anyone with a smile, insane product knowledge, and the best service you could ask for. 

It's the essence of a home-grown ice cream shop, combined with forward thinking local ingredients and a flair for fun taste combinations. Treat yourself to a 1-of-a-kind Tucson original experience that has made this town a gastronomic marvel. Joe Biden, THIS is your Trump escape. You'll feel safe here.

4stars all for the bartender. We didn't eat here so and from the reviews I'm glad we didn't. We came here Sunday to watch the football games, great sports bar, TONS of tv's. The place is dated but the tv's we're nice. The women's  bathroom was gross and it was still early, wouldn't want to see them at night! Our bartender was attentive and came to check on us often. She was great about changing the tv's to the games we wanted. She was also pretty fast with the drinks considering how busy they were. Would come back again, just to watch the games.

This place looks like a dive, but it's awesome.  If you don't like waiting, go for a late lunch or early dinner.  I got this crazy, amazing dish of phyllo dough stuffed with shrimp in a crabmeat cream sauce.  It was seriously amazing.  Unparalleled!  The crab and corn bisque in a bread bowl is also really good.  You will leave stuffed, but still wanting more.

I tried the italian sausage, and it was all right, but it didn't blow me away.  Sometimes the service is less than stellar, but the food is really out of this world.

Good hotel. The room was impressively BIG & the bed comfy. the hotel is 2 levels & sprawling -not great if you're a slow walker or have kids, although it is pretty wheelchair friendly. Thin walls & doors. Now the big downside - we were in town for a large sporting event; there were a couple hundred of us staying there. The event ended on a Sunday night & by the time we got back to the hotel the restaurant was closed. Granted this was a Sunday night but they stood to make a few thousand dollars off of us. Simply bad planning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Can't complain about service or product, it's always great here... What I do want vent about is the fact that it was closed for a week for renovations but it still looks like the same careworn cafe it always has, still beat up chairs, still same paint, still same set up.... What is different is that they currently have no wifi, which means cash only... No debit, no credit, no app pay, nothing... Who carries cash? Apparently only the three people in there. It's usually packed and there's no one there today. Not terribly impressed

It's obvious that this used to be a pretty good hotel. The location is good and the lobby is nicely appointed. The staff were friendly and helpful. The rooms were ok but the air conditioning rattled badly and the entire floor (10th) smelled faintly of mildew and mold. There were also odd holes in the walls that were covered by huge sheets of painted plywood. Very strange for a "nice" hotel. The pool area was abysmal. Huge pool area but the poor itself was no bigger than your standard backyard pool. Not nearly enough chairs or chaise lounges around the pool either. Seems like for the price you are paying for a nice lobby and the location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
In my opinion, the perfect chirashi would contain the following ingredients:
*multiple slices of sake, hamachi, saba, hotate, maguro, unagi, amaebi, tamago, white tuna
*ikura (salmon roe)
*slices of sweeten braised shiitake mushroom
*pickled radish or daikon
*seaweed salad (optional)

This restaurant's chirashi had the following pros and cons, relative to my notion of the perfect chirashi:

Pros: Terrific variety. Surprisingly fresh.  Has most of the desired elements.

Cons: Missing unagi, hotate, marinated shiitakes, seaweed salad

Came here with a large group. The beer list was huge and the menu had a lot of tasty choices. It was a bit pricey, but the ambiance and setting kind of dictate that. I ordered the Mediterranean Seafood stew with cous cous which was incredible.  Everyone else at my table loved their dish. 

However, the big downer for us was that our server was running on his own SLOW as hell time schedule. It was as if he had no concept of time whatsoever. We didn't even order our meals until an hour after we sat down.  I ordered a second beer by the time our meal came and I didn't receive it until we were all done eating.

I lived here for a year I did love the pool,gym and the location. However the staff and building itself was lacking. I had to let my dog go because they decided to not allow pets in the middle of my lease. The hallway leaked when it was raining out., guards would discuss your personal info with visitors, staff was always rude, and lets face it just parking alone made you dizzy hahaha. Let's not forget the interesting bath house next door which had some scary attendees very close to "Home". There are better locations in the city ....spend your money wisely my fellow socialites ;)

This restaurant charged our credit card twice.  The first was the actual charge for our food, but the second charge was for a different amount and was made on a day we did not order anything from them. When we called to resolve the issue, we were told that since they had the receipt of the 2nd order (the one we did not place), they stated that they would not refund our money.  After explaining that we could prove that we couldn't have mad the purchase, as we were at an appointment, they still refused to issue a refund.  I would warn anyone against using their credit card at this restaurant.

I would suggest that no one with young children consider entering.. I've lived in Philly my whole life and have never experienced such a nasty reaction to seeing children . The manager( possibly
Owner ?) and bar tender were just fine , but the one waitress working the extremely empty restaurant intentionally  walked by us multiple times and yelled to get out of her way . When we finally got a table ( not sure why there was a wait ) and asked for bread for our kids she freaked out , and yelled she'll " get to us when she gets to us". Our party of 8 all stood up and left immediately.. it was that bad .

Outside seating and waiter ~ perfect! Cold eggs, potatoes and wrong toast, not so much:(  Will never do breakfast again.  I just don't like my eggs cold. Came here instead of Nudy's just for outdoor seating with dog in tow.  Two stars, because the weather perfect to be outside and our waiter was excellent! If I would have sent the plate back with what looked like a manager that brought it...then my Morher would have waited and her (OK) French toast would have gotten cold:(  They should have offered to take off bill, but didn't bother.

Got a dress altered here and that turned out great. It was a bit pricey at 45$ just to be take in a little, but the finished product was fantastic. 

My dry cleaning experience however, was not nearly as great. I was promised that my dry cleaning would be done by early afternoon. I get there only to realize that I had to return at 4:00. I returned and had to wait another 20 minutes before my dry cleaning arrived. Beware, if you need a quick turn-around that they do not do dry cleaning themselves, but rather send it out to be done. They also get finicky if you say you want to pay with credit card and your payment is not a large amount.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I have been to the happy hour at Bistro 7 many times and have really enjoyed the appetizers and drinks.  I had family from out of town come in and decided to have dinner there for the first time.  I was disappointed with the food, my sister had a fresh pasta dish that tasted like paste, way overcooked.  The steak I had was just okay, not to the standards that I had come to expect from Bistro 7!  We did ask for a replacement side of pasta and they were happy to do that, with a different kind of pasta.  My sister did enjoy the replacement and I will give them another chance!  The service was great, I just wish the food had been better.

Disorganized...the WORST. They dropped the ball on my dog's prescription meds not once but twice. I've been a Banfield Plan member since 2012 and this location is such a disappointment. You know who suffers the most from their overall lack of attention to follow through and screwing up needed meds? My dog. I would give this place negative stars if I could. I am here taking care of family matters after my father passed and I can't tell you how much I miss my San Diego Banfield on Market Street who treat my dog and I like family!!!!

I ended up with food poisoning from undercooked duck last Sunday evening. I will say the curry was great but even my dessert was disappointing. For paying a total of 60 something dollars + tip and spending the last few days completely sick and actually taking myself to the hospital which confirmed the poisoning I was very disappointed, won't recommend and will not return. 
FYI to be fair my friend I ate with had their steak dish and was fine, so I clearly picked the wrong dish which unfortunately also added +$15 dollars to my pre-fixe meal. Regardless, this shouldn't have happened.

Absolutly the worst customer /management service ever ! Wen I let the front deak know that a mouse had eaten though my dorito bag and eaten my chips and made a spund in the bag while me and my aon were in the room the front deak refused to come and see the bag. They then disposed of the bag in the morning insted of contacting me in my room the next morning. Management emailed me only /contaced me only after I complained to the wyndham rewards people only apologizing and not offering any assistance in making it right! And wyndham rewards only gave me a half of a night off my next stay. I am leaving wyndham rewards and all of their hotels!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This was a horrible experience. Myself (a man) and my friends (a woman) had a horrible time.

The women slathered nail polish on my nails as if they just wanted to get me out of the store quickly. I wanted a design on each of my ring finger nails, but they stamped a design and told me that was good enough.

They caused my friend to bleed.

They dont sanitize and reuse tools.

They charged us $200~ish for the two of us and still wanted us to tip each attendant.
Even after explaining the bad service they still wanted us to tip.

Will never return. Please go somewhere else.

Maybe I am spoiled in NYC.  The sushi was super bland.  I got the spicy tuna and cucumber and it tasted like nothing - so I used the wasabi in the soy sauce, I swear it was the most bland wasabi I have ever had in my life.  I used all the wasabi and had to get more. very very mehhhhhhh.  so then decided to get dessert - another disappointment.  We got the tempura green tea ice cream - the green tea ice cream was fine but the tempura was super soggy and oily. I have had it a few times before in the city and when done right - its amazing.  If this is the best philly has to offer for sushi - I will not be having sushi in philly again =/

Celebrated my Mother's birthday at brunch last Sunday and had an all around excellent experience.  The food is all so fresh and cooked by the very nice owner- Anne (?). Everyone enjoyed their meal. Service was perfectly executed by our waiter Misha.  He also has a delightful personality and is ridiculously easy on the eyes. 

If this restaurant was in SF, I'd likely become a regular.
