*The only con was there are no alcoholic drinks on the menu- but that's not their fault- Moorestown is a 'dry' county. Crazy, huh?

Don't order SASHIMI from this restaurant. I ordered sashimi assortment, which comes with 6 kinds of sashimi. It taste so bad, not fresh at all, the texture feels funny, I couldn't even finish the it... We also ordered deep fried chicken, taste ok. Sushi roll combo which including California roll, salmon skin roll & spicy tuna roll, taste meh. And beef curry udon taste fine. 

I guess that best ones from our order is Eel roll, miso soup and cucumber salad(comes with combo)

Well...at least I didn't have food poison, but won't go back again either.

The $3 martinis are great. The risotto is delicious. The Bruschetta is amazing. Then we witnessed the manager yell at the hostess about a foot away from our table. The hostess was apparently not at the hostess stand and instead of taking her to the back, away from customers, to talk to her he decided to reprimand her right in front of us. It was extremely disturbing to see someone talk to another human the way he did. Then there was a busser  hysterically laughing right behind us... very weird. When I spoke to the manager he listened and then just walked to the back. Won't be returning here.

The food is very tasty, but they are often very confused about pick up. I would never eat inside, even though lots of folks are (tables are definitely not six feet apart and people are crammed inside like usual). Most of the staff wear masks, so I don't mind running in to pick up food. I am happy to support a family-owned business, but I wish they took the pandemic a bit more seriously and figured how to make the pickup situation better. I continue to order from here, but I have certainly slowed down since the pandemic started.

We stopped by here after a visit to the zoo after asking a passerby for a recommendation (March 2010). This was our first time having St. Louis style pizza. It was definitely different than any other pizza I've had. It's made with a thin crust, Provel cheese and cut into squares. I'm glad we tried it, but I don't think I need to have it again. Maybe it's an acquired taste or maybe it's because I love deep dish pizza. The restaurant was casual, your typical pizza-joint, so I felt at home. If I do come back, I want to try the toasted ravioli.

Came here after a long drive from MA. Came without a reservation and was seated quickly. Kiersten our waitress was really nice and attentive. 
House guacamole was amazing. Wanted to get the one with the figs but my daughter nixed it.  
Our margaritas were good. Not great but good enough.
My grilled fish tacos were great. Came with an Avocado creme and a chipotle (I think). Loved them both. Wished the meal was served with rice and beans or a side. However it was delicious. Our other dish was chicken enchiladas and they were great. 

Would definitely come back.

This is the place to go to get yourself stronger. This is not the meathead gym you are worried about. This is a hard-as-hell, get you motivated, community that is dedicated to get you stronger. Brian (the owner) runs a great shop with workouts planned to push you but not kill you. 

I went to this gym to learn proper technique for deadlift, squats, and everything else and it was great. All the instructors helped show proper form and continuously improve mine. Highly recommended for anyone looking to get in better shape.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Worried about covid? Don't go here. 

I've been going to doctor appointments in Davidson County because of the mask mandate, I want to go places that I can trust wear masks. Upon entering the office, three people behind the front desk were not wearing masks. One put hers on when I walked in. I asked if they usually didn't wear masks and they said "when patients are around," as one more put on her mask. However the third continued to wear hers around her chin. When she turned towards the others and yawned, maskless, I had had enough and told them I was leaving because I didn't trust their mask usage.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
I really liked this hotel. The employees were nice, some more than others. The room I had had these 2 big doors that opened onto the pool area. I would have switched rooms if it was the summer and people were out there but it was chilly in November so no one was out there thankfully. 
The room was very nicely decorated, clean, and everything worked properly.
I ordered a po'boy and house fries from Powdered Sugar. They were both delicious. The food tasted fresh, damn near perfectly seasoned, and the people working in the restaurant were very nice. I would definitely stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This hotel was such a pleasant surprise with excellent hospitality and very clean.  Their staff was friendly and attentive.  The rooms were spacious, clean and comfortable.  The free breakfast is delicious.  I couldn't believe the variety offered.  I was very impressed with everything and even their little store was reasonably priced.  This hotel made our trip to New Orleans and absolute pleasure.  It's conveniently located and prices were fair.  I would highly recommend it to anyone looking to vacay in the Big Easy!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I was very dissatisfied with this hotel, I slipped and fell in shower to start, the tub is super slippery so BE CAUTIOUS. The maids only seemed to make beds and replace towels. The breakfast features items over cooked (tater tots), or just flat out old tasting. The hotel elevator is beyond skeptical! It got stuck and that was a total panic for a whole minute, literally, it made the weirdest chain sounding noises when arriving to 1st floor. The room keys continued to become deactivated. The actual cleanliness of the bathroom grout on shower walls was pretty nasty!!! Black funky stuff in tile grout. The only thing positive was really location.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My husband and I have eaten here at least 25 times in the last 2 years...The fish is fresh and we prefer sashimi and nigiri sushi rather than rolls. They always let us know what the best choice is of daily arrivals. We sit at the bar and have always had great service. They will customize to taste. They have a little trouble getting fried appetizers out if busy. Also if you are into design, they excel. Atmosphere is casual. We really love this place. My only higher choice in Nashville is Samari in Elliston Square next to the Gold Rush and MR. CHOO...THE BEST!!

In a drive from Houston to Indy, we stayed in three hotels and this was the nicest by a mile.

The hotel was spotless and the staff was really nice. Two different rooms were comfortable, spacious and sparkling clean.

Two big bonuses, free on-site laundry and the free breakfast buffet make this place a great choice. They have four washers and four dryers for hotel guest use, just bring your own detergent (or buy one-shot packs in the hotel shop for $1).

The breakfast buffet was quite delicious, with make-your-own waffles, biscuits & gravy, eggs, sausage, yogurt, fruit, cereal, etc.

And they let you bring pets for a small fee.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Had Tara as my server. We sat waiting patiently for almost 10 minutes and when she FINALLY came she seemed like she didnt want to be there. She did NOT make eye contact, did NOT introduce herself, and gave the impression she did not care about us or her job. When i asked to speak to manager she ended up going over to manager (Cordillia) and i could see BOTH of them laughing at the situation. We got up and left. This place is unprofessional and they need to get some new management at this place because ive never felt more disrespected in my life

Ive been going to Luxury Nail Salon since it opened.  I love the staff there.   They always know your name, get to know what you like and are great at even offering you suggestions on trying new things. I LOVE the new powder nails...they feel so natural.  They offer drinks while waiting, speak to you in English, are odor free which is so nice and have awesome massage chairs for your pedicures.

I would highly recommend Luxury Nails for anyone who is looking for a nail salon that they can rely on and feel at home!  

Tami

When I come down to the area for work, I always look forward to stopping by the tavern. There always seems to be something interesting as a 'special', and the beer selection is fantastic. Out of the three or four times I've been there, I've always been happy with my food (except the cole slaw, it's a-typical and tastes weird... nutty? Just not my style). If I had anything to pick on, it's that the bar tenders generally don't tell you what the specials are unless you ask. I would recommend the burgers and steaks!

All of the staff was very friendly.  Special kudos for a good job to Larry our shuttle driver.   Hotel was clean and comfy.  Gym was nice equipment all working and well taken care of.   Food in restaurants was great we loved the recommended blue berry muffins our server suggested on the breakfast buffet.   Only downside was the wait to be served dinner on Friday night 2/3/27.  We were a party of 7 and there was a long wait for our entrees.    Not a big enough issue that we wouldn't come back and stay again.    Thank you staff of double tree for a great weekend!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have gone to Rose's for my eyebrow service and she is one of the few that offer good eyebrow waxing. However,  everytime I visit this shop she will insist that I wait for over 30mins for a 5min service. Today was the final straw. She had placed a customer in the pedi chair who was awaiting a few other friends to arrive.  I was waiting for her to come and say that while the other customer is waiting for her friends to come and while her feet soak she could complete my 5min brow service..NOPE she said I would have to wait an hour. I will no longer go to this shop due to the lack of customer service which is EXTREMELY poor.

It's an airport rental car place, so pretty much what you'd expect. The shuttle doesn't run as frequent as other rental car services, as we waited and waited while multiple Enterprise, National, Dollar, etc. buses passed before the Hertz bus came. So, if you're in a rush, just keep this in mind. Getting the car was easy, but getting out was a mess. There was a huge line of about 20 cars and only one check-out stall open. Our car was clean but the person who used it before us must have smoked several packs of cigarettes in it. Have had better experiences, but hey, it got me where I needed to get to on the same day.

Worst car rental experience I've ever had. One person at the register dealing with over 50 people. This place is understaffed to deal with the literal bus loads of customers being dropped off. After over an hour of waiting in line, we got our keys and waited another 20 mins for the car we reserved for 2:30pm (and prepaid for) to be ready. Arrived at Dollar at 3:15. Drove off at 5:17. Whole process was longer than our flight. Absolutely unacceptable. Don't rent from here if you'd like to start your trip sane. Already nervous about what drop off looks like.

I was less than impressed with this McDonald's. The customer service was lacking. We popped in for a drink and I decided to get an ice cream cone for a hot day. The cashier told me that they didn't have ice cream there. The ice cream machine is as right behind her and seemed to have been recently used. I asked my friend if I heard her right and she said that was what she said. I know McDonalds is infamous for their ice cream machines being "down" but to flat out say they don't have it was a first. I'm not likely to stop at this location again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Every review on here is ridiculous. I've been here plenty of times, so has my entire family. This place has never messed up anything for us in more than a decade. The Company always posts and mails coupons with pretty good deals. Don't listen to the two previous reviews. The female's review was probably because she took a cheap piece of clothing to them and tried to have it dry cleaned. If it was an expensive piece of clothing, she would have said so. As for the other guy, if you can't write in complete sentences on a public forum like Yelp, your opinion probably isn't very valid.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: OMG! Where do I start? This place is EXTREMELY ROACH infested. I had to report a roach infestation 8 times in one year. Swimming pools and jacuzzis are NASTY and UNCLEAN. They are slow to respond to service requests. They are purely focused on collecting money only and will only show you the model apartments and the amenities that they have spruced up. I lived there for over a year and could NOT wait to leave. You will be better off finding another community in Westchase to rent. It is NOT WORTH IT and you will regret living in Avana. It literally reminds me of well-dressed GHETTO APARTMENT COMPLEX.

This is a review more towards their inconsistency via Uber orders. I have given this place a few chances, but after my last order I'm done. There's ALWAYS food missing from my order, drinks missing, or wrong food items. I have gotten cheeseburgers with no meat, a toy yet no kids meal, no kids meal what so ever, and food in the wrong packaging. My last straw was what looked like a bite in the cheeseburger I ordered last night. Thankfully Uber Eats refunded all my money. If you can't handle the extra pressure from the additional business Uber Eats brings then don't do it. You're wasting my time and money.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Please spend your money elsewhere. Waited 45 minutes passed my reservation. The owner and or manager saw us get sat 45 minutes late, my appetizer, drink and food order was messed up. No visit from the suit man. Typical "hip" restaurant with small portions, over priced, mediocre food, and subpar service. You might be better off getting lean cuisine at Walmart and going the ABC store for a bottle of wine. Only positive was the old fashions. Many other Italian restaurants in Tampa to go to. This place is at the bottom of my list. Will not visit again.

After driving 3 1/2 hours in traffic I decided to stop in here for a couple tacos. I had a little bit of sticker shock when I saw it was four dollars per crispy taco! But I said what the heck and I  went ahead and ordered one crispy al pastor taco and one soft Carne  Asada taco. To say I was underwhelmed is an understatement! The pastor taco was dry as the desert sun was also bland and tasteless. The Carne Asada was equally disappointing. This will definitely not be a repeat place for me as there are too many great Mexican food places to try

Great coffee and the baristas are always super friendly. Seating upstairs is cozy and has big windows looking out to the street below, although it's usually really crowded during the day and tough to grab a seat with an outlet. Since they also roast upstairs, it can get really hot up there too. I would not recommend this place if you're trying to work and/or use the internet. The wireless connection is awful and only works about 50% of the time. A better alternative for working is the CHCC in East Falls by the Queen Lane Reservoir.

I toured the apartments a few months ago when I moved back to St. Pete. Full disclosure, I am in the business and didn't want to live where I worked. The only reason I didn't lease was because I chose to move closer to downtown. The pool is beautiful, the apartments more than fit my needs and the office staff were attentive and nice. My job is being relocated back to Tampa and I find myself again revisiting the possibility of moving closer to Tampa which leads me back to Lincoln Shores. For the value and service I received, I may end up calling this home.

Average service. Very over priced... you buy 20 wings and they don't give you any ranch/blue cheese with the order....they will charge you a $1 extra for each dipping sauce....also they won't let you split flavors for an order of 20 wings.... 10/10 split two flavors seems fair to me.. I'm not going to buy another 6-20 wings just for the extra flavor that I want that you won't split  -_- 
Also pizza wasn't hot by the time we got it delivered... be ready to spend $50 for only one pizza and 20 wings..
Decent crust and dough though

I stopped in here while on a day trip to Philly. First off, the staff (male cashier specifically) wasn't very friendly and I felt very rushed when ordering, despite there being no line behind me. I ordered a cup of coffee and a chicken salad sandwich. The coffee was good as expected but the sandwich was really tough and chewy. I wouldn't order again. If you are coming here to work, don't. Although there are ample tables and space to work, there are no outlets and they don't offer WiFi either. Overall it was an average experience and overpriced for what you're getting.

Absolutely love and adore the employees at this location. I'm always greeted with smiles and quick service. It's a plus when the employees actually knows your name and know what you are there for. There are time where I can be a hassle. I've lost and damaged my debt card multiple times which I have gotten  replaced the same day without having to wait days for. EXTRA POINTS for not making feel stupid for replacing my debt card multiple times and coming in for multiple gift cards every week (which are free of charge with a minimum loading limited of $25.00).

I really like Hungry Howies, the food is always pretty good. Except when I called to place my order at around 9:30 and asked for delivery the guy that answered the phone was a rude and sounded annoyed that I was ordering pizza.. Anyway. He told me there were 5 orders in front of me and told me the wait time and I said that was fine and then he sounded appalled that I'm patient and I can wait for food to be delivered to me... He then hastily asked for my address and card info he almost hung up and I asked him if he needed my name for the order he said he didn't and then just hung up. Pretty rude customer service honestly.

My family and I have been to Gallagher's Restaurant many, many times. Not only does the food having a delicious, such unique flavor.. That atmosphere is perfect for any occasion. The dessert Is one of the best parts! There's always a wide variety! Above all, the family that owns this restaurant is genuine. Also unique, a lot like the food!  But they are very kind, and put forth a lot of effort and appreciation for the people who help build it and keep it going! They would do anything could for just about anybody! We will definitely continue, and keep continuing to support this LOCAL, fun, awesome atmosphere around. It's a part of Waterloo!

Tonight, when we went to get in our beds, we pulled back the top cover to find that our sheets were covered in small hairs, yellow stains and crumbs (which I have photos to back up). We called down to the front office for help and were told no one was here to assist us and received with a sigh. When one of our party went downstairs, the woman working was on her cell. We did go retrieve our own blankets when we were able, which is why this review is two stars instead of one. Everything else was clean and our stay was comfortable thereafter. It seems the problem lies mostly with housekeeping.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I give it two stars because the location and outdoor patio seemed inviting enough that it got us to stop in and try it out.
However, the food is extremely overpriced and mediocre, at best. We ordered two fish sandwiches, a kids meal, grilled cheese and a tea, and it came to $51. It could have at LEAST been good; but no. :(
Also, the thin guy taking orders wasn't the most friendly person. Once seated, you're on your own, as far as service. The "serving staff" only bring out your order, but don't ever come back to check on customers.
Future visits to Winslow's Table aren't in the card for us.

I was a loyal customer in the neighborhood. But the way they handle their business is extremely unfriendly. It's disturbing and unreasonable to enforce such a strict cancellation policy during the pandemic. My dinner date was feeling sick. I called the restaurant and explained the difficult situation and that I didn't want to put the restaurant server and other customers at risk. And that I could reschedule the dinner. But they refused to give me that option and insisted on charging me a $100 cancellation fee. 

Super disappointed and I don't recommend anyone going there if you want to be treated with decency.

Let's start with it is fast food. 

I always make a point to stop when in town for breakfast at this location. The staff is always amazingly friendly willing to get you anything. 

Remember it is fast food and for what it is, it is delicious. I would eat here ten times over before even considering the Golden Arches or that ridiculous bell breakfast. 

I don't get all the negative reviews and with the number of cotton tops that are in this dinning room if it was bad or the staff was rude, they would not be here. (Give them a smart phone and I bet the review rating would change). 

Keep up the good job and see you next visit to stl.

For $60 a night, we were pleasantly surprised at how nice this place was. The room was huge! It had recently been renovated and had new, modern furniture and finishes. Big flatscreen TV. The bathroom was a good size but didn't have a bathtub, just a really long shower. It was weird, but the water was hot and the shower head had different settings, so whatevs. 

Free breakfast in the morning was disappointing, but isn't it usually? There is a Dunkin Donuts down the street anyways.

Easy on and off the highway, too, so it was convenient for us as travelers just passing through.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: All I can say is yikes. There was only one server on the floor which made service extremely slow. We were waiting at the host stand for at least 5 minutes before someone came to seat us. Appetizer never came out, the food took almost an hour to come out and was literally freezing. Not an exaggeration, the tater tots were literally still frozen. Would have been better off going to Burger King or Quiznos. Management needs to get it together because this restaurant is way to understaffed to provide good service.

The only reason this location gets 2 stars from me instead of 1 is because of the convenience of the drive-thru. The older women that work there are extremely rude, while the younger ones are actually very nice. I can't have cream in my coffee, so I get almond milk; multiple times I have received a coffee with cream in it because the older women were too busy gossiping to fully listen to my order. This morning, I asked for a toasted sesame bagel with veggie cream cheese. This is what I got: a burnt bagel with a smear of veggie cream cheese...

Worst experience ever with renting a car. Had to wait over an hour at 10am on Friday to pick up the car. Then they tried to upgrade me to a larger car saying they wild only charge me $5 a day more. I said ok because they were going to give me the smallest car they had. Then it ended up being $55 more for 3 days. They couldn't explain the charges to me and after waiting over an hour o wasn't going to wait longer to speak with a supervisor. The upgraded car was outdated and dirty. I will never rent from this Avis again. And I booked through Priceline.

This is not a 5 star hotel. 

Checkin: scheduled for 4pm. At 4:30 they told us our room still wasn't ready (we had been waiting since 3:00pm hoping to get in a bit early).

Room: Nice decor, comfy beds, but not 5 star. The furniture had not been maintained (lots of scratches, etc)

Pool: a complete joke. The pool is on the roof and is a tiny simple rectangle.

Location: great location, 1 block from the beach, on State street next to tons of restaurants.

This is a decent hotel, but is absolutely not 5 stars and not worth several hundred dollars per night
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A word of caution. Do not use this place if you have installed any kind of paint protection film(ppf)on your vehicle. They do not rinse the vehicles off well enough and the brushes cram the dirt into all the leading edges of the ppf. Left a number of dirty lines on what was a perfectly white car. Will cost upwards of $500 to fix. Does an ok job if you really don't care about your vehicles paint. My girlfriend loves it cuz it's convenient and unlimited for one price. But it misses a lot of spots on her car. Especially down below the doors.

This has been a not so pleasant stay here to say the least. Room service doesn't show up to clean your room, unless you ask for it. Oh and if you ask them to come clean your room make sure it's before 6:30 pm, bc they "go home for the day"! The bed sheet had period stain on it, sink had faulty pipes, and we had to use the service elevator. I would expect much more for the price I paid,and from a hotel associated to the Omni name. I've stayed at Best Westerns that are nicer than here. I'm pretty sure the La Quinta across the street is probably better than here!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Osake became much worse after the nice owner lady went back to Korea. GIANT TIP: Don't go during peak hours and don't get served by a non-Asian waitress, especially during the weekend. Tonight we waited like 5 min and got seated. Then waited over 30 min and the waitress intentionally ignored our requests for order and even just water several times! The pencils didn't work so there was no way we could write anything on the sushi menu. We left after suffering for like an hour in the back table and the waitress didn't even care what we said and how we felt.

I was helped by the manager Daniel when I came in to make an adjustment to my account... he asked a few questions and came to find out that my job offered a discount and all sport inclusive for less that what I was paying for one sport access. I am so grateful he took the time to review my account and asses a better plan for me. Every time I walk in most team members are friendly and he's always sure to greet and congratulate me for coming in (after a 9 hour shift it takes determination haha) . But thank you Daniel and the SB team for making my fitness transition in SB smooth! Wish the best to you all. :)
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I had reserved a king size bed room and got a queen size room being told " we have contracted with a company and give our king size beds to that account". Even though I reserved with approved room. Why bother reserving a king size room then. Also, not very well maintained and a recent wAter leak made the situation worse. Breakfast was sub par. On a positive note, I spoke to the new manager, Michael, about the reservation and he lowered my one night stay cost. It did not  help me any since this was a corporate paid lodging.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Called ahead for reservations and spoke with Sherry. We showed up a little early and she had us set up with a great table on the second floor. We were a party of 4 w/ 2 teenage girls. Zoe was our waiter and made the whole evening a blast. He made great recommendations on the drink and dinner menu and provided service second to none. Everything he brought from the kitchen and bar was top notch in taste and presentation. My hat's off to the entire staff... Sherry, Zoe and the Chefs in the kitchen. A 5 star experience. Can't wait to come back...

This is a great place to get a regular mani/pedi, but do not go here for acrylic nails. This was the place I went to in order to get acrylics for the first time. I would ask for squoval and get squared, then I would ask for rounded and get squoval. Also each nail was filed on the sides way too much, resulting in a very awkwardly shaped nail. At first I thought I was just being overly critical, but then I went to Cinderella Nails on Main Street and finally got exactly what I had been asking for all along. Do not waste your time with acrylic nails here!

What a funbelivable place.  I will start off by saying I wish he showers were a little better, but other than that we have a great hotel. Bar open until 12 downstairs, which for us was not entirely late enough, but they made the most incredible rinks.  I have a bloody mary with a shrimp cocktail. They have great little place open with many options including a buffet, which is great for breakfast. We had assistance from David in Security as we needed to ship a few things home, and he was incredibly helpful.  He brought us labels, boxes, tape etc... What a wonderful place for a trip.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place was ranked 3 star by Priceline. I doesn't even get 1 star for me the room was disgusting. Mold in the bathroom, stains on the rugs, under neath the bed doesn't even get  cleaned. Pubic hair on the toilet and sink, walls stained, it has a moisture to every room that leaves you feeling dirty after 3 minutes. I will never ever go back to this hotel. The staff was amazing though I will say that. And the location was nice. The hotel needs to be demolished and that staff should be in a nicer hotel tHey are the best part about it. GROSS
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The workers were very nice as soon as we entered. The first thing i noticed was thr cute curtains on some of the booths. This would be a cute place for a casual date. Unfortunately they were occupied when we arrived. I got their lunch special. From 11am-4 pm Expect on Sundays it starts at 11:30am. There pasta was very creamy. The garlic bread comes included and it also super yummy. I'm not a fan of salads so I gave mine to my friend, but that also comes with the lunch special. Overall it's a cozy tasty place.

Had been here before and my experience was good. This last time was anything but. Had an appointment for 6 and was not seen until 630. Asked for a skin tight fade and the cut was only done with clippers. When I was rushed out of the seat I was left with hair all over my head/neck/ears, was not lined up, and to top it off my shirt collar was left rolled inside my shirt. Didn't realize until I got to my car. For $35 I would expect a little better service for something I could get at super cuts. Will never go back.

A very interesting twist in tacos. I highly suggest this place if you're looking for some fusion food. I had all of the tacos in the $3.50 section. The pork belly and duck was my favourite. Although, I have heard complaints from friends that their duck is often dry. For dessert, I had the churros. It was crispy on the outside and softly textured on the inside, the chocolate on the side was a real plus too. The ambience outside is lovely, great for dates especially. Overall, a nice place with a good twist on the your palette but a little overpriced.

My nails look fine, and eventually after working very hard to compliment her and warm her up the technician showed a little friendliness. You never know what someone's going through, so I would never leave a bad review over that. 

But I got the S&S manicure for $45. The end result is good so far, but there was no manicure involved. No hand massage, cuticle cleanup, etc. My nails were just immediately powdered. And when I asked why, she said I didn't need it although I haven't had a manicure in a while and had some dry skin/cuticles I would have liked to have trimmed. Plus the person right beside me got a lotion/hand massage with her treatment.

Cute hotel, very clean, tiny rooms. But that's okay. I got a room overlooking the pool and so far it's extremely quiet (everyone may be at the game). Great location too if you want to hit up the touristy stuff but not be in the middle of it.

Nice amenities (free wifi yay!) a bar (woo!) and the front desk receptionist was completely charming and extremely friendly.

I'm only here for one night due to the way I booked things, but in the future I wouldn't hesitate to stay here.

The one odd thing for me: Holy mackerel the layout feels like a maze.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Parking is cramped here. I ended up parking across the street at the Library Pakade for $5/weekend night.

I was attending my cousin's wedding upstairs in one of their large conference rooms. Comfortably held over 200 attendees. Food was fabulous. Equipment, projectors, screens, microphones all worked well. Servers were courteous and accommodating. 

I snuck out in between courses to walk around downtown. The hotel is conveniently close to Churchill Plaza, City Hall, and the Art Gallery. Nice spot for a late night stroll.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The service was okay and the workers were nice, but the place was filthy! Every single trash can was over flowing and there was spilt soda and garbage all over the drink station. They were also completely out of straws and nearly out of lids. There were only a few handful of people in the building but choosing a table to sit at was extremely difficult because all tables were sticky with trash littered everywhere. We finally found a table to sit at after throwing away the ketchup packets. The food itself was okay (up to McDonald's standards anyway) but I feel as if I need a shot of penicillin after leaving this place!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Came here after a long day from Los Olivos and wasn't able to do walk-ins for the restaurant we originally wanted to go to. It turned out that I should've read more reviews first. The food was mediocre. The rice quality was especially disappointing if you regularly go for sushi or Japanese cuisine. The rice all sticked together and tasted sweet. Fish quality was also poor. Service? Well, we waited for 40 minutes for the food with no heads up and the server didn't bother to come over at all during the 40-minute long wait..

Legitimately the worst restaurant I have ever been to. The service took over an hour and a half for a table of 3, granted it was pretty busy. Our waiter was rude and was annoyed when we asked for refills after he had only visited our table ONCE during the first hour. Half of the food came out freezing cold, and our side of mac n cheese had a french fry mixed into it. The food was obviously microwaved, as it was warm on the inside and freezing on the outside. Additionally, the food had no flavor. Thankfully they removed the horrible food from our bill, but soft drinks were $4 each. DO NOT GO HERE.

I have tried numerous nail salons and this one was just mediocre. When I walked in the door I wasn't really greeted or felt welcomed. The shop did not feel the cleanest. The guy that did my nails was not very friendly and when I asked for him to do a sparkly accent nail he said "no that won't look good", which made me feel awkward. Also he coughed in my face and did not ask what length or nail shape I wanted. Overall, he did a fine job and I was satisfied with my nails, but I will definitely not be going back again to American Nails.

I went here for my birthday nails. I got dip powder soaked off and replaced. We collaborated on a design I loved. Atmosphere was great, great music and decor. I was so excited. But some nails came out wavy and then the total was $68. My 1st rhinestone fell off about day 3 or 4 on my non-dominant hand. So I went back over the bridge (I live in Jersey) to get it replaced and it came of again a day or two later. Then I lost a second gem the day after that. And now there's a chip at the base of a wavy thumb. My friends nails were also subpar. I won't be going back.

Ok, never had tp walk outside of the airport a good lil ways to get to the car rental facility.  I rented from Thirfty, the process was not painful,  mainly because I'm usually always prepared unlike the many folks that were in line before me. There should be a separate  line for those with debit card payment and credit card.  But overall, my experience was decent. The weather was getting bad (storming) and online the site specifically said rental car counter was in airport not in an entire separate building.

Three of us went there on a Saturday night about 730 and sat at the bar.  It took about 10 minutes to get a beer.  Then it was another 20-25 minutes to place our order.  The place didn't look too crowded but they did look short on staff.  The sushi was nothing special in my opinion, but I didn't go there too hungry.  Two of our beers went empty without being asked for another or if we wanted some water.  
Overall... I would not go there hungry if you don't want to wait.  I would also wait until happy hour to get the specialty rolls.  Not worth it to me.

Papa Murphy's has been our go-to for take out pizza for a long time. Their ingredients are fresh and their pizzas tastes great. However the customer service is sort of a deterrent. The young lady who took our order was very rude, and she acted as if she didn't want to be there. We asked her if the "family size" was the biggest size, and she proceeded to point over her shoulder in the direction of the sizes and didn't say a word. A simple "yes" would have been sufficient. Love the pizza, but the customer service is not up to par.

The one time I visited here with my membership I was not bothered. I also highly value that the reviews are turned on for this location. I have had terrible luck trying to reach someone with more authority and superior to the manager at the Canal location. I've had terrible issues with membership at that location trying to fix a problem that was created by a former employee there. If I could go back in time, I would aim to get a membership at a gym company that has a human face, not a corporate one. I'm still waiting to hear back from anyone.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Worst location i have even been to and i travel all over and visit many different planet fitness locations. If i could give 0 stars i would. Dirt and dust bunnies all over the floor. Nothing looks like it's been wiped down. The employees were all sitting on the ground when i walked in and when i left. The "personal trainer" was sitting in a brown box behind the counter. It felt like the air conditioning was broken. Felt cooler outside than it did inside and it's 80 degrees outside right now. Will never return. Go the extra miles to the next location and pass this one up.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
Great Food,Great Prices, Stank Attitude...

I was a frequent customer after tonight I will never return. The sign on the door said they closed at 930. I arrived at 8:50...took awhile to scan the menu because I wanted to try something different. The lady at the counter rudely told me "Hurry up we close in five minutes." I told her that the sign said 9:30..she brushed me off. I left and she slammed the door behind me. My money spends everywhere and I refuse to pay to be treated with disrespect. As much as I like the food I will never go back.

I had my first experience with The Artist Haus this week as I followed my amazing hairstylist Alyssa from another salon. I have trusted Alyssa with my hair for several years and she never disappoints! She keeps things real so I come out with a color and cut that is best for my hair type and lifestyle every time. Alyssa has a great personality and I always enjoy catching up with her! I loved the atmosphere of the salon and felt so relaxed. They did great with making me feel comfortable there especially during a pandemic!

Most unprofessional management out there! The old female that manages the property is extremely nit-picky about everything and does not follow the landlord rules herself. We have been harassed for every little thing that could be taken out content. I definitely will be filing a complaint on the harassment received and will follow up with whatever measurement that is needed. 

Electricity bill was high due to the un-energy efficient wall heaters. Bathroom tub clocked up after living here 2 weeks- tenant responsible for repair. Great price but not worth the old delusional female drama.

This hotel is NOT accommodating to customers. Booked through Hotwire and tried to check in prior to 3pm. The extremely unprofessional attendant at the counter was rude and abrupt, "You can't check in early." When I asked if there was a fee or any way I could get a room early as I would be checking out of this hotel within 8 hours, again he was rude, "We don't do that here."....mind you, this place has 80% of it's chewed up parking lot empty, so I KNOW there's plenty of available rooms. I recommend to avoid this place at all cost, even if you have to pay twice the price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Third time that I've dropped in looking for hard to fine bourbons...and again I was disappointed. First visit was the only time that I had moderate success. I did nab a mash whiskey this time, however, at a great price. The store is huge on a huge parking lot, shared with an Acme supermarket. It carries a full line of alcoholic beverages and appears to concentrate on wine. Because of its convenient location, I'm pretty sure that I will continue to check out its bourbon stock every time I visit Audubon NJ...and leave disappointed.

I understand that this store is in a busy location, but almost every order I've gotten at any time of the day, from mid-morning to late at night, has been wrong. Tonight I ordered a large Impossible slider combo with no onions and some honey mustard packets; and we got a small fry and four sliders, all with onion, and no sauce or napkins. Also, every time I've been, it takes a minimum of 15 minutes to make it from the drive thru order station to the window. Again, I know this is a high-trafficked area, but I won't be going back.

These guys are great based solely on their massive beer selection that I could easily justify driving across town for. But on my last couple visits the insanely good hospitality and customer service they showed me is why I'm giving this review. Some of the nicest most helpful people I have encountered while shopping. I usually don't think about writing a review in the first place unless it was horribly bad or exceptionally good but in this cases the folks over at beer peddlers were exceptionally good. Will definitely be back soon.

I have been going to this place since it has opened. I loved this place! The past 3 times I have gone for a gel manicure and a pedicure I felt I was rushed, my nail polish has chipped off and my gel lasts a week. I told myself I wasn't going to go back after the second bad experience but I went back and the lady rushed me the massage was horrible. Since there has been new staff I think the ladies are rude. I am so disappointed with this place because I loved it so much and recommended it to everyone! I feel like a whole new staff has been in their for about a year and a half now and it has just gone down hill!

Before the pandemic this was our family's favorite restaurant, always frequenting for special occasions for the great prices for some AMAZING food thanks to chef Nina, and the most awesome servers ever (miss you Emi!).  We are from Los Angeles and have never had this quality sashimi before, so good! Now we are still sure to order every few weeks take out which has been super easy and just as delicious! Every day I'm excited to see the daily $5 and $3 special rolls on Facebook to see if I'm tempted to change dinner plans. Love this restaurant!

Modern Eye is not only the best eye place around they are one of the best businesses Philly has to offer. Kate at the university city location is amazing. I recently got in touch with her about needing an emergency pair of contacts. Kate was incredibly helpful, even allowing me to come in after regular office hours for help. 

On another occasion Modern Eye was able to get me a replacement pair of glasses for me even after my warranty expired. 

It's been two years since I bought my first pair of glasses from them and I still get compliments. 

I couldn't imagine even trying another eye place.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
QT's Nail Spa is a place you should never miss in Reno ... First time I went for a treatment in June-2020 when I visited Reno..
Again I came to this place yesterday for a pedicure treatment... Staff is so friendly and professional.. First first of all I should speak about the cleanliness and decor... 
Staff take care  of you, time you enter and until you leave after the treatment.. I am sure anyone comes here will come back again and again..
Special thanks to Anna for her great hospitality and professionalism...

The Club is nice. I was immediately made to feel like an outsider though at the front counter. This is one of those clubs where they make you sign a form as though you were a guest at the club. Also i was notified I was only allowed ten visits here. I joined planet fitness and I paid for a membership that worked at all clubs. Making me sign a form at the front counter does not make someone feel a part of the planet fitness family. Either planet fitness is a group of individual clubs or it is Planet Fitness. Franchises one by one can kill the entire concept with little things like this.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Amenities and staff were very nice. Room service shrimp and grits was amaaaazing. But what I didn't like was: 1) paid more for balcony room which was only a view of the building across the street 2) also was not made aware that the balcony gets shared w another room so weird 3) walls are super thin. I was walking through the hallways and literally heard an entire conversation from someone's shower 4) very loud! My window was as if it was opened completely when it wasn't. You hear everything happening on bourbon st outside and the garbage truck manhandling dumpsters at 4 am every morning was great
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Had to write a review. Sent my mother to stay there for an event. There was a complete lack of privacy in the room. It seemed like someone was in the room while she was out--they found someone else's documents and a gosh darn PURSE in her room. Something sketchy was going on. It is ESPECIALLY unsettling because they had the privacy sign up for the room to not even be freshened up, and my mother's personal items were in there. 
Also, to add insult to injury, the steak downstairs was horrible and apparently tasted "old".
How unfortunate. 
Stay somewhere else where your privacy is respected.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

This has always been my favorite place for brunch when I come to Tampa...no carving station, no pasta station and no bloody mary bar..... But you will find the best fried chicken for miles around.  The all you can drink mimosas, bloody mary's snd margaritas are included in the brunch price of $20. I can drink $40 worth of mimosas so having it included in my food price is perfect!
The outdoor tiki bar setting with live music is always a plus... Service is great and drinks are even better... Not a bad way to spend a lazy Sunday. I will always come back.... Met owner and he's great!!!

I have been utilizing this place for my Chinese food fix for 6 years now and have to say in comparison to the 2 other Chinese food places this is indeed the best and considerably less expensive than others. Going in it is better to understand that 5 minutes does not really mean that so it is always better to hold off a bit. The food is always consistent and we have explored the menu to mix things up and have not ever been disappointed.  Always remember that unhappy people share their unhappiness while happy people rarely do....they are still in business for a reason.

Dragged here by friends who got suckered by the latest ad campaign on tv. Appetizers are over-priced and not that great, they messed up my create your own pasta, put the wrong sauce, different than what I marked, waiter offered to make it right but since it took forever to come in the first place, I said it was fine. Food tastes very massed produced and average. service was so slow, another waiter finally offered to take our checks and credit cards so we could pay and leave. 2 1/2 hours for dinner at this run-of- the-mill Italian joint was like torture! Olive Garden tastes better is cheaper and excellent service!

I don't know what I love more about this place, the food or the awesome fellas who run it! From the first visit I knew I'd be a loyal customer. 

I'm a vegan-ish vegetarian because... cheese. Cheese is my weakness but I usually pay for it later with an upset stomach and sinus issues. That's not the case with this place. I can cheat a bit and not pay for it. The only downside to working so close to this restaurant is that I have to talk myself out of going there almost everyday otherwise my pants won't fit anymore ‍. The struggle is real my friends!

I've been here a lot and I'm usually frustrated by the time I leave. I was inspired to write a review after tonight when a McDonald's employee blatantly lied to my face about there being "no ranch in the whole store." When I asked her if there were any other sauces available, she told me I "need to go to the next window because the other girl handles that." Of course, the woman at the following window gave me the ranch as I requested. I don't understand the purpose behind this, besides laziness, and lack of caring.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I took my car to the American Tire Company on Nolensville Pike, I wasn't able to find that location on Yelp.  I had an oil change scheduled at 10:30, I arrived at 10:15.  At 11:15 my car still had not been taken in to get started.  I asked how long it was going to be and they figured it was going to be another hour before they could even start it.  At no point did any one tell me they were behind and it may take longer than expected.  They didn't ask me if I wanted to reschedule, he simply said "sorry," and acted like he was glad it was one car of the list.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I am sorry to say this restaurant disappointed. I had fried oysters and a kale caesar. The oysters were drenched in buffalo wing sauce which made them soggy and inedible. The server had them remade with no sauce. Much better as they were crispy and hot, but no flavor or seasoning. And the salad was freezing cold. Like it had been in the freezer. The dressing had absolutely no flavor and was too cold & thick to dress the salad well. Our server tried to address the issue but said " Sorry we serve our salad cold".

A coworker recommended this hotel since I was making plans to celebrate my son's birthday. I booked it through hotels.com and I absolutely loved it!!! Once I got to the hotel, the friendly staff greeted us, asked for my photo ID and gave me the key to our room (such a smooth process) The room had two double beds, a huge bathroom, even a sofa bed for the kids, the room was super spacious & clean! Beds were super comfortable ;) the next day we had complementary breakfast, which was included in the hotel price.
Highly recommend it!!! Especially if you're looking for a weekend to relax =)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Based on reviews it seems they have good and bad days! My experience fell on a not so good day. Customer service was awful. The cashier spent a few minutes texting without acknowledging me as I was standing right in front of her and I was the only customer in there. The wait time for food to be done was suspiciously quick, which made sense when my rice & egg roll tasted like they were days old and just warmed up. Two stars because their crab Rangoon was decent, parking to pick up was easy, and I didn't mind their general tso chicken. Overall not horrible, but won't be returning.

If I could give this restaurant less than one star, I would. As someone who works at a restaurant, I can recognize terrible service. Don't waste your time making a reservation, because they won't honor it. They lost our reservation, and we had to wait 30 minutes to sit. We barely saw our server. She only checked on us once. There was a hair in my boyfriend's food. The food was average and overpriced. The restaurant was way too small and definitely a fire hazard. I wouldn't recommend this restaurant to anyone.

Really Great Italian food. I was hoping for a better pasta selection and being not a big seafood fan, i felt like there menu was a little weak there. However if you are a big seafood fan you would be very pleased. 
 
I went for the Parmesan Encrusted Chicken which was very lightly fried and came with creamed spinach and this small side of homemade pasta with a cheese sauce which was very tasty. We also had Tiramisu for dessert and that was damn good. 

Only reason I didn't give it a 5 was cause I have better Italian on Arthur Ave in NY but that's some stiff competition. For Italian in New Orleans, definitely a 5 Star.

I MISS OTA YA SO MUCH!

I lived in Langhorne for about a year and discovered Ota Ya.  It's small, service can be slow (would call for a reservation), but by far the BEST SUSHI I HAVE EVER HAD! It's also a BYOB.

The spicy tuna roll is the best spicy tuna!  Always fresh and they don't skimp on the fish!  Also love the spicy tuna pizza and the roti cani appetizer. Also delicious tempura ice cream!

I've been trying to find another sushi place as good as Ota Ya, but my husband (who turned me onto sushi) tells me that Ota Ya is special and that not all sushi places are like it.  I'm so sad to have moved 3 hours away :(

I am very very picky - and when I give five stars to this place - it can be taken to the bank.  The food is absolutely delicious, well presented and perfectly priced.  The fried green tomatoes were delicious, as were the grits with collards and the  fried chicken sandwich.  The food was so delicious, I forgot to take photographs.  

Madeline was a delightful server - she explained the restaurant's offerings accurately with all the fair of a Southern Belle.  Service was perfect!  

The brownie with ice cream - sublime!  I loved it.  Marvelous food with a Southern Flair for hospitality.  

Well done, The Little Lion!  I will be back.

Straight up 3 stars. Nothing was terrible. Nothing was great. 
Flavor combinations were strange.
We started with hamachi. It was too cold, the fish was not treated right. Way too much salt. Also, why are you even putting salt on hamachi???
Next was the boar cheek. Never had it before. Sounded interesting. Tastes exactly like beef stroganoff.
Hanger steak was okay. Contrary to all the other plates, the steak was very underseasoned. Like other reviews have stated, they tend to under cook it.
Scallops and accompanying sauce were good! But you only get like 3 of them.
Mushrooms had an oddly sweet flavor.
I don't recommend any of the cocktails.

Coming from NYC, I don't expect much from Italian joints down south. But Vincent's definitely holds up. We had a party of 7, and for a small place  like this it was a bit much, but they were most gracious and seated us relatively quickly. They hooked us up with some delicious appetizers for the wait, and they were delicious. The wait staff was quick and attentive. I had the veal sorrentino, and it could definitely compare to any meal I've enjoyed in little Italy. Not sure if he was the gm or owner, but tony was super nice, and such a gracious host, I will gladly return to this place on my next visit to the big easy!

Pro's , great location, front desk is friendly. There is a restaurant in the hotel that is ok. The cookies at check in our delicious.

Negatives, rooms are cramped for a two adults and two kids. Work out facility is small and was closed for a few weeks had to go the Hilton which was inconvenient. 
The bathroom in the room is cramped and has a very commercial type toilet (the kind you would find at a sports bar).

We have stayed at other double trees and we expected better. There are so many choices in New Orleans and there is so much better.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have gave this place multiple chances. Sometimes I have good luck with the customer service but the majority of the time I do not. The front desk girls are always very sassy and argue with me over what's on my nails. Today I came in to get one nail fixed. I have been sitting here for over a hour while 10+ people that walked in behind me with no reservations have already been seated. When I asked the girl what the deal was she immediately started talking over me to the net customer (whom who she was also rude too) I am only staying because I'm a hour in and desperately need this nail fixed but I most likely will not be coming back.

Rented a car 8 months in advance only to be told that they didn't have a car for me when I arrived. Not that I didn't have a reservation... they didn't have a car. How does a car rental place located in an airport in a tourist heavy destination run out of cars?!?!? To top it off, "supervisor" on duty told me he wasn't going to do anything because it wasn't his fault, openly argued and rejected other customers concerns and clearly is not in the correct profession. Supervisor finally acquiesced and offered an upgrade or discount, of which I never received. Ridiculous. Find a different rental company if at all possible.

For $17 for a tenderloin cheesesteak, was highly disappointed that my sandwich came out with a side of potatoe chips , asked for fried onions and got large pieces of barely cooked onion, and low quality cheese. Voiced my option to my u professional waitress who told me it's not her ability to change that so to talk to the manger. Asked for manager at the door and the girl st door said there was no manager on staff on a Friday eve at 7 pm ...really?! Never again will my hard earned money be spent in this over rated joke of a restaurant.

The lobby smelled of smoke and the room smelled out bleach yet the bathtub was too dirty to bathe my children. I asked for a pack m play at check in and was told they would look for one and would call or come to my room in 10 mins. That never happened. I had to back to the front desk. A pick n play was eventually delivered. The front desk attendant told me she would come back with clean sheets and she never did. The next day, I waited 19 mins for an attendant to arrive to the front desk. The pillows were also horrible. The only positive of this hotel is the close proximity to Sesame place. I expect more from Ramada
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Ate here for lunch after the movies, on a weekday.  Ordered a premium margarita which was not very flavorful.  The salsa was medium spicy, but not much flavor.  I ordered the enchilada lunch special with rice and beans.  The enchilada, rice and beans were pretty much tasteless, and the enchiladas were extremely salty, plus the tortilla was hard, and had an odd taste.  The melted cheese on top of the enchiladas was minimal.  I would say, both my husband and I would not eat here again.  Las Palmas Mexican restaurant on Rivergate Parkway in Goodlettsville is 100% times better.

What a great hotel experience!!! Our reunion booked several rooms in advance and had an amazing time together. The hotel was extremely accommodating and attentive to our needs. The manager, Jonathan, and the attendant, Jason, were particularly wonderful, even when we had last minute requests for tables and media equipment. 

My rooms were beautiful and comfortable, and the complimentary breakfast had a lot of options! The 24 hour coffee room came in handy. 

The hotel was also in a great location! 10 minute walk to Bourbon Street (far enough for the young kids), with a 24 hour convenience store down the street.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Room is ok but front desk is understaffed and service is below average. Phone is sometimes answered with attitude and room requests get lost. Bellman sometimes disappears and storing/fetching luggages takes a long time. Front desk is obviously uninterested in stepping in and helping out even when they're not doing anything. Elevators is fast but if there's a conference going on, be prepared to spend 10 minutes or more. Overall it's an ok property but nothing premium and front desk can use some training to be more professional and attentive.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We came here based on the reviews. We are visiting from out of town and it was our first restaurant here. The place is somewhat of a hole in the wall.... and those usually have the best food.
The food here was delicious! We got the Kazoku special which consisted of 20 pieces of sashimi and 2 rolls of your choice. We got the Giant and the Sunset. The sashimi was so fresh... absolutely delicious. The two rolls were also amazing! They also provided complimentary miso soup. 
The service was quick and the staff was nice. If I'm ever back in town, I will definitely revisit.

Erica gave me the best haircut of my life yesterday!  I was a ragamuffin, not knowing what I needed, but I needed "it" and Erica came through!  But, before the cut hair hit the floor, we actually talked about my hair's nuances and flaws, and she started the conversation!  Rare, most stylists just want to finish your up your appointment and move on to the next. Erica listened, suggested, and I have NEVER left a salon so pleased!  First time there and loved every minute of it!  Friendly front desk guy made paying the great price even better. Erica, my sister Ragin' Cajun, you are doing exactly what you were meant to do!

Best full set I have ever had done!!! These wonderful ladies took their time and made sure everything was perfect for me and even stayed overtime to finish. I also received a free shoulder massage while my nails were drying which was heavenly! They were the friendliest staff I've ever encountered and made me feel so welcome and comfortable from the moment I walked in. I'm new to the area and this was the first place I tried and I will definitely not be taking my business elsewhere. My waitress complimented me on them when I went out for dinner after. I'm so happy! Amazing place!!

I have been regularly having breakfast here for several years. Recently I was told to substitute tomatoes for potatoes would be a $1.50 charge per the owner. I asked to speak to the owner or manager but was told the owner comes in once a month and the manager has no set schedule. This charge is exorbitant and it is the only Jerry Bobs charging for the substitution that I know of. Tomatoes are selling year round for about $ .99/ lb. retail in the food markets. This charge for 3-4 slices of tomatoes is a rip off.

If I could give them zero stars I would. Oil changes are unreasonably priced. They charge you $40 to check the engine then don't notice that a piece of plastic is wedged in next to the serpentine belt. Customer service is terrible and rude. They tell you that you need to buy all these things and none of them are needed. I understand upwelling but if you try to sell me something that isn't going to fix the actual problem at hand, you are covering your own ass instead of helping the customer! This place and the company has lost all my respect! Stay away from these people!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
This hotel is a real mess. Got there at 4pm to check in and was told no rooms were cleaned and availible yet.  2hrs later when my room was finally ready there were 15 people waiting to be able to check into their rooms.

Shower only got warm, never really hot. One of the blankets in my "non-smoking" rooms had not one but three cigarette burns in it. 

The floors must be made of wood and not concrete as I head every step taken by the guests upstairs. 

Really not worth the price when there are several other decent chain hotels nearby.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Dirty, disappointing and disgusting!!!!! 
There was food crumbs around the bottom of the bed (that I happened to stick my hand in... Ew, ew, ew!!), hair in the tub, nasty build up on the shower head and we found out our room didn't even lock, the morning after we had already slept in the room.... Safe right?!? 
They moved us to another room... Which had the same issues. Dirty tub and nasty shower head. 
The breakfast eggs were crunchy from sitting out too long and the selection was scarce.... I was so disappointed because the pictures online looked so nice and updated....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Ristorante Gennaro never disappoints when we go there. I was there on a Friday night to celebrate a birthday dinner with my wife and 16 friends. Many of our friends had never been to Gennaro's previously. Everyone one in the party raved about their food. They loved the sauces, portion size, presentation, and most importantly the taste. The service was great and food came out all together at the right time. I would recommend this place to everyone, great food and prices. All of my friends said they would no doubt be back for another fabulous meal.

Waited at the to go table for 15 minutes to make an order. Meanwhile the line built up. No one showed so I went to go ask a hostess if she could send someone over and she told me she couldn't help me Bc the girl who was supposed to be there was running late. Meanwhile I see THREE hostesses just hanging out by the kitchen and I asked them for help and they all said they couldn't do anything. (They were too busy hanging out and gossiping). So ridiculous... way to lose out on 5 people who were ready to order... oh and thank you for the GREAT customer service.

Rented vehicle from Thrifty thru online service and was provided itemized charges which was reasonable. After I returned car I was charged an additional $104.00 for things they claimed I chose to add o . I was never asked about any additional services. Agent mentioned insurance which h I told him I carry my own but was stopped charged for it without my permission. Matter of fact agent reported Thrifty carries their own liability insurance on all vehicles but I paid for it. This was very deceitful and I will never use this rental agency again.

I was really skeptical about taking my two dogs here because of negative reviews on other sites about Banfield Pet Hospitals in general, but I'm glad I went ahead and used this location. 
The staff were all great and seemed very caring. I wasn't pressured to sign up for their Wellness Plan. The coupon for one free exam was the reason I went, but to my surprise they took another $10.00 off for multiple dogs! They did my guys toenail trims totally free also!
I was really impressed with the level of care and definately recommend
Banfield.

I would recommend that no one EVER go to this place. My last two times absolutely nothing was right with my order. But I was in a hurry today and they were convenient so I thought ok I'll try one more time. Ordered a 3 pc. chicken strip with a small fry. Opened the bag to a mess of cold nasty greasy fires in a box that looked like it was fished out of a dumpster. The chicken? Three tiny pieces that were less than 3" long and it was just mainly some breading (again cold and greasy) with maybe one tiny little strip of chicken. Totally disgusting and gross.

Looks tired and used. Smells musty. Shower rod was nearly pulled off the wall, sagged so curtain wouldn't close. Bottom of tub creaked like it was going to fall through the floor. Old, dingy and grey towels. Wireless is cantankerous in the room. Had to call for tech support after the desk person told me Apple products have trouble connecting. The tech guy had an easy fix, that the desk person should have known. Parking lot is a mess behind the building, lots of trash and old pallets etc. Even the TV channel list was incorrect. Really? Sigh. Stay elsewhere next visit here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I refuse to order from this Papa Johns ever again. I go to the Bible College down the street and lived on campus for 2 years. Ordered pizza regularly. I can't say that I've ever received my pizza in less than 1 1/2 hours after I placed the order. Most of the time the pizza was underdone and cold. Gross. Customer service is terrible, too. They lied about not having my phone number or that I gave the wrong phone number or that they couldn't find the school or any number of excuses to not have my pizza delivered on time. If I could give it less than 1 star I would.

I am a travel nurse new here in St. Pete.  Bar Milo looked like a nice place to hang out.  We put money in the jukebox and our music never played.  Several other customers complained about the same thing.  I was told by one of the regulars that the bartenders skip the music they do not like.  I asked the bartender why and he was extremely rude and condescending. I asked for the owners name so I could tell him how his customers were being treated.  The man behind the bar told me he was the owner and to get out of his bar.  I will not be returning and will spend my hard earned money elsewhere.

Stayed here for 3 nights. The hotel room was very nice. Bed is comfortable and we had a nice view of the city. Staff was very polite and the elevators always came to our floor super quick. The location is also great. Right in downtown!

Paying for internet in 2019 seems a bit absurd. $15 a day and $17.95 for hi-speed internet. The Parking was also $30 a day for self-park and $40 for valet. I was staying here for a wedding and my buddies at the marriott courtyard across the street only had to pay $20 a night to stay in the same garage!

Overall, nice hotel but the nickel and diming knocks it down a bit.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Smelled so good I had to stop, but that's all it had going for it. A neat pour of whisky (which I had to explain to my server) was a very sad 1 oz pour in a huge glass, the pulled pork was SEVERELY lacking, the fries were as white as the plate and just as cold, and the slaw served with it looked as if it had been dying under a heat lamp for the entire day. I realize this is an airport, but COME ON! At least try. Not worth the $25. I will be finishing the other half of my turkey pesto sandwich instead of eating another bite. 

TLDR: Nope, No, Definitely not.

I brought them a flat tire with a nail in it. The price was $27.96 with a $5 discount to patch it. It was around 10:45 and the salesperson said it'd be an hour to hour and a half wait so I left it with them. I call at 1:30 to check on it and they hadn't started. They call back an hour later saying it's ready for pick up. I go pay and pick it up. I get home and notice they charged me $7.99 for TPMS (tire pressure monitoring system) repair kit. This was in the price he quoted before he asked what car it was for. My car has TPMS but nothing on the tire, it uses the ABS. I'm going to go back and see what's up with that. I didn't have time today.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
This Dunkin location truly epitomizes the saying "Penny Wise / Dollar Foolish".  I have tried many times to give this location a chance - but never again!  I have ordered a dozen bagels - and they always sneak in one or two stale ones!  I'm talking like bounce off the wall stale!  They should just put the stale ones aside and make bagel chips or something!  Also, ordered a bacon egg and cheese sandwich today and most of the sandwich was stuck to the paper and not in the sandwich - really?  The jelly donut was a shriveled mess!
Take my advice, try another Dunkin.

One of the best choices in the food court, but still food court quality. They are the only Asian place in the food court that makes your food to order. All other Asian food places have the food under a heat lamp and is pretty mediocre.  The price is about average for shitty Asian food but the portions are big like usual.  

They have a cool grill and awesome outfits while making your food so that's a bonus, however you will have to wait a little for your food.

I got chicken teriyaki with grilled veggies over fried rice. It took about 5 minutes which was irksome but at least it was hot and fresh.

Visited this establishment on 8/24 for breakfast and ordered a machaca breakfast burrito. I was greatly disappointed with the quality of what I received. This was the worst excuse for machaca I've ever had. I fact I wouldn't even call it machaca. Maybe they get away with serving this garbage (Basura) to gringos but for someone who's knows authentic Mexican this placed was horrible. Machaca is roast beef, scrambled eggs, onions, chili peppers and celantro. Not beans and rice with few traces of meat and egg. Never ever go here if you want authentic Mexican.

Had the misfortune of needing a new battery, lead to a journey through the joys of car ownership but it was a true pleasure doing business with Lenny and all the guys at United Tire Paoli. Picked my car up for me while I was at work (I work in the area) and finished by the time I was done with work. We got the wrong size battery the first time (only because the car wasn't with us) and it was swapped out without a problem. Coming back for all my car needs while I'm still living in the area. Truly amazing and commendable service!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We were staying in a hotel and got daily flyers for this place, we decided to try it. When we called to order the guy was rude and extremely abrupt, didn't even tell us a total or estimated delivery time. When we got our order it was far from what we ordered. We ordered a large cheese pizza, a 2 liter of Dr Pepper, and a 2 liter of Coke. We received a pathetic pizza with very little cheese, a 2 liter of diet cherry Dr Pepper, and a 2 liter of sam's choice cola. It took over an hour to get to us, the pizza was cold and the soda warm. I suggest you pick elsewhere for your pizza and avoid being ripped off like we were.

Just went through drive thru and our sirloin bacon burger came without bacon. I took it back in after my boyfriend took a bite and they took it back over the counter (pretty sure that's not legal) and the cook added cold bacon to it and gave it back. Not only that but he didn't change his gloves either so whoever gets their burger next is getting my man's germs on their food, yucky! Unacceptable, especially since the person that handled the complaint was a manager! What happened McDonald's? This never would've flown back in the day.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I'm a regular at their pharmacy, because I can practically walk to this Publix and I need a pharmacy nearby. Other than a mom and pop pharmacy up in NY, I have to say hands down, this is the best pharmacy I have ever used. I've used CVS, Walgreens, Walmart....there is absolutely no comparison to this pharmacy. Eleni is awesome, she reaches out to you from behind the counter to make sure everything is ok and even makes suggestions. Nikki is great,too. Everyone I have dealt with there is great, Nikki and Eleni just stand out to me. Highly recommend, you will be pleased with the service you receive.

New to the area looking for a tasty breakfast. So glad I stopped here!! I was greeted warmly & seated right away. My server was funny & helpful when I asked for recommendations. My omelette was just right. Potatoes were so yummy, & the side of pancakes was truly delicious. I haven't eaten pancakes in years & I can't stop thinking of them. I left half of my food cuz I was stuffed. Priced are so reasonable & I learned all about Golden Boy bakery out of Kansas City where they get their pies. Can't wait to go back! Really great find.

We stopped for breakfast and walked out 40 minutes later to go to a Waffle House.  They served us coffee and were pleasant.  After the coffee was gone and we still didn't have any food we started asking questions.  We found that the restaurant had reopened and it was our waitress' first day on the job. There was a malfunction in the kitchen so they couldn't cook our food. And why they didn't tell us that no food would be coming? I thought they would have worked out these kinks before they reopened.    I wouldn't go back.

If I could, I would give this motel zero stars. We stayed for a total of 5 minutes before we checked out. When we walked in to our smoke free room, it stunk of smoke, there was an ash tray, and there were cigarette burns in the bedding. There was a red stain on the floor and a fresh red stain on the wall. Our door was dented like it'd been punched and kicked. The door frame next to the dead bolt was broken and "fixed" with caulk! We did not feel safe there. They tried to tell me they couldn't give me a refund and tried to charge me for the first night, even though we were there 5 minutes! Just don't stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Ate here with friends while in town for Christmas. I remember when the location housed a Popeyes so I wasn't expecting much. But man oh man. I could have eaten a vat of the oyster artichoke soup.  My friend's husband who doesn't care for artichoke orders it regularly. I ordered a pizza and it was just as I like it, oily with that great cheese. Husband had the lasagna and scarfed it down.  Place was comfortable and low key. And I almost forgot, the bread pudding was spoon sucking good. Next time we visit New Orleans again we're going back.

SAVE YOUR MONEY. This establishment is horrible. We decided to dine-in because the restaurant had 4 stars on yelp. Little did we know, the food took over an hour to arrive and when it did, it was cold and tasteless. We had to ask multiple times for anything. The worst part of it all was the fraudulent act that our server pulled on us, because of the horrible service we decided not to leave a tip. When we got home from our trip, we were charged an extra $14, meaning that the server wrote in her own tip. We called the establishment and were told they would investigate and give us a call back, no call or charge back was ever received.

We had never been to VCA and today we had to take our 16 year old family member in to be euthanized.
