I have to give many thanks and deep gratitude to every member of the staff at this office for their kindness, attentiveness, professionalism and most of all their empathy.  Dr.  Brunner went above and beyond to ensure that everything was done in the best interest of our pet. She was so kind and careful and we cannot thank her and her staff enough. We were given as much time as we needed with our pet before and after.  Thank you all for helping us through this heart wrenching task.

They are the best of the cheap car rental places that we've been to over the years.  They don't attempt to do the bait & switch to get you to upgrade to the more expensive car, and are very up front about their extras pricing.  The cars have always been clean and with very low mileage.

During a recent trip, the other driver I registered was hospitalized the very same day, and we fully expected a fight to get them to take her off the contract so we didn't have to pay for a driver that physically was unable to do so.  There was no problem at all!

We'll gladly use them again and again!

We use to like the place.  Good food and good price (interior needs a lot of help).  Recently we brought a party of 4 and a long dark hair was on our blonde friends pizza. The waitress said sorry and replaced the slice, but GROSS!  It was no big deal to her so it makes you wonder what goes on behind the scenes.  Most restaurants the manager would at least come over and apologize, maybe comp. the slice.  We were all disappointed that they cared so little.
Update, my husband called the owner Staurt who was very apologetic, asked if we would come back.  We are just to grossed out to do that. At least the owner seems to care, shame about the staff.

This was the worst hotel I have stayed in in a long time. Ended up there by courtesy of American Airlines due to a missed connection. Got there at 10 to learn the restaurant was closed even though the website says 12. So no food to have. My first room had a carpet that was so dirty I did not want to take of my shoes. Got a new room and went to bed as there was nothing else to be done. Wake up to have breakfast and they let me know that breakfast can be bought in their little store so I guess a bar or a bag of chips is they're understanding of breakfast. Went back to my room but then the keys don't even work. I will never go back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Best sushi we have ever had. I love this place and when I lived in the area while at ucsb we came here at least once a week. Vinh became like a second mom and would always take the time to chat while we were there. Bf and dad are sushi snobs and they both agree this place is the best. I love the shrimp dragon roll personally while they favor the albacore and salmon sushi. Whenever we are in the area, we always stop by for amazing sushi at reasonable prices. Wish this place was closer to home because I really miss it!

I'll never be back to Edomasa after tonight, I'm glad I found Sushi Teri House after leaving Edomasa for not being served. 

Much better service. Warmer more welcoming staff. Quality sushi
My boyfriend and I had a terrible experience tonight 
On top of often feeling like they don't want to serve me. 

Like I said, never going back. As a local, I appreciate places that welcome me and want us to return. Date night is a big deal and often in Santa Barbara we feel like we're not welcomed or wanted... 
Kao our server at sushi Teri was amazing. Go there!

This place is soooo good! It's definitely a local restaurant and the owner even told us they don't get many white people in- but don't let that scare you! Everyone is nice and although our original waitress spoke no English, the owner came to explain the menu and how to eat foods that we have Americanized! The kids and I had tacos- some chicken, some ground beef- with a side order of shredded cheese and their usual cilantro and onion! I am usually "lots of cheese and sour cream" and had neither here! I ate it all the Mexican way and am hooked!! Glad we took the chance!!

You can't do apartment hunting on a hot and humid day without some ice cream so of course I had to find a cool and unique place to try in the area instead of the practical dairy queen. Stumbled across this small joint on yelp and had to check it out because I cannot pass up custard! I got the coffee bean blizzard, my mom got the chocolate pretzel, and my roommate got the mint chocolate chip. My coffee bean one came in on top! FYI they are not actually called blizzards but since I'm behind on writing this review I cannot remember their take on them. I will be coming back for more when I move to Missouri in 2 weeks!

STAY AWAY !!
THIS IS THE WORST EXPERIENCE I'VE EVER HAD!!!
I booked this hotel thinking I got a 4 star hotel paid almost 200$ a night 
Step in and was extremely disappointed.
The elevator feels like it's about to collapse 
The rooms smell like mold 
The front desk lady was rude 
And when I told them I want to cancel 
10 min after I checked in they told me 
"We have a nun-cancellation policy "
And they didn't want to refund me even though I didn't stay there for more then 10 minuets !!
this hotel claimed to be a 4 star hotel 
If you consider this hotel you better take a motel 6
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This hotel was just ok. Not as nice as several other Courtyards I have stayed. Parking is valet only, $28/day. The inside of the building is an old molasses warehouse that was renovated into a hotel, which is kind of cool. However, the hotel layout is very awkward. Workout room is very small and hot. Small pool and hot tub, hot tub was out of order. The sink vanity in my room was extremely small. The tv signal was poor, took a while for the picture to set. The front desk staff was extremely courteous, especially Matt, the valet not so much.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Worst bank ever
Forgot my business checking debit card in the virtual atm. It was tur ed into the branch and Instead of calling me they closed it. Than they charged me $20 to expedite a card as I couldn't run my business without it for two weeks for standard delivery. 

I was told by melany (she was sure to spell her name) that if we wanted to close all of our business accounts (together we have 7) we could
 I asked her if it was worth Grow. Financial losing 7 business accounts over $20. She said rules were rules. 

Worst worst. Bank ever. 

I went ahead and paid the $20  will have all accounts closed by end of month.

The car was great and the people at the facility were friendly but appeared to lack management.  We waited 20 minutes in line to be checked in. Once our paper work was processed we were advise they were waiting for additional cars to be delivered and we would have to wait an additional 30 minutes.  The 30 minute wait was actually 50 minutes.  There was clearly a lack of management and communication.  It should not take over an hour to pick up a vehicle that was reserved in advance.  Our plane arrived on the scheduled time of 11:00 AM so why wasn't the reserved vehicle ready for us.

I can't believe the service that I just received at this Starbucks the employees are unprofessional and ratchet the girl that wears the scarf around her head threw my friends drink away and refused to make it she starting yelling and said she wasn't doing anything for him I was in disbelief and to top it off the manager just stood there and watched I couldn't believe that a Starbucks is allowing their employees to treat their guest that way I love the brand but this location is horrible and I will never return

Trash service. Dude checking us in was NOT happy to do it... and then the next day, we slept in, so I went to the front desk and ask that they have the cleaning staff go by (they were still there, just cleaning other rooms) and the front desk person was like "sure!"

Obviously we got back and it wasn't cleaned... at all. And when we called to be like "wtf", they were like "we can send up towels" - HELLA unapologetically.

As a hotel, it's obviously not terrible. Compared to other Marriotts I've stayed at, this place is garbage service-wise.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We love going here. Only been in the evening but the staff is vary friendly and prompt.  Never have trouble with waiting for a table or being greeted. Food comes out hot and taste really good. Breakfast Burger is very very good & pancakes are huge. Our servers are always on the ball with filling our drinks and cleaning the table. Bathrooms have always been clean. The best part I love about going here is how they have treated my two young children ( 5&2) one of which is autistic!  ( ps. We're not regulars but would love to if we lived closer)

I had to give a star to give a review, but just like everyone else was saying. The service is slow. It took my wife four minutes to get there and 35 minutes to get served. What a joke!!! DONT GO HERE!!! She got frosties for the family. Large ones and they filled it 2/3's but she was done and didn't bother saying anything. Avoid this place. It SUXX!! She said had never seen such slow service. No one was in a hurry at all. My wife actually said she was ready to ask for an apron to go in the back and help them. It took a girl 10 minutes to serve her 4 frosties.

I went to Dr. Putterman's office after seeing a number of recommendations of their office on Facebook. Their customer service and quality care superseded the already wonderful recommendations I had seen. They squeezed me in when I had lost my glasses and needed new ones ASAP. Communication via phone was always clear and friendly. Eye examination by Dr. Putterman was thorough, well-explained, and painless. Service from the receptionists in choosing glasses frames was understanding and respectful of my financial restraints. I cannot recommend this office more highly!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I'm sorry to have to leave a bad review but this place was extremely disappointing in terms of sushi quality and EXTREMELY overpriced. The entire meal for myself (ONE PERSON) was almost $40 after ordering one roll, 2 pieces of nigiri, and a California roll. The flavors were off and just left me wanting much more. They also need to be more transparent on pricing for the rolls as it's nowhere to be found on the menu, they don't tell you your total when you're calling in your order, and the receipt isn't itemized.

Not very happy. The woman who did my mani-pedi didn't ask me how I wanted my nails shaped, so she left them an ugly lopsided squarish shape instead of my natural rounded shape I originally had. Just cut them straight across and kinda filed them. They aren't even straight, so one side is rounded and the other is a rigid corner. Even my toenail edge is pointy. She rushed the massage part and even left the edges tagged. I didn't notice how bad they were until we were out the door. All of my other friends had much better experiences, but I don't think I'll go back again.

We just turned in our vehicle this morning. We had to drive 2&1/2 hours to drop off the car and thought we would make sure of where the drop off was before getting gas. Upon driving to the area, WE WERE DIRECTED TO drive up a drive way. We told the woman that we needed to get gas. To that she responded,  "Unfortunately, I've already checked you in and that will be $10.00 per gallon." The woman directed another car to pull up behind us so we couldn't leave. UNFORTUNATELY???!!! That was over $200.00!!!
THIS IS THEFT!!!

No Way I Will Think Smash Burger Is This Bad.

On Vacation & Thought I Would Pass Up Some Asian Cuisine For Smash Burger (Because I Never Been Before).

Why Did I Think I Should Try In Philadelphia? SMH. 

At An Airport At That. No Good. Not Good Quality Food.

I Can Understand If We Dealing With A "Rush Hour" Rush But I Was The Only Person On The Line. .

Over Priced Burgers & No Combo Meals To Accommodate.

Save Your Money & But Some Chinese At The Next Kiosk On The Right Or An Alcoholic Cocktail Till Your Next Destination. 

Good Luck

First, the parking situation SUCKS!!! they do have a self-parking lot that holds maybe 20 vehicles. You do have to pay for it, and it does fill up quick.  They have valet which is more; this is what most people are do because it is the only option left. (Unless you want to park in a shady, unmonitored lot.  The room was fine. The bed was comfy. The free breakfast was good. The hotel is non smoking. We walked to the saints game and to bourbon. Simple walk. Short distance to both. All in all, I would stay again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I'd really say 3 1/2 stars. Great....no, excellent pricing. Can't go wrong there considering how expensive everything else is in the South Meadows area. I haven't tried it all but I'm sure it's pretty good. What you'd expect from a reasonably priced taqueria. Only complaint is this...have some music going in there. It would cost less than $50 to get a decent stereo and to have a few speakers wired into that cavernous seating area. It's actually a little creepy how quiet it is in there. Give us a little ambiance please. Thanks for listening. 

PS-the chicharrón should be crispy and not a soggy mess. Won't be ordering that again.

My Black coat/jacket was stolen after I forgot it there! I went nowhere else that day.  Every time I go there I need to exchange my food because either the bread is stale or the sandwich was sitting there for a while.  I ask for a fresh pot of coffee and the manager looks at me twisted, It's always a fresh pot! Really? I know my coffee and I need freshly brewed coffee otherwise it bothers my stomach.  You shouldn't argue with customers and you should educate your employees not to steal customer's belongings, very disappointed!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If you have a conference at the Music City Center, you'll be very thankful for an escape route to coffee at Dunkin Donuts, which is on-site. Unfortunately, it's incredibly hard to find, even with Google Maps, because this DD is tucked away into a far-back, little-traveled corner of the convention center. It's tiny, so be ready for a little cramming in - then again, the staff more than makes up for the physical space with its friendliness and professionalism. I asked them to make my coffee a little cooler than usual and they were happy to oblige, asking me if they'd made it just right for me. Four stars for the service.

While the facilities are clean and inviting, the service is the exact opposite. My roommate and I came in, and had to wait for 5 minutes, even though there was a manager at the free register having a personal talk with a customer. We were willing to be patient, and then we we served. My roommates service was so-so; not great but not horrible. My service however was terrible. I asked for no onions and no blue cheese on a salad, the second manager looked at me and said, "the salads are pre-made, we can't do that." And while I found my money he had the worst attitude possible.

We are traveling from Oregon and stayed in Nashville for 3 nights. We walked everywhere we wanted to go. Even at 3:00am walking, no one bothered us. The hotel is very clean, good free breakfast. All the employees were nice and friendly.
Your only 2 blocks from Broadway where the bars/bands are. Very close to excellant food like The Stillery and Good eats and Bakersfield. We walked to the Ryman Grand Ole Oprey which was 4 blocks away and had a great time there. You are just 1-2 blocks from the Country Music Museum. You will enjoy this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We have been having a lot of issues with the AC sense we moved in. The one maintenance man Kevin fixed one of mine but didn't have time to complete the others he works in this building and that day by chance he was here. Three weeks later of trying to have the other AC fixed with appointments made and them not showing up. Finally we saw Kevin and had them send him Up now ALL of them are fixed. He went above and beyond to make sure that I was happy with our apartment. 

So happy to have people like Kevin that care so much about us being happy. If you like here ask for him when you need something.

Best membership fees in Santa Barbara!This 3-story gym has an elevator.  Weight,  machines, locker rooms and pool, jacuzzi & wet areas are in the basement floor The second floor is check in, and personal training area. The 3rd floor is cardio equipment  which is extensive. Staff is welcoming and professional. Weights and machines are extensive and well maintained. TVs in cardio area and gym. Pretty good selection of classes. 3 stars for consistently dirty men's locker room (floors, lockers, sinks, toilets, showers) and only somewhat clean co-ed jacuzzi, pool and wet areas.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The most pleasant and accommodating experience I have ever had. MJ at the front desk helped us find a room when my husband and I weren't able to get into our Airbnb very late on a Saturday night. The best customer service ever!! MJ went out of his way to bring us extra towels and toiletries because he knew we were having a rough night. The hotel itself is absolutely beautiful! The room was wonderful, great shower and comfortable bed! The lobby and restaurants are so majestic, it was such a luxury experience. If we're ever back in STL there is no doubt that this is where we will be staying.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I'm a Bus Driver Couldn't wait 2 get 2 my room. Got My keys And  2nd floor.  Carrying all my staff no elevators hallways very dark.  Going up the stairs walking to the room and there is some guy in the hallway and he had the nerve to ask are you by yourself can I come to your room. WTH. Get My room and its dirty. Lock Broken on door. Very unprofessional owner or manager very rude. Our company spend alot of money with this place. We didn't stay there after all. Placed smelled. You get what u pay for..... that part...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I placed an advance order for two dozen donuts and 25 munchkins. I picked up the order and brought it home only to find out it was wrong. I took it back to the store and the employee put the food back on the shelf to resell. When I asked if this was common practice the employee said he was instructed to do so by the manager. I spoke with the manager and got my money back. They did not take the donuts off the shelf. I have contacted corporate and department of health. While waiting for my refund I looked behind the counter when drinks are made and it was extremely dirty.

If they had minus stars I would give them ten of those. The worst customer service, the worst rental experience I have ever had. Had me sitting there for hours with minimal assistance, rudeness and emotional upsetting attitudes. The "manager" on-site was the most non customer service oriented person I have met which I believe should not only NOT be In Charge of resolving issues but should NOT be dealing with customers at all in general. 
They take forever to answer at a customer service 800 number that just reroutes you around and around. DO NOT RECOMMEND WASTING A SINGLE DOLLAR ON THEM ! Not worth the aggravation

Stay away from this place! I bought a brand new car, got a nail in a tire a week after. I ended up moving to NY and by NY law cars here need a safety inspection. They told me that the one tire different from the other three is all cracked up and could explode on the road!!! The brand new tire they installed for me didn't pass the safety inspection! When I called them they said sorry!! "I opted out of all warranties" it's such a shame how some people lack of conscience!! I paid a full price for a brand new tire "supposedly" and deserved a better service let alone honesty! I cannot find words
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We stopped in an hour before close for a bite to eat. We got seated right away and our waitress was very friendly, she was also the bartender and the hostess which impressed me. We got ice waters right away along with fried wheat wheels as a free snack, they were very good and addicting! I ordered a strawberry Ixcarita, which is their version of a margarita. It was pretty good. It was $2 taco night so I ordered a taco and also a tamale. The food came out quick. The taco was good and the tamale was awesome! I'm glad we stopped in. The prices are very reasonable and the food here is great, I'll definitely go back!

I never post reviews really and I liked this place until today. I waited for 30 minutes just to finally sit down. A lady started doing my nails and halfway threw she said sorry she had to leave and left. I thought umm.. okay? Then 10 minutes later a man starts doing my nails. He was nice and all but wasn't paying attention to me. He took an hour to shape my nails and filed them so much I said stop and he didn't hear me and by then there's blood everywhere. That's my finger in the picture.. 12 hours later. Seriously messed up and still made me pay.

Nice room. Good location. Rooftop pool is cool. The people at reception were very kind and helpful. However the woman who is the hostess / waitress (or something) in the restaurant is horribly rude. She should not be working in the hospitality business. I don't care how bad of a day you are having , there is no reason to talk to other people like they are pieces of shit. Everyone else in the restaurant was commiserating on her attitude. Normally this wouldn't be that big of a deal to me but considering we were only there one night and there is almost no where to eat in center city after 10pm, it was an issue. Anddddd we didn't eat.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It should be ZERO star rated! AVOID this place! Worst experience ever! Ordered a $5 pure vanilla cone, waited about 40 mins!!!! The taste is no difference as macdonald $2 vanilla Sande! Whoever is the Owner please hire more staff if you want to continue your business! Furthermore, please cancel your automatic 15% tip selection at your debit machine! That's nonsense for a fast food store to charge 15% tip with such unorganized and slow service. When you press other to avoid giving a tip it prompts you again for 15% tip.

Animal medical center has been my vet office for a few years. They're excellent! I highly recommend them. 

When my kitty was having urinary issues and I'd already spent a lot of money at banfield, the AMC was able to figure it out quickly! All that was needed was the incorporation of wet food and she's been fine ever since! The doctor even called us on a Saturday with the test results. It made me feel like they really care. 

They also take good care of my dog who has anxiety.  They have the patience to gently handle her while cutting her nails. 

They're all around awesome!

I live on the street--I would NEVER order from here after seeing the way the employees handle themselves and that kitchen. 

The kitchen doors in the back alley are always open, allowing for roaches and god knows what else to come inside. I have never seen the staff wearing gloves, only drinking and playing dice in the back alley and worst of all is how incredibly RUDE these people are to their neighbors... 

This could be the best Mexican food in the city and I still would NEVER eat food from this place. Go to Blue Corn, which is probably a three minute walk from here... TEN TIMES BETTER!

Want some generic, run of the mill, inoffensive Japanese cuisine? You've come to the right place! If you're REALLY REALLY REALLY in the mood for sushi and some rolls, this place is serviceable. If you actually want great food, then you may want to search elsewhere.

Does all the food blend into one giant same bland flavor? Kinda. Are the rolls chock full of imitation crap meat instead of the real yummy stuff? Mostly. Am I disappointed that I spent $70 and threw most of the food away? Definitely.

Don't worry. If you lower your expectations, you'll be just fine!

Stayed here with a buddy for the weekend (june 3-5) we had a late check-in (9pm) but everything went smooth as can be. The staff was really friendly always with a smile on their face which is nice to see. Our room was a double bedroom it was clean and spacious we had a mini fridge that didn't really cool that well but it's o.k. we didn't really use it. The room also came with a coffee maker and a LG flat screen t.v. this hotel is in a great location just a block from canal st and a few more from the French Quarter i will definitely stay here again when i come back to NOLA.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I absolutely will not be back. Took my family tonight and ordered two ice creams and a milkshake for $24. Wouldn't be terrible except for it was literally Kroger brand ice cream with a couple of crushed Oreos on top. They told me they couldn't mix them in. I could have bought four tubs of Kroger brand ice cream for $8. Complete rip off! The two girls working were extremely rude and she literally dropped a scoop of ice cream between her pants and the table, picked it up, and put it in the cup. I should have avoided when I saw the thee star review but really wanted to be proven wrong.

I normally stop by a nearby Wendys on 34th Street N (which has a great staff), but thought we would try this closer to home one. 
We didn't experience anything close to what was previously discussed in reviews. 
We were cheerfully greeted, the order was assembled in less than 5 minutes. It was correct and properly cooked.
If I had not read the reviews, I probably would not have posted. The experience was normal for a fast food chain, but just wanted to post a recent experience for ownership customers to ponder.

Great hotel! Everything was great. The front desk staff was extremely friendly and helpful. The room was very modern and very clean. 

The bed was comfortable, the pillows we weren't a fan of. They looked nice and big when you first lay on them but the quickly get flat and soft. The AC gave us some issues with getting it to stay at the temp we wanted, we kept waking up warm having to turn it back on. But when it gets cold, it gets cold!  
 
We had a great stay, the location is perfect close to so many restaurants. The only thing that we caught ourselves saying was we wish it had a pool or spa! Will definitely be back!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Wonderfully cozy and friendly place for dinner and drinks, featuring varied musicians--light jazz, soft rock, and top 40 inside-- and great rock and roll on the patio on Saturday.  Wait staff is hard working and attentive, though the crowd can overwhelm them on Friday night.  Lynn, the owner, is usually there pitching in with parking, waiting tables and generally being gracious to the loyal patrons. 

Food is delicious and moderately priced.  My favorites are the steak sandwich and shrimp and grits dinner. If you like to dance and mingle, try Friday night inside and you may become part of the advertised ambiance!

Cute decor, filled with whimsy. Unfortunately there is an overwhelming smell of old, sale cheese and an array of filth. Dirty napkins on the floor, used forks on the tables and crumbs everywhere. I ordered a drink, as I still needed my one cup o' coffee. A simple latte, yes?... $5 for 12 ounces of foamed milk and not a tinge of coffee taste. Politely I asked if it was made with espresso and was told, "yes, one shot". I beg to differ. With a name including the word coffee, they are perfectly content serving "coffee" for an egregious price and don't even care if it is packing the quality to match.

Very clean and nice staff. We walked in and greeted nicely by desk person. We had no reservation. Made reservation on spot at same low price as on other internet sites. It snowed and they had walks clean with salt down. Nice room and friendly staff. Had trouble with tv that someone unplugged. Very good breakfast food hot and still had plenty by 10 am. Just low on coffee and sausage gravy. Bonus would have been make your own waffles like others, but can't complain about price, only $109 plus taxes for a king bed. Would stay again. 1st time at an express. Even friendly upon leaving in the morning with our bags.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Checkout at 11. My family was in dire need of an extra two hours and I tried to explain the situation, but was told late checkouts are discouraged and we'd be charged $50 for a noon checkout or a full night's rate for any time beyond that. An inflexible and incredibly greedy policy given that the hotel is not at all full. I was told I would hear from management about my complaint, but no emails or calls came. A terrible way to treat loyalty members in particular, but I feel sorry for anyone in a tough situation who needs any help or understanding from this hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: *update* thank you for replying via Yelp a full year later, but for some reason my work orders are being marked as "solved" without anyone coming to fix anything so obviously there is some lack of communication. Your lovely paper towel fillers where the caulk should have been is still in place (except for my laundry room door. The paper towels gave way and the door fell and it STILL HASNT BEEN FIXED), my dishwasher is still broken, and I've had maintenance walk in my house UNANNOUNCED two more times since I made the original review (once when I was SLEEPING). I've called the office, like you suggested, to no avail.

I have to say this place is losing money. Took us 10 minutes to get seated, 8 tables had dirty dishes on them and during our lunch 4 of those tables remained dirty. Multiple couples and families walked away because of the wait, with multiple empty tables. Drink glasses were filthy dirty, service was slow, 20 mins sitting to just get bread. Salad came out after main course, had to ask for the salad it was forgotten. I had the chicken Alfredo, not much sauce on noodles at all had to ask for more sauce. I have ate here in previous years, this place ya gone down hill!!

Horrified. I used to go to this local ovation 3x day or more (having a son with autism he only eats nuggets and fries). I've been a customer to Chalfont's location for 26 years. After Yesterday I made my decision to never go  again. Not only did they get my order wrong, she still refused to correct it after two attempts of explaining why it was wrong. She simply didn't care and was trying to hand me the bag. I have tried calling many times to speak to the owner however they do not answer the phones. I refuse to spend another dollar at this location. I'm so disappointed and will drive out of my way to never spend my $ here!!!!!!!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I have complete confidence in this animal hospital.  They truly love what they do.  We brought our English Bulldog here as soon as we rescued her years ago n felt comfortable right away.  

Bulldogs are not the average dog n they understand that n r familiar with them.  Very important for any pet parents, especially Bully's. 

We recently took advantage of their dental month specials.  I was petrified having her knocked out. Dr Ligori n the entire staff were very understanding of my concerns n did everything to set me at ease.  It meant a lot to me.  

I would recommend them to anyone.  Great service n knowledge.

We arrived about 7 pm Tuesday . We wanted a booth, none were available , we asked can we sit at the bar and wait for a booth. We were told yes. We each ordered one drink at bar and hostess said we have a half booth half chair, we said that was fine . She said she needed to clean the table. We ordered another drink, and finished them. Now 7:40. We decided to leave and told hostess forge about our table . She followed us out and said we were waiting for you... how are you waiting for m ? It's your job to sit us. I don't know where to sit without help from
Hostess. If they don't want our business, we will go someone which we did .

After reading many 5 stars for Anthony, I called and booked an appointment with him and he exceeded my expectations! He was so kind, friendly, and really did quality work. He took his time and gave a wonderful, lengthy massage! Also, when I couldn't decided on a gel look I wanted for a manicure, he did his best to recreate it for me to get an idea before we started. I really appreciated that from the get-go and the rest of the experience just got better and better! I'll definitely be a returning customer of Anthony's!

Beautifully, tastefully decorated suites with outstanding service.  The staff has been cordial and efficient in filling requests. I highly recommend their accommodation's whether for a night or extended stay. Sadly, no swimming nor the exercise room are allowed due to COVID. Staff is also taking the pandemic seriously for guests to enjoy their stay. After about a ten day stay, I can add that being able to do laundry for free, outside of purchasing the high priced detergent ($2 per load) not having working machines was a huge issue! They had only four working washers out of seven, and only TWO DRYERS for All the guest's.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very crooked nails, can barely see the design on my ring finger and wasn't filed down very well the sides are still pretty sharp. First time there and won't be going back. My sisters nails were messed up also. The acrylic was caked on so they look super fake. Bubbles in the acrylic and they didn't make us wash our hands after the filing and buffing so we had the white stuff was in the nail polish. Polish also isn't even and each nail wasn't covered completely by the fake nail. So you can still see part of my real nail

Pretty disappointing considering its in santa barbara. Machines are never thoroughly cleaned. The cleaning lady just wipes of t seat and display. Im pretty sure the brushed aluminum walls have never been wiped down. Dont look up at the ceiling!! Its disgusting, especially in the bottom floor where t weights are. Bathrooms are also disgusting.  Beyond the dead skin everywhere, they're upgrading the cardio machines :) and they have a nice freemotion calf machine. For being a sport its lacking upgraded weight machines but they need to fire the cleaning staff
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: The hotel staff was super accommodating and let us change our check in and check out times on the spot. They also stored our luggage for us no cost so we could do some exploring after checkout/before our airport shuttle got there. I was worried it was going to be crazy loud, but we were in a courtyard facing room and you couldn't hear the bourbon st noise unless you were on the balcony. It's a perfect location for walking anywhere and despite how crazy (and fun!) bourbon st is, the hotel felt very secure/safe.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The counter host were down right rude, checked in the day before, confirming our reservation, received a confirmation for our 11:00 arrival...the hostess was a bitch and extremely rude, said"I don't know when your room will be available so come back later.....when would that "I don't know! So a hotel with 450+ rooms a state of the art checking online service can't find a room or offer coat check service? What a joke, oh and by the way the windows aren't clean, the glue on the wallpaper is still visible everywhere and the drywall mud is still on the window mullions! Maybe they had to get open since Skanska took so long.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We stopped in for a drink in the lobby. It wasn't crowded. We waited 15-20 mins as our server passed by several times and never acknowledged we were there. I finally got his attention and he  stuck a finger up as if to say, "wait a minute" then disappeared behind the bar. After several more minutes, we finally gave up and left. There were 6 of us so it would have been a sizable tab, and for the amount charged per cocktail we expected better service. Also, our table had not been cleaned from the previous patrons and the tab was still laying on the table.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
One start for 2 things - running water and structural stability.
Everything else were poor or downright bad. Carpet was unclean, there was grime and hair (pets/humans???) everywhere. Looked like the housekeeping staff wanted nothing to do with house keeping. There was even an opened cheetos packet lying next to the bed. The entier floor had a musty smell, probably from not being vacuumed for a long time and all the smoking in the rooms. Bathrooms were ill equiped with soap and shampoo. We had to go down to the front desk and request some. 
I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. Please stay away.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: What a missed opportunity this place had.  An annual event that gathered 80 of us together, and they managed to make every one of us swear to never go back.  Slow service, food was incorrect, but the topper was literally waiting an hour to get the checks sorted.  Unapologetically mostly. The owner acted like she couldn't care less about the issues. Seriously, we had two food options (spaghetti and fettuccini) and they were served family style. How could processing tickets be so difficult? Get your stuff together Milano, you've been around a long time but these kind of experiences will make sure that doesn't continue. We won't be returning.

Been a national/emaerald club member for 17yrs. Had several issues with thos location. 1st was the lack of emerald aisle selections. Only 3 cars, two camrys and a hyundai. There were plenty of other cars in the truck/suv and executive areas and they should have put some in the emerald aisle like other locations do. Also had an issue on check out (1st time ever) where the attendant could not print out my receipt. I had to go the counter to get it resolved. Nothing major, but not on par with LA and other locations.

I was looking to get a quick burger and stumbled across BurgerFi on UberEats. We ordered two burgers for $31.75 (quite expensive for just two burgers, no sides or drinks). I was disappointed at first glance as they looked squished and messy, but boy, the taste sure made up for it! Without a doubt the best beyond burger I've ever had (and I've been vegetarian for nearly 5 years). It was juicy and full of flavor. My friend said his double cheeseburger was quite good as well. When I finished mine I almost wished I had ordered two!

If you need glasses take heed in my warning DO NOT USE NATIONWIDE 
on Oracle and Wetmore. The 1st pair 
of glasses I got from them, both lenses fell out after 1 year so SSDI
who insures me sent me back there 
once again. After ordering a new pair 
I went back to pick them up and they said they couldn't find them, drove home and just when I sat down they called me and said they found them
I wouldn't recommend that store 
to anybody I like. I posted this review 
and somebody asked me to go to a website, all I got was a carwash HA
I should have known
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The staff was nice , courteous  and professional. Unfortunately they did not have the car  I had reserved.  In the luxury class the website list's Cadillac and Lincoln (or equal  ) . Upon arrival to pick up my car they had a Chrysler available, not exactly what I had expected but with no time to go elsewhere I either accepted the car or canceled my plans ( which wasn't really an option )  The car was ok but not in the same class as what I had expected.  They had 3 days to have the correct car available and promised to do better next time.  We shall see.

Service was unbelievably slow. Ordered a drink, received it 25 minutes later. Ordered a second drink, another 25 minutes at least. The Mac & cheese was just Mac, no cheese in sight. Very bland. The Caesar salad didn't have Caesar dressing, but seemingly spritzed water or something drizzled on top. 'Twas not tasteful. The server was nice and helpful, and I'm sure she didn't have control over the slowness of drink/food delivery. The drinks were good. The food was subpar. I would go back solely for drinks on a slow, non-crowded evening and nothing else.

We rented a minivan for a long weekend.

Check in on the quick side.  Yay.
Drivers - mixed reviews.  On the way there, took forever for a Dollar van to show up and get us, and the driver was no help whatsoever in loading our large suitcases.  On the return trip, we had the nicest guy ever who found out our terminal and helped with the bags.
Inspector at exit gate - not a nice lady.  MAKE SURE YOU INSPECT YOUR CAR BEFORE LEAVING THE LOT.  EVEN TAKE PICTURES.  That is your one chance to contest any preexisting scratches/dents.  We had a big one, and the lady wouldnt even get off her chair to look at it.  Then she barely documented it.

This is my favorite McDonald's in the area. They are the only ones who get our meals right the first time. I always order unsweetened tea and 4/5 times at other places it's wrong, but here they always get it right. They remember sauces. I rarely get cold fries here. I don't know what this location is doing differently, but I appreciate it. Here's to hoping they keep up the good work! 4 stars because it is a bit slower than other locations and we have come across a few employees who just aren't very friendly.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Recently stayed here at Oxford Suites on our way back to Washington. When we checked in, we were given 2 drink tickets and breakfast buffet tickets. The gentlemen at the bar that night was super friendly. The beds are super comfy. The breakfast buffet was AMAZING, so many options from fresh eggs, potatoes, ham, pastries, fruit, etc. 

Bonus, this hotel is within walking distance to the Boise Spectrum where we ate dinner that night. Parking in the front and tons in the back for bigger vehicles (like U Haul's).

I will most definitely be staying here again if we are ever in Boise!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I decided to go here for a quick bite of sushi and fried rice. I ordered a crunchy roll and the shrimp fried rice. once I started eating the crunchy roll, I discovered a long strand of hair in it. once the server came around I informed them and they denied it to be their hair. I had to actually pull it out of the crunchy roll to show her that it was in there when I received it. The management wasn't very helpful since they claimed it wasn't the chefs hair, but could have possibly been a servers hair that may have landed on the plate. Overall, besides the poor customer service and the hair issue, the food was decent but I will not be returning.

After reading all the horrible reviews for Thrifty, I almost cancelled my reservation.  However I usually book two car rentals and I figured I could always go to another counter.

I arrived mid morning and all car rental counters were not busy in Tampa.  I was greeted by someone at Thrifty right away.  Overall she was very friendly and continued to be polite as she tried to upsell and I had declined most options.

For those concerned about being overcharged, you just need to carefully review all screens on the touchpad and verify estimated costs.

At least for me I would rent from them again.  Our Toyota minivan was great.

My husband & I stayed here, we travel for a living so we stay at a lot of these hotel's, we have 2 Vehicle's so when we pulled in, it was tight, also a construction crew was parked out there and inside having lunch, while we took out luggage and went to drop off one car cane back to lobby and get the other Vehicle the manger was there looking for us, to yell at me and tell me it was there  busiest  time of day, between 1 & 3 and get our 2013 Chevy 3500 out of there!!!!!! He spit on my lip, and was so rude we will never stay there again!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
WOW! 
What a great find! 
super location, great atmosphere, excellent service and AMAZING food. 

Went with 4 people and we split the following : 
mushroom risotto (good), 
asparagus risotto (excellent), 
caesar salad (excellent), 
lamb (OMG), 
spaghetti carbonara (WOW), 
Chicken Marsala (good - very light - no cream), 
sunchoke chips (sound weird - very good), 
and tiramisu ( the presentation  is as delicious as the dessert itself).  
and a crap load of a wonderful bordeaux wine. 

Hey man.... there were 4 of us! We can eat a lot!

Stanley the manager is super and the chef Michael comes around to greet customers. 

YOU MUST GO!

I lived here for 2 years and it was really great, thanks to Felipe (manager) and the maintenance staff. Felipe is patient, friendly, organized, and always there to answer your questions/concerns. Maintenance requests are processed quickly and things are usually fixed on the same day I submit a request. 

Overall, the studio apartments are clean, quiet, fully furnished, and has a bus stop in front of the gate. Rent is month to month which gives you flexibility. If these things are also important to you, then I would definitely recommend living here. From what I remember, the waitlist is long so apply asap. Thanks again Felipe!

Crosswynde need to renovate all their Apartments, but I guess they plan to by overcharging for the old condos and once you move out they inflate any cleaning prices! I've tried to reach out to them several times about a bill I received after my move out they won't speak to me and they FORGED a move in inspection form that I completed. Please take pictures of every inch of the apartment before moving in and when moving OUT
Keep copies of all emails sent to them because they will complete FRAUD when you leave! Thank God for emails I can prove I had items that need to be fixed at move in

I went here with a Living Social coupon.  2 adults, 2 school age kids.  It was a Saturday night around 6:30 PM on a college campus.  (There was only 1 other table occupied.)  OK, its pizza, how bad can it be?  I didn't think it was horrible, but my husband and two kids did. My kids didn't even want to take home the left over pizza.  My son commented that school pizza was better.  In reality, it was not horrible, everything was edible, but there is no reason to choose this place.  The food was no better than making pizza and pasta at home.

An Italian restaurant where I felt like we had to beg for bread.  I ordered spaghetti bolognese and got spaghetti with a couple of meatballs.  The meatballs were terrible however, the homemade spaghetti and sauce were decent.  If you go, don't go on a hot day- air conditioning was either not working or completely inefficient.  Could have been offset with a couple of cocktails but service was terrible and server never checked in on us after we ordered.

Our $240 bill was not worth it.  There are some really great restaurants in Doylestown...don't pick this one.

I got a fabulous Name your own price on Priceline! 
Pros: location in the French Quarter, big rooms, comfy beds,   Cons: funny smoky smell, location in the busy loud French Quarter, outside rooms a bit loud, a little shabby around the edges. We were moved to an inside room that opened onto the courtyard and loved it. It is Shabby Chic. If I wanted Chic I would have spent $300 a night and stayed next door at the Ritz.
Virginia at the front desk, Miss Denise in housekeeping and Darryl in the clock bar were great. Loved it!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very clean and nice but bad paint jobs ... I went in got service right away. She did a very good job with the shape and length but the acrylic paint was messy as well as the gel nail polish, I was not pleased with that. You could definitely tell that she was rushing. But my friend had another lady and there was no gel around her finger nails and it looks really nice but She was asking her if the shape was OK if the color was OK but mine said nothing to me was I could tell she didn't care for my opinion about how I felt about them.

Very convenient location next to the airport.  No need for shuttle, just a short walk out the front door of the airport lobby to the rental cars.  Quick, easy checkout.  I love being able to pick my own car.   On this trip there was a problem with the first car (charging outlet had a blown fuse) that was not detected until we were 2 hours away.  We called the 1-800 number and was told that National, Enterprise and Alamo were affiliated.  We went to an Enterprise in Knoxville and they switched us into a bigger, better vehicle within  a few minutes.  Very Hassle free.  I will definitely use Alamo again.

Tried to order a nice fancy cake for my husbands birthday and it was CRAP! He had gastric surgery so is unable to eat carbs (including cake) so I asked for them to make a cookie crust for an ice cream cake. They acted surprised which I wondered why an oreo crust was so hard for them. The crust on the cake was all crumbs that brushed away when you cut it. My husband loves M&M so I asked for a mix-in ice cream (like a blizzard I said which I guess pissed them off) This cake looked like it had 4 M&M's in the ice cream. HORRIBLE for $30. never again! Have pics to prove it!

Very old motel,bunch of fast food places nearby, which is good,but also 3 adult night clubs, homeless people, not a safe place to be. We stayed one night, before the cruise,free breakfast was the worst I saw,when we came, no food was there, except for white bread,black water,that they call coffee and two packets of instant oatmeal. I came to the front desk,the young Afr.Amer. female was looking at the phone,I asked if anyone can add breakfast things,she slowly got up,and brought some muffins and filled the milk jar. Pathetic. Should be ashamed. Not worth $81.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Well, I'm not thoroughly disappointed... the pizza is good. I've only eaten here for the first time last night, and I wasn't used to the theme of the restaurant. It's really for hipsters. Small and quaint. The restaurant is self seating, self-serve, and self clean. I just wish the person at the front counter would have been so kind as to be more informative about that cause I definitely didn't know about the self cleaning part. Its no problem, but I just would have liked to be told up front. So I'm here to tell you that... otherwise, its ok.

My car was vandalized and many items taken from. Marriott only called the police on my behalf. Marriott failed to provide a safe environment for me and their guests. There were no cameras or security. The staff and management after the incident were less than helpful telling me everything would be handled by the corporate claims department. To add insult to this matter I was charged for my stay. Marriott denied the claim, which was within their legal right not accepting responsibility for this event. Based upon the very poor handling of this matter I will not be staying at this or any Marriott property again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I've rented from budget a lot over the years but this location is Deptford has some very rude employees
My last straw was renting a vehicle that smelled like smoke and they had the nerve to charge me for the smell at the end of my rental! Every car I rent from them I always take to the car wash, this time I didn't because I was in a rush due to the fact that I was moving out of town, they never clean those vehicles good, so they charged me a 250$ cleaning fee! One that I can guarantee they charged the person that rented it before me. The way they speak to their customers is reprehensible!

seeing a lot of negative reviews but fortunately, I didn't go through what most people did here. biggest complaint was that the room smelt weird. Front desk worker was SUPER friendly, very helpful & went above & beyond to make sure we got what we needed. It's not a resort, not a 4 star hotel, it's a relatively well maintained motel. We didn't get new toilet paper, but that and the smell were the only things that were mildly disappointing. The light switches in 130 don't really work, you have to turn the lights on manually. Boo hoo. Also it's like 2 minutes from the airport!! (Just a heads up, an Uber is cheaper than the shuttle)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've started working downtown & am spending a lot of time there.  Lunch has been both good & bad so far.  A co-worker and I went to Five Guys on Thursday and I don't think we'll be going back.  The help looked dirty and couldn't have been more disinterested in their work.  The restaurant itself was dirty, with homeless all throughout the seating areas.  The french fires we ordered were actually good (that got the 2nd star) but the sandwiches were both poor.  

There's so many choices downtown and it'll take a while to try them all.  We've likely been to Five Guys for the last time.

I am sooo disappointed in the food and service in this place tonight. I'm visiting from out of state and heard so many great things but from the beginning, our waiter was not the friendliest, our bread was cold so you could t really enjoy the flavored butter, our crab cheeecake was way too cheesy and it was mush. I ordered the linguini w clams which stayed was in a white wine sauce, but when it came it was drenched in red tomato sauce. I picked at it and just couldn't eat much of it, it was not good at all. Extremely disappointed. My visit to Philly has been amazing, and i will definitely be back, just not to Toscana....

We found Skillet's while trying to avoid chain restaurants, and had a very good experience.  Unlike other reviewers, we found one of the owners who waited on us to be very friendly.  The food is excellent, abundant, and reasonably priced.  Equally impressive was the iced tea for $.99 when so many restaurants gouge customers on drinks.  Sorry we don't live closer, but we will stop again when traveling through to visit relatives in Clarksville, TN.  The hours of operation are incorrect on YELP.  They are M - Th, 11 AM - 7 PM, and F & Sat, 11 AM - 8 PM.

Went to get a haircut from the manager (Abe) and was very unimpressed with the service and professionalism in this place. The manager kept going on his phone while cutting my hair and seemed to be in a huge hurry even though there was NO one waiting for a cut after me. Must really want that smoke break... 

Paid for a beard lineup and haircut, and he barely touched my beard and had uneven cuts on my head which I had to get fixed from another barber who was also very shocked.

Would never recommend. Worst experience ever, would expect more from a manager.

I went in after acquiring insurance up to the point of getting contacts everything was ok. The doctor is cold and uncaring. It feels like she is too busy or doesn't want to be there. After wearing my contacts for a week I went in to finalize  my contact prescription. I told her that I could not see the print on my phone nor could I read any print! She told me to get reading glasses. The whole point for the contacts was to not have to wear glasses throughout the day! I found another doctor. I will not go back nor will I recommend her to anyone, ever!!!!!
Monica  E. Diamos
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The worst!!! My first time here at Nashville and this place makes me never want to eat out again. Waited over an hour for food, when they weren't even busy.  When 2 out of 5 of us got the food it was cold. Also, most of the tables were dirty and nobody cleaned a table when we were there. Waitress would be better off working as a Wal-Mart greeter. Told her multiple of times we are unhappy, this is not great service, what is going on, etc. Never got an explanation of what is going on. Even the manager didn't do much to make us stay when we were leaving. Save yourself the trip and buy some some noodles and sauce to make at your air bnb.

This place is the epitome of just not giving a $h1+ I must have given it over 20 opportunities to change my opinion of it, but every time is worst than the last. Whether it's the sloppiest breakfast sandwiches ever served, or the simple coffee with cream and sugar they can't seem to figure out, I'm pretty confident this location is the skid mark Dunkin doesn't want you to know about. Unless you're in dire need of an improperly made coffee, slide south on Morris Bridge to the Dunkin' on Fletcher just west of i75.

Absolutely the worst customer service I have ever experienced. i ordered presc glasses and was told they would be ready in 2 weeks. Nobody called me until I went back 3 weeks later to find out they didn't have the frames in stock. I asked for a refund and they convinced me to get another frame for which they told me would be ready in one week. 2 weeks later I had to call again to check up on my order; for which they told me again that frame is unavailable. Will never shop here or any other Pearle Vision again! The absolute worst!!!!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
My husband and I spent 5 nights at this hotel. We were so impressed by the rooms, staff and location.  The rooms were clean and simple. The staff was always accommodating. They gave great recommendations about food and local attractions. The location is awesome. Great food and drink options all around. Parking was easy. I would recommend requesting a room on the quiet side of the hotel as there are a few bars next to the hotel who play music late into some nights. 
We will definitely be back if we return to Tucson.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If I could give 0 stars I would. I went for a nice relaxing pedicure, but the girl that did mine had NO clue how to do a pedicure. She did not even touch my heels, did not file my toenails and it is the worst polish job ever! I have to go pay again somewhere else to get another pedicure. Not to mention that they allowed this very loud annoying customer repeatedly make phone calls and do voice texts, and she kept taking her mask off!! NO ONE told her to put her mask back on. The worst part is she was sick or maybe allergies, so she kept wiping her snot on her pants!! Disgusted! Never again.

Would give 0 stars if it was an option. Drive through is a disorganized mess and the staff yells and cusses at you when they get your order wrong or bring your order to the wrong car. Manager does nothing. Staff yelling and talking under her breath for 5 minutes and no one did anything. They act like they want to fight customers whenever they get or bring out an order wrong, which I've learned from other reviews is more common than not. Restaurant is dirty inside. Never going back and especially never bringing children here.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I love that they got back to me right away but.... the mask thing below the nose. The workers need to order better masks for themselves to help with protection. Hopefully with the new order of mandatory masks the other customers may be asked to keep mask in. If they can't hear you speak up don't take your masks off. They also should wrap the control for massage chair between customers others wise you really need to have more Time between customers to clean better. I can see so many wrongs here. I am glad I was first in and fast out. I will go back after pandemic. I would give it higher stars than because I did like the employee I worked with.

Never going to this dunkin' again. One time my brother and I came here and ordered 2 frozen coffees, only to find out that after I drove away there was blended up pieces of plastic in both of our drinks, so we had to throw them away. Today I went there and drank about half of my coffee only to get a fly in my mouth that was buried inside of my drink. Almost threw up all of my breakfast and poured the rest down the drain. Clearly they don't pay attention to what they're doing and have some violations that come along with being careless.

Had a date night with my wife and daughter. Called late around 7:30 and they were able to work us in 15 mins which was very appreciated. Great food and nice wine selection and we always enjoy the atmosphere. Service has always been good, but this night it was exceptional and main reason for the review. Damian was our waiter, young, intergetic, super personality, and very attentive. He just moved from Chicago and new to his job, but you would think he had been doing this forever. Never waited for anything and could not have expected more. Thanks Damian for a great experience.

Seeing all the bad reviews almost made me cancel a reservation we had made.  Decided to give it a try anyways and had no problems. The rental was under my wife's name (no shared surname), made through Priceline, but with a quick ok from a manager I was able pick it up without her being present.  Car was not specifically what we had selected but was comparable. The person at the counter did try to upsell me on both vehicle type and coverage, but wasn't pushy. Not discounting other peoples' experiences here but thought it only fair to give credit where it's due. I wouldn't hesitate to try them again if the need arose.

We stayed here for 3 weeks during our daughter's hospital stay at CHOP. From the minute we walked in the door until the day we left nothing but the best service & always greeted with a smile. We have stayed here several times over the last year and a half and every time has been a pleasurable experience. Our most recent stay our daughter left her cell phone on the bed and we didn't realize it until we had already checked out and left. She realized it about an hour later, we went back to the hotel immediately and sure enough one of the employees had found it and gave it to us at the front desk. Customer service at its finest.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I was surprised to have been charged over $50 for "diagnostic" coding when I took my car in there, in addition to the repairs. I wouldn't mind paying a diagnostic read if 1) I chose not to have the repairs done and 2) I hadn't already had the codes read at Autozone for free and TOLD Pat's Auto what the problem was. They then charged me $50 to tell me Autozone was correct. I thought typically, the cost of the diagnostic read would be comped if a business then did the repairs. I had been to them twice, after this, I'm not returning.

I ordered Origami through DoorDash, and ended up having some issues with my driver. Without going into too much detail, my driver caused a few issues with my food. Origami immediately got me a new DoorDash driver, remade my food, and even threw in a complimentary avocado bomb. You guys have amazing customer service. Whoever I spoke to on the phone was fabulous, and my food was SO delicious. Just based on service alone, I'd recommend this to anyone. The tasty bento boxes and sushi is just the cherry on top. Thank you guys!!

Our stay at the Inn was excellent.  Caitlin Lysle at the desk went out of her way to provide extra service and attention.  She gets an A+ for service with a smile, and is quite knowledgeable about advice on tourist directions and activities.  Our room was spacious and comfortable, the beds are just the right balance of firmness and softness. The breakfast exceeded expectations.  They even have a dedicated hot water urn for tea.  If this is your first time to find your way here, be aware the county has not put a Rocky Run Parkway sign that is visible from Rte 202, Concord Pike.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is the worst dunkin' donuts i have ever been to which sucks because it's on my way to work. I have given the location 15+ chances but i am disappointed every single time. I usually make an on the go order from the app 15-20 minutes before i arrive and my order is still NEVER ready i usually have to wait an additional 10 minutes for an iced coffee and a wake up wrap which has on often times made me late for work. Not only do they take forever, but on multiple occasions my order was wrong and twice my wake up wrap was burnt. I am done with this dunkin' donuts!

This place has a great selection but most everything craft beer is old, meaning some beer in this store is even past it's due date. This won't hurt you but I like IPAs or hoppy beers and there was not much of anything under 5 months old. I felt like I was at the dollar store for beers LOL. They do have sweetwater IPA on tap and is probably the best seller so you might be safe there, but if you are looking for really fresh beer and great service in the Nashville area go down town!! I get fresher beer from Kroger out here. 

Jason

The food was good but the service was not great. We ordered 1 app 2 entrees and a side. The app never came and we got the pasta and side 45 minutes after sitting down. We were not offered bread but other tables did get it. I asked to wrap my food and it was never spoken of again (but I guess I didn't want it at that point). I will say that the Brussel sprouts were amazing and the entrees were very good. Maybe they just need to get their groove, it being new and all but it would have been nice to comp me a dessert or a glass of wine.

Beer Peddlers is AWESOME. They are so helpful and have a huge selection of Gluten Free hard ciders and other interesting and unique brews.                                                                                                   
They are smart, sharp and ready to help you find exactly what you need. NO Problem!!!! Wish all "beer folks" knew as much or were as happy and willing to advise customers. 

Visit their great location, easy free parking and clean friendly store with a complete selection of cold Singles, 6 Packs and Cases of anything you can think of and more... Love it!!!!!

So the stay was neutral, let's just say they redeemed themselves. The doorman is just the sweetest guy ever! He truly had the passion to give great customer service! We didn't have heat for at least 24 hours of our stay, but they comped the room one night which helped. I think once they are done renovating the hotel it will be nice. Their "flat screen tv" wasn't lol, they had no fridge which they promised with the room online. The location is truly the best! Within walking distance of The Arch, the baseball stadium, and a ton of great restaurants:)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Unfortunately, a bunch of whiny Karens got their Lululemons in a bunch and are now trying to downvote this place due to stuff that has nothing to do with the food. The food is good. Consistently. Have been there many times and will go many times in the future. Highly recommend. One of the best restaurants in the area, hands down. The rest of you keyboard warrior midwits should unclutch your pearls and find a hobby. Seriously.

Also, lol at the loony person saying the restaurant let politics get in the way. Ummmmm, irony much? Crazy lady, look inward.

Could not be more disappointed in the rooms. Small, only a desk to use as a table. First room was dusty and grimy (the heating unit, back of the TV, refrigerator wasn't on, so freezer defrosted leaving water on shelves, shower did not work). Moved to another room. A bit "cleaner", but the bathroom sink was clogged. The staff was responsive and apologetic. Cleared the drain. 
The second morning, we found a cockroach on the Kleenex box! I have never seen cockroaches in a hotel!
Have a six night reservation! Yikes!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The partner and I have been craving Mexican food, all month long. This was one of our better experiences. 

I was very happy with my meal. Their shrimp....I do not have the words.

What was even better was seeing my partner roll her eyes over the beans. 

Great food, with only one problem. 

The steak in my partners burrito had a lot of gristle. Too much of the unchewable. She struggled with the meat, though reported it to have excellent flavor.

We had a great waitperson, very attentive. 

My partner wants to go back solely for the rice and beans.

Good hotel for the price.

The public areas aren't maintained to well. (There was a party, as well as sports team staying there which could have added to the uncleanliness.)

The pool was nice but towels where not being picked up. The outdoor setting areas was added bonus. (Loved it) But it wasn't kept clean, the trash was overflowing which caused some of the garbage to be in the garden areas.

The room was very clean and spacious. Great for a family/business traveler.
The wet bar (sink, mini-fridge, and microwave) was great bonus.

The free morning breakfast was great. I love their waffles! Fresh fruit, yogurt and cereal.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Worst customers I have ever experienced. I showed up to my appointment 10 minutes early and had to wait past the time. I was there to get my oil changed, and had left my car for about 30 minutes, and I called to get an update only to be told that they couldn't change my oil because "I had no oil in my car." I picked my car up and no one even had the courtesy to apologize or say anything to me. I pulled out and checked my oil only to find that I still had oil in my car seems like they just didn't want to change it for some reason. Horrible customer service all around. I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Had a wonderful experience here at Elite Nails. The owner kept the salon open late for me as a walk in.  I had a pedicure done by Nelli, and after a few months away from the salon I needed a good pedi- she did a great job. Gentle, took her time and also went back and fixed a smudge I did while drying. Lela did my gel Manicure and was very professional took her time, cuticles cleaned, and love my painted nails.  The salon was very careful with COVID guidelines as I felt very safe and in a clean environment with protocols in place. A must return!!!!

Tried to make an order through Grubhub and the food was late. I waited 15 minutes past the delivery time and called. The employee and manager had no idea about my order until Grubhub called me back and told me the restaurant had already sent out the food and would be there any minute. 15 minutes later I call again, Grubhub tells me the manager said it would be any minute again... 15 minutes later still no food. I get it if the food is late, but why lie and say it's going to be there any minute when it clearly isn't....

I think this place is amazing.  I joined three weeks ago and by my second visit, the woman at the front desk greeted me by name!  Really nice touch.  It's not that big, but everything you could possibly need is in there and in good condition.  The patrons are quiet and friendly and the lockers have a keypad so you never need a lock!

ALSO, about a week ago the manager called and updated me on new machines I might like and thanked me for joining.  Definitely a real small business atmosphere and they immediately make you feel welcome.

I wouldn't go anywhere else.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I was waking around in central city this afternoon founded this sushi place where located at 16th street and I was attracted by the lovely place!!  So I was decided to got lunch from here . When I opened the menu there's so much delicious food I was noticed one picture from the menu then I was asked the sever what the picture was!   Then I ordered one fireworks and blushing lava! The names tells  it all !!Amazing food and lovely place !! I Must be coming back here for next time and highly recommend this place for who is looking for a lovely place for dating !  Nice for dining in place!

We reserved a SUV for a weekend trip. We had a set time, but due o work considerations, arrived 2 hours later. We were advised that the vehicle we reserved was no longer there, having been rented to someone else. No other vehicles fitting our needs were available. We were told to try Tampa airport- 40 minutes away. When asked about the website note that rentals are held for 6 hours, we were told this is a private facility no affiliated with corporate, and that that didn't apply. Needless to say, we will never use the again, and caution anyone else.

Great New Orleans Italian Restaurant.  We have been many times.  Everything on the menu is great.  Local seafood favorites and Italian classics.  Excellent soups.  Great service.  If you are downtown take the streetcar.   Classic Italian music in background.  This place will please everyone

Fantastic restaurant.  Some of the best Italian food in New Orleans with great service.  Always excellent specials.  Tonight great crab meat ravioli.  Ask for Tony's flounder, amazing.  You should go, because you will return many times.

I will not rent from them again. They told me I needed the easy pass for the tolls as the tolls were all around 15 dollars. I went through about 8 tolls and would have paid less than 20 dollars total but the stupid easy pass was closer to 50 dollars. I told the management and they were all too ready to give me the BS response that they could take it off, but then I would have to pay the fines for using the wrong lanes.

There was absolutely no misunderstanding. The girl that checked me out flat out lied about the 15 dollars for toll. It is 15 dollars fine for using the easypass without paying. Fine does not equal toll!!! Dirty stinking liars!

Pretentious and arrogant is the theme of this store. In my first, only and last experience with this liquor store that is the attitude and approach I experienced when trying to source several hundred dollars of wine for a catered in home dinner. Appeared the owners Laura and Ames were going to be very helpful initially but once they were asked a clarifying question about a price on a couple wines they became adversarial and surprisingly rude. You can get wine, liquor and beer lots of places, go where customer service and value still matter to the shopkeeper is my suggestion.

This is the first negative review I've posted, but I'm compelled to do so...  this hotel is certainly not up to Marriott standards.  My room was very old & dirty!  The carpet had not been thoroughly swept, windows were dirty, balcony door was open when I arrived...  I understand it's old & they are currently going thru renovations, but it could at least meet min. Cleanliness standards.  On top of this, the billing was messed up.  (I reserved 3 rooms; my companions each provided their own credit cards, but all were billed to me.). I would def not stay again until/unless/maybe when the renovations are complete.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Shady business. Terry's Service Center employees signed off on my car's inspection report stating that one of the things on my car in need of "Immediate Attention" were my rear brakes at 3mm. After going to a different mechanic down the road, I learned that that was far from the truth. Well over 50% of my brake pad was still there!! In addition, their quoted prices are outrageous. I paid the inspection fee at Terry's, went to a different mechanic for what needed repaired, and still saved hundreds of dollars. I would take caution in going to this place.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I gave this place two stars not because of the strip clubs nearby but because of the slight irritation. The tub didn't drain well and with three people staying in a room, it got filthy quick! I had to have the room keys reset every night I was there for some reason. They advertise HBO but they don't have it.  WiFi is free as well as breakfast. The free airport shuttle was very useful and quick. There was an iron but no ironing board. But it was cheap and served its purpose. But I've stayed in better and cheaper motels than this. Oh and personally, the pillows were awesome but the bed was like rocks!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Requires serious customer service retraining. Great location and new facility with a staff that lacks any sense of caring or urgency. No apology or recognition from front desk upon discovery of room not serviced while gone for 12 hours. Upon check in, staff tried to downgrade room reserved. Found a similar room, however for those with disabilities, after much push back. Technology enabled which allows staff to text guests to check on satisfaction of room.  Perhaps they should start with the basics of customer service training and checking on the cleaning and servicing of rooms.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My fucking ass open till midnight, went there at 10:30pm August 21st, manager is a lazy fuck, me plus another car sat in drive thru for almost 20 min, all the lights are on, I drove up to the window and the truck was gone and 2 employees plus the manager see me sitting there and don't come to the window, I call and here comes the manager and asks me what's up, wtf do u mean what's up, he says no cook, so your telling me this manager isn't smart enough to shut off the outer lights since they're "cleaning" lazy fuck can't make food for the customers himself

This place rocks. It's totally convenient free parking etc. Easy uber to bourbon st. Easy to city park. Nice little hotel with a new Orleans taste. Bathroom is small? So what. You stl get a decent room. Breakfast had packet grits? Lol you poor slob so what. You still get waffles cereal and coffee etc. The only thing management needs to do before we come back. All the carpet must go. Nobody keeps carpets anymore. Id rather walk on the old wood planks than this carpet. Other than that for the money you are paying It's a decent call. This isn't a 200$ a night room don't expect it to be.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Stayed 2 night with the family on vacation.  Multiple disappointments.  In the room numerous outlets did not work, 2 TVs only 1 remote control, no sheets for the pull out couch and 1 lamp bulb was burned out.  The biggest disappointment was the pool. When we booked clearly show that there was a pool at this location.
