When we arrive were told that the pool wasn't the hotels it belong to the fitness club that they shared the building with and that it would be closed until October.  This is like me selling my house and putting a picture of the neighbors pool that they let us use from time to time in the listing.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Quite possibly the worst cup of coffee I have ever had at a McDonalds. I purchased a large Caramel Macchiato and it tasted like hot milk. When I said something they only said, "I don't make it the machine makes it." I said, "I realize that but maybe something needs to be changed." He said he would add a shot of espresso but it still tasted bad. Also bought a large iced tea and it tasted like old tea. I know fellow tea drinkers will know what i am talking about! Anyway, i am traveling so it is not like I am going to turn around and go back! Very disappointed!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Not sure on how to even start but since this place has raging reviews by many we must be sushi snobs. Our starters arrived after our sushi, the waitress never checked on us and we had ask plates and chop sticks...isn't that what you should start with. Each roll had its own disappointment, from tasteless rice, plain surimi sticks, no sauce, too much sauce or extremely small rolls. The volcano roll came with its own light show, but I would prefer it to wow me with its flavors and not its smoke and bling. If you are looking for a place better than McDonalds with a punch card, this might be it. I know we won't be back.

Went here just this past Tuesday. Great food good service but the only thing that I may not be back is because. we were a table of six and I paid for what owed on my credit card and the waiter came back and charged me the right amount. Later I find out on my bank statement that he charged the rest of bill when I had already left and I did not authorized the second transaction. What makes me mad is I called the restaurant and got no help. So now there is $55.19 holding in my account and was told the manager was going to call me back the other day and no one as returned my call.

I am not a regular customer but placed an order to pick up at the request of the grandkids. I was not told of the current offers and deals by the person taking my order. I questioned the offers when I arrived to pay and pick up but was told this is the price for my order. The only reason I paid was there were 3 hunger "littles" in the car. When I got home there were many television adds for 2 large for the price I paid for a one medium. Even the pizza was ok, I won't be a customer of Papa Johns. An opportunity was lost for a new customer!!!

The general manager @ the Oxford Suites got in contact with me after reading review I posted. 
To my surprise Mr. Lee was not defensive & condescending as most managers would surely be. This manager is a professional problem solver. Not only did he apologize for everything that went wrong, he gave me a full refund/American Express merchant credit. No wonder his hotel has all those excellent reviews because he takes care of business & I will consider staying again @ Oxford with the knowledge that Oxford hotels stand by their claim of excellence. Mr.Lee's customer skills are 5 stars in my book.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I had a really horrible experience last week.  I ordered a burrito to go, picked it up.  As I was eating it, I felt something that was not normally in a burrito and I pulled out a wire, much like a paper clip.  I immediately took it back.  While they refunded my money, I asked to speak with the owner and he refused to come out and hear my complaint personally.  Be very careful, there are so many wonderful Mexican places in the Italian market are, there is no need to endanger yourself and go to Tres Jalapenos!

Not pleased with the services that I received at their salon today. First I paid for a deluxe pedicure which was supposed to last for 45 minutes and remove dry skin and calluses from my feet. The pedicure lasted less than 20 minutes and I still have dry feet with calluses. Then they charged me $3.00 for a nail trim which was not disclosed to me. She did nothing other than shorten my nails slightly from my last service 2 weeks ago. I have never been charged to have my nails shortened for a timely service. She was very unfriendly as well. I will never go back to this salon.

I have been disappointed by the 24 Hour Fitness in Arnold for quite some time.  Mostly, I find the gym to be in need of remodeling and repair.  There are several holes in the walls that need to be repaired or have been repaired poorly.  Several of the door handles in the women's locker room are broke, water barely comes out of one of the sinks,  the inside of the lockers need to be wiped down, and the floors look dirty.  Many of the machines need cardio theaters for watching TV.  I often find the equipment dirty, sticky, and one time with chewing gum.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Took my 10 yr old daughter in for her first ever eye exam with Dr. Waters.  What a truly wonderful experience!  My daughter was at ease and comfortable throughout the entire process.  Dr. Waters explained the entire exam every step of the way which made it "cool" for my curious kid.  She is warm, kind, caring, professional and totally amazing with kids!  A sweet surprise was being greeted by Dr Waters' dog Mia which scored huge points with my kid from the minute we walked through the door!  I very highly recommend Dr. Waters, she is a hidden gem in Santa Barbara!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: HORRIBLE! I'm not one to complain. (I understand people make mistakes sometimes.) I was there twice over the last two weeks and not only did it take 30-40 minutes for my food, they completely screwed up my order and left things out. They barely even filled my fries. The second time I was there, I had the same problem with the fries and they were also soggy. Also took about 40 minutes. The workers are rude and careless. I'm sure the McDonalds franchise would not be too thrilled to hear of one of their establishments being run like this. I will NEVER come back...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: LOVE LOVE LOVE!  As good as it gets people! I was in there Saturday and cannot express how happy I was with the service provided.  Despite the uncertainty in the midst of this pandemic, I felt safe and comfortable being there the entire time.  They took every precautionary action to make sure of it.  Plus, everyone was so friendly and professional! Eric was my stylist and took the time to really listen and understand the look I was going for, and the outcome was above and beyond my expectations. I left there feeling fresh and beautiful!  I will DEFINITELY be returning. Thank you so much, Eric and The Artist Haus!

(04/22/14)The Live Jazz had me hovering off my chair for a few moments. Mostly perfectly nice young ladies on staff. Stayed for 4 Songs. Worth the three insults i heard from one patron or? whomever wants me to "keep my place" during the 21st Century. People can't know when some one enters with connections in the Hollywood music industry. (update @ 9/5/14) Really melding into the place. Cheerful crowd, Don't need to talk to anyone. Would stay till closing if there were pretzels er popcorn with drinks. vega Nibbley bits maybe. Armenian not Italian owned. Armenian inner circle of clientele.

Terrible! First the shuttle bus didn't stop at the designated pick up spot at the airport. He just drove right on by while I was waving right at him. Then I go to check in for car and they say it''s a 1-2hr wait for a car. They had other cars but they were "premium cars" and would not upgrade me to one of those with out paying the upgraded amount. They also  wouldn't discount my current vehicle even though I had a reservation but had to wait for up to 2hrs. I can see why this place only has a 2 star review with hundreds of people rating them.

DO NOT LIVE HERE IF YOU CANNOT HELP IT! 
The models are nice. The staff is nice. The maintenance guys are nice but don't know what they are doing! I have never lived somewhere with so many problems! Forget getting anything fixed! And it's big things that break! This place is duct taped together and a total joke. Also, what they call ac isn't really ac- it's a chiller system- so not ac and not swamp, and super hot. Also our water is off probably weekly for repairs with no notice most of the time, so keep a jug in your fridge! Don't do it

I have stayed in this hotel several times for business and I must say for what you pay you'r accommodated nicely. Big flat screen TV, free internet, and a very comfortable bed. I 'm from California and for the price I paid for a single queen I would be lucky to get a rollout bed in a seedy hotel out in san francisco!
The service is always friendly and attentive to your needs. They have a free shuttle that takes you around town if you wish to venture off the property. This is great because it saves me from getting a rent a car when I travel out here. 
Overall this is a well kept, reasonably priced hotel not far from PHI airport.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Today I went to this McDonalds. I went through the drive thru the first speaker told me to move forward. The woman came on and said to please wait a minute. Then while I sat there first in line, she took the two people behind me in line. So I went inside. I ordered and paid from the machine. It still took over 20 minutes for my food. Some was standing at the counter for over 7 minutes to get waited on at the counter. I told the lady that gave me my food about the drive thru and she just shrugged her shoulders.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Very disappointed in this La Quinta Inn. There was a strong musty odor in the stairwell. The rooms were not only dated and worn but not very clean. The bathroom was distinctly unclean with a dirty bathtub/shower (pictured) and hair and dirt in the corners of the room. The carpet was faded and worn and appeared dirty. The walls were splattered. 

The bedding did appear to be clean, thankfully. The breakfast was decent with a waffle iron, packaged muffins, and yogurt. 

I would not stay here again unless desperate. Well worth the extra $30 to drive across the street to the Fairfield Inn.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The management and maintenance sucks at this facility. Earlier this year the ceiling fans were down for a few weeks. When they were fixed the part was installed incorrectly so as to draw the air up instead of down to the machines. it took over a week to get someone back to correct. Now the AC has been down for to weeks. This forces PF to close when the temps hit the 90s. Totally unacceptable. It took weeks to get the right parts for the fans to work. Now the AC has been down over a week and you close the facility. You could have had fans in. 
You also may want to look at the number of machines that have broken headsets.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: As a seasoned traveler, this place was very disappointing.  Spotty room cleaning, leaky roof, poor front desk management, air conditioning issues, clogged shower drain. I doubt it will be in my future plans..very disappointing.  In full disclosure, they gave me the equivalent of 1 room night as compensation for my issues ( I stayed a total 14 nights) ...still left me wanting. I heard others making similar complaints at the front desk. too bad as it is a great location - but check around if you go to this area, it looks like there are many other hotel options to consider.  I wish I did!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Me and my family typically visit the restaurant every week or so to eat as we live extremely close to the area.  We visited the restaurant on 1/31 for dinner.  It was a horrible dining experience the manager on duty was extremely rude and unprofessional.  She refused to let us sit in the part of the restaurant we typically do because she said it was closed, upon speaking the the other waitress we were informed the manager doesn't let people sit in that area because she forgets about them.  Overall the experience was horrible and we will be calling to make sure that manager is not on duty before visiting the restaurant again.

Food was good we came from California and we have been wanting to try it sin e we dont have any out back home food was amazing flavor was what I expected we had a huge order since it was 10 of us visiting from California and we got everything we order they didnt miss any of our order gave it to us in individual bags by combo why I gave a 3 star you ask because the cashier was rude didnt have customer service and made our experience feel horrible we kinda didnt want to ask for like the code to the restroom because she was just rude sucks that  we had to be disappointed because of the customer service

Was in town overnight for business and was lucky enough to discover this gem on Yelp. Angie the hostess was kind enough to accommodate us for a last-minute reservation. We were surprised to find such a Cute fine dining restaurant in the strip mall setting. We had to wait a few minutes before owner was taken because it was a Friday night and the place was quite packed but once we started getting our food it was totally worth the wait. From the rabbit to the scallops everything was delicious and exceeded our expectations. We will definitely be back the next time we are in Springhill.

My boyfriend and I came to this restaurant on a date, immediately when walking in the hostess (so I presume) was on the phone and a teenage girl was standing behind her on her phone just staring at us without a greeting or as much as a "I'll be right with you". First disappointing thing, it continues as costumers and waiters were staring at us like we were going to dash and run (because we look very young), which made me very uncomfortable and making the experience very awful. I enjoyed the food but I will not come to a place that makes you feel disrespected because of age. Shame.

This place is horrible.  The staff all look disgruntled and showed zero interest in showing any customer service.  I stood at the register for 5 minutes the. When it was time for me to give my order the girl stood there and didn't even acknowledge my existence.  She stuck her bare hand in my bag for donuts after receiving the order of the customer before me.  There is zero practice of sanitation.  It's too bad because the place is nice but the staff ruin the experience.  I will NEVER COME BACK HERE.  Just gross

Growing up in Northern NJ, Chinese food was amazing no matter where you ordered from. Since moving to DE 10 years ago, I have yet to find a place that I truly love. This place changed that! We ordered wonton soup, Hunan Chicken and Triple Delight Szechuan Style and they were all DELICIOUS! They were actually somewhat spicy instead of sweet, portions were huge, and the taste was absolutely delicious. I'm shocked by the mediocre/bad reviews for this place on Yelp, Google, etc. so, if you take it from a Jersey girl who knows her chinese food, THIS FOOD IS GREAT!!

2 stars for service/delivery.

We love Tres Jalapenos' wet burritos, although a little on the pricey side, they are huge and delicious. 

As much as I love the idea of my food being delivered by a man on a bike, it is not so appealing to have my food being thrown around like it was put in the dryer on tumble cycle. The sauce to the burritos had exploded outside of the to go containers and disbursed all over the bag! It breaks your appetite to have to clean up your food before eating. This has happened twice and they said it was due to the lack of having a delivery person with a car. 

Overall, their food is delicious, just beware of delivery.

We were REALLY disappointed. We chose Black Tavern because we thought that their menu included vegan or at least vegetarian options. We reserved a table via OpenTable. When we arrived, we found out that there was only a buffet and that the menu wouldn't be used. We had not received any notice of this. As vegans, we could basically only eat lettuce. And then we got the bill for about $40 each after tax and tip. And the service was terrible. I think the managers must have their heads stuck underground.  On the plus side, the place itself was pretty neat-looking and had interesting decorations.

My BF and I had a great stay.  No issues!  Just fun.  Room was clean.  Had a balcony looking out at the boardwalk and beach.  Breakfast every morning was great.  Enough option and free so what can you say bad about that!  Staff is amazing.  From both men at Breakfast-to Paul working the late shift when we checked in.  He was great!  Easy access to the beach.  Pool was clean and towels available for the beach and pool.  I wish the outside pool bar was open but Happy Hour at the 2nd floor bar from 5-7 with $2 drafts and $3 wines!!!  Can't beat that!  We plan on returning for Memorial Day.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Ordered 2 philly rolls, clear soup, and an avocado house salad tonight via Delivery Dudes.

 I eat philly rolls like no ones business. The ones delivered to me had a grayish hue to the salmon, and tasted so bad that even the ginger dressing delivered with the salad couldn't save them. I'm just hoping the salmon wasn't actually bad. 

The clear soup also tasted like warmed up, flavored chlorine water. 

The avocado salad was great though. 

Still, will never eat here again. Philly rolls aren't that hard, guys

Great experience! 

I was in from out of town on a business day trip business to Malvern, and severely damaged my Bridgestone DriveGuard after hitting a pothole on US 202 a scant five minutes from the office.

United was the closest tire service shop, so I called and spoke to Lenny. He called around to his wholesalers and found replacement tires for both front wheels and the team had me fixed in just a few hours. Made my meeting and now I'm safely on my way back home. 

Friendly faces, clean shop, great customer service. Highly recommended!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I've been a long-time customer of this store and the employees are usually friendly and nice.  I really like their produce, there is always a good selection of good quality.  The deli is great too.  The pizza's are always good and I've found the best selections of cheeses there.  I can only give them a four because the meat selection and quality is not as good as it once was.  I buy a lot of Kroger brand items and know which I like and which I prefer the name brand, over all the K brand is generally just as good.

What a disaster. Our room had no remote for the tv. When I called the front desk he said to come down and pick one up. I did, then went all the way back to my room only to find out it didn't work. We went down again to get a different remote. Finally figured out on our own that the cable wasn't hooked up.  We went out to the filthy, weed ridden pool area, and our key wouldn't open the door to get back in. I pre-paid, yet they authorized $$ on my debit card for incidentals we didn't use. When I called to inquire about it the guy was defensive and rude. We will never stay here again!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Staff is extremely friendly. Ladies pack your own hair dryer. This motel does not come with one. In fact they give you one tiny bar of soap and thats it. There is not a water fountain to be had in the entire building. You have to fill your water bottles up in the bathroom sink. Do not stay in the rooms by the exit doors. Extremely noisey all night long as modern society has lost social skills and couteousy. People were slamming the door shut all night. The beds were awful and hard as a rock. I could feel the springs in the mattress. Next to freeway very noisey.  The walls were paper thin.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I usually don't write any reviews, but I had to this time to make everyone aware. I ordered 3 burritos and chips, guac and salsa during the prime lunch time hour. Picked up my order and on my way back to the office & realize they didn't include the chips...so I went back again and got the chips but had to wait 10 mins because the guy was on the phone. This isn't even the highlight, I'm more than half way done eating the food and I find out what appears to be a mosquito in my food! Gross...I won't be going back again.

I walked into their restaurant to order a slice of cheesecake to take to our hotel room at 8:35 tonight, a Saturday night....they close at 10pm...the hostess asked me if she could help me.  I replied with I need to order a slice of cheesecake.  She answered with, "we aren't filling any more takeout orders."  Seriously?  A slice of cheesecake? You literally pick it up and place it in a to go container....but you won't do that?  And you don't close for another hour and 25 minutes.  How rude!  We were actually going to eat here before we left the city....NOT NOW!  NOT EVER!

I applied for the Barclaycard Visa with Apple Rewards, through the Apple Computer web site. Although I can pay cash for a new Apple computer, I felt it was a good way to establish better credit. *** BEWARE!! , THEY WANT YOU TO SEND THEM (THROUGH THE US MAIL), A COPY OF YOUR DRIVERS LICENSE, A COPY OF YOUR SOCIAL SECURITY CARD AND A COPY OF YOUR BANK STATEMENT. They will not allow you to fax it or give you any alternate secure means of providing this documentation, so if you want to increase your chances of your identity being stolen (not to mention having all of your money withdrawn out of your bank account!), go for it.....

Decided to come here for lunch today. Service was OK there was only one worker present in the front of the store. Not many customers but very unorganized and disheveled. They should deff have a more organized prep station for preparing food. I wasn't pleased with the taste of the pizza or salad. I got a plain pizza and it barely had sauce on it very bland. The kale Caesar that I got with no egg was pretty lackluster with minimal ingredients very thrown together. Not as disappointed in the service as I was the food that's deff worth looking into. Wasn't worth the $17 probably won't be back.

Ordered breakfast from this place...horrible. It took forever to be delivered and when it finally arrived, the guy took my money and began to walk away AND THEN told me that they did not have orange juice and I was not charged for it. Since I had already handed him the money, he ended up walking away with a $6 tip on a late, incomplete $16 order. If the food was good, it wouldn't have been a big deal, but it was not. The toast was not toasted and the homefries were undercooked. The food was less than hot and no juice. Very dissatisfied, will not order from here again.

It is sad when you come to a place asking for something and ended having something completely different.   I went last Saturday and asked for a retouch of the ombre style (made a few months before by the same person there).  Everything was ok until the end.  Instead of an ombre she dyed my hair red.  The color was pretty but it wasn't what I asked for... she blamed her helper and charged me $$$, which I payed just because of I loved the color, blow out and conditioner treatment.  Watch out if you plan to visit this place. (Be aware of the prices too....)

This is without a doubt the slowest five guys in the city. Every once and while I forget how bad it is and wander in here for a burger.. then remember why I stay away from this location.. The staff looked about as enthused as a child stuck in a clothing store.. Not one employ even attempted to take an order from the 10 people waiting. Figured my money would be better spent somewhere else. In all honesty, i could have driven to the ellerslie location and still got my food faster than waiting at this location..

Expensive for the poor service,Techs are rude they all look at your crazy they appear lazy & that they're just there to collect a pay check, instead of giving they're customers good quality work... smh I was trying to give this salon the benefit of the doubt due to them being so close but I want be back first visit my set was applied thick, poorly shaped, & uneven(Travis) The lady that did my pedicure was TERRIBLE & had a attitude the whole time of the service she left the hot towel on my legs more than 5 min and stayed in the back (Selena).I had to remove the towel myself because it got freezing cold & btw they don't even have prices listed

I love my Starbucks!!  However, we have been sitting in the drive thru for 15 minutes, so I thought I would share this experience. As we approach the 20 minute mark, I am beginning to think they take our order and go pick it up at another location. As I peered in the door from my car, I can see an employee putting out inventory instead of helping the drive thru or counter...interesting. 

On a lighter note, the gentleman working the drive thru is hilarious a very nice. He would be the only reason we return to this location.

Knotty Bread completely RAW in the middle. Thought it was cheese and the hubby said ummm no! Do not eat that! Pasta Alfredo very watery and noodles stuck to each other and no flavor at all!! Cheese pizza ordered with white sauce and it was drenched with oregano over the top, didn't ask for it and didn't know it came that way! Built our own pizza with 4 toppings, so soggy in the middle and super crunchy on the edges. Lastly, the smell when you walk in, like old but new mixed, glad our order was carry out! Never EVER will we go back. Plus side, staff was friendly, that's it! STAY AWAY! 1 star is giving a lot.

After the flooding that hit New Orleans last night people had to pull off the road because the water was so deep. This McDonald's decided to have these people towed by a private company rather than the city. The city impound understood that with the flood waters not going down until after midnight some people would have to park and walk. If the car had been towed to the city it would have been free to get out. Because they decided to use a private company it was almost $200. I'd love to understand the thought process the manager had when they decided to do this.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Have been to this restaurant many times and always had perfect experience.  We went last eve and were very disappointed.  There was no complimentary focaccia bread so we asked for a substitute.  They had bruschetta but there would be a charge.  We asked to speak to a manager.  Unfortunately I didn't get his name but he was very rude and did not want to accommodate us.  In the end he said he would send something and said (sarcastically) "nice talking to you". What a JERK!.  Waitress upstairs had a "whatever" attitude also.  We'll stick to Mandolas in Riverview

I go here pretty frequently for the burritos. I always order chicken, rice, and beans, and it's delicious. For simple, fast, no-fuss Mexican food, this is the best place I've found. I never really eat in here so I can't say much about service, but I've never had any trouble with the cashier. 

One time, however, I had ordered my regular chicken, rice, beans burrito and when I got home and opened it, there wasn't any beans...oops? I still ate and enjoyed it nonetheless, but be sure to be clear when ordering. 

Bottom line, if you're looking for some quick Mexican food, I'd recommend.

We had an amazing event here last night! We are so glad we chose the Black Powder Tavern! We had a group from all over the United States and we used the private room upstairs for 36. The event planner made it easy and was well organized. After speaking only once, by phone, we were expected, welcomed and the room was set up perfectly. Menus were printed with our special title at the top. Such a nice touch! The two BEST parts were the food & our server! Ryan Cue made this a perfect celebration.... professional, incredibly great attitude & provided over the top service. Thanks also to the chef!

Absolutely the rudest customer service I have had in years! I have never felt so uncomfortable asking someone to build my sandwich that I am paying for. Isn't that the entire Subway concept? To walk-in and have your sandwich built? There were no special, out of the ordinary requests yet every selection we made seemed to be a problem. They tried to over charge us at checkout as if $22 wasn't already enough for 2 subs. As we are trying to discuss the charges, the manager is laughing in our face.... Not a chance I would ever return to this location. I don't recommend even giving them a chance! You'll thank me later.

I'm giving this a 5 star because this is my husbands favorite place to go! We've ordered take out and dine in, what feels like 100s of times. We've even had them cater our gender reveal.  My husband loves the Cauliflower crust pizza.  I personally find anything outside of there pizza just ok with the exception of anything fried. You can never go wrong with fried!  Their spinach artichoke flatbread, though, is on point! I usually fill up on that and stick with a simpler dinner like their fried ravioli! Lol like I said, anything fried is perfect for me!

I don't think this place has much concern for stray dogs and perhaps might be a bit too concerned about money rather than saving animals.  I found a dog that had been hit by a car and brought her in.  They basically told me, after a 5 minute review of her, that her back legs were paralyzed and that unless I claimed ownership and agreed to pay around $1,500 they would have to euthanize her.  I'm not sure how you can tell permanent paralysis without even an xray, but apparently these folks think they can.

There are too many other options in Tampa for me to ever bring a pet here again.  Just dreadful...

May be too picky, or cheap, but my daughters and I went there twice a week years ago, when a young man named Tom I think ran it, and loved it there. Very customer oriented- I got some coupons recently and stopped by to get two foot longs for like 13 bucks I think, the guy said he does not take coupons-I said "really? since when ?"- he said last year  I know its the owners choice, but I will never be setting foot in that place again- so whatever, you lost an old customer who wanted to start returning.  M Gravatt  RPh

This place ended up being an amazing find. The sushi there was as good as any I've had in the SF bay area at pretty reasonable prices (the Dixieland roll is a must try). I have no idea how the crab tasted so fresh but I'm not going to question it. The best part of the experience, however, was the sushi chief, Koji. Super friendly guy with lots of interesting stories to tell. Even recommended a pretty rocking blues bar (Bourbon Street Blues and Boogie Bar) right around the corner. If you are in Nashville and craving sushi, give Koji a visit. You will not be disappointed.

Bummer! I'm a loyal Marriott person and this property looked great in the pics. Too bad it didn't live up. Concierge lounge is nice but food is blah!  Smoked chicken risotto just tastes like bacon. And then there was salad. And that's it. Order "room service" which I picked up from downstairs at the little store. They just pressed a pre made sandwich in a pani press. And it's not very good. And I can't see the tv in the room which is probably my biggest complaint!  Why put it on wall to the left of the bed?! Fact is there a plenty of other marriotts to choose from. Choose the others.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The car was fine, but the pickup was not.  We had reserved a compact and walked around the National location and could find full-size, SUVs etc., but no compact with a National sign.  We went to the exit booth and were directed to "beyond the staircase", but no National compact site, only one for Alamo, so we walked back to the booth and were told that was where we were to select.  That wasted at least five minutes.  The check out line was 6 cars deep with only one exit, and that wasted almost ten minutes.  So much the speed and ease of being an Emerald Club member.

Chef Michael worked really closely with me and my team to get his whole restaurant reserved for us to host a dinner for our clients and prospects during a conference we attended in Tampa. It was my first time in the city and my first time hosting a dinner since the pandemic - his flexibility and expertise made the night perfect. 

Cocktails and food were also INCREDIBLE. The mushroom risotto was to die for and the bartender had an incredible recipe for an espresso martini that I'll be thinking about for all my days.

I'm so disappointed,  I just ordered a Ruben sandwich, and I know from ordering Rubens in the past what it has in it. This "Ruben" was on marbled bread,  not rye, the corn beef was cut not shredded,  the sauerkraut was missing the dressing and it was not toasted. I don't know what kind of sandwich this was but it certainly wasn't a Ruben. It's also expensive and well worth it when you actually get what you ordered. Check out the pictures, by the way it was a really small sandwich. This order was placed through Instacart. 

C.Calloway

This was our second shot visit. And it didn't disappoint. Each and every entree was perfectly flavored and a price of art. The chef was on point and we appreciated every bite. Having compassion for the staffing issues the industry is incurring, we would have appreciated a warmer greeting upon arrival, the staff couldn't acknowledge us for quite a bit of time and when they did, it seemed as though we were a bother. Our server, Malorie was extremely professional and we enjoyed her. But again, the food was truly impeccable and delicious.

Never again.  Once you get past the gauntlet of panhandlers hounding you for money, you'll likely be treated to scowls and insults from the staff, who set uncompromising standards for rudeness.  And contrary to other reviews I have seen, the prices and selection are NOT extraordinary. You'll likely spend more treating your knife wounds than the few pennies you'll save buying the skunked, stale product they offer.  Yes, skunked, stale product.  I've purchased premium six packs on more than one occasion which were not fit even for the bums outside begging for them.

I always bring my cars here, usually the service is good but i bought my car in today paid for the special 17.99 an d the tire and rim cleaning machine didnt work when my car passed through. Now I don't mind paying the price for a carwash but I think everything should work and if it doesn't they should let you know before you enter. sometimes the triplfoam polish doesn't work and your paying for it and nobody says anything its up to you to catch it. I'm just saying for what I paid everything should work or your ripping people off.

I loved this place from the beginning- it's funky, outside of the 'hipster' scene,  and its small in a way that is coolly exclusive- but in a way that is inviting. Loved the service, loved the options, loved that it's late night and that they make slices available. 
Outside of the music being a bit loud, the problem is the pizza. As a previous poster noted, the sauce is sweet- too sweet. Can't get past it sweet. Literally. I threw most of mine away. 
Maybe some people like it sweet and that's cool.  Would love it though if there were a more savory option.

Still would avoid this place. I received a call from new manager Justin saying how the management is changed and they will take care of my order been not fullfiled by sending a gift card for the order amount as they cannot refund it. Fast forward couple months and never received the gift card and get a call from district manager called Curt Ullery saying he doesn't trust sending $25 gift card inspite showing him proof of conversation going on from months. 

AVOID THIS PLACE AT ALL COST AS THE NEW MANAGEMENT ISN'T ANY BETTER.

Ridiculously poor service. I'd give less than one star if the app allowed it. Ordered a late dinner, and was quoted an hour for delivery -- a little long, but acceptable. Two and a half hours later, it still hadn't arrived... no call, no notice, nothing. After arguing with the menu app helpdesk people to get a refund, we finally get a call AT MIDNIGHT from the delivery man that he's outside (like we usually open the door for people at midnight). I will not be ordering from Purple Pizza ever again, and I urge Ewing residents to avoid this establishment!

Had some transmission issues we'd been putting off until we could afford it. Car was in such bad shape that it couldn't even make it up the driveway to the shop without throwing error codes, it was putting itself in park, etc. Less than 24 hours later, the thing was running like new- AND they managed to also fix a radiator hose, replace the oil sensor, and run an engine flush in that time. I thought for sure our car was toast. Bekim is a GENIUS when it comes to anything mechanical. I'd take my lawnmower to him if I had a yard. Another stellar, easy, trustworthy experience.

Thanksgiving night my boyfriend and I decided to stay for the night. At first when we walked in nobody was around so we left and came back to try again about 15 minutes later.  We came back and the owner was finally back and we paid $100 for one room. When we went up to the room it was pretty cozy and warm. The energy was definitely weird... we stayed on the 3rd floor and I swear we were the only people here. I felt pretty unsafe & we both slept pretty bad. My boyfriend got up to use the bathroom and he cut his leg pretty bad on the side of the bed something sharp was sticking out. I definitely don't recommend paying an overnight visit.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Yummy pizza!  Snappy has come along way with the new owners and management.  I've had great service, food and a better overall experience.  They have changed their recipe for their crust, improving on the flavor!   It's a family-friendly restaurant which is hard to find and a great place for large groups or team dinners.  Reasonably priced and a great selection on the buffet.  They want to keep the pizzas hot and fresh so if my favorites not out, I just request it.  Happy to accommodate!  We'll keep coming back!

The best home cooking I've had in a long time!! Not a fancy place but well worth the stop. My husband had baked chicken and said it was the best he's had in a long time. I wasn't super hungry and had home made cabbage with veggies soup and it was great. They had the best rice pudding for dessert and chocolate cake. The waitresses were super friendly and the service was great! They have beer and wine. Go for the food and not the wine selection. Seems like a family run place. I would highly recommend this place!!

The staff here are the best! I came in with a leaking tire and they immediately checked it out, plugged the leak, filled all other tires and didn't charge a thing!! They didn't try to up sell me on tires, not even a tire rotation with my next oil change. They were completely honest and understanding of my time. 

I have come here before for an oil change and I had a positive experience then too. The waiting area is clean, comfortable and you can watch your car being serviced. I will absolutely keep this place in mind for future needs!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Great Gym at an Amazing price. I paid like $150 for the year, that included a 50 -60 fee. NO contracts all the free weights and machines you could use. Plenty of space for Misc. Activities, when crossfit isn't in session. Nice people, everything you could want. The only bad thing is the men's bathroom which is a complete disaster but if you limit your bathroom breaks to number 1 who cares? The place also has some cosmetic issues with the walls and such but I think it give it character. This place is a lifters dream.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: never go here!  My girlfriend brought our pet here after moving to the area - and it was a huge mistake!!!  Dr. Kramer is nice if you are willing to do what she wants you to do, but if you cannot afford blood work, Xrays and an ultrasound then she won't help you out.  I had to ask four times for a price quote, but by then they had already done $400 worth of tests that I never approved!!! :( :( :(  Her response was, "Well, then you don't care about your dog" - - I asked for my dog back and they refused to give me my pet unless I paid $400!!! NEVER GO HERE- THIS WOMAN IS A CRIMINAL!

Being from out of town we were looking for some place fun to go. So we were just scoping out places. Our Airbnb was literally a half a block from this place. 
I gave this place two stars, only because I witnessed one of the owners literally arguing with a female patron. She appeared really upset and disrespected.
The nonchalant attitude witnessed, coupled with feeling unwelcomed already, we just chose to move on.. As we are planning to relocate to St. Petersburg, we personally feel like this is not an establishment that we will frequent. Hopefully the vibe changes cause it is a nice place... The security outside the door was awesome though..

They do things sub-par even a simple battery hook-up. My car was dead yesterday and the AAA mechanic/tow truck driver said the connectors to the battery terminals - one was loose and the other was not getting a charge whatsoever. It was a new battery purchased from them. I went to the shop for a battery charge after AAA got it running and I told one of the guys behind the counter what happened. He blew up at me! He was yelling, "How do you point fingers!" He was loud and there were other customers in the waiting room. I was embarrassed and close to tears, They refuse to give me a charge because they were "too busy." I won't go back!

It just looks old and dingy, but not dirty. The pool looks like a dungeon it's cold dark and hot tub was closed. I was disappointed because front desk said pool was warm and it was not at all. I would not recommend it. The sheets did not look like they were changed. There was a hair in the bed and sticky toothpaste looking stuff on the blanket. The box springs cover had a stain that looked like blood on it that will probably never be cleaned. The wall has ink scribbles that clearly a child did and they don't intend to do anything about, but I'm sure they charged the customer a fee for the damage.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Super crappy service , I went in to try contacts on for the first time before i moved to California and he was rolling his eyes at me that i couldn't get it in and getting super impatient with me. Now i live in California and had contacts sent over at first he got my name wrong and couldn't find me , my name is Shay but they had me under Ally, and then I emailed him for my glasses prescription and have emailed him at least 6 times asking for it only for him to ignore my emails. Super unprofessional. Won't do it again
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The agent LUIS at Tampa airport was super helpful and friendly. I appreciated only being asked (and not harassed) about the insurance (I have felt harassed by other agents at other companies). The "deal" with the toll pass is ridiculous- $10 flat fee for the day???? when the bridge is $1.25???? good thing I knew better than to take the toll pass. Also that gas must be purchased within 10 miles of airport and receipt must be shown?? ridiculous. i wish there were a really good car rental company. have not found one yet.

Best, most efficient and long lasting dip powder nail work in the area. Linda is fast, thorough and detail oriented. My nails look great even after 3 weeks. The salon is very clean and nicely decorated. It is fresh, modern and bright. I never feel like I am being "juggled" between clients and I love that they honor appointments and take them seriously. I am a professional makeup artist and my hands are in many pictures and videos as I work on my brides and clients. My hands and nails need to look good. SunShine has outshined the competition in the Collegeville area. Pricing is very reasonable. SunShine is my "new normal" for nails.
Jill

Horrible. Absolutely horrible. We didn't even get a meal after an hour and left. Manager came over after we request the check and was not helpful or apologetic, even gave some attitude. Surprised the waiter has a job, he single handedly ruined this restaurant for our family. After he messed up an order of a salad, he gave attitude bringing back the correct one. We went in for a pizza and after about 10 "it will be right out" comments, we had had enough and asked for the check. 

Do not go here if you want good service. Can't speak on the food anymore, didn't stay long enough to eat it.

Mike and his team took a very expensive and hard job and made it their mission to make sure that we completely understood exactly what the vehicle had to have repaired to make it 100% right. What I thought going in was $500 in repairs ended up at $2000. Mike made sure I completely understood exactly what he had to do with his great team. I recommend them 100% ...as a consumer we have to listen to get results and they do not make you feel stupid like so many big out fits do in St Louis. Over the past 25 years I have spent thousands at Dobbs and was never treated half as nice as Mike and his team at Midas on Lemay Ferry in STL.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We made a reservation to dress up and eat at Vincent's Restaurant.  We were disappointed when we walked in the front door and almost tripped on other diners seated at tables close to the door.  We were seated at a table in the back room.  Two tables featured young children with and without young mothers (no fathers).  the 6-12 year old children were up and down and in short constantly moving.  It was difficult to feel that our night was special.  It felt more like eating at McDonald's.  It was ashame because the food was good, but, the children running around dampened our evening out.

We decided to try out the new restaurant Battery on Friday night with another couple. Once we were sat we waited about 10 minutes before anyone greeted our table. Once we were greeted by the server we ordered cocktails/drinks and appetizers immediately. The appetizers came before our cocktails and our drinks took at least 25 minutes to come to our table. We ordered a salad before the meal and had to remind the server to bring out. Once our meals came we had to wait for our 4th guest to get her meal for over 25 minutes. For being a fine dining restaurant in Tampa they have a lot of issues that need to be figured out!

Disappointing. The sauce, cheese and premade crust are all flavorless. The pizza is a good price, if it tasted good. The service is average, the workers seem as sad as the product they're making. The girl cutting the pizza seems to have no skill with fractions, because the slices were cut extremely uneven and too shallow to rip a clean slice off. I DO NOT recommend this place. I would rather walk another mile for the second worst pizza in the city, than to return to this depressing establishment they call "Oath Pizza".

I tried this place and was disappointed.  Some of the rolls were decent but the volcano roll was literally all rice, you could barely see any fish inside at all.  Just about all of the rolls were mostly rice.  I asked the waiter and he told me that's the way the cook makes it.  Sorry NO EXCUSE.  I ask the owner of Winnie q to go to your competitor in Marlton (Sushi Kingdom) and see what kind of quality comes out of their kitchen.  Having a special is great but don't sacrifice quality because its cheap.  People will not come back, like myself with such poor quality for any price.  Do something and do it quick.

Please do not eat here. Likely the highest rated sushi place in the area, but thats because all the sushi in the area is worse than mediocre. The fact that this place has more than 4 stars is beyond me. Very possibly the worst tuna roll ive ever had and it was also one of the most expensive. Katsu don was $17 and it was just a few small pieces of chicken with a ridiculous amount of rice underneath. Chicken was dry as hell and way too chewy. Its just another non-Japanese owned Japanese restaurant that you shouldn't bother wasting your money on.

I went here with a Japanese friend last year. This was the week before they moved to their new location. Sashimi was far from fresh and the meat had that "broken down" feel; as in when it was frozen solid and dethawed. However, the real dealbreaker for me was the long black hair that accompanied the sashimi plate. When my friend pointed out the issue to the employee (in Japanese), there was no apology. She just took the plate away and came back with another one 5 minutes later. Again, no apology. Nothing taken off the bill. I will never visit this place again.

do not ever go here! we came here on vacation and waited over 2 hrs and our food still never came. we ended leaving and asking for our food to go as my 2 yr old had already fallen asleep. do not get the veal mondella, someone else had also mentioned this, the food had way too much lemon flavor and thats it! the veal
was over cooked, my fathers eggplant had too much cheese, and the pasta was undercooked. tastes absolutely horrible with horrible service! the food should have been free but the management were well aware and did nothing to appease their customers!! i would not ever support this business!!!!

My husband rented a car here and had a blowout.  He is 80 years old and they insisted he try and fix it himself or they wouldn't come out to get it.  Needless to say it was a joke and the tow truck guy said that almost never works and the hole was too big in this tire anyway.  Luckily it blew out at a light and not on a highway or he could have been killed. At this point he has NO RENTAL CAR AND HAS TO TAKE A CAB TO THE AIRPORT!! Very poor customer service....phone numbers for help are a circular hell too !!!! Clearly they don't care or want to help.  Never again Hertz!!!!

Awful customer service!! They cannot get a drink right even when you explicitly give your order.  The drive thru is SO slow.  If Im in a hurry, Ill go out of my way to go to the location north on Little in NPR--its faster to drive that much further than wait.  Im at the point where they pay me now because I get a refund when they mess up plus I get a free drink card.  Reported to manager several times--gave up that route.  He couldn't care less--its obvious why his tram is so inadequate.  Unfortunately, the owners are losing money due to manager's inability to train the staff.

The front desk staff does not have knowledge of the app that is supposed to make checking in speedy, etc. It took us 30 minutes to check in and we were the only ones at the desk. A room type we reserved several months in advance was not honored and we were put in an inferior room at a lower rate - with the desk claiming they were discounting us. It was a terrible stay. When I verbally complained at the desk it was ignored. When I complained in writing I was given a canned response of sorry..please come back. If you don't care about where you stay then this is a great place because they dont care about you.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Early Sunday morning the app shows cars are available at the only station close to my apartment. I walk 10 minuets to figure out one car has a flat tire and the other doesn't work. I called customer service just for them to tell me there's nothing they can do! They didn't even bother to credit my account for all the inconvenience they've caused me. This company has zero supervision and only relies on responsible people to report problems if they don't this company won't send anyone to check up. The S Elder station is one of the worst and neglected stations in this city. Definitely not satisfied

Worst car wash ever.  I was duped into getting the "wildcat special"  $25 for nothing.  They ran it through and did nothing else.  I had to ask one of the workers to clean the drivers window because they had sprayed something on it and left it.  The car was supposed to have the wheels done.  Armor All the interior and tires.  None of which were done.  Blue soap deposits all over the car.  I am not a "complainer" but when you pay good money for a service you expect a reasonable effort.  

SAVE YOUR MONEY.  DO NOT USE THIS CAR WASH!

Have you ever been mugged?  Keep an eye on your wallet.  Dr. Perez conducted a number of unnecessary tests on my dog totally $250.  "Renal kidney failure" we need more tests and hundreds more of your dollars.  We said no thank you and went to another Vet.  New Vet said previous tests were not necessary but helpful.  Here are some antibiotics, call back in a week.  New diagnosis - simple infection.  $96 and my dog now has no further health concerns.  All clear and doing great.  No additional ultrasounds, IV treatments or special prescription diet needed.

Whomever is running this operation is completely inept. I rented a car here and had to return it because the plates expired. When I returned it I rented another vehicle and I was charged damage waiver when my company pays for my insurance. I was not even asked if I wanted it or not. Then two days later the new rental's oil change light came on. I was in Omaha and went by a local Avis office and they used extortion to make me get a contract a charged me a one way fee. GET YOUR SELF TOGETHER AVIS AND QUIT RIPPING PEOPLE OFF. GO TO ENTERPRISE INSTEAD.

Bright cheery place with nice helpful staff.  Mod furniture, lighting, and finishes.  nice music selection and not too loud for holding conversations.  

Yummy, creamy yogurt.  Good offering of flavors.  My fav is pomegranate raspberry and original tart with granola, blackberries, and honey.  Lots of fun toppings.  The kids enjoyed mocha, heath bar, and rock chocolates.

My son made a bit of a mess when he dropped his frogurt, but the girl there was super nice and cleaned it up immediately, reassuring me that it was no trouble at all.  Thank you!

San Antonio's is awesome. My 90 year old Dad, who lives nearby, and I went there for a late dinner. We stop in at least once when I come to visit. The Tacos are great. We usually get four different kinds and split them. Get onions and cilantro on the tacos for the perfect taste. The accompaniments are delicious and authentic. They have a large select of Jarritos Soft Drink Flavors too. For all who don't know, they are made with real sugar. The staff is great too. If I didn't live in California, I would eat here once a week. I'll be back! Ok, my name is really George.

Yoko's was very good, even accessible on a Friday night. We (2) were seated immediately and placed our appetizers and drinks. The crab rangoons came out very quickly and were hot and fresh, but the jaletuna poppers took a good amount of time. WORTH THE WAIT, these things were delicious and not terribly spicy. Many of the rolls were good, but the caterpillar and lobster stole the show. Our server was very kind, even assisted us with recommendations on the menu. Beware, food is served family style on a single platter. That caught us off guard, but we ended up enjoying it in the end. Yummy fried ice cream at the end, can't go wrong there.

I have a hot/cold relationship here. It is very convenient, especially with a monthly package and does a pretty good job wash-wise. My problem is with the employee attitude. Examples - My debit card was changed and instead of giving me some type of warning, I got an email just saying I'm dropped. I have been a member since the beginning. Just recently I added a new ceramic wax to my wash for $6 to give it a try. It did not get put on my car. Asked. About it next time in, I was basically told too bad and thanks for the cash.

There are a couple similar washes near me I could test i guess.

Honestly can't even give them a star. Place closes at 12am got here at 1130 pm and there was a cone infront if the intercom. Called them and they said no we should be open I'll have someone check on that. I order and pay and the lady is having me wait for my food and the police pull up behind me so I pull forward mind you still not 12 and someone else was trying to order and they told him they were closed. The police go on to tell me they're closed and then I tell them I ordered and I'm waiting on my food. Very annoyed. Kids shouldn't be in charge of places of business clearly they were trying to close early.

This is the worst fucking McDonald's in New Orleans I ordered a 40pc chicken nuggets with a medium fry on DoorDash and it took 2 hours to get here mind you I stay literally 4 blocks away from the McDonald's...I was on the phone with the door-dasher and he said the line was long as fuck and it wasn't moving then when he got to the window the cashiers were rude as fuck.... Everybody on that nite shift needs to be fucking FIRED or close to whole fucking McDonald's and replace it with a Taco Bell, canes or something because this shit is ridiculous!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Critical: Professionalism, Quality
This car was damaged the dash of my 2004 garage kept Audi S4 convertable.  I brought manager gorge out and explained NOT to be rough on the mid dash panel as it is succeptable to scratches, though it was still close to pristine.  I explained to VERY CAREFUL.  The dash was not only scratched , but had two large GASHES.  This 16 year old classic less than 20k mile.  I'm sick over this.  WORSE YET, HE DENIED THAT THEY DID IT, THOUGH THERE WAS LITERALLY PLASTIC SHAVINGS HANGING OFF THE BOTTOM OF THE SCRATCH!   I had our older pathfinder detailed as well and it was a terrible job.  Do not use this company!!!

We've been going to BMV for over 25 years and we like the vets and staff there. However, I've always been annoyed by the $$ for boarding services and any kind of medical procedure. Today when I picked up our 10 pound dog from dental surgery I knew it was going to be bad and it was. For one impacted tooth, and to remove four nubs of our dog's lower front teeth cost me $1,150. What's worse is I already paid $300 for a pre-op exam that was required before they put our dog under GA. So that's $1,500 for one tooth and four nubs. That's ridiculous. I will now seek other options.

First the good. The lobby is nice and the room was large. Now the bad. The bed was an adjustable bed but the adjuster dial didn't work so it remained in hard as a rock mode. The light by the bed had no switch- just a hole where it used to be so that was inoperable. The chair next to the bed was so dusty I wrote "dust me" on it creating clumps of dust.  
As we checked out I mentioned the problems to the front desk woman who didn't take one note and cared less. 
Thank goodness I don't have to stay here again and it was only one night  We are off to another Hilton in Albuquerque for a week and are hoping for a much better experience
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Stopped here after eating a quick bite at Armature Works. Honestly, I wasn't impressed. I've had much better ice cream at Cold Stone or Brusters. The flavor combinations are interesting but even my kids weren't fans. They had the strawberry shortcake which even though had chunks of shortcake and strawberry, the flavor was just lacking. I had the vanilla and added oreo crumbles. It wasn't bad, but I prefer a creamier texture and flavor to my ice cream. This was more icy and bland. Prices were high too so kind of regretting the almost $30 bucks I paid for a few scoops of mediocre ice cream.

Had a VERY unprofessional experience with Tucson Differential--made me drive across town for 30 min for scheduled appointment, and then never got to my car... TWICE! Was told by the manager that he was on the phone too much with customers, and that's why he never got to my vehicle. I never received a call warning me that he wasn't going to get to my car either time. I need my car to work, and couldn't leave it overnight, without making my wife drive 2 hours to get me to work. Was referred by a trusted mechanic, but was very disappointed.

I will start by saying the food is absolutely amazing. This is why I am giving 2 stars. However, service was terrible. Our waiter, also the bartender, was rude, short, and not attentive at all. They seemed to be short staffed. Maybe that's why he was so rude. When he realized we were not ready to order he simply walked away. Once we received our salads we sat for 20 minutes waiting on silverware. By this time I was very irritated and ready to go. We ended up getting our food to go. I purchased a Groupon for and immediately requested a refund. If bad customer service will mess up you appetite...go elsewhere.

Within an hour of lying down in bed I felt bites on my neck. I turned over the pillow and there were 2 giant bed bugs.  I killed them with a kleenex and photographed two other bed bugs.  The front desk sent "engineers" to inspect who clumsily tossed around my sheets, shrugged and said they couldn't find anything.  So the manager told me there was no evidence of bed bugs.  I showed her the two photos below of bed bugs on the sheets then showed her the physical bed bug on the kleenex below, and she said, "That could be anything."
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Big shout out to the bellman, Allen, who took the initiative to help out a set of new parents. The rooms don't have refrigerators, and we needed a place to store breast milk while we explored before checking out. The front desk refused to help and was dismissive of our request. But then, out of nowhere, Allen offered to personally take and store the breast milk in a refrigerator designated for staff. Why the front desk couldn't offer this I'll never understand, but I'm so, so grateful Allen stepped up to resolve the situation...breast milk is a prized commodity for new moms.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
When whent in it was nice and frendly until i orderd.
The guy didnt even help me with the menu and after i orderd it ans i got my pizza my onions were missing, after me waiting doe them to arive i asked the person to get me a rifill on my drink and my onions as nice as posible but i have notced something, during me ordering he didnt look like he got when i said i wanted onion rings and i said it 3 times.
And at the end i had to ask someone else to get my onion rings.
Overall a tereble and expensive place to go and honestly your better off going to another place to get food.

Pizza is great. Ambiance is good for kids, not so great if you want a quiet meal. Service is POOR. They need a manager. Went for lunch and there were 4 dirty tables outside and 5 couples waiting to be seated. Three left before they started to clear the tables. After 20 minutes the tall guy came out to seat people. When we pointed out to the tall guy that they were loosing customers because they hadnt bussed the tables, he gave us a lot of lip about how not everyone can sit outside. He almost lost us too.  This is not the first time we have been disappointed by the service and the "so what" attitude.

Every National Car Rental around the country (and I've seen a bunch traveling 40 weeks out of the year) have an excellent car selection that includes higher end cars (Chrysler 300's, Chevy Impala's, Toyota Avalon's, Chevy Suburban's, etc.) in the Executive section.  Tampa, on the other hand, seem to only have Chevy Malibu's, Hyundai Elantras and Nissan Altima's.  All OK cars but not as nice as other National locations.  This has been my observation over the last FOUR times that I have used National in Tampa.

Pretty good Publix market, but the fish department needs better QC. The deli is okay, but not up to the level of some of the sister stores in the area. Friendly staff, great produce, and above average organic selection for a Publix. 

I appreciate the covered parking on hot days. Self checkout is a nice feature for a small number of items.

My main concern is that I have purchased "fresh" fish there on a number of occasions, and once I got it home it was really not fresh - almost to the point where it was unusable. It would be expected that the quality of the product is on par with the cost.

Terrible customer service. Dropped a car off in the morning only to be told after I called them four hours later to see about my car that I was told. That it wouldn't be ready because the part was delivered to the wrong store and my car would need to sit overnight. Incredibly poor customer relation skills. Told me that "things happen" so get over it. I wouldn't recommend that anyone take their car to people who can't bother to do their job and check on things. An embarrassment to the industry to say the least. If I could give them negative stars I would. Tucson Mall location in particular.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This is a great little italian place. I just got back from rome this summer and was still craving the food. It wasn't quite sidewalk cafe excellence, but it was pretty darn good. especially considering the cost and the fact that its in the middle of a college neighborhood. The best part was the owner. He was this kind italian man and he got all excited when I spoke my little bit of broken italian to him. And it was my birthday so he gave me a free desert- a pastry with nutella. it was delicious. Great service, very good food. Will certainly be returning.

Pros: recently renovated, clean comfortable rooms.  Great location walking distance from restaurants and even the arch.

Cons: 
Noise: this is an old hotel with very thin walls.  We could clearly hear the TV and light conversation from the room next door.  Area restaurants and bars have outdoor music which goes until about 11pm. You can hear every word of every song.
Parking: the garage is in the next block over
Package receipt: this is handled completely by the FedEx Office location in the basement and the receipt fees they charge are steep and service is slow.

Suggestion: ask for a room not overlooking the street to avoid the music problem.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I do not recommend staying at the Marriott St. Louis Grand. The one star review is due to their customer service (or lack thereof) and the charge for WiFi. I have traveled extensively and have not been charged for WiFi in years. Also, the staff at check in was not at all welcoming. There was a problem with my mother's reservation and the gentleman checking us in would not even research it. We had to come back later and follow up with someone else. My room faced an inner "courtyard" that looked at concrete slab and a large vent.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: i placed a mobile order here today & i usually don't have a problem but the lady at the drive thru was so rude. she accidentally gave me the wrong order & so i came back around to get the correct order & i was greeted with "what do you need" with an attitude at the window. uh??? my original order not someone's else's?? so she basically throws my order at me & once i get home i realize my egg & cheese wraps HAVE NO EGGS!!! i don't want to be one to complain but the lady in the window was just so rude and they weren't even busy so i can't understand the attitude i got from her when i wasn't rude at all

Epic fail in new room service. Was taken aback at the limited menu when I arrived in my room after flying from LA, called down to ask if this was it and the individual said yes, it's a new take on room service. A panini, bottle of water and bag of chips for $22. That includes a $5 delivery fee plus a gratuity. 

First bite of sandwich, won't finish it. The chicken tastes funny. As a Marriott Elite Gild or Platinum over the course of the last 20 years, this was really bad. Very disappointed in the quality, offerings and service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The hotel is very nice staff are extremely nice and near plenty of bars. However the rooms are expensive and the perks are not good. For almost $200 a night you have to pay for parking, pay for breakfast, no free drink passes for the bar, no pool, no microwave in the room, and the rooms are not that big. P.S we couldn't  even check out late. However the cheaper Marriott hotels we've been very satisfied with. Price is not worth it. I much rather be on the out skirts with better perks then be downtown where I barley went out at.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Very trashy bar that I would NOT recommend going to. My boyfriend and I were dancing to the band minding our own business when a waitress named Nee came up and quite literally forced test tube shots on us. They were disgusting and she charged us $50 and was rude and unprofessional about the whole situation.

If a bar has to resort to these types of tactics, it shows you the low class type of establishment that they are. Would recommend checking out Maison Bourbon for a classier and more enjoyable experience!

I was very pleased with our stay here. The staff were nice and helpful. The room was clean, bathroom was good size. Linens were clean and bed was comfortable. I generally have trouble sleeping in any bed other than mine, but I had no problem here. (And no, it wasn't the drinks ;) ). 
Breakfast was pretty good, eggs, sausages, waffles, danish and muffins; Oatmeal and toast. Juice and let's not forget the coffee. 
Hotel is within walking distance to the French Quarters. But far enough away for a quiet stay. 
Pool is a little small, but nestled in a nice courtyard. 
The next time my husband and I visit New Orleans we will stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Great staff, I love working out here.
My problem is the lack of cleaning machines (frames are all dirty with prints) and no enforcement of wiping down when club members leave a machine! Even before the Pandemic, wipe down has been common courtesy forever! Seinfeld even did an episode on it decades ago. It needs to be enforced ! 
8 weeks without a gym was a disaster, be proactive should another round come up...and God forbid an outbreak be traced back to this club. 

I love working out at Planet Fitness, Please teach the Club members, I've been to other locations where it is 100% compliance...thank you.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I had been a loyal customer for over ten years and never had any issues.  Took my car to get washed this morning and made the mistake of leaving my iPhone plugged into the charger in the center console.  When I got back into my car after it was washed, I immediately noticed that my phone had been stolen by one of the employees.  All the woman at the front desk did for me was tell me that only the manager had access to the footage from the security cameras and that he would not be in until the following day.  The Lower Merion Police were there within minutes and were more than helpful.  Never again.

I had my shocks and struts replaced here in October 2015. after driving on the new strut for two months I had a noise that sounded like a failure of the strut mount. After inspection it was discovered the new strut had failed.

The manager Allen Lavaty replaced the strut and covered all labor free of charge. I was impressed that when there was a problem found, they immediately corrected the problem and repaired my vehicle at no additional cost. They proved to me that they stand behind their work and their service.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Enjoyed the Neely's BBQ but have to tell you, the bar/server, Calvin, was the worst. No eye contact, gave food order - no acknowledgment. Had to get his attention later and ask if he heard the order (he was entering it in the computer as my friend and I talked about it, which we didn't know), he said yes, handed us the bill and said: 'I'd appreciate if you close this out now, I want to get out of here".  Loved Nashville - everyone was so welcoming...except Calvin, my last experience before boarding the plane.

I moved here in May of this year not knowing anything about the apartments much less new orleans. I took a gamble and signed a leasse because i needed a place to stay immeditately.  They had friendly staff and the rent was decent so it was a good start to my gamble. SInce May i can honestly say my gamble paid off. Apartments are clean, safe and quiet. No problems at all.
not knowing anything about the are i was surprise to find that i was close to everrthing i needed.........food, mall, bars, grocery stores etc..... Its worth a look.

I usually really like this place because it's convenient and the rental prices are usually really good and the people are always friendly and about as quick as can be expected.  

HOWEVER - this is about the third time in the last year that I get out in the middle of Winter and no ice scraper!!  The car had been over the road - with about 28,000 miles on it so not a beater, but also should probably be out of the fleet by now.  Left rear tire was showing low most of the trip (via the sensor) - but it never got below a safe level, just an annoying warning on the dash.

Horrible customer service.  

The old Asian lady is rude and doesn't care about giving good customer service.  I took 6 shirts there and I noticed the collars were all pressured crooked when I got home.  I brought them back the next day and she said they were okay.  I told her they weren't and asked her to repress them.  

She said no, and further added she would not give me a refund.  I went here once before last year  and they messed up a pair of pants by adding another set of creases beside another crease.  Poor quality, higher than normal prices, poor service.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Worst car rental experience ever!  I'm a preferred member and should have bern able to walk to my car and drive away. But no! THIS IS THE 4th time my car has not been ready. My name was not on the list, the car assigned to me from the mobile app was not in the assigned parking space and no one is in the preferred office. So, had to go to the regular office. 30 people in line with 2 workers who have no sense of urgency. ITS NOT LIKE YOU DIDN'T KNOW WE WERE COMING. And, I arrived here at 12:30 am, it's now 12:45 and still people in front of me.

I have been a loyal customer for many years and always considered this place to be the best in STL. Today was the worst experience... the wait was well over an hour to get the two pizzas and one of the pizzas was a reheat special. The pizza was chewy and tasted old. I called Tom (one of the many managers I guess) and after consulting with the rest of the management team (seems like they have a manager for everything) they denied the claim. Something has changed at this previously wonderful pizza place. Not the same any more. Sad

Fantastic little restaurant off of St. Charles.
Wasn't a fan of their calamari, but the house salad was decent and the house chicken soup was very good. We shared the Fettuccini Alfredo and Veal Parmigiana, both were extremely well cooked with incredible taste! To wrap up the night, we shared a hearty cannoli that was well worth it!

Don't go in without a reservation :$, or if you do expect to wait in a small crowded restaurant.
The staff was great! The owner Tony was around and greeted us. Certainly a nice dinning experience. :D

The smell hits you like a brick the moment you walk in the door.  A mix of body odor, stale smoke and urine.   Fortunately this is just in the lobby and not in the rooms.  The plus side is it's quiet.   The bed is older and not completely uncomfortable.   The "breakfast" is a joke.  The coffee served here is, I'm sure, a violation of the Geneva Convention on the treatment of war prisoners.   But the condition of the room is the real issue here.  As you approach the door you get the impression that there was a murder crime scene inside.   Once you open the door those suspicions are confirmed.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Poor service, we asked to sit outside... the hostess told us no but just sat us by the patio door and said, "you'll warm up as the door opens and closes." What I learned as we sat here looking at the patio, was that it's full of their workers taking smoke breaks (despite the posted no smoking sign) so we had to smell smoke the whole time whole their was a steady stream of breaks. 

Ordered the unlimited salad, they never came around to ask if we wanted more.

Overall, would not come back to this location or recommend.

I have been ordering pizzas from here for a few years now. I really enjoy them but they seem to have a problem cooking the pizza enough most of the time. Requesting it well done seems to fall on deaf ears. Also if they don't have a topping they seem to just leave it off and not take the charge off. At a few bucks for a "premium " topping ... that sucks. A few times (ordering online) I have waited an hour just to have the status change from on its way to order cancelled. Now, I wasn't charged in those instances but with places closing earlier due to covid it means I'm not going to be able to order food that night.

I'v been meaning to write this for some time, Modern eye is simply the most outstanding relationship I have had with a business ever. I no longer live in philadelphia, but I always plan my new glasses along with visits to philly. Even across the country in portland, it's worth waiting. Kate is one of the most incredible humans, and I very much appreciate the way she and the rest of the wonderful staff do business. I can be a pain in the butt demanding customer, and they have never once failed to step up to the plate, Love em...
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is probably the worst macaroni grill I have ever been to. Just came here for some dinner last week. When we first walked in we were greeted by the hostesses who were very nice and polite took us to our table. The bread was rock hard, and when we asked for a new piece it took over 15 minutes to bring us more. The food was cold and when I asked to speak to a manager ms. Angela came out. She was very unprofessional with her overly long nails. She asked us a few questions but did not seem to really care about our food and experience. She even "mmmhhh" us.
