We ordered food for pick up, and by the time I got it on my plate the soft corn tortillas for my veggie tacos were very mushy and soggy. Not a big deal just a little disappointing, but I'm sure that would've been avoided if we sat down and were served our food fresh. I ended up just eating the contents of each taco with their tortilla chips which added a nice crunch (they gave us a LOT of chips- three bags full). The salsas were really tasty and I'm very pleased with the flavor of the veggie tacos! All very good options full of flavors and delicious ingredients. All around a good option if you're craving Mexican food or authentic street tacos!

The available options for toppings was robust and very exciting.  I ordered a medium Reece's Pieces concrete because I love Reece's Pieces.  However, I was disappointed when I received my order.  My custard was really light on toppings.  I ate about half of it before finding a topping.  There were a few more at the bottom but it was not enough to redeem it.  The prices weren't cheep so you would think think that they could afford to load them up.  Look, I love all ice cream or frozen custard so it was fine but I think I would have been just as satisfied with a vanilla ice cream cone.

They closed 15 minutes EARLY! He saw me pull up in my car at 3:45pm and I was getting my wallet, open sign light still on, then he saw me get out lock the door and walked to the back. I was knocking on the door a for 2-3 minutes and looked around the corner made eye contact and continued cleaning. Finally come to the door and said he is closed and he has to leave at four and closed, I said your sign is closed at 4pm and I am wanting to give you obey. He said he didn't care and that he is closed, I asked him if he was serious and he said yes and he has other things to do and continued cleaning.

I have been coming here for over 5 years and until today was generally satisfied. Service was abysmal and no one cared. The owner-manager did not show up until at least 35 minutes after problem began and blamed lazy help and Covid. One long term experienced employee expressed shame and embarrassment about absent management and lazy co-workers.

Manager told me he can't get it fixed. Starting with that attitude he has already defined the outcome. He observed employees not doing their job and failed to even try to manage. 

One last chance and then time to find a new carwash.

My experience at Omega was well beyond any expectations from start to finish.  The optometrist was thorough and informative throughout the exam.  The optician (Tracy) was remarkable!  For the 1st time ever, I was given a complete description of my insurance benefits along with co-pays for progressive lenses, tinting, etc.  I knew exactly what I was paying for as we went through the process and my glasses were ready within the timeframe promised.  I am extremely satisfied with my glasses and the service I received at Omega hence the 5 star rating.  Will definitely be a returning customer!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: It's hit or miss here. I've come and had really good service with beautiful nails and other times left in disbelief. I think it's pricey here so I expect a good result when I leave which doesn't always happen. If you like to gamble with your nails go ahead but I doubt I'll be back. 2 out of 3 times most recently they were horrible, uneven lengths, gel was lumpy, and bad paint job. Oh, and forget about pointing something out. They start talking about you in Vietnamese and all come over telling you why you're wrong.

I would never go back. When I decided to tell the person washing the car that there were bugs on the headlights and on the mirror he said I would have to ask the lady In charge about them. He stated they wouldn't come off so I asked for his rag and got it off in a second. I then had to do this around the whole car as I saw bugs. also I decided to pay the extra $5 to get the rims done with the basic wash and they don't even put tire shine on the tires they just wiped the rims with soap. The lady told me the tire shine was extra and so was drying the door jambs.

If you are under 30 years old. DO. NOT. BANK. HERE. This bank is very slow with processing, can not multitask and has slow staff. There are barely any members of this bank and constantly the system is down, ATM and nothing is technology advanced. Zelle is a joke. You can't even deposit through the ATM. The app is a joke. Always a scam or scandal. There are only 3 staff members that are polite and professional. The members of the team at the drive through window do not even say hello or good morning. Avoid this bank by all cost. Please save your self the headache. Go down the street to TD or a credit union.

Good sushi. I ordered the sashimi deluxe and got very small cuts of fish though. They have consistently been small so I don't think I will get it again. I've seen that most of the cuts have gotten smaller with the new owners (the husband is a sushi chef there and of couse makes those decisions).
 I usually sit in the bar area and also wish the owners and bartender would help to control some of the loud cursing that happens there on occasion with some regulars. I have actually just closed and left when it starts up.

We placed an order 2 hours ago, we were told that our order was received and ready. However, when we arrived to pick up our order they had no record of our order (according to those at the front counter). They proceeded to tell us that they found our order after some time, but that we would still have to wait 10+ minutes to receive it, so the order had still not been started. Horrible organization at this business. Do not count on your order being ready when the website says, count on waiting at least an extra hour. Very disappointing service.

I had driven passed this establishment for a couple years before I stopped in for the first time a few months ago. I am very pleased i stopped in. Their Tan-Tan Ramen with egg is worth a drive north! The broth is not as salty as I have experienced other places and you will finish the last drop. 
I have also had the Tuna and Beef tataki and they are very good. My personal choice is the beef. They do their own special twist on the sauce that I really like. 
The restaurant is very clean, the staff are very welcoming, and the overall experience is excellent. If you live in the area check them out as we have a gem in our neighborhood.

This location seriously needs to be checked by the health department. I've seen roaches crawling in the dining area during times I've spent eating in this restaurant & what tops it's off is the roaches crawling around the ice cream in the Baskin area it's disgusting I couldn't believe it. Then on another few encounters in the store I've noticed an employee not wearing gloves while Making my meal orders, sanitation is the first thing in training I don't understand why things like this aren't handle properly at this store .

This was one of the worst experiences I've had the wait is ridiculous and I waited 2 hours for it I asked for 
3 glazed
3 lemon filled
3 maple
3 krispy kreme special
And what they gave me was completely wrong and I had a 30 minute drive home so I was super upset when I opened it there was 
3 chocolate 
2 maple
6 glazed
1 Krispy Kreme special
I will never go back there and I don't recommend going there especially with the bad service and horrible wait time you're better off going to doughboys and paying $1 less per dozen

My cat was having some issues, and they were able to get me in the same day I called, which was good because it ended up being life threatening.  They took care of my cat in addition to giving me some food recommendations in the area (I just recently moved here).  My cat's issue now requires a prescription food.  I ran out of the food during the weekend, and the Vet, Scott Griffith, outside of business hours (Sunday), took care of calling in a prescription so that I could give my cat her proper food.  Great customer service.  Above and beyond!

This is the worst apartment complex I've ever lived in. If I could give no stars I would. Spend just five minutes and research the owners of this Realestate group. They will rip you off for sub standard repairs and poor maintenance. The manager of this place is a scam and has no clue how to manage or run a business. The amenities advertised are a scam and sub par. The office staff have no control over things and answer to a clearly horrible leadership. Car break ins are common and nothing will ever get done. The automatic gate constantly is not working and takes weeks to be repaired. Horrible place. Don't stay here.

I really wanted to like this place, but they fell short. The restroom has 3 stalls. The toilet in the 1st stall was broken, the 2nd stall was occupied and the third stall toilet was covered in feces. They did not have hot water in the restroom. They keep food in large garbage can like containers within sight of the patrons (I know most restaurants do this but it isn't usually visible to the customers). The food was brought out and our corn tortillas were dropped on the floor, after promising to bring more the waiter was never seen again.

OMG!!! The best Mexican food I've had in California! Just WOW!!!! I had the Chicken Tamale, Chile Relino and Enchilada combo! So delicious I can't get over it. I'm Indian so I have a sophisticated palate when it comes to food, this food satisfied my palate!!! They serve the salad, guacamole and sour cream in a separate container so it remains fresh. The taste is so authentic! I am so impressed with this place and would HIGHLY recommend it to anyone visiting Carpinteria or passing by on the 101 freeway. Kudos to the chef and friendly staff!!! Thank you!

I've been there a few times for dinner with some locals who are fans. The first time I went I was a little worried because the outdated decor suggested a sketchier, lower-quality restaurant. However, everything I've had there so far has been quite good. 

The menu is a little long and overwhelming, and not as informative or organized as I'd like. Twice I've just given up, described what I was looking for, the waiter suggested a dish, and it all worked out well.

Overall, nothing incredible, but consistent and satisfying. I'm happy to return.

Stopped to get breakfast.  Ordered a sausage and egg mcmuffin meal with 2 pumpkin pies since they never have the strawberry pies the promote.  Got home and had an egg and ham mcmuffin with 2 apple pies.  Called the store 4 times before someone finally answered.  Because they didn't give me a receipt, they want me to run back 20 minutes away, return that order to get it replaced.  I can see why they have such a poor rating.  This is NOT the first time they've messed up my drive thru order, just the first time that I'm aggravated enough with their handling of the situation and comments that make me want to write a review.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: You know it's typically a SMASH hit at Pizza Delisc, but today the pizza was a bit cold and uneven (sort of like a 18" floppy disk") and, well, the cheese was spotty and THEN the soda machine wasn't working properly. Um, here's the #1 thing with this place ... If you're not ordering a PIE, then you're just getting the equivalent of "day after" pizza ... Reheated in an oven that's not appropriate for pizza ... Adequate but not GOOOODDDD.  But today my PIE SUCKED and well they should just fire the stoner who made it ... Still the best pie in New Orleans though .... Carry on Pizza Delicious ... To the French Quarter already, hello?!?!

The service was awful the woman who did mine else didn't even take off all of the old pain when refilling my nails. Also stafd was very very rude,  1st telling me I can use my debit card to pay and then once I was at the register the lady at the table behind the register cap saying pull cash out of the atm. Then the artist who was at the register try saying the same thing yes cash better... Once I said no you told me I can use the card they snickered ,  Like it wasn't good enough and they were disappointed. But I did leave a cash tip, comma honestly I name I didn't like the overall overall nail design I'd give it a 2 star

Came here around 11:30am on a Saturday before my flight, it wasn't super busy. I ordered the BBQ pulled pork sliders, onion rings, and a beer. My lunch was tasty and filling. Good for airport food. The service was fine. 

My only complaint was it was awkward to see they had a "General Jackson" burger on the menu. I mean, I know I'm in the South but.... who is going to order that out loud when most of the staff is people of color? General Jackson belongs in the history books and museums not on my plate. Get with the times already, there are so many other awesome things in TN to name your burger after!

I've been coming to Gina for a few years now, and I always walk away happy. Coming from NYC, where a color session can easily cost $400, I was wary of how a local salon would do. Not only have I gotten consistently beautiful color and cuts, they are affordable and do their best to fit me in when I realize my hair needs help! I truly cannot recommend Textures, and Gina in particular, more. Everyone is a kind and welcoming, and they are taking COVID precautions very seriously. I felt very safe getting my hair done today.

I have never written a yelp review before so this is a big deal for me! I moved to New Orleans just about 4 years ago from Boston and for 4 years I have been looking for a pizza place in New Orleans that tasted like home... I could not be more happy to report that I have found it! Every other pizza I have tried in New Orleans either resembles something they would make at dominos or is "gourmet" and is essentially cheese and tomatoes on burnt thin toast... All I can say is that my days of eating mediocre pizza here in New Orleans have finally come to an end! No more 300$ plane tickets just to get the pizza I so desperately missed!

Booked a queen bedroom for 3 days and was disappointed to find a major damp floor leading from the bedroom to the bath area. I resolved it to the AC unit in the room. 

I mainly had the unit set to heat however the floor got so wet that I ended up leaving it off for both nights. Yes, 2 nights because the hotel was full. I made a report to the front desk when I first discovered the issue. 

I don't recommend eating anything other than breakfast from this place since there are plenty of fine eateries in the nearby French Quarter. 

Staff friendly enough but don't expect too much. 

Will not repeat.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: One of the doctors at this location was absolutely rude and essentially told me to put my animal to sleep because she assumed he had rabies. Come to find out from a different vet, the animal has a broken leg. If this vet would have taken the time to x-ray his leg she would have easily seen he was limping for that exact reason. She clearly has no heart for strays and has no interest in helping animals with actual needs other than charging people for unnecessary costs. Needless to say, I am very disappointed. The cat is now 100% normal, unchanged by any of her choices or recommendations. Very glad I got a second opinion.

My credit card was recently switched by another bank to this one.  I had a question about a recurring payment.  Every SINGLE time I call either of the two phone numbers listed for the card, and that is many, many, times, I get a busy signal.  It's my guess these aren't valid numbers at all.  When I try to "register" on line to ask a question, they insist I give my social security number.  That's just a flat NO.  Too many banks get hacked so I'm not providing that on-line to ask a simple question.  As a result, I already am dissatisfied with this new bank and expect I will NEVER use their credit card.

The thing is, everyone usually talks about the sushi in O'Sake. I feel that what really differentiates O'Sake from Samurai across the street is that it actually serves warm food beyond appetizers. I really enjoyed the pork cutlet and I would eat it really often before the menu got changed and it got removed :(. I also tried the yaki udon, the ramen, and the bulgogi (yes, I know, it's not Japanese food, but still..) and I moderately enjoyed all three items. If you're someone who lives near the place (like me), this is THE place to get quality warm Japanese or Korean food.

Unsure if they're still getting use to seeing the public more frequently due to covid restrictions being lifted, but with that being said I will not be bringing my dog here for a WHILE. one of the veterinary techs I believe her name was Nikki, treated my dog so poorly. He was clearly nervous and she forced him inside with no patience or anything. After I had mentioned it to her she had given me the nastiest attitude about the situation. People with these jobs should be caring and compassionate, not in a rush to get through appointments by traumatizing & dragging the poor animals. Neglect!

I moved from NY to FL to find that Japanese Hair Straightening was far more expensive in my new area. I later found Anna Bang Hair Design that did the straightening for a reasonable price. It ended up being a 3 hour drive for me, but it was well worth it! The process took less time than it has for me in the past and the results were perfect! The salon is nice and comfortable and they are very knowledgeable, friendly and professional! I will definitely be back! I recommend Anna Bang Hair Design to anyone looking for a professional hair straightening solution and great service.

In the past 16 months, I've tried five different stylists in four different well rated NOLA salons.  Finally, I've found the stylist, colorist, and salon that deserves recognition.   Having moved from San Diego, with a very red and very textured short cut, I was hard pressed to find my expectations met  until I discovered Paul and Erica at Stardust.  Paul is attentive, fearless and cuts hair with true passion.  Erica is genuinely sweet and gave me the deep, rich red that previous colorist just didn't make happen.  The salon itself is shabby chic, and a cool place to hang.   Love the place and my new team.

Alright. Jeni's is clearly a fan favorite, and don't get me wrong, the ice cream is good. But the workers were so rude it tainted the taste for me. I love the  amount of variety in their flavor options, and you really can't go wrong no matter what you pick. But, considering a single scoop in a cone is $5, with some tax, I would expect better service. No greeting when I walked in, no smiles except for from the woman working the register. It is a busy Friday night, but they have at least 4 people working and I am disappointed in Jeni's. If you're looking for good ice cream, GO TO CLEMENTINE'S! Look it up, it will be worth it.

So this is my first ever food or restaurant review ive ever made in my life. I went to this locations drive through today and waited 45 minutes to get a coffee and a donut. I was not frustrated, as I used to work in the food industry and understand how busy things can get sometimes. But, after realizing there were only three cars in line, and after pulling up to the window seeing only one of the three On shift actually working, while the other two were cussing about customers in complaining about how busy it was in front of my face, I decided I will no longer be returning to this location.

We were going to another restaurant down the street but decided to give this a try.  Food was good and service was excellent.  Place was relatively clean but I have to say we were a little hesitant in the beginning after seeing only a handful of patrons in the dining area.  However, more people started filing in after we sat down and the place was quickly filling up by 9PM.  We ordered a few Cantonese dishes and they didn't disappoint.  Wait staff was very attentive (not always the case in Chinatown) and helpful.  Would come here again.

So we decided to try out Ninja and branch out! We were a little disappointed to say the least. We were sat immediately but once sat it went downhill for sure. We sat for 15 min without a server taking our drink or food order. We then waited another hour before our food came. It was missing two sushi rolls  and rice. They also brought the wrong roll out. We didn't get a chance to tell them this though because they didn't come back to check on us for another 20 min. They did bring the right food once we mentioned it but overall our experience lacked. Hope your experience will be better if you try here!

Super disappointed after tonight. I've been coming to and ordering from Tres Jalapenos for years and have always loved it. Tonight I order an appetizer and a platter at 6:00pm and was told it would be about 45 minutes. After an hour and a half passed by I called and was told it was on its way and it would be right here. Another 15 minutes went by and was told she never gave the kitchen the ticket and they would only offer 30% off the next time around. As if I'm going to order delivery again. It's been an hour and 40 minutes and the food has yet to come.

My brother had been before and he had a terrible experience, but I thought it was probably just the barber that was assigned to him. I went today and I got probably the worst haircut of my life. I'm generally not picky about the way my hair looks, but it was truly horrible. First of all, my hairstylist cut my bangs way too short. And now looking at my hair, it's very uneven and extremely choppy. She shampooed my hair about 3 times, so now it's really stripped and dry. Moreover, receptionist was dismissive and unclear. Overall, really bad experience -- go to a hair salon that actually has good reviews, even if it's a little out of your way.

Rented from the BNA Alamo twice within a month, and they were awesome both times.  The first time they were running bizarrely short on cars and at first gave us a car that was making strange noises, but upon return the manager took care of us personally and gave us a couple comps to make up for the delay.  The second time was a one-way rental and went flawlessly - the same manager took care of me in person and the experience was everything I could ever ask of a rental car company.  They had great prices both times as well - booking via Alamo.com will usually provide the best deal.

In town for the Saints playoff game on a Saturday. LSU/Alabama national championship game was on Monday so pretty much every hotel in town was booked. Stumbled upon this gem and stayed here for one night. Neighborhood is sketchy, but the Crescent is very close to the dome for a cheap cab ride. Security gate closes at night so there was no need to worry about your car. Room was clean and stocked with everything, including a fridge. Don't take your wife here on the honeymoon, but great place to stay for the night. Excellent bang for your buck. Recommended.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Extremely rude owner. The young tech with the glasses is very sweet. 
I brought my elderly mother over and we brought our own colors bc my mother is picky. I believe we left them at the salon and I called to ask bc my mom was ready for another manicure.
The owner said we have many colors come and see I'm busy and hung up on me. This was 5 minutes after opening and you can't take one minute to answer a phone call and provide customer service? Too bad bc I was ready to give you my business even though there are a ton of salons to choose from. I am at work and had a sitter ready to bring her by so I couldn't "come over" to check.

The people who work here are incredibly friendly, respectful, and very customer service minded. This is a great Mexican restaurant but very different than the typical. The food is delicious and the presentation is beautiful. The restaurant is clean, the service is fast, and the prices are extremely reasonable. The atmosphere is nice but not what you expect for a Mexican restaurant - pretty average - but the staff and food make up for it.  My family eats here quite often and we always have a great experience.

Looking over reviews seems their customer service has improved...in 2017 had bad experience here.  I had walked in before signing in greeted by manager/owner told him wanted fills and pedi so seated me for pedi when done with pedi seems I was overlooked for the fills i told reminded them about the fills I also asked for then told to wait at a empty nail station for 45 minutes...it was humiliating while others walked in getting there service right away I was still there waiting, never an apology, never went back again

Food was amazing. Katsu sauce had a bit of mustard(?) in it which made it unique and delicious. Chef brought out some special dish that is coming out on Halloween which included flavored chip with various vegetables including avocado marinated along with chunks or sushi. We also ordered tempura's and it was fried just right.

As entree, we had sushi boat with 2 different types of rolls. Sashimi were in a very fresh condition and rolls had just the right amount of sauce; not too strong but enough to bring out roll's flavor.

Loved all the food here and will definitely come back to try other menu.

This is the closest McD's near my home but I go out of my way to the south and occasionally north to avoid this McDonalds at 5309 US 19 NPR. They constantly get my order wrong and when the do get it right, it is not hot and fresh! I have lived near this store many years and when they got their construction face lift a few years back I was hoping the food and service would improve...Wrong! I am surprised corporate allows this below par McDonalds to continue to operate this way. I think they need to re staff this establishment. Just had to finally say something.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Had amazing and friendly service this morning! I ordered a new drink, an iced snickerdoodle latte while my boyfriend stuck to his typical, an iced vanilla latte. I also asked for a surprise baked good and was not disappointed one bit. Everything was absolutely delicious and we also received a pup cup for our pup:). I'll be completely honest and say that I haven't gotten coffee here in awhile because the past few times it wasn't the greatest, but I think they definitely redeemed themselves and I will be visiting more often. The prices are also very good compared to other coffee places. I would recommend anyone to try if they hadn't already!!

Went to this Meineke location for a full synthetic oil change after having problems with other locations. They were the only location in the area that accepts Meineke's current oil change coupon. Sal was very helpful, they got my car in for the oil change quickly and were ready for me to drive home in under an hour even though they had a couple other vehicles to work on as well. I hate taking my car to any auto centers because usually I have problems, but with this location, I couldn't have asked for a better experience!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Reading the reviews (which were all old) I was a bit nervous coming here with our children. The women at the front desk were amazing....very kind, patient, and communicated very clearly and professionally. We saw Dr. Snyder who was equally both kind and professional. I even asked the front desk staff if I could take their picture because of how negative the reviews I had read were. I also wanted others reading this to see who they would be meeting if they come here! When I need an exam I will be coming here as well now.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: By far the worst customer service I have ever experienced. The female manager turned away myself & 2 other customers at 8pm on Monday 1/10/2022. That's 3 different people who all had reservations booked and paid for through our companies. Why would she turn down business that was already agreed upon and paid for in advance? My interpretation, she was not interested in working but only wanted social hour with the other 5 people at the desk doing absolutely nothing. I went to Hertz had no problem & was out the door in 10 minutes.

This was the worst service I have received. I walked in, picked out my nail color, and sat for A FULL HOUR before I even got seated in a chair and someone asked me what color I wanted. I told the guy what color (it was plain white) and he comes back 5 minutes later saying he couldn't find it. I told him it was white, and he disappears for 10 minutes. I don't know if he ever came back because I just left. I was there for an hour and a half, and didn't even get helped. Every girl sitting around me got helped, and people that came after me finished before I was seated.  I will never come back to this salon.

The owner of this place has no sense of customer service. We brought  a party of 10 in on a Saturday night at 8pm and made to wait for 30 minutes and pushed into a booth for 8. Asked to get another table and owner got nasty with us and told us to leave as he had reservation that were more important to seat from owner "I don't need your business". We have had this in numerous occasions with this place they don't want the business of large groups and then treat you like crap. The food is not worth  the hassle or grief.

HORRIBLE HORRIBLE SERVICE!! I ordered a Stromboli and fries and when I picked up my order there was no fries.. i rode 20 mins away to get home and they gave me a pizza. Called to Inform them of the mistake,  in which the young lady stated she see they didn't complete my order correctly.. A gentleman then got on the phone and rudely talked over me, and kept saying in order for me to get the correct food I wld have to return the pizza and he wld have to charge me again for the fries.. I WILL NEVER BLINK AN EYE AT THIS PLACE EVER AGAIN!!

This hotel needs major attention. Very musty and damp in hotel snd rooms. Carpet in rooms damp and windows full of condensation. Leaks in lobby area where free breakfast served. We had bathroom lights out upon check in. Our phone was located in night stand drawer.  When plugged in the message light would not turn off. Manger nor maintenance could figure out. So the put electrical tape over it. 
Housekeeping took our dirty towels off the floor and put hand towels back on rack and folded wet bath towels and put them on a shelf. Disgusting. 
No airport shuttle available. 
Front desk staff nice and breakfast man very nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I went there with a group of friends last night. The food was good but several of the items we ordered were served in shockingly small portions, especially considering the price. They have spirits & wine but no beer license yet, and the server and host gave us 2 different reasons for this. Our server was sweet but had to go ask other employees the answers to every question we asked & the 1 time she didnt, she gave us incorrect info on which we based an order. They just didn't have it together . Overall, I would recommend several other restaurants before this one that have better food more reasonably priced.

It's pretty clear that this hotel is for one-night stays for people desperate due to cancelled or delayed flights.  There was old lettuce in my room when I arrived and some pubic hair in the shower.  Ugh.  Then I had to work some in my room during the day between meetings, and the housekeeping staff was extremely loud, yelling down the halls to one another, bumping stuff agains the walls, slamming doors.  This went on all day during the days.  Workout room is a joke. Definitely not a business class hotel either.  Despite all that, the staff is very friendly as other reviews have mentioned.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have been at this branch twice this week and drove in the drive-thru and had to wait 10 mins. the first time and today 20 mins. No business should have customers wait 20 mins. This use to be a very professional business but they have really drop the ball this week. I even have a favorite teller name Olivia. There are many customers who want to go to the tellers instead of the ATM because it secures people's job not bonus checks for Supervisors who have saved company money and hurt hard working people who need their job, so please keep that in mind tomorrow when your working

Recently moved to St Louis. Thought gotta try some pizza out here. Horrible place for a pizza. And it's not even pizza. Whoever thinks it's pizza should go on an extreme diet. And the staff is horrible. I had been to downtown one recently and the staff didn't even bother to help us out with a good choice of toppings. And there were a bunch of guys sitting there with their legs on the table top and none of the staffs bothered to point it out. Horrible place. Horrible staff. Horrible food. Never going there again.

Amazing! Their food is so good, I always either order out from them or I come in to eat the staff is always busy and professional when cooking food their eggrolls are hand rolled and cooked to perfection, I always like to order the general tso chicken with pork fried rice the chicken is crispy and juicy pork fired rice is flavorful also like their burbon chicken with white rice so good everything that's ordered is always hot and ready to order "their are not many chinese places I can vouch for the taste and quality of their food but I give these guys the highest" keep up the great work!

I dined here once & I order shrimp tempura sushi roll & mussels, lobster ravioli. Not to mention the service sucked they act as if they didn't want to serve me. When I was eating my food my stomach started to feel queasy at the table and I threw the food up right on their table. Not to mention that the ravioli was cold in the center but long story short I didn't have to pay for my meal and I think they did something to my food to make me sick and I will never eat at this place again I prefer HOKKA HOKKA Chestnut hill much better service and food.

Okay, for the area that this store is in it's a good place to shop, it has a very 1990s vibe and feels nostalgic walking around in. Is it outdated? Yes. Is that okay? Also yes. They're selection is good, it seems impossible to find spinach there though. The produce department needs some help. I purchased two coconuts today and both were moldy inside. I know that not many people are buying coconuts but damn they must have been at least a month old. The meat department here is plentiful and the employees are very nice and personable. I had my doubts about this Winn Dixie when I first moved here but it's not bad.

I just moved into this apartment 1 month back and they are ****ing useless in terms of providing mentioned ameneties and facilities in the apartment properly.

1)They made so many issues before moving in
2)Repeated service request for the same issue inside the apartment
3)Was cheated for referral bonus to my friend who referred me
4)Not able to come inside or go outside the apartment gate with bike and there is no separate gate for bikes  too
5)Gate code not working for the mobile number allocated and they are just talking the same stupid things again and again.

Please avoid taking this apartment.

Our sushi was delivered earlier than estimated.  It was absolutely delicious.  We are sushi lovers from from the gulf coast and the sushi was among the best, if not the best we have ever eaten! It was fresh and full of flavor.  The ceviche roll was excellent.  The Alaskan roll was fabulous!  I generally prefer the specialty rolls but we ordered what we thought would be a basic Philadelphia roll as "filler".  We were so pleasantly surprised as this roll was WONDERFUL!  The smoked salmon was so full of flavor, this roll was far from "ordinary" to be considered "filler" to supplement our other rolls. Even the edamame was exceptional.

Arbor ponds is a safe community that provided me and my daughter a clean home quickly during a challenging and sudden divorce. The location and price both worked perfectly for us and I really enjoyed living there. My young daughter loved the ponds and ducks and the pool was great too. The home we got was clean and very comfortable. Whenever I had an issue, such as when my air conditioner stopped working, I got help fast. If it wasn't for a family emergency, I wouldn't be leaving. Thank you for being my safe haven!!!

I am new to the Philly area and wanted to live in the heart of Old City. Not having any connections, I looked online and found a place that looked interesting and called the number listed. City Michaels returned the call quickly and took over my search. Cristy Michaels went out of her way to find what I was looking for. I ended up renting with another management company (she directed me to them.) She was gracious and professional even though she did not get credit for finding the apartment I ended up renting.
If I don't purchase next year when my lease is up I hope she is still helping find apartments because I will call for her help.

First visit I met Dr. Smith and loved her.  She's thorough, caring and goes well beyond whatever you might expect.  I was ecstatic as the place is so convenient and the hours aren't bad.  It's been a mad dash downhill ever since.  They don't answer the phone but tell you to leave a message and they'll call you back - all leaving the message does is cost you more time because they won't return the call.  It took two weeks for them to respond to an email - and my email was a response to them!  And worst of all - no more Dr. Smith.  I am sad to say this was a very disappointing, fruitless, inefficient waste of precious time.

First 3 times going to this new Burger King had great service & correct orders. Today ordered an iced mocha coffee & it was apparent the girl at the window did not want to be there. Coffee was plain & unsweetened, yuck!
Called & asked for the manager, said she was the "manager" & told me there was no way my coffee was plain without sugar & mocha. 
Said it comes off the truck premade.
Continued to argue that I was wrong. I know when my coffee is sweetened & has mocha. So beware that you get what you order. Will not return due to attitude of the "manager"!

Was told over the phone they don't do appointments & to come in because they were free and no wait. I get there shortly after with 6 people in front of me. I waited for 3 hours. Multiple people came in, didn't sign in, and sat right down in a barber's chair. If they don't do appointments I don't know how those people are able to do that. If you want a haircut from here, make sure you carve out a ridiculous amount of time to sit and do nothing & get skipped over by each barber's friends. Oh also, they only accept cash in a world where no person carries cash. HAVE FUN :)

Their branches have one teller working both the drive-thru and the customers inside at the same time trying to cut back save Quebec on help and save money meantime customers are inconvenience or long way. I'm Confusion by the teller. Also there customer service at the 800 number different departments seem to be pretty incompetent and poorly trained. They need TD Bank needs to update game and train their employees and get proper title as both for inside the bank to treat customers as well as a tell her to deal with drive-thru.

After driving 18 hours, this hotel told me they canceled my reservation because they would not accept the priceline rate. They did not call the manager until I insisted but he told me he had refused to honor 35 reservations over two days because he would not honor the priceline or hotline price. While I stood there calling priceline (I had to do that, tho he did give me a phone number) another guest came to complain her room had not been cleaned and I listened to the desk taling to yet-another-guest whose TV didn't work. Avoid these bozos at all costs.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: VERY UNHAPPY  I sent my mother to here to get a haircut and the lady asks my disabled mom to Remove Glasses That is fine then Remove her Purse fine NOW the DOOZY Remove Your OXYGEN Wow... My mother is on a Oxygen tank and has to have Oxygen 24 hours a day this Hair stylist then REFUSES to cut her hair because she CAN and she wont cut with Oxygen on my MOTHER then the Stylist swings her HAIR DRYER See the Video at my mother and hits her Oxygen Tank and yes there where witnesses My Stepson and 3 of his friends all under 18 or someone would have went to jail. This place has a lot of reviews elsewhere take a look before going.

I scheduled an appointment via their online website for Veteran's Day. They were promoting a free basic oil change for November the 11th only in honor of veterans day for veterans. I was able to schedule mine a week before. The week of, I received a call back from one of their reps stating that they were completely booked three weeks before and needed to cancel. I was told that he can't help it they are booked by people calling in and leaving voice messages. I guess the fact that I actually scheduled one didn't matter to them. They wouldn't honor they're mistake since it was only available for the one day. Happy Veterans Day!!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I booked a rent a car through hotwire for a car at Thrifty at Tampa International I pre paid for the car  At the desk they asked if I wanted insurance I said no and chose NO insurance when I booked it I said I wanted to pre pay for the gas  They obviously fraudulently checked the box for insurance and told me to sign for the gas on a folded invoice resulting in me paying double for a rent a car I complained and they would only credit me $30 when Im out an additional $100 not to mention my wife heard me say NO insurance I wont use them again I am filing a complaint with the better business bureau

What did not impress me: iceberg lettuce as appetizer/salad, octopus (Tako) that smelled like...

not like it should if it's fresh, Snapper (Tai) that they had to put a dot of siracha on top of the nigiri?!?

Anyway, not sushi like I'm used to.  Yes, I've eaten it around the world and also in Nippon.  In addition, I had a tonkatsu, as the acid test of a Japanese restaurant - it really had a Korean flavor and was quite dry.

Wish I had better, encouraging things to say.  As I sit here with indigestion...from the Tako?, I just can't.

In my 15 years of renting cars, I've never had an issue with a car...until now. Alamo gave me a 2016 or 2017 Dodge Journey. By the time we drove it from BNA to a parking garage downtown, it was smoking...with my 18 month old strapped in the back. It took 3 hours for a tow truck to tow a new car out to me and take the old car away. That being said, roadside customer support was helpful and Alamo Nashville credited me a one day rental rate. So they did try to make it better. But I'm worried about how often Alamo's cars get maintained.

The staff, from the door to the bar to management, were cold. The bartender showed no sense of urgency or hospitality:  my drink order was requested with a "Yes?" The top shelf drinks were poured properly. There was an issue with payment processing, so to save time cash was paid with a 35% tip. The bartender was thanked. The response was a turned back walking away. Two stars only for a great design aesthetic.  This de facto critic's is prediction is as follows:  Next... maybe the next business to run the space will get it right.

Public Service Announcement: stay away from the nachos!!  They use a paper thin chip, which CAN work in certain situations.  But combined with a very "soupy" cheese (and LOTS of it) these dish is practically inedible.  The cheese is almost flavorless, literally.  

This is the first time I have ever posted a comment about food, but hoped that I could save many people $12 and, more importantly, get this establishment to rethink their recipe.  Airport food is rarely great but this item needs to be removed if it can't be better than this!!! TERRIBLE.

Great price. However, you get what you pay for. Several times, I would come to pick up my drycleaning at the promised time, and it was still not there. This is a major inconvenience, especially when you drive out of your way in rush hour on MANCHESTER to pick it up. Final straw came today when I attempted to pick up my top for the second time and was told it has gone missing! Waiting to hear what happened to it, if they can even figure it out. And this was a favorite, go-to top for me. They have lost my business. I hope they can find my missing top or reimburse me for it. But I am done with them. Be forewarned.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: WOW I've never been to a more mismanaged place in my life. I made my car rental a month in advance, and yet they don't have my car on site. My options are to drive to another location, which is an annoyance since I was dropped off, or pay $15 MORE for a different vehicle. Unfortunately, the paying more was the better option for me. Except now they're saying they have to still bring my more expensive vehicle over. I've been waiting for 30 minutes (even though I pre reserved a vehicle) with still nothing to show for it. All I want to do is rent my vehicle and be on my way. This place sucks.

I brought my car in to get the AC fixed (it's a very old Honda Civic we use as a beater) and they broke down the pricing for me and didn't make me feel pressured to do anything. I ended up not going through with the repair, since it's used as a backup, but I would 100% go back with my newer car for maintenance and repairs. As a woman, it's rare that I feel like I got true transparency from an auto service center but they broke down all the pricing for me and I'm very comfortable with this staff. Thank you Jess, Matt, and the rest of the team!!

If I could give this location a zero I would. It was a complete shit show from start to end. They need to hire more people. It took over an hour to get our already pre paid booked rental. Then another half hour to leave with the car because they have a check out gate. Then we waited a half hour to try and drop off our car and decided to just catch the second bus to the airport. Well they never emailed me the receipt. I kept getting charged daily. And when I called the hertz line ai kept getting the run around. I will never use this site or company again. Beyond irritated.

bro, i checked what time this jawn opened and it said 12 and closes at 10. I show up at 5:28 pm no one was there. i tapped on the glass for bout 5 minutes when i just assumed they weren't open. even tho the open sign was front and center. i went across the street and got some pretzel factory, and then went back to scoopy's to eat them pretzels outdoors in their nice outdoor seating. And saw other customers getting served. I don't know if they purposely didn't serve me, but i am disgusted and humiliated. I wanted ice cream and was stuck with prETZELS.

Got food poisoning from here. Don't go to here. Hence why this place has bad ratings. One of the choices is expired or something. Do not come to this subway. Tried subways in Georgia and taste way better. Florida subways arnt that food. If 0 stars were a option I would give this place that. I don't even know why they are still open. The lady didn't even do my order right the first time and had to restart. Then she put a excessive amount of ham on their. I am guessing that's what is poisoned, I don't know. They don't do masks but something in there seems off and unsanitary. Do better.

As far as taco shops go in Tucson, Los Betos (especially this location) is number one on my list.  Always tasty and they have fresh chips and a good variety of salsas while you wait for your food.  Can't beat the price for not only the amount of food you get but also the kind staff.  I've tried other taco shops in Tucson and nothing compares.  I recommend the bacon breakfast burrito with beans and also the steak quesadilla.  I've yet to order something from Betos that I wasn't satisfied with.  Oh yeah and they have AMAZING churros too if you are feeling dessert.

I love coming do love coming here. Their system is the best. I love their manicures and their pedicures. The only problem I have, would be the employees. It's a hit or miss. Either they are really kind and deserve a $5 tip, or they are really disrespectful and make u feel like a $1 is too much to give them. You have to do your job to ask the questions because they will not tell you anything. This is for the salon: have some patience, it's a spa I should not feel rushed. And work on telling the employees not to yell across the whole salon just to talk to other  employees, it makes everyone uncomfortable. Thanks!

This food is cheeks. I was born and raised in the inner city of STL and like my Chinese food cooked a certain way. I ordered the Chicken St. Paul, Cab Rangoon, Chicken lo Mein, and an Orange chicken combination plate. The chicken looked under cooked and unseasoned for all of the items the rice looked fake and tasted disgusting. The peas and the carrots were gross the rice. There wasn't any seasoning on anything, the Crab Rangoon was gummy. The only thing that taste decent is the lo mein noodles. They also didn't allow the option to put cheese on my Chicken St. Paul.

Everything was great. Staff awesome, room fine but I can't believe an Omni property doesn't have High Definition TV.  Not only was it NOT High Def it is ANALOG. Trying to watch the Saints but impossible. Couldn't recognize players.  Gives a whole new meaning to "Who Dat".  I understand you think you can get away from spending the money because most people are out and about but sometimes you need a little break from the excitement of the French Quarter and want to chill in your room. Come on it's almost 2016.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I had a flat tire that was patched at Dobbs on Tesson Ferry.  Anthony was very nice and accommodating.  Tire was flat again, they patched another hole that was missed.  Third time, I didn't come in with my boyfriend.  Pat Lammert asked if I checked the tire, or was I  just going by the dashboard?  You could see it was almost completely flat...  Told him I wanted a new tire.  He said they are expensive and I should patch it again.  Not nice at all, talked to me like i was three years old.  Took My key and went down the road to Firestone.  They were not condescending because I'm a woman.  Put a new tire on, and treated me like a human.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I Wish I didn't have to give it a start all you know I've been staying at quality Inn's on my travels for a long time and always been treated with respect but this time at the one in Plainfield Indiana treated me like an a bad person I'm disabled I have a service dog I've always had him with me I've never had a problem this Hotel promised me no charge and now I just found $100 charge on my card you know I'm traveling my mom just passed away and they want me to show his paperwork which I didn't grab because I obviously had family
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: So.... we moved here in April of 2020- right when COVID hit... we purchased 9 acres in the immediate area---my husband is in the film industry ... one year later- we came  into Krazy Kats to have a drink and to get a feel for the venue ( we were interested in acquiring the entire property for an event)..we were turned away at 8 pm on a Saturday b/c they were closing ... all we wanted was one drink and they turned us away despite the fact there were still patrons in the dining room ... congrats on being able to turn business away in this day and time!!

Never again!

Have been going here a few months for convenience (close to home) and ease of being able to stop by without an appointment.  The last visit, the nail tech asked if she could do my manicure at the pedicure chair.  I was reluctant but agreed... Only to end up with mangled cuticles. On my last visit, my eye brow wax literally took 3 minutes... Bad sign.  Chunk taken out of the top of one brow.  I can say that Jennie who did my last mani pedi was excellent.  Overall, the feeling in here is very hurried.  I'd rather pay a bit more for quality.

I feel as if I was taken advantage of.  I was asked by the representative if I wanted to purchase additional insurance and I said no.  Unfortunately because I was in a hurry to find my husband and get on the road to the hotel, I did not notice that 24.99 PER DAY of  an optional collision damage waiver was added to my contract.  We barely drove the car as we only needed it to get to and from the Grand Ole Opry for a tour.  This really 'great deal' that I got through Hotwire for the weekend has now been more than doubled and I will never ever rent from Alamo again.  I am really not happy.

We live close by and have gone here often in the last few years. The menu, chef and service have changed recently and not for the better. After a bad experience of waiting for an hour for overcooked, dried out food on a quiet night, we thought we'd give it one more try. Tonight we ordered two soups and an appetizer to go. After waiting 50 minutes (again, they were not particularly busy on a Tuesday night) we get home to find no appetizer and one of the soups was not what we ordered. We will never go back. For the prices they charge in a small town, anyone should expect better.

I've never had a problem with a dry cleaner before until I went to this one.  Whoever does the ironing, scorched an expensive blouse and ironed a pleated shirt all uneven and most of the pleats were backwards and most and few normal. Their reviews were terrible but I went because they were convenient to where I live. I had to throw the blouse out and the uneven pleated shirt just sits in my closet. I didn't even want to deal with them. Don't go! The bad reviews are true and the good are written by them I think, if any.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I've been sitting here for 20 minutes at least and still don't have my order. I watched 3 people get theres and leave that came in after me. Watched multiple orders messed up and totally unprofessional counter help take place. This place is a mess. I'm not even sure they have a manager on duty and if he is he is totally inadequate at his job.  Don't come here if you have any expectations of what customer service should be, you'll be disappointed. I only stopped here because I thought it would be fast. I was wrong.

Amazing facility with an amazing staff. I first came here many years ago and it's definitely come a very long way with improvements to the hospital. My kitties love Dr. van Saun and I love how she treats them as if they were her own furbabies. 
If you have kids, I definitely recommend taking them to see the animals outside: cows, pigs, goats, and more! One of the things I always noticed when I drove by were the longhorns. Even if you don't need to make use of the hospital's services, the outdoor residents are 100% worth checking out!

This car wash has been completely revamped! I used to shy away from this one due to its location, but just stopped to use their vacuum and found that it looked really nice and clean. I found that the vacuums here are seriously the strongest I've found in Reno or Sparks and I have tried them all. Well since they worked so well I came back after the rain to try out the self service carwash. Wow whatever was done here was done right! It usually costs me approx 13$ when I use my credit card in the bays (which is now offered at this location) but it cost me only 5.00$ at this one. I couldn't be happier! Try it out you won't be disappointed!

OMG.  Made reservation, showed up right on time.  Hostess says hi, leaves and keeps us waiting for 10 minutes to "prepare the table." 

Placed in an almost empty restaurant at the back by the kitchen doors and right next to another party with chipped glasses.  No water for another 10 minutes.  Even when water is poured the server did not even acknowledge us.  No waiter.   We wait another 5 minutes and finally get up and leave.  Can't comment on the food but I am sure it's not worth the wait.

Thanks so much Foxfire for a lovely evening you lazy bums!  Went down the street to Catherine's which was fantastic so I guess it worked out after all!

We've had a leak in our ceiling since April and it's now July. We used to love living here but they changed management last year and never follow up on anything. They're wishy washy and have no actual answers for any of our questions. We are now refusing to pay rent until they actually fix our issue but even that hasn't created a sense of urgency as it's been a week since they said maintenance was "on its way" to our apartment. They never showed. We are on our third year living here. Can't wait until our lease is up and we can leave.

Went on a busy Friday night and it was super packed.  I ordered 1 Corona and never got a receipt, presumably because they were so busy and didn't want to have to deal with collecting receipts after customers wrote tips.  I checked my bank account later and realized I was charged $10 for the Corona, and an additional $1.80 charge for tip (which I never agreed to).  I have never spent that much on a Corona, and am shocked that they had the guts to charge that much and also automatically add a tip. Clearly they think of themselves as being on par with high end nightclubs, despite being a small bar in a quiet town.  Will not be returning.

My sister, 5 year old daughter and I are becoming regulars here.  So far, so good.

I am, especially, particular about services of this nature. So when I arrive, I tend to talk them through how I like things done.  They are awesome about it all.  Further, they are so kind and sweet with my daughter and she is so comfortable with letting them give her a mani/pedi.  They do a great job for us, all.  It's  peaceful, modern and clean with convenient parking on site.

So, this is our "go to" until further notice.

My family and I had a most delicious lunch at this restaurant.  The food was great, the baked goods were out of this world.  The focaccia bread was freshly baked right on the premises and the place was spotlessly clean.

We were a party of eight, (including one vegetarian and two  vegans) everyone had something different and everyone enjoyed their meal.  The dessert were especially delicious.  Who could pass up freshly baked Italian pastries?

The best part of the restaurant are the owners.....Antonio and Elisabetta.   No, I did not know them before, but they are so friendly I can hardly wait to return.  I wish I lived a little closer.

I continue to give this store a chance because my son loves garlic knots. But if they aren't providing proper tracking information, the garlic knots are always burned (in my opinion), they forget to provide the sauce and that's not okay when you're counting on the sauce to go along with your burnt garlic knots. After having the delivery guy tell me that the sauces were in the top box of my order, I believed him and tipped him handsomely; only to find out that there was no sauce!!! It's only sauce but I ordered it, so I WANT IT!

What a joke... that's literally all I can say. My arm was yanked around the ENTIRE time, my skin was cut at least three times, my nails look like a child painted them and they lied to me about pricing. They lady who did them had an attitude when I asked her to fix a few things and stayed silent the whole time she did my nails... also seemed like she was in a rush when she did them. No one has ever done my nails that fast. My nails don't even look like she filed them after putting the dip powder on them either. 
Save your money, go somewhere else.

The boyfriend and I stumbled upon this place when driving around Philly. We always look for new sushi restaurants when traveling. Nori has been our favorite by far. It was small, beautifully​ decorated (and very clean). The presentation of the sushi was amazing. The taste was even better. We had a salmon​ appetizer​ that was on the house (nice surprise). Neither one of us consider ourselves fans of salmon and we loved it. It included fresh jalapenos​​s, avocado,​ and a citrus sauce​. We had several sushi rolls and the seafood risotto​. All wonderful. We would highly recommend​ you stopping by and giving Nori a try.​

Took my BMW in to get the wheels balanced since my car started to shake at high speeds since I hit a pothole. First time I took it in to get it fixed, drove out and it vibrated even worse. Took it in another time and was greeted by Jeff who understood my concern. He took 1.5 hours to make sure everything was perfect. Very pleased and will definitely go back to him. He is very experienced and will take his time to complete everything perfectly. Will definitely recommend everyone to go to this location and ask for Jeff. Thanks once again.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
This is not a hotel it's a motel in one of the worst one is been into full breakfast for them is hot coffee couple of muffins and instant oatmeal there were no cold beverages at the breakfast shower in the room was either boiling water or cold water after complaining maintenance guy came to fix it but never did there is no daily cleaning and they would like to charge for that 10 extra dollars for service the price needs to be reduced by at least $100 a night.
This Motel is located in an area where I would be afraid to leave my rental car there.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Decided to try our local place on Sunday at 1 pm.  Waited 5 minutes to be seen by a hostess then another 5 to be seated.  We were seated by the busy walk way to the bathrooms even though there were numerous empty tables throughout. Waited another ten minutes after being seated to be even acknowledged by a bus person at which time we threw in the towel and left.  Where was the manger?  Where was the waiter? A waste of 20 minutes of our time.  Not sure we will try again. Go to Some of the newer places in Bear Canyon area they are more appreciative of business.

Never order and pay online! It takes me 1.5 hour to received an incomplete order!!! In between, I called one time asking for the order. They have my phone number record. When I received my pizza missing the Pepsi. I called 3 times they never pick up my phone. Until I used my boyfriend phone to call them. They apologized and said they will bring back the Pepsi which they NEVER did! I called the customer service to complain about that. They said they only able to file a complaint to the owner. Said the owner will contact me. And they are not able to give me the refund!!!! I will never place any order in the future in this store!

Staff was friendly and beds had clean sheets; however, the carpet in our room was disgusting. It smelled like old urine and made our feet black after walking on it. We were tired from traveling and had a lot of luggage that we had already hauled into the room so we just bought an air freshener to stick in the vent of the fan and sucked it up for one night instead of bugging them for a different room. Other than that the room was a little dated but nice enough, it had a kitchenette with typical household items so it was helpful to not need to resort to fast food every night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Upfront info. This hotel is almost entirely rented out by a local trucking company they put there new hires there at the trucking company cost. My 2nd time staying here and other than some aesthetic's it's pretty desent. They don't have a big staff by any means so if you need t paper or a towel you'll have to get it yourself. If they put better blankets on the beds it would get another star. To those that are afraid of truckers or somehow repulsed get a grip. The truckers are some of the nices ppl you will ever meet. That and everything you own was on a truck at some point so a little respect would be nice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: While not the worst choice, I wouldn't recommend it. I've had no problems with the dry cleaning I've dropped off and their hours are great, but do note it's going to be more expensive than some other places in the city and a longer turn-around time. The customer service isn't great, and they don't take cash under $10. There's also a dog that freely roams the store. While I haven't found dog hair on my clothes, I wouldn't recommend it if you're allergic. I also dropped off some clothes for tailoring, and it was pretty poorly done so if anything I'd stick to dry cleaning and avoid the tailoring.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Was looking for car wash  and decided to stop at Tropical on Nebraska. Greeted with nice service I proceed to wait for cash wash, while waiting one of the gentlemen comes over and brings me my engagement ring (forgot at the light I took off while I was putting on lotion) that was left in passenger seat. Very honest of him. They could've kept it or it could've gotten sucked up into vacuum. Just for their honesty I will return. This review was done before service was complete ! Will update with outcome of service !

We got into Tuscon late at night and cruised around looking for the best vintage motel sign and the Hacienda Motel won. This place has the strongest 1960's American roadside motel vibes, probably because that's what it used to be!  The new GM, Kevin, checked us in and was a doll about me being fussy about room locations. The rooms were clean and cute and well appointed. We had little porches and great common outdoor hangout areas and the pool was beyond adorable, a great place to chill and unwind after a long day of driving. If you're looking for an interesting, convenient place to stay skip the interstate box motels and go check in with Kevin
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Another "0" star if possible. Pulled in to the lot at 10pm and several of the lights were out or flickering at the vacuum station & spray off stalls. First station missing the attachment on the hose, removed one from another vacuum hose, then vacuum switch was broken, wasted a buck. Moved to another station, missing attachment again, dropped in another buck and almost zero suction. Wasted another buck. This place is a Run Down, Money Grab for the lazy owner who obviously doesn't give a crap. It's an eye soar in a nice neighborhood and will be reported as such.

The first time I came here I thought "wow this place has everything!" So of course I came back already thinking this place was great. This time I was vacuuming out my car when I locked my keys and phone inside!! ‍ so embarrassed me had to ask an employee for help and because my car is super secure they couldn't get it unlocked. BUT their boss gave me a ride home to pick up my spare key AND bring me back AND bought me Dutch Bro's. WOW. I'm so grateful for such amazing service and friendly staff for helping my dumb self out! This is the very least I could do for all the help they did for me today. Thank you again!

I lived at Waterford Downs for 3 years and would highly recommend it to anyone!  The staff is AMAZING; the leasing manager Neil and the maintenance manager would remember my name and go out of their way to ensure it was a great place to live.  There were times a maintenance request was responded to as soon as 15 minutes after I called.  The complex was so safe; I would leave for work many days at 3:30 AM and never had any fear whatsoever.   Waterford Downs recently had a major renovation and is first class all the way. If I ever end up back in the area I would rent here again without hesitation.

My rental was just fine. I reserved the car through Southwest and was given a price that was all inclusive of taxes, etc. When I returned the car the price they wanted to charge me was about $13 more than my quote. After providing them with a copy of my rental agreement they could not explain the additional cost and gave me a refund of the difference. I would suggest you always check your bill and keep a copy of your original rental agreement. If I didn't have it I would have paid $13 more for my rental. Otherwise everything was just fine.

Horrible customer service! Signed up for personal training and was told I had 24 hours to decide if I wanted to cancel. I called the gym but was informed I had to come in person to cancel. I went to the gym to cancel my membership within six hours of signing up. I spoke to the manager and he was very rude and unhelpful even after explaining my situation. He put in a request and two days later it was denied. Even after I explained my situation on the voicemail he said well I'll have the trainer call you and set up the training sessions. Don't go to this gym they're not helpful they're only about their money.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Gold's Gym Corporate not accessible or responsive to SB Members or local staff. Take over October, 2016 a loss to SB gym community. Service cuts exceed minimal, unwanted rate cuts with no credits or refunds made to pre-paid Bay Club annual members. Local staff cannot respond to members without answers from corporate who blow off inquiries. Equipment needs to be replaced and maintained. TV service being "worked on we hope". Coffee service terminated adding $40/mo to member out of pocket costs plus time required to go elsewhere. Local staff got screwed in take-over along with members.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I drove 30 minutes out to this nail salon bc I looked at their yelp reviews and they seemed good overall but as soon as I sat down the lady was so judgemental and was looking at me disgusted she even put gloves on which is understandable but i've never had anyone put gloves on and i get my nails done twice a month since I was 17 lol. Mainly She was judging this simple colorful design I wanted, it wasn't even a drawing or something complex it was this picture I included. She didn't even want to do it and suggested for me to just leave.

What a great find! We were on our way back from a Pismo Beach trip. Found the Paradise Store while looking for somewhere to stop for a bathroom break. 
Since it was a Sunday, they had a cool local band The Fog, playing in the back stage area.
We decided to buy a couple of beers, stay and listen for a bit. The store doesn't have a lot of stuff, but it did have plenty of really nice people. I didn't get any food, but the burgers looked good. One of my favorite things there is the anatomically correct metal robot in the parking lot. I'll try to attach a picture of it.

WORST company ever. Do not EVER rent from this company. No one answers phones, no help, it was honestly the crappiest experience ever.

Not too mention being stranded at the airport for 45 minutes and then not having a shuttle to take back in the morning to the airport because they do not open until 7am. The manager is a joke as he never returns phone calls or the vm box is ALWAYS full. 

They also illegally keep charging your credit card and give you cars that are broken. 

I hope this place goes out of business because they do not know how to run it.

After waiting for 45 minutes after being quoted 20 minutes every single party that arrived at the restaurant ahead and after us was seated. When confronting the hostess about the situation she was dishonest in saying that we had been called and didn't respond. That wasn't possible as we were seated directly next to the hostess stand. We were not offered and solution, lied to and the manager didn't get involved although he was standing there talking on his cell phone. After many happy visits they won't be getting our business again

My Car Doc is amazing!!  Worked us in on short notice when we had an issue while visiting from out of town, very efficient, personable and professional, ran diagnostics, and when the part needed to fix the problem was going to take longer to arrive than we would be in town, they said "no charge," refused to accept any payment, gave us the info and part number we would need to have our home repair shop fix it, and simply requested we "pay it forward" to someone else in need.  How refreshing!!!  There really are still very kind and caring people in this world despite how it sometimes seems.

My husband and I almost did not go here due to service we previously had on a visit to the Blind Pass location. We were both so glad we went. We were greeted at the door by Andrew, the General Manager, or higher. He sat us where we could watch and listen to football, immediately gave us water and our drinks. Service by Crystal and Andrew was awesome. Food fabulous. Prices reasonable. We think it's the BEST on the BEACH. Can't wait to go back and try more food. The chowder is number one, full of seafood. Hushpuppies delicious and not greasy. Chicken tenders w/ a nice " kick"... mmmm... all great. Beer cold in a big glass.  A hidden gem!

The worst shop i`ve ever been to.
I stopped by to ask a simple question to a mechanic. They were all sitting by a table at around 11 am. They refused to talk to me and pointed to the lady in the office. I went in and i asked once again if any of the mechanics would answer a question i had. The lady turned her head and said the mechanics were having lunch and couln`t be interrupted. 

I left immediatly with a huge sence of disappointment. How can this be possible??? There must have been 7 or 8 people in the shop, they all saw me and nobody cared enough to listen to my question!!!! 

Horrible people!!!

I have been to this car wash three times and I love it! Every time that I come there the people are so nice. I always come during happy hour. My only complaint is that they are not offering the charity washes right now, but I guess that was temporary anyway. I don't know. Oh yeah and the vacuums are super strong. If you have any coins make sure to take them all out first, because it is really easy to suck them up. Anyway this is probably the cleanest a automatic car wash has gotten my car without having it it full detailed tbh

This is my local Wendy's and I love it here but my drive thru visit today was so bad I never want to go to that place again.First when I was ordering my food they were very rude about it and had a bad attitude.When I came home I took a bite of my fries and all I taste is salt I ordered a number ten which is 10 chicken nuggets,fries,and a drink the fries were so salty I thought I was going to get a high blood pressure my chicken nugget were so plain I think they ran out of salt on their French fries and didn't have any left for their chicken nuggets.

It's pretty great. Decent location, staff is cool, the only bad thing I have to say is that they cucked to nonsense like COVID and asked people to wear masks when they're illegally doing so be used people don't know the law. All the other complaints are from children in adult bodies who are too much of a baby to wipe down a machine . They want to cower behind masks for something as simple as a cold. If you're afraid of a cough and want to wear gloves, 3 maxipads on your face, and a face shield to look like a hamster , stay home.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I stayed 3 nights at the Hilton DoubleTree in New Orleans around Christmas. I used HiltonHonors points for one of the nights. Points were deducted from my HiltonHonors account and they charged my credit card $$$ for the night as well. I made them aware of the situation. They recognized the mistake, but have yet to refund me my $$$. It has been over 3 weeks now.
Also the hotel valet parking was full upon arrival. Very unorganized operation. Would not recommend nor will I be returning to this hotel or any other Hilton owned property. Be aware before booking.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The hotel itself is okay. There is water damage & truly not the nicest. My biggest issue with this hotel is the fact that they (or their system) managed to charge me TWICE for my hotel room on TWO different cards on TWO different days. I came here for a birthday trip & im going to new york after so now i can afford my new york hotel since they charged me a total of $1,400 which was my vacation spending money. The girls at the front desk were helpful but this is ABSOLUTELY unacceptable. Also, i've been here 3 days & maid service has came to our room once. Another hotel stayer was asking how often they cleaned the rooms & the maid didn't answer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Ick! This place is terrible. Way too crowded and sweaty and I know it's a country bar but a little variation in music would've been nice. And worst of all the night I was there they were advertising $4 tall cans of beer, so I go up to the bar to get one and get given a smaller bottle and then also charged $5.50 only to be told after that the deal is only at one of their beer tubs. This is not said on any of their ads so obviously I was annoyed. And the girl who served me was so rude while explaining this and didn't even appologize for the confusion. You will never catch me at this bar again.

I visited Friday, Sept. 10th. The food was good, but this restaurant needs to improve in other areas. There was only one server - not enough for that evening.  The server was very nice but not able to attend to our needs. We did not see much of her as she had too many tables. We needed more wasabi, but didn't  get the chance to ask for more. They were also out of the best Sake and completely sold out of dessert.  Also, we were unable to book through open table app - it kept saying they were fully booked no matter what time we tried to book. Management needs to get it together.

Tempura udon May look good on the menu BUT beware. There was a Japanese beetle in my soup! I Brought it to the owner and there was no accountability. There is no excuse for this. Absolutely Inexcusible. A meal at a Japanese restaurant should not include Japanese bugs. Either stay away from this place or carefully screen your meal for unwanted insects. If they're in the soup who knows where else bugs may show up. Maybe the kitchen is infested. I for one will not return. Shame on you Umai. You have shamed your culinary heritage...

Our flight got cancelled and we got a voucher to stay here. The staff are friendly and check in the was quick. The shuttle driver was awesome. However our room was another story. The hair dryer smelled hot upon usage. Not to mention a huge stain on the sheets the housekeeping intentionally hid by covering with those foot of bed decorative drapes. We found out AFTER we slept in it!!!  I would have given 3 stars if it haven't been for the stain. They do not offer any complimentary breakfast. However the restaurant offers a breakfast buffet for $12 pp.
