categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Still handing out cold breakfast in a bag while other Holidays Inn's are serving hot breakfast and hot coffee. They still aren't cleaning rooms or bringing clean towels. You have to put your trash in the hallway so there's trash everywhere when you're walking down the hall. Rooms are tiny and cramped. Pillow cases, carpet and walls were stained. the bathroom sink had huge cracks all in it and there was gum stuck to the carpet. Room was just dirty and gross. The hotel is small and cramped with a tiny lobby and only one elevator so there's a wait for everything even just leaving.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Since negative stars don't exist I am generously giving one star. Lobby smells of smoke. Room not clean. Reported Hair in tub and on bathroom floor. They cleaned the tub but not the floor. During night my ceiling started dripping. When I turned on light there was a puddle on the filthy couch. I called the desk and was told no other rooms. They asked if I was in danger and I told them the ceiling looked buckled and that it may collapse. They found another room for me which still had used soap and towels in it. Can not wait to get out of here
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: 1st time back since whole Covid thing.  Got sausage and pepperoni takeout.  Was just okay.  Talked place up to visiting Florida friends and kinda looked like a fool.  Previous time we went pre Covid was also a slight letdown.  Both times za crust burnt on bottom.  Also out of garlic knots both times.  Auto 12% gratuity for handing me 28 dollar pizza seemed a little severe also...but I get it.  Covid hurt.  Gonna give em one more try in couple months and see.  Not much for reviewing places, but just saw all these over-the-top praises and had to give my two cents worth.  It was ok and overpriced.

We came here to find a gift for a friend, but ended up staying for the free Saturday wine tasting! The vibe of this place is very down to earth and approachable. The selection of wine is HUGE and range from a little less than $10 to $100+. The staff was very nice and we had fun chatting with them about wine. It was the perfect way to spend a rainy day in New Orleans. This place is also close to a great BBQ joint, so come here and make a date out of it!

Also the receipt had detailed wine pairing suggestions which I thought was a nice touch.

I wish I could give it zero stars.  If you happen to have a room on the second floor don't expect Wi-Fi.  If you call to ask about it they will lie to you and tell you a maintenance person will check it. They will call you back after a few minutes and tell you they found no problem.   And, God forbid, you have a child who happens to wet the bed. The older, husband and wife team of housekeepers will try to shame you for it.  It is a clean hotel and most of the staff is nice and helpful.  But the few bad apples outweigh the good.  Would not recommend and will not be staying here in the future.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Trash service. Absolutely awful car rental place. 2+ hours of waiting in the beaming heat  with a line exceeding anything that should be appropriate. You'd think there would be a reason, but nope there were 3+ people in there working. Get to the counter and you can't use a debit card to pay even tho I used it to book, without having a credit card available too plus there's a fee. Oh and also they want another form of identification + your first born to be able to use one of their janky cars. Miserable nasty people working, and a greedy company.

The pictures don't do this hidden gem justice. Fat Salmon spot is my favorite sushi spot in Philadelphia, and the best part is it's so affordable as well! Every time I leave the city i find myself craving it. There are plenty of vegetarian options (more so than I've seen anywhere else) for those looking for vegetarian sushi, but otherwise don't miss out on their fish-based sushis especially anything with salmon. The Alaskan roll was definitely my favorite but really you can't go wrong with any. The ambiance is dimly lit, perfect for a night with friends or an intimate date night. Go and enjoy- i promise you won't regret it!

I stayed at this hotel. I year plus after corona they still have breakfast buffet closed, replaced with brown bag granola bar, muffin and 8 oz water. My 1 yr old could eat that, not a great start to a day. Then they ran out of food before breakfast time was over??  They refused to clean the room during stay or replenish the limited supply  toiletries in the room. The furniture was filthy with stains, smh There was not TV guide and limited channels available. Then they have enough nerve to charge for parking.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The facility is ramshackle and filthy. The lot attendants are inept and rude. The counter staff is friendly enough but oversold the add on to the point where I finally told them to stop. The check in line was 20 deep- 45 minutes to get a vehicle. The return was confusing and I was told "I" parked in the wrong place to drop off. Well, if "I" parked in the wrong place it was because "YOU" didn't mark the drop off lanes properly.  I will say that the shuttle drivers were nice. My home base is ATL and this type of facility wouldn't last 2 days there.

This hotel exceeded all our expectations! Incredible decor, perfectly clean and updated, lovely little seating areas and lounges all over. It's across four buildings which was a bit strange, but actually made for a lovely experience walking between them. Our room was HUGE and really pretty, we loved it! The staff is incredible, room service is top notch, beautiful hotel rooftop and pool, great drinks, I mean, it can't get any better! Love this hotel and looking forward to staying again the next time we're in Santa Barbara.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We just moved here from California. Great decor, our waiter was very friendly and the food was above average. The salsas were amazing that came with the chips. When I asked for more salsa, the waiter brought out a Habañero and Smoky Chipotle. I'm not sure if the extra salsas were supposed to come with our entrees but they were amazing. I got a combo of an Asada taco and a Chile Relleno. The taco was pretty good but the relleno was a little soggy/watery. My fiancé got the taco platter which had 3 different sauces which looked really good. Overall I'm super happy with the food and atmosphere. I'll definitely go back.

After staying at the hotel for four days, I had no choice to eat here for breakfast..
Day one -- we all ordered the all you can eat breakfast special that included drinks for 10.99. It consisted of eggs, hash browns, fruit, an omelette made to cook.

Day 2 -- I ordered the skillet cantina while my friend ordered the red velvet pancakes.

The food was rather bland and seemed average, nothing that wow'ed us especially for their prices of 8-12.. It was expected since everything in grand Sierra seemed rather grand in the first place.

I wanted to give this a 2.5 stars but I have to give it a 2 stars. Service and atmosphere were great... Food wise is pricey... Portion is BIG... My friend had the mussels. It was ok.. But only if the sauce wasn't to thick. Then I had the veal panini. The worst panini I had have in my life... Its like eating a philly cheesesteak. Then my wife she had a chicken panini that goes with the same I had eating a philly cheesesteak. Plus, the bread its not fresh... 

I have eaten better Italian food where I live. I love eating Panini and this place became the worst Italian food ever...

Me: "Two slices of pepperoni, please."

Her: "No. One slice pepperoni."

Me: (Confused. Look at slices under counter. Yes, only one slice pepperoni. Also several slices plain plus several slices of random weird pizzas. Look behind her, see dude making pizzas.) "Well, will there ever be more pepperoni ever again?"

Her: (Looks inside empty oven.) "No."

Me: (About to suggest throwing pepperonis on a slice of plain, but too tired and hungry to fight.) "Okay, you're right. One slice of pepperoni."

Food quality: not good, but typical for airports.

Recommendation: Avoid unless desperate.

Agree with the other reviewer that the hotel has a dated feel to it. Must be all the wood paneling. Restaurant isn't bad as far as hotel restaurants go.

Spent a 4th of July here and they put me in a top floor room facing the fireworks. 

"Gym" has the usual treadmill/elliptical and dumbbells. Sufficient floor space to work. Outdoor pool is heated to a comfortable temperature.

Hotel is on the outer fringes of downtown. A bit of a walk that can be unbearable midsummer. Hotel van can drop you off on the way to the airport but they seem to be rushing and are less than willing to make the little detour.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: In town for business and arrived late to my hotel. This appeared to be the only convenient food available outside of the chips, etc from my hotel's lobby marketplace. Saw the reviews and nervously went forward with my delivery order, thinking, "How can you screw up a pepperoni pizza?" Contrary to other reviews, my delivery ordered within 45 minutes as promised. Pizza was delivery-caliber hot, nothing to write home about, but not by any means terrible...hence the "Meh. I've experienced better" rating. That's my two cents.

Cool spot. Hip if you must. 

Food was very good. I stuck with a couple of appetizers. The shrimp tacos and the seared sea scallops. They were both excellent. 

This place has a strong following with what seemed to be quite a few regulars. They also have some good drinks. Try the ice water. 

The only knock was the somewhat unorganized style of the wait staff. There didn't seem to be any set tables, so you might be seated, served bread, an have your food an drink ordered from an delivered by different people. It seemed to add time to how long it took to order, get additional drinks, and pay the bill. Won't keep me away though.

Highly recommend checking out this spot if you're in the Wilmington area. We didn't have a reservation, but managed to get two seats at the bar. The bartender was entertaining and very knowledgeable about the menu/great at guiding us in what to order. We ordered the brussel sprouts and cauliflower appetizer, venison loin, scallops, lemon brulee, and chocolate smores bread pudding. Everything was excellent. On Tuesdays they offer half priced bottles of wine. They will be transitioning to their spring menu starting today, 4/5/17.

Can't give 5 stars because I'm spoiled from living in SoCal, but this place is a pretty good contender. I ordered 4 tacos: carne asada, el pastor, lengua, carnitas. Lengua was the best, hands down. Horchata was amazing. The location was kinda shady which was evident by the caged windows and doors of ALL the businesses in that complex. I came in around closing at 8pm. There was a guy slanging weed in front of the liquor store next to the Tacos El Rey. I'm sure that if you go during the day, it wouldn't seem so bad lol

At check in I was informed that I'd be charged $15 for a pet (usually waved for a red lion club member).  The wireless in the rooms is nostalgic (read: dial up speeds). When I called to order room service from the room service menu, they said "uh, we don't do room service, you'll have to come down and get it."

Not a good start, I'll update if the situation changes.

Situation didn't change appreciably.  Rooms are clean an nice, it just doesn't seem like the hotel is managed well. 

I've also stayed at the Double Tree in Boise, I think that may be a better deal, although a bit further from downtown.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This review is LONG overdue since we went there so long ago, but I just had to make sure everyone know this place is a true gem of authentic Italian food.

The wait staff is friendly, attentive, and they make you feel like you're eating at your best friend's Mom's place.

The pasta is excellent and cooked to perfection. The ziti was sinfully delicious. The asparagus was cooked exquisitely. Everything is fresh, served in large portions, and made with love -- you can tell!

If you're in Philly and want Italian, make the drive to Villa di Roma.

You get a really good value here.  The rooms are cheap but they are real nice.

The hotel staff was very friendly, easy and fast check-in.  But what do we all want in a hotel???  We want clean.  This place is super clean.  I didn't do a black light or anything, but over I was impressed.  The rooms were very modern and comfortable.  

They had a pretty good breakfast bar spread in the morning.    It is close to the airport, downtown and BSU.

Microwave and mini fridge in the room.

You can't beat this place for value.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My husband joined me for a business trip I had at this hotel.  Overall, it was awesome.  Upon arriving, they gave us both chocolate chip cookies which my husband happily gobbled up!  We then saw our beautiful room which was immaculate.  It was so pleasant and the bed was soooooooooo comfy!  There was also a fridge and microwave which we did use.  We ordered dinner (steak w/ veggies) which was awesome as well.  The steak was cooked to perfection.  The following morning, we ordered breakfast through room service.  It was equally as awesome.  I also liked that the hotel offered cucumber water.  It was really delicious!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My wife and I were in Wilmington for New Year's Weekend and had a wonderful meal at Moro's. It is tucked away on a side street and I never would have found it if not for the reviews on yelp. The food was fantastic, our waiter's knowledge was so-so but it was New Years so he may have been new (he was attentive and friendly just didn't know his menu or wine list as well as some of the others). We had the Oysters, a Salamo plate, a wonderful winter vegetable salad, Cesar salad and for entrees we had the Duck and the lamb chops. Everything was prepared perfectly.  Well worth a visit, it is expensive but well worth it for a special evening.

So, I visited Creation with a large group while in town for work, and all the locals just RAVED about it. Raved. 

I found it to be solidly nice, but nothing insanely stellar. Average+, if you will.

As a vegan, I ordered the Indiana tomato salad without mozzarella, and was pleasantly surprised when the dish came out with deliciously grilled/marinated mushrooms in place of the cheese. What a nice touch. 

If I were local to Indy, this would be my go-grab-a-drink-in-the-summer-with-coworkers place, but maybe not so much for the (*cough* overpriced) food.

Great place - some of the decor inside the rooms seemed a little old, but otherwise, it's a nice place to stay.  The grounds are immaculately kept and the lobby was extremely clean and inviting.  

Plus the sodas (plastic bottle size) in the vending machine were only $1.25!  I'm so used to being gouged on vending machine prices at hotels that I was taken aback.

I did hear some idiots outside screaming and yelling early in the morning, but I guess that's not something I can blame the hotel for.  Still, it was annoying.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Our experience here started with the busboy setting the bread bowl on fire, then walking away. After tamping out the fire, we expected to see a manager, but never did. Surprisingly, we stayed for our food after that. We had low expectations based on the other reviews and weren't disappointed. The food was bland and overcooked. The chili tasted more like a cheeseburger soup with beans. The black and blue burger wasn't terrible. The kids liked the pasta with butter.  Someone in the kitchen has a heavy hand with the salt. I think we should have turned away when we had trouble opening the door to get in.

Just went here today for lunch. Delicious food! One of the best Indian food experiences I've had in the U.S. Second only to some Indian food I've eaten in India. The food is fresh and all homemade. I couldn't believe that they offer a full Indian food menu AND full pizza place menu. I'll definitely be going back there or ordering take out. The place isn't anything special but the food is all that matters and the food was delicious. Try the tandoori chicken - great flavor. I also recommend the veggie korma or the chicken tikka masala.

Very nice clean room with small kitchen complete with a full size fridge, double burner cook top, microwave, and dishwasher. Awesome walk-in closet plus vanity leading to a full bath. Fold out queen for extra space. For the girls, having it next to the King of Prussia mall is a huge plus - high end shoppers heaven. Complimentary breakfast was great but chaotic - they ran out of plates, food, coffee and had to wait to get refills. Not sure what the real room rate was since we got transferred on a discount rate from an unfinished Sheraton in Valley Forge.

If you are in the hood, look it up, shop til' you're broke.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I just moved here from California and wanted to order pizza. I wasn't really aware that there was such a thing as St. Louis style pizza, I just ordered from here thinking it was normal pizza. It was delivered super fast, that's what the stars are for. But the pizza itself was gross. The crust tastes like saltine crackers, you can't taste the yeast and it doesn't rise like normal pizza crust. The processed cheese on it tasted weird and goopy. Maybe this is what St. Louis pizza is supposed to be like, but I really thought it was bad.

Many of the cars in the lot were banged up and the interiors of the two cars I was shown were stained and smelled like stale cigarettes.

The quote I was given when I booked the car was about $75 less than what it would have actually cost. What seemed like a good deal when I booked the car turned out to be not such a good deal.

I cancelled reservation and went to Enterprise.

I am giving a second star because the staff were accommodating. The gentleman at the counter made a good effort to find a larger vehicle  that I requested and  the shuttle driver dropped me off at the door of another rental car company when I cancelled my reservation.

Room was the best part, trendy, clean and inviting. Location is good too, but the rest left some room to be desired. The front desk staff member took a call in the middle of checking me in, when there was another staff member who could've taken the call. I had a sizable box shipped to the hotel that they did not offer to bring to my room. There is no room service and the one dining option wasn't available in the middle of the day. Blinds also didn't go all the way down, so the sun woke me up. Also, shampoo and conditioner in one in the shower?! Next time, I'll go to a full service hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Stopped in here late on a weeknight looking to get a room for the night. I asked the guy if they allowed pets or if they had a AAA discount. The guy must've felt bad for me or something because he upgraded me to one of their business-class suites (for free), waived the pet fee, and gave me a better discount than the AAA I was expecting.

Really, this place was great. I'd gladly stay here again if I was ever in the area. The breakfast in the morning was also pretty good. With pancakes, waffles, sausage patties, bacon, and eggs, it almost came off as good as Denny's.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This is for the bar specifically. Christie and Geoff were great the first night, someone named Josh was the bartender on Saturday night and he was worst than terrible. There for two hours, only had one drink, he never checked, we were sitting at the bar too and the place wasn't busy. He was sassy and lame, not a people person and should maybe work in a department where he doesn't need to speak with people at all. Asked to check out, that also took 20 minutes. Ridiculous. This bar is new too, let this go be free, not a bartender. We will be staying at the Westin down the street next time. Thanks for nothing Josh!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is great.  The chicken biryani is awesome and the other Indian dishes are as good If not better as any you'll find in the area.  The pizza, while decent, is pretty good for suburbs.  I've heard the subs are good as well.  there are not many places that can do both well...The cook is talented at this and a nice guy, he knows us by name and his style of cooking is the closest to North Indian homemade (IMHO).  The girl at the register is pretty awesome too.  So if you're looking for down to earth prices, with food that truly is quality value delicious, this place is it!

We ate there for the first time last night.  We were impressed. The menu is limited but the food was very good. As  an appetizer we shared the portobello sauteed in garlic with roasted red peppers and fresh mozzerella. They make their own pasta so we tried a pasta special which was sort of a primavera with chunks of mozzeralla, eggplant and zuchini. I also had the eggplant parm which is baked to order and not fried. It was outstanding. The service was also very good as was the decor. We would go back on our next trip to the area.

Stopped in this week while camping at the state beach.  We've had breakfast here in the past and decided to try dinner. I had a burrito smothered in mole negro. Delicioso!  The rest of my party was also very happy with their meals.  For three of us, three entrees, two beers and a coke, the the bill came to $50 and we were stuffed.  The service was very good if a little slow. Our server sent us home with some estafado sauce to try,on the house. It tasted great on our morning eggs. All and all it was a very good experience and a good price for a tourist area.

Great food! I ordered the ribeye cheesesteak sandwich with sweet potato fries. Portion sizes were excellent, in fact I was only able to eat half of my sandwich. The meat was tender, not a lot of fat. The sandwich included caramelized onions, wild mushrooms, and creamy horseradish along with a side of aioli.... perfect flavors. It was a chilly day so I tried the spiked hot apple cider and it was delicious! A wonderful lunch. I'll definitely return on my next visit to Philadelphia. Thank you to the staff, service was great.

Went in today because I had signed up for the text club and was to get a free 6 inch with the purchase of a large drink I was also ordering a foot long at the regular price but when I got to the register and presented the offer it would not work. And she said she could not do anything about it. Bad move. Because I not only did not purchase the drink or the footlong sandwich but I was made to feel like I was a bad guy asking for help. I had been a regular customer comming in about 2 times a week. Guess what I went to the deli next door and will not purchase anything from this location any longer.

Every time I go to get a haircut I am unhappy. They really only have a few kinds of haircuts they can do and it's basically the ones you see on the barbers in there. Unless you have straight hair and want a classic conservative haircut then you will be disappointed. I was let down this time when I went in for a light trim as I am trying to grow my hair longer and the barber cut off half of my hair. He showed me how much he was going to cut and then cut off waaay more then we had discussed. Won't be going back again. Although they do good business when I went back in to explain the issue they gave me my money back.

The barber told me he'd have to wash my hair and that it'd be $50. I asked if it'd be possible to just get the cut. I just washed my hair in the morning before work and I don't do manual labor so my hair wasn't greasy or disgusting. I thought spraying hair with water and combing it down was standard, but I guess not. And $50 for a men's hair cut? My hair isn't the length of Fabio's and I'm not John Edwards.

Most of the previous comments indicated twenty for a hot shave and a cut so I was surprised at the price.

Not a clean place, but it used to be a good for a cheap burrito.  Their prices have gone up and are now comparable to Chipotle and La Salsa across the street.  I only go there for breakfast burritos now.  Having consumed more burritos there than I can count/remember, I can tell you the deliciousness of your burrito is a pure gamble depending on who is in the kitchen.  Also if you are going through the drive-through, check your burrito, half the time they give you the wrong one or don't understand you on their ghetto mic.  Then, if you don't mind extra special salsa in your burrito, ask them to fix it.

My husband, 3 yr old daughter, and I went in and ordered food on our way home last night. We got Fried Potstickers to share (nothing spectacular). I ordered Beef Fried Rice (absolutely delicious) and my husband ordered Scallops with Lobster Sauce (He said it was tasty). It took them 30 minutes to get our order out. In the meantime, I happened to turn around, and I caught a glimpse of the kitchen...The man was cooking my food in a TANK TOP!!! So sick. We decided to pretend not to see this....Until my husband woke up in the middle of the night vomiting his brains out. We will NEVER go back and wouldn't recommend it to our worst enemy.

Absolutely awesome food. I had an incredible side house salad that was fresh, crispy, and made with care. The house made Ranch dressing was very tasty. I also had a side of Fettuccine Alfredo that was cheesy and not dry. Again, made with care. My wife had the soup, (some type of sausage). She said it was better than she expected. But the second dish she had that was the best of all was the meatball pizza. Thin crust, flaky, and really tasty. I would recommend this place to anyone. We will most certainly be back!

Bait hook and switch! Book the hotel for a night and the charged us a extra night more then the booking price was. It still is $175 a night and I got charged $245. 
To add the complementary breakfast they promised wasn't available in the morning. They said only if your a gold member. 
Other then that the room was nice but noisy till about 4am. Additionally, the restaurant seemed understaff to even attempt to eat. Had a waiter stop by at the host stand to ask if I've been helped, after 15 of waiting. 
Over priced, noisy, and the only free amenity was the gym and pool.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
four of us went to dinner this past saturday night. . the food was good , ( a little expensive for the amount of vegetables you get as a side dish should be part of the meal. ) our server was informative.but it lacked the good family feeling we use to get when tom and rosanna had their restaurant in there. in the time we were there, we saw mr scarpone come out and talk to one table. plus it is very loud , hard to have a conversation.  maybe , he should try to hang material from the ceiling.  the jenkintown train station had a restaurant in it and it helped buffer the noise.

i wish mr. scarpone luck.

Delaware does not have an overwhelming number of high-end spots. Eclipse Is a great small romantic bistro with very good food and pretty good service. I eat here a couple times a month and I have never been dissspointed with the food. The service can sometimes be off, but always friendly and usually spot on. The menu doesn't change to often, but the specials are usually interesting. The wine menu is a bit small for my taste; however, what they have is good. Great cozy date spot that is in my top 10 for Delaware without question.

I stayed at the Renaissance St. Louis Airport Hotel for a work conference. The staff was very friendly and accommodating especially the banquet staff. they made sure that all my meals were in fact gluten free. If I was rating the staff I would give them four stars.  

The Lobby had been recently renovated and was great for enjoying drinks with colleagues  The rooms and especially the bathrooms seemed really outdated and not well kept. My room in particular had huge black streaks on the  walls and wall paper that was peeling off the wall. 

If I go back to St. Louis I think I will try a hilton or Hyatt instead.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Being there for only a weekend, paying close to nothing and basically just using the room to sleep, this hotel was just what we needed. I will warn you the rooms are pretty small and we didn't have a view from our tiny window. What I did love was that every floor had a water machine with water bottles that we could fill up and take with us....and for free! Now that is something I've never seen before. The staff was pleasant and the hotel was very clean. I would stay here again as its located in a great area of Philly and its simplicity is all I need on a weekend getaway.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Honestly I have good and bad thoughts about The Nail Bar. I had one of the most fun and memorable experiences here, but within 3 days two of my nails chipped and two broke. I went back to the Nail bar to have the broken nail fixed and they charged me extra money for the repair  and then asked if I wanted my nails repolished. When I explained I had only just got them done they blamed the discoloration on the OPI nail polish I used. At the very least they should have fixed my chipped nail for no charge. Even though the atmosphere was great the quality of service was less than desirable.

This is a great grocery store with TERRIBLE staff.  We encountered 2 staff members during our shopping trip and both of them were undescribably rude.  It's really unfortunate as I would like to be a customer because the store is awesome, but the people they have working are so bad I will never go back. 

The lady in the bakery was on her cell phone and was very annoyed when we asked her to get us a few cupcakes.

 The checkout girl turned our cupcake container upside down, smashed the chips and ignored me when I asked her to clarify the total and then again when I asked if I had given her the right change.  Like literally IGNORED me.

Tired, not clean, definitely shopworn. The only reason it gets two stars is the free parking and the general location, which is super convenient.  I would stay almost anywhere else if you're in the neighborhood. 

Also, while I guess it was nice to be upgraded to a two bedroom suite, part of me hates to think of using such a large room and heating/cooling for one person for a one night stay. 

The breakfast was not good. The pre-made omelettes looked really unappealing and tasted like cardboard. The fruit seemed canned. Even the coffee was bad. All in all not worth it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Stayed here for one night.  Hotel is under construction but since all I needed was a place to sleep it did just fine.  The room was large along with the bathroom and the bed was super comfortable.  The real star of my stay was the young lady working the front desk at 6am on 10 Feb.  I had requested a taxi when I checked in for 6am the following morning, there must have been a mix up because instead of a taxi there was a shuttle.  She must have called 10 taxi companies/numbers to ensure I got a taxi and didn't miss my appointment.  I'm not sure many other hotels would have taken the time to get that right.  What a great employee!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Don't be fooled!!! These are NOT queen sized beds--AND, if you are coming with kids, the pull out sofa opens out so that there is no room to walk between the bed and sofa bed! Super tight for 3 people--can't imagine if you have more. Might be ok for a single traveler, but 2 adults in a full sized bed isn't very comfy either. Front desk says all rooms are the same--kind of doubt that but reviews speak louder than complaints to the desk these days, so here you go.  The refrigerator makes a ridiculous clicking sound too which will not help with sleep tonight.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This was the worst experience I have ever had renting a vehicle. The representative spent the entire time trying to convince me to buy an insurance package that I did not need. Because of this, he processed my rental incorrect, causing me to only have one driver on the vehicle, when I had originally registered for two. This threw a wrench in my plans to return the vehicle, because I would be leaving the country the day of return and unable to return myself. When I called to speak to a representative, they were unable to assist and said I needed to return in person to add the additional person, which I was unable to do.

It seems they are still renovating because the set up is weird. The lobby is a bit tight. The location is pretty close to french quarter, bourbon, etc. My biggest complaint is that they didn't come to clean the room. We went out in the morning and came back around 2:30 and the room hadn't been cleaned. They came at about 2:45 and we asked for them to come back because we were about to leave. When we returned at 5:30, the room was still not clean. We called at least to get towels. 15 min goes by and nothing. We call again.  Another 15 min goes by and nothing.  They finally came 10 minutes later.  Not that great at the service part.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Upon entering the stairs to my room, a rancid odor was penetrating my sinus.  The corridor where my room was had a mildew smell. In the room was even worse.  It was a non-smoking room, but smelled as if the previous guest smoked in there.  WiFi was non-existent from my end of the building.  3 calls to the front desk and the attendant told me was come towards the lobby and connect to the WiFi , hopefully by the time you walk back to your room you stay connected...I highly DO NOT RECOMMEND this hotel/motel to anyone.  The worse hotel I have ever stayed at.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
For a casual italian place in a remodeled Popeyes, Ill give it three stars. Paige was wonderful. Bread barely edible. 
Average caesar salad, u guys can improve.
**Excellent Fettuccine Alfredo, absolutely melt in you mouth fabulous. A perfect alfredo. I will come back for more pastas.
The real disappointment was the pizza. Both the Lamb meatball and vegetarian pizzas' completely lacked any semblance of cheese. Is it pizza without the cheese? May come again, may get take out, but please take better care of your pizza pies boys.  And cheese please, cheese!

Excellent barber shop. Have been going to Kyle for 6+months and he does a great job just how I like it every time. He is meticulous and takes his time. I like how he gets styles my hair and gets my part just right before starting the cut. At shops in the past I've ended up with stray hairs which were cut parted the wrong way which can be a hassle.

Highly recommended. Typically ready to go right at your appointment time so no waiting. Parking can be a pain but I've always found something on the street. Cash only but they have an ATM if you forget.

I should have paid closer attention to the positive reviews being 2 years old. 

I wandered in off the street for a beard trim. A barber took me, first chair to the right of the entrance, and proceeded to give me what I'll lovingly refer to as my trip to the prison barber. He roughly used a trimmer on my neck, didn't take any length off the beard, used a razor blade out of a holder to scrape my cheeks and upper lip, and his hands smelled like an ashtray. 

Worse? It was $25... a price I'm sure he made up on the spot.

Delicious food!  As you'll be told by friends who recommend this stop and the Bartaco waiters themselves, portions are very small.  However, the taste and quality of the food makes up for these portions.  I ordered the chicken and rice bowl and one cauliflower taco.  The chicken bowl was good, especially when topped with the red sauce on the table.  This sauce made it spicier and more complex. However, the cauliflower taco was the standout!  The harissa-style sauce on top brought the taco together.  I'd definitely come here again, but don't come with a huge appetite (unless you're willing to buy several tacos!)

I was met with ecstatic enthusiasm upon entry of thy restaurant. Completely bewildered by the joy excreted by the host staff, I had to take a moment to gather myself. Once I was done, I managed to nimbly dance around all the visibly joyful patrons, until finally finding a exceedingly comfortable seat at the bar. This is where we met thy accomplished bar keep Colleen. I must say, in my experience of bars (regretfully very established and knowledgeable) she was amongst the upper echelon. She created delicious yet cost friendly cocktails all while providing a warm and infectious smile. 5 stars for Colleen and thy restaurant of Tacos de Bar.

What an awesome experience!!! Last week I bought a used SUV from Sean, and his son. Very clean vehicle. I took my time with making a decision. After looking at the reviews from his establishment, I bought from them. It needed a couple of odds and ends, but let me tell you, Sean took care of everything before I drove it off the lot. Stand up guy, reasonable prices, and Tim the on site mechanic knows what he's doing. I would highly recommend checking this place out when looking for a used automobile. Thumbs up in every way with High Tech Auto. Thanks Sean

i love this place and the service is awesome, and i would rate gelish 5 stars if my nails didn't come out a completely different color than the color i picked out. i wanted a sagey sort of green so i picked the color 47 for dip. i got tiffany blue instead ?????? it is partially my fault for not stopping my technician, but i was thinking it would turn out to be different when she was over but nope, still bright tiffany blue. either the colors must've gotten mixed up or they haven't updated their colors according to their books. either way, i'm a little disappointed with the color. overall nail is great but i absolutely hate the color ):

A couple of friends decided to book a room here for our birthdays so we would be within walking distance of the local bars. I think the price of $200 was fair because of the location. The fact that valet was full and we had to pay $49 to park was ridiculous. The guy that checked us in could've been more friendly, maybe he was having a bad day. Room was nice and clean. I wouldn't recommend staying on the first floor, it tends to be a little loud at times, especially when there's a teenage cheer competition going on. I will not be returning to the Crowne Plaza.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I bookmarked this bar prior to arriving in New Orleans because my husband was so excited to try the infamous hand grenade. We finally made our way there and while I had enough after one drink (sweetness and strength-wise), my husband loved it. We tried both frozen and on the rocks, we both prefer it on the rocks. The service was good, and $10 is a reasonably priced drink for Bourbon Street. The bathroom stalls were tiny and the swing doors didn't fully shut, offering little privacy. I'd recommend at least trying it.

*Update: I will say that the main office and staff are wonderful. Friendly, easy to deal with, and will get the job done. They informed me that they are currently making changes..great news! Also very understanding and accommodating to my personal circumstances. My advice to them would be to PLEASE get a new maintenance crew and invest in technology to make it easier for tenants to file a case and track progress. Also, reevaluate the temporary housing policy to ensure it's aligned w the values, image, and brand the complex wants to promote.

We stayed here for our family vacation. We got a good deal through priceline, however the good deal was not worth it. The location is in downtown and there are not many places to eat that are family friendly. The patio deck has no purpose, possible extra room for storage. House keeping does  a very minimum job. They don't sweep or mop the floors, towels have stains, bathroom smells, and furniture is dusty. Lastly, the ladies in the morning shift have poor customer services in the reception area. I would never stayed here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: First time at Bartaco and I was not disappointed! Everything here is family-style but my friend and I both ordered tacos that came out at the same time, which was nice. We shared the shrimp tacos, miso cod, pork belly, and roasted duck. The pork belly was definitely my favorite. The shrimp taco was kind of plain and I didn't really like the miso cod, but everything else was enjoyable. We also had the pomegranate lemonade drink which was delicious. Great place and great food, minus the shrimp and fish tacos. They also have little place cards to put on the stand at your table to let the staff know if you need help. Would definitely come back!

I'd rather not waste any time writing this review because I've wasted enough time at this good-time night-killer.  Between waiting an hour for food that came out looking and tasting like the lazy-give-me-a-dollar-and-f!@#-off bathroom attendant just wiped his ass with day-old KFC and not accepting the food being sent back AND a nice little screw-you by charging us for tap-water ($1 each and served in the same doctor's piss collecting plastic cup our drinks were served in), this piece of crap ain't worth your time.

went to get my mani/pedi done almost a week ago and I got shellac done and it started chipping five days later ( I thought it was supposed to last at least two weeks..) same with my toe nails... very upsetting due to the fact that I paid a lot of money for the service. Not only that but I went with a friend and they messed up her shellac and let her walk out with it like that. Getting nails done is meant to be relaxing and I didn't get to experience that because they were working in a hurry and I went with my friend to spend quality time with her and they separated us the whole time :( . That was my first and last time I ever go there.

I never thought I would say these words, but this is the best restaurant I have been to in my entire life, hands down. I've been around the world and seen a lot of things, but the food, the energy and most importantly the men and women that work here are nothing short of stellar. Pretty sure Craig never takes a day off and he is an amazing human being. I highly recommend everything here, because this establishment can do no wrong. If there ever was a place that is doing it right, it's this place. I will be a return customer, and will tell everyone I can, all because of a small act of random kindness. Cheers #bartacolife

This hotel is way over priced for what you get. We were on the first floor and it sounded like there was a rodeo going on above us. The whole place smelled stuffy and old. The a/c didn't work. If you want a cab it has to come from Santa Barbara and they charge to come down before they pick you up (about $50).  Walking to a restuarant will take about 10-15 minutes. Not too bad as long as you don't get harrassed by the cops asking what you are doing in Carpinteria and why you are out so late. Didn't appreciate that at all. Needless to say I will never stay there or any where in carpinteria again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This hotel failed to meet my expectations. My father is a gold rewards member with Marriott solely because he is physically handicapped and finds they tend to offer the best services for his needs. This hotel had tiny bathrooms they passed off as "handicapped accessible" with NO bars anywhere near the toilet. (I work for an insurance company and this is a claim waiting to happen!!) The room was clean and the staff was friendly enough, but I cannot believe you would try to tell me someone with a wheelchair or disability is supposed to make this room work.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Rented a car for like 3 weeks and got hit at gas station the same day while I wasnt even in the car. I got all insurance and accident information from the person that hit me to turn in to Enterprise, and they said they would take car of it upon my calling them. They then proceeded to send me invoices and filed a claim against my insurance company because it was easier. Uh, no people, this is not good business. I will not pay for an accident that was not my fault.  The guy that hit me was driving a Mercedes,  I'm sure hes set to pay. Look him up Enterprise,  you have his driver license,  address, phone number  and insurance info. Do your job!

Honestly I didn't have high expectations for this place but I was blown out of the water. I was in town staying at the hotel (Crowne Plaza) for a work event and stopped by for a quick lunch. It took awhile for someone to come over and introduce themself but I couldn't be more happy with my experience. I ordered the filet mignon sliders and the soup of the day (cream of asparagus). I'm so used to being disappointed by getting lukewarm soups but it came piping hot and was so yummy. Whenever I'm back in Indy and staying at the Crowne, I'd definitely come back! YUM

I went to Hush today and they did a beautiful job! Josephine was fantastic and if I lived in Tampa, I'd definitely stay with this salon! I have only one complaint: I didn't say anything when I should have, but Josephine was ROUGH. She was pulling my hair the entire time, even to just put on the color, she would take the little strands and when just brushing the color on, she was yanking it. Later after a wash, she massaged something in and it didn't feel good at all because my scalp was SO sore. Other than that, the results were gorgeous and she did great. I would just speak up next time.

I'm very pleasantly pleased at the room I received for such a low price. It's very spacious and clean. The room came with a free Dasani water and cute tea bags for the non-coffee drinkers. The bathroom uses a pump dispenser instead of the little bottles which I thought was neat. I have one complaint which is the walls ... VERY THIN I could hear the couple next door using the microwave and their baby crying ... A LOT. Other than that inconvenience I was pleased especially with only paying $50 a night on a days notice !!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Very very bad behavior received this time. The lady in the reception is too rude for certain people. I believe attitude to customer comes first when it comes to a service oriented business. I was merely asking for some existing discount posted on Midas website, and they were like ,as if I did some crime asking that. I did $380 worth of service , still received such behavior as I am getting the service for totally free and begging for their service. I would think twice to go there again as I felt the behavior varies to their known people.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Friendly staff and very clean rooms. I also love that they change up the breakfast every morning... one day it was breakfast omelettes, one day breakfast tortillas etc. 

The only complaint I have is that the towels and toilet paper are very abrasive. My poor bum and face are not happy after my four day stay. This is very unusual for my skin and the towels don't even seem rough at first touch! Which is the weirdest part. But oh well, life could be worse. 

Still, it probably wouldn't hurt to throw in a little fabric softener into the loads of laundry ;)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Robert Williams night auditor is super kind and extremely helpful to guests! 

He is professional!  He made me fresh coffee because I am an early bird! 

Our room was beautiful clean!

They are very big rooms with a sofa! 

The attention to details the soft pillows are labeled!

There is an extra blanket in the room. It is clean and safe!  

Included free breakfast.  

With eggs and variety of different items!

The lobby is a great place to hang out!  It has books for reading pleasure!

You are in the heart of carpinteria! 

Stay here!

Plus you can bring your puppy!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: LOVE. LOVE. LOVE THIS PLACE!! Everything about this place is cozy and  comforting! The interior is completely cool and calming. Food is outstanding, always fresh and always on point. The chef and the owner is absolutely adorable, welcoming and sweet. If you're looking for a good food, good mood and a little piece of Italy you NEED to go to New Hope to visit italian Cucina!!! I'm very happy that I've had a chance to discover such an amazing little place where everyone becomes a family! Luv ya Joey! Keep up the great job and keep the yummy food comin'  happy costumer since 2008

I came to Enrich after recommendation from a friend and was sorely disappointed. I got a dip manicure and pedicure. The manicure came out great and the lady who did my nails was very nice. My pedicure experience was not great. The person who did my pedicure kept trying to upcharge me even when I told them I just wanted a basic pedicure. After my toes dried, I looked at them up close and they came out terrible so I had to have someone else put another coat on top. This place may be great for some people but I did not have a great experience.

I called my order in 
And then 10 minutes later i called the same order in to add to my order the young Lady who answered the phone wasn't very thrilled 
When i arrived the order had a different price even though they were the same thing 
I asked the young lady to correct it 
She gave me attitude 
I asked her why they didn't look the same she tried to fix it 
And then again gave me attitude 
People ask why other people don't support black businesses it's because they are unprofessional i am a black business owner and i am very disappointed in the service i received  i love Stl and i love Nephew's food but the service needs improvement ASAP

This place had gotten sooooooo cheap. I've been coming here over the years and I was floored by the "changes" this visit.  They no longer do the shrimp appetizer, which would have been nice to know because we would have charged our orders.  I mean they have it sharpied out on the menu, but you don't realize what it is.  I guess we should have asked though. Then the vegetable serving was so meager. They never asked if we had a special event and the show was extremely short. I'll definitely be going to a different location because of the changes. What a huge disappointment.

As for the hotel itself, its beautiful. Rooms are clean, big and very comfortable. Ok, now here's the problem. The elevator situation is out of control. Only 2 SMALL elevators working for 20 something floors. Our Valet guy waited 30 minutes to catch an elevator down and eventually just started carrying our bags down the 11 flights of stairs. If you need to be somewhere, catch a flight, you would never make it! Want to give this hotel a great review, but the entire new elevator system was frustrating and infuriating. I've never seen so many people take the stairs in a hotel before.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: similar to numerous earlier reviews - no cars available.  1:50pm on a wed., I had to wait for a car 20 min, but when I asked if I can take the premium, they said I have to pay.  I'm executive elite and am entitled to it, especially if there are no cars available.  terrible service, ended up getting tiny santa fe for the week.  when I called to complain, I've been waiting 2 1/2 weeks for a call back from the regional manager.  I've called 4 times requesting a f/u and still no call back.  I guess his/her lack of communication, trickles down to this specific shop as well, terrible all around.

The day staff at the front desk were extremely hostile and rude. Noisy, outdated, frayed wires for the lamps, poor water pressure and to use the cable you have to follow a printout of instructions. Horrible place not worth 40$ let alone whatever the charged. I had permission from the night staff to check out at 1200 by 1115 3 police cars showed up for checking out late. Boise police surely have better things to do. Terrible communication between shifts obviously I will NEVER stay at this particular location & Rodeway Inn locations anywhere will not even be an option due to Boise ID Location
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Not ready for prime time.  Lots of staff, and relatively few customers,  but service is abysmal from housekeeping to, especially, their bar.  They've had long enough to get the kinks out, so I think the problem is more systemic. A room with no pillowcases on the pillows, soiled sheets, no waste-basket, jammed room safe, etc.  A bar where I gave up on ordering a second drink after 50 minutes because I couldn't get the bartender's attention...and there were only five other customers in the bar.  Management seemed genuinely apologetic, but when one thing after another goes wrong, apologies grow stale. Never staying here again. Ever.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Food was good but service is really lacking. We spent $100 on dinner for 2 and had three larger parties come in after us (one 35 minutes after us) that got their entrees before us. I appreciate a meal that isn't rushed but our food was clearly forgotten. When we asked another server about our entrees, we were served warm ish food. I worked in industry and totally understand wanting to leave on a Monday but when it delays service THAT much and has that much of a negative impact, that's unacceptable. Would be highly unlikely to try it again or ever recommend to a friend. The other thing that is disappointing is I was so excited to try!

Prescribed me the wrong contact lenses (told me I could sleep in them when I couldn't). When concerned about the effects this cold have on my eyes (I wore them day and night for a week at a time and replaced every month) they did nothing but say I wasn't a candidate for 24 hour wear so they wouldn't prescribe me the same brand my previous eye doctor prescribed for me for thirteen years. Terrible, old fashioned doctor and ridiculously expensive. My visit with the doctor was absolutely horrible, the manager was helpful in some ways but stern. Go somewhere else! I'll tell all my friends the same.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This is THE BEST car wash in the area, hands down. They go out of their way and pay attention to detail when they could just "give you what you paid for." They open up your hood, to blow out all the accumulated dirt and leaves...same with the trunk. The gentleman asked me to hold off putting things in the trunk, so He could vacuum it out first. I have them shampoo my seats and carpet once a year..they still look brand new. The Works wash takes about 20-25 minutes for a reason...they vacuum and wash n dry everything.

I only gave this place 2 stars because the food was good but the employees, or should I say 1 employee Leini was so rude as always. The other girl Mariah was nice and she asked her to make one of our sandwiches and she straight up made an ugly nasty face and said "I'm not making their sandwiches" it was me and my friend. But the other girl was nice and made our sandwiches with great service I even left her a tip. I'm not sure what you want from your employees but they should definitely not be rude to a customers face and it's always the same girl Leini all the other workers were always polite.

Meineke advertised on Veterans Day all veterans get a free oil change I got my oil change rain check try to use it a few days later well the oil change is not really free unless you want them to put water in your motor the oil change changing of the oil is free the oil that they put in there when they change it cost about $10 a quart my truck holds 8 quarts so my free oil change is about 60 to $80 don't use veterans and Veterans Day to act like you're doing something for veterans I can get my oil changed cheaper at the GM dealership then I can with your free oil change thanks for nothing
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I don't know what's the point of having a "no-smoking" room anymore. I went in and it immediately smelled like cigarette. It gave me a stuffy nose and a small headache. My wife had to go to the gas station next door to get a febreeze bottle to spray the place. We waited 15 minutes to be helped at the front desk because one person was on the phone with IT support. The bathroom and shower area is very clean, which is a huge plus. There's no fridge or microwave here. The tv is updated, the bed is nice and soft. Overall an average stay but you get what you pay for.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Bella Napoli is my favorite little hidden gem. Tucked in a cozy alleyway in Edgehill, they serve up the best pizza and authentic Italian food you can find in Nashville. I don't say that lightly. They also have the friendliest service you could ever ask for. If you eat here two or three times, they start to remember you and welcome you back. Forgetting that they don't have sweet tea, I ordered one and my waitress caught herself mid-sentence telling me that they only have unsweet. She returned with a sweet tea she literally made herself. 

Come for the food. Return for the service. Highly recommended.

Even though this is closest to my home, I try to avoid shopping here because the self-check is almost consistently closed and they never have enough registers open.  Their meat and produce are very basic.  Also, I suppose because they keep advertising that they are cheaper than Wal-Mart, the caliber of the clientele at this store has deteriorated.  I have boycotted this store several times and have started taking more of my business to Rouse's on David Drive which has a much better meat department.  Not to mention that on $2.99 Tuesdays, Fresh Market is cheaper on chicken and ground beef.

Overall it was a very satisfying stay at Holiday Inn. All/most of the hotels in Carpinteria were fully booked, so we were glad that we made a reservation beforehand. The rooms were clean and had a great atmosphere. The only problem I had was that the only room they had was one closest to the highway right next to it. The street noise was pretty audible, but it was tolerable. It was also strange to me how the blinds didn't close all the way, but maybe that's a convenience thing. (Only closed a third of the space) Pretty nice stay at this hotel and I definitely recommend this place to anyone on their way to other places.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I enjoyed my stay from the moment we got there. The valet guy found us a parking spot right In front of the hotel which was free until 8am which wasn't bad since we were starting our day early after our free breakfast! The guy at the front desk was also very helpful and nice and found us a great place to order food from at 1am! The hotel room was huge and the view from the balcony was great. I enjoyed this hotel very much. One con: the parking (we got lucky finding a spot right across the hotel two nights in a row) ... The elevators weren't so bad as everyone else mentions, well I didn't mind , I wasn't in any rush
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: On 9/14/12 I was at Sushi Brothers & decided to get something different.  I ordered the Spicy Fish Salad which stated it comes with cucumber, onions, pepper, asparagus & assorted sashimi grade fish.  It was good..BUT..I realized there were no cucumbers, onions, pepper or asparagus!!  When I asked about it, I was told the menu had changed but not changed on the menu from 6 years ago.  Then I saw cucumbers & asparagus through the glass at the bar.  I said it would be good if they put these ingredients back into the dish.  One sushi chef got very angry with me & was unbelievably rude.  I WILL NEVER GO THERE AGAIN!

My husband and I are from out of state down here for a stem cell transplant for my husband. He was craving sushi so I looked online and found this little restaurant right across from the hospital.  Can I say it is probably one of the best sushi places I've been to.  So fresh.  We started out with the Kani mango salad and bbq squid followed by countless sushi rolls all for less than $20 a person.  This will definately be a place we will frequent while we are here.  I can't wait until my kids come down so I can bring them here try it out!

We arrived and the restaurant was very behind on our reservation. As folks used to enjoying a cocktail at the bar, we sat down to order and wait for our table to become available. The bartender was extremely RUDE and dismissive and did not even give us time to settle in before rushing off to another patron. As time went by, we weren't treated any better, we inquired about our table which was still held up and at that point had been treated so poorly decided to leave without dining. Was a shame because we were so looking forward.

We were there on New Years Eve and the five of us were extremely pleased.  Although, you were very busy we never felt we were being rushed.  All of our meals were perfect, and the holiday menu offered a vast choice of entrees.  My steak was cooked perfectly, and it's been a long time since I had one so delicious.  Our other guests had crab cakes, salmon and another fish....all were magnificent.  In addition, our server was great!  Thank you for a wonderful dinner and evening.  Happy New Year and see you again soon.   Dot Kessler

The food is good, service and atmosphere was terrible. 
My girlfriend and I had to explained our order 3 times to the women with tattoos as we first pulled up. She was rude and dismissive initially, and also rude when we had to go back bc the order came out wrong. 
Not only was the order wrong but it was missing food. 
When I tried to explain what was wrong, she turned off her head set. When she came back she proclaimed she'd only speak to my girlfriend bc I was rude. 
What a joke. 
Do your self a favor and don't go here.

This place has amazing sushi and small plates. We came here as a big group for a friend's birthday and the staff was so accommodating and attentive. We had a variety of rolls, sashimi and nagiri (all delicious and fresh - not fishy!) and the chef also provided us with a variety of special small plates. The presentation and flavor were outstanding. Overall the ambience was great, staff was super friendly and the chef even came out to check how the food was. Highly recommend this place and will definitely be back!

The rudest people I ever had to deal with in my life. Unprofessional and did I say rude. I give it zero stars. Will never rent with Avis again. I left my breathing machine on the bus and I asked if they could call the bus driver to make sure it was still there and we were ignored. When I ask to speak to the manager she wasn't going to call her cause she was busy. Then she started to ridicule me with other personnel. Never again. By the way we travel monthly and rent vehicles all the time so they lost a true customer.

Not happy at all with what I ordered.  The bruchetta was soggy like it was made in the morning. It lacked flavor and garlic. The toast was Melba toast!  Usually it is served with slices of lightly toasted artisian bread.  I also ordered Oso Buco and it should have been more tender as I had a tough job cutting the pork off the bone.  The Polenta however was good. My daughter had the Risoto and she liked it very much.  The bar is very nice so if you are in the mood for a nice drink and maybe a snack that would be a nice place to spend some time with a friend or two.  The music was nice and relaxing.  I will never go there for a dinner again.

Great food and impeccable service. I tried the pork belly taco... That was my favorite one. The portobello and the shrimp tacos were yummy yummy. The ribeye one was a bit salty for my taste, but it was ok. I also tried the ginger grapefruit, I liked it, but I couldn't taste the ginger, although I admit, I love ginger so much, maybe it was just me that wanted a bit more. Overall, the experience was great, the place is beautiful, and the location is so cozy, that just being there was a nice experience. I would definitely recommend it, and I will be back

Pricey, expected level for airport hotel. BUT, i ordered the trout, turns out to be very large breaded pieces of (lake?) Trout with a sauce under the skin of the trout pieces. The skin was a significant part of the fish, not a great contributor to the taste. It had a bit of lettuce and a couple of cherry tomato halves on top. No side and no bread, but a LOT of fish. More like a plate of fish to feed a family and not a meal. Flavor was fine, presentation and balance really hurts this rating. Wife had a Kale salad which was quite good, but begged for an artisan roll or bread at this price level.

Charged $100 for not filling up the tank (9.99 a gallon). Egregious obviously.

That's really not the worst of it though. The employee said to my 65 year old mother, 

"Well, I can either charge you for the gas or I can slap you in the face."

Bear in mind, this was not after any kind of confrontation; she had already agreed to pay. He just said this out of nowhere. I was just kind of in shock that he'd say that even though my mom laughed it off as if he was joking. This was following up on a really casual sexist comment to my girlfriend.

So with Hertz you apparently get a two for one of casual sexism and threats of violence against women.

Thus far, I am impressed with the gym. Little cramped in the machine area but unlike the other reviews, I have found the staff friendly and helpful. I started at LA Fitness and they wouldn't even teach me about the equipment without paying for a trainer. The folks at WH even went as far as to discuss eating habits and other simple life changes. 

Parking does suck but it is convenient to my work and home. No fighting traffic, just hit the Whitemud and I'm off.

I will post more as I get further into my experience.

P.S. Would be nice if towel service was free and childcare was a little less.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
DO NOT GO TO GINA! 
When you sit down for a beard trim at this location, any of their other locations or any other barber they will ask if you want your beard lined. Yes. You take notice of where the beard growth is currently at and confirm the desired beard line. You DO NOT go 1"-1 1/2" up from the existing beard line and ASSUME the guy wants a typical jaw line beard level. She just takes the shears and before I know it, BZZZZZZ up to my jaw line then continues for the rest of the session to work the jaw line until it's ABOVE the jaw and uneven with the jaw line. 

Wow.

This is hands down the worst chinese food that I have ever eaten.  The egg roll was the size of my thumb and tasted like it was filled with gooey stuff.  The 1 crab rangoon that they gave with the dinner portion was dry and cold.  The chicken was dry, and rubbery, my tire would've probably tasted better.  The driver was very eager to take my cash and didn't even ask me if I wanted change back. Then after calling the manager to politely tell him our review, he simply told me that he would look into it.  Terrible food, terrible experience.  Would never eat there again.  Cheap food=Gross Quality.

The service was bad and the food was only okay. The waiter couldn't do basic wait service such as refill glasses without being asked. He cut us off in the middle of us ordering to leave and go bring someone else their food. The appetizer was brought out at the same time as the meal, so what was the point in even ordering one? There were 3 people eating at our table, and 2 of them had their food brought out and had finished it before the third's even arrived. And again, none of the food was that great so it's not even someplace I would return for takeout.

Nice gym. The girl that works Wednesday mornings (around 7am) is never at the desk, is always on her phone  and is kind of rude. I've worked in the fitness industry for 5 years and it's honestly unacceptable to have an employee like that in a gym setting. I have waited over 30 mins for her to come back to the desk multiple times and when I ask for assistance she seems to have an attitude. 

Everyone else is super nice and awesome though, very helpful. The young man that works Monday mornings is so nice and a really hard worker, always helping out!! He always says hi, planet fitness should give him a raise!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: As other's have stated the owner is a sexist, homophobe. Wish I had  read these reviews in advance. I stopped by with my girlfriend and my son and after waiting through two haircuts he tells us he does not cut women's hair. I have an undercut which I sort of got, but was  still confused, but my girlfriend has a man's haircut! Only goes to barber shops. We left without getting my son's haircut. Glad we held hands while sitting there - I hope we made him uncomfortable. It's astonishing to me that he has managed to stay in business  in broad ripple. The men who go there should do better.

Stayed here this past weekend for a quick staycation and totally loved the hotel, the kitchen was well stocked and the room nicely decorated. Love the modern decor, the pool, the outdoor firepits, the oversized chess set and ping pong table. Lots to do without needing to go anywhere. The only reason this is not 5 stars is because they need an onsite restaurant / bar. But Susan and the staff were all incredibly friendly and since this a great halfway point for our family (between Santa Maria and Los Angeles) we will be staying here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I'm not picky at all, let's just say that. I love supporting entrepreneurs so I try new places but I didn't feel very relaxed or happy during this experience. The color wasn't anything like the picture, but they all acted like they love it to get you out of the place. I spent most of my time with my head in a sink to let my hair take in the color, rather than relaxing in a chair, and the stylist was very rough with every touch. Ended up not liking my hair at all, and paying a crap ton. I'd go elsewhere personally.

The staff over at Derby are truly the mot genuine in town. The customer service is exceptional every single time I've gone for my cut, which has been over 10 times now. You can sit back, relax, and enjoy a prompt cocktail while taking a seat. Vinnie has been cutting my hair for the last 10 times now and I remember the first couple times I was in there asking about hair styles. I had no idea what i wanted but Vinnie was able to narrow down to some choices where the cut wouldn't be too exotic from what I was used to. Now my style has changed because of that and I can trust him with any type of cut.

The property and room itself were nice enough, but there were a lot of issues during my stay. The TV did not work, the toilet was plugged up, and the water in my shower was brown. In their defense they sent someone to fix the toilet immediately and I Did not have anymore problems with it after that. As far as the shower water, I was told they had activated a pump in the fire system which stirred up sediment in the plumbing. 

All that aside, I wish they had more of a lobby where you could sit and work or meet with others. If you're traveling for business, the courtyard down the street is probably a better choice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Refinanced my Mortgage with PFFCU this year. Although they gave me a decent interest rate, they advertised a $300.00 credit to any new Mortgage Accounts. 

I never received the $300.00 and asked customer service multiple times in regards to this. They stated that my Mortgage advisor never put me in for it even when I pointed it out and asked at the time of my application and closing! 

very upset that I was offered this and never received/noone from PFFCU was willing to offer any assistance in investigating. I feel like I was given the runaround.

Exceptionally good Italian food, friendly and welcoming staff
Hubby and I went for dinner after reading some favorable reviews. I had the Chicken Parm and he had the lasagna and a side of meatballs. Both dishes were amazingly excellent - the sauce is divine! The meatballs are meaty and not squishy! The portions are sizable. The staff seems to work as a team and everyone is so very friendly. We don't live in this area, but will definitely return to Allegria Italiana when we are next in the Tampa/Brandon area.

My husband and I stayed at the hotel for Labor Day weekend. The hotel was clean and we appreciated the Covid safety  protocols. The hotel is decorated so tastefully! The bar area was a great experience, however the drinks are over priced, about $14 for an adult Capri sun that was half filled. 
I would say the a downfall is the parking situation Valet only. $26 plus tax a day is a bit steep, but it was quick and the valets were friendly. 
We loved how close it was to bars and restaurants. We were able to easily take transit to downtown for shopping and restaurants.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place was HORRIBLE!!!!  I would have preferred a chain pizza place over this.  The pizza was room temperature when it arrived, most of the toppings were on one side, and it was flavorless.  The buffalo wings were even worse.  The sauce was no where near buffalo, it tasted like they had washed off BBQ wings and mixed hot sauce with mayonnaise then used an eye dropper to place the smallest amount of sauce possible.  I am so disappointed and will never order from here again, especially with Rino's delicious pizza right down the street.  I only tried it because of the good reviews, ugh!

It says that they close at 9pm online but they said they couldn't take me and a group of 4 friends who where willing to spend money on burgers and food. I drove from West Chester pa to here and the manager on site told me I should have gotten here 10mins earlier. Along with the employees who not only where rude when I walked it, but also decided to not put me on hold while I was trying to reach a manager and I overheard her talking badly about me. Never will I ever waste my time here and will encourage people to not come here. Also I'm heated yelp made me give them a one star they don't even deserve it.

I stayed here for a work conference, 3 nights. First night I checked in, the table was dirty and there were gold fish crackers on the ground. The bed sheets and pillows didn't look that clean. The bathroom floors were not clean. I requested for housekeeping the next morning and informed the front desk of how the room was. The front desk didn't apologize for the messy room or wasn't that accommodating. Walked in the room, some housekeeping was done, but that one gold fish cracker crumb was still in the same spot. Carpets looked filthy. Overall, not a pleasant stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Since moving to Philly 5 years ago, I have been bringing my car to Don's for oil change, inspection, and random other issues (blown headlight on a difficult-to-access model, checking alignment following fender bender). Each time I drive away with the assurance that my car has been thoroughly and professionally cared for at a fair price. As others have noted, the mechanics are excellent at diagnosing issues that puzzled other shops, and services that may be needed are described clearly, with options explained when available. Straightforward and businesslike, while also incredibly accommodating and respectful. Would recommend in a heartbeat.

First off not hibachi 100% , no tabletop to cook in front of you. Secondly service was terrible , we had a party of 6 (4 adults) two kids. Four plates of food came out and two people who ordered tempura were told few mins. After everyone all ate , there food arrived?! No apology and nothing to help out the check. Place was not busy but you could tell there understaffed and just don't care. Anyways I won't be going back. With are bill over 120$ due to 18% gratuities , I would have loved to have the service I paid for in the tip.

Let me start by saying I really like La Colombe and the other time I had their coffee it was a pleasant experience. However, this location was very sub-par. The cost was a little surprising (even for quality coffee shops) at $8 for a pour over. When it was served, they only filled my cup up probably 80% of the way. Not a little room for cream (which I do not use) but not a full cup. Probably because I was in a rush, but it felt like it took a long time. However, I do want to be clear, this is likely a one time flub. Still- I have experienced better.

My family stayed here and we had the worst hotel experience of our lives. We paid over $300 for a night and this property was horrific. 
Police and noise and screaming up and down the halls, roaches! Disgusting unusable outdoor area. 
The rooms were putrid. The bathrooms weren't cleaned, the beds had black bugs in them, the furniture was not only old, dingy and uncomfortable- but stinky and stained with crunchy sticky crusty mystery spots. 
Housekeeping manager was unhelpful and made fun of us for asking for help. 
Do not stay here with children, I regret exposing my daughter to this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The new property management has unfortunately ruined this complex. While the amenities may appear to be nice, it is not worth the cost. The hallways smell like garbage. Residents must pay for parking without the ability to park. Door handles are broken. Poor paint job in units. Residents let their pets pee in shared spaces. Unresponsive management is not in office during posted hours. 
If you're looking for apartments in the area, look across the street at Square on Delmar. They're newly renovated and more affordable. Don't waste your money at Vanguard Crossing.
