First off, this is a review of the barbershop, not the front of the store. Aidan Gill has one of the better selections of men's grooming products and other sundry items I've seen. 

So here goes... Like others have said, I wanted to like this place because it's just a walk down the street from me and for a person that keeps his hair as short as I do, this is a big deal. Haircut is $40 and for that price you get a beer, a shampoo, and a mediocre haircut. A patchy fade isn't a good look on anyone.

Oh well, time to walk a little bit farther down Magazine.

After 11 years of loving this bank, receiving new debit cards when due or lost, and writing checks, I suddenly find out today that I am not on the account! Eleven years people. When asked why they kept sending me cards, in my name, on my husband's account, they didn't know. This is not acceptable at all. We will be transferring our banking business to Golden One where I know we will not have to deal with this kind of idiocy ever again. I gave two stars because the Reno location has been a great bank until now.

The shuttle from the airport to the car rental center and back to the airport is ridiculously SLOW!  There is absolutely no reason it should take 30 minutes to go from the rental center to the airport! The driver drove so slow we nearly missed our flight! Luckily we had already checked our bags or it would be a different story. UNACCEPTABLE SERVICE!  Y'all need to use that pedal on the right known as the ACCELERATOR!  Makes you GO! Train your drivers that it's good to be safe, but if it takes 30 minutes to go a couple of miles, you need new training!

I purchased a case of wine to be shipped across the country. It was mid summer and wine was not to be shipped until late fall but they shipped it anyway. It showed up with many bottles leaking. They did have the case returned at there cost and I thought this is not working out so I cancelled order and was charged a 10% cancelation fee. Why, it was not re-shipped. I inquired and some how I received there inter office e-mails that were not meant for my eyes and they spoke very de-meaning about me and belittled me not knowing me at all. If this is how they speak about there customers behind closed doors I don't want any part of it-

Went to Edomasa yesterday (Thursday) around 10PM.
A big plus for being one of the few places open that late on a weekday around Santa Barbara.
It was also able to seat all ten of us without any waiting which was awesome.

The price was decent and the fish quality was very good.

I ordered the chiraki sushi which was various pieces of sashimi over a bowl of sushi rice.
It came with 11 pieces for me.  It included 2 pieces of egg which was good but I was hoping for every piece to be some sort of seafood.
Still, for the price, I enjoyed a good meal and was full when I left.

Will definitely come again.

My family loves this place!  We've been there eight times since we discovered the place.  The owner was very friendly and always willing to take a couple minutes to talk to you.  I would recommend this place to anyone.  I'm a vegetarian, and was getting bored with the choices of menu items at other Mexican restaurants.  At Don Cuervo's, I have never had that problem.  The veggie Chimichanga is the best I've ever eaten.  I have yet to be able to finish one.  Don Cuervo's Revenge Margarita is top shelf awesome! Last week we went on a Thursday and the place was packed!

We stayed there in Nov 2014 while attending the APA Amateur National Championships, it's a host hotel.  I just booked our reservation for NOV 2015 (today) and when I called, the staff let me request a specific room number (101 with a patio by the bay). I believe we dealt the manager, Chellie last year.  She was FANTASTIC as was the rest of the staff.  There were 8-10 of us staying in the hotel and we were all taken care of very graciously.  The hotel has nice patio rooms around the pool.  The pool was nice and chilly, just the way I like it.  The room was clean.  It's a long drive to the pool hall, but it's worth it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Probably the worst McDonald's I've had and I've had a lot. We went through the drive thru and had to pull around front to wait for our food. Apparently they needed the extra 5 minutes to make sure the buns were dried out enough. These buns were harder than a beach volleyball players butt.  Upon receiving my extremely bad food I had to remind them they were still missing one complete meal. Glad I got a receipt for this cause they asked to verify what I ordered. I think they planned it that way so the fries would get cold and tough. I live a tad over 1 mile away so it's not like the drive is what made my food bad.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Booked a room, 2 Queen beds, 4 guests. I called earlier to make sure they knew we would require a late check in, as we were driving from California. The lady I spoke with said our room would be ready for us, with no problem. After driving for 6 long hours, we arrived at 10:30pm. They asked if we absolutely needed 2 beds... Why else would I have booked a room with 2 beds? Come to find out, they don't have a room ready, and we would need to wait another 40 minutes. Then when we finally get our room, we have the maids outside yelling HOUSEKEEPING!!! At 11:30 at night!! Terrible experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Thin walls. Sure to be woken up by neighbors voices and housekeeping at 8am even after privacy sign up. Beds are uncomfortable spring mattresses with lumpy flat pillows. Water pressure in shower is low and temperature is very touchy. Temperature in room is freezing cold if ac running or burning hot on 72. No in between. Overall rooms are OK, but desperately needed updated. Lobby is nice, but luxury ends there. Definitely not worth a repeat visit, and if not a company paid expense I would ask for a refund. Made my 5 day visit extremely uncomfortable with not a single full nights rest.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Ordered the chicken with black bean sauce dinner combo. It's really tasty! It comes with an egg roll and a good amount of food.  Be sure to ask for chopsticks/ forks before you leave because it wasn't in the to-go bag.

The place was a little hard to find. It's tucked in the corner of a 3 store strip mall. No big signage on the outside. When you first walk in, it looks like a vase store with Asian antiques. When you walk up the counter, you can see the kitchen. There isn't anywhere to sit down, so it's take out only. Save yourself some time and place the order over the phone in advance.

I'd go back here again.

This was my first time at a meat and 3 type restaurant. Was not really sure what to expect. I can defiantly say I really enjoyed the corn bread it was great. I ordered the spicy fried chicken with green beans and fried apples.  The chicken was awesome just the right amount of spicy. 

But I must say the best part of it all was the server Abby. Not only was she beautiful but she was friendly and helpful. I have always heard people talk about southern hospitality and Abby was that and more. 

Thanks Fast Freddy's lunch was great

I called, checked to make sure my new insurance would work, and made an appointment. I'm a teacher; it's difficult to make appointments, so I was glad I found a time. I show up...nope, not on the books, no appointment. They DID show that I had called and updated my insurance, but no appointment. They clearly screwed up. And yet...There was no apology, no attempt to squeeze me in, nothing. The office manager guy displayed absolutely no regret. I will find a new eye doctor - I highly suggest avoiding this place, if only to avoid having to deal with this guy.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Stopped in to pickup a hand grenade with some friends. The person behind the bar was very attentive and quick given it was Jazzfest weekend. While waiting though, an employee by the name of Malcom got very confrontational with 2 of my friends over nothing. Seemingly, he just didn't like the look one of my friends had on his face, and yelled at him "You wanna take this outside?!"
We had just gotten our order, we were getting set to leave, and this was our first stop on Bourbon Street for the evening. Very unprofessional, left a very bad taste in our mouths even though the drinks were great.

Very friendly and attentive staff here.  Convenient location and decent parking.  Rooms are a titch dated, but fine.  Chief downside is the lounge on the top floor.  There are no comfortable seats for sitting and relaxing, and the breakfast offerings are wanting - they offer eggs but no breakfast meats or potatoes.  I asked the staff why not and the reply was "if we made those things available, people would eat it all."   The lounge has a cramped, "we just want you to get in and out of here" feel.  Bar/restaurant on the ground floor is superior.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Read! Great people and good service. Just one issue!!! I took my dog in for teeth cleaning and extraction. During the review process of my quote I was told extractions are 10 to 50 dollars. From simple to worse case. So they quoted me 150 just in case they had to extract multiple teeth. ONE TOOTH. One tooth was pulled but because it was decaying badly they decided to charge me the $150 price! That is just ridiculous. First I'm told 50 dollars worse case per tooth. Now they're going to triple that price for one tooth? Very mad and feel like I was robbed. Just glad my dog is ok.

I had wrote a review here previously, but it needed updating. 

I needed Chinese and this was the only place with the ability to order online which I needed because I lost my voice. I got a phone call and was told to open the door for my food, which was weird because I hadn't heard a knock and the door to my apartment building isn't locked. I walk out and nobody is there. Then in rushes a man who hands me my food and started basically yelling at me to not order online. Then he left. 

Why bother having an online option if you don't want food ordered online??? I did not appreciate being yelled at.

Stopped here with my family after a flight in from MA. THE PIZZA IS AMAZING!! NY style pizza that is done to perfection. We also had meatballs, chicken Marsala, steak & cheese & garlic bread. Everything was so delicious!! The staff was great & Chris Pazzo came out to every table to check on his customers to make sure we were all satisfied. This restaurant is a must weather you're just visiting or live in the area. Thanks Chris for a great meal & making us feel like part of the Pazzo family!! We will definitely be back!!

This was the absolute best car rental agency I have used in the US. At the last minute a storm blew into Lake Tahoe at the end of May. I needed a 4wd to get over the summit. They replied immediately. Met me with a Lyft within minutes of walking out if baggage claim. Opened my car door, put my luggage in the the car and turned on my seat heaters. Wow. The car was perfect. Great price. Brought it back and it was effortless to return it. They are the rockstars of car rental people. Seriously. They have my business for life.

They said our wait would be 30 minutes and it ended up being a two hour wait... once seated the server with the red hair also took thirty minutes to come to our table to take everyone's orders. When we asked why our server hadn't come to our table she ended up having all another server help our table. She proceeded to give us attitude the entire time we were there. The server that we had was amazing but the red head made us wait for no reason, and had a horrible attitude. She should not be working there. 

I understand it gets busy but make more of an effort.

Terrible place. They don't know what customer srrvice is. Pulled into this Dobbs with a tire rapidly loosing air. My husband went inside to ask for help and was told it would be 2 hours before they could get it fixed. Meanwhile the tire went totally flat in the parking lot of Dobbs. So here we are sitting in Dobb's parking lot changing a flat tire. Nobody offering to help until I get up and I'm holding the tire so my husband can adjust the jack. Then the manager comes out and offers to help. Really we needed your help when we arrived. We will never be back. The only reason it's getting one star is because I can't give it a 0.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Drugs, break ins, rats, bugs, flooding, rude office staff, and poor maintenance. I've lived here for almost 3 years, and this place has gone way down hill. It used to be a quite place to live, but between people getting murdered here, increasing rent for "upgrades", always seeing pest control and having issues with roaches, them taking their sweet time to "repair" anything, dog poop everywhere, people breaking into apartments and vehicles....I could go on. AVOID THIS PLACE. For almost $900 for 750 sqft one bedroom you can do WAY better.

Nothing special with the dishes we had at the Paddock. We started with the brushetta appetizer and that was tasty, so I was looking forward to the entrees. I went with the salmon. The salmon seemed fresh but the only flavor that really emerged was salt. At first bite, the spinach side was garlicky and wasn't drenched in olive oil, which I appreciate, but by the end I felt like I was eating raw spinach out of a Fresh Express bag. My friend went with the Crab Ravioli. Again, nothing special. The sauce was average and not much flavor besides that. The waiter was attentive, but I don't think we'll return.

This hotel is a "basic" hotel; had two major problems, however,  The very small toilets (very small and low) backed up and they could not fix it while I was there for 2 days!!!  Second, they double charge for the room; they charged me and my friend---paid double!!!  I called the hotel, was patient, and asked the manager to call me back.  He never returned my call. Called again, and made the same request.  They NEVER returned my call.  I am now trying to deal with VISA company.  Very unethical.  DO NOT USE THIS HOTEL!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I ordered a salad, and it was pretty tasty, though a little light on the toppings. The menu looks fantastic- great options and fair prices. Contrary to other reviews, the service was pretty awful. It's possible that the man who was helping me is new, but he seemed very disoriented and had difficulty answering my basic question about fountain drink sizes and prices. I'll come back and give it another shot because the menu looks so great, but I'm hoping in my future experiences I get to enjoy the great service these other reviews are referring to.

Stay away!!! I tried this place after the race for a cure and they had some sort of healthy buffet. When we arrived none of the workers told us where or how we could recieve our food! Then we had to walk from upstairs to the downstairs section each time we wanted another plate. After my first plate I couldn't stomach a second!!! The glasses they put their drinks in are extremely small as well so you'll get atleast 3-4 refills. The food was great for some sort of health freak but to the average Joe this place is a big no-no!!! The only part of my dining experience I enjoyed was the beautiful building they are in!

Although the food was amazing, the service was horrible. The kid acting as a host said it would be a 45 min wait even though there were half the tables open and not a lot of people. I asked why so long and he replied with "well there is no one to clean the tables right now". I seriously couldn't believe it. I laughed and said "well you don't seem to be so busy so you should probably help". He rolled his eyes and did go clean. Had us seated in ten mins because the bar stools opened up. The bartender was very nice and on point. Food was great which is why I am giving it a 3.

I always order from Mario's pizza , they have the best pizza I ever had. Just recently I ordered some food from there and when I got my total, the prices doesn't match what the menu states. After I questioned the prices, the employee stated that I have the old menu. So I replied, that I ALWAYS order from you. Just to be fair, I asked for the delivery to come with the NEW MENU. She says, "OH!!, there not printed up yet." So from this one bad experience, I will not ever order from them again. I do not like when the customer is not valued and practices that seem untrustworthy. Good food but check your total for accuracy .   Hope this helps.....

Today. Stuck in the Drive Thru at this McDonald's for 45 minutes and the worse part was...is they forgot to put in my father's hamburger in our bag. God don't you hate that when that happens?
Being charge for something that you didn't get.

And when you tell them, they really dont give a flip. And who wants to be the crazy person on YouTube yelling at the Manager?

Now I know why this place was rated one and a half stars on Yelp. This is the whole point about Yelp. Buyer Beware. Double Check your bag and don't order the Big Mac. It was yuck.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I went to this location on Tuesday the 22nd of October, 2013 at 3:10pm..  When I got there I discovered that I forgot one of my tickets.  There was three attendants there.  One who was sitting down. I gave the young lady the information she requested about the forgotten ticket and she told me that she did not have time to look for it.  I did not understand because there was two others there and they said they did not have time also. I felt bad because I was the only customer there at the time...WOW...Terrible customer service!!!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Heard about this place and wanted to try it out. Took the wife out for a date night.  The atmosaphere is very nice and upscale. The service seemed slow to me for what was not a very busy night. As for the food, th eappetizer of tomato mac n' cheese was good, though in retrospect, it just taste like average lasagna,  For dinner, I had the special, a 14 oz NY Strip, with Nashed potatoes and bacon kale.  The meal was excellent. Overall though, I don't think this place will be on my regular rotation. The food is good, but not good enough to be as expensive as it is. For the price, I would take Iron Hill or Harry's over Moro.

Read the great reviews so had to try. The service was inattentive- gave me the wrong lunch and my new salad literally took 15 minutes after the other pizza lunches arrived. Barely an apology and then overcharged me for the salad!!!! When I told the waiter he overcharged me he said he didn't think he could change it- well, I had assumed it would be taken off of me bill in the first place. 2 of us ordered drinks and those didn't come until we asked. There were only 2 other diners at the time. The upside was the food was very good.

Like others have said, this is NOT a Hotel, it is a Motel that they repainted. Very overpriced at $400 a night for a motel. Rooms have no luxuries. I went during Covid and they said that was the reason there was no coffee in the lobby. You also have to pay for parking at the 99 Cent Store parking lot next door.

My girlfriend booked the place because she saw the price and thought "It must be high-end".

It is dog friendly which is why we stayed there with my dog, and they have a little fenced in dog area which is nice. It is also very close to main street with lots of restaurants and shops within walking distance.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The customer service at Oaxaca Fresh was VERY poor! We waited 20 minutes to get our order taken and we were only one of two families in the entire restaurant. When asked for water, the waitress seemed bothered. At one point, she started eating her lunch in front us, not bothering to ask if we needed anything else to drink while we waited. When we finally got our food, 45 minutes later, it was COLD. The food was bland and almost tasteless. I would NOT recommend this restaurant. When you see the sign Oaxaca Fresh, KEEP WALKING!

I never leave negative reviews.  We haven't even gotten up from the table yet and I feel compelled to write a review.  For nearly $30 a plate, our piccata was not breaded, the chicken was tough, and our pasta was not even cooked al deńte.  The Alfredo wasn't palatable, and the seafood bisque was salty.

The mussels were good, and the bread was tasty!

The service wasn't bad, if you only want friendly faces and  mussels it's not too bad.

I did feel like the hostess was not as warm and friendly and I would have liked--like maybe we weren't good enough to eat there.

Unmitigated disaster! Don't do it! Hertz, Nashville is awful!
Needed a car to drive from Nashville to Atlanta, (5 hours). Hertz insisted that I keep the car for two days accruing a fee of $600! $600 for a five hour trip? We said OK and on the date and time for us to pick up the car, Hertz Nashville informed us that they had no cars, none!, further that they are closing in 30 minutes! WTF do we do?
Uber agreed to drive the five hours for $5oo.
Hertz is going out of business and does not care about good will or customer service. Don't do this to yourself!

DO NOT USE THIS LENDING COMPANY I REPEAT DO NOT USE THIS LENDING COMPANY they will distroy your credit rating . They lie about trying to contact you so u can fix the problem and just send u to a collection agency. They said they sent emails( I can check my history  no emails) called my home phone who even picks that up anymore they have my cell. They will not go out of the way to try and fix anythig they have done. Just tell Lies lies lies. I have never written a review before but the general public deserves to be warned about this company .  0 stars as far as I am concerned just yelp won't post the review unless u give a star.

Our first time at this hotel and we were very impressed from check in to check out.  Very friendly onsite staff.  Remodeled rooms which looked great with upgraded amenities thoughout.  The grounds reminded us of being in Hawaii.  Great pool area.  Continental breakfast bar had everything possible.  10-15 minute drive from Santa Barbara and less than 5 minutes from SB airport.

Other than for a couple slamming room doors by unthoughtful guest in the early morning hours, we would definitely stay here again.

Thank you for the hospitality!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: A friend and I stayed at this hotel and it was horrific. There was throw up outside our door, a dirty rag in our bathroom that was wet and the WiFi did not work. Not to mention that there were no towels in our bathroom. We checked in at 12 but went to get food and had not gone up to our room til 3. I do not recommend this hotel at all. Also, parking fee was $40 and we had already spent $150 to stay in a "nice" hotel. At that point, my friend and I did not feel comfortable nor clean at all and wish we had chosen another hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The owner is Noel and he is the guy that did my hair. As I walk in, I'm looking for the prices and Barber On Whyte has the board up in front. Not hidden somewhere. First plus for me.

Anyways, I've been to many different barbers in Edmonton and haven't had a decent haircut by any single one. Noel asked me what I'd like and then he said he had the perfect look for me. Completely confident.  2nd plus. And he showed it! Slightly cocky but in the nicest way possible, but definitely backs it up with skill! What an awesome Barber, really! Kudos to the guy!

I would give this zero stars if I could. EVERY single time I go here there is an issue. Whether it be waiting in the drive thru for 20 minutes, to after waiting 20 minutes my order coming out wrong. This is the most unorganized establishment I've ever been to. Not to mention unprofessional. One time they put my hash browns in the bag with no paper cover, literally just the hash browns. This McDonald's needs a whole new more professional staff. I get it's McDonald's but seriously, have some standards. I've never left a yelp review before but after multiple mishaps here, I've reached my breaking point.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: 2/29/16 my dog Fred was hit by a car.  He had a punctured lung and broken hip.  He was transferred from another Emergency vet Bc the vet recommended it Bc of his fracture.  I will say the whole experience was amazing. They treated my dog like a person.  The techs, front desk, and docs. Dr Whitehead called me everyday he was in ICU. The cost even was cheaper than estimated.  All vet bills are $$$ but I expected at least as much as the quote.  This place treated my dog better than some local hospitals treat people !

Staff was very nice and the breakfast was basic but the area was clean/well taken care of. The room however, yikes. The bathroom only flushed sometimes. There were random hairs strewn about the floor, towels, bathroom sink. Nothing had been dusted or wiped down in a while. The carpet looked like it hadn't been changed in many many years. I guess you can't expect much from a hotel right off the turnpike. Lesson learned. We didn't bother complaining because we were so tired when we checked in so can't speak to how they would have handled the situation.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I honestly feel that this restaurant is confused as to what it is. You could almost split it in half and have fine wine and dining on one side and a brewpub style relaxed eatery on the other. The food and atmosphere are both bland and eerie. Our server was very friendly although the hostess seemed to lack enthusiasm. Honestly there's nothing here that draws me back. The environment is clean, but outdated and not inviting. The food was cooked correctly to our specifications but just nothing special.

Here's to hoping that something changes as we'd love to come back, the location is very pleasant. Not angry, just disappointed.

We dropped in for a night cap after treating the in-laws to dinner around the corner.  I found The Atlas Bar on yelp and was hoping for a laid back type of ambiance but when we walked in the music was blaring with some heavy metal jams. . . although the cocktails were great and the service was wonderful. . .the music didn't quite match the vibes the bar and the decor gives off. 

Note that we arrived around 730 as the sun was setting gorgeously. . . we sat in the elevated back area and enjoyed our one round and moved on to a bottle of wine across the street.

Maybe on the next visit to Boise, we will give it another try.

4/5 stars, first off let me say the ingredients is what made this pizza top notch. Tastes like a quality homemade pizza, the sauce, zesty pepperoni, and cheese all taste like they are made fresh. I have ate here twice, both times pepperoni pizzas with mushrooms. 

The only reason it's 4/5 and not 5 is because when you grab a slice the cheese and alot of the sauce tend to slide off. That shouldn't happen to pizza. I'm no chef but I think the sauce itself should be a little thicker, or maybe make the pizza dough a little thicker around the middle? If they fix the issue of the toppings sliding off then it's a 5/5 from me!

Absolutely the worst customer service ever. I stay at Marriott properties almost weekly for work. This property is a dump. The carpet in my room was wet and my room smelled like mold. I was supposed to be able to use a certificate for my stay which was approved by the hotel and then they went back on their word. Being a Platinum Elite member doesn't mean anything to Marriot I have spent over 4 hours of my time trying to resolve an issue over $183. Stay away from this property! Margarette and the General manager are absolutely awful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This restaurant was ok. Service was nice and helpful. My wife had the charcuterie/cheese board, and she LOVED it.

I had the fried chicken. The pancake that it came with was delicious, and the chicken was moist and had a great batter. The honey that came on the side with the chicken was delicious. The only problem was that there was absolutely no salt in the fried chicken batter. Since everything else was good, I'm guessing that someone accidentally missed the step in the recipe where you put salt in the batter. 

We'll definitely give this place another shot.

We love going to different Food Network restaurants. Meglio's Italian is definitely worth going to dinner or lunch. The salad dressing was homemade and the salad was huge. We ordered off the 2 for $25 menu. We got the Eggplant ravioli as an appetizer and it was scrumptious. The sauce was definitely homemade also. My Hubby ordered the spaghetti and it had one huge meatball. Excellent choice! But mine was the best choice of all. I had the Parmesan crusted Tilapia. It was one big fish. And cooked to perfection. We both left full and feeling we got more for our $$. Don't miss this place!!! We were just passing through on our way to PA from CO.

First and last time I go to American Cleaners. My dress was damaged and had to be sent off for repair, and I was still charged full price for the cleaning of it. Even though my phone number was taken down when the dress was sent off for repair, I had to call two weeks later to see if the dress was in. Tammy (sp?) answered the phone, and when it took me 20 seconds to retrieve my ticket, she rudely said "Listen, ma'am I have another call." And abruptly hung up on me. Expensive, damaged clothes, terrible customer service.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: If I could give them less than one star I would. We made our reservations more than 2 weeks in advance. We got to the hotel and the desk clerk said they had no clean rooms. They turned away at least two other customers away. One customer they told they were full since Thursday the customer said she had made her reservation on Friday. Then when we went up to the counter the front desk clerk told us they had no clean rooms and because we made our reservation through a third party it was our problem to get a refund and  they would not help us find another hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This was the perfect hotel for our family of 5. Could not have asked for more. The room was nice with room to move around. The beds and pillows were very comfortable. The complimentary shampoo, conditioner and shower gel in the shower were a plus. The continental breakfast was great! Enough for everyone to enjoy. It was very quiet despite being real close to the highway. Located near many shops. Did not know what to expect when I booked this hotel and actually hesitated until I read the great reviews. This place exceeded our expectations for our mini trip! Thank you Holiday Inn Express, we will be coming back!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Nice place... Mexican style from the tables to the decor on the walls. They even make their tortilla by hand, awesome.  
Ok ordered the Mole egg enchilada plate.  and some flour tortilla. Well mole sauce was ok a bit spice and sweet. The mole enchilada was good, egg in the middle. ( something new) with beans.  Give it a 7.  The flour tortilla was a disappointing---.  They looked like tortilla on a diet and no flavor!  Sad. The tortilla maker needs to work on that! They should be a bit more fluffier and I can pass on the flavor I guess. Service was good.  Waiter kept our coffee cup filled  giving it a 3 star. Maybe next time Teresa Mosaic.

Came in a large group last weekend, so was able to try a lot of dishes. Nothing was particularly noteworthy. it may compare favorably to other restaurants in reno, but i've had consistenrtly better dining experiences at similar price points in SF. i ordered the burger and wished for in n out the whole time. and they didn't have ketchup, only the house-made ketchup that tasted like spicy cocktail sauce! boo. my gf had the tilefish which she enjoyed at the moment, but would never crave again. another friend ordered the pre-fixe and he gave the thumbs down.

Don't drop your clothes off here for any sort of next day cleaning. You're probably going to find them on the floor and in worse condition than you dropped them off.

Dropped my a suit and shirt off for next-day dry cleaning. The staff assured me my clothes would be ready the next morning after I explained I needed them done for a wedding.

Arrived the following morning to find that not only were my clothes not done. But that they had been scattered randomly throughout their building. Some of them were even on the floor.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: One of the more reasonable priced places you can stay out on the Gold Coast although this place comes with its own problems. While the full breakfast bar was stocked with everything to make you start the day full, (omelettes, bacon,sausage, pancakes, yogurt and plenty more), when the lights go out and you try to fall asleep, those like me who are light sleepers can hear water running through the pipes of the upper units and cable tv that has more signal drops then a sacked QB. All in all, staff is great and accommodating and the bed and pillows are nice and firm. It even smells fresh, which the ladies like.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Probably the worst experience I have had with a rental agency in my 30 years of renting cars. I rented a compact from October 21 through October 23. They gave me a receipt for a Ford Explorer. The receipt was for October 21-22. The receipt also stated that my rental included a fuel option: a blatant lie. I am at Virginia Tech and I have very positive experiences with the nearby Enterprise. This experience was awful. The manager, a guy named Bret, called me to say "we will take care of this and I will send you an email shortly." They didn't.

We'll see if my opinion changes, but so far I'm very unimpressed. They would not let us check in when we arrived, and informed us that we would have a guaranteed room at 4:00. Came back at 4 and not only was there not a room ready (STILL) but they wouldn't even let us pay for the room to at least get that part out of the way. I am sitting in the lobby in my swimming trunks waiting because we had gone to the beach to use up some time, figuring the room would be ready when promised. Stupid me. Like I said, if we ever get into a room, my opinion may change. So far though, this sucks!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The only thing edomasa has going for it is the late hours. Sushi here is simply of unimpressive quality and over priced ($28 for 6 slices of fish on top of rice?). We ordered a roll which came cut crooked and uneven. A sushi "chef" is going to be satisfied serving a roll like that to a customer? This is the 2nd time we've been here, the first we only ordered appetizers which were quite good actually. Come here only for the gimmick of late night sushi. Otherwise go to Goleta Sushi House on hollister for quality.

DON'T rent from these people!!!!
We signed an agreement for one amount that was signed and we had the contract for.  Then 4 days later they called and tried to bully us into signing a new contract for 5x the original amount. Clearly we did not sign the new contract but they had the audacity to charge me over $400 more than agreed. I asked to speak to the manager, left her messages and she didn't return my calls to resolve this issue.

They are DISHONEST and have HORRIBLE customer service. Please find another rental company to rent from.  Save yourself the aggravation.

Well the food looks amazing but I wouldn't know. On a visit to see my mom and we tried to go tonight and we were ignored for 10 minutes! The same waitress kept looking at us then walking away. Finally the guy from the bar told us he would be with us in just a moment and we stood there for another 5 minutes while he walked into the back to talk with the chefs when a moment before he was simply cleaning glasses, no one was at the bar! Worst service ever, I have never been ignored that long at a business. Don't bother trying, the staff is beyond rude.

So me and my family came into town for my cousins Stable wedding. We first got checked in and walked to our room that was in the corner. Our carpet was so dirty and badly stained with dark spots all over we didn't even feel comfortable walking in our socks!! Our shower was badly stopped up and flooded with water when we took a shower. On top of that the ceiling in in the lobby area was leaking water on us ! Our complaints just went out the door after that. It was bad ! Our stay was horrible and I will never come back again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I really wanted to try rolled ice cream. So today l went out with my friends just to try this! The place was nice and clean. I got the Cookies and cream with banana. The first bite that I ate, OMG CAN I TELL YOU! This can be one of the best ice creams I've ever tasted! The cream isn't too sweet which I think that they made it themselves. When you dig into the ice cream, it is very frozen. I somewhat like that texture of ice cream. There is a variety of toppings which you can choose as much as you want. The ice cream is awesome and great for taking Instagram worthy pictures!

Wow, is all I can say. The filthiest motel that I've ever stayed at. We arrived after 1:00am, and had to get an early start...the linen seemed clean so we just slept and tried not touch anything. Rugs were filthy, had to pull the nightstand out to look for a plugin for a cpap, found 3/8" of dirt back there. All grouting is black and mouldy, Kleenex dispenser ripped out of wall, shampoo/conditioner dispenser empty, toilet not cleaned included "skid marks! Nasty, dirty, fowl! Buyer beware....this place is not just "dumpy", or old/dated, it is seriously neglected and unclean. It really needs a visit from the dept. of health.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Reading other reviews makes me wonder if I am at the same place.  As a platinum elite member we have stayed at many Marriott properties and this one is not as nice.  Renovations are far more than led to believe.  Placed in handicapped room and told at check in that is all they had.  Not enough storage space.  Bathroom has sink only so no place for toiletries. May be the new "contemporary design" but not functional at all.   Gave it 3 stars because if amazing view and friendly employees.  It's ok--and you do have great views---but I would check around before booking.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Honestly, 0 stars. 
To begin with, I was so excited for this event that started at 8pm. To hear a day before that it was moved up to 6pm. I missed THREE of my favorite artists because of this time change, the venue literally cut off the time for these artists. So unprofessional! Would not recommend whatsoever. 
To make matters even worse, the restrooms are disgusting, reminding me of when we were in middle school and people wrote all over the stalls. 
The place is dusty, washed up and is literally in the middle of renovating. 
Most employees were rude and paid no mind to the guests. Says a lot about management.

Called October 8th for a specific liquor that they showed on there web site. The lady that answered the phone was not very nice when I told her 3 times that I had there sku number. She finally looked it up and said they had 8 bottles in stock. I drove 45 miles to find out they didn't have the liquor that was on the web site and that the rude lady said they had 8 bottles of. Sales person said there numbers where screwed up and they didn't have it. I told him that I was not happy. He shrugged his shoulders like that's my problem. Not a good buying experience.    Find a different liquor store

Normally I would leave a four star for this hotel but they have a problem with not soundproofing the hotel. I was woken up three times during the night from the outside door being pushed open and closing. I could hear other guests walking loudly above me and talking which I could hear through my hotel door. They may not of been walking that heavy but the soundproofing in this hotel is horrible and it's right by the airport so you can hear airplane noise through the window. Aside from the noise issue everything else in this hotel is fine and I found a hot wire deal for $44 which is a great deal
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I had the privilege of going here today since i heard they sometimes have Russian River beer.  Upon entry, a staff member quickly greeted me and explained the lay out of their store.  From location of american craft organized by regions in US, to imports.  The staff were very knowledgeable on the beer.  I asked why I should get headhunter IPA and after 30 seconds I bought a case, which this beer is hard to find, especially since I live in VA/DC area.  I will definitely come back when I am in the Philly area!

Had to change rooms. The first didn't have warm water or a functional heater. The bed looks like it hosted a sit in - sagging in the middle. The receptacle was a fire hazard falling out of wall. There was mold in the bath and stains on the carpet. Dinner took 1.5 hours; there were only 4 people in the restaurant. The second room was better but about the size of a shoebox. The Holiday Inn Express I stayed in the night before was more comfortable and clean. This is my 3rd stay here, and the other 2 stays were pleasant.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I waited forever on a Friday afternoon at 5:00 - there was one attendant that apparently had the flu and was mostly in the bathroom.
Got a nice car but the canopy/ceiling in the car was splattered with what looked like a soda had exploded. 
Everything was okay but now am having to fight to get my "$250 deposit" back. They didn't "automatically" credit my account and now I've been calling (on hold for lengthy periods) trying to find out what's going on. Last I was told, it was input manually and will take another 5 business days to process. 
I guess you get what you pay for . . . .  I'd stay away.

Totally disappointed with our trip. We usually stay at the one in North Wales and love it. We had a wedding in the area so we thought we would come here for a mini vacation. I chose here becuase of having a pool and we like the staybridge name. We'll for one the pools not even open which right now I feel ripped off. I could s ok t in my room at home so mini vacation ruined!
Then in the bathroom there is black mold on the wall by the tub! No place to sit outside with shade.  Definitely don't recommend this staybridge!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The stay as such was ok. My 2 stars are for the horrible service they offered over the phone after over-charging us for valet services on the bill. I called three times in two days - I was put on hold every single time. Every time they told me they would call me in back in 20-30 minutes. Took down my details and just didn't get back to me. Called today and told them I would leave a bad review and they put in my refund for the valet mishap now. I don't want to be calling three times with frustration for something as simple as this.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Started getting my haircut from Josh a few years ago and I can't be more pleased with the consistent cut's!  He's a true artist with the scissors and clippers.  I also like the fact that his shop has T.V.s and music playing.  It makes getting a haircut feel like you're right at home.  His shop is super clean and the other barbers seem to be great people too.  Getting a haircut at SB Barbers is the best return on your investment... You spend a little and walk out feeling like a Million Bucks.  Highly recommend it.  

Aaron G-

I lived in a cute junior one bedroom at Home Suites and I loved it! It was perfect for me. I loved that I was still able to have a full size kitchen in a studio. I love cooking so that was a must for me. 

Living here I was so close to everything. You're close to the freeway, shopping and food which was so convenient. I would honestly still be living there but I needed a two bedroom. 

The office and maintenance staff were also super easy to work with. My move in and move out went so smooth and I never had an issues with my apartment itself. 

If you're looking to live in the sparks area then I would definitely suggest Home Suites!

Location is nice, the hotel is very clean and has a nice design. When we arrived we had suitcases and stroller it was a struggle getting through the doors. Would be nice if someone was there to open them or if there was a button to press for automatic doors. Happened a few times at 3 different times. Front desk people don't look or sound friendly and one of males that checked us in was a bit rude. Rooms are nice however what I don't like are the sharp corners of the bed frame, no water and no coffee. 

I believe if they get all those things right they would have one of the best hotels in Nashville.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Hotel staff are less than accommodating. Stayed for three days a room only cleaned once. I asked a housekeeper for extra towels, she asked if I called downstairs in advance- I told her yes. She left me no towels, came back 15 minutes later with towels but by that time I had already showered. Wouldn't have been a big deal but for the fact she had towels with her!! Not sure why she left only to come back- as if my word weren't good enough. The staff just doesn't seem committed to service excellence. Considering all the neighboring hotels this would not be my default.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Everyone here was amazingly helpful and super nice. The Starbucks/bar/limited menu in the lobby was great. Best lobby I have had in a hotel, live music every night, lots of tables, comfy chairs. Rooms were spacious, will agree with the other poster that the vanity is crazy deep so make up is hard to apply especially with the standard low lights in hotel bathrooms. Great breakfast buffet and well trained staff, highly recommend. Location is awesome all downtown is easy walking distance and anytbing out if town is only a $5-7/Uber/lyft ride. We would definitely stay here next time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: So today was my Mother's 95th birthday and we booked their banquet room. They only serve breakfast until noon on the weekends so we had to wait 30 minutes to get the lunch menu then another 15 minutes till the 1 server they had assigned us to take our order. Then they brought the food out with that same 1 waiter. By the time everybody had their food the first ones to be served had cold food. It's pricey, $10 for 2 ground beef tacos with rice and beans. The food was good but the service for such a momentous celebration was unfortunate.

I have never been to a barber before Derby, and I will never go anywhere again! I look forward to every haircut and beard trim I get. I leave here feeling like a million bucks! Vinnie is the most friendly and professional person I have ever had  cut my hair. To be able to get a nice drink while you get your hair cut is the greatest thing ever! Derby is an all around amazing business! I have recommended a hand full of friends. They all say the same and this is the only place they go now to! If you don't come here you are missing out! So do yourself a favor and get down here and get a hair cut!

THE BEST RESTAURANT we've eaten at in years. We had a large group, so each of us ordered something different and shared everything family style. This gave us an opportunity to try a little of everything. The Chicken Schnitzel is simply put the best chicken sandwich I have ever tasted, but the Lamb Ribs were my favorite of the night!  

The atmosphere is really cool with an open kitchen. And the waitstaff.... EXCELLENT!  

Overall: My New Favorite Nashville Restaurant!  If not my favorite in all of the South.

Went in expecting a solid coffee shop but was disappointed. Tables were all dirty and the pour over my companion ordered which was to take 6 mins took around 15 mins. Furthermore, the coffee was only 2/3 of the way full. The store was not busy and there is no reason why the 4 employees who were just sitting and talking could not have cleaned up or made the coffee in a more timely manner. $8 for a (not even full cup of) coffee and tea? Waste of time and money. There are tons of good shops in the city that'll do a better job.

Eclipse was amazing. The atmosphere is classy but comfortable. The bartender Dave gave us great service and was a lot of fun. I had the beef carpachio for an appetizer and it was so delicious I could have stopped right there! But then came the entree!!! I had the Berkshire Pork. I can honestly say that it was the best I've ever had. To wrap it up, we had the creme Brule...so so good!!  Our waiter Jack was so personable and made us feel extra special. Ask to be seated with Jack, he will give you amazing service.  
Definitely a meal to remember and Eclipse has become my new favorite Wilmington dining spot!!

I was concerned after reading reviews on Yelp. I was pleasantly pleased. I was greeted by the ladies and my Groupon vouchers was verified.  I was not treated differently because I had coupon. Lori came over and helped me look at glasses and gave me her honest opinion.  She did not say everything looked good. She took her time with me until we both found glasses that suited me. What great personal service. I am honest straight forward person I like to see that in a sales or customer service person. I have to bring in my deposit. Lori said I could call it in using my credit card. They don't except checks. Great experience.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: How can you rate a salon that you can t even make an appointment for?  Nobody ever answers the phone or returns calls from voicemails.  I physically had to go down to the salon after work one day and make a nail appointment for me and a friend.  I had to make an appointment a month in advance.  Today (the day of my appointment) I get a phone call stating that the nail lady isn t coming in.  I call back and OF COURSE nobody answers.  I m done.  Customer service is horrible!  I bought 3 groupons for this place and just refunded all of them.  Unreal.

This place was a complete waste of time to go to. We sat waiting to order our food for over 10 minutes, and no one ever came over the speaker. We tried circling the parking lot and going back around to order again with the same outcome as the first time. The building looked empty, and the employees were seen inside doing absolutely nothing. This was a huge waste of time. I feel sorry for anyone that has to go there and deal with those jerks. Dirty, understaffed, and unorganized this mcdonalds is very easily the most dysfunctional establishment I have ever been to. There are crack houses in Philadelphia that look more appealing then this place.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I had such a fun time at this hotel. I was there for a week long training but they made me feel right at home. The hotel itself is beautiful, clean & up to date. There is a huge pool/hot tub to enjoy, as well as a free breakfast everyday and a light dinner with free beer and wine 3 days a week! My room was serviced and cleaned everyday. I had fresh towels everyday as well. Awesome. Both Drew and Robbie are the sweetest staff members. They were both very helpful and I was able to have a nice conversation with each of them. I had a 10/10 experience and I hope to stay in your hotel again very soon!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The three star was mainly for the wait. Sushi, edamame, squid salad, and pork dumplings were all really good and inexpensive. The only downside was we waited at least 40 minutes for our food. There was only one guy making the sushi and we did have a party of 8, but it was Mardi Gras so I figure everywhere would be a little more prepared.

I got the New Orleans and snow crab rolls with miso soup. All fantastic!  Smaller groups looked like they weren't waiting as long. 

I would most definitely recommend this place and would eat here again.

Sopped in the drive thru today. The lady at the first window was very pleasant . When I drove to the next window a young rude girl with pink bright lipstick gave my order . I asked for extra ketchup as she gave me the ketchup she literally gave me the stare of death in a very unprofessional  manner and literally slammed the ketchup in my hand. She should not be working there if she continues with her juvenile high school behavior. I am a regular customer and this is the first time I have encountered very rude staff. Not impressed .
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Stayed August 21, 2013.  Had two room suite.  The property is fairly new probably 21st century.  Rooms were clean and no bedbugs.  Beds were very comfortable.  Nice kitchen, big refrigerator. Bath was clean and quite serviceable.  Hot water was indeed hot, but not dangerously so.  No variation in temperature with time.  Very quiet, back from highway.  Breakfast was at best mediocre, which is why I downgraded the stars.  All carbs, no meats, lots of sugar, no cream or half n half.  Awful coconut based whitener for coffee.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I'm over this store completely. I went online and set up my appointment to get an oil change. This store showed all the available appointment they had available. The appointment was set the night before online. The store opened Saturday morning at 8am. They waited until around 930am to contact my phone and cancel my appointment due to all the people already in the store. Thats not how it works if you have walk ins then you need to set them an appointment , and you need to check your schedule first. This was very disappointing.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: You can tell even before you walk through the door that this place is a hidden gem. Off of Main in downtown New Port Richey, J & M is the the only place a well groomed gentleman (or woman) can go to get a cut and a shave. This is a no frills place, run by craftsmen. You will spend a good amount of time in the chair, but every second is worth it. The skill and attention to detail you get for $20 just can't be beat. I shopped around at other barbershops but always left feeling like they didn't give me the cut I asked for. Moe on the other hand got it right the first time and gained a loyal customer. Do yourself a favor and check this place out.

My friend and I were in New Orleans for a few days and decided to rent a car to visit Alabama and Mississippi. Due to the flooding incidents in Baton Rogue all the major car rentals (Herz, Enterprise, etc...) were sold out so we ended up renting from A Priority One...and that was the best idea ever!

James and his family run the business and they are all super friendly. Their prices are pretty competitive and we even got a discount in the mileage.

I would definitely recommend to anyone specially if you feel like helping a local business.

Awful Experience

My stylist did a really good job but the over all experience made me never want to go there again.

I got into an argument with the owner. He had no control over his salon and was incredibly rude. When he over booked my stylist he never apologized. I had to switch stylists and pay both of them before my hair was done. It took sooooo long to start my hair, stop while she did another client, go get money, pay the ladies, when I saw trimming his beard in the middle of the salon I saw sooo pissed. 

After he told me to " stop being so emotional," I decided never to go back there again.

Stopped here for dinner, and were disappointed in the quality of sushi, especially for the prices. Two adults and two kids ate for $86 excluding gratuities, which I find very high. We ordered two miso soups (quite good), spring rolls, rice for two, mixed tempura (pretty good, but it's tempura...) deep fried tofu, and three rolls: dragon, sunrise, avocado. 

The sushi was cut unevenly, too large to eat comfortably, and not all that great. Wish we'd stopped at Tokyo Express, where we could have gotten average sushi for half the price.

I ordered online, they messed up 2/3 things. We ordered two shrimp tempura rolls and when I went home they gave us regular shrimp tempura. Not the sushi roll. Then I ordered teriyaki chicken. This literally looks like a microwavable meal with onions on the bottom (not in the description) the soup that it came with looks like they added curdled milk to it. When I stirred the soup the "milk curds" went straight back to the bottom. Overall, I won't come back and I'm pretty upset because they have been okay in the past.

Rating as I go....
Ambience:  A - wonderful cozy spot with inside and outside seating.
Wine List:  D - for an Italian restaurant I have not seen many others with fewer Italian offerings....no Brunello, Barolo, etc.
Bread:  A - melts in your mouth!
Ceasar Salad: A - one of the best ever!
Service:  B - very nice server but ultra slow.
Menu:  B - lots of items to choose from.
Lasagna: B - so so.   Not very exciting but I've had worse.
Value:  B - reasonably priced for a white tableclothed establishment.
Overall:  B+

Outside of not having any decent Italian wine the experience was pleasurable.

The worst Japanese steak house I've every been to. Shrimp had a chemical taste, the chicken tasted like it was boiled and then heated up. Rice and soup had no flavor. My waitress told me that she wouldn't even eat here because how they cook food. Talk to the manager and he told me nothing can be done, that they never had a complaint, that it was all me because everyone else ate the food. My dog wouldn't even eat the left overs. And the reason was because they were busy but they had a lot of tables opened. Just beware if you go..

Absolutely horrible! Nobody rent from here.. We reserved a van A WEEK ahead and were only told an hour before pickup that they don't have it and that they don't even have any cars for us to rent. We were told that they were all broken leaking or in the shop and that they canceled our reservation and we can basically do whatever we want because they don't have anything for us. I have never seen a more unprofessional company in my life. When asked if I can speak to the manager, he claimed to be the owner of that branch.. don't waste your time or money here!!! Very disappointed!!! I would post zero stars if I could!!

Everything was fantastic for our weekend rager. The hotel was clean, well lit, and in a convenient location. Overall we had a great experience but the maid service came wayyy too early in the morning. 
Also the Exit signs gave us some issues. 
Shout out to the made service for organizing our toiletries and Nattylight cans in the same general vicinity.
Lastly the woman downstairs greeting everyone was a homie, she knew all our names but we never figured out her daughters. 
Thanks for a great weekend. 

Sincerely, 
The boys
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went here on a Saturday night with a party of 7. The service was horrible, our waiter hardly checked on us and just mumbled to us. No one understood him. And he didnt even put the plates infront of the person that ordered them, he just put them down on the table. Really?! The food was ok, not anything special. One of the rolls that we ordered had a bad taste to it, I'm thinking maybe I just didnt like it. Overall, I wouldnt go back here. There has to be a better sushi place in SB, even if the prices are decent. =(

The hotel staff was nice and willing to switch our rooms to a higher floor (I hate being on the first floor) the room was nice and clean, I loved the bathroom!
The only bad thing was they told us breakfast was over at 10am, and when we went down at 930 the next morning, no one was there and food was all put away. One person wiping down the counters told us that it closed at 9 am and we missed it. We obviously were upset and we asked her if she could at least give us a yogurt from the back and she did, so that was nice. Just not a fan of the fact that we missed breakfast because of miscommunication when we checked in.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Love Winco! People ask me why I don't order online from stores and have them deliver...
Well, I love stopping by and seeing my favorite employees   Michael & Yolanda in the deli, and Charles at the checkstand 1. They all are so kind and make my shopping trip with small children so pleasant. The store is always super clean and if I have any problems, the staff is always willing to help. Customer service and just plain nice, caring people are hard to come by anymore sadly. I appreciate the smiles and hard work from the store and have never had a bad experience. Been shopping there every week since they opened.

I'll start by saying the hotel is very clean and well kept.  The first night in our room, the refrigerator went out.  It took quite a while to have a new one swapped into the room.  The second night, our television kept cutting out while trying to watch a movie with the kids.  Also, the indoor pool was advertised as heated and it most definitely was not.  The pool was freezing!!  The staff merely said "sorry" when all of these issues were addressed.  That was disappointing.  Also, the valet fee is very expensive.   Overall I would probably stay here again just due to the cleanliness, but service has to step it up.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We were pleasantly surprised by the hospitality and quality of the food at Franco's.  Service was attentive but not intrusive.  We ordered wines by the glass which were all reasonably priced and  pleasant.  Salads were generously sized, fresh and tasty.  Among the three of us we ordered Veal Piccata, Veal Saltimbocca and Eggplant Parmigiana.  The veal was very tender, sauces were flavorful and the eggplant  was delicious.  We passed on dessert, but the coffee was delicious, too.  I'd definitely recommend this place, and would return if we're in the neighborhood.

Bartaco is definitely one of my favorite spots in Tampa. They have a fair selection of different meats and toppings, including duck, tuna, pork belly, and even a fried avocado (it's off menu, but one of the best ones they have there).
Having a girlfriend with Celiacs, they are very accommodating and most of the tacos on the menu are safe for gluten free folks, and are very adjusted on the issue. 
If you want some good tacos at a very fair price, this is an essential for the Tampa area. Not a single complaint about this place.

I have to say ... I had an okay experience at this hotel compared to others. 

The staff that checked me in - Steve I believe - very friendly for a 10 pm checkin.  
Got to my room .. and had no issues .. I always check the room and clean myself but that's all me :).  Room was nicely made up and appeared in food shape.   I found the lighting a little weird -- all on/ off only worked at door but nothing to complain about


Work up after a quiet sleep .. get ready and to the lobby to check out and grab coffee.  Staff in am were also very friendly.  If back in the area - I would stay here again. 

Thanks all at the Aloft!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
River Point Apartments is overall a solid apartment complex. It was easy to arrange application and confirmation even though I was not living in Tucson at the time. This was due in part to staff being available via the phone and the application being mostly done online. 

When I arrived, they were very welcoming and everything was already arranged. I was able to move in that same day without any hassle. My apartment is very clean and they have been very responsive in fixing any items that have been broken. 

I would recommend this apartment complex to anyone who has a budget but wants to live somewhere that is organized, clean and well managed.

DO NOT STAY HERE- Very cheap, very dirty, very unsafe. Do not waste your money here. Sometimes you read a review and think "it can't be THAT bad"... this place really truly is. Homeless people and drug deals in the parking lot, broken tv, bathtub that doesn't drain, stained dirty carpet. They refused to refund my money, front desk doesn't answer the phone. The "employees" sit in the back room while the phone rings and rings. I know this because I called ahead to ask a question and no one answered, when I arrived the four of them were lounging in the side room talking. What an awful experience!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This McDonald's rarely gets the order correct. Today my husband ordered the big breakfast which is suppose to have eggs, but when he got home there are no eggs. Most of the time we check before we leave the window so if it is not right, they can correct the error.
A few years ago I was so discussed with the consistent poor service that I called the corporation and complained to them. They informed the owner. I guess we will just have to find another place that is more concerned with the quality of their service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: I have nothing nice to say about this hotel. If there was a a negative star rating I would give it. The room we were given was dirty. The was a coating of something the remote and phone  the coffee maker was missing a cover for the water well. Someone's broken eyeglass arm was in the floor. The room smelled of cigarettes. NONI the manager was not friendly at all. She made us wait while she checked the room. She would not refund the whole amount. Said we were in the room for 45 minutes and charged us half the cost of the room. Told us there was nothing wrong with the room. She did offer us another room but we thought it smiled moldy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Ordered several things...panzarotti (deep fried strombolii) with pepperoni and steak which were addded charges) .  I should have known...back in my philly days, panzarottis  were pre made and just sauce and cheese.  So i got exactly that , a cheese and sauce panzarotti.  Funny how They still charged for the steak and pepperoni.  All good though as we will avoid this place anyway since buff chicken cheese steak my daughter got was below avg and the pasta my wife got was amateur dish at best.  Wasted my money this time but never again.

Did have good wings really enjoyed the doubled dipped. Last three times soggy wing, staffs response probably due to oil due to replace  tomorrow. Last take out our order was wrong had to return to get the correct order 10 double dip 10 hot got 20 hot instead. The wings were also soggy with rubbery skin! Manger did not really have a good attitude about fixing the carry out error. Said what do you want me to do about it?! My response , I simply want the food I ordered that all! Sucks we decide not to eat here any longer.

Got my safety and Emissions checked and my serpentine belt replaced by Dobbs Tire and auto at Manchester Road and Hwy 141. Got my car back making an intermittent fluttering noise that was not there before I dropped it off. They said it was the air compressor and that it was a "coincidence that it started doing that." The coincidence is that you messed up the air compressor when you replaced the belt. The store manager refused to give me the district managers name when asked. The cost to repair the compressor is over $700. This place of business is a scam. Do not go to this location.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Probably not going to visit this location again anytime soon. The room wasn't the cleanest. The bed wasn't made 100% so I could see the stains from the mattress before I even entered the bed. No hand soap in bathroom. The shower was not properly cleaned. Upon arrival the front desk was rather abrupt when I had a question about parking. She could have been busy but for someone who has never been to this city before, she was just short and not very helpful. I have to admit though later on she was very friendly and the staff over all was pleasant after that moment. I could have caught her on a busy moment.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Pretty good Mexican spot! Nice ambience. Pretty good service, but could've been a little better. We were there in the middle of lunch today though, so it's a little more understandable. Had the Quesadilla El Patron. The quesadilla itself was massive, and really tasty. The chunks of pork inside were very tender, but a little on the fatty side. Not a big deal, and I'd definitely get it again, hopefully with a little less fatty of chunks of pork. Good chips and salsa. They didn't blow me away, but they were still tasty. Overall a really good experience, and I'll absolutely go again.

This place really does tries to rip you off. I came in to get an estimate on replacing an alternator. I guess being a female, I already knew they'll give me a ridiculous price. So the owner came out to inspect it , then told me the alternator itself will cost nearly 400 . I called AutoZone and they told me it's around $210 to get a new one. Wow.. Big difference . Then he said it'll cost around $250 in labor . That is just ridiculous!!! So it costs $250 for labor over something you can change within 30 mins- 1 hour??????? This place is just trying to rip people off .. And just because I'm a girl, doesn't mean I'm stupid!!

We are so pleased with our experiences at Art City Vets! We have an 11 year old Lab and she's always received excellent care. Recently, she developed diarrhea and vomiting, and they were so accommodating! I was able to bring her and they allowed her to stay in a resting room until a doctor was available. As dog parents are not able to come in due to COVID, the doctor called me several times and was very helpful and informative. My dog received an IV and several medications. She was fine by the next day and the office even called then to see if I had any questions or concerns.
   I highly recommend Art City Vets!!!

Waited 20 minutes in line (only 3 cars in front of me). Once I paid at the window the lady ask me "what did you order" then starts to make my drink and food. As I'm waiting at the window for another 7 minutes I see that they have 5 people "working" and only the drive-through is open. 

I ordered a sausage EGG and cheese on a croissant and caramel ice coffee with cream and sugar. I got a sausage and cheese on a croissant (the sandwich only got 3 things on it idk how you can mess that up) and a black coffee on ice.

We were staying at the Lemon Tree inn and I walked to the store behind hotel. I noticed Presto Pasta. I called in an order for Chicken Alfredo and lasagna. The order was ready in 10 mins. I got back to the hotel and my wife and I started to eat. To say I was pleasantly surprised is an understatement! The chicken Alfredo was amazing! The noodles were cooked perfectly. The sauce was very creamy and delicious. I tried my wife's lasagna. It was amazing. It was better than any Italian restaurant I've even eaten at. 
I wish there was a presto pasta in Bakersfield. Highly recommended!

I read reviews on Yelp prior to booking my appointment and I will say this was the best Spa mani /pedi I've had in years! I've had UV gel nails or acrylic nails since  the 80's. The atmosphere is quiet and they really do their best to provide a serene experience. You don't hear technicians talking in another language. The music is soothing. Tracy was my technician and she did an amazing job. Totally worth the price in my opinion!! My hands and feet haven't felt or looked better. I just wanted to take a nap it was so relaxing. Hot stone paraffin mani/pedi. WONDERFUL.

This is my favorite pizza place of all time, and I've been coming here ever since my family moved to Burlington Township. Their pizza is thin and the cheese to sauce ratio is perfect. They have a great Sunday special that my family loved to take advantage of when coming home from church. One of my fondest memories is when we ordered at least 10 pizzas for a 4th of July party and I ate a whole pizza by myself (I was 13) and it was a magical moment. In all seriousness, not many people get to grow up with such a great small-town pizza place and I've always been grateful for Villa.

Very nice place. Rooms are very nice, comfortable and clean. Service is excellent. They have their own private parking garage to keep your vehicle safe. They have a pool, but not a hot tub, and a great little workout facility. Live music at night, a solo acoustic artist. Their bar is nice and they had a small, very well presented, tasty and varietal continental breakfast. A short walk from the Broadway strip of downtown bars, food and shops. I recommend, although there are plenty of incredibly nice accommodations in downtown Nashville. This is also located just a minutes walk from the Country Music Hall of Fame.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A typical low budget hotel.  Checked in just before 11 at night and  the clerk was informal but helpful.  The room was sub par.  We found hair in the shower drain and razor stubble in the sink.  The air conditioner thermostat didn't work for me so had to shut off to avoid waking up in the arctic.  At check out the manager was helpful and responsive to our concerns.  They even said the staff member that had cleaned the room was fired the day we checked in.  Too bad they didn't check her work.  I was given a discount for my troubles.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I lived here from 2010-2012.  It looks gorgeous from the outside, but do not be fooled.  This complex is in major need of a renovation.  The apartment was disgusting, not to mention ridiculously expensive.  No cleaning product or service was able to clean the tiled floor adequately.  While living here, I was introduced to silverfish.  If you don't know what silverfish are, Google them.  We were not able to get rid of them the entire time we lived there.  

Like the other two people who left reviews, my roommate and I were also charged ridiculous fines when we moved out.

From June 2018.                                         Our week at the hotel was incredible. The hotel is impeccably clean, rooms and common areas are not only spotless, but well appointed. The staff is friendly and helpful, Marriott Corporation must have a great training program. The morning breakfast was such a surprise, lots of great choices for every taste and preference, the quality was so unexpected on a complimentary breakfast. Ron and the other attendant (sorry I forgot her name) could not be more helpful and personable, great representatives of the company. We enjoyed every minute there and would definitely stay again, loved it!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I've been through Enterprise many times but first time at this location. I can say without a doubt this is probably the worst location that I've ever been to the customer service was terrible.

The area was low on vehicles which is understandable because it was busy but we did the "You click, we pick" which should have gotten us a compact car OR LARGER. And instead of giving us whatever was available we waited an over an hour because they just had to give us a compact car. 

Then after all that waiting they gave us a car that wasn't even fully cleaned  as you see the big wad of hair gross!

went in and checked prices and had to deal with 3 different people, each more rude than the last. When I got a rough idea of prices its obvious they are just as expensive as anywhere else and the by one pair get the second free is basically a come on, as they make up for it with their excessive prices on everything else. Extremely rude, walked out and didnt buy anything. It was embarrasing to be treated like that. Its apparent they dont want anyone questioning their charges or getting an informed idea of what it is going to cost to walk out with glasses/contacts.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: First off, EVERY hotel/motel in the Santa Barbara is grossly overpriced.  OK, SB is cool -  but come on!!  It's not SF, SD or LA.  Especially this dive.  They do have a happy hour with free beer and wine from 5:00 - 7:00 Monday - Thursday, but you're gonna have to drink a LOT of beer to justify $140 plus per night for a dumpy motel room.  Seriously, I can stay in a Hilton in San Diego for roughly the same price.  What's so special about this place?  It's not like they have an ocean view or anything.  Hell, it faces the freeway!!  I guess it's what the SB market bares, but I just don't get it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I don't recommend this resturant to anyone.....the drinks where good our food was cold. There was four of us, three of us order steaks with mash patatoes and they food was cold. The fourth person ordered a grilled chesse let's just say my grilled chesse at home is way better and I don't burn my grilled chesse.  The waitress said she would tell the owner and the owner never came over to even offer anything else or to even ask what the problem was. He just kept walking by the table and never said a word to us. I will never step foot into that resturant again.....it was a horrible experience....

Decided to head here since their app said they were open today 8am-8pm.  I got there at 3:05pm today and was turned away saying they were closing early. I checked in on their app so they knew I was on my way and declined me when I walked into the store.
