Again I traveled to this one as it is a holiday and certain great clips were open on their app map.  The two ladies said no we closed at 3 sorry come back. Real short and real lazy.  I won't think about bringing me or my kids here again.  Sad way of doing business.  Short, rude, and didn't seem to care.

I have been living here a year. I agree with another reviewer who said the inside of the apartments are old. We moved in and have had roaches and ants ever since. The cabinet doors in the kitchen do not close all the way, and the apartment is small. I wish the parking was better in front of our building, but when every tenant has 2 cars, that doesn't help! The neighbors are fine, the staff is nice. Rent went up almost $50 after first year - def not worth it unless they do upgrades. We are moving next year for sure.

I wanted them to fix a tear in my pants and they asked me when i needed it and i told them monday. However they needed more time and offered to have it done by tuesday. I arrive tuesday and they have misplaced my pants altogether. As he realizes that he has misplaced my pants he asks, "when do you need it by? And follows up by asking "what can i do for you?" I am highly dissatisfied with their service along with their over pricing on iobs that cant be fulfilled. Will never return back to this poor establishment
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I was attending a beautiful wedding in Santa Barbara. Arrived on a Thursday and left on a Saturday. 2 nights total cost was $600. Plus $40 for parking and $15 early check in even though all the rooms were pretty much vacant. I would call this place a motel. The windows let in all kinds of noise. There is a club behind the hotel and the loud bass and drunken sounds of people will keep you up well past 2am. They give you earplugs which should have been a warning sign. This place is only worth $100 a night. Not sure why Santa Barbara is so overpriced when the quality is below par.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
This hotel was recently remodeled and is generally nice. The room was on the small size for a Courtyard but my big complaint about this place is the paper thin walls.  When housekeeping was in the next couple rooms I could easily hear them slamming lids and cleaning in general. Worse, though, is that I could hear my neighbor just having a regular conversation through the walls. A cough from the next room was very clearly heard as though it was in my bathroom.  

The constant thumping noise and overheard conversation through the walls is enough to ensure that I will not be back. 

If you want to sleep, this is probably not a great option.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: After renting a car on sunday i experienced problems. When you call to address them they say "its not my problem", "i don't care" and "i didn't rent this car to you" although it's the exact location you picked it up.  They don't maintain the cars or inspections.  The first car had an ant and bug infestations which it took 8 hours to replace with a car you couldn't see out the windows and expired inspection stickers.  They promised credits but decided they wouldn't honor the credits and told us that my family being jeopardy is not their problem. This is by far the worst company I ever dealt with

Disappointed. Came in with my family as we were passing through Arizona. Chicken tortilla soup was very salty- overwhelmingly so. Added lot of lemon to cover it up. Chinichanga appetizers had no flavor, shared with the rest of the table and they enjoyed them. Horchata tasted fresh. Nieve frita was good. Really turned off at the fact that this lady (photo attached) was flipping tortillas with her long acrylic nails. First off, serious health code violation. Secondly, tongs and spatula are provided at tortilla warming station, I saw 2 other employees using them. Our waitress used the provided kitchen tools and was very attentive.

The basil pesto pasta is my favorite! We picked up Piada to go and brought it over for my mother-in-law. She absolutely loved it - we got her the carbonara pasta. The garlic dough was also very good. I checked in on yelp and got a free drink so I picked the blackberry hibiscus lemonade. It was perfect for summer. The pricing was fair and you get a good amount of food for what you pay. The restaurant was super clean on the inside and the employees were nice. We will definitely go back in the future. High quality "fast food" with a setup similar to chipotle.

My friend and I had a great lunch at this amazing Italian eatery. The bread and the homemade pesto was out of this world. We both had the Muscles in a white wine sauce on a bed of angel hair pasta. It was delicious paired with a perfectly chilled Reisling. For desert we shared a tiramisu and it was equally amazing. The atmosphere and the service are great and even though we were a gay couple casually dressed we were treated well. We did get some looks from a few Snohomish, pretentious guests but who cares our money's spend the same as theirs. We plan to go back soon.

If there was a negative 5 stars, I would pick it. 
Burlington VT, Christmas day 2017 and horrible service. Without getting into detail, they refused to honor $350 worth of Budget gift certificates. When I asked the acting supervisor his business cards, he didn't have one. Then I asked his name and he only wanted to give me his manager's name, who wasn't even working. Finally, I when I got his first name, he refused to give me his last name. 
Thought calling customer service would have been a better experience, but I was wrong.
Back to Enterprise I go!

I trust John Howe West with servicing my car!! Unfortunately I no longer live in Goleta/SB, but I when I was a student at UCSB, I would always take my 2006 Lexus ES330 to get serviced there. I would bring it in for anything from an oil change, to a diagnostic, to brakes, or major repairs and every time, I've been nothing but satisfied. For anybody that loves their Toyota or Lexus, and truly want the most out of your vehicle, go to this shop. They will ensure that your reliable Toyota or Lexus, will stay reliable!!

It is pretty bad when a manager looks in your bag before handing it to you. And this is acceptable? Hope my picture of my fries posts here. Oh the lady that came inside the store from the drive thru to get a straw. She was upset too. The time was 1:30 pm. So it wasn't very busy at all.  I really would hate to see their small fry if this is their large they serve their customers. 
 No I did not go back in. Really felt I shouldn't have had too. Oh my coworker was happy cause he received 2 more fries in his large than I did.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Went for a shave on a Saturday, they were a bit hard to find but worth it! I entered the building on Carondelet street and took the elevator to the 2nd floor then followed signs. Susan gave me 3 hot towels, a great and close shave, expertly avoided a zit I had, massaged my fade and head while under the last towel, and even cleaned up my ear/nose/neck hair. The atmosphere was just what you want from a barbershop, leather and old music, and Tony and Susan discussing whether "the Judge" would be coming in today.

I recently had my daughters bridal shower at the Brickside Grille and it was lovely. Our guests felt comfortable and had a great time. Laury, our event manager, did an excellent job setting everything up to our specifications and everything went exactly as planned.  We were able to come early to decorate and were not rushed out at the end of the shower.  Our two servers took care of our guests exclusively for the three hour event and they were friendly, courteous and attentive the entire time.  The food was good and the prices just right.  Thank you for helping to make it such a special day for our daughter!

Sadly our expectations were not met. Our Chicago style pizza came out slightly over luke warm and not at all hot. We did have a large group but we were disappointed. I like to consider myself a person who really enjoys sauce but I'd have to say there was too much sauce that I couldn't taste the cheese on my pizza and we asked for extra cheese. The service was very friendly even though it did take a while for our order to arrive. Over all I'd recommend good by somewhere else for deep dish at least because it wasn't worth the price. Maybe the thin crust is better.

Started going here early this year off a recommendation from my wife's friend. Was impressed with the food but the more often we came the more accustomed to the food I became and the prices seemed to gravitate to too high. That said we love the food and service and I was willing to accept the price until my last visit. Seemed that a dinner for two (incl apps) for Italian ($80), regardless of quality, edged on being too expensive. Or maybe (what really ticked me off) it was the price inflation due to the $11 charge for a hazelnut gelato dessert (mediocre at best).

The food itself was mediocre at best, but it was the service that really just shit all over out experience. First, our waiter screwed up all our orders. Secondly, she yelled at one of us for bringing up that one of our orders were messed up, even going so far as to deny their was a mistake. Thirdly, she didnt even wait for us to leave before grabbing the tip. Fourthly, she commented on how our tip was not satisfactory to her, shouting so everyone can hear. The real icing on the cake is she tried to rush us out of the restaurant even with tables available.

This is a beautiful hotel in an area where there aren't a lot of great hotels to choose from.  Right on a main drag in Nashville, next to Vanderbilt and not far from Belmont University.  To a person, the staff was friendly and helpful, including the valets.  Which brings me to the downside of staying at this place.  Parking.  Because of the shortage of spots in the lot (which the hotel shares with a successful restaurant), the valet service is the main alternative.  Ultimately, we discovered we could self-park in the nearby garage, but that was more expensive than using the valet.  A little inconvenient if you need easy access to your car.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The sushi here was much worse than the sushi I even bought at Harris Teeter. It is also more expensive than Samurai. I ordered a roll with chicken, and the chicken tasted like it had gone bad. It is also not as appealing to see teenagers use machines to both roll and cut the rolls. Their moto is healthy sushi, yet mine came soggy with gross sauces that completely overshadowed any flavor the sushi should have had. If you are getting sushi around nashville go to Samurai, its about as authentic as you can get in Tennessee.

BEST CAR RENTAL SERVICE we have ever experienced! And I mean it. We had a group of 7 who've never been to Reno. James met us at the airport and welcomed us with such a positive attitude and that for us is awesome after all, he's the first person to assist us. No trouble finding him after claiming our baggage. They were able to accommodate us after flight times been changed and delayed multiple times. They just made the whole experience easy and we were on the road in no time. 

Our whip thoughhhhh :) It was perfect for our trip! Would recommend to family & friends visiting Reno. No questions asked!!!!!

This store has discriminatory practices. They demand that customers check their bags prior to entry. I also saw an overzealous security guard searching a patrons book bag before entering the store. There were also obnoxious signs with messages such as "SHOPLIFTERS WILL BE PROSECUTED TO THE FULLEST EXTENT OF THE LAW." I will not return to this store. I refuse to spend my money in such a blatantly racist and anti-black environment. I hope that other black people in the community will follow suit and stop spending their money with people who disrespect us.

Was visiting New Orleans & we came here because my grandpa wanted some coffee. I was born in america however the rest of my family was born in Poland. My grandpa ordered his drink & then my english speaking aunt did. when the barista told him the amount he paid & the change was a few coins & he kept it. it is always nice to put tips in the tip jar, but definitely NOT mandatory. The barista rudely told my aunt in an EXTREMELY degrading way that she needed to communicate to my grandpa that he NEEDED to tip because it is "customary". She was so rude & condescending. This place sucks. Barista is nasty & coffee is too. Don't come here.

This restaurant use to be a favorite of mine until the other day. We ordered the sushi combo and 2 rolls. The rolls were decent and the sushi combo looked beautiful; however a little too fishy. It makes me wonder if they weren't quite fresh. The ginger was warm and had a moldy taste to it, when we mentioned it to the waitress they quickly replaced it by opening a new bag. When I tried the new ginger it still had the same warm and moldy taste. I really love ginger and it is too bad that it tasted so terrible.  
I don't think I will be going back, there are a lot of other great sushi restaurants to go to.

My daughter and I are at this Pi Pizza place yesterday and it was just ok. First, they tried to seat us near the kitchen on one of the high tops.  Don't like the high tops so I refused.  I ordered a Greek salad and it was loaded - LOADED - with banana peppers and feta cheese.  It was too much.  I had to move most of them aside.  Next, the pizza - thin crust, took a while longer than expected - about 30 minutes maybe 25 but it was not thoroughly cooked- there was some topping that was not melted and mushrooms that were almost raw.  Again too much of the little chunks of feta cheese.  It was just ok.  Would not go back.

I rarely complain about my food, but tonight I was greatly disappointed in my delivery order. This is our first time ordering pizza from here (we got an ad in the mail), and it was just eh... nothing screamed "order from here again". My main complaint is that the pizza dough and the garlic knots had no flavor what so ever. It was just so bland. I couldn't even decipher the pepperoni from the cheese. Also, in my opinion, the marinara sauce is lacking in Italian seasonings and too much sugar.  

On a plus side, it was pretty inexpensive! However I think they could buff up and quality and raise the prices slightly and still be super successful.

I have stayed here a bunch of times before and never really had a problem. This time I brought my family and so we decided to pay extra for their king suite to have the separate room. Turns out their idea of a king suite is just a room with the king sized bed. We had to pay an extra $40 on top of that to get what other hotels call a suite. I was disappointed in the room. There was someone's hair in the bed. The lock on the bathroom door was broken and the bathroom sink wouldn't drain. I used to be pretty loyal to this hotel but I think I will look somewhere else next time I'm in Edmonton.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Steer clear of this place. I reserved a car thru Expedia for pick up at this rental agency. After hours of waiting, I finally received a different car, shortly before closing. When I turned the car in at the airport, the weekly rate was $180.00 more than my reservation (yes, including taxes and fees and everything). I called them about it, sent the reservation from Expedia and then nothing. They haven't called back, haven't ajusted the rate and haven't answered the phone the five times I've called and been left on hold until I hang up 30-45 minutes later. 
Stay away. Rent anywhere else. They are not an honorable rental location

Unfortunately my visit to this McDonald's wasn't the best to start the only positive thing about this visit was that my fries were nicely salted and they were hot now it goes downhill from there once I got home I decided to eat my Big Mac meal and when I open the box I see the wrong bun on my #1 meal (not the minor I didn't care too much about that) but when I bit into the burger the muddle section of the bun was hard as a rock not even edible I was hoping the 15 minute wait for one meal was going to be worth the wait but obviously not hopefully my review will be looked over and they will learn there lesson.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Pissed off had been staying there for 5 weeks had reserved my favorite room for the next two weeks go to check in they had move me without my approval that I had already reserved , then go up to the new room that took over 4 hours to cool off!!! Will  Not Go Back !!!!! Prices Changed Daily 1st nite 93$ tue 119$ wed 128$ Thursday 111$ , what kind of BS#%^¥£€!!! Is this. The free breakfast was fake eggs microwave bacon and straight out the can biscuits and gravy  very disappointed . Save you vacation stay for somewhere else! Only reason I stayed do long is my company had a corporate account.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: It's been a family favorite for years and after our first visit in many years it still is. Great location and great front desk service. Service at outdoor bar is friendly but slow. Reason: tip is automatically added. Food however is good and adjacent boardwalk has other options including a Dunkin Donuts for coffee. Room was great and and view was amazing. I'm giving the resort 4 stars simply because they allow smoking seemingly everywhere. Might be a Florida thing but regardless it can ruin things. It's not a big place so the smoker can be very effective in annoying people! They really should change that.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love this place. I would not trust my Sequoia to be serviced by anyone else. I have a 2001 model so occasionally it needs a significant part or parts replacement and the work gets done in a first rate manner and at a very competitive price. You can not find a nicer, more accommodating staff. They provided me with a nifty Lexus RX hybrid as a loaner because my service required several days of work. When I came to pick up my vehicle it had been  washed and cleaned so well I didn't recognize it. If your vehicle needs minor or major service from excellent technicians at a competitive price do not hesitate to call CS and make an appointment.

Okay first of all some person ordered tater tots and it took a whole extra 3 minutes. That's 180 seconds of my life that could have been spent doing a lot of things then I get home and I had ordered 3 crispy chicken wrap things idk and they don't have crispy chicken like what you're mcdonalds that's who you are Golden Arches so then I get the grilled chicken and settle like I'm on some freaking diet and I had asked for no ranch bc I am on a diet but they slathered my wraps in ranch like they wanted me to gain those extra 3 lbs back. -love a Big Mac 


Fries were lit tho. Def get them.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: im not one to leave reviews but do not come to this dunkin. placed a mobile order for a bagel, hashbrowns, and a hot macchiato. I was told they were out of bagels but they would replace with the bagel bites. when i got my order there was no coffee and both the bagel bites and hashbrowns were cold. I had to ask for the coffee and after drinking a few sips realized it was off and poured it into another cup to see it was all milk. food also tasted like plastic which ive never had a problem with at other locations. never coming back again.

Decent food but entrees are slightly overpriced, and the sides are WAY overpriced (and are undisclosed upcharges): a request for some green salsa=a side of green salsa for $3.50!, and adding "enchilada style" on a burrito (some salsa a a bit of extra cheese on top) is also an extra $3.50! What made it worse was that the waitress offered up but did not disclose the price of these extras. I can see an extra $1 or so for enchilada style, but I have never seeen an added charge for a small side of salsa.  Feel nickle-and-dimed here, disappointed and will not return.

I agree with everyone who mentions the dining area. It is dated , dirty and not family friendly . Get the pizza to go !  My family and friends  refer to them as  "the Pizza Nazi's" .  It is rare to go there and NOT hear  yelling between the owners. The pizza is good.... most of the time. I laugh when I go there because it is like a show. Never order the peppers and eggs or any hero. They are not worth the cost. The pizza can be  under sauced, not enough cheese, but the one thing always good is the crust. Get the pizza, skip the cannoli's.

We stoped by after watching the Cardinals game and had heard many great things about this place from friends. I was really excited to try their thin crust meatball pizza and it was very impressive. It tasted fabulous. The meatballs were flavorful and the crust had great texture and taste. My only complaint was the service. There were three or four tables around us that needed cleaned off and no one was doing it. Some of th employees were on their phones and it was a little disappointing. But overall it was a good experience and I will recommend this place to visiting friends and family.

I waited in the drive-thru for 20 minutes.  When I got to the order speaker nobody spoke, i had noticed there wasn't the sound of ordering when the car in front of me was sitting there for 5 minutes.  I asked if they were going to take my order back here?  ( I thought they may have been taking orders at the window.)  A girl replied that they would take my order when they were able.  I waited a few more minutes and when the car in front of me was out of sight I drove around and when I found that there weren't any cars waiting at the windows I just drove away. 6:10 pm
Very poorly run.

Best Italian restaurant in Edmonton. I love Italian food and this restaurant is amazing. The employees are extremely polite. The waiter knows us so well he has our drinks ready, and know what we want to order. He is genuine in his conversation and is interested in our lives. The food is top quality. My husband had a special one night which is not on the menu. But each night we go the kitchen prepare this for him. He has prawns in garlic sauce and I have chicken in sherry sauce and it is nothing less than perfect every time.
The fresh baked bread on arrival is absolutely fab aswell!
I give this restaurant 10/10 without a doubt.

We finally tried this place after driving by it so many times. We should have kept driving. The wings were good as well as the service but it went downhill from there. I ordered the signature chicken sandwich which was topped with spinach and provalone. It was dry as a bone and overcooked. The stringy spinach looked days old. My wife's personal pizza was underdone and doughy. We should have known better  to order a pizza there. With so much competition from other bars like Duffers and PJ Wellihans and Buffalo Wild Wings coming in aroud the corner, I wonder how this place will survive.

Honestly, I'll never, ever come back here or recommend it to anyone. After I smelled how old and disgusting my boyfriend's sushi plate was, I decided to stay away and thought it was best to play it safe by ordering shrimp tempura. The tempura was salty and extremely soggy, and the wet breading immediately fell off the sushi and vegetables. My boyfriend knows sushi fairly well, and will pretty much eat anything and think it's great, but even he struggled to get through his plate. After leaving we both felt rotten, and regretted the whole meal, not even to mention how ridiculously overpriced it was. Don't waste your money.

I've eaten there twice and won't return. It's ok but just that. Ok. I bought regular crust first and upon a later visit Chicago style.

The pizza crust was ok on the regular not bad like Peels but nothing special. I just didn't like the sauce.

The Chicago style crust was done on the top and bottom but real doughy under the cheese. I ordered pepperocini hardly had any on it and extra sauce but it barely covered the top with bare spots. It was again just ok. I would say fronzen Tombstone is better than both varieties.

I had a cannoli and it was ok.

Have been coming to Hart's for over 24 years - always loved the atmosphere and the friendly bartenders.
Tonight I decided to drive 1/2 hour for dinner and cocktails and arrived at 7:49pm....and found out that the kitchen and bar shut down at 8pm- are you kidding me.....it's still light out!!!!!!!!
It's summer time and most folks don't get home from work until 7 pm - looks like Harts doesn't care about their regular Wednesday night customers.
In addition to the cut back in hours - the quality of the food has diminished- not a good combination - btw- I have worked in the food industry for over 43 years- sad to see the demise of this restaurant.

I recently use a VIP card to get a medium coffee at this store.  It was severely watered down.  Called corporate on three different occasions to discuss.  Each time I was told they would contact the owner and have him call me.  The second time they also said they would notify a district manager.  I never heard back from either the owner or the district manager.  With the third call, I was stuck on hold for 17 out of the 21 minutes when they finally offered me a $10 gift card and they said they would contact the owner again.  I refused the gift card and told them that it did not fix the problem.

Traveling  from CO to Ohio and didn't have a reservation or where we would be stopping for the night we decided to avoid rush hour traffic in St Louis and go a little further we checked out 3 motels in Troy, Il. Super 8 was ruled out. Holiday Inn was too expensive and last pick was Red Roof Inn which was 40.00 cheaper so we took a chance and tried it. It was a good choice! Only 60.00 and seems to have been remodeled with flat screen TV and very clean. Ask for room away from interstate and you will have a very quiet night.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: So a few months ago I set out to become a regular at a local coffee shop, and I was immediately a fan of the coffee Hubbard & Cravens sells but they fall short in one aspect; customer service. I can no longer risk my Saturday vibes by getting a coffee from rude baristas who don't even smile or say thanks for my business. I dunno i'm just kinda hurt. Like I felt if I went to Starbucks they would say thank you. Not even to mention I tip on every coffee I get. I'm literally trying to make this my go to coffee place but the customer service inhibits me from catching good vibes. A damn shame if you ask me.

Our 5 days stay at the hotel was not bad at all...  The staff were friendly and very helpful.  Hotel was clean, our room was large (lots of space), the bed was comfy.  Although we didn't stay much in the hotel the time we did spend there was great.
I was really hesitant about booking the hotel after reading the past reviews, I guess they did a total renovation and it must be under new management because I did not experience what the past guest experienced during my stay.

My only suggestion to the hotel is update the t.v and a microwave would be nice to have in the rooms :(.....

Overall it was a * * * NICE HOTEL...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Terrible experience overall. My friends and I waited 15 minutes just to have a waiter come to our table and pour us water. When the food came out, one of our dishes (an appetizer) that my friend ordered was not with the rest of our dishes, so my friend sat without any food for 20 minutes. When we finally got the check not only did we not receive an apology but my friend's food had not been removed from the bill. Finally, we requested a manager which took (what a surprise!) another 20 minutes. Food was good so at least they've got that going for them I guess...

Salon on Sixth has moved to Terrace Road.  This salon used to be fabulous 3 years ago at it's old location and had usually six or so stylists working and some of those stylists were even involved in hair competitions.  You could get a great hair cut there.  I moved away following my favorite stylist to another spot but was in a pinch for a cut and went back to Salon on Sixth at it's new location.  Only two stylists were working, the location is at a small strip mall.  My hair cut is an absolute butcher job with hunks of hair on the top, side and back not even layered in.  Not even letting them fix it!  No way ...

Horrible experience for the second time. We figured we'd give renting a car while in Nola a second chance. No cars available after reserving one - no one working to help you - had to rent through another company and pay premium for a substandard car. Day 2 into the rental, it had a mechanical failure and we had to exchange it - final day of rental we return the swapped car to find out they didn't have that car on file and we had to wait in line to update the paperwork that should have been done before the swap. 

Total BS.

We ordered three different hibachi meals for pick up. The chicken, shrimp and filet mignon. Usually when I order hibachi for pickup/deliceru I already don't expect it to be as good as it would be in the restaurant. The food thought wasn't that great compared to what I've gotten from other places. It was a little too sweet and seemed to have teriyaki sauce all over it (meat, veggies etc.), but even the teriyaki didn't taste right. I don't know if is my personal pallet that made it taste like this or if it was a one time mix up, but there are definitely better hibach options in the surrounding area.

Customer service at the Wesley chapel location is  below average at best. Front staff does not acknowledge you when you enter the store and the optometrist the  day of my appointment did not even introduced himself . I waited 30 minutes after my appointment time ,only to be told I needed to get pre-tested first! but it didn't surprise me at all about the confusion since all I could hear was the front staff talking about their lives and such  and not  really interested in clients... awful front staff service , disorganized and optometrist wasn't  nice either .
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
The food overall was okay. Some of the food felt microwaved, because the plate was hot, and the food was cold.
One of the biggest issues I experienced was lack of good customer service.One of the servers rolled her eyes when I asked a simple question on what were the side items on a dish and what type of fish did they served since it is not specified on the menu. Throughout my experience here, they changed servers 3 times. I supposed servers were not having a great day and that is why they acted in a rude way, and failed to respond the questions that I had about the menu.

This was THE worst food I have ever paid for in my entire life.  The service was attentive, yet unprofessional. The drinks were average  to poor and yet overpriced.  Back to the food - ok, seriously, just Horrible!!! The shrimp did not even have the texture of shrimp, the veggies were barely cooked and the rice was soggy.  I will never, ever go back, and am still incredibly annoyed that I actually spent money there!!!!!
And by the way, I do not think it even deserves one star, I was forced to pick a rating!
Oh, and the decor is cheesy and outdated, and it was somewhat dirty - yuk!

horrible, horrible, horrible service. our first round was a draft beer and a soda, bartender was handed 1.25 tip. 2nd drink was just another beer, she took over 20 minutes to get to us, dollar left. third drink she stated "i do not work for free, im not servicing you." this was only our 2nd beer for the day, i have never been "cut-off" from a bar, and with 2 beers no one was intoxicated.  obviously we left and will never return. we just purchased a home in the area but i will drink the extra distance to one of the other 336 establishments near by for a beer. don't waste your time!!!

They are great at what they do when you can get them to do it. Past few times I have visited I either had to wait over an hour or actually leave. I understand being busy and frustrated but I don't like when the process is rushed. I also worked all day to pay for this and want my nails done right. They will also keep taking pedicures before manicures because they have their kids doing the pedicures so more people doing that than manicures. Enough of my rant. Like I said if you can go in at a non busy time. They are great.

After reading the owner's response below, I'm editing: 

3rd time I have waited as the first person in line for 15+ minutes to not have any of the multiple staff members communicate any forward guidance around when I might be helped or the two vacant tables in the courtyard. Didn't see three parties being assisted. Saw one. Took forever.  

BUT had takeout from here once that was pretty good. Love honey on the pepperoni. 

Try Via Vai as there is clearly a supply and demand problem here, and an amazing courtyard, Italian meal is just minutes away in the upper village, and they will seat you!

This Dunkin donuts is the absolute WORST DO NOT GO HERE! The employees must not care or something. They took forever to say anything to me, they got my order wrong, and it took forever to get my food. While waiting for my food I overheard the person behind me ordering they treated this person way differently than me, turns out this person was an employee, and this person got their order before me! How BIZARRE! The food we received was correct on the bag tag but not in the bag ‍and to top off the experience the food tasted horrible. Will not return.

Harleysville Hotel has come a long way from the biker days!
They are trying to make the atmosphere more towards a family dining establishment now.
Although the clientel has changed, the service has not.  If your really thirsty or hungry, don't stop here!  
The food is great, the drinks are great...the service just plain stinks.
You never know if it's going to be a good night or not.  
The bartenders can be a little on the surly side also.
The specials are fabulous & the wings are great. (many flavors to try!)

I have been using kwick car for almost 2 years and they do good work. The only issue is they tend to be more expensive than other shops. It is nice to have a certified mechanic working on your vehicle but just beware it is definitely not the cheapest or most budget friendly shop. Mechanic labor is $95 /hour which from calling around and getting estimates for repair was the highest of 5 shops I called. Average labor was $85/hour. I still chose kwick car because they were the only ones willing to fix my truck early in the morning while I waited and did not want me to just drop it off and come back later
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I just visited this McDonald's. The service was fast but the lady in the 2nd window was rude. She handed me my food, I checked the bags to make sure everything was in there. I ordered 20 nuggets which I ask for 3 sauce that was not it there. She did not want to give me any and said that she had already put it in there. I checked again and they're not in there. I don't understand why is it so hard to get sauce!! She gave me 1 but I ask for 2 more, she got mad and said it's in there. It's a billion $$$ chain! Why is it so hard to get some sauce, just charge me for the damn sauce if it's coming out of her damn paycheck!!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Love it great food... I don't recommend going after 9:30 pm because they are trying to close at 10pm... And don't show up at 11am to 2:30pk because it's extremely busy and if you have a limited amount of time it's very full... You'll wait about 30 mins before you can get your order taken... There really is a lot people there at that time... But overall I like eating there as well as hang out... I also don't recommend going threw the drive threw after 11pm because (again) they are trying to close but the service is still great at that time!

so me and my mom went to eat here and it was the horrendous horrible horrific there is no way to describe how bad the service was here the food was ok ig but our waiter had the most negative attitude possible and looked like she didn't even want to be there they took like 2 hours to serve us just for them to spill both of our soups and used inappropriate language right infront of us another family even walked out bc the service was terrible please like NEVER COME HERE there are way better places to go i give this give place like a -1000 stars

My written review consists of usual complaints of a subpar, ill-maintained hotel, but the picture will have the most impact. Here goes: Filthy carpets that leave your socks brown on the bottoms. Stained sheets, pillowcases, and bed skirts. Even though there is Terrible water pressure, the shower drains so slow that you'll have water up to your ankles by the time you're done. Towels that feel like brillo  pads, and smell strongly of bleach. A coffee maker that spurts water everywhere but into your cup. And the piece de resistance: sex toys in the nightstand. Needless to say, do not stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I love Lombardi's. The food is fresh and delicious, the staff is friendly and accommodating. If for some strange reason you are disappointed, they'll fix it for you, no fuss, no attitude, just flat out great customer service. I admit I order the same thing every time, Lobster and Rock Shrimp Alla Vienna with a side of sauteed spinach, it's delicious! 

So here's my advice: Go to Lombardi's for lunch. Go to Lombardi's for dinner. And then, make up an excuse to have a party and host it there. 

You just  don't find places like this anymore. My only complaint is that I don't live closer!

I have let Starbucks now at least two or three times that they do not get my order right. I have to have decaf because it adversely affects my leaky heart valves and today was the last time I will ever go there. Again, loaded with caffeine and I waited patiently for the high heart rate and shaky feeling to pass. Almost went to Urgent Care. Just ridiculous that when asked about whether or not my coffee is decaf, they always say yes it is when it is not. I also let them know that it is a medical problem and I need decaf yet it is never remedy. The next time Starbucks will get my urgent care bill

These jokers sent me a letter in an important looking envelope - like the sort a court might send you, with an ominous "$2000 Fine..." and "2nd Attempt" warnings on the front. They then worded the letter like they had a previous relationship with me. I don't have any business relationship with them and frankly there's zero chance of them getting any future business from me, but this micky mouse fear-mongering advertising tactic angered me enough to get one star on Yelp. Please don't send these characters your money.

Staff was hit or miss. Some kind and engaged, others completely disinterested and rude. Hotel is fairly dirty. Looks like they redid the lobby and forgot about the rooms. Our floor smelled like body odor and the room smelled like smoke. It was hard to get to sleep because of the smell. Sound is  rough because there seems to be quite literally an inch and a half that's open under each door so you can hear everything. Food was pretty good and it was nice being able to hunker down in the lobby to get work done as necessary. Would not return to hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Not so great. The long line was to be expected in the early morning with no other breakfast options in the terminal. However, we paid $7.99 each for two breakfast bowls (scrambled eggs, sausage or bacon, cheese, and potatoes) and when we opened them to eat on the plane, neither of us had potatoes. Maybe I'm just hangry, but it felt intentional, since potatoes were the advertised foundation of this breakfast scramble. That was pretty much the only reason we had ordered them in the first place. $8 scrambled eggs with an uncut sausage patty? Not cool, "Great" Wraps. Not cool.

I'm in St. Petes for work, I live in Los Angeles and Wendy's are hard to come by.  Growing up in the Midwest I was excited to eat there.  This pace is disgusting.  The bathroom floor was very sticky the mirror was covered in some kind of film and water spots.  After leaving the bathroom I walked up to the register; nobody was there and someone didn't show up for what felt like 5 min.
I placed my order, great but when I went to the soda machine, it seemed to out of every option I selected.  My order came up and I took my food and left.  Come on Dave, I expect better.

I'm a twice-a-year-haircut kind of girl, and I am happy to be making Snip my regular place.  I've seen Jackie twice; really enjoyed her, felt like she listened to me well and asked questions about I want.  She encouraged me to think outside of the box, but didn't bully me into something I didn't want.  Super pleasant environment!!  I don't like the feel of a lot of salons, but this one is small, friendly, well-lit, and feels like everyone in the room is part of the same conversation.  I like that.  I will keep going back!

Horrible.  reservation was made on 3/20 for 4/10 date of rental.  Was told by State Farm to call and verify reservation.  Well no one ever answered the phone.  tried all day long.  Called another location in Mt Juliet and was told sorry I do not know why they are not answering.  I was told by Mt Juliet location they could see reservation but to call the Charlotte pike on 4/7 to confirm so i would definitely have an SUV on 4/10.  Have been trying to call and confirm since 0800 and its now almost 1400 and no one will answer the phone.  Finally got through and now have been on hold for 25 minutes.  DON'T RENT HERE!!!

The hotel is really nice. The conference rooms are also really nice. The rooftop bar and the bar downstairs are really cool to hang out after work.
The rates are moderate. 

There are a few things that would make it better. First, the lobby has a slight odor and could use some air freshener. None of the rooms have microwaves, so it isn't convenient for those who stay there every other week for work. Lately, there isn't any ice. I'm on a special diet that requires me to drink smoothies for two meals per day. 

Hopefully, management will take this input and use it for good.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This Is the best Mexican food in Indiana! I haven't found one that compares! I haven't found any other place that serves guacamole included with lunch items!! & that's a must for me!! Their ChoriQueso is so yummy! Their rice & beans delish! I always love their fajitas! They unlike most have tomatoes in with the sautéed veggies! Where as other places skip it & only use peppers and onions, just not the right way to make fajitas! We are from Franklin Indiana & will travel to greenwood location and skip all the Mexican places from here && to..bc it's that good!!

This is probably the worst sushi restaurant that I've ever eaten at. First off, even though the menu says it's all you can eat, the server's attitude says otherwise. They seemed impatient with us when we were placing our orders. On top of that, the quantity that we received was incorrect. The tuna rolls were absolutely atrocious. It felt like I was eating a fish corpse left out for a couple days. The red clam would have been ok if there weren't chunks of ice inside it. Honestly speaking, you would be better off eating at the McDonald's around the corner. Definitely do not come here. 0/10.

well, our first time and we four thought it was awesome food.  Salmon salads are a great treat, with a price much lower than Brewstone Beer next door. I had a stromboli and it was delicious but only had one (1) pepperoni slice in it.  Not sure what I ordered but kinda thought it would have some meat. the sauce was excellent, great young waiter as well. we sat in back away from the 'noise' in the main restaurant. what's with the ugly fish tank????  it does have a few little, little fish that look out of place. we will come back tho for the food!

Six of us had brunch today.  The flavor of most of our dishes was good, and our experience was nearly satisfying. However, the food was also consistently room temperature when it should've been hot, and the fries were actually cold. The bacon, quiche, corned beef hash, and omelettes were sitting a while or perhaps refrigerated before they arrived at our table. The Hollandaise sauce on the eggs Benedict was overwhelming to the dish. The cinnamon sugar donuts were redeeming, as they were fresh and hot.  The service was okay, but not attentive, even though the restaurant was not overly busy.

It took 1 hour and 45 minutes to check in due to it being sold out and only 1 person working. We get to our room snd not only does it smell like cigarettes, there was hair in the bathtub and no shampoo or soap. Called down 4 times and NEVER got shampoo or soap. Was suppose to get a machine to get rid or the smoke smell or get changed to a bee room but had to have a manager call. Also NEVER GOT A CALL. I have never experienced anything like this. We paid for a service and majority of the services weren't met.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
** Lateral x-ray shows a v-shaped opaque object that was lodged in her esophagus **. How did Mt. Laurel Animal Hospital miss this?  When i asked the attending veterinarian if she saw the x-rays herself, I was told that the radiologist looks at these things all day and provides the report!

Long story short, my dog had esophageal surgery to remove the bone that perforated her esophagus.  Her esophagus was stitched up and the blood cyst that formed on the outside of the body was removed.  After 6 days in ICU after a difficult surgery, she is finally home and slowly improving!  

Thank you PennVET!

Second time and last. For $25 I expect decent vacuuming and all inside windows to be cleaned. The ones they did were smeared with dirty rag. The car was rolling before they ever got to vacuum the second row of my not very dirty minivan. Pointed it out to a friendly manager but it made no difference. Being busy does not justify overpriced rush job. Unfortunately not allot of competition in area. I have 3 cars and find it worth driving extra miles to get an adequate job for less. Never tried detailing but not confident they can handle. Agree staff is friendly but not going there for smiles, just a clean car job.

Horrible! Dirty beat-up car, empty windshield washer, incompetent person at the desk who charged me for coverage I didn't want. I specifically said I wanted "no optional coverages," but she charged me for them anyway, calling it the "basic package" without explaining what it was. I did not get to see the contract until I was actually in the car. I was terribly late and in a mad rush so I didn't notice the extra charge until it was too late. The manager refused to do anything about it. I will NEVER rent from them again. Cheaper is definitely NOT worth it!

I stayed here this weekend my room smelled like someone died  Lighting was awful we literally had to buy a candle and put on the fan because the smell smelled so bad and housekeeping didn't really clean our room all they did was come in and make the beds didn't do anything else at first we thought it only smelled like it because it was dusty and all the hotel but every time we left and came back in our room the smell was even worse like literally couldn't breathe I would definitely not recommend staying here again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If you want your very own welcoming party of bed bugs and other creepy crawlies, towels so thin you can see right through them, and urine stains on your mattress, the Fiddler's Inn is the right place for you! Myself and the rest of my delegation went here on a school field trip for a national level competition a few years back, and to say the least, it's more sanitary to sleep in the dump than this rat hole! The gift shop is utterly strange and full of mish-moshed items. Yes, it is cheap, but do yourself a favor and spend a little more to avoid the worst hotel experience of your entire life!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I rarely give reviews, but was very dissatisfied with our first experience at Firefly. Our car was nice, however had some trash and french fries so wasn't cleaned properly. We let it go in anticipation of our trip.  Upon return, a full tank of gas was required upon delivery which we provided.  The check-in person (female)stated that we were 1/16 off on fill up. How can you tell that?? In a condescending manner she stated, "You should have had us fill up your car so you wouldn't be charged a $30 fee."  We were unable to "refill" in order to make our flight. We felt taken advantage of and poorly treated. Our "cheaper" rental cost a lot more!

I use this service all the time and the staff, the service is always as good as it gets!!!! They will have no problems accommodating you, efficient, professional, quick and yes they have gone beyond my expectations.     I called to rent a car from them at the very last minutes before closing and needed a pick-up from my home, didn't think it would happen by it being so close to getting-off time for the staff , but they assured me of getting pick-up and a car would be ready to go  and they did, well after closing hours and I am grateful....... I only rent Enterprise

So I ordered a pizza online. An hour and a half later I get a call from the restaurant telling me that they were having a problem with their computers and just recieved the order. Unfortunately for them this is the second time this has happened at this location. The employee apologized but didn't offer any compensation until I asked. After consulting the manager they gave me $3 off after waiting a total of 2 hours for the pizza. I had already tipped $5 online. Great pizza but poor management at the Kirkwood location.

these apartments are very expensive. expect rent to be $1900+ per month for 1br. everything inside is very run down. cheap paint. they use the worst materials for plumbing and sinks. for window they give u a clamp to prevent the window from being open. for such a place that claim to be luxurious, they can't afford to have a decent window?
No garbage disposal , no AC
very thin wall , you can hear your neighbor two units down slam the door.

the only good thing here is the maintenance guy is responsive and designated parking

look around more ..especially in Goleta or Isla Vista for more affordable option if you can

Place is a glorified maggiano's. This is the kind of Italian restaurant your friend named Todd or Jeremy recommends. In other words, people that don't know better. Service is lackluster. Rude and with an air of "we just don't give a..."Taste is ok enough but the cooking generally lacks soul. Bread is a disgrace! I mean come on! How is it possible to serve such inedible dreck at an Italian restaurant in the heart of the italian market. Meatballs are solid, but it ain't as good as gramma used to make it.  "What you want for supper gramma," she'd ask. If yous  are from the neighborhood yous know what I'm sayin'.

We loved our stay at Schooner Hotel. Clean, cozy, comfortable, friendly - very welcoming to us and my father -who we were visiting. Only reason(s) not 5 stars: teeny, tiny ants in our room, (they came and sprayed right away), first day toilet leaked all over the floor - but my handy husband fixed it right away  and had to ask for more clean towels/wash cloths (supposed to be replaced if you set them out at designated times, was told training new girl). Other than that - outstanding place to stay. Right. On. The. Beach. Couldn't get closer! Thank you to Diane for the warm hospitality and to Jimmy (the magician- Awesome Show!)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Went there for the first time and they clearly need to get some of the kinks out as they are brand new.  The entrance area smells like mildew and needs to be addressed.  The inside decor needs some help also. I had Mozzarella sticks for appetizer and they were good but the Caprese salad only had little crumbles of fresh mozzarella they need to give full slices of cheese. The Veal saltimbocca was excellent just need to give more spinach and the seafood Christina was good but needed more lemon flavor. All in all I would recommend this restaurant and I hope if management see this review they take it under advisement.

I go to this restaurant every week for 2 for $25 tuesdays.  The deal is awesome.  Mucho food for $25.  It's also awesome that it's BYOB.  The only issue I have is that the one waitress they have on Tuesday nights (literally only one) is very mean to us every time.  She never pays attention to us.   And worst of all, she gets upset when I ask her to refill my chips/salsa layout.  That's a big problemo for me.  If you can tolerate mean service-señoritas, then definitely go.  But if service is important, then this place is no bueno!!

Grew up in New Jersey and was visiting over the holidays.  We were looking to get out Italian Food fix specifically gnochi.  Nice atmosphere and in a nice part of town.  We'd looked at the menu ahead of time and specifically picked the place for gnochii.  However when we arrived they were using a holiday menu with no gnochii.  I had the arugula and prosciutto salad which was quite tasty.  My entree was the chicken marsala.  It was ok but a bit pricy.  My wife had the penne vodka.  Same deal, ok meal but pricy.  Overall nice atmosphere but food is pricy and mediocre.

We ordered two rooms in advance.  When we got there, they asked us about taking a different room for one.  We were fine with that.  Then when we got in the room, it was freezing cold yet the mini-fridge did not work at all!!  We needed a working fridge for medication.  Same fridge had dinner in freezer that was bad.  Not impressed at all.  Moved us to different room but it was supposedly non-smoking but had terrible stench.  This room also had item in freezer.  Inn America obviously doesn't check these fridge/freezers!  Asked to be moved AGAIN.   So NOT impressed with this place.  Staff needs to work harder to do better with these rooms.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place has both an amazing staff and a large selection of unique frames.  I was seen at the 13th Street location.  Dr. Bryan Machamer is super breezy, yet incredibly thorough.  My prescription is spot on, and I'm seeing much better now.  If you need help finding a pair of glasses that work with your bone structure, I recommend asking for John's help.  The dude will not steer you wrong.  Under no circumstances will the staff at Modern Eye let you leave looking a fright.  If you want crisp vision and awesome frames, this is the place to go.  You will likely have to wait several weeks for an appointment, but it is definitely worth the wait.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
MUST TRY, YOU WON'T BE DISAPPOINTED!

    I've heard some great stuff about Home Plate, and decided it was time to give the place a try. It's official I've found my Sunday morning breakfast "spot."  The staff was amazing; super friendly and very attentive. Our waitress Melissa was a sweet heart, our drinks were always kept full, and she made sure everything was to our liking. As far as the food I can't say enough great sized portions cooked to perfection. I highly recommend the Florida eggs benedict and French toast. I honestly feel like mom cooked it, now it's time for a long walk on the trail! 

-Dunedin dweller

I live in Phoenix but when in Tucson I try to visit this place. Went today and as I'm waiting for a hostess I'm reading their hand written sign. You MUST order something if you're going to sit! We are at 50% capacity! Eat, Pay, GO!! Just reading the sign I felt like I was being reprimanded. Too many great places in Tucson to put up with that attitude. Food has gone downhill in the last few years but I still try to come to support a family owned business. If it's still around in a couple of years I may try again.

Three guys tackled me after refusing to honor their posted specials. It was the 2nd weekend in a row. Last weekend they reluctantly adjusted the bill. This weekend, an overly tan bartender got all hyped up because I called him out and only backed down once my attractive wife arrived. She paid the bill to squash things but the point was they agreed, basically, to trade 50 bucks tonight to never earn our business again (we drank/ate at least $60 a weekend plus tip). We live around the corner and now we have to find a new place.

Went with a friend and sat outside for dinner; service was good. Margaritas were great. Food was..... horrible. Absolutely horrible. My shrimp dinner consisted of lackluster sautéed shrimp which looked like it was sauteed with garlic but was flavorless.  But it seemed like a gourmet delight compared to the vegetables. It was like they took a bag of off- brand frozen carrots and broccoli and threw them in the microwave and slapped them on a plate. Tough, chewy, completely unseasoned. The rice was barely warm and barely edible. Unfortunately, my first visit and also my last. Way overpriced for high school cafeteria food.

Full disclosure, this is a complaint.  

The service and quality of the food was totally acceptable.  The coffee and donuts were perfect actually.

However, I really don't care about your personal stance on covid.  I find portions of it appropriate and other rediculous.  

But when your employees are walking around behind the counter exposed to the food you hand to the customers and they have this mask down past their chin totally exposing their face, that's a problem. 

It's not an issue for the employee, it's an issue with management.  Be a leader.  Don't let your employees do whatever they want.  That's what you're there for.

Currently sitting in a line thats wrapped around the building and it hasn't moved in the 10 minutes that I have been here.  I tried to come here a couple days ago after work but nobody was answering the the drive thru mic so the car in front of me as well as the 4 behind me all left.  Whoever runs this place does an absolutely terrible job.  They refinished the outside of the building which was way overdue but they left the ugly street sign that looks like its from the 1960s.  An employee told me that the owner is super cheap and its quite apparent because his business is failing.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Great location, friendly staff, worst drinks I've ever had. I ordered a vodka cranberry and got cup of vodka with a splash our cranberry. I continued to order a screwdriver (can't mess that up) and got a cup of vodka with a splash of orange juice (it was cloudy) and on a separate occasion the first (and only) drink I ordered was made wrong while my husband's Jack and coke was all Jack with a splash of coke. Once I got my Bacardi mango (made correctly) it was alright, however the staff could use a lot more training.

I have gone here for years. I even went to them before all my proms in 2005 and 2006. I love them in high school because the service was amazing, the location was right on 202, and they were affordable. Recently though, I have gone there because the prices are still great, but the service has been awful. With a packed room of customers, the manager was yelling on the phone to a previous customer who was unsatisfied. Totally unprofessional. And the last time, the female doing my finger nails' cuticles, cut my fingers right near my nail beds from pushing too hard. I think I am done with this place.

The sign on the door says they are open until 7PM, but the last three times we have tried to go after work they have been closed before 6. Tonight we got there at 5:50. The door was locked. A woman from inside came to the window, pointed at the Open sign that was off, then walked walked away. The few times I have been inside the staff seemed annoyed when we came in to order. This could be a convenient place to eat for people who live downtown and need a quick meal, however the hours are consistently questionable.

We stopped by here on a Saturday night mostly because we had failed to make reservations anywhere, and figured a pizzeria was our best bet. What luck! When we got there, there was a wait (a good sign, in my opinion), so we got drinks at the bar and went outside, where there was a fire going (it was cold). When we finally got our seats, the server was accommodating, the prices reasonable, and the food DELICIOUS (but then again, I'm a sucker for artisanal pizzas). I loved the atmosphere, too - live music (not so loud as to be overwhelming), low lighting, and everyone seems to be having a good time. Great find!

This is the worst subway!!!
I would not even give them one star but you have to.
I wish I would have checked the reviews prior to getting food.  I will never be back.  Seriously feel sorry for the lack of customer service.
Their store hours say open until 9pm after I placed an order they said our dining closes at 7:30.  They don't have any signs on the door and they did not tell me prior to placing and order and after I sat down at the table with a soda and food for my family they said lobby is closed.  I I replied and asked if we can eat then leave.  He said no no I don't want to have to re-clean the lobby again.

we squeezed in a quick dinner before an evening back to school event nearby.  It was our first visit.

The cheese plate was a good starter, and the salads were good.  Though one was missing the hush puppies (which arrived later on). main plates were "tastie "as well.

it was early, but even then the service was only OK. we mentioned we were rushed when we were among the first people seated yet things did not seem expedited, including waiting some time to clear the bill.

we'll be back, but this first pass was only enough to generate another look and not an endorsement.

Excellent housekeeping staff...

When we asked for things they always did their best to keep us happy. Now the bad..... Our refrigerator had frozen up (has no freezer) told the front desk and maintenance came the next day to put towels in it. Instead of changing it out .they left it
In our room to thaw out and leak on the floor. We received no apologies or fridge on check out day.   We will stay here again in the future. Just check the fridge.              
                                                                                               JAMES
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I have never done a review on Yelp before but I am that upset about what we found when we showed up.  We spent all day driving from Vegas and couldn't wait to get some good rest before heading to Washington.  The pictures of the hotel were not even close to what we saw.  We couldn't find the front entrance, parking was a joke, cigarette butts everywhere, garbage over flowing, and the area seemed unsafe.  We had our kids with us as well so we didn't even check in.  We had to find another hotel at 2 am.  Not happy.  I get COVID is rough on businesses but this was unsanitary, unsafe, and unorganized.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been to 45 Degrees, Naked Chopsticks, Sushi Club, Mikado, almost all of the sushi places here in Indy. This place is a gem! It has just as great sushi for a fraction of the other places! You get unlimited salad, soup, appetizers, & SUSHI! for $20-22 per person. My favorite roll so far I've tried is the Speedy Way...and the plum wine goes great with the meal as well. The staff is friendly and the place is spotless. I'm not sure about these few negative reviews because I've tried all the other sushi places...I highly recommend Sushi Club to anyone here in Indy.

Cashier had me waiting while she wipes everything down after the customer before me which didn't really bother me. I didn't have my Giant card on me and cashier couldn't give me sale prices. I went to customer service to apply for a Giant card which my phone number should have brought up my acct but didn't and the female behind the counter walked away and had me standing there waiting for her to come back. Another female walked behind the counter and didn't even ask me if I needed help with anything and walked right into the back door  never came back out. So unprofessional.

We have gluten allergies so we went there to get some pasta. We were significantly up charged a GF fee on each item. We received our items and the sauces were bland at best and my chicken parm was virtually inedible. At the end of the night the waiter ( who was actually a great server and we appreciated his professionalism - the reason for an extra star) asked if I wanted a box, I said no...and left a large portion. I am again discouraged by the accuracy of a Yelp review...4.6? I beg to differ... so in my humble opinion, this place was definitely not worth the price we paid for the quality of food received.

TERRIBLE Customer Service. Booked a room for my brother's wedding night about 3 months in advance, along with other people in the bridal party/ attending the wedding. When we arrived to check in, we were told their system was down so they couldn't verify our reservations and give us our rooms. We were left sitting in the lobby with all of our belongings. Eight of us sat and waited for about an hour and were then told the system could still take hours to come back. At that point, we had no choice but to leave and find another hotel in the area. They did absolutely NOTHING to accommodate us in anyway. Will never book there again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Regrettably our experience was not the best. 
It started off with the calamari which was very good. Then went slowly downhill. The service was poor; one of our entrees did not even come until the other six people were finished with dinner. There was no apology; we were told the kitchen was just too busy. Regarding the food selections at our table, the pizza, chicken parmesan and pork were very good, lasagna and pasta dish were a little disappointing. We would have tried dessert; however the bill came without being asked if we wanted it. Will we give it a second try if ever in town, possibly.

Wow! We stumbled upon this restaurant and were treated to authentic Mexican food. It felt like we had visited a friend's house and their mom had made us a traditional Mexican dinner. We were taken care of by three generations of the same family. The grandson seated us and brought our chips, salsa, and waters. The son waited on us so attentively. And the mother was in the kitchen cooking our amazing meal.  You could actually taste the love the food was prepared with! And the pride her son and grandson took in  the food was evident. What a treat! I highly recommend!

Nice cute get away. In the middle of everything and very convenient. Love all the games and activities they have. I also liked their shampoo and conditioner very fresh. The only thing I didn't like was how humid and hot the rooms get. If I were you I would try to get a room upstairs at least you can open a bathroom window for fresh air with some privacy. The tv does does work but you're in Santa Barbara! There a lot of things to do out there. And they offer bicycles to ride around! Very nice staff very accommodating. We will definitely be coming back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If you are female or don't know much about cars, I could not and would not recommend this Dobbs! They tried to charge my wife 1200$ to fix her A/C. We took her car to another mechanic. They said a bad O ring and hour to replace (200$) Dobbs wanted to replace all of the hoses and a couple of other parts.  This was the second time we took her car to Dobb's for the same issue. They referred to the previous estimate and not willing to discuss other options or attempt to figure out what the problem was. Plus, they charged my wife 40$ to open her hood and not do a single thing.  Highly recommend you question all estimated charges.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Staff is good, but sadly other than that this is a shockingly dated property.  Everything in the room was worn and dusty, upon check in the sink was covered in black grime!  Walls are paper thin, I could hear the room next to me talk on the phone, watch tv and even zip up their bag.  The room itself is more like a motel 6 at best, not a Marriott by any stretch of the imagination.

On the plus side the restaurant food was surprisingly good and service fast--important as there are no other places to eat nearby.  If this place ever remodels it would be a good place to stay but avoid it until then.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went in today for a normal gel manicure. I was immediately put in a chair and a nail tech came up she never greeted me. She immediately started cutting my cuticle and skin going way to fast and she cut me. I started to bleed and she proceeded to ignore it just rushing through cutting the cuticle. When I finally spoke about it she rolled her eyes and put a green solution while pressing very hard. After that, she quickly rushed through the polish making it sloppy. She never apologized and when we finished she never said thank you. I paid 37 dollars for a horrible experience. DO NOT GO HERE. There are much better places that are cheaper.

I went in to Snip to get a trim. Jackie took the time to talk with me about my type of hair and how I wear it. After talking we decided to go a little shorter. I have curly hair so she washed it, cut it, rinsed it then styled it curly so I could see how it would look naturally. Usually, stylist will just put some hair spray in it after cutting it or straighten it. I loved being able to see what it would really look like. I love the hair cut she gave me!. It has so much more life and fits my face well. Jackie was so nice. I will definitely be back.

I just got my 2016 Toyota Camry back and it looked like a new car driven off from the car showroom. My car had been restored to its pre-accident condition with major works on body and paints. Thanks to Patrick Leipziger,  Ed-Le Van who are very professional with hazzle-free to deal within whole process, with insurance coverage. 

This place gave a great price, amazing body and paint jobs and I  am so glad to have my car restored like new.

I would like to recommend this shop for your car body repair and they offer very good price and trustworthy workmanship.

Glad to see I am not the only one that hates this location after many tries.  The last time I complained, the manager said maybe I was doing something to the pizzas and that was when I called to get my free one and he lied and said he did not see anything and he was the one that said he would give it to me.  Like I am so broke, that I have a scam on pizzas.  Maybe if they knew how to make the pizza as ordered we would not have these problems when all I want to do is eat a pizza.  The staff are a reflection of the management.

I leave this rating not out of haste, but in hopes this once amazing restaurant gets their act together. My family has eaten here for years and the food has been fantastic. Recently something happened.. and it doesn't seem to be a change of ownership. Their once delicious pico.... I found it to have ketchup in it?! Other food I've been ordering over the last 3 or so months has also been subpar for no reason. This was once a fantastic place with reasonable pricing..... but things have changed. I won't be back until they regroup and start serving the food they used to.

Stayed here last night and was not told that the internet was not working at the hotel.  Only after I got settled in my room and called the front desk did they mention it to me.  The office told me they were fixing it but never did.  Instead they rudely just decided to stop answering the phone!  Major inconvenience to my stay!  They don't seem to even care!  No wonder the dump was empty!  OK place to stay if you want to save a buck and willing to be treated like a dog in a poor section of town  I DO NOT RECOMMEND ..............
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I can't say enough about this place. I love going there with my family and BYOB for a nice night out.

I also love bringing my elementary school Spanish students. They help my students practice ordering food and are super accommodating. They go above and beyond to give them an amazing experience and help them try new food. My students left saying it was the best field trip and experience they've ever had. 

I love there food and love their salsas and well, everything. Enchiladas are great! Burritos, chimis and the combos when I want a little of everything.

I have dined here a dozen times over the past 2 years. It is always a amazing experience! The service, food and atmosphere are excellent. The menu is always different, which is what adds so much dimension to the experience. I learn about a new preparation on every visit. Make sure to ask questions about the different items on the menu - don't be shy! They are very accomadating for different diets - for example they will alter and substitute out meat with other yummy options. Right now the Beet Salad and Ginger Spritzer are on the menu. Wonderful! Many lovely hand-rolled teas to choose from.

I would STRONGLY think twice before allowing these "hacks" on performing any work on your vehicles.  They cut corners and in the end, haven't actually fixed it the "correct" way.  They've done what I call a "patch job" charging you full price.  If you want it repaired the RIGHT way, GO SOMEPLACE ELSE!  I now have taken it to someplace else, which found the problem with "their fix" and expect to pay the SAME to have it repaired the correct way, the only way it should have been done in the first place.
No wonder why no one else has reviewed this establishment. It shouldn't be in business.

Financial service 101: 
If your institution will not loan 100% value on a vehicle, let the customer know up front. That way they don't ding their credit running an application only to get an answer that is far enough below what they need to actually purchase that they can't go through with the deal. That wastes everyone's time. 

One Nevada not only made me look foolish to a seller, they cost me the opportunity to buy a motorcycle that was a great deal. Had I gotten good info up front I could have gone to my regular bank and gotten a loan for the full amount. 

Very frustrating.

After almost two years of holding a contact with this company, I have over the past couple months come into contact with a person that I would unfortunately rather cancel my contract than continue to do business. Starting with going against there verbal agreement and running my card for a unauthorized payment putting me and my company in a bad situation and has continued to run my card against my wishes for whatever amount they find okay. The last was $50$!!
REALLY??? WTF??? I hope to continue to do business with enterprise but this is not a good way to represent any company.

Rooms are very nice and brand new.  Windows have two blackout blinds with dark curtains too.  Virtually no light comes in the room in the morning.  The bathrooms are huge and well accompanied. The employees are still working out the kinks since it just opened (this week), but all the staff was very nice and positive even if they were still a bit rusty on how things should operate at the hotel.  The specialty drinks in the bar are made with care and top shelf.  I'd definitely stay here again especially if attending an event at Lucas Oil Field.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Been to Pepper on 23 a few times. This time my wife and I ordered our food and when it came out mine was the wrong meal. They were nice about it and said they would make a new one real quick. 25 minutes later after my wife had already finished her meal they brought it out (there was only two other couples in the restaurant). I asked for the check because we couldn't stay any longer. No discount or anything just a check for full price. Not saying they have to discount but it sure would have been a nice thing to do. This is the last time we will support this Belle chasse restaurant.

I checked in about 1050 and I got up to my room and I found the bed wasn't made and that there was poop in the toilet.  I had to go all the way back down to the front desk to get this straightened out. The room was nice but I could tell it was old,  there were a few places where the paint has been chipped off and the shower head has a lot of buildup on it.  Then when I got my bill it was about $30 more than what I thought it was supposed to be so I had to get front desk to straighten that out.  Other than those things it probably stands up pretty good to the Holiday Inn express standards.  Don't think I'll be staying here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The delivery man was very rude, I had just   gotten out of the hospital and couldn't run to the door, the tracking had the delivery 30 minutes away but he was at my door sooner than expected. I answered the phone and said "give me a minute I'm coming" as I approached my living room I could hear the delivery man hollering outside of my window, I said I'm coming right now when I opened the door he basically threw my food at me and made some  disparaging remark. Completely unacceptable behavior I shocked because I've ordered from this restaurant before.

Ppl are nice enough and prices are reasonable,  the location is right in the mix of it all,  but!...
1- rooms are extremely small
2- bed was very uncomfortable
3- could see light ALL THE WAY AROUND the door where it clearly needs some weather stripping or something because 
 A- I could hear everyone at all hours and
 B- I could smell the disgusting cigarettes in
      my room... 
even though it's supposed to be a  non-smoking hotel.
4- that so called breakfast was skimpy at best,  and quite frankly very nasty... 
I recommend finding a better hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Our stay was very nice.  Everyone is the hotel was very helpful and there is great customer service amongst the staff.  Especially, Lisa in security, and she works the morning Bistro.
