She was so friendly and helpful.  She answered all of our questions, and we became instant friends with her. She was very informative about the local area.  In addition, she directed our questions to other team members that could help us at the hotel.  This is a great location. Therefore, if you go and stay at the Courtyard, please say Hello to Lisa, and get to know her.  She is lovely.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
The place isn't HORRIBLE, but think 1980's. Older .... everything.  Painfully slow elevator. At check-in, there was no one there. At check out, there was no one there. I also couldn't get a receipt due to "computer problems".  They have the noisy, manually operated AC units in the room.  Breakfast (included) but very limited.

On the plus side, it's relatively inexpensive. The shower had good water pressure and held a consistent temperature.

I definitely wouldn't book it again unless everything else was full. All said, I'd give it 2.5 stars - but go on the 'down' side because of check-in / check-out inconvenience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I am a very long time (since 1994) client of Pets First. I have brought 3 different dogs to them, and each experience with Pets First has been extremely positive. The doctors, vet techs, and staff are very welcoming and know who I am and who my dog is the moment we call on the phone or walk in the door. They have always given me all of the information regarding whatever is going on with my animals in order to allow me to make the best and most educated decisions regarding the care I choose. They treat all decisions that I make with respect. I would not want to take a dog anywhere else.

We come here when the weather is not good for outside playing. First visit here was 1/3/15. I ordered kids meal with milk. I noticed milk had "use thu 1/1/15" they didn't have anymore milk so I changed to apple juice. They had more but all of them had same date. Today(second visit), there was dried yogurt on go-gurt. I wiped off thinking it was from other pack but it was from it. I guess I don't have good luck with here but this is the only McD close by that have playground. I need to look around here to find place.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: We used to LOVE this place!  I have been a customer for over 20 yrs.  Buffalo Volcano was amazing once we discovered it!  Now days more often than not we walk away leaving rolls and fish on our plate because they taste off (like the crab salad is old or the oil they use to fry needs to be changed).  One time we ordered over $200 worth of Sushi and the tuna was REALLY bad...couldn't even chew it bad.  Instead of comping us they gave us a free Calendar...really?!?!  I am sad to say we are not going back anymore...Sorry guys:(

Took my husband out for his birthday on a Saturday eve. It was last minute. We had to wait for a table which is to be expected. We had a cocktail at the bar which was great. Once we went to table our experience changed. Waitress was adequate. Staff around kept dropping plates 2x but never picked up all the pieces of glass on floor. We order two of the same cocktail but they seemed watered down.  My water glass was dirty. Bread with oil was alright. Appetizer was OK. My husbands meal TRIO was cool, like it was frozen and microwaved. I had the pasta carbonara which was under cooked but still eat some until....eat shell in my mouth...disgusting

Went here for dinner last night and it was the worst option we could have made. I ordered the chicken parmesan and it was hardly traditional.  It had stripps of breaded frozen Tyson chicken, douse with sauce everywhere then with mozzarella cheese.  After a bite it's was definitely from a frozen bag. Horrible.  Then I had the pepperoni pizza, was grease everywhere on top and bottom of pizza. The crust was so chewy it took two hands to pull away from my mouth. I don't recommend this place to anyone.  Unless you want a horrible stomach ache.

Horrible service. Employees working the counter were not attentive, one of the employees was sucking on a ring pop while bagging up customers orders. Very unprofessional and unsanitary. The same employee was talking and laughing with another employee while customers were waiting for there orders that were ready. Management was onsite and did nothing to correct the employees. Food was cold and soda was flat. Fire and hire better employees or close down the location. This location doesn't even deserve one star.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Employees can't get to work on time. Opens at 7:30am. I had an appointment for 8:30am. Not one technician showed up for work. Customer service said to me "when our technicians show up they will take care of you. When they did all the one employee was worried about someone being 1 hour late and write them up.  Uuhhh you were late also, just not as late as the others. It is now 9:49am. And they never rotated my tires when I asked so now I am still waiting. Horrible service!!  Shame on you. I will not be back.   And I never write reviews.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Worst, slowest fast food ever. Literally sitting here with my kids right now waiting for 3 chicken wraps and 2 fries. How hard is that? Been here about 10 minutes. My kid has to get to karate. I went to a fast food restaurant for speed. Ridiculous. This is the 2nd and last time I'll ever go here. The first time they left out the toys from both kids meals, an order of fries and the ketchup I requested. Went back for the kids meals and didn't get a single word in response other than "pull around".


Update: my son is officially late for karate and the wraps are a saucy mess. Literally dripping out of the paper wrap. Terrible place.

This is probably the worst Mexican restaurant I have ever eaten at and arguably the worst restaurant in general. I ordered the Chili Rellano, a favorite of mine. The batter was heavy and greasy, the pepper undercooked and there was very little cheese inside the pepper. The rice tasted like it was days old and the refried beans were disgusting.  My friend ordered beef tacos. They were burnt hamburger patties inside a taco shell. The service was as bad as the food. Don't go here. I am sure you will be disappointed.

This was my first time to Vivo Windermere. We have been to the west end Vivo several times and while we knew this location was more casual and family friendly menu, we expected higher quality food. Small portion pasta, cold burger and fries, chicken Caesar salad that seemed like chicken out of a bag. The food was very poor quality overall. There are so many other casual dining spots with much better food in Windermere. The staff and service were fantastic a 5, did what they could hence overall 2. Don't go for the food. Sorry Vivo.

Absolutely the WORST shirt laundry anywhere.  The idiot woman that runs the place does not take accountablity for poor quality laundry of mens dress shirts.  Half come back okay, the other half like they havent been pressed on the front.  I've heard every excuse - my shirts are too big, bad fabric, shirt gets wrinkled when traveling (not from the cleaners to my house), shirt gets wrinkled when it gets put on, wrinkles go away when its put on, and so forth.  Stay away until she learns appropriate customer service and can provide a satisfactory laundered and pressed shirt.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: I will not step foot in this branch ever again. This is after several bad experiences with the staff. They are rude, invasive in that they ask personal questions that they do not need to know, and just lack any respect towards me as a 20+ yr customer that supports their paychecks. I have had decent service with other branches, and even had great service when speaking to customer service over the phone, so it really appears that this is mostly an issue with this particular branch. However, I am considering using a different bank altogether because of the inconvenience of having to go out of my way to visit a different branch.

Although the menu was large, we didn't realize there were Christmas Eve specials until we heard a waitress mention them to another table across the room.  My veal with brandy was tender and tasty, but my companion's branzino was dry even with aurora sauce. My side of angel hair was over-cooked and my companion, who asked for aurora sauce, received angel hair with marinara.    The entire meal was punctuated with the shouting and banging of two little boys (around age 3) at the next table, whose parents allowed them to disturb the entire room.  The staff said nothing, so dinner was neither pleasant nor relaxed!

As donut lovers, my wife and I were excited to hear about a new donut bistro downtown so we decided to give it a try. We ordered a half dozen of their best/most popular donuts recommended by the young woman behind the counter, and we were sadly disappointed by the flavors. First, we ordered a lemon filled donut that literally had no lemon filling! Second, the dough itself tasted like loafs of bread from the store,  and the unique flavor icings left a lot to be desired. Don't waste your money here, DoughBoy's offers far superior donuts at a lower price point.

I have been here twice for "All You Can Eat" for $19.99. The options are quite impressive and the quality of the fish and presentation have been spot on.  I tend to go heavier on the salmon and white tuna sashimi, which is as good as most places. The nigiri options are very good as well and enjoyed the yellowtail and maguro. The handrolls are nicely done and there are a number of very good specialty rolls to choose from. You can also order non sushi items as part of the $19.99 as well. The appearance from the outside isn't as inviting but inside is nice. Would definitely recommend

This gym gives really has a true sense of community. Everyone is friendly and the trainers and staff truly care and work to get to know everyone. I started training with Dan and Cary and they helped me lose 5% body fat in only a few weeks. I feel better than I have in a long time! I look forward to training every week because it feels like I am hanging out with friends. It is always clean and there's never any waiting for machines like I've experienced elsewhere. The office manager, Jackie, is awesome and super accommodating. Definitely worth checking out!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Stayed the night for a one day business trip and woke up an hour early to a crew of Painters talking, laughing, smacking paint buckets around, scraping mud on their trays, everything but pounding on my door and you can hear EVERYTHING through the walls & door. Needless to say we know painters won't always be there, but it's the carelessness of the hotel to let them start work outside your door that early. Not to mention pubes on your white wash cloths and towels. Not pleased at all. I'd recommend staying somewhere else.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Service staff very good (5 Stars); food (4 Stars). 

Why the 1 Star? Management!

Subjected to owner/manager berating and reprimanding bartender and service staff in front of customers, making for an uncomfortable dining experience. Also, we chose to have limoncello instead of dessert. Our check was brought out before we were served our limoncello. Our bill was $200 for a couple. Lots of money only to have owner/manager tap our paid tab and comment "You're all done and ready" as if to hurry us off before we had a chance to finish our drinks. Disappointing.

The food is great. But the staff were horrible and very unprofessional, Not only did it take a long time for my order, but they were back there playing, laughing, not answering the phone. I thought they were super busy because they did not answer when you called, but once I got there,  I saw why. I witnessed several people come in and ask for a refund because they had not received their delivery. They are rude and disrespectful. When I asked why was there very little meat on my sausage, she said that was the amount that you get. It is sad because the pizza is good but the staff was very unprofessional and uncaring.

The first time I went to Dobbs I was spoken to rudely and unprofessionally. Unfortunately, I figured this would be the case at just about any auto shop, because I'm a small 22 year old woman. The work they did was fine and well priced, so I went back a couple of months later looking for an oil change. The man looked me dead in the eye and told me my car *only* takes synthetic oil ($40 more expensive). Luckily I left and looked this up in my car manual. It was a complete lie. Jokes on them for thinking they could scam me for $40, maybe if they hadn't lied I would have returned in the future. Now I will never be back.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I have no complaints.  While the room was small (2 double beds room) and putting our portable crib in the room was quite the feat, we had a comfortable stay and no noise like you might expect from a "budget" motel.  We made use of the small but serviceable pool and found all staff to be pleasant and helpful.  Room was clean and beds were comfortable.  Wifi worked fine.  Breakfast was a lot better than you'd expect with yogurt, waffles, bagels and cream cheese, and the like.  Will stay here again when passing through Boise.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This motel was probably the worst motel I have ever been to, the house keeper would walk into our rooms when we were sleeping and I told him one minute and he just walked in, the ceiling was leaking from the snow on the roof the wall had a bubble of water in it, the bathroom had black mold, nothing was cleaned the fridge freezer didn't freeze food well and the phone was not plugged into the wall the outlet was broken and sparking blew the power out twice, it took them a week of us telling them the power was out to fix it, I would not recommend going to this motel for anyone.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This place is adorable and delicious. Outside of the restaurant is a cute bench you can relax on. Upon entering you're immediately greeted by your server with a giant smile and a warm welcome. The decor is homey and inviting. The paper cut outs draped across the ceiling add a colorful touch. The portion sizes were very generous and the food was well seasoned. I ordered the carnitas with the homemade tortillas. The pork literally melted in my mouth, it was so good. Tucked away in the plaza behind Goodwill and Discount Tires, this place truly is a hidden gem.

Overall while the hotel was nice it was a little dated. But that's OK, they can't all be brand new. 

The breakfast bar was really good food, the omelette maker was delightful, but the service at the restaurant for breakfast was horrible. It was impossible to get ahold of them after they served coffee, and when we finally got up to leave there were three of them huddled talking. On the way out I passed one who was apparently tasked with folding napkins, but was instead found doing social media. We use Marriott all the time and this was definitely not Marriott quality service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This place tried to charge my niece $1200.00 for a repair when she broke down in Tucson in the searing heat with 3 small children!  Luckily we called the dealer to check what they would charge for the same job and the same parts (part # provided by Fletcher's) it was only $500.00.

These shameless guys thought they could take advantage of what they thought was a vulnerable young woman.  Later my 85 year old Step Dad told me he was sure they ripped him off too awhile back.

Stay away from this dishonest shop!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
We tried Jax on the recommendation of friends.  Though it came highly recommended, we were somewhat disappointed.  The soup was only so-so, the salad was good, but I was not blown away, and the pasta entree, though it sounded good from the description, was way too creamy without enough pasta.

The waiter, though friendly, prompt, and attentive  had only superficial knowledge about the wine list.  The wines we chose, while good, we're terribly over priced.

All toll, we spent ~$250 for three of us, and we were no where near getting our money's worth.  I gave it three stars, but really 2.5 would have been closer.

I have agree with one of the other posters - although the food is worthy of a return trip, because of their cheap and stringent policy on salsa we won't return. I think it's very short sighted of a company to charge for extra salsa containers when we live only blocks away and are regulars. Also, I've asked to have my tortilla for my veggie salad left unfried and they charged me and extra $2.50 for a 'special order'. It's cheaper for them and less work to simply put a warmed tortilla on the side and instead they have now lost two customers and good reviews for their insane policies. If owners changed them we'd return....

This review is not exclusive to this Dobb's location.

If you need tires, Dobb's might be the way to go. Maybe. For anything else, you're going to pay way, way too much! They do what's quick and easy for them, regardless of how much it's going to cost you. These folks are salesmen first, and mechanics second. Once you drop off your car, they'll try to sell you on just about anything they can.

Also... air filters are probably the easiest & cheapest thing to change on any car. Learn how to do it yourself, and don't ever let Dobb's tell you that you "need" it.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Don't consider this place if you're moving into Franklin.  The management is the worst!  Maintenance problems are never reported to the maintenance crews. We have on more than one occasion had to do our own repairs because our calls for maintenance went unanswered.  
The maintenance people are incredible!  They are skilled and friendly. However, we have been told more than once by maintenance workers that they don't always get the requests.
Management needs to start concentrating on the comfort and convenience of the residence.

We absolutely love oak oven! Their service is amazing, the owners are fabulous and always accommodate and are friendly to their guests, and the food is AMAZING! We had a crab meat ravioli for a starter which was absolutely delicious. I had the margherita pizza which is my favorite. Their pizza's are thin crust and have FRESH toppings, such as mozzarella, basil, etc. My boyfriend had the Pasta Diavolo which he absolutely loved. To be honest, this restaurant is one of my favorites and deserves over 5 stars for their impeccable service, their delicious food, and their lovely/friendly environment. DEFINITELY RECOMMEND!

Do NOT stay here.  We booked for 5 night for a hockey tournament.  On night #2 the toilet over flowed.  The lazy piece of poop at the front desk said "we don't have a plunger, maintenance will be back tomorrow, feel free to use the bathroom down stairs".  Ummmm hello I have sewage in my room.  He gives my husband a pile of towels.  So as of now the sewer soaked towels are laying in the hallway.  We went to Walgreens bought a plunger and Lysol.  It's valentines and there are no rooms in Nashville.  Tomorrow is a new day and you can be sure that someone will be on the unemployment line with his manager.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Here is the thing. I order all the time. Staffs ok. But, I want my order the way I want it. Cheesteaks need ketchup on top. Not at the bottom. I hate dry a$@ cheesesteaks. I repeatedly ask them to put ketchup on it. Later to find out they have been just under the meat. Eww. This is my first complaint about them. It is not the 1st, 2nd or 3rd time they have made my sandwich incorrectly.  Its a small business. So I rather tell them and keep it off line. Now, I am tired. 
Native Philadelphians who want ketchup or mustard on sandwich want it on TOP.

After midnight  the men's bathrooms are the grosses I don't go home after gym so I don't have a choice but to shower there.
It's a pick of the draw if you can find a decent shower that isn't clogged and the water filling up around your feet.
The midnight  staff doesn't appear to check the showers or the stalls for that matter as I was greeted with an unpleasant surprise today yet I've seen them go to the locker area several times.
The guy who takes the smoke breaks doesn't speak  or greet  unless I say something first but the other guy does.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I hosted my sister in laws baby shower at Brickside.  The day of the event everything went great!  They were very accomodating and helpful with everything we needed and the service was great.  The only reason I did not give it 5 stars is becuase leading up the event I tried to get in contact with the party planner several times and she never returned my calls.  I ended up solidifying all the details with one of the managers and everything turned out great however, I was a little nervous prior to the day of since i had never actually talked the the planner.  Overall, I recommend it for private parties as they do a really nice job.

Terrible experience. Very disorganized - and had to wait for an hour before I could be told about what was happening with the car we had booked which was not available. Was given a car that was dirty and stank like an ashtray!  My 6 yo and 9 yo children got out smelling like they had been smoking a pack a day. Agent did not read the details of the booking information and tried to charge taxes on top of taxes. While the staff remained very friendly, if you you're expecting a smooth pick up and to get the car you booked - this branch is not the one to deliver on simple booking and pick up of a hire car.

Been here over five years and now I must say the quality of the sushi have gone down hill! Brought take out today and few things which were bad: 1. Spider roll were smaller than usual and had no soft shell crab legs sticking out. 2. Avocado were getting bad as they are turning dark. (No ideal why would they use this) So being a loyal customer for years i call them back to tell them how bad it was and the response i get is sometime the crab legs are shorter. What a bunch of crap, i have posted a pic of the dragon rolls and clearly there are no legs on them. Never will i go back to this sushi place.

The hotel is nice but it's like pulling teeth to get service for breakfast or valet. If you need something before 7...forget it. Yesterday I went to get a coffee right at 7. At first no one was there and then a frazzled young man showed up. He looked at me and said "what do you want?"  I was appalled! So many professionals stay in this hotel who know what customer service is and to be asked what do you want...... I asked to speak to a manager and was told he was the manager. WOW. I recommend you just stay at a Courtyard because you'll get much better service.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Vacation can be hard to plan on a budget. But we wanted to stay somewhere nice, so instead of the Vista Inn (looked decent) we decided last minute on this hotel from booking.com. It only had three pictures but we were pretty impressed at the value it had - breakfast, wifi, pool. 

WOW! 

We were blown away by the poolside bar and the decor of the room. It is absolutely the most beautiful hotel we have ever stayed in for the price. The staff have all been extremely friendly and we have already decided this will be a place we will continue to come to. Oh, and the breakfast was great.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I made a Yelp account just to review this place. This is HANDS DOWN the worst McDonald's in the city. People regularly drive away  from the  restaurant because the wait is so long. I've waited 20 minutes before anyone even took my order in the drive thru, received food that was only partially assembled, and on multiple occasions have been told the store could only accept cash. Service inside the store isn't any better. The folks working there are very rude and disorganized and the store is dirty. Let's be real, McDonald's does one thing, and they do it poorly, but this place still finds a way to fail at meeting even the lowest standards.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Got the margherita pizza. This is easily one of the best pizzas I've ever had. The sauce and crust are both amazing. Had the perfect amount of cheese. We split an order of meatballs and the pizza, perfect meal at a pretty reasonable price. Meatballs were delicious, though came in an order of three (odd for splitting). Can't be too picky when they taste that good! 

Service was awesome; and by that I mean fast. We were in and out in 45 minutes. As soon as we finished our meatballs, the pizza came out. Pacing was great. I don't like to linger at a restaurant, though. I'd highly recommend Bettina!

My first time here was when it first opened and it was not good...but we figured they had time to "iron out the kinks" so we tried again, big mistake. There was 4 of us an everyone was disappointed with their meal. Worst caesar salad ever...and their menu is full of meat options, so there's almost nothing for a vegetarian. Surprising to that beer is their thing, yet their extensive bottle menu has zero descriptions-just seems lazy? VERY disappointing, especially considering it's such a nice space. We will not be back.

First time coming here on a Friday night, I was super excited to hear the mariachi play. I was unaware that after a certain time, I believe it's 9pm there's a fee per song. The service wasn't great. We had to flag down our waiter a couple of times to get some service and order drinks. The food is not great. The queso fundido was a little bland with a slice of cheese melted over the top. The aguachiles were way to spicy to eat and the drinks were way too strong. Our waiter never came to bring us our bill so we had to go find him inside and ask for our bill. I will definitely not be coming back.

Ate here when I was back home in TN for Thanksgiving. Had a great meal at Josephine. The highlights for me were:

- Very nicely executed old fashion, and I tried my gf's tequila based cocktail. It was delicious as well.

- The Brussels sprouts are some of the best I have had anywhere. They were the best food highlight for me.

- I had a bolognese dish that was very good and nicely done. My gf out ordered me and got a beef cheek dish with risotto that was melt in your mouth. 

Overall, I would absolutely eat here again when I'm back in town.

When I first walked into the dining area the scents were pleasantly overwhelming. Aromas of premium ground frying beef and fresh salsa filled the air and reminded me of a simpler time. Hearing the gentle popping of the oil bubbling in the cast iron settled my nerves as I prepared to enjoy the meal ahead of me. As I took the first bite it was sheer bliss, the beef was cooked to perfection with the perfect crisp of the tortilla, whether it was flour or corn. There was only one to describe my experience, olfactory overload. 
.
.
Spanish rice was made in a rice cooker.. 1 star

Delayed flight on Christmas Eve caused our original booking with a different company to be missed. Arrived there late afternoon on the 24th and walked up to the counter to meet Devyn who was working that day, instantly greeted with a smile and was more than willing to do anything he could to make our already stressful day much better. He found us a car at a very good rate and got us on our way in a timely manner. They beat all of the other competitors by almost 60% and customer service was excellent. Thank you for the great service when all the other agents at the other companies we spoke to were less than friendly.

Got a hair cut here recently and it was the most horrible experience ever, the old woman was very rude and distracted, when she started to clip my side burns she accidentally clipped my eye brows and nearly injured my eye. I complained to her about it, but she kept denying it. She started saying if I don't like the hair cut, don't come back. She said this will be the last time she will ever cut my hair, if anything, I will never visit Perfect Cuts ever again. Spoke to the manager about the unfortunate situation but she was not very helpful and was not concerned a hairdresser nearly injured my eye.

Very disappointing. From the focaccia to the pasta and clams and the pork shoulder, this meal was poorly executed. The menu selections were limited  as might be expected in a restaurant like this and would not have been faulted under other circumstances. I did notice an older couple  nearby literally pushing their food around their plates.  In stark contrast, the decor was lovely and the wait staff were pleasant,  but in retrospect  strangely reticent. A very off night, or a disaster in the making? We will not be recommending this restaurant, and we so wanted to have a good meal with friends.

The bread was cold, tasteless and nearly stale. One girl comes around offering a piece at a time with only two tiny slabs of cold butter on the table. Fortunately my second course was very good - but the ribs came only with some tiny carrots. It needed a starch - mashed potatoes, rice or polenta - something to bind it together and with which I could soak up the delicious sauce. And the wine is way overpriced. My first course was very tasty as well...but for $90 per person without dessert, not a repeat (unless someone else is picking up the tab)

While the rooms are sacious (we got a 2 bedroom). Do NOT stay here if you need sleep! The courtyard outside our window, and our kids bedroom, had a barbecue party going on. Lots of loud music, screaming and swearing going on. Front desk says it would close at 11. HA!!  It's really too bad because the gal who checked us in was very nice and rooms were clean. But we were here for an early morning at it was horrible!! Should have stayed in downtown Indy, never had this problem there. Also, a really weird smell throughout hotel!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: For starters the service was great throughout the night. However, the restaurant is pretty small and begins to feel crowed as guests roll in. It was our anniversary and we decided to check this place out because I saw good yelp reviews prior to my visit. To be completely honest I was disappointed with the high pricing of food given its quality. Sodas were flat. I ordered chicken Alfredo and my boyfriend ordered chicken piccata. The chicken on my Alfredo was so plain it looked boiled, definitely not worth the 17$ I paid. My boyfriend wasn't to happy with his plate either. Will probably not be going back to this place.

My husband and I have had really good luck with First Wok II--until tonight. Our order took 25 minutes longer than what was estimated, and when we received it, it was incorrect, and what food we did get was subpar, to say the least. They forgot my husband's order altogether, and then argued with us when we told them it was wrong. They then compromised and said they'd bring a new order of his food. It's been another hour, and we still haven't received it. I called to ask, and they couldn't have cared less about our issue. That's the last time they'll hear from us.

Mosaic Cafe makes me wish I lived in Tucson.  I live in the Phoenix area, but go down to Tucson several times a year for U of A (alumni and kids).  Every time we go down we stop at Mosaic.  
They have, hands down, the best salsa anywhere.  It used to be a bit hotter (even better), but I'm guessing they had to scale it back a bit.  The handmade tortillas are awesome as well.  Every time we go, we get Salsa and Tortillas to take home.
And, to the menu.... I've never had anything that wasn't great.  Breakfast, lunch or dinner, special or a simple enchilada.

DO NOT rent from these people! They are rude, unhelpful and con artists. They did not refund my deposit until two weeks after the car was returned, and four phone calls to inquire about it, and each time I was put on hold for at least five minutes. When they returned my deposit, they shorted me $20, by claiming I had signed for insurance which was provably untrue. They scam you by having you initial both "accept" and "decline", then claim later that you declined but changed your mind! Possibly the stupidest, most inept short con I've ever seen. Whoever wrote here that the staff is friendly is clearly a family member. This company is the pits.

I had a great first experience at Don's! I went to get in my car the other day only to realize my state inspection was overdue. After a quick online search I found Don's and called them up. They said to come right away and they can fit me in. (This was 4:30 in the afternoon by the way). When I get there they took my car back right away-they seemed pretty busy as well. I told them I was almost due for an oil change, but I planned to come back-but they said not to worry they'll just do it. In less than an hour I was out of there. Great people and very accommodating. I will definitely come back.

Rates are seasonal. Well over $100 tonight. The front desk said that as the hotel fills up, the rates go up.  Ok, the room was clean. Convention of kids running up and down the halls from the time we got there (5pm) until 11pm.  Wood construction so you hear noise from hallway and bordering rooms.  Wi-fi not working.  Front desk said "this has never happened before, there a lot of people here tonight".  Breakfast is minimal, straight out of a plastic wrapper.  Motel 6 at Hampton price.  I'll pass next time...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Mavis tires are cheap & worthless ! They told me over the phone that 4 Brand New tires was gonna be $320 for everything but then after the service they charged me $350 for the 4 NEW tires without telling me I had to pay for an alignment & $10 disposal fee for each tire Which was very misleading. 8 days after getting the New Tires I caught a flat one & they charged me $30 to fix the leak/$100 for an alignment ‍ Now it's been 16 days total since I got the tires & now I have another flat tire ! Their tires are cheap material & are not worth the money !
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: We went there for lunch. They weren't that busy, maybe 4 other small groups in the restaurant. We got there around 12:10 and didn't get served until 12:45. People arrived after us, got their orders taken before us and served before us. When we asked for the check and some ToGo boxes, she brought other food to other people and boxes to others before us. Everyone was taken care of before us, while we arrived before them. This wasn't the first time this has happened there, with this waitress as well as others. My pizza was not fully cooked and came out to the table warm. Not hot. We will not be returning.

After for looking on Yelp for some local ice cream places open later on a Sunday night in the dead of winter, I found this location. My friends and I looked at the menu online and were excited about all the flavors we saw so we decided to try it out. 
We got there and the line was long, which to me is a good sign, but when we got to the window we were disappointed. We only saw a small fraction of the flavors that were listed online. The ice cream was OK but nothing memorable, they add way too much whipped cream topping and not enough fudge/peanut butter/whatever sauce.

This place is a mess beginning with the managers. They are rude, aggressive, and SWEAR they know what they are doing. Crew members get no proper training so the service doesn't surprise me. You can get one drink and it will take you two hours or get 10 mcChicken in less than a minute. Always seems to be understaffed yet never hiring anybody. George and Marge are nice people but very cheap. General Manager has no say in what goes on. Shift managers leave everything up to the crew members. Crew members with nasty attitudes like they're nasty food. Surprised it hasn't shut down yet.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
We were shopping in the area and were looking for a non-chain restaurant for dinner. Happened upon Allegria during a web search.  We were greeted immediately and seated quickly. It was fairly early so the dining room only had a few tables with other diners.

I had the chicken parm and husband had the veal saltimbocca.  Both meals were very good. We did not order apps, but did order desserts.  The desserts were delicious! I had the lemon angel cake and he had the double chocolate cake.  Our server, Anthony, was very attentive. The atmosphere is clean and comfortable.  If we are in the Brandon area again, we would consider returning to Allegria.

Very cute design, clean and spacious rooms, the staff was so sweet and helpful. My boyfriend, daughter and I had to evacuate Florida due to hurricane Irma. I found this hotel on Expedia and immediately booked without doing much research. I was more than pleased with this choice. It is located in such a gorgeous area and not even a mile away from Target, Starbucks, and other great shopping choices. We ended up having to extend our stay due to the storm and they accommodated us with no issues. If we are ever back in Tennessee we will be more than glad to book this hotel once again! Thank you.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Was there on a Sat couple weeks ago, tried to get a reser for an early evening dinner but they were booked up so I made a later reser that same night. Glad I did. The food was better than I heard. Service was spot on. I had the crab cake app which was one of the best, loaded with jumbo lump crab meat. My guest had the pear salad which she loved. I got the entree special, Chilean Sea Bass, which was out of this world. She got the lobster risotto and raved about it. Overall a great meal and great experience at Bliss. Glad I went back that night!

I have always rented my cars worked with the wonderful folks on 19th Street, but just now had a poor experience. I telephoned to reserve a car and spoke with someone in another location. He refused to even say what kinds of cars they had in the current fleet.  When I said that staff always let me know,  he replied there was a new system and no contact and no information RE the fleet was no permitted. His name was "Quinn" and after years of working with the 19th Street Enterprise, I will be seeking another source for my two week rental. 

Sonia B.

JD must have forgotten the salt at home! Otherwise perfectly executed pasta dishes fell flat due to rampant under-seasoning. A flaccid bolognese! Almost criminal lack of salt leading to a meaty milky mess. The agnolotti suffered from a topping of chopped star anise. Too thick! Let''s grind that to a fine powder next time buddy boy. The octopus in the bucatini was cooked to perfection, but the dish was a muddled mess of fishy flavor. Bartender was a gruff and unskilled brute. Learn to mix a drink and serve customers!

Checked in for a wedding.  The wedding rate is more expensive than the rate on the hotel website...pretty bizarre.  There's no closet in the room (rather, a 4 inch deep cutout in the bathroom with a flimsy curtain on it that can hang a few items.  No drawers in the room either to store anything.  The sliding door in the bathroom is wildly awkward and the air conditioning unit is louder than anything I have ever dealt with, particularly in such a small room.  Not exactly looking forward to a good night's sleep.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Went here because I started a new job nearby.  The barbers on the end who people were waiting for seemed good.  I went to the "available dude" in the middle.  Mistake.
Big mistake.  The cut was completely not what I asked for.  Way shorter than I asked.  The shape up of my hairline looked like a 5 year old did it.  The place seemed like a good place, but I may have just picked the wrong barber.

Honestly this was the worst haircut I've ever ended up with.  I knew better than to let the guy who was available do anything to my head. ARGH!

* Lack of urgency to address resident's concerns (maintenance requests or any other general issues)
* VERY POOR customer service over the phone AND in person ( we still cannot go into the office  even though ALL other offices, businesses are pretty much open at this point)
* Apartment not having clean, working items and amenities upon move in 

I've been here less than a more and my experience has been poor to say the least. There is a character limit so I can no post my entire review. (yes, its that long) They HAVE to do better here. BBB and owner company will be contacted soon

The service at this hotel is one of the worst I've seen in my life. The front desk employee Maurice feels it's an invovience for him to answer questions of paying guests at the hotel. Manager Andrew Dryden kicked out a guest during the corona virus claiming "they can search rooms because of corona virus" whatever that means..?The guest he kicked out happened to be Asian and the only one in the hotel that was wearing a mask. Aloft corporate NEEDS to take action about this issue. Shame on you Andrew. You violated this man's privacy AND put his life at risk entering the room with no mask or gloves.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I love the actual look and feel of the salon but unfortunately I have to agree that my kids both got pretty lousy cuts there...twice.  My daughter had LOOOOONG hair and I asked for a slight layer and she ended up with major layers and the underneath portion shorter than the top...its totally difficult to style now.  The girl told me she has baby hair and I need to cut it all short in order to make it look nice....ugh I don't think so. 

At any rate...they are terrific at getting your kid to sit still, give them lollipops etc.  but overall I'm not impressed.  Will go back to our old place in Merchantville next time.

The family and I went there for the first time last night. We should have stuck with water, as there are no free refills on beverages, which is almost not heard of in today's day and time. The menu is extremely limited, which was surprising for a sit down pizza restaurant. We ended getting 2 pizzas, a basic cheese pizza and a double decker. The cheese pizza was pathetic, looked like melted cheese on a cracker. Very poor. The double decker was better, but lacked any true flavor. It was very filling, as I stated previously, it was bland. I probably was generous in giving 2 stars.

We took our dog to Pet Doctor last week when the Vet close to our  home had no available appointments. Our Vet's front office staff recommended them. We did not have an appointment and expected to have to wait a while. We waited only 15 minutes. Everyone was super nice to us and our dog. We were pleased with the care, cost and amount of time that the Vet took to explain our options. They provided estimates in writing for all of our options. Even though Pet Doctor is quite the drive from our home, we have decided it is worth the trip and are switching.

My girlfriends and I met up last night at ambrosia and had a total blast! We started off the evening with drinks at the bar. The bartender, Courtney, was really sweet and attentive to everyone at the bar. I found it great that the owner and manager took time to converse with us and also the other customers. Our server, Dave, had a very bubbly and sweet personality. Not only was the meal absolutely fantastic, but the wait time was maybe 15 minutes before it was brought to the table! Overall great experience, I would recommend this restaurant to all.

This dump of a location offers incompetent service and terrible dirty cars.  I waited 30 mins in line after making an online reservation for a guy to tell me all he had was a Ford Fiesta.  I told him I had 3 kids and had specified that when reserving and he rummaged around and found the keys to a dirty POS Hyundai.  The thing pulls to the left and is a danger on the road.  I call back to swap it out and when I get somebody on the phone finally they tell me it will be several days.  Use another rental company.

For the second time, at this exact location, National has dropped the ball.  Once again I arrive after a long flight.  My reservation has been completely pre-paid (not just reserved) for a Midsized vehicle via a 3rd party travel site.  I arrive to pick up my rental and there are no Midsized cars or anything close available, only SUVs which I'm not accustomed to driving.  Considering I already pre-paid, my car should have been reserved.  Request for upgrade was denied.....  Had to wait over an hour on Thanksgiving day for Midsized vehicle.

The room was fine just a place to sleep but housekeeping came knocking on our door the next morning at 8am what kind of crap is that. Breakfast was non existent. It looked like it would have made me sick. At first contact the staff were rude but I'm the type of person to break the ice with people. Once you do that they are all really lovely. The  manager was such a lovely person. The reason I could only give it two stars is because the walls are like paper you can hear everything in every room around, breakfast being non existent,and housekeeping knocking at 8am an we just fell asleep two hours ago.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I just want to say thank you to Dr. Ware and the staff. I took my senior girl in after hours of her walking in circles and whining. When I first called, I was told I could bring her down to be checked to see if she was critical. If not, which she wasn't, I could be put on a list and be called to come down when it was our turn.  It made me feel better knowing that while we waited to see the doctor. As promised, they called me and we went into a room right away. From the start, the vet techs were wonderful and Dr. Ware was great. Tests were done as needed. I highly recommend All Valley Pet Hospital.

Food was very disappointing. The worst lasagna I've ever eaten. Even the spamoni desert was not as good as before. Our waiter, even though on the job, appeared to not be present at all.  Had to ask other staff to assist us on many occasions. One of the orders was wrong. I have never written a restaurant review before, but Felt the need. All four people in our party were not happy with their meals. Tasteless. Two of those in our party have never been here before and we were telling them how good the food was. We were embarrassed and will not return.

We called and ordered their two pizza and a 2-liter soda special. When we went to pick up our order, turns out they were out of soda. Did they offer us an alternative, like another item, a refund, or even a coupon for our next order? No. I'm not usually one to make a fuss over a bottle of soda, but they sold us an item despite not having it in stock and didn't offer a solution to their mistake. Add to that the fact that our pizza was undercooked.
I'm giving them two stars for making decent pizza in the past, but I'd highly recommend finding an alternative pizza place.

The elevators are the worse ever though. So SLOW and only 3 of them. (the reason why i did not put 5 stars) and the $50 overnight parking is bullshit.

Breakfast was so great! I never get a hot breakfast so I was so happy; they even provided soy milk, biscuits n gravy, eggs, (meat for carnivores), tea, coffee and many juices and an omelet station!!

Cool FREE drinks and snacks in lobby between 5:30 to 8:30.

AWESOME, SOFT and SO COMFORTABLE king size beds! And big full size sofa sleeper big, a HUGE living room AND PATIO!! Right in city-center so we walked to the venue down the street. 

Workers are very friendly too!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I am sooo upset I didn't take photos of the food! This review definitely deserves photos of their food! We were so happy with their eye pleasing dishes we just couldn't wait to dig in! My family a party of 9 went to this restaurant today. Nothing planned we drove to this area to visit Peddlers Village! Oh my goodness, the food was fantastic! Every single thing we ordered was so delicious! It's a little place way set back from the street, but it's always my experience that little places like this make up for the size and understated decor with their incredible food! My Compliments again to the chef!

I came to Nashville on business and the Hyatt was wonderful. 

My second day in the city I broke my ankle downtown and had to go to the hospital. Once I arrived back at the hotel the staff did their best to help me. They brought up my meals (they have a 24/7 gallery menu for purchase but you need to pick-up your food in the cafe area) and even brought ice to help ice my ankle down. The room was great for me as a business traveler but big enough to bring my family (the sofa has a pull out). Overall room was clean, food was good and the customer service was excellent.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've been going to Lonnie's for about 10 years.  Last month I had an appointment at 6pm, showed up at 5:55  & the place was packed!  I sat there until 6:30 when a group of 6 walked in and were seated before me.  At 6:40 I walked out & never going back.  I've dealt with the waiting and overbooking for years because there are 2 very sweet and professional technicians that I adore! However, after being a VERY loyal customer (all of my friends dropped Lonnie years ago) for so long, I made the mistake of thinking that I actually mattered.  I just wish my 2 favorite ladies would leave and work at another salon so I could go back to them.

Just came from there. Horrible. Had to go out for ice cream because I was hungary & now I am eating snacks! Had the ribs, drowned in sauce, lots of hard gristle that I had to keep taking out of my mouth. My Husband had a Very DRY prime rib & was supposed to be with mashed potatoes, it was baked. My Son had Boubilase ( spelled wrong) looked like vomit, my Daughter-in-Laws crab cakes looked good, she ate them. My Granddaughters pizza was dry bread.
What a waste of 100.00 & that did not include any drinks or dessert.
Would never go back!

This is the 3rd time I ordered from this place, and yet its gotten worse.I can understand one bad time but three?! Anyone who gives this place a positive review either has poor judgment or is a friend of the owner. I've never had such drier tacos in my life....Carne enchilada tacos are pork marinated and cooked in a spicy sauce, so how does it get delivered "DRY". I won't mention that the delivery driver doesn't carry change but that's irrelavant. I sincerely apologize to "La Guadalupana," on Haddon Ave in Westmont, for trying another Mexican place.  If you want authentic, good tasting Mexican food then go to La Guadalupana!!

I am a local and have been here many times. Each time I get routinely ignored by the MIA hostess. The last time was the last straw. I put my name in and a party that arrived after me with the same amount of people got seated first. Their waitresses/hostesses are terrible at being available and the wait is way too long for a mediocre restaurant. Why the wait? It's the only restaurant in Harleysville that serves alcohol. Drive the extra 5-10 minutes out of town to another place. IMO this place isn't worth the wait.

Great food but they need to do something about the acoustics and/or their sound system.  The speakers are large and  angled right on top of those that dine along the back wall, which makes it unusually difficult to carry on a comfortable conversation.  This is an easy fix for an otherwise wonderful restaurant.  If you're standing or seated elsewhere in the restaurant, you wouldn't notice it because it's not a "volume" issue, it's just how it's set up acoustically.  In sharing our experience with others, we realized this wasn't an unusual experience.

Mold in the bathroom fans. Constantly requesting maintenance services. But the biggest kicker, it leaves a bad taste in my mouth when essentially slum lords team up (the complex and a towing company) to go around private property for hours writing down its tenants plates to check if it's valid or not to tow it in the middle of the night. Like.... is this the society we live in now lol...... Literally everyone just being a scum human trying to make a quick buck off someone potentially struggling? And to do it over the weekend so they have no time to renew plates  Criminal. I'd be ashamed.

We go here once or twice a year with the whole family but now I'll never go back. I found a piece of black plastic which looked like a piece of a grill brush that was in my tortellini. The server I had took it back to the chef and the server said it was a mushroom stem and said we will not remake or comp your food. Rudeness from the server as if I was asking for comp or anything.  I am a chef for a living myself and that was not a mushroom stem that was a piece of plastic which I chewed and had to remove from the tortellini myself. I left the plate and did not continue eating. Worst service ever.

One of the saddest looking mcdonalds i seen and experienced, the cashier was nice but cleaned his station for a few minutes knowing i was ready to order and did not agknowledge me untik i fidgeted around. I ordered a large fries which came in a paper bag and were soggy, the girl that made them also dropped a few.  the drinks i got came with paper straws . Since i was travelling from Orange County where we use plastic straws,  this seemed odd to me, good for the environment but paper straws get soggy too quick. Overall, needs better customer service, better food quality and a better layout
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: If I could do 0 stars I would, screw this place. First I had to wait 20 minutes to check in because the clerk (who was very patient) was dealing with the owners lack of intelligence and poor planning and had to deal with moving guests from other rooms because of mix ups. Once It was my turn. The owner came in and stated that my family could not visit and hang out with me in my room for more than 15 minutes. I was here around this time last year...no issue whatsoever with my family visiting me in my room.  Spend a little bit more money and stay at best western, cleaner and better management
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I called try to get a quote for a passenger van... The customer service is NOT PROFESSIONAL AT ALL... First she said will transfer me to the manager about the quote. Then I spoke with thr manager and he said he will make me a reservation, I said may I get a quote first before I make a reservation? And he said I will transfer you to someone else for the quote.. And then another women answer my phone, and I told her I just need a quote and you guys keeping transferred me around..  And she HANG UP the phone.. GREAT JOB guys.. !!!

Well. This was an adventure. The guy who first started cutting my hair clearly knew nothing about cutting hair. He did not wet my hair and all in all made it look 10 times worse than it was to begin with. It didn't help that he didn't speak very good english. Finally he got the other guy there to finish it, and given the circumstances he did a very good job. I imagine if he had cut my hair from the start it would have looked great. Even so, it's pretty hard for me to recommend this place. 

I don't like to be picky, but it's pretty unacceptable for someone to charge $16 for a haircut that I could have given myself.

Stopped in to grab lunch to go and found a new go to place. I ordered the teriyaki chicken bento box  and waited only a few minutes for my order to be ready. Very clean inside. I got a generous portion of teriyaki chicken and fried rice with vegetables. It was tasty and also included a container of a  sauce that complimented the chicken. Also in the box were two crab rangoon that were great and a four piece California roll. I was able to divide the chicken into three lunches, so I enjoyed  it for several days. I will definitely be returning.

The service was slow and the cashier was not friendly. When I went to get my food, they had only made my two frosty's and hadn't even made my fries. When I told them I had ordered fries as well, they questioned me and told me that they gave them to the person I was dining with. I told them they hadn't so they made the fries but the cook gave me a very annoyed look.  Later we opened our frostys to see that they weren't even filled up all the way! (see attached). I'm giving 2 stars only because normally their service is fine and I've never experienced a problem before even when it's been busy.

The seafood mushrooms were amazing! The spinach salad was good. The asparagus soup was really good.. Except why do they have to ruin it with pork????  It definitely did not need it, it would have been been 5 stars without it. Not everyone eats pork!  The seafood soup was pretty good.. but why are they using cheap bay shrimp??  My husband got the chicken and eggplant... The chicken had absolutely no seasoning or flavor. The eggplant was covered with a layer of balsamic... Balsamic is a minor seasoning not a main! It was gross!

I was introduced to Bakthiar by a friend of mine who knew I was looking for a trustworthy mechanic to check out a car I was going to buy. My first impression of the shop was so-so but when he took a look at the car and suggested what all work it needed it helped me bargain a very decent price for the buy and since then I have been Hawramy's customer. Every time I go there, me and my car come out happy and I would recommend this shop to anyone looking for a friendly mechanic who treat your car as their own and always treat the customer as king. Thanks Hawramy brothers!

This is an unethical and incompetent cleaner. I had a wool suit coat destroyed by this business and the owner ("Karen") rudely denied any liability. When I told her I disovered the damage after removing the jacket from my closet and no longer had the receipt she refused to accept responsibility saying, "I have a copy of the receipt in my records but you need to bring it or you get nothing."
Stay away from this unethical place. The "we clean cheaply mantra" really should be "we clean cheaply, and some of the time we ruin your clothes and fail to accept responsibility for it."
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
I'm sorry, but if you have a restaurant, try to have a few fresh ingredients. I made a mistake and ordered nachos-canned cheese, canned chile, canned pico de gallo. All for $14. Come on. 

The desert is just weird. Cheesecake is lemon based ricotta. Just serve a slice of NY cheesecake. And why serve pineapple carrot cake?  It is not good. 

Just because you are a hotel bar, does not mean you shouldn't serve decent food. It doesn't need to be fancy, just simple, fresh and good. 

Insulting meal but the bartenders were nice.

I felt I had to leave a review for this place. Everyone who has a bad experience are always the ones who leave reviews, never the the ones who receive great service like me and my family have for years now. Brian has been working on my families cars and trucks for years, we have never had a problem with any of his repairs and his pricing is more than fair. He has gone above and beyond on several occasions doing extra things on our vehicles and not charging us for them. Me and my whole family highly recommend this repair facility and would never take any of our vehicles anywhere else for service.

1. Go to this barber shop before you go anywhere else in New Orleans!!!

2. Great atmosphere.

3. Great Barbers.

4. Great haircuts.

This place is definitely one for the books. I'm not from New Orleans and I was in need of a haircut desperately! I came here and my prayers were answered! I normally get a taper starting with a double zero back home and this haircut was better than the one I get back home. Doesn't use guards lots of scissor work, very old school and classy. Loved the shop and will definitely be coming here every time I'm in New Orleans and in need of a cut! Thank you Susan and Tony for a wonderful experience!

Quaint restaurant that gives you that real Italian dining experience.  The staff was very warm and welcoming.  My girlfriend and I I started of with cups of corn and crab bisque - phenomenal.  It was served in a bread bowl which reminded me of being back in San Francisco with a sourdough bread bowl of clam chowder.  We had a craving for red fish so we came to the right spot.  I had the blackened redfish and she had the parmesan crusted red fish , both with lump crab meat in a cream sauce.  If you're looking for a quality Italian restaurant with a great ambiance, look no further.

You've been warned. Don't stay here.  This place was so filthy.  I should have know by the condition in the lobby. The carpets in the hallway and the rooms were disgusting.  The smell of mothballs permeated the entire hotel. Nauseating.  There was hair on the toilet seat.  If it wasn't so late, I would have never stayed there and gone home. When I dropped the keys off this morning, the girl at check in was sleeping in the chair.  The coffee was lukewarm at best, the creamer was empty.  I couldn't wait to drive home and take a shower.  Just don't.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I was in town visiting family and needed to get my nails done so I went to Noiree nail bar, I have been there once before, this time when my nails were finished and I went to pay it was more than expected. I was charged for 2 repairs and nail cut down which neither happened. I wear my nails short and never had paid extra for them to be filed, and I did not receive any repairs,  not one drop of glue or a tip was placed on my nails. I have acrylic with gel polish which is normally 30-35 dollars, my bill was 44.00. I want to pay for what I get but PADDING  the bill was not right. Be careful and ask how much before they start on your nails.

The last 5 times I have driven through they have messed up my order. I ask for Diet Coke and I get regular. I ask for UNsweet tea and get sweet. Every time. They talk over me when I'm still ordering. The last time I got to the window and confirmed that it was diet. I was told yes- it was not. In the same order they left out a hash brown. I've have thrown out more drinks than I have kept. I won't go back. So disappointing. My orders aren't that difficult. It's just me and mostly a Diet Coke and chicken biscuit. When I ordered the bundle and a diet, I got just the biscuit, no hash brown and regular Coke.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I was new in town and took the shop reference from a new acquaintance. At first they were pleasant and professional, but extremely focused on the upsell. My third visit in was for a simple oil change. I asked for a full synthetic by valvoline - nothing exceptional. My ship literally sailed off the edge of the earth when the guy processing my bill charged me $160 for an oil change on my nissan versa, and had the audacity to try and justify the price with my brand choice.
I get the same oil change at Break Masters for less than $60 a few miles in the other direction. I would never go back to this shop for anything.

The not so good:  It shouldn't be priced higher than $150. I paid $190. Although a pleasant driver, the complimentary 24 hour shuttle took more than 30 minutes (with a reservation) picking me up from the airport.  The desk clerk  chose to broadcast the unfair and unbalanced news channel in the beautiful, open and airy lobby, rather than the balanced and more respectable national/internationally recognized news channel. 
The good: Close to the airport. Welcoming entrance. Open. Airy. Safe. Comfortable. Complimentary business center. And there was a 24 hour shuttle and a pleasant shuttle driver. The guest room was decorated nicely.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The food was quite tasty, but I had the lamb special and was very disappointed with the portion size.  I had 4 quarter-sized pieces of lamb.  Just not enough food to justify the $25 entree cost.  The bruschetta and beet salad, while good, also very minimal.  The bruschetta consisted of 2 pieces of bread with tomatoes and a sliver of anchovies at a cost of $9.  Really liked our server...very nice and attentive.  She was quite sympathetic about the portion size, and was not surprised by my reaction to it.  Also, they charge for bread, which is a pet peeve of mine.

I have had such wonderful experiences with this place. Dr. Samson is down to earth, thorough, and just downright pleasant to work with. I've worked with a number of the others on lenses and glasses, including Tony and Mary, and always leave with a smile (even got a very welcome hug from Mary!) They take my insurance (VSP) and always work to get me the best deal. I never feel like they're trying to upsell me on features I don't need. They are professional, friendly, knowledgable and quick. I wish every doctor's visit was this easy!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I came here around 2AM with my friend who is a black card member this was our first time here the girl at the front seemed like she was upset when I asked could she show us around we then said we would just look around and she seemed to roll  her eyes as we walked away we then went into the changing room and was greeted by staff member Brian who was mopping the floor we asked him about the gym and he was very helpful and seemed very excited to talk to us we loved working out at this gym aside from the rude staff member
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: I got a terrible infection in my nail bed after getting a gel mani and pedi here. My finger was green, extreme swollen, and very painful. I had to get antibiotics from a doctor to get rid of the bacterial infection. My sister ALSO got an infection in her toe nail after visiting here. I thought she was just unlucky, but after this horrifying experience, I will never go back! Also, when I called to let them know, they gave me a refund of the mani only. Considering the discomfort, not to mention medical expense, that the mani caused me, I think they could have at least comped the pedi too.

We just spent 2 nights here for the first time. We had a very good experience here. For an inn- the experience was 5 star. We had a hard time finding chargers for our tesla and the shuttle drivers at the inn were so helpful. We're so grateful for their help. The rooms were very clean and nice. The front desk was very helpful. Overall we had a very nice experience. The shuttle driver Dave was so caring!! If you're looking for a good inn at an affordable price that has nice accommodations, I would highly recommend this place!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: They do not make appointments, are not open on Saturdays, and you must wait in your car - which is understandable due to Covid.  I called then I went on a Monday and spent 2 hours waiting to be seen for a simple appointment - no illness.  Other people came and went with their pets while I waited and waited, I even checked to make sure they hadn't forgotten about our being out there in the car.  A couple of months prior to that,  I spent an hour waiting for a simple nail trim. I really like the tech who trims my dog's nails, but the wait times are horrible.

Got free delivery by calling the restaurant (instead of using a delivery app) during the Coronavirus Pandemic and it was amazing! The food was delicious and was delivered hot and quickly! The price for the amount of and quality of the food was unbeatable! The phone service and delivery driver was so kind and accommodating! Food was servers with free load of Italian bread that was unbelievably warm and fresh! Recommend you take advantage of the free delivery available now to and enjoy your own delicious dinner. We had the 4 cheese pasta, burrata salad, chicken parm, and cannolis!

I live about 2 mins from here and every time I come, they have to remake my order. The drinks I order are always very simple and do not stray from the original recipe. They will knowingly hand you a latte with 75% foam or a matcha drink that is basically white because they obviously failed to measure out the correct amount of matcha powder. I've only had a nice employee a handful of times. Majority of their employees are extremely rude and seem very unhappy. Do not waste your money at this starbucks because there is a good chance it will be wasted.

This place has been around for a while for a reason. The food is very good, but a word of warning, stay away from the hot n sour soup...it tastes like cleaning supplies.

The crab rangoon is very good, although they skimp on the filling.  The portions are decent sized, although rather small compared to other chinese in the area.  They do not accept credit cards and the interior could stand to have some updating.

The employees are not very friendly unless you happen to be a regular and know them on a first name basis.  They can come off as snippy.  You cannot beat their fried rice and sweet n sour chicken!

I wish I could leave zero stars. Extremely overpriced freezer burned ice cream. Very little selection (about 6 flavors) even though they advertise a very large selection.  The employee charged me for 2 regular priced  ice creams when we ordered and received smalls. When I asked him to ring it up correctly and give me the correct change, he refused and told me that he'd "get me next time". When I told him we would not be returning he still refused to give me correct change. After I figured out the correct change, he gave me $2 (not the correct amount) then walked away. We will not return or recommend this business.

Ordered food through their app for this location, ordered it at 12:41, got there at 12:50pm and they said they couldn't find my order, I had my receipts and everything. 

OKAY, whatever I know things happen but when I was talking to the manager trying to track down my order she laughs at me about the situation. Like really lady? You don't know my history or what's happening today, what if this is the only food I was going to have today or the only money I had and now I don't have either. 

Wont be shopping at this location again.

Horrible.  Avoid.  Shameful, sloppy, unprofessional.  Showed up at 8 a.m. to pick up car that I had reserved.   When I got there there were two other groups of people waiting ahead of me.  They too had standing reservations.  The Firefly employee had failed to show up for work, though.  The office was supposed to be open at 5 a.m., but the counter was completely unstaffed.  Phone calls to Firefly went straight to voicemail.  All of us had to rent cars from Thrifty at the next counter.  Thank goodness they had enough cars on hand.

LISTEN UP. Choose somewhere else to stay. The people who run this place must not have even graduated from MIDDLE SCHOOL. Hasia the girl at the front desk could not have been ruder. So much for the customer is always right i guess? "20 minute wait for valet" THATS FALSE because I'm writing this review while waiting for my car, it's been exactly 53 minutes at this point. Seriously just stay somewhere else there's so many other options that have to better than this building filled with incompetent assholes. :-)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Had dinner last night at Jax Kitchen. This was my fourth and probably last try there. The service was good, but servers seem disinterested for lack of a better word. The two salads were excellent, but incredibly small for the price. The "chowder" was three over salted scallops without broth or substance. The burger and fries were excellent. Each time I've been there, the waiter has taken my drink before I was finished. I think for the $100 (three adults) there are many great Tucson restaurants that are offering better food and service.

Food was OK once it finally arrived, forgot mayo on all burgers, not that difficult.  Had to clean off our own table to be seated, also had to clean up an elderly  couples table behind so they had a place to sit. Service was worst I've ever seen, had Monica as the waitress and had to go to the bar to get her off her phone for any service. Ordered fried pickles and came.oit in a puddle of grease breading not crisp at all sent them back and second batch was worse. Finally just quit caring so that we can leave. Will not come back for a while if ever and a shame as they used to be a good establishment.

If I could give it 2 1/2 stars I would.  My wife and I are always looking for new places to try since this was open a few months back we though whuy not give it a try.  I had made the reservation for Saturday night at 8 and thought that being a saturday it would be busy so we would get there ealry and have a drink at the bar. When we got there past 7 they could sit was.  I was surprise that for a Saturday there was a lot of empty tables and no wait.  Altough the staff where attentive to our needs and the restaurant was nice the food lack luster for the price.  There was not one item that we eat and said "oh my god that was great".

Hotel is fine. There are several better options nearby for similar rates. 
DO NOT get a room across The Republic - a very loud nightclub. The music and bass thumping get right through the windows and unless you are drunk it is unlikely anyone can sleep through that!
If they are going to charge people for rooms across the club then they need to redo the windows to reduce the noise!!! Seriously unprofessional! 
An overbooked hotel means no alternative room - I have to repack, check out and hope that they have a better room available tomorrow. This was a bad experience for me!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: In town for the night and was looking for some good Mexican food. The salsa was good and spicy and the draft beer was nice and cold. I ordered a machaca burro, enchilada style and it was good. I wouldn't say amazing like I had to go back the next day, but it was good. The service was great and the staff was all very friendly. I would definitely go back next time I'm in Tucson. Clean restaurant (glasses and silverware were clean) which is always my first guess as to how the food will be. Definitely passed my test. I would recommend for sure if your looking for an inexpensive sit-down Mexican food restaurant.

I love the food at Cafe Lombardi's and have eaten there numerous times. I just ordered from them for catering for 25 people this weekend. With everything going on with coronavirus and getting catering for the first time, I wasn't sure if their food would be at the same quality. The food was AMAZING! Everyone was raving about it and my house smelled delicious! Additionally, the customer service was outstanding. Ordering from them was so easy and they were very accommodating in making a gluten free dish for my mom. Highly recommend their penne vodka, and the new chicken with mushrooms and sundried tomatoes in a white wine sauce!

We went to the restaurant this past week and walked away really disappointed. For starters the Italian wedding soup was very bland, not much flavor at all, The chicken caesar was very salty. We also ordered the penne and meatballs with the marinara sauce .The penne was overcooked and the meatballs were flavorless, but the real issue was the sauce, it tasted burnt (and told our server) We left the whole dinner and felt that they should at least taken that off our bill seeing as we didn't eat it. The garlic rolls were good.

We had to make an unexpected trip from Southern California to Boise. Our dad's health took a turn for worse and was to be taken off life support. After searching yelp for accommodations,we discovered the red lion hotel. The reviews where good so we decided to stay there for the stay . The staff welcomed us with open arms just like long lost family. Teresa B and Misty B made our stay very enjoyable while dealing with issue's  with our dieing father.The rooms were clean and very tidy. The staff at Charicters was awesome too. We plan on returning in the summer for a reunion.  My family  will  definitely stay at the Red Lion in Boise.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've stayed here in years past but was disappointed with my last stay. Check in was slow and not as courteous as in the past. The restaurant service was slow and the food has declined. The servers are trying hard but too few people are covering the bar and restaurant. My order was wrong two out of the three times i went to the restaurant. 
On the plus side, the rooms are clean and the location is very close to the airport if you need to be close. 
There are a lot of options in the area so I will probably try another place next time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We just moved to the west side of Tucson and this restaurant is near our home.  At first it seemed okay, the decor is festive, the salsa was tasty, they make their own tortillas, but every time we've gone our meals have gotten worse and worse.  Two times I've been there the rice has been crunchy and undercooked.  The meals are uninspired and bland. I ordered the tamales this last time and they smelled like they had bad cheese in them, a moldy smell. My dish was inedible.  Both my husband and I looked at each other and said we'd never eat there again.

Frustrated!  First time customer for a blow out only - waited 45minutes.  Then to have the shampoo tech tell me, "shampoo not lathering too well - your hair is very dirty".  Note: I wash my hair every 2-3 days.  I told her there are others ways to phrase that.  I decide to make another appt - a few weeks later - for a highlight - as I heard one of the stylists is excellent.  Appt set - date marked in my calendar.  I call to switch time of appt and they never even had original booked!  arg  Will never go back.  They all seem so ditsy...  Also, pricing on website for highlight is different from what you re told over phone.

Studio was great when I first started. Good workouts, but overtime the repetitive movements started causing pain in hips, arms and shoulders. Haven't had any pain since starting at a new gym.
