Management is awful at orange theory. I had heard this from many friends who had issues. Took it with a grain of salt until I had my own billing issues. Wrong charges, double charges, charges after I canceled, etc. Multiple messages left for manager to call me back and no response. Khalifa only cares about money and getting clients signed up. Once you're in, she could careless about your issues.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
A star is not worth, this place probably has the worst service of all. And we go to McDonald's all the time. Last night, we ordered our food and he girl who distributes the food left for a long time and cashier must be new because she had no clue what to do. When the girl came back, she had this annoyed expression "what do you want" since were staying there FOR OUR FOOD. Food sat in the warmer for quite some time, fries were old and there was so much mustard on our burger.

Ummm... and there was a dead roach on the counter. So please go over your cleaning procedure along with customer service.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
For a small city, this is 4 stars. However, for a decent size city, it is a 3.

We ordered:

Takoyaki-very disappointing. It wasn't cooked properly, it was way too mushy, plus there is hardly any octopus in there. Skip.

Salmon and avocado roll- decent, but tiny roll

Tuna and avocado-again, decent, but tiny

Cucumber salad-its drenched in rice vinegar, not the best, but still good

Curry chicken rice-it tastes ok, but not enough chicken

Futomaki roll- tastes ok

Overall, don't get sushi in Tuscon unless you're craving for it. You'll be disappointed.

The car was great, and the service I received at both ends of the journey was fine. But Alamo charged me too much for a toll I was unable to pay.

While I know that I consented to such fees up front, Alamo charged me $13.00 on top of a $4.00 toll that I was unable to pay along I-95. It was especially disappointing because the toll agent said I could pay the fee online. Unfortunately, the Web site did not register my vehicle, so I could not pay.

I understand that Alamo needed to pay the fee quickly, to avoid more charges. And I understand that there might be an extra fee for Alamo's time. But $13.00 is too much. I am dissatisfied.

We waited 2 hours for our dinner and ultimately opted to have mine and my husband's boxed up to go. I asked that our 3 year old's pasta with butter come out first at least which took 30 min from the time I asked. Pretty ridiculous considering all that goes into that dish.

They comped us our appetizers and threw in a free dessert. The wine pours are generous and they take covid seriously, both positives and worthy of the 2 stars. Unfortunately, when I finally went to eat my meal at the hotel, it was missing the shrimp I had ordered and the sauce was not right. What a bummer.

Came here with my dad while killing time for our flight at the philadelphia airport. This is the only restaraunt in the area without passing security. The restaraunt is located in the marriot. The whole hotel is very nicely decorated as the restaraunt is also. The waiter and staff are very nice and helpful. The restaraunt is quiet. I ordered the philadelphia cheese steak & my dad ordered the roasted french cut chicken. Philadelphia Cheese Steak was pretty good. Nothing too special but the fries that came with the sandwich = BOMB. :) The French cut chicken was pretty good. Tasted perfect, not too salty nor dry.

I discovered this place on a recent visit home. Wish I had known about it sooner. It's mostly a locals place, where you can relax with a beer inside or grab one of the sidewalk tables and soak in the night. It's a less busy part of the Quarter, so it feels more like a dive bar in some European hamlet, away from the frenzy of Bourbon. 

Had the club sandwich one night, which was a bit gristly, but hits the spot if you've had a few. Tried the meatballs and angel hair pasta another night, and they were the best meatballs I've had in a long time.

I was recently walking the streets of New Orleans when BAM my beautiful, handmade Oaxacan purse gave in to the pressures of hauling around my NOLA bounty. The strap broke, and as if on cue, it started raining :(

I walked a block down Bourbon looking for a store when I looked up and saw this cute little laundromat and walked in to ask if they had any safety pins for sale and the awesome woman folding neat piles of clothes (the owner?) said no...but she had some I could have!

It was so nice to find a helping hand in the middle of my mini crisis. Thanks again for your help!
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Staying here was a great experience. Everyone is so polite and welcoming. The complimentary breakfast is amazing. I was very surprised at how good it was. And they made sure it was replenished at all times. Only negative I saw was that they didn't have enough staff for breakfast on Sunday morning (11/18). There was only 1 person on staff to keep everything replenished and help anyone who needed it. But she did the thing all by herself and was pleasant the whole time. Oh and the toiletries are bath and body works which was a major thumbs up.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It's been a while since I was last in New Orleans, and I'm glad to say Mojo's hasn't really changed. The faces are new, local and friendly enough. It's a place you can stagger in, get amazing food at a really good price without all the noise and bother of Bourbon street. 

When you're looking for a place to get steak at midnight and a round of drinks in a darkened tavern, it's a good place to end the night, collect your thoughts or maybe make some new friends.

If you're on Bourbon and need some quiet, go to Mojo's. Good late night food that is a staple of New Orleans and a bar that serves whiskey neat. . . not hand grenades.

Crisp crust with a soft chewy center and baked in a wood fire oven - this pizza dough was just about perfect! We had several pizza variations along with the spaghetti al pomodoro, which was delicious. Tomato, garlic, and homemade pasta - simple and pure. Truthfully I could have made a meal out of the house salad, tomato sauce and pizza crusts. Sometimes the most simple of meals are the best. 

Plus the location is tucked away in a old brick building, making it a bit of an adventure finding it.

Would definitely go back again.

We stayed here for a night since it has the cheapest rate in the area and it is somewhat close to the Saguaro National Park. 

I made a reservation online the day before I got here and check in was super quick and easy. Room was clean and comfy. For the price I paid, I couldn't ask for more. 

The only downside is like all Motel 6, there is no free breakfast but there is a Jack in the Box very close by. If you are ever on your way to Saguaro National Park and want to stay at somewhere close and decent, i definitely recommend this place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Very unimpressed with those place. I've taken both my wife's truck and my car. I paid $30 for my wife they did a good job on interior but left bugs on bumper. With mine I paid $16 I asked the guy for inside and outside and added tire shine. When got car back dash wasn't wiped well, doors not wiped at all, and center counsel not touched. I went back and asked the guy if with a full service wash they wiped the dash and center counsel and he said they do the dash but not the counsel. Needless to say I won't be back again.

If I could give this place negative stars I would ...... the rooms are f***en disgusting.  This morning after taking a shower .... I walk over to the bed to put my shoes on and my feet are all dirty from the carpet after just walking 25ft..... got what i assumed was a clean wash clorh to wipe off my feet and it eas left all black with dirt from cleaning my feet.......disgusting doesn't begin to describe it..... shower curtain rod was barely hanging on..... motel 6 in arroyo grande, ca you have just been elevated to the 2nd most disgusting place I've ever state and that is a distant 2nd on top of that....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I've eaten here several times, sometimes at the bar, sometimes the tables.  The food has always been decent hotel-prepped meals, and usually I get the daily specials.  I had crab legs, shrimp and steak for $14.99, lasagna for $12 (and it was huge) and several other daily specials.  The beer is cold, and the bartenders friendly.  It is open later in the evening than most places in Reno, and the service is simply ok.  You will have to wait a bit after being seated, and for sure the management has placed Keno and Keno runners everywhere for a reason.  But other than that it is a ok place for an ok meal.   Still cheaper than room service.

This place is a great addition to the NoLibs neighborhood! It has huge potential, but not quite a 5 star place yet.

Pros:
BYOB!
Amazing arugula salad
BYOB
And did I mention BYOB?
The pizza is great except...

Cons:
The crust is always always burnt (I went twice to be sure) and it tastes bitter. The slice of plain pizza crust they give you with the salad is basically inedible.

Will go back or get takeout for lazy nights, but I hope they up their crust game. Would also like to see them get more creative with pizza toppings too!

This hotel has a great location for seeing the city and the Art Museum etc..

This is my second stay there. Once with family and once with just my wife. The hotel suites our needs each time. 

Large rooms with tons of space and kicthen!   Fold out sofa as well.

Also the staff is great!  Special mention to a young lady names Tyler that was super friendly and helpful to my wife and I. She took extra time and talked with us when had questions. I really value that. I dont like when folks rush you along / away. Tyler gets 5.5 stars in my book !!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: How did I get a reservation here?  I can't believe this place is as good as it is, as reasonably priced as it is, and has reservations available on Saturday night!  I had my doubts, but the food and drinks are really great.  I had Caesar Salad (they said there was kale in it, I have my doubts, but the fired anchovies make the salad anyways) and the grilled Branzino (and the brownie, but you don't come here for the desserts).  Cocktails and wine by the glass list are great.  Interesting drinks with all house made ingredients.  Also tried the chicken fried lobster: yum.  I will definitely be returning to this place!

The Hotel looked nice but as soon as we checked into our room the vent on the ceiling was leaking water we told the front desk and they didn't do anything we had to put a trash can under it and it filled all the way up. Second their Valet company curbed my rim on my car and after a few weeks I get a letter stating they are claiming they are not responsible. The rim still had the dust from the curb on it. The hotel will not return calls and either will the valet company. I highly recommend you choose somewhere else to stay.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I stayed at this Hampton recently for work.  It was not bad and I would probably stay here again.  This was, in my experience, a run of the mill Hampton Inn.  When I walked in I was greeted by the person at the front desk.  They were booked so I only had rooms available on the first floor.  My room was okay.  It seemed like an older property which has that older hotel feel.  Decent place.  Very vanilla.  Also, I'm not sure if they had a sundry store. 

Not bad.  I was not wowed but  I would probably stay here again if for business.  It gets the job done.   

The thing I like best was the price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I just came into this location and order and Hand Grenade. Upon tasting it I asked Stephanie the bartender, who claimed to be he manager, if there were pineapples in the drink because I'm severely allergic and she said yes. I asked if she could switch the drink to a cheaper beverage with no price change and she said no, I had to deal with it. When I quoted the FDA guidelines about have labeling and ingredients available on the menu, she asked their security to remove me. I will never come to this establishment again and I will be filing a suit for the allergic reaction that I incurred along with contacting the local department of health.

Brides be warned! I recently had my wedding here and would not recommend to anyone! My day-of coordinator, Katie, totally dropped the ball on my wedding day. I didn't even see her until I walked down the aisle. Precious wedding items went missing, the vendors had no direction, and the whole day was completely unorganized. After my wedding when I called her superior (The general manager, Ron) to say how displeased I was, he treated me like a child and was completely unprofessional. Please don't have your wedding here. Your wedding day is too special to put in the hands of these people.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Rooms seemed clean but the gym was a massive disappointment. There was nothing to clean the equipment with and you could actually see dried sweat marks on everything. Still wondering what the purpose was for the random desk chair sitting against one wall. 

The TV was broken. The four days I was there the same empty water bottle sat in the corner so clearly no one cleans the space. 

Again. Rooms did the trick but if they don't take care of the gym it just makes you wonder what else they're not taking care of.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I've had to stay overnight in Philly a few times recently for some early hospital appointments the next morning.  I chose this hotel when I made my reservation basically on price that day.  The other Marriott hotels were either more expensive (Downtown) or booked.  
I was pleased to find out it was only a 10 min drive to Penn University.  I wasn't exactly sure how far away I would be from everything since I was staying out at the airport.  Plus the staff was above friendly and helpful.
I have more appointments coming up. I will certainly be spending the night here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
This was actually a really cute find on my recent trip to Nashville. We grabbed lunch next door and we're heading out to the airport when my friend noticed that there was ice cream in a very cool looking store front.

While it took a while for someone to come up front to take our orders, we were met with friendly service. 

I settled on the Sweet Cream with Reese's and my friend got the chocolate ice cream. 

It is a bit overpriced but seems to be competing with Coldstone so I barely noticed that I spent 10 entire dollars on 2 scoops of ice cream.

This is actually my aunt and uncle's restaurant; so I'd hate to sound biased or tooting our family's horn,
But I absolutely loved everything that I ordered. 
The chips and the bean dip as an appetizer will prep your taste buds for delicious food.
I had a shredded beef burrito that I will say wasn't up to LA's Mexican restaurant's caliber, but was a perfect alternate.
The fried ice cream was for sure my fav.  part of the meal, somehow I was able to fit it into my stomach with all the rice and beans that came along with the delicious burrito.
More on that fried ice cream though, DE-FUCKING-LICIOUS!

I stayed here while working as Essence Festival. The room and hotel seemed very nice upon arrival. The shower is great and it's a nice size room. It's in walking distance from the French quarter.    It turned into a huge party scene in the lobby, which is fine. But then my room started to smell like pot for the rest of the weekend.  The Wifi doesn't work at all. The TV doesn't work at all; most of the channels aren't even in HD (if you can even get a signal for them to come in). If I come back to New Orleans on my own time I will not stay here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I've stayed at this property several times over the last year and a half and have to admit that it is really starting to look pretty ragged around the edges. The public area in and around the reception desk has really deteriorated. When having breakfast this morning I couldn't help but notice how badly soiled all of the upholstery was on the chairs. It was not very inviting and actually turned me off from having breakfast in the dining area. The rest of the hotel is nice enough... the rooms are still spacious and well kept but I think I will be looking for other accommodations the next time I'm in Franklin, Tennessee
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Hotel is clean, but very outdated. Toilet leaked. Big "splat" of a stain on the floor right off the elevator (looked like a crime scene). Coworker's door to his room would not shut without force. Uncooperative staff -- it was an issue to order breakfast off the menu and even though credit authorization was approved far in advance, the front desk claimed they never got it (I have an emailed receipt that says they did) and I had to front the money vs. having them apply it to the company card that was on file. Best meal I had? Was when I walked over to the Marriott. I have no interest in ever returning to this place again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Best ice cream I have ever had in my life!  I actually haven't been here in over a year because I moved out of state, and I find myself missing Sundae School often.  The place itself is adorable.  The building is a real schoolhouse turned into an ice cream shop, so it has so much charm.  It gets very busy after dinner and surprisingly, right before they close.  Love that it is open late.  They have a large variety of very unique flavors, including some very colorful ones kids will love.  If you live within a half hour of this place and you've never gone, you have to try it.  Seriously, BEST ice cream; better than Haagen Dazs.

In a "ME-first", "What have you done for me lately?" society, it is an absolute pleasure to find a nice family restaurant in Brandon. If you are looking for a place that whisks you in and out like the big chains, look elsewhere. Allegria is what a nice sit down restaurant should be. An attentive owner, focused waitstaff, and quality food, the experience is great.
My wife had the gnocchi with spinach, I had the gnocchi bolognese. Both dishes were splendid, and very filling (as gnocchi can be). My son's spaghetti and meatballs is quite generous for a kids portion.

This place is horrible. 

Avoid at all costs unless you want to be given back stained clothing.

I recently moved to Philadelphia and have used their services exclusively for shirt laundering.

At least half of the shirts I have given them have been returned with oil or starch stains (Even though I stated NO STARCH).  The proprietor declares that they were submitted in that fashion but, unsurprisingly, has no proof to back up his claims (Stories of notes taken on the stains do not hold water when you cannot produce those notes with corresponding dates).

Stay away.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text:
The atmosphere is funky and southern and at first you think...way cool. But then, you get to the rooms and the pleasure takes a steep decline. The bathroom has no shelving space for any of your bathroom needs, and the room is dusty and very old. The shower tiles had mildew and I was not impressed with the clearly wallpapered appearance of the room.

As a plus, the staff was great, and the bed was VERY comfortable.

The location was convenient for the needs of my business trip, however I would likely not stay at this location again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Pizza is pretty good .  Reason for only 3 stars is we come every year and the service is always lacking .  You have to ask for everything , including the soft drinks you purchase .  

 With the Covid and outdoor seating only , they should invest in a few more umbrellas at HD or Lowe's.  I guess when most of your business is campers from out of the area you don't really need to go the extra mile or even have a good attitude. 

  Probably better rating if it was take out ... food was good , rest needs much improvement .

Nothing to complain about here. Hotel was clean and a typical Westin property. Views were fantastic and access from the Tampa airport was very painless.

Staff were very accommodating which included a room change when switching from two bed room to a single King room. The front desk clerk also made sure we kept the same view which was great. 

Bonus with the lobby Starbucks which made it convenient to not leave the hotel to get morning caffeine fixes.

Will probably increase SPG member benefits going forward as it has been a consistent positive.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Husband and I decided to treat ourselves to some Pie Hole. The pizza was delivered, lo-and-behold, one half was not what we ordered. Instead of being willing to give us the pizza we paid for and correct their mistake, they INSISTED that we not eat the four wrong slices. We had to wait for the delivery driver to bring the correct slices and exchange them. I hope that I'm not the customer on the receiving end of a pizza that has been re-heated, delivered to someone, brought back then served. Truly disgusting service to give to customers. Excuse us for wanting our order to be correct and tummies to be filled on time.

Stopped here after a friday afternoon at the zoo, the place is literally outside of the exit. Had 3 others with me who also ordered, the staff was friendly but could not save the food. The cornbread I bite into and literally spit out, it was so bland. The fried steak and fried okra was barely decent, while everything else tasted terrible or near flavorless. The mashed potatoes tasted worse than instant and I've had better macaroni and cheese out of a box, was watery....prices were okay, but the portion sizes were also pretty small~

Avoid at all costs, there are so many better choices in the Nashville are.

Ordered 2 quesadillas (cheese and chicken) and 2 tacos (carne asada and pollo) to-go. Waited 40 minutes for them to make the most basic things... I saw that it was because they were taking care of the customers that were eating in the restaurant first, but I think 40 minutes is unreasonable. There were three groups that came in after me, and they all got their burritos and cocktails before I got my order. I came here for a quick taco fix but all I got was slow service and very average food :( Lowkey sad and offended lol. Don't come here if you're gonna order to-go!

JetBlue has transferred their credit card services from American Express to Barclays Bank.  Barclays bank has a substandard online credit card interface that must have been created at the start of the internet.  Currently they are having website difficulties that does not allow the presentation of current charges.  Their website does not allow the direct download of any transactions to QuickBooks or other software.  You can download information after the monthly statement is prepared if you make a request in their website for the date to be prepared, wait and hour and then download it.  Really 21st Century.

Keep your paperwork. Terrible customer service. Booked and picked up the rental in Knoxville to return/fly out from Nashville the next day. Cost was to be $56.14, but when I returned it they charged me $112. I took it to the service desk, where the representative was rude and unhelpful, speaking to me like I was in the wrong. I showed my paperwork detailing the original price, and he gave me a new bill with that amount telling me my card would be credited for the difference. Will not use this rental company ever again.

Though a bit of a walk to the beachfront, the location is good.  If you want to be closer to the beachfront I'd recommend you pick a hotel closer to Pier 60.  The rooms are small and outdated.  Pool area is small but nice. Pool attendant (Matthew) could use some customer service skills.  Overall the staff is good, but for the price I would expect that staff to be better prepared to serve their guests. Without the location, this would be a 2-3 star hotel.  In my opinion, there are much better options for the price.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
We arrived knowing that we booked with a travel agent. When we got here they couldn't find our names at all. We had 3 rooms total and one was supposed to be a suite but they were sold out. When we check in and we're dealing with our mess there was a handful of people upset there room wasn't ready, they do offer to store your luggage but it can hard if you have kids or no car. Free parking, rooms were very nice, love the tall mirrors and bathroom/sink areas for getting ready. 
We brought our own chairs for the beach, snacks, alcohol in a small cooler for the beach and they never said anything. All was in all it was okay ..
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is a cozy hotel but they needs to step it up with the housekeeping staff. I thought that I got an ok deal on this Microtel. However, when I put the toilet seat down in my suits restroom and found A LOT OF DRIED URINE and the sink had schmutz all over it, I didn't need to have a trained eye to know I paid to much money for my room. Although the front desk staff was friendly and cleaned it for me, I was a little surprised that the manager who was present when I personally went up front and requested a reclean, did not apologize.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Rented 3 months ahead of time. 
Got a good price for the week. Only $228.00.mid size car.
Then at pick up I got surprised again...airport fees of over $100.00.
 But I said ..you got me I am traveling. 
Then I got he final bill, another $100. of junk fees, additional driver fees more airport fees and fuel surcharge. If possible... be aware of this dilemma, they cheat the consumer wherever possible.
 I was induced by the low price and I have learned not to trust Dollar Rental. Good Luck in your travels.  Car rental $228.00 and junk fees over $200.00 be prepared.

I stayed here for a business trip, if I had to pay for this place out of my own pocket I would have been upset. Room was dirty! Hair from previous travelers in the drawers and coffee stains on the wall. My room was not locked when I got there, nor was it locked one day when I returned after cleaning staff had entered. 
Do you like a cup of coffee when you wake up? No luck at this hotel. No coffee machines in the room. 
Rooms are tiny and awkward. Just trying to get through the front door with ones luggage was a task in itself. 
Save yourself the frustration and stay somewhere else.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My mother and I had a fantastic experience at this restaurant. Although hard to spot from the street, it is one of Lansdale's true gems. The atmosphere is quaint and comfortable, and the owner was incredibly kind to my mother and myself. All of the food is homemade - this certainly isn't your average Olive Garden. While I found that the prices were a bit higher than what I would expect for Lansdale, the quality of the food and the service were absolutely phenomenal. I will be returning with family, friends, and telling my future dates that this is a great spot to treat me to dinner! ;)

I read reviews about Best NY Pizza and I must say that I certainly did not have the same experience like most people. I found the garlic knots very greasy and it left an unpleasing aftertaste in my mouth. 

I ordered a small cheese pie and once I opened the box, it reminded me of the Pizza Hut Restaurant style. Thought to myself that this better taste awesome bc it doesn't look like the best NY pizza and I've had many in my days. 

They should not call themselves Best NY Pizza bc NY pizza does not taste so bland. The pizza was mediocre and not much flavor. I was very disappointed. I  wasted my money but lesson learned.

They ripped me a new one when I wanted the ins to cover the car it cost over $30 a day and when I reserved my vehicle there was nothing in the web site to tell me I had a option to get ins or not and on top of that I used a debit card which you can run either way and the company had to run a credit check, there was nothing saying anything about that on their site , it's a debit card it comes right out of your account, really people get a clue and on top of it the car wasn't clean looked like they just got it back and stuck it back in operation. Never again

Will never stay here again due to an unfortunate event. My vehicle was parked on drive at hotel that was apparently valet only and was not informed of that until arriving. When valet moved the car one of my wheels was damaged. The valet company refuses to accept liability for the damage therefore causing me to repair the vehicle out of my own pocket. Even after informing the valet company that upon arriving the wheels and tires were brand new on the vehicle. Again terrible valet company who does not take care of your vehicle. While I love hotel indigo, I can not stay somewhere that does not offer good care for my vehicle.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Definitely my new favorite when I visit from NC. Such a great experience. Our server Ms Tracy was awesome and the food was amazing. We had side salad, meatball appetizer, lasagna, chicken parmesan,  and cheese gnocchi. First of all, the food is ALL super fresh. My little simple side salad was LIFE!  I have never eaten gnocchi, but Scalessa's cheese gnocchi made my entire day! Soooo light, flavorful, and pillowy! OH YEAH, let's not forget to mention we paid $37 for an appetizer and two entrees and the portions were HUGE! My leftovers will surely make for two more meals. Definitely a 5 stars! We'll surely be back!

I got my gel dip removed, a pedicure and my eyebrows waxed.  The lady literally took off the end of my eyebrow after I said that I just wanted them cleaned up and nothing major.  My friends could easily see that they were uneven and on top of that I still had some stray hairs that I had to tweeze.  Both my manicure and pedicure chipped within 3 days.  My pedicures never chip.  Also they didn't have any social distancing in place.  The seats were close together and no barriers in place.  The whole experience was super disappointing.

It's been awhile since I have written a review, but... my friends and I as first time customers were just kicked out. Apparently there is a un mentioned no bag policy. We had immediate plans to visit this bar after the Independence Day Fireworks show. My bag was inspected by the fireworks inspection and ran through metal detector. 

The floor manager inspected my bag and said I was ok. One minute later I was told the manager mandated that my friends and I to leave. We had to go the front and finish the beer that was just placed in front of us, no refund. Friends don't bother with this place.

I never post anything on Yelp but use it all the time to look for recommendations. I live in downtown Nashville but work in Smyrna.  I use to have a good go to place for my bourbon fix but that has changed since the first time I went into Legacy Wine & Spirits. I was amazed with the whiskey and bourbon selection they had.  The night shift team was very helpful and had all the answers to my questions. I personally told them this will be my store for business for now on.  It was great having people that love talking bourbons and whiskey, when you have a crazy day at work.

I have been a long time customer at this nail salon but sadly today I've had the worst experience. 

I went in for a gel manicure and my nails turned out horrible. It was the older man (I think the owner) who did them. When he was taking my old gel polish off he used his own finger nail to scrape mine off! He kept dosing off while doing my nails and even skipped a few nails when doing the base coat. He kept coughing and sneezing then continuing to touch my hands after. 

He should not be doing anyone's nails. My nails turned out un even, chunky and polish on my skin.

Pima Federal has the absolute worst online banking system. I am perpetually locked out of my accounts and have to call them to unlock my account on a regular basis. Unfortunately, they only have people answering the phones during banking hours. Locked out on a Friday afternoon? Eh, who needs to access their bank account on the weekend?

I wish I would have researched this more before selecting a credit union. It didn't occur to me how awful this problem would make my experience banking with Pima Federal. 

I haven't had any negative experiences in a branch. The tellers are always helpful and friendly.

Upon check in, the front desk lady was nice and courteous. We checked in the hotel past 9:30pm.Our room had 2 roaches, the bathroom smelled like urine like it was a public restroom and one of the towels was dirty. Notified the front desk at 630am and filed a complaint. Upon check out, complaint was not handled the way I had expected. I guess the front desk clerk didn't know how to handle it. Whatever. 
Complimentary breakfast was good- my kids loved it.
Overall experience was ok. It could be better though. Not worth the price for the room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Fantastic experience here today. My parents have been going here for a few years now and I can see why - awesome customer service and great prices. They value their customers and that is reflected in the service they provide. I got a great package on glasses for a price that is lower than most of the frames alone. The customer service was excellent as well - I am leaving town in a few days, so they made sure to expedite my purchase and I got the glasses in 20 minutes!! I'll definitely be going back in the future.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This place is great, and the vibes are wonderful. I recently took out my locs myself that I had for over 20 years. Afterwards, I was left with a tangled, matted mess. I can't remember the name of the sister who did my hair, but she was WONDERFUL and extremely meticulous with my hair. By the time she was done, my hair was soft, completely detangled, trimmed, and awesome looking for days and days. This in itself was a miracle because I've never seen anyone with hair thicker than mine! I highly recommend this salon. Also, the hair oils they sell smell amazing.

This place saved me. Had a tire blow out late night and had my car towed to Thomas at Kwik Kar. They are who I have been using for the basics since I've moved to nashville. I didn't realize they didn't specialize in tires but they helped me out anyway! They removed my tire, helped me find a place near by with a tire and allowed me to bring my tire to them, get a new tire on and then put my tire back on for me. It is so helpful to have a local shop who cares about their customers and not making a dollar. I'll continue to give my business to Kwik Kar!!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: Just had a great experience at Alamo.  First the guy driving the shuttle, friendly, polite,  lifted my bags in and out of the van and i'm neither old nor hot.  Then the girl behind the counter was super friendly and helpful.  There was a glitch with her computer so she came out from behind the counter to do the kiosk for me (didn't just point and tell me to do it!)  Even the woman outside getting the car was friendly and helpful and put my bag in the car for me.  And did I mention it was literally 98 degrees outside?  Got my reservation on hot-wire, and sometimes places treat you like crap when they know you got it cheap.

I purposely drive out of the way just to have their trash wings. I was in Denver yesterday, drove into Kansas City last night just so I could take the long way around St. Louis today to have their trash wings. Bar is small, seat yourself, but you will get a waitress. The first time I came was when the St.louis Blues were in the Stanley Cup. Even with a crowd I had excellent service. Inside seating not your forte, they have a decent outside patio that is covered. I have had other items off the menu other than trash wings, never had anything that wasn't good but if you come, experience the trash wings.

If your looking for donuts.....don't go here!  I have been to this place numerous times, and never had a good experience. They NEVER have donuts! Once, I went at 7:15 a.m. to get donuts for work. They didn't have 3 dozen in the store.  Today, I went in at around 9:15, and stood at the counter for 8 minutes. No one else in the place. The employee continued to serve the drive through line the whole time.  By the way, they had 23 donuts left, and she had no idea when they would have more. Save some time, and go to Tastee on Loyola. They are WAY better.

We came here for a family w/ kids vacation and stayed for 4 nights. 
Pros:
-Nice and New hotel
-high ceilings 
-basic rooms feel big
-Amazing food in the bar and restaurant 
-Good service 
-comfortable beds medium firm
-microwaves and refrigerators are free
-central location
-clean
-price
Cons:
-small parking spots
-pillows are super soft
-no baths
-nothing super close by we were in our car the whole trip
-cold pool no jacuzzi
-no where for kids to play has more of a business vibe

We loved it. I prolly wouldn't stay here again because I would want more of a kid friendly place but it is a super nice hotel I would recommend it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
I would highly recommend this car wash.  The only other options in the area are a full service down the street and Champion on Charlotte.  I don't care for Champion because I always feel like I'm going to get in an accident and my car doesn't come out clean.  The full service takes forever and is expensive.  

All the employees and the owner at Suds Up have always been smiling and very friendly.  It takes 3 minutes to get in and out, and my car is always clean.

Also, look for sales on their unlimited monthly plans.

If I could give CARS a 0 for a review I would. I went in for my windows not working, they told me it was a wire issue and took 6 days to "hunt down the problem". I was told to expect a bill of around $150, on day 6 they call me and tell me the car will be ready that evening. I get a call around 4pm saying my car was ready and it would be $500. When I tried to get the rationale for the price being tripled to our previous conversation, both Bonnie and Michelle were incredibly rude. At one point one of them hung up on me because I did not agree with the prices. HORRIBLE customer service, DO NOT waste your time or money with this company.

I had the small almond cranberry salad and it was super good, the dressing was tangy and the feta cheese very creamy and the chicken was grilled and flavorful. I'm a picky eater about chicken, but this was awesome! They also packed a ton into the small salad so it's enough without being too small! This order was takeout and I was getting soda in cans for someone and accidentally dropped one and the guy at the register let me get another one even though I offered to pay, and that was very cool of him to do that. I highly recommend this place!

Pasta was good, wines were just ok even the reserve wine pairing, which were considerably more expensive, just ok. One of the reserve wines actually tasted like it was past its prime and we asked if we can have a substitution and was told no. We opted for the shaved truffles which was extra but when they were shaved onto the food the truffle stuck to the bottom of the shaver and ended up on the floor when the shaver walked away. The rib eye entree was inconsistent, my piece had fat and gristle but my husbands was perfect. The chocolate cake at the finish was wonderful I have to admit. Wanted to try it but won't be returning.

I'll never stay at Club Quarters again.

My flight into Philly was canceled at about 7 PM on Monday evening.  I called and canceled as soon as I found out. I stayed there the next two nights. They charged me for three. They refused to refund the night my flight was canceled. Moreover, when I called Anthony, the manager, he wouldn't return my phone calls. I had to return physically to the hotel to find him and talk to him. 

I travel at least 40 weeks out of the year. I usually stay at Marriott's. I've never had a hotel charge me for a night when my flight was canceled.
 
Would not recommend staying here.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: My husband and I went here for our anniversary dinner. We called ahead and made reservations for 7:30pm. We got there and ended up waiting for over 10 mins without anyone up front to great us. When the lady finally came she acted annoyed that we were there. Our server was friendly however. The food is way over priced for what you get and did not taste good at all. I could cook it better at home. The place looked pretty and romantic but that was about it as far as the restaurant went. I do not recommend this place at all.

A pleasant surprise! After being stranded in Philly with no flights available until the next day, I booked a room at the Courtyard. I wasn't expecting much...I was tired, hungry and anxious to get home. The staff at the Courtyard were friendly and helpful. I ordered the Pan-Seared Salmon from the Bistro onsite, and to my surprise it was quite tasty. The salmon was cooked to the perfect temperature and the olives gave it a Mediterranean flavor. I was most impressed with the staff at the Bistro. My waiter and bartender went above and beyond! This really is the city of brotherly love!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I loved the service and highly recommend Enterprise for their hospitality and unbelievable attentiveness to their clients needs-however, the car I was given had a huge NO SMOKING sign in the car and when I opened the trunk the car smelled like an ashtray.
I was in a hurry to get to my destination-so I didn't want to switch cars thinking I could open windows to get the smell out, but it was fumigated with cigarette smoke and wouldn't go away.
They were generous in compensating me, but the experience could have been more positive-had they taken the time to alleviate the problem prior to my taking the car.

Great food, always been great service. Been going there for years. But then y'know one day I ordered some more food to go. The lady took my order, and I sat there patiently at one of the tables while my family left to go sit in the car to wait for me. 20 minutes later she still never looked up and told me my to go food was ready. My dad ended up storming in and asking her if it was ready, she promptly handed it over. I would excuse it, but she looked up at me multiple times and made eye contact while I sat there doing nothing. We try not to come in as often, but on occasion we break down. . . it was our only Chinese place after all.

Would you like to come somewhere that feels safe as a woman? A place where even if there are just the female bartenders there, they won't mess with your drinks? 

Well, don't come here then.

I travel frequently by myself and when I go to a bar alone I hope I can feel safe regardless of if I am alone or what I order.

Here if you leave your beer for a second, regardless of the thoughtful conversations you had with them previously, they switch your beer out with water, think it's funny then offer a free drink to you as penance. Honestly, charge me more money just to feel safe.

Pro: Great tea and coffee selection.
Con: I am a frequent customer of La Colombe and go to most locations in the city. While the layout of this location is clearly the best, today, while sitting in one of the corner locations with my boyfriend. A mouse ran over his foot. A mouse. We went up to the sales person to let her know and she responded with "I'm not really sure what to do in this situation" and proceeded to go about her duties. No apology. La Colombe typically has excellent service so I was very surprised that this situation happened.

The absolute worst management I have ever encountered!The head manager actually hung up on me when I called to make a complaint about roaches infesting the apartment.  Now I have called several times in the past three days to have nobody answer the phone so I leave a message with the answering service to stating the problem I am having to have nobody call me back. Meanwhile I am forced to live in a apartment with  my wife that is infested with roaches. They are breaking the rental agreement signed when I moved in stating that they will provide a livable housing environment.

Last night, I wanted to go out to McDonald's with a few of my friends. We went there at 8p.m. and when we tried to open the doors to the fast-food place; the doors were locked. There were already a few people waiting outside, we ALL knocked on the door, but NO employees EVEN ac​knowl​edge that we were outside. There were people already inside eating and when one of them tried to open up to let us in, the door was locked as well. When an employee FINALLY opened the door, she said that they were "cleaning". Need I remind people that they were "cleaning" at 8pm but this McDonald's DOES NOT close until 11pm.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
We arrived at opening time with a party of 6 and were seated promptly. After ordering, it took us almost an hour to receive our sushi. We only received the apps we ordered during this time. 

Once we started eating, we noticed how much rice they packed into the rolls. The texture of the rice itself was also so chewy. Honestly, we weren't impressed. It wasn't high quality or anything, but on top of the poor service, it made our experience pretty disappointing. 

Just keep in mind when you order the sushi that they put soooo much rice in there. I likely won't be coming back.

So anytime I go in there, I was get the worst service. Like I'm pretty laid back with any restaurant, definitely fast food because I've been there but today was the last straw. They always fuck up my order one way or another and when I ask them to fix it they just give me a death glare. Or they leave my food to get cold on the counter while they help someone else. The manager wouldn't give his name when I called today but he was rude and lied to my face. I don't even like leaving this review because it's a subway, you're not expecting great customer service but come on now!

Not bad at all! We're in town from Orlando visiting family for Christmas and my boyfriend suggested we go. We don't do chains so we decided to try it out. We didn't sit at the hibachi but we did order the steak and chicken hibachi lunch special. We ordered our steak medium. Everything was pretty tasty! We were both pleasantly surprised. The lunch special comes with a chicken broth "soup" that I wasn't too enthused about but the ginger salad dressing they use is pretty good. If you're looking for a hibachi joint and one of the few non-chain places in town, I recommend it!

What a gem of a place in Harahan/River Ridge. We had such an enjoyable evening during Jazz Fest that I thought I'd give them my business again tonight. I live in Florida but my local friend had just had surgery and I thought I'd send her some deliciousness from Oak Oven I DO NOT suggest ordering from Uber Eats In fact, after tonight, I may cancel my Uber account!! Michael took the reigns and made the delivery happen. What awesome customer service I already knew they had terrific food, but add this level of customer service and I won't go anywhere else. Enjoy!!

Gym is okay!!  7 out of 10 here have chicken legs cuz they really don't have anything good for legs.  Rest of equipment is mediocre at best.  Definitely worth the $10 a month but not a dime more.  Likely looking for an upgrade in the next few months.  Tired of same ole same ole.

And whoever hires the girls for the front desk, try getting people who give a shit and have a personality.  The one blonde with the green eyes who thinks she's all that just sits there twirling her hair staring off into space....and she's getting PAID???  Tried talking to her this morning, just got the "duh" look and the eye roll.  Good luck in life Sugar!!
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: After having an unusual situation take place with my rental, I called to speak with the corporate office immediately after dropping off my car and I was put on hold for nearly a half hour which initially kind of turned me off. It wasn't until I got to the location that I was able to get anything accomplished.  Kiki helped me and she was so kind, attentive and my experience with her totally redeemed the annoyance of having to drive back in traffic just to speak with someone face to face. She's awesome, thanks for your help Kiki !

I was not impressed with this hotel at all !  If I could give less than 1 star I would. The front desk clerk was not friendly  and everything I handed her (ID, Credit Card) was not handed back to me but rudely slammed down on the counter for me to pickup.  I felt insulted and not appreciated as a guest.  How could management allow this lady to work with the public? The room was even less impressive outdated furniture, visibly patched 70's style carpet, dirty lamp shade, small bathroom, tiny bath soap.  I could barely close the bathroom door without hitting the toilet.  I cannot recommend this hotel to anyone and I will not be returning again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Chair had an unknown stain on the seat, table was broken , and no wifi in the rooms.  You get free wifi in lobby area if you are a guest but you have to authenticate every half hour which is annoying even then there is no indication you won't be charged.  Its 2012... wifi in the room should be an option. The bar prices are okay for a hotel but the food price is too high.  If you are stuck here with no mode of transport catch the shuttle to the airport then take the train down town or call a cab.  It would be cheaper than a meal at the bar.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
On Father's Day, my family and I were looking for a nice sushi restaurant that has quiet and spacious ambience. I remembered that I had a wonderful experience with my friend who took me there last time, so I took my family there. 

The service was very good. The waitress was very attentitive and cordial. They give hot towels to clean the hands!

We ordered hardcore sushi plate, crazy roll, Japanese steak, and individual sushi (mackerel, squid, fluke). They were all delicious.  The rice was perfectly seasoned and the steak sauce was not to sweet or salty.

I highly recommend the place and will return.

Michael was *awesome* dropping off my latest rental due to some guy totaling my van right before the COVID-19 stay at home orders. 

Dealing with the other guy's insurance has been an absolute nightmare (stay away from MAPFRE/AIC) - they've "extended" the rental after it expired (necessitating a new reservation), then "canceled" the new rental around close of business yesterday, 4 days before the rental expired. 

Now my insurance is taking over, and has issued a new reservation. Enterprise on Fairview (and in the admin office) has just been really accommodating and wonderful throughout it all. Great people, great service!

This is one of the worst experiences I have had with a Chinese restaurant , I orders through SkipTheDishes and the driver arrived earlier than we expected so we didn't hear him arrive at the door , we call him back to deliver the food and he's being extremely rude to us and dropping the F bomb on us while we're on the phone , I call the restaurant and they totally disregard the fact that their  driver was being rude to us and the lady on the phone is talking over me the entire time . The delivery guy comes and he's still being extremely rude to us and still putting up a fight .

Great pizza at a good price ... can't ask for much more. 
The parking lot is tiny, as is the dining room of the restaurant ... but the staff are friendly and the atmosphere is nice and casual. 
I've found that on average their pizzas take a little longer to be delivered then they estimate but what's another 5-10min when you're already waiting 45, right. 
Their classic cheese pizza is awesome as are their Margharita, Tarpon Greek and Chicken Florintine specialty pizzas. 
Definitely my favorite pizza in the Tarpon Springs area!

Went to this store today and asked if the afternoon happy hour promotion was still ongoing. After the cashier stared at me blankly for a good minute, I added, you know the promotion where medium drinks are $2? He replied, "No, no sales. Everything is full price." Whats wrong with the employees????? Noone seems to know what's going on! I left, went on the website and the promotion is ongoing until 3/3! I previously went to another store on Washington as well and that cashier wasnt able to tell me the flavors of ice tea. Both places missed out on my business. Poor service all around. I'll stick with Starbucks.

Sadly...ever since their remodel last summer...the drive through is insanely slow and the employees there today were not very friendly either. I have been going there less and less because i have spent over 10 minutes waiting...when there has only been one car ahead of me. It is the most convenient dd around but the long wait is out of control. There were 3 cars ahead of me today...the one in front of me only got one beverage and when i slowly got to the window there were 4 people standing around and they were just starting my latte.  The old system and old employees were much more efficient sadly. I hope it improves.

HORRIBLE HORRIBLE BAR!!! Have had a few encounters at this bar and let's just say I will never recommend this place to anyone or step foot in there again.. the dark hair male bartender with missing teeth is outrageously rude for absolutely no reason at all.. we were practically screamed at upon entry and it only went downhill from there, super unwelcoming from the minute we stepped foot in, the last place I would wanna spend my money! and not to mention my friend was called a racial slur by the bartender on our way out , horrible establishment , not sure how it is in business

I have been a customer of vantage west for a few years now. I have an auto loan through them and do some banking. Today I went to make a large deposit. Im in real estate and money doesn't come in consistently. My mortgage payment is due today and I was thankful the sale was closing and the funds would be released today to cover the mortgage payment on time - however - vantage west decides to put a hold on the funds until Feb. 27th. Awful Awful credit union. Horrible customer service not to mention the branch on 32nd street and shea is a total dump.

Super disappointed. I love sushi and I love hibachi. I ordered shrimp hibachi Spicy and there wasn't any added spice. The sauce it came in was so over powering it ruined the taste of the food. The veggies were cold. I also ordered the shaggy dog roll and a salmon roll. The shaggy roll had a good spice to it but was mostly rice. The salmon roll had a weird secondary taste which made me stop eating all together. It's only raw salmon and rice so there shouldn't be another flavor when eating this. I had my friend try it as well(he also couldn't get past the taste and his hibachi shrimp was in the same condition). Won't be coming back.

Best Neapolitan Pizza ever. Before you jump to conclusions make sure you understand what Neapolitan pizza is, it is def not your regular pizza and this place makes it is exactly how it is supposed to be, very traditional. The flavor combinations of every single pizza are delicious, and I crave it every day. The pizzas are personal sized, salads are good to share and the desserts are amazing, we're talking home made gelato flavors that change weekly, dessert calzone with nutella and marshmellows and perfect individual sized cannoi's. The food is fresh and simple just like the decor. BYOB. Seating is easy to grab, first come first serve.

Stayed for a long weekend a few weeks ago and overall had great service. As I travel a lot for work using only Hilton brand hotels, I was looking forward to a staycation at the Conrad. Overall, was an amazing experience. However, after going to a concert, all of my room keys did not work. The staff at the front desk was extremely helpful, but could not print out new keys. When the manager (20 minutes later), came to let us back into our room, he asked repeatedly if I was sure I was staying here and if I had the correct room. Next time this happens to a customer, I hope management treats the customer as well as their staff.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have to share an amazing experience I just had at this car wash.  I am astonished at how clean my vehicle is.  The time they took to ensure it was perfect alone is enough to share- however- in addition I have over ten dollars in my middle console that I forgot about and remembered after I got the vehicle back... But also they found my missing name brand sunglasses and left them on the seat for me. Of course they didn't know they were missing.  Yes.. the tip was increased when I saw that level of honesty. I hope you pay this car wash a visit sometime soon too.

I'm new to yelp so I've already added a photo to the main page for Regis at Park Place and can't remove it, thought I left a review but it was a tip...which due to error was unable to post lol.  So lucky you; now you get the condensed version:  not becoming a regular and if I ever want a late haircut again I will try someone besides Savannah.  

P.S.  advertised price for men's cut $23.00 my price $27.00 explanation: she has been there long enough she sets her prices.  Moral to story if you go try a new hire then maybe it'll be less than advertised : p

Stayed her overnight traveling back from Orlando. The gentleman working the front desk was very friendly, and even found my Hilton honors account. Our family found the room to be very clean and family friendly. There was a microwave and fridge in the room. There were multiple outlets available to charge our electronics. The bathroom was updated, very clean, and had plenty of towels. 
In the morning we enjoyed the complimentary breakfast, that offered a variety of choices. We would definitely stay at this hotel again during our travels!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
After a long day of travel from OKC, we stopped here in St. Charles.  Hotel is gorgeous however a number of minor problems keeps this rating down.

Problems included: mattresses that need replacement, pillows with NO support, pealing paint on the ceiling of the shower, slow and aging elevator.

The building itself is grand.  The lobby area is beautiful. The halls are clean and huge!  Check-in was quick and flawless.  Staff is friendly.  

Would I return? Yes, hopefully with a more comfortable room.
Would I recommend saying here? Yes, with caution...don't have high hopes!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Not impressed. Got the $30 wash and I had to ask the "finisher" to clean the wheels, tailgate, and side steps 3 times. I suggested to the girl at the desk that she have some supervision out in the drying area and she just walked out and made the comment to me that sometimes they need to run the cars through a second time. After that, the guy had an attitude with me. I handed him a tip and tried to explain that people need to see a value when they have a service performed. It was obvious that he didn't care. I try to support small business, but in this situation, I'm not sure can do that with this establishment again.

I don't review often.. But they deserve it..

I've been eating here for a year, sometimes as many as four times a week.

The pizza is the best I've had in Florida. 

The salads are literally perfect. 

The sandwiches are huge and better than any stand alone sub shop. 

The pasta dishes are worthy of a last meal request. 

The restaurant is clean, and the employees are always very freindly and know you by name after just a couple of visits. 

In all those meals, I've not once had a bad one. 


Thank you Plum Tomato!

I'm really shocked by the positive reviews here. It's not necessarily that it's dirty, or even that it's just an older hotel; it's just not well-maintained at all. It's really run-down, a bit dumpy (rusted tissue box, rusted shower rod, peeling wood, shaky sink). Yes, the decor is crazy and outdated, but mostly it just feels a little sad inside. Too many other good hotel options nearby. (Google for some reason had this listed as a 4-star hotel. That's an error. It's probably a 2-star based on comparable hotels.)
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My partner and I had a fantastic two-day stay here! The room was cozy and pleasant, the bed was comfortable, and the view was excellent. Two particular staff members stand out; Annette and Milton. Annette answered our room charge questions when I was panicked at 1 in the morning, and explained them to great clarity. When the next day, we had to change rooms (due to a sudden need for a second stay), Milton found a way to allow us to keep the room we had instead of having to check out and in again. We were very grateful for all the assistance, and would absolutely stay here again!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The only reason for the 3 stars is because of the food. Although the sashimi isn't always fresh, for the price, it is worth it. The service is terrible here. I have been here both on weekdays and weekends. Always get the one rude waitress who seems like she rolls her eyes as she walks away if you ask for anything. On one occasion, being the only table there, we heard her complain about how much we ordered. They are very slow and often take their time to see if you forget what you asked for. If you can deal with the terrible service that comes with it, its worth the price to come here and eat all the sushi/sashimi you want.

I am a Hilton Diamond member and asked for upgrades at check-in. I was offered a "one-tier" upgrade to a Superior room, which is exactly the same room on a higher floor. The hotel is dead empty, suites were still available and I arrived at 8PM. Come on, why not make a loyal customer happy? And then the only option to use the Diamond F&B credit is in-room dining with all the mandatory charges that come with it. You cannot use it at Capital Grille although they serve breakfast for hotel guests. If you are expecting any loyalty benefits, book elsewhere. The brand new Bottleworks hotel looks amazing.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I came in for a manicure with gel on my nails already which needed to be soaked off. Instead of soaking, Bonnie began using her own nails and also one of those acrylic tips (which she didn't throw out after) to try to just scrape off the gel which honestly hurt. I said "maybe it will be easier if it's soaked first." Once I suggested this, she began using an electric filer which was much better. That being said, the rest of the manicure was great and it was done by a different nail tech. She was very detailed and my nails look amazing!!

My daughter said the Chicken Fried rice was the best she'd ever had and both my boys enjoyed their sushi (Classic Tuna Roll with an up charge for Fatty Tuna, Wave Rolls & Volcano Roll). We arrived before 6 pm and even though there were several open tables, we were asked to take a seat up front. After a short wait we were seated, and ordered 4 appetizers in addition to the Fried rice and 4 sushi rolls.  We were told at 6:36 when we received our ticket that we would not receive the Happy Hour discount on appetizers that ends at 6 pm as "it starts when I got your drinks" and that was 34 minutes ago (or 6:02). Hmmm.

Made a 5pm reservation for my family. We were 30 minutes late because of the snow. Besides one family and the staff, the restaurant was empty. Yet, the staff gave us attitude about being late, and told us we would have to leave promptly by 7pm. This kind of behavior is unacceptable, especially for an empty restaurant. The people who walked in after us got no such spiel for having to rush out before 7. Only us. When we asked why, we we were simply given the option to leave. My family was cordial, this staff could not have been ruder. Maybe you'll have better luck here if you're not an immigrant.

Ouch. Glad I'm not the only one to have experienced this place on the bad side. We ordered from them based on the fact that they deliver. I'm just going to focus on the Mongolian Beef. There was...no beef. I literally counted like 5 pieces in the carton. And then it was the same grade as you'd get at a Mongolian BBQ. The bamboo shoots were tough, like recycled asphalt shingles marinated in MSG. The fried rice and chow mein were passable, barely. Order from them if you must, but buyer beware, the food is just not very good.

I went there with my family to celebrate my birthday. It is a nice cozy restaurant on the corner with nice large windows. There were five of us dining and we all ordered different dishes. Everyone enjoyed the food especially the chicken parm, seafood pasta and fish of the day. We had a lot of laughs with the staff and felt very comfortable there. It is BYOB which was not a problem. They had an ice bucket to chill the wine and we brought our own small cooler of beer. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a nice evening out.

First of all, if this review were for Hayward only, it'd be 6 stars, 4 thumbs up, and $175.  Hayward welcomed us and bid us goodbye - he is awesome.

As for the non-Hayward aspects of the hotel: there were 2 dirty glasses left outside the room next to ours for 48 hours, our room was turned over with no towels once, and there was a peculiar scurrying noise in the ceiling above our room.  We will never know.  The drinks in the bar are good, the food in the bar is good (jambaella is 5/10, chicken sandwich is 8/10, and red fish is 10/10), and Hayward is awesome.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Very nice and clean. Stayed on the top floor (3rd), room had a mini fridge and microwave. The thinness of the walls were not a problem for my mid week stay. 

I took a star away because they only have one luggage cart for the whole place. And of course when I needed it to check in someone was hoarding it in their room until check out. 

The continental breakfast was a good start to the day before heading over to Weeki wachee springs. 
For dinner there's an Outback Steakhouse in front of the hotel or a Golden Corral .5 mile doe the road. 

I would definitely stay  at microtel again
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place wasn't too bad overall. I think we got lucky by catching a shuttle right away when we got to the level of the ramp that the pick-up area is on. It was a little difficult to find but the person on the phone was helpful when it came to finding it. The person at the counter instantly tried getting us into a more expensive car even though we had already reserved a smaller more affordable car that suited our needs. He was nice, but seemed like he was trying to get us to spend more money, which I think all car rental businesses do to a certain extent. Overall, a pretty fast and good experience.

Frank De Roma jr is a true gentleman.
He didn't know me from Adam
He was so kind and nice he gladly gave me his recipe for muscles and red sauce. He took his time and wanted to make sure I could do it right. 
That was totally a selfless act and showed a lot of character
Every time I come back to Philly from Arizona I make sure to go to Villa De roma 
For a nice dinner out in south Philly
Their food is authentic, delicious, consistent and they make you feel like you're at their home when you're in the restaurant .
I highly recommend this establishment you'll have an awesome meal and a great time

My mom had a credit card through Barclays. When she passed away, we tried to cancel it. At first they told us we could not do that. Then they told us that it was cancelled and there was a zero balance, but then they took money out of her debit account at another bank. I made 13 different phone calls over the course of several weeks trying to resolve this including with the president's office, with no resolution whatsoever! They would not even reveal what the $200+ charge was for. This is the worst credit card company I've ever had the experience of dealing with. I would never ever get a credit card with them! They are unethical!

Stayed for one night after evening car trouble while traveling had us stranded in SB. We were fortunate enough to get their last room, which they kindly held for us for 20 minutes until we could make our way there. For some reason everything in the area was sold out (other than the Bacara for $575--not in the budget!). I have not stayed at a Best Western in years but was relieved to find it much nicer than expected. It had a very modern decor, was comfortable, and most importantly, CLEAN. The front desk staff was warm and friendly, which was really appreciated after what ended up being a very stressful day of traveling.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I was a barista at one of the Tucson coffee shops with a cult following, so usually Starbucks is just average for me. But this Starbucks truly breaks the mold. They're incredible! One of the baristas is such a ham and really made my day. I don't know his name... Tall with curly hair. Even now as I write this review he is checking in with his regulars about their kids and weekend golf games. The other baristas are also very kind. And my drink is delicious and at a perfect 140 degrees (not my request, I'm not one of those customers). I just moved to a condo near this Starbucks and I'll will definitely be adding this one to my weekly routine.

I reserved an intermediate car and was provided an standard vehicle with break issues.
My destination was over 2 hrs away from the airport location and over halfway through my drive the car started to have break issues. Long story short and no success on getting a new car or assistance from other locations in the area or roadside assistance, to get me back to the airport to make my flight I drove back to the airport location with my fingers crossed. As I checked the car in and told them of my issue, it was a sorry to hear that apology with a business card that said free upgrade to your next car rental.

SERVICE - Friendly staff who offered us to sample some flavors :)

AMBIENCE/DECOR - Chillax. The place is quite spacious and can use some more decorations! Feels a bit empty, especially on the walls. (or maybe because it was literally empty when we got there...)

FOOD - Out of the 3 that I tried my favorite was probably [TARO], which had the richest flavor. [ORANGE CREAM] was pretty good but I'm not a fan of orange-flavored anything. [CHARCOAL VANILLA] looked cool but i couldn't taste anything?! All of them had very creamy texture.

Not really impressed by the flavor selection during our visit. Nothing special that stood out to me.

The place is ok. The beds are not very comfortable. You can hear your neighbors like they are in your room. We were in the room by the train tracks. The trains were much better than the neighbors. I did not hear the trains once I went to sleep and the train wasn't bad when I was awake. The train did shake our room once. You can only valet park. It is really convenient if you are going to the convention center. I only gave three stars mainly because of the parking. I would stay again, but wouldn't be first choice.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I tried to order a sandwich a certain way, a sausage McMuffin ADD folded egg, but the person on front headset entered it as a sausage egg McMuffin SUB folded egg. I worked at another McDonald's for 2 years and KNOW it is cheaper to do it the way I wanted, and I didn't want cheese because I am lactose intolerant, but she INSISTED to do it her way which, of course, ended up costing more. I had asked her 4 times to change it to how I wanted but she was very stubborn and refused. Very disappointed in the service provided by her.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Dirty and rundown. Not at all what you would usually expect from a Hilton property... There was mold growing on the walls and ceiling of the bathroom. The air conditioner made a clunking and rattling - when I looked in the vent to see if something was stuck, the AC unit was also full of mold growth. The headboard of the bed was cracking and splitting, carpet stained, and there was a gap between the door and the frame so large that you can see through it. What the heck is going on here?? This is not what you normally get with a DoubleTree. I wasn't brave enough to try the room service after seeing the state of the room....
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This restaurant is fabulous. It was perfect for date night, the table size was adequate so we didn't feel like our plates were touching on a two top. The service was attentive and fun with great menu recommendations. The food was spectacular, we tried the Brussel sprouts which had amazing flavor, the salmon tartar the duck and the salmon entrees. Everything had wonderful flavor, was arranged nicely on the plate and a perfect portion size. We topped it off with the truffle dessert . I would highly recommend this restaurant for a date night or anniversary celebration!

I couldn't give this salon less stars. I wish there was a negative option. I walked in today for the first time. I've never been there. I was greeted by a friendly women doing someone else's nails and told to sanitize my hands and pick a color. As I'm picking a color the man behind the counter says with serious attitude...we have appointments coming in we won't have time for you. Well...when I walked in he should've said we are currently only taking appointments...I would never suggest this salon again for how rude they were! I gladly went and spent my money somewhere else!

It was my first experience here and that said it was not a good one. I picked a restaurant on a Friday night and it gave way to staff that was either too busy or not really meant for the job. That said, food was ok at best. We had drinks and buying some of their main offerings indicates please try the wine. Appetizers look great on paper but the execution not so much. Octopus is ok but heavy on the smoke. Shrimp app seems made by an amateur. Want to try the bolognese, please go to Pinterest and make it at home. Sorry for the review guys but  this place is not meant for the future it is meant for the past.

I can't in good conscience recommend this location. 
1-The Site fails to indicate it is going through major renovations. Lobby and hallways are a construction site. 
2-We were sent to a room that had not been made.
3-You will hear the neighbors. Ours were loud.
4-Electrical in our room was not working properly.
5-Dust everywhere. We woke up in the morning to see our sheets full of black dust from the A/C unit. If you have family members sensitive to dust, your road trip will include a trip to the pharmacy.
The only saving grace is that staff is friendly.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
THEY SUCKED!!!!
I WAITED OVER 45 min. After I got someone I told
Them over 3 times I didn't want layers!
My friend wanted barely some layers she got her shit layered to the max
I didn't get no shampoo yet they charged me the same
Over all for one shampoo n 2 hair cuts one without layers they charged us $63!!! I literally get $15 haircut across the street from them. They are overpriced and the lady on  the front desk is a fucking rude ass bitch. I don't recommend to anyone. They are overpriced and rude and don't even do a good. They get one star cuz that's the lowest I can give. Hope they get closed down.

Paid a premium for the room, tv viewing was so dark, it was straining our eyes!!
First thing in the morning, I asked if they could look into it. Nicely they said yes, 10 hours later, I arrived to my room very tired. I found the tv no different. Had to follow up, called front desk and reminded them of the situation. They said they would send a tech down. He came, and said it was the cable. I called the front desk again, and mentioned what he had said. Front desk said they  could offer another room. What good would that be?????????
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Subway is always a good choice when you straped for time and want something nutricious and filling. They must have very good quality standards cause I have yet to come across one that really sucked. Price is my only issue. I'm pretty sure that the bread is re-heated from frozen and the rest of the ingredients are cheap enough to sell for a buck. I still have a problem with them pre cooking chicken and bacon and others only to be microwaved when you want the sandwich. Otherwise this particular location allows you to purchase items from the "Max" at their till.

I ordered my usual hot wings. I get home to eat them and they were so spicy that my lips were on fire. I figured maybe the put 911 sauce on them instead. I of course reached out for a refund. The wings are inedible.  I was told that this is the hot wing sauce. I've been coming to sopranos for over 10 years now and i order the same thing. The sauce is different and way to spicy. The also refused to give me a refund. I will not be going back here anymore. Customer service should be number one and if you are going to switch up things at least be prepared to offer refunds when customers don't like the sudden change in product

Came in today an hour before closing with my 18 month old. No sign on the door or anything, noting that they'd be closing early but several people were gathered in the back of the salon, potentially having a birthday party.
