I waited up front for about 5 minutes while my son grew increasingly agitated. Several people looked at me and quickly looked away, but no one acknowledged me. No one called "oh sorry, we closed early!" Just left me standing there with a crying child. Next time I need to drag a baby out in the cold for a haircut, I'll look elsewhere. I suggest you do the same.

I've been here multiple times. Product of my fiancé and her family living a few miles away. I don't take proximity for granted with sushi so this isn't a disaster but it's not a place you crave either. 

We order a decent assortment each time with sashimi and more complex rolls. The flavor profiles won't impress you when read aloud in the menu. Everything tastes like a solid C+ student offering. That's average right?  I tasted fishy rolls a few times although the sashimi shockingly wasn't. 

Listen, if you live close by and must sushi yourself, check in but otherwise maybe check out Nippon Tei.

I go to this Starbucks regularly since it opened to study. Wait times for drinks have gotten progressively longer. The interior of the store is freezing, I mean freezing!!! I wear long pants, long sleeve shirts and bring a sweatshirt and I'm still cold. I've asked them to turn the air conditioning temp up a little and said they couldn't because it is controlled by corporate. Don't know how true that is. I have had to leave many times because the Internet was ridiculously slow and could not support the live lectures I needed to view for my classes. Looking for a new place to study.

I called to place an order. A small pepperoni pizza with green peppers and opinion. The man on the phone asked if I needed anything else. I said please cook the peppers and onions before they put them in the oven. He said "NO." I asked "why?" he said "we don't do that." I replied, "yes you do. You do it every time I order. Monday happened to be the last time." The man then replied, "No take it or leave it." So I said, "I'll leave it." They are the rudest individual in service I've encountered thus far. It's bad enough the food isn't that great, much less to be met with an attitude. The nerve.

My girlfriend and I came in for dinner tonight, neither of us had been here before so we didn't really know what to expect. Magnifico! Sara took care of us and she was attentive and really friendly. We ordered a bottle of wine and Calabrese bruschette, which consisted of a creamy goat cheese, capers, sweet peppersand house made olive oil....amazing! For our main courses we ordered Tortellaci and veal piccata...omg we were absolutely blown away. Then there was dessert which was tiramisu which was the perfect balance of rich and creamy. We will definitely be back in the near future and appreciate the wonderful experience we had tonight.

I used to love this place but recently like others before me have said, management SUCKS, nowadays I wouldn't recommend anyone who wants to get a late night bite to even attempt this place, whoever closes now loves to do it early, and not just a slow Monday night.. it seems like for the past few months now anytime I go from 11:30-12:30 there's a chance that they're gonna be closed even though it says 1am online and all over the building itself. Long story short, don't waste your time with this place unless you're used to being disappointed, that is until they get there management under control, until then my review stands.

I do like the fact the motel is 4 miles from the french quarter but.... the tv didn't work the first night and the mini refrigerator had the knob taken off so even water bottles in the freezer section didn't get cold. I found 2 cockroaches crawling around the microwave and I did tell the front desk. The first morning no one came to the lobby until after 9 so no coffee. The wifi went out and it's been around 24 hours. If you want a convenient place to stay then it's ok and pet friendly but you get what you pay for. Staff was nice btw.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We moved from California to Ohio in February 2017 and stayed in La Quinta's all across the USA because they allow pups. This particular one, although they were under construction, went out of their way to make us feel comfortable, The room was clean and the bed comfortable. This past week we attended a convention in Indianapolis and decided to stay here again. The construction is completed and looks great. Again the room was clean and comfortable, reservations were easy to make, and the breakfast was great considering that it is trying to cater to the largest range of tastes as possible. I would recommend this to anyone.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I went to Stepping Stones to get a perm. Lisa was incredibly friendly and I appreciated that she didn't feel the need to talk my ear off (since I am more content to just sit quietly during hair appointments). The only reason I wasn't completely thrilled with the experience is because when I booked the appointment, it said it would take about an hour and a half. I was expecting that, or maybe a couple of hours since I have long hair and I know perms take time. However, I was there for almost 3 hours, and while my hair looks nice it doesn't really look like the picture of the type of perm I wanted that I had brought in.

We were on our way to BJ's Brewery and saw the sign and immediately stopped in our tracks.  Could that be the same Grimaldi's we walked over the Brooklyn Bridge for, got lost once we got to Brooklyn, stood in a line outside for 45 minutes waiting to get in, got insulted by the server, and ate at a communal table and LOVED EVERY BIT OF IT??  It was!  

We were committed to going to BJ's but later ordered pizza to go (to take home to Bradenton).  This is the real deal; real NY pizza.  The tomatoes, the crust, the fresh mozzerella were perfect.  Can't wait to go back to Tampa to get it fresh and hot from the oven!

This is the absolute dirtiest, and worst customer service I've ever seen. !! The place even smells when you walk in , our fries were not even cooked fully and still cold when we got them , the burger had a hole in the center and was black it was so burnt and on the top of the bun was blackish specs that looked to be mold . Of course we seen all this after leaving and threw all the food away !! Employees are rude beyond rude won't even respond when asked a question. I've never seen anything like it  negative stars is what's needed
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
This hotel truly was a disappointment. I couldn't stay another night in our suite when I saw all the little bugs in the night stands and drawers and the bathroom floor! We left and went to another hotel. I was there in Florida for my cousins wedding and staying for a week.  I cannot imagine being able to be there for the rest of the week with those bugs there all over our clothes and food 

We did talk to the lady at the front desk and supposedly she was going to give us Hilton points but we still had to pay for our nightly rate. Still haven't received those points though.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: La Colombe's cold brew receipt is far superior to other coffee places. Specifically, I really like the fact that it's on draft - I don't know, it just gives it a little flavor which I haven't found in other coffees before. Their pastries are delicious as well. The only reason they don't get five stars is that they don't start serving breakfast until late morning and you can't just get a basic bagel with cream cheese. I'm an early morning person and I really enjoy a coffee and bagel at 7 AM which just isn't a viable option here.

I would rate this place one star if available! this place is a scam, my friends and i ordered a pizza and mozzarella sticks at 11:24 pm thinking that would give them enough time to deliver it before they closed at 12:45. we were sadly mistaken, we called to check up on it around 12:20 and they said it was on the way: it is now 1 in the morning still no sign of the pizza. we tried calling around 12:40 and there was no answer after multiple phone calls. our card was charged yet no sign of the food. only go order from this place if your in the mood for utter disappointment and to be scammed.

This restaurant is excellent. I've been here many times and only had an issue once or twice (burnt chicken). The food comes quick and is delicious.

My only complaint is that the service is terrible. Perhaps it is due to the language barrier, but the (older) waitress is rude, they've given my table dirty looks for ordering a lot of food (AYCE, what did you expect?), and there was one instance of the staff pushing us to leave the restaurant so they could close almost an hour early. 

Despite all of the issues, I still highly recommend a visit to this restaurant. It's affordable and the food is great.

This was the saddest motel 6 I have ever stayed at. The grounds were disgusting, the rooms were not very clean, the toilet barely flushed, the sink did not drain so by the time I left the sink was half full. The halls were dirty especially the carpet. My dogs white feet got black just by walking in the halls. The location was very sketchy, and there were several scary looking people hanging out in or around the hotel. The only redeeming feature of this hotel was the staff. They were all super friendly and helpful.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Food was great, service cost a star. Little tardy with drink order. A few pointers; Always have water in one hand and coffee in the other. Do not wander around. Always ask the customers "is there any thing i can get you?"  Hire a professional waitress. Greet and seat faster. Take drink orders and deliver them faster. People want fast service.   Not sure whats happening in the kitchen but the food it takes too long. Turn up the heat. This area is in desperate need of another restuarant.  Unless you turn things around you're not going to be around.

Sorry to say COSTCO ravioli beats this place.  It's dumpy, especially for the location and although the cook/host/teller is nice enough; professionalism is lacking big time.  Ravioli is sub par.  To bad!  Was looking forward to having another  good local eatery.  Give it a try, like me it will more than likely be only ONCE.

It amazes me there are 4 and 5 stars for this place.  Just proves some people have very low expectations and/or taste buds.

By the way super expensive for very small portions $12 to $15

No one greeted me nor did they offer to take my order. I stood there and watched them walk back and forth for 2-3 minutes. When asked if they were going to take my order they informed me to go use the kiosk. I don't go to a restaurant for a kiosk experience. I go inside to interact with humans. Then they served 4 people who ordered after me... all I ordered was a large fry! Then to add insult to rudeness the fries were cold. I don't care how short staffed you are. Put up a sign, greet people, and serve warm food.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I got 2 burgers and 2 fries for takeout. For both I requested packets of ketchup and mayo. When I came to the pickup window I asked the guy again whether ketchup was in there, and he said yes. It was extremely important to me because I ran out of ketchup at home. Came home, opened the bag, and not a single packet of either ketchup or mayo. It was sad to eat fries without ketchup. Also, they did not put tomato in the burgers although I requested it, which was disappointing too.

Anyways, the place is cheap and the food is good. If only they got my order right...

The advertised on-site  parking is a block away and if someone has physical limitations, they probably would have an issue dragging their bags down the street to this hotel. Next. the room was okay, but the bathrooms was very small and poorly designed. In addition, we returned to our room expecting it would be cleaned with fresh linens, and had to request towels. Staff was friendly, but they couldn't answer questions about housekeeping or  even where to eat locally. The restaurant inside the hotel is not open. Definitely did not receive what was advertised. Regret not spending the extra $100 to stay at another hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Worst night of sleep ever! Guests above us were so loud that it woke us from a sound sleep after a day of travel. As we checked out and casually mentioned the noise, the hotel desk clerk, Heather, didn't even bothered to acknowledge the complaint with an apology. A simple apology would have been appreciated.  At least the evening staff were "service oriented." The rooms were clean and had a quirky vibe, which was a draw. Just wish that clerk could have showed some hospitality skills, being in the service industry and such.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: We picked this place for a "quick" dinner based on all of the other Yelp reviews. Big mistake. They weren't busy, less than 10 people in the entire restaurant but it took more than 10 minutes just to get our drinks and then another 40 minutes to get our food. Not once did anyone come around to give us an update or let us know there was a delay but instead, we were completely ignored. If you are willing to wait nearly an hour from the time you order to receive mediocre food and horrible service, then by all means visit Antonios.

Great food & great service every time we go! Sometimes the seafood fettuccine has broken chunks of shell from the shellfish they cook in it, but still my favorite dish though. The bread and oil vinegar is delicious. Unfortunately they do not allow reservations at such a small yet busy restaurant. Also tried to go there a little while back and they were closed due to staffing shortage. I understand that but their hours on Google did not reflect that and stated that they were open. Driving there only to get let down by a paper sign taped to the door. That's why the four stars

Worst McDonald's I've ever been in. Filthy, nats flying around. Worst customer service. Employees eating behind counter. They have no clue what they are doing. Machines alarms kept going off. Food cold and nasty. Rude employees. Coming from being a GM of a hotel I am totally shocked. I'm not looking for a gourmet experience, just the normal McDonald's experience. This franchise location needs the whole staff fired, clean the facility and hire and train the correct staff. I hope you as a owner will take a good look at your investment.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The cost was good , but the service was terrible . I got a mani pedi ,  My pedi was good till she painted my toes . It was really thick . And there was polish on my skin everywhere. I started getting my mani . She didn't say anything, just shoved my hand . Didn't get massage , just lotion on . Then She used an emery board for fake nails on my real nails . Everyone was uneven . Then came the paint job . My 8 year old granddaughter could have done better . I had to go and buy the things to fix them . When I got back to my daughter's . We are on vacation and I didn't have what I needed . I definitely won't go there again .

The Hotel Indigo charged us with smoking in the room ($250) when we ARE NOT SMOKERS! I have contacted the hotel management directly as well as the corporate offices. I have also initiated a charge back on my credit card as this is ridiculous. This hotel was built in the 1920's, it's freaking 90 years old, and the only evidence they had was a "smell." The manager at the desk was short with us from the beginning and the fact they would do this is just appalling. I will NEVER stay at another Intercontinental Hotel again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I came in with my dog on a Saturday early morning and ended up spending 8 hours here just to get some blood work and an X-ray done. The staff was nice, but it seems like they would have more vets on staff on a Saturday which I would guess is their busiest day as most vet offices are closed on Saturdays. They were able to help my dog, but had to spend all day there so if you've got the time to spend a whole Saturday there then this is the place for you. Giving 2 stars because they did help my dog, but terrible service and outrageous prices.

I flew in to finalize surprise birthday party arrangements for my dad that's turning 90.  Flight was smooth but the service at this Enterprise was amazing!  I worked with MARY WESTER and although it was cold out she was extremely patient and made sure I was satisfied with my selection.  We even changed cars a couple times but she was great the entire time.  Nowadays good customer service is hard to find so we truly appreciate her going over and above.  I have rented at this location now at least a half dozen times and will ONLY rent here when in Philly.

I came in from traveling for about 4 1/2 hours. The wait for even the menu was long let alone waiting for the food for an hour. We were one of only 2 tables in the whole restaurant and the other table had already been served, so it wasn't busy. I'm a vegetarian and ordered the penne alla vodka (description did not mention any meat which I am careful about when eating at restaurants) and after the hour long wait, there were pancetta pieces in the pasta that was not mentioned in the menu. It was not acceptable. If meat is included in anything, it should be stated clearly.

Usually not the best customer service. Not the friendliest staff but that's okay because I have an understanding that customers can be REALLY rude too. I'm usually always polite and understanding of others but they should improve there customer service skills and hire better people. I have had 2 bad experiences at this location but it would be nice to see improvement. Food is usually a hit or miss. The iced coffee is okay but when I ask for caramel they always give me chocolate and they SHOULD also speak English so I won't have to repeat myself twice.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Best Super Cuts I've been to!! I went in January 2019 to cut off 12 inches of my hair. I was pretty nervous going to a new Super Cuts as a UCSB student going from such long hair to short hair but with Bradley's kindness and humor he relaxed me about it. He actually cut more than I wanted but I loved it even more because of the cut he did made my hair look so good! I've been meaning to get my hair cut again, and will definitely get it cut with Bradley because he will not disappoint, he will go above your expectations!

We aren't from the area so we Yelped Mexican food.  From all the good reviews, we figured we might as well try it and we did. Nothing great about this place. The location is cool and the restaurant had a clean look as well. As for the food, it was tasteless and unflavorful. We each got our own thing and all 6 of us weren't too pleased. The grilled chicken taco salad was blah and I've had some tasteful taco salads before. The chicken burritos are okay. The asada tacos and gorditas weren't nothing to brag about. I loved the vibe inside, but as for the food.. I don't think we'll be returning when we come to Reno again.

This was probably the worst service I've ever had at a pizza joint. We gir ordered 2 pizzas for delivery. When they didn't show up we called. The manager in a very rude way said it was for carry out and to come pick it up if we want it. When I went to pick the pizzas up I told him very calmly that I was not blaming him but that he should check into the stores on line ordering because there was a problem. He became very rude and
told me to get the F#@K out of his store or he would call the cops. This guy was  rude and inappropriate. Than I got home and the order was wrong and cold. I would not recommend Papa John's on Mallory in Franklin

Decent little place. Could have quieter music playing in the lounge/reception area. We asked our waitress to turn the music down as we were the only people (5 of us) in the lounge and her words to us were "I'm sorry, I can't. My boss is here otherwise I would" since when is the boss's preference more important than the customers? Also worth noting we were there for a conference and everyone who had rooms over the covered drop off area complained that they could hear the music they have blasting out there all night, so maybe ask for a room elsewhere. Other than these two complaints, the hotel was really great. Nice clean rooms!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The hotel staff that checked us in was not very friendly at all.  Our non-smoking room had the employee smoking area right outside our window, so we could not open the window, and had to keep the drapes closed for privacy.  The head housekeeper was fantastic, very friendly.  The morning desk clerk was very friendly also.  The breakfast was ok, the waffle maker was out of order, it happens.  Had to report a fire in the cigarette ashtray outside side door of non-smoking floor, but head housekeeper took care of it immediately.  All in all would staying there again if we could not book something else.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If I could give this less than one star, I would. The sheets were dirty upon arrival & I called & told the front desk about it, specifying that we needed our sheets changed. Hair & literal dirt was everywhere. I was told to remove the sheets from the bed myself. When we returned to the room 4 hours later, the "cleaning" staff had not bothered to even move the dirty sheets. Calling the front desk to request service - again - resulted in attitude from whoever answered the phone. You'd have the same disgusting conditions from a motel for a way cheaper price. Don't bother with this dump.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
Unfortunately, I was disappointed with the general experience. The service was slow, seemed like 1 waitress for all the tables during the afternoon on a Sunday. 

I ordered The Gabriel, which was a large portion, probably could serve 2 people! However, it was extremely salty, and I couldn't finish it. It came with a slice of garlic bread, which not very flavorful, but I used it as a neutralizer for the salty pasta.

My favorite part of the meal was the toasty and crispy complimentary bread and balsamic dipping sauce served in the beginning.

They are the worst - I've been three times now. The first two times, the cheap polish for a gel manicure lasted less than two weeks - my mother had a similar experience. The third time I entered the shop at 7:21 (the close at 8), they told me to have a seat and then proceeded to tell me that they don't have time for a regular manicure. The level of rudeness (on top of the cheap products) will ensure that I never go back again. I was only going out of convenience because it is near my house, but I rather drive across town than to go here again.

You get what you pay for. This place is one of the cheapest in New Orleans. You don't get French Quarter luxury for $70 a night. If all you want is a firm bed to nap on in between sight seeing and partying then this place is perfect. A Lyft to the French Quarter costs about $12. 

If you're expecting a complimentary breakfast and a mint on your pillow in a fancy neighborhood then you're gonna have to spend a lot more money. The only negative thing I have to say is that the gates for the gated parking don't work. Otherwise, it's a perfect pit stop for a weekend of fun in the Big Easy!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Went here for lunch (9-16-2011) and had the Margharita slice as well as a pepperoni slice.

It was very good.  I've been to 8 or so pizza joints in the area (I'm from out of town) over the past few months and this one is the best by far.  Fresh ingredients are what makes this pizza shop better than the others.

Also, their pepperoni is excellent and not the standard pepperoni you get at other places.  I *think* they slice their own from the pepperoni sticks instead of buying the presliced stuff.

I will be back and will be ordering take out from time to time.  Recommended!!!

I walked in expecting a great time celebrating my 25th birthday with my friends and my experience was the least enjoyable. Our waitress did not write down our orders therefore causing her to forget multiple drinks for our only party of 9. We had to ask for drinks so many as 4 times. In addition I found bones in my fettuccine Alfredo & when I told the waitress her excuse was "well at least you know it's fresh" and no discount or apology was given. In addition when my friend asked for a vegan dessert she was told "we can't serve that, that would ruin our reputation". Safe to say we will not return and my birthday was ruined.

The workers didn't really have much of an attitude but did not honor an advertisement on their window if the advertisement ends do not display it simple as that will not be coming here again as no one was understanding of this advertisement on their window other customers agreed with us that we should get the Bogo still.The managers excuse for not honoring it is that a three dollar chicken nugget meal will get her fired if it goes down to one dollar Will not be returning as the customers needs are not priority at this location
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
After having my car washed at Royal, I later discovered that they went though my car and stole from me.  They took some very expensive sun glasses and knife.  The manager was rude and unapologetic when contacted about the theft.  The response was essentially that it was all lies or that the items were misplaced.  There was no apology, we will look into it, etc.   To top it all off, they did a horrible job washing the car, were pushy during the sale, and the cashier failed to even look up when I paid.  

I will never, ever go back to Royal Car Wash.

This is an older Hyatt Place and in need of a good cleaning or remodeling. Bathroom was dirty, sink not draining properly, and missing light fixture. Our room was missing a room service menu and phone was not working, so we had to go down to front desk to place order. Hotel staff acknowledged phones not working is ongoing problem due to cleaning staff disconnecting wires and not knowing how to reconnect them properly. I was happy with the late checkout at 12pm and 2 free water bottles per day for being a Hyatt rewards member.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I recently went to Aidan Gill for a hot towel shave. The experience started off fantastically. I was greeted by a man who asked for my name and then promptly guided me to the waiting area. The Women who gave the shave was friendly and outgoing. The shave itself seemed wonderful and was relaxing until I got home and looked in the mirror. My sideburns, where the lady had shaved, were extremely uneven. I had cuts all along the left side of my upper lip as well as on my chin and neck. For almost $50 with tip this is unacceptable. Stay Away!

Belleville has a cute, but unappreciated old town main street. I'm from out of town, and had it not been for the "coffee" flag out front, I'd have missed this little gem. Walking in, it's the decor and charm that stand out. Excellent mix of repurposed fixtures, and classsic building elements create a super cozy and inviting space.  I had an americano, and a muffin. The muffin was standard fare and nothing special. Coffee drink was perfect.  As customers came and went, Michelle at the counter did a great job of interacting at a personal level.

Credit Card Information was stolen after having two consecutive meals here while on business a few days ago while staying at nearby hotel. Ghetto bartender asked me for a company discount after casually inquiring what I was doing in town and I replied that I was here on business.  Notified management after $700 in fraudulent charges posted to my card as a courtesy and manager was absolute in naively stating that it could not have happened there, as we both had copies of the receipt..which made absolutely no sense! PROCEED WITH CAUTION!

We stayed for 4 nights around the end of July 2016. Literally, the worst hotel I have ever stayed in. Filthy, rooms are never cleaned, the "pool refurb" has been going on for 2 years. 

When they replaced our towels (which was only once by the way), we were only given 1 in return...for four people. And, they didn't even replace our toilet paper so we ran out. Beds are never made...a few bottles of shampoo and soap were thrown on the table by the door. Oh, and the trash is sat outside your door for days after it's emptied.

Overall, you don't want to stay here. Pay the extra money and go somewhere else. Anywhere else for that matter!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
Called to ask what time they close, very rude person on the phone answered. Walked in to get a quick gel manicure, was greeted with "what do you want," and I responded nicely. The owner, who I'm guessing is Sunny, didn't even look at me and was rude the entire time. I got up and left after seeing she and one other tech were the only ones working and a gel was $25---that's how much I pay in the suburbs at a clean, friendly and professional salon! 

I would assume she will go out of business soon because of her lack of customer service skills. Very rude, I hope they see these reviews and plans re-evaluate her business structure.

I stopped in Fresh Grocer just a little after 7 p.m. I had decided that I was going to try one of the platters from hot foods section of the store sad to say my options were limited but as I waited for my turn in line I had decided from what I had to choose what I was going to get but while waiting with the three people that were in front of me and two people working in the section one who was serving customer and the other was taking the food from the front of my face and putting it away so I walked out the store and sat in my car and gave this review

Tom went above and beyond by finding out that my daughter's Outback had engine work done before we bought the car at a dealership and therefore the needed repairs would still be under warranty. The extra homework he did saved us a ton of money and meant that he didn't get to do the very expensive repair in his shop. This truly shows how Tom is looking out for his customers best interests and not his own. I can't say enough about the service we've received and how I wish I could have a trust worthy shop like Boise Foreign Car Service back in California for all my other cars.

I've never been more embarrassed or upset! My first 3 experiences went well. Each time I went I took a new customer to be serviced! Today after getting my nails done I asked the tech to sign my rewards card! She told me she'll sign it today but next time if I don't tip a minimum of 10 percent she would not sign it again! I am upset because I thought my nails were $20, they added $5 to fix the shape; which mind you they were correcting their mistake! Long story short my nails were $25, I tipped what I had left in my purse which was $2! However to sum it up I will not return and those I have brought will not be retuning either!

These guys, for one thing, have horrible customer service skills. We had a reservation at 1:30 and didn't get a car until 3 and it wasn't even a compact car that we reserved. We were told the only car they had was a mini van. So we waited another half hour to get a smaller car and they were not apologetic or anything for the long wait. Even though they denied it, everyone knew they were out of cars. Second, they are scam artists. They'll tell you they will refund your $250 and they never will. Lesson learned. I'll go with someone else next time.

I'm here from California on business.  I am not a hotdog fan, but every visit to Tucson wouldn't be complete without stopping in for the sonoran hot dogs.  I tried them once last year and was hooked.  To my surprise a cooking magazine i subscribe to had a recent article listing the top 25 hotdog places in the US. This hotdog was on that list!  This is your typical "hole in the wall, mom and pop" place to eat, known by the locals.  Looking forward to them and I don't care that it takes 25 minutes to prepare.  You shouldn't rush perfection!

We were in town just for 3 days. Didn't know where to eat. This place had outdoor seating and the weather was good. So, we gave it a shot. She got the walleye with mixed vegetables and mashed sweet potatoes. I got the shrimp and crab cake duo with onion rings and mixed vegetables. Both were well cooked. The crab cake was 95% crab meat, no filler. Delicious. The shrimp were cooked perfectly. Same for the walleye. Cocktail sauce was scratch. We found the menu to be quite vast. They have GF and veggie options. Well done. It was a nice meal outside. It's not fancy at all. Service and food are good though.

This is by far the worst Avis I've ever been to, the staff is short and rude and don't want to help at all. If I could give zero stars I would.... I rent with Avis literally every week and never again from this location... They don't know basic information about vehicles and when asked questions rather than try to find an answer they just dismiss them as someone trying to ask for more than what they need. The ppl I dealt with (07/26 11:20) were just lazy for lack of a better word and shouldn't be working if they don't indeed want to work.

I CAN'T BELIEVE THIS PLACE IS IN BUSINESS?? 
I ordered a simple Spaghetti marinara. It was a Saturday night, 9 p.m. 
There were 4 or 5 guys behind the counter, "counting their money"...... I noticed, no one was actually, "Working". 
I was the only customer. After 25 minutes, I asked where my pasta was? The "Cook" said, 
" I ran out of sauce, so In "defrosting" some more" right now. 
I said to him, "It took you this long, to figure out , you "ran out of sauce"? What kind of Italian restaurant, runs out of pasta sauce?"
I asked for my $15. back & got out of there.
Maybe they were having a "Bad Night"? I don't know.

Just walked in and was greeted with a rude one word "reservation?" 
No welcome at all. I said we had nine in our party and he very rudely said there was no way he would get us in tonight. Then we said we would split up to two tables. He said well maybe in two hours. I touched a wine bottle on the counter and he said "don't touch that!" 
There was a lady who actually came over and tried to see if she could fit us in and he kept saying "don't you understand it's not gonna work!?" She at least was nice. First time in Boise, here for a funeral and didn't need the sheer rudeness of this jerk.

The food is generally good but Service is hit or miss. Also, yesterday I went in to have dinner with my daughter and girlfriend. They charged my card twice for my meal. They then said they had it fixed, which they did not I then had to call the manager myself. He finally got it figured out after about a day. He sent me an email with the proof that he's refunding one of my transactions. He then offered absolutely no compensation whatsoever for the Inconvenience of double charging my debit card. So apparently it's OK for them to screw up and make a mistake and not be accountable for it.

Food was delicious. My entire party got different things & loved all of them. We got flautas, fajitas & a burrito. The burrito was huge, the fajitas came prepared perfectly & flautas were extremely long & a good portion. Went on a Tuesday when it was taco Tuesday which they had two different tacos for 2.99. Service was somewhat slow but it seemed like they didn't have that much staff. We would definitely go again and again. We all got the unlimited margarita which was 16.99 plus $1 each flavored drink which was a little excessive after paying $16.99 but it was worth it.

I filled the tank 10.2 miles from the airport.  The tank was still registering at F. when I dropped off the vehicle.  After returning home I found a charge of $118.32 had been posted to my CC without my approval.   When I called Budget I was told that the charge was due to returning the vehicle with only 10 gallons of gas and that they charge $10 a gallon. Again the tank was FULL when I dropped it off.  I read the reviews prior to renting and saw that this was a pattern but thought it wouldn't happen to me.  Well think twice before you make the same mistake.  I will be contacting my CC company and disputing the charge.

I've been a long time customer here, but I think I am done with this place for a while.  My wife and I were seated in the dining room and sat there for 20 min and no one even took our drink order.  Several other people came in and were served while we were not even acknowledged.  We walked out and none of the staff even noticed.  We walked right past them.  Not a peep.  I know the owners and I know they spend more time in the Wesley Chapel location.  The restaurant in Carrollwood needs some attention.  Service has been steadily going downhill at this location.

I haven't sign my application yet cause we're still debating if should go on this apartment. The staffs are very rude we told that we're still undecided which date should we get and of the stuff told me that it's difficult for them to change everuthing that we should make up our mind! Whoever is that number one that is your job. Second whatever circumstances or questions that we have upon moving you should be courteous tonyour customer. I'd like to request to change your stuff or you'll never get a renter the way they treat the customers who like to move in your apartment

Robotic and sterile.  The hotel itself has very little street exposure so most rooms look out at internal walls of the hotel itself.  My room had nice looking windows which were actually sealed behind an unbreakable glass shield.  Room was comfortable enough, staff very good.  Forget about having visitors as the elevators operate via key card. Worst was hearing every word, fart and cough in the rooms on either side, and thinking someone was at my door because the knocking on either neighbor's door was so loud.  I would not stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
My daughter and I went here yesterday for a Mani/Pedi time right before I have my second child (days away!).  I will say, the massage was nice but this was definitely not a good mani/pedi.  My technician cut my cuticles so short that 2 toes and 2 fingers bled.  My toe and nail polish has bubbles showing - meaning this will not last long at all.  Also - they painted over our cuticles - that's not how it's supposed to be done!  Now as soon as our cuticles grow, the polish will flake off.  

All in all - we will not return here.  Sorry people.  Posh is much better.

Maybe it's just my unit because I'm in the front, but it is extremely noisy here. On top of the walls & windows being paper thin... every morning there's something going on outside. From the garbage truck waking me up, lawn or maybe irrigation equipment, drilling noises, the neighbors, renovations above me; it's always something. The apartment itself is decent, but the amount of noise is almost unbearable. Also didn't receive my amenity key for being here almost a month. Maintenance staff is very helpful due to having to have filled out quite a few requests.

I was pleased with the quality relative to the price.  I had the veal special and it was a meal in itself.  My Fiancée had the snapper and she enjoyed it but the fresh bass looked fresher.  Owner and his daughter greeted up a the door and were very accommodating in meeting our 8 15 reservation made at 7 30 pm on a Saturday. Service staff was great also bring my finance a taste of fruit. You can even BYOB (wine for sure) and I don't think they even charge a corking fee (double check this). Being of southern Italian descent, I found the Sicilian food excellent!  Only negative is only one one-person bathroom.

For the obnoxious price of $70 (not including tip) you can have your feet butchered. I do NOT recommend this salon whatsoever. For whatever reason, this woman cut the corner of my toenails off (in like a weird triangle shape) and ripped along the sides, almost like pulling an ingrown nail - which I've only had a handful of times in my life but almost completely expect once my nails grow out. I bled from multiple toes and now I have painful sections of exposed under-nail. I'm anticipating infection as the redness and pain are getting worse.

I use to go to Nails Uptown 3--times per month, until Ty and Ruby sold their business (to a very nice man). But not all of the staff is so friendly or professional. 
If you're looking for Ty or Ruby, they're at Modern Nails.  It's about $10 more there for my appointments and for the exact same services. I'm a loyal person, but the atmosphere means a lot to me. It's a very busy place, clean, and a lot of technicians talking amongst themselves instead of engaging with their client. 
Love Ty and Ruby and may follow them even to "The OC."

A good mechanic is hard to find. Gulfport Garage has been in the family for going on 50 years, and as Eric, the guy I spoke to, says, they're a part of the community, and when they go to O'Maddy's they'd rather have customers buying them drinks than throwing drinks at them. I set up an appointment, and when I got there the part was in and they were ready. I was in and out in 45 minutes, and paid almost $50 less than they estimated. Gulfport Garage is definitely where I'm going next time I need work done.

P.S. If it's going to take a while, they are about 10 steps from the shopping/restaurant district.

Horrible experience making the booking. Then was passed off to a time share proposal where I got major attitude for not wanting to complete the transaction after hearing the details. Hilton has gone down hill. So once we show up we find out that everything we asked for in the room was nothing that we got. And then we found out that a sports team or some thing was coming into town and we probably got dumped down into a crappy room so they could make accommodations for the team. I understand but they should've at least given us a major discount. Horrible customer service, horrible hotel, horrible Hilton. And no apologies.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Front desk staff was very friendly at check-in, however when I got up to take a shower to get ready there was no water.  I called downstairs and she told me that they were working on the hot water and the water would not be on until later in the day.  Her solution was to bring up room temp bottles of water.  She said she had called every room and left a message, I had no message I even double checked in case the blinking light on my phone wasn't working.  Not a way to start your day when you have to go to work and not shower.  Very poor planning.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
It's a decent hotel, but not for the price. It should be priced in the sub-$100/night range. I stay at La Quintas while traveling with my dogs and they're generally pretty good. This one was a bit subpar.

The room I stayed in had a strange odor and unfished repairs or renovations. The hotel is generally clean, but the staff tend to hang out at a table away from the front desk instead of behind the front desk like most every other hotel you've been to. Overall it wasn't a bad experience, but I'd probably recommend someone else to try another La Quinta in the area than this particular hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Super clean. Great Covid safe breakfast option, too. We stayed here on our way down south and a week later on our way back up. My daughter left her retainer on the first stay. We realized this 24 hours after we left. We called and a lovely gentleman said he would save it for us for when we returned. When we came back, the lady at the desk search high and low for it and couldn't find it. She called the gentleman who had been on duty the night before. He came in on his night off to retrieve it and return it to us. I told him he was our hero and his response was so sweet. I highly recommend this hotel. THANK YOU!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The hotel is nice and clean - no issues there.  Our company has stayed here the past few years during a busy convention.  We booked 12 rooms in advance and typically have no issues.  However, this past December (2016), a room was added on to our tab by a random individual.  The hotel manager or front desk employee approved the additional room without seeking approval from our company.  So basically they told us to pound sand on a room that someone added to our bill.  Based on their response, we'll likely choose another hotel option in 2017.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
First time here. Went to pick colors for hands and toes. Polishes looked horrible, dull, separated in layers, muddy. Difficult to find any that looked decent. Finally picked two, chose an OPI product for fingernails. Ben did pedi work, Ivy did painting. Then Ivy did manicure. It was ok. She tried to up sell me on two cosmetic products priced at $40 and $70. 
Next day, polish started to come off at fingertips. Day after that I had to take it off, even more polish had come off. This supposedly was the OPI product. 
Will not return.

I've been a long time customer with them for almost 20 years, but am probably going to be switching to another optometrist.   I've called now about 7 times to get an appointment, and you get put on hold and nobody answers or you get hung up on.  That tells me they just don't want my business, or are too busy to help someone that has been with them for so long.  So sad they are terrible with the phone and making appointments. I'd like to give them my business, but I just can't get a hold of them, because they are good once you get in there.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: The last 2 times we had a carry out order they did not add the protein to our meals. Both times got home and had to go back to get it. This time we called and they said they would have it ready for us. We got there and the Chef asked where the food was. We didn't bring it and weren't told too. The Chef replied how do I know you haven't already eaten those meals and they were correct?! We weren't asking for a whole salad just the chicken. And to question if I was lying was completely unreasonable. Neither time did they do anything to make this right. Extremely disappointed!

Ambra, is by far, one of my absolute favorite places to dine in Philadelphia.  I have frequented Southwark since Chris D'Ambro and Marina de Oliveira assumed ownership, and counted down the days to the opening of their sister restaurant.  

From the canapés and champagne to the dessert and digestif, each course is executed beautifully with attention to both taste and aesthetic.  The tasting menu changes regularly, which makes return visits a must...and each more enjoyable than the last

**For the perfect date night - a magical Old Fashioned at Southwark's bar then stellar service and exceptional food at Ambra.**

Terrible experience with billing.  They incorrectly authorized my debit card for thousands over the amount I should have ever been charged and the authorizations continue, resulting in freezes on my debit, overdraft charges, etc.
They cannot explain why it's happening, but auths continue & increase each time they hit my card.
Our holiday stay has been stained by this terrible experience, not to mention hours of time on the phone with their front desk, accounting & my bank to reverse autos and get my money back!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I went to this cafe today with my family. It has a small selection of drinks besides coffee. We asked for a regular coke because there was none in the cooler. The waiter could not be more disinterested, "whatever you see there is what we have." Also, my brother got a diet coke from the cooler and it was not cold at all. We asked for a cup with ice and the waiter wanted to charge us $1. It is a busy street and the place was empty when we went there today, I guess that was a sign we should have gone to another place. I am not coming back after today's experience.

I went earlier today to get a haircut just as a walk in, had 3 people ahead of me in the queue from online check in, which was absolutely fine. I was told it would be about 30 min and that I'd be their last customer before they closed at 1300. They had my name and number and said they'd call when it was my turn, since you're not allowed in the lobby due to covid 19 protocols. I received no phone call or haircut, they just closed up without letting me know any information. In the past they've been great and convenient, but unfortunately I think I'll take my business elsewhere. I wouldn't recommend going to this location.

I ordered Tso Shrimp for my husband but had to give him my order and suffer through the Shrimp. The outer breading was smothered with sauce but I still had trouble penetrating the hardness and burnt pieces. Unpleasant experience. The shrimp was small but were huge with breading... that could have been the over hardness and burning problem. Some things should just go in the trash not charge someone $13.45. Too many other Chinese Restaurants to go back to this. Save your money. I'd love to post picture but do not see option to do that.

For all the people on here leaving a poor review about the pies being uncut (and there are quite a few) need to do some research on why Italian AUTHENTIC ITALIAN pies are UNCUT!! Geez Lmao...Know what you're talking about before you try and bash the ONLY authentic Italian pizza in Nashville. Just my two cents. I find it so comedic when people try and go waaay out of their intelligence level only to unknowingly embarrass themselves....

OH, before I forget. Great pizza fellas, keep it up! Crust is phenomenal!

1 hour ago, i went that restaurant and i totally got annoying!! I found hair in the California roll and i talked to my server! Actually i thought apology is mandatory in this case, But they just took away my food which was included hair and just provided new one! They didn't say any SORRY!! It simply doesn't make sense. 
I really disappointed that restaurant also i didn't wanna eat anymore, so i asked my check and they just include my California roll that had trouble! It was really rude and they have to apologize about that part!! I absolutely DO NOT recommend this restaurant

Great and friendly staff; they let us bring our dog even though it's no pets allowed for one night. The breakfast tastes good, I recommend the pancakes. Clean rooms, and the TV can be controlled by your phone! Only bad thing is that you have to pay for Internet/WiFi, and it's a little expensive (~$15/day). Other than that, great. Also, there is a cool view of the airport. Besides the view, the room also includes a safe, Ethernet port (paid), Tv with HDMI ports, comfy chairs, clean bathroom, and hard pillows. Would come again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: False advertising. Claims it's loaded with bacon but where? I am still going through my ice cream looking for bacon of any kind. The pieces are so tiny that you can barely see them. I bit into 3 pieces of tiny bacon. It was topped with 4 small pieces of brittle and that's it. I imagine that with the bacon this could have been amazing but the ice cream alone simply taste like sugared cream. The amount of money you spend on this you should get what you pay for but you don't. Didn't help that customer service was rude.

Expected this restaurant to be decent based on the previous reviews. To start off, this place is very warm and humid inside, which does not set a good atmosphere to eat in, and the service is poor and unfriendly. The sushi comes with an over-load of rice with a very thin slice of fish. With every order, the fish on top got smaller and smaller. As for the rolls, they are filled with pretty much all vegetables and the thinnest slice of meat. Also, the fish is very un-fresh and warm. If you like only vegetable rolls and a lot of rice and small pieces of warm fish, go ahead and give this place a shot.

Honestly, the most disgusting place I have ever stayed at. The beds were sooooo gross. They DO NOT wash the bedding. They obviously just throw sheets over it. Had stains if I don't even want to know on it. Shower curtain had hella mold on it. The bathroom walls and door had severe water damage and dirt on it. The bedroom walls had food, or some sort of filth on them. And EVERYTHING was covered In dirt. THEY DO NOT CLEAN THE ROOMS, PERIOD. I would never recommend anyone stay here and if they are not willing to step up there level of cleanliness, they need to be shut down. You own a Motel, cleanliness should be a MUST.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
this shhhhhhhhh/t sucks!!
go elsewhere!

____
Came here because my family and I was camping at the beach (down the street), we came here because of the coupon & should have read other people reviews.
* they do not honor their coupon, had to get a friend to come inside and talk a little smack for them to honor*
We were a big PARTY and it was not busy.
___
FOOOD: horrible, uncook pizza, Found hair in one of our pizza, one pizza was uncool- pulled a slice and everything fell off. Super Unsatisfied.
Tables were pretty dirty, peppers/cheese shakers were dirty and where they place it is dirty. JUST FILTHY PLACE!

SO much incompetence and laziness it's RIDICULOUS!! Is this what customer service is COMING to?! 

FIRST of all, the restaurant was a MESS... trash everywhere, overflowing trash bins and unsavory bathroom conditions! 

SECONDLY... the chocolate frosty was ATROCIOUS!! absolutely disgusting!

FINALLY (and, frankly MOST importantly!!)... UNCOOKED FOOD!! Not only did I take an order of fries back ONCE, but TWICE and still ended up with HALF a carton of uncooked fries! The health inspector would have a FEILD day with this place! I would NEVER ever EVER (!!!) recommend this place to ANYONE for as long I live!!

Great option for delivery. We ordered 2 large pizzas, greek salad and chicken parm. People were friendly, portions were huge, delivery was fast. Kids loved the pizzas, chicken parm was tasty, sauce was meaty and tasted nice and fresh. Greek salad was unusual, with a big dollop of potato salad in the middle. Very tasty, although the dressing was a little sweeter than I'm used to and I wish they used nice greek olives instead of canned black olives. But still it was a great option for a vacationing family. Definitely recommended if you live or vacation in the Weeki Wachee area.

I would give them 2 stars because of the blood stained mattress in my suite (see pictures).

Check your mattresses people, you never know what is under the sheets. The pullout couch had a nasty blood stain. I had to go downstairs at 2am to tell them about it. The reason I give them 2 stars and not lower is because they were very accommodating about it after I showed them the pictures. The staff was pretty nice. 

The hotel is also in a great location downtown. I was just extremely shocked to find the mattress like that and it ruined my brand perception of the hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Stayed 3 nights here. We had a corner room so we had a lot space to move around. Loved the exposed brick. 3 big windows gave us plenty of natural light. There was even a window in the bathroom! Check in and out was easy. The only negative part was the parking...$37/day! Parking garage was 6 blocks away meaning a 30 minute wait for your car. Location was right off Canal street and 2 blocks from the casino and riverwalk.  Bourbon street was just 3 blocks away. Overall, it was a great place to stay and would recommend it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Open 24/7 huh? Not! Stop in on our way home from LA to stretch, use the bathroom, an grab a bite to eat at 1:15am to stay awake. I walk in, no one is in the kitchen. No one is behind the counter. Some of the lights were off In the kitchen. A guy comes out from the back and says, "oh we will be with you in like 10 mins. 10 to 15 mins. About that time frame." Bro, I'm not tryin to sit here for 15 min before I order my food. Then what, I guarantee you weren't going to make fresh fries. I would have gotten the cold fries that weren't even sitting under a heat lamp because it was also off!
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Wife and I were working on the house late on a Sunday, called our usual spot for a pizza, which didn't pick up the phone.
I've passed this place a dozen times since moving to Ewing a month ago so I suggested giving them a call. They picked up the phone immediately, easy order process, delivered FAST. The food was fantastic. I had a small Ruben pizza, wife had a cheesesteak, we had sides of onion rings and cheese fries. All amazing. I got curious and checked them out on Instagram, looks like they make some Czech specials every few days that I'd love to try. They look like a new place and I hope they stick around.

I had a great experience here. As other reviewers have stated, it's an all you can eat buffet, but you order from your seats. Pretty much everything is made to order. My dad, brother and I ordered various small salads/soups, various tempura, and a huge plate of maki and special rolls. The sushi was the highlight. It was delicious and fresh. I left with a happy, full stomach. Servers were very nice and attentive. Some of them have difficulty with speaking English, but we understood them perfectly. I would recommend this place and hope to return soon.

Booked through Expedia, but told room request was not guaranteed. Police arrest in lobby while we were in bar. Bartender very nice, but inexperienced. He was running the whole bar food and drinks by himself. Not enough luggage carts when we asked and we were just given an oh well attitude by front desk. 1/2 updated towels in bath, nice toiletries. Carpets in hallways need updating or at least stretched. Ac in room did not work, and we were not the only ones. Ice makers not working. Did not have a warm fuzzy feeling here. We will not be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Worst hotel sleeping experience in my life. $400 a night and a train runs directly underneath the rooms (no one bothered to tell me that when I checked in) it woke me three times during the night as it literally shook the building! The room was made to look like, if not built in, an old train car - no black out shades so the room was never really dark and you could hear every noise when people walked by, used the ice machine, etc. The response by the front desk:"We are so sorry." I will never stay there again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
They'll try to screw you over!

I moved to Carmel recently and I went to this location and was told that my car had 2 things wrong with it and it would cost $750 to fix. I wanted to get a second opinion so I took it to another mechanic back home and they said not only was one of the things that Midas said was wrong with my car PERFECTLY FINE, but it only cost $250 for the repairs. 

I will not be going back to this location and I have heard from coworkers that Midas tried to add on charges to basic things that needed done on their cars!
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Been a member here for about 2 years. The staff is very unpleasant. Just the limited time you say hi and bye at the front desk when you come and go you are inconveniencing the staff. 

They don't repair their equipment properly, I've complained about a few of their bars that have lost their grips and they just leave the bars with missing grips exposing the holes where the grips go that rip your skin and pinch you..

Oh and it's a really small gym.. only 1 pec/deck machine!!!

Updated picture to show a water drip and the closed grip they can't fix.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text:
I am one of those people who cannot wear a mask for medical reasons, and it's been extremely difficult to function in society.  This business is one of those great gems with people who understand that we DO exist and respect that.

Did I mention the food is phenomenal?  Originally I'd only tried their pasta with veggies and it was soooo good, but one night we ordered pizza and it is now our favorite place to go.

The white pizza is so flavorful, and my fella loves the pepperoni.  The staff and owner are all wonderful, friendly, and caring people.  We will patronize this place for years to come.  Marco's pizza has become my new favorite place!

Staff were very friendly. Room was clean. Breakfast was good. 
However, the building condition needs attention badly. Water fixtures in bathroom leaked, causing electrical shortage in bathroom where the fan & light would not turn on at all. Lamp on desk would not work, and when I looked at the outlet - in it was 'swinging' from the wall. Older building. Very noisy area/location - traffic kept us up until 1:30 pm (it was a Saturday night), and there looked like some shady transactions happening in the parking lot. Lastly, it cost $160 for one evening. Will not stay here again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Not enough staff on Fridays to do clients hair. Arrived at 8:45 around the time they open and have been waiting for 3 hours to get a simple hairstyle done. Last time I was here a few months ago, they had plenty of staff there to work fast to ensure people are not waiting too long and to get the other clients in and out. Summer is a busy season for hair braiding and I have been coming here off and on for a couple of years and I never expected the wait time on a Fri in June to take as long as it did, as well as having to sit for a few hours to get my hair done.

Great location, perfect access to Vanderbilt. Recently renovated rooms are very comfortable. But there are 2 substantial problems to note. The rooms are very very noisy! Every door opening and closing all along the hall makes the other rooms shudder. Plumbing noises are constant and if the stadium is in use the rooms get everything. Second, the overuse of scent in the reception area is a real problem for migraine or asthma sufferers. It might be nice in small amounts, but it's strong enough to be a health hazard.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
12/18/14 
After a long  airline delay, the shuttle was a quick ride and the bus was full. When we arrived at the Enterprise rental center there was a line of customer service personnel waiting to take care of us. ( This was great to see!)  The staff was great they gave us a bottle of water as we checking out our vehicles. I was in and out of the rental center in less then 10 minutes. Upon my return the staff was quick to check in my vehicle and get my receipt and make sure I had no problems with the car and a shuttle was waiting to take me back to the airport for my flight. My sincere thanks to a job well done! Keep up the great service.

I was very disappointed with my service. I went in asking for gel, and they said I couldn't get it because my "nails were too short and damaged". They offered me regular nail polish instead, but they did an awful job. It's been less than a week and my nails have chipped so much. The salon itself is very clean and nice, but the service is simply subpar. Not to mention I paid $35 for a regular manicure. Worst of all, I was offered an array of sugar scrub options and spent 10 minutes picking out the best one and then the technician never used it on me :(

Two workers... long line... 1 employee is serving the customers and the other is cleaning the popcorn machine. They don't have all items, therefore the employee that is now cleaning the pretzel machine should be checking with the guest to see what they want... improve on your customer service skills. No smiles from the employees... you can do better. Also if you close at 8pm customers come first until then. In order to make money you need to have the product. This is from someone who is in the food service industry.

I have a major problem w/ Vantage West Credit Union. They are the  lender for my car loan. However, I did NOT choose them personally. The way they handle business on a co-signed account is very time consuming & unorganized. This :update" to account login in that went into effect April 2019 was not done w/ consideration to anyone except the company themselves. As far as that, I would give them no stars if possible. They treat the joint account holders as if we have no value while maintaining the "value" & payment of the loan. 
Good company ethics you have there Vantage West!!

Overall great sushi for New Orleans! I love sushi and have had a hard time finding a good place and this was actually great. However, my friend got the sashimi and the pieces of fish were cut so thick she compared it to biting whole into a fish. Again stars were also docked do not receiving any water or anything to drink for that matter until half through through eating our rolls after asking multiple times for water and were told all dishes were dirty so there weren't any water glasses. I even asked for water in a wine glass and they said no. I will go back because of the food but if the service is bad again I will not return!

Me and my boyfriend came here for my birthday. We had a reservation and they had our table ready when we came in. We brought our own wine, which they do not charge to open. We ordered the poke - it was amazing, it had this interesting hummus and a good amount of poke. I ordered the grilled sirloin - it was so tender, it came with blue cheese mashed potatoes and I've got to say these are the best mashed potatoes that I've EVER HAD!! My boyfriend got the short rib bolognese - that was amazing! Lastly we got the pomegranate blueberry cheesecake - its the best one!! We would definately be back here again!! And we highly recommend it!

Rang in 2022 with a stay at the graduate Tucson. The staff appeared to be disheveled and stressed for the holiday weekend upon arrival. Rooms are decent size for your boutique hotel setting, however the pillows uncomfortable and took 45 minutes for a hair dryer to be brought up to the room. At check in there was no New Years packages/upgrades or amenities offered which was disappointing. The cafe & bar staff were definitely struggling from their New Year's Eve festivities. Signs of intoxication were visible along with the scent of substances. If the staff took professionalism seriously then this hotel could reach higher levels of success.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My family and friends stayed here for three nights for the national championship weekend. Two rooms for three nights  to the tune of $3,000. The staff is phenomenal.  We rented the second floor room to watch the game. All went well until the owner, Bobby Guidry showed up. He was so rude and hostile to me and my family. His behavior was unbelievable.  He basically ruined what was a great evening. I will never return to his hotel. It's very creepy that he hangs out in the lobby and drinks all day.  We were treated horribly by him. Stay somewhere else. I sure will.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The employees at this restaurant are corrupt! They only took cash and didn't provide me with a receipt! The employee behind the counter, sat there on his iPhone and would not prepare our order. The cashier had to go in the back to prepare the order. She kept asking the guy in the back if he was going to prepare the Order... he didn't so, she went back there. The cashier was good. No issues. However, as soon as the security guard noticed I was taking pictures, he kicked me and my husband out of the restaurant.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: The facility itself is fine -- basic gym  equipment that is readily available from 9 to about 3:30. Early and late it is pretty crowed and by folks that seem to feel if you are not  in perfect  shape you need to be somewhere else as they need to do their workout NOW. Not the business's fault totally but some  of the employees seem to feel the same way. the biggest problem is that they charge you for EVERYTHING including quitting -- it is $25 to quit even though you are on a month to month status with supposedly no contract. READ THE SMALL PRINT CLOSELY.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Big thanks to Sierra Veterinary Specialists! My three month old puppy, Newman, was having a rough day and not getting better when I decided it was time to take him to SVS. I had never been to a pet ER so I was a little nervous about what to expect. From the moment I arrived to when I left, the entire staff could not have been nicer or more helpful with helping determine what was wrong/what to do next for Newman. Glad to report he's doing much better! I would definitely recommend them to anyone needing pet help. Thanks again Sierra Veterinary Specialists!

This location has some of the worst customer service in South Florida. After failing to complete my order as paid for, twice, and being ignored at the window for 10 minutes, they told me to pull up to spot 1 and they would bring my chicken nuggets out. I waited for another 5-10 minutes until I went inside to get my order and they tried to make me pay for it a second time. They proceeded to accuse me of having the food already, insisting they put it in the bag the first time. After a brief argument, they let me go with my PAID FOR food and told me not to make this mistake again.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I have been coming here once a year for about 3 years now. They are very good with Asian hair, that's the major reason why I come here. 

The 1st time I came here there was a lot of eye-balling going on, but only for a short while. The staff is young & chatty, even though I only visit the place once a year, they always remember me. 

They are VERY good with my hair and they give me useful tips that I normally wouldn't get elsewhere. 

I love this place, however, I wouldn't recommend you to visit this place unless you're asian and speak some chinese.

Of all the Subway's I've been to, this is by far the worst one. I came in with my date for a coupon for 2 footlongs for $12 and the woman working said it didn't apply for any beef (ie my steak and cheese). The coupon's only restriction was no ciabatta bread/specials, but when I pointed that out she was flat out rude, unapologetic, and wouldn't honor the coupon. Needless to say these people at this location need a major attitude adjustment and need to learn how to respect their customers.

Will definitely never be coming back to this location. Shout out to the Fairview location for honoring the coupon plus apologizing on the woman's behalf!

Employees at this Wells Fargo branch provided me with incorrect and contradictory information, which led to problems depositing my paycheck and left me SOL on the West Coast without money for a place to sleep and barely any money for food.  After being made aware how this was clearly a result of THEIR ERRONEOUS INFORMATION a manager here refused to accept responsibility and gave me only a very cursory apology.  I filed a complaint to the district manager.  Really, a bank should try to move heaven and earth to avoid making a customer SLEEP ON THE STREET BECAUSE OF THEIR ERROR.  Frightfully unprofessional, avoid depending on them.

Location of the hotel is close to food and shopping and in a safe area. The staff was friendly and the check-in and check-out was very easy. However, our room was not cleaned very good. My wife found dog food on the floor and a toy alligator behind the couch/bed. I understand we are still dealing with COVID-19, but there was no hot breakfast buffet. They had cereal, yogurt, and breakfast bars. They ran out of juice the 1 day we decided to eat breakfast at the hotel. I also had to get under the cabinet to get more plastic silverware packs.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: This is the WORST McDonald's in the area. Everything is fine until you get your order. I try to keep giving it a chance but EVERYTIME my order is given to me wrong. Examples-- being given regular coke instead of diet. Given bbq sauce instead of Buffalo. Given a double cheeseburger instead of a McDouble. The screen is correct at the time of ordering so the disconnect is between the workers inside and the screen. They either can't read or don't care enough to get the order correct-- i HIGHLY SUGGEST you drive an extra few miles up the road to go to a different location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
Do not rent from Executive. It takes forever to get a hold of anyone. When you do get a hold of someone, they will put you on hold only to hang up on you.
They will force you to buy their collision insurance claiming your insurance isn't valid as collision insurance and also claim that they and all the car rentals at the airport don't take insurance via Priceline's Allianz due to them "not paying their claims"
Deposit takes forever to process and be returned. Everytime you call, they give you a new excuse as to why it hasn't been processed.
Pay a few dollars more to book via other car rentals to save yourself the headache and inconvenience.

Had been coming here for years and it was always delicious, however I went there a few days ago and the food dramatically changed. I ordered a tostada de camarón and the tostada was smothered exaggeratedly with Mayo it should be called a tostada de mayonesa instead of camarón . The tacos were not how I remember them. I don't know if they changed cooks or what. Also the cashiers seem like they had no idea what they were doing. I just hope they can improve their food and service to what it once was. I was so excited to go and eat there again but I was so disappointed.

Absolutely horrible. The clerk offered an upgrade for 18.00 per night extra. When I got the bill two days later (they are not open 24 hours and if you drop off after hours you can't review your bill and they charge 9.00 for parking) they charge 40.00 for the upgrade. Also, they asked me if I wanted to buy a tank of gas in advance for 2.23 per gallon. I agreed and brought it back on empty (like they instructed) later got charged 141.00 for 17 gallons of gas at 7.99 per gallon. Spoke to manager and he said he would look into it but never called me back. Left several messages but still no call. Will absolutely never use dollar again.

This was a great, cozy place to stay! Within very short distance to Tampa General Hospital. The beds were comfortable and we loved having a kitchen. Elizabeth, with whom we made reservations and worked with throughout our stay, was extremely helpful. We also were able to walk to some very good restaurants, Oggi for great Italian food and service and Plum Tree Chinese, for very good wings, dumplings,  and soups. Would highly recommend. If you're someone that appreciates a well-cared for building and grounds from 1925, this will be a great place for you. Another plus, the rooms are very reasonable especially for such a great location. Thank you!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
We requested a board room and full dining service for a staff meeting over a month in advance and never received formal confirmation for the room. They gave us vague responses via telephone and email, but acted very excited and enthusiastic for our business. They assured us we'd have the room but never actually committed even as late as the morning of our meeting.

The person we worked with, Kenny Truxillo, was incredibly unreliable, unprofessional and lacked a business sense. We were very disappointed and would not use the Q & C for either hotel or meeting needs again.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Been going to this car wash for years. Cheap and decent wash. Customer service is terrible. There were times when I would go and got the impression that I should have washed the car before I came there. This Friday I went and was directed to turn this way and got the ok. Say and waited to move up. After being shouted at to move up apparently I was directed wrong and was treated as if I did something wrong. The man I assume who runs this place shouted that "he comes here all the time ". Why to treat a long time customer. I won't be coming back.

Trying to get someone on the phone is such a hassle. Sure they pick up quickly then put you on hold for 15 mind at least. Once at the appointment the doctor and his assistant were really friendly but the girls at the front desk, not so much. The glasses took the full 14 business days to get back. Which is basically 3 weeks. And now they finally got here the frames broke within the first 2 weeks. And when I called to order a replacement I was on hold again for over half an hour. It's a real bummer my eye insurance only worked with nationwide for some reason. So I'm switching insurance come open enrollment
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Hotel bed was full of hair and crumbs when the sheets were pulled open to go to sleep. When we called to the front we were treated rudely (by one of the manager none the less) and were told their house cleaning staff was all gone for the night and that we could put new sheets on. Ummmm. No. When paying for a hotel you expect the room to have been cleaned and not still have the previous guests hair in the bed! Also you'd think a manager would be much more customer focused and not so rude. We can put clean sheets on! Seriously? Very disappointing.

Gave 2 stars instead of 1 because food in the bar was good.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: If you love sushi, than you will love Sushikazu! I would consider myself a sushi foodie and Sushikazu never disappoints. Let me tell you, their assortment of various fresh fish as well as grilled options are absolutely delicious. I usually order the Honeymoon roll and the King Crab Dynamite roll and top the meal off with their tempura ice cream (you must order this for dessert, it is absolutely mouthwatering!!)
