Sushikazu is currently under new management by head chef/owner Jay Park, who is definitely one of the best sushi chefs in the Philadelphia area.

As always, Enterprise is the best. I love getting an email so that when I open my phone as the plane lands I know just where to go to get to the Enterprise location. I rarely wait in a long line at Enterprise and the friendly service that is provided at pick up and drop off is consistently outstanding.  Cars are clean, often have satellite radio (a huge plus) and I am given instructions on things like how to open the flap to the gas tank. I travel often and choose Enterprise as often as I possibly can. This location is no exception. I will be back.

I reserved a car online only to go there to the site and to have them tell me that "there is no car available". After that they gave me a card and I was basically on my own. Maybe it's done differently in Tucson, but usually the people at the desk will check to see if there are other available cars at other Enterprises.It is unprofessional to have customers reserve cars only to say that you don't have cars available.. this is especially horrible for out of state people. 

IF you are a customer, either call in or choose another site.. you may not get a car if you reserve it online and no one will tell you that until you've gotten there

This place gets 2 stars only because the location and views are great. I ate there the other night with 3 others and it was very disappointing. The service was terrible. The waiter spilled a drink an a chair and sweater of ours and just looked at it and never came back. Another staff member noticed and came to wipe it up. The waiter never checked with us after we received our food, otherwise we would have sent the pizza back, it was completely dark brown on top. The baked pastas were nothing special, just topped with lots of cheese and everything is served on plastic dishes.

New to the area and was looking for a good Mexican meal. The reviews of people who had moved here from the Southwest and raved about it convinced me to try with me wife and daughter and we all loved it. Home made chips best we've ever had, and a surprisingly varied menu. Stuck to a tried and true burrito which was delicious. A very talented gentleman played guitar and harmonica and sang. He came to our table and sang "Teensy Weensy Spider" to my 10-month old grandson, who thoroughly enjoyed the event as well. Going back to check out the rest of the menu. Service is excellent and prices are very reasonable

I've rented cars hundreds of times in my career but I've never experienced such great service from a rental company.  The shuttle bus actually showed up quickly and the driver was very nice and helpful.  Once at the rental center we were greeted by a very nice young man who handled the entire transaction quickly and professionally.  The Center actually had plenty of staff so the process was very quick.  We also received water and soft pretzels before we left.  By far the best rental car experience I've ever had !

Excellent service, which is something I never thought I would say about any care service establishment. Lee is awesome--honest, very fair, looking to help you out instead of squeeze every cent out of you. This was the first time I went for basic maintenance and wasn't told I needed to do a handful of other services as well. Oil change and inspection done at a fraction of the cost of what the dealership costs, and done quickly. I will certainly be going back here for the rest of my car needs in the future, even for larger ticket service items.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
Tried Enterprise the first time because they were the least expensive.  Now I rent from Enterprise wherever I go because in addition to the economy, they are by far the best in customer service.  From the genuinely friendly greeting on arrival to the very accommodating and patient attitude when assisting us in picking out a car (my wife is particular about style and color) the experience with Enterprise is always great.
On top of that, we get those pretzels at the Philadelphia Airport location for a real Philly welcome!
I'm traveling again next week to Los Angeles and I've already reserved an Enterprise car.

What a scam. Booked a Luxury Car for 4 days via Priceline. This was meant to be a Chrysler 300 or similar. After the paperwork was completed they offered me a Nissan Altima which is no luxury car. When I protested they said they had no luxury cars. I spoke to their manager Toni who said "too bad so sad". When I insisted that they refund my money they said there would be a $300 cancellation fee even though they did a bait and switch on me. Luckily the car was paid with my Chase Ink Card who said they would protect me. Such scams should not be allowed to stay in business. Renter beware

What a scam. Booked a Luxury Car for 4 days via Priceline. This was meant to be a Chrysler 300 or similar. After the paperwork was completed they offered me a Nissan Altima which is no luxury car. When I protested they said they had no luxury cars. I spoke to their manager Toni who said "too bad so sad". When I insisted that they refund my money they said there would be a $300 cancellation fee even though they did a bait and switch on me. Luckily the car was paid with my Chade Ink Card who said they would protect me. Such scams should not be allowed to stay in business. Renters be wary.

My husband and I have been to Chiarella's numerous times, and we are never disappointed.  The food is delicious and the staff are super friendly and attentive.  On our most recent visit, I ordered the Veal special, which was lightly breaded with Mozzarella cheese and roasted red peppers on top.  It was so yummy. My husband ordered the Ahi Tuna special which was absolutely incredible.  The atmosphere in this restaurant is warm and cozy, and the staff makes you feel at home.  I really enjoy eating here, and would consider it one of the best restaurant's in the East Passyunk neighborhood.

DO NOT STAY AT THIS HOTEL!!!! My fiancé and I had thousands of dollars worth of stuff stolen from this hotel. Management never apologized or acted concerned at all. When the police were taking the police report he said this happens all the time at this hotel. He said that people from the streets walk up and down the halls checking for doors that haven't fully shut. 

It feels horrible to have your space violated by a stranger and have your stuff stolen. It is worse to have the people that were suppose to have taken care of your things act so poorly and never apologize or seem surprised.

DO NOT STAY AT THIS HOTEL!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Went in for the first time ever and I was very lucky to meet and be taken care by Hannah. She did an OUTSTANDING JOB, I could not stay put on my seat she's a hype master and I love it. She took her time, she is a perfectionist which is great, she listened to my every complicated need haha. She so sweet and I had so much fun talking to her and getting to know her. I will be back FOR HER! HANNAH I LOVE YOU, YOU ARE GREAT. :) point here is she is FIRE. Don't forget to tip ya'll she deserve EVERY DOLLAR you can give.

The absolute worst!! I have been traveling for my job for about 2 years non stop and I have to stay this is the worst place I've ever been booked in. They told us that due to maintenance, the water would be shut off one day between 11am and 2pm, but they didn't tell us that would cause no hot water until the next day! The next day, I was greeted with a note on my door saying it was happening again and this time it caused blackish sludge to come out of the sink and toilets for 5 hours after, and NO AC IN 97 DEGREE WEATHER!!, plus questionable hygiene of their upholstery! Ugh! This place needs An exorcism!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
My daughter and I went through the Drive-Thru on 9/22 at around 6:45 pm. As we were waiting for our food we watched a RAT run from the eastern side of the building to an island in the parking lot.

Less than a minute later, a SECOND rat ran across the drive from the same area on side of the building. 

I told the the teenage girl who came to the window that we just saw two rats run across the drive in front of our car.  Apparently they're already aware of the rats, as her nonchalant reply was, "oh, yeah, uh, that's not our problem". 

Hello Boothwyn McDonalds: rats romping through a fast food restaurant drive-thru at dinner time IS A PROBLEM.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Worst experience at a salon. Purchased a groupon and every time I called they could not get me an appointment. I would call back when I knew my schedule and same thing, this went on for weeks. Finally they said they hired a new girl who was great and schedule me for the next week. Oh my, it was the worst. She didn't know how to paint toe nails at all. My 8 year old niece has painted my nails better I am sorry to say. The tech had to redo my nails over and over. It was really bad.  The gels for my fingers wasn't any better. I really do not want to keep going on, I think you get the picture. Really poor service. Do not recommend.

I belonged to this gym for a year and many of the equipment was consistently broken.  The owner is a bodybuilder from New York and is not very friendly.  I only joined this gym as I was working different shifts for a year and it was conveniently located.  If I could give it less than a one rating I would, my advice is stay away.  The owner recently told a friend of mine that his membership would not be renewed as he was taking to long to workout and talking to his friends, Gino should change the name to sometimes fitness.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: Shane at the St. Petersburg/Clearwater Airport Enterprise location was professional and very helpful. We rented a 12 person van and the one we originally picked up was very nice but after two days, the a/c blew hot air. We went back and they gave us a 12 person can that hadn't been cleaned and smelled like manure. Then we were given, as a last resort, a Kia Sedona. We decided to make it work since the a/c worked and it didn't smell bad. We lost an afternoon of vacation and though we were assured our rate would be adjusted down, it wasn't. But bottom line, Shane was great.

I rent from this location twice a year.  On both occasions I was charged a fuel service charge despite the fact I had topped off the car, to the point of overflowing, within 3 miles of the rental facility.   

The first occurrence was for 17 gallons!!!  On my last visit I was asked "did I fill up" I answered yes and indicated the last fill up was to top off, which it was right to the brim.  The car was full! 

Make sure you verify, with a receipt, that you filled up and check your receipt!! 

Avoid renting here if you can

I normally don't write reviews but this place is amazing! I have always had the most relaxing and calming experience here. You can tell the owner really cares about her business and customers and is constantly moving around the salon, organizing, cleaning and tending to the the customers.

 I used to frequent another salon in the area that was so filthy but I went there because it was cheaper until the lack of cleanliness because unbeatable and probably a health hazard. Cinderella nails is pristine and absolutely worth every penny for their amazing services.

Great location! Love this place and all of the things they offer to their guests! Free chilled water was absolutely perfect! 

The room wasn't so spacey, but that's okay because on vacation I do not hangout in my room I come to explore and just sleep. Which the beds were super comfy. 

The only weird thing was at 10 am I got woken up because someone opened my door and my boyfriend was sleeping next to me.. So I don't know who that was, kinda scary since this is a new city and that happened. Definitely couldn't fall back asleep after that .. That is the only reason it doesn't get 5 stars from me.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: After months of waiting for the Suchi Club on 10th St. to reopen the dine-in option so I could get the all you can eat suchi. Their website says the price on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday is $19.99, it's $22.99 at other times. I went there for lunch on a Thursday. They charged me the full $22.99. So don't believe what their website says. I will say I enjoyed the food, but the least they could have done is tell me about the price increase, so no .... they didn't do the least they could do. You might also want to know that soda's cost $1.25/can, awfully expensive for a restaurant.

Accompanied my husband on business trip to Indianapolis,  searched Yelp for restaurant . Both in the mood for Italian food. Best reviews were for Ambrosia. Out of way from where we were staying, but worth the drive! Best waiter ever, "David". Service was outstanding. Never felt rushed. Atmosphere romantic, casual,.food was delicious, calamari , beet salad and fettuccini Alfredo with shrimp. Compliments to the bartender, sorry I didn't catch her name, but my Vanilla Cold Brew Martini for dessert was delicious. Highly recommend.

It is so sad that I cannot give 0 star. I've been here twice cause it is close to an Expo I attended. The first time I visited here, the waitress was very rude to serve me, an Asian customer, but super friendly to white customers. The second time I came here was picking up. They didn't even give me the bill before they swiped my card. And it was a wrong bill! Their attitude was pretty bad to deal with their mistake. Anyway, the food was just okay, but the attitude of the waitress and owner was super bad. Wouldn't come here anymore

I made an 8:00 appointment for a rotation and balance. When I arrived promptly at 8:00 the gentleman at the desk informed me it would be a 3 and 1/2 hour wait. I have to ask why to you accept appointments if you cannot honor them?  This is reflective of a poor customer experience related to extremely ineffective management.  I'll be needing tires later this year and this store is one that will absolutely not get my business.  I would recommend others look elsewhere as well and find a place where the customers are valued.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: My wife and I went to Kroger this morning to pick up a few groceries.  Since we're seniors, we arrived about 6:50 a.m., knowing that the store hours for seniors ( people 60 years old or older ) are specifically from 7:00 a.m. - 8:00 a.m.  There we're multiple people younger than 60 years old inside the store.  Obviously, Kroger is NOT enforcing their senior policy in regard to what they are advertising on television.  So much for their concern about senior safety.  I guess that is a policy that sounds good to the public.  However, Kroger is just like most all businesses....it's all about the money.

Front desk staff is the  problem at this hotel. On march 13 8 am Karen was working the front desk
 She has a nasty attitude and complete lack of customer service skills. Her behavior at the desk, in front of a lobby full of customers, was embarrassing for her coworkers. She told a customer that "she didn't have time for her" and used profanity despite another employee trying to calm her down.  Valet staff was really great. The room was fine, but housekeeping took dirty towels and didn't leave clean ones and no one can unlock the towels before 9 am. !?!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: There are definitely better pizza places in New Orleans, although the sandwiches are pretty good and fairly priced.  I went a few times when I lived in NOLA, and the absolute best part of going there was the bartender, Anthony.  The other people behind the bar were nice enough, but certainly not attentive in the way that Anthony was.  As someone who has worked in the service industry in that town myself, the personal attention he gave to each customer is what kept me going back.  New Orleans is a foodie town, and if a restaurant doesn't measure up in food, it has to rely on its staff to keep it open.

The exterior wash by the machine was okay. The hand dry of the exterior and interior wipe down was poor. Streaks left on the windshield, inside and out, from wet towels that perhaps had some tire or dashboard dressing on them. Floor mats put back in car dripping wet after I asked the young man to dry them off before putting them back into the care. Used to be a good place years ago, but has gone downhill. No heating inside the building for waiting when it's cold outside, poor lighting, worn out carpet -- needs remodeling.

MOST HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE EVER My son was stranded due to storms. After some mix up with the insurance company he was finally told 9 hrs later that someone was coming out to tow his car. 3 hrs later he was informed that this tow company would NOT come out til they were paid. The owner then told my son his money was more important than helping my son. He also told my son that it's his fault for leaving his vehicle there. I will never use this company and we ended getting another company to come out. Also put a complain't in with the insurance company.

Ordered two pizzas after confirming they had gluten free pizzas available. One was brought out first, so we dug in, not realizing until the second pizza arrived that the first one was NOT gluten free (both very thin crusts). Very disappointed the server didn't confirm we wanted a regular pizza, particularly when we asked what the gluten free options were before even ordering. Now I'm sick and will have to spend the next two weeks healing my gut. I understand not everyone will have this reaction, but they need to be cognizant that people who seek out gluten free options most often do so for specific health reasons. Please take care.

Not the worst hotel stay I've experienced but definitely up there.  For starters, the room was not cleaned properly.  Visible dust on furniture and the carpet needed to be vacuumed.  There was one small garbage can in the bathroom with no liner.  The lighting in the bathroom is horrible.  There is also no ventilation system and the shower pressure is weak.  It took two phone calls (separate days) to get someone to bring up fresh towels, replenish the coffee and an extra roll of toilet paper.  The room left a lot to be desired.  It's such a shame, the downstairs lobby is really cute and cozy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: My girlfriend and I moved into the Laurel last month from Seattle and they couldn't have made it any easier. Our leasing agent, Haley, always responded in a timely manner and was very helpful. The place is clean and the concierges (Raphael and Aunray) are extremely polite. There is also discounts on great places to eat that are in walking distance. Our favorite places to go so far are Sugarfire and Hi-Pointe. The only downside has been the parking garage which is a little cramped. Wish I could give this place closer to a 5 star than a 4 star. I'm sure this next year at the Laurel will be great.

The absolute best car rental experience I've ever had was at the National Car Rental in Nashville! I had received an upsetting phone call while getting off of my plane. By the time I arrived at the car rental counter, I was almost in tears and could not speak. The wonderful agent saw that I was distraught. She gave me a cold bottle of water, asked what kind of car I preferred, took me to the car, loaded my luggage, asked if I needed directions, then gave me instructions on how to exit the garage...all without me saying more than 3 words! When I go back to Nashville, I will rent from National!! Great service, with a smile!!

The outdoor area was great and food very good and that is where things stop     The service this past Saturday afternoon was so bad and being in the hospitality business and understanding some of the challenges I don't forgive poor service since those on the front line represent me.  The sever was in another world and her follow up was pathetic to say the least .   Asked for pepper never delivered, asked for bread never followed up,  never asked how our meal was  and forget getting the bill     Such a shame since the food was very good

I must give credit where credit it due!  We went to Sapori yesterday between lunch and dinner.  The owner was gracious enough to serve us dinner when they were closed.  My husband, two young boys and I sat down and had a fabulous meal!!  As soon as we walked thru the front door, we were treated like family.  The appetizers were hand made delicious morsels.  The entrees that the owner elected for us were beyond description.  We live in Pennsylvania, but can assure Sapori....WE WILL BE BACK!!  Thank you again!

Trash attitudes. My employee ordered 5 pizzas for a team party. The number listed for this location is apparently actually for Eastbay. Manager says he can have the pizza brought over for me in about 5 minutes. 45 minutes later I let him know that I'll have to leave because my lunch break is over. His reply? " what do you want it isn't my fault" 

My employee calls the Eastbay location and the manager tells her over and over that " we will be taken care of", but instead in Clearwater I'm met with a poor attitude and full price for hour old pizza. Last time I order from you again.

Went to get my favorite cup of latte and the guy made it so wrong. I don't even think he knew what or how to make a vanilla cha latte. Disgusting. On my way home and realized that it tasted like hot chocolate. It wasn't even HOT. Went to another Dunkin down the way same street 1941 w main and tried to explain that I was not happy and the man told me he cld not make me another one without paying for it. Mind you he was going to take it without me mentioning that I brought this cup of latte at another Dunkin......UM isn't it the same product???? Foolery!!!!!!

It's been almost 6 hours and still no news. Took 2 hours after our arrival before I even got to talk to a vet tech. Finally talked to the doctor three and a half hours ago when they initially took my dog back and she told me she had an idea what it might be but they just needed to take an X-ray and blood draw to be sure. When they brought my dog back three hours ago, I was told the doctor would let me know shortly. All of this is after I called ahead to see if I should bring my dog in or if the issue could wait until Monday and was told I should bring him in ASAP. Will not be returning anytime soon.

This has to be one of the WORST experiences I have ever experienced. The food was not overly priced. I had the bam bam shrimp and it was OK, I also ordered the Chicken Alfredo this was the worst I have ever tasted, the toss salad tasted like GRASS, and the drink sex on the beach was not tasteful. I don't think I ate anything I ordered except the shrimp and I didn't finish the drink . I was there for a bridal shower the waiter was a wreck from the time we walked in, he apologized a thousand times it was just a bad experience and I will never return.

This Hotel if you want to call it that...... is terrible!  Staff lacks knowledge and management is worse.  Elevator didn't operate, staff had no idea where to send us for a beer and our all around stay was horrible.  They charged me for my room although it was a paid room!  I can't get my money back from them so I'm finally disputing  the charges on the debit card.  Yes debit charge so they got my money, money I need to pay bills. They didn't care.  Jeff the general manager would not help me, told me to call my credit card company and dispute the charges even gave me the phone number.  DO NOT STAY AT THIS HOTEL!!!!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: If I could give less than one star, I would. The accommodations were pretty much what you would expect when pulling up to a place like that. I didn't mind it but the priced seemed okay. When I woke up the next morning I had a few bites that I noticed. Within hours I realize I was riddled with no less than 25 bed bug bites. Including my face, neck, hands, and legs. It was the most disgusting thing I've ever seen. I left a day early because I couldn't stand the idea of staying another night there. I do not recommend it.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I love wendys but this location was not good at all. Customer service was horrible- walked in with my boyfriend and nobody wanted to take our order. All the employees were standing around doing nothing but just stared at us and ignored us. A women who seemed to be the manager noticed and pointed for someone to help us- a girl from the back came. Not sure why there's people in the front if they aren't going to do their job. I will say the manager was nice and I appreciate that she tried to make us happy but I suggest finding some new employees or retraining. The food was not even good so it wasn't worth it, I can go to a better wendys.

Three night stay mid-April 2016 in a first floor room with two queen beds. Motel looks great, very well-maintained grounds. First night occupants above checked in at 4 a.m. They kept rolling desk chair or rolling luggage back and forth on linoleum floor. They also showered and plumbing made loud vibrating, jack hammer sound. Complained to desk, but they hadn't heard of that complaint. Strange because our shower made same loud sound as did at least two showers in adjoining rooms. No HD tv also weak Wifi. Free breakfast nothing to write home about. I think you can find better value for your money.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Although the hotel grounds are attractive, the Service Level provided at the property is a disaster. The Hotel Management is not in line with the type of property and the staff has not been trained properly. We experienced delays in checking-in, the Manager completely failed to address concerns about our room (cleanliness level/ noise concerns) and simply does not get it when it comes to meeting guest expectations!  There are many more better options in Philly so choose a location where one actually feels welcomed and not stressed by a Manager and staff who do not know how to manage an hotel!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Because I had not rented from Hertz in a couple of years they closed my Gold membership and I had to open a new account. That meant that I had to stop at the counter to show my license and credit card.  There was only one clerk at the desk and I had to wait 10-15 min while the clerk apparently explained the origin of the universe to the couple. Once I reached the lone clerk it took less than 5 min and from there it was a simple, streamlined process to pick up the car and later to return it.  I forgot to stop at a gas station on return, however, and I paid an enormous sum for Hertz gas.

Terrible! We had to be switched rooms because the first one was dirty. Breakfast service area is dirty no one cleans that area. Housekeeping staff is rude! You ask for your room to be done and no one does it. We found pubic hairs in our beds Gross!!! They throw some towels on the dirty sofa and leave! They don't even put them in the bathroom. Dirty towels are left in the room and they don't even replace toilet paper! No one cares! They make you feel like you're complaining for nothing and it's your fault. Horrible place! I'm not expecting anything with this review but to let people know how things work in this place!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Downright rude today.  Counter guy not wearing a mask.  I asked if his workers would be wearing a mask and gloves in my car.  I explained that I am on chemo and have a compromised immune system.  This was not a confrontational encounter, but his response was to tell me to go somewhere else.  No concern or accomodation.   He defininetly did not like be called on the fact that he was not wearing a mask and his shop guys were not and yet he tells me that they will.  He told me to leave if I didnt like it.  OK then, I did.  Terrible customer service on this guys part.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This salon is amazing. Everyone is so kind and professional. I came in to see John following a bit of a fiasco dye-job at another salon. My hair was VERY yellow, uneven in color, and overall unflattering. Not only did John transform it to a beautiful color, but the texture is much better than when I first walked in. He's a true artist and wonderful at what he does. The overall experience was great as well with a complimentary hand massage while I waited for my color to set and refreshments offered. I finally found 'my' salon and will absolutely be coming back.

Excellent service. I had a question about pricing and understanding how to maximize my experience in the automatic bay. I left the owner a comment card, (located at the top of the bill change machine) with my contact information, followed by my questions/concerns. The owner got back to me within 24 hours and assisted me with all of my needs. I love that I had the option to reach out to a real person. Following our telephone conversation, I received a refund in the mail for the total cost of my car wash. Marty really cares about his customers and I appreciate that he was patient with me. My concerns turned out to be user error.

This is the first time we stayed at a Homewood Suites and it won't be our last. We were in Clearwater to visit family and friends for Thanksgiving. The location was easy to get to (we drove down from Atlanta) and close to close to our friends plus it is a straight drive to Indian Rocks Beach.

It looks to be recently remodeled. Our king room suite was clean and roomy. We were there for 3 nights so the extra room and full kitchen was nice to have. There is a nice area that breakfast and dinners (M thru Th) are served free. Also, there is a very nice outdoor patio/pool area just behind the indoor eating room to enjoy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I ordered a couple pizzas and salad for my family for delivery and paid with a credit card. Waited for an hour and a half. I finally called and they said it had been sitting there because they wrote it down as a pick up. Why didn't they call? Did they wander why it had been sitting for an hour and a half? No apologies and actually asked if I wanted them to go ahead and deliver the food. Really?  After its been sitting for an hour and a half? They did not offer to make new pizza just to refund my credit card.

It is amazing to me that on August 7, 2020, this store chooses to rearrange the design of its store.  This means there were many, many personnel in the store at 10 am on a Friday.  This included men standing around chatting, most likely there to be sure they received proper shelf space.
We are told to social distance.  Impossible in this store.  
Now, everyone who shops here will have to search & spend more time in this store trying to find the items they need.  This means more exposure to Covid-19.
Where is your humanity, Rouses Family?  Shame, shame, shame on you.  You also chose to delete my post from your website.  I will not be silenced!

So I ordered a pizza online last week from Yelp and it said free brownie with ANY online order of $15 or more. Well, I didn't get the brownie. So I order online again tonight and wrote in the special instructions free brownie to make sure they did it. They call me to tell me that for me to get the brownie they will have to void the order and I'll have to redo the order and put in some code that never once appeared on my screen. I told them if it's that much hassle then to go ahead and cancel my $25 order and I'll get it from somewhere else. No apology, no let me just change it, just an OK. Worst customer service ever.

Wow. In town for the first time visiting family. I was very skeptic about getting a haircut and beardtrim as its. I also wasn't the best customer. I had just got out of the gym, was sweaty and didn't have an appointment.  I have a long beard and it was dry. I was lucky in that my barber Hamid's appointment was late and he was able to fit me in quick. Best haircut of my life. Epic beard trim. Not only that, but it was on the very much cheaper side for having such a professional, comfortable cut. I had to pay for the customer after me just so I could pay it forward.

The menu has changed. Prices are high and food is basic.  I came here to have a great meal and sat outside. Had to endure cigarette smoke, basic and very bland Mexican food. Pay for chips and added $8 for guacamole that was horrible and salsa without a kick. If you want American Mexican food, this is your place. A table that was never cleared, watery sangria and a total disappointment. I find that Coyote Rojo #4 is the place to go! Skip Chulas and avoid being disappointed! Oh, it got dark and finally the waitress remembered to turn on the lights. Adios Chulas. Never again! $90 dollar for 3 and a total disappointment!!!

BE CAREFUL! The do not disturb sign on your door means nothing. Went for a company meeting and was very happy about the rooms only to come back and find housekeeping had been inside my room (with sign on door) and somehow important medication went missing- the hotel did nothing- they ran a report on who entered my room and said they had the wrong room and were only in their for 5 mins. Felt very violated and hotel was defensive and unaccommodating. It's also very very difficult to get in touch with concierge, room service, or front desk via phone
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: BECAREFUL ! I rented a car 05/27 - 05/29/2019 that is 2 days. The total for the 2 days was $330.98, I may get $95.97 back , that remains to be seen. The price is not the reason I am writing this review (which was supposed to be $38.10 per day). The reason for this review is the fact when I took the car back there was no one there to check the car in, I had an early morning flight to catch. In the rush of catching my flight I left my "GPS" in the car, (that GPS is my life) I have tried everything to get it back, they will not return phone calls,  they will not return e-mails, everything you get a hold of is automated... I want my GPS back..

RUDE!
What a shame... The whole place was so beautiful, but the person who worked on me was not. It was so clear that he just didn't want to work. He kept reassuring me that I would not get hurt, and did my nails all crooked. When I asked for the simplest request, he spoke in frustration. "I can't do that! This is all I have!" I asked for a small letter in the corner of one of my nails. "Be grateful I didn't charge you." He wrote the letter very largely and it took over my whole nail. Don't go to this place. I know he was trying to be patient and courteous, by why offer nail art if you can't do it?

I don't think the guy not knowing how to do hair cut to his female customers, the girl asked for shoulder length cut with layers after that it looks like that her hair was being cut by a unprofessional or new learner. Also they own the business there for awhile, and this is the second time he did it for the other friend of mine. I see three young guys there with no other female customer except me, probably they only know how to cut short hair without any styling, just what it's saying "boom hair" that my hair looks like a broom stick. I plan to go back to the one I used to do my hair and correct the unprofessional cut tomorrow.

This hotel has serious quality issues with the AC and the stale smell of smoke throughout the property.  Other guests were smoking on our floor and the hotel seems to be noisier than others in this price range.  The staff is excellent and really friendly.  I hate to write a negative review because they go out of their way to help solve problems and make you feel welcome.  The restaurant has good food and overall the hotel is acceptable.  In its current state, I would not stay here again due AC and the smell.  If you just want good friendly hosts then this is your place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I am not sure if the call-ahead strategy works for me. I am a working woman and the fact I have limited free time usually means I can only get my nails done on the weekend. I have been going to The Nail Bar for over a year. At first I loved the decor, the professionalism and no fume atmosphere. However, after a while I didn't feel like the 30 minute ride and higher prices may not be worth it. my phone messages are never returned, the parking is limited, when I CAN get a time slot I am usually rushed through and there are no extra perks that I have experienced at other salons, such as a hot stone massage while your nails dry. I feel cheated.

Went for the All You Can Eat Sushi with a group of friends. The sushi was good for the most part. The Spicy Salmon was ground up salmon which makes me gag due to the texture. The service was poor. No one paid attention to our table and I'm a pretty patient person from working in retail myself. I ran out of water and no one stopped to check if we needed anything additional to drink or to make sure everything was ok. They were slightly busy for being all you can eat but doesn't excuse the situation. Don't think I would go back.

Worst customer service I've ever experienced. Normally, customer service wouldn't completely ruin a company for me, but a company that guarantees access to vehicles around the city needs to have customer service in case something goes wrong. I left Blue Indy 6 months ago and a couple weeks ago I got a random charge on my credit card from them. I contacted support and guess what they did... they credited my account $11. Thanks Blue-Indy. Can't wait to use that credit to pay for more Blue-Indy rides with my cancelled account.

We ordered our food through Uber eats and it arrived cold. It is unfortunate that it arrived in this condition because overall the taste was pretty good. Wish that there weren't so many missing items also, like our black beans and rice, the toppings on our chicken taquitos and all of the utensils to eat our meals with. 

I understand that things can be difficult when you're busy but hopefully you can be better next time. Additionally the credit that we were supposed to receive still hasn't been given to us for the missing items.

I only have an hour lunch break so I decided to call ahead. The lady on the phone was beyond rude. First she started taking my order then told me to hold on as she took the order for someone dining in. When she came back I proceeded with my order. When asking for no onions for a friend who is allergic she made a huge deal and continuously sighedvery loudly through the phone. The whole time I felt as if she wanted us to know she was annoyed. Once I completed my order she just hung up the phone on me. When I picked up my food the guy at the counter was nice and fast. Wish he was the one who took my order.

I only have an hour lunch break so I decided to call ahead. The lady on the phone was beyond rude. First she started taking my order then told me to hold on as she took the order for someone dining in. When she came back I proceeded with my order. When asking for no onions for a friend who is allergic she made a huge deal and continuously sighed very loudly through the phone. The whole time I felt as if she wanted us to know she was annoyed. Once I completed my order she just hung up the phone on me. When I picked up my food the guy at the counter was nice and fast. Wish he was the one who took my order.

My experience was with a male employee. Although he was friendly enough, it was honestly the worst gel manicure I have ever had! I can't believe how sloppy it is and he even left the building while my nails were drying for a cigarette break lol. I'm so upset with myself for walking out of there without saying anything because of my non-confrontational ways. On top of that, I even left a tip  oh well. Lesson learned. To be fair, other customers seemed to love their nails so if you do try this place, just be forewarned.

this is a good clinic. BUT they are very expensive. just annual check up and shots for 2 yr old golden was over $200....that is really high.
plus, we went to order our heartguard and frontline online at 1-800-pet-meds because its cheaper. in order to do that you need a prescription from the vet. they USED to be very kind about it and fax the 'script for us, now they state they will NO LONGER fax, and you must go in, pick it up and find somewhere to fax it. we thought that was rude, not good customer service. prices are very high. we would love to have a 2nd dog, but would have to find another vet due to expense.

I would not recommend this hotel and as a result of this experience I will steer clear of red lion hotels in the future. The receptionist was flippant when checking me in which wasn't a big deal but the lack of cleanliness of our room was. Our bed did appear to be clean with new sheets but beyond that the room was not. There was hair clinging to the toilet and visible hair and dirt on the floor. There was a used fork lying on the floor outside our door presumably from room service from who knows how long ago. And the hallway carpet was filthy, looking like it had been a week since it had been vacuum. Yuck.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: CANT GET THEIR ACT TOGETHER. Placed order and confirmed at drive through. Got to first window and had no record of my order. They entered it and I paid at the window. Move to second window and THEY don't have a record of the order. I show receipt and they give me my drink but no sandwiches. End up waiting an extra 10 minutes for my sandwiches outside. After waiting in go inside and the guy is SWEEPING THE FLOOR. And my sandwiches STILL aren't made. Manager offers me two free meal coupons when my order comes up and it's not what I ordered at all. Never coming back to this location.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
ROACHES ROACHES ROACHES

I've stayed in countless hotels in countless cities all over the east coast. And I've never had roaches in my hotel room. Until this hotel in Philadelphia. All the hotel staff did was switch our room. No offer of free breakfast at the restaurant, or a partial refund on my stay. Not even to comp the $30 parking fee. The staff told me the hotel manager would reach out to me but no one ever did. Horribly unprofessional.
The pillows were tremendously uncomfortable and the bed sheets had someone else's hair all over it, but those were the least of my concerns after dealing with two roaches in the room.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: We ate here for NYE and while I understand it is busy on a day such as this, it was the most unorganized establishment I have ever eaten in.  The food was just okay for the extremely high price.  Instead of assigning a waitress to a particular table, you were served by all of the waitresses.  This caused mass confusion!  I saw several patrons sitting there waiting for drinks, waiting for food, waiting for their check, etc....And lastly, an adult at our table used the bathroom and said it was extremely filthy.  This really makes me wonder what the kitchen looks like??!!

They get two stars for their breakfast, which unto itself would be four star rated. However, the staff dress unprofessionally, (jeans at the front desk) any request made of them is responded to with an attitude, the 'bellhops' didn't have any carts, and the free coffee always seems to be empty. I guess the terrific location lets them get away with being less than satisfactory in the customer service department.  Although the rooms are fine, we like professional service, so next time we are going to stay at the Omni.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I have no idea why there is a Baskin Robbins ice cream sign on this building.  Not one time in the last 4 visits did they have all the makings of a banana split. Twice out of the last 4 times they were out of bananas.  They've been out of almost every flavor that you request. One time they gave me a hot fudge sundae instead of banana split and the hot fudge was scorched and smelled horrible. I don't know if they are franchised owned or what, but someone needs to step up and close that part of the store. It's worthless!!!!

Beware they do not care about your hair they will brush through your hair without taking the time out to detangle it. You got to ask for extra things like deep conditioner, oil, and trim. Speaking about trim, I asked the girl who was doing my hair to trim the dead ends of my hair and she cut off almost 2 inches! two whole inches i worked so hard to grow wtf! I was so mad because I'm natural and i was so excited to see my length after getting it straightened. Only thing I was pleased about was that my hair turned out nice and straight from roots to ends and it lasted long with no frizziness.

Another brunt crust, tasteless  ice cold pizza with zero garlic oil on crust. We have  been getting pizza from Rick's for over 10 years, but no more after tonight. Husband was there 10 minutes before it was supposed to be ready and we live 8 -10  minutes away. Pizza had  black to dark brown brunt smelling  tough crust and was inedible. Used to be so good, but has 
been goning down hill past 3 years. No great pizza in Tarpon Springs so used to take a chance that we could get decent pizza from Rick's every now and  then. Done for now, too much money wasted on mediocre pizza.

The attached sandwich is what I received in the drive-thru. If you complain, the employee's involve all customers in the store.  Last time over a black cup of coffee, there was almost a riot. The drive through is constantly double parked and it is very dangerous to utilize it. The traffic pulls in from Little Road driving 50 miles an hour, and almost hit me on a couple of occasions.  I will never use this location again. Something should be done to ensure the safety of the customers and there should be more mature employees on staff.  

I do not live in CA, I live in New Port Richey, FL and this location is on Little Road, New Port Richey, FL

Was charged additional $250.00 for smoking in the room which is not true.  Rude clerk on shift 04/08/19 4:45pm hung up on me 3 times, transferred the call to a manager who did not answer, threatened to call the police for harassment when I requested proof of smoking in the room.
The place was very unsanitary, staff from front desk to house keeping, maintenance staff was very unfriendly and rude.  I would not recommend this hotel to anyone I know or anyone who is looking to book this hotel. Please review other reviews from others that stayed in this lousy hotel.

text:
Moving out of these apartments after having been here nearly two years. Poor management and was a little bit rude. I feel like we have been pretty good tenants, paying our rent on time or early and not bugging maintenance too much. 
Our dishwasher died twice and it was over a month before we got the replacement. It was not until we called corporate that finally someone was sent out to replace the dishwasher. 
Please consider NOT using these apartments. I typically do not due this and leave poor reviews, but the rudeness by some of the office staff and poor service are unprofessional.
Thank you for taking the time to read this.

I have never written a yelp review before, because I have never had such a terrible experience that I felt the need to write one. First of all, the treatment I received from the owner (Bonnie) was like actually shocking. She was extremely rude and condescending to paying customer and I have never felt so unwelcome in a salon. Secondly, the salon looks like is hasn't been cleaned in years. The floors are covered in dust, dirt, and nail clippings. The light that I had to put my hand under was full of scum. They also did NOT wear gloves when they did my friends pedicure, during a pandemic! Extremely over priced, rude service, and DIRTY!

This place charged me 70$ for a pedicure, manicure and overlay on my nails. When I arrived I was told everything I wanted would be 55$. Absolutely too high! I have gone to other nail shops in Nashville and paid 60$ for 2 people. My nails still look like they did before I went for the manicure. My feet still look the same except they have polished toes. My overlay is extremely thick and does not look natural. There are no prices posted on the walls. They did not massage my hands or do any routine manicure procedures. I do not recommend this place to anyone. This was my first and last time.

I ordered taste queen on Ubereat today, their food is not even eatable. I am Chinese, I ubderstand people put cornstarch while cooking, however, the chef from this restaurant put way too much cornstarch in the Buddhist delight which make it not only look sticky but also taste disgusting. So I called the restaurant, whoever pick up my call is so unpatience.  They won't give me refound and tell me to complain on Uber eat.  A restaurant doesn't care about its views, guess how terrible the food could be. If you want to get pissed, try Taste Queen.

Long line at counter, no car available (only a large SUV).  Had to do a walk around of the car to prove there were no dents / scratches.  Took 30 minutes to get a car.  I'm used to Hertz that sends me an email while I'm on the plane telling which space my car is in, and what kind of car it is (and gives me an opportunity to change cars).  I go to the car, show my license at the gate, and I'm gone!

The people working at Enterprise were great, and did their best with Enterprise's procedures.  Enterprise needs to get with the times.

I was referred to German Motorworks after a disappointing visit with a local dealership. Brett and his team took the time to review multiple issues with my vehicle and provided an affordable solution to get me back on the road quickly. I highly recommend German Motorworks! Their communication was spot on (even during the busy holiday season) and everyone I spoke to was friendly and understanding. They were honest and didn't push unnecessary mechanical work! Five star service. I will never go back to the dealership again.

When we first arrived I was a little concerned - very crowded area with lots of traffic.  And the place is OLD!  There are cracks in the walls, especially in the bathrooms.  That being said, the staff was very nice, the bedding was clean and comfortable, the room and bathroom was clean, the shower had good water pressure.  It is on the inexpensive side of hotels so for the value it is good.  The staff is obviously making the best of the age of the building.  Breakfast was also good and BONUS! after a long day of driving the Subway is attached (normally not somewhere I eat) and it was delicious and their staff couldn't have been nicer.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Enterprise always has exceptional interactions with their customers.  When you arrive you are always greeted by staff and offered water after your long travel.  The staff are quick in the check-in process and will get you your car ASAP.  The car that I rented could have been a bit cleaner.  Also instructions to get back to the rental location should be provided for each vehicle especially for traveler who are unfamiliar with Philadelphia airport and the quickest route to return car.  Overall, the experience was good and recommend this rental location.

RUDE! Josh (assistant manager) was very uncooperative and made excuses for his employees. Nobody greeted us at the drive-thru and when we pulled up, thinking it was an issue with the speaker, the employees were messing around! They refused to take our order at the window and insisted that we go back through the drive-thru!

Josh was unapologetic and made excuses for his employees instead of correcting the situation. 

This was by far the WORST EXPERIENCE with this location in all the times we've been there! Soggy buns on a whopper is more tolerable than this! (And I hate soggy stuff."

Based on the choices of other hotels and prices, this hotel is worth it. Very nice beds, pillows, flat panel, fridge, internet and the grounds are impeccable. The pool and jacuzzi are well apart from each other , giving plenty of space to hang out and not be crowded or bothered by loud mouth Sasquatch beings-- hehe. Peaceful and close to a nice Japanese Restayrant Sushi Tera. The free Breakfast selections here were good. Their expresso /hot cocoa machine was used from sun up to...maybe sundown , don't know I went paddle boarding. Lol
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
If I could give O stars I would. First time in Fort Washington and my boyfriend decided to try the Dunkin' here...

I ordered plain bagel with cream cheese and an ice coffee. How do you forget the cream cheese. It's the essential part of a plain bagel WITH cream cheese !! 
My coffee was done wrong twice ..

The first order was not even mine it was made from 9 AM and we ordered at 12PM so please tell me why your giving me someone else's drink from a few hours before ?

Terrible . Also this is the first review I've ever made . I literally had to make an account for this.

This is the most poorly run McDonalds. I have spoken directly with the owner on a couple of occasions. Lots of excuses. Bottom line is not enough people and no management whatsoever. So much for the "McDonald's System". It's funny when I listened to her tell me how she was struggling to pay employees, I pointed out that Chick-Filet locations have three times as many employees at each location and are exponentially more profitable. She has tons of traffic so they should be doing great. Bottom line - avoid this location at all costs unless time has no value to you.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: Hotel is extremely dated. The building is very old but has newer furnishings. The bed was very comfortable and towels were above average for a hotel. The ceiling in the room looked as if it had some water damage in the past resulting in a hole in the popcorn ceiling (asbestos?), the windows also did not open and there was no air conditioning. Also, I would never bring children here as the bathtub had black mold in the caulking. Save you money and stay at the Riverside if you really want to be close to downtown. Also, no free breakfast!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I went there with my mom and first of all we asked for 2 hash-browns and they said 1 on the reciept so we just paid for another one. Then my mom asked to put the bacon,  egg and cheese croissant ,which was my friends order in a separate bag because we are vegetarian. He guys said ok ok and started doing his own thing. Then we heard him say to the girl worker that this lady is sh*t. Then my mom started complaining and the lady took care of our order. They still got my friends order wrong. Instead of a croissant they used an english muffin.

When I asked for liquid sugar, they put powder sugar in my coffee which sat at the bottom of my coffee cup. Their apple fritters were small and flat. They were stale and had little filling. Where there was filling, It was pilled up in one spot. They were heavy and not at all fluffy like fritters are meant to be. My frozen caramel coffee was watered down and really thin. Also, they serve paper straws which dissolve in any liquid and half way through the cup of coffee start bending and making drinking impossible. You dont get any napkins in the drive through.

. I'm so done with neighbors credit union here I am out of town trying to pick up my rental when the teller tells me that she can't authorize my payment because neighbors didn't put on alert out that I was going out of town like wtf I gave you all my information about me going out of town and you told me that you would notate my account ... I am so pissed cause now I have to wait two whole hours at the airport until they open... Once I get back to Stl I am switching ASAP!! I wouldn't recommend to anyone. Been with you all for years.

This place usually has very good food and the service is usually very well. However, visiting during COVID made me realize that I won't be going back until the pandemic is over, or ever. The owner of the restaurant greeted us at the door with no mask (even though they have signs everywhere saying "masks are required to enter the building") and then was walking around the entire restaurant with NO MASK. I find this very rude and it makes the customers very uncomfortable. Also, the fries were not cooked at all and tasted like rubber. I will not be visiting Rexy's again.

I have staid at this resort multiple times while visiting Clearwater! the rooms are clean , and staff is nice and helpful . The souvenir shops in the hotel were nice . The pool is nice but can get very crowded during late afternoon . My personal favorite was the hotels private beach directly in front of the pool. the first time I ever stayed in Clearwater we stayed at a Hilton and we went to a beach near pier 60. This beach was WAY CROWDED! the private beach at the Sheraton was incredible compared to this ! the workout room was nice with a incredible view !
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I took my mom here for a birthday dinner because the place we orginally want to go to was out of business.  While the place looked nice, the food was not.  The waitress said the flaming miwon was 8 oz but it looked like 3 oz.  I asked for it rare but it was not rare, just a bit pink.  The meat was bland.  The broccoli was soggy and the mac and cheese was tasteless. This place might be good for going out and drinking with friends or for their sandwiches (which I did not have).  Otherwise DO NOT EAT DINNER HERE!

Service was phenomenal- very pleasant and quick. We came on the earlier side so it wasn't packed (only con would be that the space is kind of small so if it's busy there's not a ton of tables) Sushi chefs were really talented, I watched them make the rolls. Ordered the spicy girl, sunshine & volcano special rolls-- all of them were awesome, equally so. Definitely fair prices too, nothing super upcharged. Rolls were huge and really fresh & fulfilling. So glad we stopped here while in town! Also try the lemon sake :) was recommended by the waitress and was definitely delicious too

Rented a car here last week of February. Car was clean, service was quick. The guy asked me if i wanted a Toll pass I said no, he didn't push it on me matter of fact he said when I use my GPS just make sure I put in avoid tolls. Now the problem is I haven't received my $250 refund yet. They said 7-10 days its been 19 days. Called several times no answer. However today someone did answer, she was very kind and stated that the deposit would be put back on my card by the end of the day so we shall see. So rent at own risk lol.

They used cheap parts and overcharge in labor. Worth driving out of the community to get better service. Your time is more valuable then having to have them work or your car twice and try to charge you for re- work. Owner is rude! They kept my car overnight without any comment about why or what it needed after their diag. Then returned car next day after $1000 in repairs and it came back to me with same problems it went in with. Then when I took it back to them they said it wasn't their problem and wanted to charge more money to fix problem.

Nice hotel! Great location, many restaurants and attractions within walking distance. The staff was friendly and helpful when checking in and out and when helping us navigate the city. Small rooms but very nice bed and decor. Bathroom sink had very little counter space which was inconvenient, but not a deal breaker. Bottom line, I would stay here again. On every floor there are complimentary purified water stations and free water bottles. The lobby also offers free cans of pop, some candy, and other small treats.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Me and my wife came here for the first time after a recommendation.  We enjoy good byob sushi places and have a couple regulars in the area but we decided to give it a try. mainly because it was all you can eat. I wouldn't eat here again. The fish didn't seem fresh at all. It didn't taste fresh and you could tell by the coloring it wasn't fresh. The more we ate the more we got grossed out and were wondering if we were going to get sick later. We could have gotten a much higher quality for the same price and same amount of food at the places we normally go to. Unless your into quantity over quality I would try somewhere else.

ZERO STARS IF I COULD!!! Despite the online booking service stating that you must be 18 to check in, and despite the person literally standing two feet in front of us saying to our faces that at the very least the booking age is 18, my friend and I (20 and 19 years old) were turned away from checking in, and were told even if we got a 21 year old we knew to help us check in, we would not be able to use a reservation we booked ourselves because we are under 21. Tennessee the volunteer state? Seems like all they wanted to do was volunteer to kick two eager guests to the curb!

text:
I tried the hot dogs and liked them, and I ordered them a few times, but each time the 'with everything' condiments' would be different.

Sometimes there would be a green guacamole (?) sauce, or a lime, or a salsa.  Sometimes there would be one item, but most of the time it was the hot dogs and nothing else.

I inquired through their web site, asking what I should expect and they failed to respond so I won't go back.

Oh, and at that store?  If you order on-line, call them when you get there 'cause they'll forget you or ignore you if you don't call.

Room cost was higher than advertised online. Charged $35 to park even though I was staying at the hotel. No vending machines, but you can buy a lukewarm soda for $4 that is completely flat at the desk. This hotel gouges like no other I've experienced. The desk clerk rattled off stay info like he does it 200 times a day. I told him he's speaking too fast and I can't follow his lips through the mask and asked him to repeat twice then gave up. Many homeless people nearby. Drove cross country 2330 miles, this was the only unpleasant hotel.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I agree with the March 2013 review.  Slow service with an attitude.  I went twice with different friends in April 2013.  It was my 5th and 6th visits this year.   I visit at least once every time I'm in Tampa.  When it was Caffe Amaretto it was excellent.  When the new owners took over it was even better and redecorated beautifully.  Now there's a new kid in charge. The food was still good but the racket over the loudspeakers that they called music and the "Frankly my dear, I don't give 'dang' " attitude after they brought the WRONG MEAL was enough to convince me I won't be back.

I pre-paid a rental through Budget. While I picked up the rental, they representative told me that I pre-paid and was good to go. They gave me a Toyota Camry and didn't mention a price change. After I returned my vehicle, I noticed that they charged me $70 more. I called them and they stated that there was an upgrade fee for full-size car instead of a standard car. I told them that there was not a mentioning to me of an increase in price and that there was nothing they could do. I can't get a hold
of anyone directly at the site.

Location could not have been more perfect. Rooms are small, but ours was quite clean. Nicely sized fridge and kitchenette area in the superior queen room. Hotel management was quick and responsive when we requested pillows be sent to our room. Overall, a rather enjoyable experience in a wonderful location. However, and here's the kicker, hotel staff, without knocking, entered our room more than 1 hour before our checkout time. This was a massive invasion of privacy for reasons I don't have to state here and completely irresponsible and unprofessional. Would recommend this hotel for a quick overnight stay in Philly. 3/5 experience.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

DO NOT STAY HERE! Pay the little extra to stay by the beach because they will charge your card an extra $100 above what you initially had booked. The rooms smell, carpets stained, water pressure is low, cables hanging from the wall, nothing is nearby, and the beds need to be replaced.

text: B & G deserves minus a million stars. This place is HORRIBLE AND DANGEROUS. I was just there and one of the dryers caught fire and they didn't even have a fire extinguisher. Thank god they got it out with water, but acted like it was no big deal.  anyone who owns a laundromat should know you have to clean the whole machine for lint at least once a year. AND HAVE A GD FUNCTIONING FIRE EXTINGUISHER! I lost everything to a landlords faulty dryer two years ago. I lived in my car until just this May. My ptsd is going insane. These people don't care about you!!

text:
If your car is over 7 yes old, Sammy's is not responsible for any damage their machines does to your car. I learned this, today, from the manager. Their drying roller, as it spins, slid back the rear cover to my luggage rack, knocking it off. By the time, they retrieved it, it was mangled. Sammy's is a still a great place, but in learning about this policy, it's not a risk I am willing to take. So I won't be back. Regarding the part: I found the replacement part for $50, not a huge deal.

Sammy's Damage Policy:
If you car is more than 7yrs old, ENTER AT YOUR OWN RISK.

The business that made me establish a yelp account!
If you need a haircut, go somewhere else. I waited over 50 minutes for my turn while I saw multiple different individuals literally walk in and sit down ahead of me. I watched as stylists texted on their phones or took random phone calls while cutting customers hair. Apparently business is SO GOOD here that the stylists can ignore potential customers. After reading their last reviews on yelp, I can understand why their rating is so low.

Do yourself a favor, don't bother coming to this establishment. Find a different place to cut your hair!

My son and I had a terrible experience at this place. Throughout the night there where doors slamming and people walking the halls so we did not get much sleep. The front desk was not helpful at all and was very unapologetic and rude about the situation. When we got back to the hotel the room had not been cleaned. When we told the front desk she was once again she was unapologetic and rude. She accused me of lying about the lack of maid service and said that she needed to consult the maids about the situation before she could do anything. We paid way too much for the lack of service we got at this hotel. I will not be back.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Orpheum is the best!  I've been going there my whole life and have consistently had friendly service, fantastic quality work, and timeliness!  This family has owned the business for three generations and are passionate about maintaining the quality and service started by their grandfather many years ago.  Even though I rarely get candy any more (I think I'm too old now), I love going in and hearing stories of the past and continuing to support a store that brings so much character and community to South Grand.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Just got finished with my first experience at Saku. Very pleased! I'm so happy to have a sushi bar so close by. The decor was tasteful, the server was extra attentive, and the food was great. We tried the Hawaiian special roll, which was very nice. A nice sauce with a tad of spice, not too cloyingly sweet. My sashimi and sushi was tender and cut beautifully. Portion sizes are great, even slightly large, for the price! We even sampled a dessert item and it was very tasty! Can't wait to return, or even do take out. And I thought I curbed my sushi addiction!

We stopped in for a little peace and quiet while wandering down Bourbon Street.  We were charged $16.75 for 2 beers in small plastic cups.  The menu had no prices so we asked the bartender how much beers were ($8.375 seemed like an odd amount).  She said "You're in a tourist trap on Bourbon Street.  I can charge you whatever I want".  Nice!  I love dive bars but this was ridiculous.  We may have been overcharged at other places in New Orleans but this was the only place where the bartender was downright rude.

Let me start by saying that our check in process was awesome. Niya was so helpful and kind, she greeted us with a great big smile and accommodated us although we arrived way before check in. 
Our room was perfect. We had a great view, room was spotless, and the bed was extremely comfortable. The hotel is modern and well kept and is perfectly located near all the delicious restaurant and tourist attractions. Everything is walking distance, literally. I really enjoyed my stay and i look forward to visiting again soon.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I had to write a review it was that good........... ordered a pizza the other night it was out of this word, wings were great and cooked to order perfectly..........now today I decided to get a calzone for my brother and myself so we got two one would have fed four, it was the best calzone I ever had in my life, I cant even explain it.....I threw all the other menus out, this will be the only place we order Italian from ever again, just one thing missing off the menu to make it perfect, clams with the bellies........Susan Rodney

They did an amazing job.  I got the interior done in one car and the whole package done.  The car hadn't been detailed in awhile, so there were a few layers of dirt that had accumulated. The car came out looking like new. My floor carpets, seats and dash came out clean. The price was reasonable and they really paid attention to detail and super worth it. Not to mention, they were very polite and professional. Once they were done, they gave me a chance to do a walk around and corrected anything that wasn't right, so I will definitely be back. I recommend this car wash.

When this market first opened, it was nice and clean. 
Employee's looked more perfessional.   Lately my experience has not been all that good.  The people that work in the hot food section don't respect the fact that people like to see employees around food, have there hair covered. wairing gloves when servin and preparing food.  Anyone that work in the food area should not be outside with their apron on and then return back to work with the same apron on.  I have seen people touching other things like walls and other things while preparing food.  this is a big turn off when I'm wanting to have lunch.

This is the best sushi I have had in a while! This establishment is very clean, the service is great, the people are nice, and most importantly the fish is fresh! 
I got the rainbow roll without the cream cheese and they were very accommodating. It tasted great! My sister had the Vegas roll and she said it was great! She also had some spicy Mayo on the side and it completed the meal. Lastly my dad got the gyoza and the tempura roll and again we're great with no complaints! 
For dessert I enjoyed the green tea ice cream and it was sooooo gooooddd. Overall, it was a great night with the family and I will definitely be coming back!

Worst experience of my life. DO NOT MOVE HERE. The price and location are very attractive but don't be fooled. I had rats in my air ducts and all throughout my walls. The worst part is the property management company who cares nothing about their tenants. Do not expect a response from them whenever you call. I left my apartment in perfect condition and they did not give me my security deposit back. After filing multiple complaints to try to get it back, I never heard a word from them. Do not rent anything if Phillip Scott Management & Investments of Indian Rocks Beach manages it. Stay away!!

The staff is tremendously kind and helpful at Mill Creek Animal Hospital. They gave me tons of information, helpful tips, and took great care of my pet during our visits. 
I am extremely disappointed in their pricing, however. I've had multiple medications for my cat that I now know I was criminally over-charged for. One medication was around $9 when I looked it up on Amazon and they charged me $20! I understand they must make their money somehow, but they will no longer be getting my business because of that.

This company states their signage removes them from the liability of damage done to cars. I beg to differ. I have used other machine type car washes with no damage to my vehicle. So the damage was clearly caused by the machinery and therefore the company should be liable to reimburse for damages. 

I welcome the company to contact me to reimburse me for damages. I  stand by my statement to not use this automatic car wash. If it was a mechanism by which I can give a half-star I would...and this would only be for the young man who took the damage report and handled all other issues alone while I was on the property.

Waited well over 10 mins for someone to acknowledge me to take my order in the drive thru - which never happened. So after watching 2 cars that were ahead of me pull up to the next window I thought maybe the speaker had broken. I inched up and waited in line for over 15 mins. Finally after getting up to the window to let the employee know that I didn't place an order because I thought the speaker was broken (which apparently it wasn't) I was told to circle around and go back in line to place my order even though all I wanted was a cheeseburger and fries. What a joke.
