text: I personally would not ever shop at this particular Rouses because I only went in their to talk to the manager so I can be interviewed for the job. And the women that were behind the service counter was very rude and had nasty attitudes. They both ignored me when I was asking them can I see the hiring manager and made me wait while they were talking to each other then when we're finished talking one of them turned to me and started assisting me and told me that I had to wait for the manager for 30-45 minutes and so I just left. I wasn't even shopping their all I wanted was to work their, I'm not ever going to that specific rouses ever again.

Dr. Page is a very nice man who will take the time to get to know you and help you figure out exactly what prescription/contact lenses are best for you.  His prices are also unbeatable.  $60 for an exam and he will match any online website's prices (like 1-800 contacts) for contacts.  I am a medical student and when he found this out he also turned my visit into a learning experience, showing me pictures of diseased retinas and explaining the pathology.  His office staff are also very nice and helpful.  They will even mail your contacts to your house!  Very professional and well worth a visit!
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I have been to Donnie Mac's 3 times and each time the service gets worse and so does the food. I was with a fairly large group and we waited forever to place our order and we asked for separate tickets and he said no problem. One person I was with couldn't even eat her burger it was so bad, they did take it back and did not charge her for it. At the end he screwed up on the tickets, even tho we explained everything,and took a half hour just to pay. I really loved the place in the beginning, but they really need to get a grip on their quality and service. Cool atmosphere!

I am done with Giant on Huntingdon Pike.  Isles are to small always cluttered making it very hard to get around.  The customer service is really lousy & the store manager doesn't care.  I was tears telling him my store experience as I was sick & going to pass out.  On top of which I accidently eft $80 cash in the self checkout trying to get out of the heat & into my air conditioned car.  He promised to call me back & never did.  I told him I was scrambling for my cell to call 911 in the parking lot.  He didnt care.  Shame on Giant.  I will spend another dollar there

The bartenders mix awful drinks, they charge you $2 for a small plastic cup of water, and they won't turn on the overhead fans, even in over 100 degree heat. But the bands, the bands!! Ed Willis, Natalie Cris, so many others - are AMAZING. Absolutely the best show on Frenchman Street. Fire the terrible, rude bartenders, turn on the goddamn fans, stop nickel-and-diming me, and I will sit and drink and listen forever. Or, you all can just walk in, buy nothing, listen for a bit, and leave. Or listen from the street.

We have been there several times and have enjoyed the food and the service. Two weeks ago we went back and we were promised a seat by the wall, and the owner took our reservation. When we arrived we were told that there where no tables available by the wall ? Why make a reservation and why promise something you can't deliver? The owner came out and gave us a half assed apology and sent out some raviolis. When the owner walked away he commented the the food would taste just as good from that table ?? We were very disappointed with the seating and the food was ok. Not heading back anytime soon.

Don't believe the $39 for eye exam claim! I just needed a new script for contacts and even called ahead to ask about pricing. Was told the $39 for just contacts and added charge if I needed a prescription for glasses - I was very clear about what I needed. Got there, the price is now $89 (39 + additional add-ons). By the time I left, my bill was $114! There is a reason why they don't detail their fee structure on their website - it's total crap. 2 star rating only because the man who did my exam was actually nice and professional. Go to America's Best where they clearly advertise a single price where everything is included.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text:
Not all that great, for the price.  They were deliberately vague about a web special which supposedly included a breakfast. The front-desk acted like they'd never heard of the website before.  I got charged for the breakfast, because I didn't present a PAPER coupon, which I think room service "cleaned up".

Don't even bother trying to get a copy of your room charges (simple request, right?)....you'll just be sent to Natalie's vmail. And Natalie doesn't seem to return many calls.

C'mon guys, it's the little things, especially when you're paying $300/night in INDIANAPOLIS.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: Terrible, they will spend 45 minutes trying to upsell you on everything.  We received a fiat with 27,000 miles on it.  It was loaded with scratches and a few dents.  The balance on the rear tire was terrible with a really load vibration sound.  When we returned the car 3 minutes late we were charged 10 dollars but they didn't tell us.  It just showed up on the receipt.  We called customer service and they were no help at all.  Finally, you have to take a shuttle which can take up to 30 minutes to arrive.  Bottom line: poor service and badly maintained cars

Hotel could care less about inconvenience placed on customers when they're at capacity.  Overbooked the hotel, had people staying in conference rooms waiting the night out.  Let people check in with no towels for their customers, told multiple times they'd be brought up, but empty promises. Told by staff they'd been dealing with upset customers all night. No foresight to deal with full capacity. Condescending staff and management in Guest Services.  Ice machine broken as well...wow. Counting the days to leave this joke of a place.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I currently live at Lighthouse Landings and would recommend it to anyone looking for a place in the Indianapolis/Greenwood area. The apartment complex is close to downtown Indianapolis without paying downtown rates. The apartment office staff works to create a neighborhood environment in the complex that I really appreciate. The maintenance staff is one of the best I have encountered while living in an apartment (about 4 in the past 5 years) - they fix issues expeditiously and get it right on the first try. The apartment grounds are well-kept at all times.

Horrendous. No communication- I understand that COVID has restrictions HOWEVER when a pet owner is left to sit in their car for FOUR HOURS with NO communication (ZERO) other than a CALL FOR PAYMENT- which had a huge visit fee that we were not told about upfront- two hours into waiting...it is completely unacceptable. We will be switching vets ASAP. Staff is rude and unprofessional when you ask direct questions they clearly do not know the answers to. This is not the first negative experience we have had with this place, but it will definitely be the last.

So disappointed in this experience.

Heard great things about a Mano so made a reservation and dined with my wife and 2 kids aged 5 and 7. Room is nice. Service was good and they were very accommodating to our fussy kids palates. 
We had bruschetta with buratta cheese that was great as well as very tasty gnudi with mushrooms. Duck entree was great as well as my wife's tuna cooked perfectly rare. Panna cotta was nice . A very unusual not run of the mull menu made it a great place for us as we prefer different more experimental menus than the usual meat and potato ones found at many Italian places.

On 29.5 years on this planet, I have never gotten such bad service. The staff acted like were on some type of work release program.  They were joyless and miserable. After we were given our food, 45 minutes went by without anyone asking us if we wanted another drink.  The manager was asked to come over, and he informed us that he was sorry and jokingly suggested that we stiff our waiter, which we did.  It would have been nice if they offered to reduce our bill instead of offering us free coffee.  What a waste.  Food was bad too.

This is the 1st time I have been to this restaurant & probably my last.  I ordered the Dragon roll to go.  It is a eel & cucumber on the inside with avocado & smelt egg on top.  I was most disappointed there was hardly any eel in it.  The eel was such a thin sliver of an eel.  The roll was filled with thinly sliced cucumbers which just over powered the taste of the Eel.  For $10.50 (tax incl) this was the most expensive cucumber I have eaten in my life.  This restaurant can do better!!!

I never write reviews for anything.  I was so unhappy......I made this an exception!

Wow unfortunately after visiting 3x, the only good experience I had was my very first visit. Today was my third time visiting and never again. Very sloppy, instead of making sure my mani and pedi are being done correctly, they're too busy being distracted by each other. They have a ton of colors on display but every time you select one they snatch it, throw it in the trash and say they don't have it anymore. The lady doing my pedi cut my toe nail crooked, when I told her she brushed it off said something to her coworkers and 4 of them came over to look at my toe. -_-
Another lady does my nails, extremely sloppy. Just-never again.

The lobby bar is the best you will get at this establishment! Everyone is so friendly and accommodating! I had my wedding there last week. Ladies please look somewhere else for your wedding,  this magisterial and historical hotel has gone very south in the past 7 months. I was yelled at by my "wedding planner" like a a small child after they couldn't find my room or bridal suite. They seem like they have it together. Every time  something goes wrong they give you a champagne comp! Not what you want for the day you want to remember! Please look elsewhere for your big day!

I've lived in the Block for 10 years so I've seen my fair share of leasing agents. The location is convenient and is the main selling point for the property. The building is old, which of course will lead to issues. I've not experienced anything from the staff that is less than responsive when those issues arise. Maintenance is readily available via cell. They're so accommodating that they have, at my request and approval, let my visitors in my place when I'm not in the building. 

I appreciate that they offer early lease signing concessions. I am confident that I will remain a resident in the building as long as I'm a resident in the city.

I have a corporate account with Avis through my job and dropped off a one day rental at this location. They're trying to charge me for the cleaning associated with the "smoking fee." I DON'T EVEN SMOKE! When I immediately challenged the guy Rodney about it and asked him to walk back out to the car with me he refused to do so. He must get a cut of that $250 charge. He gave me his boss's business card and the phone number doesn't even work. I immediately filed a complaint with corporate and will dispute the charge for as long as it takes. Avoid these thieves at all costs.

My family and I stayed at the Marriott across the street but the Sheraton was amazing to spend a beach day. They have carts to drive you from the Sheraton pool down to the beach and have chair and umbrella rentals. Even though we weren't guests, they were AMAZING at setting up a beach proposal for my brother. Eric Muñiz, the restaurant manager, was such a big help with food and even cleaned up the beach for us so that we could celebrate. Definitely recommend coordinating with Eric at the Sheraton for celebrations and events!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: To check into a room at 11:00 at night and find water stains on the ceiling after being shocked by a light switch....needless to say I was very disappointed. Then I opened what was supposed to be an entertainment center to find the same tv I had purchased as a teenager. Luckily I remembered that it took a few minutes for it to warm up before the tv turned on. Otherwise I would have switched rooms for the third time. Although the conference center is quite nice they need to update the rooms to accommodate the guests that are visiting.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I wanted to like my stay at the Q&C since the people that work there are fantastic. And the food and drinks were above average and worth my time. 

But there are two things over-riding my warm feelings for the individuals that work there. 

The first is the room I was given smelled musty and the only thing that saved me is that it was a short trip which didn't afford me a lot of time in the room. 

And the second was the mouse roaming in the bar seating area which were viewed both on Friday and Saturday. 

In closing, I can recommend the food, drink and people but not staying there. The musty smell was a deal breaker for me.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: This place is fucking horrible, i rented a room to stay for the weekend but when i first walked in it smelled like cigarettes and apparently theres a no smoking policy, the bed sheets are stained and not properly cleaned, theres holes in the walls, and chewed gum left on the walls. Like wtf kind of people are hired here?!? I really wonder how the management takes care of this place, its worth to pay $30+ on a better hotel that ACTUALLY TAKES GOOD CARE OF THE ROOMS so fuck this place, im not being picky either so trust me when i know what a hotel is supposed to be
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I must say that, as an Enterprise Plus customer, I was more than a little disappointed in the vehicle I was provided.  The vehicle was a very basic older model Nissan Altima that had 31,000 hard miles on it.  It was not very clean and had very few of the creature comforts I receive when I rent full size vehicles using my Avis Preferred or Hertz Gold memberships.  I was also disappointed in the length of time I had to wait for the Enterprise shuttle bus. In the time it took for the Enterprise bus to arrive, two Hertz, two Avis, two Alamo/Budget and two National rental car buses had passed by. Definitely not a good experience.

This Dobbs damaged a car when it was brought in for an oil change. We had pictures showing there was no damage on the vehicle from days before that. They refused to take ownership of their actions, would not show the video proving it wasn't them, and they refused to file a claim on their insurance. This location is next door to the corporate office too. When we contacted them they refused to help with the situation, including being very vulgar on the phone. Beware when taking your car here. If you do, take photos before you leave the parking lot, otherwise you make get your car back scratched and dented.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text:
The location on keystone is amazing. The Carmel location however is the complete opposite. The service was disgusting and shameful for the business. I eat there regularly, but  today I was in the area and decided to do curbside pick up. My order time was 1:30.. I didn't receive my order until 2:00. On top of the completely unprofessional timely manner of the workers I was thrown my and when I called and asked for corporate I got hung up on!  This totally put a bad taste in my mouth. This is a terrible look for the company and will be my last time coming and recommending this place. 


Btw, got a name, his managers name is "Grant" Spicy Diavolo

On Friday, I ordered the nacho supreme but I only wanted beef, lettuce, tomato and cheese only!When I called to let them know my order was incorrect no one answered the phone and it was before 2:00pm.  When I reach them on Tuesday they told me that there was nothing they could do about. So now I'm just waiting to talk to the owner. This is what they sent me. It looks like they just threw the leftovers together. This is the second time they've done this to me. I think my coworkers and I will be finding another Mexican restaurant for lunch.

On Friday, I ordered the nacho supreme but I only wanted beef, lettuce, tomato and cheese only!When I called to let them know my order was incorrect no one answered the phone and it was before 2:00pm.  When I reach them on Tuesday they told me that there was nothing they could do about. So now I'm just waiting to talk to the owner. This is what they sent me. It looks like they just threw the leftovers together. This is the second time they've done this to me. I think my coworkers and I will be finding another Mexican restaurant for lunch. Very disappointed in the service!

Probably one of the worst experiences I have ever had. I ordered 3 frappes and 3 orders of Cini Minis got a bag first and then waited for my drinks and when I got them they were dripping all over the cup holder, looked like a child made them. Of course by the time I got to a parking spot they had dripped all over my seat . Re made them and I left. When going to give my feedback to get a free sandwich my survey code and surprise there wasn't one the receipt had been torn right above the code. Hate this location.

Honestly, I'm incredibly disappointed. I was excited to try this place, but it was a complete let down.  We didn't even get a large portion of our food. We let them know and they gave us some of what they forgot, no apologies. We got home and noticed we were missing even more food. The worst part is, the food we got was so awful it had to be thrown away.  The caramelo is made with nacho cheese. The chicharrones taco was inedible. We originally thought this place was a bit overpriced, but now we know for sure the price is not worth it. Low quality and unappetizing.

How is this place still in business? I ordered a pick up order and was told it would be ready in 20-30 minutes. I show up 40 minutes later to them confused about our online order, even though i spoke with one of the employees beforehand, and she had refused to call me because she felt too "nervous" to reach out. Very unprofessional. And the other item we ordered in our online order hadn't even been made yet when we got there. It was 3 slices of pre-made pizza. We watched them heat it up it front of us. Good luck though!

As a business traveler who travels every week,  you hook up with new brands and their better properties. Well, this one fooled me! As I did a mobile check in and told them the time I would arrive would be late, they STILL gave my room that I paid extra for away!! No explanation except it's not available! Offered me free breakfast and some drinks. Told me I got a upgraded Superior 2 Queen bed room. If this is superior, YIKES. Marriott and Autograph collection should re-think this one. I gave two stars for location only! Stay away
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: I got food poisoning there and when I went in the next day to notify them the lady owner was entirely unsympathetic and defensive. I told her rhe egg foo young and wonton soup were good but I know the General Tao's chicken dish was bad, re-heated not fresh and even gave me the runs! .  She refused to even consider the possibility, asked if I had evidence from a doctor's visit, and refused my request for a refund or a do-over on just that portion of the entire order--about $7.00! Won't eat there again, or will stick to the egg foo yung.

My husband chose this place for his birthday dinner. The waitress Hanna kept staring at me like she knew me, but we had never seen her here before. Hubby's entree arrived fresh and hot, but we had to ask several times where mine was. It finally arrived 10 minutes later, too hot to eat while my husband's was already cool. No apology or extra attention was offered. Very disappointing service from a place we have been coming to for a long time but my feeling is that while their business is so good, they don't need to care.

Owner is a surly, nasty, greedy "little" man.   He actually screamed at my wife for daring to ask for a few samples before purchasing a *second* order of ice cream.  He already KNEW she was a paying customer, but demanded "evidence" of a second customer. Then he proceeded to throw her change at her, across the counter.  Seriously, do yourself a favor and go elsewhere, there are only about 1,000 other options in the area.

NOTE:  You will find some other reviews from people with similar experiences where the owner claims the review was for his "competitor"; don't believe the hype,  it most certainly is THIS guy,  Mr. "Amish Creamery Company".

Extremely not pleased with this salon. Went there for a routine eyebrow wax and left not happy. The lady who did my brows managed to take off too much and ruined the shape and made it short and thin after telling her to keep the shape and leave it thick. On top of that she was very pushy and kept offering me other services that I declined several times. After having my brows ruined, I will never go back there nor would I recommend anyone to go there for a wax! If you're looking for a place to have your brows done, this is not the one!

I really want to give five stars for the taste of the ice creams, soft serves, and milkshakes they offer, but whenever I have come as of late, they do not serve enough for the size of the cup I am buying. I will often get a large cup of soft serve for myself and share some with family. When I get the soft serve, 2 inches of the inside of the cup is visible for what looks to be a 3 inch cup. And they will put the twist straight up the middle, but don't exceed the top line of the cup. 

I want to support small businesses, but it's hard to do that when it feels like they are charging more and giving less.

Was very excited to try this place. Well at least I thought I was until it took 43 minutes to get 3 margaritas. I didn't really think anything of it until I noticed other people complaining. When I went to ask what was taking so long, the hostess simply rolled their eyes. Apparently the server Ana and multiple others do not have very good reputations there. What was very upsetting though was when they tried to charge $73 for drinks that were never ordered. If you really feel like some good Latin food, I would strongly consider Red Mesa. They have just as good food, but even better service.

This was the most amazing place to stay. The people working there helped us at every turn. It was amazing. I recommend this place as a 5 stars.  I have been to clear water 4 times..... this place was amazing. Met several locals who choose this place to stay. The gym is the best gym I have ever seen in a hotel. 

Not to mention rusties downstairs... all you can eat buffet including amazing prime rib and I mean amazing prime rib. They cut it right in front of you as prime rib should be.

So yes stay here it's awesome.


We are going to return for sure. Thanks sand key people!!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I stayed here for three weeks for work. I was in a corner suite and the bed was extremely comfortable. It was generally clean but the couch and pillows on the couch were stained.

The staff was all very nice and the location was great. Lots of excellent restaurants in walking distance.

The walls are very thin. I could make out my neighbors conversations easily and twice had to call down because someone's alarm had gone off at early morning after they'd checked out.

The restaurant is over priced and not very good. The valet is very slow because they park the cars off property. Nice gym.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: The experience at the counter was good, fast and efficient. Being walked to my car was nice. The car looked new and worked perfectly (a Sonata). The car appeared clean inside and out when I picked it up. Gas tank was full (not always the case at some rental agencies). However, the next day, the smell of cigarette smoke permeated the cabin. Weird that I couldn't smell it right way. Doesn't Enterprise prohibit smoking in their cars or designate smoking cars? Also, I found an empty water bottle and a chicken nugget under the driver's seat. You need to do a better job cleaning the car from the previous occupants.

I mean hey, it's a McDonalds. You pretty much get what you expect; it's satisfying while it lasts, and then is followed by a certain amount of guilt and self hate because why on earth should you be happy about consuming 20 pieces of delicious poison masquerading as nuggets, a double quarter-pounder with cheese, a large fries, 2 apple pies and a vanilla shake. It was ok. Nothing to go out of your way for, but certainly suitable in a pinch. Maybe I'll come again? But only if I'm just passing through y'know. Lastly, why are you looking up McDonalds on Yelp? Have you never been to one? If so, I'm quite impressed...
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text:
I honestly love their sushi and I have to visit them from time to time to enjoy their sushi!! honestly the best the sushi place I have ever been to. The only downside in this place is that they are sooooooooooooooo cheap. Literally so cheap. 
They even charged me for an extra sauce I asked for and sometimes they don't want to give you all the food you ordered in all you eat because they think it is too much so in some way they are trying to control what you are eating. The customer service there is eh depending on your server but still cheap. love their sushi but hate their cheapness

I have been coming to Fuji Sushi for over 8 years now, typically around 10-15 times a year. Never ONCE have I complained about the food or even had a bad word to say about the place, but today I ordered 3 shrimp tempura rolls with steamed shrimp and the rolls had absolutely zero shrimp and overloaded with imitation crab. It tasted AWFUL. I called to let them know that there was no shrimp and it didn't taste good, but he completely refused to refund or put a replacement order in for us. I will not be returning to this location ever again. Horrible customer service.

Poor management response. Poor security. Cheaply constructed for the amount of rent.  States "energy efficient" appliances, we have none.  Maintenance came into my apartment while I was in the shower and proceeded to walk all the way to the open bathroom where I was showering.  Claims they knocked.  Apparently the TV that was on didn't clue them in and they claim they couldn't hear the shower running when both bedroom and bathroom doors were open.  Horrifying.  There are no deadbolts locks to insure no entry while home.  I do not feel safe in my own home.  Poor policy.

Good luck if they make a mistake. Missing something from our delivery order. Called. They said they would send the missing item. When we did not hear from them after an hour, we called again. The manger said that they made no mistake and that we received our entire order. She proceeded to scream over the phone and hung up on us. We tried to call back a few times including from another phone. They continued to hang up on us. As loyal customers for years, even before they delivered,  I hope that the $4.25 was worth the trade off of our continued business. We will not ever be ordering from them again.

I stayed here when I was here for a conference at Philadelphia. The conference arranged the accomodations for us, and I was assigned to share a room with a stranger (which I agreed to in advance). The dismay came when I checked in at the earliest possible time and I was told that I'd have to share the bed, because they didn't have any more rooms with twin beds available. 

It was ridiculous they didn't bother trying to do anything about that, especially when I checked in so early in the day. I later found out that they could've split the queen bed into two twin beds, and I was pissed...
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: Apparently they just reopened last week after 2 years of being forcibly closed as they rebuilt the complex. The restaurant is absolutely breathtaking and beautifully redone! A+ rating on decor!! They were packed so we had to wait a bit but it was well worth it! The BYOB policy is awesome especially with the wine store being just 2 doors down:-) Very very pleasant owner and staff. Professional, welcoming and most importantly DELICIOUS food. I will def be going back there again when next I'm in the area. Great job!

Don't get me wrong. The food was delicious. That isn't the problem. 
The problem is the service. No one seemed to be able to speak English and we had to ask twice for bread. Not to mention we had to ask for a menu while three waitresses stood around our table aimlessly! 

The problems with this restaurant are not insurmountable. As I said, the food was perfection. The service was so bad though, that it makes going back seem like a chore. If they can improve on that aspect? It would be a four or five star experience, easy.

We expected I'll Gattopardo to be better. Clams casino were inedible, far too salty. The highlight of the meal were the simple salads, but were overpriced. Pasta dishes were fine, but nothing out of the ordinary and very expensive. The fish (sea bass I think) was okay, but my husband said it was not the freshest tasting. The ambiance is nice, although the hard surfaces make the sound level high. I'm surprised to read anyone call the food "excellent." Very expensive for what is mostly pasta that didn't taste "homemade" as stated on the menu.

My wife and I placed an order for 200 donut holes and 6 custom lavender flavoured Bavarian cream with a lavender colored and grey icing. First off, I want to say that the staff here were so wonderful to talk through. They walked me through everything and answered my million questions. We picked up the doughnuts Saturday morning October 12. Had our ceremony and performed our doughnut cutting after. The flavor or the lavender Bavarian cream was out of this world!!! They did so amazing on giving it color and the taste of lavender. Thank you Holy Schmidt Donuts for making our wedding so much more with your creations!

$931 for a fuel pump on a 1998 Grand Marquis.  This included a $130 diagnostic fee even though I told them exactly what was wrong with my car.  I figured I would just pay it and move on.   

This occured two years ago but I recently had a fuel pump go out on a 2003 Grand Marquis and was charged less than $500 from a local shop in Manchester.  Both fuel pumps are in the fuel tank.  I didn't realize how bad they stuck it to me until the fuel pump went out on the 2003.  Thanks Dobbs for ripping me off.  It will never happen again.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: The hotel is really nice, great big rooms, very clean, nice beds, good free breakfast with delicious breakfast sandwiches and French toast. Also has a full bar in lobby and 24/7 food available from their "galley menu" but I never did order anything from them. Room had a refrigerator. Didn't give em five star because first room had some sort of leak coming in from the window and flooded one side of the room by the morning oops! Don't know if it had something to do with the ice storm outside. They quickly changed my room the next day with no issue and my new room was great and cozy.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I really needed a pick me up coffee so I went to a Dunkin' Donuts and they ruined my drink with so much sugar. I then went to this Dunkin' Donuts which was on my way ask them to fix the ice coffee that I received. Without any hesitation they did it with a smile on their face and blessed by day. Ingy was a amazing in how she handled a slightly upset guest. If I ran the store she'd be getting a two dollar raise. Thank you so much to this Dunkin' location for not ever letting me down. After writing this yelp review I am going to now go on their website and give a perfect score survey. #BESTDunkin'inflorida

Buyer Beware, this place is not the place to do business. They use alot of lies to tell you want you want to hear. Do not sign a break down consent on your transmission. If you do you will regret it. After signing they wanted to charge me 4700 dollars to rebuild a transmission. I could have purchased a new one for half the cost. When I told them to take a hike they got nasty. I had to call the police to get my car back. Cost me almost 400 dollars for the diagnostic. They wanted 600 but couldn't extort any more than 400 due to the consent I signed. Beware of these guys, do your homework. They are way overpriced and very dishonest.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: ok first off stay away... waiter was strange kept coming to out table to chat on xmas eve, rude, i felt as though he was dis respecting my husband and hitting in me.the food...chicken  piccata served with chicken gravy?? not mashed potatoes but polenta.. my dish..linguini and clams..clams in a can..burnt garlic that came up on me all night.. watery escarole soup.creepy guy behind bar.. do  not waste yiur time chef ramsey tried..just sell the place,how can thy serve that food and feel good about yourselves..and you call yourself italian?? no pride.

My sister went to this car wash and used to love the prior car wash company (Classic Car Wash), but was extremely dissatisfied with Spark. She paid $20 to drive through and did not include any interior cleaning or drying afterwards. When she got home she noticed a piece of rubber dangling from her car. She felt robbed and unsettled so she went back to complain. She asked and got confirmation that the $20 included only going through the car wash, but was allowed to go through again. She was grateful but bird poop was still on her car and windshield after 2 washes. This was the worst car wash she ever had and would not go back.

WOW Chef George Lacognia has hit this one out of the park with the opening of Bacco and Verne in Temple Terrace. My wife Sheryl our son Tony and good friend Sandy Work were treated like family by Chef George and his staff. The food was amazing the wine selections paired well with the dishes we ordered. Prosciutto wrapped scallops and the duck were simply delicious and we just had to sample all of the deserts to top off a delightful evening. I strongly recommend Bacco and Verne for a delightful culinary experience

DON'T take your car here for wax. I took mine in today and was told it would be about one hour and twenty min. Two hours and a half later they finished. I checked the car and it was not slick like a car normally is after it is waxed. I talked to the person that did the work and this is what I was told. They put the wax on with a buffer and they donot polish it after applying the wax. If you rub your hand across the paint it is rough. I rubbed a place in the door and shined it and it was slick like you would expect. The worker felt it and greed but he said that they just put the wax on and do not buff it after. STAY AWAY!!!!!!

Usually come here and its pretty good. However the last time I brought in my pet the doctor seeing him started telling me "you should get him neutered" and i said "i just haven't rly thought about it  cuz he's rly young still" and she started kind of like bashing me saying "so you want more animals to die!?you want your cat to get injured more just because you don't wanna neuter him!" And went on and on. I didnt really know how to respond because I just want my pet to be his normal self. So I just said "I'll think about it" Wish I had gotten her name.

Lexpro is only in it for the money and cry babies as owners.  I dropped off my car and they got mad when needed a ride home.  Poor service. Then they said my repair would be 1200 after finding the problem.  Another shop found the real problem a little hose that only cost me 180.00.  Jim is very demeaning on the phone and treats people with total disrespect.   I would never deal with this auto service shop for two reasons.  Not doing the right thing for customers. Pure greed to fill his pocket book. Second totally unprofessional on the phone and at the office.

I normally go to this shop however, the last time I went they quoted me 0ver $870. before tax to fix my brakes.  I was horrified wondering how this was even possible. They said the car needed new Calipers. I could never afford this. long story took it to another mechanic who my family uses and after looking at my car he said I do not need new calipers.  I ended up paying $415. for front and back brakes and an oil change!  I will never go back to this Brake Max store.  The triple A truck driver told me he has had lot's of complaints about this particular store.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: I will forever tell people to stay way from this place. Took my suv in to get a small problem fixed. Waited over an hour then they came out and told me I needed over a $1,000 in repairs. They said they wouldn't fix my original problem because it was unsafe. I left with out them fixing anything. Took it to another mechanic. He put my car on s lift and physically showed me the parts they were talking about. Only one thing the said needed to be fixed. The other mechanic fixed it and the original issue go just over $200. These guys are crooks and they were flat out rude when I told them I was going somewhere else. Find somebody else to go to.
categories: Auto Repair, Automotive, Oil Change Stations, Tires

text: This was the worst room I've ever had in a hotel. The bathroom was only the size of the toilet - to get into it you have to open the door all the way, which closes off the sink. To take a shower, you have to close the door all the way or the shower door won't open. It was extremely uncomfortable. Everything was run down, stained, and dirty. The room made noises all night. Sadly, it cost more than the other conference hotel options, which were all nicer. On top of everything, they charged me for using a mini bar I never even saw. Choose any hotel in New Orleans over this one!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I love the hotel!  (Usually).  This time a lot of the staff was inattentive and rude!  I do realize that they are short staffed, but they were exceptionally rude.  When we asked for a blanket for my daughter, they said no.  After asking again, they sent up an obviously used duvet cover.  When I went downstairs for a cup of coffee, I sat at the bar area for 15 min. And then was told to go to Starbucks (two blocks away).  (And the Starbucks wasn't where she had sent me!!).  Obviously we will stay at another hotel next time!!
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I got my eye exam here. They do a thorough job and I had no problems. Very nice helpful staff. The problem is that most of their frames are pretty expensive. After the exam, I tried on different glasses and found a pair I liked. When I asked the price, they were $495 for the frames alone. I cant afford that even with an insurance discount. Sadly, for me, I dont think they have a large selection under $300. They do have some of the most interesting frames in town and this would certainly have to be a long term investment.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: This rent-a car company is the absolute worst. I had no problems with this company before up until now. I rented a car on 4/19/13 at 12:30 am I took my car back on4/23/13. When I took my car back I was not greeted the representative was very unpleasant and made me miss my flight which (made me miss a day of work unpaid)! I called to speak to a manager no manager was ever available nor did I receive a call back. They are still holding money and refuse to release it. I now go to Alamo! I will say this they are good but one bad seed has ruined the whole bunch for me!!!

I've tried their lunch special a few times now and its always hit or miss. Ribs are usually good, but beware of "rib-eye" steak lunches! I've gone here 4 times for rib-eye steak and have only gotten a rib-eye twice! 50/50! Although, 1 time was a strip steak, it wasn't bad, just not what was advertised. This last time I went, it wasn't even steak! It was some sort of rump roast cut into steak looking slices, grilled and passed off as steak! That's false advertising, and not worth the $7!!! 

So Freddies, if you're going to do rib-eye steak lunch, serve a rib-eye steak. If not, at least call it "steak" lunch. You're not fooling anyone.

I appreciate the prices at this store. I like most, the family-sized portions in the meat department. I son;t like that there were certain Asian products that we unavailable because it makes me have to shop at a place farther away from my home. Simple items I think they should stock. such as sesame oil and other small items. The store is MOSTY clean although, this past summer I brought an out of towner into the store after bragging about it and was embarrassed at how unclean it was. Shame in the manager for not making certain the employees aren't staying up on their job in that area.

The food was decent but the staff was rude and the service was terrible. In fact, I was shocked by how bad the service was. The waitress brought out the wrong food and then tried to argue over what was ordered rather than fixing the mistake. They eventually fixed their mistake after waiting an hour for the food. But then they gave us the wrong bill. The manager was rude too. The waitress and the manager never said sorry nor did they offer a discount for their mistake. Since it was a large party, they automatically applied a tip to the meal. Obviously, they did not deserve one.

I do like the prices during happy hour, everything is half off. They offer free miso soup and edamame or salad. The rolls are decent, but the fried rice I ordered was awful. I don't know if it was the seasoning, or all of the vegetables like corn and broccoli in it that I'm not used to, but I just couldn't finish it. The decor was decent for a low-key place, not fancy, but it wasn't dirty. The service has been hit and miss, you either get your food right away or you wait forever. One of the more irritating things about the place was they'd serve us at different times. I'd get my food, then almost 10 minutes later my fiance got his.

I had very disappointing service at this restaurant. The food was adequate. However, the server in the pink shirt with the ponytail discriminated against my African American friend who was visiting from Maryland. I am deeply offended and ashamed I would hope this warning is heeded by all prospective customers- the servers at this establishment are rude and conniving DO NOT VISIT this location. 

- despite my displeasure at the Brentwood location, the HWY 70 establishment "U.S. Border Cantina" is highly accommodating

Got an appt right away. They kept me waiting forever. The worst part was the sale dept. I was pretty sure I was not going to buy glasses, however I may have. the older lady who helped me snubbed me and was quite rude. I asked about my temple size and she acted like I was retarded and she knew everything. She kept using jargon and terms to confuse me. When I asked her what that meant, she snubbed me by saying "You should know, you order on line"  I guess she wasnt making commission off of me, so I was dirt to her. HORRIBLE experience.
categories: Eyewear & Opticians, Health & Medical, Optometrists, Shopping

text: I can't agree with the negative reviews.  Our experience was positive.  Only negative is due to the small interior of the restaurant/bar any loud patrons will be a bit annoying when added to normal background noise.  We had one such guy right behind us.  Not being from here allowed us to know everything going on at his workplace.  Anyway, I had burger and fries and wife had chicken sandwich and both were very good.  Setting record straight, there are 10 tables inside and 9 bar stools.  Exterior seating on porch was served by waitress.  Staff was nice and accommodating, food was served promptly.  We will return if back this way.

Had a half day meeting with a businessman who lived equidistant to the hotel, a 120 miles car trip for each of us.

I gave the hotel a 1/2 day notice and they set us up in a very nice alcove at the restaurant where we had lunch.

The staff was responsive, the facilities were excellent, and the lunch we had was sufficient for what we needed. My only peeve was that parking costs ($20) as the Marriott spaces were all used and if the meeting exceeds 3 hours. The reduced rate is about $5. That's the problem with having a meeting at the airport for entrepreneurs on their own dime.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: A horrible place to eat. I would not suggest to come here. The food is not cooked properly & it is cold when you get it. The chicken is rubbery & burnt. The servers do not come to check on you & have bad attitudes. Nobody helps at all. We had a large party and when we came to the door she said "you guys can ask that man to move or you can to that table or I don't know" & walked away to the back. We moved once and the server said we messed her up because she kept messing up our order. Horrible horrible service. Never coming here again.

Dinner for 4 with reservation. Sat in a timely fashion. Ordered drinks and appetizer.  Came out and the calamari was delish aside from them leaving the shells on the few shrimp on the platter. Gnocchi pesto goid, alfredo excellebt. Husband ordered a filet medium and it came well done. Sent back. After 25 minutes when the steak came out he refused it because we were all done eating. Not even a drink was offered to him while waiting for his steak. No manager came over to apologize.  Too many restaurants out there to accept sub par service and food.

Great Food, Great Drinks!. Just went to my usually hangout spot at Luisa's and another excellent meal I had. I like how they changed up their drink menu and started having drink specials, nice job guys! Had my usually bruschetta and shrimp scampi to start and changed it up from this time, from my usual tortellini and chicken to the lamb shank and veggies, no regrets there. I like how they changed up their drink menu and started advertising drink specials, nice job guys! Great cesare drink with the lemon sliced rim and the decorated celery to top it off. Once again, ill be back for more!

What a great hidden treasure we found on our afternoon walk while staying at a local hotel!!!!  The Cozy Coffee Cafe was first of all, extremely clean!! All employees wearing mask and very welcoming.   While talking to the owners, they had explained their opening date was March 9th. It's safe to say, the timing wasn't the greatest, but their enthusiasm, certainly is! 
My husband wanted a full breakfast for lunch, while I had their Cuban sandwich, two thumbs up! 
You won't  be disappointed if you're in the area! Enjoy!!!!!!

45 mins with a vet tech and 5 minutes with a vet. If you want to feel like you're on the receiving end of a sales pitch, or someone who works on commission, you'd be in the right place! I can't believe the "pre-invoice" was almost $400 for a pet that had no temperature - she just didn't feel very good!!! They don't any lab work there and they would not do any procedure in front of us! That made me very suspicious - regardless of their reasoning - and the fast talking salesman - I mean, vet tech - had 'reasoning' for everything. We cut our losses and left. We won't be back.

Worse drive thru experience EVER!  I was the ONLY 1 in the drive thru and ordered 2 fish sandwiches during Lent.  After 5 minutes, I was told to park.  I thought my order was done!  I waited 5 more minutes and went inside.  They hadn't even dropped my fish yet!  I had to wait nearly another 10 minutes to get my food.  Mind you the restaurant had VERY light volume and they were struggling to get food out.

Arbys do yourself a favor and close this location.  It's not servicing the public in any acceptable fashion.

Manager on duty during my visit was horrific.  He answered the phone while taking our order ok cool, then continued to talk on the phone throughout us ordering.  That wasn't bad enough he came out to lobby to get himself a drink cutting off the person with me waiting to get her drink.  To back he goes, then the driver thru employee asked me to fill a coke for her customer at the drive thru window as I stood at the front waiting for my food.  It was just sitting there finally the cook making sandwiches came around and gathered up our order.  I can assure you that employee is the best thing this location has going for them!

My wife and I just ate here tonight. We were one of the first couples seated for dinner. We used to come here when it was Tiramisu. There was a musty smell in the dining area. As more people started to come in the smell seemed to disappear. One other annoying aspect was you could hear the phone ringing, and the caller ID announcing who was calling.  Aside from that, the food was very good! The portions were alright, but the side of vegetables (particularly the spinach) was really small.

We would certainly give it another try just based on the quality of the food!

Very very disappointed. I've been to La Boca and thought it was great so I anticipated this would be of the same merit. Waiter was nice but cocktails took a while to come out but overall the service was OK. 

Fruta di mari was the best thing we had and it was just ok. Carbonara was soupy, amatriciana was bland, flank steak was very chewy (medium rare), panna cotta was literally terrible and the sorbet tasted like it had been in a freezer at a grocery store too long. And after the bill came i left feeling like I got pick pocketed. Definitely avoid.

This is an example of a horrible restaurant. I gave it 1 star only because I had to give it something. They only had 1 person taking orders and the line was very long. It took 10 minutes just to order. It then too another 10 minutes to get the meal I ordered. The food was only warm not hot and the fries were soggy. When I finished I went to the counter and asked for a refill on my drink. The little girl told me we don't do refills. Then she turned and walked off and would not respond to me again. I have never in my life been refused a refill on a drink in any establishment. This McDonalds is the worst McDonalds I have ever seen. Stay away.
categories: Burgers, Coffee & Tea, Fast Food, Food, Restaurants

text: In the last month, I met my neighbors, who were nice! It's seems like the residents are very diverse in age, career, and "season of life," which I really enjoy. The community is quite and people mostly keep to themselves, but every time I've passed someone and said "hi," I've been met with pleasant returns! The home itself is nice. The big plus, which I just discovered, is that a park with great hiking and biking trails is nearby, called Southwestway Park. It's great to be so close to green space in the city!

I am SO disappointed in the chef salad I received tonight.  While it basically cost me what a Special sandwich would, I was hard pressed to find the meat on it.  Subway had closed at 7 pm or I would have gotten a chopped salad from them.  I wouldn't have had to wonder where the meat was on it either.  
I have hit or miss experiences with sandwiches here too.  I love a hot special, loaded with toppings and when it is actually CRUSTY so you can TELL it has been toasted but sometimes there is hardly any crunch to it.  One time I will get a nice size sandwich, next time it will look like they were running short of bread.  I guess live and learn.

Consistantly poor service.  Haven't ordered to go here in months. I decided to give them another try. I asked the server specifically if she had my items in the bag. Once again they screwed the order up. 
My side salad was a bowl of lettuce. No carrots. No cheese. No dressing. Just a bowl of lettuce. I ordered, and offered to pay for, extra yum yum sauce. They didn't put it in the bag.  I asked for spicy sauce with my lettuce wraps. They didn't put it in the bag. 
The food is good when you get it all. 

Frankly, I think the only reason this place is still in business is because there isn't another Japanese steak house for 15 miles.

Never coming back! Brought dog in for a lump he was licking. I was told it could be removed but to give him medicine because it had to be scheduled and they were a month out. Within a week it got worse only now the procedure they quoted me for was to Cost double. Explained this was not acceptable but they left me no
Options. 2 hour procedure and they held the dog for
Over 5 hours! I know it was because I gave them attitude over how it was handled. They agreed to do it for the original quoted price but held the dog until closing.  They literally locked the door before bringing him out.

I'm so torn! In one hand I love this place, the people that work there, and the food. In the other hand, I had my first bad experience but with my first ever delivery from them. The worst food delivery I have had so far, compared to other restaurants. The food container was sideways causing the rice and enchilada sauce to spill everywhere in the bag. It got all over the napkins, straw wrapper, and the food was all piled together to one side from it being tilted. It was a mess. GrubHub gave me a 10% discount on the next order.... I paid full price and already left a tip for this spilled bag...Other than that, the food was amazing, hot and fresh.

What do you do when you and your two guests are the only patrons there - at dinner time - and the adult cashier is so bewildered?  

When you order a Beef 'n Cheddar and he asks what kind of cheese you want on it?  Twice.  (You thought you heard him wrong the first time.)  

When you order three meals and he gives you two cups before walking away from the counter for five minutes?  

When he brings the food out but forgets one of the three meals?  - a full third of the place's orders.  Just what do you do?  Resolve not to go there ever again?  Write a review on Yelp?  Pray for the cashier?

Shit place, bad attitude !!!
We booked a room for 4 people we got to the place to a small room the manager did not let us go into the main lobby at all and talk. We talked to him through a small window and showed him the invitation for 4 people and he said that on his computer it is written for 2 people. We showed him our order in the Booking app and he did not want to look at the order and rudely expelled us and told us if you ordered online you will enter the app again and order or cancel and kept yelling and chasing us out even though we are his customers. It was degrading behavior! This is not a service
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text:
The place is beautiful  but don't move here if you want to get mail. No packages are ever found.  We ordered art prints and USPS says scanned but no where. Ups, fedex, Amazon all the same. Packages disappear and Mgmt NEVER responds.  Patio Door has been leaking since moved in.  Hurricane caused the glass to majorly crack and no response.  

Shame because the location is great and amenities are nice.  But working nights at the hospital , we need to be able to get packages delivered and can't be there to wait on them.  And we need to be able to communicate effectively with office.

Do NOT rent from these people. Shuttle does not run 24 hours. It is impossible to contact the office - one of the numbers listed is an 800 number - and the people who answer have no jurisdiction over local operations. The other number listed is a local number - if you call it, it will go straight to voicemail. I had to pay $75 for a cab to my hotel as the shuttle was not running - and when I showed Advantage my receipt they stalled and I still have not been reimbursed - probably never will be. The manager is totally uncooperative and isn't interested in dealing with legitimate customer complaints.

I wouldn't trust the positive reviews here. Lighthouse will not respond to month old maintenance requests however they send frequent emails offering a chance for $100 off rent for "non anonymous" reviews on apartmentratings google or yelp. See attached picture. With the cost of rent being so high maintenance should be available as needed. The grounds are not kept well at all. There are goose and dog droppings all over the property. Despite being in a nonsmoking unit our hallway constantly smells like cigarette smoke. I will be moving out as soon as my lease ends.

If you're itching for a light dessert, along with a pleasant experience, yogi's might be the calamine you're searching for.  The concept of a self-serve frozen yogurt bar is brilliant in and of itself. Taste is the selling factor but the number and variety of toppings are deal breakers. Yogi's vanilla with assorted fruit toppings is delicious but it may disappoint some chocolate lovers. Overall, it's a great dessert spot but there's nothing here to separate yogi's from other yogurt spots. For frequenters of these places, some of your choice favorites may be missing as well.

Seriously, everyone was so friendly and energetic that I thought they were being observed by a boss or a travel writer.  Pick-up to and from the airport was fast and each time the driver rushed to help with my bags.  We were offered water and soft pretzels each time but we would never have the chance to consume them, check-in and drop-off were fast and painless.  I wanted the Charger but was happy with the Maxima.  I paid a good rate for a new car in great shape with low miles.  I can only hope for the same overall experience the next time I rent.

If I could give this company zero stars I would! After a late arrival to airport the agent said my credit card and debit card both would not swipe. Both worked perfectly fine everywhere else. They would not manually enter and did not have pin pad capabilities. Therefore they had to rent my car to my underage son and double the price of my rental. Completely ridiculous and customer service was rude. They even tried to make my son sign a hand written waiver that no one else was going to drive the car. This day in age I would think they would have proper equipment to process credit cards.

The hotel decor is beautiful. The beds are comfy and the food with room service wasn't bad but don't ask the front desk agent any questions or she gets an attitude! We asked about extra towels and she got irritated. We asked about breakfast at the hotel in the morning and she handed us a brochure. She kept having side conversations gossiping about co-workers with other staff. The police in the building were more helpful and polite than the front desk agent. Terrible customer service but once again GREAT rooms.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text: I can't remember the last time we were in a place this run down and crappy. Kids were starving so we stopped here while passing through. Pizza was soggy, hot sandwich was cold, beer was warm. How this place stays open I have no idea. Dirty and run down beyond belief. Health inspector must be a realitive or was paid off. Jose behind the counter could care less. Scary to think he made our food with his flighty hands. Yes, I'm a dumb ass for not walking out when I know I should have. See a common theme here? This is my first yelp review but have never felt this strongly about a place to leave a one!

Horrible place to live. The staff is extremely rude and disrespectful especially Tracy. The living conditions awful almost 3rd world considering the fact that they shut the water and air off almost weekly for "repairs". The rent is outrageous and is raised bi-monthly. The elevators are always breaking down as well as plumbing and an ongoing issue with water leaks leading to mold in walls and floors. 
  There is so much more I could add... the list goes on forever. 
   All in all the worst place I have ever lived!

Had a suit jacket that I didn't realized needed cleaning until the day before I needed it.  Took it to Comet at 5 pm on a Friday and told them that I needed it by noon the next day.  I knew it was probably a long shot, but they said they could get it done.  Everything was great, the mystery stain was gone and it was cleaned and pressed right when they said it would be done.  

I spoke to two different ladies, one when I dropped off and one when I picked up and they were both very pleasant people.  

I'd easily recommend this location to anyone.
categories: Dry Cleaning & Laundry, Laundry Services, Local Services

text: Terrible food. Outrageous prices for the specials. Paid far far too much for an appetizer saturated in balsamic, for a salad with barely any taste, salmon so doused in red sauce that there is no reason it had to be salmon, and a steak so bland that only table-ready salt and pepper could revive it from its culinary coma. Service was very bad as well.  We were there for an hour and 15 minutes and we didn't even have our salads. DO NOT GO HERE! I am perplexed as to the 4 and 5 stars this place has gotten on Yelp.  Drive South toward Philly for some good food or cook at home.

My wife and I visited Franklin, TN two weekends ago. We had the pleasure of eating at Zolo's. The food was very good and the service as well. Servers were very polite and clean looking; food was hot and served in a timely manner. The place was very clean as well. This is our third time visiting Franklin and we always dine at Zolo's authentic Italian restaurant.  You can tell that the owners take pride in their business. We have dined at several Italian establishment over the years and this is one of the best.Highly recommend.

This hotel was pretty nasty. Overall, it smelled musty throughout. The room itself and beds were damp. Wouldn't be surprised if mold is lingering underneath wallpaper, which was also damp and peeling. The headboards were all scratched up and falling apart. There was damage to walls throughout the room. We were there for a soccer tournament and were booked as a team, otherwise we probably would have left. This is the first Doubletree we've stayed in that was in bad shape. Definitely would not recommend until major renovations are made.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel, Venues & Event Spaces

text:
I stayed here for several nights on a work trip. Each night we were awakened by screaming and stomping in the next room as late as 3:30am. They also left the TV on full volume while they were out late and let their morning alarms go off for half an hour uninterrupted, presumably because they were blacked out from the night before. 

We spoke to our loud neighbors in person in the middle of the night, asking nicely for some quiet, and talked to the front desk several times about the problem. Staff intervened very reluctantly and argued with us over minute details of our complaint, as if we were making it up. Hardly slept the whole time.
categories: Event Planning & Services, Hotels, Hotels & Travel

text: The food was okay. We choose this place because there was a Yelp deal $20 for $30. The deal was incorrectly applied to the final cost of our meal. We only had $20 subtracted from the total cost of our meal instead of $30. So ultimately we did not save anything and paid full price in the end. The waitor did not correctly apply our Yelp deal. It was too late and not worth the hassle once we realized it. There was a nice ambiance to the place. The cheaper meals were really basic and you had to pay extra for things you wanted to add on.

Being new to the area I did my research of Salons close by.  I chose Blue Gemini, booked my appointment on line for a shampoo, cut and style.  I even chose my Stylist and amount charged for the service.  Well, imagine my surprise when I was charged $20 more when I went to pay.  How are salons able to advertise one price and charge after the service a much higher amount?  I didn't complain when left waiting for a lengthy period of time, I almost expect that.  Megan did a nice job cutting my hair but it was not worth the $85 I was charged.  I was hoping I had found my new Salon, I guess my search continues.

Planet Fitness in Plant City is not enforcing the mask requirement. They require you to be wearing one to enter but, once you are past the front desk no one is enforcing this requirement. Several of their employees walk around with their nose sticking out of their mask or wearing the mask under their chin. When I reported this to the manager she told me that " She can't make everyone happy". She also told me that the County mask requirement had been discontinued. At any given time, half of the people in this business are walking around less than six feet from other people with no mask on.
categories: Active Life, Fitness & Instruction, Gyms, Trainers

text: About the only good thing I can say about Advantage is that their van drivers are very courteous. Beyond that...the line at their off-airport trailer was very long, they woked way too hard selling extras, and they add a $200 "just in case" charge to your card until you return the car. Just in case you wreck it, someone else runs into you, you don't put enough gas in it, etc. if you use a debit card, that money is held. Then after finding our way finally back to their trailer, we were an hour late with the return. That cost us an extra day. Pay a bit more and rent on-airport with a more reputable company. They weren't worth the cheaper rates.
